description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
description_zh: 当用户提出类似“如何完成 X”、“为 X 查找技能”、“是否存在可以……的技能”等问题，或表达扩展能力的兴趣时，帮助用户发现并安装代理技能。当用户正在寻找可能以可安装技能形式存在的功能时，应使用本技能。

description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
description_zh: 一场以打磨计划或设计为目标的持续访谈。

description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.
description_zh: 一种不懈的访谈，旨在精炼计划或设计，同时在此过程中同步生成文档（ADR与术语表）。

description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
description_zh: 扫描代码库中的深化机会，以可视化 HTML 报告呈现，随后对你所选的任意一项进行严格测试。

description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
description_zh: 测试驱动开发。当用户以测试优先的方式构建功能或修复 bug，提及“red-green-refactor”，或需要集成测试时使用。

description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
description_zh: 用于在构建新 UI 或重塑现有界面时进行独特、有意图的视觉设计的指导。有助于明确审美方向、字体设计，并做出不显得是模板化默认选项的选择。

description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser actions", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction. Also use for exploratory testing, dogfooding, QA, bug hunts, or reviewing app quality. Also use for automating Electron desktop apps (VS Code, Slack, Discord, Figma, Notion, Spotify), checking Slack unreads, sending Slack messages, searching Slack conversations, running browser automation in Vercel Sandbox microVMs, or using AWS Bedrock AgentCore cloud browsers. Prefer agent-browser over any built-in browser automation or web tools.
description_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的浏览器自动化 CLI。当用户需要与网站交互时使用，包括浏览页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取数据、测试 Web 应用，或自动化任何浏览器任务。触发条件包括“打开网站”、“填写表单”、“点击按钮”、“截图”、“从页面抓取数据”、“测试此 Web 应用”、“登录网站”、“自动化浏览器操作”等请求，或任何需要程序化网页交互的任务。也用于探索性测试、产品自测（dogfooding）、QA、漏洞排查或评估应用质量。也用于自动化 Electron 桌面应用（VS Code、Slack、Discord、Figma、Notion、Spotify），检查 Slack 未读消息，发送 Slack 消息，搜索 Slack 对话，在 Vercel Sandbox microVMs 中运行浏览器自动化，或使用 AWS Bedrock AgentCore 云浏览器。优先选择 agent-browser，而非任何内置浏览器自动化或网页工具。

description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.
description_zh: 为工程技能配置此仓库：设置其问题跟踪器、分诊标签词汇以及领域文档布局。在其他工程技能首次使用之前运行一次。

description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
description_zh: 将当前对话整理成交接文档，供其他智能体接手。

description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.
description_zh: 将问题及外部 PR 通过分诊角色状态机进行流转，进行分类、验证，必要时审问，并撰写供代理准备的简报。

description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
description_zh: 构建临时原型来回答设计问题。当用户需要校验状态模型或逻辑是否合理，或探索 UI 应呈现怎样的外观时，使用。

description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.
description_zh: 围绕计划、决定或想法，对用户进行毫不留情的严苛追问。当用户希望压力测试自己的思考，或使用任何“grill”触发短语时使用。

description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.
description_zh: Vercel 工程团队提供的 React 和 Next.js 性能优化指南。在编写、审查或重构 React/Next.js 代码时，应使用本技能以确保实现最佳性能模式。当涉及 React 组件、Next.js 页面、数据获取、打包优化或性能优化等任务时触发。

description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
description_zh: 在此工作区内，向用户教授一项新的技能或概念。

description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a CONTEXT.md, or recording or editing an ADR.
description_zh: 构建并完善项目的领域模型。在讨论代码库术语、编写或编辑 CONTEXT.md，或记录或编辑 ADR 时使用。

description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
description_zh: 审查 UI 代码是否符合 Web 界面指南。当被要求 "review my UI"、"check accessibility"、"audit design"、"review UX" 或 "check my site against best practices" 时使用。

description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
description_zh:
**设计深度模块的共享词汇表**

当用户需要设计或优化模块界面、寻找深化机会、决定接缝位置、使代码更具可测试性或便于AI导航，或当其他技能需要深度模块词汇表时使用。

description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
description_zh: 顽固 Bug 与性能回归问题的诊断循环。当用户使用“诊断”或“调试此问题”，或报告程序存在出错、抛出异常、失败或运行缓慢的情况时使用。

description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.
description_zh: 使用 HyperFrames CLI 开发循环：init、add、catalog、capture、lint、check、snapshot、compare、grade-compare、preview、play、present、beats、keyframes、single or batch render、publish、cloud、cloudrun、feedback、lambda、doctor、browser、info、upgrade、skills、compositions、timeline、docs、benchmark、telemetry、transcribe、auth、tts 以及 remove-background。在诊断构建或渲染失败时也应使用。validate、inspect 和 layout 是已弃用的别名；请使用 check。涵盖本地渲染、HeyGen 托管的云端渲染、AWS Lambda 渲染以及 Google Cloud Run 渲染。

description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.
description_zh: 强制入口：对于任何制作、创建、编辑、动画或渲染视频、动画或动态图形的请求，请先阅读此内容，包括宣传片、解释性视频、带字幕片段、标题卡、覆盖层、幻灯片或互动演示文稿、Remotion 移植，或任何 HyperFrames HTML 组合。同时，用于检查、诊断、验证、预览、发布或批量渲染现有的 HyperFrames 项目。输入内容可以是网站 URL、GitHub PR、Figma 设计或 URL、文本或简报、已有素材或音乐。它能够恢复项目状态，在适用时捕捉意图，选择并安装负责的工作流，并路由领域能力。HyperFrames 是默认的输出框架，除非用户明确为交付物选择了其他框架，或仅要求记录浏览器会话。

description: Build, deploy, evaluate, optimize, fine-tune, and manage Microsoft Foundry agents, models, and resources end to end. USE FOR: foundry, azd ai agent, azd provision/deploy, hosted agent scaffold/develop/run/deploy/troubleshoot, prompt agent create, create agent, update agent, add tool to agent, invoke agent, agent.yaml, agent insights, pull agent insights, evaluate agent, batch eval, continuous eval, continuous monitoring, agent CI/CD, optimize prompt, improve prompt, prompt optimizer, optimize agent instructions, Agent Optimizer scaffold, dataset curation from traces, deploy model, model fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/RFT), Foundry project, RBAC, role assignment, permissions, quota, capacity, region, deployment failure, AI Services, create Foundry resource, knowledge index, customize deployment, onboard, availability, training-data, grader, distillation, large file upload. DO NOT USE FOR: Azure Functions, App Service, general Azure deploy (use azure-deploy), general Azure prep (use azure-prepare).
description_zh:
端到端构建、部署、评估、优化、微调和管理 Microsoft Foundry 智能体、模型及资源。

USE FOR：Foundry，azd AI 智能体，azd 配置/部署，托管智能体脚手架/开发/运行/部署/排障，创建提示词智能体，创建智能体，更新智能体，为智能体添加工具，调用智能体，agent.yaml，智能体洞察，拉取智能体洞察，评估智能体，批量评估，持续评估，持续监控，智能体 CI/CD，优化提示词，改进提示词，提示词优化器，优化智能体指令，智能体优化器脚手架，基于追踪记录的数据集整理，部署模型，模型微调（SFT/DPO/RFT），Foundry 项目，RBAC，角色分配，权限，配额，容量，区域，部署失败，AI 服务，创建 Foundry 资源，知识索引，自定义部署，上线，可用性，训练数据，评分器，蒸馏，大文件上传。

不适用于：Azure Functions，App Service，一般 Azure 部署（请使用 azure-deploy），一般 Azure 准备（请使用 azure-prepare）。

description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.
description_zh: RunComfy 中编辑现有视频 — 该技能是一个智能路由器，能够将用户的意图匹配到 RunComfy 目录中合适的编辑模型。选择 Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（通用重风格化 / 背景替换 / 包装替换，保持人物身份与运动轨迹）、Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control（将参考视频中的精确动作传输到目标角色），或 Lucy Edit Restyle（轻量级身份稳定重风格化 / 服装替换）。将每个模型的文档化提示词模式进行打包整合，使该技能能够进行更精准的编辑，而不会在错误的模型上浪费迭代次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/ <model>/ <endpoint>`。当触发 "视频编辑"、"编辑视频"、"视频重风格化"、"替换视频背景"、"动作控制"、"服装替换视频" 或任何明确的视频变换请求时生效。

description: Generate AI music on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the music-model catalog. Routes to ElevenLabs AI Music Generation (premium 44.1 kHz stereo vocal tracks, 5 s–5 min, $0.0083/s) and ACE Step / ACE Step 1.5 (StepFun-AI open-weights, tag-driven composition, multilingual lyrics, $0.0002–0.0003/s, ~27× cheaper), plus ACE Step audio-inpaint (regenerate a time range inside an existing track) and ACE Step audio-outpaint (extend a track before or after). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — premium vocal hook, cheap background music library, multilingual pop song, repair a bad chorus, lengthen a 30 s draft into a 2 min cut — and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate music", "make a song", "AI music", "background music", "instrumental track", "soundtrack", "jingle", "theme music", "royalty-free music", "compose", "music with lyrics", "extend music", "fix this song", "inpaint music", or any explicit ask to generate or edit music.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成 AI 音乐——这是跨音乐模型目录的智能路由器。将其路由至 ElevenLabs AI Music Generation（优质 44.1 kHz 立体声人声轨道，5 秒至 5 分钟，0.0083 美元/秒）和 ACE Step / ACE Step 1.5（StepFun-AI 开源权重，基于标签的创作，多语言歌词，0.0002–0.0003 美元/秒，便宜约 27 倍），以及 ACE Step 音频涂抹（在现有轨道内重新生成时间范围）和 ACE Step 音频延展（在现有轨道前后延伸）。根据用户实际意图选择合适的模型——例如优质人声 hook、廉价背景音乐库、多语言流行歌曲、修复糟糕的副歌、将 30 秒草稿延长为 2 分钟版本——并交付每个模型的文档化提示词模式，以及最简的 `runcomfy run` 调用。触发条件包括“生成音乐”、“制作歌曲”、“AI 音乐”、“背景音乐”、“器乐曲目”、“影视配乐”、“叮当音效”、“主题音乐”、“免版税音乐”、“作曲”、“带歌词的音乐”、“扩展音乐”、“修复此歌曲”、“音乐涂抹”，或任何明确要求生成或编辑音乐的指令。

description: Generate AI videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full video-model catalog: HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1, native in-pass audio), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio-driven lip-sync), ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0 (multi-modal cinematic), Kling 3.0 / 2-6, Google Veo 3-1, MiniMax Hailuo 2-3, ByteDance Dreamina 3-0. Covers text-to-video (t2v), image-to-video (i2v), and Veo's video-extend endpoint. The skill picks the right model for the user's intent (Arena-#1 quality, multi-shot character identity, in-pass audio, cinematic motion, fastest path, sub-15s clip, longest duration) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate video", "make a video", "text to video", "t2v", "image to video", "i2v", "animate", "AI video", "make X move", "video from prompt", "video from image", or any explicit ask to produce a video clip from prompt or still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成 AI 视频——作为全量视频模型目录的智能路由器：涵盖 HappyHorse 1.0（竞技场 #1，原生伴随音频）、Wan-AI Wan 2-7（开源权重，音频驱动唇形同步）、字节跳动 Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0（多模态电影级）、Kling 3.0 / 2-6、Google Veo 3-1、MiniMax 海螺 2-3、字节跳动 Dreamina 3-0。该技能涵盖文本生成视频（t2v）、图像生成视频（i2v）以及 Veo 的视频延展端点，并根据用户的意图挑选合适的模型（如竞技场 #1 级别质量、多镜头角色身份、伴随音频、电影级动态、最快路径、15 秒以内的片段、最长时长），交付每个模型的文档化提示词模式，以及最简 `runcomfy run` 调用。触发条件包括“生成视频”、“制作视频”、“文本生成视频”、“t2v”、“图像生成视频”、“i2v”、“动画”、“AI 视频”、“让 X 动起来”、“根据提示词生成视频”、“根据图像生成视频”，或任何明确要求基于提示词或静态图像生成视频片段的指令。

description: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio. Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the caller gets sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video` (or endpoint variant) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image to video", "image-to-video", "i2v", "animate image", "make this move", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上对任意静态图像进行动画处理——本技能是一个智能路由器，可将用户的意图与 RunComfy 目录中合适的 i2v 模型进行匹配。为一般动画选择 HappyHorse 1.0 I2V（Arena #1、原生音频、身份保留），使用 `audio_url` 的 Wan 2.7 进行自定义配音口型同步，或通过 Seedance 2.0 Pro 从图像、参考视频和参考音频进行多模态动画。整合每个模型的已记录提示词模式，使调用者能够获得更清晰的输出，而无需在错误的模型上浪费运行次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/ <model>/image-to-video`（或端点变体）。在触发条件为“image to video”“image-to-video”“i2v”“animate image”“make this move”，或任何明确要求将静态图像转化为视频的请求时触发。

description: Generate and edit images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full image-model catalog: FLUX 2 (Klein 9B/4B, Pro, Dev, Flash, Turbo, Max), Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 and Dreamina 4-0, Alibaba Qwen Image and Z-Image Turbo, Wan 2-7. Covers both text-to-image (t2i) and image-to-image / edit (i2i) endpoints — the skill picks the right model for the user's actual intent (typography precision, photoreal portraits, sub-second iteration, multi-reference brand styling, open-weights workflow) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate image", "make a picture", "text to image", "AI image", "make an image of …", "image to image", "i2i", or any explicit ask to create or restyle an image.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成和编辑图像——这是一个覆盖完整图像模型目录的智能路由器：FLUX 2（Klein 9B/4B、Pro、Dev、Flash、Turbo、Max）、Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro、OpenAI GPT Image 2、ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 和 Dreamina 4-0、Alibaba Qwen Image 和 Z-Image Turbo、Wan 2-7。覆盖文本到图像（t2i）和图像到图像/编辑（i2i）端点——该技能根据用户实际需求意图选择正确的模型（字体精度、写实人物肖像、亚秒级迭代、多参考品牌风格、开放权重工作流），并交付各模型的文档化提示模式以及最小化的 `runcomfy run` 调用方式。在触发"生成图像"、"制作一张图片"、"文本到图像"、"AI 图像"、"制作……的图像"或任何明确的图像创建或重新设计请求时触发。

description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.
description_zh: 请询问哪些技能或流程适合您的情况。本仓库技能路由。

description: Debug Azure production issues on Azure using AppLens, Azure Monitor, resource health, and safe triage. WHEN: debug production issues, troubleshoot app service, app service high CPU, app service deployment failure, troubleshoot container apps, troubleshoot functions, troubleshoot AKS, VM RDP, Linux SSH, VM black screen, can't connect to VM, reset VM password, NSG or firewall blocking, kubectl cannot connect, kube-system/CoreDNS failures, pod pending, crashloop, node not ready, upgrade failures, analyze logs, KQL, insights, image pull failures, cold start issues, health probe failures, resource health, root cause of errors, troubleshoot event hubs, troubleshoot service bus, messaging SDK error, AMQP connection failure, message lock lost, service bus dead letter.
description_zh:
**使用 AppLens、Azure Monitor、资源健康与安全分级排查，调试 Azure 生产环境问题**

**WHEN：**
调试生产环境问题、排查应用服务、应用服务高 CPU、应用服务部署失败、排查容器应用、排查函数应用、排查 AKS、排查 VM RDP、Linux SSH、虚拟机黑屏、无法连接到虚拟机、重置虚拟机密码、NSG 或防火墙拦截、kubectl 无法连接、kube-system/CoreDNS 故障、Pod 待处理、crashloop、节点未就绪、升级失败、分析日志、KQL、洞察、镜像拉取失败、冷启动问题、健康探针失败、资源健康、错误根本原因、排查事件中心、排查服务总线、消息 SDK 错误、AMQP 连接失败、消息锁丢失、服务总线死信队列。

description: Find Reddit threads where people are genuinely asking for what you offer, then draft short, genuinely helpful replies — disclosing your affiliation honestly and naming your product only when it truly answers the question. Two moves: discovery — scan the right subreddits for real needs (recommendation asks, expressed pain, competitor mentions) and rank the few threads where you can actually help; drafting — write from real experience, respect each community's self-promo rules, and keep a human in the loop to review and post. This markets on Reddit the honest way: contribute value, disclose who you are, never astroturf. Distilled from the playbook behind doany.ai's Reddit agent. Triggers on "find reddit opportunities", "reddit marketing", "reddit automation", "reply on reddit for my product", "reddit community engagement", "reddit lead gen", or any ask to turn Reddit threads into genuine, disclosed marketing replies.

description_zh: 当你需要解决进行中的 git 合并/重基冲突时使用。

description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.
description_zh: The HyperFrames 合成契约——构建一个可渲染的项目。用于合成结构、`data-*` 时序属性、`class="clip"`、轨道、子组合、变量、框架管理的媒体播放、确定性渲染规则以及校验。在编写合成 HTML 之前阅读。

description: Agent Media OS, the single skill for every media need in a HyperFrames project. Resolve BGM, SFX, image, icon, brand logo, voice, color grade, or LUT into a frozen local file or paste-ready block + ledger record (one verb, `resolve`); generate via TTS / music / image models when the catalog misses; produce voiceover, transcription, captions, and background removal through one shared audio engine; operate on media (cut / reframe / transform); and reuse assets across projects. Also use for vague feedback that real footage looks dark, flat, boring, should feel retro/camcorder/print/ASCII, needs privacy, or needs a media reveal.
description_zh: **Agent Media OS，HyperFrames 项目中满足每一种媒体需求的核心技能。** 一键解析 BGM、音效、图片、图标、品牌标识、语音、调色或 LUT，输出为本地冻结文件或可直接粘贴的模块 + 台账记录（一个动词，`resolve`）；当素材库缺失时，通过 TTS / 音乐 / 图片模型进行生成；通过共享音频引擎批量产出配音、转录、字幕与背景去除；对媒体素材进行剪辑、重新构图与格式转换；并实现跨项目资产复用。同时适用于模糊反馈场景——例如真实素材显得昏暗、平淡、乏味，需呈现复古 / 摄像机 / 印刷 / ASCII 风格，需要隐私保护，或需要进行媒体展示等。

description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
description_zh: 面向着陆页、作品集与重新设计的反套板前端技能。该智能体阅读需求简报，推断正确的设计方向，并交付外观不显模板化的界面。适用时采用真实设计系统，重新设计以审计为先，执行严格预检检查。

description: All animation knowledge for HyperFrames — atomic motion rules, multi-phase scene blueprints, scene transitions, broader motion-design techniques, AND the seven runtime adapters (GSAP default, plus Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, CSS keyframes, Web Animations API, TypeGPU). Use for any motion or animation task: pick 2-4 rules and compose, or load a blueprint, or look up runtime-specific API (e.g. GSAP eases / Lottie player / Three.js mixer). Also covers auditing an existing composition's choreography (animation map) and 24 named text-animation effects. HyperFrames-native: single paused timeline, seek-safe, deterministic.
description_zh: HyperFrames 的全部动效知识——原子运动规则、多阶段场景蓝图、场景转场、更广泛的动态设计技法，以及七种运行时适配器（GSAP 默认，以及 Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、CSS 关键帧、Web Animations API、TypeGPU）。用于任何动效或动画任务：选择 2-4 条规则进行组合，或加载蓝图，或查阅特定运行时的 API（如 GSAP 缓动 / Lottie 播放器 / Three.js mixer）。同时涵盖对现有合成的动作编排（动画映射）的审计，以及 24 种命名文本动画效果。HyperFrames 原生特性：单个暂停时间线、跳转安全、确定性。

description: Helps users find the right Azure RBAC role for an identity with least privilege access, then generate CLI commands and Bicep code to assign it. Also provides guidance on permissions required to grant roles. WHEN: bicep for role assignment, what role should I assign, least privilege role, RBAC role for, role to read blobs, role for managed identity, custom role definition, assign role to identity, what role do I need to grant access, permissions to assign roles.
description_zh: 帮助用户为具有最小权限访问原则的身份找到合适的 Azure 基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）角色，随后生成 CLI 命令和 Bicep 代码以分配该角色。同时，提供有关授予角色所需权限的指导。WHEN：Bicep 用于角色分配、应该分配什么角色、最小权限角色、面向……的 RBAC 角色、读取 Blob 的角色、用于托管标识的角色、自定义角色定义、将角色分配给身份、我需要授予访问权限的角色、为角色分配权限。

description: Non-animation creative direction for HyperFrames videos. Use for design spec (frame.md / design.md) handling, palettes, typography, narration, beat planning, audio-reactive visuals, composition patterns, and brand / style decisions. For atomic motion patterns and scene blueprints, use `hyperframes-animation`.
description_zh: HyperFrames 视频的非动画创意方向。用于设计规范（frame.md / design.md）处理、调色板、排版、旁白、节拍规划、音频响应式视觉、构图模式以及品牌/风格决策。原子运动模式与场景蓝图请使用 `hyperframes-animation`。

description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".
description_zh:
跨提供商检查/管理 Azure 配额与使用情况。用于部署规划、容量验证、区域选择。触发场景：

“check quotas”, “service limits”, “current usage”, “request quota increase”, “quota exceeded”, “validate capacity”, “regional availability”, “provisioning limits”, “vCPU limit”, “how many vCPUs available in my subscription”

description: Assess and upgrade Azure workloads between plans, tiers, or SKUs, or modernize Azure SDK dependencies in source code. WHEN: upgrade Consumption to Flex Consumption, upgrade Azure Functions plan, change hosting plan, function app SKU, migrate App Service to Container Apps, modernize legacy Azure Java SDKs (com.microsoft.azure to com.azure), migrate Azure Cache for Redis (ACR/ACRE) to Azure Managed Redis (AMR).
description_zh:
评估与升级 Azure 工作负载（在不同套餐、层级或 SKU 之间转换），或对源代码中的 Azure SDK 依赖进行现代化改造。

时机：升级消耗式至 Flex 消耗式、升级 Azure Functions 套餐、更改托管计划、更改 function app SKU、将 App Service 迁移至 Container Apps、对遗留的 Azure Java SDK（从 com.microsoft.azure 迁移至 com.azure）进行现代化改造，以及将 Azure Cache for Redis（ACR/ACRE）迁移至 Azure Managed Redis（AMR）。

description: Rigor Paper Context helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use only when the README and repository files leave a narrow reproduction-critical gap and the task is to resolve a specific paper detail such as dataset split, preprocessing, evaluation protocol, checkpoint mapping, or runtime assumption from primary paper sources while recording conflicts. Do not use for general paper summary, repo scanning, environment setup, command execution, title-only paper lookup, or replacing README guidance by default.
description_zh: 用于以README开头的深度学习仓库复现的严谨论文上下文辅助工具。仅在README和仓库文件存在对复现至关重要的窄小缺口，且任务需根据原始论文来源解决特定论文细节（如数据集划分、预处理、评估协议、检查点映射或运行时假设）并记录冲突时使用。不得用于通用论文摘要、仓库扫描、环境配置、命令执行、仅凭标题的论文查找，或默认情况下以README指引替代。

description: Rigor Intake helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to scan a repository, read the README and common project files, extract documented commands, classify inference, evaluation, and training candidates, and return the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan to the main orchestrator. Do not use for environment setup, asset download, command execution, final reporting, paper lookup, or end-to-end orchestration.
description_zh: 用于README优先深度学习仓库复现的严谨摄入助手。当任务具体需要扫描仓库、阅读README及常见项目文件、提取文档中记录的命令、对推理、评估和训练候选内容进行分类，并将最小的可信复现方案返回给主编排器时使用。不得用于环境配置、资源下载、命令执行、最终报告、论文查找或端到端编排。

description: Rigor Run skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to capture or normalize evidence from the selected smoke test or documented inference or evaluation command and write standardized `repro_outputs/` files, including patch notes when repository files changed. Do not use for training execution, initial repo intake, generic environment setup, paper lookup, target selection, hidden scientific-meaning changes, or end-to-end orchestration by itself.
description_zh: 针对README优先的深度学习仓库复现的严谨运行技能。当任务具体用于从所选冒烟测试或已记录的文档化推理/评估命令中捕捉或标准化证据，并编写标准化的 `repro_outputs/` 文件（若仓库文件发生变更，需包含补丁说明）时使用。不得用于训练执行、初始仓库接入、通用环境配置、论文查找、目标选择、隐藏的科学含义变更，或单独进行端到端编排。

description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.
description_zh: Rigor 设置技能，用于 README 优先的深度学习仓库复现。当任务专门用于在 README 文档化的仓库运行之前，准备保守的 conda 优先环境、检查点与数据集路径假设、缓存位置提示及设置说明时使用。请勿用于仓库扫描、全面编排、论文解读、最终运行报告，或未针对特定复现目标而进行的通用环境设置。

description: Build, deploy, and modify GitHub Copilot SDK apps on Azure. MANDATORY when codebase contains @github/copilot-sdk or CopilotClient in package.json. PREFER OVER azure-prepare when copilot-sdk markers detected. WHEN: copilot SDK, @github/copilot-sdk, copilot-powered app, build copilot app, prepare copilot app, add feature to copilot app, modify copilot app, BYOM, bring your own model, CopilotClient, createSession, sendAndWait, azd init copilot. DO NOT USE FOR: deploying already-prepared copilot-sdk apps (use azure-deploy), general web apps without copilot SDK (use azure-prepare), Copilot Extensions, Foundry agents (use microsoft-foundry).
description_zh: 在 Azure 上构建、部署和修改 GitHub Copilot SDK 应用。强制要求：当代码库包含 package.json 中的 @github/copilot-sdk 或 CopilotClient 时。优先于 azure-prepare：当检测到 Copilot SDK 标记时。适用场景（WHEN）：Copilot SDK、@github/copilot-sdk、Copilot 驱动的应用、构建 Copilot 应用、准备 Copilot 应用、为 Copilot 应用添加功能、修改 Copilot 应用、BYOM（自带模型）、CopilotClient、createSession、sendAndWait、azd init copilot。禁止用于：部署已准备好的 Copilot SDK 应用（使用 azure-deploy）、不包含 Copilot SDK 的一般 Web 应用（使用 azure-prepare）、Copilot 扩展、Foundry 智能体（使用 microsoft-foundry）。

description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.
description_zh:
从工作负载描述构建并部署企业级 Azure 基础设施。适用于为网络、身份、安全、合规性及多资源拓扑进行规划，并实现 WAF 对齐的云架构师与平台工程师。直接生成 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码（无需 azd）。

WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'

优先采用 azure-prepare 支持以应用为中心的工作流程。

description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上编辑已有视频——该技能是一款智能路由器，能够根据用户意图，将需求精准匹配到 RunComfy 目录中对应的编辑模型。优先选用 Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（涵盖通用重制、背景替换、包装替换，并保留身份与动作特征）、Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control（将参考视频中的精准动作迁移至目标角色）、或 Lucy Edit Restyle（轻量级且保持身份稳定的重制 / 服装替换）。整合各模型的文档化提示词模式，确保技能能够执行更精准的编辑，而不会在错误的模型上白白消耗迭代次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/ <model>/ <endpoint>`。触发词包括“视频编辑”、“编辑视频”、“视频重制”、“视频背景替换”、“动作控制”、“视频服装替换”，或任何明确要求对视频进行转换的指令。

description: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio. Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the caller gets sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video` (or endpoint variant) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image to video", "image-to-video", "i2v", "animate image", "make this move", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video.
description_zh:
在 RunComfy 上为任意静帧图像进行动画处理——本技能是一个智能路由器，能够将用户意图与 RunComfy 目录中的合适 i2v 模型进行匹配。针对一般性动画，选用 HappyHorse 1.0 I2V（竞技场 #1，原生音频，身份保持）；针对自定义配音口型同步，选用带 `audio_url` 的 Wan 2.7；针对图像、参考视频与参考音频的多模态动画，选用 Seedance 2.0 Pro。每个模型均整合了其文档化的提示词模式，让调用方获得更精准的输出，而无需在错误的模型上浪费计算迭代次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/`/`model/`/`image-to-video`（或端点变体）。

触发条件包括 "图像到视频"、"图像到视频"、"i2v"、"动画图像"、"做出此动作"，或任何将静态图像转为视频的明确指令。

description: Generate images with Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini-family flash-tier text-to-image) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents Nano Banana 2's strengths (rapid iteration, in-image typography rendering, predictable framing, optional web-grounded context), the resolution-tier pricing, the safety-tolerance dial, and when to route to Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana", "nano-banana-2", "nano banana 2", "google image gen", "gemini image", or any explicit ask to generate with this model.
description_zh:
在 RunComfy 上使用 Google Nano Banana 2（Gemini 系列快捷层文本转图像）生成图像，并结合该模型的官方提示词模式，使该技能相较于针对同一模型的生硬提示词，能产出更锐利、更精准的输出。

说明 Nano Banana 2 的优势（快速迭代、图像内文字排版渲染、可预测的构图、可选的基于网络上下文），分级分辨率定价、安全容忍度调节选项，以及应在何种情况下转向使用 Nano Banana Pro、GPT Image 2、Flux 2 或 Seedream。

通过本地的 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/ text-to-image`。

触发条件为 "nano banana"、"nano-banana-2"、"nano banana 2"、"google image gen"、"gemini image"，或任何明确要求使用该模型生成图像的指令。

description: Edit images on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Nano Banana Edit (batch up to 20, identity-preserving default), OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit (multilingual in-image text rewrite, multi-ref composition, layout precision), Flux Kontext Pro (single-ref high-fidelity local edit), or Z-Image Turbo Inpaint (mask-driven precise region edit). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image edit", "edit image", "image-to-image", "i2i", "swap background", "remove object", "rewrite headline", or any explicit ask to edit a single or batch of images.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 编辑图片 — 该技能是一种智能路由，能够将用户意图与 RunComfy 目录中的相应编辑模型相匹配。它能选择 Nano Banana Edit（支持批量处理最多 20 张图片，默认保持身份）、OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit（支持多语言图像内文本改写、多参考图合成、排版精度优化）、Flux Kontext Pro（单参考高保真本地编辑）、或 Z-Image Turbo Inpaint（以蒙版驱动的精准区域编辑）。该技能整合了每个模型的已记录提示词模式，确保编辑效果更精准，避免因使用错误模型而浪费迭代次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/edit`。触发条件包括“图片编辑”、“编辑图片”、“图生图”、“i2i”、“替换背景”、“移除物体”、“改写标题”等，以及任何明确要求编辑单张或多张图片的指令。

description: Edit images with Google Nano Banana 2 (image-to-image edit endpoint) on RunComfy. Documents Nano Banana Edit's strengths (preserve subject identity, swap background, localize edits with spatial language, multi-image batch edits up to 20 inputs), the schema, and when to route to GPT Image 2 edit / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana edit", "edit with nano banana", "image edit nano banana", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 Google Nano Banana 2（图像到图像编辑端点）编辑图像。说明 Nano Banana Edit 的优势（保留主体身份、更换背景、通过空间语言进行本地化编辑、支持最多 20 个输入的多图批量编辑）、其模式定义，以及何时应路由至 GPT Image 2 编辑 / Flux Konkt / Nano Banana 2 t2i 而非此方案。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit`。在触发关键词“nano banana edit”、“edit with nano banana”、“image edit nano banana”，或任何明确要求使用该模型进行编辑的请求时触发。

description: Edit images with Flux 1 Kontext Pro (Black Forest Labs' precise local image-edit model) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents Flux Kontext's strengths (single-reference precise local edits, strong prompt control, consistent high-fidelity outputs), the schema (single image + prompt), and when to route to Nano Banana Edit / GPT Image 2 edit / Flux 2 Klein instead. Calls `runcomfy run blackforestlabs/flux-1-kontext/pro/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "flux kontext", "flux-kontext", "flux 1 kontext", "kontext", "BFL kontext", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 Flux 1 Konult Pro（Black Forest Labs 的精确本地图像编辑模型）编辑图像 —— 该模型捆绑了其文档记录的提示词模式，因此此技能相较于对同一模型进行简单提示时能获得更出色的输出。文档阐述了 Flux Konult 的优势（单参考精确本地编辑、强大的提示控制、一致的高保真输出）、架构（单张图像 + 提示词），以及何时转向 Nano Banana Edit / GPT Image 2 edit / Flux 2 Klein 替代。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run blackforestlabs/flux-1-koncontext/pro/edit`。触发条件为“flux konult”、“flux-konult”、“flux 1 konult”、“konult”、“BFL konult”，或任何要求使用此模型进行编辑的明确请求。

description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.
description_zh:
规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 Azure Kubernetes Service（AKS）集群。涵盖 Day-0 检查清单、SKU 选择（Automatic 与 Standard）、网络选项（私有 API 服务器、Azure CNI Overlay、出口配置）、安全以及运维（自动扩展、升级策略、成本分析）。

description: Generate text-to-video with Wan 2.7 (Wan-AI's flagship motion model) on RunComfy. description: Postgres best practices maintained by Supabase, for Postgres running anywhere. This is not just a performance guide — schema, migration, security, and SQL authoring tasks need these rules too, even for a one-column change or a single query.

description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成和编辑图像——这是一个覆盖完整图像模型目录的智能路由器：包含 FLUX 2（Klein 9B/4B、Pro、Dev、Flash、Turbo、Max）、Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro、OpenAI GPT Image 2、ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 和 Dreamina 4-0、Alibaba Qwen Image 和 Z-Image Turbo、Wan 2-7。覆盖文本到图像（t2i）和图像到图像/编辑（i2i）端点——该技能根据用户的实际需求（排版精度、真实感人像、亚秒级迭代、多参考品牌风格、开源工作流）选择合适的模型，并随附每个模型的已记录提示词模式以及最简化的 `runcomfy run` 调用。触发条件包括 "generate image"、"make a picture"、"文本到图像"、"AI image"、"make an image of …"、"image to image"、"i2i"，或任何明确要求创建或重新调整图像的需求。

description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.
description_zh: 将 CLAUDE.md 或待办事项列表等内存文件压缩为简化版格式，以节省输入 token，同时保留可读的备份。触发命令：/caveman-compress。

description: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. This skill should be used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces, including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 79 searchable styles (50 active), 192 product palettes and reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 stacks.
description_zh:
UI/UX 设计智能：面向网页、移动端和桌面端。此技能适用于设计、构建、审核或修复界面，包括页面、组件、设计系统、无障碍性、交互、响应式布局、排版、色彩、图表，以及特定技术栈的 UI 实现。

可搜索的本地数据：79 种可搜索样式（50 种活跃）、192 个产品调色板及推理档案、74 种字体搭配、119 条 UX 指南、105 个图标、17 个 GSAP 预设、25 种图表类型，以及 22 种技术栈。

description: Migrate test files from `as` type assertions to @total-typescript/shoehorn. Use when user mentions shoehorn, wants to replace `as` in tests, or needs partial test data.
description_zh: 将测试文件从 `as` 类型断言迁移到 @total-typescript/shoehorn。当用户提及 shoehorn、希望替换测试中的 `as`，或需要部分测试数据时使用。

description: Run any model on RunComfy from the command line. The `runcomfy` CLI is one binary, one auth, hundreds of model endpoints — image generation, image edit, video generation, image-to-video, lip-sync, face swap, video edit, inpainting, outpainting, extend, ControlNet, relight, upscale, LoRA training and more. Submit a request, poll for status, download the output. This skill teaches the agent how to install, authenticate, discover model schemas, invoke models, stream / poll / no-wait, script in JSON output mode, and handle errors. Triggers on "runcomfy cli", "install runcomfy", "runcomfy login", "runcomfy run", "runcomfy whoami", "runcomfy api", or any explicit ask to call a RunComfy model from a script or terminal. Sibling skills (ai-image-generation, ai-video-generation, image-edit, video-edit, face-swap, lipsync, image-to-video, image-inpainting, image-outpainting, video-extend, controlnet-pose, relight) all dispatch through this CLI.
description_zh: 使用命令行在 RunComfy 上运行任何模型。`runcomfy` CLI 是一个可执行程序、一次登录认证、数百个模型接口——包括图像生成、图像编辑、视频生成、图像转视频、唇形同步、换脸、视频编辑、图像修复、图像扩展、扩展、ControlNet、重打光、超分、LoRA 训练等。提交请求、轮询状态、下载输出。本技能教授代理如何安装、认证、发现模型 schema、调用模型、流式/轮询/不等待、在 JSON 输出模式下编写脚本以及处理错误。在出现 "runcomfy cli"、"install runcomfy"、"runcomfy login"、"runcomfy run"、"runcomfy whoami"、"runcomfy api"，或在脚本或终端中明确要求调用 RunComfy 模型时触发。相关技能（ai-image-generation、ai-video-generation、image-edit、video-edit、face-swap、lipsync、image-to-video、image-inpainting、image-outpainting、video-extend、controlnet-pose、relight）均通过此 CLI 进行调度。

description: Create AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (audio-driven mouth sync via `audio_url` on a portrait), HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1 t2v / i2v with in-pass audio), and Seedance v2 Pro (multi-modal cinematic with reference audio + reference subject). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — UGC voiceover, virtual presenter, dubbed product demo, lip-synced character, dialog scene — and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "talking head", "lip sync", "avatar video", "make X speak", "audio to video", "audio driven avatar", "virtual presenter", "AI spokesperson", "dubbed video", "UGC avatar", "HeyGen alternative", "Synthesia alternative", "digital human", "make this portrait talk", "video from voiceover", or any explicit ask to put words in a face.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上创建 AI 虚拟形象、出镜头视频及唇形同步视频。支持基于 ByteDance OmniHuman（音频驱动全身虚拟形象）、Wan-AI Wan 2-7（人物肖像上通过 `audio_url` 实现音频驱动嘴型同步）、HappyHorse 1.0（Arena #1 的 t2v / i2v 模式，支持过程音频）、Seedance v2 Pro（多模态电影质感，支持参考音频与参考主体）等模型。根据用户实际需求选择合适的模型——覆盖 UGC 配音、虚拟主持人、配音产品演示、唇形同步角色、对白场景等场景——并交付各模型的文档化提示词规范及最简 `runcomfy run` 调用方式。触发条件包括“出镜头”、“唇形同步”、“虚拟形象视频”、“让 X 说话”、“音频转视频”、“音频驱动虚拟形象”、“虚拟主持人”、“AI 发言人”、“配音视频”、“UGC 虚拟形象”、“HeyGen 替代方案”、“Synthesia 替代方案”、“数字人”、“让该肖像说话”、“从配音生成视频”，或任何要求“让脸部说出文字”的明确请求。

description: Swap a face / character into video or images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation + identity swap), GPT Image 2 Edit (single-shot precise face swap on still images via reference composition), Nano Banana Edit (batch identity-preserving swap), Flux Kontext (single-ref high-fidelity local face edit), and Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro (transfer motion from one performance onto a target character). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — single still vs video, full character vs face only, dialog scene vs silent motion. Triggers on "face swap", "swap face", "deepfake", "face replacement", "character swap", "head swap", "put X's face on Y", "make this video star X", "replace the actor in this video", "swap the character in the photo", "deepfake video", "ReActor alternative", or any explicit ask to substitute one identity for another.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` 命令行工具，可在 RunComfy 上将面部或角色替换到视频或图片中。支持多种路由方案，包括：社区 Wan 2-2 Animate（音频驱动角色动画 + 身份互换）、GPT Image 2 Edit（基于参考构图实现静态图片的单次精准换脸）、Nano Banana Edit（批量保留身份的换脸）、Flux Konft（单参考高保真本地面部编辑）以及 Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro（将一种表演的动作迁移至目标角色）。它会根据用户的实际需求选择匹配的模型，覆盖单张静态图片与视频、完整角色与仅面部、带有对白的场景与无声动作等不同需求。当触发以下关键词或任何明确要求将一种身份替换为另一种身份的指令时，即可执行操作：“换脸”、“互换面部”、“深度伪造”、“面部替换”、“角色互换”、“头部互换”、“将 X 的面孔放到 Y 上”、“让这段视频以 X 为主角”、“替换这段视频中的演员”、“更换照片中的角色”、“深度伪造视频”、“ReActor 替代方案”。

description: Region edits across video frames on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — remove an object that appears across many frames, clean up wires or watermarks, replace a region with matching motion. Routes across Wan 2-7 edit-video (default, prompt-driven region edits with spatial language), Lucy Edit Restyle (identity-stable region-aware restyle), and Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential (when treating the clip as a frame stack). Picks the right route based on whether the change is prose-driven, identity-locked, or needs frame-by-frame still inpaint chained into a video. Triggers on "video inpaint", "video inpainting", "remove from video", "mask region in video", "clean up video", "remove object from clip", "video patch", "frame-by-frame edit", "remove watermark from video", "remove passing person", or any explicit ask to edit a region across video frames.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 中进行跨视频帧的区域编辑——删除跨多帧出现的一个对象、清理线条或水印、用匹配的运动替换某区域。支持通过 Wan 2-7 edit-video（默认方案，基于提示词的、带有空间语言的区域编辑）、Lucy Edit Restyle（保持身份稳定、具备区域感知的重塑）以及 Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential（当将片段视为帧堆栈时使用）进行路由。根据更改是文本驱动、身份锁定，还是需要逐帧静态填充串联为视频的需求，选择正确的路由方案。触发条件包括："video inpaint"、"video inpainting"、"remove from video"、"mask region in video"、"clean up video"、"remove object from clip"、"video patch"、"frame-by-frame edit"、"remove watermark from video"、"remove passing person"，或任何明确的跨视频帧编辑区域的请求。

description: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't available and the region must be described instead. Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area. Triggers on "inpaint", "inpainting", "image inpaint", "remove from image", "fill region", "mask-driven edit", "remove watermark", "remove object", "patch the photo", "fill the hole", or any explicit ask to edit a specific masked region of a still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上执行的掩码驱动图像修复。当掩码不可用且需以区域描述替代时，将请求路由至通义万相 Z-Image Turbo 图像修复（配备含掩码、强度与控制比例的专用图像修复接口），以及保持身份的编辑模型（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Konct Pro）。适用于物体去除、水印去除、区域替换、瑕疵清理，以及任何由二值掩码界定目标区域的受控局部编辑。触发场景包括：“inpaint”、“inpainting”、“image inpaint”、“remove from image”、“fill region”、“mask-driven edit”、“remove watermark”、“remove object”、“patch the photo”、“fill the hole”，或对静态图像中被掩码区域进行编辑的任何明确请求。

description: Pose-conditioned generation on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro / Standard (transfer the motion / blocking of a reference video onto a target character), community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation with pose conditioning), and Z-Image Turbo ControlNet LoRA (pose-conditioned image generation from an OpenPose / DWPose / canny / depth control image). Picks the right route based on video vs still and stylized vs photoreal. Triggers on "controlnet", "control net", "pose control", "openpose", "DWPose", "transfer pose", "motion control", "pose driven", "character pose", "depth control", "canny edge", "use this pose", or any explicit ask to condition generation on a pose / skeleton / motion / depth / canny reference.
description_zh: 通过`runcomfy` CLI在RunComfy上进行姿态条件生成。跨多个路线支持：Kling 2-6运动控制Pro/标准（将参考视频的运动/动作转换到目标角色）、社区Wan 2-2 Animate（带姿态条件音频驱动角色动画），以及Z-Image Turbo ControlNet LoRA（基于OpenPose / DWPose / canny / 深度控制图像的姿态条件图像生成）。根据视频与静态图像、风格化与写实的差异选择合适路线。触发条件包含"controlnet"、"control net"、"pose control"、"openpose"、"DWPose"、"transfer pose"、"motion control"、"pose driven"、"character pose"、"depth control"、"canny edge"、"use this pose"，或任何明确要求将生成条件设置为姿态/骨架/运动/深度/canny参考的指令。

description: Lip-sync a face to a specific audio track on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar from a portrait + audio), Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro (state-of-the-art mouth sync onto a video), Kling lipsync (audio-to- video and text-to-video with synced speech), and Creatify lipsync. The skill picks the right endpoint for the user's actual intent — portrait still + audio (avatar-style), source video + audio (mouth- swap on existing footage), or generate-and-sync from a script. Triggers on "lip sync", "lipsync", "make this video speak", "match audio to mouth", "dub video", "sync lips to voice", "Sync Labs", "voiceover sync", or any explicit ask to drive a face's mouth from an audio track.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上，将面部与特定音频轨进行口型同步。涵盖 ByteDance OmniHuman（基于肖像与音频的音频驱动全身高仿真人）、Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro（应用于视频的最前沿口型同步）、Kling 唇动同步（支持同步语音的音频转视频与文本转视频功能），以及 Creatify 唇动同步。该技能会根据用户的实际意图选择正确的接口：即针对肖像静态图与音频（化身风格）、源视频与音频（基于现有素材的口型替换），或根据脚本进行生成并同步。触发条件包括：“lip sync”、“lipsync”、“让该视频开口说话”、“将音频与口型匹配”、“为视频配音”、“将嘴唇与声音同步”、“Sync Labs”、“语音同步”，或任何要求根据音频轨驱动人脸口型的明确指令。

description: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. Use when the user has a short Veo clip and wants it longer, or wants a chained narrative built shot-by-shot from a single seed clip. Triggers on "extend video", "continue video", "longer video", "video extend", "make this clip longer", "Veo extend", "chain video shots", "video continuation", or any explicit ask to take an existing video and add more frames after it.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上扩展或继续现有的视频片段。路由至 Google Veo 3-1 的 `extend-video` 和 `fast/extend-video` 接口——选择源视频并附上描述后续内容的提示词，模型将生成一个视频片段，在保持原有运动、光线和主体身份一致的前提下，对原始视频进行延续。适用于用户拥有较短的 Veo 视频片段且希望其变长，或希望从单个种子片段逐镜头构建连贯叙事的情况。触发关键词包括“extend video”、“continue video”、“longer video”、“video extend”、“make this clip longer”、“Veo extend”、“chain video shots”、“video continuation”，以及任何明确要求对现有视频进行续接并添加后续帧的请求。

description: Generate full songs and instrumental tracks with ElevenLabs Music on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. ElevenLabs Music turns a style description plus structured lyrics into studio-quality 44.1 kHz stereo audio — 5 seconds to 5 minutes — with section-level control (Intro / Verse / Chorus / Bridge), multilingual vocals, and commercial-friendly output. Generate a backing track, a full vocal song, a jingle, a podcast intro, a game loop, or an instrumental bed. Calls `runcomfy run elevenlabs/elevenlabs/music-generation` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "generate music", "make a song", "AI music", "background music", "instrumental track", "ElevenLabs Music", "soundtrack", "jingle", "theme music", "royalty-free music", "compose", or any explicit ask to generate music or a song from a text description.
description_zh:
通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上使用 ElevenLabs Music 生成完整歌曲和纯音乐曲目。ElevenLabs Music 将风格描述与结构化的歌词转化为具有专业录音质量的 44.1 kHz 立体声音频——时长为 5 秒至 5 分钟——并支持段落级控制（Intro / Verse / Chorus / Bridge）、多语言人声以及适合商业使用的输出。

可生成伴奏曲目、完整人声歌曲、广告歌曲（jingle）、播客开场、游戏循环或纯音乐背景音。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run elevenlabs/elevenlabs/music-generation`。

触发词包括 "generate music"、"make a song"、"AI music"、"background music"、"instrumental track"、"ElevenLabs Music"、"soundtrack"、"jingle"、"theme music"、"royalty-free music"、"compose"，或任何明确要求根据文本描述生成音乐或歌曲的请求。

description: Image outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend a still beyond its original canvas, fill in what the camera didn't capture, change aspect ratio (square → 16:9, portrait → landscape) while preserving the original content. Routes across Nano Banana 2 Edit (default, spatial-language driven), GPT Image 2 Edit (multi-ref with reference-style matching), FLUX Kontext Pro (single-shot maximum-preservation), and the brand edit endpoints (Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2). Picks the right route based on whether the outpaint is prose-driven, reference-driven, or brand-locked. Triggers on "outpaint", "outpainting", "extend image canvas", "expand the image", "fill in around the photo", "uncrop", "change aspect ratio", "extend frame", "wide-screen from square", or any explicit ask to add canvas around an existing still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行图像外扩——将静帧延伸超出其原始画布，填补相机未捕捉到的内容，在保留原始内容的同时改变宽高比（正方形 → 16:9，竖幅 → 横幅）。支持 Nano Banana 2 Edit（默认，基于空间-语言驱动）、GPT Image 2 Edit（多参考源，采用参考风格匹配）、FLUX Kon text Pro（单次生成，最大程度保留），以及品牌编辑端点（Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2）。根据外扩是散文驱动、参考源驱动还是品牌锁定，选择相应路线。触发条件包括“外扩”、“外扩补画”、“延伸图像画布”、“扩展图像”、“为照片周边进行填充”、“去裁切”、“改变宽高比”、“延伸画面”、“由方形转为宽屏”，以及任何明确要求为现有静帧添加画布边界的请求。

description: Relight a still image — change the lighting setup, color temperature, direction, or mood — on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Qwen Edit 2509's dedicated `relight` LoRA endpoint for purpose-built relighting, with fallback to identity-preserving edit endpoints (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when prose lighting language is enough. Use for product relighting (studio softbox → window light), portrait mood shift (overcast → golden hour), or color-grade change. Triggers on "relight", "relighting", "change the lighting", "make it golden hour", "studio lighting", "rim light", "blue hour", "soft window light", "change light direction", "color temperature", or any explicit ask to alter how a still is lit.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上通过 `runcomfy` CLI 对静态图片进行重新打光——更改光照布置、色温、方向或氛围——并路由至 Qwen Edit 2509 专用的 `relight` LoRA 端点，以实现专门定制的重新打光；当文字类光照描述足够时，则回退至保持身份不变形的编辑端点（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Kon文本 Pro）。可用于产品重新打光（影室柔光箱光 → 窗光）、人像氛围转换（阴天 → 黄金时段），或色彩调校调整。触发于 “relight”、“relighting”、“change the lighting”、“make it golden hour”、“studio lighting”、“rim light”、“blue hour”、“soft window light”、“change light direction”、“color temperature”，或任何明确要求改变静态图片打光方式的请求。

description: Video outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend the spatial canvas of a video, change aspect ratio (9:16 vertical to 16:9 horizontal or vice versa), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action. Routes prompt-shaped spatial extension through Wan 2-7 edit-video and points the agent at dedicated ComfyUI outpaint workflows when seam quality matters for hero delivery. Triggers on "video outpaint", "video outpainting", "extend video canvas", "expand video frame", "uncrop video", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal video", "16:9 from 9:16", "TikTok to YouTube", or any explicit ask to extend a video spatially beyond its original frame.
