description_zh:
Rigor Reproduce 兼容技能 slug：用于以 README 为先的深度学习仓库复现。

当用户需要端到端、最小化且可信的流程，首先阅读仓库，选择已文档化且最小的推理或评估目标，协调输入接收、环境设置、可信执行、可选可信训练、可选仓库分析以及可选论文差距补救，强制执行保守补丁规则，记录证据、假设、偏差和人工决策点，并生成标准化的 `repro_outputs/` 包时使用。

不可用于论文总结、通用环境配置、孤立仓库扫描、独立命令执行、静默协议变更、追逐分数，或超出基于仓库复现范围的广泛研究辅助。

description: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.
description_zh: Rigor 改进实施叶子技能，用于在深度学习研究仓库中进行可审计的候选实现。当研究人员明确授权在独立分支或工作树上进行探索性工作时，可使用该技能，以移植模块、适配主干网络、添加 LoRA 或适配层、替换头部，拼接具有意义的低风险迁移方案，并在 `explore_outputs/` 中保存带有回滚感知的记录。不得用于在 `current_research` 之上进行端到端探索编排、可信基准复现、保守调试、环境设置、已验证的贡献声明，或默认仓库分析。

description: Rigor Debug / Rigor Audit skill for deep learning research work. Use when the user pastes a traceback, terminal error, CUDA OOM, checkpoint load failure, shape mismatch, NaN loss symptom, or training failure and wants conservative diagnosis before any patching, with debug fixes clearly separated from research contributions. Do not use for broad refactoring, speculative adaptation, automatic exploratory patching, or general repository familiarization.
description_zh: 面向深度学习研究工作的严谨调试/严谨审计技能。当用户粘贴回溯信息、终端错误、CUDA OOM（内存溢出）、检查点加载失败、形状不匹配、NaN损失症状或训练失败，并在打补丁之前需进行保守诊断，同时要求调试修复与研究成果清晰区分时使用。不适用于大规模重构、推测性适配、自动探索性补丁及通用仓库熟悉。

description: Rigor Train skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when a documented or selected training command should be run conservatively for startup verification, short-run verification, full kickoff, or resume, with command, config, seed, log, checkpoint, status, and metric evidence written to standardized `train_outputs/`. Do not use for environment setup, exploratory sweeps, speculative idea implementation, or end-to-end orchestration.
description_zh: 为深度学习研究仓库提供严谨训练（Rigor Train）技能。当文档记录或已选择的训练命令需要谨慎执行启动验证、短期验证、完整启动或恢复，且命令、配置、种子、日志、检查点、状态及指标证据需写入标准化的 `train_outputs/` 目录时使用。不适用于环境配置、探索性扫描、推测性方案实现或端到端编排。

description: Rigor Improve / Rigor Explore run leaf skill for bounded exploratory evidence in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs such as small-subset validation, short-cycle guess-and-check, batch sweeps, idle-GPU search, or quick transfer-learning trials, with fair-comparison caveats and no-overclaim summaries in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline execution, conservative training verification, default routing, verified SOTA claims, or implicit experimentation.
description_zh: Rigor Improve / Rigor Explore 运行叶子技能，用于深度学习研究仓库中有界的探索性证据。当研究人员明确授权探索性运行时使用，例如小样本验证、短周期猜测与检查、批量扫描、空闲GPU搜索或快速迁移学习试验，并在 `explore_outputs/` 中包含公平比较注意事项和无过度声称的总结。不得用于在 `current_research` 之上进行端到端探索编排、受信任的基线执行、保守的训练验证、默认路由、经验证的SOTA声称，或隐式实验。

description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.
description_zh: 高端品牌套件图像生成技能，用于创建高端品牌规范板、标志系统、品牌形象册和视觉世界演示。专为极简、电影感、编辑风格、暗黑科技、奢华、文化、安全、游戏、开发者工具和消费应用等品牌系统训练。优化用于目标明确的标志构思、精致构图、稀疏排版、强烈的象征意义、高端模拟图、艺术指导图像以及灵活网格布局。

description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.
description_zh: 面向 Codex 的顶尖网站图生代码技能。对于视觉重要的网页任务，它必须首先自行生成设计图，深入分析，随后实现网站，以尽可能紧密地匹配设计。在 Codex 中，它必须优先选择大尺寸、易于阅读、针对特定区块的图像，而非微小且压缩的版面；为区块或详情视图生成全新的独立图像，而非裁剪旧图；避免懒于生成（的敷衍做法）；避免多层嵌套卡片式的UI（cards-inside-cards-inside-cards）；并保持首屏简洁、空间充裕、易于阅读，在小尺寸笔记本电脑上依然清晰可见。

description: Guides for configuring Prisma with different database providers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, etc.). Use when setting up a new project, changing databases, or troubleshooting connection issues. Triggers on "configure postgres", "connect to mysql", "setup mongodb", "sqlite setup".
description_zh: 不同数据库提供商（PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、MongoDB 等）的 Prisma 配置指南。在设置新项目、更改数据库或排查连接问题时使用。触发于“configure postgres”、“connect to mysql”、“setup mongodb”、“sqlite setup”。

description: Prisma Client API reference covering model queries, filters, operators, and client methods. Use when writing database queries, using CRUD operations, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client. Triggers on "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction".
description_zh: Prisma Client API 参考文档，涵盖模型查询、过滤器、操作符及客户端方法。在编写数据库查询、执行 CRUD 操作、过滤数据或配置 Prisma Client 时使用。触发条件为 "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction"。

description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.
description_zh:
**生成优质、注重转化的落地页设计参考的高级前端图像方向技能**

**关键输出规则** — 为每个部分生成一张独立的横向图片。8个部分的落地页将生成8张图片。绝不将多个部分压缩为一张图片。强制版面构图多样性（并非 always 左侧文字/右侧图像），背景图像自由，行动号召（CTA）多样化，首屏缩放尺寸多样化（巨型 / 中等 / 极简小型），叙事概念主线，二次阅读时刻，以及所有图片中统一一致的调色板。针对落地页、营销网站以及开发或编码模型可准确复现的产品参考图进行了优化。

description: Hand the current conversation off to a fresh background agent that picks up the work immediately.
description_zh: 将当前对话转交给新的后台代理，使其立即接手工作。

description: Prisma ORM CLI commands reference covering init, generate, migrate, db, dev, complete, studio, validate, format, debug, and mcp. Use for ORM/database CLI workflows, not the Prisma Platform CLI. Triggers on "prisma init", "prisma generate", "prisma migrate", "prisma db", "prisma complete", "prisma studio", "prisma mcp".
description_zh: Prisma ORM CLI 命令参考，涵盖 init、generate、migrate、db、dev、complete、studio、validate、format、debug 和 mcp。用于 ORM/数据库 CLI 工作流，而非 Prisma Platform CLI。触发于“prisma init”、“prisma generate”、“prisma migrate”、“prisma db”、“prisma complete”、“prisma studio”、“prisma mcp”。

description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
description_zh: 为智能体编写文档。在创建或编辑技能，或修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 时使用。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "write agent code", "build an agent with ADK", "add a tool", "create a callback", "define an agent", "use state management" — in a project that needs ADK (Agent Development Kit) API patterns and code examples. It provides a quick reference for agent types, tool definitions, orchestration patterns, callbacks, state management, the graph Workflow API, and reference recipes to study. Do NOT use for scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold) or deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy).
description_zh: 本技能适用于在需要 ADK（Agent 开发工具包）API 模式与代码示例的项目中，当用户需要“编写代理代码”、“使用 ADK 构建代理”、“添加工具”、“创建回调”、“定义代理”或“使用状态管理”时使用。它提供代理类型、工具定义、编排模式、回调、状态管理、图 Workflow API 以及参考食谱的快速参考，供学习研究。请勿用于搭建脚手架（请使用 google-agents-cli-scaffold），也请勿用于部署（请使用 google-agents-cli-deploy）。

description: Prisma Postgres setup and operations guidance across Console, create-db CLI, Management API, and Management API SDK. Use when creating Prisma Postgres databases, working in Prisma Console, provisioning with create-db/create-pg/create-postgres, or integrating programmatic provisioning with service tokens or OAuth.
description_zh: Prisma Postgres 配置与运维指南，涵盖 Console、create-db CLI、Management API 及 Management API SDK。适用于创建 Prisma Postgres 数据库、在 Prisma Console 中操作、使用 create-db/create-pg/create-postgres 进行配置，或通过服务令牌或 OAuth 进行程序化配置集成的场景。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "develop an agent", "build an agent using ADK", "run the agent locally", "debug agent code", "test an agent", "deploy an agent", "publish an agent", "monitor an agent", or needs the ADK (Agent Development Kit) development lifecycle and coding guidelines. Entrypoint for building ADK agents. Always active — provides the full workflow (scaffold, build, evaluate, deploy, publish, observe), code preservation rules, model selection guidance, and troubleshooting steps for ADK or any agent development.
description_zh: 当用户需要"开发智能体"、"使用ADK构建智能体"、"在本地运行智能体"、"调试智能体代码"、"测试智能体"、"部署智能体"、"发布智能体"、"监控智能体"，或需要ADK（智能体开发工具包）的开发生命周期与编码规范时，应使用此技能。构建ADK智能体的入口点。始终激活——为ADK或任何智能体开发提供完整的工作流程（脚手架搭建、构建、评估、部署、发布、监控）、代码保留规则、模型选择指导及故障排除步骤。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "run an evaluation", "evaluate my agent", "evaluate my ADK agent", "write an eval dataset", "analyze eval failures", "compare eval results", "optimize agent", or needs guidance on the Agent Platform eval methodology and the Quality Flywheel. Covers eval metrics, dataset schema, LLM-as-judge scoring, and common failure causes. Applies to any agents-cli project, whatever framework the agent is written in. Do NOT use for agent API code patterns (ADK: use google-agents-cli-adk-code), deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy), or project scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold).
description_zh: 本技能适用于用户需要“运行评估”、“评估我的代理”、“评估我的 ADK 代理”、“编写评估数据集”、“分析评估失败”、“对比评估结果”、“优化代理”，或需要关于 Agent 平台评估方法论与质量飞轮的指导的情况。涵盖评估指标、数据集架构、大语言模型（LLM）作为裁判的评分以及常见失败原因。适用于任何 agents-cli 项目，无论代理采用何种框架编写。不用于代理 API 代码模式（ADK：使用 google-agents-cli-adk-code）、部署（使用 google-agents-cli-deploy）或项目脚手架（使用 google-agents-cli-scaffold）。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "deploy an agent", "deploy my ADK agent", "set up CI/CD", "configure secrets", "troubleshoot a deployment", or needs guidance on Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, or GKE deployment targets, or binding an agent to an Agent Gateway. Covers deployment workflows, service accounts, rollback, and production infrastructure. Applies to any framework agents-cli deploys (ADK, LangChain, ...). Part of the agents-cli skills suite. Do NOT use for agent API code patterns (ADK: use google-agents-cli-adk-code), evaluation (use google-agents-cli-eval), or project scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold).
description_zh: 本技能适用于当用户想要“部署智能体”、“部署我的 ADK 智能体”、“设置 CI/CD”、“配置机密信息”、“排查部署问题”，或需要关于 Agent Runtime、Cloud Run 或 GKE 部署目标的指导，或需要将智能体绑定到 Agent Gateway 时使用。涵盖部署工作流程、服务账号、回滚及生产基础设施。适用于任何框架通过 agents-cli 部署的智能体（ADK、LangChain 等）。属于 agents-cli 技能套件的一部分。请勿用于智能体 API 代码模式（ADK：使用 google-agents-cli-adk-code）、评估（使用 google-agents-cli-eval）或项目脚手架（使用 google-agents-cli-scaffold）。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "create an agent project", "start a new ADK project", "build me a new agent", "add CI/CD to my project", "add deployment", "enhance my project", or "upgrade my project". Part of the agents-cli skills suite. Covers `agents-cli scaffold create`, `scaffold enhance`, and `scaffold upgrade` commands, template options, deployment targets, and the prototype-first workflow. Do NOT use for writing agent code (ADK projects: use google-agents-cli-adk-code) or deployment operations (use google-agents-cli-deploy).
description_zh: 该技能应在用户希望“创建智能体项目”、“启动新的 ADK 项目”、“为我构建一个新的智能体”、“为我的项目添加 CI/CD”、“添加部署”、“增强我的项目”或“升级我的项目”时使用。它是 agents-cli 技能套件的一部分。本技能涵盖 `agents-cli scaffold create`、`scaffold enhance` 和 `scaffold upgrade` 命令、模板选项、部署目标以及原型优先的工作流。请勿用于编写智能体代码（ADK 项目请使用 `google-agents-cli-adk-code`）或部署操作（请使用 `google-agents-cli-deploy`）。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "set up tracing", "monitor my agent", "configure logging", "add observability", "debug production traffic", or needs guidance on monitoring deployed agents, including ADK (Agent Development Kit) agents. Covers Cloud Trace, prompt-response logging, BigQuery Agent Analytics, third-party integrations (AgentOps, Phoenix, MLflow, etc.), and troubleshooting. Part of the agents-cli skills suite. Do NOT use for deployment setup (use google-agents-cli-deploy) or API code patterns (use google-agents-cli-adk-code).
description_zh: 本技能适用于当用户希望“设置追踪”、“监控我的智能体”、“配置日志”、“添加可观测性”、“调试生产环境流量”，或需要有关监控已部署智能体（包括 ADK (智能体开发套件) 智能体）的指导时。涵盖 Cloud Trace、提示-响应日志、BigQuery Agent Analytics、第三方集成（AgentOps、Phoenix、MLflow 等）以及故障排查。属于 agents-cli 技能套件的一部分。请勿用于部署设置（请使用 google-agents-cli-deploy）或 API 代码模式（请使用 google-agents-cli-adk-code）。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "publish an agent", "publish my ADK agent", "register an agent with Gemini Enterprise", "publish to Gemini Enterprise", or needs guidance on the agents-cli publish gemini-enterprise command. Also use when the user wants to "manage agents in Agent Registry", "list/update/delete registered agents", or "register an MCP server". Covers ADK vs A2A registration modes, programmatic and interactive usage, flag reference, auto-detection from deployment metadata, Agent Registry fleet management, and troubleshooting. Part of the agents-cli skills suite. Do NOT use for deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy).
description_zh: 本技能适用于以下场景：用户希望“发布智能体”、“发布我的 ADK 智能体”、“向 Gemini Enterprise 注册智能体”、“向 Gemini Enterprise 发布智能体”，或需要关于 `agents-cli publish gemini-enterprise` 命令的指导。此外，也适用于用户希望“管理 Agent Registry 中的智能体”、“列出/更新/删除已注册的智能体”或“注册 MCP 服务器”的情况。本技能涵盖 ADK 与 A2A 的注册模式、编程式与交互式使用、参数说明、根据部署元数据自动检测、Agent Registry 舰队管理以及故障排查。它是 `agents-cli` 技能套件的一部分。**请勿用于部署（请使用 `google-agents-cli-deploy`）。**

description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.
description_zh: 精英移动应用图像生成技能，用于创建高端、原生应用屏幕概念与流程。专为 iOS、Android 及跨平台移动产品而设计。优先考虑清晰的层级结构、舒适可读的文本、强烈的多屏一致性、受控的颜色调色板、非千篇一律的创意方向、富有质感的表面、以图像为主导的构图、精致的自定义图标设计，以及简洁的手机原型呈现效果。默认情况下，屏幕应展示在精致的、高端的 iPhone 或类似手机原型内部，并带有可见的框架，同时主要重点始终集中于应用内容本身。此技能仅生成图像，不编写代码。

description: Required reference for Prisma ORM 7 SQL driver adapter work. Use when implementing or modifying adapters, adding database drivers, or touching SqlDriverAdapter, Transaction, savepoint, result mapping, or DriverAdapterError behavior. Covers current transaction lifecycle, optional savepoint hooks, original database-error preservation, and verification.
description_zh: Prisma ORM 7 SQL 驱动适配器工作的必备参考。适用于实现或修改适配器、添加数据库驱动、或涉及 SqlDriverAdapter、Transaction、保存点、结果映射或 DriverAdapterError 行为时使用。涵盖当前事务生命周期、可选保存点钩子、原始数据库错误保留以及验证。

description: Complete migration guide from Prisma ORM v6 to v7 covering all breaking changes. Use when upgrading Prisma versions, encountering v7 errors, or migrating existing projects. Triggers on "upgrade to prisma 7", "prisma 7 migration", "prisma-client generator", "driver adapter required".
description_zh:
从 Prisma ORM v6 到 v7 的完整迁移指南，涵盖所有破坏性变更。适用于升级 Prisma 版本、遇到 v7 错误或迁移现有项目时。触发条件：
- "upgrade to prisma 7"
- "prisma 7 migration"
- "prisma-client generator"
- "driver adapter required"

description: Set up a new Prisma Postgres database and connect it to a local project using the Management API. Use when asked to "set up a database", "create a Prisma Postgres project", "get a connection string", "connect my app to Prisma Postgres", or "provision a database".
description_zh: 使用管理 API 设置一个新的 Prisma Postgres 数据库，并将其连接到本地项目。当被要求执行“设置数据库”、“创建 Prisma Postgres 项目”、“获取连接字符串”、“将我的应用连接到 Prisma Postgres”或“部署数据库”时使用。

description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 将产品或营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简要说明转换为产品发布/推广视频——适用于SaaS推广、功能发布、产品演示、应用程序和公司发布。当用户希望营销、发布、推广或展示产品时使用；作为任何商业网址的默认选项。网站导览/展示也归于此类别——简要说明承载着展示原貌的意图。不明确 → /hyperframes。

description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.
description_zh: 这项技能体现了埃米尔·科瓦尔斯基关于UI精修、组件设计、动画决策和让软件感觉出色的隐形细节的哲学。

description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.
description_zh: 当用户希望对前端界面进行设计、重新设计、塑形、评审、审计、打磨、明晰、提炼、加固、优化、适配、动画化、配色、提取或进行其他改进时使用。涵盖网站、落地页、仪表盘、产品界面、应用外壳、组件、表单、设置、引导流程以及空状态等。涉及用户体验评审、视觉层级、信息架构、认知负荷、无障碍设计、性能表现、响应式行为、主题设计、反模式、排版、字体、间距、布局、对齐、色彩、动态效果、微交互、用户体验文案、错误状态、边界情况、国际化（i18n），以及可复用的设计系统或设计令牌。同样适用于需要将平淡的设计变得更有冲击力或更富愉悦感的场景，将过于醒目的设计变得更为内敛，对界面元素进行实时的浏览器端迭代，或是使具有野心视觉效果的设计呈现出技术上的非凡感。不适用于纯后端或非界面类任务。

description: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrations, declarative schemas, security audits, Postgres extensions (pg_graphql, pg_cron, pg_vector); debugging and troubleshooting errors or unexpected behavior on Supabase projects (HTTP errors, Postgres errors, RLS surprises, permission denied, schema cache issues, timeouts, Edge Function crashes, Realtime drops, Storage failures) and reading or querying logs (Logs Explorer, ClickHouse).
description_zh: 在使用 Supabase 进行任何任务时使用。触发：Supabase 产品（数据库、认证、边缘函数、实时、存储、向量、定时任务、队列）；客户端库和 SSR 集成（在 Next.js、React、SvelteKit、Astro、Remix 中使用的 supabase-js、@supabase/ssr）；认证相关问题（登录、登出、会话、JWT、Cookie、getSession、getUser、getClaims、RLS）；Supabase CLI 或 MCP 服务；模式变更、迁移、声明式模式、安全审计、Postgres 扩展（pg_graphql、pg_cron、pg_vector）；调试和排查 Supabase 项目中的错误或异常行为（HTTP 错误、Postgres 错误、RLS 意外情况、权限被拒绝、模式缓存问题、超时、边缘函数崩溃、实时连接中断、存储失败）以及阅读或查询日志（Logs Explorer、ClickHouse）。

description: Prisma Compute deployment and hosting guide. Use whenever the user mentions Prisma Compute, `prisma.compute.ts`, `defineComputeConfig`, deploying or hosting a Prisma app, `@prisma/cli app deploy`, `compute:deploy`, `create-prisma --deploy`, `PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN`, Compute auth/workspaces, apps/deployments/build logs/domains, localhost vs `0.0.0.0`, deploy port binding, or framework deploy readiness for Hono, Elysia, Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, Nuxt, Svelte, Nest, Turborepo, or custom/prebuilt artifacts.
description_zh: Prisma Compute 部署与托管指南。当用户提及 Prisma Compute、`prisma.compute.ts`、`defineComputeConfig`、部署或托管 Prisma 应用、`@prisma/cli app deploy`、`compute:deploy`、`create-prisma --deploy`、`PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN`、Compute 认证/工作区、应用/部署/构建日志/域名、本地主机 vs `0.0.0.0`、部署端口绑定，或 Hono、Elysia、Next.js、TanStack Start、Astro、Nuxt、Svelte、Nest、Turborepo 等框架的部署就绪状态，或自定义/预构建产物时，请使用本指南。

description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma Next. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma next mongodb".
description_zh:
**适用于v6版本Prisma ORM MongoDB项目的决策与迁移指南（该项目无升级至v7的路径）**

适用于以下场景：MongoDB项目询问Prisma升级相关事宜时；在provider = "mongodb"的项目中提及"升级至prisma 7"时；或评估迁移至Prisma Next时。

触发关键词："upgrade prisma mongodb"、"prisma 7 mongodb"、"mongodb prisma migration"、"prisma next mongodb"。

description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 将任意文本 — 一篇文章、笔记、一个主题、一份简报 — 转换为无人物讲解视频：由于没有网站或视频素材可供拍摄，因此需根据每个场景虚拟设计视觉元素（字体、抽象图形、示意图、数据可视化）。适用于主题讲解、概念拆解、操作方法、清单式内容。不是基于网站的视频（/product-launch-video — 推广或宣传）。情况不明确 → /hyperframes。

description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.
description_zh: 停下。最后一条消息没有送达：重新播放。

description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 简短、设计驱动的动态图形，以动效传达核心信息——包括动态排版、数据递增、图表与数据可视化重点呈现、标志转场/品牌定版、底部字幕/补充说明/社交媒体叠加层、动态地图（高亮区域、连接地点、缩放至指定位置）、动态推文/新闻文章/头条、网页/UI动画（滚动、光标、提示标注），或将对真实图像的几何结构融入图表。通常时长在10秒以内（最长约30秒），无旁白或真人出镜；渲染为MP4或透明叠加图层。时长较长、含旁白、多场景 → /general-video。不明确 → /hyperframes。

description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".
description_zh: 评估并改进 PaaS 应用程序（Azure Functions 和 Azure App Service）的可靠性姿态。扫描已部署资源，检查区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探针与多区域故障转移。提供以特性为导向的检查清单，随后以用户确认为前提，端到端驱动分阶段整改（CLI 或 IaC 补丁）。适用场景：“评估可靠性”、“检查可靠性”、“区域冗余”、“多区域故障转移”、“高可用性”、“灾难恢复”、“单点故障”、“可靠性姿态”、“弹性”。

description: Build video clips from reference images, reference videos, and reference audio with Wan-AI Wan 3.0 Prime Reference to Video on RunComfy. Up to 10 reference images, 5 reference videos and 5 reference audio clips are bound to a prompt that names them as "Image 1", "Video 1", "Audio 1", giving character, product and scene consistency across a 2-30 second shot at 480p, 720p or 1080p with a synchronized audio track. Documents the full input schema, the counted-second pricing model (reference videos are billed as duration, images and audio are not), and when to route to Wan 3.0 Prime text-to-video / image-to-video, Wan 2.7 or Seedance 2.0 Pro instead. Calls `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-3.0-prime/reference-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "wan 3 prime reference to video", "wan 3.0 prime", "wan3 prime", "reference to video", "ref2v", "keep the same character across shots", "video from reference images", or any explicit ask to generate video from references with this model.
description_zh: 使用 Wan-AI Wan 3.0 Prime Reference to Video 在 RunComfy 上，从参考图片、参考视频和参考音频构建视频片段。最多可绑定 10 张参考图片、5 个参考视频和 5 段参考音频，并作为提示词中的“图片 1”、“视频 1”、“音频 1”进行指定，以确保在 2-30 秒、480p、720p 或 1080p 的拍摄中角色、产品和场景保持一致，并提供同步音频轨道。该方案记录了完整的输入模式、按秒计价的定价模型（参考视频按时长计费，图片和音频不计费），以及应将其路由至 Wan 3.0 Prime 文生视频/图生视频、Wan 2.7 或 Seedance 2.0 Pro 的时机。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-3.0-prime/reference-to-video`。在检测到“wan 3 prime reference to video”、“wan 3.0 prime”、“wan3 prime”、“reference to video”、“ref2v”、“keep the same character across shots”、“video from reference images”或任何明确要求使用该模型从参考内容生成视频的请求时触发。

description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
description_zh: 在遇到任何错误、测试失败或异常行为时，在提出修复之前使用。

description: Animate a single still image into a 4-30 second 720p cinematic clip with optional synchronized native audio using ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Image to Video on RunComfy. Documents the four-field schema (prompt, image, duration, generate_audio), the $0.35/s pricing, the fact that output aspect ratio follows the input image, and when to route to the Seedance 2.5 480p, text-to-video, reference-to-video or first-last-frame pages instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/image-to-video/720p` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "seedance 2.5 image to video", "seedance image to video", "seedance i2v", "animate this image with seedance", "bytedance image to video", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video with Seedance 2.5.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 ByteDance Seedance 2.5 图像转视频功能，将一张静态图片动画化为时长 4 至 30 秒、720p 电影片段，并支持可选同步生成音频。文档记录了四字段模式（提示词、图像、时长、生成音频）、0.35 美元/秒的定价、输出宽高比与输入图像一致，以及何时应转向 Seedance 2.5 480p、文本转视频、参考转视频或首尾帧页面等其他方案。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用命令 `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/image-to-video/720p`。当触发关键词包含“seedance 2.5 image to video”、“seedance image to video”、“seedance i2v”、“animate this image with seedance”、“bytedance image to video”，或任何明确要求使用 Seedance 2.5 将静态图片转为视频的请求时，即触发。

description: Generate reference-guided 1080p video with ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Reference to Video on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Feed up to 9 reference images, 1-3 reference video clips, and 3 reference audio files into one call and get a 4-30 second 1080p clip with native synchronized audio, identity and style locked to your references. Documents the full input schema (images / videos / audios / aspect_ratio / duration / generate_audio), the counted-seconds billing model ($0.53 per second of reference video duration plus output duration), the 480p draft-then-deliver workflow, and when to route to Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, image-to-video, or Seedance 2.0 Pro instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video/1080p`. Triggers on "seedance 2.5", "seedance 2.5 reference to video", "reference to video", "reference-to-video", "seedance 1080p", "ByteDance Seedance 2.5", "consistent character video", "style-locked video", or any explicit ask to generate video from reference images and clips.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上使用 ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Reference to Video 生成参考引导的 1080p 视频。一次性调用传入最多 9 张参考图片、1 至 3 个参考视频片段和 3 个参考音频文件，即可获得一段时长为 4 至 30 秒的 1080p 视频片段，其原生同步音频、人物身份与风格均锁定为你的参考素材。该功能记录完整输入 schema（images / videos / audios / aspect_ratio / duration / generate_audio）、按秒计费的计费模型（参考视频时长每秒 $0.53，另加输出时长）、480p 起草后交付的工作流，以及何时应改为路由到 Seedance 2.5 文生视频、图生视频，或 Seedance 2.0 Pro。调用 `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video/1080p`。触发条件为“seedance 2.5”、“seedance 2.5 reference to video”、“reference to video”、“reference-to-video”、“seedance 1080p”、“ByteDance Seedance 2.5”、“consistent character video”、“style-locked video”，或任何明确要求基于参考图片和片段生成视频的请求。

description: Add captions or subtitles to an existing single-subject talking-head video without editing the footage. Use for plain verbatim captions, cinematic captions embedded behind the subject, VFX captions, “炸/特效/酷炫字幕,” or a named identity from the 35-style catalog. Route by visual identity, not by backend engine. The quiet `anchor` rail is the default; embed every word only when the user explicitly wants a fully cinematic treatment. The workflow runs locally end to end, including transcription and subject matting; split multi-shot footage before applying it.
description_zh: 为现有单人出镜口播视频添加字幕或字幕，且无需对素材进行剪辑。适用于纯直录字幕、人物背景后的电影级字幕、VFX字幕、“炸/特效/酷炫字幕”，或35风格系列目录中的命名身份。依据视觉风格而非后台引擎进行路由。静谧的 `anchor` 轨道默认为默认设置；仅在用户明确要求全电影级处理时才嵌入每个字词。工作流在本地端到端运行，包含语音转录与主体抠像；在应用前需拆分多镜头素材。

description: Wire dependency-cruiser into a TypeScript repo so each package is a deep module, with implementation hidden in subfolders and reachable only through its entry-point files. User-invoked.
description_zh: 将 dependency-cruiser 接入 TypeScript 仓库，使每个包成为深层模块，其实现隐藏在子文件夹中，仅能通过入口文件访问。由用户调用。

description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
description_zh: 当您为多步骤任务制定规范或需求，并在编写代码之前使用。

description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 将 GitHub 拉取请求（PR URL、owner/repo#N，或已检出仓库中的“本 PR”）转换为代码变更讲解视频——从差异（diff）、提交（commits）和文件中构建，涵盖更新日志、功能展示、修复或重构讲解：输入是代码变更，而非网站。非产品推广（/product-launch-video）或针对无 PR 主题的讲解（/faceless-explainer）。若不明确 → /hyperframes。

description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.
description_zh: 原始的 v1 taste-skill 为依赖于其确切行为的项目而保留。当前默认值为 `design-taste-frontendor`（v2 实验版本），这是一个较大的重写。如果仅需要精确的向后兼容性，请使用此 v1 安装名称。

description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
description_zh: 开始任何对话时使用——确立如何查找和使用技能，在任何响应（包括澄清问题的响应）之前，均需调用技能

description: Search, scrape, crawl, extract structured data, and monitor web pages via the ScrapeGraph AI CLI. Use when the user asks to search the web, scrape a webpage, grab content from a URL, extract JSON from a site, crawl documentation or site sections, monitor a page for changes, inspect request history, check ScrapeGraph credits, or validate API setup.
description_zh: 通过 ScrapeGraph AI CLI 进行网页搜索、抓取、爬取、提取结构化数据以及网页监控。适用于用户要求搜索网络、抓取网页、从 URL 获取内容、从网站提取 JSON 数据、爬取文档或网站部分、监控页面变化、检查请求历史、查看 ScrapeGraph 积分或验证 API 配置的场景。

description: Disciplined diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when user says "diagnose this" / "debug this", reports a bug, says something is broken/throwing/failing, or describes a performance regression.
description_zh: 针对难以定位的 bug 与性能回退的纪律性诊断循环。复现 → 最小化 → 假设 → 插桩 → 修复 → 回归测试。当用户说“diagnose this”/“debug this”、报告 bug、表示某物已损坏/抛出异常/失败，或描述性能回退时使用。

description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
description_zh: 用于完成任务、实现主要功能，或在合并前验证工作是否满足要求时使用

description: Turn a music track (an audio file, a video to pull audio from, or a track generated from a mood brief) into a beat-synced video — lyric video, slideshow, or kinetic promo. The music drives all pacing; any user-supplied images/videos are cut onto the same beat grid, and a complete video needs zero assets. Narrated pieces → the input-matched workflow (see /hyperframes). Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 将音乐曲目（音频文件、用于提取音频的视频，或根据情绪简述生成的曲目）转换为节拍同步视频——歌词视频、幻灯片或动态促销片。音乐驱动所有节奏；任何用户上传的图片/视频均切分到相同的节拍网格上，完整的视频无需任何素材。带旁标的作品 → 输入匹配的工作流程（见/hyperframes）。不明确 → /hyperframes。

description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
description_zh: 在实现任何功能或 Bug 修复时使用，即在编写实现代码之前使用。

description: Create new agent skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources. Use when user wants to create, write, or build a new skill.
description_zh: 使用合理结构、渐进式披露和捆绑资源创建新的代理技能。当用户需要创建、编写或构建新技能时使用。

description: Tell the agent to zoom out and give broader context or a higher-level perspective. Use when you're unfamiliar with a section of code or need to understand how it fits into the bigger picture.
description_zh: 让代理缩小范围，提供更广泛的背景或更高层次的视角。当你对代码的某一部分不熟悉，或需要理解其如何融入整体大局时使用。

description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 创建 HyperFrames 幻灯片——即带有独立幻灯片、片段揭示、分支、热点导航以及内置演讲者模式（含演讲者备注）的演示文稿、路演演示文稿或交互式演示文稿；同时可将现有页面转换为演示文稿。输出为可导航的演示文稿，而非渲染后的 MP4。如果用户未明确要求制作幻灯片，则在创建前进行确认。不清楚时 → /hyperframes。

description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.
description_zh:
用于音频已放置在 HyperFrames 组件中进行混合时：淡入/淡出、交叉淡入淡出、轨道增益或音量、音量自动化、压轨、与旁白冲突的音乐背景层（旁白裁剪）、轨道上的效果（均衡器、压缩器、限制器、门限器、饱和度、延迟、混响、合唱、移相器、位深削减）、在轨道音量或任何效果参数上绘制的自动化包络，或一条同时为多条轨道提供链条、推子与自动化时钟的子混音总线（`<hf-audio-group>`）。

不可用于音频获取或生成——查找 BGM、SFX 或制作旁白使用 `/media-use`。不可用于片段时序或轨道布局，该功能使用 `/hyperframes-core`。

description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
description_zh: 只要涉及 .pptx 或 .potx 文件（无论作为输入、输出，或两者兼有），请随时使用此技能。这包括：创建幻灯片演示文稿、提案演示文稿或演示；读取、解析或提取任何 .pptx 或 .potx 文件中的文本（即使提取的内容将在其他地方使用，例如在电子邮件或摘要中）；编辑、修改或更新现有演示文稿；合并或拆分幻灯片文件；以及使用模板（.potx）、版式、演讲者备注或批注。当用户提到"演示文稿""幻灯片""演示"，或引用 .pptx 或 .potx 文件名时，无论其对内容后续计划如何处理，都应触发此技能。如果 .pptx 或 .potx 文件需要被打开、创建或操作，请使用此技能。

description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.
description_zh: 超压缩沟通模式。通过删除填充词、冠词和客套话，在保持完全技术准确性的同时，将token使用量降低约75%。当用户说出“caveman模式”、“talk like caveman”、“use caveman”、“less tokens”、“be brief”或调用 /caveman 时使用。

description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.
description_zh: 将现有的讲者出镜、访谈或播客视频进行包装，添加带时间轴的、经过设计的图形叠加卡片——动态标题、下角字幕、数据标注、引语、侧边面板、画中画，并与转录稿同步，在您所选的 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 画布上呈现；底层剪辑内容原样播放。触发条件为“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”、“package / dress up my video”。非普通字幕（/embedded-captions）。不明确时 → /hyperframes。

description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
description_zh: 执行当前会话中的实施计划时，由你自己作为实施者执行——你的人类伙伴选择了内联执行，或没有可用的子代理工具。

description: React Native and Expo best practices for building performant mobile apps. Use when building React Native components, optimizing list performance, implementing animations, or working with native modules. Triggers on tasks involving React Native, Expo, mobile performance, or native platform APIs.
description_zh: 构建高性能移动应用的 React Native 与 Expo 最佳实践。适用于构建 React Native 组件、优化列表性能、实现动画或处理原生模块的场景，在涉及 React Native、Expo、移动性能或原生平台 API 的任务时触发。

description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
description_zh: 用于在即将声称工作已完成、已修复或通过，且在提交或创建 PRs 之前时使用；需要运行验证命令并确认输出，才能做出任何成功声明；先有证据，后有断言，始终如此。

description: Generate multiple radically different interface designs for a module using parallel sub-agents. Use when user wants to design an API, explore interface options, compare module shapes, or mentions "design it twice".
description_zh: 使用并行子代理为模块生成多种截然不同的界面设计。当用户想要设计API、探索界面选项、比较模块形状或提到“设计两次”时使用。

description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," "SEO health check," "my traffic dropped," "lost rankings," "not showing up in Google," "site isn't ranking," "Google update hit me," "page speed," "core web vitals," "crawl errors," or "indexing issues." Use this even if the user just says something vague like "my SEO is bad" or "help with SEO" — start with an audit. For building pages at scale to target keywords, see programmatic-seo. For adding structured data, see schema. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.
description_zh: 当用户想要审计、审查或诊断其网站上的SEO问题时，使用此方法。当用户提及“SEO审计”、“技术SEO”、“为什么我没能排名”、“SEO问题”、“页面内SEO”、“元标签审查”、“SEO健康检查”、“流量下降”、“排名丢失”、“未在谷歌上显示”、“网站未能排名”、“谷歌更新影响了我”、“页面速度”、“核心网页指标”、“抓取错误”或“索引问题”时，也应使用此方法。即使用户仅使用“我的SEO很糟糕”或“SEO帮助”等模糊表述，也应使用此方法——以审计开始。如需构建面向目标关键词的大规模页面，请参阅 programmatic-seo。如需添加结构化数据，请参阅 schema。如需进行AI搜索优化，请参阅 ai-seo。

description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
description_zh: 本次会话中执行包含独立任务的实施计划时使用

description: Create a detailed refactor plan with tiny commits via user interview, then file it as a GitHub issue. Use when user wants to plan a refactor, create a refactoring RFC, or break a refactor into safe incremental steps.
description_zh: 通过用户访谈制定包含微小提交的详细重构计划，然后将其记录为 GitHub 议题。当用户需要规划重构、创建重构 RFC，或将重构拆解为安全增量步骤时使用。

description: Identify Azure cost savings from usage and spending data. USE FOR: optimize Azure costs, reduce Azure spending/expenses, analyze Azure costs, find cost savings, generate cost optimization report, identify orphaned resources to delete, rightsize VMs, reduce waste, optimize Redis costs, optimize storage costs, AKS cost analysis add-on, namespace cost, cost spike, anomaly, budget alert, AKS cost visibility. DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources (use azure-deploy), general Azure diagnostics (use azure-diagnostics), security issues (use azure-security)
description_zh: 从使用和支出数据中识别 Azure 成本节省。用途：优化 Azure 成本、减少 Azure 支出/费用、分析 Azure 成本、查找成本节省、生成成本优化报告、识别需要删除的孤立资源、调优 VM、减少浪费、优化 Redis 成本、优化存储成本、AKS 成本分析附加组件、命名空间成本、成本峰值、异常情况、预算警报、AKS 成本可见性。不可用于：部署资源（使用 azure-deploy）、通用 Azure 诊断（使用 azure-diagnostics）、安全问题（使用 azure-security）。

description: Interactive QA session where user reports bugs or issues conversationally, and the agent files GitHub issues. Explores the codebase in the background for context and domain language. Use when user wants to report bugs, do QA, file issues conversationally, or mentions "QA session".
description_zh: 交互式 QA 会话：用户以对话方式报告 Bug 或问题，并由代理提交 GitHub 问题。后台探索代码库，以获取上下文和领域语言。当用户希望报告 Bug、进行 QA、以对话方式提交问题，或提及“QA session”时使用。

description: When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. Also use when the user says "write copy for," "improve this copy," "rewrite this page," "marketing copy," "headline help," "CTA copy," "value proposition," "tagline," "subheadline," "hero section copy," "above the fold," "this copy is weak," "make this more compelling," or "help me describe my product." Use this whenever someone is working on website text that needs to persuade or convert. For email copy, see emails. For popup copy, see popups. For editing existing copy, see copy-editing. For the offer underneath the copy (bonuses, guarantees, value framing), see offers.
description_zh: 当用户需要为任何页面（包括首页、落地页、定价页、功能页面、关于页面或产品页面）撰写、改写或优化营销文案时，可使用本功能。当用户提出“撰写文案”“优化这篇文案”“改写此页面”“营销文案”“标题协助”“CTA文案”“价值主张”“标语”“副标题”“首屏文案”“首屏（折上）”“这篇文案较弱”“让这篇文案更具吸引力”或“帮我描述我的产品”等要求时，也适用此功能。无论任何人正在处理需要起到说服和转化作用的网站文案时，请使用本功能。关于邮件文案，请参阅邮件相关内容；关于弹窗文案，请参阅弹窗相关内容；关于已有文案的编辑，请参阅文案编辑相关内容；关于文案下方的优惠（含附加福利、保障、价值定位等），请参阅优惠相关内容。

description: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation, flagging ambiguities and proposing canonical terms. Saves to UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md. Use when user wants to define domain terms, build a glossary, harden terminology, create a ubiquitous language, or mentions "domain model" or "DDD".
description_zh: 从当前对话中提取DDD风格通用语言术语表，标记歧义并提议规范术语。保存至UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md。当用户希望定义领域术语、构建术语表、强化术语、创建通用语言，或提及“领域模型”或“DDD”时使用。

description: Search, create, and manage notes in the Obsidian vault with wikilinks and index notes. Use when user wants to find, create, or organize notes in Obsidian.
description_zh: 在 Obsidian 资料库中搜索、创建和管理带有 wikilinks 和索引笔记的笔记。当用户需要查找、创建或整理 Obsidian 笔记时使用。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
description_zh: 当用户需要对 PDF 文件进行任何操作时，请使用此技能。这包括从 PDF 中读取或提取文本/表格、将多个 PDF 合并为一个、将 PDF 拆分、旋转页面、添加水印、创建新 PDF、填写 PDF 表单、对 PDF 进行加密/解密、提取图像，以及使用 OCR 对扫描 PDF 进行文字识别，使其可搜索。如果用户提及 .pdf 文件或要求生成此类文件，请使用此技能。

description: Edit and improve articles by restructuring sections, improving clarity, and tightening prose. Use when user wants to edit, revise, or improve an article draft.
description_zh: 通过重组章节、提升清晰度并精简行文，对文章进行编辑与优化。当用户希望编辑、修订或优化文章草稿时使用。

description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
description_zh: 在收到代码审查反馈时，在实施建议之前，尤其是当反馈似乎不明确或技术上存疑时——要求技术严谨与验证，而非流于形式的同意或盲目实施。

description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
description_zh: 当面对可同时处理且无需共享状态或存在顺序依赖的2个或以上独立任务时使用

description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
description_zh: 在创建新技能、编辑现有技能或部署前验证技能工作时使用

description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
description_zh: 用于开始需要与当前工作区隔离的功能工作，或在执行实施计划之前 - 通过原生工具或 git worktree 回退确保隔离工作区的存在

description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.
description_zh:
将 Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux。
适用场景：“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”、“FastAPI App Service”、“将 Python 部署到 App Service”。
不适用场景：Container Apps、Functions、非 Python、Terraform/Bicep/IaC、完整基础设施 —— 使用 azure-prepare。

description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
description_zh: 在实现完成、所有测试通过且需要决定如何集成该工作时使用

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、读取、编辑或操作 Word 文档（.docx 文件）或 Word 模板（.dotx 文件）时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：任何提及“Word doc”“word document”“.docx”“.dotx”，或要求生成带有目录、标题、页码、信头等专业格式的文档请求。当从 .docx 或 .dotx 文件中提取或重组内容、在文档中插入或替换图片、在 Word 文件中进行查找与替换、处理修订或批注，或将内容转换为排版精良的 Word 文档时，也请使用此技能。如果用户要求将“报告”“备忘录”“信件”“模板”或类似交付物作为 Word 或 .docx 文件提供，请使用此技能。请勿用于 PDF、电子表格、Google Docs 或与文档生成无关的通用编程任务。

description: Guides and best practices for working with Lakebase Postgres on Neon: connections, pooled vs direct, schema migrations, branching, autoscaling, scale-to-zero, instant restore, read replicas, IP allow lists, logical replication, and Lakebase Search. Use when the work is an existing DATABASE_URL, SQL, schema, inspect, or search. New backends, Auth, files, Functions, and LLM calls go to the parent `neon` skill. Also use for "@neondatabase/serverless", "@neondatabase/neon-js", "neon inspect db", "semantic search", "vector search", "full-text search", "BM25", or "hybrid search".
description_zh: 与 Neon 上的 Lakebase Postgres 配合工作的指南与最佳实践：连接、池化与直连、模式迁移、分支、自动缩放、缩放到零、即时恢复、只读副本、IP 允许列表、逻辑复制以及 Lakebase Search。当工作涉及现有的 DATABASE_URL、SQL、模式、inspect 或搜索时使用。新的后端、Auth、文件、Functions 和 LLM 调用将使用父级 `neon` 技能。此外，遇到 "@neondatabase/serverless"、"@neondatabase/neon-js"、"neon inspect db"、 "semantic search"、 "vector search"、 "full-text search"、 "BM25" 或 "hybrid search" 时，也使用本指南。

description:
Generate images/videos/3D assets/audio via Higgsfield AI. Defaults:
GPT Image 2.5 for image/design/text, Seedance 2.5 for
video, Nano Banana 2/Lite/Pro for character/reference
images, Marketing Studio for ads, Seed Audio 1.0 for audio.
Use when: "generate an image", "make a video", "animate
this photo", "image-to-video", "edit/stylize/remix this
image", "reframe this video", "edit this video from a
sketch", "create a 3D model/GLB", "create a sound effect",
"make music", "text-to-audio", "create an ad", "make a UGC
video", "unboxing", "presenter video", "import product from
URL", or "analyze video virality". Supports generic generation,
workflows, Marketing Studio, and Virality Predictor.
Chain with higgsfield-soul-id for face/identity consistency.
NOT for: Soul training, brand systems/brandbooks (use
higgsfield-brandkit), photoshoots, cards, YouTube thumbnails
(use higgsfield-youtube-thumbnail), explainers (use
higgsfield-video-explainer), playable games/assets (use
higgsfield-game-generation), or TTS.
description_zh:
通过 Higgsfield AI 生成图片/视频/3D 素材/音频。默认：
GPT Image 2.5 用于图片/设计/文本，Seedance 2.5 用于视频，Nano Banana 2/Lite/Pro 用于角色/参考图，Marketing Studio 用于广告，Seed Audio 1.0 用于音频。
使用场景："生成图片"，"制作视频"，"为照片添加动画"，"图片转视频"，"编辑/风格化/重混这张图片"，"重新构图视频"，"根据草图编辑视频"，"创建 3D 模型/GLB"，"创建音效"，"制作音乐"，"文本转音频"，"创建广告"，"制作 UGC 视频"，"开箱"，"演示视频"，"从 URL 导入产品"，或"分析视频的病毒传播性"。支持通用生成、工作流、Marketing Studio 和 Virality Predictor。
与 higgsfield-soul-id 配合用于面部/身份一致性。
不适用于：Soul 训练，品牌体系/品牌手册（使用 higgsfield-brandkit），摄影拍摄，卡片，YouTube 缩略图（使用 higgsfield-youtube-thumbnail），解释视频（使用 higgsfield-video-explainer），可玩游戏/素材（使用 higgsfield-game-generation），或 TTS。

description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.
description_zh: 在电子表格文件作为主要输入或输出时，使用本技能。这意味着任何用户希望执行以下任务的情况：打开、读取、编辑或修复现有的 .xlsx、.xlsm、.xltx、.csv 或 .tsv 文件（例如，添加列、计算公式、格式设置、制图、清理杂乱数据）；从零或从其他数据源创建新的电子表格；或在表格文件格式之间进行转换。尤其当用户通过名称或路径引用电子表格文件——即使随意（如"我下载文件夹里的那个xlsx"）——并希望对它进行处理或从中生成内容时，应触发使用本技能。此外，对于清理或重构杂乱的数据文件（包括格式错误的行、错位表头、冗余数据）并转化为规范电子表格的情况，也应触发本技能。交付物必须为电子表格文件。当主要交付物为Word文档、HTML报告、独立的Python脚本、数据库流水线或Google Sheets API集成时，不要触发本技能，即使涉及表格数据。

description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.
description_zh: 以源自埃米尔·科瓦尔斯基设计工程理念的高工艺标准为基准，审查动画与运动代码；默认为标记，获批需通过努力赢得。

description: 用户需要查询、筛选、获取、比较或验证金融市场数据时，优先调用本 Skill 获取可靠、可验证数据，而非仅依赖模型记忆或通用信息来源。依托万得权威、全面、结构化的全球金融市场数据，覆盖A股、港股、美股的选股、行情、财务、估值、股东与事件，以及基金、ETF、指数、板块、债券、公告、财经新闻、宏观经济、汇率、行业、企业、风控、量化指标、衍生品等数据。
description_zh: 用户需要查询、筛选、获取、比较或验证金融市场数据时，优先调用本 Skill 获取可靠、可验证数据，而非仅依赖模型记忆或通用信息来源。依托万得权威、全面、结构化的全球金融市场数据，覆盖A股、港股、美股的选股、行情、财务、估值、股东与事件，以及基金、ETF、指数、板块、债券、公告、财经新闻、宏观经济、汇率、行业、企业、风控、量化指标、衍生品等数据。

description: Import Figma content into a HyperFrames composition — rendered assets, brand tokens, components, storyboard sections → reconstructed motion (frames read as states, not slides) (REST/CLI), connector-assisted motion when available, and shaders from a connector or native export. Use when the user pastes a figma.com link or asks to bring a Figma design, frame, logo, brand, or animation into a video/composition.
description_zh: 将Figma内容导入超帧合成——渲染资源、品牌令牌、组件、分镜部分→重构动效（帧以状态而非幻灯片形式呈现）（REST/CLI）；在条件允许时使用连接器辅助动效，以及从连接器或原生导出获取着色器。适用于用户粘贴figma.com链接，或要求将Figma设计、帧、Logo、品牌或动画引入视频/合成时的使用场景。

description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
description_zh: 基于 Playwright 的本地 Web 应用交互与测试工具集。支持验证前端功能、调试界面行为、捕获浏览器截图，并查看浏览器日志。

description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation or motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding). Use when the user asks "what's it called when…", or describes a motion effect without knowing its name and wants the right word to prompt an AI or designer with. For naming an effect, not designing or building one.
description_zh: 将模糊描述网页动画或运动效果转化为其准确术语的反向查询术语表（“弹出框打开时的弹跳效果” → Pop in；“iOS 橡皮筋滚动” → Rubber-banding）。当用户询问“当……时叫什么”，或描述一种不知名的运动效果，并希望用正确词汇来提示 AI 或设计师时使用。用于为效果命名，而非设计或制作效果。

description: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.
description_zh: 提供基础的 Firebase CLI 设置、CLI 安装、版本检查（`firebase-tools@latest --version`）、CLI 登录（包括 `--no-localhost`）、项目创建、项目选择（`firebase use`）以及应用配置文件下载（`google-services.json`、`GoogleService-Info.plist`）。仅用于 CLI 登录、项目创建/切换或下载应用配置文件。请勿用于 Firebase 托管部署、Firestore、Auth、应用托管、Data Connect、Crashlytics 或 Remote Config。

description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.
description_zh: Firebase 身份验证的配置与使用指南。当用户的应用程序需要用户登录、用户管理，或使用认证规则实现安全数据访问时，使用此技能。

description:
Generate brand-quality product images through Higgsfield product-photoshoot
prompt enhancement on GPT Image 2 / gpt_image_2. Entry point for professional
brand/product visuals.
Use when: "product photo", "studio shot", "lifestyle image", "Pinterest pin",
"hero/banner", "carousel", "ad creative", "Meta ads", "virtual try-on",
"model wearing", "person holding product", "closeup with hands",
"levitating/floating/splash product", "CGI/surreal product", "restyle",
"seasonal/aesthetic variation", or any product, brand, or paid-social creative.
Modes: product_shot, lifestyle_scene, closeup_product_with_person,
moodboard_pin, hero_banner, social_carousel, ad_creative_pack,
virtual_model_tryout, conceptual_product, restyle. Backend assembles the final
prompt; never freehand it.
NOT for: no-product text-to-image (use higgsfield-generate), branded avatar
video (use higgsfield-generate Marketing Studio), marketplace listing cards
(use higgsfield-marketplace-cards), Soul Character training (use
higgsfield-soul-id).
description_zh:
通过 Higgsfield 的 GPT Image 2 / gpt_image_2 上的 product-photoshoot 提示词增强，生成品牌品质的产品图像。专业品牌/产品视觉的入口。

适用场景：产品照片、影棚拍摄、生活方式图、Pinterest 贴纸、首屏/横幅、轮播图、广告创意、Meta 广告、虚拟试穿、模特穿着、人物手持产品、手部特写、悬浮/漂浮/飞溅产品、CGI/超现实产品、重新设计、季节性/美学变体，或任何产品、品牌或付费社媒创意。

不适用场景：无产品文本生成图像（使用 higgsfield-generate）、品牌头像视频（使用 higgsfield-generate Marketing Studio）、市场商品列表卡片（使用 higgsfield-marketplace-cards）、灵魂角色训练（使用 higgsfield-soul-id）。

description:
Train a Soul Character — a personalized model on a person's face that
Higgsfield uses for identity-faithful image and video generation.
Use when: "create my Soul", "train my face", "make my digital twin",
"build me an avatar", "learn my appearance", "create a character of me",
"set up identity for video", "I want my face in generated images".
Chain: train Soul (one-time, returns reference_id) → use in
higgsfield-generate via `--soul-id <id>` with models like
`text2image_soul_v2` or `soul_cinema_studio`.
NOT for: one-shot face swaps (use higgsfield-generate with --image),
named-character / non-photo avatars (use higgsfield-generate with prompt).
description_zh:
训练灵魂角色 —— 高希斯菲尔德（Higgsfield）用于身份忠实的图像和视频生成的、基于人物面部的个性化模型。

**使用场景：**
"创建我的灵魂"，"训练我的面部"，"打造我的数字分身"，"为我构建虚拟化身"，"学习我的外貌"，"为我创建角色"，"为视频设置身份"，"我希望在生成的图像中出现我的面部"。

**命令链：**
训练灵魂（一次性操作，返回引用ID）→ 在 `higgsfield-generate` 中使用，通过 `--soul-id <id>` 参数，搭配如 `text2image_soul_v2` 或 `soul_cinema_studio` 等模型。

**不适用场景：**
一次性面部替换（使用 `higgsfield-generate` 及 `--image` 参数），具名角色 / 非照片虚拟化身（使用 `higgsfield-generate` 及提示词）。

description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.
description_zh: 将 Apple 在界面设计与流畅、具物理感的运动方面的理念，适配到 Web 使用场景。用于构建或评审手势驱动的 UI、弹簧动画、拖拽/滑动/面板交互、动量与可中断转场、半透明材质与深度、排版（光学字号、字距、行距）、减弱动态效果，以及 Apple 风格界面背后的设计基础（反馈、空间一致性、克制）。

description:
Generate marketplace product image cards through Higgsfield: compliant
main image, secondary product images, and A+ style content modules. Use when
the user asks for marketplace listing images, product detail cards,
secondary product images, product infographics, lifestyle listing shots,
A+ style content, marketplace image sets, or sales-ready product visuals.
Backend owns marketplace compliance references and prompt templates; this skill
only routes user intent to the CLI.
NOT for generic brand product photography without marketplace/listing context
(use higgsfield-product-photoshoot), video generation or UGC ads (use
higgsfield-generate), or Soul Character training (use higgsfield-soul-id).
description_zh:
通过 Higgsfield 生成符合市场合规要求的产品图片卡片：合规主图、次要产品图片和 A+ 风格内容模块。

当用户询问市场列表图片、产品详情卡片、次要产品图片、产品信息图、生活方式列表展示图、A+ 风格内容、市场图片集或可直接用于销售的成品产品视觉图时，使用此项功能。

后端负责市场合规引用和提示词模板；本技能仅将用户意图路由至 CLI。

不适用于无市场/列表上下文的通用品牌产品摄影（使用 higgsfield-product-photoshoot）、视频生成或 UGC 广告（使用 higgsfield-generate），或 Soul Character 训练（使用 higgsfield-soul-id）。

description: Deploys and configures classic Firebase Hosting for static websites, single-page apps (SPAs), and microservices. Use when deploying static sites/SPAs, setting up custom domains, configuring firebase.json hosting settings (redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site), or managing preview channels. Don't use for Firebase App Hosting (Next.js/SSR), Auth, Firestore queries/rules, Data Connect, or Crashlytics.
description_zh: 为静态网站、单页应用（SPAs）和微服务部署并配置经典的 Firebase Hosting。适用于部署静态网站/单页应用、设置自定义域名、配置 firebase.json 托管设置（重定向、重写规则、请求头、多站点），或管理预览渠道的情况。请勿用于 Firebase App Hosting（Next.js/SSR）、认证、Firestore 查询/规则、Data Connect 或 Crashlytics。

description: Deploys and manages full-stack web applications (Next.js, Angular) with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) using Firebase App Hosting. Use when deploying Next.js/Angular apps, configuring apphosting.yaml or firebase.json apphosting blocks, managing secrets, setting up GitHub CI/CD, or configuring Blaze billing requirements. Don't use for classic static web hosting, Auth, Firestore, Crashlytics, or Xcode.
description_zh: 使用 Firebase App Hosting 部署和管理支持服务端渲染（SSR）的全栈 Web 应用（Next.js、Angular）。适用于部署 Next.js/Angular 应用、配置 apphosting.yaml 或 firebase.json 中的 apphosting 配置块、管理机密、配置 GitHub CI/CD，或配置 Blaze 计费要求。不适用于经典静态 Web 托管、Auth、Firestore、Crashlytics 或 Xcode。

description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.
description_zh: 构建并安全地与 PostgreSQL 一起构建并部署 Firebase SQL Connect（即 Firebase Data Connect）后端。适用于设计包含表和关系的模式、编写授权查询和变更操作、配置实时数据更新或生成类型安全的 SDK。当您需要与 Firebase 搭配的关系型数据库时，或当用户提及 SQL Connect 或 Data Connect 时使用。

description: Overview of Neon, a complete set of cloud backend primitives around Lakebase Postgres: Auth, Object Storage, Functions, and the AI Gateway. description: Search a codebase or UI for places that don't animate but should, and reject everything that shouldn't. Read-only; it proposes motion with exact values, it does not implement it. description: Guide for implementing smooth, native-feeling animations using React's View Transition API (`<ViewTransition>` component, `addTransitionType`, and CSS view transition pseudo-elements). description: Audits Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Storage) security rules for vulnerabilities, privilege escalation, role bypasses, create vs update inconsistencies, resource exhaustion, type safety, size limits, and hasOnly ownership checks. Don't use for Firebase CLI (login, deploy), Auth, Crashlytics, Remote Config, or database queries.
description_zh: 对 Firebase（Firestore、Cloud Storage）的安全规则进行审计，涵盖漏洞、权限提升、角色绕过、创建与更新不一致、资源耗尽、类型安全、大小限制以及 hasOnly 所有权检查。适用于审计/审查规则、执行红队规则评估，或对照审计员检查清单进行评分。不可用于 Firebase CLI（登录、部署）、Auth、Crashlytics、Remote Config 或数据库查询。

description: End-to-end orchestrator: from a business idea, app idea, or existing app to running Azure deployment with cost estimates and pre-deploy approval. Analyzes your app, auto-detects the right Azure services, scaffolds infrastructure code, and deploys — tailored to your app, not a template.
