description: Optimizes application performance across frontend, backend, queries, and databases. Use when performance requirements exist, when you suspect performance regressions, when Core Web Vitals or load times need improvement, when N+1 query patterns need fixing, or when profiling reveals bottlenecks.
description_zh: 优化应用程序在前后端、查询及数据库方面的性能。适用于存在性能要求、怀疑出现性能回退、需要改善 Core Web Vitals 或加载时间、需要修复 N+1 查询模式，或性能剖析揭示瓶颈时。

description: Golang performance optimization patterns and methodology - if X bottleneck, then apply Y. Covers allocation reduction, CPU efficiency, memory layout, GC tuning, pooling, caching, and hot-path optimization. Use when profiling or benchmarks have identified a bottleneck and you need the right optimization pattern to fix it. Also use when performing performance code review to suggest improvements or benchmarks that could help identify quick performance gains. Not for measurement methodology (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` skill) or debugging workflow (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` skill).
description_zh: Golang 性能优化模式与方法论——如果 X 存在瓶颈，则应用 Y。涵盖分配减少、CPU 效率、内存布局、GC 调优、池化、缓存和热路径优化。当性能剖析或基准测试已识别出瓶颈，且需要合适的优化模式来修复该瓶颈时使用。在执行性能代码审查时，也用于建议改进方案或基准测试，以帮助识别快速性能提升。不适用于测量方法论（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` 技能）或调试流程（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` 技能）。

description: Security best practices and vulnerability prevention for Golang — injection (SQL, command, XSS), cryptography, path traversal, SSRF and HTTP security headers, cookies, secrets management, memory safety, PII in logs, STRIDE/DREAD threat modeling, plus `gosec` SAST, race detection, and fuzz testing. Apply when writing, reviewing, or auditing Go code for security, or when touching crypto, file or network I/O, secrets, user input, or authentication. Not for non-exploitable defensive bugs such as nil panics or slice aliasing (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill), dependency vulnerability scanning with govulncheck (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` skill), or wiring security scanners into CI pipelines (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-continuous-integration` skill).
description_zh: Go语言安全最佳实践与漏洞防范——注入（SQL、命令、XSS）、密码学、路径遍历、SSRF 及 HTTP 安全响应头、Cookie、密钥管理、内存安全、日志中的 PII、STRIDE/DREAD 威胁建模，以及 `gosec` 静态应用安全测试（SAST）、竞态检测和模糊测试。在编写、审查或审计 Go 代码以保障安全时，或在处理密码学、文件或网络 I/O、密钥、用户输入或认证时应用。不适用于诸如 nil panic 或切片别名等非可利用的防御性 bug（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` 技能）、使用 govulncheck 进行依赖漏洞扫描（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` 技能），或将安全扫描器集成到 CI 流水线（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-continuous-integration` 技能）。

description: Golang concurrency design — goroutine lifecycle and leak prevention, channels and `select`, channel ownership and direction, `sync.Mutex`/`RWMutex`/`sync.Map`/`sync.Once`/atomics, `errgroup`, `singleflight`, worker pools, and fan-out/fan-in pipelines. Use when writing or reviewing concurrent Go code, when choosing between channels and mutexes, when protecting a shared map or counter, or when a goroutine has no clear exit. Not for defensive coding unrelated to concurrency such as nil panics, slice aliasing, or numeric overflow (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill), and not for debugging a specific hung, crashing, or racing program after the fact (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` skill).
description_zh: Golang 并发设计 — goroutine 生命周期与泄漏防止，通道与 `select`，通道所有权与方向，`sync.Mutex`/`sync.RWMutex`/`sync.Map`/`sync.Once`/atomics，`errgroup`、`singleflight`、工作池与扇出/扇入管道。适用于编写或审查并发 Go 代码时，在通道与互斥锁之间进行选择时，在保护共享 map 或计数器时，或者当 goroutine 没有明确的退出方式时。不适用于与并发无关的防御性编码，例如 nil panic、切片别名或数值溢出（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill），且不适用于事后调试特定的卡住、崩溃或竞态程序（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` skill）。

description: Idiomatic context.Context usage in Golang — propagation through API boundaries, cancellation, timeouts and deadlines, request-scoped values, context.WithoutCancel for background work outliving requests. description_zh: Golang 中惯用的 context.Context 用法：跨 API 边界传播、取消、超时与截止时间、请求作用域的值，以及 context.WithoutCancel 用于后台任务超出请求生命周期的场景。适用于设计跨层级的 context 传播、调试泄漏或未过期的 context、在 context.Background、context.TODO 以及 context.WithoutCancel 之间进行选择，或在 context 中存储值。不适用于仅将 ctx 作为第一个参数接收的代码。

description: Go (Golang) naming conventions — covers packages, constructors, structs, interfaces, constants, enums, errors, booleans, receivers, getters/setters, functional options, acronyms, test functions, and subtest names. Use this skill when writing new Go code, reviewing or refactoring, choosing between naming alternatives (New vs NewTypeName, isConnected vs connected, ErrNotFound vs NotFoundError, StatusReady vs StatusUnknown at iota 0), debating Go package names (utils/helpers anti-patterns), or asking about Go naming best practices. Also trigger when the user mentions MixedCaps vs snake_case, ALL_CAPS constants, Get-prefix on getters, or error string casing. Do NOT use for general Go implementation questions that don't involve naming decisions.
description_zh: **Go（Golang）命名规范** —— 涵盖包、构造函数、结构体、接口、常量、枚举、错误、布尔值、接收者、获取器/设置器、函数选项、首字母缩写词、测试函数和子测试名称。当编写新的 Go 代码、审查或重构代码、在命名备选方案之间进行选择（如 New 与 NewTypeName、isConnected 与 connected、ErrNotFound 与 NotFoundError、iota 0 下的 StatusReady 与 StatusUnknown）、讨论 Go 包名（如 utils/helpers 反模式）或询问 Go 命名最佳实践时，请使用此技能。当用户提及 MixedCaps 与 snake_case（蛇形命名）、ALL_CAPS 常量、获取器上的 Get 前缀或错误字符串的大小写时，也会触发此技能。请勿用于不涉及命名决策的一般 Go 实现问题。

description: Comprehensive guide for Go database access — parameterized queries, struct scanning, NULLable columns, transactions, isolation levels, SELECT FOR UPDATE, connection pool, batch processing, context propagation, and migration tooling. Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging Golang code that interacts with PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL, or SQLite; for database testing; or for questions about database/sql, sqlx, or pgx. Does NOT generate database schemas or migration SQL.
description_zh: Go 数据库访问全面指南：涵盖参数化查询、结构体扫描、可空列、事务、隔离级别、SELECT FOR UPDATE、连接池、批量处理、上下文传播以及迁移工具。适用于编写、审查或调试与 PostgreSQL、MariaDB、MySQL 或 SQLite 交互的 Golang 代码；用于数据库测试；或针对 database/sql、sqlx 或 pgx 的相关问题。不生成数据库模式或迁移 SQL。

description: Delivers changes incrementally in thin, verifiable slices. Use when implementing any feature or change that touches more than one file, or when picking up the next task from a plan. Use when rolling a change out behind a feature flag, when you're about to write a large amount of code at once, or when a task feels too big to land in one step.
description_zh:
以薄而可验证的切片，逐步交付变更。

在实现任何涉及多个文件的特性或变更时使用，或在计划中领取下一份任务时使用。在通过功能开关发布变更时使用；当你即将一次性编写大量代码时使用，或当一项任务太大，无法一步落地时使用。

description: Comprehensive documentation guide for Golang projects, covering godoc comments, README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, Go Playground, Example tests, API docs, and llms.txt. Use when writing or reviewing doc comments, documentation, adding code examples, setting up doc sites, or discussing documentation best practices. Triggers for both libraries and applications/CLIs.
description_zh: 适用于 Go 项目（Golang）的全面文档指南，涵盖 godoc 注释、README、CONTRIBUTING、CHANGELOG、Go Playground、示例测试、API 文档以及 llms.txt。当编写或审查文档注释、文档，添加代码示例，搭建文档网站，或讨论文档最佳实践时使用。适用于库和应用/CLI（命令行工具）。

description: Defensive Golang coding against accidental bugs — nil panics, typed-nil interfaces, `append` backing-array aliasing, silent int64-to-int32 truncation, float `==` comparison, `defer` inside loops, defensive copies of slices and maps, and usable zero values. Use when a Go program panics on a nil map write or nil pointer dereference, when reviewing code for nil-safety, numeric conversion overflow, or resource lifecycle, or when designing a type whose zero value must be safe. Not for designing concurrent access with goroutines, channels, or sync primitives (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-concurrency` skill), not for exploitable vulnerabilities such as injection, weak crypto, or leaked secrets (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` skill), and not for debugging an already-failing program (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` skill).
description_zh:
防范意外错误的 Golang 防御性编码——nil 导致的 panic、类型化 nil 接口、`append` 后备数组别名问题、静默的 int64 到 int32 截断、浮点数 `==` 比较、循环内 `defer`、切片和映射的防御性拷贝，以及可用的零值。

在 Go 程序因 nil 映射写入或 nil 指针解引用而 panic 时使用，在进行代码审查排查 nil 安全性、数值转换溢出或资源生命周期问题时使用，或在设计零值必须安全的类型时使用。不适用于设计使用 goroutine、通道或同步原语的并发访问（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-concurrency` 技能），不适用于可利用的漏洞，如注入、弱加密或泄露的密钥（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` 技能），不适用于调试已出错的程序（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-troubleshooting` 技能）。

description: Golang data structures — slices (internals, capacity growth, preallocation, slices package), maps (internals, hash buckets, maps package), arrays, container/list/heap/ring, strings.Builder vs bytes.Buffer, generic collections, pointers (unsafe.Pointer, weak.Pointer), and copy semantics. Use when choosing or optimizing Go data structures, implementing generic containers, using container/ packages, unsafe or weak pointers, or questioning slice/map internals. Not for applying optimization patterns once profiling has identified a bottleneck (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` skill).
description_zh:
Golang数据结构——slices（内部机制、容量增长、预分配、slices包），maps（内部机制、hash桶、maps包），arrays，container/list/heap/ring，strings.Builder vs bytes.Buffer，泛型集合，pointers（unsafe.Pointer、weak.Pointer），copy语义。

用于在选择或优化Go数据结构时、实现泛型容器时、使用container/包时、使用unsafe或weak指针时，或探究slice/map内部机制时使用。

不适用于在性能分析（profiling）已识别瓶颈后应用优化模式（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` 技能）。

description: Modernize Golang code to use recent language features, standard library improvements, and idiomatic patterns. Use when reviewing Go code with old-style patterns, when encountering a deprecation warning, or when the user asks for modernization, a Go version upgrade (e.g. to Go 1.27), or a CI/tooling refresh. Not for structural refactors, extracting functions, or moving code between packages (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-refactoring` skill).
description_zh: 将 Go 代码现代化，以使用最新的语言特性、标准库改进和惯用模式。适用于审查采用旧式模式的 Go 代码、遇到弃用警告、用户要求现代化、进行 Go 版本升级（例如升级至 Go 1.27）或进行 CI/工具链更新等场景。不适用于结构性重构、提取函数或将代码在不同包之间移动（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-refactoring` 技能）。

description: Golang project layout and workspace setup — cmd/internal/pkg directory conventions, module and package naming, go.work workspaces, and essential configuration files. Use when starting a new Go project, organizing an existing codebase, setting up a monorepo with multiple packages, creating CLI tools with multiple main packages, or discussing package restructuring, package splits, or module splits. Not for restructuring existing code without a layout change (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-refactoring` skill).
description_zh: Go 项目布局与工作区设置 —— cmd/internal/pkg 目录约定、模块与包命名、go.work 工作区以及关键配置文件。适用于创建新的 Go 项目、整理现有代码库、为包含多个包的单一代码仓库（monorepo）进行配置、使用多个 main 包创建 CLI 工具，或讨论包的重组、包的拆分或模块拆分。不适用于在不改变布局的情况下重构现有代码（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-refactoring` 技能）。

description: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps on the stable @cloudflare/sandbox package. Use sandbox-next for preview apps and sandbox-migrate-to-next for stable-to-preview migrations.
description_zh: 在稳定的 @cloudflare/sandbox 包中构建或维护 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用。使用 sandbox-next 构建预览应用，并使用 sandbox-migrate-to-next 进行稳定版到预览版的迁移。

description: Linting best practices and golangci-lint configuration for Golang projects — running linters, configuring .golangci.yml, suppressing warnings with nolint directives, interpreting lint output, and selecting linters. Use when configuring golangci-lint, asking about lint warnings or nolint suppressions, setting up code quality tooling, or choosing linters. Also use when the user mentions golangci-lint, go vet, staticcheck, or revive. Not for wiring a lint step into a GitHub Actions pipeline (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-continuous-integration` skill).
description_zh: Golang 项目的 Linting 最佳实践与 golangci-lint 配置—— 运行 linters、配置 .golangci.yml、使用 nolint 指令抑制警告、解析 lint 输出以及选择 linters。在配置 golangci-lint、咨询 lint 警告或 nolint 抑制相关事项、搭建代码质量工具或选择 linters 时使用。当用户提及 golangci-lint、go vet、staticcheck 或 revive 时使用。不适用于将 lint 步骤集成到 GitHub Actions 流水线中（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-continuous-integration` 技能）。

description: Drives development with tests using the red-green-refactor loop. Use when implementing any logic, fixing any bug, or changing any behavior. Use when you need to prove that code works, when a bug report arrives, or when you're about to modify existing functionality.
description_zh: 通过红-绿-重构循环，以测试驱动开发。在任何逻辑实现、缺陷修复或行为变更时使用。在需要证明代码正常工作、收到缺陷报告，或即将修改现有功能时使用。

description: Create, run, and maintain Momentic mobile E2E tests and modules for Android and iOS. Use Momentic MCP tools for live device validation, and use direct v2 YAML edits only for high-confidence local mobile v2 changes.
description_zh: 创建、运行和维护适用于 Android 和 iOS 的 Momentic 移动端 E2E 测试及模块。使用 Momentic MCP 工具进行实时设备验证，仅对高置信度的本地移动端 v2 变更使用直接的 v2 YAML 编辑。

description: 万得金融能力发现与安装路由入口。用于金融数据、行情查询、市场分析、今日大盘、市场主线、板块轮动、资金流向、估值、选股、复盘、仓位、交易计划、回测等任务。必须先读取 catalog 判断必需数据 skill / 工作流 skill；缺失时必须展示安装选项，用户确认后由 AI 直接安装，不得只给命令或用通用分析替代。
description_zh: 万得金融能力发现与安装路由入口。用于金融数据、行情查询、市场分析、今日大盘、市场主线、板块轮动、资金流向、估值、选股、复盘、仓位、交易计划、回测等任务。必须先读取 catalog 判断必需数据 skill / 工作流 skill；缺失时必须展示安装选项，用户确认后由 AI 直接安装，不得只给命令或用通用分析替代。

description: Optimizes agent context setup. Use when starting a new session, when agent output quality degrades, when switching between tasks, or when you need to configure rules files and context for a project.
description_zh:
优化智能体上下文设置。

在开始新会话、智能体输出质量下降、切换任务，或需要为项目配置规则文件和上下文时使用。

description: Troubleshoot Golang programs systematically - find and fix the root cause. Use when encountering bugs, crashes, deadlocks, races, or unexpected behavior in Go code. Covers debugging methodology, common Go pitfalls, test-driven debugging, pprof setup and capture, Delve, race detection, GODEBUG tracing, and production debugging. Start here for any 'something is wrong' situation. Not for interpreting profiles or benchmarking (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` skill), applying optimization patterns (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` skill), or designing new code (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill for defensive coding, `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-concurrency` skill for concurrency design).
description_zh: 系统化排查 Golang 程序 - 找出并修复根本原因。适用于在 Go 代码中遇到 Bug、崩溃、死锁、竞态条件或异常行为时使用。涵盖调试方法论、常见的 Go 陷阱、测试驱动调试、pprof 设置与采集、Delve、竞态检测、GODEBUG 追踪以及生产环境调试。遇到任何“有问题”的情况时，从这里开始。不适用于解释 profile 或进行基准测试（→ 见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` skill），应用优化模式（→ 见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` skill），或设计新代码（→ 见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill 用于防御性编码，`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-concurrency` skill 用于并发设计）。

description: Golang everyday observability — the always-on signals in production. Covers structured logging with slog, Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, continuous profiling with pprof/Pyroscope, server-side RUM event tracking, alerting, and Grafana dashboards. Apply when instrumenting Go services for production monitoring, setting up metrics or alerting, adding OpenTelemetry tracing, correlating logs with traces, migrating legacy loggers (zap/logrus/zerolog) to slog, adding observability to new features, or implementing GDPR/CCPA-compliant tracking with Customer Data Platforms (CDP). Not for temporary deep-dive performance investigation (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark` and `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` skills).
description_zh: Go语言日常可观测性——生产环境的常驻信号。涵盖使用slog的结构化日志、Prometheus指标、OpenTelemetry分布式追踪、使用pprof/Pyroscope的持续性能分析、服务端RUM事件追踪、告警及Grafana仪表板等内容。适用于以下场景：对Go服务进行埋点以进行生产环境监控、设置指标或告警、添加OpenTelemetry追踪、将日志与追踪关联、将旧版日志器(zap/logrus/zerolog)迁移至slog、为新功能添加可观测性，或在客户数据平台(CDP)上实现符合GDPR/CCPA要求的数据追踪。不适用于临时性的深度性能排查（→ 详见``samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-benchmark``和``samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance``技能）。

description: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.
description_zh: **以品牌为先的落地页设计师** — 进行品牌身份沟通（色彩、排版、形态语言），然后通过 Stitch 生成并迭代打磨落地页，输出可直接部署的 HTML。当用户请求创建、设计或搭建落地页、首页或营销页，且没有既定视觉方向时使用。当用户已有设计稿、需要仪表盘或应用界面、处于组件级别工作、构建多页面应用，或基于已知设计令牌进行重新设计时，应跳过此技能，改用 front-end-design。

description: Dependency management for Golang projects — go.mod and go.sum, `go get` install and upgrade flows, Minimal Version Selection, conflict resolution with replace/exclude/retract, `govulncheck` scanning of the module tree, outdated dependency and binary size auditing, vendoring, `tool` directives, and go.work workspaces. Use when adding, removing, or upgrading Go dependencies, deciding whether to take on a package, resolving version conflicts, or auditing what a module pulls in. Covers choosing and upgrading dependency versions, not the surrounding tooling: do NOT use for fixing an exploitable vulnerability in code (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` skill) or for wiring Dependabot/Renovate update bots into CI workflows (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-continuous-integration` skill).
description_zh: Go项目依赖管理 — go.mod 和 go.sum、`go get` 安装与升级流程、最小版本选择、通过 replace/exclude/retract 冲突解决、`govulncheck` 对模块树的扫描、过期依赖与二进制体积审计、引入 vendoring、`tool` 指令，以及 go.work 工作区。在添加、移除或升级 Go 依赖时，决定是否需要纳入某个包、解决版本冲突，或审计某个模块会引入哪些依赖时使用。本内容涵盖依赖版本的选型和升级，而非周边工具：请勿用于修复代码中的可利用漏洞（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` 技能）或用于将 Dependabot/Renovate 更新机器人集成到 CI 工作流中（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-continuous-integration` 技能）。

description: Build or maintain Cloudflare Sandbox apps on @cloudflare/sandbox@next (SDK 1.0 preview). Use sandbox-migrate-to-next when porting a stable app.
description_zh: 在 @cloudflare/sandbox@next（SDK 1.0 预览版）上构建或维护 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用。迁移稳定应用时，请使用 sandbox-migrate-to-next。

description: Golang struct and interface design patterns — composition, embedding, type assertions, type switches, interface segregation, dependency injection via interfaces, struct field tags, and pointer vs value receivers. Use this skill when designing Go types, defining or implementing interfaces, embedding structs or interfaces, writing type assertions or type switches, adding struct field tags for JSON/YAML/DB serialization, or choosing between pointer and value receivers. Also use when the user asks about "accept interfaces, return structs", compile-time interface checks, or composing small interfaces into larger ones.
description_zh: Go 语言结构体与接口设计模式——组合、嵌入、类型断言、类型切换、接口隔离、通过接口进行依赖注入、结构体字段标签，以及指针接收者与值接收者。当设计 Go 类型、定义或实现接口、嵌入结构体或接口、编写类型断言或类型切换、为 JSON/YAML/数据库序列化添加结构体字段标签，或选择指针接收者与值接收者时，使用本技能。当用户询问“接收接口，返回结构体”、编译期接口检查，或将小接口组合成更大接口时，也应使用本技能。

description: Migrate Cloudflare Sandbox apps from stable @cloudflare/sandbox to @cloudflare/sandbox@next (SDK 1.0 preview). Use sandbox-next for apps already on the preview.
description_zh: 迁移 Cloudflare Sandbox 应用，从稳定的 @cloudflare/sandbox 迁移至 @cloudflare/sandbox@next（SDK 1.0 预览版）。已使用预览版本的应用，请使用 sandbox-next。

description: Golang library and framework selection — vetted production-ready options by category (web, database, testing, logging, messaging), new and experimental stdlib packages, standard-library-first tradeoffs, and maturity signals (maintenance, license, importer counts). Apply when the user asks for library suggestions, wants to compare alternatives, needs to choose a library for a specific task, or when a new dependency is being added to the project. Not for a specific library's API once chosen (→ See that library's dedicated skill, e.g. `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-lo`), nor for go.mod mechanics, upgrades, or vulnerability audits (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` skill).
description_zh: Golang库与框架选择——按类别（Web、数据库、测试、日志、消息）提供经过验证的生产就绪方案，涵盖新与实验性的标准库包、优先采用标准库的取舍，以及成熟度信号（维护、许可证、导入者数量）。在用户询问库的推荐、希望对比替代方案、需要为特定任务选择库，或将新依赖添加到项目中时，本指南适用。不适用于选定特定库后的API细节（→ 参见该库的专属技能，例如 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-lo`），也不适用于go.mod机制、升级或漏洞审计（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` 技能）。

description: Comprehensive guide for dependency injection (DI) in Golang. Covers why DI matters (testability, loose coupling, separation of concerns, lifecycle management), manual constructor injection, and DI library comparison (google/wire, uber-go/dig, uber-go/fx, samber/do). Use this skill when designing service architecture, setting up dependency injection, refactoring tightly coupled code, managing singletons or service factories, or when the user asks about inversion of control, service containers, or wiring dependencies in Go. For a specific DI library, → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-google-wire`, `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig`, `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-fx`, or `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-do` skills.
description_zh: Golang 依赖注入 (DI) 全面指南。涵盖 DI 的重要性（可测试性、松耦合、关注点分离与生命周期管理）、手动构造函数注入，以及 DI 库对比（google/wire、uber-go/dig、uber-go/fx、samber/do）。当设计服务架构、设置依赖注入、重构紧密耦合的代码、管理单例或服务工厂，或使用本技能响应用户关于控制反转、服务容器，或如何在 Go 中连接依赖的询问时，请使用本技能。针对特定的 DI 库，→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-google-wire`、`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig`、`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-fx` 或 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-do` 技能。

description: Golang benchmarking, profiling, and performance measurement. Use when writing, running, or comparing Go benchmarks, profiling hot paths with pprof, interpreting CPU/memory/trace profiles, analyzing results with benchstat, setting up CI benchmark regression detection, or investigating production performance with Prometheus runtime metrics. Also use when the developer needs deep analysis on a specific performance indicator - this skill provides the measurement methodology, while `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` provides the optimization patterns.
description_zh: Go 基准测试、性能分析与性能测量。在编写、运行或对比 Go 基准测试时使用；使用 pprof 对热路径进行性能分析，解读 CPU/内存/调用栈性能分析数据，使用 benchstat 分析测试结果，配置 CI 基准测试回归检测，或使用 Prometheus 运行时指标调查生产环境性能。当开发者需要对特定性能指标进行深度分析时，也应使用本技能——本技能提供测量方法，而 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-performance` 提供优化模式。

description: Golang CLI application development. Use when building, modifying, or reviewing a Go CLI tool — especially for command structure, flag handling, configuration layering, version embedding, exit codes, I/O patterns, signal handling, shell completion, argument validation, and CLI unit testing. Also triggers when code uses cobra, viper, or urfave/cli. For cobra-specific APIs → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-cobra` skill; for viper configuration layering → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-viper` skill.
description_zh: Golang CLI 应用开发。用于构建、修改或审查 Go CLI 工具时——尤其适用于命令结构、标志处理、配置分层、版本嵌入、退出码、I/O 模式、信号处理、shell 补全、参数验证及 CLI 单元测试。当代码使用 cobra、viper 或 urfave/cli 时也会触发。针对 cobra 特有的 API → 请参阅 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-cobra` 技能；针对 viper 配置分层 → 请参阅 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-viper` 技能。

description: Guides stable API and interface design. Use when designing APIs, module boundaries, or any public interface. Use when creating REST or GraphQL endpoints, defining type contracts between modules, or establishing boundaries between frontend and backend.
description_zh: 引导API与接口设计保持稳定。在设计API、模块边界或任何公共接口时使用。在创建REST或GraphQL端点、定义模块间类型契约，或建立前后端边界时使用。

description: Comprehensive guide to stretchr/testify for Golang testing. Covers assert, require, mock, and suite packages in depth. Use when writing tests with testify, creating mocks, setting up test suites, or choosing between assert and require. Covers testify assertions, mock expectations, argument matchers, call verification, suite lifecycle, and advanced patterns like Eventually, JSONEq, and custom matchers. Apply when the codebase imports github.com/stretchr/testify.
description_zh: Go语言测试 stretchr/testify 综合指南。深入涵盖 assert、require、mock 和 suite 包，适用于使用 testify 编写测试、创建 mock、配置测试套件，或选择使用 assert 与 require。覆盖 testify 断言、mock 期望、参数匹配器、调用验证、suite 生命周期，以及 Eventually、JSONEq 和自定义匹配器等高级模式。当代码库引入 github.com/stretchr/testify 时适用。

description: Skill for converting an installed Firebase Extension (or extension source) into a standalone Cloud Functions for Firebase codebase or publishable npm package, including V1 to V2 trigger upgrades, lifecycle hooks, and declarative security

description: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline configuration for Golang projects — workflow files for test, lint, SAST, coverage and vulnerability-scan jobs, Dependabot and Renovate config files, GoReleaser release pipelines, Docker build/push, repository security settings, and AI-driven PR review. Use when setting up or improving Go project CI, writing or fixing `.github/workflows/*.yml`, adding a linter or security scanner as a pipeline job, wiring automated dependency-update bots, or adding quality gates. Covers wiring tools into a pipeline, not the analysis they perform: do NOT use for choosing or interpreting security findings (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` skill) or for choosing, upgrading, or auditing dependency versions (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` skill).
description_zh:
Go 项目的 GitHub Actions CI/CD 流水线配置指南

涵盖测试、代码检查（lint）、静态应用安全测试（SAST）、代码覆盖率与漏洞扫描等任务的工作流文件，Dependabot 与 Renovate 的配置文件，GoReleaser 发布流水线，Docker 构建/推送，仓库安全设置，以及 AI 驱动的 PR 审查。

适用于搭建或优化 Go 项目的持续集成（CI），编写或修改 `.github/workflows/*.yml` 文件，为流水线任务添加代码检查工具或安全扫描器，配置自动化依赖更新机器人，或添加质量门槛。

本内容涵盖将工具集成到流水线中，而非它们所执行的分析工作：切勿用于选择或解读安全分析结果（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` 技能），也切勿用于选择、升级或审核依赖版本（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-dependency-management` 技能）。

description: Provides gRPC usage guidelines, protobuf organization, and production-ready patterns for Golang microservices. Use when implementing, reviewing, or debugging gRPC servers/clients, writing proto files, setting up interceptors, handling gRPC errors with status codes, configuring TLS/mTLS, testing with bufconn, or working with streaming RPCs.
description_zh: 提供适用于 Golang 微服务的 gRPC 使用指南、protobuf 组织方式及生产就绪模式。适用于在实现、评审或调试 gRPC 服务/客户端，编写 proto 文件，配置拦截器，处理 gRPC 错误及状态码，配置 TLS/mTLS，使用 bufconn 进行测试，或处理流 RPC 等场景时使用。

description: Guidelines for creating API routes in Expo Router with EAS Hosting

description_zh: 支持网页搜索、垂直领域搜索、并行批量搜索以及URL内容提取的实时搜索引擎。

description: Golang ecosystem watch list — official sources (go.dev/blog, pkg.go.dev, tour.golang.org, golang-nuts), newsletters (Golang Weekly, Awesome Go Newsletter), communities (r/golang, gophers.slack.com, Go Forum, go.dev/wiki), blogs (Dave Cheney, Ardan Labs, Rob Pike), YouTube channels (Gopher Academy, GopherCon EU/UK), conferences, and Go contributors to follow on GitHub, X and Bluesky. Use when seeking Golang learning resources, discovering new libraries or tools, finding community channels or meetups, picking Go people to follow, or keeping up with Go language changes and releases. Not for querying a specific module's versions, docs, or vulnerabilities from the CLI (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-pkg-go-dev` skill).
description_zh: Go生态关注列表——官方来源（go.dev/blog、pkg.go.dev、tour.golang.org、golang-nuts），新闻通讯（Golang Weekly、Awesome Go Newsletter），社区（r/golang、gophers.slack.com、Go Forum、go.dev/wiki），博客（Dave Cheney、Ardan Labs、Rob Pike），YouTube频道（Gopher Academy、GopherCon EU/UK），会议，以及GitHub、X和Bluesky平台上的Go贡献者。适用于：查找Go学习资源、发掘新库或工具、寻找社区渠道或线下活动、筛选值得关注的Go相关人士，以及跟进Go语言的变化与版本更新。不适用于通过命令行工具查询特定模块的版本、文档或漏洞（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-pkg-go-dev` 技能）。

description: Generates Angular code and provides architectural guidance. description_zh: 生成Angular代码并提供架构指导。在创建项目、组件、服务或HTTP通信时触发，或在响应式（信号、linkedSignal、resource、httpResource）、表单、依赖注入、路由、服务端渲染（SSR）、可访问性（ARIA）、动画、样式（组件样式、Tailwind CSS）、测试、命名规范或CLI工具方面的最佳实践中触发。

description: Functional programming helpers for Golang using samber/lo — 500+ type-safe generic functions for slices, maps, channels, strings, math, tuples, and concurrency (Map, Filter, Reduce, GroupBy, Chunk, Flatten, Find, Uniq, etc.). Core immutable package (lo), concurrent variants (lo/parallel aka lop), in-place mutations (lo/mutable aka lom), lazy iterators (lo/it aka loi for Go 1.23+), and experimental SIMD (lo/exp/simd). Apply when using or adopting samber/lo, when the codebase imports github.com/samber/lo, or when implementing functional-style data transformations in Go. Not for streaming pipelines (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-ro` skill).
description_zh: 使用 samber/lo 的 Golang 函数式编程辅助工具 —— 500 多个用于切片、映射、通道、字符串、数学运算、元组及并发处理的类型安全泛型函数（包括 Map、Filter、Reduce、GroupBy、Chunk、Flatten、Find、Uniq 等）。核心不可变包（lo）、并发变体（lo/parallel，别名 lop）、就地可变修改（lo/mutable，别名 lom）、适用于 Go 1.23+ 版本的惰性迭代器（lo/it，别名 loi）以及实验性 SIMD（lo/exp/simd）。适用于使用或采用 samber/lo、代码库引入 github.com/samber/lo，或在 Go 中实现函数式风格数据转换的场景。不适用于流式流水线（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-ro` 技能）。

description: Dependency injection in Golang using samber/do — service containers, lifecycle management, scopes, health checks, graceful shutdown, and module organization. Apply when using or adopting samber/do, when the codebase imports github.com/samber/do or github.com/samber/do/v2, or when refactoring manual constructor injection into a DI container.
description_zh: 在Go语言中使用samber/do进行依赖注入——涵盖服务容器、生命周期管理、作用域、健康检查、优雅关闭以及模块组织。适用于以下场景：使用或采用samber/do、代码库导入github.com/samber/do或github.com/samber/do/v2、或将手动构造函数注入重构为依赖注入容器时。

description: Structured logging extensions for Golang using samber/slog-**** packages — multi-handler pipelines (slog-multi), log sampling (slog-sampling), attribute formatting (slog-formatter), HTTP middleware (slog-fiber, slog-gin, slog-chi, slog-echo), and backend routing (slog-datadog, slog-sentry, slog-loki, slog-syslog, slog-logstash, slog-graylog...). Apply when using or adopting slog, or when the codebase already imports any github.com/samber/slog-* package.
description_zh: 基于 samber/slog-**** 包为 Go 语言提供结构化日志扩展——多处理器流水线（slog-multi）、日志采样（slog-sampling）、属性格式化（slog-formatter）、HTTP 中间件（slog-fiber、slog-gin、slog-chi、slog-echo）以及后端路由（slog-datadog、slog-sentry、slog-loki、slog-syslog、slog-logstash、slog-graylog...）。当使用或采用 slog，或代码库已导入任何 github.com/samber/slog-* 包时适用。

description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.

description: Structured error handling in Golang with samber/oops — error builders, stack traces, error codes, error context, error wrapping, error attributes, user-facing vs developer messages, panic recovery, and logger integration. Apply when using or adopting samber/oops, or when the codebase already imports github.com/samber/oops.
description_zh: Go 语言中使用 samber/oops 的结构化错误处理——错误构建器、堆栈跟踪、错误码、错误上下文、错误包装、错误属性、面向用户与开发者的消息、panic 恢复以及日志记录器集成。适用于使用或采用 samber/oops，或代码库已导入 github.com/samber/oops 的情况。

description: Monadic types for Golang using samber/mo — Option, Result, Either, Future, IO, Task, and State types for type-safe nullable values, error handling, and functional composition with pipeline sub-packages. Apply when using or adopting samber/mo, when the codebase imports `github.com/samber/mo`, or when considering functional programming patterns as a safety design for Golang. Not for nil-safety and zero-value design without this library (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` skill), nor for native error wrapping with fmt.Errorf, errors.Is and errors.As (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-error-handling` skill).
description_zh: 使用 samber/mo 的 Golang 单子类型——Option、Result、Either、Future、IO、Task 和 State 类型，用于类型安全的可空值、错误处理，以及与流水线子包配合的功能组合。适用于以下情况：使用或采用 samber/mo，代码库导入 `github.com/samber/mo`，或考虑将函数式编程模式作为 Golang 的安全设计方案。不适用于在没有本库的情况下进行 nil 安全性和零值设计（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-safety` 技能），也不适用于使用 `fmt.Errorf`、`errors.Is` 和 `errors.As` 进行原生错误包装（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-error-handling` 技能）。

description: In-memory caching in Golang using samber/hot — eviction algorithms (LRU, LFU, TinyLFU, W-TinyLFU, S3FIFO, ARC, TwoQueue, SIEVE, FIFO), TTL, cache loaders, sharding, stale-while-revalidate, missing key caching, and Prometheus metrics. Apply when using or adopting samber/hot, when the codebase imports github.com/samber/hot, or when the project repeatedly loads the same medium-to-low cardinality resources at high frequency and needs to reduce latency or backend pressure.
description_zh:
基于 samber/hot 的 Golang 内存缓存——淘汰算法（LRU、LFU、TinyLFU、W-TinyLFU、S3FIFO、ARC、TwoQueue、SIEVE、FIFO）、TTL、缓存加载器、分片、stale-while-revalidate、缺失键缓存和 Prometheus 指标。

适用于使用或采用 samber/hot、代码库导入 github.com/samber/hot，或者项目频繁以高频率加载相同的中等至低基数资源并需要降低延迟或后端压力的场景。

description: Reactive streams and event-driven programming in Golang using samber/ro — ReactiveX implementation with 150+ type-safe operators, cold/hot observables, 5 subject types (Publish, Behavior, Replay, Async, Unicast), declarative pipelines via Pipe, 40+ plugins (HTTP, cron, fsnotify, JSON, logging), automatic backpressure, error propagation, and Go context integration. Apply when using or adopting samber/ro, when the codebase imports github.com/samber/ro, or when building asynchronous event-driven pipelines, real-time data processing, streams, or reactive architectures in Go. Not for finite slice transforms (→ See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-lo` skill).

使用 samber/ro 在 Go 语言中实现响应式流与事件驱动编程——基于 ReactiveX 的响应式实现，具备 150+ 类型安全操作符、冷/热观察者、5 种主题类型（Publish、Behavior、Reactive、Async、Unicast）、通过 Pipe 的声明式流水线、40+ 插件（HTTP、cron、fsnotify、JSON、日志）、自动背压、错误传播及 Go 上下文集成。

当使用或采用 samber/ro、代码库引入 github.com/samber/ro，或在 Go 中构建异步事件驱动流水线、实时数据处理、流或响应式架构时，应用此方案。

不适用于有限切片转换（→ 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-samber-lo` 技能）。

Also apply when the codebase imports `github.com/99designs/gqlgen` or `github.com/graph-gophers/graphql-go`.
description_zh: 使用 gqlgen 或 graphql-go 在 Go 语言中实现 GraphQL API。适用于构建 GraphQL 服务器、设计 schema、编写 resolver、处理订阅，或将 GraphQL 与现有 Go HTTP 服务集成。此外，当代码库导入 `github.com/99designs/gqlgen` 或 `github.com/graph-gophers/graphql-go` 时，也适用。

description: Golang CLI command tree library using spf13/cobra — cobra.Command, RunE vs Run, PersistentPreRunE hook chain, Args validators (NoArgs, ExactArgs, MatchAll, custom), persistent vs local flags, command groups, ValidArgsFunction, RegisterFlagCompletionFunc, ShellCompDirective, usage/help template customization, man-page and markdown doc generation, and testing with SetArgs/SetOut/SetErr. Apply when using or adopting spf13/cobra, or when the codebase imports `github.com/spf13/cobra`. For configuration layering alongside cobra, see the `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-viper` skill. For general CLI architecture (project layout, exit codes, signal handling, I/O patterns), see `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-cli`.
description_zh: 使用spf13/cobra的Golang CLI命令树库——涵盖cobra.Command、RunE与Run的区别、PersistentPreRunE钩子链、参数校验器（NoArgs、ExactArgs、MatchAll、自定义校验）、持久化标志与本地标志的对比、命令组、ValidArgsFunction、RegisterFlagCompletionFunc、ShellCompDirective、用法/帮助模板定制、man页与markdown文档生成，以及使用SetArgs/SetOut/SetErr进行测试。当使用或采用spf13/cobra，或代码库导入`github.com/spf13/cobra`时适用。关于与cobra搭配的配置分层，请参见`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-viper`技能。关于一般CLI架构（项目布局、退出码、信号处理、I/O模式），请参见`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-cli`技能。

description: Compile-time dependency injection in Golang using google/wire — wire.NewSet, wire.Build, wire.Bind (interface→concrete), wire.Struct, wire.Value, wire.InterfaceValue, wire.FieldsOf, cleanup functions, //go:build wireinject injector files, and generated wire_gen.go. Apply when using or adopting google/wire, when the codebase imports `github.com/google/wire`, or when wiring an application graph at compile time via `wire.Build`. For runtime DI with reflection, see `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig` skill.
description_zh:
使用 google/wire 在 Go 语言中实现编译期依赖注入，涉及 wire.NewSet、wire.Build、wire.Bind（接口→具体实现）、wire.Struct、wire.Value、wire.InterfaceValue、wire.FieldsOf、清理函数、//go:build wireinject 注入器文件以及生成的 wire_gen.go。

在以下场景中可使用或采用本方案：代码库导入了 `github.com/google/wire`、使用或采用 google/wire、或通过 `wire.Build` 在编译期对应用图进行接线。

关于基于反射的运行时依赖注入，请参考 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig` 技能。

description: Golang configuration library using spf13/viper — layered precedence (flag > env > file > KV > default), BindPFlag/BindPFlags, SetEnvPrefix + SetEnvKeyReplacer + AutomaticEnv, ReadInConfig + ConfigFileNotFoundError, Unmarshal + mapstructure struct tags, Sub for sub-trees, WatchConfig + OnConfigChange for hot reload, viper.New() for test isolation, and remote KV integration. Apply when using or adopting spf13/viper, or when the codebase imports `github.com/spf13/viper`. For CLI command structure alongside viper, see the `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-cobra` skill. For general CLI architecture, see `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-cli`.
description_zh:
基于 spf13/viper 的 Go 配置库，具备分层优先级（flag > 环境变量 > 文件 > KV > 默认值）、BindPFlag/BindPFlags、SetEnvPrefix + SetEnvKeyReplacer + AutomaticEnv、ReadInConfig + ConfigFileNotFoundError、Unmarshal + mapstructure 结构体标签、Sub 用于子树、WatchConfig + OnConfigChange 实现热重载、viper.New() 用于测试隔离以及远程 KV 集成等功能。

在使用或采用 spf13/viper，或代码库中导入 `github.com/spf13/viper` 时，适用本指南。

关于与 viper 配套的 CLI 命令结构，请参考 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-spf13-cobra` 技能。关于通用 CLI 架构，请参考 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-cli`。

description: Configure rate limiting, manage auth secrets, set up CSRF protection, define trusted origins, secure sessions and cookies, encrypt OAuth tokens, track IP addresses, and implement audit logging for Better Auth. Use when users need to secure their auth setup, prevent brute force attacks, or harden a Better Auth deployment.
description_zh: 为 Better Auth 配置限流、管理认证密钥、设置 CSRF 防护、定义可信来源、保护会话和 Cookie、加密 OAuth 令牌、跟踪 IP 地址，并实现审计日志。当用户需要保护其认证设置、防止暴力攻击或加固 Better Auth 部署时，请使用。

description: Grounds every implementation decision in official documentation. Use when you want to verify an approach against the official docs before implementing it, or when you want authoritative, source-cited code free from outdated patterns. Use when building with any framework or library where correctness matters.
description_zh: 将每一项实现决策建立在官方文档之上。当您想在实施前对照官方文档验证方案，或需要权威、有来源引用且无过时模式的代码时使用。当使用任何框架或库进行构建，且正确性至关重要时使用。

description: Golang application framework using uber-go/fx — fx.New, fx.Provide, fx.Invoke, fx.Module, fx.Lifecycle hooks, fx.Annotate (name/group/As), fx.Decorate, fx.Supply, fx.Replace, fx.WithLogger, and signal-aware Run(). Apply when using or adopting uber-go/fx, when the codebase imports `go.uber.org/fx`, or when wiring services with fx.New. For raw DI without lifecycle, see `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig` skill.
description_zh: 使用 uber-go/fx 的 Go 应用框架 —— fx.New、fx.Provide、fx.Invoke、fx.Module、fx.Lifecycle 钩子、fx.Annotate（名称/组/As）、fx.Decorate、fx.Supply、fx.Replace、fx.WithLogger 以及信号感知的 Run()。当使用或采用 uber-go/fx、当代码库引入 `go.uber.org/fx`，或在通过 fx.New 组装服务时，适用本指南。对于无需生命周期处理的原始依赖注入，请参阅 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig` 技能。

description: Use `LayoutBuilder`, `MediaQuery`, or `Expanded/Flexible` to create a layout that adapts to different screen sizes. Use when you need the UI to look good on both mobile and tablet/desktop form factors.
description_zh: 使用 `LayoutBuilder`、`MediaQuery` 或 `Expanded/Flexible` 创建能够适配不同屏幕尺寸的布局。在需要 UI 在移动端和平板/桌面端均呈现良好效果时使用。

description: Prepares production launches. Use when preparing to deploy to production, or when asking what needs to be in place before shipping. Use when you need a pre-launch checklist, when setting up monitoring, when planning a staged rollout, or when you need a rollback strategy.
description_zh: 准备生产发布。在准备部署到生产环境时使用，或在询问发布前需要准备到位的内容时使用。当需要发布前检查清单、配置监控、规划分阶段上线，或需要回滚策略时使用。

description: Implements dependency injection in Golang using uber-go/dig — reflection-based container, Provide/Invoke, dig.In/dig.Out parameter and result objects, named values, value groups, optional dependencies, scopes, and Decorate. Apply when using or adopting uber-go/dig, when the codebase imports `go.uber.org/dig`, or when wiring an application graph at startup. For higher-level lifecycle and modules, see `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-fx` skill.
description_zh:
使用 uber-go/dig 在 Golang 中实现依赖注入——基于反射的容器、Provide/Invoke、dig.In/dig.Out 参数与结果对象、命名值、值组、可选依赖、作用域及 Decorate。

在使用或采用 uber-go/dig、代码库导入 `go.uber.org/dig`，或在启动时搭建应用程序图时适用。

对于更高层次的生命周期与模块，参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-fx` 技能。

description: Guide for background coding agents running inside Replicas cloud workspaces
description_zh: Replicas 云工作区中运行的后台编码智能体指南

description: skill does absolutely nothing, as well as the agent that uses it.
description_zh: 该技能完全毫无作用，使用它的智能体也一样。

description: Manages deprecation and migration. Use when removing old systems, APIs, or features. Use when migrating users from one implementation to another. Use when migrating a database schema in production, such as renaming or dropping a column without downtime (expand/contract). Use when deciding whether to maintain or sunset existing code.
description_zh: 管理弃用与迁移。适用于移除旧系统、API或功能。适用于将用户从一个实现迁移到另一个实现。适用于在生产环境中迁移数据库模式，例如在不中断服务的情况下重命名或删除列（扩展/收缩）。适用于决定是维护还是下线现有代码。

description: Golang skills orchestrator — always active on any Golang coding, review, debug, or setup task. Reads the task context and loads the most relevant skills from samber/cc-skills-golang, often multiple at once: writing a gRPC service loads golang-grpc + golang-testing + golang-error-handling; debugging a panic loads golang-troubleshooting + golang-safety; auditing security loads golang-security + golang-lint + golang-safety. Also: disambiguates competing clusters when two skills seem to overlap (performance vs benchmark vs troubleshooting, samber/lo vs mo vs ro, DI cluster, safety vs security), and configures the project's agent-config file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor rules, or Copilot instructions) to force-trigger skills in a project (/golang-how-to configure).
description_zh: Golang 技能编排器——在任何 Golang 编码、审查、调试或搭建任务中始终活跃。读取任务上下文，并从 samber/cc-skills-golang 加载最相关的技能，通常一次加载多个：编写 gRPC 服务时将加载 golang-grpc + golang-testing + golang-error-handling；调试 panic 时将加载 golang-troubleshooting + golang-safety；安全审计时将加载 golang-security + golang-lint + golang-safety。此外：当两个技能看似重叠时，能够区分竞争性的技能集群（性能与基准测试与故障排查，samber/lo 与 mo 与 ro，DI 集群，安全与安全性），并且配置项目的智能体配置文件（CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、GEMINI.md、Cursor 规则或 Copilot 指令）以在项目中强制触发技能（/golang-how-to configure）。

description: Official skill for integrating Firebase AI Logic (Gemini API) into web applications. Covers setup, multimodal inference, structured output, and security.
description_zh: 用于将 Firebase AI Logic（Gemini API）集成到 Web 应用中的官方技能。涵盖配置、多模态推理、结构化输出和安全。

description:
Produce an intensive, cited analytical report: executive summary, multi-angle
findings, contrarian views, open questions, and full sources. Use only when the
user needs rigorous synthesis of a complex topic (scientific, technical, policy,
or market-analytical) that cannot be answered with a short search, and wants
a formal written report, not a recommendation list.

Do not use for product picks, top-N lists, quick lookups, or routine "find out
about X" tasks. If the request does not clearly need this kind of report, do
not use this skill.

Do not use for a literature review over published papers. This skill collects
evidence from the open web. A request for the literature on a biomedical,
clinical, life-science, or other scientific topic — papers, studies, trials,
preprints — belongs to firecrawl-research-papers, which queries Firecrawl's
paper index (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv) instead of searching websites.
description_zh: 生成一份详尽、有引用的分析报告：执行摘要、多角度发现、反方观点、开放问题，以及完整来源。仅当用户需要针对复杂主题（科学、技术、政策或市场分析类）进行严谨综合，且该问题无法通过简短搜索回答，并希望获得正式书面报告而非推荐列表时，方可使用。不用于产品推荐、热门排名列表、快速查询，或常规“了解X”类任务。如果请求并不明确需要此类报告，请勿使用此技能。不用于针对已发表论文的文献综述。本技能从开放网络收集证据。对于关于生物医学、临床、生命科学或其他科学主题的文献（论文、研究、试验、预印本）的请求，应属于 firecrawl-research-papers，该技能通过查询 Firecrawl 的论文索引（PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv、arXiv）而非搜索网站。

description: Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yourself silently filling in ambiguous requirements before any plan, spec, or code exists.
description_zh: 提取用户实际想要的内容，而非其认为应当想要的内容。通过逐个提问的访谈，直至对底层意图的置信度达到约95%。适用场景包括：需求不够明确（如“为我构建X”，却未说明“为谁”或“为何此时”）；用户明确要求介入（如“请对我进行访谈”、“严苛追问我”、“我们确定吗？”、“对我的思路进行压力测试”）；或在任何方案、规格或代码确立之前，你发现自己正静默地补充模糊需求。

description: Vue 3 Composition API, script setup macros, reactivity system, and built-in components. Use when writing Vue SFCs, defineProps/defineEmits/defineModel, watchers, or using Transition/Teleport/Suspense/KeepAlive.
description_zh: Vue 3 组合式 API、script setup 宏、响应式系统与内置组件。用于编写 Vue SFC（单文件组件）、使用 defineProps/defineEmits/defineModel、设置 watch 侦听器，或使用 Transition/Teleport/Suspense/KeepAlive。

description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (贴图, formerly 图文) with multiple images. Markdown article workflows default to converting ordinary external links into bottom citations for WeChat-friendly output. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "贴图/图文/文章".
description_zh: 通过 API 或 Chrome CDP 将内容发布到微信公众号（WeChat Official Account）。支持以 HTML、Markdown 或纯文本输入发布文章（文章），并支持多图发布贴图（原称图文）。Markdown 文章工作流默认将普通外链转换为底部引用，以适配微信友好的输出格式。当用户提及“发布公众号”、“post to wechat”、“微信公众号”或“贴图/图文/文章”时使用。

description: Fixes Flutter layout errors (overflows, unbounded constraints) using Dart and Flutter MCP tools. Use when addressing "RenderFlex overflowed", "Vertical viewport was given unbounded height", or similar layout issues.
description_zh: 使用 Dart 和 Flutter MCP 工具修复 Flutter 布局错误（溢出、无界约束）。当处理“RenderFlex overflowed”、“Vertical viewport was given unbounded height”或类似布局问题时使用。

description: Use after a failure, user correction, repeated workflow problem, or validated success reveals a reusable lesson. Captures bounded redacted candidates, runs executable behavior evals, and separates validation from application in durable guidance.
description_zh: 于失败、用户修正、重复的工作流问题或验证成功之后使用，可揭示出可复用的经验。捕获受限制的脱敏候选对象，执行可执行的行为评估，并在持久化的指引中将验证与应用相分离。

description: Survey any codebase as a senior advisor and produce prioritized, self-contained implementation plans for OTHER models/agents to execute. Strictly read-only on source code — never implements, fixes, or refactors anything itself. Use when asked to audit a codebase, find improvement opportunities (bugs, security, performance, test coverage, tech debt, migrations, DX), suggest features or where to take the project next (roadmap, product direction), or generate handoff plans for another agent to implement.
description_zh: 以资深顾问身份对任意代码库进行调研，并产出供其他模型/智能体执行的优先级排序、自包含实施计划。严格以只读方式操作源代码——绝不自行实施、修复或重构任何内容。当被要求审计代码库、找出改进机会（缺陷、安全、性能、测试覆盖率、技术债务、迁移、DX）、提出功能建议或项目下一步方向（路线图、产品方向），或生成交接计划交由其他智能体实施时，即可使用。

description: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when you want every assumption cross-examined before proceeding, when stress-testing a plan for hidden failure modes, when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production auth, security-sensitive logic, a high-stakes migration, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.
description_zh: 在决策最终生效前，将每一个非平凡的决策提交至全新上下文下的对抗性审查。适用于以下场景：在推进前希望每个假设都经过交叉检验；对计划进行压力测试以排查潜在故障模式；当正确性比速度更为重要时；在处理不熟悉的代码时；涉及高风险（如生产环境认证、安全敏感逻辑、高风险迁移、不可逆操作）；或任何确信的输出现在验证比事后调试更为经济的情况。

description: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Python. Use when the user asks about Genkit, AI agents, flows, or tools in Python, or when encountering Genkit errors, import issues, or API problems.
description_zh: 使用 Genkit 在 Python 中开发 AI 驱动的应用。当用户询问 Genkit、AI 智能体、流程或 Python 工具，或遇到 Genkit 错误、导入问题或 API 问题时使用。

description: Build sandboxed applications for secure code execution. Load when building AI code execution, code interpreters, CI/CD systems, interactive dev environments, or executing untrusted code. Covers Sandbox SDK lifecycle, commands, files, code interpreter, and preview URLs. Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.
description_zh: 构建沙箱应用，用于安全代码执行。在构建AI代码执行、代码解释器、CI/CD系统、交互式开发环境，或执行不可信代码时进行加载。涵盖沙箱SDK生命周期、命令、文件、代码解释器及预览URL。偏向于从Cloudflare文档中检索，而非预训练知识。

description: Profile and optimize Python code using cProfile, memory profilers, and performance best practices. Use when debugging slow Python code, optimizing bottlenecks, or improving application performance.
description_zh: 使用 cProfile、内存分析工具及性能最佳实践，对 Python 代码进行剖析与优化。适用于调试缓慢的 Python 代码、优化瓶颈或提升应用性能的场景。

description: Implement a component-level test using `WidgetTester` to verify UI rendering and user interactions (tapping, scrolling, entering text). Use when validating that a specific widget displays correct data and responds to events as expected.
description_zh: 使用 `WidgetTester` 实现组件级测试，以验证 UI 渲染和用户交互（点击、滚动、输入文本）。当需要验证特定组件是否正确展示数据并针对预期事件作出响应时使用。

description: When the user wants to set up a recurring, self-running marketing workflow — a repeatable loop an AI agent runs on a cadence (weekly, daily, on a trigger) rather than a one-off task. Also use when the user mentions 'marketing loop,' 'recurring marketing workflow,' 'automate my marketing,' 'marketing on autopilot,' 'weekly marketing review,' 'ad fatigue check,' 'content refresh loop,' 'churn watch,' 'ranking drop alert,' 'always-on marketing,' 'marketing automation workflow,' or 'run this every week.' Use this to pick, adapt, and schedule an ongoing marketing loop that orchestrates the other marketing skills. For one-off marketing ideas, see marketing-ideas. For the experimentation loop specifically, see ab-testing.
description_zh: 当用户希望设置一个重复性、自主运行的营销工作流——即由AI代理按固定频率（每周、每天或基于触发条件）重复执行的循环流程，而非一次性任务。此外，当用户提及“营销循环”、“重复性营销工作流”、“自动化我的营销”、“自动化营销”、“每周营销回顾”、“广告疲劳检查”、“内容更新循环”、“流失监控”、“排名下降预警”、“全天候营销”、“营销自动化工作流”或“每周执行此操作”时，使用此功能。使用此功能以挑选、调整并安排一个持续运行的营销循环，该循环负责编排其他营销技能。对于一次性营销思路，请参阅 marketing-ideas。针对实验循环，请参阅 ab-testing。

description: Find and synthesize research papers, whitepapers, PDFs, technical reports, and academic sources with Firecrawl Research, using semantic paper search, related-paper expansion, and in-body verification over Firecrawl's paper index — largely biomedical and life-science literature from PubMed, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, plus arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math. Use when the user wants a literature review, systematic review, survey of studies, paper summary, research landscape, or sourced synthesis from scholarly and industry publications, including clinical, drug, gene, disease, epidemiology, and public-health topics. Prefer this over a general web-research workflow whenever the evidence base is published papers rather than web pages.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl Research，在 Firecrawl 的论文索引上，通过语义论文检索、相关论文扩展和正文内验证，查找并整合研究论文、白皮书、PDF 文件、技术报告和学术来源——主要是来自 PubMed、bioRxiv 和 medRxiv 的生物医学与生命科学文献，以及计算机科学、物理和数学领域的 arXiv 预印本。适用于当用户需要文献综述、系统综述、研究综述、论文摘要、研究格局，或从学术与行业出版物中获取有来源的整合内容时使用，涵盖临床、药物、基因、疾病、流行病学和公共卫生等主题。当证据基础为已发表论文而非网页时，优先使用此方案而非通用的网页研究流程。

description: Implement comprehensive testing strategies with pytest, fixtures, mocking, and test-driven development. Use when writing Python tests, setting up test suites, or implementing testing best practices.
description_zh: 结合 pytest、测试夹具、mocking 与测试驱动开发，实施全面的测试策略。在编写 Python 测试、搭建测试套件或落实测试最佳实践时使用。

description: Search the web with LLM-optimized results via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to search the web, find articles, look up information, get recent news, discover sources, or says "search for", "find me", "look up", "what's the latest on", "find articles about", or needs current information from the internet. Returns relevant results with content snippets, relevance scores, and metadata — optimized for LLM consumption. Supports domain filtering, time ranges, and multiple search depths.
description_zh: 通过 Tavily CLI 搜索网页，获取经 LLM 优化后的结果。当用户想要搜索网页、查找文章、查询信息、获取最新新闻、发现来源，或说出"search for"、"find me"、"look up"、"what's the latest on"、"find articles about"等关键词，亦或需要从互联网获取最新信息时，使用此技能。返回带有内容片段、相关性评分和元数据的相关结果——专为 LLM 消费优化。支持域名筛选、时间范围和多层搜索深度。

description: Configure multi-tenant organizations, manage members and invitations, define custom roles and permissions, set up teams, and implement RBAC using Better Auth's organization plugin. Use when users need org setup, team management, member roles, access control, or the Better Auth organization plugin.
description_zh: 配置多租户组织，管理成员与邀请，定义自定义角色与权限，搭建团队，并使用 Better Auth 的组织插件实现基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）。适用于需要组织配置、团队管理、成员角色设置、访问控制，或使用 Better Auth 组织插件的用户。

description: Extract any website's design system into an agent-ready DESIGN.md using Firecrawl scrape evidence. Use when the user wants colors, fonts, spacing, components, layout patterns, or brand/UI guidance from a website so AI agents can create new websites, clone a look, or build pages inspired by that design.
description_zh: 使用Firecrawl抓取证据，将任何网站的风格系统提取为智能体就绪的DESIGN.md。当用户需要从网站获取颜色、字体、间距、组件、布局模式或品牌/UI指导时使用，以便AI智能体可以创建新网站、克隆外观，或构建受该设计启发的页面。

description: Token architecture, component specifications, and slide generation. Three-layer tokens (primitive→semantic→component), CSS variables, spacing/typography scales, component specs, strategic slide creation. Use for design tokens, systematic design, brand-compliant presentations.
description_zh: 令牌架构、组件规范与幻灯片生成。三层令牌（基础→语义→组件）、CSS 变量、间距/字体排版比例、组件规范、战略性幻灯片创建。用于设计令牌、系统化设计及符合品牌规范的演示文稿。

description: AI image generation with OpenAI GPT Image 2.5, Azure OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, DashScope, Z.AI GLM-Image, MiniMax, Jimeng, Seedream, Replicate and Agnes APIs. Supports text-to-image, reference images, aspect ratios, and batch generation from saved prompt files. Sequential by default; use batch parallel generation when the user already has multiple prompts or wants stable multi-image throughput. Use when user asks to generate, create, or draw images.
description_zh: 支持 OpenAI GPT Image 2.5、Azure OpenAI、Google、OpenRouter、DashScope、Z.AI GLM-Image、MiniMax、Jimeng、Seedream、Replicate 和 Agnes API 的 AI 图像生成。支持文生图、参考图片、比例设置，以及从已保存的提示词文件中批量生成。默认按顺序生成；当用户已有多个提示词或需要稳定的多图像吞吐量时，请使用批量并行生成。当用户要求生成、创建或绘制图像时使用。

description: Comprehensive design skill: brand identity, design tokens, UI styling, logo generation (55 styles, Gemini or Atlas Cloud AI), corporate identity program (50 deliverables, CIP mockups), HTML presentations (Chart.js), banner design (22 styles, social/ads/web/print), icon design (15 styles, SVG, Gemini 3.1 Pro), social photos (HTML→screenshot, multi-platform). Actions: design logo, create CIP, generate mockups, build slides, design banner, generate icon, create social photos, social media images, brand identity, design system. Platforms: Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, Threads, Google Ads.
description_zh:
**综合设计技能：** 品牌识别、设计令牌、UI 样式设计、标志生成（55种样式，Gemini 或 Atlas 云端 AI）

**企业识别计划（50项交付物，CIP mockups）**

**HTML 演示文稿（Chart.js）**

**横幅设计（22种样式，适用于社交/广告/网络/印刷）**

**图标设计（15种样式，SVG，Gemini 3.1 Pro）**

**社交媒体照片（HTML 转换截图，多平台）**

**操作：** 设计标志、创建 CIP、生成 mockups、制作演示文稿、设计横幅、生成图标、创建社交媒体照片、社交媒体图片、品牌识别、设计系统

**平台：** Facebook、Twitter、LinkedIn、YouTube、Instagram、Pinterest、TikTok、Threads、Google Ads

description: Create beautiful, accessible user interfaces with shadcn/ui components (built on Radix UI + Tailwind), Tailwind CSS utility-first styling, and canvas-based visual designs. Use when building user interfaces, implementing design systems, creating responsive layouts, adding accessible components (dialogs, dropdowns, forms, tables), customizing themes and colors, implementing dark mode, generating visual designs and posters, or establishing consistent styling patterns across applications.
description_zh: 借助 shadcn/ui 组件（基于 Radix UI 与 Tailwind 构建）、Tailwind CSS 工具优先样式设计以及基于画布的视觉设计，打造美观、可访问的用户界面。适用于构建用户界面、实现设计系统、创建响应式布局、添加可访问组件（对话框、下拉菜单、表单、表格）、定制主题与颜色、实现深色模式、生成视觉设计与海报，或在不同应用间建立统一的样式规范。

description: Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring SwiftUI code for iOS or macOS, including state and `@Observable` data flow, view composition, resizable layouts, safe areas, display scale, performance, lists, environment, localization, animation, Liquid Glass, and API migration. Also use for iPhone Duo or foldable layouts, `ArrangementView`, `ReservedRegion`, hinge effects, vertical bars, `@State` initialization or synthesized-property diagnostics, `@ContentBuilder` ambiguity, `reorderable` drag/drop, custom `AsyncImage` `URLSession`, swipe actions outside List, item-bound `alert`/`confirmationDialog`, `ToolbarOverflowMenu`, `AnimatableValues`, Document APIs (`Document`/`DocumentReader`), and Instruments `.trace` capture or analysis.
description_zh: 用于编写、审查或重构 iOS 或 macOS 的 SwiftUI 代码时使用，涵盖状态与 `@Observable` 数据流、视图组合、可调整大小的布局、安全区域、显示缩放、性能、列表、环境、本地化、动画、Liquid Glass 及 API 迁移。亦用于 iPhone Duo 或折叠屏布局、`ArrangementView`、`ReservedRegion`、铰链效果、竖向栏、`@State` 初始化或合成属性诊断、`@ContentBuilder` 歧义、`reorderable` 拖放、自定义 `AsyncImage` 的 `URLSession`、List 外部滑动操作、与条目绑定的 `alert`/`confirmationDialog`、`ToolbarOverflowMenu`、`AnimatableValues`、文档 API（`Document`/`DocumentReader`），以及 Instruments `.trace` 捕获或分析。

description: Configures Flutter Driver for app interaction and converts MCP actions into permanent integration tests. Use when adding integration testing to a project, exploring UI components via MCP, or automating user flows with the integration_test package.
description_zh: 为应用交互配置 Flutter 驱动，并将 MCP 操作转换为永久的集成测试。当需要在项目中添加集成测试、通过 MCP 探索 UI 组件，或使用 integration_test 包自动化用户流程时使用。

description: Extract market, financial, earnings, industry, and company metrics with Firecrawl. Use when the user asks for market research, industry trends, public company data, financial comparisons, earnings research, or structured market reports.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 提取市场、金融、盈利、行业和公司指标。当用户询问市场研究、行业趋势、上市公司数据、财务对比、盈利研究或结构化市场报告时使用。

description: Configure `MaterialApp.router` using a package like `go_router` for advanced URL-based navigation. Use when developing web applications or mobile apps that require specific deep linking and browser history support.
description_zh: 使用类似 `go_router` 的包配置 `MaterialApp.router`，以实现高级的 URL 导航。适用于开发需要特定深度链接和浏览器历史记录支持的网络应用或移动应用。

description: Brand voice, visual identity, messaging frameworks, asset management, brand consistency. Activate for branded content, tone of voice, marketing assets, brand compliance, style guides.
description_zh: 品牌声音、视觉形象、信息框架、资产管理、品牌一致性。激活用于品牌内容、语调、营销资产、品牌合规、风格指南。

description: Design banners for social media, ads, website heroes, creative assets, and print. Multiple art direction options with optional generated or supplied visuals. Actions: design, create, generate banner. Platforms: Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Google Display, website hero, print. Styles: minimalist, gradient, bold typography, photo-based, illustrated, geometric, retro, glassmorphism, 3D, neon, duotone, editorial, collage.
description_zh:
为社交媒体、广告、网站首屏、创意素材和印刷品设计横幅。提供多种艺术方向选项，支持可选的自动生成或手动提供视觉素材。
操作：设计、创建、生成横幅。
平台：Facebook、Twitter/X、LinkedIn、YouTube、Instagram、Google 展示网络、网站首屏、印刷品。
风格：极简、渐变、大字体粗体、照片式、插画、几何、复古、玻璃拟态、3D、霓虹、双色调、编辑风、拼贴。

description: Generate professional infographics with 21 layout types and 22 visual styles. Analyzes content, recommends layout×style combinations, and generates publication-ready infographics. Use when user asks to create "infographic", "信息图", "visual summary", "可视化", or "高密度信息大图".
description_zh: 生成具备21种版式与22种视觉风格的专业信息图。分析内容，推荐版式×风格组合，并生成可直接发布的信息图。当用户要求创建“infographic”、“信息图”、“可视化”或“高密度信息大图”时使用。

description: Build a knowledge base from web content with Firecrawl. Use for local reference docs, RAG-ready chunks, fine-tuning datasets, documentation mirrors, topic corpora, or LLM-ready markdown organized from web sources.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 基于网页内容构建知识库。可用于本地参考文档、RAG 就绪的分块、微调数据集、文档镜像、主题语料库，或从网络来源整理的 LLM 就绪 Markdown。

description: Run outcome-focused Firecrawl workflows that produce deliverables such as research reports, literature reviews over published papers, SEO audits, QA reports, lead lists, knowledge bases, website design systems, and other structured web-data artifacts. Use when the user wants Firecrawl to complete a business, marketing, product, or creative workflow rather than merely scrape a page or integrate API calls into code.
description_zh: 运行以结果为导向的 Firecrawl 工作流，生成如研究报告、基于已发表论文的文献综述、SEO 审计、QA 报告、潜在客户名单、知识库、网站设计系统及其他结构化网页数据制品的交付物。适用于用户希望 Firecrawl 完成商业、营销、产品或创意工作流，而非仅抓取页面或将 API 调用集成到代码中的情况。

description: Create strategic HTML presentations with Chart.js, design tokens, responsive layouts, copywriting formulas, and contextual slide strategies.
description_zh: 创建结合 Chart.js、设计令牌、响应式布局、文案公式及上下文演示策略的战略性 HTML 演示文稿。

description: Audit a website's SEO with Firecrawl. Use when the user asks for an SEO audit, metadata and heading review, sitemap/site-structure analysis, keyword opportunities, competitor SERP comparison, or prioritized search optimization recommendations.
description_zh: 使用Firecrawl审计网站的SEO。当用户要求SEO审计、元数据与标题审查、网站地图/网站结构分析、关键词机会、竞争对手SERP对比，或优先排序的搜索优化建议时使用。

description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, Mermaid (rendered to PNG via headless Chrome), PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bottom citations for external links. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md 转 html", "微信外链转底部引用", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.
description_zh: 将 Markdown 转换为采用微信兼容主题的样式化 HTML。支持代码高亮、数学公式、Mermaid（通过无头 Chrome 渲染为 PNG）、PlantUML、脚注、警告、信息图，以及为外部链接提供可选的底部引用。当用户要求使用“markdown to html”、“convert md to html”、“md 转 html”、“微信外链转底部引用”，或需要从 Markdown 获取样式化 HTML 输出时使用。

description: Instruments code so production behavior is visible and diagnosable. Use when adding logging, metrics, tracing, or alerting. Use when shipping any feature that runs in production and you need evidence it works. Use when production issues are reported but you can't tell what happened from the available data.
description_zh: 对代码进行埋点，使生产环境下的行为可见且可诊断。在添加日志、指标、追踪或告警时使用。在向生产环境发布任何运行中的功能且需要证明其有效时使用。当报告生产环境问题时，但现有数据无法明确发生何事时使用。

description: Pull metrics from analytics dashboards and internal web tools with Firecrawl browser. Use when the user needs dashboard reporting, cross-platform metric summaries, authenticated analytics extraction, date-range reports, or structured metrics from web dashboards.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器从分析仪表板和内部网页工具中拉取指标。当用户需要仪表板报告、跨平台指标摘要、身份验证的分析提取、日期范围报告或来自网页仪表板的结构化指标时使用。

description: Generates article cover images with 5 dimensions (type, palette, rendering, text, mood) combining 11 color palettes and 7 rendering styles. Supports cinematic (2.35:1), widescreen (16:9), and square (1:1) aspects. Use when user asks to "generate cover image", "create article cover", or "make cover".
description_zh: 生成具备5个维度（类型、配色、渲染、文字、氛围）且结合11种配色方案与7种渲染样式的文章封面图片。支持电影感（2.35:1）、宽屏（16:9）及方形（1:1）画面比例。当用户要求“生成封面图片”、“创建文章封面”或“制作封面”时使用。

description: Create model classes with `fromJson` and `toJson` methods using `dart:convert`. Use when manually mapping JSON keys to class properties for simple data structures.
description_zh: 使用`dart:convert`创建带有`fromJson`和`toJson`方法的模型类。当需要手动将JSON键映射到类属性以处理简单数据结构时使用。

description: Generate structured lead lists from prospect databases and web directories with Firecrawl browser. Use for finding prospects by role, company type, industry, stage, location, technologies, or other criteria and exporting CRM-ready JSON or CSV.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器，从潜在客户数据库和网络目录生成结构化的潜在客户列表。用于通过角色、公司类型、行业、阶段、位置、技术或其他标准查找潜在客户，并导出适合 CRM 的 JSON 或 CSV 文件。

description: When the user wants multiple expert perspectives on a marketing question — a simulated board of advisors staffed by legendary marketers (Seth Godin, David Ogilvy, Eugene Schwartz, April Dunford, Rory Sutherland, Alex Hormozi, Byron Sharp, and more). Also use when the user mentions 'marketing council,' 'board of advisors,' 'advisory board,' 'what would Seth Godin say,' 'what would Ogilvy think,' 'channel Hormozi,' 'get multiple perspectives,' 'debate this,' 'have the council review,' 'marketing mentors,' or asks how a famous marketer would approach their problem. The council gives each advisor's take through their documented frameworks, surfaces where they disagree, and synthesizes a recommendation. For executing the winning direction, hand off to positioning, offers, copywriting, ads, or the relevant skill.
description_zh: 当用户希望对某个营销问题获得多位专家的见解——一个由传奇营销人（塞斯·戈丹、大卫·奥格威、尤金·施瓦茨、艾普莉·邓福德、罗里·萨瑟兰、亚历克斯·霍姆兹、拜伦·夏普等）组成的模拟顾问董事会。当用户提到“营销委员会”、“顾问董事会”、“顾问委员会”、“赛斯·戈丹会怎么说”、“奥格威会怎么想”、“咨询霍姆兹”、“获取多方视角”、“对此进行辩论”、“让委员会进行审核”、“营销导师”，或询问著名营销人将如何解决他们的问题时，也使用。该委员会通过各自的既定框架给出每位顾问的见解，指出他们意见不一致的地方，并综合出一项建议。对于执行胜出的方向，将任务转交给定位、促销、文案、广告或相关技能。

description: Produce pre-meeting lead intelligence briefs with Firecrawl. Use when the user needs company research, person research, recent news, talking points, pain points, or outreach preparation before a sales call, partnership meeting, investor conversation, or customer interview.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 生成会前线索情报简报。适用于销售通话、合作会议、投资者交流或客户访谈前的公司调研、人物调研、最新新闻获取、沟通要点梳理、痛点分析及外联准备工作。

description: Monitor competitor pricing, features, changelogs, dashboards, and product changes with Firecrawl. Use for recurring competitive intelligence, pricing tier extraction, feature change tracking, or structured competitor alerts.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 监控竞争对手的定价、功能、更新日志、仪表盘及产品变更。可用于持续竞争情报、定价层级提取、功能变更追踪或结构化竞争对手预警。

description: QA test a live website with Firecrawl browser and scrape evidence. Use when the user wants exploratory QA, form testing, navigation/link checks, responsive checks, performance observations, bug reports, or a pre-launch quality review.
description_zh: 使用Firecrawl浏览器对实时网站进行QA测试并抓取证据。当用户需要进行探索性质量测试、表单测试、导航/链接检查、响应式检查、性能观察、缺陷报告或发布前质量审查时使用。

description: Research products across the web with Firecrawl and produce a shopping recommendation or cart-ready summary. Use when the user wants to compare products, find the best option, evaluate reviews, respect budget/preferences, or shop with a saved browser session.
description_zh: 利用 Firecrawl 在全网调研产品，并生成购物推荐或可直接放入购物车的摘要。适用于用户需要对比产品、寻找最优选项、评估评论、遵守预算与偏好，或使用已保存的浏览器会话进行购物等场景。

description: Ingest public or authenticated knowledge bases and docs portals with Firecrawl browser. Use for JS-heavy docs, login-gated portals, paginated help centers, support knowledge bases, or structured JSON/markdown extraction from documentation sites.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器导入公开或已认证的知识库和文档门户。适用于依赖 JavaScript 的文档、需登录才能访问的门户、分页帮助中心、支持类知识库，或从文档网站进行结构化 JSON/Markdown 提取。

description: Analyzes article structure, identifies positions requiring visual aids, generates illustrations with Type × Style × Palette three-dimension approach. Use when user asks to "illustrate article", "add images", "generate images for article", or "为文章配图".
description_zh: 分析文章结构，识别需要视觉辅助的位置，采用“类型×风格×调色板”三维方法生成插图。当用户请求“为文章配图”、“添加图片”、“为文章生成图片”或“为文章配图”时使用。

description: Extract structured company lists from directories with Firecrawl. Use for scraping YC, Crunchbase, Product Hunt, G2, startup directories, category directories, or custom company databases into JSON, CSV, CRM-ready lists, or research tables.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 从公司目录中提取结构化的公司列表。可用于抓取 YC、Crunchbase、Product Hunt、G2、初创公司目录、类别目录或自定义公司数据库，并将数据转换为 JSON、CSV、CRM 就绪列表或研究表格。

description: Add `flutter_localizations` and `intl` dependencies, enable "generate true" in `pubspec.yaml`, and create an `l10n.yaml` configuration file. Use when initializing localization support for a new Flutter project.
description_zh: 添加 `flutter_localizations` 和 `intl` 依赖，在 `pubspec.yaml` 中启用 "generate true"，并创建 `l10n.yaml` 配置文件。用于为新 Flutter 项目初始化本地化支持。

description: Walk through a product's key flows with Firecrawl browser and produce a structured UX/product walkthrough. Use for signup, onboarding, pricing, docs, dashboard, product demo prep, UX teardown, and first-run experience analysis.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器走查产品关键流程，生成结构化的 UX/产品走查。适用于注册、入驻、定价、文档、仪表板、产品演示准备、UX 拆解以及首次运行体验分析。

description: Adds interactive widget previews to the project using the previews.dart system. Use when creating new UI components or updating existing screens to ensure consistent design and interactive testing.
description_zh: 通过 previews.dart 系统向项目添加交互式组件预览。在创建新 UI 组件或更新现有屏幕时使用，以确保设计的一致性和交互式测试。

description: Configure TOTP authenticator apps, send OTP codes via email/SMS, manage backup codes, handle trusted devices, and implement 2FA sign-in flows using Better Auth's twoFactor plugin. Use when users need MFA, multi-factor authentication, authenticator setup, or login security with Better Auth.
description_zh: 配置TOTP身份验证应用，通过邮件或短信发送OTP验证码，管理备用验证码，处理受信任设备，并使用Better Auth的twoFactor插件实现2FA登录流程。当用户使用Better Auth需要多因素认证（MFA）、身份验证器设置或登录安全时，即可使用本功能。

description: Use Expo DOM components to run web code in a webview on native and as-is on web. Migrate web code to native incrementally.
description_zh: 使用 Expo DOM 组件在原生端的 WebView 中运行网页代码，并在 Web 端原样运行。逐步将网页代码迁移到原生应用。

description: Plan the UX and UI for a feature before writing code. Runs a structured discovery interview, then produces a design brief that guides implementation. Use during the planning phase to establish design direction, constraints, and strategy before any code is written.
description_zh: 在编写代码之前，规划功能的用户体验（UX）与界面（UI）。开展结构化需求访谈，随后编制设计简报，为实施过程提供指导。在规划阶段应用，于编写任何代码之前确立设计方向、约束条件与策略。

description: Generates infographic image card series with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts, and 3 color palettes. Breaks content into 1-10 cartoon-style image cards optimized for social media engagement. Use when user mentions "小红书图片", "小红书种草", "小绿书", "微信图文", "微信贴图", "image cards", "图片卡片", baoyu-xhs-images, or wants social media infographic series.
description_zh: 生成包含12种视觉风格、8种版式和3套配色方案的信息图图片卡片系列。将内容拆分为1至10张针对社交媒体互动优化的卡通风格图片卡片。当用户提到“小红书图片”、“小红书种草”、“小绿书”、“微信图文”、“微信贴图”、“image cards”、“图片卡片”、“baoyu-xhs-images”，或者想要社交媒体信息图系列时使用。

description: Use the `http` package to execute GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE requests. Use when you need to fetch from or send data to a REST API.
description_zh: 使用 `http` 包执行 GET、POST、PUT 或 DELETE 请求。当需要从 REST API 获取数据或向 REST API 发送数据时使用。

description: Token architecture, component specifications, and slide generation. Three-layer tokens (primitive→semantic→component), CSS variables, spacing/typography scales, component specs, strategic slide creation. Use for design tokens, systematic design, brand-compliant presentations.
description_zh: 令牌架构、组件规格与幻灯片生成。三层令牌（原始→语义→组件）、CSS变量、间距/排版比例、组件规格、策略性幻灯片制作。用于设计令牌、系统化设计与符合品牌规范的演示。

description: EAS service (paid). Check the health of published EAS Update: crash rates, install/launch counts, unique users, payload size, and the split between embedded and OTA users per channel. Use when the user asks how an update is performing, whether a rollout is healthy, how many users are on the embedded build vs OTA, or wants to gate CI on update health.
description_zh: EAS服务（付费）。检查已发布的EAS更新健康状况：崩溃率、安装/启动次数、唯一用户数、载荷大小，以及每个渠道中嵌入式用户与OTA用户的占比。适用于用户询问更新运行表现、推广是否正常、嵌入式版本与OTA版本分别有多少用户，或希望根据更新健康状态来控制CI流程等场景。

description: Generates professional slide deck images from content. Creates outlines with style instructions, then generates individual slide images. Use when user asks to "create slides", "make a presentation", "generate deck", "slide deck", or "PPT".
description_zh: 根据内容生成专业的幻灯片图像。根据样式说明创建大纲，随后生成各张幻灯片图像。当用户要求“创建幻灯片”、“制作演示文稿”、“生成演示文稿”、“幻灯片”、“演示文稿”或“PPT”时使用。

description: Master Next.js 14+ App Router with Server Components, streaming, parallel routes, and advanced data fetching. Use when building Next.js applications, implementing SSR/SSG, or optimizing React Server Components.
description_zh: 掌握 Next.js 14+ 的 App Router：服务端组件、流式传输、并行路由与高级数据获取。在构建 Next.js 应用、实现 SSR/SSG 或优化 React 服务端组件时使用。

description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams from natural language descriptions. Use when asked to "create a diagram", "make a flowchart", "visualize a process", "draw a system architecture", "create a mind map", or "generate an Excalidraw file". Supports flowcharts, relationship diagrams, mind maps, and system architecture diagrams. Outputs .excalidraw JSON files that can be opened directly in Excalidraw.
description_zh: 根据自然语言描述生成 Excalidraw 图表。当被要求“创建图表”、“制作流程图”、“可视化流程”、“绘制系统架构”、“创建思维导图”或“生成 Excalidraw 文件”时使用。支持流程图、关系图、思维导图和系统架构图。输出可直接在 Excalidraw 中打开的 .excalidraw JSON 文件。

description: Scaffold and implement authentication in TypeScript/JavaScript apps using Better Auth. Detect frameworks, configure database adapters, set up route handlers, add OAuth providers, and create auth UI pages. Use when users want to add login, sign-up, or authentication to a new or existing project with Better Auth.
description_zh: 使用 Better Auth 在 TypeScript/JavaScript 应用中搭建并实现身份认证。检测框架、配置数据库适配器、设置路由处理器、添加 OAuth 提供商，并创建认证 UI 页面。适用于用户希望使用 Better Auth 为新建或现有项目添加登录、注册或身份认证的场景。

description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video by layering timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards onto the playing video — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript. The source video plays in full; the agent designs and writes each card's HTML in conversation, then renders to MP4 via hyperframes. Use when the user asks for graphic overlays, on-screen graphics / lower-thirds / data callouts / kinetic titles on a video, "package / dress up my video", "add overlay cards / graphic cards", or AI-composed graphic packaging of an existing video. NOT for plain subtitles (→ embedded-captions) or building a video from scratch (→ the creation workflows); when unsure overlays-vs-captions, see /hyperframes.
description_zh: 为现有单人出镜/访谈/播客视频打包：通过在播放视频上叠加经过设计、带时间标记的图形叠加卡片——标题、底部文字、数据标注、引用、侧边面板、画中画——并与文字稿同步。原始视频完整播放；智能体在与用户对话中设计并编写每张卡片的 HTML，随后通过 hyperframes 渲染为 MP4 格式。当用户要求为视频添加图形叠加、屏幕图形/底部文字/数据标注/动态标题，或提出“打包/美化我的视频”“添加叠加卡片/图形卡片”、或对现有视频进行 AI 创作图形包装时使用。不适用于纯字幕（→ 内嵌字幕）或从零开始构建视频（→ 创作工作流）；当不确定是叠加层还是字幕时，参见 /hyperframes。

description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using baoyu-fetch CLI (Chrome CDP with site-specific adapters). Built-in adapters for X/Twitter, YouTube transcripts, Hacker News threads, and generic pages via Defuddle. Handles login/CAPTCHA via interaction wait modes. Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.
description_zh: 使用 baoyu-fetch 命令行工具（基于 Chrome 远程调试协议（CDP）及特定站点适配器）获取任意 URL 并转换为 Markdown 格式。内置适配器支持 X/Twitter、YouTube 字幕、Hacker News 帖子，以及利用 Defuddle 处理通用页面。通过交互等待模式处理登录及验证码。当用户需要保存网页为 Markdown 格式时使用。

description: Comprehensive design skill: brand identity, design tokens, UI styling, logo generation (55 styles, Gemini, Atlas Cloud, or MuAPI AI), corporate identity program (50 deliverables, CIP mockups), HTML presentations (Chart.js), banner design (22 styles, social/ads/web/print), icon design (15 styles, SVG, Gemini 3.1 Pro), social photos (HTML→screenshot, multi-platform). Actions: design logo, create CIP, generate mockups, build slides, design banner, generate icon, create social photos, social media images, brand identity, design system. Platforms: Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, Threads, Google Ads.
description_zh:
**综合设计技能：**

**品牌识别、设计令牌、UI 样式、Logo 生成（55 种样式，支持 Gemini、Atlas Cloud 或 MuAPI AI）**

**企业识别计划（50 项交付物、CIP 效果图）**

**HTML 演示文稿（Chart.js）**

**横幅设计（22 种样式，涵盖社交、广告、网络及印刷）**

**图标设计（15 种样式，SVG，支持 Gemini 3.1 Pro）**

**社交图片（HTML→截图，多平台）**

**功能：**
- 设计 Logo
- 创建 CIP
- 生成效果图
- 制作演示文稿
- 设计横幅
- 生成图标
- 创建社交图片
- 制作社交媒体图片
- 品牌识别
- 设计系统

**平台：**
Facebook、Twitter、LinkedIn、YouTube、Instagram、Pinterest、TikTok、Threads、Google Ads。

description: Comprehensively reviews SwiftUI code for best practices on modern APIs, maintainability, and performance. Use when reading, writing, or reviewing SwiftUI projects.
description_zh: 全面审查 SwiftUI 代码中关于现代 API、可维护性和性能的最好实践。在阅读、编写或审查 SwiftUI 项目时使用。

description: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh. Navigate web pages, interact with elements using @e refs, take screenshots, record video. Capabilities: web scraping, form filling, clicking, typing, drag-drop, file upload, JavaScript execution. Use for: web automation, data extraction, testing, agent browsing, research. Triggers: browser, web automation, scrape, navigate, click, fill form, screenshot, browse web, playwright, headless browser, web agent, surf internet, record video
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh 为 AI 智能体提供浏览器自动化。导航网页，使用 @e refs 与元素交互，截图，录制视频。

功能：网页抓取、表单填写、点击、输入、拖拽、文件上传、JavaScript 执行。

用途：网页自动化、数据提取、测试、智能体浏览、研究。

触发词：浏览器、网页自动化、抓取、导航、点击、填写表单、截图、浏览网页、playwright、无头浏览器、网页智能体、上网、录制视频

description: Knowledge comic creator supporting multiple art styles and tones. Creates original educational comics with detailed panel layouts and batch-capable image generation. Use when user asks to create "知识漫画", "教育漫画", "biography comic", "tutorial comic", or "Logicomix-style comic".
description_zh: 支持多种艺术风格和色调的知识漫画创作者。创作具有详细分镜布局和批量图片生成能力的原创教育漫画。当用户要求创作“知识漫画”、“教育漫画”、“biography comic”、“tutorial comic”或“Logicomix-style comic”时使用。

description: Create beautiful, accessible user interfaces with shadcn/ui components (built on Radix UI + Tailwind), Tailwind CSS utility-first styling, and canvas-based visual designs. Use when building user interfaces, implementing design systems, creating responsive layouts, adding accessible components (dialogs, dropdowns, forms, tables), customizing themes and colors, implementing dark mode, generating visual designs and posters, or establishing consistent styling patterns across applications.
description_zh: 使用 shadcn/ui 组件（基于 Radix UI + Tailwind 构建）、Tailwind CSS 优先样式以及基于 canvas 的视觉设计，创建优美且可访问的用户界面。适用于构建用户界面、实现设计系统、创建响应式布局、添加无障碍组件（对话框、下拉框、表单、表格）、自定义主题和颜色、实现深色模式、生成视觉设计和海报，或在应用程序中建立统一的样式模式。

description: Master effective code review practices to provide constructive feedback, catch bugs early, and foster knowledge sharing while maintaining team morale. Use when reviewing pull requests, establishing review standards, or mentoring developers.
description_zh: 掌握有效的代码审查实践，以提供建设性反馈、尽早发现缺陷，并在保持团队士气的同时促进知识共享。在审查拉取请求、制定审查标准或指导开发者时使用。

description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.
description_zh: 掌握 REST 和 GraphQL API 设计原则，构建直观、可扩展且可维护的 API，令开发者感到愉悦。适用于设计新 API、评审 API 规范或建立 API 设计标准。

description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). In Codex, honor explicit requests for the Codex Chrome plugin/@chrome by using the Chrome Extension workflow; otherwise use Chrome Computer Use when available and fall back to real Chrome CDP scripts only when allowed. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".
description_zh: 发布内容及文章至 X (Twitter)。支持带有图片/视频的常规发布及 X 文章（长文 Markdown)。在 Codex 中，尊重用户明确要求使用 Codex Chrome 插件或 @chrome 的请求，优先采用 Chrome 扩展工作流；若无法使用，则在可用时使用 Chrome Computer Use，仅当获得允许时回退至真实的 Chrome CDP 脚本。当用户请求执行 '发布到 X'、'发推文'、'发布到 Twitter' 或 '在 X 上分享' 时使用。

description: Brand voice, visual identity, messaging frameworks, asset management, brand consistency. Activate for branded content, tone of voice, marketing assets, brand compliance, style guides.
description_zh: 品牌声音、视觉形象、信息框架、资产管理与品牌一致性。为品牌内容、语调、营销资产、品牌合规与风格指南启用。

description: Design banners for social media, ads, website heroes, creative assets, and print. Multiple art direction options with optional generated or supplied visuals.
