Actions: design, create, generate banner. Platforms: Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Google Display, website hero, print. Styles: minimalist, gradient, bold typography, photo-based, illustrated, geometric, retro, glassmorphism, 3D, neon, duotone, editorial, collage.
description_zh: 为社交媒体、广告、网站首屏、创意素材和印刷设计横幅。提供多种艺术指导选项，并可选使用生成的或提供的视觉效果。操作：设计、创建、生成横幅。平台/场景：Facebook、Twitter/X、LinkedIn、YouTube、Instagram、Google Display、网站首屏、印刷。风格：极简主义、渐变、大胆排版、照片风格、插画、几何、复古、玻璃拟态、3D、霓虹、双色调、编辑风格、拼贴。

description: Use when building or editing a HyperFrames project that people open in Studio: how the timeline should be laid out so it reads well (one caption track, one element kind per track, every scene a sub-composition) and where captions and key content may sit (safe zones). Don't use for how to perform an individual edit (split, trim, retime, volume, copy, swap): that is `creator-editing-recipes.md` in `/hyperframes-core`.
description_zh: 在Studio中打开并构建或编辑HyperFrames项目时使用：时间轴应如何布局才能清晰易读（每个轨道一个字幕轨、每个轨道一种元素类型、每个场景为一个子合成），以及字幕和关键内容可能放置的位置（安全区域）。请勿用于单个编辑（拆分、裁剪、变速、音量、复制、替换）的操作方法：该文件为 `/hyperframes-core` 目录下的 `creator-editing-recipes.md`。

description: Build, modify, debug, migrate, review, or verify TypeScript MCP servers and MCP Apps with mcp-use. Use for tools, resources, prompts, middleware, Views, authentication, Skills over MCP, scaffolding, and advanced features.
description_zh: 使用 mcp-use 构建、修改、调试、迁移、审查或验证 TypeScript MCP 服务器和 MCP 应用。可用于工具、资源、提示词、中间件、视图、认证、MCP 之上的技能、脚手架及高级特性。

description: NestJS best practices and architecture patterns for building production-ready applications. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring NestJS code to ensure proper patterns for modules, dependency injection, security, and performance.
description_zh: NestJS 构建生产环境就绪应用的最佳实践与架构模式。在编写、审查或重构 NestJS 代码时，应使用本技能，以确保模块、依赖注入、安全性与性能遵循正确模式。

description: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.
description_zh: 将图像压缩为 WebP（默认）或 PNG，并自动选择工具。当用户要求“压缩图像”、“优化图像”、“转换为 WebP”，或减小图像文件大小时使用。

description: Create strategic HTML presentations with Chart.js, design tokens, responsive layouts, copywriting formulas, and contextual slide strategies.
description_zh: 创建策略性的HTML演示文稿，使用Chart.js、设计令牌、响应式布局、文案写作公式和基于情境的幻灯片策略。

description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.
description_zh: 支持为纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加前置元数据、标题、摘要、层级标题、粗体、列表和代码块。当用户要求“格式化 Markdown”、“美化文章”、“添加格式”或优化文章布局时使用。输出至 {filename}-formatted.md。

description: Converts X (Twitter) tweets and articles to markdown with YAML front matter. Uses reverse-engineered API requiring user consent. Use when user mentions "X to markdown", "tweet to markdown", "save tweet", or provides x.com/twitter.com URLs for conversion.
description_zh: 将 X（Twitter）的推文和文章转换为带有 YAML front matter 的 Markdown。使用需用户同意的逆向工程 API。当用户提及“X to markdown”、“tweet to markdown”、“save tweet”，或提供用于转换的 x.com/twitter.com 链接时使用。

description: Run an evidence-led web quality audit covering performance, accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing. Use when asked to "audit my site", "review web quality", "run lighthouse audit", "check page quality", or "optimize my website".
description_zh: 执行以证据为导向的网页质量审计，涵盖性能、可访问性、SEO、最佳实践及智能代理浏览。当被要求“审计我的网站”、“审查网页质量”、“执行 Lighthouse 审计”、“检查页面质量”或“优化我的网站”时使用。

description: Generates images and text via reverse-engineered Gemini Web API. Supports text generation, image generation from prompts, reference images for vision input, and multi-turn conversations. Use when other skills need image generation backend, or when user requests "generate image with Gemini", "Gemini text generation", or needs vision-capable AI generation.
description_zh: 通过逆向工程的 Gemini Web API 生成图像与文本。支持文本生成、基于提示词生成图像、用于视觉输入的参考图像以及多轮对话功能。适用于其他技能需要图像生成后端时，或当用户请求使用"Gemini生成图像"、"Gemini文本生成"时，或需要具备视觉能力的AI生成场景。

description: Clerk authentication router. Use when user asks about Clerk CLI operations, adding authentication, setting up Clerk, custom sign-in flows, Swift or native iOS auth, native Android auth, Next.js patterns, React patterns, Vue patterns, Nuxt patterns, Astro patterns, TanStack Start patterns, Expo patterns, React Router patterns, Chrome Extension patterns, organizations, billing, subscriptions, payments, pricing, plans, seat-based pricing, feature entitlements, syncing users, testing, impersonating a user, or testing webhooks locally. Automatically routes to the specific skill based on their task.
description_zh: Clerk 认证路由。当用户询问 Clerk CLI 操作、添加认证、设置 Clerk、自定义登录流程、Swift 或原生 iOS 认证、原生 Android 认证、Next.js 模式、React 模式、Vue 模式、Nuxt 模式、Astro 模式、TanStack Start 模式、Expo 模式、React Router 模式、Chrome 扩展程序模式、组织、计费、订阅、支付、定价、套餐、座位制定价、功能权限、用户同步、测试、模拟用户或本地测试 Webhooks 时使用。根据用户的任务，自动将其路由至相应的技能。

description: Operate the Clerk CLI (`clerk` binary) for authentication, user/org/session management, impersonation, local webhook testing, deploy verification, instance config, env keys, feature toggles, and any Clerk Backend, Platform, or Frontend API call. Use when the user mentions Clerk management tasks, "list clerk users", "impersonate a user", "test webhooks locally", "enable orgs", "enable billing", "clerk env pull", "clerk doctor", "clerk deploy", "clerk api", or any ad-hoc Clerk API request. Prefer the CLI over raw HTTP: it handles auth, key resolution, app/instance targeting, and formatting automatically.
description_zh: 操作 Clerk CLI（`clerk` 二进制文件），用于认证、用户/组织/会话管理、身份模拟、本地 Webhook 测试、部署验证、实例配置、环境变量、功能开关，以及任何 Clerk 后端、平台或前端 API 调用。当用户提及 Clerk 管理任务、“list clerk users”、“impersonate a user”、“test webhooks locally”、“enable orgs”、“enable billing”、“clerk env pull”、“clerk doctor”、“clerk deploy”、“clerk api”，或任何临时性的 Clerk API 请求时使用。优先使用 CLI 而非原始 HTTP 请求：它自动处理认证、密钥解析、应用/实例定位，以及格式化。

description: Craft-first interface design for dashboards, admin panels, SaaS apps, tools, settings pages, data interfaces, and interactive products. Use when designing, building, reviewing, auditing, or refining product UI where visual craft, layout hierarchy, tokens, states, visual direction, or design-system consistency matter. Not for marketing pages, landing pages, campaigns, or brand-only work.
description_zh: 以工艺为核心的界面设计，适用于仪表盘、后台管理面板、SaaS应用、工具、设置页面、数据接口及交互产品的界面设计。用于在界面设计的构思、构建、评审、审计或优化过程中，当视觉工艺、布局层级、设计令牌、状态、视觉方向或设计系统一致性具有重要影响时使用。不适用于营销页面、落地页、营销活动或纯品牌类工作。

description: Improve layout, spacing, and visual rhythm. Fixes monotonous grids, inconsistent spacing, and weak visual hierarchy. Use when the user mentions layout feeling off, spacing issues, visual hierarchy, crowded UI, alignment problems, or wanting better composition.
description_zh: 优化布局、间距与视觉节奏。修正单调的网格、不一致的间距和薄弱的视觉层级。当用户提到布局感觉不佳、间距问题、视觉层级、界面拥挤、对齐问题，或希望获得更好的构图时使用。

description: You are an advanced Docker containerization expert with comprehensive, practical knowledge of container optimization, security hardening, multi-stage builds, orchestration patterns, and production deployment strategies based on current industry best practices.
description_zh: 你是基于当前行业最佳实践的资深 Docker 容器化专家，在容器优化、安全加固、多阶段构建、编排模式及生产部署策略方面具备全面且实用的知识。

description: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) for better page experience using field and lab evidence. Use when asked to "improve Core Web Vitals", "fix LCP", "reduce CLS", "optimize INP", "page experience optimization", or "fix layout shifts".
description_zh: 基于现场和实验室证据优化核心网页指标（LCP、INP、CLS），以提升页面体验。当被要求“改善核心网页指标”、“修复LCP”、“减少CLS”、“优化INP”、“页面体验优化”或“修复布局偏移”时使用。

description: Diátaxis Documentation Expert. An expert technical writer specializing in creating high-quality software documentation, guided by the principles and structure of the Diátaxis technical documentation authoring framework.
description_zh: Diátaxis 文档专家。一位专注于编写高质量软件文档的资深技术作家，遵循 Diátaxis 技术文档编写框架的原则与结构。

description:
Build and iterate playable browser games, or create game-specific sprites,
textures, animated 3D assets, music, SFX, and voice with Higgsfield CLI.
Use when: "make a game", "build a browser game", "create game assets",
"make a spritesheet", "generate a tileable texture", "animate a 3D game
character", or "deploy/publish my game". Supports solo, local multiplayer,
and online multiplayer games. NOT for: ordinary image/video generation,
game trailers, native mobile/desktop builds, or editing a game without its
source files.
description_zh:
使用 Higgsfield CLI 构建并迭代可玩的浏览器游戏，或创建游戏专属的精灵、纹理、动态 3D 资产、音乐、音效（SFX）和语音。

适用场景："制作游戏"、"构建浏览器游戏"、"创建游戏资源"、"制作精灵图"、"生成可平铺纹理"、"动画化 3D 游戏角色"，或"部署/发布我的游戏"。

支持单人、本地多人及在线多人游戏。

不适用于：普通图片/视频生成、游戏预告片、原生移动端/桌面端构建，或在无源代码文件的情况下编辑游戏。

description: Sanity development best practices for schema design, GROQ queries, TypeGen, Visual Editing, images, Portable Text, Studio structure, localization, migrations, Sanity Functions, webhooks, Blueprints, and framework integrations such as Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, Remix, SvelteKit, Angular, Hydrogen, and the App SDK. Use this skill whenever working with Sanity schemas, defineType or defineField, GROQ or defineQuery, content modeling, Presentation or preview setups, Sanity-powered frontend integrations, event-driven content automation, documentEventHandler, defineDocumentFunction, defineMediaLibraryAssetFunction, @sanity/functions, @sanity/blueprints, sanity.blueprint.ts, event-driven content automation, or when reviewing and fixing a Sanity codebase.
description_zh: Sanity 开发最佳实践，涵盖模式设计、GROQ 查询、TypeGen、可视化编辑、图片、Portable Text、Studio 结构、本地化、迁移、Sanity Functions、网页钩子、蓝图，以及 Next.js、Nuxt、Astro、Remix、SvelteKit、Angular、Hydrogen 和 App SDK 等框架集成。在涉及 Sanity 模式、defineType 或 defineField、GROQ 或 defineQuery、内容建模、Presentation 或预览设置、基于 Sanity 的前端、基于事件的內容自動化、documentEventHandler、defineDocumentFunction、defineMediaLibraryAssetFunction、@sanity/functions、@sanity/blueprints、sanity.blueprint.ts、基于事件的內容自動化，或者在审查和修复 Sanity 代码库时，请使用此技能。

description: Provides React Native performance optimization guidelines for FPS, TTI, bundle size, memory leaks, re-renders, and animations. Applies to tasks involving Hermes optimization, JS thread blocking, bridge overhead, FlashList, native modules, or debugging jank and frame drops.
description_zh: 为 FPS、TTI、包体积、内存泄漏、重新渲染和动画提供 React Native 性能优化指南。适用于涉及 Hermes 优化、JS 线程阻塞、桥接开销、FlashList、原生模块，或排查卡顿与掉帧的任务。

description: Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering. Finds what to delete: reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility. One line per finding: location, what to cut, what replaces it. Use when the user says "review for over-engineering", "what can we delete", "is this over-engineered", "simplify review", or invokes /ponytail-review. Complements correctness-focused review, this one only hunts complexity.
description_zh: 仅聚焦于过度设计的代码审查。找出需要删除的内容：重新发明的标准库、不必要的依赖、推测性的抽象、已废弃的灵活性。每条发现一行：位置、需要删减的内容、替换方案。当用户说“对过度设计进行审查”、“我们可以删除什么”、“这是过度设计吗”、“简化代码审查”或调用 /ponytail-review 时使用。作为以正确性为重点的审查的补充，这一审查仅追踪复杂性。

description: Create optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles for any language or framework
description_zh: 为任何语言或框架创建优化的多阶段 Dockerfile。

description: Review a pull request diff and write structured feedback to review.json for the workflow to publish. Use when reviewing a checked-out PR from local artifacts like pr_diff.txt and pr_description.txt and producing machine-readable review output instead of posting directly to GitHub.
description_zh: 审查拉取请求的差异，并为发布工作流向 review.json 写入结构化反馈。当需要审查从本地产物（如 pr_diff.txt 和 pr_description.txt）检出的拉取请求，并生成机器可读的评审输出，而非直接发布到 GitHub 时使用。

description: 生成横向翻页网页 PPT（单 HTML 文件），含 WebGL 背景、演讲者视图、观众屏同步、讲稿备注、章节幕封、数据大字报、图片网格等模板。提供两种风格：① "电子杂志 × 电子墨水"（衬线 + 流体背景 + 暖色） ② "瑞士国际主义"（无衬线 + 网格点阵 + IKB/柠檬黄/柠檬绿/安全橙高亮）。当用户需要制作分享 / 演讲 / 发布会风格的网页 PPT，或提到"杂志风 PPT"、"瑞士风 PPT"、"Swiss Style"、"horizontal swipe deck"时使用。
description_zh: 生成横向翻页网页 PPT（单 HTML 文件），包含 WebGL 背景、演讲者视图、观众屏同步、讲稿备注、章节幕封、数据大字报、图片网格等模板。提供两种风格：① “电子杂志 × 电子墨水”（衬线字体 + 流体背景 + 暖色调） ② “瑞士国际主义”（无衬线字体 + 网格点阵 + IKB/柠檬黄/柠檬绿/安全橙高亮）。当用户需要制作分享、演讲、发布会风格的网页 PPT，或提到“杂志风 PPT”、“瑞士风 PPT”、“Swiss Style”、“horizontal swipe deck”时使用。

description: Drive a spec-first workflow for substantial features by writing PRODUCT.md before implementation, writing TECH.md when warranted, and keeping both specs updated as implementation evolves. Use when starting a significant feature, planning agent-driven implementation, or when the user wants product and tech specs checked into source control.
description_zh: 通过实施前编写 PRODUCT.md、需要时编写 TECH.md，并在实现演进过程中保持两份规格的最新更新，以规格为先驱动实质性功能的工作流程。在启动重要功能、规划智能体驱动的实现，或用户希望将产品和技术规格提交至源代码控制时使用。

description:
女娲造人：输入人名/主题/甚至只是模糊需求，自动深度调研→思维框架提炼→生成可运行的人物Skill。
两种入口：(1)明确人名→直接蒸馏 (2)模糊需求→诊断推荐→再蒸馏。
触发词：「造skill」「蒸馏XX」「女娲」「造人」「XX的思维方式」「做个XX视角」「更新XX的skill」。
模糊需求也触发：「我想提升决策质量」「有没有一种思维方式能帮我...」「我需要一个思维顾问」。
English triggers: "distill [person]", "nuwa", "create a [person] perspective skill", "how does [person] think", "I need a thinking advisor".
description_zh:
女娲造人：输入人名/主题/甚至只是模糊需求，自动深度调研→思维框架提炼→生成可运行的人物Skill。
两种入口：(1)明确人名→直接蒸馏 (2)模糊需求→诊断推荐→再蒸馏。
触发词：「造skill」「蒸馏XX」「女娲」「造人」「XX的思维方式」「做个XX视角」「更新XX的skill」。
模糊需求也触发：「我想提升决策质量」「有没有一种思维方式能帮我...」「我需要一个思维顾问」。
英文触发词： "distill [person]", "nuwa", "create a [person] perspective skill", "how does [person] think", "I need a thinking advisor".

description: Write a PRODUCT.md spec for a significant user-facing feature in Warp, focused on detailed behavior and validation. Use when the user asks for a product spec, desired behavior doc, or PRD, wants to define feature behavior before implementation, or when the feature is substantial or behaviorally ambiguous enough that a written spec would improve implementation or review.
description_zh: 编写 Warp 中一项重要用户界面功能的 PRODUCT.md 规范，重点关注详细行为与验证。适用于用户要求产品规范、期望行为文档或 PRD、希望在实现前定义功能行为，或功能较为重大且行为存在模糊性，书面规范足以提升实现与审查质量的情况。

description: dontbesilent 商业工具箱主入口，提供新手教程与单任务动态编排。用户第一次使用 dbskill、不知道该用哪个正式 Skill、带着真实任务寻求合适能力，或在一项任务完成后询问下一步时使用。
description_zh: dontbesilent 商业工具箱主入口，提供新手教程与单任务动态编排。用户首次使用 dbskill、不清楚应使用哪个正式 Skill、带着真实任务寻求合适能力，或在完成一项任务后询问下一步时使用。

description: Write a TECH.md spec for a significant Warp feature after researching the current codebase and implementation constraints. Use when the user asks for a technical spec, implementation plan, or architecture doc tied to a product spec.
description_zh: 在对当前代码库和实施约束进行调研后，为一项重要的 Warp 功能编写一份 TECH.md 技术规范。当用户需要与产品规格相关的技术规范、实施计划或架构文档时使用。

description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features
description_zh: 在设计和审核 PostgreSQL 特定模式时使用此技能。涵盖最佳实践、数据类型、索引、约束、性能模式以及高级功能。

description: Fix compilation errors, linting issues, and test failures in the warp Rust codebase. Covers presubmit checks, WASM-specific errors, and running specific tests. Use when the user hits build errors, clippy or fmt failures, test failures, or needs to run or interpret presubmit before a PR.
description_zh: 修复 warp Rust 代码库中的编译错误、lint 检查问题以及测试失败。涵盖预提交检查、WASM 特定错误以及运行特定测试。当用户遇到构建错误、clippy 或 fmt 失败、测试失败，或在 Pull Request 提交前需要运行或解读预提交检查时使用。

description: Resolve Git merge conflicts by extracting only unresolved paths, conflict hunks, and compact diffs instead of loading whole files into context. Use when a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or stash pop stops on conflicts, when `git status` shows unmerged paths, or when files contain conflict markers.
description_zh: 解决 Git 合并冲突：仅提取未解决路径、冲突块和紧凑差异，而非将整个文件加载到上下文中。当合并、rebase、cherry-pick 或 stash pop 因冲突而停止，`git status` 显示未合并路径，或文件包含冲突标记时使用。

description: Implement an approved feature from PRODUCT.md and TECH.md, keeping specs and code aligned in the same PR as implementation evolves. Use after the product and tech specs are approved and the next step is building the feature.
description_zh: 在 PRODUCT.md 和 TECH.md 中实现已批准的功能，在实现演进过程中确保规范与代码在同一个 PR 中保持一致。在产品和技术规范已批准，且下一步是构建该功能之后使用。

description: Create a pull request in the warp repository for the current branch. Use when the user mentions opening a PR, creating a pull request, submitting changes for review, or preparing code for merge.
description_zh: 在当前分支的 warp 仓库中创建 Pull Request。当用户提及开启 PR、创建 Pull Request、提交变更供评审，或准备代码用于合并时使用。

description: Create or update skills by generating, editing, or refining SKILL.md files in this repository. Use when authoring new skills or revising the structure, frontmatter, or guidance for existing ones.
description_zh: 在本仓库中生成、编辑或完善 SKILL.md 文件，以创建或更新技能。当编写新技能，或修改现有技能的结构、frontmatter 或指导内容时使用。

description: Diagnose CI failures for a PR using the GitHub CLI, extract error logs, and generate a plan to fix them. Use when the user asks to check CI status, pull CI issues, triage test failures, or investigate PR build failures.
description_zh: 使用 GitHub CLI 诊断 PR 的 CI 故障，提取错误日志，并制定修复方案。当用户要求检查 CI 状态、提取 CI 问题、分诊测试失败或调查 PR 构建失败时使用。

description: Guides creation, revision, and review of Warp- or Oz-branded assets. Use when working on launch pages, docs, HTML/CSS components, UI mockups, prompts, social assets, copy, presentations, or any other branded deliverable that should look and sound unmistakably Warp or Oz.
description_zh: 指导 Warp 或 Oz 品牌资产的创建、修订与审核。适用于发布页面、文档、HTML/CSS 组件、UI 原型、提示词、社交资产、文案、演示文稿，或任何其他应明确呈现 Warp 或 Oz 风格（外观与声音）的品牌交付物。

description: Unified entry point for Stitch design work. Handles prompt enhancement (UI/UX keywords, atmosphere), design system synthesis (.stitch/DESIGN.md), and high-fidelity screen generation/editing via Stitch MCP.
description_zh: Stitch 设计工作的统一入口。负责提示词增强（UI/UX 关键词、氛围）、设计系统整合（.stitch/DESIGN.md），以及通过 Stitch MCP 实现的高保真屏幕生成/编辑。

description: Generate a static interactive D3 walkthrough of a pull request. Use when the user wants a zoomable PR map, graph/canvas PR orientation, or alternate visualization of PR system components, data flow, code dependencies, and user actions.
description_zh: 生成一个用于拉取请求的静态交互式 D3 导览。适用于用户需要可缩放的拉取请求（PR）地图、图/画布视角的 PR 呈现，或对拉取请求（PR）系统组件、数据流、代码依赖与用户操作进行替代性可视化的场景。

description: 诊断如何把已经确定的选题做成好内容。用户要求设计内容、检查文案或改善内容表达时使用。
description_zh: 诊断如何将已确定的选题转化为优质内容。适用于用户需要设计内容、检查文案或优化内容表达时使用。

description: 自动识别用户是在解决具体商业问题，还是希望全面检查商业模式，并进入对应诊断流程。用户希望拆解业务、检查商业模式或消解具体商业困境时使用。
description_zh: 自动识别用户是解决具体商业问题，还是希望全面检查商业模式，并进入对应的诊断流程。用户希望拆解业务、检查商业模式或消解具体商业困境时使用。

description: 用五重过滤法寻找值得模仿的对标，并排除主体差异造成的噪音。用户要求找对标、选择模仿对象或分析竞争参照时使用。
description_zh: 用五重过滤法寻找值得模仿的对标，并排除主体差异造成的噪音。用户要求找对标、选择模仿对象或分析竞争参照时使用。

description: 用维特根斯坦与奥派经济学方法拆解模糊的商业概念。用户要求解释一个词、澄清概念边界或识别概念混用时使用。
description_zh: 运用维特根斯坦与奥派经济学方法，拆解模糊的商业概念。在用户要求解释一个词、澄清概念边界或识别概念混用的时候使用。

description: Run a model-diverse subagent council to investigate the same problem from multiple perspectives, compare findings, and produce a final recommendation. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a council, second opinions, multiple agents/models to evaluate one question, parallel investigation, red-team/blue-team comparison, or help deciding between competing technical approaches.
description_zh: 运行一个由不同模型组成的子代理委员会，从多个角度调查同一问题，比较研究结果，并给出最终建议。当用户要求委员会、寻求第二意见、要求多个代理/模型评估一个问题、开展并行调查、进行红队/蓝队对比，或需要帮助在相互竞争的技术方案之间做出选择时，应使用此技能。

description: Polishes and improves the UI in your project. Covers concentric border radius, optical alignment, surface depth, contextual icons, hit areas and more.
description_zh: 优化并完善您项目中的UI。涵盖同心圆边框圆角、光学对齐、表面层次、情境图标、点击区域等更多功能。

description: Vue 3 debugging and error handling for runtime errors, warnings, async failures, and SSR/hydration issues. Use when diagnosing or fixing Vue issues.
description_zh: Vue 3 的调试与错误处理，用于诊断或修复 Vue 问题，涵盖运行时错误、警告、异步失败及 SSR/水合问题。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "translate", "翻译", "精翻", "translate article", "translate to Chinese", "translate to English", "改成中文", "改成英文", "convert to Chinese", "localize", "本地化", "refined translation", "精细翻译", "proofread translation", "快速翻译", "快翻", "这篇文章翻译一下", or provides a URL/file with translation intent. Supports three modes (quick/normal/refined) with custom glossary support.
description_zh: 该技能应在用户请求“翻译”、“翻译”、“精翻”、“翻译文章”、“翻译成中文”、“翻译成英文”、“改成中文”、“改成英文”、“转换成中文”、“本地化”、“本地化”、“精细翻译”、“精细翻译”、“校对翻译”、“快速翻译”、“快翻”、“请翻译这篇文章”，或提供带有翻译意图的URL/文件时使用。支持三种模式（快速/正常/精细），并支持自定义术语表。

description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".
description_zh: 通用发布工作流。自动检测版本文件与变更日志。支持 Node.js、Python、Rust、Claude 插件、GitHub 发布、带注释的标签、历史发布回填以及通用项目。当用户说“发布”、“新版本”、“版本升级”、“推送”、“发布说明”、“GitHub 发布”或“回填发布”时使用。

description: Apply modern web development best practices for security, compatibility, and code quality. Use when asked to "apply best practices", "security audit", "modernize code", "code quality review", or "check for vulnerabilities".
description_zh: 应用现代网页开发中关于安全性、兼容性和代码质量的最佳实践。当要求执行“应用最佳实践”、“安全审计”、“代码现代化”、“代码质量审查”或“检查漏洞”时使用。

description: Whole-repo audit for over-engineering. Like ponytail-review, but scans the entire codebase instead of a diff: a ranked list of what to delete, simplify, or replace with stdlib/native equivalents. Use when the user says "audit this codebase", "audit for over-engineering", "what can I delete from this repo", "find bloat", "ponytail-audit", or "/ponytail-audit". One-shot report, does not apply fixes.
description_zh: 整个仓库的过度工程审计。类似于 ponytail-review，但扫描的是整个代码库而非 diff：一份按重要性排序的列表，列出需要删除、简化或替换为标准库/原生替代品的代码。当用户说“审计这个代码库”、“审计过度工程”、“这个仓库能删除什么代码”、“查找冗余代码”、“ponytail-audit”或“/ponytail-audit”时使用。一次性报告，不应用修复。

description: 诊断短视频开头的问题并生成优化方案。用户要求修改开头、提高开场吸引力或降低开头流失时使用。
description_zh: 诊断短视频开头的问题并生成优化方案。用户要求修改开头、提高开场吸引力或降低开头流失时使用。

description: Create production-ready FastAPI projects with async patterns, dependency injection, and comprehensive error handling. Use when building new FastAPI applications or setting up backend API projects.
description_zh: 创建生产就绪的 FastAPI 项目，采用异步模式、依赖注入和全面的错误处理。适用于构建新的 FastAPI 应用或搭建后端 API 项目。

description: 用阿德勒心理学框架诊断执行阻滞。用户知道该做什么却迟迟不做、反复拖延或行动中断时使用。
description_zh: 使用阿德勒心理学框架诊断执行阻滞。适用于用户知道该做什么却迟迟不做、反复拖延或行动中断的情况。

description: Compare a pull request's implementation against spec context in spec_context.md and feed any material mismatches into review.json. Use during PR review when approved or repository spec context is available.
description_zh: 将拉取请求的实现与 `spec_context.md` 中的规格上下文进行对比，并将任何实质性不匹配内容写入 `review.json`。在 PR 审查过程中使用，当已获批准且仓库规格上下文可用时。

description: Launch Oz cloud agents with computer use to reproduce UI-focused bug reports, capture visual evidence (a screen recording by default), and report reproduction findings. Use when investigating a specific interactive or visual bug from an issue, ticket, support report, or prompt.
description_zh: 通过计算机操作启动 Oz 云端代理，以重现以界面功能为核心的 bug 报告，捕获视觉证据（默认使用屏幕录制），并报告复现结果。适用于排查问题、工单、支持报告或提示词中出现的特定交互或视觉类 bug。

description: Add authentication (passkeys/OAuth) to the current Convex app, including the auth.config.ts wiring.
description_zh: 为当前的 Convex 应用添加认证（passkeys/OAuth），包括 auth.config.ts 的接线。

description: Convex backend specialist. Use this agent for any code inside a `convex/` directory — function definitions, schemas, indexes, queries, mutations, actions, HTTP endpoints, cron jobs, file storage, auth wiring, and component installation. Knows the object-form function syntax, validator patterns, resource limits, and component ecosystem that generic Claude routinely gets wrong.
description_zh: Convex 后端专家。针对 `convex/` 目录内的任何代码，请使用此智能体，包括函数定义、模式、索引、查询、变更、动作、HTTP 端点、定时任务、文件存储、认证接线与组件安装。熟悉对象式函数语法、校验器模式、资源限制以及组件生态系统，这些也是通用版 Claude 通常容易弄错的地方。

description: Pull version-current Convex docs for the version this project uses — pin the installed version, fetch page-as-markdown or check node_modules types, freshness hierarchy — instead of writing a possibly-stale API from memory.
description_zh: 拉取项目所用版本对应的当前版本 Convex 文档——固定已安装版本、获取 page-as-markdown 内容或检查 node_modules 类型，确保文档新鲜度层次——而不是凭记忆编写可能过时的 API。

description: Migrate schema + backfill data on a deployed Convex app using @convex-dev/migrations.
description_zh: 使用 @convex-dev/migrations 在已部署的 Convex 应用中迁移模式 + 回填数据。

description: Audit and harden a Convex app's authorization: identity-from-arg impersonation, missing per-document ownership checks, public queries leaking data by a client-supplied id, and writes into a parent/container the caller doesn't own. Scans for the 4 shapes, applies requireIdentity/requireOwner, verifies with tsc. TRIGGER on 'secure my app', 'audit auth/authz', 'who can access this data'. SKIP when there is no convex/ directory.
description_zh: 审计并加固 Convex 应用的授权：基于参数身份的冒充、缺失的逐文档所有权检查、因客户端提供的 ID 泄露数据的公开查询、以及向调用者不拥有的父级/容器写入数据。扫描这 4 种问题形态，应用 requireIdentity/requireOwner，并用 tsc 验证。触发条件：'secure my app'、'audit auth/authz'、'who can access this data'。当不存在 convex/ 目录时跳过。

description: Convex code reviewer — security, auth, validators, performance, and pattern checks for code in a convex/ directory. Use to review or audit Convex functions before shipping.
description_zh: Convex 代码审查工具 — 针对 convex/ 目录下代码的安全、认证、验证器、性能与模式检查。用于在发布前审查或审计 Convex 函数。

description: Audit and optimize an existing Convex app: security, scale, upgrades, observability.
description_zh: 审计并优化现有 Convex 应用：安全性、可扩展性、升级、可观测性。

description: Design and build reactive, type-safe, production-grade backends on Convex. Covers schema, queries/mutations/actions, indexes, auth, file storage, scheduling, real-time multiplayer, mobile backends, and LLM/agent workflows on Convex's one-platform stack.
description_zh: 在 Convex 上设计并构建具备响应式、类型安全与生产级能力的后端。涵盖 Convex 一站式技术栈中的模式定义、查询/变更/动作、索引、认证、文件存储、任务调度、实时多人游戏、移动后端以及 LLM/智能体工作流。

description: Classify + announce the target Convex deployment before any deployment-affecting command; fresh explicit consent for prod actions; session read-only mode.
description_zh: 在任何影响部署的命令执行之前，对目标 Convex 部署进行分类并予以宣布；为生产环境操作获取全新明确同意；会话以只读模式运行。

description: Set and wire Convex deployment env vars / secrets for the app.
description_zh: 为应用设置并配置 Convex 部署环境变量/密钥。

description: Add recurring scheduled jobs (crons) to the Convex app.
description_zh: 为 Convex 应用添加周期性定时任务（cron）。

description: Read the Convex deployment's 72h insights (read limits, OCC contention), root-cause each event in code, report evidence-backed perf/cost findings with fixes.
description_zh: 阅读 Convex 部署的 72 小时洞察（读取限制、OCC 争用），在代码中根因分析每个事件，并报告有证据支撑的性能/成本发现结果及修复方案。

description: Add a capability to the CURRENT Convex app — consults the served Convex capability catalog for always-current procedures (billing, crons, auth, agent, search, …); falls back to built-in hosting or @convex-dev component search. TRIGGER when the user runs /add, or asks to add hosting/publishing or any backend capability to an existing Convex app.
description_zh: 为 CURRENT Convex 应用添加一种能力——查询所提供 Convex 能力目录，以获取始终有效的流程（计费、定时任务、认证、代理、搜索，……）；若无法获取，则回退至内置托管或 @convex-dev 组件搜索。触发条件：当用户执行 /add，或要求向现有 Convex 应用添加托管/发布或任何后端能力时，触发。

description: Add an AI agent / RAG backend (@convex-dev/agent) to the Convex app.
description_zh: 在 Convex 应用中添加一个 AI 代理 / RAG 后端（@convex-dev/agent）。

description: Rehearse a live-app schema change + backfill on a snapshot-seeded preview deployment, verify, then promote the proven change to prod with the snapshot as rollback.
description_zh: 在由快照初始化的预发布部署环境中，演练线上应用的表结构变更与回填，验证后，将已验证通过的变更发布到生产环境，以该快照作为回滚方案。

description: Query a running Convex app's logs + health in natural language (official MCP): failures, slow/expensive functions, deploy causality — scoped, evidence-backed, with a dashboard deep link.
description_zh: 以自然语言查询正在运行的 Convex 应用的日志与健康状态（官方 MCP）：覆盖故障、缓慢/高成本函数及部署关联等场景，提供有据可依的分项说明，并支持仪表板深度链接。

description: Set up Convex backups and run a restore DRILL that proves recovery — snapshot, restore into a throwaway preview, assert the data came back — plus a schedule matched to your RPO and a gated recovery runbook.
description_zh: 配置 Convex 备份并运行恢复演练（DRILL），以验证恢复能力——创建快照，将其恢复到临时预览环境，并确认数据已恢复；同时制定与您的 RPO 相匹配的恢复计划，并准备受控的恢复操作手册。

description: Preview Convex spend — rank functions by bytes/documents-read × call-volume from insights, project each cost driver's growth curve, name the cheapest fix; confirm-cost for paid actions.
description_zh: 预览 Convex 支出——基于洞察数据，按"字节/文档读取数 × 调用量"对函数进行排名，推算各成本驱动因素的增长曲线，找出成本最低的修复方案；对付费操作确认费用。

description: Explain an existing Convex app — data model + relationships, public vs internal functions, auth/ownership model, components, a request→data flow — read from the schema and function surface. Read-only.
description_zh: 解释一个现有的 Convex 应用——涵盖数据模型与关系、公开函数与内部函数、认证与所有权模型、组件，以及请求到数据的流转流程——须基于 Schema 与函数接口表面进行只读分析。仅限只读。

description: Run every Convex audit (authz, reviewer, advisor, insights) into one scored, deduped readiness report with an ordered fix plan — Lighthouse for your backend.
description_zh: 运行所有 Convex 审计（authz，reviewer，advisor，insights），转化为一份含有序修复计划的计分、去重后的就绪报告——为您的后端提供 Lighthouse。

description: Point a domain you already own at your Convex app (DNS records, custom-domain attach, auth-origin rebind).
description_zh: 将您已拥有的域名指向您的 Convex 应用（通过 DNS 记录、自定义域名绑定、认证来源重新绑定）。

description: Generate convex-test tests for the app's Convex functions.
description_zh: 为应用的 Convex 函数生成 convex-test 测试。

description: Add Stripe billing/payments to the Convex app via @convex-dev/stripe (checkout + webhook + gating).
description_zh: 通过 @convex-dev/stripe 为 Convex 应用添加 Stripe 计费/支付功能（结账 + Webhook + 门控）。

description: Watch for the next dev/prod error or request in a Convex app and react to it.
description_zh: 留意 Convex 应用中下一个开发/生产环境的错误或请求，并对此做出响应。

description: Send this coding session's transcript to the Convex team for an AI post-mortem that improves the quickstart system.
description_zh: 将本次编码会话的记录发送给 Convex 团队，以便进行 AI 事后分析，改进快速入门系统。

description: Seed or import data into the Convex database.
description_zh: 向 Convex 数据库导入种子数据或导入数据。

description: Prove a Convex feature works — seed, drive as multiple mocked users via convex-test, assert behavior including the negative authz cases (wrong user refused, data-scope enforced).
description_zh: 验证 Convex 功能可用：准备种子数据，通过 convex-test 以多个模拟用户身份驱动，并验证行为，包括负向授权（authz）用例（错误用户被拒绝、数据范围强制执行）。

description: Suggest the matching Convex component when the user hand-rolls a pattern it already solves (crons, sharded-counter, rate-limiter, storage, search, presence, workflow, RAG, prosemirror-sync). Passive — suggest after the task, never interrupt. Never install without consent.
description_zh: 当用户手工实现一种可被其解决的模式（crons、sharded-counter、rate-limiter、storage、search、presence、workflow、RAG、prosemirror-sync）时，建议匹配的 Convex 组件。被动——任务完成后建议，绝不中断。未经同意切勿安装。

description: Production error → triaged, root-caused, repaired, and certified (tsc + rehearsal + reproduce-then-gone) fix PR for a human to merge — then confirm the error stops recurring. Never auto-merges.
description_zh: 生产错误 → 分级排查、根因定位、修复并验证认证（tsc + 演练 + 复现后消失），提交需人工合并的修复PR —— 随后确认该错误不再复现。严禁自动合并。

description: Set up Sentinel production error capture in your own Convex deployment.
description_zh: 在您自己的 Convex 部署中设置 Sentinel 生产环境错误捕获。

description: MUST be used for Vue.js tasks. Strongly recommends Composition API with `<script setup>` and TypeScript as the standard approach. Covers Vue 3, SSR, Volar, vue-tsc. Load for any Vue, .vue files, Vue Router, Pinia, or Vite with Vue work. ALWAYS use Composition API unless the project explicitly requires Options API.
description_zh: 必须用于 Vue.js 任务。强烈推荐以 Composition API、`<!script setup>` 和 TypeScript 作为标准方案。覆盖 Vue 3、SSR、Volar、vue-tsc。适用于任何 Vue、.vue 文件、Vue Router、Pinia 或基于 Vue 的 Vite 工作。始终使用 Composition API，除非项目明确要求使用 Options API。

description: When the user wants to run influencer, creator, or ambassador partnerships to promote their product — finding and vetting partners, structuring deals, briefing creators, disclosure compliance, and measuring ROI. Also use when the user mentions 'influencer marketing,' 'creator partnerships,' 'sponsorships,' 'YouTube sponsorships,' 'podcast sponsorships,' 'brand ambassador,' 'ambassador program,' 'creator program,' 'UGC creators,' 'tech UGC,' 'UGC creator program,' 'creator network,' 'B2B influencers,' 'thought leader ads,' 'gifting,' 'product seeding,' 'whitelisting creator content,' 'how much to pay an influencer,' or 'FTC disclosure.' For affiliate/referral payout mechanics, see referrals. For community-led advocacy, see community-marketing. For turning creator content into paid ads, see ad-creative.
description_zh: 当用户希望开展网红、创作者或大使合作以推广其产品时——需涵盖寻找并筛选合作伙伴、制定合作方案、向创作者进行简报、确保信息披露合规，以及衡量投资回报率。当用户提及“网红营销”、“创作者合作”、“赞助”、“YouTube 赞助”、“播客赞助”、“品牌大使”、“大使计划”、“创作者计划”、“UGC 创作者”、“技术 UGC”、“UGC 创作者计划”、“创作者网络”、“B2B 网红”、“思想领袖广告”、“赠礼”、“产品种草”、“白名单创作者内容”、“向网红支付多少费用”或“FTC 信息披露”时，也应使用。关于联盟/推荐返款机制，请参阅 referrals 部分。关于社区主导的倡导，请参阅社区营销部分。关于将创作者内容转化为付费广告，请参阅广告创意部分。

description: Generate high-quality Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) for software systems and AI-powered features. Includes executive summaries, user stories, technical specifications, and risk analysis.
description_zh: 生成面向软件系统与AI驱动功能的高质量产品需求文档（PRDs）。内容包含执行摘要、用户故事、技术规范及风险评估。

description: Router for the gstack skill suite. (gstack)
description_zh: gstack 技能套件的路由。(gstack)

description: When the user wants to figure out which marketing actually drives conversions and revenue, choose or interpret an attribution model, or reconcile conflicting numbers across tools. Also use when the user mentions "attribution," "attribution model," "first-touch vs last-touch," "multi-touch," "which channel drives revenue," "what's my real CAC," "my dashboards disagree," "Google/Meta says X but GA says Y," "media mix model," "MMM," "incrementality," "geo lift," "holdout test," "how did you hear about us," "self-reported attribution," "dark social," or wants to instrument attribution themselves — "stitch my bookings to their source," "SavvyCal/Calendly attribution," "close the identify gap," "track conversions on a third-party domain," "first-party / self-hosted attribution." For event tracking setup and UTMs, see analytics. For ad-platform pixels/CAPI, see ads. For pipeline and CRM revenue reporting, see revops. For the AI-search attribution blind spot, see ai-seo.
description_zh: 当用户想要弄清楚究竟是哪种营销方式真正驱动转化与收入，就需要选择或解读一种归因模型，或者协调不同工具间相互冲突的数据。当用户提到“归因”“归因模型”“首触与末触”“多触点”“哪种渠道驱动收入”“我的真实获客成本”“我的仪表板数据不一致”“Google/Meta 说 X 但 GA 说 Y”“媒介组合模型”“MMM”“增量效果”“地域提升”“留存测试”“我是如何了解到我们的”“自报归因”“暗社交”，或想要自行配置归因，此时也应使用——“将我的预订数据与其来源对接”“SavvyCal/Calendly 归因”“弥合识别差距”“在第三方域名上追踪转化”“第一方/自建归因”等方法。关于事件追踪设置与 UTM，请参阅分析相关章节；关于广告平台像素/CAPI，请参阅广告相关章节；关于管道与 CRM 的收入报告，请参阅营收运营相关章节；关于 AI 搜索的归因盲区，请参阅 ai-seo。

description: Audit and fix animation performance issues including layout thrashing, compositor properties, scroll-linked motion, and blur effects. Use when animations stutter, transitions jank, or reviewing CSS/JS animation performance.
description_zh: 审计并修复动画性能问题，包括布局抖动、合成器属性、滚动关联运动以及模糊效果。当动画卡顿、过渡不流畅，或审查 CSS/JS 动画性能时使用。

description: Quick-reference card for all ponytail modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /ponytail-help, "ponytail help", "what ponytail commands", "how do I use ponytail".
description_zh: 快速参考卡：所有ponytail模式、技能和命令。一次性显示，而非持久模式。触发：/ponytail-help、"ponytail帮助"、"ponytail命令是什么"、"如何使用ponytail"。

description: 从 75 个经过验证的小红书标题公式中选择并生成合适标题。用户要求起小红书标题、改标题或选择标题公式时使用。
description_zh: 从 75 个经过验证的小红书标题公式中选择并生成合适的标题。用户在要求起小红书标题、修改标题或选择标题公式时使用。

description: Nuxt full-stack Vue framework with SSR, auto-imports, and file-based routing. Use when working with Nuxt apps, server routes, useFetch, middleware, or hybrid rendering.
description_zh: Nuxt 是具备服务端渲染（SSR）、自动导入和文件路由的全栈 Vue 框架。适用于 Nuxt 应用、服务端路由、useFetch、中间件或混合渲染等工作场景。

description: Harvest every `ponytail:` comment in the codebase into a debt ledger, so the deliberate shortcuts and deferrals ponytail leaves behind get tracked instead of rotting into "later means never". Use when the user says "ponytail debt", "/ponytail-debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", "ponytail ledger", or "what did we mark to do later". One-shot report, changes nothing.
description_zh: 将代码库中每一个 `ponytail:` 注释都录入债务账本，让 ponytail 留下的刻意快捷操作和延期事项得到追踪，而不是逐渐腐烂成“以后再说就永远不会”。当用户说“ponytail debt”、“/ponytail-debt”、“ponytail 延迟了什么”、“列出快捷操作”、“ponytail 账本”，或“我们标记为稍后处理的事项是什么”时使用。一次性报告，不改变任何内容。

description: Framework (OSS). Build native UI with the @expo/ui package: real SwiftUI on iOS and Jetpack Compose on Android. Default to @expo/ui for sheets (BottomSheet), pickers, sliders, toggles, menus, and grouped-form sections — do NOT reach for Reanimated, @gorhom/bottom-sheet, or RN built-in Picker/Switch; use @expo/ui instead. Fall back to RN built-ins only when @expo/ui is missing the component. NOTE: @expo/ui List renders native grouped rows like an iOS Settings screen — it is NOT a virtualized list; use FlatList/FlashList for large datasets. Covers universal components (Host, Column, Row, Button, Text, List, BottomSheet, FieldGroup, Switch, Slider, Picker, Menu), drop-in replacements for RN community libraries, and platform-specific SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose trees. Not for Expo Router navigation, Reanimated, or data fetching.
description_zh: 框架（OSS）。使用 @expo/ui 包构建原生 UI：iOS 端使用原生 SwiftUI，Android 端使用 Jetpack Compose。默认使用 @expo/ui 实现页面（BottomSheet）、选择器、滑块、开关、菜单以及分组表单区域——切勿使用 Reanimated、@gorhom/bottom-sheet 或 React Native 内置的 Picker/Switch，应改用 @expo/ui。当 @expo/ui 缺少对应组件时，仅回退使用 React Native 内置组件。注意：@expo/ui 的 List 会以类似 iOS 设置页面的原生分组行进行渲染——它并非虚拟列表，处理大数据集时应使用 FlatList/FlashList。涵盖通用组件（Host, Column, Row, Button, Text, List, BottomSheet, FieldGroup, Switch, Slider, Picker, Menu）、React Native 社区库的直接替换方案，以及平台特定的 SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose 组件树。不适用于 Expo Router 导航、Reanimated 及数据获取。

description:
Search tool for modern web development best practices. MANDATORY: Execute FIRST for all HTML/CSS and clientside JS tasks. Do NOT skip — web APIs evolve rapidly and training weights contain obsolete patterns.

Trigger immediately for:
- UI/Layout: Modals, dialogs, popovers, Glassmorphism/backdrop-filters, anchor positioning, container queries, `:has()`, `:user-valid`.
- Scroll/Motion: View Transitions, Scroll-driven animations, scroll parallax/reveals.
- Performance: CWV (LCP, INP), content-visibility, Fetch Priority, image optimization.
- System/APIs: Local filesystem access, WebUSB, WebSockets sync, WebAssembly widgets.
- Frameworks: Adapting layout/styles in React, Vue, Angular.
- General Frontend: Forms, autofill, advanced inputs, custom scrollbars, modern component states, etc.

DO NOT trigger for:
- Backend: Database SQL, ORMs, Express API routes.
- Pipelines: CI/CD deployment, Docker, Actions.
- Generic: Local scripts (Python/Go tools), ESLint, Git.
description_zh:
现代Web开发最佳实践搜索工具。强制要求：针对所有HTML/CSS和客户端JS任务，必须优先执行。切勿跳过——Web API发展迅速，训练权重中包含过时模式。

立即触发以下内容：
- UI/布局：模态框、对话框、弹出层、毛玻璃效果/背景模糊、锚点定位、容器查询、`:has()`、`:user-valid`。
- 滚动/动效：视图过渡、滚动驱动动画、滚动视差/揭示效果。
- 性能：CWV（LCP、INP）、content-visibility、Fetch优先级、图片优化。
- 系统/API：本地文件系统访问、WebUSB、WebSockets同步、WebAssembly组件。
- 框架：在React、Vue、Angular中调整布局/样式。
- 前端通用：表单、自动填充、高级输入、自定义滚动条、现代组件状态等。

切勿触发以下内容：
- 后端：数据库SQL、ORM、Express API路由。
- 流水线：CI/CD部署、Docker、Actions。
- 通用：本地脚本（Python/Go工具）、ESLint、Git。

description: Master end-to-end testing with Playwright and Cypress to build reliable test suites that catch bugs, improve confidence, and enable fast deployment. Use when implementing E2E tests, debugging flaky tests, or establishing testing standards.
description_zh: 掌握使用 Playwright 和 Cypress 进行端到端测试，构建可靠测试套件，以发现缺陷、提升信心并实现快速部署。适用于实施端到端测试、调试不稳定测试或建立测试标准。

description: Master Material Design 3 and Jetpack Compose patterns for building native Android apps. Use when designing Android interfaces, implementing Compose UI, or following Google's Material Design guidelines.

description: Find the papers that answer a research query in Firecrawl's research paper index — a corpus of paper abstracts whose largest share is biomedical and life-science literature (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv), alongside arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math — using semantic search, semantic and structural expansion, and in-body verification. Use this skill for literature-finding and paper-retrieval tasks of any kind, including clinical, biomedical, drug, gene, disease, and other life-science questions, whether the answer is a single paper or a full multi-paper set. The index is reached only through the `firecrawl_research_*` MCP tools or the `firecrawl research` CLI subcommands. Calling `firecrawl_search` with its `categories` option set to `["research"]` is a different feature — it filters ordinary web search to research-affiliated websites (the list includes PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, and publisher sites) and returns page results from them, without querying the paper records in this index.
description_zh: 在 Firecrawl 的研究论文索引中查找能够回答研究问题的论文——该索引是一个论文摘要语料库，其中最大比例为生物医学和生命科学文献（PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv），同时包含 CS、物理和数学领域的 arXiv 预印本——该索引使用语义搜索、语义与结构扩展以及文中验证功能实现。请使用此技能执行任何类型的文献查找和论文检索任务，包括临床、生物医学、药物、基因、疾病及其他生命科学问题，无论答案为单篇论文还是完整的多篇论文集。该索引仅可通过 `firecrawl_research_*` MCP工具或 `firecrawl research` CLI子命令访问。使用 `categories` 选项设置为 `["research"]` 的 `firecrawl_search` 是另一项功能——它将普通网络搜索过滤为与研究领域相关的网站（列表包括 PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv、arXiv 及出版商网站），并返回这些网站上的页面结果，不会查询本索引中的论文记录。

description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that calls OpenAI (ChatGPT, GPT-4o, an LLM, a chatbot, embeddings). The ONLY supported path is the `openai-client` mops package with a canister-side API-key bearer. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` to `api.openai.com/v1/...` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it leaks the bearer across replicated outcalls (security + 13× billing impact), bypasses the typed request/response bindings, and forces hand-rolled JSON on a language with poor JSON support. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions ChatGPT, GPT (any version), OpenAI, an LLM, a chatbot, or embeddings — and BEFORE writing any code that touches `api.openai.com`.
description_zh: 对于任何调用 OpenAI（ChatGPT、GPT-4o、大型语言模型（LLM）、聊天机器人（chatbot）、嵌入（embeddings））的含 `Caffeine` 构建，必须采用以下强制方案。唯一支持的路径是使用 `openai-client` mops 封装包，并采用网舟端（canister）侧的 API 密钥 Bearer 令牌。手动实现 `ic.http_request` 并直接调用 `api.openai.com/v1/...` 属于被禁止的违规反模式——它会将 Bearer 令牌泄露到跨副本（复制）调用过程中（带来安全风险及 13 倍的计费影响），绕过类型化的请求/响应绑定，并在 JSON 支持较差的语言中强制手工编写 JSON。每当用户、规范或任何先前任务提及 ChatGPT、GPT（任意版本）、OpenAI、大型语言模型（LLM）、聊天机器人或嵌入时，请加载此技能——且在编写任何涉及 `api.openai.com` 的代码之前。

description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that posts to X (Twitter). The ONLY supported path is the `x-client` mops package with OAuth 2.0 PKCE. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` or `icBooking.http_request` calls to `api.x.com/2/tweets`, `api.x.com/2/oauth2/token`, or any other X endpoint is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses bearer auth, replication-cost safeguards, and `x-client`'s null-field handling. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions tweeting, live-tweeting, posting-to-X, posting-a-status, sharing-to-Twitter, or any equivalent phrasing — and BEFORE writing any code that touches `api.x.com`.
description_zh: 对于所有发布到 X (Twitter) 的 Caffeine 构建，必须遵循强制性方案。唯一支持的途径是使用带有 OAuth 2.0 PKCE 的 `x-client` mops 包。自行实现 `ic.http_request` 或 `icBooking.http_request` 对 `api.x.com/2/tweets`、`api.x.com/2/oauth2/token` 或其他任何 X 端点的调用，属于被禁止的反模式——这会绕过 Bearer 认证、复制成本防护措施，以及 `x-client` 的 null 字段处理。当用户、规范或任何先前任务中提及发推、直播发推、发布到 X、发布状态、分享到 Twitter，或任何等效表述时，请加载此技能——并且在编写任何访问 `api.x.com` 的代码之前。

description: Render videos from React/Remotion component code via inference.sh. Pass TSX code, get MP4. Supports all Remotion APIs: useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, AbsoluteFill, Sequence. Configurable resolution, FPS, duration, codec. Use for: programmatic video generation, animated graphics, motion design, data-driven videos, React animations to video. Triggers: remotion, render video from code, tsx to video, react video, programmatic video, remotion render, code to video, animated video, motion graphics code, react animation video
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh 从 React/Remotion 组件代码渲染视频。传入 TSX 代码，即可获取 MP4。

支持全部 Remotion API：useCurrentFrame、useVideoConfig、spring、interpolate、AbsoluteFill、Sequence。可配置分辨率、帧率、时长和编码格式。

适用于：编程式视频生成、动态图形、动态设计、数据驱动视频、React 动画转视频。

触发词：remotion、从代码渲染视频、tsx 转视频、react video、programmatic video、remotion render、代码转视频、动态视频、动态图形代码、react 动画视频

description: Web search and content extraction with Tavily and Exa via inference.sh CLI. Apps: Tavily Search, Tavily Extract, Exa Search, Exa Answer, Exa Extract. Capabilities: AI-powered search, content extraction, direct answers, research. Use for: research, RAG pipelines, fact-checking, content aggregation, agents. Triggers: web search, tavily, exa, search api, content extraction, research, internet search, ai search, search assistant, web scraping, rag, perplexity alternative
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 Tavily 和 Exa 进行网络搜索与内容提取。应用：Tavily Search、Tavily Extract、Exa Search、Exa Answer、Exa Extract。功能：AI 驱动的搜索、内容提取、直接回答、研究。用途：研究、RAG 流水线、事实核查、内容聚合、智能体。触发条件：网络搜索、tavily、exa、search api、内容提取、研究、互联网搜索、ai search、搜索助手、网络爬取、rag、Perplexity 的替代方案

description: Execute Python code in a safe sandboxed environment via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh). Pre-installed: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, MoviePy, Pillow, OpenCV, trimesh, and 100+ more libraries. Use for: data processing, web scraping, image manipulation, video creation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, automation scripts. Triggers: python, execute code, run script, web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, 3D models, automation, pandas, matplotlib
description_zh: 通过 [inference.sh](https://inference.sh) 在安全的沙盒环境中执行 Python 代码。预安装：NumPy、Pandas、Matplotlib、requests、BeautifulSoup、Selenium、Playwright、MoviePy、Pillow、OpenCV、trimesh 及 100 余个其他库。用途：数据处理、网页抓取、图像处理、视频制作、3D 模型处理、PDF 生成、API 调用、自动化脚本。触发关键词：python、execute code、run script、web scraping、data analysis、image processing、video editing、3D models、automation、pandas、matplotlib

description: Master ES6+ features including async/await, destructuring, spread operators, arrow functions, promises, modules, iterators, generators, and functional programming patterns for writing clean, efficient JavaScript code. Use when refactoring legacy code, implementing modern patterns, or optimizing JavaScript applications.
description_zh: 精通 ES6+ 特性，包括 async/await、解构赋值、展开运算符、箭头函数、Promise、模块、迭代器、生成器及函数式编程模式，以编写清晰、高效的 JavaScript 代码。适用于重构遗留代码、实现现代模式或优化 JavaScript 应用。

description: Find the cheapest hotel deal by comparing live prices across Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel for any city worldwide and any travel dates — one command returns ranked best-value, cheapest, and quality picks with direct booking links, all normalized to USD. Use whenever someone asks for hotel prices, hotel deals, the cheapest room or rate, best hotel rates, a hotel price comparison, or which OTA is cheaper — e.g. 'is Booking or Agoda cheaper for Tokyo', 'find me a hotel in Bangkok under $100', 'compare hotel prices for 12–15 Aug', 'cheapest hotel near Shinjuku'.
description_zh: 通过比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Google Hotels 和 OpenTravel 的实时价格，可查找全球任何城市、任何出行日期的最便宜酒店优惠。一条指令即可返回按性价比、最低价和质量排序的精选酒店，并提供直接预订链接，所有价格均统一为美元（USD）。每当有人询问酒店价格、酒店优惠、最便宜的房间或价格、最佳酒店价格、酒店价格对比，或哪家在线旅行社（OTA）更便宜时，即可使用。例如：“东京的 Booking 和 Agoda 哪个更便宜？”、“在曼谷找到 100 美元以下的酒店”、“对比 8月12日至15日的酒店价格”、“查找新宿附近最便宜的酒店”。

description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
description_zh: 审查 UI 代码是否符合 Web 界面指南。当被要求“审查我的 UI”、“检查可访问性”、“审计设计”、“审查 UX”或“检查我的网站是否符合最佳实践”时使用。

description: 识别关键环节中的贪快与必要摩擦，寻找能长期积累资产的方法。用户担心推进过快、反复返工或希望设计长期复利路径时使用。
description_zh: 识别关键环节中的急功近利与必要阻力，寻找能够长期积累资产的方法。用户担心推进过快、反复返工，或希望设计长期复利路径时使用。

description: 把模糊问题改写成 Agent 可推理、可批评、可验证的问题说明书，并判断自动化解决程度。用户要求把问题说清、生成好问题或评估 Agent 可解性时使用。
description_zh: 将模糊问题改写成 Agent 可推理、可批评、可验证的问题说明书，并判断自动化解决程度。在用户要求将问题说清楚、生成高质量问题或评估 Agent 可解性时使用。

description: Conduct comprehensive AI-powered research with citations via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user wants deep research, a detailed report, a comparison, market analysis, literature review, or says "research", "investigate", "analyze in depth", "compare X vs Y", "what does the market look like for", or needs multi-source synthesis with explicit citations. Returns a structured report grounded in web sources. Takes 30-120 seconds. For quick fact-finding, use tavily-search instead.
description_zh: 使用 Tavily CLI 进行全面的 AI 驱动的带引用的研究。当用户需要深度研究、详细报告、对比分析、市场分析、文献综述，或提到"研究"（research）、"调查"（investigate）、"深度分析"（analyze in depth）、"对比X与Y"（compare X vs Y）、询问"市场情况如何"（what does the market look like for），或需要多来源综合并明确引用时，使用此技能。该技能将基于网络来源生成结构化报告。耗时30-120秒。如需快速查找事实信息，请改用 tavily-search。

description: Helps with grouping, alignment, reading order, progressive disclosure and other details that make a good layout.
description_zh: 有助于分组、对齐、阅读顺序、渐进式披露以及其他能够形成良好布局的细节。

description: Delegate noisy investigation to one or more subagents so the orchestrator's context stays clean, then work from the distilled answer. Use this skill whenever answering a question would require reading many files, long logs, large diffs, or wide codebase surveys — i.e. when producing the answer generates far more noise than the answer itself. Use it for "how does X work", "where is Y used", "what's the root cause of Z", "summarize this PR/log" style questions, and reach for it liberally before reading a pile of files inline.
description_zh: 将嘈杂的调查工作委托给一个或多个子代理，以便编排器的上下文保持干净，随后基于提炼后的答案开展工作。当回答某个问题需要读取大量文件、长日志、大 diff 或进行全面的代码库调研时，请使用此技能——即产生答案的噪声远大于答案本身。对于"X 是如何运作的"、"Y 在哪里被使用"、"Z 的根本原因是什么"、"总结这个 PR/日志"这类问题，请积极使用此技能，并在内联阅读大量文件之前先广泛运用它。

description: Run a second round on a contested question by circulating each subagent's independent proposal to the other authors and asking for structured pros and cons, then synthesize. Use this skill whenever you have multiple independent proposals or opinions on a contested decision — architecture tradeoffs, code review disagreements, design choices, competing root-cause theories — and want sharper analysis than you'd produce by synthesizing alone. Pairs naturally with the council and research skills; reach for it liberally whenever proposals diverge.
description_zh: 针对有争议的问题，进行第二轮讨论：将各子代理的独立方案分发传阅给其他作者，并征求结构化的优缺点分析，随后进行综合整合。当您需要就一个有争议的决定存在多个独立的提议或意见——例如架构权衡、代码评审分歧、设计选择、相互竞争的根因理论——且期望获得比单独综合时更为敏锐的分析时，请使用此技能。此技能与委员会技能及研究工作技能自然协同配合，当提议出现分歧时，应灵活运用。

description: Use when working with the Resend email API — sending transactional emails (single or batch), receiving inbound emails via webhooks, managing email templates, tracking delivery events, managing domains, contacts, broadcasts, webhooks, API keys, automations, events, viewing API request logs, or setting up the Resend SDK. Always use this skill when the user mentions Resend, even for simple tasks like "send an email with Resend" — the skill contains critical gotchas (idempotency keys, webhook verification, template variable syntax) that prevent common production issues.
description_zh: 用于在配合 Resent 邮件 API 进行工作时使用——包括发送事务性邮件（单条或批量）、通过 Webhooks 接收收件邮件、管理邮件模板、追踪投递事件、管理域名、联系信息、广播、Webhooks、API 密钥、自动化流程、事件、查看 API 请求日志，或配置 Resent SDK。当用户提及 Resent 时，无论任务是否简单（例如“使用 Resend 发送邮件”），都始终调用本技能——因为本技能包含防止常见生产环境问题的关键易错点（幂等性密钥、Webhook 验证、模板变量语法）。

description: Build AI chat interfaces using ai-elements components — conversations, messages, tool displays, prompt inputs, and more. Use when the user wants to build a chatbot, AI assistant UI, or any AI-powered chat interface.
description_zh: 使用 ai-elements 组件构建 AI 聊天界面——对话、消息、工具显示、提示输入，以及更多。当用户想要构建聊天机器人、AI 助手 UI 或任何 AI 驱动的聊天界面时使用。

description: Implement modern responsive layouts using container queries, fluid typography, CSS Grid, and mobile-first breakpoint strategies. Use when building adaptive interfaces, implementing fluid layouts, or creating component-level responsive behavior.
description_zh: 使用容器查询、流式排版、CSS Grid 和移动优先断点策略，实现现代响应式布局。适用于构建自适应界面、实现流式布局，或创建组件级响应式行为。

description: Implement comprehensive testing strategies using Jest, Vitest, and Testing Library for unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end testing with mocking, fixtures, and test-driven development. Use when writing JavaScript/TypeScript tests, setting up test infrastructure, or implementing TDD/BDD workflows.
description_zh: 使用 Jest、Vitest 和 Testing Library 实施全面测试策略，支持单元测试、集成测试和端到端测试，并运用模拟、测试数据（fixtures）及测试驱动开发方法。适用于编写 JavaScript/TypeScript 测试、搭建测试基础设施或实施 TDD/BDD 工作流程。

description: Use when an agent needs to drive a real Chrome window via opencli — inspect a page, fill forms, click through logged-in flows, or extract data ad-hoc. Covers the selector-first target contract, compound form fields, stale-ref handling, network capture, and the agent-native envelopes the CLI returns. Not for writing adapters — see opencli-adapter-author for that.
description_zh: 当代理需要通过 opencli 驱动真实的 Chrome 窗口时使用——检查页面、填写表单、点击完成登录流程或临时提取数据。涵盖以选择器为核心的目标契约、复合表单字段、失效引用处理、网络捕获，以及 CLI 返回的代理原生封装结构。不用于编写适配器，相关内容请参阅 opencli-adapter-author。

description: Official Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) v2.1 skill for applying the methodology to frontend projects. Use when the task involves organizing project structure with FSD layers, deciding where code belongs, placing static assets (images, icons, fonts, PDFs), grouping closely related slices, defining public APIs and import boundaries, resolving cross-imports or evaluating the @x pattern, deciding whether to create or remove an entity, evaluating whether the entities layer is needed at all, deciding where page layouts belong or whether to use the widgets layer (discouraged), deciding whether logic should remain local or be extracted, migrating from FSD v2.0 or a non-FSD codebase, integrating FSD with frameworks (Next.js App Router and Pages Router, React Router, Nuxt, Vite, Astro), or implementing common patterns such as authentication, API handling, Redux, and TanStack Query (React Query) within FSD.
description_zh: 用于将该方法论应用于前端项目的官方特性切片设计（FSD）v2.1 技能。当任务涉及使用 FSD 层来组织项目结构、确定代码归属位置、放置静态资源（图像、图标、字体、PDF）、将密切相关的切片分组、定义公共 API 与导入边界、解决跨导入或评估 @x 模式、决定创建或移除实体、评估实体层是否完全需要、确定页面布局归属位置，或是否使用 widgets 层（不建议使用）、决定逻辑应保持在本地还是提取出来、从 FSD v2.0 或非 FSD 代码库迁移、将 FSD 与框架集成（Next.js App Router 和 Pages Router、React Router、Nuxt、Vite、Astro），或在 FSD 中实现常见模式，如身份验证、API 处理、Redux 以及 TanStack Query（React Query）时，应使用本技能。

description: Vue Router 4 patterns, navigation guards, route params, and route-component lifecycle interactions.
description_zh: Vue Router 4 路由模式、导航守卫、路由参数，以及路由组件生命周期交互。

description: Audit and fix HTML accessibility issues including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, color contrast, and form errors. Use when adding interactive controls, forms, dialogs, or reviewing WCAG compliance.
description_zh: 审计并修复HTML无障碍问题，包括ARIA标签、键盘导航、焦点管理、颜色对比度和表单错误。适用于添加交互控件、表单、对话框，或审查WCAG合规性时使用。

description: Set up and connect to an Android emulator using argent MCP tools. Use when starting a new session on Android, booting an emulator, getting a device serial, or before any UI interaction task.
description_zh: 使用 argent MCP 工具设置并连接 Android 模拟器。用于在 Android 上启动新会话、启动模拟器、获取设备序列号，或任何 UI 交互任务之前使用。

description: Combines all of the `better-*` skills into a single review across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI polish.
description_zh: 将所有的 `better-*` 技能整合为一次综合评审，涵盖无障碍、布局、写作、排版、颜色和 UI 精修。

description: Master Rust async programming with Tokio, async traits, error handling, and concurrent patterns. Use when building async Rust applications, implementing concurrent systems, or debugging async code.
description_zh: 精通 Rust 异步编程，掌握 Tokio、异步 trait、错误处理与并发模式。适用于构建异步 Rust 应用、实现并发系统或调试异步代码。

description: Optimizes a React Native app by profiling first to find real bottlenecks, then sweeping for mechanical issues. Entry-point for all performance work. Use when the app feels slow, user asks to optimize, fix re-renders, reduce jank, or improve startup. Delegates to argent-react-native-profiler for measurement.
description_zh: 对 React Native 应用进行优化：先进行性能剖析以定位真实瓶颈，再排查机械性问题。作为所有性能工作的入口点。当应用运行卡顿、用户要求优化、修复重新渲染、降低卡顿或改善启动速度时使用。测量工作委托给 argent-react-native-profiler 执行。

description: Set up and connect to an iOS simulator using argent MCP tools. Use when starting a new session, booting an iOS simulator, getting an iOS UDID, or before any iOS simulator interaction task.
description_zh: 使用argent MCP工具设置并连接iOS模拟器。用于启动新会话、启动iOS模拟器、获取iOS UDID，或在进行任何iOS模拟器交互任务之前。

description: Step-by-step workflows for developing or debugging React Native apps on iOS simulator or Android emulator. Use when starting the app, debugging Metro, fixing builds, diagnosing runtime errors, or running tests.
description_zh: 用于在 iOS 模拟器或 Android 模拟器上开发或调试 React Native 应用的逐步工作流程。当启动应用、调试 Metro、修复构建、诊断运行时错误或运行测试时使用。

description: 把需要长期跟踪的业务、关系、健康、职业、学习或投资问题建成本地决策知识工程。用户要求决策立案、结果回填、状态画像或长期复盘时使用。
description_zh: 把需要长期跟踪的业务、关系、健康、职业、学习或投资问题建成本地决策知识工程。用户要求决策立案、结果回填、状态画像或长期复盘时使用。

description: Interact with an iOS simulator, Android emulator, or Chromium (CDP) app using argent MCP tools. Use when tapping UI elements, performing gestures, scrolling/swiping, typing text, pressing hardware buttons, launching apps, opening URLs, taking screenshots, waiting for an element to appear or disappear, or checking visible app state after interactions. Not for TV targets.
description_zh: 使用 argent MCP 工具与 iOS 模拟器、Android 模拟器或 Chromium（CDP）应用进行交互。适用于点击 UI 元素、执行手势、滚动/滑动、输入文本、按下硬件按钮、启动应用、打开网址、截取屏幕截图、等待元素出现或消失，以及交互后检查应用的可见状态。不适用于电视目标。

description: Profile a React Native Hermes app to measure re-render and CPU performance using argent profiler tools. Use when optimizing for performance, measuring before/after a fix, spotting slow components, diagnosing re-renders, checking CPU hotspots, or producing a ranked issue report.
description_zh: 使用 argent profiler 工具分析 React Native Hermes 应用，以测量重渲染与 CPU 性能。适用于性能优化、修复前后性能测量、识别慢速组件、诊断重渲染、检查 CPU 热点，或生成按优先级排序的问题报告。

description: Turn complex or visual agent responses into rich, reviewable HTML artifacts the user can annotate and send feedback on, using the lavish-axi CLI. Use when about to give a plan, comparison, diagram, table, code diff, report, or anything easier to grasp visually than as prose.
description_zh: 使用 lavish-axi CLI，将复杂或视觉化的智能体回复转化为富媒体、可审阅的 HTML 产物，用户可对产物进行标注并发送反馈。适用于即将提供方案、对比、图表、表格、代码差异、报告，或以视觉方式比以文字更易理解的任何内容。

description: Autonomously test an app UI (iOS or Android) by running interact-screenshot-verify loops using argent MCP tools. Use when testing UI flows, verifying login works, testing navigation, running end-to-end UI test scenarios, manual QA steps, visible UI changes, or visual behavior.
description_zh: 使用argent MCP工具，通过运行交互-截图-验证循环，自主测试应用界面（iOS或Android）。在测试界面流程、验证登录功能、测试导航、运行端到端界面测试场景、手动执行QA步骤、处理可见的界面变更或视觉表现时使用。

description: Helps your project comply with accessibility standards and best practices.
description_zh: 有助于您的项目符合无障碍标准与最佳实践。

description: Debug a JS runtime via CDP using argent debugger tools. Primary path is React Native via Metro (iOS / Android / Vega); a subset of the tools (debugger-connect, debugger-status, debugger-evaluate, debugger-log-registry) also drive a Chromium (CDP) app's renderer (an Electron app, or any Chromium browser exposing CDP) through the same surface. Use when connecting to the runtime, inspecting React components, reading console logs, or evaluating JavaScript.
description_zh: 使用 argent 调试器工具通过 CDP 调试 JavaScript 运行时。主要路径是通过 Metro 调试 React Native（iOS / Android / Vega）；其中一小部分工具（debugger-connect、debugger-status、debugger-evaluate、debugger-log-registry）也可通过同一接口驱动 Chromium（CDP）应用中的渲染器（Electron 应用，或任何暴露 CDP 的 Chromium 浏览器）。适用于连接运行时、检查 React 组件、读取控制台日志或执行 JavaScript 的场景。

description: Guide for writing idiomatic Rust code based on Apollo GraphQL's best practices handbook. Use this skill when: (1) writing new Rust code or functions, (2) reviewing or refactoring existing Rust code, (3) deciding between borrowing vs cloning or ownership patterns, (4) implementing error handling with Result types, (5) optimizing Rust code for performance, (6) writing tests or documentation for Rust projects.
description_zh: 基于 Apollo GraphQL 最佳实践手册，编写地道 Rust 代码的指南。使用本技能时，适用于以下情况：(1) 编写新的 Rust 代码或函数；(2) 审查或重构现有 Rust 代码；(3) 在借用、克隆与所有权模式之间进行选择；(4) 使用 Result 类型实现错误处理；(5) 为性能优化 Rust 代码；(6) 为 Rust 项目编写测试或文档。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create an agent", "add an agent", "write a subagent", "agent frontmatter", "when to use description", "agent examples", "agent tools", "agent colors", "autonomous agent", or needs guidance on agent structure, system prompts, triggering conditions, or agent development best practices for Claude Code plugins.
description_zh: 当用户请求“创建智能体”、“添加智能体”、“编写子智能体”、“智能体frontmatter”、“何时使用描述”、“智能体示例”、“智能体工具”、“智能体颜色”、“自主智能体”，或需要针对Claude Code插件的智能体结构、系统提示词、触发条件或智能体开发最佳实践提供指导时，应使用本技能。

description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that sends email through the user's own Gmail account. The ONLY supported path is the `googlemail-client` mops package (Gmail REST API) combined with the `google-oauth` mops package (token exchange + refresh + PKCE). Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `oauth2.googleapis.com` or `gmail.googleapis.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses bearer auth, replication-cost safeguards, and the `google-oauth` library's percent-encoding and JSON parsing. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions sending email, Gmail, "notify via email", "forward results by email", or any equivalent phrasing — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a Google endpoint.
description_zh: **强制使用方案：** 任何通过用户自身 Gmail 账户发送邮件的 Caffeine 构建，均须遵循此强制方案。唯一支持的路径是 `googlemail-client` mops 包（Gmail REST API）与 `google-oauth` mops 包（令牌交换 + 刷新 + PKCE）的组合。手工实现调用 `oauth2.googleapis.com` 或 `gmail.googleapis.com` 的 `ic.http_request`，是 **被禁止的反模式** —— 它会绕过 bearer 认证、复制成本保护机制，以及 `google-oauth` 库的百分号编码与 JSON 解析。每当用户、规格说明或任何先前任务提及发送邮件、Gmail、"通过邮件通知"、"通过邮件转发结果"或任何等效表述时，**务必加载此技能** —— 且在任何编写触及 Google 端点的代码之前。

description:
Use when the user wants to publish new content to Binance Square — short text, multi-image
posts (up to 4), long-form articles with an optional cover, or videos with an auto-generated
cover frame. Trigger on direct phrasings like "post to Square", "publish to Binance Square",
"发广场", "发布到广场", and on near-miss intents where the user clearly wants to share or
publish content on Square even without naming the skill: "share this analysis on Square",
"把这篇文章发出去", "发个动态", "把这个视频上传到广场", "publish my chart to Square as an
article". Also use when the user provides media (images, video) plus a caption and asks to
push it to Square, or asks to turn a draft into a Square article. Do not use for reading,
searching, commenting, liking, editing, deleting, scheduling, or managing existing Square
posts — this skill only creates new posts.
description_zh: 当用户想要向币安广场发布新内容时使用——包括短文本、多图帖文（最多4张图片）、带可选封面的长文，或带自动生成封面图帧的视频。触发条件包括直接表述，如“post to Square”、“publish to Binance Square”、“发广场”、“发布到广场”；以及近似的意图，即用户在不提及该技能的情况下，明确想要在广场分享或发布内容：如“share this analysis on Square”、“把这篇文章发出去”、“发个动态”、“把这个视频上传到广场”、“publish my chart to Square as an article”。此外，当用户提供了图片、视频等媒体并附带说明文字，要求将其推送到广场，或要求将草稿转换为广场文章时，也应使用。不得用于阅读、搜索、评论、点赞、编辑、删除、安排或管理已有广场帖文的操作——本技能仅用于创建新帖文。

description: Run an autonomous, spec-driven development "saga" for medium-to-large features using an orchestrator agent and a fleet of worker subagents. Use this skill whenever the user invokes /saga, asks to autonomously build a sizable feature end-to-end with minimal human intervention, wants a comprehensive spec broken into milestones and tasks with airtight validation criteria before parallelized implementation, or wants an orchestrator to delegate implementation to worker agents while preserving its own context window. Also use this skill when asked to continue, resume, or pick up an existing saga from its saga directory (e.g. under ~/.sagas).

Use when building Go applications requiring concurrent programming, microservices architecture, or high-performance systems. description:
MUST USE when user wants to 调研/research/搜索/search/查/找/look up anything on the internet — e.g. 全网调研 X / 帮我调研一下 X / 查一下 X / 搜搜 X / 看看大家怎么评价 X / X 上有什么讨论 / research this topic。
Also MUST USE when user mentions any platform or shares any URL/链接: 小红书/xiaohongshu/xhs, Twitter/推特/X, B站/bilibili, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram, V2EX, LinkedIn/领英/Boss直聘/招聘/求职/jobs, YouTube, GitHub code search, 小宇宙播客, 雪球/股票行情, RSS feeds, or any web URL.
16 platforms, multi-backend routing (OpenCLI / per-platform CLIs / APIs). Zero config for 6 channels. Run `agent-reach doctor --json` to see which backend serves each platform right now.
NOT for: 写报告/数据分析/翻译等内容加工（本 skill 只负责从互联网获取内容）； 发帖/评论/点赞等写操作；已有专门 skill 的平台（先用专门 skill）。
【路由方式】SKILL.md 包含路由表和常用命令，复杂场景需按需阅读对应分类的 references/*.md。 分类：search / social (小红书/推特/B站/V2EX/Reddit/Facebook/Instagram) / career(LinkedIn/Boss直聘) / dev(github) / web(网页/文章/RSS) / video(YouTube/B站/播客) / finance(雪球/股票)。
description_zh:
当用户想要在互联网上调研/research/搜索/search/查/找/look up 任何内容时，必须使用——例如：全网调研 X / 帮我调研一下 X / 查一下 X / 搜搜 X / 看看大家怎么评价 X / X 上有什么讨论 / 研究这个主题。

当用户提及任何平台或分享任何 URL/链接时，也必须使用——例如：小红书/xiaohongshu/xhs、推特/Twitter/X、B站/bilibili、Reddit、Facebook、Instagram、V2EX、LinkedIn/领英/Boss直聘/招聘/求职/jobs、YouTube、GitHub code search、小宇宙播客、雪球/股票行情、RSS feeds，或任何网页 URL。

16 个平台，多后端路由（OpenCLI / 各平台 CLI / API）。6 个频道零配置。运行 `agent-reach doctor --json` 可查看当前每个平台由哪个后端提供服务。

不适用于：撰写报告/数据分析/翻译等内容加工（本 skill 只负责从互联网获取内容）；发布帖子/评论/点赞等写操作；已有专门 skill 的平台（先使用专门 skill）。

【路由方式】SKILL.md 包含路由表和常用命令，复杂场景需按需阅读相应分类的 references/*.md。分类：search / social（小红书/推特/B站/V2EX/Reddit/Facebook/Instagram）/ career（LinkedIn/Boss直聘）/ dev（github）/ web（网页/文章/RSS）/ video（YouTube/B站/播客）/ finance（雪球/股票）。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when your Deep Agent needs memory, persistence, or filesystem access. Covers StateBackend (ephemeral), StoreBackend (persistent), FilesystemMiddleware, and CompositeBackend for routing.
description_zh: 当您的深度智能体需要记忆、持久化或文件系统访问时，调用此技能。涵盖 StateBackend（临时性）、StoreBackend（持久性）、FilesystemMiddleware 以及用于路由的 CompositeBackend。

description: Automatically fix broken OpenCLI adapters when commands fail. Load this skill when an opencli command fails — it guides you through collecting a trace artifact, patching the adapter, retrying, and filing an upstream GitHub issue after a verified fix. Works with any AI agent.
description_zh: 当命令失败时，自动修复损坏的 OpenCLI 适配器。当 OpenCLI 命令失败时，加载此技能——它引导您收集追踪产物、修复适配器、重试，并在验证修复后提交上游 GitHub 问题。适用于任何 AI 代理。

description: 企业微信智能表格内容操作技能——专注于智能表格（smartsheet）的数据、结构与样式管理：读取表结构与记录、管理子表/字段/记录/视图/图表，以及修改行列样式（填色/高亮）；记录新增或更新遇到 851003 / no authority 时通过 Webhook 兜底写入。触发条件：用户提到智能表格、企微表格、smartsheet 的内容操作或样式修改，或链接形如 https://doc.weixin.qq.com/smartsheet/s3_xxx。企业微信表格分为「智能表格」和「在线表格」两种类型，本文档介绍的是智能表格的相关技能。智能表格包含子表（sheet）、视图（view）、字段/列（field），每条记录（record）以 `record_id` 作为主键，结构类似关系型数据库。当用户未明确说明使用「在线表格」时，一律默认使用功能更强大的智能表格（本技能）。
description_zh:
企业微信智能表格内容操作技能——专注于智能表格（smartsheet）的数据、结构与样式管理：读取表结构与记录、管理子表/字段/记录/视图/图表，以及修改行列样式（填色/高亮）；记录新增或更新遇到 851003 / no authority 时，通过 Webhook 兜底写入。

触发条件：用户提及智能表格、企微表格、smartsheet 的内容操作或样式修改，或链接形如 https://doc.weixin.qq.com/smartsheet/s3_xxx。

企业微信表格分为「智能表格」和「在线表格」两种类型，本文档介绍的是智能表格的相关技能。

智能表格包含子表（sheet）、视图（view）、字段/列（field），每条记录（record）以 `record_id` 作为主键，结构类似关系型数据库。

当用户未明确说明使用「在线表格」时，一律默认使用功能更强大的智能表格（本技能）。

description: Full OpenAI-compatible GPT Image 2 coverage across images/generations, images/edits, and responses with the image_generation tool. Use when the one-shot image helper is not enough - text-to-image, mask edits, multi-image batches, streaming, partial_images, and mixed text+image Responses flows. Reads .env and respects process environment variables; works with any OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description_zh: 全面覆盖基于 OpenAI 兼容格式的 GPT Image 2，涵盖 images/generations、images/edits 以及使用 image_generation 工具生成 responses。适用于一次性图像辅助功能不足的场景——支持文本生成图像、掩码编辑、多图像批量处理、流式传输、partial_images，以及混合文本+图像 Responses 流程。读取 .env 文件，并遵循进程环境变量；兼容任意 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description: Provides comprehensive Tailwind CSS utility-first styling patterns including responsive design, layout utilities, flexbox, grid, spacing, typography, colors, and modern CSS best practices. Use when styling React/Vue/Svelte components, building responsive layouts, implementing design systems, or optimizing CSS workflow.
description_zh: 提供全面的 Tailwind CSS 工具优先（utility-first）样式模式，包括响应式设计、布局工具、flexbox、网格、间距、排版、颜色及现代 CSS 最佳实践。适用于为 React/Vue/Svelte 组件进行样式设置，构建响应式布局，实现设计系统或优化 CSS 工作流程。

description: Prompt and workflow for generating conventional commit messages using a structured XML format. Guides users to create standardized, descriptive commit messages in line with the Conventional Commits specification, including instructions, examples, and validation.
description_zh: 生成基于结构化 XML 格式的常规提交信息的提示词与工作流。指导用户按照 Conventional Commits 规范创建标准化、描述性的提交信息，包括指令、示例和校验。

description: Manage GitHub issues locally as Markdown files. Use for triaging, searching, editing, and creating issues without leaving your editor or terminal.
description_zh: 以 Markdown 文件在本地管理 GitHub 问题。在编辑器和终端中即可完成问题的分诊、搜索、编辑与创建，无需离开编辑器或终端。

description: End-to-end analytics instrumentation workflow for a PR, branch, file, directory, or feature. Reads the code, discovers what events should be tracked, and produces a concrete instrumentation plan — all in one shot. Use this skill whenever a user wants to add analytics to a PR, asks "instrument this PR", "add tracking to this branch", "what analytics does this file need", "instrument the checkout flow", "run the full instrumentation workflow", or any request that implies going from code changes to a tracking plan. Also trigger when the user gives you a PR link, branch name, file path, or feature description and mentions analytics, events, or instrumentation. This is the main entry point for the analytics workflow — prefer it over calling the individual steps (diff-intake, discover-event-surfaces, instrument-events) separately.
description_zh:
针对 PR、分支、文件、目录或功能的端到端分析埋点工作流。它读取代码、发现应追踪的事件，并一站式生成具体的埋点计划。

每当用户需要为 PR 添加分析，或询问“对 PR 进行埋点”、“为分支添加追踪”、“该文件需要哪些分析”、“为检出流程进行埋点”、“运行完整埋点工作流”，或任何隐含从代码变更到追踪计划的请求时，都应使用此技能。当用户提供 PR 链接、分支名、文件路径或功能描述，并提及分析、事件或埋点时，也触发此功能。

这是分析工作流的主要入口——优先于此，而非分别调用（diff-intake、discover-event-surfaces、instrument-events）。

description: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要"查看消息"、"看聊天记录"、"发消息给某人"、"最近有什么消息"、"给群里发消息"、"看看发了什么图片/文件"时触发。
description_zh: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要“查看消息”、“看聊天记录”、“发消息给某人”、“最近有什么消息”、“给群里发消息”、“看看发了什么图片/文件”时触发。

description: Reads a PR or branch diff and produces a structured YAML change brief for downstream analytics instrumentation skills. Use this as the first step whenever a user shares a PR link, branch comparison, or raw diff and wants to understand what changed, what needs tracking, or how to instrument a feature. Trigger on phrases like "review this PR", "what changed in this branch", "help me instrument this diff", "check analytics coverage for this change", or any request to start the analytics review workflow.
description_zh:
读取 PR 或分支差异，为下游分析仪表化技能生成结构化的 YAML 变更简报。
每当用户分享 PR 链接、分支对比或原始差异，并希望了解发生了哪些变更、需要追踪哪些内容或如何对功能进行仪表化时，请将此作为第一步使用。
当用户提及“审查此 PR”、“此分支发生了哪些变更”、“帮助我对此差异进行仪表化”、“检查此变更的分析覆盖率”等表述，或提出启动分析审查工作流的任何请求时，触发此功能。

description: Discovers how analytics tracking calls are actually written in this codebase — the concrete SDK calls, function signatures, and import patterns used to send events. Use this skill whenever you need to understand the existing analytics instrumentation patterns before adding new tracking, when someone asks "how do we track events here?", "show me the analytics setup", "what's the analytics pattern in this codebase?", or any time the instrument-events or discover-event-surfaces skills are about to run and you need to know the correct coding style to follow. Outputs a deduplicated list of patterns with generalized examples and the file paths where each pattern appears, plus the dominant event and property naming conventions inferred from those call sites. Always use this skill before writing any analytics instrumentation code.
description_zh: 本技能揭示代码库中分析跟踪调用实际是如何编写的——包括用于发送事件的具体 SDK 调用、函数签名和导入模式。每当您需要理解现有分析插桩模式并在添加新跟踪之前使用时，请使用本技能；当有人询问“我们在这里如何跟踪事件？”“展示一下分析设置”、“此代码库中的分析模式是什么？”，或每当 instrument-events 或 discover-event-surfaces 技能即将运行时，且您需要知道需要遵循的正确编码风格时，请使用本技能。输出去重后的模式列表，包含通用示例以及每种模式出现所在的文件路径，并从中推断出主导的事件和属性命名规范。在编写任何分析插桩代码之前，始终使用本技能。

description: 所有联网操作必须通过此 skill 处理，包括：搜索、网页抓取、登录后操作、网络交互等。 触发场景：用户要求搜索信息、查看网页内容、访问需要登录的网站、操作网页界面、抓取社交媒体内容（小红书、微博、推特等）、读取动态渲染页面、以及任何需要真实浏览器环境的网络任务。
description_zh: 所有网络操作必须通过此技能处理，包括：搜索、网页抓取、登录后操作、网络交互等。触发场景：用户要求搜索信息、查看网页内容、访问需要登录的网站、操作网页界面、抓取社交媒体内容（小红书、微博、推特等）、读取动态渲染页面、以及任何需要真实浏览器环境的网络任务。

description: Given a change_brief YAML (output from diff-intake), generates an exhaustive list of candidate analytics events to instrument. Takes the perspective of an engineer with a PM mindset — surfaces everything worth considering so a PM can decide what actually matters. Use this as step 2 of the analytics instrumentation workflow, immediately after diff-intake produces a change_brief. Trigger whenever a user has a change_brief YAML and wants to know what analytics events to add, or asks "what should I track for this PR", "what events should I instrument", "generate event candidates", or any request to surface analytics coverage gaps for a code change.
description_zh: 根据 change_brief YAML（diff-intake 的输出），生成需要埋点的候选分析事件完整列表。以兼具工程师思维与产品经理（PM）思维的视角，呈现所有值得考虑的内容，以便产品经理能够决定真正重要的内容。将此作为分析埋点工作流中的第 2 步，在 diff-intake 生成 change_brief 后立即执行。在用户持有 change_brief YAML 并希望了解需要添加哪些分析事件时触发，或在询问“此 PR 应追踪哪些内容”、“应埋点哪些事件”、“生成事件候选”，以及任何要求为代码变更呈现分析覆盖缺口的需求时触发。

description: Given event_candidates YAML (output from discover-event-surfaces), generates a concrete instrumentation plan for priority-3 (critical) events. Acts as a Software Architect: discovers existing analytics patterns in the codebase, reads the hinted files to determine what variables are in scope, designs minimal chart-useful properties, and identifies the exact insertion point for each tracking call. Outputs a structured JSON trackingPlan. Use this as step 3 of the analytics instrumentation workflow, after discover-event-surfaces. Trigger whenever a user has event_candidates and wants to generate tracking code, asks "instrument these events", "generate tracking plan", "add analytics for these events", "where should I put the tracking calls", or any request to turn event candidates into concrete implementation guidance.
description_zh: 根据 event_candidates YAML（discover-event-surfaces 的输出），为优先级 3（关键）事件生成具体的埋点计划。作为软件架构师，本工具：在代码库中发现现有的分析模式，读取提示文件以判断当前作用范围内的变量，设计最小且对图表有用的属性，并确定每个追踪调用的确切插入位置。输出结构化的 JSON trackingPlan。将其作为分析埋点工作流中的第 3 步使用，在 discover-event-surfaces 之后执行。当用户已拥有 event_candidates 并希望生成追踪代码，或询问“instrument these events”“generate tracking plan”“add analytics for these events”“where should I put the tracking calls”，或提出任何将事件候选转化为具体实现指导的请求时触发。

description: Source of truth for event taxonomy generation, data auditing, and governance best practices in Amplitude. Use when an agent needs to create, validate, audit, score, or recommend improvements to event tracking plans, naming conventions, property standards, data quality, or deprecation workflows. Covers naming rules, property standards, scoring frameworks, safe metadata operations, deprecation procedures, and AI readiness guidance.
description_zh: Amplitude 中事件分类体系生成、数据审计与治理最佳实践的权威来源。当智能体需要为事件跟踪计划、命名规范、属性标准、数据质量或弃用流程创建、验证、审计、评分或建议改进时，可参考使用。涵盖命名规则、属性标准、评分框架、安全元数据操作、弃用流程及 AI 就绪指导。

description: Draft a complete documentation page for a new Warp feature from its PRODUCT.md and/or TECH.md spec. Use when an engineer has written a spec and needs to produce a first-pass MDX draft for the warpdotdev/docs repo. Also handles features without specs by researching the codebase first. Invoke this skill whenever an engineer mentions writing docs for a feature, drafting a docs page, creating feature documentation, starting the eng-docs workflow, or converting a spec into documentation. Requires an interactive session with the engineer present - it confirms a content design plan, then an outline, before drafting, and cannot run unattended. For automated, release-triggered docs, use the missing_docs skill in warpdotdev/docs instead. Works from warp-internal or warp-server.
description_zh: 根据 PRODUCT.md 和/或 TECH.md 规范，为新 Warp 功能起草一份完整的文档页面。当工程师已编写规范，需要为 warpdotdev/docs 仓库生成初稿 MDX 草稿时使用。对于没有规范的功能，先研究代码库再进行处理。当工程师提及为功能编写文档、起草文档页面、创建功能文档、启动 eng-docs 工作流，或将规范转化为文档时，调用此技能。需要工程师在场参与交互式会话——在起草前，先确认内容设计计划，随后确认大纲，且无法无人值守运行。对于自动化、由发布触发的文档，请改用 warpdotdev/docs 中的 missing_docs 技能。可在 warp-internal 或 warp-server 中工作。

description: Interact with Langfuse and access its documentation: tracing, monitoring, creating datasets, running experiments, and evaluating AI applications. Use when needing to (1) query or modify Langfuse data, (2) look up Langfuse documentation, concepts, integration guides, a feature or SDK usage, or (3) do any AI engineering task (AI observability, prompt engineering/management, evaluation and evaluator management, experimentation, dataset management, evaluation-driven CI/CD, feedback collection). Invoke it for tasks in this scope even when Langfuse is not configured or explicitly mentioned.
description_zh: 与 Langfuse 交互并访问其文档：支持追踪、监控、创建数据集、运行实验以及评估 AI 应用。当需要（1）查询或修改 Langfuse 数据、（2）查阅 Langfuse 文档、概念、集成指南、特定功能或 SDK 的使用，或（3）完成任何 AI 工程任务（AI 可观测性、提示词工程/管理、评估与评估器管理、实验、数据集管理、基于评估的 CI/CD、反馈收集）时使用。即使 Langfuse 未配置或未被明确提及，也应调用它来完成此范围内的任务。

description: DEPRECATED and retired as of 2026-08-20. Do not invoke, and do not schedule. This skill scanned for merged PRODUCT.md specs and auto-drafted docs PRs, which produced documentation for features that had not shipped. Docs for newly shipped features are now triggered by the weekly release and gated on documentation-worthiness by the missing_docs skill in warpdotdev/docs. If you were about to run this skill to find docs gaps, run missing_docs in drift-watch mode instead.
description_zh: 已于 2026-08-20 弃用并停用。请勿调用，也不要安排。该技能扫描已合并的 PRODUCT.md 规范，并自动起草文档 PR，从而为尚未发布的功能生成了文档。新发布功能的文档现在由每周发布触发，并由 warpdotdev/docs 中的 missing_docs 技能根据文档价值把关。如果你正打算运行此技能以查找文档缺口，请改用 drift-watch 模式运行 missing_docs。

description: Security code review for vulnerabilities. Use when asked to "security review", "find vulnerabilities", "check for security issues", "audit security", "OWASP review", or review code for injection, XSS, authentication, authorization, cryptography issues. Provides systematic review with confidence-based reporting.
description_zh: 安全代码漏洞审查。当被要求执行“安全审查”、“查找漏洞”、“检查安全问题”、“安全审计”、“OWASP审查”，或审查代码中的注入、XSS、身份认证、权限授权、密码学问题时使用。提供基于置信度的系统性审查与报告。

description: Execute database migrations across ORMs and platforms with zero-downtime strategies, data transformation, and rollback procedures. Use when migrating databases, changing schemas, performing data transformations, or implementing zero-downtime deployment strategies.
description_zh: 执行跨ORM与平台的数据库迁移，采用零停机策略、数据转换及回滚流程。适用于数据库迁移、模式变更、数据转换或实施零停机部署策略等场景。

description: Master Python asyncio, concurrent programming, and async/await patterns for high-performance applications. Use when building async APIs, concurrent systems, or I/O-bound applications requiring non-blocking operations.
description_zh: 精通 Python asyncio、并发编程与 async/await 模式，以构建高性能应用。在构建异步 API、并发系统或 I/O 密集型应用时使用，这类应用需要非阻塞操作。

description: 企业微信日程管理技能。适用于用户对企业微信日程的各类管理需求。当用户需要：(1) 查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取日程详细信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），(2) 创建新日程并设置提醒、参与人等，(3) 修改已有日程的标题、时间、地点等信息或取消日程，(4) 添加或移除日程参与人，(5) 查询多个成员的闲忙状态并分析共同空闲时段以安排会议时使用此技能。
