description: Write or explain **Admin GraphQL** queries and mutations for apps and integrations that extend the Shopify admin. Use when the user wants to **understand, design, or generate** the operation itself—even before deciding how to run it. Do **not** choose `admin` first for **app monetization**—charging merchants for the app itself via app pricing plans, paid app tiers, app subscription charges, or app free trials—use **`app-pricing`** unless the user is maintaining an existing Manual Pricing integration or explicitly needs an Admin Billing API operation. Merchant **product** subscriptions stay with `admin` (selling plans, subscription contracts, try-before-you-buy). Do **not** choose `admin` first for **app or extension config validation** —use **`use-shopify-cli`**. Do **not** choose `admin` first to **execute** Admin GraphQL **now via Shopify CLI** or for CLI setup/troubleshooting on store workflows—use **`use-shopify-cli`** (store auth/execute, handle/SKU/location lookups, inventory changes).
description_zh: 编写或解释用于扩展 Shopify 管理的 **Admin GraphQL** 查询和变更。在用户想要**理解、设计或生成**操作本身时使用——即使在使用它之前就已决定如何运行。不要为**应用变现**首先选择 `admin`——通过应用定价方案、付费应用层级、应用订阅收费或应用免费试用向商户收取应用费用——应使用 **`app-pricing`**，除非用户正在维护现有的 Manual Pricing 集成或明确需要 Admin Billing API 操作。商户**商品**订阅保持在 `admin`（销售计划、订阅合同、试用购买前）。不要为**应用或扩展配置校验**首先选择 `admin`——应使用 **`use-shopify-cli`**。不要为了**通过 Shopify CLI 现在执行** Admin GraphQL 或用于店铺工作流中的 CLI 设置/故障排除而首先选择 `admin`——应使用 **`use-shopify-cli`**（店铺授权/执行、处理/SKU/位置查询、库存变更）。

description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that lists upcoming events or creates events on the user's own Google Calendar. The ONLY supported path is the `googlecalendar-client` mops package (Calendar REST API v3) combined with the `google-oauth` mops package (token exchange + refresh + PKCE). Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `oauth2.googleapis.com` or `www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses bearer auth, replication-cost safeguards, and the `google-oauth` library's percent-encoding and JSON parsing. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions scheduling, calendar events, appointments, meetings, "add to calendar", or any equivalent phrasing — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a Google endpoint.
description_zh: 每个需要列出即将到来的事件或在用户自己的Google日历中创建事件的Caffeine构建，必须采用**强制配方**。**唯一**支持的路径是`googlecalendar-client` mops包（Calendar REST API v3）与`google-oauth` mops包（令牌交换 + 刷新 + PKCE）相结合。手动编写对`oauth2.googleapis.com`或`www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3`的`ic.http_request`调用，是一种**禁止的anti-pattern**——它会绕过Bearer认证、复制成本防护机制，以及`google-oauth`库的百分号编码和JSON解析。每当用户、规范或任何先前任务提及排程、日历事件、预约、会议、“添加到日历”，或任何等效表述时，请加载此技能——并且在编写任何接触Google端点的代码**之前**。

Use this skill when the user has one or more URLs and wants their content, says "extract", "grab the content from", "pull the text from", "get the page at", "read this webpage", or needs clean text from web pages. Handles JavaScript-rendered pages, returns LLM-optimized markdown, and supports query-focused chunking for targeted extraction. Can process up to 20 URLs in a single call.
description_zh: 通过 Tavily CLI 从特定 URL 中提取干净的 Markdown 或文本内容。当用户拥有一个或多个 URL 并需要获取其内容、说出"提取"、"从……抓取内容"、"从……提取文本"、"获取该页面"、"阅读该网页"等表述，或需要从网页中获取干净文本时，请使用此技能。可处理 JavaScript 渲染的页面，返回经 LLM 优化的 Markdown，并支持针对查询的聚焦分块以实现定向提取。单次调用最多可处理 20 个 URL。

description: Master authentication and authorization patterns including JWT, OAuth2, session management, and RBAC to build secure, scalable access control systems. Use when implementing auth systems, securing APIs, or debugging security issues.
description_zh: 掌握包括JWT、OAuth2、会话管理和RBAC在内的认证与授权模式，以构建安全、可扩展的访问控制系统。用于实现认证系统、保护API或调试安全问题。

description: Apply STRIDE methodology to systematically identify threats. Use when analyzing system security, conducting threat modeling sessions, or creating security documentation.
description_zh: 应用 STRIDE 方法系统性地识别威胁。适用于分析系统安全、开展威胁建模会议或编写安全文档时使用。

description: Use when writing an OpenCLI adapter for a new site or adding a new command to an existing site. Guides end-to-end from first recon through field decoding, adapter coding, and verify. Replaces opencli-oneshot / opencli-explorer. For ad-hoc browser driving (no adapter), see opencli-browser instead; for a top-level orientation to opencli, see opencli-usage.
description_zh: 编写 OpenCLI 适配器用于新站点或向现有站点添加新命令时使用。提供从首次侦察、字段解码、适配器编码到验证的端到端指南。替代 opencli-oneshot / opencli-explorer。对于临时浏览器控制（无需适配器），请参阅 opencli-browser；对于 OpenCLI 的整体入门指南，请参阅 opencli-usage。

description: Create LangChain agents with create_agent, define tools, and use middleware for human-in-the-loop and error handling.
description_zh: 使用 create_agent 创建 LangChain 智能体，定义工具，并使用中间件实现人工干预循环与错误处理。

description:
Replace the usage of `expect` and similar functions from `package:matcher`
to `package:checks` equivalents.
description_zh: 将 `expect` 及其类似函数的用法，从 `package:matcher` 替换为 `package:checks` 中的等效函数。

description: Manages Cloud Run services, jobs, and worker pools. Use when you need to deploy applications responding to HTTP requests (services), run event-triggered or scheduled tasks (jobs), or handle always-on pull-based background processing (worker pools).
description_zh: 管理 Cloud Run 服务、任务和 worker 池。当您需要部署响应 HTTP 请求的应用程序（服务）、运行事件触发或定时任务（任务）、或处理常驻拉取式后台处理（worker 池）时使用。

description: Build robust backtesting systems for trading strategies with proper handling of look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, and transaction costs. Use when developing trading algorithms, validating strategies, or building backtesting infrastructure.
description_zh: 构建交易策略的稳健回测系统，正确处理前瞻偏差、幸存者偏差和交易成本。用于开发交易算法、验证策略或构建回测基础设施。

description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
description_zh: 构建新用户界面（UI）或重塑现有界面时的独特、有目的视觉设计指南。有助于明确美学方向、选择字体排版，并做出不显得是模板化默认选项的选择。

description: Generate and maintain OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from code, design-first specs, and validation patterns. Use when creating API documentation, generating SDKs, or ensuring API contract compliance.
description_zh: 从代码、设计优先规范及验证模式生成并维护 OpenAPI 3.1 规范。用于创建 API 文档、生成 SDK 或确保 API 契约合规。

description: Add, fix, refactor, debug, test, or explain Flutter animations and motion effects. Use when working with implicit animations such as AnimatedContainer, AnimatedOpacity, AnimatedSwitcher, and TweenAnimationBuilder; explicit animations using AnimationController, Tween, CurvedAnimation, AnimatedWidget, AnimatedBuilder, and built-in transitions; Hero/shared-element route transitions; staggered or sequenced animations; physics-based motion, gestures, springs, flings, scroll physics, curves, performance, accessibility, reduced motion, and animation lifecycle bugs.
description_zh: 添加、修复、重构、调试、测试或解释 Flutter 动画与运动效果。在涉及以下内容时使用：隐式动画，例如 AnimatedContainer、AnimatedOpacity、AnimatedSwitcher 和 TweenAnimationBuilder；使用 AnimationController、Tween、CurvedAnimation、AnimatedWidget、AnimatedBuilder 及内置转场效果的显式动画；Hero/共享元素路由转场；交错或顺序动画；基于物理的运动、手势、弹簧、抛掷、滚动物理、曲线、性能、无障碍、减少动态效果，以及动画生命周期问题。

description: Architectural patterns, entrypoint structure, exit codes, stream routing, and subprocess spawning for Dart command-line interface (CLI) applications. Use when building CLI tools, console utilities, scripts, argument parsing with `package:args` (ArgParser or CommandRunner), handling exit codes, configuring executables in pubspec.yaml, spawning Dart subprocesses, or compiling native CLI binaries. Don't use for Flutter UI widgets, web applications, or standalone HTTP backend servers.
description_zh: Dart 命令行界面（CLI）应用程序的架构模式、入口点结构、退出码、流路由和子进程生成。在构建 CLI 工具、控制台工具、脚本、使用 `package:args`（ArgParser 或 CommandRunner）进行参数解析、处理退出码、在 pubspec.yaml 中配置可执行文件、生成 Dart 子进程或编译原生 CLI 二进制文件时使用。不要用于 Flutter UI 控件、网页应用或独立的 HTTP 后端服务器。

description: Set up, authenticate, update, troubleshoot, or choose between Tavily CLI web commands. Use when the user asks about the Tavily CLI, installing Tavily skills, first-time setup, authentication, keyless limits, CLI updates, or which Tavily command to use. For an ordinary web task, use the specific search, extract, map, crawl, research, or dynamic-search skill instead.
description_zh: 设置、认证、更新、故障排查或选择Tavily CLI网络命令。当用户询问有关Tavily CLI、安装Tavily技能、首次设置、认证、免密钥限制、CLI更新或应该使用哪个Tavily命令时，使用。对于普通网络任务，应使用特定的搜索、提取、地图、爬虫、研究或动态搜索技能替代。

description: Create, revise, audit, and export manuscript scientific figures in Python or R. Use for 论文配图、科研绘图、多面板图 and submission-ready plots, or explicitly requested AI-generated graphical abstracts and mechanism schematics. Not for interactive dashboards, data cleaning, or statistics-only analysis.
description_zh: 使用 Python 或 R 创建、修订、审核并导出论文科学图表。适用于论文配图、科研绘图、多面板图、提交前即可使用的图表，或根据明确要求的 AI 生成图摘要及机制示意图。不适用于交互式仪表盘、数据清洗，或仅基于统计的分析。

description: Pinia stores, state management patterns, store setup, and reactivity with stores.
description_zh: Pinia 状态、状态管理模式、状态设置以及 store 的响应性。

description: Generate CI/CD configuration for Linear Release. Use when setting up release tracking, configuring CI pipelines for Linear, or integrating deployments with Linear releases. Supports GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, and other platforms.
description_zh: 为 Linear 发布生成 CI/CD 配置。用于设置发布跟踪、配置 Linear 的 CI 管道或集成部署与 Linear 发布。支持 GitHub Actions、GitLab CI、CircleCI 及其他平台。

description: Remove AI writing patterns from prose. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to eliminate predictable AI tells.
description_zh: 从文本中去除AI写作模式。在起草、编辑或审查文本时使用，以消除可预测的AI痕迹。

description: Expert-level browser automation, debugging, and performance analysis using Chrome DevTools MCP. Use for interacting with web pages, capturing screenshots, analyzing network traffic, and profiling performance.
description_zh: 使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 实现专家级浏览器自动化、调试与性能分析。可用于与网页交互、截取屏幕截图、分析网络流量以及性能剖析。

description: Ensure .NET/C# code meets best practices for the solution/project.
description_zh: 确保 .NET/C# 代码符合解决方案/项目的最佳实践。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when implementing human-in-the-loop patterns, pausing for approval, or handling errors in LangGraph. Covers interrupt(), Command(resume=...), approval/validation workflows, and the 4-tier error handling strategy.
description_zh: 在实现人类在环模式、暂停获取批准或在 LangGraph 中处理错误时调用此技能。涵盖 interrupt()、Command(resume=...)、批准/验证工作流程以及四层错误处理策略。

description: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh. Navigate web pages, interact with elements using @e refs, take screenshots, record video. Capabilities: web scraping, form filling, clicking, typing, drag-drop, file upload, JavaScript execution. Use for: web automation, data extraction, testing, agent browsing, research. Triggers: browser, web automation, scrape, navigate, click, fill form, screenshot, browse web, playwright, headless browser, web agent, surf internet, record video
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 为 AI 智能体提供浏览器自动化。浏览网页，使用 @e refs 与元素交互，截图，录制视频。功能能力：网页抓取、表单填写、点击、输入、拖放、文件上传、JavaScript 执行。用途：网页自动化、数据提取、测试、智能体浏览、研究。触发词：浏览器、网页自动化、抓取、导航、点击、填写表单、截图、浏览网页、playwright、无头浏览器、网页智能体、上网浏览、录制视频。

description: Three.js animation - keyframe animation, skeletal animation, morph targets, animation mixing. Use when animating objects, playing GLTF animations, creating procedural motion, or blending animations.
description_zh: Three.js 动画 - 关键帧动画，骨骼动画，变形目标，动画混合。适用于对对象进行动画、播放 GLTF 动画、创建程序化运动或混合动画。
很抱歉，您提供的待翻译内容似乎不完整，目前没有可翻译的文本内容。请您提供需要翻译的具体内容，我会为您准确、流畅地翻译成简体中文。

description: Transform AI agents from task-followers into proactive partners that anticipate needs and continuously improve. Now with WAL Protocol, Working Buffer for context survival, Compaction Recovery, and battle-tested security patterns. Part of the Hal Stack 🦞
description_zh: 将 AI 智能体从任务跟随者转化为能够预判需求并持续改进的主动伙伴。现在加入 WAL 协议、保障上下文存续的工作缓冲、压缩恢复机制，以及经过实战验证的安全模式。属于 Hal Stack 🦞

description: Python code style, linting, formatting, naming conventions, and documentation standards. Use when writing new code, reviewing style, configuring linters, writing docstrings, or establishing project standards.
description_zh: Python 代码风格、代码检查、格式化、命名规范与文档规范。适用于编写新代码、审查代码风格、配置代码检查工具、编写 docstring（文档字符串）或建立项目规范时。

description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.
description_zh: 通过可视化、上下文和说服性结构，将数据转化为引人入胜的叙事。用于向利益相关方展示分析、创建数据报告或制作高管演示文稿。

description: Use when the user asks about using Gemini in an enterprise environment or explicitly mentions Vertex AI, Google Cloud, or Agent Platform. Guides the usage of the Gemini API on Agent Platform with the Google Gen AI SDK. Covers SDK usage (Python, JS/TS, Go, Java, C#), capabilities like multimodal inputs, tools, media generation, caching, batch prediction, and Live API.
description_zh: 当用户询问在企业环境中使用 Gemini，或明确提及 Vertex AI、Google Cloud 或 Agent Platform 时使用。指导使用 Google Gen AI SDK 在 Agent Platform 上使用 Gemini API。涵盖 SDK 的使用（Python、JS/TS、Go、Java、C#），以及多模态输入、工具、媒体生成、缓存、批量预测和 Live API 等能力。

description: Clerk Billing for subscription management - render Clerk's PricingTable and in-app checkout drawer, configure subscription plans, seat-limit plans for B2B, feature entitlements with has(), and billing webhooks. Use for SaaS monetization, plan gating, checkout flows, trials, invoicing, and subscription lifecycle management.
description_zh: Clerk 订阅计费管理 - 渲染 Clerk 的 PricingTable 和应用内结账抽屉，配置订阅计划、面向 B2B 的席位限制计划、使用 has() 的功能权限以及计费 Webhook。用于 SaaS 变现、计划门控、结账流程、试用、开票及订阅生命周期管理。

description: EAS service (paid). Build and submit iOS and Android apps with EAS to TestFlight, the App Store, or Google Play. Supports Expo and other React Native projects, plus existing native apps. Use for eas.json setup, release pipelines, signing, app versions and build numbers, store submissions, and listing metadata. For Expo websites and API routes, use eas-hosting; for adding React Native screens to a native app, use expo-brownfield.
description_zh: EAS 服务（付费）。使用 EAS 将 iOS 和 Android 应用构建并提交至 TestFlight、App Store 或 Google Play。支持 Expo 及其他 React Native 项目，以及现有原生应用。适用于 eas.json 配置、发布流水线、签名、应用版本和构建编号、商店提交以及列表元数据。对于 Expo 网站和 API 路由，使用 eas-hosting；为在原生应用中添加 React Native 界面，使用 expo-brownfield。

description: Produce a polished, self-contained HTML "readout" document under ~/.readouts (with an auto-maintained index page), either by snapshotting the findings accumulated in the current conversation or — when invoked fresh, e.g. "/readout on how github webhook events are processed" — by sharpening scope with clarifying questions and researching the codebase before documenting. The work runs in a child agent so the main conversation's context stays clean. Use whenever the user invokes /readout, says "write this up", "turn this into a doc/page", "make a readout", or asks for a readable, shareable document capturing findings or explaining how something works.
description_zh: 生成一份风格精致、内容自包含的 HTML“读取输出”文档，存放于 ~/.readouts 目录（并附带一个自动维护的索引页）。要么将当前对话中累积的发现直接快照为文档；要么——当被全新调用时，例如“/readout on how github webhook events are processed”——通过提出澄清问题来明确范围，并在记录文档前研究代码库。该工作在一个子代理中运行，因此主对话的上下文保持整洁。当用户调用 /readout，说“write this up”、“turn this into a doc/page”、“make a readout”，或要求生成一份可读、可分享的文档，以记录发现或解释某事物的工作原理时，随时使用此方法。

description: Map identified threats to appropriate security controls and mitigations. Use when prioritizing security investments, creating remediation plans, or validating control effectiveness.
description_zh: 将已识别威胁映射至适当的控制措施及缓解措施。用于在安全投资优先级排序、整改计划制定或控制有效性验证时。

description: Manages datasets, tables, and jobs in BigQuery. Use when you need to interact with BigQuery, run SQL queries, manage BigQuery resources (datasets, tables, views), or perform basic data ingestion and analysis.
description_zh: 管理 BigQuery 中的数据集、表与作业。当您需要与 BigQuery 交互，运行 SQL 查询，管理 BigQuery 资源（数据集、表、视图），或执行基础数据导入与分析时使用。

description: Comprehensive Tailwind CSS v4 documentation snapshot and workflow guidance. Use when answering Tailwind v4 questions, selecting utilities/variants, configuring Tailwind v4, or migrating projects from v3 to v4 with official docs and gotcha checks.
description_zh: 全面的 Tailwind CSS v4 文档快照与工作流程指南。适用于在结合官方文档及常见陷阱排查的情况下，回答 Tailwind v4 相关问题、选择工具类/变体、配置 Tailwind v4，或将项目从 v3 迁移到 v4。

description: Propose multiple visual design variants for on-screen elements and let the human pick in the Argent Lens window. Use when the user asks for design alternatives / options / A-B choices for a screen or component, or any time you have produced more than one candidate look for an element and want a human decision before committing.
description_zh: 在 Argent Lens 窗口内，为屏幕元素提供多种视觉设计变体，并交由人工进行选择。当用户要求对屏幕或组件提供设计替代方案/选项/A-B 选择，或在为某元素提供多种候选外观后需由人工在提交前做出决策时，使用此功能。

description: Website exploration for testing using Playwright MCP
description_zh: 使用 Playwright MCP 进行测试的网站探索

description: Query official Microsoft documentation to find concepts, tutorials, and code examples across Azure, .NET, Agent Framework, Aspire, VS Code, GitHub, and more. Uses Microsoft Learn MCP as the default, with Context7 and Aspire MCP for content that lives outside learn.microsoft.com.
description_zh: 查询微软官方文档，在 Azure、.NET、Agent 框架、Aspire、VS Code、GitHub 等平台查找概念、教程和代码示例。默认使用 Microsoft Learn MCP，针对位于 learn.microsoft.com 之外的内容，则使用 Context7 和 Aspire MCP。

description: Automates Apple-platform apps (iOS, tvOS, macOS), Android devices, and Amazon Vega OS TV apps in Vega Virtual Devices. Use when navigating apps, taking snapshots/screenshots where supported, driving TV remotes, tapping, typing, scrolling, extracting UI info, collecting evidence, or planning agent-device CLI commands.
description_zh: 在 Vega 虚拟设备中自动化 Apple 平台应用（iOS、tvOS、macOS）、Android 设备及 Amazon Vega OS 电视应用。用于导航应用、在支持时截取快照/截图、控制电视遥控器、点击、输入、滚动、提取界面信息、收集证据，或规划代理与设备 CLI 命令。

description: Universal SQL performance optimization assistant for comprehensive query tuning, indexing strategies, and database performance analysis across all SQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle). Provides execution plan analysis, pagination optimization, batch operations, and performance monitoring guidance.
description_zh: 通用 SQL 性能优化助手，适用于所有 SQL 数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle）的全面查询调优、索引策略与数据库性能分析，提供执行计划分析、分页优化、批量操作及性能监控指导。

description: Crawl websites and extract content from multiple pages via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to crawl a site, download documentation, extract an entire docs section, bulk-extract pages, save a site as local markdown files, or says "crawl", "get all the pages", "download the docs", "extract everything under /docs", "bulk extract", or needs content from many pages on the same domain. Supports depth/breadth control, path filtering, semantic instructions, and saving each page as a local markdown file.
description_zh: 通过 Tavily CLI 抓取网站并从多个页面提取内容。当用户希望抓取网站、下载文档、提取整个文档部分、批量提取页面、将网站保存为本地 Markdown 文件，或表述为“crawl”（抓取）、“get all the pages”（获取所有页面）、“download the docs”（下载文档）、“extract everything under /docs”（提取 /docs 目录下的所有内容）、“bulk extract”（批量提取），或需要获取同一域名下多个页面的内容时，请使用此技能。支持深度/广度控制、路径过滤、语义指令，并将每页保存为本地 Markdown 文件。

description: Use when finishing a feature, fixing a bug, before committing React code, or when the user types `/doctor`, asks to scan, triage, or clean up React diagnostics. Covers lint, accessibility, bundle size, architecture. Includes a regression check and a full local-triage workflow that fetches the canonical playbook.
description_zh: 在完成功能、修复bug、提交React代码之前，或当用户输入 `/doctor` 并请求扫描、分诊或清理React诊断信息时使用。涵盖 lint、无障碍、包体积与架构。包含回归检查，以及获取标准操作手册（playbook）的完整本地分诊工作流。

description: Turn on Cache Components in a Next.js app and resolve the blocking routes it surfaces. Use when the user wants to enable, adopt, or migrate to Cache Components, flip the `cacheComponents` flag, work through a flood of blocking-prerender / instant validation errors, run the `cache-components-instant-false` codemod, or decide between opting routes out with `export const instant = false` and fixing them in place.
description_zh: 在 Next.js 应用中启用缓存组件，并解决其显现出的阻塞路由。当用户想要启用、采用或迁移至缓存组件，切换 `cacheComponents` 标志，应对大量阻塞预渲染/即时验证错误，运行 `cache-components-instant-false` 代码修改工具，或在决定是使用 `export const instant = false` 将路由排除在缓存组件之外并就地修复，还是直接就地修复时使用。

description: Generate an explore-prompt.md file that gives Momentic's explore agent (`momentic ai explore diff` / `momentic ai explore latest`) repo-specific context — which applications to test, the URLs tests must target, how to authenticate, where to save generated tests, and repo quirks. Use when setting up or improving the prompt file passed via `--prompt-file`.
description_zh: 生成一个 explore-prompt.md 文件，为 Momentic 的探索代理（`momentic ai explore diff` / `momentic ai explore latest`）提供特定代码库的上下文，包括需要测试的应用程序、测试必须针对的 URL、如何进行身份验证、生成的测试应保存的位置以及代码库的特殊性。在设置或改进通过 `--prompt-file` 参数传递的提示文件时使用。

description: 长篇网文规划与写作。支持只讨论结构、只写大纲或指定细纲，明确要求正文后再写章节。触发方式：/story-long-write、/写长篇、「帮我开书」「规划剧情」「写大纲」「补细纲」「日更」「续写」「继续写」「修改第X章」「回炉」「重写第X章」。
description_zh: 长篇网文规划与写作。支持仅讨论结构、仅写大纲或指定细纲，在明确要求正文后再撰写章节。触发方式：/story-long-write、/写长篇、「帮我开书」「规划剧情」「写大纲」「补细纲」「日更」「续写」「继续写」「修改第X章」「回炉」「重写第X章」。

description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。
description_zh: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "add MCP server", "integrate MCP", "configure MCP in plugin", "use .mcp.json", "set up Model Context Protocol", "connect external service", mentions "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with MCP", or discusses MCP server types (SSE, stdio, HTTP, WebSocket). Provides comprehensive guidance for integrating Model Context Protocol servers into Claude Code plugins for external tool and service integration.
description_zh: 当用户要求“添加 MCP 服务器”、要求“集成 MCP”、要求“在插件中配置 MCP”、要求“使用 .mcp.json”、要求“设置模型上下文协议”、要求“连接外部服务”，或提及“${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} 与 MCP”，或讨论 MCP 服务器类型（SSE、stdio、HTTP、WebSocket）时，应使用本技能。本技能为将模型上下文协议服务器集成到 Claude Code 插件中，以实现外部工具和服务集成，提供全面指导。

description: ONLY use when user explicitly says 'deep research', 'exhaustive', 'comprehensive report', or 'thorough investigation'. Slower and more expensive than parallel-web-search. For normal research/lookup requests, use parallel-web-search instead. Supports multi-turn: pass --previous-interaction-id from a prior research or enrichment to continue with context.
description_zh: 仅在用户明确表述为“深度研究”“详尽”“综合报告”或“彻底调查”时使用。其速度比并行网络搜索更慢，成本也更高。对于常规的研究/查询请求，请改用并行网络搜索。支持多轮对话：将先前研究或信息补充中的 --previous-interaction-id 传入，以延续上下文。

description: Get crypto and meme token price charts (K-line, candlestick, OHLCV), trending meme coin rankings by volume, newly launched tokens on launchpads (pump.fun, fourmeme, letsbonk, Raydium, etc.), the hot-search ranking (most-searched tokens), and search for a specific token or wallet by name, symbol, contract address, wallet address, or ENS via GMGN API on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum. Use when user asks for price chart, trending tokens, what's pumping, hot coins, most searched tokens, new launches, token signals, wants to look up / find / search a specific token or wallet by name or address, or wants to discover early-stage opportunities.
description_zh: 获取加密货币和 meme 代币价格图表（K线图、蜡烛图、OHLCV），按交易量排序的 meme 代币热门排名，在发行平台（pump.fun、fourmeme、letsbonk、Raydium 等）上新上线的代币，热搜排名（搜索量最高的代币），并通过 GMGN API 在 Solana、BSC、Base 或以太坊网络上，按名称、代码、合约地址、钱包地址或 ENS 搜索特定代币或钱包。适用于用户询问价格图表、热门代币、哪些在上涨、热门币种、搜索量最高的代币、新上线代币、代币信号，或希望按名称或地址查找/搜索特定代币或钱包，或希望发掘早期机会时的使用场景。

description: Research any crypto or meme token by address — real-time price, market cap, liquidity, holder list, trader list, top Smart Money and KOL positions, security audit (honeypot, rug pull risk, dev wallet, renounced status), social links (Twitter/X, website) via GMGN API on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum. Use when user asks about a token's price, safety, holders, traders, smart money exposure, or wants due diligence before buying.
description_zh: 通过 GMGN API 在 Solana、BSC、Base 或 Ethereum 区块链上，按地址研究任意加密货币或模因代币的实时价格、市值、流动性、持有者列表、交易者列表、顶级聪明钱和关键意见领袖（KOL）持仓，以及安全检查（蜜罐、rug pull 风险、开发者钱包、弃权状态）、社交链接（Twitter/X、网站）。当用户询问代币的价格、安全性、持有者、交易者、聪明钱暴露情况，或希望在购买前进行尽职调查时使用。

description: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org chart, state machine, or any visual representation of structure/logic/process. Also trigger when the user says "画个图" "画一个架构图" "diagram" "flowchart" "sequence diagram" "draw me a ..." or uploads content and asks to visualize it. Output is always a standalone .svg file.
description_zh: 创建专业、深色主题的SVG图表，类型不限——架构图、流程图、时序图、结构图、思维导图、时间线、示意/概念图等。当用户要求任何类型的专业技术或概念图表、系统可视化、流程、数据流、组件关系、网络拓扑、决策树、组织架构图、状态机，或任何结构/逻辑/流程的视觉表现时，请使用此技能。当用户说“画个图”、“画一个架构图”、“diagram”、“flowchart”、“sequence diagram”、“draw me a ...”或上传内容并要求可视化时，也应触发此功能。输出始终为一个独立的 .svg 文件。

description: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls the transcript from captions (or Whisper API fallback), and hands the result to Claude so it can answer questions about what's in the video.
description_zh: 播放视频（提供 URL 或本地路径）。使用 yt-dlp 进行下载，使用 ffmpeg 提取自动缩放帧，从字幕中提取文本记录（或使用 Whisper API 作为备用方案），并将结果提供给 Claude，以便其能够回答关于视频内容的提问。

description: Build scalable design systems with design tokens, theming infrastructure, and component architecture patterns. Use when creating design tokens, implementing theme switching, building component libraries, or establishing design system foundations.
description_zh: 通过设计令牌、主题化基础设施和组件架构模式，构建可扩展的设计系统。在创建设计令牌、实现主题切换、构建组件库或建立设计系统基础时使用。

description: 长篇网文拆文。深度拆解爆款长篇小说的黄金三章、人设架构、爽点设计、节奏控制。单一深度拆解管道：跑完黄金三章（Stage 1）后产出快速预览报告并询问是否继续全量拆解，确认后从 Stage 2 续跑逐章摘要、聚合分析、设定关系、汇总报告，全程产物落盘 拆文库/{书名}/。触发方式：/story-long-analyze、/长篇拆文、「帮我拆这本书」「拆这本书」「分析黄金三章」「深度拆解」「完整拆解」「系统拆解」或提供小说文本文件路径——全部进入同一管道。
description_zh: 长篇网文拆文。深度拆解爆款长篇小说的黄金三章、人设架构、爽点设计及节奏控制。单一深度拆解管道：跑完黄金三章（Stage 1）后，产出快速预览报告并询问是否继续全量拆解；确认后，从 Stage 2 续跑，完成逐章摘要、聚合分析、设定关系与汇总报告，全程产物统一落盘至 拆文库/{书名}/。触发方式：/story-long-analyze、/长篇拆文、「帮我拆这本书」「拆这本书」「分析黄金三章」「深度拆解」「完整拆解」「系统拆解」或提供小说文本文件路径——全部进入同一管道。

description: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.
description_zh: 遵循基础设施即代码（IaC）最佳实践，为 AWS、Azure、GCP 和 OCI 基础设施构建可复用的 Terraform 模块。适用于创建基础设施模块、标准化云资源配置，以及实现可复用的基础设施即代码组件。

description: 短篇网文写作。辅助短篇小说创作，从构思到成稿，聚焦情绪拉扯与节奏把控。触发方式：/story-short-write、/写短篇、「帮我写一篇短篇」「写个盐言故事」。
description_zh: 短篇网文写作。辅助短篇小说创作，从构思到成稿，聚焦情绪拉扯与节奏把控。触发方式：/story-short-write、/写短篇、「帮我写一篇短篇」「写个盐言故事」。

description: Discover and list all URLs on a website without extracting content, via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to find a specific page on a large site, list all URLs, see the site structure, find where something is on a domain, or says "map the site", "find the URL for", "what pages are on", "list all pages", or "site structure". Faster than crawling — returns URLs only. Essential when you know the site but not the exact page. Combine with extract for targeted content retrieval.
description_zh: 通过 Tavily CLI，无需提取内容，即可发现并列出网站上的所有 URL。当用户想要在大型网站中找到特定页面、列出所有 URL、查看网站结构、查找某物在域名上的位置，或说出“映射网站”、“查找 URL”、“有哪些页面”、“列出所有页面”或“网站结构”时，使用此技能。比爬取更快——仅返回 URL。当你知道网站但不知道具体页面时，必不可少。与 extract 结合使用，可实现定向内容提取。

description: Master React Native styling, navigation, and Reanimated animations for cross-platform mobile development. Use when building React Native apps, implementing navigation patterns, or creating performant animations.
description_zh: 掌握 React Native 的样式、导航与 Reanimated 动画，用于跨平台移动开发。适用于构建 React Native 应用、实现导航模式或创建高性能动画。

description: Master smart contract security best practices to prevent common vulnerabilities and implement secure Solidity patterns. Use when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or implementing security measures for blockchain applications.
description_zh: 掌握智能合约安全最佳实践，以预防常见漏洞并实施安全的Solidity模式。适用于编写智能合约、审计现有合约或为区块链应用实施安全措施。

description: Design effective KPI dashboards with metrics selection, visualization best practices, and real-time monitoring patterns. Use this skill when building an executive SaaS metrics dashboard tracking MRR, churn, and LTV/CAC ratios; designing an operations center with live service health and request throughput; creating a cohort retention analysis view for a product team; or debugging a dashboard where metrics contradict each other due to inconsistent calculation methodology.
description_zh: 设计有效的KPI仪表盘，涵盖指标选择、可视化最佳实践和实时监控模式。当构建追踪MRR（月度经常性收入）、流失率及LTV/CAC（客户终身价值/客户获取成本）比率的高管SaaS指标仪表盘；设计具备实时服务健康与请求吞吐量的运营中心；为产品团队创建用户群体留存分析视图；或调试因计算口径不一致导致指标相互矛盾的仪表盘时，请使用本技能。

description: Use when building PHP applications with modern PHP 8.3+ features, Laravel, or Symfony frameworks. Invokes strict typing, PHPStan level 9, async patterns with Swoole, and PSR standards. Creates controllers, configures middleware, generates migrations, writes PHPUnit/Pest tests, defines typed DTOs and value objects, sets up dependency injection, and scaffolds REST/GraphQL APIs. Use when working with Eloquent, Doctrine, Composer, Psalm, ReactPHP, or any PHP API development.
description_zh: 适用于使用现代 PHP 8.3+ 特性、Laravel 或 Symfony 框架构建 PHP 应用时。支持严格类型校验、PHPStan 第 9 级、Swoole 异步模式以及 PSR 标准。创建控制器、配置中间件、生成迁移、编写 PHPUnit/Pest 测试、定义带类型的 DTO 与值对象、配置依赖注入，并搭建 REST/GraphQL API。适用于使用 Eloquent、Doctrine、Composer、Psalm、ReactPHP 或进行任何 PHP API 开发时。

description: 短篇网文拆文。拆解爆款短篇小说（番茄短篇 / 故事会 / 知乎盐选 / 追妻 / 世情 / 重生 / 虐渣等通俗题材）的故事核、结构、情感线、反转设计、写作手法、共鸣层次。单一全量拆解管道：跑完 Stage 2-6 产出完整拆文报告，落盘到 拆文库/{书名}/，下游 story-short-write 同时读拆文报告 + 情节节点 + 写作手法 + 原文 + _meta.json 写下一篇。触发方式：/story-short-analyze、/短篇拆文、「拆短篇」「拆这篇短文」「短篇拆文」「精细拆解短篇」「8000 字短篇拆解」「番茄短篇拆文」「故事会拆解」「盐言故事拆解」「分析这篇短篇」——均进入同一管道。
description_zh: 短篇网文拆文。拆解爆款短篇小说（番茄短篇 / 故事会 / 知乎盐选 / 追妻 / 世情 / 重生 / 虐渣等通俗题材）的故事核、结构、情感线、反转设计、写作手法、共鸣层次。单一全量拆解管道：跑完 Stage 2-6 产出完整拆文报告，落盘到 拆文库/{书名}/，下游 story-short-write 同时读拆文报告 + 情节节点 + 写作手法 + 原文 + _meta.json 撰写下一篇。触发方式：/story-short-analyze、/短篇拆文、「拆短篇」「拆这篇短文」「短篇拆文」「精细拆解短篇」「8000 字短篇拆解」「番茄短篇拆文」「故事会拆解」「盐言故事拆解」「分析这篇短篇」——均进入同一管道。

description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。
description_zh: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

description: Framework (OSS). Folder structure for a new Expo app. Use when scaffolding or laying out a new Expo project with Expo Router, or deciding where a file should live in one. For new projects only — never restructure an existing app to match.
description_zh: 框架（OSS）。新 Expo 应用的文件夹结构。在搭建或使用 Expo Router 创建新 Expo 项目，或决定某个文件应存放于其中的位置时使用。仅限新项目——切勿为适配现有应用而重构其目录结构。

description: 用匹配当前文稿的传播学与社会心理学理论，诊断共鸣机制、问题位置和修改方向。用户担心内容没流量、没戳中观众、完播率低或不确定能否发布时使用。
description_zh: 用匹配当前文稿的传播学与社会心理学理论，诊断共鸣机制、问题位置和修改方向。用户担心内容没流量、没戳中观众、完播率低或不确定能否发布时使用。

description: Analyze one or many crypto wallets by address — holdings, batch realized/unrealized P&L, win rate, trading history, performance stats, specific token balance, and tokens created by a developer wallet (with ATH market cap and DEX graduation status) via GMGN API on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum. Use when user asks about wallet holdings, P&L (including comparing up to 100 wallets), win rate, what tokens a dev has launched, the highest ATH token a dev ever created, or wants a wallet report to decide whether to copy-trade or follow.
description_zh: 按地址分析一个或多个加密钱包，获取以下信息：持仓、分批已实现/未实现盈亏、胜率、交易历史、绩效统计、特定代币余额，以及开发者钱包创建的代币（含历史最高价格市值与 DEX 上牌状态）。通过 GMGN API 从 Solana、BSC、Base 或以太坊链上获取数据。适用于用户询问钱包持仓、盈亏（可对比多达 100 个钱包）、胜率、开发者已推出的代币、开发者曾创作的最高历史最高价格代币，或需要获取钱包报告以决定是否跟单或复制交易等场景。

description: 用传播学与社会心理学中匹配当前内容的理论，解码共鸣机制、受众情绪、有效立场和传播动机。用户要求分析内容为什么能引起共鸣、打中什么情绪或受众还想听什么时使用。
description_zh:
经检查，您提供的源文本本身已是简体中文，因此无需进行翻译转换。原文在专业术语（如传播学、社会心理学、共鸣机制等）的运用以及语言表达的流畅度上，均准确、规范，符合简体中文的书面表达要求。

**译文如下：**

用传播学与社会心理学中匹配当前内容的理论，解码共鸣机制、受众情绪、有效立场和传播动机。用户要求分析内容为什么能引起共鸣、打中什么情绪或受众还想听什么时使用。

description: EAS service (paid). Helps understand and write EAS workflow YAML files for Expo projects. Use this skill when the user asks about CI/CD or workflows in an Expo or EAS context, mentions .eas/workflows/, or wants help with EAS build pipelines or deployment automation.
description_zh: EAS 服务（付费）。帮助理解和编写 Expo 项目的 EAS 工作流 YAML 文件。当用户在 Expo 或 EAS 相关场景中询问 CI/CD 或工作流，提及 .eas/workflows/，或需要协助处理 EAS 构建流水线或部署自动化时，使用此技能。

description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.
description_zh: 当您需要通过 CDP（Chrome DevTools 协议）控制 Chrome 浏览器以复用现有登录会话时，请使用此技能。涵盖内容：以调试模式启动 Chrome、打开网址、等待页面加载、执行 JavaScript 评估、截取截图以及提取认证令牌。触发短语：浏览器自动化、CDP、agent-browser、浏览器操作、操作浏览器、Chrome CDP、复用登录态、从浏览器提取令牌。

description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。
description_zh: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

description: Manage NuGet packages in .NET projects/solutions. Use this skill when adding, removing, or updating NuGet package versions. It enforces using `dotnet` CLI for package management and provides strict procedures for direct file edits only when updating versions.
description_zh: 管理 .NET 项目/解决方案中的 NuGet 包。在添加、删除或更新 NuGet 包版本时，使用此技能。它强制使用 `dotnet` CLI 进行包管理，并在更新版本时仅对直接文件编辑提供严格的操作流程。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when you need human-in-the-loop approval, custom middleware, or structured output. Covers HumanInTheLoopMiddleware for human approval of dangerous tool calls, creating custom middleware with hooks, Command resume patterns, and structured output with Pydantic/Zod.
description_zh: 调用此技能，当您需要人在环中审批、自定义中间件或结构化输出时。涵盖用于对危险工具调用进行人工审批的 HumanInTheLoopMiddleware、创建带有钩子的自定义中间件、Command 恢复模式以及使用 Pydantic/Zod 的结构化输出。

description: Look up Microsoft API references, find working code samples, and verify SDK code is correct. Use when working with Azure SDKs, .NET libraries, or Microsoft APIs—to find the right method, check parameters, get working examples, or troubleshoot errors. Catches hallucinated methods, wrong signatures, and deprecated patterns by querying official docs.
description_zh: 查阅 Microsoft API 参考资料，查找可运行的代码示例，并验证 SDK 代码是否正确。适用于使用 Azure SDK、.NET 库或 Microsoft 应用程序程序时——用于查找正确的方法、检查参数、获取可运行的示例或排查错误。通过查询官方文档，可捕获虚构的方法、错误的签名及过时的模式。

description: Design and implement microinteractions, motion design, transitions, and user feedback patterns. Use when adding polish to UI interactions, implementing loading states, or creating delightful user experiences.

description: EAS service (paid). Run and control a user's app on a remote iOS/Android simulator hosted on EAS cloud. Read before running any `eas simulator:*` commands - it has the current syntax for this experimental API. Use whenever the user needs a simulator they can't run locally - 'run my app on a cloud simulator', 'use eas simulator to run/install/screenshot my app', 'I'm on Linux/Cursor and need an iOS device', 'no sim on this box / headless CI', 'let an agent click through my app and screenshot it', 'test my dev build on a remote sim with live reload', 'stream a sim to my browser' - even when they don't say 'EAS Simulator' or 'cloud'. On a host WITHOUT a local simulator (Linux, CI, cloud sandbox) it's the default; on macOS, do NOT auto-trigger for a plain 'run on the simulator' - use it only for a cloud/remote/shareable sim, an iOS version they lack, or an agent-driven session. NOT for local sims (expo run:ios, Xcode, Android Studio), EAS Build/Update, web preview, or physical devices.
description_zh: EAS 服务（付费）。在 EAS 云端托管的远程 iOS/Android 模拟器上，运行和控制用户的 App。运行任何 `eas simulator:*` 命令之前请阅读——它包含该实验性 API 的当前语法。当用户需要无法在本地运行的模拟器时，随时使用——例如：“在云模拟器上运行我的 App”、“使用 eas simulator 运行/安装/截图我的 App”、“我在 Linux/Cursor 上，需要一台 iOS 设备”、“本机没有模拟器 / 无头 CI”、“让代理点击完成我的 App 并截图”、“在支持实时重载的远程模拟器上测试我的开发构建”、“将模拟器流送到我的浏览器”——即使用户没有提到“EAS Simulator”或“cloud”。在**没有本地模拟器**的主机（Linux、CI、云沙箱）上，它是默认选项；在 macOS 上，不要为单纯的“在模拟器上运行”自动触发——仅用于云/远程/可共享的模拟器、用户缺少的 iOS 版本，或代理驱动的会话。**不用于**本地模拟器（expo run:ios、Xcode、Android Studio）、EAS Build/Update、网页预览或实体设备。

description: Drive a Next.js route to instant navigation by setting up an agentic loop, under Cache Components / PPR, on initial load (hard navigation) and client-side navigation (soft navigation). Encode the goal as a failing @next/playwright instant() e2e and work it to green, one verified route at a time; the shipped test then guards against regression. Use when asked to make a route's navigation instant (its static shell commits immediately), fix a route whose static shell isn't prerendered/served/prefetched, grow a route's static shell or fix its slow first paint, diagnose which Suspense boundary keeps a route out of its static shell, or write the instant() e2e guard for one. Requires Next.js 16.3+ with cacheComponents; directs an upgrade if older.
description_zh:
通过设置智能体循环，使 Next.js 路由在 Cache Components / PPR 下，于初始加载（硬导航）和客户端导航（软导航）时实现即时导航。将目标编码为一个失败的 @next/playwright instant() 端到端测试，并逐条已验证路由将其推进至通过状态；已发布的测试将防范回归问题。

当被要求实现路由导航即时（其静态外壳立即提交）、修复静态外壳未进行预渲染、提供或预取的路由、扩展路由的静态外壳或修复首屏渲染缓慢、诊断是哪个 Suspense 边界导致路由脱离其静态外壳，或为该路由编写 instant() 端到端测试防护时使用。

要求使用配备 cacheComponents 功能的 Next.js 16.3 或更高版本；若版本过低，将引导升级。

Use when user asks what smart money or KOLs are buying, wants whale alerts, on-chain alpha, copy-trade signals, or wants to check a wallet's followed tokens. description: [FINANCIAL EXECUTION] Buy and sell meme coins and crypto tokens on Solana, BSC, Base, or Ethereum — single swap, multi-wallet batch trading, limit orders, stop loss, take profit, trailing stop loss, trailing take profit via GMGN API. Requires explicit user confirmation. Use when user asks to buy, sell, or swap a token, trade from multiple wallets, set a limit order, stop loss, take profit, or check order status. This skill SUBMITS the trade — it is the only skill holding a private key, and every buy still ends here. It is not the entry point for a buy that has not been vetted yet: 「帮我买 200u 的 PENGU」, "buy me $500 of BONK", 「帮我买点 dogwifhat」, 「XX 能不能买」 start at gmgn-token-buy, which resolves the name to the one right contract among its copycats, gates volume / depth / security, sizes slippage and gas, then hands the confirmed parameters back here to execute. Come straight here for a buy only once the contract is settled AND the user says they do not want a pre-buy check ("skip the security check", "I already checked", 「直接买」, 「不用尽调」, 「我很急」). Two facts make the split unavoidable rather than a preference: the pre-swap check here reads only `is_honeypot` and `rug_ratio`, and there is no name resolution at all — `--output-token` takes a contract address and the only names resolved here are the SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC currencies — so a same-name copycat is a total loss this skill has no way to catch. Everything else is unchanged and unconditionally this skill's: selling, percentage sells, swaps, multi-wallet batch trading, limit orders, stop loss, take profit, trailing orders, order status, gas prices.
description_zh:
[FINANCIAL EXECUTION] 在 Solana、BSC、Base 或 Ethereum 上买卖 meme 币和加密代币——通过 GMGN API 支持单次兑换、多钱包批量交易、限价单、止损、止盈、跟踪止损、跟踪止盈。需要明确的用户确认。当用户要求买入、卖出或兑换代币、从多个钱包交易、设置限价单、止损、止盈或查询订单状态时使用。

本技能提交交易——它是唯一持有私钥的技能，且所有买入最终都会在此完成。它不是尚未经过审查的买入的入口：例如「帮我买 200u 的 PENGU」、「buy me $500 of BONK」、「帮我买点 dogwifhat」、「XX 能不能买」这类请求，应从 gmgn-token-buy 开始——该命令将名称解析为同类仿品中正确的合约，对成交量/深度/安全性进行把关，确定滑点和 gas，然后将确认的参数返回至此执行。

只有在合约已确认且用户表示不需要前置买入检查（如「跳过安全检查」、「我已经检查过了」、「直接买」、「不用尽调」、「我很急」）时，才直接在此买入。将此处与前端的区分是必然的而非偏好，由两个事实决定：此处的兑换前检查仅读取 `is_honeypot` 和 `rug_ratio`，完全不进行名称解析——`--output-token` 接收合约地址，此处仅解析 SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC 等货币名称——因此，同名仿品将是全部损失，本技能无法识别。

其余内容均未改变，无条件属于本技能的范畴：卖出、按比例卖出、兑换、多钱包批量交易、限价单、止损、止盈、跟踪订单、订单状态、 gas 价格。
