description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Create modern Angular standalone components following v20+ best practices. Use for building UI components with signal-based inputs/outputs, OnPush change detection, host bindings, content projection, and lifecycle hooks. Triggers on component creation, refactoring class-based inputs to signals, adding host bindings, or implementing accessible interactive components.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 该技能已不再维护。请改用位于 https://github.com/angular/skills 的官方 Angular 技能。按照 v20+ 最佳实践创建现代化的 Angular 独立组件。该技能用于构建具备基于信号的输入/输出、OnPush 变更检测、host 绑定、内容投影和生命周期钩子的 UI 组件。当创建组件、将基于类的输入重构为基于信号、添加 host 绑定，或实现可访问的交互式组件时触发。

description: Establishes a project's quality bar as a written contract and stops agents quietly lowering it. Interviews the user on which dimensions matter, supplies sane default thresholds when they have no number in mind, records everything in CONSTRAINTS.md, and watches the diff for a weakened bar — new @ts-ignore or eslint-disable suppressions, skipped or deleted tests, assertions stripped out, unimplemented stubs, thresholds edited down. Use when no quality bar is written down, when the user says "set up constraints" or "define our standards", when the user wants dimensions they care about — accessibility, web performance, coverage — set up as enforced constraints, when an agent keeps silencing checks or skipping tests to get to green, when you need a coverage or performance threshold and don't know what number to pick, or when an agent writes more code than anyone will read.
description_zh:
将项目的质量门槛确立为书面合同，阻止代理人为求省事悄然降低标准。通过与用户访谈确定哪些维度至关重要，为其提供合理的默认阈值，并将所有内容记录在 CONSTRAINTS.md 中，同时监控 diff，留意质量门槛被削弱的迹象——例如出现新的 @ts-ignore 或 eslint-disable 抑制性代码、跳过或删除的测试、被移除的断言、未实现的桩函数，或阈值被调低的情况。

适用场景：当项目未书面确立质量标准时；当用户提出"设置约束""定义我们的标准"时；当用户希望将其重视的维度（如无障碍性、网页性能、覆盖率）设为强制约束时；当代理人为追求绿色结果而持续抑制检查或跳过测试时；当需要确定覆盖率或性能阈值却不确定应选用何数值时；或当代理人为写入超出任何人都愿意阅读的代码量时。

description: Run AI apps via inference.sh CLI - image generation, video creation, LLMs, search, 3D, Twitter automation. Models: FLUX, Veo, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Seedance, OmniHuman, Tavily, Exa, OpenRouter, and many more. Use when running AI apps, generating images/videos, calling LLMs, web search, or automating Twitter. Triggers: inference.sh, infsh, ai model, run ai, serverless ai, ai api, flux, veo, claude api, image generation, video generation, openrouter, tavily, exa search, twitter api, grok
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 运行 AI 应用——图像生成、视频创建、大语言模型（LLMs）、搜索、3D、推特自动化。模型：FLUX、Veo、Gemini、Grok、Claude、Seedance、OmniHuman、Tavily、Exa、OpenRouter 等更多模型。适用于运行 AI 应用、生成图像/视频、调用大语言模型（LLMs）、网页搜索或自动化推特。触发词：inference.sh、infsh、ai model、run ai、serverless ai、ai api、flux、veo、claude api、image generation、video generation、openrouter、tavily、exa search、twitter api、grok

description: Proven workflow architectural patterns from real n8n workflows. Use when building new workflows, designing workflow structure, choosing workflow patterns, planning workflow architecture, or asking about webhook processing, HTTP API integration, database operations, AI agent workflows, batch processing, or scheduled tasks. Always consult this skill when the user asks to create, build, or design an n8n workflow, automate a process, or connect services — even if they don't explicitly mention 'patterns'. Covers webhook, API, database, AI, batch processing, and scheduled automation architectures. Also use when optimizing a slow workflow or speeding up large-item-count processing (node count, batchSize, all-items vs per-item).
description_zh: 源自真实 n8n 工作流经实践验证的架构模式。在构建新工作流、设计工作流结构、选择工作流模式、规划工作流架构，或询问 Webhook 处理、HTTP API 集成、数据库操作、AI Agent 工作流、批量处理、定时任务时使用。始终咨询此技能，当用户要求创建、构建或设计 n8n 工作流、自动化流程或连接服务时——即使用户未明确提及"模式"。涵盖 Webhook、API、数据库、AI、批量处理和定时自动化架构。此外，在优化缓慢工作流或加速大量项目处理（节点数量、batchSize、全部项目与逐项处理）时使用。

description: Design, organize, and manage Helm charts for templating and packaging Kubernetes applications with reusable configurations. Use when creating Helm charts, packaging Kubernetes applications, or implementing templated deployments.
description_zh: 设计、组织和管理 Helm charts，用于模板化和打包带有可复用配置的 Kubernetes 应用。适用于创建 Helm charts、打包 Kubernetes 应用或实施模板化部署。

description: Design presentation visuals and slide layouts. Create visual concepts, suggest graphics, and provide design specifications for impactful PowerPoint slides.
description_zh: 设计演示视觉与幻灯片布局。创建视觉概念，建议图形，并为具有影响力的PowerPoint幻灯片提供设计规范。

description: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh. Navigate web pages, interact with elements using @e refs, take screenshots, record video. Capabilities: web scraping, form filling, clicking, typing, drag-drop, file upload, JavaScript execution. Use for: web automation, data extraction, testing, agent browsing, research. Triggers: browser, web automation, scrape, navigate, click, fill form, screenshot, browse web, playwright, headless browser, web agent, surf internet, record video
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh 为 AI 代理提供浏览器自动化。

导航网页，使用 @e 引用与元素交互，截取屏幕截图，录制视频。

功能：网络爬取、表单填写、点击、输入、拖放、文件上传、JavaScript 执行。

用途：网页自动化、数据提取、测试、代理浏览、研究。

触发词：浏览器、网页自动化、爬取、导航、点击、填写表单、截取屏幕截图、浏览网页、Playwright、无头浏览器、网页代理、浏览互联网、录制视频

description: Ready-to-use prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution
description_zh: 用于全面 .NET 框架升级分析与执行的即用型提示

description: Programmatic Tavily search with context isolation. Use when web search or extraction will return large results that need filtering, deduplication, or multi-step triage before they enter the model context. Use tavily-search for ordinary lookups and tavily-research for end-to-end cited synthesis.
description_zh: 程序化 Tavily 搜索与上下文隔离。当网络搜索或提取将返回大量需要过滤、去重或多步筛选后方可进入模型上下文的结果时，使用此功能。普通检索使用 tavily-search，端到端引用综合使用 tavily-research。

description: Three.js shaders - GLSL, ShaderMaterial, uniforms, custom effects. Use when creating custom visual effects, modifying vertices, writing fragment shaders, or extending built-in materials.
description_zh: Three.js 着色器 - GLSL、ShaderMaterial、uniforms、自定义效果。用于创建自定义视觉效果、修改顶点、编写片段着色器或扩展内置材质。

description: Implement memory-safe programming with RAII, ownership, smart pointers, and resource management across Rust, C++, and C. Use when writing safe systems code, managing resources, or preventing memory bugs.
description_zh: 使用 RAII、所有权、智能指针和资源管理，在 Rust、C++ 和 C 中实现内存安全编程。适用于编写安全系统代码、管理资源或防止内存错误。

description: Make a web app feel native on a phone — the small CSS and meta-tag fixes that separate "a website in a browser" from something that feels installed. Covers sticky hover states, tap highlight flashes, the 100vh bug, inputs that zoom the page, laggy taps, pull-to-refresh hijacking scroll, content under the notch, long-press selecting button text, carousels that scroll the wrong way, mismatched status bars, and the rule that you test on real hardware. Use when a web app is being built for or reviewed on mobile, when something "works in Chrome but feels wrong on my phone", when building a PWA, a bottom sheet, a carousel, a full-screen layout, or any touch interaction. For motion itself use animate; for React Native use animate-expo.
description_zh: 让网页应用在手机上呈现出原生感——那些将“浏览器中的网站”与“仿佛已安装的应用”区分开来的细微 CSS 与元标签修复方案。涵盖固定悬停状态、点击高亮闪烁、100vh 问题、会导致页面缩放的输入框、延迟的点击、下拉刷新劫持滚动、刘海屏下方的内容、长按选中按钮文字、反向滚动的轮播、状态栏不匹配，以及“必须在真实硬件上测试”这一原则。当为移动端构建或审查网页应用时使用，当遇到“在 Chrome 中运行正常，但在手机上感觉不对”的情况时使用，以及在构建 PWA、底部弹层、轮播、全屏布局或任何触控交互时使用。对于动效，请使用 animate；对于 React Native，请使用 animate-expo。

description: Scrape web content as clean markdown/HTML/JSON via the Bright Data CLI (`bdata scrape`). Use when the user wants to fetch a page, extract content from a list of URLs, or crawl paginated listings. Hands off to `data-feeds` for supported platforms (Amazon, LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, etc.) and to `search` when URLs must be discovered first. Requires the Bright Data CLI; proactively guides install + login if missing.
description_zh: 通过 Bright Data CLI (`bdata scrape`) 以干净的 Markdown/HTML/JSON 格式抓取网页内容。当用户需要获取页面、从一组 URL 中提取内容，或爬取分页列表时使用。对于支持的平台（Amazon、LinkedIn、TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Reddit 等），将任务转交给 `data-feeds`；当必须首先发现 URL 时，则转交给 `search`。需要 Bright Data CLI；若缺失，主动指导安装与登录。

description: Diagnose and fix excessive Postgres egress (network data transfer) in a codebase. Use when a user mentions high database bills, unexpected data transfer costs, network transfer charges, egress spikes, "why is my Neon bill so high", "database costs jumped", SELECT * optimization, query overfetching, reduce Neon costs, optimize database usage, or wants to reduce data sent from their database to their application. Also use when reviewing query patterns for cost efficiency, even if the user doesn't explicitly mention egress or data transfer.
description_zh: 在代码库中诊断并修复过量的 Postgres 出网流量（网络数据传输）问题。适用于当用户提及数据库账单过高、意外数据传输成本、网络传输费用、出网流量激增、“我的 Neon 账单为何如此高昂”、“数据库成本突然上涨”、SELECT * 优化、查询过度获取数据、降低 Neon 成本、优化数据库使用，或希望减少从数据库发送到应用程序的数据等情况时。此外，即使用户未明确提及出网流量或数据传输，当需要审查查询模式以提升成本效率时，也应使用此功能。

description: Ensure that Java types are documented with Javadoc comments and follow best practices for documentation.
description_zh: 确保Java类型通过Javadoc注释进行文档说明，并遵循文档最佳实践。

description: Choose when the user needs **Shopify CLI** to run or fix something now: validate app or extension config on disk (`shopify.app.toml`, `shopify.app.<name>.toml`, `shopify.extension.toml`); run or troubleshoot store workflows (`shopify store auth`, `shopify store execute`); or perform explicit store-scoped reads/writes on a named store domain (for example, show/list/find the first 10 products on my store at `foo.myshopify.com`, or inventory and product changes by handle, SKU, or location name). Emphasize **commands and operational steps**, not only authoring GraphQL. Skip for API-only understanding or codegen with no CLI execution, and skip for brand-new merchant asks to start a Shopify store or try Shopify before they have an account. Examples: validate configuration before deploy; run an existing query via CLI; show the first 10 products on `foo.myshopify.com`; missing `shopify store execute`.
description_zh: 当需要让 **Shopify CLI** 立即执行或修复某些任务时，请选择以下情况：在磁盘上验证应用或扩展配置（`shopify.app.toml`、`shopify.app.<name>.toml`、`shopify.extension.toml`）；运行或排查店铺工作流（`shopify store auth`、`shopify store execute`）；或在指定的店铺域名上进行显式的、以店铺为范围的读写操作（例如，在 `foo.myshopify.com` 我的店铺上显示/列出/查找前 10 个商品，或按 handle、SKU 或位置名称进行库存和产品变更操作）。重点强调**命令与操作步骤**，而不仅仅是编写 GraphQL 代码。以下情况应跳过：仅用于 API 理解或无需 CLI 执行的代码生成；以及新商家尚未拥有账户时，需要启动 Shopify 店铺或初次尝试 Shopify 的请求。示例：部署前验证配置；通过 CLI 运行现有查询；在 `foo.myshopify.com` 显示前 10 个商品；缺少 `shopify store execute`。

description: Build your app's primary user interface embedded in the Shopify admin using the **iframe** model — a web app you host yourself, rendered with `@shopify/polaris-types` and App Bridge. Covers the Intents API (`shopify.intents.invoke`) for launching native workflows from App Home. For the Shopify-hosted `admin.app.home.render` extension target, use **`polaris-admin-extensions`** instead. If the prompt just mentions `Polaris` and you can't tell based off of the context what API they meant, assume they meant this API.
description_zh: 使用**iframe**模型构建嵌入Shopify管理后台的应用主用户界面——即由您自行托管的网页应用，使用`@shopify/polaris-types`和App Bridge渲染。涵盖从App Home启动原生工作流的Intents API（`shopify.intents.invoke`）。对于Shopify托管的`admin.app.home.render`扩展目标，请改用**`polaris-admin-extensions`**。如果提示词仅提到`Polaris`且根据上下文无法判断其所指的API，则默认其指的是此API。

description: Provide evidence-grounded mock peer review of scientific manuscripts or excerpts, covering significance, validity, and major/minor concerns. Use for 模拟审稿、投稿前自审、审稿人视角评估; not author rebuttal drafting.
description_zh: 提供基于证据的模拟同行评审，对科学论文或摘录进行评审，涵盖其重要性、有效性和主要/次要问题。用于 模拟审稿、投稿前自审、审稿人视角评估；不用于作者回复草拟。

description: Svelte 5 runes, snippets, SvelteKit patterns, and modern best practices for TypeScript and component development. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Svelte 5 components and SvelteKit applications. Triggers on: Svelte components, runes ($state, $derived, $effect, $props, $bindable, $inspect), snippets ({#snippet}, {@render}), event handling, SvelteKit data loading, form actions, Svelte 4 to Svelte 5 migration, store to rune migration, slots to snippets migration, TypeScript props typing, generic components, SSR state isolation, performance optimization, or component testing.
description_zh: Svelte 5 runes、snippets、SvelteKit 模式，以及针对 TypeScript 和组件开发的现代最佳实践。适用于编写、审查或重构 Svelte 5 组件和 SvelteKit 应用程序。触发场景包括：Svelte 组件、runes（$state、$derived、$effect、$props、$bindable、$inspect）、snippets（{#snippet}、{@render}）、事件处理、SvelteKit 数据加载、表单操作、从 Svelte 4 到 Svelte 5 的迁移、从 store 到 rune 的迁移、从 slots 到 snippets 的迁移、TypeScript props 类型定义、泛型组件、SSR 状态隔离、性能优化或组件测试。

description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.
description_zh: 面向多步骤AI智能体工作的基于文件的持久化规划。将 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 保留在磁盘上；生命周期钩子注入所选项目规划上下文。自动恢复仅读取项目规划文件。显式调用 session-catchup.py --metadata 仅读取同项目本地智能体会话记录并仅输出汇总计数；--replay 可能输出受 nonce 边界限制的片段。可选的门控模式仅在宿主系统支持时请求续传，且绝不执行 Markdown 中声明的命令。该技能无网络上传路径。适用于需要 5+ 次工具调用的研究或工作。

description: Darwin Skill 2.0 (达尔文.skill 2.0): autonomous skill optimizer, v2.0 integrates Microsoft Research SkillLens (arXiv 2605.23899) 9-dim rubric + SkillOpt (arXiv 2605.23904) validation-gated design + human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Evaluates SKILL.md files using a 9-dimension rubric (structure + effectiveness + meta-skill blacklists), runs hill-climbing with git version control, spawns independent judge agents for blind evaluation, validates improvements through test prompts with auto-break on diminishing returns, and generates visual result cards. Use when user mentions "优化skill", "skill评分", "自动优化", "auto optimize", "skill质量检查", "达尔文", "darwin", "帮我改改skill", "skill怎么样", "提升skill质量", "skill review", "skill打分".
description_zh: 达尔文 Skill 2.0（达尔文.skill 2.0）：自主技能优化器。v2.0 整合了 Microsoft Research SkillLens（arXiv 2605.23899）的 9 维评分标准 + SkillOpt（arXiv 2605.23904）的验证门控设计 + 人在回路检查点。使用 9 维评分标准（结构 + 有效性 + 元技能黑名单）评估 SKILL.md 文件，以 git 版本控制运行爬山优化，为盲评生成独立评判 agent，通过测试提示词验证改进，在边际收益递减时自动中断，并生成可视化结果卡片。当用户提及“优化skill”、“skill评分”、“自动优化”、“auto optimize”、“skill质量检查”、“达尔文”、“darwin”、“帮我改改skill”、“skill怎么样”、“提升skill质量”、“skill review”、“skill打分”时使用。

description: Reviews your work across multiple categories like UI, typography, layout, color, writing and accessibility and gives you a detailed analysis of the findings.
description_zh: 从UI、排版、布局、色彩、写作和无障碍等多个类别对您的作品进行评审，并为您提供详细的发现分析。

description: Create a formal specification for an existing GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow, optimized for AI consumption and workflow maintenance.
description_zh: 为现有 GitHub Actions CI/CD 工作流创建正式规范，使其面向 AI 消费与工作流维护进行优化。

description: Get best practices for C# async programming
description_zh: 获取 C# 异步编程的最佳实践

description: Optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI through resource rightsizing, tagging strategies, reserved instances, and spending analysis. Use when reducing cloud expenses, analyzing infrastructure costs, or implementing cost governance policies.
description_zh: 通过资源优化调整、标签策略、预留实例和支出分析，优化AWS、Azure、GCP和OCI的云成本。在减少云支出、分析基础设施成本或实施成本治理政策时使用。

description: Vue 3 Options API style (data(), methods, this context). Each reference shows Options API solution only.
description_zh: Vue 3 选项式API风格（data()、方法、this上下文）。每个示例仅展示选项式API解决方案。

description: Implement GitOps workflows with ArgoCD and Flux for automated, declarative Kubernetes deployments with continuous reconciliation. Use when implementing GitOps practices, automating Kubernetes deployments, or setting up declarative infrastructure management.
description_zh: 使用 ArgoCD 与 Flux 实现 GitOps 工作流，实现具备持续对账功能的自动化、声明式 Kubernetes 部署。适用于实现 GitOps 实践、自动化 Kubernetes 部署或搭建声明式基础设施管理。

description: CLI tools for Svelte 5 documentation lookup and code analysis. MUST be used whenever creating, editing or analyzing any Svelte component (.svelte) or Svelte module (.svelte.ts/.svelte.js). If possible, this skill should be executed within the svelte-file-editor agent for optimal results.
description_zh: Svelte 5 文档查找与代码分析的命令行工具。在创建、编辑或分析任何 Svelte 组件（.svelte）或 Svelte 模块（.svelte.ts/.svelte.js）时，必须使用。如果可能，此技能应在 svelte-file-editor agent 内执行，以获得最佳效果。

description: Python resilience patterns including automatic retries, exponential backoff, timeouts, and fault-tolerant decorators. Use when adding retry logic, implementing timeouts, building fault-tolerant services, or handling transient failures.
description_zh: Python 韧性模式，涵盖自动重试、指数退避、超时和容错装饰器等。适用于添加重试逻辑、实现超时、构建容错服务或处理瞬时故障等场景。

description: Gemini-native Nano Banana image generation and editing across Nano Banana, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro. Use when you need text-to-image, image-to-image edits, repeated local references, batch generation, dry-run request inspection, or a custom Gemini-compatible base URL such as a self-hosted gateway.
description_zh: 基于Gemini原生的Nano Banana图像生成与编辑功能，支持Nano Banana、Nano Banana 2和Nano Banana Pro。适用于需要文本到图像生成、图像到图像编辑、重复本地引用、批量生成、试运行请求检查，或自定义Gemini兼容基础URL（如自托管网关）的场景。

description: Python observability patterns including structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. Use when adding logging, implementing metrics collection, setting up tracing, or debugging production systems.
description_zh: Python 可观测性模式，包括结构化日志记录、指标和分布式追踪。用于添加日志、实现指标收集、配置追踪或调试生产系统时。

description: Shopify Functions allow developers to customize the backend logic that powers parts of Shopify. Available APIs: Discount, Cart and Checkout Validation, Cart Transform, Pickup Point Delivery Option Generator, Delivery Customization, Fulfillment Constraints, Local Pickup Delivery Option Generator, Order Routing Location Rule, Payment Customization
description_zh: Shopify Functions 允许开发者自定义驱动 Shopify 各部分的后端逻辑。可用的 API：折扣、购物车和结账验证、购物车转换、取货点配送选项生成器、配送定制、履约约束、本地取货配送选项生成器、订单路由位置规则、支付定制。

description: Search live flight fares for a route and date across Agoda, Trip.com, and Traveloka — one-way or round-trip, any cabin, with airline, times, stops, duration, and a direct booking link. Use when the user wants flight prices, plane or air tickets, cheap flights or airfare between two cities, comparing airlines for travel dates, or planning the flying leg of a trip.
description_zh: 在 Agoda、Trip.com 和 Traveloka 等平台搜索指定航线与日期的实时航班价格——支持单程或往返、任意舱位，并提供航空公司、时间、经停点、飞行时长及直接预订链接。适用于用户需要查询航班价格、购买机票或航票、获取两城市间廉价航班或机票价格、对比出行日期的航空公司，或规划行程中飞行环节的场景。

description: Compare live hotel room rates across Booking.com, Agoda, Traveloka, and OpenTravel for specific dates — which OTA is cheapest for the same property, per-room prices, and free-cancellation terms. Use when comparing hotel prices, checking room rates for a named hotel, asking which site is cheaper, or finding the best rate for given check-in/check-out dates.
description_zh:
针对特定日期，跨 Booking.com、Agoda、Traveloka 和 OpenTravel 比较实时酒店房型价格——了解同一酒店在各 OTA 上的最低价格、每间房价格及免费取消条款。

适用于比较酒店价格、查询指定酒店房型价格、询问哪个平台价格更低，或为给定的入住/退房日期查找最优价格。

description: Upgrades React Native apps to newer versions by applying rn-diff-purge template diffs, updating package.json dependencies, migrating native iOS and Android configuration, resolving CocoaPods and Gradle changes, and handling breaking API updates. Use when upgrading React Native, bumping RN version, updating from RN 0.x to 0.y, or migrating Expo SDK alongside a React Native upgrade.
description_zh: 将 React Native 应用升级到新版本，具体方法包括应用 rn-diff-purge 模板差异、更新 package.json 依赖项、迁移 iOS 和 Android 原生配置、处理 CocoaPods 和 Gradle 变更，并处理破坏性 API 更新。适用于升级 React Native、提升 RN 版本、从 RN 0.x 更新至 0.y，或在升级 React Native 的同时迁移 Expo SDK 的场景。

description: Python configuration management via environment variables and typed settings. Use when externalizing config, setting up pydantic-settings, managing secrets, or implementing environment-specific behavior.
description_zh: 通过环境变量和类型化设置管理 Python 配置。在外部化配置、配置 pydantic-settings、管理密钥或实现环境特定行为时使用。

description: Search hotels live across Agoda + Booking.com + Traveloka + OpenTravel with realtime pricing for specific dates. Use when user wants hotel prices for travel dates, comparing OTAs, or finding rooms.
description_zh: 在Agoda、Booking.com、Traveloka和OpenTravel平台实时搜索酒店，针对具体日期提供实时定价。当用户需要查询旅行日期的酒店价格、比较OTA平台或寻找房间时使用。

description: Recommend hotel rooms and complete a real booking end to end — reserve an OpenTravel direct property with a payment link (bank QR, card, or PayPal), check payment status, resend an expired link, or cancel a booking. Falls back to direct Booking.com/Agoda/Traveloka links for OTA-only hotels. Use when booking or reserving a hotel, getting room recommendations, paying for a stay, checking a confirmation code, or cancelling a reservation.
description_zh: 推荐酒店房间并端到端完成实际预订——预订 OpenTravel 直营房源并附带支付链接（银行二维码、卡片或 PayPal），检查支付状态、重新发送已失效链接，或取消预订。对于仅 OTA 的酒店，回退至 Booking.com/Agoda/Traveloka 的直接链接。用于预订或预留酒店、获取房间推荐、为住宿付费、核对确认码或取消预订。

description: Generate short AI videos from text or images — text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-based generation — with zero API key setup. Use when the user wants to create a video clip, animate an image, or generate video from a description.
description_zh: 从文本或图像生成短AI视频——支持文本转视频、图像转视频及基于参考的生成——无需配置API密钥。当用户想要创建视频片段、动画图像或根据描述生成视频时使用。

description: Select and optimize embedding models for semantic search and RAG applications. Use when choosing embedding models, implementing chunking strategies, or optimizing embedding quality for specific domains.
description_zh: 为语义搜索及RAG（检索增强生成）应用选择并优化嵌入模型。适用于选择嵌入模型、实施分块策略，或针对特定领域优化嵌入质量时。

description: Develop, debug, and deploy Apify Actors - serverless cloud programs for web scraping, automation, and data processing. Use when creating new Actors, modifying existing ones, or troubleshooting Actor code.
description_zh: 开发、调试并部署 Apify Actors——用于网页抓取、自动化和数据处理的无服务器云端程序。在创建新 Actors、修改现有 Actors 或排查 Actor 代码问题时使用。

description: Generate a complete MCP server project in Python with tools, resources, and proper configuration
description_zh: 使用 Python 生成一个包含工具、资源和正确配置的完整 MCP 服务器项目。

description: Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM for market opportunities using top-down, bottom-up, and value theory methodologies. Use this skill when sizing markets, estimating addressable revenue, validating market opportunity for a new venture, or building investor-ready market analysis for a startup pitch or business plan.
description_zh: 使用自上而下、自下而上和价值理论方法，计算市场机会的 TAM/SAM/SOM。在评估市场规模、估算可触及收入、验证新业务的市场机会，或为初创公司路演或商业计划构建面向投资者的市场分析时，使用本技能。

description: Master Go concurrency with goroutines, channels, sync primitives, and context. Use when building concurrent Go applications, implementing worker pools, or debugging race conditions.
description_zh: 通过协程、通道、同步原语和 context，掌握 Go 并发编程。在构建并发 Go 应用、实现工作池或调试竞态条件时使用。

description: Use when a user asks to debug or fix failing GitHub PR checks that run in GitHub Actions; use `gh` to inspect checks and logs, summarize failure context, draft a fix plan, and implement only after explicit approval. Treat external providers (for example Buildkite) as out of scope and report only the details URL.
description_zh: 当用户请求调试或修复在 GitHub Actions 中运行的 GitHub PR 失败检查时使用；使用 `gh` 检查检查项及日志，总结失败背景，草拟修复计划，仅在获得明确批准后实施。将外部提供商（例如 Buildkite）视为不在范围内，仅报告详情 URL。

description: Use when building any system where email content triggers actions — AI agent inboxes, automated support handlers, email-to-task pipelines, or any workflow processing untrusted inbound email. Always use this skill when the user wants to receive emails and act on them programmatically, even if they don't mention "agent" — the skill contains critical security patterns (sender allowlists, content filtering, sandboxed processing) that prevent untrusted email from controlling your system.
description_zh: 适用于构建任何邮件内容会触发操作的系统的场景——包括AI智能体收件箱、自动化支持处理者、邮件转任务流水线，或处理不受信任的入站邮件的工作流处理。当用户希望以编程方式接收邮件并对其采取操作时，请始终使用此技能，即使用户未提及"智能体"——该技能包含关键的安全模式（发件人白名单、内容过滤、沙箱处理），以防止不受信任的邮件控制您的系统。

description: Drive a live marimo notebook as a workspace: run Python in the same kernel the user does, inspect live notebook state, and commit durable notebook changes. Use when the user wants to start a marimo notebook or pair on an active marimo session.
description_zh: 以实时 Marimo 笔记本作为工作区使用：在用户使用的内核中运行 Python，查看实时笔记本状态，并提交持久化的笔记本修改。适用于用户需要启动 Marimo 笔记本或配合正在进行的 Marimo 会话时。

description: Master ShellCheck static analysis configuration and usage for shell script quality. Use when setting up linting infrastructure, fixing code issues, or ensuring script portability.
description_zh: 掌握 ShellCheck 的静态分析配置与用法，以提升 shell 脚本质量。用于搭建 linting 基础设施、修复代码问题或确保脚本可移植性。

description: 把本地文件夹建成 Agent 可稳定查找、收录和维护的知识库，并支持导航、版本判断、健康检查及 SOT 分层治理。用户要求搭建、查询、更新、整理或瘦身知识库时使用。
description_zh: 将本地文件夹构建为 Agent 可稳定查找、收录和维护的知识库，并支持导航、版本判定、健康检查及 SOT 分层治理。供用户在搭建、查询、更新、整理或瘦身知识库时使用。

description: Creates smooth animations and micro-interactions using Framer Motion including page transitions, gestures, scroll-based animations, and orchestrated sequences. Use when users request "add animation", "framer motion", "page transition", "animate component", or "micro-interactions".
description_zh: 使用 Framer Motion 创建流畅的动画与微交互，涵盖页面过渡、手势、滚动驱动动画及编排序列。适用于用户请求“add animation”、“framer motion”、“page transition”、“animate component”或“micro-interactions”的场景。

description: Build automated billing systems for recurring payments, invoicing, subscription lifecycle, and dunning management. Use when implementing subscription billing, automating invoicing, or managing recurring payment systems.
description_zh: 构建用于周期性付款、开票、订阅生命周期及催款管理的自动化计费系统。适用于订阅计费实施、开票自动化或周期性付款系统管理时使用。

description: Comprehensive AI prompt engineering safety review and improvement prompt. Analyzes prompts for safety, bias, security vulnerabilities, and effectiveness while providing detailed improvement recommendations with extensive frameworks, testing methodologies, and educational content.
description_zh: 全面的AI提示工程安全审查与改进提示。该提示分析提示在安全、偏见、安全漏洞及有效性方面的表现，同时提供详尽的改进建议，涵盖广泛框架、测试方法与教育内容。

description: Set up Prometheus for comprehensive metric collection, storage, and monitoring of infrastructure and applications. Use when implementing metrics collection, setting up monitoring infrastructure, or configuring alerting systems.
description_zh: 部署 Prometheus，用于全面收集、存储和监控基础设施及应用的指标。适用于实施指标采集、搭建监控基础设施或配置告警系统时。

description:
Patterns and techniques for evaluating and improving AI agent outputs. Use this skill when:
- Implementing self-critique and reflection loops
- Building evaluator-optimizer pipelines for quality-critical generation
- Creating test-driven code refinement workflows
- Designing rubric-based or LLM-as-judge evaluation systems
- Adding iterative improvement to agent outputs (code, reports, analysis)
- Measuring and improving agent response quality
description_zh:
评估和改进AI智能体输出结果的模式和技巧。当使用此技能时：
- 实现自我批评和反思循环
- 构建评估器-优化器流水线，用于质量关键生成
- 创建测试驱动代码优化工作流程
- 设计基于评分标准或LLM作为评判的评估系统
- 为智能体输出（代码、报告、分析）添加迭代改进
- 衡量并改进智能体回复质量

description: Execute Python code in a safe sandboxed environment via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh). Pre-installed: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, MoviePy, Pillow, OpenCV, trimesh, and 100+ more libraries. Use for: data processing, web scraping, image manipulation, video creation, 3D model processing, PDF generation, API calls, automation scripts. Triggers: python, execute code, run script, web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, 3D models, automation, pandas, matplotlib
description_zh: 在安全沙盒环境中通过 [inference.sh](https://inference.sh) 执行 Python 代码。预装：NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, MoviePy, Pillow, OpenCV, trimesh 以及 100 多种其他库。用途：用于数据处理、网络爬取、图像处理、视频制作、3D模型处理、PDF生成、API调用和自动化脚本。触发：python, execute code, run script, web scraping, data analysis, image processing, video editing, 3D models, automation, pandas, matplotlib

description: FastAPI best practices and conventions. Use when working with FastAPI APIs, Pydantic models, dependencies, streaming responses including Server-Sent Events (SSE), and serving frontend apps. Keeps FastAPI code clean and up to date with the latest features and patterns.
description_zh: FastAPI 最佳实践与规范。适用于使用 FastAPI API、Pydantic 模型、依赖、流式响应（包括服务端推送事件 SSE）以及部署前端应用的场景。能够保持 FastAPI 代码整洁，并紧跟最新的功能与模式。

description: Implement data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts. Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts.
description_zh: 使用 Great Expectations、dbt 测试和数据契约实现数据质量校验。适用于构建数据质量流水线、实施校验规则或建立数据契约时。

description: Track, calculate, and optimize key performance metrics for SaaS, marketplace, consumer, and B2B startups from seed through Series A, including unit economics, growth efficiency, and cash management. Use this skill when defining a metrics framework, calculating CAC/LTV/burn multiple, benchmarking business health, or preparing metrics dashboards for investors or board reporting.
description_zh: 为SaaS、市场平台、消费者和B2B初创企业从种子轮到A轮全程追踪、计算和优化关键绩效指标，涵盖单位经济、增长效率和现金流管理。当需要定义指标框架、计算获客成本（CAC）/生命周期价值（LTV）/烧钱倍数、评估业务健康状况或为投资者或董事会报告准备指标仪表盘时，请使用此技能。

description: Create production-ready Kubernetes manifests for Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets following best practices and security standards. Use when generating Kubernetes YAML manifests, creating K8s resources, or implementing production-grade Kubernetes configurations.
description_zh: 按照最佳实践和安全标准，创建生产就绪的 Kubernetes 清单，涵盖 Deployments、Services、ConfigMaps 和 Secrets。适用于生成 Kubernetes YAML 清单、创建 K8s 资源或实施生产级 Kubernetes 配置的场景。

description: Create a Product Requirements Document using a comprehensive 8-section template covering problem, objectives, segments, value propositions, solution, and release planning. Use when writing a PRD, documenting product requirements, preparing a feature spec, or reviewing an existing PRD.
description_zh: 使用涵盖问题、目标、用户群体、价值主张、解决方案和发布规划的综合8节模板，创建产品需求文档。在撰写PRD、记录产品需求、准备功能规格说明或审查现有PRD时使用。

description: Creates and maintains project context artifacts (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a `conductor/` directory. Scaffolds new projects from scratch, extracts context from existing codebases, validates artifact consistency before implementation, and synchronizes documents as the project evolves. Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, defining development workflows, tracking work units, onboarding to an existing codebase, or running project scaffolding.
description_zh: 在 `conductor/` 目录中创建和维护项目上下文制品（product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md）。从零开始搭建新项目，从现有代码库中提取上下文，在实施前验证制品的一致性，并在项目发展过程中同步文档。用于设置项目、创建或更新产品文档、管理技术栈文件、定义开发工作流、跟踪工作单元、加入现有代码库或执行项目搭建。

description: Manage major dependency version upgrades with compatibility analysis, staged rollout, and comprehensive testing. Use when upgrading framework versions, updating major dependencies, or managing breaking changes in libraries.
description_zh: 通过兼容性分析、分阶段发布与全面测试，对主要依赖版本升级进行管理。适用于框架版本升级、主要依赖更新以及库的破坏性变更管理。

description: Get best practices for XUnit unit testing, including data-driven tests
description_zh: 获取XUnit单元测试的最佳实践，包括数据驱动测试

description: Render videos from React/Remotion component code via inference.sh. Pass TSX code, get MP4. Supports all Remotion APIs: useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, AbsoluteFill, Sequence. Configurable resolution, FPS, duration, codec. Use for: programmatic video generation, animated graphics, motion design, data-driven videos, React animations to video. Triggers: remotion, render video from code, tsx to video, react video, programmatic video, remotion render, code to video, animated video, motion graphics code, react animation video
description_zh: 通过inference.sh从React/Remotion组件代码渲染视频，传入TSX代码，获取MP4。支持所有Remotion API：useCurrentFrame、useVideoConfig、spring、interpolate、AbsoluteFill、Sequence。可配置分辨率、FPS、时长、编码器。适用于：程序化视频生成、动画图形、动态设计、数据驱动视频、React动画转视频。触发词：remotion、render video from code、tsx to video、react video、programmatic video、remotion render、code to video、animated video、motion graphics code、react animation video

description: Run AI apps via inference.sh CLI - image generation, video creation, LLMs, search, 3D, Twitter automation. Models: FLUX, Veo, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Seedance, OmniHuman, Tavily, Exa, OpenRouter, and many more. Use when running AI apps, generating images/videos, calling LLMs, web search, or automating Twitter. Triggers: inference.sh, infsh, ai model, run ai, serverless ai, ai api, flux, veo, claude api, image generation, video generation, openrouter, tavily, exa search, twitter api, grok

description: Reviews Swift code for concurrency correctness, modern API usage, and common async/await pitfalls. Use when reading, writing, or reviewing Swift concurrency code.
description_zh: 审查 Swift 代码的并发正确性、现代 API 用法以及常见 async/await 陷阱。在阅读、编写或审查 Swift 并发代码时使用。

description: Python background job patterns including task queues, workers, and event-driven architecture. Use when implementing async task processing, job queues, long-running operations, or decoupling work from request/response cycles.
description_zh: Python 后台任务模式，包括任务队列、工作进程与事件驱动架构。适用于实现异步任务处理、作业队列、长时运行操作，或将工作与请求/响应周期解耦。

description: Operate the Resend platform from the terminal — send emails (including React Email .tsx templates via --react-email), manage domains, contacts, broadcasts, templates, webhooks, API keys, logs, automations, and events via the `resend` CLI. Use when the user wants to run Resend commands in the shell, scripts, or CI/CD pipelines, or send/preview React Email templates. Always load this skill before running `resend` commands — it contains the non-interactive flag contract and gotchas that prevent silent failures.
description_zh: 通过终端操作 Resent 平台——通过 `resent` CLI 发送邮件（包括通过 `--react-email` 发送 React Email .tsx 模板），管理域名、联系人、广播、模板、Webhooks、API 密钥、日志、自动化及事件。当用户需要在 shell、脚本或 CI/CD 流水线中运行 Resent 命令，或发送/预览 React Email 模板时使用。运行 `resent` 命令前，请始终加载本技能——其中包含防止静默失败的参数约定与常见陷阱。

description: Master memory forensics techniques including memory acquisition, process analysis, and artifact extraction using Volatility and related tools. Use when analyzing memory dumps, investigating incidents, or performing malware analysis from RAM captures.
description_zh: 掌握包括内存采集、进程分析及样本提取在内的内存取证核心技术，使用Volatility及相关工具。适用于分析内存转储、调查事件，或基于内存抓取执行恶意软件分析。

description: Create an Architectural Decision Record (ADR) document for AI-optimized decision documentation.
description_zh: 创建用于 AI 优化的决策文档的架构决策记录（ADR）文档。

description_zh: 使用 inference.sh 命令行工具运行 AI 应用 - 图像生成、视频创建、大语言模型、搜索、3D、Twitter 自动化。模型：FLUX、Veo、Gemini、Grok、Claude、Seedance、OmniHuman、Tavily、Exa、OpenRouter 等更多模型。适用于运行 AI 应用、生成图像/视频、调用大语言模型、网页搜索或自动化 Twitter 的场景。触发词：inference.sh, infsh, ai model, run ai, serverless ai, ai api, flux, veo, claude api, image generation, video generation, openrouter, tavily, exa search, twitter api, grok

Three.js geometry creation - built-in shapes, BufferGeometry, custom geometry, instancing. Use when creating 3D shapes, working with vertices, building custom meshes, or optimizing with instanced rendering.

description_zh: Vue 中的 JSX 语法（例如 class 与 className 的区别、JSX 插件配置）。

description: Prompt for creating Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) for new features, based on an Epic.
description_zh: 基于一个Epic创建新功能产品需求文档（PRDs）的提示词。

description: Record a video of an iOS simulator or Android emulator/device screen using argent MCP tools. Use when the user asks to record the screen, capture a video of a flow, interaction, or animation, produce a screen recording, or document app behavior as a video clip.
description_zh: 使用 argent MCP 工具记录 iOS 模拟器或 Android 模拟器/设备屏幕视频。适用于用户要求录制屏幕、捕捉流程、交互或动画的视频、生成屏幕录像，或将应用程序行为记录为视频片段等场景。

description: HeroUI Native component library for React Native (Tailwind v4 via Uniwind). Use when building mobile UIs with HeroUI Native — creating Buttons, Cards, TextFields, Dialogs; installing heroui-native; configuring dark/light themes; or fetching component docs. Keywords: HeroUI Native, heroui-native, React Native UI, Uniwind, mobile components.
description_zh:
用于 React Native 的 HeroUI Native 组件库（通过 Uniwind 使用 Tailwind v4）。使用 HeroUI Native 构建移动界面时，可用于创建按钮、卡片、文本输入框、对话框；安装 heroui-native；配置深色/浅色主题；或获取组件文档。

关键词：HeroUI Native、heroui-native、React Native 界面、Uniwind、移动组件。

description: Skill for using the command-line tool pdftk (PDFtk Server) for working with PDF files. Use when asked to merge PDFs, split PDFs, rotate pages, encrypt or decrypt PDFs, fill PDF forms, apply watermarks, stamp overlays, extract metadata, burst documents into pages, repair corrupted PDFs, attach or extract files, or perform any PDF manipulation from the command line.
description_zh: 使用命令行工具 pdftk (PDFtk Server) 处理 PDF 文件的技能。当要求合并 PDF、分割 PDF、旋转页面、加密或解密 PDF、填写 PDF 表单、添加水印、印章叠加、提取元数据、将文档拆分页面、修复损坏的 PDF、附加或提取文件，或从命令行执行任何 PDF 处理操作时使用。

description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.
description_zh: 构建生产环境的 Apache Airflow DAG，遵循算子、传感器、测试和部署的最佳实践。适用于创建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批量任务。

description: Use this skill for token-level data: search tokens, trending/hot tokens (热门, 代币榜单), liquidity pools, holder distribution (whale/巨鲸, sniper, bundler-tagged holder %), token risk metadata (riskControlLevel, tokenTags, dev stats, suspicious/bundle holding % via advanced-info), recent buy/sell activity, trade feed/逐笔成交/每笔交易/stream trades, top profit addresses, token trade history, detailed price info with market cap volume liquidity and holder count (price-info), or holder cluster analysis (持仓集中度, cluster overview, cluster rug pull risk/跑路风险, new wallet percentage/新钱包持仓比例, holder clusters, 'are top holders in same cluster'). Also handles Market API payment/计费/x402/402, Basic/Premium tier/quota/额度 questions, and MARKET_API_*_OVER_QUOTA / confirming:true responses on token endpoints (advanced-info, top-trader, cluster-*, trades, hot-tokens). NOTE: if the user wants to write a WebSocket script/脚本/bot, use okx-dex-ws instead.
description_zh: 使用此技能处理代币级别数据：代币搜索、热门代币/代币榜单、流动性池、持有者分布（巨鲸/whale、sniper、捆绑标签持有者百分比）、代币风险元数据（riskControlLevel、tokenTags、开发者统计、可疑/捆绑持有百分比，通过 advanced-info 高级信息获取）、近期买卖活动、交易流/逐笔成交/每笔交易/流式交易（stream trades）、最高收益地址、代币交易历史、详细价格信息（含市值、成交量、流动性及持有者数量，price-info），或持有者集群分析（持仓集中度、集群概览、集群跑路风险、新钱包持仓比例、持有者集群、头部持有者是否在同一集群）。此外，还处理 Market API 的支付/计费/x402/402、Basic/高级（Premium）版本及额度相关问题，以及代币端点的 MARKET_API_*_OVER_QUOTA 响应和 confirming:true 响应（advanced-info、top-trader、cluster-*、trades、hot-tokens）。注意：如果用户需要编写 WebSocket 脚本/脚本/机器人，请使用 okx-dex-ws 替代。

description: Web search and content extraction with Tavily and Exa via inference.sh CLI. Apps: Tavily Search, Tavily Extract, Exa Search, Exa Answer, Exa Extract. Capabilities: AI-powered search, content extraction, direct answers, research. Use for: research, RAG pipelines, fact-checking, content aggregation, agents. Triggers: web search, tavily, exa, search api, content extraction, research, internet search, ai search, search assistant, web scraping, rag, perplexity alternative
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh CLI，使用 Tavily 和 Exa 进行网页搜索与内容提取。

应用：Tavily Search、Tavily Extract、Exa Search、Exa Answer、Exa Extract。

能力：AI 驱动的搜索、内容提取、直接回答、研究。

用途：研究、RAG 流水线、事实核查、内容聚合、智能体。

触发词：网页搜索、tavily、exa、搜索 API、内容提取、研究、互联网搜索、AI 搜索、搜索助手、网页抓取、rag、perplexity alternative。

description: Master dbt (data build tool) for analytics engineering with model organization, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies. Use when building data transformations, creating data models, or implementing analytics engineering best practices.
description_zh: 掌握 dbt（数据构建工具）在分析工程中的应用，包括模型组织、测试、文档与增量策略。适用于构建数据转换、创建数据模型以及实施分析工程最佳实践的场景。

description: When the user wants to plan, run, sponsor, speak at, or get pipeline from events — webinars, conferences, trade shows, meetups, dinners, workshops, virtual summits, or user conferences. Also use when the user mentions 'event marketing,' 'field marketing,' 'run a webinar,' 'webinar funnel,' 'show-up rate,' 'should we sponsor,' 'sponsor a conference,' 'trade show booth,' 'booth strategy,' 'event ROI,' 'badge scans,' 'event follow-up,' 'speaking slot,' 'CFP,' 'conference talk,' 'host a dinner,' 'user conference,' or 'virtual summit.' Covers all four roles: hosting, sponsoring/exhibiting, speaking, and attending. For product launch moments, see launch. For the partnership side of joint webinars, see co-marketing. For ongoing community programs, see community-marketing. For podcast appearances, see public-relations. For the email sequences themselves, see emails.
description_zh: 当用户需要策划、举办、赞助、演讲或获取来自活动的线索时——包括网络研讨会、会议、贸易展、线下聚会、晚宴、工作坊、虚拟峰会或用户大会。当用户提到以下内容时，也应使用本功能：“活动营销”、“线下营销”、“举办网络研讨会”、“网络研讨会漏斗”、“到场率”、“是否应赞助”、“赞助会议”、“贸易展展位”、“展位策略”、“活动投资回报率”、“徽章扫描”、“活动后续跟进”、“演讲时段”、“CFP”、“会议演讲”、“举办晚宴”、“用户大会”或“虚拟峰会”。涵盖所有四个角色：主办、赞助/参展、演讲和参会。有关产品发布环节，请参阅“launch”。有关联合网络研讨会的合作方面，请参阅“co-marketing”。有关持续性的社区项目，请参阅“community-marketing”。有关播客出镜，请参阅“public-relations”。有关邮件序列本身，请参阅“emails”。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "test this website", "run exploratory testing", "check for accessibility issues", "verify the login flow works", "find bugs on this page", or requests automated QA testing. Triggers on web application testing scenarios including smoke tests, accessibility audits, e-commerce flows, and user flow validation using ScoutQA CLI. Use this skill proactively after implementing web application features to verify they work correctly.
description_zh: 当用户要求“测试此网站”、“执行探索性测试”、“检查无障碍问题”、“验证登录流程是否正常”、“查找此页面上的错误”，或请求自动化 QA 测试时，应使用此技能。在 Web 应用测试场景中触发，包括冒烟测试、无障碍审计、电商流程以及使用 ScoutQA CLI 的用户流程验证。在实现 Web 应用功能后，应主动使用该技能以验证其运行正确。

description: Test Temporal workflows with pytest, time-skipping, and mocking strategies. Covers unit testing, integration testing, replay testing, and local development setup. Use when implementing Temporal workflow tests or debugging test failures.
description_zh: 使用 pytest、时间跳过和模拟策略测试 Temporal 工作流。涵盖单元测试、集成测试、重放测试和本地开发配置。在实现 Temporal 工作流测试或调试测试失败时使用。

description: Refactor given method `${input:methodName}` to reduce its cognitive complexity to `${input:complexityThreshold}` or below, by extracting helper methods.
description_zh: 通过提取辅助方法，重构给定的 `${input:methodName}` 方法，将其认知复杂度降低至 `${input:complexityThreshold}` 或以下。

description: Use when building email features, emails going to spam, high bounce rates, setting up SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, implementing email capture, ensuring compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL), handling webhooks, retry logic, making emails accessible (alt text, headings, contrast, screen readers), or deciding transactional vs marketing.
description_zh: 用于构建邮件功能、邮件被归入垃圾邮件、高退信率、设置 SPF/DKIM/DMARC 认证、实施邮件采集、确保合规（CAN-SPAM、GDPR、CASL）、处理 Webhooks、重试逻辑、提升邮件可访问性（替代文本、标题、对比度、屏幕阅读器），或决定事务性邮件与营销邮件之间的区分。

description: Analyze competition, identify differentiation opportunities, and develop winning market positioning strategies using Porter's Five Forces, Blue Ocean Strategy, and positioning maps. Use this skill when evaluating competitors, assessing market positioning, identifying sustainable competitive advantages, or preparing competitive strategy analysis for a startup or investor pitch.
description_zh: 运用波特的五力模型、蓝海战略和定位地图，分析竞争，识别差异化机会，制定具有优势的市场定位策略。在评估竞争对手、评估市场定位、识别可持续竞争优势或为初创企业或投资者路演准备竞争策略分析时，使用本技能。

description: Calculate portfolio risk metrics including VaR, CVaR, Sharpe, Sortino, and drawdown analysis. Use when measuring portfolio risk, implementing risk limits, or building risk monitoring systems.
description_zh: 计算包括风险价值（VaR）、条件风险价值（CVaR）、夏普比率、索提诺比率和回撤分析在内的投资组合风险指标。在衡量投资组合风险、实施风险限制或构建风险监控系统时使用。

description: Python resource management with context managers, cleanup patterns, and streaming. Use when managing connections, file handles, implementing cleanup logic, or building streaming responses with accumulated state.
description_zh: Python资源管理（基于上下文管理器、清理模式与流式处理），适用于管理连接、文件句柄，实现清理逻辑，或构建带有累积状态的流式响应。

description: AI product photography with studio lighting, lifestyle shots, and packshot conventions. Covers angles, backgrounds, shadow types, hero shots, and e-commerce image requirements. Use for: product photos, e-commerce images, Amazon listings, packshots, lifestyle photography. Triggers: product photography, product photo, packshot, e-commerce photography, product shot, product image, studio photography, lifestyle product, amazon product photo, product listing image, hero shot, product mockup, commercial photography
description_zh: AI产品摄影，涵盖工作室灯光、生活方式镜头与包装摄影惯例。内容包括角度、背景、阴影类型、主图及电商图片要求。用途：产品照片、电商图片、亚马逊商品列表、包装照片、生活方式摄影。触发词：产品摄影、产品照片、包装照片、电商摄影、产品镜头、产品图片、工作室摄影、生活方式产品、亚马逊产品照片、商品列表图片、主图、产品展示图、商业摄影。

description: Generate or edit images via OpenRouter with the Gemini 3 Pro Image model. Use for prompt-only image generation, image edits, and multi-image compositing; supports 1K/2K/4K output.
description_zh: 通过 OpenRouter 配合 Gemini 3 Pro Image 模型生成或编辑图像。适用于仅基于提示词的图像生成、图像编辑和多图像合成；支持 1K/2K/4K 输出。

description: Investigates Google Cloud networking issues by analyzing logs, metrics, and diagnostics. Use when investigating VPC Flow Logs (including cost estimation), NAT, firewall, or threat logs, querying latency and throughput metrics, or running Connectivity Tests for path diagnostics. Don't use for generic VM management or non-observability tasks.
description_zh: 通过分析日志、指标和诊断信息，调查谷歌云网络问题。适用于调查 VPC 流量日志（包括成本估算）、NAT、防火墙或威胁日志，查询延迟与吞吐量指标，或执行连通性测试以进行路径诊断。不适用于通用虚拟机管理或非可观测性任务。

description: Character consistency across AI-generated images with reference sheets and LoRA techniques. Covers turnaround views, expression sheets, color palettes, and style consistency tricks. Use for: character design, game art, illustration, animation, comics, visual novels. Triggers: character design, character sheet, character consistency, character reference, turnaround sheet, expression sheet, character art, consistent character, character concept, reference sheet, character creation, oc design, character bible
description_zh: 借助参考表和 LoRA 技术，在 AI 生成图像中实现角色的一致性。涵盖正面、侧面、背面等转身视角、表情表、色彩调色板以及风格一致性技巧。适用于：角色设计、游戏美术、插画、动画、漫画、视觉小说。触发词：角色设计、角色表、角色一致性、角色参考、转身表、表情表、角色艺术、一致角色、角色概念、参考表、角色创作、OC 设计、角色圣经

description: Create structured incident response runbooks with step-by-step procedures, escalation paths, and recovery actions. Use this skill when building a service outage runbook for a payment processing system; creating database incident procedures covering connection pool exhaustion, replication lag, and disk space alerts; onboarding new on-call engineers who need step-by-step recovery guides written for a 3 AM brain; or standardizing escalation matrices across multiple engineering teams.
description_zh: 创建包含分步骤流程、升级路径和恢复措施的结构化事故响应手册。在以下场景中使用本技能：为支付处理系统构建服务中断手册；制定涵盖连接池耗尽、复制延迟和磁盘空间警报的数据库事故处理流程；为需要编写面向凌晨3点紧急决策场景的分步骤恢复指南的新值班工程师进行入职培训；或在多个工程团队中统一升级矩阵。

description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard
description_zh: 电影和视频分镜制作，包含镜头词汇、连续性规则与分格布局。涵盖镜头类型、拍摄角度、镜头运动、180度规则与标注格式。用途包括：视频策划、电影前期制作、广告分镜、音乐视频策划、动画。触发词：分镜、分镜制作、分镜表、电影策划、视频策划、前期制作、镜头构图、拍摄角度、场景策划、视觉脚本、动态脚本、分镜分格、视频分镜。

description: Build end-to-end MLOps pipelines from data preparation through model training, validation, and production deployment. Use when creating ML pipelines, implementing MLOps practices, or automating model training and deployment workflows.
description_zh: 构建端到端的MLOps流水线，涵盖从数据准备到模型训练、验证和部署生产上线。用于创建ML流水线、实施MLOps实践或自动化模型训练与部署工作流程时使用。

description: Convert Markdown files to HTML similar to `marked.js`, `pandoc`, `gomarkdown/markdown`, or similar tools; or writing custom script to convert markdown to html and/or working on web template systems like `jekyll/jekyll`, `gohugoio/hugo`, or similar web templating systems that utilize markdown documents, converting them to html. Use when asked to "convert markdown to html", "transform md to html", "render markdown", "generate html from markdown", or when working with .md files and/or web a templating system that converts markdown to HTML output. Supports CLI and Node.js workflows with GFM, CommonMark, and standard Markdown flavors.
description_zh: 将 Markdown 文件转换为 HTML，支持类似 `marked.js`、`pandoc`、`gomarkdown/markdown` 或同类工具的功能；或使用自定义脚本将 Markdown 转换为 HTML，以及/或针对 `jekyll/jekyll`、`gohugoio/hugo` 等利用 Markdown 文档并将其转换为 HTML 的 Web 模板系统进行处理。当被要求执行"将 Markdown 转换为 HTML"、"将 md 转换为 HTML"、"渲染 Markdown"、"从 Markdown 生成 HTML"，或处理 .md 文件及/或将 Markdown 转换为 HTML 输出的 Web 模板系统时使用。支持配合 GFM、CommonMark 及标准 Markdown 风格运行的 CLI 和 Node.js 工作流。

description: Optimize LinkedIn profile for searchability, recruiter visibility, and engagement
description_zh: 优化领英个人资料，提升可搜索性、招聘者可见性及互动性。

description: Use when writing, restructuring, or revising any technical document - specs, design docs, READMEs, reference documentation, plans, reports - or any prose that must survive being read twice by someone in a hurry. Encodes the house style, the truth and sourcing rules, and the banned-constructions list. Use whenever you produce repository-bound text longer than a paragraph, even if nobody says "document". Foundation for the sibling document-type skills.
description_zh: 用于编写、重组或修订任何技术文档——规格说明书、设计文档、README、参考文档、计划与报告等——或任何必须经受匆忙阅读者二次阅读的文本。其编码了规范风格、事实与出处规则，以及禁用句式列表。只要产出的仓库内文本超过一个段落，即便无人称其为“文档”，也应使用。作为同类文档类型技能的基石。

description: Use when the user needs multi-source research with citation tracking, evidence persistence, and structured report generation. Triggers on "deep research", "comprehensive analysis", "research report", "compare X vs Y", "analyze trends", or "state of the art". Not for simple lookups, debugging, or questions answerable with 1-2 searches.
description_zh: 适用于用户需要进行多源研究，并具备引用追踪、证据留存与结构化报告生成功能的场景。触发条件为“深度研究”、“全面分析”、“研究报告”、“对比 X 与 Y”、“分析趋势”或“前沿技术”。不适用于简单查询、调试，或可通过 1-2 次搜索即可回答的问题。

description: Migrate from AngularJS to Angular using hybrid mode, incremental component rewriting, and dependency injection updates. Use when upgrading AngularJS applications, planning framework migrations, or modernizing legacy Angular code.
description_zh: 从 AngularJS 迁移到 Angular，采用混合模式、增量组件重写和依赖注入更新。适用于升级 AngularJS 应用、规划框架迁移或现代化遗留 Angular 代码。

description: Design and implement event stores for event-sourced systems. Use when building event sourcing infrastructure, choosing event store technologies, or implementing event persistence patterns.
description_zh: 设计与实现事件源系统中的事件存储。在构建事件溯源基础设施、选择事件存储技术或实现事件持久化模式时使用。

description: Structured competitive analysis with feature matrices, SWOT, positioning maps, and UX review. Covers research frameworks, pricing comparison, review mining, and visual deliverables. Use for: market research, competitive intelligence, investor decks, product strategy, sales enablement. Triggers: competitor analysis, competitive analysis, competitor teardown, market research, competitive intelligence, swot analysis, competitor comparison, market landscape, competitor review, competitive landscape, feature comparison, market positioning
description_zh: 提供包含功能矩阵、SWOT分析、定位图及UX审查的结构化竞争分析。涵盖研究框架、定价对比、评论挖掘与可视化交付成果。适用于：市场研究、竞争情报、投资者演示文稿、产品策略、销售赋能。触发词：竞争对手分析、竞争分析、竞品拆解分析、市场研究、竞争情报、SWOT分析、竞争对手对比、市场格局、竞品评测、竞争格局、功能对比、市场定位。

description: Generate concise, actionable meeting minutes for internal meetings. Includes metadata, attendees, agenda, decisions, action items (owner + due date), and follow-up steps.
description_zh: 为内部会议生成简洁、可操作的会议纪要。内容包括元数据、参会人员、议程、决策、行动项（负责人 + 截止日期）及后续步骤。

description: Manage Linear issues from the command line using the linear cli. This skill allows automating linear management.
description_zh: 通过 linear cli 从命令行管理 Linear 问题。该技能支持自动化 Linear 管理。

description: Admin-only paginated viewer for stable canister state. Use whenever the user asks for a viewer, dashboard, debug panel, or admin browse over backend data — users, items, orders, logs, or any stable Map/Set/Array/VarArray/List/Stack/Queue. Pre-installed in every Caffeine app via the `caffeineai-data-viewer` mops package; this skill explains what it does and how to keep using it correctly.
description_zh: 用于稳定 canister 状态的仅管理员分页查看器。当用户请求查看器、仪表盘、调试面板，或对后端数据进行管理员浏览时，请随时使用——涵盖用户、商品、订单、日志，或任何稳定的 Map/Set/Array/VarArray/List/Stack/Queue。该查看器通过 `caffeineai-data-viewer` mops 包在每一个 Caffeine 应用中预装；本技能说明其功能，以及如何正确、持续地使用。

description: Power BI semantic modeling assistant for building optimized data models. Use when working with Power BI semantic models, creating measures, designing star schemas, configuring relationships, implementing RLS, or optimizing model performance. Triggers on queries about DAX calculations, table relationships, dimension/fact table design, naming conventions, model documentation, cardinality, cross-filter direction, calculation groups, and data model best practices. Always connects to the active model first using power-bi-modeling MCP tools to understand the data structure before providing guidance.
description_zh: 用于构建优化数据模型的 Power BI 语义建模助手。在涉及 Power BI 语义模型、创建度量值、设计星型模式、配置关系、实施行级安全（RLS）或优化模型性能时使用。当针对 DAX 计算、表关系、维度/事实表设计、命名规范、模型文档、基数、跨表筛选方向、计算组及数据模型最佳实践进行查询时触发。始终先使用 power-bi-modeling MCP 工具连接到当前活动模型，以理解数据结构后再提供指导。

description:
Write or rewrite text in plain, layman-readable English in the spirit of
ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice,
simple tenses, one word one meaning, condition before command, every
technical term defined at first use, no AI slop. Default mode is Plain.
Strict mode applies full STE vocabulary compliance when the user names
STE, ASD-STE100, or compliance. Use for documentation, READMEs, runbooks,
procedures, error messages, release notes, incident reports, API guides,
and explanations for readers outside the field. Also use when the user
says "STE", "Simplified Technical English", "ASD-STE100", "plain English",
"layman's terms", "explain it simply", "no jargon", "de-slop", "make this

---

**Translation Notes:**
- **Huawei Cloud CCI**: Translated as "华为云CCI" to maintain standard terminology for Huawei Cloud products.
- **hcloud CLI**: Kept as-is since it's a specific tool name.
- **Namespace, Network, Deployment, StatefulSet, Pod**: These are standard Kubernetes concepts. "Namespace" is translated as "命名空间" which is the standard Chinese term. "Deployment" and "StatefulSet" are typically kept in English in Chinese technical contexts (or could be translated as 部署/有状态集合, but keeping English is more standard in Huawei Cloud documentation). I'll keep them as standard technical terms.
- **EIPPool**: Kept as "EIPPool" with explanation "弹性公网IP（EIPPool）池".
- **destructive operations**: "破坏性操作" is the standard term.
- **triggers** section: Preserved as "触发词" with the terms listed, maintaining the metadata format.
- The paragraph structure and formatting are preserved.
