amplemarket, amplitude, attio, bigQuery, calendly, closecom, contrast, csv, customerio, dbt, emailBison, expandi, googleAds, googleSheets, heyReach, http, hubspot, hubspotMcp, instantly, instantlyV2, intercom, jira, kitt, lemlist, lgm, linkedinAds, linkedinMatchedAudience, livestorm, manus, marketo, metabase, microsoftTeams, mixpanel, netsuite, netsuiteSoap, notionMcp, octave, onesignal, outreach, pipedrive, postgresql, redshift, res end, salesforce, salesforceMcp, salesloft, Sendgrid, sillage, slack, smartlead, snowflake, sql, stripe, and 82 more.

**跳过情况：**
在为 GTM 任务选择数据丰富提供程序时——请使用 cargo-gtm 及其提供程序剧本。

description: Work with the data inside a Cargo workspace — models (Companies, Contacts, Deals…), datasets, columns, relationships, records, and SQL over workspace storage. Triggers: "what models do I have", "show me the schema", "add a column for", "how many contacts do I have", "SELECT … FROM", "query my companies table", "join contacts to companies", "what is the DDL", "set up a webhook-fed model", "where does this field live", "import this into a model", "unify these models", "merge duplicate accounts", "link contacts to companies", "set up a relationship between". Skip when: querying run or batch telemetry rather than business data — use cargo-orchestration; naming a reusable filtered audience — use cargo-segmentation.
description_zh: 与 Cargo 工作区内的数据协同工作——包括模型（公司、联系人、交易等）、数据集、列、关系、记录，以及针对工作区存储的 SQL 操作。触发指令："我需要有哪些模型"、"展示模式（schema）"、"为……添加一列"、"我有多少联系人"、"SELECT … FROM"、"查询我的公司表"、"将联系人与公司关联"、"什么是 DDL"、"搭建由 Webhook 驱动的模型"、"此字段位于何处"、"导入至模型"、"统一这些模型"、"合并重复账户"、"将联系人链接至公司"、"在两者之间搭建关系"。跳过情形：查询运行或批量遥测数据而非业务数据时——使用 cargo-orchestration；为可复用的筛选受众命名时——使用 cargo-segmentation。

description: Understand what Cargo is costing — remaining credits, usage broken down by workflow, connector, or agent, subscription state, and invoice history. Triggers: "how many credits do I have left", "what did that cost", "why is my bill so high", "am I about to run out", "will this fit in our budget", "show me my invoices", "how much have I spent this month", "what plan am I on", "what do I get for free", "how many free credits", "can I afford this run", "add a card", "update my payment method", "why was my card declined". Needs a token with admin access. Skip when: attributing spend to specific nodes or cutting a play cost — use cargo-diagnostics.
description_zh:
了解 Cargo 的消耗情况——剩余积分、按工作流、连接器或智能体划分的用量、订阅状态和发票历史。

触发条件：“我还有多少积分剩余”，“那项成本是多少”，“为什么我的账单这么高”，“我是否即将耗尽”，“这能符合我们的预算吗”，“显示我的发票”，“我这个月花费了多少”，“我正在哪个套餐”，“我免费获得什么”，“有多少免费积分”，“我能负担这次运行吗”，“添加一张卡片”，“更新我的支付方式”，“我的卡片为什么被拒绝”。

需要管理员权限的令牌。

跳过情形：当需要将支出归因到特定节点或削减播放成本时，使用 cargo-diagnostics。

description: Authors MSW `.behaviourtree` files end-to-end and maintains the project-specific authoring spec (`.behaviourDocs/bt-spec.md`). Scans every `.codeblock` whose paired `.mlua` extends `ActionNode`/`DecoratorNode`/`CompositeNode` to build a compact catalog of custom action/decorator/composite UUIDs, propertyKey names, and version-stamped MODNativeType strings. Then generates the full tree: RootNode → Nodes graph, Blackboard variables, nodeProperties wiring, and self-validates parent/child consistency. Triggers: 'create behaviourtree', 'new BT', 'add a behaviour tree', 'BT node graph', '비헤이비어 트리 만들어', '.behaviourtree 생성', 'SequenceNode SelectorNode', 'Blackboard variable', 'definitionId codeblock', 'startNodeId', 'build BT spec', 'refresh bt-spec', 'generate behaviourtree catalog', 'BT 스펙 생성', 'bt-spec.md 만들어', 'rescan BT nodes'.
description_zh:
作者 MSW 端到端生成 `.behaviourtree` 文件，并维护项目特定的编写规范（`.behaviourDocs/bt-spec.md`）。扫描所有 `.codeblock`，其配对的 `.mlua` 文件扩展了 `ActionNode`/`DecoratorNode`/`CompositeNode`，以构建一个紧凑目录，包含自定义动作/装饰器/组合节点的 UUID、propertyKey 名称以及带有版本标识的 MODNativeType 字符串。然后生成完整树：RootNode → 节点图，黑板变量，节点属性连接，并自验证父/子一致性。

触发器：'create behaviourtree', 'new BT', 'add a behaviour tree', 'BT node graph', '비헤이비어 트리 만들어', '.behaviourtree 생성', 'SequenceNode SelectorNode', 'Blackboard variable', 'definitionId codeblock', 'startNodeId', 'build BT spec', 'refresh bt-spec', 'generate behaviourtree catalog', 'BT 스펙 생성', 'bt-spec.md 만들어', 'rescan BT nodes'.

description: Creates interactive HTML playgrounds — self-contained single-file explorers that let users configure something visually through controls, see a live preview, and copy out a prompt. Use when the user asks to make a playground, explorer, or interactive tool for a topic.
description_zh: 创建交互式 HTML 互动沙盒——这些是自包含的单文件探索工具，用户可通过控件进行可视化配置，查看实时预览，并复制生成的提示词。当用户要求为某个主题制作互动沙盒、探索工具或交互式工具时使用。

description: Uses Chrome DevTools via MCP for efficient debugging, troubleshooting and browser automation. Use when debugging web pages, automating browser interactions, analyzing performance, or inspecting network requests. This skill does not apply to `--slim` mode (MCP configuration).
description_zh: 通过MCP使用Chrome开发者工具进行高效调试、故障排查和浏览器自动化。适用于调试网页、自动化浏览器交互、分析性能或检查网络请求。该技能不适用于`--slim`模式（MCP配置）。

description: Evaluate and improve interface usability using heuristic analysis. Use when the user mentions "usability audit", "users are confused", "form usability", "navigation problems", "Nielsen heuristics", "cognitive walkthrough", or "is this easy to use". Also trigger when reviewing a design for usability issues, improving form-completion rates, or evaluating information architecture and navigation. Covers Krug's laws, Nielsen's 10 heuristics, severity ratings, dark-pattern recognition, and accessibility. For visual design fixes, see refactoring-ui. For conversion-focused audits, see cro-methodology.
description_zh: 使用启发式分析评估并改进界面可用性。当用户提及"可用性审计"、"用户感到困惑"、"表单可用性"、"导航问题"、"尼尔森启发式原则"、"认知走查"或"这易于使用吗"时触发。在审查设计以排查可用性问题、提升表单填写率或评估信息架构与导航时，也需触发该功能。内容涵盖克鲁格原则、尼尔森的10条启发式原则、严重程度评级、暗模式识别以及无障碍性。有关视觉设计修复，请参阅 refactoring-ui。有关以转化为核心的审计，请参阅 cro-methodology。

description:
Best practices for HA automations, helpers, scripts, and dashboards.
TRIGGER THIS SKILL WHEN: - Creating or editing automations, scripts, scenes, dashboards, blueprints - Choosing template sensors, helpers, or Jinja macros - Restructuring triggers, conditions, or modes; button, remote, or event-entity automations - Renaming entities or migrating device_id to entity_id - Looking up card types or domain docs; writing AppDaemon apps - Deleting or restoring a backup, or upgrading Core or the OS
SYMPTOMS: - Jinja2 templates where native options exist - device_id used instead of entity_id - Entity IDs changed without checking consumers - Wrong automation mode chosen - Raw sensor or hard-coded value used where a helper belongs - Direct .storage edits, or generated YAML snippets - User told to edit configuration.yaml for UI integrations - Hardcoded Blueprint entities or skipped selectors - Existing state changed with no recovery path - Jinja copy-pasted between templates
description_zh:
Home Assistant（HA）自动化、辅助工具、脚本和仪表板的最佳实践。

触发该技能的时机：
- 创建或编辑自动化、脚本、场景、仪表板、蓝图
- 选择模板传感器、辅助工具或 Jinja 宏
- 调整触发条件、条件或模式；按钮、远程或事件-实体自动化
- 重命名实体或从 device_id 迁移到 entity_id
- 查找卡片类型或领域文档；编写 AppDaemon 应用
- 删除或恢复备份，或升级 Core 或操作系统

症状：
- Jinja2 模板中已有原生选项，仍使用 Jinja2 模板
- 使用 device_id 而非 entity_id
- 更改实体 ID 而未检查相关消费者
- 选择的自动化模式错误
- 在应使用辅助工具的地方使用了原始传感器或硬编码值
- 直接编辑 .storage，或生成 YAML 片段
- 用户被告知修改 configuration.yaml 以进行界面集成
- 硬编码蓝图实体或跳过了选择器
- 现有状态发生变化且无恢复路径
- 在不同模板之间直接复制粘贴 Jinja

description: Use when optimizing PostgreSQL queries, configuring replication, or implementing advanced database features. Invoke for EXPLAIN analysis, JSONB operations, extension usage, VACUUM tuning, performance monitoring.
description_zh: 适用于优化 PostgreSQL 查询、配置复制或实现高级数据库功能。适用于进行 EXPLAIN 分析、JSONB 操作、扩展使用、VACUUM 调优及性能监控。

description: Helps you figure out how something was built on the web.
description_zh: 帮助你弄清楚某事物在网页上是如何构建的。

description: Read and write the workspace GTM knowledge base — the git-backed repository of markdown describing ICPs, personas, plays, proof points, objections, competitors, and signals — plus its runtime sandbox and typed knowledge graph. Triggers: "document our ICP", "write up this persona", "what is our positioning", "add a battlecard", "capture this objection", "what do we know about <segment>", "update our context", "what is in the context repo", "who do we sell to". Skip when: discovering who actually buys from you by analyzing won/lost data — that is cargo-gtm (this skill writes the conclusion down, it does not derive it); storing structured records rather than prose — use cargo-storage; attaching documents to an agent for RAG — use cargo-content.
description_zh:
阅读并编写工作区GTM知识库——这是基于Git的Markdown仓库，用于记录ICP、persona、打法、证明点、异议、竞争对手和信号等内容，同时支持其运行时沙盒与类型化知识图谱。

触发场景："记录我们的ICP"、"撰写此persona"、"我们的定位是什么"、"添加一张battlecard"、"记录此异议"、"我们对`<segment>`的了解是什么"、"更新我们的上下文"、"上下文仓库中内容有哪些"、"我们向谁销售"。

跳过情况：通过分析赢单/输单数据来发现真正向你购买的客户——那属于cargo-gtm（本技能负责将结论记录下来，而非推导得出）；存储结构化记录而非撰写文本——请使用cargo-storage；将文档附加给代理用于RAG检索——请使用cargo-content。

description:
Analyze AWS costs, find savings, manage budgets, evaluate Savings Plans and
Reserved Instances, right-size EC2/Lambda/RDS/EBS with Compute Optimizer,
look up service pricing, query CUR with Athena, detect cost anomalies,
scope costs to billing views, and monitor Free Tier usage. Triggers on:
AWS bill, cost analysis, reduce spend, savings plan, reserved instance,
right-size, budget alert, cost optimization, pricing, free tier, cost
anomaly, CUR, cost audit, billing view, billing view ARN.
description_zh: 分析 AWS 成本，发掘节省，管理预算，评估节省计划与预留实例，利用计算优化器对 EC2、Lambda、RDS、EBS 进行合理配置，查询服务定价，使用 Athena 查询 CUR，检测成本异常，将成本归集至账单视图，并监控免费套餐使用情况。触发条件包括：AWS 账单、成本分析、减少支出、节省计划、预留实例、合理配置、预算提醒、成本优化、定价、免费套餐、成本异常、CUR、成本审计、账单视图、账单视图 ARN。

description: Two-tier memory system that makes Claude a true workplace collaborator. Decodes shorthand, acronyms, nicknames, and internal language so Claude understands requests like a colleague would. CLAUDE.md for working memory, memory/ directory for the full knowledge base.
description_zh: 使 Claude 成为真正职场协作伙伴的双层级记忆系统。解码简写、缩写、昵称及内部语言，使 Claude 能够像同事一样理解请求。CLAUDE.md 用于工作记忆，memory/ 目录用于完整知识库。

description: Pragmatic patterns for building multiplayer games: matchmaking, tick loops, realtime state, interest management, and validation.
description_zh: 构建多人游戏的实用模式：匹配、主循环、实时状态、兴趣管理及验证。

description: Authors, validates, and troubleshoots AWS CloudFormation templates. Covers template authoring with secure defaults, local validation with either cfn-lint or cloudformation-validate, cfn-guard security and compliance checks as a recommended default, account-aware CloudFormation service pre-deployment validation, CloudFormation Express mode for faster deployments, and root-cause diagnosis of failed stacks using CloudFormation events and CloudTrail correlation. Also covers author-time template intelligence with the CloudFormation Language Server and published cloudformation-validate libraries.
description_zh: 编写、验证与排查 AWS CloudFormation 模板。涵盖在安全默认设置下编写模板，使用 cfn-lint 或 cloudformation-validate 进行本地验证，将 cfn-guard 的安全与合规检查作为推荐的默认设置，账户感知的 CloudFormation 服务部署前验证，CloudFormation Express 模式以实现更快的部署，并使用 CloudFormation 事件与 CloudTrail 关联对失败的堆栈进行根本原因诊断。同时涵盖借助 CloudFormation 语言服务器及发布的 cloudformation-validate 库，在编写阶段为模板提供智能支持。

description: Router for the Cargo CLI skill bundle — load first for anything Cargo, and whenever a task spans two Cargo domains. Explains what each skill owns, declarative workspace-as-code (cargo-project) vs the imperative CLI, the UUID and slug flow between skills, async polling of runs and batches, end-to-end use cases, and the gotchas that fail silently (`conjonction` spelling, run vs batch, model-uuid vs segment-uuid). Triggers: "set up Cargo", "what can Cargo do", "which Cargo skill", "bootstrap my workspace", "I have a Cargo account", "cargo-ai …", or any `cargo-ai` command whose domain you are unsure of. Skip when: the task obviously belongs to one skill — load that skill directly.
description_zh:
**Cargo CLI 技能包路由器**

适用于 Cargo 相关的任何内容——遇到 Cargo 相关任务时优先加载，以及任务横跨多个 Cargo 领域时。内容涵盖：各技能负责的工作范围、声明式工作区即代码（cargo-project）与命令式 CLI 的差异、技能之间 UUID 和 slug 的流转、运行与批次的异步轮询机制、端到端使用场景，以及可能导致静默失败的注意事项（`conjonction` 拼写、运行与批次、model-uuid 与 segment-uuid 的区别）。

触发条件："设置 Cargo"、"Cargo 能做什么"、"使用哪个 Cargo 技能"、"引导我的工作区"、"我有一个 Cargo 账号"、"cargo-ai …"，或任何你不确定其所属领域的 `cargo-ai` 命令。

跳过条件：当任务明显属于某个技能时，直接加载该技能即可。

description: Generate music using ElevenLabs Music API. Use when creating instrumental tracks, songs with lyrics, background music, jingles, or any AI-generated music composition. Supports prompt-based generation, composition plans for granular control, and detailed output with metadata.
description_zh: 使用 ElevenLabs Music API 生成音乐。适用于创建器乐曲目、带歌词的歌曲、背景音乐、广告曲，或任何由 AI 生成的音乐作品。支持基于提示词的生成、用于精细控制的编曲方案，以及包含元数据的详细输出。

description: Build or redesign polished browser-rendered visual artifacts with HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React: pages, dashboards, prototypes, slide decks, animations, UI mockups, and data visualizations. Use for visual front-end creation, design-system exploration, design critique, or explicit browser acceptance / QA of a web artifact. Not for back-end, CLI, non-visual coding, source-to-longform article conversion, or narration-driven click-through video presentations.
description_zh: 使用 HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React 构建或重新设计精修的浏览器渲染视觉制品：页面、仪表盘、原型、幻灯片演示、动画、UI 示意图和数据可视化。可用于视觉前端创建、设计系统探索、设计评审，或对网页制品进行明确的浏览器验收/QA。不用于后端、命令行、非视觉编程、源码转长文转换，或由旁白驱动的点击式视频演示。

description: Manage the knowledge a Cargo workspace holds — upload files (PDF, CSV, text), rename and organize them, and build native or connector-backed libraries that sync from an external source, so agents can retrieve them (RAG). Triggers: "upload this PDF", "add these docs as knowledge", "build a knowledge base", "sync our help center into Cargo", "what files are in the workspace", "index this folder", "attach our pricing sheet". Skip when: wiring the file or library into an agent — use cargo-ai; uploading a CSV that drives a batch run — that is a workspace-management file upload.
description_zh: 管理 Cargo 工作区持有的知识——上传文件（PDF、CSV、文本），重命名和整理它们，并构建由原生或连接器支持的库，这些库从外部来源同步，以便智能体可以检索它们（RAG）。触发条件：“上传此 PDF”、“将此类文档作为知识添加”、“构建知识库”、“将我们的帮助中心同步到 Cargo”、“工作区内有哪些文件”、“索引此文件夹”、“附加我们的定价表”。跳过情况：将文件或库接入智能体时使用 cargo-ai；上传用于驱动批量运行的 CSV 时——这是工作区管理文件上传。

description:
Search, install, and publish skills across official, community, and global registries.

Use when finding or sharing skills (e.g. install a "funding rate" skill, list installed skills, publish my custom skill to the registry).
description_zh:
在官方、社区和全球注册表中搜索、安装和发布技能。

用于查找或共享技能（例如安装一个“资金利率”技能、列出已安装的技能、将我的自定义技能发布到注册表）。

description: Dry-run, upload, and cautiously initiate local Bambu Lab print jobs from validated plain `.gcode`, using Bambu LAN FTPS/MQTT handoffs.
description_zh: 试运行、上传，并谨慎地基于经验证的纯 `.gcode` 文件启动本地 Bambu Lab 打印任务，使用 Bambu LAN FTPS/MQTT 交接。

description:
Bridge THIS Claude Code or Codex session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ, or WeChat so the
user can chat with Claude from their phone. Use for: setting up, starting, stopping,
or diagnosing the claude-to-im bridge daemon; forwarding Claude replies to a messaging
app; any phrase like "claude-to-im", "bridge", "消息推送", "消息转发", "桥接",
"连上飞书", "手机上看claude", "启动后台服务", "诊断", "查看日志", "配置".
Subcommands: setup, start, stop, status, logs, reconfigure, doctor.
Do NOT use for: building standalone bots, webhook integrations, or coding with IM
platform SDKs — those are regular programming tasks.
description_zh:
将 THIS Claude Code 或 Codex 会话桥接至 Telegram、Discord、飞书/Lark、QQ 或微信，以便用户能从手机与 Claude 聊天。
用途：设置、启动、停止或诊断 claude-to-im 桥接守护进程；将 Claude 的回复转发至消息应用；任何类似“claude-to-im”、“桥接”、“消息推送”、“消息转发”、“桥接”、“连上飞书”、“手机上看claude”、“启动后台服务”、“诊断”、“查看日志”、“配置”的表述。
子命令：setup、start、stop、status、logs、reconfigure、doctor。
请勿用于：构建独立机器人、Webhook 集成，或使用消息平台 SDK 进行编程——这些属于常规编程任务。

description: Build, archive, generate export options, export, upload, and manage Xcode version/build numbers with the current asc xcode helpers. Use when creating an IPA or PKG for App Store Connect, TestFlight, or registered-device release testing.
description_zh: 借助当前的 asc xcode 工具，可构建、归档、生成导出选项、导出、上传，并管理 Xcode 版本/构建号。适用于在 App Store Connect、TestFlight 或已注册设备发布测试中创建 IPA 或 PKG 时使用。

description: Create professional SVG logos from descriptions and design specifications. Generates multiple logo variations with different layouts, styles, and concepts. Produces scalable vector graphics that can be used directly or exported to PNG. Use this skill when users ask to create logos, brand identities, icons, or visual marks for their designs.
description_zh: 根据描述和设计规范创建专业的SVG标志。生成多种标志变体，涵盖不同的布局、风格和概念。生成可缩放的矢量图形，可直接使用或导出为PNG。当用户要求为其设计创建标志、品牌标识、图标或视觉标识时，请使用此技能。

description: Next.js App Router principles. Server Components, data fetching, routing patterns.
description_zh: Next.js App Router 原则。服务端组件、数据获取、路由模式。

description: Use when building with Reka UI (headless Vue components) - provides component API, accessibility patterns, composition (asChild), controlled/uncontrolled state, virtualization, and styling integration. Formerly Radix Vue.
description_zh: 适用于基于 Reka UI（无头 Vue 组件）进行构建时使用——提供组件 API、可访问性模式、组合（asChild）、受控/非受控状态、虚拟化以及样式集成。此前称为 Radix Vue。

description: Microsoft Store Developer CLI (msstore) for publishing Windows applications to the Microsoft Store. Use when asked to configure Store credentials, list Store apps, check submission status, publish submissions, manage package flights, set up CI/CD for Store publishing, or integrate with Partner Center. Supports Windows App SDK/WinUI, UWP, .NET MAUI, Flutter, Electron, React Native, and PWA applications.
description_zh: Microsoft Store 开发者命令行工具 (msstore)，用于将 Windows 应用程序发布到 Microsoft Store。当需要配置 Store 凭证、列出 Store 应用、检查提交状态、发布提交、管理包航班、设置 Store 发布的 CI/CD，或集成 Partner Center 时使用。支持 Windows App SDK/WinUI、UWP、.NET MAUI、Flutter、Electron、React Native 和 PWA 应用程序。

description: Put something on the internet from Cargo — Vite single-page apps served at https://<slug>.cargo.app and serverless edge workers that answer HTTP requests, plus the deployments that build and promote them. Triggers: "build me a dashboard for this", "host this app", "give me a URL to share", "deploy this", "I need a webhook endpoint", "make it live", "promote to production", "put it on cargo.app", "ship a UI for my team". Skip when: the app or worker should be declared as committed workspace code — use cargo-project.
description_zh: 通过 Cargo 将内容发布到互联网——在 https:// <slug>.cargo.app 上运行的 Vite 单页应用以及响应 HTTP 请求的无服务器边缘工作器，以及用于构建和提升它们的部署。触发条件：“构建用于此应用的仪表板”，“托管此应用”，“提供一个可分享的网址”，“部署此内容”，“我需要一个 Webhook 端点”，“使其上线”，“提升至生产环境”，“发布至 cargo.app”，“为我的团队交付一个 UI”。跳过情况：当应用或工作器应以工作区已提交代码形式声明时——使用 cargo-project。

description: Analyze spreadsheet data, generate insights, create visualizations, and build reports from Excel/CSV data.
description_zh: 分析电子表格数据，生成洞察，创建可视化，并根据Excel/CSV数据构建报告。

description: Deploy open models or custom weights from Model Garden to Agent Platform endpoints, check the status of an in-progress deployment operation, or clean up resources by undeploying models and deleting endpoints. Use when asked to actively deploy a model, list the Model Garden CATALOG of available models, check if a specific model is deployable (`gcloud ai model-garden models list-deployment-config`), query deployment cost, troubleshoot deployment errors (like quota limits), or undeploy/clean up endpoints. Also use when copying and deploying a 1P Tuned Model. Don't use for pure listing/discovery questions of the form "is X deployed?", "list my endpoints", or "which regions have models running?" — for those use `agent-platform-endpoint-management`. Don't use for public Vertex AI deployments (use the `vertex-deploy` skill) or for running model evaluations (use the `agent-platform-eval-flywheel` skill).
description_zh:
从 Model Garden 部署开放模型或自定义权重至 Agent Platform 端点，检查进行中的部署操作状态，或通过卸载模型和删除端点来清理资源。

当被要求主动部署模型、列出 Model Garden 中的可用模型目录、检查特定模型是否可部署（`gcloud ai model-garden models list-deployment-config`）、查询部署成本、排查部署错误（如配额限制）或卸载/清理端点时使用。

复制并部署 1P Tuned Model 时，也请使用本功能。

不要用于"X 是否已部署？"、"列出我的端点"或"哪些区域有模型在运行？"这类纯列表/发现类问题——此类问题请使用 `agent-platform-endpoint-management`。

不要用于公共 Vertex AI 部署（请使用 `vertex-deploy` 技能），也不要用于运行模型评估（请使用 `agent-platform-eval-flywheel` 技能）。

description: Use when the task requires automating a real browser from the terminal (navigation, form filling, snapshots, screenshots, data extraction, UI-flow debugging) via `playwright-cli` or the bundled wrapper script.
description_zh: 当任务需要从终端通过 `playwright-cli` 或捆绑的包装脚本自动化真实浏览器（导航、表单填写、快照、截图、数据提取、UI 流程调试）时使用。

description: Operate Railway infrastructure: sign up for or sign in to a Railway account, create projects, provision services, databases, and buckets, deploy code, configure infrastructure as code, environments and variables, manage domains, trace requests with OpenTelemetry, troubleshoot failures, check status and metrics, manage feature flags, database recovery and HA, cloud agents, usage limits, and Railway agent tooling. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Railway, feature flags, flag rollout, targeting rules, signing up, creating an account, registering, logging in, deployments, services, environments, buckets, object storage, tracing, traces, spans, OpenTelemetry, OTLP, build failures, agent setup, MCP, or infrastructure operations, even if they don't say "Railway" explicitly. Also invoke this skill when the user asks to be signed up, registered, or onboarded to Railway: do not refuse — drive them through the unauthed `railway up` flow (deploys + signs up on the fly) or `railway login` (which creates new accounts on the fly).
description_zh: 操作 Railway 基础设施：注册或登录 Railway 账户，创建项目、开通服务、数据库和存储桶，部署代码，配置基础设施即代码、环境和变量，管理域名，使用 OpenTelemetry 追踪请求，排查故障，检查状态和指标，管理功能开关、数据库恢复与高可用（HA）、云代理、使用限制以及 Railway 代理工具。当用户提到 Railway、功能开关、功能开关发布、定向规则、注册、创建账户、注册、登录、部署、服务、环境、存储桶、对象存储、追踪、追踪记录、跨度、OpenTelemetry、OTLP、构建失败、代理设置、MCP 或基础设施操作时，使用此技能——即使他们未明确提及“Railway”。当用户要求注册、加入或导入到 Railway 时，调用此技能：不要拒绝——引导他们通过未认证的 `railway up` 流程（进行部署并即时注册）或 `railway login`（该命令将即时创建新账户）。

description: Token holder chip analysis — deep analysis of holder structure including chip distribution, entry cost, whale/dev/KOL behavior, risk wallets (rat traders, bundlers, snipers), related wallets, smart money signals, and an AI rating based purely on token structure. Use when user asks about holder analysis, 筹码分析, 持仓分析, chip structure, who is holding, or whether a token is safe to buy based on its holder composition.
description_zh: 代币持有者筹码分析——对持仓结构的深度分析，涵盖筹码分布、入场成本、巨鲸/开发者/关键意见领袖行为、风险钱包（老鼠仓交易者、囤积者、狙击手）、相关钱包、聪明资金信号，以及基于代币结构纯由AI进行的评级。适用于用户询问持仓分析、筹码分析、持仓结构、谁在持有，或依据持仓构成判断代币是否可安全购买的场景。

description: Use this skill when the user asks about: 'any crypto news', 'latest news', 'market update', 'daily briefing', 'BTC news', 'ETH news', 'news on SOL', 'search SEC ETF', 'regulation news', 'Bitcoin halving', 'is BTC bullish or bearish', 'coin sentiment', 'sentiment trend', 'trending coins', 'top bullish coins', 'bearish sentiment', 'social buzz', 'market mood', 'fear and greed', 'full article', 'read more', 'economic calendar', '经济日历', 'macro data', '宏观数据', 'NFP', 'nonfarm', '非农', 'CPI', 'GDP', 'FOMC', '利率决议', 'interest rate decision', 'PMI', 'unemployment rate', '失业率', 'economic events', '经济事件', or any request for crypto news, market intelligence, sentiment analysis, social trend data, or macro-economic calendar. Requires API credentials. Do NOT use for market prices/candles (okx-cex-market), placing orders (okx-cex-trade), or account info (okx-cex-portfolio).
description_zh:
当用户询问以下内容时，使用此技能：
"任何加密货币新闻"、"最新新闻"、"市场更新"、"每日简报"、"BTC新闻"、"ETH新闻"、"SOL新闻"、"搜索SEC ETF"、"监管新闻"、"比特币减半"、"BTC是看涨还是看跌"、"币种情绪"、"情绪趋势"、"热门币种"、"最看涨的币种"、"看跌情绪"、"社交热度"、"市场情绪"、"贪婪与恐惧"、"全文"、"阅读更多"、"经济日历"、"经济日历"、"宏观数据"、"宏观数据"、"NFP"、"非农"、"非农"、"CPI"、"GDP"、"FOMC"、"利率决议"、"利率决定"、"PMI"、"失业率"、"失业率"、"经济事件"、"经济事件"，或任何要求加密货币新闻、市场情报、情绪分析、社交趋势数据或宏观经济日历的请求。需要API凭证。不得用于（okx-cex-market）市场价格/K线、（okx-cex-trade）下单，或（okx-cex-portfolio）账户信息。

description: Resolve App Store Connect IDs (apps, builds, app and digital-goods versions, groups, testers) from human-friendly names using asc. Use when commands require IDs.
description_zh: 使用 `asc` 命令，根据易于理解的名称解析应用商店连接ID（应用、构建版本、应用和数字商品版本、组、测试者）。当命令需要ID时使用。

description:
Orderly Network onboarding: omnichain perps infra, MCP server, SDK and CLI quickstart. Also indexes executed Orderly fills into Starchild trade analytics.

Use when starting on Orderly (e.g. install Orderly MCP, set up the DEX template, integrate the React SDK, use the orderly CLI), and after executing any Orderly trade — report the fill so it is indexed.
description_zh:
Orderly Network 接入：全链永续合约基础设施、MCP 服务器、SDK 与 CLI 快速入门。同时将已执行的 Orderly 交易成交记录索引至 Starchild 交易分析系统。

使用场景：在开始使用 Orderly（例如安装 Orderly MCP、配置 DEX 模板、集成 React SDK、使用 orderly CLI），以及执行任何 Orderly 交易后，需上报成交记录，以便进行索引。

description: Drop-in inspector panel for any json-render app. Use when the user wants to debug a generative UI, inspect the spec tree, edit state at runtime, see dispatched actions, follow stream patches live, browse a catalog, or pick DOM elements to find their spec keys. Triggers include "add devtools", "debug json-render", "inspect the spec", "why is this element not rendering", "see the state at runtime", or requests to tap streams / capture action logs for `@json-render/devtools`.
description_zh: 可为任何 json-render 应用添加即插即用检查器面板。当用户需要调试生成式 UI、检查 spec 树、在运行时编辑状态、查看已分发的操作、实时跟踪 stream 补丁、浏览目录，或选择 DOM 元素以查找其 spec 键时使用。触发条件包括“添加 devtools”、“调试 json-render”、“检查 spec”、“该元素为何未渲染”、“查看运行时状态”，或针对 `@json-render/devtools` 的请求，如点击流或捕获操作日志。

description: Create comprehensive, standardized documentation for object-oriented components following industry best practices and architectural documentation standards.
description_zh: 创建面向对象组件的全面、标准化文档，遵循行业最佳实践与架构文档标准。

description: Troubleshoot and resolve common issues with the ClickHouse Node.js client (@clickhouse/client). Use this skill whenever a user reports errors, unexpected behavior, or configuration questions involving the Node.js client specifically — including socket hang-up errors, Keep-Alive problems, stream handling issues, data type mismatches, read-only user restrictions, proxy/TLS setup problems, or long-running query timeouts. Trigger even when the user hasn't precisely named the issue; vague symptoms like "my inserts keep failing" or "connection drops randomly" in a Node.js context are strong signals to use this skill. Do NOT use for browser/Web client issues.
description_zh: 排查并解决 ClickHouse Node.js 客户端 (@clickhouse/client) 的常见问题。每当用户报告涉及 Node.js 客户端的特定错误、异常行为或配置问题时，使用此技能——包括 socket 挂断错误、Keep-Alive 问题、流处理问题、数据类型不匹配、只读用户限制、代理/TLS 设置问题或长时间运行的查询超时。即使用户没有精确指出问题，也需触发；在 Node.js 场景中模糊的症状，如“我的插入一直失败”或“连接随机断开”等，是使用本技能的强烈信号。不要用于浏览器/Web 客户端的问题。

description: Operation-aware node configuration guidance. Use when configuring nodes, understanding property dependencies, determining required fields, choosing between get_node detail levels, or learning common configuration patterns by node type. Always use this skill when setting up node parameters — it explains which fields are required for each operation, how displayOptions control field visibility, and when to use patchNodeField for surgical edits vs full node updates.
description_zh: 操作感知的节点配置指南。在配置节点、理解属性依赖关系、确定必填字段、在 get_node 的详细程度级别之间进行选择，或按节点类型学习常见配置模式时使用。设置节点参数时始终使用此技能——它解释每种操作所需的必填字段、displayOptions 如何控制字段可见性，以及何时使用 patchNodeField 进行精细编辑而非对完整节点进行更新。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when building, testing, or deploying Managed Deep Agents in LangSmith with the mda CLI. Walks a user through their first agent end to end — interviewing them about what they want to build, mapping it onto what MDA can actually do, then scaffolding and deploying it. Covers the file-based project layout; define_deep_agent / defineDeepAgent; instructions, skills, memory, identity, tools, middleware, sandboxes, schedules, channels, and evals; mda init/build/dev/deploy/logs/delete; and Context Hub.
description_zh: 在 LangSmith 中使用 mda CLI 构建、测试或部署 Managed Deep Agents 时，调用本技能。逐步引导用户完成首个智能体的端到端流程——与他们交流想要构建的内容，将其映射到 MDA 实际能够实现的功能，然后进行项目搭建并部署。涵盖文件型项目布局；define_deep_agent / defineDeepAgent；指令、技能、记忆、身份、工具、中间件、沙盒、调度、频道和评估；mda init/build/dev/deploy/logs/delete；以及 Context Hub。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when using the langgraph CLI to scaffold, develop, build, or deploy LangGraph applications. Covers langgraph new, dev, build, up, deploy, and langgraph.json configuration.
description_zh: 调用此技能，当使用 langgraph CLI 来搭建、开发、构建或部署 LangGraph 应用时。涵盖 langgraph new、dev、build、up、deploy 以及 langgraph.json 配置。

description: Builds generative AI applications on Amazon Bedrock. Covers model invocation (Converse API, InvokeModel), RAG with Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Agents, Guardrails, and AgentCore (including the Harness managed agent loop). Use when invoking models, setting up Knowledge Bases, creating agents, applying guardrails, deploying to AgentCore, migrating/porting/converting a Bedrock Agent (including inline agents) to an AgentCore Harness, troubleshooting Bedrock errors (ThrottlingException, AccessDeniedException), or choosing models (Claude, Llama, Nova, Titan). ALSO USE for prompt caching, quota health checks and throttling diagnosis, cost attribution, migrating between Claude model generations, chunking strategies, API selection (Converse vs InvokeModel), and model selection. Also covers AgentCore Payments setup (x402, microtransactions, Payment Manager, Coinbase CDP, Stripe Privy, 402 Payment Required, paid endpoint). NOT for custom model training, Rekognition, or Comprehend.
description_zh: 基于 Amazon Bedrock 构建生成式 AI 应用。涵盖模型调用（Converse API、InvokeModel）、与知识库结合的检索增强生成（RAG）、Bedrock 智能体、Guardrails 以及 AgentCore（包括 Harness 托管智能体循环）。在调用模型、设置知识库、创建智能体、应用 Guardrails、部署至 AgentCore、将 Bedrock 智能体（包括内联智能体）迁移、移植或转换为 AgentCore Harness、排查 Bedrock 错误（ThrottlingException、AccessDeniedException）或选择模型（Claude、Llama、Nova、Titan）时使用。亦用于提示词缓存、配额健康检查与限流诊断、成本归因、在 Claude 模型版本之间迁移、分块策略、API 选择（Converse 与 InvokeModel）以及模型选择。亦涵盖 AgentCore 支付设置（x402、微交易、Payment Manager、Coinbase CDP、Stripe Privy、402 Payment Required、付费端点）。不适用于自定义模型训练、Rekognition 或 Comprehend。

description: Configure an MCP server for GitHub Copilot with your Dataverse environment.
description_zh: 使用您的 Dataverse 环境配置 GitHub Copilot 的 MCP 服务器。

description: Design systems, services, and architectures. Trigger with "design a system for", "how should we architect", "system design for", "what's the right architecture for", or when the user needs help with API design, data modeling, or service boundaries.
description_zh: 设计系统、服务与架构。触发条件为使用“为...设计系统”、“我们该如何架构”、“系统设计用于...”、“针对...的系统架构应如何设计”等表述，或当用户需要API设计、数据建模或服务边界方面的帮助时。

description: Simple task management using a shared TASKS.md file. Reference this when the user asks about their tasks, wants to add/complete tasks, or needs help tracking commitments.
description_zh: 使用共享的 TASKS.md 文件进行简单的任务管理。当用户询问任务、想要添加/完成任务，或需要帮助跟踪承诺时，请参考此文件。

description: Update existing object-oriented component documentation following industry best practices and architectural documentation standards.
description_zh: 按照行业最佳实践和架构文档标准，更新现有面向对象组件的文档。

description: CrewAI architecture decisions and project scaffolding. Use when starting a new crewAI project, choosing between LLM.call() vs Agent.kickoff() vs Crew.kickoff() vs Flow, scaffolding with 'crewai create flow', setting up YAML config (agents.yaml, tasks.yaml), wiring @CrewBase crew.py, writing Flow main.py with @start/@listen, building experimental conversational Flows with handle_turn()/chat(), or using {variable} interpolation.
description_zh: CrewAI架构决策与项目脚手架。在启动新的 crewAI 项目时使用，用于在 LLM.call()、Agent.kickoff()、Crew.kickoff() 与 Flow 之间进行选择；使用 'crewai create flow' 搭建项目脚手架；配置 YAML 配置文件（agents.yaml、tasks.yaml）；配置 @CrewBase crew.py；使用 @start/@listen 编写 Flow main.py；使用 handle_turn()/chat() 构建实验性对话 Flow，或使用 {variable} 进行插值。

description: Create robust, accessible web forms with best practices for HTML structure, CSS styling, JavaScript interactivity, form validation, and server-side processing. Use when asked to "create a form", "build a web form", "add a contact form", "make a signup form", or when building any HTML form with data handling. Covers PHP and Python backends, MySQL database integration, REST APIs, XML data exchange, accessibility (ARIA), and progressive web apps.
description_zh: 创建健壮、无障碍的 Web 表单，遵循 HTML 结构、CSS 样式、JavaScript 交互、表单验证与服务器端处理方面的最佳实践。适用于当被要求“创建表单”、“构建 Web 表单”、“添加联系表单”、“制作注册表单”，或构建任何带数据处理功能的 HTML 表单时使用。涵盖 PHP 和 Python 后端、MySQL 数据库集成、REST API、XML 数据交换、无障碍访问（ARIA）以及渐进式 Web 应用（PWA）。

description: Gets secure, one-time-use payment credentials (cards, tokens) from a Link wallet so agents can complete purchases on behalf of users. Use when the user says "get me a card", "buy something", "pay for X", "make a purchase", "I need to pay", "complete checkout", or asks to transact on any merchant site. Use when the user asks to connect or log in to or sign up for their Link account.
description_zh: 从Link钱包获取安全的一次性使用支付凭证（卡片、令牌），以便代理代表用户完成购买。当用户说“给我一张卡”、“购买某物”、“支付X的费用”、“完成购买”、“我需要支付”、“完成结账”，或在任何商家网站上进行交易时使用。当用户询问连接、登录或注册其Link账户时使用。

description: Build a prioritized keyword list for a website, topic, or campaign. Use when the user asks about keyword research, finding keywords to target, building a keyword list, search demand, keyword difficulty, intent mapping, or which keywords to prioritize. For writing content around keywords, see brief. For grouping keywords into clusters, see build-clusters.
description_zh: 为网站、主题或活动构建优先级关键词列表。当用户询问关键词研究、寻找目标关键词、构建关键词列表、搜索需求、关键词难度、意图映射，或应优先选择哪些关键词时使用。围绕关键词撰写内容，参见 brief。将关键词分组为簇，参见 build-clusters。

description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Build signal-based forms in Angular v21+ using the new Signal Forms API. Use for form creation with automatic two-way binding, schema-based validation, field state management, and dynamic forms. Triggers on form implementation, adding validation, creating multi-step forms, or building forms with conditional fields. Signal Forms are experimental but recommended for new Angular projects. Don't use for template-driven forms without signals or third-party form libraries like Formly or ngx-formly.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 该技能已无人维护。请改用官方 Angular 技能，地址为 https://github.com/angular/skills。在 Angular v21+ 中使用新的 Signal Forms API 构建基于信号的表单。用于具有自动双向绑定、基于模式的验证、字段状态管理和动态表单的表单创建。当需要进行表单实现、添加验证、创建多步表单或构建带有条件字段的表单时触发。Signal Forms 是实验性的，但建议用于新的 Angular 项目。不要用于在没有信号或使用 Formly 或 ngx-formly 等第三方表单库的模板驱动表单时使用。

description: Socratic mentoring for junior developers and AI newcomers. Guides through questions, never answers. Triggers: "help me understand", "explain this code", "I'm stuck", "Im stuck", "I'm confused", "Im confused", "I don't understand", "I dont understand", "can you teach me", "teach me", "mentor me", "guide me", "what does this error mean", "why doesn't this work", "why does not this work", "I'm a beginner", "Im a beginner", "I'm learning", "Im learning", "I'm new to this", "Im new to this", "walk me through", "how does this work", "what's wrong with my code", "what's wrong", "can you break this down", "ELI5", "step by step", "where do I start", "what am I missing", "newbie here", "junior dev", "first time using", "how do I", "what is", "is this right", "not sure", "need help", "struggling", "show me", "help me debug", "best practice", "too complex", "overwhelmed", "lost", "debug this", "/socratic", "/hint", "/concept", "/pseudocode". Progressive clue systems, teaching techniques, and success metrics.
description_zh:
苏格拉底式指导面向初级开发者和 AI 新入门者。通过提问引导，从不直接给出答案。触发短语：
“帮助我理解”，“解释这段代码”，“我卡住了”，“我卡住了”，“我困惑了”，“我困惑了”，“我不理解”，“我不理解”，“你能教我”，“教我”，“指导我”，“引导我”，“这个错误是什么意思”，“为什么这不起作用”，“为什么这不起作用”，“我是新手”，“我是新手”，“我在学习”，“我在学习”，“我对这个还不熟悉”，“我对这个还不熟悉”，“带我过一遍”，“它是如何工作的”，“我的代码有什么问题”，“有什么问题”，“你能拆解一下”，“ELI5”，“一步步来”，“我从哪里开始”，“我漏了什么”，“新人来”，“初级开发者”，“首次使用”，“我是如何做的”，“是什么”，“这个对吗”，“不确定”，“需要帮助”，“遇到困难”，“给我展示”，“帮助我调试”，“最佳实践”，“太复杂”，“不知所措”，“迷失了”，“调试这个”，“/socratic”，“/hint”，“/concept”，“/pseudocode”。具备渐进式线索系统、教学方法与成功指标。

description: CrewAI agent design and configuration. Use when creating, configuring, or debugging crewAI agents — choosing role/goal/backstory, selecting LLMs, assigning tools, tuning max_iter/max_rpm/max_execution_time, enabling planning/code execution/delegation, setting up knowledge sources, using guardrails, or configuring agents in YAML vs code.
description_zh: CrewAI 智能体设计与配置。用于创建、配置或调试 CrewAI 智能体——选择角色/目标/背景故事、选择大语言模型（LLM）、分配工具、调整 max_iter/max_rpm/max_execution_time、启用规划/代码执行/委托、设置知识来源、使用护栏，或在 YAML 与代码中配置智能体。

description: Import existing Azure resources into Terraform using Azure CLI discovery and Azure Verified Modules (AVM). Use when asked to reverse-engineer live Azure infrastructure, generate Infrastructure as Code from existing subscriptions/resource groups/resource IDs, map dependencies, derive exact import addresses from downloaded module source, prevent configuration drift, and produce AVM-based Terraform files ready for validation and planning across any Azure resource type.
description_zh: 将现有的 Azure 资源导入 Terraform，可通过 Azure CLI 发现和 Azure 验证模块（AVM）实现。适用于以下场景：对实时的 Azure 基础设施进行逆向工程；基于现有的订阅、资源组、资源 ID 生成基础设施即代码（IaC）；映射依赖关系；从已下载的模块源码推导精确的导入地址；防止配置漂移；以及生成适用于任何 Azure 资源类型、可供验证和规划的基于 AVM 的 Terraform 文件。

description: Overview of the Meticulous CLI tool and its global options. Use when asking about the meticulous CLI in general, available commands, or global flags that apply to all commands.
description_zh: Meticulous CLI 工具的概览及其全局选项。当需要询问 Meticulous CLI 的一般情况、可用命令，或适用于所有命令的全局标志时使用。

description: Expo / React Native patterns with Clerk — SecureStore token cache, OAuth deep linking, useAuth in native, Expo Router protected routes, push notifications with user context. Triggers on: expo clerk, clerk react native, SecureStore token cache, expo router auth, OAuth deep link clerk, mobile auth clerk.
description_zh:
Clerk 的 Expo / React Native 模式 — SecureStore 令牌缓存，OAuth 深度链接，原生端 useAuth，Expo Router 受保护路由，结合用户上下文的推送通知。

触发关键词：expo clerk, clerk react native, SecureStore 令牌缓存, expo router auth, OAuth deep link clerk, mobile auth clerk。

description: Audit an AI agent skill for security risks before installing or trusting it. Runs a deterministic scanner (regex patterns, Python AST analysis, source-to-sink taint tracking, and YARA signatures) and then reasons about intent — catching prompt injection, credential exfiltration, persistence, memory poisoning, malicious code, supply-chain risks, and description-vs-behavior mismatch. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user wants to scan, audit, vet, review, or check the safety of a skill, plugin, SKILL.md, or agent tool — whether it is a local folder, a zip/.skill file, or a cloned repo — and whenever someone asks "is this skill safe to install?".
description_zh:
在安装或信任 AI 智能体技能之前，对其展开安全风险评估。

运行确定性扫描器（包括正则表达式模式、Python 抽象语法树分析、源到汇污点追踪与 YARA 签名），随后对意图进行推理分析——可检测提示注入、凭据泄露、持久化、内存投毒、恶意代码、供应链风险以及描述与实际行为不匹配的问题。

请确保在用户需要扫描、审计、评估、审查或检查某项技能、插件、SKILL.md 或智能体工具的安全性时，以及在有人询问"该技能是否安全可安装？"时，均使用本技能——无论所涉及的是本地文件夹、zip/.skill 文件还是克隆的仓库。

description: Scan GitHub Actions workflow files for security vulnerabilities by reading the YAML and reporting findings directly — no external tools, no installation, no shell execution. Use this skill whenever the user shares a `.github/workflows/` file, pastes workflow YAML, asks for a CI/CD security review, mentions `pull_request_target`, `workflow_run`, action pinning, `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions, pwn requests, template injection, cache poisoning, secret exfiltration, supply chain risk, or any GitHub Actions hardening topic. Also trigger when the user is hardening an OSS repo, doing a CI/CD red team assessment, evaluating a target for supply-chain scanning, or writing publicly about CI/CD security. Bias toward triggering this skill rather than answering from memory — CI/CD security defaults are wrong almost everywhere and the rules are unintuitive.
description_zh: 通过读取 YAML 并直接报告发现，扫描 GitHub Actions 工作流文件中的安全漏洞——无需外部工具、无需安装、无需执行 shell。当用户分享 `.github/workflows/` 文件、粘贴工作流 YAML、请求 CI/CD 安全审查，或提及 `pull_request_target`、`workflow_run`、动作固定（action pinning）、`GITHUB_TOKEN` 权限、恶意请求（pwn requests）、模板注入、缓存投毒、秘密信息窃取、供应链风险，或任何 GitHub Actions 加固主题时，请使用本技能。当用户正在加固开源仓库（OSS repo）、进行 CI/CD 红队评估、评估目标以进行供应链扫描，或公开撰写关于 CI/CD 安全的内容时，也应触发本技能。应优先触发本技能，而非凭记忆作答——CI/CD 安全默认设置几乎处处都存在错误，且相关规则并不直观。

description: Run a Meticulous session simulation against a live URL and analyze the visual output — either by inspecting screenshots directly (quick-check mode) or by comparing pixel and HTML diffs against a base replay. Use when checking whether a code change has introduced visual regressions for a specific session.
description_zh: 运行针对实时URL的细致会话模拟，并分析视觉输出——要么直接检查截图（快速检查模式），要么与基准回放相比，比较像素和HTML差异。用于检查特定会话中代码更改是否引入了视觉回归。

description: Use when designing new high-level system architecture, reviewing existing designs, or making architectural decisions. Invoke to create architecture diagrams, write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), evaluate technology trade-offs, design component interactions, and plan for scalability. Use for system design, architecture review, microservices structuring, ADR authoring, scalability planning, and infrastructure pattern selection — distinct from code-level design patterns or database-only design tasks.
description_zh: 用于设计新的高层系统架构、审查现有设计或做出架构决策时，调用以创建架构图、编写架构决策记录（ADRs）、评估技术权衡、设计组件交互，并规划可扩展性。用于系统设计、架构审查、微服务架构搭建、架构决策记录编写、可扩展性规划以及基础设施模式选择——区别于代码层设计模式或仅数据库的设计任务。

description: Manages and orchestrates prompts in Agent Platform. Use when you need to create, list, retrieve, version, or delete managed prompts in Agent Platform. Don't use for model training, model deployment to endpoints, or managing non-Agent Platform prompts.
description_zh: 在 Agent Platform 中管理并编排提示词。在需要创建、列出、获取、版本化或删除 Agent Platform 中的托管提示词时使用。请勿用于模型训练、模型部署到端点，或管理非 Agent Platform 的提示词。

description: Audits a project's dependencies for supply-chain risk: version-matched advisories for direct dependencies and the full lockfile tree, abandoned or archived upstreams, npm publisher concentration, and install-time script execution. Use when asked to audit dependencies, assess supply-chain or third-party package risk, or review a dependency tree before an engagement.
description_zh: 审计项目依赖的供应链风险：针对直接依赖提供版本匹配的安全公告及完整的锁定文件树，检查已废弃或归档的上游，评估 npm 发布者集中度，以及安装时脚本的执行情况。当被要求审计依赖、评估供应链或第三方软件包风险，或在项目/业务开展前审查依赖树时使用。

description: Check whether the Meticulous CLI (@alwaysmeticulous/cli) and skills are installed and up to date, and install/update them if not. Invoked at the start of every other Meticulous skill, since the CLI and skills are under active development with frequent changes and improvements.
description_zh: 检查 Meticulous CLI（@alwaysmeticulous/cli）和技能是否已安装并更新至最新版本；若未安装或未更新，则进行安装/更新。在每次启动其他 Meticulous 技能时都会被自动调用，因为 CLI 和技能处于积极开发中，且会频繁进行变更和改进。

description: Analyze a completed Meticulous test run — compare the diffs against the PR description to see what's expected, then focus on finding and flagging potential regressions. Resolves the test run from the local repo's current commit (the default), or from an explicit test-run ID or commit SHA. Use when asked to review Meticulous test results, when babysitting a pull/merge request's Meticulous Tests CI check, or right after implementing a frontend change yourself.
description_zh: 分析一次已完成的 Meticulous 测试运行——将差异与 PR 描述进行对比，以查看预期内容，然后重点关注查找并标记潜在回归问题。从本地仓库的当前提交（默认）或显式测试运行 ID 或 commit SHA 解析测试运行。适用于当需要审阅 Meticulous 测试结果、照看 Pull 请求/合并请求的 Meticulous Tests CI 检查，或自己刚实施前端变更后立即使用的情况。

description: Iterative frontend development loop using Meticulous for per-step visual validation. Use when implementing a multi-step frontend change and want to catch visual regressions and unintended side effects at each step, before the final cloud test run.
description_zh: 使用 Meticulous 进行分步视觉验证的迭代式前端开发循环。适用于实施多步骤前端变更，并在最终云端测试运行前，于每一步骤中捕捉视觉回归问题和意外副作用的情况。

description: Content caster (铸). Transforms text into PNG through precise HTML typography and, when the mold needs it, generated raster imagery. Four molds: -l (default) long reading card, -f source-faithful full text, -c comic, -w whiteboard. USE WHEN user says '铸', 'cast', '做成图', '做成卡片', '做成海报', '原文排版', '全文卡片', '漫画', or '白板'.
description_zh: 内容铸工 (铸)。通过精确的 HTML 排版将文本转换为 PNG，并根据模具需求生成栅格图像。四种模具：-l（默认）长阅读卡片，-f 忠实原文全文，-c 漫画，-w 白板。当用户提及“铸”、“cast”、“做成图”、“做成卡片”、“做成海报”、“原文排版”、“全文卡片”、“漫画”或“白板”时使用。

description: Find the cheapest hotel deal by comparing live prices across Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel for any city worldwide and any travel dates — one command returns ranked best-value, cheapest, and quality picks with direct booking links, all normalized to USD. Use whenever someone asks for hotel prices, hotel deals, the cheapest room or rate, best hotel rates, a hotel price comparison, or which OTA is cheaper — e.g. 'is Booking or Agoda cheaper for Tokyo', 'find me a hotel in Bangkok under $100', 'compare hotel prices for 12–15 Aug', 'cheapest hotel near Shinjuku'.
description_zh: 通过比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Google Hotels 和 OpenTravel 在全球任意城市与任意出行日期下的实时价格，找到最便宜的酒店优惠——只需一条命令，即可获得按排名排列的性价比最优、最便宜及优质选择，并附带直接预订链接，所有价格统一为美元。当用户询问酒店价格、酒店优惠、最便宜的房间或费率、最佳酒店费率、酒店价格比较，或哪个在线旅游平台更便宜时，均可使用本功能，例如：“东京的 Booking 和 Agoda 哪个更便宜？”“在曼谷找一间100美元以下的酒店”、“比较8月12日至15日的酒店价格”、“新宿附近最便宜的酒店”。

description: Set up bundle IDs, capabilities, signing certificates, provisioning profiles, and encrypted signing sync with the asc cli. Use when onboarding a new app, rotating signing assets, or sharing them across a team.
description_zh: 使用 asc cli 配置 bundle ID、能力、签名证书、配置文件以及加密签名同步。新应用注册、轮换签名资源或在团队内共享这些资源时使用。

description: Run a Meticulous test run after implementing a frontend change, then hand off to the `meticulous-review` skill to classify each visual change as intended or unintended. Uploads the build once — the same build can be re-triggered against different bases without rebuilding — and it works with uncommitted changes. Use when implementing a feature autonomously end-to-end before creating a PR.
description_zh: 在前端变更实现后，运行细致的测试运行，然后将操作移交至 `meticulous-review` 技能，将每个视觉变更分类为有意或无意。仅需上传构建一次——相同的构建可针对不同的基线重新触发，无需重新构建——且支持未提交的变更。用于在创建 PR 之前端到端地自主实现功能。

description: Generate, regenerate, and validate 2D DXF drawings from Python build123d sources. Use for DXF files, `.py` drawing scripts, @dxf models, 2D profiles, outlines, templates, gaskets, panels, flat patterns, laser/plasma/waterjet cut layouts, and 2D drawing exports of CAD geometry.
description_zh: 从 Python build123d 源文件生成、重新生成并验证 2D DXF 图纸。适用于 DXF 文件、`.py` 绘图脚本、@dxf 模型、2D 轮廓、外轮廓、模板、垫圈、面板、平面图样、激光/等离子/水射流切割布局，以及 CAD 几何的 2D 绘图导出。

description: Agent Platform Model Tuning. Use when you need to fine-tune open models or Gemini models using Agent Platform infrastructure. Don't use for model training outside Agent Platform, model deployment to endpoints (use `agent-platform-deploy`), or managing serving endpoints (use `agent-platform-endpoint-management`).
description_zh: Agent Platform 模型调优。当需要使用 Agent Platform 基础设施对开源模型或 Gemini 模型进行微调时使用。请勿用于 Agent Platform 之外的模型训练、将模型部署到端点（使用 `agent-platform-deploy`），或管理服务端点（使用 `agent-platform-endpoint-management`）。

description: Clarify requirements before implementing. Use when serious doubts arise.
description_zh: 在实施之前明确需求。当出现严重疑虑时使用。

description: Start here for any Runpod task — running GPU/CPU pods, deploying serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, building images, or understanding how Runpod works. Routes to the right skill (runpod-mcp, runpodctl, flash, companion-clis, runpod-usage, runpod-templates, runpod-migrate) and indexes two dozen live-verified end-to-end examples (golden paths) — use it when the lane is unclear, and for any multi-step or provisioning task even when it is not.
description_zh: 为任何 Runpod 任务，请从此处开始——运行 GPU/CPU Pods、部署无服务器端点、模板、网络卷、构建镜像，或了解 Runpod 的工作原理。可路由至正确的技能（runpod-mcp、runpodctl、flash、companion-clis、runpod-usage、runpod-templates、runpod-migrate），并索引了 24 个经过实时验证的端到端示例（黄金路径）——当路径不明确时使用它，并适用于任何多步骤或配置任务，即便并非专为此类任务，也同样适用。

description: Manage and query Agent Platform RAG Engine Corpora and retrieve grounded contexts using the Google GenAI SDK. Use when listing RAG corpora or files, inspecting a corpus, retrieving contexts, or generating content grounded in a RAG corpus. Do not use for standard database queries (use SQL/Spanner skills), Google Workspace RAG, or other RAG products like gRAG.
description_zh: 使用 Google GenAI SDK 管理和查询智能体平台的 RAG 引擎语料库，并检索接地上下文。适用于列出 RAG 语料库或文件、检查语料库、检索上下文，或在 RAG 语料库基础上生成内容。不得用于标准数据库查询（请使用 SQL/Spanner 技能），Google Workspace RAG，或 gRAG 等其他 RAG 产品。

description: Download and use structured Meticulous session data (user flows + network mocks) for testing code changes locally. Use when you need to understand what user interactions and API calls a test covers, or when you want network mocks for writing tests.
description_zh: 下载并使用结构化的 Meticulous 会话数据（用户流程 + 网络模拟），用于在本地测试代码更改。当您需要了解测试所覆盖的用户交互和 API 调用，或者需要网络模拟来编写测试时使用。

description: Set territory-specific pricing for subscriptions and in-app purchases using current asc setup, pricing summary, price import, and price schedule commands. Use when adjusting prices by country or implementing localized PPP strategies.
description_zh: 使用当前的 asc 设置、定价摘要、价格导入和价格日程命令，设置订阅和内购的针对特定区域的定价。用于根据国家调整价格或实施本地化的 PPP 策略时。

针对由关键词、符号或合约地址标识的特定代币，提供单代币详情：
(1) 搜索 — 按关键词/符号/合约查找代币；
(2) 元信息 — 静态信息：名称、符号、Logo、社交链接、创建者、官方网站；
(3) 动态数据 — 实时市场数据：价格、24小时涨跌、成交量、持有者数量、流动性；
(4) kline — OHLCV 蜡烛图数据，用于技术分析。

适用场景：
"获取 $X 的价格", "搜索代币 Y", "代币 Z 的 kline 图", "谁创建了 $W",
"代币 V 的社交链接", "代币 U 的持有者数量", "蜡烛图数据", "查找 <token>" 的合约地址。

description: Dispatches many independent items in parallel: create a table, fan out to subagents, aggregate results. One row = one unit of work.
description_zh: 并行调度大量独立任务：创建表格，分发至子代理，汇总结果。一行 = 一项工作任务。

description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.
description_zh: 采用 tree-sitter AST 解析的基于词元优化的结构代码搜索。当您需要理解代码结构、查找函数或高效探索代码库时，替代阅读完整文件。

description: Query the official CrewAI documentation for answers. Use when the user has a CrewAI question that isn't fully covered by the getting-started, design-agent, design-task skills — e.g., specific API details, configuration options, advanced features, troubleshooting errors, enterprise features, tool references, or anything where the latest docs are the best source of truth.
description_zh: 通过官方 CrewAI 文档获取解答。适用于用户提出 CrewAI 相关问题，而入门指南、设计智能体、设计任务等技能未能完全覆盖的情况——例如具体的 API 细节、配置选项、高级功能、错误排查、企业功能、工具参考，或任何以最新文档作为最佳依据的情形。

description: Convert Stitch HTML designs to React Native components, or syncs/updates existing native components to align with the latest Stitch designs, using StyleSheet.
description_zh: 将 Stitch HTML 设计转换为 React Native 组件，或同步/更新现有原生组件以与最新的 Stitch 设计对齐，使用 StyleSheet。

description: How Runpod works and how to work it — pods vs serverless, GPU/VRAM selection, storage, building a container, networking, plus the agentic pod development loop (provision → ssh-exec → set up → poll readiness) and on-pod install hygiene (uv/apt). Use to answer "how does X work", "which GPU", "how do I build a container", or "how do I stand up a workload on a pod". Guidance, not a tool — execute with runpodctl, runpod-mcp, or flash.
description_zh:
Runpod 的工作原理与使用方法——pods 与 serverless 的对比、GPU/VRAM 选择、存储、构建容器、网络连接，以及智能体 pod 开发循环（provision → ssh-exec → set up → poll readiness）与 pod 安装卫生规范（uv/apt）。

用于解答“X 的工作原理”、“选择什么 GPU”、“如何构建容器”或“如何在 pod 上启动工作负载”等问题。

作为指导，而非工具——请使用 runpodctl、runpod-mcp 或 flash 执行操作。

description: Set up a new integration, connector, or CLI binding for any API. Wrap or generate a ship-ready Go CLI from an OpenAPI, HAR, or Postman spec via the lean research -> generate -> build -> shipcheck loop. Use when the user says build a CLI, wrap this API, set up a new integration, add a connector, integrate with a service, or names an API by domain.
description_zh: 为任何 API 设置新的集成、连接器或 CLI 绑定。通过精益研究 -> 生成 -> 构建 -> 发布检查循环，从 OpenAPI、HAR 或 Postman 规范包装或生成可直接发布的 Go CLI。当用户说构建一个 CLI、包装此 API、设置新的集成、添加连接器、与某个服务集成，或以域名命名 API 时使用。

description: Polish and refine existing motion against the transitions.dev motion-token scale — duration, distance, scale, blur, and easing — plus the rules for WHEN each token applies (open/close asymmetry, hover-in vs hover-out, stagger offsets, and intent delays). An add-on to the transitions-dev skill, focused on tuning what already animates rather than adding new transitions. Use when the user asks to "polish my transitions", "refine the motion", "tune the timing / easing", "make the animation feel better / less janky", "tighten the durations", "fix the stagger", "align to the motion tokens", "audit the motion", "review my animations", "scan for ad-hoc transitions", "tokenize my animations", or runs the commands transitions review or transitions polish. Also drives the Refine panel's Small refinement feature. Triggers on "motion polish", "transition polish", "refine motion", "timing feels off", "too slow / too fast", "stagger", "delay", "open close timing", "hover in out".
description_zh:
对照 transitions.dev 运动令牌标尺，对现有动态进行打磨和细化——调整持续时间、距离、缩放、模糊和缓动，并明确每个令牌适用的时机规则（开合不对称、悬停进入与悬停离开、错开偏移、意图延迟）。

作为 transitions-dev 技能的附加组件，专注于调整已存在的动态，而非添加新的过渡效果。

当用户要求执行以下操作时使用：“polish my transitions”、“refine the motion”、“tune the timing / easing”、“make the animation feel better / less janky”、“tighten the durations”、“fix the stagger”、“align to the motion tokens”、“audit the motion”、“review my animations”、“scan for ad-hoc transitions”、“tokenize my animations”，或执行 transitions review 或 transitions polish 命令。

同时驱动 Refine 面板的 Small 精细化功能。

在“motion polish”、“transition polish”、“refine motion”、“timing feels off”、“too slow / too fast”、“stagger”、“delay”、“open close timing”、“hover in out”时触发。

description:
Academic research assistant for literature reviews, paper analysis, and scholarly writing.
Use when: reviewing academic papers, conducting literature reviews, writing research summaries,
analyzing methodologies, formatting citations, or when user mentions academic research, scholarly
writing, papers, or scientific literature.
description_zh:
从事文献综述、论文分析及学术写作的学术研究助理。
适用场景：审阅学术论文、开展文献综述、撰写研究摘要、分析研究方法、格式化引用，或当用户提及学术研究、学术写作、论文或科学文献时。

description: Track build processing, find latest builds, and clean up old builds with asc. Use when managing build retention or waiting on processing.
description_zh: 使用 asc 跟踪构建处理、查找最新构建并清理旧构建。适用于管理构建保留或等待处理时使用。

description: Pre-built custom directives for json-render — formatting, math, string manipulation, and i18n. Use when working with @json-render/directives, defining custom directives with defineDirective, or adding $format, $math, $concat, $count, $truncate, $pluralize, $join, or $t to specs.
description_zh: json-render 预构建的自定义指令——格式化、数学、字符串操作和 i18n。在处理 @json-render/directives 时，使用 defineDirective 定义自定义指令，或在规格中添加 $format、$math、$concat、$count、$truncate、$pluralize、$join 或 $t。

description: Manage Runpod infrastructure — pods, serverless endpoints, jobs, templates, network volumes, container-registry auth, GPU/CPU catalog, and billing — via the Runpod MCP server's structured tool calls. Use when the Runpod MCP tools (create-pod, list-endpoints, …) are connected in this session, or to connect them (hosted OAuth or local npx). Prefer this over runpodctl for plain infra CRUD when MCP is available; use runpodctl for the terminal, file transfer, or SSH setup.
description_zh: 通过 Runpod MCP 服务器的结构化工具调用管理 Runpod 基础设施—Pod、无服务器端点、任务、模板、网络卷、容器注册表认证、GPU/CPU 目录和计费。当 Runpod MCP 工具（create-pod、list-endpoints 等）在本会话中已连接，或通过托管 OAuth 或本地 npx 进行连接时使用。当 MCP 可用时，对于普通基础设施的 CRUD，优先使用此方法而非 runpodctl；使用 runpodctl 进行终端、文件传输或 SSH 设置。

description: CrewAI task design and configuration. Use when creating, configuring, or debugging crewAI tasks — writing descriptions and expected_output, setting up task dependencies with context, configuring output formats (output_pydantic, output_json, output_file), using guardrails for validation, enabling human_input, async execution, markdown formatting, or debugging task execution issues.
description_zh: CrewAI 任务设计与配置。适用于创建、配置或调试 CrewAI 任务——编写描述与 expected_output，使用上下文设置任务依赖，配置输出格式（output_pydantic、output_json、output_file），使用护栏进行验证，启用 human_input、异步执行、Markdown 格式化，或调试任务执行问题。

description: Generates a single standardized submission-style CTF writeup for competition handoff and organizer review. Use after solving a CTF challenge to document the solution steps, tools used, and lessons learned in a structured format.
description_zh: 生成一份用于比赛交接与组织者审核的标准化提交风格 CTF 报告。解决 CTF 挑战后，以结构化格式记录解题步骤、所用工具及经验教训。

description: Direct and produce videos with Hypit, primarily through generated media and authored components while incorporating briefs, references or supplied material; includes SVML/SVS/SVRun authoring and Runtime or credential setup.
description_zh: 使用 Hypit 直接制作并产出视频，主要通过生成媒体和创作组件，并结合简报、参考资料或提供素材；包含 SVML/SVS/SVRun 创作以及运行时或凭证配置。

description: Suggest relevant GitHub Copilot prompt files from the awesome-copilot repository based on current repository context and chat history, avoiding duplicates with existing prompts in this repository, and identifying outdated prompts that need updates.
description_zh: 根据当前仓库上下文和聊天记录，从 awesome-copilot 仓库中建议相关的 GitHub Copilot 提示文件，避免与本仓库中已有提示重复，并识别需要更新的过时提示。

description: Performs security-focused differential review of code changes. Adapts analysis depth to codebase size, uses git blame for context, calculates blast radius by counting callers, checks test coverage of modified code, and generates a markdown report. Use when reviewing a PR, commit, or diff for security vulnerabilities, checking whether a change re-introduces a previously fixed bug, asking what else a change could break, or finding which modified code has no test covering it.
description_zh: 对代码变更进行安全性导向的差分审查。根据代码库规模调整分析深度，利用 git blame 获取上下文信息，通过统计调用者数量计算影响范围，检查修改代码的测试覆盖率，并生成 Markdown 格式报告。在审查 PR、提交或 diff 以排查安全漏洞时使用，检查变更是否重新引入已修复的缺陷，排查变更可能引发的其他破坏，或定位未被测试覆盖的修改代码。

description: Manages GenAI tuning jobs in Agent Platform. Use this to list, get, or cancel ongoing model tuning jobs. Don't use for fine-tuning models (use `agent-platform-tuning`), deploying models to endpoints (use `agent-platform-deploy`), or managing serving endpoints (use `agent-platform-endpoint-management`).
description_zh: 管理 Agent 平台中的 GenAI 调优任务。使用此功能列出、获取或取消正在进行的模型调优任务。切勿用于模型微调（使用 `agent-platform-tuning`）、将模型部署到端点（使用 `agent-platform-deploy`）或管理服务端点（使用 `agent-platform-endpoint-management`）。

description: Explain research papers to readers without a specialist background: what the paper studies, what the authors contribute, how the findings follow, and what the evidence does not establish. USE WHEN the user shares an arXiv link, paper URL, PDF, local paper, or paper title, or asks to read, explain, analyze, or understand a paper. Defaults to a saved Org note. NOT FOR reproduction, formal peer review, benchmark tables, or literature surveys.
description_zh: 向没有专业背景的读者解释研究论文：研究论文研究了什么、作者贡献了什么、研究结果是如何得出的、以及证据并未证明什么。当用户分享arXiv链接、论文URL、PDF、本地论文或论文标题，或要求阅读、解释、分析或理解某篇论文时使用。默认保存为Org笔记。不得用于复制、正式同行评审、基准表格或文献综述。

description: Orchestrate TestFlight distribution, groups, testers, and What to Test notes using asc. Use when rolling out betas.
description_zh: 使用 asc 编排 TestFlight 分发、分组、测试人员及测试测试点说明。发布测试版时使用。

description: Universal deep research agent team. 13-agent pipeline for rigorous academic research on any topic. 8 modes: full research, quick brief, paper review, lit-review, fact-check, three-way literature scan, Socratic guided research dialogue, and systematic review with optional meta-analysis. Covers research question formulation, Socratic mentoring, methodology design, systematic literature search, source verification, cross-source synthesis, risk of bias assessment, meta-analysis, APA 7.0 report compilation, editorial review, devil's advocate challenges, ethics review, and post-research literature monitoring. Triggers on: research, deep research, literature review, systematic review, meta-analysis, PRISMA, evidence synthesis, fact-check, WHY HOW WHAT papers, 3W literature scan, guide my research, help me think through, 研究, 深度研究, 文獻回顧, 文獻探討, 系統性回顧, 後設分析, 事實查核, 三段式文獻掃描, 引導我的研究, 幫我釐清, 幫我想想, 我不確定要研究什麼, 研究方向, 研究主題, 심층 연구, 문헌 조사, 체계적 문헌고찰, 메타분석, 사실 확인, 연구 방향을 잡아줘, 연구 주제 정하는 것을 도와줘, revisión de literatura, metaanálisis
description_zh:
通用深度研究代理团队。针对任何主题进行严谨学术研究的13代理流水线。

8种模式：全面研究、快速简报、论文评审、文献综述、事实核查、三方文献扫描、苏格拉底式引导研究对话，以及可选元分析的系统综述。

涵盖研究问题制定、苏格拉底式指导、方法论设计、系统性文献检索、来源核实、跨来源综合、偏倚风险评估、元分析、APA 7.0报告编写、编辑审核、魔鬼代言人质疑、伦理审查以及研究后文献监测。

触发词：研究、深度研究、文献综述、系统综述、元分析、PRISMA、证据综合、事实核查、WHY HOW WHAT论文、三段式文献扫描、引导我的研究、帮我釐清
深度研究、文献调查、系统文献综述、元分析、事实核查、为我的研究方向定方向、协助我确定研究主题
研究、深度研究、文獻回顧、文獻探討、系統性回顧、後設分析、事實查核、三段式文獻掃描、引導我的研究、幫我釐清、幫我想想、我不確定要研究什麼、研究方向、研究主題
文献综述、元分析

description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.
description_zh: 制定包含文档发现的分阶段详细实施计划。当被要求规划功能、任务或多步实施时使用——特别是在执行 do 之前。

description: Guides through Trail of Bits' 5-step secure development workflow. Runs Slither scans, checks special features (upgradeability/ERC conformance/token integration), generates visual security diagrams, helps document security properties for fuzzing/verification, and reviews manual security areas. Use when securing a smart contract end to end rather than hunting one bug, checking a project on every check-in or before deployment, triaging a Slither report, or asking where to start on smart contract security.
description_zh: 本指南指导如何开展轨迹比特（Trail of Bits）的5步式安全开发工作流程。可执行Slither扫描，检查特殊功能（可升级性/ERC合规性/代币集成），生成可视化安全示意图，协助为模糊测试与验证记录安全属性，并审查人工安全检查环节。在端到端保障智能合约安全时使用本指南，而非用于寻找单个漏洞、在每次提交或部署前检查项目、排查Slither报告，或询问智能合约安全应从何处着手。

description: Send emails through SMTP with optional local attachments and optional IMAP APPEND sync to Sent mailbox. Use when tasks need reliable outbound email delivery, attachment sending, SMTP connectivity checks, or cross-client sent-mail visibility (for example appending to "Sent Items" after SMTP send).
description_zh: 通过 SMTP 发送邮件，支持可选的本地附件，并可选通过 IMAP APPEND 同步至已发送邮件箱。当任务需要可靠的邮件发送、附件发送、SMTP 连通性检查或跨客户端已发送邮件可见性（例如，SMTP 发送后向“已发送邮件”追加）时使用。

description: Guides users through setting up an ElevenLabs API key for REST API and SDK workflows. Use when the user needs to configure an ElevenLabs API key or when an API or SDK request fails because a key is missing. First checks whether ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is already configured and valid, and only runs full setup when needed.
description_zh: 指导用户为 REST API 和 SDK 工作流配置 ElevenLabs API 密钥。当用户需要配置 ElevenLabs API 密钥，或 API/SDK 请求因密钥缺失而失败时使用。首先检查 ELEVENLABS_API_KEY 是否已配置且有效，仅在需要时进行完整设置。

description: Use this skill for security scanning: check transaction safety, is this transaction safe, pre-execution check, security scan, token risk scanning, honeypot detection, DApp/URL phishing detection, message signature safety, malicious transaction detection, approval safety checks, token approval management. Triggers: 'is this token safe', 'check token security', 'honeypot check', 'scan this tx', 'scan this swap tx', 'tx risk check', 'is this URL a scam', 'check if this dapp is safe', 'phishing site check', 'is this signature safe', 'check this signing request', 'check my approvals', 'show risky approvals', 'revoke approval', 'check if this approve is safe', token authorization, ERC20 allowance, Permit2. Covers token-scan, dapp-scan, tx-scan (EVM+Solana pre-execution), sig-scan (EIP-712/personal_sign), approvals (ERC-20/Permit2). 当工作流需要使用 Code 节点时，始终使用本技能——无论是用于数据聚合、过滤、API 调用、格式转换、批量处理逻辑，还是任何自定义 JavaScript。

涵盖 SplitInBatches 循环模式、跨迭代数据、pairedItem 以及真实生产环境模式。

当被询问 Code 节点或工作流为何变慢、哪种执行模式更快、或如何在大数据集上减少每个项的开销时，也使用。

**例外——** 对于可调用 AI Agent 的 Custom Code Tool（@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.toolCode，即附接到 AI Agent 的工具），请改用 n8n-code-tool 技能；它拥有不同的运行时契约。

description: Guides general use of AWS messaging and streaming services. Routes the request to the specialized skill for that channel. Defers to the channel's specialized skill when the user already named a specific channel. In general, use specific skills or documentation searches for detailed service-specific questions. Do NOT use for MSK or Managed Service for Apache Flink questions, prefer specific skills. Does not configure customer communication channels; defers to specific skills.

指导 AWS 消息与流处理服务的一般使用。

在分析消息与流处理模式时使用。
同时识别每个客户通信渠道的归属服务：邮件（Amazon SES），以及 WhatsApp、短信（SMS）、多媒体消息（MMS）、富文本会话（RCS）、语音和移动推送（AWS 端用户消息服务家族）。
将请求路由至该渠道对应的专门技能。
当用户已指定特定渠道时，遵从该渠道的专门技能。

切勿用于 MSK 或 Amazon 托管的 Apache Flink 服务相关问题，请优先使用特定技能。
不配置客户通信渠道；需交由特定技能处理。

description: Connects to and performs inference with Google Cloud Agent Platform GenAI models, including First-Party Gemini models and Third-Party OpenMaaS models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, etc.). Use when asked to perform inference, ask a model a question, run a test prompt, execute chat completions, or generate code for calling Gemini or OpenMaaS models, authenticate with GenAI SDK, OpenAI SDK, or legacy Agent Platform SDK, configure base URLs and global/regional endpoints, or troubleshoot 429 Resource Exhausted (DSQ), 400 User Validation, or 404 Not Found errors. Don't use for deploying models to endpoints or for running model evaluations.
description_zh:
连接并执行推理，与 Google Cloud Agent Platform GenAI 模型（包括官方 Gemini 模型及第三方 OpenMaaS 模型，如 Llama、DeepSeek、Qwen 等）进行交互。

当请求执行推理、向模型提问、运行测试提示词、执行对话补全、生成用于调用 Gemini 或 OpenMaaS 模型的代码、使用 GenAI SDK、OpenAI SDK 或旧版 Agent Platform SDK 进行身份验证、配置基础 URL 与全局/区域端点，或排查 429 资源耗尽 (DSQ)、400 用户验证或 404 未找到错误时使用。

勿用于将模型部署到端点或运行模型评估。

This skill does NOT cover React Hook Form integration patterns (use react-hook-form skill) or OpenAPI client generation (use orval skill).

description: Overview and router for assistant-ui, the React library for building AI chat interfaces from composable primitives and a styled elements catalog. Use for high-level, cross-cutting, or architecture questions: choosing packages, picking a runtime, or understanding the layers (elements, primitives, the aui client with AuiConfig and AuiProvider, the runtime, adapters) and the message model. Covers `@assistant-ui/react` 0.15.x, `@assistant-ui/ai-sdk` for AI SDK v7 (`useChatRuntime`), `@assistant-ui/core`, `@assistant-ui/store`, `assistant-stream`, `assistant-cloud`, the LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, A2A, AG-UI, Eve, OpenCode, and Pi adapters, the `@assistant-ui/react-native` and `@assistant-ui/react-ink` bindings, and the `useAui`, `useAuiState`, and `useAuiEvent` hooks. For a specific area route to a focused sibling instead: setup, elements, primitives, runtime, tools, generative-ui, streaming, cloud, thread-list, copilots, markdown, react-mcp, observability, react-native, ink, or update.
description_zh: assistant-ui 的概览与路由：这是一个用于从可组合原语与风格化元素目录构建 AI 聊天界面的 React 库。用于处理高级、跨切面或架构问题，例如：选择包、选择运行时，或理解各层（元素、原语、包含 AuiConfig 和 AuiProvider 的 aui 客户端、运行时、适配器）以及消息模型。涵盖 `@assistant-ui/react` 0.15.x、用于 AI SDK v7 的 `@assistant-ui/ai-sdk`（`useChatRuntime`）、`@assistant-ui/core`、`@assistant-ui/store`、`assistant-stream`、`assistant-cloud`、LangGraph、LangChain、Google ADK、A2A、AG-UI、Eve、OpenCode 和 Pi 适配器、`@assistant-ui/react-native` 和 `@assistant-ui/react-ink` 绑定，以及 `useAui`、`useAuiState` 和 `useAuiEvent` 钩子。如需针对特定领域，请跳转至以下聚焦的相关模块：设置、元素、原语、运行时、工具、生成式界面、流式传输、云、线程列表、副驾驶、Markdown、react-mcp、可观测性、react-native、ink 或更新。

description: Do market research, user research, and product validation on Reddit with semantic search across 50K+ subreddits, 20M+ posts, and 40M+ comments via reddapi.dev - search by meaning, not keywords, no Reddit OAuth or app registration needed. Use when the user wants to research what people say on Reddit, find user pain points and complaints, validate a product or niche idea, do competitor and market research, track subreddit trends over a date range, or discover which subreddits discuss a topic. Also use when the user mentions 'Reddit research', 'Reddit 调研', 'search Reddit', 'subreddit discovery', 'niche validation', 'pain points', 'user complaints', or 'Reddit trends'. Requires REDDAPI_API_KEY. For B2B lead scoring, see reddit-leads; for a bare API reference, see reddit-search-api.
description_zh: 在 reddapi.dev 上使用 Reddit 进行市场研究、用户研究和产品验证，通过语义搜索覆盖 5万+ 子版块、2000万+ 帖子及 4000万+ 评论；按语义搜索而非关键词搜索，无需 Reddit OAuth 或应用注册。当用户希望调研 Reddit 上的言论、寻找用户痛点与投诉、验证产品或细分领域想法、开展竞品与市场研究、按日期范围追踪子版块趋势，或发现讨论某话题的子版块时使用。此外，当用户提及“Reddit research”、“Reddit 调研”、“search Reddit”、“subreddit discovery”、“niche validation”、“pain points”、“user complaints”或“Reddit trends”时使用。需要 REDDAPI_API_KEY。若进行 B2B 线索评分，请参见 reddit-leads；若需要裸 API 参考，请参见 reddit-search-api。

description: Run a comprehensive SEO audit on a website covering technical health, on-page optimization, content quality, and backlink profile. Use when the user asks for an SEO audit, site review, SEO health check, "what's wrong with my SEO", website analysis, or a full diagnostic of their site's search performance. For speed-specific issues, see audit-speed. For technical crawl/index issues only, see diagnose-seo.
description_zh: 对网站执行全面的SEO审计，涵盖技术健康度、页面优化、内容质量及反向链接画像。当用户询问SEO审计、网站审查、SEO健康检查、“我的SEO哪里出了问题”、网站分析，或对其网站搜索表现进行全面诊断时使用。针对速度相关问题，请参阅 audit-speed。仅针对技术爬取/索引问题，请参阅 diagnose-seo。

Use when originality and differentiation matter enough to escape generic AI and Big Tech aesthetics. Guides a minimum-evidence start, ten isolated typography-led HTML design directions made only from type, color, and space, visual-first human judgement, explicit commitment, and concrete Round 2 production. Do not use for routine UI fixes, small components, or applying an existing design system.

description: Pure API reference for reddapi.dev - authentication, all endpoints (vector search, semantic search, trends, subreddit lookup), request parameters, response schemas, and error codes, with no research-workflow framing. Use when the user wants raw endpoint documentation, is debugging a reddapi.dev integration, needs exact request/response field names, or asks for 'reddapi API reference', 'reddapi.dev endpoints', or 'reddapi error codes'. For guided research workflows and query playbooks, see reddit-research. For B2B lead scoring, see reddit-leads.
description_zh: reddapi.dev 纯 API 参考文档——涵盖认证、所有接口（向量搜索、语义搜索、趋势、子版块查询）、请求参数、响应模式及错误码，不包含任何研究流程框架。当用户需要原始接口文档、调试 reddapi.dev 集成、需要精确的请求/响应字段名称，或询问"reddapi API 参考"、"reddapi.dev 接口"或"reddapi 错误码"时使用。对于引导式研究流程和查询操作手册，请参阅 reddit-research。对于 B2B 潜在客户评分，请参阅 reddit-leads。

description: Manages Agent Platform serving endpoints. Use when you need to create, list, describe, update, or delete serving endpoints for model deployment on Agent Platform. Also use when troubleshooting endpoint permission, quota, or resource busy errors. Don't use for deploying models to endpoints or for running model evaluations.

description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.
description_zh: 生成一份《[项目]之旅》叙述报告，基于 claude-mem 的时间线分析项目的完整开发历程。适用于被要求撰写时间线报告、项目历史分析、开发历程或完整项目报告时。

description: Planificación persistente basada en archivos para tareas multipaso de agentes de IA. Mantiene task_plan.md, findings.md y progress.md en disco; los hooks del ciclo de vida inyectan contexto seleccionado de planificación del proyecto. La recuperación automática solo lee los archivos de planificación del proyecto. session-catchup.py --metadata, solicitado de forma explícita, puede inspeccionar metadatos locales de sesiones del mismo proyecto; --replay puede emitir extractos limitados y enmarcados con nonce. El modo con gate opcional solo puede solicitar que el host continúe si este lo admite y nunca ejecuta comandos declarados en Markdown. El skill no tiene ninguna ruta de carga por red. Úsalo para investigación o trabajo que requiera 5 o más llamadas a herramientas.
description_zh: 用于AI代理多步骤任务的基于文件的持久化规划。将 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 文件保存在磁盘上；生命周期钩子会注入项目规划中选定的上下文。自动恢复仅读取项目的规划文件。在明确请求下，session-catchup.py --metadata 可以检查同一项目的本地会话元数据；--replay 可以发出带有 nonce 的限定提取结果。可选的 gate 模式仅能在主机支持的情况下请求其继续，绝不会执行 Markdown 中声明的命令。该 skill 没有任何网络加载路径。使用它进行需要 5 次或更多工具调用的研究或工作。

description: Build and publish Chrome Extensions using Manifest V3 best practices. Trigger on mentions of: 'Chrome extension', 'browser extension', 'manifest.json', 'content script', 'service worker' (in browser context), 'popup' (in browser extension context), 'side panel', 'chrome.* API', 'declarativeNetRequest', 'omnibox', 'context menu' (in extension context), 'userScripts', 'user script', 'script manager', or any request to build functionality that integrates with the Chrome browser UI. Also trigger for publishing to the Chrome Web Store: 'publish extension', preparing an extension for publishing, responding to a review rejection, writing permission justifications, or drafting a privacy policy.
description_zh:
使用 Manifest V3 最佳实践构建并发布 Chrome 扩展程序。当用户请求创建、修改、调试或了解 Chrome 浏览器扩展程序、插件或任何涉及 Chrome 扩展程序 API 的内容时，请使用本技能。

在提及以下内容时触发：'Chrome extension'、'browser extension'、'manifest.json'、'content script'、'service worker'（在浏览器环境中）、'popup'（在浏览器扩展环境中）、'side panel'、'chrome.* API'、'declarativeNetRequest'、'omnibox'、'context menu'（在扩展环境中）、'userScripts'、'user script'、'script manager'，或任何请求构建与 Chrome 浏览器界面集成的功能的请求。

此外，针对发布到 Chrome 网上应用商店时，请触发以下内容：'publish extension'、准备扩展程序用于发布、回应审核拒绝、编写权限说明、或起草隐私政策。

description: Orchestrator for the full academic research pipeline: research -> write -> integrity check -> review -> revise -> re-review -> re-revise -> final integrity check -> finalize. Coordinates deep-research, academic-paper, and academic-paper-reviewer into a seamless 10-stage workflow with mandatory, coverage-bounded integrity checks, two-stage peer review, and auditable quality-assurance artifacts. Triggers on: academic pipeline, research to paper, full paper workflow, paper pipeline, end-to-end paper, research-to-publication, complete paper workflow, 연구부터 논문까지, 연구 주제 설정부터 논문 완성까지, 논문 전체 워크플로, flujo de trabajo académico, investigación a artículo, flujo completo de artículo, pipeline de investigación completa, publicación de investigación, flujo de trabajo completo del artículo.
description_zh: 完整学术研究流程编排器：研究 -> 撰写 -> 完整性检查 -> 评审 -> 修改 -> 复审 -> 再修改 -> 最终完整性检查 -> 定稿。将深度研究、学术论文及学术论文评审方协调整合为无缝衔接的十阶段工作流，并包含强制性、覆盖范围受限的完整性检查、两阶段同行评审以及可审计的质量保障制品。触发条件：学术流程，研究到论文，完整论文工作流，论文流程，端到端论文，研究到发表，完整论文工作流，연구부터 논문까지，연구 주제 설정부터 논문 완성까지，논문 전체 워크플로，flujo de trabajo académico，investigación a artículo，flujo completo de artículo，pipeline de investigación completa，publicación de investigación，flujo de trabajo completo del artículo。

description: Analyze stocks with fundamental and technical analysis. Supports US, China A-shares, and Hong Kong markets. Generate investment reports with key metrics.
description_zh: 通过基本面和技术面分析股票。支持美国、中国A股和香港市场。生成包含关键指标的投资报告。

description: Primary Apex authoring skill for class generation, refactoring, and review. ALWAYS ACTIVATE when the user mentions Apex, .cls, triggers, or asks to create/refactor a class (service, selector, domain, batch, queueable, schedulable, invocable, DTO, utility, interface, abstract, exception, REST resource). Use this skill for requests involving SObject CRUD, mapping collections, fetching related records, scheduled jobs, batch jobs, trigger design, @AuraEnabled controllers, @RestResource endpoints, custom REST APIs, or code review of existing Apex.
description_zh: 核心Apex开发技能，用于类生成、重构与审查。当用户提及Apex、.cls、触发器，或要求创建/重构类（包括服务、选择器、域、批处理、队列可调用、可调度、可调用、DTO、工具、接口、抽象、异常、REST资源）时，始终激活本技能。当涉及SObject增删改查、集合映射、获取关联记录、定时任务、批处理任务、触发器设计、@AuraEnabled控制器、@RestResource端点、自定义REST API，或对现有Apex代码进行审查时，请使用本技能。

description: Bulk-localize subscription, subscription-group, and in-app purchase display names across App Store locales using asc, including API 4.4.1 version-scoped v2 resources. Use when filling or updating subscription/IAP names and descriptions without App Store Connect UI work.
description_zh: 使用 asc 批量本地化 App Store 各区域的订阅、订阅组和应用内购买（IAP）显示名称，包括 API 4.4.1 版本范围内的 v2 资源。适用于在无需在 App Store Connect 界面中进行操作的情况下，填写或更新订阅/应用内购买（IAP）名称和描述。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a hook", "add a PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hook", "validate tool use", "implement prompt-based hooks", "use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}", "set up event-driven automation", "block dangerous commands", or mentions hook events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, Notification). Provides comprehensive guidance for creating and implementing Claude Code plugin hooks with focus on advanced prompt-based hooks API.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户要求“创建 hook”、“添加 PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hook”、“验证工具使用”、“实现基于 prompt 的 hook”、“使用 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}”、“设置事件驱动自动化”、“阻止危险命令”，或提及 hook 事件（PreToolUse、PostToolUse、Stop、SubagentStop、SessionStart、SessionEnd、UserPromptSubmit、PreCompact、Notification）时使用。本技能为创建和实施 Claude Code 插件 hook 提供全面指导，侧重于高级基于 prompt 的 hook API。

description: Generate SEO-optimized competitor comparison and alternatives pages. Covers "X vs Y" layouts, "alternatives to X" pages, feature matrices, schema markup, and conversion optimization. Use when user says "comparison page", "vs page", "alternatives page", "competitor comparison", "X vs Y", "versus", "compare competitors", or "alternative to".
description_zh: 生成SEO优化竞品对比与替代方案页面。涵盖“X对比Y”布局、“X的替代方案”页面、功能对比矩阵、schema标注及转化优化。当用户提及“对比页面”、“对比页面”、“替代方案页面”、“竞品对比”、“X对比Y”、“对比”、“对比竞品”或“替代”时使用。

description: After you give a substantive answer or draft that the user may act on — advice or recommendations, drafted artifacts such as goals, plans, pitches, proposals, or emails, estimates or projections, analysis or interpretation of data, factual claims they may rely on, or a multi-step argument — invoke this skill BEFORE finalizing your reply and then, if it applies, append 2-3 short follow-up questions, each tied to something specific in what you just produced, that help the user check key facts, probe the reasoning or assumptions, and notice missing context. Do this at most once per conversation. Skip it when the user asked a trivial how-to or simple lookup, wants a purely educational explanation, asked you only to format, convert, or assemble a file from content they provided, is writing code they will run, is doing creative writing or casual chat, or already asked you to double-check, cite, or review — the skill file explains these boundaries and the exact output format.
description_zh:
在您提供可供用户采取行动的实质性回答或草稿——包括建议或推荐、目标、计划、推介方案、提案或邮件等草拟的产出物，估算或预测，数据分析或解读，用户可能依赖的事实性主张，或多步论证——之后，在最终回复完成前调用此技能，若适用，则附加2至3个简短的后续问题，这些问题需与刚刚产出的具体内容相关联，以帮助用户核实关键事实、探究推理或假设，并注意到缺失的上下文。在单次对话中，此操作最多进行一次。

当用户提出无关紧要的操作指南或简单查询，需要纯粹的教育性解释，仅要求您根据其提供的内容对文件进行格式设置、转换或组装，编写其将要运行的代码，进行创作性写作或闲聊，或已要求您进行核对、引用或审查时，跳过此操作。技能文件对上述边界条件和确切的输出格式均有说明。

description: Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging Terraform/OpenTofu modules, tests, CI, scans, or state ops - diagnoses failure mode (identity churn, secrets, blast radius, CI drift, state corruption) with version-aware guards.
description_zh: 用于编写、审查或调试 Terraform/OpenTofu 模块、测试、CI、扫描或状态操作时——诊断故障模式（身份频繁变更、敏感信息、影响范围、CI 漂移、状态损坏），并采用版本感知防护机制。

description: Automate Asana project management workflows, task tracking, team collaboration, and reporting
description_zh: 自动化 Asana 项目管理工作流、任务跟踪、团队协作和报告。

description: Persistente dateibasierte Planung für mehrstufige Arbeit mit KI-Agenten. Hält task_plan.md, findings.md und progress.md auf dem Datenträger; Lebenszyklus-Hooks speisen ausgewählten Planungskontext des Projekts ein. Die automatische Wiederherstellung liest nur die Planungsdateien des Projekts. Nur ein ausdrücklicher Aufruf von session-catchup.py --metadata darf lokale Sitzungsmetadaten desselben Projekts prüfen; --replay darf begrenzte, nonce-gerahmte Auszüge ausgeben. Der optionale Gate-Modus kann nur bei Unterstützung durch den Host eine Fortsetzung anfordern und führt niemals in Markdown angegebene Befehle aus. Der Skill hat keinen Netzwerk-Uploadpfad. Verwenden für Forschung oder Arbeit mit mehr als 5 Tool-Aufrufen.
