description_zh: 基于持久化文件的方案规划，用于AI Agent进行多层级工作。在存储设备上保留 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 文件；生命周期钩子将所选项目的规划方案注入。自动恢复仅读取项目自身的规划文件。仅允许显式调用 session-catchup.py --metadata 来检查同一项目的本地会话元数据；--replay 可输出有限的、基于nonce的摘录。可选的 Gate 模式仅在主机支持的情况下请求继续，且永远不会执行 Markdown 中指定的命令。该技能没有网络上传路径。用于研究或执行超过 5 次工具调用的任务。

description: Use MagicPath through the magicpath-ai CLI to find, preview, inspect, install, export, create, and edit UI components and manage MagicPath skills. Trigger for MagicPath designs/components; personal or team projects; active canvases and selected components/images/revisions; themes/design systems; teams, members, ownership, attribution, installed-component audits, and share/view links. Use when exporting exact MagicPath components or revisions to local folders/apps; replacing, adapting, or translating local UI with 1:1 fidelity and explicit requested changes; installing React/TypeScript components with inspect/add; authoring responsive interactive canvas components with code start/submit; importing or recreating UI from local paths or GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repositories into MagicPath; or creating, retrieving, updating, importing, enabling, disabling, or deleting MagicPath skills. In hosts with an embedded browser, keep the project canvas open via share URLs for visual work.
description_zh: 通过 magicpath-ai CLI 使用 MagicPath，可查找、预览、检查、安装、导出、创建和编辑 UI 组件，并管理 MagicPath 技能。适用于 MagicPath 设计/组件的触发；个人或团队项目；处于活动状态的画布及已选定的组件、图片、版本；主题/设计系统；团队、成员、所有权、署名、已安装组件审计以及分享/查看链接。适用于将 MagicPath 组件或版本精确导出至本地文件夹或应用的场景；以 1:1 保真度和明确要求变更的方式替换、适配或翻译本地 UI；使用 inspect/add 安装 React/TypeScript 组件；通过代码开始/提交编写响应式的交互式画布组件；将本地路径或 GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket 仓库中的 UI 导入或重建至 MagicPath；或创建、获取、更新、导入、启用、禁用或删除 MagicPath 技能。在带有嵌入式浏览器的宿主环境中，请通过分享链接保持项目画布打开，以进行可视化工作。

description: تخطيط مستمر قائم على الملفات لعمل وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي متعدد الخطوات. يحتفظ بملفات task_plan.md و findings.md و progress.md على القرص، وتحقن خطافات دورة الحياة سياق التخطيط المحدد للمشروع. تقرأ الاستعادة التلقائية ملفات تخطيط المشروع فقط. يمكن للأمر الصريح session-catchup.py --metadata فحص بيانات وصفية لجلسات الوكيل المحلية التابعة للمشروع نفسه، بينما قد يصدر --replay مقتطفات محدودة مؤطرة بقيمة nonce. يمكن للوضع المحكوم الاختياري طلب المتابعة فقط عندما يدعمه المضيف، ولا ينفذ أبدًا أوامر معلنة في Markdown. لا تتضمن المهارة مسارًا لرفع البيانات عبر الشبكة. تُستخدم للبحث أو العمل الذي يحتاج إلى 5 استدعاءات أدوات أو أكثر.
description_zh: 用于多步骤智能体工作的持续文件驱动规划。在磁盘上保留 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 文件，并将项目的特定规划上下文通过生命周期钩子进行加密。自动恢复仅读取项目规划文件。显式命令 session-catchup.py --metadata 可以检查属于该项目自身的本地智能体会话的元数据，而 --replay 可能会输出由 nonce 值界定的有限片段。可选的受控状态仅在主机支持时才会请求后续操作，并且绝不会执行 Markdown 中的任何声明命令。该功能不包含通过网络上传数据的方法。用于需要 5 次或更多工具调用的搜索或工作。

description: 投资分析。给一个项目（公司名、BP、创始人对话记录），写一份深度投资分析报告。不走传统投资分析的路——核心判断只有一个：这个项目是不是一台「秩序创造机器」。Use when user says '投资报告', '投资分析', '分析这个项目', '写投资报告', 'investment report', 'invest analysis', or provides entrepreneur conversation records wanting investment evaluation. Also trigger when user pastes or references meeting notes, pitch decks, or founder interviews and asks for analysis.
description_zh: 投资分析。给一个项目（公司名、BP、创始人对话记录），写一份深度投资分析报告。不走传统投资分析的路——核心判断只有一个：这个项目是不是一台「秩序创造机器」。当用户说“投资报告”、“投资分析”、“分析这个项目”、“写投资报告”、“投资报告”、“投资分析”或提供希望进行投资评估的创始人对话记录时使用。另外，当用户粘贴或引用会议记录、路演幻灯片或创始人访谈，并要求进行分析时，也触发此规则。

description: PluginEval quality methodology — dimensions, rubrics, statistical methods, and scoring formulas. Use this skill when understanding how plugin quality is measured, when interpreting a low score on a specific dimension, when deciding how to improve a skill's triggering accuracy or orchestration fitness, when calibrating scoring thresholds for your marketplace, or when explaining quality badges to external partners like Neon.
description_zh: PluginEval 质量方法论 — 维度、评分标准、统计方法及评分公式。当理解插件质量如何被测量时，当解读特定维度的低分时，当决定如何提升技能的触发准确率或编排适配度时，当为您的市场校准评分阈值时，或当向 Neon 等外部合作伙伴解释质量徽章时，请使用此技能。

description: Use when working with Payload projects (payload.config.ts, collections, fields, hooks, access control, Payload API). Use when debugging validation errors, security issues, relationship queries, transactions, or hook behavior.
description_zh: 适用于在 Payload 项目（payload.config.ts、集合、字段、钩子、访问控制、Payload API）中工作。适用于调试验证错误、安全问题、关系查询、事务或钩子行为。

description: MCP server with 39 tools for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, OCR operations
description_zh: MCP 服务器配备 39 个用于 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、PDF 和 OCR 操作的工具

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "add MCP server", "integrate MCP", "configure MCP in plugin", "use .mcp.json", "set up Model Context Protocol", "connect external service", mentions "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with MCP", or discusses MCP server types (SSE, stdio, HTTP, WebSocket). Provides comprehensive guidance for integrating Model Context Protocol servers into Claude Code plugins for external tool and service integration.
description_zh: 当用户询问添加 MCP server、集成 MCP、在插件中配置 MCP、使用 .mcp.json、设置 Model Context Protocol、连接外部服务、提及 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with MCP" 或讨论 MCP server 类型（SSE、stdio、HTTP、WebSocket）时，应使用本技能。为将 Model Context Protocol 服务器集成到 Claude Code 插件中，以实现外部工具和服务集成，提供全面的指导。

description: Polish a generated CLI to pass verification and become publish-ready. Runs diagnostics (dogfood, verify, scorecard, go vet, gosec), automatically fixes all issues (verify failures, static-analysis findings, dead code, descriptions, README, MCP tool quality), reports the before/after delta, and offers to publish. Use after any /printing-press run, or on any CLI in $PRESS_LIBRARY/. Trigger phrases: "polish", "improve the CLI", "fix verify", "make it publish-ready", "clean up the CLI", "get this ready to ship".
description_zh: 对生成的 CLI 进行润色，使其通过验证并达到发布就绪状态。运行诊断（dogfood、verify、scorecard、go vet、gosec），自动修复所有问题（verify 失败、静态分析发现、死代码、描述、README、MCP 工具质量），报告修改前后的差异，并提供发布选项。在任何 /printing-press 运行之后使用，或在 $PRESS_LIBRARY/ 中的任意 CLI 上使用。触发短语：“润色”、“改进 CLI”、“修复 verify 问题”、“使其发布就绪”、“清理 CLI”、“准备好发布”。

description: 将数据可视化为图表。当用户需要生成柱状图、折线图、饼图、散点图、雷达图、桑基图、思维导图、流程图等图表时调用此技能，通过 curl 工具调用 AntV API 生成图表图片
description_zh: 将数据可视化为图表。当用户需要生成柱状图、折线图、饼图、散点图、雷达图、桑基图、思维导图、流程图等图表时调用此技能，通过 curl 工具调用 AntV API 生成图表图片。

description: Publish a generated CLI to the printing-press-library repo
description_zh: 将生成的 CLI 发布到 printing-press-library 仓库

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a slash command", "add a command", "write a custom command", "define command arguments", "use command frontmatter", "organize commands", "create command with file references", "interactive command", "use AskUserQuestion in command", or needs guidance on slash command structure, YAML frontmatter fields, dynamic arguments, bash execution in commands, user interaction patterns, or command development best practices for Claude Code.
description_zh: 当用户请求"创建斜杠命令"、"添加命令"、"编写自定义命令"、"定义命令参数"、"使用命令 YAML frontmatter"、"组织命令"、"创建包含文件引用的命令"、"交互式命令"、"在命令中使用 AskUserQuestion"，或需要有关斜杠命令结构、YAML frontmatter 字段、动态参数、命令中的 bash 执行、用户交互模式或 Claude Code 命令开发最佳实践的指导时，应使用此技能。

description: Define, validate, run, resume, and audit repo-local multi-step automations with current `asc workflow` and `.asc/workflow.json`, including step outputs and safe release/TestFlight workflows.
description_zh: 使用当前的 `asc workflow` 和 `.asc/workflow.json`，定义、验证、运行、恢复并审计仓库本地的多步骤自动化，包括步骤输出以及安全的发布/TestFlight 工作流。

description: 给一个领域，找出背后真正撑着它的几根独立的力。十几个现象砍到不可再少的生成器——砍完能把现象一个个生回来，才算数。Use when user says '降秩', '找秩', '秩是什么', '这个领域靠什么撑着', '背后是什么', or wants to decompose any domain to its irreducible generators.
description_zh: 对于一个领域，找出背后真正支撑它的几股独立的力。将十几个现象砍到不可再少的生成器——砍完之后能把现象一个个生成出来，才算数。当用户说“降秩”、“找秩”、“秩是什么”、“这个领域靠什么撑着”、“背后是什么”，或希望对任意领域分解为其不可再少的生成器时使用。

description: Write high-converting landing page copy using proven frameworks like PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solution), AIDA, and StoryBrand. Creates headlines, value propositions, CTAs, and full page sections optimized for conversion. Use when users need landing page copy, sales page content, or marketing website text.
description_zh: 运用经过验证的框架（如PAS（问题-激化-解决方案）、AIDA和StoryBrand），撰写高转化落地页文案。创建优化转化的标题、价值主张、行动号召（CTAs）及完整页面板块。适用于用户需要落地页文案、销售页面内容或营销网站文本时。

description: Guides agents and users through migrating from Gemini API in Google AI Studio to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI). Use this skill when moving applications to Google Cloud, to leverage Cloud credits, or to unify inferencing with other Cloud infrastructure (IAM, billing, telemetry).
description_zh: 引导智能体和用户完成从 Google AI Studio 中的 Gemini API 迁移至 Gemini 企业智能体平台（原 Vertex AI）。当将应用程序迁移至 Google Cloud、利用云额度，或将推理与云的其他基础设施（IAM、billing、telemetry）统一时，使用此技能。

description: Interpret validation errors and guide fixing them. Use when encountering validation errors, validation warnings, false positives, operator structure issues, or need help understanding validation results. Also use when asking about validation profiles, error types, the validation loop process, or auto-fix capabilities. Consult this skill whenever a validate_node or validate_workflow call returns errors or warnings — it knows which warnings are false positives and which errors need real fixes.
description_zh: 解读验证错误并提供修正指导。在遇到验证错误、验证警告、误报、操作符结构问题，或需要帮助理解验证结果时，请使用此技能。在询问验证配置、错误类型、验证循环流程或自动修正功能时，也请使用此技能。每当 `validate_node` 或 `validate_workflow` 调用返回错误或警告时，请咨询此技能——它明确哪些警告属于误报，哪些错误需要进行实质性修正。

description: Archive, export, and notarize macOS apps using xcodebuild and asc. Use when you need to prepare a macOS app for distribution outside the App Store with Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.
description_zh: 使用 xcodebuild 和 asc 归档、导出并公证 macOS 应用。适用于需要准备 macOS 应用，通过 Developer ID 签名与 Apple 公证进行 App Store 之外分发的情况。

description: Generate and validate Apex test classes with TestDataFactory patterns, bulk testing (251+ records), mocking strategies, assertion best practices, and disciplined test-fix loops. Use this skill when creating new Apex test classes, improving test coverage, debugging and fixing failing Apex tests, running test execution and coverage analysis, or implementing testing patterns for triggers, services, controllers, batch jobs, queueables, and integrations. Triggers on *Test.cls, *_Test.cls files, sf apex run test workflows, coverage reports, test-fix loops. Do NOT trigger for production Apex code (use platform-apex-generate) or Jest/LWC tests.
description_zh: 使用测试数据工厂（TestDataFactory）模式生成并验证 Apex 测试类，支持批量测试（251条以上记录）、模拟（mocking）策略、断言最佳实践以及规范化的测试修复循环。当创建新的 Apex 测试类、优化测试覆盖率、调试和修复失败的 Apex 测试、运行测试执行与覆盖率分析，或为触发器、服务、控制器、批处理任务、队列任务及集成实现测试模式时，请使用本技能。适用于 *Test.cls、*_Test.cls 文件、sf apex run test 工作流、覆盖率报告、测试修复循环。请勿用于生产 Apex 代码（使用 platform-apex-generate）或 Jest/LWC 测试。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a hookify rule", "write a hook rule", "configure hookify", "add a hookify rule", or needs guidance on hookify rule syntax and patterns.
description_zh: 当用户要求执行“创建 Hookify 规则”“编写 Hook 规则”“配置 Hookify”“添加 Hookify 规则”，或需要关于 Hookify 规则语法和模式的指导时，应使用本技能。

description: Pentest a web app or website end to end — black-box testing of a live URL, staging environment, or local dev server that finds and exploits real vulnerabilities (auth bypass, broken access control, IDOR, injection, XSS, SSRF, business logic) and proves each one with a working proof-of-concept instead of a signature match. Runs with Strix, either the self-hosted open-source CLI or the managed app.strix.ai cloud. Use when the user asks to pentest, hack, security-test, or audit their web app, website, web application, or staging site.
description_zh: 对 Web 应用或网站进行端到端渗透测试——对在线 URL、预发布环境或本地开发服务器进行黑盒测试，发现并利用真实漏洞（身份验证绕过、访问控制失效、IDOR、注入、XSS、SSRF、业务逻辑），并为每个漏洞提供可工作的概念验证来证明，而非仅凭签名匹配。可通过 Strix 运行，无论是自托管开源命令行工具，还是托管的 app.strix.ai 云服务。当用户要求对 Web 应用、网站、Web 应用程序或预发布站点进行渗透测试、黑客攻击、安全测试或审计时使用。

description: Find security vulnerabilities in a codebase or repository with Strix — a white-box AI security review that reads your source, reasons about the actual data flow and authorization model, then exploits what it finds in a live sandbox so every reported issue has a working proof-of-concept instead of a noisy static-analysis alert. Covers injection, XSS, SSRF, broken access control and IDOR, insecure deserialization, secrets in code, unsafe dependencies, and business-logic flaws. Use when the user asks to security-scan, security-review, or audit their code, repo, or pull request for vulnerabilities.
description_zh: 使用Strix在代码库或仓库中查找安全漏洞——Strix是一种白盒AI安全审查，它能够读取您的源代码，对实际的数据流和授权模型进行分析，并在实时沙箱中利用所发现的问题，从而确保每个报告的问题都拥有可用的概念验证，而非嘈杂的静态分析告警。覆盖注入、XSS（跨站脚本）、SSRF（服务端请求伪造）、访问控制失效和IDOR（基于不安全的直接对象引用）、不安全的反序列化、代码中的秘密信息、不安全的依赖项以及业务逻辑缺陷。当用户要求对代码、仓库或拉取请求进行安全扫描、安全审查或漏洞审计时使用。

description: Create or evaluate an architecture decision record (ADR). Use when choosing between technologies (e.g., Kafka vs SQS), documenting a design decision with trade-offs and consequences, reviewing a system design proposal, or designing a new component from requirements and constraints.
description_zh: 创建或评估架构决策记录（ADR）。在以下情况下使用：在技术之间进行选择（例如，Kafka vs SQS）、记录包含权衡与后果的设计决策、审查系统设计方案，或根据需求和约束设计新组件。

description: Use this skill when the user mentions 'onchainos ws', 'ws start', 'ws poll', 'ws stop', 'ws channels', 'ws session', 'ws channel-info', 'idle-timeout', 'idle timeout', 'WebSocket channels', 'WS频道', or asks about managing WebSocket sessions/会话管理. Also use when writing a custom WebSocket script/脚本/bot for real-time on-chain data. Covers: onchainos ws CLI commands (start/poll/stop/list/channels/channel-info), session lifecycle, idle-timeout configuration, and all 9 DEX WebSocket channels (price, candle, trades, price-info, signals, tracker, meme scanning).
description_zh: 当用户提及以下内容时，请使用此技能：'onchainos ws'、'ws start'、'ws poll'、'ws stop'、'ws channels'、'ws session'、'ws channel-info'、'idle-timeout'、'idle timeout'、'WebSocket channels'、'WS频道'，或询问关于 WebSocket 会话与/会话管理的内容。同时，当编写用于实时链上数据的自定义 WebSocket 脚本/脚本/机器人时，也请使用此技能。涵盖内容：onchainos ws CLI 命令（start/poll/stop/list/channels/channel-info）、会话生命周期、idle-timeout 配置，以及全部 9 个 DEX WebSocket 频道（price、candle、trades、price-info、signals、tracker、meme scanning）。

description: Use when building real-time communication systems with WebSockets or Socket.IO. Invoke for bidirectional messaging, horizontal scaling with Redis, presence tracking, room management.
description_zh: 在基于 WebSocket 或 Socket.IO 构建实时通信系统时使用。用于双向通信、基于 Redis 的横向扩展、在线状态追踪及房间管理。

description: MUST USE when investigating performance issues on a ClickHouse-managed Postgres instance. Provides an evidence-based RCA workflow that scrapes the Prometheus endpoint for system signal, pulls per-digest evidence from the Slow Query Patterns API, and recommends (does not apply) a fix.
description_zh: 调查 ClickHouse 托管 Postgres 实例的性能问题时，必须使用。提供基于证据的根因分析（RCA）工作流，该工作流抓取 Prometheus 端点获取系统信号，从 Slow Query Patterns API 获取每个摘要的证据，并推荐（不适用）修复方案。

description: Security-test a REST, GraphQL, or gRPC API with Strix — autonomous agents that enumerate endpoints from an OpenAPI/GraphQL schema (or by crawling), then actually exploit the API-specific vulnerability classes in the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023) — broken object-level authorization (BOLA/IDOR), broken object property level authorization (excessive data exposure and mass assignment), broken function-level authorization, unrestricted resource consumption, SSRF, injection, and auth/token flaws. Every finding comes with a working proof-of-concept request. Use when the user asks to pentest, security-test, audit, or find vulnerabilities in an API, endpoint, or backend service.
description_zh: 使用 Strix 对 REST、GraphQL 或 gRPC API 进行安全测试——Strix 配备自主智能体，能够从 OpenAPI/GraphQL 模式（或通过爬取）枚举端点，并实际利用 OWASP API 安全 Top 10（2023）中的 API 特定漏洞类别，如对象级授权绕过（BOLA/IDOR）、对象属性级授权绕过（过度数据暴露和批量赋值）、功能级授权绕过、不受限制的资源消耗、SSRF、注入以及认证/令牌漏洞。每个发现均附带可用的概念验证请求。当用户要求对 API、端点或后端服务进行渗透测试、安全测试、审计或漏洞查找时，使用本功能。

description: Test an application against the OWASP Top 10 with Strix — autonomous AI agents that attempt real exploits for each category of the current OWASP Top 10:2025 (broken access control including SSRF, security misconfiguration, software supply chain failures, cryptographic failures, injection, insecure design, authentication failures, integrity failures, logging and alerting failures, mishandling of exceptional conditions) and report only what they could actually prove, mapped back to the category with a proof-of-concept. Also covers the OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023). Use when the user asks for an OWASP Top 10 assessment, OWASP compliance testing, or a security review mapped to OWASP categories.
description_zh: 使用 Strix 对应用进行 OWASP Top 10 测试——Strix 是自主 AI 代理，针对当前 OWASP Top 10:2025（越权访问控制（含 SSRF）、安全配置错误、软件供应链漏洞、加密失败、注入、设计不安全、认证失败、完整性失败、日志与告警失败、异常条件处理不当）的各个类别尝试真实漏洞利用，并仅报告其实际能够验证的内容，映射回对应类别并附带概念验证。同时涵盖 OWASP API 安全 Top 10 (2023)。当用户要求 OWASP Top 10 评估、OWASP 合规性测试或按 OWASP 类别映射的安全审查时使用。

description: Salesforce debug log analysis and troubleshooting with 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user analyzes debug logs, hits governor limits, reads stack traces, or touches .log files from Salesforce orgs. DO NOT TRIGGER when: running Apex tests (use platform-apex-test-run), generating or fixing Apex code (use platform-apex-generate), or Agentforce session tracing (use agentforce-observe).
description_zh: 采用 100 分制评分的 Salesforce 调试日志分析与故障排除。触发条件：用户分析调试日志、达到 governor 限制、读取堆栈跟踪，或接触来自 Salesforce 组织的 .log 文件。禁止触发条件：运行 Apex 测试（使用 platform-apex-test-run）、生成或修复 Apex 代码（使用 platform-apex-generate），或 Agentforce 会话追踪（使用 agentforce-observe）。

description: Systematically verifies suspected security bugs to eliminate false positives, producing a TRUE POSITIVE or FALSE POSITIVE verdict with documented evidence for each. Use when asked whether a specific finding is real, exploitable, or a false positive, or to verify or validate a suspected vulnerability — not for hunting or discovering new bugs.
description_zh: 系统性验证疑似安全漏洞，以消除误报，并为每条产出具有文档化证据的“真阳性”或“假阳性”判定。当被询问特定发现是否为真实、可利用或误报，或用于验证或确认疑似漏洞时使用——不用于漏洞挖掘或发现新漏洞。

description: TikTok content strategy, video creation workflows, posting optimization, and analytics. Based on n8n automation templates.
description_zh: TikTok内容策略、视频创作工作流、发布优化和数据分析。基于 n8n 自动化模板。

description: Repository-grounded threat modeling that enumerates trust boundaries, assets, attacker capabilities, abuse paths, and mitigations, and writes a concise Markdown threat model. Trigger only when the user explicitly asks to threat model a codebase or path, enumerate threats/abuse paths, or perform AppSec threat modeling. Do not trigger for general architecture summaries, code review, or non-security design work.
description_zh: 基于代码仓库的威胁建模：枚举信任边界、资产、攻击者能力、滥用路径及缓解措施，并生成简洁的 Markdown 威胁模型。仅在用户明确要求对代码库或路径进行威胁建模、枚举威胁/滥用路径或执行应用安全（AppSec）威胁建模时触发。不对一般的架构概述、代码审查或非安全相关设计工作触发。

description: Deep-dive English word mastery tool. Deconstructs a single English word into core semantics and epiphany. Use when user asks to explain/master a specific English word.
description_zh: 深度英语单词掌握工具。拆解单个英语单词，将其核心语义与顿悟揭示出来。当用户要求解释或掌握特定英语单词时使用。

description: Guided first-run demo for Cargo — one persona question to 25 real leads with a cost receipt in under two minutes, ending by saving the pull as a recurring play. Triggers: "show me what Cargo can do", "give me a demo", "take me on a tour", "quickstart", "getting started with Cargo", "I just installed Cargo", "my workspace is empty", "does this actually work". Skip when: the user has a real job to run (build a list, enrich a CSV, find emails) — use cargo-gtm; when they want CLI reference or routing — use the cargo router skill.
description_zh:
**Cargo 引导式首次演示**

用一个问题询问 25 位真实线索用户的身份，在两分钟内生成费用收据，并将运行结果保存为周期性播放。

**触发词：**

**跳过情况：**
用户有实际任务需处理（如构建列表、丰富 CSV 文件、查找邮件）时，使用 cargo-gtm；当用户需要 CLI 参考或路由功能时，使用 cargo 路由技能。

description: Renamed to cargo-project. This entry exists only so installs from before the rename are replaced by a pointer. Skip when: always — load cargo-project.
description_zh: 已重命名为 cargo-project。此条目仅用于将重命名前的安装替换为指向 cargo-project 的指针。跳过时：始终 — 加载 cargo-project。

description: Apex test execution, coverage analysis, and test-fix loops with 120-point scoring. Use when the user needs to run Apex tests, check code coverage, fix failing tests, or work with *Test.cls / *_Test.cls files. TRIGGER when: user runs Apex tests, checks code coverage, fixes failing tests, or touches *Test.cls / *_Test.cls files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex production code (use platform-apex-generate), Agentforce agent testing (use agentforce-test), or Jest/LWC tests (use experience-lwc-generate).
description_zh:
具备 120 分制评分的 Apex 测试执行、覆盖率分析与测试修复循环。

适用场景：当用户需要执行 Apex 测试、检查代码覆盖率、修复失败测试，或处理 *Test.cls / *_Test.cls 文件时使用。

触发条件：当用户执行 Apex 测试、检查代码覆盖率、修复失败测试，或接触 *Test.cls / *_Test.cls 文件时触发。

不触发条件：编写 Apex 生产代码（使用 platform-apex-generate）、进行 Agentforce 智能体测试（使用 agentforce-test），或执行 Jest/LWC 测试（使用 experience-lwc-generate）。

description: Help users write syntactically and semantically correct primary constructors in Dart, and migrate/use the new constructor syntax, empty-body semicolon syntax, in-body initializer list syntax, and abbreviated concise constructor syntax.
description_zh: 帮助用户在Dart中编写语法和语义正确的主构造函数，并迁移/使用新的构造函数语法、空体分号语法、构造函数体内初始化列表语法以及简洁缩写构造函数语法。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a plugin", "scaffold a plugin", "understand plugin structure", "organize plugin components", "set up plugin.json", "use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}", "add commands/agents/skills/hooks", "configure auto-discovery", or needs guidance on plugin directory layout, manifest configuration, component organization, file naming conventions, or Claude Code plugin architecture best practices.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户要求"创建插件"、"搭建插件脚手架"、"理解插件结构"、"组织插件组件"、"设置 plugin.json"、"使用 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"、添加命令/代理/技能/钩子，或需要关于插件目录布局、清单文件配置、组件组织、文件命名规范或 Claude Code 插件架构最佳实践的指导时使用。

description: Relationship analyst combining structural diagnostics (5-layer framework) with psychoanalytic depth (transference, unconscious patterns, resistance). Guides users through dialogue to "see" the real structure of their relationship issues. Use when user says "关系分析", "分析关系", "relationship", "人际关系", or describes a specific relationship problem they want to understand.
description_zh: 结合结构性诊断（五层框架）与精神分析深度（移情、无意识模式、阻抗）的关系分析师。通过对话引导用户“看见”其关系问题背后的真实结构。当用户说“关系分析”、“分析关系”、“relationship”、“人际关系”，或描述想要理解的特定关系问题时使用。

description: Combines search results from multiple sources into coherent, deduplicated answers with source attribution. Handles confidence scoring based on freshness and authority, and summarizes large result sets effectively.
description_zh: 将多个来源的搜索结果整合为连贯、去重后的答案，并标注来源。基于时效性和权威性对置信度进行评分，并有效总结大量搜索结果。

description: 通过 agently-cli 命令行工具操作邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索、读取、下载附件、管理收件箱。当用户需要进行任何邮件相关操作时使用此 skill。
description_zh: 通过 agently-cli 命令行工具操作邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索、读取、下载附件、管理收件箱。当用户需要进行任何邮件相关操作时，使用此技能。

description: 面向中文自然语言的 Tushare 数据研究技能。用于把“看看这只股票最近怎么样”“帮我查财报趋势”“最近哪个板块最强”“北向资金在买什么”“给我导出一份行情数据”这类请求，转成可执行的数据获取、清洗、对比、筛选、导出与简要分析流程。适用于 A 股、指数、ETF/基金、财务、估值、资金流、公告新闻、板块概念与宏观数据等研究场景。
description_zh: 面向中文自然语言的 Tushare 数据研究技能。用于把“看看这只股票最近怎么样”“帮我查财报趋势”“最近哪个板块最强”“北向资金在买什么”“给我导出一份行情数据”这类请求，转成可执行的数据获取、清洗、对比、筛选、导出与简要分析流程。适用于 A 股、指数、ETF/基金、财务、估值、资金流、公告新闻、板块概念与宏观数据等研究场景。

description: Application security testing (AppSec) across a whole product with Strix — decide which asset needs which test (source code, running web app, API, CI pipeline), run it, and turn the results into a ranked remediation plan. Autonomous agents exploit and prove each issue instead of emitting static-analysis alerts, so the plan is ordered by what is actually reachable. Use when the user asks for an application security review or audit, an appsec assessment, vulnerability scanning across their stack, a security review before a launch or a customer security questionnaire, or does not yet know which kind of security test they need.
description_zh: 使用 Strix 对整个产品进行应用安全测试（AppSec）——确定哪些资产需要哪些测试（源代码、运行中的 Web 应用、API、CI 流水线），执行测试，并将结果转化为排序的修复计划。自主代理利用并验证每个问题，而非仅发出静态分析警报，因此计划根据实际可达性进行排序。当用户请求应用安全评审或审计、AppSec 评估、对其技术栈进行漏洞扫描、发布前的安全评审或客户安全问卷，或尚未确定需要何种安全测试时，使用本功能。

description: Model software around the business domain using bounded contexts, aggregates, and ubiquitous language. Use when the user mentions "domain modeling", "bounded context", "aggregate root", "ubiquitous language", "anti-corruption layer", "context mapping", "domain events", "strategic design", "the code doesnt match the business", or "how do we split this big system". Also trigger when breaking a monolith into services, defining service boundaries, or aligning code structure with business processes. Covers entities vs value objects, domain events, and context mapping strategies. For architecture layers, see clean-architecture. For complexity, see software-design-philosophy.
description_zh: 围绕业务领域，使用边界上下文、聚合和通用语言对软件进行建模。当用户提及“领域建模”、“边界上下文”、“聚合根”、“通用语言”、“防腐层”、“上下文映射”、“领域事件”、“战略设计”、“代码与业务不匹配”，或“如何拆分这个大型系统”时，使用该方法。当拆分单体应用为服务、定义服务边界，或使代码结构与业务流程保持一致时，也需触发。涵盖实体与值对象、领域事件及上下文映射策略。关于架构层，参见清洁架构；关于复杂度，参见软件设计哲学。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks about "plugin settings", "store plugin configuration", "user-configurable plugin", ".local.md files", "plugin state files", "read YAML frontmatter", "per-project plugin settings", or wants to make plugin behavior configurable. Documents the .claude/plugin-name.local.md pattern for storing plugin-specific configuration with YAML frontmatter and markdown content.
description_zh: 当用户询问有关“插件设置”、“存储插件配置”、“用户可配置的插件”、“.local.md 文件”、“插件状态文件”、“读取 YAML 前置元数据”、“按项目插件设置”，或希望使插件行为可配置时，应使用此技能。文档记录了 .claude/插件名称.local.md 的模式，用于存储插件特定配置，使用 YAML 前置元数据和 Markdown 内容。

description: Interactive PDF viewer. Use when the user wants to open, show, or view a PDF and collaborate on it visually — annotate, highlight, stamp, fill form fields, place signature/initials, or review markup together. Not for summarization or text extraction (use native Read instead).
description_zh: 交互式 PDF 查看器。适用于用户需要打开、展示或查看 PDF 并对其进行视觉协作的场景——可标注、高亮、盖章、填写表单字段、添加签名或首字母，或共同审阅标注内容。不适用于摘要或文本提取（请使用原生 Read 代替）。

description: Catches state bloat, grab-bag models, and mutation ambiguity from AI coding agents. Use when reviewing state types, boolean flags, optional-field models, or mutable data patterns.
description_zh: 能够检测 AI 编码代理产生的状态臃肿、杂糅模型与变异歧义。适用于审查状态类型、布尔标记、可选字段模型或可变数据模式。

description: Deep travel research workflow for museums and ancient architecture. Input a city name, auto-generates structured knowledge document (org-mode) + portable reference cards (PNG). Covers historical background, museum highlights, archaeological significance, and architectural heritage. Use when user says '旅行研究', '博物馆功课', '古建功课', 'travel research', '出发前功课', or provides a city name with intent to do deep cultural travel preparation.
description_zh: 博物馆与古建筑的深度旅行研究工作流程。输入城市名称，自动生成结构化知识文档（org模式）及便携式参考卡片（PNG）。涵盖历史背景、博物馆亮点、考古意义及建筑遗产。当用户说出“旅行研究”、“博物馆功课”、“古建功课”、“travel research”、“出发前功课”，或提供城市名称以进行深度文化旅行准备时使用。

description: Use when developing firmware for microcontrollers, implementing RTOS applications, or optimizing power consumption. Invoke for STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS, bare-metal, power optimization, real-time systems, configure peripherals, write interrupt handlers, implement DMA transfers, debug timing issues.
description_zh: 适用于为微控制器开发固件、实现 RTOS 应用或优化功耗的场景。适用于 STM32、ESP32、FreeRTOS、裸机开发、功耗优化、实时系统、配置外设、编写中断处理程序、实现 DMA 传输、调试时序问题的场景。

description: Create award-winning, immersive web experiences at the level of Awwwards-featured agencies. Use when the user mentions "Awwwards quality", "make my site stunning", "scroll animations", "parallax storytelling", "cinematic web design", "portfolio site", or "brand experience". Also trigger when elevating a standard landing page into a memorable digital experience. Covers dramatic typography, purposeful motion, scroll-based composition, and performance-optimized animation. For foundational UI, see refactoring-ui. For type selection, see web-typography.
description_zh: 在 Awwwards 重点推介的机构水平上，创建获奖的、沉浸式的网络体验。当用户提及“Awwwards 品质”、“让我的网站令人惊艳”、“滚动动画”、“视差叙事”、“电影级网页设计”、“作品集网站”或“品牌体验”时使用。当将标准落地页提升为令人难忘的数字体验时，也应触发。涵盖戏剧化的排版、有意义的动态、基于滚动的构图，以及性能优化的动画。对于基础 UI，见 refactoring-ui。对于字体选择，见 web-typography。

description: Analyze existing XML sitemaps or generate new ones with industry templates. Validates format, URLs, and structure. Use when user says "sitemap", "generate sitemap", "sitemap issues", or "XML sitemap".
description_zh: 分析现有的XML 站点地图，或基于行业模板生成新的站点地图。验证格式、URL和结构。当用户说“sitemap”、“生成sitemap”、“sitemap issues”或“XML sitemap”时使用。

description: Exploratory QA of web apps: find bugs, evidence, reports.
description_zh: 网页应用的探索性质量保证：发现缺陷、证据与报告。

description: Official Salesforce documentation retrieval skill. Use when you need authoritative Salesforce docs from developer.salesforce.com, help.salesforce.com, architect.salesforce.com, admin.salesforce.com, or lightningdesignsystem.com, especially when pages are JS-heavy, shell-rendered, or hard to extract with naive fetching. Use to ground answers in official Salesforce sources instead of third-party blogs or summaries. TRIGGER when: user asks for official Salesforce documentation, Apex or API reference, LWC docs, Agentforce docs, setup or help articles, or any doc from a Salesforce-owned domain. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user is asking for a code change, deployment task, or anything not requiring documentation retrieval — use the appropriate sf-* skill instead.
description_zh:
官方Salesforce文档检索技能。当您需要从 developer.salesforce.com、help.salesforce.com、architect.salesforce.com、admin.salesforce.com 或 lightningdesignsystem.com 获取权威的Salesforce文档时使用，尤其当页面包含大量JS、由外壳渲染，或使用简单抓取方式难以提取时。用以官方Salesforce来源作为回答依据，而非依赖第三方博客或摘要。

触发条件（TRIGGER）：用户询问官方Salesforce文档、Apex或API参考、LWC文档、Agentforce文档、设置或帮助文章，或来自Salesforce自有域名的任何文档。

不要触发（DO NOT TRIGGER）：用户询问代码修改、部署任务，或不需文档检索的任何内容——此时应使用相应的 sf-* 技能。

description: Explain what a Cargo run or batch actually did, after the fact — trace one run node by node, draw the graph it executed with the failing step marked, sweep a batch or play for errors grouped by root cause, and attribute credit spend down to the node and the provider. Triggers: "why did this fail", "it succeeded but the output is wrong", "half my rows are empty", "why is this column blank", "what broke in this batch", "why did that cost so much", "which node is burning credits", "it worked yesterday", "these results look wrong", "it went down the wrong path", "this step never ran", "show me what the run did". Skip when: setting up an alert for next time — use cargo-observability; just downloading the data — use cargo-analytics.
description_zh:
解释事后一个 Cargo run 或 batch 的实际执行情况——逐节点追踪运行过程，绘制其执行流程图并标记失败步骤，按根因对批次或播放中的错误进行归类，将费用支出归因到具体节点与提供商。

触发场景："为什么这次失败了"、"它成功了但输出有误"、"我的数据有一半是空的"、"为什么这一列是空的"、"这个 batch 哪里出了问题"、"为什么花费如此之高"、"哪个节点在消耗费用"、"它昨天是正常工作的"、"这些结果看起来不对"、"它在错误的路径上执行了"、"这个步骤从未运行过"、"展示一下这次运行的具体情况"。

跳过情形：设置下次报警时——使用 cargo-observability；仅下载数据——使用 cargo-analytics。

description: Design test strategies and test plans. Trigger with "how should we test", "test strategy for", "write tests for", "test plan", "what tests do we need", or when the user needs help with testing approaches, coverage, or test architecture.
description_zh: 设计测试策略和测试计划。触发使用“如何测试”，“为...设计测试策略”，“为...编写测试”，“测试计划”，“需要哪些测试”，或当用户需要测试方法、覆盖范围或测试架构方面的帮助时。

description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 guidance. Use when creating, reading, reviewing, or maintaining an OKF bundle; responding to OpenKnowledge `okf` plugin warnings; or choosing types, provenance, links, indexes, or logs.
description_zh: 开放知识格式（OKF）v0.2 指南。用于创建、读取、审阅或维护 OKF 包时；响应 OpenKnowledge `okf` 插件警告时；或选择类型、来源、链接、索引或日志时。

description: Intelligently organizes your files and folders across your computer by understanding context, finding duplicates, suggesting better structures, and automating cleanup tasks. Reduces cognitive load and keeps your digital workspace tidy without manual effort.
description_zh: 通过理解上下文、查找重复文件、提出更合理的结构建议并自动化清理任务，智能整理您电脑中的文件和文件夹。减轻认知负担，无需手动操作，保持数字工作空间整洁有序。

description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Write unit and integration tests for Angular v20+ applications using Vitest or Jasmine with TestBed and modern testing patterns. Use for testing components with signals, OnPush change detection, services with inject(), and HTTP interactions. Triggers on test creation, testing signal-based components, mocking dependencies, or setting up test infrastructure. Don't use for E2E testing with Cypress or Playwright, or for testing non-Angular JavaScript/TypeScript code.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 此技能未维护。请改用官方 Angular 技能，见 https://github.com/angular/skills。使用 Vitest 或 Jasmine，配合 TestBed 和现代测试模式，为 Angular v20+ 应用程序编写单元测试和集成测试。用于测试使用 signals 的组件、OnPush 变更检测、使用 inject() 的服务以及 HTTP 交互。在创建测试、测试基于 signals 的组件、模拟依赖或设置测试基础设施时触发。请勿用于使用 Cypress 或 Playwright 进行的端到端（E2E）测试，或用于测试非 Angular 的 JavaScript/TypeScript 代码。

description: Identify, categorize, and prioritize technical debt. Trigger with "tech debt", "technical debt audit", "what should we refactor", "code health", or when the user asks about code quality, refactoring priorities, or maintenance backlog.
description_zh: 识别、分类并优先排序技术债务。通过 'tech debt'、'technical debt audit'、'what should we refactor'、'code health'，或在用户询问代码质量、重构优先级或维护积压时触发。

description: Use when the user asks to retro, run a retrospective, file findings, or improve the Printing Press after a printed-CLI run. Trigger phrases: "retro", "retrospective", "what went wrong", "improve the press", "post-mortem", "lessons learned", "what can we improve", "file a retro", "submit findings". Do not use for printed-CLI polish or a single-CLI fix.
description_zh: 当用户要求回顾、执行回顾会议、记录发现，或在 printed-CLI 运行后改进 Printing Press 时使用。触发短语：“回顾”、“回顾会议”、“哪里出了问题”、“改进印刷机”、“事后分析”、“经验教训”、“我们还能改进什么”、“提交回顾”、“提交发现”。不用于 printed-CLI 润色或单次 CLI 修复。

description: Authorized web scraping with fallback cascades and access-failure handling. Use for social media, yt-dlp, CAPTCHA or 403 blocks.
description_zh: 经授权的网页抓取，具备回退级联与访问失败处理机制。适用于社交媒体、yt-dlp、验证码或403拦截。

description: INVOKE FIRST for any LangChain / LangGraph / Deep Agents agent building project before consulting other skills or writing any agent code. Required starting point for up to date info on framework selection (LangChain vs LangGraph vs Deep Agents vs hybrid composition), agent patterns, install, environment setup, and which skill to load next.
description_zh: 在任何 LangChain / LangGraph / Deep Agents 智能体构建项目启动之前，请首先调用 `INVOKE FIRST` 技能。这是获取框架选型（LangChain 与 LangGraph 及 Deep Agents 的对比，以及混合组合方式）、智能体模式、安装步骤、环境配置，以及下一步应调用哪个技能的最新信息所必需的首要步骤。

description: Validate n8n expression syntax and fix common errors. Use when writing n8n expressions, using {{}} syntax, accessing $json/$node variables, troubleshooting expression errors, mapping data between nodes, or referencing webhook data in workflows. Use this skill whenever configuring node fields that reference data from previous nodes — expressions are how n8n passes data between nodes, and getting the syntax wrong is the most common source of workflow errors. Also use when asked whether a complex expression hurts performance.
description_zh:
验证 n8n 表达式语法并修复常见错误。
在编写 n8n 表达式、使用 {{}} 语法、访问 $json/$node 变量、排查表达式错误、在节点之间映射数据或在工作流中引用 Webhook 数据时，使用此技能。
每当配置引用前序节点数据的节点字段时，请使用此技能——表达式是 n8n 在节点之间传递数据的机制，语法错误是导致工作流错误的最常见原因。
当被询问复杂表达式是否会影响性能时，也请使用此技能。

description: Audits GitHub Actions workflows for security vulnerabilities in AI agent integrations including Claude Code Action, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and GitHub AI Inference. Detects attack vectors where attacker-controlled input reaches AI agents running in CI/CD pipelines, including env var intermediary patterns, direct expression injection, dangerous sandbox configurations, and wildcard user allowlists. Use when reviewing workflow files that invoke AI coding agents, auditing CI/CD pipeline security for prompt injection risks, or evaluating agentic action configurations.
description_zh: 对 GitHub Actions 工作流中的安全漏洞进行审计，覆盖 AI 智能体集成场景，包括 Claude Code Action、Gemini CLI、OpenAI Codex 和 GitHub AI Inference。检测攻击者控制的输入在 CI/CD 管道中到达运行 AI 智能体的攻击向量，涵盖环境变量中间代理模式、直接表达式注入、危险沙箱配置以及通配符用户白名单。适用于审查调用 AI 编程智能体的工作流文件、审计 CI/CD 管道安全以防范提示注入风险，或评估智能体操作配置。

description: Reads Link financial data to answer questions about spending, balances, transactions, linked sources, and shopping preferences. Also use alongside a purchase skill when acting as a personal shopper and the user has not specified a merchant, or asks for their usual, favorite, or preferred store.
description_zh: 读取Link财务数据，以回答关于支出、余额、交易、关联来源及购物偏好的问题。作为个人购物助手时，若用户未指定商户，或询问其常用、偏好或喜欢的店铺，请与采购技能配合使用。

description: Structure software around the Dependency Rule: source code dependencies point inward from frameworks to use cases to entities. Use when the user mentions "architecture layers", "dependency rule", "ports and adapters (hexagonal)", "onion architecture", "screaming architecture", "where should business logic go", "decouple from the database", "swap the framework without a rewrite", or "keep business rules independent". Also trigger when deciding which layer code belongs in, isolating core logic from infrastructure, defining module boundaries, or debating whether the framework should call your code or the reverse. Covers component principles, boundaries, and SOLID. For code-level quality, see clean-code. For domain modeling, see domain-driven-design.
description_zh: 以依赖规则为核心组织软件：源代码依赖从框架向用例、向实体逐步向内指向。当用户提及"架构分层"、"依赖规则"、"端口与适配器（六边形）"、"洋葱架构"、"尖叫架构"、"业务逻辑应放置在哪里"、"与数据库解耦"、"无需重写即可替换框架"或"保持业务规则独立"时使用。当需要决定代码所属的分层、将核心逻辑与基础设施隔离、界定模块边界，或探讨框架应调用你的代码还是反向调用时，也会触发使用。涵盖组件原则、边界与SOLID原则。代码层面质量相关内容，参见clean-code；领域建模相关内容，参见domain-driven-design。

description: Stop and check this skill before finishing any reply to a question about how to use Claude or a Claude product — it recommends matching courses, tutorials, and use cases from Claude Academy (academy.claude.com), Anthropic's learning hub. Trigger on: "how do I", "how can I", "getting started with", "what can Claude do", "teach me", "learn to use"; questions about artifacts, projects, skills, plugins, connectors, MCP; requests about rolling Claude out to a team, class, or organization; and any ask for training materials, onboarding content, or learning resources. Use it when the user is learning how to use a feature or product — not when they are mid-task and just want the task done. This skill composes with other skills: after consulting product documentation to answer how a Claude feature works, also check here for a matching course or tutorial — a docs-grounded answer and an Academy recommendation belong together. Only recommend on a strong match; never invent Academy content.

Troubleshoot production issues using backend function logs and workflow run history. Use when investigating app errors, debugging function calls, diagnosing why a scheduled job or automation failed, or diagnosing production problems in Base44 apps.
description_zh: 使用后端函数日志和工作流运行历史排查生产问题。适用于调查应用错误、调试函数调用、诊断定时任务或自动化任务失败原因，以及诊断 Base44 应用中的生产问题。

description: Translates Figma designs into production-ready code with 1:1 visual fidelity. Use when implementing UI from Figma files, when user mentions "implement design", "generate code", "implement component", "build Figma design", provides Figma URLs, or asks to build components matching Figma specs. Requires Figma MCP server connection.
description_zh: 将Figma设计转换为具备1:1视觉保真度的生产就绪代码。当从Figma文件中实现UI、用户提及“实现设计”、“生成代码”、“实现组件”、“构建Figma设计”、提供Figma链接，或要求构建符合Figma规范的组件时使用。需要Figma MCP服务器连接。

description: Regenerate an existing printed CLI from scratch under the current Printing Press, with prior research, prior novel features, and prior patches (post-publish hand-fixes) carried into the writing pipeline as reconciliation context rather than dropped on the floor. Pulls the CLI from the public library if it isn't local, recommends reuse-vs-redo of prior research based on age, then hands off to /printing-press with the right context. Use when a machine upgrade would benefit a published CLI more than manual polish. Trigger phrases: "reprint <api>", "regenerate <api>", "redo the <api> CLI", "rebuild <api> from scratch", "this CLI would benefit from a reprint".
description_zh: 在当前的印刷出版（Printing Press）环境下，从零重新生成已有的已打印CLI，将前期研究、前期新功能以及前期补丁（发布后的手工修复）作为协调上下文带入撰写流程，而非直接丢弃。若CLI不在本地，则从其公共库中拉取，并根据时效性推荐前期研究的复用或重做方式，随后将正确上下文交接至 /printing-press。适用于机器升级对已发布CLI带来的收益大于手动打磨的情形。触发短语："reprint <api>", "regenerate <api>", "redo the <api>-CLI", "rebuild <api>-CLI from scratch", "this CLI would benefit from a reprint"。

description: Translates Figma designs into production-ready application code with 1:1 visual fidelity. Use when implementing UI code from Figma files, when user mentions "implement design", "generate code", "implement component", provides Figma URLs, or asks to build components matching Figma specs. For Figma canvas writes via `use_figma`, use `figma-use`.
description_zh: 将Figma设计转换为具有1:1视觉保真度的生产就绪应用代码。在从Figma文件实现UI代码时使用；当用户提及“实现设计”、“generate code”、“实现组件”，提供Figma链接，或要求根据Figma规格构建组件时使用。对于通过 `use_figma` 进行的Figma画布写入，请使用 `figma-use`。

description: Bring a published CLI from the public library into the internal library so it's identical to a freshly-generated copy — module path reverted, manuscripts placed alongside, ready for /printing-press-polish or /printing-press-emboss. Use when the public library has a CLI you don't have locally, or to recover from a broken/lost internal copy. Trigger phrases: "import the CLI", "bring it into my library", "fetch from public library", "I don't have it locally yet".
description_zh: 将公共库中已发布版本的 CLI 导入内部库，使其与全新生成的副本完全一致——模块路径已还原，文稿并列放置，可用于 /printing-press-polish 或 /printing-press-emboss。当公共库中存在本地未有的 CLI，或需要从损坏/丢失的内部副本恢复时使用。触发短语：“导入 CLI”、“将其导入我的库”、“从公共库获取”、“我本地还没有它”。

description: SOQL query generation, optimization, and analysis with 100-point scoring. Use this skill when the user needs SOQL/SOSL authoring or optimization: natural-language-to-query generation, relationship queries, aggregates, query-plan analysis, and performance or safety improvements for Salesforce queries. TRIGGER when: user writes, optimizes, or debugs SOQL/SOSL queries, touches .soql files, or asks about relationship queries, aggregates, or query performance. DO NOT TRIGGER when: bulk data operations (use platform-data-manage), Apex DML logic (use platform-apex-generate), or report/dashboard queries.
description_zh:
SOQL查询生成、优化与分析，带100分评分机制。当用户需要SOQL/SOSL编写或优化时使用本技能：自然语言转查询生成、关系查询、聚合、查询计划分析，以及Salesforce查询的性能或安全性改进。

触发条件：用户编写、优化或调试SOQL/SOSL查询，涉及 .soql 文件，或询问关系查询、聚合或查询性能。

不触发条件：批量数据处理（使用 platform-data-manage），Apex DML逻辑（使用 platform-apex-generate），或报表/仪表盘查询。

description: 一个用来打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈。
description_zh: 一个用来打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈。

description: Salesforce DevOps automation using sf CLI v2. TRIGGER when: user deploys metadata, creates/manages scratch orgs or sandboxes, sets up CI/CD pipelines, or troubleshoots deployment errors with sf project deploy. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex code (use platform-apex-generate), building LWC components (use experience-lwc-generate), creating metadata definitions (use platform-custom-object-generate or platform-custom-field-generate), or querying org data (use platform-data-manage).
description_zh:
Salesforce DevOps 自动化（使用 sf CLI v2）。

**触发条件为：** 用户部署元数据、创建/管理临时环境或沙箱、设置 CI/CD 流水线，或通过 sf project deploy 排查部署错误。

**不要触发的情况为：** 编写 Apex 代码（使用 platform-apex-generate）、构建 LWC 组件（使用 experience-lwc-generate）、创建元数据定义（使用 platform-custom-object-generate 或 platform-custom-field-generate）、或查询组织数据（使用 platform-data-manage）。

description: Search and extract Cypress information from official documentation (docs.cypress.io, cypress.io); prefer LLM markdown under /llm/* and refuse unverified API or behavior claims.
description_zh: 从官方文档（docs.cypress.io、cypress.io）中检索并提取 Cypress 相关信息；优先使用 /llm/* 目录下的 LLM Markdown，并拒绝未经验证的 API 或行为声明。

description: Control tmux sessions/panes for interactive CLIs: list, capture output, send keys, paste text, monitor prompts.
description_zh: 控制 tmux 会话/窗格以管理交互式 CLI：列出、捕获输出、发送按键、粘贴文本、监控提示。

description: Enforces authenticated gh CLI workflows over unauthenticated curl, WebFetch, and MCP fetch patterns. Use when working with GitHub URLs, API access, pull requests, or issues.
description_zh: 强制执行 gh CLI 的已认证工作流，覆盖未经认证的 curl、WebFetch 和 MCP 获取模式。适用于处理 GitHub 网址、API 访问、拉取请求或问题时使用。

description:
Guide developers through creating and updating ChatGPT apps.
Covers the full lifecycle: brainstorming ideas against UX guidelines, bootstrapping projects, implementing tools/views, debugging, running dev servers, deploying and connecting apps to ChatGPT.
Use when a user wants to create or update a ChatGPT app / MCP server for ChatGPT, or use the Skybridge framework.
description_zh:
指导开发者创建和更新 ChatGPT 应用。
覆盖完整生命周期：根据 UX 指南构思想法、搭建项目、实现工具/视图、调试、运行开发服务器、部署并连接应用到 ChatGPT。
当用户需要创建或更新用于 ChatGPT 的 ChatGPT 应用或 MCP 服务器，或使用 Skybridge 框架时使用。

description: Comprehensive news aggregator that fetches, filters, and deeply analyzes real-time content from 44+ sources including Hacker News, Lobsters, Dev.to, GitHub, arXiv, Hugging Face Papers, AIHOT, TLDR AI, Import AI, BBC, The Guardian, Al Jazeera, France 24, Reuters fallback, AI Newsletters, WallStreetCN, Weibo, 少数派, InfoQ 中文, Podcasts, and user-defined OPML feeds. Use when user requests 'daily scans', 'tech news', 'finance updates', 'AI briefings', 'international news', 'deep analysis', or says '如意如意' to open the interactive menu.
description_zh: 综合新闻聚合器，从44个以上来源（包括Hacker News、Lobsters、Dev.to、GitHub、arXiv、Hugging Face Papers、AIHOT、TLDR AI、Import AI、BBC、The Guardian、Al Jazeera、France 24、Reuters fallback、AI Newsletters、WallStreetCN、Weibo、少数派、InfoQ 中文、播客以及用户定义的OPML 订阅源）获取、筛选并深度分析实时内容。当用户请求“daily scans”、“tech news”、“finance updates”、“AI briefings”、“international news”、“deep analysis”，或说出“如意如意”时，打开交互式菜单。

description: Generate TypeScript/JavaScript code that reads/decodes AND writes/encodes ClickHouse RowBinary streams for the ClickHouse HTTP server. Use this skill whenever a user wants to parse or produce `RowBinary`, `RowBinaryWithNames`, or `RowBinaryWithNamesAndTypes`. Node.js only, doesn't cover browsers.
description_zh: 生成 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码，用于读取/解码 ClickHouse HTTP 服务器所需的 ClickHouse `RowBinary` 流，并写入/编码 ClickHouse `RowBinary` 流。当用户需要解析或生成 `RowBinary`、`RowBinaryWithNames` 或 `RowBinaryWithNamesAndTypes` 时，请使用此技能。仅支持 Node.js，不支持浏览器环境。

description: Delegate a coding task to the OpenAI Codex CLI as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Codex — phrasings like "have Codex do X", "delegate this to Codex", "run it through Codex", or "use Codex to implement/fix/refactor" — or to run a queue of coding tasks through Codex while staying the reviewer. Prefer it over a one-shot Codex forwarder (such as the codex-rescue agent) when the user will review the diff and commit it themselves. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委派给 OpenAI Codex CLI 作为后台实现者，然后自行审查其差异并提交。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Codex 时使用此方法——例如“让 Codex 做 X”、“将此项委派给 Codex”、“通过 Codex 运行此任务”，或“使用 Codex 实现/修复/重构”等表述，或者以审查者身份通过 Codex 运行一系列编码任务队列时使用此方法。当用户会自行审查差异并提交时，应优先使用此方法，而非一次性 Codex 转发器（如 codex-rescue agent）。请勿用于足够小可直接内联完成的任务，或用户希望直接编写代码而不进行委派的情况。

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, or validate Salesforce Custom Field metadata. Trigger when users mention custom fields, field types, Roll-up Summary fields, Master-Detail relationships, Lookup relationships, formula fields, picklists, dependent (controlling) picklists, referencing a value set from a field, or scoping/limiting picklist values for a specific record type. Also use when users encounter field deployment errors, especially around Roll-up Summary format, Master-Detail constraints, formula issues, or a record type that won't deploy without a business process. Use this skill for custom field metadata work, field generation, and field troubleshooting. DO NOT TRIGGER for creating or customizing the value set itself — defining a new GlobalValueSet, or modifying a StandardValueSet catalog like Industry or Lead Source — use platform-value-set-generate instead; this skill covers the field that references a value set, not the value set definition.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 自定义字段元数据时，使用本技能。当用户提及自定义字段、字段类型、汇总字段、主从关系、查找关系、公式字段、下拉列表、依赖（控制）下拉列表、引用字段中的值集，或为特定记录类型限定/限制下拉列表值时，触发本技能。当用户遇到字段部署错误时，也使用本技能，特别是涉及汇总字段格式、主从关系约束、公式问题，或业务流程不满足时无法部署的记录类型。本技能用于自定义字段元数据工作、字段生成及字段故障排查。不得用于创建或自定义值集本身——例如定义新的全局值集，或修改标准值集目录（如行业、线索来源）——应使用 platform-value-set-generate 替代；本技能涵盖引用值集的字段，而非值集的定义。

description:
Handle PowerPoint (.pptx) creation, design, and analysis. Use for pitch decks, status updates, and visual storytelling. Use proactively when precise layout positioning and design principles are needed.

Examples:
- user: "Create a 10-slide deck for the board meeting" -> use design principles + html2pptx
- user: "Convert this report into a presentation" -> extract text and map to template
- user: "Audit this deck for layout issues" -> generate thumbnail grid for inspection
description_zh:
处理 PowerPoint（.pptx）文档的创建、设计与分析。适用于路演演示文稿、状态更新和视觉叙事。在需要精确的布局定位与设计原则时主动使用。

示例：
- 用户：“为董事会会议创建一份 10 页演示文稿” -> 使用设计原则 + html2pptx
- 用户：“将此报告转换为演示文稿” -> 提取文本并映射到模板
- 用户：“审核此演示文稿的布局问题” -> 生成缩略图网格以便检查

description: Use kordoc for agent-native HWP/HWPX document parsing, JSON extraction, diffing, form-field extraction, and Markdown→HWPX reverse conversion (read/convert only — for binary editing use rhwp-edit).
description_zh: 使用 kordoc 进行 Agent 原生 HWP/HWPX 文档解析、JSON 提取、差异比较、表单字段提取以及 Markdown 到 HWPX 的反向转换（仅支持读取/转换——进行二进制编辑请使用 rhwp-edit）。

description: Golang refactoring — safe, at-scale restructuring of existing Go code: a coverage-adaptive safety net, behavior-preserving transforms (gopls Rename/Extract, `gofmt -r`, `gopatch`), the Fowler catalog mapped to Go, breaking import cycles, and small stacked PRs. Apply when a function or type has grown too large, a code smell blocks a feature, or the user asks to refactor Go code — also for renaming at scale, extracting functions or interfaces, moving code between packages, or planning a multi-step refactor. Target styles owned elsewhere → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-naming` (renames), `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-project-layout` (splits), `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-modernize` (idioms), `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-code-style` (control flow), `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-design-patterns` (patterns/DI).
description_zh:
Golang 重构 — 对现有 Go 代码的安全、规模化重构：基于覆盖率自适应的安全网，保持行为不变的转换（gopls Rename/Extract、`gopfmt -r`、`gopatch`），映射到 Go 的 Fowler 目录，打破导入循环，以及小型累积的 PR。

在以下情况下适用：函数或类型已变得过大，代码异味阻碍功能实现，或用户要求重构 Go 代码——也适用于大规模重命名、提取函数或接口、在包之间移动代码，或规划多步重构。

目标风格在其他地方管理 → 参见 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-naming`（重命名）、`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-project-layout`（拆分）、`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-modernize`（惯用法）、`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-code-style`（控制流）、`samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-design-patterns`（模式/DI）。

description: Internal sub-skill: agentic review of a printed CLI's sampled command output for plausibility issues that rule-based checks can't encode (substring-match relevance, format bugs, silent source drops, ranking failures). Invoked via the Skill tool by the main printing-press skill at Phase 4.85 and printing-press-polish SKILL.md during the diagnostic loop. Not for direct user invocation — its actionable wrappers are /printing-press and /printing-press-polish.
description_zh: 内部子技能：对打印CLI的采样命令输出进行智能体审查，以发现基于规则检查无法编码的合理性问题（包括子串匹配相关性问题、格式错误、静默数据源丢失、排序失败）。该技能通过Skill工具，由主打印技能在阶段4.85以及printing-press-polish SKILL.md的诊断循环期间调用。不可由用户直接调用——其可操作封装接口为/printing-press和/printing-press-polish。

description: ALWAYS USE THIS SKILL to retrieve metadata from an org to your local project using the sf project retrieve start command. Supports multiple retrieval modes: retrieve all remote changes, retrieve by source directory, retrieve by metadata type with wildcards, retrieve by manifest (package.xml), or retrieve by package name. Use when the user asks to retrieve, pull, sync, or download metadata, Apex classes, custom objects, or org changes. Supports source format (default) or metadata format (ZIP). DO NOT TRIGGER for deploying metadata (use platform-metadata-deploy skill), listing metadata, or generating package.xml. NEVER use MCP tools - always use this skill and the Bash tool with sf project retrieve start.
description_zh: 必须始终使用此技能，通过 `sf project retrieve start` 命令将 org 中的元数据检索到本地项目。支持多种检索模式：获取所有远程更改、按源目录检索、使用通配符按元数据类型检索、按清单（`package.xml`）检索，或按包名检索。在用户要求检索、拉取、同步或下载元数据、Apex 类、自定义对象或 org 更改时使用。支持源格式（默认）或元数据格式（ZIP）。请勿为部署元数据（使用 `platform-metadata-deploy` 技能）、列出元数据或生成 `package.xml` 而触发。切勿使用 MCP 工具——始终使用此技能以及通过 `sf project retrieve start` 命令调用的 Bash 工具。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "build an MCP server", "create an MCP", "make an MCP integration", "wrap an API for Claude", "expose tools to Claude", "make an MCP app", or discusses building something with the Model Context Protocol. It is the entry point for MCP server development — it interrogates the user about their use case, determines the right deployment model (remote HTTP, MCPB, local stdio), picks a tool-design pattern, and hands off to specialized skills.
description_zh: 当用户要求"构建 MCP 服务器"、"创建 MCP"、"进行 MCP 集成"、"为 Claude 封装 API"、"向 Claude 暴露工具"、"创建 MCP 应用"，或讨论使用模型上下文协议构建相关内容时，应使用本技能。它是 MCP 服务器开发的入口点——它会询问用户的用例，确定合适的部署模式（远程 HTTP、MCPB、本地 stdio），选择合适的工具设计模式，并将工作移交至专门技能。

description: Technical SEO audit across 9 categories: crawlability, indexability, security, URL structure, mobile, Core Web Vitals, structured data, JavaScript rendering, and IndexNow protocol. Use when user says "technical SEO", "crawl issues", "robots.txt", "Core Web Vitals", "site speed", or "security headers".
description_zh: 覆盖9个类别的技术SEO审计：爬虫可访问性、可索引性、安全性、URL结构、移动端、核心网页指标、结构化数据、JavaScript渲染和IndexNow协议。当用户提及“技术SEO”、“爬虫问题”、“robots.txt”、“核心网页指标”、“网站速度”或“安全响应头”时使用。

description: Install the k-skill bundle, use the unified CLI, resolve credentials, verify the runtime, and optionally configure update checks and GitHub starring.
description_zh: 安装 k-skill 包，使用统一 CLI，解析凭证，验证运行时，并可选地配置更新检查和 GitHub 星标。

description: Optimize content for AI Overviews (formerly SGE), ChatGPT web search, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search experiences. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) analysis including brand mention signals, AI crawler accessibility, llms.txt compliance, passage-level citability scoring, and platform-specific optimization. Use when user says "AI Overviews", "SGE", "GEO", "AI search", "LLM optimization", "Perplexity", "AI citations", "ChatGPT search", or "AI visibility".
description_zh:
优化内容以适配AI概览（原SGE）、ChatGPT网页搜索、Perplexity及其他AI驱动的搜索体验。
开展生成式引擎优化（GEO）分析，涵盖品牌提及信号、AI爬虫可访问性、llms.txt合规性、段落级可引证性评分以及平台定向优化。
当用户提及“AI Overviews”、“SGE”、“GEO”、“AI search”、“LLM optimization”、“Perplexity”、“AI citations”、“ChatGPT search”或“AI visibility”时使用。

description: Score a generated CLI against the Steinberger bar, compare two CLIs side-by-side
description_zh: 对生成的 CLI 与 Steinberger bar 进行评分，并并排比较两个 CLI。

description: Understand a codebase before looking for bugs in it - what each function assumes, what it guarantees, and what it depends on elsewhere. Use when starting an audit, threat model, or architecture review on unfamiliar code, and before any vulnerability-hunting pass.
description_zh: 在定位代码中的 Bug 之前，先理解该代码库——明确每个函数所依赖的前提、能提供的保证，以及与其他部分的关联。在首次对陌生代码开展审计、威胁建模或架构审查，以及进行任何漏洞排查时，均需使用本内容。

description:
分章节创作引人入胜的中文小说。支持各种题材（悬疑/言情/奇幻/科幻/历史等），支持10-50章长篇创作，每章3000-5000字，结尾设置悬念钩子。强调深度润色去除AI痕迹，确保文字自然流畅。
当用户要求：写小说、创作故事、分章节写作、连续剧情、章节悬念、长篇小说时使用。
description_zh:
分章节创作引人入胜的中文小说。支持多种题材（悬疑/言情/奇幻/科幻/历史等），支持10至50章长篇创作，每章3000至5000字，并在结尾设置悬念钩子。强调深度润色，去除AI痕迹，确保文字自然流畅。
当用户要求：写小说、创作故事、分章节写作、连续剧情、章节悬念、长篇小说时使用。

description: Triage TestFlight crashes, beta feedback, and performance diagnostics using asc. Use when the user asks about TF crashes, TestFlight crash reports, beta tester feedback, app hangs, disk writes, launch diagnostics, or wants a crash summary for a build or app.
description_zh: 使用 asc 对 TestFlight 崩溃、beta 反馈和性能诊断进行分诊。当用户询问 TF 崩溃、TestFlight 崩溃报告、beta 测试者反馈、应用卡死、磁盘写入、启动诊断，或需要某构建版本或应用的崩溃摘要时，使用此功能。

description: 追本之箭——纵向深钻思维工具。给一个观点、现象或问题，像箭一样一路向下钻到不可再分的本质。Use when user says '想透', '追本', '本质是什么', '为什么会这样', '深挖', '钻到底', 'think deep', 'drill down', or wants to trace any idea/phenomenon vertically to its irreducible root. Also trigger when user provides a statement and wants depth analysis, not breadth survey.
description_zh: 追本之箭——纵向深钻思维工具。针对一个观点、现象或问题，像箭一样一路向下深钻，抵达不可再分的本质。当用户使用“想透”、“追本”、“本质是什么”、“为什么会这样”、“深挖”、“钻到底”、“深入思考”、“向下深钻”等表达，或希望将任何想法、现象垂直追踪至其不可再分的本质时，使用此工具。此外，当用户提供陈述并希望进行深度分析而非广度调研时，也触发此工具。

description: Explains Cypress tests (E2E and component tests), and answers questions about Cypress use and behavior. Use when the user asks to explain how a test works, explain how Cypress works, review or critique a test without writing code. Apply even when the user does not say 'Cypress' (e.g. 'explain this test'). Prefer the cypress-author skill when the user wants to create, fix, or update tests.
description_zh: 解释 Cypress 测试（E2E 和组件测试），并解答有关 Cypress 的使用与行为的疑问。当用户要求解释测试的工作原理、解释 Cypress 如何工作、或在不编写代码的情况下评审或评判测试时，使用本技能。即使用户未提及“Cypress”（例如“解释这个测试”），也应应用本技能。当用户需要创建、修复或更新测试时，优先使用 cypress-author 技能。

description: Analyzes code diffs and files to identify bugs, security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, insecure deserialization), code smells, N+1 queries, naming issues, and architectural concerns, then produces a structured review report with prioritized, actionable feedback. Use when reviewing pull requests, conducting code quality audits, identifying refactoring opportunities, or checking for security issues. Invoke for PR reviews, code quality checks, refactoring suggestions, review code, code quality. Complements specialized skills (security-reviewer, test-master) by providing broad-scope review across correctness, performance, maintainability, and test coverage in a single pass.
description_zh: 分析代码差异与文件，以识别缺陷、安全漏洞（SQL注入、XSS、不安全的反序列化）、代码异味、N+1查询、命名问题及架构问题，并生成包含优先级与可操作性反馈的结构化评审报告。适用于审查Pull Request、进行代码质量审计、识别重构机会或排查安全问题的场景。针对PR审查、代码质量检查、重构建议、代码审查及代码质量等场景调用。作为安全审查员、测试大师等专业技能的补充，在单次评审中提供覆盖正确性、性能、可维护性及测试覆盖率的全面审查。

description: Detect, validate, and generate Schema.org structured data. JSON-LD format preferred. Use when user says "schema", "structured data", "rich results", "JSON-LD", or "markup".
description_zh: 检测、验证并生成 Schema.org 结构化数据。优先使用 JSON-LD 格式。当用户提到“schema”、“structured data”、“rich results”、“JSON-LD”或“markup”时使用。

description: Backlink profile analysis: referring domains, anchor text distribution, toxic link detection, competitor gap analysis. Works with free APIs (Moz, Bing Webmaster, Common Crawl) and DataForSEO extension. Use when user says backlinks, link profile, referring domains, anchor text, toxic links, link gap, link building, disavow, or backlink audit.
description_zh: 反向链接档案分析：引用域名、锚文本分布、毒性链接检测、竞争对手差距分析。支持免费API（Moz、Bing Webmaster、Common Crawl）以及DataForSEO扩展。当用户提到反向链接、链接档案、引用域名、锚文本、毒性链接、链接差距、链接构建、反奉诚或反向链接审计时使用。

description: Battle-tested Playwright patterns for writing, debugging, and scaling reliable test suites. Use when you need guidance for E2E, API, component, visual, accessibility, or security testing, plus CI/CD, CLI automation, page objects, and migration from Cypress or Selenium. TypeScript and JavaScript.
description_zh: 经过实战检验的 Playwright 模式，可用于编写、调试和扩展可靠的测试套件。适用于需要针对端到端（E2E）、API、组件、视觉、无障碍或安全测试的指导，以及 CI/CD、CLI 自动化、页面对象和从 Cypress 或 Selenium 迁移的场景。支持 TypeScript 和 JavaScript。

description: Writes, reviews, and debugs property-based tests — Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, jqwik, rapid, and Echidna or Medusa for Solidity invariants. Use whenever tests should cover a whole input domain instead of a hand-picked list of examples: encode/decode and serialize/deserialize pairs, parsers, canonicalizers and normalizers, validators, numeric and Decimal types, comparators and sort order, data structures, and smart-contract state invariants. Also use when adding cases to an existing @given, fast-check, or proptest suite, when judging whether existing property tests assert anything real, and when a generator has shrunk a counterexample and you need to tell a wrong property from a genuine bug. Not for coverage-guided binary fuzzing (libFuzzer, AFL), mutation-testing campaigns, static analysis, benchmarking, or end-to-end UI tests.
description_zh: 编写、审查和调试属性测试 —— Hypothesis、fast-check、proptest、jqwik、rapid，以及用于 Solidity 不变式的 Echidna 或 Medusa。当测试应覆盖整个输入域，而非手工挑选的示例列表时，请使用：编解码对与序列化/反序列化对、解析器、规范化器与标准化器、验证器、数值和 Decimal 类型、比较器与排序规则、数据结构，以及智能合约状态不变式。此外，当为现有的 @given、fast-check 或 proptest 测试套件添加用例时，当判断现有属性测试是否真正断言了任何真实内容时，以及当生成器缩小了反例、你需要区分错误属性和真实缺陷时，也请使用。不适用于基于覆盖率引导的二进制模糊测试（libFuzzer、AFL）、变异测试活动、静态分析、基准测试，以及端到端UI测试。

description: Generate Salesforce Flows using the MCP tool execute_metadata_action. Use when the user asks to create, build, or generate a flow — including Screen, Autolaunched, Record-Triggered (before/after-save), Scheduled. Also trigger for flow-like requests such as "when a record is created", "trigger daily at", "send an email when", "update the field when", "automate", "workflow", or "flow XML/metadata". This is the only skill for Salesforce Flow generation.
description_zh: 使用 MCP 工具的 execute_metadata_action 生成 Salesforce 流程。当用户要求创建、构建或生成流程时使用，包括 Screen、Autolaunched、Record-Triggered（保存前/保存后）、Scheduled。同时也适用于类似流程的请求，如“当记录创建时”、“每日定时触发”、“当...时发送邮件”、“当...时更新字段”、“自动化”、“工作流”或“流程 XML/元数据”。这是用于 Salesforce 流程生成的唯一技能。

description: WhatsApp Business automation - customer support, notifications, chatbots, and broadcast messaging
description_zh: WhatsApp Business 自动化——客户支持、通知、聊天机器人和广播消息

description: Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error handling standards.
description_zh: 用于设计 REST 或 GraphQL API、创建 OpenAPI 规范、规划 API 架构时。用于资源建模、版本策略、分页模式、错误处理标准。

description: Find and explore Windows desktop APIs. Use when building features that need platform capabilities — camera, file access, notifications, UI controls, AI/ML, sensors, networking, etc. Discovers the right API for a task and retrieves full type details (methods, properties, events, enumeration values).
description_zh: 查找并探索 Windows 桌面 API。在构建需要平台能力的功能时使用，包括相机、文件访问、通知、UI 控件、AI/ML、传感器、网络等。发现任务的正确 API，并检索完整的类型详情（方法、属性、事件、枚举值）。

description: Optimizes SQL queries, designs database schemas, and troubleshoots performance issues. Use when a user asks why their query is slow, needs help writing complex joins or aggregations, mentions database performance issues, or wants to design or migrate a schema. Invoke for complex queries, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, covering index creation, recursive queries, EXPLAIN/ANALYZE interpretation, before/after query benchmarking, or migrating queries between database dialects (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle).
description_zh: 优化SQL查询，设计数据库模式，并排查性能问题。当用户询问为何查询缓慢、需要帮助编写复杂连接或聚合、提及数据库性能问题，或想要设计或迁移模式时使用。在针对复杂查询、窗口函数、CTE、索引策略、查询计划分析、覆盖索引创建、递归查询、EXPLAIN/ANALYZE解读、查询前后基准测试，或在数据库方言（PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server、Oracle）之间迁移查询时调用。

description: Generate, edit, and read PowerPoint presentations. Create from scratch with PptxGenJS (cover, TOC, content, section divider, summary slides), edit existing PPTX via XML workflows, or extract text with markitdown. Triggers: PPT, PPTX, PowerPoint, presentation, slide, deck, slides.
description_zh: 生成、编辑和阅读 PowerPoint 演示文稿。使用 PptxGenJS 从零开始创建（封面、目录、内容、章节分隔页、总结幻灯片），通过 XML 工作流程编辑现有 PPTX，或使用 markitdown 提取文本。触发词：PPT, PPTX, PowerPoint, 演示文稿, 幻灯片, 演示文稿组, 幻灯片。

description: Generates correct, deployable Salesforce permission set metadata (PermissionSet XML) with object, field, user, and app permissions. Use this skill when creating or editing permission set metadata, object permissions, field-level security (FLS), tab visibility, or deploying permission sets.
description_zh: 生成包含对象、字段、用户和应用权限的正确、可部署的Salesforce权限集元数据（PermissionSet XML）。在创建或编辑权限集元数据、对象权限、字段级安全（FLS）、选项卡可见性或部署权限集时，请使用此技能。

description: Transform monolithic Terraform configurations into reusable, maintainable modules following HashiCorp's module design principles and community best practices.
description_zh: 遵循 HashiCorp 的模块设计原则与社区最佳实践，将单体式 Terraform 配置转换为可复用、可维护的模块。

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, or validate Salesforce Custom Object metadata. Trigger when users mention custom objects, creating objects, object metadata, .object files, sharing models, name fields, or validation rules on objects. Also use when users say things like "create a custom object", "generate object metadata", "set up an object for...", or when they're troubleshooting object deployment errors especially around sharing models and Master-Detail relationships. Always use this skill for any custom object metadata work, including enriching and keeping the object's description current whenever its fields or validation rules change. Do NOT use this skill for non-Custom-Object metadata (Apex, Flows, LWC, Permission Sets, Custom Metadata Types) or for standard Salesforce objects.
description_zh:
当用户需要创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 自定义对象元数据时，请使用此技能。当用户提及自定义对象、创建对象、对象元数据、.object 文件、共享模型、名称字段或对象的验证规则时，即触发此技能。当用户说类似"创建自定义对象"、"生成对象元数据"、"为...设置对象"等表述，或正在排查对象部署错误（尤其在共享模型和主从关系方面）时，也请使用此技能。

对于任何自定义对象元数据工作，始终使用此技能，包括在对象的字段或验证规则发生变化时丰富和保持对象的描述最新。

请勿将此技能用于非自定义对象元数据（Apex、流程、LWC、权限集、自定义元数据类型）或标准 Salesforce 对象。

description: UWP-to-WinUI 3 migration reference. Maps legacy UWP APIs to correct Windows App SDK equivalents with before/after code snippets. Covers namespace changes, threading (CoreDispatcher to DispatcherQueue), windowing (CoreWindow to AppWindow), dialogs, pickers, sharing, printing, background tasks, and the most common Copilot code generation mistakes.
description_zh: UWP 到 WinUI 3 迁移参考。将传统 UWP API 映射为正确的 Windows App SDK 对应实现，并提供前后对照的代码片段。涵盖命名空间变更、线程处理（CoreDispatcher 到 DispatcherQueue）、窗口管理（CoreWindow 到 AppWindow）、对话框、选择器、共享、打印、后台任务，以及最常见的 Copilot 代码生成错误。

description: Streaming wire protocols and backend helpers for assistant-ui, built on the assistant-stream package. Use when building a custom streaming endpoint outside the Vercel AI SDK with createAssistantStreamResponse, createAssistantStream, or createAssistantStreamController; choosing between the Data Stream protocol (useDataStreamRuntime, DataStreamEncoder, DataStreamDecoder) and the Assistant Transport protocol (AssistantTransportEncoder, AssistantTransportDecoder); decoding a response with AssistantStream.fromResponse, UIMessageStreamDecoder, or PlainTextDecoder; or wiring resumable streams through assistant-stream/resumable with in-memory, Redis, or ioredis stores. Route here for wire level symptoms: an unexpected part-start or text-delta shape, a tool call that never settles, a part that silently drops, a Content-Type mismatch, or a reload that cannot resume a response. For runtime hooks use runtime; for AI SDK route handlers without a custom protocol use setup; for cloud persistence use cloud.
description_zh: 基于 assistant-stream 包构建的 assistant-ui 流式线协议与后端辅助工具。用于在 Vercel AI SDK 之外使用 createAssistantStreamResponse、createAssistantStream 或 createAssistantStreamController 构建自定义流式端点时使用；选择使用 Data Stream 协议（useDataStreamRuntime、DataStreamEncoder、DataStreamDecoder）还是 Assistant Transport 协议（AssistantTransportEncoder、AssistantTransportDecoder）；使用 AssistantStream.fromResponse、UIMessageStreamDecoder 或 PlainTextDecoder 对响应进行解码；或通过 assistant-stream/resumable 配合内存、Redis 或 ioredis 存储来连接可恢复的流。当出现线协议层面的症状时，请路由到此处：意外的 part-start 或 text-delta 形状、无法结束的工具调用、无声丢弃的 part、Content-Type 不匹配，或无法恢复响应的重载。运行时钩子请使用 runtime；对于无需自定义协议的 AI SDK 路由处理器，请使用 setup；对于云端持久化，请使用 cloud。

description: Discover what customers truly need by analyzing the "job" they hire your product to do. Use when the user mentions "customer discovery", "why customers churn", "what job does this solve", "competing against luck", "product-market fit", "switching behavior", "milkshake moment", or "functional vs emotional jobs". Also trigger when investigating why users choose competitors, designing features around real customer needs, or reframing a value proposition. Covers JTBD interviews, competition analysis, and jobs-oriented roadmaps. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For rapid validation, see design-sprint. For non-leading interview technique, see mom-test.
description_zh:
通过分析客户雇佣你的产品来完成的具体"任务"，来发现客户真正需要什么。

当用户提及"客户发现"、"客户为何流失"、"该产品解决的任务"、"与运气竞争"、"产品与市场契合度"、"切换行为"、"奶昔时刻"或"功能需求与情感需求"时使用。

当需要调查用户选择竞品的原因、围绕真实客户需求设计功能，或重塑价值主张时，也应触发此功能。

涵盖JTBD访谈、竞品分析和以任务为导向的路线图。

进行产品定位时，请参阅 obviously-awesome；进行快速验证时，请参阅 design-sprint；关于非引导性访谈技巧，请参阅 mom-test。

description: Umbrella skill for all Convex development patterns. Routes to specific skills like convex-functions, convex-realtime, convex-agents, etc.
description_zh: 适用于所有 Convex 开发模式的伞式技能。可路由至 convex-functions、convex-realtime、convex-agents 等特定技能。

description: MCP Apps integration for json-render. Use when building MCP servers that render interactive UIs in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or VS Code, or when integrating json-render with the Model Context Protocol.
description_zh: json-render 的 MCP 应用集成。适用于在 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 或 VS Code 中构建用于渲染交互式用户界面的 MCP 服务器时，或者将 json-render 与模型上下文协议集成时使用。

description: Identifies error-prone APIs, dangerous configurations, and footgun designs that enable security mistakes. Use when reviewing API designs, configuration schemas, cryptographic library ergonomics, or evaluating whether code follows 'secure by default' and 'pit of success' principles. Triggers: footgun, misuse-resistant, secure defaults, API usability, dangerous configuration.
description_zh: 识别易出错的API、危险配置以及隐蔽陷阱设计，这些都会导致安全失误。在审查API设计、配置模式、密码学库易用性，或评估代码是否遵循“安全默认”与“成功之坑”原则时使用。触发条件：隐蔽陷阱、防误用、安全默认、API可用性、危险配置。

description: Converts Stitch designs into modular Vite and React components, or syncs/updates existing React components to align with the latest Stitch designs, using system-level networking and AST-based validation.
description_zh: 将 Stitch 设计转换为模块化 Vite 与 React 组件，或将现有 React 组件同步/更新，使其与最新的 Stitch 设计保持一致，利用系统级网络通信和基于 AST 的验证。

description: Run Salesforce Code Analyzer to scan code for security, performance, best practice, and code style violations. Supports all engines (PMD, ESLint, CPD, RetireJS, Flow, SFGE, ApexGuru), targets (files, folders, git diff), categories, and severities. Also handles post-scan exploration: filtering results by engine/severity/category/file, and explaining what rules mean. TRIGGER when: user says 'scan my code', 'check security issues', 'run PMD/ESLint', 'find duplicates', 'analyze Flows', 'check vulnerable libraries', 'AppExchange review', 'lint my LWC', 'static analysis', 'code quality', 'show security violations', 'what is this rule', 'explain ApexCRUDViolation', 'filter results', or mentions engines/file types (.cls, .trigger, .js, .flow-meta.xml). Use this skill for scanning, exploring results, and listing rules. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user asks only about installation/configuration (use dx-code-analyzer-configure), or wants to create a custom rule (use dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create).
description_zh: 运行 Salesforce 代码分析器，以扫描代码中的安全、性能、最佳实践和代码风格违规问题。支持所有引擎（PMD、ESLint、CPD、RetireJS、Flow、SFGE、ApexGuru）、目标（文件、文件夹、git 差异）、类别和严重程度。同时支持扫描后探索：根据引擎/严重程度/类别/文件筛选结果，并解释规则的含义。当触发条件为：用户说“scan my code”、“check security issues”、“run PMD/ESLint”、“find duplicates”、“analyze Flows”、“check vulnerable libraries”、“AppExchange review”、“lint my LWC”、“static analysis”、“code quality”、“show security violations”、“what is this rule”、“explain ApexCRUDViolation”、“filter results”，或提及引擎/文件类型（.cls、.trigger、.js、.flow-meta.xml）时，触发运行。使用此技能进行扫描、探索结果和列出规则。请勿触发：当用户仅询问安装/配置（使用 dx-code-analyzer-configure），或想要创建自定义规则（使用 dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create）时。

description: Run an offline ASO audit on canonical App Store metadata under `./metadata` and surface keyword gaps using Astro MCP. Use after pulling metadata with `asc metadata pull`.
description_zh: 在`./metadata`下对规范的App Store元数据运行离线ASO审计，并使用Astro MCP揭示关键词空白。在通过`asc metadata pull`拉取元数据后使用。

description: Deep single-page SEO analysis covering on-page elements, content quality, technical meta tags, schema, images, and performance. Use when user says "analyze this page", "check page SEO", "single URL", "check this page", "page analysis", or provides a single URL for review.
description_zh: 深度单页SEO分析，涵盖页面元素、内容质量、技术元标签、Schema、图片与性能。当用户提及“分析此页面”、“检查页面SEO”、“单URL”、“检查此页面”、“页面分析”，或提供单个URL以供审核时使用。

description: 面向创作者的内容发布风险检查。逐句检查自媒体、社交媒体和内容平台的标题、正文、图片文字、字幕、口播、评论、账号资料及视频画面，分别判断平台机器可能识别什么、内容本身存在什么实质问题，并给出具体位置和最小修改动作；需要明确视频语境边界时，额外生成真实准确的三行贴片小字。用户询问「检查敏感词」「发布前排雷」「这篇内容哪里可能违规」「这条小红书能不能发」「视频上放什么声明」时使用。保留强观点、情绪张力、个人风格和传播钩子。
description_zh: 面向创作者的内容发布风险检查。逐句检查自媒体、社交媒体和内容平台的标题、正文、图片文字、字幕、口播、评论、账号资料及视频画面，分别判断平台机器可能识别什么、内容本身存在什么实质问题，并给出具体位置和最小修改动作；需要明确视频语境边界时，额外生成真实准确的三行贴片小字。用户询问「检查敏感词」「发布前排雷」「这篇内容哪里可能违规」「这条小红书能不能发」「视频上放什么声明」时使用。保留强观点、情绪张力、个人风格和传播钩子。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to build an "MCP app", add "interactive UI" or "widgets" to an MCP server, "render components in chat", build "MCP UI resources", make a tool that shows a "form", "picker", "dashboard" or "confirmation dialog" inline in the conversation, or mentions "apps SDK" in the context of MCP. Use AFTER the build-mcp-server skill has settled the deployment model, or when the user already knows they want UI widgets.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户想要构建“MCP app”、向 MCP server 添加“交互式 UI”或“小部件”、在聊天中渲染组件、构建“MCP UI 资源”、制作在对话中内联显示“表单”、“选择器”、“仪表板”或“确认对话框”的工具，或在 MCP 语境中提及“apps SDK”时使用。应在 build-mcp-server 技能确定部署模型之后使用，或当用户已明确表示需要 UI 小部件时使用。

description: Creates and maintains concise AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md project instruction files. Use when asked to create AGENTS.md, update AGENTS.md, maintain agent docs, set up CLAUDE.md, document repository agent conventions, or keep coding-agent instructions minimal and reference-backed.
description_zh: 创建并维护简洁的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 项目指令文件。当被要求创建 AGENTS.md、更新 AGENTS.md、维护代理文档、设置 CLAUDE.md、记录仓库代理规范，或保持编程代理指令简洁且基于参考时使用。

description: Find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues in local branch changes. Use when asked to review changes, find bugs, security review, or audit code on the current branch.
description_zh: 在本地分支的变更中查找错误、安全漏洞和代码质量问题。当被要求审查变更、查找错误、进行安全审查或对当前分支的代码进行审计时使用。

description: Create and troubleshoot AWS Glue connections to JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS), Redshift, Snowflake, and BigQuery. Gathers connection hints from user, discovers existing connections and RDS/Redshift candidates, registers credentials in Secrets Manager or IAM DB auth, configures VPC, and tests. Triggers on: connect to database, set up Glue connection, register data source, connect to Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS, connection timeout, test connection, troubleshoot connection. Do NOT use for moving data (use ingesting-into-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table), queries (use querying-data-lake), catalog exploration (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka).
description_zh: 创建并排查 AWS Glue 与 JDBC 数据库（Oracle、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、RDS）、Redshift、Snowflake 和 BigQuery 的连接。收集用户提供的连接提示，发现现有连接及 RDS/Redshift 候选连接，在密钥管理（Secrets Manager）或 IAM 数据库认证中注册凭证，配置 VPC 并进行测试。触发场景包括：连接到数据库、设置 AWS Glue 连接、注册数据源、连接到 Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS、连接超时、测试连接、排查连接问题。禁止用于以下场景：数据传输（使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）、创建表（使用 creating-data-lake-table）、查询（使用 querying-data-lake）、目录探索（使用 exploring-data-catalog），或 SaaS（Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、MongoDB、Kafka）。

description: Migrates Next.js projects to vinext (Vite-based Next.js reimplementation). Load when asked to migrate, convert, or switch from Next.js to vinext. Handles compatibility scanning, package replacement, Vite config generation, ESM conversion, and deployment setup (Cloudflare Workers natively, other platforms via Nitro).
description_zh: 将 Next.js 项目迁移至 vinext（基于 Vite 的 Next.js 重新实现）。当需要从 Next.js 迁移、转换或切换至 vinext 时进行加载。负责兼容性扫描、依赖替换、Vite 配置生成、ESM 转换及部署设置（原生支持 Cloudflare Workers，其他平台通过 Nitro 实现）。

description: Golang semantic code intelligence via `gopls`, the official Go language server — go-to-definition, find references, call/implementation hierarchy, workspace symbol search, package API discovery, diagnostics, safe rename, refactors (extract/inline/fill/rewrite code actions), formatting, and generated tests. Reaches an agent via gopls's own MCP server (`go_*` tools), Claude Code's native `LSP` tool, or the `gopls` CLI. Use when navigating or refactoring Go code — jumping to a definition, finding call sites before a rename, understanding a file's or package's dependencies, running diagnostics after an edit, or extracting/inlining/renaming. Not for the published ecosystem — packages not in your `go.mod`, versions, licenses, importers — → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-pkg-go-dev` skill (`godig`). Not for a whole-tree vulnerability audit → See `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security` skill (`govulncheck`).
description_zh:
基于 `gopls`（Go 官方语言服务器）实现的 Golang 语义代码智能功能，支持：定义跳转（go-to-definition）、引用查找、调用/实现层级、工作区符号搜索、包 API 发现、诊断、安全重命名、重构（提取/内联/填充/重写代码操作）、代码格式化、以及生成测试。可通过 gopls 自带的 MCP 服务器（`go_*` 工具）、Claude Code 原生的 `LSP` 工具，或 `gopls` CLI 与智能体对接。

适用于导航或重构 Go 代码的场景——跳转至定义、重命名前查找调用位置、理解文件或包的依赖关系、编辑后运行诊断，或提取/内联/重命名代码。

不适用于发布生态环境——不在您 `go.mod` 中的包、版本、许可证、导入方——→ 参见技能 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-pkg-go-dev`（`godig`）。不适用于全树漏洞审计 → 参见技能 `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-security`（`govulncheck`）。

description: Create, edit, and manipulate Excel spreadsheets programmatically using openpyxl
description_zh: 使用 openpyxl 以编程方式创建、编辑和操控 Excel 电子表格

description: REQUIRED companion for Salesforce metadata generation — load this schema/API-context skill in the SAME turn as ANY metadata generation skill; if you load a generator, you ALSO load this. Use it whenever you create, generate, add, edit, or author metadata or a *-meta.xml file: custom object, custom field, formula field, picklist, lookup, master-detail, validation rule, permission set, profile, custom tab, lightning record page, flexipage, list view, custom application, flow, layout, record type, sharing rules, report, and 604 Metadata API types. It provides the authoritative schema, fields, field properties, required flags, allowed enum values, and XML structure so generated *-meta.xml deploys cleanly — skipping it causes hallucinated element names and deploy failures. Trigger on *-meta.xml, metadata schema, api context, 'Salesforce metadata', or 'sfdx project'. DO NOT use for SOQL, DML, runtime sObject access, or Tooling API records.
description_zh: Salesforce 元数据生成必备配套技能——在同次对话中与任何元数据生成技能同步，必须加载此 Schema/API-context 技能；若您加载了生成器，也必须同时加载该技能。当您创建、生成、添加、编辑或编写元数据或 *-meta.xml 文件时，请始终使用它，涵盖自定义对象、自定义字段、公式字段、picklist、lookup、master-detail、验证规则、权限集、profile、custom tab、lightning record page、flexipage、list view、custom application、flow、layout、record type、sharing rules、report，以及 604 种 Metadata API 类型。它提供权威的 Schema、字段、字段属性、必填标志、允许的枚举值及 XML 结构，确保生成的 *-meta.xml 能够顺利部署——省略该技能将导致幻觉的元素名称和部署失败。当涉及 *-meta.xml、元数据 Schema、API 上下文、'Salesforce 元数据' 或 'sfdx 项目' 时进行触发。请勿用于 SOQL、DML、运行时 sObject 访问或 Tooling API 记录。

description: Automate web browser interactions using natural language via CLI commands. Use when the user asks to browse websites, navigate web pages, extract data from websites, take screenshots, fill forms, click buttons, or interact with web applications. Supports remote Browserbase sessions with Browserbase Identity, Verified browsers, automatic CAPTCHA solving, and residential proxies — ideal for protected websites and JavaScript-heavy pages.
description_zh: 通过命令行命令使用自然语言自动化网页浏览器交互。适用于用户要求浏览网站、导航网页、从网站提取数据、截图、填写表单、点击按钮或与网页应用交互的场景。支持结合 Browserbase Identity 的远程 Browserbase 会话、已验证的浏览器、自动验证码识别以及住宅代理，适用于受保护网站和依赖大量 JavaScript 的页面。

description: Reconcile App Store Connect subscriptions and in-app purchases with RevenueCat products, entitlements, offerings, and packages using asc and RevenueCat MCP. Use when setting up or syncing subscription catalogs across ASC and RevenueCat.
