description_zh: 使用 asc 和 RevenueCat MCP 对 App Store Connect 订阅与应用内购买与 RevenueCat 产品、许可、提供项及套餐进行对账。适用于在 App Store Connect 与 RevenueCat 之间设置或同步订阅目录时使用。

description: Strategic SEO planning for new or existing websites. Industry-specific templates, competitive analysis, content strategy, and implementation roadmap. Use when user says "SEO plan", "SEO strategy", "SEO planning", "content strategy", "keyword strategy", "content calendar", "site architecture", or "SEO roadmap".
description_zh: 针对新网站或现有网站的SEO战略规划。行业特定模板、竞争分析、内容策略及实施路线图。当用户说'SEO plan'、'SEO strategy'、'SEO planning'、'content strategy'、'keyword strategy'、'content calendar'、'site architecture'或'SEO roadmap'时使用。

description: Datadog CLI (Rust). OAuth2 auth with token refresh.
description_zh: Datadog CLI（Rust）。使用 OAuth2 进行身份认证，支持令牌刷新。

description: Create and secure S3 buckets following AWS best practices for access control, encryption, monitoring, and remediation of misconfigurations. Use when the user wants to secure a new bucket, audit an existing bucket, fix a security finding, configure encryption, or enable logging and monitoring. Do NOT use for general S3 data operations, S3 Tables setup, or discovering existing data assets.
description_zh: 遵循 AWS 在访问控制、加密、监控和配置错误修复方面的最佳实践，创建并保护 S3 存储桶。当用户需要保护新存储桶、审计现有存储桶、修复安全发现、配置加密或启用日志与监控时使用。不得用于一般 S3 数据操作、S3 Tables 设置，或发现现有数据资产。

description: Use when writing technical documentation that needs to be readable by both humans and AI models, converting existing docs to HADS format, validating a HADS document, or optimizing documentation for token-efficient AI consumption.
description_zh: 适用场景：编写既可供人类和 AI 模型阅读的技术文档，将现有文档转换为 HADS 格式，验证 HADS 文档，或优化文档以利于 token 高效的 AI 消耗。

description: Lightning Web Components with PICKLES methodology and 165-point scoring. Use this skill when the user creates or edits LWC components, builds wire service patterns, or writes Jest tests for LWC. TRIGGER when: user creates/edits LWC components, touches lwc/**/*.js, .html, .css, .js-meta.xml files, or asks about wire service, SLDS, or Jest LWC tests. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex classes (use platform-apex-generate), Aura components, or Visualforce.
description_zh: 采用 PICKLES 方法论和 165 分评分标准的 Lightning Web Components。当用户创建或编辑 LWC 组件、构建 wire service 模式，或编写 LWC 的 Jest 测试时，使用此技能。触发条件：当用户创建/编辑 LWC 组件、操作 lwc/**/*.js、.html、.css、.js-meta.xml 文件，或询问 wire service、SLDS 或 Jest LWC 测试时，触发该技能。不触发条件：当涉及 Apex 类（使用 platform-apex-generate）、Aura 组件或 Visualforce 时，不触发该技能。

description: A Twitter API alternative and X API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no OAuth and no developer application. Use when the user wants to search tweets by keyword, hashtag, or advanced operators (from:, to:, since:, until:, min_faves:, filter:), scrape a Twitter/X profile by handle, pull a user's tweets, replies, followers, or followings, fetch a single tweet with its replies or retweeters, read a Twitter List's members or tweets, check trending topics by country, or search for X accounts by name. Also covers Twitter data pipelines, competitor monitoring, hashtag tracking, sentiment analysis input, or follower export without the official X API's pricing tiers or app-review process.
description_zh: fetcher.sh 上的 Twitter API 与 X API 替代方案——通过 x402 以 USDC 按调用付费，或使用 Bearer key 进行预付费额度，无需 OAuth 和开发者申请。当用户需要时，可用于：根据关键词、标签或高级操作（from:、to:、since:、until:、min_faves:、filter:）搜索推文；按用户名抓取 Twitter/X 个人资料；拉取用户的推文、回复、关注者或粉丝；获取包含回复或转发者的单条推文；读取 Twitter 列表的成员或推文；按国家检查热门话题；以及按名称搜索 X 账户。此外，还涵盖 Twitter 数据管道、竞品监控、标签追踪、情感分析输入及粉丝导出等内容，无需遵循官方 X API 的定价层级或应用审核流程。

description: 一个用来打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈，并在过程中创建文档（ADRs 和词汇表）。
description_zh: 一种用于打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈，并在过程中创建文档（ADRs 和词汇表）。

description: Use when interacting with Unity CLI from the terminal, or to control a running/connected Unity Editor from the command line — create or modify GameObjects, edit scenes and assets, inspect the hierarchy, and run C# in a live Editor instead of hand-editing scene or asset files. Also install, upgrade or uninstall editors, create, list or open projects, manage modules, manage licenses, check auth status, read logs, browse Unity releases, build/test projects, configure the Unity MCP server for AI agents, or run any other Unity CLI operation. For a guided idea-to-running-project flow for a brand-new game, use the new-unity-project skill instead.
description_zh: 用于在终端中与 Unity CLI 交互，或通过命令行控制正在运行或已连接的 Unity Editor 时使用——创建或修改游戏对象，编辑场景和资源，检查层级结构，并在实时编辑器中运行 C#，而无需手动编辑场景或资源文件。还可安装、升级或卸载编辑器，创建、列出或打开项目，管理模块，管理许可证，检查认证状态，读取日志，浏览 Unity 发布版本，构建/测试项目，为 AI 代理配置 Unity MCP 服务器，或执行任何其他 Unity CLI 操作。对于全新游戏的引导式从创意到可运行项目的流程，请改用 new-unity-project 技能。

description: Reading companion agent. Accompanies user through any text (books, articles, essays, papers, news) with translation, structural annotation, deep questioning, and cross-domain insights. Detects language, translates English to Chinese (faithfulness-expressiveness-elegance), guides reader to understand the author and encounter real questions. Use when user says '伴读', '陪我读', '读这篇', 'read with me', 'companion read', or shares a text/URL wanting guided reading.
description_zh: 阅读伴读智能体。伴随用户阅读任何文本（书籍、文章、论文、新闻），提供翻译、结构注释、深度提问与跨领域洞察。识别语言，将英文翻译为中文（忠实-表达-优雅），引导读者理解作者并直面真实问题。当用户说出“伴读”、“陪我读”、“读这篇”、“read with me”、“companion read”，或分享文本/URL并希望获得引导阅读时，即可使用。

description: Expert 10x engineer with comprehensive knowledge of web development, internet protocols, and web standards. Use when working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, web APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, web security, performance optimization, accessibility, or any web/internet concepts. Specializes in translating web terminology accurately and implementing modern web standards across frontend and backend development.
description_zh: 十倍工程师专家，具备全面的Web开发、互联网协议与Web标准知识。适用于处理HTML、CSS、JavaScript、Web API、HTTP/HTTPS、Web安全、性能优化、无障碍访问，以及各类Web/互联网相关概念。专注于准确翻译Web术语，并在前后端开发中落地现代Web标准。

description: Help users manage their time and tasks more effectively. Use when someone is overwhelmed with work, struggling with focus, trying to balance multiple responsibilities, or asking how to get more done.
description_zh: 帮助用户更高效地管理时间与任务。当有人被工作压得喘不过气、难以专注、需要平衡多项责任，或询问如何做更多事时，使用本工具。

description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Implement dependency injection in Angular v20+ using inject(), injection tokens, and provider configuration. Use for service architecture, providing dependencies at different levels, creating injectable tokens, and managing singleton vs scoped services. Triggers on service creation, configuring providers, using injection tokens, or understanding DI hierarchy.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 该技能未维护。请改用官方 Angular 技能：https://github.com/angular/skills 。在 Angular v20+ 中使用 inject()、注入令牌和提供器配置实现依赖注入。适用于服务架构、在不同层级提供依赖、创建可注入令牌，以及管理单例与作用域服务。当涉及服务创建、配置提供器、使用注入令牌，或理解依赖注入层级时触发。

description: Use this skill when users need to create, modify, or validate Salesforce Validation Rules. Trigger when users mention validation rules, field validation, data quality rules, formula validation, error messages, or validation logic. Also use when users encounter validation errors, need to update formulas, or want to enforce business rules at the data layer. Always use this skill for any validation rule work.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、修改或验证 Salesforce 验证规则时，请使用此技能。当用户提及验证规则、字段验证、数据质量规则、公式验证、错误消息或验证逻辑时，请触发此技能。当用户遇到验证错误、需要更新公式，或希望在数据层强制执行业务规则时，也请使用此技能。对于任何验证规则工作，始终使用此技能。

description: Image optimization analysis for SEO and performance. Checks alt text, file sizes, formats, responsive images, lazy loading, CLS prevention, image SERP rankings (via DataForSEO), and image file optimization (WebP/AVIF conversion, IPTC/XMP metadata injection). Use when user says "image optimization", "alt text", "image SEO", "image size", "image audit", "optimize images", "image metadata", "image SERP", "convert to webp", or "image file optimize".
description_zh: 面向SEO和性能的图像优化分析。检查替代文本、文件大小、格式、响应式图像、懒加载、CLS预防、图像SERP排名（通过DataForSEO），以及图像文件优化（WebP/AVIF转换、IPTC/XMP元数据注入）。当用户提到“图像优化”、“替代文本”、“图像SEO”、“图像大小”、“图像审计”、“优化图像”、“图像元数据”、“图像SERP”、“转换为WebP”或“图像文件优化”时使用。

description:
Vision-driven browser automation using Midscene. Operates from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels needed.

Runs in headless Puppeteer — does NOT take over the user's mouse or keyboard.
Also supports CDP mode and Bridge mode to connect to an existing Chrome.

Use this skill when the user wants to:
- Browse, navigate, or open web pages
- Scrape, extract, or collect data from websites
- Fill out forms, upload local files, click buttons, or interact with web elements
- Verify, validate, test, or QA frontend UI behavior
- Take screenshots of web pages
- Automate multi-step web workflows
- Test what was just built, see if it works in browser
- Connect to Chrome via CDP, DevTools Protocol, or remote debugging
- Connect to user's Chrome browser, control my browser, operate my Chrome

Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)
description_zh:
基于视觉的浏览器自动化（使用 Midscene）。通过截图操作——无需 DOM 或无障碍标签。

以无头 Puppeteer 模式运行——不会接管用户的鼠标或键盘。

同时支持 CDP 模式和 Bridge 模式，以便连接至现有的 Chrome。

当用户需要以下操作时，使用本技能：
- 浏览、导航或打开网页
- 从网站抓取、提取或收集数据
- 填写表单、上传本地文件、点击按钮或与网页元素交互
- 验证、校验、测试或对前端 UI 行为进行 QA
- 对网页进行截图
- 自动化多步骤网页工作流
- 测试刚刚构建的内容，并验证其在浏览器中是否能正常运行
- 通过 CDP、DevTools Protocol 或远程调试连接到 Chrome
- 连接用户使用的 Chrome 浏览器，控制我的浏览器，操作我的 Chrome

由 Midscene.js（https://midscenejs.com）提供支持

description: Airtable database automation - views, automations, integrations, and workflow triggers
description_zh: Airtable 数据库自动化 - 视图、自动化、集成和工作流触发器

description: Writes, reviews, and debugs idiomatic Rust code with memory safety and zero-cost abstractions. Implements ownership patterns, manages lifetimes, designs trait hierarchies, builds async applications with tokio, and structures error handling with Result/Option. Use when building Rust applications, solving ownership or borrowing issues, designing trait-based APIs, implementing async/await concurrency, creating FFI bindings, or optimizing for performance and memory safety. Invoke for Rust, Cargo, ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, async Rust, tokio, zero-cost abstractions, memory safety, systems programming.
description_zh: 编写、审查并调试具备内存安全与零成本抽象特性的地道 Rust 代码。实现所有权模式，管理生命周期，设计 trait 层次结构，使用 tokio 构建异步应用程序，并借助 Result/Option 组织错误处理。在构建 Rust 应用程序、解决所有权或借用问题、设计基于 trait 的 API、实现异步/await 并发、创建 FFI 绑定，或优化性能与内存安全时使用。适用于 Rust、Cargo、所有权、借用、生命周期、异步 Rust、tokio、零成本抽象、内存安全、系统编程等。

description: Defines model-callable tools and renders their calls in assistant-ui. The authoring model: a "use generative" file whose default export is defineToolkit({...}), compiled by withAui from @assistant-ui/next, aui() from @assistant-ui/vite, or withAui from @assistant-ui/metro, mounted with AuiConfig({ tools: Tools({ toolkit }) }), and exposed to the model with new AISDKToolkit({ toolkit }).tools({ frontend }). Covers the tool kinds (backend, "use client" frontend, humanTool(), providerTool(), externalTool(), stubTool(), defineMcpToolkit()), render and display, ToolCallMessagePartProps, approval gates, MCP servers, MCP Apps, WebMCP, and sub-agent messages. Reach for it when a tool is never called, a tool UI does not render, a frontend result never reaches the model, humanTool() throws at runtime, or an approval gate cannot be answered. For model-composed UI use generative-ui, for MCP servers users add in the browser use react-mcp, and for the styled ToolFallback and ToolGroup use elements.
description_zh:
在 assistant-ui 中定义可在模型中调用的工具，并渲染其调用。

其编写模型：一个“use generative”文件，其默认导出为 `defineToolkit({...})`，使用 `@assistant-ui/next` 提供的 `withAui`、`@assistant-ui/vite` 提供的 `aui()`，或 `@assistant-ui/metro` 提供的 `withAui` 进行编译；通过 `AuiConfig({ tools: Tools({ toolkit }) })` 进行挂载，并使用 `new AISDKToolkit({ toolkit }).tools({ fronten })` 将其暴露给模型。

涵盖工具类型（后端、前端“use client”、`humanTool()`、`providerTool()`、`externalTool()`、`stubTool()`、`defineMcpToolkit()`）、渲染与展示、`ToolCallMessagePartProps`、审批门、MCP 服务器、MCP 应用、WebMCP 以及子代理消息。

当工具从未被调用、工具 UI 不渲染、前端结果从未传递给模型、`humanTool()` 在运行时抛出异常，或审批门无法被响应时，请使用此组件。

对于由模型组合的 UI，使用 `generative-ui`；对于在浏览器中添加的 MCP 服务器，使用 `react-mcp`；对于样式化的 `ToolFallback` 和 `ToolGroup`，使用相关元素。

description: Design the small details -- triggers, rules, feedback, loops and modes -- that separate good products from great ones. Use when the user mentions "microinteraction", "button feedback", "loading state", "toggle design", "animation detail", "state transitions", "input feedback", "the interface feels dead", "make the UI feel responsive", or "add polish to interactions". Also trigger when designing form-validation responses, progress indicators, confirmation dialogs, or any element where the user expects immediate feedback. Covers trigger design, state rules, feedback mechanisms, and progressive loops. For overall UI polish, see refactoring-ui. For affordance design, see design-everyday-things.
description_zh:
设计那些将优秀产品与卓越产品区分开的细节——触发条件、规则、反馈、循环和模式。

当用户提到"微交互"、"按钮反馈"、"加载状态"、"开关设计"、"动画细节"、"状态切换"、"输入反馈"、"界面显得死气沉沉"、"让界面感觉有响应性"或"为交互添加细节打磨"时使用。在设计表单校验响应、进度指示器、确认对话框或任何用户期望即时反馈的元素时，也需要触发。涵盖触发条件设计、状态规则、反馈机制以及渐进循环。如需整体UI打磨，参见 refactoring-ui。如需可发现性设计，参见 design-everyday-things。

description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.
description_zh: 配置一个 PreToolUse 钩子，以防止 AI 智能体在使用 --no-verify 及其他绕过标志时跳过 git pre-commit 钩子。适用于设置强制执行提交质量门禁的 Claude Code 项目。

description: Converts books and documents (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, plain text, RTF, MOBI/AZW with Calibre) into structured agent skills, extracting frameworks, mental models, principles, techniques, and anti-patterns. Use when the user wants to study a document through GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, Claude Code, Hermes Agent, or OpenClaw, apply an author's frameworks while working, or build a reusable knowledge base from a file.
description_zh: 将书籍和文档（PDF、EPUB、DOCX、HTML、Markdown、纯文本、RTF、Calibre支持的MOBI/AZW）转换为结构化的智能体技能，提取框架、思维模型、原则、技术方法及反模式。适用于用户通过GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp、Claude Code、Hermes Agent或OpenClaw学习文档、在工作时应用作者的框架，或从文件构建可复用知识库的场景。

description: Tired of juggling 8 API keys? This skill gives you one-command access to Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, and more, with zero setup. Use when you want to generate any image without worrying about API keys.
description_zh: 厌倦了同时管理8个API密钥吗？本技能为您提供对Midjourney、Flux、Ideogram等工具的无需任何配置的一键访问，适用于您想生成任意图像且无需担心API密钥的场景。

description: Use when the user wants to use the UCP CLI to find, compare, buy, or track products from online merchants, or to set up and troubleshoot the local UCP profile required for merchant-scoped operations. Covers global catalog search ("find me X under $Y"), named-merchant transactions ("buy this from Z.com"), order tracking, `ucp profile init`, `ucp doctor`, carts, checkout, orders, and UCP setup/help. Falls back to merchant-hosted handoff when direct in-protocol checkout isn't available.
description_zh: 当用户想要使用 UCP CLI 从在线商家查找、比较、购买或追踪商品，或设置并排查用于商家范围操作的本地 UCP 配置文件时使用。涵盖全球目录搜索（“find me X under $Y”）、针对指定商家的交易（“buy this from Z.com”）、订单追踪、`ucp profile init`、`ucp doctor`、购物车、结账、订单以及 UCP 设置/帮助。当直接基于协议的结账不可用时，回退至商家托管的交接流程。

description: Google Ads campaign management - campaign setup, keyword research, bid optimization, and performance reporting
description_zh: Google Ads广告系列管理——广告系列设置、关键词研究、出价优化和绩效报告

description: Builds and customizes assistant-ui chat UI from composable, unstyled @assistant-ui/react primitives: ThreadPrimitive, ComposerPrimitive (with Unstable_TriggerPopover for mentions and slash commands), MessagePrimitive and MessagePartPrimitive, ActionBarPrimitive, BranchPickerPrimitive, AttachmentPrimitive, ErrorPrimitive, AssistantModalPrimitive, ChainOfThoughtPrimitive, SelectionToolbarPrimitive, SuggestionPrimitive, QueueItemPrimitive, and the ThreadList primitives. Use when assembling or styling a custom Thread, Composer, message list, action bar, branch picker, or suggestion grid; wiring composer input, dictation, quoting, or attachments; or handling editing, branching, virtualization, scrolling, or chain of thought UI. Covers MessagePrimitive.Parts render functions per part type, groupPartByType, AuiIf in selector form, and the unstyled gotchas (AssistantRuntimeProvider, className). For prebuilt UI use setup, for the styled catalog use elements, for multi-thread sidebars use thread-list.
description_zh: 从可组合、未样式化的 @assistant-ui/react 原语构建并定制 assistant-ui 聊天 UI：ThreadPrimitive、ComposerPrimitive（含用于提及和斜杠命令的 Unstable_TriggerPopover）、MessagePrimitive 和 MessagePartPrimitive、ActionBarPrimitive、BranchPickerPrimitive、AttachmentPrimitive、ErrorPrimitive、AssistantModalPrimitive、ChainOfThoughtPrimitive、SelectionToolbarPrimitive、SuggestionPrimitive、QueueItemPrimitive 以及 ThreadList 原语。用于组装或定制自定义的 Thread、Composer、消息列表、操作栏、分支选择器或建议网格；连接 Composer 输入、听写、引用或附件；或处理编辑、分支、虚拟化、滚动或思维链 UI。涵盖 MessagePrimitive.Parts 的各类型渲染函数、groupPartByType、以选择器形式使用的 AuiIf，以及未样式化的注意事项（AssistantRuntimeProvider、className）。对于预构建的 UI，使用 setup；对于样式目录，使用 elements；对于多线程侧边栏，使用 thread-list。

description: Hreflang and international SEO audit, validation, and generation. Detects common mistakes, validates language/region codes, and generates correct hreflang implementations. Use when user says "hreflang", "i18n SEO", "international SEO", "multi-language", "multi-region", or "language tags".
description_zh: Hreflang 与国际 SEO 审计、验证与生成。检测常见错误、验证语言/地区代码，并生成正确的 hreflang 实现。当用户提及“hreflang”、“i18n SEO”、“international SEO”、“多语言”、“多地区”或“语言标签”时使用。

description: Run an incident response workflow — triage, communicate, and write postmortem. Trigger with "we have an incident", "production is down", an alert that needs severity assessment, a status update mid-incident, or when writing a blameless postmortem after resolution.
description_zh: 运行事件响应工作流——分诊、沟通并撰写事后报告。触发条件包括“我们遇到了事件”、“生产环境宕机”、需要评估严重程度的告警、事件进行中的状态更新，或在问题解决后撰写无责事后报告时。

description: Use when the user explicitly asks for a desktop or system screenshot (full screen, specific app or window, or a pixel region), or when tool-specific capture capabilities are unavailable and an OS-level capture is needed.
description_zh: 当用户明确要求截取桌面或系统截图（全屏、特定应用程序或窗口、或像素区域），或者当工具特定的捕获功能不可用且需要操作系统级别的捕获时使用。

description: Salesforce data operations with 130-point scoring. Use this skill to create, update, delete, bulk import/export, generate test data, and clean up org records using sf CLI and anonymous Apex. TRIGGER when: user creates test data, performs bulk import/export, uses sf data CLI commands, needs data factory patterns for Apex tests, or needs to seed/clean records in a Salesforce org. DO NOT TRIGGER when: SOQL query writing only (use platform-soql-query), Apex test execution (use platform-apex-test-run), or metadata deployment (use platform-metadata-deploy).
description_zh:
具备130分评分的Salesforce数据操作。使用此技能，结合sf CLI与匿名Apex，创建、更新、删除、批量导入/导出、生成测试数据，并清理组织记录。

触发条件：当用户创建测试数据、执行批量导入/导出、使用sf数据CLI命令、需要Apex测试的数据工厂模式，或需要在Salesforce组织中填充/清理记录时。

禁止触发条件：仅编写SOQL查询（使用platform-soql-query）、执行Apex测试（使用platform-apex-test-run）或进行元数据部署（使用platform-metadata-deploy）时。

description: Create, edit, render, and snapshot browser-native implicit CAD `.implicit.js` and `.implicit.mjs` files using GLSL signed-distance fields, shader primitives, smooth booleans, TPMS fields, and direct CAD Viewer raymarch rendering. Experimental.
description_zh: 使用 GLSL 有符号距离场、着色器原语、平滑布尔、TPMS 字段和直接 CAD Viewer 光线 march 渲染，创建、编辑、渲染并快照浏览器原生隐式 CAD ``. implicit.js`` 和 ``. implicit.mjs`` 文件。实验性。

description: Complete browser automation with Playwright. Auto-detects dev servers, writes reusable test scripts, and supports screenshots, responsive checks, UX validation, login flows, link checks, and arbitrary browser automation. Use when the user wants to test a website, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform browser-based testing.
description_zh: 通过 Playwright 完成浏览器自动化。自动检测开发服务器，编写可重复使用的测试脚本，并支持截图、响应式检查、UX验证、登录流程、链接检查以及任意浏览器自动化。适用于用户需要测试网站、自动化浏览器交互、验证Web功能或进行基于浏览器的测试时。

description: Google Calendar and Outlook automation - scheduling optimization, meeting workflows, time blocking, and Slack/Sheets integration
description_zh: Google 日历与 Outlook 自动化 - 日程安排优化、会议工作流、时间块划分及 Slack/Sheets 集成

description: Use when building high-performance async Python APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic V2. Invoke to create REST endpoints, define Pydantic models, implement authentication flows, set up async SQLAlchemy database operations, add JWT authentication, build WebSocket endpoints, or generate OpenAPI documentation. Trigger terms: FastAPI, Pydantic, async Python, Python API, REST API Python, SQLAlchemy async, JWT authentication, OpenAPI, Swagger Python.
description_zh: 在 FastAPI 和 Pydantic V2 下构建高性能异步 Python API 时使用。调用以创建 REST 端点、定义 Pydantic 模型、实现认证流程、设置异步 SQLAlchemy 数据库操作、添加 JWT 认证、构建 WebSocket 端点，或生成 OpenAPI 文档。触发术语：FastAPI、Pydantic、async Python、Python API、REST API Python、SQLAlchemy async、JWT 认证、OpenAPI、Swagger Python。

description: Create polished design artifacts as self-contained HTML: UI mockups, interactive prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, app screens, mobile apps, slide decks (a.k.a. PPT / PowerPoint presentations), documents and résumés, animations, 3D objects, research reports, HTML email, diagrams, fliers, and visual explorations. Use whenever the user asks to design, mock up, prototype, wireframe, visualize, explore, or make a PPT/deck for an interface, product screen, user flow, content layout, visual artifact, or pitch/deck concept, even if they do not say "design". Also use to export a deck built with this skill to PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX) — but only decks authored here (deck-stage / this skill's slide-structured HTML), NOT arbitrary HTML, so confirm the target is such a deck first. Also use for setting up, importing, or authoring reusable design systems, UI kits, brand tokens, or component libraries. Harness-agnostic for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex Agent, and similar file-capable agents.
description_zh:
创建以 HTML 格式制作、精致且自包含的设计工件：UI 样机、交互式原型、线框图、落地页、仪表盘、应用界面、移动端应用、演示文稿（亦作 PPT / PowerPoint 演示文稿）、文档与简历、动画、3D 对象、研究报告、HTML 邮件、图表、传单及视觉探索。

每当用户要求为界面、产品界面、用户流程、内容布局、视觉工件，或演示/提案概念进行设计、制作样机、构建原型、绘制线框图、可视化、探索，或制作 PPT/演示文稿时，均应使用（本功能），即使用户未明确提及“设计”。

同时，可使用（本功能）将使用本技能制作的演示文稿导出为 PowerPoint（PPT / PPTX）格式——但仅限于使用本技能创建（此处所涉及，即 deck-stage / 本技能中采用幻灯片结构编写的 HTML），而非任意 HTML，因此，使用前需先确认目标确为上述此类演示文稿。

此外，可用于搭建、导入或编写可复用的设计系统、UI 套件、品牌令牌或组件库。

与运行环境无关，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex Agent 等具备文件操作能力的智能体。

description: Local SEO analysis covering Google Business Profile optimization, NAP consistency, citation health, review signals, local schema markup, location page quality, multi-location SEO, and industry-specific recommendations. Detects business type (brick-and-mortar, SAB, hybrid) and industry vertical. Use when user says "local SEO", "Google Business Profile", "GBP", "map pack", "local pack", "citations", "NAP consistency", "service area", or "multi-location".
description_zh: 本地SEO分析，涵盖Google Business Profile优化、NAP一致性、引用健康度、评论信号、本地Schema标记、位置页面质量、多地点SEO及行业特定建议。检测业务类型（实体店、SAB、混合型）和行业垂直领域。当用户提及“本地SEO”、“Google Business Profile”、“GBP”、“map pack”、“local pack”、“citations”、“NAP consistency”、“service area”或“multi-location”时使用。

description: Profile and explore a dataset to understand its shape, quality, and patterns. Use when encountering a new table or file, checking null rates and column distributions, spotting data quality issues like duplicates or suspicious values, or deciding which dimensions and metrics to analyze.
description_zh: 画像并探索数据集，以了解其形状、质量和模式。当遇到新的表格或文件时使用，用于检查空值率和列分布，发现数据质量问题（如重复项或可疑值），或决定分析哪些维度和指标。

description: Guide to the assistant-ui runtime system, the state and action layer behind every chat surface. Use when creating a runtime (useLocalRuntime with a ChatModelAdapter, useExternalStoreRuntime for Redux or Zustand backed stores, useRemoteThreadListRuntime, useCloudThreadListRuntime, useAssistantTransportRuntime), wiring AssistantRuntimeProvider, or reading and mutating thread, message, composer, and attachment state. Covers useAui, useAuiState, and useAuiEvent with the stable selector rule, the scope accessors (aui.thread, aui.message, aui.composer, and siblings), the AuiConfig plus AuiProvider grammar, RuntimeCapabilities, and the attachment, speech, dictation, feedback, suggestion, and history adapters. Route here for a provider error ('Cannot read property of undefined'), a removed v0.12 hook import, an infinite re-render from an object literal selector, or state not updating. For multi-thread list UI use thread-list instead; for toolkit definitions and tool call UI use tools instead.
description_zh:
助手 UI 运行时系统指南：位于每个聊天界面背后的状态与动作层

当创建运行时（使用 useLocalRuntime 配合 ChatModelAdapter、使用 useExternalStoreRuntime 处理基于 Redux 或 Zustand 的后台状态、使用 useRemoteThreadListRuntime、useCloudThreadListRuntime 或 useAssistantTransportRuntime）、配置 AssistantRuntimeProvider，或读取并修改线程、消息、输入框（composer）及附件状态时的参考文档。

涵盖 useAui、useAuiState 与 useAuiEvent，包括稳定的 selector 规则、作用域访问器（aui.thread、aui.message、aui.composer 及兄弟元素）、AuiConfig 与 AuiProvider 语法、RuntimeCapabilities，以及附件、语音、文字输入（dictation）、反馈、建议和历史适配器。

遇到提供方错误（"Cannot read property of undefined"）、已移除的 v0.12 hook 导入、来自对象字面量 selector 导致的无限重渲染，或状态未更新时，请在此查阅。

多线程列表 UI 请使用 thread-list；工具定义与工具调用 UI 请使用 tools。

description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Create custom directives in Angular v20+ for DOM manipulation and behavior extension. Use for attribute directives that modify element behavior/appearance, structural directives for portals/overlays, and host directives for composition. Triggers on creating reusable DOM behaviors, extending element functionality, or composing behaviors across components. Note - use native @if/@for/@switch for control flow, not custom structural directives.
description_zh: 已弃用 —— 该技能已停止维护。请改用官方 Angular 技能，地址为 https://github.com/angular/skills。在 Angular v20+ 中创建自定义指令，用于 DOM 操作和行为扩展。适用于修改元素行为/外观的属性指令、用于 portals/overlays 的结构指令，以及用于组合的宿主指令。适用于创建可复用 DOM 行为、扩展元素功能，或在组件之间组合行为。注意：控制流应使用原生的 @if/@for/@switch，而不是自定义结构指令。

description: YouTube thumbnail design with specific dimensions, contrast rules, and mobile preview optimization. Covers safe zones, text placement, face expression psychology, and A/B testing. Use for: YouTube thumbnails, video cover images, click-through optimization. Triggers: youtube thumbnail, thumbnail design, video thumbnail, click through rate, ctr optimization, youtube cover, video cover image, thumbnail maker, thumbnail tips, youtube design, video preview image
description_zh: YouTube缩略图设计，包含特定尺寸、对比规则以及移动端预览优化。涵盖安全区域、文字放置、面部表情心理学以及A/B测试。用途：YouTube缩略图、视频封面图片、点击率优化。触发词：YouTube缩略图、缩略图设计、视频缩略图、点击率、CTR优化、YouTube封面、视频封面图片、缩略图制作、缩略图技巧、YouTube设计、视频预览图

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, modify, or validate Salesforce Lightning pages (FlexiPages). Trigger when users mention RecordPage, AppPage, HomePage, Lightning pages, page layouts, adding components to pages, or page customization. Also use when users say things like 'create a Lightning page', 'add a component to a page', 'customize the record page', 'generate a FlexiPage', or when they're working with FlexiPage XML files and need help with components, regions, or deployment errors. Always use this skill for any FlexiPage-related work, even if they just mention 'page' in the context of Salesforce. DO NOT TRIGGER when users ask about Visualforce pages, Aura components without FlexiPage context, page layout assignments in the UI, or Lightning Web Component development that does not involve placing components on a FlexiPage.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、生成、修改或验证 Salesforce 闪电页面（FlexiPages）时，使用本技能。当用户提及 RecordPage、AppPage、HomePage、闪电页面、页面布局、向页面添加组件或页面定制时，触发本技能。当用户提及类似“创建闪电页面”、“向页面添加组件”、“定制记录页面”、“生成 FlexiPage”，或正在使用 FlexiPage XML 文件并需要帮助处理组件、区域或部署错误时，也使用本技能。只要涉及 FlexiPage 相关工作的任何情况，始终使用本技能，即使用户仅在 Salesforce 的语境中提到“页面”。当用户询问 Visualforce 页面、不涉及 FlexiPage 上下文的 Aura 组件、UI 中的页面布局分配，或未涉及在 FlexiPage 上放置组件的闪电 Web 组件开发时，不要触发本技能。

description: Search local KakaoTalk archives on Apple Silicon macOS through the katok CLI. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 katok CLI 在 Apple Silicon macOS 上搜索本地 KakaoTalk 存档。在 돌쇠 中，通过官方界面进行后续操作，直至完成。

description: Build, modify, audit, repair, optimize, debug, and deploy agents with Agentforce Agent Script. TRIGGER when: user creates, reviews, or changes .agent files or aiAuthoringBundle metadata; asks to fix AgentScript, audit an existing agent, run an AgentScript health check, common-pitfall review, or baseline-versus-candidate repair loop; changes a response, action, subagent, route, state flow, or Agent Spec; previews, debugs, deploys, publishes, or tests agents; uses sf agent generate/preview/publish/test; or manages Agentforce MCP servers, tools, assets, or authentication. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex, Flow, Prompt Template, Experience Cloud, or general Salesforce CLI work is unrelated to Agent Script; or the primary input is a production session or trace ID rather than an agent artifact.
description_zh:
使用 Agentforce Agent Script 构建、修改、审计、修复、优化、调试和部署智能体。

触发条件：用户创建、审查或修改 .agent 文件或 aiAuthoringBundle 元数据；要求修复 AgentScript、审计现有智能体、运行 AgentScript 健康检查、常见陷阱审查或基准与实际候选的修复循环；修改响应、操作、子智能体、路由、状态流程或 Agent Spec；预览、调试、部署、发布或测试智能体；使用 sf agent generate/preview/publish/test；或管理 Agentforce MCP 服务器、工具、资源或认证。

不触发条件：Apex、Flow、Prompt Template、Experience Cloud 或一般的 Salesforce CLI 工作与 Agent Script 无关；或主要输入是生产会话或 trace ID 而非智能体制品。

description: Set up, configure, and troubleshoot Salesforce Code Analyzer for any project. Handles installation, prerequisite checks, diagnosing broken setups, creating and editing code-analyzer.yml overrides, engine-specific settings, ignore patterns, severity overrides, and CI/CD pipeline setup. TRIGGER when: user says 'set up code analyzer', 'configure code analyzer', 'install code analyzer', 'code analyzer not working', 'fix my setup', 'scan failing', 'check my setup', 'enable/disable engine', 'exclude files', 'change severity', 'set up GitHub Actions', 'set up CI/CD', 'add to pipeline', 'pipeline fail', 'update my workflow', 'quality gate', 'fail on violations', 'scan changed files only', 'add SARIF', 'code-analyzer.yml', 'ESLint config', 'increase SFGE memory', or reports errors running Code Analyzer. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to run a scan (use dx-code-analyzer-run), fix violations, explain rules, create custom rules (use dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create), or suppress violations.
description_zh:
为任何项目设置、配置和排查 Salesforce Code Analyzer。支持安装、前提条件检查、诊断配置损坏问题、创建和编辑 code-analyzer.yml 覆盖配置、引擎特定设置、忽略模式、严重性覆盖以及 CI/CD 流水线配置。

触发条件：当用户说“设置代码分析器”、“配置代码分析器”、“安装代码分析器”、“代码分析器无法正常工作”、“修复我的设置”、“扫描失败”、“检查我的设置”、“启用/禁用引擎”、“排除文件”、“更改严重性”、“设置 GitHub Actions”、“设置 CI/CD”、“添加到流水线”、“流水线失败”、“更新我的工作流”、“质量门禁”、“在违规时失败”、“仅扫描已更改文件”、“添加 SARIF”、“code-analyzer.yml”、“ESLint 配置”、“增加 SFGE 内存”，或报告运行 Code Analyzer 时出现的错误时触发。

不触发条件：当用户需要运行扫描（使用 dx-code-analyzer-run）、修复违规、解释规则、创建自定义规则（使用 dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create），或抑制违规时，不触发。

description:
Vision-driven Android device automation using Midscene. Operates entirely from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels required. Can interact with all visible elements on screen regardless of technology stack. Control Android devices with natural language commands via ADB. Perform taps, swipes, text input, app launches, screenshots, and more.
Trigger keywords: android, phone, mobile app, tap, swipe, install app, open app on phone, android device, mobile automation, adb, launch app, mobile screen, test android app, verify mobile app, QA on phone, check the app on android, test on device, see if the app works on phone, end-to-end test on android, visual verification on mobile
Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)
description_zh:
基于 Midscene 的视觉驱动安卓设备自动化。完全基于截图操作——无需 DOM 或无障碍标签。无论技术栈如何，均可与屏幕上所有可见元素交互。通过 ADB 使用自然语言指令控制安卓设备。执行点击、滑动、文本输入、应用启动、截图等操作。

触发关键词：安卓、手机、移动应用、点击、滑动、安装应用、在手机上打开应用、安卓设备、移动自动化、ADB、启动应用、移动屏幕、测试安卓应用、验证移动应用、手机端QA、在安卓上检查应用、在设备上测试、查看应用在手机上是否正常运行、安卓端到端测试、移动端视觉验证

description: Expert guidance for working with Dagster and the dg CLI. ALWAYS use before doing any task that requires knowledge specific to Dagster, or that references assets, materialization, components, data tools or data pipelines. Common tasks may include creating a new project, adding new definitions, understanding the current project structure, answering general questions about the codebase (finding asset, schedule, sensor, component or job definitions), debugging issues, or providing deep information about a specific Dagster concept.
description_zh: 在 Dagster 和 dg CLI 协作方面的专家指导。在进行任何需要特定 Dagster 知识，或引用资产、物化、组件、数据工具或数据管道的任务之前，始终使用。常见任务可能包括创建新项目、添加新定义、理解当前项目结构、回答有关代码库的常见问题（查找资产、调度、传感器、组件或作业定义）、调试问题，或提供关于特定 Dagster 概念的深度信息。

description: Control the user own Chrome browser via Playwriter extension with Playwright code snippets in a stateful local js sandbox. Use this over other Playwright MCPs to automate the browser — it connects to the user's existing Chrome instead of launching a new one. Use this cli for navigating JS-heavy websites (Instagram, Twitter, cookie/login walls, lazy-loaded UIs) instead of webfetch/curl. ALWAYS load this skill before using any playwriter commands
description_zh: 通过 Playwriter 扩展，使用 Playwright 代码片段在具有状态性的本地 JS 沙箱中控制用户自己的 Chrome 浏览器。相比其他 Playwright MCP，优先使用此方式自动化浏览器——它连接用户现有的 Chrome，而非启动新的浏览器。使用此 CLI 来导航 JS 密集的网站（Instagram、Twitter、Cookie/登录墙、懒加载 UI），而非使用 webfetch/curl。在运行任何 playwriter 命令之前，始终加载此技能。

description: Deploy, manage, inspect, and troubleshoot Vercel projects from the command line. Use for Vercel deployments, Vercel Toolbar comments, build failures, projects and teams, environment variables, domains and DNS, logs, metrics, Speed Insights, Core Web Vitals, request traces, usage, activity, alerts, firewall rules, cache, cron jobs, deploy hooks, Edge Config, feature flags (`vercel flags`), integrations, connectors, Blob storage, Container Registry (VCR), microfrontends, rolling releases, custom environments, Sandbox, agent/MCP setup, preview access, local development, or `vercel api` fallback.
description_zh: 在命令行中部署、管理、检查和故障排除 Vercel 项目。适用于 Vercel 部署、Vercel 工具栏评论、构建失败、Vercel 项目与团队、环境变量、域名与 DNS、日志、指标、Speed Insights、Core Web Vitals、请求追踪、使用量、活动、告警、防火墙规则、缓存、定时任务、部署钩子、边缘配置、特性开关（`vercel flags`）、集成、连接器、Blob 存储、容器注册表 (VCR)、微前端、滚动发布、自定义环境、Sandbox、agent/MCP 设置、预览访问、本地开发或 `vercel api` 回退等场景。

description: Programmatic SEO planning and analysis for pages generated at scale from data sources. Covers template engines, URL patterns, internal linking automation, thin content safeguards, and index bloat prevention. Use when user says "programmatic SEO", "pages at scale", "dynamic pages", "template pages", "generated pages", or "data-driven SEO".
description_zh: 针对从数据源规模化生成的页面的程序化 SEO 规划与分析。涵盖模板引擎、URL 模式、内部链接自动化、内容单薄保护以及索引膨胀防控。适用于用户提及“programmatic SEO”、“pages at scale”、“dynamic pages”、“template pages”、“generated pages”或“data-driven SEO”时使用。

description: Set up and use portless for named local dev server URLs (e.g. https://myapp.localhost instead of http://localhost:3000). Use when integrating portless into a project, configuring dev server names, setting up the local proxy, working with .localhost domains, or troubleshooting port/proxy issues.
description_zh: 配置并使用 portless 为命名的本地开发服务器 URL（例如，https://myapp.localhost 代替 http://localhost:3000）。在将 portless 集成到项目中、配置开发服务器名称、设置本地代理、处理 .localhost 域名或排查端口/代理问题时使用。

description: Prevents generic AI/Codex UI patterns when generating frontend code. Use this skill whenever generating HTML, CSS, React, Vue, Svelte, or any frontend UI code to enforce clean, human-designed aesthetics inspired by Linear, Raycast, Stripe, and GitHub instead of typical AI-generated UI.
description_zh: 在生成前端代码时，防止通用的AI/Codex界面模式。每当生成HTML、CSS、React、Vue、Svelte或任何前端UI代码时，使用此技能以确保采用干净、由人工设计的美学风格，灵感源自Linear、Raycast、Stripe和GitHub，而非典型的AI生成界面。

description: Look up Daiso products by store name and product keyword using official Daiso Mall store/search/stock surfaces. Use when the user wants to know whether a product is available at a specific Daiso store. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用官方Daiso Mall的门店、搜索和库存界面，按门店名称和商品关键词查询Daiso产品。当用户想了解特定Daiso门店是否有某产品时使用。在돌쇠中，通过官方界面进行后续操作。

description: Apply SLDS-compliant UI using the correct blueprints, styling hooks, utility classes, and icons. Use when building any UI that needs SLDS, choosing between Lightning Base Components and SLDS Blueprints, applying styling hooks for theming, using utility classes for layout and spacing, or selecting icons. Triggers include "build a modal", "create a form", "data table", "SLDS styling", "style with hooks", "add an icon".
description_zh: 使用正确的蓝图、样式钩子、工具类和图标，应用符合 SLDS 要求的界面。适用于以下情况：构建任何需要 SLDS 的界面、在 Lightning 基础组件与 SLDS 蓝图之间进行选择、为主题应用样式钩子、使用工具类进行布局和间距设置、选择图标。触发条件包括“构建模态框”、“创建表单”、“数据表格”、“SLDS 样式”、“使用钩子进行样式设置”、“添加图标”。

description: Help with MongoDB query optimization and indexing. Use only when the user asks for optimization or performance: "How do I optimize this query?", "How do I index this?", "Why is this query slow?", "Can you fix my slow queries?", "What are the slow queries on my cluster?", etc. Do not invoke for general MongoDB query writing unless user asks for performance or index help. Prefer indexing as optimization strategy. Use MongoDB MCP when available.
description_zh: 提供 MongoDB 查询优化和索引方面的帮助。仅在用户询问优化或性能问题时使用：“如何优化这个查询？”、“如何为这个建立索引？”、“为什么这个查询很慢？”、“你能修复我的慢查询吗？”、“我的集群中有哪些慢查询？”等。除非用户询问性能或索引帮助，否则不要为一般的 MongoDB 查询编写而触发调用。优先将索引作为优化策略。在可用时使用 MongoDB MCP。

description: Audit Lightning Web Components for SLDS design-system compliance and produce a scored quality report. Runs the SLDS linter and analyzes CSS for theming hook usage and pairing, scoring SLDS findings across categories into an overall grade. Use when asked to "score my component's SLDS", "SLDS scorecard", "SLDS quality report", "audit SLDS compliance", "how good is my SLDS", "check SLDS quality", "rate my SLDS styling", "evaluate my component's SLDS", "is this component's SLDS ready to ship?", "look at my LWC for SLDS issues", "audit SLDS before I submit", "review my component's SLDS before code review", or any time a user wants an SLDS quality assessment or SLDS production-readiness check on an LWC. Not for fixing violations (use design-systems-slds2-migrate), building new components (use design-systems-slds-apply), or accessibility/WCAG/ARIA audits (use experience-accessibility-validate).
description_zh:
审计 Lightning Web Components 是否符合 SLDS 设计系统合规性要求，并生成带分的质量报告。运行 SLDS linter，分析 CSS 中的主题钩子使用与配对情况，将 SLDS 检查结果按类别进行评分，形成综合评级。

当用户请求以下内容时使用：
- “为我组件的 SLDS 评分”
- “SLDS 评分卡”
- “SLDS 质量报告”
- “审计 SLDS 合规性”
- “我的 SLDS 有多好”
- “检查 SLDS 质量”
- “为我的 SLDS 样式评分”
- “评估我组件的 SLDS”
- “这个组件的 SLDS 是否准备好上线？”
- “查看我的 LWC 中的 SLDS 问题”
- “在我提交前审计 SLDS”
- “代码评审前审查我组件的 SLDS”
以及用户任何时候需要对 LWC 进行 SLDS 质量评估或 SLDS 生产就绪检查时。

不适用于以下情况：
- 修复违规（使用 design-systems-slds2-migrate）
- 创建新组件（使用 design-systems-slds-apply）
- 进行无障碍性/WCAG/ARIA 审计（使用 experience-accessibility-validate）

description: Still-to-video conversion guide: model selection, motion prompting, and camera movement. Covers Wan 2.5 i2v, Seedance, Fabric, Grok Video with when to use each. Use for: animating images, creating video from stills, adding motion, product animations. Triggers: image to video, i2v, animate image, still to video, add motion to image, image animation, photo to video, animate still, wan i2v, image2video, bring image to life, animate photo, motion from image
description_zh: 静态转视频转换指南：模型选择、运动提示与镜头运动。涵盖 Wan 2.5 i2v、Seedance、Fabric、Grok Video 及其适用场景。用于：图像动画、由静帧生成视频、添加动态效果、产品动画。触发词：图像转视频、i2v、动画图像、静态转视频、为图像添加动态效果、图像动画、照片转视频、静态图动画、Wan i2v、image2video、使图像活起来、照片动画、从图像获取动态

description: Write readable, maintainable code through disciplined naming, small functions, and clean error handling. Use when the user mentions "clean up this code", "this function is too long", "code smells", "naming conventions", "boy scout rule", "single responsibility", or "unit test quality". Also trigger when reviewing a pull request for readability, untangling a messy function, debating comment styles, or improving error-handling patterns. Covers SRP, comment discipline, formatting, and unit testing. For refactoring techniques, see refactoring-patterns. For architecture and dependency rules, see clean-architecture.
description_zh: 通过规范的命名、小型函数和清晰的错误处理，编写可读、可维护的代码。当用户提到“clean up this code”“this function is too long”“code smells”“naming conventions”“boy scout rule”“single responsibility”或“unit test quality”时，使用。在评审 Pull Request 以提高可读性、拆解混乱的函数、讨论注释风格或改进错误处理模式时，也应触发。涵盖单一职责原则、注释规范、格式化和单元测试。关于重构技术，参见 refactoring-patterns。关于架构和依赖规则，参见 clean-architecture。

description: Use this skill when users need to create or configure Salesforce Custom Tabs. Trigger when users mention tabs, navigation tabs, object tabs, web tabs, Visualforce tabs, Lightning component tabs, app page tabs, or tab configuration. Also use when users want to add navigation to custom objects, create tabs for external content, or set up Lightning page tabs. Always use this skill for any custom tab work.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建或配置 Salesforce 自定义标签时，请使用此技能。当用户提及标签、导航标签、对象标签、网页标签、Visualforce 标签、Lightning 组件标签、应用页面标签或标签配置时，请触发此技能。此外，当用户希望为自定义对象添加导航、为外部内容创建标签或设置 Lightning 页面标签时，也请使用此技能。对于任何自定义标签工作，请始终使用此技能。

description: Use when building game systems, implementing Unity/Unreal Engine features, or optimizing game performance. Invoke to implement ECS architecture, configure physics systems and colliders, set up multiplayer networking with lag compensation, optimize frame rates to 60+ FPS targets, develop shaders, or apply game design patterns such as object pooling and state machines. Trigger keywords: Unity, Unreal Engine, game development, ECS architecture, game physics, multiplayer networking, game optimization, shader programming, game AI.
description_zh: 用于构建游戏系统、实现 Unity/Unreal Engine 功能或优化游戏性能时。调用以实现 ECS 架构、配置物理系统和碰撞体、搭建支持延迟补偿的多人网络、将帧率优化至 60+ FPS 目标、开发着色器，或应用对象池和状态机等游戏设计模式。触发关键词：Unity、Unreal Engine、游戏开发、ECS 架构、游戏物理、多人网络、游戏优化、着色器编程、游戏 AI。

description: Hunts for the other instances of a bug already found — the variants of one root cause across a codebase. Use immediately after a vulnerability, logic bug, or bad pattern turns up in a specific file and the question becomes where else it occurs, including the bare conversational form ("are there others like this?", "is this the same bug?"). Also for generalizing one known instance into a CodeQL or Semgrep query for its whole pattern family, and for triaging a set of look-alike candidates against a known root cause. Not for initial discovery with no bug in hand.
description_zh: 用于搜索已发现的 Bug 的其他实例——跨代码库的同一根因的各类变体。当漏洞、逻辑缺陷或不良模式在特定文件中被发现，且问题变为其是否还会出现在其他地方时，立即使用，包括日常对话形式（“这类问题还有其他的吗？”“这是同一个 Bug 吗？”）。此外，用于将一个已知实例泛化为针对其整个模式族的 CodeQL 或 Semgrep 查询，以及根据已知根因对一组相似候选进行分诊筛选。不适用于在没有具体 Bug 的情况下进行初步发现。

description: Grades agent skills by scoring agent conversations for efficiency, code quality, procedure compliance, and verbosity, then drafts concrete skill edits and a shareable report. Use when the user wants their agent setup graded from real conversation history, or asks which of their installed skills are actually working.
description_zh: 通过针对智能体对话在效率、代码质量、流程合规性及冗长度方面的评分来评定智能体技能，随后生成具体的技能修改建议与可分享的报告。当用户想要依据真实的对话历史对其智能体配置进行评分，或询问已安装的哪些技能实际有效时，可使用此功能。

description: Structured debugging session — reproduce, isolate, diagnose, and fix. Trigger with an error message or stack trace, "this works in staging but not prod", "something broke after the deploy", or when behavior diverges from expected and the cause isn't obvious.
description_zh: 结构化调试会话——复现、隔离、诊断与修复。当出现错误信息或堆栈跟踪，出现“在预发布环境（staging）中可以运行，但在生产环境（prod）中不行”、“部署后出现了异常情况”，或行为与预期不符且原因不明显时，即可触发。

description: Landing page conversion optimization with layout rules, hero section design, and CTA psychology. Covers above-the-fold formula, social proof placement, mobile design, and F-pattern reading. Use for: startup landing pages, product pages, SaaS marketing, conversion optimization. Triggers: landing page, hero section, above the fold, conversion optimization, landing page design, cta button, hero image, landing page layout, saas landing page, product page design, conversion rate, landing page best practices
description_zh: 基于布局规则、首屏设计与行动号召（CTA）心理的落地页转化优化。涵盖首屏视觉公式、社会证明（Social Proof）的布局、移动端设计以及F型阅读习惯。适用于：初创公司落地页、产品页面、SaaS营销与转化优化。触发词：落地页、首屏、首屏上方、转化优化、落地页设计、行动号召按钮、首屏图片、落地页布局、SaaS落地页、产品页面设计、转化率、落地页最佳实践。

description: AI product photography with studio lighting, lifestyle shots, and packshot conventions. Covers angles, backgrounds, shadow types, hero shots, and e-commerce image requirements. Use for: product photos, e-commerce images, Amazon listings, packshots, lifestyle photography. Triggers: product photography, product photo, packshot, e-commerce photography, product shot, product image, studio photography, lifestyle product, amazon product photo, product listing image, hero shot, product mockup, commercial photography
description_zh: AI产品摄影，包含影棚灯光、生活方式拍摄与产品套图规范。涵盖角度、背景、光影类型、主图及电商图片要求。用途：产品照片、电商图片、亚马逊商品listing、产品套图、生活方式摄影。触发词：产品摄影、产品照片、产品套图、电商摄影、产品拍摄、产品图片、影棚摄影、生活方式产品、亚马逊产品照片、产品listing图片、主图、产品模型、商业摄影

description: Execute and manage Athena SQL queries across default and federated catalogs (Glue, S3 Tables, Redshift). Triggers on phrases like: query data, run SQL, athena query, analyze table, SQL query, workgroup status, profile table, query Redshift catalog, query S3 Tables. Do NOT use for finding specific data assets (use finding-data-lake-assets), full catalog audits (use exploring-data-catalog), importing data (use ingesting-into-data-lake).
description_zh: 执行并管理 Athena 在默认目录及联邦目录（Glue、S3 Tables、Redshift）中的 SQL 查询。触发条件包括短语，如：查询数据、运行 SQL、Athena 查询、分析表、SQL 查询、工作区状态、配置文件表、查询 Redshift 目录、查询 S3 Tables。请勿用于查找特定数据资产（使用 finding-data-lake-assets）、全面目录审计（使用 exploring-data-catalog）、导入数据（使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）。

description: Declared architecture snapshot for one Agentforce agent: planner, topics, actions, flows, Apex, prompt templates, and NGA plugins. Renders a human-readable architecture document and Mermaid invocation graph from design-time metadata (not runtime audit rows). TRIGGER when user asks to describe, diagram, inventory, audit, document, or diff (e.g. v3 vs v5) the architecture / action tree / topic structure / tool inventory of a specific agent by agent API name in a specific org. DO NOT TRIGGER for runtime session traces, conversation transcripts, generation timings, or gateway audit chains — this skill reads design-time metadata only (use agentforce-d360-analyze for session traces).
description_zh: 单个 Agentforce Agent 的声明式架构快照：规划器、主题、操作、流程、Apex、提示词模板和 NGA 插件。基于设计时元数据（而非运行时审计行）渲染人类可读的架构文档与 Mermaid 调用图。当用户按特定组织的 Agent API 名称，针对特定 Agent 要求描述、绘图、盘点、审计、文档化或对比（例如 v3 与 v5）其架构/操作树/主题结构/工具盘点时触发。不得针对运行时会话跟踪、对话记录、生成时间或网关审计链路触发——本技能仅读取设计时元数据（会话跟踪请使用 agentforce-d360-analyze）。

description: Full inventory and audit of AWS Glue Data Catalog assets across S3 Tables, Redshift-federated, and remote Iceberg catalogs. Triggers on: inventory the catalog, audit databases, list all tables, catalog overview, data landscape, enumerate catalogs, data inventory, search the catalog. Do NOT use for finding specific data (use finding-data-lake-assets), running queries (use querying-data-lake), or creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table).
description_zh: 对 AWS Glue Data Catalog 资产的全面盘点与审计，覆盖 S3 Tables、Redshift 联邦及远程 Iceberg 目录。触发条件：盘点目录、数据库审计、列出所有表、目录概览、数据布局、枚举目录、数据盘点、搜索目录。禁止用于查找特定数据（请使用 finding-data-lake-assets）、执行查询（请使用 querying-data-lake）、或创建表（请使用 creating-data-lake-table）。

description: This skill should be used when code search is needed (whether explicitly requested or as part of completing a task), when indexing the codebase after changes, or when the user asks about ccc, cocoindex-code, or the codebase index. Trigger phrases include 'search the codebase', 'find code related to', 'update the index', 'ccc', 'cocoindex-code'.
description_zh: 该技能应在需要代码搜索时使用（无论是明确请求，还是作为完成某项任务的一部分），在修改后对代码库进行索引时，以及当用户询问 ccc、cocoindex-code 或代码库索引时。触发短语包括“在代码库中搜索”、“查找与……相关的代码”、“更新索引”、“ccc”、“cocoindex-code”。

description: Builds and customizes multiple conversation lists in assistant-ui with the runtime connected ThreadList and ThreadListSidebar elements, ThreadListPrimitive, ThreadListItemPrimitive, ThreadListItemMorePrimitive, useAui, useAuiState, and threads.selectionChanged. Use when adding a conversation sidebar, switching, archiving, renaming, deleting, searching, grouping, paginating, or persisting threads, or when thread state is stale after authentication. Covers AssistantCloud, RemoteThreadListRuntime, and ExternalStoreThreadListAdapter. Use runtime for the active conversation runtime, cloud for managed authentication and persistence, and elements for registry installation and styling.
description_zh: 在 assistant-ui 中，使用与运行时（runtime）连接相联的 ThreadList 和 ThreadListSidebar 元素，以及 ThreadListPrimitive、ThreadListItemPrimitive、ThreadListItemMorePrimitive、useAui、useAuiState 和 threads.selectionChanged，构建并定制多个会话列表。适用于添加会话侧边栏、切换、归档、重命名、删除、搜索、分组、分页或持久化线程的场景，或在认证后线程状态过期时使用。覆盖 AssistantCloud、RemoteThreadListRuntime 以及 ExternalStoreThreadListAdapter。其中，runtime 用于管理当前活动的会话运行时，cloud 用于管理式认证与持久化，elements 用于注册安装与样式设置。

description: Use this skill when users need to create or configure tab-based Salesforce Custom Applications with navigation, branding, and action overrides. Trigger when users mention custom apps, application metadata, app navigation, or organizing tabs into applications. Use when users want to create app containers for tabs and pages. Do NOT use when the goal is hosting a React UI bundle in the App Launcher — use experience-ui-bundle-custom-app-generate for that case.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建或配置包含导航、品牌标识和动作覆盖功能的基于标签的 Salesforce 自定义应用时，使用此技能。当用户提及自定义应用、应用元数据、应用导航，或将标签组织成应用时，触发此技能。当用户想要为标签和页面创建应用容器时，使用此技能。当目标是在 App Launcher 中托管 React UI 包时，请勿使用此技能——应使用 experience-ui-bundle-custom-app-generate 处理该情况。

description: Use for TSX components, UI libraries, styling, state locality, layout, render performance and memoization.
description_zh: 适用于 TSX 组件、UI 库、样式、状态局部性、布局、渲染性能和记忆化。

description: Store and query vector embeddings using Amazon S3 Vectors, a cost-effective long-term vector storage service with its own API namespace (s3vectors). Triggers on: create S3 vector bucket, vector index, store embeddings, semantic search, RAG vector storage, similarity search, vector database, migrate from other vector databases. Do NOT use for: querying tabular data (use querying-data-lake), S3 object storage, or hundreds/thousands of sustained QPS (use OpenSearch).
description_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 Vectors 存储和查询向量嵌入，该服务是一种拥有自身 API 命名空间（s3vectors）的经济实惠的长期向量存储服务。触发场景：创建 S3 向量桶、建立向量索引、存储嵌入向量、语义搜索、RAG 向量存储、相似度搜索、向量数据库、从其他向量数据库迁移。请勿用于：查询表格数据（使用 querying-data-lake）、S3 对象存储，或数百/数千的持续 QPS（使用 OpenSearch）。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "package an MCP server", "bundle an MCP", "make an MCPB", "ship a local MCP server", "distribute a local MCP", discusses ".mcpb files", mentions bundling a Node or Python runtime with their MCP server, or needs an MCP server that interacts with the local filesystem, desktop apps, or OS and must be installable without the user having Node/Python set up.

description_zh:
当用户需要创建、编写、撰写或设计新的 Agent Skill（即 SKILL.md），用于 OpenKnowledge 或其编辑人员，并包含诸如“帮助我编写一个 Skill”、“制作一个……的 Skill”、“将此工作流转化为一个 Skill”或改进现有 Skill 的触发条件与规范等请求时使用。

description: Creates and manages secrets in AWS Secrets Manager following security best practices. Always use this skill when creating secrets — it sets up dedicated KMS encryption keys, automatic rotation, least-privilege IAM policies, CloudTrail auditing, and lifecycle management that are essential for production-grade secret handling.

description: Download YouTube videos with customizable quality and format options. Use this skill when the user asks to download, save, or grab YouTube videos. Supports various quality settings (best, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p), multiple formats (mp4, webm, mkv), and audio-only downloads as MP3.
description_zh: 支持可自定义画质和格式选项的 YouTube 视频下载。当用户要求下载、保存或获取 YouTube 视频时，请使用此技能。支持多种画质设置（最佳、1080p、720p、480p、360p）、多种格式（mp4、webm、mkv），以及以 MP3 格式进行的纯音频下载。

description: Product Hunt launch optimization with specific specs, timing, and gallery strategy. Covers taglines, gallery images, maker comments, and launch day tactics. Use for: product launches, startup launches, side project launches, Product Hunt optimization. Triggers: product hunt, ph launch, product hunt launch, launch strategy, product launch, startup launch, product hunt tips, product hunt gallery, ph optimization, launch day, product hunt maker
