description: English LaTeX assistant for existing .tex journal or conference papers. Use for compile repair, venue formatting, bibliography/citation checks, section writing, logic, related work, tables, pseudocode, de-AI polish, claim-forward (self-weakening) fixes, translation, adaptation, and submission readiness; use latex-thesis-zh for Chinese theses and paper-audit for critique.
description_zh: 现有 .tex 期刊或会议论文的英语 LaTeX 助手。用于编译修复、会议/期刊格式排版、参考文献与引用核对、章节撰写、逻辑检查、相关工作、表格、伪代码、去 AI 痕迹润色、论点前置（自我弱化）修正、翻译、适配及投稿就绪；中文论文请使用 latex-thesis-zh，批评与评审请使用 paper-audit。

description: Video ad creation with exact platform-specific specs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn. Covers dimensions, duration limits, AIDA framework, and caption requirements. Use for: video ads, social media ads, paid media creative, video marketing, ad production. Triggers: video ad, social media ad, tiktok ad, instagram ad, youtube ad, facebook ad, linkedin ad, video creative, ad specs, paid media, video marketing, ad production, reels ad, stories ad, pre roll, bumper ad
description_zh:
针对TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook、LinkedIn平台，提供精确的、平台特定的视频广告创作规格。涵盖尺寸、时长限制、AIDA广告框架及字幕要求。

适用于：视频广告、社交媒体广告、付费媒体创意、视频营销、广告制作。

触发词：视频广告、社交媒体广告、TikTok广告、Instagram广告、YouTube广告、Facebook广告、LinkedIn广告、视频创意、广告规格、付费媒体、视频营销、广告制作、Reels广告、Stories广告、前贴片、前奏广告。

description: Use this skill when users need to create Custom Lightning Types (CLTs) for Einstein Agent actions or structured input/output schemas. Trigger when users mention CLT, Custom Lightning Types, JSON schemas for agents, type definitions, lightning__objectType, or editor/renderer configurations. For widget renditions that combine a CLT with a Widget bundle, use the platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate orchestrator instead. This is complex - always use this skill for CLT work.
description_zh: 当用户需要为爱因斯坦智能体的动作或结构化输入/输出模式创建自定义闪电类型（CLT）时，请使用此技能。当用户提及 CLT、自定义闪电类型、智能体 JSON 模式、类型定义、lightning__objectType 或编辑器/渲染器配置时，请触发此技能。对于将 CLT 与控件包结合使用的控件呈现，请改用 platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate orchestrator。此任务较为复杂——对于 CLT 工作，请务必使用此技能。

description: Analyze production Agentforce agent behavior using session traces and Data Cloud, and manage Agent Health Monitoring (AHM) alerts. TRIGGER when: user queries STDM session data or Data Cloud trace records; investigates production agent failures, regressions, or performance issues; asks about session traces, conversation logs, or agent metrics; wants to reproduce a reported production issue in preview; runs findSessions or trace analysis queries; creates, lists, updates, or deletes an AHM data alert on an agent metric (escalation rate, deflection, etc.); asks why an alert is not firing or wants to check whether alerts have fired (notification counts, or the per-alert Incidents view). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user creates, modifies, or debugs .agent files during development (use agentforce-generate); writes or runs test specs (use agentforce-test); uses sf agent preview for local development iteration; deploys or publishes agents.
description_zh:
分析生产环境 Agentforce Agent 行为，使用会话追踪和 Data Cloud，并管理 Agent 健康监测（AHM）告警。

触发条件：
用户查询 STDM 会话数据或 Data Cloud 追踪记录；
调查生产 Agent 故障、回归问题或性能问题；
询问会话追踪、对话日志或 Agent 指标；
希望在预览环境中复现已报告的生产问题；
运行 findSessions 或追踪分析查询；
对 Agent 指标（升级率、转移率等）创建、列出、更新或删除 AHM 数据告警；
询问为何告警未触发，或想检查告警是否已触发（通知数量，或按告警的 Incidents 视图）。

不触发条件：
用户在开发过程中创建、修改或调试 .agent 文件（使用 agentforce-generate）；
编写或运行测试规范（使用 agentforce-test）；
使用 sf agent preview 进行本地开发迭代；
部署或发布 Agent。

description: Search and analyze academic literature. Find papers, understand research methodologies, and synthesize academic findings for research projects.
description_zh: 检索与分析学术文献。查找论文，理解研究方法，并将学术成果综合应用于研究项目。

description: Write, run, and analyze structured test suites for Agentforce agents — functional AND security. TRIGGER when: user writes or modifies test spec YAML (AiEvaluationDefinition); runs sf agent test create, run, run-eval, or results commands; asks about test coverage strategy, metric selection, or custom evaluations; interprets test results or diagnoses test failures; asks about batch testing, regression suites, or CI/CD test integration; requests security testing, OWASP LLM Top 10, red-teaming, penetration testing, prompt-injection tests, a security grade, or a vulnerability assessment of an agent. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user creates, modifies, previews, or debugs .agent files (use agentforce-generate); deploys or publishes agents; writes Agent Script code; uses sf agent preview for development iteration; analyzes production session traces (use agentforce-observe); performs a static safety review of .agent file content (use agentforce-generate Section 15).
description_zh: 编写、运行和分析针对 Agentforce 智能体的结构化测试套件——兼顾功能性与安全性。触发条件：用户编写或修改测试规范 YAML（AiEvaluationDefinition）；运行 sf agent test create、run、run-eval 或 results 命令；询问测试覆盖率策略、指标选择或自定义评估；解读测试结果或诊断测试失败；询问批量测试、回归测试套件或 CI/CD 测试集成；请求安全测试、OWASP LLM Top 10、红队测试、渗透测试、提示词注入测试、安全等级或智能体漏洞评估。请勿触发：用户创建、修改、预览或调试 .agent 文件（使用 agentforce-generate）；部署或发布智能体；编写 Agent Script 代码；使用 sf agent preview 进行开发迭代；分析生产会话轨迹（使用 agentforce-observe）；对 .agent 文件内容进行静态安全审查（使用 agentforce-generate 第 15 节）。

description: Character consistency across AI-generated images with reference sheets and LoRA techniques. Covers turnaround views, expression sheets, color palettes, and style consistency tricks. Use for: character design, game art, illustration, animation, comics, visual novels. Triggers: character design, character sheet, character consistency, character reference, turnaround sheet, expression sheet, character art, consistent character, character concept, reference sheet, character creation, oc design, character bible
description_zh: 结合参考图与LoRA技术，在AI生成图像中实现角色一致性。涵盖转身视角、表情设定图、色彩方案以及风格一致性技巧。适用于：角色设计、游戏美术、插画、动画、漫画、视觉小说。触发词：角色设计、角色设定表、角色一致性、角色参考、转身设定表、表情设定表、角色美术、一致性角色、角色概念、参考图、角色创建、OC设计、角色圣经

description: Define the structural layer of a product or site before visual design begins. Covers navigation, content hierarchy, page structure, URL patterns, and user flows. Use when user wants to plan site structure, define navigation, map user flows, organize content, or mentions "IA" or "information architecture".
description_zh: 在产品或网站的视觉设计开始之前，定义其结构层。涵盖导航、内容层级、页面结构、URL 模式与用户流程。当用户需要规划网站结构、定义导航、规划用户流程、组织内容，或提及“IA”或“信息架构”时使用。

description: Telegram bot development - chatbots, notifications, AI assistants, and group automation
description_zh: Telegram 机器人开发 - 聊天机器人、通知、AI 助手与群组自动化

description: Import data into the AWS data lake from S3 files, local uploads, JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS, Aurora), Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, DynamoDB, or existing Glue catalog tables (migration). Default target is S3 Tables; standard Iceberg on a general purpose bucket is supported where S3 Tables is not adopted. Handles one-time loads, recurring pipelines, migrations. Triggers on: import data, load data, ingest, sync database, migrate table, move data to AWS, set up pipeline, ETL, pull from Snowflake, query BigQuery into S3, export DynamoDB, CTAS, convert to Iceberg. Do NOT use for setting up or troubleshooting Glue connections (use connecting-to-data-source), creating empty tables (use creating-data-lake-table), running queries (use querying-data-lake), finding tables by fuzzy name (use finding-data-lake-assets), catalog audit (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka.
description_zh: 将数据从 S3 文件、本地上传、JDBC 数据库（Oracle、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、RDS、Aurora）、Amazon Redshift、Snowflake、BigQuery、DynamoDB 或现有 Glue 目录表（迁移）导入至 AWS 数据湖。默认目标为 S3 表；若未采用 S3 表，则支持在通用存储桶上启用标准 Iceberg。支持一次性加载、定期管道作业及迁移。触发事件：导入数据、加载数据、数据摄取、同步数据库、迁移表、将数据移至 AWS、设置管道、ETL、从 Snowflake 拉取数据、将 BigQuery 查询导入 S3、导出 DynamoDB、CTAS、转换为 Iceberg。不得用于设置或排查 Glue 连接（请使用 connecting-to-data-source）、创建空表（请使用 creating-data-lake-table）、运行查询（请使用 querying-data-lake）、按模糊名称查找表（请使用 finding-data-lake-assets）、目录审计（请使用 exploring-data-catalog），以及用于 Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、MongoDB、Kafka 等 SaaS 平台。

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, or validate Salesforce List View metadata. Trigger when users mention list views, filtered record lists, creating views, setting up record columns, filtering records by criteria, or ask about list view visibility. Also use when users say things like "I need a view that shows...", "filter records by...", "create a list view for...", or when they're working with ListView XML files and need validation or troubleshooting.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 列表视图元数据时，请使用此技能。当用户提及列表视图、过滤后的记录列表、创建视图、设置记录列、根据条件过滤记录，或询问列表视图可见性时，应触发此技能。当用户说类似“我需要一个展示……的视图”、“根据……过滤记录”、“为……创建列表视图”，或与 ListView XML 文件配合工作并需要验证或故障排查时，也请使用此技能。

description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard
description_zh: 影视分镜与分镜头脚本，包含镜头词汇、连续性规则与分格布局。涵盖镜头类型、摄像机角度、镜头运动、180度规则与标注格式。用途：视频策划、影视前期制作、广告分镜、音乐视频策划、动画。触发词：分镜、分镜头、镜头清单、影视策划、视频策划、前期制作、镜头构图、摄像机角度、场景策划、视觉脚本、动画样片、分镜画面、视频分镜

description: Submit or update a Wall of Apps entry in the App-Store-Connect-CLI repository using `asc apps wall submit`. Use when the user says "submit to wall of apps", "add my app to the wall", or "wall-of-apps".
description_zh: 提交或更新 App-Store-Connect-CLI 仓库中的应用展示墙（Wall of Apps）条目，使用 `asc apps wall submit`。当用户说“提交到应用展示墙”、“将我的应用添加到展示墙”或“应用展示墙”时使用。

description: Create managed Iceberg tables using Amazon S3 Tables (s3tables API namespace) with automatic compaction and snapshot management. Sets up table bucket, namespace, table, schema, Glue catalog registration, partitioning, IAM access control. Triggers on: create table, data lake table, analytics table, structured data storage, S3 Tables, Iceberg, Athena table, partitioning strategy, access permissions. Do NOT use  for: importing files (use ingesting-into-data-lake), vector storage (use storing-and-querying-vectors), querying existing tables (use querying-data-lake), or locating existing table (use finding-data-lake-assets).
description_zh:
使用 Amazon S3 Tables（s3tables API 命名空间）创建受管理的 Iceberg 表，并具备自动压缩与快照管理功能。  
设置表桶、命名空间、表、模式、Glue 目录注册、分区以及 IAM 访问控制。  
触发条件：创建表、数据湖表、分析表、结构化数据存储、S3 Tables、Iceberg、Athena 表、分区策略、访问权限。  
请勿使用（空缺）进行：导入文件（使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）、存储和查询向量（使用 storing-and-querying-vectors）、查询现有表（使用 querying-data-lake）、或定位现有表（使用 finding-data-lake-assets）。

description: Generate a design tokens file (CSS variables or Tailwind config) based on a chosen aesthetic philosophy, with light and dark mode palettes, spacing scale, type ramp, and component-level tokens. Use when starting a new project, establishing a visual system, setting up tokens, or mentions "tokens" or "design system".
description_zh: 根据所选美学理念生成设计令牌文件（CSS 变量或 Tailwind 配置），包含浅色和深色模式调色板、间距比例、字体阶梯及组件级令牌。当启动新项目、建立视觉系统、设置令牌或提及“令牌”或“设计系统”时使用。

description: Answer data questions -- from quick lookups to full analyses. Use when looking up a single metric, investigating what's driving a trend or drop, comparing segments over time, or preparing a formal data report for stakeholders.
description_zh: 回答数据问题——从快速查询到全面分析。适用于查询单个指标、探究趋势或下滑的原因、对比不同时间段的细分群组，或为利益相关者准备正式数据报告。

description: Expert Django backend development guidance. Use when creating Django models, views, serializers, or APIs; debugging ORM queries or migrations; optimizing database performance; implementing authentication; writing tests; or working with Django REST Framework. Follows Django best practices and modern patterns.
description_zh: 专家级Django后端开发指南。适用于创建Django模型、视图、序列化器或API；调试ORM查询或迁移；优化数据库性能；实现身份认证；编写测试；或使用Django REST框架。遵循Django最佳实践和现代模式。

description: Create, edit, and manipulate Word documents programmatically using python-docx
description_zh: 使用 python-docx 以编程方式创建、编辑和操作 Word 文档

description: 에어코리아 기반 미세먼지/초미세먼지를 지역명 또는 위치 힌트로 조회한다. 기본 경로는 k-skill-proxy의 report endpoint다.
description_zh: 通过地名或位置提示查询基于Air Korea的细颗粒物/超细颗粒物。基本路径为k-skill-proxy的report端点。

description: Resolve data lake and lakehouse asset references across Glue Data Catalog, S3, S3 Tables, and Redshift. Triggers on: find the table, where is our data, which table has, locate dataset, find data for, search catalog, what tables match, Redshift table, lakehouse table, data lake table, warehouse table, reverse lookup S3 path. Do NOT use for: full catalog audits (use exploring-data-catalog), running queries (use querying-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table).
description_zh: 跨 Glue Data Catalog、S3、S3 Tables 和 Redshift 解决数据湖与湖仓资产引用。触发条件：查找表、我们的数据在哪里、哪个表包含、定位数据集、查找所需数据、搜索目录、哪些表匹配、Redshift 表、湖仓表、数据湖表、仓库表、反向查找 S3 路径。请勿用于：全面目录审计（使用 exploring-data-catalog）、执行查询（使用 querying-data-lake）、创建表（使用 creating-data-lake-table）。

description: Use this skill when users need to get, create, edit, delete, or manage Salesforce Sharing Rules metadata. TRIGGER when: users mention sharing rules, record sharing, criteria-based sharing, role-based sharing, guest user sharing, sharingRules, sharingCriteriaRules, sharingGuestRules, sharingOwnerRules, .sharingRules-meta.xml files, or ask to share records with specific roles or groups. Also trigger when users want to retrieve or view existing sharing rules from an org, modify or remove existing sharing rules, or update sharing rule criteria or access levels. DO NOT TRIGGER when user needs permission sets or profiles (use platform-permission-set-generate), or needs object-level security rather than record-level sharing (use platform-permission-set-generate).
description_zh:
当用户需要获取、创建、编辑、删除或管理 Salesforce 共享规则元数据时，请使用此技能。

触发条件：用户提及共享规则、记录共享、基于条件的共享、基于角色的共享、访客用户共享、sharingRules、sharingCriteriaRules、sharingGuestRules、sharingOwnerRules、.sharingRules-meta.xml 文件，或要求与特定角色或组共享记录。此外，当用户希望从组织（org）中检索或查看现有共享规则、修改或删除现有共享规则、或更新共享规则条件或访问级别时，也需触发。

不触发条件：当用户需要权限集或配置文件（使用 platform-permission-set-generate），或需要对象级安全而非记录级共享（使用 platform-permission-set-generate）时，请勿触发。

description: Search Korean statutes, articles, precedents, interpretations, and local ordinances via k-skill-proxy. Use when the user asks for Korean law/article/precedent lookups.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 检索韩国法律、条款、判例、解释和地方法规。当用户询问韩国法律、条款或判例查询时使用。

description: Installs and configures assistant-ui with the `assistant-ui` CLI (`create`, `init`, `add`, `update`, `upgrade`, `codemod`, `doctor`, `info`, `mcp`, `agent`) and picks the runtime adapter for a backend. Use for first-time install (`npx assistant-ui@latest create`, templates, `--example` scaffolds), adding to an existing Next.js app (`init`), or keeping an install current. Covers the runtime hook per backend: `useChatRuntime` (AI SDK v7), `useLangGraphRuntime`, `useStreamRuntime` (LangChain), `useAdkRuntime`, `useA2ARuntime`, `useAgUiRuntime`, `useEveAgentRuntime`, `useOpenCodeRuntime`, `useLocalRuntime`, `useExternalStoreRuntime`, `useDataStreamRuntime`, and `useAssistantTransportRuntime`, plus wiring guides for Mastra, Cloudflare Agents, Claude Managed Agents, LLM gateways, and Electron, the Expo (`--native`) and React Ink (`--ink`) scaffolds, and the hosted MCP docs server. Once a runtime exists, use elements for the styled Thread, runtime for hooks and adapters, and update for a deep migration.
description_zh: 使用 `assistant-ui` CLI（`create`、`init`、`add`、`update`、`upgrade`、`codemod`、`doctor`、`info`、`mcp`、`agent`）安装和配置 assistant-ui，并为后端选择运行时适配器。可用于首次安装（`npx assistant-ui@latest create`，模板，`--example` 脚手架）、添加到现有 Next.js 应用中（`init`）或保持安装最新。涵盖每种后端的运行时钩子：`useChatRuntime`（AI SDK v7）、`useLangGraphRuntime`、`useStreamRuntime`（LangChain）、`useAdkRuntime`、`useA2ARuntime`、`useAgUiRuntime`、`useEveAgentRuntime`、`useOpenCodeRuntime`、`useLocalRuntime`、`useExternalStoreRuntime`、`useDataStreamRuntime` 和 `useAssistantTransportRuntime`，以及针对 Mastra、Cloudflare Agents、Claude Managed Agents、LLM 网关和 Electron 的布线指南，Expo（`--native`）和 React Ink（`--ink`）脚手架，以及托管的 MCP 文档服务器。一旦存在运行时，使用 elements 用于带有样式的 Thread，使用 runtime 用于钩子和适配器，并使用 update 进行深度迁移。

description: Connects an existing AWS Lambda function to Amazon API Gateway by creating a REST or HTTP API with resource/method setup, Lambda proxy integration, permissions, and deployment. Always use this skill when connecting Lambda to API Gateway — it handles CORS, throttling, access logging, and production security hardening that are easy to miss.
description_zh: 通过创建具有资源/方法设置、Lambda 代理集成、权限和部署的 REST 或 HTTP API，将现有的 AWS Lambda 函数连接至 Amazon API Gateway。在连接 Lambda 与 API Gateway 时，始终使用此技能——它能够处理容易遗漏的 CORS、节流、访问日志以及生产环境安全加固。

description: Run Maestro YAML flows against a Limrun cloud iOS simulator with `lim ios maestro`, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use when the user wants to run, write, or debug Maestro flows or `maestro test` on iOS, migrate an existing Maestro suite to remote simulators, or asks for UI testing with Maestro. iOS simulators only today. For Detox suites use limrun-detox-testing; for driving the simulator without a test framework use limrun-ios-simulator.
description_zh: 使用 `lim ios maestro` 从任何环境（Linux、Windows、macOS、虚拟机、容器）运行 Maestro YAML 流程，针对 Limrun 云 iOS 模拟器。当用户需要运行、编写或调试 iOS 上的 Maestro 流程或 `maestro test`，将现有 Maestro 套件迁移至远程模拟器，或需要使用 Maestro 进行 UI 测试时，请使用此功能。目前仅支持 iOS 模拟器。使用 Detox 套件时请使用 limrun-detox-testing；如需在无测试框架的情况下驱动模拟器，请使用 limrun-ios-simmer。

description: Use to EXECUTE Salesforce org operations immediately via the sf CLI (this skill runs them, it does NOT generate scripts): create scratch orgs (from edition, definition file, snapshot, or org shape), list/display/resume/delete scratch orgs, open orgs in browser. Trigger: 'create scratch org', 'create org from snapshot', 'delete scratch org', 'open my org'. Do NOT use for switching the default org (use dx-org-switch), deploying metadata (use platform-metadata-deploy), or creating/checking/listing/deleting org snapshots (use dx-org-snapshot-manage).
description_zh:
使用 sf CLI 立即执行 Salesforce 组织运营（该技能负责执行操作，不会生成脚本）：创建临时组织（可从版本、定义文件、快照或组织形态创建）、列出/显示/恢复/删除临时组织，以及在浏览器中打开组织。

触发条件："创建临时组织"、"根据快照创建组织"、"删除临时组织"、"打开我的组织"。

请勿用于：切换默认组织（使用 dx-org-switch）、部署元数据（使用 platform-metadata-deploy）、或创建/检查/列出/删除组织快照（使用 dx-org-snapshot-manage）。

description: MongoDB schema design patterns and anti-patterns. Use when designing data models, reviewing schemas, migrating from SQL, or troubleshooting performance issues caused by schema problems. Triggers on "design schema", "embed vs reference", "MongoDB data model", "schema review", "unbounded arrays", "one-to-many", "tree structure", "16MB limit", "schema validation", "JSON Schema", "time series", "schema migration", "polymorphic", "TTL", "data lifecycle", "archive", "index explosion", "unnecessary indexes", "approximation pattern", "document versioning".
description_zh: MongoDB 模式设计模式与反模式。适用于设计数据模型、审查模式、从 SQL 迁移或排查由模式问题导致的性能问题。触发条件包括：“模式设计”、“嵌入与引用”、“MongoDB 数据模型”、“模式审查”、“无界数组”、“一对多”、“树形结构”、“16MB 限制”、“模式验证”、“JSON Schema”、“时间序列”、“模式迁移”、“多态”、“TTL”、“数据生命周期”、“归档”、“索引爆炸”、“不必要的索引”、“近似模式”、“文档版本控制”。

description: Read-only KTX operating-timetable lookup from official Korail public XLSX attachments. No login, internal mobile API, anti-bot bypass, live seat availability, reservation, or payment.
description_zh: 通过官方Korail公开XLSX附件进行只读的KTX运行时刻表查询。不提供登录、内部移动API、反机器人绕过、实时座位可用性、预订或支付功能。

description: Run a structured design critique against the brief and codebase. Checks visual hierarchy, consistency, responsiveness, accessibility, and aesthetic fidelity. Use when user wants a design review, critique, QA pass, polish pass, or mentions "review" after building.
description_zh: 对简报和代码库执行结构化设计评审，检查视觉层级、一致性、响应式适配、可访问性及审美保真度。当用户需要设计评审、设计点评、QA 通过、润色通过，或在构建完成后提及“review”时使用。

description: Build and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps with AWS Amplify Gen2 (TypeScript code-first). Covers auth (Cognito), data (AppSync/DynamoDB), storage (S3), functions, APIs, and AI (Amplify AI Kit with Bedrock). Supports React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, React Native, Flutter, Swift, and Android. Always use this skill for Amplify Gen2 topics — even for questions you think you know — it contains validated, version-specific patterns that prevent common mistakes. TRIGGER when: user mentions Amplify Gen2; project has amplify/ directory or amplify_outputs; code imports @aws-amplify packages; user asks about defineBackend, defineAuth, defineData, defineStorage, defineFunction, or npx ampx. SKIP: Amplify Gen1 (amplify CLI v6), standalone SAM/CDK without Amplify (use aws-serverless), direct Bedrock without Amplify AI Kit (use bedrock).
description_zh: 使用 AWS Amplify Gen2（基于 TypeScript 的代码优先模式）构建并部署全栈 Web 和移动应用。涵盖认证（Cognito）、数据（AppSync/DynamoDB）、存储（S3）、函数、API 以及 AI（Amplify AI Kit 配合 Bedrock）。支持 React、Next.js、Vue、Angular、React Native、Flutter、Swift 和 Android。对于 Amplify Gen2 相关主题，始终使用本技能——即使是你认为已经掌握的问题——该技能包含经过验证、针对特定版本的模式，可防止常见错误。触发条件：用户提及 Amplify Gen2；项目包含 amplify/ 目录或 amplify_outputs；代码导入 @aws-amplify 包；用户询问 defineBackend、defineAuth、defineData、defineStorage、defineFunction 或 npx ampx。跳过条件：Amplify Gen1（amplify CLI v6）、不含 Amplify 的独立 SAM/CDK（使用 aws-serverless）、不含 Amplify AI Kit 时直接使用 Bedrock（使用 bedrock）。

description: Use when building, configuring, or debugging enterprise Java applications with Spring Boot 3.x, microservices, or reactive programming. Invoke to implement WebFlux endpoints, optimize JPA queries and database performance, configure Spring Security with OAuth2/JWT, or resolve authentication issues and async processing challenges in cloud-native Spring applications.
description_zh: 适用于使用Spring Boot 3.x、微服务或响应式编程构建、配置或调试企业级Java应用程序。调用以实现WebFlux端点、优化JPA查询及数据库性能、使用OAuth2/JWT配置Spring Security，或在云原生Spring应用中解决认证问题及异步处理挑战。

description: k-skill-proxy의 공식 Coupang Partners API 경로로 쿠팡 상품을 검색하고 로켓배송·가격 후보를 비교한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 的官方 Coupang Partners API 路径搜索 Coupang 商品，并比较火箭配送与价格选项。在 돌쇠 中，通过官方接口执行后续操作。

description: Apply named refactoring transformations to improve code structure without changing behavior. Use when the user mentions "refactor this", "code smells", "extract method", "replace conditional", "technical debt", "move method", "inline variable", "decompose conditional", or "clean up this messy code". Also trigger when cleaning up legacy code, preparing code for new features by restructuring, or identifying which transformation fits a specific code smell. Covers smell-driven refactoring, safe transformation sequences, and testing guards. For code-quality foundations, see clean-code. For managing complexity, see software-design-philosophy.
description_zh: 通过具名重构变换优化代码结构，且不改变原有行为。当用户提到“重构此代码”、“代码异味”、“提取方法”、“替换条件”、“技术债务”、“移动方法”、“内联变量”、“分解条件”或“清理这段混乱的代码”时使用。当清理遗留代码、通过重构为新产品功能做准备，或识别哪种变换适用于特定代码异味时，也应触发。涵盖基于代码异味的重构、安全的变换序列以及测试防护。如需了解代码质量基础，参见 clean-code；如需管理复杂性，参见 software-design-philosophy。

description: Paper workflow: read papers + cast 取景框 library cards in one go. Takes one or more arxiv links, paper URLs, PDFs, or paper names. For each paper, runs ljg-paper (generates org analysis) then ljg-library (distills the paper's 取景框 into a 2050 library card PNG). Use when user says '论文流', 'paper flow', '读论文并做卡片', '论文卡片', or provides multiple papers wanting both analysis and cards.
description_zh: 论文工作流：一次性读取论文并生成取景框图库卡片。可接收一个或多个 arxiv 链接、论文 URL、PDF 文件或论文名称。对每篇论文，依次运行 ljg-paper（生成组织分析），随后运行 ljg-library（将论文的取景框提炼为 2050 图库卡片 PNG）。当用户说出“论文流”、“paper flow”、“读论文并做卡片”、“论文卡片”，或提供多篇论文并希望同时获得分析与卡片时使用。

description: Build complete Salesforce Lightning Experience applications from natural language descriptions. Use this skill when a user requests a "complete app", "Lightning app", "business solution", "management system", or describes a scenario requiring multiple interconnected Salesforce components (objects, fields, pages, tabs, security). Orchestrates all required metadata types in proper dependency order to produce a deployable application.
description_zh: 根据自然语言描述构建完整的 Salesforce Lightning Experience 应用程序。当用户请求“完整应用”、“Lightning 应用”、“业务解决方案”、“管理系统”，或描述需要多个相互关联的 Salesforce 组件（对象、字段、页面、标签、安全设置）的场景时，使用此技能。按正确的依赖顺序编排所有必需的元数据类型，以生成可部署的应用程序。

description: Use this skill to manage Google Cloud Workload Manager evaluations, rules, scanned resources, and validation results by using public client libraries and the REST API. Use when you need to inspect workload best-practice rules, create and run evaluations for Google Cloud general best practices, SAP, SQL Server, or custom organizational rules, review violations, export results to BigQuery, or automate Workload Manager through client libraries because no service-specific public CLI or MCP server is available. Don't use for general Google Compute Engine instance management, VPC configuration, or standard IAM auditing.
description_zh: 使用此技能通过公开的客户端库和 REST API 管理 Google Cloud 工作负载管理器的评估、规则、扫描资源和验证结果。当您需要检查工作负载最佳实践规则、为 Google Cloud 通用最佳实践、SAP、SQL Server 或自定义组织规则创建并运行评估、审查违规情况、将结果导出至 BigQuery，或因无服务专用的公开 CLI 或 MCP 服务器而需通过客户端库自动化工作负载管理器时，请使用本技能。请勿用于一般的 Google Compute Engine 实例管理、VPC 配置或标准的 IAM 审计。

description: Fetch KBO game schedules and results for a specific date with the kbo-game npm package. Use when the user asks for today's KBO games, yesterday's scores, or a date-specific scoreboard.
description_zh: 使用 kbo-game npm 包获取特定日期的 KBO（韩国职业棒球）比赛日程和结果。当用户询问今天的 KBO 比赛、昨天的比分或特定日期的比赛日程表时使用。

description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that calls an LLM, chatbot, GPT, or ChatGPT **on Caffeine Inference** (no user-pasted OpenAI key). The ONLY supported path is the `caffeineai-inference-client` mops package with `Config.fromEnv<system>()`, which hands the canister a ready-to-use authenticated config — the app never asks for, stores, or returns a key. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` to `inference.caffeine.ai` (or `api.openai.com`) is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task wants an LLM in a Caffeine app — and BEFORE writing any code that talks to an LLM host. Use `extension-openai` only when the spec explicitly requires a user- or admin-pasted `sk-...` key against `api.openai.com`.
description_zh: 任何需要调用 LLM、聊天机器人（chatbot）、GPT 或 ChatGPT **在 Caffeine 推理（Caffeine Inference）上** 的 Caffeine 应用构建，都必须遵循以下强制方案（不使用用户直接粘贴的 OpenAI 密钥）。唯一受支持的路径是使用 `Config.fromEnv`<System> 的 `caffeineai-inference-client` mops 包，它向 canister 提供一个已就绪且已认证的配置——应用永远不会请求、存储或返回任何密钥。自行编写 `ic.http_request` 请求 `inference.caffeine.ai`（或 `api.openai.com`）属于被禁止的反模式。当用户、规范或任何先前任务都需要在 Caffeine 应用中接入 LLM 时，加载此技能——并且在编写任何与 LLM 主机通信的代码之前。仅在规范明确要求针对 `api.openai.com` 使用由用户或管理员直接粘贴的 `sk-...` 密钥时，才使用 `extension-openai`。

description: Look up Seoul real-time subway arrival information with the official Seoul Open Data API. Use when the user asks when a train arrives, which trains are approaching a station, or how crowded Seoul subway timing looks right now.
description_zh: 使用官方首尔开放数据API查询首尔地铁实时到站信息。当用户询问列车何时到达、哪些列车正接近车站，或首尔地铁的实时拥挤状况如何时，使用该功能。

description: Writes, debugs, and refactors JavaScript code using modern ES2023+ features, async/await patterns, ESM module systems, and Node.js APIs. Use when building vanilla JavaScript applications, implementing Promise-based async flows, optimising browser or Node.js performance, working with Web Workers or Fetch API, or reviewing .js/.mjs/.cjs files for correctness and best practices.
description_zh: 使用现代 ES2023+ 特性、async/await 模式、ESM 模块系统和 Node.js API，编写、调试并重构 JavaScript 代码。适用于构建原生 JavaScript 应用、实现基于 Promise 的异步流程、优化浏览器或 Node.js 性能、使用 Web Workers 或 Fetch API，或审阅 .js/.mjs/.cjs 文件以检查正确性与最佳实践。

description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh CLI 使用阿里 HappyHorse 1.0 模型生成并编辑视频。  
模型：HappyHorse T2V、I2V、R2V、Video Edit。  
功能：文本生成视频、图像生成视频、参考生成视频、支持自然语言的视频编辑、角色保持一致、720P/1080P、最长 15 秒。  
用途：制作写实视频、视频编辑、角色一致内容、产品演示、社交媒体。  
触发词：happyhorse、happy horse、alibaba video、happyhorse 1.0、dashscope video、alibaba happyhorse、video editing ai、ai video editor

description: Look up a Korean postcode and official English address from a known address with the official ePost integrated search page.
description_zh: 使用官方ePost集成搜索页面，从已知地址查询韩国邮编和官方英文地址。

description: SERP-based semantic topic clustering for content architecture planning. Groups keywords by actual Google SERP overlap (not text similarity), designs hub-and-spoke content clusters with internal link matrices, and generates interactive visualizations. Optionally executes content creation if claude-blog is installed. Use when user says "topic cluster", "content cluster", "semantic clustering", "pillar page", "hub and spoke", "content architecture", "keyword grouping", or "cluster plan".
description_zh: 用于内容架构规划的基于SERP的语义主题聚类。按谷歌SERP的实际重叠度（而非文本相似度）对关键词进行分组，设计具有内部链接矩阵的“枢纽-放射（hub-and-spoke）”内容集群，并生成交互式可视化。若已安装 claude-blog，则可选地执行内容创作。当用户说出“topic cluster”、“content cluster”、“semantic clustering”、“pillar page”、“hub and spoke”、“content architecture”、“keyword grouping”或“cluster plan”时使用。

description: Migrate Lightning Web Components from SLDS 1 to SLDS 2 by running the SLDS linter and fixing violations. Use this skill whenever users mention SLDS 2, SLDS uplift, linter violations, LWC token migration, class overrides, hardcoded CSS values that need SLDS hook replacement, or styling hook selection. Covers all styling hook categories — color, spacing, sizing, typography, borders, radius, and shadows. Also use when users mention no-hardcoded-values, no-slds-class-overrides, lwc-to-slds-hooks, no-deprecated-tokens-slds1, or ask about SLDS component migration — even if they don't explicitly say "uplift" or "migration".
description_zh: 通过运行 SLDS linter 并修复违规问题，将 Lightning Web Components（LWC）从 SLDS 1 迁移至 SLDS 2。当用户提及 SLDS 2、SLDS uplift、linter 违规、LWC token 迁移、类覆盖（class overrides）、需要 SLDS hook 替换的硬编码 CSS 值，或样式 hook 选择时，请使用此技能。该技能涵盖所有样式 hook 类别——颜色、间距、尺寸、字体排印、边框、圆角和阴影。当用户提及 no-hardcoded-values、no-slds-class-overrides、lwc-to-slds-hooks、no-deprecated-tokens-slds1，或询问 SLDS 组件迁移时，也请使用此技能，即使他们并未明确提及"uplift"或"migration"。

description: Performs AI-powered code review on Git changes using the `ocr` CLI from alibaba/open-code-review. Use when the user asks to review code, review a pull request, review staged/unstaged changes, review a commit, or compare branches for code quality issues. Produces line-level review comments and can automatically apply fixes when requested. With appropriate review rules, can detect various types of issues including bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance problems, and code quality concerns.
description_zh: 使用来自 `alibaba/open-code-review` 的 `ocr` 命令行工具，对 Git 变更进行 AI 驱动的代码审查。适用于用户要求审查代码、审查拉取请求、审查已暂存或未暂存变更、审查提交，或比较分支以查找代码质量问题的场景。生成行级审查评论，并在请求时自动应用修复。在合适的审查规则下，可检测包括缺陷、安全漏洞、性能问题及代码质量问题在内的各类问题。

description: Use Nara/PNU Korean spell-check surfaces conservatively to proofread Korean text, chunk long input, and return change-focused correction suggestions.
description_zh: 审慎使用 Nara/PNU 韩文拼写检查界面来校对韩文文本，将长文本分块处理，并返回以变更为中心的校对建议。

description: Use this skill first for ANY PixiJS v8 task; it routes to the right specialized skill for the job. Covers the full PixiJS surface: Application setup, the scene graph (Container, Sprite, Graphics, Text, Mesh, ParticleContainer, DOMContainer, GifSprite), rendering (WebGL/WebGPU/Canvas, render loop, custom shaders, filters, blend modes), assets, events, color, math, ticker, accessibility, performance, environments, migration from v7, and project scaffolding. Triggers on: pixi, pixi.js, pixijs, PixiJS, v8, Application, app.init, Sprite, Container, Graphics, Text, Mesh, ParticleContainer, DOMContainer, GifSprite, Assets, Ticker, renderer, WebGL, WebGPU, scene graph, filter, shader, blend mode, texture, BitmapText, create-pixi, how do I draw, how do I render, how do I animate in pixi.
description_zh: 处理任何 PixiJS v8 任务时，请优先使用此技能；它将正确引导至适合该任务的专业专项技能。全面覆盖 PixiJS 的完整功能：应用设置（Application setup）、场景图（Container, Sprite, Graphics, Text, Mesh, ParticleContainer, DOMContainer, GifSprite）、渲染（WebGL/WebGPU/Canvas、渲染循环、自定义着色器、滤镜、混合模式）、资源、事件、颜色、数学、定时器（Ticker）、无障碍、性能、环境、从 v7 的迁移，以及项目脚手架。触发关键词包括：pixi, pixi.js, pixi.js, pixi.js, PixiJS, v8, Application, app.init, Sprite, Container, Graphics, Text, Mesh, ParticleContainer, DOMContainer, GifSprite, Assets, Ticker, renderer, WebGL, WebGPU, scene graph, filter, shader, blend mode, texture, BitmapText, create-pixi, how do I draw, how do I render, how do I animate in pixi。

description: Provides domain-specific best practices for Node.js development with TypeScript, covering type stripping, async patterns, error handling, streams, modules, testing, performance, caching, logging, and more. Use when setting up Node.js projects with native TypeScript support, configuring type stripping (--experimental-strip-types), writing Node 22+ TypeScript without a build step, or when the user mentions 'native TypeScript in Node', 'strip types', 'Node 22 TypeScript', '.ts files without compilation', 'ts-node alternative', or needs guidance on error handling, graceful shutdown, flaky tests, profiling, or environment configuration in Node.js. Helps configure tsconfig.json for type stripping, set up package.json scripts, handle module resolution and import extensions, and apply robust patterns across the full Node.js stack.
description_zh:
提供针对 TypeScript 开发的 Node.js 领域专属最佳实践，涵盖类型剥离、异步模式、错误处理、流（Stream）、模块、测试、性能、缓存、日志记录等。

适用于配置具有原生 TypeScript 支持的 Node.js 项目、配置类型剥离（--experimental-strip-types）、编写无需构建步骤的 Node 22+ TypeScript 代码，或当用户提及“Node 中原生 TypeScript”、“strip types”、“Node 22 TypeScript”、“无需编译的 .ts 文件”、“ts-node 替代方案”，或需要 Node.js 中的错误处理、优雅关闭、不稳定测试、性能分析与环境配置指导时使用。

帮助为类型剥离配置 tsconfig.json、设置 package.json 脚本、处理模块解析与导入扩展名，并在完整的 Node.js 技术栈中应用稳健模式。

description_zh: 为此仓库配置 engineering skills——设置其 issue tracker、triage labels 词汇与 domain docs 布局。在首次使用其他 engineering skills 前运行一次。

description: Check Korean Lotto draw results, latest rounds, and ticket matches with the k-lotto npm package. Use when the user asks for winning numbers, payout details, or whether their numbers matched.
description_zh: 使用 k-lotto npm 包查询韩国乐透开奖结果、最新一期开奖及票码匹配。当用户询问中奖号码、派奖详情或号码是否匹配时使用。

description: AWS SDK for Swift development patterns. Use when writing Swift code that uses AWS services via aws-sdk-swift package.
description_zh:
**AWS SDK for Swift 开发模式**

用于编写通过 aws-sdk-swift 包调用 AWS 服务的 Swift 代码时使用。

description: Skill map viewer. Scans all installed skills and renders a visual overview — name, version, description, category at a glance. Use when user says 'skills', '技能', '技能地图', 'skill map', '我有哪些技能', '看看技能', '列出技能', 'list skills'. Also trigger when user asks what skills are available or installed.
description_zh: 技能地图查看器。扫描所有已安装技能，并渲染可视化总览——名称、版本、描述、分类一目了然。当用户说‘skills’、‘技能’、‘技能地图’、‘skill map’、‘我有哪些技能’、‘看看技能’、‘列出技能’、‘list skills’时使用。当用户询问有哪些技能或已安装技能时，同样触发。

description: Generate engaging, localized App Store release notes (What's New) from git log, bullet points, or free text using canonical metadata under `./metadata`. Optionally pairs with promotional text updates.
description_zh: 根据 `./metadata` 目录下的标准元数据，从 git log、要点列表或自由文本生成吸引人且本地化的 App Store 发布说明（What's New）。可选搭配推广文本更新。

description: ALWAYS USE THIS SKILL to assign permission sets to org users. Assign one or more permission sets to org users using the sf org assign permset command. TRIGGER when the user asks to assign, grant, give, add, or apply permission sets to users, admins, specific orgs, or specific users. Supports granting permissions, giving access, and adding permission sets to default admin or specific users via --on-behalf-of. DO NOT TRIGGER for listing permission sets or checking user permissions.
description_zh: 始终使用本技能为组织用户分配权限集。使用 sf org assign permset 命令，为组织用户分配一个或多个权限集。当用户要求为用户、管理员、特定组织或特定用户分配、授予、给予、添加或应用权限集时触发。支持通过 --on-behalf-of 为默认管理员或特定用户授予权限、提供访问权限并添加权限集。不要为列出权限集或检查用户权限而触发。

description: Use this skill when the user wants to 'login/log in/sign in', 'authenticate', 'authorize', 'connect OKX account', 'set up credentials', 'first time setup', 'configure okx', '登录', '授权', '认证', '连接账户', '首次配置'. Also when any OKX CLI command fails with an auth error: 'Run okx auth login first', 'Session expired', 'not authenticated', 'requires_auth', '401 Unauthorized', 'token expired/not found', 'StorageNotFoundError', '会话过期', '未认证', '需要登录'. Also when the user asks about login status or the login was interrupted. Also use before using okx-cex-trade/portfolio/earn/bot for the first time. Do NOT use for market data queries (use okx-cex-market).
description_zh: 当用户需要使用‘login/log in/sign in’、‘authenticate’、‘authorize’、‘connect OKX account’、‘set up credentials’、‘first time setup’、‘configure okx’、‘登录’、‘授权’、‘认证’、‘连接账户’、‘首次配置’时，使用本技能。当任何 OKX CLI 命令因认证错误而失败时：‘Run okx auth login first’，‘Session expired’，‘not authenticated’，‘requires_auth’，‘401 Unauthorized’，‘token 过期/未找到’，‘StorageNotFoundError’，‘会话过期’，‘未认证’，‘需要登录’。当用户询问登录状态或登录被中断时。当用户需要安装/更新/检查/移除 okx-auth 二进制文件时——使用‘install/update/remove auth’，‘download okx-auth’，‘安装/更新/卸载认证’，‘auth binary status’，‘Failed to spawn okx-auth’。在用户首次使用 okx-cex-trade/portfolio/earn/bot 之前，使用本技能。不要用于市场数据查询（请使用 okx-cex-market）。

description: Write a marimo notebook in a Python file in the right format.
description_zh: 用正确的格式在 Python 文件中编写一个 marimo 笔记本。

description: Use when the user's task involves Ant Design (antd) — writing antd components, debugging antd issues, querying antd APIs/props/tokens/demos, migrating between antd versions, or analyzing antd usage in a project. Triggers on antd-related code, imports from 'antd', or explicit antd questions.

description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT-Image-2 via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, mask-based editing, multi-image reference, batch generation. Use for: product mockups, marketing visuals, image editing, concept art, inpainting, photo manipulation. 使用 inference.sh CLI 通过 OpenAI GPT-Image-2 生成和编辑图像。

用途：产品原型图、营销视觉、图像编辑、概念艺术、图像修复、照片处理。

description: Manages Google Analytics reporting data, enables the Analytics Data API via the Cloud CLI, and creates reports using the Google Analytics Data API (v1beta). Use when you need to interact with Google Analytics properties, run customized analytics reports, query metrics (like activeUsers, screenPageViews) and dimensions (like city, date), check metrics and dimensions compatibility, or verify API enablement. Don't use for Google Analytics Admin API operations (e.g., creating properties, managing users) or for front-end tracking installation.
description_zh: 管理 Google Analytics 报告数据，通过 Cloud CLI 启用 Analytics Data API，并使用 Google Analytics Data API (v1beta) 创建报告。当您需要与 Google Analytics 属性交互、运行定制化分析报告、查询指标（如 activeUsers、screenPageViews）和维度（如 city、date）、检查指标和维度兼容性，或验证 API 启用状态时可使用。不要用于 Google Analytics Admin API 操作（例如创建属性、管理用户）或前端追踪安装。

description: Use when the user asks for nearby bars or 근처 술집. Ask for the user's location, search with the official Kakao Local API, then follow returned Kakao Map detail links for open-now, menu, and seating hints. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户询问附近酒吧或附近餐厅时使用。获取用户位置信息，使用官方 Kakao Local API 进行搜索，然后按照返回的 Kakao Map 详情链接，获取当前营业状态、菜单和座位提示等信息。在 돌쇠 中，通过官方界面完成后续操作。

description: Identifies security vulnerabilities, generates structured audit reports with severity ratings, and provides actionable remediation guidance. Use when conducting security audits, reviewing code for vulnerabilities, or analyzing infrastructure security. Invoke for SAST scans, penetration testing, DevSecOps practices, cloud security reviews, dependency audits, secrets scanning, or compliance checks. Produces vulnerability reports, prioritized recommendations, and compliance checklists.
description_zh: 识别安全漏洞，生成包含严重程度评级的结构化审计报告，并提供可操作的整改指导。用于进行安全审计、检查代码中的漏洞或分析基础设施安全。适用于SAST扫描、渗透测试、DevSecOps实践、云安全审查、依赖审计、密钥扫描或合规检查。生成漏洞报告、优先级排序的推荐建议和合规检查清单。

description: Convert PDF files to editable Word documents using pdf2docx
description_zh: 使用 pdf2docx 将 PDF 文件转换为可编辑的 Word 文档

description: Scaffold, configure, and troubleshoot Solana Mobile apps for Android using the solana-mobile CLI, Expo, and React Native. Use when creating a new Solana mobile app, picking a template, adding Solana to an existing Expo app, checking the Android toolchain, managing Android emulators or connected devices, installing a wallet APK for testing, running a local validator the device can reach, or producing a development build.
description_zh: 使用 solana-mobile CLI、Expo 和 React Native 为 Android 搭建、配置并排查 Solana Mobile 应用。适用于创建新的 Solana 移动应用、选择模板、将 Solana 添加到现有 Expo 应用中、检查 Android 工具链、管理 Android 模拟器或已连接设备、安装钱包 APK 进行测试、在设备可访问的范围内运行本地验证器，或生成开发构建版本。

description: Connect Solana wallets and sign or send transactions in React Native Expo apps using Mobile Wallet Adapter and Wallet UI. Use when adding a connect wallet button, showing a connected address, disconnecting, signing messages, sign-in with Solana, transferring SOL, or sending any transaction from a Solana mobile app.
description_zh: 使用移动钱包适配器（Mobile Wallet Adapter）与钱包界面（Wallet UI），在 React Native Expo 应用中连接 Solana 钱包，并签名或发送交易。适用于在应用中添加连接钱包按钮、显示已连接地址、进行断开连接、对消息签名、通过 Solana 登录、转账 SOL 或在 Solana 移动应用中发送任意交易等场景。

Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, multi-image compositing, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. description_zh:
通过 inference.sh 命令行工具，使用 Pruna P-Image 模型生成图像。

description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard

description: Resolve and display .skr domain names in Solana mobile apps, in both directions between names and wallet addresses. Use when showing .skr names instead of wallet addresses in profiles, friend lists, or transaction history, resolving a .skr domain to an address, reverse-looking-up an address to a domain, or validating .skr input.
description_zh: 在 Solana 移动应用中双向解析并显示 .skr 域名名称与钱包地址的对应关系。适用于在个人资料、好友列表或交易历史中，用 .skr 名称替代钱包地址进行展示，将 .skr 域名解析为地址、反向查询地址对应的域名，或验证 .skr 输入。

description: Verify Seeker device ownership by checking for the Seeker Genesis Token (SGT) with Sign-in-with-Solana and server-side token verification. Use when gating content or rewards to Seeker owners, verifying a user holds an SGT, adding anti-Sybil checks to a Solana mobile app, or implementing one-claim-per-device logic.

description: Connects an AWS Lambda function to DynamoDB with IAM roles, stream event source mapping, and read/write permissions. Use when setting up Lambda-DynamoDB integration, processing DynamoDB stream events, or deploying serverless event-driven architectures.
description_zh: 连接 AWS Lambda 函数与 DynamoDB，支持 IAM 角色、流式事件源映射以及读写权限。适用于设置 Lambda-DynamoDB 集成、处理 DynamoDB 流式事件或部署无服务器事件驱动架构的场景。

description: Add Privy authentication to a Solana Expo Android app on top of Mobile Wallet Adapter, using Sign-In-With-Solana. Use when installing @privy-io/expo, mounting PrivyProvider, logging a user in with useLoginWithSiws, linking a wallet to an existing Privy account, reading the Privy access token from a backend, or debugging a Privy plus MWA setup.

description: Troubleshoots failing applications by discovering and analyzing CloudWatch log groups to identify error patterns, root causes, and actionable solutions. Use when an application is experiencing failures and log-based diagnosis is needed.
description_zh: 通过发现并分析 CloudWatch 日志组，排查故障应用，识别错误模式、根本原因和可行解决方案。当应用程序出现故障且需要进行基于日志的诊断时使用。

description: Smart Money analytics on OKX: leaderboard traders, position tracking, trade records, closed-position history, aggregated consensus signals, and signal history. description: Leverages BigQuery's built-in machine learning and GenAI capabilities for advanced data analytics. Use when you need to write SQL queries that perform time-series forecasting, predict values, detect outliers or anomalies, find key drivers, perform semantic search or vector search, classify text, calculate similarity, summarize content, translate language, evaluate models, filter by semantic conditions, or leverage generative AI capabilities in BigQuery. Do not use for general BigQuery dataset, table, or job management requests.

description: Creates and configures NestJS modules, controllers, services, DTOs, guards, and interceptors for enterprise-grade TypeScript backend applications. Use when building NestJS REST APIs or GraphQL services, implementing dependency injection, scaffolding modular architecture, adding JWT/Passport authentication, integrating TypeORM or Prisma, or working with .module.ts, .controller.ts, and .service.ts files. Use when creating, modifying, or validating Terraform Stack configurations (.tfcomponent.hcl, .tfdeploy.hcl files), working with stack components and deployments from local modules, public registry, or private registry sources, managing multi-region or multi-environment infrastructure, or troubleshooting Terraform Stacks syntax and structure.

description: Pre-deployment verification checklist. Use when about to ship a release, deploying a change with database migrations or feature flags, verifying CI status and approvals before going to production, or documenting rollback triggers ahead of time.

Also trigger when designing notification or re-engagement strategies, building streaks or progress systems, or analyzing why users stop after signup. Covers ethics evaluation and onboarding for habits. For friction reduction and B=MAP, see improve-retention. For viral sharing, see contagious.

description: Upgrades an existing assistant-ui application and applies the migrations needed to reach the current AI SDK v7 and assistant-ui 0.15.x lines. Use when updating, bumping, or migrating @assistant-ui/react, @assistant-ui/ai-sdk, the older @assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk alias, ai, or @ai-sdk/react, or when an upgrade exposes removed hooks, scope accessor calls, provider configuration, registry paths, event names, legacy interactables, or tool registrations. Start here for an existing project, post-update type failures, package compatibility, CLI codemods, and version-specific migration order. For a first install or a new project use setup; for authoring a runtime without an upgrade use runtime.
description_zh: 升级现有的 assistant-ui 应用，并应用必要的迁移，以适配当前的 AI SDK v7 与 assistant-ui 0.15.x 版本线。在更新、升级或迁移 @assistant-ui/react、@assistant-ui/ai-sdk、旧版 @assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk 别名、ai 或 @ai-sdk/react 时使用；或者在升级过程中暴露了已移除的 hooks、作用域访问器调用、提供器配置、注册表路径、事件名称、传统交互对象或工具注册时使用。对于现有项目、更新后的类型错误、包兼容性、CLI 代码转换工具以及特定版本的迁移顺序，请从此处开始。首次安装或新项目时使用 setup；在编写无需升级的运行时项目时使用 runtime。

description: Debugs AWS Lambda function timeout failures by systematically analyzing function configuration, CloudWatch logs and metrics, VPC/networking, cold starts, memory constraints, and downstream dependencies to identify root causes with actionable fixes. Use when a Lambda function is timing out or approaching its timeout limit.
description_zh: 可通过系统性地分析函数配置、CloudWatch 日志与指标、VPC/网络、冷启动、内存限制以及下游依赖，调试 AWS Lambda 函数超时失败，以识别根本原因并提供可操作的修复方案。当 Lambda 函数出现超时或即将达到其超时限制时使用。

description: Salesforce Connected Apps and External Client Apps OAuth configuration with 120-point scoring. Use this skill to configure OAuth flows, JWT bearer auth, Connected Apps, and External Client Apps in Salesforce. TRIGGER when: user configures OAuth flows, JWT bearer auth, Connected Apps, ECAs, or touches .connectedApp-meta.xml / .eca-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: configuring Named Credentials for callouts (use integration-connectivity-generate), reviewing permission policies (use platform-metadata-deploy), or writing Apex token-handling code (use platform-apex-generate).
description_zh:
使用 120 分评分进行 Salesforce 连接应用和外部客户端应用 OAuth 配置。使用此技能在 Salesforce 中配置 OAuth 流程、JWT bearer 认证、连接应用和外部客户端应用。

**触发条件**：当用户配置 OAuth 流程、JWT bearer 认证、连接应用、ECAs 或触碰 `.connectedApp-meta.xml` / `.eca-meta.xml` 文件时触发。

**以下情况不触发**：配置用于调用的命名凭证（使用 integration-connectivity-generate）、审核权限策略（使用 platform-metadata-deploy），或编写 Apex 令牌处理代码（使用 platform-apex-generate）。

End-to-end project engineering: design, incremental build, verify, debug systematically.

description: Migrate a codebase from the Runpod GraphQL API or REST v1 to REST v2 — inventory which parts use which API version, rewrite the call sites, flag breaking changes, and verify. Use when someone asks to move to v2, asks what v2 would change, or asks which Runpod API their code is on. For managing infrastructure rather than migrating code, use runpod-mcp or runpodctl.
description_zh: 将基于 Runpod GraphQL API 或 REST v1 的代码库迁移至 REST v2，需盘点哪些部分使用了哪个 API 版本，重写调用点，标记破坏性变更，并进行验证。当有人询问迁移至 v2、询问 v2 将带来哪些变更，或询问其代码所使用的 Runpod API 版本时使用。若目的是管理基础设施而非迁移代码，请使用 runpod-mcp 或 runpodctl。

description: Salesforce integration architecture and runtime plumbing with 120-point scoring. Use this skill to set up Named Credentials, External Credentials, External Services, REST/SOAP callout patterns, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture. TRIGGER when: user sets up Named Credentials, External Services, REST/SOAP callouts, Platform Events, CDC, or touches .namedCredential-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Connected App/OAuth config (use integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure), Apex-only logic (use platform-apex-generate), data import/export (use platform-data-manage), or CDC channel-membership metadata such as PlatformEventChannel, PlatformEventChannelMember, or EnrichedField (use integration-eventing-cdc-configure).
description_zh:
Salesforce集成架构与运行时管道（120分评分）。

使用此技能配置命名凭证、外部凭证、外部服务、REST/SOAP callout 模式、Platform Events 以及变更数据捕获。

**触发条件：** 用户设置命名凭证、外部服务、REST/SOAP callouts、Platform Events、CDC，或操作 `.namedCredential-meta.xml` 文件。

**避免触发条件：** Connected App/OAuth 配置（请使用 `integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure`）、仅使用 Apex 的逻辑（请使用 `platform-apex-generate`）、数据导入/导出（请使用 `platform-data-manage`），或 CDC channel-membership 元数据，如 PlatformEventChannel、PlatformEventChannelMember 或 EnrichedField（请使用 `integration-eventing-cdc-configure`）。

description: AI-powered codebase security scanner that reasons about code like a security researcher — tracing data flows, understanding component interactions, and catching vulnerabilities that pattern-matching tools miss. Use this skill when asked to scan code for security vulnerabilities, find bugs, check for SQL injection, XSS, command injection, exposed API keys, hardcoded secrets, insecure dependencies, access control issues, or any request like "is my code secure?", "review for security issues", "audit this codebase", or "check for vulnerabilities". Covers injection flaws, authentication and access control bugs, secrets exposure, weak cryptography, insecure dependencies, and business logic issues across JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, PHP, Go, Ruby, and Rust.

Also triggers on session discovery — find/list/search sessions by time, agent, channel, outcome, or conversation text — when the user has no session id yet. DO NOT TRIGGER for design-time architecture questions (use agentforce-architecture-analyze instead) or for runtime perf/latency/SLO questions that require platform telemetry beyond Data Cloud.
description_zh: Data Cloud 针对单个 Agentforce 会话的360°视图。当用户按会话ID（Agent Session UUID `019d…` 或 MessagingSession ID `0Mw…`）请求追踪、检查、总结或描述特定 Agentforce 会话时触发。当用户尚无会话ID但需要按时间、代理、渠道、结果或对话文本发现/列出/搜索会话时，同样触发。对于设计阶段的架构问题（请使用 agentforce-architecture-analyze 处理）或需要 Data Cloud 之外平台遥测数据才能解答的运行时性能/延迟/SLO 问题，请勿触发。

description: Manages Google Analytics account and property settings, enables the Analytics Admin API via the Cloud CLI, lists accounts and properties, and manages data streams, custom dimensions, conversion events, and integrations. Use when you need to programmatically configure Google Analytics accounts, provision properties, manage data retention, configure Measurement Protocol secrets, or manage Firebase and Google Ads links.
description_zh: 管理 Google Analytics 账户和属性设置，通过 Cloud CLI 启用 Analytics Admin API，列出账户和属性，并管理数据流、自定义维度、转化事件和集成。在需要程序化配置 Google Analytics 账户、配置属性、管理数据保留、配置 Measurement Protocol 密钥，或管理 Firebase 和 Google Ads 链接时使用。

description: Use this skill alongside figma-use when the task involves translating an application page, view, or multi-section layout into Figma. Triggers: 'write to Figma', 'create in Figma from code', 'push page to Figma', 'take this app/page and build it in Figma', 'create a screen', 'build a landing page in Figma', 'update the Figma screen to match code', 'convert this modal/dialog/drawer/panel to Figma'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, modal, dialog, drawer, sidebar, panel, or any composed multi-section view in Figma from code or a description. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles from Code Connect files, existing screens, and library search, then imports them and assembles views incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.
description_zh: 当任务涉及将应用页面、视图或多区块布局转换为 Figma 时，请配合 figma-use 技能使用本技能。触发条件：“将内容写入 Figma”、“从代码在 Figma 中创建”、“将页面推送到 Figma”、“根据此应用/页面在 Figma 中构建”、“创建屏幕”、“在 Figma 中构建落地页”、“更新 Figma 屏幕以匹配代码”、“将此模态框/对话框/抽屉/面板转换为 Figma”。这是用户在需要从代码或描述构建或更新 Figma 中的完整页面、模态框、对话框、抽屉、侧边栏、面板或任何组合多区块视图时的首选工作流技能。从 Code Connect 文件、已有屏幕和库搜索中识别设计系统组件、变量和样式，然后导入它们，并基于设计系统令牌而非硬编码值，逐步逐区块组装视图。

description: Assists in provisioning instances/tables, designing performant schemas, and querying data in Bigtable. Use when designing Bigtable row keys, configuring column families, writing SQL queries or client library code (Java, Go, Python) for Bigtable, or diagnosing performance/hotspotting issues. Also use when provisioning Bigtable clusters using gcloud or cbt CLIs. Don't use for generic Cloud SQL administration.
description_zh: 协助进行 Bigtable 的实例/表配置、高性能 schema 设计与数据查询。当设计 Bigtable 行键、配置列族、编写用于 Bigtable 的 SQL 查询或客户端库代码（Java、Go、Python），或诊断性能/热点问题时使用。此外，使用 gcloud 或 cbt CLI 配置 Bigtable 集群时也可使用。请勿用于通用的 Cloud SQL 管理。

description: Scans Solana programs for 6 critical vulnerabilities including arbitrary CPI, improper PDA validation, missing signer/ownership checks, and sysvar spoofing. Use when auditing Solana/Anchor programs.
description_zh: 扫描 Solana 程序，针对 6 项关键漏洞，包括任意 CPI 调用、PDA 验证不当、缺乏签名者/所有权检查以及 sysvar 伪造。适用于审计 Solana/Anchor 程序时使用。

description: upstream daiso CLI를 사용해 올리브영 매장 검색, 상품 검색, 재고 확인을 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用 upstream daiso CLI 对 Olive Young 门店搜索、商品搜索、库存确认进行查询。在돌쇠中，通过官方界面执行后续操作直至完成。

description: 企业微信微盘（Disk / 网盘）文件操作技能。承接"微盘 / 网盘"里的文件列出、搜索、读取元信息、上传、下载、重命名、新建文件夹操作。用户明确提到"微盘"/"网盘"/"共享空间"时必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。用户说"上传到微盘"、"帮我在微盘里搜一下 xxx"、"微盘那个 PPT 在哪"、"下载微盘那个文件"、"把微盘那个文件重命名成 xxx"、或直接给出 `https://drive.weixin.qq.com/s?k=...` 形式的微盘文件链接时使用本技能。与 `wecomcli-doc` / `wecomcli-sheet` / `wecomcli-smartsheet` / `wecomcli-smartpage` 的区别：本技能处理微盘里所有文件（含在线文档）的搜索/列表/基础信息/位置/路径/重命名等文件级操作；在线文档（`doc/sheet/smartsheet/smartpage` 类型）的内容读写走对应文档技能，不由本技能接管。当用户问「这个文档在微盘哪里」或问某文件在微盘的位置时，由本技能用 get 返回空间名/文件夹名/路径等元信息。
description_zh:
企业微信微盘（Disk / 网盘）文件操作技能。承接"微盘 / 网盘"中的文件列出、搜索、读取元信息、上传、下载、重命名、新建文件夹等操作。用户明确提及"微盘"/"网盘"/"共享空间"时，必须先调用本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。当用户说"上传到微盘"、"帮我在微盘里搜一下 xxx"、"微盘那个 PPT 在哪"、"下载微盘那个文件"、"把微盘那个文件重命名成 xxx"，或直接给出 `https://drive.weixin.qq.com/s?k=...` 形式的微盘文件链接时，使用本技能。

与 `wecomcli-doc` / `wecomcli-sheet` / `wecomcli-smartsheet` / `wecomcli-smartpage` 的区别：本技能处理微盘中所有文件（含在线文档）的搜索/列表/基础信息/位置/路径/重命名等文件级操作；在线文档（`doc/sheet/smartsheet/smartpage` 类型）的内容读写由对应文档技能处理，不由本技能接管。当用户询问"这个文档在微盘哪里"或询问某文件在微盘的位置时，由本技能通过 get 返回空间名/文件夹名/路径等元信息。

description: 企业微信文档公共管理：搜索文档（最近浏览/创建）、文档改名、添加文档成员权限、设置文档加入规则。适用于所有文档类型（doc文档 / 在线表格 / 智能表格 / 智能文档）。新建或导入doc文档请使用 wecomcli-doc；新建或导入在线表格请使用 wecomcli-sheet；智能表格内容 CRUD 请使用 wecomcli-smartsheet；生成智能文档请使用 wecomcli-smartpage。"看过哪些文档/浏览历史"类需求走本技能，不要走 wecom_get_user_memory。
description_zh: 企业微信文档公共管理：搜索文档（最近浏览/创建）、文档改名、添加文档成员权限、设置文档加入规则。适用于所有文档类型（doc文档 / 在线表格 / 智能表格 / 智能文档）。新建或导入doc文档请使用 wecomcli-doc；新建或导入在线表格请使用 wecomcli-sheet；智能表格内容 CRUD 请使用 wecomcli-smartsheet；生成智能文档请使用 wecomcli-smartpage。"看过哪些文档/浏览历史"类需求走本技能，不要走 wecom_get_user_memory。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks about libraries, frameworks, API references, or needs code examples. Activates for setup questions, code generation involving libraries, or mentions of specific frameworks like React, Vue, Next.js, Prisma, Supabase, etc.
description_zh: 当用户询问有关库、框架、API 参考，或需要代码示例时，应使用此技能。适用于设置问题、涉及库的代码生成，或提及 React、Vue、Next.js、Prisma、Supabase 等特定框架。

description: 企业微信邮件：发送/回复/转发邮件、搜索邮件列表、获取邮件详情（正文、附件、内嵌图片解析），支持通过邮件发送日程邀约和会议预定。当用户涉及内部邮件收发、邮件查询、邮件管理等需求时使用。注意：日程和会议有单独的技能，仅当用户明确提到"邮箱"或"邮件"时（如"通过邮箱发送会议邀请"、"发封会议邮件"），才使用本技能处理会议日程邮件。
description_zh: 企业微信邮件：发送/回复/转发邮件、搜索邮件列表、获取邮件详情（正文、附件、内嵌图片解析），支持通过邮件发送日程邀约和会议预定。当用户涉及内部邮件收发、邮件查询、邮件管理等需求时使用。注意：日程和会议有单独的技能，仅当用户明确提到"邮箱"或"邮件"时（如"通过邮箱发送会议邀请"、"发封会议邮件"），才使用本技能处理会议日程邮件。

description: 企业微信媒体文件上传/下载技能。承接基于 media_id 下载媒体文件到本地，以及上传本地文件获取 media_id 两类操作。当其他技能（微盘、邮件等）返回了 media_id 需要落地为本地文件，或已有本地文件需要转换为 media_id 供其他技能使用时，必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。本技能不解析/识别文件内容，仅负责文件本身的搬运。
description_zh: 企业微信媒体文件上传/下载技能。承接基于 media_id 下载媒体文件到本地，以及上传本地文件获取 media_id 两类操作。当其他技能（微盘、邮件等）返回了 media_id 需要落地为本地文件，或已有本地文件需要转换为 media_id 供其他技能使用时，必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。本技能不解析/识别文件内容，仅负责文件本身的搬运。

description: 查询当前可以发送消息的聊天会话范围，并向会话列表中的单聊或群聊发送文本、Markdown、图片、文件、语音、视频消息。用户要求“给某人发消息”“在某个群里通知”“给最近会话发消息”或“把图片/文件/语音/视频发到企业微信”时使用。
description_zh: 查询当前可发送消息的聊天会话范围，并向会话列表中的单聊或群聊发送文本、Markdown、图片、文件、语音、视频消息。当用户要求“给某人发消息”“在某个群里通知”“给最近会话发消息”或“把图片/文件/语音/视频发到企业微信”时使用。

description: Configures Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to a CloudFront distribution using a custom domain. Use when setting up DNS alias records, alternate domain names (CNAMEs), ACM certificates for HTTPS, and IPv6 support for CloudFront.
description_zh: 配置Amazon Route 53，使用自定义域名将流量路由至CloudFront分发。在设置DNS别名记录、备用域名（CNAMEs）、用于HTTPS的ACM证书以及CloudFront的IPv6支持时使用。

description: 한국 날씨를 기상청 단기예보 조회서비스와 프록시 경유로 조회해 요약한다.
description_zh: 通过气象厅短期预报查询服务及代理，对韩国天气进行查询并总结。

description: 企业微信日程管理。当用户需要预约日程、预订会议室、查看/更新/取消日程或查忙闲时触发。本技能负责『日程』——即不含在线会议链接的安排（也涵盖纯线下面对面碰头）；若用户要的是『在线会议』（含会议号/入会链接、可远程或视频参会），改用 wecomcli-meeting 技能。用户仅说'开会/约个会/某会'等、未明确要创建的是日程还是在线会议时，必须先读取本技能并按其中的消歧流程向用户追问确认后再处理，不可臆断直接创建。
description_zh: 企业微信日程管理。当用户需要预约日程、预订会议室、查看/更新/取消日程或查忙闲时触发。本技能负责『日程』——即不含在线会议链接的安排（也涵盖纯线下面对面碰头）；若用户要的是『在线会议』（含会议号/入会链接、可远程或视频参会），改用 wecomcli-meeting 技能。用户仅说“开会/约个会/某会”等、未明确要创建的是日程还是在线会议时，必须先读取本技能并按其中的消歧流程向用户追问确认后再处理，不可臆断直接创建。

description: Plans, executes, and validates Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster upgrades and maintenance operations for both Standard and Autopilot clusters. Produces upgrade plans, pre/post-upgrade checklists, maintenance runbooks with gcloud commands, release channel strategy, and troubleshooting guides. Handles node pool upgrade strategies (surge, blue-green), version compatibility, PDB management, and workload-specific concerns (stateful, GPU, operators). Use this skill whenever the user mentions GKE upgrades, Kubernetes version bumps, node pool maintenance, GKE patching, cluster version management, release channel selection, maintenance windows, surge upgrades, stuck upgrades, or any GKE lifecycle management task — even casual mentions like "we need to upgrade our clusters" or "plan our next GKE maintenance" or "our upgrade is stuck." Don't use for GKE cluster creation, application onboarding, general networking/routing setup, or security policy configurations (use gke-basics or relevant GKE skills instead).
description_zh:
为标准和自动驾驶集群（Autopilot）的升级与维护操作进行规划、执行与验证。

制定升级计划、升级前/后检查清单、包含 gcloud 命令的维护运行手册、发布渠道策略以及排障指南。

负责节点池升级策略（突发、蓝绿）、版本兼容性、PDB（Pod 中断预算）管理，以及处理（有状态、GPU 和 Operator）等特定工作负载的相关需求。

当用户提及 GKE 升级、Kubernetes 版本升级、节点池维护、GKE 补丁、集群版本管理、发布渠道选择、维护窗口、突发升级、卡住的升级或任何 GKE 生命周期管理任务时，均使用本技能——即使涉及“我们需要升级集群”、“规划下一次 GKE 维护”或“我们的升级卡住了”等日常性提及。

不适用于 GKE 集群创建、应用接入、通用网络与路由配置以及安全策略配置（请改用 gke-basics 或相关的 GKE 技能）。

description: Run /architect when choosing between approaches, designing a feature or page, picking a tech stack, or when /develop says a decision is owed, anytime a load bearing technical decision is unmade. Asks deep questions, recommends an answer, and writes a build spec to docs/specs/. Owns all spec files.
description_zh: 在多种方案之间进行选择、设计功能或页面、选择技术栈时，或在 /develop 表明需要做出决策时，以及任何关键性技术决策尚未决定时，运行 /architect。深入提问，推荐解决方案，并在 docs/specs/ 中编写构建规范。负责所有规范文件。

description: README construction — initialize template structure, generate per-package READMEs from doc comments, plan writing tasks, assemble root README from docs/ and package READMEs via doc.json config, and verify edits with `plan drift`.
description_zh: README 构建——初始化模板结构，根据文档注释生成各包 README，规划写作任务，通过 doc.json 配置，依据 docs/ 与包 README 组装根 README，并使用 `plan drift` 校验修改。

description: Use k-skill-proxy to search Korean listed stocks, inspect KRX base information, and fetch daily trade snapshots without asking the user to issue a KRX API key.
description_zh: 使用 k-skill-proxy 搜索韩国上市股票、检查 KRX 基础信息，并获取每日交易快照，无需用户提供 KRX API 密钥。

description: App Store and Google Play screenshot creation with exact platform specs. Covers iOS/Android dimensions, gallery ordering, device mockups, and preview videos. Use for: app store optimization, ASO, app screenshots, app preview, play store listing. Triggers: app store screenshots, aso, app store optimization, play store screenshots, app preview, app listing, ios screenshots, android screenshots, app store images, app mockup, device mockup, app gallery, store listing
description_zh: App Store 与 Google Play 截图制作，支持精确平台规格。涵盖 iOS/Android 尺寸、画廊排序、设备模型图及预览视频。用途：应用商店优化、ASO、应用截图、应用预览、Play Store 上架列表。触发词：应用商店截图、ASO、应用商店优化、应用商店截图、应用预览、应用列表、iOS 截图、Android 截图、应用商店图片、应用模型图、设备模型图、应用画廊、商店列表

description: Build, modify, and ship Grafana dashboards as JSON via the HTTP API — panel types (timeseries / stat / gauge / table / heatmap / logs / traces / node-graph), `gridPos` 24-column layout, units, thresholds, template + datasource + chained variables, transformations (`organize` / `calculateField` / `filterByValue`), panel + dashboard links with `${__field.labels.x}` / `${__from}`, and Loki/Prometheus annotations. Use when scripting dashboard creation, writing the dashboard JSON for a new service, adding a `$job` dropdown variable, computing an "Error %" column with a transformation, overlaying deploys as annotations, or pushing a dashboard via `POST /api/dashboards/db` — even when the user says "create a dashboard for this metric", "add a service dropdown", "show errors as percentage", "overlay our deploys", or "export the dashboard JSON" without naming the API or schema. After every API push, verify with the returned `version` plus a GET on the dashboard UID.
description_zh: 通过 HTTP API 以 JSON 格式构建、修改和发布 Grafana 仪表盘 —— 面板类型（时间序列 / 统计 / 仪表盘 / 表格 / 热力图 / 日志 / 追踪 / 节点图），`gridPos` 24 列布局，单位，阈值，模板 + 数据源 + 链式变量，变换（`organize` / `calculateField` / `filterByValue`），面板 + 仪表盘链接，以及使用 `${__field.labels.x}` / `${__from}`，Loki/Prometheus 注释。当编写仪表盘创建脚本、为新服务编写仪表盘 JSON、添加 `$job` 下拉变量、使用变换计算“错误 %”列、将部署覆盖为注释、或通过 `POST /api/dashboards/db` 推送仪表盘时使用 —— 即使用户说“为这个指标创建仪表盘”、“添加服务下拉菜单”、“以百分比显示错误”、“覆盖我们的部署”，或“导出仪表盘 JSON”而未提及 API 或 schema。在每次通过 API 推送后，使用返回的 `version` 以及对该仪表盘 UID 执行 GET 请求进行验证。

description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Use Angular CLI and development tools effectively in Angular v20+ projects. Use for project setup, code generation, building, testing, and configuration. Triggers on creating new projects, generating components/services/modules, configuring builds, running tests, or optimizing production builds. Don't use for Nx workspace commands, custom Webpack configurations, or non-Angular CLI build systems like Vite standalone or esbuild direct usage.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 此技能未维护。请改用官方 Angular 技能（https://github.com/angular/skills）。在 Angular v20+ 项目中有效使用 Angular CLI 和开发工具。用于项目初始化、代码生成、构建、测试和配置。当创建新项目、生成组件/服务/模块、配置构建、运行测试或优化生产构建时触发。不用于 Nx 工作区命令、自定义 Webpack 配置，或不使用 Angular CLI 的构建系统（如直接使用 Vite standalone 或 esbuild）。

description: Prepares codebases for security review using Trail of Bits' checklist. Helps set review goals, runs static analysis tools, increases test coverage, removes dead code, ensures accessibility, and generates documentation (flowcharts, user stories, inline comments). Use when preparing your own codebase to be audited by someone else, getting a repository review-ready before an external security review, deciding what to fix before auditors start, or asking what assessors need from a project. For understanding unfamiliar code you are about to audit, use audit-context-building instead.
description_zh:
使用Trail of Bits的检查清单为代码库准备安全审查。帮助设定审查目标、运行静态分析工具、提高测试覆盖率、移除冗余代码、确保可访问性，并生成文档（流程图、用户故事、行内注释）。

适用场景包括：为他人审计自己的代码库、在外部安全审查前将代码库准备至审查就绪状态、在审计师开始前决定需要修复的问题，或询问评估者需要项目的哪些内容。

对于即将审计的陌生代码，请使用audit-context-building。

description: Extract text from scanned PDFs using optical character recognition
description_zh: 使用光学字符识别从扫描的PDF文件中提取文本

description: Riot 공식 LoL Esports 데이터와 Oracle's Elixir 스타일 historical 데이터로 LCK 경기 결과, 현재 순위, live turning point, 밴픽 matchup/synergy, patch meta, 팀 파워 레이팅을 조회한다.
description_zh: 利用 Riot 官方 LoL 电竞数据与 Oracle's Elixir 风格历史数据，可查询 LCK 比赛结果、当前排名、实时转折点、ban/pick 对阵/协同、版本 meta 及队伍实力评级。

description: Generate EventSettings metadata to enable or disable Platform Tracing (TraceSpanEvent publishing) in Event Monitoring. Use this skill for any EventSettings enablePlatformTracing metadata work. TRIGGER when: user mentions Platform Tracing, TraceSpanEvent, enable tracing in Event Monitoring Settings, event monitoring tracing toggle, enablePlatformTracing, .settings-meta.xml for Event settings tracing, turn on trace span events, or stop publishing trace spans. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants Agentforce agent tracing to Data Cloud (use platform-tracing-agentforce-configure), wants Event Log Files or ELF generation, wants Change Data Capture (use integration-eventing-cdc-configure), or wants ManagedEventSubscription (use integration-eventing-subscription-configure).
description_zh:
生成 EventSettings 元数据，以在事件监控中启用或禁用平台追踪（TraceSpanEvent 发布）。此技能适用于所有 EventSettings enablePlatformTracing 元数据相关工作。

**触发条件（TRIGGER when）：** 当用户提及以下内容时触发：平台追踪、TraceSpanEvent、在事件监控设置中启用追踪、事件监控追踪开关、enablePlatformTracing、用于事件设置追踪的 .settings-meta.xml、开启跟踪跨度事件，或停止发布跟踪跨度。

**不要触发（DO NOT TRIGGER when）：** 当用户想要将 Agentforce 代理追踪发送到 Data Cloud（使用 platform-tracing-agentforce-configure）、想要事件日志文件或 ELF 生成、想要变更数据捕获（使用 integration-eventing-cdc-configure），或想要 ManagedEventSubscription（使用 integration-eventing-subscription-configure）时，不要触发。

description: 한강홍수통제소 기반 현재 수위/유량을 관측소명 또는 관측소코드로 조회한다. 기본 경로는 k-skill-proxy의 han-river water-level endpoint다.

description_zh: 精通 TypeScript、Node.js、Next.js App Router、React、Shadcn UI、Radix UI 和 Tailwind

description: Search Joseon Dynasty Annals records from the official sillok.history.go.kr site with keyword search plus optional king/year narrowing.
description_zh: 在官方网站 sillok.history.go.kr 上搜索朝鲜王朝实录记录，支持关键词搜索，并可按国王/年份进行筛选。

description: 번개장터 검색, 상세조회, 찜, 채팅, 대량 수집, AI TOON export를 bunjang-cli로 안내한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 bunjang-cli 引导闪商城的搜索、详情查看、收藏、聊天、批量采集和 AI TOON 导出。锤子则通过官方界面推进后续操作。

description: Clarify brand messaging using narrative structure that positions the customer as hero. Use when the user mentions "brand message", "website copy", "elevator pitch", "one-liner", "brand script", "StoryBrand framework", "customer as hero", or "my messaging isnt resonating". Also trigger when rewriting homepage copy, crafting email nurture sequences, or creating consistent messaging across sales and marketing collateral. Covers landing page copy, marketing collateral, and consistent communication. For memorable messaging, see made-to-stick. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome.
description_zh: 采用将客户定位为主角的叙事结构，明确品牌信息。当用户提及“品牌信息”、“网站文案”、“电梯演讲”、“一句话”、“品牌脚本”、“StoryBrand 框架”、“客户为主角”或“我的信息没有共鸣”时使用。在重写首页文案、构思邮件培育序列或确保销售与营销宣传材料中的信息保持一致时，也需触发。涵盖落地页文案、营销宣传材料及一致性的沟通。如需打造令人记住的信息，请参阅 made-to-stick。如需进行产品定位，请参阅 obviously-awesome。

description: Creates custom Semgrep rules for detecting security vulnerabilities, bug patterns, and code patterns. Use when writing Semgrep rules or building custom static analysis detections.
description_zh: 创建用于检测安全漏洞、错误模式和代码模式的自定义 Semgrep 规则。在编写 Semgrep 规则或构建自定义静态分析检测时使用。

description: 把一篇文章或口播稿，做成"看起来像视频"的点击驱动 16:9 网页演示，可选合成口播音频。流程：原始文章 → **一次产出**口播稿 + outline 开发计划 → 用户**一次对齐** 5 件事（稿子 / outline / 主题 / 素材 / 开发模式）→ 网页开发（逐章 / 顺序 / 并行）→ 可选音频合成（provider-agnostic：内置 MiniMax mmx-cli + OpenAI TTS，可换 ElevenLabs / edge-tts / Azure / 自带 TTS）。**outline 只规划节奏与信息密度，不规划动画** —— 动画由章节开发时按 PRINCIPLES + ANTI-AI 法则即时设计。每次点击推进口播稿的一个节拍，每一步独占整屏，进度条平时隐藏只在悬浮时出现。适用场景：用网页做视频（动态 PPT 但不像 PPT）、把口播稿 / 文章变成可交互的解说、为 B 站 / YouTube / 视频号录屏教程、做有电影感的产品 / talk demo。本 Skill 沉淀的是设计方法论 + 协作流程 —— 不绑定任何特定样式 / 字体 / 颜色 —— 因此能复用到任意主题与美学。
description_zh: 把一篇文章或口播稿，做成"看起来像视频"的点击驱动 16:9 网页演示，可选合成口播音频。流程：原始文章 → **一次产出**口播稿 + outline 开发计划 → 用户**一次对齐** 5 件事（稿子 / outline / 主题 / 素材 / 开发模式）→ 网页开发（逐章 / 顺序 / 并行）→ 可选音频合成（provider-agnostic：内置 MiniMax mmx-cli + OpenAI TTS，可换 ElevenLabs / edge-tts / Azure / 自带 TTS）。**outline 只规划节奏与信息密度，不规划动画** —— 动画由章节开发时按 PRINCIPLES + ANTI-AI 法则即时设计。每次点击推进口播稿的一个节拍，每一步独占整屏，进度条平时隐藏只在悬浮时出现。适用场景：用网页做视频（动态 PPT 但不像 PPT）、把口播稿 / 文章变成可交互的解说、为 B 站 / YouTube / 视频号录屏教程、做有电影感的产品 / talk demo。本 Skill 沉淀的是设计方法论 + 协作流程 —— 不绑定任何特定样式 / 字体 / 颜色 —— 因此能复用到任意主题与美学。

description: Configures EC2 instances to securely call AWS services by creating and attaching IAM roles via instance profiles, eliminating hardcoded credentials. Use when an EC2 instance needs permissions to access AWS services like S3, DynamoDB, SQS, or CloudWatch through temporary credentials.
description_zh: 通过创建并附加实例配置文件来创建和关联IAM角色，使EC2实例能够安全调用AWS服务，从而消除硬编码凭据。当EC2实例需要借助临时凭据访问S3、DynamoDB、SQS或CloudWatch等AWS服务时使用。

description: Unix 气质的演讲设计与保真排版。把 Org/Markdown 提纲或经授权提炼的讲稿制成单文件离线 HTML；以语义角色选择巨句、对照、Unicode 关系图、证据与章节版式。默认深色，支持讲稿层、原生图表与翻页笔。USE WHEN present、做演讲、slides、按 outline 美化、把讲述精髓放上屏幕。NOT FOR 未经授权改写作者内容或生成企业 PPT。
description_zh: Unix 气质的演讲设计与保真排版。将 Org/Markdown 提纲或经授权提炼的讲稿制作成单文件离线 HTML；通过语义角色选择巨句、对照、Unicode 关系图、证据与章节版式。默认采用深色模式，支持讲稿层、原生图表与翻页笔。适用于存在讲稿、进行演讲、制作幻灯片、按提纲美化、将讲述精髓呈现于屏幕时。不适用于未经授权改写作者内容或生成企业 PPT。

description: Live SEO data via DataForSEO MCP server: SERP analysis, keyword research (volume, difficulty, intent, trends), backlink profiles, on-page analysis, competitor and content analysis, business listings, AI visibility (LLM mention tracking), and domain analytics. Requires DataForSEO extension installed. Use when user says "dataforseo", "live SERP", "keyword volume", "backlink data", "AI visibility check", or "real search data".
description_zh: 通过 DataForSEO MCP 服务器获取实时 SEO 数据：SERP 分析、关键词研究（搜索量、难度、意图、趋势）、反向链接档案、页面优化分析、竞争对手和内容分析、商户列表、AI 可见性（大语言模型提及追踪）及域名分析。需要安装 DataForSEO 扩展。当用户提及 "dataforseo"、"live SERP"、"keyword volume"、"backlink data"、"AI visibility check" 或 "real search data" 时使用。

description: Audit an existing product surface against its own design evidence, identify verified UI problems, and write self-contained implementation plans for another agent. Strictly read-only on product source. Use when asked to review, refine, improve, or clean up an interface without replacing its identity; investigate design-system drift; or prepare a design handoff.
description_zh: 针对现有产品界面，对照其自身设计证据进行审计，识别已验证的界面问题，并为另一个智能体编写自包含的实施方案。严格对产品源只读。当被要求审查、优化、改进或清理界面且不改变其原有身份时使用；调查设计系统漂移；或准备设计交接。

description: Creates a production-ready VPC with public and private subnets across multiple Availability Zones, including internet gateway, NAT gateways, route tables, and security groups following AWS Well-Architected principles. Use when deploying multi-AZ VPC infrastructure with automatic CIDR planning and DNS resolution.
description_zh: 创建符合 AWS 健全架构原则、在多个可用区上配置公共子网和私有子网的生产就绪 VPC，包括互联网网关、NAT 网关、路由表和安全组。在部署多可用区 VPC 基础设施并使用自动 CIDR 规划与 DNS 解析时使用。

description: Generate AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings metadata to enable or disable Agentforce agent execution trace spans flowing to Data Cloud. Use this skill for any AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings metadata work. TRIGGER when: user mentions Agentforce tracing, agent trace spans, Data Cloud tracing, AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings, platform observability tracing, enable agent tracing, wants agent execution spans in Data Cloud, mentions .settings-meta.xml for AgentforcePlatformTracing, or asks about enabling observability for Agentforce agents. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants Platform Tracing for TraceSpanEvent (use platform-tracing-configure), wants to query or analyze existing agent trace data in Data Cloud (use agentforce-observe), wants Event Log Files or ELF configuration, wants Change Data Capture (use integration-eventing-cdc-configure), or wants ManagedEventSubscription (use integration-eventing-subscription-configure).
description_zh:
生成 AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings 元数据，以启用或禁用流向 Data Cloud 的 Agentforce 代理执行追踪跨度。针对任何 AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings 元数据相关工作，请使用此技能。

**TRIGGER 触发条件：**
- 用户提及 Agentforce 追踪、代理追踪跨度、Data Cloud 追踪、AgentforcePlatformTracingSettings、平台可观测性追踪、启用代理追踪、希望获得 Data Cloud 中的代理执行追踪跨度、提及用于 AgentforcePlatformTracing 的 .settings-meta.xml，或询问如何为 Agentforce 代理启用可观测性。

**DO NOT TRIGGER 不要触发条件：**
- 用户需要为 TraceSpanEvent 进行平台追踪（使用 platform-tracing-configure）
- 用户需要查询或分析 Data Cloud 中已有的代理追踪数据（使用 agentforce-observe）
- 用户需要 Event Log Files 或 ELF 配置
- 用户需要变更数据捕获（使用 integration-eventing-cdc-configure）
- 用户需要 ManagedEventSubscription（使用 integration-eventing-subscription-configure）

description: Configure Cedar policy enforcement and Ed25519 signed receipts for Claude Code tool calls. Use when setting up projects that need cryptographic audit trails, policy-gated tool execution, or compliance-ready evidence of agent actions.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 工具调用配置 Cedar 策略执行和 Ed25519 签名收据。当设置需要密码学审计追踪、策略门控工具执行，或可满足合规要求的智能体操作证据的项目时使用。

description: 让 issues 和 external PRs 通过一组 triage roles 状态机——分类、验证、必要时 grilling，并写出 agent-ready briefs。
description_zh: 让问题与外部 PR 通过一组分诊角色状态机——分类、验证，并在必要时进行审查，同时撰写供智能体使用的简报。

description: Search Korean patent and utility-model publications through the official KIPRIS Plus Open API with keyword search plus application-number detail lookup.
description_zh: 通过官方 KIPRIS Plus Open API，结合关键词检索与应用号详情查询，检索韩国专利和实用新型公开文献。

description: Generates, formats, and validates technical documentation — including docstrings, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, JSDoc annotations, doc portals, and user guides. Use when adding docstrings to functions or classes, creating API documentation, building documentation sites, or writing tutorials and user guides. Invoke for OpenAPI/Swagger specs, JSDoc, doc portals, getting started guides.
description_zh: 生成、格式化并校验技术文档——包括文档字符串、OpenAPI/Swagger 规范、JSDoc 注解、文档门户和用户指南。在向函数或类添加文档字符串、创建 API 文档、构建文档站点，或编写教程和用户指南时使用。对 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范、JSDoc、文档门户、入门指南调用。

description: Create, read, update, and delete ManagedEventSubscription metadata in Salesforce. Use this skill for any work involving managed event subscriptions, platform event subscriptions, event channel subscribers, or .managedEventSubscription-meta.xml files. TRIGGER when: user asks to subscribe to a platform event, create a managed subscription, set up event replay, configure an event channel subscriber, update replay preset, activate or deactivate a subscription, delete a subscription, or manage ManagedEventSubscription metadata. SKIP when: user needs to create the platform event channel itself (use platform-custom-object-generate skill) or needs Flow-based event subscriptions (use automation-flow-generate skill).
description_zh: 在 Salesforce 中创建、读取、更新和删除 ManagedEventSubscription 元数据。使用此技能处理任何涉及托管事件订阅、平台事件订阅、事件通道订阅者或 .managedEventSubscription-meta.xml 文件的工作。触发条件为：用户要求订阅平台事件、创建托管订阅、设置事件重放、配置事件通道订阅者、更新重放预设、激活或停用订阅、删除订阅或管理 ManagedEventSubscription 元数据。跳过条件为：用户需要自行创建平台事件通道（使用 platform-custom-object-generate 技能）或需要使用基于 Flow 的事件订阅（使用 automation-flow-generate 技能）。

description: Analyzes smart contract codebases to identify state-changing entry points for security auditing. Detects externally callable functions that modify state, categorizes them by access level (public, admin, role-restricted, contract-only), and generates structured audit reports. Excludes view/pure/read-only functions. Use when auditing smart contracts (Solidity, Vyper, Solana/Rust, Move, TON, CosmWasm) or when asked to find entry points, audit flows, external functions, access control patterns, or privileged operations.
description_zh: 分析智能合约代码库，以识别用于安全审计的状态变更入口点。检测可外部调用的修改状态的函数，按访问级别（公共、管理、角色受限、仅合约）进行分类，并生成结构化的审计报告。排除视图函数、纯函数和只读函数。适用于审计智能合约（Solidity、Vyper、Solana/Rust、Move、TON、CosmWasm），或在需要查找入口点、审计流程、外部函数、访问控制模式或特权操作时使用。

description: ALWAYS USE THIS SKILL for anything involving Salesforce Archive (also called Trusted Services Archive) — search, view, unarchive, analyze, mask, and erase (RTBF) archived records via the Archive Connect API, and reading archive job status from the ArchiveActivity object. TRIGGER when: user mentions Salesforce Archive, Trusted Services Archive, archive/unarchive records, ArchiveActivity, archive jobs, archive policy, archive analyzer, archived record search, archive storage, archive failure logs, right to be forgotten / RTBF on archived data, or masking archived PII — including phrasings like 'find records that were archived', 'restore archived data', 'why did the archive job fail', 'download the archive failure log', or 'monitor my archive jobs', AND even when they ask you to explain, give guidance, or write a runbook/doc about these topics rather than run code. SKIP when: the user wants generic data-export/backup unrelated to the Archive add-on, or wants to build the archive policy UI metadata.
description_zh:
始终使用此技能处理任何涉及 Salesforce Archive（也称为 Trusted Services Archive）的内容——通过 Archive Connect API 搜索、查看、解除归档、分析、脱敏并删除（RTBF）归档记录，并从 ArchiveActivity 对象读取归档作业状态。

触发条件：当用户提及 Salesforce Archive、Trusted Services Archive、归档/解除归档记录、ArchiveActivity、归档作业、归档策略、归档分析器、归档记录搜索、归档存储、归档故障日志、对归档数据的被遗忘权 / RTBF（被遗忘权），或对归档 PII 进行脱敏时触发——包括诸如 '查找被归档的记录'、'恢复归档数据'、'归档作业为何失败'、'下载归档故障日志'、'监控我的归档作业' 等表述，即便他们要求你解释、提供指导或撰写关于这些主题的操作手册/文档，而不是运行代码，也触发。

跳过条件：当用户想要与 Archive 附加组件无关的通用数据导出/备份，或想要构建归档策略 UI 元数据时，跳过。

description: ISV App Analytics metadata types — AppAnalyticsQueryRequest and AppAnalyticsSettings. Use this skill when the user asks about retrieving managed package usage data, configuring App Analytics simulation mode, querying subscriber snapshots, or understanding the AppAnalyticsQueryRequest lifecycle (New → Pending → Complete → Expired). TRIGGER when: user mentions App Analytics, AppAnalyticsQueryRequest, AppAnalyticsSettings, package usage data, subscriber analytics, ISV analytics, or simulation mode for app analytics. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is about standard Salesforce reports/dashboards (use reporting skills), custom SOQL on Account/Contact (use platform-soql-query).
description_zh: ISV App Analytics 元数据类型 — AppAnalyticsQueryRequest 和 AppAnalyticsSettings。当用户询问获取托管包使用数据、配置 App Analytics 模拟模式、查询订阅者快照，或了解 AppAnalyticsQueryRequest 生命周期（New → Pending → Complete → Expired）时，使用此技能。触发条件：用户提及 App Analytics、AppAnalyticsQueryRequest、AppAnalyticsSettings、包使用数据、订阅者分析、ISV 分析，或 App Analytics 模拟模式。不得触发：任务涉及标准 Salesforce 报表/仪表盘（使用报告技能），或在 Account/Contact 上执行自定义 SOQL（使用 platform-soql-query）。

description: Writes, refactors, and evaluates prompts for LLMs — generating optimized prompt templates, structured output schemas, evaluation rubrics, and test suites.
