Use when designing prompts for new LLM applications, refactoring existing prompts for better accuracy or token efficiency, implementing chain-of-thought or few-shot learning, creating system prompts with personas and guardrails, building JSON/function-calling schemas, or developing prompt evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.
description_zh: 为 LLM 编写、重构并评估提示词——生成优化后的提示模板、结构化输出 schema、评估标准及测试套件。适用于为新 LLM 应用设计提示词、重构现有提示词以提升准确性和 token 效率、实现思维链或少样本学习、创建带有角色设定和护栏的系统提示词、构建 JSON/函数调用 schema，或开发提示词评估框架，以衡量并提升模型性能。

description: Use to enable Salesforce Change Data Capture (CDC) on a standard or custom object, configure a custom event channel, set a filter expression, or add enrichment fields. TRIGGER broadly on any of: 'enable CDC', 'enable Change Data Capture', 'turn on CDC', 'subscribe X to change events', 'only emit events for', 'filter change events', 'enrich change events', 'create a custom event channel'; or any mention of CDC, change events, PlatformEventChannel, PlatformEventChannelMember, EnrichedField, ChangeEvents channel, enrichment fields, change event filter; or when the user wants a downstream system to receive Salesforce data changes; or when the user touches .platformEventChannelMember-meta.xml / .platformEventChannel-meta.xml files. SKIP when publishing platform events, Pub/Sub API or REST/SOAP (use integration-connectivity-generate), or ManagedEventSubscription (out of scope for CDC). Always use this skill for CDC channel-membership metadata.
description_zh: 用于在标准或自定义对象上启用 Salesforce 变更数据捕获（CDC），配置自定义事件通道，设置过滤表达式，或添加富化字段。当出现以下情况时，触发：'启用 CDC'、'启用变更数据捕获'、'开启 CDC'、'将 X 订阅至变更事件'、'仅针对...发出事件'、'过滤变更事件'、'富化变更事件'、'创建自定义事件通道'；或提及 CDC、变更事件、平台事件通道、平台事件通道成员、富化字段、变更事件通道、富化字段、变更事件过滤；或当用户希望下游系统接收 Salesforce 数据变更时；或当用户接触 .platformEventChannelMember-meta.xml / .platformEventChannel-meta.xml 文件时。当发布平台事件、Pub/Sub API 或 REST/SOAP（使用 integration-connectivity-generate），或 ManagedEventSubscription（不属于 CDC 范围）时，跳过。对于 CDC 通道成员元数据，始终使用该技能。

description: Create a design brief through an interactive interview, codebase exploration, and experience design decisions. Saved as a markdown file in the project. Use when user wants to write a design brief, plan a new feature or page, define a UI direction, or mentions "brief".
description_zh: 通过互动访谈、代码库探索和体验设计决策，创建设计简报。保存为项目中的 Markdown 文件。当用户希望撰写设计简报、规划新功能或页面、定义 UI 方向，或提及“brief”时使用。

description: AI image generation for SEO assets: OG/social preview images, blog hero images, schema images, product photography, infographics. Powered by Gemini via nanobanana-mcp. Requires banana extension installed. Use when user says "generate image", "OG image", "social preview", "hero image", "blog image", "product photo", "infographic", "seo image", "create visual", "image-gen", "favicon", "schema image", "pinterest pin", "generate visual", "banner", or "thumbnail".
description_zh: 用于 SEO 资产的 AI 图像生成：OG/社交预览图片、博客首屏图片、schema 图片、产品摄影、信息图表。由 Gemini 通过 nanobanana-mcp 提供支持。需要安装 banana 扩展。当用户说以下内容时使用：“生成图片”、“OG 图片”、“社交预览”、“首屏图片”、“博客图片”、“产品照片”、“信息图”、“SEO 图片”、“创建视觉”、“图像生成”、“favicon”、“schema 图片”、“Pinterest 贴纸”、“生成视觉”、“横幅”或“缩略图”。

description: Search issues, merged pull requests, and READMEs from public code repositories, plus curated documentation. Use when the question is how a library or API behaves, what an error means, or whether a bug was fixed; prefer this over a general web page.
description_zh: 从公开代码仓库中搜索问题、已合并的 Pull Request 以及 README，以及精选的文档。用于回答库或 API 的行为、错误含义，以及某个 bug 是否已修复等问题；相比通用网页，应优先使用本功能。

description: MUST activate before editing ANY file under uiBundles/*/src/ (or the bundle's index.html) for visual or UI changes to an EXISTING app — pages, components, sections, layout, styling, colors, fonts, navigation, animations, branding, or any look-and-feel change. Use this skill when modifying pages, components, layout, styling, navigation, or branding in an existing UI bundle app. Activate when the project contains appLayout.tsx, routes.tsx, src/pages/, src/components/, src/styles/global.css, or the bundle's index.html. This skill contains critical project-specific conventions (appLayout.tsx shell, shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS, Salesforce base-path routing, module restrictions) that override general knowledge. Without this skill, generated code will use wrong imports, break routing, or ignore project structure. Do NOT use when creating a new app from scratch or the bundle has not been scaffolded yet (use experience-ui-bundle-app-coordinate instead).
description_zh: **必须在编辑 `uiBundles/*/src/`（或对应的 bundle 的 `index.html`）下的任何文件之前激活**，以对现有应用进行视觉或 UI 修改——包括对**现有**应用的页面、组件、模块、布局、样式、颜色、字体、导航、动画、品牌标识，或任何外观与风格修改。当需要对现有 UI bundle 应用中的页面、组件、布局、样式、导航或品牌进行修改时，请使用此技能。在项目包含 `appLayout.tsx`、`routes.tsx`、`src/pages/`、`src/components/`、`src/styles/global.css`，或 bundle 的 `index.html` 时激活。此技能包含关键的项目特定规范（`appLayout.tsx` 外壳、shadcn/ui 组件、Tailwind CSS、Salesforce base-path 路由、模块限制），这些规范将覆盖一般知识。若不使用此技能，生成的代码将出现错误的导入、路由失效，或忽略项目结构。**当从零创建新应用，或 bundle 尚未脚手架搭建完成时，请勿使用**（请使用 experience-ui-bundle-app-coordinate 代替）。

description: Use when the user asks for 생활쓰레기 배출 요일/시간/장소 정보 by 지역명(시군구) and wants official data.go.kr household waste guidance.
description_zh: 使用场景：当用户根据地区名称（市、区、郡、邑、洞等）询问生活垃圾排放的日期、时间、地点信息，并要求使用官方 data.go.kr 生活垃圾指引时。

description: Set up and maintain the Parallel CLI (install, auth, balance, skills install)
description_zh: 配置并维护 Parallel CLI（安装、认证、余额、技能安装）

description: Use before UI-related work to select the smallest useful UI Skills context through the ui-skills CLI.
description_zh: 在UI相关工作之前，通过 ui-skills CLI 选择最小的有用 UI Skills 上下文。

description: Read-only live SRT timetable and seat-availability lookup through the SRTrain search path. No login, reservation, payment, cancellation, exact seat selection, or automated monitoring.
description_zh: 通过 SRTrain 搜索路径，以只读方式查询实时 SRT 时刻表和座位可用性。无需登录、预订、支付、取消、精确选座或自动化监控。

description: Performs code upgrades, migrations, and transformations using the AWS Transform (ATX) CLI. Use when upgrading language versions, migrating AWS SDKs, migrating frameworks (Angular, Vue.js, Spring Boot, React), upgrading libraries, optimizing performance, migrating x86 to Graviton, analyzing codebases / generating documentation, or defining custom transformations with natural language. Runs locally on a few repositories or at scale across hundreds via AWS Batch/Fargate.
description_zh: 使用 AWS Transform (ATX) CLI 执行代码升级、迁移和转换，适用于升级语言版本、迁移 AWS SDK、迁移框架（Angular、Vue.js、Spring Boot、React）、升级库、优化性能、将 x86 迁移至 Graviton、分析代码库/生成文档，或利用自然语言定义自定义转换时。可在本地针对少数仓库运行，或通过 AWS Batch/Fargate 以大规模处理数百个仓库。

description: Builds security-focused full-stack web applications by implementing integrated frontend and backend components with layered security at every level. Covers the complete stack from database to UI, enforcing auth, input validation, output encoding, and parameterized queries across all layers. Use when implementing features across frontend and backend, building REST APIs with corresponding UI, connecting frontend components to backend endpoints, creating end-to-end data flows from database to UI, or implementing CRUD operations with UI forms. Distinct from frontend-only, backend-only, or API-only skills in that it simultaneously addresses all three perspectives—Frontend, Backend, and Security—within a single implementation workflow. Invoke for full-stack feature work, web app development, authenticated API routes with views, microservices, real-time features, monorepo architecture, or technology selection decisions.
description_zh: 通过集成前端与后端组件并在每个层级实施分层安全，构建注重安全的全栈Web应用。覆盖从数据库到用户界面的完整技术栈，在所有层级强制执行身份验证、输入验证、输出编码与参数化查询。适用于在前后端实现功能、构建带对应界面的REST API、连接前端组件与后端端点、从数据库到用户界面构建端到端数据流，或结合UI表单实施CRUD操作等场景。与仅前端、仅后端或仅API的技能不同，该技能在单一实施工作流中同时兼顾前端、后端与安全三个视角。适用于全栈功能开发、Web应用开发、带有视图的身份验证API路由、微服务、实时功能、单体仓库架构或技术选型决策等工作。

description: Enables internet access for AWS Lambda functions deployed in VPC subnets by creating NAT Gateway infrastructure, configuring public/private subnet routing, and updating security groups. Use when a VPC-attached Lambda function cannot reach the internet.
description_zh: 通过创建 NAT 网关基础设施、配置公有/私有子网路由并更新安全组，为部署在 VPC 子网中的 AWS Lambda 函数启用互联网访问。当与 VPC 关联的 Lambda 函数无法访问互联网时使用。
您提供的内容为空，没有需要翻译的文本，因此无法进行翻译。请提供具体的需要翻译的内容，我将为您进行准确的简体中文翻译。

description: Prepare and execute negotiations using tactical empathy, calibrated questions, and the Ackerman method. Use when the user mentions "salary negotiation", "contract terms", "handling objections", "mirroring and labeling", "difficult conversation", "deal terms", "BATNA", "anchoring", "how do I ask for a raise", "get a better deal", or "they wont budge on price". Also trigger when preparing for a vendor negotiation, resolving a pricing dispute, or navigating a high-stakes conversation where both sides need to feel heard. Covers accusation audits, Black Swan discovery, and the "Thats Right" technique. For persuasion in product and marketing, see influence-psychology.
description_zh: 使用战术性同理心、校准的问题和 Ackerman 方法准备并执行谈判。当用户提到“薪资谈判”、“合同条款”、“处理异议”、“镜像与标注”、“困难对话”、“交易条款”、“BATNA”、“锚定效应”、“如何要求加薪”、“获得更好的交易”或“他们不会在价格上让步”时使用。当为供应商谈判做准备、解决价格争议或应对高风险对话且双方都需要感到被倾听时，也会触发。涵盖指控审计、黑天鹅发现以及“That's Right”技巧。关于产品和营销领域的说服，请参考 influence-psychology。

description: Create publication-quality visualizations with Python. Use when turning query results or a DataFrame into a chart, selecting the right chart type for a trend or comparison, generating a plot for a report or presentation, or needing an interactive chart with hover and zoom.
description_zh: 使用 Python 创建出版级可视化图表。当需要将查询结果或 DataFrame 转化为图表、为趋势或对比选择合适的图表类型、为报告或演示生成图表，或需要具备悬停和缩放功能的交互式图表时使用。

description: Delegate a coding task to the OpenCode CLI as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to OpenCode — phrasings like "have OpenCode do X", "delegate this to OpenCode", "run it through OpenCode", or "use OpenCode to implement/fix/refactor" — or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through OpenCode while staying the reviewer. Prefer it when the user will review the diff and commit it themselves. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编程任务委派给 OpenCode CLI 作为后台实现者，随后审查其差异并自行提交。在用户希望将实现工作交由 OpenCode（例如使用“让 OpenCode 执行 X”、“将此任务委派给 OpenCode”、“通过 OpenCode 处理它”或“使用 OpenCode 实现/修复/重构”等表述），或希望将一批编程任务通过 OpenCode 批量处理、同时自己担任审查者的场景下，使用此策略。当用户将自行审查差异并提交时，优先使用此策略。**绝对不要**用于足够小可直接在线执行的任务，或当用户要求不委派而直接编写代码时。

description: Establishes VPC peering connections between two VPCs for direct private network connectivity. Always use this skill when creating or managing VPC peering — it validates CIDR overlap, updates all route tables in both VPCs, configures DNS resolution, and provides security group guidance that are critical for correct connectivity.
description_zh: 在两个 VPC 之间建立 VPC 对等连接，以实现直接私有网络连通性。在创建或管理 VPC 对等连接时，始终使用此技能——它验证 CIDR 重叠，更新两个 VPC 中的所有路由表，配置 DNS 解析，并提供对正确连通性至关重要的安全组指导。

description: Generate a standup update from recent activity. Use when preparing for daily standup, summarizing yesterday's commits and PRs and ticket moves, formatting work into yesterday/today/blockers, or structuring a few rough notes into a shareable update.
description_zh: 根据近期活动生成站会更新。适用于准备每日站会、总结昨日提交、拉取请求（PR）及工单变动，将工作按“昨日/今日/阻碍”分类，或将几条粗略笔记整理为可分享的更新等内容。
您提供的内容为空（仅包含一个“>”符号），没有需要翻译的源文本，因此无法进行翻译。如果您有具体的文本内容需要翻译，请提供完整的内容，我会为您准确、流畅地翻译为简体中文。

description: Run the full design-to-build workflow as a guided sequence. Orchestrates all designer skills in order, from grilling through review. Use when user wants to go through the complete design process, start a project from scratch, run the full flow, or mentions "design flow" or "full workflow".
description_zh: 以引导式序列运行完整的“设计到建造”工作流，按顺序调集所有设计师技能，涵盖从审阅到检查的全流程。适用于用户希望经历完整的“设计流程”、从零开始启动项目、运行全流程，或提及“设计流程”或“全流程”的情况。

description: Use for TypeScript style and type safety when editing TS/TSX/MTS, including imports, async code and error suppression.
description_zh: 用于编辑 TS/TSX/MTS 时的 TypeScript 风格与类型安全，包括导入、异步代码和错误抑制。

description: Amend a published CLI from one of two input sources: (1) dogfood mode mines the active Claude Code session transcript for friction (missing flags, hand- rolled API payloads, silent-null returns); (2) direct-input mode accepts user-supplied asks (rename a command, add commands or feeds, fix a named bug, optionally sniff the source site for new endpoints). Confirms scope with the user, plans + executes the fix autonomously, scrubs PII, and opens a PR against mvanhorn/printing-press-library. Two user-in-loop checkpoints: scope after capture, PR draft before open. Trigger phrases: "amend the CLI", "submit a patch", "fix what I just dogfooded", "open a PR for this CLI", "patch this CLI", "add features to my CLI", "rename this command", "add these feeds to <cli>", "sniff for new APIs in <cli>", "amend with these ideas", "use printing-press-amend", "run printing-press-amend".
description_zh:
从两个输入源之一修正一个已发布的CLI： (1) dogfood模式挖掘活跃的Claude Code会话记录以查找摩擦点（缺失的标志、手工构建的API负载、静默返回空值的结果）； (2) 直接输入模式接受用户提供的需求（重命名一个命令，添加命令或内容源，修复指定名称的Bug，可选地嗅探源站点以查找新端点）。与用户确认范围，自主规划和执行修复，清除个人身份信息（PII），并针对 mvanhorn/printing-press-library 打开一个Pull请求。

两个用户参与的检查点：捕获后确认范围，打开前草拟PR。

触发短语："修正该CLI"，"提交补丁"，"修复我刚才dogfooded的内容"，"为此CLI打开一个Pull请求"，"修补该CLI"，"为我的CLI添加功能"，"重命名该命令"，"为 <cli>"添加这些内容源"，"在 <cli>"中嗅探新API"，"结合这些想法进行修正"，"使用printing-press-amendor"，"运行printing-press-amendor"。

description: Use for Drizzle schemas and queries: tables, indexes, relations, joins and inferred types. Rollout belongs to db-migrations.
description_zh: 用于 Drizzle 模式与查询：表、索引、关系、连接和推断类型。Rollout 属于 db-migrations。

description: E-commerce SEO analysis: Google Shopping visibility, Amazon marketplace intelligence, product schema validation, competitor pricing analysis, and marketplace keyword gaps. Combines on-page product SEO with marketplace data from DataForSEO Merchant API. Use when user says "ecommerce SEO", "product SEO", "Google Shopping", "marketplace SEO", "product schema", "Amazon SEO", "product listings", "shopping ads", or "merchant SEO".
description_zh: 电子商务SEO分析：Google购物可见性、亚马逊市场情报、产品Schema验证、竞争对手定价分析以及市场关键词缺口。结合线上产品SEO与DataForSEO商户API提供的市场数据。当用户说“ecommerce SEO”、“product SEO”、“Google Shopping”、“marketplace SEO”、“product schema”、“Amazon SEO”、“product listings”、“shopping ads”或“merchant SEO”时使用。

description: MUST activate when the project has a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves deploying to an org or post-deploy org setup. Deploys a UI bundle app and runs ordered setup: org auth, build, metadata deploy, permission-set and role assignment, Experience Cloud self-registration, social login / SSO / IDP linking (Auth Providers + SAML on a React site), site logout URL, seed-data import, and GraphQL schema fetch + codegen. Trigger signals: *.network-meta.xml, org-setup.config.json (socialLogin/logoutUrl), data-plan.json, sfdx-project.json, or mentions of deploy, org setup, social login/SSO, or logout URL on an Experience site. DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating a new UI bundle project (use experience-ui-bundle-project-generate); styling pages without deploying (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate); adding a feature such as auth, search, or file upload without deploying (use the matching experience-ui-bundle-*-generate skill); configuring MFA permission sets (use experience-ui-bundle-mfa-configure).
description_zh:
必须激活以下条件：当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录，且任务涉及将项目部署至某个组织或进行部署后的组织配置时。

将部署一个 UI bundle 应用，并执行有序的设置流程，包括：组织认证、构建、元数据部署、权限集与角色分配、Experience Cloud 自助注册、社交登录/SSO/身份提供商（IDP）关联（在 React 站点上使用 Auth Providers + SAML）、站点登出 URL、种子数据导入以及 GraphQL 模式获取与代码生成。

触发信号：*.network-meta.xml、org-setup.config.json（socialLogin/logoutUrl）、data-plan.json、sfdx-project.json，或在 Experience 站点上提及部署、组织设置、社交登录/SSO 或登出 URL。

禁止触发以下情况：创建新的 UI bundle 项目（使用 experience-ui-bundle-project-generate）；在不部署的情况下样式化页面（使用 experience-ui-bundle-front end-generate）；在未部署的情况下添加认证、搜索或文件上传等功能（使用匹配的 experience-ui-bundle-*-generate 技能）；配置 MFA 权限集（使用 experience-ui-bundle-mfa-configure）。

description: Use this skill when adding a front-end React or Angular UI bundle to an EXISTING SFDX project, or configuring UI bundle metadata and config files. TRIGGER when: adding or scaffolding a new UI bundle — including adding one more or another UI bundle — into a project that already exists; scaffolding a single bundle with the basic template (reactbasic or angularbasic) via sf template generate ui-bundle; editing ui-bundle.json routing, headers, or output directory; working with *.uibundle-meta.xml files; or registering CSP Trusted Sites, resolving blocked images or fonts or external API calls, or editing cspTrustedSites/*.cspTrustedSite-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating a brand-new Salesforce project entirely from scratch, where the whole SFDX starter project (UI bundle plus Experience Site metadata and toolchain) is generated together in one step (use experience-ui-bundle-project-generate).
description_zh: 当向一个 EXISTING SFDX 项目添加前端 React 或 Angular UI bundle 时，或配置 UI bundle 元数据和配置文件时，使用此技能。触发条件：添加或搭建一个新的 UI bundle——包括添加另一个或更多的 UI bundle——到一个已存在的项目中；使用基础模板（reactbasic 或 angularbasic）通过 sf template generate ui-bundle 搭建单个 bundle；编辑 ui-bundle.json 的路由、头部或输出目录；处理 *.uibundle-meta.xml 文件；或注册 CSP Trusted Sites，解决被阻止的图片、字体或外部 API 调用，或编辑 cspTrustedSites/*.cspTrustedSite-meta.xml 文件。当满足以下条件时不触发：完全从零开始创建一个全新的 Salesforce 项目，其中整个 SFDX 起步项目（UI bundle 加上 Experience Site 元数据及 toolchain）在一步中生成（使用 experience-ui-bundle-project-generate）。

description: Generate SDD requirements from RFCs/specs and quantitatively verify implementation conformance. spec draft → spec align → spec verify → automated validation loop with codex/claude. Operate spec-to-impl drift gates as CI checks.
description_zh: 从 RFC 和规格说明生成 SDD 需求，并对实现符合性进行定量验证。规范草案 → 规范对齐 → 规范验证 → 与 Codex/Claude 的自动化验证循环。将 spec-to-impl 偏差闸门作为 CI 检查运行。

description: Analyzes DevOps Center test failures and Code Analyzer violations in plain language — failure category, offending file/class/method/line, rule violated, fix direction, and prioritized improvement suggestions (test-code vs production-code) — then optionally creates a tracked fix WorkItem on explicit request. Analysis is pure reasoning; work-item creation is a confirmation-gated write. Use this skill to explain failures or improvement suggestions, translate Code Analyzer violations, or track a fix as a work item. TRIGGER when: a run failed and the user wants root cause; a quality gate failure needs explaining; violations need translating; the user shares a failure payload and asks how to address it; wants to strengthen tests; or wants to create a fix work item, log a remediation, or assign a failure. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user wants fix code written (use platform-apex-generate) or new test classes authored (use platform-apex-test-generate).
description_zh:
以通俗语言分析 DevOps 中心的测试失败与代码分析器的违规情况——包括失败类别、违规文件/类/方法/行、触发的规则、修复方向，以及按优先级排序的改进建议（测试代码与生产代码）——并在用户明确请求时，可选地创建受追踪的修复工作项。分析过程纯粹为逻辑推理；工作项创建属于需经确认门控的写入操作。使用此技能进行失败或改进建议的解释、代码分析器违规的翻译，或作为工作项进行修复追踪。

触发条件：运行失败且用户需要根本原因；质量门禁失败需要解释；违规需要翻译；用户分享失败载荷并询问如何应对；需要增强测试；或需要创建修复工作项、记录整改措施或分配失败。

请勿触发：用户需要编写修复代码（请使用 platform-apex-generate），或编写新测试类（请使用 platform-apex-test-generate）。

description: Manages connected MCP sources for enterprise search. Detects available sources, guides users to connect new ones, handles source priority ordering, and manages rate limiting awareness.
description_zh: 管理企业搜索中已连接的 MCP 数据源。检测可用数据源，引导用户连接新的数据源，处理数据源优先级排序，并管理限流感知。

description: A self-evolution engine for AI agents. Analyzes runtime history to identify improvements and applies protocol-constrained evolution. Communicates with EvoMap Hub via local Proxy mailbox.
description_zh: AI代理自进化引擎。分析运行历史以识别改进并应用协议约束下的进化。通过本地代理邮箱与EvoMap Hub通信。

description: MUST activate when the user wants to build, create, or generate a React application, React app, web application, single-page application (SPA), or frontend application — even if no project files exist yet. MUST also activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory or sfdx-project.json and the prompt says create, build, construct, or generate a new app, site, or page from scratch — even if the prompt also describes visual styling. MUST also activate when the task spans more than one ui-bundle skill. Use this skill when building a complete app end-to-end. Do NOT use for Lightning Experience apps with custom objects (use platform-lightning-app-coordinate). Do NOT use for single-concern edits to an existing page (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate).
description_zh: 当用户想要构建、创建或生成 React 应用（React app）、Web 应用、单页应用（SPA）或前端应用时，必须激活——即使目前尚无项目文件。当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录或 sfdx-project.json，且提示要求从零创建、构建、构造或生成新的应用、网站或页面时，也必须激活——即使提示中也包含视觉样式描述。当任务涉及多个 ui-bundle 技能时，也必须激活。在端到端构建完整的项目应用时，使用此技能。不要用于具有自定义对象的 Lightning Experience 应用（请使用 platform-lightning-app-coordinate）。不要用于对现有页面进行单一关注点的修改（请使用 experience-ui-bundle-fronten-generate）。

description: MUST activate whenever a uiBundles/*/src/ project reads, writes, or displays Salesforce data — INCLUDING building a page, list, table, card grid, dashboard, or form that shows, filters, counts, or edits records of any object (e.g. Property__c, Account, Case), even when the prompt names only the UI or the object and never says query, GraphQL, or SDK. Records behind such a component come from Salesforce, so use this ALONGSIDE experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate: that skill styles the component, this one wires its data. Also triggers on @salesforce/platform-sdk imports, sdk.graphql.query / mutate / sdk.fetch calls, *.graphql files, or stale data needing force-refresh. New read/write work uses the current @salesforce/platform-sdk API; migrate only EXISTING old @salesforce/sdk-data callable code. Not for pure styling/layout with no records, app shell, file upload, or auth/search scaffolding. DO NOT TRIGGER for OAuth, object/field schema changes, Bulk/Tooling/Metadata API, or declarative automation.
description_zh:
**每当 uiBundles/*/src/ 项目读取、写入或显示 Salesforce 数据时，必须激活——包括构建用于显示、筛选、统计或编辑任何对象（例如 Property__c、Account、Case）记录的页面、列表、表格、卡片网格、仪表盘或表单，即使提示词仅提及 UI 或对象，从未提及查询、GraphQL 或 SDK。**

**此类组件背后的记录来源于 Salesforce，因此需配合 experience-ui-bundle-front-front-generate 使用：该技能负责组件的样式，本技能负责连接其数据。**

**同时在以下情况触发：@salesforce/platform-sdk 导入、sdk.graphql.query / mutate / sdk.fetch 调用、*.graphql 文件，或需要强制刷新的过期数据。**

**新的读写工作需使用当前的 @salesforce/platform-sdk API；仅迁移现有的旧版 @salesforce/sdk-data 可调用代码。**

**不适用于纯样式/布局且无记录的应用外壳、文件上传或认证/搜索搭建脚手架。**

**不得触发 OAuth、对象/字段模式变更、Bulk/Tooling/Metadata API 或声明式自动化。**

description: Documentation analysis — assess coverage, detect code-to-doc drift with plan reconcile, visualize dependencies with doc graph. Answers "what needs docs?" and "are docs still accurate?"
description_zh: 文档分析 — 评估覆盖范围，通过计划协调检测代码到文档的漂移，使用文档图可视化依赖。解答“需要哪些文档？”和“文档是否仍然准确？”

description: Exports Amazon RDS or Aurora database snapshots to Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format for analytics, backup, or data migration. Handles snapshot selection or creation, IAM role setup, KMS encryption, S3 bucket preparation, export task execution, progress monitoring, and data verification. Use when exporting RDS/Aurora data to S3 for Athena, Glue, or Redshift Spectrum consumption.
description_zh: 将 Amazon RDS 或 Aurora 数据库快照以 Apache Parquet 格式导出至 Amazon S3，用于分析、备份或数据迁移。该功能可处理快照的选择或创建、IAM 角色配置、KMS 加密、S3 存储桶准备、导出任务执行、进度监控和数据验证。适用于将 RDS/Aurora 数据导出至 S3，供 Athena、Glue 或 Redshift Spectrum 使用。

description: Create effective AI image generation prompts for DALL-E, Midjourney, and Stable Diffusion. Generate prompts for various styles and use cases.
description_zh: 为 DALL-E、Midjourney 和 Stable Diffusion 创建有效的 AI 图像生成提示词，并为各种风格和用例生成提示词。

description: After writing code, detect and clean up duplication at three levels — copy-paste blocks, cross-package shared code, unnecessary wrappers, and concept-level SoT violations. Detect with indexion, fix, and verify.
description_zh: 在编写代码后，从三个层级检测并清理重复代码——复制粘贴代码块、跨包共享代码、不必要的包装器，以及概念层级的 SoT 违规。使用 indexion 进行检测、修复和验证。

description: 紫鸟员工管理：员工的查询、创建、修改、启用/禁用/删除和调岗。当用户需要查询员工信息、创建新员工、修改员工信息、启用/禁用/删除员工或调整员工部门时使用。
description_zh: 紫鸟员工管理：员工的查询、创建、修改、启用/禁用/删除和调岗。当用户需要查询员工信息、创建新员工、修改员工信息、启用/禁用/删除员工或调整员工部门时使用。

description: Identifies high-quality leads for your product or service by analyzing your business, searching for target companies, and providing actionable contact strategies. Perfect for sales, business development, and marketing professionals.
description_zh: 通过分析您的业务、寻找目标公司，并提供切实可行的联系策略，为您识别产品或服务的优质潜在客户。非常适合销售、业务拓展及市场营销专业人士。

description: 紫鸟 API 探索：当现有快捷命令无法满足需求时，通过通用 api 命令和已知路径清单探索紫鸟全部 73 个 API 接口。
description_zh: 紫鸟 API 探索：当现有快捷命令无法满足需求时，通过通用 api 命令和已知路径清单探索紫鸟全部 73 个 API 接口。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves creating or configuring a Custom Application for hosting a UI bundle in Lightning Experience. Use this skill when creating a CustomApplication metadata record to surface the UI bundle in the App Launcher. Activate when files matching applications/*.app-meta.xml exist and need modification, or when the user wants to expose their app via the Lightning App Launcher without a Digital Experience Site. Do NOT use platform-custom-application-generate for this — UI bundle apps do not use tabs, action overrides, or flexipages.
description_zh: 当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录，且任务涉及创建或配置用于在 Lightning 体验中托管 UI 包的自定义应用程序时，必须激活。创建 CustomApplication 元数据记录以在应用启动器（App Launcher）中显示 UI 包时，使用本技能。当存在需要修改的、符合 applications/*.app-meta.xml 模式的文件，或当用户希望在无需数字体验站点的情况下，通过 Lightning 应用启动器公开其应用程序时，激活此技能。切勿为此使用 platform-custom-application-generate——UI 包应用程序不使用标签页、操作覆盖或 FlexiPage（灵活页面）。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory (React or Angular) and the user wants to add a pre-built feature — such as authentication (login, logout, protected routes, session management) or search (global search across pages and content) — instead of building it from scratch. Always run list first to see the current feature catalog, since it can include more than authentication and search. Always use this skill for installing pre-built features rather than hand-building them. DO NOT TRIGGER for Agentforce conversational client or file-upload features — use experience-ui-bundle-agentforce-client-generate and experience-ui-bundle-file-upload-generate respectively.
description_zh: 当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录（React 或 Angular），且用户希望添加预构建功能——例如身份验证（登录、登出、受保护路由、会话管理）或搜索（跨页面和内容进行全局搜索）——而非从零开始构建时，必须激活。始终先运行 list，以查看当前功能目录，因为它可能包含除身份验证和搜索之外的其他功能。始终使用本技能安装预构建功能，而非手动构建这些功能。不得针对 Agentforce 对话客户端或文件上传功能进行触发——应分别使用 experience-ui-bundle-agentforce-client-generate 和 experience-ui-bundle-file-upload-generate。

description: Comprehensive guide for creating software diagrams using Mermaid syntax. Use when users need to create, visualize, or document software through diagrams including class diagrams (domain modeling, object-oriented design), sequence diagrams (application flows, API interactions, code execution), flowcharts (processes, algorithms, user journeys), entity relationship diagrams (database schemas), C4 architecture diagrams (system context, containers, components), state diagrams, git graphs, pie charts, gantt charts, or any other diagram type. Triggers include requests to "diagram", "visualize", "model", "map out", "show the flow", or when explaining system architecture, database design, code structure, or user/application flows.
description_zh: 使用 Mermaid 语法创建软件图的综合指南。适用于用户需要通过图表来创建、可视化或记录软件内容的情况，涵盖类图（领域建模、面向对象设计）、序列图（应用流程、API 交互、代码执行）、流程图（流程、算法、用户旅程）、实体关系图（数据库模式）、C4 架构图（系统上下文、容器、组件）、状态图、Git 图、饼图、甘特图或其他任何类型的图表。触发条件包括提出“图表”、“可视化”、“建模”、“绘制流程”、“展示流程”等请求，或当解释系统架构、数据库设计、代码结构或用户/应用流程时。

description: Token integration and implementation analyzer based on Trail of Bits' token integration checklist. Analyzes token implementations for ERC20/ERC721 conformity, checks for 20+ weird token patterns, assesses contract composition and owner privileges, performs on-chain scarcity analysis, and evaluates how protocols handle non-standard tokens. Use when integrating or accepting arbitrary ERC20/ERC721 tokens, auditing a token implementation for standards conformity, or assessing risk from weird tokens such as fee-on-transfer, rebasing, missing return values, or blocklists.
description_zh: 基于 Trail of Bits 代币集成清单的代币集成与实现分析器。该分析器分析代币实现是否符合 ERC20/ERC721 标准，检查 20 多种奇怪的代币模式，评估合约组成与所有者权限，进行链上稀缺性分析，并评估协议如何处理非标准代币。在集成或接受任意 ERC20/ERC721 代币、审计代币实现是否符合标准、或评估来自奇怪代币（如转移费代币、rebasing、缺失返回值或黑名单等）的风险时使用。

description: 设置 Claude Code hooks，在危险 git commands（push、reset --hard、clean、branch -D 等）执行前阻止它们。适用于用户想防止破坏性 git 操作、添加 git safety hooks，或在 Claude Code 中阻止 git push/reset 时。
description_zh: 配置 Claude Code 钩子，在危险 git 命令（push、reset --hard、clean、branch -D 等）执行前阻止它们。适用于用户需要防止破坏性 git 操作、添加 git 安全钩子，或在 Claude Code 中阻止 git push/reset 的场景。

description: Fetch agentic setup prompt categories from a connected Salesforce org using the Connect API. Use this skill to call GET /agenticsetup/categories and return the list of prompt categories, optionally with their nested prompts. TRIGGER when: user asks to get, fetch, list, or show agentic setup categories, prompt categories, setup copilot categories, prompt library categories, available setup prompts, Agentforce prompt library, or copilot prompts. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to create new categories, work with non-categories endpoints, or generate OpenAPI specs.
description_zh: 通过 Connect API 从已连接的 Salesforce 组织中获取代理设置提示类别。使用此技能调用 GET /agenticsetup/categories，并返回提示类别列表，可选地包含其嵌套提示。触发条件：当用户要求获取、拉取、列出或显示代理设置类别、提示类别、设置 Copilot 类别、提示库类别、可用设置提示、Agentforce 提示库或 Copilot 提示时。不要触发：当用户想要创建新类别、处理非类别端点或生成 OpenAPI 规范时。

description: Write personalized cold outreach emails to hiring managers and founders — specific, human, not a pitch deck
description_zh: 为招聘经理和创始人撰写个性化冷邮件——具体、有人情味，而非商业计划书式的推介。

description: 紫鸟角色管理：角色的查询、创建、修改、分配和权限查看。当用户需要查看角色列表、创建/修改角色、将角色分配给员工或查看角色成员时使用。
description_zh: 紫鸟角色管理：角色的查询、创建、修改、分配和权限查看。当用户需要查看角色列表、创建/修改角色、将角色分配给员工或查看角色成员时使用。

description: Enables a multi-region AWS CloudTrail trail with S3 log storage, CloudWatch Logs integration, and CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for security monitoring and compliance auditing. Use when setting up centralized API activity logging across all AWS regions.
description_zh: 支持为多区域 AWS CloudTrail 追踪配置 S3 日志存储、CloudWatch Logs 集成及 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询功能，用于安全监控与合规审计。适用于在所有 AWS 区域设置集中式 API 活动日志记录时使用。

description: 面向 GPT Image 2 的图像生成 / 编辑技能。可在 3 种环境下使用：(A) Garden 本地模式，通过 OpenAI 兼容接口直接出图并落盘；(B) Host-Native 模式，把本 Skill 当作提示词工程指引，把渲染好的 prompt 交给宿主 Agent 自带的图像工具出图；(C) Advisor 模式，宿主无任何图像工具时退化为高质量 prompt 顾问。涵盖 18 大类、80+ 个结构化模板，覆盖海报 / UI / 产品 / 信息图 / 学术图 / 技术架构图 / 漫画 / 头像 / 流程板 / 电影分镜 / IP 周边 / 编辑工作流等场景。
description_zh: 面向 GPT Image 2 的图像生成/编辑技能。可在 3 种环境下使用：(A) Garden 本地模式，通过 OpenAI 兼容接口直接生成图像并保存至本地；(B) Host-Native 模式，将本 Skill 作为提示词工程指引，将渲染好的 prompt 交由宿主 Agent 自带的图像工具生成图像；(C) Advisor 模式，当宿主无图像工具时退化为高质量 prompt 顾问。涵盖 18 大类、80+ 个结构化模板，覆盖海报 / UI / 产品 / 信息图 / 学术图 / 技术架构图 / 漫画 / 头像 / 流程板 / 电影分镜 / IP 周边 / 编辑工作流等应用场景。

description: Fill out job application form fields with context-aware, tailored answers drawn from the candidate's CV and the job description
description_zh: 根据候选人的简历和职位描述，填写工作申请表的各个字段，并提供具有上下文感知能力和定制化特点的答案。

description: 紫鸟设备管理：代理设备（IP）的查询、添加、修改、绑定/解绑、购买续费和自动续费。当用户需要查看代理设备列表、添加/修改自有代理、绑定设备到店铺或管理设备费用时使用。
description_zh: 紫鸟设备管理：代理设备（IP）的查询、添加、修改、绑定/解绑、购买续费和自动续费。当用户需要查看代理设备列表、添加/修改自有代理、绑定设备到店铺或管理设备费用时使用。

description: 创建 ziniao-cli 的自定义 Skill。当用户需要把紫鸟 API 操作封装成可复用的 Skill（包装原子 API 或编排多步流程）时使用。
description_zh: 创建 ziniao-cli 的自定义 Skill。当用户需要将紫鸟 API 操作封装为可复用的 Skill（包装原子 API 或编排多步流程）时使用。

description: 紫鸟访问策略管理：网页访问规则、网页/网页分组、规则生效成员/账号、账号绑定策略的查询和维护。当前无快捷命令，全部通过 ziniao-cli api 直调。
description_zh: 紫鸟访问策略管理：对网页访问规则、网页/网页分组、规则生效成员/账号及账号绑定策略进行查询和维护。当前暂无快捷命令，全部通过 ziniao-cli api 直接调用。

description: 批量账号授权工作流：编排 account list + staff list + api 调用完成批量授权店铺给员工。适用于新员工入职时批量分配店铺权限。
description_zh: 批量账号授权工作流：编排账号列表、员工列表和 API 调用，完成批量授权店铺给员工。适用于新员工入职时批量分配店铺权限。

description: Configures GKE observability, including Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and managed Prometheus. Use when configuring GKE monitoring, setting up GKE logging, or configuring Prometheus metrics collection. Don't use to configure local application logging frameworks or external APMs outside GKE.
description_zh: 配置 GKE 可观测性，包括 Cloud Logging、Cloud Monitoring 以及托管 Prometheus。适用于配置 GKE 监控、设置 GKE 日志或配置 Prometheus 指标采集。不可用于配置本地应用日志框架或 GKE 外部的外部 APM。

description: 紫鸟账号（店铺）管理：店铺账号的查询、创建、修改、删除、授权和标签管理。当用户需要查看店铺账号列表、创建/修改/删除账号、管理账号授权或标签时使用。
description_zh: 紫鸟账号（店铺）管理：店铺账号的查询、创建、修改、删除、授权和标签管理。当用户需要查看店铺账号列表、创建/修改/删除账号、管理账号授权或标签时使用。

description: 紫鸟部门管理：部门的查询、创建、修改、删除和排序。当用户需要查看组织架构、创建/修改/删除部门、调整部门排序时使用。
description_zh: 紫鸟部门管理：对部门进行查询、创建、修改、删除和排序。当用户需要查看组织架构、创建/修改/删除部门、调整部门排序时使用。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves creating or configuring site infrastructure. Use this skill when creating or configuring a Salesforce Digital Experience Site for hosting a UI bundle. Activate when files matching digitalExperiences/, networks/, customSite/, or DigitalExperienceBundle exist and need modification, or when the user wants to publish, host, or configure guest access for their app. Also use this skill to add multi-language, multi-locale, internationalization, or translation support to such a site by declaring a default locale and additional supported languages via the sfdc_cms__languageSettings content type. DO NOT TRIGGER for LWR (non-React) sites; use experience-lwr-site-generate instead.
description_zh:
当项目包含 `uiBundles/*/src/` 目录且任务涉及创建或配置站点基础设施时，必须激活。创建或配置用于托管 UI bundle 的 Salesforce Digital Experience Site 时，使用此技能。当存在需要修改的 `digitalExperiences/`、`networks/`、`customSite/` 或 `DigitalExperienceBundle` 相关文件时激活，或者当用户想要发布、托管或配置其应用的访客访问权限时激活。此外，使用此技能通过 `sfdc_cms__languageSettings` 内容类型声明默认语言及额外支持语言，为此类站点添加多语言、多 locale、国际化或翻译支持。

**禁止**针对 LWR（非 React）站点触发本技能；应使用 `experience-lwr-site-generate` 代替。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves uploading, attaching, or dropping files. Use this skill when adding file upload functionality to a UI bundle app. Provides progress tracking and Salesforce ContentVersion integration. This feature provides programmatic APIs ONLY — build custom UI using the upload() API. ALWAYS use this instead of building file upload from scratch with FormData or XHR.
description_zh: 当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录且任务涉及上传、附加或拖放文件时，必须激活。在 UI bundle 应用中添加文件上传功能时使用此技能。该技能提供进度跟踪和 Salesforce ContentVersion 集成功能。此功能仅提供编程接口——请使用 upload() API 构建自定义 UI。始终使用此方式，而非使用 FormData 或 XHR 从头构建文件上传功能。

description: 创建包含章节、题目、答案和讲解的练习目录结构，并确保通过 linting。适用于用户想 scaffold exercises、创建 exercise stubs，或设置新的课程章节时。
description_zh: 创建包含章节、题目、答案和讲解的练习目录结构，并确保通过 lint 检查。适用于用户想搭建练习脚手架、创建练习桩，或设置新的课程章节时。

description: Split text into contextual chunks for RAG/embedding pipelines. Document segmentation and section extraction using window, tfidf, punctuation, or hybrid strategies chosen by intent.
description_zh: 将文本拆分用于 RAG/嵌入流水线处理的上下文块。根据意图选择窗口、TF-IDF、标点或混合策略，实现文档分段与章节提取。

description: Extract, define, and apply design DNA across three dimensions: design system (tokens), design style (qualitative feel), and visual effects (Canvas, WebGL, 3D, particles, shaders, scroll effects, etc.). Use this skill when: (1) a user wants to see the full 3-dimension design structure/schema, (2) a user provides images, screenshots, or URLs of reference designs and wants them analyzed into a structured JSON profile covering all three dimensions, (3) a user has a Design DNA JSON and content and wants a design generated from it, or (4) any combination of these phases. Triggers on "design DNA", "extract design style", "analyze design", "design tokens from reference", "generate design from JSON", "design system from screenshot", "design profile", "style guide JSON", "visual effects analysis", "design with effects", "3d design analysis".
description_zh: 提取、定义并应用跨越三个维度的设计DNA：设计系统（设计令牌）、设计风格（定性感受）和视觉效果（Canvas、WebGL、3D、粒子、着色器、滚动效果等）。使用本技能时，适用于以下场景：(1) 用户希望查看完整的三维设计结构/架构；(2) 用户提供参考设计的图片、截图或链接，并希望将其分析为涵盖所有三个维度的结构化 JSON 配置文件；(3) 用户拥有设计DNA JSON及相关内容，并希望从中生成设计；或 (4) 这些阶段中的任意组合。触发条件包括“设计DNA”、“提取设计风格”、“分析设计”、“从参考设计中提取设计令牌”、“从 JSON 生成设计”、“从截图生成设计系统”、“设计配置文件”、“样式指南 JSON”、“视觉效果分析”、“带效果的设计”、“3D 设计分析”。

description: Debug and inspect KGF specs — view tokenization results, parse trees, and extracted edges from source files. Use when adding/fixing language support or when indexion's analysis output looks wrong.
description_zh: 调试并检查KGF规格——查看源文件的分词结果、解析树和提取的边。在添加/修复语言支持时，或当indexion的分析输出看起来有误时使用。

description: Project wiki lifecycle — create pages, track source changes with ingest, update stale pages, lint structural integrity, detect code-to-doc drift with reconcile, and manage search indexes. A runbook for navigating and maintaining the wiki as an agent.
description_zh: 项目 wiki 生命周期——创建页面，通过 ingest 跟踪源变更，更新失效页面，检查结构完整性，通过 reconcile 检测代码与文档的漂移，并管理搜索索引。这是一份供智能体（agent）进行维基导航与维护的操作手册。

description: Use this skill when the user asks to add, embed, integrate, configure, style, or remove an agent, chatbot, chat widget, conversation client, or AI assistant in a UI Bundle project (React or Angular). TRIGGER when: project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves adding or modifying a chat widget, chatbot, or conversational AI; files under uiBundles/*/src/ import AgentforceConversationClient in React `.tsx`/`.jsx` files, or use the app-agentforce-conversation-client element in Angular `.html` templates and AgentforceConversationClientComponent in `.component.ts` files; user asks to add any chat or agent functionality to a page. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to create a custom agent, chatbot, or chat widget component from scratch; the project has no uiBundles directory.
description_zh:
当用户要求在一项 UI Bundle 项目（React 或 Angular）中添加、嵌入、集成、配置、样式化或移除一个智能体、聊天机器人、聊天组件、对话客户端或 AI 助手时，请使用此技能。

触发条件：项目包含 `uiBundles/*/src/` 目录，且任务涉及添加或修改聊天组件、聊天机器人或对话式 AI；位于 `uiBundles/*/src/` 下的文件在 React `.tsx`/`.jsx` 文件中导入 `AgentforceConversationClient`，或在 Angular `.html` 模板中使用的 `app-agentforce-conversation-client` 元素，以及在 `.component.ts` 文件中使用的 `AgentforceConversationClientComponent`；用户要求在某页面中增加任何聊天或智能体功能。

不要触发的情况：用户要求从零开始创建自定义智能体、聊天机器人或聊天组件；项目中没有 `uiBundles` 目录。

description: Persistent browser and Electron interaction through `js_repl` for fast iterative UI debugging.
description_zh: 通过 `js_repl` 实现浏览器与 Electron 的持久化交互，用于快速迭代式 UI 调试。

description: Smart contract development advisor based on Trail of Bits' best practices. Analyzes codebase to generate documentation/specifications, review architecture, check upgradeability patterns, assess implementation quality, identify pitfalls, review dependencies, and evaluate testing. Use when asking whether a smart contract project follows development best practices, reviewing on-chain/off-chain split, upgradeability, or delegatecall proxy patterns against guidelines, or seeking recommendations on contract design, inheritance, events, documentation, dependencies, or test strategy.
description_zh: 基于 Trail of Bits 最佳实践的智能合约开发顾问。分析代码库以生成文档/规范，审查架构，检查可升级性模式，评估实现质量，识别潜在风险，审查依赖，并评估测试。适用于询问智能合约项目是否遵循开发最佳实践、对照规范审查链上/链下分工、可升级性、delegatecall 代理模式，或寻求关于合约设计、继承、事件、文档、依赖及测试策略的建议。

description: 在当前仓库设置 Husky pre-commit hooks，集成 lint-staged (Prettier)、类型检查和测试。适用于用户想添加 pre-commit hooks、设置 Husky、配置 lint-staged，或在提交时运行格式化、类型检查和测试时。
description_zh: 在当前仓库中设置 Husky pre-commit 钩子，集成 lint-staged (Prettier)、类型检查和测试。适用于用户想添加 pre-commit 钩子、设置 Husky、配置 lint-staged，或在提交时运行格式化、类型检查和测试时。

description: Generate and use a pre-edit structure brief so coding agents learn likely owners, consumer surfaces, and unsafe edit locations before implementing.
description_zh: 生成并使用预编辑结构简报，以便编码智能体在实施前了解可能的责任方、消费者界面以及不安全的编辑位置。

description: Detect and review name/content drift in code using `indexion identity audit`, then plan verified renames, moves, folder changes, or splits.
description_zh: 使用 `indexion identity audit` 检测并审查代码中的名称/内容漂移，然后规划经验证的改名、移动、文件夹更改或分割。

description: Plans, configures, and manages core GKE cluster networking. Covers private clusters, VPC-native configurations, DNS, node egress, Dataplane V2, and IP planning. Use when designing GKE networking layouts, configuring private clusters, setting up Dataplane V2, planning GKE IP ranges, or managing VPC- native cluster modes. Don't use for application ingress, load balancing, or service networking (use gke-service-networking instead).
description_zh: 规划、配置和管理 GKE 集群核心网络，涵盖私有集群、VPC 原生配置、DNS、节点出站流量、Dataplane V2 及 IP 规划。适用于设计 GKE 网络布局、配置私有集群、部署 Dataplane V2、规划 GKE IP 范围或管理 VPC 原生集群模式。不适用于应用接入、负载均衡或服务网络（请改用 gke-service-networking）。

description: Configures DevOps Center pipeline testing infrastructure: enables a test provider so its suites become available, re-syncs a configured provider to pull in new suites, or creates a quality gate with rules on a stage. Routes by intent across three modes after running shared prerequisite checks and an explicit confirmation gate. Use this skill when a user wants to set up, configure, enable, sync, or refresh a test provider, or set/configure a quality gate or coverage threshold on a DevOps Center pipeline stage. TRIGGER when: the user wants to configure/enable/add/set up a test provider, re-sync or refresh a provider's suite list, pull in new suites, or set/configure a quality gate, coverage threshold, or testing benchmark on a stage. DO NOT TRIGGER when: assigning existing suites to a stage (use dx-devops-test-suite-assignments-configure), running or retriggering a suite (use dx-devops-test-suite-run), or non-DevOps-Center work.
description_zh: 配置 DevOps Center 管道测试基础设施：启用一个测试提供者，使其套件可供使用；重新同步已配置的提供者以拉取新的套件；或在某个阶段创建具有规则的质量门禁。在运行共享前置检查和明确的确认门禁后，按照三种模式根据意图进行路由。当用户希望设置、配置、启用、同步或刷新测试提供者，或在 DevOps Center 管道阶段设置/配置质量门禁或覆盖率阈值时，使用此技能。触发条件：当用户希望配置、启用、添加或设置测试提供者，重新同步或刷新提供者的套件列表，拉取新套件，或在阶段设置/配置质量门禁、覆盖率阈值或测试基准时触发。切勿触发：将现有套件分配给阶段（使用 dx-devops-test-suite-assignments-configure），运行或重新触发套件（使用 dx-devops-test-suite-run），或非 DevOps Center 相关工作。

description: Creates a complete Amazon Aurora database cluster with instances, handling cluster creation, instance provisioning, and Secrets Manager password management in the proper sequence. Use when setting up new Aurora MySQL or PostgreSQL clusters with production-ready configuration.
description_zh: 创建包含实例的完整 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群，按正确顺序处理集群创建、实例配置与 Secrets Manager 密码管理。适用于在设置具备生产级配置的新 Aurora MySQL 或 PostgreSQL 集群时使用。

description: Extracts and analyzes competitors' ads from ad libraries (Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.) to understand what messaging, problems, and creative approaches are working. Helps inspire and improve your own ad campaigns.
description_zh: 从广告库（如 Facebook、LinkedIn 等）中提取并分析竞争对手的广告，以了解哪些信息传递、问题和创意方法行之有效。帮助启发并改进您自身的广告活动。

description: Break a design brief into an ordered checklist of independently buildable tasks using vertical slices. Saves as a markdown checklist. Use when user wants to break down work, create tasks from a brief, plan implementation order, or mentions "tasks" or "breakdown".
description_zh: 使用垂直切片法，将设计简报拆解为有序的、可独立构建任务检查清单，并保存为 Markdown 检查清单。当用户希望拆解工作内容、从简报中创建任务、规划实施顺序，或提及“任务”或“拆解”时使用。

description: Recommends and manages DevOps Center test suite assignments for pipeline stages. Mode A analyzes a commit diff against assigned suite metadata to recommend relevant existing suites and flag coverage gaps (pure reasoning). Modes B-D assign a single suite, bulk-map multiple suites with a mandatory impact preview, or add/remove test classes with governance rules, via the testSuiteStages Connect API. Use this skill to recommend suites for a commit, assign or map suites to stages, or add/remove tests in a suite. TRIGGER when: the user asks which suites to run for a commit/diff or what covers their changes; a suite is unlinked and the user wants it assigned; the user wants to configure suite-to-stage mappings, assign multiple suites, or add/remove/sync tests in a suite. DO NOT TRIGGER when: configuring or syncing a test provider (use dx-devops-test-pipeline-configure), running suites (use dx-devops-test-suite-run), or authoring/running tests directly (use platform-apex-test-generate or platform-apex-test-run).
description_zh: 为流水线阶段推荐和管理DevOps中心的测试套件分配。模式A将提交差异与已分配的套件元数据进行分析，推荐相关的现有套件并标记覆盖空白（纯推理）。模式B-D通过testSuiteStages Connect API，分配单个套件、批量映射多个套件（需进行强制性影响预览），或使用治理规则添加/移除测试类。使用本技能为提交推荐套件、为阶段分配或映射套件，或在套件中添加/移除测试。触发条件：当用户询问为提交/差异需要运行哪些套件或哪些内容覆盖其变更；当套件未关联且用户希望对其进行分配；当用户需要配置套件与阶段的映射、分配多个套件或在套件中添加/移除/同步测试时。不触发条件：配置或同步测试提供程序（使用dx-devops-test-pipeline-configure），运行套件（使用dx-devops-test-suite-run），或直接编写/运行测试（使用platform-apex-test-generate或platform-apex-test-run）。

description: Measures and interprets what a fuzzing campaign actually reaches, using llvm-cov, lcov, or a fuzzer's own coverage output. Covers baselining a new campaign, reading coverage reports, and turning uncovered regions into harness, seed, or dictionary work. Use when a fuzzer plateaus, when judging whether a harness is effective, after changing a harness, or when asking why some code is never reached.
description_zh: 通过 llvm-cov、lcov 或模糊测试器自身的覆盖率输出，测量并解读模糊测试活动实际覆盖到的内容。涵盖为新的模糊测试活动建立基线、阅读覆盖率报告，以及将未覆盖区域转化为测试框架、种子或字典工作。当模糊测试器达到平台期、在判断测试框架是否有效、在修改测试框架之后，或询问某些代码为何从未被覆盖到时使用。

description: Multi-platform social media publishing automation - schedule, post, and track content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and more
description_zh: 多平台社交媒体发布自动化 - 在 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、LinkedIn 等平台安排、发布并追踪内容

description: Runs DevOps Center test suites on a pipeline stage (Pre-Promote, Post-Promote, or Review event) end to end: triggers async execution via the Connect API after an explicit confirmation gate, then polls by runId at provider-specific intervals until it completes, fails, or times out, and hands results to failure analysis. Also retriggers a quality gate after fixes, but only once coverage meets the threshold. Use this skill when a user wants to run, kick off, or launch test suites on a stage, re-run a quality gate, or watch an in-progress run to completion. TRIGGER when: the user wants to run/launch suites on a stage, execute tests before or after promotion, re-run a quality gate after fixing failures, unblock a blocked promotion after adding tests, or poll/watch an in-progress run. DO NOT TRIGGER when: running sf apex run test directly (use platform-apex-test-run), or configuring a NEW gate or threshold (use dx-devops-test-pipeline-configure).
description_zh:
在Pipeline阶段（Pre-Promote、Post-Promote或Review事件）端到端运行DevOps中心的测试套件：在明确的确认闸门后，通过Connect API触发异步执行，然后依据runId，以提供商特定的间隔进行轮询，直至任务完成、失败或超时，并将结果交给失败分析。修复后重新触发质量门，但仅在覆盖率满足阈值时才执行。当用户希望运行、启动或发布测试套件到某个阶段，重新运行质量门，或观看运行中任务直至完成时，使用此技能。

TRIGGER 当：用户想要在阶段上运行/启动测试套件，在提升前或提升后执行测试，修复失败后重新运行质量门，添加测试后解除被阻塞的提升，或轮询/观看运行中任务时，触发本技能。

DO NOT TRIGGER 当：直接运行 sf apex run test（使用 platform-apex-test-run），或配置新的门或阈值（使用 dx-devops-test-pipeline-configure）时，不触发本技能。

description: Expert in building 3D experiences for the web - Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, WebGL, and interactive 3D scenes. Covers product configurators, 3D portfolios, immersive websites, and bringing depth to web experiences.
description_zh: 专注为网页构建3D体验的专家——使用 Three.js、React Three Fiber、Spline、WebGL 及交互式3D场景。涵盖产品配置器、3D作品集、沉浸式网站，以及为网页体验注入深度。

description: Extract content from specific URLs using Tavily's extraction API. Returns clean markdown/text from web pages. Use when you have specific URLs and need their content without writing code.
description_zh: 使用 Tavily 的提取 API 从特定 URL 提取内容，返回网页的干净 Markdown/文本。当您需要特定 URL 的内容且无需编写代码时使用。

description: Apply meta-principles of software craftsmanship: DRY, orthogonality, tracer bullets, and design by contract. Use when the user mentions "best practices", "pragmatic approach", "broken windows", "tracer bullet", "software craftsmanship", "avoid technical debt", "code ownership", or "how do I become a better developer". Also trigger when evaluating build-vs-buy decisions, designing estimation approaches, or choosing between reversible and irreversible architectural decisions. Covers estimation, domain languages, and reversibility. For code-level quality, see clean-code. For refactoring techniques, see refactoring-patterns.
description_zh: 遵循软件工匠精神的元原则：DRY、正交性、追踪子弹、按契约设计。当用户提及“最佳实践”、“务实方法”、“破窗效应”、“追踪子弹”、“软件工匠精神”、“避免技术债务”、“代码所有权”或“我如何成为一名更优秀的开发者”时，适用此原则。在评估构建与采购决策、设计估算方法，或在可逆与不可逆的架构决策之间进行选择时，也触发此原则。涵盖估算、领域语言和可逆性。有关代码级质量，见 clean-code。有关重构技术，见 refactoring-patterns。

description: Configures, optimizes, and troubleshoots GKE ComputeClasses. Use when configuring Spot VMs with on-demand fallback, targeting specific accelerators (GPUs/TPUs) or machine families, restricting ComputeClass access, or debugging pending pods related to node pool auto-creation. Do not use for cluster-level Node Auto Provisioning configuration or general GKE cluster creation.
description_zh: 配置、优化和排查 GKE ComputeClass。当需要配置带有按需回退的 Spot VM、针对特定加速器（GPUs/TPUs）或机型族、限制 ComputeClass 访问，或排查与节点池自动创建相关的待处理 Pod 时使用。不可用于集群级节点自动配置或通用 GKE 集群创建。

description: Use when building, extending, or debugging WordPress REST API endpoints/routes: register_rest_route, WP_REST_Controller/controller classes, schema/argument validation, permission_callback/authentication, response shaping, register_rest_field/register_meta, or exposing CPTs/taxonomies via show_in_rest.
description_zh: 用于构建、扩展或调试 WordPress REST API 端点/路由时使用：register_rest_route、WP_REST_Controller/controller 类、schema/参数校验、permission_callback/认证、响应整形、register_rest_field/register_meta，或通过 show_in_rest 暴露 CPTs/分类法。

description: Provides GKE golden path configuration defaults, production readiness checklists, and cluster default patterns. Use when designing GKE clusters, verifying GKE production readiness, or checking configurations against GKE defaults. Don't use for setting up workload autoscaling specifically (use gke-workload-scaling instead).
description_zh: 提供 GKE 黄金路径配置默认值、生产就绪检查清单及集群默认模式。设计 GKE 集群、验证 GKE 生产就绪或对照 GKE 默认值检查配置时使用。请勿用于专门设置工作负载自动扩缩容（请改用 gke-workload-scaling）。

description: Expert guidance for Swift Testing: test structure, #expect/#require macros, traits and tags, parameterized tests, test plans, parallel execution, async waiting patterns, and XCTest migration. Use when writing new Swift tests, modernizing XCTest suites, debugging flaky tests, or improving test quality and maintainability in Apple-platform or Swift server projects.
description_zh: Swift 测试专家指导：测试结构、#expect/#require 宏、特性和标签、参数化测试、测试计划、并行执行、异步等待模式以及 XCTest 迁移。适用于编写新的 Swift 测试、现代化 XCTest 套件、调试不稳定的测试，或提升 Apple 平台或 Swift 服务器项目中的测试质量和可维护性。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or make presentations (PPT/PPTX). Creates visually rich slides by generating images for each slide and composing them into a PowerPoint file.
description_zh: 当用户请求生成、创建或制作演示文稿（PPT/PPTX）时，使用本技能。通过为每张幻灯片生成图像并将其组合成 PowerPoint 文件，创建视觉效果丰富的幻灯片。

description: 将测试文件从 `as` 类型断言迁移到 @total-typescript/shoehorn。适用于用户提到 shoehorn、想替换测试中的 `as`，或需要局部测试数据时。
description_zh: 将测试文件从 `as` 类型断言迁移到 `@total-typescript/shoehorn`。适用于用户提到 shoehorn、希望替换测试中的 `as`，或需要局部测试数据时。

description: Use when working with Lynx DevTool or debugging a Lynx app, page, or device, especially when the task mentions clients or sessions, CDP or App commands, DOM/CSS inspection, runtime or console logs, evaluating JavaScript on a device, screenshots, heap snapshots, performance traces, Page.reload or App.openPage, global switches, interactive snapshot refs and taps/fills/scrolls, inspecting or searching a ReactLynx component tree, linking DOM Snapshot refs to ReactLynx components (`reactlynx link`), or mutating ReactLynx props/state/context on Android, iOS, or Desktop.
description_zh: 适用于使用 Lynx DevTool 或调试 Lynx 应用、页面或设备时使用，尤其当任务涉及客户端或会话、CDP 或应用命令、DOM/CSS 检查、运行时或控制台日志、在设备上执行 JavaScript、截图、堆快照、性能跟踪、Page.reload 或 App.openPage、全局开关、交互式快照引用及点击、填充、滚动、检查或搜索 ReactLynx 组件树、将 DOM Snapshot 引用链接至 ReactLynx 组件（`reactlynx link`），或在 Android、iOS 或桌面端修改 ReactLynx 的 props/state/context 时使用。

description: Design MVPs, validated learning experiments, and pivot-or-persevere decisions using Build-Measure-Learn. Use when the user mentions "MVP scope", "validated learning", "pivot or persevere", "vanity metrics", "test assumptions", "innovation accounting", "build-measure-learn", "minimum viable experiment", "should we pivot", "test a business idea cheaply", or "build the smallest version first". Also trigger when deciding what to include in a first version, measuring startup progress, or evaluating whether to change direction on a product bet. Covers innovation accounting and actionable metrics. For 5-day prototype testing, see design-sprint. For customer motivation analysis, see jobs-to-be-done.
description_zh:
使用 Build-Measure-Learn，设计 MVP、开展验证性学习实验，并做出转向或坚持的决策。当用户提及“MVP 范围”、“验证性学习”、“转向或坚持”、“虚荣指标”、“测试假设”、“创新会计”、“Build-Measure-Learn”、“最小可行实验”、“是否应该转向”、“低成本测试商业理念”或“先构建最小版本”时使用。也适用于决定首次版本应包含的内容、衡量初创企业进展，或评估是否应改变产品方向的决策。涵盖创新会计与可执行指标。

如需了解 5 天原型测试，请参阅“设计冲刺”。如需进行客户动机分析，请参阅“待完成的工作（JTBD）”。

description: Extracts, retrieves, and applies CMS brand guidelines (voice, tone, style, colors, typography) to generated content. Use this skill ANY TIME a user request involves branding, brand voice, brand tone, brand guidelines, brand identity, brand styling, or applying a brand to content. Triggers for requests like "apply my brand", "use our brand voice", "match our brand guidelines", "find my brand", "search for brand", "get brand instructions", "apply brand tone". Handles the full workflow: searching for brands in Salesforce CMS, extracting brand instructions, and applying brand voice/tone/guidelines to generated content. Does not apply to media/image search (use experience-search-coordinate skill), logo search, or creating new brand definitions.
description_zh: 提取、检索并应用内容管理系统（CMS）的品牌指南（声音、语气、风格、色彩、字体排版）到生成的内容中。当用户请求涉及品牌、品牌声音、品牌语气、品牌指南、品牌形象、品牌样式，或将品牌应用于内容时，请在任何时间使用此技能。触发请求示例包括：“应用我的品牌”、“使用我们的品牌声音”、“匹配我们的品牌指南”、“查找我的品牌”、“搜索品牌”、“获取品牌说明”、“应用品牌语气”。该技能处理完整工作流程：在 Salesforce CMS 中搜索品牌、提取品牌说明，并将品牌声音、语气、指南应用于生成的内容。该技能不适用于媒体/图片搜索（使用 experience-search-coordinate 技能）、标志搜索或创建新的品牌定义。

description: Generate Guizang-style social card image sets, Live Photo motion cards, material-first Live Photo puzzle layouts, triple Live Photo collages, long-video-to-Live-Photo treatments, and WeChat official account cover pairs from articles, scripts, screenshots, product notes, subtitles, photos, or user-supplied videos. Use when the user asks for 小红书图文, Rednote/Xiaohongshu images, social cards, carousel images, 3:4 covers, Live Photo, 实况照片, 单视频实况拼图, 二宫格实况拼图, 三连实况拼图, 四宫格实况拼图, 微信公众号封面, WeChat 21:9 + 1:1 covers, Swiss Style, or magazine-style social images.
description_zh: 根据文章、脚本、截图、产品说明、字幕、照片或用户提供的视频，生成 Guizang 风格社交卡片图片集、实况照片动态卡片、素材优先的实况照片拼图版式、三连实况照片拼图、长视频转实况照片处理，以及微信公众号封面成对图。当用户需要小红书图文、Rednote/Xiaohongshu 图片、社交卡片、轮播图、3:4 封面、实况照片（Live Photo）、单视频实况拼图、二宫格实况拼图、三连实况拼图、四宫格实况拼图、微信公众号封面、WeChat 21:9 + 1:1 封面、瑞士风格或杂志风格社交图片时使用。

description: Use when building React 18+ applications in .jsx or .tsx files, Next.js App Router projects, or create-react-app setups. Creates components, implements custom hooks, debugs rendering issues, migrates class components to functional, and implements state management. Invoke for Server Components, Suspense boundaries, useActionState forms, performance optimization, or React 19 features.
description_zh: 适用于构建基于 .jsx 或 .tsx 文件的 React 18+ 应用、Next.js App Router 项目或 create-react-app 项目配置。可创建组件、实现自定义 Hook、调试渲染问题、将类组件迁移为函数式组件，并实现状态管理。适用于服务端组件、Suspense 边界、useActionState 表单、性能优化或 React 19 功能。

description: Use when investigating or improving WordPress performance (backend-only agent): profiling and measurement (WP-CLI profile/doctor, Server-Timing, Query Monitor via REST headers), database/query optimization, autoloaded options, object caching, cron, HTTP API calls, and safe verification.
description_zh: 用于调查或改进 WordPress 性能（仅后端代理）：性能分析与测量（WP-CLI profile/doctor、Server-Timming、通过 REST 头部的 Query Monitor）、数据库/查询优化、自动加载的选项、对象缓存、cron（计划任务）、HTTP API 调用，以及安全验证。

description: Use when the user asks to create, scaffold, or edit Jupyter notebooks (`.ipynb`) for experiments, explorations, or tutorials; prefer the bundled templates and run the helper script `new_notebook.py` to generate a clean starting notebook.
description_zh: 当用户请求创建、搭建或编辑 Jupyter notebooks（`.ipynb`）以进行实验、探索或教程时使用；建议优先使用随附的模板，并运行辅助脚本 `new_notebook.py`，以生成简洁的起始笔记本。

description: Manages GKE application onboarding, covering containerization, deployment manifests, and migration. Use when onboarding or deploying an application to GKE for the first time, or containerizing an app for GKE. Don't use for general GKE cluster administration or upgrades (use gke-basics or gke-upgrades instead).
description_zh: 管理 GKE 应用接入，涵盖容器化、部署清单与迁移。适用于首次将应用接入或部署到 GKE，或为 GKE 容器化应用。请勿用于通用的 GKE 集群管理或升级（请改用 gke-basics 或 gke-upgrades）。

description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".
description_zh: 通过通读每个源文件来预热代码库。在处理新项目或不熟悉的项目时使用，或在用户要求“learn the codebase”、“read the codebase”、“prime”或“get up to speed”时使用。

description: Design effective data visualizations and charts. Generate chart configurations for ECharts, Chart.js, and other libraries. Create dashboards and reports.
description_zh: 设计高效的数据可视化与图表。为 ECharts、Chart.js 及其他图表库生成图表配置。创建仪表盘和报告。

description: Implement, diagnose, or review SwiftUI motion using explicit and scoped implicit animations, springs, transitions, PhaseAnimator, KeyframeAnimator, matched geometry or navigation zoom, SF Symbol effects, and custom Animation types. Use when views should animate on state changes, insertion, removal, navigation, or multi-step choreography, or when motion must respect Reduce Motion and Swift concurrency.
description_zh: 实现、诊断或审阅 SwiftUI 动画，使用显式动画和限定作用域的隐式动画、弹簧动画、过渡动画、PhaseAnimator、KeyframeAnimator、匹配几何或导航缩放、SF Symbol 效果以及自定义 Animation 类型。适用于视图在状态变更、插入、移除、导航或多步编排时进行动画，或在运动必须遵循 Reduce Motion（减少动态效果）和 Swift 并发时使用。

description: Improves GKE workload reliability, using PDBs, health probes, and topology spread constraints. Use when configuring GKE workload reliability, setting up PDBs, or configuring GKE health probes (liveness, readiness, startup). Don't use for disaster recovery setup or full cluster backups (use gke-backup-dr instead).
description_zh: 通过使用 Pod 中断保护（PDB）、健康探针和拓扑分布约束，提升 GKE 工作负载可靠性。在配置 GKE 工作负载可靠性、设置 PDB 或配置 GKE 健康探针（存活探针 liveness、就绪探针 readiness、启动探针 startup）时使用。请勿用于灾难恢复配置或完整集群备份（请改用 gke-backup-dr）。

description: Scans Android APKs for Firebase security misconfigurations including open databases, storage buckets, authentication issues, and exposed cloud functions. Use when analyzing APK files for Firebase vulnerabilities, performing mobile app security audits, or testing Firebase endpoint security. For authorized security research only.
description_zh: 扫描Android APK文件中的Firebase安全配置错误，包括开放的数据库、存储桶、认证问题和暴露的云函数。适用于分析APK文件中的Firebase漏洞、执行移动应用安全审计或测试Firebase端点安全性时使用。仅限授权安全研究使用。

description: Retrieve Data Lake Object (DLO) and Data Model Object (DMO) schema information from Salesforce Data Cloud using REST APIs. Use this skill when you need to inspect DLO or DMO field definitions, data types, or metadata. Takes org alias and optional DLO/DMO name as parameters.
description_zh: 使用 REST 接口从 Salesforce 数据云中检索数据湖对象 (DLO) 和数据模型对象 (DMO) 的模式信息。当您需要检查 DLO 或 DMO 的字段定义、数据类型或元数据时，使用本技能。接收组织别名和可选的 DLO/DMO 名称作为参数。

description: Use when implementing infrastructure as code with Terraform across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Invoke for module development (create reusable modules, manage module versioning), state management (migrate backends, import existing resources, resolve state conflicts), provider configuration, multi-environment workflows, and infrastructure testing.
description_zh: 适用于在 AWS、Azure 或 GCP 上使用 Terraform 实现基础设施即代码时。用于模块开发（创建可复用模块、管理模块版本），状态管理（迁移后端、导入现有资源、解决状态冲突），提供商配置，多环境工作流程，以及基础设施测试。

description: CRM workflow automation for HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive - lead management, deal tracking, and multi-CRM synchronization
description_zh: 面向 HubSpot、Salesforce 和 Pipedrive 的 CRM 工作流自动化 - 线索管理、交易跟踪和多方 CRM 同步

description: Organize and rename files based on content analysis
description_zh: 根据内容分析整理和重命名文件

description: Discover keyword opportunities, evaluate metrics and SERPs, and save/tag promising terms.
description_zh: 发现关键词机会，评估指标和SERP，并保存/标注有前景的关键词。

description: Plans and executes GKE cluster creation, provisioning, and production readiness audits using pre-defined templates (Autopilot, Standard Regional, GPU/AI Inference, AI Hypercompute). Use when creating GKE clusters, provisioning GKE environments, selecting cluster modes, or auditing GKE clusters. Don't use for application onboarding or deployment configuration (use gke-app-onboarding instead).
description_zh: 使用预定义模板（自动运维、标准区域、GPU/AI 推理、AI 超算）规划并执行 GKE 集群创建、配置及生产就绪审计。当创建 GKE 集群、配置 GKE 环境、选择集群模式或审计 GKE 集群时使用。不要用于应用接入或部署配置（请使用 gke-app-onboarding 代替）。

description: AI product photography with studio lighting, lifestyle shots, and packshot conventions. Covers angles, backgrounds, shadow types, hero shots, and e-commerce image requirements. Use for: product photos, e-commerce images, Amazon listings, packshots, lifestyle photography. Triggers: product photography, product photo, packshot, e-commerce photography, product shot, product image, studio photography, lifestyle product, amazon product photo, product listing image, hero shot, product mockup, commercial photography
description_zh:
AI产品摄影，包含影棚灯光、生活场景拍摄与包装展示照片规范。涵盖拍摄角度、背景、阴影类型、主图及电商图片要求。用途：产品照片、电商图片、亚马逊商品列表、包装展示照片、生活摄影。

触发词：产品摄影、产品照片、包装展示照片、电商摄影、产品拍摄、产品图片、影棚摄影、生活方式产品、亚马逊产品照片、商品列表图片、主图、产品模拟图、商业摄影

description: MSW (MapleStory Worlds) game-planning mode — for BOTH starting a brand-new game from scratch AND continuing/resuming an in-progress prototype. Narrow the idea with guided questions, ground it in the MSW genre catalog (3 map types, ~180 core mechanic tags, build-effort hints), and produce or advance an implementation-ready GDD / roadmap (markdown). Trigger proactively (even without the word 'planning') whenever the user wants to decide WHAT to build, scope an MVP, or continue/resume a phased build — INCLUDING when a Docs/*-GDD.md or *-Phase*.md already exists and the user says to continue: do NOT treat that as plain implementation and jump straight into the phase doc; a continue/resume runs through this skill's resume flow first. Match triggers by intent, not exact wording — variants like 'what now?', 'where were we?', and their equivalents in ANY language fire it too. A comprehensive build request spanning multiple implementation pieces, made while no GDD exists, is ALSO a planning trigger — not a plain implementation request, with NO 'small/simple game' exception; implementing that without a plan is the exact failure mode this skill prevents. Triggers: 'plan a new game', 'GDD', 'what game should I make', 'scope an MVP', 'planning mode', 'continue my game', 'resume my game', 'what should I work on next', 'next task'. (Plans & manages the game's build across its milestones — GDD · standing milestone roadmap · phase plans · progress · revisions; does NOT write code — implementation (.mlua/.model etc.) uses msw-general/msw-scripting.)
description_zh: MSW（MapleStory Worlds）游戏规划模式——既适用于从零开始全新创建游戏，也适用于继续/恢复进行中的原型。通过引导性问题将想法细化，并基于MSW的题材目录（3种地图类型、约180个核心机制标签、制作难度提示）落地，并产出或推进可实施的游戏设计文档（GDD）/路线图（Markdown格式）。主动触发（即使未出现“规划”一词），只要用户想要决定要构建什么、规划MVP（最小可行产品）、或继续/恢复分阶段构建时，均应触发——包括当已存在 Docs/*-GDD.md 或 *-Phase*.md 文件，且用户表示要继续时：不要将其视为普通实现，而应直接进入阶段文档；继续/恢复需先经过本技能的恢复流程。根据意图而非确切措辞来匹配触发条件——例如“现在做什么？”、“我们之前到哪了？”，以及任意语言的等价表达，均应触发。当没有GDD时，提出涉及多个实现部分且全面的构建请求，同样是规划触发条件——并非普通实现请求，且没有“小/简单游戏”的例外；在没有规划的情况下实施该请求，正是本技能所要避免的失败模式。触发条件：“规划新游戏”、“GDD”、“我应该制作什么游戏”、“规划MVP”、“规划模式”、“继续我的游戏”、“恢复我的游戏”、“接下来应该做什么”、“下一个任务”。（负责规划并管理游戏在里程碑上的构建——GDD · 里程碑路线图 · 阶段计划 · 进度 · 修订；不编写代码——实现（.mlua/.model 等）使用 msw-general/msw-scripting。）

description: Headless UI for building powerful tables & datagrids for TS/JS, React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Qwik, Angular, and Lit.
description_zh: Headless UI 用于构建功能强大的表格与数据网格，支持 TS/JS、React、Vue、Solid、Svelte、Qwik、Angular 和 Lit。

description: Apply the seven principles of ethical persuasion (reciprocity, commitment, social proof, authority, liking, scarcity, unity) to product design, copy, and sales. Use when the user mentions "social proof", "persuasive copy", "why users dont convert", "ethical persuasion", "reciprocity", "scarcity tactics", "commitment and consistency", "shared identity", "in-group", "make my copy more persuasive", "increase trust", or "get more people to say yes". Also trigger when designing testimonial sections, crafting urgency messaging, or improving trust signals on landing pages. Covers the principles, when each applies, and ethical limits. For deal negotiation tactics, see negotiation. For viral word-of-mouth, see contagious.
description_zh: 将道德说服的七大原则（互惠、承诺、社会认同、权威、喜好、稀缺、统一）应用于产品设计、文案和销售。当用户提及“社会认同”、“说服性文案”、“用户为何不转化”、“道德说服”、“互惠”、“稀缺策略”、“承诺与一致性”、“共同身份认同”、“内群体”、“让我的文案更具说服力”、“提升信任度”或“让更多人同意”时使用。当设计评价区域、撰写紧迫感文案或优化落地页信任信号时，也会触发。涵盖各项原则、各原则的适用场景以及道德底线。关于商务谈判策略，参见谈判。关于病毒式口碑传播，参见传染力。

description: Manages GKE storage, including PVCs, PersistentVolumes, Filestore, and GCS FUSE. Use when configuring GKE storage, creating PVCs, or setting up GCS FUSE on GKE. For diagnosing storage failures (volume attach/mount errors, disk performance/node storage pressure, or Cloud Storage FUSE OOM), use the gke-storage-troubleshooting skill instead. Don't use for database administration or replication strategies outside volume provisioning context.
description_zh: 管理 GKE 存储，包括 PVCs（持久卷声明）、持久卷（PersistentVolumes）、文件存储（Filestore）和 GCS FUSE。在配置 GKE 存储、创建 PVCs 或于 GKE 上设置 GCS FUSE 时使用。对于诊断存储故障（卷附加/挂载错误、磁盘性能/节点存储压力，或 Cloud Storage FUSE OOM（内存溢出）），请改用 gke-storage-troubleshooting 技能。不要用于数据库管理或卷配置上下文之外的复制策略。

description: Develop and deploy Data Cloud Code Extensions using SF CLI plugin. Use this skill when creating custom Python transformations for Data Cloud, deploying code extensions, or testing data transformations. Supports init, run, scan, and deploy operations.
description_zh: 使用 SF CLI 插件开发与部署 Data Cloud 代码扩展。当为 Data Cloud 创建自定义 Python 转换、部署代码扩展或测试数据转换时，使用此技能。支持 init、run、scan 和 deploy 操作。

description: Designs and improves fuzzing harnesses for C/C++ and Rust. Covers mapping raw bytes onto a target API, generating structured inputs, avoiding non-determinism and false crashes, and deciding what to fuzz together. Use when writing a first LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput or fuzz_target! harness, when a campaign finds nothing or reports crashes that will not reproduce, or when the target API needs structured rather than raw input.
description_zh: 为C/C++和Rust设计与改进模糊测试框架。涵盖将原始字节映射至目标API、生成结构化输入、规避非确定性与误报崩溃，以及确定将哪些内容一同进行模糊测试。在编写首个 LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput 或 fuzz_target! 测试框架时，当模糊测试活动未发现任何问题或报告了无法重现的崩溃，或当目标API需要结构化输入而非原始输入时使用。

description: Configures Backup for GKE: the BackupRestore cluster addon, BackupPlan and RestorePlan resources, restore workflows, and CMEK-encrypted backups. Use for backup policies, disaster recovery, or GKE cluster restores. Don't use for database backups.
description_zh: 配置 GKE 备份：配置 BackupRestore 集群插件、BackupPlan 和 RestorePlan 资源、恢复工作流以及 CMEK 加密备份。用于备份策略、灾难恢复或 GKE 集群恢复。请勿用于数据库备份。

description: Multi-platform ad copy generation for Google Ads, Meta/Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn with A/B testing variants
description_zh: 面向 Google Ads、Meta/Facebook、TikTok、LinkedIn 等多平台的广告文案生成，支持 A/B 测试变体

description: Enable or disable the org preference that controls whether a Salesforce org can receive partner offers from the Transactable Marketplace. Use this skill when the user wants to turn partner offer reception on or off for an org. TRIGGER when: user asks to enable or disable partner offers, configure TransactableMarketplaceReceivePartnerOffers, configure enableTransactableMarketplaceReceivePartnerOffers, set up marketplace partner offer reception, toggle the TM partner offers setting, edit a TransactableMarketplacePrivateOffer.settings file, or configure org preferences related to transactable marketplace. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user needs to create or manage the partner offer records themselves, configure marketplace listing settings, or work with SfdcPartnerOffer objects (use platform-metadata-deploy or platform-apex-generate instead).
description_zh: 启用或禁用控制 Salesforce 组织能否从 Transactable Marketplace 接收合作伙伴报价的机构偏好设置。当用户希望对某个组织开启或关闭合作伙伴报价接收时，使用此技能。TRIGGER 当：用户要求启用或禁用合作伙伴报价、配置 TransactableMarketplaceReceivePartnerOffers、配置 enableTransactableMarketplaceReceivePartnerOffers、设置市场合作伙伴报价接收、切换 TM 合作伙伴报价设置、编辑 TransactableMarketplacePrivateOffer.settings 文件，或配置与 Transactable Marketplace 相关的机构偏好时。DO NOT TRIGGER 当：用户需要自行创建或管理合作伙伴报价记录、配置市场列表设置，或处理 SfdcPartnerOffer 对象（请使用 platform-metadata-deploy 或 platform-apex-generate 代替）。

description: Search across all connected sources in one query. Trigger with "find that doc about...", "what did we decide on...", "where was the conversation about...", or when looking for a decision, document, or discussion that could live in chat, email, cloud storage, or a project tracker.
description_zh: 一次查询即可跨所有关联来源进行搜索。使用“find that doc about...”、“what did we decide on...”、“where was the conversation about...”来触发，或者当你寻找可能存在于聊天、电子邮件、云端存储或项目跟踪器中的决定、文档或讨论时。

description: Invoke the `slack-cli` binary to read and act on a Slack workspace from the command line — list channels, read/search conversation history and threads, fetch unread messages, search users, manage user groups, post messages, add reactions, mark channels read, and manage saved items. Use whenever a task needs Slack data or actions, such as "what are the unread messages in
description_zh: 调用 `slack-cli` 二进制文件，从命令行读取并操作 Slack 工作区 — 列出频道，阅读/搜索对话历史和线程，获取未读消息，搜索用户，管理用户群组，发布消息，添加反应，标记频道为已读，以及管理保存的项目。在需要 Slack 数据或操作的任务时使用，例如“在……中的未读消息有哪些”

description: Detects timing side-channel vulnerabilities in cryptographic code. Use when implementing or reviewing crypto code, encountering division on secrets, secret-dependent branches, or constant-time programming questions in C, C++, Go, Rust, Swift, Java, Kotlin, C#, PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Ruby.
description_zh: 检测加密代码中的时序侧信道漏洞。适用于实现或审查加密代码时，在 C、C++、Go、Rust、Swift、Java、Kotlin、C#、PHP、JavaScript、TypeScript、Python 或 Ruby 中遇到对密钥进行除法运算、依赖密钥的分支，或常数时间编程问题时使用。

description: Step-by-step cookbook for setting up cryptographically signed audit trails on Claude Code tool calls. Use when explaining, evaluating, or demonstrating the pattern before committing to the protect-mcp runtime hooks. Covers Cedar policy, Ed25519 receipts, offline verification, tamper detection, CI/CD integration, and SLSA composition.
description_zh: 设置 Claude Code 工具调用上密码学签名审计轨迹的分步操作指南。在决定采用 protect-mcp 运行时钩子之前，用于解释、评估或演示该模式。涵盖 Cedar 策略、Ed25519 回执、离线验证、防篡改检测、CI/CD 集成及 SLSA 组合。

description: Plans and configures multi-tenancy on GKE. Covers namespace isolation, RBAC planning for teams, resource quotas, LimitRanges, network isolation, and cost allocation. Use when designing GKE multi-tenancy, configuring GKE namespaces, setting up resource quotas, or isolating GKE teams. Don't use for single-tenant cluster configuration or general deployment instructions (use gke-basics or gke-app-onboarding instead).
description_zh: 规划和配置 GKE 的多租户。涵盖命名空间隔离、团队 RBAC 规划、资源配额、LimitRanges、网络隔离以及成本分配。在设计和配置 GKE 多租户、配置 GKE 命名空间、设置资源配额或隔离 GKE 团队时使用。请勿用于单租户集群配置或一般部署说明（请改用 gke-basics 或 gke-app-onboarding）。

description: Structured competitive analysis with feature matrices, SWOT, positioning maps, and UX review. Covers research frameworks, pricing comparison, review mining, and visual deliverables. Use for: market research, competitive intelligence, investor decks, product strategy, sales enablement. Triggers: competitor analysis, competitive analysis, competitor teardown, market research, competitive intelligence, swot analysis, competitor comparison, market landscape, competitor review, competitive landscape, feature comparison, market positioning
description_zh: 结构化竞争分析，包括功能矩阵、SWOT分析、定位地图和用户体验审查。涵盖研究框架、价格比较、评论挖掘以及可视化交付成果。用途：市场研究、竞争情报、投资者演示文稿、产品策略、销售赋能。触发关键词：竞争对手分析、竞争分析、竞争对手拆解、市场研究、竞争情报、SWOT分析、竞争对手对比、市场格局、竞争对手评审、竞争格局、功能对比、市场定位。

description: Use when developing WordPress block themes: theme.json (global settings/styles), templates and template parts, patterns, style variations, and Site Editor troubleshooting (style hierarchy, overrides, caching).
description_zh: 在开发WordPress区块主题时使用：theme.json（全局设置/样式）、模板和模板部件、模式、样式变体，以及站点编辑器的故障排除（样式层级、覆盖、缓存）。

description: Searches for and retrieves existing visual media (images, logos, icons, photos, graphics, banners, thumbnails, hero images, backgrounds) from sources such as Salesforce CMS, Data 360 or any other source. Use this skill ANY TIME a user request involves finding, searching, getting, fetching, retrieving, grab, looking up, locating media. NEVER call search_media_cms_channels, search_electronic_media tools directly — always go through this skill first. This skill must be activated before any tool is used for media search or retrieval, without exception.  Takes PRIORITY and activates FIRST when ANY media search/retrieval is mentioned, regardless of what else happens with the media afterward. Triggers for requests like "search for logo", "find hero image", "get company logo", "locate icons", "fetch background image", "retrieve product photos". Handles the search and source selection workflow. Does not apply when the request is about brand search, to generate NEW images with AI, or edit existing images.
description_zh: 从 Salesforce CMS、Data 360 或其他来源检索现有视觉媒体（图像、logo、图标、照片、图形、横幅、缩略图、主图、背景图）。任何时候，当用户请求涉及查找、搜索、获取、抓取、检索、查找、定位媒体时，请始终使用此技能。切勿直接调用 search_media_cms_channels、search_electronic_media 工具，必须先通过此技能进行处理。此技能必须在任何用于媒体搜索或检索的工具使用前激活，且不得例外。当提及任何媒体搜索/检索时，该技能具有优先权，并应首先激活，无论媒体后续发生其他操作。触发情形包括如“搜索 logo”“查找主图”“获取公司 logo”“定位图标”“获取背景图片”“获取产品照片”等请求。该技能负责搜索与来源选择流程。当请求涉及品牌搜索、使用 AI 生成新图片，或编辑现有图片时，该技能不适用。

description: Perform code reviews following Sentry engineering practices. Use when reviewing pull requests, examining code changes, or providing feedback on code quality. Covers security, performance, testing, and design review.
description_zh: 遵循Sentry工程实践进行代码审查。在审查拉取请求、检查代码变更或提供代码质量反馈时使用。涵盖安全、性能、测试和设计审查。

description: Patches past the barriers that stop a fuzzer making progress — checksum and hash verification, magic-value validation, time-based seeds, and other non-deterministic global state. Covers locating the blocking check, neutering it behind a fuzzing build flag, and avoiding the false positives a patch can introduce. Use when a fuzzer is stuck at validation, when coverage shows large regions behind a checksum, or when valid inputs are impractical to generate.
description_zh: 绕过阻碍模糊测试器推进的障碍，包括校验和与哈希校验、魔法值校验、基于时间的种子以及其他非确定性全局状态。涵盖定位阻塞性检查、通过模糊测试构建标志禁用该检查，以及避免补丁可能引入的误报。当模糊测试器在验证阶段卡住、覆盖率显示校验和覆盖区域较大，或有效输入难以生成时使用。

description: Software Mansion's best practices for production React Native and Expo apps on the New Architecture. MUST USE before writing, reviewing, or debugging ANY code in a React Native or Expo project. If the working directory contains a package.json with react-native, expo, or expo-router as a dependency, this skill applies. Trigger on: any code task in a React Native/Expo project, 'React Native', 'Expo', 'New Architecture', 'Reanimated', 'Gesture Handler', 'react-native-svg', 'ExecuTorch', 'react-native-audio-api', 'react-native-enriched-html', 'Worklet', 'Fabric', 'TurboModule', 'WebGPU', 'react-native-wgpu', 'TypeGPU', 'GPU shader', 'WGSL', 'svg', 'animation', 'gesture', 'audio', 'rich text', 'AI model', 'multithreading', 'chart', 'vector', 'image filter', 'shared value', 'useSharedValue', 'runOnJS', 'scheduleOnRN', 'thread', 'worklet', 'Bundle Mode', or any question involving UI, graphics, native modules, or React Native threading and animation behavior. Also use when a more specific sub-skill matches.
description_zh: Software Mansion 基于新架构的生产 React Native 和 Expo 应用的最佳实践。在编写、审查或调试任何 React Native 或 Expo 项目代码之前，必须使用。如果工作目录中包含依赖了 react-native、expo 或 expo-router 的 package.json，则本技能适用。触发条件：在 React Native/Expo 项目中执行任何代码任务，或出现以下关键词：'React Native'、'Expo'、'New Architecture'、'Reanimated'、'Gesture Handler'、'react-native-svg'、'ExecuTorch'、'react-native-audio-api'、'react-native-enriched-html'、'Worklet'、'Fabric'、'TurboModule'、'WebGPU'、'react-native-wgpu'、'TypeGPU'、'GPU shader'、'WGSL'、'svg'、'animation'、'gesture'、'audio'、'rich text'、'AI model'、'multithreading'、'chart'、'vector'、'image filter'、'shared value'、'useSharedValue'、'runOnJS'、'scheduleOnRN'、'thread'、'worklet'、'Bundle Mode'，或任何涉及 UI、图形、原生模块或 React Native 线程与动画行为的问题。当存在更具体的子技能匹配时，也使用。

description: Manages shadcn-vue components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn-vue, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn-vue init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".
description_zh: 管理 shadcn-vue 组件与项目——用于添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式化及组合 UI。提供项目上下文、组件文档和使用示例。适用于使用 shadcn-vue、组件注册表、预设、--preset 代码，或任何包含 components.json 文件的项目。同时，在执行 "shadcn-vue init"、"使用 --preset 创建应用" 或 "切换至 --preset" 时触发。

description: Diagnoses and resolves Amazon EFS issues including mount failures, NFS timeouts, permission errors, throughput problems, and burst credit exhaustion. Use when the user has an EFS file system that is not mounting, returning errors, performing slowly, or showing access denied.
description_zh: 诊断并解决 Amazon EFS 问题，包括挂载失败、NFS 超时、权限错误、吞吐量问题和突发配额耗尽。当用户遇到无法挂载、返回错误、运行缓慢或显示访问被拒绝的 EFS 文件系统时使用。

description: Sets up and runs cargo-fuzz, the standard fuzzing tool for Cargo-based Rust projects. Covers cargo fuzz init, the nightly toolchain requirement, fuzz_target! harnesses, Arbitrary-derived structured inputs, sanitizer options, cargo fuzz coverage, and reproducing a crash artifact. Use when fuzzing a Rust crate, writing a fuzz_target!, exercising unsafe blocks or FFI in Rust, or triaging a cargo fuzz crash.
description_zh: 配置并运行 cargo-fuzz，这是基于 Cargo 的 Rust 项目的标准模糊测试工具。涵盖 cargo fuzz 初始化、nightly 工具链要求、fuzz_target! 测试框架、由 Arbitrary 派生结构化的输入数据、清理器选项、cargo fuzz 覆盖率，以及重现崩溃产物。当对 Rust crate 进行模糊测试、编写 fuzz_target!、在 Rust 中执行 unsafe 代码块或 FFI，或排查 cargo fuzz 崩溃时使用。

description: Analyze contracts for risks, check completeness, and provide actionable recommendations. Supports employment contracts, NDAs, service agreements, and more.
description_zh: 分析合同风险，检查完整性，并提供可操作的建议。支持劳动合同、保密协议（NDA）、服务协议等。

description: Guide for building React applications with Apollo Client 4.x. Use this skill when: (1) setting up Apollo Client in a React project, (2) writing GraphQL queries or mutations with hooks, (3) configuring caching or cache policies, (4) managing local state with reactive variables, (5) troubleshooting Apollo Client errors or performance issues.
description_zh:
使用 Apollo Client 4.x 构建 React 应用指南。
本技能适用于以下场景：
(1) 在 React 项目中设置 Apollo Client；
(2) 使用 hooks 编写 GraphQL 查询或 mutation；
(3) 配置缓存或缓存策略；
(4) 使用响应式变量管理本地状态；
(5) 排查 Apollo Client 错误或性能问题。

description: Landing page conversion optimization with layout rules, hero section design, and CTA psychology. Covers above-the-fold formula, social proof placement, mobile design, and F-pattern reading. Use for: startup landing pages, product pages, SaaS marketing, conversion optimization. Triggers: landing page, hero section, above the fold, conversion optimization, landing page design, cta button, hero image, landing page layout, saas landing page, product page design, conversion rate, landing page best practices
description_zh: 基于布局规则、首屏区域设计与 CTA 心理学的落地页转化优化。涵盖首屏可见公式、社会证明布局、移动端设计以及 F 型阅读规律。适用场景：初创公司落地页、产品页面、SaaS 营销、转化优化。触发词：落地页、首屏区域、首屏可见区域、转化优化、落地页设计、CTA 按钮、首屏图片、落地页布局、SaaS 落地页、产品页面设计、转化率、落地页最佳实践。

description: YouTube thumbnail design with specific dimensions, contrast rules, and mobile preview optimization. Covers safe zones, text placement, face expression psychology, and A/B testing. Use for: YouTube thumbnails, video cover images, click-through optimization.
