Triggers: youtube thumbnail, thumbnail design, video thumbnail, click through rate, ctr optimization, youtube cover, video cover image, thumbnail maker, thumbnail tips, youtube design, video preview image
description_zh: YouTube 缩略图设计，包含特定尺寸、对比度规则和移动端预览优化。涵盖安全区域、文字布局、面部表情心理学和 A/B 测试。用途：YouTube 缩略图、视频封面图、点击率优化。触发词：YouTube 缩略图、缩略图设计、视频缩略图、点击率、点击率优化、YouTube 封面、视频封面图、缩略图制作、缩略图技巧、YouTube 设计、视频预览图

description: Outsider-perspective end-to-end review of a plan, PR, or code change. First questions intent and whether a simpler/more elegant approach would achieve the same goal, then traces the actual code path (not just the diff) to verify the change does what it claims. Output is concise, actionable, and every call carries its rationale. Trigger on /scrutinize and proactively whenever the user asks to review, audit, sanity-check, or get a second opinion on a plan, PR, diff, design doc, or proposed code change.
description_zh: 从外部视角对计划、PR 或代码变更进行端到端审查。首先询问意图，并判断是否存在更简单、更优雅的方案能够实现相同目标，然后追踪实际代码路径（而非仅查看差异）以验证变更是否确实实现了其声称的功能。输出简洁、可执行，且每一次调用都附带其依据。在 /scrutinize 指令时触发，并在用户要求对计划、PR、差异、设计文档或建议的代码变更进行审查、审计、合理性检查或获取第二意见时主动触发。

description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard
description_zh: 影视分镜，包含镜头术语、连续性规则与版面布局。涵盖镜头类型、相机角度、镜头运动、180度原则与标注格式。适用于：视频策划、电影前期制作、广告分镜、音乐视频策划与动画。触发关键词：分镜、分镜制作、镜头清单、电影策划、视频策划、前期制作、镜头构图、相机角度、场景规划、文学剧本、动画样片、分镜面板、视频分镜

description: Sync tasks and refresh memory from your current activity. Use when pulling new assignments from your project tracker into TASKS.md, triaging stale or overdue tasks, filling memory gaps for unknown people or projects, or running a comprehensive scan to catch todos buried in chat and email.
description_zh: 基于您当前的活动，同步任务并刷新记忆。当您将新任务从项目跟踪器拉取至 TASKS.md、筛选过时或逾期的任务、填补未知人物或项目的记忆空白，或运行全面扫描以捕获藏在聊天和邮件中的待办事项时使用。

description: Builds and runs code under AddressSanitizer to catch buffer overflows, use-after-free, and other memory errors during fuzzing or tests. Covers -fsanitize=address builds, ASAN_OPTIONS, reading the crash report, LeakSanitizer, and the overhead and platform trade-offs. Use when fuzzing C/C++ or Rust that has unsafe blocks or FFI, when debugging a memory corruption crash, or when reading an ASan stack trace.
description_zh: 在 AddressSanitizer（ASAN）下构建并运行代码，以在模糊测试或测试过程中捕获缓冲区溢出、use-after-free（释放后使用）及其他内存错误。涵盖 -fsanitize=address 构建、ASAN_OPTIONS、读取崩溃报告、LeakSanitizer 以及开销与平台权衡。当对包含不安全代码块或 FFI（外部函数接口）的 C/C++ 或 Rust 代码进行模糊测试时，或调试内存损坏崩溃，或读取 ASAN 堆栈跟踪时使用。
您好，我注意到您没有提供需要翻译的文本。请您将需要翻译的内容发送给我，我会立即将其准确、流畅地翻译成简体中文。

description: Gets AWS credentials for CLI/SDK access via `aws login`. Activates when a developer needs to authenticate to AWS for local development, when an AWS operation fails due to missing or expired credentials, or when someone asks about setting up AWS access. Triggers: "set up AWS", "configure AWS", "aws login", "get credentials", "authenticate", "session expired", "token expired", "no credentials", "AccessDeniedException" with no configured credentials.
description_zh: 通过 `aws login` 获取用于 CLI/SDK 访问的 AWS 凭证。当开发者需要为本地开发进行 AWS 身份验证、AWS 操作因缺少或过期的凭证而失败，或有人询问如何设置 AWS 访问时触发。触发条件："设置 AWS"、"配置 AWS"、"aws login"、"获取凭证"、"身份验证"、"会话过期"、"令牌过期"、"无凭证"、"AccessDeniedException"（未配置凭证时）。

description: Guidance for Worktrunk (the `wt` CLI) — git worktree management, hooks, and config. Load when working out which worktree a `wt` command will act on, or reaching for the global `-C <path>` to target one; editing .config/wt.toml or ~/.config/worktrunk/config.toml; adding, modifying, or debugging hooks (post-merge, post-start, pre-commit, pre-merge, post-switch, etc.); configuring commit message generation or command aliases; or troubleshooting wt behavior. Also answers general worktrunk/wt questions.
description_zh: Worktrunk (wt CLI) 使用指南——git 工作树管理、钩子和配置。当需要确定 `wt` 命令将作用于哪个工作树，或需要使用全局 `-C <path>` 来指定目标；编辑 `.config/wt.toml` 或 `~/.config/worktrunk/config.toml`；添加、修改或调试钩子（如 post-merge、post-start、pre-commit、pre-merge、post-switch 等）；配置提交信息生成或命令别名；或排查 `wt` 行为问题时，请参考本指南。本指南还解答关于 Worktrunk/`wt` 的一般问题。

description: 店铺巡检工作流：编排 store list + store open + page visit + page screenshot 完成店铺状态检查和截图巡检。适用于定期检查店铺页面状态、批量截图存档。
description_zh: 店铺巡检工作流：编排 store list + store open + page visit + page screenshot 完成店铺状态检查和截图巡检。适用于定期检查店铺页面状态、批量截图存档。

description: Configures monitoring systems, implements structured logging pipelines, creates Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, defines alerting rules, and instruments distributed tracing. Implements Prometheus/Grafana stacks, conducts load testing, performs application profiling, and plans infrastructure capacity. Use when setting up application monitoring, adding observability to services, debugging production issues with logs/metrics/traces, running load tests with k6 or Artillery, profiling CPU/memory bottlenecks, or forecasting capacity needs.
description_zh:
配置监控系统，实现结构化日志管道，创建 Prometheus/Grafana 仪表盘，定义告警规则，并为分布式追踪进行埋点。实现 Prometheus/Grafana 技术栈，执行负载测试，开展应用性能分析，规划基础设施容量。

适用于配置应用监控、为服务添加可观测性、通过日志/指标/追踪数据排查生产问题、使用 k6 或 Artillery 执行负载测试、分析 CPU/内存瓶颈或预测容量需求时。

description: Create irresistible offers using the Value Equation, bonus stacking, risk-reversing guarantees, and ethical scarcity. Use when the user mentions "grand slam offer", "make my offer more compelling", "what bonuses should I add", "guarantee strategy", "offer naming", or "people say its too expensive". Also trigger when packaging a product for higher perceived value, justifying premium pricing instead of discounting, designing a money-back guarantee, or structuring tiers to maximize conversions. Covers the MAGIC naming formula and starving-crowd targeting. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For outbound sales, see predictable-revenue.
description_zh: 使用价值方程、奖励叠加、风险逆转保障和道德稀缺性，打造令人无法抗拒的优惠方案。当用户提到“大满贯Offer”、“使我的报价更有吸引力”、“我应该添加哪些奖励”、“保障策略”、“报价命名”或“人们说它太贵了”时使用。此外，当用于为产品提升更高的感知价值、为溢价定价提供合理依据而非采用折扣、设计退款保障，或构建层级结构以最大化转化时，也会触发。涵盖MAGIC命名公式和饥饿人群定向。关于产品定位，请参阅obviously-awesome。关于外联销售，请参阅predictable-revenue。

description: Generate and edit images using Wan and Qwen Image models. Supports text-to-image, image editing (style transfer, subject consistency, text rendering), and interleaved text-image output. TRIGGER when: user wants to create illustrations, product images, artistic designs, posters, text-to-image generation, edit/transform existing images, apply style transfer, generate images based on reference photos, interleaved text-image content, mentions Wan/Qwen Image models/AI art creation, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qianwen-image-generation). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to understand/analyze existing images or OCR (use qianwen-vision), video generation (use qianwen-video-generation), text-only tasks.
description_zh:
使用万和通义千问图像模型生成并编辑图像。支持文生图、图像编辑（风格迁移、主体一致性、文字渲染），以及图文交错输出。

description_zh: 当任务受益于AI生成的位图视觉素材，如照片、插画、纹理、精灵、样机或带透明背景的抠图时，生成或编辑位图图像。当Codex需要创建全新图像、转换现有图像，或从参考图衍生视觉变体，且输出应为位图资产而非仓库原生代码或矢量图时，使用。当任务更适合通过编辑现有SVG/矢量/代码原生资产、扩展既有的图标或标识系统，或在HTML/CSS/画布中直接构建视觉元素时，不要使用。

description: Local speech-to-text with the Whisper CLI (no API key).
description_zh: 使用 Whisper CLI 进行本地语音转写（无需 API 密钥）。

description: Interact with ClawDirect, a directory of social web experiences for AI agents. Use this skill to browse the directory, like entries, or add new sites. Requires ATXP authentication for MCP tool calls. Triggers: browsing agent-oriented websites, discovering social platforms for agents, liking/voting on directory entries, or submitting new agent-facing sites to ClawDirect.
description_zh: 与 ClawDirect 交互，ClawDirect 是一个面向 AI 智能体的社交网络体验目录。使用此技能浏览目录、点赞条目或添加新网站。进行 MCP 工具调用需要 ATXP 认证。触发条件：浏览面向智能体的网站、发现智能体使用的社交平台、对目录条目点赞或投票，或向 ClawDirect 提交面向智能体的新网站。

description: Generates Claude Code skills from the Trail of Bits Testing Handbook (appsec.guide), analyzing handbook pages and emitting SKILL.md files with the structure each skill type requires. Use when creating or refreshing a skill from handbook content, or when the user names the testing handbook or appsec.guide. Not for answering security testing questions — the generated skills cover those.
description_zh: 从 Trail of Bits Testing Handbook (appsec.guide) 生成 Claude Code 技能，分析手册页面，并生成每种技能类型所要求的 SKILL.md 文件结构。当从手册内容创建或刷新技能，或当用户提及测试手册或 appsec.guide 时使用。不用于回答安全测试问题——生成的技能涵盖这些内容。

description: Resize and validate App Store screenshots with current asc screenshot-size data and macOS sips. Use when preparing or fixing screenshots for App Store Connect submission.
description_zh: 使用当前 App Store Connect 截图尺寸数据与 macOS Sips，对应用商店截图进行调整和验证。适用于准备或修复待提交至 App Store Connect 的截图。

description: Assess and classify legal risks using a severity-by-likelihood framework with escalation criteria. Use when evaluating contract risk, assessing deal exposure, classifying issues by severity, or determining whether a matter needs senior counsel or outside legal review.
description_zh: 运用基于严重性与发生可能性的框架及升级标准，评估和分类法律风险。适用于评估合同风险、评估交易风险敞口、按严重程度对问题进行分类，或判断事项是否需要资深律师或外部法律审核的场景。

description: Fetches real-time Azure retail pricing using the Azure Retail Prices API (prices.azure.com) and estimates Copilot Studio agent credit consumption. Use when the user asks about the cost of any Azure service, wants to compare SKU prices, needs pricing data for a cost estimate, mentions Azure pricing, Azure costs, Azure billing, or asks about Copilot Studio pricing, Copilot Credits, or agent usage estimation. Covers compute, storage, networking, databases, AI, Copilot Studio, and all other Azure service families.
description_zh: 通过 Azure Retail Prices API（prices.azure.com）获取实时 Azure 零售价格，并估算 Copilot Studio 智能体信用消耗。当用户询问任何 Azure 服务的成本、想比较 SKU 价格、需要定价数据用于成本估算、提及 Azure 定价、Azure 成本、Azure 计费，或询问 Copilot Studio 定价、Copilot Credits、智能体使用估算时使用。涵盖计算、存储、网络、数据库、AI、Copilot Studio，以及其他所有 Azure 服务类型。

description: Synthesize speech from text with Qwen TTS models. TRIGGER when: user wants to convert text to speech, create voiceovers, generate audio narration, read text aloud, build TTS applications, mentions speech synthesis/voice generation/audio output from text, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qianwen-audio-tts). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants speech recognition/ASR, text generation without audio, non-Qwen audio tasks.
description_zh:
使用通义千问 TTS 模型从文本合成语音。

**TRIGGER 条件：** 当用户希望将文本转换为语音、创建配音、生成音频旁白、朗读文本、构建 TTS 应用、提及基于文本的语音合成/语音生成/音频输出，或明确调用本技能（例如使用 qianwen-audio-tts）时触发。

**DO NOT TRIGGER 条件：** 当用户需要语音识别/ASR、无需音频的文本生成或非通义音频任务时，不要触发。

description: The entry point for building any Salesforce native mobile app on iOS or Android. TRIGGER when the user says: "build a Salesforce iOS app", "add Salesforce login to my Android app", "set up Mobile SDK", "add MobileSync / SmartStore offline storage", "embed an Agentforce agent in my mobile app", "add Agentforce chat to iOS/Android", or otherwise asks to create, extend, or integrate a Salesforce mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin (MSDK, Agentforce SDK, or both). SKIP when the user is building a non-Salesforce mobile app, using React Native / Flutter / Ionic without Salesforce integration, asking about generic mobile UI design, or working on a Salesforce-adjacent web/desktop surface (LWC, Experience Cloud, Mobile Publisher branding-only).
description_zh:
构建任何 Salesforce 原生移动应用（iOS 或 Android）的入口。当用户说以下内容时触发：
“构建 Salesforce iOS 应用”，
“在我的 Android 应用中添加 Salesforce 登录”，
“设置 Mobile SDK”，
“添加 MobileSync / SmartStore 离线存储”，
“在我的移动应用中嵌入 Agentforce 代理”，
“为 iOS/Android 添加 Agentforce 聊天”，
或在其他情况下要求使用 Swift 或 Kotlin 创建、扩展或集成 Salesforce 移动体验（MSDK、Agentforce SDK，或两者）。当用户构建非 Salesforce 移动应用、使用无需 Salesforce 集成的 React Native / Flutter / Ionic、询问通用移动 UI 设计，或在与 Salesforce 相关的网页/桌面端进行工作（LWC、Experience Cloud、Mobile Publisher 品牌相关）时跳过。

description:
Creates engaging content for blogs, social media, and marketing materials with audience focus.
Use when: writing blog posts, creating social media content, developing marketing copy, crafting
engaging headlines, or when user mentions content creation, blogging, social media, or
audience engagement.
description_zh:
以受众为导向，制作用于博客、社交媒体和营销材料的引人入胜内容。
适用于：撰写博客文章，创建社交媒体内容，开发营销文案，打造
引人入胜的标题，或当用户提及内容创作、博客、社交媒体或
受众互动。

description: Writes, optimizes, and debugs C++ applications using modern C++20/23 features, template metaprogramming, and high-performance systems techniques. Use when building or refactoring C++ code requiring concepts, ranges, coroutines, SIMD optimization, or careful memory management — or when addressing performance bottlenecks, concurrency issues, and build system configuration with CMake.
description_zh: 使用现代 C++20/23 特性、模板元编程和高性能系统技术编写、优化和调试 C++ 应用程序。适用于构建或重构需要概念、范围、协程、SIMD 优化或细致内存管理的 C++ 代码——或用于解决性能瓶颈、并发问题，以及使用 CMake 进行构建系统配置的情况。

description: Get structured design feedback on usability, hierarchy, and consistency. Trigger with "review this design", "critique this mockup", "what do you think of this screen?", or when sharing a Figma link or screenshot for feedback at any stage from exploration to final polish.
description_zh: 获取关于可用性、层级与一致性方面的结构化设计反馈。可通过“review this design”、“critique this mockup”、“what do you think of this screen?”触发，或在从探索到最终润色的任何阶段分享 Figma 链接或截图以获取反馈时触发。

description: Creates durable, resumable workflows using Vercel's Workflow SDK. Use when building workflows that need to survive restarts, pause for external events, retry on failure, or coordinate multi-step operations over time. Triggers on mentions of "workflow", "durable functions", "resumable", "workflow sdk", "queue", "event", "push", "subscribe", or step-based orchestration.
description_zh: 使用 Vercel 工作流 SDK 创建持久、可恢复的工作流。适用于构建需要能够应对重启、为外部事件暂停、失败时重试或协调随时间进行多步骤操作的工作流。在提及“工作流”、“持久函数”、“可恢复”、“工作流 SDK”、“队列”、“事件”、“推送”、“订阅”或“基于步骤的编排”时触发。

description: Map SEO market leaders, winning content themes, keyword coverage, backlinks, and strategic gaps.
description_zh: 映射SEO市场领导者、成功内容主题、关键词覆盖、反向链接及战略空白。

description: Populate a project's shared OpenSEO context — site scope, goals, positioning, competitors, key pages, and preferences — plus MCP checks and Search Console intake.
description_zh: 填充项目共享的OpenSEO上下文——站点范围、目标、定位、竞争对手、关键页面和偏好——以及MCP检查与Search Console数据导入。

description: Use when writing E2E tests with Playwright, setting up test infrastructure, or debugging flaky browser tests. Invoke to write test scripts, create page objects, configure test fixtures, set up reporters, add CI integration, implement API mocking, or perform visual regression testing. Trigger terms: Playwright, E2E test, end-to-end, browser testing, automation, UI testing, visual testing, Page Object Model, test flakiness.
description_zh: 用于使用 Playwright 编写 E2E 测试、搭建测试基础设施或调试不稳定的浏览器测试时。调用以编写测试脚本、创建页面对象、配置测试夹具、设置报告器、添加 CI 集成、实现 API 模拟或进行视觉回归测试。触发术语：Playwright、E2E 测试、端到端、浏览器测试、自动化、UI 测试、视觉测试、页面对象模型、测试不稳定性。

description: Invoke the `groundcover` Go CLI to manage Groundcover resources (dashboards, monitors, silences, connected apps, notification routes, API keys, policies, integrations, pipelines, workflows) AND to answer production observability questions by querying logs, traces, metrics, k8s inventory, and k8s events. Use whenever a task needs an authenticated call against the Groundcover API or whenever the user is debugging a prod issue and asks things like "why is X erroring in prod", "show me logs for service Y", "what's the p99 latency on Z", "what pods are crashlooping", "search traces for slow requests", "any k8s events for namespace N", "is service S receiving traffic", "list groundcover monitors", "create a silence", "update notification route", "hit a groundcover endpoint". Covers required env vars, the SDK-backed vs raw command split, and concrete request-body templates for logs/traces/metrics/k8s so the CLI can be driven from anywhere.
description_zh:
调用 `groundcover` Go CLI 来管理 Groundcover 资源（仪表盘、监控、静默、已连接应用、通知路由、API 密钥、策略、集成、流水线、工作流），并通过查询日志、追踪、指标、k8s 资源清单和 k8s 事件来回答生产环境的可观测性问题。

在需要针对 Groundcover API 进行身份验证调用，或用户正在排查生产环境问题并询问诸如“为什么 X 在生产环境报错”、“显示服务 Y 的日志”、“Z 的 p99 延迟是多少”、“哪些 Pod 正在 crashlooping”、“搜索慢请求的追踪信息”、“命名空间 N 有哪些 k8s 事件”、“服务 S 是否在接收流量”、“列出 Groundcover 监控”、“创建静默”、“更新通知路由”、“调用 Groundcover 端点”等问题时，随时使用。

涵盖所需的环境变量、基于 SDK 与原生命令的区分，以及针对日志、追踪、指标和 k8s 的具体请求体模板，以确保该 CLI 能够从任何位置驱动。

description: OmniStudio Data Mapper (formerly DataRaptor) creation and validation with 100-point scoring. Use when building Extract, Transform, Load, or Turbo Extract Data Mappers, mapping Salesforce object fields, or reviewing existing Data Mapper configurations. TRIGGER when: user creates Data Mappers, configures field mappings, works with OmniDataTransform metadata, or asks about DataRaptor/Data Mapper patterns. DO NOT TRIGGER when: building Integration Procedures (use omnistudio-integration-procedure-generate), authoring OmniScripts (use omnistudio-omniscript-generate), or analyzing cross-component dependencies (use omnistudio-dependencies-analyze).
description_zh:
OmniStudio 数据映射器（原 DataRaptor）创建与验证（100 分评分）。用于构建 Extract、Transform、Load、Turbo Extract 数据映射器、映射 Salesforce 对象字段、或审查现有数据映射器配置时。

触发条件：用户创建数据映射器、配置字段映射、使用 OmniDataTransform 元数据，或询问 DataRaptor/数据映射器模式时。

不触发条件：构建集成过程（使用 omnistudio-integration-procedure-generate）、编写 OmniScripts（使用 omnistudio-omniscript-generate）、或分析跨组件依赖关系（使用 omnistudio-dependencies-analyze）时。

description: Scans Algorand smart contracts for 11 common vulnerabilities including rekeying attacks, unchecked transaction fees, missing field validations, and access control issues. Use when auditing Algorand projects (TEAL/PyTeal).
description_zh: 扫描Algorand智能合约中的11种常见漏洞，包括重密钥攻击、未检查的交易手续费、缺失字段验证以及访问控制问题。适用于审计Algorand项目（TEAL/PyTeal）。

description:
Deploys a baseline landing zone foundation for a Google Cloud Organization, establishing security guardrails using Organization Policies, resource hierarchy folders and projects, billing association, and centralized logging and monitoring. Deploys Google Cloud's recommended security controls and architecture. Use when setting up a new Google Cloud Organization or establishing a secure, enterprise-grade landing zone foundation.
Don't use for individual project onboarding (use google-cloud-recipe-onboarding or product-specific skills instead).
description_zh:
为 Google Cloud 组织部署基准着陆区基础架构，并建立基于组织策略、资源层级文件夹与项目、计费关联以及集中日志与监控的安全护栏。部署 Google Cloud 推荐的安全控制措施与架构。适用于设置新的 Google Cloud 组织或建立安全、企业级的着陆区基础架构。

请勿用于单个项目的接入（请改用 google-cloud-recipe-onboarding 或产品专用技能）。

description: Apply foundational design principles: affordances, signifiers, constraints, feedback, and conceptual models. Use when the user mentions "why is this confusing", "affordance", "error prevention", "discoverability", "human-centered design", "mental model", "mapping", "seven stages of action", "users keep making mistakes", "this is unintuitive", or "people cant figure out how to use it". Also trigger when reducing product complexity or feature creep. Covers the gulfs of execution and evaluation. For usability scoring, see ux-heuristics. For iOS-specific patterns, see ios-hig-design.
description_zh: 应用以下基础设计原则：可感知性、指示符、约束、反馈和概念模型。当用户提到“为什么这令人困惑”、“可感知性”、“防错”、“可发现性”、“以人为中心的设计”、“心智模型”、“映射”、“行动七阶段”、“用户不断犯错”、“这并不直观”或“人们无法弄清楚如何使用这些功能”时，应使用上述原则。当需要减少产品复杂性或功能蔓延时，也会触发。涵盖执行与评估中的障碍。关于可用性评分，请参阅 ux-heuristics。关于 iOS 特定模式，请参阅 ios-hig-design。

description: Build a Salesforce LWC that uses native mobile device capabilities — barcode scanner, biometrics, location, NFC, calendar, contacts, document scanner, geofencing, AR space capture, app review, and payments. Use this skill when the user asks for an LWC that scans a barcode, captures a photo of a document, reads location or geofences, prompts for biometrics, reads/writes the device calendar or contacts, taps NFC, takes a payment, prompts for an app review, or scans an AR space. Also triggers on "lightning/mobileCapabilities", "mobile capability", "Nimbus", "device capability". Do not use for mobile offline / Komaci priming reviews (use `mobile-platform-offline-validate`) or for picking generic Lightning base components (use `design-systems-slds-apply`).
description_zh: 构建一个使用原生移动设备功能的 Salesforce LWC——包括条形码扫描器、生物识别、定位、NFC、日历、联系人、文档扫描器、地理围栏、AR 空间捕获、应用审核和支付。当用户请求构建用于扫描条形码的 LWC、扫描文档照片、读取位置或地理围栏、提示进行生物识别、读取或写入设备日历或联系人、触碰 NFC、进行支付、提示应用审核或扫描 AR 空间时，使用此技能。此外，当出现“lightning/mobileCapabilities”、“mobile capability”、“Nimbus”、“device capability”等关键词时，亦会触发。请勿用于移动离线/Komaci 初始化审核（请使用 `mobile-platform-office-validate`），也不用于选择通用的 Lightning 基础组件（请使用 `design-systems-slds-apply`）。

description: Find link prospects, discover contact paths, and draft outreach from SERPs and backlink signals.
description_zh: 从 SERP 和反向链接信号中，发现链接潜在客户、发掘联系渠道，并拟定外联方案。

description: Salesforce Industries Common Core (OmniStudio/Vlocity) Apex callable generation and review skill with 120-point scoring. Use when creating, reviewing, or migrating Industries callable Apex implementations. TRIGGER when: user creates or reviews System.Callable classes, migrates VlocityOpenInterface or VlocityOpenInterface2, or builds Industries callable extensions used by OmniStudio, Integration Procedures, or DataRaptors. DO NOT TRIGGER when: generic Apex classes or triggers (use platform-apex-generate), building Integration Procedures (use omnistudio-integration-procedure-generate), authoring OmniScripts (use omnistudio-omniscript-generate), configuring Data Mappers (use omnistudio-datamapper-generate), or analyzing namespace/dependency issues (use omnistudio-dependencies-analyze).
description_zh:
Salesforce Industries Common Core（OmniStudio/Vlocity）的 Apex 可调用代码生成与审阅技能，采用 120 分评分。在创建、审阅或迁移 Industries 可调用 Apex 实现时使用。

触发条件：用户创建或审阅 System.Callable 类、迁移 VlocityOpenInterface 或 VlocityOpenInterface2、或构建用于 OmniStudio、Integration Procedures、DataRaptors 的 Industries 可调用扩展。

请勿触发：处理通用 Apex 类或触发器（使用 platform-apex-generate）、构建 Integration Procedures（使用 omnistudio-integration-procedure-generate）、编写 OmniScripts（使用 omnistudio-omniscript-generate）、配置 Data Mappers（使用 omnistudio-datamapper-generate），或分析命名空间/依赖问题（使用 omnistudio-dependencies-analyze）。

description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.
description_zh: 将代码库映射为按功能分组的流程图，识别跨功能的重复关注点，并提议统一架构。当被要求“寻找理想路径”、“统一重复系统”或重构前进行架构审计时使用。输出建议的统一流程图，以及针对各系统的 /make-plan 提示。

description: Use when adding, removing, upgrading, or discovering Unity (UPM) packages programmatically from outside the Editor — headless or CI package installs via the C# UnityEditor.PackageManager.Client API, verifying package ids/versions against the Unity registry, or choosing which packages a game needs by genre, platform, and monetization. The Unity CLI does not manage UPM packages, so this skill covers that gap. Triggers on "install a Unity package", "add com.unity.*", "set up packages headless/CI", "which packages for a [genre] game".
description_zh: 适用于在编辑器外部以编程方式添加、移除、升级或发现 Unity (UPM) 包——通过 C# UnityEditor.PackageManager.Client API 进行无头模式或 CI 环境下的包安装，核对包 ID/版本是否符合 Unity 注册表，或根据游戏类型、平台和商业化模式选择游戏所需的包。Unity CLI 不管理 UPM 包，因此本技能覆盖这一空白。触发条件包括"安装 Unity 包"、"添加 com.unity.*"、"在无头模式/CI 环境下配置包"、"为 [游戏类型] 游戏选择所需包"等。

description: Cross-cutting OmniStudio analysis skill for namespace detection, dependency visualization, and impact analysis across OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures, and Data Mappers. TRIGGER when: user asks about OmniStudio dependencies, wants namespace detection (Core vs vlocity_cmt vs vlocity_ins), needs impact analysis, requests dependency graphs or Mermaid diagrams, or asks which components are affected by a change. DO NOT TRIGGER when: authoring OmniScripts (use omnistudio-omniscript-generate), building FlexCards (use omnistudio-flexcard-generate), creating Integration Procedures (use omnistudio-integration-procedure-generate), or configuring Data Mappers (use omnistudio-datamapper-generate).
description_zh:
横切 OmniStudio 分析技能，用于跨 OmniScripts、FlexCards、集成流程与数据映射器进行命名空间检测、依赖可视化及影响分析。

**触发条件（TRIGGER）：**
当用户询问 OmniStudio 依赖关系、需要命名空间检测（Core 与 vlocity_cmt 与 vlocity_ins 之间）、需要影响分析、请求依赖图或 Mermaid 图表，或询问变更会影响哪些组件时触发。

**勿触发条件（DO NOT TRIGGER）：**
当进行 OmniScripts 编写（使用 omnistudio-omniscript-generate）、构建 FlexCards（使用 omnistudio-flexcard-generate）、创建集成流程（使用 omnistudio-integration-procedure-generate）、或配置数据映射器（使用 omnistudio-datamapper-generate）时勿触发。

description: Search Naver blogs, read full post content, and download images using only python3 stdlib — no API key required.
description_zh: 仅使用 python3 标准库搜索 Naver 博客、读取完整文章内容并下载图片——无需 API 密钥。

description: Use when the user asks how to build with OpenAI products or APIs, asks about Codex itself or choosing Codex surfaces, needs up-to-date official documentation with citations, help choosing the latest model for a use case, or model upgrade and prompt-upgrade guidance; use OpenAI docs MCP tools for non-Codex docs questions, use the Codex manual helper first for broad Codex self-knowledge, and restrict fallback browsing to official OpenAI domains.
description_zh: 适用于以下情况：当用户询问如何基于 OpenAI 产品或 API 构建，询问 Codex 本身或选择 Codex 的界面形式，需要带有引用的最新官方文档，需要根据具体场景帮助选择最新模型，或需要模型升级与提示词升级指导时；对于非 Codex 的文档问题，使用 OpenAI 文档 MCP 工具；对于广泛的 Codex 自身知识，优先使用 Codex 手册助手；并将备选浏览限制在官方 OpenAI 域名内。

description: OmniStudio Integration Procedure creation and validation with 110-point scoring. Use this skill when building server-side process orchestrations that combine Data Mapper actions, Apex Remote Actions, HTTP callouts, and conditional logic. TRIGGER when: user creates Integration Procedures, adds Data Mapper steps, configures Remote Actions, or reviews existing IP configurations. description: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT YET VERIFIED AGAINST LIVE TWILIO, and it spends real money — every message is billed, and a US-bound production number additionally needs A2P 10DLC registration (fees, weeks of lead time). Say both things to the user before building. That said, if a Caffeine build does send SMS or MMS, or configures Twilio messaging, from a canister, the `twilio-client` mops package (Twilio REST API) with a canister-held HTTP Basic credential is the only supported path. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `api.twilio.com` or `messaging.twilio.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses the typed bindings, the per-operation host routing, the Basic-Auth header construction, and above all the non-replicated outcall default that stops one `send` from becoming ~13 billed messages. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions SMS, MMS, "text message", "send a text", phone numbers, Twilio, a Messaging Service, A2P 10DLC, toll-free verification, short codes, or an alphanumeric sender — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a Twilio endpoint.
description_zh:
这是一项实验性的、尚未针对实时代码环境（Live）验证的方案，且会产生真实费用——每条消息均需计费，且发往美国的生产环境号码还需完成 A2P 10DLC 注册（涉及相关费用及数周的筹备周期）。

在构建代码之前，必须向用户说明上述这两点。

尽管如此，如果 Caffeine 构建确实从容器中发送短信或 MMS，或配置了 Twilio 消息服务，则使用存放于容器中的 HTTP Basic 凭证的 `twilio-client` mops 包（基于 Twilio REST API）是唯一支持的路径。

手动编写指向 `api.twilio.com` 或 `messaging.twilio.com` 的 `ic.http_request` 调用，属于禁止的反模式——这会导致绕过类型化绑定、按操作的主机路由、Basic 认证头部构建，且最重要的是，会绕过非复制对外呼叫的默认机制，致使一次 `send` 操作演变为约 13 条计费消息。

当用户、规范或任何先前任务提及短信（SMS）、MMS、“文本消息”、“发送短信”、电话号码、Twilio、消息服务、A2P 10DLC、免费电话验证、短代码或字母数字发送者时，请加载本技能——并在编写任何涉及 Twilio 端点的代码之前。

description: Measures timing side channels in cryptographic implementations by running them, using dudect for statistical analysis and Timecop over Valgrind for dynamic tracing. Covers the formal, symbolic, dynamic, and statistical tool categories and how to read a result. Use when testing whether a running implementation is constant-time, measuring timing variance on a compiled binary, or investigating a suspected timing attack. Not for statically inspecting compiler output — the constant-time-analysis plugin covers that.
description_zh: 通过运行来测量密码实现中的时序侧信道，使用 dudect 进行统计分析，利用 Valgrind 上的 Timecop 进行动态追踪。涵盖形式化、符号化、动态和统计分析等工具类别以及结果的解读方法。适用于测试运行中的实现是否为常数时间、测量编译后二进制的时序方差，或调查疑似时序攻击的情况。不适用于静态检查编译器输出——常数时间分析插件已覆盖该场景。

description: Write, validate, and optimize PromQL for Prometheus / Grafana Mimir / Grafana Cloud Metrics. Covers `rate` vs `irate` vs `increase`, label matchers and regex, `sum / avg / topk / by / without` aggregation, classic + native `histogram_quantile`, ratios with divide-by-zero guards, `absent` / `changes` for staleness, time offsets and `predict_linear`, recording-rule naming, SLO + burn-rate math, and a cardinality-hunting playbook. Use when writing a metric query, fixing wrong p95s, building an error-budget alert, debugging "query is slow", finding the noisy label that blew up cardinality, or migrating a dashboard query to a recording rule — even when the user says "calculate the error rate", "p99 latency", "sum by service", "why is this query slow", or "what's filling Mimir" without naming PromQL.
description_zh: 编写、验证和优化 PromQL，适用于 Prometheus / Grafana Mimir / Grafana Cloud Metrics。内容涵盖 `rate` 与 `irate` 与 `increase` 的区别，标签匹配器和正则表达式，`sum / avg / topk / by / without` 聚合函数，经典版与原生版 `histogram_quantile`，带除零保护的比率计算，用于判断数据陈旧性的 `absent` / `changes`，时间偏移和 `predict_linear`，记录规则命名，SLO 与燃烧速率的数学计算，以及基数排查指南。适用于编写指标查询、修正错误的 p95 值、构建错误预算告警、排查“查询变慢”、找出导致基数爆炸的嘈杂标签、或将仪表板查询迁移为记录规则——即便用户未指明 PromQL，仅以“计算错误率”“p99 延迟”“按服务汇总”“为何查询变慢”或“什么是占满 Mimir 的负载”等表述提出需求时，本工具同样适用。
您提供的内容中并没有需要翻译的源文本，目前无法进行翻译。请提供需要翻译的文本，我将为您准确地翻译成简体中文。

当用户提及“用户注册了但无法留存”、“激活率”、“上手体验摩擦”、“留存指标”、“用户为何未完成”、“流失分析”或“Aha时刻”时使用。

当分析用户群留存曲线、设计激活里程碑、缩短新用户的价值实现时间，或调查用户首次会话后流失原因时，亦触发此方案。

description: Create custom Code Analyzer rules for Regex (pattern matching), PMD (XPath/AST for Apex and metadata XML), and ESLint (LWC/JavaScript/TypeScript). Use when users want to enforce coding standards, ban patterns, detect hardcoded values, govern metadata, or add rules not in the built-in set. TRIGGER when: user says 'create a rule', 'ban System.debug', 'enforce naming convention', 'detect hardcoded IDs', 'custom rule', 'xpath rule', 'regex rule', 'add a PMD rule', 'enforce a policy', 'create a check for', 'flag this pattern', 'make a rule that catches', 'metadata rule', 'check permissions', 'enforce API version', 'eslint rule', 'lwc rule', 'override rule threshold', 'customize complexity', or describes a pattern to enforce. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to run a scan (use dx-code-analyzer-run), configure engines (use dx-code-analyzer-configure), or explain existing rules (use dx-code-analyzer-run).
description_zh:
为 Regex（模式匹配）、PMD（针对 Apex 和元数据 XML 的 XPath/AST）以及 ESLint（LWC/JavaScript/TypeScript）创建自定义代码分析规则。当用户需要强制编码标准、禁止特定模式、检测硬编码值、管控元数据，或添加内置集合之外的规则时使用。

触发条件：当用户说“创建规则”、“禁止 System.debug”、“强制执行命名规范”、“检测硬编码 ID”、“自定义规则”、“XPath 规则”、“正则表达式规则”、“添加 PMD 规则”、“强制执行策略”、“为…创建检查”、“标记此模式”、“创建能捕获…的规则”、“元数据规则”、“检查权限”、“强制执行 API 版本”、“ESLint 规则”、“LWC 规则”、“覆盖规则阈值”、“定制复杂度”，或描述需要强制执行的模式时，触发。

不触发条件：当用户想要运行扫描（使用 dx-code-analyzer-run）、配置引擎（使用 dx-code-analyzer-configure），或解释现有规则（使用 dx-code-analyzer-run）时，不触发。

description: Logging best practices focused on wide events (canonical log lines) for powerful debugging and analytics
description_zh: 日志记录最佳实践：聚焦宽事件（标准日志行），用于强大的调试与分析。

description: Sets up and runs Atheris, the coverage-guided Python fuzzer built on libFuzzer. Covers TestOneInput harnesses, FuzzedDataProvider, instrumenting both pure Python and native C extensions, and running under AddressSanitizer. Use when fuzzing a Python package, hunting memory corruption in a Python C extension, or choosing between Atheris and Hypothesis for a Python target.
description_zh: 设置并运行基于 libFuzzer 构建的覆盖率引导型 Python 模糊测试工具 Atheris。该工具支持 TestOneInput 测试框架、FuzzedDataProvider，可对纯 Python 与原生 C 扩展进行插桩，并可在 AddressSanitizer 环境下运行。适用于对 Python 包进行模糊测试、排查 Python C 扩展中的内存损坏问题，或在为 Python 目标选择 Atheris 与 Hypothesis 时选用。

description: Sets up and runs AFL++ for multi-core fuzzing of C/C++ projects built with afl-clang-fast or afl-gcc-fast. Covers instrumentation modes, parallel main and secondary campaigns, persistent mode, corpus minimization, and crash triage. Use when scaling fuzzing across cores, fuzzing a mature C/C++ codebase, reading the afl-fuzz status screen, or moving on after libFuzzer has plateaued.
description_zh: 为基于 afl-clang-fast 或 afl-gcc-fast 构建的 C/C++ 项目设置并运行 AFL++ 的多核模糊测试。覆盖插桩模式、并行主战役与次战役、持久模式、语料缩减以及崩溃分诊。适用于在核心间扩展模糊测试、对成熟 C/C++ 代码库进行模糊测试、查看 afl-fuzz 状态屏幕，或在 libFuzzer 达到平台期后继续推进。

description: Scans Substrate/Polkadot pallets for 7 critical vulnerabilities including arithmetic overflow, panic DoS, incorrect weights, and bad origin checks. Use when auditing Substrate runtimes or FRAME pallets.
description_zh: 扫描 Substrate/Polkadot 插槽（pallets）中的 7 项关键漏洞，包括算术溢出、panic DoS、权重错误以及来源检查错误。适用于审计 Substrate 运行时或 FRAME 插槽。

**不触发条件：当用户想要生成图像（使用 qianwen-image-generation）、理解/分析现有视频（使用 qianwen-vision），或仅执行纯文本任务时。**

description: Validates cryptographic implementations against Project Wycheproof's test vectors, which encode known attacks and edge cases across AES, RSA, ECDSA, ECDH, and more. Covers loading test vectors, mapping result flags onto pass and fail expectations, and reading a failure. Use when testing a crypto implementation against known attacks, checking a library against standard test vectors, or investigating why two implementations disagree on the same input.

Use when the user mentions "design sprint", "validate before we build", "rapid prototype", "test with users", or "should we build this". Also trigger when a team is stuck in endless debate over a high-stakes product decision, or wants to de-risk a costly idea before investing in development. Covers mapping, sketching, deciding, prototyping, and testing across Monday-Friday. For ongoing experimentation and MVPs, see lean-startup. For customer job analysis, see jobs-to-be-done. For non-leading user interviews, see mom-test.

description: Use this skill when understanding how PixiJS v8 renders frames: the systems-and-pipes renderer, the render loop, and how the library adapts to different environments. Covers WebGLRenderer/WebGPURenderer/CanvasRenderer selection, renderer.render() pipeline, environment detection, rendering into RenderTextures and RenderTargets (flipY, mipLevel, layer, bind/push/pop, copyDepthTexture), WebGL context loss and WebGPU device loss recovery, and pointers to per-topic deep dives. Triggers on: renderer, WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, render loop, render pipeline, systems, environments, autoDetectRenderer, RenderTexture, RenderTarget, render to texture, flipY, mipLevel, renderTarget.bind, copyToTexture, copyDepthTexture, depth-only, WebGLLoader, WebGPULoader, CanvasLoader, RendererLoader, lazy-load renderer systems, code splitting, context lost, webglcontextlost, device lost, GPUDevice.lost.
description_zh: 使用此技能，用于理解 PixiJS v8 如何渲染帧：系统与管道渲染器、渲染循环，以及库如何适配不同环境。涵盖 WebGLRenderer/WebGPURenderer/CanvasRenderer 的选择、renderer.render() 流水线、环境检测、将内容渲染到 RenderTextures 和 RenderTargets（flipY、mipLevel、layer、bind/push/pop、copyDepthTexture）、WebGL 上下文丢失与 WebGPU 设备丢失恢复，以及指向各主题深度解析的指引。触发关键词：renderer, WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, render loop, render pipeline, systems, environments, autoDetectRenderer, RenderTexture, RenderTarget, render to texture, flipY, mipLevel, renderTarget.bind, copyToTexture, copyDepthTexture, depth-only, WebGLLoader, WebGPULoader, CanvasLoader, RendererLoader, lazy-load renderer systems, code splitting, context lost, webglcontextlost, device lost, GPUDevice.lost。

description_zh: 使用 LibAFL（模块化 Rust 模糊测试库）构建自定义模糊测试器。涵盖将观察者、反馈、变异器、调度器和执行器组合为模糊测试器，用于标准工具无法满足的目标。当编写定制模糊测试器或变异器、对非标准目标或架构进行模糊测试、实现模糊测试研究构想，或者当 libFuzzer 和 AFL++ 缺乏所需控制时使用。

description: Use this skill when profiling or optimizing a PixiJS v8 app for FPS, draw calls, or GPU memory. Covers destroy patterns (cacheAsTexture(false), releaseGlobalResources), GCSystem and TextureGCSystem, PrepareSystem, object pooling, batching rules, BitmapText for dynamic text, culling (Culler, CullerPlugin, cullable, cullArea), resolution/antialias tradeoffs, low-level wins (transient MSAA render textures, render bundles, partial buffer updates). Triggers on: FPS, jank, draw calls, batching, object pool, GCSystem, PrepareSystem, Culler, cacheAsTexture, memory leak, destroy patterns, render bundle, transient, MSAA, Buffer.update, WebGPU performance, TexturePool, repeatEdgePixels, bind group.

当需要对 PixiJS v8 应用的性能分析与优化提供支持，且聚焦于 FPS、Draw Call 和 GPU 显存时，请使用此技能。

触发条件如下：FPS、卡顿、Draw Call、批处理、对象池、GCSystem、PrepareSystem、Culler、cacheAsTexture、内存泄漏、销毁模式、渲染包、瞬态、MSAA、Buffer.update、WebGPU 性能、TexturePool、repeatEdgePixels、bind group。

description: Use this skill when drawing vector shapes and paths in PixiJS v8. Covers the Graphics API: shape-then-fill methods (rect/circle/ellipse/poly/roundRect/star/regularPoly/roundPoly/roundShape/filletRect/chamferRect), path methods (moveTo/lineTo/bezierCurveTo/quadraticCurveTo/arc/arcTo/arcToSvg/closePath), fill/stroke/cut, holes, FillGradient (linear/radial), FillPattern, GraphicsContext sharing, svg import/export, containsPoint hit testing, cloning, clearing, bounds, fillStyle/strokeStyle, draw-time transforms (rotateTransform/scaleTransform/translateTransform/setTransform/save/restore), default styles, GraphicsPath reuse. description_zh:
在使用 PixiJS v8 绘制矢量形状和路径时使用此技能。涵盖 Graphics API：形状后填充方法（rect/circle/ellipse/poly/roundRect/star/regularPoly/roundPoly/roundShape/filletRect/chamferRect）、路径方法（moveTo/lineTo/bezierCurveTo/quadraticCurveTo/arc/arcTo/arcToSvg/closePath）、填充/描边/裁剪、孔洞（holes）、FillGradient（线性/径向）、FillPattern、GraphicsContext 共享、svg 导入/导出、containsPoint 命中测试、克隆、清空、边界（bounds）、fillStyle/strokeStyle、绘制时变换（rotateTransform/scaleTransform/translateTransform/setTransform/save/restore）、默认样式、GraphicsPath 复用。

触发条件：Graphics、GraphicsContext、rect、circle、poly、roundRect、fill、stroke、cut、hole、beginHole、FillGradient、FillPattern、moveTo、bezierCurveTo、svg、graphicsContextToSvg、svg export、GraphicsOptions、containsPoint、clone、clear、bounds、rotateTransform、translateTransform、setFillStyle、setStrokeStyle、GraphicsPath。

description: Instrument any app with OpenTelemetry and ship metrics / logs / traces to Grafana Cloud or self-hosted Mimir / Loki / Tempo / Pyroscope. Covers SDK auto-instrumentation for Go, Java (Grafana JVM agent), Python (`opentelemetry-instrument`), Node.js, .NET (`Grafana.OpenTelemetry`), Beyla eBPF for zero-code; Grafana Cloud OTLP gateway + Basic-auth (instanceID + API key, base64); env-var config (`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*`, `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`); Alloy / OTel-Collector pipelines; Kubernetes Operator inject-annotations; and head + tail sampling. Use when instrumenting a service, pointing OTLP at Grafana Cloud, switching from Jaeger / Datadog / New Relic, choosing head- vs tail-sampling, or debugging "spans aren't showing in Explore" — even when the user says "auto-instrument my Java app", "send traces to Grafana", "what env vars do I set", "OTLP endpoint", or "Operator inject" without naming OpenTelemetry.

使用 OpenTelemetry 为任何应用进行插桩，并将指标/日志/追踪发送至 Grafana 云或自托管的 Mimir、Loki、Tempo、Pyroscope。
涵盖 Go、Java（Grafana JVM agent）、Python（`opentelemetry-instrument`）、Node.js、.NET（`Grafana.OpenTelemetry`）、Beyla 零代码 eBPF 的自动插桩；
Grafana 云 OTLP 网关 + Basic-auth（instanceID + API key，base64）；
环境变量配置（`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*`、`OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`）；
Alloy / OTel-Collector 管道；
Kubernetes Operator 注入注解；
以及头部采样与尾部采样。
适用于对服务进行插桩、将 OTLP 指向 Grafana 云、从 Jaeger、Datadog、New Relic 切换、选择头部采样与尾部采样，或调试“追踪（spans）未在 Explore 中显示”的问题——即使用户未提及 OpenTelemetry，仅说“为我的 Java 应用进行自动插桩”、“将追踪发送到 Grafana”、“我需要设置哪些环境变量”、“OTLP 端点”或“Operator 注入”。

description: Analyzes the downstream impact (blast radius) when a BigQuery table or view is broken, stale, or modified. Identifies all downstream tables, dashboards, and processes that will be affected. Use when: - Performing a blast radius or impact analysis for a BigQuery table or view. - Assessing the consequences of modifying, deleting, or pausing updates to a BigQuery asset. - Identifying downstream dependencies (tables, dashboards, processes) of a BigQuery asset. Don't use for: - General BigQuery querying or data analysis (use BigQuery-related tools instead). - Non-BigQuery assets (e.g., Cloud Storage files) unless they are part of the BigQuery lineage. - Creating or modifying lineage links directly.
description_zh:
分析当 BigQuery 表或视图发生损坏、过期或修改时产生的下游影响（爆炸半径）。识别所有将受影响的下游表格、仪表板和处理流程。使用场景：
- 对 BigQuery 表或视图执行爆炸半径或影响分析时使用。
- 评估对 BigQuery 资产进行修改、删除或暂停更新的后果时使用。
- 识别 BigQuery 资产的下游依赖（表格、仪表板、处理流程）时使用。

请勿用于：
- 通用的 BigQuery 查询或数据分析（请改用 BigQuery 相关工具）。
- 非 BigQuery 资产（例如 Cloud Storage 文件），除非它们属于 BigQuery 血缘的一部分。
- 直接创建或修改血缘链接。

description_zh: 适用于用户需要使用 ClickHouse 构建应用程序、搭建本地 ClickHouse 开发环境、安装 ClickHouse、创建本地服务器、创建表或开始使用 ClickHouse 开发的场景。涵盖从零开始至搭建可运行的本地 ClickHouse 环境的完整流程。

description: Use when implementing authentication/authorization, securing user input, or preventing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities — including custom security implementations such as hashing passwords with bcrypt/argon2, sanitizing SQL queries with parameterized statements, configuring CORS/CSP headers, validating input with Zod, and setting up JWT tokens. Invoke for authentication, authorization, input validation, encryption, OWASP Top 10 prevention, secure session management, and security hardening. For pre-built OAuth/SSO integrations or standalone security audits, consider a more specialized skill.
description_zh: 适用于在实现身份认证/授权、保障用户输入安全或防范 OWASP Top 10 漏洞时使用；包括使用 bcrypt/argon2 对密码进行哈希处理、使用参数化语句对 SQL 查询进行净化、配置 CORS/CSP 响应头、使用 Zod 验证输入以及配置 JWT 令牌等自定义安全实现。用于身份认证、授权、输入验证、加密、OWASP Top 10 漏洞防范、安全会话管理及安全加固。对于预置的 OAuth/SSO 集成或独立安全审计，请考虑使用更专业的专用技能。

description: Use this skill when reasoning about the PixiJS v8 scene graph as a whole: how containers, leaves, transforms, and render order fit together. Covers leaf vs container distinction, local/world coordinates, culling, render groups, sortable children, masking, RenderLayer, constructor options shared by every scene node, and which leaf skill covers which display object. Triggers on: scene graph, display list, Container, Sprite, Graphics, Text, Mesh, ParticleContainer, DOMContainer, GifSprite, masking, render group, RenderLayer, world transform, constructor options, ContainerOptions.
description_zh: 在从整体上推理 PixiJS v8 场景图时，使用本技能：容器、叶子、变换和渲染顺序如何协同工作。涵盖叶子与容器的区别、局部/世界坐标、剔除、渲染组、可排序子元素、遮罩、RenderLayer、每个场景节点共有的构造选项，以及哪个叶子技能覆盖哪个显示对象。触发关键词：场景图、显示列表、Container、Sprite、Graphics、Text、Mesh、ParticleContainer、DOMContainer、GifSprite、遮罩、渲染组、RenderLayer、世界变换、构造选项、ContainerOptions。

description: Guide for configuring and managing GitHub secret scanning, push protection, custom patterns, and secret alert remediation. For pre-commit secret scanning in AI coding agents via the GitHub MCP Server, this skill references the Advanced Security plugin (`advanced-security@copilot-plugins`). Use this skill when enabling secret scanning, setting up push protection, defining custom patterns, triaging alerts, resolving blocked pushes, or when an agent needs to scan code for secrets before committing.
description_zh: 用于配置和管理 GitHub 密钥扫描、推送保护、自定义模式以及密钥警报修复的指南。针对 AI 编码智能体通过 GitHub MCP 服务器进行的提交前密钥扫描，本技能引用了高级安全插件（`advanced-security@copilot-plugins`）。在启用密钥扫描、设置推送保护、定义自定义模式、分诊警报、解决被阻止的推送，或当智能体需要在提交前扫描代码以查找密钥时，请使用本技能。

description: Create uncontested market space using value innovation instead of competing head-to-head. Use when the user mentions "blue ocean", "red ocean", "strategy canvas", "ERRC framework", "value innovation", "non-customers", "buyer utility map", "the market is too crowded", "how do we stand out", or "escape the price war". Also trigger when exploring a new market category, or finding underserved or non-customers. Covers the Four Actions Framework, Six Paths, buyer utility map, and value-cost trade-offs. For real strategy formulation and bad-strategy detection, see good-strategy-bad-strategy. For tech adoption strategy, see crossing-the-chasm. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome.
description_zh: 通过价值创新而非正面竞争，创造无竞争的市场空间。当用户提及“蓝海”、“红海”、“战略画布”、“ERRC框架”、“价值创新”、“非客户”、“购买者效用地图”、“市场过于拥挤”、“我们如何脱颖而出”或“规避价格战”时使用。当探索新的市场品类，或发现未被充分满足需求的客户或非客户时，也触发使用。涵盖四项行动框架、六条路径、购买者效用地图以及价值与成本权衡。关于真实的策略制定和不良策略识别，见 good-strategy-bad-strategy。关于技术采用策略，见 crossing-the-chasm。关于产品定位，见 obviously-awesome。

description: Design data systems by understanding storage engines, replication, partitioning, transactions, and consistency models. Use when the user mentions "database choice", "which database should I use", "SQL or NoSQL", "replication lag", "partitioning strategy", "consistency vs availability", "stream processing", "ACID transactions", "eventual consistency", "my queries are slow at scale", or "data is inconsistent across replicas". Also trigger when choosing a datastore, designing data pipelines, or debugging distributed-system consistency issues. Covers data models, batch/stream processing, and distributed consensus. For system design, see system-design. For resilience, see release-it.
description_zh: 理解存储引擎、复制、分区、事务和一致性模型，以设计数据系统。当用户提及“数据库选择”、“我应该使用哪个数据库”、“SQL还是NoSQL”、“复制延迟”、“分区策略”、“一致性与可用性”、“流处理”、“ACID事务”、“最终一致性”、“我在大规模下查询很慢”或“数据在副本间不一致”时使用。同时，在选择数据存储、设计数据管道或排查分布式系统一致性问题时也触发。涵盖数据模型、批处理/流处理和分布式共识。关于系统设计，参见 system-design。关于韧性，参见 release-it。

description: Automate LinkedIn marketing, lead generation, content publishing, and professional networking
description_zh: 自动化领英营销、潜在客户生成、内容发布以及专业社交

description: Automate YouTube content workflows including video management, analytics, scheduling, and channel optimization
description_zh: 自动化 YouTube 内容工作流程，包括视频管理、数据分析、日程安排和频道优化。

description: Use Copilot Spaces to provide project-specific context to conversations. Use this skill when users mention a "Copilot space", want to load context from a shared knowledge base, discover available spaces, or ask questions grounded in curated project documentation, code, and instructions.
description_zh: 使用 Copilot Spaces 为对话提供项目特定上下文。当用户提及“Copilot space”、希望从共享知识库加载上下文、发现可用空间，或基于精选的项目文档、代码和指令提出问题时，请使用此技能。

description: Use this skill when running per-frame logic or controlling the PixiJS v8 render loop. Covers Ticker.add/addOnce/remove, deltaTime vs deltaMS vs elapsedMS, UPDATE_PRIORITY ordering, maxFPS/minFPS capping, speed scaling, Ticker.shared vs new instances, per-object onRender hook, manual rendering. Triggers on: Ticker, UPDATE_PRIORITY, deltaTime, deltaMS, elapsedMS, onRender, app.ticker, maxFPS, minFPS, Ticker.shared.
description_zh: 当执行逐帧逻辑或控制 PixiJS v8 渲染循环时使用此技能。涵盖 Ticker.add/addOnce/remove、deltaTime 与 deltaMS 与 elapsedMS 的区别、UPDATE_PRIORITY 排序、maxFPS/minFPS 限速、速度缩放、Ticker.shared 与新建实例、逐对象 onRender 钩子及手动渲染。触发条件：Ticker、UPDATE_PRIORITY、deltaTime、deltaMS、elapsedMS、onRender、app.ticker、maxFPS、minFPS、Ticker.shared。

description: Guides developers through downloading, configuring, and installing the official open-source Google Ads MCP Server. Use this skill when a user wants to connect their AI assistant (such as Gemini, Claude Code, or Cursor) to their Google Ads account to query campaigns or retrieve reporting metrics using natural language.
description_zh: 引导开发者下载、配置并安装官方开源的 Google Ads MCP Server。当用户希望将其 AI 助手（如 Gemini、Claude Code 或 Cursor）连接到 Google Ads 账户，并使用自然语言查询活动或获取报告指标时，请使用此技能。

description: Four-mantra debugging discipline — reproduce, trace the fail path, falsify the hypothesis, cross-reference every breadcrumb. Recite the mantra block verbatim at the start of any debugging session, then apply the four steps in order before proposing any fix. Trigger on /debug-mantra and proactively whenever debugging starts — user reports a bug, says something is broken/throwing/failing, asks to debug/diagnose/investigate an issue, or pastes a stack trace or error log.
description_zh: 四真言调试纪律——复现、追踪失败路径、证伪假设、交叉比对每一个线索。在每次调试开始时，逐字默念真言块，然后在提出任何修复方案之前，按顺序执行这四个步骤。当触发 /debug-mantra 以及每当调试开始时——用户报告bug、表示某处出错/抛出异常/失败、要求调试/诊断/排查问题、或粘贴堆栈跟踪或错误日志时，主动执行。

description: Build a complete marketing plan covering the full customer journey from stranger to raving fan. Use when the user mentions "marketing plan", "marketing strategy", "target market", "USP", "lead nurture", "customer lifetime value", "PVP Index", or "I dont know where to start with marketing". Also trigger when building a marketing plan from scratch, choosing acquisition channels, or designing end-to-end customer-lifecycle campaigns. Covers the PVP Index, channel selection, and advocacy systems. For brand messaging, see storybrand-messaging. For conversion optimization, see cro-methodology.
description_zh: 制定一份完整的营销计划，涵盖从陌生人到狂热粉丝的完整客户旅程。当用户提及“营销计划”、“营销策略”、“目标市场”、“独特销售主张（USP）”、“线索培育”、“客户终身价值”、“PVP指数”或“我在营销方面不知从何下手”时，使用此计划。同时，当从零开始制定营销计划、选择获客渠道或设计端到端客户生命周期活动时，也会触发此计划。该计划涵盖PVP指数、渠道选择和推荐系统。品牌传播方面，请参阅 storybrand-messaging。转化优化方面，请参阅 cro-methodology。

description: Delegate a coding task to a separate Claude Code CLI process or another Claude session as an implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use only when the user explicitly asks to delegate implementation to Claude Code, another Claude session, or the `claude` CLI — for example, "have another Claude implement this", "delegate this to Claude Code", or "run this queue through a separate Claude session." Do not trigger merely because the current orchestrator is Claude, and do not use when the user asks the current Claude to implement directly without delegation.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给独立的 Claude Code CLI 进程或另一个 Claude 会话作为实施者，然后审查其差异并自行合入。仅在用户明确要求将实现任务委托给 Claude Code、另一个 Claude 会话或 `claude` CLI 时使用——例如，“让另一个 Claude 实现此任务”、“将此项委托给 Claude Code”或“通过另一个 Claude 会话处理该队列”。不要仅因当前编排者为 Claude 而触发，并且当用户要求当前 Claude 直接实施而不进行委托时也不要使用。

description: Controls an isolated Browser Use Cloud browser from a sandboxed machine with the current Browser Use CLI.
description_zh: 使用当前的 Browser Use CLI，从沙盒化机器上控制独立的 Browser Use Cloud 浏览器。

description: Build Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation models. Calculate intrinsic value with customizable assumptions. Generate professional valuation reports.
description_zh: 构建贴现现金流（DCF）估值模型。根据可定制假设计算内在价值。生成专业估值报告。

description: Next.js best practices - file conventions, RSC boundaries, data patterns, async APIs, metadata, error handling, route handlers, image/font optimization, bundling
description_zh: Next.js 最佳实践——文件约定、RSC 边界、数据模式、异步 API、元数据、错误处理、路由处理程序、图片/字体优化、打包
您提供的源内容为空，没有可供翻译的内容，因此无法进行翻译。如果您有具体的文本需要翻译，请提供相关内容，我会为您进行准确的简体中文翻译。

description: Optimize MongoDB client connection configuration (pools, timeouts, patterns) for any supported driver language. Use this skill when working/updating/reviewing on functions that instantiate or configure a MongoDB client (eg, when calling `connect()`), configuring connection pools, troubleshooting connection errors (ECONNREFUSED, timeouts, pool exhaustion), optimizing performance issues related to connections. This includes scenarios like building serverless functions with MongoDB, creating API endpoints that use MongoDB, optimizing high-traffic MongoDB applications, creating long-running tasks and concurrency, or debugging connection-related failures.
description_zh: 优化 MongoDB 客户端连接配置（连接池、超时设置、连接模式），支持所有受支持的驱动程序语言。当需要工作、更新或审查实例化或配置 MongoDB 客户端的函数（例如调用 `connect()` 时）、配置连接池、排查连接错误（如 ECONNREFUSED、超时、连接池耗尽）、优化与连接相关的性能问题时，请使用此技能。这包括构建基于 MongoDB 的 Serverless 函数、创建使用 MongoDB 的 API 端点、优化高流量 MongoDB 应用、创建长时间运行任务和并发场景，以及调试与连接相关的故障等场景。

description: Use this skill when rendering text in PixiJS v8. Covers Text for canvas-quality styled labels, BitmapText for cheap per-frame updates via glyph atlas, HTMLText for HTML/CSS markup via SVG, SplitText and SplitBitmapText for per-character animation, TextStyle, tagStyles, constructor options, TextOptions, HTMLTextOptions, BitmapText, SplitTextOptions, SplitBitmapTextOptions. Triggers on: Text, BitmapText, HTMLText, SplitText, SplitBitmapText, TextStyle, HTMLTextStyle, BitmapFont.install, tagStyles, fontFamily, wordWrap.
description_zh: 在 PixiJS v8 中渲染文本时，使用本技能。覆盖 Text（用于画布质量的带样式标签）、BitmapText（通过字形图集实现每帧更新成本较低）、HTMLText（通过 SVG 实现 HTML/CSS 标记）、SplitText 和 SplitBitmapText（用于逐字符动画）、TextStyle、tagStyles、构造函数选项、TextOptions、HTMLTextOptions、BitmapText、SplitTextOptions、SplitBitmapTextOptions。触发条件：Text、BitmapText、HTMLText、SplitText、SplitBitmapText、TextStyle、HTMLTextStyle、BitmapFont.install、tagStyles、fontFamily、wordWrap。

description: DEPRECATED legacy alias — x402 + MPP support has been merged into `okx-agent-payments-protocol` (see `references/exact.md`, `references/aggr_deferred.md`, `references/charge.md`, `references/session.md`). This stub exists only so that legacy invocations referencing the old name resolve to a meaningful redirect. If you land here, immediately load `okx-agent-payments-protocol` via the Skill tool and follow it instead. Do NOT execute any payment logic from this stub. All HTTP 402 / x402 / MPP / channel / voucher / session triggers now route directly to `okx-agent-payments-protocol` (Path A in its SKILL.md).
description_zh: 已弃用的遗留别名 — x402 和 MPP 支持已合并至 `okx-agent-payments-protocol`（参见 `references/exact.md`、`references/aggr_deferred.md`、`references/charge.md`、`references/session.md`）。此存根仅用于使引用旧名称的遗留调用能够解析到有效的重定向。如果进入此处，请立即通过 Skill 工具加载 `okx-agent-payments-protocol` 并遵循其指引。请勿在此存根中执行任何支付逻辑。所有 HTTP 402 / x402 / MPP / 渠道 / 代金券 / 会话触发现在均直接路由至 `okx-agent-payments-protocol`（其 SKILL.md 中的路径 A）。

description: Routes AWS networking requests to the correct service skill for implementation. Covers Route 53 (DNS, health checks, routing policies, Resolver, DNS Firewall), CloudFront (caching, edge, OAC, mTLS, signed URLs), Transit Gateway (multi-VPC hub, segmentation, centralized egress), Direct Connect (hybrid link, DX Gateway, MACsec), Site-to-Site VPN (IPsec tunnels, static or BGP), WAF (web ACLs, AWS Managed Rules, rate-based rules, Bot and Fraud Control), and Shield Advanced (L3/L4 DDoS). Applicable when creating, configuring, troubleshooting, or designing across these services, choosing between them, or diagnosing connectivity or traffic-filtering issues. Not for VPC subnets and route tables, load balancers, VPC endpoints, PrivateLink, API Gateway, IAM policy logic, container or serverless networking, or IaC authoring.
description_zh: 将 AWS 网络请求路由至正确的服务技能以实施。覆盖 Route 53（DNS、健康检查、路由策略、Resolver、DNS Firewall）、CloudFront（缓存、边缘、OAC、mTLS、签名 URL）、Transit Gateway（多 VPC 中心、分段、集中出口）、Direct Connect（混合链路、DX Gateway、MACsec）、Site-to-Site VPN（IPsec 隧道、静态或 BGP）、WAF（Web 访问控制列表、AWS 托管规则、基于速率的规则、机器人及欺诈控制）以及 Shield Advanced（L3/L4 DDoS）。适用于在跨这些服务创建、配置、排查、设计，或在它们之间进行选择，以及诊断连接性或流量过滤问题。不适用于 VPC 子网和路由表、负载均衡器、VPC 端点、PrivateLink、API Gateway、IAM 策略逻辑、容器或无服务器网络，或 IaC 编写。

description: Ghost Security - SAST code scanner. Finds security vulnerabilities in source code by planning and executing targeted scans for issues like SQL injection, XSS, BOLA, BFLA, SSRF, and other OWASP categories. Supports applications (backend, frontend, mobile) and libraries (prototype pollution, unsafe deserialization, ReDoS, path traversal, zip slip). Use when the user asks for a code security audit, SAST scan, vulnerability scan of source code, or wants to find security flaws in a codebase or library.
description_zh: Ghost Security - SAST 代码扫描器。通过规划并执行针对性扫描，在源代码中检测 SQL 注入、XSS、BOLA、BFLA、SSRF 等 OWASP 类别的安全漏洞。支持应用（后端、前端、移动端）和库（原型污染、不安全反序列化、ReDoS、路径穿越、zip slip）的扫描。适用于用户要求进行代码安全审计、SAST 扫描、源代码漏洞扫描，或希望查找代码库或库中安全缺陷时使用。

description: 로그인 없이 접근 가능한 마켓컬리 검색/상품 상세 표면으로 상품 후보, 현재 가격, 할인 여부, 품절 여부를 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 用户无需登录即可访问 Marketkurli 的搜索/商品详情界面，可查询商品候选、当前价格、折扣情况及缺货情况。在钻取过程中，通过官方界面完成后续操作。

description: Design infographic layouts and content structure. Plan visual storytelling with data, icons, and text hierarchy for impactful information design.
description_zh: 设计信息图的版面布局与内容结构。规划结合数据、图标与文本层级的视觉叙事，以打造富有冲击力的信息设计。

description: Adds AssistantCloud backed persistence, authorization, and telemetry to assistant-ui apps. Use when wiring cross-session thread and message history, multi-device chat, message feedback, file uploads, or auth: passing `cloud` to `useChatRuntime` from `@assistant-ui/ai-sdk`, `AISDKThreads({ cloud })` for `AuiConfig` hosts, the `useCloudChat`/`useThreads` hooks from `@assistant-ui/cloud-ai-sdk`, or `cloud` on `useLangGraphRuntime`. Covers constructing `AssistantCloud` with `authToken` (JWT), `apiKey` plus `userId`/`workspaceId` (server-side only), or `anonymous`; Clerk, Auth0, Supabase, and Firebase integrations and a backend token endpoint; the `cloud.threads`, `cloud.files`, `cloud.runs`, and `cloud.telemetry` client surface; and a custom `ThreadHistoryAdapter` on `CloudMessagePersistence`. Route here for threads that do not persist, 401s against the cloud API, or feedback buttons that do not save. For the `<ThreadList />` sidebar UI use thread-list; for the general adapter contracts use runtime.
description_zh:
为 assistant-ui 应用添加基于 AssistantCloud 的持久化、授权和遥测功能。在集成跨会话线程与消息历史、多设备聊天、消息反馈、文件上传或授权功能时使用：将 `cloud` 传递给 `@assistant-ui/ai-sdk` 中的 `useChatRuntime`，在 `AuiConfig` 宿主中使用 `AISDKThreads({ cloud })`，使用 `@assistant-ui/cloud-ai-sdk` 中的 `useCloudChat` / `useThreads` 钩子，或在 `useLangGraphRuntime` 上使用 `cloud`。

涵盖构建 `AssistantCloud` 的方式：使用 `authToken`（JWT）、`apiKey` 加上 `userId`/`workspaceId`（仅服务端可用），或 `anonymous`；支持 Clerk、Auth0、Supabase 和 Firebase 集成以及后端令牌端点；提供 `cloud.threads`、`cloud.files`、`cloud.runs` 和 `cloud.telemetry` 客户端接口；以及在 `CloudMessagePersistence` 上的自定义 `ThreadHistoryAdapter`。

对于不持久化的线程、对 cloud API 返回 401 的情况，或保存不上的反馈按钮，请在此处路由。对于 `<ThreadList />` 侧边栏 UI，使用 `thread-list`；对于通用适配器合约，使用 runtime。
所提供的源文本为空或仅包含标记符号（>），没有可供翻译的内容，因此无法进行翻译。如需翻译，请提供具体的文本内容。

description: Build integrated financial models with 3-statement projections. Create income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow models with proper linkages.
description_zh: 基于三表预测构建整合财务模型。创建损益表、资产负债表及现金流量表模型，并建立适当的勾稽关系。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when building evaluation pipelines for LangSmith. Covers three core components: (1) Creating Evaluators - LLM-as-Judge, custom code; (2) Defining Run Functions - how to capture outputs and trajectories from your agent; (3) Running Evaluations - locally with evaluate() or auto-run via LangSmith. Uses the langsmith CLI tool.
description_zh: 调用此技能用于构建 LangSmith 评估流程。涵盖三个核心组件：(1) 创建评估器——LLM-as-Judge 与自定义代码；(2) 定义运行函数——如何捕获智能体的输出与轨迹；(3) 运行评估——使用 evaluate() 本地运行，或通过 LangSmith 自动运行。使用 langsmith CLI 工具。

description: Use this skill when applying visual effects to PixiJS v8 containers via the filter pipeline. Covers built-in filters (AlphaFilter, BlurFilter, ColorMatrixFilter, DisplacementFilter, NoiseFilter), custom Filter.from() with GLSL/WGSL, options (resolution, padding, antialias, blendRequired), filterArea optimization, pixi-filters community package. Triggers on: filters, BlurFilter, ColorMatrixFilter, DisplacementFilter, NoiseFilter, Filter.from, GLSL filter, pixi-filters, filterArea.
description_zh: 当需要通过滤镜管线为 PixiJS v8 容器应用视觉效果时使用此技能。涵盖内置滤镜（AlphaFilter、BlurFilter、ColorMatrixFilter、DisplacementFilter、NoiseFilter）、支持 GLSL/WGSL 的自定义 Filter.from()、选项（resolution、padding、antialias、blenderRequired），filterArea 优化，pixi-filters 社区包。触发条件：filters、BlurFilter、ColorMatrixFilter、DisplacementFilter、NoiseFilter、Filter.from、GLSL filter、pixi-filters、filterArea。

description:
Guides developers through Google Ads API quickstart: credential setup, choosing from 6 client libraries/REST, configuring environments, and running a "retrieve campaigns" script. Troubleshoots common setup errors: USER_PERMISSION_DENIED, login_customer_id issues, and DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED.

Use this skill when:
- The user asks how to get started with the Google Ads API.
- The user needs to set up Google Ads credentials or developer tokens.
- The user wants to write a quickstart/example script for Google Ads.
- The user encounters errors like USER_PERMISSION_DENIED or DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED.
description_zh:
指导开发者完成 Google Ads API 快速入门：配置凭证、从 6 个客户端库/REST 中选择、配置环境，并运行“获取广告系列”脚本。排查常见配置错误：USER_PERMISSION_DENIED、login_customer_id 问题，以及 DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED。

使用此技能时：
- 当用户询问如何开始使用 Google Ads API。
- 当用户需要设置 Google Ads 凭证或开发者令牌。
- 当用户希望为 Google Ads 编写快速入门/示例脚本。
- 当用户遇到 USER_PERMISSION_DENIED 或 DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED 等错误。

description: Runs an autonomous review-and-fix improvement loop over a Claude Code skill until a review comes back clean, with a cross-round findings ledger, escalation when fixes stop converging, and a mechanical scope guard. Reviews are performed by the plugin-dev skill-reviewer agent. Use to fix skill quality issues, iteratively refine a skill, or resume a loop after an escalation ('fix my skill', 'improve this skill until it passes review', 'skill improvement loop'). NOT for a one-time review — use the plugin-dev skill-reviewer agent directly.
description_zh:
运行 Claude Code 技能的自主审查与修复改进循环，直至审查结果通过，具备跨轮次发现记录台账、当修复不再收敛时触发升级处理，以及机制性范围防护。审查由 plugin-dev 技能审查者 agent 执行。

用于修复技能质量问题、迭代优化技能，或在升级处理后恢复循环（"修复我的技能"、"改进此技能直至通过审查"、"技能改进循环"）。

不适用于一次性审查——请直接使用 plugin-dev 技能审查者 agent。

description: 식약처 공공 OpenAPI를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 조회하기 전에 증상·복용상황을 반드시 되묻는 인터뷰형 의약품 안전 체크 스킬.
description_zh: 经k-skill-proxy查询食品药品安全处公共OpenAPI前，须询问症状与用药情况的访谈式药品安全核查技能。

description: 식약처/식품안전나라 공개 표면을 k-skill-proxy 경유로 조회하기 전에 증상·섭취상황을 반드시 되묻는 인터뷰형 식품 안전 체크 스킬.
description_zh: 一种在通过 k-skill-proxy 查询食品药品监督管理局/食品安全国家公开平台之前，必须询问症状与摄入情况的访谈式食品安全检查技能。
