description_zh: agent-im 会话技能 - 通过 liblib.tv 的 AI 能力生成和编辑图片/视频。覆盖场景包括：生成（文生图、文生视频、图生视频、做动画、画一个xxx、来段xxx）、编辑修改（把xxx换成yyy、去掉xxx、加上xxx、改成xxx、调整xxx、局部修改、改镜头）、风格转换（风格迁移、转绘、换风格）、视频续写延长、复刻视频/TVC/宣传片、短剧/短漫剧生成、音乐MV生成、产品广告/展示片制作、分镜/故事板设计、教育视频/短视频制作。当用户提到 liblib、libtv、上传参考图/视频、查看生成进度时也应触发。关键判断：只要用户的请求涉及 AI 图片或视频的创作、生成、编辑、修改，无论措辞如何（如“画只猫”、“做个海报”、“把纸船换成爱心”、“这个视频帮我改一下”、“帮我复刻这段视频”、“用这首歌做个MV”、“一句话生成短剧”），都必须触发此技能。

description: Professional DOCX document creation, editing, and formatting using OpenXML SDK (.NET). Three pipelines: (A) create new documents from scratch, (B) fill/edit content in existing documents, (C) apply template formatting with XSD validation gate-check. MUST use this skill whenever the user wants to produce, modify, or format a Word document — including when they say "write a report", "draft a proposal", "make a contract", "fill in this form", "reformat to match this template", or any task whose final output is a .docx file. Even if the user doesn't mention "docx" explicitly, if the task implies a printable/formal document, use this skill.
description_zh: 使用OpenXML SDK (.NET) 进行专业的DOCX文档创建、编辑和格式化。三个流程：(A) 从零开始创建新文档；(B) 填写/编辑现有文档内容；(C) 应用模板格式化，并进行XSD验证门控检查。每当用户想要生成、修改或格式化Word文档时，必须使用此技能——包括当用户说“write a report”、“draft a proposal”、“make a contract”、“fill in this form”、“reformat to match this template”，或任何最终输出为.docx文件的任务时。即使用户没有明确提及“docx”，如果任务隐含需要可打印/正式文档，也使用此技能。

description: Guides MongoDB users through implementing and optimizing Atlas Search (full-text), Vector Search (semantic), and Hybrid Search solutions. Use this skill when users need to build search functionality for text-based queries (autocomplete, fuzzy matching, faceted search), semantic similarity (embeddings, RAG applications), or combined approaches. Also use when users need text containment, substring matching ('contains', 'includes', 'appears in'), case-insensitive or multi-field text search, or filtering across many fields with variable combinations. Provides workflows for selecting the right search type, creating indexes, constructing queries, and optimizing performance using the MongoDB MCP server.
description_zh: 指导 MongoDB 用户实施并优化 Atlas Search（全文搜索）、向量搜索（语义搜索）及混合搜索解决方案。当用户需要构建文本查询的搜索功能（如自动补全、模糊匹配、分面搜索）、语义相似度（嵌入、RAG 应用）或混合方案时，请使用此技能。当用户需要进行文本包含、子串匹配（'contains', 'includes', 'appears in'）、不区分大小写的多字段文本搜索，或对多个字段以可变组合方式进行筛选时，同样使用本技能。通过 MongoDB MCP 服务器提供选择合适搜索类型、创建索引、构造查询并优化性能的工作流。

description: Use this skill when rendering thousands of lightweight sprites in PixiJS v8. Covers ParticleContainer with Particle instances, addParticle/removeParticle, particleChildren array, dynamicProperties (vertex, position, rotation, uvs, color), boundsArea, roundPixels, update, inherited alpha/tint/blendMode from ancestors. Triggers on: ParticleContainer, Particle, IParticle, addParticle, particleChildren, dynamicProperties, boundsArea, particle effects, particle alpha, particle tint, fade particles, constructor options, ParticleContainerOptions, ParticleOptions.
description_zh: 在 PixiJS v8 中渲染数千个轻量级精灵时使用本技能。涵盖带 Particle 实例的 ParticleContainer、addParticle/removeParticle、particleChildren 数组、dynamicProperties（vertex、position、rotation、uvs、color）、boundsArea、roundPixels、update，以及从祖先继承的 alpha/tint/blindMode。触发条件：ParticleContainer、Particle、IParticle、addParticle、particleChildren、dynamicProperties、boundsArea、particle effects、particle alpha、particle tint、fade particles、constructor options、ParticleContainerOptions、ParticleOptions。

description: Build and audit SwiftUI, UIKit, and AppKit accessibility for VoiceOver, Voice Control, Switch Control, Full Keyboard Access, Dynamic Type, focus restoration, labels/traits/actions, traversal, custom rotors, NSAccessibility, XCTest checks, adaptive system preferences, and App Store accessibility declarations. Use when implementing accessible UI, fixing an accessibility audit, testing assistive-technology behavior, or substantiating App Store Accessibility Nutrition Labels.
description_zh: 构建并审计 SwiftUI、UIKit 和 AppKit 的辅助功能，涵盖 VoiceOver、Voice Control、Switch Control、全键盘访问、动态字体、焦点恢复、标签、特性、操作、遍历、自定义旋转器、NSAccessibility、XCTest 检查、自适应系统偏好以及 App Store 辅助功能声明等。用于实现无障碍 UI、修复辅助功能审计、测试辅助技术行为，或证明 App Store 无障碍营养标签。

description: Discover existing cloud resources using Terraform Search queries and bulk import them into Terraform management. Use when bringing unmanaged infrastructure under Terraform control, auditing cloud resources, or migrating to IaC.
description_zh: 使用 Terraform 搜索查询发现现有的云资源，并将其批量导入 Terraform 管理。适用于将未受管理的 infrastructure 纳入 Terraform 控制、审计云资源，或向基础设施即代码（IaC）迁移时使用。

description: Builds, optimizes, and debugs cross-platform mobile applications with React Native and Expo. Implements navigation hierarchies (tabs, stacks, drawers), configures native modules, optimizes FlatList rendering with memo and useCallback, and handles platform-specific code for iOS and Android. Use when building a React Native or Expo mobile app, setting up navigation, integrating native modules, improving scroll performance, handling SafeArea or keyboard input, or configuring Expo SDK projects.
description_zh: 使用 React Native 和 Expo 构建、优化并调试跨平台移动应用。实现导航层级（标签页、栈、抽屉）、配置原生模块，利用 memo 和 useCallback 优化 FlatList 渲染，并处理 iOS 与 Android 的特定平台代码。适用于构建 React Native 或 Expo 移动应用、设置导航、集成原生模块、提升滚动性能、处理 SafeArea 或键盘输入，或配置 Expo SDK 项目。

description: Design or review backend domain and dependency boundaries using DDD, Clean Architecture, and ports/adapters. Use for aggregate modeling, bounded contexts, use-case isolation, or architecture refactoring; not routine CRUD changes.
description_zh: 使用领域驱动设计（DDD）、干净架构及端口/适配器，设计或审查后端领域的领域边界与依赖边界。适用于聚合建模、有界上下文、用例隔离或架构重构；而非常规 CRUD 变更。

description: Conduct comprehensive company research and due diligence. Analyze business model, competitive landscape, management, and market position.
description_zh: 开展全面的公司研究与尽职调查。分析商业模式、竞争格局、管理团队及市场地位。

description: Build AI agents with Pydantic AI — tools, capabilities (including on-demand loading), structured output, streaming, testing, and multi-agent patterns. Use when the user mentions Pydantic AI, imports pydantic_ai, or asks to build an AI agent, add tools/capabilities, defer capability loading, stream output, define agents from YAML, or test agent behavior.
description_zh: 使用 Pydantic AI 构建 AI 智能体——工具、能力（包括按需加载）、结构化输出、流式输出、测试和多智能体模式。当用户提及 Pydantic AI、导入 pydantic_ai，或要求构建 AI 智能体、添加工具/能力、延迟能力加载、流式输出、根据 YAML 定义智能体或测试智能体行为时使用。

description: Build quiz and assessment funnels that generate qualified leads at 30-50% conversion. Use when the user mentions "quiz funnel", "scorecard", "lead magnet", "score-based segmentation", or "lead qualification". Also trigger when designing self-assessment tools, building calculators or graders for marketing, or creating personalized result pages that drive conversions. Covers concept hooks, question design, dynamic results by tier, and automated follow-up sequences. For landing page conversion, see cro-methodology. For full marketing plans, see one-page-marketing.
description_zh: 构建转化率达30%-50%的测验与评估漏斗，以生成合格线索。当用户提及“测验漏斗”、“记分卡”、“线索诱饵”、“基于分数的用户分层”或“线索资格评估”时使用。当设计自评工具、为营销构建计算器或评分工具，或创建能推动转化的个性化结果页面时，也触发。涵盖概念钩子、题目设计、按层级动态结果以及自动化跟进序列。关于落地页转化，请参阅 cro-methodology。关于完整营销计划，请参阅 one-page-marketing。

description: Opinionated production Python standards with automatic version detection (3.10-3.13). Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Python in repos that want modern type syntax, explicit condition checks where practical, pathlib operations, interface guidance, and pragmatic production patterns.
description_zh: 具有自动版本检测（3.10-3.13）的生产级 Python 规范。适用于在希望采用现代类型语法、在可行时明确进行条件检查、执行 pathlib 操作、提供接口指导并采用务实生产模式的仓库中编写、审查或重构 Python 代码。

description: Create professional invoices with proper formatting for freelancers and small businesses. Supports multiple currencies and tax calculations.
description_zh: 为自由职业者和小型企业创建格式规范的专业发票。支持多种货币和税收计算。

description: USE FOR web search. Returns ranked results with snippets, URLs, thumbnails. Supports freshness filters, SafeSearch, Goggles for custom ranking, pagination. Primary search endpoint.
description_zh: 用途：网页搜索。返回按相关度排序的结果，包含摘要、URL 和缩略图。支持时效性筛选、SafeSearch、Goggles 自定义排序以及分页。主要搜索接口。

description: Build production-ready systems with stability patterns: circuit breakers, bulkheads, timeouts, and retry logic. Use when the user mentions "production outage", "circuit breaker", "deployment pipeline", "chaos engineering", "retry storm", "health checks", "my service keeps crashing", "prevent cascading failures", or "make it resilient". Also trigger when designing resilient microservices, planning zero-downtime deployments, or capacity-planning for peak load. Covers stability patterns, capacity planning, deploy/release decoupling, and observability. For data systems, see ddia-systems. For system architecture, see system-design.
description_zh: 使用稳定性模式构建生产就绪的系统：断路器、舱壁、超时机制及重试逻辑。在用户提及“生产中断”、“断路器”、“部署流水线”、“混沌工程”、“重试风暴”、“健康检查”、“我的服务持续崩溃”、“防止级联故障”或“使其具备弹性”时使用。在设计和弹性微服务、规划零停机部署，或针对高峰负载进行容量规划时，也应触发。涵盖稳定性模式、容量规划、部署与发布解耦以及可观测性。对于数据系统，请参阅 ddia-systems。对于系统架构，请参阅 system-design。

description: Evaluates, configures, and migrates workloads to AWS Lambda Managed Instances (LMI). Runs Lambda functions on EC2 instances in the user's account while AWS manages provisioning, patching, scaling, routing, and load balancing. Triggers when queries mention Lambda Managed Instances, LMI, capacity providers, multi-concurrent execution environments, EC2-backed Lambda, persistent Lambda instances, PerExecutionEnvironmentMaxConcurrency, CapacityProviderConfig, cold start elimination via dedicated instances, migrating standard Lambda to managed instances, or cost comparison between standard Lambda and LMI with Savings Plans or Reserved Instances. Also covers long-running and asynchronous workloads and the 90-minute (5400s) function timeout for asynchronous and event-source-mapping (SQS, Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams / ESM) invocations, including how to raise the function timeout up to 90 minutes / 5400s and the related duration limits.
description_zh: 评估、配置并将工作负载迁移至AWS Lambda托管实例（LMI）。在用户账户中的EC2实例上运行Lambda函数，同时由AWS管理资源供应、补丁、扩展、路由和负载均衡。当查询中提及Lambda托管实例、LMI、容量提供商、多并发执行环境、基于EC2的Lambda、持久Lambda实例、PerExecutionEnvironmentMaxConcurrency、CapacityProviderConfig、通过专用实例消除冷启动、将标准Lambda迁移至托管实例，或以节省计划或预留实例对比标准Lambda与LMI的成本时，该功能将触发。此外，还涵盖长时运行和异步工作负载，以及异步和事件源映射（SQS、Kinesis、DynamoDB数据流/ESM）调用的90分钟（5400秒）函数超时设置，包括将函数超时时间提升至90分钟/5400秒及相关时长限制的方法。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when working with LangSmith tracing OR querying traces. Covers adding tracing to applications and querying/exporting trace data. Uses the langsmith CLI tool.
description_zh: 在处理 LangSmith 追踪或查询追踪信息时调用此技能。该技能涵盖向应用程序添加追踪功能以及查询/导出追踪数据，并使用 langsmith CLI 工具。

description: Expert in web scraping and data extraction with Python tools
description_zh: 精通使用 Python 工具的网页抓取与数据提取专家

description: Improves the quality of images, especially screenshots, by enhancing resolution, sharpness, and clarity. Perfect for preparing images for presentations, documentation, or social media posts.
description_zh: 通过增强分辨率、锐度和清晰度，有效提升图像质量，特别是截图。非常适合为演示文稿、文档或社交媒体帖子准备图像。

description: Automate Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns, audience targeting, and performance optimization
description_zh: 自动化 Facebook 和 Instagram 广告投放、受众定向与效果优化

description: Provides comprehensive Drizzle ORM patterns for schema definition, CRUD operations, relations, queries, transactions, and migrations. Proactively use for any Drizzle ORM development including defining database schemas, writing type-safe queries, implementing relations, managing transactions, and setting up migrations with Drizzle Kit. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, and CockroachDB.
description_zh: 提供全面的 Drizzle ORM 模式，涵盖模式定义、CRUD 操作、关联、查询、事务与迁移。在 Drizzle ORM 的各类开发中，可主动采用这些模式，包括定义数据库模式、编写类型安全的查询、实现关联、管理事务，以及使用 Drizzle Kit 配置迁移。支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、MSSQL 和 CockroachDB。

description: Use this skill when creating, converting, or manipulating colors in PixiJS v8. Covers Color class input formats (hex, CSS names, RGB/HSL objects, arrays, Uint8Array), conversion methods (toHex, toNumber, toArray, toRgba), component access, setAlpha/multiply/premultiply, Color.shared singleton. Triggers on: Color, ColorSource, hex, rgb, hsl, tint, premultiply, Color.shared, color conversion.
description_zh: 在使用 PixiJS v8 创建、转换或操作颜色时，使用此技能。涵盖 Color 类的输入格式（hex、CSS 名称、RGB/HSL 对象、数组、Uint8Array）、转换方法（toHex、toNumber、toArray、toRgba）、组件访问、setAlpha/multiply/premultiply 以及 Color.shared 单例。触发词：Color、ColorSource、hex、rgb、hsl、tint、premultiply、Color.shared、color conversion。

description: Optimize web performance through network protocols, resource loading, and browser rendering internals. Use when the user mentions "my site is slow", "Core Web Vitals", "HTTP/2 or HTTP/3", "resource hints", "network latency", "render blocking", "TCP/TLS optimization", "service worker", "Cache-Control or caching strategy", or "critical rendering path". Also trigger when diagnosing slow page loads, optimizing time to first byte, choosing between WebSocket and SSE, or reducing bundle sizes. For UI visual performance, see refactoring-ui. For font loading, see web-typography.
description_zh: 通过网络协议、资源加载和浏览器渲染内部机制优化网页性能。当用户提及“我的网站很慢”、“Core Web Vitals”、“HTTP/2 或 HTTP/3”、“资源提示”、“网络延迟”、“渲染阻塞”、“TCP/TLS 优化”、“Service Worker”、“Cache-Control 或缓存策略”或“关键渲染路径”时使用。在诊断页面加载缓慢、优化首字节时间、选择 WebSocket 与 SSE 方案，或减小包体大小时触发。有关 UI 视觉性能优化，请参考 refactoring-ui。有关字体加载，请参考 web-typography。

description: Generate TradingView-style candlestick charts with indicators. Use when the user wants a visual chart, price visualization, or technical analysis plot.
description_zh: 生成带有指标的可视化 TradingView 风格 K 线图。适用于用户需要可视化图表、价格可视化或技术分析图表的场景。

description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.
description_zh: 观察一个拉取请求或审查周期，直到其可以合并。当被要求照看、监控或持续检查PR评论、评审和CI，直到所有可解决的问题都得到解决时使用。

description: Use when the user asks for Korean school meal menus (급식 식단) by natural-language education office and school name, via k-skill-proxy NEIS school-search and school-meal routes.
description_zh: 当用户以自然语言提供教育部门和学校名称，要求查询韩国学校餐单（급식 식단）时，通过 k-skill-proxy NEIS 学校检索与学校餐单路由使用。

description: An Instagram API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no login and no session cookies. Use when the user wants to resolve an Instagram profile by @handle, search users by keyword, pull a profile's posts, reels, stories, tagged posts, followers, or followings, look up a single post by its shortcode, read a post's comments, fetch posts under a hashtag or reel-only hashtag feed, pull posts from a location, or pull posts using a specific audio/music track. Also covers Instagram follower export, hashtag and location monitoring, influencer discovery, competitor content tracking, and Instagram data pipelines without an official Graph API business verification or a headless browser.
description_zh: fetcher.sh 上的 Instagram API 替代方案——通过 x402 以 USDC 按次付费，或使用 Bearer 密钥预购积分，无需登录，无需会话 Cookie。当用户希望通过 @handle 解析 Instagram 个人资料、按关键词搜索用户、获取个人资料的帖子、Reels、故事、带标签的帖子、关注者或关注对象、通过短码查询单条帖子、阅读帖子评论、获取标签或仅 Reels 标签动态下的帖子、获取来自某地点的帖子，或使用特定音频/音乐曲目获取帖子时使用。此外还涵盖 Instagram 粉丝导出、标签和地点监控、影响力者发现、竞争对手内容追踪，以及无需官方 Graph API 商业验证或无头浏览器即可构建的 Instagram 数据管道。

description: Designs distributed system architectures, decomposes monoliths into bounded-context services, recommends communication patterns, and produces service boundary diagrams and resilience strategies. Use when designing distributed systems, decomposing monoliths, or implementing microservices patterns — including service boundaries, DDD, saga patterns, event sourcing, CQRS, service mesh, or distributed tracing.
description_zh: 设计分布式系统架构，将单体应用分解为有界上下文服务，推荐通信模式，并生成服务边界图与韧性策略。适用于设计分布式系统、拆解单体应用或实施微服务模式时使用——包括服务边界、DDD、Saga 模式、事件溯源、CQRS、服务网格或分布式链路追踪。

description: Invoke the `incidentio` CLI to drive the incident.io API — incidents, actions, follow-ups, alerts/alert sources/routes, escalations & on-call schedules, catalog (types/entries/resources), custom fields, severities, incident types/roles/statuses/timestamps, status pages (including creating and managing public pages, components, layout, subscribers, templates), workflows, users, teams, API keys, heartbeats, maintenance windows, and settings. Uses the public Bearer API (OpenAPI-generated commands) plus internal dashboard (cookie) commands generated from captured HARs, hand-curated internal endpoints, and a `raw` escape hatch for any un-codified path. Use whenever a task needs incident.io data or actions, such as "list our incidents", "create an incident", "show the on-call schedule", "build or manage a status page", "list status page subscribers", "tune a dashboard setting", or "hit an internal dashboard endpoint".
description_zh:
调用 `incidentio` CLI 以驱动 incident.io API —— 涵盖事件、操作、跟进、警报（含警报来源/警报路由）、升级与值班排班、目录（类型/条目/资源）、自定义字段、严重级别、事件类型/角色/状态/时间戳、状态页（包括创建和管理公开页面、组件、布局、订阅者、模板）、工作流、用户、团队、API 密钥、心跳、维护窗口和设置。

该工具使用公开 Bearer API（由 OpenAPI 生成的命令）以及从捕获的 HARs 生成的内部仪表盘（cookie）命令、人工精选的内部端点，以及用于访问任何未编码路径的 `raw` 逃生通道。

在任何需要获取 incident.io 数据或执行操作的任务中均可使用，例如："列出我们的事件"、"创建事件"、"查看值班排班"、"构建或管理状态页"、"列出状态页订阅者"、"调整仪表盘设置"或"访问内部仪表盘端点"。

description: Build a weekly cadence of customer touchpoints using Opportunity Solution Trees, assumption mapping, and interview snapshots. Use when the user mentions "continuous discovery", "opportunity solution tree", "weekly interviews", "assumption testing", "discovery habits", "product trio", "outcome-based roadmap", "how do I talk to customers regularly", "we keep building things nobody uses", or "connect research to the roadmap". Also trigger when setting up regular customer feedback loops, prioritizing which experiments to run, or tying discovery insights to delivery work. Covers experience mapping, co-creation, and prioritizing opportunities. For interview technique, see mom-test. For team structure, see inspired-product.
description_zh: 利用机会解决方案树、假设映射和访谈快照，建立客户触点每周节奏。当用户提及“持续发现”、“机会解决方案树”、“每周访谈”、“假设测试”、“发现习惯”、“产品三件套”、“基于成果的路线图”、“我如何定期与客户交流”、“我们一直在构建无人使用的东西”或“将研究联系到路线图”时使用。同时，当设置定期客户反馈循环、确定哪些实验需要执行，或将发现洞察与交付工作关联时触发。涵盖体验映射、共创和优先排序机会。关于访谈技巧，参见 mom-test。关于团队结构，参见 inspired-product。

description: Analyze and optimize tweets for maximum reach using Twitter's open-source algorithm insights. Rewrite and edit user tweets to improve engagement and visibility based on how the recommendation system ranks content.
description_zh: 利用推特的开源算法洞察，分析和优化推文以实现最大传播效果。根据推荐系统对内容的排名方式，重写和编辑用户推文，以提高参与度和可见度。

description: Comprehensive guide for configuring and managing GitHub Dependabot. Use this skill when users ask about creating or optimizing dependabot.yml files, managing Dependabot pull requests, configuring dependency update strategies, setting up grouped updates, monorepo patterns, multi-ecosystem groups, security update configuration, auto-triage rules, or any GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) supply chain security topic related to Dependabot. For pre-commit dependency vulnerability scanning in AI coding agents via the GitHub MCP Server, this skill references the Advanced Security plugin (`advanced-security@copilot-plugins`). Use this skill when an agent needs to scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities before committing.
description_zh: GitHub Dependabot 配置与管理的全面指南。当用户询问关于创建或优化 dependabot.yml 文件、管理 Dependabot 拉取请求、配置依赖更新策略、设置分组更新、单体仓库模式、多生态系统分组、安全更新配置、自动分类规则，或与 Dependabot 相关的任何 GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) 供应链安全议题时，请使用此技能。对于通过 GitHub MCP Server 在 AI 编码代理中进行提交前依赖漏洞扫描，本技能引用了 Advanced Security 插件（`advanced-security@copilot-plugins`）。当代理需要在提交前扫描依赖以识别已知漏洞时，使用此技能。

description: Email marketing automation - campaign creation, sequence building, A/B testing, deliverability optimization, and analytics
description_zh: 邮件营销自动化——活动创建、序列构建、A/B测试、送达率优化与数据分析

description: Use this skill when scaffolding a new PixiJS v8 project with the create-pixi CLI or adding PixiJS to an existing project. Covers npm/yarn/pnpm/bun create commands, interactive vs non-interactive flows, bundler vs creation template categories, available template presets (bundler-vite, bundler-webpack, bundler-esbuild, bundler-import-map, creation-web, framework-react, extension-default), Node version requirements, `npm install pixi.js` for existing projects, TypeScript 5/6/7 tsconfig setup (moduleResolution, @webgpu/types, @types/web), post-scaffold dev flow, and the Vite top-level-await production-build gotcha. Triggers on: create pixi.js, npm create, npm install pixi.js, scaffold, template, bundler-vite, bundler-webpack, creation-web, framework-react, new project, existing project, getting started, quick start, TypeScript, tsconfig, moduleResolution, @webgpu/types, @types/web, Cannot find name GPUTextureUsage.
description_zh: 在使用 create-pixi CLI 搭建新的 PixiJS v8 项目或向现有项目添加 PixiJS 时使用此技能。涵盖 npm/yarn/pnpm/bun create 命令、交互式与非交互式流程、打包工具与创建模板类别、可用模板预设（bundler-vite、bundler-webpack、bundler-esbuild、bundler-import-map、creation-web、framework-react、extension-default）、Node 版本要求、向现有项目使用 `npm install pixi.js`、TypeScript 5/6/7 下的 tsconfig 设置（moduleResolution、@webgpu/types、@types/web）、搭建后开发流程，以及 Vite 顶层 await 生产构建的注意事项。触发条件：create pixi.js、npm create、npm install pixi.js、scaffold、template、bundler-vite、bundler-webpack、creation-web、framework-react、new project、existing project、getting started、quick start、TypeScript、tsconfig、moduleResolution、@webgpu/types、@types/web、Cannot find name GPUTextureUsage。

description: Implements an accepted incremental brownfield migration from native iOS or Android to React Native or Expo using @callstack/react-native-brownfield. Use after the brownfield path has been selected, when setting up the integration, packaging XCFramework or AAR artifacts, or adding React Native surfaces to native hosts.
description_zh: 使用 @callstack/react-native-brownfield 实现经认可的棕色现场增量迁移，从原生 iOS 或 Android 迁移到 React Native 或 Expo。在选定棕色现场迁移路径之后，在设置集成、打包 XCFramework 或 AAR 工件，或将 React Native 界面添加到原生宿主时使用。

description: Use this skill when writing custom shaders, uniforms, filters, batchers, or low-level draw code in PixiJS v8. Covers Shader.from({gl, gpu, resources}), GlProgram/GpuProgram, UniformGroup with typed uniforms (f32, vec2, mat4x4), UBO mode, textures as resources, TextureView for depth sampling, WGSL override constants, custom bind group layouts (gpuLayout), partial buffer updates (Buffer.update), Geometry.vertexCount/indexCount, TexturePool scratch textures, State winding and culling (clockwiseFrontFace, cullMode), WebGPU render bundles, custom Filter via Filter.from, GLSL ES 3.0 conventions (finalColor), uBackTexture sampling, pixi.js/unsafe-eval for strict CSP, custom Batcher and InstructionPipe.destroyInstructionSet via extensions. Triggers on: Shader, GLSL, WGSL, uniform, custom shader, blendRequired, ShaderOverrides, bind group layout, depth texture, getSize, indexCount, TexturePool, getOptimalTexture, destroyInstructionSet, beginBundle, executeBundle, RenderBundle.
description_zh:
在 PixiJS v8 中编写自定义着色器、uniforms、滤镜、批处理器或底层绘制代码时使用此技能。涵盖 `Shader.from({gl, gpu, resources})`、`GlProgram`/`GpuProgram`、带有类型化 uniforms（f32、vec2、mat4x4）的 `UniformGroup`、UBO 模式、作为资源的纹理、用于深度采样的 `TextureView`、WGSL 覆盖常量、自定义绑定组布局（`gpuLayout`）、部分缓冲区更新（`Buffer.update`）、`Geometry.vertexCount/indexCount`、`TexturePool` 的临时纹理、状态环绕与剔除（`clockwiseFrontFace`、`cullMode`）、WebGPU 渲染包、通过 `Filter.from` 创建的自定义 `Filter`、GLSL ES 3.0 规范（`finalColor`）、`uBackTexture` 采样、用于严格内容安全策略（CSP）的 `pixi.js`/`unsafe-eval`，以及通过扩展自定义 `Batcher` 与 `InstructionPipe.destroyInstructionSet`。

触发条件包括：Shader、GLSL、WGSL、uniform、自定义着色器、blendingRequired、ShaderOverrides、绑定组布局、深度纹理、getSize、indexCount、TexturePool、getOptimalTexture、destroyInstructionSet、beginBundle、executeBundle、RenderBundle。

description: Printing Press CLI for Flight Goat. Search real Google Flights fares, cheapest dates, Kayak routes, and FlySoar price checks with no API key — plus optional FlightAware AeroAPI flight status, delay, and alert data.
description_zh: 用于 Flight Goat 的 Printing Press CLI。搜索真实的 Google Flights 票价、最便宜日期、Kayak 航线及 FlySoar 价格查询，无需 API 密钥——此外还支持可选的 FlightAware AeroAPI 航班状态、延误和预警数据。

description: Use when the user asks how to look up 지하철 분실물 or 유실물 by 역명/물품명. v1 is an 안내형/하이브리드 skill that structures the official LOST112 + 서울교통공사 flow conservatively. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 用户询问如何通过站名或物品名查询地铁遗失物或失物时使用。v1 是一款指引型/混合式技能，以保守的方式构建官方 LOST112 + 首尔交通公社的标准流程。在돌쇠中，通过官方界面完成后续操作。

description: Local-first, security-first control center for OpenClaw agents — visibility dashboard with readonly defaults, token attribution, collaboration tracing, and safe write operations.
description_zh: OpenClaw代理本地优先、安全优先的控制中心——带有只读默认设置、令牌归属、协作追踪和安全写入操作的可视化仪表盘。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Antigravity or agy - phrasings like "have Antigravity do X", "delegate this to agy", "run it through agy", or "use Antigravity to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through agy while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委派给 Google Antigravity CLI（`agy`）作为后台执行者，随后审查其 diff 并自行合入落地。当用户希望将实现工作交由 Antigravity 或 agy（诸如“让 Antigravity 完成 X”、“将此项委派给 agy”、“通过 agy 运行”、“使用 Antigravity 实现/修复/重构”等表述），或希望将一批编码任务通过 agy 运行，同时自己担任审查者时，请使用此功能。对于足够小可直接内联完成的任务，或当用户要求不经过委派直接编写代码时，切勿使用。

description: Use when a user wants to wire an OpenTelemetry collector into a Managed ClickStack service on ClickHouse Cloud, either by deploying a new local collector (Docker run or Docker Compose) or by configuring their own existing collector, then send rich synthetic telemetry and verify it is visible in ClickStack.
description_zh: 适用于当用户需要将 OpenTelemetry 收集器接入 ClickHouse Cloud 上的托管 ClickStack 服务时使用，用户既可通过部署新的本地收集器（采用 Docker run 或 Docker Compose 方式），也可配置其现有的收集器，随后发送丰富的合成遥测数据，并验证其在 ClickStack 中可见。

description: Use this skill when compositing display objects with blend modes in PixiJS v8. Covers standard modes (normal, add, multiply, screen, erase, min, max), advanced modes via pixi.js/advanced-blend-modes (color-burn, overlay, hard-light, etc.), batch-friendly ordering. Triggers on: blendMode, additive, multiply, screen, overlay, color-burn, color-dodge, advanced-blend-modes, glow, erase.
description_zh: 在 PixiJS v8 中，当组合带有混合模式的显示对象时，使用此技能。涵盖标准模式（正常、叠加、正片叠底、滤色、擦除、最小、最大），通过 pixi.js/advanced-blink-modes 使用高级模式（color-burn、overlay、hard-light 等），支持批量处理的顺序。触发条件：blendsMode, additive, multiply, screen, overlay, color-burn, color-dodge, advanced-blink-modes, glow, erase。

description: SaaS subscription lifecycle management - billing, upgrades, downgrades, churn prevention, and revenue optimization
description_zh: SaaS订阅生命周期管理 - 计费、升级、降级、流失预防及收入优化

description: Reconstruct slide images, screenshots, scanned PDFs, or image-only PPTX files as object-level editable PowerPoint. Use for 图片转可编辑PPT、截图还原PPT and diagram reconstruction; not authoring a new deck from research notes.
description_zh: 将幻灯片图片、截图、扫描版PDF或纯图片的PPTX文件重构为对象级可编辑的PowerPoint。用于图片转可编辑PPT、截图还原PPT及图表重构；不适用于从研究笔记撰写新演示文稿。

description: Use when user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture charts, or visualizations. Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, complex data flows, or relationships that benefit from visual representation. Generates .excalidraw files and exports to PNG/SVG via Kroki API or locally using excalidraw-brute-export-cli.
description_zh: 当用户请求图表、流程图、架构图或可视化时使用。也应在解释包含 3 个及以上组件、复杂数据流，或从可视化呈现中受益的关系的系统时，主动使用。生成 .excalidraw 文件，并通过 Kroki API 或本地使用 excalidraw-brute-export-cli 将其导出为 PNG/SVG。

description: A TikTok API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no login and no app review. Use when the user wants to search TikTok posts by keyword and sort by most-liked or most recent within a date range, look up a post by its share URL or ID, scrape a TikTok profile by @username, pull a user's posts, followers, or followings, fetch a hashtag's posts, pull posts using a specific sound/music track, get posts from a location, or read a post's comments and comment replies. Also covers TikTok trend tracking, hashtag monitoring, influencer discovery, competitor content analysis, and TikTok data pipelines without official TikTok API access or a scraping browser.
description_zh: 位于 fetcher.sh 的 TikTok API 替代方案——通过 x402 以 USDC 按调用计费，或使用带 Bearer key 的预付费积分；无需登录，无需应用审核。适用于用户需要按关键词搜索 TikTok 帖子并按点赞数最多或最新在指定日期范围内排序、根据分享链接或帖子 ID 查询帖子、通过 @username 抓取 TikTok 主页、获取用户的帖子、粉丝或关注对象、获取标签下的帖子、使用指定的音乐/声音曲目获取帖子、获取特定地点的帖子，以及阅读帖子评论及评论回复等场景。此外还涵盖 TikTok 趋势追踪、标签监控、达人发现、竞品内容分析，以及无需官方 TikTok API 访问权限或抓取浏览器即可实现的 TikTok 数据流水线。

description: Use this skill when overlaying HTML elements on the PixiJS v8 canvas. Covers DOMContainer with element, anchor, and scene-graph-driven CSS transforms, the pixi.js/dom side-effect import, DOMPipe registration, visibility sync, pointer-events handling. Triggers on: DOMContainer, pixi.js/dom, DOMPipe, HTML overlay, input on canvas, iframe overlay, DOMContainerOptions, element, anchor, constructor options.
description_zh: 当在 PixiJS v8 画布上叠加 HTML 元素时使用此技能。涵盖 DOMContainer（支持 element、anchor 以及基于场景图的 CSS 变换）、pixi.js/dom 副作用导入、DOMPipe 注册、可见性同步与指针事件处理。触发条件：DOMContainer、pixi.js/dom、DOMPipe、HTML 叠加层、画布输入、iframe 叠加层、DOMContainerOptions、element、anchor、构造函数选项。

description:
Breaks down complex projects into actionable tasks with timelines, dependencies, and milestones.
Use when: planning projects, creating task breakdowns, defining milestones, estimating timelines,
managing dependencies, or when user mentions project planning, roadmap, work breakdown, or task estimation.
description_zh:
将复杂的项目拆解为包含时间进度、依赖关系及里程碑的可执行任务。
使用时机：规划项目、创建任务分解、定义里程碑、估算时间进度、管理依赖关系，或用户提及项目规划、路线图、工作分解或任务估算时使用。

description: Draft, promote, archive, and supersede ADR-style decision records (types are open: architecture, product, security, policy, legal, …) and keep INDEX.md and cross-links generated, via the bundled scripts/decisions.py tool. Use when creating or promoting decision drafts, superseding or archiving a decision, fixing a promotion breach, flattening the old per-type accepted/ layout, or running build, check, promote, rename-draft-id, migrate-layout, or install.
description_zh: 起草、推广、归档并替代ADR风格决策记录（类型开放：架构、产品、安全、政策、法律等），并通过捆绑的scripts/decisions.py工具生成并保持INDEX.md及交叉链接。在创建或推广决策草稿、替代或归档决策、修复推广违规、扁平化旧有按类型区分的接受/布局，或执行构建、检查、推广、重命名草稿ID、迁移布局或安装操作时使用。

description: Navigate the technology adoption lifecycle from early adopters to mainstream market. Use when the user mentions "crossing the chasm", "beachhead segment", "whole product", "early adopters vs mainstream", "tech go-to-market", "bowling pin strategy", "technology adoption lifecycle", "pragmatist buyers", "growth stalled after early adopters", or "our go-to-market plan". Also trigger when planning go-to-market for a technical product. Covers the D-Day analogy, bowling-pin strategy, the tornado, and positioning against incumbents. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For new market creation, see blue-ocean-strategy.
description_zh: 引导技术采用生命周期，从早期采用者到主流市场。当用户提及“跨越鸿沟”、“滩头阵地”、“完整产品”、“早期采用者与主流市场”、“技术产品上市策略”、“保龄球瓶策略”、“技术采用生命周期”、“务实型买方”、“早期采用者之后增长停滞”或“我们的上市计划”时使用。规划技术产品上市计划时，亦会触发。涵盖 D-Day（诺曼底登陆日）类比、保龄球瓶策略、龙卷风，以及针对现有竞争对手的定位。关于产品定位，请参阅“显然很棒的”词条。关于新市场开拓，请参阅“蓝海战略”词条。

description: Type-safe SQL ORM for TypeScript with zero runtime overhead
description_zh: 零运行时开销的类型安全 TypeScript SQL ORM

description: Scripted onboarding for LaunchDarkly: quiet execution, fixed sequence, SDK install, first flag with a live reveal, MCP offered afterwards. Enforces step completion before advancing and redirects drift. Use when adding LaunchDarkly, setting up or integrating feature flags in a project, SDK integration, or 'onboard me'.
description_zh: LaunchDarkly 的脚本化入门引导：静默执行，固定序列，SDK 安装，首次功能标志实时揭示，之后提供 MCP。在执行下一步前强制完成步骤，并纠正偏差。在添加 LaunchDarkly、在项目中设置或集成功能标志、进行 SDK 集成或点击“引导我”时使用。

description: Engineer word-of-mouth and virality using the STEPPS framework (Social Currency, Triggers, Emotion, Public, Practical Value, Stories). Use when the user mentions "go viral", "word of mouth", "shareable content", "social currency", "why people share", "referral program", "nobody is sharing it", or "make this spread". Also trigger when designing shareable features, crafting social campaigns, or building products that spread through peer recommendation. Covers environmental triggers and high-arousal emotional content. For sticky messaging, see made-to-stick. For persuasion tactics, see influence-psychology.
description_zh: 利用 STEPPS 框架（社交货币、触发点、情绪、公开、实用价值、故事）打造口碑与病毒式传播。当用户提及“病毒式传播”、“口碑”、“可分享内容”、“社交货币”、“人们为何分享”、“推荐计划”、“没人分享”或“让内容传播”时使用。在设计与可分享功能、策划社交活动、或构建通过用户推荐传播的产品时，也应触发使用。涵盖环境触发因素与高唤醒度情绪内容。关于有记忆点的传播文案，见 made-to-stick。关于说服技巧，见 influence-psychology。

description: Develop a Base44 app remotely from your own coding agent (Claude Code, claude.ai, or any MCP client) by connecting it to the Base44 sandbox. Cloud agents connect over MCP; local agents can connect over MCP or drive the same sandbox with the `base44 sandbox` CLI subcommands (the CLI uses shorter names — e.g. read_file is `sandbox read`, list_directory is `sandbox ls`, run_command is `sandbox run`). Covers connecting/ authenticating, the available sandbox tools (run_command, read_file, write_file, edit_file, grep, list_directory, create_checkpoint, get_app_preview_url, get_app_status, list_user_apps, and the connector tools list_connectors / initiate_connector_connection), the edit→preview→verify loop, how changes persist, builder/external-agent concurrency, the in-editor "Send to Coding Agent" button + onboarding README URLs, and tips like reading the Vite dev-server logs. Triggers on "develop my Base44 app remotely", "connect Claude Code to Base44", "bring my own agent", "edit a Base44 app over MCP", "Base44 sandbox MCP", or "Send to Coding Agent".
description_zh:
使用您自己的编码代理（Claude Code、claude.ai 或任何 MCP 客户端），通过连接到 Base44 沙盒，远程开发 Base44 应用。云端代理通过 MCP 进行连接；本地代理既可通过 MCP 连接，也可使用 `base44 sandbox` CLI 子命令驱动同一个沙盒（CLI 使用更短的名称——例如，read_file 为 `sandbox read`，list_directory 为 `sandbox ls`，run_command 为 `sandbox run`）。

内容涵盖连接与身份验证、可用的沙盒工具（run_command、read_file、write_file、edit_file、grep、list_directory、create_checkpoint、get_app_preview_url、get_app_status、list_user_apps 以及连接工具 list_connectors / initiate_connector_connection）、编辑→预览→验证循环、变更的持久化方式、构建器/外部代理的并发处理、编辑器中的“发送到编码代理”按钮及引导 README URL，以及诸如阅读 Vite 开发服务器日志等技巧。

触发条件包括“远程开发我的 Base44 应用”、“将 Claude Code 连接到 Base44”、“使用我自己的代理”、“通过 MCP 编辑 Base44 应用”、“Base44 沙盒 MCP”或“发送到编码代理”。

description: Conduct comprehensive research on any topic. Synthesize information from multiple angles, provide structured analysis, and generate detailed research reports.
description_zh: 针对任何主题开展全面研究。从多个角度综合信息，提供结构化分析，并撰写详细的调研报告。

description: Use for user-facing strings and react-i18next locale keys, namespaces, interpolation, translations or bun run i18n.
description_zh: 用于面向用户的字符串以及 react-i18next 的 locale key、命名空间、插值、翻译，或 bun run i18n。

description: Automate Gmail with intelligent workflows - attachment management, email organization, auto-archiving, and Google Drive integration
description_zh: 使用智能工作流自动化Gmail——附件管理、邮件整理、自动归档与Google Drive集成

description: Develop a Base44 app remotely inside Base44's cloud sandbox using your own agent — no local checkout and no deploy/push commands. The implementation is remote: writing a resource file into the sandbox is what ships it (backend functions, realtime actors, entities, and agents all auto-sync from the file you write), and OAuth connectors are set up against the remote app via MCP tools or the projectless `base44 connectors` CLI. This skill is the place for learning what you can author in the sandbox, how backend functions, actors, entities, and agents are structured, and how to connect a connector without a local filesystem. Triggers on 'develop my Base44 app remotely', 'no local files', 'cloud sandbox', 'create an entity/agent remotely', 'add realtime/multiplayer/presence remotely', 'connect a connector remotely', 'bring my own agent', or any work editing a Base44 app inside a sandbox.
description_zh: 使用你自己的智能体在 Base44 的云沙箱中远程开发 Base44 应用——无需本地检出，也无需部署/推送命令。实现是远程的：将资源文件写入沙箱即是完成部署（后端函数、实时角色、实体和智能体都会从你写入的文件自动同步），并且通过 MCP 工具或无项目 `base44 connectors` 命令行工具，将 OAuth 连接器配置到远程应用上。本技能是学习在沙箱中可编写的内容、后端函数、角色、实体和智能体的结构，以及如何无需本地文件系统即可连接连接器的最佳场所。触发条件包括“远程开发我的 Base44 应用”、“无需本地文件”、“云沙箱”、“远程创建实体/智能体”、“远程添加实时/多人/在线存在功能”、“远程连接连接器”、“自带智能体”，或任何在沙箱内编辑 Base44 应用的工作。

description: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — creates, modifies, and advises on Aurora PostgreSQL clusters specifically (PostgreSQL-compatible engine, Aurora serverless, express configuration, pgvector, Babelfish). Trigger for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster operations, express-configuration quick-start, ACU sizing, I/O-Optimized storage, commitment pricing, or PostgreSQL upgrade planning. For Aurora MySQL, use amazon-aurora-mysql instead. Contains safety guardrails, express-first routing, and response templates that override defaults.
description_zh: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — 专门用于创建、修改及就 Aurora PostgreSQL 集群提供咨询（PostgreSQL 兼容引擎、Aurora 无服务器、快速配置、pgvector、Babelfish）。触发条件包括 Aurora PostgreSQL 集群操作、快速配置速览、ACU 容量规划、I/O 优化存储、承诺定价或 PostgreSQL 升级规划。针对 Aurora MySQL 请使用 amazon-aurora-mysql。包含安全防护机制、优先采用 Express 路由及可覆盖默认设置的自定义响应模板。

description: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.
description_zh: TypeScript 最佳实践。适用于阅读或编辑任何 .ts 或 .tsx 文件。

description: Type-safe routing for React and Solid applications with first-class search params, data loading, and seamless integration with the React ecosystem.
description_zh: 为 React 和 Solid 应用提供类型安全路由，支持一等搜索参数、数据加载，并与 React 生态系统无缝集成。

description: Structured content modeling guidance for schema design, content architecture, content reuse, references versus embedded objects, separation of concerns, and taxonomies across Sanity and other headless CMSes. Use this skill when designing or refactoring content types, deciding field shapes, debating reusable versus nested content, planning omnichannel content models, or reviewing whether a schema is too page-shaped or presentation-driven.
description_zh: 针对 Sanity 及其他无头 CMS 的结构化内容建模指导，涵盖模式设计、内容架构、内容复用、引用与内嵌对象、关注点分离及分类体系。当设计或重构内容类型、决定字段形状、讨论可复用与嵌套内容、规划全渠道内容模型，或审查模式是否过于页面化或呈现驱动时，使用此技能。

description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong visual direction, polished typography, considered layout, and working HTML/CSS/JS or framework code. Use for websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, application screens, and UI beautification.
description_zh: 打造独特、符合生产标准的前端界面，拥有明确的视觉方向、精致的排版、考究的布局，并提供可正常运行的 HTML/CSS/JS 或框架代码。适用于网站、落地页、仪表板、React 组件、应用屏幕及 UI 美化等场景。

description: Use this skill when rendering custom geometry in PixiJS v8. Covers Mesh with MeshGeometry (positions, uvs, indices, topology), MeshSimple for per-frame vertex animation, MeshPlane for subdivided deformation, MeshRope for path-following textures, PerspectiveMesh for 2.5D corners. Triggers on: Mesh, MeshGeometry, MeshSimple, MeshPlane, MeshRope, PerspectiveMesh, positions, uvs, indices, topology, setCorners, constructor options, MeshOptions, MeshPlaneOptions, MeshRopeOptions, SimpleMeshOptions, PerspectivePlaneOptions.
description_zh: 使用此技能可在 PixiJS v8 中渲染自定义几何体。涵盖 Mesh 与 MeshGeometry（positions、uvs、indices、topology）、用于逐帧顶点动画的 MeshSimple、用于细分变形的 MeshPlane、用于路径跟随纹理的 MeshRope，以及用于 2.5D 拐角的 PerspectiveMesh。触发条件：当出现 Mesh、MeshGeometry、MeshSimple、MeshPlane、MeshRope、PerspectiveMesh、positions、uvs、indices、topology、setCorners、constructor options、MeshOptions、MeshPlaneOptions、MeshRopeOptions、SimpleMeshOptions、PerspectivePlaneOptions 时触发。

description: Create professional diagrams using Mermaid, PlantUML, and other text-based diagram tools. Generate flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, and more.
description_zh: 使用 Mermaid、PlantUML 及其他基于文本的绘图工具创建专业图表。生成流程图、序列图、架构图等。

description: Builds, runs, debugs, and operates applications on AWS Lambda MicroVMs — Firecracker-isolated, snapshot-resumable serverless compute environments running inside a container with up to 8 hr lifetimes. Applicable when workloads need strong isolation between tenants, isolated serverless compute, sandbox compute, or secure multi-tenant execution. Also suited for AI/agent code-execution sandboxes, interactive code playgrounds and notebooks (Jupyter, REPLs, dev environments running user-supplied code), reinforcement-learning environments, multi-tenant CI executors and build runners, sessionful game or simulation servers, or isolated security scanners. Also applicable when the workload needs long-lived sessions, a real port-listening server (gRPC, WebSocket, custom TCP protocols), state preserved across periods of inactivity (suspend/resume), container-level access (FUSE, eBPF, custom syscalls), or session-affine routing.
description_zh: 基于 AWS Lambda 微虚拟机构建、运行、调试和部署应用——这类环境为无服务器计算环境，运行于容器内，最长可维持 8 小时寿命，采用 Firecracker 隔离并支持快照恢复。适用于需要租户间强隔离、隔离的无服务器计算、沙箱计算或安全多租户执行的工作负载。同样适用于 AI/智能体代码执行沙箱、交互式代码练习场与笔记本（Jupyter、REPL、运行用户提供的代码的开发环境）、强化学习环境、多租户 CI 执行器与构建运行器、具备会话功能的游戏或仿真服务器，以及隔离的安全扫描器。当工作负载需要长寿命会话、真实的端口监听服务器（gRPC、WebSocket、自定义 TCP 协议）、在闲置期间保存状态（挂起/恢复）、容器级访问（FUSE、eBPF、自定义系统调用），或会话亲和路由时，也适用。

description:
马斯克的思维操作系统。基于传记、播客、推文、法庭证词、决策记录和外部批评的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用马斯克的视角分析问题、审视决策、拆解成本结构、挑战行业假设。
当用户提到「用马斯克的视角」「马斯克会怎么看」「Musk模式」「马斯克perspective」「elon perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「这个成本合理吗」「从第一性原理想想」「白痴指数是多少」「五步算法」「能不能垂直整合」也可触发。
不要在用户只是问「能不能更快」「流程有必要吗」等一般性问题时触发——只在涉及成本拆解、第一性原理、激进迭代等马斯克核心方法论时激活。
description_zh:
马斯克的思维操作系统。基于传记、播客、推文、法庭证词、决策记录和外部批评的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。

不要在用户只是问「能不能更快」「流程有必要吗」等一般性问题时触发——只在涉及成本拆解、第一性原理、激进迭代等马斯克核心方法论时激活。

description: Queries S3 object metadata, tracks bucket activity, audits object changes, searches annotations, and analyzes storage metrics using S3 Metadata system tables (journal, inventory, annotation) and S3 Storage Lens tables via Athena SQL. Applies when counting objects, finding recent uploads or deletions, identifying who wrote to a prefix, breaking down storage classes, finding objects by tag, searching annotation content, analyzing storage lens metrics, or enabling S3 Metadata tracking. Prefers system tables over raw S3 APIs (list-objects-v2, head-object) at scale. Trigger phrases: bucket activity, object count, who uploaded, track deletions, storage class breakdown, find by tag, search annotations, storage lens metrics, audit bucket changes.
description_zh: 通过S3元数据系统表（日志、清单、注解）及S3 Storage Lens表，在Athena SQL中查询S3对象元数据、追踪桶活动、审计对象变更、搜索注解内容及分析存储指标。以下场景适用：统计对象数量、查找近期上传或删除、识别特定前缀的写入者、分解存储类型、按标签查找对象、搜索注解内容、分析存储Lens指标或启用S3元数据追踪。在规模化场景下，优先采用系统表而非原始S3 API（list-objects-v2、head-object）。触发短语：桶活动、对象数量、谁上传、追踪删除、存储类型分解、按标签查找、搜索注解、存储Lens指标、审计桶变更。

description: Convert HTML/Markdown to PowerPoint presentations using Marp
description_zh: 使用Marp将HTML/Markdown转换为PowerPoint演示文稿

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when creating evaluation datasets, uploading datasets to LangSmith, or managing existing datasets. Covers dataset types (final_response, single_step, trajectory, RAG), CLI management commands, SDK-based creation, and example management. Uses the langsmith CLI tool.
description_zh: 在创建评估数据集、将数据集上传到 LangSmith 或管理现有数据集时，调用此技能。涵盖数据集类型（final_response、single_step、trajectory、RAG）、CLI 管理命令、基于 SDK 的创建以及示例管理。使用 langsmith CLI 工具。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing Jakarta Bean Validation (JSR-380), including @Valid, @NotNull, @Min, @Max, @Email constraints with Hibernate Validator. Generates custom validator tests, constraint violation assertions, validation groups, and parameterized validation tests. Validates data integrity logic without Spring context. Use when writing validation tests, bean validation tests, or testing custom constraint validators.
description_zh: 提供结合 Hibernate Validator 用于 Jakarta Bean Validation（JSR-380）单元测试的模式，涵盖 @Valid、@NotNull、@Min、@Max、@Email 等约束。可生成自定义校验器测试、约束违规断言、校验分组以及参数化校验测试。无需 Spring 上下文即可验证数据完整性逻辑。适用于编写校验测试、Bean 校验测试或测试自定义约束校验器。

description: Build empowered product teams using discovery and delivery dual-track. Use when the user mentions "product discovery", "empowered teams", "feature factory", "opportunity assessment", "product vision", "product strategy", "what should we build", or "our roadmap is just a feature list". Also trigger when restructuring teams away from output-driven models, or deciding what to build next based on outcomes. Covers discovery techniques, team structure, opportunity assessment, vision/strategy, and continuous delivery. For customer interviews, see mom-test. For ongoing discovery systems, see continuous-discovery.
description_zh: 采用“发现与交付”双轨制，构建赋能的产品团队。当用户提到“产品发现”、“赋能团队”、“功能工厂”、“机会评估”、“产品愿景”、“产品策略”、“我们应该构建什么”或“我们的路线图仅仅是一份功能清单”时使用。当团队从以产出为导向的模式进行调整重构，或基于成果决定下一步构建内容时，也会触发。涵盖发现方法、团队结构、机会评估、愿景与策略以及持续交付。客户访谈相关内容，请参阅 mom-test；持续发现系统相关内容，请参阅 continuous-discovery。

description: Use when working with WP-CLI (wp) for WordPress operations: safe search-replace, db export/import, plugin/theme/user/content management, cron, cache flushing, multisite, and scripting/automation with wp-cli.yml.
description_zh: 在使用 WP-CLI (wp) 进行 WordPress 操作时使用：安全的搜索替换、数据库导出/导入、插件/主题/用户/内容管理、cron 定时任务、缓存刷新、多站点，以及使用 wp-cli.yml 进行脚本化与自动化。

description: Write the canonical engineering record of a fixed bug — root cause, mechanism, fix, validation, and how it slipped through. Engineer-audience, code identifiers welcome. Use after a debug session lands a fix, before closing the ticket. Trigger on /post-mortem, when the user says "write the post-mortem / postmortem / RCA / root cause analysis", "document this fix", "write up the root cause", "close out this bug with a writeup", or hands you a fixed-and-validated bug and asks for the writeup.
description_zh: 撰写已修复缺陷的规范工程记录，内容包括根本原因、发生机制、修复方案、验证结果，以及该缺陷是如何漏网的。面向工程师撰写，欢迎包含代码标识符。在调试定位到修复方案、关闭工单之前使用。触发条件为 /post-mortem，当用户说“撰写事后总结 / postmortem / RCA / 根本原因分析”、“记录本次修复”、“撰写根本原因说明”、“用总结提交关闭此缺陷”，或提交一个已修复并经过验证的缺陷并要求撰写总结时。

description: Guides migration, provisioning, search, log-analytics, trace-analytics, and Agentic AI Assistant workflows for Amazon OpenSearch Service and Serverless across six capabilities — migration (Solr/ES/self-managed into AOS/AOSS, schema/query translation, sizing, cutover); provisioning (domain + AOSS lifecycle, upgrades, FGAC, monitoring); search (vector / semantic / hybrid / RAG with Bedrock); log-analytics (PPL, OSI, anomaly detection, Dashboards); trace-analytics (OTel spans, service maps, Data Prepper); ai-assistant (natural language data exploration, incident investigation, root cause analysis). Triggers on OpenSearch, AOS, AOSS, Elasticsearch, Solr, vector/k-NN/semantic/hybrid search, RAG, log analytics, PPL, trace analytics, ISM, FAISS, HNSW, Migration Assistant, UltraWarm, OR1, query my data, analyze logs, investigate errors, root cause analysis.
description_zh:
为Amazon OpenSearch Service和Serverless的六大能力——迁移、配置、搜索、日志分析、链路分析与智能体AI助手工作流提供指南：迁移（Solr/ES/自管理环境迁移至AOS/AOSS，模式/查询翻译，容量规划，上线切换）；配置（域名与AOSS生命周期管理，升级，FGAC，监控）；搜索（配合Bedrock的向量/语义/混合/RAG搜索）；日志分析（PPL、OSI、异常检测、仪表板）；链路分析（OTel跨度、服务映射、Data Prepper）；AI助手（自然语言数据探索、事件调查、根因分析）。

触发内容包括：OpenSearch、AOS、AOSS、Elasticsearch、Solr、向量/k-NN/语义/混合搜索、RAG、日志分析、PPL、链路分析、ISM、FAISS、HNSW、迁移助手、UltraWarm、OR1、查询我的数据、分析日志、排查错误、根因分析。

description:
Query Ondo tokenized US stock data on Binance Web3.
Covers: supported stock token list, RWA metadata (company info, attestation reports),
market and per-asset trading status (with corporate action codes for earnings, dividends, splits),
real-time on-chain data (token price, holders, circulating supply, market cap),
US stock fundamentals (P/E, dividend yield, 52-week range), and token K-Line/candlestick charts.

Use this skill when users ask about:
- Tokenized stock price, holders, or on-chain data for specific tickers
- Whether a stock token is tradable, paused, or halted
- Ondo RWA token list or which US stocks are available on-chain
- Corporate actions affecting a token (dividends, stock splits, earnings halt)
- Stock token K-Line or candlestick chart data
- Comparing on-chain token price vs US stock price

NOT for general crypto tokens (BTC, ETH, SOL, etc.) — use query-token-info for those.
description_zh:
**查询在 Binance Web3 平台上基于 Ondo 的美国股票代币数据。**

**覆盖内容：**
- 支持的股票代币列表、RWA 元数据（公司信息、认证报告），
- 市场及单个资产的交易状态（包含财报、分红、拆股等企业行为代码），
- 链上实时数据（代币价格、持有者、流通量、市值），
- 美国股票基本面（市盈率（P/E）、股息率、52周价格区间），以及代币 K-Line/K 线图。

**当用户询问以下内容时，请使用本技能：**
- 特定代币的股票价格、持有者或链上数据
- 某只股票代币是否可交易、已暂停或已停牌
- Ondo RWA 代币列表或哪些美国股票可在链上交易
- 影响代币的企业行为（分红、拆股、财报停牌）
- 股票代币 K-Line 或 K 线图数据
- 对比链上代币价格与美股价格

description: Write Python in n8n Code nodes (native Python, `language` pythonNative, n8n 2.x). Use when the user explicitly wants Python in a Code node, when migrating old Pyodide/"Python (Beta)" code that used _input/_json/_node/_now, or when a Python Code node fails with NameError, "Security violations detected", "Import of standard library module … is disallowed", "__build_class__ not found", "A 'json' property isn't a dictionary", or "Python runner unavailable". Covers the only two variables (_items/_item), dict-only access, imports blocked by default, the sandbox's denied builtins, accepted return shapes, and how errors interact with onError. JavaScript is the default for Code nodes — native Python has no n8n helpers and, by default, no imports. EXCEPTION — for Python in the AI-agent-callable Custom Code Tool (@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.toolCode), use the n8n-code-tool skill instead (input is _query, return must be a string).
