description: Slack automation and workflow builder - notifications, standup bots, approval flows, and cross-platform integrations
description_zh: Slack 自动化与工作流构建器——通知、站会机器人、审批流程及跨平台集成

description: Generate and validate Apex test classes with TestDataFactory patterns, bulk testing (251+ records), mocking strategies, assertion best practices, and disciplined test-fix loops. Use this skill when creating new Apex test classes, improving test coverage, debugging and fixing failing Apex tests, running test execution and coverage analysis, or implementing testing patterns for triggers, services, controllers, batch jobs, queueables, and integrations. Triggers on *Test.cls, *_Test.cls files, sf apex run test workflows, coverage reports, test-fix loops. Do NOT trigger for production Apex code (use generating-apex) or Jest/LWC tests.
description_zh: 生成并验证采用 TestDataFactory 模式、批量测试（251+ 条记录）、Mock 策略、断言最佳实践以及规范的测试修复循环的 Apex 测试类。当创建新的 Apex 测试类、提升测试覆盖率、调试和修复失败的 Apex 测试、运行测试执行与覆盖率分析，或为触发器、服务、控制器、批处理作业、队列任务和集成实现测试模式时，使用此技能。触发条件包括 *Test.cls、*_Test.cls 文件、sf apex run test 工作流、覆盖率报告和测试修复循环。请勿用于生产环境 Apex 代码（请使用 generating-apex）或 Jest/LWC 测试。

description: Data pipeline and ETL automation - extract, transform, load workflows for data integration and analytics
description_zh: 数据管道与ETL自动化 - 提取、转换、加载工作流，用于数据集成与分析

description: Defines service level objectives, creates error budget policies, designs incident response procedures, develops capacity models, and produces monitoring configurations and automation scripts for production systems. Use when defining SLIs/SLOs, managing error budgets, building reliable systems at scale, incident management, chaos engineering, toil reduction, or capacity planning.
description_zh: 定义服务等级目标，制定错误预算策略，设计事件响应流程，开发容量模型，并为生产系统生成监控配置与自动化脚本。适用于定义SLIs/SLOs、管理错误预算、构建大规模可靠系统、事件管理、混沌工程、减少冗余工作或容量规划。

description: 面向本地知识库目录的检索和问答助手。核心流程：(1)分层索引导航 (2)遇到PDF/Excel时必须先读取references学习处理方法 (3)处理文件后再检索。按文件类型组合使用 grep、Read、pdfplumber、pandas 进行渐进式检索，避免整文件加载。用户问题涉及"从知识库目录回答问题/检索信息/查资料"时使用。
description_zh: 面向本地知识库目录的检索和问答助手。核心流程：(1)分层索引导航；(2)遇到PDF/Excel时，必须先读取references并学习处理方法；(3)处理文件后再检索。按文件类型组合使用grep、Read、pdfplumber、pandas进行渐进式检索，避免整文件加载。用户问题涉及“从知识库目录回答问题/检索信息/查资料”时使用。

description: Use for the OSS repository map, code-layer lookup, apps/packages/src ownership and business stubs.
description_zh: 适用于 OSS 仓库映射、代码层查找、apps/packages/src 所有权及业务桩。

description: Configure human-in-the-loop gating for AI agent review actions in Claude Code. Use when setting up a project where an agent may post PR reviews, comments, merges, or edit CI configuration, and you want a cryptographically auditable approval trail with Cedar-enforced gates.
description_zh: 在 Claude Code 中配置 AI agent 评审动作的人工在环门控。适用于设置项目时：agent 可能提交 PR 评审、评论、合并或修改 CI 配置，同时需要可密码学审计的审批轨迹，并由 Cedar 强制执行门控。

description: Use when you need a deterministic inspection of a WordPress repository (plugin/theme/block theme/WP core/Gutenberg/full site) including tooling/tests/version hints, and a structured JSON report to guide workflows and guardrails.
description_zh: 当您需要对 WordPress 代码仓库（插件/主题/块主题/WP 核心/Gutenberg/完整站点）进行确定性检查时使用，包括检查工具/测试/版本提示，并提供结构化 JSON 报告以指导工作流与护栏。

description: Prometheus and Grafana Cloud Metrics overview including PromQL query language, Metrics Drilldown, alerting, recording rules, and integration patterns. Use when working with Prometheus, writing PromQL queries, configuring alerting, or discussing metrics architecture and best practices.
description_zh: Prometheus 与 Grafana Cloud 指标概述，涵盖 PromQL 查询语言、指标下钻、告警、记录规则及集成模式。适用于与 Prometheus 协作、编写 PromQL 查询、配置告警，或探讨指标架构与最佳实践的场景。

description: UI/UX best practices for web interfaces. Use when reviewing animations, CSS, audio, typography, UX patterns, prefetching, or icon implementations. Covers 11 categories from animation principles to typography. Outputs file:line findings.
description_zh: 网页界面 UI/UX 最佳实践。用于审查动画、CSS、音频、排版、UX 模式、预加载或图标实现。涵盖从动画原则到排版的 11 个类别。输出文件:行号发现。

description: Use when building .NET 8 applications with minimal APIs, clean architecture, or cloud-native microservices. Invoke for Entity Framework Core, CQRS with MediatR, JWT authentication, AOT compilation.
description_zh: 适用于构建使用最小化 API、清晰架构或云原生微服务的 .NET 8 应用程序。适用于 Entity Framework Core、使用 MediatR 的 CQRS、JWT 认证及 AOT 编译。

description: Build an Android app on a remote Gradle sandbox with `lim gradle build` instead of local Gradle or Android Studio, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use when the user wants to build an APK or AAB, sign a release with an upload key, prepare a Play Store publish, inspect build logs, or select sandbox tools and run shell commands, for native Android projects, React Native, and Expo. To run, tap, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the built APK on an emulator, use limrun-android-emulator. For iOS builds, use limrun-xcode or limrun-expo-development.
description_zh: 在任意环境（Linux、Windows、macOS、虚拟机、容器）中，使用 `lim gradle build` 在远程 Gradle 沙箱中构建安卓应用，而无需使用本地 Gradle 或 Android Studio。适用于用户需要构建 APK 或 AAB、使用上传密钥对发行版本进行签名、准备 Play 商店发布、检查构建日志，或选择沙箱工具并执行 shell 命令的情况，支持原生安卓项目、React Native 和 Expo。如需在模拟器上运行、点击、截图或与其他方式与构建好的 APK 进行交互，请使用 limrun-android-emulator。进行 iOS 构建时，请使用 limrun-xcode 或 limrun-expo-development。

description: HR workflow automation - recruiting, onboarding, employee management, and offboarding processes
description_zh: 人力资源工作流自动化——招聘、入职、员工管理与离职流程

description: Routes any task involving AWS databases — choosing, comparing, recommending, getting started with, or operating a database — to the correct service-specific skill. Supersedes general training-data knowledge with post-training service updates, corrected limitations, and decision procedures for relational (Aurora, DSQL, RDS), key-value (DynamoDB), wide-column (Keyspaces), document (DocumentDB), graph (Neptune), time-series (Timestream), and in-memory/caching (ElastiCache, MemoryDB) workloads. Activates when a user describes building an application on AWS that will store, retrieve, or manage data, even if they do not mention 'database' explicitly.
description_zh: 将任何涉及AWS数据库的任务——包括选择、比较、推荐、入门操作或管理数据库——路由至正确的特定服务技能。以训练后服务更新、修正后的限制说明及决策流程取代通用的训练数据知识，针对关系型（Aurora、DSQL、RDS）、键值型（DynamoDB）、宽列型（Keyspaces）、文档型（DocumentDB）、图型（Neptune）、时序型（Timestream）以及内存型/缓存型（ElastiCache、MemoryDB）工作负载。当用户描述在AWS上构建将存储、获取或管理数据的应用程序时触发，即使用户未明确提及“数据库”。

description: Guides building full-stack applications with AWS Blocks — an Infrastructure-from-Code framework. Applies when creating APIs, selecting Building Blocks (KVStore, DistributedTable, Database, AuthBasic, AuthCognito, Realtime, AsyncJob, FileBucket, etc.), running local development, or deploying AWS Blocks applications. Also covers AWS Blocks topics with validated, version-specific patterns that prevent common mistakes. Triggers when user mentions AWS Blocks; project has aws-blocks/ directory; code imports @aws-blocks packages.
description_zh: 使用 AWS Blocks 构建全栈应用的指南——一种从代码生成基础设施的框架。在创建 API、选择 Building Blocks（KVStore、DistributedTable、Database、AuthBasic、AuthCognito、Realtime、AsyncJob、FileBucket 等）、进行本地开发或部署 AWS Blocks 应用时适用。此外，还涵盖 AWS Blocks 相关主题，其中包含经过验证且针对不同版本的模式，可防止常见错误。当用户提到 AWS Blocks；项目包含 aws-blocks/ 目录；代码导入 @aws-blocks 包时触发。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to design or implement caching in a Next.js 16+ App Router project — setting up the "use cache" directive, building a cache tag registry, wiring mutations to invalidation utilities, structuring Suspense boundaries for partial prerendering, handling personalized content near cache boundaries, choosing cacheLife profiles, calling cacheTag / updateTag / revalidateTag correctly, migrating from unstable_cache, or debugging stale or incorrectly fresh data. Trigger even when the user only describes their domain (e.g. "I have a posts table") and asks how to cache it properly.
description_zh: 当用户希望在Next.js 16+ App Router项目中设计或实现缓存时，请使用此技能——包括设置"use cache"指令、构建缓存标签注册表、将变更与失效工具关联、为部分预渲染构建Suspense边界、处理缓存边界处的个性化内容、选择cacheLife配置方案、正确调用cacheTag / updateTag / revalidateTag、从unstable_cache迁移，以及调试过期或不正确新鲜的数据。即使用户仅描述了其领域需求（例如："我有一个帖子表"）并询问如何正确缓存，也应当触发本技能。

description: Call the Recoup API and external connectors directly — fetch any platform resource (artists, socials, organizations, research, documents) and run connector actions (Google Docs/Sheets/Drive edits, Gmail, TikTok, Instagram). Use whenever you need raw Recoup data, a platform resource, to write curl against api.recoupable.dev, or to read/write something outside Recoup like a Google Doc URL or a spreadsheet. The plumbing every other skill rides on. To onboard or operate on an artist use the recoup-roster-* skills; for first-run connection use recoup-platform-connect-account.
description_zh: 直接调用 Recoup API 与外部连接器——获取任意平台资源（艺术家、社交平台、组织、研究、文档），并执行连接器操作（Google Docs/Sheets/Drive 编辑、Gmail、TikTok、Instagram）。无论您需要获取原始 Recoup 数据、平台资源、针对 api.recoupable.dev 编写 curl 命令，还是需要读写 Recoup 之外的内容（如 Google Doc 网址或电子表格），均可使用。这是所有其他技能所依赖的底层基础设施。如需为新艺术家进行入职操作或在艺术家处开展运营，请使用 recoup-roster-* 技能；首次连接时请使用 recoup-platform-connect-account。

description: Competitive analysis two ways - the in-deal play against a named competitor, and win/loss patterns, competitor mentions, and battlecards across the book. Use when the user asks "competitive intel", "research competitors", "how do we compare to [competitor]", "what's new with [competitor]", "battlecard for [competitor]", "how do we beat [competitor]", "what's the play against [competitor] in [deal]", "where are we losing to [competitor]", "win/loss patterns", "competitive analysis", "refresh the battlecards", or on a weekly schedule.
description_zh: 竞争分析有两种方式——针对特定竞争对手的交易中应对策略，以及胜负模式、竞争对手提及和全书中的战役卡片。当用户询问“竞争情报”、“研究竞争对手”、“我们如何与[竞争对手]进行比较？”、“[竞争对手]有什么新动态？”、“[竞争对手]的战役卡片”、“我们如何击败[竞争对手]？”、“在[交易]中，针对[竞争对手]的应对策略是什么？”、“我们是在哪些方面输给[竞争对手]？”、“胜负模式”、“竞争分析”、“刷新战役卡片”，或按每周安排时，使用此功能。

description: Three-layer verification pipeline for AI output. Extracts verifiable claims, finds supporting or contradicting sources via web search, runs adversarial review for hallucination patterns, and produces a structured verification report with source links for human review.
description_zh: 面向AI输出的三层验证流水线。提取可验证的论断，通过网页搜索查找支持性或反驳性来源，针对幻觉模式进行对抗性审查，并生成包含来源链接的结构化验证报告，供人工审查。

description: Generate complete presentations with AI - from outline to polished slides
description_zh: 使用AI生成完整演示文稿：从大纲到精致幻灯片的全方位制作

description: Edit HWP documents — insert/delete text, replace-all, create tables, set cell text — with the k-skill-rhwp CLI that wraps the @rhwp/core WASM engine (rhwp by Edward Kim).
description_zh: 编辑 HWP 文档 —— 插入/删除文本、全部替换、创建表格、设置单元格文本 —— 使用 k-skill-rhwp CLI（封装 @rhwp/core WASM 引擎，由 Edward Kim 开发的 rhwp）。

description: Activate when developers have latent caching needs: slow API responses, database read bottlenecks, DynamoDB throttling or cost, RDS/Aurora scaling pressure, Bedrock latency or cost, or adding a cache; activate when working with Redis, Valkey, Memcached, or any in-memory data store, cache-aside patterns, session stores, rate limiting, leaderboards, counters, streams, queues, pub/sub, distributed locks, feature flags, shopping carts, or other caching strategies. Activate for GenAI and ML retrieval: vector similarity search for low-latency retrieval, semantic caching, RAG, LLM response caching, embedding stores, AI agent memory, recommendation, personalization. Activate for ElastiCache lifecycle: provisioning (serverless or node-based), engine selection, CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform IaC, VPC connectivity, TLS, RBAC, IAM auth, Global Datastore, monitoring, troubleshooting, cost optimization, and migration from self-managed Redis. Do not trigger for browser caches, CDN/CloudFront, HTTP Cache-Control, CPU caches.
description_zh: 在开发人员存在潜在缓存需求时激活：如API响应缓慢、数据库读取瓶颈、DynamoDB限流或成本问题、RDS/Aurora扩展压力、Bedrock延迟或成本，或需要添加缓存；当使用Redis、Valkey、Memcached或任何内存数据存储、cache-aside模式、会话存储、限流、排行榜、计数器、流、队列、发布/订阅、分布式锁、功能开关、购物车或其他缓存策略时，激活；为GenAI和ML检索激活：用于低延迟检索的向量相似度搜索、语义缓存、RAG、LLM响应缓存、嵌入存储、AI代理记忆、推荐、个性化。为ElastiCache生命周期激活：配置（无服务器或基于节点的）、引擎选择、CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform基础设施即代码(IaC)、VPC连接、TLS、基于角色的访问控制(RBAC)、IAM身份验证、Global Datastore、监控、故障排除、成本优化，以及从自管Redis迁移。不要因浏览器缓存、CDN/CloudFront、HTTP Cache-Control、CPU缓存而触发。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
description_zh: 创建有效技能的指南。此技能应在用户希望创建新技能（或更新现有技能）时使用，以通过专业知识、工作流或工具集成扩展 Claude 的能力。

description: Generate comprehensive test plans, manual test cases, regression test suites, and bug reports for QA engineers. Includes Figma MCP integration for design validation.
description_zh: 生成面向 QA 工程师的综合测试计划、手动测试用例、回归测试套件及 bug 报告。包含用于设计验证的 Figma MCP 集成。

description: Rails 7+ specialist that optimizes Active Record queries with includes/eager_load, implements Turbo Frames and Turbo Streams for partial page updates, configures Action Cable for WebSocket connections, sets up Sidekiq workers for background job processing, and writes comprehensive RSpec test suites. Use when building Rails 7+ web applications with Hotwire, real-time features, or background job processing. Invoke for Active Record optimization, Turbo Frames/Streams, Action Cable, Sidekiq, RSpec Rails.
description_zh: Rails 7+ 专家，通过 includes/eager_load（预加载）优化 Active Record 查询，实现用于页面局部更新的 Turbo Frames 和 Turbo Streams，为 WebSocket 连接配置 Action Cable，设置 Sidekiq 工作进程用于后台任务处理，并编写全面的 RSpec 测试套件。当构建使用 Hotwire、实时功能或后台任务处理的 Rails 7+ Web 应用程序时使用。用于 Active Record 优化、Turbo Frames/Streams、Action Cable、Sidekiq、RSpec Rails 等场景。

description: Build AI agents with tools, memory, and multi-step reasoning - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini integration patterns
Automate document workflows with n8n - 7800+ workflow templates
description_zh: 使用n8n自动化文档工作流 - 7800+个工作流模板

description: Design robust, scalable database schemas for SQL and NoSQL databases. Provides normalization guidelines, indexing strategies, migration patterns, constraint design, and performance optimization. Ensures data integrity, query performance, and maintainable data models.
description_zh: 为SQL和NoSQL数据库设计健壮、可扩展的数据库模式。提供规范化指南、索引策略、迁移模式、约束设计及性能优化。确保数据完整性、查询性能以及可维护的数据模型。

description: Automate audio/video transcription, meeting notes, subtitle generation, and content processing
description_zh: 实现音频/视频转写、会议记录、字幕生成及内容处理的自动化

description: Foodora-only CLI for checking past orders and active order status (Deliveroo WIP).
description_zh: 仅限 Foodora 的 CLI，用于查询历史订单和进行中订单状态（Deliveroo WIP）。

description: Use this skill when adding screen reader and keyboard navigation to PixiJS v8 apps. Covers AccessibilitySystem options (enabledByDefault, debug, activateOnTab, deactivateOnMouseMove), per-container accessibility properties, shadow DOM overlay, mobile touch-hook activation. Triggers on: accessibility, a11y, screen reader, ARIA, keyboard navigation, tab order, AccessibilitySystem, accessibleTitle, accessibleHint, tabIndex, accessibleChildren.
description_zh: 为 PixiJS v8 应用添加屏幕阅读器与键盘导航功能时，使用此技能。涵盖 AccessibilitySystem 选项（enabledByDefault、debug、activateOnTab、deactivateOnMouseMove）、容器级无障碍属性、Shadow DOM 覆盖层及移动端触摸钩子激活。触发关键词：accessibility、a11y、screen reader、ARIA、keyboard navigation、tab order、AccessibilitySystem、accessibleTitle、accessibleHint、tabIndex 和 accessibleChildren。

description: Use for every request to commit changes or draft a commit message. Creates Sentry-style conventional commits with issue references.
description_zh: 用于每次请求提交更改或草拟提交信息时。创建带有问题引用的Sentry风格规范提交。

description: Use this skill to bridge tokens, cross-chain swap/transfer, move assets between chains, get cross-chain quotes, compare bridge fees, find the cheapest/fastest route, build bridge calldata, check bridge status, track a cross-chain transaction, list supported chains or bridge protocols, or when the user mentions bridging ETH/USDC/tokens from one chain (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, etc.) to another. Routes through multiple bridge protocols (Stargate, Across, Relay, Gas.zip) for optimal execution. One-shot execute: a single confirmed call approves (if needed), waits for on-chain confirmation, swaps, and broadcasts. Supports fee comparison, destination address specification, and full lifecycle status tracking until fund arrival.
description_zh:
使用此技能进行代币跨链桥接、跨链兑换/转账、在链间转移资产、获取跨链报价、比较桥接费用、寻找最便宜/最快的路径、生成桥接调用数据、检查桥接状态、跟踪跨链交易、列出支持的链或桥接协议；当用户提及从一条链（以太坊、BSC、Polygon、Arbitrum、Base、Optimism 等）向另一条链跨链桥接 ETH/USDC/代币时亦可使用。通过多个桥接协议（Stargate、Across、Relay、Gas.zip）执行，以实现最佳执行效果。

一键执行：单个确认的调用（如需要）即进行批准，等待链上确认，完成兑换并广播。支持费用比较、目标地址指定，以及直至资金到达的全生命周期状态跟踪。

description: Notion database automation - sync, templates, workflows, and cross-platform integrations
description_zh: Notion 数据库自动化 - 同步、模板、工作流与跨平台集成

description: Expert Next.js performance optimization skill covering Core Web Vitals, image/font optimization, caching strategies, streaming, bundle optimization, and Server Components best practices. Use when optimizing Next.js applications for Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), implementing next/image and next/font, configuring caching with unstable_cache and revalidateTag, converting Client Components to Server Components, implementing Suspense streaming, or analyzing and reducing bundle size. Supports Next.js 16 + React 19 patterns.
description_zh: Next.js 性能优化专家级技能，涵盖核心网页指标（Core Web Vitals）、图像与字体优化、缓存策略、流式传输、打包优化及服务端组件最佳实践。适用于优化 Next.js 应用以提升核心网页指标（LCP、INP、CLS）、实现 next/image 与 next/font、配置 unstable_cache 与 revalidateTag 缓存、将客户端组件转换为服务端组件、实施 Suspense 流式传输，或分析并缩减打包体积的场景。支持 Next.js 16 与 React 19 模式。

description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件的自动化语义化版本控制与发布工作流。负责在 package.json、marketplace.json、plugin.json 清单文件中进行版本递增、构建验证、Git 打标签、GitHub 发布及变更日志生成。NPM 发布（以便 `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` 能够正常解析）交由人工维护者处理，该维护者负责 NPM 安全相关事宜。

description: 네이버 쇼핑 공개 BFF JSON을 k-skill-proxy로 조회해 상품 후보, 최저가, 판매처 링크를 보수적으로 가격비교한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过k-skill-proxy查询Naver购物公开的BFF JSON，以保守的方式对商品候选、最低价、销售方链接进行价格比较。在轮盘游戏中，通过官方界面进行的后续行动也将进行到底。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to convert text into speech, generate audio from text, or produce voiceovers. Triggers include: any mention of 'TTS', 'text to speech', 'speak', 'say', 'voice', 'read aloud', 'audio narration', 'voiceover', 'dubbing', or requests to turn written content into spoken audio. Also use when converting EPUB/PDF/SRT/articles to audio, cloning voices from reference audio, controlling emotion or speed in speech, aligning speech to subtitle timelines, or producing per-segment voice-mapped audio.
description_zh: 当用户希望将文本转换为语音、从文本生成音频或生成旁白时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：任何提及'TTS'、'文本转语音'、'speak'、'say'、'voice'、'read aloud'、'audio narration'、'voiceover'、'dubbing'，或要求将书面内容转为口语音频的请求。此外，当将EPUB/PDF/SRT/文章转换为音频、从参考音频克隆声音、控制语音的情感或速度、将语音与字幕时间轴对齐，或制作分段语音映射音频时，也请使用此技能。

description: SEO strategy and optimization - keyword research, on-page SEO, technical audits, content optimization, and rank tracking
description_zh: SEO 策略与优化：关键词研究、页面内 SEO、技术审计、内容优化及排名追踪

description:
Binance Onchain Pay enables users to buy cryptocurrency with fiat (e.g., EUR, USD) or send existing crypto from their Binance account directly to any external on-chain wallet address in a single flow—no manual withdrawal needed.

Enables partners to integrate crypto buying services:
- payment-method-list: Get available payment methods (Card, P2P, Google Pay, Apple Pay, etc.) with limits for a fiat/crypto pair
- trading-pairs: List all supported fiat currencies and cryptocurrencies
- estimated-quote: Get real-time price quote including exchange rate, fees, and estimated crypto amount
- pre-order: Create a buy order and get redirect URL to Binance payment flow
- order: Query order status and details (processing, completed, failed, etc.)
- crypto-network: Get supported blockchain networks with withdraw fees and limits
- p2p/trading-pairs: List P2P-specific trading pairs
description_zh:
Binance Onchain Pay 使用户能够以法币（例如 EUR、USD）购买加密货币，或一次性从其 Binance 账户向任何外部链上钱包地址发送现有加密货币——无需手动提现。

它使合作伙伴能够集成加密货币购买服务：
- payment-method-list：获取针对法币/加密货币交易对的可用支付方式（银行卡、P2P、Google Pay、Apple Pay 等）及其限额
- trading-pairs：列出所有支持的法币货币和加密货币
- estimated-quote：获取实时价格报价，包括汇率、手续费和估算的加密货币金额
- pre-order：创建买入订单并获取跳转至 Binance 支付流程的 URL
- order：查询订单状态和详情（处理中、已完成、失败等）
- crypto-network：获取支持的区块链网络及其提现手续费和限额
- p2p/trading-pairs：列出 P2P 专属交易对

description: Use when writing prose humans will read—documentation, commit messages, error messages, explanations, reports, or UI text. Applies Strunk's timeless rules for clearer, stronger, more professional writing.
description_zh: 用于撰写供人阅读的文本——文档、提交信息、错误消息、解释、报告或用户界面文本。遵循斯特伦克永恒的写作规则，以实现更清晰、更有力、更专业的写作。

description: Analyze a codebase to produce an interactive knowledge graph for understanding architecture, components, and relationships
description_zh: 分析代码库，生成用于理解架构、组件和关系的交互式知识图谱。

description: Answer questions about PDF content, summarize, and extract information
description_zh: 解答关于PDF内容的疑问，进行总结，并提取信息

description: Batch convert documents between multiple formats using a unified pipeline
description_zh: 使用统一流水线批量在不同格式之间转换文档

description: Configure delegation fleet lanes: which implementer CLI handles which kind of work, with optional model and effort (or variant) dials. Discovers installed CLIs, proposes a lane map for user approval, and writes global or project config only after explicit yes. Use when the user asks to set up, configure, or reconfigure delegation lanes, a fleet of lanes, or which implementer handles feature/tests/ui work — not for dispatching a coding task to an implementer.
description_zh: 配置委派车队通道：定义哪个实施者CLI负责处理何种类型的工作，并包含可选的模型、工作量（或变体）调节项。该功能用于发现已安装的CLI，为用户批准提议通道映射，仅在获得明确确认后才会写入全局或项目配置。适用于用户请求设置、配置或重新配置委派通道、车队通道，或指定哪个实施者负责功能、测试、界面工作的场景；不可用于向实施者派发编码任务。

description: Generate Mermaid diagrams (.mmd) and export to PNG/SVG/PDF using mmdc CLI or Kroki API. USE THIS SKILL when user mentions diagram, flowchart, sequence diagram, class diagram, ER diagram, state machine, architecture, visualize, git graph, 画图, 架构图, 流程图, 时序图. PROACTIVELY USE when explaining ANY system with 3+ components, API flows, authentication sequences, class hierarchies, database schemas, or state machines. Supports 11+ diagram types with fully automatic layout.
description_zh: 使用 mmdc CLI 或 Kroki API 生成 Mermaid 图（.mmd）并导出为 PNG/SVG/PDF。当用户提到图、流程图、时序图、类图、ER 图、状态机、架构、可视化、git 图、画图、架构图、流程图、时序图时，使用本技能。当解释任何包含 3 个及以上组件、API 流程、认证时序、类继承、数据库模式或状态机的系统时，主动使用本技能。支持 11 种及以上图类型，并具备完全自动布局。

description: Designs and implements production-grade RAG systems by chunking documents, generating embeddings, configuring vector stores, building hybrid search pipelines, applying reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality. Use when building RAG systems, vector databases, or knowledge-grounded AI applications requiring semantic search, document retrieval, context augmentation, similarity search, or embedding-based indexing.
description_zh: 设计并实现生产级RAG系统，通过对文档进行分块、生成嵌入向量、配置向量存储、构建混合搜索流水线、应用重排序并评估检索质量。适用于构建RAG系统、向量数据库，或需具备语义搜索、文档检索、上下文增强、相似度搜索或基于嵌入索引的知识支撑型AI应用。

description: Process multiple documents in bulk with parallel execution
description_zh: 批量并行处理多份文档

description: Configures CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeConnections, and CodeArtifact. Covers CodePipeline V2 (triggers, variables, execution modes, cross-account), buildspec.yml (caching, VPC, Docker), CodeDeploy strategies (blue/green, canary, linear), CodeArtifact (private package registries, auth tokens, cross-account), and source connections (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket). Applies when CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeConnections, CodeArtifact, buildspec.yml, appspec.yml, or CI/CD pipeline orchestration is referenced. Does NOT cover: ECS Fargate services or task definitions (use aws-containers), CDK Pipelines or cdk deploy (use aws-cdk), sam deploy (use aws-serverless), Amplify deployments (use aws-amplify), or GitHub Actions/GitLab CI.
description_zh: 使用 AWS CodePipeline、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodeConnections 和 CodeArtifact 来配置 CI/CD 流水线。涵盖 CodePipeline V2（触发器、变量、执行模式、跨账户）、buildspec.yml（缓存、VPC、Docker）、CodeDeploy 策略（蓝绿、金丝雀、线性）、CodeArtifact（私有包仓库、身份验证令牌、跨账户）以及源连接（GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket）。在引用 CodePipeline、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodeConnections、CodeArtifact、buildspec.yml、appspec.yml 或 CI/CD 流水线编排时适用。不包括：ECS Fargate 服务或任务定义（使用 aws-containers）、CDK Pipelines 或 cdk deploy（使用 aws-cdk）、sam deploy（使用 aws-serverless）、Amplify 部署（使用 aws-amplify）以及 GitHub Actions/GitLab CI。

description: Formulate effective web search queries, analyze search results, and synthesize findings. Optimize search strategies for different types of information needs.
description_zh: 制定有效的网络搜索查询，分析搜索结果，并综合提炼发现。针对不同类型的信息需求，优化搜索策略。

description: Interactively discovers requirements and designs holistic, multi-product system architectures, solution blueprints, and deployment recommendations for complex workloads on Google Cloud. Use when designing end-to-end cloud solutions, selecting and integrating Google Cloud services, generating architecture diagrams, or conducting requirements discovery for new cloud workloads or migrations. Don't use for single-product tasks (use product-specific skills), initial onboarding or authentication (use google-cloud-recipe-*), Well-Architected Framework reviews or audits (use google-cloud-waf-*), or workloads covered by specialized solution skills.
description_zh: 交互式发现需求，设计针对 Google Cloud 上复杂工作负载的整体化、多产品系统架构、解决方案蓝图及部署建议。适用于设计端到端云解决方案、选择并集成 Google Cloud 服务、生成架构图，或针对新云工作负载或迁移开展需求发现。不适用于单产品任务（使用产品特定技能）、初始接入或身份认证（使用 google-cloud-recipe-*）、Well-Architected Framework 审查或审计（使用 google-cloud-waf-*），或使用专门解决方案技能覆盖的工作负载。

description: Shopify e-commerce automation - inventory management, order processing, customer workflows, and analytics
description_zh: Shopify 电商自动化 - 库存管理、订单处理、客户工作流程和分析

description: Internationalization and localization patterns. Detecting hardcoded strings, managing translations, locale files, RTL support.
description_zh: 国际化与本地化模式。检测硬编码字符串，管理翻译、区域设置文件及RTL支持。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
description_zh: 创建有效技能指南。当用户希望创建新技能（或更新现有技能），以借助专业化知识、工作流或工具集成扩展 Codex 的能力时，应使用本技能。

description: Designs cloud architectures, creates migration plans, generates cost optimization recommendations, and produces disaster recovery strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Use when designing cloud architectures, planning migrations, or optimizing multi-cloud deployments. Invoke for Well-Architected Framework, cost optimization, disaster recovery, landing zones, security architecture, serverless design.
description_zh: 在 AWS、Azure 和 GCP 上设计云架构、制定迁移方案、生成成本优化建议，并制定灾难恢复策略。用于设计云架构、规划迁移、优化多云部署时。调用适用于 Well-Architected Framework、成本优化、灾难恢复、落地区、安全架构、无服务器设计。

description: Send an email via the Recoup API the reliable way — a Node helper that serializes the body correctly and fails loudly instead of sending an empty email. Use whenever a task needs to email a report/summary/notification to the account owner or a recipient. ALWAYS use this script to send email; never hand-build `curl … -d "{…}"` with inline `jq`/shell interpolation (that silently produces empty "Message from Recoup" footer-only emails). Pairs with recoup-platform-api-access (which it sends through).
description_zh: 通过 Recoup API 可靠地发送邮件——这是一款 Node 辅助工具，能够正确序列化正文并明确报错，而非发送空邮件。当任务需要向账户所有者或接收人发送报告、汇总或通知时，务必使用此工具。**始终使用此脚本发送邮件，禁止手工构建带内联 `jq` 或 shell 插值的 `curl … -d "{…}"`（该方式会静默产生仅有“Message from Recoup”尾注的空邮件）。** 该脚本需与 recoup-platform-api-access 配合使用（邮件即通过该服务发送）。

description: Detects missing zeroization of sensitive data in source code and identifies zeroization removed by compiler optimizations, with assembly-level analysis, and control-flow verification. Use for auditing C/C++/Rust code handling secrets, keys, passwords, or other sensitive data.
description_zh: 检测源代码中敏感数据零化缺失，并识别编译器优化移除的零化，基于汇编级分析与控制流验证。用于审计处理秘密、密钥、密码或其他敏感数据的 C/C++/Rust 代码。

description:
史蒂夫·乔布斯(Steve Jobs)的思维框架与表达方式。基于Isaacson授权传记、Stanford演讲、
Lost Interview、D Conference系列、Make Something Wonderful、30+一手来源的深度调研，
提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用乔布斯的视角分析产品、审视决策、提供反馈。
当用户提到「用乔布斯的视角」「乔布斯会怎么看」「Jobs模式」「steve jobs perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「帮我用乔布斯的角度想想」「如果乔布斯会怎么做」「切换到乔布斯」也应触发。
description_zh:
史蒂夫·乔布斯（Steve Jobs）的思维框架与表达方式。基于 Isaacson 授权传记、Stanford 演讲、
Lost Interview、D Conference 系列、Make Something Wonderful、
30+一手来源的深度调研，
提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。

用途：作为思维顾问，用乔布斯的视角分析产品、审视决策、提供反馈。

当用户提到「用乔布斯的视角」「乔布斯会怎么看」「Jobs模式」「steve jobs perspective」时使用。

即使用户只是说「帮我用乔布斯的视角」「如果乔布斯会怎么做」「切换到乔布斯的视角」也应触发。

description: Automate ClickUp workspace management, task workflows, time tracking, and team productivity
description_zh: 自动化 ClickUp 工作区管理、任务流程、时间跟踪及团队生产力

description: Draws the 12 Houses of the Zodiac Tarot spread to inject entropy into planning when prompts are vague, ambiguous, or casually delegated. Interprets the spread to guide next steps. Use when the user says 'let fate decide', 'YOLO', 'whatever', 'idk', or other nonchalant phrases, makes Yu-Gi-Oh references, or when you are about to arbitrarily pick between multiple reasonable approaches. Prefer over asking clarifying questions when the user's tone is casual or playful rather than precision-seeking.
description_zh: 当提示模糊、含糊或随意委托时，抽取十二星座塔罗牌阵，为规划注入不确定性。通过解读牌阵，指导下一步行动。当用户说出“让命运决定”、“YOLO”、“随便”、“不知道”或其他漫不经心的短语，提及《游戏王》相关内容，或当你即将在多个合理方案中随意做出选择时，使用此牌阵。当用户语气随意或俏皮，而非追求精确时，本方法优于询问澄清问题。

description: KBL 한국프로농구 경기 결과와 현재 팀 순위를 날짜/팀 기준으로 조회한다. 공식 JSON 엔드포인트와 kbl-results npm 패키지를 사용한다.
description_zh: 按日期和球队为基准，查询KBL韩国职业篮球联赛的比赛结果及当前球队排名。使用官方JSON接口以及kbl-results npm 包。

description: Apply statistical methods including descriptive stats, trend analysis, outlier detection, and hypothesis testing. Use when analyzing distributions, testing for significance, detecting anomalies, computing correlations, or interpreting statistical results.
description_zh: 应用包括描述性统计、趋势分析、异常值检测和假设检验等统计方法。用于分析分布、检验显著性、检测异常、计算相关性或解释统计结果。

description: Provides comprehensive React 19 patterns for Server Components, Server Actions, useOptimistic, useActionState, useTransition, concurrent features, Suspense boundaries, and TypeScript integration. Generates executable code patterns, validates security for public endpoints, and optimizes performance with React Compiler or manual memoization. Proactively use when building React 19 applications with Next.js App Router, implementing optimistic UI, or optimizing concurrent rendering.
description_zh: 为服务端组件、服务端动作、useOptimistic、useActionState、useTransition、并发特性、Suspense 边界以及 TypeScript 集成提供全面的 React 19 模式。生成可执行的代码模式，验证公共端点的安全性，并通过 React Compiler 或手动记忆化优化性能。在使用 Next.js App Router 构建 React 19 应用、实现乐观 UI 或优化并发渲染时，请主动使用。

description: Generate Salesforce Flows using the MCP tool execute_metadata_action. Use when the user asks to create, build, or generate a flow — including Screen, Autolaunched, Record-Triggered (before/after-save), Scheduled. Also trigger for flow-like requests such as "when a record is created", "trigger daily at", "send an email when", "update the field when", "automate", "workflow", or "flow XML/metadata". This is the only skill for Salesforce Flow generation.
description_zh: 使用 MCP 工具的 execute_metadata_action（执行元数据操作）生成 Salesforce 流程。当用户要求创建、构建或生成流程时使用，包括 Screen、Autolaunched、Record-Triggered（保存前/保存后）、Scheduled 等类型。当出现类似流程的请求时也会触发，例如“当记录创建时”、“每日在...时触发”、“当...时发送邮件”、“当...时更新字段”、“自动化”、“工作流”或“流程 XML/元数据”等请求。这是唯一用于生成 Salesforce 流程的技能。

description: DevOps and IT Ops automation - CI/CD, monitoring, incident management, and infrastructure workflows
description_zh: DevOps 与 IT 运维自动化 - CI/CD、监控、事件管理及基础设施工作流

description: Discover agent-native CLIs for professional software. Access the live catalog to find tools for creative workflows, productivity, AI, and more.
description_zh: 发现面向专业软件的智能体原生CLI。访问实时目录，查找适用于创意工作流、生产力、AI 及更多场景的工具。

description: 올라포케 역삼점의 메뉴·매장 정보·이벤트 참여 흐름을 remote MCP 서버 기준으로 안내한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: All Proof 梨川店的菜单、门店信息、活动参与流程，将以远程MCP服务器为准进行引导。在돌쇠中，通过官方界面完成后续操作。

description: Automate Obsidian knowledge management, note linking, and personal knowledge base workflows
description_zh: 自动化 Obsidian 知识管理、笔记链接与个人知识库工作流

description: Configure Grafana Alerting, Incident Response Management (IRM), and SLOs end-to-end — provisions Grafana-managed and data-source-managed alert rules, contact points (Slack/PagerDuty/email/webhook), notification policies with hierarchical matchers, silences, mute timings, on-call schedules and escalation chains, incident-management integrations, and SLOs with multi-window burn-rate alerts. Use when configuring alerts, debugging notification routing, setting up on-call rotations, declaring or managing incidents, defining SLOs, provisioning alerting via YAML or API, picking matchers for a notification policy, building a PagerDuty/Slack webhook receiver, or troubleshooting why an alert isn't firing — even when the user says "page me on errors", "alert me when X happens", "route this to the platform team", or "set up an SLO" without naming Alerting or IRM.
description_zh: 端到端配置 Grafana 告警、事件响应管理（IRM）和 SLOs（服务等级目标）——配置 Grafana 管理的告警规则、数据源管理的告警规则、联系方式（Slack/PagerDuty/邮件/Webhook）、带有层级匹配器的通知策略、静默、静音时间、值守时间表和升级链路、事件管理集成，以及支持多窗口燃烧率告警的 SLOs。适用于以下场景：配置告警、排查通知路由问题、设置值守轮换、声明或管理事件、定义 SLO、通过 YAML 或 API 进行告警配置、为通知策略选择匹配器、构建 PagerDuty/Slack Webhook 接收器，或排查告警为何未触发——即使用户未提及告警或 IRM 却说出"当出现错误时通知我"、"当 X 发生时报提醒我"、"将此路由至平台团队"或"设置 SLO"。

description: Use for Vitest tests, mocks, coverage and failing-test diagnosis.
description_zh: 用于 Vitest 测试、mock、覆盖率以及失败测试诊断。

description: Use when the user asks for nearby public/open restrooms or 근처 화장실. Always ask the user's current location first, then use the official nationwide public-restroom standard dataset plus Kakao anchor resolution.
description_zh: 当用户询问附近的公共/开放式卫生间或附近的卫生间时使用。始终首先询问用户的当前位置，然后使用官方全国公共卫生间标准数据集以及 Kakao 锚点解析。

description: Search Korean scholarship announcements across official KOSAF, university, foundation, company, and public-sector sources, extract amount and eligibility, and filter results by school, income band, student level, and organization type. Users may invoke it with the phrase 장학금 검색 및 조회. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在官方 KOSAF、高校、基金会、企业及公共部门来源中检索韩国奖学金公告，提取金额与资格要求，并根据学校、收入区间、学生级别和组织类型筛选结果。用户可通过短语“奖学金搜索与查询”调用该功能。在 돌쇠 中，可借助官方平台执行后续操作。

description: Profile, diagnose, and remediate SwiftUI runtime performance using code review, Instruments, and repeatable measurements. Use when a SwiftUI screen renders slowly, scrolling or animations hitch, view bodies update excessively, list identity churns, layout work spikes, or broad Observation dependencies raise CPU cost. description: Expert UI/UX design guidance for unique, accessible interfaces. Use for visual decisions, colors, typography, layouts. Always ask before making design decisions. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications.

Use this skill when creating or editing permission set metadata, object permissions, field-level security (FLS), tab visibility, or deploying permission sets.
description_zh: 生成正确且可部署的 Salesforce 权限集元数据（PermissionSet XML），包含对象、字段、用户和应用权限。当创建或编辑权限集元数据、对象权限、字段级安全（FLS）、标签可见性，或部署权限集时，使用此技能。

description: Paseo reference for managing projects, workspaces, workspace scripts, agents, schedules, and heartbeats.
description_zh: Paseo 参考指南：用于管理项目、工作区、工作区脚本、代理、排程及心跳。

description: Electron desktop development guide — IPC handlers, controllers, preload scripts, window/menu management.
description_zh: Electron 桌面开发指南 — IPC 处理程序、控制器、预加载脚本、窗口/菜单管理。

description: The best, fastest, and cheapest way to scrape Instagram — battle-tested by tens of thousands of customers including enterprise teams. Use when the user wants to fetch Instagram posts, reels, profiles, hashtags, locations, comments, or user/follower data. Five specialized actors cover every Instagram data surface.
description_zh: 爬取 Instagram 的最好、最快、最实惠的方式——已通过数万名客户（含企业团队）的实战检验。适用于用户需要获取 Instagram 帖子、Reels、个人资料、话题标签、地点、评论或用户及粉丝数据的场景。五个专业脚本覆盖 Instagram 的全部数据接口。

description: Load automatically when planning, researching, or implementing ANY Medusa backend features (custom modules, API routes, workflows, data models, module links, business logic). REQUIRED for all Medusa backend work in ALL modes (planning, implementation, exploration). Contains architectural patterns, best practices, and critical rules that MCP servers don't provide.
description_zh: 在规划、研究或实施任何 Medusa 后端功能（自定义模块、API 路由、工作流、数据模型、模块链接、业务逻辑）时自动加载。所有 Medusa 后端工作（规划、实施、探索等所有模式）均强制要求。包含 MCP 服务器未提供的架构模式、最佳实践和关键规则。

description: Iterate on a PR until actionable CI passes and high/medium review feedback is addressed. Use for PR CI failures, review feedback, or green-check loops; do not wait for human approval, draft status, or merge gates.
description_zh: 对PR进行迭代，直至可操作CI通过，且高/中风险评审反馈均已处理。适用于PR CI失败、评审反馈或绿灯循环；切勿等待人工审批、草稿状态或合并门控。

description: Use when the user asks for nearby parking lots or 근처 주차장/공영주차장. Always ask the user's current location first, then use official Data.go.kr public parking data through k-skill-proxy or the parking-lot-search package.
description_zh: 当用户询问附近停车场或（근처 주차장/공영주차장，即附近停车场/公共停车场）时使用。首先，始终先询问用户的当前位置，然后通过 k-skill-proxy 或 parking-lot-search 包使用官方 Data.go.kr 公共停车数据。

description: Create and trigger Apple Shortcuts for iOS/macOS automation and cross-platform workflows
description_zh: 创建并触发 Apple 快捷指令，用于 iOS/macOS 自动化与跨平台工作流

description: Combine multiple PDFs or split into separate files
description_zh: 合并多个PDF文件，或将文件拆分为独立文件

description: 네이버 검색 Open API 뉴스 검색(news.json)을 k-skill-proxy 경유로 조회해 최신 뉴스 기사 제목·발행시각·링크·요약을 보수적으로 정리한다. 사용자는 별도 API 키 발급 없이 호출한다.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 查询 Naver 搜索的 Open API 新闻搜索（news.json），并谨慎整理最新新闻文章的标题、发布时间、链接与摘要。用户无需单独发放 API 密钥即可调用。

description: Generate Privy wallet policy rules from natural language. Use when the user wants to set up, modify, or review wallet security policies — transfer limits, address allowlists, method restrictions, time windows, etc.
description_zh: 从自然语言生成 Privy 钱包策略规则。当用户需要设置、修改或审查钱包安全策略时使用——包括转账限额、地址白名单、方法限制、时间窗口等。

description: Automate WooCommerce e-commerce operations including orders, inventory, customers, and marketing
description_zh: 自动化 WooCommerce 电商运营，涵盖订单、库存、客户及营销。

description: Use when the user asks to search Korean library books, book details, library holdings, or whether a Korean public library owns a book via k-skill-proxy Data4Library routes. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户通过 k-skill-proxy Data4Library 路由请求搜索韩语图书馆书籍、图书详情、馆藏信息，或询问韩国公共图书馆是否拥有某本书时使用。돌쇠会通过官方界面执行后续操作。

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, modify, or validate Salesforce Lightning pages (FlexiPages). Trigger when users mention RecordPage, AppPage, HomePage, Lightning pages, page layouts, adding components to pages, or page customization. Also use when users say things like 'create a Lightning page', 'add a component to a page', 'customize the record page', 'generate a FlexiPage', or when they're working with FlexiPage XML files and need help with components, regions, or deployment errors. Always use this skill for any FlexiPage-related work, even if they just mention 'page' in the context of Salesforce.
description_zh: 在用户需要创建、生成、修改或验证 Salesforce Lightning 页面（FlexiPages）时使用本技能。当用户提及 RecordPage、AppPage、HomePage、Lightning 页面、页面布局、向页面添加组件或页面定制等内容时触发。此外，当用户说类似“创建 Lightning 页面”、“向页面添加组件”、“定制记录页面”、“生成 FlexiPage”等，或在处理 FlexiPage XML 文件时，需要帮助处理组件、区域或部署错误时，也请使用本技能。对于任何与 FlexiPage 相关的操作，始终使用本技能，即使用户只是在 Salesforce 语境下仅提到“页面”。

description: Reduce PDF file size while maintaining acceptable quality
description_zh: 在保证可接受质量的前提下减小PDF文件大小

description: Use for modals, dialogs and confirmations with createModal, confirmModal, ModalHost or base-ui modal APIs.
description_zh: 用于配合 createModal、confirmModal、ModalHost 或 base-ui 模态 API 来实现模态框、对话框和确认功能。

description: Operate professional paid advertising across Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, and X. Use for account intake, source-grounded audits, strategy, budget and measurement planning, creative production, experiments, reporting, monitoring, and explicitly approved campaign changes. Also trigger on PPC, paid social, retail media, attribution, tracking, landing pages, cross-platform conversion totals, negative keywords or search terms, beta-feature scoring, stale platform claims, API-token or credential setup, campaign deletion, and safe Claude Ads installation or uninstall.
description_zh: 在 Google、Meta、YouTube、LinkedIn、TikTok、Microsoft、Apple、Amazon、Reddit、Pinterest、Snapchat 和 X 等平台开展专业付费广告操作。用于账户接入、基于来源的审计、策略、预算与测量规划、创意制作、实验、报告、监控及明确批准的营销活动变更。并基于 PPC、付费社交、零售媒体、归因、追踪、落地页、跨平台转化总数、负向关键词或搜索词、测试版功能评分、过期平台声明、API 令牌或凭证设置、活动删除，以及安全的 Claude Ads 安装或卸载进行触发。

description: Amazon Aurora MySQL — creates, modifies, and advises on Aurora MySQL clusters specifically (MySQL-compatible engine, Aurora serverless, parallel query). Trigger for Aurora MySQL cluster operations, ACU sizing, I/O-Optimized storage, commitment pricing, or MySQL upgrade planning. Aurora MySQL uses full (VPC-based) configuration — express configuration is PostgreSQL-only. For Aurora PostgreSQL, use amazon-aurora-postgresql instead. Contains safety guardrails and response templates that override defaults.
description_zh: Amazon Aurora MySQL —— 专门针对 Aurora MySQL 集群的创建、修改和提供建议（兼容 MySQL 的引擎、Aurora 服务器less、并行查询）。适用于 Aurora MySQL 集群操作、ACU 容量规划、I/O 优化存储、承诺定价或 MySQL 升级规划等场景的触发条件。Aurora MySQL 使用完整的（基于 VPC）配置——简化配置仅适用于 PostgreSQL。如需使用 Aurora PostgreSQL，请改用 amazon-aurora-postgresql。包含安全护栏（safety guardrails）和覆盖默认设置的响应模板。

description: Research topics and write content like blog posts, articles, and copy
description_zh: 研究主题，并撰写类似博客文章、文章及文案的内容。

description: Build a unified telemetry pipeline with Grafana Alloy — one OpenTelemetry-compatible binary that collects metrics, logs, traces, and profiles and ships to Grafana Cloud / Prometheus / Loki / Tempo / Pyroscope. Covers the Alloy config language (blocks, `sys.env`, component refs), `prometheus.scrape` → `remote_write`, `loki.source.file` + `loki.process` → `loki.write`, `otelcol.receiver.otlp` → `otelcol.exporter.otlp`, `pyroscope.scrape`, K8s / Docker / EC2 discovery, relabeling, modules (`import.file/git/http`), clustering, Fleet Management `remotecfg`, the Alloy UI at `:12345`, and `alloy fmt` / `alloy validate`. Use when writing a `config.alloy`, replacing Grafana Agent / OTel Collector, scraping K8s pods, parsing logs, ingesting OTLP, or debugging "Alloy isn't sending anything" — even when the user says "set up the agent", "write me a scrape config", "drop these logs before sending", or "OTel collector config" without naming Alloy.
description_zh: 使用 Grafana Alloy 构建统一的遥测管道——一个与 OpenTelemetry 兼容的二进制程序，可收集指标、日志、追踪和性能概览，并发送到 Grafana Cloud / Prometheus / Loki / Tempo / Pyroscope。涵盖 Alloy 配置语言（块、`sys.env`、组件引用）、`prometheus.scrape` → `remote_write`、`loki.source.file` + `loki.process` → `loki.write`、`otelcol.receiver.otlp` → `otelcol.exporter.otlp`、`pyroscope.scrape`、K8s / Docker / EC2 发现、重标注、模块（`import.file/git/http`）、集群、Fleet Management `remotecfg`、Alloy UI 的 `:12345` 地址，以及 `alloy fmt` / `alloy validate`。在编写 `config.alloy`、替代 Grafana Agent / OTel Collector、抓取 K8s Pods、解析日志、摄取 OTLP，或调试“Alloy 没有发送任何数据”时使用——即使用户说的是“设置 agent”、“写个抓取配置”、“在发送前丢弃这些日志”或“OTel collector 配置”，但没有提到 Alloy 时。

description: Audits App Store submission readiness and rejection risk across current review guidelines, PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and required-reason APIs, privacy labels, ATT, StoreKit payments, metadata, entitlements, widgets, and Live Activities. Use when preparing a submission, responding to rejection, reconciling privacy evidence, or separating upload blockers from cleanup.
description_zh: 审核当前审核指南、PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy与所需理由API、隐私标签、ATT、StoreKit支付、元数据、权限、小组件以及Live Activities，评估App Store提交就绪状态与拒绝风险。适用于准备提交、响应拒绝、核对隐私证据，或将上传阻塞项与清理工作区分开时使用。

description: Guides developers through implementing event and conversion ingestion to Google products using the Data Manager API /v1/events/ingest endpoint and its associated client libraries. Use this skill when the user wants to upload offline conversions, enhanced conversions for leads, click conversions, Google Analytics web or app events, or any other event ingestion use case supported by the Data Manager API. Don't use for uploading audience members (use the data-manager-api-audience-ingestion skill).
description_zh: 指导开发者通过 Data Manager API 的 /v1/events/ingest 端点及其关联客户端库，实现事件和转化数据向 Google 产品的摄入。当用户需要上传离线转化、针对潜在客户的增强转化、点击转化、Google Analytics 网页或应用事件，或 Data Manager API 支持的其他任何事件摄入用例时，请使用本技能。请勿用于上传受众成员（请使用 data-manager-api-audience-ingestion 技能）。

description: Review generated or changed production code before it ships, using Clean Code, SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI, and LLM-specific failure-mode checks in any programming language. Best used reactively after an agent writes, edits, refactors, or fixes code, before presenting, committing, or merging the result. Use when the user asks "review this PR", "is this safe to merge?", "make this cleaner", "audit this code", "refactor this", "fix this bug", or after a coding agent produced implementation code. Can also guide writing when explicitly invoked before a risky edit. Invoke it on your own initiative the moment you finish writing, editing, or refactoring non-trivial production code, before presenting or committing — don't wait to be asked. DO NOT USE for factual/conceptual questions, CI/tooling config, git workflow, running/debugging tests, pure architecture discussion, prose writing, data analysis, or test-code review (use test-guard).
description_zh:
在将代码交付发布前，使用 Clean Code、SOLID、DRY、KISS、YAGNI 以及针对 LLM 的故障模式检查（适用于任何编程语言），对生成或已变更的生产代码进行审查。最佳用法是在智能体编写、编辑、重构或修复代码之后，于展示、提交或合并该结果之前进行审查。

适用于用户提出"审查此 PR"、"是否可以安全合并"、"使此代码更整洁"、"审计此代码"、"重构此代码"、"修复此 Bug"，或在编码智能体产出实现代码之后。也可在用户明确要求对存在风险的操作进行修改之前引导编写。当您自行完成对非平凡生产代码的编写、编辑或重构后，应立即主动调用，在展示或提交之前——无需等待被要求。

请勿用于事实性/概念性问题、CI/工具配置、Git 工作流、运行/调试测试、纯架构讨论、散文写作、数据分析或测试代码审查（请使用 test-guard）。

description: Build and manage webhook-based integrations for real-time event processing and API connections
description_zh: 构建和管理基于Webhook的集成，用于实时事件处理和API连接

description: Use this skill when users need to create or configure Salesforce Custom Tabs. Trigger when users mention tabs, navigation tabs, object tabs, web tabs, Visualforce tabs, Lightning component tabs, app page tabs, or tab configuration. Also use when users want to add navigation to custom objects, create tabs for external content, or set up Lightning page tabs. Always use this skill for any custom tab work.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建或配置 Salesforce 自定义标签时，使用本技能。当用户提及标签、导航标签、对象标签、Web 标签、Visualforce 标签、Lightning 组件标签、应用页标签或标签配置时触发。此外，当用户希望为自定义对象添加导航、为外部内容创建标签，或设置 Lightning 页面标签时，也使用本技能。对于任何自定义标签工作，始终使用本技能。

description: Use when starting a brand-new Unity game or project from scratch — "make/start/create a new game", "bootstrap a Unity project", "I want to build a [genre] game", "scaffold/prototype a game", game jam, greenfield, blank project, project setup. A guided flow that gathers the concept, target platforms, and monetization, installs the Editor in the background while it asks, then creates the project and source control and installs packages — delegating the mechanics to the unity-cli and unity-package-management skills and handing off monetization to the dedicated skills. Does not scaffold gameplay code.
description_zh: 当从零开始启动全新的 Unity 游戏或项目时使用——“创建/启动/制作新游戏”、“初始化 Unity 项目”、“我想制作一款[类型]游戏”、“搭建/原型化游戏”、游戏制作挑战、全新开发、空白项目、项目配置。一个引导式流程，该流程收集概念、目标平台和盈利方式，在询问的同时在后台安装编辑器，然后创建项目、版本控制并安装包——将玩法机制委托给 unity-cli 和 unity-package-management 技能，并将盈利方式移交至专门技能。不搭建游戏玩法代码。

description:
Generate and render Mermaid diagrams for architecture docs, READMEs, PRs,
terminals, chats, and CI as themed SVG, PNG, or ASCII/Unicode art. Use this skill whenever
the user provides Mermaid code or .mmd files; asks for a flowchart,
sequence/state/class diagram, ERD, XY chart, or architecture/workflow/data-model
visualization; or wants to beautify, theme, batch-convert, or make a diagram
terminal-friendly. Runs locally without a browser or DOM, with 15 built-in
themes and custom colors.
description_zh:
为架构文档、README、PR、终端、聊天和 CI 生成并渲染 Mermaid 图，将其转换为主题化的 SVG、PNG 或 ASCII/Unicode 艺术。

当用户提供 Mermaid 代码或 .mmd 文件；要求生成流程图、序列图/状态图/类图、ERD、XY 图表，或进行架构/工作流/数据模型可视化；或希望美化、主题化、批量转换或制作终端友好的图时，请使用此技能。该技能无需浏览器或 DOM 即可本地运行，并提供 15 个内置主题和自定义颜色。

description: Create professional Marp presentation slides with 7 beautiful themes (default, minimal, colorful, dark, gradient, tech, business). Use when users request slide creation, presentations, or Marp documents. Supports custom themes, image layouts, and "make it look good" requests with automatic quality improvements.
description_zh: 创建专业的 Marp 演示文稿幻灯片，内置 7 款精美主题（default、minimal、colorful、dark、gradient、tech、business）。适用于用户请求创建幻灯片、演示文稿或 Marp 文档时。支持自定义主题、图片版式，以及“让内容看起来更美观”的请求，并自动提升质量。

description: Generate read-only MongoDB queries (find) or aggregation pipelines using natural language, with collection schema context and sample documents. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write, create, or generate MongoDB queries, wants to filter/query/aggregate data in MongoDB, asks "how do I query...", needs help with query syntax, or discusses finding/filtering/grouping MongoDB documents. Also use for translating SQL-like requests to MongoDB syntax. Does NOT handle Atlas Search ($search operator), vector/semantic search ($vectorSearch operator), fuzzy matching, autocomplete indexes, or relevance scoring - use search-and-ai for those. Does NOT analyze or optimize existing queries - use mongodb-query-optimizer for that. Does NOT handle aggregation pipelines that involve write operations. Requires MongoDB MCP server.
description_zh:
根据自然语言生成只读 MongoDB 查询（find）或聚合管道，并提供集合模式上下文和示例文档。当用户要求编写、创建或生成 MongoDB 查询，需要过滤/查询/聚合 MongoDB 数据，询问"如何查询……"，需要帮助编写查询语法，或讨论查找/过滤/分组 MongoDB 文档时，请使用此技能。同时，将此技能用于将类 SQL 请求转换为 MongoDB 语法。

该技能不处理 Atlas Search（$search 运算符）、向量/语义搜索（$vectorSearch 运算符）、模糊匹配、自动补全索引或相关性评分——请使用 search-and-ai 处理这些任务。该技能不分析或优化现有查询——请使用 mongodb-query-optimizer 处理该任务。该技能不处理涉及写入操作的聚合管道。需要 MongoDB MCP 服务器。

description: Use this skill when upgrading to PixiJS v8 from v7 or diagnosing broken v7 code after an upgrade. Covers async app.init, single pixi.js package (deprecated @pixi/* sub-packages), Graphics shape-then-fill, BaseTexture → TextureSource, shader/uniform rework, ParticleContainer+Particle, constructor options objects, DisplayObject removal, settings/utils removal, Ticker signature, events rewrite. Triggers on: migrate v7, v8 breaking changes, @pixi/ import, DisplayObject, beginFill, endFill, cacheAsBitmap, BaseTexture, deprecated.
description_zh: 在从 v7 升级到 PixiJS v8，或在升级后诊断 v7 损坏代码时使用本技能。覆盖内容：异步 app.init、单一 pixi.js 包（已弃用的 @pixi/* 子包）、Graphics 先定义形状后填充、BaseTexture → TextureSource、shader/uniform 重构、ParticleContainer+Particle、构造函数选项对象、DisplayObject 移除、settings/utils 移除、Ticker 签名、事件重写。触发条件：从 v7 迁移、v8 破坏性变更、@pixi/ import、DisplayObject、beginFill、 endFill、cacheAsBitmap、BaseTexture、已弃用。

description: Your AI agent's crypto brain. One skill, 100+ commands across 14 data domains — real-time prices, wallets, DeFi, on-chain SQL, prediction markets, and more. Natural language in, structured data out. Install once, access everything. Use whenever the user needs crypto data, asks about prices/wallets/tokens/DeFi, wants to investigate on-chain activity, or is building something that consumes crypto data — even if they don't say "surf" explicitly.
description_zh: 您的AI代理的加密智能大脑：一个技能，覆盖14个数据领域，拥有100多条命令——实时价格、钱包、DeFi、链上SQL、预测市场等。输入自然语言，输出结构化数据。安装一次，访问所有。当用户需要加密数据、询问价格/钱包/代币/DeFi、调查链上活动，或构建消费加密数据的应用时，随时使用——即使他们并未明确提及“浏览”。

description: Use this skill when users need to create or configure tab-based Salesforce Custom Applications with navigation, branding, and action overrides. Trigger when users mention custom apps, application metadata, app navigation, or organizing tabs into applications. Use when users want to create app containers for tabs and pages. Do NOT use when the goal is hosting a React UI bundle in the App Launcher — use generating-ui-bundle-custom-app for that case.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建或配置基于标签的 Salesforce 自定义应用程序，并包含导航、品牌标识和操作覆盖功能时，请使用此技能。当用户提及自定义应用程序、应用程序元数据、应用程序导航，或将标签组织为应用程序时，应触发本技能。当用户想要为标签和页面创建应用程序容器时，请使用本技能。当目标是将在 App Launcher 中托管 React UI 资源包时，请勿使用本技能——请针对该场景使用 generating-ui-bundle-custom-app。

description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
description_zh: 创建高质量 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器的指南：通过精心设计的工具，使大语言模型（LLM）能够与外部服务进行交互。该指南适用于构建用于集成外部 API 或服务的 MCP 服务器时使用，无论采用 Python（FastMCP）还是 Node/TypeScript（MCP SDK）开发。

description: Builds Vue 3 components with Composition API patterns, configures Nuxt 3 SSR/SSG projects, sets up Pinia stores, scaffolds Quasar/Capacitor mobile apps, implements PWA features, and optimises Vite builds. Use when creating Vue 3 applications with Composition API, writing reusable composables, managing state with Pinia, building hybrid mobile apps with Quasar or Capacitor, configuring service workers, or tuning Vite configuration and TypeScript integration.
description_zh: 使用组合式 API 模式构建 Vue 3 组件，配置 Nuxt 3 SSR/SSG 项目，设置 Pinia 状态管理，搭建 Quasar/Capacitor 移动应用，实现 PWA 功能，优化 Vite 构建。适用于创建使用组合式 API 的 Vue 3 应用、编写可复用组合式函数、使用 Pinia 管理状态、使用 Quasar 或 Capacitor 构建混合移动应用、配置 Service Worker，或调整 Vite 配置与 TypeScript 集成。

description: Generate professional PDF invoices from templates
description_zh: 根据模板生成专业PDF发票

description: Auto-fill document templates with data - mail merge for any format
description_zh: 使用数据自动填充文档模板——支持任意格式的信件合并

description: Analyzes meeting transcripts and recordings to uncover behavioral patterns, communication insights, and actionable feedback. Identifies when you avoid conflict, use filler words, dominate conversations, or miss opportunities to listen. Perfect for professionals seeking to improve their communication and leadership skills.
description_zh: 分析会议记录与录音，揭示行为模式、沟通洞察和切实可行的反馈。能够识别回避冲突、使用填充词、主导对话或错过倾听机会的具体表现。非常适合希望提升沟通与领导能力的专业人士。

description: Screen job applications against requirements and score candidates
description_zh: 对照要求筛选求职申请，并对候选人进行评分。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants text extracted from images, photos, scans, screenshots, or scanned PDFs. Returns exact machine-readable strings with line-level text and optional bbox coordinates. Strong accuracy for CJK, small print, and handwritten text. Trigger terms: OCR, 文字识别, 图片转文字, 截图识字, 提取图中文字, 扫描识字, 识字, 纯文字, plain text extraction, 坐标, 检测框, bbox, bounding box, image to text, screenshot, photo scan, recognize text.
description_zh: 当用户需要从图片、照片、扫描件、截图或扫描的PDF文件中提取文本时，请使用此技能。该技能返回精确的可机器读取字符串，包含行级文本及可选的bbox坐标，对CJK（中文等）、小字和手写文本具有高准确率。触发词：OCR、文字识别、图片转文字、截图识字、提取图中文字、扫描识字、识字、纯文字提取、坐标、检测框、bbox、bounding box、image to text、screenshot、photo scan、recognize text。

description: 금융감독원 전자공시시스템(DART) OpenAPI로 공시검색, 기업개황, 재무제표, 주요사항보고서를 조회한다. 사용자의 API_K_DART 환경변수를 직접 사용한다.
description_zh: 通过金融监督院电子披露系统(DART)的OpenAPI查询披露信息、企业概况、财务报表及主要事项报告。直接使用用户的API_K_DART环境变量。

description: Add server-side environment variables that control default values for user settings.
description_zh: 添加控制用户设置默认值的服务端环境变量。

description: Build complete Salesforce Lightning Experience applications from natural language descriptions. Use this skill when a user requests a "complete app", "Lightning app", "business solution", "management system", or describes a scenario requiring multiple interconnected Salesforce components (objects, fields, pages, tabs, security). Orchestrates all required metadata types in proper dependency order to produce a deployable application.
description_zh: 从自然语言描述中构建完整的 Salesforce Lightning Experience 应用。当用户要求构建“完整的 App”、“Lightning 应用”、“业务解决方案”或“管理系统”，或描述需要多个相互关联的 Salesforce 组件（对象、字段、页面、标签、安全）的场景时，请使用此技能。该技能按正确的依赖顺序协调所有必需的元数据类型，以生成可部署的应用。

description: Price-action pattern reading — classifies a token's candles into a named pattern (uptrend channel, breakdown, bounce off the lows, distribution at highs, basing, wide chop, consolidation) and scores it 0-100 from six measurements you compute directly from the kline response. Every point added or deducted states its reason. Use when the user asks about K 线, K线形态, 走势, 趋势, 形态, price action, chart pattern, whether a chart looks strong or weak, is it breaking down, is it consolidating, or wants a technical read of a token's chart rather than the raw numbers.
description_zh: 价格行为形态识别——将代币的K线归入特定的命名形态（上升趋势通道、破位、低点反弹、高位出货、筑底、区间震荡、整理），并根据六个由你直接从K线反应中计算得出的指标进行0至100分的评分。每个加分或减分的理由均说明清楚。适用于用户询问K线、K线形态、走势、趋势、形态、价格行为、图表形态，或判断图表强弱、是否破位、是否整理，或希望对代币图表做出技术分析解读（而非仅基于原始数据）的场景。

description: Scaffold and run a label's self-managing "music-company OS" inside its own git repo — the full label-intelligence workspace (folders, a self-managing CLAUDE.md mirrored to AGENTS.md, a read-only doctor + never-stale janitor, compound-learning and self-improvement loops, an in-place plugin) seeded with Recoup's conventions (top-level artists/{slug}/RECOUP.md identity files, releases/{slug}/RELEASE.md) and backed by the Recoup API as system of record. Use for "set up our label OS", "build the org workspace", "turn this repo into our label brain", or onboarding a new org/label repo. Pulls the real roster from the live account (auth via recoup-platform-connect-account), onboards artists API-first via recoup-roster-add-artist, and calls the other recoup-* skills (research/content/release/song/catalog) instead of reinventing them. The single workspace/OS builder — also covers the lightweight "just mirror my roster into folders" case.
description_zh:
在自身的 Git 仓库中搭建并运行发行公司自我管理的"音乐公司操作系统"——完整的发行公司智能工作区（包含文件夹、镜像至 AGENTS.md 的自我管理 CLAUDE.md、只读诊断工具与永不过期的维护者、复合学习与自我改进循环，以及原地插件），预置 Recoup 的规范（顶层 artists/{slug}/RECOUP.md 身份文件、releases/{slug}/RELEASE.md），并以 Recoup API 作为权威数据源。

适用于"搭建我们的发行公司操作系统"、"构建组织工作区"、"将这个仓库转化为我们的发行公司大脑"或为新的组织/发行公司仓库进行引导等场景。它会从在线账户中获取真实艺人名单（通过 recoup-platform-connect-account 进行身份验证），以 API 优先方式引导艺人（recoup-roster-add-artist），并调用其他 recoup-* 技能（research/content/release/song/catalog），而非重新构建这些技能。它是唯一的工作区/操作系统构建者，同时也涵盖了"将我的艺人名单简单镜像到文件夹"这一轻量化场景。

description: Score and qualify leads based on criteria and fit
description_zh: 根据标准和匹配度，对线索进行评分与合格筛选。

description: Use this skill when users need to create Custom Lightning Types (CLTs) for Einstein Agent actions or structured input/output schemas. Trigger when users mention CLT, Custom Lightning Types, Custom Lightning Types (CLTs) with widget/mosaic/fragment rendition/renderer, JSON schemas for agents, type definitions, lightning__objectType, or editor/renderer configurations. When widget renditions are requested, you MUST first read the widget-rendition.md reference file in this skill's references/ directory and follow its complete workflow. This is complex - always use this skill for CLT work.
description_zh: 当用户需要使用本技能创建爱因斯坦智能体动作或结构化输入/输出模式的自定义 Lightning 类型（Custom Lightning Types）时，请使用本技能。当用户提及 CLT、Custom Lightning Types、带有 widget/mosaic/fragment 渲染方式/渲染器的 Custom Lightning Types（CLTs）、智能体 JSON 模式、类型定义、lightning__objectType 或编辑器/渲染器配置时，触发本技能。当需要 widget 渲染方式时，您必须先读取本技能 references/ 目录下的 widget-randation.md 参考文件，并遵循其完整工作流。此项工作较为复杂——请始终使用本技能处理 CLT 相关工作。

description: Automate security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and compliance workflows
description_zh: 自动化安全监控、威胁检测、事件响应和合规工作流

description: Migrates Android applications from the old, legacy Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK (com.google.android.gms:play-services-ads) to the new GMA Next-Gen SDK (com.google.android.libraries.ads.mobile.sdk:ads-mobile-sdk). Provides comprehensive mapping tables for imports, classes, and method signatures to help determine migration steps. Use when migrating an existing Android codebase from the old, legacy GMA SDK to GMA Next-Gen SDK.
description_zh: 将 Android 应用从旧的、遗留的 Google 移动广告（GMA）SDK（com.google.android.gms:play-services-ads）迁移到新的 GMA 下一代 SDK（com.google.android.libraries.ads.mobile.sdk:ads-mobile-sdk）。提供全面的导入、类和方法签名映射表，以帮助确定迁移步骤。用于将现有 Android 代码库从旧的、遗留的 GMA SDK 迁移到 GMA 下一代 SDK。

description: Work inside one artist's folder — read and update their context, brand, songs, and releases. Use for "organize [artist]'s files", "update [artist]'s brand/context", "what's in [artist]'s workspace", or any task about a named artist's files. To list your whole roster use recoup-roster-list-artists; for research/metrics on an artist use recoup-research-artist-overview.
description_zh: 在单个艺术家的文件夹内工作——读取并更新其背景、品牌、歌曲和发布信息。适用于“整理[艺术家]的文件”、“更新[艺术家]的品牌/背景”、“查看[艺术家]工作区中的内容”或任何关于指定艺术家文件的任务。要列出整个阵容，请使用 recoup-roster-list-artists；对艺术家进行研究和指标查询，请使用 recoup-research-artist-overview。

description: Onboard a brand-new artist to your roster and enrich them — the 8-call chain (create → Spotify match → research → catalog → socials → knowledge base) that sets up the artist and their workspace folder. Use for "create/add/onboard an artist", "set up [artist]", "we just signed [artist]", or "new signing". To see your roster use recoup-roster-list-artists; to work inside an existing artist's files use recoup-roster-manage-artist.
description_zh: 将一位全新艺术家纳纳入您的艺人名单并丰富其资料——这是一套8步流程（创建 → Spotify匹配 → 研究 → 目录 → 社交 → 知识库），用于为艺术家及其工作区文件夹做好准备。用于“创建/添加/入驻一位艺术家”、“设置[艺术家]”、“我们刚签约了[艺术家]”或“新签约”等场景。要查看您的艺人名单，请使用 recoup-roster-list-artists；要在现有艺术家的文件内工作，请使用 recoup-roster-manage-artist。

description: See who's on your roster — answers "what artists do I have" by walking the workspace and falling back to your live account when the filesystem is empty. Use for "what artists do I have", "list my roster", "who's on my roster", or "what's in this sandbox". To add a new artist use recoup-roster-add-artist; to work inside one artist's files use recoup-roster-manage-artist.
description_zh:
查看你的阵容中都有谁——通过遍历工作区来回答“我有哪些艺术家”，当文件系统为空时则回退到你的在线账户。

适用于“我有哪些艺术家”、列出我的阵容、查询我的阵容中有谁，或查询这个沙盒里有什么。

要添加新艺术家，请使用 recoup-roster-add-artist；要在某个艺术家的文件内工作，请使用 recoup-roster-manage-artist。

description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.
description_zh: 将一份文档转换为可爱的 NotebookLM 幻灯片版 PDF。适用于“wowerpoint 这个”“根据 <file>/制作关于 <file>/的幻灯片”“将这份报告转换为幻灯片”，或任何要求将单个文档渲染为可共享叙事幻灯片的需求。

description: 将单个 Skill 或 Skill 集合安装到通用 Agents、Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy、Grok、Hermes Agent、Kiro、Qwen Code、Cline 等 Agent。用户要求跨 Agent 安装、同步、查看、去重或卸载 Skill 时使用。

description: When the user wants a full ASO health audit, review their App Store listing quality, or diagnose why their app isn't ranking. Also use when the user mentions "ASO audit", "ASO score", "why am I not ranking", "listing review", or "optimize my app store page". For keyword-specific research, see keyword-research. For metadata writing, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户需要完整的ASO健康审计时，应审核其App Store列表质量，或诊断其应用排名不佳的原因。同样，当用户提及“ASO审计”、“ASO评分”、“为什么我没有排名”、“列表审核”或“优化我的应用商店页面”时，也应使用。针对关键词特定研究，参见 keyword-research。对于元数据撰写，参见 metadata-optimization。

description: Set up and use 1Password CLI for sign-in, desktop integration, and reading or injecting secrets.
description_zh: 配置并使用 1Password CLI 进行登录、桌面集成以及读取或注入密钥。

description: Automate Mailchimp email marketing campaigns, audience management, automations, and analytics
description_zh: 自动化 Mailchimp 邮件营销活动、受众管理、自动化流程和数据分析

description: Add watermarks, page numbers, headers, and footers to PDFs
description_zh: 为PDF文件添加水印、页码、页眉和页脚

description_zh: 使用 mcporter 通过 HTTP 或 stdio 列出、配置、认证、调用并检查 MCP 服务器/工具。

description:
Publish previews to a public URL, open-source projects to community GitHub, and list services (free or paid) on the Service Marketplace.

Use when the user wants to share, publish, list, open-source, or monetize what they built (e.g. make this dashboard public, share my project, push to GitHub, 上架到服务市场, 上架付费服务, 提交审核).
description_zh:
发布预览至公开网址，将开源项目发布至社区 GitHub，并在服务市场列出服务（免费或付费）。

当用户希望分享、发布、列出、开源或以付费形式变现其构建的成果时使用（例如：将此仪表盘公开、分享我的项目、推送到 GitHub、上架到服务市场、上架付费服务、提交审核）。

description: Configure (or troubleshoot) an AI coding agent or CLI to route through the Salesforce Models API using a signed OrgJWT. Use this skill when pointing an agent at the Salesforce model endpoint (api.salesforce.com/ai/gpt/v1), setting up OrgJWT / Bedrock-mode auth, wiring the agent's settings, API-key helper, and credentials file for the Salesforce endpoint, or fixing Models API 401 / 404 / "model not available" errors. DO NOT TRIGGER when the user needs to create or configure the Salesforce Connected App itself (use integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure) or set up Named Credentials / callout auth (use integration-connectivity-generate).
description_zh: 配置（或排查）AI 编码代理或命令行工具，使其通过带有签名 OrgJWT 的 Salesforce Models API 进行路由。当需要将代理指向 Salesforce 模型端点（api.salesforce.com/ai/gpt/v1）、设置 OrgJWT / Bedrock 模式认证、配置代理的设置、API 密钥辅助工具及 Salesforce 端点所需凭据文件，或修复 Models API 401 / 404 / “模型不可用”错误时，使用此技能。当用户需要创建或配置 Salesforce Connected App 本身（使用 integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure），或设置 Named Credentials / callout 认证（使用 integration-connectivity-generate）时，请勿触发。

description: Guides developers through managing (adding, removing, and clearing) audience members for Google products using the Data Manager API and its associated client libraries. Use this skill when the user wants to upload audience members, remove specific users, or clear/replace an entire audience for Customer Match, mobile device ID audiences, or any other audience use case supported by the Data Manager API. Don't use for uploading events or conversions (use the data-manager-api-event-ingestion skill).
description_zh: 使用 Data Manager API 及其关联客户端库，引导开发者管理（添加、移除和清空）用于 Google 产品的受众成员。当用户需要上传受众成员、移除特定用户，或为 Customer Match、移动设备 ID 受众以及 Data Manager API 支持的任何其他受众使用场景清空/替换整个受众时，使用此技能。不要用于上传事件或转化（请使用 data-manager-api-event-ingestion 技能）。
您提供的源内容似乎为空，仅包含格式符号“>”，没有需要翻译的文本内容，因此无法进行翻译。如果您有具体的文本需要翻译，请提供相关内容，我会为您进行准确、流畅的简体中文翻译。

description: Automate Spotify music playback, playlist management, and audio analysis workflows
description_zh: 自动化 Spotify 音乐播放、歌单管理与音频分析工作流程

description: Audit your LaunchDarkly feature flags to understand the landscape, find stale or launched flags, and assess removal readiness. Use when the user asks about flag debt, stale flags, cleanup candidates, flag health, or wants to understand their flag inventory.
description_zh: 审计您的 LaunchDarkly 特性标志，以了解整体情况，查找过时或已上线标志，并评估移除准备就绪性。当用户询问标志负债、过时标志、清理候选项、标志健康状况，或希望了解其标志清单时使用。

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, or validate Salesforce List View metadata. Trigger when users mention list views, filtered record lists, creating views, setting up record columns, filtering records by criteria, or ask about list view visibility. Also use when users say things like "I need a view that shows...", "filter records by...", "create a list view for...", or when they're working with ListView XML files and need validation or troubleshooting.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 列表视图元数据时，请使用此技能。当用户提及列表视图、过滤后的记录列表、创建视图、设置记录列、按条件过滤记录或询问列表视图可见性时，即触发使用此技能。当用户说出类似“我需要一个能显示...的视图”、“按...过滤记录”、“为...创建列表视图”等表述，或当用户处理 ListView XML 文件且需要进行验证或故障排除时，也应使用此技能。

description: ALWAYS use this skill when working on ecommerce storefronts, online stores, shopping sites. Use for ANY storefront component including checkout pages, cart, payment flows, product pages, product listings, navigation, homepage, or ANY page/component in a storefront. CRITICAL for adding checkout, implementing cart, integrating Medusa backend, or building any ecommerce functionality. Framework-agnostic (Next.js, SvelteKit, TanStack Start, React, Vue). Provides patterns, decision frameworks, backend integration guidance.
description_zh: 在进行电商店面、在线商店或购物网站开发时，始终使用此技能。适用于任何店面组件，包括结账页面、购物车、支付流程、产品页面、产品列表、导航、首页，以及店面的任何页面/组件。对于添加结账功能、实现购物车、集成 Medusa 后端，或构建任何电商功能至关重要。框架无关（Next.js、SvelteKit、TanStack Start、React、Vue）。提供模式、决策框架和后端集成指导。

description_zh: 使用 docassemble 构建交互式文档表单和问卷

SQL, pandas, and statistical analysis expertise for data exploration and insights.

or when user mentions data analysis, SQL, pandas, statistics, or needs help exploring datasets.

具备SQL、pandas及统计分析的专业能力，用于数据探索与洞察。
使用场景：分析数据、编写SQL查询、使用pandas、进行统计分析，
或当用户提及数据分析、SQL、pandas、统计，或需要帮助探索数据集时。

description_zh: 研究公司与联系信息，用于销售外展

description_zh: 适用于从特定 URL 及目标描述快速生成单个 OpenCLI 命令的场景。四步流程：打开页面、捕获 API、编写 TS 适配器、测试。如需对完整站点进行探索，请使用 opencli-explorer。

description_zh: 根据 Git 提交、更新或功能列表生成发布说明

description_zh: 整理、分类并跟踪发票和收据

输入内容仅包含格式符号">"，没有需要翻译的文本内容，因此无需翻译。如有具体文本需要翻译，请提供内容。

description: Guides developers through client library installation and authentication setup steps for the Data Manager API. Use this skill when a user is getting started with the Data Manager API and needs to setup their local environment, install the client library, or setup access to the API. Don't use for implementing audience or event ingestion logic (use the data-manager-api-audience-ingestion or data-manager-api-event-ingestion skills instead).

description: Build, review, or improve networking code in iOS/macOS apps using URLSession with async/await, structured concurrency, and modern Swift patterns. description: Use this skill when authoring PolicyRuleDefinition and PolicyRuleDefinitionSet metadata XML for Salesforce Data Cloud governance policies, or when editing *.policyRuleDefinition / *.policyRuleDefinitionSet files. Do NOT use this skill for UserAccessPolicy, AccessPolicy, SharingRules, PermissionSet, or any other access-control metadata type — those have their own types and live outside the PolicyRuleDefinition schema.

description: Stand up Grafana Tempo as a cost-efficient distributed-tracing backend that only needs object storage, and write TraceQL queries against it. Covers OTLP + Jaeger + Zipkin ingestion, the distributor → live-store → block-builder → object-storage write path, metrics-generator for RED spanmetrics + service graphs, Helm `tempo-distributed` deployment, multi-tenant `X-Scope-OrgID`, TraceQL span / resource / event scopes, structural operators (`>>`, `<<`), `rate()` + `quantile_over_time` metrics, and the traces-to-logs / metrics / profiles datasource links. Use when deploying Tempo, writing a TraceQL query for slow / errored requests, debugging "no traces showing in Explore", sizing queriers / compactors, configuring S3 / GCS / Azure block storage, or wiring trace ↔ log ↔ profile correlation — even when the user says "tracing backend", "find slow requests", "show me the service graph", "store traces in S3", "Jaeger compatible store", or "what called this span" without naming Tempo.
description_zh: 将 Grafana Tempo 部署为经济高效、仅依赖对象存储的分布式追踪后端，并针对其后端编写 TraceQL 查询。涵盖 OTLP、Jaeger、Zipkin 数据摄入，分发器 → 实时存储 → 区块构建器 → 对象存储写入路径，RED span 指标和服务图的指标生成功能，Helm `tempo-distributed` 部署，多租户 `X-Scope-OrgID`、TraceQL 的 span / resource / event 作用域、结构化运算符（`>>`、`<<`）、`rate()` 指标与 `quantile_over_time` 指标，以及追踪到日志 / 指标 / 配置的数据源链接。适用于部署 Tempo、为慢请求 / 错误请求编写 TraceQL 查询、调试 "Explore 中无追踪显示"、调整查询器 / 压缩器的规模、配置 S3 / GCS / Azure 块存储、连接追踪 ↔ 日志 ↔ 配置的相关性，即使用户在不提及 Tempo 的情况下说 "追踪后端"、"查找慢请求"、"显示服务图"、"将追踪存储在 S3"、"兼容 Jaeger 的存储" 或 "这个 span 由谁调用"。

description: Configures Amazon CloudFront content delivery across six workflows: when to use CloudFront and how it fits with AWS WAF, Shield, CloudFront Functions, Lambda@Edge, Route 53, and origins (creating a distribution, caching, and Flat Rate Pricing (FRP) versus pay-as-you-go pricing); managing custom-domain TLS certificates (ACM in us-east-1); configuring multi-tenant distributions; protecting origins with origin access control (OAC), VPC origins, and origin mutual TLS (mTLS); securing content with signed URLs and cookies, geographic restrictions, viewer mutual TLS, and edge token validation; and observing traffic with standard and real-time logs. Applicable when the customer wants to put CloudFront in front of content, choose pricing, lock an origin, restrict who can view content, or analyze logs. Not applicable for the Route 53 DNS side of a CloudFront custom domain or failover between distributions (see the route53-cloudfront skill), or for pure-Route 53 DNS work (see the route53 skill).
description_zh: 跨六个工作流配置 Amazon CloudFront 内容分发：何时使用 CloudFront 以及其与 AWS WAF、Shield、CloudFront Functions、Lambda@Edge、Route 53 和源站的配合方式（创建分发、缓存以及按量付费定价与 Flat Rate Pricing (FRP) 之间的选择）；管理自定义域名 TLS 证书（在 us-east-1 中使用 ACM）；配置多租户分发；通过源站访问控制（OAC）、VPC 源站和源站双向 TLS（mTLS）来保护源站；通过签名 URL 和 Cookie、地理限制、查看者双向 TLS 和边缘令牌验证来保护内容；以及使用标准日志和实时日志观测流量。适用于客户希望将 CloudFront 部署在内容前面、选择定价、锁定源站、限制内容查看权限或分析日志的场景。不适用于 CloudFront 自定义域名的 Route 53 DNS 部分，或分发之间的故障转移（参见 route53-cloudfront 技能），也不适用于纯 Route 53 DNS 工作（参见 route53 技能）。

description: Help address review/issue comments on the open GitHub PR for the current branch using gh CLI; verify gh auth first and prompt the user to authenticate if not logged in.
description_zh: 使用 gh CLI 协助处理当前分支开放 GitHub PR 上的评审意见及 Issue 评论；首先验证 gh 认证，若未登录则提示用户进行认证。

description: Headless, performant, and type-safe form state management for TS/JS, React, Vue, Angular, Solid, Lit, and Svelte.
description_zh: 面向 TS/JS、React、Vue、Angular、Solid、Lit 和 Svelte 的无头、高性能、类型安全的表单状态管理

description: This skill should be used whenever users need help planning trips, creating travel itineraries, managing travel budgets, or seeking destination advice. On first use, collects comprehensive travel preferences including budget level, travel style, interests, and dietary restrictions. Generates detailed travel plans with day-by-day itineraries, budget breakdowns, packing checklists, cultural do's and don'ts, and region-specific schedules. Maintains database of preferences and past trips for personalized recommendations.
description_zh: 本技能应在使用者需要规划旅行、制定旅行行程、管理旅行预算或寻求目的地建议时使用。首次使用时，将收集包括预算水平、旅行风格、兴趣及饮食限制在内的全面旅行偏好。生成包含每日行程、预算明细、行李打包清单、文化注意事项及区域特定安排在内的详细旅行计划。维护偏好及过往旅行记录数据库，以提供个性化推荐。
您提供的源文本为空，暂无可翻译的内容。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for React Native and Expo. Use when asked to "add Sentry to React Native", "install @sentry/react-native", "setup Sentry in Expo", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, or logging for React Native applications. Supports Expo managed, Expo bare, and vanilla React Native.
description_zh: React Native 和 Expo 的完整 Sentry SDK 设置。当被要求“将 Sentry 添加到 React Native”、“安装 @sentry/react-native”、“在 Expo 中设置 Sentry”，或为 React Native 应用程序配置错误监控、追踪、性能分析、会话重放或日志功能时使用。支持 Expo managed、Expo bare 和原生 React Native。

description: Manual-only skill for minimizing total codebase size. Only activate when explicitly requested by user. Measures success by final code amount, not effort. Bias toward deletion.
description_zh: 仅手动触发的技能，旨在最小化代码库总体规模。仅在用户明确请求时激活。以最终代码量而非所耗精力来衡量成功，并偏向删除。

description: Automate customer support workflows with Zendesk ticket management, routing, and analytics
description_zh: 通过 Zendom 工单管理、路由与分析，实现客户支持工作流的自动化

description: Load automatically when planning, researching, or implementing Medusa Admin dashboard UI (widgets, custom pages, forms, tables, data loading, navigation). REQUIRED for all admin UI work in ALL modes (planning, implementation, exploration). Contains design patterns, component usage, and data loading patterns that MCP servers don't provide.
description_zh: 在规划、研究或实施 Medusa Admin 仪表盘 UI（组件、自定义页面、表单、表格、数据加载、导航）时自动加载。必需适用于所有模式（规划、实施、探索）下的所有后台 UI 工作，包含 MCP 服务器未提供的设计模式、组件使用方式及数据加载模式。

description: Connect Claude to external apps like Gmail, Slack, GitHub. Use this skill when the user wants to send emails, create issues, post messages, or take actions in external services.
description_zh: 将 Claude 连接到 Gmail、Slack、GitHub 等外部应用。当用户需要发送邮件、创建问题、发布消息或在外设服务中执行操作时，使用此技能。

description: Intelligent lead assignment and routing - AI-powered scoring, territory mapping, round-robin distribution, and workload balancing
description_zh: 智能线索分配与路由 - AI驱动的评分、区域地图、轮询分配和负载均衡

description: Skill for creating and managing a Design System using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. Use when defining design tokens, setting up theming with CSS variables, building a consistent UI component library, initializing a design system configuration, or wrapping shadcn/ui components into design system primitives.
description_zh: 使用 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 创建和管理设计系统的技能。适用于定义设计令牌、使用 CSS 变量设置主题、构建统一的 UI 组件库、初始化设计系统配置，或将 shadcn/ui 组件封装为设计系统原语。

description: Automate weather-based workflows, forecasts, alerts, and location-aware notifications
description_zh: 自动化天气相关工作流程、预报、警报及位置感知通知。

description: Write or review UX copy — microcopy, error messages, empty states, CTAs. Trigger with "write copy for", "what should this button say?", "review this error message", or when naming a CTA, wording a confirmation dialog, filling an empty state, or writing onboarding text.
description_zh: 撰写或审阅 UX 文案——微文案、错误消息、空状态、行动召唤（CTA）。触发方式包括使用“write copy for”“what should this button say?”“review this error message”，或在命名 CTA、撰写确认对话框文案、完善空状态、撰写引导文本时触发。

description: Create formal employment offer letters with compensation and terms
description_zh: 创建包含薪酬和条款的正式雇佣录用信。

description: Guidelines for building production-ready Convex apps covering function organization, query patterns, validation, TypeScript usage, error handling, and the Zen of Convex design philosophy
description_zh: 构建生产就绪 Convex 应用的指南：涵盖函数组织、查询模式、验证、TypeScript 使用、错误处理，以及 Convex 设计哲学的禅意

description: This skill should be used when creating a Claude Code slash command. Use when users ask to "create a command", "make a slash command", "add a command", or want to document a workflow as a reusable command. Essential for creating optimized, agent-executable slash commands with proper structure and best practices.
description_zh: 在创建 Claude Code 斜杠命令时，应使用本技能。当用户要求“创建命令”、“创建斜杠命令”、“添加命令”，或希望将工作流记录为可复用命令时，应使用本技能。对于创建优化、可由智能体执行、结构规范且符合最佳实践的斜杠命令至关重要。

description:
查理·芒格的思维框架与表达方式。基于《穷查理宝典》、伯克希尔/Daily Journal股东会、
USC/哈佛演讲、访谈记录、外部批评等50+来源的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用芒格的视角分析问题、审视决策、提供反馈。
当用户提到「用芒格的视角」「芒格会怎么看」「芒格模式」「munger perspective」时使用。
也适用于：投资决策审视、认知偏误检查、跨学科思考训练、逆向思考练习。
即使用户只是说「逆向思考一下」「这有什么认知偏误」「Lollapalooza效应」「能力圈之外」「激励结构是什么」也可触发。
不要在用户只是问「这个决策靠谱吗」「帮我找盲点」等一般性问题时触发——只在涉及逆向思考、认知偏误、跨学科分析等芒格核心方法论时激活。
