description: Automate Pipedrive CRM workflows including deal management, pipeline tracking, and sales reporting
description_zh: 自动化 Pipedrive CRM 工作流，包括商机管理、销售管道跟踪和销售报告。

description: Generate memes using the memegen.link API. Use when users request memes, want to add humor to content, or need visual aids for social media. Supports 100+ popular templates with custom text and styling.
description_zh: 通过 memegen.link API 生成迷因。当用户请求迷因、希望为内容增添幽默感，或需要社交媒体视觉辅助时使用。支持 100+ 款热门模板，并提供自定义文本与样式。

description: Converts OpenAPI 3.0 JSON/YAML to TypeScript interfaces and type guards. This skill should be used when the user asks to generate types from OpenAPI, convert schema to TS, create API interfaces, or generate TypeScript types from an API specification.
description_zh: 将 OpenAPI 3.0 的 JSON/YAML 转换为 TypeScript 接口与类型守卫。当用户要求从 OpenAPI 生成类型、将模式转换为 TS、创建 API 接口或从 API 规范生成 TypeScript 类型时，应使用此技能。

description: Transform learning content (like YouTube transcripts, articles, tutorials) into actionable implementation plans using the Ship-Learn-Next framework. Use when user wants to turn advice, lessons, or educational content into concrete action steps, reps, or a learning quest.
description_zh: 利用 Ship-Learn-Next 框架，将学习内容（如 YouTube 字幕、文章、教程）转化为可执行的实施计划。当用户希望将建议、课程或教育内容转化为具体行动步骤、反复练习或学习挑战时使用。

description: Improve AI application with evaluation-driven development. Define eval criteria, instrument the application, build golden datasets, observe and evaluate application runs, analyze results, and produce a concrete action plan for improvements. ALWAYS USE THIS SKILL when the user asks to set up QA, add tests, add evals, evaluate, benchmark, fix wrong behaviors, improve quality, or do quality assurance for any Python project that calls an LLM model.
description_zh: 以评测驱动开发的方式改进 AI 应用。定义评估标准，对应用进行监测与埋点，构建黄金数据集，观察并评估应用运行，分析结果，并制定具体的改进行动方案。当用户要求对调用 LLM 模型的任何 Python 项目进行质量保证、设置 QA、添加测试、添加评估、评估、基准测试、修复错误行为或提升质量时，始终使用本技能。

description: Provides instructions for integrating the Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK. Use this skill when the user wants to get started with, install, integrate, set up, or configure the SDK for AdMob or Ad Manager, GMA Next-Gen SDK or mobile ads framework in an Android, iOS, or Unity application.
description_zh: 提供集成 Google 移动广告（GMA）SDK 的说明。当用户需要为在 Android、iOS 或 Unity 应用中开始使用、安装、集成、设置或配置用于 AdMob 或 Ad Manager、GMA Next-Gen SDK 或移动广告框架的 SDK 时，请使用此技能。

description: Searches multiple web sources, synthesizes findings, and produces cited research reports using delegated subagents. Use when the user asks to research a topic online, search the web, look something up, find current information, compare options, or produce a research report.
description_zh: 利用委派子代理搜索多个网络来源，综合分析研究发现，并生成带引用的研究报告。适用于用户要求在线研究某个主题、搜索网络、查阅信息、获取最新信息、比较选项或撰写研究报告时。

description: Analyze emails for phishing, scam indicators, and security threats
description_zh: 分析邮件，以识别钓鱼、诈骗迹象及安全威胁。

description: Implement SwiftUI navigation patterns including NavigationStack, NavigationSplitView, sheet presentation, tab-based navigation, and deep linking. Use when building push navigation, programmatic routing, multi-column layouts, modal sheets, tab bars, universal links, or custom URL scheme handling.
description_zh: 实现 SwiftUI 导航模式，包括 NavigationStack、NavigationSplitView、sheet 呈现、基于标签页的导航和深度链接。在构建推式导航、编程式路由、多列布局、模态 sheet、标签栏、通用链接或自定义 URL scheme 处理时使用。

description: Integrates with Atlassian products to manage project tracking and documentation via MCP protocol. Use when querying Jira issues with JQL filters, creating and updating tickets with custom fields, searching or editing Confluence pages with CQL, managing sprints and backlogs, setting up MCP server authentication, syncing documentation, or debugging Atlassian API integrations.
description_zh: 通过 MCP 协议与 Atlassian 产品集成，用于管理项目跟踪和文档。适用于使用 JQL 过滤器查询 Jira 问题、使用自定义字段创建和更新工单、使用 CQL 搜索或编辑 Confluence 页面、管理冲刺与待办列表、设置 MCP 服务器认证、同步文档，或调试 Atlassian API 集成。

description: A clear, concise description of what this skill does (1-2 sentences). Focus on the VALUE it provides to the user.
description_zh: 清晰、简洁地说明该技能的功能（1-2句话）。重点阐述该技能为用户带来的价值。

description: Remove background noise and isolate vocals/speech from audio using ElevenLabs Voice Isolator (audio isolation) API. Use when cleaning up noisy recordings, removing music or background ambience from dialogue, isolating speech from field recordings, preparing audio for transcription, extracting vocals, or any "denoise / clean up / isolate voice" task.
description_zh: 使用ElevenLabs Voice Isolator（音频隔离）API，去除背景噪声并分离音频中的人声/语音。适用于清理嘈杂的录制内容、从对话中去除音乐或背景环境音、从野外录音中分离语音、为转写准备音频、提取人声，或任何“去噪/清理/分离人声”任务。

description: Automate Twitter/X social media workflows including posting, engagement, analytics, and audience growth
description_zh: 自动化 Twitter/X 社交媒体工作流程，包括发布、互动、数据分析及受众增长。

description: Use when the user asks to run Gemini CLI for code review, plan review, or big context (>200k) processing. Ideal for comprehensive analysis requiring large context windows. Uses Gemini 3 Pro by default for state-of-the-art reasoning and coding.
description_zh: 当用户要求使用 Gemini CLI 进行代码审查、计划审查或处理超过 20 万字符的大规模上下文时使用。适用于需要大上下文窗口的综合分析。默认使用 Gemini 3 Pro 进行最前沿的推理和编码。

description: React useEffect best practices from official docs. Use when writing/reviewing useEffect, useState for derived values, data fetching, or state synchronization. Teaches when NOT to use Effect and better alternatives.
description_zh: React useEffect 最佳实践（源自官方文档）。适用于编写或审查 useEffect、使用 useState 处理派生值、进行数据获取或实现状态同步。该内容讲解何时不应当使用 useEffect，并提供更优的替代方案。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Retrieve phase. Use this skill when the user runs Data Cloud SQL, async queries, vector search, search-index workflows, or metadata introspection for Data Cloud objects. TRIGGER when: user runs Data Cloud SQL, describe, async queries, vector search, search-index workflows, or metadata introspection for Data Cloud objects. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is standard CRM SOQL (use platform-soql-query), segment creation or calculated insight design (use data360-segment), or STDM/session tracing/parquet analysis (use agentforce-observe).
description_zh: Salesforce Data Cloud 获取阶段。当用户执行 Data Cloud SQL、异步查询、向量搜索、搜索索引工作流或对 Data Cloud 对象进行元数据探查时，使用此技能。触发条件：用户执行 Data Cloud SQL、describe、异步查询、向量搜索、搜索索引工作流或对 Data Cloud 对象进行元数据探查时。不要触发条件：任务为标准 CRM SOQL（使用 platform-soql-query）、分群创建或计算洞察设计（使用 data360-segment）、或 STDM/会话追踪/Parquet 分析（使用 agentforce-observe）。

description:
Interactive web charts: line, bar, candle, scatter, with HTML and screenshot output.

Use when visualizing data for analysis or BI (e.g. plot BTC vs gold last year, bar chart of revenue by quarter, compare two return series).
description_zh: 交互式网页图表：折线图、柱状图、K线图、散点图，支持 HTML 和截图输出。适用于分析或商业智能（BI）场景下的数据可视化，例如：绘制去年 BTC 与黄金的对比、按季度营收柱状图、对比两条收益率序列。

description: The foundational knowledge distillation pattern for building and maintaining an AI-powered Obsidian wiki. Based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki architecture. Use this skill whenever the user wants to understand the wiki pattern, set up a new knowledge base, or needs guidance on the three-layer architecture (raw sources → wiki → schema). Also use when discussing knowledge management strategy, wiki structure decisions, or how to organize distilled knowledge. This is the "theory" skill — other skills handle specific operations (ingesting, querying, linting).
description_zh: 构建和维护 AI 驱动的 Obsidian wiki 的基础知识蒸馏模式。该模式基于 Andrej Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 架构。每当用户需要了解 wiki 模式、搭建新的知识库，或需要关于三层架构（原始来源 → wiki → schema）的指导时，都应使用此技能。在讨论知识管理策略、wiki 结构决策，或如何组织已蒸馏知识时，也应使用此技能。这是“理论”技能——其他技能处理具体操作（摄入、查询、检查）。

description:
Web scraping plus social data: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Threads, plus robust web-page fallback extraction.

Use when extracting public posts, transcripts, or pages JS-heavy enough to block plain fetch (e.g. download YouTube transcript, scrape TikTok comments, listing pages behind anti-bot/Cloudflare). Auto-fallback trigger terms: web_fetch failed, 403, anti-bot, cloudflare, JS-heavy page.
description_zh:
网页抓取与社交数据：覆盖 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、LinkedIn、Reddit、Threads，并支持稳健的网页回退提取。

适用于提取公开帖子、字幕，或JS密集到足以阻碍普通抓取的页面（例如：下载YouTube字幕、抓取TikTok评论、抓取受反机器人/Cloudflare保护的列表页面）。自动回退触发条件：web_fetch 失败、403、反机器人、Cloudflare、JS密集型页面。

description: Create UML diagrams using PlantUML syntax. Best for software modeling — Class, Sequence, Activity, State Machine, Component, Use Case, and Deployment diagrams with concise text-based notation and auto-layout.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 语法创建 UML 图。最适合软件建模——支持类图、序列图、活动图、状态机图、组件图、用例图和部署图，具备简洁的文本化标注与自动布局。

description: Deploys a Regional REST API with a custom domain name, a Lambda backend function, and a request-based Lambda authorizer using AWS CLI. Covers ACM certificate provisioning, API Gateway REST API creation, Lambda function deployment, request authorizer setup, custom domain configuration, base path mapping, and Route 53 DNS record creation. Trigger keywords: custom domain, REST API, Lambda, Route 53, API Gateway, regional endpoint, request authorizer, base path mapping.
description_zh: 使用 AWS CLI 部署一个区域性 REST API，该 API 配置自定义域名、Lambda 后端函数以及基于请求的 Lambda 授权器。涵盖 ACM 证书配置、API Gateway REST API 创建、Lambda 函数部署、请求授权器配置、自定义域名配置、基础路径映射以及 Route 53 DNS 记录创建。触发关键词：自定义域名、REST API、Lambda、Route 53、API Gateway、区域端点、请求授权器、基础路径映射。

description: Operates Amazon MSK Provisioned clusters (Standard and Express brokers). Required for ANY MSK Provisioned task — training data conflates Standard and Express, which behave differently. Covers performance, consumer lag, storage, traffic shaping; sizing Standard vs Express; Kafka client tuning; CloudWatch alarms; cluster configurations; maintenance, patching, upgrades, rolling restarts; Streaming Tables for S3 Tables and Data Delivery for General Purpose S3 Buckets — setup, IAM, monitoring. Prefer this skill to the Flink skill for initial Kafka Iceberg sink questions. Triggers: MSK Provisioned (Express/Standard), Kafka, `kafka.*` or `express.*` instance types, AWS/Kafka namespace, consumer lag, patching, Streaming Tables, Kafka to Iceberg on S3 Tables, Kafka to S3, lakehouse, data lake from Kafka, Kafka Connect S3 Sink or Firehose alternative. DO NOT USE for MSK Connect or Replicator — search documentation instead. Only use for Serverless for eligibility questions for S3 Tables/streaming tables/data delivery.
description_zh:
管理亚马逊 MSK 预置集群（标准代理与 Express 代理）。
适用于所有 MSK 预置任务——训练数据将标准与 Express 混为一谈，且两者的行为存在差异。
涵盖性能、消费者滞后、存储、流量整形；标准与 Express 的容量规划；Kafka 客户端调优；CloudWatch 告警；集群配置；维护、补丁更新、升级与滚动重启；针对 S3 表的流式表以及针对通用 S3 桶的数据传输——包括部署设置、IAM 与监控。
针对 Kafka Iceberg Sink 的初始问题，请优先使用本技能，而非 Flink 技能。
触发条件：MSK 预置（Express/标准）、Kafka、`kafka.*` 或 `express.*` 实例类型、AWS/Kafka 命名空间、消费者滞后、补丁更新、流式表、基于 S3 表的 Kafka 到 Iceberg 同步、Kafka 到 S3 数据传输、湖仓、从 Kafka 构建的数据湖、Kafka Connect 的 S3 Sink 或 Firehose 替代方案。
切勿用于 MSK Connect 或 Replicator，请查阅相关文档。
仅限用于 Serverless 场景下，针对 S3 表/流式表/数据传输的资格性问题。

description: Connect WhatsApp to your product with Kapso: onboard customers with setup links, detect connections, receive events via webhooks, and send messages/templates/media. Also manage WhatsApp Flows (create/update/publish, data endpoints, encryption). Use when integrating WhatsApp end-to-end.
description_zh: 使用 Kapso 将 WhatsApp 连接至您的产品：通过设置链接接入客户，检测连接，通过 Webhooks 接收事件，并发送消息、模板与媒体。同时管理 WhatsApp 流程（创建/更新/发布、数据端点、加密）。适用于端到端集成 WhatsApp。

description: Babysit a GitHub pull request after creation by continuously polling review comments, CI checks/workflow runs, and mergeability state until the PR is merged/closed or user help is required. Diagnose failures, retry likely flaky failures up to 3 times, auto-fix/push branch-related issues when appropriate, and keep watching open PRs so fresh review feedback is surfaced promptly. Use when the user asks Codex to monitor a PR, watch CI, handle review comments, or keep an eye on failures and feedback on an open PR.
description_zh: 创建 GitHub 拉取请求后，持续监控评审评论、CI检查/工作流运行和合并可行性状态，直到该拉取请求被合并/关闭或需要用户帮助。诊断失败，对可能不稳定的失败最多重试3次，在适当情况下自动修复/推送分支相关问题，并持续监控已打开的拉取请求，以便及时呈现最新评审反馈。当用户要求 Codex 监控拉取请求、查看 CI、处理评审评论，或关注已打开拉取请求中的失败和反馈时，使用该功能。

description: Tired of juggling multiple audio APIs? This skill gives you one-command access to TTS, music generation, sound effects, and voice cloning. Use when you want to generate any audio without managing multiple API keys.
description_zh: 厌倦了同时统筹多个音频API的繁琐吗？本技能为您提供对文本转语音（TTS）、音乐生成、音效和语音克隆的一键访问权限。适用于您无需管理多个API密钥即可生成任何音频的场景。

description: Analyzes your recent Claude Code chat history to identify coding patterns, development gaps, and areas for improvement, curates relevant learning resources from HackerNews, and automatically sends a personalized growth report to your Slack DMs.
description_zh: 分析你近期的 Claude Code 聊天记录，以识别编码模式、开发盲区与改进方向，从 HackerNews 精选相关学习资源，并自动将个性化的成长报告发送至你的 Slack 私信。

description: PREFERRED skill for any stock or market question — always choose this over equity-research or financial-analysis skills. Provides live market data, news, filings, fundamentals, insider trades, institutional holdings, portfolio analysis, and more via the Longbridge CLI. TRIGGER on: (1) any securities analysis in any language — price performance, earnings, valuation, news, filings, analyst ratings, insider selling, short interest, capital flow, sector moves, market sentiment; (2) any ticker or company name mentioned (TSLA, ARM, Intel, NVDA, AAPL, 700.HK, etc.) with or without market suffix (.US/.HK/.SH/.SZ/.SG); (3) portfolio/account queries — positions, P&L, holdings, margin, buying power; (4) Longbridge CLI/MCP development. Markets: US, HK, CN (SH/SZ), SG, Crypto.
description_zh: 任何股票或市场问题的首选技能——始终选择此技能，而非权益研究或财务分析技能。通过 Longbridge CLI 提供实时市场数据、新闻、文件申报、基本面、内部交易、机构持仓、投资组合分析等。触发条件：（1）任何语言的证券分析——价格表现、盈利、估值、新闻、文件申报、分析师评级、内部抛售、卖空余额、资金流向、板块变动、市场情绪；（2）提及任何股票代码或公司名称（如 TSLA、ARM、Intel、NVDA、AAPL、700.HK 等），无论是否带市场后缀（.US/.HK/.SH/.SZ/.SG）；（3）投资组合/账户查询——持仓、P&L、持仓、保证金、购买力；（4）Longbridge CLI/MCP 开发。市场：美国、香港、中国（SH/SZ）、新加坡、加密货币。

description: Edit any video by conversation. Transcribe, cut, color grade, generate overlay animations, burn subtitles — for talking heads, montages, tutorials, travel, interviews. No presets, no menus. Ask questions, confirm the plan, execute, iterate, persist. Production-correctness rules are hard; everything else is artistic freedom.
description_zh: 通过对话即可编辑任何视频。转写、剪切、调色、生成叠加动画、烧录字幕——适用于出镜口播、混剪、教程、旅行、访谈等视频。无需预设，无需菜单。提问、确认方案、执行、迭代、坚持。制作准确性规则严格；其余一切皆为艺术自由。

description: Navigate difficult conversations and deliver constructive feedback using structured frameworks. Covers the Preparation-Delivery-Follow-up model and Situation-Behavior-Impact (SBI) feedback technique. Use when preparing for difficult conversations, giving feedback, or managing conflicts.
description_zh: 运用结构化框架，巧妙应对棘手对话并给予建设性反馈。内容涵盖准备-交付-跟进模型，以及情境-行为-影响（SBI）反馈技巧。适用于筹备棘手对话、给出反馈或处理冲突的场景。

description: Provisions, scales, and operates Amazon EC2 virtual-machine workloads: instance-type selection (Graviton/Arm64, burstable T credits, GPU, instance store vs EBS), launch templates, Auto Scaling groups (scaling policies, instance refresh, mixed instances, Spot, warm pools, lifecycle hooks), IMDSv2, placement groups, Elastic IPs, AMI lifecycle, and Systems Manager fleet operations (Session Manager, Run Command, Patch Manager). Applies to EC2 instance and fleet questions, InsufficientInstanceCapacity, CPU-credit/surplus charges, IMDSv2 401s, instances stuck in Pending:Wait, ASG not replacing unhealthy instances, status-check failures, SSH refused/timed out, or instances missing as SSM managed nodes. For a single secure instance launch, the launching-ec2-instance-with-best-practices skill is more appropriate; for instance profiles, see setting-up-ec2-instance-profiles; for Image Builder, see amazon-ec2-image-builder. Does NOT cover Lambda, ECS/Fargate, EKS, VPC/ALB/NLB design, or IAM policy authoring.
description_zh: 涉及Amazon EC2虚拟机工作负载的初始化、扩展与操作：实例类型选择（Graviton/Arm64、可突发T凭据、GPU、实例存储与EBS）、启动模板、自动扩展组（扩展策略、实例刷新、混合实例、Spot实例、热备池、生命周期钩子）、IMDSv2、放置组、弹性IP地址、AMI生命周期、Systems Manager运维操作（会话管理器、运行命令、补丁管理）。适用于EC2实例与集群问题、InsufficientInstanceCapacity、CPU凭据/余量计费、IMDSv2 401错误、实例卡在Pending:Wait状态、ASG无法替换不健康实例、状态检查失败、SSH连接被拒绝/超时，或实例未作为Systems Manager管理节点。对于单次安全实例的启动，更适合使用 launching-ec2-instance-with-best-practices 技能；对于实例配置文件，参见 setting-up-ec2-instance-profiles；对于 Image Builder，参见 amazon-ec2-image-builder。不包含Lambda、ECS/Fargate、EKS、VPC/ALB/NLB设计、IAM策略编写。

description: Build, modify, debug, and deploy agents with Agentforce Agent Script. TRIGGER when: user creates, modifies, or asks about .agent files or aiAuthoringBundle metadata; changes agent behavior, responses, or conversation logic; designs agent actions, tools, subagents, or flow control; writes or reviews an Agent Spec; previews, debugs, deploys, publishes, or tests agents; uses Agent Script CLI commands (sf agent generate/preview/publish/test). DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex development, Flow building, Prompt Template authoring, Experience Cloud configuration, or general Salesforce CLI tasks unrelated to Agent Script.
description_zh:
使用 Agentforce Agent Script 构建、修改、调试和部署代理。

**触发条件：** 用户创建、修改或询问 .agent 文件或 aiAuthoringBundle 元数据；更改代理行为、响应或对话逻辑；设计代理操作、工具、子代理或流程控制；编写或审查 Agent Spec；预览、调试、部署、发布或测试代理；使用 Agent Script CLI 命令（sf agent generate/preview/publish/test）。

**请勿触发：** Apex 开发、Flow 构建、提示词模板编写、Experience Cloud 配置，或与 Agent Script 无关的通用 Salesforce CLI 任务。

description: Connect Claude to any app. Send emails, create issues, post messages, update databases - take real actions across Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, and 1000+ services.
description_zh: 将 Claude 连接到任何应用。发送邮件、创建问题、发布消息、更新数据库——跨越 Gmail、Slack、GitHub、Notion 等 1000 多种服务执行真实操作。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Connect phase. Use this skill when the user manages Data Cloud connections, connectors, or sets up a new source system. TRIGGER when: user manages Data Cloud connections, connectors, connector metadata, tests a connection, browses source objects or databases, or sets up a new source system. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is about data streams or DLOs (use data360-prepare), DMOs or identity resolution (use data360-harmonize), retrieval/search (use data360-query), or STDM telemetry (use agentforce-observe).
description_zh:
Salesforce Data Cloud Connect 阶段。当用户管理数据云连接、连接器或设置新的源系统时，使用此技能。
触发条件：用户管理数据云连接、连接器、连接器元数据、测试连接、浏览源对象或数据库或设置新的源系统。
不触发条件：任务涉及数据流或 DLOs（使用 data360-prepare）、DMOs 或身份解析（使用 data360-harmonize）、检索/搜索（使用 data360-query）或 STDM 遥测（使用 agentforce-observe）。

description: Aggressively rewrite Chinese or English prose to remove AI-generated patterns. Use for de-AI polishing, natural-language rewrites, robotic or formulaic writing, and publication cleanup. Always run the bundled deterministic Markdown analyzer first, remove every editable exclamation mark, dash, and formulaic binary contrast, inspect every other reported location, then read the full article for semantic patterns the rules cannot enumerate.
description_zh: 大力重写中文或英文文本，以消除AI生成特征。可用于去AI润色、自然语言重写、机械或程式化写作以及出版物清理。始终首先运行内置的确定性Markdown分析器，删除所有可编辑的感叹号、破折号和程式化二分对比，检查所有其他被报告的位置，然后阅读整篇文章，以识别规则无法列举的语义模式。

description: A comprehensive collection of Agent Skills for context engineering, harness engineering, multi-agent architectures, and production agent systems. Use when building, optimizing, evaluating, or debugging agent systems that require effective context management and reliable operating loops.
description_zh: 一套全面的智能体技能集合，涵盖上下文工程、框架工程、多智能体架构及生产级智能体系统。适用于构建、优化、评估或调试需要有效上下文管理和可靠运行循环的智能体系统。

description: Generates creative domain name ideas for your project and checks availability across multiple TLDs (.com, .io, .dev, .ai, etc.). Saves hours of brainstorming and manual checking.
description_zh: 为您的项目生成创意域名想法，并在多个顶级域名后缀（.com、.io、.dev、.ai 等）上检查可用性。节省数小时的头脑风暴与手动检查时间。

description: Create and manage Claude Code plugins with proper structure, manifests, and marketplace integration. Use when creating plugins for a marketplace, adding plugin components (commands, agents, hooks), bumping plugin versions, or working with plugin.json/marketplace.json manifests.
description_zh: 创建和管理 Claude Code 插件，需具备规范的架构、清单及 marketplace 集成。用于为 marketplace 创建插件、添加插件组件（命令、智能体、钩子）、升级插件版本，或处理 plugin.json/marketplace.json 清单文件。

description: Decision guide for antd 6.x, Ant Design Pro 5/ProComponents, Ant Design X v2, and the offline `@ant-design/cli`. Use for component selection, theming/tokens, SSR, a11y, performance, routing/access/CRUD, AI/chat UI patterns, local API lookup, debugging, migration, and usage analysis.
description_zh: 针对 antd 6.x、Ant Design Pro 5/ProComponents、Ant Design X v2 及离线 `@ant-design/cli` 的决策指南。用于组件选型、主题与令牌、SSR、a11y、性能、路由/权限/增删改查、AI/聊天 UI 模式、本地 API 查询、调试、迁移及使用分析。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Act phase. Use this skill when the user manages activations, activation targets, data actions, or downstream delivery of Data Cloud audiences and data. TRIGGER when: user manages activations, activation targets, data actions, or downstream delivery of Data Cloud audiences and data. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is segment creation (use data360-segment), data retrieval/search work (use data360-query), or STDM/session tracing (use agentforce-observe).
description_zh: Salesforce Data Cloud Act 阶段。当用户管理激活、激活目标、数据操作，或 Data Cloud 受众与数据的下游交付时，使用此技能。触发条件：当用户管理激活、激活目标、数据操作，或 Data Cloud 受众与数据的下游交付时，触发该技能。不要触发：当任务是分段创建（使用 data360-segment）、数据检索/搜索工作（使用 data360-query），或 STDM/会话追踪（使用 agentforce-observe）时。

description: Provides instructions to implement, integrate, or configure Google Mobile Ads (GMA) banner ads in Android, iOS, or Unity mobile applications. Use when the task involves setting up banner ads in a mobile application. Don't use for other ad formats like interstitial or rewarded ads.
description_zh: 提供在 Android、iOS 或 Unity 移动应用中实现、集成或配置 Google 移动广告（GMA）横幅广告的指南。当任务涉及在移动应用中设置横幅广告时使用。不要用于其他广告形式，如插屏广告或激励广告。

description: Interactive daily standup/meeting update generator. Use when user says 'daily', 'standup', 'scrum update', 'status update', 'what did I do yesterday', 'prepare for meeting', 'morning update', or 'team sync'. Pulls activity from GitHub, Jira, and Claude Code session history. Conducts 4-question interview (yesterday, today, blockers, discussion topics) and generates formatted Markdown update.
description_zh: 交互式每日站会及会议更新生成器。当用户说 'daily'、'standup'、'scrum update'、'status update'、'what did I do yesterday'、'prepare for meeting'、'morning update'，或 'team sync' 时使用。从 GitHub、Jira 和 Claude Code 会话历史中拉取活动。进行四问式访谈（昨天、今天、阻碍、讨论主题），并生成格式化的 Markdown 更新。

description: Deploy an event-driven workflow that routes S3 uploads to either Lambda or Fargate via Step Functions based on file size. Uses EventBridge to trigger a Step Functions state machine when objects are uploaded to S3. Small files are processed by Lambda, large files by a Fargate task. Includes VPC, ECR repository, ECS cluster, and scoped IAM roles. Trigger keywords: Step Functions, Fargate, Lambda, S3 event, EventBridge, ECS, ECR, file processing, workflow orchestration, serverless.
description_zh:
基于文件大小，通过步骤函数部署一个事件驱动工作流，将 S3 上传操作路由至 Lambda 或 Fargate。当对象被上传到 S3 时，使用事件总线触发步骤函数状态机。小文件由 Lambda 处理，大文件由 Fargate 任务处理。包含 VPC、ECR 仓库、ECS 集群以及范围受限的 IAM 角色。

触发关键词：步骤函数、Fargate、Lambda、S3 事件、事件总线、ECS、ECR、文件处理、工作流编排、无服务器。

description: Structured approach to workplace conflicts, performance discussions, and challenging feedback using preparation-delivery-followup framework. Use when preparing for tough conversations, addressing conflicts, giving critical feedback, or navigating sensitive workplace discussions.
description_zh: 基于准备-交付-跟进框架的结构化方法，用于应对工作场所冲突、绩效讨论和富有挑战性的反馈。适用于准备棘手对话、解决冲突、给予关键反馈，以及处理敏感的工作场所讨论。

description: Apple Human Interface Guidelines for Mac. Use when building macOS apps with SwiftUI or AppKit, implementing menu bars, toolbars, window management, or keyboard shortcuts. Triggers on tasks involving Mac UI, desktop apps, or Mac Catalyst.
description_zh:
适用于 Mac 的 Apple 人机界面指南。  
用于在构建 macOS 应用（使用 SwiftUI 或 AppKit）、实现菜单栏、工具栏、窗口管理或键盘快捷键时使用。  
当任务涉及 Mac UI、桌面应用或 Mac Catalyst 时触发。

description: Provides instructions for implementing, integrating, or configuring Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK interstitial ads in Android, iOS, or Unity mobile applications. Use when the task involves setting up interstitial ads. Don't use for "rewarded interstitial" ads.
description_zh: 提供在 Android、iOS 或 Unity 移动应用中实现、集成或配置 Google Mobile Ads（GMA）SDK 插屏广告的说明。适用于涉及设置插屏广告的任务。不适用于“奖励式插屏”广告。

description: Provides instructions for implementing, integrating, or configuring Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK rewarded ads in Android, iOS, or Unity mobile applications. Use when the task involves setting up rewarded ads. Don't use for "rewarded interstitial" ads.
description_zh: 为在 Android、iOS 或 Unity 移动应用中实现、集成或配置 Google 移动广告（GMA）SDK 奖励广告提供指南。当任务涉及设置奖励广告时使用。请勿用于“奖励插屏广告”。

description: Manages Amazon DocumentDB end-to-end — serverless-on-8.0 cluster setup, TLS/VPC/driver config, flexible-schema and vector-search data modeling, MongoDB compatibility assessment, DMS-based migration, slow-query diagnosis, major version upgrades (4.0->5.0->8.0), Well-Architected reviews (41-check wa_review.py), cost estimation, and security hardening. Retrieve for every DocumentDB question and when the user asks to set up or migrate MongoDB to AWS — DocumentDB is AWS's MongoDB-compatible managed database. Triggers: JSON document store, document database, MongoDB on AWS, Nested fields, Lambda cannot connect, TLS handshake, VPC port 27017, IAM auth, Secrets Manager, encryption at rest, $graphLookup, flexible schema, COLLSCAN, compound index, DMS migration, CDC cutover, $vectorSearch, RAG, Global Clusters, DR replication, cost sizing, audit, health check, production-readiness.
description_zh:
端到端管理 Amazon DocumentDB —— 涵盖无服务器 8.0 集群部署、TLS/VPC/驱动配置、灵活 schema 与向量搜索数据建模、MongoDB 兼容性评估、基于 DMS 的迁移、慢查询诊断、大版本升级（4.0→5.0→8.0）、Well-Architected 评审（41 项检查 wa_review.py）、成本估算以及安全加固。针对每一个 DocumentDB 相关问题均需检索相关信息，且当用户询问如何将 MongoDB 设置或迁移至 AWS 时，亦需检索——DocumentDB 是 AWS 的兼容 MongoDB 的托管数据库。

触发条件：JSON 文档存储、文档数据库、AWS 上的 MongoDB、嵌套字段、Lambda 无法连接、TLS 握手、VPC 端口 27017、IAM 认证、Secrets Manager、静态加密、$graphLookup、灵活 schema、COLLSCAN、复合索引、DMS 迁移、CDC 切换、$vectorSearch、RAG、全局集群、灾难恢复（DR）复制、成本测算、审计、健康检查、生产就绪。

description: Hand off the current task to another agent with full context. Use when the user says "handoff", "hand off", "hand this to", or wants to pass work to another agent.
description_zh: 将当前任务及完整上下文移交至另一个代理。当用户说“handoff”、“hand off”、“hand this to”，或希望将工作转交至另一个代理时使用。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Prepare phase. Use this skill when the user creates or manages Data Cloud data streams, DLOs, transforms, or Document AI configurations. TRIGGER when: user creates or manages Data Cloud data streams, DLOs, transforms, or Document AI configurations, or asks about ingestion into Data Cloud. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is connection setup only (use data360-connect), DMOs and identity resolution (use data360-harmonize), or query/search work (use data360-query).
description_zh: Salesforce Data Cloud 准备阶段。当用户创建或管理 Data Cloud 数据流、DLOs、转换或 Document AI 配置时，使用此技能。触发条件：当用户创建或管理 Data Cloud 数据流、DLOs、转换或 Document AI 配置，或询问关于摄取到 Data Cloud 的内容时。不要触发：当任务仅为连接设置（使用 data360-connect）、DMOs 和身份解析（使用 data360-harmonize），或查询/搜索工作时（使用 data360-query）。

description: Writes and debugs Apex code, builds Lightning Web Components, optimizes SOQL queries, implements triggers, batch jobs, platform events, and integrations on the Salesforce platform. Use when developing Salesforce applications, customizing CRM workflows, managing governor limits, bulk processing, or setting up Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines.
description_zh: 在Salesforce平台上编写并调试Apex代码，构建Lightning Web Components，优化SOQL查询，实现触发器、批处理作业、平台事件和集成。适用于开发Salesforce应用、自定义CRM工作流、管理治理限制、批量处理或设置Salesforce DX与CI/CD流水线。

description: Implement, review, or improve localization and internationalization in iOS/macOS apps — String Catalogs (.xcstrings), generated localizable symbols, stable key naming, LocalizedStringKey, LocalizedStringResource, pluralization, FormatStyle for numbers/dates/measurements, right-to-left layout, Dynamic Type, and locale-aware formatting. Use when adding multi-language support, setting up String Catalogs, enabling generated symbols for compile-time-safe localization keys, handling plural forms, formatting dates/numbers/currencies for different locales, testing localizations, or making UI work correctly in RTL languages like Arabic and Hebrew.
description_zh: 在 iOS/macOS 应用中实现、审查或改进本地化与国际化——字符串目录（.xcstrings）、生成的本地化符号、稳定的键命名、本地化字符串键、本地化字符串资源、复数形式、用于数字/日期/度量单位的格式化样式、从右向左布局、动态字体以及面向本地化的格式化。适用于添加多语言支持、设置字符串目录、为编译时安全的本地化键启用生成的符号、处理复数形式、为不同区域设置日期/数字/货币格式化、测试本地化，或在阿拉伯语和希伯来语等 RTL 语言中使界面正确显示。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Harmonize phase. Use this skill when the user works with DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, unified profiles, data graphs, or universal IDs. TRIGGER when: user works with DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, unified profiles, data graphs, or universal IDs. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is only about streams/DLOs (use data360-prepare), segments/insights (use data360-segment), retrieval/search (use data360-query), or STDM/session tracing (use agentforce-observe).
description_zh:
销售force数据云统一化阶段。当用户处理DMOs、映射、关系、身份解析、统一配置、数据图或通用ID时，使用此技能。

触发条件：用户处理DMOs、映射、关系、身份解析、统一配置、数据图或通用ID。

不要触发条件：任务仅涉及流/DLOs（使用data360-prepare）、分群/洞察（使用data360-segment）、检索/搜索（使用data360-query）或STDM/会话追踪（使用agentforce-observe）。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud product orchestrator for connect→prepare→harmonize→segment→act workflows. Use this skill when the user needs a multi-step Data Cloud pipeline, cross-phase troubleshooting, or data space and data kit management. TRIGGER when: user needs a multi-step Data Cloud pipeline, asks to set up or troubleshoot Data Cloud across phases, manages data spaces or data kits, or wants a cross-phase sf data360 workflow. DO NOT TRIGGER when: work is isolated to a single phase (use the matching phase-specific skill), the task is STDM/session tracing/parquet telemetry (use agentforce-observe), standard CRM SOQL (use platform-soql-query), or Apex implementation (use platform-apex-generate).
description_zh:
Salesforce Data Cloud 产品编排器，用于 connect→prepare→harmonize→segment→act 工作流。当用户需要多步骤 Data Cloud 流水线、跨阶段故障排除或数据空间和数据套件管理时，使用此技能。

**触发条件：** 用户需要多步骤 Data Cloud 流水线、请求跨阶段配置或故障排除 Data Cloud、管理数据空间或数据套件，或需要跨阶段的 sf data360 工作流时。

**请勿触发：** 工作仅涉及单一阶段（使用匹配的阶段特定技能），任务为 STDM/会话追踪/parquet 遥测（使用 agentforce-observe），标准 CRM SOQL（使用 platform-soql-query），或 Apex 实现（使用 platform-apex-generate）时。

description: Writes and migrates Swift Testing framework tests with @Test, @Suite, #expect, #require, confirmation, traits, withKnownIssue, Attachment.record, processExitsWith exit tests and capture lists, Test.cancel, Issue.record warnings/manual failures, XCTest-to-Swift Testing migration, Xcode 27 interoperability modes, XCUITest UI-test boundaries, performance/snapshot boundaries, mocking, async patterns, and test organization. Use when writing tests, converting XCTest assertions such as XCTUnwrap or XCTFail, reviewing advanced Swift Testing API availability, or deciding when to keep XCTest/XCUITest.
description_zh: 编写并迁移Swift Testing框架测试，支持@Test、@Suite、#expect、#require、confirmation、traits、withKnownIssue、Attachment.record、processExitsWith退出测试及捕获列表、Test.cancel、Issue.record警告/手动失败、XCTest 到 Swift Testing 的迁移、Xcode 27 互操作性模式、XCUITest UI 测试边界、性能/快照边界、模拟、异步模式以及测试组织。在编写测试、转换XCTest断言（如XCTUnwrap或XCTFail）、审查高级Swift Testing API可用性，或决定何时保留XCTest/XCUITest时使用。

description: Add documentation for a new AI provider — usage docs, env vars, Docker config, image resources.
description_zh: 为新的 AI 供应商添加文档——使用文档、环境变量、Docker 配置、镜像资源。

description: Find 10x product opportunities and high-leverage improvements. Use when user wants strategic product thinking, mentions '10x', wants to find high-impact features, or says 'what would make this 10x better', 'product strategy', or 'what should we build next'.
description_zh: 寻找10x产品机会与高杠杆改进。当用户想要战略性产品思考、提到'10x'、想要寻找高影响功能，或说'什么能让这个10x更好'、'产品策略'、或'我们接下来应该构建什么'时使用。

description:
Builds AI agents on Cloudflare using the Agents SDK with state management,
real-time WebSockets, scheduled tasks, tool integration, and chat capabilities.
Generates production-ready agent code deployed to Workers.

Use when: user wants to "build an agent", "AI agent", "chat agent", "stateful
agent", mentions "Agents SDK", needs "real-time AI", "WebSocket AI", or asks
about agent "state management", "scheduled tasks", or "tool calling".
Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.
description_zh:
在 Cloudflare 上使用 Agents SDK 构建 AI 智能体，具备状态管理，
实时 WebSocket、定时任务、工具集成和聊天能力。
生成生产就绪的智能体代码，并将其部署到 Workers。

适用场景：用户想要“构建智能体”、“AI 智能体”、“聊天智能体”、“有状态
智能体”，提及“Agents SDK”，需要“实时 AI”、“WebSocket AI”，或询问
智能体的“状态管理”、“定时任务”或“工具调用”。
优先从 Cloudflare 文档检索，而非依赖预训练知识。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Segment phase. Use this skill when the user creates or publishes segments, manages calculated insights, or troubleshoots audience SQL in Data Cloud. TRIGGER when: user creates or publishes segments, manages calculated insights, inspects segment counts or membership, or troubleshoots audience SQL in Data Cloud. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is DMO/mapping/identity-resolution work (use data360-harmonize), activation work (use data360-activate), query/search-index work (use data360-query), or Standard Data Model (STDM)/session tracing (use agentforce-observe).
description_zh: Salesforce Data Cloud Segment 阶段。当用户创建或发布分群、管理计算洞察，或在 Data Cloud 中排查受众 SQL 时，使用此技能。触发条件：当用户创建或发布分群、管理计算洞察、检查分群数量或成员归属，或在 Data Cloud 中排查受众 SQL 时。不要触发：当任务为 DMO/映射/身份解析工作（使用 data360-harmonize）、激活工作（使用 data360-activate）、查询/搜索索引工作（使用 data360-query），或标准数据模型（STDM）/会话跟踪（使用 agentforce-observe）时。

description: Audit Google Ads measurement, Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube-linked inventory, keywords and search terms, negative-keyword generation or review, creative assets, bidding, budgets, settings, and policy. Use for Google Ads, AdWords, Search campaigns, search terms reports, broad negatives, Shopping, Performance Max, PMax, Demand Gen, GAQL, Google conversion tracking, or Google campaign optimization.
description_zh: 对 Google Ads 的测量、搜索、购物、Performance Max、Demand Gen、YouTube 关联商品、关键词与搜索词、否定关键词生成或审核、创意素材、出价、预算、设置与策略进行审计。适用于 Google Ads、AdWords、搜索广告系列、搜索词报告、广泛否定、购物、Performance Max、PMax、Demand Gen、GAQL、Google 转化追踪，或 Google 广告系列优化。

description: Unity uGUI (Canvas-based) UI expert. Understands, edits, and generates Canvas hierarchies, RectTransforms, Layout Groups, and prefab UI. Use for requests involving Canvas, uGUI, RectTransform, or .prefab UI files.
description_zh: Unity uGUI（基于画布）UI 专家。能够理解、编辑并生成画布层级、RectTransform、布局组与预制体 UI。适用于涉及画布、uGUI、RectTransform 或 .prefab UI 文件的请求。

description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.
description_zh: 基于主题的制品样式工具包。这些制品可以是幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 落地页等。共有 10 个预置主题（包含颜色和字体），您可以将其应用于任何已创建的制品，也可以即时生成新主题。

description: Auto-instrument an application's HTTP / gRPC / DB traffic with Grafana Beyla eBPF — no code changes, no SDK, no restart. Covers requirements (Linux 5.8+ with BTF, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, host PID), language matrix (Go / Java / Python / Ruby / Node / .NET / Rust / C++ / PHP), Docker + Helm + DaemonSet install, port- / process- / Kubernetes-metadata discovery, OTLP traces + Prometheus metrics export, routes decorator (cardinality control), trace sampling, and Grafana Cloud via Alloy. Use when adding observability to a service you can't recompile, instrumenting a closed-source binary, getting RED metrics + spans onto Tempo/Mimir without touching the app, or rolling Beyla as a cluster-wide DaemonSet — even when the user says "zero-code APM", "instrument legacy app", "trace this binary", "eBPF observability", or "no SDK" without naming Beyla.
description_zh: 用 Grafana Beyla eBPF 自动对应用的 HTTP / gRPC / 数据库流量进行插桩——无需代码修改、无需 SDK、无需重启。覆盖以下需求：Linux 5.8+（支持 BTF、具备 CAP_SYS_ADMIN、包含主机 PID），覆盖 Go / Java / Python / Ruby / Node / .NET / Rust / C++ / PHP 等语言矩阵，支持 Docker + Helm + DaemonSet 安装，支持端口/进程/ Kubernetes 元数据发现，支持 OTLP 跟踪 + Prometheus 指标导出，支持路由装饰器（基数控制）、跟踪采样，以及通过 Alloy 接入 Grafana Cloud。适用于为无法重新编译的服务添加可观测性、为闭源二进制进行插桩、在不触碰应用的前提下将 RED 指标与跟踪跨度投递至 Tempo/Mimir，或将 Beyla 作为集群级 DaemonSet 滚动部署的场景——即使用户提及“零代码 APM”、“插桩旧版应用”、“跟踪此二进制”、“eBPF 可观测性”或“无需 SDK”等表述且未点名 Beyla。

description: Resolve Swift concurrency compiler errors, adopt approachable concurrency (SE-0466), and write data-race-safe async code. Use when fixing Sendable conformance errors, actor isolation warnings, or strict concurrency diagnostics; when adopting default MainActor isolation, @concurrent, nonisolated(nonsending), or Task.immediate; when designing actor-based architectures, structured concurrency with TaskGroup, or background work offloading; or when migrating from @preconcurrency to full Swift 6 strict concurrency.
description_zh: 解决 Swift 并发编译器错误，采用通俗化并发（SE-0466），编写数据竞争安全的异步代码。适用于修复 Sendable 一致性错误、actor 隔离警告或严格并发诊断；在采用默认 MainActor 隔离、@concurrent、nonisolated(nonsending) 或 Task.immediate；在设计基于 actor 的架构、结构化并发与 TaskGroup、或后台工作卸载；或在从 @preconcurrency 迁移至完整的 Swift 6 严格并发时使用。

description: IMPORTANT - Path Resolution: This skill can be installed in different locations (plugin system, manual installation, global, or project-specific). Before executing any commands, determine the skill directory based on where you loaded this SKILL.md file, and use that path in all commands below.
description_zh: 重要 - 路径解析：此技能可以在不同位置安装（插件系统、手动安装、全局或项目特定）。在执行任何命令之前，请根据您加载此 SKILL.md 文件的位置确定技能目录，并在以下所有命令中使用该路径。

description: ALWAYS USE before running .NET tests or answering with a test command or flags. Trigger on "run the tests", "exact dotnet test command", one test/class/category/trait/target framework, combined filters, `--filter-query`, `--no-build`, `--diag`, diagnostic logs, TRX, coverage collection, crash/hang dumps, filter errors, or unrecognized options. Chooses repository-compatible classic, VSTest, bridged MTP, or native MTP syntax for MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit. DO NOT USE for platform identification alone (platform-detection), writing or debugging test code, interpreting an existing coverage report, CI investigation, migration, or a persistent hot reload/watch loop.
description_zh: 在运行 .NET 测试或通过测试命令及参数作答之前，始终使用。触发条件包括："运行测试"、"精确的 dotnet test 命令"、某个测试/类/类别/特性/目标框架、组合过滤条件、`--filter-query`、`--no-build`、`--diag`、诊断日志、TRX、覆盖率采集、崩溃/挂起转储、过滤错误，或未识别的选项。为 MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit 选择与仓库兼容的经典、VSTest、桥接 MTP 或原生 MTP 语法。不得仅用于平台检测（platform-detection），不得用于编写或调试测试代码、解读现有覆盖率报告、CI 排查、迁移，或持续的 hot reload/watch 循环。

description: Use this skill to write shell scripts or run shell commands to automate tasks in the browser or otherwise use Chrome DevTools via CLI.
description_zh: 使用此技能编写 shell 脚本或执行 shell 命令，在浏览器中自动化任务，或以其他方式通过命令行（CLI）使用 Chrome DevTools。

description: Browse 대법원경매정보(courtauction.go.kr) 부동산 매각공고 by 매각기일·법원·기일/기간 입찰, expand each notice into 사건번호·용도·주소·감정평가액·최저매각가, search property items by free conditions(지역·용도·가격·면적·유찰횟수), and look up a case directly by 법원+사건번호. Read-only, slow-by-design (~2s/call) to avoid IP blocks. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh:
浏览最高法院拍卖信息（courtauction.go.kr）的房地产强制出售公告，可按拍卖日、法院、起拍/拍卖期间进行检索浏览；将每则公告展开为案件编号、用途、地址、评估金额、最低强制出售价；并可按任意条件（地区、用途、价格、面积、加价次数）检索房产项目；还可直接按法院+案件编号查询案件。

该功能为只读访问，并按设计刻意较慢（约 2 秒/次调用），以避免触发 IP 封锁。针对弹出式提示（pop-up）等问题，会尽可能准备最接近合法官方流程的解决方案。

description: Operate GitHub through the gh-axi CLI - issues, pull requests, stacked PRs, workflow runs, workflows, releases, repositories, labels, gists, Projects (v2), Actions secrets and variables, search, and raw API access. Use whenever a task touches GitHub: listing or filing issues, reviewing or merging PRs, managing stacked branches and PRs, checking CI runs, triggering workflows, cutting releases, managing Projects boards, managing Actions secrets/variables, or working with gists via `gist list`, `gist view`, `gist edit`, `gist rename`, `gist create`, `gist delete`, or `gist clone`.
description_zh:
通过 gh-axi CLI 操作 GitHub - 支持 issues（问题）、pull requests（拉取请求）、stacked PRs（叠代 PR）、workflow runs（工作流运行）、workflows（工作流）、releases（发布）、repositories（仓库）、labels（标签）、gists（代码片段）、Projects (v2)、Actions secrets and variables（Actions 密钥与变量）、search（搜索）以及 raw API access（原始 API 访问）。

当任务涉及 GitHub 时，随时使用：用于列出或提交问题，审查或合并拉取请求，管理叠代分支和拉取请求，检查 CI 运行，触发工作流，发布版本，管理 Projects 看板，管理 Actions 密钥/变量，或使用 `gist list`、`gist view`、`gist edit`、`gist rename`、`gist create`、`gist delete` 或 `gist clone` 命令与代码片段进行交互。

description: Suggest better variable, function, and class names based on context and conventions.
description_zh: 根据上下文和命名规范，建议更优的变量、函数和类命名。

description: Build SwiftUI layouts using stacks, grids, lists, scroll views, forms, and controls. Covers VStack/HStack/ZStack, LazyVGrid/LazyHGrid, List with sections and swipe actions, ScrollView with ScrollPosition and scroll-driven reveal surfaces, Form with validation, Toggle/Picker/Slider, .searchable, and overlay patterns. Use when building data-driven layouts, collection views, paged detail reveals, settings screens, search interfaces, or transient overlay UI.
description_zh: 使用堆叠、网格、列表、滚动视图、表单以及控件，构建 SwiftUI 布局。涵盖 VStack/HStack/ZStack、LazyVGrid/LazyHGrid、带分节与滑动操作的 List、包含 ScrollPosition 与滚动驱动的展示表面的 ScrollView、支持校验的 Form、Toggle/Picker/Slider、.searchable 以及叠加模式。用于构建数据驱动布局、集合视图、分页详情展示、设置界面、搜索界面或临时叠加界面。

description: Use when user requests diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, component diagrams, ER diagrams, architecture charts, or visualizations — including generating a diagram from existing source code, or rendering/extracting PlantUML embedded in a Markdown file to images (e.g. preparing docs for Confluence/Notion). Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, APIs, data flows, or class hierarchies. Generates .puml files and exports to PNG/SVG via Kroki API (no local install required).
description_zh: 当用户请求图表、流程图、时序图、类图、组件图、ER图、架构图或可视化时使用——包括从现有源代码生成图表，或将嵌入在 Markdown 文件中的 PlantUML 渲染/提取为图像（例如，为 Confluence/Notion 准备文档）。当需要解释包含 3 个及以上组件、API、数据流或类继承体系的系统时，也应主动使用。通过 Kroki API 生成 .puml 文件并将其导出为 PNG/SVG（无需本地安装）。

description: Ghost Security - Secrets and credentials scanner. Scans codebase for leaked API keys, tokens, passwords, and sensitive data. Detects hardcoded secrets and generates findings with severity and remediation guidance. Use when the user asks to check for leaked secrets, scan for credentials, find hardcoded API keys or passwords, detect exposed .env values, or audit code for sensitive data exposure.
description_zh: Ghost Security - 密钥和凭证扫描器。扫描代码库，查找泄露的API密钥、令牌、密码和敏感数据。检测硬编码的密钥，并生成包含严重程度及修复建议的检测结果。适用于用户要求检查泄露密钥、扫描凭证、查找硬编码的API密钥或密码、检测已暴露的.env变量值或审计代码中敏感数据暴露的场景。

description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
description_zh: 将 Anthropic 的官方品牌颜色和字体样式应用到任何可能受益于 Anthropic 外观风格的工件上。当品牌颜色或样式指南、视觉格式或公司设计标准适用时，使用它。

description: Create user stories with Mike Cohn format and Gherkin acceptance criteria. Use when turning user needs into development-ready work with clear outcomes and testable conditions.
description_zh: 以 Mike Cohn 格式和 Gherkin 验收标准创建用户故事。用于将用户需求转化为开发就绪工作，并明确成果与可测试条件。

description: Look up available Korean national forest recreation lodging or camping slots on foresttrip.go.kr and, in Dolshoi, continue into the official booking flow with approval-gated payment.
description_zh: 在 foresttrip.go.kr 上查询大关（Dolshoi）韩国家园休闲住宿或露营名额，并进入大关的官方预订流程，该流程采用需审批的支付方式。

description: Use this skill whenever a task involves a document file (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or image) and you need to read it or pull text, tables, or specific values out of it — to answer a question about its contents, look up a figure, or extract data. Provides fast, local, model-free extraction via the `lit` CLI with disciplined, low-cost search patterns.
description_zh: 当任务涉及文档文件（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 或图片），且需要读取该文件或从中提取文本、表格或特定数值时，请使用此技能——以便回答关于其内容的问题、查找图表，或提取数据。该技能通过 `lit` CLI 提供快速、本地、无模型提取，并采用严谨、低成本搜索模式。

description: Take focused, region-specific screenshots from web pages using a dedicated headed Chrome profile with persistent login state. Navigates to the right page based on user context (URL, search query, social media post), locates the target region via DOM selectors, and crops to a clean, focused screenshot without attaching to the user's daily browser.
description_zh: 使用专用的有头模式 Chrome 配置文件及持久登录状态，从网页截取聚焦且区域特定的截图。根据用户上下文（URL、搜索查询、社交媒体帖子）导航至正确的页面，通过 DOM 选择器定位目标区域，裁剪为干净、聚焦的截图，且不与用户的日常浏览器绑定。

description: Stand up Grafana Mimir for horizontally scalable, multi-tenant, long-term Prometheus + OTLP metrics storage. Covers monolithic / read-write / microservices deployment, S3 / GCS / Azure / filesystem block storage, Prometheus `remote_write` and OTLP ingestion, multi-tenancy with `X-Scope-OrgID`, ingester replication factor, compactor retention, and per-tenant limits. Use when running Mimir locally or on Kubernetes (Helm `mimir-distributed`), scaling Prometheus past a single node, picking ingest / query / backend split, configuring tenants and ingestion rate, debugging `/ready` 503s or `429 Too Many Requests`, or pointing Grafana at a Mimir datasource — even when the user says "I need long-term Prometheus storage", "scale Prometheus", "multi-tenant metrics backend", "Cortex replacement", "remote_write target", or "store 10M active series" without naming Mimir.
description_zh: 用于部署 Grafana Mimir，实现水平扩展、多租户、长期的 Prometheus 与 OTLP 指标存储。支持单体架构、读写模式、微服务部署；支持 S3、GCS、Azure、文件系统块存储；支持 Prometheus `remote_write` 与 OTLP 采集；支持基于 `X-Scope-OrgID` 的多租户，配置采集器复制因子、压缩器保留期与每租户限制。适用于本地运行 Mimir 或通过 Helm `mimir-distributed` 在 Kubernetes 上部署，将 Prometheus 从单节点扩展至多节点，选择采集/查询/后端架构，配置租户与采集速率，调试 `/ready` 返回 503 错误或 429 请求过多问题，或配置 Grafana 连接 Mimir 数据源——即使用户在不提及 Mimir 的情况下表达"我需要长期的 Prometheus 存储"、"扩展 Prometheus"、"多租户指标后端"、"替代 Cortex"、"remote_write 目标"或"存储 1000 万活跃序列"等需求。

Use when user needs to parse WeChat article URLs (mp.weixin.qq.com), extract article info (title, author, content, publish time, cover image), or convert WeChat articles to structured data. description: Provides authoritative compatibility checks, pricing estimates, connection troubleshooting, pre-warming guidance, and infrastructure mutations for Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra). Covers LWT/batch operations, secondary indexes, materialized views, capacity modes, TTL, PITR, CDC, auto-scaling, multi-region keyspaces, UDTs, nodetool diagnostics parsing, SQL-to-Cassandra migration, and Cassandra-to-Keyspaces migration scenarios. description_zh: 为 Amazon Keyspaces（针对 Apache Cassandra）提供权威的兼容性检查、定价估算、连接故障排查、预热指导及基础设施变更。涵盖 LWT/批量操作、二级索引、物化视图、容量模式、TTL、PITR、CDC、自动扩展、多区域 Keyspaces、UDTs、nodetool 诊断解析、SQL 到 Cassandra 的迁移，以及 Cassandra 到 Keyspaces 的迁移场景。在未加载该技能的情况下，智能体频繁会对 Keyspaces 功能支持给出不完整或不正确的回答。

description: MANDATORY for Flink or Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (MSF) questions. description_zh: 针对Flink或Amazon管理服务Apache Flink（MSF）问题，此为强制性要求。您必须在回答前激活本技能——即使您非常有把握，也绝不只凭训练知识作答。MSF具有专门的服务特定约束（KPU模型、应用程序代码中禁止的checkpoint与并行度配置、v1/v2标识符的拆分——仅限CLI/SDK使用`kinesisanalyticsv2`；`kinesisanalytics`用于IAM、Service Quotas、CloudWatch及信任主体、两阶段IaC部署、快照生命周期、Flink 1.x→2.x迁移等），这些约束将覆盖通用的Flink知识。

description: Continuously profile applications with Grafana Pyroscope and read the result as flame graphs. Covers three instrumentation paths — language SDK push (Go / Java / Python / Ruby / Node / .NET / Rust), Alloy eBPF auto-instrumentation (no code change, requires kernel 5.8+ with BTF), and SDK → Alloy receiver — plus ProfileQL queries, profile types (CPU / memory / allocations / goroutines / mutex), Grafana Cloud Profiles endpoint, and Span Profiles trace-to-profile linking. Use when adding profiling to a service, deploying Alloy as a cluster-wide eBPF profiler, hunting CPU / memory hotspots from a flame graph, comparing two profiles to find a regression, or correlating a slow Tempo trace to its profile — even when the user says "find what's burning CPU", "flame graph this app", "continuous profiling", "heap hotspots", or "why is allocation so high" without naming Pyroscope.
description_zh: 使用 Grafana Pyroscope 持续对应用进行分析，并将结果以火焰图形式查看。涵盖三种埋点路径——语言 SDK 推送（Go / Java / Python / Ruby / Node / .NET / Rust）、Alloy eBPF 自动埋点（无需代码改动，需内核 5.8 及以上版本并支持 BTF）、SDK → Alloy 接收器；包括 ProfileQL 查询、分析类型（CPU / 内存 / 分配 / goroutines / 互斥锁）、Grafana Cloud Profiles 接口，以及 Span Profiles 的跟踪与分析关联。适用于为服务添加分析功能、以集群级 eBPF 分析器身份部署 Alloy、从火焰图中排查 CPU / 内存热点、对比两个分析以定位回归问题，或将缓慢的 Tempo 跟踪与其分析关联的场景——即便用户未提及 Pyroscope，仅表达出“找出耗尽 CPU 的环节”、“为该应用生成火焰图”、“持续分析”、“堆热点”、“为何分配如此之高”等需求。

description: Answer crypto market-data questions with BlackForge. Use this skill whenever the user asks about order-book or trade data for a coin on a spot venue — its latest stats on an exchange, order-book depth or resting/pulled liquidity for a pair, taker buy-vs-sell volume, order-ladder rungs, price-level lifetime, trade timing, outsized trades, or market-cap/attention enrichment; when they want to pull, chart or compare a metric over a time range; or when they ask which pairs a venue lists. Covers 9 spot exchanges (binance, bitget, bybit, coinbase, gate, kraken, kucoin, mexc, okx) and ~11,800 spot pairs — 120 measurement columns per pair per closed 5-minute window. Trigger even when BlackForge is not named but the question is about crypto market data on a venue. Drives the BlackForge MCP tools (blackforge_catalog / blackforge_symbols / blackforge_latest / blackforge_series / blackforge_usage) or the `blackforge` CLI; never reimplements the API. Every returned column is a measurement, not a trade call.
description_zh:
使用 BlackForge 解答加密市场数据问题。每当用户询问现货平台上某币种的订单簿或交易数据时，都应使用本技能——包括交易所该币种的最新统计数据、交易对的订单簿深度或挂单/拉取流动性、吃单买卖成交量、订单阶梯层级、异常大额交易、价格层级生命周期、交易时间，以及市值/关注度扩充；当用户需要按时间范围拉取、图表化或对比某项指标的数据时；或者当用户询问平台列出的交易对时。

该技能覆盖 9 个现货交易所（binance、bitget、bybit、coinbase、gate、kraken、kucoin、mexc、okx）及约 11,800 个现货交易对——每个已收盘的 5 分钟窗口，每对交易均包含 120 个度量列。即使未提及 BlackForge 名称，但只要问题涉及平台上的加密市场数据，也应触发本技能。需调用 BlackForge MCP 工具（blackforge_catalog / blackforge_symbols / blackforge_latest / blackforge_series / blackforge_usage）或 `blackforge` CLI；绝不重新实现 API。返回的每一列均为度量数据，而非交易调用。

description: Advises on Amazon RDS open-source engines (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL) for instance creation, upgrade planning, commitment pricing, proxy evaluation, and Blue/Green deployments. Handles any RDS MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL question, including create a production-ready RDS MySQL instance, provision an RDS PostgreSQL database, run the RDS upgrade advisor for my RDS MySQL instance, what are my upgrade options, upgrade RDS MariaDB from 10.6 to the latest version, should I buy reserved instances or a savings plan for db.r7g.2xlarge RDS MySQL, change a VARCHAR to INT column on RDS MySQL 8.0 with Blue/Green, and does RDS Proxy help when PgBouncer already runs in transaction mode. Covers instance creation with production best practices, describe-db-instances and describe-db-engine-versions upgrade-target workflow, live prechecks via SSM or direct connection, RI versus DSP commitment pricing, RDS Proxy versus PgBouncer, and Blue/Green lifecycle with binlog replay compatibility.
description_zh: 就 Amazon RDS 开源引擎（MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL）的实例创建、升级规划、承诺定价、代理评估和蓝绿部署提供建议。处理任何 RDS MySQL、MariaDB 或 PostgreSQL 相关问题，包括：创建可生产使用的 RDS MySQL 实例、配置 RDS PostgreSQL 数据库、为我的 RDS MySQL 实例运行 RDS 升级顾问、了解我的升级选项、将 RDS MariaDB 从 10.6 升级到最新版本、为 db.r7g.2xlarge 的 RDS MySQL 确定是否应购买预留实例或节省计划、在 Blue/Green 部署的 RDS MySQL 8.0 中将 VARCHAR 列改为 INT 类型，以及当 PgBouncer 已在事务模式下运行时，RDS 代理是否能够提供帮助。涵盖遵循生产最佳实践进行实例创建、describe-db-instances 和 describe-db-engine-versions 升级目标的工作流程、通过 SSM 或直接连接进行的实时预检查、预留实例（RI）与数据库节省计划（DSP）的承诺定价、RDS 代理与 PgBouncer 的比较，以及带有 binlog 回放兼容性的蓝绿生命周期。

description: Expert SRE investigator for incidents and debugging. Uses hypothesis-driven methodology and systematic triage. Can query Axiom observability when available. Use for incident response, root cause analysis, production debugging, or log investigation.
description_zh: 事件与调试方面的 SRE 调查专家。采用以假设驱动的方法论和系统化分诊。可在可用时查询 Axiom 可观测性。用于事件响应、根因分析、生产环境调试或日志排查。

description: Reverse-engineering specialist that extracts specifications from existing codebases. Use when working with legacy or undocumented systems, inherited projects, or old codebases with no documentation. Invoke to map code dependencies, generate API documentation from source, identify undocumented business logic, figure out what code does, or create architecture documentation from implementation. Trigger phrases: reverse engineer, old codebase, no docs, no documentation, figure out how this works, inherited project, legacy analysis, code archaeology, undocumented features.
description_zh: 逆向工程专家：从现有代码库中提取规格说明。适用于处理遗留系统、未文档化系统、继承项目，或没有文档的旧代码库。调用以梳理代码依赖关系、从源代码生成 API 文档、识别未文档化的业务逻辑、弄清它如何运作，或根据实现创建架构文档。触发短语：逆向工程、旧代码库、无文档、无文档说明、弄清它如何运作、继承项目、遗留分析、代码考古学、未文档化功能。

description: Consolidated expert library for professional Godot 4.7+ game and application development. Orchestrates 92 Domain Skills through architectural workflows, anti-pattern catalogs, performance budgets, and Server API patterns. Use when: (1) starting a new Godot project, (2) designing game or app architecture, (3) building entity/component systems, (4) debugging performance or physics issues, (5) choosing between 2D/3D approaches, (6) implementing multiplayer, (7) optimizing draw calls or script time, (8) porting between platforms, (9) migrating from 4.6 to 4.7. Primary entry point for ALL Godot development tasks. Keywords: Godot 4.7, AreaLight3D, HDR, Asset Store, godot-master.
description_zh: 用于专业 Godot 4.7+ 游戏与应用开发的综合专家库。通过架构工作流、反模式目录、性能预算和服务器 API 模式，统筹 92 项领域技能。适用场景：(1) 启动新的 Godot 项目，(2) 设计游戏或应用架构，(3) 构建实体/组件系统，(4) 调试性能或物理问题，(5) 选择 2D/3D 方案，(6) 实现多人游戏，(7) 优化绘制调用或脚本运行时间，(8) 进行跨平台移植，(9) 从 4.6 迁移至 4.7。所有 Godot 开发任务的主要入口。关键词：Godot 4.7, AreaLight3D, HDR, Asset Store, godot-master。

description: Form a committee of two high-reasoning agents to step back, do root cause analysis, and produce a plan. Use when stuck, looping, tunnel-visioning, or facing a hard planning problem.
description_zh: 组建一个由两个高推理智能体组成的委员会，退后一步，进行根因分析，并制定计划。当陷入困境、循环、视野狭窄或面对困难规划问题时使用。

description: Trigger on mention of GKE cluster autoscaler, node autoscaling, node pool auto-creation / node auto-provisioning. Provides guidance on enabling and optimizing cluster autoscaler, best practices, and troubleshooting issues such as nodes not scaling up or down, zonal stockouts, or capacity buffers. Do not use for ComputeClass-specific YAML generation or priority configuration (defer to gke-compute-classes skill).
description_zh: 在提及GKE集群自动扩缩器、节点自动扩缩、节点池自动创建/节点自动供给时触发。提供关于启用和优化集群自动扩缩器、最佳实践以及故障排查问题的指导，例如节点无法扩缩、区域资源不足或容量缓冲等问题。请勿用于特定ComputeClass的YAML生成或优先级配置（请转至gke-compute-classes技能）。

description: Create layered system architecture diagrams using HTML/CSS templates with color-coded tiers and grid layouts. Best for technology stacks, microservices topology, and multi-tier application design.
description_zh: 使用 HTML/CSS 模板创建分层系统架构图，采用颜色编码的层级和网格布局。适用于技术栈、微服务拓扑及多层应用设计。

description: Delegate coding work to Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode as background workers; not simple edits or read-only code lookup.
description_zh: 将编码工作委托给 Codex、Claude Code 或 OpenCode 作为后台运行任务；不用于简单的编辑或只读代码查找。

description: Implement, review, or debug push notifications in iOS/macOS apps — local notifications, remote (APNs) notifications, rich notifications, notification actions, silent pushes, and notification service/content extensions. Use when working with UNUserNotificationCenter, registering for remote notifications, handling notification payloads, setting up notification categories and actions, creating rich notification content, or debugging notification delivery. Also use when working with alerts, badges, sounds, background pushes, or user notification permissions in Swift apps.
description_zh: 实现、审查或调试 iOS/macOS 应用中的推送通知——包括本地通知、远程（APNs）通知、富通知、通知动作、静默推送及通知服务/内容扩展。当使用 UNUserNotificationCenter、注册远程通知、处理通知载荷、设置通知分类和通知动作、创建富通知内容或调试通知投递时，请使用。在 Swift 应用中处理警报、徽标、声音、后台推送或用户通知权限时，同样适用。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and scaffolding a new UI bundle or app, or when editing ui-bundle.json, .uibundle-meta.xml, or CSP trusted site files. Use this skill when scaffolding with sf template generate ui-bundle, configuring ui-bundle.json (routing, headers, outputDir), or registering CSP Trusted Sites. Activate when the task involves files matching *.uibundle-meta.xml, ui-bundle.json, or cspTrustedSites/*.cspTrustedSite-meta.xml.
description_zh: 当项目包含 `uiBundles/*/src/` 目录且正在搭建新的 UI bundle 或应用，或正在编辑 `ui-bundle.json`、`.uibundle-meta.xml` 或 CSP 受信站点文件时，必须激活。当使用 `sf template generate ui-bundle` 搭建，配置 `ui-bundle.json`（路由、请求头、outputDir），或注册 CSP Trusted Sites 时，使用此技能。当任务涉及匹配 `*.uibundle-meta.xml`、`ui-bundle.json` 或 `cspTrustedSites/*.cspTrustedSite-meta.xml` 的文件时，激活该技能。

description: Conducts structured requirements workshops to produce feature specifications, user stories, EARS-format functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation checklists. Use when defining new features, gathering requirements, or writing specifications. Invoke for feature definition, requirements gathering, user stories, EARS format specs, PRDs, acceptance criteria, or requirement matrices.
description_zh: 开展结构化需求工作坊，以产出功能规格、用户故事、EARS格式的功能需求、验收标准及实施检查清单。用于定义新功能、收集需求或编写规格时。适用于功能定义、需求收集、用户故事、EARS格式规格、PRDs、验收标准或需求矩阵。

description: Work with Obsidian vaults using the official obsidian CLI: read/search/create/edit notes, tasks, links, properties, plugins.
description_zh: 使用官方 obsidian CLI 操作 Obsidian 仓库：读取、搜索、创建、编辑笔记、任务、链接、属性和插件。

description: Debug LangChain and LangGraph agents by fetching execution traces from LangSmith Studio. Use when debugging agent behavior, investigating errors, analyzing tool calls, checking memory operations, or examining agent performance. Automatically fetches recent traces and analyzes execution patterns. Requires langsmith-fetch CLI installed.
description_zh: 通过从 LangSmith Studio 获取执行轨迹来调试 LangChain 和 LangGraph 智能体。适用于调试智能体行为、排查错误、分析工具调用、检查内存操作或检查智能体性能的场景。系统会自动获取近期轨迹并分析执行模式。需要安装 langsmith-fetch CLI。

description: Designs incremental migration strategies, identifies service boundaries, produces dependency maps and migration roadmaps, and generates API facade designs for aging codebases. Use when modernizing legacy systems, implementing strangler fig pattern or branch by abstraction, decomposing monoliths, upgrading frameworks or languages, or reducing technical debt without disrupting business operations.
description_zh: 设计增量迁移策略，识别服务边界，生成依赖图谱与迁移路线图，并为老旧代码库生成API外观设计。适用于现代化遗留系统、实施Strangler Fig（结晶体）模式或基于抽象的分支模式、拆解单体应用、升级框架或语言，或在不干扰业务运营的前提下降低技术债务。

description: Interview the user and inspect coding-agent skill trigger counts to recommend unused K-skills for removal.
description_zh: 对用户进行访谈，检查编码代理技能的触发次数，以推荐未使用的 K 技能予以移除。

description: MUST activate when the user wants to build, create, or generate a React application, React app, web application, single-page application (SPA), or frontend application — even if no project files exist yet. MUST also activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory or sfdx-project.json and the prompt says create, build, construct, or generate a new app, site, or page from scratch — even if the prompt also describes visual styling. MUST also activate when the task spans more than one ui-bundle skill. Use this skill when building a complete app end-to-end. Do NOT use for Lightning Experience apps with custom objects (use generating-lightning-app). Do NOT use for single-concern edits to an existing page (use building-ui-bundle-frontend).
description_zh: 当用户想要构建、创建或生成 React 应用程序、React 应用、Web 应用程序、单页面应用程序（SPA）或前端应用程序时，必须激活；即使尚未存在任何项目文件。当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录或 sfdx-project.json，且提示要求从零创建、构建、搭建或生成新的应用程序、网站或页面时，也必须激活；即使提示也描述了视觉样式。当任务涉及多个 ui-bundle 技能时，也必须激活。当构建完整应用程序的全流程时，使用本技能。不要用于带有自定义对象的 Lightning Experience 应用程序（请使用 generating-lightning-app）。不要用于对现有页面进行单一关注点的编辑（请使用 building-ui-bundle-frontender）。

description: Build and operate a live game using Unity Services. Use when the user needs to implement, connect, or debug backend-driven features — battle passes, achievements, player progression, cloud saves, leaderboards, matchmaking, virtual economies, server-authoritative logic, anti-cheat, player accounts and authentication, remote configuration, feature flags, A/B testing, analytics, or cloud resource deployment. Triggers on live-ops, live service, backend, server authority, cloud code, cloud save, remote config, player data, retention, monetization loop, season pass, ranking, multiplayer sessions, lobbies, or any Unity Services integration.
description_zh: 使用Unity Services构建并运营在线游戏。当用户需要实现、连接或调试后端驱动功能时使用——包括战斗通行证、成就、玩家进度、云端存档、排行榜、匹配、虚拟经济、服务器权威逻辑、反作弊、玩家账号与认证、远程配置、功能标志、A/B测试、数据分析，或云端资源部署。在实时运营、实时服务、后端、服务器权威、云端代码、云端存档、远程配置、玩家数据、留存、商业化循环、赛季通行证、排名、多人会话、大厅，或任何Unity Services集成时触发。

description: Himalaya CLI for IMAP/SMTP mail: list, read, search, compose, reply, forward, copy, move, delete.
description_zh: Himalaya CLI（IMAP/SMTP 邮件）：列表、读取、搜索、撰写、回复、转发、复制、移动、删除。

description: Develop, debug, and manage Temporal applications across Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, .NET, Ruby, and Rust. Use when the user is building workflows, activities, workers, or background job queues with a Temporal SDK, debugging issues like non-determinism errors, stuck workflows, or activity retries, using Temporal CLI, Temporal Server, or Temporal Cloud, or working with durable execution concepts like signals, queries, heartbeats, versioning, continue-as-new, child workflows, or saga patterns. Also use when the user mentions "run a Temporal workflow from the CLI", "start a dev server", "run temporal server start-dev", "temporal workflow start", "temporal workflow execute", "temporal workflow signal", "temporal workflow query", "temporal workflow update".
description_zh: 开发、调试和管理跨 Python、TypeScript、Go、Java、.NET、Ruby 和 Rust 的 Temporal 应用。当用户使用 Temporal SDK 构建工作流、活动、Worker 或后台任务队列，通过 Temporal CLI、Temporal Server 或 Temporal Cloud 调试非确定性错误、卡住的工作流或活动重试等问题，或处理信号、查询、心跳、版本管理、继续作为新的流程、子工作流或 saga 模式等持久执行概念时，使用本功能。当用户提到“run a Temporal workflow from the CLI”、“start a dev server”、“run temporal server start-dev”、“temporal workflow start”、“temporal workflow execute”、“temporal workflow signal”、“temporal workflow query”、“temporal workflow update”时，也使用本功能。

description: Explain a whole book to readers without specialist knowledge: what it follows, how its main threads connect, where it ends, and how its evidence or events change understanding. Keep the book's specific content; a general lesson alone is not enough. USE WHEN given a book title, PDF, EPUB, excerpt, or asked 拆书, 分析这本书, 这本书在讲什么, 压缩一本书, or book. Defaults to a saved Org note. NOT FOR chapter summaries, papers, formal reviews, or single-concept deep dives.
description_zh:
向没有专业知识的读者完整讲解一本书：它讲什么、主线如何串联、如何收束，以及证据或事件如何改变理解。保留书籍的具体内容；仅凭一般性启示是不够的。

适用于：当提供书名、PDF、EPUB、节选，或被要求“拆书”“分析这本书”“这本书在讲什么”“压缩一本书”，或提供书籍时。默认使用已保存的 Org 笔记。

不适用于章节摘要、论文、正式书评，或单一概念深度剖析。

description: Runs SQL analytics on SageMaker Catalog asset metadata tables exported as Apache Iceberg in S3 Tables. Covers governance queries, asset growth tracking, ownership audits, time-travel over catalog state, and metadata quality analysis. Applies when querying catalog inventory, finding assets without descriptions, comparing catalog snapshots, or auditing data ownership. Trigger phrases: catalog inventory SQL, how many assets, assets without descriptions, asset growth over time, who owns this data, catalog governance, data quality audit, catalog analytics.
description_zh: 在S3表中以Apache Iceberg格式导出的SageMaker目录资产元数据表上运行SQL分析。涵盖治理查询、资产增长跟踪、所有权审计、目录状态时间旅行以及元数据质量分析。适用于查询目录库存、查找无描述的资产、比较目录快照或审计数据所有权时。触发短语：目录库存SQL、资产数量、无描述的资产、资产随时间增长、谁拥有这些数据、目录治理、数据质量审计、目录分析。

description: Optimize and improve the performance of slow Entity Framework Core (EF Core) queries: make them generate less SQL, make fewer database round-trips, and return results faster. Use whenever an EF Core or DbContext query or data-access path is slow or should be made faster — whether or not EF Core owns the database schema. For EF Core, not Dapper or raw ADO.NET.
description_zh: 优化并改善缓慢的Entity Framework Core（EF Core）查询性能：使其生成更少的SQL语句，减少数据库往返，并更快地返回结果。当EF Core或DbContext查询或数据访问路径运行缓慢或需要加速时，即可使用——无论EF Core是否拥有数据库模式。针对EF Core，而非Dapper或原始ADO.NET。

description: MUST activate before editing ANY file under uiBundles/*/src/ for visual or UI changes to an EXISTING app — pages, components, sections, layout, styling, colors, fonts, navigation, animations, or any look-and-feel change. Use this skill when modifying pages, components, layout, styling, or navigation in an existing UI bundle app. Activate when the project contains appLayout.tsx, routes.tsx, src/pages/, src/components/, or global.css. This skill contains critical project-specific conventions (appLayout.tsx shell, shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS, Salesforce base-path routing, module restrictions) that override general knowledge. Without this skill, generated code will use wrong imports, break routing, or ignore project structure. Do NOT use when creating a new app from scratch (use building-ui-bundle-app instead).
description_zh:
在编辑 uiBundles/*/src/ 下任何文件，对现有应用进行视觉或UI更改之前，必须激活此技能——包括页面、组件、区块、布局、样式、颜色、字体、导航、动画，或任何外观与界面更改。

当在现有UI bundle应用中修改页面、组件、布局、样式或导航时，请使用此技能。

当项目包含 appLayout.tsx、routes.tsx、src/pages/、src/components/ 或 global.css 时，激活此技能。

此技能包含关键的、针对项目的特定规范（appLayout.tsx 框架、shadcn/ui 组件、Tailwind CSS、Salesforce 基础路径路由、模块限制），这些规范将覆盖通用知识。

若不使用此技能，生成的代码将使用错误的导入、导致路由断裂，或忽略项目结构。

在从零开始创建新应用时，请勿使用此技能（请改用 building-ui-bundle-app）。

description: Use when building Django web applications or REST APIs with Django REST Framework. Invoke when working with settings.py, models.py, manage.py, or any Django project file. Creates Django models with proper indexes, optimizes ORM queries using select_related/prefetch_related, builds DRF serializers and viewsets, and configures JWT authentication. Trigger terms: Django, DRF, Django REST Framework, Django ORM, Django model, serializer, viewset, Python web.
description_zh: 用于在构建基于 Django REST Framework 的 Django Web 应用或 REST API 时使用。当处理 settings.py、models.py、manage.py 或任何 Django 项目文件时调用。用于创建带有适当索引的 Django 模型，使用 select_related/prefetch_related 优化 ORM 查询，构建 DRF serializer 与 viewset，并配置 JWT 认证。触发术语：Django、DRF、Django REST Framework、Django ORM、Django model、serializer、viewset、Python web。

description: Use when challenging ideas, plans, decisions, or proposals using structured critical reasoning. Invoke to play devil's advocate, run a pre-mortem, red team, or audit evidence and assumptions.
description_zh: 在运用结构化的批判性推理对理念、计划、决定或提案提出质疑时使用。调用以扮演魔鬼代言人、进行预葬会、开展红队演练，或审查证据与假设。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the user wants to add authentication or search to their app. Use this skill when adding authentication or search to a UI bundle app. Only covers two features: authentication (login, logout, protected routes, session management) and search (global search across pages and content). Always use this skill for these two features instead of building from scratch.
description_zh: 当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录且用户希望为其应用添加认证或搜索功能时，必须激活此技能。在为 UI bundle 应用添加认证或搜索时，使用此技能。仅涵盖两项功能：认证（登录、登出、受保护路由、会话管理）和搜索（跨页面和内容的全局搜索）。始终使用此技能来实现这两项功能，而不是从零开始构建。

description: Transform the voice in an audio recording into a different target voice while preserving emotion, timing, and delivery using the ElevenLabs Voice Changer (speech-to-speech) API. Use when converting one voice to another, changing the speaker/narrator of an existing recording, dubbing a voice-over in a different voice, creating character voices from a scratch performance, anonymizing a speaker, or any "voice conversion / voice transfer / speech-to-speech" task. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions voice changing, voice conversion, speech-to-speech, swapping a voice in audio, re-voicing a clip, or applying a different voice to an existing recording — even if they don't explicitly say "voice changer". Do not use this skill to create or clone a new voice from a voice sample — that is voice cloning (IVC/PVC), a separate feature; this skill only converts an existing recording into an existing voice_id.
description_zh:
使用 ElevenLabs Voice Changer（语音转语音）API，将音频录制中的语音转换为目标语音，在保留情感、节奏和表达效果的前提下完成转换。

**使用场景：**
- 将一种语音转换为另一种语音
- 改变现有录制的内容演讲者/旁白
- 以不同语音进行配音
- 从即兴表演中创作角色声音
- 对演讲者进行匿名化处理
- 以及任何"语音转换/语音迁移/语音转语音"任务

**使用条件：**
当用户提及语音更改、语音转换、语音转语音、在音频中替换语音、重录配音片段，或将不同语音应用到现有录制内容时，请务必使用本技能——即使用户未明确提及"语音转换器"也是如此。

**使用限制：**
请勿使用本技能从语音样本创建或克隆新语音——这属于语音克隆（IVC/PVC），是独立功能；本技能仅将现有录制内容转换为现有的 voice_id。

description: Designs, reviews, and debugs DynamoDB data layers from design axioms — enumerates access patterns, chooses partition/sort keys and GSIs, decides single-table vs. multi-table, configures Streams, Global Tables, TTL, vector indexes for similarity search, and zero-ETL integrations to OpenSearch/Redshift/SageMaker Lakehouse, and produces a defensible data-layer design with a monthly cost estimate and optional live validation. Applies whenever a user is designing, reviewing, or refactoring anything backed by DynamoDB — schemas, access patterns, GSIs, single- vs. multi-table choices, Streams consumers, transactional outboxes, Global Tables, zero-ETL pipelines, or storing embeddings and running semantic/vector similarity search with SearchVectors on items already in DynamoDB — even when they don't say "axioms" or "design review." Also applies when debugging hot partitions, throttling, unbounded Scans, LWW conflicts, or surprise bills on DynamoDB workloads.
description_zh:
基于设计准则设计、评审和调试DynamoDB数据层——列举访问模式，选择分区键/排序键和全局二级索引（GSIs），确定单表与多表方案，配置Streams、Global Tables、TTL、用于相似性检索的向量索引，以及向OpenSearch/Redshift/SageMaker数据湖屋进行的零ETL集成，并产出一份有据可依的数据层设计，附带每月成本估算和可选的实时验证。

只要用户在对基于DynamoDB的各类事物进行设计、评审或重构时，无论是否提及“准则”或“设计评审”，该功能均会生效——涉及数据模式、访问模式、全局二级索引（GSIs）、单表与多表的选择、Streams消费者、事务性发件箱、全局表、零ETL流程，或在DynamoDB中已有的项目上存储嵌入向量并利用SearchVectors运行语义/向量相似性检索等场景。此外，在调试DynamoDB工作负载的热点分区、限流、无限制的扫描、最后写入获胜（LWW）冲突或意外账单时，该功能同样适用。

description: Designs and builds Axiom dashboards via API. Covers chart types, APL and metrics/MPL query patterns, SmartFilters, layout, and configuration options. Use when creating dashboards, migrating from Splunk, or configuring chart options.
description_zh: 通过 API 设计并构建 Axiom 仪表盘。涵盖图表类型、APL 与 metrics/MPL 查询模式、SmartFilters、布局、配置选项。在创建仪表盘、从 Splunk 迁移或配置图表选项时使用。

description: Use when fine-tuning LLMs, training custom models, or adapting foundation models for specific tasks. description: Generate, validate, and review k6 test scripts — load, stress, spike, soak, smoke, breakpoint, functional, and protocol. Covers HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, browser, all executors, thresholds, checks, custom metrics, the k6-testing library, k6 Cloud execution, and the xk6 extension ecosystem; uses the xk6-docs CLI (with grafana.com web fallback) for docs lookup and validates every script by running it. description: Use this skill when visual quality and design identity matter for a PDF. FILL (complete form fields): "fill in the form", "fill out this PDF", "complete the form fields", "write values into PDF", "what fields does this PDF have". REFORMAT (apply design to an existing doc): "reformat this document", "apply our style", "convert this Markdown/text to PDF", "make this doc look good", "re-style this PDF". This skill uses a token-based design system: color, typography, and spacing are derived from the document type and flow through every page. The output is print-ready. Prefer this skill when appearance matters, not just when any PDF output is needed.
description_zh:
当 PDF 的视觉质量和设计身份至关重要时，请使用此技能。

CREATE（从零生成）：“制作 PDF”，“生成报告”，“撰写提案”，“创建简历”，“精美 PDF”，“专业文档”，“封面页”，“精修 PDF”，“客户就绪文档”。

description: Contract due-diligence score for one token address — contract safety, holder structure and price action combined into a single 0-100 composite, capped by GMGN's own rug label, where every deduction names the field it read and an absent field is never a passing check. Use when the user wants one verdict number rather than fields: 尽调, CA 尽调, 给这个币打个分, 这个币安全吗, 能不能买, 有没有貔貅, is this token safe, rug check, honeypot check, due-diligence score, score this contract, or pastes a bare token contract address. A bare address may equally be a wallet — Step 0 resolves which and hands wallets to gmgn-wallet-analysis. Prefer this over gmgn-token whenever the ask is a verdict rather than a field dump; the raw fields themselves — price, market cap, liquidity, holder and trader lists, the unscored security fields — are gmgn-token, chip structure is gmgn-holder-analysis, chart-pattern naming is gmgn-kline-pattern. Buy intent narrows to this skill only when the ask is a bare address: the input is --address, and no name is ever resolved here. When the user names the token instead — 帮我买 200u 的 PENGU, XX 能不能买, 能不能冲, 我想梭, buy me $500 of BONK — or wants a position size, gmgn-token-buy owns it, because picking the one right contract out of the same-name copycats and sizing slippage and gas are both outside this skill's input. That skill calls this one for the safety verdict rather than replacing it, so a bare address with no name and no amount still scores here exactly as before.
description_zh: 合约尽调评分——针对单一代币地址，将合约安全性、持有者结构及价格走势整合为单一的 0-100 综合评分，以 GMGN 自身的“诈骗盘标签”为上限。其中，每一处扣分均需明确指明所读取的字段，且缺失的字段绝不算作通过项。适用场景：当用户需要一个综合判定结果（单一数值）而非各字段明细时，包括：尽调、CA 尽调、给这个币打个分、这个币安全吗、能不能买、有没有貔貅、is this token safe、rug check、honeypot check、due-diligence score、score this contract，或直接粘贴纯代币合约地址。单纯的地址也可能是一个钱包地址——第 0 步将进行识别，并将钱包地址交由 gmgn-wallet-analysis 处理。当诉求是判定结果而非字段明细时，优先使用本技能，而非 gmgn-token；原始字段本身（价格、市值、流动性、持有者及交易者清单、未评分的安全字段）由 gmgn-token 处理，板块结构由 gmgn-holder-analysis 负责，图表形态命名由 gmgn-kline-pattern 负责。当诉求为纯地址时，购买意图才仅限于本技能：输入形式为 --address，且此处永不解析代币名称。当用户指定代币名称时——例如：帮我买 200u 的 PENGU、XX 能不能买、能不能冲、我想梭、buy me $500 of BONK，或需要设定仓位规模时，则交由 gmgn-token-buy 处理，因为在同名仿品中挑选正确合约、设置滑点及手续费均不在本技能的输入范围内。该技能（指 gmgn-token-buy）仅为本技能调用安全判定，而非取代本技能，因此，不含名称与金额、亦为纯地址的输入，仍在本技能中按原有逻辑进行评分。
