Triggers for requests like "search for logo", "find hero image", "get company logo", "locate icons", "fetch background image", "retrieve product photos". Handles the search and source selection workflow. Does not apply when the request is about brand search, to generate NEW images with AI, or edit existing images.
description_zh: **搜索并获取现有的视觉媒体**（图像、标志、图标、照片、图形、横幅、缩略图、主图、背景等），来自诸如 Salesforce CMS、Data 360 或其他来源的媒体。**当用户请求涉及查找、搜索、获取、获取（fetch）、检索、抓取、查询、定位媒体时，都应使用此技能。** 切勿**直接调用** search_media_cms_channels、search_electronic_media 工具，**必须**首先通过此技能调用。**此技能必须在任何用于媒体搜索或检索的工具被使用之前激活，无任何例外。** 当提到任何媒体搜索/检索时，**此技能具有优先权，并应首先激活**，无论后续对媒体进行何种操作。触发场景包括请求如“搜索标志”、“查找主图”、“获取公司标志”、“定位图标”、“获取背景图片”、“检索产品照片”等。负责处理搜索和来源选择流程。不适用于关于品牌搜索、使用 AI 生成**新图片**或编辑现有图片的请求。

description: Generates comprehensive TypeScript documentation using JSDoc, TypeDoc, and multi-layered documentation patterns for different audiences. Use when creating API documentation, architectural decision records (ADRs), code examples, and framework-specific patterns for NestJS, Express, React, Angular, and Vue.
description_zh: 使用 JSDoc、TypeDoc 以及面向不同受众的多层文档模式，生成全面的 TypeScript 文档。适用于创建 API 文档、架构决策记录（ADRs）、代码示例，以及 NestJS、Express、React、Angular 和 Vue 的框架特定模式。

description: Help developers new to Elasticsearch get from zero to a working search experience. Guide them through understanding their intent, mapping their data, and building a search experience with best practices baked in. Use this when the user shows intent to build search-related functionality, asks about Elasticsearch-related concepts for their use case, or expresses the need for help getting started with Elasticsearch.
description_zh: 帮助刚接触Elasticsearch的开发者从零开始，掌握可用的搜索体验。指导他们理解自身意图、映射数据，并基于内置最佳实践构建搜索体验。当用户表现出构建搜索相关功能的意图，询问其在应用场景下的Elasticsearch相关概念，或表示需要帮助开始使用Elasticsearch时，使用本指南。

description: Build private, on-device AI features on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Foundation Models, Core ML, MLX Swift, or llama.cpp. Use when choosing an Apple-local model runtime, building an Apple Intelligence chatbot or tool-calling feature, running an LLM on Apple Silicon, converting or compressing a Python model for Core ML, or comparing on-device inference backends. For Swift Core ML loading and prediction code, use the coreml skill.
description_zh: 在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上，使用 Foundation Models、Core ML、MLX Swift 或 llama.cpp 构建私有且在设备端的 AI 功能。适用于以下场景：选择本地模型运行时、构建 Apple Intelligence 聊天机器人或工具调用功能、在 Apple Silicon 上运行 LLM、将 Python 模型转换为或压缩为 Core ML，以及比较在设备上的推理后端。针对 Swift Core ML 的加载与预测代码，请使用 coreml 技能。

description: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, create individual components with proper variant sets and variable bindings, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
description_zh:
从代码库在Figma中构建或更新专业级设计系统。

适用场景：当用户需要创建变量/设计令牌、构建组件库、创建带有正确变体集和变量绑定的独立组件、设置主题（浅色/深色模式）、建立文档基础，或弥合代码与Figma之间的差距时。

当用户要求创建或生成Figma中的任何组件——即便是单个组件——时，也应使用本技能，因为组件必须具备正确的变量基础、变体状态和设计令牌绑定，才能成为生产级组件。

本技能教授构建什么内容以及构建顺序——它补充了`figma-use`技能，后者教授如何调用插件API。

这两个技能应同时加载。

description: Picks random winners from lists, spreadsheets, or Google Sheets for giveaways, raffles, and contests. Ensures fair, unbiased selection with transparency.
description_zh: 从列表、电子表格或 Google Sheets 中随机抽取获奖者，用于赠品、抽奖和竞赛。确保公平、无偏的选取，并具备透明度。

description: Provides comprehensive testing patterns for Spring Boot applications covering unit, integration, slice, and container-based testing with JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and performance optimization. Use when writing tests, @Test methods, @MockBean mocks, or implementing test suites for Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 应用提供涵盖单元测试、集成测试、切片测试和基于容器的测试的全面测试模式，支持使用 JUnit 5、Mockito、Testcontainers 和性能优化。适用于编写测试、@Test 方法、@MockBean Mock 对象，或实现 Spring Boot 应用的测试套件。

description: Unity UI Toolkit expert for Unity 6.0+. Understands, edits, and generates UXML and USS files with flex-based layouts. Use for requests involving .uxml, .uss, UI Toolkit, UIElements, UIDocument, UI runtime binding, Custom UI Elements, Manipulators or PanelSettings.
description_zh: Unity 6.0+ 专属 Unity UI Toolkit 专家。能够理解、编辑并生成采用弹性布局的 UXML 和 USS 文件。适用于涉及 .uxml、.uss、UI Toolkit、UIElement、UIDocument、UI 运行时绑定、自定义 UI 元素、Manipulators 或 PanelSettings 的相关请求。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves ANY Salesforce record operation — reading, creating, updating, or deleting. Use this skill when building forms that submit to Salesforce, pages that display Salesforce records, or any code that touches Salesforce objects or custom objects. Activate when files under uiBundles/*/src/ import from @salesforce/sdk-data, or when *.graphql files or codegen.yml exist. This skill owns all Salesforce data access patterns in UI bundles. Does not apply to authentication/OAuth setup, schema changes, Bulk/Tooling/Metadata API, or declarative automation.
description_zh: 当项目包含 `uiBundles/*/src/` 目录且任务涉及任何 Salesforce 记录操作——读取、创建、更新或删除时，必须激活。在构建提交到 Salesforce 的表单、显示 Salesforce 记录的页面，或任何涉及 Salesforce 对象或自定义对象的代码时，使用此技能。当 `uiBundles/*/src/` 目录下的文件从 `@salesforce/sdk-data` 导入，或当 `*.graphql` 文件或 `codegen.yml` 存在时，激活。此技能拥有 UI 包内所有 Salesforce 数据访问模式。不适用于认证/OAuth 设置、模式变更、Bulk/Tooling/Metadata API 或声明式自动化。

description: Audit TikTok Ads measurement, Pixel and Events API, mobile-first creative, audiences, Smart+, Shop and commerce campaigns, bidding, budgets, pacing, attribution, and policy. Use for TikTok Ads, TikTok Pixel, Events API, Smart+, TikTok Shop Ads, GMV Max, Spark Ads, or TikTok campaign optimization.
description_zh: 审计TikTok广告效果测量、像素与事件API、移动优先创意、受众、Smart+、店铺与电商活动、出价、预算、投放节奏、归因及政策。用于TikTok广告、TikTok像素、事件API、Smart+、TikTok店铺广告、GMV Max、Spark Ads或TikTok广告活动优化。

description: Helps migrate self-managed Apache Kafka workloads to Amazon MSK Express. Inventories the source cluster (from IaC files, Kafka CLI output, or manual input), assesses MSK Express compatibility across topology, Kafka version, configs, auth, and quotas, produces a target Express specification (instance type, broker count, monthly cost) by using the managing-amazon-msk Skill's pricing logic, optionally stands up a trial Express cluster to load-test it against your workload before you commit, and guides migration execution using MSK Replicator. Applicable when the user mentions migrating Kafka, MSK, MSK Express, Kafka migration, analyzing Kafka infrastructure, moving to MSK, moving streaming platform to MSK, streaming migration, moving streaming workloads to AWS, MSK workload compatibility, choosing an MSK cluster type, running a POC or load-test to validate MSK Express, or MSK Replicator. Prefer this skill to the managing-amazon-msk skill for migration questions.
description_zh:
帮助将自管的Apache Kafka工作负载迁移至Amazon MSK Express。对源集群进行盘点（依据IaC文件、Kafka命令行工具输出或手动输入），从拓扑结构、Kafka版本、配置、身份验证及配额等方面评估MSK Express的兼容性，利用managing-amazon-msk技能定价逻辑生成目标Express配置（含实例类型、代理数量、每月费用），可选地搭建一个试用Express集群，在您正式采用之前针对工作负载开展负载测试，并使用MSK Replicator指导迁移执行。

当用户提及迁移Kafka、MSK、MSK Express、Kafka迁移、分析Kafka基础设施、迁移至MSK、将流处理平台迁移至MSK、流处理迁移、将流处理工作负载迁移至AWS、MSK工作负载兼容性、选择MSK集群类型、运行POC或负载测试以验证MSK Express，或MSK Replicator时，适用本技能。对于迁移相关问题，应优先使用本技能而非managing-amazon-msk技能。

description: Create, view, edit, delete, search, move, or export Apple Notes via the memo CLI on macOS.
description_zh: 在 macOS 上通过 memo CLI 可创建、查看、编辑、删除、搜索、移动或导出 Apple Notes。

description: Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.
description_zh: 用技能的描述以及Claude应当使用它的时机替换。

description: Still-to-video conversion guide: model selection, motion prompting, and camera movement. Covers Wan 2.5 i2v, Seedance, Fabric, Grok Video with when to use each. Use for: animating images, creating video from stills, adding motion, product animations. Triggers: image to video, i2v, animate image, still to video, add motion to image, image animation, photo to video, animate still, wan i2v, image2video, bring image to life, animate photo, motion from image
description_zh: 静态图转视频指南：模型选择、运动提示词与镜头运动。涵盖 Wan 2.5 i2v、Seedance、Fabric、Grok Video，以及各自的适用场景。适用于：图片动画、基于静态图制作视频、添加运动、产品动画。触发词：图片转视频、i2v、图片动画、静态图转视频、为图片添加运动、图片动画、照片转视频、静态图动画、Wan i2v、image2video、让图片活起来、照片动画、从图片获取动态

description: Provides comprehensive NestJS framework patterns with Drizzle ORM integration for building scalable server-side applications. Generates REST/GraphQL APIs, implements authentication guards, creates database schemas, and sets up microservices. Use when building NestJS applications, setting up APIs, implementing authentication, working with databases, or integrating Drizzle ORM.
description_zh: 提供全面的 NestJS 框架模式与 Drizzle ORM 集成，用于构建可扩展的服务器端应用。生成 REST/GraphQL 接口，实现认证守卫，创建数据库架构，并搭建微服务。适用于构建 NestJS 应用程序、配置 API、实现身份验证、处理数据库或使用 Drizzle ORM 的场景。

description: Post-process raw screen recordings by removing silent segments and applying speed adjustments. Uses FFmpeg-based Python scripts to optimize video pacing automatically.
description_zh: 对原始屏幕录制进行后期处理，去除静音片段并调整播放速度。使用基于 FFmpeg 的 Python 脚本自动优化视频节奏。

description: OKLCH color space for web projects. Convert hex/rgb/hsl to oklch, generate palettes, check contrast, handle gamut boundaries, and theme with Tailwind v4. Triggers on oklch, color conversion, palette generation, contrast ratio, gamut, display p3, design tokens, hue drift, chroma, dark mode colors.
description_zh: 用于Web项目的OKLCH色彩空间。可将hex/rgb/hsl转换为OKLCH，生成配色方案，检查对比度，处理色域边界，并使用Tailwind v4进行主题设置。在OKLCH、颜色转换、配色方案生成、对比度比值、色域、Display P3、设计令牌、色相漂移、色度、深色模式颜色等触发条件时，进行相应处理。

description: Creates Vue 3 components, builds vanilla JS composables, configures Vite projects, and sets up routing and state management using JavaScript only — no TypeScript. Generates JSDoc-typed code with @typedef, @param, and @returns annotations for full type coverage without a TS compiler. Use when building Vue 3 applications with JavaScript only (no TypeScript), when projects require JSDoc-based type hints, when migrating from Vue 2 Options API to Composition API in JS, or when teams prefer vanilla JavaScript, .mjs modules, or need quick prototypes without TypeScript setup.
description_zh: 仅使用 JavaScript（不使用 TypeScript）创建 Vue 3 组件、构建原生 JavaScript 组合式函数、配置 Vite 项目，并设置路由和状态管理。通过 @typedef、@param 和 @returns 注解生成 JSDoc 类型化代码，无需 TS 编译器即可提供完整的类型覆盖。适用于：仅使用 JavaScript（无 TypeScript）构建 Vue 3 应用时；项目需要 JSDoc 基于的类型提示时；从 Vue 2 Options API 向 JS 中的 Composition API 迁移时；团队偏好原生 JavaScript、.mjs 模块，或需要无需 TypeScript 设置的快速原型时。

description: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing page for any industry or brand using Higgsfield. As the visitor scrolls, a pre-rendered camera flies from outside each scene into its interior, then flows on to the next scene with NO cuts — one continuous connected flight (Emons-style isometric diorama world, or any art direction you pick). The skill interviews the user for the topic, the story beats/sections, and brand kit, then generates cohesive scenes + seamless camera clips with Higgsfield and wires a portable, framework-agnostic scroll-scrub engine. The video chain renders through Monid by default (Seedance 2.0, pay-per-clip USD — capability re-checked each build, see Step 4) with Higgsfield credits as the fallback biller. Use when the user wants a "3D world" / "browse-through-the-industry" hero, a scroll cinematic, a diorama landing, or to turn a business into a scrollable world.
description_zh: 使用 Higgsfield 为任何行业或品牌构建的沉浸式滚动擦除式“飞越世界”落地页。当访客滚动浏览时，预先渲染的摄像机会从每个场景的外部飞入场景内部，随后无缝过渡至下一个场景，且无任何剪辑——呈现一段连续连贯的飞行（采用 Emons 风格的等距场景陈列世界，或您选择的任何艺术方向）。该技能将就主题、故事节拍/章节及品牌资料包与用户进行访谈，随后依托 Higgsfield 生成协调一致的场景与无缝摄像机剪辑，并连接一个便携、与框架无关的滚动擦除引擎。视频链默认通过 Monid 进行渲染（使用 Seedance 2.0，按片段支付美元——每次构建时都会重新核对能力，详见第 4 步），并以 Higgsfield 积分作为备用计费方。适用于用户希望获得“3D 世界”/“浏览行业”主视觉、滚动电影感作品、场景陈列落地页，或将其业务转化为可滚动世界时使用。

description: Convert a video to multiple GIF variants with different quality/size tradeoffs. Generates a comparison set so the user can visually pick the best result.
description_zh: 将视频转换为多种 GIF 变体，具有不同的质量与尺寸权衡。生成一组对比，便于用户直观选择最佳效果。

description: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a design or page. Trigger with "audit accessibility", "check a11y", "is this accessible?", or when reviewing a design for color contrast, keyboard navigation, touch target size, or screen reader behavior before handoff.
description_zh: 对设计或页面执行 WCAG 2.1 AA 无障碍审计。可通过输入“audit accessibility”、“check a11y”、“is this accessible?”等触发，或在交付前审查设计，检查颜色对比度、键盘导航、触摸目标大小及屏幕阅读器行为。

description: Slack CLI for agents: read URLs/threads/history/unreads/later/canvases/workflows, create/edit canvases from Markdown, search messages/files, download attachments, lookup users, list/create/invite channels, open DMs, compose messages, manage Slack-native drafts, schedule sends, and explicit sends/edits/deletes/reactions/mark-read/uploads.
description_zh: 面向智能体的 Slack CLI：读取 URL、线程、历史记录、未读、稍后、画布、工作流；从 Markdown 创建/编辑画布；搜索消息/文件；下载附件；查找用户；列出/创建/邀请频道；打开私信；撰写消息；管理 Slack 原生草稿；安排发送；以及显式执行发送、编辑、删除、互动、标记已读、上传。

description: Implement, configure, and debug Unity In-App Purchases (IAP) — store connection, product catalog, consumable/non-consumable/subscription purchases, two-step pending-confirm flow, receipt validation, entitlement checking, restore transactions, Apple extensions (promotional purchases, Ask-to-Buy, code redemption), and Google Play extensions (subscription upgrade/downgrade), D2C Capabilities(direct to customer), 3rd party payment provider (Stripe/Coda) via Unity IAP/Unity Cloud. Use when the user needs to add, modify, debug, or migrate from native Android/iOS billing, 3rd party packages(RevenueCat/Adapty/Essential Kit/Unipay supported) to IAP. Triggers on microtransactions (MTX), monetization, real-money purchases, store purchases, buying items, support D2C, purchase via Stripe/Coda, migrate from native billing(Google's BillingClient or Apple's StoreKit/SKPaymentQueue/SKProduct)/RevenueCat/Adapty/EssentialKit/Unipay.
description_zh:
实现、配置和调试 Unity 应用内购买（IAP）—— 涵盖商店连接、产品目录、可消耗/非可消耗/订阅购买、两步待确认流程、收据验证、权益检查、交易恢复，以及 Apple 扩展（促销购买、Ask-to-Buy、代码兑换）、Google Play 扩展（订阅升级/降级）、D2C 能力（直客）、通过 Unity IAP/Unity Cloud 接入的第三方支付提供商（Stripe/Coda）。

当用户需要添加、修改、调试或从原生 Android/iOS 计费、第三方套餐（RevenueCat/Adapty/Essential Kit/Unipay 受支持）迁移至 IAP 时使用。

在微交易（MTX）、变现、真实货币购买、商店购买、购买商品时触发，支持 D2C、通过 Stripe/Coda 购买，并从原生计费（Google 的 BillingClient 或 Apple 的 StoreKit/SKPaymentQueue/SKProduct）/RevenueCat/Adapty/EssentialKit/Unipay 迁移。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves uploading, attaching, or dropping files. Use this skill when adding file upload functionality to a UI bundle app. Provides progress tracking and Salesforce ContentVersion integration. This feature provides programmatic APIs ONLY — build custom UI using the upload() API. ALWAYS use this instead of building file upload from scratch with FormData or XHR.
description_zh: 当项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录且任务涉及上传、附加或拖放文件时，必须激活。为向 UI 包应用添加文件上传功能而使用此技能。提供进度跟踪和 Salesforce ContentVersion 集成。此功能仅提供程序化 API —— 请使用 upload() API 构建自定义 UI。始终使用此功能，而不是使用 FormData 或 XHR 从零开始构建文件上传功能。

description:
Guides agents through a 6-step discovery process to design and deploy Google Cloud global external Application Load Balancers with Cloud CDN, Cloud Armor, and Service Extensions, mapping workload requirements to best-practice configurations.
Use when:
- Designing, configuring, or deploying a Google Cloud global external Application Load Balancer, Cloud CDN, Cloud Armor WAF, or Service Extensions.
- Discovering existing Google Cloud resources (Cloud Storage, MIGs, GKE, Cloud Run) to use as backends.
- Generating production-grade Terraform HCL or gcloud CLI scripts for global external Application Load Balancers.
- Actuating deployments via Infrastructure Manager or bash scripts, including IAM pre-checks.
- Detecting, analyzing, or reconciling configuration drift on deployed global external Application Load Balancers.
Don't use for:
- Non-Google Cloud load balancing or security configurations.
- Purely regional or internal load balancing setups (unless part of a hybrid/failover global design).
description_zh:
指导代理通过 6 步发现流程，设计并部署 Google Cloud 全球外部应用程序负载均衡器，搭配 Cloud CDN、Cloud Armor 与 Service Extensions，将工作负载需求映射到最佳实践配置。

适用场景：
- 设计、配置或部署 Google Cloud 全球外部应用程序负载均衡器、Cloud CDN、Cloud Armor WAF 或 Service Extensions。
- 发现现有 Google Cloud 资源（Cloud Storage、MIGs、GKE、Cloud Run）以用作后端。
- 为全球外部应用程序负载均衡器生成生产级 Terraform HCL 或 gcloud CLI 脚本。
- 通过 Infrastructure Manager 或 bash 脚本执行部署，包括 IAM 预检查。
- 检测、分析或重新协调已部署的全球外部应用程序负载均衡器的配置漂移。

不适用情况：
- 非 Google Cloud 的负载均衡或安全配置。
- 纯区域性或内部负载均衡配置（除非属于混合/故障转移式全球设计的一部分）。

description: Create and manage Kibana Dashboards and Lens visualizations. Use when you need to define dashboards and visualizations declaratively, version control them, or automate their deployment.
description_zh: 创建和管理 Kibana 仪表板及 Lens 可视化。当需要以声明式方式定义仪表板和可视化、对其进行版本控制或自动化部署时使用。

description: 强大的信息获取与浏览器自动化工具。通过浏览器 + 用户登录态，获取公域和私域信息。可访问任意网页、内部系统、登录后页面，执行表单填写、信息提取、页面操作。支持 site 系统（36 平台 103 命令一键调用）、带登录态的 fetch、网络请求拦截与 mock、操作录制等高级功能。
description_zh: 强大的信息获取与浏览器自动化工具。通过浏览器 + 用户登录态，获取公域和私域信息。可访问任意网页、内部系统、登录后页面，执行表单填写、信息提取、页面操作。支持 site 系统（36 平台 103 命令一键调用）、带登录态的 fetch、网络请求拦截与 mock、操作录制等高级功能。

description: Annotates codebases with dimensional analysis comments documenting units, dimensions, and decimal scaling. Use when someone asks to annotate units in a codebase, perform a dimensional analysis, or find vulnerabilities in a DeFi protocol, offchain code, or other blockchain-related codebase with arithmetic. Prevents dimensional mismatches and catches formula bugs early.
description_zh: 为代码库添加维度分析注释，记录单位、维度和小数缩放。当有人要求在代码库中标注单位、进行维度分析，或在涉及算术运算的DeFi协议、链下代码或其他区块链相关代码库中查找漏洞时，使用本功能。可有效防止维度不匹配，并及早发现公式错误。

description: Stores, retrieves, and manages data as objects in Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage, or GCS) buckets. Use when you need to interact with Cloud Storage — create or configure buckets, upload, download, stream, or transfer data, organize objects with folders, generate signed URLs, control access (IAM, ACLs, public access prevention), set storage classes and tiering (Standard, Nearline, Coldline, Archive), manage cost and lifecycle, protect data (versioning, encryption/CMEK, retention and Bucket Lock, object holds, soft delete), host static websites, trigger Pub/Sub notifications on object changes, mount buckets as a file system (gcsfuse), or optimize storage performance at any scale. Covers the gcloud storage / gsutil CLI, JSON and XML APIs, client libraries, Terraform, and Cloud Storage MCP servers. Don't use for block storage (Persistent Disk), data warehousing/analytics (BigQuery), or databases (Cloud SQL, Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore).
description_zh: 在 Cloud Storage（Google Cloud Storage，或 GCS）桶中，存储、检索和管理以对象形式的数据。当您需要与 Cloud Storage 交互时使用，包括：创建或配置桶；上传、下载、流式传输或传输数据；使用文件夹组织对象；生成签名 URL；控制访问（IAM、ACL、防止公共访问）；设置存储类型与分层（标准、近线、冷、归档）；管理成本与生命周期；保护数据（版本控制、加密/CMEK、保留和桶锁定、对象保留、软删除）；托管静态网站；在对象更改时触发 Pub/Sub 通知；将桶挂载为文件系统（gcsfuse）；或在任何规模上优化存储性能。涵盖 gcloud storage / gsutil CLI、JSON 和 XML API、客户端库、Terraform 以及 Cloud Storage MCP 服务器。不用于块存储（持久磁盘）、数据仓库/分析（BigQuery）或数据库（Cloud SQL、Spanner、Bigtable、Firestore）。

description: Extract frames or short clips from videos using ffmpeg.
description_zh: 使用 ffmpeg 从视频中提取帧或短片段。

description: Run knip to find and remove unused files, dependencies, and exports. Use for cleaning up dead code and unused dependencies.
description_zh: 运行 knip 以查找并移除未使用的文件、依赖项和导出项。可用于清理死代码和未使用的依赖项。

description: Generates Mermaid diagrams from Trailmark code graphs. Produces call graphs, class hierarchies, module dependency maps, containment diagrams, complexity heatmaps, and attack surface data flow visualizations. Use when visualizing code architecture, drawing call graphs, generating class diagrams, creating dependency maps, producing complexity heatmaps, or visualizing data flow and attack surface paths as Mermaid diagrams.
description_zh: 从 Trailmark 代码图生成 Mermaid 图表。生成调用图、类层次结构、模块依赖映射、包含图、复杂度热力图以及攻击面数据流可视化。当需要将代码架构可视化、绘制调用图、生成类图、创建依赖映射、生成复杂度热力图，或将数据流及攻击面路径以 Mermaid 图表形式可视化时使用。

description: Use when working with the WordPress Abilities API (wp_register_ability, wp_register_ability_category, /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/*, @wordpress/abilities) including defining abilities, categories, meta, REST exposure, and permissions checks for clients.
description_zh: 适用于在 WordPress 能力 API（wp_register_ability, wp_register_ability_category, /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/*, @wordpress/abilities）中工作时，包括为客户端定义能力、分类、元数据、REST 暴露及权限检查。

description: Write Milvus application-level Jupyter notebook examples using a Markdown-first workflow with jupyter-switch for format conversion.
description_zh: 通过 Markdown 优先的工作流程与 jupyter-switch 完成格式转换，编写 Milvus 应用层 Jupyter Notebook 示例。

description: Implement, review, or improve WidgetKit widgets and controls. Use when building Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy, or CarPlay widgets with timeline providers; configurable widgets with AppIntentTimelineProvider; interactive widgets or Control Center controls with Button/Toggle wiring; WidgetKit push reloads, refresh budgets, deep links, Smart Stack relevance, Liquid Glass/accented rendering, widget extension setup, WidgetBundle, App Groups, and entitlements.
description_zh:
实施、审查或改进 WidgetKit 小部件与控制。

在以下场景中使用：
- 使用时间轴提供者构建主屏幕、锁屏、待机或 CarPlay 小部件；
- 使用 AppIntentTimelineProvider 的可配置小部件；
- 通过按钮（Button）和开关（Toggle）连接方式的交互式小部件或控制中心控件；
- 涉及 WidgetKit 推送刷新、刷新预算、深层链接、Smart Stack 相关性、液态玻璃（Liquid Glass）及强调渲染、小部件扩展设置、WidgetBundle、应用组（App Groups）和权限（entitlements）等内容。

description: Scans the codebase to generate project-doc.md and AGENTS.md. Use when bootstrapping a new agent-driven repo, refreshing project documentation after architectural changes, or running a delta scan to detect drift. Runs a full scan on first use and a smart delta scan on subsequent runs. Uses understand-anything + context-mode when available, falls back to native tools otherwise. Only updates AGENTS.md on detected architectural changes with human confirmation.
description_zh: 扫描代码库以生成 project-doc.md 和 AGENTS.md。适用于搭建新的由智能体驱动的仓库、在架构变更后刷新项目文档，或运行增量扫描以检测偏差。首次使用时执行完整扫描，后续运行执行智能增量扫描。在工具可用时使用 understand-anything + context-mode，否则回退使用原生工具。仅在检测到架构变更且获得人工确认后，才会更新 AGENTS.md。

description: Choose GPT-Image2 / gpt-image-2 visual styles and industrial prompt templates from the awesome-gpt-image-2 style library. Use when an agent needs to create, rewrite, classify, or improve image-generation prompts with repository-backed templates, categories, style tags, scene tags, pitfalls, and example cases.
description_zh: 从 awesome-gpt-image-2 风格库中选择 GPT-Image2 / gpt-image-2 视觉风格与工业提示词模板。当智能体需要借助仓库支持的模板、分类、风格标签、场景标签、常见陷阱和示例案例，创建、改写、分类或改进图像生成提示词时使用。

description: 商品价格全网对比技能，获取商品在淘宝(Taobao)、天猫(TMall)、京东(JD.com)、拼多多(PinDuoDuo)、抖音(Douyin)、快手(KaiShou)的最优价格、优惠券，当用户想购物或者获取优惠信息时使用。Get the best price, coupons for goods on Chinese e-commerce platforms, compare product prices, and use when users want to shop or get discount information.
description_zh: 商品价格全网对比技能，获取商品在淘宝(Taobao)、天猫(TMall)、京东(JD.com)、拼多多(PinDuoDuo)、抖音(Douyin)、快手(KaiShou)的最优价格与优惠券，当用户想购物或获取优惠信息时使用。获取中国电商平台商品的最佳价格与优惠券，对比商品价格，供用户在购物或获取优惠信息时使用。

description: Rules and formatting guidelines for writing Dart /// API documentation and doc comments. Use when documenting Dart code, writing doc comments for any Dart declaration (libraries, classes, methods, variables, etc.), or when instructed to follow the Effective Dart documentation guidelines.
description_zh: 编写 Dart /// API 文档及注释文档的规则与格式指南。用于记录 Dart 代码、为任何 Dart 声明（库、类、方法、变量等）编写文档注释，或当按要求遵循 Effective Dart 文档指南时使用。

description: Implement, review, or improve SwiftUI gesture handling. Use when adding tap, long press, drag, magnify, or rotate gestures, composing gestures with simultaneously/sequenced/exclusively, managing transient state with @GestureState, resolving parent/child gesture conflicts with highPriorityGesture or simultaneousGesture, building custom Gesture protocol conformances, or migrating from deprecated MagnificationGesture to MagnifyGesture or using the newer RotateGesture.
description_zh: 实现、审查或改进 SwiftUI 手势处理。适用于以下场景：添加点击、长按、拖拽、放大或旋转手势，使用同时、顺序或独占方式组合手势，使用 @GestureState 管理瞬时状态，使用 highPriorityGesture 或 simultaneousGesture 解决父子手势冲突，构建自定义 Gesture 协议遵从，或从已弃用的 MagnificationGesture 迁移至 MagnifyGesture，或使用更新的 RotateGesture。

description: Audit paid-ad copy, images, video, hooks, concepts, format coverage, platform-native fit, message match, creative fatigue, accessibility, and policy across supported platforms. Use for creative audit, ad creative, creative fatigue, creative diversity, ad copy review, video review, image review, or production priorities.
description_zh: 在支持的平台范围内，对付费广告文案、图片、视频、钩子、创意概念、格式覆盖、平台原生适配性、信息匹配、创意疲劳、无障碍性及政策进行审计。适用于创意审计、广告创意、创意疲劳、创意多样性、广告文案审查、视频审查、图片审查，或制作优先级。

description: Guide for quality focused software architecture. This skill should be used when users want to write code, design architecture, analyze code, in any case that relates to software development.
description_zh: 专注于质量的软件架构指南。当用户需要编写代码、设计架构、分析代码，或任何与软件开发相关的场景时，应使用本技能。

description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.
description_zh: 根据根本原因，将 GitHub 问题积压聚类为少量计划主问题，以标准化评论重定向子问题，并打包架构修复 PR，以原子化方式关闭这些聚类。适用场景为：当问题追踪器积累了数十条共享根本缺陷的报告，或当需要对问题进行分诊、合并、聚类、去重，或当需要从开放问题中构建计划系列或路线图，或当需要将新收到的 Bug 路由到现有计划时。

description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.
description_zh: 按周顺序生成项目完整 Claude-Mem 时间线的叙事摘要。将时间线按 ISO 周拆分为独立的文件，然后每周依次运行一个子代理——每个子代理接收上一周的延续内容块——为每个 ISO 周生成一章数据。当用户请求项目的"周度摘要"、"按周讲述的故事"、"顺序时间线"或"叙事章节"时使用。

description: Implement, review, or improve data visualizations using Swift Charts. Use when building bar, line, area, point, pie, donut, or iOS 26 3D charts; when adding chart selection, scrolling, annotations, axes, scales, legends, or foregroundStyle grouping; when plotting functions with BarPlot, LinePlot, AreaPlot, PointPlot, Chart3D, or SurfacePlot; or when creating heat maps, Gantt charts, grouped bars, sparklines, threshold lines, or spatial visualizations.
description_zh: 使用 Swift Charts 实现、审查或改进数据可视化。适用于构建柱状图、折线图、面积图、点图、饼图、甜甜圈图或 iOS 26 3D 图表；添加图表选择、滚动、标注、坐标轴、刻度、图例或 foregroundStyle 分组；使用 BarPlot、LinePlot、AreaPlot、PointPlot、Chart3D 或 SurfacePlot 进行绘制；或创建热力图、甘特图、分组柱状图、迷你图、阈值线或空间可视化。

description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance by the Vercel engineering team. Covers layout, typography, color, motion, and accessibility for product UI.
description_zh: 由 Vercel 工程团队审核 UI 代码，确保符合 Web 界面指南要求，涵盖产品 UI 的布局、排版、色彩、动效与无障碍性。

description: Handles the full DMS Schema Conversion lifecycle including creating migration projects, converting database schemas to a target engine, running compatibility assessments, navigating metadata trees, exporting converted DDL to S3, applying schema changes to a target database, and converting SQL statements between database engines. Applies when migrating database schemas between heterogeneous engines using AWS DMS Schema Conversion.
description_zh: 负责处理完整的 DMS Schema Conversion 生命周期，包括创建迁移项目、将数据库模式转换为目标引擎、执行兼容性评估、遍历元数据树、将转换后的 DDL 导出至 S3、将模式变更应用到目标数据库，以及在不同数据库引擎之间转换 SQL 语句。在通过 AWS DMS Schema Conversion 将数据库模式在不同异构数据库引擎之间迁移时适用。

description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
description_zh: 当用户提出类似“如何做X”、“为X寻找技能”、“是否有能够……的技能”这样的问题，或表达扩展能力的兴趣时，帮助用户发现并安装智能体技能。当用户正在寻找可能以可安装技能形式存在的功能时，应使用此技能。

description: EAS service (paid). Configure and use EAS Update for over-the-air JavaScript and asset updates with expo-updates and EAS CLI. Use when setting up OTA updates, running eas update:configure or eas update, publishing to preview/staging/production channels, explaining branches/channels/runtime versions, testing updates, or debugging why an installed build still shows old code. Load for TestFlight, preview, or production updates that do not appear, including questions about cold launches or reopening the app. Not for update health metrics; use eas-update-insights for adoption, crashes, and rollout monitoring.
description_zh: EAS 服务（付费）。使用 expo-updates 和 EAS CLI 配置并利用 EAS Update 进行 OTA JavaScript 和资产更新。适用于设置 OTA 更新、运行 eas update:configure 或 eas update、发布到预览/预发布/生产渠道、说明分支/渠道/运行时版本、测试更新，或调试已安装的构建版本仍显示旧代码等场景。当 TestFlight、预览或生产更新无法显示时，可用于处理相关问题，包括关于冷启动或重新打开应用的问题。不用于更新健康指标；请使用 eas-update-insights 进行采用度、崩溃和部署监控。

description: Watch a Cargo workspace and get told when something breaks — scheduled threshold alerts over workflow telemetry (spans, runs, records), a storage model freshness or row count, or any SQL query, firing a connector, tool, or agent when a metric breaches. Triggers: "alert me when", "notify me if", "let me know when the error rate", "monitor this workflow", "tell me if the sync stops", "warn me before I run out of credits", "dead man’s switch", "is this still running", "set up monitoring", plus listing, previewing, editing, and reviewing an alert firing history. Skip when: diagnosing something that already went wrong — use cargo-diagnostics.
description_zh: 监控 Cargo 工作区，在组件发生故障时及时获知 — 基于工作流遥测（span、run、record）、存储模型新鲜度或行数、或任何 SQL 查询的定时阈值警报，当指标突破阈值时触发连接器、工具或代理。触发条件：“当...时通知我”、“如果...则通知我”、“告知我错误率时”、“监控此工作流”、“同步停止时通知我”、“在积分用尽前警告我”、“死手开关”、“此是否仍在运行”、“设置监控”，以及列出、预览、编辑和审核警报触发历史。跳过场景：诊断已发生故障的问题 — 使用 cargo-diagnostics。

description: Apply modern Swift language patterns and idioms for non-concurrency, non-SwiftUI code. Covers if/switch expressions (Swift 5.9+), typed throws (Swift 6+), result builders, property wrappers, opaque and existential types (some vs any), guard patterns, Never type, Regex builders (Swift 5.7+), basic Codable shaping (CodingKeys, custom decoding, nested containers), modern collection APIs (count(where:), contains(where:), replacing()), basic FormatStyle usage, and string interpolation patterns. Use when writing core Swift code involving generics, protocols, enums, closures, or modern language features; route deep Codable to swift-codable, detailed formatting/localization to swift-formatstyle, and API naming to swift-api-design-guidelines.
description_zh: 采用现代Swift语言模式与惯用法，适用于不涉及并发与SwiftUI的代码。涵盖if/switch表达式（Swift 5.9及以上）、类型化throws（Swift 6及以上）、结果构建器、属性包装器、不透明与存在型类型（some与any）、guard模式、Never类型、Regex构建器（Swift 5.7及以上）、基础Codable配置（CodingKeys、自定义解码、嵌套容器）、现代集合API（count(where:)、contains(where:)、replacing()）、基础FormatStyle用法以及字符串插值模式。在编写涉及泛型、协议、枚举、闭包或现代语言特性的核心Swift代码时使用；将深度Codable相关任务路由至swift-codable，将详细格式化/本地化任务路由至swift-formatstyle，并按swift-api-design-guidelines规范API命名。

description: Connect AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, OpenAI Codex) to Grafana Cloud via the `mcp-grafana` Model Context Protocol server. Installs the server with `go install`, generates a Grafana service-account token, wires `~/.claude/settings.json` or `~/.cursor/mcp.json` with the `command` + `env` block, runs `--disable-write` for safer read-only sessions, switches to SSE transport for team-shared / VS Code setups, and verifies with `/mcp` + a `list_datasources` round-trip. Use when connecting Claude Code to Grafana, setting up MCP for Grafana, configuring the Grafana MCP server, using Grafana tools in Cursor/VS Code, querying Grafana from an AI agent, sharing the MCP server across a team — even when the user says "give my agent Grafana access", "let Claude see my metrics", or "Cursor + Grafana" without saying "MCP".
description_zh:
通过 `mcp-grafana` 模型上下文协议服务器，将 AI 编码智能体（Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、OpenAI Codex）连接到 Grafana Cloud。

使用 `go install` 安装服务器，生成 Grafana 服务账户令牌，使用 `command` 与 `env` 区块配置 `~/.claude/settings.json` 或 `~/.cursor/mcp.json`；为更安全的只读会话运行 `--disable-write`，为团队协作 / VS Code 环境切换至 SSE 传输；并通过 `/mcp` 与 `list_datasources` 函数的往返调用完成验证。

适用于连接 Claude Code 与 Grafana、为 Grafana 配置 MCP、配置 Grafana MCP 服务器、在 Cursor/VS Code 中使用 Grafana 工具、从 AI 智能体查询 Grafana，以及跨团队共享 MCP 服务器等场景——即使用户未提及 "MCP"，仅以 "给我的智能体访问 Grafana"、"让 Claude 查看我的指标" 或 "Cursor 与 Grafana" 等方式提出需求时。

description: Crawl any website and save pages as local markdown files. Use when you need to download documentation, knowledge bases, or web content for offline access or analysis. No code required - just provide a URL.
description_zh: 抓取任何网站，并将页面保存为本地 Markdown 文件。适用于需要下载文档、知识库或网页内容，以便进行离线访问或分析。无需代码 - 只需提供网址即可。

description: Use this skill when the user asks to add, embed, integrate, configure, style, or remove an agent, chatbot, chat widget, conversation client, or AI assistant in a UI Bundle project. TRIGGER when: project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves adding or modifying a chat widget, chatbot, or conversational AI; files under uiBundles/*/src/ import AgentforceConversationClient; user asks to add any chat or agent functionality to a page. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to create a custom agent, chatbot, or chat widget component from scratch; the project has no uiBundles directory.
description_zh: 在使用此技能时，若用户要求在 UI Bundle 项目中添加、嵌入、集成、配置、样式化或移除智能体、聊天机器人、聊天组件、对话客户端或 AI 助手。触发条件：项目包含 uiBundles/*/src/ 目录，且任务涉及添加或修改聊天组件、聊天机器人或对话式 AI；位于 uiBundles/*/src/ 下的文件导入 AgentforceConversationClient；用户要求向页面添加任何聊天或智能体功能。禁止触发条件：用户要求从零开始创建自定义的智能体、聊天机器人或聊天组件；项目中没有 uiBundles 目录。

description: Convert local Markdown files to Feishu (Lark) documents with automatic image uploading. Uses the feishu-docx CLI tool.
description_zh: 将本地 Markdown 文件转换为飞书（Lark）文档并自动上传图片。使用 feishu-docx CLI 工具。

description:
Technical analysis frameworks — candlestick patterns, Ichimoku cloud, technical indicators (RSI/MACD/EMA/Bollinger), harmonic patterns (Gartley/Bat/Butterfly/Crab), Elliott Wave, Chan Theory (缠论 bi/zhongshu/buy-sell points), Smart Money Concepts (BOS/FVG/Order Block), and Turtle Trading signals with ATR/Unit position sizing.
Triggers: "技术分析", "K线形态", "蜡烛图", "一目均衡表", "RSI", "MACD", "布林带", "谐波形态", "艾略特波浪", "缠论", "分型", "笔", "中枢", "Smart Money", "BOS", "FVG", "海龟交易", "海龟信号", "K線形態", "蠟燭圖", "一目均衡表", "纏論", "ichimoku", "candlestick pattern", "K线形态识别", "形态识别", "识别K线", "识别形态", "harmonic", "Elliott Wave", "chan theory", "turtle trading", "SMC", "technical indicators", "技術分析", "海龜交易", "海龜信號", "諧波形態"
description_zh: 技术分析框架——K线形态，一目均衡表，技术指标（RSI/MACD/EMA/布林带），谐波形态（Gartley/Bat/Butterfly/Crab），艾略特波浪，缠论（分型/中枢/买卖点），Smart Money 概念（BOS/FVG/订单块），以及海龟交易信号（ATR/单位仓位管理）。

description: Research competitor paid-ad presence, messaging, creative, formats, landing pages, keyword and auction signals, transparent ad libraries, and strategic gaps across supported platforms. Use for competitor ads, ad libraries, ad spy, competitive PPC analysis, competitor creative, Google Ads Transparency, Meta Ad Library, or paid-media competitor research.
description_zh: 研究竞争对手在支持平台上的付费广告存在、信息传达、创意、格式、落地页、关键词与竞价信号、透明广告库及战略差距。用于竞争对手广告、广告库、广告间谍、竞争PPC分析、竞争对手创意、Google Ads Transparency、Meta Ad Library或付费媒体竞争对手研究。

description: Craft one-of-a-kind, ship-ready frontend interfaces with elevated design quality. Apply this skill whenever the user wants to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (for example, websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or any task that involves styling or beautifying a web UI). Produces inventive, refined code and UI design that sidesteps cookie-cutter AI aesthetics.
description_zh:
打造独一无二的、可直接上线的前端界面，具备卓越的设计品质。

每当用户需要构建前端组件、页面、成品、海报或应用时，即可应用此技能。例如，涵盖网站、着陆页、仪表盘、React组件、HTML/CSS布局，或任何涉及网页界面样式化与美化任务。

产出富有创意、精致的代码与界面设计，规避千篇一律的AI风格。

description: Convert Mermaid code blocks in .mmd or .md files to animated GIFs with customizable animation styles (progressive, highlight walk, pulse flow, wave).
description_zh: 将 .mmd 或 .md 文件中的 Mermaid 代码块转换为动画 GIF，支持自定义动画样式（渐进、高亮行走、脉冲流动、波浪）。

description: Configures mewt or muton campaigns, analyzes surviving mutants, and investigates bugs exposed by testing gaps. Use when setting up mutation testing, reviewing campaign results, identifying equivalent mutants, or finding bugs from surviving mutations.
description_zh: 配置 mewt 或 muton 战役，分析存活变异体，调查测试缺口所暴露的缺陷。用于设置变异测试、审查战役结果、识别等价变异体，或从存活变异体中发现缺陷。

description: Review generated or changed test code against universal testing rules before it ships. Best used reactively after an agent writes, edits, generates, or refactors tests, before presenting, committing, or merging them. Use for pytest (test_*.py, *_test.py), PHPUnit/Pest (*Test.php), Jest/Vitest (*.test.ts, *.spec.js), Go (*_test.go), files under tests/, __tests__/, or spec/, and review requests like 'write tests for X', 'add tests', 'test this', 'review these tests', or PR diffs containing tests. Can also guide test writing when explicitly invoked before the work. This skill is the quality gate that prevents AI-generated test bloat. DO NOT USE for production or implementation code review (use clean-code-guard), CI or test-runner configuration, running or debugging tests, or general architecture discussion.
description_zh: 在测试代码发布前，对照通用测试规则审查生成的或修改过的测试代码。最佳使用方式是在代理编写、编辑、生成或重构测试之后，并在提交、展示或合并测试之前，进行响应式审查。适用于 pytest（test_*.py、*_test.py）、PHPUnit/Pest（*Test.php）、Jest/Vitest（*.test.ts、*.spec.js）、Go（*_test.go）、位于 tests/、__tests__/ 或 spec/ 目录下的文件，以及诸如“为 X 编写测试”、“添加测试”、“测试此内容”、“审查这些测试”等请求，或包含测试内容的 PR 差异。在明确被调用且在任务执行之前时，还可指导测试编写。本技能是防止 AI 生成的测试冗余的质量关口。禁止用于生产代码或实现代码审查（请使用 clean-code-guard）、CI 或测试运行器配置、运行或调试测试，或一般性架构讨论。

description: Vitest testing framework patterns for test setup, async testing, mocking with vi.*, snapshots, and test performance (formerly test-vitest). This skill should be used when writing or debugging Vitest tests. This skill does NOT cover TDD methodology (use test-tdd skill), API mocking with MSW (use test-msw skill), or Jest-specific APIs.
description_zh: Vitest 测试框架模式，涵盖测试设置、异步测试、使用 vi.* 进行 mock、快照以及测试性能（原 test-vitest）。编写或调试 Vitest 测试时，应使用此技能。本技能不涵盖 TDD 方法论（使用 test-tdd 技能）、使用 MSW 进行 API mock（使用 test-msw 技能），或 Jest 专用 API。

description: (Mobile-First · Touch-First · Platform-Respectful)
description_zh: (移动优先 · 触控优先 · 平台尊重)

description: Progressive Web Apps - service workers, caching strategies, offline, Workbox
description_zh: 渐进式 Web 应用——服务工作者、缓存策略、离线、Workbox

description: Comprehensive word document processing with full format support. Handles creation, editing, formatting preservation, tracked changes, and metadata management.
description_zh: 全面的 Word 文档处理，支持完整格式。可创建、编辑、保持格式、跟踪更改并管理元数据。

description: Compress PNG and JPEG screenshots in place using pngquant and jpegoptim, keeping the original format for maximum compatibility.
description_zh: 就地使用 pngquant 和 jpegoptim 压缩 PNG 和 JPEG 截图，并保持原始格式以实现最大兼容性。

description: Direct-invocation specialist for self-contained HTML diagrams whose layout, notation, and interaction clarify relationships, sequence, topology, state, hierarchy, or quantitative structure. Use when the user explicitly invokes html-diagram or the broad html skill routes a diagram request here. Do not activate independently from a general request.
description_zh: 直接调用专家：用于自包含的 HTML 图，其布局、标注与交互能够清晰呈现关系、顺序、拓扑、状态、层级或定量结构。当用户明确调用 html-diagram，或宽泛的 html 技能将图表请求路由到此处时使用。不要仅因一般请求而独立激活。

description:
Builds remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers on Cloudflare Workers
with tools, OAuth authentication, and production deployment. Generates
server code, configures auth providers, and deploys to Workers.

Use when: user wants to "build MCP server", "create MCP tools", "remote
MCP", "deploy MCP", add "OAuth to MCP", or mentions Model Context Protocol
on Cloudflare. Also triggers on "MCP authentication" or "MCP deployment".
Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.
description_zh:
在 Cloudflare Workers 上构建远程 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，支持工具、OAuth 认证和生产环境部署。生成服务器代码，配置认证提供商，并部署到 Workers 平台。

适用场景：用户想要“构建 MCP 服务器”、“创建 MCP 工具”、“远程 MCP”、“部署 MCP”、在 MCP 中添加“OAuth”，或提及在 Cloudflare 上的 Model Context Protocol（模型上下文协议）时使用。也适用于用户提及“MCP 认证”或“MCP 部署”的情况。优先通过 Cloudflare 官方文档检索信息，而非依赖预训练知识。

description: Use when designing GraphQL schemas, implementing Apollo Federation, or building real-time subscriptions. Invoke for schema design, resolvers with DataLoader, query optimization, federation directives.
description_zh: 用于设计 GraphQL 模式、实现 Apollo 联邦或构建实时订阅。调用用于模式设计、使用 DataLoader 的解析器、查询优化和联邦指令。

description: Implement App Intents for Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, widgets, Control Center, and Apple Intelligence on iOS. Covers AppIntent actions, AppEntity and EntityQuery models, AppShortcutsProvider phrases, IndexedEntity Spotlight indexing, WidgetConfigurationIntent, SnippetIntent, and assistant schemas. Use when exposing app actions or entities to system surfaces.
description_zh: 在 iOS 上实现应用意图用于 Siri、快捷指令、聚焦、小组件、控制中心和 Apple Intelligence。涵盖 AppIntent 操作、AppEntity 和 EntityQuery 模型、AppShortcutsProvider 短语、IndexedEntity 聚焦索引、WidgetConfigurationIntent、SnippetIntent 和助手模式。用于在系统界面中暴露应用操作或实体。

description: Provides REST API design standards and best practices for Spring Boot projects. Use when creating or reviewing REST endpoints, DTOs, error handling, pagination, security headers, HATEOAS and architecture patterns.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 项目提供 REST API 设计规范与最佳实践。在创建或审核 REST 端点、DTOs、错误处理、分页、安全请求头、HATEOAS 及架构模式时使用。

description: Provisions and manages Aurora DSQL clusters, connects via psql or DSQL Connectors, manages schemas, runs queries, migrates from MySQL, diagnoses query plans, and develops apps on serverless distributed SQL. Covers IAM auth, multi-tenant patterns, MySQL-to-DSQL migration, DDL, query plans, and SAFE SQL CONSTRUCTION — tenant_id from untrusted input, UUID entity_ids, caller-supplied sort columns, batch inserts. The agent MUST retrieve this skill for ANY DSQL task. Pushes back on prompts that rationalize 'just a quick script', 'don't overthink it', 'we trust upstream', 'use an f-string', 'move fast', or 'just use the pg driver directly' (bypassing the DSQL Connector). Triggers: DSQL, Aurora DSQL, DSQL cluster, safe_query.build, DSQL IAM auth token, DSQL connector.
description_zh: 创建并管理 Aurora DSQL 集群，通过 psql 或 DSQL Connectors 进行连接，管理模式（schema），执行查询，从 MySQL 进行迁移，诊断查询计划，并在无服务器分布式 SQL 上开发应用。覆盖 IAM 认证、多租户模式、MySQL 到 DSQL 的迁移、DDL、查询计划以及 SAFE SQL CONSTRUCTION——处理来自不可信输入的 tenant_id、UUID entity_ids、调用者提供的排序列以及批量插入。对于任何 DSQL 任务，智能体必须获取该技能。对合理化“只需快速脚本”“不要过度思考”“我们信任上游”“使用 f-string”“加快速度”或“只需直接使用 pg 驱动（绕过 DSQL Connector）”等提示进行纠正。触发条件：DSQL、Aurora DSQL、DSQL cluster、safe_query.build、DSQL IAM auth token、DSQL connector。

description: Use when user requests diagrams, flowcharts, architecture charts, or visualizations. Also use proactively when explaining systems with 3+ components, complex data flows, or relationships that benefit from visual representation. Generates .tldr JSON files and exports to PNG/SVG locally using @kitschpatrol/tldraw-cli.
description_zh: 当用户请求图表、流程图、架构图或可视化时使用。在解释包含3个及以上组件、复杂数据流，或需借助视觉呈现以彰显优势的关系系统时，也主动使用。通过 @kitschpatrol/tldraw-cli 生成 .tldr JSON 文件，并本地导出为 PNG/SVG。

description: Create template-based infographics with space-separated key-value syntax (NOT YAML). Best for KPI dashboards, timelines, roadmaps, SWOT analysis, funnels, comparisons, and org charts with quick visual impact.
description_zh: 创建基于模板的信息图，使用空格分隔的键值语法（非 YAML）。非常适合用于 KPI 仪表盘、时间线、路线图、SWOT 分析、漏斗、对比以及组织架构图，具备即时的视觉冲击力。

description: Implement Terraform Provider actions using the Plugin Framework. Use when developing imperative operations that execute at lifecycle events (before/after create, update, destroy).
description_zh: 通过插件框架实现 Terraform Provider 操作。用于开发在生命周期事件（创建前/后、更新前/后、销毁前/后）触发的命令式操作时使用。

description: Complete setup for automated agent-driven development. Define features as user stories with testable acceptance criteria, then run AI agents in a loop until all stories pass.
description_zh: 自动化智能体驱动开发的完整搭建：将功能定义为具备可测试验收标准的使用故事，随后让 AI 智能体循环运行，直到所有故事全部通过。

description: Surfaces social-layer signals for crypto markets. Three capability groups: news (latest aggregated crypto news feed, filter articles by coin symbol, run full-text keyword searches, fetch a single article in full, and list available upstream platforms — blockbeats, odaily, theblock and similar — for use as filters); sentiment (rank coins by social mention volume over 1h / 4h / 24h, plus per-coin bullish/bearish/neutral counts with an optional time-bucketed trend); vibe (per-contract hotness score over 24h / 72h / 7d / 30d with timeline and sample KOLs per bucket, plus a TOP50 KOL leaderboard sortable by engagement, mentions, or impressions). Triggers: 'latest crypto news', 'BTC headlines', 'search news for X', 'is BTC bullish', 'hottest coins by chatter', 'who is tweeting about <token>', 'vibe score', 'first-mention KOL', and Chinese variants like '最新加密新闻', '搜索新闻', '市场情绪', '情绪排行', 'KOL榜', '热度走势'. Also handles x402/402 payment, quota, MARKET_API_*_OVER_QUOTA, and confirming:true notifications on social endpoints.
description_zh: 向加密市场呈现社交层信号。三大能力组：新闻（最新聚合的加密新闻流、按币种符号筛选文章、执行全文关键词检索、获取单篇文章全文，以及列出可作为筛选依据的可用上游平台，如 blockbeats、odaily、theblock 等）；情绪（按 1 小时 / 4 小时 / 24 小时的社媒提及量对币种进行排名，以及各币种的看涨/看跌/中性数量统计，并支持可选的按时间分桶的趋势展示）；热度（每个合约的热度得分，覆盖 24 小时 / 72 小时 / 7 天 / 30 天，附带时间轴及各分桶的示例 KOL，以及支持按互动量、提及量或曝光量排序的 TOP50 KOL 排行榜）。触发词：'最新加密新闻'、'BTC 头条'、'搜索 X 的新闻'、'BTC 是否看涨'、'热议最热币种'、'谁正在就 <token 发言'、'热度得分'、'首次提及 KOL'，以及类似“最新加密新闻”、“搜索新闻”、“市场情绪”、“情绪排行”、“KOL 榜”、“热度走势”等中文变体。同时处理 x402/402 支付、配额、MARKET_API_*_OVER_QUOTA，以及社交接口上 confirming:true 的通知。

description: Fetch, store, and visualize GitHub repository traffic data (views, clones, referrers, stars) with trend charts. Requires repo push access.
description_zh: 获取、存储并以趋势图表可视化 GitHub 仓库流量数据（视图、克隆、引用者、星标）。需要仓库推送访问权限。

description: Guide for using uv, the Python package and project manager. Use this when working with Python projects, scripts, packages, or tools.
description_zh: uv 使用指南：Python 包与项目管理器。在编写 Python 项目、脚本、包或工具时使用。

description: Build lean, opinionated products using the 37signals philosophy from "Getting Real", "Rework", and "Shape Up". Use when the user mentions "Getting Real", "Rework", "Shape Up", "37signals", "Basecamp method", "six-week cycles", "fixed time variable scope", "appetite vs estimates", "betting table", "breadboarding", "fat marker sketch", "build less", "underdo the competition", "opinionated software", "we have too many meetings", "how do we ship faster", or "stop overbuilding". Also trigger when cutting scope to ship sooner, running a small team, or avoiding long-term roadmaps. Covers shaping, betting, building, and the art of saying no. For MVP validation, see lean-startup. For design sprints, see design-sprint.
description_zh:
运用源自《Getting Real》、《Rework》和《Shape Up》的 37signals 理念，构建精益、立场鲜明的产品。

当用户提及《Getting Real》、《Rework》、《Shape Up》、37signals、Basecamp 方法、六周周期、固定时间可变范围、胃口与估算、下注表、预演、胖标记草图、少构建、让竞争处于劣势、有明确主张的软件、我们会议过多、如何更快地交付或“停止过度构建”时使用。当为了尽快交付而削减范围、运行小团队或避免长期路线图时，也触发使用。

涵盖塑造、下注、构建以及说不的艺术。

关于 MVP（最小可行性产品）验证，请参阅精益创业。

关于设计冲刺，请参阅设计冲刺。

description: Run a source-grounded paid-advertising audit for one or more of Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, and X. Use for full ad checks, account health reviews, paid-media diagnostics, partial audits after authentication or worker failure, missing-platform weighting, beta-feature eligibility and scoring, spend audits, tracking audits, or prioritized opportunities and risks.
description_zh: 运行针对谷歌、Meta、YouTube、LinkedIn、TikTok、Microsoft、Apple、Amazon、Reddit、Pinterest、Snapchat 和 X 等一个或多个平台的基于源数据的付费广告审核。用于全面广告检查、账号健康度审核、付费媒体诊断、认证或工作进程失败后的部分审核、缺失平台权重、测试版功能资格与评分、支出审核、追踪审核，或优先级机会与风险。

description: Use this when scaffolding a new Terraform provider with the Plugin Framework: workspace layout, go module setup, provider server main.go, and a provider.go with schema and Configure. Also use when a user wants to start building a provider for a new API or asks how to begin a terraform-provider-* project.
description_zh: 使用本教程，当使用插件框架为新的 Terraform provider 搭建项目时（包括工作区布局、go 模块设置、provider 服务端 main.go，以及包含 schema 和 Configure 的 provider.go）。此外，当用户想要为新的 API 开始构建 provider，或询问如何开始一个 terraform-provider-* 项目时，也请使用本教程。

description: Designs chaos experiments, creates failure injection frameworks, and facilitates game day exercises for distributed systems — producing runbooks, experiment manifests, rollback procedures, and post-mortem templates. Use when designing chaos experiments, implementing failure injection frameworks, or conducting game day exercises. Invoke for chaos experiments, resilience testing, blast radius control, game days, antifragile systems, fault injection, Chaos Monkey, Litmus Chaos.
description_zh: 设计混沌实验，创建故障注入框架，并推动分布式系统的游戏日演练——产出运行手册、实验清单、回滚程序和事后分析模板。设计混沌实验、实施故障注入框架或进行游戏日演练时使用。针对混沌实验、韧性测试、爆炸半径控制、游戏日、反脆弱系统、故障注入、Chaos Monkey、Litmus Chaos 进行调用。

description: Read, search, send, and draft Gmail emails and Google contacts. Use when the user asks to check email, find emails, search messages, send emails, create drafts, look up contacts, or find someone's email/phone. Supports multiple accounts.
description_zh: 支持阅读、搜索、发送和起草 Gmail 邮件及 Google 联系人。当用户要求检查邮件、查找邮件、搜索信息、发送邮件、创建草稿、查找联系人或查找某人的电子邮件或电话时使用。支持多个账户。

description: Use when building functions that must survive process crashes, retry automatically on failure, run on a schedule, react to events, or maintain state across infrastructure failures — e.g., webhook handlers that drop events, flaky cron jobs, background jobs that fail mid-execution, or workflows that need to resume where they left off. Covers Inngest function configuration, triggers (events, cron, invoke), step execution and memoization, idempotency, cancellation, error handling, retries, logging, and observability.
description_zh: 适用于构建必须能够在进程崩溃时存活、失败后自动重试、按计划运行、响应事件，或在基础设施故障期间维持状态的功能——例如，会丢失事件的 Webhook 处理器、不稳定的 cron 任务、在执行过程中失败的后台任务，或需要从中断处恢复的工作流。涵盖 Inngest 函数配置、触发器（事件、cron、调用）、步骤执行与记忆化、幂等性、取消、错误处理、重试、日志记录及可观测性。

description: Plan, conduct, and synthesize user research. Trigger with "user research plan", "interview guide", "usability test", "survey design", "research questions", or when the user needs help with any aspect of understanding their users through research.
description_zh: 规划、开展并整合用户研究。当触发词为“用户研究计划”、“访谈指南”、“可用性测试”、“问卷设计”、“研究问题”，或用户需要借助研究了解其用户的任何方面时触发。

description: Interact with the Paperclip control plane API for task coordination and governance. Use when checking assignments, updating issue status, posting comments, delegating work, managing routines, or calling Paperclip API endpoints.
description_zh: 通过 Paperclip 控制平面 API 进行任务协调与治理。适用于检查任务指派、更新问题状态、发布评论、委派工作、管理例行任务，或调用 Paperclip API 接口。

description: Explore vague or ambitious ideas into a right-sized requirements-only unified plan. Use when the user wants to brainstorm or scope what to build. Not for executing already-specified work. Use ce-pov for a verdict on adopting a named external technology.
description_zh:
将模糊或宏大的想法，转化为规模适中、仅包含需求的统一方案。

当用户需要头脑风暴或确定要构建的内容时使用。不用于执行已明确指定的任务。

采用名为 ce-pov 的命名外部技术时，请使用 ce-pov 进行采纳决策。

description: Expert guidance for computer vision development using OpenCV, PyTorch, and modern deep learning techniques for image and video processing.
description_zh: 使用 OpenCV、PyTorch 和现代深度学习技术进行图像与视频处理的计算机视觉开发专家指导。

description: Use when designing event-driven workflows, decoupling services, implementing fan-out patterns (one trigger, many downstream handlers), implementing idempotent event handling with IDs (24-hour dedupe window), or handling at-least-once delivery from external sources like Stripe webhooks. Covers Inngest event schema, payload format, naming conventions, IDs for idempotency, the ts param, fan-out patterns, and system events like inngest/function.failed.
description_zh: 用于设计事件驱动工作流、实现服务解耦、实现扇出模式（一个触发器，多个下游处理器）、使用 ID 实现幂等事件处理（24 小时去重窗口），或处理来自 Stripe 网页hook 等外部来源的至少一次投递。涵盖 Inngest 事件模式、负载格式、命名规范、幂等性标识、ts 参数、扇出模式，以及系统事件（如 inngest/function.failed）。

description: Expert in building Telegram bots that solve real problems - from simple automation to complex AI-powered bots. Covers bot architecture, the Telegram Bot API, user experience, monetization strategies, and scaling bots to thousands of users.
description_zh: 专精于构建解决实际问题Telegram机器人的专家——从简单自动化到复杂AI驱动机器人。涵盖机器人架构、Telegram机器人API、用户体验、变现策略，以及将机器人扩展到数千用户。

description: Ruflo is a multi-agent orchestration platform for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Amp, +12 more). Use this skill when the user wants to (1) install/init ruflo in a project, (2) run multi-agent swarms with hierarchical coordination, (3) use ruflo's 314+ MCP tools for memory, routing, hooks, sub-agents, or workflows, (4) check ruflo status/version/doctor health, or (5) discover which of ruflo's 30+ plugins fits their task.
description_zh:
Ruflo 是面向 AI 编程智能体（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Gemini、Amp 等 12 款以上）的多智能体编排平台。当用户需要以下操作之一时，请使用此技能：
(1) 在项目中安装/初始化 ruflo；
(2) 运行具备层级协调的多智能体群组；
(3) 使用 ruflo 的 314+ MCP 工具，用于记忆、路由、钩子、子智能体或工作流；
(4) 检查 ruflo 的状态、版本或健康诊断；
或
(5) 发现哪种 ruflo 的 30+ 插件最契合其任务。

description: Android pentesting playbook. Use when testing Android applications for SSL pinning bypass, exported component abuse, WebView vulnerabilities, intent redirection, root detection bypass, tapjacking, and backup extraction during authorized mobile security assessments.
description_zh: **Android 安全测试手册。** 用于在已授权的移动安全评估中，测试 Android 应用程序以绕过 SSL 锁定、滥用已导出组件、WebView 漏洞、Intent 重定向、绕过根检测结果、Tapjacking（手势劫持）以及提取备份。

description: 询问当前情境适合哪个技能或流程；它是本仓库所有 skills 的路由器。
description_zh: 询问当前情境适合使用哪个技能或流程；它是本仓库所有 skills 的路由器。

description: 构建并打磨项目的领域模型。适用于讨论 codebase 术语、编写或编辑 CONTEXT.md，或记录或编辑 ADR。
description_zh: 构建并打磨项目的领域模型。适用于讨论代码库术语、编写或编辑 CONTEXT.md，或记录或编辑 ADR。

description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
description_zh: 创建独具特色、符合生产级标准且设计质量卓越的前端界面。当用户要求构建网页组件、页面、成品、海报或应用程序（示例包括网站、落地页、仪表盘、React 组件、HTML/CSS 布局，或对任意网页界面进行样式化与美化）时，使用此技能。生成富有创意、精致考究的代码与 UI 设计，摒弃通用的 AI 审美风格。

description: Generates a Gemini LiveAPI client service class in the user's chosen programming language. Use when the user wants to build, scaffold, or integrate a client that connects to the Gemini Enterprise LiveAPI websocket endpoint, handles session setup/resumption, bearer token refresh, and sending/receiving `ClientMessage`/`ServerMessage` protos. Don't use for general (non-live, non-bidirectional) Gemini API usage such as one-shot `generateContent`, embeddings, image/video generation, or fine-tuning — use the `gemini-api` skill for those.
description_zh: 在用户所选编程语言中生成 Gemini LiveAPI 客户端服务类。当用户需要构建、搭建脚手架或集成一个连接至 Gemini Enterprise LiveAPI WebSocket 端点、处理会话设置与恢复、Bearer Token 刷新，以及发送/接收 `ClientMessage`/`ServerMessage` protos 的客户端时使用。请勿用于一般的（非实时、非双向）Gemini API 调用，例如一次性 `generateContent`、嵌入（embeddings）、图像/视频生成或微调——请在这些情况下使用 `gemini-api` 技能。

description: Full-stack React framework powered by TanStack Router with SSR, streaming, server functions, and deployment to any hosting provider.
description_zh: 基于 TanStack Router 的全栈 React 框架，支持 SSR、流式传输、服务端函数，并可部署到任何托管服务提供商。

description: 从固定点（commit、branch、tag 或 merge-base）开始，按 Standards（代码是否符合本仓库记录的编码标准？）和 Spec（代码是否符合来源 issue/spec 的要求？）两个轴线审查变更。两个审查会在并行子代理中运行，并并排报告。适用于用户想审查 branch、PR、进行中的变更，或要求 “review since X” 时。
description_zh: 从固定点（commit、branch、tag 或 merge-base）开始，按照 Standards（代码是否符合本仓库记录的编码标准？）和 Spec（代码是否符合来源 issue/spec 的要求？）两条轴线审查变更。两项审查将在并行子代理中运行，并并排报告。适用于用户希望审查 branch、PR、进行中的变更，或要求“review since X”时。

description: Debugs the Buttercup CRS (Cyber Reasoning System) running on Kubernetes. Use when diagnosing pod crashes, restart loops, Redis failures, resource pressure, disk saturation, DinD issues, or any service misbehavior in the crs namespace. Covers triage, log analysis, queue inspection, and common failure patterns for: redis, fuzzer-bot, coverage-bot, seed-gen, patcher, build-bot, scheduler, task-server, task-downloader, program-model, litellm, dind, tracer-bot, merger-bot, competition-api, pov-reproducer, scratch-cleaner, registry-cache, image-preloader, ui.
description_zh: 调试运行于 Kubernetes 上的蝴蝶花 CRS（Cyber Reasoning System）。用于诊断 Pod 崩溃、重启循环、Redis 故障、资源压力、磁盘饱和、DinD 问题或 crs 命名空间内任何服务异常的问题。涵盖针对以下组件的分级诊断、日志分析、队列检查及常见故障模式：redis、fuzzer-bot、coverage-bot、seed-gen、patcher、build-bot、scheduler、task-server、task-downloader、program-model、litellm、dind、tracer-bot、merger-bot、competition-api、pov-reproducer、scratch-cleaner、registry-cache、image-preloader、ui。

description: Provides JWT authentication and authorization patterns for Spring Boot 3.5.x covering token generation with JJWT, Bearer/cookie authentication, database/OAuth2 integration, and RBAC/permission-based access control using Spring Security 6.x. Use when implementing authentication or authorization in Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 3.5.x 提供 JWT 认证与授权模式，涵盖基于 JJWT 的令牌生成、Bearer/cookie 认证、数据库/OAuth2 集成，以及基于 Spring Security 6.x 的 RBAC/基于权限的访问控制。适用于在 Spring Boot 应用程序中实现认证或授权。

description: Use when implementing delays that must survive process restarts (e.g., 24-hour cart abandonment, scheduled follow-ups), waiting for human approval or external events with timeouts (review gates, webhook callbacks, async API completion), polling external services without losing state on crashes, calling other functions and awaiting their results, memoizing expensive operations so they don't re-run on retry, or running async work in parallel inside a workflow. Covers Inngest step methods: step.run, step.sleep, step.waitForEvent, step.waitForSignal, step.sendEvent, step.invoke, step.ai, plus patterns for loops and parallel execution.
description_zh: 用于实现必须能容忍流程重启的延迟（例如：24小时购物车弃单、计划跟进），等待带有时限的人工审批或外部事件（审核关卡、Webhook 回调、异步 API 完成），轮询外部服务且不在崩溃时丢失状态，调用其他函数并等待其返回结果，对昂贵操作进行缓存（memoization）以便重试时不会重复执行，或在工作流中并行运行异步任务。涵盖 Inngest 的步骤方法：step.run、step.sleep、step.waitForEvent、step.waitForSignal、step.sendEvent、step.invoke、step.ai，以及循环与并行执行的模式。

description: Manages scaling for GKE workloads using HPA and VPA. Use when configuring Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA), configuring Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA), or applying best practices for GKE workload autoscaling. Do not use for cluster-level autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler), static cluster sizing, or configuring node-level machine styles directly.
description_zh: 通过 HPA 和 VPA 管理 GKE 工作负载的扩缩容。在配置水平 Pod 自动扩展器（HPA）、配置垂直 Pod 自动扩展器（VPA），或应用 GKE 工作负载自动扩展的最佳实践时使用。不可用于集群级自动扩缩容（Cluster Autoscaler）、静态集群配置，或直接配置节点级机器类型。

description: 面向棘手缺陷和性能回退的诊断循环。适用于用户说 “diagnose” / “debug this”，或报告某些东西 broken、throwing、failing、slow 时。
description_zh: 针对棘手缺陷和性能回退的诊断循环。适用于用户说 “diagnose” / “debug this”，或报告某些东西 broken、throwing、failing、slow 时。

description: Implement iOS authentication flows with AuthenticationServices and LocalAuthentication. Use when building Sign in with Apple, passkey/WebAuthn registration or sign-in with ASAuthorizationPlatformPublicKeyCredentialProvider, ASAuthorizationController credential state and revocation handling, ASWebAuthenticationSession OAuth or third-party login, Password AutoFill, identity-token server validation, or local biometric re-authentication with LAContext.
description_zh: 使用 AuthenticationServices 和 LocalAuthentication 实现 iOS 认证流程。适用于构建"使用 Apple 登录"、进行 passkey/WebAuthn 注册或通过 ASAuthorizationPlatformPublicKeyCredentialProvider 注册/登录 ASAuthorization 平台公钥凭据、处理 ASAuthorizationController 的凭据状态与撤销、执行 ASWebAuthenticationSession 的 OAuth 或第三方登录、实现密码自动填充、完成身份令牌服务器验证，或使用 LAContext 进行本地生物特征重新认证。

description: Guide users through configuring key MongoDB MCP server options. Use this skill when a user has the MongoDB MCP server installed but hasn't configured the required environment variables, or when they ask about connecting to MongoDB/Atlas and don't have the credentials set up.
description_zh: 引导用户配置关键 MongoDB MCP 服务器选项。当用户已安装 MongoDB MCP 服务器但尚未配置所需的环境变量，或当用户询问连接 MongoDB/Atlas 且尚未设置凭据时，使用此技能。

description: Guide for designing GraphQL schemas following industry best practices. Use this skill when: (1) designing a new GraphQL schema or API, (2) reviewing existing schema for improvements, (3) deciding on type structures or nullability, (4) implementing pagination or error patterns, (5) ensuring security in schema design.
description_zh: 遵循行业最佳实践设计 GraphQL 模式的指南。当使用此技能时： (1) 设计新的 GraphQL 模式或 API，(2) 审查现有模式以进行改进，(3) 决定类型结构或可空性，(4) 实现分页或错误模式，(5) 确保模式设计的安全性。

description: Code obfuscation analysis and deobfuscation playbook. Use when reversing binaries protected by junk code, opaque predicates, self-modifying code, control flow flattening, VM protection, or string encryption.
description_zh: 代码混淆分析与去混淆操作手册。适用于对受垃圾代码、不透明谓词、自修改代码、控制流扁平化、虚拟机保护或字符串加密保护的二进制文件进行逆向工程。

description: Ingest any source into the Obsidian wiki by distilling its knowledge into interconnected wiki pages. Handles structured documents (PDFs, markdown, articles, papers, notes, folders), raw/unstructured text (chat exports, conversation logs, Slack/Discord threads, meeting transcripts, CSV/JSON data, journal entries, browser bookmarks, email archives, text dumps), AND web URLs. Use whenever the user wants to add new sources to their wiki: "add this to the wiki", "process these docs", "ingest this folder", "ingest this data", "process this export/logs", "import my chat history from X", "/ingest-url <url>", "add this URL", "save this page", or pastes a URL and says "add this" / "save this to my wiki". Also triggers when the user drops a file, or for raw mode: "process my drafts", "promote my raw pages", or any reference to the _raw/ staging directory. This is the general catch-all ingest skill for any document, text, or URL source not covered by a more specific ingest skill (claude-history-ingest, etc.).
description_zh:
将任何来源摄入 Obsidian 知识库，通过将知识提炼为相互关联的百科页面来实现。处理结构化文档（PDF、Markdown、文章、论文、笔记、文件夹）、原始/非结构化文本（聊天导出、对话日志、Slack/Discord 会话、会议转写稿、CSV/JSON 数据、日记条目、浏览器书签、邮件存档、文本转储），以及网络 URL。

当用户希望将其知识库中添加新来源时使用："将此内容添加到知识库"、"处理这些文档"、"摄入此文件夹"、"摄入这些数据"、"处理此导出/日志"、"从 X 导入我的聊天历史"、"/ingest-url <url>"、"将此 URL 添加"、"保存此页面"，或粘贴 URL 并说 "add this" / "save this to my wiki"。

此外，当用户拖入文件时触发，或在原始模式（raw mode）下："处理我的草稿"、"提升我的原始页面"，或对任何提及 _raw/ 暂存目录的引用触发。这是用于处理任何未被更具体的摄入技能（如 claude-history-ingest 等）涵盖的文档、文本或 URL 来源的通用兜底摄入技能。

description: Provides patterns to implement persistence layers with Spring Data JPA. Use when creating repositories, configuring entity relationships, writing queries (derived and `@Query`), setting up pagination, database auditing, transactions, UUID primary keys, multiple databases, and database indexing.
description_zh: 为使用 Spring Data JPA 实现持久化层提供模式。在创建仓库、配置实体关系、编写查询（派生查询和 `@Query`）、设置分页、配置数据库审计、管理事务、使用 UUID 主键、使用多个数据库以及数据库索引时使用。

description: Install and configure shadcn/ui components for React projects. Guides component selection, installation order, dependency management, customisation with semantic tokens, and common UI recipes (forms, data tables, navigation, modals). Use after tailwind-theme-builder has set up the theme infrastructure, when adding components, building forms, creating data tables, or setting up navigation.
description_zh: 为 React 项目安装并配置 shadcn/ui 组件。该指南涵盖组件选择、安装顺序、依赖管理、使用语义令牌进行定制，以及常见 UI 食谱（表单、数据表格、导航、模态框）。在 tailwind-theme-builder 设置好主题基础设施后，在添加组件、构建表单、创建数据表格或配置导航时使用。

description: Google Flights 공개 검색 표면을 무료로 조회해 항공권 후보, 예약 검색 링크, 날짜/월/연도별 최저가·평균가 비교를 보수적으로 제공한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: Google Flights免费查看公开搜索界面，审慎提供机票候选、预订搜索链接，以及按日期/月份/年度划分的最低价与平均价比较。在돌쇠中，可执行至通过官方界面进行的后续操作。

description: Use when asking about Rust code style or best practices. Keywords: naming, formatting, comment, clippy, rustfmt, lint, code style, best practice, P.NAM, G.FMT, code review, naming convention, variable naming, function naming, type naming, 命名规范, 代码风格, 格式化, 最佳实践, 代码审查, 怎么命名
description_zh: 在询问 Rust 代码风格或最佳实践时使用。关键词：命名, 格式化, 注释, clippy, rustfmt, 检查, 代码风格, 最佳实践, P.NAM, G.FMT, 代码审查, 命名规范, 变量命名, 函数命名, 类型命名, 命名规范, 代码风格, 格式化, 最佳实践, 代码审查, 怎么命名

description: 基于 spec 或 ticket 集合实现一段工作。
description_zh: 基于 spec 或 ticket 集合实现一段工作。

description: Plan and review paid-media budgets, bidding, pacing, marginal return, forecasts, CPA, ROAS, MER, LTV:CAC, constraints, and allocation across supported platforms. Use for ad budget allocation, media budget, bidding strategy, scaling, spend pacing, budget forecast, ROAS target, or investment tradeoffs.
description_zh: 规划和审查付费媒体预算、竞价、投放节奏、边际回报、预测、CPA、ROAS、MER、LTV:CAC、限制条件及跨支持平台的分配。用于广告预算分配、媒体预算、竞价策略、扩展、支出节奏、预算预测、ROAS目标或投资权衡。

description: Install and configure Vercel Workflow SDK before it exists in node_modules. Use when the user asks to "install workflow", "set up workflow", "add durable workflows", "configure workflow sdk", or "init workflow" for Next.js, Express, Hono, Fastify, NestJS, Nitro, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit, or Vite.
description_zh: 在 Vercel Workflow SDK 尚未存在于 node_modules 中时，安装并配置 Vercel Workflow SDK。当用户询问为 Next.js、Express、Hono、Fastify、NestJS、Nitro、Nuxt、Astro、SvelteKit 或 Vite 执行“install workflow”、“set up workflow”、“add durable workflows”、“configure workflow sdk”或“init workflow”时使用。

description: 通过需求分析把反复出现的问题制作成可安装、可分级验证的单个 Skill。用户要求做 Skill、把问题沉淀成 Skill、检查或测试候选 Skill 时使用；只有用户明确要求分享或发布时，才准备 GitHub 仓库并验证 `npx skills add`。
description_zh: 通过需求分析，将反复出现的问题制作成可安装、可分级验证的单个 Skill。在用户要求制作 Skill、将问题沉淀为 Skill、检查或测试候选 Skill 时使用；只有用户明确要求分享或发布时，才准备 GitHub 仓库并验证 `npx skills add`。

description: Create, search, update, and manage SOC cases via the Kibana Cases API. Use when tracking incidents, linking alerts to cases, adding investigation notes, or managing triage output.
description_zh: 通过 Kibana Cases API 创建、搜索、更新和管理 SOC 案件。适用于追踪事件、将告警关联至案件、添加调查笔记或管理分诊输出等场景。

description: Plan a strategic roadmap across prioritization, epic definition, stakeholder alignment, and sequencing. Use when turning strategy into a release plan that teams can execute.
description_zh: 制定一份贯穿优先级规划、史诗定义、干系人对齐与顺序安排的战略路线图。用于将策略转化为团队能够执行的发布计划。

description: Schedule and execute background work on iOS using BGTaskScheduler. Use when registering BGAppRefreshTask for short background fetches, BGProcessingTask for long-running maintenance, BGContinuedProcessingTask (iOS 26+) for foreground-started work that continues in background, background URLSession downloads, or background push notifications. Covers Info.plist configuration, expiration handling, task completion, and debugging with simulated launches.
description_zh: 使用 BGTaskScheduler 在 iOS 上安排并执行后台工作。适用于注册以下任务时使用：BGAppRefreshTask（用于短时后台抓取）、BGProcessingTask（用于长时间维护）、BGContinuedProcessingTask (iOS 26+)（用于前台启动后继续在后台执行的工作）、后台 URLSession 下载，或后台推送通知。涵盖 Info.plist 配置、过期处理、任务完成，以及使用模拟启动进行调试。

description: Guides the design and structuring of workflow-based Claude Code skills with multi-step phases, decision trees, subagent delegation, and progressive disclosure. Use when creating skills that involve sequential pipelines, routing patterns, safety gates, task tracking, phased execution, or any multi-step workflow. Also applies when reviewing or refactoring existing workflow skills for quality.
description_zh: 指导基于工作流的 Claude Code 技能的设计与构建，涵盖多步骤阶段、决策树、子代理委派及渐进式披露。适用于创建涉及顺序流程、路由模式、安全门、任务跟踪、分阶段执行或任何多步骤工作流的技能。同样适用于审查或重构现有工作流技能以提升质量。

description: Use this skill to configure or inspect Salesforce Data Cloud DataSpace access for permission sets. Grants dataspace-level access via MDAPI PermissionSet XML with dataspaceScopes elements, optionally grants object-level access to DMO, DLO, or CIO objects via the Object Access Grants Connect API, and inspects existing scopes via read-only PermissionSet metadata retrieval. TRIGGER when: user needs to create or update a permission set with DataSpace access, grant access to a specific dataspace, list permission sets with access to a DataSpace, configure dataAccessLevel/objectAccessLevel, add RBAC object access grants, or list/remove object access grants for a permission set + DataSpace pair. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is a generic permission set without dataspace access (use platform-permission-set-generate), the request is about data ingestion/streams, or the work involves creating dataspaces themselves rather than granting access to them.
description_zh:
使用此技能配置或检查权限集对 Salesforce Data Cloud 数据空间的访问权限。通过 MDAPI PermissionSet XML 中的 dataspaceScopes 元素授予数据空间级访问权限；可选地通过 Object Access Grants Connect API 授予 DMO、DLO 或 CIO 对象的对象级访问权限；并通过只读的 PermissionSet 元数据检索检查现有范围。

触发条件：当用户需要创建或更新包含 DataSpace 访问权限的权限集、为特定数据空间授予访问权限、列出具备 DataSpace 访问权限的权限集、配置 dataAccessLevel/objectAccessLevel、添加 RBAC 对象访问授权，或为权限集与 DataSpace 对列出/移除对象访问授权时，触发该技能。

不触发条件：当任务为不含数据空间访问权限的通用权限集（使用平台权限集生成）、请求涉及数据接入/流，或工作内容涉及自行创建数据空间而非授予其访问权限时，不触发该技能。

description: SQL injection playbook. Use when input reaches SQL queries, authentication logic, sorting, filtering, reporting, or DB-specific blind and out-of-band execution paths.

description: Create a professional paid-advertising strategy covering objectives, economics, platform selection, campaign architecture, audiences, budget, creative, measurement, experiments, governance, rollout, and reporting. Use for ad plan, media plan, PPC strategy, paid-social strategy, campaign architecture, advertising roadmap, or channel planning.

description: Provides edge case, corner case, boundary condition, and limit testing patterns for Java unit tests. Validates minimum/maximum values, null cases, empty collections, numeric overflow/underflow, floating-point precision, and off-by-one scenarios using JUnit 5 and AssertJ. Use when writing .java test files to ensure code handles limits, corner cases, and special inputs correctly.

description: Designs a tailored multi-product agentic data science architecture on Google Cloud that incorporates opinionated best practices. Use when architecting multi-product solutions for agent-based data analytics or ML workloads. Don't use for simple queries, non-agentic pipelines, general cloud reviews, or writing agent code.

Covers Inngest SDK installation, client config, environment variables, serve endpoints (Next.js, Express, Hono, Fastify), connect-as-worker mode, and the local dev server.

description: Audit paid-ad landing pages for message match, mobile experience, performance, accessibility, trust, forms, consent, tracking, security, and conversion friction. description: Provides connectivity, authentication, and troubleshooting guidance for Amazon RDS for SQL Server. Applicable when users ask about SSMS times out connecting from EC2, Cannot generate SSPI context with Windows auth, connect RDS SQL Server from Lambda with pymssql, auth_scheme shows NTLM instead of KERBEROS on ECS Fargate, SSM tunnel to RDS SQL Server from laptop, port 1433 security group, TrustServerCertificate=True for localhost tunnels, SPN MSSQLSvc, AWS Managed Microsoft AD, CNAME not RDS endpoint for Kerberos, tds_version='7.4', encryption='require', port-as-string for pymssql, Secrets Manager credential caching in Lambda, error 18456 login failed. Covers Python (pymssql, pyodbc), .NET (Microsoft.Data.SqlClient), Java (JDBC mssql-jdbc), Node.js (tedious), IAM auth via RDS Proxy, and VPC/ECS/EKS/Lambda deployment.
description_zh: 提供 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 的连接、身份验证和故障排除指南。适用于用户询问 SSMS 从 EC2 连接时超时、使用 Windows 身份验证时无法生成 SSPI 上下文、使用 pymssql 从 Lambda 连接 RDS SQL Server、ECS Fargate 上 auth_scheme 显示 NTLM 而非 KERBEROS、从笔记本电脑通过 SSM 隧道访问 RDS SQL Server、端口 1433 安全组、本地主机隧道设置 TrustServerCertificate=True、SPN 为 MSSQLSvc、AWS 托管 Microsoft AD、Kerberos 的 CNAME 不是 RDS 端点、tds_version='7.4'、encryption='require'、pymssql 的 port-as-string、Lambda 中的 Secrets Manager 凭证缓存，以及错误 18456 登录失败。涵盖 Python (pymssql, pyodbc)、.NET (Microsoft.Data.SqlClient)、Java (JDBC mssql-jdbc)、Node.js (tedious)、通过 RDS Proxy 进行 IAM 身份验证，以及 VPC/ECS/EKS/Lambda 部署。

Use when architecting multi-cloud storage infrastructure (Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Azure Blob), establishing ingestion and AI serving subsystems, configuring Cross-Cloud Interconnect, or deploying Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and BigQuery data agents. Don't use for single-cloud data warehouses, or when the focus is on Knowledge Catalog metadata governance and Spark-driven IDE analytics workflows (use google-cloud-solution-agentic-analytics-spark-knowledge-catalog instead).

description: Professional typography rules for UI design, web applications, software interfaces, and all screen-based text. Enforces timeless typographic correctness that LLMs consistently get wrong: proper quote marks, dashes, spacing, hierarchy, and layout. ENFORCEMENT MODE: When generating ANY HTML, CSS, React, JSX, or UI code containing visible text, auto-apply every rule in this skill silently — do not ask, do not explain, just produce correct typography. AUDIT MODE: When reviewing or improving existing interfaces or legacy code, flag violations and provide fixes. Trigger on: any HTML/CSS/React artifact creation, "build a landing page", "create a component", "design a UI", "fix the typography", "make this look professional", "review this layout", web design, presentation design, dashboard creation, document generation, or any task producing visible text for humans. Even if the user doesn't mention typography, apply these rules whenever generating UI output.
description_zh:
面向 UI 设计、网页应用、软件界面及所有屏幕显示文本的专业排版规则。强制执行 LLM 模型普遍做错的永恒且正确的排版：规范的引号、破折号、间距、层次结构（层级）与布局。

强制执行模式 (ENFORCEMENT MODE)：当生成任何包含可见文本的 HTML、CSS、React、JSX 或 UI 代码时，静默自动应用本技能中的每一项规则——不询问、不解释，仅产出正确的排版。

审计模式 (AUDIT MODE)：在审查或改进现有界面或遗留代码时，标记违规情况并提供修复方案。

触发条件 (Trigger)：适用于任何 HTML/CSS/React 产物的创建、“构建落地页”、“创建组件”、“设计 UI”、“修复排版”、“使此外观专业”、“审查此布局”、网页设计、演示设计、仪表板创建、文档生成，或任何为人类产出可见文本的任务。即使用户未提及排版，在生成任何 UI 输出时，也须应用这些规则。

description: Implement computer vision features including text recognition (OCR), face detection, barcode scanning, image segmentation, object tracking, and document scanning in iOS apps. Covers both the modern Swift-native Vision API (iOS 18+) and legacy VNRequest patterns, VisionKit DataScannerViewController for live camera scanning, and CoreMLRequest/VNCoreMLRequest for custom model inference. Use when adding OCR, barcode scanning, face detection, or custom Core ML model inference with Vision.

description: Configure Salesforce Shield Platform Encryption — generate deployable encryption settings and encrypted-field metadata, and answer key-model and lifecycle questions. TRIGGER when: user wants to turn on deterministic encryption, encrypt a field, set up Cache-Only Keys, External Key Management, or replay detection, or mentions Shield Platform Encryption, encryption at rest, deterministic vs probabilistic encryption, encryptionScheme, PlatformEncryptionSettings, EncryptionKeySettings, BYOK, BYOKMS, tenant secrets, key rotation, or .settings-meta.xml / .field-meta.xml for encryption — even when they don't say 'Shield'. SKIP when: user needs a generic custom field with no encryption (use platform-custom-field-generate), needs the raw Metadata API type reference (use platform-metadata-api-context-get), or asks about Classic Encryption (encrypted text fields), which is a different feature. Use this skill for any Platform Encryption configuration, field-encryption, or key-model question.
description_zh:
**配置销售force Shield平台加密** — 生成可部署的加密设置和加密字段元数据，并回答密钥模型和生命周期相关问题。

**触发条件（TRIGGER）：** 当用户希望启用确定性加密、加密某个字段、设置缓存专用密钥、外部密钥管理或重放检测，或提及安全平台加密、静态加密、确定性加密与概率性加密、encryptionScheme、PlatformEncryptionSettings、EncryptionKeySettings、BYOK、BYOKMS、租户密钥、密钥轮换，或用于加密的 .settings-meta.xml / .field-meta.xml 时——即使用户并未提及“Shield”。

**跳过条件（SKIP）：** 当用户需要无加密的通用自定义字段（请使用 platform-custom-field-generate），需要原始 Metadata API 类型参考（请使用 platform-metadata-api-context-get），或询问经典加密（加密文本字段），而经典加密是功能不同的特性时。

在涉及平台加密配置、字段加密或密钥模型问题的任何情况下，均使用此技能。

Supports full-stack apps built with vibe-coding platforms (Lovable, Bolt.new, Replit) and frontend web applications and websites: React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit, Gatsby, Vite, Svelte, Solid, Docusaurus, and others (static sites, SPAs, and SSR frameworks with static export). description_zh:
从 Grafana Cloud 获取 RED 指标、服务地图、前端 RUM 及 AI/LLM 监控能力——应用可观测性（来自 OTel 追踪的 `traces_spanmetrics_*`、p50/p95/p99 延迟、exemplar 至 trace、追踪至日志/画像等），前端可观测性（依托 Faro Web SDK，包含 Core Web Vitals、会话重放、`pushError`、React 与路由集成，以及用于浏览器至后端追踪关联的 `TracingInstrumentation`），AI 可观测性（依托 OpenLIT，涵盖 token / 费用 / 延迟、GPU、幻觉与毒性评估）。

description: Content experimentation and A/B testing guidance covering experiment design, hypotheses, metrics, sample size, statistical foundations, CMS-managed variants, and common analysis pitfalls. Use this skill when planning experiments, setting up variants, choosing success metrics, interpreting statistical results, or building experimentation workflows in a CMS or frontend stack.
description_zh: 内容实验与A/B测试指南，涵盖实验设计、假设、指标、样本量、统计学基础、CMS管理的版本以及常见分析误区等内容。当规划实验、设置版本、选择成功指标、解读统计结果或在CMS或前端技术栈中构建实验工作流程时，请使用此技能。

description: Create, edit, synchronize, inspect, test, and publish editable draw.io diagrams. Use when the user explicitly requests draw.io/diagrams.net, needs a polished architecture, ERD, UML, sequence, C4, SysML, BPMN, network, swimlane, ML, or infrastructure diagram, wants code/IaC/SQL/OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/Protobuf/GraphQL converted into a diagram, or wants an existing diagram queried, reviewed, diffed, restyled, kept in sync, or made interactive. Prefer Mermaid/PlantUML elsewhere when the requested artifact is diagrams-as-code rather than an editable draw.io file.
description_zh: 创建、编辑、同步、检查、测试并发布可编辑的 draw.io 图表。当用户明确要求使用 draw.io/diagrams.net、需要制作精良的架构图、ERD、UML、序列图、C4、SysML、BPMN、网络、泳道、机器学习或基础设施图、需要将代码/IaC/SQL/OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/Protobuf/GraphQL 转换为图表，或需要对现有图表进行查询、审阅、差异比对、重新样式化、保持同步或制作交互时使用。当请求的产物是代码形式的图表而非可编辑的 draw.io 文件时，优先使用 Mermaid/PlantUML 等其他工具。

description: Create structured interview plans with competency-based questions and scorecards. Trigger with "interview plan for", "interview questions for", "how should we interview", "scorecard for", or when the user is preparing to interview candidates.
description_zh: 创建包含能力导向问题与评分卡的结构化面试计划。当使用“面试计划制定”、“面试问题制定”、“我们应该如何进行面试”、“评分卡制定”等关键词，或正在准备面试候选人时触发。

description: Build full-stack React applications using React Router's framework mode. Use when configuring routes, working with loaders and actions, handling forms, handling navigation, pending/optimistic UI, error boundaries, or working with react-router.config.ts or other react router conventions.
description_zh: 使用 React Router 的框架模式构建全栈 React 应用程序。适用于配置路由、使用加载器和操作、处理表单、处理导航、处理待处理/乐观 UI、处理错误边界，或处理 react-router.config.ts 或其他 React Router 约定的情况。

description: Provides comprehensive Turborepo monorepo management guidance for TypeScript/JavaScript projects. Use when creating Turborepo workspaces, configuring turbo.json tasks, setting up Next.js/NestJS apps, managing test pipelines (Vitest/Jest), configuring CI/CD, implementing remote caching, or optimizing build performance in monorepos
description_zh: 为 TypeScript/JavaScript 项目提供全面的 Turborepo 单体仓库管理指南。适用于创建 Turborepo 工作区、配置 turbo.json 任务、搭建 Next.js/NestJS 应用、管理测试流水线（Vitest/Jest）、配置 CI/CD、实现远程缓存，或在单体仓库中优化构建性能。
