description: Orchestrate Xcode build optimization by benchmarking first, running the specialist analysis skills, prioritizing findings, requesting explicit approval, delegating approved fixes to xcode-build-fixer, and re-benchmarking after changes. Use when a developer wants an end-to-end build optimization workflow, asks to speed up Xcode builds, wants a full build audit, or needs a recommend-first optimization pass covering compilation, project settings, and packages.
description_zh: 通过先进行基准测试、运行专业分析技能、对发现结果进行优先级排序、请求明确批准、将已批准的修复方案委派给 xcode-build-fixer，并在修改后重新进行基准测试，对 Xcode 构建进行优化协调。适用于需要端到端构建优化工作流、要求加速 Xcode 构建、需要完整构建审计，或需要以推荐为优先的优化环节（涵盖编译、项目设置与打包内容）的开发者。

description: Designs and implements production-grade ML pipeline infrastructure: configures experiment tracking with MLflow or Weights & Biases, creates Kubeflow or Airflow DAGs for training orchestration, builds feature store schemas with Feast, deploys model registries, and automates retraining and validation workflows. Use when building ML pipelines, orchestrating training workflows, automating model lifecycle, implementing feature stores, managing experiment tracking systems, setting up DVC for data versioning, tuning hyperparameters, or configuring MLOps tooling like Kubeflow, Airflow, MLflow, or Prefect.
description_zh:
设计并实现生产级ML流水线基础设施：使用MLflow或Weights & Biases配置实验追踪，创建Kubeflow或Airflow DAGs用于训练编排，使用Feast构建特征存储模式，部署模型注册库，并自动化重训练与验证工作流。

适用于构建ML流水线、编排训练工作流、自动化模型生命周期、实施特征存储、管理实验追踪系统、通过DVC进行数据版本管理、调优超参数，或配置Kubeflow、Airflow、MLflow、Prefect等MLOps工具的场景。

description: Earnings analysis — pre- and post-earnings. Pre-earnings preview: prior-guidance review, recent-events tracking, last call's Q&A, and a key-things-to-watch framework for an upcoming release. Post-earnings: two tiers — a fast in-chat summary card (default) and a full Markdown research report (on request). Covers beat/miss, segments, margins, guidance, estimates, valuation. US / HK / A-share. Use whenever the user wants an earnings preview or a post-earnings / quarterly-results writeup. Triggers: "earnings update", "quarterly results", "Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 results", "earnings report", "post-earnings analysis", "beat/miss", "guidance update", "earnings preview", "pre-earnings", "what to watch this earnings", "before earnings", "财报分析", "业绩更新", "季度业绩", "季报", "年报", "盈利分析", "财报点评", "财报前瞻", "业绩前瞻", "财报预览", "上季度指引", "財報分析", "業績更新", "季度業績", "季報", "年報", "財報點評", "財報前瞻", "業績前瞻", "財報預覽".
description_zh:
盈利分析 —— 财报发布前与发布后。

**财报发布前预览**：上季度指引回顾、近期事件跟踪、电话会议问答，以及针对即将发布财报的重点关注框架。

**财报发布后**：分为两个层级 —— 快速聊天摘要卡片（默认）和完整 Markdown 研究报告（按需提供）。涵盖超预期/低于预期、业务板块、利润率、指引、预期和估值。

市场范围：美股 / 港股 / A股。

使用场景：当用户需要获取财报预览，或撰写财报发布后、季度业绩相关内容时，随时使用。

触发词：
"业绩更新", "季度业绩", "Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 业绩", "财报分析", "财报报告", "财报发布后分析", "超预期/低于预期", "指引更新", "财报预览", "财报发布前", "本财报需关注什么", "财报发布前", "财报分析", "业绩更新", "季度业绩", "季报", "年报", "盈利分析", "财报点评", "财报前瞻", "业绩前瞻", "财报预览", "上季度指引", "财报分析", "业绩更新", "季度业绩", "季报", "年报", "财报点评", "财报前瞻", "业绩前瞻", "财报预览"

description: Essential tools and frameworks for modern product management, from discovery to delivery.
description_zh: 现代产品管理的必备工具与框架，从发现到交付。

description: Answer questions by searching the compiled Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user asks a question about their knowledge base, wants to find information across their wiki, asks "what do I know about X", "find everything related to Y", or wants synthesized answers with citations from their wiki pages. Also use when the user wants to explore connections between topics in their wiki, or asks a multi-hop "how is X connected to Y", "what links X to Y", "trace the chain from X to Z", or "what does X depend on transitively" question — answered by walking typed edges across multiple hops. Works from any project. Includes an index-only fast mode triggered by "quick answer", "just scan", "don't read the pages", "fast lookup" — returns answers from page summaries and frontmatter without reading page bodies. Accepts inline named-vault routing like "wiki-query @work what do I know about X" via the shared Config Resolution Protocol.
description_zh:
通过搜索编译后的 Obsidian 维基来回答问题。当用户询问有关其知识库的问题、希望在维基中跨页面查找信息、询问"我对 X 了解多少"、"查找所有与 Y 相关的内容"，或希望基于维基页面进行整合回答并附上引用时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户希望探索维基中主题之间的关联，或提出跨多跳的"X 与 Y 是如何关联的"、"X 与 Y 之间有什么联系"、"从 X 到 Z 追溯链路"、"X 在传递性上依赖于什么"等问题时，也应使用此技能——通过跨越多个跳点的带类型边进行回答。适用于任何项目。

包含通过"快速回答"、"仅扫描"、"不阅读页面"、"快速查找"触发的仅索引快速模式——从页面摘要和前置元数据中返回答案，无需阅读页面正文。通过共享的配置解析协议接受类似"wiki-query @work 我对 X 了解多少"的内联具名维基路由。

description: Diagnoses and resolves Amazon RDS for Oracle connectivity, authentication, networking, and driver troubleshooting. Applicable to any RDS-for-Oracle question including connecting a Python Lambda to RDS Oracle in a VPC with pooling and cold-start optimization, EKS pods to RDS Oracle via the Secrets Manager CSI driver with IRSA and SecretProviderClass, ORA-12170 cross-VPC timeouts from EC2, DPI-1047 cannot-locate-64-bit-Oracle-Client errors, and Oracle Connection Manager (CMAN) on EC2 as a proxy with HA across two AZs. Covers python-oracledb thin vs thick mode, init_oracle_client, RDS Proxy does NOT support RDS Oracle, port 1521, VPC peering, Transit Gateway, Kerberos with AWS Managed Microsoft AD, SSL/TLS/NNE, SSM port forwarding, EC2/ECS Fargate/EKS/Lambda, SQL Developer/DBeaver/Toad/SQLcl, and Secrets Manager.
description_zh: 诊断并解决亚马逊 RDS for Oracle 的连接、身份验证、网络及驱动程序排查问题。适用于任何 RDS-for-Oracle 相关问题的排查，包括：在支持连接池与冷启动优化的 VPC 环境中，将 Python Lambda 连接到 RDS Oracle；通过带有 IRSA 和 SecretProviderClass 的 Secrets Manager CSI 驱动，将 EKS 容器（pods）连接到 RDS Oracle；EC2 发起 ORA-12170 跨 VPC 超时；DPI-1047 无法定位 64 位 Oracle 客户端错误；以及在两个可用区（AZ）之间通过 HA 模式作为代理运行的 EC2 上的 Oracle 连接管理器（CMAN）。涵盖 python-oracledb 的薄模式与厚模式、init_oracle_client、RDS Proxy 不支持 RDS Oracle、1521 端口、VPC 对等连接、传输网关、使用 AWS 托管 Microsoft AD 的 Kerberos、SSL/TLS/NNE、SSM 端口转发、EC2/ECS Fargate/EKS/Lambda、SQL Developer/DBeaver/Toad/SQLcl 以及 Secrets Manager 等内容。

description: Optimizes GKE costs, rightsizes workloads, and configures Spot VMs, CUDs, cost allocation, and resource quotas. Use when optimizing GKE cluster or workload costs, configuring GKE cost allocation or quotas, rightsizing CPU/memory requests, or selecting Spot VMs and machine types. Don't use for general compute class provisioning or GPU Selection (use gke-compute-classes instead).
description_zh: 优化 GKE 成本、调整工作负载规模、配置 Spot 虚拟机、容器实例、成本分配及资源配额。适用于优化 GKE 集群或工作负载成本、配置 GKE 成本分配或配额、调整 CPU/内存请求、或选择 Spot 虚拟机及机器类型时使用。不适用于通用计算类 provisioning 或 GPU 选择（应改用 gke-compute-classes）。

description: Provides patterns to generate comprehensive REST API documentation using SpringDoc OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger UI in Spring Boot 3.x applications. Use when setting up API documentation, configuring Swagger UI, adding OpenAPI annotations, implementing security documentation, or enhancing REST endpoints with examples and schemas.
description_zh: 提供模式，用于在 Spring Boot 3.x 应用中基于 SpringDoc OpenAPI 3.0 和 Swagger UI 生成全面的 REST API 文档。适用于设置 API 文档、配置 Swagger UI、添加 OpenAPI 注解、实现安全文档，或通过示例与模式（Schema）增强 REST 接口。

description: Ship Kubernetes, host, container, and cloud-provider telemetry into Grafana Cloud — `k8s-monitoring` Helm chart for K8s clusters (metrics + logs + traces + events + cost), Alloy `prometheus.exporter.unix` for Linux hosts, cAdvisor + Docker discovery for containers, and CloudWatch / Azure Monitor / Google Cloud Monitoring datasource setup. Use when onboarding a new cluster or VM fleet to Grafana Cloud, picking the right Helm values for K8s scraping, wiring kube-state-metrics + node-exporter + cAdvisor, alerting on `PodCrashLooping` / node memory / PVC capacity, or pulling AWS / Azure / GCP cloud metrics — even when the user says "monitor my cluster", "send K8s metrics to Grafana", "scrape EC2 metrics", "cluster pod logs", or "install the monitoring helm chart" without naming `k8s-monitoring` or Alloy.
description_zh:
将 Kubernetes、主机、容器及云服务商的遥测数据导入 Grafana Cloud——包括用于 Kubernetes 集群（指标、日志、链路追踪、事件与成本）的 `k8s-monitoring` Helm 图表，Linux 主机使用的 Alloy `prometheus.exporter.unix`，容器使用的 cAdvisor + Docker 发现方案，以及 CloudWatch / Azure Monitor / Google Cloud Monitoring 数据源配置。

适用于将新集群或 VM 集群接入 Grafana Cloud 时，为 Kubernetes 采集选择合适的 Helm 参数，接入 kube-state-metrics + node-exporter + cAdvisor，针对 `PodCrashLooping` / 节点内存 / PVC 容量进行告警，或拉取 AWS / Azure / GCP 云指标。

即使用户未提及 `k8s-monitoring` 或 Alloy，仅以"监控我的集群"、"将 K8s 指标发送到 Grafana"、"采集 EC2 指标"、"获取集群 Pod 日志"或"安装监控 Helm 图表"等表述提出需求，本方案均可覆盖。

description: 다나와 공개 검색/가격비교 표면으로 상품 후보를 찾고, 쇼핑몰별 최저가·배송비 포함 실구매가·카드 할인가·무이자 할부 정보를 보수적으로 비교한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在Dana公开的搜索/比价界面中筛选商品候选，并针对各电商平台的最低价、含运费实际成交价、信用卡优惠价、无息分期等信息进行审慎比较。在돌쇠中，可继续完成通过官方界面开展的后续操作。

description: Designs, builds, and deploys AI agents or multi-agent systems on Google Cloud. Provides an interactive workflow to gather requirements, recommend a tailored architecture, and generate deployment instructions. Use when designing or implementing agentic systems on Google Cloud. Don't use for general Google Cloud solution architecture (use google-cloud-solution-architecture instead) or for narrow tasks targeting a single product without agent context.
description_zh: 在 Google Cloud 上设计、构建和部署 AI 智能体或多智能体系统。提供交互式工作流，用于收集需求、推荐量身定制的架构，并生成部署说明。在 Google Cloud 上设计或实现智能体系统时适用。不适用于通用的 Google Cloud 解决方案架构（请使用 google-cloud-solution-architecture 替代），也不适用于仅针对单一产品且无智能体上下文约束的特定任务。

description: Drive a physical iPhone through argent. Use when a physical iPhone is involved (a list-devices iOS entry with kind "device") and ONLY then; never for a simulator. For cable, trust, or signing problems read argent-ios-device-setup.
description_zh: 通过 argent 驱动物理 iPhone。当涉及物理 iPhone（即 list-devices 的 iOS 条目，其 kind 为 "device"）时使用，且仅在该情况下使用；切勿用于模拟器。如遇线缆、信任或签名问题，请阅读 argent-ios-device-setup。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Next.js. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Next.js", "install @sentry/nextjs", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, logging, profiling, AI monitoring, or crons for Next.js applications. Supports Next.js 13+ with App Router and Pages Router.
description_zh: Next.js 完整的 Sentry SDK 配置。适用于被要求“为 Next.js 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/nextjs”，或为 Next.js 应用配置错误监控、链路追踪、会话重放、日志记录、性能分析、AI 监控或定时任务的场景。支持 Next.js 13 及以上版本，兼容 App Router 和 Pages Router。

description: Answer natural language questions and perform analysis on GKE cluster and workload costs using BigQuery billing exports, cost allocation data, and live cluster monitoring metrics. Use when querying GKE costs across projects, namespaces, or workloads, analyzing billing reports in BigQuery (`bq`), checking cluster cost budgets (`gcloud billing`), or diagnosing cost drivers like pod requests vs. actual utilization (`kubectl top`). Don't use for applying cost optimization changes, creating rightsizing manifests (VPA/MPA), or selecting ComputeClasses (use gke-cost-optimization instead).
description_zh: 使用 BigQuery 计费导出、成本分配数据和实时集群监控指标，回答自然语言问题并对 GKE 集群和工作负载成本进行分析。适用于：查询跨项目、命名空间或工作负载的 GKE 成本；在 BigQuery（`bq`）中分析计费报表；通过 `gcloud billing` 检查集群成本预算；或使用 `kubectl top` 诊断成本驱动因素（如 Pod 请求量与实际利用率对比）。不用于执行成本优化变更、创建资源再调整清单（VPA/MPA），或选择 ComputeClasses（请使用 gke-cost-optimization 替代）。

description: Manage Trello boards, lists, and cards via the Trello REST API.
description_zh: 通过 Trello REST API 管理 Trello 看板、列表和卡片。

description: Configures AWS Site-to-Site VPN: creating an IPsec VPN connection between an on-premises network and a VPC, choosing the target gateway (virtual private gateway, transit gateway, or AWS Cloud WAN), choosing static or dynamic (BGP) routing, sizing tunnel bandwidth (Standard 1.25 Gbps or Large 5 Gbps), connecting many sites through a VPN Concentrator, applying the customer gateway device configuration, making a connection highly available, and monitoring tunnels with CloudWatch. Applicable when the user wants to connect a data center or branch office to AWS over an encrypted tunnel, choose how routes are exchanged, scale throughput, consolidate sites, or diagnose a down tunnel. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Not for AWS Direct Connect (its own service), Client VPN for individual remote users, the transit gateway side of a VPN attachment (transitgateway skill), or Route 53 DNS work.
description_zh: 配置 AWS 站点到站点 VPN：在本地网络与 VPC 之间创建 IPsec VPN 连接，选择目标网关（虚拟专用网关、传输网关或 AWS Cloud WAN），选择静态或动态（BGP）路由，设置隧道带宽大小（标准 1.25 Gbps 或大型 5 Gbps），通过 VPN 集中器连接多个站点，应用客户网关设备配置，使连接具备高可用性，并使用 CloudWatch 监控隧道。适用场景：当用户希望通过加密隧道将数据中心或分支机构连接到 AWS，选择路由交换方式，扩展吞吐量，整合站点，或诊断隧道故障时。请根据参考资料中相应任务的操作流程进行路由。不适用于 AWS Direct Connect（其自身服务）、面向个人远程用户的客户端 VPN、VPN 附加的传输网关侧（传输网关技能），或 Route 53 DNS 工作。

description: Set up a cabled physical iPhone for argent. Use when a physical iPhone is involved (a list-devices iOS entry with kind "device") and ONLY then; never for a simulator.
description_zh: 为 Argent 设置有线连接的实体 iPhone。当涉及实体 iPhone（即 list-devices iOS 条目，kind 为 “device”）时使用，且仅在此情况下使用；绝不可用于模拟器。

description: Reconnaissance and methodology playbook. Use when mapping assets, discovering endpoints, fingerprinting technology, and building a structured testing plan for a new target.
description_zh: 侦察与方法论手册。用于资产映射、端点发现、技术指纹识别，以及为新目标制定结构化测试计划。

description: Autonomous skill generator that learns new technologies from the web. Use when, users want to learn about a new library/framework/tool, need to create a skill for an unfamiliar technology, want to research and document a technology's usage patterns, or invoke with `/learn <topic>`. This skill uses web search and browser tools to discover, extract, and synthesize documentation into a reusable skill.
description_zh: 从网络学习新技术的自主技能生成器。当用户想要了解新的库/框架/工具、需要为不熟悉的技术创建技能、想要研究并记录某技术的使用模式，或通过 `/learn <topic>` 调用时使用。

description: Entry P1 category router for API security. Use when choosing between API recon, authorization, token abuse, and hidden-parameter workflows before any deeper API topic skill.
description_zh: API安全P1类别路由条目。在API侦察、授权、令牌滥用和隐藏参数工作流之间进行选择时，在任何更深入的API主题技能之前使用。

description: Implement game audio practice — bus/mixer architecture and gain in decibels, ducking (sidechain), adaptive/dynamic music via layering and re-sequencing, SFX variation, and beat synchronization. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions audio mixing, audio buses, adaptive/dynamic music, ducking, SFX variation, music layers, or syncing gameplay to the beat.
description_zh: 实现游戏音频练习——总线/混音器架构与分贝增益、侧链压缩（sidechain）、通过分层与重序列化实现的自适应/动态音乐、音效变化以及节拍同步。引擎无关。当用户提到音频混音、音频总线、自适应/动态音乐、侧链压缩、音效变化、音乐分层，或将游戏与节拍同步时使用。

description: Get Shit Done (GSD) - A comprehensive project management system for solo developers using Claude agents
description_zh: Get Shit Done（GSD）—— 面向独立开发者、基于 Claude 智能体的综合项目管理系统

description: XSS playbook. Use when user-controlled content reaches HTML, attributes, JavaScript, DOM sinks, uploads, or multi-context rendering paths.
description_zh: XSS 操作手册。用于用户可控内容到达 HTML、属性、JavaScript、DOM 注入点、上传或跨上下文渲染路径时。

description: Review generated or changed documentation before it ships — READMEs, API references, docstrings, PHPDoc/JSDoc, changelogs, tutorials, and doc sites. Best used reactively after an agent writes or edits docs, after code changes documented behavior, or before publishing docs. Use when the user says 'review the docs', 'is this documentation accurate', 'update the docs', 'write a README', 'document this API', 'add a docstring', or 'add a changelog entry'. Core job: verify every referenced function, flag, endpoint, config key, and code sample against the source; catch docs-vs-code drift; strip filler and unverifiable claims. DO NOT USE for production code review (use clean-code-guard), test review (use test-guard), marketing copy or blog posts, prose style editing of non-technical writing, or documentation site theming.
description_zh: 在文档发布之前，审查已生成或修改过的文档——包括 READMEs、API 参考、docstrings、PHPDoc/JSDoc、变更日志、教程以及文档站点。最佳使用时机为代理编写或编辑文档之后、代码变更所记录的行为变化之后，或在发布文档之前。当用户说“审查文档”、“本文档是否准确”、“更新文档”、“撰写 README”、“记录此 API”、“添加 docstring”或“添加变更日志条目”时使用。核心任务：对照源代码验证每一个被引用的函数、标志、接口、配置键和代码示例；发现文档与代码之间的差异；去除冗余内容和无法验证的声明。切勿用于生产代码审查（请使用 clean-code-guard）、测试审查（请使用 test-guard）、营销文案或博客文章、非技术写作的散文风格编辑，或文档站点主题设置。

description:
Research Solana/crypto startup opportunities using builder project history, crypto archives,
investor theses, and market signals. Answers questions conversationally by default; runs the
full 8-step deep research workflow on explicit opt-in ("vet this idea", "deep dive").
description_zh: 研究 Solana/加密货币初创机会，利用构建项目历史、加密档案、投资者论证和市场信号。默认以对话方式回答问题；在明确选择加入（“评估此想法”、“深入探究”）的情况下，运行完整的8步深度研究流程。

description: Audit/harden OpenClaw hosts: SSH, firewall, updates, exposure, backups, disk encryption, gateway security.
description_zh: 审计/加固 OpenClaw 主机：SSH、防火墙、更新、暴露风险、备份、磁盘加密、网关安全。

description: Analyze market conditions, geographic opportunities, pricing, consumer behavior, and product validation across Google Maps, Facebook, Instagram, Booking.com, and TripAdvisor.
description_zh: 分析Google地图、Facebook、Instagram、Booking.com和TripAdvisor上的市场条件、地理机会、定价、消费者行为及产品验证。

description: Set up Grafana Cloud Database Observability for MySQL and PostgreSQL — enables `pg_stat_statements` / Performance Schema, creates a least-privilege monitoring user, configures the `database_observability.postgres` / `database_observability.mysql` Alloy components, ships query samples + visual explain plans + RED metrics + schema details to Grafana Cloud, and correlates slow queries with application traces via `db.statement` / `db.system` OTel attributes. Use when monitoring database performance, diagnosing slow queries, setting up DB observability for RDS / Aurora / Cloud SQL / Azure Database / self-managed instances, correlating DB metrics with APM, or alerting on query latency — even when the user says "my database is slow", "find the slow queries", or "monitor RDS" without saying "observability".
description_zh: 设置 Grafana Cloud 数据库可观测性（支持 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL）—— 启用 `pg_stat_statements` / Performance Schema，创建最小权限监控用户，配置 `database_observability.postgres` / `database_observability.mysql` 的 Alloy 组件，向 Grafana Cloud 推送查询样本、可视化解释计划、RED 指标及模式详情，并通过 `db.statement` / `db.system` OTel 属性将慢查询与应用追踪进行关联。适用于数据库性能监控、慢查询诊断、为 RDS / Aurora / Cloud SQL / Azure Database / 自管理实例部署数据库可观测性、将数据库指标与 APM 进行关联，或基于查询延迟进行告警等场景——即使用户未提及“可观测性”，而是说“我的数据库很慢”、“查找慢查询”或“监控 RDS”时也可使用。

description: Create directed/undirected graphs using DOT language with automatic layout. Best for dependency trees, call graphs, package hierarchies, and module relationships requiring fine-grained edge routing.
description_zh: 使用具备自动布局功能的 DOT 语言创建有向/无向图。最适合依赖树、调用图、包层级结构，以及需要细粒度边路由的模块关系。

description: Builds and queries multi-language source and binary code graphs for security analysis. Includes pre-analysis passes for blast radius, taint propagation, privilege boundaries, entry point enumeration, proxy/unresolved-call tracking, type/reference queries, structural traversal, graph diffs, audit augmentation, declared cross-language/FFI/external links via `.trailmark/links.toml`, and SQL schema graphs. Use when analyzing call paths, mapping attack surface, finding complexity hotspots, enumerating entry points, tracing taint propagation, measuring blast radius, importing SARIF/weAudit/binary findings, linking source graphs across language or RPC boundaries, or building a code graph for audit prioritization. Feature-gate version-specific Trailmark APIs before using them; prefer `trailmark.parse.detect_languages()` or `--language auto` when the target language is unknown or polyglot.
description_zh: 构建并查询多语言源文件与二进制代码图，用于安全分析。包含爆炸半径、污点传播、权限边界、入口点枚举、代理/未解析调用追踪、类型/引用查询、结构遍历、图差异、审计增强、以及通过 `.trailmark/links.toml` 声明的跨语言/FFI/外部链接和 SQL 模式图等预分析步骤。适用于分析调用路径、映射攻击面、查找复杂度热点、枚举入口点、追踪污点传播、测量爆炸半径、导入 SARIF/weAudit/二进制分析结果、跨语言或 RPC 边界连接源图，或构建用于审计优先级排序的代码图。使用前需通过特性门控启用特定版本的 Trailmark API；当目标语言未知或多语言混排时，优先使用 `trailmark.parse.detect_languages()` 或 `--language auto`。

description: Provides comprehensive code review capability for React applications, validates component architecture, hooks usage, React 19 patterns, state management, performance optimization, accessibility compliance, and TypeScript integration. Use when reviewing React code changes, before merging pull requests, after implementing new features, or for component architecture validation. Triggers on "review React code", "React code review", "check my React components".
description_zh: 为React应用提供全面的代码审查能力，验证组件架构、hooks使用、React 19模式、状态管理、性能优化、可访问性合规以及TypeScript集成。在审查React代码变更、合并拉取请求之前、实施新功能之后，或用于组件架构验证时使用。触发条件包括“review React code”、“React code review”、“check my React components”。

description: Give your AI agents something more useful than a prompt. Velocity through clarity.
description_zh: 为你的 AI 代理提供比提示词更有用的内容。速度源于清晰。

description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.
description_zh: 超压缩沟通模式。通过以原始人风格说话，同时保持完整的技术准确性，可将 token 使用量减少约75%。支持强度级别：lite（轻量）、full（完整，默认）、ultra（超）、wenyan-lite（文言轻量）、wenyan-full（文言完整）、wenyan-ultra（文言超）。当用户说出“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”、“use caveman”、“less tokens”、“be brief”或调用 /caveman 时使用。当请求 token 效率时，也会自动触发。

description: Explains how to develop Playwright - add APIs, MCP tools, CLI commands, and vendor dependencies.
description_zh: 说明如何开发 Playwright——添加 API、MCP 工具、CLI 命令和厂商依赖。

description: 对照高可信一手来源调研问题，并把发现保存为仓库中的 Markdown 文件。适用于用户想调研主题、收集文档或 API 事实，或把阅读工作委托给后台代理时。
description_zh: 对照高可信一手来源调研问题，并把发现保存为仓库中的 Markdown 文件。适用于用户想调研主题、收集文档或 API 事实，或把阅读工作委托给后台代理时。

description: Search and assist Korean 고속버스/KOBUS bookings using official HTTP/API-first flows; use for 고속버스 예매, 시간표, 좌석 조회, 임시 선점, and official checkout-entry handoff. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过官方 HTTP/API-first 流程，搜索并协助韩国高速巴士/KOBUS 的预订；适用于高速巴士预订、时刻表查询、座位查询、临时选座，以及官方结账入场交接。돌쇠 中将完成官方界面通道内的后续操作。

description: This skill applies brand guidelines to content creation. It should be used when the user asks to "write an email", "draft a proposal", "create a pitch deck", "write a LinkedIn post", "draft a presentation", "write a Slack message", "draft sales content", or any content creation request where brand voice should be applied. Also triggers on "on-brand", "brand voice", "enforce voice", "apply brand guidelines", "brand-aligned content", "write in our voice", "use our brand tone", "make this sound like us", "rewrite this in our tone", or "this doesn't sound on-brand". Not for generating guidelines from scratch (use guideline-generation) or discovering brand materials (use discover-brand).
description_zh: 本技能将品牌规范应用于内容创作。当用户要求“撰写邮件”、“起草方案”、“制作推介演示文稿”、“撰写 LinkedIn 帖子”、“起草演示文稿”、“撰写 Slack 消息”、“起草销售内容”，或任何需要将品牌声音应用于内容创作的需求时，应使用该技能。此外，当出现“符合品牌调性”、“品牌声音”、“执行品牌声音”、“应用品牌规范”、“符合品牌调性内容”、“以我们的声音撰写”、“使用我们的品牌语气”、“让此内容听起来像我们”、“以我们的语气重写此内容”或“此内容听起来不符合品牌调性”等提示时，也会触发。不用于从零生成规范（请使用 guideline-generation），也不用于发现品牌素材（请使用 discover-brand）。

description: Sets up, configures, and debugs URP post-processing effects using the Volume framework. Use when the user asks about bloom, tonemapping, color adjustments, depth of field, vignette, motion blur, or other Volume overrides in a URP project.
description_zh: 使用 Volume 框架搭建、配置和调试 URP 后处理效果。当用户在 URP 项目中询问泛光、色调映射、色彩调整、景深、暗角、运动模糊或其他 Volume 覆盖设置时使用。

description: Audit LinkedIn Ads measurement, Insight Tag and conversions, professional audiences, lead generation, ABM, creative, bidding, budgets, pacing, automation, and policy. Use for LinkedIn Ads, Campaign Manager, Insight Tag, Lead Gen Forms, Thought Leader Ads, ABM campaigns, or B2B paid media.
description_zh: 审计领英广告投放效果衡量、洞察标签与转化、专业受众、线索生成、ABM、创意、出价、预算、投放节奏、自动化及政策。适用于领英广告、广告活动管理、洞察标签、线索生成表单、思想领袖广告、ABM活动或B2B付费媒体。

description: Create structured plans for multi-step work, including software and non-software tasks. Use when asked to plan, break down implementation, plan from requirements, or deepen an existing plan; prefer ce-brainstorm for exploratory framing.
description_zh: 为包含软件和非软件任务的多步骤工作制定结构化计划。当被要求规划、分解实施、根据需求制定计划，或深化现有计划时使用；对于探索性框架构建，优先采用 ce-brainstorm。

description: Use when writing Spark jobs, debugging performance issues, or configuring cluster settings for Apache Spark applications, distributed data processing pipelines, or big data workloads. Invoke to write DataFrame transformations, optimize Spark SQL queries, implement RDD pipelines, tune shuffle operations, configure executor memory, process .parquet files, handle data partitioning, or build structured streaming analytics.
description_zh: 在编写Spark作业、调试性能问题，或针对Apache Spark应用、分布式数据处理流水线或大数据工作负载配置集群设置时使用。调用以编写DataFrame转换、优化Spark SQL查询、实现RDD流水线、调整shuffle操作、配置executor内存、处理.parquet文件、处理数据分区或构建结构化流式分析。

description: Use this skill to automate managed package post-install configuration. Package-agnostic — works with any managed package (LMA, FMA, work.com, Certinia, etc.). TRIGGER when: user installs a managed package and needs post-install configuration, mentions LMA/FMA/work.com post-install setup, asks to configure permission sets/FLS/page layouts for an installed package, says 'post-install', 'package setup', 'configure LMA', 'set up FMA', 'post-install steps'. DO NOT TRIGGER for: standalone permission set assignment (use dx-org-permission-set-assign), generating permission set metadata XML (use platform-permission-set-generate), package installation, or org switching.
description_zh:
使用此技能来自动化托管包安装后配置。与包无关——可与任何托管包（LMA、FMA、work.com、Certinia 等）配合使用。

**触发条件**：当用户安装托管包并需要安装后配置，提及 LMA/FMA/work.com 安装后设置，要求为已安装包配置权限集/FLS/页面布局，或提及"post-install"（安装后）、"package setup"（包配置）、"configure LMA"（配置 LMA）、"set up FMA"（设置 FMA）、"post-install steps"（安装后步骤）时，触发此技能。

**不触发情形**：独立的权限集分配（请使用 dx-org-permission-set-assign）、生成权限集元数据 XML（请使用 platform-permission-set-generate）、包安装，或组织切换。

description: Augments Trailmark code graphs with external audit findings from SARIF static analysis results, weAudit annotation files, and version-gated Trailmark 0.4.x binary-analysis graph exports. Maps findings to graph nodes by file and line overlap, creates severity-based subgraphs, and enables cross-referencing findings with pre-analysis data (blast radius, taint, etc.). Use when projecting SARIF results onto a code graph, overlaying weAudit annotations, importing binary graph findings, cross-referencing Semgrep, CodeQL, or binary-analysis findings with call graph data, or visualizing audit findings in the context of code structure.
description_zh: 将外部审计发现（来自 SARIF 静态分析结果、weAudit 标注文件以及版本受控的 Trailmark 0.4.x 二进制分析图导出结果）补充至 Trailmark 代码图。根据文件与行号的重叠关系，将发现映射到图节点，创建按严重程度划分的子图，并支持将发现与分析前数据（如爆炸半径、污点分析等）进行交叉引用。使用场景：将 SARIF 结果投影到代码图上、叠加 weAudit 标注、导入二进制图发现、将 Semgrep、CodeQL 或二进制分析发现与调用图数据交叉引用，或在代码结构背景下可视化审计发现。

description: Create business process diagrams using PlantUML syntax with BPMN, EIP, and Lean Mapping stencil icons. Best for workflow automation, approval chains, message-based integration patterns, and value stream mapping.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 语法及 BPMN、EIP 和精益映射（Lean Mapping）图块图标创建业务流程图。最适合工作流程自动化、审批链、基于消息的集成模式以及价值流映射。

description: Comprehensive design guide for web and mobile applications. Use when designing new UI components or pages, choosing color palettes and typography, or reviewing code for UX issues.
description_zh: 面向网页与移动应用的全面设计指南。用于设计新的 UI 组件或页面、选择配色方案和字体排印，或审查代码以排查 UX 问题。

description: Audit YouTube Ads campaign setup, video and Demand Gen inventory, Shorts, in-stream, CTV, creative, audiences, brand safety, bidding, and measurement. Use for YouTube Ads, video ads, pre-roll, bumper ads, skippable in-stream, Shorts ads, Demand Gen, VAC migration, CTV, or YouTube campaign optimization.
description_zh: 审计YouTube广告活动设置、视频及需求生成内容库存、Shorts、视频内广告、CTV、创意、受众、品牌安全、出价和测量。用于YouTube广告、视频广告、片头广告、贴片广告、可跳过视频内广告、Shorts广告、需求生成内容、VAC迁移、CTV或YouTube广告活动优化。

description: Use when building UIs leveraging the WordPress Design System (WPDS) and its components, tokens, patterns, etc.
description_zh: 用于利用WordPress设计系统（WPDS）及其组件、令牌、模式等构建用户界面（UI）时。

description: Integrate Core ML models in iOS apps for on-device machine learning inference. Covers model loading (.mlmodel, .mlpackage, .mlmodelc), predictions with auto-generated classes and MLFeatureProvider, compute unit configuration (CPU, GPU, Neural Engine), MLTensor, VNCoreMLRequest, MLComputePlan, multi-model pipelines, and deployment strategies. Use when loading Core ML models, making predictions, configuring compute units, or profiling model performance.
description_zh: 在iOS应用中集成Core ML模型，用于设备端机器学习推理。涵盖模型加载（.mlmodel、.mlpackage、.mlmodelc）、使用自动生成的类和MLFeatureProvider进行预测、计算单元配置（CPU、GPU、神经引擎）、MLTensor、VNCoreMLRequest、MLComputePlan、多模型流水线以及部署策略。当加载Core ML模型、进行预测、配置计算单元或分析模型性能时使用。

description: Extracts protocol message flow from source code, RFCs, academic papers, pseudocode, informal prose, ProVerif (.pv), or Tamarin (.spthy) models and generates Mermaid sequenceDiagrams with cryptographic annotations. Use when diagramming a crypto protocol, visualizing a handshake or key exchange flow, extracting message flow from a spec or RFC, diagramming a ProVerif or Tamarin model, or drawing sequence diagrams for TLS, Noise, Signal, X3DH, Double Ratchet, FROST, DH, or ECDH protocols.
description_zh: 从源代码、RFC、学术论文、伪代码、非正式文本、ProVerif（.pv）或 Tamarin（.spthy）模型中提取协议消息流程，并生成带有密码学注释的 Mermaid 时序图。用于为加密协议绘制图表、可视化握手或密钥交换流程、从规范或 RFC 中提取消息流程、为 ProVerif 或 Tamarin 模型绘制图形，或为 TLS、Noise、Signal、X3DH、Double Ratchet、FROST、DH 或 ECDH 协议绘制时序图。

description: Summarizes Google Cloud Data Lineage graphs to help users debug data quality issues and understand data provenance for BQ/GCS. Use when summarizing upstream and downstream data flows, and presenting complex lineage data as an intuitive Markdown report. Don't use for generic BigQuery queries, editing lineage relationships, or downstream deprecation. Don't use for downstream blast-radius impact analysis (use datalineage-bigquery-asset-impact-analysis skill instead).
description_zh:
总结 Google Cloud 数据血缘图谱，帮助用户排查 BQ/GCS 的数据质量问题并理解数据溯源。适用于总结上下游数据流转，并将复杂的血缘数据以直观的 Markdown 报告呈现。

不适用于通用式 BigQuery 查询、编辑血缘关系或下游弃用。不适用于下游爆炸半径影响分析（请改用 datalineage-bigquery-asset-impact-analysis 技能）。

description: Create source-grounded paid-ad campaign concepts, messaging, copy, creative briefs, and production plans from a validated brand profile, campaign objective, platform requirements, and optional audit evidence. Triggers on: campaign brief, campaign concepts, create a campaign, ad concepts, ad copy, ad messaging, creative brief, headlines, descriptions.
description_zh: 基于已验证的品牌档案、活动目标、平台要求及可选审计证据，创建有据可依的付费广告活动概念、信息传达、文案、创意简报和制作计划。触发词：活动简报、活动概念、创建活动、广告概念、广告文案、广告信息、创意简报、标题、描述。

description: Generate Shopify Liquid theme code (sections, blocks, snippets) with correct schema JSON, LiquidDoc headers, translation keys, and CSS/JS patterns. Use when creating or editing .liquid files for Shopify themes, working with schema, doc, stylesheet, javascript tags, or Shopify Liquid objects/filters/tags.
description_zh: 生成包含正确 schema JSON、LiquidDoc 头部、翻译键和 CSS/JS 模式的 Shopify Liquid 主题代码（区块、模块、代码片段）。在创建或编辑用于 Shopify 主题的 .liquid 文件时，或在处理 schema、文档、样式表、JavaScript 标签或 Shopify Liquid 对象/过滤器/标签时使用。

description: Writes the body of a pull request - the summary, the repository template sections, and reviewer guidance such as a recommended reading order and focus areas. Use whenever drafting or revising a PR description, filling in a repository's PR template, refreshing a description that no longer matches the branch, or preparing a branch for review. Use it even when the user only says "open a PR", "put this up for review", or "write this up" without naming the description.
description_zh: 编写拉取请求（PR）的正文——包括摘要、仓库模板的各部分，以及评审指导，如推荐的阅读顺序和重点关注领域。在起草或修订 PR 描述、填写仓库的 PR 模板、更新不再与分支匹配的描述，或将分支准备用于评审时，都应使用。即使用户只说“发起 PR”、“将此提交审查”或“撰写该内容”，而未指明具体描述，也应使用它。

description: Design save/load for game state — choosing what to serialize, file formats, save slots, atomic crash-safe writes, schema versioning and migration, and autosave. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions save system, save/load, game state persistence, save slots, autosave, save file corruption, or migrating old saves to a new version.
description_zh: 设计游戏状态保存/加载方案——选择需要序列化的内容、文件格式、保存槽位、原子式崩溃安全写入、模式版本控制与迁移以及自动保存。引擎无关。当用户提到保存系统、保存/加载、游戏状态持久化、保存槽位、自动保存、保存文件损坏或将旧保存迁移到新版本时使用。

description: Audit and maintain the health of the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to check their wiki for issues, find orphaned pages, detect contradictions, identify stale content, fix broken wikilinks, or perform general maintenance on their knowledge base. Also triggers on "clean up the wiki", "what needs fixing", "audit my notes", or "wiki health check". Add --consolidate to switch from report-only to act-and-report mode (the "dream cycle"): fixes broken links, adds missing cross-references for orphans, corrects lifecycle states, demotes stale peripheral pages, normalizes tag aliases, and adds contradiction callouts — all with a dry-run preview and explicit user confirmation before any writes.
description_zh: 审计并维护 Obsidian 维基的运行健康状态。当用户需要检查其维基的各类问题、查找孤立页面、检测矛盾、识别过时内容、修复损坏的 wiki 链接，或对其知识库进行常规维护时，使用此技能。此外，当出现"清理维基"、"需要修复什么"、"审计我的笔记"或"维基健康检查"等表述时也会触发。添加 --consolidate 参数，可将模式从仅报告切换为操作与报告结合的模式（即"梦想循环"）：修复损坏链接、为孤立页面补充缺失的交叉引用、修正生命周期状态、将过时的周边页面降级、规范标签别名，并添加矛盾提示——所有操作均会在任何写入操作前进行试运行预览，并获得用户的明确确认。

description: Instruments assistant-ui AI SDK backend routes with Langfuse, LangSmith, or Helicone, and renders independent trace data with the experimental @assistant-ui/react-o11y SpanResource and SpanPrimitive APIs. Use it when traces are missing, serverless spans are dropped, an AI SDK call needs provider metadata, Helicone is not proxying a provider, or a trace tree or timeline needs rendering. For streaming transport use streaming, for initial application wiring use setup, for Assistant Cloud persistence use cloud, and for copied styled trace UI use elements.
description_zh: 集成 assistant-ui 和 AI SDK 后端路由与 Langfuse、LangSmith 或 Helicone，并使用实验性 @assistant-ui/react-o11y SpanResource 与 SpanPrimitive API 独立渲染追踪数据。当追踪数据缺失、Serverless 分片被丢弃、AI SDK 调用需要提供商元数据、Helicone 未代理提供商，或需要渲染追踪树或时间线时使用它。流式传输使用 streaming，初始应用配置使用 setup，Assistant Cloud 持久化使用 cloud，复制并设置样式的追踪 UI 使用 elements。

description: Use this skill when the user uploads Excel (.xlsx/.xls) or CSV files and wants to perform data analysis, generate statistics, create summaries, pivot tables, SQL queries, or any form of structured data exploration. Supports multi-sheet Excel workbooks, aggregation, filtering, joins, and exporting results to CSV/JSON/Markdown.
description_zh: 当用户上传 Excel (.xlsx/.xls) 或 CSV 文件并需要进行数据分析、生成统计信息、创建摘要、生成数据透视表、编写 SQL 查询，或进行任何形式的结构化数据探索时，请使用此技能。支持多工作表 Excel 工作簿、聚合、筛选、连接，并将结果导出为 CSV/JSON/Markdown。

description: 국가데이터처가 운영하는 KOSIS(국가통계포털, kosis.kr) Open API로 한국 공식 통계표를 검색하고 메타데이터·데이터·대용량 자료를 조회한다. Use when the user asks for 한국 공식 통계 (인구, 가구, 물가, 고용 등) 수치 조회, not for analysis or visualization.
description_zh: 利用国家数据机构运营的KOSIS（国家统计门户网站，kosis.kr）开放API，检索韩国官方统计表，并查询元数据、数据及大数据资料。当用户要求查询韩国官方统计（人口、家庭、物价、就业等）数值时使用，不用于分析和可视化。

description: Discovers requirements and designs an end-to-end governed agentic analytics solution using Knowledge Catalog and Managed Service for Apache Spark (Lightning Engine). Use when designing data science and analytics workflows across structured and unstructured distributed data (including in S3, Azure Blob, AlloyDB, and Iceberg), establishing metadata governance with Knowledge Catalog aspect types, or grounding agentic IDEs (VS Code, Antigravity) by using the Google Cloud Data Agent Kit. Don't use for provisioning borderless data lakehouse infrastructure (use google-cloud-solution-agentic-ai-borderless-data-lakehouse instead).
description_zh: 发现需求并设计利用 Knowledge Catalog 与 Apache Spark 托管服务（Lightning Engine）构建的端到端受治理智能体分析解决方案。当需要在结构化与非结构化分布式数据（包括 S3、Azure Blob、AlloyDB 和 Iceberg）上设计数据科学与分析工作流、使用 Knowledge Catalog 的方面类型建立元数据治理，或使用 Google Cloud Data Agent Kit 为智能体 IDE（VS Code、Antigravity）奠定基础时使用。不适用于配置无边界数据湖仓基础设施（请使用 google-cloud-solution-agentic-ai-borderless-data-lakehouse 代替）。

description: Covers TextMeshPro font stacks, dynamic fallback atlases, padding and sampling ratios, SDF16, AutoSize discipline, worldspace vs UGUI, and Memory Profiler font-data capture. Use when the user mentions TextMeshPro, Text Mesh Pro, TMP (TextMeshPro), font asset, dynamic atlas, TMP localization, CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) fonts, font alignment across scripts, mixed western and eastern fonts, text rendering performance, profiler markers related to text generation or glyph rasterization, font fallback strategy, font normalization, multilingual or localized text rendering, SDF font quality, or text-related memory issues—not for UI Toolkit layout (unity-ui-toolkit) or non-TMP uGUI (unity-ui).
description_zh: 涵盖TextMeshPro字体堆栈、动态回退图集、填充与采样比例、SDF16、AutoSize规范、世界空间与UGUI的对比，以及内存分析器字体数据捕获。当用户提及TextMeshPro、Text Mesh Pro、TMP（TextMeshPro）、字体资源、动态图集、TMP本地化、CJK（中文、日文、韩文）字体、跨脚本字体对齐、混合西文字体与东文字体、文本渲染性能、与文本生成或字形栅格化相关的分析器标记、字体回退策略、字体归一化、多语言或本地化文本渲染、SDF字体质量，或文本相关内存问题时使用——不适用于UI工具包布局（unity-ui-toolkit）或非TMP的UGUI（unity-ui）。

description: Discovers requirements, and generates architectural, design, and deployment guidance for a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-capable enterprise search system in Google Cloud. Use when users need a vector-enabled SQL database as the store and index for the embedding vectors, an open model and open-source inferencing framework, and Kubernetes containers to host all the application components. DON'T use this skill for fully-managed RAG, or SaaS search services, or when a non-SQL vector database is required.
description_zh: 发现需求，并为 Google Cloud 的可检索增强生成（RAG）企业搜索系统生成架构、设计与部署指南。当用户需要将支持向量的 SQL 数据库作为嵌入向量的存储与索引、采用开放模型与开源推理框架，并通过 Kubernetes 容器托管所有应用程序组件时，使用此技能。不要将此技能用于完全托管的 RAG、SaaS 搜索服务，或当需要非 SQL 向量数据库时。

description:
Options chains, option quotes, option volume, Greeks (Delta/Gamma/Theta/Vega), implied volatility, and HK warrants (callable bull/bear, call/put warrants, issuer list) for HK/US markets via Longbridge.
Triggers: "期权", "期权链", "认购", "认沽", "行权价", "到期日", "IV", "隐含波动率", "Greeks", "delta", "gamma", "窝轮", "牛熊证", "认购证", "认沽证", "認購", "認沽", "行權價", "隱含波動率", "窩輪", "牛熊證", "option", "option chain", "call", "put", "strike", "expiry", "implied volatility", "warrant", "CBBC", "期權", "期權鏈"
description_zh: 通过Longbridge平台，为HK/美国市场提供期权链、期权报价、期权成交量、希腊字母（Delta/Gamma/Theta/Vega）、隐含波动率及香港窝轮（牛熊证、认购证/认沽证、发行人清单）服务。

description: Adds user managed browser MCP servers to assistant-ui with `@assistant-ui/react-mcp`. Use when mounting `McpManagerResource`, declaring `defineConnector` presets, persisting custom servers and OAuth state, composing `McpManagerPrimitive`, `McpServerPrimitive`, `McpAddFormPrimitive`, or `McpElicitationPrimitive`, handling an OAuth callback, browsing MCP resources, or diagnosing missing server tools, connection failures, and OAuth redirects. This covers end user chosen servers, not application owned backend MCP tools. For those use tools; for the chat runtime use runtime; for the copied dialog use elements.
description_zh: 通过 `@assistant-ui/react-mcp`，可将用户管理的浏览器 MCP 服务器添加到 assistant-ui 中。使用时，适用于挂载 `McpManagerResource`、声明 `defineConnector` 预设、持久化自定义服务器与 OAuth 状态、组合 `McpManagerPrimitive`、`McpServerPrimitive`、`McpAddFormPrimitive` 或 `McpElicitationPrimitive`、处理 OAuth 回调、浏览 MCP 资源，或诊断缺失的服务器工具、连接失败及 OAuth 重定向等场景。本功能覆盖的是终端用户选择的服务器，而非应用自有的后端 MCP 工具。对于应用自有的后端 MCP 工具，使用工具；对于聊天运行时，使用运行时；对于复制对话框，使用元素。

description: Business logic vulnerability playbook. Use when reasoning about workflows, race conditions, price manipulation, coupon abuse, state machines, and multi-step authorization gaps.
description_zh: 业务逻辑漏洞指南。用于推理工作流、竞态条件、价格操纵、优惠券滥用、状态机以及多步授权漏洞。

description: Build direct Bluetooth Low Energy workflows with Core Bluetooth. Use when implementing BLE central or peripheral GATT communication, scanning or connecting with CBCentralManager, discovering services and characteristics, reading/writing/subscribing with CBPeripheral, publishing local services with CBPeripheralManager, handling Bluetooth authorization, background BLE modes, state restoration, write flow control, or CBUUID-based workflows. For privacy-preserving accessory setup/picker flows, use accessorysetupkit first and return here for post-setup GATT communication.
description_zh:
使用核心蓝牙构建低功耗蓝牙（BLE）工作流程。

在实现 BLE 中心或外围设备的 GATT 通信、使用 CBCentralManager 进行扫描与连接、发现服务与特征、使用 CBPeripheral 进行读取/写入/订阅、使用 CBPeripheralManager 发布本地服务、处理蓝牙授权、后台 BLE 模式、状态恢复、写入流程控制，或基于 CBUUID 的工作流程时使用。

对于注重隐私的配件设置/选择流程，请优先使用 accessorysetupkit，并在设置完成后在此处进行 GATT 通信。

description: 당근부동산 공개 웹 데이터로 매물을 검색하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 계정 표면에서 문의·방문예약·계약 준비까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过당근부동산公开网页数据搜索房源，在돌쇠上通过官方账号界面进行咨询、到访预约、签约准备等操作。

description: Runs a Trailmark summary analysis on a codebase. Returns auto-detected languages, entry point count, and dependency list. Use when vivisect or galvanize needs a quick structural overview. Triggers: trailmark summary, code summary, structural overview.
description_zh: 对代码库执行 Trailmark 摘要分析。返回自动检测到的语言、入口点数量和依赖列表。当 vivisect 或 galvanize 需要快速结构概览时使用。触发条件：Trailmark summary、code summary、structural overview。

description: Manage a fleet of Grafana Alloy collectors with Fleet Management — author Alloy pipelines once, target them via attribute matchers (`env="production"`, regex `region=~"us-.*"`), push remotely via OpAMP without restarting collectors. Covers pipeline create / update / matcher RPCs, collector attribute API, `remotecfg` bootstrap block (standalone + Helm), pre-deploy `alloy fmt` validation, the local Alloy UI at port 12345 for component health, and post-deploy `REMOTE_CONFIG_STATUS_APPLIED` verification. Use when standing up a Cloud Alloy fleet, pushing a config change to 200 collectors, hunting why one collector shows `REMOTE_CONFIG_STATUS_FAILED`, validating River syntax before saving, or wiring `discovery.kubernetes` → `prometheus.remote_write` — even when the user says "configure Alloy", "remote config the collectors", "push pipeline", "OpAMP", "collector is unhealthy", or "manage agent config centrally" without naming Fleet Management.
description_zh: 使用 Fleet Management 管理 Grafana Alloy 采集器舰队——一次性创建 Alloy 流水线，通过属性匹配器（`env="production"`、正则 `region=~"us-.*"`）进行目标匹配，通过 OpAMP 远程推送配置而无需重启采集器。涵盖流水线创建/更新/匹配 RPC、采集器属性 API、`remotecfg` 引导块（独立部署 + Helm）、部署前 `alloy fmt` 校验、端口 12345 上的本地 Alloy UI 组件健康状态，以及部署后 `REMOTE_CONFIG_STATUS_APPLIED` 验证。适用于在云端搭建 Alloy 舰队、向 200 个采集器推送配置变更、排查某采集器显示 `REMOTE_CONFIG_STATUS_FAILED` 的原因、保存前校验 River 语法，或将 `discovery.kubernetes` 配置为 `prometheus.remote_write` 的场景——即使用户未提及 Fleet Management，仅使用"配置 Alloy"、"远程配置采集器"、"推送流水线"、"OpAMP"、"采集器异常"或"集中管理 Agent 配置"等说法时。

description: Interactive workflow to create Commerce B2B Stores and retrieve storefront metadata. Use when users want to: create B2B Commerce stores, build Commerce storefronts, set up B2B stores from Vibes, retrieve Commerce metadata, deploy Commerce experiences, work with DigitalExperienceBundle for Commerce.
description_zh: 交互式工作流：创建 Commerce B2B 商店和检索店面元数据。当用户希望：创建 Commerce B2B 商店、构建 Commerce 店面、从 Vibes 设置 Commerce B2B 商店、检索 Commerce 元数据、部署 Commerce 体验、在 Commerce 中使用 DigitalExperienceBundle。

description: Generate a Business Model Canvas with all 9 building blocks. Use when creating a business model, documenting how a business creates value, or analyzing an existing business model.
description_zh: 生成包含全部9个构建模块的业务模型画布。用于创建商业模式、记录企业创造价值的方式，或分析现有商业模式。

description: Run a comprehensive SEO audit — keyword research, on-page analysis, content gaps, technical checks, and competitor comparison. Use when assessing a site's SEO health, when finding keyword opportunities and content gaps competitors own, or when you need a prioritized action plan split into quick wins and strategic investments.
description_zh: 执行全面的SEO审计——包括关键词研究、页面内分析、内容缺口、技术检查及竞争对手对比。适用于评估网站SEO健康状况、寻找竞争对手占据的关键词机会和内容缺口，以及需要一份将“速赢”与“战略投资”区分开来的优先级行动计划时。

description: Guide for running acceptance tests for a Terraform provider. Use this when asked to run an acceptance test or to run a test with the prefix `TestAcc`, when a test fails with missing environment variables, or when diagnosing a failing or suspiciously passing acceptance test.
description_zh: Terraform provider 验收测试运行指南。当被要求运行验收测试或运行以 `TestAcc` 为前缀的测试、当测试因缺少环境变量而失败，或当诊断失败的验收测试或可疑通过的验收测试时，使用本指南。

description: Starts and controls the reaper MITM proxy to capture, inspect, search, and replay HTTP/HTTPS traffic between clients and servers. Capabilities include starting/stopping the proxy scoped to specific domains, viewing captured request/response logs, searching traffic by method/path/status/host, and inspecting full raw HTTP entries for security analysis. Use when the user asks to "start the proxy", "capture traffic", "intercept requests", "inspect HTTP traffic", "search captured requests", or "view request/response".
description_zh: 启动并控制 reaper MITM 代理，以捕获、检查、搜索和重放客户端与服务器之间的 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。其功能包括：针对特定域名启动/停止代理、查看已捕获的请求/响应日志、根据方法、路径、状态或主机搜索流量，以及检查完整的原始 HTTP 条目以进行安全分析。当用户要求“启动代理”、“捕获流量”、“拦截请求”、“检查 HTTP 流量”、“搜索已捕获请求”或“查看请求/响应”时使用。

description: Scrape public Instagram data without logging in and without a Meta developer account — profiles, posts, reels, stories, comments, hashtags, locations, and mentions. Use when the user wants to fetch an Instagram profile's follower count, bio, or post count, pull a profile's recent posts or reels, read the comments on a post, find posts under a hashtag or at a location, search for accounts by keyword, track a competitor's Instagram content, vet or discover influencers, export engagement metrics, monitor a brand's mentions, or build an Instagram data pipeline. Runs on Apify's Instagram Scraper; needs a free Apify account (API token), which this skill will help set up on first use.
description_zh: 无需登录、无需Meta开发者账户，即可抓取公开Instagram数据——个人资料、帖子、Reels、快拍、评论、话题标签、地点和提及。适用于用户需要获取Instagram个人资料的粉丝数、个人简介或帖子数，提取个人资料的最新帖子或Reels，阅读帖子的评论，查找话题标签下的帖子或某地点的帖子，通过关键词搜索账号，追踪竞争对手的Instagram内容，审核或发现影响力人物，导出互动指标，监控品牌的提及，或构建Instagram数据管道的场景。在Apify的Instagram Scraper上运行；需要免费的Apify账户（API令牌），本技能将在首次使用时协助完成设置。

description: Create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring. Use when you need to inspect adapter configuration options, compare existing agent configs, draft a new agent prompt/config, and submit a hire request.
description_zh: 在 Paperclip 中采用治理感知型招聘创建新代理。当您需要检查适配器配置选项、比较现有代理配置、起草新的代理提示词/配置，并提交招聘请求时使用。

description: Runs full Trailmark structural analysis by building a graph, running `preanalysis()`, and reporting hotspots, taint, blast radius, privilege boundaries, attack surface, and version-gated Trailmark 0.4+/0.5+ data such as proxy counts, subgraph edges, type/reference summaries, and entrypoint attributes. Use when vivisect needs detailed structural data for a target. Triggers: structural analysis, blast radius, taint analysis, complexity hotspots, proxy nodes, type references.
description_zh: 通过构建图、运行 `preanalysis()`，并报告热点、污点、爆炸半径、权限边界、攻击面，以及受版本限制的 Trailmark 0.4+/0.5+ 数据（如代理计数、子图边、类型/引用摘要、入口点属性），执行完整的 Trailmark 结构分析。当 vivisect 为某个目标需要详细结构数据时使用。触发条件：结构分析、爆炸半径、污点分析、复杂度热点、代理节点、类型引用。

description: Build game cameras that feel good — 2D follow with a deadzone, look-ahead, smoothing, and level-bounds clamping; 3D third-person orbit with collision and first-person look; plus multi-target framing and a shake hook. Engine-neutral techniques that pair with the engine's camera node and rigs like Unity Cinemachine or Godot Camera2D/PhantomCamera. Use when the user mentions camera follow, follow camera, deadzone, look-ahead, camera smoothing, camera bounds/ limits, third-person camera, orbit camera, first-person look, Cinemachine, or camera jitter.
description_zh: 打造手感出色的游戏相机——2D跟随功能具备死区、前瞻、平滑处理与关卡边界限制；3D第三人称环绕支持碰撞检测与第一人称视角；此外还支持多目标取景与抖动钩子。这些引擎无关的技术方案，可与Unity Cinemachine或Godot Camera2D/PhantomCamera等引擎相机节点与角色系统配合使用。适用于用户提及摄像机跟随、跟随相机、死区、前瞻、相机平滑、相机边界/限制、第三人称相机、环绕相机、第一人称视角、Cinemachine或相机抖动等场景时使用。

description: Find and fix game performance problems methodically — measure with the engine profiler first, reason about the frame-time budget, locate the CPU-vs-GPU bottleneck, then apply the right fix: object pooling, draw-call batching, fewer allocations/GC spikes, and asset budgets. Engine- neutral method that pairs with each engine's profiler. Use when the user mentions performance, optimize, low/dropping FPS, frame drops, stutter, lag, profiler, frame budget, draw calls, batching, garbage collection/GC spikes, object pooling, or "the game runs slow".
description_zh: 系统化地查找并修复游戏性能问题——首先利用引擎分析器进行测量，分析帧时间预算，定位 CPU 与 GPU 的性能瓶颈，随后应用合适的解决方案：对象池化、绘制调用批处理、减少分配与 GC 峰值以及资源预算。这是一种引擎无关的方法，可与每个引擎的分析器配合使用。适用场景：当用户提及性能、优化、帧率（FPS）过低或下降、帧掉帧、卡顿、延迟、分析器、帧预算、绘制调用、批处理、垃圾回收（GC）峰值、对象池化，或“游戏运行缓慢”时。

description: Use when adding cross-cutting concerns to durable functions — structured logging or tracing across all functions, error tracking with Sentry, payload encryption for sensitive data, dependency injection of clients (DB, Stripe, etc.) into function handlers, custom telemetry, or behavior that should apply uniformly across many functions. Covers Inngest middleware lifecycle, creating custom middleware, dependencyInjectionMiddleware, @inngest/middleware-encryption, @inngest/middleware-sentry, and custom middleware patterns.
description_zh: 用于为持久函数添加横切关注点的场景——即在全部函数中实现结构化日志或链路追踪、使用 Sentry 进行错误追踪、对敏感数据加密负载、将客户端（如数据库、Stripe 等）注入函数处理程序、实现自定义遥测，或需应用于多个函数中统一生效的行为。涵盖 Inngest 中间件生命周期、创建自定义中间件、dependencyInjectionMiddleware、@inngest/middleware-encryption、@inngest/middleware-sentry 以及自定义中间件模式等内容。

description: Define and use segments — named, saved filters over a Cargo model that become the audience for a batch run, a play trigger, or an export. Triggers: "build a segment of", "filter my contacts where", "who matches this criteria", "save this as a list", "how many companies match", "the Closed-Won segment", "everyone who has not been emailed", "target only accounts that", "what is in this segment", "narrow this down to". Filter JSON uses `conjonction` (not `conjunction`) — misspelling it fails silently. Skip when: running something over the segment — use cargo-orchestration; exporting its rows — use cargo-analytics; ad-hoc SQL over the model — use cargo-storage.
description_zh:
定义和使用分段——即针对 Cargo 模型的已命名且已保存的筛选器，它们可作为批量运行、播放触发器或导出的受众。
触发器："构建一个分段"，"筛选我的联系人，其中"，"哪些符合这些标准"，"将其保存为列表"，"有多少公司符合"，"已赢取分段"，"所有尚未收到邮件的"，"仅针对满足该条件的账户"，"该分段包含哪些内容"，"将此缩小到"。
筛选 JSON 使用 `conjonction`（而非 `conjunction`）——拼写错误会导致静默失败。
跳过情况：对该分段运行任何操作 —— 使用 cargo-orchestration；导出其数据行 —— 使用 cargo-analytics；在模型上执行即席 SQL —— 使用 cargo-storage。

description: Create and manage Kibana alerting rules. Use when creating, updating, or managing rule lifecycle (enable, disable, mute, snooze), choosing metric threshold rule types and params, or read-only find/list with tag filters.
description_zh: 创建并管理 Kibana 告警规则。用于创建、更新或管理规则生命周期（启用、禁用、静音、延时）、选择指标阈值规则类型及参数，或使用标签过滤器进行只读查找/列表。

description:
Trigger when: (1) User mentions "manim" or "Manim Community" or "ManimCE", (2) Code contains `from manim import *`, (3) User runs `manim` CLI commands, (4) Working with Scene, MathTex, Create(), or ManimCE-specific classes.

Best practices for Manim Community Edition - the community-maintained Python animation engine. Covers Scene structure, animations, LaTeX/MathTex, 3D with ThreeDScene, camera control, styling, and CLI usage.

NOT for ManimGL/3b1b version (which uses `manimlib` imports and `manimgl` CLI).
description_zh:
触发条件：
（1）用户提及“manIm”“ManIm Community”或“ManImCE”；
（2）代码中包含 `from manIm import *`；
（3）用户运行 `manIm` CLI 命令；
（4）正在使用 Scene、MathTex、Create() 或 ManImCE 特定类。

ManIm 社区版最佳实践 —— 社区维护的 Python 动画引擎。涵盖 Scene 结构、动画、LaTeX/MathTex、基于 ThreeDScene 的 3D 场景、相机控制、样式及 CLI 使用。

不适用于 ManImGL/3b1b 版本（该版本使用 `manImlib` 导入和 `manImgl` CLI 命令）。

description: Creates professional logical flow diagrams and logical system architecture diagrams using draw.io XML format (.drawio files). Use when creating: (1) logical flow diagrams showing data/process flow between system components, (2) logical architecture diagrams representing system structure without cloud provider specifics, (3) BPMN process diagrams, (4) UML diagrams (class, sequence, activity), (5) data flow diagrams (DFD), (6) decision flowcharts, or (7) system interaction diagrams. This skill focuses on generic/abstract representations, not AWS/Azure-specific architectures (use aws-drawio-architecture-diagrams for cloud diagrams).
description_zh: 使用 draw.io XML 格式（.drawio 文件）创建专业逻辑流程图和逻辑系统架构图。用于创建以下内容：(1) 展示系统组件之间数据/流程的逻辑流程图，(2) 表示系统结构且不涉及云服务商具体细节的逻辑架构图，(3) BPMN 流程图，(4) UML 图（类图、序列图、活动图），(5) 数据流图（DFD），(6) 决策流程图，(7) 系统交互图。本技能聚焦于通用/抽象表示，而非 AWS/Azure 特定的架构（云图请使用 aws-drawio-architecture-diagrams）。

description: Compares Trailmark code graphs at two source code snapshots (git commits, tags, or directories) to surface security-relevant structural changes. Detects new attack paths, complexity shifts, blast radius growth, taint propagation changes, and privilege boundary modifications that text diffs miss. Use when comparing code between commits or tags, analyzing structural evolution, detecting attack surface growth, reviewing what changed between audit snapshots, or finding security-relevant changes that text diffs miss.
description_zh: 比较两个源代码快照（git提交、标签或目录）中的Trailmark代码图，以揭示与安全相关的结构性变化。检测文本差异所遗漏的新的攻击路径、复杂度变化、爆炸半径扩大、污点传播变化以及权限边界修改。在提交或标签之间比较代码、分析结构演化、检测攻击面增长、审查审计快照之间的变化，或查找文本差异所遗漏的安全相关变化时使用。

description: Generate paid-ad image assets from a validated creative brief and brand profile using an explicitly configured image provider. Triggers on: generate ads, generate ad images, create ad creatives, create ad images, make ad images, generate visuals, make campaign visuals, generate images from campaign brief.
description_zh: 根据经过验证的创意简报和品牌档案，使用明确配置的图像提供商，生成付费广告图片素材。触发条件：生成广告、生成广告图片、创建广告素材、创建广告图片、制作广告图片、生成视觉素材、制作活动视觉素材、根据活动简报生成图片。

description: Grounds an assistant in your app with assistant-ui copilots. Use when steering behavior with useAssistantInstructions, feeding send-time app state through useAssistantContext({ getContext }), exposing components with makeAssistantVisible(Component, { clickable, editable }), giving the model two-way component state through interactables (unstable_useInteractable for app-scoped panels, unstable_interactableTool inside defineToolkit for thread-scoped artifacts, mounted via AuiConfig({ unstable_interactables: unstable_Interactables() })), registering instructions and tools with aui.modelContext.register, or bridging model context across an iframe with AssistantFrameProvider and useAssistantFrameHost. Legacy Interactables(), useAssistantInteractable, and useInteractableState are deprecated in favor of the unstable_ API. Reach for this when the assistant should read the page, click or edit UI, or update component state. For LLM tools use tools; for runtime and thread state use runtime.
description_zh: 使用 assistant-ui 副驾驶将助手集成到您的应用中。使用 useAssistantInstructions 控制行为时，通过 useAssistantContext({ getContext }) 传递发送时的应用状态，使用 makeAssistantVisible(Component, { clickable, editable }) 暴露组件，通过 interactables 为模型提供双向组件状态（使用 unstable_useInteractable 为应用作用域面板，在 defineToolkit 内部使用 unstable_interactableTool 为线程作用域产物，通过 AuiConfig({ unstable_interactables: unstable_Interactables() }) 挂载），使用 aui.modelContext.register 注册指令和工具，或使用 AssistantFrameProvider 和 useAssistantFrameHost 在 iframe 中桥接模型上下文。传统的 Interactables()、useAssistantInteractable 和 useInteractableState 已废弃，推荐使用 unstable_ API。当助手需要读取页面、点击或编辑 UI，或更新组件状态时使用本方法。使用 tools 处理 LLM 工具，使用 runtime 处理运行状态和线程状态。

description: Set up Sentry in any language or framework. Detects the user's platform and loads the right SDK skill. Use when asked to add Sentry, install an SDK, or set up error monitoring in a project.
description_zh: 在任意语言或框架中设置 Sentry。检测用户的平台并加载正确的 SDK 技能。当被要求为项目添加 Sentry、安装 SDK 或设置错误监控时使用。

description: Audit Xcode project configuration, build settings, scheme behavior, and script phases to find build-time improvements with explicit approval gates. Use when a developer wants project-level build analysis, slow incremental builds, guidance on target dependencies, build settings review, run script phase analysis, parallelization improvements, or module-map and DEFINES_MODULE configuration.
description_zh: 审计 Xcode 项目的配置、构建设置、方案行为和脚本阶段，以发现带有明确审批门控的构建期改进。当开发者需要进行项目级构建分析、解决增量构建缓慢问题、获取目标依赖指引、审查构建设置、运行脚本阶段分析、进行并行化改进，或配置模块映射和 DEFINES_MODULE 时使用。

description: Autonomous iterative experimentation loop for any programming task. Guides the user through defining goals, measurable metrics, and scope constraints, then runs an autonomous loop of code changes, testing, measuring, and keeping/discarding results. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch. USE FOR: autonomous improvement, iterative optimization, experiment loop, auto research, performance tuning, automated experimentation, hill climbing, try things automatically, optimize code, run experiments, autonomous coding loop. DO NOT USE FOR: one-shot tasks, simple bug fixes, code review, or tasks without a measurable metric.
description_zh:
针对任何编程任务的自主迭代实验循环。引导用户明确目标、可量化的指标与范围约束，随后执行自主循环，进行代码修改、测试、度量，并根据结果保留或舍弃。灵感源自 Karpathy 的 autoresearch。

**适用场景：** 自主改进、迭代优化、实验循环、自动研究、性能调优、自动化实验、爬山法、自动尝试多种方案、代码优化、运行实验、自主编码循环。

**禁止使用场景：** 一次性任务、简单的 Bug 修复、代码审查，或缺乏可量化指标的任务。

description: SSRF playbook. Use when the server fetches URLs, resolves hostnames, imports remote content, or can be driven toward internal networks, cloud metadata, or secondary protocols.
description_zh: SSRF 操作手册。当服务器获取 URL、解析主机名、导入远程内容，或可能被引导至内部网络、云元数据或次要协议时使用。

description: Probe, load-test, and instrument frontends from Grafana Cloud. Covers Synthetic Monitoring (HTTP / DNS / TCP / Ping / Traceroute / Multihttp / k6-browser scripted checks from 20+ global probes, alert on `probe_success` + TLS-cert expiry), Grafana Cloud k6 (distributed load tests across AWS load-zones, scenarios, `http_req_duration` thresholds, CI integration via `grafana/k6-action`), and Frontend Observability with Faro Web SDK (RUM, Core Web Vitals, custom events, `pushError`, distributed-trace correlation). Use when checking website / API uptime from multiple regions, gating a release on a load test, watching for TLS-cert renewal, instrumenting a React/Vue app, tracking Core Web Vitals, or correlating frontend errors to backend traces — even when the user says "is my login flow up?", "monitor my API", "ping our endpoint every minute", "release-gate load test", "browser performance monitoring", "session replay", or "RUM" without naming Synthetic Monitoring / k6 / Faro.
description_zh: 对Grafana Cloud的前端进行探测、负载测试和监测。涵盖合成监控（HTTP / DNS / TCP / Ping / 路由追踪 / Multihttp / k6浏览器脚本化检查，基于20多个全球探针，在`probe_success`指标触发告警的同时监控TLS证书有效期）、Grafana Cloud k6（在AWS负载区域、场景间进行分布式负载测试，设置`http_req_duration`阈值，通过`grafana/k6-action`实现CI集成），以及使用Faro Web SDK的前端可观测性（真实用户监控RUM、核心网页指标Core Web Vitals、自定义事件、`pushError`、分布式追踪关联）。当需要从多个区域检查网站/API的正常运行时间、基于负载测试控制发布、监控TLS证书续期、为React/Vue应用进行监测配置、追踪核心网页指标，或将前端错误关联到后端追踪时使用——即使用户未提及合成监控/k6/Faro，而是用“我的登录流程是否正常运行？”“监控我的API”“每分钟检测我们的接口”“发布门控负载测试”“浏览器性能监控”“会话回放”或“RUM”等说法表达需求时。

description: The movie CLI that combines TMDb's discovery engine with OMDb's multi-source ratings — and ships a SQLite watchlist that flags what's streaming on your services right now. Trigger phrases: `what should I watch tonight`, `where can I stream <title>`, `rate <title>`, `compare <title> and <title>`, `what's <person>'s filmography`, `plan a <franchise> marathon`, `use movie-goat`, `run movie-goat`.
description_zh: 这款结合 TMDb 发现引擎与 OMDb 多源评分的电影 CLI，并内置一个 SQLite 观看列表，可实时标记您当前在服务上正在流播的内容。触发短语：`今晚我应该看什么`，`我能在哪里 streaming <title>`，`评价 <title>`，`比较 <title>` 和 <title>`，`查看 <person>` 的电影作品`，`策划 <franchise>` 马拉松观影`，`使用 movie-goat`，`运行 movie-goat`。

description: 당근 중고거래 공개 웹 데이터로 매물을 검색하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 계정 표면에서 찜·채팅·거래 준비까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用당근二手交易平台公开网页数据搜索商品，在돌쇠平台，可在官方账号界面进行收藏、聊天和交易准备等操作。

description: Transcribe audio files to text with optional diarization and known-speaker hints. Use when a user asks to transcribe speech from audio/video, extract text from recordings, or label speakers in interviews or meetings.
description_zh: 将音频文件转录为文本，支持可选的说话人分离与已知说话人提示。适用于当用户要求对音频/视频中的语音进行转录、从录制文件中提取文本，或在访谈或会议中标注说话人的场景。

description: Create spatial diagrams with free-positioned nodes using JSON format. Best for concept maps, knowledge graphs, and planning boards requiring precise x/y coordinate control.
description_zh: 使用 JSON 格式创建带有自由定位节点的空间图。非常适合需要精确控制 x/y 坐标的概念图、知识图谱和规划板。

description: Audit Microsoft Advertising measurement, UET, search and audience campaigns, Google imports, syndication, keywords, creative, bidding, budgets, Copilot inventory, and policy. Use for Microsoft Ads, Bing Ads, UET, Microsoft Audience Network, Google Ads import, or Microsoft campaign optimization.
description_zh: 审计 Microsoft Advertising 的测量、UET、搜索和受众活动、Google 导入、分发、关键词、创意、竞价、预算、Copilot 素材库及政策。适用于 Microsoft Ads、Bing Ads、UET、Microsoft 受众网络、Google Ads 导入或 Microsoft 活动优化。

description: Best practices and example-driven guidance for building SwiftUI views and components, including navigation hierarchies, custom view modifiers, and responsive layouts with stacks and grids. Use when creating or refactoring SwiftUI UI, designing tab architecture with TabView, composing screens with VStack/HStack, managing @State or @Binding, building declarative iOS interfaces, or needing component-specific patterns and examples.
description_zh: 构建 SwiftUI 视图和组件的最佳实践及基于示例的指导，涵盖导航层级、自定义视图修饰符以及使用栈和网格的响应式布局。在创建或重构 SwiftUI UI、使用 TabView 设计标签页架构、使用 VStack/HStack 组合界面、管理 @State 或 @Binding、构建声明式 iOS 界面，或需要特定组件的模式和示例时使用。

description: Sending telemetry data to Grafana Cloud — metrics via Prometheus remote write or OTLP, logs via Loki push or Alloy, traces via OTLP to Tempo, profiles via Pyroscope. Covers Alloy-based pipelines, direct SDK/agent integrations, cloud integrations catalog, and credentials management. Use when connecting an application or infrastructure to Grafana Cloud, setting up data ingestion, configuring remote write, or choosing between ingestion methods.
description_zh: 将遥测数据传输至 Grafana Cloud — 指标通过 Prometheus 远程写入或 OTLP，日志通过 Loki 推送或 Alloy，追踪通过 OTLP 发送至 Tempo，性能分析通过 Pyroscope。涵盖基于 Alloy 的管道、直接 SDK/代理集成、云集成目录以及凭证管理。适用于将应用程序或基础设施连接至 Grafana Cloud、设置数据摄取、配置远程写入或选择摄取方法时使用。

description: Provides implementation patterns for Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters), and Domain-Driven Design in Java 21+ Spring Boot 3.5+ applications. Use when structuring layered architectures, separating domain logic from frameworks, implementing ports and adapters, creating entities/value objects/aggregates, or refactoring monolithic codebases for testability and maintainability.
description_zh: 为 Java 21+ 与 Spring Boot 3.5+ 应用提供清洁架构、六边形架构（端口与适配器）及领域驱动设计的实现模式。用于构建分层架构、将领域逻辑与框架分离、实现端口与适配器、创建实体、值对象与聚合，或为可测试性与可维护性重构单体代码库。

description: Plans, configures, and hardens platform-level Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster security. Covers cluster add-ons (Secret Manager enablement), RBAC hardening (disabling insecure bindings, audit tools), Binary Authorization, enabling Shielded Nodes, GKE Sandbox cluster enablement, GKE IAM roles, and cross-service authentication IAM patterns. Use when securing cluster control planes, hardening GKE RBAC, enabling Shielded Nodes, enabling GKE Sandbox runtime, enabling cluster-wide security add-ons, or managing GKE IAM roles. Don't use for workload-level security (Workload Identity, SecretProviderClass, PSS, NetPol, gVisor pod runtimeClassName; use gke-workload-security instead).
description_zh: 规划、配置并强化平台级 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 集群安全。涵盖集群插件（启用 Secret Manager）、RBAC 加固（禁用不安全绑定、审计工具）、Binary Authorization、启用 Shielded Nodes、启用 GKE Sandbox 集群、GKE IAM 角色，以及跨服务认证的 IAM 模式。适用于安全集群控制面、强化 GKE RBAC、启用 Shielded Nodes、启用 GKE Sandbox 运行时、启用集群级安全插件或管理 GKE IAM 角色。不适用于工作负载级安全（如 Workload Identity、SecretProviderClass、PSS、NetPol、gVisor pod runtimeClassName；请使用 gke-workload-security 代替）。

description: Cut your Grafana Cloud bill by attributing spend to teams and reducing telemetry volume. Covers FOCUS-compliant billing dashboards, cost-attribution labels in Alloy, Adaptive Metrics (cardinality reduction), Adaptive Logs (drop/sample), Adaptive Traces (tail sampling), usage alerts, and an optimization checklist. Use when investigating a high Grafana Cloud bill, attributing observability cost to a team or service, reducing active series / log bytes / trace spans, or setting up usage / quota alerts — even when the user says "our Grafana bill is too high", "who's burning the most metrics", "drop debug logs", "sample our traces", or "alert me before we hit quota" without naming Cost Management.
description_zh: 通过将其支出归入团队并减少遥测数据量来削减您的 Grafana Cloud 账单。涵盖 FOCUS 合规计费仪表盘、Alloy 中的成本归属标签、Adaptive Metrics（基数缩减）、Adaptive Logs（丢弃/采样）、Adaptive Traces（尾部采样）、使用量告警以及优化清单。在调查高 Grafana Cloud 账单、将可观测性成本归入团队或服务、减少活跃序列/日志字节/追踪跨度或设置使用量/配额告警时使用——即使用户未提及“成本管理”，而说“我们的 Grafana 账单太高”、“谁占用的指标最多”、“丢弃调试日志”、“采样我们的追踪”或“在达到配额前通知我”。

description: When the user wants to design or optimize their app's monetization — pricing, paywalls, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Also use when the user mentions "pricing", "paywall", "subscription", "IAP", "how to monetize", "revenue optimization", "free trial", or "conversion to paid". For retention impact, see retention-optimization. For competitive pricing, see competitor-analysis.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计或优化其应用变现——定价、付费墙、订阅或应用内购买时使用。当用户提及“定价”、“付费墙”、“订阅”、“IAP”、“如何变现”、“收入优化”、“免费试用”或“向付费转化”时，也使用此功能。如需了解其对留存的影响，请参阅留存优化。如需了解竞争性定价，请参阅竞品分析。

description: Provides workflows to write, debug, and optimize prompts for LLMs, including few-shot example selection, chain-of-thought structuring, system prompt design, and template composition. Use when the user asks to write or improve a prompt, wants help with few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, system prompts, prompt templates, or asks how to get better results from an LLM.
description_zh: 提供用于编写、调试和优化 LLM 提示词的工作流，包括少样本示例选择、思维链结构化、系统提示词设计与模板组合。当用户要求编写或改进提示词、需要少样本示例、思维链、系统提示词、提示词模板方面的帮助，或询问如何从 LLM 获得更好的结果时使用。

description: Extract a public-safe brand and offer profile for paid advertising from an authorized website and operator input. Triggers on: brand DNA, brand profile, brand identity, brand style, brand colors, brand voice, visual identity, style guide, website brand analysis.
description_zh: 从授权网站及运营人员输入中提取用于付费广告的公开安全品牌及商品档案。触发条件：品牌DNA、品牌档案、品牌标识、品牌风格、品牌颜色、品牌声音、视觉标识、风格指南、网站品牌分析。

description: Audit and rewrite content to remove AI writing patterns ("AI-isms"). Use this skill when asked to "remove AI-isms," "clean up AI writing," "edit writing for AI patterns," "audit writing for AI tells," or "make this sound less like AI." Supports a detect-only mode, an edit-in-place mode for files, an optional voice profile (casual / professional / technical / warm / blunt), and an iterate-to-convergence pass.
description_zh: 审计并重写内容，以去除AI写作模式（“AI-isms”）。当被要求执行“去除 AI-isms”、“清理 AI 写作”、“编辑写作以去除 AI 模式”、“审计写作中的 AI 痕迹”或“使文本听起来不那么像 AI”时，使用此技能。支持仅检测模式、用于文件的就地编辑模式、可选的语气风格（随意/专业/技术/温暖/直接），以及迭代至收敛的流程。

description: Cut Grafana Cloud Metrics cost by shrinking active-series count with Adaptive Metrics aggregation rules — auto-recommendations from query history, custom exact/regex rules, label-drop config, unused-metric detection, and Alloy remote_write fallback. Use when investigating a high Mimir/Grafana Cloud bill, hunting high-cardinality labels (`pod_uid`, `service_instance_id`, `version`), pre-aggregating counters/gauges, dropping unused metrics, or measuring `grafanacloud_instance_active_series` before/after — even when the user says "reduce cardinality", "too many series", "metrics spend", "active series count is exploding", or "drop the version label" without naming Adaptive Metrics.
description_zh: 采用 Adaptive Metrics 聚合规则，通过缩减活跃序列数量来削减 Grafana Cloud 指标成本——基于查询历史自动推荐、自定义精确/正则规则、标签删除配置、未使用指标检测，以及 Alloy remote_write 备用方案。适用于排查高 Mimir/Grafana Cloud 账单、排查高基数标签（`pod_uid`、`service_instance_id`、`version`）、对计数器/仪表进行预聚合、删除未使用指标，或在 Grafana Cloud 实例上对 `grafanacloud_instance_active_series` 指标进行事前/事后测量——即使用户未提及 Adaptive Metrics，仅表达诸如"降低基数"、"序列过多"、"指标支出"、"活跃序列数量激增"或"删除版本标签"等需求时。

description: Audit a website, investigate its real search opportunities, and deliver a short data-backed report on the few changes most likely to grow organic traffic that converts.
description_zh: 审计网站，调研其真实搜索机会，并提供一份数据支撑的简短报告，关于最有可能增长能够带来转化的自然流量的少数改动。

description: Assists in designing and implementing secure n-tier serverless web applications and microservices on Google Cloud. Use when users need architecture designs, security checklists, Terraform code, or deployment guidance for multi-tier serverless apps, regional data residency / European sovereignty compliance, zero-trust private VPC networking, or Private Service Connect. Don't use for VM, GKE, or non-Google Cloud architectures.
description_zh: 协助在 Google Cloud 上设计和实施安全 n 层无服务器 Web 应用与微服务。适用于用户需要为多层无服务器应用、区域数据驻留 / 欧洲主权合规、零信任私有 VPC 网络或 Private Service Connect 提供架构设计、安全清单、Terraform 代码或部署指南时。不适用于 VM、GKE 或非 Google Cloud 架构。

description: Set up, configure, and troubleshoot Grafana Cloud integrations for AWS, Azure, and other cloud providers. Use when the user asks to connect AWS CloudWatch, set up Azure Monitor, configure Confluent Cloud observability, install a Grafana integration, set up hosted exporters, use AWS Firehose for CloudWatch logs, or troubleshoot a cloud integration. Triggers on phrases like "AWS CloudWatch", "Azure Monitor", "Confluent integration", "cloud integration", "hosted exporter", "AWS Firehose", "install integration", "cloud metrics", or "cloud logs".
description_zh: 设置、配置并排查 Grafana Cloud 针对 AWS、Azure 及其他云供应商的集成。适用于用户要求连接 AWS CloudWatch、设置 Azure Monitor、配置 Confluent Cloud 可观测性、安装 Grafana 集成、设置托管导出器、使用 AWS Firehose 处理 CloudWatch 日志，或排查云集成问题时。在出现诸如“AWS CloudWatch”、“Azure Monitor”、“Confluent 集成”、“云集成”、“托管导出器”、“AWS Firehose”、“安装集成”、“云指标”或“云日志”等短语时触发。

description: Route alerts, run on-call rotations, and drive incidents in Grafana IRM / OnCall — integrations (Alertmanager / Grafana Alerting / generic webhook / PagerDuty), Jinja2 routing + grouping templates, escalation chains (wait → notify schedule → notify team → webhook → auto-resolve), schedules (web + iCal + Terraform `grafana_oncall_schedule`), Slack chatops with Acknowledge/Resolve/Silence, and the P1-P4 incident lifecycle. Use when wiring Alertmanager to OnCall, deciding which team gets paged, building rotations from a Google Calendar / iCal, hooking up Slack notifications, or declaring an incident from an alert — even when the user says "page the platform team on critical alerts", "send Prometheus alerts to Slack", "set up our on-call rota", "escalation policy", or "auto-resolve when the alert clears" without naming OnCall / IRM. Heads up — OnCall OSS is in maintenance mode (archived March 2026); Grafana Cloud users should use IRM.
description_zh:
告警路由、轮值排班与事故驱动——Grafana IRM / OnCall 集成（Alertmanager / Grafana Alerting / 通用 Webhook / PagerDuty）、Jinja2 路由与分组模板、升级链（等待 → 按日程通知 → 通知团队 → Webhook → 自动解决）、排期（Web 及 iCal + Terraform `grafana_oncall_schedule`）、Slack 聊天运维（确认/解决/静音）及 P1-P4 事故生命周期。

适用于将 Alertmanager 对接至 OnCall、确定由哪个团队接收告警、从 Google Calendar / iCal 构建轮值排班、配置 Slack 通知，以及在告警触发时宣布事故的场景——即便用户不提及 OnCall / IRM，而是使用诸如"关键告警请呼叫平台团队"、"将 Prometheus 告警发送至 Slack"、"设置我们的轮值排班"、"升级策略"或"告警清除后自动解决"等表述。

提示——OnCall OSS 目前处于维护模式（已于 2026 年 3 月归档）；Grafana Cloud 用户应使用 IRM。

description: 대신증권 리포트 GitHub Pages 미러에서 최신 HTML 리포트 목록과 원문/설명 페이지를 조회한다.
description_zh: 可从大信证券报告的 GitHub Pages 镜像中查看最新 HTML 报告列表及原文/说明页面。

description: Generates minimal macOS Seatbelt sandbox configurations. Use when sandboxing, isolating, or restricting macOS applications with allowlist-based profiles.
description_zh: 生成最小化的 macOS Seatbelt 沙箱配置。当使用基于白名单的配置对 macOS 应用程序进行沙箱化、隔离或限制时使用。

description: Inspect an agent repository and optional traces, interview the user, write reviewed Task Specs, build and audit Harbor tasks, and bootstrap reusable project World Knowledge Skills. Use for agent evals, benchmark design, Task generation, controlled Environments, synthetic data, Verifiers, Harbor runs, calibration, or continuous benchmark maintenance.
description_zh: 检查智能体仓库和可选追踪，访谈用户，编写经审核的任务规格，构建并审计 Harbor 任务，并初始化可复用的项目世界知识技能。用于智能体评估、基准测试设计、任务生成、受控环境、合成数据、验证器、Harbor 运行、校准或持续基准测试维护。

description: Review a contract against your organization's negotiation playbook — flag deviations, generate redlines, provide business impact analysis. Use when reviewing vendor or customer agreements, when you need clause-by-clause analysis against standard positions, or when preparing a negotiation strategy with prioritized redlines and fallback positions.
description_zh: 对照组织的谈判手册审查合同——标记偏差、生成红线、提供业务影响分析。适用于审查供应商或客户协议时，当您需要对标准立场逐条进行条款分析时，或在制定谈判策略时需根据优先级确定红线及备选立场。

description: Find the Prometheus metrics that drive your Grafana Cloud bill. `dpm-finder` is a Grafana Professional Services CLI that ranks metrics by Data Points per Minute (DPM) with per-label-set breakdown, optional `--cost-per-1000-series` pricing, and a Prometheus-exporter mode. Use when investigating high Grafana Cloud spend, hunting noisy / high-cardinality metrics, comparing pre/post recording-rule cardinality, or feeding cost data into dashboards — even when the user says "why is my Mimir bill so high?", "find the biggest metrics", "cardinality offenders", or "optimize Prometheus cost" without naming dpm-finder.
description_zh: 查找驱动您 Grafana Cloud 账单的 Prometheus 指标。`dpm-finder` 是一款 Grafana 专业服务 CLI，通过每分钟数据点数（DPM）对指标进行排名，并提供按标签集细分、可选的 `--cost-per-1000-series` 定价以及 Prometheus-exporter 模式。当需要调查高 Grafana Cloud 支出、排查噪声/高基数指标、对比录制规则执行前后的基数，或将成本数据引入仪表盘时，请使用本工具——即使用户在不提及 `dpm-finder` 的情况下，说出“我的 Mimir 账单为何如此高昂？”“找出最大的指标”“基数违规者”或“优化 Prometheus 成本”等表述时。

description: When the user wants to create LinkedIn post copy or optimize for LinkedIn. Also use when the user mentions "LinkedIn post," "LinkedIn article," "professional post," "post to LinkedIn," "LinkedIn content," "LinkedIn copy," "B2B LinkedIn," "LinkedIn engagement," "LinkedIn feed," "share box," "document post," "poll," "Newsletter," "reshare," or "LinkedIn marketing." For LinkedIn ads, use linkedin-ads.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建领英帖子文案或针对领英进行优化时。当用户提到“领英帖子”、“领英文章”、“专业帖子”、“发布到领英”、“领英内容”、“领英文案”、“B2B领英”、“领英互动”、“领英信息流”、“分享框”、“文档帖子”、“投票”、“Newsletter”、“再分享”或“领英营销”时，也使用。针对领英广告，使用 linkedin-ads。

description:
대한민국 국토교통부가 매년 공시하는 "개별공시지가"(원/㎡) 조회.
지번 단위 토지의 정부 공시 단가로, 재산세·종부세·양도세 등
세금 산정의 법적 기준이다. **시세/실거래가가 아니다.**
Use when the user asks for 공시지가, 개별공시지가, 토지 공시단가,
세무 계산용 토지 단가, or "이 땅 공시지가 얼마야".
Do NOT use for 시세, 실거래가, 매매가, 호가, 공동주택가격
(those need a different data source).
description_zh:
查询大韩民国国土交通部每年公布的“个别公示地价”（元/㎡）。
它是地块单位土地的政府公示单价，是财产税、不动产税、转让税等税额计算的法定基准。**不是市场价/实际交易价。**
当用户询问公示地价、个别公示地价、土地公示单价、税务计算用土地单价，或询问“这块地的公示地价多少”时使用。
不要用于市场价、实际交易价、买卖价、挂牌价、公寓房价
（这些需要不同数据源。）

description: Korean door-to-door public transit routing (subway + bus + walking) via ODsay LIVE API with Kakao geocoding for address-to-address queries. Use when the user asks for 지하철/버스/대중교통 길찾기, 환승 경로, 소요시간, or transit directions between two places in Korea.
description_zh: 韩国门到门的公共交通路由（地铁 + 公交 + 步行），通过ODsay LIVE API结合Kakao地理编码，用于地址到地址的查询。当用户询问韩国两地之间的地铁/公交/公共交通寻路、换乘路线、所需时间或交通方向时使用。

description: 适用于需要解决正在进行的 git merge/rebase 冲突时。
description_zh: 适用于需要解决正在进行的 git merge/rebase 冲突时。

description: Generate rights-cleared paid-ad product photography variants from an authorized source image and validated brand profile. Triggers on: product photo, product photography, virtual photoshoot, photoshoot, enhance product image, studio shot, lifestyle shot, lifestyle product image, floating product image, ingredient shot.
description_zh: 从已授权源图片和经过验证的品牌资料生成获得授权许可的付费广告产品摄影变体。触发条件：产品照片、产品摄影、虚拟试拍、试拍、增强产品图像、摄影棚拍摄、生活方式拍摄、生活方式产品图像、悬浮产品图像、原料拍摄。

description: Use when starting any grafana-app-sdk work — scaffolding a Grafana app, initializing a Grafana App Platform app, picking a deployment mode (standalone operator / grafana/apps / frontend-only), wiring app-specific config, or onboarding to the SDK. Covers `grafana-app-sdk` CLI install, `project init` per deployment mode, project layout, the schema-centric workflow (CUE kinds → generated code → reconciler/admission logic), and `SpecificConfig` for env-driven app configuration. Use even if the user just says "make a new app", "Grafana app platform", "kinds and watchers", "operator scaffold", or asks about `apps/` inside the Grafana repo, without naming the SDK explicitly.
description_zh: 用于启动任何 Grafana App SDK 工作的场景——包括搭建 Grafana 应用、初始化 Grafana App Platform 应用、选择部署模式（独立 Operator / grafana/apps / 仅前端）、配置应用特定设置，或对 SDK 进行入门配置。涵盖 `grafana-app-sdk` CLI 的安装、按部署模式执行的 `project init`、项目结构、以模式为中心的流程（CUE kinds → 生成代码 → 调和器/准入逻辑），以及用于环境驱动应用配置的 `SpecificConfig`。即使用户仅使用"创建新应用"、"Grafana 应用平台"、"kinds 和 watchers"、"Operator 脚手架"，或在 Grafana 仓库中询问 `apps/`，而无需明确提及 SDK，也请使用本说明。

description: GitHub CLI for issues, PRs, CI/check logs, comments, reviews, releases, repos, and gh api queries.
description_zh: GitHub CLI，用于议题、拉取请求、CI/检查日志、评论、评审、发布、仓库以及 gh API 查询。

description: Build terminal UIs with OpenTUI. Covers Core, frameworks, components, application APIs, testing, extensions, integrations, deployment, and public API lookup.
description_zh: 使用 OpenTUI 构建终端 UI。涵盖核心、框架、组件、应用 API、测试、扩展、集成、部署以及公共 API 查询。

description: Create and manage Kibana Agent Builder agents and custom tools. Use when asked to create, update, delete, test, or inspect agents or tools in Agent Builder, or when the user wants to understand what agents or tools already exist.
description_zh: 创建和管理 Kibana Agent Builder 中的智能体及自定义工具。当被要求创建、更新、删除、测试或检查 Agent Builder 中的智能体或工具时使用，或当用户希望了解已存在哪些智能体或工具时使用。

description: Access Core Motion accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, device-motion, pedometer, activity-recognition, altitude, headphone motion, batched high-frequency workout motion, and water-submersion/depth data. Use when reading device sensors, counting steps, detecting walking/running/driving/cycling, tracking altitude, building motion interactions, handling AirPods head tracking, or implementing watchOS dive/depth features.
description_zh: 访问核心运动的加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计、设备运动、步数计、活动识别、高度、耳机运动、批量高频运动数据以及浸水/深度数据。适用于读取设备传感器、计步、检测行走/跑步/驾驶/骑行、追踪高度、构建运动交互、处理 AirPods 头部追踪，或实现 watchOS 潜水/深度功能时使用。

description: Tokenize, tag, and analyze natural language text using Apple's NaturalLanguage framework and translate between languages with the Translation framework. Use when adding language identification, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging, text embeddings, or in-app translation to iOS/macOS/visionOS apps.
description_zh: 使用 Apple 的 NaturalLanguage 框架对自然语言文本进行分词、标注和分析，并利用 Translation 框架进行语言互译。在 iOS、macOS 和 visionOS 应用中添加语言识别、情感分析、命名实体识别、词性标注、文本嵌入或应用内翻译时使用。

description: Audits, configures, and hardens workload-level security controls for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) applications and namespaces. Covers running cluster security audits (`audit_cluster.sh`), configuring Workload Identity Federation (impersonation, KSA/GSA binding, and pod setup), enforcing Network Policies (default-deny and Dataplane V2 logging), isolating high-risk pods inside GKE Sandbox (`gVisor`), enforcing Pod Security Standards (`restricted` labeling), and mounting Secret Manager secrets via CSI (`SecretProviderClass`). Use when auditing cluster security posture, isolating namespaces, applying pod security standards, setting up Workload Identity, or configuring network policies and secret volume mounts. Don't use for cluster-wide control plane security, RBAC hardening, Binary Authorization, Shielded Nodes, or enabling platform-level GKE add-ons (use gke-platform-security instead).
description_zh: 对 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 应用和命名空间进行审计、配置和加固工作负载级别安全控制。涵盖执行集群安全审计（`audit_cluster.sh`）、配置工作负载身份联邦（身份模拟、KSA/GSA 绑定及工作负载配置）、强制执行网络策略（默认拒绝和数据面 V2 日志）、在 GKE 沙箱中隔离高危 Pod（`gVisor`）、通过 CSI 挂载 Secret Manager 密钥（`SecretProviderClass`）。适用于对集群安全态势进行审计、隔离命名空间、应用 Pod 安全标准、设置工作负载身份，或配置网络策略和密钥卷挂载等场景。不适用于集群级控制平面安全、RBAC 加固、二进制授权、受保护节点，或启用平台级 GKE 附加组件（请使用 gke-platform-security）。

description: Graph-informed mutation testing triage. Parses codebases with Trailmark, runs mutation testing and necessist, then uses survived mutants, unnecessary test statements, and call graph data to identify false positives, missing test coverage, and fuzzing targets.
