Use when triaging survived mutants, analyzing mutation testing results, identifying test gaps, finding fuzzing targets from weak tests, running mutation frameworks (including circomvent and cairo-mutants), or using necessist.
description_zh: 图引导的变异测试分诊。使用 Trailmark 解析代码库，执行变异测试和 necessist，从而利用存活变异体、不必要的测试语句以及调用图数据，识别误报、测试覆盖缺失和模糊测试目标。适用于对存活变异体进行分诊、分析变异测试结果、识别测试缺口、从弱测试中寻找模糊测试目标、运行变异测试框架（包括 Circomvent 和 Cairo-mutants），或使用 necessist 的场景。

description: QA an analysis before sharing -- methodology, accuracy, and bias checks. Use when reviewing an analysis before a stakeholder presentation, spot-checking calculations and aggregation logic, verifying a SQL query's results look right, or assessing whether conclusions are actually supported by the data.
description_zh: 共享前对分析进行质量保证——方法论、准确性与偏见检查。用于在向利益相关方汇报分析前回顾分析、抽查计算与汇总逻辑、验证 SQL 查询结果是否合理，或评估结论是否由数据真正支撑。

description: 公众号文章自动化写作流程。支持资料搜索、文章撰写、爆款标题生成、排版优化。当用户提到写公众号、微信文章、自媒体写作、爆款文章、内容创作时使用此 skill。
description_zh: 公众号文章自动化写作流程。支持资料搜索、文章撰写、爆款标题生成、排版优化。当用户提到写公众号、微信文章、自媒体写作、爆款文章、内容创作时使用此技能。

description: Write or review k6 documentation across the three k6 repositories - k6-DefinitelyTyped (TypeScript types), k6-docs (user documentation), and k6 (release notes / changelog). Applies k6 doc style conventions, generates TypeScript type definitions, drafts release notes, and validates examples by running them against k6@master. Use when working on k6 documentation, the k6 changelog, the k6 release notes, k6 API reference, k6 TypeScript types, load testing docs, or when the user asks to write, edit, or review anything in the k6, k6-docs, or k6-DefinitelyTyped repos - even if they don't explicitly say "documentation".
description_zh: 编写或审查跨 k6 三个仓库的 k6 文档 —— k6-DefinitelyTyped（TypeScript 类型）、k6-docs（用户文档）和 k6（发布说明 / 变更日志）。应用 k6 文档样式规范，生成 TypeScript 类型定义，草拟发布说明，并在 k6@master 上运行示例以验证其正确性。当处理 k6 文档、k6 变更日志、k6 发布说明、k6 API 参考、k6 TypeScript 类型、负载测试文档，或当用户要求在 k6、k6-docs 或 k6-DefinitelyTyped 仓库中编写、编辑或审查任何内容时使用 —— 即使用户没有明确说明“文档”。

description: Show the current state of the wiki — what's been ingested, what's pending, and the delta between sources and wiki content. Use this skill when the user asks "what's the status", "how much is ingested", "what's left to process", "show me the delta", "what changed since last ingest", "wiki dashboard", or wants an overview of their knowledge base health and completeness. Also use before deciding whether to append or rebuild. Includes an insights mode triggered by "wiki insights", "what's central", "show me the hubs", "central pages", "what's connected", "wiki structure" — analyzes the shape of the wiki itself to surface top hubs, cross-domain bridges, and orphan-adjacent pages. Also includes an equilibrium mode triggered by "is my vault at equilibrium", "wiki equilibrium", "is maintenance done", "is the vault converged", or "are my skills fighting" — runs every maintenance skill's audit-only pass and reports whether any of them still has a pending change.
description_zh:
展示当前维基的状态——已摄取的内容、待处理的内容，以及来源内容与维基内容之间的差异。当用户询问“what's the status”、“how much is ingested”、“what's left to process”、“show me the delta”、“what changed since last ingest”、“wiki dashboard”，或希望了解知识库的健康状况与完整性概览时，使用此技能。在决定是否追加还是重建之前，也使用此技能。

包含一种由“wiki insights”、“what's central”、“show me the hubs”、“central pages”、“what's connected”、“wiki structure”触发的洞察模式——分析维基本身的结构，以呈现顶级枢纽、跨域连接以及邻近孤立页面的信息。还包含一种由“is my vault at equilibrium”、“wiki equilibrium”、“is maintenance done”、“is the vault converged”或“are my skills fighting”触发的平衡模式——对每个维护技能的审计检查进行仅审计流程，并报告其中是否仍存在待处理变更。

description: 당근알바 공개 웹 데이터로 공고를 검색하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 계정 표면에서 지원서 작성·채팅·승인 기반 전송까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过당근알바公开的网页数据搜索招聘公告，并在돌쇠系统中，于官方账号界面完成从填写申请表、在线沟通到基于审核的提交等流程。

description: Use when the user asks where to donate, 기부처 조회, or donation place recommendations by Korean location and category. Recommend recipients with best-effort 1365 verification-assist links and never execute donations. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 适用于用户询问捐助地点、查询捐助机构，或根据韩国地点和类别推荐捐助地点时。推荐带有尽力而为的 1365 核验辅助链接的受捐人，并且绝不执行捐助操作。在 Door 中，所有后续操作均通过官方界面进行。

description: Translates Mermaid sequenceDiagrams describing cryptographic protocols into ProVerif formal verification models (.pv files). Use when generating a ProVerif model, formally verifying a protocol, converting a Mermaid diagram to ProVerif, verifying protocol security properties (secrecy, authentication, forward secrecy), checking for replay attacks, or producing a .pv file from a sequence diagram.
description_zh: 将描述加密协议的Mermaid时序图转换为ProVerif形式化验证模型（.pv文件）。用途：当生成ProVerif模型、对协议进行形式化验证、将Mermaid图表转换为ProVerif、验证协议安全属性（保密性、认证、前向保密性）、检查是否存在重放攻击，或从时序图生成.pv文件时使用。

description: Verify device legitimacy and app integrity using DeviceCheck (DCDevice per-device bits) and App Attest (DCAppAttestService key generation, attestation, and assertion flows). Use when implementing fraud prevention, detecting compromised devices, validating app authenticity with Apple's servers, protecting sensitive API endpoints with attested requests, or adding device verification to a backend architecture.
description_zh: 验证设备合法性与应用完整性，使用DeviceCheck（基于DCDevice的设备位）以及App Attest（DCAppAttestService的密钥生成、证明和断言流程）。适用于实现防欺诈、检测被入侵设备、通过Apple服务器验证应用真实性、以已证明请求保护敏感API接口，或将设备验证集成到后端架构等场景。

description: Implement reconcilers and watchers for grafana-app-sdk apps — write `TypedReconciler[*MyKind]` reconcile functions, apply generation-based skip patterns, do conflict-safe status updates via `resource.UpdateObject`, configure `BasicReconcileOptions` (namespace, label/field filters, finalizer management), use `Watcher` for event-style handling, reconcile `UnmanagedKinds` (resources your app doesn't own), and register the whole thing in `app.go`. Use when writing a reconciler, implementing the reconcile loop, adding async business logic, handling create/update/delete events, processing resource state changes, scheduling periodic resyncs with `RequeueAfter`, picking between Watcher and Reconciler, or wiring a controller into `app.go` — even when the user says "process this resource", "handle X events", or "write a controller" without saying "reconciler".
description_zh:
为 grafana-app-sdk 应用实现 Reconciler 与 Watcher —— 编写 `TypedReconciler[*MyKind]` 协调函数，应用基于生成（generation）的跳过模式，通过 `resource.UpdateObject` 进行冲突安全的状态更新，配置 `BasicReconcileOptions`（namespace、label/field 过滤器、finalizer 管理），使用 `Watcher` 处理事件驱动式逻辑，协调 `UnmanagedKinds`（应用未拥有的资源），并将整体功能注册到 `app.go`。

以下场景中可使用本说明：编写 Reconciler、实现协调循环、添加异步业务逻辑、处理创建/更新/删除事件、处理资源状态变化、使用 `RequeueAfter` 调度定期重新同步、在 Watcher 与 Reconciler 之间进行选择，或将控制器接入 `app.go` —— 即使用户说“处理该资源”、“处理 X 事件”或“编写控制器”，却未提及“Reconciler”。

description: Transcribe speech to text using Apple's Speech framework. Use when implementing live microphone transcription with AVAudioEngine, recognizing recorded audio files, handling speech and microphone authorization, choosing on-device vs server-backed SFSpeechRecognizer behavior, or adopting SpeechAnalyzer, SpeechTranscriber, DictationTranscriber, AssetInventory, and async result streams on iOS 26+.
description_zh: 使用 Apple 语音框架将语音转写为文本。适用于在实现基于 AVAudioEngine 的实时麦克风转写、识别录制音频文件、处理语音和麦克风授权、选择使用设备端还是服务器支持的 SFSpeechRecognizer 行为，或在 iOS 26+ 上采用 SpeechAnalyzer、SpeechTranscriber、DictationTranscriber、AssetInventory 及异步结果流时使用。

description: Use when the user asks to "write a validator", "add validation", "implement admission control", "write a mutating webhook", "add a mutation handler", "validate incoming resources", "implement admission logic", "add admission webhooks", "write ingress validation", or asks how to validate or mutate resources before they are persisted in a grafana-app-sdk app. Provides guidance on implementing validation and mutation admission handlers for grafana-app-sdk apps.
description_zh: 当用户要求“编写验证器”、“添加验证”、“添加变更处理器”、“编写变更型 webhook”、“验证传入资源”、“添加准入控制”、“添加准入 webhook”、“编写入站验证”，或询问如何在资源被持久化到 grafana-app-sdk 应用之前验证或变更资源时使用。为 grafana-app-sdk 应用提供关于实施验证和变更准入处理程序的指导。

description: 당근중고차 공개 웹 데이터로 차량을 검색하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 계정 표면에서 문의·찜·거래 준비까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过당근중고차公开网页数据搜索车辆，并在돌쇠上通过官方账号页面进行咨询、收藏、交易准备等流程。

description: Document a solved problem as a durable repo learning. Use when verified work produced non-obvious reasoning absent from its final code, tests, or existing docs; avoid routine fixes whose artifacts already explain the lesson.
description_zh: 将已解决的问题记录为持久的仓库学习经验。当已验证的成果生成了未在最终代码、测试或现有文档中体现的非显而易见推理时使用；避免那些其相关产物已能说明该经验的常规修复。

description: Author CUE kind definitions for grafana-app-sdk apps - schemas, versioning, field constraints, named type definitions, custom routes, and codegen configuration. Scaffolds kinds via `grafana-app-sdk project kind add`, writes spec/status schemas with type constraints (regex, enum, range), defines `#`-prefixed named types for reusable structs, registers versions in the app manifest, and runs `grafana-app-sdk generate` with explicit error recovery. Use when working with CUE kinds, adding a new resource type, adding a version to an existing kind, writing schema field constraints, defining `#Definition` types, adding custom routes, editing files under `kinds/`, or when the user asks to "model a resource", "add a CUE schema", or "write a kind" — even without saying "CUE" explicitly.
description_zh:
为 grafana-app-sdk 应用编写 CUE kind 定义，涵盖模式、版本管理、字段约束、命名类型定义、自定义路由及代码生成配置。通过 `grafana-app-sdk project kind add` 脚手架化 kind，编写带有类型约束（正则表达式、枚举、范围）的 spec/status 模式，为可重用结构体定义以 `#` 开头的命名类型，在应用清单中注册版本，并运行 `grafana-app-sdk generate` 并进行明确的错误恢复。

在以下场景下使用：使用 CUE kind、添加新资源类型、向现有 kind 添加版本、编写模式字段约束、定义 `#Definition` 类型、添加自定义路由、编辑 `kinds/` 目录下的文件时，或当用户要求“建模资源”、“添加 CUE 模式”或“编写 kind”时——即使用户未明确提及“CUE”。

description: Extract transcripts from YouTube videos. Use when the user asks for a transcript, subtitles, or captions of a YouTube video and provides a YouTube URL (youtube.com/watch?v=, youtu.be/, or similar). Supports output with or without timestamps.
description_zh: 从YouTube视频中提取转录文本。当用户要求获取YouTube视频的转录文本、字幕或屏幕字幕，并提供YouTube网址（youtube.com/watch?v=、youtu.be/或类似链接）时使用。支持带或不带时间戳的输出。

description:
Systematic fact verification and misinformation identification using evidence-based analysis.
Use when: verifying claims, checking facts, identifying misinformation, evaluating source credibility,
or when user asks to "fact check", "verify", "is this true", or mentions claims that need validation.
description_zh:
基于证据分析的系统性事实核验与虚假信息识别。
适用场景：核实主张、核查事实、识别虚假信息、评估来源可信度，
或当用户要求“事实核查”、“验证”、“这是真的吗？”，或提及需要验证的主张时。

description: Build Grafana plugin pages using the @grafana/scenes framework. Use when creating new scene pages, adding panels/visualizations, setting up drilldown navigation, defining variables, configuring query runners, building table/timeseries/stat panels, or extending SceneObjectBase for custom scene objects. Triggers on any work involving SceneApp, SceneAppPage, EmbeddedScene, SceneQueryRunner, SceneDataTransformer, PanelBuilders, SceneFlexLayout, QueryVariable, or drilldown/tab configuration in Grafana plugins.
description_zh: 使用 @grafana/scenes 框架构建 Grafana 插件页面。用于创建新的场景页面、添加面板/可视化、配置下钻导航、定义变量、配置查询执行器、构建表格/时序/统计面板，或为自定义场景对象扩展 SceneObjectBase 时使用。当 Grafana 插件的任何工作涉及 SceneApp、SceneAppPage、EmbeddedScene、SceneQueryRunner、SceneDataTransformer、PanelBuilders、SceneFlexLayout、QueryVariable，或下钻/标签页配置时触发。

description: Audit Apple Ads measurement, AdServices and AdAttributionKit, campaign and keyword structure, Search Match, App Store placements, custom product pages, bidding, budgets, MMP reconciliation, and policy. Use for Apple Ads, Apple Search Ads, App Store ads, Search Match, custom product pages, AdServices, or Apple app-install campaigns.
description_zh: 审计 Apple Ads 测量、AdServices 与 AdAttributionKit、活动与关键词结构、Search Match、App Store 展示位、自定义产品页面、竞价、预算、MMP 对账及政策。适用于 Apple Ads、Apple Search Ads、App Store 广告、Search Match、自定义产品页面、AdServices 或 Apple 应用安装活动。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Kimi Code CLI (`kimi`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Kimi - phrasings like "have Kimi implement X", "delegate this to Kimi", "run it through Kimi Code", or "use Kimi to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Kimi while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Kimi Code CLI（`kimi`），作为后台实现者，然后自行审阅其 diff 并落地。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Kimi——例如包括“让 Kimi 实现 X”、“将此项委托给 Kimi”、“通过 Kimi Code 运行”、“使用 Kimi 实现/修复/重构”等表述——或者希望将一批编码任务通过 Kimi 处理、同时自己仍担任审阅者时，使用本方法。切勿用于足够小、可直接内联完成的任务，也不要在用户要求不委托、直接编写代码时使用。

description: Guide users through creating Agent Skills for Claude Code. Use when the user wants to create, write, author, or design a new Skill, or needs help with SKILL.md files, frontmatter, or skill structure.
description_zh: 指导用户创建 Claude Code 的 Agent Skills。当用户需要创建、编写、撰写或设计一个新的 Skill，或需要有关 SKILL.md 文件、frontmatter 或 Skill 结构的帮助时使用。

description: Mutation-driven test vector generation. Finds implementations of a cryptographic algorithm or protocol, runs mutation testing to identify escaped mutants, then generates new test vectors that deliberately exercise the uncovered code paths. Compares before/after mutation kill rates to prove vector effectiveness. Use when generating cryptographic test vectors, measuring Wycheproof coverage gaps, finding escaped mutants via mutation testing, creating cross-implementation test suites, or improving test vector coverage for crypto primitives.
description_zh: 基于变异的测试向量生成。查找密码算法或协议的实现，运行变异测试以识别逃逸突变，然后生成新的测试向量，专门用于执行未覆盖的代码路径。比较变异测试前后的变异消除率，以证明向量的有效性。适用于生成密码测试向量、测量Wycheproof覆盖率差距、通过变异测试查找逃逸突变、创建跨实现测试套件或提升密码原语测试向量覆盖率。

description: Edits Unity sprite properties by generating C# editor scripts using ISpriteEditorDataProvider APIs. Handles sprite rectangles, borders, pivots, outlines, and slicing operations (automatic, grid, isometric). Use when working with sprite assets, sprite sheets, texture atlases, or sprite slicing.
description_zh: 通过基于 ISpriteEditorDataProvider 接口 API 生成的 C# 编辑器脚本，编辑 Unity 精灵属性。支持处理精灵矩形、边框、枢轴、轮廓及切片操作（自动、网格、等距）。适用于处理精灵资源、精灵图、纹理图集或进行精灵切片时使用。

description: Search and retrieve content from Reddit. Get posts, comments, subreddit info, and user profiles via the public JSON API. Use when user mentions Reddit, a subreddit, or r/ links.
description_zh: 搜索并检索来自Reddit的内容。通过公开的JSON API获取帖子、评论、子版块信息和用户资料。当用户提及Reddit、一个子版块或r/链接时使用。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing recent market-moving news events and their impact on equity markets and commodities. Use this skill when the user requests analysis of major financial news from the past 10 days, wants to understand market reactions to monetary policy decisions (FOMC, ECB, BOJ), needs assessment of geopolitical events' impact on commodities, or requires comprehensive review of earnings announcements from mega-cap stocks. The skill automatically collects news using WebSearch/WebFetch tools and produces impact-ranked analysis reports. All analysis thinking and output are conducted in English.
description_zh:
当分析近期引发市场变动的消息事件及其对股票市场和大宗商品的影响时，应使用此技能。

当用户请求对过去10天的重大财经新闻进行分析、希望了解对货币政策决策（FOMC、ECB、BOJ）的市场反应、需要评估地缘政治事件对大宗商品的影响，或要求对超大盘股的业绩公告进行全面审查时，应使用此技能。该技能使用WebSearch/WebFetch工具自动收集新闻，并生成按影响排序的分析报告。所有分析思考和输出均以英语进行。

description: Use when reading or writing TypeScript or JavaScript files (.ts, .tsx, .js, tsconfig.json).
description_zh: 当阅读或编写 TypeScript 或 JavaScript 文件（.ts, .tsx, .js, tsconfig.json）时使用

description: Optimise Grafana app plugin bundle size using React.lazy, Suspense, and webpack code splitting. Use when the user asks to reduce plugin bundle size, optimise module.js, add code splitting, improve initial plugin load performance, split plugin chunks, lazy load plugin pages, or help implement lazy loading in a Grafana app plugin. Triggers on phrases like "optimise plugin bundle size", "module.js is too large", "plugin is slow to load", "code split the plugin", "reduce initial JS payload", or "help me with Suspense in my plugin".
description_zh: 使用 React.lazy、Suspense 与 webpack 代码分割来优化 Grafana 应用插件包体积。适用场景：当用户请求减少插件包体积、优化 module.js、添加代码分割、提升初始插件加载性能、分割插件代码块、延迟加载插件页面，或协助在 Grafana 应用插件中实现懒加载时，使用本方案。触发短语包括“优化插件包体积”、“module.js 太大”、“插件加载缓慢”、“对插件进行代码分割”、“减少初始 JS 负载”，以及“帮助我在插件中使用 Suspense”等。

description:
Full-stack backend architecture and frontend-backend integration guide.
TRIGGER when: building a full-stack app, creating REST API with frontend, scaffolding backend service,
building todo app, building CRUD app, building real-time app, building chat app,
Express + React, Next.js API, Node.js backend, Python backend, Go backend,
designing service layers, implementing error handling, managing config/auth,
setting up API clients, implementing auth flows, handling file uploads,
adding real-time features (SSE/WebSocket), hardening for production.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: pure frontend UI work, pure CSS/styling, database schema only.
description_zh:
全栈后端架构与前后端集成指南。
TRIGGER when: 构建全栈应用、创建前后端集成 REST API、搭建后端服务，
构建待办事项应用、构建 CRUD 应用、构建实时应用、构建聊天应用，
Express + React、Next.js API、Node.js 后端、Python 后端、Go 后端，
设计服务层、实现错误处理、管理配置/认证，
设置 API 客户端、实现认证流程、处理文件上传，
添加实时功能（SSE/WebSocket）、为生产环境加固。
DO NOT TRIGGER when: 纯前端 UI 工作、纯 CSS/样式工作、仅数据库 schema。

description: An opintionated skill to prepare a marimo notebook to make it ready for a scheduled run.
description_zh: 一个带有倾向性的技能，用于将 Marimo 笔记本准备就绪，使其能够按计划运行。

description: Generate game content procedurally — seeded deterministic RNG, value/Perlin/ Simplex noise for terrain and heightmaps, grid dungeon generation (rooms + corridors, BSP, random walk), and weighted loot/drop tables. Engine-neutral algorithms. Use when the user mentions procedural generation, perlin/simplex noise, random seed, dungeon generator, heightmap/terrain, or loot tables.
description_zh: 程序化生成游戏内容——带种子确定的随机数生成器，用于地形和高度图的基于值/柏林噪声/辛普森噪声，网格地牢生成（房间和走廊、BSP、随机游走），以及加权物品掉落表。引擎无关算法。当用户提及程序化生成、perlin/辛普森噪声、随机种子、地牢生成器、高度图/地形或掉落表时使用。

description: Migrate a Grafana plugin to React 19 compatibility. Use when the user asks to update a plugin for React 19, prepare for React 19, fix React 19 compatibility, upgrade to React 19, migrate to React 19, bump grafanaDependency to 12.3.0, externalize jsx-runtime, or run react-detect. Triggers on phrases like "update plugin for React 19", "React 19 migration", "prepare for React 19", "plugin React 19 compat", "grafanaDependency 12.3.0", "JSX runtime externals", "react-detect", "SECRET_INTERNALS", "ReactCurrentOwner", or "ReactCurrentDispatcher".
description_zh: 将 Grafana 插件迁移至 React 19 兼容性。当用户要求更新 React 19 插件、为 React 19 做准备、修复 React 19 兼容性、升级至 React 19、迁移至 React 19、将 grafanaDependency 提升至 12.3.0、外部化 jsx-runtime，或运行 react-detect 时使用。触发条件为诸如“更新 React 19 插件”、“React 19 迁移”、“为 React 19 做准备”、“插件 React 19 兼容性”、“grafanaDependency 12.3.0”、“JSX 运行时外部化”、“react-detect”、“SECRET_INTERNALS”、“ReactCurrentOwner”或“ReactCurrentDispatcher”等短语。

description: Authentication bypass testing playbook. Use when assessing login flows, password reset logic, account recovery, MFA bypass, token predictability, brute-force resistance, and session boundary flaws.
description_zh: 认证绕过测试流程手册。用于评估登录流程、密码重置逻辑、账号恢复、多因素认证（MFA）绕过、令牌可预测性、暴力破解抗性以及会话边界缺陷。

description:
Vision-driven desktop automation using Midscene. Control your local desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) or a remote Windows desktop over RDP with natural language commands.
Operates entirely from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels required. Can interact with all visible elements on screen regardless of technology stack.

⚠️ In local mode this takes over the user's real mouse and keyboard. For web apps, prefer "Browser Automation" instead.
Only use this for desktop-native apps (Electron, Qt, native macOS/Windows/Linux) that cannot run in a browser, or for driving a remote Windows host via RDP.

Triggers: open app, press key, desktop, computer, click on screen, type text, screenshot desktop,
launch application, switch window, desktop automation, control computer, mouse click, keyboard shortcut,
screen capture, find on screen, read screen, verify window, close app, test Electron app,
rdp, remote desktop, windows server, connect via rdp

Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)
description_zh:
使用 Midscene 的视觉驱动桌面自动化。使用自然语言命令控制您本地的桌面（macOS、Windows、Linux）或通过 RDP 远程控制 Windows 桌面。
完全基于截图运行——无需 DOM 或无障碍标签。无论技术栈如何，都可以与屏幕上所有可见元素交互。

⚠️ 在本地模式下，此功能将接管用户的真实鼠标和键盘。对于网页应用，建议使用“浏览器自动化”。
仅将此功能用于无法在浏览器中运行的桌面原生应用（Electron、Qt、macOS/Windows/Linux 原生应用），或通过 RDP 驱动远程 Windows 主机。

触发条件：打开应用，按键，桌面，电脑，点击屏幕，输入文本，截取桌面截图，
启动应用，切换窗口，桌面自动化，控制电脑，鼠标点击，键盘快捷键，
屏幕截取，在屏幕中查找，读取屏幕，验证窗口，关闭应用，测试 Electron 应用，
RDP，远程桌面，Windows 服务器，通过 RDP 连接

由 Midscene.js 提供支持（https://midscenejs.com）

description: Read, create, update, and pick contacts using the Contacts and ContactsUI frameworks. Use when fetching contact data, saving new contacts, wrapping CNContactPickerViewController in SwiftUI, handling contact permissions, or working with CNContactStore fetch and save requests.
description_zh: 使用 Contacts 和 ContactsUI 框架读取、创建、更新和选择联系人。适用于获取联系人数据、保存新联系人、在 SwiftUI 中封装 CNContactPickerViewController、处理联系人权限，或处理 CNContactStore 的获取与保存请求。

description: API reconnaissance and documentation review playbook. Use when discovering endpoints, schemas, versions, OpenAPI specs, hidden docs, and surface area for API testing.
description_zh: API侦察与文档审查手册。适用于在API测试中发现端点、模式、版本、OpenAPI规范、隐藏文档及攻击面。

description: Runs metrics queries against Axiom MetricsDB via scripts. Discovers available metrics, tags, and tag values. Use when asked to query metrics, explore metric datasets, check metric values, or investigate OTel metrics data.
description_zh: 通过脚本对 Axiom MetricsDB 执行指标查询。可发现可用的指标、标签及标签值。当被要求查询指标、探索指标数据集、检查指标值或调查 OTel 指标数据时使用。

description: 마이리얼트립 공식 Streamable HTTP MCP 서버로 항공권, 숙소, 투어/티켓/액티비티를 검색하고 상세·가격·예약 링크를 확인한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过迈瑞途官方的 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务器，搜索机票、住宿、旅游/票/活动，并查看详情、价格、预订链接。在 DoorDash 上，通过官方界面完成后续操作。

description: Use for "how does X work", code walkthroughs before changing something, and placement / ownership / layering questions ("where should this live", "which package owns this", "is this the right layer"). Explains subsystem architecture, runtime flow, onboarding mental models. Use why for motivation.
description_zh: 用于 "X 如何工作"、修改任何内容之前的代码走查，以及放置、归属与分层相关的问题（"此内容应放置在何处"、"此内容由哪个包负责"、"这是合适的层级吗"）。解释了子系统架构、运行时流程和入职心智模型。使用 "为什么" 来激励。

description: Review a named diff or PR for bugs, regressions, tests, and standards. Use when asked to review code or when a shipping skill needs a review receipt. Use when asked to apply this review's findings locally. Use ce-resolve-pr-feedback for feedback already left on a PR.
description_zh: 审查命名的差异或 PR，检查其中是否存在缺陷、回归、测试和标准问题。当被要求审查代码，或发布技能需要审查凭证时使用。当被要求将本次审查的发现本地应用时使用。当需要根据已提交在 PR 上的反馈时，使用 ce-resolve-pr-feedback。

description: Build, review, refactor, or architect ASP.NET Core web applications using current official guidance for .NET web development. Use when working on Blazor Web Apps, Razor Pages, MVC, Minimal APIs, controller-based Web APIs, SignalR, gRPC, middleware, dependency injection, configuration, authentication, authorization, testing, performance, deployment, or ASP.NET Core upgrades.
description_zh: 根据当前 .NET Web 开发的最新官方指南，构建、审查、重构或设计 ASP.NET Core Web 应用。可用于 Blazor Web 应用、Razor Pages、MVC、Minimal APIs、基于控制器的 Web API、SignalR、gRPC、中间件、依赖注入、配置、身份验证、授权、测试、性能、部署或 ASP.NET Core 升级等工作场景。

description: When the user wants to discover, evaluate, or prioritize App Store keywords. Also use when the user mentions "keyword research", "find keywords", "search volume", "keyword difficulty", "keyword ideas", or "what keywords should I target". For implementing keywords into metadata, see metadata-optimization. For auditing current keyword performance, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户需要发现、评估或优先考虑 App Store 关键词时，使用本功能。用户提及“关键词研究”“查找关键词”“搜索量”“关键词难度”“关键词灵感”或“我应该针对哪些关键词”时，也可使用。要将关键词应用到元数据中，请参阅 metadata-optimization。要审计当前关键词表现，请参阅 aso-audit。

description: Sync the current project's knowledge into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill from any project when the user says "update wiki", "sync to wiki", "save this to my wiki", "update obsidian", or wants to distill what they've been working on into their knowledge base. This is the cross-project skill that lets you push knowledge from wherever you are into the vault. Accepts inline named-vault routing like "@work update wiki" via the shared Config Resolution Protocol.
description_zh: 将当前项目的知识同步至 Obsidian 知识库。当用户表示需要"更新知识库"、"同步至知识库"、"将此保存至我的知识库"、"更新 Obsidian"或希望将其工作内容提炼至知识库时，可在任意项目中调用此技能。这是一款跨项目技能，可将知识从任意位置推送至你的知识库仓库中。支持通过共享配置解析协议接收类似于"@work 更新知识库"的内联命名仓库路由。

description: Generates custom Shader Graph nodes from HLSL code. Use when the user wants to create a new Shader Graph node or make existing HLSL code work as a reflected function node.
description_zh: 从 HLSL 代码生成自定义着色器图节点。用户如需创建新的着色器图节点，或将现有 HLSL 代码作为反射函数节点使用，可使用该功能。

description: Design composable recommendation, ranking, and feed pipelines using the six-stage Source→Hydrator→Filter→Scorer→Selector→SideEffect framework popularized by xAI's open-sourced X For You algorithm. Use when building any system that picks "the top K items for a (user, context)" — content feeds, search ranking, RAG rerankers, task prioritizers, notification triage, ad selection.
description_zh: 基于由xAI开源的X For You算法推广的六阶段Source→Hydrator→Filter→Scorer→Selector→SideEffect框架，设计可组合的推荐、排序及信息流管道。适用于构建任何选择针对（用户，上下文）的"Top K项"的系统——内容信息流、搜索排序、RAG重排序、任务优先级排序、通知分诊、广告选择。

description: Optimizes Unity 6 audio memory, CPU cost, and playback quality through correct import settings and mixer configuration. Use when the user wants to reduce audio memory usage, choose the right Load Type for short clips versus music versus ambient beds, configure platform-appropriate sample rates and codecs, force 3D audio to mono, or reduce AudioMixer CPU cost from deep group trees or effects running on silent paths.
description_zh: 通过正确的导入设置和混音器配置，优化 Unity 6 的音频内存、CPU 开销和播放质量。当用户需要减少音频内存使用、为短片段、音乐及环境音床选择正确的加载类型、配置平台合适的采样率和编解码器、将 3D 音频强制设为单声道、或从深层组树或静音路径上运行的效果中降低 AudioMixer 的 CPU 开销时使用。

description: JWT and OAuth token attack playbook. Use when validating token trust, signing algorithms, key handling, claim abuse, bearer flows, and OAuth account-binding weaknesses.
description_zh: JWT 与 OAuth token 攻击方案。适用于验证 token 信任、签名算法、密钥处理、声明滥用、Bearer 流程以及 OAuth 账号绑定弱点的场景。

description: Monitor blogs and RSS/Atom feeds for updates using the blogwatcher CLI.
description_zh: 使用blogwatcher CLI监控博客和RSS/Atom订阅源以获取更新。

description: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea. Use when turning a vague idea or user request into a structured document, scoping a feature with goals and non-goals, defining success metrics and acceptance criteria, or breaking a big ask into a phased spec.
description_zh: 根据问题陈述或功能想法编写功能规格或产品需求文档（PRD）。用于将模糊的想法或用户请求转化为结构化文档，界定功能范围（明确目标与非目标），定义成功指标与验收标准，或将大型需求拆分为分阶段规格时使用。

description: Implement AlarmKit alarms and countdown timers for iOS and iPadOS with Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, StandBy, and paired Apple Watch system UI. Covers AlarmManager scheduling, AlarmAttributes and AlarmPresentation, system Stop and AlarmButton secondary actions, authorization, state observation, countdown widget-extension handoff, and Live Activity integration. Use when building wake-up alarms, countdown timers, or alarm-style alerts that need Apple's system alarm experience.
description_zh: 实现 iOS 和 iPadOS 的 AlarmKit 闹钟与倒计时定时器，支持锁定屏幕、灵动岛、睡眠小部件以及与配对 Apple Watch 联动的系统 UI。涵盖 AlarmManager 调度、AlarmAttributes 与 AlarmPresentation、系统停止与 AlarmButton 副操作、授权、状态观察、倒计时小组件与扩展的交接，以及 Live Activity 集成。适用于构建唤醒闹钟、倒计时定时器，或需要 Apple 系统闹钟体验的闹钟样式提醒。

description: The trader's decision dossier on a wallet — four pass/fail gates (is the record real, is the edge still working THIS week, can you actually get filled, does it cut losses) plus what the wallet is holding and buying right now, its entry market-cap band, its copy window in seconds, and a concrete size cap. Answers the question a memecoin trader actually has: "the numbers look good, but if I copy this wallet what happens to me?" Use when the user asks 「这个钱包能跟吗」, 「帮我分析一下这个钱包」, 「它现在在买什么」, 「这个钱包最近还行吗」, 「跟着他买我能吃到吗」, 「他是不是已经不行了」, 「这个钱包什么风格」, 「它是什么类型的」, 「打法」, "can I copy this wallet", "analyze this wallet", "what is this wallet buying now", "is this wallet still hot", "would I actually get filled following this", "what kind of trader is this", or pastes a bare wallet address. This is the default for a bare wallet address: it prints a style title and speed subtitle AND the four gates, so it answers "what kind of trader is this" and "should I act on it" in one pass.
description_zh:
交易者的钱包决策档案

针对一个钱包，包含四个通过/不通过关卡（记录是否真实、本周的优势是否仍在生效、是否真的能成交、能否止损），以及钱包当前持有的和正在买卖的资产、入场市值区间、秒级复制窗口期，以及具体的规模上限。它回答了热门币交易者真正关心的问题："数据看起来不错，但我要复制这个钱包，会发生什么？"

当用户询问「这个钱包能跟吗」「帮我分析一下这个钱包」「它现在在买什么」「这个钱包最近还行吗」「跟着他买我能吃到吗」「他是不是已经不行了」「这个钱包什么风格」「它是什么类型的」「打法」，或者直接粘贴裸钱包地址时使用。

对于裸钱包地址，这是默认处理方式：它会打印风格标题和速度副标题，并展示四个关卡，一次性回答「这个钱包是什么类型的」和「是否值得操作」的问题。

description: Control Sonos speakers (discover/status/play/volume/group).
description_zh: 控制 Sonos 音箱（发现/状态/播放/音量/组群）

description: Remove AI writing patterns from prose using either audit-only detection or a two-pass rewrite flow (diagnosis then reconstruction). Use this skill when editing, reviewing, or rewriting AI-generated content to make it sound human. Triggers on requests to "humanize", "de-slop", "fix AI text", "make it sound human", "remove AI patterns", or when reviewing text that contains obvious AI tells like "Here's the thing:", "Let that sink in", or "In today's fast-paced landscape". Also use when the user pastes text and says it "sounds like ChatGPT", "sounds robotic", "needs to sound more natural", or asks you to "clean up" drafted content before publishing.
description_zh: 使用仅审计检测或两遍重写流程（诊断后再重构）来从文稿中移除AI写作特征。当需要编辑、审阅或重写AI生成的内容，使其听起来更人性化时，请使用本技能。触发条件包括要求"人性化处理"、"去AI腔"、"修复AI文本"、"使其听起来更自然"、"去除AI特征"，或审阅包含明显AI痕迹的文本，例如"Here's the thing:"、"Let that sink in"和"In today's fast-paced landscape"。此外，当用户粘贴文本并表示其"像ChatGPT"、"听起来很机械"、"需要听起来更自然"，或要求在发布前清理起草内容时，也请使用本技能。

description: Read and write NFC tags using CoreNFC. Use when scanning NDEF tags, reading ISO7816/ISO15693/FeliCa/MIFARE tags, writing NDEF messages, handling NFC session lifecycle, configuring NFC entitlements, or implementing background tag reading in iOS apps.
description_zh: 使用 CoreNFC 读取和写入 NFC 标签。适用于扫描 NDEF 标签、读取 ISO7816/ISO15693/FeliCa/MIFARE 标签、写入 NDEF 消息、处理 NFC 会话生命周期、配置 NFC 权限，或在 iOS 应用中实现后台标签读取。

description: Implement and review Apple TipKit feature-discovery UI for iOS 17+ apps. Use when adding or auditing in-app tips, contextual help, coach marks, Tip, TipView, popoverTip, rules, events, actions, display frequency, testing overrides, reusable tip identifiers, or iOS 18+ TipGroup and CloudKit tip sync; avoid for generic SwiftUI navigation or layout outside tip presentation.
description_zh: 实现并审查适用于 iOS 17+ 应用的 Apple TipKit 功能发现 UI。在添加或审核应用内提示、上下文帮助、coach marks、Tip、TipView、popoverTip、规则、事件、操作、显示频率、测试覆盖、可复用提示标识，或 iOS 18+ TipGroup 与 CloudKit 提示同步时使用；避免用于提示呈现之外的通用 SwiftUI 导航或布局。

description: Summarize CodexBar local cost logs by model for Codex or Claude, including current or full breakdowns.
description_zh: 按模型总结 CodexBar 针对 Codex 或 Claude 的本地成本日志，包含当前或完整明细。

description: IDOR and broken object authorization testing playbook. Use when requests expose object identifiers, tenant boundaries, writable fields, or missing object-level authorization checks.
description_zh: IDOR 与对象授权失效测试手册。当请求暴露对象标识符、租户边界、可写字段，或缺少对象级授权检查时使用。

description: Expert evaluator for Grafana Loki label strategy. Audits, designs, and improves label schemas using cardinality scoring, access-pattern alignment, static vs. dynamic label rules, and consistency checks. Use when the user asks to evaluate, audit, design, or improve a Loki label strategy — or asks why their Loki queries are slow.
description_zh: Grafana Loki 标签策略专家评估者。基于基数评分、访问模式对齐、静态与动态标签规则及一致性检查，对标签模式进行审计、设计与优化。适用于用户要求评估、审计、设计或改进 Loki 标签策略——或询问 Loki 查询为何运行缓慢的场景。

description: Terminal Spotify playback/search via spogo (preferred) or spotify_player.
description_zh: 终端 Spotify 播放/搜索：通过 spogo（首选）或 spotify_player。

description: Create network topology diagrams using PlantUML syntax with mxgraph device icons (Cisco, Citrix, etc.). Best for LAN/WAN layouts, datacenter interconnects, and physical/logical network design.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 语法，结合 mxgraph 设备图标（Cisco、Citrix 等）创建网络拓扑图。非常适合 LAN/WAN 布局、数据中心互联以及物理/逻辑网络设计。

description: API authentication and JWT abuse playbook. Use when testing bearer tokens, API keys, claim trust, header spoofing, rate limits, and API auth boundary weaknesses.
description_zh: API 认证与 JWT 滥用操作手册。用于测试 Bearer 令牌、API 密钥、claim 信任、header 伪造、速率限制及 API 认证边界脆弱性。

description: Use when the user wants to review or validate a Unity 6+ URP ScriptableRendererFeature that uses the Render Graph API. Checks for correctness issues - resource wiring, material binding, execution structure, descriptor usage, global resource exposure, and Render Graph best practices.
description_zh: 当用户需要审查或验证使用渲染图 API 的 Unity 6+ URP ScriptableRendererFeature 时使用。检查正确性问题——资源连接、材质绑定、执行结构、描述符使用、全局资源暴露以及渲染图最佳实践。

description: Create or redesign self-contained single-file HTML artifacts with a visual direction shaped by the user's brief, project, and subject. Use when HTML is the deliverable for a report, explainer, landing page, presentation, tool, mixed artifact, or broad request. This is the collection's only implicit router. Route clear wireframe, prototype, mockup, plan, or diagram requests to the matching direct-invocation specialist when available. Do not use for ordinary application implementation when a standalone HTML file is not the deliverable.
description_zh: 以用户的需求、项目和主题为视觉方向，创建或重新设计自包含的单一文件HTML产物。当HTML作为报告、解释说明、着陆页、演示文稿、工具、混合制品或广泛需求的交付成果时使用。这是该集合唯一的隐式路由。若有可用，将明确的线框图、原型、样机、计划或图表请求路由至对应的直接调用专家。当独立HTML文件并非交付成果时，不要用于普通应用实现。

description: Create data pipeline and analytics architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with database/analytics stencil icons. Best for ETL pipelines, data lakes, real-time streaming, data warehousing, and BI dashboard design.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 语法并搭配数据库/分析图框图标，创建数据管道和分析架构图。最适合 ETL 管道、数据湖、实时流处理、数据仓库以及 BI 仪表板设计。

description: 401/403 bypass playbook. Use when encountering access-denied responses on admin panels, API endpoints, or restricted paths. Covers path manipulation, HTTP method tampering, header injection, protocol downgrade, and automated bypass tools.
description_zh: 401/403 绕过指南。适用于在管理后台、API 接口或受限路径上遇到拒绝访问响应时使用。涵盖路径篡改、HTTP 方法篡改、头部注入、协议降级以及自动化绕过工具。

description: E2E testing with Playwright - Page Objects, cross-browser, CI/CD
description_zh: 使用 Playwright 进行 E2E 测试 - 页面对象、跨浏览器、CI/CD

description: Architect game input — action mapping (abstracting keys into named actions), rebinding with conflict detection and persistence, multi-device support (keyboard, gamepad, touch), analog deadzones, and feel features like input buffering and coyote time, plus accessibility. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions input mapping, rebind controls, gamepad support, deadzone, input buffering, coyote time, or accessible controls.
description_zh: 游戏输入架构 —— 动作映射（将按键抽象为命名动作），支持带冲突检测与持久化的重绑定，多设备支持（键盘、手柄、触摸），模拟输入死区，以及输入缓冲、渡鸦时间等手感特性，并具备无障碍功能。与引擎无关。当用户提及输入映射、重绑控制、手柄支持、死区、输入缓冲、渡鸦时间或无障碍控制时使用。

description: Provides and generates complete CRUD workflows for Spring Boot 3 services. Creates feature-focused architecture with Spring Data JPA aggregates, repositories, DTOs, controllers, and REST APIs. Validates domain invariants and transaction boundaries. Use when modeling Java backend services, REST API endpoints, database operations, web service patterns, or JPA entities for Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 为Spring Boot 3服务提供并生成完整的CRUD工作流。创建面向功能的架构，包含Spring Data JPA的聚合对象、仓库、数据传输对象（DTO）、控制器和REST API。验证领域不变量与事务边界。适用于为Spring Boot应用建模Java后端服务、REST API端点、数据库操作、Web服务模式或JPA实体。

description: Knowledge and governance closeout: reconcile project docs, rule files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), authorized agent memory, and workspace residue with what the code and runtime actually do, so the next session or the next person starts from one current answer. Trigger when the user names "neat-freak", "洁癖", or "/neat" — and also on clear knowledge-closeout intent without the name: syncing or tidying project docs/rules/memory after development ("把文档和记忆整理一下", "收尾时把文档同步掉", "docs 和代码对不上了"), stale or conflicting CLAUDE.md/memory, a clean handoff to a teammate or a fresh session, or auditing whether workspace rules are actually followed. Do not trigger for pure coding/refactoring/debugging tasks, tidying data or prose (JSON, 周报, changelog announcements), or a bare "整理" with no project-knowledge context.
description_zh:
知识与治理收尾：核对项目文档、规则文件（CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md）、授权智能体记忆及工作区残留内容，使其与代码及运行时的实际行为保持一致，以便下一个会话或下一位人员基于一致的当前状态启动工作。

触发条件：当用户提及“neat-freak”、“洁癖”或“/neat”时触发；同时也触发于明确的收尾意图且未使用上述名称的情形，例如开发完成后同步或整理项目文档、规则与记忆（如“把文档和记忆整理一下”、“收尾时把文档同步掉”、“文档和代码对不上了”）、存在过时或冲突的 CLAUDE.md/记忆、向团队成员或全新会话进行干净的交接，或审计工作区规则是否真正得到遵循。

不触发场景：不对纯粹的编码/重构/调试任务、整理数据或文本（JSON、周报、变更日志公告）、以及仅有“整理”且无项目知识背景的纯粹表述触发。

description: Create child communication safety experiences using PermissionKit to request parental permission for children. Use when building apps that involve child-to-contact communication, need to check communication limits, request parent/guardian approval, or handle permission responses for minors.
description_zh: 使用 PermissionKit 创建儿童沟通安全体验，以请求儿童的家长许可。适用于构建涉及儿童与联系人的沟通、需要检查沟通限制、请求家长/监护人批准或处理未成年人权限响应的应用程序时。

description: Fetch financial and market data using the yfinance Python library. Use this skill whenever the user asks for stock prices, historical data, financial statements, options chains, dividends, earnings, analyst recommendations, or any market data. Triggers include: any mention of stock price, ticker symbol (AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, etc.), "get me the financials", "show earnings", "what's the price of", "download stock data", "options chain", "dividend history", "balance sheet", "income statement", "cash flow", "analyst targets", "institutional holders", "compare stocks", "screen for stocks", or any request involving Yahoo Finance data. Always use this skill even if the user only provides a ticker — infer intent from context.
description_zh: 使用 yfinance Python 库获取财务和行情数据。当用户要求获取股价、历史数据、财务报表、期权链、股息、盈利、分析师建议或任何行情数据时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：任何提及股价、股票代码（AAPL、MSFT、TSLA 等）、"获取我的财务数据"、"展示盈利情况"、"股价是多少"、"下载股票数据"、"期权链"、"股息历史"、"资产负债表"、"利润表"、"现金流量"、"分析师目标价"、"机构持有者"、"比较股票"、"筛选股票"，或任何涉及 Yahoo Finance 数据的请求。即使用户只提供了股票代码，也始终使用此技能——请从上下文中推断意图。

description: WebSocket handshake, CSWSH, tooling (wsrepl, ws-harness, Burp), and common flaws. Use when apps use real-time channels, chat, notifications, or WS-backed APIs.
description_zh: WebSocket 握手、CSWSH、工具（wsrepl、ws-harness、Burp）及常见缺陷。适用于使用实时通道、聊天、通知或基于 WebSocket 的 API 的应用。

description: WAF bypass methodology and generic evasion techniques. Use when a web application firewall blocks injection payloads (SQLi, XSS, RCE) and you need to craft bypasses using encoding, protocol-level tricks, or WAF-specific weaknesses.
description_zh: WAF绕过方法论与通用规避技术。当Web应用防火墙拦截注入载荷（SQLi、XSS、RCE）时，需使用编码、协议层技巧或Web应用防火墙特定弱点来构造绕过方案，请使用本技术。

description: Analyze Swift and mixed-language compile hotspots using build timing summaries and Swift frontend diagnostics, then produce a recommend-first source-level optimization plan. Use when a developer reports slow compilation, type-checking warnings, expensive clean-build compile phases, long CompileSwiftSources tasks, warn-long-function-bodies output, or wants to speed up Swift type checking.
description_zh: 通过构建时间摘要和 Swift 前端诊断分析 Swift 及混合语言编译热点，并生成优先推荐的源码级优化方案。当开发者报告编译缓慢、类型检查警告、成本较高的清理构建编译阶段、较长的 CompileSwiftSources 任务、warn-long-function-bodies 输出，或需要加速 Swift 类型检查时使用。

description: Build iOS App Clips with invocation URLs, App Clip Codes, NFC, QR codes, Safari banners, Maps, Messages, target setup, App Store Connect experiences, size/capability constraints, NSUserActivity routing, SKOverlay promotion, App Group/keychain handoff, ephemeral notifications, location confirmation, and full-app migration. Use when creating App Clips or wiring App Clip invocation, experience configuration, or full-app handoff.
description_zh: 通过调用 URL、应用贴片代码、NFC、QR 码、Safari 横幅、Maps、Messages、目标设置、App Store Connect 体验、尺寸/能力限制、NSUserActivity 路由、SKOverlay 推广、App Group/钥匙串交接、临时通知、位置确认和全应用迁移，构建 iOS App Clips。在创建 App Clips 或配置 App Clip 调用、体验配置或全应用交接时使用。

description:
Watchlist group management (list/create/rename/delete/add/remove symbols), price alerts (list/add/delete), and community stock lists (sharelist: list/detail/create/delete/manage) via Longbridge. Mutating operations require explicit user confirmation (dry-run protocol).

description_zh:
通过Longbridge进行自选股分组管理（列表/创建/重命名/删除/添加/移除标的）、价格提醒（列表/添加/删除）及社区股票清单（sharelist：列表/详情/创建/删除/管理）。变更操作需用户明确确认（试运行协议）。

description: 고러닝과 대한철인3종협회 공개 표면으로 한국 마라톤·철인3종 경기 일정, 장소, 신청 마감일, 종목을 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过网球与韩国铁人三项三项目协会的公开公示平台，可查询韩国马拉松、铁人三项三项目赛事的日程、地点、报名截止日期及项目。在骑行区域，所有通过官方公示平台进行的后续操作均予以开展。

description: 서울 주요 121개 핫스팟 장소의 실시간 혼잡도와 인구 현황을 조회한다. 지금 강남역이 얼마나 붐비는지, 홍대 인파가 얼마나 되는지 물어볼 때 사용한다.
description_zh: 用于查询首尔主要121个热门景点地点的实时拥挤度与人口状况。可用于了解当前江南站的拥挤程度以及弘大人流情况。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "validate a finding", "check if a vulnerability is real", "triage a security finding", "confirm a vulnerability", "determine if a finding is a true positive or false positive", or provides a security finding for review. It validates security vulnerability findings by tracing data flows, verifying exploit conditions, analyzing security controls, and optionally testing attack vectors against a live application.
description_zh: 当用户要求“验证发现项”、“检查漏洞是否真实存在”、“对安全发现进行分诊”、“确认漏洞”、“判断发现项是真实阳性还是误报”，或提供安全发现供审查时，应使用本技能。本技能通过追踪数据流、验证利用条件、分析安全控制措施，并可选地针对实时应用测试攻击向量，从而验证安全漏洞发现项。

description: Add, enrich, and manage contacts in Joel's Vault. Fire the Inngest enrichment pipeline for full multi-source dossiers, or create quick contacts manually. Use when: 'add a contact', 'enrich this person', 'who is X', 'VIP contact', 'update contact', or any task involving the Vault/Contacts directory.
description_zh: 在 Joel 的 Vault 中添加、丰富和管理联系人。为完整的多源档案触发 Inngest 丰富管线，或手动创建快捷联系人。适用场景：'添加联系人'、'丰富该人员'、'X 是谁'、'VIP 联系人'、'更新联系人'，或任何涉及 Vault/联系人目录的任务。
