description: Notion CLI/API for pages, Markdown content, data sources, files, comments, search, Workers, and raw API calls.
description_zh: Notion CLI/API 支持页面、Markdown 内容、数据源、文件、评论、搜索、Workers 以及原始 API 调用。

description: Manage Grafana Cloud accounts — organizations, stacks, RBAC roles and assignments, SSO/SAML/OAuth/GitHub auth, service accounts for CI/CD, user invites, team membership, and API-driven provisioning. Creates stacks via the Cloud API, mints service-account tokens, applies role assignments, configures SSO providers, and provisions teams/folders/dashboards via Terraform. Use when managing Grafana Cloud access, configuring SSO/SAML/OAuth, setting up service accounts for Terraform/CI/CD, assigning RBAC roles, inviting users, managing multiple stacks or organizations, provisioning cloud resources via API or Terraform, or auditing admin actions — even when the user says "set up SSO", "create a stack", "make a service account", or "onboard a team" without explicitly saying "admin".
description_zh: 管理 Grafana Cloud 账户——组织、栈、RBAC 角色和分配、SSO/SAML/OAuth/GitHub 认证、用于 CI/CD 的服务账户、用户邀请、团队成员资格以及基于 API 的资源配置。通过 Cloud API 创建栈，签发服务账户令牌，应用角色分配，配置 SSO 提供商，并通过 Terraform 配置团队/文件夹/仪表盘。用于在管理 Grafana Cloud 访问、配置 SSO/SAML/OAuth、为 Terraform/CI/CD 设置服务账户、分配 RBAC 角色、邀请用户、管理多个栈或组织、通过 API 或 Terraform 配置云资源或审计管理员操作时使用——即使用户说“设置 SSO”、“创建栈”、“创建服务账户”或“加入团队”，但并未明确说“管理员”，也可使用。

description: Ghost Security — combined security report. Aggregates findings from all scan skills (scan-deps, scan-secrets, scan-code) into a single prioritized report focused on the highest risk, highest confidence issues. Use when the user requests a security overview, vulnerability summary, full security audit, or combined scan results.
description_zh: Ghost Security — 综合安全报告。汇总所有扫描技能（scan-deps、scan-secrets、scan-code）的发现，整合为一份按优先级排序的报告，聚焦于风险最高、置信度最高的安全问题。当用户请求安全概览、漏洞摘要、全面安全审计或综合扫描结果时使用。

description: OpenAI Audio Transcriptions API via curl; gpt-4o-transcribe, mini, diarize, or whisper-1.
description_zh: 通过 curl 调用 OpenAI 音频转写 API；gpt-4o-transcribe、mini、diarize 或 whisper-1。

description: Use when searching academic papers, looking up citations, finding authors, or getting paper recommendations using the Semantic Scholar API. Triggers on queries about research papers, academic search, citation analysis, or literature discovery.
description_zh: 在通过 Semantic Scholar API 搜索学术论文、查阅引用、查找作者或获取论文推荐时使用。当涉及研究论文、学术检索、引用分析或文献发现的查询时触发。

description: Configure single-project Google Cloud Logging: regional log buckets, log sinks, log views, restricting or hiding sensitive logs in the default view (_Default) filter, IAM permissions for views (Logs View Accessor, IAM conditions), logs-based metrics, log exclusions, and sampling. Don't use for cross-project logging or multi-project setups.
description_zh: 配置单项目 Google Cloud 日志服务：区域日志存储桶、日志接收器、日志视图、在默认视图（_Default）过滤条件中限制或隐藏敏感日志、视图的 IAM 权限（日志视图访问者、IAM 条件）、基于日志的指标、日志排除项和采样功能。不适用于跨项目日志或多项目配置。

description: Analyze git repositories to build a security ownership topology (people-to-file), compute bus factor and sensitive-code ownership, and export CSV/JSON for graph databases and visualization. Trigger only when the user explicitly wants a security-oriented ownership or bus-factor analysis grounded in git history (for example: orphaned sensitive code, security maintainers, CODEOWNERS reality checks for risk, sensitive hotspots, or ownership clusters). Do not trigger for general maintainer lists or non-security ownership questions.
description_zh: 分析 Git 仓库，构建安全所有权拓扑（人员-文件），计算 bus factor（业务因子）及敏感代码所有权，并导出 CSV/JSON 文件，供图数据库和可视化使用。仅在用户明确需要基于 Git 历史的安全所有权或业务因子分析时触发（例如：孤立的敏感代码、安全维护人员、用于风险评估的 CODEOWNERS 真实性检查、敏感热点、所有权集群）。对于一般维护人员列表或非安全所有权问题，不触发。

description: Use whenever the user wants to obtain, download, or fetch a paper's PDF — given a DOI, an arXiv id, a paper title, a citation, or a list of DOIs. Trigger on phrases like "download this paper", "find the PDF for [DOI]", "grab me the [Nature/bioRxiv/arXiv] paper on X", "get the open-access version", "I need this article", or any bulk/batch paper download request, even when the user doesn't explicitly say "PDF" or "DOI". Resolves via Unpaywall → Semantic Scholar → arXiv → PubMed Central → bioRxiv/medRxiv → publisher direct (institutional opt-in) → Sci-Hub mirrors as last-resort fallback.
description_zh: 适用于用户想要获取、下载或抓取某篇论文的 PDF 文件时——可基于 DOI、arXiv ID、论文标题、引用或 DOI 列表。当出现诸如“下载这篇论文”、“为 [DOI] 找到 PDF”、“给我获取 [Nature/bioRxiv/arXiv] 的 X 论文”、“获取开放获取版本”、“我需要这篇文章”，或任何批量论文下载请求等短语时触发，即使用户并未明确提到“PDF”或“DOI”。解析路径为 Unpaywall → Semantic Scholar → arXiv → PubMed Central → bioRxiv/medRxiv → 出版商直连（机构授权确认）→ Sci-Hub 镜像作为最后备选方案。

description: Provides chunking strategies for RAG systems. Generates chunk size recommendations (256-1024 tokens), overlap percentages (10-20%), and semantic boundary detection methods. Validates semantic coherence and evaluates retrieval precision/recall metrics. Use when building retrieval-augmented generation systems, vector databases, or processing large documents.
description_zh: 为RAG系统提供分块策略。生成分块大小建议（256-1024个token）、重叠百分比（10-20%）以及语义边界检测方法。验证语义连贯性并评估检索精确度/召回率指标。适用于构建检索增强生成系统、向量数据库或处理大型文档。

description: Turn on AI + ML features in Grafana Cloud — Grafana Assistant (NL → PromQL/LogQL/TraceQL, dashboard build, incident investigation, MCP integration), Dynamic Alerting (Prophet forecasting + DBSCAN outlier detection), Sift (8-analysis automated root-cause), Knowledge Graph + RCA Workbench, and the LLM Plugin (OpenAI / Anthropic / Azure / Ollama / vLLM / LiteLLM). Use when you want anomaly alerts without static thresholds, natural-language querying, automated incident investigation, dashboards generated from a sentence, or a managed LLM proxy for plugins — even when the user says "alert when something looks weird", "explain this PromQL", "find the root cause", "make this a dashboard", or "wire Claude into Grafana" without naming any of these products.
description_zh: 在 Grafana Cloud 中启用 AI + ML 功能——Grafana Assistant（NL → PromQL/LogQL/TraceQL，仪表板构建、事件调查、MCP 集成）、动态告警（Prophet 预测 + DBSCAN 异常检测）、Sift（8 步分析自动化根因分析）、知识图谱 + RCA 工作台，以及 LLM 插件（OpenAI / Anthropic / Azure / Ollama / vLLM / LiteLLM）。当您需要无需静态阈值的异常告警、自然语言查询、自动事件调查、通过一句话生成仪表板，或为插件提供托管 LLM 代理时，即可使用——即便用户在不提及任何这些产品的情况下，说出诸如“当某事物看起来异常时告警”、“解释这条 PromQL”、“找出根本原因”、“将此设为仪表板”或“将 Claude 接入 Grafana”等话语。

description: Solve competition math problems (IMO, Putnam, USAMO, AIME) with adversarial verification that catches the errors self-verification misses. Activates when asked to 'solve this IMO problem', 'prove this olympiad inequality', 'verify this competition proof', 'find a counterexample', 'is this proof correct', or for any problem with 'IMO', 'Putnam', 'USAMO', 'olympiad', or 'competition math' in it. Uses pure reasoning (no tools) — then a fresh-context adversarial verifier attacks the proof using specific failure patterns, not generic 'check logic'. Outputs calibrated confidence — will say 'no confident solution' rather than bluff. If LaTeX is available, produces a clean PDF after verification passes.
description_zh: 解决竞赛数学问题（IMO、Putnam、USAMO、AIME），并结合对抗性验证，以捕获自验证所遗漏的错误。当被要求“解决该IMO问题”“证明该奥林匹克不等式”“验证该竞赛证明”“寻找反例”“该证明是否正确”，或任何包含“IMO”“Putnam”“USAMO”“olympiad”或“竞赛数学”的问题时即会激活。先进行纯推理（不使用工具）——随后，一个具备全新上下文对抗验证器的工具会通过特定的失败模式来攻击证明，而非泛泛的“检查逻辑”。输出校准后的置信度——不会故作保证，而是会说明“没有可靠的解决方案”。若可用LaTeX，验证通过后将生成清晰的PDF。

description: Answer questions about LLM and agentic-application behavior from data already ingested into Elastic: latency and error rate, token and cost utilization, response quality and guardrail events, and agentic call-chain orchestration. Use when the user asks about LLM monitoring, GenAI observability, token spend or AI cost, model latency, prompt or guardrail failures, or how an agent's tool-call chain executed.
description_zh: 利用已导入 Elastic 的数据，回答有关 LLM 和智能体应用行为的问题：延迟与错误率、Token 与成本利用率、响应质量与护栏事件，以及智能体调用链编排。当用户询问 LLM 监控、GenAI 可观测性、Token 支出或 AI 成本、模型延迟、提示词或护栏故障，或智能体工具调用链的执行方式时使用。

description: Set up private network connectivity to Grafana Cloud — AWS PrivateLink, Azure Private Link, GCP Private Service Connect, and Private Data Source Connect (PDC). Provisions VPC endpoints, private endpoints, or PSC forwarding rules per signal type (metrics / logs / traces / profiles); wires Alloy to push to the private DNS endpoint instead of the public one; verifies private DNS resolution + endpoint approval state. Use when sending telemetry to Grafana Cloud without traversing the public internet, eliminating cloud egress costs, meeting PCI-DSS / HIPAA / data-residency compliance, configuring PDC for private data-source queries, or connecting AWS / Azure / GCP workloads to Grafana — even when the user says "stop paying egress", "keep our telemetry off the public internet", or "PCI compliance for Grafana" without naming PrivateLink.
description_zh: 配置通往 Grafana Cloud 的私有网络连接——支持 AWS PrivateLink、Azure Private Link、GCP Private Service Connect 及私有数据源连接（PDC）。按信号类型（指标 / 日志 / 追踪 / 配置）创建 VPC 端点、私有端点或 PSC 转发规则；将 Alloy 配置为推送至私有 DNS 端点而非公网端点；验证私有 DNS 解析与端点审批状态。当需要将遥测数据发送至 Grafana Cloud 且不经过公网时使用，可消除云出站流量费用，满足 PCI-DSS / HIPAA / 数据驻留合规要求，配置 PDC 用于私有数据源查询，或将 AWS / Azure / GCP 工作负载连接到 Grafana——即使用户表示"停止支付出站费用"、"将我们的遥测数据置于公网之外"或"Grafana 需要 PCI 合规"，且未提及 PrivateLink 时。

description: Professional document creation, editing, and analysis for Office formats (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx). Use when working with Word documents, PDFs, PowerPoint presentations, or Excel spreadsheets.
description_zh: 专业的 Office 格式文档创建、编辑与分析（docx、pdf、pptx、xlsx）。适用于处理 Word 文档、PDF、PowerPoint 演示文稿或 Excel 电子表格。

description: PHP 8.x modern patterns, PSR standards, and SOLID principles. Use when reviewing PHP code, checking type safety, auditing code quality, or ensuring PHP best practices. Triggers on "review PHP", "check PHP code", "audit PHP", or "PHP best practices".
description_zh: PHP 8.x 现代化模式、PSR 标准与 SOLID 原则。当需要审查 PHP 代码、检查类型安全性、审计代码质量或确保 PHP 最佳实践时使用。触发条件：在“review PHP”、“check PHP code”、“audit PHP”或“PHP best practices”时触发。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing service layer with Mockito. Creates isolated tests that mock repository calls, verify method invocations, test exception scenarios, and stub external API responses. Use when testing service behaviors and business logic without database or external services.
description_zh: 使用 Mockito 为服务层单元测试提供模式。创建隔离的测试，通过 mock 仓库调用、验证方法调用、测试异常场景以及模拟外部 API 响应。用于在没有数据库或外部服务的情况下测试服务行为和业务逻辑。

description: YES24 / 인터파크 공연의 공개 일정 + 등급별 잔여석을 단일 HTTP 호출로 조회 (조회 전용, 예매·결제 없음). 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: YES24 / 인터파크演出公开日程 + 按等级查询剩余座位（通过单一 HTTP 调用查询）（仅查询，无预订、支付）。在돌쇠平台上，将准备至尽可能接近的合法官方步骤。

description: Redis performance optimization and best practices. Use this skill when working with Redis data structures, Redis Query Engine (RQE), vector search with RedisVL, semantic caching with LangCache, or optimizing Redis performance.
description_zh: Redis性能优化与最佳实践。在处理Redis数据结构、Redis查询引擎（RQE）、RedisVL向量搜索、LangCache语义缓存或优化Redis性能时，请使用此技能。

description: Build and debug Kapso WhatsApp workflows, triggers, functions, and executions.
description_zh: 构建并调试 Kapso WhatsApp 工作流、触发器、功能和执行。

description: Query grid electricity forecasts and submit load events using EnergyKit to help users optimize home electricity usage. Use when building smart home apps, EV charger controls, HVAC scheduling, or energy management dashboards that guide users to use power during cleaner or cheaper grid periods.
description_zh: 使用 EnergyKit 查询电网电力预测并提交负荷事件，以帮助用户优化家庭用电。在构建智能家居应用、电动汽车充电桩控制、暖通空调（HVAC）调度或能源管理仪表板时使用，以引导用户于电网运行更清洁或电价更便宜的时段使用电力。

description: Provides security review capability for TypeScript/Node.js applications, validates code against XSS, injection, CSRF, JWT/OAuth2 flaws, dependency CVEs, and secrets exposure. Use when performing security audits, before deployment, reviewing authentication/authorization implementations, or ensuring OWASP compliance for Express, NestJS, and Next.js. Triggers on "security review", "check for security issues", "TypeScript security audit".
description_zh: 为 TypeScript/Node.js 应用程序提供安全审查能力，对 XSS、注入、CSRF、JWT/OAuth2 漏洞、依赖项 CVE 以及密钥暴露进行代码验证。在开展安全审计、部署前、审查认证/授权实现，或确保 Express、NestJS 和 Next.js 符合 OWASP 标准时使用。当触发“安全审查”、“检查安全问题”、“TypeScript 安全审计”等关键词时触发。

description: Benchmark Xcode clean and incremental builds with repeatable inputs, timing summaries, and timestamped `.build-benchmark/` artifacts. Use when a developer wants a baseline, wants to compare before and after changes, asks to measure build performance, mentions build times, build duration, how long builds take, or wants to know if builds got faster or slower.
description_zh: 对 Xcode 的清理与增量构建进行基准测试，支持可重复输入、计时摘要以及带时间戳的 `.build-benchmark/` 产物。当开发者需要建立基准、比较修改前后的差异、要求测量构建性能、提及构建时间、构建持续时间或构建耗时，或希望了解构建是否变快或变慢时，可使用此项功能。

description: Scans directory structure, detects projects, maps dependencies, and documents code organization into a repo.md file. Use when the user needs a codebase overview, project structure map, or repository context before security analysis.
description_zh: 扫描目录结构、检测项目、映射依赖，并将代码组织记录到 repo.md 文件中。当用户需要在安全分析之前获取代码库概览、项目结构图或仓库上下文时使用。

description: Entry P1 category router for authentication and authorization. Use when testing login flows, sessions, object authorization, JWT, OAuth, CORS, CSRF, and enterprise SSO weaknesses before any deeper auth topic skill.
description_zh: 认证与授权入口 P1 分类路由器。在任何更深层的认证主题技能之前，用于测试登录流程、会话、对象授权、JWT、OAuth、CORS、CSRF 及企业单点登录（SSO）漏洞。

description: Documentation reference for writing Python code using the browser-use open-source library. Use this skill whenever the user needs help with Agent, Browser, or Tools configuration, is writing code that imports from browser_use, asks about @sandbox deployment, supported LLM models, Actor API, custom tools, lifecycle hooks, MCP server setup, or monitoring/observability with Laminar or OpenLIT. Also trigger for questions about browser-use installation, prompting strategies, or sensitive data handling. Do NOT use this for Cloud API/SDK usage or pricing — use the cloud skill instead. Do NOT use this for directly automating a browser via CLI commands — use the browser-use skill instead.
description_zh: 使用 browser-use 开源库编写 Python 代码的文档参考。当用户需要帮助配置 Agent、Browser 或 Tools，编写从 browser_use 导入的代码，或询问 @sandbox 部署、支持的 LLM 模型、Actor API、自定义工具、生命周期钩子、MCP server 设置，或通过 Laminar 或 OpenLIT 进行监控/可观测性时，请使用本技能。当用户询问 browser-use 安装、提示词策略或敏感数据处理时，也应触发本技能。请勿将此技能用于 Cloud API/SDK 的使用或定价——请使用 cloud 技能。请勿将此技能用于通过 CLI 命令直接自动化浏览器——请使用 browser-use 技能。

description: Creates formal academic research papers following IEEE/ACM formatting standards with proper structure, citations, and scholarly writing style. Use when the user asks to write a research paper, academic paper, or conference paper on any topic.
description_zh: 根据 IEEE/ACM 格式标准生成格式规范的正式学术研究论文，具备规范的结构、引用和学术写作风格。当用户要求撰写任何主题的研究论文、学术论文或会议论文时使用。

description: Execute a plan or concrete work prompt end-to-end. Use when implementing from a plan document, a spec path, or a clear build request; use ce-debug for open-ended bugs. Use when an outer orchestrator needs implementation and local verification only, without the shipping tail.
description_zh: 执行计划或具体任务提示词的全流程。当从计划文档、规范路径或明确的构建请求进行实施时使用；针对开放性问题使用 ce-debug。当外部编排器仅需实现与本地验证，无需部署尾段时使用。

description: Provides patterns and code examples for building Next.js 16+ applications with App Router architecture. Use when creating projects with App Router, implementing Server Components and Client Components ("use client"), creating Server Actions for forms, building Route Handlers (route.ts), configuring caching with "use cache" directive (cacheLife, cacheTag), setting up parallel routes (`@slot`) or intercepting routes, migrating to proxy.ts, or working with App Router file conventions (layout.tsx, page.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx).
description_zh: 提供用于使用 App Router 架构构建 Next.js 16+ 应用程序的模式与代码示例。在基于 App Router 创建项目、实现 Server Components 与 Client Components（"use client"）、为表单创建 Server Actions、构建 Route Handlers（route.ts）、使用 "use cache" 指令（cacheLife、cacheTag）配置缓存、设置并行路由（`@slot`）或拦截路由、迁移至 proxy.ts 或处理 App Router 文件约定（layout.tsx、page.tsx、loading.tsx、error.tsx）时使用。

description:
Systematic debugging and root cause analysis for identifying and fixing software issues.
Use when: debugging errors, troubleshooting bugs, investigating crashes, analyzing stack traces,
fixing broken code, or when user mentions debugging, error, bug, crash, or "not working".
description_zh:
系统化的调试与根因分析，用于识别和修复软件问题。
适用场景：调试错误、排查缺陷、排查崩溃、分析堆栈跟踪、修复出错代码，或当用户提及调试、错误、缺陷、崩溃或“无法使用”时。

description: 调用万得 Alice Agent（A2A 协议，SSE 流式）执行指定 Skill 并获取分析结果的 CLI 工具。当用户要求"用 Alice 跑某个 Skill"、"出一份某公司的调研问题清单"、"做一页纸投资备忘"、"核验一段金融信息"等需要点名 Alice 子 Skill 的场景使用。
description_zh: 调用万得 Alice Agent（A2A 协议，SSE 流式）执行指定 Skill 并获取分析结果的命令行（CLI）工具。适用于用户要求“用 Alice 运行某个 Skill”“出具一份某公司的调研问题清单”“制作一页纸投资备忘”“核验一段金融信息”等需要点名 Alice 子 Skill 的场景。

description: Provides comprehensive NestJS best practices including modular architecture, dependency injection scoping, exception filters, DTO validation with class-validator, and Drizzle ORM integration. Use when designing NestJS modules, implementing providers, creating exception filters, validating DTOs, or integrating Drizzle ORM within NestJS applications.
description_zh: 提供全面的 NestJS 最佳实践，包括模块化架构、依赖注入作用域、异常过滤器、使用 class-validator 进行 DTO 验证以及 Drizzle ORM 集成。在设计 NestJS 模块、实现提供者、创建异常过滤器、验证 DTO 或在 NestJS 应用中集成 Drizzle ORM 时使用。

description: Provides patterns for implementing Spring Boot caching: configures Redis/Caffeine/EhCache providers with TTL and eviction policies, applies @Cacheable/@CacheEvict/@CachePut annotations, validates cache hit/miss behavior, and exposes metrics via Actuator. Use when adding caching to Spring Boot services, configuring cache expiration, evicting stale data, or diagnosing cache misses.
description_zh: 提供实现Spring Boot缓存的模式：配置具有TTL和淘汰策略的Redis/Caffeine/EhCache提供者，应用@Cacheable/@CacheEvict/@CachePut注解，验证缓存命中/未命中行为，并通过Actuator暴露指标。在向Spring Boot服务添加缓存、配置缓存过期、清除过期数据或诊断缓存未命中时使用。

description: API authorization and BOLA testing playbook. Use when APIs expose object identifiers, nested resources, hidden writable fields, or weak function-level authorization.
description_zh: API 授权与 BOLA 测试操作手册。当 API 暴露对象标识符、嵌套资源、隐藏的可写字段，或函数级授权较弱时使用。

description: Analyze Swift Package Manager dependencies, package plugins, module variants, and CI-oriented build overhead that slow Xcode builds. Use when a developer suspects packages, plugins, or dependency graph shape are hurting clean or incremental build performance, mentions SPM slowness, package resolution time, build plugin overhead, duplicate module builds from configuration drift, circular dependencies between modules, oversized modules needing splitting, or modularization best practices.
description_zh: 分析 Swift 包管理器（SPM）的依赖、包插件、模块变体以及导致 Xcode 构建变慢的面向持续集成（CI）的构建开销。适用于开发者怀疑包、插件或依赖图结构对干净或增量构建性能造成不利影响，并提及 SPM 运行缓慢、包解析耗时、构建插件开销、配置漂移导致的模块重复构建、模块间的循环依赖、需要拆分的大型模块或模块化最佳实践等情况时。

description: Review requirements, plans, or specs with role-specific lenses. Use when the user wants to improve an existing planning document.
description_zh: 以角色专属视角审查需求、计划或规格。当用户希望改进现有规划文档时使用。

description: Entry P1 category router for injection testing. Use when routing between XSS, SQLi, SSRF, XXE, SSTI, command injection, and NoSQL injection workflows based on how attacker-controlled input is consumed.
description_zh: 用于注入测试的 P1 类别入口路由器。使用时，根据攻击者控制的输入的使用方式，在 XSS、SQLi、SSRF、XXE、SSTI、命令注入和 NoSQL 注入工作流之间进行路由。

description: Take a request all the way to done, hands-off, through the right Compound Engineering skills. A code change ends as an open pull request, pushed without stopping. Use only when the user explicitly asks for autonomous end-to-end work or invokes lfg directly. Use ce-plan, ce-work, ce-debug, or ce-commit-push-pr for work the user reviews step by step.
description_zh: 借助正确的复合工程技能，实现请求的全程自主处理，无人干预地完成。代码修改以未合并的拉取请求形式结束，并持续推送而不中断。仅当用户明确要求自主端到端工作或直接调用 lfg 时使用。对于用户逐步审查的工作，使用 ce-plan、ce-work、ce-debug 或 ce-commit-push-pr。

description: Provides Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) patterns for Spring Boot — creates domain events, configures ApplicationEvent and @TransactionalEventListener, sets up Kafka producers and consumers, and implements the transactional outbox pattern for reliable distributed messaging. Use when implementing event-driven systems in Spring Boot, setting up async messaging with Kafka, publishing domain events from DDD aggregates, or needing reliable event publishing with the outbox pattern.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 提供事件驱动架构（EDA）模式——创建领域事件，配置 ApplicationEvent 与 @TransactionalEventListener，搭建 Kafka 生产者和消费者，并实现事务性发件箱模式，以保障可靠的分布式消息传递。适用于在 Spring Boot 中实现事件驱动系统、使用 Kafka 设置异步消息、从 DDD 聚合发布领域事件，或需要借助发件箱模式实现可靠事件发布等场景。

description: Create hierarchical mind maps using PlantUML @startmindmap syntax. Best for brainstorming, topic decomposition, study notes, and decision trees with automatic radial layout, left/right branches, and per-node styling.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML @startmindmap 语法创建分层思维导图。最适合头脑风暴、主题分解、学习笔记和决策树，并带有自动径向布局、左右分支以及每个节点的样式设置。

description: Provides fault tolerance patterns for Spring Boot 3.x using Resilience4j. Use when implementing circuit breakers, handling service failures, adding retry logic with exponential backoff, configuring rate limiters, or protecting services from cascading failures. Generates circuit breaker, retry, rate limiter, bulkhead, time limiter, and fallback implementations. Validates resilience configurations through Actuator endpoints.
description_zh: 提供基于 Resilience4j 的 Spring Boot 3.x 容错模式。适用于实现断路器、处理服务故障、添加带指数退避的重试逻辑、配置限流器或保护服务免受级联故障影响时的场景。可生成断路器、重试、限流器、舱壁、时间限制器和降级实现。通过 Actuator 端点验证弹性配置。

description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
description_zh: 从精选列表或 GitHub 仓库路径将 Codex 技能安装到 $CODEX_HOME/skills 中。当用户要求列出可安装技能、安装精选技能或从其他仓库（包括私有仓库）安装技能时使用。

description: Kubernetes penetration testing playbook. Use when targeting Kubernetes clusters via API server, RBAC enumeration, service account abuse, etcd access, Kubelet API, pod escape, cloud-specific metadata, admission webhook bypass, and registry secrets.
description_zh: Kubernetes 渗透测试手册。适用于通过 API 服务器、RBAC 枚举、服务账户滥用、etcd 访问、Kubelet API、Pod 逃逸、云特定元数据、准入 Webhook 绕过以及注册表密钥等方式针对 Kubernetes 集群。

description: Use when the user dictates an app, site, bot, or feature to build end-to-end and expects a finished result without reviewing specs, tickets, or code — vibecoding sessions, non-technical users, "собери под ключ", "build it for me", "не задавай лишних вопросов" requests. Also use when the user invokes /autopilot, or asks for a build in a named mode, depth or finish — «полный автомат», «режим интервью», «погриль меня», «ручной режим», «строго по брифу», «проработай глубоко», «вылижи до эталона».
description_zh: 当用户指示端到端构建应用、网站、机器人或功能，并在不审查规范、工单或代码的情况下期望直接获得最终成果时使用——包括氛围编码会话、非技术用户，以及提出“一次搞定”、“为我构建”、“不要提多余问题”等请求的场景。当用户调用 /autopilot，或要求以命名模式、深度或完成度进行构建时，也应使用——即“全自动”、“访谈模式”、“我来烤制”、“手动模式”、“严格按简报”、“深入处理”、“打磨到标准”。

description: Build production-ready Express.js servers with middleware, authentication, routing, and database integration. Use when creating REST APIs, managing requests/responses, implementing middleware chains, and handling server logic.
description_zh: 使用中间件、身份验证、路由和数据库集成构建生产就绪的 Express.js 服务器。适用于创建 REST API、管理请求/响应、实现中间件链和处理服务器逻辑。

description: Provides Spring Boot MCP server patterns that create Model Context Protocol servers with Spring AI by defining tool handlers, exposing resources, configuring prompt templates, and setting up transports for AI function calling and tool calling. Use when building MCP servers to extend AI capabilities with Spring's official AI framework, implementing AI tools, custom function calling, or MCP client integration.
description_zh: 提供 Spring Boot MCP 服务器模式，该模式通过定义工具处理器、暴露资源、配置提示模板以及设置 AI 函数调用和工具调用的传输，使用 Spring AI 创建模型上下文协议服务器。用于构建 MCP 服务器时，借助 Spring 官方 AI 框架扩展 AI 能力，实现 AI 工具、自定义函数调用或 MCP 客户端集成。

description: CORS misconfiguration testing playbook. Use when analyzing cross-origin trust, credentialed browser reads, origin reflection, preflight policy bugs, and browser-based access to authenticated APIs.
description_zh: CORS配置错误测试指南。用于分析跨域信任、带凭据的浏览器读取、源址反射、预检策略缺陷，以及浏览器访问已认证API的场景。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing external REST APIs using WireMock. Stubs API responses, verifies request details, simulates failures (timeouts, 4xx/5xx errors), and validates HTTP client behavior without real network calls. Use when testing service integrations with external APIs or mocking HTTP endpoints.
description_zh: 提供使用 WireMock 对外部 REST API 进行单元测试的模式。模拟 API 响应，验证请求详情，模拟故障（超时、4xx/5xx 错误），并在不执行真实网络请求的情况下验证 HTTP 客户端行为。适用于测试服务与外部 API 的集成，或模拟 HTTP 端点。

description: Find the best version of any recipe across 37 trusted sites — with offline cookbook, pantry match, substitution lookup, meal planning, and USDA-backed nutrition. Trigger phrases: `find the best recipe for`, `what can I make with`, `substitute for <ingredient>`, `nutrition for <recipe>`, `use recipe-goat`.
description_zh: 在 37 个可信站点中查找任何食谱的最佳版本——支持离线食谱手册、食材库存匹配、替代品查询、用餐计划，以及 USDA 认证的营养信息。触发短语： `find the best recipe for`, `what can I make with`, `substitute for <ingredient>", `nutrition for <recipe>", `use recipe-goat`。

description: Sets up and configures Unity Localization, including locales, String/Asset Tables, CJK font support, and Addressables workflows. Use when the user wants to add languages to a project, translate UI text, support Asian (CJK) languages with TMP fonts, or mentions i18n, l10n, multilingual support, or making a game support multiple languages.
description_zh: 设置并配置 Unity 本地化，包括语言环境、字符串/资源表、中日韩字体支持以及 Addressables 工作流。适用于当用户想要为项目添加语言、翻译 UI 文本、支持使用 TMP 字体的亚洲（CJK）语言，或提及 i18n、l10n、多语言支持，或使游戏支持多种语言时。

description: Provides patterns to configure Spring Boot Actuator for production-grade monitoring, health probes, secured management endpoints, and Micrometer metrics across JVM services. Use when setting up monitoring, health checks, or metrics for Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 提供用于配置 Spring Boot Actuator 以进行生产级监控、健康探测、受保护的管理端点以及 JVM 服务中 Micrometer 指标的配置模式。适用于设置 Spring Boot 应用的监控、健康检查或指标时。

description: Build shared real-time experiences using GroupActivities and SharePlay. Use when implementing shared media playback, collaborative app features, synchronized game state, or any FaceTime, Messages, AirDrop, or nearby visionOS group activity on iOS, macOS, tvOS, or visionOS.
description_zh: 使用组活动（GroupActivities）和共享播放（SharePlay）构建共享实时体验。适用于实现共享媒体播放、协作应用功能、同步游戏状态，或在 iOS、macOS、tvOS、visionOS 上执行任何 FaceTime、Messages、AirDrop 或附近组活动。

description: Scrape e-commerce data for pricing intelligence, customer reviews, and seller discovery across Amazon, Walmart, eBay, IKEA, and 50+ marketplaces. Use when user asks to monitor prices, track competitors, analyze reviews, research products, or find sellers.
description_zh: 在亚马逊、沃尔玛、eBay、宜家及50多个市场，抓取电子商务数据，用于获取价格情报、客户评论和卖家发现。当用户要求监控价格、追踪竞争对手、分析评论、研究产品或寻找卖家时使用。

description: Entry P1 category router for reconnaissance and methodology. Use when mapping scope, drawing an attack surface from one application, discovering assets, fingerprinting technology, building endpoint inventory, and choosing the first high-value security testing path.
description_zh: P1分类侦察与方法论入口路由器。用于范围映射、从单个应用绘制攻击面、发现资产、进行技术指纹识别、构建终端清单，以及选择首要的高价值安全测试路径时使用。

description: Triage Elastic Security alerts — gather context, classify threats, create cases, and acknowledge. Use when triaging alerts, performing SOC analysis, or investigating detections.
description_zh: 对 Elastic Security 告警进行分诊——收集上下文信息，分类威胁，创建案件，并认领。适用于分诊告警、进行 SOC 分析或调查检出情况。

description: World-class game UI design expertise combining the clarity of Nintendo's UI philosophy, the immersive diegetic interfaces of Dead Space and Metroid Prime, and the competitive readability principles from esports titles. Game UI is the invisible bridge between player intent and game response.  Great game UI serves the player without breaking immersion. It communicates critical information at a glance during intense action, guides new players without patronizing veterans, and adapts gracefully from 4K monitors to handheld screens and from keyboard to touch to controller. The best game UI designers understand that every pixel of screen space is sacred - borrowed from the game world itself. Use when "game ui, game interface, hud design, heads up display, game menu, inventory ui, health bar, stamina bar, game hud, minimap, crosshair, reticle, button prompt, controller ui, gamepad navigation, diegetic interface, in-world ui, quest tracker, damage numbers, cooldown indicator, radial menu, game tooltip, game-ui, hud, game-interface, game-menu, controller-ui, diegetic, game-design, accessibility, console, mobile-games" mentioned.
description_zh:
将任天堂UI理念之清晰、《死亡空间》与《质变前夜》的沉浸式拟境界面，以及电竞类游戏标题的竞争性可读性原则融为一体的世界级游戏UI设计专长。游戏UI是连接玩家意图与游戏响应之间的无形桥梁。卓越的游戏UI在不破坏沉浸感的前提下服务于玩家。它在激烈动作中即时传递关键信息，为新手玩家提供引导而不显傲慢地对待资深玩家，并能够从4K显示器到手持设备屏幕、从键盘触屏到手柄，优雅地适应。最顶尖的游戏UI设计师深知，屏幕上每一个像素都神圣不可侵犯——它源自游戏世界本身。

当提及“游戏UI，游戏界面，抬头显示设计，抬头显示，游戏菜单，物品栏UI，生命值条，体力条，游戏抬头显示，小地图，准星，瞄准器，按钮提示，手柄UI，手柄导航，拟境界面，世界内UI，任务追踪器，伤害数字，冷却指示器，环形菜单，游戏提示框，游戏UI，抬头显示，游戏界面，游戏菜单，手柄UI，拟境，游戏设计，无障碍，主机，移动游戏”时使用：

description: Complete Valyu API toolkit for AI agents. Use this skill when asked to perform real-time search across web, academic, medical, transportation, financial sources, content extraction from URLs, AI-powered answers with citations, or comprehensive deep research reports.
description_zh: 适用于 AI 代理的完整 Valyu API 工具包。当被要求执行针对网络、学术、医疗、交通、金融等来源的实时搜索、从 URL 提取内容、提供带引用的 AI 驱动答案，或生成全面的深度研究报告时，请使用此技能。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
description_zh: 创建有效技能的指南。当用户希望创建新技能（或更新现有技能），以借助专业知识、工作流程或工具集成来扩展 Claude 的能力时，应使用本技能。

description: Generate professional SVG logos and high-end showcase images. Use when the user wants to: (1) Create a logo or icon for their product/brand, (2) Generate logo design concepts based on product information, (3) Create professional logo showcase presentations with multiple background styles, (4) Export logos in various formats (SVG, PNG), or (5) Iterate on logo designs with different visual styles. Supports geometric patterns, dot matrix designs, line systems, and mixed compositions. Generates showcase images using Nano Banana (Gemini image generation) with 12 professional background styles.
description_zh: 生成专业的SVG Logo和高端展示图片。适用于用户需要以下场景时：(1) 为其产品或品牌创建Logo或图标，(2) 根据产品信息生成Logo设计概念，(3) 创建包含多种背景风格的专业Logo展示演示，(4) 以多种格式（SVG、PNG）导出Logo，或(5) 以不同的视觉风格迭代Logo设计。支持几何图案、点阵设计、线条系统和混合构图。使用Nano Banana（Gemini图像生成）配合12种专业背景风格生成展示图片。

description: Implement Swift Codable models for JSON and property-list encoding and decoding with JSONDecoder, JSONEncoder, CodingKeys, and custom init(from:) or encode(to:). Use when parsing API responses, remapping keys, flattening nested JSON, handling date or data decoding strategies, decoding heterogeneous arrays, or integrating Codable with URLSession, SwiftData, or UserDefaults.
description_zh: 实现使用 JSONDecoder、JSONEncoder、CodingKeys 以及自定义的 init(from:) 或 encode(to:) 的 Swift Codable 模型，用于对 JSON 和属性列表进行编码与解码。适用于解析 API 响应、重映射键、将嵌套 JSON 扁平化、处理日期或数据解码策略、解码异构数组，以及将 Codable 与 URLSession、SwiftData 或 UserDefaults 集成。

description: iOS pentesting playbook. Use when testing iOS applications for keychain extraction, URL scheme hijacking, Universal Links exploitation, runtime manipulation, binary protection analysis, data storage issues, and transport security bypass during authorized mobile security assessments.
description_zh: iOS渗透测试操作手册。在授权的移动安全评估中，用于测试iOS应用的关键钥匙串提取、URL方案劫持、Universal Links利用、运行时篡改、二进制保护分析及数据存储问题、传输安全绕过等场景的操作指南。

description: Provides dependency injection patterns for Spring Boot projects, including constructor-first design, optional collaborator handling, bean selection, and wiring validation. Use when creating services and configurations, replacing field injection, or troubleshooting ambiguous or fragile Spring wiring.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 项目提供依赖注入模式，包括优先构造函数设计、可选协作组件处理、Bean 选择以及装配验证。在创建服务和配置、替换字段注入，或排查模糊或脆弱的 Spring 装配时使用。

description: Calculate and model paid-media CPA, CPL, CPC, CPM, ROAS, MER, break-even targets, contribution margin, LTV:CAC, impression-share opportunity, budgets, forecasts, and experiment economics. Use for PPC math, ad calculator, break-even analysis, ROAS calculator, CPA calculator, budget forecast, LTV CAC, or MER.
description_zh: 计算并建模付费媒体CPA、CPL、CPC、CPM、ROAS、MER、盈亏平衡目标、贡献毛益、LTV: CAC（生命周期价值与客户获取成本比）、展示份额机会、预算、预测，以及实验经济性。用于点击付费计算（PPC math）、广告计算器、盈亏平衡分析、ROAS计算器、CPA计算器、预算预测、LTV: CAC（生命周期价值与客户获取成本比）或MER（营销效率比率）。

description: Fetch and display GitHub trending repositories and developers. Use when building dashboards showing trending repos, discovering popular projects, or tracking GitHub trends. Triggers on GitHub trending, trending repos, popular repositories, GitHub discover.
description_zh: 获取并展示 GitHub 热门仓库和开发者。用于构建展示热门仓库、发现热门项目或追踪 GitHub 趋势的仪表盘。触发关键词：GitHub trending、热门仓库、流行仓库、GitHub discover。

description: Create ArchiMate enterprise architecture diagrams using PlantUML stdlib macros. Best for TOGAF viewpoints, layered EA modeling (Business/Application/Technology), motivation analysis, and migration planning.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 标准库宏创建 ArchiMate 企业架构图。非常适合 TOGAF 视角、分层企业架构建模（业务/应用/技术）、动机分析和迁移规划。

description: Heap exploitation playbook. Use when targeting ptmalloc2/glibc heap vulnerabilities including UAF, double free, overflow, off-by-one/null, and leveraging tcache/fastbin/unsortedbin attacks for arbitrary write or code execution.
description_zh: 堆利用手册。用于针对 ptmalloc2/glibc 堆漏洞（包括 UAF、双重释放、溢出、off-by-one/null），并利用 tcache/fastbin/unsortedbin 攻击实现任意写或代码执行。

description: Reconcile accounts by comparing GL balances to subledgers, bank statements, or third-party data. Use when performing bank reconciliations, GL-to-subledger recs, intercompany reconciliations, or identifying and categorizing reconciling items.
description_zh: 通过比较总账余额与子账簿、银行对账单或第三方数据，进行账务核对。当执行银行对账、总账至子账簿对账、公司间对账，或识别并分类对账项目时使用。

description: Guide for writing GraphQL operations (queries, mutations, fragments) following best practices. Use this skill when: (1) writing GraphQL queries or mutations, (2) organizing operations with fragments, (3) optimizing data fetching patterns, (4) setting up type generation or linting, (5) reviewing operations for efficiency.
description_zh: 遵循最佳实践的 GraphQL 操作（查询、变更、片段）编写指南。使用本技能时：(1) 编写 GraphQL 查询或变更，(2) 使用片段组织操作，(3) 优化数据获取模式，(4) 设置类型生成或代码检查（linting），(5) 审查操作以提升效率。

description: CSRF testing playbook. Use when reviewing state-changing web flows, anti-CSRF defenses, SameSite behavior, JSON CSRF, login CSRF, and OAuth state handling.
description_zh: CSRF 测试操作手册。适用于审查变更状态的网页流程、反 CSRF 防御、SameSite 行为、JSON CSRF、登录 CSRF 及 OAuth 状态处理。

description: Direct-invocation specialist for clear, self-contained HTML plans that preserve source material while improving hierarchy, sequence, ownership, dependencies, and reviewability. Use when the user explicitly invokes html-plan or the broad html skill routes a plan request here. Do not activate independently from a general request.
description_zh: 直接调用专项专家：为清晰、自包含的 HTML 计划提供支持，这些计划在保留源材料的同时，改进层级、顺序、所有权、依赖关系与可审查性。当用户明确调用 html-plan，或较广泛的 html 技能将计划请求路由至此场景时使用。不得从一般请求中独立激活。

description: LLM prompt injection playbook. Use when testing AI/LLM applications for direct injection, indirect injection via RAG/browsing, tool abuse, data exfiltration, MCP security risks, and defense bypass techniques.
description_zh: LLM 提示注入实战手册。适用于测试 AI/LLM 应用，涵盖直接注入、通过 RAG/浏览进行的间接注入、工具滥用、数据外泄、MCP 安全风险及防御绕过技术。

description: Traffic analysis and PCAP forensics playbook. Use when analyzing network captures including Wireshark filters, protocol analysis (HTTP/DNS/FTP/SMTP/USB/WiFi), data extraction, covert channel detection, PCAP repair, TLS decryption, and tshark command-line analysis.
description_zh: 网络流量分析与PCAP取证操作手册。用于分析网络抓包数据，包括Wireshark过滤器、协议分析（HTTP/DNS/FTP/SMTP/USB/WiFi）、数据提取、隐蔽信道检测、PCAP修复、TLS解密以及tshark命令行分析。

description: Entry P1 category router for business logic testing. Use when workflow abuse, race conditions, pricing flaws, or multi-step state attacks matter more than parser-level input injection.
description_zh: 用于业务逻辑测试的 P1 类别入口路由。当工作流滥用、竞态条件、定价缺陷或多步状态攻击比解析器层面的输入注入更重要时使用。

description: Create, tune, and manage Elastic Security detection rules (SIEM and Endpoint). Use for false positives, exceptions, new coverage, noisy rules, or rule management via Kibana API.
description_zh: 创建、调优和管理 Elastic Security 检测规则（SIEM 和端点）。用于处理误报、例外、新覆盖、嘈杂规则或通过 Kibana API 进行规则管理。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing REST controllers using MockMvc and @WebMvcTest. Generates controller tests that validates request/response mapping, validation, exception handling, and HTTP status codes. Use when testing web layer endpoints in isolation for API endpoint testing, Spring MVC tests, mock HTTP requests, or controller layer unit tests.
description_zh: 使用MockMvc和@WebMvcTest，提供对REST控制器进行单元测试的示例模式。生成验证请求/响应映射、验证、异常处理及HTTP状态码的控制器测试。适用于独立测试Web层端点，用于API端点测试、Spring MVC测试、模拟HTTP请求或控制器层单元测试。

description: Provides parameterized testing patterns with JUnit 5, generates data-driven unit tests using @ParameterizedTest, @ValueSource, @CsvSource, @MethodSource. Creates tests that run the same logic with multiple input values. Use when writing data-driven Java tests, multiple test cases from single method, or boundary value analysis.
description_zh: 在 JUnit 5 中提供参数化测试模式，使用 @ParameterizedTest、@ValueSource、@CsvSource、@MethodSource 注解生成数据驱动单元测试。创建在多个输入值下运行相同逻辑的测试。当编写数据驱动的 Java 测试、从单个方法创建多个测试用例或进行边界值分析时使用。

description: Local text-to-speech via sherpa-onnx (offline, no cloud)
description_zh: 通过 sherpa-onnx 实现本地文本转语音（离线，无云端）

description: OAuth and OIDC misconfiguration testing playbook. Use when reviewing redirect URI handling, state and nonce validation, PKCE, token audience, callback binding, and identity-provider trust flaws.
description_zh: OAuth与OIDC配置错误测试手册。适用于审查重定向URI处理、状态与nonce验证、PKCE、令牌受众、回调绑定及身份提供者信任缺陷。

description: Tune game physics for stable, good-feeling motion — fixed vs variable timestep, render interpolation, mass/gravity/drag, continuous collision detection (CCD) to stop tunneling, fixing jitter, and collision layers/masks. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions physics feel, jitter, tunneling, fixed timestep, FixedUpdate, CCD, bouncing/unstable physics, or collision layers.
description_zh: 为游戏物理调优，以呈现稳定且手感良好的运动表现——涵盖固定步长与可变步长的处理、渲染插值、质量/重力/阻力参数设置、连续碰撞检测（CCD）以阻止穿透问题、抖动修复以及碰撞层/碰撞掩码的设定。该方案引擎无关。当用户提及物理手感、抖动、穿透、固定步长、FixedUpdate、CCD、弹跳/不稳定的物理表现，或碰撞层相关内容时使用。

description: Creates reusable Zod v4 schemas, validates API payloads, forms, and configuration input, transforms and coerces data safely, and handles validation errors with strong type inference for TypeScript applications. Use when designing validation layers, parsing `z.string()`, `z.object()`, or `z.email()` schemas, or implementing runtime type-safe data validation.
description_zh: 创建可复用的 Zod v4 模式，验证 API 负载、表单与配置输入，安全地转换和强制转换数据，并为 TypeScript 应用提供强类型推断以处理验证错误。适用于设计验证层、解析 `z.string()`、`z.object()` 或 `z.email()` 模式，或实现运行时类型安全的数据验证。

description: When the user wants to optimize App Store metadata — title, subtitle, keyword field, or description. Also use when the user mentions "optimize my title", "ASO metadata", "keyword field", "character limits", "app description", or "write my subtitle". For keyword discovery, see keyword-research. For full ASO audits, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化 App Store 元数据——包括标题、副标题、关键词字段或描述时，应使用此功能。当用户提及“优化我的标题”、“ASO 元数据”、“关键词字段”、“字符限制”、“应用描述”或“撰写我的副标题”时，也应使用。关于关键词发现，请参阅 keyword-research。关于完整的 ASO 审计，请参阅 aso-audit。

description: Scaffold a minimal local LangGraph agent in Python by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangGraph agent locally.
description_zh: 通过遵循官方快速入门，在 Python 中搭建一个最小化的本地 LangGraph 智能体。适用于用户希望快速构建或本地尝试 LangGraph 智能体时。

description: Generate a response to a common legal inquiry using configured templates, with built-in escalation checks for situations that shouldn't use a templated reply. Use when responding to data subject requests, litigation hold notices, vendor legal questions, NDA requests from business teams, or subpoenas.
description_zh: 使用已配置的模板生成常见法律询问的回复，并内置升级检查，针对不应使用模板回复的情形进行升级。适用于响应数据主体请求、诉讼保全通知、供应商法律问题、业务团队的NDA请求或传票等场景。

description: Add, update, list, search, or inspect Things 3 todos, inbox, today, projects, areas, and tags on macOS.
description_zh: 在 macOS 上添加、更新、列出、搜索或查看 Things 3 的待办事项、收件箱、今日、项目、区域和标签。

description: 把单个 agent session 装不下的一大块工作规划成 issue tracker 上的 decision tickets shared map，并逐一解决，直到通往 destination 的路清晰。
description_zh: 将单个 agent session 装不下的一大块工作，规划为 issue tracker 上的 decision tickets shared map，并逐一解决，直到通往 destination 的路清晰。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing JSON serialization/deserialization with Jackson and `@JsonTest`. Validates JSON mapping, custom serializers, date formats, and polymorphic types. Use when testing JSON serialization, validating custom serializers, or writing JSON unit tests in Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 提供使用 Jackson 和 `@JsonTest` 进行 JSON 序列化/反序列化单元测试的模式。校验 JSON 映射、自定义序列化器、日期格式和多态类型。在 Spring Boot 应用中测试 JSON 序列化、校验自定义序列化器或编写 JSON 单元测试时使用。

description: Generate anywidget components for marimo notebooks.
description_zh: 为 marimo 笔记本生成 anywidget 组件。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Grok Build CLI as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Grok — phrasings like "have Grok do X", "delegate this to Grok", "run it through Grok", "use Grok Build to implement/fix/refactor", or "have grok CLI do this" — or to run a queue of coding tasks through Grok while staying the reviewer. Prefer it when the user will review the diff and commit it themselves. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Grok Build CLI 作为后台实现者，然后审查其差异（diff）并由您自行落地。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Grok 时使用此方法——例如当出现“让 Grok 做 X”、“将此项委托给 Grok”、“通过 Grok 执行此任务”、“使用 Grok Build 实现/修复/重构”，或“让 grok CLI 执行此操作”等表述时，或者当需要保持审查者身份，同时将一系列编码任务通过 Grok 运行处理时。当用户将审查差异（diff）并自行提交（commit）时，优先使用此方法。切勿用于足够小、可内联完成的任务，或当用户要求直接编写代码且无需委托时。

description: Scans .NET code for ~50 performance anti-patterns across async, memory, strings, collections, LINQ, regex, serialization, and I/O with tiered severity classification. Use when analyzing .NET code for optimization opportunities, reviewing hot paths, or auditing allocation-heavy patterns.
description_zh: 扫描 .NET 代码中约 50 种性能反模式，涵盖异步、内存、字符串、集合、LINQ、正则表达式、序列化及 I/O，并按分级严重程度进行分类。用于分析 .NET 代码中的优化机会、审查热点路径，或审计高分配模式。

description: Custom VM and bytecode reverse engineering playbook. Use when CTF challenges or protected software implement custom virtual machines with proprietary bytecode, dispatcher loops, or maze-style challenges.
description_zh: 自定义虚拟机与字节码逆向工程操作手册。适用于在 CTF 挑战或保护软件中使用自定义虚拟机、专有字节码、调度循环或迷宫式挑战的场景。

description: Integrate Apify into an existing JavaScript/TypeScript or Python application using the apify-client package. Use when adding web scraping, automation, or data extraction capabilities to an existing app via the Apify API.
description_zh: 使用 apify-client 包，将 Apify 集成到现有的 JavaScript/TypeScript 或 Python 应用中。适用于通过 Apify API 为现有应用添加网页抓取、自动化或数据提取功能时使用。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing Spring Security with `@PreAuthorize`, `@Secured`, `@RolesAllowed`. Validates role-based access control and authorization policies. Use when testing security configurations and access control logic.
description_zh: 为使用 `@PreAuthorize`、`@Secured`、`@RolesAllowed` 测试 Spring Security 提供单元测试模式。验证基于角色的访问控制与授权策略。适用于测试安全配置和访问控制逻辑。

description: Provides Spring Data Neo4j integration patterns for Spring Boot applications. Use when you need to work with a graph database, Neo4j nodes and relationships, Cypher queries, or Spring Data Neo4j. Creates node entities with @Node annotation, defines relationships with @Relationship, writes Cypher queries using @Query, configures imperative and reactive Neo4j repositories, implements graph traversal patterns, and sets up testing with embedded databases.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 应用提供 Spring Data Neo4j 集成模式。当您需要处理图数据库、Neo4j 节点与关系、Cypher 查询或 Spring Data Neo4j 时使用。使用 @Node 注解创建节点实体，利用 @Relationship 定义关系，借助 @Query 编写 Cypher 查询，配置命令式和响应式 Neo4j 仓库，实现图遍历模式，并配置嵌入式数据库测试。

description: Provides distributed transaction patterns using the Saga Pattern for Spring Boot microservices. Use when implementing distributed transactions across services, handling compensating transactions, ensuring eventual consistency, or building choreography or orchestration-based sagas with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Axon Framework.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 微服务提供基于 Saga 模式的分布式事务模式。适用于实现跨服务分布式事务、处理补偿事务、确保最终一致性，或基于 Kafka、RabbitMQ 或 Axon Framework 构建协同或编排型 Saga。

description: When the user wants to analyze competitors' App Store strategy, find keyword gaps, or understand competitive positioning. Also use when the user mentions "competitor analysis", "competitive research", "keyword gap", "what are my competitors doing", or "compare my app to". For keyword-specific research, see keyword-research. For metadata writing, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户希望分析竞争对手的应用商店策略、找出关键词缺口或理解竞争定位时使用。当用户提及“竞争对手分析”、“竞品研究”、“关键词缺口”、“我的竞争对手在做什么”或“将我的应用与...比较”时，也应使用。对于关键词特定研究，请参阅 `keyword-research`。对于元数据撰写，请参阅 `metadata-optimization`。

description: Provides comprehensive code review capability for Next.js applications, validates Server Components, Client Components, Server Actions, caching strategies, metadata, API routes, middleware, and performance patterns. Use when reviewing Next.js App Router code changes, before merging pull requests, after implementing new features, or for architecture validation. Triggers on "review Next.js code", "Next.js code review", "check my Next.js app".
description_zh: 为 Next.js 应用提供全面的代码审查能力，验证服务端组件、客户端组件、服务端动作、缓存策略、元数据、API 路由、中间件以及性能模式。在审查 Next.js App Router 代码变更、合并拉取请求之前、实现新功能之后，或用于架构验证时使用。当输入“审查 Next.js 代码”、“Next.js 代码审查”或“检查我的 Next.js 应用”时触发。

description: Android Kotlin development with Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, and MockK testing
description_zh: 使用 Coroutines、Jetpack Compose、Hilt 与 MockK 测试的 Android Kotlin 开发

description: Fetch WeatherKit current, minute, hourly, and daily forecasts; weather alerts; iOS 18+ changes, historical comparisons, summaries, and statistics; and required Apple Weather attribution. Use when integrating weather data, showing forecasts or alerts, caching WeatherKit responses, displaying attribution, or reviewing WeatherKit query limits in iOS apps.
description_zh: 获取WeatherKit的当前、分钟、小时和日常预报；天气预警；iOS 18+变更、历史对比、摘要和统计数据；以及必需的Apple Weather署名。用于在iOS应用中集成天气数据，显示预报或预警，缓存WeatherKit响应，显示署名，或审查WeatherKit查询限制。

description: Configures GKE edge networking, traffic routing, load balancing, and private service endpoints. Use when configuring Gateway API manifests, standard Ingress, Cloud Armor WAF security policies, Container-Native Load Balancing (NEGs), Private Service Connect (PSC), or Google-managed SSL certificates on GKE. Don't use for core cluster IP planning, Dataplane V2 network policies, or node NAT egress (use gke-networking instead).
description_zh: 配置 GKE 边缘网络、流量路由、负载均衡和私有服务端点。在配置 Gateway API 清单、标准 Ingress、Cloud Armor WAF 安全策略、Container-Native Load Balancing（NEGs）、Private Service Connect（PSC）或 GKE 上由 Google 管理的 SSL 证书时使用。不适用于核心集群 IP 规划、Dataplane V2 网络策略或节点 NAT 出口（改用 gke-networking）。

description: CGV, 메가박스, 롯데시네마 영화관 검색, 상영작, 시간표, 잔여석 조회가 필요할 때 사용한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 该功能用于在需要搜索 CGV、Mega Box、乐天影院，查询正在上映作品、场次时间表及余座信息时使用。在돌쇠中，可通过官方界面推进至后续操作。

description: Create a new GitHub repository and clone it locally
description_zh: 创建一个新的 GitHub 仓库并在本地克隆它。

description: Anti-debugging detection and bypass playbook. Use when reversing protected binaries that detect debuggers via ptrace, PEB flags, timing checks, or signal/exception handlers on Linux and Windows.
description_zh: 反调试检测与绕过操作手册。适用于在 Linux 和 Windows 上逆向受保护二进制文件，且该类文件通过 ptrace、PEB 标志、时序检查或信号/异常处理器检测调试器的情形。

description: Scan the Obsidian wiki and automatically discover missing cross-references between pages. Use this skill when the user says "link my pages", "find missing links", "cross-reference", "connect my wiki", "add wikilinks", "what pages should be linked", or after any large ingestion to ensure new pages are woven into the existing knowledge graph. Also trigger when the user mentions "orphan pages" in the context of wanting to connect them, or says things like "my wiki feels disconnected" or "pages aren't linked well". This is a write-heavy skill — it actually modifies pages to add links, unlike wiki-lint which just reports issues.
description_zh: 扫描 Obsidian wiki，自动发现页面之间缺失的交叉引用。当用户说出“链接我的页面”、“查找缺失的链接”、“交叉引用”、“连接我的 wiki”、“添加 wikilinks”、“哪些页面应该被链接”，或在任何大规模导入后，确保新页面融入现有知识图谱时，使用此技能。当用户提及“孤立页面”且希望将其连接，或说出“我的 wiki 感觉不连贯”、“页面链接不佳”等表述时，也需触发。这是一个以写入为主的技能——它会实际修改页面以添加链接，与仅报告问题的 wiki-lint 不同。

description: Control Philips Hue lights and scenes via the OpenHue CLI.
description_zh: 通过 OpenHue CLI 控制 Philips Hue 灯具和场景。

description: Provides and generates LangChain4j tool and function calling patterns: annotates methods as tools with @Tool, configures tool executors, registers tools with AiServices, validates tool parameters, and handles tool execution errors. Use when building AI agents that call tools, define function specifications, manage tool responses, or integrate external APIs with LLM-driven applications.
description_zh: 提供并生成 LangChain4j 工具与函数调用模式：使用 @Tool 注解方法作为工具，配置工具执行器，通过 AiServices 注册工具，验证工具参数，并处理工具执行错误。适用于构建调用工具的 AI 智能体、定义函数规范、管理工具响应，或将外部 API 集成到由大语言模型驱动的应用程序中。

description: Query Google Places for text search, place details, resolve, reviews, or scriptable JSON via goplaces.
description_zh: 通过 goplaces，可查询 Google Places 的文本搜索、地点详情、地址解析、评价，或可脚本化的 JSON。

description: Provides patterns for testing utility classes, static methods, and helper functions. Validates pure functions, null handling, edge cases, and boundary conditions. Generates AssertJ assertions and @ParameterizedTest for string utils, math utils, validators, and collection helpers. Use when testing utils, test helpers, helper functions, static methods, or verifying utility code correctness.
description_zh: 提供用于测试工具类、静态方法和辅助函数的测试模式。验证纯函数、空值处理、边缘情况与边界条件。为字符串工具、数学工具、验证器和集合辅助功能生成 AssertJ 断言及 @ParameterizedTest。在测试工具、测试辅助、辅助函数、静态方法，或验证工具代码正确性时使用。

description: React UI component systems with TailwindCSS + Radix + shadcn/ui. Stack: TailwindCSS (styling), Radix UI (primitives), shadcn/ui (components), React/Next.js. Capabilities: design system architecture, accessible components, responsive layouts, theming, dark mode, component composition. Actions: review, design, build, improve, refactor UI components. Keywords: TailwindCSS, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, design system, component library, accessibility, ARIA, responsive, dark mode, theming, CSS variables, component architecture, atomic design, design tokens, variant, slot, composition. Use when: building component libraries, implementing shadcn/ui, creating accessible UIs, setting up design systems, adding dark mode/theming, reviewing UI component architecture.
description_zh: React UI 组件系统（基于 TailwindCSS + Radix + shadcn/ui）。技术栈：TailwindCSS（样式）、Radix UI（基础原语）、shadcn/ui（组件）、React/Next.js。能力：设计系统架构、无障碍组件、响应式布局、主题定制、深色模式、组件组合。操作：审查、设计、构建、优化、重构 UI 组件。关键词：TailwindCSS、Radix UI、shadcn/ui、设计系统、组件库、无障碍性、ARIA、响应式、深色模式、主题化、CSS 变量、组件架构、原子化设计、设计令牌、变体、插槽、组合。适用场景：构建组件库、实现 shadcn/ui、创建无障碍 UI、搭建设计系统、添加深色模式/主题定制、审查 UI 组件架构。

description: Binary protection bypass playbook. Use when identifying and bypassing ASLR, PIE, NX/DEP, stack canary, RELRO, FORTIFY_SOURCE, CET, and MTE protections in ELF binaries to enable exploitation.
description_zh: 二进制保护绕过操作手册。用于在ELF二进制文件中识别和绕过ASLR、PIE、NX/DEP、栈金丝雀、RELRO、FORTIFY_SOURCE、CET和MTE等保护措施，以实现漏洞利用。

description: Provides comprehensive code review capability for NestJS applications, analyzing controllers, services, modules, guards, interceptors, pipes, dependency injection, and database integration patterns. Use when reviewing NestJS code changes, before merging pull requests, after implementing new features, or for architecture validation. Triggers on "review NestJS code", "NestJS code review", "check my NestJS controller/service".
description_zh: 为 NestJS 应用提供全面的代码审查能力，分析控制器、服务、模块、守卫、拦截器、管道、依赖注入和数据库集成模式。在审查 NestJS 代码变更、合并拉取请求之前、实现新功能之后或进行架构验证时使用。触发条件：“审查 NestJS 代码”、“NestJS 代码审查”、“检查我的 NestJS 控制器/服务”。

description: Design and evaluate paid-ad experiments with hypotheses, randomization units, sample-size and duration assumptions, guardrails, platform experiment tools, analysis, and decision rules. Use for A/B test, split test, experiment design, hypothesis, statistical significance, sample size, test duration, or experiment readout.
description_zh: 设计并评估付费广告实验，基于假设、随机化单元、样本量和时长假设、护栏、平台实验工具、分析及决策规则。适用于 A/B 测试、拆分测试、实验设计、假设、统计学显著性、样本量、测试时长或实验结果展示。

description: World-class data science skill for statistical modeling, experimentation, causal inference, and advanced analytics. Expertise in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn), R, SQL, statistical methods, A/B testing, time series, and business intelligence. Includes experiment design, feature engineering, model evaluation, and stakeholder communication. Use when designing experiments, building predictive models, performing causal analysis, or driving data-driven decisions.
description_zh: 世界级数据科学技能，涵盖统计建模、实验、因果推断和高级分析。精通 Python（NumPy、Pandas、Scikit-learn）、R、SQL、统计方法、A/B 测试、时间序列和商业智能。包括实验设计、特征工程、模型评估和利益相关者沟通。适用于设计实验、构建预测模型、进行因果分析或推动数据驱动决策。

description: Use when the user wants to retrieve or update Organization-Wide Default (OWD) sharing settings for Salesforce objects. TRIGGER when: user asks to check current OWD settings, view sharing defaults, change default access levels (Private, Public Read Only, Public Read/Write, Controlled by Parent), configure internal or external access for standard or custom objects, mentions org-wide defaults, wants to make records private or restrict who can see records, wants to control default record visibility for an object, or references .settings-meta.xml sharing fields or sharingModel in .object-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user asks about sharing rules, criteria-based sharing, role hierarchy, or manual sharing — delegate to platform-sharing-rules-generate.
description_zh:
当用户需要获取或更新 Salesforce 对象的组织范围默认设置（OWD）共享设置时使用。

**触发条件（TRIGGER）**当：用户询问检查当前 OWD 设置、查看共享默认设置、更改默认访问级别（私有、公开只读、公开读写、受父记录控制）、为标准对象或自定义对象配置内部或外部访问权限、提及组织范围默认设置、希望将记录设为私有或限制谁能查看记录、希望对对象控制默认记录可见性，或引用了 .settings-meta.xml 文件中的共享字段或 .object-meta.xml 文件中的 sharingModel 时。

**不使用（DO NOT TRIGGER）**当：用户询问共享规则、基于条件的共享、角色层级或手动共享——转交至 platform-sharing-rules-generate。

description: Path traversal and LFI playbook. Use when file paths, download endpoints, include operations, archive extraction, or wrapper behavior may expose filesystem control.
description_zh: 路径穿越与LFI实战手册。当文件路径、下载端点、包含操作、归档解压或包装行为可能暴露文件系统控制权时使用。

description: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, beyond the diff, and prove the one fact it's safe because of by running real code instead of writing it up. Use for 'blast radius of X', 'what could this break', or reviewing a small diff you don't trust.
description_zh: 在发布前，在差异之外找出改动可能造成破坏的位置，并实际运行代码来证明其安全这一唯一依据，而不是仅仅写下来。用于查询 'blast radius of X'、'what could this break'，或在审查你不信任的小差异时。

description: Provides integration patterns for LangChain4j with Spring Boot. Configures AI model beans, sets up chat memory with Spring context, integrates RAG pipelines with Spring Data, and handles auto-configuration, dependency injection, and Spring ecosystem integration. Use when embedding LangChain4j into Spring Boot applications, building Java LLM applications with @Bean configuration, or setting up Spring AI patterns.
description_zh: 为 LangChain4j 与 Spring Boot 提供集成模式。配置 AI 模型 Bean，使用 Spring 上下文设置聊天记忆，将 RAG 流水线与 Spring Data 集成，并处理自动配置、依赖注入以及 Spring 生态系统集成。适用于将 LangChain4j 嵌入 Spring Boot 应用、使用 @Bean 配置构建 Java LLM 应用，或设置 Spring AI 模式时使用。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing Spring `@Scheduled` and `@Async` methods using JUnit 5, CompletableFuture, Awaitility, and Mockito. Covers mocking task execution and timing, verifying execution counts, testing cron expressions, validating retry behavior, and simulating thread pool behavior. Use when testing background tasks, cron jobs, periodic execution, scheduled tasks, or thread pool behavior.
description_zh: 使用 JUnit 5、CompletableFuture、Awaitility 和 Mockito，为 Spring 的 @Scheduled 和 @Async 方法的单元测试提供模式。涵盖任务执行与定时模拟、执行次数验证、cron 表达式测试、重试行为验证以及线程池行为模拟。用于测试后台任务、cron 任务、周期执行、定时任务或线程池行为。

description: Provides Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) implementation patterns with LangChain4j for Java. Generates document ingestion pipelines, embedding stores, vector search, and semantic search capabilities. Use when building chat-with-documents systems, document Q&A over PDFs or text files, AI assistants with knowledge bases, semantic search over document repositories, or knowledge-enhanced AI applications with source attribution.
description_zh: 提供基于 LangChain4j 的 Java 检索增强生成（RAG）实现模式。生成文档摄取流水线、嵌入存储、向量搜索及语义搜索能力。适用于构建基于文档的聊天系统、基于 PDF 或文本文件的文档问答、带知识库的 AI 助手、文档库的语义搜索，或具备来源溯源的增强知识 AI 应用。

description: Retrieves authoritative guidance on Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB (managed InfluxDB 2, InfluxDB 2 Read Replica Clusters, InfluxDB 3 Core and Enterprise). Applicable to any InfluxDB-on-AWS request including engine selection, provisioning (Marketplace + AmazonTimestreamInfluxDBFullAccess/ConsoleFullAccess IAM), schema design (tags vs fields, cardinality, HTTP/sensor/metric data modeling), migration from LiveAnalytics, Processing Engine plugins, connectivity (port 8086 V2, port 8181 V3, VPC-only by default), and write/query errors.
description_zh: 提供 Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB（托管版 InfluxDB 2、InfluxDB 2 读取副本集群、InfluxDB 3 核心版和企业版）的权威指引。适用于所有 Amazon InfluxDB on AWS 请求，包括引擎选择、开通（Marketplace + AmazonTimestreamInfluxDBFullAccess/ConsoleFullAccess IAM）、模式设计（标签与字段、基数、HTTP/传感器/指标数据建模）、从 LiveAnalytics 的迁移、处理引擎插件、连接（V2 端口 8086、V3 端口 8181、默认仅限 VPC），以及写入/查询错误。

description: Command injection playbook. Use when user input may reach shell commands, process execution, converters, import pipelines, or blind out-of-band command sinks.
description_zh: 命令注入操作手册。当用户输入可能进入 shell 命令、进程执行、转换器、导入管道，或隐蔽带外命令接收点时使用。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing `@ExceptionHandler` and `@ControllerAdvice` in Spring Boot applications. Validates error response formatting, mocks exceptions, verifies HTTP status codes, tests field-level validation errors, and asserts custom error payloads. Use when writing Spring exception handler tests, REST API error tests, or mocking controller advice.
description_zh: 为 Spring Boot 应用中的 `@ExceptionHandler` 和 `@ControllerAdvice` 单元测试提供模式。校验错误响应格式、模拟异常、验证 HTTP 状态码、测试字段级校验错误，并断言自定义错误载荷。在编写 Spring 异常处理器测试、REST API 错误测试，或模拟控制器建议（`@ControllerAdvice`）时使用。

description: Configures Amazon Route 53 DNS: public and private records, traffic-steering routing policies, health checks, DNS Firewall, Route 53 Profiles, VPC Resolver (also known as Route 53 Resolver) for hybrid and Outposts networks, and Global Resolver. Applicable when the customer wants to point a hostname at a target, split or fail over traffic across endpoints, monitor an endpoint, block malicious domains, centralize DNS across accounts, or resolve private DNS across a hybrid network. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Does not cover CloudFront-specific setup (see the route53-cloudfront skill) or non-DNS networking.
description_zh: 配置 Amazon Route 53 DNS：公开记录和私有记录、流量引导路由策略、健康检查、DNS 防火墙、Route 53 配置文件、适用于混合网络和 Outposts 网络的 VPC 解析器（也称为 Route 53 解析器）以及全局解析器。适用于客户希望将主机名指向目标、在端点之间分流或故障转移流量、监控端点、阻止恶意域名、跨账户集中管理 DNS 或通过混合网络解析私有 DNS 的场景。根据任务，指引至参考文档中的相应操作流程。不包括 CloudFront 专用设置（参见 route53-cloudfront 技能）或非 DNS 网络配置。

description: Write game shaders from cross-engine fundamentals — the vertex→fragment pipeline, coordinate spaces, UV math, and common 2D/3D effects (tint, UV scroll, dissolve, outline, fresnel rim, vignette) in GLSL with HLSL equivalents. Use when the user mentions shaders, fragment/pixel shader, vertex shader, UV, GLSL, HLSL, or effects like dissolve, outline, or rim light.
description_zh: 基于跨引擎基础编写游戏着色器——在 GLSL 中结合 HLSL 等价实现，涵盖顶点→片段流水线、坐标系、UV 数学，以及常见的 2D/3D 特效（着色、UV 滚动、溶解、轮廓、菲涅尔边缘光、暗角）。当用户提到着色器、片段/像素着色器、顶点着色器、UV、GLSL、HLSL，或溶解、轮廓、边缘光等特效时使用。

description: Search and filter Observability logs using ES|QL. Use when investigating log spikes, errors, or anomalies; getting volume and trends; or drilling into services or containers during incidents.
description_zh: 使用 ES\ |QL 搜索和筛选可观测性日志。调查日志飙升、错误或异常时使用；获取数量和趋势时使用；或在进行事件时深入分析服务和容器。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing mappers, converters, and bean mappings. Validates entity-to-DTO and model transformation logic in isolation. Generates executable mapping tests with MapStruct and custom converter test coverage. Use when writing mapping tests, converter tests, entity mapping tests, or ensuring correct data transformation between DTOs and domain objects.
description_zh: 提供用于单元测试映射器、转换器和Bean映射的模式。在隔离环境中验证实体到DTO及模型转换逻辑。结合MapStruct和自定义转换器测试覆盖生成可执行的映射测试。适用于编写映射测试、转换器测试、实体映射测试，以及确保DTO与领域对象之间正确数据转换等场景。

description: Oracle CLI second-model review/debug/refactor/design with selected files, dry-run token checks, API or browser engine.
description_zh: Oracle CLI 第二模型审查/调试/重构/设计（基于选定文件），试运行 token 检查，API 或浏览器引擎。

description: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Discovers available MCPs and queries each evidence category (source control, issue tracker, long-form docs, real-time chat, infrastructure observability, error tracking, product analytics warehouse) in parallel, then returns a cited read on decisions and tradeoffs. Use how for runtime behavior.
description_zh: 用于回答"X为何以这种方式运作"、"为何选择Y"，提供设计依据，分析回归问题、进行事后复盘，或确定基于数据的阈值。该功能可并行发现可用的MCP，并针对各项证据类别（源代码控制、问题追踪器、长文档、实时聊天、基础设施可观测性、错误追踪、产品分析仓库）进行查询，随后返回关于决策与权衡的引证分析。用于查询运行时行为。

description: Format string exploitation playbook. Use when printf-family functions receive user-controlled format strings, enabling arbitrary stack reads (%p/%s), arbitrary memory writes (%n/%hn/%hhn), GOT/hook overwrites, and canary/libc/PIE leaks.
description_zh: 格式化字符串利用手册。当 printf 系列函数接收到由用户控制的格式字符串时，可用于任意栈读取（%p/%s）、任意内存写入（%n/%hn/%hhn）、GOT/钩子覆盖，以及金丝雀/libc/PIE 泄漏。

description: Provides comprehensive Nx monorepo management guidance for TypeScript/JavaScript projects. Use when creating Nx workspaces, generating apps/libraries/components, running affected commands, setting up CI/CD, configuring Module Federation, or implementing NestJS backends within Nx
description_zh: 为 TypeScript/JavaScript 项目提供全面的 Nx 单体仓库管理指导。在创建 Nx 工作区、生成应用、库、组件、运行受影响的命令、设置 CI/CD、配置模块联邦或实现 NestJS 后端时使用。

description: Hacker News API for stories and comments. Use when user mentions "Hacker News", "HN", "Y Combinator", or asks about tech news.
description_zh: Hacker News API，用于获取故事与评论。当用户提及“Hacker News”、“HN”、“Y Combinator”或询问科技新闻时使用。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing Spring Cache annotations (@Cacheable, @CachePut, @CacheEvict). Generates test code that mocks cache managers, verifies cache hit/miss behavior, tests cache key generation with SpEL expressions, validates eviction strategies, and checks conditional caching scenarios. Triggers: caching tests, test Spring cache, mock cache, Spring Boot caching, cache hit/miss verification, @Cacheable testing.
description_zh: 为 Spring Cache 注解（@Cacheable、@CachePut、@CacheEvict）提供单元测试模式。生成模拟缓存管理器的测试代码，验证缓存命中/未命中行为，测试基于 SpEL 表达式的缓存键生成，校验淘汰策略，并检查条件缓存场景。触发条件：缓存测试、测试 Spring Cache、缓存模拟、Spring Boot 缓存、缓存命中/未命中验证、@Cacheable 测试。

description: XXE playbook. Use when XML, SVG, OOXML, SOAP, or parser-driven imports may resolve external entities, files, or internal network resources.
description_zh: XXE 操作手册。当 XML、SVG、OOXML、SOAP 或基于解析器的导入可能会解析外部实体、文件或内部网络资源时使用。

description: Provides authentication implementation patterns for Next.js 15+ App Router using Auth.js 5 (NextAuth.js). Use when setting up authentication flows, implementing protected routes, managing sessions in Server Components and Server Actions, configuring OAuth providers, implementing role-based access control, or handling sign-in/sign-out flows in Next.js applications.
description_zh: 提供基于 Auth.js 5（NextAuth.js）的 Next.js 15+ App Router 认证实现模式。适用于在 Next.js 应用中设置认证流程、实现受保护路由、在 Server Components 和 Server Actions 中管理会话、配置 OAuth 提供商、实现基于角色的访问控制，或处理登录/登出流程。

description: Use this skill when rendering live HTML/DOM elements (or frozen snapshots of them) as PixiJS v8 textures via the EXPERIMENTAL HTML-in-Canvas browser APIs. Covers the pixi.js/html-source import, feature detection with canvas.requestPaint, HTMLSource for a live, repainting, still-interactive element (autoLayout/autoUpdate/autoRequestPaint, requestPaint, isReady, HTMLSource.defaultOptions, the direct-child-of-canvas + layoutsubtree requirement), ElementImageSource for an immutable captureElementImage() snapshot (autoClose, ready immediately), using the source on a Sprite/Texture/Mesh, fallback-only auto-detection via Texture.from at priority -10, uploader error messages, and destroy/cleanup. Triggers on: HTMLSource, ElementImageSource, ElementImage, HTML in canvas, render DOM to texture, render HTML to texture, texElementImage2D, copyElementImageToTexture, HTMLSourceOptions, ElementImageSourceOptions, HTMLSourceCanvas.
description_zh: 在通过 EXPERIMENTAL HTML-in-Canvas 浏览器 API 将实时 HTML/DOM 元素（或冻结的快照）渲染为 PixiJS v8 纹理时，使用此技能。该技能涵盖 pixi.js/html-source 的导入、基于 canvas.requestPaint 的特性检测、使用 HTMLSource 处理实时重绘且仍可交互的元素（包括 autoLayout/autoUpdate/autoRequestPaint、requestPaint、isReady、HTMLSource.defaultOptions，以及 canvas 的直接子元素与 layoutsubtree 的要求）、使用 ElementImageSource 处理不可变的 captureElementImage() 快照（支持 autoClose，且立即就绪），在 Sprite/Texture/Mesh 上使用源，通过 Texture.from 在优先级 -10 下进行仅作回退的自动检测、上传器错误消息以及销毁与清理等工作。该技能的触发条件包括：HTMLSource、ElementImageSource、ElementImage、Canvas 内 HTML、将 DOM 渲染为纹理、将 HTML 渲染为纹理、texElementImage2D、copyElementImageToTexture、HTMLSourceOptions、ElementImageSourceOptions、HTMLSourceCanvas。

description: SSTI playbook. Use when template expressions, server-side rendering, preview features, or templating engines may evaluate attacker-controlled content.
description_zh: SSTI 演练手册。当模板表达式、服务端渲染、预览功能或模板引擎可能评估攻击者控制的内容时使用。

description: Generate sample security events, attack scenarios, and synthetic alerts for Elastic Security. Use when demoing, populating dashboards, testing detection rules, or setting up a POC.
description_zh: 为Elastic Security生成示例安全事件、攻击场景和合成告警。适用于演示、填充仪表板、测试检测规则或设置POC。

description: Orchestrates comprehensive production readiness reviews and assessments for GKE clusters and workloads across scalability, security, reliability, observability, backup/DR, and cost optimization. Use when asked to productionize, prepare, assess, audit, or review a GKE cluster or workload before going live to production. Don't use for deep-dive single-domain implementation (use specific domain skills like gke-workload-scaling, gke-platform-security, gke-workload-security, gke-service-networking, gke-reliability instead).
description_zh: 统筹针对GKE集群和工作负载的全面生产就绪性评审和评估，覆盖可扩展性、安全性、可靠性、可观测性、备份/灾难恢复以及成本优化。用于在被要求对GKE集群或工作负载进行生产化、准备、评估、审计或审查，并在上线生产前使用。请勿用于单一领域的深度实施（请使用特定领域技能，如gke-workload-scaling、gke-platform-security、gke-workload-security、gke-service-networking、gke-reliability等代替）。

description: Quick backtest a strategy on a symbol. Creates a complete .py script with data fetch, signals, backtest, stats, and plots.
description_zh: 快速对某个标的回测策略。生成包含数据获取、信号、回测、统计和绘图功能的完整 .py 脚本。

description: Entry P1 category router for file access and upload workflows. Use when testing download endpoints, file paths, local file inclusion, upload flows, preview pipelines, archive extraction, or storage and sharing boundaries.
description_zh: P1 类别路由入口，用于文件访问和上传工作流。当测试下载端点、文件路径、本地文件包含、上传流程、预览流水线、归档提取，或存储与共享边界时使用。

description: Use when the user asks for nearby Korean emergency rooms, 응급실, ER, or emergency bed/병상 status near a location. Ask for the user's current location first unless a location was already provided.
description_zh: 当用户询问附近的韩国的急诊室、응급실、ER，或某地点附近的急诊床/병상状态时使用。如果尚未提供位置，请先询问用户的当前位置。

description: GraphQL and hidden parameter testing playbook. Use when exploring introspection, batching, undocumented fields, hidden parameters, schema abuse, and GraphQL authorization gaps.
description_zh: GraphQL 与隐藏参数测试手册。适用于探索内省（Introspection）、批处理、未文档化字段、隐藏参数、模式滥用以及 GraphQL 授权差距的场景。

description: Provides Qdrant vector database integration patterns with LangChain4j. Handles embedding storage, similarity search, and vector management for Java applications. Use when implementing vector-based retrieval for RAG systems, semantic search, or recommendation engines.
description_zh: 提供 Qdrant 向量数据库与 LangChain4j 的集成模式。为 Java 应用程序处理嵌入存储、相似度搜索和向量管理。在实现 RAG 系统的基于向量的检索、语义搜索或推荐引擎时使用。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing `@ConfigurationProperties` classes with `@ConfigurationPropertiesTest`. Validates property binding, tests validation constraints, verifies default values, checks type conversions, and mocks property sources for Spring Boot configuration properties. Use when testing application configuration binding, validating YAML or application.properties files, verifying environment-specific settings, or testing nested property structures.
description_zh: 提供使用 `@ConfigurationPropertiesTest` 对 `@ConfigurationProperties` 类进行单元测试的模式。验证属性绑定、测试验证约束、验证默认值、检查类型转换，并模拟用于 Spring Boot 配置属性的属性源。当测试应用配置绑定、验证 YAML 或 application.properties 文件、验证特定环境的设置，或测试嵌套属性结构时使用。

description: Linux kernel exploitation playbook. Use when exploiting kernel vulnerabilities (UAF, OOB, race condition, type confusion) for privilege escalation via commit_creds, modprobe_path overwrite, or kernel ROP chains in CTF and real-world scenarios.
description_zh: Linux内核利用手册。用于在CTF和实际场景中，通过commit_creds、modprobe_path覆写或内核ROP链，利用内核漏洞（UAF、OOB、竞态条件、类型混淆）进行提权。

description: Provides patterns for unit testing Spring application events. Validates event publishing with ApplicationEventPublisher, tests @EventListener annotation behavior, and verifies async event handling. Use when writing tests for event listeners, mocking application events, or verifying events were published in your Spring Boot services.
description_zh: 提供单元测试 Spring 应用事件的模式。使用 ApplicationEventPublisher 验证事件发布，测试 @EventListener 注解的行为，并验证异步事件处理。在为事件监听器编写测试、模拟应用事件，或验证 Spring Boot 服务中的事件是否已被发布时使用。

description: Create data-driven charts with Vega-Lite (declarative) and Vega (programmatic). Best for statistical visualization of numeric data — bar, line, scatter, heatmap, area, radar charts, and word clouds.
description_zh: 使用 Vega-Lite（声明式）和 Vega（编程式）创建数据驱动图表。最适合数值数据的统计可视化——条形图、折线图、散点图、热力图、面积图、雷达图和词云。

description: Search GIF providers with CLI/TUI, download results, and extract stills/sheets.
description_zh: 使用 CLI/TUI 搜索 GIF 提供商，下载结果，并提取静态帧/图片集。

description: 공공데이터포털 창업진흥원 K-Startup Open API(15125364)로 통합 공고 사업 정보·지원사업 공고·창업 콘텐츠·통계보고서를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 조회한다. 검색 전용. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过公共数据门户创业振兴院K-Startup开放API（15125364），经由k-skill-proxy查询综合公告业务信息、支持业务公告、创业内容及统计报告。专用于搜索。在“돌쇠”中，可执行直至通过官方界面进行的后续操作。

description: Writing queries, mutations, actions, and HTTP actions with proper argument validation, error handling, internal functions, and runtime considerations
description_zh: 编写查询、变更、动作和HTTP动作，并具备正确的参数校验、错误处理、内部函数及运行时考量。

description: HTTP Parameter Pollution (HPP): duplicate query/body keys parsed differently by servers, proxies, WAFs, and app frameworks. Use when filters and application layers disagree on which value wins, enabling bypass, SSRF second URL, logic abuse, or CSRF token confusion.
description_zh: HTTP 参数污染（HPP）：服务器、代理、WAF 和应用框架对重复的查询参数/请求体键以不同方式解析。在过滤器与应用层对哪个值生效存在分歧时使用，可引发绕过、SSRF 访问第二个 URL、逻辑滥用或 CSRF 令牌混淆。

description: Lightning Web Components with PICKLES methodology and 165-point scoring. Use this skill when the user creates or edits LWC components, builds wire service patterns, or writes Jest tests for LWC. TRIGGER when: user creates/edits LWC components, touches lwc/**/*.js, .html, .css, .js-meta.xml files, or asks about wire service, SLDS, or Jest LWC tests. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex classes (use generating-apex), Aura components, or Visualforce.
description_zh: 采用 PICKLES 方法论和 165 分评分制的 Lightning Web 组件（LWC）。当用户创建或编辑 LWC 组件、构建 wire service 模式，或为 LWC 编写 Jest 测试时，使用此技能。TRIGGER 触发条件：用户创建/编辑 LWC 组件，涉及 lwc/**/*.js、.html、.css、.js-meta.xml 文件，或询问 wire service、SLDS 或 Jest LWC 测试。DO NOT TRIGGER 不触发条件：Apex 类（使用 generating-apex）、Aura 组件或 Visualforce。

description: Implements document chunking, embedding generation, vector storage, and retrieval pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems. Use when building RAG applications, creating document Q&A systems, or integrating AI with knowledge bases.
description_zh: 实现检索增强生成（RAG）系统的文档分块、嵌入生成、向量存储和检索流水线。适用于构建 RAG 应用、创建文档问答系统，或将 AI 与知识库集成。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Node.js, Bun, and Deno. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Node.js", "add Sentry to Bun", "add Sentry to Deno", "install @sentry/node", "@sentry/bun", or "@sentry/deno", or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, profiling, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for server-side JavaScript/TypeScript runtimes.
description_zh: 完整的 Node.js、Bun 和 Deno 的 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求执行"为 Node.js 添加 Sentry"、"为 Bun 添加 Sentry"、"为 Deno 添加 Sentry"、"安装 @sentry/node"、"@sentry/bun"或"@sentry/deno"，或为服务端 JavaScript/TypeScript 运行时配置错误监控、链路追踪、日志记录、性能分析、指标、定时任务或 AI 监控时使用。

description: Provides patterns to build declarative AI Services with LangChain4j for LLM integration, chatbot development, AI agent implementation, and conversational AI in Java. Generates type-safe AI services using interface-based patterns, annotations, memory management, and tools integration. Use when creating AI-powered Java applications with minimal boilerplate, implementing conversational AI with memory, or building AI agents with function calling.
description_zh: 提供使用 LangChain4j 在 Java 中构建声明式 AI Services 的模式，支持 LLM 集成、聊天机器人开发、AI Agent 实现以及对话式 AI。利用基于接口的模式、注解、记忆管理以及工具集成，生成类型安全的 AI Services。适用于以最少样板代码创建由 AI 驱动的 Java 应用程序、利用记忆实现对话式 AI，或构建具备函数调用功能的 AI Agent 的场景。

description: Author or review AgentSkills: create, repair, validate, or restructure SKILL.md files and bundled resources.
description_zh: 编写或审查 AgentSkills：创建、修复、验证或重构 SKILL.md 文件及打包资源。

description: Insecure deserialization playbook. Use when Java, PHP, or Python applications deserialize untrusted data via ObjectInputStream, unserialize, pickle, or similar mechanisms that may lead to RCE, file access, or privilege escalation.
description_zh: 不安全的反序列化操作手册。当Java、PHP或Python应用程序通过ObjectInputStream、unserialize、pickle或类似机制反序列化不可信数据，可能引发RCE、文件访问或权限提升时，使用本手册。

description: Fetch GitHub issues, select candidates, spawn background fix agents, open PRs, and optionally process PR review comments.
description_zh: 获取 GitHub 问题，筛选候选者，生成后台修复代理，创建 Pull Request（PR），并可选地处理 PR 评审评论。

description: Set up the Discord channel — save the bot token and review access policy. Use when the user pastes a Discord bot token, asks to configure Discord, asks "how do I set this up" or "who can reach me," or wants to check channel status.
description_zh: 配置 Discord 频道——保存机器人令牌并审查访问权限。当用户粘贴 Discord 机器人令牌、请求配置 Discord、询问“如何设置”或“谁能联系到我”，或希望检查频道状态时使用。

description: Browser and V8 exploitation playbook. Use when exploiting JavaScript engine vulnerabilities including JIT type confusion, incorrect bounds elimination, and V8 sandbox bypass to achieve renderer RCE and sandbox escape in Chrome/Chromium.
description_zh: 浏览器与 V8 漏洞利用手册。用于利用 JavaScript 引擎漏洞（包括 JIT 类型混淆、错误边界消除和 V8 沙箱绕过）实现 Chrome/Chromium 渲染器 RCE 及沙箱逃逸时使用。

description: Archive existing wiki knowledge and rebuild from scratch, or restore from a previous archive. Use this skill when the user wants to start fresh, rebuild the wiki from all sources, archive current knowledge before a major change, or restore an older version. Triggers on "rebuild the wiki", "start over", "archive and rebuild", "restore from archive", "nuke and repave", "clean rebuild". Also use when the wiki has drifted too far from sources and incremental fixes won't cut it.
description_zh: 归档现有的 wiki 知识并从零重建，或从之前的归档中恢复。当用户希望全新开始、从所有来源重建 wiki、在重大变更前归档当前知识，或恢复旧版本时，使用此技能。触发条件包括“rebuild the wiki”、“start over”、“archive and rebuild”、“restore from archive”、“nuke and repave”、“clean rebuild”。当 wiki 与来源信息偏离过大、增量修复已不足以解决问题时，也使用此技能。

description: xurl CLI for authenticated X posts, replies, reads/search, DMs, media upload, followers, auth status, or raw v2 API calls.
description_zh: xurl CLI：用于已认证的X平台帖子、回复、阅读与搜索、私信、媒体上传、粉丝、认证状态，或原始v2 API调用的命令行工具。

description: Commit changes and push to origin without creating a PR
description_zh: 提交更改并推送到 origin，无需创建 PR。

description: Provides configuration patterns for LangChain4J vector stores in RAG applications. Use when building semantic search, integrating vector databases (PostgreSQL/pgvector, Pinecone, MongoDB, Milvus, Neo4j), implementing embedding storage/retrieval, setting up hybrid search, or optimizing vector database performance for production AI applications.
description_zh: 为RAG应用中的LangChain4J向量存储提供配置模式。适用于构建语义搜索、集成向量数据库（PostgreSQL/pgvector、Pinecone、MongoDB、Milvus、Neo4j）、实现嵌入存储与检索、搭建混合搜索，或为生产级AI应用优化向量数据库性能时使用。

"检查错误率", "查询指标", "检查内存使用率",
