或希望通过日志、指标、追踪信息、RUM或APM中的可观测性数据来回答相关问题。

description: Race condition and TOCTOU testing for web apps. Use when testing one-time operations, concurrent HTTP abuse, rate-limit bypass, Turbo Intruder gates, HTTP/2 single-packet attacks, and CWE-362-style synchronization gaps.
description_zh: Web应用的竞争条件与TOCTOU测试。用于测试一次性操作、并发HTTP滥用、绕过速率限制、Turbo Intruder 门控、HTTP/2 单包攻击以及CWE-362风格同步间隙等场景。

description: HTTP request smuggling and desynchronization testing. Use when front proxies, CDNs, or load balancers disagree with the origin on message framing (Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding), on HTTP/2→HTTP/1 translation, or when exploring client-side desync via browser fetch pipelines.
description_zh: HTTP 请求走私与脱同步测试。适用于前端代理、CDN 或负载均衡器与源站在消息分帧（Content-Length 与 Transfer-Encoding）上存在分歧、HTTP/2→HTTP/1 转换，或通过浏览器 fetch 管道探索客户端脱同步的场景。

description: Use when working with VueUse composables - track mouse position with useMouse, manage localStorage with useStorage, detect network status with useNetwork, debounce values with refDebounced, and access browser APIs reactively. Check VueUse before writing custom composables - most patterns already implemented.
description_zh: 在使用 VueUse 组合式函数时使用 - 使用 useMouse 追踪鼠标位置，使用 useStorage 管理 localStorage，使用 useNetwork 检测网络状态，使用 refDebounced 对值进行防抖，并响应式地访问浏览器 API。在编写自定义组合式函数之前，请先检查 VueUse - 大多数模式已经实现。

description: Provides LangChain4j patterns for implementing MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, creating Java AI tools, exposing tool calling capabilities, and integrating MCP clients with AI services. Use when building a Java MCP server, implementing tool calling in Java, connecting LangChain4j to external MCP servers, or securing tool exposure for agent workflows.
description_zh: 提供 LangChain4j 实现 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器、创建 Java AI 工具、暴露工具调用能力及集成 MCP 客户端与 AI 服务的模式。当构建 Java MCP 服务器、在 Java 中实现工具调用、将 LangChain4j 与外部 MCP 服务器连接，或保障智能体工作流中工具暴露的安全时使用。

description: 서울주택도시개발공사(SH) 공개 공고/공지 게시판에서 청약·주택 공고 목록, 상세 본문, 첨부 미리보기 메타데이터를 직접 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在首尔住宅都市开发公社（SH）公开公告/公告信息发布板上，可直接查询认购与住房公告列表、详细正文及附件预览元数据。在돌쇠中，可执行通过官方界面进行的后续操作。

description: Advanced Content Security Policy bypass techniques. Use when XSS or data exfiltration is blocked by CSP and you need to find policy weaknesses, trusted endpoint abuse, nonce leakage, or exfiltration channels that CSP cannot block.
description_zh: 高级内容安全策略绕过技术。当 XSS 或数据外泄被内容安全策略（CSP）阻断，且需要查找策略漏洞、可信端点滥用、nonce 泄露，或 CSP 无法阻断的外泄渠道时使用。

description: Symbolic execution and constraint solving playbook. Use when solving CTF reversing challenges, recovering keys, bypassing checks, or automating binary analysis with angr, Z3, or Unicorn Engine.
description_zh: 符号执行与约束求解操作手册。适用于破解 CTF 逆向挑战、恢复密钥、绕过检查，或使用 angr、Z3 或 Unicorn Engine 自动化二进制分析。

description: Provides Amazon S3 patterns and examples using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when working with S3 buckets, uploading/downloading objects, multipart uploads, presigned URLs, S3 Transfer Manager, object operations, or S3-specific configurations.
description_zh: 提供基于 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 的 Amazon S3 模式与示例。在操作 S3 存储桶、上传/下载对象、多部分上传、预签名 URL、S3 Transfer Manager、对象操作或 S3 特定配置时使用。

description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech with mac-style say UX.
description_zh: 具备 mac 风格 Say 用户体验的 ElevenLabs 文本转语音。

description: Manage Discord channel access — approve pairings, edit allowlists, set DM/group policy. Use when the user asks to pair, approve someone, check who's allowed, or change policy for the Discord channel.
description_zh: 管理Discord频道访问权限 — 批准配对、编辑允许列表、设置私信/群组策略。当用户要求配对、批准某人、查看授权人员或更改Discord频道策略时使用。

description: Provides unit test, integration test, and mock AI patterns for LangChain4j applications. Creates mock LLM responses, tests retrieval chains, validates RAG workflows, and implements Testcontainers-based integration tests for Java AI services. Use when unit testing AI services, integration testing LangChain4j components, mocking AI models, or testing LLM-based Java applications.
description_zh: 为 LangChain4j 应用程序提供单元测试、集成测试和模拟 AI 模式。创建模拟 LLM 响应，测试检索链，验证 RAG 工作流，并为 Java AI 服务实现基于 Testcontainers 的集成测试。适用于单元测试 AI 服务、集成测试 LangChain4j 组件、模拟 AI 模型或测试基于 LLM 的 Java 应用程序。

description: Open redirect playbook. Use when URL parameters, form actions, or JavaScript sinks control navigation targets and may redirect users to attacker-controlled destinations.
description_zh: 开放重定向操作手册。当 URL 参数、表单操作或 JavaScript 接收器控制跳转目标，并可能将用户重定向至攻击者控制的目的地时使用。

description: Source control and artifact exposure (.git, .svn, .hg, backups, .env). Use when recon finds VCS paths, 403 on hidden dirs, or backup/config leaks during authorized testing.
description_zh: 源码控制及制品暴露（.git、.svn、.hg、备份文件、.env）。当侦察发现 VCS 路径、隐藏目录出现 403 错误，或在授权测试期间发现备份/配置文件泄露时使用。

description: Provides Next.js App Router data fetching patterns including SWR and React Query integration, parallel data fetching, Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), revalidation strategies, and error boundaries. Use when implementing data fetching in Next.js applications, choosing between server and client fetching, setting up caching strategies, or handling loading and error states.
description_zh: 提供 Next.js App Router 的数据获取模式，包括 SWR 与 React Query 集成、并行数据获取、增量静态再生成（ISR）、重新验证策略和错误边界。用于在 Next.js 应用程序中实现数据获取、在服务器和客户端获取之间进行选择、设置缓存策略，或处理加载和错误状态。

description: Mobile SSL pinning bypass playbook. Use when intercepting HTTPS traffic from mobile applications that implement certificate pinning, public key pinning, or SPKI hash pinning on Android and iOS, including React Native, Flutter, and Xamarin frameworks.
description_zh: 移动端 SSL 证书固定绕过操作手册。适用于拦截在 Android 和 iOS 平台上实现证书固定、公钥固定或 SPKI 哈希固定的移动应用所产生的 HTTPS 流量，包括 React Native、Flutter 和 Xamarin 框架。

description: CRLF injection playbook. Use when user input reaches HTTP response headers, Location redirects, Set-Cookie values, or log files where carriage-return/line-feed characters can split or inject content.
description_zh: CRLF 注入操作手册。当用户输入会到达 HTTP 响应头、Location 重定向、Set-Cookie 值或日志文件，且回车符/换行符可能导致内容被拆分或注入时使用。

description: Web cache deception and poisoning playbook. Use when CDN, reverse proxy, or application caching may serve sensitive authenticated content to other users due to path confusion or cache key manipulation.
description_zh: Web缓存欺骗与投毒操作手册。当CDN、反向代理或应用缓存可能因路径混淆或缓存键篡改而向其他用户提供敏感认证内容时使用。

description: Supply-chain testing via package-manager dependency confusion: when internal package names resolve to attacker-controlled public registries, leading to malicious install and script execution. Use for npm/pip/gem/Maven/Composer/Docker manifest review and authorized red-team supply-chain exercises.
description_zh: 通过包管理器依赖混淆进行的供应链测试：当内部包名解析到攻击者控制的公共注册表时，会导致恶意安装和脚本执行。适用于 npm/pip/gem/Maven/Composer/Docker 清单审查及授权红队供应链演练。

description: Generate developer handoff specs from a design. Use when a design is ready for engineering and needs a spec sheet covering layout, design tokens, component props, interaction states, responsive breakpoints, edge cases, and animation details.
description_zh: 从设计生成开发者交接规范。当设计已准备好供工程使用，且需要一份涵盖布局、设计令牌、组件属性、交互状态、响应式断点、边界情况以及动画细节的规范表时使用。

description: Configure OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, metrics, and logging in ASP.NET Core using the .NET OpenTelemetry SDK. Use when adding observability, setting up OTLP exporters, creating custom metrics/spans, or troubleshooting distributed trace correlation.
description_zh: 使用 .NET OpenTelemetry SDK 在 ASP.NET Core 中配置 OpenTelemetry 分布式追踪、指标和日志。适用于添加可观测性、设置 OTLP 导出器、创建自定义指标/跨度或排查分布式追踪关联问题。

description: Build branching dialogue and narrative — a node/choice graph with conditions, variables, and localization hooks — and choose between authoring tools Ink and Yarn Spinner or a custom data-driven runner. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions dialogue system, branching dialogue, conversation tree, choices, Ink (.ink), Yarn Spinner (.yarn), or NPC dialogue.
description_zh: 构建分支对话与叙事——一个包含条件、变量和本地化钩子的节点/选项图谱——并选择使用编辑工具 Ink 和 Yarn Spinner，或自定义数据驱动运行器。引擎无关。当用户提及对话系统、分支对话、对话树、选项、Ink（.ink）、Yarn Spinner（.yarn）或 NPC 对话时使用。

description: Provides Amazon DynamoDB patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when creating, querying, scanning, or performing CRUD operations on DynamoDB tables, working with indexes, batch operations, transactions, or integrating with Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 提供基于 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 的 Amazon DynamoDB 模式。适用于在 DynamoDB 表上进行创建、查询、扫描或执行 CRUD 操作，以及使用索引、批处理操作、事务或集成 Spring Boot 应用时使用。

description: Use this skill when writing code, implementing features, refactoring, planning architecture, designing systems, reviewing code, or debugging. This skill transforms junior-level code into senior-engineer quality software through SOLID principles, TDD, clean code practices, and professional software design.
description_zh: 在编写代码、实现功能、重构、规划架构、设计系统、审查代码或调试时，使用此技能。该技能通过 SOLID 原则、测试驱动开发（TDD）、整洁代码实践以及专业软件设计，将初级代码提升至资深工程师级别的软件质量水平。

description: Research a target company and optionally a specific contact - company overview, recent news, likely priorities, and fit against your ICP. Cross-references existing CRM records. Use when the user asks to "research [company]", "look into [company]", "prospect research on [company]", "look up [person]", "intel on [prospect]", "who is [person] at [company]", or "tell me about [company]" when the company is a prospect rather than an existing account.
description_zh: 研究目标公司，并可选研究特定联系人——涵盖公司概述、近期新闻、可能优先事项，以及与您ICP（意图与客户画像）的匹配情况。与现有的CRM记录进行交叉参考。当用户询问以下内容，且该公司为潜在客户而非现有客户时，使用本功能：“研究[公司]”、“调查[公司]”、“对[公司]进行潜在客户研究”、“查询[人员]”、“获取[潜在客户]的资讯”、“[公司]中的[人员]是谁”、“告诉我关于[公司]的信息”。

description: Configures AWS WAF to filter web traffic: creating web access control lists (web ACLs) on CloudFront, Application Load Balancers, API Gateway, and AppSync; AWS Managed Rules tuned in Count mode; rate-based rules for HTTP floods; IP set and geographic match rules; Bot Control (Common and Targeted); turning bot labels into a confidence signal; stripping spoofed inbound x-amzn-waf-* headers; recovering the real client IP behind a CDN; Fraud Control (account takeover and account creation fraud prevention); and logging and request sampling. Use when the user wants to protect a web application or API from common exploits, bots, credential stuffing, fake-account creation, or HTTP floods at the application layer (layer 7). Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Do NOT use for L3/L4 DDoS protection (shieldadvanced skill), multi-account WAF rollout (firewallmanager skill), CloudFront configuration (cloudfront skill), or Route 53 health checks or records (route53 skill).
description_zh: 配置 AWS WAF 以过滤网页流量：在 CloudFront、应用负载均衡器、API Gateway 和 AppSync 上创建网页访问控制列表（Web ACLs）；将 AWS 托管规则调整为 Count 模式；为 HTTP 洪水设置基于速率的规则；设置 IP 集和地理匹配规则；启用机器人控制（常见目标和定向目标）；将机器人标签转化为置信度信号；剥离伪装入站的 x-amzn-waf-* 头部；恢复 CDN 背后的真实客户端 IP；启用欺诈控制（防范账户接管与账户创建欺诈）；以及日志记录与请求采样。当用户希望在应用层（第 7 层）保护 Web 应用或 API，以防范常见漏洞利用、机器人、凭证填充、虚假账户创建或 HTTP 洪水时使用。依据参考中的对应任务流程进行路由。不得用于 L3/L4 DDoS 防护（shieldadvanced 技能）、多账户 WAF 部署（firewallmanager 技能）、CloudFront 配置（cloudfront 技能）或 Route 53 健康检查与记录（route53 技能）。

description: HTTP Host header injection and routing abuse playbook. Use when the application trusts the Host header for generating URLs, routing requests, or access control — enabling password reset poisoning, web cache poisoning, SSRF via routing, and virtual host bypass.
description_zh: HTTP Host 请求头注入与路由滥用操作手册。适用于应用程序信任 Host 请求头以生成 URL、路由请求或进行访问控制的场景，可导致密码重置投毒、Web 缓存投毒、基于路由的 SSRF 以及虚拟主机绕过。

description: Export the Obsidian wiki's knowledge graph to structured formats for use in external tools. Use this skill when the user says "export wiki", "export graph", "export to JSON", "export to Gephi", "export to Neo4j", "export to Postgres", "export to SQL", "graphml", "visualize wiki", "knowledge graph export", "export to OKF", "OKF bundle", "open knowledge format", "export as markdown bundle", or wants to use their wiki data in another tool. Outputs graph.json, graph.graphml, cypher.txt (Neo4j), postgres.sql (Postgres), and graph.html (interactive browser visualization) into a wiki-export/ directory at the vault root, plus an optional OKF (Open Knowledge Format) markdown bundle under wiki-export/okf/.
description_zh: 将 Obsidian wiki 的知识图谱导出为结构化格式，供外部工具使用。当用户说“导出 wiki”、“导出图谱”、“导出为 JSON”、“导出到 Gephi”、“导出到 Neo4j”、“导出到 Postgres”、“导出为 SQL”、“graphml”、“可视化 wiki”、“知识图谱导出”、“导出为 OKF”、“OKF 包”、“开放知识格式（OKF）”、“导出为 Markdown 包”，或希望在其他工具中使用其 wiki 数据时，使用此技能。输出 graph.json、graph.graphml、cypher.txt（Neo4j）、postgres.sql（Postgres）以及 graph.html（交互式浏览器可视化）到 wiki-export/ 目录（位于仓库根目录），并在 wiki-export/okf/ 下生成可选的 OKF（开放知识格式）Markdown 包。

description: Reading coach: guides users through books systematically with knowledge compilation, mastery testing, spaced repetition, and knowledge querying. Use when user says 'read this book with me', 'book study', 'start studying X', 'reading plan', 'ingest this chapter', 'review what I read', 'quiz me on the book', 'what did the book say about X', or invokes /book-study. Supports sub-commands: ingest, query, review, compare, status. Triggers: book, study, read, chapter, ingest, review, quiz, reading plan, book notes.
description_zh: 阅读教练：通过知识汇编、掌握测试、间隔重复与知识查询，系统性地引导用户通读书籍。当用户说“与我一起读这本书”、“书籍学习”、“开始学习 X”、“阅读计划”、“摄入本章内容”、“复习我读过的内容”、“就这本书测验我”、“这本书关于 X 说了什么”，或调用 /book-study 时使用。支持子命令：摄入、查询、复习、对比、状态。触发词：书、学习、读、章节、摄入、复习、测验、阅读计划、读书笔记。

description: Get cryptocurrency market data. Get Binance AI analysis report. Get blockchain news updates.
description_zh: 获取加密货币市场数据。获取币安 AI 分析报告。获取区块链新闻更新。

description: Generate and edit images using Google's Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) API. Use when the user asks to generate, create, edit, modify, change, alter, or update images. Also use when user references an existing image file and asks to modify it in any way (e.g., "modify this image", "change the background", "replace X with Y"). Supports both text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing with configurable resolution (1K default, 2K, or 4K for high resolution). DO NOT read the image file first - use this skill directly with the --input-image parameter.
description_zh: 使用 Google 的 Nano Banana Pro（Gemini 3 Pro Image）API 生成和编辑图像。当用户要求生成、创建、编辑、修改、更改、调整或更新图像时使用。当用户引用现有图像文件并要求以任何方式修改图像时（例如："修改这张图像"、"更改背景"、"用 Y 替换 X"）也使用。支持文本到图像生成与图像到图像编辑，支持可配置分辨率（默认 1K，可选 2K 或 4K 以支持高分辨率）。请勿先读取图像文件，请直接使用该技能并配合 --input-image 参数使用。

description:
Parse a structured design brief written in I-Lang protocol format into a
concrete design spec. Eliminates ambiguity from vague requests like
"make it professional" by requiring explicit dimensions: palette, typography,
layout, mood, density, and constraints.
Trigger keywords: "design brief", "create a design brief", "ilang brief", "structured brief".
description_zh:
将采用 I-Lang 协议格式书写的结构化设计简报解析为具体的设计规范。通过要求明确的维度——色板、字体排版、版式、情绪、密度和约束条件，消除“让它专业”等模糊需求带来的歧义。
触发关键词：“设计简报”、“创建设计简报”、“I-Lang 简报”、“结构化简报”。

description: Expression Language injection playbook. Use when Java EL, SpEL, OGNL, or MVEL expressions may evaluate attacker-controlled input in Spring, Struts2, Confluence, or similar frameworks.
description_zh: 表达式语言注入操作手册。当Java EL、SpEL、OGNL或MVEL表达式可能在Spring、Struts2、Confluence等框架中对攻击者控制的输入进行求值时使用。

description:
High-level strategic thinking and business decision guidance for planning and direction-setting.
Use when: making strategic decisions, evaluating business options, setting direction, analyzing
trade-offs, or when user mentions strategy, business planning, competitive analysis, or long-term planning.
description_zh:
为规划与方向设定提供高层战略思维与业务决策指导。
使用场景：在制定战略决策、评估业务选项、设定方向、分析权衡，
或在用户提及策略、业务规划、竞争分析或长期规划时使用。

description: Provides patterns to configure AWS RDS (Aurora, MySQL, PostgreSQL) with Spring Boot applications. Configures HikariCP connection pools, implements read/write splitting, sets up IAM database authentication, enables SSL connections, and integrates with AWS Secrets Manager. Use when setting up RDS connections in Spring Boot, configuring connection pooling, or managing database credentials securely.
description_zh: 提供模式，用于配置 AWS RDS（Aurora、MySQL、PostgreSQL）与 Spring Boot 应用。可配置 HikariCP 连接池，实现读写分离，设置 IAM 数据库认证，启用 SSL 连接，并与 AWS Secrets Manager 集成。适用于在 Spring Boot 中设置 RDS 连接、配置连接池或安全地管理数据库凭证。

description: 오늘의집 공개 오늘의딜 페이지에서 로그인 없이 특가 상품을 조회하고 할인율, 가격, 리뷰, 링크를 정리하는 읽기 전용 스킬. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 这是一款在今日家居公开·今日特价页面中提供的只读技能，支持免登录查询特价商品，并整理折扣率、价格、评价及链接。在돌쇠中，亦支持通过官方界面进行后续操作。

description: Use when reading or writing React components (.tsx, .jsx files with React imports).
description_zh: 在阅读或编写 React 组件（.tsx、.jsx 文件，包含 React 导入）时使用。

description: Commit changes and create a pull request to the official upstream repo
description_zh: 提交更改，并向上游官方仓库创建拉取请求。

description: Animation patterns and best practices for Next.js/React applications. Use this skill when implementing animations, transitions, hover effects, page transitions, modals, or any motion in React components. Based on Emil Kowalski's "Animations on the Web" course.
description_zh: 适用于 Next.js/React 应用程序的动画模式与最佳实践。在为 React 组件实现动画、过渡、悬停效果、页面过渡、模态框或任何动态效果时，请使用本技能。该技能基于 Emil Kowalski 的《Web 动画》课程。

description: Diagnosis loop for bugs and failing behavior. Use when asked to debug or fix failing or slow behavior.
description_zh: 用于排查 bug 与失败行为的诊断循环。当被要求调试或修复失败或缓慢行为时使用。

description: Writing, exploit——把原始素材塑造成文章，一段一段地推进。
description_zh: 写作，利用——把原始素材塑造成文章，一段一段地推进。

description: Subdomain takeover detection and exploitation playbook. Use when targets have dangling CNAME/NS/MX records pointing to deprovisioned cloud resources, expired third-party services, or unclaimed SaaS tenants that an attacker can register to serve content under the victim's domain.
description_zh: 子域名接管检测与利用操作手册。当目标存在悬空的 CNAME/NS/MX 记录，指向已下线的云资源、已过期的第三方服务，或攻击者可注册并在受害者域名下提供内容的未占用 SaaS 租户时，使用本手册。

description: CSV/spreadsheet formula injection (DDE, Excel/LibreOffice, Google Sheets IMPORT*). Use when exports, imports, or user fields feed spreadsheets or reporting tools.
description_zh: CSV/电子表格公式注入（DDE、Excel/LibreOffice、Google Sheets IMPORT*）。适用于向电子表格或报表工具导入、导出或通过用户字段传入数据时。

description: Provides AWS Lambda patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when invoking Lambda functions, creating/updating functions, managing function configurations, working with Lambda layers, or integrating Lambda with Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 使用 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 提供 AWS Lambda 模式。适用于调用 Lambda 函数、创建/更新函数、管理函数配置、使用 Lambda 层，或集成 Lambda 与 Spring Boot 应用。

description: JNDI injection playbook. Use when Java applications perform JNDI lookups with attacker-controlled names, especially via Log4j2, Spring, or any code path reaching InitialContext.lookup().
description_zh: JNDI注入操作指南。用于Java应用使用攻击者控制的名称执行JNDI查找的情况，特别是通过Log4j2、Spring，或任何到达InitialContext.lookup()代码路径时。

description: 当用户或 Agent 需要通过同花顺金融数据服务获取、查询、同步、分析或导出 A 股行情、财报、估值、指数、板块、公募基金、期货、期权、特色数据或本地 DuckDB 数据，或需要选择、安装、配置、诊断 REST API、MCP、hithink-finance CLI、Python SDK/marketdb 时使用。
description_zh: 当用户或 Agent 需要通过同花顺金融数据服务获取、查询、同步、分析或导出 A股行情、财报、估值、指数、板块、公募基金、期货、期权、特色数据或本地 DuckDB 数据，或需要选择、安装、配置、诊断 REST API、MCP、hithink-finance CLI、Python SDK/marketdb 时使用。

description: Active Directory ACL abuse playbook. Use when exploiting misconfigured AD permissions including GenericAll, WriteDACL, DCSync rights, shadow credentials, LAPS reading, GPO abuse, and BloodHound-guided attack paths.
description_zh: 活动目录 ACL 滥用攻击手册。适用于利用配置错误的活动目录权限，包括 GenericAll、WriteDACL、DCSync 权限、影子凭据、LAPS 读取、GPO 滥用以及 BloodHound 引导的攻击路径。

description: Clickjacking playbook. Use when testing whether target pages can be framed, whether X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors are properly configured, and whether UI redress attacks can trigger sensitive actions.
description_zh: 点击劫持演练手册。用于测试目标页面是否可被嵌入框架、X-Frame-Options 或 CSP frame-ancestors 是否配置正确，以及 UI 伪装攻击是否能够触发敏感操作。

description: Guides the migration of existing AI workloads (Cloud Run, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) to self-hosted GKE inference using gcloud and kubectl. Use when the user has an existing AI inference workload (on Cloud Run, the Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, or a custom VM) and wants to move it to self-hosted inference on GKE, or asks follow-up questions during such a migration (hardware sizing, model staging, manifest generation, validation, traffic cutover). DO NOT use for brand new GKE inference deployments with no existing workload to migrate (use gke-inference instead). DO NOT use if the user intends to automate the migration via the Gemini Cloud Assist MCP server.
description_zh:
指导现有 AI 工作负载（Cloud Run、Gemini API、Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform）通过 gcloud 和 kubectl 迁移至自托管 GKE 推理。适用于以下场景：用户拥有现有 AI 推理工作负载（部署于 Cloud Run、Gemini API、Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 或自定义虚拟机中），并希望将其迁移至 GKE 自托管推理环境，或在迁移过程中提出相关问题（涉及硬件规模配置、模型暂存、清单生成、验证与流量切换等）。

请勿用于尚无待迁移工作负载的全新 GKE 推理部署（请改用 gke-inference）。若用户意图通过 Gemini Cloud Assist MCP 服务器自动化完成迁移，则请勿使用。

description:
Full-stack frontend development combining premium UI design, cinematic animations,
AI-generated media assets, persuasive copywriting, and visual art. Builds complete,
visually striking web pages with real media, advanced motion, and compelling copy.
Use when: building landing pages, marketing sites, product pages, dashboards,
generating media assets (image/video/audio/music), writing conversion copy,
creating generative art, or implementing cinematic scroll animations.
description_zh:
涵盖优质UI设计、电影级动画、AI生成媒体素材、说服力文案与视觉艺术的全栈前端开发。打造完整、视觉冲击力强的网页，拥有真实媒体素材、高级动态效果与有力文案。

适用场景：构建着陆页、营销站点、产品页面、仪表盘，生成媒体素材（图片/视频/音频/音乐），撰写转化文案，创作生成式艺术，或实现电影级滚动动画。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Apple platforms (iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS). Use when asked to "add Sentry to iOS", "add Sentry to Swift", "install sentry-cocoa", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, logging, or metrics for Apple applications. Supports SwiftUI and UIKit.
description_zh: 用于Apple平台（iOS、macOS、tvOS、watchOS、visionOS）的完整Sentry SDK设置。当被要求“为iOS添加Sentry”、“为Swift添加Sentry”或“安装sentry-cocoa”，或为Apple应用程序配置错误监控、追踪、性能分析、会话重放、日志或指标时使用。支持SwiftUI和UIKit。

description: Set up Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui themed UI with dark mode. Install deps, configure CSS variables via @theme inline, wire dark mode toggle, verify. Use whenever the user mentions Tailwind v4, setting up Tailwind theming, shadcn/ui colours, dark mode, or troubleshooting colours not working, tw-animate-css errors, @theme inline conflicts, @apply breaking after upgrade, or v3 → v4 migration issues.
description_zh: 设置 Tailwind v4 与 shadcn/ui 的主题化 UI（支持深色模式）。安装依赖，通过 @theme inline 配置 CSS 变量，接入深色模式切换开关，并完成验证。当用户提及 Tailwind v4、设置 Tailwind 主题、shadcn/ui 颜色、深色模式，或遇到颜色无法显示、tw-animate-css 错误、@theme inline 冲突、升级后 @apply 失效，以及 v3 → v4 的迁移问题时，使用此功能。

description: Writing, explore——挖掘原始 fragments，暂不施加任何结构。
description_zh: 写作，探索——挖掘原始碎片，暂不赋予任何结构。

description: Provides Amazon Bedrock patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Invokes foundation models (Claude, Llama, Titan), generates text and images, creates embeddings for RAG, streams real-time responses, and configures Spring Boot integration. Use when asking about Bedrock integration, Java SDK for AI models, AWS generative AI, Claude/Llama invocation, embeddings for RAG, or Spring Boot AI setup.
description_zh: 使用 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 提供 Amazon Bedrock 模式。调用基础模型（Claude、Llama、Titan），生成文本和图像，为 RAG 创建嵌入，流式传输实时响应，并配置 Spring Boot 集成。当询问 Amazon Bedrock 集成、用于 AI 模型的 Java SDK、AWS 生成式 AI、Claude/Llama 调用、用于 RAG 的嵌入，或 Spring Boot AI 配置时使用。

description: Provides AWS SDK for Java 2.x client configuration, credential resolution, HTTP client tuning, timeout, retry, and testing patterns. Use when creating or hardening AWS service clients, wiring Spring Boot beans, debugging auth or region issues, or choosing sync vs async SDK usage.
description_zh: 提供 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 客户端配置、凭证解析、HTTP 客户端调优、超时、重试及测试模式。适用于创建或加固 AWS 服务客户端、装配 Spring Boot Bean、调试身份验证或区域问题，或选择同步与异步 SDK 使用方式时使用。

description: When the user wants to design, optimize, or evaluate App Store screenshots and preview videos. Also use when the user mentions "screenshots", "app preview", "product page design", "screenshot design", "creative assets", or "what should my screenshots show". For A/B testing screenshots, see ab-test-store-listing. For full ASO audit, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、优化或评估 App Store 截图与预览视频时，使用本功能。当用户提及“截图”、“应用预览”、“产品页面设计”、“截图设计”、“创意素材”或“我的截图应该展示什么”时，也使用本功能。如需进行截图 A/B 测试，请参阅 ab-test-store-listing。如需进行全面的 ASO 审计，请参阅 aso-audit。

description: Generate professional investment reports for stocks and ETFs. Use when user requests market analysis, investment reports, stock analysis, or trading recommendations for financial instruments (SPY, AAPL, TSLA, etc.). Creates institutional-grade reports with technical indicators, AI-powered insights, charts, and investment recommendations.
description_zh: 为股票和ETF生成专业投资报告。当用户请求对金融工具（SPY、AAPL、TSLA等）进行市场分析、投资报告、股票分析或交易建议时使用。生成带有技术指标、AI驱动的洞察、图表和投资建议的机构级报告。

description: Research across Notion and synthesize into structured documentation; use when gathering info from multiple Notion sources to produce briefs, comparisons, or reports with citations.
description_zh: 在 Notion 中开展研究，并综合整理为结构化文档；用于从多个 Notion 来源收集信息，生成附带引用的简报、对比或报告。

description: Gemini CLI one-shot prompts, summaries, generation, skills, hooks, MCP, or Gemma routing.
description_zh: Gemini CLI 的一次性提示、摘要、生成、技能、钩子、MCP 或 Gemma 路由。

description: Draft a detailed privacy policy covering data types, jurisdiction, GDPR and compliance considerations, and clauses needing legal review. Use when creating a privacy policy, updating data protection documentation, or preparing for compliance.
description_zh: 起草一份详细的隐私政策，涵盖数据类型、管辖权、GDPR及合规考虑，以及需要法律审查的条款。适用于创建隐私政策、更新数据保护文档或准备合规时使用。

description: Fork a GitHub repo and clone it locally with proper remote setup
description_zh: Fork 一个 GitHub 仓库，并在本地使用正确的远程设置进行克隆。

description: Expert guidance for systematic backtesting of trading strategies. Use when developing, testing, stress-testing, or validating quantitative trading strategies. Covers "beating ideas to death" methodology, parameter robustness testing, slippage modeling, bias prevention, and interpreting backtest results. Applicable when user asks about backtesting, strategy validation, robustness testing, avoiding overfitting, or systematic trading development.
description_zh: 针对交易策略系统性回测的专家指导。在开发、测试、压力测试或验证量化交易策略时使用。涵盖“彻底检验想法”的方法论，参数稳健性测试，滑点建模，偏差预防，以及回测结果的解读。当用户询问回测、策略验证、稳健性测试、避免过拟合或系统化交易开发时适用。

description: Provides AWS Key Management Service (KMS) patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when creating/managing encryption keys, encrypting/decrypting data, generating data keys, digital signing, key rotation, or integrating encryption into Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 基于 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 提供 AWS Key Management Service（KMS）模式。适用于创建/管理加密密钥、加密/解密数据、生成数据密钥、数字签名、密钥轮换，或将加密集成到 Spring Boot 应用程序中的场景。

description: Provides AWS Secrets Manager patterns for AWS SDK for Java 2.x, including secret retrieval, caching, rotation-aware access, and Spring Boot integration. Use when storing or reading secrets in Java services, replacing hardcoded credentials, or wiring secret-backed configuration into applications.
description_zh: 为 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 提供 AWS Secrets Manager 模式，包括密钥获取、缓存、感知轮换的访问以及 Spring Boot 集成。适用于在 Java 服务中存储或读取密钥、替换硬编码凭据，或将密钥驱动的配置接入应用程序。

description: GoFrame v2 development skill. Use only when the target Go project uses or is explicitly adopting GoFrame v2: the nearest go.mod requires github.com/gogf/gf/v2, existing Go files import github.com/gogf/gf/v2 or any github.com/gogf/gf/v2/... component package, or the user asks to scaffold, migrate, or build with GoFrame. Trigger for GoFrame-backed Go work such as APIs/controllers/services, middleware, routing/config, ORM/DAO/DO/entity/database operations, gf CLI/codegen, HTTP/gRPC services, and microservice conventions. Do not trigger for generic Go projects without GoFrame evidence, frontend-only work, shell scripts, or unrelated infrastructure tasks.
description_zh: GoFrame v2 开发技能。仅在目标 Go 项目使用或明确采用 GoFrame v2 时使用：最近的 go.mod 包含 github.com/gogf/gf/v2 依赖，现有 Go 文件导入 github.com/gogf/gf/v2 或任何 github.com/gogf/gf/v2/... 组件包，或用户要求使用 GoFrame 进行脚手架搭建、迁移或构建。适用于基于 GoFrame 支持的 Go 开发工作，如 API/控制器/服务、中间件、路由/配置、ORM/DAO/DO/实体/数据库操作、gf CLI/代码生成、HTTP/gRPC 服务以及微服务规范。不适用于缺乏 GoFrame 证据的通用 Go 项目、仅前端工作、Shell 脚本，或不相关的基础设施任务。

description: Core Redis modeling guidance — choose the right data structure (String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set, JSON, Stream, Vector Set) and use consistent colon-separated key names. Use when designing a Redis data model, caching objects, deciding between Hash and JSON, building counters, leaderboards, membership sets, or session stores, or when reviewing/cleaning up Redis key naming.
description_zh:
核心 Redis 建模指南——选择合适的数据类型（String、Hash、List、Set、Sorted Set、JSON、Stream、Vector Set），并使用一致的冒号分隔键名。

适用于 Redis 数据模型设计、缓存对象设计、在 Hash 与 JSON 之间进行选择、构建计数器、构建排行榜、创建成员集合或会话存储，以及审查或清理 Redis 键名等场景。

description: Choose the right metrics for a LaunchDarkly experiment, guarded rollout, or release policy. Use when the user wants to know which metrics to use, which is the primary metric for an experiment, what guardrails to add, or which events to monitor in a rollout. Surfaces what will auto-attach from existing release policies before making additional recommendations.
description_zh: 为 LaunchDarkly 实验、受控发布或发布策略选择合适的指标。当用户需要了解应使用哪些指标、实验的主要指标是什么、需要添加哪些护栏，或在发布过程中需监控哪些事件时使用本功能。在提供额外建议之前，展示基于现有发布策略将自动关联的内容。

description: Kerberos attack playbook for Active Directory. Use when targeting AD authentication via AS-REP roasting, Kerberoasting, golden/silver/diamond tickets, delegation abuse, or pass-the-ticket attacks.
description_zh: Active Directory Kerberos 攻击方案手册。适用于通过 AS-REP 投喂、Kerberos 投喂攻击（Kerberoasting）、黄金/白银/钻石票据、委派滥用或票据传递攻击对 Active Directory 认证进行攻击时使用。

description: Summarize weekly GitHub contributions for writing weekly reports
description_zh: 总结每周GitHub贡献，用于撰写每周报告

description: Provides AWS messaging patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x for SQS queues and SNS topics. Handles sending/receiving messages, FIFO queues, DLQ, subscriptions, and pub/sub patterns. Use when implementing messaging with SQS or SNS.
description_zh: 提供基于AWS SDK for Java 2.x的SQS队列与SNS主题消息模式。涵盖消息发送/接收、FIFO队列、死信队列（DLQ）、订阅及发布/订阅模式。在基于SQS或SNS实现消息通信时使用。

description: SAML SSO assertion attack playbook. Use when testing signature validation, assertion wrapping, audience restrictions, ACS handling, XML trust boundaries, and enterprise SSO flaws.
description_zh: SAML SSO 断言攻击演练手册。用于测试签名验证、断言包装、受众限制、ACS 处理、XML 信任边界及企业 SSO 缺陷。

description: Writing, exploit——把原始素材组装成一段节拍旅程，在某个 beat 依赖一个术语之前先把它 grounded。
description_zh: 写作，利用——把原始素材组装成一段节拍旅程，在某个节拍依赖某个术语之前，先把它夯实。

description: Hash attack playbook. Use when exploiting length extension, MD5/SHA1 collisions, HMAC timing leaks, birthday attacks, or hash-based proof of work in CTF and authorized testing scenarios.
description_zh: 哈希攻击手册。在 CTF 及授权测试场景中，用于利用长度扩展、MD5/SHA1 碰撞、HMAC 时序泄漏、生日攻击或基于哈希的工作量证明。

description: HTTP/2 protocol-specific attack playbook. Use when the target supports HTTP/2 and you need to exploit binary framing, HPACK compression, h2c upgrade smuggling, pseudo-header injection, stream multiplexing abuse, or H2→H1 downgrade translation flaws.
description_zh: HTTP/2 协议特定攻击剧本。当目标支持 HTTP/2，且您需要利用二进制分帧、HPACK 压缩、h2c 升级走私、伪头注入、流多路复用滥用，或 H2→H1 降级转换缺陷时使用。

description: Provides AWS RDS (Relational Database Service) management patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when creating, modifying, monitoring, or managing Amazon RDS database instances, snapshots, parameter groups, and configurations.
description_zh: 提供基于 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 的 AWS RDS（关系型数据库服务）管理模式。用于创建、修改、监控或管理 Amazon RDS 数据库实例、快照、参数组和配置。

description: Scaffold a minimal local LangChain agent in Python by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangChain agent locally.
description_zh: 按照官方快速入门指南，在Python中搭建一个极简的本地LangChain智能体。当用户想要快速在本地构建或试用LangChain智能体时使用。

description: 飞书/Lark 官方 MCP 集成。支持发送消息、创建群组、操作多维表格（Bitable）、导入/搜索文档、知识库查询。触发词：飞书、Feishu、Lark、多维表格、bitable、飞书文档、飞书群。
description_zh: 飞书/Lark 官方 MCP 集成。支持发送消息、创建群组、操作多维表格（Bitable）、导入/搜索文档、知识库查询。触发词：飞书、Feishu、Lark、多维表格、bitable、飞书文档、飞书群。

description: Troubleshoots Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform issues (Agent Gateway, Registry, Identity, Policies, Model Armor, Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP)). Use when agent requests fail with 403 (especially unauthorized egress), Agent Runtime queries return 500, or gateway/IAP logs show permission errors. Don't use for general Google Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) debugging or networking issues unrelated to the Agent Platform stack.
description_zh: 排查 Google Cloud Gemini 企业智能体平台问题（Agent 网关、注册中心、身份认证、策略、模型防护（Model Armor）、身份感知代理（IAP））。当智能体请求因 403 错误（尤其是未授权出站）而失败、智能体运行时查询返回 500 错误，或网关/IAP 日志显示权限错误时使用。请勿用于排查与智能体平台无关的通用 Google Cloud 身份与访问管理（IAM）或网络问题。

description: AD Certificate Services attack playbook. Use when targeting misconfigured AD CS for privilege escalation via ESC1-ESC13 template abuse, NTLM relay to enrollment, CA officer abuse, and certificate-based persistence.
description_zh: AD证书服务攻击演练指南。用于针对配置不当的AD证书服务进行权限提升，通过滥用ESC1-ESC13模板、NTLM向注册中心转发、CA管理员滥用以及基于证书的持久化。

description: Check GitHub notifications and recent Issues/PRs for monitored repos
description_zh: 检查受监控仓库的 GitHub 通知及最近 Issue/PRs。

description: CRITICAL: Use for performance optimization. Triggers: performance, optimization, benchmark, profiling, flamegraph, criterion, slow, fast, allocation, cache, SIMD, make it faster, 性能优化, 基准测试
description_zh: 关键：用于性能优化。触发词：性能、优化、基准测试、性能剖析、火焰图、Criterion、慢、快、分配、缓存、SIMD、使其更快、性能优化、基准测试

description: Always use this skill when the task involves writing, reviewing, or editing files in the `/docs` directory or any `.md` files in the repository.
description_zh: 当任务涉及编写、审查或编辑 `/docs` 目录或仓库中的任何 `.md` 文件时，始终使用此技能。

description: Performs comprehensive C/C++ security review for memory corruption, integer overflows, race conditions, and platform-specific vulnerabilities. Use when auditing native C/C++ applications, reviewing daemons or services for memory safety, or hunting integer overflow / use-after-free / race conditions in userspace code.
description_zh: 针对内存损坏、整数溢出、竞态条件及平台特定漏洞，进行全面的 C/C++ 安全审查。适用于审计原生 C/C++ 应用程序、审查守护进程或服务的内存安全性，或在用户态代码中查找整数溢出、释放后使用及竞态条件。

description: Linux privilege escalation playbook. Use when you have low-privilege shell access and need to escalate to root via SUID/SGID binaries, capabilities, cron abuse, kernel exploits, misconfigurations, or credential harvesting on Linux systems.
description_zh: Linux 权限提升操作手册。当你在 Linux 系统上拥有低权限 shell 访问权限，需要通过 SUID/SGID 二进制文件、能力（capabilities）、cron 滥用、内核漏洞利用、配置错误或凭据收集等方式提升到 root 权限时使用。

description: Sync local main branch with the latest code from official upstream or origin remote
description_zh: 将本地 main 分支与来自官方上游或 origin 远程的最新代码同步。

description: Reviewer-style audit and submission gate for academic papers in .tex, .typ, or .pdf. Use for peer-review critique, readiness/gate decisions, blocker triage, revision roadmaps, journal-style reports, re-audits, and under-claim / self-weakening prose signals. Do not use for source editing, sentence polishing, bibliography search, or compile repair.
description_zh: 用于.tex、.typ或.pdf格式学术论文的审稿风格审计与投稿闸门。用于同行评审点评、就绪/闸门决策、阻塞问题分诊、修订路线图、期刊风格报告、重新审计以及低估/自我弱化行文信号。不可用于源文件编辑、句子润色、参考文献检索或编译修复。

description: Swap or trade tokens on Base or Polygon. Use when you or the user want to trade, swap, exchange, buy, sell, or convert between tokens like USDC, ETH, and POL. Covers phrases like "buy ETH", "sell ETH for USDC", "convert USDC to ETH", "get some ETH", "buy POL".
description_zh: 在 Base 或 Polygon 上交换或交易代币。适用于您需要或用户想要在 USDC、ETH 和 POL 等代币之间进行交易、交换、兑换、买入、卖出或转换的场景。覆盖类似“购买 ETH”、“以 USDC 卖出 ETH”、“将 USDC 转换为 ETH”、“获取一些 ETH”、“购买 POL”等短语。

description: Create a LaunchDarkly metric that measures what matters for an experiment or rollout. Use when the user wants to create a metric, track an event, measure page views, button clicks, conversion, latency, error rate, or any custom numeric or binary outcome. Instruments the event first when needed (including SDK setup and .env), then creates and verifies the metric.
description_zh: 创建用于实验或推广中衡量关键指标的 LaunchDarkly 指标。当用户需要创建指标、跟踪事件、衡量页面浏览量、按钮点击次数、转化率、延迟、错误率，或任何自定义数值或二值结果时使用。在需要时先记录事件（包括 SDK 配置和 .env），然后创建并验证指标。

description: Unified wiki-history-ingest entrypoint for conversation/session sources. Use this when the user says "/wiki-history-ingest claude", "/wiki-history-ingest copilot", "/wiki-history-ingest codex", "/wiki-history-ingest pi", or asks to ingest agent history without naming the underlying skill. This router dispatches to the specialized history skill.
description_zh: 对话/会话来源的统一 wiki-history-ingest 入口点。当用户说 "/wiki-history-ingest claude"、"/wiki-history-ingest copilot"、"/wiki-history-ingest codex"、"/wiki-history-ingest pi"，或要求摄入代理历史记录但未指定底层技能时，使用此入口。该路由器会将请求分派至专门的 history 技能。

description: Create, search, and manage Bear notes via grizzly CLI.
description_zh: 通过 grizzly CLI 创建、搜索和管理 Bear 笔记。

description: Arbitrary write to RCE playbook. Use when you have an arbitrary write primitive (from heap exploitation, format string, or OOB write) and need to convert it into code execution by targeting GOT, hooks, _IO_FILE vtable, exit_funcs, TLS_dtor_list, modprobe_path, .fini_array, or C++ vtables.
description_zh: 任意写至远程代码执行（RCE）操作手册。当您拥有任意写原语（来自堆利用、格式字符串或越界写），且需要将其转化为代码执行时，通过针对 GOT、钩子、_IO_FILE vtable、exit_funcs、TLS_dtor_list、modprobe_path、.fini_array 或 C++ vtables 进行利用，即可使用本手册。

description: Instrument a LaunchDarkly metric event in a codebase by adding a track() call. Use when the user wants to wire up an event, instrument an action for a metric, add tracking to a feature, or confirm that an event is flowing to LaunchDarkly.
description_zh: 通过添加 track() 调用，在代码库中插桩一个 LaunchDarkly 度量事件。当用户需要挂接事件、为度量插桩操作、为功能添加追踪，或确认事件已流向 LaunchDarkly 时使用。

description: AI/ML security playbook. Use when assessing model supply chain attacks (pickle RCE, poisoned weights), adversarial examples, model poisoning, model stealing, data privacy attacks (membership inference, model inversion), and autonomous agent security risks.
description_zh: AI/ML 安全操作手册。用于评估模型供应链攻击（pickle 远程代码执行、被污染的权重）、对抗样本、模型投毒、模型窃取、数据隐私攻击（成员推断、模型逆推），以及自主智能体安全风险。

description: Generate complete, accessible colour palettes from a single brand hex. Produces 11-shade scale (50-950), semantic tokens, dark mode variants, Tailwind v4 CSS output, WCAG contrast checks. Use whenever the user supplies a brand hex and asks for a palette, mentions setting up a design system, wants Tailwind theme colours from a brand colour, or asks to check colour accessibility / contrast.
description_zh: 从单个品牌十六进制色值生成完整、可访问的颜色调色板。生成 11 色调色板梯度（50–950）、语义化令牌、暗黑模式变体、Tailwind v4 CSS 输出，以及 WCAG 对比度检查。当用户提供品牌十六进制色值并要求生成调色板、提及搭建设计系统、希望从品牌色获取 Tailwind 主题色，或要求检查颜色可访问性/对比度时，即可使用。

description: DNS rebinding attack playbook. Use when testing applications that trust DNS resolution for origin checks, interact with internal services from browser context, or when SSRF is not possible server-side but the target has client-side fetch/XHR to attacker-controlled domains.
description_zh: DNS重绑定攻击操作手册。适用于测试依赖DNS解析进行源点检查的应用程序，在浏览器上下文中与内部服务交互，或在服务端无法实施SSRF攻击，但目标存在客户端fetch/XHR可访问攻击者控制的域名时使用。

description: Prototype pollution testing for JavaScript stacks. Use when user input is merged into objects (query parsers, JSON bodies, deep assign), when configuring libraries via untrusted keys, or when hunting RCE gadgets via polluted Object.prototype in Node or the browser.
description_zh: JavaScript 栈的原型污染测试。用于在用户输入被合并到对象（查询解析器、JSON 请求体、深层赋值）时，通过不可信键配置库时，或在 Node 或浏览器中通过被污染的对象原型寻找 RCE 漏洞组件时。

description: AV/EDR evasion playbook for Windows. Use when bypassing AMSI, ETW, .NET assembly detection, shellcode execution, process injection, API hooking, and signature-based detection on Windows endpoints.
description_zh: Windows 下的 AV/EDR 规避手册。适用于在 Windows 端点上绕过 AMSI、ETW、.NET 程序集检测、shellcode 执行、进程注入、API 钩子以及基于签名的检测。

description: Capture frames or clips from RTSP/ONVIF cameras and local webcams, including USB pan/tilt/zoom control.
description_zh: 捕获来自RTSP/ONVIF摄像机及本地网络摄像机的帧或片段，包括USB云台/变焦控制。

description: Sets up and configures the Unity AI Navigation system — NavMesh surfaces, NavMesh agents, obstacles, links, modifiers, areas and costs. Use when creating walkable navigation meshes, adding pathfinding agents, setting up patrol routes, configuring obstacle avoidance and carving, connecting separate NavMeshes with links, coupling navigation with animation, or troubleshooting navigation issues.
description_zh: 设置并配置 Unity AI 导航系统——导航网格表面、导航网格代理、障碍物、链接、修饰符、区域和代价。当需要创建可行走的导航网格、添加寻路代理、设置巡逻路线、配置障碍物避让与雕刻、通过链接连接多个独立的导航网格、将导航与动画耦合，或排查导航问题时使用。

description: DeFi attack pattern playbook. Use when analyzing flash loan attacks, price oracle manipulation, MEV sandwich attacks, governance exploits, bridge vulnerabilities, and token standard edge cases in decentralized finance protocols.
description_zh: DeFi攻击模式操作手册。在分析去中心化金融协议中的闪贷攻击、价格预言机操纵、MEV三明治攻击、治理利用漏洞、跨链桥漏洞以及代币标准边界情况时使用。

description: Create editorial-style information cards using HTML/CSS in Markdown. Best for knowledge summaries, data highlights, event announcements, and single-topic content cards with magazine-quality typography.
description_zh: 使用 Markdown 中的 HTML/CSS 创建编辑风格的资讯卡片。最适合知识摘要、数据亮点、活动公告，以及具有杂志级排版质感、单主题的内容卡片。

description: Dangling markup injection playbook. Use when HTML injection is possible but JavaScript execution is blocked (CSP, sanitizer strips event handlers, WAF blocks script tags) — exfiltrate CSRF tokens, session data, and page content by injecting unclosed HTML tags that capture subsequent page content.
description_zh: 悬空标记注入操作手册。在可进行 HTML 注入但 JavaScript 执行被阻止（CSP、清洗器剥离事件处理器、WAF 阻止 script 标签）时使用——通过注入未闭合的 HTML 标签截获后续页面内容，窃取 CSRF token、会话数据和页面内容。

description: SOQL query generation, optimization, and analysis with 100-point scoring. Use this skill when the user needs SOQL/SOSL authoring or optimization: natural-language-to-query generation, relationship queries, aggregates, query-plan analysis, and performance or safety improvements for Salesforce queries. TRIGGER when: user writes, optimizes, or debugs SOQL/SOSL queries, touches .soql files, or asks about relationship queries, aggregates, or query performance. DO NOT TRIGGER when: bulk data operations (use handling-sf-data), Apex DML logic (use generating-apex), or report/dashboard queries.
description_zh:
**100分制SOQL查询生成、优化与分析**

当用户需要SOQL/SOSL编写或优化时使用此技能：自然语言转查询生成、关联查询、聚合查询、查询计划分析，以及Salesforce查询的性能或安全性优化。

**触发条件**：当用户编写、优化或调试SOQL/SOSL查询、涉及.soql文件，或询问关于关联查询、聚合或查询性能时触发。

**请勿触发条件**：批量数据操作（使用handling-sf-data）、Apex DML逻辑（使用generating-apex），或报告/仪表盘查询。

description: Create cloud provider architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with official AWS, Azure, GCP, and Alibaba Cloud service icons. Best for multi-service cloud topologies and migration blueprints.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 语法和官方 AWS、Azure、GCP 及阿里云服务图标创建云提供商架构图，最适合多服务云拓扑结构和迁移蓝图。

description: Optimizes Unity 6 WebGL and WebGPU builds for smaller download size, faster initial load, and efficient browser runtime performance. Use when the user's web build is too large, stutters in a specific browser, consumes excessive battery, needs CDN/server compression configured, or needs guidance on resource stripping, shader variant reduction, KTX textures, quality settings, or web profiling.
description_zh:
优化 Unity 6 WebGL 与 WebGPU 构建，以提供更小的下载体积、更快的初始加载速度和高效的浏览器运行时性能。

当用户使用的 Web 构建体积过大、在特定浏览器中出现卡顿、消耗过多电量、需要配置 CDN/服务器压缩，或需要关于资源剥离、着色器变体减少、KTX 纹理、质量设置或 Web 性能分析的指导时使用。

description: Network protocol attack playbook. Use when exploiting layer 2/3 protocols including ARP spoofing, LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS poisoning, WPAD abuse, DHCPv6 attacks, VLAN hopping, STP manipulation, DNS spoofing, IPv6 attacks, and IDS/IPS evasion.
description_zh: 网络协议攻击手册。用于利用二层/三层协议进行攻击，包括ARP欺骗、LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS中毒攻击、WPAD滥用、DHCPv6攻击、VLAN跳转、STP操纵、DNS欺骗、IPv6攻击以及IDS/IPS规避。

description: Configure and troubleshoot Google Cloud cross-project centralized logging and read-time aggregation. Use when: - Setting up log routing from multiple projects/folders/organizations to a central log bucket. - Creating cross-project log sinks and configuring central log buckets. - Troubleshooting cross-project routing. Don't use for single-project basic configurations.
description_zh:
配置并排查 Google Cloud 跨项目集中日志与读取时聚合。适用场景：
- 将来自多个项目/文件夹/组织的日志路由至中心日志存储桶。
- 创建跨项目日志接收器并配置中心日志存储桶。
- 排查跨项目路由问题。
不适用于单项目基础配置。

description: Generate spectrograms and feature-panel visualizations from audio with the songsee CLI.
description_zh: 使用 songsee CLI 从音频生成频谱图与特征面板可视化。

description:
Encrypted backup and restore for OpenClaw Agent workspace files
(SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md). Uses
tar + openssl (AES-256-CBC) encryption and soul-upload.com API.
Auto-generates a new random password for each backup (DO NOT reuse
passwords). Use when the user needs to: (1) Back up or upload agent
workspace files, (2) Restore or download a previous backup, (3) Delete
a backup from remote storage, or (4) Manage encrypted agent persistence.
description_zh:
OpenClaw Agent工作区文件的加密备份与恢复
（SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md）。使用 tar + openssl (AES-256-CBC) 加密和 soul-upload.com API。
每次备份自动生成新的随机密码（请勿复用密码）。当用户需要以下操作时使用：（1）备份或上传代理工作区文件，（2）恢复或下载先前备份，（3）从远程存储删除备份，或（4）管理加密代理持久化。

description: XSLT injection testing: processor fingerprinting, XXE and document() SSRF, EXSLT write primitives, PHP/Java/.NET extension RCE surfaces. Use when user-controlled XSLT/stylesheet input or transform endpoints are in scope.
description_zh: XSLT注入测试：处理器指纹识别、XXE与document() SSRF、EXSLT写入原语、PHP/Java/.NET扩展远程代码执行（RCE）攻击面。当用户可控的XSLT/样式表输入或转换端点处于覆盖范围内时使用。

description: Provides comprehensive patterns for deploying Next.js applications to production. Use when configuring Docker containers, setting up GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, managing environment variables, implementing preview deployments, or setting up monitoring and logging for Next.js applications. Covers standalone output, multi-stage Docker builds, health checks, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and production best practices.
description_zh: 提供 Next.js 应用部署到生产环境的全面模式。在配置 Docker 容器、设置 GitHub Actions CI/CD 流水线、管理环境变量、实现预览部署，或为 Next.js 应用配置监控与日志记录时使用。涵盖独立产物输出、多阶段 Docker 构建、健康检查、OpenTelemetry 插桩以及生产环境最佳实践。

description: AI creative director with recursive self-assessment: 20+ methodologies (SIT, TRIZ, Bisociation, SCAMPER, Synectics), 3-axis evaluation calibrated against Cannes/D&AD/HumanKind, 5-phase process from brief to presentation.
description_zh: 具备递归式自我评估的AI创意总监：20余种方法论（SIT、TRIZ、Bisociation、SCAMPER、Synectics）、对照戛纳/D&AD/HumanKind校准的三轴评估、从简报到展示的五阶段流程。

description: Limit-order strategy trading on OKX Agentic Wallet. Use this skill when the user wants to place a price-triggered limit order (buy a dip, take profit, stop loss, chase a high), cancel one or more pending orders, list active or historical orders, or resume orders that have been suspended by SA TEE upgrades. Distinct from okx-dex-swap (market orders, immediate execution at the best available aggregated price). Strategy orders are stored on the Agentic Wallet TEE and execute automatically when the user-defined trigger fires. Trigger phrases: limit order, place limit order, buy at price, sell when price reaches, take profit at, stop loss at, chase high, buy dip, cancel order, cancel all orders, my orders, list orders, active orders, suspended orders, resume orders, recover suspended orders, trader mode, agentic limit order.
description_zh: 在 OKX Agentic Wallet 上使用限价单策略交易。当用户需要挂价格触发的限价单（如买入回调、止盈、止损、追高）、取消一个或多个待执行订单、列出活跃订单或历史订单，或恢复因 SA TEE 升级而暂停的订单时，请使用此技能。该技能与 okx-dex-swap（市价单，以最优可用聚合价格立即执行）不同。策略订单存储在 Agentic Wallet TEE 中，并在用户定义的触发条件触发时自动执行。触发短语：限价单、挂限价单、按价格买入、价格达到时卖出、达到止盈点时、达到止损点时、追高、买入回调、取消订单、取消所有订单、我的订单、列出订单、活跃订单、暂停订单、恢复订单、恢复暂停订单、交易模式、Agentic 限价单。

description: Help users transform abstract ideas into actionable project specs that align engineering and design teams on the problem and success metrics.
description_zh: 帮助用户将抽象想法转化为可执行的项目规格，使工程团队与设计团队对问题与成功指标达成共识。

description: Use when the deliverable is WordPress Playground Blueprint JSON or a Blueprint bundle, including creating, editing, reviewing, validating schema keys, choosing steps/resources, and debugging Blueprint files. For only running or sharing a Playground environment, use wp-playground.
description_zh: 当交付物为 WordPress 沙盒蓝图 JSON 或蓝图包时使用，包括创建、编辑、审查、验证模式键、选择步骤/资源以及调试蓝图文件。仅用于运行或分享沙盒环境时，请使用 wp-playground。

description: PHP type juggling and weak comparison (`==`) bypass. Use when authentication, HMAC/signature checks, or token validation uses loose equality, numeric coercion, or hash comparisons without strict types — common in legacy PHP and CTF-style code paths.
description_zh: PHP 类型转换与弱比较（`==`）绕过。当认证、HMAC/签名校验或令牌验证中使用松散相等比较、数值强制转换或哈希比较且未启用严格类型时使用——常见于遗留 PHP 及 CTF 风格代码路径。

description: Linux lateral movement playbook. Use after gaining initial access to pivot across Linux hosts via SSH hijacking, credential harvesting, internal pivoting, D-Bus exploitation, sudo token reuse, and shared filesystem abuse.
description_zh: Linux横向移动手册。在获得初始访问权限后，通过SSH劫持、凭证收集、内部横向移动、D-Bus利用、sudo令牌复用和共享文件系统滥用等手段，在Linux主机间进行横向移动。

description: Windows local privilege escalation playbook. Use when you have low-privilege shell access on Windows and need to escalate via token abuse, Potato exploits, service misconfigurations, DLL hijacking, UAC bypass, or registry autoruns.
description_zh: Windows 本地权限提升操作手册。适用于拥有 Windows 低权限 Shell 访问权限，且需要通过令牌滥用、Potato 漏洞利用、服务配置错误、DLL 劫持、UAC 绕过或注册表自启动提升权限的情况。

description: Email header injection and spoofing playbook. Use when testing contact forms, email APIs, password reset flows, or any feature that constructs SMTP messages with user-controlled fields. Covers CRLF injection in headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC bypass, and phishing amplification.
description_zh: 邮件头注入与伪造手册。用于测试联系表单、电子邮件API、密码重置流程，或任何使用用户可控字段构建SMTP消息的功能。涵盖头部中的CRLF注入、SPF/DKIM/DMARC绕过，以及钓鱼欺骗放大。

description: Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks. Trigger with "what are the risks", "risk assessment", "risk register", "what could go wrong", or when the user is evaluating risks associated with a project, vendor, process, or decision.
description_zh: 识别、评估和减轻运营风险。触发场景：当用户使用“有哪些风险”、“风险评估”、“风险登记册”、“可能出错的情况”，或评估与项目、供应商、流程或决策相关的风险时。

description: Salesforce debug log analysis and troubleshooting with 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user analyzes debug logs, hits governor limits, reads stack traces, or touches .log files from Salesforce orgs. DO NOT TRIGGER when: running Apex tests (use running-apex-tests), generating or fixing Apex code (use generating-apex), or Agentforce session tracing (use observing-agentforce).
description_zh:
带100分评分的Salesforce调试日志分析与故障排除。

触发条件：用户分析调试日志、触发 governor 限制、读取堆栈跟踪，或处理来自 Salesforce 组织的 .log 文件。

不触发条件：运行 Apex 测试（使用 running-apex-tests）、生成或修复 Apex 代码（使用 generating-apex），或进行 Agentforce 会话追踪（使用 observing-agentforce）。

description: Scaffold a minimal local Deep Agent in Python by following the official quickstart, using provider-native web search instead of Tavily. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a Deep Agent locally.
description_zh: 遵循官方快速开始指南，使用提供商原生的网络搜索（而非 Tavily），在 Python 中搭建一个最小化的本地深度智能体。适用于用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试深度智能体的情况。

description: BluOS CLI (blu) for discovery, playback, grouping, and volume.
description_zh: BluOS CLI（blu）用于发现、播放、分组和音量。

description: Container escape playbook. Use when operating inside a Docker container, LXC, or Kubernetes pod and need to escape to the host via privileged mode, capabilities, Docker socket, cgroup abuse, namespace tricks, or runtime vulnerabilities.
description_zh:
容器逃逸手册。

适用于在 Docker 容器、LXC 或 Kubernetes Pod 中操作，且需要通过特权模式、能力、Docker 套接字、cgroup 滥用、命名空间技巧或运行时漏洞逃逸至主机的场景。

description: Apply VueUse composables where appropriate to build concise, maintainable Vue.js / Nuxt features.
description_zh: 酌情应用 VueUse 组合式函数，构建简洁、易于维护的 Vue.js / Nuxt 特性。

description: Classical cipher analysis playbook. Use when encountering substitution ciphers, Vigenere, transposition, XOR, or encoded text in CTF challenges that requires frequency analysis, Kasiski examination, or known-plaintext cryptanalysis.
description_zh: 古典密码分析实操手册。适用于在 CTF 挑战中遇到替换密码、维吉尼亚密码、换位密码、XOR 或编码文本，且需要频率分析、卡西斯基分析或已知明文密码分析的情况。

description: Memory forensics playbook using Volatility 2/3. Use when analyzing memory dumps for malware analysis, credential extraction, process investigation, code injection detection, and incident response timeline reconstruction.
description_zh: 使用Volatility 2/3的内存取证操作指南。用于分析内存转储以进行恶意软件分析、凭据提取、进程调查、代码注入检测以及事件响应时间线重建。

description: Orchestrate Apex-backed Lightning Type + HXL widget generation. TRIGGER only when the prompt EXPLICITLY invokes Lightning Types: user says 'Lightning Type', 'CLT', 'Custom Lightning Type', 'Apex-backed type', references '@apexClassType/...', asks to build a widget or card for a named Lightning Type, asks to create a new Lightning Type and widget together, or grounds a widget in a specific Apex class as its schema. DO NOT TRIGGER when the prompt names only a subject, domain, feature, or entity noun. Also DO NOT TRIGGER when: authoring only a Custom Lightning Type (use platform-custom-lightning-type-generate), only an Apex class (use platform-apex-generate), editing an existing widget without any Lightning Type change, or grounding a widget on an object/JSON-based Lightning Type (lightning__objectType with primitives).
description_zh:
编排基于 Apex 的 Lightning 类型 + HXL 小部件生成。仅在提示词明确调用 Lightning 类型时触发：用户提及"Lightning Type"、"CLT"、"Custom Lightning Type"、"Apex-backed type"，引用"@apexClassType/..."，要求为特定命名的 Lightning 类型构建小部件或卡片，要求同时创建新的 Lightning 类型与小部件，或以特定 Apex 类作为架构将小部件与 Lightning 类型绑定。

当提示词仅提及主题、领域、功能或实体名词时，不要触发。此外，不要触发的情况包括：仅编写自定义 Lightning 类型（使用 platform-custom-lightning-type-generate）、仅编写 Apex 类（使用 platform-apex-generate）、在没有 Lightning 类型变更的情况下编辑现有小部件，或将小部件基于对象/JSON 类 Lightning 类型（lightning__objectType 配合基本数据类型）进行绑定。

description: Routes any game-development request to the right specialized skill(s): it detects the engine (Godot, Unity, Unreal, Bevy, Phaser, PixiJS, three.js, LÖVE, pygame, Roblox) and the task, then reads the chosen skill before acting. Use to make a game or to decide which skill applies — for players, levels, enemies, shaders, art direction, sprites, tiles, textures, 3D assets, UI/UX, cameras, game feel, physics, input, audio, saving, multiplayer, AI, dialogue, procedural generation, or performance, for genres (platformer, roguelike, RPG, FPS, tower-defense, card game, visual novel, survival-crafting, puzzle), and for shipping (game jam, Steam, itch). Start here when unsure which gamedev skill to use.
description_zh: 将任何游戏开发请求路由到正确的专项技能：它检测所使用的引擎（Godot、Unity、Unreal、Bevy、Phaser、PixiJS、three.js、LÖVE、pygame、Roblox）和具体任务，随后在采取行动前读取所选技能。用于制作游戏或决定适用哪些技能——涵盖玩家、关卡、敌人、着色器、美术指导、精灵图、瓦片、纹理、3D 资源、UI/UX、摄像机、游戏手感、物理、输入、音频、存档、多人游戏、AI、对话、程序化生成或性能等方面，适用于平台游戏、roguelike、RPG、FPS、塔防、卡牌游戏、视觉小说、生存建造、解谜等类型，以及用于发行（游戏竞赛、Steam、itch）。当不确定应使用哪种游戏开发技能时，请从此处开始。

description: Tunneling and pivoting playbook. Use when establishing network tunnels through compromised hosts including SSH tunneling, Chisel, Ligolo-ng, socat, DNS/ICMP/HTTP tunneling, ProxyChains, and multi-layer pivoting strategies.
description_zh: 隧道与 Pivot 实战手册。适用于通过已失陷主机建立网络隧道，包括 SSH 隧道、Chisel、Ligolo-ng、socat、DNS/ICMP/HTTP 隧道、ProxyChains，以及多层 Pivot 策略。

description: Create a git commit with a clear, value-communicating message. Use when the user asks to commit/save staged or unstaged changes with a repo-appropriate message.
description_zh: 使用清晰、价值传递的提交信息创建 git 提交。当用户请求提交或保存暂存或未暂存的更改，并提供与仓库相匹配的提交信息时使用。

description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph
description_zh: 启动交互式网页仪表板，可视化代码库的知识图谱

description: Linux security mechanism bypass playbook. Use when facing restricted bash/rbash, read-only or noexec filesystems, AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp filters, or audit logging that must be evaded during post-exploitation.
description_zh: Linux安全机制绕过指南：当面对受限的bash/rbash、只读或noexec文件系统、AppArmor、SELinux、seccomp过滤器，或需在后期利用阶段规避的审计日志时使用。

description: Adds Arize AX tracing to an LLM application for the first time. Detects the stack, routes to the single matching integration doc, wires auto-instrumentation after user confirmation, and verifies traces land. Use when the user wants to instrument their app, add tracing from scratch, set up LLM observability, integrate OpenTelemetry or openinference, or get started with Arize tracing.
description_zh: 首次为 LLM 应用添加 Arize AX 追踪。检测技术栈，路由至唯一匹配的集成文档，在用户确认后配置自动插桩，并验证追踪数据已成功生成。适用于用户需要为其应用进行插桩、从零开始添加追踪、搭建 LLM 可观测性、集成 OpenTelemetry 或 openinference，或开始使用 Arize 追踪的场景。

description: Salesforce DevOps automation using sf CLI v2. TRIGGER when: user deploys metadata, creates/manages scratch orgs or sandboxes, sets up CI/CD pipelines, or troubleshoots deployment errors with sf project deploy. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex code (use generating-apex), building LWC components (use generating-lwc-components), creating metadata definitions (use generating-custom-object or generating-custom-field), or querying org data (use handling-sf-data).
description_zh: 使用 sf CLI v2 的 Salesforce DevOps 自动化。触发条件：当用户部署元数据、创建/管理临时组织（scratch orgs）或沙盒（sandboxes）、设置 CI/CD 流水线，或使用 sf project deploy 排查部署错误时。禁止触发条件：当编写 Apex 代码（使用 generating-apex）、构建 LWC 组件（使用 generating-lwc-components）、创建元数据定义（使用 generating-custom-object 或 generating-custom-field），或使用 handling-sf-data 查询组织数据时。

description: Enforce consistent tagging across the Obsidian wiki using a controlled vocabulary. Use this skill when the user says "fix my tags", "normalize tags", "clean up tags", "tag audit", "what tags should I use", "tag taxonomy", or whenever you're creating or updating wiki pages and need to choose the right tags. Also trigger when the user asks about tag conventions, wants to add a new tag to the taxonomy, or says "my tags are a mess". Always consult this skill's taxonomy file before assigning tags to any wiki page.
description_zh: 通过受控词汇，在 Obsidian wiki 上强制执行统一的标签标记。当用户表述中包含“修复我的标签”、“标准化标签”、“清理标签”、“标签审计”、“我应该使用哪些标签”、“标签分类体系”，或在创建或更新 wiki 页面时需要选择合适的标签时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户询问标签规范、希望将新标签添加到分类体系中，或表示“我的标签一团糟”时，也应触发此技能。在为任何 wiki 页面分配标签之前，始终查阅本技能的分类文件。

description: Use this skill when setting up a repository that uses the Effect Typescript library.
description_zh: 当设置使用 Effect TypeScript 库的仓库时，请使用此技能。

description: Scaffold a minimal local LangGraph agent in TypeScript by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangGraph agent locally.
description_zh: 按照官方快速入门指南，在 TypeScript 中搭建一个最小化的本地 LangGraph 智能体。适用于用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试 LangGraph 智能体的情况。

description: Control Eight Sleep pods (status, temperature, alarms, schedules).
description_zh: 控制八睡睡眠舱（状态、温度、警报、日程）。

description: Generate and evaluate grounded ideas. Use when the user wants ideas, improvements, or surprising directions before choosing one to develop. Not for refining an idea they already have (ce-brainstorm) or judging one already on the table (ce-pov).
description_zh: 生成并评估基于事实的想法。当用户需要想法、改进建议或令人惊喜的方向，且在尚未选择要开发的方案之前时使用。不适用于细化已有想法（ce-brainstorm），也不适用于评判已摆在桌面上的方案（ce-pov）。

description: Stack overflow and ROP playbook. Use when exploiting buffer overflows to hijack control flow via return address overwrite, ROP chains, ret2libc, ret2csu, ret2dlresolve, or SROP on Linux userland binaries.
description_zh: 栈溢出与ROP利用手册。用于在 Linux 用户态二进制文件中利用缓冲区溢出，通过覆盖返回地址、ROP链、ret2libc、ret2csu、ret2dlresolve 或 SROP 劫持控制流。

description: Simplify settled, recently changed code for clarity, reuse, quality, and efficiency while preserving behavior. Use after implementation and before review; use ce-debug for bugs.
description_zh: 简化已定稿、近期变更的代码，以提高清晰度、复用性、质量和效率，同时保持原有行为。实施后、评审前使用；使用 ce-debug 排查缺陷。

description: Scan agent skills for security issues. Use when asked to "scan a skill", "audit a skill", "review skill security", "check skill for injection", "validate SKILL.md", or assess whether an agent skill is safe to install. Checks for prompt injection, malicious scripts, excessive permissions, secret exposure, and supply chain risks.
description_zh: 扫描代理技能中的安全问题。当被要求执行“扫描技能”、“审计技能”、“审查技能安全性”、“检查技能注入风险”、“验证 SKILL.md”或评估代理技能是否安全可安装时使用。检查提示注入、恶意脚本、过度权限、密钥泄露和供应链风险。

description: Advanced prototype pollution playbook — server-side RCE, client-side gadgets, filter bypasses, and detection techniques. Companion to ../prototype-pollution/ for basics. Use when you've confirmed pollution and need to escalate to code execution or find framework-specific gadgets.
description_zh: 高级原型污染操作手册——服务端远程代码执行（RCE）、客户端工具、过滤器绕过与检测技术。作为`../prototype-pollution/`基础内容的配套指南。当已确认污染且需将攻击升级至代码执行或查找特定框架组件时使用。

description: Commit, push, and open a PR. Use when asked to ship/open a PR, or for PR-description-only flows like writing, rewriting, or describing a PR body.
description_zh: 提交、推送并打开一个PR。当被要求发布/打开PR时使用，或用于仅描述PR的流程，例如编写、重写或描述PR正文。

description: Official Salesforce documentation retrieval skill. Use when you need authoritative Salesforce docs from developer.salesforce.com, help.salesforce.com, architect.salesforce.com, admin.salesforce.com, or lightningdesignsystem.com, especially when pages are JS-heavy, shell-rendered, or hard to extract with naive fetching. Use to ground answers in official Salesforce sources instead of third-party blogs or summaries. TRIGGER when: user asks for official Salesforce documentation, Apex or API reference, LWC docs, Agentforce docs, setup or help articles, or any doc from a Salesforce-owned domain. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user is asking for a code change, deployment task, or anything not requiring documentation retrieval — use the appropriate sf-* skill instead.
description_zh:
官方 Salesforce 文档检索技能。当您需要从 developer.salesforce.com、help.salesforce.com、architect.salesforce.com、admin.salesforce.com 或 lightningdesignsystem.com 获取权威 Salesforce 文档时使用，特别是当页面包含大量 JavaScript、以壳形式渲染，或难以通过简单抓取提取时。使用以在权威的 Salesforce 来源基础上为答案提供依据，而非依赖第三方博客或摘要。

TRIGGER 条件：用户询问官方 Salesforce 文档、Apex 或 API 参考、LWC 文档、Agentforce 文档、设置或帮助文章，或任何来自 Salesforce 自有域名的文档。
DO NOT TRIGGER 条件：用户要求代码变更、部署任务，或任何不需要检索文档的内容——请改用适当的 sf-* 技能。

description: Diagnoses, predicts, and mitigates node disruptions during Compute Engine host maintenance and hardware or software maintenance events for GPU and TPU workloads on GKE. Use when diagnosing node disruptions, predicting host maintenance events on GPU/TPU nodepools, inspecting node interruption PromQL metrics, auditing node taints, or configuring workload protection strategies (graceful termination, opportunistic maintenance, PodDisruptionBudgets). Don't use for general GKE cluster creation, network policy configuration, or non-disruption workload deployment.
description_zh: 可诊断、预测并缓解 GKE 上 GPU 和 TPU 工作负载在 Compute Engine 主机维护及硬件或软件维护事件期间的节点中断。适用于诊断节点中断、预测 GPU/TPU 节点池中的主机维护事件、检查节点中断 PromQL 指标、审计节点污点，或配置工作负载保护策略（优雅终止、机会性维护、PodDisruptionBudgets）。请勿用于一般 GKE 集群创建、网络策略配置或非中断工作负载部署。

description: Session retrospective for improving marimo-pair and marimo._code_mode. Use when the user wants to analyze friction from a pairing session, identify what went wrong, and brainstorm improvements to the skill docs or the underlying API. Trigger on: "retro", "what went wrong", "improve the skill", "session review", "friction", or /retro-marimo-pair.
description_zh: 改进 marimo-pair 和 marimo._code_mode 的会话复盘。当用户希望分析配对会话中的摩擦、找出问题所在，并围绕技能文档或底层 API 构思改进方案时使用。触发条件：“retro”、“what went wrong”、“ improve the skill”、“session review”、“friction”，或 /retro-marimo-pair。

description: Authenticate to Elasticsearch using native, file-based, LDAP/AD, SAML, OIDC, Kerberos, JWT, or certificate realms. Use when connecting with credentials, choosing a realm, or managing API keys. Assumes the target realms are already configured.
description_zh: 通过原生、基于文件、LDAP/AD、SAML、OIDC、Kerberos、JWT 或证书身份域向 Elasticsearch 进行认证。适用于凭据连接、身份域选择或 API 密钥管理。假设目标身份域已配置。

description: Always-on autonomous meme dropper. A UserPromptSubmit hook fires every user message and tells Claude to drop multiple memes per response — 1-3 image+sound combos plus 1-5 sound-only fires, scaled to response length. Every answer carries brainrot. No invocation needed; loads and stays active automatically. The roast lands through the meme itself, never words. Self-contained skill — catalogue and assets live in this skill folder.
description_zh: 始终开启的自主表情包投放器。UserPromptSubmit 钩子每次用户消息时触发，并指示 Claude 在每次回复中投放多个表情包——1-3 组图像+声音组合，外加 1-5 组仅声音内容，根据回复长度进行缩放。每个答案都带有脑腐。无需调用；自动加载并保持活动状态。调侃通过表情包本身传达，而非文字。这是自包含技能——目录与素材均位于此技能文件夹中。

description: Comprehensive market environment analysis and reporting tool. Analyzes global markets including US, European, Asian markets, forex, commodities, and economic indicators. Provides risk-on/risk-off assessment, sector analysis, and technical indicator interpretation. Triggers on keywords like market analysis, market environment, global markets, trading environment, market conditions, investment climate, market sentiment, forex analysis, stock market analysis, 相場環境, 市場分析, マーケット状況, 投資環境.
description_zh: 综合市场环境分析与报告工具。分析包括美国、欧洲、亚洲市场、外汇、大宗商品和经济指标在内的全球市场。提供风险倾向/风险规避评估、板块分析和技术指标解读。触发关键词包括市场分析、市场环境、全球市场、交易环境、市场条件、投资气候、市场情绪、外汇分析、股市分析、相場環境、市場分析、マーケット状況、投資環境。

description: Smart contract vulnerability playbook. Use when auditing Solidity/EVM contracts for reentrancy, integer overflow, access control, delegatecall, flash loan, signature replay, and MEV-related attack patterns.
description_zh: 智能合约漏洞手册。用于审计 Solidity/EVM 合约，防范重入、整数溢出、访问控制、delegatecall、闪电贷、签名重放以及与 MEV 相关的攻击模式。

description: Tailwind CSS utility-first CSS framework. Use when styling web applications with utility classes, building responsive designs, or customizing design systems with theme variables.
description_zh: Tailwind CSS 是一款工具优先的 CSS 框架，可用于通过工具类样式化 Web 应用、构建响应式设计，或使用主题变量自定义设计系统。

description: 数字生命卡兹克（Khazix）的公众号长文写作skill。当用户需要撰写公众号文章、写稿子、续写文章、根据素材产出长文时使用。触发词包括但不限于：写文章、写稿子、帮我写、续写、扩写、公众号文章、长文、出稿、按我的风格写。即使用户只是说"帮我把这个写成文章"或"用我的风格写一下"，只要上下文涉及内容创作和公众号输出，都应该触发。也适用于用户丢过来一个PDF、brief、新闻链接、语音转文字或任何素材说"帮我写篇文章"的场景。不要用于短内容（小红书帖子、推特、朋友圈）或纯标题摘要生成（那个用wechat-title skill）。
description_zh: 数字生命卡兹克（Khazix）的公众号长文写作skill。当用户需要撰写公众号文章、写稿子、续写文章、根据素材产出长文时使用。触发词包括但不限于：写文章、写稿子、帮我写、续写、扩写、公众号文章、长文、出稿、按我的风格写。即使用户只是说"帮我把这个写成文章"或"用我的风格写一下"，只要上下文涉及内容创作和公众号输出，都应该触发。也适用于用户丢过来一个PDF、brief、新闻链接、语音转文字或任何素材说"帮我写篇文章"的场景。不要用于短内容（小红书帖子、推特、朋友圈）或纯标题摘要生成（那个用wechat-title skill）。

description: Draft a personalized outreach email or multi-touch sequence to a prospect, create it as an email draft for review, and add the contact to a sequence in your sales engagement tool when asked. Use when the user asks to "draft outreach to [person/company]", "write a cold email to [prospect]", "re-engage [prospect]", "draft a 3-touch sequence", or "reach out to [person]".
description_zh: 为潜在客户起草个性化的外联邮件或多触点序列，将其创建为用于审核的邮件草稿，并在用户要求时，将该联系人添加到销售互动工具中的序列。当用户要求“为[人员/公司]起草外联邮件”、“向[潜在客户]撰写冷邮件”、“重新激活[潜在客户]”、“起草3触点序列”或“联系[人员]”时使用。

description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase
description_zh: 用于需要深入解释代码库中特定文件、函数或模块时

description: Lattice-based cryptanalysis playbook. Use when attacking RSA via Coppersmith small roots, recovering DSA/ECDSA nonces from bias, solving knapsack problems, or applying LLL/BKZ reduction to cryptographic constructions.
description_zh: 格基密码分析操作手册。适用于通过Coppersmith小根攻击RSA、从偏差恢复DSA/ECDSA随机数、解决背包问题，或将LLL/BKZ约化应用于密码构造的场景。

description: 把较长的编码、排查、测试或交互式 CLI 工作交给 tmux 中的内层命令行编码 Agent， 由当前外层 Agent 负责拆解任务、读取稳定屏幕快照、纠正方向、执行最终验收，并在本次 任务结束后销毁内层 session。适用于用户明确要求使用 cc-use、希望把长时间实现工作 交给内层 Agent、需要在真实 Codex CLI 或 Claude Code TUI 中完成受监督工作，或需要 评估如何由 cron、launchd、systemd 等外部调度器触发 cc-use。
description_zh: 将较长的编码、排查、测试或交互式 CLI 工作交给 tmux 中的内层命令行编码 Agent，由当前外层 Agent 负责拆解任务、读取稳定屏幕快照、纠正方向、执行最终验收，并在本次任务结束后销毁内层 session。适用于用户明确要求使用 cc-use、希望将长时间实现工作交给内层 Agent、需要在真实 Codex CLI 或 Claude Code TUI 中完成受监督工作，或需要评估如何由 cron、launchd、systemd 等外部调度器触发 cc-use。

description: Three.js skills for creating 3D elements and interactive experiences in the browser — scenes, materials, controls, and post-processing.
description_zh: Three.js 在浏览器中创建 3D 元素和交互体验的技能——场景、材质、控制器及后处理。

description: Sandbox escape playbook. Use when breaking out of Python sandbox, Lua sandbox, seccomp filter, chroot jail, container/Docker, browser sandbox, or namespace isolation to achieve unrestricted code execution or file access.
description_zh: 沙箱逃逸操作手册。用于从 Python 沙箱、Lua 沙箱、seccomp 过滤器、chroot 沙箱、容器/Docker、浏览器沙箱或命名空间隔离中逃出，以实现不受限制的代码执行或文件访问。

description: Steganography detection and extraction playbook. Use when analyzing images (LSB, PNG chunks, JPEG DCT, EXIF), audio (spectrogram, DTMF), files (polyglots, appended data, ADS), and text (whitespace, zero-width, homoglyphs) for hidden data.
description_zh: 隐写检测与提取操作手册。适用于分析图像（LSB、PNG 数据块、JPEG DCT、EXIF）、音频（谱图、DTMF）、文件（多格式兼容文件、附加数据、ADS）、文本（空白符、零宽字符、同形字）中隐藏数据的情况。

description: Symmetric cipher attack playbook. Use when exploiting block cipher mode weaknesses (CBC padding oracle, ECB cut-and-paste, bit flipping), stream cipher key reuse, or meet-in-the-middle attacks.
description_zh: 对称密码攻击手册。适用于利用块密码模式弱点（CBC填充预言机、ECB剪切粘贴、位翻转）、流密码密钥重用或中途相遇攻击。

description: Windows lateral movement playbook. Use when pivoting between Windows hosts via PsExec, WMI, WinRM, DCOM, RDP, pass-the-hash, overpass-the-hash, or pass-the-ticket techniques.
description_zh:
Windows 横向移动操作手册。

当通过 PsExec、WMI、WinRM、DCOM、RDP、哈希传递（pass-the-hash）、哈希超越（overpass-the-hash）或票据传递（pass-the-ticket）等技术在 Windows 主机之间进行横向移动时使用。

Value investing analysis using Graham (NCAV/net-net/defensive-investor) and Buffett (economic moat/ROE/FCF) methodologies. Covers single-stock diagnostics and batch screening for both Graham cigar-butt and Buffett quality-compounder criteria. Runs cross-statement reconciliation before scoring. Data from Longbridge CLI first, MCP fallback, WebSearch only for genuine gaps.

基于格雷厄姆（NCAV/净净/防御型投资者）与巴菲特（经济护城河/ROE/FCF）投资方法的价值投资分析。涵盖针对格雷厄姆“烟蒂股”与巴菲特“质量复利”标准，开展单股票诊断与批量筛选。评分前执行跨报表对账。数据优先采用 Longbridge CLI 数据源，MCP 作为备选回退，仅在存在真实缺口时使用 WebSearch。
