description: RSA attack playbook for CTF and real-world cryptanalysis. Use when given RSA parameters (n, e, c) and need to recover plaintext by exploiting weak keys, small exponents, shared factors, or padding oracles.
description_zh: 针对CTF与真实世界密码分析的RSA攻击手册。当给定RSA参数（n, e, c）并需要利用弱密钥、小指数、共享因子或填充预言机来恢复明文时使用。

description: Capture conversations and decisions into structured Notion pages; use when turning chats/notes into wiki entries, how-tos, decisions, or FAQs with proper linking.
description_zh: 将对话和决策捕获到结构化的 Notion 页面中；在将聊天/笔记转化为 wiki 条目、操作指南、决策或常见问题解答（FAQ）时使用，并设置合理的链接。

description: Refresh the repo's captured learnings against the current codebase. Use when auditing stale, overlapping, superseded, or drifted learnings; avoid general refactor, debugging, or code review unless the learnings store is explicit.
description_zh: 将仓库中捕获的经验教训与当前代码库进行刷新。在审计过期、重叠、被替代或存在漂移的经验教训时使用；除非经验教训存储库明确要求，否则避免通用的重构、调试或代码审查。

description: Morning rundown - today's meetings with account context, opps closing soon with stale flags, waiting customer emails, and the day's top actions. Use when the user says "daily briefing", "daily brief", "morning briefing", "what's my day", "what's on my plate today", "prep my day", "start my day", "morning rundown", or on a schedule.
description_zh: 晨间概览：结合账户背景的今日会议、带有陈旧标记的即将成交商机、等待的客户邮件，以及当日核心行动。当用户说“日常简报”、“每日简报”、“晨间简报”、“我的今日日程”、“今日待办事项”、“准备我的日程”、“开始今日”、“晨间概览”，或按预定日程时使用。

description: Scaffold a minimal local LangChain agent in TypeScript by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangChain agent locally.
description_zh: 按照官方快速入门，在 TypeScript 中搭建一个最小化的本地 LangChain 智能体。当用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试 LangChain 智能体时使用。

description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for Python with cold start optimization. Use when deploying Python functions to AWS Lambda, choosing between AWS Chalice and raw Python approaches, optimizing cold starts, configuring API Gateway or ALB integration, or implementing serverless Python applications. Triggers include "create lambda python", "deploy python lambda", "chalice lambda aws", "python lambda cold start", "aws lambda python performance", "python serverless framework".
description_zh: 提供针对 Python 的 AWS Lambda 集成模式，并包含冷启动优化。适用于将 Python 函数部署到 AWS Lambda、在 AWS Chalice 与原始 Python 方案之间进行选择、优化冷启动、配置 API Gateway 或 ALB 集成，或实现无服务器 Python 应用。触发条件包括："create lambda python"、"deploy python lambda"、"chalice lambda aws"、"python lambda cold start"、"aws lambda python performance"、"python serverless framework"。

description: Apex test execution, coverage analysis, and test-fix loops with 120-point scoring. Use when the user needs to run Apex tests, check code coverage, fix failing tests, or work with *Test.cls / *_Test.cls files. TRIGGER when: user runs Apex tests, checks code coverage, fixes failing tests, or touches *Test.cls / *_Test.cls files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex production code (use generating-apex), Agentforce agent testing (use testing-agentforce), or Jest/LWC tests (use generating-lwc-components).
description_zh:
120分评分的Apex测试执行、覆盖率分析和测试修复循环。

用户需要运行Apex测试、检查代码覆盖率、修复失败测试，或处理 *Test.cls / *_Test.cls 文件时使用。

触发条件：用户运行Apex测试、检查代码覆盖率、修复失败测试，或涉及 *Test.cls / *_Test.cls 文件。

不得触发条件：编写Apex生产代码（使用 generating-apex）、Agentforce 智能体测试（使用 testing-agentforce）、或 Jest/LWC 测试（使用 generating-lwc-components）。

description:
Generates Google Cloud Monitoring Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Widget and XyChart Protocol Buffer textprotos from resolved PromQL or ListTimeSeries queries. Use when:
  - Generating valid google.monitoring.dashboard.v1.Widget textprotos,
    containing PrometheusQuery or TimeSeriesFilter datasets, for use with the Cloud Monitoring
    Dashboards API, gcloud CLI, or declarative dashboard definitions.
  - Synthesizing Server-Driven UI (SDUI) widget titles, axis labels, and
    plot types for Prometheus or ListTimeSeries queries.
Don't use for:
  - Metric discovery or PromQL query generation. For those tasks, use the
    cloud-monitoring-metric-selection or cloud-monitoring-promql-query skills.
description_zh:
基于已解析的 PromQL 或 ListTimeSeries 查询，生成 Google Cloud 监控服务驱动 UI (SDUI) 组件及 XyChart 协议缓冲区文本定义。使用场景：
  - 为 Cloud Monitoring 仪表板 API、gcloud CLI 或声明式仪表板定义生成有效的 google.monitoring.dashboard.v1.Widget 文本定义，其中包含用于上述接口的 PrometheusQuery 或 TimeSeriesFilter 数据集。
  - 针对 Prometheus 或 ListTimeSeries 查询，合成服务驱动 UI (SDUI) 组件的标题、坐标轴标签与图表类型。

勿用于：
  - 指标发现或 PromQL 查询生成。对于这些任务，请使用 cloud-monitoring-metric-selection 或 cloud-monitoring-promql-query 技能。

description: Use when the user asks for text-to-speech narration or voiceover, accessibility reads, audio prompts, or batch speech generation via the OpenAI Audio API; run the bundled CLI (`scripts/text_to_speech.py`) with built-in voices and require `OPENAI_API_KEY` for live calls. Custom voice creation is out of scope.
description_zh: 当用户请求文本转语音旁白、配音、无障碍朗读、音频提示，或通过 OpenAI 音频 API 进行批量语音生成时，运行随附的命令行工具（`scripts/path_to_file.py`），使用内置语音，并为实时调用提供 `OPENAI_API_KEY`。自定义语音创建不在范围内。

description: squirrelscan audits websites for SEO, performance, security, accessibility, content, and structured data issues (260+ rules) and scores site health, via the squirrel CLI. Use when the user wants to check, audit, or improve a website's SEO, ranking, speed, or health, and for anything squirrelscan itself, installing or updating the CLI, login and API keys, running audits, publishing and sharing reports, cloud credits, MCP server setup, configuration, or troubleshooting.
description_zh: Squirrelscan 通过 squirrel CLI 对网站的 SEO、性能、安全、无障碍、内容和结构化数据问题（260 余条规则）进行审计，并评估网站健康度。适用于用户希望检查、审计或优化网站的 SEO、排名、速度或健康度时，以及用于 squirrelscan 自身相关的任何操作，包括安装或更新 CLI、登录和 API 密钥、执行审计、发布和分享报告、云信用额度、设置 MCP 服务器、配置或排障。

description: Generates complete CRUD modules for NestJS applications with Drizzle ORM. Use when building server-side features in NestJS that require database operations, including creating new entities with full CRUD endpoints, services with Drizzle queries, Zod-validated DTOs, and unit tests. Triggered by requests like "generate a user module", "create a product CRUD", "add a new entity with endpoints", or when setting up database-backed features in NestJS.
description_zh: 为使用 Drizzle ORM 的 NestJS 应用生成完整的 CRUD 模块。在构建需要数据库操作的 NestJS 服务端功能时使用，包括创建具备完整 CRUD 接口的新实体、使用 Drizzle 查询的服务、Zod 校验的 DTO 以及单元测试。通过“生成用户模块”、“创建产品 CRUD”、“添加带有接口的新实体”等请求触发，或在 NestJS 中配置基于数据库的功能时触发。

description: Write docstrings for PyTorch functions and methods following PyTorch conventions. Use when writing or updating docstrings in PyTorch code.
description_zh: 编写 PyTorch 函数和方法的文档字符串，遵循 PyTorch 的规范。在 PyTorch 代码中编写或更新文档字符串时使用。

description: macOS security bypass playbook. Use when targeting macOS endpoints and need to bypass TCC, Gatekeeper, SIP, sandbox, code signing, or entitlement-based protections during authorized red team or pentest engagements.
description_zh: macOS 安全绕过手册。在针对 macOS 终端、需在获得授权的红队或渗透测试活动中绕过 TCC、Gatekeeper、SIP、沙盒、代码签名或基于授权的保护时使用。

description: Extract article content from any URL as clean Markdown. Uses Scrapling script as primary method (with auto fast→stealth fallback), Jina Reader as alternative for simple pages. Preserves headings, links, images, lists, and code blocks. Use this skill whenever the user wants to fetch, read, extract, scrape, or summarize content from a URL — including blog posts, news articles, WeChat articles (微信公众号), documentation pages, or any web page. Also trigger when the user says things like "帮我读一下这篇文章", "抓取这个网页", "提取正文", or "read this page for me".
description_zh: 从任意 URL 提取文章内容，生成整洁的 Markdown。主要使用 Scrapling 脚本（自动快速→隐蔽回退），并将 Jina Reader 作为简单页面的备选方案。保留标题、链接、图片、列表和代码块。当用户需要从 URL 获取、读取、提取、抓取或总结内容时，请使用此技能——包括博客文章、新闻文章、微信公众号文章、文档页面或任何网页。此外，当用户提及"帮我读一下这篇文章"、"抓取这个网页"、"提取正文"或"read this page for me"等表述时，也请触发。

description: Helps coding agents integrate and work with the Tiptap rich text editor. Use when building or modifying a rich text editor with Tiptap, installing Tiptap extensions, or implementing features like collaboration, comments, AI, or document conversion.
description_zh: 帮助编程智能体集成并使用Tiptap富文本编辑器。适用于使用Tiptap构建或修改富文本编辑器、安装Tiptap扩展，或实现协作、评论、AI、文档转换等功能的场景。

description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for TypeScript with cold start optimization. Use when creating or deploying TypeScript Lambda functions, choosing between NestJS framework and raw TypeScript approaches, optimizing cold starts, configuring API Gateway or ALB integration, or implementing serverless TypeScript applications. Triggers include "create lambda typescript", "deploy typescript lambda", "nestjs lambda aws", "raw typescript lambda", "aws lambda typescript performance".
description_zh: 提供具备冷启动优化的 TypeScript AWS Lambda 集成模式。适用于创建或部署 TypeScript Lambda 函数、在 NestJS 框架与原生 TypeScript 方案之间进行选择、优化冷启动、配置 API Gateway 或 ALB 集成，或实现无服务器 TypeScript 应用。触发词包括“创建 Lambda TypeScript”、“部署 TypeScript Lambda”、“NestJS Lambda AWS”、“原生 TypeScript Lambda”、“AWS Lambda TypeScript 性能”。

description: Kakao Local (장소 검색·주소-좌표 변환) + Kakao Mobility (자동차 길찾기) 를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 조회한다. 사용자 키 불필요. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: Kakao Local (地点搜索·地址-坐标转换) + Kakao Mobility (汽车导航) 通过 k-skill-proxy 进行查询。无需用户密钥。在锁中，可通过官方界面执行后续操作。

description: Review PyTorch pull requests for code quality, test coverage, security, and backward compatibility. Use when reviewing PRs, when asked to review code changes, or when the user mentions "review PR", "code review", or "check this PR".
description_zh: 审查 PyTorch 的 Pull Request（PR），以评估代码质量、测试覆盖率、安全性和向后兼容性。在审查 PR、要求审查代码变更，或用户提及“审查 PR”、“代码审查”或“检查此 PR”时使用。

description: Check Compound Engineering health and repo-local config, or scaffold a Compound Pack with `pack:<id>`.
description_zh: 检查 Compound Engineering 的健康与仓库本地配置，或使用 `pack:<id>` 搭建一个 Compound Pack。

description: Scaffold a minimal local Deep Agent in TypeScript by following the official quickstart, using provider-native web search instead of Tavily. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a Deep Agent locally.
description_zh: 遵循官方快速开始指南，使用 provider 原生网络搜索（而非 Tavily）在 TypeScript 中搭建一个最小化的本地深度智能体。当用户希望快速在本地构建或试用深度智能体时使用。

description: CRITICAL: Use for concurrency/async. Triggers: E0277 Send Sync, cannot be sent between threads, thread, spawn, channel, mpsc, Mutex, RwLock, Atomic, async, await, Future, tokio, deadlock, race condition, 并发, 线程, 异步, 死锁
description_zh: 严重：用于并发/异步。触发条件：E0277 Send（发送）与 Sync（同步），无法在多个线程之间发送，线程，spawn（生成），通道，mpsc，Mutex，RwLock，Atomic，异步，await（等待），Future，tokio，死锁，竞态条件，并发，线程，异步，死锁

description: When the user wants to create or update their app marketing context document. Also use when the user mentions "app context", "marketing brief", "app positioning", or when starting any ASO or app marketing project. This is the foundation skill — all other skills check for this context first.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建或更新其应用营销上下文文档时。此外，当用户提及“应用上下文”、“营销简报”、“应用定位”，或在启动任何 ASO 或应用营销项目时，都应使用。这是基础技能——其他所有技能都应首先检查此上下文。

description: Use this skill to Upgrade Einstein Bots into Agentforce agents end-to-end in a single pass, orchestrating per-bot Agent Spec generation, planner reconciliation across bots, agentforce-generate authoring, and post-conversion .agent enhancements. TRIGGER when: user asks to migrate, upgrade, or convert one or more Einstein Bots to Agentforce; runs a multi-bot bot-to-agent upgrade; needs Einstein Bot metadata turned into Agent Spec handoffs and generated .agent agents; convert bots to agents; upgrade my service bots; move bots to Agentforce. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user already has an approved Agent Spec and only wants direct .agent authoring, deploy, test, or observe flows; the request is unrelated to Einstein Bot migration.
description_zh:
使用此技能，可在一次流程中端到端将爱因斯坦机器人升级为 Agentforce 智能体，全程编排每个机器人的 Agent Spec 生成、跨机器人规划器协调、agentforce-generate 编写以及转换后 .agent 增强。

**触发条件（TRIGGER when）：**
用户要求将一个或多个爱因斯坦机器人迁移、升级或转换为 Agentforce；执行多机器人机器人转智能体升级；需要将爱因斯坦机器人元数据转化为 Agent Spec 交接并生成 .agent 智能体；将机器人转换为智能体；升级我的服务机器人；或将机器人迁移至 Agentforce。

**不触发条件（DO NOT TRIGGER when）：**
用户已拥有已批准的 Agent Spec，仅需直接进行 .agent 编写、部署、测试或观察流程；或该请求与爱因斯坦机器人迁移无关。

description: 把当前对话转成 spec 并发布到项目 issue tracker——不做访谈，只综合已经讨论的内容。
description_zh: 把当前对话转成 spec 并发布到项目 issue tracker——不做访谈，只综合已经讨论的内容。

description: Domain expertise for Ai2 Asta MCP tools (Semantic Scholar corpus). Intent-to-tool routing, safe defaults, workflow patterns, and pitfall warnings for academic paper search, citation traversal, and author discovery.
description_zh: 面向 Ai2 Asta MCP 工具（Semantic Scholar 语料库）的领域专业知识：意图-工具路由、安全默认值、工作流模式，以及针对学术论文搜索、引用遍历与作者发现的潜在陷阱警示。

description: Structure a performance review with self-assessment, manager template, and calibration prep. Use when review season kicks off and you need a self-assessment template, writing a manager review for a direct report, prepping rating distributions and promotion cases for calibration, or turning vague feedback into specific behavioral examples.
description_zh: 构建包含自我评估、管理者模板及校准准备的绩效评估方案。在评估季启动时使用，用于您需要自我评估模板、为直接下属撰写管理者评估、为校准准备评级分布与晋升案例，或将模糊反馈转化为具体行为示例。

description: Use this skill to author a complete HXL WidgetBundle (UEM body + schema.json + -meta.xml). TRIGGER when: user asks for a widget, mosaic, fragment, card, or rich UI surface for any subject, domain, feature, or entity noun; the prompt names only an entity or data shape without invoking Lightning Types, CLTs, or Apex-backed types. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the prompt explicitly says 'Lightning Type', 'CLT', 'Custom Lightning Type', 'Apex-backed type', or references '@apexClassType/...' (use platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate); authoring a custom-LWC renderer for a Custom Lightning Type (use platform-custom-lightning-type-generate); or editing only an LWC component.
description_zh: 使用此技能为完整的 HXL WidgetBundle（UEM 正文 + schema.json + -meta.xml）进行开发。触发条件：当用户请求针对任何主体、领域、功能或实体名词的小部件、马赛克、片段、卡片或富 UI 界面时触发；且提示词仅命名了实体或数据结构，未调用 Lightning Type、CLT 或 Apex-backed type。勿触发条件：当提示词明确提及 'Lightning Type'、'CLT'、'Custom Lightning Type'、'Apex-backed type'，或引用 '@apexClassType/...'（使用 platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate）时；为 Custom Lightning Type 编写自定义-LWC 渲染器（使用 platform-custom-lightning-type-generate）时；或仅编辑 LWC 组件时。

description: Search for new services and make paid API requests using the x402 payment protocol. Use when you don't have a clear tool to choose, search the bazaar. You can also use this tool if you or the user want to call an x402 endpoint, discover payment requirements, browse the bazaar, or search for paid services.
description_zh: 搜索新服务，并使用 x402 支付协议发起付费 API 请求。当您没有明确的选择工具时，请搜索集市。如果您或用户需要调用 x402 端点、了解支付要求、浏览集市或搜索付费服务，也可以使用此工具。

description: NTLM relay and authentication coercion playbook. Use when capturing and relaying NTLM authentication to escalate privileges via SMB, LDAP, HTTP, or MSSQL relay targets, combined with PetitPotam, PrinterBug, and other coercion methods.
description_zh: NTLM 中继与认证强制操作手册。用于捕获并中继 NTLM 认证，以通过 SMB、LDAP、HTTP 或 MSSQL 中继目标升级权限，并结合 PetitPotam、PrinterBug 及其他强制方法使用。

description: Use for nontrivial Effect 3 work including services/layers, typed errors, Schema/JSONSchema, Config, runtime/concurrency, @effect/vitest, @effect/ai, @effect/sql, Effect Atom, or @prb/effect-next.
description_zh: 适用于非平凡的 Effect 3 相关工作，包括服务/层、类型化错误、Schema/JSONSchema、配置、运行时/并发、@effect/vitest、@effect/ai、@effect/sql、Effect Atom 或 @prb/effect-next。

description: Brainstorm feature ideas for a new product in initial discovery from PM, Designer, and Engineer perspectives. Use when starting product discovery for a new product, exploring features for a startup idea, or doing initial ideation.
description_zh: 在初期发现阶段，从产品经理（PM）、设计师和工程师的视角进行功能想法的头脑风暴。当开始新产品发现、为初创想法探索功能或进行初步构思时使用。

description: Research competitors and generate a positioning and messaging comparison with content gaps, opportunities, and threats. Use when building sales battlecards, when finding positioning gaps and messaging angles competitors haven't claimed, or when a competitor makes a move and you need to assess the impact.
description_zh: 调研竞争对手，生成定位与传播对比（含内容空白、机会与威胁）。用于构建销售作战卡、挖掘竞争对手未占据的定位差距与传播角度，或应对竞争对手行动并评估影响时使用。

description: Deploy web projects to Netlify using the Netlify CLI (`npx netlify`). Use when the user asks to deploy, host, publish, or link a site/repo on Netlify, including preview and production deploys.
description_zh: 使用 Netlify CLI (`npx netlify`) 将 Web 项目部署到 Netlify。当用户要求在 Netlify 上部署、托管、发布或链接网站/仓库（包括预览和生产的部署）时，使用本命令。

description: When the user wants to localize their App Store listing for international markets. description: Optimize a named target with a measured loop: attribute a workload's cost, or score variants and keep winners. Use when a working system's metric should move and the winning change is not already known. Use ce-debug when the job is diagnosis; use ce-work when the change is already known.
description_zh: 为命名目标进行优化，并采用可测循环：为工作负载分配成本，或对变体评分并保留胜出者。当运行系统中的指标应发生变动，且胜出的变更尚不可知时使用。任务用于诊断时使用 ce-debug；当变更已经明确时使用 ce-work。

description: When the user wants to get featured on the App Store or understand the editorial process. Also use when the user mentions "get featured", "App Store editorial", "App of the Day", "Today tab", "Apple featuring", or "how to get Apple to feature my app". For launch strategy, see app-launch. For ASO optimization, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 适用于用户希望获得 App Store 推荐或了解编辑流程的情况。当用户提及“get featured”、“App Store editorial”、“App of the Day”、“Today tab”、“Apple featuring”或“how to get Apple to feature my app”时，也适用。关于发布策略，参见 app-launch。关于 ASO 优化，参见 aso-audit。

description: 自动化处理 Word 和 Excel 文件。使用 Python 脚本读取、写入、格式化文档和表格。支持批量处理、模板填充、数据提取和格式转换。
description_zh: 自动化处理 Word 和 Excel 文件。使用 Python 脚本读取、写入、格式化文档与表格。支持批量处理、模板填充、数据提取和格式转换。

description: Guides the development of online multiplayer experiences where players connect, group, and interact in real-time using Unity Multiplayer Services. Use when the user asks for topology choice, player grouping, hosting, matchmaking, discovery, network setup, and session-based play (rooms, parties, lobbies) using the Unity Multiplayer Services APIs. Not for leaderboards, cloud saves, or backend features that involve no real-time connection between players; those belong to the build-live-game skill.
description_zh: 指导使用 Unity 多人服务，实现玩家通过实时连接、组队和互动构建的在线多人游戏体验。适用于用户使用 Unity 多人服务 API 时，涉及拓扑选择、玩家分组、主机服务、匹配、发现、网络设置以及基于会话的游玩（房间、队伍、大厅）等场景。不适用于排行榜、云端存档，以及不涉及玩家间实时连接的后端功能；这些功能属于构建上线游戏技能。

description:
理查德·费曼的思维框架与表达方式。基于40+个一手来源的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用费曼的视角分析问题、审视决策、提供反馈。
当用户提到「用费曼的视角」「费曼会怎么看」「费曼模式」「feynman perspective」「费曼学习法」时使用。
即使用户只是说「这是不是cargo cult」「命名不等于理解」「能不能做个演示替代论证」「我真的理解了还是只记住了名字」也可触发。
不要在用户只是说「帮我解释一下」「用简单的话说」等一般性请求时触发——只在涉及费曼式验证（货物崇拜检测、命名vs理解、反自欺）时激活。
description_zh:
理查德·费曼的思维框架与表达方式。基于40+个一手来源的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用费曼的视角分析问题、审视决策、提供反馈。
当用户提到「用费曼的视角」「费曼会怎么看」「费曼模式」「feynman perspective」「费曼学习法」时使用。
即使用户只是说「这是不是cargo cult」「命名不等于理解」「能不能做个演示替代论证」「我真的理解了还是只记住了名字」也可触发。
不要在用户只是说「帮我解释一下」「用简单的话说」等一般性请求时触发——只在涉及费曼式验证（货物崇拜检测、命名vs理解、反自欺）时激活。

description: Build Godot 4.7 user interfaces with Control nodes: anchors and offsets for responsive layout, Container nodes (VBox/HBox/Grid/Margin) for automatic arrangement, Theme resources for consistent styling, and keyboard/gamepad focus navigation. Use when laying out a HUD, menu, or UI in a Godot project, working with Control/Container nodes, anchors, themes, or focus in a .tscn.
description_zh: 使用 Control 节点构建 Godot 4.7 用户界面：通过锚点与偏移量实现响应式布局，通过 Container 节点（VBox/HBox/Grid/Margin）实现自动排列，通过主题资源实现统一样式，并支持键盘/游戏手柄焦点导航。在 Godot 项目中布局 HUD、菜单或 UI 时使用，配合 Control/Container 节点、锚点、主题或焦点在 .tscn 中工作。

description: Compare independent views on a consequential or contested decision. Use when: the caller selects multiple judges; evidence resolves disagreement, not voting.
description_zh: 比较针对一项实质性或有争议的决定的独立意见。适用情形：调用方选择多名法官；证据解决分歧，而非投票。

description: Generates and updates secure, production-ready Kubernetes YAML manifests optimized for GKE Autopilot and GKE Standard clusters. Use when creating or modifying GKE deployment manifests, configuring container security contexts, setting CPU/memory resource limits, defining readiness/liveness/startup probes, mounting secrets and volumes, configuring GKE Gateway API routes, targeting Spot VMs, or deploying AI model inference workloads (vLLM, TGI, Gemma). Don't use for live cluster operations, pod troubleshooting (use gke-workload-troubleshooting), or cluster infrastructure provisioning (use gke-cluster-creation).
description_zh:
生成并更新针对 GKE Autopilot 和 GKE Standard 集群优化、安全且可用于生产环境
的 Kubernetes YAML 清单。在创建或修改 GKE 部署清单、配置容器安全上下文、设置 CPU/内存资源限制、定义就绪、存活和启动探针、挂载秘密和卷、配置 GKE Gateway API 路由、针对 Spot 虚拟机或部署 AI 模型推理工作负载（vLLM、TGI、Gemma）时使用本工具。

请勿用于集群实时操作、容器编排单元故障排除（请使用 gke-workload-troubleshooting），或集群基础设施配置（请使用 gke-cluster-creation）。

description: Expert evaluator for Prometheus label strategy on Grafana Cloud. Audits, designs, and improves label schemas using cardinality scoring, access-pattern alignment, static vs. dynamic label rules, histogram bucket discipline, and instrumentation hygiene. Prevents high cardinality at the source — in application code and scrape target labels — without dropping labels that make series unique (which breaks the data). For reducing the cost of series already in Grafana Cloud, routes to the adaptive-metrics skill. Use when the user asks to evaluate, audit, design, or improve Prometheus labels — or asks how to prevent high cardinality at the source. For "why is my Prometheus slow / expensive right now" triage, see prometheus-cardinality-troubleshooter.
description_zh: Prometheus标签策略在Grafana Cloud上的专家评估者。审计、设计并优化标签模式，运用基数评分、访问模式对齐、静态标签规则与动态标签规则、直方图分桶管理规范及仪器化整洁规范。从源头防止高基数问题——包括在应用代码和抓取目标标签中——同时不丢弃能使序列唯一（否则会破坏数据）的标签。对于已存在于Grafana Cloud中序列的成本降低，将引导至adaptive-metrics技能。当用户询问评估、审计、设计或优化Prometheus标签，或询问如何从源头防止高基数时使用。对于“为什么我的Prometheus现在运行缓慢/成本高”的排查，请参阅prometheus-cardinality-troubleshooter。

description: Run a compliance check on a proposed action, product feature, or business initiative, surfacing applicable regulations, required approvals, and risk areas. Use when launching a feature that touches personal data, when marketing or product proposes something with regulatory implications, or when you need to know which approvals and jurisdictional requirements apply before proceeding.
description_zh: 对拟议行动、产品功能或业务举措进行合规检查，揭示适用法规、必需审批及风险领域。适用于发布涉及个人数据的功能、营销或产品提出具有监管影响的事项，或在继续操作前需明确适用审批与管辖要求的情况。

description: Audit code for memory leaks and disposable issues. Use when reviewing event listeners, DOM handlers, lifecycle callbacks, or fixing leak reports. Covers addDisposableListener, Event.once, MutableDisposable, DisposableStore, and onWillDispose patterns.
description_zh: 对代码中的内存泄漏及可释放问题进行审计。适用于审查事件监听器、DOM 处理器、生命周期回调，或修复泄漏报告时。涵盖 addDisposableListener、Event.once、MutableDisposable、DisposableStore 以及 onWillDispose 模式。

description: Always use when user asks to create, generate, draw, or design a diagram, flowchart, architecture diagram, ER diagram, sequence diagram, class diagram, network diagram, mockup, wireframe, or UI sketch, or mentions draw.io, drawio, drawoi, .drawio files, or diagram export to PNG/SVG/PDF.
description_zh: 当用户要求创建、生成、绘制或设计图表、流程图、架构图、ER图、时序图、类图、网络图、原型、线框图或UI草图，或提及draw.io、drawio、drawoi、.drawio文件，或图表导出为PNG/SVG/PDF时，始终使用draw.io。

description:
Onboarding script for first-time Starchild users: positioning, quick wins, discovery.

Use when the user is new or vague (e.g. "what can you do", "I don't know where to start", first session with no context, generic hello).
description_zh:
首次使用 Starchild 用户的引导脚本：定位、快速获胜、探索。

适用于用户为新手或表达模糊的场景（例如：“你能做什么”、“我不知道从何开始”、首次无背景会话、通用的问候语）。

description: Rules and formatting guidelines for writing Dart /// API documentation and doc comments. Use when documenting Dart code, writing doc comments for any Dart declaration (libraries, classes, methods, variables, etc.), or when instructed to follow the Effective Dart documentation guidelines.
description_zh: 编写 Dart /// API 文档和文档注释的规则与格式指南。当记录 Dart 代码、为任何 Dart 声明（如库、类、方法、变量等）编写文档注释，或根据要求遵循 Effective Dart 文档指南时使用。

description: Coding Agent Session Search - unified CLI/TUI to index and search local coding agent history from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Aider, ChatGPT, Pi-Agent, Factory, and more. Purpose-built for AI agent consumption with robot mode.
description_zh: 编码智能体会话检索 - 统一的CLI/TUI，用于从Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Cursor、Aider、ChatGPT、Pi-Agent、Factory等来源索引并检索本地编码智能体历史记录。专为AI智能体（机器人模式）消费而打造。

description: AI가 생성한 한국어 텍스트의 특징적인 패턴을 감지하고 자연스러운 인간의 글쓰기로 변환합니다. 과학적 언어학 연구(KatFishNet 논문, 94.88% AUC 정확도)에 기반합니다. 쉼표 과다, 띄어쓰기 경직성, 품사 다양성, AI 어휘 과용, 번역투(에 대해/통해/되어진다), 대명사 과다, 복수형 과다, 구조적 단조로움 등 40가지 패턴을 S1/S2/S3 심각도로 분석합니다. ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini가 생성한 한국어 텍스트를 자연스럽게 만들거나 LLM 출력에서 AI 흔적을 제거할 때 사용하세요.
description_zh: 可识别 AI 生成的韩语文本中的典型特征模式，并将其转化为自然的人类写作。基于科学语言学研究（KatFishNet 论文，94.88% AUC 准确率）。以 S1/S2/S3 严重度对 40 种模式进行分析，包括标点过度使用、排版僵硬、词性多样性不足、AI 词汇过度使用、翻译腔（如“关于”“通过”“已被”“进行”等）、代词过多、复数形式过多、结构单调等。适用于将 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 生成的韩语文本变得自然，或在 LLM 输出中去除 AI 痕迹时使用。

description:
Structured decision-making frameworks for evaluating options and making informed choices.
Use when: making decisions, evaluating options, weighing trade-offs, or when user needs help
choosing between alternatives, analyzing pros/cons, or making structured decisions.
description_zh:
用于评估选项和做出明智决策的结构化决策框架。
适用场景：做出决策，评估选项，权衡利弊，或当用户需要帮助
在备选方案之间做出选择，分析优缺点，或做出结构化决策。

description:
Andrej Karpathy的思维框架与表达方式。基于20+篇博文、16段深度访谈、100+条X帖子的系统蒸馏，
提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、完整的中文输出适配和经典句式速查。
用途：作为思维顾问，用Karpathy的视角分析AI技术可靠性、学习方法、行业趋势、产品设计。
当用户提到「用Karpathy的视角」「Karpathy会怎么看」「卡帕西」「karpathy模式」时使用。
也适用于：Software 2.0/3.0讨论、vibe coding话题、神经网络训练、AI炒作判断、LLM能力边界。
即使用户只是说「从工程现实主义角度」「march of nines」「构建即理解」「锯齿状智能」也可触发。
不在用户只是普通问AI相关问题时触发——只在明确想要Karpathy式思维框架时激活。
description_zh:
安德烈·卡帕西的思维框架与表达方式。基于20余篇博文、16段深度访谈、100余条X帖子的系统蒸馏，
提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、完整的中文输出适配与经典句式速查。

用途：作为思维顾问，以卡帕西的视角分析AI技术的可靠性、学习方法、行业趋势与产品设计。

当用户提到「用卡帕西的视角」「卡帕西会怎么看」「卡帕西」「卡帕西模式」时使用。

也适用于：Software 2.0/3.0讨论、vibe coding话题、神经网络训练、AI炒作判断、LLM能力边界。

即使用户只是提到「从工程现实主义角度」「march of nines」「构建即理解」「锯齿状智能」也可触发。

不在用户只是普通询问AI相关问题时触发——只在明确想要卡帕西式思维框架时激活。

description: Design AI-first interfaces that build ongoing relationships through memory, trust evolution, and collaborative planning, not just isolated screen interactions
description_zh: 设计以 AI 为核心、通过记忆、信任演进与协作规划建立持续关系的界面，而非仅仅依赖孤立的屏幕交互。

description: Run database migrations in Medusa
description_zh: 在 Medusa 中运行数据库迁移

description: NVIDIA RAG Blueprint — deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and manage. Handles any RAG action: deploy, install, start, enable, disable, toggle, change, configure, troubleshoot, debug, fix, shutdown, stop, or tear down any RAG feature or service (Agentic RAG, VLM, guardrails, query rewriting, models, search, ingestion, observability, summarization, reasoning, and more).
description_zh: NVIDIA RAG 蓝图 —— 部署、配置、排障与管理。涵盖任何 RAG 操作：部署、安装、启动、启用、禁用、切换、更改、配置、排障、调试、修复、关闭、停止或拆除任何 RAG 功能或服务（智能体 RAG、VLM（视觉语言模型）、护栏、查询重写、模型、搜索、信息摄入、可观测性、摘要生成、推理等）。

description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for Java with cold start optimization. Use when deploying Java functions to AWS Lambda, choosing between Micronaut and Raw Java approaches, optimizing cold starts below 1 second, configuring API Gateway or ALB integration, or implementing serverless Java applications. Triggers include "create lambda java", "deploy java lambda", "micronaut lambda aws", "java lambda cold start", "aws lambda java performance", "java serverless framework".
description_zh: 提供用于 Java 的 AWS Lambda 集成模式与冷启动优化方案。适用于将 Java 函数部署到 AWS Lambda、在 Micronaut 与原始 Java 方案之间进行选择、将冷启动时间优化至 1 秒以下、配置 API Gateway 或 ALB 集成，或实现 Java 无服务器应用时使用。触发词包括“创建 Java Lambda”、“部署 Java Lambda”、“Micronaut Lambda AWS”、“Java Lambda 冷启动”、“AWS Lambda Java 性能”、“Java 无服务器框架”。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing weekly price charts for stocks, stock indices, cryptocurrencies, or forex pairs. Use this skill when the user provides chart images and requests technical analysis, trend identification, support/resistance levels, scenario planning, or probability assessments based purely on chart data without consideration of news or fundamental factors.
description_zh: 当分析股票、股票指数、加密货币或外汇对的周线价格图表时，应使用此技能。当用户提供图表图像，并请求纯粹基于图表数据进行技术分析、趋势识别、支撑/阻力水平、情景规划或概率评估，且不考量新闻或基本面因素时，应使用此技能。

description: Add unsigned integer (uint) type support to PyTorch operators by updating AT_DISPATCH macros. Use when adding support for uint16, uint32, uint64 types to operators, kernels, or when user mentions enabling unsigned types, barebones unsigned types, or uint support.
description_zh: 通过更新 AT_DISPATCH 宏，为 PyTorch 算子添加无符号整数（uint）类型支持。在向算子、内核添加 uint16、uint32、uint64 类型支持，或当用户提及启用无符号类型、基础无符号类型或 uint 支持时使用。

description: Control a Chrome browser session through the chrome-devtools-axi CLI - navigate, snapshot, click, fill forms, run JavaScript, inspect console and network, take screenshots, audit performance. Use whenever a task needs a real browser: opening or testing a web page, clicking through a flow, extracting page content, or debugging a website.
description_zh: 通过 chrome-devtools-axi CLI 控制 Chrome 浏览器会话：导航、截图、点击、填写表单、运行 JavaScript、检查控制台和网络、截取截图、审计性能。在需要真实浏览器的任务中随时使用：打开或测试网页、点击操作流程、提取页面内容或调试网站。

description: Use when validating Azure DevOps pipeline changes for the VS Code build. Covers queueing builds, checking build status, viewing logs, and iterating on pipeline YAML changes without waiting for full CI runs.
description_zh: 在验证用于 VS Code 构建的 Azure DevOps 流水线变更时使用。覆盖排队构建、检查构建状态、查看日志，以及在不等待完整 CI 运行的情况下迭代流水线 YAML 变更。

description: Unauthorized access playbook for common exposed services. Use when Redis, Rsync, PHP-FPM, AJP/Ghostcat, Hadoop YARN, H2 Console, or similar management interfaces are exposed without authentication.
description_zh: 针对常见暴露服务的未授权访问操作剧本。当Redis、Rsync、PHP-FPM、AJP/Ghostcat、Hadoop YARN、H2 Console或类似管理接口未经认证就暴露时使用。

description: Write Metal/MPS kernels for PyTorch operators. Use when adding MPS device support to operators, implementing Metal shaders, or porting CUDA kernels to Apple Silicon. Covers native_functions.yaml dispatch, host-side operators, and Metal kernel implementation.
description_zh: 为 PyTorch 算子编写 Metal/MPS 内核。用于在算子上添加 MPS 设备支持、实现 Metal 着色器，或将 CUDA 内核移植到 Apple Silicon。涵盖 native_functions.yaml 调度、主机端算子以及 Metal 内核实现。

description: Enables interaction with Google NotebookLM for advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) capabilities via the notebooklm-mcp-cli tool. Use when querying project documentation stored in NotebookLM, managing research notebooks and sources, retrieving AI-synthesized information, generating audio podcasts or reports from notebooks, or performing contextual queries against curated knowledge bases. Triggers on "notebooklm", "nlm", "notebook query", "research notebook", "query documentation in notebooklm".
description_zh: 通过 notebooklm-mcp-cli 工具实现与 Google NotebookLM 的交互，支持高级 RAG（检索增强生成）功能。适用于查询存储在 NotebookLM 中的项目文档、管理研究笔记本及来源、检索 AI 生成的合成信息、从笔记本生成音频播客或报告，或针对精选知识库执行上下文查询。触发条件为 "notebooklm", "nlm", "notebook query", "research notebook", "query documentation in notebooklm"。

description: Create interface designs, wireframes, and design systems. Masters user research, accessibility standards, and modern design tools.
description_zh: 创建界面设计、线框图和设计系统。精通用户研究、无障碍标准与现代设计工具。

description: 把 plan、spec 或当前对话拆成一组 tracer-bullet tickets，每个 ticket 声明 blocking edges，并发布到已配置的 tracker；本地用每 ticket 一个文件中的文本 edge，真实 tracker 用 native blocking links。
description_zh: 将 plan、spec 或当前对话拆分为一组 tracer-bullet tickets，每个 ticket 声明 blocking edges，并发布到已配置的 tracker；本地使用每个 ticket 对应文件中的文本 edge，真实 tracker 使用 native blocking links。

description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for PHP with Symfony using the Bref framework. Creates Lambda handler classes, configures runtime layers, sets up SQS/SNS event triggers, implements warm-up strategies, and optimizes cold starts. Use when deploying PHP/Symfony applications to AWS Lambda, configuring API Gateway integration, implementing serverless PHP applications, or optimizing Lambda performance with Bref. Triggers include "create lambda php", "deploy symfony lambda", "bref lambda aws", "php lambda cold start", "aws lambda php performance", "symfony serverless", "php serverless framework".
description_zh: 提供使用 Bref 框架为 PHP 和 Symfony 打造的 AWS Lambda 集成模式。创建 Lambda 处理器类，配置运行时层，设置 SQS/SNS 事件触发器，实现预热策略，并优化冷启动。适用于将 PHP/Symfony 应用部署到 AWS Lambda、配置 API Gateway 集成、实现基于无服务器的 PHP 应用，或使用 Bref 优化 Lambda 性能。触发器包括“create lambda php”、“deploy symfony lambda”、“bref lambda aws”、“php lambda cold start”、“aws lambda php performance”、“symfony serverless”、“php serverless framework”。

description: Convert PyTorch AT_DISPATCH macros to AT_DISPATCH_V2 format in ATen C++ code. Use when porting AT_DISPATCH_ALL_TYPES_AND*, AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES*, or other dispatch macros to the new v2 API. For ATen kernel files, CUDA kernels, and native operator implementations.
description_zh: 在 ATen C++ 代码中，将 PyTorch AT_DISPATCH 宏转换为 AT_DISPATCH_V2 格式。在将 AT_DISPATCH_ALL_TYPES_AND*、AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES* 或其他 dispatch 宏移植到新的 v2 API 时使用。适用于 ATen 内核文件、CUDA 内核和原生算子实现。

description: Reverse shell techniques playbook. Use when establishing remote shells including language one-liners, encrypted shells (OpenSSL/socat/ncat), web shells, PTY upgrades, file transfer methods, PowerShell shells, and Windows payload generation.
description_zh: 反向 Shell 技术使用指南。用于建立远程 shell，包括语言一行命令、加密 shell（OpenSSL/socat/ncat）、Web shell、PTY 升级、文件传输方法、PowerShell shell 以及 Windows 载荷生成。

description: Salesforce data operations with 130-point scoring. Use this skill to create, update, delete, bulk import/export, generate test data, and clean up org records using sf CLI and anonymous Apex. TRIGGER when: user creates test data, performs bulk import/export, uses sf data CLI commands, needs data factory patterns for Apex tests, or needs to seed/clean records in a Salesforce org. DO NOT TRIGGER when: SOQL query writing only (use querying-soql), Apex test execution (use running-apex-tests), or metadata deployment (use deploying-metadata).
description_zh:
支持130分评分的Salesforce数据操作。使用此技能，借助sf CLI和匿名Apex，完成Salesforce记录的创建、更新、删除、批量导入与导出、测试数据生成以及组织（org）记录的清理工作。

触发场景：当用户创建测试数据、执行批量导入/导出、使用sf数据CLI命令、需要用于Apex测试的数据工厂模式，或在Salesforce组织中需初始化与清理记录时触发。

不触发场景：仅进行SOQL查询编写（使用querying-soql）、执行Apex测试（使用running-apex-tests）、进行元数据部署（使用deploying-metadata）。

description: Creates and scaffolds a new Spring Boot project (3.x or 4.x) by downloading from Spring Initializr, generating package structure (DDD or Layered architecture), configuring JPA, SpringDoc OpenAPI, and Docker Compose services (PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB). Use when creating a new Java Spring Boot project from scratch, bootstrapping a microservice, or initializing a backend application.
description_zh: 通过从 Spring Initializr 下载并创建 Spring Boot 项目（3.x 或 4.x），生成包结构（DDD 或分层架构），配置 JPA、SpringDoc OpenAPI 以及 Docker Compose 服务（PostgreSQL、Redis、MongoDB）。适用于从零开始创建新的 Java Spring Boot 项目、搭建微服务或初始化后端应用。

description: Diagnoses GKE workload failures (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff, Pending, etc.) via logs and events. Use when pods fail to start or crash repeatedly. Don't use for GKE cluster infrastructure provisioning, node pool creation, or non-Kubernetes Google Cloud services.
description_zh: 通过日志和事件诊断 GKE 工作负载故障（CrashLoopBackOff、OOMKilled、ImagePullBackOff、Pending 等）。适用于 Pod 启动失败或反复崩溃的场景。请勿用于 GKE 集群基础设施配置、节点池创建或非 Kubernetes 的 Google Cloud 服务。

description: Implement secure coding practices following OWASP Top 10. Use when preventing security vulnerabilities, implementing authentication, securing APIs, or conducting security reviews. Triggers on OWASP, security, XSS, SQL injection, CSRF, authentication security, secure coding, vulnerability.
description_zh: 遵循 OWASP Top 10 实施安全编码实践。适用于防范安全漏洞、实现身份验证、保护 API 或开展安全审查。触发关键词：OWASP、安全、XSS、SQL 注入、CSRF、身份验证安全、安全编码、漏洞。

description: Drive an app running on a Limrun cloud Android emulator: install an APK, launch and terminate apps with crash reports, tap, type, read the UI element tree, screenshot, record video, inject microphone audio, shape network bandwidth, read app logs, run shell commands, transfer files, tunnel the app's network destinations through your machine with HTTP inspection and HAR capture, and use adb over the CLI's tunnel for full logcat and interactive tools. Use after a build (from limrun-gradle or any builder) when the user wants to see, test, or interact with their app on an emulator, or says 'show me a screenshot', 'tap', 'run it on the emulator', 'check logcat', 'record a video', 'inspect network traffic', or 'reach my local server from the emulator'. To build the APK or AAB first, use limrun-gradle.
description_zh:
操控 Limrun 云 Android 模拟器上运行的 App：安装 APK，启动并终止应用（并获取崩溃报告），点击，输入，读取 UI 元素树，截图，录制视频，注入麦克风音频，调整网络带宽，读取应用日志，执行 Shell 命令，传输文件，通过 HTTP 检查与 HAR 捕获，将 App 的网络目标经由您的机器进行隧道传输，并使用通过 CLI 隧道访问的 adb，用于完整的 logcat 与交互式工具。

在构建完成（通过 limrun-gradle 或任何构建器）后，当用户希望在模拟器上查看、测试或交互其应用，或说出“展示截图”“点击”“在模拟器上运行”“检查 logcat”“录制视频”“检查网络流量”，或“从模拟器访问我的本地服务器”时，使用。

如需先构建 APK 或 AAB，请使用 limrun-gradle。

description: Bence's code style, tech stack, and workflow conventions
description_zh: 本斯的代码风格、技术栈和工作流约定

description: Animate in Godot 4.7 three ways: AnimationPlayer for keyframed clips (incl. call and signal tracks), AnimationTree with state machines and blend spaces for character animation, and Tween for short procedural/UI tweens via create_tween(). Use when working with AnimationPlayer/AnimationTree nodes in a .tscn, blending character states, sprite-sheet animation, or code-driven Tweens.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中可通过三种方式实现动画：AnimationPlayer 用于带关键帧的剪辑（包括调用和信号轨道），AnimationTree 借助状态机与混合空间（blends）实现角色动画，以及 Tween 用于通过 create_tween() 创建的程序化/UI 短时补间动画。适用于在 .tscn 中处理 AnimationPlayer/AnimationTree 节点、混合角色状态、精灵图动画或代码驱动的 Tween。

description: Provides automated documentation updates by analyzing git changes between the current branch and the last release tag. Performs git diff analysis to identify modifications, then updates README.md, CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog standard, and discovers documentation folders for contextual updates. Use when preparing a release, maintaining documentation sync, or before creating a pull request. Triggers on "update docs", "update changelog", "sync documentation", "update readme", "prepare release documentation".
description_zh: 通过分析当前分支与上一个发布标签之间的git 变更，提供自动化的文档更新。通过git diff分析识别修改内容，随后遵循《Keep a Changelog》标准更新README.md与CHANGELOG.md，并发现文档文件夹以进行上下文更新。适用于准备发布、维护文档同步或创建拉取请求之前。触发于"update docs"、"update changelog"、"sync documentation"、"update readme"、"prepare release documentation"。

description: Use when detecting ambiguous user intent, hedging language, open-ended framing, personal context before requests, or when unsure whether user wants exploration vs direct answer. Applies to all conversations.
description_zh: 用于检测用户意图模糊、使用缓和语言、开放式表述、请求前涉及个人背景信息，或不确定用户是需要探索性回答还是直接回答时。适用于所有对话。

description: Send tokens (USDC, ETH, POL, or SOL) to an address or ENS name on Base, Polygon, or Solana. Use when you or the user want to send money, pay someone, transfer tokens, tip, donate, or send funds to a wallet address or .eth name. Covers phrases like "send $5 to", "pay 0x...", "transfer to vitalik.eth", or "send USDC on Solana".
description_zh: 在 Base、Polygon 或 Solana 上，向地址或 ENS 名称发送代币（USDC、ETH、POL 或 SOL）。当您或用户需要发送资金、付款、转账代币、打赏、捐赠，或将资金发送至钱包地址或 .eth 名称时使用。涵盖诸如“发送 $5 至...”、“付款 0x...”、“转账至 vitalik.eth”或“在 Solana 上发送 USDC”等短语。

description: When the user wants to optimize YouTube videos for search, create video descriptions, or improve channel visibility. Also use when the user mentions "YouTube SEO," "YouTube description," "YouTube tags," "YouTube thumbnail," "YouTube title," "YouTube channel," or "video SEO." For YouTube ads, use youtube-ads.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化 YouTube 视频以利于搜索、创建视频简介，或提升频道曝光度时，使用此指令。当用户提及“YouTube SEO”、“YouTube 简介”、“YouTube 标签”、“YouTube 缩略图”、“YouTube 标题”、“YouTube 频道”或“视频 SEO”时，也使用此指令。针对 YouTube 广告，使用 youtube-ads。

description: Provides a structured 8-phase workflow for resolving GitHub issues in Claude Code. Covers fetching issue details, analyzing requirements, implementing solutions, verifying correctness, performing code review, committing changes, and creating pull requests. Use when user asks to resolve, implement, work on, fix, or close a GitHub issue, or references an issue URL or number for implementation.
description_zh: 为Claude Code中的GitHub问题提供结构化的八个阶段工作流。涵盖获取问题详情、分析需求、实现解决方案、验证正确性、进行代码审查、提交更改以及创建拉取请求。当用户请求解决、实现、处理、修复或关闭GitHub问题，或提及GitHub问题的URL或编号以便进行实现时使用。

description: Terraform provider acceptance test patterns using terraform-plugin-testing with the Plugin Framework. Covers test structure, TestCase/TestStep fields, ConfigStateChecks with custom statecheck.StateCheck implementations, plan checks, CompareValue for cross-step assertions, config helpers, import testing with ImportStateKind, sweepers, and scenario patterns (basic, update, disappears, validation, regression), and ephemeral resource testing with the echoprovider package. Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging provider acceptance tests, including questions about statecheck, plancheck, TestCheckFunc, CheckDestroy, ExpectError, import state verification, ephemeral resources, or how to structure test files.
description_zh: Terraform 提供商验收测试模式：使用 terraform-plugin-testing 与插件框架（Plugin Framework）实现。涵盖测试结构、TestCase/TestStep 字段、使用自定义 statecheck.StateCheck 实现的 ConfigStateChecks、计划检查、用于跨步骤断言的 CompareValue、配置辅助函数、基于 ImportStateKind 的导入测试、sweeper（清理器），以及场景模式（基础、更新、消失、验证、回归），以及使用 echoprovider 包的临时资源测试。适用于编写、审查或调试提供商验收测试时使用，包括关于 statecheck、plancheck、TestCheckFunc、CheckDestroy、ExpectError、导入状态验证、临时资源，或如何组织测试文件等方面的问题。

description: Use this to access external services/CLIs/APIs: Gmail/gh/Github/Stripe etc. or when running any bash command, script, or curl/wget that makes outbound HTTP calls. Make HTTP requests directly and the gateway injects credentials automatically.
description_zh: 使用此方式访问外部服务/CLIs/APIs（如 Gmail、gh、Github、Stripe 等），或在运行任何发起出站 HTTP 调用的 bash 命令、脚本、curl/wget 时使用。直接发起 HTTP 请求，网关会自动注入凭证。

description: Manage Elasticsearch RBAC: native users, roles, role mappings, document- and field-level security. Use when creating users or roles, assigning privileges, or mapping external realms like LDAP/SAML.
description_zh: 管理 Elasticsearch RBAC：包括原生用户、角色、角色映射以及文档级与字段级安全。适用于创建用户或角色、分配权限，或映射 LDAP/SAML 等外部领域。

description: Build an RPG: stats and leveling, inventory and equipment, quests, branching dialogue, save/load, and combat. Use for an RPG/JRPG, or designing stat, inventory, quest, or combat systems.
description_zh: 构建一款RPG：包含属性与升级、背包与装备、任务、分支对话、存档/读取以及战斗。可用于RPG/JRPG，或用于设计属性、背包、任务或战斗系统。

description: Make a paid API request to an x402 endpoint with automatic USDC payment. Use when you or the user want to call a paid API, make an x402 request, use a paid service, or pay for an API call. Use after finding a service with search-for-service.
description_zh: 向 x402 端点发起付费 API 请求，并自动使用 USDC 付款。当您或用户需要调用付费 API、发起 x402 请求、使用付费服务或为 API 调用付费时使用。在使用 search-for-service 找到服务后使用。

description: Enable, configure, and query Elasticsearch security audit logs. Use when the task involves audit logging setup, event filtering, or investigating security incidents like failed logins.
description_zh: 启用、配置并查询 Elasticsearch 安全审计日志。适用于审计日志设置、事件过滤或调查安全事件（如登录失败）等任务。

description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to stage, commit, push, and open a GitHub pull request in one flow using the GitHub CLI (`gh`).
description_zh: 仅在用户明确要求使用 GitHub CLI（`gh`）在同一流程中执行暂存、提交、推送并打开 GitHub 拉取请求时使用。

description: Discover, find, compare, audit, repair, adapt, craft, run, debrief, save, and prepare repeatable AI-agent loops for publication. Use when a user asks to analyze code or coding threads for recurring work, find a published loop, interview them to turn a goal into a bounded loop, review a loop for weak checks or unsafe authority, execute a loop with an evidence receipt, learn from completed runs, save or reuse a project loop, or validate and submit a loop to Loop Library.
description_zh: 发现、查找、比较、审计、修复、调整、定制、运行、复盘、保存，并准备可重复的AI智能体循环以供发布。当用户要求分析代码或编码脉络中的重复性工作、查找已发布的循环、对循环进行访谈以将目标转化为有界循环、审查循环中的薄弱检查或不安全权限、带证据收据执行循环、从完成的运行中学习、保存或复用项目循环，或验证并将循环提交至Loop Library时使用。

description: Implement, configure, and customize Streamdown — a streaming-optimized React Markdown renderer with syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, math rendering, and CJK support. Use when working with Streamdown setup, configuration, plugins, styling, security, or integration with AI streaming (e.g., Vercel AI SDK). Triggers on: (1) Installing or setting up Streamdown, (2) Configuring plugins (code, mermaid, math, cjk), (3) Styling or theming Streamdown output, (4) Integrating with AI chat/streaming, (5) Configuring security, link safety, or custom HTML tags, (6) Using carets, static mode, or custom components, (7) Troubleshooting Tailwind, Shiki, or Vite issues.
description_zh:
实现、配置和自定义 Streamdown——一款流式优化的 React Markdown 渲染器，具备语法高亮、Mermaid 图表、数学公式渲染及 CJK 支持。适用于 Streamdown 的设置、配置、插件、样式、安全，以及与 AI 流式交互（例如 Vercel AI SDK）的集成。触发场景包括：
（1）安装或设置 Streamdown；
（2）配置插件（代码、Mermaid、数学公式、CJK）；
（3）对 Streamdown 输出进行样式设置或主题定制；
（4）与 AI 聊天/流式交互进行集成；
（5）配置安全、链接安全或自定义 HTML 标签；
（6）使用 carets、静态模式或自定义组件；
（7）排查 Tailwind、Shiki 或 Vite 相关问题。

description: Generate a full campaign brief with objectives, audience, messaging, channel strategy, content calendar, and success metrics. Use when planning a product launch, lead-gen push, or awareness campaign, when you need a week-by-week content calendar with dependencies, or when translating a marketing goal into a structured, executable plan.
description_zh: 生成完整的活动简报，涵盖目标、目标受众、信息、渠道策略、内容日历和成功指标。适用于规划产品发布、潜在客户获取推广或认知推广活动；需要按周内容日历并注明依赖关系时；以及将营销目标转化为结构化、可执行的计划时。

description: Support SOX 404 compliance with control testing methodology, sample selection, and documentation standards. Use when generating testing workpapers, selecting audit samples, classifying control deficiencies, or preparing for internal or external audits.
description_zh: 支持SOX 404合规，采用控制测试方法论、样本选取及文档标准。适用于生成测试工作底稿、选取审计样本、分类控制缺陷或准备内部或外部审计。

description: Create security architecture diagrams using PlantUML syntax with identity, encryption, firewall, and compliance stencil icons. Best for IAM flows, zero-trust models, encryption pipelines, and threat detection architectures.
description_zh: 使用 PlantUML 语法，通过身份、加密、防火墙和合规性图块图标创建安全架构图，尤其适用于 IAM 流程、零信任模型、加密管道和威胁检测架构。

description: Primary accessibility skill for VS Code. REQUIRED for new feature and contribution work, and also applies to updates of existing UI. Covers accessibility help dialogs, accessible views, verbosity settings, signals, ARIA announcements, keyboard navigation, and ARIA labels/roles.
description_zh: VS Code 的主要无障碍技能。对于新功能和贡献工作，必需；同时适用于现有界面的更新。涵盖无障碍帮助对话框、无障碍视图、详细程度设置、信号、ARIA 公告、键盘导航以及 ARIA 标签/角色。

description: Salesforce integration architecture and runtime plumbing with 120-point scoring. Use this skill to set up Named Credentials, External Credentials, External Services, REST/SOAP callout patterns, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture. TRIGGER when: user sets up Named Credentials, External Services, REST/SOAP callouts, Platform Events, CDC, or touches .namedCredential-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Connected App/OAuth config (use configuring-connected-apps), Apex-only logic (use generating-apex), data import/export (use handling-sf-data), or CDC channel-membership metadata such as PlatformEventChannel, PlatformEventChannelMember, or EnrichedField (use managing-cdc-enablement).
description_zh: Salesforce集成架构与运行时管道，含120分评分。使用此技能设置命名凭证、外部凭证、外部服务、REST/SOAP调用模式、平台事件和变更数据捕获。触发条件：当用户设置命名凭证、外部服务、REST/SOAP调用、平台事件、CDC，或触及 .namedCredential-meta.xml 文件时。不要触发，当：Connected App/OAuth 配置 (使用 configuring-connected-apps)、仅 Apex 逻辑 (使用 generating-apex)、数据导入/导出 (使用 handling-sf-data)，或 CDC 通道成员元数据，如 PlatformEventChannel、PlatformEventChannelMember 或 EnrichedField (使用 managing-cdc-enablement) 时。

description: Analyze and improve business processes. Trigger with "this process is slow", "how can we improve", "streamline this workflow", "too many steps", "bottleneck", or when the user describes an inefficient process they want to fix.
description_zh: 分析与改进业务流程。触发条件为：“流程很慢”、“我们如何改进”、“优化此工作流程”、“步骤过多”、“瓶颈”，或当用户描述需要改进的低效流程时。

description: Software architecture and UI/UX principles for building genuinely new solutions, not derivative work. Use when designing features, architecting software, brainstorming apps, reviewing designs, or during strategy discussions. Focuses on first-principles thinking, simplicity where it matters, and creating rather than commenting.
description_zh: 构建真正全新解决方案的软件开发架构与UI/UX原则，而非衍生成果。适用于功能设计、软件架构规划、应用头脑风暴、设计方案评审及战略讨论等场景。注重第一性原理思考，在关键环节追求简洁，强调创造而非评判。

description: Expert in SQLite embedded database development for Tauri/desktop applications with focus on SQL injection prevention, migrations, FTS search, and secure data handling
description_zh: 精通 Tauri/桌面应用 SQLite 嵌入式数据库开发的专家，专注于 SQL 注入防护、数据库迁移、FTS 搜索及安全数据处理。

description: List, inspect, enable, disable, and resync Kibana Streams via the REST API. Use when the user needs stream details, ingest settings, query-stream settings, or linked attachments (dashboards, rules, SLOs).
description_zh: 通过 REST API 列出、检查、启用、禁用并重新同步 Kibana Streams。当用户需要流详情、摄取设置、查询流设置或关联附件（仪表盘、规则、SLOs）时使用。

description: Audit a python-pptx export against its source HTML deck, identify layout/content drift (footer overflow, cropped content, missing italic/em, lost styling, off-rhythm spacing), and re-export with strict footer-rail + cursor-flow layout discipline. Use this skill whenever the user has a .pptx that was generated from an HTML slide deck and asks to compare/audit/verify/fix the export — including phrases like "compare ppt with html", "fidelity audit", "fix the pptx", "ppt is cut off", "footer overlap", "italic missing in pptx", "re-export the deck", "pptx-html-fidelity-audit", or any case where a python-pptx → HTML round-trip needs verification or repair. Also trigger when the user shows you a deck.html and a deck.pptx side by side and is debugging visual differences.
description_zh: 审计 python-pptx 导出与源 HTML 幻灯片之间的差异，识别布局与内容漂移（页脚溢出、内容被截断、缺少斜体/强调、样式丢失、间距节奏失调），并以严格的页脚轨与光标流布局纪律重新导出。当用户拥有由 HTML 幻灯片生成的 .pptx，并要求对导出结果进行比较、审计、验证或修复时，应使用本技能——包括诸如“对比 ppt 与 html”、“保真度审计”、“修复 pptx”、“ppt 被截断”、“页脚重叠”、“pptx 中缺少斜体”、“重新导出演示文稿”、“pptx-html-fidelity-audit”等表述，以及任何需要验证或修复 python-pptx → HTML 往返过程出现问题的场景。此外，当用户将 deck.html 与 deck.pptx 并排展示，并正在调试视觉差异时，也应触发本技能。

description: CRITICAL: Use for ownership/borrow/lifetime issues. Triggers: E0382, E0597, E0506, E0507, E0515, E0716, E0106, value moved, borrowed value does not live long enough, cannot move out of, use of moved value, ownership, borrow, lifetime, 'a, 'static, move, clone, Copy, 所有权, 借用, 生命周期
description_zh: 关键：用于所有权/借用/生命周期问题。触发：E0382, E0597, E0506, E0507, E0515, E0716, E0106, 值移动, 借用值生命周期不足, 无法移出, 使用移动后的值, 所有权, 借用, 生命周期, 'a, 'static, 移动, 克隆, 复制, 所有权, 借用, 生命周期

description: Delegate a coding task to the Cursor Agent CLI (`cursor-agent`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Cursor — phrasings like "have Cursor implement X", "delegate this to Cursor", "run it through Cursor Agent", or "use Cursor to implement/fix/refactor" — or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Cursor while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh:
将编程任务作为后台实现者委派给 Cursor Agent CLI（`cursor-agent`），然后审查其差异并自行落地。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Cursor 时，请使用此功能——例如，当用户使用“让 Cursor 实现 X”、“将此任务委派给 Cursor”、“通过 Cursor Agent 处理”或“使用 Cursor 实现/修复/重构”等表述，或希望将一系列编程任务通过 Cursor 处理但仍作为审查者时，即需使用此功能。

不要用于足够小可直接在本地完成的任务，也不要在用户要求无需委派即可直接编写代码时使用。

description: Migrate a file to use stricter Pyrefly type checking with annotations required for all functions, classes, and attributes.
description_zh: 迁移文件，使用更严格的 Pyrefly 类型检查，要求所有函数、类和属性都必须提供注解。

description:
Professional editing and proofreading for clarity, grammar, style, and readability improvements.
Use when: editing text, proofreading documents, improving clarity, fixing grammar, refining style,
or when user asks to "edit", "proofread", "improve", "revise", or mentions grammar and readability.
description_zh:
针对清晰度、语法、风格及可读性进行专业编辑与校对，以提升文本质量。
适用场景：编辑文本、校对文档、提升清晰度、纠正语法、优化风格，或当用户要求"编辑"、"校对"、"改善"、"修订"，或提及语法与可读性时。

description: Fetch Twitter/X post content including long-form Articles with full images and metadata. Use when Claude needs to retrieve tweet/article content, author info, engagement metrics, and embedded media. Supports individual posts and X Articles (long-form content). Automatically downloads all images to local attachments folder and generates complete Markdown with proper image references. Preferred over Jina for X Articles with images.
description_zh: 获取包含完整图片和元数据的 Twitter/X 帖子内容，包括长文文章。当 Claude 需要获取推文/文章内容、作者信息、互动指标和内嵌媒体时使用。支持单个帖子及 X 文章（长文内容）。自动将所有图片下载至本地附件文件夹，并生成包含正确图片引用的完整 Markdown 内容。对于带图片的 X 文章，优先于 Jina 使用。

description: Implement, review, or improve Live Activities and Dynamic Island experiences in iOS apps using ActivityKit. Use when building real-time updating widgets for the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island — delivery tracking, sports scores, ride-sharing status, workout timers, media playback, or any time-sensitive information that updates in real time. Also use when working with ActivityKit, ActivityAttributes, Activity lifecycle (request/update/end), Dynamic Island layouts (compact/minimal/expanded), push-to-update Live Activities, or Lock Screen live widgets.
description_zh: 使用 ActivityKit 实现、审查或改进 iOS 应用中的“实时活动（Live Activities）”与“灵动岛（Dynamic Island）”体验。适用于在锁屏（Lock Screen）与灵动岛中构建实时更新的小组件——包括配送追踪、体育比分、网约车状态、运动计时器、媒体播放以及任何需要实时更新的时效性信息。当使用 ActivityKit、ActivityAttributes、活动生命周期（请求/更新/结束）或灵动岛布局（紧凑/简约/展开式），以及锁屏实时小组件时，也应使用本功能。

description: Diagnostic guide for active Prometheus cardinality problems — slow queries, OOMing Prometheus, high Grafana Cloud Active Series or DPM bills, "too many samples" ingest errors, series churn, or rapid memory growth. Walks through tsdb status endpoints, per-metric and per-label drill-downs, common-culprit galleries, and remediation paths. Use when the user is *currently experiencing* a cardinality fire. For preventing cardinality issues at the source, route to prometheus-label-strategy. For post-ingest aggregation, route to adaptive-metrics. For DPM-specific analysis, route to dpm-finder.
description_zh:
**活跃的 Prometheus 基数问题诊断指南** —— 慢查询、Prometheus 发生 OOM、Grafana Cloud 活跃序列或 DPM 账单过高、“样本过多”摄入错误、序列频繁变动或内存快速增长。本指南详细梳理 tsdb 状态端点、按指标与按标签的逐项排查、常见元凶库以及修复路径。

当用户*当前正经历*基数（基数）爆发时，请使用本指南。用于从源头预防基数问题的，请路由至 prometheus-label-strategy；用于摄入后聚合的，请路由至 adaptive-metrics；用于 DPM 专项分析的，请路由至 dpm-finder。

description: 서울 따릉이 실시간 대여소의 대여 가능 자전거와 빈 거치대를 좌표 주변 또는 대여소 이름으로 조회한다.
description_zh: 首尔泰朗通过坐标周边或租赁站名称，查询实时租赁站的可租赁自行车与空停车桩。

description: Generate code using nx generators. INVOKE IMMEDIATELY when user mentions scaffolding, setup, structure, creating apps/libs, or setting up project structure. Trigger words - scaffold, setup, create a new app, create a new lib, project structure, generate, add a new project. ALWAYS use this BEFORE calling nx_docs or exploring - this skill handles discovery internally.
description_zh: 使用 nx 生成器生成代码。当用户提到搭建脚手架、设置、结构、创建应用/库，或设置项目结构时，立即调用。触发词——搭建脚手架、设置、创建新应用、创建新库、项目结构、生成、添加新项目。始终在调用 nx_docs 或进行探索之前使用此技能——该技能在内部处理发现。

description: Check when Salesforce orgs expire (or already expired) and what to do about it, for one org, the default org, or across all authenticated orgs, using the Salesforce CLI (sf). Use when the user asks about org or trial expiration, "when does my trial expire", "is my trial org still active", "how many days are left", "which orgs are expiring soon", wants to filter orgs expiring within N days, needs machine-readable (JSON/CSV) output for cron or alerting, wants to back up an at-risk org before it lapses, or asks how to extend or renew an expiring trial or Developer Edition org. Covers trial editions, Developer Edition orgs (anything with a TrialExpirationDate), and scratch orgs (via sf org list). DO NOT TRIGGER for sandbox refresh timing, for creating, deleting, or switching the active org, or for non-Salesforce trials such as AWS, Netflix, or other vendors — this skill reads expiration and prints guidance, it does not modify orgs.
description_zh: 使用 Salesforce CLI (sf) 检查 Salesforce 组织（或已过期的组织）的过期时间及处理方式，可针对单个组织、默认组织或所有已验证组织。当用户询问组织或试用到期情况，例如“我的试用何时过期”、“我的试用组织是否仍然有效”、“还剩多少天”、“哪些组织即将过期”、“需要过滤在 N 天内过期的组织”、“需要供 cron 或告警使用的机器可读（JSON/CSV）输出”、“希望在试用期或开发者版组织过期前备份有风险的组织”，或询问如何延长或续期即将过期的试用或开发者版组织时使用。涵盖试用版本、开发者版组织（任何带有 TrialExpirationDate 的组织）以及通过 sf org list 列出的临时组织。请勿针对沙箱刷新时间、创建、删除或切换当前组织，以及 AWS、Netflix 或其他供应商的非 Salesforce 试用触发本技能——本技能仅读取过期信息并打印指导，不会修改组织。

description: Apple Human Interface Guidelines as 14 agent skills covering platforms, foundations, components, patterns, inputs, and technologies for iOS, macOS, visionOS, watchOS, and tvOS.
description_zh: 苹果人机界面指南作为14项智能体技能，涵盖针对iOS、macOS、visionOS、watchOS和tvOS的平台、基础、组件、模式、输入与技术。

description: When the user wants to plan or optimize paid user acquisition campaigns. Also use when the user mentions "Apple Search Ads", "user acquisition", "paid ads", "UA", "ad campaign", "install campaign", "Facebook ads for apps", "TikTok ads", or "cost per install". For organic growth, see aso-audit. For launch-specific UA, see app-launch.
description_zh: 当用户需要规划或优化付费用户获取活动时，以及当用户提及“苹果搜索广告”、“用户获取”、“付费广告”、“UA”、“广告活动”、“安装活动”、“面向应用的Facebook广告”、“TikTok广告”或“每次安装成本”时，也使用。关于自然增长，请参阅aso-audit。关于启动期特定的用户获取（UA），请参阅app-launch。

description: Upgrade the Sentry JavaScript SDK across major versions. Use when asked to upgrade Sentry, migrate to a newer version, fix deprecated Sentry APIs, or resolve breaking changes after a Sentry version bump.
description_zh: 在所有主要版本中升级 Sentry JavaScript SDK。当被要求升级 Sentry、迁移到更新版本、修复已弃用的 Sentry API，或解决 Sentry 版本升级后的破坏性变更时使用。

description: When the user wants to analyze, respond to, or improve their app reviews and ratings. Also use when the user mentions "reviews", "ratings", "negative reviews", "how to get more reviews", "review response", or "my rating is dropping". For broader ASO audit, see aso-audit. For retention issues causing bad reviews, see retention-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要分析、回复或改进其应用评论与评分时。当用户提及“评论”、“评分”、“差评”、“如何获得更多评论”、“评论回复”或“我的评分正在下降”时，也使用此功能。如需更广泛的ASO审计，参见aso-audit。若因留存问题导致差评，参见retention-optimization。

description: Author, audit, and improve Grafana SKILL.md files against Anthropic's published Agent Skills guidance and the four-dimension rubric the grafana/skills CI gate uses (conciseness, actionability, workflow clarity, progressive disclosure). Applies the canonical SKILL.md structure (YAML frontmatter + body + references/ + scripts/ + assets/), the "pushy description" trigger pattern, the three-level progressive-disclosure model, and the validate-fix-rerun feedback loop. Use when creating a new skill in this repo, when reviewing a skill PR, when a skill's Tessl review score is below 75 (the merge gate), when a skill's description isn't getting picked up by agents, when restructuring a long SKILL.md into a bundle, or when the user asks how to write, improve, optimize, audit, or fix a skill - even if they don't say "skill" explicitly (e.g. "this isn't triggering", "Tessl scored this 72", "split this doc").
description_zh:
根据 Anthropic 发布的 Agent Skills 指导以及 grafana/skills CI 门禁所使用的四维评分标准（简洁性、可操作性、工作流清晰度、渐进式披露），对 Grafana SKILL.md 文件进行编写、审计与优化。

应用标准 SKILL.md 结构（YAML 前缀 + 正文 + references/ + scripts/ + assets/）、"pushy description"触发模式、三级渐进式披露模型以及验证-修复-重运行反馈循环。

在以下情况下使用：在本仓库中创建新技能时、审查技能 PR 时、技能 Tessl 评审分数低于 75（合并门禁）时、技能的描述未被 Agent 识别时、将冗长的 SKILL.md 重构为功能包时，或者用户询问如何编写、改进、优化、审计或修复技能时——即使用户并未明确提及"技能"（例如："这没有触发"、"Tessl 给这个评分为 72 分"、"把这个文档拆分一下"）。

description: CRITICAL: Use for generics, traits, zero-cost abstraction. Triggers: E0277, E0308, E0599, generic, trait, impl, dyn, where, monomorphization, static dispatch, dynamic dispatch, impl Trait, trait bound not satisfied, 泛型, 特征, 零成本抽象, 单态化
description_zh: 关键：用于泛型、特征、零成本抽象。触发条件：E0277、E0308、E0599、泛型、特征、impl、dyn、where、单态化、静态分发、动态分发、impl Trait、特征边界未满足、泛型、特征、零成本抽象、单态化

description: Implement, review, or improve CloudKit and iCloud sync in iOS/macOS apps. Use when working with CKContainer, CKRecord, CKQuery, CKSubscription, CKSyncEngine, CKShare, NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore, or iCloud Drive file coordination; when syncing SwiftData models via ModelConfiguration with cloudKitDatabase; when handling CKError codes for conflict resolution, network failures, or quota limits; or when checking iCloud account status before performing sync operations.
description_zh: 在 iOS/macOS 应用中实现、审查或改进 CloudKit 与 iCloud 同步功能。当涉及 CKContainer、CKRecord、CKQuery、CKSubscription、CKSyncEngine、CKShare、NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore 或 iCloud Drive 文件协调；通过 ModelConfiguration 使用 cloudKitDatabase 同步 SwiftData 模型；处理 CKError 代码以解决冲突、网络故障或配额限制；或执行同步操作前检查 iCloud 账户状态时使用。

description: freee-mcp / freee-sign-mcp と連携するスキル。会計・人事労務・請求書・工数管理・販売・IT管理・固定資産・業務委託管理・サーベイ・開業・人事評価・申告・サイン（電子契約）の詳細APIリファレンスと使い方ガイドを提供。freee の経費申請・取引登録・勤怠打刻・給与明細・見積書・試算表・仕訳・従業員管理・工数登録・売上管理・SaaSアカウント管理・備品管理・固定資産管理・業務委託先の企業ユーザー/部門管理・サーベイ企画/実施回の取得・開業申請用データの参照/更新・人事評価結果の取得・法人税申告データや帳票の参照・電子契約の文書管理などの操作やAPI仕様を調べたいときに使う。ユーザーが freee のデータ操作、会計処理、人事労務管理、請求・見積、プロジェクト工数管理、販売管理、IT管理、固定資産管理、業務委託管理、サーベイ、開業、人事評価、申告、電子契約について質問や操作を依頼してきた場合は、明示的に freee と言及していなくても、このスキルの利用を検討すること。サインは別途 freee-sign-mcp の設定が必要。
description_zh: 与 freee-mcp / freee-sign-mcp 联动的技能。提供会计、人事劳务、发票、工时管理、销售、IT管理、固定资产、业务委托管理、调查、开业、人事评价、申报、签署（电子合同）的详细API参考与使用指南。当需要查询 freee 的经费申请、交易登记、勤怠打卡、工资明细、报价单、试算表、记账、员工管理、工时登记、销售管理、SaaS账户管理、备件管理、固定资产管理、业务委托方的企业用户/部门管理、调查企划/执行批次获取、开业申请数据参照/更新、人事评价结果获取、法人税申报数据和票据的参照、电子合同文档管理等操作或API规范时使用。当用户针对 freee 的数据操作、会计处理、人事劳务管理、请款、报价、项目工时管理、销售管理、IT管理、固定资产管理、业务委托管理、调查、开业、人事评价、申报、电子合同等方面提出疑问或操作请求时，即使没有明确提及 freee，也应考虑使用此技能。签署需要另外配置 freee-sign-mcp。

description: Triages GitHub issues by routing to oncall teams, applying labels, and closing questions. Use when processing new PyTorch issues or when asked to triage an issue.
description_zh: 通过对 GitHub 问题进行分诊，将问题路由到值班团队、应用标签并关闭问题。用于处理新的 PyTorch 问题，或当被要求分诊问题时。

description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams from text content. Supports three output modes - Obsidian (.md), Standard (.excalidraw), and Animated (.excalidraw with animation order). Triggers on "Excalidraw", "画图", "流程图", "思维导图", "可视化", "diagram", "标准Excalidraw", "standard excalidraw", "Excalidraw动画", "动画图", "animate".
description_zh: 从文本内容生成 Excalidraw 图表。支持三种输出模式——Obsidian（.md）、标准（.excalidraw）和动画（.excalidraw，带动画顺序）。触发关键词包括“Excalidraw”、“画图”、“流程图”、“思维导图”、“可视化”、“diagram”、“标准Excalidraw”、“standard excalidraw”、“Excalidraw动画”、“动画图”、“animate”。

description: Always use this skill when the user wants to create a new Figma Design, FigJam, or Slides file. You MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `create_new_file` tool call.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建新的Figma设计、FigJam或Slides文件时，始终使用本技能。您必须在每次调用`create_new_file`工具之前调用本技能。

description: Create and manage Kibana connectors for Slack, PagerDuty, Jira, webhooks, and more via REST API or Terraform. Use when configuring third-party integrations or managing connectors as code.
description_zh: 通过 REST API 或 Terraform 创建和管理用于 Slack、PagerDuty、Jira、Webhooks 等服务的 Kibana 连接器。配置第三方集成或以代码方式管理连接器时使用。

description: Create Vega and Vega-Lite visualizations with ES|QL data sources in Kibana. Use when building custom charts, dashboards, or programmatic panel layouts beyond standard Lens charts.
description_zh: 在 Kibana 中使用 ES\QL 数据源创建 Vega 和 Vega-Lite 可视化。适用于构建自定义图表、仪表板，或用于标准 Lens 图表之外的程序化面板布局。

description: Creates and maintains Figma Code Connect template files that map Figma components to code snippets. Use when the user mentions Code Connect, Figma component mapping, design-to-code translation, or asks to create/update .figma.ts or .figma.js files.
description_zh: 创建并维护将 Figma 组件映射到代码片段、并关联 Figma Code Connect 模板文件的文件。当用户提及 Code Connect、Figma 组件映射、设计到代码的转换，或要求创建/更新 .figma.ts 或 .figma.js 文件时使用。

description: Configure specific Sentry features beyond basic SDK setup. Use when asked to set up OpenTelemetry pipelines, create alerts and notifications, or set up Sentry Snapshots.
description_zh: 在基础SDK设置之外，配置特定的Sentry功能。当需要配置OpenTelemetry管道、创建告警和通知，或设置Sentry快照时使用。

description: Assists in provisioning instances and databases, designing performant schemas, and querying data in Spanner. Use when designing primary keys, writing SQL queries or client library code, or diagnosing performance issues.
description_zh: 协助配置实例和数据库，设计高性能表结构，并查询 Spanner 中的数据。用于设计主键、编写 SQL 查询或客户端库代码，或诊断性能问题。

description: Generate database migrations for a Medusa module
description_zh: 为 Medusa 模块生成数据库迁移。

description: Create user stories following the 3 C's (Card, Conversation, Confirmation) and INVEST criteria with descriptions, design links, and acceptance criteria. Use when writing user stories, breaking down features into backlog items, or defining acceptance criteria.
description_zh: 按照3C原则（卡片、对话、确认）和INVEST标准创建用户故事，包含描述、设计链接和验收标准。用于撰写用户故事、将功能拆解为待办事项，或定义验收标准时。

description: Analyze recent code changes via git history and extract software engineering lessons. Use when the user asks 'what is the lesson here?', 'what can I learn from this?', 'engineering takeaway', 'what did I just learn?', 'reflect on this code', or wants to extract principles from recent work.
description_zh: 分析最近代码更改的Git历史，并提取软件工程经验。当用户询问“这里有什么经验？”、“我能从中学到什么？”、“工程收获”、“我刚学到了什么？”或“反思这段代码”，或想从近期工作中提取原则时使用。

description: CRITICAL: Use for type-driven design. Triggers: type state, PhantomData, newtype, marker trait, builder pattern, make invalid states unrepresentable, compile-time validation, sealed trait, ZST, 类型状态, 新类型模式, 类型驱动设计
description_zh: 关键：用于类型驱动设计。触发条件：类型状态、PhantomData、新类型、标记特质、构建器模式、使无效状态无法表示、编译时验证、密封特质、ZST、类型状态、新类型模式、类型驱动设计。

description: Debug AOTInductor (AOTI) errors and crashes. Use when encountering AOTI segfaults, device mismatch errors, constant loading failures, or runtime errors from aot_compile, aot_load, aoti_compile_and_package, or aoti_load_package.
description_zh: 调试 AOTInductor (AOTI) 错误和崩溃。在遇到 AOTI 段错误、设备不匹配错误、常量加载失败，或 aot_compile、aot_load、aoti_compile_and_package、aoti_load_package 的运行时错误时使用。

description: Build native-feeling, benchmark-quality mobile app screens (Expo / React Native). Use when designing or implementing any mobile UI — screens, flows, onboarding, paywalls, tab bars, sheets, settings, empty states — or when polishing motion, navigation, typography, dark mode, or perceived performance. Enforces Apple HIG fidelity, semantic colors, native controls, anti-slop discipline, navigation semantics (push vs replace, modal vs sheet vs overlay, the one-way doors where back must not exist), purposeful Reanimated motion, a full-motion simulator-verified iteration loop, and a study-real-apps-first workflow (pairs with the Appllama MCP). Trigger on "build a screen", "make this screen better", "design the onboarding", "wire up this flow", "polish the UI", "make it feel native", or any mobile design/implementation task.
description_zh: 构建具有原生质感、基准质量的移动应用界面（支持 Expo / React Native）。适用于设计或实现任何移动 UI（屏幕、流程、引导、付费墙、标签栏、浮动面板、设置、空状态等），或用于优化动效、导航、排版、深色模式或感知性能。强制执行 Apple HIG 忠实度、语义化配色、原生控件、无拖沓原则、导航语义（推送与替换、模态、面板与覆盖层，以及必须不存在返回按钮的单向门禁）、有目的性的 Reanimated 动效、全动效模拟器验证的迭代循环，以及研究真实应用优先的工作流程（与 Appllama MCP 配合使用）。当出现“构建界面”、“优化该界面”、“设计引导流程”、“配置该流程”、“优化界面”、“让其更具原生感”，或任何移动设计/实现任务时触发。

description: Binance Spot request using the Binance API. Authentication requires API key and secret key. Supports testnet, mainnet, and demo.
description_zh: 使用 Binance API 发起 Binance Spot 请求。认证需要 API 密钥和秘密密钥。支持测试网、主网和演示环境。

description: Diagnose and resolve Elasticsearch security errors: 401/403 failures, TLS problems, expired API keys, role mapping mismatches, and Kibana login issues. Use when the user reports a security error.
description_zh: 诊断并解决 Elasticsearch 安全错误：401/403 失败、TLS 问题、已过期的 API 密钥、角色映射不匹配以及 Kibana 登录问题。当用户报告安全错误时使用。

description: A decision-support framework that evaluates systems, architectures, and strategies through the entropy (decay) vs negentropy (growth) lens, while surfacing tacit knowledge gaps. Use this skill whenever the user is making architecture decisions, evaluating system designs, reviewing technical approaches, choosing between options, auditing existing systems, or planning strategies. Also trigger when the user explicitly asks to "apply the negentropy lens", mentions "entropy", "negentropy", "tacit knowledge", "knowledge engine", or "flip the switch". Nudge activation when you detect the user is at a decision point — even if they haven't asked for this lens — by briefly noting the entropic/negentropic dimension before proceeding.
description_zh: 一个通过熵（衰退）与负熵（增长）的视角评估系统、架构和策略，并揭示隐性知识差距的决策支持框架。当用户进行架构决策、评估系统设计方案、审查技术方案、在选项间做出选择、审计现有系统或制定策略时，请使用此技能。当用户明确要求“应用负熵视角”、提及“熵”、“负熵”、“隐性知识”、“知识引擎”或“切换开关”时，也请触发该技能。当检测到用户处于决策点——即使他们尚未要求此视角——时，请在继续操作前简要说明熵/负熵维度，以提示激活该技能。

description: Use this skill when the user wants to retrieve a URL without a full browser session: fetch HTML or JSON from static pages, inspect status codes or headers, follow redirects, or get page source for simple scraping. Prefer it over a browser when JavaScript rendering and page interaction are not needed. Supports proxies and redirect control.
description_zh: 当用户需要在不具备完整浏览器会话的情况下获取URL时使用此技能：从静态页面获取HTML或JSON、检查状态码或请求头、跟随重定向，或获取页面源代码以供简单抓取。当不需要JavaScript渲染和页面交互时，优先于使用浏览器。支持代理和重定向控制。

description: Sets up and manages ClickHouse using the clickhousectl CLI — installs and runs a local ClickHouse server for development, and creates managed ClickHouse Cloud services for production (authentication, service creation, schema migration, application connection). Use when the user wants to build an application with ClickHouse, set up a local ClickHouse dev environment, create tables and start querying, deploy ClickHouse to production or ClickHouse Cloud, or migrate from a local setup to the cloud.
description_zh: 使用 clickhousectl CLI 搭建和管理 ClickHouse —— 为开发安装并运行本地 ClickHouse 服务器，并为生产环境创建托管的 ClickHouse 云服务（涵盖认证、服务创建、模式迁移、应用连接）。适用于用户需要基于 ClickHouse 构建应用程序、搭建本地 ClickHouse 开发环境、创建表并开始查询，或将 ClickHouse 部署到生产环境或 ClickHouse 云，以及从本地环境迁移至云端时使用。

description: CRITICAL: Use for smart pointers and resource management. Triggers: Box, Rc, Arc, Weak, RefCell, Cell, smart pointer, heap allocation, reference counting, RAII, Drop, should I use Box or Rc, when to use Arc vs Rc, 智能指针, 引用计数, 堆分配
description_zh: 重要提示：用于智能指针和资源管理。触发条件：Box, Rc, Arc, Weak, RefCell, Cell, 智能指针, 堆分配, 引用计数, RAII, Drop, 应该使用Box还是Rc，何时使用Arc而不是Rc，智能指针, 引用计数, 堆分配

description: Optimizes, improves, and debugs LLM prompts using production trace data, evaluations, and annotations. Extracts prompts from spans, gathers performance signal, and runs a data-driven optimization loop using the ax CLI. Use when the user mentions optimize prompt, improve prompt, make AI respond better, improve output quality, prompt engineering, prompt tuning, or system prompt improvement.
description_zh: 使用生产环境追踪数据、评估及标注，对大语言模型（LLM）提示词进行优化、改进与调试。从代码片段中提取提示词，收集性能信号，并使用 ax CLI 工具运行基于数据的优化循环。当用户提及优化提示词、改进提示词、让 AI 响应更佳、提升输出质量、提示词工程、提示词调优或系统提示词优化时使用。

description: Build custom components that integrate with Mantine's theming, Styles API, and core features. Use this skill when: (1) creating a new component using factory(), polymorphicFactory(), or genericFactory(), (2) adding Styles API support (classNames, styles, vars, unstyled), (3) implementing CSS variables via createVarsResolver, (4) building compound components with sub-components and shared context, (5) registering a component with MantineProvider via Component.extend(), or (6) any task involving Factory, useProps, useStyles, BoxProps, StylesApiProps, or ElementProps in @mantine/core.
description_zh:
构建集成 Mantine 主题、样式 API 和核心功能的自定义组件。在以下场景使用本技能：
(1) 使用 factory()、polymorphicFactory() 或 genericFactory() 创建新组件，
(2) 添加 Styles API 支持（classNames、styles、vars、unstyled），
(3) 通过 createVarsResolver 实现 CSS 变量，
(4) 借助子组件和共享上下文构建复合组件，
(5) 通过 Component.extend() 将组件注册到 MantineProvider，
(6) 在 @mantine/core 中执行涉及 Factory、useProps、useStyles、BoxProps、StylesApiProps 或 ElementProps 的任何任务。

description: Audit cross-platform attribution, conversion definitions, reporting windows, GA4, AdServices and AdAttributionKit, MMPs, browser and server events, offline conversions, and platform reconciliation. Use for attribution audit, attribution models, conversion windows, requests to add or total Meta and Google conversions, incompatible reporting-window aggregation, GA4 attribution, MMP review, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Singular, or cross-platform discrepancies.
description_zh: 审计跨平台归因、转化定义、报告窗口、GA4、AdServices和AdAttributionKit、MMPs、浏览器和服务器事件、离线转化及平台对账。用于归因审计、归因模型、转化窗口、请求添加或汇总Meta和Google的转化、不兼容报告窗口的汇总、GA4归因、MMP审查、AppsFlyer、Adjust、Branch、Singular或跨平台差异。

description: Build and deploy a paid API that other agents can pay to use via x402. Use when you or the user want to monetize an API, make money, earn money, offer a service, sell a service to other agents, charge for endpoints, create a paid endpoint, or set up a paid service. Covers "make money by offering an endpoint", "sell a service", "monetize your data", "create a paid API".
description_zh: 构建并部署一个付费API，其他代理可以通过x402付费使用。适用于当您或用户希望货币化API、赚钱、创收、提供服务、向其他代理出售服务、对接口收费、创建付费接口或设置付费服务时使用。涵盖“通过提供接口赚钱”、“出售服务”、“货币化您的数据”、“创建付费API”。
