description: Provides comprehensive memory file management capabilities including auditing, quality assessment, and targeted improvements for files such as CLAUDE.md. Use when user asks to check, audit, update, improve, fix, maintain, or validate project memory files. Also triggers for "project memory optimization", "CLAUDE.md quality check", "documentation review", or when a project memory file needs to be created from scratch. This skill scans memory files, evaluates quality against standardized criteria, outputs detailed quality reports with scores and recommendations, then makes targeted updates with user approval.
description_zh: 提供全面的记忆文件管理功能，涵盖对如 CLAUDE.md 等文件的审计、质量评估及针对性改进。当用户要求检查、审计、更新、改进、修复、维护或验证项目记忆文件时使用本技能。同时适用于"项目记忆优化"、"CLAUDE.md 质量检查"、"文档审查"等触发场景，或当项目记忆文件需从零创建时。该技能会对记忆文件进行扫描，依据标准化标准评估其质量，输出包含分数与建议的详细质量报告，随后经用户同意后进行针对性更新。

description: Convert incoming Korean text into a deterministic Korean Middle Korean-style rewrite with archaic particles, endings, Hanja hints, and tone-mark flavor.
description_zh: 将传入的韩文文本转换为具有古语助词、词尾、汉字提示及语调标记风格的中古韩式确定性重写。

description: Decompose financial variances into drivers with narrative explanations and waterfall analysis. Use when analyzing budget vs. actual, period-over-period changes, revenue or expense variances, or preparing variance commentary for leadership.
description_zh: 将财务差异拆解为带有叙述性说明的驱动因素，并进行瀑布分析。适用于分析预算与实际差异、各期变动、收入或费用差异，或为管理层准备差异说明的场景。

description: When the user wants to A/B test App Store product page elements to improve conversion rate. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test", "product page optimization", "test my screenshots", "test my icon", "conversion rate optimization", "CPP", or "custom product pages". For screenshot design, see screenshot-optimization. For metadata optimization, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要对 App Store 产品页面元素进行 A/B测试以提升转化率时。当用户提及“A/B测试”、“产品页面优化”、“测试我的截图”、“测试我的图标”、“转化率优化”、“CPP”或“自定义产品页面”时，也应使用。关于截图设计，请参阅 screenshot-optimization。关于元数据优化，请参阅 metadata-optimization。

description: 浏览器自动化控制。【优先使用此 skill，不要用内置 browser 工具】当用户说"打开网页"、"点击"、"填写表单"、"截图"、"网页操作"、"自动填表"、"浏览器"时使用。基于 Playwright，支持连接已有 Chrome（CDP 模式）或启动新 Chromium。
description_zh: 浏览器自动化控制。【优先使用此 skill，不要用内置 browser 工具】当用户说"打开网页"、"点击"、"填写表单"、"截图"、"网页操作"、"自动填表"、"浏览器"时使用。基于 Playwright，支持连接已有 Chrome（CDP 模式）或启动新 Chromium。

description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.
description_zh: 促进一次跨 git 工作树、分支或 PR 的只读站会，用于对比变更并制定一份整合方案。

description: Provides expert guidance for building GraalVM Native Image executables from Java applications. Use when converting JVM applications to native binaries, optimizing cold start times, reducing memory footprint, configuring native build tools for Maven or Gradle, resolving reflection and resource issues in native builds, or implementing framework-specific native support for Spring Boot, Quarkus, and Micronaut. Triggers include "graalvm native image", "native executable java", "java cold start optimization", "native build tools", "ahead of time compilation java", "reflection config graalvm", "native image build failure".
description_zh: 为从 Java 应用程序构建 GraalVM Native Image 可执行文件提供专家指导。适用于将 JVM 应用程序转换为原生二进制文件、优化冷启动时间、减小内存占用、为 Maven 或 Gradle 配置原生构建工具、解决原生构建中的反射与资源问题，以及为 Spring Boot、Quarkus 和 Micronaut 实现特定框架的原生支持。触发条件包括“graalvm native image”、“native executable java”、“java cold start optimization”、“native build tools”、“ahead of time compilation java”、“reflection config graalvm”、“native image build failure”。

description: Create and develop external Paperclip plugins with the CLI-first workflow. Use when scaffolding a plugin, iterating on a local plugin, installing it into Paperclip, or updating plugin authoring docs.
description_zh: 使用以命令行（CLI）优先的工作流创建和开发外部 Paperclip 插件。在搭建插件、迭代本地插件、将其安装到 Paperclip 或更新插件编写文档时使用。

description: Routes broad or ambiguous Sent requests to the correct MCP-backed operation or specialist skill. Use when the user asks what Sent can do, says "help me with Sent" or "set up messaging," needs several Sent workflows, or has not made the channel, task, or desired operation clear enough to select a more specific skill.
description_zh: 将宽泛或含义模糊的 Sent 请求路由至正确的 MCP 支持流程或专业技能。在用户询问 Sent 能做什么、说"帮我使用 Sent"或"设置消息功能"、需要多个 Sent 工作流，或尚未将渠道、任务或期望操作清晰到足以选择更具体技能的场景时使用。

description: Configures AWS Transit Gateway: creating a hub and attaching VPCs, segmenting traffic with route tables, centralizing egress and inspection through a hub (appliances or a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint), forcing east-west traffic between VPCs through AWS Network Firewall, connecting on-premises networks over the transit-gateway side of a Site-to-Site VPN or Direct Connect attachment (including ECMP to aggregate bandwidth across multiple VPN tunnels), peering transit gateways across Regions, migrating from a VPC peering mesh, and routing IP multicast. Applicable when connecting many VPCs through one router, isolating environments, forcing VPC-to-VPC traffic through a central Network Firewall, reaching on-premises over the hub, linking Regions, or moving off a peering mesh. Not applicable for single-VPC routing, VPC peering between two VPCs (vpcpeering skill), Direct Connect gateway or virtual interface setup (directconnect skill), or Route 53 DNS work.
description_zh: 配置 AWS 传送网关：创建枢纽并附加 VPC，使用路由表对流量进行分段，通过枢纽集中出口流量和检查（应用设备或网关负载均衡器端点），通过 AWS 网络防火墙强制 VPC 之间的东西向流量，通过 Site-to-Site VPN 或 Direct Connect 附件的传送网关侧连接本地网络（包括使用 ECMP 合并多个 VPN 隧道的带宽），跨区域对等连接传送网关，从 VPC 对等连接网络迁移，并路由 IP 多播。适用场景包括：通过一个路由器连接多个 VPC、隔离环境、通过中央网络防火墙强制 VPC 之间的流量、通过枢纽连接本地网络、连接区域，或脱离对等连接网络。不适用于单 VPC 路由、两个 VPC 之间的 VPC 对等连接（vpcpeering 技能）、Direct Connect 网关或虚拟接口设置（directconnect 技能），以及 Route 53 DNS 操作。

description: Build Unity games with optimized C# scripts, efficient rendering, and proper asset management. Masters Unity 6 LTS, URP/HDRP pipelines, and cross-platform deployment. Handles gameplay systems, UI implementation, and platform optimization. Use PROACTIVELY for Unity performance issues, game mechanics, or cross-platform builds.
description_zh: 运用优化后的C#脚本、高效的渲染和合理的资源管理，构建Unity游戏。精通Unity 6 LTS、URP/HDRP管线及跨平台部署。负责游戏玩法系统、UI实现及平台优化。针对Unity性能问题、游戏机制或跨平台构建，积极主动地解决。

description: Analyze stock correlations to find related companies and trading pairs. Use when the user asks about correlated stocks, related companies, sector peers, trading pairs, or how two or more stocks move together. Triggers: "what correlates with NVDA", "find stocks related to AMD", "correlation between AAPL and MSFT", "what moves with", "sector peers", "pair trading", "correlated stocks", "when NVDA drops what else drops", "stocks that move together", "beta to", "relative performance", "supply chain partners", "correlation matrix", "co-movement", "related tickers", "sympathy plays", "semiconductor peers", "hedging pair", "realized correlation", "rolling correlation", or any request about stocks that move in tandem or inversely. Also triggers for well-known pairs like AMD/NVDA, GOOGL/AVGO, LITE/COHR. If only one ticker is provided, infer the user wants correlated peers.
description_zh: 分析股票相关性，以查找相关公司和交易对。当用户询问相关股票、相关公司、同行业同行、交易对，或两支或多支股票如何同步波动时使用。触发词：“NVDA 的相关因素是什么”、“寻找与 AMD 相关的股票”、“AAPL 与 MSFT 之间的相关性”、“与什么同时波动”、“同行业同行”、“配对交易”、“相关股票”、“当 NVDA 下跌时，哪些股票也会下跌”、“同步波动的股票”、“相对于……的 beta”、“相对表现”、“供应链合作伙伴”、“相关性矩阵”、“共动性”、“相关股票代码”、“共鸣交易”、“半导体同行”、“对冲交易对”、“已实现相关性”、“滚动相关性”，或任何关于股票同步或反向波动的请求。此外，AMD/NVDA、GOOGL/AVGO、LITE/COHR 等知名交易对也为触发条件。如果只提供了单个股票代码，则推断用户需要相关同行。

description: Screen US stocks for high-quality dividend opportunities combining value characteristics (P/E ratio under 20, P/B ratio under 2), attractive yields (3% or higher), and consistent growth (dividend/revenue/EPS trending up over 3 years). Supports two-stage screening using FINVIZ Elite API for efficient pre-filtering followed by FMP API for detailed analysis. Use when user requests dividend stock screening, income portfolio ideas, or quality value stocks with strong fundamentals.

description: Capture a full DevTools-protocol trace of any browser automation — CDP firehose, screenshots, and DOM dumps — then bisect the stream into per-page searchable buckets. Use when the user wants to debug a failed run, audit network/console/DOM activity, attach a trace to an in-progress session, or feed structured per-page summaries back into an agent loop so its next iteration learns from the last one.
description_zh: 捕获所有浏览器自动化的完整 DevTools 协议追踪，涵盖 CDP 数据流、截图及 DOM 转储，随后将数据流分割为按页面划分的可搜索数据组。适用于用户需要调试失败的运行、审计网络/控制台/DOM 活动、将追踪附加到进行中的会话，或将结构化的按页面摘要反馈至智能体循环，从而让智能体的下一次迭代基于上一次迭代进行学习时使用。

description: Decide whether a token creator's NEXT launch is safe to buy. Scores a dev address 0-100 on two separate axes — CONDUCT (will he dump on you at open) and POWER (has he ever actually built anything big) — from his full launch history and every trade he made in his own coins, then returns a buy / don't-buy call with a timing window. USE THIS SKILL WHEN the user asks a buy-decision question about a launcher: "can I buy this dev's new launch", "should I buy his next launch", "will this dev rug", "will he dump at open", "is his launch safe to snipe", "is it safe to buy at his open", "dev score", "creator score", "launch score", "is this launcher trustworthy enough to buy"; OR when the user gives a TOKEN address plus a team-trust question ("is this token's team trustworthy", "does this project's dev have a record", "has this creator rugged before") — resolve the creator with `gmgn-cli token info` -> `dev.creator_address` first, then score that address; OR when the user gives a WALLET address plus an explicit launch-history question ("what tokens has this address launched", "how did his previous launches do", "did all his coins go to zero"). The same questions asked in any other language route here too — match on meaning, not on wording. DO NOT USE THIS SKILL for a bare wallet address with no question attached: a bare address is a copy-trade question by default and belongs to gmgn-wallet-analysis, which declares itself the default for it. Also do not use it for copy-trade questions ("is this wallet worth copying", "should I copy this wallet", "copy-trade score"), wallet profitability ("is this wallet profitable", "what is this wallet's track record"), or wallet-profile phrasings ("is this a token-creator wallet", "how is this dev's reputation") — those belong to gmgn-wallet-score. The split is by question type, not by address type: those skills answer "who is this wallet" (a profile), this skill answers "should I buy his launch" (a decision, with a timing window). Note how close "how is this dev's reputation" (profile → gmgn-wallet-score) sits to "dev score" (decision → here): the deciding factor is whether a buy is on the table. If it is genuinely ambiguous, ask one short question instead of guessing — the two produce different reports and there is no cheap hedge.
description_zh: 判断代币创作者下一次上线是否安全值得购买。根据该开发者的完整上线历史和其用自己的币进行的所有交易，对一个开发地址在两个独立维度上进行 0-100 的评分——品行（是否会在开盘时抛售你）和实力（是否曾真正构建过大型项目）——然后返回一个买入/不买入建议，并附带一个时间窗口。当用户就发币方提出买入决策问题时使用此技能：“我能否购买该开发者新的上线”、“是否应该购买他的下一次上线”、“这个开发者是否会 rug pull”、“他是否会在开盘时抛售”、“这个上线是否适合狙击”、“在他开盘时购买是否安全”、“开发评分”、“创作者评分”、“上线评分”、“这个发币方是否足够可信值得购买”；或者当用户提供 TOKEN 地址并附带团队信任问题时（“这个代币的团队是否可信”、“这个项目的开发者是否有记录”、“该创作者是否曾经 rug pull”——首先使用 `gmgn-cli token info` 获取 `dev.creator_address`，再对该地址进行评分）；或者当用户提供 WALLET 地址并附带明确的发币历史问题时（“这个地址上线了哪些代币”、“他的上一次上线表现如何”、“他的所有币种是否都归零了”）。以任何其他语言提出的相同问题，也应路由到此处——匹配依据是含义，而非措辞。请勿在无附带问题的纯钱包地址时使用此技能：纯地址默认为复制交易问题，应属于 gmgn-wallet-analysis，该技能声明其为默认处理。此外，请勿用于复制交易问题（“这个钱包是否值得复制”、“我是否应该复制这个钱包”、“复制交易评分”）、钱包盈利能力（“这个钱包是否盈利”、“这个钱包的历史表现如何”），或钱包档案类表述（“这个钱包是否是代币创作者钱包”、“这个开发者的声誉如何”）——这些问题属于 gmgn-wallet-score。划分依据是问题类型，而非地址类型：那些技能回答“这个钱包是谁”（档案），本技能回答“我应该购买他的上线”（决策，附带时间窗口）。注意“how is this dev's reputation”（档案 → gmgn-wallet-score）与“dev score”（决策 → 此处）的接近程度：决定性的因素是是否提出了购买方案。如果确实存在歧义，应提出一个简短的问题，而不是猜测——两者会产生不同的报告，且不存在便宜的妥协方案。

description: AI가 쓴 티가 나는 한국어 글을 자연스러운 사람 글로 고친다. 번역체, AI 상투어, 과도한 명사화·피동, 3의 법칙, 과장된 의의 부여, 마무리 상투구, 챗봇 잔재, 줄표·곡선따옴표 같은 한국어 특유의 AI 흔적을 심각도(S1/S2/S3)로 분류해 잡아내고 의미는 보존하면서 다시 쓴다. 목표 글자수를 함께 주면(예: "1000자로", length=1000) 그 분량에 맞춰 늘리거나 줄인다. "AI 티 안 나게", "사람이 쓴 것처럼", "자연스럽게 다듬어줘", "번역체 고쳐줘", "어색한 거 고쳐줘", "N자로 맞춰서" 같은 요청에 사용.
description_zh: 将带有AI痕迹的韩语文章修改为自然流畅的人工撰写的文章。针对翻译体、AI常用语、过度名词化与被动化、3的法则、过度赋予意义、收尾套路话、聊天机器人残留、换行符与曲线引号等韩语特有的AI痕迹，按严重程度（S1/S2/S3）分类提取，在保留原意的基础上重新撰写。若同时提供目标字数（例如“1000字”、length=1000），则按照该篇幅进行扩充或缩减。适用于“让文章不显AI痕迹”“像人工写的那样”“自然流畅地修改润色”“修改翻译体”“修正不自然的地方”“调整为N字格式”等请求场景。

description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".
description_zh:
将应用程序和网站部署到 Vercel。

当用户请求部署操作，如“部署我的应用”“部署并给我链接”“将其发布上线”或“创建预览部署”时使用。

description: Build and edit live Superwall paywalls from the CLI. Attach to a running browser editor session using a pairing code, list the tools the browser exposes right now, and invoke them. Covers native sw-* elements, editing workflow, design standards, and the attach/call/release lifecycle. Use whenever the user wants to design, build, modify, or review a Superwall paywall, onboarding, or web2app flow.
description_zh: 通过命令行界面（CLI）构建并编辑实时超级墙（Superwall）付费墙。使用配对代码连接到正在运行的浏览器编辑器会话，列出浏览器当前暴露的工具，并调用它们。涵盖原生 sw-* 元素、编辑工作流、设计标准以及附加/调用/释放的生命周期。当用户需要设计、构建、修改或审查超级墙付费墙、注册引导流程或 Web2App 流程时，请使用本功能。

description: Audit server-side paid-media measurement including server-side tag management, platform conversion APIs, event taxonomy, browser/server deduplication, consent, hashing, data quality, observability, and privacy. Use for server-side tracking, sGTM, server-side tagging, CAPI, Events API, event_id, pixel debugging, first-party measurement, or conversion data loss.
description_zh: 审计服务端付费媒体测量，包括服务端标签管理、平台转化API、事件分类、浏览器/服务端去重、用户同意、哈希、数据质量、可观测性与隐私。适用于服务端追踪、sGTM、服务端标签标记、CAPI、Events API、event_id、像素调试、第一方测量，或转化数据丢失等场景。

description: Diagnoses GKE JobSet interruptions, restarts, and preemptions for AI/ML training workloads autonomously. Use when troubleshooting JobSet restart loops, spot VM preemptions, node readiness failures, host VM issues, or coordinator worker crashes. Don't use for general GKE cluster creation, basic workload deployment, or non-JobSet application issues.
description_zh: 自主诊断 GKE JobSet 针对 AI/ML 训练工作负载的中断、重启和抢占。适用于排查 JobSet 重启循环、按量 VM 抢占、节点就绪失败、主机 VM 问题或协调器工作程序崩溃等问题。不适用于一般的 GKE 集群创建、基础工作负载部署或非 JobSet 应用程序问题。

description: Writes, classifies, validates, and repairs WhatsApp templates using the Sent v3 template definition contract. Use for utility, marketing, authentication, OTP, Meta review, rejected templates, variables, buttons, channel overrides, or submission-ready Sent payloads.
description_zh: 使用 Sent v3 模板定义契约编写、分类、校验并修复 WhatsApp 模板。适用于工具类、营销、身份验证、OTP、Meta 审核、被拒绝的模板、变量、按钮、渠道覆盖，或可直接提交的 Sent 负载。

description: Binance Pay Assistant - Send and Receive crypto payments. Send: QR code payment from Funding Wallet (C2C + PIX). Use when user wants to buy/purchase/pay/transfer/send, confirm/cancel payment, or query order status. Requires QR code data. PIX QR codes (pix, br.gov.bcb.pix) are auto-detected. Receive: Generate QR codes and payment links to collect crypto. Use when user wants to receive/collect payment (generate receive link, receive QR). Do NOT use for earning, buying/selling crypto, or digital goods.
description_zh:
Binance Pay Assistant - 发送和接收加密货币支付。

发送：从资金钱包（C2C + PIX）进行二维码支付。用户想要购买、付款、转账、发送，确认/取消支付，或查询订单状态时使用。需要二维码数据。PIX 二维码（pix、br.gov.bcb.pix）会自动识别。

接收：生成二维码和收款链接以收取加密货币。用户想要收款（生成收款链接、获取二维码）时使用。不得用于赚钱、买卖加密货币或数字商品。

description: Add and configure in-game voice chat and text chat for Unity multiplayer games using Unity Vivox. Covers microphone setup and mic permissions on Android/iOS, voice activity detection (VAD) tuning, voice volume and mute controls in a settings UI (VoiceVadMinimumVolume, mic slider, mute button, speaking indicator), proximity/3D spatial voice for FPS/co-op games, team/party/lobby/guild voice channels, push-to-talk, muting self and other players, whisper/direct messages, in-game text chat, and Vivox SDK init + Unity Authentication sign-in. Use when the user asks to add voice chat, voice comms, microphone/mic support, a voice-chat settings UI, mute button, VAD threshold, push-to-talk, proximity or spatial voice, team voice, party chat, lobby chat, direct messages, or mentions Vivox, VivoxService, com.unity.services.vivox, JoinGroupChannelAsync, JoinPositionalChannelAsync, LoginAsync, or migrating from legacy Vivox (Client.Instance / LoginSession / AccountId).
description_zh: 为使用 Unity Vivox 的 Unity 多人游戏添加并配置游戏内语音聊天与文字聊天。涵盖 Android/iOS 上的麦克风设置和麦克风权限、语音活动检测（VAD）调优、设置界面中的语音音量与静音控制（VoiceVadMinimumVolume、麦克风滑块、静音按钮、讲话指示器）、FPS/合作游戏中的邻近/3D空间语音、团队/派对/大厅/公会语音频道、语音按下说话、静音自己和其他玩家、暗语/直接消息、游戏内文字聊天，以及 Vivox SDK 初始化 + Unity 认证登录。当用户要求添加语音聊天、语音通信、麦克风/麦克风支持、语音聊天设置界面、静音按钮、VAD 阈值、语音按下说话、邻近或空间语音、团队语音、派对聊天、大厅聊天、直接消息，或提及 Vivox、VivoxService、com.unity.services.vivox、JoinGroupChannelAsync、JoinPositionalChannelAsync、LoginAsync，或从旧版 Vivox（Client.Instance / LoginSession / AccountId）迁移时使用。

description: Analyzes Sent message delivery, webhook, and activity data to explain funnel drop-offs, delivery failures, read-rate gaps, channel fallback, and suspicious performance changes. Use when a user says MDR, delivery report, message activity, webhook event, failed messages, low delivery rate, RCS fallback, WhatsApp read rate, SMS filtering, campaign performance, or asks why messages did not arrive.
description_zh: 分析 Sent 消息投递、webhook 和活动数据，以解释漏斗流失、投递失败、阅读率差距、渠道降级和可疑性能变化。当用户提及 MDR、投递报告、消息活动、webhook 事件、失败消息、低投递率、RCS 降级、WhatsApp 阅读率、SMS 过滤、活动效果，或询问消息为何未送达时使用。

description: Resolve PR review feedback. Use when addressing feedback already left on a PR. Not for reviewing the code before feedback exists; that is ce-code-review.
description_zh: 处理 PR 评审反馈。用于回应在 PR 上已留下的反馈。不用于在反馈存在之前审查代码；即 ce-code-review。

description: Create complete stylized 3D animated shorts from a story idea through an ordered production workflow covering project brief, story outline, character and environment cards, standardized shot planning, text or optional pencil storyboards, video-model selection, single-shot generation, assembly, BGM matching, and final review. Use when the user wants an end-to-end narrative animation workflow with strong character consistency, scene continuity, timing, camera, performance, and audio control. Not for single images, simple edits, photorealistic live action, or one standalone clip.
description_zh: 通过有序的制作工作流，从故事创意出发，创建完整的风格化3D动画短片，工作流涵盖项目简报、故事大纲、角色与环境设定卡、标准化镜头策划、文字或可选手绘分镜、视频模型选择、单镜头生成、合成、背景音乐匹配及最终审核。适用于用户需要端到端叙事动画工作流，且具备强大角色一致性、场景连贯性、节奏、镜头、表演及音频控制能力时使用。不适用于单张图片、简单编辑、写实类真人实拍或单一独立片段。

description: Guides current Sent RCS and RBM onboarding, launch evidence, carrier approval, text and suggestion-chip templates, Sender Profile readiness, and safe routing. Use for RCS launch, fallback, pinned-channel tests, or broadcast prevention.
description_zh: 指导当前 Sent RCS 与 RBM 的接入、发布证据、运营商审批、文本与建议标识模板、发送方资料就绪状态及安全路由。适用于 RCS 发布、降级、固定通道测试或广播拦截等场景。

description: Prepares and validates Sent US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration through Sender Profiles, including inheritance, all campaign use cases, opt-in evidence, sample-message policy, autoresponses, sandbox validation, TCR status, and rejection remediation.
description_zh: 通过发件人资料（Sender Profiles）准备并验证 Sent US A2P 10DLC 品牌和活动注册，涵盖继承、所有活动用例、选择加入（opt-in）证据、示例消息策略、自动回复、沙箱验证、TCR 状态以及拒收修复。

description: Generates a minimal, ready-to-develop SFDX starter project from template instead of hand-scaffolding files. Use this skill when starting a brand-new Salesforce UI bundle app (React or Angular) and the initial project must be scaffolded — trigger phrases include create, start, or scaffold a new UI bundle app, generate a starter project, or use a prebuilt/starter template. DO NOT TRIGGER when: editing, styling, or adding pages or components to an EXISTING app (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate); configuring ui-bundle.json or metadata files (use experience-ui-bundle-metadata-generate); deploying to an org (use experience-ui-bundle-deploy); or when the user explicitly says they want to hand-scaffold from scratch.
description_zh: 通过模板生成一个最小化、可立即开始开发的 SFDX 入门项目，而非手动搭建文件。当需要启动一个全新的 Salesforce UI 包应用（React 或 Angular），且需要初始化项目时，使用本技能——触发短语包括创建、启动或搭建新的 UI 包应用、生成入门项目或使用预构建/入门模板。请勿在以下情况下触发：编辑、样式设置或向已有应用添加页面或组件（使用 experience-ui-bundle-fronten-generate）；配置 ui-bundle.json 或元数据文件（使用 experience-ui-bundle-metadata-generate）；部署到组织（使用 experience-ui-bundle-deploy）；或用户明确表示需要从零手动搭建。

description: Install and authenticate Link CLI for agent payments, financial insights, or both. Use when a user is setting up Link CLI for the first time, asks to connect or log in to Link, or needs to configure Link access before using payment or financial-data features.
description_zh: 为代理支付、财务洞察，或二者兼具安装并认证 Link CLI。当用户首次设置 Link CLI、请求连接或登录 Link，或在调用支付或财务数据功能前需要配置 Link 访问权限时使用。

description: Designs Sent Sender Profile architecture for multi-tenant, multi-brand, and multi-channel systems. Use for API-key scoping, x-profile-id, isolation, inheritance, sharing, billing, WABA, 10DLC campaigns, webhooks, or tenant offboarding.
description_zh: 设计 Sent Sender Profile 架构，用于多租户、多品牌和多渠道系统。可用于 API 密钥作用域限定、x-profile-id、隔离、继承、共享、计费、WABA、10DLC 营销活动、Webhook 或租户退场。

description: Designs and audits tenant-facing Sent template builders, previews, validation, lifecycle UX, and API payload mapping. Use for template editor forms, variables, channel overrides, WhatsApp review, RCS suggestion chips, authentication templates, and safe submission flows.
description_zh: 设计并审计面向租户的 Sent 模板构建器、预览、校验、生命周期用户体验以及 API 载荷映射。用于模板编辑器表单、变量、渠道覆盖、WhatsApp 审核、RCS 建议芯片、认证模板以及安全提交流程。

description: Guides WhatsApp Business Account onboarding through Sent, separating dashboard Embedded Signup, organization WABA inheritance, and direct child-profile credentials. Use for WABA connection, Meta signup, profile creation, access-token handling, phone number mapping, completion callbacks, or WhatsApp onboarding failures.
description_zh: 通过Sent引导WhatsApp商务账号入驻，区分仪表盘内嵌注册、组织WABA继承以及直接子资料凭据。适用于WABA连接、Meta注册、资料创建、访问令牌处理、电话号码映射、完成回调或WhatsApp入驻失败场景。

description:
Generate or improve a company-specific data analysis skill by extracting tribal knowledge from analysts.
BOOTSTRAP MODE - Triggers: "Create a data context skill", "Set up data analysis for our warehouse", "Help me create a skill for our database", "Generate a data skill for [company]" → Discovers schemas, asks key questions, generates initial skill with reference files
ITERATION MODE - Triggers: "Add context about [domain]", "The skill needs more info about [topic]", "Update the data skill with [metrics/tables/terminology]", "Improve the [domain] reference" → Loads existing skill, asks targeted questions, appends/updates reference files
Use when data analysts want Claude to understand their company's specific data warehouse, terminology, metrics definitions, and common query patterns.
description_zh:
通过从分析师处提取公司内部“部落知识”，生成或改进针对特定公司的数据分析技能。

**初始化模式（BOOTSTRAP MODE）- 触发条件：“创建数据上下文技能”、“为我们的仓储设置数据分析”、“帮助我为数据库创建技能”、“为[公司]生成数据技能” → 发现数据模式、提问关键问题、生成包含参考文件的初始技能**

**迭代模式（ITERATION MODE）- 触发条件：“添加[领域]背景信息”、“该技能需要关于[主题]的更多信息”、“使用[指标/表/术语]更新数据技能”、“改进[领域]参考内容” → 加载现有技能、提问针对性问题、追加/更新参考文件**

当数据分析师希望Claude理解其公司特定的数据仓库、术语、指标定义及常见查询模式时使用。

description: Checks the authorized Sent account, organization and Sender Profile scope, balance, onboarding/KYC status, and readiness with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks whether the account can send, what the MCP connection authorized, whether funds are sufficient, why onboarding is blocked, or for a preflight check before a mutation or channel launch. Route remediation to the relevant onboarding or compliance skill.
description_zh: 检查授权的Sent账户、组织与发送者档案范围、余额、开户/KYC状态以及与Sent MCP工具的就绪情况。适用于用户询问账户是否可以发送、MCP连接已授权的内容、资金是否充足、开户为何受阻，或在变更或渠道上线前进行预检时。将修复操作路由到相关开户或合规技能。

description: Queries Sent phone-number capabilities and aggregate messaging, deliverability, and contact analytics with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks for number lookup, line or channel capability, messages sent, delivery rate, contact growth, dashboard metrics, period comparisons, or date-bounded trends. Use messaging-performance-analyzer for message-level evidence and root-cause diagnosis.
description_zh: 通过 Sent MCP 工具查询电话号码能力，并汇总消息、送达性和联系数据分析。当用户询问号码查询、线路或频道能力、已发送消息、送达率、联系增长、仪表盘指标、时段对比或日期受限趋势时使用。使用 messaging-performance-analyzer 获取消息层面证据和根因诊断。

description: Lists, finds, inspects, bulk-creates, summarizes, or deletes Sent contacts with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks to search contacts, get a contact by ID, import or deduplicate a contact list, review a contact's messaging summary, remove a contact, or manage direct contact records. Requires confirmation gates for creates and deletes.
description_zh: 使用 Sent MCP 工具列出、查找、检查、批量创建、汇总或删除 Sent 联系人。当用户请求搜索联系人、根据 ID 获取联系人、导入或去重联系人列表、查看联系人消息汇总、移除联系人或管理直连联系人记录时使用。创建和删除操作需设置确认门控。

description: Sends SMS, WhatsApp, or RCS messages through Sent and retrieves individual message status and activity history with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks to send or preview a message, check a message ID, confirm delivery status, inspect lifecycle events, investigate a timed-out or ambiguous send, or retry safely. Use messaging-performance-analyzer for aggregate delivery diagnosis.
description_zh: 通过"Sent"发送短信、WhatsApp或RCS消息，并使用"Sent MCP工具"检索单个消息的状态和活动历史。当用户要求发送或预览消息、检查消息ID、确认投递状态、检查生命周期事件、调查超时或存疑的发送，或安全重试时使用。使用messaging-performance-analyzer进行整体投递诊断。

description: Lists, finds by name or ID, inspects, or deletes existing Sent templates with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks to browse templates, find an approved template, check template language, channel, category, or status, retrieve a template record, or delete a template. Use waba-template-author to write WhatsApp content and template-builder-ui to design template interfaces.
description_zh: 使用 Sent MCP 工具，可列出、按名称或 ID 查找、检查或删除现有的 Sent 模板。当用户要求浏览模板、查找已批准模板、检查模板语言、渠道、类别或状态、获取模板记录或删除模板时，使用此项功能。使用 waba-template-author 编写 WhatsApp 内容，并使用 template-builder-ui 设计模板界面。

description: Write Godot 4.7 shaders in the Godot Shading Language: canvas_item shaders for 2D and spatial shaders for 3D, with vertex/fragment functions, uniforms (source_color, hint_range), TIME/UV animation, and screen-reading via hint_screen_texture. Use when authoring .gdshader files, writing fragment/vertex code, making 2D/3D visual effects, or porting 3.x shaders (SCREEN_TEXTURE, hint_color) to 4.x.
description_zh: 使用 Godot 着色语言编写 Godot 4.7 着色器：编写用于 2D 的画布项着色器、用于 3D 的空间着色器，包含顶点/片段函数、统一变量（源颜色、提示范围）、TIME/UV 动画，以及通过 hint_screen_texture 实现屏幕读取。在编写 .gdshader 文件、编写片段/顶点代码、制作 2D/3D 视觉效果，或将 3.x 着色器（SCREEN_TEXTURE、hint_color）移植到 4.x 时使用。

description: Guides the end-to-end AWS resilience lifecycle integrating Resilience Hub v2, Fault Injection Service, and Application Recovery Controller. Covers the Define → Test → Operate workflow: from policy creation through failure mode assessment, to FIS experiment validation, to ARC operational controls. Applicable when the user wants a complete resilience strategy, needs to connect findings to experiments to controls, or is planning a resilience program. Also applicable for the meta question of whether marking NGRH findings as resolved is enough, whether they are "done" after resolving findings, or how to validate findings before resolving them. Not applicable for resolving or remediating a specific individual finding (see resilience-hub-failure-mode-assessment), or when a single service is explicitly named (e.g. "what FIS experiment should I run").
description_zh: 引导端到端AWS韧性生命周期，集成韧性中心v2（Resilience Hub v2）、故障注入服务（Fault Injection Service）和应用恢复控制器（Application Recovery Controller）。涵盖"定义→测试→运行"的工作流程：从策略创建，到故障模式评估，再到FIS实验验证，以及ARC运行控制。适用于用户需要完整的韧性策略、需要将发现结果与实验及控制措施关联，或正在规划韧性项目时。同样适用于元问题：将NGRH发现标记为已解决是否足够，在解决发现后是否算"已完成"，或在解决发现前如何验证发现。不适用于解决或修复特定单一发现（见韧性中心故障模式评估），或当明确提及单个服务时（例如"我应该运行哪个FIS实验"）。

description: Implement, review, or improve photo picking, camera capture, and media handling in iOS apps using PhotoKit and AVFoundation. Use when working with PhotosPicker, PHPickerViewController, camera capture sessions (AVCaptureSession), photo library access, image loading and display, video recording, or media permissions. Also use when selecting photos from the library, taking pictures, recording video, processing images, or handling photo/camera privacy permissions in Swift apps.
description_zh: 在 iOS 应用中，使用 PhotoKit 和 AVFoundation 实现、审查或改进照片选择、相机拍摄与媒体处理。适用于使用 PhotosPicker、PHPickerViewController、相机捕获会话（AVCaptureSession）、照片库访问、图像加载与显示、视频录制或媒体权限时。也适用于在 Swift 应用中从照片库选择照片、拍照、录制视频、处理图像或处理照片/相机隐私权限。

description: Optimize website and web application performance including loading speed, Core Web Vitals, bundle size, caching strategies, and runtime performance
description_zh: 优化网站和Web应用性能，包括加载速度、Core Web Vitals、打包体积、缓存策略以及运行时性能。

description: Build Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) with Packer using the amazon-ebs builder. Use when creating custom AMIs for EC2 instances.
description_zh: 使用 Packer 和 amazon-ebs 构建器构建 Amazon Machine Images (AMI)。用于创建 EC2 实例的自定义 AMI。

description: Anti Slop: Rules for AI Coding Agents. The core filter. Load always to stop generic AI slop.
description_zh: 反平庸（Anti Slop）：AI编程智能体的规则。核心过滤器。始终加载，以杜绝通用的AI平庸内容。

description: Ingest Claude Code conversation history into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to mine their past Claude conversations for knowledge, import their ~/.claude folder, extract insights from previous coding sessions, or says things like "process my Claude history", "add my conversations to the wiki", "what have I discussed with Claude before". Also triggers when the user mentions their .claude folder, Claude projects, session data, past conversation logs, local-agent-mode sessions, or audit logs.
description_zh: 将 Claude Code 的对话历史导入到 Obsidian 知识库中。当用户希望从过往的 Claude 对话中挖掘知识时，请使用此技能；当需要导入其 ~/.claude 文件夹、从之前的编程会话中提取见解，或说出类似"处理我的 Claude 历史记录"、"将我的对话添加到知识库"、"我之前与 Claude 讨论过什么"等表述时，也应使用此技能。此外，当用户提到其 .claude 文件夹、Claude 项目、会话数据、过往对话日志、本地代理模式会话或审计日志时，也会触发本技能。

description: Multi-source research on a customer question or topic with source attribution. Use when a customer asks something you need to look up, investigating whether a bug has been reported before, checking what was previously told to a specific account, or gathering background before drafting a response.
description_zh: 对客户问题或主题进行多源研究，并标注来源。适用于以下场景：客户提出需查询的内容、调查该缺陷是否此前已被报告、查看此前向特定账户提供的信息，或在起草回复前收集背景信息。

description: Implement, review, or improve maps and location features in iOS/macOS apps using MapKit and CoreLocation. Use when working with Map views, annotations, markers, polylines, user location tracking, geocoding, reverse geocoding, search/autocomplete, directions and routes, geofencing, region monitoring, CLLocationUpdate async streams, or location authorization flows. Also use when working with maps, coordinates, addresses, places, directions, distance calculations, or location-based features in Swift apps.
description_zh: 使用MapKit和CoreLocation在iOS/macOS应用中实现、审查或改进地图和位置功能。适用于当涉及地图视图、标注、标记、折线、用户位置追踪、地理编码、反向地理编码、搜索/自动补全、方向与路线、地理围栏、区域监控、CLLocationUpdate异步流或位置授权流程时。也适用于在Swift应用中，当涉及地图、坐标、地址、地点、方向、距离计算或位置相关功能时。

description: Provides TypeScript patterns for DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 including schema/table/entity modeling, .build() command workflow, query/scan access patterns, batch and transaction operations, and single-table design with computed keys. Use when implementing type-safe DynamoDB access layers with DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 in TypeScript services or serverless applications.
description_zh: 提供针对 DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 的 TypeScript 模式，包括模式/表/实体建模、.build() 命令工作流、查询/扫描访问模式、批处理与事务操作，以及带计算键的单表设计。当在 TypeScript 服务或无服务器应用中，使用 DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 实现类型安全的 DynamoDB 访问层时使用。

description: Provides Gemini CLI delegation workflows for large-context analysis and complex reasoning using Gemini 3.0 Flash and Gemini 3.0 Pro models, including English prompt formulation, execution flags, and safe result handling. Use when the user explicitly asks to use Gemini for tasks such as broad codebase analysis, fast iterations with Gemini 3 Flash, or deep architectural reasoning with Gemini 3 Pro. Triggers on "use gemini", "delegate to gemini", "run gemini cli", "ask gemini", "use gemini for this task", "use gemini 3 flash", "use gemini 3 pro".
description_zh: 提供基于 Gemini 3.0 Flash 和 Gemini 3.0 Pro 模型的 Gemini CLI 委托工作流，用于大上下文分析与复杂推理，包括英文提示词制定、执行标志以及安全结果处理。当用户明确要求使用 Gemini 执行诸如广泛代码库分析、使用 Gemini 3 Flash 快速迭代、使用 Gemini 3 Pro 进行深度架构推理等任务时使用。触发条件为：'use gemini', 'delegate to gemini', 'run gemini cli', 'ask gemini', 'use gemini for this task', 'use gemini 3 flash', 'use gemini 3 pro'.

description: Configures AWS Direct Connect: choosing a connection model (dedicated, hosted, or a link aggregation group) and completing the cross connect; creating private, public, and transit virtual interfaces and bringing up BGP; reaching many VPCs through a Direct Connect gateway including cross-account transit gateway associations; encrypting traffic with MACsec or a private IP Site-to-Site VPN; making the connection resilient and tuning failover; managing link aggregation groups; SiteLink; and migrating from a virtual private gateway to a transit gateway. Use when the user wants a private, consistent network link between a data center and AWS, or operates an existing Direct Connect setup and needs to extend, encrypt, or harden it. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Do NOT use for transit gateway route tables and attachments (transitgateway skill), Site-to-Site VPN without Direct Connect (sitetositevpn skill), or Route 53 DNS routing (route53 skill).
description_zh: 配置 AWS Direct Connect：选择连接模式（专用、托管或链路聚合组）并完成交叉连接；创建私有、公共和传输虚拟接口并启动 BGP；通过 Direct Connect 网关连接多个 VPC，包括跨账户传输网关关联；使用 MACsec 或私有 IP Site-to-Site VPN 对流量进行加密；使连接具备弹性和调整故障转移；管理链路聚合组；SiteLink；以及从虚拟私有网关迁移到传输网关。当用户需要在数据中心与 AWS 之间建立私有、一致的（或稳定的）网络链路，或运营现有 Direct Connect 设置并需要扩展、加密或加固时使用。在参考资料中路由到正确的分任务操作程序。不要用于传输网关路由表和附加项（transitgateway 技能）、不使用 Direct Connect 的 Site-to-Site VPN（sitetositevpn 技能），或 Route 53 DNS 路由（route53 技能）。

description: Creates new Architecture Decision Record (ADR) documents for significant architectural changes using a consistent template and repository-aware naming and storage guidance. Use when a user or agent decides on an architectural change, needs to document technical rationale, or wants to add a new ADR to the project history.
description_zh: 针对重大架构变更，使用统一的模板以及仓库感知的命名与存储指引，创建新的架构决策记录（ADR）文档。当用户或代理决定进行架构变更、需要记录技术依据，或希望将新的ADR添加到项目历史时使用。

description: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.
description_zh: 为AI工具生成优化提示词。仅在用户明确要求为特定AI工具（LLM、Cursor、Midjourney、图像AI、视频AI、编码智能体等）撰写、修正、优化或调整提示词时激活；对于一般对话、编码任务、文档撰写或其他非提示词工程工作，不会激活。

description: Assess APM service health using SLOs, alerts, ML, throughput, latency, error rate, and dependencies. Use when checking service status, performance, or when the user asks about service health.
description_zh: 利用SLOs、告警、ML、吞吐量、延迟、错误率和依赖关系来评估APM服务健康状况。用于检查服务状态、性能，或在用户询问服务健康时。

description: Build iOS augmented reality and 3D experiences with RealityKit and ARKit. Use when adding RealityView content, loading entities or USDZ models, anchoring objects to planes or world positions, distinguishing entity hit tests from ARKit real-world raycasts, handling AR camera availability, world tracking, scene updates, or RealityKit entity gestures and interactions.
description_zh: 使用 RealityKit 和 ARKit 构建 iOS 增强现实与 3D 体验。适用于添加 RealityView 内容、加载实体或 USDZ 模型、将对象锚定到平面或世界位置、区分实体命中检测与 ARKit 实际射线检测、处理 AR 摄像头可用性、世界追踪、场景更新，以及 RealityKit 实体手势与交互。

description: Write idiomatic GDScript for Godot 4.7: static typing, the node lifecycle (_ready/_process/_physics_process), @export/@onready/@tool annotations, signals, and await for asynchronous flow. Use when editing .gd scripts in a Godot project (project.godot), writing or debugging GDScript, or porting 3.x GDScript to 4.x (function signatures, yield to await, export to @export).
description_zh: 为 Godot 4.7 编写地道的 GDScript：静态类型、节点生命周期（_ready/_process/_physics_process）、@export/@onready/@tool 注解、信号，以及用于异步流程的 await。适用于在 Godot 项目（project.godot）中编辑 .gd 脚本、编写或调试 GDScript，或将 3.x GDScript 移植到 4.x（函数签名、yield 改为 await、导出至 @export）。

description: Use when designing resource lifecycles. Keywords: RAII, Drop, resource lifecycle, connection pool, lazy initialization, connection pool design, resource cleanup patterns, cleanup, scope, OnceCell, Lazy, once_cell, OnceLock, transaction, session management, when is Drop called, cleanup on error, guard pattern, scope guard, 资源生命周期, 连接池, 惰性初始化, 资源清理, RAII 模式
description_zh: 在设计资源生命周期时使用。关键词：RAII, Drop, 资源生命周期, 连接池, 惰性初始化, 连接池设计, 资源清理模式, 清理, 作用域, OnceCell, Lazy, once_cell, OnceLock, 事务, 会话管理, Drop 何时被调用, 错误时的清理, 守卫模式, 作用域守卫, 资源生命周期, 连接池, 惰性初始化, 资源清理, RAII 模式

description: Create, update, and review Terraform provider documentation for Terraform Registry using HashiCorp-recommended patterns, tfplugindocs templates, and schema descriptions. Use when adding or changing provider configuration, resources, data sources, ephemeral resources, list resources, functions, actions, or guides; when validating generated docs; and when troubleshooting missing or incorrect Registry documentation.
description_zh: 使用 HashiCorp 推荐的模式、tfplugindocs 模板及模式描述，创建、更新和审核 Terraform 注册中心的 Provider 文档。在添加或更改 Provider 配置、资源、数据源、临时资源、列表资源、函数、操作或指南时使用；在验证生成文档时使用；以及在排查注册中心文档缺失或不正确的问题时使用。

description: CRITICAL: Use for domain modeling. Triggers: domain model, DDD, domain-driven design, entity, value object, aggregate, repository pattern, business rules, validation, invariant, 领域模型, 领域驱动设计, 业务规则
description_zh: 重要：用于领域建模。触发词：领域模型、DDD、领域驱动设计、实体、值对象、聚合、仓储模式、业务规则、校验、不变式、领域模型、领域驱动设计、业务规则

description: Adds user authentication to web and mobile apps with Amazon Cognito (user pools and identity pools) and the AWS Amplify client auth libraries. Covers sign-up/sign-in flows and the login page (Cognito-hosted UI / managed login), MFA, password policies, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows (auth-code + PKCE, client credentials), social/SAML federation, tokens (ID/access/refresh, rotation, revocation, storage), Cognito Lambda triggers, identity pools (temp AWS creds), and gating API Gateway (or ALB) routes to signed-in users via Cognito/JWT authorizers. Applies when adding a login or sign-up page, configuring a user pool or app client, choosing user pool vs identity pool, wiring social/SAML, refreshing tokens, requiring sign-in on an API Gateway or ALB, or debugging redirect_uri/token/MFA/CORS/federation errors. Does NOT cover Amplify Gen2 backend definitions (defineAuth, npx ampx → aws-amplify), IAM/STS/Identity Center (→ aws-iam), or API Gateway/Lambda resource config beyond the authorizer (→ aws-serverless).
description_zh: 为使用 Amazon Cognito（用户池和身份池）以及 AWS Amplify 客户端认证库的 Web 和移动应用添加用户认证。涵盖注册/登录流程及登录页（Cognito 托管 UI / 托管登录）、多因素认证（MFA）、密码策略、OAuth 2.0 / OIDC 流程（授权码 + PKCE、客户端凭证）、社交/SAML 联邦、令牌（ID/访问/刷新令牌，轮换、吊销、存储）、Cognito Lambda 触发器、身份池（临时 AWS 凭证），以及通过 Cognito/JWT 认证器管控已登录用户对 API Gateway（或 ALB）路由的访问。在添加登录或注册页面、配置用户池或应用客户端、选择用户池与身份池、配置社交/SAML、刷新令牌、在 API Gateway 或 ALB 中强制登录、或调试 redirect_uri/token/MFA/CORS/联邦相关错误时适用。不包括 Amplify Gen2 后端定义（defineAuth、npx ampx → aws-amplify）、IAM/STS/Identity Center（→ aws-iam），或 API Gateway/Lambda 资源配置中除认证器之外的内容（→ aws-serverless）。

description: Provides GitHub Copilot CLI task delegation in non-interactive mode with multi-model support (Claude, GPT, Gemini), permission controls, output sharing, and session resume. Use when users ask to hand work to Copilot, compare models, or run Copilot programmatically from Claude Code.
description_zh: 在非交互模式下提供GitHub Copilot CLI的任务委托，支持多模型（Claude、GPT、Gemini），具备权限控制、输出分享及会话恢复功能。适用于用户请求将任务委派给Copilot、比较模型，或从Claude Code以编程方式运行Copilot的情况。

description: Generate and edit images using Google Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro). Supports text-to-image, image editing, various aspect ratios, and high-resolution output (2K/4K). Use when user wants to generate images, create images, use Gemini image generation, or do AI image generation.
description_zh: 使用 Google Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro) 生成和编辑图像。支持文生图、图像编辑、多种宽高比以及高清输出（2K/4K）。当用户需要生成图像、创建图像、使用 Gemini 图像生成或进行 AI 图像生成时使用。

description:
Structured meeting summaries with action items, decisions, and key discussion points.
Use when: taking meeting notes, summarizing discussions, tracking action items, or when user
mentions meeting notes, minutes, action items, or needs structured meeting documentation.
description_zh:
包含行动项、决策和关键讨论要点的结构化会议摘要。

适用场景：记录会议笔记、总结讨论、跟踪行动项，或当用户提及会议笔记、纪要、行动项，或需要结构化的会议文档时。

description: Downloads, exports, and inspects existing Arize traces and spans to understand what an LLM app is doing or debug runtime issues. Covers exporting traces by ID, spans by ID, sessions by ID, and root-cause investigation using the ax CLI. Use when the user wants to look at existing trace data, see what their LLM app is doing, export traces, download spans, investigate errors, or analyze behavior regressions.
description_zh: 下载、导出并检查现有的 Arize 追踪和跨度，以了解 LLM 应用正在执行的内容或调试运行时问题。涵盖通过 ax CLI 按 ID 导出追踪、按 ID 导出跨度、按 ID 导出会话，以及进行根因调查。当用户希望查看现有追踪数据、了解其 LLM 应用正在执行的内容、导出追踪、下载跨度、调查错误或分析行为回归时使用。

description: Designer Who Codes: visual audit then fixes with atomic commits and before/after screenshots. Useful for tightening shipped UI before launch.
description_zh: 会编码的设计师：先进行视觉审查，再借助原子提交和前后对比截图进行修复。适用于上线前优化发布后的UI。

description: Structure a Godot 4.7 project with the scene tree and node composition: build reusable scenes, instance PackedScenes at runtime, navigate the tree safely, and register autoload singletons. Use when designing .tscn scenes, deciding how to split nodes, spawning instances with instantiate(), wiring autoloads, or fixing "node not found"/freed-node errors in a Godot project.
description_zh: 以场景树和节点组合的方式构建 Godot 4.7 项目：构建可复用场景，在运行时实例化 PackedScenes，安全导航场景树，注册 autoload 单例。用于设计 .tscn 场景、确定节点拆分方式、使用 instantiate() 生成实例、连接 autoloads，或在 Godot 项目中修复"节点未找到"与释放节点错误。

description: Provides guidance and instructions on managing remote devices on Developer Device Platform (DDP). Use when reserving remote Android devices, establishing connection tunnels, checking session status, or extending/cancelling leases. Don't use for iOS or local device/hardware inquiries.
description_zh: 为在开发者设备平台（DDP）上管理远程设备提供指导和说明。用于预留远程安卓设备、建立连接隧道、检查会话状态，或延长/取消租赁。不适用于 iOS 或本地设备/硬件相关咨询。

description: Brainstorm 3-5 monetization strategies with audience fit, risks, and validation experiments. Use when exploring revenue models, evaluating pricing strategies, or deciding how to monetize a product.
description_zh: 头脑风暴3-5种包含受众匹配度、风险及验证实验的变现策略。在探索收入模式、评估定价策略或决定如何为产品变现时使用。

description: Review content against your brand voice, style guide, and messaging pillars, flagging deviations by severity with specific before/after fixes. Use when checking a draft before it ships, when auditing copy for voice consistency and terminology, or when screening for unsubstantiated claims, missing disclaimers, and other legal flags.
description_zh: 对照您的品牌声音、风格指南和信息支柱审查内容，依据偏离严重程度进行标记，并附上具体的修改前后修正方案。用于发布草稿前检查内容，审核文案的语气一致性和术语使用，或筛查无根据的声明、缺失的免责声明及其他法律警示标记。

description: Create or update an operational runbook for a recurring task or procedure. Use when documenting a task that on-call or ops needs to run repeatably, turning tribal knowledge into exact step-by-step commands, adding troubleshooting and rollback steps to an existing procedure, or writing escalation paths for when things go wrong.
description_zh: 创建或更新周期性任务或流程的运营运行手册。用于记录值班人员或运维人员需要重复执行的任务，将行内知识转化为精确的逐步操作命令，为现有流程添加排障和回滚步骤，或在出现异常时编写升级路径。

description: Provides React Navigation UI patterns for stacks, tabs, drawers etc. Use when building navigation UIs with React Navigation, configuring headers, bottom sheets or handling safe areas and insets.
description_zh: 为堆叠、标签页、抽屉等提供 React Navigation UI 模式。可在使用 React Navigation 构建导航 UI、配置头部、底部弹层或处理安全区域与内边距时使用。

description: Salesforce Connected Apps and External Client Apps OAuth configuration with 120-point scoring. Use this skill to configure OAuth flows, JWT bearer auth, Connected Apps, and External Client Apps in Salesforce. TRIGGER when: user configures OAuth flows, JWT bearer auth, Connected Apps, ECAs, or touches .connectedApp-meta.xml / .eca-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: configuring Named Credentials for callouts (use building-sf-integrations), reviewing permission policies (use deploying-metadata), or writing Apex token-handling code (use generating-apex).
description_zh: Salesforce 连接应用与外部客户端应用 OAuth 配置（120 分评分）。使用此技能在 Salesforce 中配置 OAuth 流程、JWT Bearer 认证、连接应用和外部客户端应用。触发条件：当用户配置 OAuth 流程、JWT Bearer 认证、连接应用、ECAs，或操作 .connectedApp-meta.xml / .eca-meta.xml 文件时。请勿触发：当为用户调用（callouts）配置命名凭据（使用 building-sf-integrations）、审查权限策略（使用 deploying-metadata）、或编写 Apex 令牌处理代码（使用 generating-apex）时。

description: Use for Tailwind v4 styling: add/fix classes, configure or migrate Tailwind, use tailwind-variants, or tw-animate-css.
description_zh: 用于 Tailwind v4 样式化：添加/修复样式类、配置或迁移 Tailwind、使用 tailwind-variants 或 tw-animate-css。

description: Audits codebases for common security vulnerabilities that AI coding assistants introduce in "vibe-coded" applications. Checks for exposed API keys, broken access control (Supabase RLS, Firebase rules), missing auth validation, client-side trust issues, insecure payment flows, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks about security, wants a code review, mentions "vibe coding", or when you're writing or reviewing code that handles authentication, payments, database access, API keys, secrets, or user data — even if they don't explicitly mention security. Also trigger when the user says things like "is this safe?", "check my code", "audit this", "review for vulnerabilities", or "can someone hack this?".
description_zh: 审计 AI 编码助手在“氛围编程”（vibe-coding）应用中引入的常见安全漏洞的代码库。检查暴露的 API 密钥、失效的访问控制（Supabase RLS、Firebase 规则）、缺失的身份验证验证、客户端信任问题、不安全的支付流程等。当用户询问安全相关问题、需要代码审查、提及“氛围编程”，或编写/审查处理身份验证、支付、数据库访问、API 密钥、密钥或用户数据的代码时，都应使用此技能——即使用户未明确提及安全相关内容。此外，当用户说“这安全吗？”、“检查我的代码”、“审计一下”、“审查漏洞”、“会不会被黑客入侵？”等表述时，也应触发此技能。

description: Update, create, or reprioritize your product roadmap. Use when adding a new initiative and deciding what moves to make room, shifting priorities after new information comes in, moving timelines due to a dependency slip, or building a Now/Next/Later view from scratch.
description_zh: 更新、创建或重新调整你的产品路线图。当添加新举措并决定哪些举措需要让位以腾出空间、在获得新信息后调整优先级、因依赖项延误调整时间线，或从零开始构建当前/后续/待定视图时使用。

description: Fix the visual diffs that have been reviewed and rejected on a Meticulous test run, following their review comments if given. Use when a user has reviewed the results of a test run and is handing off to an agent to implement the fixes.
description_zh: 修复在 Meticulous 测试运行中已被审阅并驳回的视觉差异，并根据审查意见（如有）进行修改。当用户已审阅测试运行结果并移交代理实施修复时使用。

description: Enable and configure Kibana audit logging for saved object access, logins, and space operations. Use when setting up Kibana audit, filtering events, or correlating Kibana and ES audit logs.
description_zh: 启用并配置 Kibana 审计日志，用于保存对象访问、登录和空间操作。在设置 Kibana 审计、过滤事件或关联 Kibana 与 ES 审计日志时使用。

description: Search for scientific papers, preprints, and publications on arXiv. Extract metadata, abstracts, and download full-text PDFs or HTML versions of papers. Use when the user asks to find research papers, literature, or specific arXiv IDs.
description_zh: 在 arXiv 上检索科学论文、预印本和出版物。提取元数据、摘要，并下载论文全文的 PDF 或 HTML 版本。当用户要求查找研究论文、文献或特定的 arXiv ID 时使用。

description: Brainstorm 5 unique, memorable product names with rationale aligned to brand values and target audience. Use when naming a new product, rebranding, or exploring product name ideas.
description_zh: 为5个独特且令人难忘的产品名称进行头脑风暴，并阐述其与品牌价值观及目标受众相契合的理由。适用于新产品命名、品牌重塑或探索产品名称创意时使用。

description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks
description_zh: 适用于您需要分析 git 差异或拉取请求，以了解变更内容、受影响组件及风险的情况。

description: Use when learning Rust concepts. Keywords: mental model, how to think about ownership, understanding borrow checker, visualizing memory layout, analogy, misconception, explaining ownership, why does Rust, help me understand, confused about, learning Rust, explain like I'm, ELI5, intuition for, coming from Java, coming from Python, 心智模型, 如何理解所有权, 学习 Rust, Rust 入门, 为什么 Rust
description_zh: 学习 Rust 概念时使用。关键词：心智模型，如何思考所有权，理解借用检查器，可视化内存布局，类比，误解，解释所有权，为什么 Rust，帮助我理解，对……感到困惑，学习 Rust，像对我解释，ELI5，对……的直觉，来自 Java，来自 Python，心智模型，如何理解所有权，学习 Rust，Rust 入门，为什么 Rust

description: Use when asked to run deep research or AI-Q research through a reachable NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint backend.
description_zh: 当被要求通过可访问的 NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint 后端运行深度研究或 AI-Q 研究时使用。

description: Options trading strategy analysis and simulation tool. Provides theoretical pricing using Black-Scholes model, Greeks calculation, strategy P/L simulation, and risk management guidance. Use when user requests options strategy analysis, covered calls, protective puts, spreads, iron condors, earnings plays, or options risk management. Includes volatility analysis, position sizing, and earnings-based strategy recommendations. Educational focus with practical trade simulation.
description_zh:
期权交易策略分析与模拟工具。
基于Black-Scholes模型提供理论定价、希腊值计算、策略盈亏模拟及风险管理指导。适用于用户请求期权策略分析、备兑看涨、保护性看跌、价差、铁鹰、财报交易或期权风险管理等场景。包含波动率分析、仓位管理与基于财报的策略推荐。注重教育性，并提供实际交易模拟。

description: AI-powered image generation for Salesforce visuals via Nano Banana Pro. Use this skill when the user needs rendered PNG/SVG output such as visual ERDs (Entity Relationship Diagrams), UI mockups, wireframes, or architecture illustrations. TRIGGER when: user asks for PNG/SVG output, UI mockups, wireframes, visual ERDs, or says "generate image" / "create mockup". DO NOT TRIGGER when: text-based Mermaid diagrams (use generating-mermaid-diagrams), or non-visual documentation tasks.
description_zh: 通过 Nano Banana Pro 为 Salesforce 视觉进行 AI 图像生成。当用户需要渲染 PNG/SVG 输出，如视觉 ERDs（实体关系图）、UI 原型图、线框图或架构插图时，请使用此技能。触发条件：用户要求输出 PNG/SVG、UI 原型图、线框图、视觉 ERD，或提到“生成图像”/“创建原型”。不要触发的情况：用户需要基于文本的 Mermaid 图表（请使用 generating-mermaid-diagrams），或非视觉文档任务。

description: Apply trader Serenity's (@aleabitoreddit) AI/semiconductor supply-chain analytical lens to US-stock ideas and market judgment. Use this skill whenever evaluating a stock decision (buy / sell / hold / size); forming an outlook on any AI, semiconductor, optical/CPO, memory, power/grid, or neocloud name; mentioning any ticker in Serenity's universe (NBIS, AXTI, LITE, SIVE, COHR, AAOI, IREN, CRWV, MU, SNDK, NVDA, TSM, MRVL, AVGO, INTC, SOI, IQE, TSEM, CIFR, XLU, VST, CEG, EWY, etc.); asking "what would Serenity think", "is this a real bottleneck", or wanting a supply-chain / bottleneck read on a thesis. Decision-support only — never auto-trades and never places or cancels orders.
description_zh: 运用交易员 Serenity（@aleabitoreddit）的 AI/半导体供应链分析视角，应用于美股见解与市场判断。在评估任何股票决策（买入 / 卖出 / 持有 / 仓位调整）时，请使用本技能；对任意 AI、半导体、光/CPO、内存、电力/电网或新云相关标的形成展望；在提及 Serenity 股票池（universe）中的任何代码（NBIS、AXTI、LITE、SIVE、COHR、AAOI、IREN、CRWV、MU、SNDK、NVDA、TSM、MRVL、AVGO、INTC、SOI、IQE、TSEM、CIFR、XLU、VST、CEG、EWY 等）时；询问“Serenity 会怎么想”、“这是真正的瓶颈吗”，或要求就某一论点提供供应链与瓶颈分析。仅供决策支持——绝不自动交易，也绝不执行下单或撤单操作。

description: The skill for control Home Assistant smart home devices and query states using MCP protocol.
description_zh: 通过 MCP 协议控制 Home Assistant 智能家居设备并查询设备状态的技能。

description: Reviews codebases, architectures, PRs, and technical plans for vanity engineering — code and systems built for the developer's ego, resume, or intellectual pleasure rather than delivering user or business value. Triggers on: "review this code", "is this over-engineered", "code review", "architecture review", "complexity audit", "vanity check", "is this necessary", "simplify this", "tech debt review", or any request to evaluate whether code or architecture is justified by actual requirements. Also trigger when the user shares a codebase and asks for feedback, when discussing framework/library choices, when reviewing PRs, or when someone is debating whether to refactor or rebuild. Nudge activation when you detect patterns of unnecessary abstraction, premature optimization, or resume-driven technology choices in code the user shares — even if they haven't asked for a vanity review.
description_zh:
审查代码库、架构、PR及技术方案中的虚荣工程——这些工程是指为开发者的自负、简历或智力愉悦而构建的代码与系统，其目的并非交付用户或业务价值。

触发条件包括：“审查此代码”、“这是过度工程化吗”、“代码评审”、“架构评审”、“复杂度审计”、“虚荣检查”、“这是必要的吗”、“简化此代码”、“技术债务评审”，以及任何请求评估代码或架构是否由实际需求所支撑的诉求。

当用户分享代码库并请求反馈、讨论框架或库的选择、审查PR，或有人辩论是否进行重构或重建时，亦需触发。

当检测到用户分享的代码中存在不必要的抽象、过早优化，或以简历为导向的技术选型等模式时，即触发提醒——即便用户未提出虚荣工程审查的需求。

description: Plan a sprint — scope work, estimate capacity, set goals, and draft a sprint plan. Use when kicking off a new sprint, sizing a backlog against team availability (accounting for PTO and meetings), deciding what's P0 vs. stretch, or handling carryover from the last sprint.
description_zh: 制定冲刺计划——明确工作范围，估算容量，设定目标，并草拟冲刺计划。适用于新冲刺启动、根据团队可用时间（考虑 PTO 和会议）对待办事项列表进行规模评估、判定哪些属于 P0 而非延伸任务，或处理上一冲刺的遗留事项。

description: When the user wants a comprehensive App Store market overview, daily/weekly market briefing, or combined view of chart movements, trending keywords, featured apps, and new releases. Also use when the user mentions "market overview", "what's happening on the App Store", "market briefing", "weekly report", "market trends", or "state of the market". For chart-specific rank changes only, see market-movers. For keyword trends only, see keyword-research.
description_zh: 当用户需要全面的 App Store 市场概览、每日/每周市场简报，或图表变动、热门关键词、精选应用与新发布的综合视图时，使用本内容。当用户提及“市场概览”、“App Store 发生了什么”、“市场简报”、“周报”、“市场趋势”或“市场状态”时，也使用本内容。仅涉及图表特定排名变化时，参见 market-movers。仅涉及关键词趋势时，参见 keyword-research。

description: Create a comprehensive product strategy using the 9-section Product Strategy Canvas — vision, segments, costs, value propositions, trade-offs, metrics, growth, capabilities, and defensibility. Use when building a product strategy, creating a strategic plan, or defining product direction.
description_zh: 使用包含愿景、客户细分、成本、价值主张、权衡取舍、指标、增长、能力及防御性这9个模块的产品策略画布，制定全面的产品策略。在构建产品策略、制定战略计划或明确产品方向时使用。

description: Use when looking up journal or magazine name abbreviations, converting between full names and ISO 4/MEDLINE abbreviations, processing BibTeX files for journal name standardization, or answering questions about 期刊缩写/杂志缩写. Triggers on "journal abbreviation", "abbreviate journal", "journal name", "期刊缩写", "杂志缩写", "ISO 4", "LTWA", "BibTeX journal". PROACTIVELY USE when user mentions citation formatting, reference list preparation, or manuscript submission to specific journals.
description_zh: 适用于查找期刊或杂志名称缩写、在全称与ISO 4/MEDLINE缩写之间进行转换、为期刊名称标准化处理BibTeX文件，或回答关于期刊缩写/杂志缩写的提问时使用。触发条件包括“期刊缩写”“缩写期刊”“期刊名称”“期刊缩写”“杂志缩写”“ISO 4”“LTWA”“BibTeX期刊”。当用户提及引用格式、参考文献列表准备，或向特定期刊提交手稿时，主动使用。

description: Official NVIDIA-authored guidance for NVIDIA cuDF GPU DataFrames, pandas acceleration, dask-cuDF, ETL, joins, groupby, CSV/Parquet I/O, nullable semantics, and multi-GPU DataFrame workloads.
description_zh: NVIDIA 官方编写指南，涵盖 NVIDIA cuDF GPU DataFrame、pandas 加速、dask-cuDF、ETL、连接、分组、CSV/Parquet 输入/输出、可空语义及多 GPU DataFrame 工作负载。

description: Configures AWS Shield Advanced for enhanced Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection: subscribing accounts and adding resource protections, enabling automatic application layer (layer 7) mitigation through AWS WAF, configuring health-based detection with Route 53 health checks, setting up Shield Response Team (SRT) access and proactive engagement, reviewing DDoS events and requesting cost protection credits, and aggregating resources into protection groups. Applicable when the user wants stronger DDoS protection for internet-facing resources (CloudFront, Application or Network Load Balancers, Elastic IP addresses, Global Accelerator, or Route 53 hosted zones), wants expert help during an attack, or wants to recover attack-driven scaling charges. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Not applicable for authoring AWS WAF rules (waf skill), creating Route 53 health checks (route53 skill), or org-wide Shield Advanced rollout with Firewall Manager (firewallmanager skill).
description_zh: 为增强分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）防护配置 AWS Shield Advanced：订阅账户并添加资源防护，通过 AWS WAF 启用自动应用层（第 7 层）缓解，使用 Route 53 健康检查配置基于健康的检测，设置 Shield 响应团队（SRT）访问权限及主动参与，审查 DDoS 事件并申请成本防护抵用金，并将资源聚合为保护组。适用于需要为面向互联网的以下资源提供更强的 DDoS 防护、在攻击时需专家帮助，或需恢复因攻击产生的扩展费用的用户。适用资源包括：CloudFront、应用或网络负载均衡器、弹性 IP 地址、全球加速器和 Route 53 托管区域。根据参考资料中针对各任务的操作流程进行路由。不适用于编写 AWS WAF 规则（waf skill）、创建 Route 53 健康检查（route53 skill）或使用 Firewall Manager 进行组织范围的 Shield Advanced 部署（firewallmanager skill）。

description: Setup Sentry AI Agent Monitoring in any project. Use when asked to monitor LLM calls, track AI agents, track conversations, or instrument OpenAI/Anthropic/Vercel AI/LangChain/Google GenAI/Pydantic AI/Laravel AI. Detects installed AI SDKs and configures appropriate integrations.
description_zh: 在任何项目中设置 Sentry AI Agent 监控。当被要求监控 LLM 调用、追踪 AI 智能体、追踪对话，或为 OpenAI/Anthropic/Vercel AI/LangChain/Google GenAI/Pydantic AI/Laravel AI 进行配置时使用。检测已安装的 AI SDK 并配置合适的集成。

description: Direct high-fidelity cinematic video with AI — translates creative intent into technical cinematographic directives for Veo3, Kling, and Luma video models via muapi.ai
description_zh: 基于AI的高保真电影级视频生成——通过muapi.ai将创意意图转化为针对Veo3、Kling和Luma视频模型的技术性电影摄影指令。

description: Use when reviewing WordPress plugins for GPL compliance, checking license headers or compatibility, evaluating upsell/freemium/trialware patterns, validating plugin naming or trademark rules, checking plugin slugs, understanding why a plugin was rejected from WordPress.org, or answering any question about the 18 WordPress.org Plugin Directory guidelines — even if the user doesn't mention 'guidelines' explicitly.
description_zh: 用于审查 WordPress 插件是否符合 GPL 合规要求、检查许可证头或兼容性、评估 upsell（加购）、freemium（免费增值）、trialware（试用版）模式、验证插件命名或商标规则、检查插件 slug、了解插件为何被 WordPress.org 拒绝的原因，或回答关于 18 条 WordPress.org 插件目录指南的任何问题——即使用户未明确提及“指南”。

description: Provides Codex CLI delegation workflows for complex code generation and development tasks using OpenAI's GPT-5.3-codex models, including English prompt formulation, execution flags, sandbox modes, and safe result handling. Use when the user explicitly asks to use Codex for complex programming tasks such as code generation, refactoring, or architectural analysis. Triggers on "use codex", "delegate to codex", "run codex cli", "ask codex", "codex exec", "codex review".
description_zh: 为使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.3-codex 模型处理复杂代码生成与开发任务的 Codex CLI 提供委托工作流程，涵盖英文提示词编写、执行参数、沙箱模式及安全结果处理。当用户明确要求使用 Codex 执行代码生成、重构或架构分析等复杂编程任务时使用。触发关键词包括“use codex”、“delegate to codex”、“run codex cli”、“ask codex”、“codex exec”、“codex review”。

description: Implement a task for which no visual diffs are expected end to end, using Meticulous to drive the implementation to a clean visual diff before opening a PR. Use when the task's whole premise is "the UI shouldn't change" — a dependency/version upgrade, a code refactor, a migration, or similar. Meticulous isn't just a final check here, it's the loop you iterate against while implementing.
description_zh:
使用 Meticulous 实现一个预期无需视觉差异（端到端）的任务，并在提交代码合并请求（PR）之前，驱动实现过程达到干净的视觉差异。

当任务的整体前提为"用户界面不应发生变化"——如依赖项/版本升级、代码重构、迁移等场景时，使用此方法。

在此处，Meticulous 并非仅仅是一个最终检查，它更是你在实现过程中不断迭代验证的循环。

description:
横纵分析法（Horizontal-Vertical Analysis）深度研究Skill。由数字生命卡兹克提出，融合了索绪尔的历时-共时分析、社会科学的纵向-横截面研究设计、商学院案例研究法与竞争战略分析的核心思想。
当用户想要系统性研究一个产品、公司、概念、技术或人物时使用。核心是双轴分析：纵轴追踪从诞生到当下的完整生命历程（以叙事故事呈现），横轴在当下时间截面上与竞品/同类进行系统性横向对比，最后交叉两条轴产出独到洞察。最终产出一份排版精美的PDF研究报告。
触发词包括但不限于：横纵分析、研究一下、帮我分析、深度研究、做个研究、调研一下、竞品分析、帮我看看这个东西怎么样、这个产品/公司/概念是怎么回事、帮我摸清楚、帮我搞懂、帮我做个deep research。
即使用户只是说"帮我了解一下XX"或"XX是什么来头"，只要上下文暗示需要系统性的深度研究（而非简单的概念解释），都应该触发。也适用于用户丢来一个产品名、公司名、技术名词说"帮我研究一下这个"的场景。
不要用于简单的名词解释（用户只是问"XX是什么"）、不要用于公众号写作（那个用khazix-writer）、不要用于纯标题摘要生成（用wechat-title）。
description_zh:

即使用户只是说“帮我了解一下XX”或“XX是什么来头”，只要上下文暗示需要系统性的深度研究（而非简单的概念解释），都应该触发。也适用于用户丢来一个产品名、公司名、技术名词说“帮我研究一下这个”的场景。
不要用于简单的名词解释（用户只是问“XX是什么”）、不要用于公众号写作（那个用khazix-writer）、不要用于纯标题摘要生成（用wechat-title）。

description: Container orchestration with Docker Compose for multi-container applications, networking, volumes, and production deployment
description_zh: 使用 Docker Compose 进行容器编排，涵盖多容器应用、网络、卷及生产部署。

description: Manage OpenClaw bot configuration - channels, agents, security, and autopilot settings
description_zh: 管理 OpenClaw 机器人配置：渠道、智能体、安全及自动驾驶设置

description: Core principles and workflow router for changes to the Agents Window under src/vs/sessions.
description_zh: src/vs/sessions 下 Agents 窗口变更的核心原则与工作流路由器

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or imagine videos. Supports structured prompts and reference image for guided generation.
description_zh: 当用户请求生成、创建或想象视频时，使用此技能。该技能支持结构化的提示词和参考图像，用于引导生成。

description: Use when designing domain error handling. Keywords: domain error, error categorization, recovery strategy, retry, fallback, domain error hierarchy, user-facing vs internal errors, error code design, circuit breaker, graceful degradation, resilience, error context, backoff, retry with backoff, error recovery, transient vs permanent error, 领域错误, 错误分类, 恢复策略, 重试, 熔断器, 优雅降级
description_zh: 在设计领域错误处理时使用。关键词：领域错误, 错误分类, 恢复策略, 重试, 回退, 领域错误层级结构, 面向用户的错误与内部错误, 错误码设计, 熔断器, 优雅降级, 韧性, 错误上下文, 退避, 带退避的重试, 错误恢复, 暂时性错误与永久性错误, 领域错误, 错误分类, 恢复策略, 重试, 熔断器, 优雅降级

description: Build 2D games and animations using SpriteKit. Use when creating game scenes with SKScene and SKView, adding sprites with SKSpriteNode, animating with SKAction sequences, simulating physics with SKPhysicsBody and contact detection, creating particle effects with SKEmitterNode, building tile maps, using SKCameraNode, or integrating SpriteKit scenes in SwiftUI with SpriteView.
description_zh: 使用 SpriteKit 构建 2D 游戏和动画。在创建游戏场景（使用 SKScene 和 SKView）、使用 SKSpriteNode 添加精灵、使用 SKAction 序列进行动画、使用 SKPhysicsBody 和接触检测模拟物理效果、使用 SKEmitterNode 创建粒子效果、构建瓦片地图、使用 SKCameraNode，或在 SwiftUI 中使用 SpriteView 集成 SpriteKit 场景时使用。

description: Build a roguelike: turn-based grid movement, procedural dungeons, permadeath, field-of-view, and loot tables. Use for a roguelike/roguelite or turn-based grid dungeon crawler with procedural levels.
description_zh: 构建一个类Roguelike游戏：支持回合制网格移动、程序生成的地牢、永久死亡机制、视野范围以及战利品表。适用于类Roguelike/类Roguelite游戏，或具备程序化关卡的回合制网格地牢爬行游戏。

description: Provides patterns and configurations for running WireMock as a standalone Docker container. Generates mock HTTP endpoints, creates stub mappings for testing, validates integration scenarios, and simulates error conditions. Use when you need to mock APIs, create a mock server, stub external services, simulate third-party APIs, or fake API responses for integration testing.
description_zh: 提供以独立 Docker 容器形式运行 WireMock 的模式与配置。生成模拟 HTTP 端点，为测试创建桩映射，验证集成场景，并模拟错误条件。当需要模拟 API、创建模拟服务器、为外部服务打桩、模拟第三方 API 或为集成测试模拟 API 响应时使用。

description: Generate an interactive options payoff curve chart with dynamic parameter controls. Use this skill whenever the user shares an options position screenshot, describes an options strategy, or asks to visualize how an options trade makes or loses money. Triggers include: any mention of butterfly, spread (vertical/calendar/diagonal/ratio), straddle, strangle, condor, covered call, protective put, iron condor, or any multi-leg options structure. Also triggers when a user pastes strike prices, premiums, expiry dates, or says things like "show me the payoff", "draw the P&L curve", "what does this trade look like", or uploads a screenshot from a broker (IBKR, TastyTrade, Robinhood, etc). Always use this skill even if the user only provides partial info — extract what you can and use defaults for the rest.
description_zh: 生成带动态参数控制的交互式期权损益曲线图。当用户提供期权持仓截图、描述期权策略或要求可视化期权交易如何盈利或亏损时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：任何提及蝶式期权、价差（垂直/日历/对角/比率价差）、跨式期权、宽跨式期权、空跨式期权、备兑看涨期权、保护性看跌期权、铁鹰式期权或任何多腿期权结构的情况。此外，当用户粘贴行权价格、权利金、到期日，或说出诸如“展示我的损益”、“绘制损益曲线”、“这笔交易看起来如何”等话语，或上传来自经纪商（IBKR、TastyTrade、Robinhood等）的截图时，也会触发。即使用户仅提供部分信息，也始终使用该技能——尽可能提取可用信息，其余部分使用默认设置。

description: Market news briefings with AI summaries. Use when asked about stock news, market updates, portfolio performance, morning/evening briefings, financial headlines, or price alerts. Supports US/Europe/Japan markets, WhatsApp delivery, and English/German output.
description_zh:
带 AI 摘要的市场新闻简报。
在用户询问股票新闻、市场动态、投资组合表现、早间/晚间简报、财经头条或价格提醒时使用。
支持美、欧、日市场，WhatsApp 消息推送，以及英文/德文输出。

description: When the user wants to track App Store chart rank changes, find top gainers and losers, detect breakout apps entering the top 100, or identify apps dropping out of charts. Also use when the user mentions "chart movers", "rank changes", "who's rising", "who's falling", "new chart entries", "top gainers", or "market shifts". For broader market overview, see market-pulse. For competitive keyword analysis, see competitor-analysis.
description_zh: 当用户希望跟踪 App Store 排行榜排名变化、查找涨幅最高和跌幅最大的应用、检测进入前 100 名榜单的突围应用、或识别从榜单中掉出的应用时。当用户提及“榜单动态”、“排名变化”、“谁在上升”、“谁在下跌”、“新榜上榜应用”、“涨幅榜首”或“市场变动”时，也需使用。如需更全面的市场概览，请参见 market-pulse。如需进行竞争关键词分析，请参见 competitor-analysis。

description: Use Godot 4.7 physics bodies and detection in 2D and 3D: RigidBody, StaticBody, Area, and CharacterBody; collision layers vs masks; contact/overlap signals; and raycasts (RayCast nodes and direct space-state queries). Use when configuring collision layers/masks, detecting overlaps with Area2D/Area3D, applying forces to a RigidBody, or casting rays in a Godot project (.tscn with physics bodies).
description_zh: 使用 Godot 4.7 在 2D 和 3D 中的物理体与检测：刚体（RigidBody）、静态体（StaticBody）、区域（Area）与角色体（CharacterBody）；碰撞层与遮罩；接触/重叠信号；以及射线检测（RayCast节点与直接空间状态查询）。适用于配置碰撞层/遮罩、使用 Area2D/Area3D 检测重叠、对刚体施加力，或在包含物理体的 Godot 项目（.tscn）中投射射线。

description: Use to configure, set up, or repair the Sales Management agent and Agentforce Pipeline Management in a Salesforce org. Automates metadata creation for flows, prompt templates, permission sets, and data source configuration. TRIGGER when: user wants to enable Pipeline Management, configure Sales pipeline features, set up the Sales Management agent for opportunity field updates (including autonomous updates), connect enabled data sources like Einstein Conversation Insights or Einstein Activity Capture, customize opportunity stage descriptions, configure post-meeting suggestions, verify or audit configuration status, fix partially configured orgs, or troubleshoot Pipeline Management metadata issues. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to build a custom agent (use agentforce-generate), configure general Agentforce tracing (use platform-tracing-agentforce-configure), work with non-Sales agents, or enable Einstein Conversation Insights or Einstein Activity Capture from scratch (provisioning is out of scope).
description_zh:
用于在 Salesforce 组织中对销售管理代理与 Agentforce 管道管理进行配置、设置或修复。自动创建流程、提示模板、权限集和数据源配置的元数据。

**触发条件：** 当用户希望启用管道管理、配置销售管道功能、为机会字段更新（包括自主更新）设置销售管理代理、连接已启用的数据源（如爱因斯坦对话洞察或爱因斯坦活动捕获）、自定义机会阶段描述、配置会后建议、验证或审计配置状态、修复部分配置的 org、排查管道管理元数据问题时触发。

**请勿触发：** 当用户希望构建自定义代理（请使用 agentforce-generate）、配置通用的 Agentforce 追踪（请使用 platform-tracing-agentforce-configure）、与销售非相关代理交互，或从零启用爱因斯坦对话洞察或爱因斯坦活动捕获（部署不在范围内）时，请勿触发。

description: When the user wants to plan video marketing, create video scripts, or optimize for short-form or long-form video. Also use when the user mentions "video marketing," "video script," "short-form video," "long-form video," "TikTok script," "Reels script," "YouTube script," "video hook," or "video content strategy." For on-site video SEO, use video-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户需要规划视频营销、编写视频脚本，或对短视频或长视频进行优化时使用。当用户提及“视频营销”、“视频脚本”、“短视频”、“长视频”、“TikTok脚本”、“Reels脚本”、“YouTube脚本”、“视频钩子”或“视频内容策略”时，同样适用。针对站内视频SEO，请使用视频优化。

description: AI-powered adversarial UI testing via the browse CLI. Analyzes git diffs to test only what changed, or explores the full app to find bugs. Tests functional correctness, accessibility, responsive layout, and UX heuristics. Use when the user asks to test UI changes, QA a pull request, audit accessibility, or run exploratory testing. Supports local browser (localhost) and remote Browserbase (deployed sites).
description_zh: 通过 browse CLI 进行 AI 驱动的对抗性 UI 测试。分析 git diff 以仅测试变更内容，或探索整个应用以查找 bug。测试功能正确性、可访问性、响应式布局和 UX 启发式规则。适用于用户要求测试 UI 变更、审查 Pull Request、审计可访问性或运行探索性测试时。支持本地浏览器（localhost）和远程 Browserbase（已部署站点）。

description: Build custom dropdown/select/autocomplete/multiselect components using Mantine's Combobox primitives. Use this skill when: (1) creating a new custom select-like component with Combobox primitives, (2) building a searchable dropdown, (3) implementing a multi-select or tags input variant, (4) customizing option rendering, (5) adding custom filtering logic, or (6) any task involving useCombobox, Combobox.Target, Combobox.Option, or Combobox.Dropdown.
description_zh:
使用 Mantine 的 Combobox 基础组件构建自定义的下拉/选择/自动补全/多选组件。使用此技能当：
(1) 使用 Combobox 基础组件创建新的类似选择器的自定义组件，
(2) 构建可搜索的下拉菜单，
(3) 实现多选或标签输入变体，
(4) 定制选项渲染，
(5) 添加自定义筛选逻辑，
(6) 任何涉及 useCombobox、Combobox.Target、Combobox.Option 或 Combobox.Dropdown 的任务。

description: Create media playback experiences using AVKit. Use when adding video players with AVPlayerViewController, enabling Picture-in-Picture, routing media with AirPlay, using SwiftUI VideoPlayer views, configuring transport controls, displaying subtitles and closed captions, or integrating AVFoundation playback with system UI.
description_zh: 使用 AVKit 创建媒体播放体验。在添加使用 AVPlayerViewController 的视频播放器、启用画中画、通过 AirPlay 传输媒体、使用 SwiftUI VideoPlayer 视图、配置传输控件、显示字幕和隐藏式字幕，或集成 AVFoundation 播放与系统 UI 时使用。

description: Set up isolated git worktrees — create a new branch for fresh work, or attach a worktree to an existing branch, PR, or commit. Use when starting isolated work or isolating an existing ref.
description_zh: 设置独立的 Git 工作树——为全新工作创建新的分支，或将工作树附加到现有的分支、Pull Request（PR）或提交。适用于开始隔离工作或隔离现有引用时。

description: Vitest fast unit testing framework powered by Vite with Jest-compatible API. Use when writing tests, mocking, configuring coverage, or working with test filtering and fixtures.
description_zh: 基于 Vite 的 Vitest 快速单元测试框架，具备 Jest 兼容的 API。在编写测试、进行模拟、配置覆盖率，或处理测试筛选与测试夹具时使用。

description: Generates B2B/B2C leads by scraping Google Maps, websites, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Google Search. Use when user asks to find leads, prospects, businesses, build lead lists, enrich contacts, or scrape profiles for sales outreach.
description_zh: 通过爬取 Google Maps、网站、Instagram、TikTok、Facebook、LinkedIn、YouTube 和 Google Search，生成 B2B/B2C 潜在客户线索。当用户要求查找线索、潜在客户、企业，构建线索列表、丰富联系人信息或爬取个人资料用于销售外联时使用。

description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.
description_zh: 从代码库中抽取业务领域知识，并生成交互式领域流程图。支持独立运行（轻量扫描），也可基于现有的 /understand 知识图谱进行派生。

description: Create, repair, validate, preview, and package Codex-compatible animated pet spritesheets from character art, screenshots, generated images, or visual references. Use when a user wants to hatch a Codex pet, create a custom animated pet, or build a built-in pet asset with an 8x9 atlas, transparent unused cells, row-by-row animation prompts, QA contact sheets, preview videos, and pet.json packaging. This skill composes the installed $imagegen system skill for visual generation and uses bundled scripts for deterministic spritesheet assembly.
description_zh: 创建、修复、验证、预览并打包 Codex 兼容的动画宠物精灵图集，素材来源包括角色美术、截图、生成图像或视觉参考。当用户需要孵化 Codex 宠物、创建自定义动画宠物，或构建内置宠物资源时使用（资源包含 8x9 图集、透明未使用单元格、逐行动画提示词、QA 拼图、预览视频以及 pet.json 打包）。该技能组合了已安装的 $imagegen 系统技能用于视觉生成，并使用捆绑脚本进行确定性的精灵图集组装。

description:
Latest news articles, regulatory filings, community discussion topics for listed stocks, and SEC EDGAR filing analysis (10-K/10-Q/8-K/proxy/Form 4) via Longbridge.
Triggers: "新闻", "公告", "资讯", "话题", "社区讨论", "SEC", "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "Form 4", "新聞", "公告", "資訊", "話題", "社區討論", "news", "filing", "announcement", "topic", "community", "SEC filing", "annual report", "quarterly report", "proxy", "insider filing", "regulatory rules", "监管规则", "涨跌停", "漲跌停", "T+1", "PDT rule", "熔断", "熔斷", "circuit breaker", "margin rules", "保证金", "保證金", "監管規則"
description_zh: 通过 Longbridge，提供最新新闻文章、监管申报、上市公司社区讨论话题，以及 SEC EDGAR 申报文件分析（10-K/10-Q/8-K/proxy/Form 4）。

description: 通过小云雀的 AI 能力进行综合创作，支持生成和编辑图片/视频。覆盖场景包括：生成（文生图、文生视频、图生视频、做动画、画一个xxx、来段xxx）、编辑修改（把xxx换成yyy、去掉xxx、加上xxx、改成xxx、调整xxx、局部修改、改镜头）、风格转换（风格迁移、转绘、换风格）、视频续写延长、复刻视频/TVC/宣传片、短剧/短漫剧生成、音乐MV生成、产品广告/展示片制作、分镜/故事板设计、教育视频/短视频制作。当用户提到小云雀、xyq、上传参考图/视频、查看生成进度时也应触发。关键判断：只要用户的请求涉及 AI 视频的创作、生成、编辑、修改，无论措辞如何（如"画只猫"、"做个海报"、"做个视频"、"这个视频帮我改一下"、"帮我复刻这段视频"、"用这首歌做个MV"、"一句话生成短剧"），都必须触发此技能。
description_zh: 通过小云雀的 AI 能力进行综合创作，支持生成和编辑图片/视频。覆盖场景包括：生成（文生图、文生视频、图生视频、制作动画、画一个xxx、来段xxx）、编辑修改（把xxx换成yyy、去掉xxx、加上xxx、改成xxx、调整xxx、局部修改、改镜头）、风格转换（风格迁移、转绘、换风格）、视频续写延长、复刻视频/TVC/宣传片、短剧/短漫剧生成、音乐MV生成、产品广告/展示片制作、分镜/故事板设计、教育视频/短视频制作。当用户提到小云雀、xyq、上传参考图/视频、查看生成进度时也应触发。关键判断：只要用户的请求涉及 AI 视频的创作、生成、编辑、修改，无论措辞如何（如"画只猫"、"做个海报"、"做个视频"、"这个视频帮我改一下"、"帮我复刻这段视频"、"用这首歌做个MV"、"一句话生成短剧"），都必须触发此技能。

description: Build a playable prototype in about an hour to answer one question — is it fun? — with greybox primitives, a hard timebox, and explicit keep/kill criteria. Use when prototyping a mechanic, making a vertical slice or MVP, greyboxing/blockout, or judging throwaway vs keep.
description_zh: 大约一小时内构建可玩的原型，来回答一个问题——它是否有趣？——并采用灰盒原语、硬性时间盒和明确的保留/剔除标准。适用于原型化机制、开发垂直切片或MVP、灰盒化/画底图，或评估可抛弃方案与保留方案时。

description: Autonomous AI pentester for web apps and APIs. Run white-box security assessments with Shannon — analyzes source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities. Triggered by 'shannon', 'pentest', 'security audit', 'vuln scan'.
description_zh: 用于网页应用和API的自主AI渗透测试器。使用Shannon即可运行白盒安全评估——该工具分析源代码、识别攻击向量，并执行真实利用代码以验证漏洞。可通过'Shannon'、'pentest'、'security audit'、'vuln scan'等关键词触发。

description: CRITICAL: Use for unsafe Rust code review and FFI. Triggers on: unsafe, raw pointer, FFI, extern, transmute, *mut, *const, union, #[repr(C)], libc, std::ffi, MaybeUninit, NonNull, SAFETY comment, soundness, undefined behavior, UB, safe wrapper, memory layout, bindgen, cbindgen, CString, CStr, 安全抽象, 裸指针, 外部函数接口, 内存布局, 不安全代码, FFI 绑定, 未定义行为
description_zh: CRITICAL：用于不安全 Rust 代码审查及 FFI。触发条件：unsafe、裸指针、FFI、extern、transmute、*mut、*const、union、#[repr(C)]、libc、std::ffi、MaybeUninit、NonNull、SAFETY 注释、稳健性、未定义行为、UB、安全封装、内存布局、bindgen、cbindgen、CString、CStr、安全抽象、裸指针、外部函数接口、内存布局、不安全代码、FFI 绑定、未定义行为

description: Synthesize user research from interviews, surveys, and feedback into structured insights. Use when you have a pile of interview notes, survey responses, or support tickets to make sense of, need to extract themes and rank findings by frequency and impact, or want to turn raw feedback into roadmap recommendations.
description_zh: 将来自访谈、调查与反馈的用户研究综合为结构化洞察。当您需处理大量访谈记录、调查回复或支持工单，厘清内容，提炼主题并按频率和影响对发现排序，或将原始反馈转化为路线图建议时，使用本工具。

description: Run an end-to-end product strategy session across positioning, discovery, and roadmap planning. Use when a team needs validated direction before committing to execution.
description_zh: 开展端到端产品策略会议，涵盖定位、发现与路线图规划。当团队在决定执行前需要已验证的方向时使用。

description: Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI — including ordinary web research: searching the web, reading or extracting pages, gathering sources, discovering site URLs, bulk extraction, downloading a site, change alerts, or pages needing clicks/login — web only; local files route to firecrawl-parse. For papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.
description_zh: 任何通过 Firecrawl CLI 进行的实时网页任务——包括常规网页研究，例如：网络搜索、阅读或提取网页、收集资料来源、发现网站 URL、批量提取、下载整个网站、变更提醒，或需要点击/登录的页面——均仅限网页任务；本地文件则路由至 firecrawl-parse。论文相关请使用 firecrawl-research-index；关于图书馆、API、错误或 Bug 的问题，请使用 firecrawl-developer-index。

description: Scholarly writing and research compliance. Use for CRediT, preregistration, Plan S, Nelson Memo, preprints, ORCID, LLM disclosure.
description_zh: 学术写作与研究合规。用于CRediT、预注册、Plan S、Nelson备忘录、预印本、ORCID、大语言模型披露。

description: Build, scaffold, refactor, and troubleshoot ChatGPT Apps SDK applications that combine an MCP server and widget UI. Use when Codex needs to design tools, register UI resources, wire the MCP Apps bridge or ChatGPT compatibility APIs, apply Apps SDK metadata or CSP or domain settings, or produce a docs-aligned project scaffold. Prefer a docs-first workflow by invoking the openai-docs skill or OpenAI developer docs MCP tools before generating code.
description_zh: 构建、搭建、重构和排查结合了 MCP 服务器与组件 UI 的 ChatGPT 应用 SDK 应用程序。当 Codex 需要设计工具、注册 UI 资源、连接 MCP 应用桥接或 ChatGPT 兼容性 API、配置应用 SDK 元数据、CSP 或域名设置，或生成与文档对齐的项目脚手架时使用。优先采用文档优先的工作流，即在生成代码之前调用 openai-docs 技能或 OpenAI 开发者文档 MCP 工具。

description: Reference-only filter syntax for VSTest and MTP with MSTest, NUnit, xUnit v3, and TUnit. Load only after the platform/framework is known and a consumer needs to create or translate a filter. Do not load for unfiltered runs or platform detection. Used by run-tests and mtp-hot-reload; never invoke directly.
description_zh: 用于 VSTest 和 MTP 的仅作参考的过滤器语法（支持 MSTest、NUnit、xUnit v3 和 TUnit）。仅在平台/框架已知且消费者需要创建或翻译过滤器时加载。不得用于无过滤器运行或平台检测。由 run-tests 和 mtp-hot-reload 使用；切勿直接调用。

description: Use Apple CryptoKit for Swift cryptographic primitives. Use when hashing with SHA-2 or SHA-3, generating HMACs, encrypting with AES-GCM or ChaChaPoly, signing with P256/P384/P521/Curve25519 or ML-DSA keys, performing ECDH, HPKE, ML-KEM, or X-Wing key exchange, using Secure Enclave CryptoKit keys, or migrating CommonCrypto code to CryptoKit.
description_zh: 使用 Apple CryptoKit 为 Swift 提供密码学原语。在以下情况下使用：使用 SHA-2 或 SHA-3 进行哈希，生成 HMAC，使用 AES-GCM 或 ChaChaPoly 进行加密，使用 P256/P384/P521/Curve25519 或 ML-DSA 密钥进行签名，进行 ECDH、HPKE、ML-KEM 或 X-Wing 密钥交换，使用 Secure Enclave 的 CryptoKit 密钥，或将 CommonCrypto 代码迁移至 CryptoKit。

description: Design a detailed value proposition using a 6-part JTBD template — Who, Why, What before, How, What after, Alternatives. Use when creating a value proposition, analyzing customer value delivery, or articulating why customers should choose your product.
description_zh: 使用六部分JTBD模板设计详细的价值主张——谁、为何、之前、如何、之后、替代方案。在创建价值主张、分析客户价值交付，或阐述客户为何应选择您的产品时使用。

description: Guidelines for fixing unhandled errors from the VS Code error telemetry dashboard. Use when investigating error-telemetry issues with stack traces, error messages, and hit/user counts. Covers tracing data flow through call stacks, identifying producers of invalid data vs. consumers that crash, enriching error messages for telemetry diagnosis, and avoiding common anti-patterns like silently swallowing errors.
description_zh: VS Code 错误遥测仪表板中未处理错误的修复指南。用于当排查涉及堆栈跟踪、错误信息和命中次数及用户数的错误遥测问题时。涵盖通过调用栈追踪数据流、识别无效数据生产者与导致崩溃的消费者、丰富错误信息以进行遥测诊断，以及避免如静默吞掉错误等常见反模式。

description: Use when collecting or analyzing production iOS or iPadOS performance telemetry with MetricKit, including iOS 27 MetricManager async metric or diagnostic reports, hang or crash triage, custom signposts, extended launch measurement, durable export, or iOS 26 MXMetricManager compatibility.
description_zh: 用于使用 MetricKit 采集或分析生产环境 iOS 或 iPadOS 性能遥测数据，包括 iOS 27 MetricManager 异步指标或诊断报告、挂起或崩溃故障排查、自定义标志点、扩展启动测量、持久化导出，或 iOS 26 MXMetricManager 兼容性。

description: Set up or troubleshoot @przeprogramowani/10x-cli for a 10xDevs learner: reuse or install a compatible CLI, check authentication and course access, choose the project and AI tool, and hand off to 10x-cli-guide. Use for installation, updates, npm permissions and onboarding. Excludes CLI source development and everyday download/use/sync guidance once setup is ready.
description_zh: 为 10xDevs 学习者设置或排查 @przeprogramowani/10x-cli：复用或安装兼容的 CLI，检查身份验证与课程访问权限，选择项目和 AI 工具，并转交给 10x-cli-guide。适用于安装、更新、npm 权限设置及入职引导。设置完成后，不包含 CLI 源码开发以及日常下载、使用、同步的指导。

description: Use when integrating crates or ecosystem questions.
