Keywords: E0425, E0433, E0603, crate, cargo, dependency, feature flag, workspace, which crate to use, using external C libraries, creating Python extensions, PyO3, wasm, WebAssembly, bindgen, cbindgen, napi-rs, cannot find, private, crate recommendation, best crate for, Cargo.toml, features, crate 推荐, 依赖管理, 特性标志, 工作空间, Python 绑定
description_zh: 用于集成 crate 或生态系统问题时使用。关键词：E0425、E0433、E0603、crate、cargo、依赖、特性标志、工作空间、使用哪个 crate、使用外部 C 库、创建 Python 扩展、PyO3、wasm、WebAssembly、bindgen、cbindgen、napi-rs、找不到、私有、crate 推荐、最佳 crate 选择、Cargo.toml、特性、crate 推荐、依赖管理、特性标志、工作空间、Python 绑定

description: ALWAYS ACTIVE — read at the start of any ADK agent development session. ADK development lifecycle and mandatory coding guidelines — spec-driven workflow, code preservation rules, model selection, and troubleshooting.
description_zh: 始终启用 — 在任何 ADK 代理开发会话开始时阅读。ADK 开发生命周期和强制性编码规范 — 规范驱动的工作流程、代码保留规则、模型选择及故障排查。

description: Java "Ghost Bits" / Cast Attack playbook (Black Hat Asia 2026). Use when attacking Java services where 16-bit char is silently narrowed to 8-bit byte to bypass WAF/IDS for SQL injection, deserialization RCE, file upload (Webshell), path traversal, CRLF injection, request smuggling, and SMTP injection. Affects Tomcat, Spring, Jetty, Undertow, Vert.x, Jackson, Fastjson, Apache Commons BCEL, Apache HttpClient, Angus Mail, JDK HttpServer, Lettuce, Jodd, XMLWriter and re-enables many "patched" CVEs through WAF bypass.
description_zh: Java "幽灵位" / 类型转换攻击操作手册（Black Hat Asia 2026）。适用于攻击 Java 服务，当 16 位字符被静默收窄为 8 位字节时，可绕过 WAF/IDS，用于实现 SQL 注入、反序列化 RCE、文件上传（Webshell）、路径穿越、CRLF 注入、请求走私及 SMTP 注入。影响 Tomcat、Spring、Jetty、Undertow、Vert.x、Jackson、Fastjson、Apache Commons BCEL、Apache HttpClient、Angus Mail、JDK HttpServer、Lettuce、Jodd、XMLWriter，并通过 WAF 绕过方式重新启用许多已修复的 CVE 漏洞。

description: Design data-driven Godot 4.7 games with custom Resource classes: define typed data with class_name + @export, save/load .tres/.res files, instance and duplicate resources, and load on demand with ResourceLoader (incl. threaded loading). Use when modeling items/stats/configs as data in a Godot project, creating .tres resources, or working with custom Resource subclasses and ResourceLoader/ResourceSaver.
description_zh: 使用自定义 Resource 类设计数据驱动的 Godot 4.7 游戏：定义类型化数据（通过 class_name + @export），保存/加载 .tres/.res 文件，实例化与复制资源，并通过 ResourceLoader 按需加载（包括线程加载）。适用于在 Godot 项目中以物品、属性、配置等作为数据建模、创建 .tres 资源，或与自定义 Resource 子类及 ResourceLoader/ResourceSaver 协同工作的场景。

description: Sets up and manages Postgres using the clickhousectl CLI — runs a local Docker-backed Postgres for development, and creates and operates managed ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services (connections, TLS, runtime config, read replicas, failover, point-in-time restore). Use when the user wants a Postgres or PostgreSQL database for their application, a local Postgres dev environment, psql access, or a managed/production Postgres in ClickHouse Cloud, or mentions moving a local Postgres to production.
description_zh: 使用 clickhousectl 命令行工具 (CLI) 搭建和管理 Postgres——在开发环境中运行基于 Docker 的本地 Postgres，并创建和管理托管的 ClickHouse Cloud Postgres 服务（包括连接、TLS 加密、运行时配置、只读副本、故障转移、时间点恢复）。当用户需要为应用程序使用 Postgres 或 PostgreSQL 数据库、搭建本地 Postgres 开发环境、进行 psql 访问，或在 ClickHouse Cloud 中使用托管/生产级 Postgres，或提及将本地 Postgres 迁移至生产环境时使用。

description: Search and browse the x402 bazaar marketplace for paid API services. Use when you or the user want to find available services, see what's available, discover APIs, or need an external service to accomplish a task. Also use as a fallback when no other skill clearly matches — search the bazaar to see if a paid service exists. Covers "what can I do?", "find me an API for...", "what services are available?", "search for...", "browse the bazaar".
description_zh: 在 x402 bazaar 市场中搜索并浏览付费 API 服务。当您或用户需要查找可用服务、查看有哪些可用、发现 API 或需要外部服务来完成任务时使用。当没有其他技能明确匹配时，也可作为备用方案——在 bazaar 中搜索，以查看是否存在付费服务。涵盖“我能做什么？”“为我寻找……的 API”“有哪些服务可用？”“搜索……”“浏览 bazaar”等。

description: Display and manipulate PDF documents using PDFKit. Use when embedding PDFView to show PDF files, creating or modifying PDFDocument instances, adding annotations (highlights, notes, signature widgets), extracting text with PDFSelection, navigating pages, generating thumbnails, filling PDF forms, or wrapping PDFView in SwiftUI.
description_zh: 使用 PDFKit 显示并操作 PDF 文档。适用于将 PDFView 嵌入以展示 PDF 文件、创建或修改 PDFDocument 实例、添加标注（高亮、批注、签名控件）、使用 PDFSelection 提取文本、导航页面、生成缩略图、填写 PDF 表单，或在 SwiftUI 中封装 PDFView。

description: Integrate Game Center features using GameKit. Use when authenticating GKLocalPlayer, checking player restrictions, submitting leaderboard scores, reporting achievements, implementing real-time or turn-based matchmaking, handling GKMatch data, showing the Game Center dashboard or access point, adding challenges and friend invitations, saving game data, or verifying player identity on a server.
description_zh: 使用 GameKit 集成游戏中心功能。适用于为 GKLocalPlayer 进行身份验证、检查玩家限制、提交排行榜分数、上报成就、实现实时或回合制匹配、处理 GKMatch 数据、显示游戏中心仪表盘或入口、添加挑战和朋友邀请、保存游戏数据，或在服务器上验证玩家身份。

description: Summarize a meeting transcript into structured notes with date, participants, topic, key decisions, summary points, and action items. Use when processing meeting recordings, creating meeting notes, writing meeting minutes, or recapping discussions.
description_zh: 将会议记录总结为包含日期、参会人员、议题、关键决策、总结要点和行动项的结构化会议纪要。在处理会议录音、创建会议纪要、撰写会议记录或回顾讨论时使用。

description: Free AI search via Exa MCP. Web search for news/info, code search for docs/examples from GitHub/StackOverflow, company research for business intel. No API key needed.
description_zh: 通过 Exa MCP 免费的 AI 搜索。网页搜索获取新闻/信息，代码搜索获取 GitHub/StackOverflow 上的文档/示例，企业研究获取商业情报。无需 API 密钥。

description: For marketers and creators producing promotional content for brands, products, websites, apps, shops, or personal projects. Users provide logos, product images, interface screenshots, official links, or other verifiable assets and confirm duration, aspect ratio, audience, and campaign focus. The Skill organizes brand facts and asset provenance, selects a narrative direction, plans precise beats and shots, generates needed imagery, video, voiceover, or music, and completes assembly and pre-delivery review. It outputs a promotional short that highlights product capabilities, use cases, and a call to action. Best for launches, website showcases, and social promotion; not for imitating real brand marks without authorized assets, inventing product claims, or producing long-form narrative films.
description_zh: 面向为品牌、产品、网站、应用、商店或个人项目制作宣传内容的营销人员与创作者。用户提供标志、产品图片、界面截图、官方链接或其他可验证素材，并确认时长、比例、受众与活动焦点。该技能整理品牌信息与素材溯源，确定叙事方向，规划精准的镜头与节奏，生成所需图片、视频、配音或音乐，并完成组装与交付前审核。它能输出一部突出产品功能、使用场景与行动号召的宣传短片。适用于产品发布、网站展示及社交推广；不可在无授权素材的情况下模仿真实品牌标志、虚构产品声明，或制作长篇叙事电影。

description: Audit a test file or suite; produce a severity-ranked diagnostic report. ALWAYS USE for tests that verify nothing, missing/tautological assertions, swallowed/broad exceptions, flaky/order-dependent tests, duplication, or magic values. Polyglot. DO NOT USE for direct edits: writing-mstest-tests owns supplied MSTest assertions/attributes/lifecycle; code-testing-agent owns new tests. Exclude running tests, migration, assertion metrics (assertion-quality), raw .NET coverage collection (run-tests), non-.NET coverage collection/analysis (native tooling), project-wide .NET coverage/CRAP (coverage-analysis), named-target .NET CRAP (crap-score), behavioral/pseudo-mutation gaps (test-gap-analysis), test-mix/ happy-vs-error classification and trait distributions (test-tagging), or the testsmells.org catalog (test-smell-detection).
description_zh: 审计测试文件或测试套件；生成按严重程度排序的诊断报告。始终用于审计以下类型的测试：不验证任何内容的测试、缺失或同义反复的断言、被吞没或过于宽泛的异常、不稳定或依赖执行顺序的测试、重复项或魔法值。多语言。严禁用于直接编辑：编写 MSTest 测试（writing-mstest-tests）负责使用所供 MSTest 断言、属性及生命周期；代码测试代理（code-testing-agent）负责编写新测试。排除以下内容：运行测试、迁移、断言指标（assertion-quality）、原始 .NET 覆盖率收集（run-tests）、非 .NET 覆盖率收集/分析（原生工具）、项目级 .NET 覆盖率/CRAP（coverage-analysis）、指定目标的 .NET CRAP（crap-score）、行为/伪变异间隙（test-gap-analysis）、测试混合/正常与错误分类及特征分布（test-tagging），以及 testsmells.org 目录（test-smell-detection）。

description: Create and manage SLOs in Elastic Observability using the Kibana API. Use when defining SLIs, setting error budgets, or managing SLO lifecycle.
description_zh: 使用 Kibana API 在 Elastic Observability 中创建和管理 SLO。用于定义 SLIs、设置错误预算或管理 SLO 生命周期。

description: Build event-driven, decoupled Godot 4.7 gameplay with signals and node groups: declare and emit custom signals, connect with Callables (incl. bind/one-shot), and broadcast to many nodes via groups and call_group. Use when wiring node communication in a Godot project, replacing tight references with signals, emitting/connecting events, or porting 3.x connect("sig", self, "method") code.
description_zh: 使用信号和节点组构建事件驱动、解耦的 Godot 4.7 游戏：声明并发出自定义信号，通过 Callable 进行连接（包括 bind/one-shot），并通过节点组和 call_group 向多个节点广播。在 Godot 项目中进行节点通信连接时使用，用信号替代紧密的引用，发出/连接事件，或移植 3.x 版本的 connect("sig", self, "method") 代码。

description: Scheduled function patterns for background tasks including interval scheduling, cron expressions, job monitoring, retry strategies, and best practices for long-running tasks
description_zh: 后台任务的定时调度模式，包括间隔调度、cron 表达式、任务监控、重试策略以及长期运行任务的最佳实践

description: Play and mix audio in Godot 4.7: AudioStreamPlayer (2D/3D variants), audio buses with volume/mute and effects, music vs SFX routing, db/linear volume, and precise sync-to-beat playback timing. Use when playing sounds or music in a Godot project, routing AudioStreamPlayer nodes to buses, adjusting bus volume via AudioServer, or syncing gameplay to the beat.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中播放与混合音频：AudioStreamPlayer（2D/3D 版本）、带音量/静音和特效的音频总线、音乐与音效的路由、dB/线性音量，以及精确的对拍同步播放节奏。适用于在 Godot 项目中播放声音或音乐、将 AudioStreamPlayer 节点路由到总线上、通过 AudioServer 调整总线音量，或将游戏玩法与节拍同步的场景。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or write professional research reports including but not limited to market analysis, consumer insights, brand analysis, financial analysis, industry research, competitive intelligence, investment due diligence, or any consulting-grade analytical report. This skill operates in two phases — (1) generating a structured analysis framework with chapter skeleton, data query requirements, and analysis logic, and (2) after data collection by other skills, producing the final consulting-grade report with structured narratives, embedded charts, and strategic insights.
description_zh:
当用户要求生成、创建或撰写专业研究报告（包括但不限于市场分析、消费者洞察、品牌分析、财务分析、行业研究、竞争情报、投资尽职调查，以及任何咨询级分析报告）时，使用本技能。本技能分为两个阶段：

(1) 生成包含章节骨架、数据查询要求和分析逻辑的结构化分析框架；

(2) 在其他技能完成数据收集后，产出包含结构化叙述、嵌入图表和战略见解的最终咨询级报告。

description: Create and manage DESIGN.md files. Useful for capturing design direction, tokens, and visual rules in a single source of truth.
description_zh: 创建并管理 DESIGN.md 文件。可在单一事实来源中记录设计方向、设计令牌及视觉规则。

description: Manage the month-end close process with task sequencing, dependencies, and status tracking. Use when planning the close calendar, tracking close progress, identifying blockers, or sequencing close activities by day.
description_zh: 通过任务排序、依赖关系和状态跟踪来管理月末结账流程。用于规划结账日历、跟踪结账进度、识别阻碍或按日排序结账活动。

description: Generate a status report with KPIs, risks, and action items. Use when writing a weekly or monthly update for leadership, summarizing project health with green/yellow/red status, surfacing risks and decisions that need stakeholder attention, or turning a pile of project tracker activity into a readable narrative.
description_zh: 生成包含关键绩效指标（KPIs）、风险和行动项的状态报告。该报告在向领导层撰写每周或每月更新时使用，以绿色、黄色、红色状态总结项目健康状况，凸显需利益相关者关注的风险与决策，或将项目跟踪器中的大量活动内容转化为可读的叙述。

description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
description_zh: **旨在减少常见LLM编码错误的行为准则。在编写、审查或重构代码时使用，以避免过度复杂，实施精准修改，明确假设，并制定可验证的成功标准。**

description: Expert guidelines for building performant animations with Framer Motion/Motion library in React applications
description_zh: React 应用中基于 Framer Motion/Motion 库构建高性能动画的专家指南

description: Use when diagnosing CopilotKit issues -- runtime connectivity failures, agent not responding, streaming errors, tool execution problems, transcription failures, version mismatches, and AG-UI event tracing.
description_zh: 用于诊断 CopilotKit 问题——运行时连接失败、智能体未响应、流式传输错误、工具执行问题、转录失败、版本不匹配及 AG-UI 事件追踪。

description: Run browser tests for pages affected by the current branch or PR. Use when asked to run or check browser tests for the current change.
description_zh: 针对受当前分支或 PR 影响的页面运行浏览器测试。当要求运行或检查当前变更的浏览器测试时使用。

description: Turn product images and ad requirements into minimalist product ad shorts for e-commerce promotion and product launches. The Skill confirms format and product variants, extracts selling points, writes concise English ad copy, builds product anchors, plans beat-synced typography/storyboards, and generates a clean product film with premium camera language. Not for KOC talking-head ads, general editing, or complex screen demos.
description_zh: 将产品图片与广告要求转化为电商推广与产品发布所需的极简产品广告短视频。该技能确认格式与产品变体，提取产品卖点，撰写简洁的英文广告文案，构建产品锚点，策划节拍同步的排版与分镜脚本，并生成带有高级拍摄语感、画面干净的成品产品视频。不适用于KOC口播广告、通用剪辑或复杂屏幕演示。

description: Teaches the agent to produce D3 charts and interactive data visualizations. A comprehensive D3.js skill with examples across chart types and techniques giving the agent expert-level knowledge to generate complex, interactive visualizations. Useful for editorial dashboards, reports, data-rich prototypes, and explanatory graphics.
description_zh: 教授代理生成D3图表和交互式数据可视化的能力。提供一套全面的D3.js技能，涵盖各类图表与技术的示例，为代理提供生成复杂、交互式可视化的专家级知识。适用于编辑仪表板、报告、数据丰富的原型和解释性图形。

description: Identify all files a specific author contributed to on a branch vs its upstream, tracing code through renames. Use when asked who edited what, what code an author contributed, or to audit authorship before a merge. This skill should be run as a subagent — it performs many git operations and returns a concise table.
description_zh: 识别特定作者在分支及其上游分支中贡献的全部文件，并追踪代码在重命名过程中的对应关系。当被询问谁编辑了哪些文件、特定作者贡献了哪些代码，或在合并前审计作者归属时，使用此技能。此技能应以子代理方式运行——它执行多项 git 操作，并返回一份简洁的表格。

description: Create, repair, validate, visually QA, and package Codex-compatible animated pets and pet spritesheets from character art, generated images, company or prospect brand cues, or visual references. Use when a user wants a lightweight-worker Codex pet workflow, a non-pixel custom pet style, a prospect or company mascot pet, or a full 8x9 animated pet atlas with transparent unused cells, QA contact sheets, and pet.json packaging. This skill composes the installed $imagegen system skill for visual generation and uses bundled scripts for deterministic spritesheet assembly.
description_zh: 基于角色美术、生成图像、公司或潜在客户品牌元素或视觉参考，创建、修复、验证、进行视觉质量检查，并打包 Codex 兼容的动画宠物及宠物精灵图集。适用于用户需要轻量级 Codex 宠物工作流、非像素自定义宠物风格、潜在客户或公司吉祥物宠物，或完整的 8x9 动画宠物画集（含透明未使用单元格、QA 接触表及 pet.json 打包）的场景。本技能整合已安装的 $imagegen 系统技能以完成视觉生成，并借助捆绑脚本进行确定性精灵图集组装。

description: Generate the commit / best-case / pipeline narrative for a forecast call or a 1:1 with your manager - what's closing, what's at risk, what changed since last time. Use when the user asks "write my forecast", "forecast narrative", "prep for forecast call", "prep for my quarterly forecast call", "which deals should I commit vs. call upside", "forecast from this pipeline export", or "prep for my 1:1 with my manager".
description_zh: 生成用于预测电话会议或与您的经理进行一对一沟通的承诺/最佳情况/管道叙述——内容包括当前正在推进或完成的事项、存在风险的事项，以及自上次以来发生的变化。在用户询问“撰写我的预测”、“预测叙述”、“准备预测电话会议”、“准备我的季度预测电话会议”、“我应该对哪些交易做承诺，哪些应预测上行空间”、“根据本次管道导出生成预测”、“准备与我的经理的一对一会议”时使用。

description: Write effective prompts for Jimeng Seedance 2.0 multimodal AI video generation. Use when users want to create video prompts using text, images, videos, and audio inputs with the @ reference system. Covers camera movements, effects replication, video extension, editing, music beat-matching, e-commerce ads, short dramas, and educational content.
description_zh: 为 Jimeng Seedance 2.0 多模态AI视频生成撰写有效的提示词。当用户希望使用文本、图像、视频和音频输入配合@引用系统创建视频提示词时使用。涵盖镜头运动、特效复制、视频扩展、编辑、音乐节奏匹配、电商广告、短剧和教育内容。

description: Create, read, and manage calendar events and reminders using EventKit and EventKitUI. Use when adding events to the user's calendar, creating reminders, setting recurrence rules, requesting calendar or reminders access, presenting event editors, choosing calendars, handling alarms, observing calendar changes, or working with EKEventStore, EKEvent, EKReminder, EKCalendar, EKRecurrenceRule, EKEventEditViewController, EKCalendarChooser, or EventKitUI views.
description_zh: 使用 EventKit 和 EventKitUI 创建、读取和管理日历事件及提醒。适用于向用户日历添加事件、创建提醒、设置重复规则、请求日历或提醒访问权限、呈现事件编辑器、选择日历、处理提醒、观察日历变更，或使用 EKEventStore、EKEvent、EKReminder、EKCalendar、EKRecurrenceRule、EKEventEditViewController、EKCalendarChooser 或 EventKitUI 视图。

description: Integrate Apple Music playback, catalog search, and Now Playing metadata using MusicKit and MediaPlayer. Use when adding music search, Apple Music subscription flows, queue management, playback controls, remote command handling, or Now Playing info to iOS apps.
description_zh: 使用 MusicKit 和 MediaPlayer 集成 Apple Music 播放、目录搜索及正在播放元数据。当为 iOS 应用添加音乐搜索、Apple Music 订阅流程、队列管理、播放控制、远程命令处理或正在播放信息时使用。

description: Use when building AI-powered features with CopilotKit v2 -- adding chat interfaces, registering frontend tools, sharing application context with agents, handling agent interrupts, and working with the CopilotKit runtime.
description_zh: 在基于 CopilotKit v2 构建 AI 驱动功能时使用——用于添加聊天界面、注册前端工具、与智能体共享应用上下文、处理智能体中断以及使用 CopilotKit 运行时。

description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape.
description_zh: 在代码编写前，先确定草图类型、签名与模块结构，并在实施过程中持续跟进。用于 /architect、'设计该'、'架构该'，或任何非琐碎工作——若直接跳至代码编写，将锁定错误的结构。

description: Guide for creating effective skills following best practices. Use when creating or updating skills that extend agent capabilities.
description_zh:
遵循最佳实践的创建有效技能指南。  
在创建或更新能够扩展智能体能力的技能时使用。

description: Build responsive, accessible UI components and layouts using Chakra UI v3, install or configure Chakra UI in new and existing projects, and design scalable themes using tokens, semantic tokens, recipes, and slot recipes. Use this skill whenever a user asks to build, create, or generate any UI component, page, form, dashboard, navbar, card, landing section, pricing table, or layout using Chakra UI; wants to add Chakra UI to a project, set up ChakraProvider, run CLI snippets, configure color mode, or fix provider wrapping; or asks about theming — defining brand colors, design tokens, semantic tokens, dark mode values, component recipes, slot recipes, typegen, or ejecting the default theme. Trigger on any Chakra UI building, setup, or theming or charts request, however casually phrased — "add my brand colors", "make a reusable card style", "build a bar chart", "show me a line chart", "make me a login form", "build a sidebar", "add Chakra to my app".
description_zh:
使用 Chakra UI v3 构建响应式、无障碍的 UI 组件和布局，在新项目和现有项目中安装或配置 Chakra UI，并使用令牌、语义令牌、配方及插槽配方设计可扩展主题。

在用户使用 Chakra UI 构建、创建或生成任何 UI 组件、页面、表单、仪表盘、导航栏、卡片、落地页区域、价格表或布局；希望将 Chakra UI 添加到项目中、设置 ChakraProvider、运行 CLI 代码片段、配置颜色模式或修复提供者包裹；或询问主题化相关内容——包括定义品牌颜色、设计令牌、语义令牌、深色模式值、组件配方、插槽配方、typegen 或移除默认主题——时，使用本技能。

当用户提出任何 Chakra UI 构建、设置、主题化或图表请求时，无论措辞如何随意，均应触发——例如："添加我的品牌颜色"、"制作可复用的卡片样式"、"构建一个柱状图"、"向我展示一条折线图"、"为我创建一个登录表单"、"构建一个侧边栏"、"将 Chakra 添加到我的应用中"。

description: Fast, modern JavaScript/TypeScript development with the Bun runtime, inspired by [oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun).
description_zh: 通过 Bun 运行时，快速、现代地开发 JavaScript/TypeScript，灵感源自 [oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun)。

description: Use when building custom agent backends, implementing the AG-UI protocol, debugging streaming issues, or understanding how agents communicate with frontends. Covers event types, SSE transport, AbstractAgent/HttpAgent patterns, state synchronization, tool calls, and human-in-the-loop flows.
description_zh: 用于构建自定义智能体后端、实现 AG-UI 协议、调试流式传输问题或理解智能体与前端如何通信的场景。涵盖事件类型、SSE 传输、AbstractAgent/HttpAgent 模式、状态同步、工具调用以及人工在环流程。

description: Build a first-person shooter: move+mouse-look controller, hitscan or projectile shooting, weapons, health, and enemy AI. Use for an FPS, or tuning aim feel, time-to-kill, recoil, or spread.
description_zh: 构建一款第一人称射击游戏：包含移动+鼠标视角控制器、直瞄射击或投射物射击、武器、生命值以及敌人AI。可用于第一人称射击游戏的开发，或用于调整瞄准手感、击杀时间、后坐力或散布度。

description: Export and build a Godot 4.7 project for distribution: install export templates, define export presets (Windows/macOS/Linux/Web/Android), run headless command-line exports for CI, and handle web (HTML5) COOP/COEP and dedicated-server/headless builds. Use when exporting a Godot game, configuring export_presets.cfg, building for web/desktop/mobile, or automating builds from the command line.
description_zh: 导出并构建用于分发的 Godot 4.7 项目：安装导出模板，定义导出预设（Windows/macOS/Linux/Web/Android），为 CI 运行无头命令行导出，并处理 Web（HTML5）下的 COOP/COEP 以及专用服务器/无头构建。当导出 Godot 游戏、配置 export_presets.cfg、针对 Web/桌面/移动端进行构建，或从命令行自动化构建时使用。

description: Create visually strong landing pages, websites, and app UIs with restrained composition. OpenAI's production frontend playbook.
description_zh: 以克制的构图，打造视觉上强有力的落地页、网站和应用界面。OpenAI 的生产前端行动指南。

description: Navigate Rust code using LSP. Triggers on: /navigate, go to definition, find references, where is defined, 跳转定义, 查找引用, 定义在哪, 谁用了这个
description_zh:
使用 LSP 导航 Rust 代码。触发条件：
- /navigate
- 跳转定义
- 查找引用
- 定义在哪
- 谁用了这个

description: Phase quiz for AI Engineering from Scratch. Trigger with "quiz me", "test phase", "check my understanding", "do I know phase 3", or `/check-understanding <phase>`.
description_zh:
从零开始的 AI 工程阶段测验。

可通过“quiz me”、“test phase”、“check my understanding”、“do I know phase 3”或 `/check-understanding <phase>` 触发。

description: For musicians, video creators, and social-media editors producing AI music videos or emotional short films with lyric typography. Users provide music, lyrics, references, characters, typography direction, mood, or target platform. The Skill analyzes beat and vocal timing, separates character, scene, and text references, designs beat-reactive spatial typography, decomposes long works into connected shots, audits prompts, and routes generation for H3 or other video tools. It outputs MV concepts, shot prompts, lyric text plans, and stitching guidance. Best for stylized MVs and subtitle-driven music visuals, not ordinary caption cleanup, licensed IP copying, or fully manual post-production editing.
description_zh: 为音乐人、视频创作者和社交媒体编辑者制作带有歌词字体的AI音乐视频或情感短片而设计。用户提供音乐、歌词、参考素材、角色、字体方向、情绪或目标平台。该技能分析节拍与人声节奏，将角色、场景和文字参考分离，设计节拍响应式空间排版，将长作品分解为连贯的镜头，审核提示词，并将生成任务路由至 H3 或其他视频工具。它输出MV概念、镜头提示词、歌词文本方案和拼接指导。最适合风格化的MV和以字幕驱动的音乐视觉内容，不适用于普通字幕清理、授权IP复制或完全手动后期剪辑。

description: For creators explaining science, education, or general knowledge through tactile handmade papercraft visuals. Users provide a topic, core knowledge points, or source material and may specify audience, duration, aspect ratio, and deliverable type. The Skill extracts the learning goal and visual metaphor, proposes creative directions, designs paper characters, layered diorama sets, and props, creates preview concepts plus image and video prompts, and plans storyboards, camera movement, transitions, and sound with staged approvals and review checklists. It outputs a production-ready papercraft stop-motion explainer package, or selected assets such as still prompts, image-series prompts, short-video prompts, or storyboards. Best for cut-paper, pop-up-book, layered diorama, and miniature stop-motion explainers; not for standard 2D cartoons, line doodles, live action, or explainers without a paper-art look.
description_zh: 为通过触觉手工纸艺视觉来讲解科学、教育或通用知识的创作者提供支持。用户提供主题、核心知识点或素材，并可指定受众、时长、画面比例和交付形式。该技能提取学习目标与视觉隐喻，提出创意方向，设计纸艺角色、分层立体场景和道具，生成预览概念以及图像与视频提示词，并规划分镜、镜头运动、转场和音效，支持分阶段审批与审查清单。其输出可直接投入生产的纸艺定格动画讲解套件，或静态图像提示词、图像序列提示词、短视频提示词及分镜等选定素材。适用于剪纸、立体书、分层微缩场景及微型定格动画讲解，不适用于标准2D动画、线条涂鸦、真人实拍，以及缺乏纸艺风格的讲解内容。

description: Multi-agent CLI system for autonomous novel writing, auditing, and revision with human review gates
description_zh: 具备人工审核把关功能的多智能体 CLI 系统，用于自主小说写作、审核与修订

description:
AgentX forum: create posts, comments, likes, reposts, follows, attachments.

Use when posting to the Starchild AgentX forum, not Twitter (e.g. share a project on AgentX, comment on a post, follow an agent, upload image).
description_zh:
AgentX 论坛：创建帖子、评论、点赞、转发、关注、附件。

在 Starchild AgentX 论坛发帖时使用，而非推特（例如：在 AgentX 上分享项目、评论帖子、关注代理、上传图片）。

description: Pre-call brief for an upcoming meeting - attendees, account history, prior call context from transcripts, open opportunity status, and suggested discovery questions. Use when the user asks "prep me for [meeting/company]", "call prep [company]", "I'm meeting with [company], prep me", "get me ready for [meeting]", or "what do I need to know before my [time] call".
description_zh: 即将召开的会议会前简报——参会人员、账户历史、基于转录本的先前通话背景、开放商机状态及建议的探索性问题。当用户询问“为 [meeting/company] 做准备”、“为 [company] 准备通话”、“我将与 [meeting/company] 会面，为我准备”、“为 [meeting] 做好准备”，或“在 [time] 的通话前，我需要了解什么”时使用。

description: Guide for using Apollo MCP Server to connect AI agents with GraphQL APIs. Use this skill when: (1) setting up or configuring Apollo MCP Server, (2) defining MCP tools from GraphQL operations, (3) using introspection tools (introspect, search, validate, execute), (4) troubleshooting MCP server connectivity or tool execution issues.
description_zh: 使用 Apollo MCP Server 连接 AI 代理与 GraphQL API 的指南。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 设置或配置 Apollo MCP Server；(2) 从 GraphQL 操作定义 MCP 工具；(3) 使用内省工具（introspect, search, validate, execute）；(4) 排查 MCP 服务器连接性或工具执行问题。

description: Publish, read, comment on, or edit markdown in Proof. Use for Proof links, sharing specs/plans/drafts, or publish handoffs from planning workflows; avoid proofread, math, evidence, or proof-of-concept meanings.
description_zh: 在 Proof 中发布、阅读、评论或编辑 Markdown。用于 Proof 链接、共享规格/计划/草稿，或发布规划工作流的交接；避免校对、数学、证据或概念验证的含义。

description: Turn Notion specs into implementation plans, tasks, and progress tracking; use when implementing PRDs/feature specs and creating Notion plans + tasks from them.
description_zh: 将 Notion 规格转化为实施计划、任务及进度跟踪；在实施 PRDs/功能规格并基于此创建 Notion 计划与任务时使用。

description: Answers questions about Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) Region switch including architecture, plans, execution blocks, workflows, triggers, active/active vs active/passive, cross-account support, recovery time, dashboards, and customer positioning. Applicable when users ask about ARC Region switch adoption, design, or troubleshooting.
description_zh: 解答有关亚马逊应用恢复控制器（ARC）区域切换的问题，内容涵盖架构、方案、执行阻塞、工作流程、触发条件、主动/主动模式与主动/被动模式、跨账户支持、恢复时间、仪表盘以及客户定位等方面。适用于用户询问 ARC 区域切换的采用、设计或故障排查时。

description: Run accessibility and visual design review on components. Use when reviewing UI code for WCAG compliance and design issues.
description_zh: 对组件执行可访问性与视觉设计评审。适用于审查 UI 代码是否符合 WCAG 标准及设计问题。

description: Build a card game: card data, deck/hand/discard zones, draw/shuffle/reshuffle, a turn structure, costs, and effect resolution. Use for a deckbuilder, TCG/CCG, or roguelike deckbuilder.
description_zh: 构建一款卡牌游戏：卡牌数据、牌组/手牌/弃牌区域、抽牌/洗牌/重洗、回合结构、费用与效果结算。适用于牌组构建类游戏、TCG/CCG 或 roguelike 牌组构建游戏。

description: Provides AWS CDK TypeScript patterns for defining, validating, and deploying AWS infrastructure as code. Use when creating CDK apps, stacks, and reusable constructs, modeling serverless or VPC-based architectures, applying IAM and encryption defaults, or testing and reviewing `cdk synth`, `cdk diff`, and `cdk deploy` changes. Triggers include "aws cdk typescript", "create cdk app", "cdk stack", "cdk construct", "cdk deploy", and "cdk test".
description_zh: 提供 AWS CDK TypeScript 模式，用于定义、验证和部署 AWS 基础设施即代码。适用于创建 CDK 应用、栈和可复用组件，构建无服务器或基于 VPC 的架构，应用 IAM 和加密默认设置，或测试和审查 `cdk synth`、`cdk diff` 和 `cdk deploy` 的变更。触发条件包括“aws cdk typescript”、“create cdk app”、“cdk stack”、“cdk construct”、“cdk deploy”和“cdk test”。

description: Diagnoses and prevents vbar_control_agent segfaults, out-of-memory (OOM) errors, and TPU device initialization failures on TPU v6e nodes in GKE caused by race conditions during TPU device resets or high-frequency metrics polling. Use when troubleshooting vbar_control_agent crashes, memory cgroup OOMs in serial console logs, tpu-device-plugin metrics checksum corruption errors, or custom TPU metrics collection conflicts on GKE TPU v6e nodes. Don't use for general non-TPU container OOM troubleshooting or standard GKE node lifecycle operations.
description_zh: 诊断并预防在 GKE TPU v6e 节点上因 TPU 设备重置或高频指标轮询期间的竞争条件导致的 vbar_control_agent 段错误、内存不足（OOM）错误及 TPU 设备初始化失败。在排查 GKE TPU v6e 节点上 vbar_control_agent 崩溃、串口控制台日志中的内存 cgroup OOM、tpu-device-plugin 指标校验和损坏错误或自定义 TPU 指标收集冲突时使用。不可用于一般非 TPU 容器 OOM 故障排查或标准 GKE 节点生命周期操作。

description: Use for GitHub CLI automation: repository reads, workflow runs, search, codespaces, releases, configuration, or gh command syntax. Use yeet for contribution writes to PRs, issues, comments, or discussions.
description_zh: 适用于 GitHub CLI 自动化：仓库读取、工作流运行、搜索、代码空间、发布、配置或 gh 命令语法。使用 yeet 对拉取请求（PRs）、问题、评论或讨论进行贡献性写入。

description: @copilotkit/react-core — mount the CopilotKit provider (from @copilotkit/react-core/v2) in a Next.js App Router / React Router v7 / TanStack Start / SPA app, drop in CopilotChat/CopilotPopup/CopilotSidebar (v2 chat components ship from react-core/v2 — NOT react-ui, which is CSS-only in v2), access and subscribe to agents with useAgent / useAgentContext / useCapabilities, switch between multiple agents, manage durable Intelligence threads with useThreads, register browser-side tools via useFrontendTool, render tool calls with useRenderTool / useComponent / useDefaultRenderTool, gate execution with useHumanInTheLoop, wire file attachments with useAttachments, configure suggestion pills, and register activity- and custom-message renderers. Load the reference under references/ that matches your task.
description_zh: @copilotkit/react-core — 在 Next.js App Router / React Router v7 / TanStack Start / SPA 应用中挂载 CopilotKit provider（来自 @copilotkit/react-core/v2），引入 CopilotChat/CopilotPopup/CopilotSidebar（v2 聊天组件从 react-core/v2 提供——v2 中 react-ui 仅包含 CSS，不可使用），通过 useAgent / useAgentContext / useCapabilities 访问并订阅 agents，在多个 agents 之间切换，使用 useThreads 管理持久的 Intelligence 线程，通过 useFrontlineTool 注册浏览器端工具，使用 useRenderTool / useComponent / useDefaultRenderTool 渲染工具调用，通过 useHumanInTheLoop 管控执行流程，通过 useAttachments 连接文件附件，配置建议药丸，并注册活动与自定义消息渲染器。根据您的任务加载与 references/ 下匹配的参考文档。

description: Monitor Catchtable for open reservation slots and attempt booking using a logged-in Chrome session. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 监控Catchable的开放预订槽位，并使用已登录的Chrome会话尝试预订。在돌쇠上，通过官方界面进行后续操作直至完成。

description: Manage Serverless network security (traffic filters): create, update, and delete IP filters and AWS PrivateLink VPC filters. Use when restricting network access or configuring private connectivity.
description_zh: 管理无服务器网络安全（流量过滤器）：创建、更新和删除 IP 过滤器和 AWS PrivateLink VPC 过滤器。用于限制网络访问或配置私有连接。

description: Triage and prioritize a support ticket or customer issue. Use when a new ticket comes in and needs categorization, assigning P1-P4 priority, deciding which team should handle it, or checking whether it's a duplicate or known issue before routing.
description_zh: 对支持工单或客户问题进行分类和优先级排序。当新工单进入，需要分类、分配 P1-P4 优先级、确定由哪个团队处理，或在路由前检查其是否为重复工单或已知问题时使用。

description: Write optimized SQL for your dialect with best practices. Use when translating a natural-language data need into SQL, building a multi-CTE query with joins and aggregations, optimizing a query against a large partitioned table, or getting dialect-specific syntax for Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, etc.
description_zh: 为您的数据库方言编写符合最佳实践的优化 SQL。当需要将自然语言数据需求转换为 SQL、构建包含连接与聚合的多 CTE 查询、优化针对大型分区表的查询，或获取适用于 Snowflake、BigQuery、Postgres 等数据库的特定方言语法时，请使用本功能。

description: Implement 2D kinematic character movement in Godot 4.7 with CharacterBody2D and move_and_slide(): platformer run/jump with gravity, top-down 8-direction motion, slope handling, and reading collisions. Use when coding a 2D player or enemy controller, a platformer or top-down character, or fixing move_and_slide()/ is_on_floor() behavior in a .tscn with a CharacterBody2D.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中使用 CharacterBody2D 和 move_and_slide() 实现 2D 运动学角色移动：支持带重力的平台跳跃、跑动与跳跃，俯视角 8 向运动，斜坡处理，以及读取碰撞。适用于编写 2D 玩家或敌人控制器、平台跳跃角色或俯视角角色，或在带有 CharacterBody2D 的 .tscn 中修复 move_and_slide()/ is_on_floor() 的行为时。

description: Explore Rust trait implementations using LSP. Triggers on: /trait-impl, find implementations, who implements, trait 实现, 谁实现了, 实现了哪些trait
description_zh: 使用 LSP 探索 Rust trait 实现。触发条件：/trait-impl、查找实现、谁实现了、trait 实现、谁实现了、实现了哪些 trait。

description: Hugging Face Hub CLI (`hf`) for downloading, uploading, and managing models, datasets, spaces, buckets, repos, papers, jobs, and more on the Hugging Face Hub. Use when: handling authentication; managing local cache; managing Hugging Face Buckets; running or scheduling jobs on Hugging Face infrastructure; managing Hugging Face repos; discussions and pull requests; browsing models, datasets and spaces; reading, searching, or browsing academic papers; managing collections; querying datasets; configuring spaces; setting up webhooks; or deploying and managing HF Inference Endpoints. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions 'hf', 'huggingface', 'Hugging Face', 'huggingface-cli', or 'hugging face cli', or wants to do anything related to the Hugging Face ecosystem and to AI and ML in general. Also use for cloud storage needs like training checkpoints, data pipelines, or agent traces. Use even if the user doesn't explicitly ask for a CLI command. Replaces the deprecated `huggingface-cli`.
description_zh: Hugging Face Hub CLI (`hf`)，用于在 Hugging Face Hub 上下载、上传和管理模型、数据集、Spaces、Buckets、仓库、论文、任务等更多内容。使用场景：处理认证；管理本地缓存；管理 Hugging Face Buckets；在 Hugging Face 基础设施上运行或调度任务；管理 Hugging Face 仓库；讨论和拉取请求；浏览模型、数据集和 Spaces；阅读、搜索或浏览学术论文；管理集合；查询数据集；配置 Spaces；设置 Webhooks；或部署和管理 HF 推理端点。当用户提及 'hf'、'huggingface'、'Hugging Face'、'huggingface-cli' 或 'hugging face cli'，或希望处理与 Hugging Face 生态系统以及 AI 和 ML（机器学习）相关的任何事项时，请务必使用本技能。此外，请用于训练检查点、数据流水线或智能体追踪等云存储需求。即使用户未明确要求 CLI 命令，也应使用。替换已弃用的 `huggingface-cli`。

description: Update the committed blocks-ci screenshot hashes after the "Screenshots & Tests" check fails, or investigate a screenshot diff reported on a PR. Use when asked to update, accept, or refresh component screenshot baselines from CI. This skill should be run as a subagent.
description_zh: 在“Screenshots & Tests”检查失败后更新已提交的 blocks-ci 截图哈希，或对 PR 上报告的截图差异进行调查。当被要求从 CI 更新、接受或刷新组件截图基线时使用。此技能应以子代理形式运行。

description: Generate extremely simple, cute, personified square character images with rounded heavy forms, two purposeful character colors, one solid background color, and a dominant lower-corner composition. Use when creating an animal, creature, robot, ghost, plant, object, or other character image, including when the agent should infer three product-relevant directions and propose six independent candidates for approval.
description_zh: 生成极其简单、可爱、拟人化的方形角色图像，造型圆润厚重，使用两种具有明确目的的角色配色、一种纯色背景，并以画面下角为主导的构图。在创建动物、生物、机器人、幽灵、植物、物品或其他角色图像时使用，包括当智能体应推断出三个与产品相关的方向并提出六组独立候选供审批时。

description: Designs a resilience program: how to structure and standardize resilience policies across an organization, team, or portfolio (tiered policy model with availability/RTO/RPO targets and DR approach selection), and how often to run resilience activities (operational cadence). Applies when the user asks how to structure policies org-wide, what tiers/targets to set, which DR approach fits a tier, or how frequently to run assessments, FIS experiments, GameDays, or autoshift practice. Does not apply to creating or configuring a specific policy or resource for a single workload (use resilience-hub-getting-started), to step-by-step lifecycle execution (see aws-resilience-lifecycle), or to service-specific setup.
description_zh: 设计韧性计划：如何组织并标准化组织、团队或投资组合层面的韧性政策（采用分层政策模型，设定可用性/RTO/RPO目标并选择灾备（DR）方案），以及如何确定韧性活动的运行频率（运营节奏）。当用户询问如何制定全组织范围的政策、设置何种层级及目标、哪种灾备（DR）方案适合某一层级，或评估、FIS实验、GameDays及自动换班实践的执行频率时适用。不适用于为单个工作负载创建或配置特定策略或资源（请使用 resilience-hub-getting-started），执行逐步生命周期操作（请参阅 aws-resilience-lifecycle），或进行服务特定配置。

description: Cross-platform UI/UX design reviewer grounded in Apple's Human Interface Guidelines (122 pages pulled from developer.apple.com, including 57 component pages) plus a design-craft lens for distinctive, non-templated work. Use it to audit, review, critique, or improve any mobile app (iOS, Flutter, React Native) or desktop app (macOS, Tauri, Electron) design: design review, UI audit, HIG compliance, accessibility audit, dark mode, Liquid Glass or glassmorphism, navigation structure, onboarding, forms, app icons, generative AI UX, or requests like "make this look less generic". Also use whenever the user shares screenshots, mockups, wireframes, Figma exports, or UI code and wants feedback, even if they only say "review my design" or "is this good UI". Works for SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, Flutter, React Native, Tauri, and Electron.
description_zh:
基于苹果《人机界面指南》（HIG）（从 developer.apple.com 提取的 122 页，包含 57 个组件页面）构建的跨平台 UI/UX 设计评审专家，并辅以设计工艺视角，保障独特、非模板化的设计成果。

用于对任意移动应用（iOS、Flutter、React Native）或桌面应用（macOS、Tauri、Electron）的设计进行审计、评审、点评或改进：包括设计评审、UI 审计、HIG 合规性检查、可访问性审计、深色模式、液态玻璃（Liquid Glass）或玻璃拟态（glassmorphism）、导航结构、引导流程、表单、应用图标、生成式 AI UX，或类似“让此设计看起来不那么千篇一律”的需求。

此外，当用户分享截屏、原型图（mockups）、线框图（wireframes）、Figma 导出文件或 UI 代码并希望获得反馈时，也请使用本工具，即便用户仅表示“评审我的设计”或“这个 UI 是否优秀”。

适用于 SwiftUI、UIKit、AppKit、Flutter、React Native、Tauri 和 Electron。

description: Web search with full page content. Use when no URL is known: finding sources, articles, or news. For papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.
description_zh: 带有完整页面内容的网页搜索。当没有已知 URL 时使用：查找来源、文章或新闻。对于论文，使用 firecrawl-research-index；对于图书馆、API、错误或 bug 相关问题，使用 firecrawl-developer-index。

description: Add Apple Pencil drawing with PKCanvasView, PKToolPicker, PKDrawing serialization/export, stroke inspection, and PencilKit/PaperKit handoffs. Use when building drawing apps, annotation features, handwriting capture, signature fields, content-version-safe ink workflows, or Apple Pencil-powered experiences on iOS/iPadOS/visionOS.
description_zh: 通过PKCanvasView、PKToolPicker和PKDrawing实现Apple Pencil绘图、序列化与导出、笔画检查以及PencilKit/PaperKit交互衔接。适用于构建绘图应用、标注功能、手写捕获、签名字段，以及iOS/iPadOS/visionOS平台上内容版本安全墨迹工作流或Apple Pencil驱动的体验。

description: Extract a URL's content as clean markdown, including JS-rendered pages. Use whenever the user provides a URL and wants its content; prefer over WebFetch.
description_zh: 提取 URL 的内容，以整洁的 Markdown 格式输出，包括 JavaScript 渲染的页面。用户提供 URL 并希望获取其内容时使用，优先于 WebFetch。

description: Designs and develops specs following the spec-driven method. Asks clarifying questions before proposing structure, and builds the spec section by section. Use it when starting a large feature, before writing code.
description_zh: 遵循规格驱动方法，设计并制定规格。在提出结构之前提出问题以澄清疑问，并逐节构建规格。在启动大型功能、编写代码之前使用它。

description: Interactive quiz that maps your AI/ML knowledge to a starting point in the 523-lesson, 20-phase AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Trigger phrases: "where should I start", "find my level", "what do I know", "which phase", "assess my knowledge", "placement test", "skip ahead"
description_zh: 交互式测验，可将您的AI/ML知识映射到523课时、20阶段的“从零开始的AI工程”课程中的起点。触发短语：“where should I start”、“find my level”、“what do I know”、“which phase”、“assess my knowledge”、“placement test”、“skip ahead”

description: Guides an end-to-end data-warehouse migration to Amazon Redshift — discovery, schema/SQL/stored-procedure/macro/script conversion, data migration, validation, performance comparison, and reporting. Source-routed via `references/<source>/`; Teradata (Vantage) is the supported source; additional sources are added as their own `references/<source>/` sets. Text-only knowledge (no executable code) — the AI generates all execution at runtime. Applies when a user wants to migrate Teradata to Amazon Redshift, convert Teradata DDL/SQL/stored procedures/macros/BTEQ to Redshift/RSQL, or assess Teradata-to-Redshift migration complexity. Applies only to migrations targeting Amazon Redshift; migrations to other platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.) are out of scope regardless of source. Does not cover general Redshift administration, performance tuning, or troubleshooting of existing Redshift clusters (no migration involved), or sources not listed under references/.
description_zh:
引导完成端到端数据仓库迁移至Amazon Redshift——包括数据探查、Schema/SQL/存储过程/宏/脚本转换、数据迁移、验证、性能对比与报表。

通过`references/<source>/`进行源路由；支持的数据源为Teradata (Vantage)；其他数据源以各自的`references/<source>/`集合形式添加。

纯文本知识（不包含可执行代码）——AI在运行时生成所有执行过程。

适用场景为：用户需要将Teradata迁移至Amazon Redshift、将Teradata的DDL/SQL/存储过程/宏/BTEQ转换为Redshift/RSQL，或评估Teradata至Redshift迁移的复杂度时。

仅适用于目标为Amazon Redshift的迁移；无论数据源如何，迁移至其他平台（如Snowflake、BigQuery、Databricks等）的迁移均不在适用范围之内。

不包含通用的Redshift管理、性能调优，以及针对现有Redshift集群的故障排查（不涉及迁移），或`references/`下未列出的数据源相关的内容。

description: Validate a business idea using the minimalist entrepreneur framework. Use when someone has a business idea and wants to test if it's worth pursuing before building anything.
description_zh: 使用极简创业框架验证商业想法。当有人有商业想法，并希望在构建任何事物之前测试其是否值得推进时使用。

description: Prepare journal entries with proper debits, credits, and supporting documentation for month-end close. Use when booking accruals, prepaid amortization, fixed asset depreciation, payroll entries, revenue recognition, or any manual journal entry.
description_zh: 在月末结账时编制包含正确借方、贷方及支持性文件的记账分录。适用于登记应计费用、预付摊销、固定资产折旧、薪酬分录、收入确认，或任何手动记账分录时使用。

description: Prepare structured briefings for meetings with legal relevance and track resulting action items. Use when preparing for contract negotiations, board meetings, compliance reviews, or any meeting where legal context, background research, or action tracking is needed.
description_zh: 为具有法律相关性的会议准备结构化简报，并跟踪所产生的行动项。在准备合同谈判、董事会会议、合规审查，或任何需要法律背景、背景研究或行动跟踪的会议时使用。

description: Product manager for PRD creation and requirements discovery. Use when the user asks to talk to John or requests the product manager
description_zh: 负责PRD创建与需求发现的产品经理。当用户要求与John沟通或请求产品经理时使用。

description: Review code changes with several independent reviewers in parallel, then triage and present the findings. Use when the user says "run code review" or "review this code"
description_zh: 与多位独立审查人员并行审查代码变更，然后对审查发现进行分类处理并呈现。当用户说“执行代码审查”或“审查此代码”时使用。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to tools. Do not use this skill; invoke tools instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-tools still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用重定向——该技能已更名为 tools。请勿使用此技能，请改用 tools。仅保留此内容，以便旧引用 aiconfig-tools 仍能引导用户找到新名称。

description: Search Google Flights for flight prices and schedules using browser automation. Use when user asks to search flights, find airfare, compare prices, check flight availability, or look up routes. Triggers include "search flights", "find flights", "how much is a flight", "flights from X to Y", "cheapest flight", "flight prices", "airfare", "flight schedule", "nonstop flights", "when should I fly".
description_zh: 使用浏览器自动化在 Google Flights 上搜索航班价格与时刻表。当用户询问搜索航班、查找机票、比较价格、查询航班可用性或查询航线时使用。触发条件包括：“搜索航班”、“查找航班”、“航班多少钱”、“从 X 到 Y 的航班”、“最便宜航班”、“航班价格”、“机票价格”、“航班时刻表”、“直飞航班”、“我应该何时乘机”。

description: Create or update STRATEGY.md. Use when starting a product, adding a strategy doc, or changing direction or roadmap.
description_zh: 创建或更新 STRATEGY.md。在产品启动、添加策略文档、或调整方向与路线图时使用。

description: Use when the user wants to download, use or update 10xDevs CLI skills, choose a helper installation channel, inspect course content, switch tool profiles or troubleshoot CLI/auth/content conflicts. Guides filtered get → an actual agent task → sync while preserving local work and course/tool/language context. For first installation or authentication preparation, use an available 10x-cli-setup copy. Does not implement CLI runtime or grant course access.
description_zh: 当用户需要下载、使用或更新10xDevs CLI技能，选择辅助安装渠道，检查课程内容，切换工具配置，或排查CLI/认证/内容冲突时使用。引导从过滤获取 → 实际代理任务 → 同步，同时保留本地工作及课程/工具/语言上下文。对于首次安装或认证准备，使用可用的10x-cli-setup副本。不实现CLI运行时，不授予课程访问权限。

description: Sets up AWS Resilience Hub v2 from scratch: creates resilience policies with SLO targets, registers systems and user journeys, onboards services with input sources, and runs a first failure mode assessment. Applies when the user wants to get started with Resilience Hub v2, create a policy, onboard a service, or run an assessment — including creating one concrete policy with specific availability/RTO/RPO targets and a DR approach for a single service (even a tier-1 one). Does not apply to FIS experiments or ARC routing controls.
description_zh: 从零开始搭建 AWS Resilience Hub v2：创建带有 SLO 目标的服务韧性策略，注册系统与用户旅程，将服务接入并配置输入源，并执行首次故障模式评估。当用户需要启动 Resilience Hub v2、创建策略、接入服务或执行评估时适用——包括创建包含特定可用性/RTO/RPO 目标以及针对单个服务（即使是 Tier-1 服务）灾备方案的具体策略。不适用于 FIS 实验或 ARC 路由控制。

description: For creators making surreal short videos that blend rough glowing hand-drawn animation with live-action spaces. Users provide a scene idea, contact object or hand, desired mood, and optional language or style constraints. The Skill clarifies the physical contact, designs continuous morphing, escape route, and delayed handheld chase movement, then writes a reusable 15-second 16:9 video prompt in the user's language. After user confirmation it recommends MiniMax H3 generation and checks contact realism, camera delay, rough glowing stroke texture, and non-horror tone. Best for single-scene creative clips, not polished CG, horror jump scares, plush characters, or multi-scene cuts.
description_zh: 针对制作将粗糙发光手绘动画与实景空间相融合的超现实短视频的创作者。用户需提供场景构思、接触物体或手部、期望氛围，以及可选的语言或风格限制。该技能明确物理接触细节，设计连续变形、逃生路线与延迟手持追逐动作，随后以用户的语言撰写一份可复用的15秒16:9视频提示词。经用户确认后，该技能推荐使用MiniMax H3生成模型，并检查接触真实感、镜头延迟、粗糙发光笔触质感以及非恐怖基调。该功能最适用于单场景创意片段，不适用于精修CG、恐怖跳跃惊吓、毛绒角色或多场景剪辑。

description: @copilotkit/runtime — mount a fetch-native CopilotRuntime on any JS server, wire middleware, pick an AgentRunner, instantiate BuiltInAgent (Factory Mode with TanStack AI is the preferred default) or plug in any of 12 external agent frameworks (Mastra, LangGraph, CrewAI Crews/Flows, PydanticAI, ADK, LlamaIndex, Agno, AWS Strands, MS Agent Framework, AG2, A2A), enable Intelligence mode for durable threads + websocket, register server-side tools via defineTool, and wire voice transcription. Uses the fetch-based createCopilotRuntimeHandler primitive — the Express/Hono adapters are discouraged. Load the reference under references/ that matches your task.
description_zh: @copilotkit/runtime — 在任何JS服务器上挂载基于fetch的CopilotRuntime，配置中间件，选择AgentRunner，实例化BuiltInAgent（使用TanStack AI的工厂模式是首选默认设置），或接入12个外部智能体框架之一（Mastra、LangGraph、CrewAI Crews/Flows、PydanticAI、ADK、LlamaIndex、Agno、AWS Strands、MS Agent Framework、AG2、A2A），启用智能模式以支持持久化线程和WebSocket，通过defineTool注册服务端工具，并接入语音转录功能。使用基于fetch的createCopilotRuntimeHandler原语——不推荐使用Express/Hono适配器。在references/目录下加载与您任务匹配的参考文件。

description: For creators, educators, and social-video editors who need a tactile paper-collage language for narration, knowledge points, opinions, or abstract topics. Users provide source copy, story beats, or a core concept and may specify aspect ratio, duration, palette, and audio needs. The Skill extracts meaning, proposes visual metaphors, prepares a production plan and storyboard, generates approved halftone collage stills, then creates stop-motion clips with paper movement and tactile sound effects, with optional final assembly. By default it keeps collage SFX and does not add BGM, voiceover, or subtitles unless requested. Best for explainers, viewpoints, story visuals, and social B-roll; not for presenter ads, editable layers, complex typography, or prompt-only tasks.
description_zh: 适用于需要为旁白、知识要点、观点或抽象主题提供触觉式纸拼贴语言的创作者、教育者及社交媒体视频编辑者。用户可提供源稿、剧情节拍或核心概念，并指定宽高比、时长、调色板和音频需求。该技能会提取内容含义，构思视觉隐喻，制定制作计划与分镜，生成经审核的半色调拼贴静帧，进而制作以纸张运动与触感音效为特色的定格动画片段，并支持可选的最终组装。默认情况下，它保留拼贴音效，除非用户请求，否则不添加背景音乐、配音或字幕。最适合讲解类视频、观点类视频、故事画面及社交媒体素材片段；不适用于演讲广告、可编辑图层、复杂排版或仅根据提示执行的任务。

description: Create an end-to-end customer journey map with stages, touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities. Use when mapping the customer experience, identifying friction points, improving onboarding, or visualizing the user journey.
description_zh: 创建包含阶段、触点、情绪、痛点与机会的端到端客户旅程地图。适用于绘制客户体验、识别摩擦点、优化入职流程或可视化用户旅程。

description: Creates, runs, and analyzes Arize experiments for evaluating and comparing model performance. Covers experiment CRUD, exporting runs, comparing results, and evaluation workflows using the ax CLI. Use when the user mentions create experiment, run experiment, compare models, model performance, evaluate AI, experiment results, benchmark, A/B test models, or measure accuracy.
description_zh: 用于评估和比较模型性能的创建、运行和分析Arize实验功能。涵盖通过ax CLI进行的实验增删改查（CRUD）、运行结果导出、结果对比及评估工作流。当用户提及创建实验、运行实验、比较模型、模型性能、评估AI、实验结果、基准测试、A/B模型测试或测量准确率时使用。

description: Runs and interprets AWS Resilience Hub v2 failure mode assessments. Covers starting assessments, understanding findings (severity, categories, recommendations), triaging by achievability, working with AI-generated service functions, and resolving findings. Applies when the user wants to run an assessment, review findings, or understand failure modes, or has a specific finding and asks how to resolve, remediate, or fix it. Does not apply to initial setup (use resilience-hub-getting-started) or FIS experiments.
description_zh: 执行并解读AWS弹性聚合中心v2的故障模式评估。涵盖开始评估、理解发现（严重程度、类别、建议）、根据可实现性进行分诊、与AI生成的服务功能协作以及解决发现等内容。当用户需要运行评估、查看发现或理解故障模式，或有特定发现并询问如何解决、补救或修复时，此功能适用。不适用于初始设置（使用resilience-hub-getting-started）或FIS实验。

description: Manages existing Elastic Cloud Serverless projects: list, get, update, delete, reset credentials, resume, and load saved credentials. Connects to existing projects by resolving endpoints and acquiring scoped Elasticsearch API keys. Use when performing day-2 operations on serverless projects, connecting to an existing project, loading or resetting project credentials, or looking up project details.
description_zh: 管理现有的 Elastic Cloud Serverless 项目：列出、获取、更新、删除、重置凭证、恢复以及加载已保存的凭证。通过解析端点和获取范围受限的 Elasticsearch API 密钥连接现有项目。适用于对 Serverless 项目执行 day-2 操作、连接现有项目、加载或重置项目凭证，或查询项目详情时使用。

description: Creates, manages, and queries Arize datasets and examples. Covers dataset CRUD, appending examples, exporting data, and file-based dataset creation using the ax CLI. Use when the user needs test data, evaluation examples, or mentions create dataset, list datasets, export dataset, append examples, dataset version, golden dataset, or test set.
description_zh: 创建、管理和查询 Arize 数据集和示例。涵盖数据集 CRUD、追加示例、导出数据，以及使用 ax CLI 的文件型数据集创建。当用户需要测试数据、评估示例，或提及创建数据集、列出数据集、导出数据集、追加示例、数据集版本、金标准数据集或测试集时使用。

description: Set up a Godot 4.7 3D scene: Node3D transforms, Camera3D, lighting (DirectionalLight3D/OmniLight3D), WorldEnvironment for sky/ambient/tonemap/post, MeshInstance3D materials, and GridMap for tile-based 3D levels. Use when building a 3D scene in a Godot project, placing cameras/lights, configuring environment and post-processing, or working with Node3D/.tscn 3D content and GridMap.
description_zh:
设置 Godot 4.7 3D 场景：Node3D 变换、Camera3D、灯光（DirectionalLight3D/OmniLight3D）、用于天空/环境光/色调映射/后处理的 WorldEnvironment、MeshInstance3D 材质，以及用于基于瓦片的 3D 关卡的 GridMap。

在 Godot 项目中构建 3D 场景、放置相机/灯光、配置环境和后处理，或处理 Node3D/.tscn 3D 内容与 GridMap 时使用。

description: Provides autonomous project pattern learning by analyzing the codebase to discover development conventions, architectural patterns, and coding standards, then generates project rule files in .claude/rules/. Use when user asks to "learn from project", "extract project rules", "analyze codebase conventions", "discover project patterns", or wants to auto-generate Claude Code rules for the current project.
description_zh: 提供通过代码库分析实现的自主项目模式学习，以发现开发规范、架构模式与编码标准，并在 .claude/rules/ 下生成项目规则文件。当用户请求“从项目学习”、“提取项目规则”、“分析代码库规范”、“发现项目模式”，或希望为当前项目自动生成 Claude Code 规则时使用。

description: This skill generates, creates, or builds brand voice guidelines from source materials. It should be used when the user asks to "generate brand guidelines", "create a style guide", "extract brand voice", "create guidelines from calls", "consolidate brand materials", "analyze my sales calls for brand voice", "build a brand playbook from documents", "synthesize a voice and tone guide", or uploads brand documents, transcripts, or meeting recordings for brand analysis. Also triggers when the user has a discovery report and wants to convert it into actionable guidelines.
description_zh: 本技能根据源材料生成、创建或构建品牌声音指南。当用户要求“生成品牌指南”、“创建风格指南”、“提取品牌声音”、“根据通话创建指南”、“整合品牌材料”、“分析我的销售通话的品牌声音”、“从文档构建品牌手册”、“综合声音和语气指南”，或上传品牌文档、转录稿或会议录音进行品牌分析时，应使用本技能。此外，当用户拥有发现报告并希望将其转换为可操作指南时，本技能也会被触发。

description: Configures AWS Resilience Hub v2 for multi-account resilience management across an AWS Organization. Covers the per-service cross-account permission model, cross-account IAM roles, and centralized assessment from a single account. Applies when the user wants to set up org-wide resilience or assess workloads that span multiple AWS accounts.
description_zh: 为 AWS 组织中的多账户韧性管理配置 AWS 韧性中心 v2。该配置涵盖按服务划分的跨账户权限模型、跨账户 IAM 角色以及从单一账户进行的集中评估。适用于用户需要设置组织级韧性或评估跨越多个 AWS 账户的工作负载时。

description: System architect and technical design leader. Use when the user asks to talk to Winston or requests the architect
description_zh: 系统架构师与技术设计负责人。当用户要求与 Winston 交谈或请求该架构师时使用。

description: MUST READ before writing or modifying ADK agent code. ADK API quick reference for Python — agent types, tool definitions, orchestration patterns, callbacks, and state management. Includes an index of all ADK documentation pages. Do NOT use for creating new projects (use adk-scaffold).
description_zh: **必须阅读**：在编写或修改 ADK 代理代码之前。ADK API 快速参考（Python）—— 代理类型、工具定义、编排模式、回调以及状态管理。包含所有 ADK 文档页面的索引。**请勿用于**创建新项目（使用 adk-scaffold）。

description: Build CarPlay-enabled apps using the CarPlay framework. Use when creating navigation, audio, communication, EV charging, parking, or food ordering apps for the car display, working with CPTemplateApplicationScene, CPInterfaceController template hierarchies, CPListTemplate, CPMapTemplate, CPNowPlayingTemplate, configuring CarPlay entitlements, or integrating with CarPlay Simulator for testing.
description_zh: 使用 CarPlay 框架构建支持 CarPlay 的应用。在创建面向汽车显示屏的导航、音频、通信、电动汽车充电、停车或食品点餐应用时使用，配合使用 CPTemplateApplicationScene、CPInterfaceController 模板层级、CPListTemplate、CPMapTemplate、CPNowPlayingTemplate，配置 CarPlay 权限，或集成 CarPlay 模拟器进行测试。

description: Control smart-home accessories and commission Matter devices using HomeKit and MatterSupport. Use when managing homes/rooms/accessories, creating action sets or triggers, reading accessory characteristics, onboarding Matter devices, or building a third-party smart-home ecosystem app.
description_zh: 使用 HomeKit 和 MatterSupport 控制智能家居配件并配置 Matter 设备。适用于管理家庭/房间/配件、创建动作组或触发器、读取配件特性、对接 Matter 设备，或构建第三方智能家居生态系统应用。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for browser JavaScript. Use when asked to "add Sentry to a website", "install @sentry/browser", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, or logging for vanilla JavaScript, jQuery, static sites, or WordPress.
description_zh: 浏览器 JavaScript 的 Sentry SDK 完整设置。用于在要求为网站“添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/browser”，或为原生 JavaScript、jQuery、静态网站或 WordPress 配置错误监控、追踪、会话回放或日志记录时使用。

description: Use when adding CopilotKit to an existing project or bootstrapping a new CopilotKit project from scratch. Covers framework detection, package installation, runtime wiring (managed Intelligence or self-hosted SSE), provider setup, and first working chat integration.
description_zh: 当向现有项目添加 CopilotKit 或从零开始引导式搭建新的 CopilotKit 项目时使用。内容涵盖框架检测、包安装、运行时集成（托管智能体或自建 SSE）、服务提供商配置以及首次可用的聊天集成。

description: Analyze user feedback data to identify segments with sentiment scores, JTBD, and product satisfaction insights. Use when analyzing user feedback at scale, running sentiment analysis on reviews or surveys, or identifying satisfaction patterns.
description_zh: 分析用户反馈数据，以识别具有情感评分、JTBD 及产品满意度洞察的用户分群。适用于大规模分析用户反馈、对评论或调查进行情感分析，或识别满意度模式时使用。

description: Write and rewrite marketing copy for landing pages, homepages, and ads. Useful as a copy chief partner during launches.
description_zh: 为着陆页、首页和广告撰写并改写营销文案，在发布阶段可作为文案负责人合作伙伴，十分实用。

description: Configures Elastic Cloud authentication and environment defaults. Use when setting up EC_API_KEY, configuring Cloud API access, or when another cloud skill requires credentials.
description_zh: 配置 Elastic Cloud 身份验证和环境默认设置。用于设置 EC_API_KEY、配置 Cloud API 访问，或在其他云技能需要凭据时使用。

description: One-time onboarding for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum (523 lessons, 20 phases). Interviews the learner, runs the placement quiz, and writes LEARNING.md, a persistent study plan the learn skill drives. Trigger phrases: "start learning", "set up the course", "begin the curriculum", "onboard me", "create my learning plan"
description_zh:
**【一次性入职引导】** 针对《从零开始的AI工程》课程（523课时，20个阶段）。需执行以下操作：对学习者进行访谈、运行分班测评，并撰写 LEARNING.md（由所学技能驱动的持续学习计划）。

**触发短语**："开始学习"、"开启课程"、"开始课程"、"为我安排入职引导"、"创建我的学习计划"。

description: Playwright modern end-to-end testing framework with cross-browser automation, auto-wait, and built-in test runner
description_zh: Playwright 现代化端到端测试框架，具备跨浏览器自动化、自动等待和内置测试运行器

description: For users creating a two-player co-op game menu or opening animation. Users provide two player names, a game title, a target visual style, and optional character reference images. The Skill locks identity cues, generates an approval image from a fixed menu framework with coordinated color, buttons, icons, and typography, then uses the approved result to rebuild the character, UI-copy, and event timing instructions for the final video. It outputs a co-op game intro featuring two characters, player cards, and menu interaction motion. Best for game concepts, character-led menus, and social content; not for playable game development, complex multi-page UI, exact brand-logo replication, or generic character-free title sequences.
description_zh: 面向创建双人合作游戏菜单或开场动画的用户。用户将提供两名玩家姓名、游戏标题、目标视觉风格以及可选的参考角色图片。该技能会锁定角色身份识别特征，基于固定的菜单框架生成色彩、按钮、图标与字体排版协调一致的确认预览图，再以确认后的结果重新构建角色、界面文案及事件时序说明，用于最终视频的制作。它输出包含两名角色、玩家卡片和菜单交互动效的双人合作游戏开场动画。适用于游戏概念、以角色为核心的菜单以及社交内容；不适用于可玩游戏开发、复杂多页界面、品牌 Logo 的精确复刻，或不含角色的通用片头序列。

description: This skill orchestrates autonomous discovery of brand materials across enterprise platforms (Notion, Confluence, Google Drive, Box, SharePoint, Figma, Gong, Granola, Slack). It should be used when the user asks to "discover brand materials", "find brand documents", "search for brand guidelines", "audit brand content", "what brand materials do we have", "find our style guide", "where are our brand docs", "do we have a style guide", "discover brand voice", "brand content audit", or "find brand assets".
description_zh: 该技能负责在企业平台（Notion、Confluence、Google Drive、Box、SharePoint、Figma、Gong、Granola、Slack）上自主进行品牌资料的发现与编排。当用户提出以下需求时，应使用本技能："发现品牌资料"、"查找品牌文档"、"搜索品牌指南"、"审计品牌内容"、"我们有哪些品牌资料"、"查找我们的样式指南"、"我们的品牌文档在哪里"、"我们是否有样式指南"、"发现品牌声音"、"品牌内容审计"或"查找品牌资产"。

description: Access eligible Wallet financial data using FinanceKit and FinanceKitUI. Use when querying transactions or balances, reading Apple Card, Apple Cash, Savings, or U.K. connected-account data, requesting financial-data authorization, using TransactionPicker, enabling iOS 26 background delivery, or saving and checking Wallet orders.
description_zh: 使用 FinanceKit 和 FinanceKitUI 访问符合条件的钱包财务数据。在查询交易或余额、读取 Apple Card、Apple Cash、储蓄或英国连接账户数据、请求财务数据授权、使用 TransactionPicker、启用 iOS 26 后台投递以及保存和检查钱包订单时使用。

description: Use when creating, editing, or generating draw.io diagram files (.drawio, .drawio.svg, .drawio.png). Covers mxGraph XML authoring, shape libraries, style strings, flowcharts, system architecture, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, UML class diagrams, network topology, layout strategy, the hediet.vscode-drawio VS Code extension, and the full agent workflow from request to a ready-to-open file.
description_zh: 创建、编辑或生成 draw.io 图形文件（.drawio、.drawio.svg、.drawio.png）时使用。涵盖 mxGraph XML 编辑、形状库、样式字符串、流程图、系统架构、序列图、ER 图、UML 类图、网络拓扑、布局策略、hediet.vscode-drawio VS Code 扩展，以及从需求请求到可打开文件的全流程智能体工作流。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to projects. Do not use this skill; invoke projects instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-projects still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向——此技能已更名为 projects。请勿使用此技能，请改用 projects 调用。仅保留该内容，以便旧有的 aiconfig-projects 引用仍能将用户指向新名称。

description: External API integration and webhook handling including HTTP endpoint routing, request/response handling, authentication, CORS configuration, and webhook signature validation
description_zh: 外部 API 集成与 Webhook 处理，包括 HTTP 端点路由、请求/响应处理、认证、CORS 配置以及 Webhook 签名验证

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to configs-create. Do not use this skill; invoke configs-create instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-create still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用重定向——此技能已更名为 configs-create。请勿使用此技能，请改用 configs-create。仅保留此重定向，以便旧引用 aiconfig-create 的用户仍能指向新名称。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to configs-update. Do not use this skill; invoke configs-update instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-update still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 该技能已重命名为 configs-update。请勿使用该技能，请调用 configs-update。仅为此以便旧引用 aiconfig-update 的用户仍能指向新名称而保留。

description: Deploy applications to Render by analyzing codebases, generating render.yaml Blueprints, and providing Dashboard deeplinks. Use when the user wants to deploy, host, publish, or set up their application on Render's cloud platform.
description_zh: 通过分析代码库、生成 render.yaml 蓝图并为您提供仪表盘深链，将应用程序部署到 Render。当用户希望在 Render 云平台部署、托管、发布或搭建其应用程序时使用。

description: Track compliance requirements and audit readiness. Trigger with "compliance", "audit prep", "SOC 2", "ISO 27001", "GDPR", "regulatory requirement", or when the user needs help tracking, preparing for, or documenting compliance activities.
description_zh: 跟踪合规要求与审计就绪状态。当输入“合规”、“审计准备”、“SOC 2”、“ISO 27001”、“GDPR”、“监管要求”等关键词，或需要帮助跟踪、准备或记录合规活动时触发。

description: Discover and track emerging trends across Google Trends, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok to inform content strategy.
description_zh: 通过Google Trends、Instagram、Facebook、YouTube和TikTok发现并追踪新兴趋势，以指导内容策略。

description: Manages MongoDB Atlas Stream Processing (ASP) workflows. Handles workspace provisioning, data source/sink connections, processor lifecycle operations, debugging diagnostics, and tier sizing. Supports Kafka, Atlas clusters, S3, HTTPS, and Lambda integrations for streaming data workloads and event processing. NOT for general MongoDB queries or Atlas cluster management. Requires MongoDB MCP Server with Atlas API credentials.
description_zh: 管理 MongoDB Atlas 流处理（ASP）工作流。处理工作区配置、数据源/汇连接、处理器生命周期操作、调试诊断以及层级容量规划。支持 Kafka、Atlas 集群、S3、HTTPS 和 Lambda 的集成，用于流式数据工作负载及事件处理。不适用于通用的 MongoDB 查询或 Atlas 集群管理。需要 MongoDB MCP Server（包含 Atlas API 凭证）。

description: Build with the AgentMail TypeScript or Python SDK for inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, domain, allow/block list, pod, webhook, and WebSocket workflows, including programmatic agent sign-up, domain/DNS administration, and deliverability triage (bounces, spam, blocked mail). Use when implementing or reviewing AgentMail API code; do not use for direct mailbox operations, CLI usage, MCP setup, or framework-toolkit integration.
description_zh: 使用 AgentMail 的 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 构建以下工作流：收件箱、消息、线程、草稿、附件、域名、允许/阻止列表、pod、webhook 和 WebSocket 工作流，包括程序化代理注册、域名/DNS 管理以及投递性分类（退信、垃圾邮件、阻止邮件）。用于实现或审查 AgentMail API 代码时使用；不得用于直接邮箱操作、CLI 使用、MCP 设置或框架工具集成。

description: Discover and configure Bluetooth and Wi-Fi accessories using AccessorySetupKit. Use when presenting a privacy-preserving accessory picker, defining discovery descriptors for BLE or Wi-Fi devices, handling accessory session events, migrating from CoreBluetooth permission-based scanning, or setting up accessories without requiring broad Bluetooth permissions.
description_zh: 使用 AccessorySetupKit 发现并配置蓝牙与 Wi-Fi 配件。适用于提供注重隐私的配件选择器、定义 BLE 或 Wi-Fi 设备的发现描述符、处理配件会话事件、从 CoreBluetooth 基于权限的扫描迁移，或在不要求广泛蓝牙权限的情况下配置配件。

description: Maintain and extend existing SceneKit 3D scenes and visualizations. Use when working with SCNView, SCNScene, SCNNode scene graphs, SceneKit geometry/materials/lights/cameras, SCNAction animation, SCNPhysicsBody physics, SCNParticleSystem effects, .scn/.dae/.abc SceneKit assets, shader modifiers, or SwiftUI SceneView. SceneKit is soft-deprecated and in maintenance mode; route new apps, significant updates, USD/USDZ pipelines, and migration planning toward RealityKit.
description_zh:
维护和扩展现有的 SceneKit 3D 场景与可视化效果。

适用于处理 SCNView、SCNScene、SCNNode 场景图、SceneKit 几何体/材质/灯光/相机、SCNAction 动画、SCNPhysicsBody 物理效果、SCNParticleSystem 特效、.scn/.dae/.abc SceneKit 资源、着色器修改器或 SwiftUI SceneView 等场景。

SceneKit 已被软弃用并处于维护模式；请将新应用、重大更新、USD/USDZ 流水线及迁移规划引导至 RealityKit。

description: Brainstorm product ideas for an existing product using multi-perspective ideation from PM, Designer, and Engineer viewpoints. Use when generating new feature ideas, brainstorming solutions for an identified opportunity, or ideating with a product trio.
description_zh: 针对现有产品，基于产品经理、设计师和工程师的多视角头脑风暴，构思产品创意。适用于生成新功能创意、为已识别机会头脑风暴解决方案，或与产品三人小组进行创意构思时使用。

description: Visualize Rust function call graphs using LSP. Triggers on: /call-graph, call hierarchy, who calls, what calls, 调用图, 调用关系, 谁调用了, 调用了谁
description_zh: 使用 LSP 可视化 Rust 函数调用图。触发关键词：/call-graph、调用层级、谁调用、被调用、调用图、调用关系、谁调用了、调用了谁。

description: Prioritize drug targets from a ranked gene list (e.g., scRNA-seq DE output) by orchestrating parallel API queries against UniProt, OpenTargets (with integrated DepMap CRISPR essentiality + gnomAD constraint), PubMed, the Human Protein Atlas (HPA), and ChEMBL tool compounds, then re-ranking by a composite score combining protein localization, druggability, disease genetics, tissue specificity (safety), focus-cell-type expression, CRISPR essentiality, LoF safety constraint, and research maturity. Use whenever the user wants to filter, triage, prioritize, or "do due diligence" on a list of candidate genes for drug discovery, especially after a DE / DEG analysis when they say things like "which of these should I follow up on", "filter for druggable targets", "make a target dossier", "rank these for tractability", "annotate these genes for druggability", or "build a target report". Trigger even when the user says just "filter these candidate genes" or hands over a CSV from a DE pipeline.
description_zh:
基于排序后的基因列表（例如scRNA-seq差异表达输出）优先确定药物靶点：通过编排对UniProt、OpenTargets（集成DepMap CRISPR必需性+gnomAD约束条件）、PubMed、Human Protein Atlas（HPA）以及ChEMBL工具化合物的并行API查询，随后根据综合评分重新排序，该综合评分融合了蛋白质定位、成药性、疾病遗传学、组织特异性（安全性）、重点关注细胞类型表达、CRISPR必需性、LoF安全性约束及研究成熟度。

当用户需要对药物发现中的候选基因列表进行筛选、分诊、优先排序或"尽职调查"时，可随时使用本工具，尤其当进行差异表达/差异表达基因（DE/DEG）分析后，用户提出诸如"我应该跟进哪些基因"、"筛选可成药靶点"、"制作靶点档案"、"为可操作可行性对这些基因进行排序"、"为这些基因标注成药性"或"构建靶点报告"等需求时，即触发本工具。即使用户仅表示"筛选这些候选基因"或直接提交来自差异表达（DE）流程的CSV文件时，也应触发本工具。

description: Build a customer deck, one-pager or leave-behind from your account data, call notes and approved materials, with no made-up numbers. Use when the user asks for a sales asset, one-pager, deck, leave-behind, "create an asset for [prospect]", or "make something for [account]".
description_zh: 制作客户演示文稿、一页纸文档或传单，基于您的账户数据、通话记录和已审批材料，且不使用虚构数字。当用户要求制作销售资产、一页纸文档、演示文稿、传单，或请求“为[潜在客户]创建资产”或“为[账户]制作内容”时使用。

description: Track and manage recruiting pipeline stages. Trigger with "recruiting update", "candidate pipeline", "how many candidates", "hiring status", or when the user discusses sourcing, screening, interviewing, or extending offers.
description_zh: 跟踪并管理招聘管道阶段。当出现‘招聘更新’，‘候选人管道’，‘有多少候选人’，‘招聘状态’等关键词，或用户讨论寻源、筛选、面试或扩展 offer 时，触发。

description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改并改进现有技能，并衡量技能表现。适用于用户从零开始创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能，运行evals测试技能，通过方差分析对技能表现进行基准测试，或优化技能描述以提升触发准确性的情况。

description: Configures AWS Application Recovery Controller (ARC) for operational resilience: routing controls with safety rules for cross-Region failover, and zonal shift / zonal autoshift for AZ-impairment recovery. Applies when setting up failover routing, configuring safety rules, enabling zonal shift, or configuring zonal autoshift with practice runs. Also applies when shifting traffic out of a specific Availability Zone (AZ) for an ALB/NLB or other resource. For a broader "an AZ is impaired, what is my response across services" question, see aws-resilience-lifecycle. Does not apply to Resilience Hub setup or FIS experiments.
description_zh: 配置 AWS 应用恢复控制器（ARC）以实现运维韧性：为跨区域故障切换配置带有安全规则的路由控制，并实现区域转移/区域自动转移以恢复可用区降级。在设置故障切换路由、配置安全规则、启用区域转移或结合预演配置区域自动转移时适用。当将流量从特定可用区（AZ）移出以用于 ALB/NLB 或其他资源时，该功能同样适用。对于更广泛的"某个可用区降级时，我的服务响应如何"这一疑问，请参阅 aws-resilience-lifecycle。该功能不适用于 Resilience Hub 配置或 FIS 实验。

description: Implement VoIP calling with CallKit and PushKit. Use when building incoming/outgoing call flows, registering for VoIP push notifications, configuring CXProvider and CXCallController, handling call actions, coordinating audio sessions, or creating Call Directory extensions for caller ID and call blocking.
description_zh: 使用 CallKit 和 PushKit 实现 VoIP 通话，用于构建来电/去电通话流程、注册 VoIP 推送通知、配置 CXProvider 和 CXCallController、处理通话操作、协调音频会话或创建 Call Directory 扩展以支持主叫 ID 和通话拦截的场景。

description: Detect structural macro regime transitions (1-2 year horizon) using cross-asset ratio analysis. Analyze RSP/SPY concentration, yield curve, credit conditions, size factor, equity-bond relationship, and sector rotation to identify regime shifts between Concentration, Broadening, Contraction, Inflationary, and Transitional states. Run when user asks about macro regime, market regime change, structural rotation, or long-term market positioning.
description_zh: 通过跨资产比率分析检测结构性宏观周期状态转变（1-2年周期）。分析RSP/SPY集中度、收益率曲线、信用条件、规模因子、股债关系及板块轮动，以识别集中、扩张、收缩、通胀及过渡状态之间的周期状态转变。当用户询问宏观周期状态、市场周期状态变化、结构性轮动或长期市场定位时执行。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, imagine, or visualize images including characters, scenes, products, or any visual content. Supports structured prompts and reference images for guided generation.
description_zh: 当用户要求生成、创作、想象或可视化图像（包括角色、场景、产品或任何视觉内容）时，请使用本技能。该技能支持结构化提示词和参考图像，以引导生成。

description: Access security tokens and smart cards using CryptoTokenKit. Use when building TKTokenDriver or TKSmartCardTokenDriver extensions, communicating with smart cards via TKSmartCard/TKSmartCardSlotManager, using iOS 26+ NFC smart-card sessions, registering smart cards, querying token-backed keychain items with kSecAttrTokenID, monitoring TKTokenWatcher, or configuring certificate-based smart-card authentication.
description_zh: 使用 CryptoTokenKit 访问安全令牌和智能卡。适用于构建 TKTokenDriver 或 TKSmartCardTokenDriver 扩展、通过 TKSmartCard/TKSmartCardSlotManager 与智能卡通信、使用 iOS 26+ 的 NFC 智能卡会话、注册智能卡、使用 kSecAttrTokenID 查询基于令牌的可信钥匙串项、监控 TKTokenWatcher，或配置基于证书的智能卡认证等场景。

description: Instrument a Python application with the Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) Python agent for automatic tracing, metrics, and logs. Use when adding observability to a Python service that has no existing APM agent.
description_zh: 使用 Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry（EDOT）的 Python 代理对 Python 应用程序进行插桩，实现自动追踪、指标与日志采集。适用于为没有现有 APM 代理的 Python 服务添加可观测性。

description:
Caveman encoding for SPEC.md and spec-adjacent writes. Loaded by /spec, /build,
/check. Cuts tokens ~75% vs prose while staying precise. Triggers on any write
to SPEC.md or when user says "caveman", "compress this", "be brief".
description_zh: 石器时代编码，用于SPEC.md及周边规格文件的写入操作。由 /spec、/build、/check 加载。相比散文，在保持精确的同时，减少约75%的令牌数量。当对任何SPEC.md进行写入，或用户说出“caveman”、“compress this”、“be brief”时触发。

description: Use when building CLI tools. Keywords: CLI, command line, terminal, clap, structopt, argument parsing, subcommand, interactive, TUI, ratatui, crossterm, indicatif, progress bar, colored output, shell completion, config file, environment variable, 命令行, 终端应用, 参数解析
description_zh: 构建 CLI 工具时使用。关键词：CLI、命令行、终端、clap、structopt、参数解析、子命令、交互式、TUI、ratatui、crossterm、indicatif、进度条、彩色输出、shell 补全、配置文件、环境变量、命令行、终端应用、参数解析

description: Create or update a DESIGN.md from an existing product repository or public website. Use when asked to document an interface's design language, reconstruct its visual system, extract design tokens and guidance from current evidence, or give coding agents persistent UI context. Do not modify product source or promote accidental implementation patterns into design decisions.
description_zh: 从现有的产品仓库或公开网站创建或更新 DESIGN.md。当被要求记录界面的设计语言、重构其视觉系统、从现有证据中提取设计令牌和指南，或为编码代理提供持久的 UI 上下文时使用。不要修改产品源码，也不要将偶然的实现模式提升为设计决策。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants speech to sound more human, companion-like, or emotionally expressive. Triggers include: any mention of 'say like', 'talk like', 'speak like', 'companion voice', 'comfort me', 'cheer me up', 'sound more human', 'good night voice', 'good morning voice', or requests to add fillers, emotion, or personality to generated speech. Also use when the user wants to mimic a specific character's voice, apply speaking style presets (goodnight, morning, comfort, celebration, chatting), tune emotional parameters like warmth or tenderness, or make TTS output feel like a real person talking. If the user asks for a 'voice message', 'companion audio', 'character voice', or wants speech that sighs, laughs, hesitates, or sounds genuinely warm, use this skill. Do NOT use for plain text-to-speech without personality, music generation, sound effects, or general coding tasks unrelated to expressive speech.
description_zh: 当用户希望生成的语音听起来更有人情味、更具陪伴感或更具情感表达力时，请使用本技能。触发条件包括：任何提及 'say like'、'talk like'、'speak like'、'companion voice'、'comfort me'、'cheer me up'、'sound more human'、'good night voice'、'good morning voice'，或要求为生成的语音添加语气词、情感或个性的请求。当用户希望模仿特定角色的声音、应用说话风格预设（goodnight、morning、comfort、celebration、chatting）、调节情感参数（如温暖或温柔），或使 TTS 输出听起来像真实的人在说话时，也请使用本技能。如果用户要求 'voice message'、'companion audio'、'character voice'，或希望语音会叹气、笑、犹豫或听起来真正温暖，请使用本技能。请勿用于无需个性的纯文本转语音、音乐生成、音效，或与表达性语音无关的一般编程任务。

description: Deploy serverless browser automation as cloud functions using Browserbase. Use when the user wants to deploy browser automation to run on a schedule or cron, create a webhook endpoint for browser tasks, run automation in the cloud instead of locally, or asks about Browserbase Functions.
description_zh: 使用 Browserbase 将无服务器浏览器自动化部署为云函数。适用于用户希望部署浏览器自动化以按计划或定时任务（cron）运行、创建浏览器任务 Webhook 端点、在云端而非本地运行自动化，或咨询 Browserbase Functions 的场景。

description: Quick security audit checklist covering authentication, function exposure, argument validation, row-level access control, and environment variable handling
description_zh: 涵盖身份认证、功能暴露、参数验证、行级访问控制及环境变量处理的快速安全审计检查清单

description: Use when the user gives a topic and wants an automated topic-driven narrated explainer, podcast, or knowledge-summary video (Bilibili / YouTube / Xiaohongshu / Douyin / WeChat Channels), or asks to learn visual design patterns from a reference video/image. Trigger when the user mentions creating a knowledge video, narrated explainer, video podcast, or animated infographic-style video from a topic — even if they don't say "video podcast" explicitly. Also trigger when the user wants to regenerate, re-render, rebuild, update, or iterate on a narrated video this skill already produced — e.g. they edited the script/prompt, changed the visuals, or swapped the background music and want the final video remade (reuse the existing videos/{name}/ directory, never start a new project). Do NOT trigger for generic video editing, trimming, format conversion, color grading, or non-narrative video tasks. Produces 4K video via research → script → TTS → Remotion → MP4 + BGM.
description_zh: 当用户给出主题，并希望生成自动化的、以该主题驱动的旁白讲解视频、播客或知识总结视频（支持 Bilibili / YouTube / Xiaohongshu / Douyin / WeChat Channels），或要求从参考视频/图像中学习视觉设计模式时，使用。当用户提到基于某个主题创作知识视频、旁白讲解视频、视频播客或动画信息图风格视频时触发，即使未明确提及“视频播客”。当用户希望对本技能已生成的旁白视频进行重新生成、重新渲染、重建、更新或迭代时，也触发——例如用户修改了脚本/提示词、改变了画面效果，或更换了背景音乐，并希望重新制作最终视频（复用现有的 videos/{name}/ 目录，切勿开启新的项目）。对于通用的视频编辑、剪辑、格式转换、调色或非叙事类视频任务，不要触发。通过研究→脚本→TTS→Remotion→MP4 + BGM 的方式生成 4K 视频。

description: VectorBT backtesting expert. Use when user asks to backtest strategies, create entry/exit signals, analyze portfolio performance, optimize parameters, fetch historical data, use VectorBT/vectorbt, compare strategies, position sizing, equity curves, drawdown charts, or trade analysis. Also triggers for openalgo.ta helpers (exrem, crossover, crossunder, flip, donchian, supertrend).
description_zh: VectorBT 回测专家。当用户要求回测策略、生成买入/卖出信号、分析投资组合表现、优化参数、获取历史数据、使用 VectorBT/vectorbt、比较策略、进行仓位管理、查看权益曲线、回撤图表或进行交易分析时使用。此外，还会触发 openalgo.ta 辅助函数（exrem、crossover、crossunder、flip、donchian、supertrEND）的使用。

description_zh: Seedance 2.0（字节跳动）专家电影导演技能——高保真视频生成覆盖中文、全球及VIP层级。支持文本转视频、图像转视频、首帧末帧、全向参考、角色训练、全向参考训练、视频编辑和去水印。

description: Add drawings, shapes, and a consistent markup experience using PaperKit. Use when integrating PaperMarkupViewController for markup editing, adding shape recognition, working with PaperMarkup data models, embedding markup tools in document editors, or building annotation features that need the system-standard markup toolbar. New in iOS 26.

description_zh: 使用 PassKit 集成苹果支付和钱包通行证，适用于添加 Apple Pay 按钮、创建支付请求、处理支付授权、将通行证添加到钱包、配置商户功能、管理运输/联系方式字段，或使用 PKPaymentRequest、PKPaymentAuthorizationController、PKPaymentButton、AddPassToWalletButton、PKPass、PKAddPassesViewController、PKPassLibrary、钱包通行证分发，以及用于实体商品、现实世界服务、捐赠和符合条件的周期性支付的苹果支付结账流程。

Use when registering ad impressions, handling attribution postbacks, updating conversion values, implementing re-engagement attribution, configuring publisher or advertiser apps, or replacing SKAdNetwork with AdAttributionKit for ad measurement.

description: Build and edit tile-based 2D levels in Godot 4.7 with TileMapLayer and TileSet: paint layers, set up collision/navigation/custom-data on tiles, autotile with terrain sets, and read/write cells from code (set_cell, get_cell_tile_data, local_to_map). Use when working with TileMapLayer nodes, .tres TileSets, autotiling, or migrating a deprecated TileMap node to TileMapLayer.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中使用 TileMapLayer 和 TileSet 构建并编辑基于瓦片的 2D 关卡：绘制图层、在瓦片上设置碰撞/导航/自定义数据、使用地形集自动平铺，并从代码读取/写入单元格（set_cell, get_cell_tile_data, local_to_map）。适用于与 TileMapLayer 节点、.tres TileSet、自动平铺或从已弃用的 TileMap 节点迁移至 TileMapLayer 的场景。

description: Build a puzzle game: grid/board state, move input, rule-based resolution (match-3 cascades, sokoban pushes, tile logic), scoring, and undo. Use for a match-3, sokoban, or grid-logic puzzle.
description_zh: 构建一个谜题游戏：包含网格/棋盘状态、移动输入、基于规则的解算（三消级联、推箱子推动、瓦片逻辑）、计分和撤销。用于三消、推箱子或网格逻辑谜题。

description: Use this skill when asked to read an arxiv paper given an arxiv URL
description_zh: 当要求根据 arxiv URL 阅读 arxiv 论文时，使用此技能。

description: Turn a token name into a vetted, sized buy order. Two things here are exclusive to this skill: resolving a NAME or symbol to the one right contract among its copycats, and sizing an order — amount, slippage, gas, position. No sibling does either. USE THIS SKILL WHEN a buy is being prepared, which shows up as a NAME or symbol, or an AMOUNT, or both — including the plainest possible ask with no mention of checking: 我想买 200u 的 PENGU, 帮我买 500 刀的 BONK, 买 1 个 SOL 的 WIF, 帮我买点 dogwifhat, 想梭 100u 的 XX, PENGU 现在能买吗, PENGU 能不能买, 能不能冲, 值不值得进, 确认是正主不是仿盘再买, buy me $500 of PENGU — and including a bare contract address once an amount arrives with it. DO NOT USE THIS SKILL for a bare contract address with no name to resolve and no amount to size (「这个地址能不能买」, 打个分, 尽调, 有没有貔貅, rug check, is this token safe): that one belongs to gmgn-contract-dd, which is the skill that returns the 0-100 safety verdict.
