This skill never computes a second verdict of its own — it CALLS gmgn-contract-dd and defers to it — so there is nothing to gain by taking that ask, and the user gets an order card they never asked for. Come back here the moment they name an amount. A buy question about a LAUNCHER rather than about a token — 「这个 dev 的新盘能不能买」, 「他下一个盘值不值得冲」, "should I buy his next launch", "will this dev rug at open" — is gmgn-dev-score: it scores the creator's own record, and there is no token name to resolve or amount to size yet. Come back here once they name the coin. Naming a token with no buy intent at all is gmgn-market search. gmgn-swap is where this skill ENDS, not a rival for it: gmgn-swap signs and submits, and this skill never touches a private key and never places an order, so a plain buy request starts HERE and reaches gmgn-swap only after the user confirms the order card. Note that gmgn-swap cannot start from a name either — its --output-token is a contract address and the only names it resolves are the currencies SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC — so 帮我买点 dogwifhat has to come here regardless of who is asked. Go straight to gmgn-swap only when the user says the pre-buy check is unwanted (skip the checks, 直接买, 不用尽调, 我很急), or for what this skill does not do at all: selling, percentage sells, limit orders, stop loss, take profit, trailing orders, multi-wallet batch trading, order status, gas-price lookups. The split is by what the ask still needs done, not by who executes: a name needs resolving and an amount needs sizing, so both start here; a bare address needs only a verdict, so it is gmgn-contract-dd's; a signed transaction is always gmgn-swap's.
description_zh:
将代币名称转化为经审查、已定量的买入订单。

本技能独有的两件事：将 NAME 或代码解析为在仿盘众多中的那一唯一正确合约，以及订单定量——包括金额、滑点、Gas、仓位。其他技能均无法做到这一点。

当正在准备买入时，请使用本技能，买入意向表现为 NAME 或代码、AMOUNT，或两者皆有——包括最简单、未提及任何核查的询问：我想买 200u 的 PENGU，帮我买 500 刀的 BONK，买 1 个 SOL 的 WIF，帮我买点 dogwifhat，想梭 100u 的 XX，PENGU 现在能买吗，PENGU 能不能买，能不能冲，值不值得进，确认是正主不是仿盘再买，buy me $500 of PENGU——以及一旦金额伴随合约地址一同出现时的裸合约地址。

请勿使用本技能处理仅提供裸合约地址、无需解析名称也无需定量的情况（「这个地址能不能买」，打个分，尽调，有没有貔貅，rug check，该代币是否安全）：此类请求应由 gmgn-contract-dd 处理，该技能提供 0-100 的安全性判定。

本技能从不自行计算第二次判定——它调用 gmgn-contract-dd 并以此为准——因此，承接此类请求毫无收益，反而会让用户得到一份从未要求过的订单卡片。

一旦用户明确指定金额，请立即回到此处。

关于 LAUNCHER 而非代币的买入提问——「这个 dev 的新盘能不能买」，「他下一个盘值不值得冲」，"should I buy his next launch"，"will this dev rug at open"——属于 gmgn-dev-score：它评估创作者本人的记录，此时尚无代币名称可解析，也无需定量。

一旦他们命名了代币，请回到此处。

仅命名代币而无任何买入意向，属于 gmgn-market 搜索。

gmgn-swap 是本技能的终点，而非其竞争对手：gmgn-swap 负责签名与提交，本技能从不触碰私钥，也从不直接下订单，因此，普通的买入请求从此处开始，仅当用户确认订单卡片后才会流转至 gmgn-swap。

请注意，gmgn-swap 也无法从名称直接启动——其 --output-token 为合约地址，且仅能解析 SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC 等货币名称——因此，无论询问谁，「帮我买点 dogwifhat」都必须先到此处。

仅在用户表示不想进行买入前核查（跳过核查，直接买，不用尽调，我很急）时，或针对本技能完全不做的事，才可直接前往 gmgn-swap：包括卖单、百分比卖出、限价单、止损、止盈、追踪止损、多钱包批量交易、订单状态、Gas 价格查询。

这种区分依据的是询问仍需完成的操作，而非由谁执行：名称需要解析，金额需要定量，因此这两类请求均从这里开始；裸地址仅需判定，因此属于 gmgn-contract-dd；已签名的交易则始终属于 gmgn-swap。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to configs-variations. Do not use this skill; invoke configs-variations instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-variations still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向——该技能已更名为 configs-variations。请勿使用此技能，请改用 configs-variations。保留此重定向，仅是为了让对 aiconfig-variations 的旧引用仍能指向新名称。

description: Save the current conversation as a permanent, structured wiki note. Use this skill when the user says "save this", "/wiki-capture", "capture this", "file this conversation", "preserve this", "add this to my wiki", or wants to turn what was just discussed into lasting knowledge. The skill classifies the content, rewrites it as declarative knowledge (not a chat transcript), and places it in the correct vault category. Also supports a fast QUICK MODE (`/wiki-capture --quick`, "quick capture", "capture this finding", "save this bug fix", "save this gotcha", "drop this to raw", "quick save to wiki") that drops findings to the `_raw/` staging area in under 60 seconds with no manifest or index writes — used by the session-end Stop hook to auto-preserve findings. Accepts inline named-vault routing like "@research save this" via the shared Config Resolution Protocol.
description_zh: 将当前对话保存为一份永久性、结构化的维基笔记。当用户说"save this"、"/wiki-capture"、"capture this"、"file this conversation"、"preserve this"、"add this to my wiki"，或希望将刚讨论的内容转化为持久化知识时，请使用本技能。该技能对内容进行分类，将其重写为陈述性知识（而非聊天记录），并放入正确的存储库分类中。此外，该技能还支持快速模式（QUICK MODE，通过 `/wiki-capture --quick`、"quick capture"、"capture this finding"、"save this bug fix"、"save this gotcha"、"drop this to raw"、"quick save to wiki" 触发），可在 60 秒内将发现内容存入 `_raw/` 暂存区，无需写入清单或索引——该模式由会话结束时的停止钩子（Stop hook）调用，用于自动保留发现内容。同时，该技能通过共享的配置解析协议（Config Resolution Protocol）接受内联命名存储库路由，例如 "@research save this"。

description: Support automatic audio switching for paired third-party Bluetooth headphones or earbuds with AudioAccessoryKit. Use when a companion app registers an audio accessory, an app extension reports worn/removed placement or connected source-device changes, or AccessoryControlDevice capabilities and errors need handling. Do not use for general AVAudioSession routing, Bluetooth transport, or initial accessory pairing.
description_zh: 支持使用 AudioAccessoryKit 为已配对的第三方蓝牙耳机或耳塞进行自动音频切换。当配套应用注册音频配件、应用扩展报告佩戴/摘下位置或已连接源设备变更，或需要处理 AccessoryControlDevice 的能力与错误时使用。不可用于一般的 AVAudioSession 路由、蓝牙传输或初始配件配对。

description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.
description_zh: 分析 Karpathy 模式 LLM 维基知识库，生成包含实体抽取、隐含关系和主题聚类的交互式知识图谱。

description: 自动捕获经验并安全进化的技能。触发条件：(1)命令/操作失败时→记ERRORS.md (2)被用户纠正('不对'/'应该是')时→记LEARNINGS.md (3)用户需要不存在的能力时→记FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (4)外部API/工具出错时→记ERRORS.md (5)发现自己知识过时/错误时→记LEARNINGS.md (6)发现更好做法时→记LEARNINGS.md (7)每个任务完成时→回顾过程，有新经验则记LEARNINGS.md。去重原则：如果没有新经验或已有条目已覆盖则跳过不写。每次写入同时在.learnings/CHANGELOG.md追加JSONL日志。经验反复出现≥3次时晋升到AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md/SOUL.md。详见正文。
description_zh: 自动捕获经验并安全进化的技能。触发条件：(1)命令/操作失败时→记ERRORS.md (2)被用户纠正（“不对”/“应该是”）时→记LEARNINGS.md (3)用户需要尚未存在的能力时→记FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (4)外部API/工具出错时→记ERRORS.md (5)发现自己知识过时或错误时→记LEARNINGS.md (6)发现更好做法时→记LEARNINGS.md (7)每个任务完成时→回顾过程，有新经验则记LEARNINGS.md。去重原则：如果没有新经验或已有条目已覆盖，则跳过不写。每次写入同时在.learnings/CHANGELOG.md追加JSONL日志。经验反复出现≥3次时晋升到AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md/SOUL.md。详见正文。

description: Use when wiring an external agent framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, PydanticAI, Mastra, ADK, LlamaIndex, Agno, Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework, or others) into a CopilotKit application via the AG-UI protocol.
description_zh: 当通过 AG-UI 协议将外部智能体框架（LangGraph、CrewAI、PydanticAI、Mastra、ADK、LlamaIndex、Agno、Strands、Microsoft Agent Framework 或其他框架）集成到 CopilotKit 应用时使用。

description: Drafts engaging social media posts, writes hooks, suggests hashtags, creates thread structures, and generates companion images. Use when the user asks to write a LinkedIn post, tweet, Twitter/X thread, social media caption, social post, or repurpose content for social platforms.
description_zh: 起草有吸引力的社媒帖子，撰写钩子，建议话题标签，构建线程结构，生成配套图片。适用于用户要求撰写 LinkedIn 帖子、推文、Twitter/X 线程、社媒配文、社媒帖子，或将内容重新用于社交平台时。

description: Bulk-extract many pages from one site or section. Use for "crawl", "everything under /docs", or content spanning linked pages.
description_zh: 从一个站点或板块批量提取多页内容。适用于“爬取”、“所有 /docs 下的内容”或“跨越链接页面的内容”。

description: Handles LLM-as-judge and code evaluator workflows on Arize including creating/updating evaluators, running evaluations on spans or experiments, managing tasks, trigger-run operations, column mapping, and continuous monitoring. Use when the user mentions create evaluator, LLM judge, code evaluator, hallucination, faithfulness, correctness, relevance, run eval, score spans, score experiment, trigger-run, column mapping, continuous monitoring, or improve evaluator prompt.
description_zh: 在 Arize 上处理 LLM作为裁判和代码评估器的工作流，包括创建/更新评估器、在 spans 或实验中运行评估、任务管理、触发运行操作、列映射以及持续监控。当用户提及创建评估器、LLM作为裁判、代码评估器、幻觉、忠实性、正确性、相关性、运行评估、为 spans 评分、为实验评分、触发运行操作、列映射、持续监控或改进评估器提示词时，使用此功能。

description: Control motorized camera docks and enable intelligent subject tracking using DockKit. Use when discovering DockKit-compatible accessories, implementing camera subject tracking for faces or bodies, controlling dock motors for pan and tilt, configuring framing behavior, setting regions of interest, or building video apps with automatic camera tracking.
description_zh: 使用 DockKit 控制电动相机坞并启用智能主体追踪。适用于发现 DockKit 兼容配件、为面部或身体实现相机主体追踪、控制坞的横移和俯仰马达、配置取景行为、设置兴趣区域，或构建带有自动相机追踪功能的视频应用时。

description: Push Packer build metadata to HCP Packer registry for tracking and managing image lifecycle. Use when integrating Packer builds with HCP Packer for version control and governance.
description_zh: 将 Packer 构建元数据推送到 HCP Packer 注册表，用于跟踪和管理镜像生命周期。在将 Packer 构建与 HCP Packer 集成，用于版本控制和治理时使用。

description: Analyze Rust project structure using LSP symbols. Triggers on: /symbols, project structure, list structs, list traits, list functions, 符号分析, 项目结构, 列出所有, 有哪些struct
description_zh: 使用 LSP 符号分析 Rust 项目结构。触发条件：/symbols、项目结构、列出结构体、列出 trait、列出函数、符号分析、项目结构、列出所有、有哪些struct

description: Render A2UI (Agent-to-UI declarative surfaces) in CopilotKit v2. Enable the runtime via CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }), then enable the provider via <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}>. Auto-activates via /info — do NOT manually pass renderActivityMessages. createA2UIMessageRenderer ships from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; low-level primitives (A2UIProvider, A2UIRenderer, createCatalog) ship from @copilotkit/a2ui-renderer. Covers theme customization, createSurface dedup, action-bridge try/finally cleanup. Load when an agent emits A2UI operations (createSurface / updateComponents / updateDataModel), when wiring a2ui on CopilotRuntime, or when styling A2UI surfaces.
description_zh: 在 CopilotKit v2 中渲染 A2UI（智能体到 UI 的声明式界面）。通过 CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }) 启用运行时，并通过 <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}> 启用 provider。通过 /info 自动激活——请勿手动传入 renderActivityMessages。createA2UIMessageRenderer 由 @copilotkit/react-core/v2 提供；底层原语（A2UIProvider、A2UIRenderer、createCatalog）由 @copilotkit/a2ui-renderer 提供。涵盖主题定制、createSurface 去重、action-bridge try/finally 清理过程。当智能体发出 A2UI 操作（createSurface / updateComponents / updateDataModel）时、在 CopilotRuntime 上配置 a2ui 时，或为 A2UI 界面进行样式设置时加载。

description: Perform a detailed SWOT analysis — strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats with actionable recommendations. Use when doing strategic assessment, competitive analysis, or evaluating a product or business position.
description_zh: 进行详细的SWOT分析—优势、劣势、机会和威胁，并附上可操作的建议。在开展战略评估、竞争分析，或评估产品或业务地位时使用。

description: Write Unity 6.3 LTS C# gameplay scripts: the MonoBehaviour lifecycle (Awake/OnEnable/Start/Update/FixedUpdate/LateUpdate), GameObject and component access, coroutines, and Inspector serialization. Use when creating or editing .cs scripts in a Unity project, or when the user mentions MonoBehaviour, Start/Update, GetComponent, SerializeField, coroutines, or "Unity script".
description_zh: 编写 Unity 6.3 LTS C# 游戏脚本：包括 MonoBehaviour 生命周期（Awake/OnEnable/Start/Update/FixedUpdate/LateUpdate）、GameObject 与组件访问、协程以及 Inspector 序列化。在 Unity 项目中创建或编辑 .cs 脚本时使用，或当用户提及 MonoBehaviour、Start/Update、GetComponent、SerializeField、协程或“Unity 脚本”时使用。

description: Builds and debugs Sent v3 webhook receivers end to end — endpoint registration, HMAC signature verification, replay rejection, event dedupe, retry and auto-disable behavior, secret rotation, and delivery-log triage. Use when handling Sent webhook events, verifying x-webhook-signature, fixing 401 or signature-mismatch failures, recovering a disabled endpoint, choosing event_types or event_filters, rotating a signing secret, or interpreting the webhook delivery log.
description_zh: 构建并调试 Sent v3 webhook 接收器端到端——端点注册、HMAC 签名验证、重放拒绝、事件去重、重试和自动禁用行为、密钥轮换以及投递日志分类。在处理 Sent webhook 事件、验证 x-webhook-signature、修复 401 或签名不匹配故障、恢复禁用的端点、选择事件类型或事件过滤器、轮换签名密钥或解读 webhook 投递日志时使用。

description: Covers writing backend Trigger.dev tasks with @trigger.dev/sdk: defining task() and schemaTask(), the run function and its ctx, retries, waits, queues and concurrency, idempotency keys, run metadata, logging, triggering other tasks (and the Result shape), scheduled/cron tasks, and the essentials of trigger.config.ts. Load this whenever you are authoring or editing code inside a /trigger directory, defining a task, or writing backend code that triggers tasks. Realtime/React hooks and AI chat are covered by separate skills.
description_zh: 涵盖使用 @trigger.dev/sdk 编写 Trigger.dev 后端任务：定义 task() 和 schemaTask()、运行函数及其 ctx、重试、等待、队列与并发、幂等键、运行元数据、日志、触发其他任务（以及 Result 结构）、定时任务（scheduled/cron）、以及 trigger.config.ts 的基本内容。当您正在 /trigger 目录中编写或编辑代码、定义任务，或编写触发任务的后端代码时，随时加载此内容。实时/React hooks 和 AI 聊天由单独的技能覆盖。

description: Create, edit, and analyze Word documents with tracked changes, comments, and formatting. Useful for design briefs, copy docs, and review-ready deliverables.
description_zh: 创建、编辑和分析带有修订标记、批注和格式的 Word 文档。适用于设计简报、文案文档以及可供审阅的交付成果。

description: Plans and executes a migration from Twilio, Sinch, Infobip, Vonage, or MessageBird/Bird to Sent v3 — mapping send calls, status vocabularies, webhook signature schemes, opt-out stores, templates, and tenancy models, then cutting over safely with dual-run and rollback. Use when replacing an incumbent CPaaS provider, translating provider code or webhook handlers to Sent, or planning a phased cutover and its verification gates.
description_zh: 计划并执行从 Twilio、Sinch、Infobip、Vonage 或 MessageBird/Bird 到 Sent v3 的迁移——映射发送调用、状态词汇表、Webhook 签名方案、退订存储、模板和租户模型，然后通过双跑和回滚安全切换。适用于替换现有的 CPaaS 服务商、将服务商代码或 Webhook 处理程序转换为 Sent，或规划分阶段切换及其验证关卡的情况。

description: Stands up a production-ready Sent v3 integration in an existing codebase — SDK selection and client construction, x-api-key configuration, idempotent sends, retry and rate-limit handling, the 46-code error catalog, sandbox verification, and a verified webhook receiver. Use when adding Sent to an app for the first time, choosing an SDK or framework wiring, handling 429 or 409 responses, deciding what to log, or hardening an integration before launch.
description_zh: 在现有代码库中部署并上线生产就绪的 Sent v3 集成——包括 SDK 选型与客户端构造、x-api-key 配置、幂等发送、重试与速率限制处理、46 个错误码目录、沙箱验证，以及经验证的 webhook 接收器。适用于首次将 Sent 集成到应用、选择 SDK 或框架接线、处理 429 或 409 响应、决定记录哪些内容，或在发布前加固集成时使用。

description: Decides how a Sent message should reach the recipient — automatic routing versus a pinned channel, what the channel array actually does, how fallback and reroute work, and why a message ended as FAILED, FILTERED, BLOCKED, or channel "auto". Use when choosing the channel field, expecting WhatsApp-to-SMS fallback, debugging an unexpected route or duplicate charges from multiple channels, or interpreting message status and activity evidence.
description_zh: 决定已发送的消息应如何送达收件人——是自动路由还是固定频道，频道数组的具体功能，回退与重路由的工作原理，以及消息最终以 FAILED、FILTERED、BLOCKED 或频道“auto”状态结束的原因。适用于选择频道字段、预期 WhatsApp 至短信回退、排查多频道不预期路由或重复扣费问题，或解读消息状态与活动证据的场景。

description: Designs inbound and conversational Sent flows — opt-out and opt-in keyword handling, consent state on contacts, auto-replies inside the WhatsApp 24-hour window, RCS STOP chips, conversation history retrieval, and per-channel inbound capability. Use when handling message.received events, implementing STOP or HELP behavior, restoring consent after an opt-out, building a support inbox or chatbot on Sent, or paginating conversation history.
description_zh: 设计入站与对话式 Sent 流程——包括选择退出与选择加入关键词处理、联系人上的同意状态、WhatsApp 24 小时窗口内的自动回复、RCS STOP 标签、对话历史检索以及按渠道入站能力。在处理 message.received 事件、实现 STOP 或 HELP 行为、在用户选择退出后恢复同意状态、在 Sent 上构建支持收件箱或聊天机器人，或分页获取对话历史时使用。

description: Executes the Sent Sender Profile lifecycle over the API — creating profiles with the right inheritance, sharing, billing, and WhatsApp options, driving profile completion and its callback, managing 10DLC campaigns per profile, and administering users and roles. Use when calling POST /v3/profiles, handling a completion callback or unclear profile status, choosing inherit or dedicated resources, wiring per-tenant onboarding, or inviting and role-managing users.
description_zh: 通过 API 执行 Sent Sender Profile 生命周期——创建具有正确继承、共享、计费和 WhatsApp 选项的资料，驱动资料完成及回调，管理每个资料的 10DLC 活动，并管理用户与角色。当调用 POST /v3/profiles、处理完成回调或状态不清晰的资料状态、选择继承或专用资源、配置每租户的入职引导，或邀请并管理用户角色时使用。

description: Identify grammar, logical, and flow errors in text and suggest targeted fixes without rewriting the entire text. Use when proofreading content, checking writing quality, or reviewing a draft.
description_zh: 识别文本中的语法、逻辑和流畅性错误，并提出有针对性的修改建议，而无需重写整段文本。适用于校对内容、检查写作质量或审阅草稿。

description: Build a marketing performance report with key metrics, trend analysis, wins and misses, and prioritized optimization recommendations. Use when wrapping a campaign, when preparing weekly, monthly, or quarterly channel summaries for stakeholders, or when you need data translated into an executive summary with next-period priorities.
description_zh: 构建一份包含关键指标、趋势分析、成功与不足以及优先排序优化建议的营销绩效报告。在总结一项营销活动时，在准备面向利益相关者的周、月或季度渠道总结时，或在需要将数据转化为包含下一周期优先事项的执行摘要时使用。

description: Instrument a Java application with the Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) Java agent for automatic tracing, metrics, and logs. Use when adding observability to a Java service that has no existing APM agent.
description_zh: 使用 Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry（EDOT）Java Agent 为 Java 应用程序添加埋点，以实现追踪、指标和日志的自动采集。当为没有现有 APM 代理的 Java 服务添加可观测性时使用。

description: Build alternative browser engines using BrowserEngineKit. Use when developing a non-WebKit browser engine for iOS/iPadOS in supported regions, managing web content/rendering/networking extension processes, configuring GPU and networking process capabilities, checking alternative-engine device eligibility, or reviewing BrowserEngineKit entitlements and Info.plist setup.
description_zh: 利用 BrowserEngineKit 构建替代浏览器引擎。在为支持地区开发 iOS/iPadOS 非 WebKit 浏览器引擎、管理网页内容/渲染/网络扩展进程、配置 GPU 和网络进程能力、检查替代引擎设备资格，或审查 BrowserEngineKit 权限及 Info.plist 配置时使用。

description: Instrument a .NET application with the Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) .NET SDK for automatic tracing, metrics, and logs. Use when adding observability to a .NET service that has no existing APM agent.
description_zh: 使用Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) .NET SDK为.NET应用进行插桩，实现自动追踪、指标和日志功能。适用于为没有现有APM代理的.NET服务添加可观测性。

description: Write, review, and improve blog posts for the Sentry engineering blog following Sentry's specific writing standards, voice, and quality bar. Use this skill whenever someone asks to write a blog post, draft a technical article, review blog content, improve a draft, write a product announcement, create an engineering deep-dive, or produce any written content destined for the Sentry blog or developer audience. Also trigger when the user mentions "blog post," "blog draft," "write-up," "announcement post," "engineering post," "deep dive," "postmortem," or asks for help with technical writing for Sentry. Even if the user just says "help me write about [feature/topic]" — if it sounds like it could become a Sentry blog post, use this skill.
description_zh: 为 Sentry 工程博客撰写、审阅并改进博客文章，遵循 Sentry 的具体写作标准、语气和品质要求。当有人要求撰写博客文章、起草技术文章、审阅博客内容、改进草稿、撰写产品公告、创作工程深度解析，或为 Sentry 博客或开发者受众制作任何书面内容时，应使用此技能。此外，当用户提及"blog post"、"blog draft"、"write-up"、"announcement post"、"engineering post"、"deep dive"、"postmortem"，或要求 Sentry 的技术写作帮助时，也应触发此技能。即使用户仅说"help me write about [feature/topic]"——如果该内容听起来可以成为 Sentry 博客文章，也应使用此技能。

description: MUST READ before creating or enhancing any ADK agent project. Use when the user wants to build a new agent (e.g. "build me a search agent") or enhance an existing project (e.g. "add CI/CD to my project", "add RAG").
description_zh: 创建或增强任何 ADK 智能体项目之前，必须阅读。当用户想要构建新的智能体（例如：“构建一个搜索智能体”）或增强现有项目（例如：“为我的项目添加 CI/CD”、“添加 RAG”）时使用。

description: Comprehensive Cline SDK skill for building AI agents. Covers the direct Agent runtime, ClineCore sessions, custom tools, plugins, events, LLM providers, scheduling, multi-agent teams, and production deployment. Use for any task involving @cline/sdk or its sub-packages.
description_zh: 用于构建AI智能体的全面Cline SDK技能。涵盖直接Agent运行时、ClineCore会话、自定义工具、插件、事件、LLM提供商、调度、多智能体团队以及生产环境部署。适用于任何涉及 @cline/sdk 或其子包的任务。

description: Creates Elastic Cloud Serverless projects (Elasticsearch, Observability, or Security) via the REST API, saves credentials to file, and bootstraps a scoped Elasticsearch API key. Use when creating a new serverless project, provisioning a search or observability environment, or spinning up a new Elastic Cloud project.
description_zh: 通过 REST API 创建弹性云无服务器项目（Elasticsearch、可观测性或安全类），将凭据保存到文件中，并初始化一个受限的 Elasticsearch API 密钥。用于创建新的无服务器项目、配置搜索或可观测性环境，或启动新的弹性云项目时。

description: Turns CSV, Excel, or JSON data into a polished visual report page.
description_zh: 将CSV、Excel或JSON数据转换为精美的视觉报告页面。

description: Nuxt SEO meta-module with robots, sitemap, og-image, schema-org. Use when configuring SEO, generating sitemaps, creating OG images, or adding structured data.
description_zh: Nuxt SEO 元模块，支持 robots、sitemap、og-image 与 schema-org。用于配置 SEO、生成 sitemap、创建 OG 图片或添加结构化数据时使用。

description: Transfer app data to or from other platforms using AppMigrationKit. Use when implementing system-orchestrated one-time migration between iOS and Android or another platform, building an AppMigrationExtension, packaging transportable resources with ResourcesArchiver, importing resources on the destination device, reporting import progress, handling migration errors and app group cleanup, checking MigrationStatus, or testing migration code with AppMigrationTester.
description_zh: 使用 AppMigrationKit 在平台之间传输应用数据。适用于实施在 iOS 与 Android 或其他平台之间的系统编排一次性数据迁移，包括构建 AppMigrationExtension、使用 ResourcesArchiver 打包可传输资源、在目标设备上导入资源、报告导入进度、处理迁移错误和 App Group 清理、检查 MigrationStatus，或使用 AppMigrationTester 测试迁移代码。

description: Design system and guidelines for Claude's built-in generative UI — the show_widget tool that renders interactive HTML/SVG widgets inline in claude.ai conversations. This skill provides the complete Anthropic "Imagine" design system so Claude produces high-quality widgets without needing to call read_me first. Use this skill whenever the user asks to visualize data, create an interactive chart, build a dashboard, render a diagram, draw a flowchart, show a mockup, create an interactive explainer, or produce any visual content beyond plain text or markdown. Triggers include: "show me", "visualize", "draw", "chart", "dashboard", "diagram", "flowchart", "widget", "interactive", "mockup", "illustrate", "explain how X works" (with visual), or any request for visual/interactive output. Also triggers when the user wants to display financial data visually, create comparison grids, or build tools with sliders, toggles, or live-updating displays.
description_zh: 针对 Claude 内置生成式 UI 的设计系统与指南——show_widget 工具，该工具在 claude.ai 对话中内联渲染交互式 HTML/SVG 组件。本技能提供完整的 Anthropic "Imagine" 设计系统，使 Claude 无需先调用 read_me 即可生成高质量组件。当用户要求可视化数据、创建交互式图表、构建仪表盘、渲染图形、绘制流程图、展示效果图、创建交互式讲解器，或生成任何超出纯文本或 Markdown 形式的视觉内容时，请使用本技能。触发条件包括："show me"、"visualize"、"draw"、"chart"、"dashboard"、"diagram"、"flowchart"、"widget"、"interactive"、"mockup"、"illustrate"、"解释 X 的工作原理" (with visual)，或任何要求视觉/交互式输出的请求。当用户希望以可视化方式展示财务数据、创建对比网格，或构建带有滑块、开关或实时更新显示的控件时，也会触发本技能。

description: Test iOS apps in a simulator with XcodeBuildMCP. Use when iOS changes need simulator evidence before handoff.
description_zh: 使用 XcodeBuildMCP 在模拟器中对 iOS 应用进行测试。当 iOS 变更需要交接前的模拟器证据时使用。

description: Generate a pre-earnings briefing for any stock using Yahoo Finance data. Use this skill whenever the user wants to prepare for an upcoming earnings report, understand what analysts expect, review a company's beat/miss track record, or get a quick overview before an earnings call. Triggers include: "earnings preview for AAPL", "what to expect from TSLA earnings", "MSFT reports next week", "earnings preview", "pre-earnings analysis", "what are analysts expecting for NVDA", "earnings estimates for", "will GOOGL beat earnings", "earnings beat/miss history", "upcoming earnings", "before earnings", "earnings setup", "consensus estimates", "earnings whisper", "EPS expectations", "what's the street expecting", "earnings season preview", any mention of preparing for or previewing an earnings report, or any request to understand expectations ahead of a company's earnings date. Always use this skill when the user mentions a ticker in context of upcoming earnings, even if they don't say "preview" explicitly.
description_zh: 使用Yahoo Finance数据为任何股票生成财报前简报。当用户需要为即将到来的财报报告做准备、了解分析师的预期、回顾公司超出或低于预期的记录，或在进行财报电话会议前获取快速概览时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括："AAPL财报预览"、"从TSLA财报中期待什么"、"MSFT下周发布"、"财报预览"、"财报前分析"、"分析师对NVDA有何预期"、"财报估算针对"、"GOOGL能否超越财报"、"财报超预期/低于预期历史"、"即将到来的财报"、"财报前"、"财报准备工作"、"一致预期估算"、"财报传闻"、"EPS预期"、"市场预计什么"、"财报季预览"、任何提及为财报报告做准备或预览的内容，或在公司的财报日期之前请求理解预期的要求。当用户提到任何在即将到来的财报背景下提及的股票代码时，即使他们没有明确说"预览"，也请始终使用此技能。

description: Provides Qwen Coder CLI delegation workflows for coding tasks using Qwen2.5-Coder and QwQ models, including English prompt formulation, execution flags, and safe result handling. Use when the user explicitly asks to use Qwen for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, debugging, or architectural analysis. Triggers on "use qwen", "use qwen coder", "delegate to qwen", "ask qwen", "second opinion from qwen", "qwen opinion", "continue with qwen", "qwen session".
description_zh: 支持使用 Qwen2.5-Coder 和 QwQ 模型进行编码任务的 Qwen Coder CLI 委派工作流，涵盖英文提示词构建、执行参数配置以及安全结果处理。当用户明确要求使用 Qwen 执行代码生成、重构、调试或架构分析等任务时使用。触发条件包括："使用 qwen"、"使用 qwen coder"、"委派给 qwen"、"询问 qwen"、"请 qwen 给予意见"、"qwen 意见"、"使用 qwen 继续"、"qwen 会话"等。

description: Define and design a product metrics dashboard with key metrics, data sources, visualization types, and alert thresholds. Use when creating a metrics dashboard, defining KPIs, setting up product analytics, or building a data monitoring plan.
description_zh: 定义并设计一个包含关键指标、数据源、可视化类型和告警阈值的产品指标仪表板。适用于创建指标仪表板、定义KPI、设置产品分析或制定数据监控计划时。

description: Access research-grade sensor data using SensorKit for approved studies. Use when an app needs SensorKit entitlement setup, Research Sensor & Usage Data authorization, ambient light, recorded motion, device usage, keyboard metrics, visits, speech, face, wrist temperature, ECG, PPG, acoustic settings, or sleep-session data. Route ordinary motion to CoreMotion and health records/workouts to HealthKit.
description_zh: 通过 SensorKit 获取研究级传感器数据，用于获批研究。当应用需要设置 SensorKit 权限、Research Sensor & Usage Data 授权，以及获取环境光、记录的运动、设备使用、键盘指标、到访记录、语音、面部、手腕温度、ECG、PPG、声学设置或睡眠会话数据时使用。将普通运动路由至 CoreMotion，将健康记录与锻炼路由至 HealthKit。

description: Screen US stocks using William O'Neil's CANSLIM growth stock methodology. Use when user requests CANSLIM stock screening, growth stock analysis, momentum stock identification, or wants to find stocks with strong earnings and price momentum following O'Neil's investment system.
description_zh: 使用威廉·欧尼尔（William O'Neil）的CANSLIM成长股筛选方法筛选美股。适用于用户请求CANSLIM股票筛选、成长股分析、动量股识别，或希望按照欧尼尔的投资体系寻找盈利强劲且价格动能的股票时使用。

description: Use this skill when the user wants to search the web without a full browser session: find URLs, titles, and metadata for a query. Prefer it over a browser when you just need search results, not page content. Returns structured results with titles, URLs, authors, and dates.
description_zh: 当用户希望无需完整浏览器会话即可搜索网络时，使用此技能：为查询查找URL、标题和元数据。当只需要搜索结果而非页面内容时，优先使用它而非浏览器。它返回包含标题、URL、作者和日期的结构化结果。

description: Migrate a .NET application from the classic Elastic APM .NET agent to the EDOT .NET SDK. Use when switching from Elastic.Apm.* packages to Elastic.OpenTelemetry.
description_zh: 将 .NET 应用程序从经典的 Elastic APM .NET 代理迁移到 EDOT .NET SDK。适用于从 Elastic.Apm.* 包切换为 Elastic.OpenTelemetry 时使用。

description: Instant lead enrichment. Drop a name, company, LinkedIn URL, or email and get the full contact card with email, phone, title, company intel, and next actions.
description_zh: 即时线索丰富化。输入姓名、公司、LinkedIn 链接或邮箱，即可获取包含邮箱、电话、职位、公司信息及后续行动建议的完整联系人卡片。

description: Discover and list a site's URLs, with search filtering. Use for "map the site" or "find the URL for" requests — when the user knows the site but not the exact page, or wants site structure.
description_zh: 发现并列出网站的网址，支持搜索筛选。适用于“梳理网站”或“查找网址”等场景——当用户知晓网站但不清楚具体页面，或需要了解网站结构时使用。

description:
Set up Tailwind v4 with shadcn/ui using @theme inline pattern and CSS variable architecture. Four-step pattern: CSS variables, Tailwind mapping, base styles, automatic dark mode. Prevents 8 documented errors.

Use when initializing React projects with Tailwind v4, or fixing colors not working, tw-animate-css errors, @theme inline dark mode conflicts, @apply breaking, v3 migration issues.
description_zh:
采用 @theme inline 模式与 CSS 变量架构，配置 Tailwind v4 与 shadcn/ui。四步模式：CSS 变量、Tailwind 映射、基础样式、自动暗黑模式。可预防 8 个已记录的错误。

适用于使用 Tailwind v4 初始化 React 项目，或解决颜色不生效、tw-animate-css 错误、@theme inline 暗黑模式冲突、@apply 失效、v3 迁移问题等场景。

description: Implements an approved spec. Validates that the state means "Approved" (in any language), creates a git branch named after the spec, switches to it, and starts the implementation step by step with pauses to review diffs.
description_zh: 实现已批准的规格。验证状态为“已批准”（任意语言），创建以该规格命名的 git 分支，切换至该分支，并逐步开始实现，期间暂停以审查差异。

description:
AI video generation: text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, model selection.

Use when generating a short video clip from a prompt or reference (e.g. 5s clip of a cat in rain, animate this photo, restyle this video).
description_zh:
AI视频生成：文本到视频、图片到视频、视频到视频、模型选择。

根据提示词或参考素材生成短视频片段时使用（例如：下雨场景中猫的5秒片段、将这张照片进行动画处理、对这段视频进行风格重塑）。

description: Increase widget visibility on Apple Watch using RelevanceKit. Use when providing contextual relevance signals for watchOS widgets, declaring time-based or location-based relevance, combining multiple relevance providers, helping the system surface the right widget at the right time on watchOS 26, or routing mixed RelevanceKit/WidgetKit/HealthKit/MapKit Smart Stack scope.
description_zh: 使用 RelevanceKit 提高 Apple Watch 小部件的可见性。适用于在 watchOS 小部件中提供上下文相关度信号、声明基于时间或基于位置的相关度、整合多个相关度提供程序、帮助系统在 watchOS 26 的合适时机呈现正确的小部件，或路由混合 RelevanceKit/WidgetKit/HealthKit/MapKit Smart Stack 的作用域的场景。

description: Manage Elastic Cloud organization access: invite users, assign roles to Serverless projects, and create or revoke Cloud API keys. Use when granting, modifying, or auditing user access.
description_zh: 管理 Elastic Cloud 组织访问权限：邀请用户、为 Serverless 项目分配角色、创建或撤销 Cloud API 密钥。在授予、修改或审计用户访问权限时使用。

description: Build a survival-crafting game: resource gathering, inventory, crafting and a tech tree, needs (hunger/thirst/temperature), and base building. Use for a survival or crafting/base-building game.
description_zh: 制作一个生存建造游戏：包含资源采集、背包系统、制作与科技树、需求（饥饿、口渴、温度）以及基地建造功能。适用于生存或制作建造类游戏。

description: Extract text, create PDFs, and handle forms. Useful for press releases, branded one-pagers, and printable design deliverables.
description_zh: 提取文本，创建PDF，以及处理表单。适用于新闻稿、品牌化的一页文档和可打印的设计交付物。

description: Generate a stakeholder update tailored to audience and cadence. Use when writing a weekly or monthly status for leadership, announcing a launch, escalating a risk or blocker, or translating the same progress into exec-brief, engineering-detail, or customer-facing versions.
description_zh: 根据受众与节奏，生成量身定制的利益相关方更新。适用于为领导层撰写周报或月报、宣布发布、上报风险或阻碍，或将同一进展转化为高管简报、工程详情或面向客户的版本等场景。

description: Facilitate a brainstorming session using diverse creative techniques. Use when the user says 'help me brainstorm' or 'help me ideate'
description_zh: 使用多样化的创意技巧，主持一场头脑风暴会议。当用户说“help me brainstorm”或“help me ideate”时使用。

description: Identify the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) from research data with demographics, behaviors, JTBD, and needs. Use when defining your ICP, analyzing PMF survey data, or understanding who your best customers are.
description_zh: 从包含人口统计、行为、JTBD 和需求的研究数据中，识别理想客户画像（ICP）。适用于定义您的 ICP、分析 PMF 调查数据或了解您的最佳客户群体时使用。

description: Schedule and publish social media posts across 13 platforms (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook Pages, TikTok, Discord, Telegram, YouTube, Reddit, WordPress, Pinterest) via the SocialClaw API. Use when the user wants to publish, schedule, or manage social media content programmatically. Requires SOCIALCLAW_API_KEY.
description_zh: 通过 SocialClaw API 在 13 个平台（X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook Pages、TikTok、Discord、Telegram、YouTube、Reddit、WordPress、Pinterest）上安排并发布社交媒体帖子。当用户希望以编程方式发布、安排或管理社交媒体内容时使用。需要 SOCIALCLAW_API_KEY。

description: Design and draft multi-email sequences with full copy, timing, branching logic, exit conditions, and performance benchmarks. Use when building onboarding, lead nurture, re-engagement, win-back, or product launch flows, when you need a complete drip campaign with A/B test suggestions, or when mapping a sequence end-to-end with a flow diagram.
description_zh: 设计并撰写多邮件营销序列，包含完整文案、发送时间、分支逻辑、退出条件和性能基准。适用于构建新用户引导、潜在客户培育、重新激活、流失客户召回或产品发布流程；适用于需要完整滴灌营销活动并包含A/B测试建议；适用于配合流程图对序列进行端到端映射的场景。

description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
description_zh: 当用户提出诸如“如何做 X”、“为 X 查找技能”、“是否有技能可以……”的问题，或对扩展能力表示兴趣时，帮助用户发现和安装智能体技能。当用户正在寻找可能以可安装技能形式存在的功能时，应使用此技能。

description: Migrate a Python application from the classic Elastic APM Python agent to the EDOT Python agent. Use when switching from elastic-apm to elastic-opentelemetry.
description_zh: 将 Python 应用从经典的 Elastic APM Python 代理迁移到 EDOT Python 代理。当从 elastic-apm 切换到 elastic-opentelemetry 时使用。

description: Autonomous multi-page extraction into structured JSON. Use when the user wants website data matching a schema — pricing tiers, product listings — beyond a single-page scrape.
description_zh: 自主多页数据提取至结构化 JSON。当用户需要提取符合特定模式（schema）的网站数据——如定价层级、产品列表等，且需求超出单页抓取范围时使用。

description: Alert by webhook/email on web changes — use for "monitor/watch/track/alert me when": recurring checks on known URLs (prefer over repeated one-off scrapes) or web-wide watches for new results (queries + goal).
description_zh: 通过webhook/电子邮件在网页变化时告警 — 用于“监控、观察、跟踪并通知我当”：对已知URL的定期检查（优于重复的一次性抓取），或全网监控以获取新结果（查询+目标）。

description: Headcount planning, org design, and team structure optimization. Trigger with "org planning", "headcount plan", "team structure", "reorg", "who should we hire next", or when the user is thinking about team size, reporting structure, or organizational design.
description_zh: 人员编制规划、组织设计及团队结构优化。当用户提及 "org planning"、"headcount plan"、"team structure"、"reorg"、"who should we hire next"，或当用户正在考虑团队规模、汇报结构或组织设计时，即触发。

description: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom to its root cause and fix it there; reproduce first, ask why until you reach it, resist nil-check guards that silence crashes.
description_zh: 调试时采用。将每个症状追溯到根本原因，并在该处修复；先复现问题，持续追问原因，直到触及根源，避免使用能掩盖崩溃的空值检查防护。

description: Generate a post-earnings analysis for any stock using Yahoo Finance data. Use when the user wants to review what happened after earnings, understand beat/miss results, see stock reaction, or get an earnings recap. Triggers: "AAPL earnings recap", "how did TSLA earnings go", "MSFT earnings results", "did NVDA beat earnings", "post-earnings analysis", "earnings surprise", "what happened with GOOGL earnings", "earnings reaction", "stock moved after earnings", "EPS beat or miss", "revenue beat or miss", "quarterly results for", "how were earnings", "AMZN reported last night", "earnings call recap", or any request about a company's recent earnings outcome. Use this skill when the user references a past earnings event, even if they just say "AAPL reported" or "how did they do".
description_zh: 使用雅虎财经（Yahoo Finance）数据，为任何股票生成业绩后分析报告。当用户需要回顾财报发布后的情况、了解超预期/未达预期结果、查看股票反应或获取业绩摘要时使用。触发词："AAPL earnings recap"、"TSLA 财报表现如何"、"MSFT earnings results"、"NVDA 是否超预期盈利"、"post-earnings analysis"、"earnings surprise"、"GOOGL 财报发生了什么"、"earnings reaction"、"财报后股票走势"、"EPS beat or miss"、"revenue beat or miss"、"季度业绩（for）"、"how were earnings"、"AMZN 昨晚发布了财报"、"earnings call recap"，或任何关于公司近期业绩表现的要求。当用户提及过往财报事件时使用本技能，即使用户仅提到如 "AAPL reported" 或 "how did they do" 等表述时。

description: Use this skill to track institutional investor ownership changes and portfolio flows using 13F filings data. Analyzes hedge funds, mutual funds, and other institutional holders to identify stocks with significant smart money accumulation or distribution. Helps discover stocks before major moves by following where sophisticated investors are deploying capital.
description_zh: 使用本技能，利用13F申报数据跟踪机构投资者持仓变化与投资组合流动。通过对冲基金、共同基金及其他机构持有者的分析，识别存在聪明资金显著累积或派发行为的股票。通过跟踪成熟投资者资金部署的动向，有助于在重大行情发生前发掘相关股票。

description:
Agile sprint planning with story estimation, capacity planning, and sprint goal setting.
Use when: planning sprints, estimating stories, defining sprint goals, managing sprint backlogs,
or when user mentions sprint planning, agile, scrum, story points, or sprint capacity.
description_zh:
敏捷冲刺计划，包含故事估算、容量规划和冲刺目标设定。
使用场景：计划冲刺、估算故事、定义冲刺目标、管理冲刺待办事项，
或当用户提及冲刺计划、敏捷、Scrum、故事点或冲刺容量时。

description: Review and analyze product metrics with trend analysis and actionable insights. Use when running a weekly, monthly, or quarterly metrics review, investigating a sudden spike or drop, comparing performance against targets, or turning raw numbers into a scorecard with recommended actions.
description_zh: 结合趋势分析与可操作洞察，回顾并分析产品指标。适用于执行每周、每月或每季度的指标回顾，调查突发的激增或下降，将绩效与目标进行比较，或将原始数据转化为带有建议行动的评分卡时。

description: Classify issue type, activate the matching agent mode for type-specific drafting, and enforce shared safety gates before GitHub mutation.
description_zh: 分类问题类型，激活用于特定类型起草的匹配智能体模式，并在 GitHub 变异前强制执行共享安全门。

description: Generates architecture diagrams from code, infrastructure, or descriptions. Use when user asks to visualize, diagram, or document system architecture.
description_zh: 从代码、基础设施或描述中生成架构图。当用户要求可视化、绘制或记录系统架构时使用。

description: Migrate a Java application from the classic Elastic APM Java agent to the EDOT Java agent. Use when switching from elastic-apm-agent.jar to elastic-otel-javaagent.jar.
description_zh: 将一个Java应用程序从经典Elastic APM Java代理迁移到EDOT Java代理。当从elastic-apm-agent.jar切换到elastic-otel-javaagent.jar时使用。

description: Find and add Nx plugins. USE WHEN user wants to discover available plugins, install a new plugin, or add support for a specific framework or technology to the workspace.
description_zh: 查找并添加 Nx 插件。当用户需要发现可用插件、安装新插件，或为工作区添加对特定框架或技术的支持时使用。

description: Prepare meeting materials with Notion context and Codex research; use when gathering context, drafting agendas/pre-reads, and tailoring materials to attendees.
description_zh: 结合 Notion 上下文与 Codex 研究，准备会议材料；用于收集上下文、起草议程/预习材料，以及根据参会者需求定制材料。

description: Search and retrieve content from Product Hunt. Get posts, topics, users, and collections via the GraphQL API. Use when user mentions Product Hunt, PH, or product launches.
description_zh: 从Product Hunt搜索并获取内容。通过GraphQL API获取帖子、主题、用户和合集。当用户提及Product Hunt、PH或产品发布时使用。

description: Run /develop to build a feature, UI or backend, from an approved design, a page, component, API, service, or data slice. If something load bearing is undecided and no spec records it, it stops and routes you to /architect; otherwise it reads the spec plus AGENTS.md, builds, and advances the scope.
description_zh: 运行 /develop 命令，可从经批准的设计、页面、组件、API、服务或数据切片构建功能、UI 或后端。若存在尚未确定的关键承载功能，且规范中未记录相关说明，则流程将停止并跳转至 /architect；否则，它将读取规范及 AGENTS.md，完成构建，并推进项目范围。

description: MUST READ before running any ADK evaluation. ADK evaluation methodology — eval metrics, evalset schema, LLM-as-judge, tool trajectory scoring, and common failure causes. Use when evaluating agent quality, running adk eval, or debugging eval results. Do NOT use for API code patterns (use adk-cheatsheet), deployment (use adk-deploy-guide), or project scaffolding (use adk-scaffold).
description_zh: 在运行任何 ADK 评估之前必须阅读。ADK 评估方法论——评估指标、evalset schema、LLM-as-judge、工具轨迹评分，以及常见失败原因。用于评估 agent 质量、运行 adk eval 或调试评估结果。不要用于 API 代码模式（使用 adk-cheatsheet）、部署（使用 adk-deploy-guide）或项目搭建（使用 adk-scaffold）。

description: Create refined user personas from research data — 3 personas with JTBD, pains, gains, and unexpected insights. Use when building personas from survey data, creating user profiles from research, or segmenting users for product decisions.
description_zh: 从研究数据创建精炼的用户画像——3 个包含 JTBD、痛点、收益与意外洞察的用户画像。适用于从调研数据构建用户画像、基于研究创建用户档案，或为产品决策开展用户细分。

description: Implement React Three Fiber pointer events, picking, dragging, keyboard input, and camera controls. Use for scene interaction and event propagation, rather than animation or physics simulation itself.
description_zh: 实现 React Three Fiber 的指针事件、拾取、拖拽、键盘输入和相机控制。用于场景交互和事件传播，而非动画或物理模拟本身。

description: Build a tower defense: enemies pathing along lanes, wave spawning, towers that auto-target and fire, an economy, and lives. Use for a tower-defense/wave-defense game, or balancing waves and economy.
description_zh: 构建一座塔防游戏：敌人沿通道行进，波次生成，自动瞄准并射击的塔，经济系统，以及生命值。可用于塔防/波次防御游戏，或用于平衡波次与经济。

description: Internal guidance for presenting Pi helper output back to the user
description_zh: 向用户回传 Pi 辅助输出结果的内部指引

description: Generates deep links to the Arize UI for projects, traces, spans, sessions, datasets, labeling queues, evaluators, and annotation configs. Discovers organization and project IDs with the ax CLI and produces clickable URLs for sharing Arize resources with team members. Use when the user wants to link to or open a project, trace, span, session, dataset, evaluator, or annotation config in the Arize UI.
description_zh: 为项目、追踪、跨度、会话、数据集、标注队列、评估器和标注配置生成指向 Arize UI 的深度链接。通过 ax CLI 发现组织 ID 和项目 ID，并生成可点击的 URL，以便与团队成员共享 Arize 资源。当用户希望在 Arize UI 中链接到或打开项目、追踪、跨度、会话、数据集、评估器或标注配置时使用。

description: Conduct multi-round deep research on any GitHub Repo. Use when users request comprehensive analysis, timeline reconstruction, competitive analysis, or in-depth investigation of GitHub. Produces structured markdown reports with executive summaries, chronological timelines, metrics analysis, and Mermaid diagrams. Triggers on Github repository URL or open source projects.
description_zh: 对任意 GitHub 仓库进行多轮深度研究。当用户请求对 GitHub 进行综合分析、时间线重建、竞争分析或深入调查时使用。生成包含执行摘要、按时间顺序的时间线、指标分析及 Mermaid 图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。当触发 GitHub 仓库 URL 或开源项目时执行。

description: MUST READ before deploying any ADK agent. ADK deployment guide — Agent Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, CI/CD pipelines, secrets, observability, and production workflows. Use when deploying agents to Google Cloud or troubleshooting deployments. Do NOT use for API code patterns (use adk-cheatsheet), evaluation (use adk-eval-guide), or project scaffolding (use adk-scaffold).
description_zh: 部署任何 ADK 代理之前务必阅读。ADK 部署指南 —— 代理引擎、Cloud Run、GKE、CI/CD 流水线、密钥、可观测性以及生产工作流。适用于将代理部署到 Google Cloud 或排查部署问题。严禁用于 API 代码模式（请使用 adk-cheatsheet）、评估（请使用 adk-eval-guide）或项目搭建（请使用 adk-scaffold）。

description: Configures PromQL-based Service Level Objective (SLO) alerting policies for Google Cloud resources registered in App Hub or individually specified. Generates Terraform output. Use when the user asks to configure an SLO or Service Level Objective. Don't use for standard alerting policies.
description_zh: 为在 App Hub 中注册或单独指定的 Google Cloud 资源配置基于 PromQL 的服务等级目标（SLO）告警策略。生成 Terraform 输出。当用户要求配置 SLO 或服务等级目标时使用。请勿用于标准告警策略。

description: Save a site or section as local files (markdown, screenshots). Use for "download the site", offline docs, or a local copy for reference.
description_zh: 将站点或区块保存为本地文件（markdown、截图）。可用于“下载站点”、离线文档或作为参考的本地副本。

description: Build a visual novel: a branching script, character and background display, a text box with choices, save/load, backlog, and skip/auto. Use for a VN, dating sim, or branching story game.
description_zh: 制作一个视觉小说：支持分支脚本、角色与背景展示、带选项的文本框、存档与读档、待办（backlog）以及跳过与自动播放等功能。适用于VN、恋爱模拟或分支剧情游戏。

description: Build a composable CLI for Codex from API docs, an OpenAPI spec, existing curl examples, an SDK, a web app, an admin tool, or a local script. Use when the user wants Codex to create a command-line tool that can run from any repo, expose composable read/write commands, return stable JSON, manage auth, and pair with a companion skill.
description_zh: 从 API 文档、OpenAPI 规范、现有 curl 示例、SDK、Web 应用、管理工具或本地脚本构建可组合的 Codex CLI。当用户希望 Codex 创建可从任何仓库运行的命令行工具，提供可组合的读写命令，返回稳定的 JSON，管理认证，并与配套技能配对时使用。

description: Full ICP-to-leads pipeline. Describe your ideal customer in plain English and get a ranked table of enriched decision-maker leads with emails and phone numbers.
description_zh: 完整的ICP至潜在客户转化流程。用通俗易懂的英文描述您的理想客户，即可获得一份按排名排序的、经过富化处理的决策者潜在客户清单，内含电子邮件和电话号码。

description: Run a two-agent code review: spawn two fresh, clean-context agents that examine the SAME committed branch diff in parallel. One agent runs Codex's native `codex review --base` command, while the other independently reviews the code against Google's "What to look for in a code review" guidance. Merge both outputs into one agreement-ranked report. Use this whenever the user asks for "review-all", a second-opinion review, a dual review, a cross-check before a PR, or a maximum-confidence review of committed branch changes. Do not use it to APPLY fixes; it is review-only.
description_zh: 执行双智能体代码审查：启动两个全新的、上下文干净的智能体，并行检查相同的已提交分支差异。其中一个智能体运行 Codex 原生的 `codex review --base` 命令，另一个智能体则独立依据 Google 的《代码审查中需要关注的内容》指南进行代码审查。将两者的审查结果合并为一份按一致性排序的报告。当用户提出“review-all”、二次意见审查、双重审查、合并请求前的交叉检查，或对已提交分支变更进行最大置信度审查时，使用此方法。请勿将其用于应用修复；该方法仅用于审查。

description: Polish changed code when the user explicitly asks, or when an active workflow requests post-implementation simplification and risk-profiled review over a fixed file scope.
description_zh: 当用户明确要求时，或在活跃工作流要求在固定文件范围内进行实施后精简与基于风险画像的审查时，润色会修改代码。

description: Analyze and design pricing strategies including pricing models, competitive pricing analysis, willingness-to-pay estimation, and price elasticity. Use when setting prices, evaluating pricing models, preparing for a pricing change, or comparing freemium vs paid approaches.
description_zh: 分析并设计定价策略，包括定价模型、竞争定价分析、支付意愿估算以及价格弹性。适用于制定价格、评估定价模型、准备定价调整，或比较免费增值与付费方案。

description:
Register a custom LLM endpoint with your own API key for chat in Starchild.

Use when adding a personal Anthropic, OpenAI, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, Meta (Muse Spark), NEAR AI, or Venice key as a chat model (e.g. add my Claude key, register DeepSeek, use Muse Spark 1.1).
description_zh:
在 Starchild 中，使用你自己的 API Key 注册用于聊天的自定义 LLM 接口。

当将个人 Anthropic、OpenAI、Grok、Qwen、DeepSeek、Meta（Muse Spark）、NEAR AI 或 Venice 密钥作为聊天模型添加时使用（例如：添加我的 Claude 密钥、注册 DeepSeek、使用 Muse Spark 1.1）。

description: Document a business process — flowcharts, RACI, and SOPs. Use when formalizing a process that lives in someone's head, building a RACI to clarify who owns what, writing an SOP for a handoff or audit, or capturing the exceptions and edge cases of how work actually gets done.
description_zh: 记录业务流程——流程图、RACI 与 SOP。当需要将某个存在于个人脑海中的流程正式化、制定 RACI 以明确职责归属、为交接或审计编写 SOP，或记录实际工作流程中的例外情况和边界情况时使用。

description: Drive a live browser on a scraped page: click, fill forms, log in, paginate, infinite-scroll. Use when content requires interaction or a scrape failed or returned incomplete content.
description_zh: 在已抓取页面驱动实时浏览器：点击、填写表单、登录、分页、无限滚动。适用于内容需要交互，或抓取失败、或返回不完整内容的情况。

description: Engineer professional-grade brand logos using geometric primitives and negative space — generates minimalist, scalable vector-style marks via muapi.ai
description_zh: 使用几何基本图形和负空间，打造专业级品牌标志——通过 muapi.ai 生成极简、可缩放的矢量风格标志。

description: Authoritative field/schema reference for 2130 STANDARD Salesforce objects — use to look up standard sObject and Tooling field API names, types, properties (filterable/sortable/groupable/updateable), and relationship names for Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Case, ApexClass, ApexCodeCoverage, TraceFlag, and more. Load this alongside a SOQL/query/Apex skill when the field names, types, or Filter/Sort/Group capabilities are unverified — not when the fields are already known and only query syntax or optimization is needed. TRIGGER when verifying, validating, or debugging fields in a SOQL/SOSL query or DML against a standard object — capabilities, relationship/subquery paths, or what fields an object has — so the query runs instead of guessing. Custom __c objects and __c fields are NOT in these assets; describe the live org for those (sf sobject describe). DO NOT TRIGGER for authoring/deploying *-meta.xml or sfdx source (use the Metadata API skill).
description_zh: 2130 标准 Salesforce 对象的权威字段/模式参考——用于查询标准 sObject 和工具化字段的 API 名称、类型、属性（可筛选/可排序/可分组/可更新），以及 Account、Contact、Opportunity、Lead、Case、ApexClass、ApexCodeCoverage、TraceFlag 等对象的关联关系名称。当字段名称、类型或 Filter/Sort/Group 功能尚未验证时，请将此与 SOQL/查询/Apex 技能一同加载——而非当字段已明确，仅需查询语法或优化时。当在 SOQL/SOSL 查询或 DML 中针对标准对象验证、校验或调试字段（功能、关联/子查询路径，或对象包含的字段）时触发该参考，以确保查询能够正常执行而无需猜测。Custom __c 对象和 __c 字段并不包含在这些资源中；针对此类情况，请使用 sf sobject describe 描述线上组织（在编写/部署 *-meta.xml 或 sfdx 源码时，不要触发，请使用 Metadata API 技能）。

description: Internal helper contract for calling the pi-companion runtime from Claude Code
description_zh: Claude Code 调用 pi-companion 运行时的内部辅助契约

description: Generate time-windowed product pulse reports from configured signals.
description_zh: 根据配置的信号生成带时间窗口的产品脉冲报告。

description: Calculate risk-based position sizes for long stock trades. Use when user asks about position sizing, how many shares to buy, risk per trade, Kelly criterion, ATR-based sizing, fractional-share sizing, or portfolio risk allocation. Supports stop-loss distance calculation, volatility scaling, and sector concentration checks.
description_zh: 根据风险计算做多股票交易的仓位规模。当用户询问仓位规模、买入股数、每笔交易风险、凯利准则、基于ATR的仓位规模、分股仓位规模或投资组合风险分配时使用。支持止损距离计算、波动率缩放及行业集中度检查。

description: Review the current Kelos branch, or an explicitly specified PR, issue, or diff, for Kubernetes API and CRD design quality. Use when asked for a Kelos API review, CRD/API compatibility review, Kubernetes API convention review, or review of changes under api/, generated CRDs, examples/, or self-development/ manifests. Default to the current branch when no target is specified. This skill is review-only.
description_zh: 审查当前 Kelos 分支，或明确指定的 PR、issue 或 diff，以评估 Kubernetes API 和 CRD 的设计质量。当被要求进行 Kelos API 审查、CRD/API 兼容性审查、Kubernetes API 规范审查，或审查 api/、生成的 CRDs、examples/ 或 self-development/ 下的变更时使用。若未指定具体目标，则默认使用当前分支。本技能仅用于审查。

description: Edit Elementor pages and manage templates on WordPress sites via browser automation (for visual / structural changes) or WP-CLI (for safe text replacements). Use whenever the user wants to edit an Elementor page, update text in Elementor widgets, apply or manage Elementor templates, or make content changes to pages built with the Elementor page builder.
description_zh: 通过浏览器自动化（用于视觉效果/结构更改）编辑WordPress网站上的Elementor页面，或使用WP-CLI（用于安全的文本替换）管理模板。当用户需要编辑Elementor页面、更新Elementor组件中的文本、应用或管理Elementor模板，或对使用Elementor页面构建器构建的页面进行内容更改时，请使用此功能。

description: Generate personalized outreach messages using Common Room signals. Triggers on 'draft outreach to [person]', 'write an email to [name]', 'compose a message for [contact]', or any outreach drafting request.
description_zh: 使用 Common Room 信号生成个性化外联消息。触发条件为‘起草致[个人]的外联消息’、‘撰写致[姓名]的邮件’、‘为[联系人]撰写消息’，或任何外联起草请求。

description: Create dynamic, queryable dashboard views of the Obsidian vault using Obsidian Bases or Dataview. Use this skill when the user says "create a dashboard", "vault dashboard", "show all X as a table", "dynamic view", "query my vault", "build a content index", "show me all concepts/entities/projects", or wants a structured, auto-updating view of their wiki content. Bases is native to Obsidian 1.8+ (no plugin needed). Dataview requires the community plugin.
description_zh: 使用 Obsidian Bases 或 Dataview 创建 Obsidian 库的动态、可查询的仪表盘视图。当用户表示“创建仪表盘”、“库仪表盘”、“以表格形式显示所有 X”、“动态视图”、“查询我的库”、“构建内容索引”、“显示我所有的概念/实体/项目”，或希望获得其维基内容的结构化、自动更新视图时，使用此技能。Bases 是 Obsidian 1.8+ 的原生功能（无需插件）。Dataview 需要社区插件。

description: Senior software engineer who implements stories and code changes. Use when the user asks to talk to Amelia or requests the developer agent
description_zh: 高级软件工程师，负责实现用户故事（stories）和代码变更。当用户要求与 Amelia 交流或请求开发者代理时使用。

description: Enter OpenSpec explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements in a project that uses OpenSpec. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during an OpenSpec change. Also use when the user says "openspec explore" or "opsx explore".
description_zh: 进入 OpenSpec 探索模式——这是一位思考伙伴，用于在采用 OpenSpec 的项目中探索想法、调研问题、明确需求。当用户希望在 OpenSpec 变更之前或期间思考梳理某事时，请使用此模式。当用户说"openspec explore"或"opsx explore"时，也应使用此模式。

description: React Hook Form performance optimization for client-side form validation using useForm, useWatch, useController, useFieldArray, the subscribe() API, and the Watch / FormStateSubscribe / FieldArray render-prop components. Covers RHF 7.82 additions including resetDefaultValues() and the disabled field-array option. This skill should be used when building client-side controlled forms with React Hook Form library. This skill does NOT cover React 19 Server Actions, useActionState, or server-side form handling (use react-19 skill for those).
description_zh: React Hook Form 使用 useForm、useWatch、useController、useFieldArray、subscribe() API 以及 Watch、FormStateSubscribe、FieldArray render-prop 组件的客户端表单验证性能优化。涵盖 RHF 7.82 新增功能，包括 resetDefaultValues() 和 disabled 字段数组选项。当使用 React Hook Form 库构建客户端受控表单时，应使用本技能。本技能不包含 React 19 Server Actions、useActionState 或服务端表单处理（对于这些内容，请使用 react-19 技能）。

description: This skill should be used whenever users request personal assistance tasks such as schedule management, task tracking, reminder setting, habit monitoring, productivity advice, time management, or any query requiring personalized responses based on user preferences and context. On first use, collects comprehensive user information including schedule, working habits, preferences, goals, and routines. Maintains an intelligent database that automatically organizes and prioritizes information, keeping relevant data and discarding outdated context.
description_zh: 该技能应在用户请求个人辅助任务时启用，例如日程管理、任务跟踪、提醒设置、习惯监测、生产力建议、时间管理，或任何需基于用户偏好与情境提供个性化回复的查询。首次使用时，会收集涵盖日程、工作习惯、偏好、目标及日常在内的全面用户信息。系统维护一个智能数据库，该数据库能自动组织并优先处理信息，保留相关信息并剔除过时上下文。

description: Read, generate, and adjust PowerPoint slides, layouts, and templates. Useful for executive decks, training material, and product reviews.
description_zh: 读取、生成并调整 PowerPoint 幻灯片、版式及模板。适用于高管演示文稿、培训材料及产品评测。

description: Use when asking about Rust versions or crate info. Keywords: latest version, what's new, changelog, Rust 1.x, Rust release, stable, nightly, crate info, crates.io, lib.rs, docs.rs, API documentation, crate features, dependencies, which crate, what version, Rust edition, edition 2021, edition 2024, cargo add, cargo update, 最新版本, 版本号, 稳定版, 最新, 哪个版本, crate 信息, 文档, 依赖, Rust 版本, 新特性, 有什么特性
description_zh: 用于询问 Rust 版本或 crate 信息时使用。关键词：最新版本、有什么新内容、更新日志、Rust 1.x、Rust 版本发布、稳定版、nightly、crate 信息、crates.io、lib.rs、docs.rs、API 文档、crate 特性、依赖、哪个 crate、什么版本、Rust 版本规范、edition 2021、edition 2024、cargo add、cargo update、最新版本、版本号、稳定版、最新、哪个版本、crate 信息、文档、依赖、Rust 版本、新特性、有什么特性

description: Research a specific person using Common Room data. Triggers on 'who is [name]', 'look up [email]', 'research [contact]', 'is [name] a warm lead', or any contact-level question.
description_zh: 使用 Common Room 数据研究特定个人。触发条件为 “谁是 [name]”、 “查找 [email]”、 “研究 [contact]”、 “[name] 是否是意向客户” 或任何涉及联系人的问题。

description: Break requirements into epics and user stories. Use when the user says "create the epics and stories list"
description_zh: 将需求拆分为史诗和用户故事。当用户说“创建史诗和故事列表”时使用。

description: 为一个或多个项目建立、运行和管理长期 Agent 队伍。适用于初始化长期自主工作、按项目 cron 计划持续推进 Story、查看或调整 Story 看板，以及处理人类输入。
description_zh: 为一个或多个项目建立、运行和管理长期 Agent 队伍。适用于初始化长期自主工作、按项目 cron 计划持续推进 Story、查看或调整 Story 看板，以及处理人类输入。

description: Propose a new OpenSpec change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation. Also use when the user says "openspec propose" or "opsx propose".
description_zh: 提议一次完成所有产物生成的全新 OpenSpec 变更。适用于用户希望快速描述其构建需求，并立即获得包含设计、规范及任务在内的完整提案以供实施的情形。同时适用于用户输入“openspec propose”或“opsx propose”时。

description: Comprehensive PM resume review and tailoring against 10 best practices including XYZ+S formula, keyword optimization, job-specific tailoring, and structure. Use when reviewing a PM resume, preparing for job applications, or improving resume impact.
description_zh: 全面审查和定制PM简历，遵循10项最佳实践，包括XYZ+S公式、关键词优化、岗位针对性定制和结构。适用于审查PM简历、准备求职申请，或提升简历影响力。

description: Bootstrap a modular AI agent with OpenRouter SDK, extensible hooks, and optional Ink TUI
description_zh: 使用 OpenRouter SDK、可扩展钩子和可选 Ink TUI，搭建一个模块化的 AI 智能体。

description: Autonomously research a topic via multi-round web search, synthesize findings, and file structured results into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user says "/wiki-research [topic]", "research X", "find everything about Y", "do a deep dive on Z", "autonomous research on X", or wants comprehensive, web-sourced knowledge on a topic filed directly into their wiki.
description_zh: 通过多轮网络搜索自主研究主题，综合研究发现，并将结构化结果存入 Obsidian wiki。当用户输入“/wiki-research [主题]”、“研究 X”、“查找关于 Y 的所有信息”、“对 Z 进行深度探究”、“对 X 进行自主研究”，或需要关于某个主题的全面、有网络来源的知识并直接存入其 wiki 时，使用此技能。

description: Business analyst for market research, competitive analysis, and requirements. Use when the user asks to talk to Mary or requests the business analyst
description_zh: 负责市场调研、竞争分析及需求分析的业务分析师。当用户要求与玛丽交谈或请求业务分析师时使用。

description: MUST READ before setting up observability for ADK agents or when analyzing production traffic, debugging agent behavior, or improving agent performance. ADK observability guide — Cloud Trace, prompt-response logging, BigQuery Agent Analytics, third-party integrations, and troubleshooting. Use when configuring monitoring, tracing, or logging for agents, or when understanding how a deployed agent handles real traffic.
description_zh: 必读：在为 ADK 代理配置可观测性之前，或在分析生产流量、调试代理行为、优化代理性能时阅读。ADK 可观测性指南 — Cloud Trace、提示-响应日志、BigQuery 代理分析、第三方集成与排障。适用于为代理配置监控、追踪或日志记录，或理解已部署代理如何处理真实流量。

description: Bootstrap, develop, and design modern WinUI 3 desktop applications with C# and the Windows App SDK using official Microsoft guidance, WinUI Gallery patterns, Windows App SDK samples, and CommunityToolkit components. Use when creating a brand new app, preparing a machine for WinUI, reviewing, refactoring, planning, troubleshooting, environment-checking, or setting up WinUI 3 XAML, controls, navigation, windowing, theming, accessibility, responsiveness, performance, deployment, or related Windows app design and development work.
description_zh: 使用 C# 与 Windows App SDK，依托微软官方指导、WinUI 画廊模式、Windows App SDK 示例及 CommunityToolkit 组件，构建、开发并设计现代 WinUI 3 桌面应用程序。适用于创建全新应用、为 WinUI 准备设备环境、开展评审、重构、规划、故障排查、环境检查，以及配置 WinUI 3 的 XAML、控件、导航、窗口管理、主题、无障碍、响应式、性能、部署，或进行相关 Windows 应用设计与开发工作。

description: Generate user-facing release notes from tickets, PRDs, or changelogs. Creates clear, engaging summaries organized by category (new features, improvements, fixes). Use when writing release notes, creating changelogs, announcing product updates, or summarizing what shipped.
description_zh: 从工单、产品需求文档（PRDs）或变更日志生成面向用户的发布说明。创建按类别（新功能、改进、修复）组织的清晰、引人入胜的摘要。在编写发布说明、创建变更日志、宣布产品更新或总结已发布内容时使用。

description: Use TinyFish for web search, fetching URLs, reading pages, current information, source-backed answers, research, docs, pricing/product pages, extraction, scraping, and browser automation. Use whenever the user asks to search, find, look up, research, compare, get information from the web, summarize a URL, fetch page content, or automate a website.
description_zh: 使用 TinyFish 执行网页搜索、URL 获取、页面阅读、当前信息获取、基于来源的解答、研究、文档、定价/产品页面、内容提取、数据采集与浏览器自动化。当用户要求搜索、查找、查询、研究、比较、从网络获取信息、对 URL 进行总结、获取页面内容或自动化网站时，请使用 TinyFish。

description: Use when adding Auth0 authentication to any app and unsure which SDK or skill to use. Detects the project's framework and routes to the right setup workflow — use this as the entry point even if the user just says "add login to my app" or "set up Auth0" without naming a framework.
description_zh: 当向任何应用添加 Auth0 认证，并不确定应使用哪个 SDK 或技能时，可使用本功能。它会自动检测项目的框架，并路由至正确的设置流程——即使用户仅表示“为我的应用添加登录”或“设置 Auth0”，而未指明框架，也请将此作为入口点使用。

description: Blender to web export workflows for 3D models and animations. Use this skill when exporting Blender models to glTF for web, optimizing 3D assets for Three.js or Babylon.js, batch processing models with Python scripts, automating Blender workflows, or creating web-ready 3D pipelines. Triggers on tasks involving Blender glTF export, bpy scripting, 3D asset optimization, model compression, texture baking, or Blender automation. Exports models for threejs-webgl, react-three-fiber, and babylonjs-engine skills.
description_zh: 面向 3D 模型与动画的 Blender 网页导出工作流程。当需要将 Blender 模型导出为网页 glTF、优化用于 Three.js 或 Babylon.js 的 3D 资产、使用 Python 脚本批量处理模型、自动化 Blender 工作流，或创建面向网页的 3D 流水线时，使用此技能。适用于涉及 Blender glTF 导出、bpy 脚本编程、3D 资产优化、模型压缩、纹理烘焙或 Blender 自动化的任务。导出模型以支持 threejs-webgl、react-three-fiber 和 babylonjs-engine 技能。

description: Convert a local file (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, …) to markdown, or answer questions about its content. Use whenever the input is a file path, not a URL.
description_zh: 将本地文件（PDF、DOCX、XLSX、HTML、…）转换为 Markdown，或回答其内容相关问题。当输入为文件路径而非 URL 时使用。

description: Color-code the Obsidian graph view by rewriting `.obsidian/graph.json` colorGroups. Use this skill when the user says "color my graph", "color code obsidian", "colorize the graph", "color the graph by tag", "color by category", "highlight visibility in graph", "make the graph colorful", "distinguish tags in graph", or wants nodes in Obsidian's graph view tinted by tag, folder, or visibility. Generates a `colorGroups` array from the vault's actual tags/categories and merges it into the existing graph.json without clobbering other graph settings. Always backs up first.
description_zh: 通过重写 `.obsidian/graph.json` 中的 `colorGroups`，对 Obsidian 图形视图进行颜色编码。当用户说“color my graph”、“color code obsidian”、“colorize the graph”、“color the graph by tag”、“color by category”、“highlight visibility in graph”、“make the graph colorful”、“distinguish tags in graph”，或者希望 Obsidian 图形视图中的节点按标签、文件夹或可见性进行着色时，请使用此技能。该技能从仓库的实际标签/类别生成 `colorGroups` 数组，并将其合并到现有的 `graph.json` 中，同时不会覆盖其他图形设置。始终先进行备份。

description: Update ElevenLabs agent skills from a merged weekly changelog in elevenlabs-dx, then open a pull request in elevenlabs/skills. Trigger after a changelog merges to main on elevenlabs-dx, or when asked to update skills from changelog YYYY-MM-DD.
description_zh: 从 elevenlabs-dx 合并后的每周更新日志更新 ElevenLabs 智能体技能，然后在 elevenlabs/skills 中发起拉取请求。当 elevenlabs-dx 中的更新日志合并到 main 后触发，或当要求根据更新日志 YYYY-MM-DD 更新技能时触发。

description: Spin up a single agent as an advisor — second opinion on the current task. Use when the user says "advisor", "second opinion", "what does X think", or wants an outside take without delegating the work itself.
description_zh: 启动单个智能体作为顾问——对当前任务的第二意见。当用户说“顾问”、“第二意见”、“X 认为什么”，或希望获得外部观点但无需将工作本身委托出去时使用。

description: Apply Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to artifacts for consistent visual identity and professional design standards. A reference for shaping your own.
description_zh: 应用 Anthropic 的官方品牌颜色和字体到作品，以实现一致的视觉身份和专业设计标准。作为塑造自身设计的参考。

description: Help users understand and respond to competition. Use when someone is positioning against competitors, evaluating market threats, running competitive war games, or deciding how much to focus on competitors versus customers.
description_zh: 帮助用户理解并应对竞争。适用于当用户需要针对竞争对手进行定位、评估市场威胁、开展竞争对抗演练，或决定在竞争对手与客户之间如何分配精力时使用。

description: Guide users through creating a new plugin from scratch in a cowork session. Use when users want to create a plugin, build a plugin, make a new plugin, develop a plugin, scaffold a plugin, start a plugin from scratch, or design a plugin. This skill requires Cowork mode with access to the outputs directory for delivering the final .plugin file.
description_zh: 指导用户在工作协作（Cowork）会话中从零开始创建新插件。当用户需要创建插件、构建插件、制作新插件、开发插件、搭建插件、从零开始启动插件或设计插件时，使用此技能。该技能需要启用 Cowork 模式，并具备访问输出目录的权限，以交付最终的 .plugin 文件。

description: Draft blog posts, social media, email newsletters, landing pages, press releases, and case studies with channel-specific formatting and SEO recommendations. Use when writing any marketing content, when you need headline or subject line options, or when adapting a message for a specific platform, audience, and brand voice.
description_zh: 可起草博客文章、社交媒体内容、电子邮件通讯、落地页、新闻稿和案例研究，并采用渠道特定格式与SEO建议。适用于撰写任何营销内容、需要标题或主题行选项，或将信息调整为适合特定平台、受众及品牌语气时。

description: A Claude Code plugin that displays a real-time HUD showing context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress in your terminal statusline.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，可在终端状态栏实时显示抬头显示（HUD），展示上下文使用量、活动工具、运行中的代理和待办事项进度。

description: Use when building web services. Keywords: web server, HTTP, REST API, GraphQL, WebSocket, axum, actix, warp, rocket, tower, hyper, reqwest, middleware, router, handler, extractor, state management, authentication, authorization, JWT, session, cookie, CORS, rate limiting, web 开发, HTTP 服务, API 设计, 中间件, 路由
description_zh:
构建 Web 服务时使用。
关键词：Web 服务器, HTTP, REST API, GraphQL, WebSocket, axum, actix, warp, rocket, tower, hyper, reqwest, 中间件, 路由, 处理器, 提取器, 状态管理, 身份验证, 授权, JWT, 会话, Cookie, CORS, 速率限制, web 开发, HTTP 服务, API 设计, 中间件, 路由

description: Archive a completed OpenSpec change in the experimental workflow. Use when the user wants to finalize and archive a change after implementation is complete. Also use when the user says "openspec archive" or "opsx archive".
description_zh: 在实验工作流中归档已完成的 OpenSpec 变更。当用户希望在实现完成后对变更进行最终确认并归档时使用。当用户提及“openspec archive”或“opsx archive”时，也使用。

description: Estimate market size using TAM, SAM, and SOM with top-down and bottom-up approaches. Use when sizing a market opportunity, estimating addressable market, preparing for investor pitches, or evaluating market entry.
description_zh: 采用自上而下与自下而上的方法，利用总可寻址市场（TAM）、可服务可寻址市场（SAM）和可获取可服务市场（SOM）来估算市场规模。适用于评估市场机会规模、估算可寻址市场、为投资者路演做准备或评估市场进入的场景。

description: Use when creating or maintaining OpenCLI site sitemaps: agent-facing navigation, page-state, action, workflow, API-reference, pitfall, and fallback knowledge for a website. Use after browser exploration discovers durable site context, when a sitemap is stale, or when promoting local site knowledge into the repo.
description_zh: 用于创建或维护 OpenCLI 站点网站地图：需包含面向智能体的网站导航、页面状态、操作、工作流、API 参考、常见陷阱及兜底知识。在浏览器探索发现持久站点上下文、网站地图已过时，或将本地站点知识推广至代码仓库时使用。

description: This skill retrieves upcoming earnings announcements for US stocks using the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API. Use this when the user requests earnings calendar data, wants to know which companies are reporting earnings in the upcoming week, or needs a weekly earnings review. The skill focuses on mid-cap and above companies (over $2B market cap) that have significant market impact, organizing the data by date and timing in a clean markdown table format. Supports multiple environments (CLI, Desktop, Web) with flexible API key management.
description_zh: 本技能利用 Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API 获取美股即将发布的财报公告。当用户需要财报日历数据、查询即将到来的周有哪些公司发布财报，或需要每周财报回顾时，请使用本技能。该技能聚焦于市值超过20亿美元的中盘及以上公司（即市值超20亿美元），此类公司对市场具有显著影响力，并将数据按日期与时间整理为清晰的Markdown表格。支持多种运行环境（CLI、桌面端、Web端），并具备灵活的API密钥管理能力。

description: Color science expert skill with 286K words of reference material covering OKLCH/OKLAB, palette generation, accessibility/contrast, color naming, pigment mixing, and historical color theory.
description_zh: 色彩科学专家技能，拥有涵盖 OKLCH/OKLAB、配色生成、无障碍/对比度、色彩命名、颜料混合及历史色彩理论的 286,000 词参考资料。

description: Opinionated, evolving constraints to guide agents when building interfaces. Useful for keeping output coherent across many small UI pieces.
description_zh: 以带有明确立场且持续演进的约束引导智能体构建界面。适用于在众多小型 UI 组件中保持输出的一致与连贯。

description: Multi search engine integration with 17 engines (8 CN + 9 Global). Supports advanced search operators, time filters, site search, privacy engines, and WolframAlpha knowledge queries. No API keys required.
description_zh: 支持集成17个搜索引擎（8个中国及9个全球）。支持高级搜索运算符、时间筛选、网站搜索、隐私搜索引擎以及WolframAlpha知识查询，无需API密钥。

description: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks. Also use when the user says "openspec apply", "opsx apply", or "openspec implement".
description_zh: 从 OpenSpec 变更中实现任务。在用户希望开始实现、继续实现或处理任务时使用。当用户说“openspec apply”、“opsx apply”或“openspec implement”时，也使用。

description: Check the current status of the Strait of Hormuz — shipping transit data, oil price impact, stranded vessels, insurance risk levels, diplomatic developments, and global trade impact. Use this skill whenever the user asks about the Strait of Hormuz, Hormuz chokepoint, Persian Gulf shipping risk, oil transit disruption, war risk premium in the Gulf, Middle East shipping routes, tanker traffic through Hormuz, oil supply chain risk, or geopolitical risk affecting energy markets. Triggers include: "Hormuz status", "Strait of Hormuz", "is Hormuz open", "shipping through the Gulf", "oil chokepoint", "Persian Gulf tanker traffic", "war risk premium", "Hormuz crisis", "energy supply chain risk", "oil transit disruption", "Middle East shipping", any mention of Hormuz or Persian Gulf in context of oil, shipping, or geopolitical risk.
description_zh: 检查霍尔木兹海峡的当前状态——航运过境数据、油价影响、搁浅船舶、保险风险水平、外交动态和全球贸易影响。每当用户询问霍尔木兹海峡、霍尔木兹咽喉要道、波斯湾航运风险、石油运输中断、海湾战争风险溢价、中东航运航线、通过霍尔木兹海峡的油轮流量、石油供应链风险或影响能源市场的地缘政治风险时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：“霍尔木兹海峡状态”、“霍尔木兹海峡”、“霍尔木兹海峡是否开放”、“穿越海湾的航运”、“石油咽喉要道”、“波斯湾油轮流量”、“战争风险溢价”、“霍尔木兹危机”、“能源供应链风险”、“石油运输中断”、“中东航运”，以及任何提及霍尔木兹或波斯湾与石油、航运或地缘政治风险相关的表述。

description: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.
description_zh: 在发现自己再次重复相同的指令，或察觉到反复出现的修正时，应用该规则。将规则编码为 lint、元数据标记、运行时检查或脚本，而非更多文本。

description: Publish or update a game on Steam with Steamworks and SteamPipe: configure depots and packages, upload builds with steamcmd, set a build live on a branch, and run the release checklists. Use for Steam publishing, app_build.vdf/steamcmd uploads, depots, beta branches, or a store page release.
description_zh: 使用 Steamworks 和 SteamPipe 在 Steam 上发布或更新游戏：配置仓库和包，使用 steamcmd 上传构建，在分支上将构建发布上线，并运行发布检查清单。适用于 Steam 发布、app_build.vdf/steamcmd 上传、仓库、测试分支或商店页面发布。

description: Design, implement, or critique website and web-app UX/UI: information structure, user flows, responsive layouts, visual systems, content, and interaction states. Use for a requested interface or visual-design change; do not expand a small component edit into an unrequested product redesign.
description_zh: 设计、实现或评审网站与网页应用的 UX/UI：涵盖信息结构、用户流程、响应式布局、视觉系统、内容及交互状态。用于满足请求的界面或视觉设计变更；不得将小型组件的修改扩展为未经请求的产品重新设计。

description: Find and remove AI slop — the generic, machine-default visual and copy tics of vibe-coded products — from a web project. Use when the user asks to "kill AI slop", "de-slop", "remove the AI look", "make this not look AI-generated", or clean up a landing page / UI / docs that feels templated. Detects and fixes the catalogue of tells: indigo→violet gradients, gradient-clip headlines, the default semantic palette, one-hue status boxes, atmospheric gradients, serif-italic emphasis, highlighted keywords, AI copywriting voice ("not just X — it's Y"), emoji everywhere, glowing status dots, wobbling spinners, colored-left-border callouts, pastel icon tiles, glassmorphism, over-rounding, oversized shadows, borders that die at corners, badge & pill spam, AI-drawn SVG icons, kickers over every heading, flat type hierarchies, invented stat rows, 01/02/03 section markers, cards nested in cards, the default Inter/Space Grotesk look, and more. Works on HTML/CSS, React/Vue/Svelte/Astro, Tailwind, PHP, and Markdown copy.
description_zh:
**查找并移除 AI 杂烩 —— 去除氛围感产品中通用、由机器默认生成的视觉与文案特征**

**适用场景**：当用户要求"杀死 AI 杂烩"、"去杂烩"、"移除 AI 外观"、"让内容看起来不像 AI 生成的"，或需清理感觉被模板化的落地页 / UI / 文档时使用。

**检测并修复的特征清单**：包含靛蓝→紫色渐变、渐变裁剪标题、默认语义色板、单色状态框、氛围渐变、衬线斜体强调、高亮关键词、AI 文案语气（"不只是 X —— 它是 Y"）、到处使用的表情符号、发光的状态圆点、晃动的加载圈、彩色左边框提示框、柔和色调图标瓦片、毛玻璃效果、过度圆角、过大的阴影、在角落处渐隐的边框、徽章与胶囊标签堆砌、AI 绘制的 SVG 图标、每个标题上方的多余引导文字、扁平化的字号层级、编造的统计数据行、01/02/03 章节标记、嵌套的卡片、默认的 Inter/Space Grotesk 外观，以及更多。

**适用技术**：支持 HTML/CSS、React/Vue/Svelte/Astro、Tailwind、PHP 及 Markdown 文案。

description: Creates, reads, updates, and deletes Arize AI integrations that store LLM provider credentials used by evaluators and other Arize features. Supports any LLM provider (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Gemini, NVIDIA NIM). Use when the user mentions AI integration, LLM provider credentials, create integration, list integrations, update credentials, delete integration, or connecting an LLM provider to Arize.
description_zh: 创建、读取、更新和删除 Arize AI 集成，该集成存储供评估器及其他 Arize 功能使用的 LLM 提供商凭据。支持任何 LLM 提供商（例如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Azure OpenAI、AWS Bedrock、Vertex AI、Gemini、NVIDIA NIM）。当用户提及 AI 集成、LLM 提供商凭据、创建集成、列出集成、更新凭据、删除集成，或将 LLM 提供商连接到 Arize 时使用。

description: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'
description_zh: 任务完成后，在宣告完成前应用。依据真实产物（运行功能，读取实际值，检查 diff），而非代理、自我报告或'编译通过'。

description: Authors and edits AWS Step Functions state machines: writes Amazon States Language (ASL) in JSONata, and chooses and structures state types (Task, Choice, Map, Parallel, Pass, Wait, Succeed, Fail). Covers ASL syntax, JSONata data transformation and variables, Retry/Catch error handling, service integrations (.sync, waitForTaskToken callbacks), Distributed Map for large-scale S3/CSV processing, saga/compensation patterns, Standard vs Express workflow choice, TestState API unit testing, and migrating state machines from JSONPath to JSONata. Use when the user is building, authoring, debugging, or migrating a Step Functions state machine or ASL definition, or orchestrating multi-step workflows with branching, retries, or human-approval callbacks, even if they don't say 'Step Functions.' Do NOT use for general Lambda function code, API Gateway, EventBridge wiring, or SAM/CDK application packaging.
description_zh: 作者并编辑 AWS 步骤函数（Step Functions）状态机：以 JSONata 编写 Amazon 状态语言（ASL），并选择和构建状态类型（任务、选择、映射、并行、传递、等待、成功、失败）。涵盖 ASL 语法、JSONata 数据转换与变量、重试/捕获错误处理、服务集成（.sync、waitForTaskToken 回调）、用于大规模 S3/CSV 处理的分布式映射、Saga/补偿模式、标准版与 Express 工作流选择、TestState API 单元测试，以及将状态机从 JSONPath 迁移至 JSONata。适用于用户构建、编写、调试或迁移 Step Functions 状态机或 ASL 定义，或编排包含分支、重试或人工审批回调的多步骤工作流的情况，即使用户未提及“Step Functions”。**不可**用于通用 Lambda 函数代码、API Gateway、EventBridge 连线，或 SAM/CDK 应用打包。

description: Complete file handling including upload flows, serving files via URL, storing generated files from actions, deletion, and accessing file metadata from system tables
description_zh: 完成文件处理，包括上传流程、通过URL提供文件、存储操作生成的文件、删除以及从系统表访问文件元数据。

description: Create beautiful visual art in PNG and PDF documents using design philosophy and aesthetic principles for posters, illustrations, and static pieces.
description_zh: 运用设计理念与审美原则，在 PNG 和 PDF 文档中为海报、插画和静态作品创作精美的视觉艺术作品。

description: Programmatic video creation with React. Useful for branded explainers, social cuts, dashboards-to-video, and reproducible motion graphics.
description_zh: 使用 React 进行程序化视频创作。适用于品牌解说视频、社交媒体剪辑、仪表板转视频，以及可复现的动态图形。

description: Create a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, and org context. Use when preparing for interviews, competitive analysis, partnerships, or market-entry work.
description_zh: 创建公司研究简报，包含高管引述、产品战略与组织背景。适用于准备面试、竞争分析、合作或市场进入等工作。

description:
Plan-then-execute implementation against SPEC.md. Native single-thread
loop, no sub-agents. On test or build failure, auto-invokes the backprop
skill before retrying — a failed verification always considers whether
a new §V invariant would prevent recurrence. Triggers when the user asks
to build, implement, execute the spec, or tackle a specific §T task
(`build §T.3`, `build --next`, `implement next task`, `run the build`).
Expects SPEC.md to exist; if not, defers to the spec skill.
description_zh: 针对 SPEC.md 进行先计划后执行的实现。采用原生单线程循环，无子代理。在测试或构建失败时，于重试前自动调用反向传播技能——失败的验证始终需考量新的 §V 不变量是否会防止问题复发。当用户要求构建、实现、执行规范或处理特定 §T 任务（如 `build §T.3`、`build --next`、`实现下一个任务`、`run the build`）时即触发。要求 SPEC.md 必须存在；若不存在，则转交规范技能处理。

description: Implement animated effects, transitions, and motion in Flutter apps. Useful for native iOS/Android motion design.
description_zh: 在 Flutter 应用中实现动画效果、过渡效果与动效。适用于原生 iOS/Android 动效设计。

description: Self-improving browser automation via the auto-research loop. Iteratively runs a browsing task, reads the trace, and improves the navigation skill (strategy.md) until it reliably passes. Supports parallel runs across multiple tasks using sub-agents. Use when you want to build or improve browser automation skills for specific website tasks.
description_zh: 通过自动研究循环实现自我改进的浏览器自动化。迭代执行浏览任务，读取追踪记录，并改进导航技能（strategy.md），直至可靠地通过。支持使用子代理跨多个任务并行运行。当你需要为特定网站任务构建或改进浏览器自动化技能时使用。

description: Analyze compensation — benchmarking, band placement, and equity modeling. Trigger with "what should we pay a [role]", "is this offer competitive", "model this equity grant", or when uploading comp data to find outliers and retention risks.
description_zh: 分析薪酬——对标分析、岗位职级定位与股权建模。可通过“我们为[岗位]支付多少合适”、“该offer是否具有竞争力”、“对该股权授予进行建模”等语句触发，或在上传薪酬数据以查找异常值与留存风险时使用。

description: CSS, JavaScript, and HTML coding standards for Shopify Liquid themes. Covers BEM naming inside stylesheet tags, design tokens, CSS custom properties, Web Components for themes, defensive CSS, and progressive enhancement. Use when writing CSS/JS/HTML in .liquid files or theme asset files.
description_zh: Shopify Liquid 主题的 CSS、JavaScript 和 HTML 编码规范。涵盖样式表标签中的 BEM 命名、设计令牌、CSS 自定义属性、主题 Web Components、防御性 CSS 及渐进增强。适用于在 .liquid 文件或主题资源文件中编写 CSS/JS/HTML 时使用。

description: Selects, reviews, and migrates Apple-platform app architectures across MV with Observation, MVVM, MVI, TCA, Clean Architecture, Coordinator, and legacy VIPER. Use when choosing module and dependency boundaries, escalating a feature beyond simple SwiftUI MV, planning incremental architecture migration, or auditing state ownership and test seams.
description_zh: 在MV架构中，选择、审查并迁移基于观察者、MVVM、MVI、TCA、干净架构、协调器及遗留VIPER架构的Apple平台应用架构。在需要确定模块与依赖边界、将功能从简单的SwiftUI MV架构进行升级、规划渐进式架构迁移，或审计状态归属与测试接口时使用。

description: Set up a new Obsidian knowledge base with the LLM Wiki pattern. Use when the user wants to create a second brain, initialize a vault, set up a personal knowledge base, or says "onboard". Guides through an interactive wizard to configure vault name, location, domain, agent support, and tooling.
description_zh: 使用 LLM Wiki 模式搭建一个新的 Obsidian 知识库。当用户想要创建第二大脑、初始化仓库、设置个人知识库，或说“onboard”时使用。通过交互式向导引导用户配置仓库名称、位置、域名、智能体支持及工具链。

description: Create a change management request with impact analysis and rollback plan. Use when proposing a system or process change that needs approval, preparing a change record for CAB review, documenting risk and rollback steps before a deployment, or planning stakeholder communications for a rollout.
description_zh: 创建包含影响分析和回滚计划的变更管理请求。用于提出需要批准的变更（系统或流程变更）、为 CAB 审查准备变更记录、部署前记录风险及回滚步骤，以及规划发布推广阶段的相关方沟通。

description: Run /debug to find and fix a bug's root cause: a test failing for an unclear reason, /check verify finding a failure, or behavior being wrong. Runs a reproduce, localize, hypothesize, test, fix, verify loop, makes the minimal fix, and hands a regression test to /test. No features, no extra refactors.
description_zh: 运行 /debug 以查找并修复缺陷的根本原因：测试因不明原因而失败、/check 验证发现失败，或行为不正确的情况。执行复现、定位、假设、测试、修复、验证循环，进行最小化修复，并将回归测试提交给 /test。不新增功能，不额外重构。

description:
Create, amend, or backprop bugs into SPEC.md at repo root. Sole mutator
of the project spec. Triggers when the user asks to write a spec, start
a new spec, distill a spec from existing code, add invariants, amend
sections (§G, §C, §I, §V, §T, §B), or record a bug via backprop.
Common phrasings: "write the spec for...", "new spec", "bug: ...",
"amend §V.3", "distill spec from code", "spec this idea". Reads and
