follows FORMAT.md for the caveman encoding rules and pipe-table shape
of §T and §B.
description_zh:
在仓库根目录的 SPEC.md 中创建、修改或通过反向传播记录缺陷（bug）。项目规范的唯一修改者。当用户要求编写规范、启动新规范、从现有代码提炼规范、添加不变量、修改章节（§G、§C、§I、§V、§T、§B），或通过反向传播记录缺陷时触发。

常见表述：“为……编写规范”、“新规范”、“缺陷：……”、“修订 §V.3”、“从代码提炼规范”、“为这个想法制定规范”。阅读并遵循 FORMAT.md，以获取 caveman 编码规则以及 §T 和 §B 的管道表结构。

description: Automatically monitors OKX Flash Earn, Fixed Earn and Flexible Earn opportunities, sends push notifications, and guides subscription. 自动监控 OKX 闪赚、定期和活期赚币机会，推送通知并引导申购。Use when user says: 有闪赚通知我, 监控赚币, monitor earn, notify me about earn, 定时检查理财, 执行 earn-hunter 扫描, earn-hunter scan, 活期年化高了通知我, 监控活期.
description_zh: 自动监控 OKX 闪赚、定期和活期赚币机会，推送通知并引导申购。适用场景：当用户说“有闪赚通知我”“监控赚币”“monitor earn”“notify me about earn”“定时检查理财”“执行 earn-hunter 扫描”“earn-hunter scan”“活期年化高了通知我”“监控活期”时使用。

description: Visualize Rust project dependencies as ASCII art. Triggers on: /deps-viz, dependency graph, show dependencies, visualize deps, 依赖图, 依赖可视化, 显示依赖
description_zh: 将 Rust 项目的依赖关系以 ASCII 艺术形式可视化。触发条件：/deps-viz、dependency graph、show dependencies、visualize deps、依赖图、依赖可视化、显示依赖

description: Manages iOS Simulator devices and app tests with xcrun simctl: lifecycle, install/launch, push and location simulation, privacy permissions, deep links, status-bar overrides, screenshots/video, log streaming, app containers, and targetEnvironment(simulator). Use when scripting Simulator workflows, debugging CoreSimulator boot failures, or deciding which hardware, performance, networking, memory-pressure, and security behaviors require a physical device.
description_zh: 使用 xcrun simctl 管理 iOS 模拟器设备及应用测试：生命周期、安装/启动、推送与定位模拟、隐私权限、深链接、状态栏覆盖、截图/视频、日志流传输、应用容器，以及 targetEnvironment(sup器等模拟器)。用于脚本化模拟器工作流、调试 CoreSimulator 启动失败，或决定哪些硬件、性能、网络、内存压力及安全行为需要物理设备时。

description: Use when the user wants to update, refresh, or reinstall the CopilotKit agent SKILLS (the SKILL.md files that teach this agent about CopilotKit). NOT for updating the CopilotKit codebase or project — this is specifically about refreshing the skills/knowledge this agent has loaded. Triggers on "update copilotkit skills", "update skills", "refresh skills", "skills are stale", "skills are outdated", "get latest skills", "my copilotkit knowledge is wrong", "copilotkit APIs changed", "skills seem old", "wrong API names", "reinstall skills", "skills not working right", "update your copilotkit knowledge".
description_zh: 当用户需要更新、刷新或重新安装 CopilotKit 智能体 SKILLS（即教授该智能体了解 CopilotKit 的 SKILL.md 文件）时使用。不用于更新 CopilotKit 代码库或项目——此用途专门针对刷新该智能体已加载的技能/知识。适用于以下触发情形：“update copilotkit skills”、“update skills”、“refresh skills”、“skills are stale”、“skills are outdated”、“get latest skills”、“my copilotkit knowledge is wrong”、“copilotkit APIs changed”、“skills seem old”、“wrong API names”、“reinstall skills”、“skills not working right”、“update your copilotkit knowledge”。

description: Use for "interrogate", "adversarial review", "multi-model review", "challenge this", "stress test this code", "find blind spots", or "tear this apart". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge changes from independent angles.
description_zh: 适用于"深度审查"、"对抗性审查"、"多模型审查"、"质疑此内容"、"对该代码进行压力测试"、"查找盲点"或"深入拆解此内容"。多个大语言模型审查员会从不同的角度对变更内容提出挑战。

description: Implement web accessibility (a11y) best practices following WCAG guidelines to create inclusive, accessible user interfaces.
description_zh: 遵循 WCAG 指南，实施网页无障碍（a11y）最佳实践，以创建包容、可访问的用户界面。

description: Customize a Claude Code plugin for a specific organization's tools and workflows. Use when: customize plugin, set up plugin, configure plugin, tailor plugin, adjust plugin settings, customize plugin connectors, customize plugin skill, tweak plugin, modify plugin configuration.
description_zh:
为特定组织的工具与工作流定制 Claude Code 插件。

适用场景：
- 定制插件
- 设置插件
- 配置插件
- 量身定制插件
- 调整插件设置
- 定制插件连接器
- 定制插件技能
- 微调插件
- 修改插件配置

description: Use this skill when users need to create, generate, or validate Salesforce Lightning Report metadata. Trigger when users mention reports, creating reports, report metadata, .report-meta.xml files, tabular reports, summary reports, matrix reports, joined reports, report columns, report groupings, report filters, report charts, cross-filters, bucket fields, report formulas, or report time frame filters. Also use when users say things like 'create a report', 'generate a report', 'build a report on Accounts', 'add a chart to my report', or when they encounter deployment errors for .report-meta.xml files. Do NOT trigger for: creating or modifying Custom Report Type metadata (.reportType-meta.xml — use platform-custom-report-type-generate), creating dashboards, creating list views, running or viewing existing reports in the UI, or SOQL queries.
description_zh: 使用此技能当用户需要创建、生成或验证 Salesforce Lightning 报告元数据时。当用户提及报告、创建报告、报告元数据、.report-meta.xml 文件、表格报告、汇总报告、矩阵报告、联合报告、报告列、报告分组、报告筛选器、报告图表、跨筛选器、分桶字段、报告公式或报告时间范围筛选器时触发。当用户说诸如“创建报告”、“生成报告”、“在 Accounts 上构建报告”、“为我的报告添加图表”等内容时，或者当用户遇到 .report-meta.xml 文件的部署错误时，也使用该技能。请勿针对以下情况触发：创建或修改自定义报告类型元数据（.reportType-meta.xml —— 使用 platform-custom-report-type-generate）、创建仪表板、创建列表视图、在 UI 中运行或查看现有报告，或 SOQL 查询。

description: Builds multiplayer spatial board games using TabletopKit on visionOS. Use when creating tabletop game experiences with boards, pieces, cards, or dice; managing seats, turns, equipment state, TabletopAction flows, or TabletopInteraction delegates; synchronizing gameplay through FaceTime Group Activities; rendering with RealityKit; or implementing snapping, tosses, and physics on a virtual table surface.
description_zh: 使用 TabletopKit 在 visionOS 上构建多人空间桌游。适用于创建带有棋盘、棋子、卡片或骰子的桌游体验，管理座位、回合、设备状态、TabletopAction 流程或 TabletopInteraction 委托，通过 FaceTime Group Activities 同步游戏玩法，使用 RealityKit 进行渲染，或在虚拟桌面表面实现吸附、投掷与物理效果。

description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree (OST) to structure product discovery — map a desired outcome to opportunities, solutions, and experiments. Based on Teresa Torres' Continuous Discovery Habits. Use when structuring discovery work, mapping opportunities to solutions, or deciding what to build next.
description_zh: 构建机会解决树（OST），以结构化产品发现——将期望结果映射至机会、解决方案与实验。基于特蕾莎·托雷斯（Teresa Torres）的《持续发现习惯》。用于结构化发现工作、将机会映射至解决方案，或决定下一步构建什么。

description: Package an escalation for engineering, product, or leadership with full context. Use when a bug needs engineering attention beyond normal support, multiple customers report the same issue, a customer is threatening to churn, or an issue has sat unresolved past its SLA.
description_zh: 为工程、产品或领导层打包一份带有完整上下文信息的升级事件。当 Bug 需要超出常规支持的工程处理，或多位客户报告同一问题，或客户威胁流失，或问题悬而未决且已超过 SLA 期限时，使用。

description: Extract the full design language from any website URL. Produces 8 output files including AI-optimized markdown, visual HTML preview, Tailwind config, React theme, shadcn/ui theme, Figma variables, W3C design tokens, and CSS variables. Also runs WCAG accessibility scoring. Use when user says 'extract design', 'get design system', 'design language', 'design tokens', 'what colors/fonts does this site use', or '/extract-design'.
description_zh: 从任何网站的网址中提取完整的 设计语言。生成 8 个输出文件，包括 AI 优化版 Markdown、可视化 HTML 预览、Tailwind 配置、React 主题、shadcn/ui 主题、Figma 变量、W3C 设计令牌和 CSS 变量。同时运行 WCAG 无障碍评分。当用户说“提取设计”、“获取设计系统”、“设计语言”、“设计令牌”、“该网站使用了什么颜色/字体”或“/提取设计”时使用。

description: Provides guidance for migrating Apache Airflow DAGs in Managed Service for Apache Airflow (MSAA; formerly Cloud Composer). Covers migration to Airflow 2.11.1 (MSAA Gen 2 and 3) and Airflow 3 (MSAA Gen 3), including environment inspection, GCS download/upload and scanning patterns for breaking changes. Use when migrating the DAG code to newer Airflow version. Don't use when checking DAG run failures unrelated to code migration.
description_zh: 为在 Managed Service for Apache Airflow（MSAA；原名 Cloud Composer）中迁移 Apache Airflow 的 DAG 提供指南。涵盖向 Airflow 2.11.1（MSAA 第 2 代和第 3 代）和 Airflow 3（MSAA 第 3 代）的迁移，包括环境检查、GCS 下载/上传以及针对破坏性变更的扫描模式。在将 DAG 代码迁移到更新的 Airflow 版本时使用。当检查与代码迁移无关的 DAG 运行失败时不要使用。

description: Turn a call transcript or call notes into a customer follow-up email draft, an internal chat summary, and proposed CRM updates. Use when the user says "call summary", "follow up on my [company] call", "summarize my call with [account]", "write the recap", "process this transcript", "process my call notes", "capture the objections and next steps", or pastes rough notes or a transcript after a discovery, demo, or negotiation call.
description_zh: 将通话文字记录或通话笔记转化为客户跟进邮件草稿、内部聊天摘要及拟定的CRM更新。当用户提及“通话总结”、“跟进我[company]的通话”、“与[account]的通话总结”、“撰写总结”、“处理此通话记录”、“处理我的通话笔记”、“提取异议及下一步计划”，或在需求发现、演示或谈判通话后粘贴原始笔记或通话记录时使用。

description: Brainstorm product positioning ideas differentiated from competitors. Identifies top competitors and generates positioning statements with rationale. Use when developing product positioning, differentiating from competitors, or crafting brand positioning strategy.
description_zh: 头脑风暴，激发区别于竞争对手的产品定位思路。识别主要竞争对手，并结合依据生成定位陈述。适用于制定产品定位、实现竞争差异化或制定品牌定位策略。

description:
Professional email composition for business communication across various contexts.
Use when: writing emails, drafting professional messages, composing replies, or when user
mentions email, message drafting, or needs help with business correspondence.
description_zh:
适用于各类场景的商业沟通专业邮件撰写。

适用场景：撰写邮件、起草专业信息、撰写回复，或当用户提及邮件、信息起草、需要帮助进行商务通信时。

description: Script a Roblox experience in Luau: get services, create and parent Instances, connect events, run server Scripts vs client LocalScripts, and communicate across the client/server boundary with RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions (server-authoritative). Use when building or debugging Roblox Studio scripts — when the user mentions Roblox, Luau, services, RemoteEvent, Instance.new, PlayerAdded, or client vs server. For saving player data use roblox-datastores.
description_zh: 在 Luau 中编写 Roblox 体验：获取服务、创建并设置父级实例、连接事件、运行服务端脚本与客户端本地脚本，并使用 RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions（服务端权威模式）在客户端与服务器端之间进行通信。适用于在构建或调试 Roblox Studio 脚本时使用——当用户提及 Roblox、Luau、服务、RemoteEvent、Instance.new、PlayerAdded 或客户端与服务器端时。如需保存玩家数据，请使用 roblox-datastores。

description: Create and edit PowerPoint presentations from scratch with PptxGenJS — MiniMax's production-tested deck pipeline.
description_zh: 使用PptxGenJS，从零开始创建并编辑PowerPoint演示文稿——MiniMax经过生产验证的演示文稿流水线。

description: Creates and manages annotation configs (categorical, continuous, freeform label schemas) and annotation queues (human review workflows) on Arize. Applies human annotations to project spans via the Python SDK. Use when the user mentions annotation config, annotation queue, label schema, human feedback, bulk annotate spans, update_annotations, labeling queue, annotate record, or human review.
description_zh: 在 Arize 上创建和管理标注配置（分类型、连续型、自由形式标签模式）及标注队列（人工审核工作流）。通过 Python SDK 将人工标注应用于项目跨度。适用于用户提及标注配置、标注队列、标签模式、人工反馈、批量标注跨度、update_annotations、标注队列、标注记录或人工审核等场景时使用。

description: Use when migrating a CopilotKit v1 application to v2 -- updating package imports, replacing deprecated hooks and components, switching from GraphQL runtime to AG-UI protocol runtime, and resolving breaking API changes.
description_zh: 在将 CopilotKit v1 应用迁移至 v2 时使用——更新包导入，替换已弃用的 hooks 和组件，将 GraphQL 运行时切换为 AG-UI 协议运行时，并处理破坏性 API 变更。

description:
Read-only drift detector. Diffs SPEC.md against current code and reports
violations grouped by severity. Writes nothing — suggests remedies via
the spec or build skills but never invokes them. Triggers when the user
asks to check drift, audit the spec, verify invariants, or ask whether
code still matches the spec. Phrasings: "check drift", "audit the spec",
"does the code still match §V", "check invariants", "spec vs code".
description_zh: 只读漂移检测器。将 SPEC.md 与当前代码进行差异比对，并按严重程度报告违规项。不写入任何内容——通过规范或构建技能提供修复建议，但从不调用它们。当用户要求检查漂移、审计规范、验证不变量，或询问代码是否仍与规范一致时触发。表述用语："check drift"、"audit the spec"、"does the code still match §V"、"check invariants"、"spec vs code"。

description: Configure guarded rollouts with progressive traffic increases, metric monitoring, and automatic rollback. Use when releasing features gradually with safety thresholds.
description_zh: 配置支持渐进式流量提升、指标监控和自动回滚的受保护发布。适用于在安全阈值条件下逐步发布功能。

description: Senior Designer review: rates each design dimension 0-10, explains what a 10 looks like, and flags AI Slop signals. Useful as a gate before merging UI work.
description_zh: 资深设计师评审：为每个设计维度评分0至10分，阐释得分为10分的具体表现，并标记AI Slop（AI劣化）的预警信号。作为合并UI工作前的审核关卡，十分实用。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing sector rotation patterns and market cycle positioning. It fetches sector uptrend data from CSV (no API key required) and optionally accepts chart images for supplementary analysis. Use this skill when the user requests sector rotation analysis, cyclical vs defensive assessment, overbought/oversold identification, or market cycle phase estimation. All analysis and output are conducted in English.
description_zh: 本技能适用于分析板块轮动模式与市场周期定位。它从CSV获取板块上涨趋势数据（无需API密钥），并可选择接收图表图像进行补充分析。当用户要求进行板块轮动分析、周期性与防御性评估、超买/超卖识别或市场周期阶段估算时，使用本技能。所有分析与输出均以英语进行。

description: 接收抖音、小红书、微信视频号等短视频链接或分享文案，查询作品／账号数据并提取语音文字稿，按作者和标题归档为 Markdown。用户希望完整解析短视频、取得数据或文字稿时使用；运行前检查 TikHub 与轻抖使用凭证，缺少时用新手能理解的方式引导购买和安全配置。
description_zh: 接收抖音、小红书、微信视频号等短视频链接或分享文案，查询作品／账号数据并提取语音文字稿，按作者和标题归档为 Markdown。用户希望完整解析短视频、获取数据或文字稿时使用；运行前检查 TikHub 与轻抖的使用凭证，凭证缺失时，以新手能够理解的方式引导用户购买并进行安全配置。

description: Estimate the intrinsic value of a public company using DCF, relative (peer multiple) and sum-of-parts (SOTP) methods, then triangulate to an implied share price with upside/downside versus the current market price. Use this skill whenever the user asks: "what is AAPL worth", "valuation of NVDA", "fair value of TSLA", "intrinsic value", "DCF for MSFT", "build a DCF", "discounted cash flow", "WACC", "terminal value", "implied share price", "upside to fair value", "is X overvalued/undervalued", "relative valuation", "peer comparison valuation", "EV/EBITDA target", "SOTP", "sum of the parts", "how much is [company] worth", "price target from fundamentals", "value this company", or any ticker in the context of computing intrinsic or relative valuation. Default to running ALL three methods (DCF + relative + SOTP-if-applicable) and presenting a blended implied price with a sensitivity table. Do not answer valuation questions from memory — always run the workflow.
description_zh:
使用DCF（现金流折现法）、相对估值（同行倍数法）和分部估值法（SOTP）等方法估算上市公司的内在价值，随后进行三角验证，得出隐含股价，并与当前市场价对比，计算上行/下行空间。

当用户询问：“AAPL值多少钱”、“NVDA的估值”、“TSLA的公允价值”、“内在价值”、“MSFT的DCF”、“构建DCF”、“现金流折现（DCF）”、“WACC”、“终值”、“隐含股价”、“公允价值上行空间”、“X是否高估/低估”、“相对估值”、“同行比较估值”、“EV/EBITDA目标”、“SOTP”、“各组成部分估值”、“[公司]值多少钱”、“基于基本面的目标价”、“评估这家公司”，或在计算内在价值或相对估值语境下的任何股票代码时，使用该技能。

默认需运行全部三种方法（DCF + 相对估值 + 适用情况下的SOTP），并呈现综合隐含价格及敏感性分析表。切勿凭记忆回答估值问题——必须始终执行该工作流。

description: Deep-dive into analyst estimates and revision trends for any stock using Yahoo Finance data. Use when the user wants to understand analyst estimate direction, how EPS or revenue forecasts changed over time, compare estimate distributions, or analyze growth projections across periods. Triggers: "estimate analysis for AAPL", "analyst estimate trends for NVDA", "EPS revisions for TSLA", "how have estimates changed for MSFT", "estimate revisions", "EPS trend", "revenue estimates", "consensus changes", "analyst estimates", "estimate distribution", "growth estimates for", "estimate momentum", "revision trend", "forward estimates", "next quarter estimates", "annual estimates", "estimate spread", "bull vs bear estimates", "estimate range", or any request about tracking or comparing analyst estimates/revisions. Use this skill when the user asks about estimates beyond a simple lookup — if they want context, trends, or analysis, this is the right skill.
description_zh:
使用雅虎财经数据，对任意股票进行分析师预估与修订趋势的深度分析。

当用户希望了解分析师预估方向、EPS或营收预测随时间的变化情况、对比预估分布，或分析不同周期增长预测时使用本技能。

触发条件：
"AAPL的预估分析"，"NVDA分析师预估趋势"，"TSLA的EPS修订"，"MSFT的预估如何变化"，"预估修订"，"EPS趋势"，"营收预估"，"共识变化"，"分析师预估"，"预估分布"，"增长预估"，"预估动能"，"修订趋势"，"前瞻预估"，"下季度预估"，"年度预估"，"预估价差"，"看涨与看跌预估"，"预估区间"，或任何关于跟踪或对比分析师预估/修订的请求。

当用户询问的预估已超出简单查询的范围时，使用本技能——如果他们需要背景、趋势或分析，这就是正确的技能。

description: Set up and run experiments in LaunchDarkly. Create experiments with metrics, treatments, and flag config, start iterations to collect data, swap design between iterations, and stop with a winner.
description_zh: 在 LaunchDarkly 中搭建并运行实验。创建包含指标、处理和标志配置的实验，启动迭代以收集数据，在不同迭代之间切换设计，并以胜出者结束实验。

description: Use when creating skills for Rust crates or std library documentation. Keywords: create rust skill, create crate skill, create std skill, 创建 rust skill, 创建 crate skill, 创建 std skill, 动态 rust skill, 动态 crate skill, skill for tokio, skill for serde, skill for axum, generate rust skill, rust 技能, crate 技能, 从文档创建skill, from docs create skill
description_zh: 当为 Rust crate 或标准库文档创建技能时使用。关键词：create rust skill、create crate skill、create std skill、创建 rust skill、创建 crate skill、创建 std skill、动态 rust skill、动态 crate skill、skill for tokio、skill for serde、skill for axum、generate rust skill、rust 技能、crate 技能、从文档创建 skill、from docs create skill

description: Create, update, or validate a product brief. Use when the user wants help producing, editing, or validating a brief
description_zh: 创建、更新或验证产品简报。当用户需要帮助编写、编辑或验证简报时使用。

description: Retrieve Data Lake Object (DLO) and Data Model Object (DMO) schema information from Salesforce Data Cloud using REST APIs. Use this skill when you need to inspect DLO or DMO field definitions, data types, or metadata. Takes org alias and optional DLO/DMO name as parameters.
description_zh: 使用REST API从Salesforce数据云检索数据湖对象（DLO）和数据模型对象（DMO）的模式信息。当您需要检查DLO或DMO的字段定义、数据类型或元数据时，使用此技能。该技能以组织别名和可选的DLO/DMO名称为参数。

description: AdsPower profile operation via adspower-browser CLI. open/launch/start browser or profile, environment, config profile, AdsPower; create/update/delete/list profiles; groups, tags, proxies; kernel download/list; client patch; API check-status. User phrases like open environment or map to commands such as open-browser.
description_zh: 通过 adspower-browser CLI 进行 AdsPower 配置文件操作：打开/启动/启动浏览器或配置文件，访问环境、配置配置文件、AdsPower；创建/更新/删除/列出配置文件；分组、标签、代理；内核下载/列出；客户端补丁；API 状态检查。用户短语（如 open environment）需映射到相应命令（如 open-browser）。

description: Druckenmiller Strategy Synthesizer - Integrates 8 upstream skill outputs (Market Breadth, Uptrend Analysis, Market Top, Macro Regime, FTD Detector, VCP Screener, Theme Detector, CANSLIM Screener) into a unified conviction score (0-100), pattern classification, and allocation recommendation. Use when user asks about overall market conviction, portfolio positioning, asset allocation, strategy synthesis, or Druckenmiller-style analysis. Triggers on queries like "What is my conviction level?", "How should I position?", "Run the strategy synthesizer", "Druckenmiller analysis", "総合的な市場判断", "確信度スコア", "ポートフォリオ配分", "ドラッケンミラー分析".
description_zh: Druckenmiller策略综合器 - 整合8个上游技能输出（市场广度、上升趋势分析、市场顶部、宏观环境、FTD检测器、VCP筛选器、主题检测器、CANSLIM筛选器）为一个统一的确信度评分（0-100）、模式分类和配置建议。适用于用户询问整体市场确信度、投资组合定位、资产配置、策略综合或Druckenmiller风格分析时使用。触发条件包括查询如“我的确信度水平是多少？”、“我应该如何定位？”、“运行策略综合器”、“Druckenmiller分析”、“综合市场判断”、“确信度评分”、“投资组合配分”、“Druckenmiller分析”。

description: Build networked games with Godot 4.7 high-level multiplayer: set up an ENetMultiplayerPeer server/client, define RPCs with the @rpc annotation (call via rpc()/rpc_id()), set per-node multiplayer authority, and replicate state with MultiplayerSpawner and MultiplayerSynchronizer. Use when adding multiplayer/networking to a Godot project, writing @rpc functions, or syncing player/world state across peers.
description_zh: 使用 Godot 4.7 构建高级多人网络游戏：搭建 ENetMultiplayerPeer 服务器/客户端，使用 @rpc 注解定义 RPC（通过 rpc()/rpc_id() 调用），设置节点级多人权限，并使用 MultiplayerSpawner 和 MultiplayerSynchronizer 同步状态。适用于向 Godot 项目添加多人/网络功能、编写 @rpc 函数，或在跨对等端同步玩家/世界状态时使用。

description: Drive Unity 6.3 LTS character animation with Animator Controllers: states, transitions, parameters, blend trees, animation layers, and humanoid Avatar IK. Use when wiring an Animator, setting parameters from script (SetFloat/SetBool/SetTrigger), building blend trees, or when the user mentions Animator, Mecanim, state machine, blend tree, or .controller.
description_zh: 使用Animator控制器驱动Unity 6.3 LTS角色动画：状态、转换、参数、混合树、动画层与人形Avatar倒帧（IK）。在连接配置Animator、从脚本设置参数（SetFloat/SetBool/SetTrigger）、构建混合树，或当用户提及Animator、Mecanim、状态机、混合树或.controller时使用。

description: Run an agent loop until an exit condition is met. Use when the user says "loop", "babysit", "keep trying until", "check every X", "watch", or wants iterative autonomous execution.
description_zh: 运行智能体循环，直到退出条件满足。当用户表示“循环”、“照看”、“继续尝试直到”、“每 X 检查一次”、“观察”，或需要迭代自主执行时使用。

description: Skills for accessing and searching docs in DeepWiki/GitHub’s public code repositories can help users understand open-source project source codes, and users can also ask questions directly about the code docs.
description_zh: 通过 DeepWiki/GitHub 公共代码仓库获取和搜索文档的能力，有助于用户理解开源项目的源代码，并且用户还能直接就代码文档进行提问。

description: UX designer and UI specialist. Use when the user asks to talk to Sally or requests the UX designer
description_zh: 用户体验设计师和界面设计专家。当用户要求与 Sally 交谈，或请求用户体验设计师时使用。

description: Comprehensive backend development skill for building scalable backend systems using NodeJS, Express, Go, Python, Postgres, GraphQL, REST APIs. Includes API scaffolding, database optimization, security implementation, and performance tuning. Use when designing APIs, optimizing database queries, implementing business logic, handling authentication/authorization, or reviewing backend code.
description_zh: 使用 NodeJS、Express、Go、Python、Postgres、GraphQL、REST API 构建可扩展后端系统的全面后端开发技能。涵盖 API 脚手架搭建、数据库优化、安全实现与性能调优。适用于设计 API、优化数据库查询、实现业务逻辑、处理认证/授权，或审查后端代码的场景。

description: Structure a design presentation for a specific audience and decision. Use when presenting internally. For a portfolio narrative use `case-study`; for the written argument use `design-rationale`.
description_zh: 针对特定受众和决策，构建设计演示。适用于内部演示时使用。用于作品集叙事时使用 `case-study`；用于书面论证时使用 `design-rationale`。

description: Systematically discover synthesis opportunities across the Obsidian wiki — pairs or clusters of concepts that co-occur frequently across pages but have no synthesis page connecting them. Creates new synthesis/ pages that draw explicit cross-cutting conclusions. Use when the user says "synthesize my wiki", "find connections", "what concepts keep coming up together", "/wiki-synthesize", or after a large ingest when the vault has grown significantly.
description_zh: 系统性地发现 Obsidian 维基中的综合机会——那些在页面中频繁共现的概念对或概念簇，但缺乏将它们连接起来的综合页面。创建新的综合页面，从中得出明确的交叉性结论。当用户说“综合我的维基”、“寻找连接”、“哪些概念不断共同出现”、“/wiki-synthesize”时使用，或在大量导入后当仓库显著增长时使用。

description: Confirm a change before merge. `/check verify` drives the real app to prove behavior against the spec (every acceptance criterion met, every surface built). `/check review` runs a senior code review on a fresh model, one that did not write the code. Verify after /develop, review before a PR. Writes to docs/reviews/, never edits code.
description_zh: 合并前确认变更。`/check verify` 驱动真实应用，对照规范验证行为（每个验收标准均已满足，每个界面均已构建）。`/check review` 对未编写该代码的全新模型执行资深代码审查。在 `/develop` 之后验证，在 PR 之前进行审查。写入 `docs/reviews/`，绝不修改代码。

description: Reasoning-driven image generation using structured creative briefs (Gemini 3 style) — generates high-fidelity images via muapi.ai with logic-based prompting
description_zh: 基于结构化创意简报的推理驱动图像生成（Gemini 3 风格）——通过 muapi.ai 基于逻辑的提示词生成高保真图像

description: SwiftUI 前端设计 skill — anti AI-slop rules, design direction advisor, brand asset protocol, and five-dimension review. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode.
description_zh: SwiftUI 前端设计技能——反 AI 低质设计规则、设计方向顾问、品牌资产规范，以及五维评审。可与 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和 OpenCode 配合使用。

description: Generate videos with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 via inference.sh CLI. Unified model for text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video with synchronized audio, up to 1080p, 4-15s duration. Pro and Fast variants. Studio variants with private asset library for portrait consistency. Use for: social media videos, music videos, product demos, animated content, AI video with sound. Triggers: seedance, seedance 2, bytedance video, seedance t2v, seedance i2v, seedance r2v, video with audio, seedance 2.0, bytedance seedance, seedance studio
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 ByteDance Seedance 2.0 生成视频

**统一的文本转视频、图像转视频和参考转视频模型**，支持同步音频，最高支持 1080p，时长 4-15 秒。提供 Pro 版和 Fast 版。Studio 版配备私有素材库，确保人物形象一致性。

**适用场景**：社交媒体视频、音乐视频、产品演示、动画内容、带声音的 AI 视频。

**关键词触发**：seedance, seedance 2, bytedance video, seedance t2v, seedance i2v, seedance r2v, video with audio, seedance 2.0, bytedance seedance, seedance studio

description: React Native renderer for json-render that turns JSON specs into native mobile UIs. Use when working with @json-render/react-native, building React Native UIs from JSON, creating mobile component catalogs, or rendering AI-generated specs on mobile.
description_zh: json-render 的 React Native 渲染器，用于将 JSON 规格转换为原生移动界面。适用于使用 @json-render/react-native、基于 JSON 构建 React Native 界面、创建移动组件目录，或在移动端渲染 AI 生成的规格。

description: Use C#/.NET in Godot 4.7: partial classes extending nodes, the PascalCase lifecycle (_Ready/_Process/_PhysicsProcess), [Export] fields, [Signal] delegates as C# events, type-safe node lookup, and calling between C# and GDScript. Use when writing Godot game code in C# (.cs files, .csproj), needing the Godot .NET build, converting GDScript patterns to C#, or wiring Godot signals as C# events.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中使用 C#/.NET：扩展节点类的部分类、帕斯卡大小写生命周期的（_Ready/_Process/_PhysicsProcess）、[Export] 字段、将 [Signal] 委托用作 C# 事件、类型安全的节点查找，以及 C# 与 GDScript 之间的调用。在编写使用 C# 的 Godot 游戏代码（.cs 文件、.csproj）、需要 Godot .NET 构建、将 GDScript 模式转换为 C#，或将 Godot 信号连接为 C# 事件时使用。

description: Aggregates and summarizes the latest AI news from multiple sources including AI news websites and web search. Provides concise news briefs with direct links to original articles. Activates when user asks for 'today's AI news', 'AI updates', 'latest AI developments', or mentions wanting a 'daily AI briefing'.
description_zh: 聚合并总结来自多个来源（包括AI新闻网站和网页搜索）的最新AI新闻，提供简洁的新闻简讯，并附原始文章直达链接。当用户请求“今日AI新闻”、“AI最新动态”、“最新AI进展”，或提及想要“每日AI简报”时，激活。

description: Find and explain company policies in plain language. Trigger with "what's our PTO policy", "can I work remotely from another country", "how do expenses work", or any plain-language question about benefits, travel, leave, or handbook rules.
description_zh: 以通俗易懂的语言查找并解释公司政策。使用“我们的年假政策是什么”、“我可以从另一个国家远程办公吗”、“费用是如何计算的”，或任何关于福利、差旅、假期或手册规则的通俗易懂的提问来触发。

description: Analyze, describe, and extract information from images using the MiniMax vision MCP tool. Use when: user shares an image file path or URL (any message containing .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp, .bmp, or .svg file extension) or uses any of these words/phrases near an image: "analyze", "analyse", "describe", "explain", "understand", "look at", "review", "extract text", "OCR", "what is in", "what's in", "read this image", "see this image", "tell me about", "explain this", "interpret this", in connection with an image, screenshot, diagram, chart, mockup, wireframe, or photo. Also triggers for: UI mockup review, wireframe analysis, design critique, data extraction from charts, object detection, person/animal/activity identification. Triggers: any message with an image file extension (jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, bmp, svg), or any request to analyze/describ/understand/review/extract text from an image, screenshot, diagram, chart, photo, mockup, or wireframe.
description_zh: 使用 MiniMax 视觉 MCP 工具分析、描述并提取图像信息。适用场景：当用户分享图像文件的路径或 URL（任何包含 .jpg、.jpeg、.png、.gif、.webp、.bmp 或 .svg 文件扩展名的消息）时，或使用图像附近的任何以下词语/短语：“analyze”, “analyse”, “describe”, “explain”, “understand”, “look at”, “review”, “extract text”, “OCR”, “what is in”, “what's in”, “read this image”, “see this image”, “tell me about”, “explain this”, “interpret this”，或与图像、截屏、图表、示意图、模型图、线框图或照片相关联时。此外，触发条件还包括：UI 原型审核、线框图分析、设计批评、图表数据提取、目标检测、人物/动物/活动识别。触发条件：任何包含图像文件扩展名（jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, bmp, svg）的消息，或对图像、截屏、图表、照片、模型图或线框图进行分析/描述/理解/审核/提取文本的请求。

description: Generate a Lean Canvas with problem, solution, metrics, cost structure, UVP, unfair advantage, channels, segments, and revenue. Use when exploring a lean startup canvas, testing a business hypothesis, or modeling a new venture.
description_zh: 生成一份包含问题、解决方案、指标、成本结构、UPV、不公平优势、渠道、细分市场和收入的精益画布。在探索精益创业画布、测试商业假设或构建新业务模式时使用。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to configs-targeting. Do not use this skill; invoke configs-targeting instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-targeting still point users to the new name.
description_zh: DEPRECATED redirect — 该技能已更名为 configs-targeting。请勿使用此技能，请改为调用 configs-targeting。仅为保留对 aiconfig-targeting 的旧引用，仍能指引用户至新名称。

description: Expert guidelines for Chrome extension development with Manifest V3, covering security, performance, and best practices. Use when building browser extensions, creating popup UIs, implementing content scripts, working with Chrome APIs, managing extension permissions, or publishing to Chrome Web Store.
description_zh: 《Chrome 扩展程序 Manifest V3 开发专家指南》涵盖安全、性能与最佳实践。适用于构建浏览器扩展程序、创建弹窗界面、实现内容脚本、使用 Chrome API、管理扩展程序权限，或发布至 Chrome Web Store。

description: Create comprehensive test scenarios from user stories with test objectives, starting conditions, user roles, step-by-step actions, and expected outcomes. Use when writing QA test cases, creating test plans, defining acceptance tests, or preparing for feature validation.
description_zh: 基于用户故事创建全面的测试场景，包含测试目标、初始条件、用户角色、逐步操作和预期结果。适用于编写QA测试用例、创建测试计划、定义验收测试或准备功能验证。

description: Run /audit on a greenfield project, an existing codebase with missing docs, or one area (/audit src/auth) to bootstrap the project's AI context, the AGENTS.md files every later skill reads. Writes tool agnostic AGENTS.md plus thin CLAUDE.md pointers, adding only what is missing; never overwrites curated content.
description_zh: 对全新项目、文档缺失的现有代码库，或特定区域（/audit src/auth）运行 /audit，用于初始化项目的 AI 上下文——即后续所有技能读取的 AGENTS.md 文件。它生成与工具无关的 AGENTS.md，并添加精简的 CLAUDE.md 指引，仅补充缺失内容，绝不覆盖精选内容。

description: Run /document `pr` | `changelog` | `release-note` | `postmortem` (or let it ask) to write the human facing prose about a change. Drafts from the real commits and diff, writing to the right place. Does not write code, tests, or specs.
description_zh: 运行 `/document` 下的 `pr`、`changelog`、`release-note`、`postmortem`（或由它来询问），撰写关于变更的面向用户说明。根据真实的提交和差异生成草稿，并写入正确位置。不编写代码、测试或规范。

description: Iteratively inspect traces, interview the user, and create LangSmith online evaluators one at a time. Use specifically for creating online evaluators for use within LangSmith -- use "eval-engineering" for Harbor-style online evaluations.
description_zh: 迭代检查轨迹，访谈用户，并逐一创建 LangSmith 在线评估器。专门用于在 LangSmith 中创建在线评估器——使用 "eval-engineering" 用于 Harbor 风格的在线评估。

description: Analyze A/B test results with statistical significance, sample size validation, confidence intervals, and ship/extend/stop recommendations. Use when evaluating experiment results, checking if a test reached significance, interpreting split test data, or deciding whether to ship a variant.
description_zh: 分析A/B测试结果，包含统计显著性、样本量验证、置信区间以及发布/延长/停止建议。适用于评估实验结果、检查测试是否达到显著性、解读分流测试数据，或决定是否发布变体版本时使用。

description: Generate contextual briefings for legal work — daily summary, topic research, or incident response. Use when starting your day and need a scan of legal-relevant items across email, calendar, and contracts, when researching a specific legal question across internal sources, or when a developing situation (data breach, litigation threat, regulatory inquiry) needs rapid context.
description_zh: 为法律工作生成上下文简报——每日摘要、主题研究或事件响应。当您开始一天并需要扫描邮件、日历和合同中的法律相关事项时，当您研究特定法律问题并跨越内部资料时，或当发展中的情况（数据泄露、诉讼威胁、监管调查）需要快速上下文时，均可使用。

description: Plan resource capacity — workload analysis and utilization forecasting. Use when heading into quarterly planning, the team feels overallocated and you need the numbers, deciding whether to hire or deprioritize, or stress-testing whether upcoming projects fit the people you have.
description_zh: 规划资源容量——工作量分析与利用率预测。在进入季度规划时，若团队感到资源超载，需要相关数据，以便决定是招聘还是降低优先级，或对即将到来的项目与现有人员是否适配进行压力测试。

description: Use when managing Apple Ads with asc, including OAuth profiles, ad-account discovery, Platform API v1 campaigns and targeting, reports, assets, recommendations, guarded mutations, raw requests, and Campaign Management API v5 migration.
description_zh: 在通过 asc 管理 Apple 广告时使用，包括 asc 的 OAuth 配置文件、广告账户发现、Platform API v1 的广告活动与定向、报告、素材、推荐、受保护变更、原始请求，以及 Campaign Management API v5 迁移。

description: Brainstorm an inspiring, achievable, and emotional product vision that motivates teams and aligns stakeholders. Use when defining or refining a product vision, creating a vision statement, or aligning the team around a shared direction.
description_zh: 头脑风暴一个富有启发性、切实可行且能触动人心的产品愿景，以激励团队并统一各方的利益。适用于在定义或完善产品愿景、制定愿景陈述或围绕共同方向统一团队时使用。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to online-evals. Do not use this skill; invoke online-evals instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-online-evals still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已废弃重定向 — 此技能已更名为 online-evals。请勿使用此技能；请调用 online-evals。仅为使旧对 aiconfig-online-evals 的引用仍能指向新名称而保留。

description: Draft a knowledge base article from a resolved issue or common question. Use when a ticket resolution is worth documenting for self-service, the same question keeps coming up, a workaround needs to be published, or a known issue should be communicated to customers.
description_zh: 根据已解决的问题或常见问题，撰写知识库文章。当工单的解决方案值得为自助服务进行记录、同一问题反复出现、需要发布变通方案，或需要向客户传达已知问题时使用。

description: Check the status of existing agreements with a vendor across all connected systems — CLM, CRM, email, and document storage — with gap analysis and upcoming deadlines. Use when onboarding or renewing a vendor, when you need a consolidated view of what's signed and what's missing (MSA, DPA, SOW), or when checking for approaching expirations and surviving obligations.
description_zh: 检查所有已连接系统（CLM、CRM、邮件及文档存储）中与供应商现有协议的签署状态，并开展差距分析与即将到期的截止日期核查。对供应商进行入职或续约时使用，当需要获取已签署与缺失文件（MSA、DPA、SOW）的整合视图时使用，或检查即将到期协议及存续义务时使用。

description: Run /scope to turn a product idea into a living, coarse scope in docs/scope/ and keep it current: plan a new product, plan the next slice, enroll one named feature, or run with no argument to reconcile after shipping and queue what is next. Seeds WHAT to build; /architect designs, /develop builds.
description_zh: 运行 /scope，将产品想法转化为 docs/scope/ 目录下的活体、粗粒度范围，并保持其时效性：规划新产品、规划下一个切片、登记一个命名的特性，或者不带参数运行，以在发布后协调范围，并将下一步任务排入队列。播种 WHAT 以构建；/architect 设计，/develop 构建。

description: Publish Markdown/HTML articles to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) drafts via API 新手引导：输入 `/公众号发布 新手`、「这个怎么用」「第一次用」「能干嘛」时，走 SKILL.md 的〈新手上路〉，不要直接开始干活。
description_zh: 通过 API 将 Markdown/HTML 文章发布到微信公众号（公众号）草稿的新手引导：当输入 `/公众号发布 新手`、「这个怎么用」「第一次用」「能干嘛」时，走 SKILL.md 中的〈新手上路〉，不要直接开始干活。

description: Brainstorm team-level OKRs aligned with company objectives — qualitative objectives with measurable key results. Use when setting quarterly OKRs, aligning team goals with company strategy, drafting objectives, or learning how to write effective OKRs.
description_zh: 与公司目标对齐的团队层面OKR头脑风暴——定性目标与可衡量的关键结果。适用于设定季度OKR、将团队目标与公司战略对齐、草拟目标或学习如何撰写有效OKR时。

description: Develop and deploy Data Cloud Code Extensions using SF CLI plugin. Use this skill when creating custom Python transformations for Data Cloud, deploying code extensions, or testing data transformations. Supports init, run, scan, and deploy operations.
description_zh: 使用 SF CLI 插件开发并部署 Data Cloud 代码扩展。当您需要为 Data Cloud 创建自定义 Python 转换、部署代码扩展或测试数据转换时，请使用此技能。支持初始化、运行、扫描和部署操作。

description: Create an admin user in Medusa
description_zh: 在 Medusa 中创建管理员用户。

description: Create, configure, and manage Netlify deploys from code — reach for this when setting up Git continuous deployment, running netlify deploy or netlify deploy --prod from the CLI, writing netlify.toml deploy contexts, adding a Deploy to Netlify button, wiring build hooks, configuring Deploy Previews or branch deploys, locking or skipping deploys, fixing a failed or secrets-scanning deploy, or when someone asks to "deploy my site", "set up preview deploys", "add per-branch build config", or "add a deploy button to my README".
description_zh: 从代码创建、配置和管理 Netlify 部署——在以下场景中使用此功能：设置 Git 持续部署、通过命令行运行 netlify deploy 或 netlify deploy --prod、编写 netlify.toml 部署上下文、添加"Deploy to Netlify"按钮、配置构建钩子、设置部署预览或分支部署、锁定或跳过部署、修复失败的或包含密钥扫描的部署，或当有人要求"部署我的网站"、"设置预览部署"、"添加按分支的构建配置"或"在我的 README 中添加部署按钮"时。

description: Query the OpenAlex scholarly database for research papers, authors, institutions, topics, sources, publishers, funders, geo-locations, and keywords. Use when searching academic papers, resolving DOIs, downloading open-access PDFs, finding an author's publications, aggregating bibliometric data (citation counts, h-index, impact factor), exploring the research taxonomies, or performing DOI lookups.
description_zh: 向 OpenAlex 学术数据库查询研究论文、作者、机构、主题、来源、出版商、资助方、地理位置及关键词。适用于检索学术论文、解析 DOI、下载开放获取的 PDF、查找作者的发表论文、聚合计量文献数据（引用次数、h指数、影响因子）、探索研究分类体系或进行 DOI 查询。

description: Check if a marimo notebook is compatible with WebAssembly (WASM) and report any issues.
description_zh: 检查 Marimo 笔记本是否与 WebAssembly（WASM）兼容，并报告任何问题。

description: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape.
description_zh: 在相同任务下同时生成 N 个并行候选，挑选一个基底，将失败者中最强的部分嫁接进该基底。适用于 `/arena`、'arena this'、'throw it in the arena'，或在一次尝试制作一个非平凡物品会锁定错误形态时使用。

description: Set up and debug a Phaser 4 game: the Game config, the Scene lifecycle (init/preload/create/update), the asset loader, cameras, and cross-scene communication. Use when building or debugging a Phaser game — when the user mentions Phaser, Phaser.Game, Phaser.Scene, preload/create/update, this.load, this.add, or scene transitions. For Arcade Physics movement/collisions use phaser-arcade-physics.
description_zh: 搭建并调试 Phaser 4 游戏：游戏配置、Scene 生命周期（init/preload/create/update）、资源加载器、相机及跨场景通信。在构建或调试 Phaser 游戏时使用——当用户提到 Phaser、Phaser.Game、Phaser.Scene、preload/create/update、this.load、this.add 或场景转换时使用。如需使用 Arcade Physics 的运动/碰撞，请使用 phaser-arcade-physics。

description: Build UI components with shadcn/ui. Pairs with the Stitch design loop to ship structured, accessible components quickly.
description_zh: 使用 shadcn/ui 构建界面组件。配合 Stitch 设计循环，可快速交付结构化、无障碍的组件。

description: Update an OpenSpec change by revising its existing planning artifacts and keeping them coherent with one another. Use when the user wants to revise a change's plan, fold new decisions into it, or reconcile its artifacts after an edit. Also use when the user says "openspec update change" or "opsx update". If the user means the openspec update CLI command, which refreshes generated files, run that command instead. Never edits code.
description_zh: 通过修订其现有规划工件并使其相互协调一致，更新 OpenSpec 变更。当用户需要修订变更的计划、将新的决策融入其中，或在编辑后统一其工件时使用。当用户说“openspec update change”或“opsx update”时，也使用。如果用户指的是刷新生成文件的 openspec update CLI 命令，请运行该命令。切勿编辑代码。

description: Answer a merchant's **analytics and reporting** questions with **ShopifyQL** — Shopify's query language for aggregated store metrics that the Admin GraphQL API cannot compute. Choose this (not `admin`) whenever the ask is for **numbers, totals, trends, or breakdowns** rather than fetching or mutating individual records: including but not limited to total/gross/net sales and revenue, order counts, average order value, refunds, quantity sold, sessions, conversion rate, and traffic — sliced by product, channel, region, or customer, trended over time, or compared period-over-period. Examples: "total sales last 7 days", "orders by sales channel this month", "top products by revenue", "conversion rate this week", "sales this year vs last year". This topic covers writing the ShopifyQL query; if the merchant wants to run it against their store, execution is handed off to `use-shopify-cli`. Not for general Admin GraphQL record operations — fetching or mutating individual resources (use `admin`).
description_zh: 使用 **ShopifyQL** 回答商家的 **分析与报表** 问题——Shopify 的查询语言，用于计算 Admin GraphQL API 无法处理的聚合店铺指标。当需求是获取 **数值、总计、趋势或明细**，而非获取或修改单个记录时，请选择此方案（而非 `admin`）：包括但不限于总销售额、毛销售额、净销售额与营收、订单数量、平均订单价值、退款、销量、会话、转化率以及流量——可按产品、渠道、区域或客户进行细分，随时间趋势分析，或进行期间对比。示例："过去 7 天的总销售额"、"本月按销售渠道的订单数"、"营收最高的产品"、"本周的转化率"、"今年销售额与去年对比"。本主题涵盖编写 ShopifyQL 查询；如果商家希望在其店铺上执行该查询，执行则交由 `use-shopify-cli` 负责。不适用于通用的 Admin GraphQL 记录操作——获取或修改单个资源（请使用 `admin`）。

description: ERC-8004 on-chain Agent identity on XLayer: register / create / update / activate / deactivate / search agents; view ratings; list agent services; set avatar. Roles: user (User / User Agent / Buyer / Client / 用户 / 买家 / 买方), asp (ASP / Provider / Provider Agent / Seller / Merchant / 提供者 / 商家 / 服务提供商 / 卖家 / 卖方), evaluator (Evaluator / Evaluator Agent / 仲裁者 / 评估者). Use for: 注册agent / 注册ASP / 注册User / 注册用户 / 注册买家 / 注册卖家 / 注册服务提供商 / 注册仲裁者 / 创建用户 / 创建买家 / 创建卖家 / 我的agent / 我的ASP / 改agent / 更新agent / 上架 / 下架 / 上架ASP / 停用 / 搜索agent / 找做X的ASP / 查口碑 / 传头像 / agent有什么服务 / endpoint怎么填 / register agent / register ASP / register User / register Provider / register Seller / register Buyer / register Client / update agent / modify agent / activate / deactivate / search agent / agent reviews / agent services / upload avatar. Role words, lifecycle verbs and the product name are spacing / casing / typo tolerant — match by meaning (e.g. "更新卖家身份" → update an asp identity).
description_zh:
XLayer上的ERC-8004链上智能体身份：注册 / 创建 / 更新 / 激活 / 停用 / 搜索智能体；查看评分；列出智能体服务；设置头像。
角色：用户（User / 用户智能体 / 买家 / 客户 / 用户 / 买家 / 买方），ASP（ASP / 提供者 / 提供者智能体 / 卖家 / 商家 / 提供者 / 商家 / 服务提供商 / 卖家 / 卖方），评估者（Evaluator / 评估者智能体 / 仲裁者 / 评估者）。
用途：注册智能体 / 注册ASP / 注册User / 注册用户 / 注册买家 / 注册卖家 / 注册服务提供商 / 注册仲裁者 / 创建用户 / 创建买家 / 创建卖家 / 我的智能体 / 我的ASP / 修改智能体 / 更新智能体 / 上架 / 下架 / 上架ASP / 停用 / 搜索智能体 / 寻找做X的ASP / 查询口碑 / 上传头像 / 智能体提供什么服务 / endpoint如何填写 / register agent / register ASP / register User / register Provider / register Seller / register Buyer / register Client / update agent / modify agent / activate / deactivate / search agent / agent reviews / agent services / upload avatar。
角色词汇、生命周期动词和商品名称对空格、大小写和拼写错误具有容错性——按含义匹配（例如“更新卖家身份”对应 update an ASP身份）。

description: Guide for testing Codex TUI interactively
description_zh: Codex TUI 交互式测试指南

description: Vitest API and config reference (Jest-compatible) — mocking with vi.*, spies, fake timers, coverage configuration, fixtures, snapshots, and test filtering. Use for Vitest API and configuration questions anywhere in the monorepo; for Studio-specific test strategy and component-test setup, start with studio-testing and studio-mock-api-tests.
description_zh:
**Vitest API 与配置参考（Jest 兼容）**

—— 涵盖使用 vi.* 进行模拟、spy 函数、假定时器、覆盖率配置、测试夹具、快照及测试过滤等内容。

在 monorepo 的任何位置，均可用于解答关于 Vitest API 与配置的问题。

针对特定于 Studio 的测试策略和组件测试设置，请先从 studio-testing 和 studio-mock-api-tests 开始。

description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser actions", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction.
description_zh: 面向AI智能体的浏览器自动化CLI。当用户需要与网站交互时使用，包括导航页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取数据、测试Web应用或自动化任何浏览器任务。触发条件包括请求“打开网站”、“填写表单”、“点击按钮”、“截图”、“从页面抓取数据”、“测试此Web应用”、“登录网站”、“自动化浏览器操作”，或任何需要编程式网页交互的任务。

description: Generate engaging short video scripts (30s-3min) for social media platforms like WeChat Channels, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, and Reels. Use when user asks for "short video script", "WeChat/Douyin/TikTok/XHS content", "social media video content".
description_zh: 为微信视频号、抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels等社交媒体平台生成引人入胜的短视频脚本（30秒-3分钟）。当用户询问"短视频脚本"、"微信/抖音/TikTok/小红书内容"、"社交媒体视频内容"时使用。

description: Check that planning is complete enough to implement, then generate the sprint status file from the epics. Can also summarize sprint progress and validate or repair the tracking file. Use when the user says "run sprint planning", "generate sprint plan", "check implementation readiness", "show sprint status", "validate sprint status", or "fix sprint status"
description_zh: 检查规划是否足够完整以实施，然后从epics生成冲刺状态文件。还可以总结冲刺进度，验证或修复追踪文件。用户说"运行冲刺规划"、"生成冲刺计划"、"检查实施就绪性"、"显示冲刺状态"、"验证冲刺状态"或"修复冲刺状态"时使用。

description: Best practices for integrating TanStack Query with TanStack Router and TanStack Start. Patterns for full-stack data flow, SSR, and caching coordination.
description_zh: 集成 TanStack Query 与 TanStack Router 和 TanStack Start 的最佳实践。全栈数据流、SSR 与缓存协调的模式。

description: 사업자등록번호 하나로 "이 사업자, 실제 문제 없나"를 확인한다 — 국세청 사업자등록 상태·국민연금 가입 사업장·국세 체납 명단·금융위 법인개요·조달청 부정당제재·지방행정 인허가 영업상태를 무료 공공 데이터로 교차 조회해 사실만 병렬하는 실사 리포트(점수·등급·위험 판정 없음).
description_zh: 仅凭一个企业注册号即可确认“该企业是否存在实际问题”——利用免费公共数据交叉查询韩国国税厅企业登记状态、国民年金参保经营场所、税务欠税名单、金融监督院企业信息、采购厅不正不当行为制裁以及地方行政许可营业状态，生成仅交叉比对事实的实地核查报告（不含评分、等级、风险判定）。

description: EXPERIMENTAL: Three-layer parallel meta-cognition analysis. Triggers on: /meta-parallel, 三层分析, parallel analysis, 并行元认知
description_zh: 实验：三层并行元认知分析。触发条件：/meta-parallel、三层分析、parallel analysis、并行元认知

description: Evaluate a vendor — cost analysis, risk assessment, and recommendation. Use when reviewing a new vendor proposal, deciding whether to renew or replace a contract, comparing two vendors side-by-side, or building a TCO breakdown and negotiation points before procurement sign-off.
description_zh: 对供应商进行评估——成本分析、风险评估和建议。适用于审查新供应商提案、决定续约或替换合同、并排比较两家供应商，或在采购审批前构建总拥有成本（TCO）分析及议价要点时使用。

description: MUST ACTIVATE on inbound envelopes: (1) {agentId, message:{source:"system", event, jobId, ...}} — system event; (2) {msgType:"a2a-agent-chat", jobId, sender:{role}, ...} — agent-to-agent task chat (fields at top level; sender.role = COUNTERPARTY, not you); (3) literal "Read okx-agent-task/SKILL.md" in envelope. ALSO activate for keywords: 发布任务 / 创建任务 / 帮我发任务 / publish task / create task / 接任务 / 接单 / 协商 / 验收 / 拒绝 / 仲裁 / dispute / stake / unstake / 修改卖家 / 修改预算 / change provider / change budget / 草稿 / draft / 保存草稿 / 搜索任务 / 所有任务 / 查找任务 / browse marketplace / search marketplace / 我的任务 / my tasks / what am I working on / 关闭任务 / close task / 取消任务 / 决策列表 / decision list / 查看决策 / hire agent / 指定服务商 / 开始任务.
description_zh:
在入站信封中必须激活以下内容：
(1) {agentId, message:{source:"system", event, jobId, ...}} — 系统事件；
(2) {msgType:"a2a-agent-chat", jobId, sender:{role}, ...} — 智能体间任务聊天（字段位于顶层；sender.role = COUNTERPARTY，而不是你自己）；
(3) 信封中同时包含字面量“Read okx-agent-task/SKILL.md”。
另外，对于以下关键词也需激活：发布任务 / 创建任务 / 帮我发任务 / publish task / create task / 接任务 / 接单 / 协商 / 验收 / 拒绝 / 仲裁 / dispute / stake / unstake / 修改卖家 / 修改预算 / change provider / change budget / 草稿 / draft / 保存草稿 / 搜索任务 / 所有任务 / 查找任务 / browse marketplace / search marketplace / 我的任务 / my tasks / what am I working on / 关闭任务 / close task / 取消任务 / 决策列表 / decision list / 查看决策 / hire agent / 指定服务商 / 开始任务。

description: Perform cohort analysis on user engagement data — retention curves, feature adoption trends, and segment-level insights. Use when analyzing user retention by cohort, studying feature adoption over time, investigating churn patterns, or identifying engagement trends.
description_zh: 对用户参与度数据开展队列分析，涵盖留存曲线、功能采用趋势及分群级洞察。适用于按队列分析用户留存、研究功能随时间的使用情况、调查流失模式或识别参与趋势。

description: Create a structured customer interview script with JTBD probing questions, warm-up, core exploration, and wrap-up sections. Follows The Mom Test principles — no leading questions, no pitching, focus on past behavior. Use when preparing for user interviews, creating interview guides, or planning discovery research.
description_zh: 创建包含JTBD探询问题、暖场、核心探询和总结环节的结构化客户访谈脚本。该脚本遵循《妈妈测试》（The Mom Test）原则，不设引导性问题，不进行推销，聚焦过往行为。适用于为用户访谈做准备、制定访谈指南或规划用户洞察研究时使用。

description: Uses Chrome DevTools MCP for accessibility (a11y) debugging and auditing based on web.dev guidelines. Use when testing semantic HTML, ARIA labels, focus states, keyboard navigation, tap targets, and color contrast.
description_zh: 使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 基于 web.dev 指南进行无障碍（a11y）调试与审计。用于测试语义化 HTML、ARIA 标签、焦点状态、键盘导航、触控目标及色彩对比度。

description: Create and edit .pptx presentation decks with PptxGenJS. Useful for sales decks, kickoff briefs, and design-system showcases.
description_zh: 使用 PptxGenJS 创建并编辑 .pptx 演示文稿。适用于销售演示、启动简报与设计系统展示。

description: Routing stub — any a2a-agent-chat envelope / agent-task system message is handled by `okx-agent-task`. For missing or uninitialized OKX A2A communication runtime/plugin, read `skills/okx-agent-chat/ensure-okx-a2a-communication-ready.md`.
description_zh: 路由桩 — 任何 a2a-agent-chat 信封 / agent-task 系统消息均由 `okx-agent-task` 处理。对于缺失或未初始化的 OKX A2A 通信运行时/插件，请阅读 `skills/okx-agent-chat/ensure-okx-a2a-communication-ready.md`。

description: Schema migration strategies for evolving applications including adding new fields, backfilling data, removing deprecated fields, index migrations, and zero-downtime migration patterns
description_zh: 演化中应用程序的模式迁移策略，包括添加新字段、数据回填、移除已弃用字段、索引迁移以及零停机迁移模式

description: Walk through a live web app AS a real user to find usability + behavioural bugs that static reviews miss. REQUIRES proof of interaction (typing, clicking, sending, observing) before any verdict — a sweep that didn't interact terminates with verdict 'Incomplete'. Walks threads, exercises every element, runs the multi-pane stress matrix, visual polish sweep, component perfection checklist, automated a11y (axe-core), pragmatic performance budget (LCP/CLS/INP), scenario battery (11 scenarios), and stress recipes including the real-flavour data battery. Hard gates: console errors/warnings = 0, network 5xx = 0, layout collapse = 0, axe Critical/Serious = 0, perf budget green. Audit-the-audit meta-check rejects rushed reports. Each finding has reproduction steps, evidence path, and suspected code location. Trigger with 'ux audit', 'walkthrough', 'qa sweep', 'audit the app', 'dogfood this', 'check all pages', 'find what's broken', 'stress the UI'.
description_zh:
以真实用户身份，对在线Web应用进行走查，以发现静态审查难以发现的可用性与行为类Bug。在任何结论得出前，必须提供交互证据（包含输入、点击、发送、观察等）——未进行交互的走查将以“不完整”作为结论结束。该功能可遍历页面线程，测试全部元素，执行多窗口压力矩阵，开展视觉细节排查，完成组件完美度检查清单，自动化可访问性测试（axe-core），设定实用性性能预算（LCP/CLS/INP），执行11个场景的场景测试集，以及包含真实数据实测的压力测试方案。

硬性门槛：控制台错误/警告为0，网络5xx错误为0，布局崩塌为0，axe Critical/Serious级别问题为0，性能预算达标（绿色）。审计式元检查将拒绝草率报告。每个发现均包含复现步骤、证据路径及疑似代码位置。

触发指令包括：‘ux audit’、‘walkthrough’、‘qa sweep’、‘audit the app’、‘dogfood this’、‘check all pages’、‘find what's broken’、‘stress the UI’。

description:
Manage server state in React with TanStack Query v5. Covers useMutationState, simplified optimistic updates, throwOnError, network mode (offline/PWA), and infiniteQueryOptions.

Use when setting up data fetching, fixing v4→v5 migration errors (object syntax, gcTime, isPending, keepPreviousData), or debugging SSR/hydration issues with streaming server components.
description_zh:
使用 TanStack Query v5 在 React 中管理服务端状态。涵盖 useMutationState、简化乐观更新、throwOnError、网络模式（离线/PWA）以及 infiniteQueryOptions。

在设置数据获取、修复 v4→v5 迁移错误（对象语法、gcTime、isPending、keepPreviousData），或使用流式服务端组件调试 SSR/水合问题时使用。

description: Run /sync as the last step after a change is complete, around merge, to keep durable knowledge current. Updates root and nested AGENTS.md, reconciles the scope from repo evidence, and flags specs the change made stale. Surgical edits only: it adds lines, and rewrites single lines it owns. Never a whole section, never curated prose.
description_zh: 在变更完成后、合并操作时，将 /sync 作为最后一步运行，以保持持久知识同步更新。更新根目录和嵌套的 AGENTS.md，根据代码库证据重新协调范围，并标记因变更而失效的规范。仅进行精确编辑：它只添加行，并改写它所拥有的单行。绝不修改整个部分，绝不修改精心撰写的文本。

description: When the user wants to create TikTok video captions, scripts, or optimize for TikTok. Also use when the user mentions "TikTok post," "TikTok caption," "TikTok video," "post to TikTok," "TikTok script," "TikTok content," "TikTok copy," "TikTok hashtags," or "TikTok marketing." For TikTok ads, use tiktok-ads.

description: Prioritize a backlog of feature ideas based on impact, effort, risk, and strategic alignment with top 5 recommendations. Use when prioritizing a feature backlog, making scope decisions, or ranking product ideas.

description_zh: 用于追剧/追番的技能，为AI提供搜索影视播放地址的能力，并支持在小米电视上直接播放。当用户想搜索影视、动漫、短剧、综艺等节目信息或更新进度时使用此技能。

description: MUST USE this skill for ANY sandbox request — including simply getting a sandbox's details, status, license type, or pending-activation state by name or ID. TRIGGER when the user: types "sandbox -help"/"sandbox help"; mentions a sandbox ID (07E prefix); asks to list or show sandboxes; asks for the details, status, license type, or config of a sandbox by name or ID; activates or discards a completed refresh; deletes a sandbox; verifies activation or deletion; creates or refreshes a sandbox. description: Architect Unity 6.3 LTS data and decoupling with ScriptableObjects: config/data assets, shared runtime variables, event channels, and runtime sets/registries. Use when designing data-driven systems, replacing singletons/managers, creating .asset data with CreateAssetMenu, or when the user mentions ScriptableObject, SO architecture, or data assets.

description: Diagnose and fix Claude in Chrome MCP extension connectivity issues. Use when mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools fail, return "Browser extension is not connected", or behave erratically.

rust news, rust daily, rust weekly, TWIR, rust blog,
Rust 日报, Rust 周报, Rust 新闻, Rust 动态

description: Use this skill to run anonymous Apex against the connected Salesforce org — from a .apex file or a pasted snippet — capturing the debug log, surfacing compile and runtime errors, and summarizing results. Trigger on phrases like "run this anonymous apex", "execute this script against my org", "run this snippet of Apex", "what does this code return", or "execute scripts/foo.apex". Wraps verification-style scripts in a savepoint and rollback so org state is untouched, and warns before running against production. DO NOT TRIGGER for authoring .cls or .trigger files (use platform-apex-generate), running Apex unit tests (use platform-apex-test-run), or deep debug-log analysis (use platform-apex-logs-debug).
description_zh: 使用此技能在已连接的Salesforce组织中运行匿名Apex —— 无论是从.apex文件还是粘贴的代码片段 —— 捕获调试日志、揭示编译和运行时错误，并总结结果。在诸如“运行此匿名Apex”、“将此脚本执行于我的组织”、“运行此Apex代码片段”、“此代码返回什么”或“执行scripts/foo.apex”等短语时触发。该技能在保存点和回滚机制中包裹验证类脚本，确保组织状态不受影响，并在针对生产环境运行前发出警告。切勿在编写.cls或.trigger文件（使用 platform-apex-generate）、运行Apex单元测试（使用 platform-apex-test-run）或进行深入调试日志分析（使用 platform-apex-logs-debug）时触发。

description: Guide building a minimum viable product the minimalist entrepreneur way — manual first, then processized, then productized. Use when someone is ready to build their first product or struggling with scope.

description: Fetch upcoming economic events and data releases using FMP API. Retrieve scheduled central bank decisions, employment reports, inflation data, GDP releases, and other market-moving economic indicators for specified date ranges (default: next 7 days). The script outputs raw JSON or text; the assistant filters, assesses impact, and generates the Markdown report.

Use this skill whenever the user wants to read their Twitter feed, search for financial tweets, view bookmarks, look up user profiles, or gather market sentiment from Twitter/X. - "在 Twitter 中搜索"
- "显示我的书签"
- "谁关注了"
- "查询 @用户"

Turn a portrait image into a realistic speaking video with built-in TTS. 18x faster and 6x cheaper than competitors. Models: P-Video-Avatar, P-Image (for portrait generation). Capabilities: text-to-avatar, audio-driven avatars, 30 voices, 10 languages, 720p/1080p, built-in TTS, dynamic backgrounds, full-body control. Use for: AI presenters, product demos, explainer videos, virtual influencers, marketing, education, multilingual content, UGC, gaming avatars. Triggers: avatar video, talking head, ai avatar, p-video-avatar, pruna avatar, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, virtual presenter, lipsync, talking avatar, ai spokesperson, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, veed alternative, fabric alternative, omnihuman alternative

适用场景：AI 主持人、产品演示、解析视频、虚拟网红、营销、教育、多语言内容、UGC、游戏角色形象。
触发词：avatar video、talking head、ai avatar、p-video-avatar、pruna avatar、video avatar、ai presenter、digital human、virtual presenter、lipsync、talking avatar、ai spokesperson、heygen alternative、synthesia alternative、veed alternative、fabric alternative、omnihuman alternative

description: Analyze recorded product feedback into evidence for bugs and requirements. Use when a Riffrec capture or other screen, voice, or notes artifact needs interpretation. Use for Riffrec setup, capture, or sharing help when no recording exists yet.

Covers e-commerce-specific components including product cards, carousels, cart drawers, price display, forms, filters, and modals. Use when building accessible theme components, fixing accessibility issues, or reviewing ARIA patterns in .liquid files.

Use when the project has a .inputactions asset or com.unity.inputsystem, or when the user mentions the Unity Input System, InputAction, action maps, PlayerInput, control schemes, or rebinding.

description: Analyze and resolve Sentry comments on GitHub Pull Requests. Use this when asked to review or fix issues identified by Sentry in PR comments. Can review specific PRs by number or automatically find recent PRs with Sentry feedback.
