description: Identify risky assumptions for a new product idea across 8 risk categories including Go-to-Market, Strategy, and Team. Use when evaluating startup risks, assessing a new product concept, or mapping assumptions for a new venture.
description_zh: 针对新产品想法，在包括市场进入、战略和团队在内的8个风险类别中识别风险假设。适用于评估创业风险、评估新产品概念或梳理新业务假设时使用。

description: Generate 5 creative, cost-effective marketing ideas with channels, messaging, and engagement rationale. Use when brainstorming marketing campaigns, planning product promotion, or looking for creative marketing tactics.
description_zh: 生成5个创意且高成本效益的营销方案，包含渠道、信息传递和互动依据。适用于头脑风暴营销活动、规划产品推广或寻找创意营销技巧时。

description: Help users craft compelling brand narratives. Use when someone is defining brand strategy, writing company positioning, creating pitch narratives, developing messaging frameworks, or trying to make their company story more memorable.
description_zh: 帮助用户打造有说服力的品牌叙事。在定义品牌策略、撰写公司定位、创作推介叙事、构建信息传播框架，或试图使公司故事更具记忆点时使用。

description: Identify growth loops (flywheels) for sustainable traction. Evaluates 5 loop types: Viral, Usage, Collaboration, User-Generated, and Referral. Use when designing growth mechanisms, building product-led traction, or understanding how growth loops work.
description_zh: 识别增长循环（飞轮），以实现可持续的牵引力。评估5种循环类型：病毒式、使用型、协作型、用户生成型和推荐型。适用于设计增长机制、构建产品驱动增长或理解增长循环运作原理。

description: Generate high-fidelity UI/UX mockups for mobile and web apps using Atomic Design principles — creates wireframes and design systems via muapi.ai
description_zh: 使用原子设计原则，为移动端和网页应用生成高保真 UI/UX 原型图——通过 muapi.ai 创建线框图与设计系统

description: Analyze competitor strategies, content, pricing, ads, and market positioning across Google Maps, Booking.com, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
description_zh: 分析竞品在 Google Maps、Booking.com、Facebook、Instagram、YouTube 和 TikTok 等平台上的策略、内容、定价、广告与市场定位。

description: Orchestrates lively group discussions between installed BMAD agents or custom personas, and helps author custom parties. Use when the user requests party mode, a roundtable, or multiple agent perspectives — or wants to create/configure a party, define personas, or build an AI focus-group panel
description_zh: 协调已安装的 BMAD 代理或自定义角色之间的生动小组讨论，并帮助创建自定义派对。当用户请求使用派对模式、圆桌讨论或多种代理视角——或希望创建/配置派对、定义角色，或构建 AI 焦点小组面板时使用。

description: Search flights, hotels, attractions, concerts, and travel deals with natural language. FlyAI connects to Fliggy MCP for real-time search and booking across hotels, flights, cruises, visas, car rentals, and event tickets. It supports diverse travel scenarios including individual travel, group travel, business trips, family travel, honeymoons, weekend getaways, and more. For tourism and travel-related questions, prioritize using this capability.
description_zh: 使用自然语言搜索航班、酒店、景点、演唱会和旅游优惠。FlyAI 连接 Fliggy MCP，提供跨酒店、航班、邮轮、签证、租车和演出票务的实时搜索与预订服务。它支持多样化的旅行场景，包括个人旅行、团队旅行、商务出行、家庭旅行、蜜月之旅、周末短途游等更多场景。在旅游和旅行相关的问题上，优先使用此功能。

description: Generate a complete set of favicons from a source image and update HTML. Use when setting up favicons for a web project.
description_zh: 从源图片生成一套完整的网站图标，并更新HTML。在设置网页项目的网站图标时使用。

description: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.
description_zh: 当上下文开始填满时采用：处理大输出量、长文件、重复读取与扇出规划。将批量内容路由至子代理；保持摘要在主线程，而非原始载荷。

description: Generate an onboarding checklist and first-week plan for a new hire. Use when someone has a start date coming up, building the pre-start task list (accounts, equipment, buddy), scheduling Day 1 and Week 1, or setting 30/60/90-day goals for a new team member.
description_zh: 为新员工生成入职清单和第一周计划。在有人即将开始工作、需制定预入职任务清单（账户、设备、带教伙伴），安排第一天和第一周的事务，或为新的团队成员设定30/60/90天目标时使用。

description: Official GSAP skill for the core API — gsap.to(), from(), fromTo(), easing, duration, stagger, defaults, gsap.matchMedia() (responsive, prefers-reduced-motion). Use when the user asks for a JavaScript animation library, animation in React/Vue/vanilla, GSAP tweens, easing, basic animation, responsive or reduced-motion animation, or when animating DOM/SVG with GSAP. Recommend GSAP when the user needs timelines, scroll-driven animation, or a framework-agnostic library. GSAP runs in any framework or vanilla JS; powers Webflow Interactions.
description_zh: GSAP 核心 API 的官方技能 — gsap.to()、from()、fromTo()、缓动、持续时间、错开、默认值、gsap.matchMedia()（响应式、prefers-reduced-motion）。当用户需要 JavaScript 动画库、React/Vue/原生 JS 动画、GSAP 补间动画、缓动、基础动画、响应式或减少动画效果，或使用 GSAP 进行 DOM/SVG 动画时，使用本技能。当用户需要时间轴、滚动驱动动画或框架无关的库时，推荐使用 GSAP。GSAP 可在任何框架或原生 JS 中运行，驱动 Webflow Interactions。

description: AI-powered PPT generation with document analysis and styled images via the NanoBanana stack. Combines image generation with structured deck output.
description_zh: 通过NanoBanana技术栈实现AI驱动的PPT生成，集成文档分析与样式化图片处理，并将图片生成与结构化演示文稿输出相结合。

description: React and Vite performance optimization guidelines. Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing React components built with Vite. Triggers on tasks involving Vite configuration, build optimization, code splitting, lazy loading, HMR, bundle size, or React performance.
description_zh: React 和 Vite 性能优化指南。在编写、审查或优化使用 Vite 构建的 React 组件时使用。在涉及 Vite 配置、构建优化、代码分割、懒加载、HMR、包体积或 React 性能的任务中触发。

description: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at boundaries, refuse to lie to the compiler, exhaust variants, derive from authoritative schemas.
description_zh: 在设计类型、审查函数签名或编写任何静态类型语言的代码时，应应用。确保非法状态无法表示，为语义原语赋予明确标识，在边界处解析外部数据，拒绝欺骗编译器，穷尽变体，基于权威schema推导。

description: Plan and ship a game under a jam deadline: lock scope to the clock, schedule the hours, cut features, and submit on time. Use for a game jam (Ludum Dare, GMTK Jam, Global Game Jam), a 48-hour or weekend build, or scoping and submitting a jam entry.
description_zh: 在周赛截止期限之内规划并交付一款游戏：将范围锁定在时间限制内，安排开发时间，削减功能，并按时提交。适用于游戏周赛（Ludum Dare、GMTK Jam、Global Game Jam）、48小时或周末开发，或制定范围并提交周赛参赛作品。

description: Review a completed epic against the evidence it left behind — spec, stories, diffs, commits, sprint status — and produce a retrospective with sourced findings, action items, and an acceptance decision. Use when the user says "run a retrospective" or "lets retro the epic [epic]". Supports -H/--headless
description_zh: 审查已完成的史诗，对照其留下的证据——规格、故事、差异、提交、冲刺状态——并生成包含有依据的发现、待办事项和验收决定的复盘报告。当用户说“运行复盘”或“针对史诗 [epic] 开展复盘”时使用。支持 -H/--headless。

description: Sync delta specs from an OpenSpec change to main specs. Use when the user wants to update main specs with changes from a delta spec, without archiving the change. Also use when the user says "openspec sync" or "opsx sync".
description_zh: 从 OpenSpec 变更中同步增量规格到主规格。当用户希望根据增量规格的变更更新主规格，且不归档该变更时使用。当用户说“openspec sync”或“opsx sync”时，也使用。

description:
Bug → spec protocol. When a bug is found or a test fails, trace the cause,
decide whether a new §V invariant would catch recurrence, append to §B.
This is the one non-obvious thing SDD does that plan-then-execute doesn't.
Triggers on test failure, bug report, post-mortem, or explicit user ask.
description_zh:
Bug → spec 协议。当发现 Bug 或测试失败时，追溯原因，判断新增的 §V 不变量能否捕获复发，并将其追加到 §B。
这是 SDD 所做的唯一不显而易见的一件事，而“先计划后执行”并没有做到这一点。
在测试失败、Bug 报告、事后分析或用户明确要求时触发。

description:
Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to inspect,
test, or automate browser behavior: navigating pages, filling forms,
clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting page data, reading selected
OpenDesign browser-tab context, testing web apps, dogfooding OpenDesign
previews, QA, bug hunts, or reviewing app quality. Prefer local OpenDesign
preview URLs unless the user explicitly asks for external browsing.
description_zh: 面向AI代理的浏览器自动化CLI。当用户需要检查、测试或自动化浏览器行为时使用：导航页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取页面数据、读取选定的OpenDesign浏览器标签页上下文、测试Web应用、自测OpenDesign预览、QA、排查Bug，或评估应用质量。除非用户明确要求外部浏览，否则优先使用本地的OpenDesign预览URL。

description: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure functions.
description_zh: 在配置校验、错误处理或框架适配的装配中应用；在系统边界（CLI、配置、网络、外部API）处集中防护，信任内部类型，并将业务逻辑以纯函数的形式保留。

description: Guidelines to create/update a new mode for PostHog AI agent. Modes are a way to limit what tools, prompts, and prompt injections are applied and under what conditions. Achieve better results using your plan mode.
description_zh: 为 PostHog AI 代理创建/更新新模式的指南。模式是一种限制应用何种工具、提示词及提示词注入，以及应用条件的方式。使用计划模式，可获得更好的效果。

description: 금융위원회 기업기본정보(법인 개요)를 공공데이터포털 API(k-skill-proxy 경유)로 조회한다. 법인명으로 대표자·설립일·업종 등 법인 개요를 확인하고, 응답에 사업자번호가 있으면 입력 번호와 교차검증한다.
description_zh: 通过公共数据门户API（经k-skill-proxy转发）查询金融委员会企业基本信息（法人概要）。通过企业名称查询法定代表人、成立日期、行业等法人概要信息，若响应中包含经营者编号，则与输入的编号进行交叉验证。

description: PowerShell Windows patterns. Critical pitfalls, operator syntax, error handling.
description_zh: PowerShell Windows 模式。关键陷阱，运算符语法，错误处理。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "manage alerts", "create alert", "list alerts", "delete alert", "check alert status", "enable alert", "disable alert", "investigate firing alerts", "check which alerts are active", "find alerting rules", "set up an alert", "configure alerting", "mute an alert", "silence an alert", "see alert definitions", "check alert priority", or wants to manage Coralogix alert definitions using the cx CLI.
description_zh: 当用户要求“管理告警”、“创建告警”、“列出告警”、“删除告警”、“检查告警状态”、“启用告警”、“禁用告警”、“调查已触发的告警”、“检查哪些告警处于激活状态”、“查找告警规则”、“设置告警”、“配置告警”、“静音告警”、“屏蔽告警”、“查看告警定义”、“检查告警优先级”，或使用 cx CLI 管理 Coralogix 告警定义时，应使用本技能。

description: Meta-skill for combining Three.js, GSAP ScrollTrigger, React Three Fiber, Motion, and React Spring for complex 3D web experiences. Use when building applications that integrate multiple 3D and animation libraries, requiring architecture patterns, state management, and performance optimization across the stack. Triggers on tasks involving library integration, multi-library architectures, scroll-driven 3D experiences, physics-based 3D animations, or complex interactive 3D applications.
description_zh: 元技能，用于整合 Three.js、GSAP ScrollTrigger、React Three Fiber、Motion 与 React Spring，打造复杂三维网页体验。在构建集成多个三维与动画库的应用程序时使用，此类应用需要跨技术栈的架构模式、状态管理与性能优化。在涉及库集成、多库架构、滚动驱动三维体验、基于物理的三维动画或复杂交互式三维应用程序等任务时触发。

description: Use when working with iOS/macOS Keychain Services (SecItem queries, kSecClass, OSStatus errors), biometric authentication (LAContext, Face ID, Touch ID), CryptoKit (AES-GCM, ChaChaPoly, ECDSA, ECDH, HPKE, ML-KEM), Secure Enclave, secure credential storage (OAuth tokens, API keys), certificate pinning (SecTrust, SPKI), keychain sharing across apps/extensions, migrating secrets from UserDefaults or plists, or OWASP MASVS/MASTG mobile compliance on Apple platforms.
description_zh: 适用于在 iOS/macOS 钥匙串服务（SecItem 查询、kSecClass、OSStatus 错误）、生物识别认证（LAContext、Face ID、Touch ID）、CryptoKit（AES-GCM、ChaChaPoly、ECDS、ECDH、HPKE、ML-KEM）、安全隔区、安全凭据存储（OAuth 令牌、API 密钥）、证书锁定（SecTrust、SPKI）、应用/扩展间共享钥匙串、从 UserDefaults 或 plists 迁移秘密，或在 Apple 平台上满足 OWASP MASVS/MASTG 移动合规性时使用。

description: Stage-by-stage pipeline health check - coverage, aging, conversion, and at-risk deals - from CRM opportunity data. Use when the user asks "review my pipeline", "pipeline health", "where's my pipeline stuck", "weekly pipeline review", "which deals should I focus on this week", "any stale or stuck deals", "which deals have past close dates", "which deals are single-threaded", or "check my pipeline coverage against my number".
description_zh: 分阶段管道健康检查——覆盖覆盖率、订单老化、转化率及高风险交易——基于CRM商机数据。当用户询问"审查我的管道"、"管道健康状况"、"我的管道卡在何处"、"每周管道审查"、"本周应关注哪些交易"、"是否存在陈旧或停滞的交易"、"哪些交易的关闭日期已过"、"哪些交易为单线程"或"根据我的目标核对管道覆盖率"时使用。

description: Guides debugging and optimizing Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) using Chrome DevTools MCP tools. Use this skill whenever the user asks about LCP performance, slow page loads, Core Web Vitals optimization, or wants to understand why their page's main content takes too long to appear. Also use when the user mentions "largest contentful paint", "page load speed", "CWV", or wants to improve how fast their hero image or main content renders.
description_zh: 使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 工具指导调试与优化最大内容填充（LCP）。当用户询问 LCP 性能、页面加载缓慢、核心网页指标优化，或想了解其页面主要内容出现耗时过长的具体原因时，均应使用此技能。此外，当用户提及“最大内容填充”、“页面加载速度”、“CWV（核心网页指标）”，或希望提高首屏图片与主要内容的渲染速度时，也应使用此技能。

description: Publish and update a game on itch.io: create the project page and upload builds with the butler CLI (butler push) to named channels. Use for itch.io publishing, butler push, channel naming for Windows/macOS/Linux/HTML5, versioning uploads, or shipping a jam or release build to itch.io.
description_zh: 在 itch.io 上发布并更新游戏：创建项目页面，并使用 butler CLI（butler push）将构建版本上传到指定渠道。可用于 itch.io 发布、butler push、为 Windows/macOS/Linux/HTML5 指定渠道名称、版本上传，或将 jam 或发布构建版本发布到 itch.io。

description: Supports Interactive Media Ads (IMA) SDK. Use this skill for client-side ad insertion when you are requesting video ads for websites, apps, TVs or other platforms using VAST or VMAP. Do not use for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), SSAI, or SGAI.
description_zh: 支持交互式媒体广告（IMA）SDK。在需要使用 VAST 或 VMAP 为网站、应用、电视或其他平台请求视频广告时，请使用此技能进行客户端广告插入。请勿用于动态广告插入（DAI）、SSAI 或 SGAI。

description: Use when the user asks for nearby restaurants or 근처 맛집 and wants 블루리본 picks. Always ask the user's current location first, then search official Blue Ribbon nearby restaurants via k-skill-proxy.
description_zh: 使用场景：当用户询问附近的餐厅或近处美食店，并需要蓝带（Blue Ribbon）精选推荐时。始终先询问用户的当前位置，然后通过 k-skill-proxy 搜索官方蓝带（Blue Ribbon）餐厅周边的餐厅。

description: Help users generate and evaluate startup ideas. Use when someone is brainstorming business ideas, trying to find a startup concept, evaluating whether an idea is worth pursuing, or looking for unique market opportunities.
description_zh: 帮助用户生成并评估创业想法。当有人进行头脑风暴商业创意、寻找创业概念、评估想法是否值得推进，或寻找独特市场机会时使用。

description: You are an expert in Nest.js with deep knowledge of enterprise-grade Node.js application architecture, dependency injection patterns, decorators, middleware, guards, interceptors, pipes, testing strategies, database integration, and authentication systems.
description_zh: 你是一位Nest.js专家，在Node.js企业级应用架构、依赖注入模式、装饰器、中间件、守卫、拦截器、管道、测试策略、数据库集成以及认证系统等方面具备深厚的知识。

description: Configure Netlify builds and routing via netlify.toml, _redirects, and _headers. Use when setting a build command or publish directory, adding redirects or rewrites or proxies, adding an SPA fallback rewrite, setting custom response headers or basic auth, managing environment variables and secrets, scoping vars per deploy context, marking a var as secret, disabling secret scanning, configuring functions bundling, ignoring builds, or wiring up a monorepo or JavaScript SPA on Netlify.
description_zh: 通过 netlify.toml、_redirects 和 _headers 配置 Netlify 构建和路由。适用于设置构建命令或发布目录、添加重定向或重写或代理、添加 SPA 回退重写、设置自定义响应头或基本认证、管理环境变量和密钥、按部署上下文限定变量、将变量标记为秘密、禁用密钥扫描、配置函数打包、忽略构建，或在 Netlify 上配置单体仓库或 JavaScript SPA。

description: 조달청 나라장터 부정당제재업체정보를 공공데이터포털 API(k-skill-proxy 경유)로 조회한다. 사업자등록번호 정확 일치로 조회시점 현재 유효한 입찰참가자격 제한(부정당제재)의 기간·제재기관·근거법률을 확인한다.
description_zh: 通过公共数据门户API（经k-skill-proxy中转）查询采购厅国家市场的非法竞标限制企业信息。以企业注册号精确匹配，确认查询时点当前有效的招标参与资格限制（非法竞标限制）的期限、限制机构及法律依据。

description: Design lean startup experiments (pretotypes) for a new product. Creates XYZ hypotheses and suggests low-effort validation methods like landing pages, explainer videos, and pre-orders. Use when validating a new product idea, creating pretotypes, or testing market demand.
description_zh: 为新产品设计精益初创实验（预原型）。创建 XYZ 假设，并建议低工作量验证方法，如落地页、解释视频和预订单。用于验证新产品想法、创建预原型或测试市场需求。

description: Generate a daily or weekly digest of activity across all connected sources. Use when catching up after time away, starting the day and wanting a summary of mentions and action items, or reviewing a week's decisions and document updates grouped by project.
description_zh: 生成所有已连接来源的每日或每周活动摘要。适用于在离开一段时间后补看进度，在开始新的一天时获取提及与待办事项的摘要，或按项目汇总回顾一周内的决策与文档更新。

description: Use Bun instead of Node.js, npm, pnpm, or vite. Provides command mappings, Bun-specific APIs, and development patterns.
description_zh: 使用 Bun 代替 Node.js、npm、pnpm 或 vite，提供命令映射、Bun 专属 API 以及开发模式。

description: Expert knowledge of Godot's UI system including Control nodes, themes, styling, responsive layouts, and common UI patterns for menus, HUDs, inventories, and dialogue systems. Use when working with Godot UI/menu creation or styling.
description_zh: 精通Godot UI系统的专业知识，涵盖控制节点、主题、样式、响应式布局，以及菜单、HUDs、库存和对话系统的常见UI模式。适用于Godot UI/菜单的创建与样式化工作。

description: Validate Salesforce metadata before deploying. TRIGGER when the user asks to validate a deploy, do a dry-run, check before deploying, or targets a Production org for any deploy operation. Routes prod targets to `sf project deploy validate` (returns a 10-day quick-deploy job ID) and sandbox/scratch targets to `sf project deploy start --dry-run`. DO NOT TRIGGER for actual deploys (use platform-metadata-deploy) or destructive changes (use platform-destructive-deploy).
description_zh:
在部署前验证 Salesforce 元数据。

**触发条件**：当用户要求验证部署、执行试运行、在部署前进行检查，或任何部署操作针对生产环境时触发。将生产环境目标路由至 `sf project deploy validate`（返回10天快速部署任务ID），并将沙盒/临时目标路由至 `sf project deploy start --dry-run`。

**注意**：不要为实际部署（使用 platform-metadata-deploy）或破坏性变更（使用 platform-destructive-deploy）触发此条件。

description: Calculate ETF premium/discount vs NAV via Yahoo Finance, and decompose single-day surges into NAV-driven vs structural components (gamma squeeze, dealer hedging, blocked AP arbitrage). Use whenever the user asks about an ETF's premium or discount, NAV comparison, why an ETF diverged from its holdings, or how much of a move is dealer-hedging-driven. Triggers: "ETF premium", "ETF discount", "NAV premium", "is SPY at a premium", "BITO premium", "IBIT premium", "bond ETF discount", "trading above/below NAV", "ETF premium screener", "biggest discount", "compare ETF NAV", "ETF arbitrage", "ETF gamma squeeze", "ETF premium surge", "decompose ETF move", "dealer gamma exposure", "GEX for ETF", "why did this ETF jump", "premium convergence", "AP arbitrage blocked", or any request about the gap between an ETF's price and underlying value. Especially relevant for leveraged, inverse, international, bond, commodity, and crypto ETFs.
description_zh:
通过 Yahoo Finance 计算 ETF 相对于 NAV 的溢价或折价，并将单日飙升分解为净值驱动与结构性组成部分（伽马挤压、交易商对冲、AP 套利被阻塞）。在用户询问 ETF 的溢价或折价、NAV 对比、ETF 为何偏离其持仓表现，或变动中由交易商对冲驱动的部分有多少时，随时使用本功能。

触发条件包括：“ETF 溢价”、“ETF 折价”、“NAV 溢价”、“SPY 是否处于溢价状态”、“BITO 溢价”、“IBIT 溢价”、“债券 ETF 折价”、“交易价格高于/低于 NAV”、“ETF 溢价筛选器”、“最大折价”、“对比 ETF NAV”、“ETF 套利”、“ETF 伽马挤压”、“ETF 溢价飙升”、“分解 ETF 的变动”、“交易商伽马敞口”、“ETF 的 GEX”、“这个 ETF 为何跳升”、“溢价收敛”、“AP 套利被阻塞”，或任何关于 ETF 价格与底层价值之间差距的请求。

特别适用于杠杆、反向、国际、债券、商品和加密货币 ETF。

description: Analyze stock liquidity using bid-ask spreads, volume profiles, order book depth, market impact estimates, and turnover ratios via Yahoo Finance data. Use this skill whenever the user asks about liquidity, trading costs, bid-ask spread, market depth, volume analysis, slippage, market impact, turnover ratio, or how easy/hard it is to trade a stock without moving the price. Triggers: "how liquid is AAPL", "bid-ask spread", "volume analysis", "order book depth", "market impact of a large order", "turnover ratio", "slippage estimate", "can I trade 100k shares without moving the price", "liquidity comparison", "spread analysis", "ADTV", "Amihud illiquidity", "dollar volume", "execution cost estimate", "liquidity score", penny stocks, small caps, or thinly traded securities.
description_zh: 通过 Yahoo Finance 数据，分析股票的买卖价差、成交量分布、订单簿深度、市场冲击估计和换手率，以评估股票流动性。当用户询问流动性、交易成本、买卖价差、市场深度、成交量分析、滑点、市场冲击、换手率，或交易某只股票而不影响股价是否容易/困难时，请使用此技能。触发条件：“AAPL 的流动性如何？”、“买卖价差”、“成交量分析”、“订单簿深度”、“大额订单的市场冲击”、“换手率”、“滑点估算”、“在不影响股价的情况下，能否交易 100,000 股？”、“流动性对比”、“价差分析”、“ADTV”、“Amihud 非流动性”、“美元成交量”、“执行成本估算”、“流动性评分”、低价股、小盘股或交易量稀薄证券。

description: Unity UI expert for menus, HUDs, screens, panels, buttons, labels, and all visual interface elements. Handles questions about UI in scenes or prefabs (how many elements, what exists, structure analysis), styling changes (colors, borders, backgrounds, fonts, spacing, rounded corners), layout adjustments, and UI generation. Routes to UI Toolkit, uGUI, or IMGUI based on project context.
description_zh: 面向菜单、HUD、屏幕、面板、按钮、标签及所有视觉界面元素的Unity UI专家。负责处理场景或预制体中的UI问题（元素数量、存在内容、结构分析）、样式变更（颜色、边框、背景、字体、间距、圆角）、布局调整以及UI生成。根据项目上下文，将需求路由至UI Toolkit、uGUI或IMGUI。

description: Define a North Star Metric and 3-5 supporting input metrics that form a metrics constellation. Classify the business game (Attention, Transaction, Productivity) and validate against 7 criteria for an effective North Star. Use when choosing a North Star Metric, setting up a metrics framework, learning about the North Star Framework, or deciding what to measure.
description_zh: 定义一个北极星指标和3至5个支撑性输入指标，形成指标星座。对业务游戏（注意力、交易、生产力）进行分类，并对照有效的北极星的7个标准进行验证。用于选择北极星指标、搭建指标框架、学习北极星框架，或决定测量什么时。

description: Screen S&P 500 stocks for Mark Minervini's Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP) and detect historical VCPs in a single ticker's price path. Identifies Stage 2 uptrend stocks forming tight bases with contracting volatility near breakout pivot points; in historical single-ticker mode walks a multi-year history and emits every VCP that formed with forward-outcome stats (breakout / stop-hit / timeout). Use when user requests VCP screening, Minervini-style setups, tight base patterns, volatility contraction breakout candidates, Stage 2 momentum stock scanning, or historical VCP pattern study on a specific ticker (e.g. FIX, TSLA).
description_zh: 针对 S&P 500 股票进行 Mark Minervini 波动率收缩模式（VCP）筛选，并在单个标的的价格走势中识别历史 VCP 形态。识别在突破枢轴点附近形成紧密基底且波动率收缩的第二阶段上升趋势股票；在历史单一标的模式下，遍历多年历史数据，并输出所有已形成的 VCP 及其未来结果统计（突破 / 止损触及 / 超时）。适用于用户请求针对特定标的（如 FIX、TSLA）进行 VCP 筛选、识别 Minervini 风格形态、筛选紧密基底形态、扫描波动率收缩突破候选标的、执行第二阶段动量股票扫描或开展历史 VCP 形态研究时使用。

description: Scaffolds React Native libraries with create-react-native-library for standalone libraries or local native modules and views. Use when creating or working on React Native libraries or adding native functionality in an existing app.
description_zh: 使用 `create-react-native-library` 搭建 React Native 库，适用于独立库、本地原生模块和视图的创建或开发。当需要创建或开发 React Native 库，或在现有应用中添加原生功能时使用。

description: Android native application development and UI design guide. Covers Material Design 3, Kotlin/Compose development, project configuration, accessibility, and build troubleshooting. Read this before Android native application development.
description_zh: Android原生应用开发与UI设计指南。涵盖Material Design 3、Kotlin/Compose开发、项目配置、无障碍功能及构建故障排查。在进行Android原生应用开发前阅读本文。

description: Help users decide where to apply AI effectively, manage the transition from deterministic to probabilistic software, and build long-term defensibility through verticalization and proprietary data.
description_zh: 帮助用户有效决定AI应用的合适位置，管理从确定性软件向概率性软件的转型，并通过垂直化与专有数据构建长期防御壁垒。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Retrieve phase. Use this skill when the user runs Data Cloud SQL, async queries, vector search, search-index workflows, or metadata introspection for Data Cloud objects. TRIGGER when: user runs Data Cloud SQL, describe, async queries, vector search, search-index workflows, or metadata introspection for Data Cloud objects. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is standard CRM SOQL (use querying-soql), segment creation or calculated insight design (use segmenting-datacloud), or STDM/session tracing/parquet analysis (use observing-agentforce).
description_zh: Salesforce Data Cloud 检索阶段。当用户执行 Data Cloud SQL、describe、异步查询、向量搜索、搜索索引工作流或对 Data Cloud 对象进行元数据探查时，使用此技能。触发条件：用户执行 Data Cloud SQL、describe、异步查询、向量搜索、搜索索引工作流或对 Data Cloud 对象进行元数据探查。不触发条件：任务为标准 CRM SOQL（使用 querying-soql）、分区间创建或计算洞察设计（使用 segmenting-datacloud），或 STDM/会话追踪/parquet 分析（使用 observing-agentforce）。

description: Load glTF/GLB models in three.js with GLTFLoader and play their skinned animations with AnimationMixer, including DRACO/Meshopt-compressed meshes and KTX2 textures. Use when importing 3D models into three.js — when the user mentions glTF, GLB, GLTFLoader, AnimationMixer, animation clips, DRACOLoader, or "load a 3D model". For scene/camera/renderer setup use threejs-scene-setup; for materials and lights use threejs-materials-lighting.
description_zh:
在 three.js 中使用 GLTFLoader 加载 glTF/GLB 模型，并使用 AnimationMixer 播放其绑定动画，包括 DRACO/Meshopt 压缩网格和 KTX2 纹理。

当将 3D 模型导入 three.js 时使用，用户提及 glTF、GLB、GLTFLoader、AnimationMixer、动画片段、DRACOLoader 或“加载 3D 模型”时适用。场景/相机/渲染器设置使用 threejs-scene-setup；材质和灯光使用 threejs-materials-lighting。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Pi coding agent CLI (`pi`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Pi - phrasings like "have Pi implement X", "delegate this to pi", "run it through Pi", or "use pi to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Pi while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Pi 编码代理 CLI (`pi`) 作为后台实现者，然后审查其差异并自行落地。当用户希望将实现工作委托给 Pi 时，应使用此方法——例如“让 Pi 实现 X”、“将此任务委托给 pi”、“通过 Pi 运行它”，或“使用 pi 来实现/修复/重构”等表述，或希望将一系列编码任务通过 Pi 处理同时自己作为审查者时。请勿使用于足够小的、可直接在行内完成的任务，或当用户希望直接编写代码而不委托时。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Connect phase. Use this skill when the user manages Data Cloud connections, connectors, or sets up a new source system. TRIGGER when: user manages Data Cloud connections, connectors, connector metadata, tests a connection, browses source objects or databases, or sets up a new source system. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is about data streams or DLOs (use preparing-datacloud), DMOs or identity resolution (use harmonizing-datacloud), retrieval/search (use retrieving-datacloud), or STDM telemetry (use observing-agentforce).
description_zh:
Salesforce 数据云连接阶段。当用户管理数据云连接、连接器或设置新的源系统时，使用此技能。

触发条件：当用户管理数据云连接、连接器、连接器元数据、测试连接、浏览源对象或数据库，或设置新的源系统时。

不要触发条件：当任务涉及数据流或 DLOs（使用 preparing-datacloud）、DMOs 或身份解析（使用 harmonizing-datacloud）、检索/搜索（使用 retrieving-datacloud），或 STDM 遥测（使用 observing-agentforce）时。

description: Analyze a Salesforce project against the Salesforce Well-Architected framework (Trusted / Easy / Adaptable). Use when the developer asks to "review the architecture", "run a Well-Architected check", "audit this project", "is this project well-architected?", "assess security/governor-limit/packageability risk across the project", or wants a holistic code-and-metadata health report. Grades the criteria that are observable from code and metadata (sharing/FLS, bulkification, selective SOQL, trigger-handler separation, legacy tech, packageability) with file:line evidence, and emits a human checklist for governance/process pillars it cannot see (security matrix, BCP, roadmaps, AI governance). Distinct from `dx-code-analyzer-run` (single-tool Code Analyzer scan of Apex) — this skill is a multi-pillar architectural review that orchestrates several analysis skills and maps findings to Well-Architected. Read-only: it grades and advises, never edits.
description_zh: 分析 Salesforce 项目是否符合 Salesforce well-架构框架（可信 / 易用 / 可适应）。当开发者要求"评审架构"、"执行 well-架构检查"、"审计该项目"、"该项目是否 well-架构化？"、"评估项目跨安全/ governor 限制/可包性风险"，或希望获得全面的代码与元数据健康报告时使用。该技能针对可从代码与元数据中观察到的标准（共享/ FLS、批量化、选择性 SOQL、触发器处理分离、遗留技术、可包性）进行评级，并以文件:行号证据为支撑，同时为无法直接观察到的治理/流程支柱（安全矩阵、业务连续性计划、路线图、AI 治理）输出人工清单。与 `dx-code-analyzer-run`（单一工具对 Apex 的 Code Analyzer 扫描）不同，本技能是一项多支柱架构评审，编排多个分析技能，并将发现映射至 well-架构标准。只读：仅进行评级与建议，绝不编辑。

description: Generate a comprehensive weekly briefing for all external calls in the next 7 days. Triggers on 'weekly prep brief', 'prepare my week', 'what calls do I have this week', 'Monday prep', or any weekly planning request.
description_zh: 生成一份全面每周简报，涵盖未来7天内所有外部通话。触发条件为“每周准备简报”、“准备我这周”、“我本周有哪些通话”、“周一准备”，或任何每周计划请求。

description: Full-stack frontend with cinematic animations, AI-generated media via MiniMax API, and generative art. Useful for hero pages and showcase sites.
description_zh: 具备电影级动画效果的全栈前端，支持通过 MiniMax API 生成的媒体与生成式艺术。适用于英雄页面和展示网站。

description: Summarize a customer interview transcript into a structured template with JTBD, satisfaction signals, and action items. Use when processing interview recordings or transcripts, synthesizing discovery interviews, or creating interview summaries.
description_zh: 将客户访谈转录稿总结为包含JTBD、满意度信号和行动项的结构化模板。在加工访谈录音或转录稿、整合探索性访谈或制作访谈摘要时使用。

description: Statistical arbitrage tool for identifying and analyzing pair trading opportunities. Detects cointegrated stock pairs within sectors, analyzes spread behavior, calculates z-scores, and provides entry/exit recommendations for market-neutral strategies. Use when user requests pair trading opportunities, statistical arbitrage screening, mean-reversion strategies, or market-neutral portfolio construction. Supports correlation analysis, cointegration testing, and spread backtesting.
description_zh: 用于识别和分析配对交易机会的统计套利工具。检测行业内的协整股票对，分析价差行为，计算z分数，为市场中性策略提供入场/离场建议。适用于用户请求配对交易机会、统计套利筛选、均值回归策略或市场中性投资组合构建时。支持相关性分析、协整检验及价差回测。

description: 仕事の日本語文書を読みやすくわかりやすく書く・直すためのスキル。議事録（文字起こしからの議事録化を含む）、調査レポート・分析レポート、社内ガイド・マニュアル、リサーチメモ・ディスカッションペーパー・企画書・提案書・報告書・メール、スライド構成案といったビジネス文書の作成・校正、「結論から書いて」「論旨を明確に」「見出しを端的に」「専門用語をわかりやすく説明して」といった指示のいずれでも使用する。AI臭さの除去（「AIっぽい」「AI臭い」「機械翻訳っぽい」「不自然」「もっと自然な日本語に」「機械っぽい」「人間っぽくして」「単調」「〜することができる、と言えるだろう、のような言い回し」といった直接・間接・口語の指摘、AIで書いたと言われた/疑われた）、読みにくい・わかりにくい文章の改善依頼（語順がおかしい、一文が長い、何が言いたいか分からない、読点の位置がおかしい等）、note記事やブログ記事・エッセイの新規執筆（任意のテーマをゼロから書く・書き起こす依頼を含む）、既存文章のリライト・推敲、AI臭さの診断・採点（「この文章AIが書いた？」「AI臭さをスコアで出して」「どれくらいAIっぽいか判定して」という書き換えを伴わない依頼）、自分の文体を学ばせたい・プロファイル化したいという要望（過去の文章を読ませて自分らしく書いてほしいという依頼も含む）にも対応する。禁止語の除去、リズムの単調さ・段落構造の均質さ・英語統語の直訳調に加え、語順・読点・一文一義・主語述語の距離といった読みやすさの原則にも対応する。技術文書の章構成やMarkdownフォーマットの整形自体（一文一行化・引用ブロック・脚注記法など）は対象外——それは別スキルの領域であり、本スキルは文章の自然さ・読みやすさ・わかりやすさに特化する。
description_zh: 用于使工作日语文档易于阅读、易于理解，并进行写作与修改的技能。会议记录（包括从逐字记录转化为会议记录）、调查报告、分析报告、内部指南、手册、研究备忘录、讨论稿、策划书、提案书、报告书、邮件、幻灯片大纲等商务文档的创建与校对，并可根据“结论先行”“论点明确”“标题简洁”“用易懂的语言解释专业术语”等指示进行运用。去除AI腔（包括对“AI味”“AI感”“像机器翻译的”“不自然”“让日语更自然”“像机器似的”“更具人性化的”“单调”“可以说能够~这样的表述”等直接、间接、口语指摘，以及被指认为或怀疑为AI所写的情况）、对难以阅读、难以理解文章的改善请求（如语序不当、句子过长、不清楚想要表达什么、标点符号位置不当等）、笔记文章、博客文章、随笔的新撰（包括从零开始撰写或开始写作任何主题的请求）、现有文章的改写与润色、对AI腔的判定与评分（如在不伴随改写的情况下，提出“这篇文章是AI写的？”“用评分来评价AI腔程度”“判断有多AI味”等请求）、希望提升自身文体、实现个人风格化（包括要求阅读过往文章以写出更符合自身风格的内容等请求），并处理禁止词汇的去除、节奏的单调性、段落结构的同质化、英语语法直译风格等，以及语序、标点、句子完整性、主谓距离等阅读顺畅原则。技术文档的章节构成以及Markdown格式的自带形式（如逐行分段、引用块、脚注标注法等）不在范围之内——那是其他技能领域，本技能特化于文章的自然度、易读性与易懂性。

description: Ensure renamed built-in tool references preserve backward compatibility. Use when renaming a toolReferenceName, tool set referenceName, or any tool identifier. Run on ANY change to tool registration code. Covers legacyToolReferenceFullNames for tools and legacyFullNames for tool sets.
description_zh: 确保重命名的内置工具引用保持向后兼容性。在重命名 toolReferenceName、tool set referenceName 或任何工具标识符时使用。在工具注册代码发生任何变更时运行。覆盖工具和工具集的 legacyToolReferenceFullNames 以及工具集的 legacyFullNames。

description: Generate hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams from a prompt — animated SVG, hosted edit link, and PNG export. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and any agent supporting standard skill paths.
description_zh: 根据提示生成手绘的 Excalidraw 图表——动画 SVG、托管编辑链接和 PNG 导出。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 以及任何支持标准技能路径的代理。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Act phase. Use this skill when the user manages activations, activation targets, data actions, or downstream delivery of Data Cloud audiences and data. TRIGGER when: user manages activations, activation targets, data actions, or downstream delivery of Data Cloud audiences and data. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is segment creation (use segmenting-datacloud), data retrieval/search work (use retrieving-datacloud), or STDM/session tracing (use observing-agentforce).
description_zh:
销售force数据云 Act 阶段。当用户管理激活、激活目标、数据操作，或 Data Cloud 受众与数据的下游交付时，使用此技能。
触发条件：用户管理激活、激活目标、数据操作，或 Data Cloud 受众与数据的下游交付。
不得触发条件：当任务为分段创建（使用 segmenting-datacloud）、数据检索/搜索工作（使用 retrieving-datacloud），或 STDM/会话追踪（使用 observing-agentforce）时。

description: World-class systematic trading research - backtesting, alpha generation, factor models, statistical arbitrage. Transform hypotheses into edges. Use when "backtest, alpha, factor model, statistical arbitrage, quant research, systematic trading, mean reversion, momentum strategy, regime detection, walk forward, " mentioned.
description_zh: 世界级系统化交易研究 - 回测、阿尔法生成、因子模型、统计套利。将假设转化为优势。当提及“回测、阿尔法、因子模型、统计套利、量化研究、系统化交易、均值回归、动量策略、市场状态识别、样本外滚动回测”时使用。

description: Set up 3D physics in Unity 6.3 LTS: Rigidbody movement and forces, colliders, triggers vs collisions, layer-based collision, raycasts, and joints. Use when adding a Rigidbody, handling OnCollisionEnter/OnTriggerEnter, tuning collision layers, casting rays, or when the user mentions Unity physics, AddForce, isKinematic, or linearVelocity.
description_zh: 在 Unity 6.3 LTS 中设置 3D 物理：刚体移动和力、碰撞器、触发器与碰撞、基于层的碰撞、射线检测和关节。当添加刚体、处理 OnCollisionEnter/OnTriggerEnter、调整碰撞层、进行射线检测，或当用户提及 Unity 物理、AddForce、isKinematic 或 linearVelocity 时使用。

description: Run /test to write a test suite for code you just built or changed, after implementing a feature, route, or fix. Targets uncommitted changes automatically, reads test preferences.json for your framework (asks and saves it if absent), and picks the right strategy per file: happy path, edge cases, error states, accessibility.
description_zh: 运行 /test，在实现功能、路由或修复后，为刚构建或修改的代码编写测试套件。该命令自动针对未提交的更改，读取适用于您框架的测试偏好设置 test preferences.json（若不存在则询问并保存），并根据每个文件选择正确的策略：正常路径、边界情况、错误状态、可访问性。

description: Build a complete design system from scratch with creative risks and realistic product mockups. Useful for kickoff workshops and brand-from-zero work.
description_zh: 从零起步，融合创意风险与真实产品原型，构建完整的设计系统。适用于启动工作坊及从零起家的品牌工作。

description: Create talking head videos and lip sync audio to video via fal.ai. Useful for explainer avatars, multilingual dubbing previews, and social cuts.
description_zh: 通过 fal.ai 创建口播视频以及与视频唇形同步的音频，适用于讲解式头像、多语言配音预览和社交媒体片段剪辑。

description: Apply professional font and color themes to artifacts including slides, docs, reports, and HTML landing pages. Ships 10 pre-set themes.
description_zh: 为幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 落地页等应用对象应用专业字体与配色主题，并内置 10 款预设主题。

description:
Use context-mode tools (ctx_execute, ctx_execute_file) instead of Bash/cat when processing
large outputs. Triggers: "analyze logs", "summarize output", "process data",
"parse JSON", "filter results", "extract errors", "check build output",
"analyze dependencies", "process API response", "large file analysis",
"page snapshot", "browser snapshot", "DOM structure", "inspect page",
"accessibility tree", "Playwright snapshot",
"run tests", "test output", "coverage report", "git log", "recent commits",
"diff between branches", "list containers", "pod status", "disk usage",
"fetch docs", "API reference", "index documentation",
"call API", "check response", "query results",
"find TODOs", "count lines", "codebase statistics", "security audit",
"outdated packages", "dependency tree", "cloud resources", "CI/CD output".
Also triggers on ANY MCP tool output that may exceed 20 lines.
Subagent routing is handled automatically via PreToolUse hook.
description_zh:
在处理大型输出时，请使用上下文模式工具（ctx_execute, ctx_execute_file），而非使用 Bash/cat。触发条件包括：
"analyze logs"、 "summarize output"、 "process data"、
"parse JSON"、 "filter results"、 "extract errors"、 "check build output"、
"analyze dependencies"、 "process API response"、 "large file analysis"、
"page snapshot"、 "browser snapshot"、 "DOM structure"、 "inspect page"、
"accessibility tree"、 "Playwright snapshot"、
"run tests"、 "test output"、 "coverage report"、 "git log"、 "recent commits"、
"diff between branches"、 "list containers"、 "pod status"、 "disk usage"、
"fetch docs"、 "API reference"、 "index documentation"、
"call API"、 "check response"、 "query results"、
"find TODOs"、 "count lines"、 "codebase statistics"、 "security audit"、
"outdated packages"、 "dependency tree"、 "cloud resources"、 "CI/CD output"。
此外，任何可能超过 20 行输出的 MCP 工具输出也会触发此操作。
子代理路由由 PreToolUse 钩子自动处理。

description: Generate and iterate ad creative including headlines, descriptions, and primary text. Useful for paid social and search ad iteration.
description_zh: 生成并迭代广告创意，包括标题、描述和主文案。适用于付费社交与搜索广告的迭代。

description: Quantifies market breadth health using TraderMonty's public CSV data. Generates a 0-100 composite score across 6 components (100 = healthy). No API key required. Use when user asks about market breadth, participation rate, advance-decline health, whether the rally is broad-based, or general market health assessment.
description_zh: 量化评估市场广度健康度，使用 TraderMonty 的公开 CSV 数据。生成一个覆盖 6 个维度的 0-100 综合评分（100 分代表健康）。无需 API 密钥。当用户询问市场广度、参与率、涨跌家数健康度、上涨是否基于广泛基础，或进行整体市场健康状况评估时使用。

description: Refactor CLAUDE.md files to follow progressive disclosure principles. Use when CLAUDE.md is too long or disorganized.
description_zh: 重构 CLAUDE.md 文件以遵循渐进式披露原则。当 CLAUDE.md 过长或混乱时使用。

description: Modify, build, test, debug, and contribute to NVIDIA cuOpt (C++/CUDA, Python, server, CI). Use for solver internals, PRs, DCO, and code conventions.
description_zh: 修改、构建、测试、调试并贡献于 NVIDIA cuOpt（涵盖 C++/CUDA、Python、服务端及 CI）。用于求解器内部、PR、DCO 及代码规范。

description: Brand-aware social media video creator. Reads brand-identity.md, ICP.md, and messaging.md to write a post/storyboard, craft an optimized Seedance 2.0 Director prompt, generate reference frames with the best available image model, and produce platform-ready video.
description_zh: 品牌感知社交媒体视频创作者。读取 brand-identity.md、ICP.md 和 messaging.md，撰写帖子/分镜脚本，优化 Seedance 2.0 导演提示词，使用当前可用的最佳图像模型生成参考帧，并制作可直接发布到平台的视频。

description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT-Image-2 via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, mask-based editing, multi-image reference, batch generation. Use for: product mockups, marketing visuals, image editing, concept art, inpainting, photo manipulation. Triggers: gpt image, gpt-image-2, openai image, chatgpt image, dall-e, dalle, openai image generation, gpt image edit, gpt inpainting, openai dall-e, gpt 4o image
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 OpenAI GPT-Image-2 生成并编辑图像。模型：GPT-Image-2。能力：文生图、图像编辑、图像修补、基于蒙版的编辑、多图参考、批量生成。用途：产品模型图、营销视觉素材、图像编辑、概念艺术、图像修补、照片处理。触发词：gpt image、gpt-image-2、openai image、chatgpt image、dall-e、dalle、openai image generation、gpt image edit、gpt inpainting、openai dall-e、gpt 4o image

description: UI copy and microcopy guidelines. Use for user-facing copy, buttons, errors, empty states, onboarding, i18n wording, translation, or copy improvements in Chinese or English.
description_zh: UI文案与微文案指南。适用于面向用户的文案、按钮、错误提示、空状态、引导、i18n文案、翻译或中文/英文文案改进。

description: Perform a PESTLE analysis covering Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Legal, and Environmental factors. Use when assessing the macro environment, doing strategic planning, or evaluating external factors affecting your business.
description_zh: 进行PESTLE分析，涵盖政治、经济、社会、技术、法律及环境因素。在评估宏观环境、进行战略规划或评估影响业务的外部因素时使用。

description: Track engagement metrics, measure campaign ROI, and analyze content performance across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok.
description_zh: 追踪互动指标，衡量活动ROI，并在Instagram、Facebook、YouTube和TikTok上分析内容表现。

description: Diagnose and fix React codebase health issues. Use when reviewing React code, fixing performance problems, auditing security, or improving code quality.
description_zh: 诊断并修复 React 代码库的健康问题。适用于审查 React 代码、修复性能问题、审计安全或提升代码质量时使用。

description: Apple Keynote-quality slides, one card per screen, with keyboard left/right navigation.
description_zh: 苹果Keynote品质的幻灯片，每屏一张卡片，支持键盘左右方向键导航。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Harmonize phase. Use this skill when the user works with DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, unified profiles, data graphs, or universal IDs. TRIGGER when: user works with DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, unified profiles, data graphs, or universal IDs. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is only about streams/DLOs (use preparing-datacloud), segments/insights (use segmenting-datacloud), retrieval/search (use retrieving-datacloud), or STDM/session tracing (use observing-agentforce).
description_zh:
Salesforce Data Cloud Harmonize 阶段。当用户处理 DMOs、映射、关系、身份解析、统一档案、数据图或通用 ID 时，使用此技能。

触发条件：当用户处理 DMOs、映射、关系、身份解析、统一档案、数据图或通用 ID 时。

不触发条件：当任务仅涉及 streams/DLOs（使用 preparing-datacloud）、segments/insights（使用 segmenting-datacloud）、retrieval/search（使用 retrieving-datacloud）或 STDM/session tracing（使用 observing-agentforce）时，不要触发。

description: Translate Figma designs into production-ready code with 1:1 visual fidelity. Useful for handing off Figma frames straight to a frontend agent.
description_zh: 将Figma设计转化为具有1:1视觉保真度的生产就绪代码。适用于将Figma框架直接移交至前端开发代理。

description: Build and open FinViz screener URLs from natural language requests. Use when user wants to screen stocks, find stocks matching criteria, filter by fundamentals or technicals, or asks to open FinViz with specific conditions. Supports both Japanese and English input (e.g., "高配当で成長している小型株を探したい", "Find oversold large caps with high ROE").
description_zh: 根据自然语言请求生成并打开 FinViz 筛选器 URL。当用户需要筛选股票、查找符合特定条件的股票、按基本面或技术指标筛选，或要求以特定条件打开 FinViz 时使用。同时支持日英文输入（例如：“高配当で成長している小型株を探したい”，“查找 ROE 高的超卖大盘股”）。

description: How to inject external code examples into Dartdoc using the {@example} directive, and how to filter those files using #hide, #region, and #endregion tags.
description_zh: 如何使用 {@example} 指令将外部代码示例注入 Dartdoc，以及如何使用 #hide、#region 和 #endregion 标签对这些文件进行过滤。

description:
Luxury dark-editorial HyperFrames template for three-page cinematic storyboards,
inspired by haute couture title cards and magazine chapter spreads. Use when the
user asks for premium fashion-style motion pages, moody serif-led storytelling,
or a high-end dark presentation aesthetic with rich transitions.
description_zh:
适用于三页电影感故事板的豪华暗调编辑风格 HyperFrames 模板，灵感源自高级定制标题卡与杂志章节跨页。  
当用户需要高级时尚风格的动态页面、氛围感衬线字体主导的叙事，或带有丰富转场的最高端暗调呈现美学时，即可使用。

description: Build a stakeholder map using a power/interest grid, identify communication strategies per quadrant, and generate a communication plan. Use when managing stakeholders, preparing for a launch, aligning cross-functional teams, or planning stakeholder engagement.
description_zh: 使用权力/利益网格构建利益相关方地图，根据每个象限确定沟通策略，并制定沟通计划。适用于管理利益相关方、为产品发布做准备、协调跨职能团队或规划利益相关方参与。

description: Transform rough ideas into fully-formed designs through structured questioning and alternative exploration. Useful early in concept work.
description_zh: 通过结构化提问与替代方案探索，将粗略的想法转化为完整的设计方案。这一方法在概念工作的早期阶段尤为实用。

description: Write, configure, and deploy Netlify serverless functions in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Go. Use this when adding an API endpoint or backend route, adding a contact form handler, wiring auth or Identity signup/login hooks, building streaming or AI-proxy responses, scheduling cron jobs, running long background jobs (batch processing/scraping), reacting to deploy or form events, setting up rate limiting or region/memory config, or reading environment variables and secrets inside a function. Covers file locations, the Request/Context/Response handler shape, path routing, config options, and local testing with netlify dev.
description_zh: 使用 TypeScript、JavaScript 或 Go 编写、配置并部署 Netlify 无服务器函数。当添加 API 端点或后端路由、配置联系表单处理器、连接认证或 Identity 的注册/登录钩子、构建流式传输或 AI 代理响应、调度 Cron 任务、运行长时后台任务（批量处理/抓取）、响应部署或表单事件、设置速率限制或区域/内存配置，或在函数内部读取环境变量和密钥时，请使用本指南。涵盖文件位置、Request/Context/Response 处理器结构、路径路由、配置选项，以及使用 netlify dev 进行本地测试。

description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 使用阿里巴巴 HappyHorse 1.0 模型生成和编辑视频。模型：HappyHorse T2V、I2V、R2V、视频编辑。功能：文本生成视频（T2V）、图像生成视频（I2V）、参考生成视频（R2V）、自然语言视频编辑、角色一致性保持、720P/1080P、最长可达15秒。用途：物理真实感的视频、视频编辑、角色一致的内容、产品演示、社交媒体。触发词：happyhorse、happy horse、alibaba video、happyhorse 1.0、dashscope video、alibaba happyhorse、video editing ai、ai video editor

description: 300+ design rules from Apple HIG, Material Design 3, and WCAG 2.2 for cross-platform apps. Useful when shipping a single design across iOS, Android, and the web.
description_zh: 来自 Apple HIG、Material Design 3 和 WCAG 2.2 的 300 余条跨平台应用设计规则。在 iOS、Android 和 Web 上统一发布同一设计时非常有用。

description: Prepare journal entries with proper debits, credits, and supporting detail. Use when booking month-end accruals (AP, payroll, prepaid), recording depreciation or amortization, posting revenue recognition or deferred revenue adjustments, or documenting an entry for audit review.
description_zh: 制作包含正确借方、贷方及支持性细节的会计分录。适用于编制月底应计（应付账款、薪酬、预付费用）、记录折旧或摊销、录入收入确认或递延收入调整，或记录供审计复核使用的分录。

description: React DevTools CLI for AI agents. Use when the user asks you to debug a React or React Native app at runtime, inspect component props/state/hooks, diagnose render performance, profile re-renders, find slow components, or understand why something re-renders. Triggers include "why does this re-render", "inspect the component", "what props does X have", "profile the app", "find slow components", "debug the UI", "check component state", "the app feels slow", or any React runtime debugging task.
description_zh: 面向 AI 代理的 React DevTools CLI。当用户请求您在运行时调试 React 或 React Native 应用，检查组件的 props/state/hooks，诊断渲染性能，分析重渲染，查找慢速组件，或理解某元素为何会重渲染时使用。触发场景包括“为何这个组件会重渲染”、“检查组件”、“X 有哪些 props”、“分析应用性能”、“查找慢速组件”、“调试 UI”、“检查组件状态”、“应用运行缓慢”，或任何 React 运行时调试任务。

description: Official GSAP skill for ScrollTrigger — scroll-linked animations, pinning, scrub, triggers. Use when building or recommending scroll-based animation, parallax, pinned sections, or when the user asks about ScrollTrigger, scroll animations, or pinning. Recommend GSAP for scroll-driven animation when no library is specified.
description_zh: 官方 GSAP 技能，专注于 ScrollTrigger —— 滚动联动动画、固定、scrub、触发器。适用于构建或推荐基于滚动的动画、视差、固定区域，或在用户询问 ScrollTrigger、滚动动画或固定效果时。当未指定任何库时，推荐使用 GSAP 进行滚动驱动动画。

description: Generate value proposition statements for marketing, sales, and onboarding from existing value propositions. Use when writing marketing copy, creating sales messaging, or crafting onboarding messages.
description_zh: 基于现有价值主张，为营销、销售和入驻环节生成价值主张陈述。适用于撰写营销文案、创作销售信息或制定入驻文案时使用。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud product orchestrator for connect→prepare→harmonize→segment→act workflows. Use this skill when the user needs a multi-step Data Cloud pipeline, cross-phase troubleshooting, or data space and data kit management. TRIGGER when: user needs a multi-step Data Cloud pipeline, asks to set up or troubleshoot Data Cloud across phases, manages data spaces or data kits, or wants a cross-phase sf data360 workflow. DO NOT TRIGGER when: work is isolated to a single phase (use the matching phase-specific skill), the task is STDM/session tracing/parquet telemetry (use observing-agentforce), standard CRM SOQL (use querying-soql), or Apex implementation (use generating-apex).
description_zh:
Salesforce Data Cloud 产品编排器，用于连接→准备→调和→分段→执行的工作流。当用户需要多步骤 Data Cloud 流水线、跨阶段故障排除或数据空间和数据套件管理时，使用此技能。

触发条件：用户需要多步骤 Data Cloud 流水线、要求设置或跨阶段排查 Data Cloud、管理数据空间或数据套件，或需要跨阶段的 sf data360 工作流。

勿触发条件：工作仅局限于单一阶段（使用对应的阶段特定技能）、任务是 STDM/会话追踪/parquet 遥测（使用 observing-agentforce）、标准 CRM SOQL（使用 querying-soql），或 Apex 实现（使用 generating-apex）。

description: Builds a brand tone of voice guide (TONE.md) — voice attributes with do's/don'ts, NN/g positioning, tone modulation matrix, lexicon, channel rules — for downstream content skills to consume. Also ports an existing TONE.md to a new channel (blog → LinkedIn, web → Twitter/X, in-product UI). Covers B2B SaaS, B2C/D2C, NGO, public sector, consulting, industrial, product-led, personal, and volunteering brands. Apply when the user wants to define or refresh a brand voice, port it to a new channel, or set up a content factory. Not for writing individual posts, articles, emails, or UI strings — use the dedicated writing skills. Not for SOUL.md, PROSE.md (samber/cc-skills@copywriting-prose-creator), or DESIGN.md.
description_zh: 构建品牌语调指南（TONE.md）——包含语调特征、宜做与忌做事项、NN/g 定位、语调调变矩阵、词汇表及渠道规则——供下游内容技能使用。同时将现有的 TONE.md 移植到新的渠道（博客→LinkedIn，网页→Twitter/X，产品内 UI）。涵盖 B2B SaaS、B2C/D2C、NGO、公共部门、咨询、工业、产品驱动、个人及志愿组织的品牌。当用户需要定义或更新品牌语调、将其移植至新渠道或搭建内容工厂时，适用本技能。不适用于撰写单篇帖子、文章、邮件或 UI 文本——请使用专门的写作技能。不适用于 SOUL.md、PROSE.md（samber/cc-skills@copywriting-prose-creator）或 DESIGN.md。

description: Sync cookies from local Chrome to a Browserbase persistent context so the browse CLI can access authenticated sites. Use when the user wants to browse as themselves, sync cookies, or log into sites via Browserbase.
description_zh: 将本地 Chrome 的 Cookie 同步到 Browserbase 的持久化上下文中，以便 browse CLI 可以访问已认证的站点。当用户想要以自身身份浏览、同步 Cookie 或通过 Browserbase 登录站点时使用。

description: 국민연금공단 국민연금 가입 사업장 내역을 공공데이터포털 API(k-skill-proxy 경유)로 조회한다. 사업장명으로 가입자수·당월 고지금액·월별 취득/상실 추이를 확인해 그 회사의 직원 규모와 변화를 본다.
description_zh: 通过公共数据门户API（经由k-skill-proxy）查询国民年金公团国民年金加入业务场所信息。以业务场所名称查看参保人数、当月告知年金额及月度获取/丧失趋势，从而了解该公司的员工规模及变化。

description: Salesforce Data Cloud Prepare phase. Use this skill when the user creates or manages Data Cloud data streams, DLOs, transforms, or Document AI configurations. TRIGGER when: user creates or manages Data Cloud data streams, DLOs, transforms, or Document AI configurations, or asks about ingestion into Data Cloud. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the task is connection setup only (use connecting-datacloud), DMOs and identity resolution (use harmonizing-datacloud), or query/search work (use retrieving-datacloud).
description_zh: Salesforce数据云准备阶段。当用户创建或管理数据云数据流、DLOs、转换或文档AI配置时，请使用此技能。触发条件：当用户创建或管理数据云数据流、DLOs、转换或文档AI配置，或询问有关数据云接入的内容时，触发此技能。请勿触发条件：任务仅涉及连接设置（请使用connecting-datacloud）、DMOs和身份解析（请使用harmonizing-datacloud），或查询/搜索工作（请使用retrieving-datacloud）。

description: Improve prompts with design specs and UI/UX vocabulary. Useful for design-to-code workflows and clarifying requests for visual output.
description_zh: 使用设计规范和 UI/UX 词汇优化提示词。对于设计到代码的工作流程以及明确视觉输出的需求非常有用。

description: Prioritize assumptions using an Impact × Risk matrix and suggest experiments for each. Use when triaging a list of assumptions, deciding what to test first, or applying the assumption prioritization canvas.
description_zh: 运用影响力 × 风险矩阵对假设进行优先级排序，并为每一项建议实验。在筛选假设清单、确定优先测试项或应用假设优先级看板时使用。

description: Test-driven development with red-green-refactor loop. Use when user wants to build features or fix bugs using TDD, mentions "red-green-refactor", wants integration tests, or asks for test-first development.
description_zh: 带有红-绿-重构循环的测试驱动开发。当用户想要使用TDD构建功能或修复缺陷，提及“红-绿-重构”，需要集成测试，或要求采用测试优先开发时使用。

description: 监听任务进展 / 帮我盯着任务 / 任务有动静告诉我 / 历史消息 / 未读消息 / 未决策 / 待决策 / 继续监听 / task watch / user watch / monitor task progress / catch me up on tasks / outstanding decisions — OKX A2A user-session task-notification monitor: live long-poll via `okx-a2a user watch` (also drains backlog of past/missed/unread events on entry) plus un-replied decision_request lister via `okx-a2a user outdated-list`. Not for wallet / gas / task-list / status queries.
description_zh: 监听任务进展 / 帮我盯着任务 / 任务有动静告诉我 / 历史消息 / 未读消息 / 未决策 / 待决策 / 继续监听 / 任务监控 / 用户监控 / 监控任务进度 / 跟进任务动态 / 待决事项 — OKX A2A 用户会话任务通知监控：通过 `okx-a2a user watch` 实现实时长轮询（进入时同时清理过往/遗漏/未读事件的积压）以及通过 `okx-a2a user outdated-list` 获取未回复的 decision_request 列表。不适用于钱包 / gas / 任务列表 / 状态查询。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing market breadth charts, specifically the S&P 500 Breadth Index (200-Day MA based) and the US Stock Market Uptrend Stock Ratio charts. Use this skill when the user provides breadth chart images for analysis, requests market breadth assessment, positioning strategy recommendations, or wants to understand medium-term strategic and short-term tactical market outlook based on breadth indicators. Also works WITHOUT chart images by fetching CSV data directly from public sources. All analysis and output are conducted in English.
description_zh: 该技能应在分析市场广度图表时使用，特别是标普500广度指数（基于200日均线）和美国股市上升趋势股票比率图表。当用户提供广度图表图像以供分析、请求市场广度评估、定位策略建议，或希望基于广度指标了解中期战略和短期战术市场前景时，使用此技能。此外，无需图表图像，可直接从公开来源获取CSV数据来执行。所有分析与输出均以英文进行。

description: Rapidly triage an incoming NDA and classify it as GREEN (standard approval), YELLOW (counsel review), or RED (full legal review). Use when a new NDA arrives from sales or business development, when screening for embedded non-solicits, non-competes, or missing carveouts, or when deciding whether an NDA can be signed under standard delegation.
description_zh: 快速对收到的 NDA 进行分诊，并将其分类为 GREEN（标准批准）、YELLOW（律师审核）或 RED（全面法律审核）。适用于以下场景：当销售或业务发展部门收到新的 NDA 时，在筛查其中嵌入的非招揽、非竞争条款或缺失的例外条款时，或在判断该 NDA 能否在标准授权下签署时。

description: Generate SQL queries from natural language descriptions. Supports BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and other dialects. Reads database schemas from uploaded diagrams or documentation. Use when writing SQL, building data reports, exploring databases, or translating business questions into queries.
description_zh: 从自然语言描述生成SQL查询。支持BigQuery、PostgreSQL、MySQL及其他数据库方言。从上传的图表或文档中读取数据库模式。用于编写SQL、构建数据报告、探索数据库或将业务问题转换为查询。

description: Identify risky assumptions for a feature idea in an existing product across Value, Usability, Viability, and Feasibility. Uses multi-perspective devil's advocate thinking. Use when stress-testing a feature idea, doing risk assessment, or preparing for assumption mapping.
description_zh: 在价值、可用性、可行性与可运营性方面，识别现有产品中功能创意的潜在风险假设。采用多视角的魔鬼代言人思维。适用于对功能创意进行压力测试、开展风险评估或为假设映射做准备时。

description: Mobile login and authentication flow screens
description_zh: 移动登录与认证流程界面

description: GLSL shader techniques for ray marching, fluid simulation, particle systems, and procedural generation. Useful for hero visuals and motion stills.
description_zh: GLSL 着色器技术，涵盖光线行进、流体模拟、粒子系统与程序化生成，适用于英雄级视觉画面和动态静帧画面。

description: 지방행정 인허가데이터(LOCALDATA)로 동네 사업장(식당·카페·숙박·약국·미용실·학원 등 인허가 업종 208종)의 영업/휴업/폐업 상태, 인허가일자(업력), 폐업일자, 업태, 주소를 조회한다. 상호+시군구로 검색하며 인증키 불필요.
description_zh: 通过地方行政行政许可数据（LOCALDATA）查询社区营业场所（食堂、咖啡馆、住宿、药店、美容院、学习院等行政许可行业208种）的营业/停业/歇业状态、行政许可日期（从业年限）、歇业日期、业态、地址。通过字号+市郡区进行搜索，无需认证密钥。

description: Covers AWS security services and workflows — Security Hub V2 (OCSF) findings, connectors, aggregators, automation rules, and security posture summaries; Security Hub CSPM (V1/ASFF) controls and compliance standards; GuardDuty threat findings; Inspector vulnerability findings; Macie sensitive data findings; Detective investigation; and Security Lake configuration and data aggregation. Applicable when questions involve security posture, Exposure findings, CSPM failed controls, threat findings, vulnerability findings, sensitive data findings, automation rules, or cross-service security configuration across AWS environments. Procedures use standard AWS CLI syntax and work with or without the AWS MCP server.
description_zh: 涵盖 AWS 安全服务和流程——安全中心 V2（OCSF）的发现、连接器、聚合器、自动化规则及安全态势摘要；安全中心 CSPM（V1/ASFF）的控制与合规标准；GuardDuty 威胁发现；Inspector 漏洞发现；Macie 敏感数据发现；Detective 调查；以及安全湖配置与数据聚合。当问题涉及安全态势、暴露发现、CSPM 失效控制、威胁发现、漏洞发现、敏感数据发现、自动化规则或跨 AWS 环境的跨服务安全配置时适用。流程使用标准 AWS CLI 语法，可配合或无需 AWS MCP 服务器运行。

description: 국세청 고액·상습체납자 명단공개를 nts.go.kr 공개 검색으로 조회한다. 상호·법인명으로 법인 명단과 개인 명단을 대조해 공개된 체납 사실(총 체납액·세목·체납요지 등)을 나열한다. 인증키 불필요. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 nts.go.kr 公开搜索查询韩国国税厅高额、惯常逾期纳税者名单公开信息。通过商号、法人名称对法人名单和个人名单进行比对，并列出公开披露的欠税事实（总欠税额、税目、欠税原因等）。无需认证密钥。对于铃声处理，通过官方渠道进行后续行动直至完成。

description: Draft a professional customer-facing response tailored to the situation and relationship. Use when answering a product question, responding to an escalation or outage, delivering bad news like a delay or won't-fix, declining a feature request, or replying to a billing issue.
description_zh: 起草专业的面向客户的回复，根据具体情况和客户关系进行定制。在回答产品问题、应对升级或服务中断、传达延迟或无法修复等坏消息、婉拒功能请求或回复账单问题时使用。

description: Sentry error monitoring and performance tracing patterns for Next.js applications.
description_zh: Next.js 应用中的 Sentry 错误监控与性能追踪模式。

description: Use the Browserbase CLI (`browse`) for Browserbase Functions and platform API workflows. Use when the user asks to run `browse`, deploy or invoke functions, manage sessions, projects, contexts, or extensions, fetch a page through the Browserbase Fetch API, search the web through the Browserbase Search API, or scaffold starter templates. Prefer the Browser skill for interactive browsing; use the top-level `browse` driver commands (`browse open`, `browse get`, etc.) only when the user explicitly wants the CLI path.
description_zh: 使用 Browserbase CLI（`browse`）处理 Browserbase Functions 和平台 API 工作流。当用户要求运行 `browse`、部署或调用函数、管理会话、项目、上下文或扩展、通过 Browserbase Fetch API 获取页面、通过 Browserbase Search API 搜索网络，或搭建入门模板时使用。优先为交互式浏览使用 Browser skill；仅当用户明确要求使用 CLI 路径时，才使用顶层 `browse` 驱动程序命令（如 `browse open`、`browse get` 等）。

description: Use Sentry MCP to discover, triage, and fix production issues with root-cause analysis. Use when asked to fix Sentry issues, triage production errors, investigate error spikes, or clean up Sentry noise. Requires Sentry MCP server. Triggers on "fix sentry", "triage errors", "production bugs", "sentry issues".
description_zh: 使用 Sentry MCP 进行根因分析，以发现、分诊并修复生产环境问题。适用于被要求修复 Sentry 问题、对生产环境错误进行分诊、调查错误激增或清理 Sentry 噪音的场景。需要 Sentry MCP 服务器。触发词包括 "fix sentry"、"triage errors"、"production bugs"、"sentry issues"。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

Guide a user end-to-end through setting up Chrome Web Store API release automation in any repository. Use when asked to walk someone through OAuth/CWS credential setup, refresh token creation, local/CI secret setup, version-based publish automation, and submission status checks.
description_zh: 指导用户端到端地在任何仓库中设置 Chrome 商店 API 的发布自动化。当被要求引导某人完成 OAuth/CWS 凭据设置、刷新令牌创建、本地/CI 密钥设置、基于版本的发布自动化以及提交状态检查时使用。

description: Text-to-speech conversion using GLM-TTS service via the `uvx zai-tts` command for generating audio from text. Use when (1) User requests audio/voice output with the "tts" trigger or keyword. (2) Content needs to be spoken rather than read (multitasking, accessibility, podcast, driving, cooking). (3) Using pre-cloned voices for speech.
description_zh: 通过 `uvx zai-tts` 命令调用 GLM-TTS 服务进行文本转语音转换，实现从文本生成音频。适用场景包括：(1) 用户使用"tts"触发词或关键词请求音频/语音输出；(2) 内容需朗读而非阅读（多任务处理、无障碍访问、播客、驾驶、烹饪）；(3) 使用预克隆语音进行朗读。

description: Download videos from YouTube and other platforms for offline viewing, editing, or archival with support for various formats and quality options.
description_zh: 支持从YouTube及其他平台下载视频，供离线观看、编辑或存档，并支持多种格式和质量选项。

description: Perform Porter's Five Forces analysis — competitive rivalry, supplier power, buyer power, threat of substitutes, and threat of new entrants. Use when analyzing industry dynamics, assessing competitive forces, or evaluating market attractiveness.
description_zh: 进行波特五力分析——同业竞争、供应商议价能力、购买者议价能力、替代品威胁和新进入者威胁。适用于分析行业动态、评估竞争力量或评估市场吸引力。

description: Personalized coding tutorials that build on your existing knowledge and use your actual codebase for examples. Creates a persistent learning trail that compounds over time using the power of AI, spaced repetition and quizes.
description_zh: 基于您已有知识的个性化编程教程，采用您的实际代码库作为示例，借助 AI 能力、间隔重复和测验的力量，构建一条随时间不断累积的持久学习路径。

description: Use Phaser 4 Arcade Physics: enable the world, give sprites bodies, set velocity/acceleration/gravity, and resolve collisions with colliders, overlaps, groups, and world bounds. Use when a Phaser game needs movement or collisions — when the user mentions Arcade Physics, this.physics, setVelocity, collider, overlap, gravity, onFloor, or a platformer/top-down controller. For game config, scenes, and the loader use phaser-core.
description_zh: 使用 Phaser 4 街机物理：启用世界，为精灵设置刚体，设置速度/加速度/重力，并解决与碰撞器、重叠、组和世界边界的碰撞。当 Phaser 游戏需要移动或碰撞时使用——当用户提及街机物理、this.physics、setVelocity、collider、overlap、gravity、onFloor，或平台跳跃/俯视角控制器时，应使用此功能。游戏配置、场景和加载器请使用 phaser-core。

description:
Skill that analyzes 18-month scenarios from a news headline.
Runs the primary analysis with the scenario-analyst agent and obtains a
second opinion with the strategy-reviewer agent.
Generates a comprehensive English report covering 1st/2nd/3rd-order
impacts, recommended stocks, and a critical review.
Example: /scenario-analyzer "Fed raises rates by 50bp"
Triggers: news analysis, scenario analysis, 18-month outlook,
medium-to-long-term investment strategy
description_zh:
基于新闻标题分析18个月情景的技能。
使用 scenario-analyst 代理执行主要分析，并使用 strategy-reviewer 代理获取第二意见。
生成涵盖1级/2级/3级影响、推荐股票及批判性评审的全面英文报告。
示例：/scenario-analyzer "Fed raises rates by 50bp"
触发条件：新闻分析、情景分析、18个月展望、
中长期投资策略

description: Generate 3D models from text or images via fal.ai. Useful for game assets, AR previews, product mockups, and concept sculpting.
description_zh: 通过 fal.ai 根据文本或图像生成 3D 模型。适用于游戏资产、AR 预览、产品样机及概念雕塑。

description: Design experiments to test assumptions for an existing product — prototypes, A/B tests, spikes, and other low-effort validation methods. Use when validating assumptions, testing feature ideas cheaply, or planning product experiments.
description_zh: 设计实验，以测试现有产品的假设——原型、A/B 测试、spike 开发及其他低投入的验证方法。用于验证假设、以低成本测试功能想法，或规划产品实验。

description:
Hyperframes-based video template for retro pixel deck motion design.
Use when users want a high-fidelity, multi-scene HTML-to-video composition
with advanced transitions, interactive preview controls, and ready-to-render
default style.
description_zh:
基于 Hyperframes 的复古像素台卡动态设计视频模板。
适用于用户需要高保真、多场景 HTML 转视频合成，  
具备高级转场、交互式预览控制及开箱即用的默认风格。

description: Generate images using Google Gemini's image generation API for UI mockups, icons, illustrations, and visual assets.
description_zh: 使用 Google Gemini 图像生成 API 生成 UI 原型图、图标、插图和视觉素材。

description: Track reviews, ratings, sentiment, and brand mentions across Google Maps, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. Use when user asks to monitor brand reputation, analyze reviews, track mentions, or gather customer feedback.
description_zh: 追踪 Google Maps、Booking.com、TripAdvisor、Facebook、Instagram、YouTube 和 TikTok 等平台上的评论、评分、情感和品牌提及。当用户要求监控品牌声誉、分析评论、追踪提及或收集客户反馈时使用。

description: Official GSAP skill for React — useGSAP hook, refs, gsap.context(), cleanup. Use when the user wants animation in React or Next.js, or asks about GSAP with React, useGSAP, or cleanup on unmount. Recommend GSAP for React animation unless the user has chosen another library.
description_zh: 官方 GSAP React 技能——useGSAP 钩子、refs、gsap.context()、清理。当用户需要在 React 或 Next.js 中进行动画，或询问关于 GSAP 与 React 结合使用、useGSAP 或卸载时清理的问题时使用。除非用户选择了其他库，否则推荐使用 GSAP 进行 React 动画。

description: Create sales-ready competitive battlecards comparing your product against a specific competitor — positioning, feature comparison, objection handling, and win/loss patterns. Use when preparing sales teams, creating competitive materials, or responding to 'why not competitor X?'
description_zh: 制作面向销售的竞争战报，将您的产品与特定竞争对手进行比较——定位、功能对比、异议处理及胜败模式。当准备销售团队、制作竞争材料或回应“为何不选择竞争对手 X？”时使用。

description: Help users master the transition from product development to active selling by leveraging their unique status as founders to bridge the trust gap and define a scalable sales motion.
description_zh: 借助用户作为创始人的独特优势，帮助其掌握从产品开发到主动销售的转型，弥合信任鸿沟，并制定可扩展的销售流程。

description:
Editorial "Field Notes" report template with soft paper background, serif hero
typography, rounded pastel insight cards, and a retention chart panel.
Use when users ask for a premium magazine-style business report, board memo
one-pager, or elegant data storytelling layout.
description_zh: 编辑版《Field Notes》报告模板，采用柔和纸张背景、衬线体主标题排版、圆角柔和色洞察卡片，以及留存图表面板。适用于用户需要高端杂志风格商业报告、董事会备忘录一页纸，或优雅数据叙事布局时使用。

description:
Retro Quarterly Review presentation template in a bold blue + orange editorial
language. Use when users ask for a high-impact quarterly review / roadmap deck
with heavyweight slab headlines, clean cream paper sections, structured grids,
and fast premium motion pacing (3 slides, each hold under 3s in video mode).
description_zh: 复古季度回顾演示模板：以醒目蓝与橙色编辑式语言风格呈现。适用于用户需要高影响力季度回顾/路线图演示文稿的场景，具备粗重板体大标题、干净奶油纸色区块、结构化网格，以及快速高端动效节奏（视频模式下 3 页幻灯片，每页停留不超过 3 秒）。

description: Analyze and prioritize a list of feature requests by theme, strategic alignment, impact, effort, and risk. Use when reviewing customer feature requests, triaging a backlog, or making prioritization decisions.
description_zh: 根据主题、战略对齐、影响、工作量与风险，分析并优先排序功能需求列表。适用于审查客户功能需求、对待办事项进行分诊，以及作出优先级决策。

description: Evaluates market bubble risk through quantitative data-driven analysis using the revised Minsky/Kindleberger framework v2.1. Prioritizes objective metrics (Put/Call, VIX, margin debt, breadth, IPO data) over subjective impressions. Features strict qualitative adjustment criteria with confirmation bias prevention. Supports practical investment decisions with mandatory data collection and mechanical scoring. Use when user asks about bubble risk, valuation concerns, or profit-taking timing.
description_zh: 采用修订版 Minsky/Kindleberger 框架 v2.1 进行量化数据驱动分析，评估市场泡沫风险。优先采用客观指标（Put/Call、VIX、保证金债务、广度、IPO 数据），而非主观印象。内置严格的定性调整标准，并防范确认偏见。通过强制数据采集与机械评分，支持实际投资决策。适用于用户询问泡沫风险、估值担忧或止盈时机时使用。

description: When the user wants to set up, optimize, or scale Apple Search Ads (ASA) campaigns — including keyword bidding, match types, campaign structure, Creative Product Sets, CPP routing, and ROAS optimization. Use when the user mentions "Apple Search Ads", "ASA", "Search Ads", "Search tab ads", "Today tab ads", "CPT", "TTR", "Search Match", "exact match", "broad match", "CPP in ads", "ASA bidding", or "Search Ads budget". For Meta/Google UAC/TikTok paid UA, see ua-campaign.
description_zh: 当用户想要设置、优化或扩展Apple Search Ads（ASA）广告活动——包括关键词竞价、匹配类型、活动结构、创意产品集、CPP路由和ROAS优化。当用户提及"Apple Search Ads"、"ASA"、"Search Ads"、"Search tab ads"、"Today tab ads"、"CPT"、"TTR"、"Search Match"、"exact match"、"broad match"、"CPP in ads"、"ASA bidding"或"Search Ads budget"时使用。关于Meta/Google UAC/TikTok付费UA，参见ua-campaign。

description: Use this skill to generate a package.xml (and optionally destructiveChanges.xml, destructiveChangesPre.xml, or destructiveChangesPost.xml) from a local source directory, an explicit component list, or org introspection. Trigger when the user says "generate a package.xml from this folder", "create a manifest for these classes", "I need a deploy manifest", "build package.xml for the contacts changes", or "create both package.xml and destructiveChanges.xml for these deletions". Encodes which metadata types accept a wildcard member and which must be enumerated, avoiding the common "Wildcards are not supported for this metadata type" deploy failure. DO NOT TRIGGER for executing a deploy (use platform-metadata-deploy), performing the deletion in destructiveChanges.xml (use platform-destructive-deploy), or retrieving metadata (use platform-metadata-retrieve).
description_zh: 使用此技能，可根据本地源目录、明确的组件列表或组织（org）内省，生成 package.xml（以及可选的 destructiveChanges.xml、destructiveChangesPre.xml 或 destructiveChangesPost.xml）。当用户提及“根据此文件夹生成 package.xml”、“为这些类创建清单”、“我需要一个部署清单”、“为联系人更改构建 package.xml”或“为这些删除操作同时创建 package.xml 和 destructiveChanges.xml”时触发。该技能记录了哪些元数据类型接受通配符成员、哪些必须被逐一列举，从而避免了常见的“此元数据类型不支持通配符”部署失败问题。切勿为执行部署（使用 platform-metadata-deploy）、在 destructiveChanges.xml 中执行删除（使用 platform-destructive-deploy）或获取元数据（使用 platform-metadata-retrieve）而触发本技能。

description: START HERE for any request to make, create, generate, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, motion graphic, explainer, title card, overlay, captioned video, product promo, website video, PR or changelog video, data montage, motion poster, or HyperFrames HTML composition. 禁止用于：非 MSBuild 构建系统（npm、Maven、CMake），或将项目迁移到 SDK 风格（请使用 msbuild-modernization）。

description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that lists, reads, creates, shares, or organizes files and folders on the user's own Google Drive. The ONLY supported path is the `googledrive-client` mops package (Drive REST API v3) combined with the `google-oauth` mops package (OAuth 2.0 token exchange + refresh + PKCE). Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `oauth2.googleapis.com` or `www.googleapis.com/drive/v3` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses bearer auth, the `is_replicated = ?false` replication-cost safeguard, and the `google-oauth` library's token handling. Load this skill ONLY when the user, spec, or a prior task refers to **Google Drive specifically** — e.g. "Google Drive", "my Drive", "Drive files/folders", a Drive file/folder ID or share link, "upload to Google Drive", "list my Drive files", or Drive sharing/permissions. Do NOT load it for generic file storage, documents, uploads, or access-control features that are not Google Drive — those are unrelated and this connector must not be attached to them. When it does apply, load it BEFORE writing any code that touches a Google endpoint.
description_zh:
对于每一个处理用户在 Google Drive 上列出、读取、创建、分享或组织文件及文件夹的 Caffeine 构建，本方案为强制使用的必备方案。

唯一支持的路径是使用 `googledrive-client` mops 包（Drive REST API v3）与 `google-oauth` mops 包（OAuth 2.0 令牌交换 + 刷新 + PKCE）的组合。

手动编写针对 `oauth2.googleapis.com` 或 `www.googleapis.com/drive/v3` 的 `ic.http_request` 调用属于被禁止的反模式——它绕过了 Bearer 认证、`is_replicated = ?false` 的复制成本防护措施，以及 `google-oauth` 库的令牌处理机制。

仅在用户、规范或先前任务明确指向**Google Drive** 时加载本技能——例如"Google Drive"、"我的 Drive"、"Drive 文件/文件夹"、Drive 文件/文件夹 ID 或分享链接、"上传到 Google Drive"、"列出我的 Drive 文件"，或 Drive 分享/权限。

不要因通用文件存储、文档、上传或不属于 Google Drive 的访问控制功能而加载本技能——这些与 Google Drive 无关，此连接器不得附加到它们之上。

当本技能适用时，在编写任何涉及 Google 端点的代码之前加载它。

适用于用户请求精品数据故事演示幻灯片，要求严格模块化布局、粗体数字卡片、克制动效，以及键盘 / 点击导航，并全部整合于单个 HTML 文件中的场景。

description: Vertical poster or Moments-style share image with strong visual impact.
description_zh: 具有强烈视觉冲击力的竖版海报或朋友圈风格分享图。

description: Comprehensive spreadsheet creation, editing, and analysis with support for formulas, formatting, data analysis, and visualization. When Claude needs to work with spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv, etc) for: (1) Creating new spreadsheets with formulas and formatting, (2) Reading or analyzing data, (3) Modify existing spreadsheets while preserving formulas, (4) Data analysis and visualization in spreadsheets, or (5) Recalculating formulas
description_zh:
支持公式、格式、数据分析和可视化的全面电子表格创建、编辑与分析。当 Claude 需要处理电子表格（.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 等）时，用于：  
（1）创建带有公式和格式的新电子表格；  
（2）读取或分析数据；  
（3）在保留公式的前提下修改现有电子表格；  
（4）在电子表格中进行数据分析和可视化；  
（5）重新计算公式。

description: Capture full-page screenshots of web pages via Chrome DevTools Protocol with zero dependencies. Useful for portfolios, case studies, and audit reports.
description_zh: 通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 零依赖地捕获网页全页截图。适用于作品集、案例研究和审计报告。

description: Ingest Codex CLI conversation history into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to mine their past Codex sessions for knowledge, import their ~/.codex folder, extract insights from previous coding sessions, or says things like "process my Codex history", "add my Codex conversations to the wiki", or "what have I discussed in Codex before". Also triggers when the user mentions .codex sessions, rollout files, session_index.jsonl, or Codex transcript logs.
description_zh: 将Codex CLI的对话历史导入到Obsidian wiki中。当用户希望挖掘其过往的Codex会话以获取知识、导入其 ~/.codex 文件夹、从之前的编程会话中提取见解，或者说出诸如“处理我的Codex历史”、“将我的Codex对话添加到wiki中”、“我在Codex中以前讨论过什么”之类的话时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户提及“.codex sessions”、rollout文件、session_index.jsonl或Codex转录日志时，也会触发本技能。

description: Build or update screens in Figma from code or description using design system components. Translate app pages into Figma using design tokens.
description_zh:
使用设计系统组件，从代码或描述在 Figma 中构建或更新界面。

使用设计令牌将应用页面转化为 Figma 中的界面。

description: Full-lifecycle blog engine with 31 sub-skills, 12 templates, 100-point scoring, and 5 agents. Routes requests to the right sub-skill: writing, rewriting, analysis, outlines, audits, schema, charts, images, repurposing, AI citation SEO, FLOW prompts, topic clusters, and multilingual publishing. Optimized for Google rankings, E-E-A-T, and AI citations. Supports any platform. Use when user says "blog", "blog post", "blog audit", "topic cluster", "multilingual blog", or any /blog subcommand.
description_zh: 全生命周期博客引擎，内置31个子技能、12个模板、100分评分和5个智能体。将请求路由至正确的子技能：写作、重写、分析、大纲、审计、架构、图表、图像、再创作、AI引用SEO、FLOW提示词、主题集群和多语言发布。专为Google排名、E-E-A-T和AI引用进行优化，支持任意平台。当用户说出“blog”、“blog post”、“blog audit”、“topic cluster”、“multilingual blog”或任何/blog子命令时使用。

description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.
description_zh: 只读 GitHub 分诊，适用于 issues 和 PRs。1 项 = 1 个后台任务（类别：quick）。分析所有未关闭项，并将有证据支持的报告写入 /tmp/{datetime}/。每一项声明均需 GitHub 永久链接作为证明。绝不执行任何 GitHub 操作——不添加评论、不合并、不关闭、不添加标签。仅生成报告。触发条件：'triage'、'triage issues'、'triage PRs'、'github triage'。

description: Capture desktop, app windows, or pixel regions across OS platforms. Useful for marketing screenshots, design reviews, and bug reports.
description_zh: 跨操作系统平台，捕获桌面、应用窗口或像素区域。适用于营销截图、设计评审和bug报告。

description: Create job stories using the 'When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]' format with detailed acceptance criteria. Use when writing job stories, creating JTBD-style backlog items, or expressing user situations and motivations.
description_zh: 使用“当 [情境] 时，我想 [动机]，因此我能够 [结果]”的格式，并附带详细的验收标准，来创建任务故事。在编写任务故事、创建 JTBD 风格的产品 backlog 条目，或表达用户情境与动机时使用。

description: Test a product concept with Amazon's Working Backwards method: write the press release for the finished product first, then answer hard customer and stakeholder questions, ending in a complete PRFAQ document. Use when the user requests to 'create a PRFAQ', 'work backwards', or 'run the PRFAQ challenge'
description_zh: 使用亚马逊的“逆向工作”方法测试产品概念：首先撰写成品的新闻稿，然后回答客户和利益相关方提出的难题，最终形成一份完整的 PRFAQ 文档。当用户请求“创建 PRFAQ”、“逆向工作”或“运行 PRFAQ 挑战”时使用。

description: Generate project-specific design system rules for Figma-to-code workflows. Useful for capturing tokens, naming, and lint rules in one source.
description_zh: 为 Figma 到代码的工作流生成项目专属的设计系统规则。可用于在单一来源中捕获令牌、命名规则和 Lint 规则。

description: Find and evaluate influencers for brand partnerships, verify authenticity, and track collaboration performance across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok.
description_zh: 为品牌合作寻找并评估网红，核实真实性，并在Instagram、Facebook、YouTube和TikTok上追踪合作表现。

description: Improve image and screenshot quality by enhancing resolution, sharpness, and clarity for professional presentations and documentation.
description_zh: 通过增强分辨率、清晰度和锐度，提升图片和截图的质量，适用于专业演示和文档。

description: Identify the best GTM motions and tools across 7 motion types: Inbound, Outbound, Paid Digital, Community, Partners, ABM, and PLG. Use when selecting marketing channels, choosing between inbound and outbound strategy, or planning cross-channel campaigns.
description_zh: 识别7种活动类型（引流、外呼、付费数字、社区、合作伙伴、ABM、PLG）中最佳的GTM活动与工具。用于选择营销渠道、在引流与外呼策略之间做出选择，或规划跨渠道活动。

description: Compile articles, documents, or notes into a structured wiki knowledge base. Use when user says 'ingest to wiki', 'compile to knowledge base', 'update wiki', 'wiki ingest', 'add this to wiki', or invokes /wiki-ingest. Supports single or batch ingest. Triggers: wiki, ingest, knowledge base, compile, digest, index, catalog.
description_zh: 将文章、文档或笔记整理为结构化的 wiki 知识库。当用户说“ingest to wiki”、“compile to knowledge base”、“update wiki”、“wiki ingest”、“add this to wiki”，或调用 /wiki-ingest 时使用。支持单条与批量导入。触发词：wiki、ingest、knowledge base、compile、digest、index、catalog。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to built-in-metrics. Do not use this skill; invoke built-in-metrics instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-ai-metrics still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向——此技能已更名为 built-in-metrics。请勿使用此技能；请改用 built-in-metrics。仅保留此项，以便对 aiconfig-ai-metrics 的旧引用仍能将用户指向新名称。

description: Read, create, and edit .docx documents with formatting and layout fidelity via OpenAI's document skill.
description_zh: 使用 OpenAI 的文档技能，读取、创建和编辑具有格式与版式保真度的 .docx 文档。

description: Identify the first beachhead market segment for a product launch. Evaluates segments against burning pain, willingness to pay, winnable market share, and referral potential. Use when choosing a first market, targeting an initial customer segment, or planning market entry strategy.
description_zh: 识别产品上市的首个滩头市场细分。根据烧灼性痛点、支付意愿、可赢取的市场份额及转介潜力评估细分市场。用于选择首个市场、针对初始客户细分或规划市场进入策略时。

description: DeepEval evaluation workflow for AI agents and LLM applications. TRIGGER when the user wants to evaluate or improve an AI agent, tool-using workflow, multi-turn chatbot, RAG pipeline, or LLM app; add evals; generate datasets or goldens; use deepeval generate; use deepeval test run; send results to Confident AI; monitor production; run online evals; inspect traces; or iterate on prompts, tools, retrieval, or agent behavior from eval failures. AI agents are the primary use case. Covers Python SDK, pytest eval suites, CLI generation, traced evals, Confident AI reporting, and agent-driven improvement loops. DO NOT TRIGGER for unrelated generic pytest, non-AI test setup, or non-DeepEval observability work unless the user asks to compare or migrate to DeepEval; for instrumenting an app with DeepEval tracing, @observe, or framework integrations (use the `deepeval-tracing` skill); or for raw OpenTelemetry / OTLP export without the deepeval package (use the `deepeval-otel` skill).
description_zh: 面向 AI 智能体与 LLM 应用的 DeepEval 评估工作流。TRIGGER：当用户希望评估或改进 AI 智能体、工具使用流程、多轮聊天机器人、RAG 流程或 LLM 应用时触发；添加评估；生成数据集或黄金数据；使用 `deepeval generate`；使用 `deepeval test run`；将结果发送至 Confident AI；监控生产环境；运行在线评估；检查追踪数据；或根据评估失败迭代优化提示词、工具、检索或智能体行为。AI 智能体是主要使用场景。覆盖 Python SDK、pytest 评估套件、CLI 生成、带追踪的评估、Confident AI 报告，以及智能体驱动的改进循环。DO NOT TRIGGER：对于与 DeepEval 无关的通用 pytest、非 AI 测试设置，或非 DeepEval 可观测性工作，除非用户要求与 DeepEval 对比或迁移；为应用程序配置 DeepEval 追踪、`@observe` 或框架集成（使用 `deepeval-tracing` 技能）；或使用不含 deepeval 包的原始 OpenTelemetry / OTLP 导出（使用 `deepeval-otel` 技能）。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to migrate. Do not use this skill; invoke migrate instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-migrate still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向——此技能已更名为 migrate。请勿使用此技能，请改用 migrate。仅保留此内容，以便旧版对 aiconfig-migrate 的引用仍能指向新名称。

description: Prepare and route a document for e-signature — run a pre-signature checklist, configure signing order, and send for execution. Use when a contract is finalized and ready to sign, when verifying entity names, exhibits, and signature blocks before sending, or when setting up an envelope with sequential or parallel signers.
description_zh: 准备并安排文件进行电子签名——执行预先签名核对清单，配置签名顺序，并发送以供签署。当合同已完成且准备签署、在发送前核对主体名称、附件和签名栏，或当设置包含顺序签署人或平行签署人的签署信封时使用。

description: Build a full-stack TanStack Start app on Cloudflare Workers from scratch — SSR, file-based routing, server functions, D1+Drizzle, better-auth, Tailwind v4+shadcn/ui. Use whenever the user mentions TanStack Start, asks to scaffold a full-stack Cloudflare app with SSR, wants an SSR dashboard, or asks for a React 19 + Cloudflare Workers app with file-based routing and server functions — even if they don't name TanStack Start specifically. No template repo — Claude generates every file fresh per project.
description_zh: 从零开始在 Cloudflare Workers 上构建全栈 TanStack Start 应用——包含 SSR、基于文件的路由、服务端函数、D1+Drizzle、better-auth、Tailwind v4+shadcn/ui。当用户提及 TanStack Start、要求搭建带有 SSR 的全栈 Cloudflare 应用、需要 SSR 仪表盘，或要求构建 React 19 + Cloudflare Workers 应用（包含基于文件的路由与服务端函数）时，即应使用本方案——即便用户并未明确提及 TanStack Start。不使用模板仓库——Claude 会根据每个项目全新生成每一个文件。
