description: Learn how to install and migrate to Jetpack Navigation 3, and how to implement features and patterns such as deep links, multiple backstacks, scenes (dialogs, bottom sheets, list-detail, two-pane, supporting pane), conditional navigation (such as logged-in navigation versus anonymous), returning results from flows, integration with Hilt, ViewModel, Kotlin, and view interoperability.
description_zh: 学习如何安装和迁移到 Jetpack Navigation 3，以及如何实现诸如深度链接、多个回退栈、场景（对话框、底部弹出窗口、列表详情、双栏、辅助面板）、条件导航（例如，已登录导航与匿名导航）、从流程中返回结果、与 Hilt、ViewModel、Kotlin 及视图互操作性的集成等功能和模式。

description: Build Azure managed images and Azure Compute Gallery images with Packer. Use when creating custom images for Azure VMs.
description_zh: 使用 Packer 构建 Azure 托管镜像和 Azure Compute Gallery 镜像。用于为 Azure 虚拟机创建自定义镜像。

description:
Editorial studio deck template in burgundy / blush / muted-gold palette.
Use when users ask for premium manifesto or culture slides with pill tags,
large typographic statements, principle cards, and guided keyboard/click navigation.
description_zh:
采用酒红、腮红、哑光金配色的编辑工作室演示模板。
适用于用户需要高级宣言或文化幻灯片，并带有药丸标签、大型排版声明、原则卡片及引导式键盘/点击导航。

description:
Swiss-inspired creative-mode presentation template skill with bold editorial
typography, high-contrast geometric cards, interactive slide navigation,
theme switching, hotspot overlays, and palette choreography in a single-file
HTML artifact. Use when users ask for a premium presentation-style landing,
a Swiss/brutalist deck look, or a creative launch page with rich interactions.
description_zh: 具备瑞士风格启发的创意模式演示模板技能，集大胆编辑排版、高对比度几何卡片、交互式幻灯片导航、主题切换、热点叠加及调色板编排于一体，以单一 HTML 文件形式呈现。适用于用户需要高级演示风格落地页、瑞士/粗野主义风格演示文稿外观，或需具备丰富交互的创意发布页时。

description: Use when asked to install, deploy, run, validate, troubleshoot, or stop NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint infrastructure.
description_zh: 当被要求安装、部署、运行、验证、排查或停止 NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint 基础设施时使用。

description: Segment users from feedback data based on behavior, JTBD, and needs. Identifies at least 3 distinct user segments. Use when segmenting a user base, analyzing diverse user feedback, or building a segmentation model.
description_zh: 基于行为、JTBD 和用户需求，从反馈数据中划分用户群体。至少识别出 3 个不同的用户细分群体。适用于对用户群体进行细分、分析多样化的用户反馈，或构建细分模型时使用。

description: Analyzes Android build files and R8 keep rules to identify redundancies, broad package-wide rules, and rules that subsume library consumer keep rules. Use when developers want to optimize their app's size, remove redundant or overly broad keep rules, or troubleshoot Proguard configurations.
description_zh: 分析 Android 构建文件与 R8 保留规则，以识别冗余项、范围过宽的全包规则，以及会涵盖库使用者保留规则的规则。适用于开发者需要优化应用体积、移除冗余或过于宽泛的保留规则，或排查 Proguard 配置时。

description: Creates, modifies, or manages Salesforce Experience Cloud LWR sites via DigitalExperience metadata. Always trigger when the tasks involve LWR sites configurations, e.g. creating/modifying pages/routes/views/theme layouts/branding sets, previewing sites, or creating/modifying guest sharing rule (metadata type sharingGuestRules)/guest user access/sharing records to guest users, or when user provides a guest user ID (15 or 18 characters starting with 005). NEVER trigger for React or any other ui bundle framework. LWR sites ONLY.
description_zh: 通过 Digital Experience 元数据创建、修改或管理 Salesforce Experience Cloud LWR 站点。当任务涉及 LWR 站点配置时，必须始终触发，例如创建/修改页面、路由、视图、主题布局、品牌集，以及预览站点，或创建/修改访客共享规则（元数据类型 sharingGuestRules）/访客用户对访客用户的访问/共享记录，或当用户提供访客用户 ID（15 位或 18 位，以 005 开头）时。切勿针对 React 或任何其他 UI 打包框架触发。仅限 LWR 站点。

description:
Generate HeyGen presenter videos via the v3 Video Agent pipeline — handles Frame Check
(aspect ratio correction), prompt engineering, avatar resolution, and voice selection.
Required for any HeyGen video generation. Replaces deprecated endpoints with v3.
Use when: (1) generating any HeyGen video (via API or otherwise),
(2) sending a personalized video message (outreach, update, announcement, pitch, knowledge),
(3) creating a HeyGen presenter-led explainer, tutorial, or product demo with a human face,
(4) "make a video of me saying...", "send a video to my leads", "record an update for my team",
"create a video pitch", "make a loom-style message", "I want to appear in this video",
"generate a HeyGen video", "make a talking head video".
Accepts avatar_id from heygen-avatar for identity-first HeyGen videos, or uses a stock presenter.
Returns video share URL + HeyGen session URL for iteration.
Chain signal: when the user wants to create/design an avatar AND make a video in the same request,
run heygen-avatar first, then return here. Conjunctions to watch: "and then", "and immediately",
"first...then", "X and make a video", "design [presenter] and record" = always CHAIN.
If the user provides a photo AND wants a video, route to heygen-avatar first.
NOT for: avatar creation or identity setup (use heygen-avatar first), cinematic footage
or b-roll without a presenter, translating videos, TTS-only, or streaming avatars.
description_zh:
通过 v3 Video Agent 流水线生成 HeyGen 演示者视频——负责帧校验（宽高比校正）、提示词工程、头像分辨率处理，以及语音选择。
任何 HeyGen 视频生成均必需。用 v3 替代已弃用的接口。
使用时场景：
(1) 通过 API 或其他方式生成任何 HeyGen 视频，
(2) 发送个性化视频消息（外联、更新、公告、推介、知识），
(3) 创建由演示者主导的 HeyGen 讲解、教程或产品演示，且使用真人面部，
(4) “让我说出……的视频”、“向我的潜在客户发送视频”、“为我的团队记录更新”、
“创建视频推介”、“制作 loom 风格消息”、“我想出现在这个视频中”、
“生成 HeyGen 视频”、“制作出镜说话视频”。
接受来自 heygen-avatar 的 avatar_id，用于身份优先的 HeyGen 视频，或使用预置演示者。
返回视频分享链接 + HeyGen 会话链接，用于迭代。
链路信号：当用户在同一请求中既要创建/设计头像，又要制作视频时，先运行 heygen-avatar，再返回此处。
需要关注的连接词：“然后”、“并立即”、“先……再……”、“X 与制作视频”、“设计 [演示者] 并录制” = 始终为 CHAIN。
如果用户提供照片且想要视频，则首先路由到 heygen-avatar。
不适用于：头像创建或身份设置（需先使用 heygen-avatar）、无演示者的电影画面或 B-roll、视频翻译、仅 TTS、或流媒体头像。

description: Generate images and videos using fal.ai AI models. Production-grade catalogue covering Flux, SDXL, ideogram, and other community-hosted endpoints.
description_zh: 使用 fal.ai 的 AI 模型生成图像和视频，并提供覆盖 Flux、SDXL、ideogram 及其他社区托管端点的生产级目录。

description:
Connect a ChatGPT or Codex subscription via OAuth device-code login.

Use when the user wants to sign in with their ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Team account (e.g. "use my Codex subscription", "log in with ChatGPT").
YouTube clip generation and editing with automated workflows — pull source video, slice highlights, add captions, and export.
description_zh: 使用自动化工作流生成和编辑 YouTube 视频片段——提取源视频、切分精彩片段、添加字幕并导出。

description: Draft an offer letter with comp details and terms. Use when a candidate is ready for an offer, assembling a total comp package (base, equity, signing bonus), writing the offer letter text itself, or prepping negotiation guidance for the hiring manager.
description_zh: 起草包含薪酬详情与条款的录用信。在候选人已准备好录用、编制总薪酬组合（基本薪酬、股权、签约奖金）、撰写录用信正文，或为招聘经理准备谈判指导时使用。

description: Interactive lesson tutor for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Reads LEARNING.md, fetches the next lesson, teaches it section by section in the terminal, quizzes at the end, and records progress. Works cloned or entirely over raw.githubusercontent.com — no setup required. Trigger phrases: "next lesson", "teach me", "continue the course", "let's learn", "resume learning"
description_zh: 针对“从零开始AI工程”课程的交互式课程辅导助手。读取 LEARNING.md，获取下一节课，在终端中逐节教授，在课程结束时进行测验，并记录学习进度。支持通过克隆或完全基于 raw.githubusercontent.com 工作，无需设置。触发短语："下一节课"、"教我"、"继续课程"、"让我们学习"、"继续学习"。

description: AI-powered image editing with style transfer, background removal, object removal, and inpainting via fal.ai hosted models.
description_zh: 通过 fal.ai 托管的模型实现的 AI 驱动图像编辑，支持风格迁移、背景移除、对象移除和图像修复。

description: Critically review strategy drafts from edge-strategy-designer for edge plausibility, overfitting risk, sample size adequacy, and execution realism. Use when strategy_drafts/*.yaml exists and needs quality gate before pipeline export. Outputs PASS/REVISE/REJECT verdicts with confidence scores.
description_zh: 严格审查边缘策略设计器提供的策略草稿，评估边缘合理性、过拟合风险、样本量充足性以及执行现实性。当存在 strategy_drafts/*.yaml 且需要质量门禁时，在流水线导出前使用。输出附带置信度评分的 PASS/REVISE/REVISE/REJECT 判定结果。

description: Run Figma Plugin API scripts for canvas writes, inspections, variables, and design-system work. Prerequisite for every other Figma skill in this catalogue.
description_zh: 运行 Figma 插件 API 脚本，用于画布写入、检视、变量与设计系统工作。这是本目录中所有其他 Figma 技能的前置条件。

description: Detects market top probability using O'Neil Distribution Days, Minervini Leading Stock Deterioration, and Monty Defensive Sector Rotation. Generates a 0-100 composite score with risk zone classification. Use when user asks about market top risk, distribution days, defensive rotation, leadership breakdown, or whether to reduce equity exposure. Focuses on 2-8 week tactical timing signals for 10-20% corrections.
description_zh: 检测市场顶部概率，使用O'Neil分布日、Minervini领先股票恶化及Monty防御板块轮动。生成0-100综合评分并进行分类风险区域划分。用户询问市场顶部风险、分布日、防御轮动、龙头股疲软，或是否应降低股票持仓时使用。侧重于2-8周战术时机信号，适用于10-20%的市场回调。

description: Guides creation and modification of ASP.NET Core Web API endpoints with correct HTTP semantics, OpenAPI metadata, and error handling. USE FOR: adding new API endpoints (controllers or minimal APIs), wiring up OpenAPI/Swagger, creating .http test files, setting up global error handling middleware. DO NOT USE FOR: general C# coding style, EF Core data access or query optimization (use optimizing-ef-core-queries), frontend/Blazor work, gRPC services, or SignalR hubs.
description_zh: 指南用于创建和修改 ASP.NET Core Web API 端点，确保其具备正确的 HTTP 语义、OpenAPI 元数据及错误处理。适用场景：添加新的 API 端点（控制器或极简 API）、配置 OpenAPI/Swagger、创建 .http 测试文件、设置全局错误处理中间件。不适用场景：通用 C# 编码风格、EF Core 数据访问或查询优化（请使用 optimizing-ef-core-queries）、前端/Blazor 开发工作、gRPC 服务或 SignalR Hubs。

description: Deploy and configure web frameworks on Netlify — build settings and SSR/edge adapters plus local platform emulation and env vars. Use when setting up or fixing a framework deploy (Next.js / Astro / Nuxt / SvelteKit / Remix / React Router / TanStack Start / SolidStart / Gatsby / Angular / Vite / Express / Hydrogen / Hugo / Eleventy / Vue / React), adding SSR or edge functions or middleware wired to Netlify context, fixing SPA redirect and catch-all rules, setting a build command or publish directory, or debugging "why isn't my env var updating" and framework build failures.
description_zh: 在 Netlify 上部署和配置 Web 框架——构建设置、SSR/边缘适配器，以及本地平台模拟和环境变量。适用于设置或修复框架部署（Next.js / Astro / Nuxt / SvelteKit / Remix / React Router / TanStack Start / SolidStart / Gatsby / Angular / Vite / Express / Hydrogen / Hugo / Eleventy / Vue / React）时，添加绑定 Netlify 上下文的 SSR 或边缘函数或中间件、修复 SPA 重定向和通配规则、设置构建命令或发布目录，或排查“为什么我的环境变量没有更新”以及框架构建失败的问题。

description: Generate creative domain name ideas and check availability across multiple TLDs including .com, .io, .dev, and .ai.
description_zh: 生成创意域名名称建议，并在包括 .com、.io、.dev 和 .ai 在内的多个顶级域名（TLDs）上检查其可用性。

description: Generate and edit images using OpenAI's Image API for project assets — UI mockups, icons, illustrations, social cards, and visual references.
description_zh: 使用 OpenAI 图像 API 生成和编辑图像，用于项目资产——UI 界面原型、图标、插画、社交媒体卡片及视觉参考。

description: Analyzes market breadth using Monty's Uptrend Ratio Dashboard data to diagnose the current market environment. Generates a 0-100 composite score from 5 components (breadth, sector participation, rotation, momentum, historical context). Use when asking about market breadth, uptrend ratios, or whether the market environment supports equity exposure. No API key required.
description_zh: 使用Monty的上升趋势比率看板数据分析市场广度，以诊断当前市场环境。基于5个成分（广度、板块参与度、轮动、动能、历史背景）生成0-100的综合评分。适用于询问市场广度、上升趋势比率，或市场环境是否支持股票持仓的情况。无需API密钥。

description: 企业微信文档管理技能。提供文档的创建、读取和编辑能力，支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 操作企业微信文档（doc_type=3）和智能表格（doc_type=10）。适用场景：(1) 以 Markdown 格式导出获取文档完整内容（异步轮询） (2) 新建文档或智能表格 (3) 用 Markdown 格式覆写文档内容。当用户需要查看文档内容、创建新文档、编辑文档正文时触发此 Skill。
description_zh: 企业微信文档管理技能。提供文档的创建、读取和编辑能力，支持通过 `docid` 或文档 URL 操作企业微信文档（`doc_type=3`）和智能表格（`doc_type=10`）。适用场景：(1) 以 Markdown 格式导出获取文档完整内容（异步轮询） (2) 新建文档或智能表格 (3) 用 Markdown 格式覆写文档内容。当用户需要查看文档内容、创建新文档、编辑文档正文时触发此技能。

description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions, or commit messages.
description_zh: 分层技术写作标准：Diátaxis 结构、谷歌开发者风格句子、STE 指令规则、全球英语语法。适用于 / 技术写作，或在编写或审核文档、RFC、readme、PR 描述或提交信息时使用。

description: Build and script 2D tilemaps in Unity 6.3 LTS: the Grid + Tilemap components, the Tile Palette, tilemap colliders, rule tiles, and runtime SetTile/GetTile painting. Use when painting tile levels, adding a TilemapCollider2D, using rule or animated tiles, generating tilemaps from code, or when the user mentions Unity tilemap, tile palette, rule tile, or Grid.
description_zh: 在 Unity 6.3 LTS 中构建并脚本化 2D 瓦片图：Grid 与 Tilemap 组件、瓦片调色板、瓦片图碰撞体、规则瓦片以及运行时 SetTile/GetTile 绘制操作。用于绘制瓦片层级、添加 TilemapCollider2D、使用规则或动画瓦片、通过代码生成瓦片图，或当用户提及 Unity 瓦片图、瓦片调色板、规则瓦片或 Grid 时。

description: Generate realistic dummy datasets for testing with customizable columns, constraints, and output formats (CSV, JSON, SQL, Python script). Use when creating test data, building mock datasets, or generating sample data for development and demos.
description_zh: 生成逼真的模拟数据集，支持自定义列、约束及输出格式（CSV、JSON、SQL、Python脚本），可用于测试。适用于创建测试数据、构建模拟数据集，或为开发与演示生成样本数据。

description: Guides for writing and editing Remotion documentation. Use when adding docs pages, editing MDX files in packages/docs, or writing documentation content.
description_zh: Remotion 文档撰写与编辑指南。在添加文档页面、编辑 packages/docs 中的 MDX 文件或撰写文档内容时使用。

description: Full Caido SDK integration for Claude Code. Search HTTP history with HTTPQL, test with curl proxied through Caido (caching auth in reusable static curl config files), add match & replace rules, and organize handoffs into named replay sessions and collections - all via the official @caido/sdk-client. PAT auth recommended.
description_zh: Claude Code 的完整 Caido SDK 集成。使用 HTTPQL 搜索 HTTP 历史记录，通过经 Caido 代理的 curl 进行测试（在可复用的静态 curl 配置文件中缓存认证），添加匹配与替换规则，并将交接工作整理为命名重放会话和集合——所有操作均通过官方的 @caido/sdk-client 完成。建议使用 PAT 认证。

description: B2B LinkedIn ghostwriting — hooks, post structures, and copywriting frameworks for conversion-focused posts. Use when the user wants to write LinkedIn content, create ghostwritten posts, ghostwrite for a founder or executive, or develop a B2B social strategy. Apply when the user shares a story, result, or insight and wants it turned into a post. Do NOT use for newsletter or Substack issues — use samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting instead.
description_zh: B2B LinkedIn 文案代写——用于转化导向帖子的吸引关注点、帖子结构与文案框架。当用户需要撰写 LinkedIn 内容、创建代写帖子、为创始人或高管代写，或制定 B2B 社交策略时使用。当用户分享故事、成果或见解并希望将其转化为帖子时适用。请勿用于新闻通讯或 Substack 内容——请改用 samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting。

description: Optimize App Store product pages for search visibility and conversion. Use for App Store Optimization (ASO), keyword research, app name/subtitle/keyword-field strategy, conversion-focused descriptions and promotional text, screenshot captions and ordering, Custom Product Pages with assigned search keywords, In-App Events, Product Page Optimization tests, localized metadata, ratings/review strategy, and in-app review prompt timing with RequestReviewAction or AppStore.requestReview. Also use when routing ASO vs App Store review, privacy/ATT, or StoreKit implementation boundaries.
description_zh: 优化 App Store 产品页面，以提升搜索可见性与转化效果。用于 App Store 优化（ASO）、关键词研究、应用名称/副标题/关键词字段策略、以转化为导向的描述与推广文案、截图说明与排序、分配搜索关键词的自定义产品页面、应用内事件、产品页面优化测试、本地化元数据、评分/评价策略，以及应用内评价提示时机（使用 RequestReviewAction 或 AppStore.requestReview）。同时适用于区分 ASO 与 App Store 评价的路由、隐私/ATT 相关处理，以及 StoreKit 实施边界。

description: Build Windows images with Packer using WinRM communicator and PowerShell provisioners. Use when creating Windows AMIs, Azure images, or VMware templates.
description_zh: 使用 WinRM 通信器与 PowerShell 配置器，通过 Packer 构建 Windows 镜像。在创建 Windows AMIs、Azure 镜像或 VMware 模板时使用。

description: UI and visual skill for antislop. Use when building or editing any interface: color, layout, components, motion. Load with the core.
description_zh: Antislop 的 UI 与视觉技能。构建或编辑任何界面时使用：色彩、布局、组件、动效。随核心加载。

description: Full-lifecycle AI music album production — concept, lyric drafting, track sequencing, and export. Useful for indie album experiments and brand soundtracks.
description_zh: AI音乐专辑全生命周期制作——概念构思、歌词起草、曲目编排与导出。适用于独立专辑实验与品牌配乐。

description: Official GSAP skill for timelines — gsap.timeline(), position parameter, nesting, playback. Use when sequencing animations, choreographing keyframes, or when the user asks about animation sequencing, timelines, or animation order (in GSAP or when recommending a library that supports timelines).
description_zh: 官方 GSAP 时间线技能 — gsap.timeline()、位置参数、嵌套、播放。适用于为动画排序、编排关键帧，或在用户询问动画排序、时间线或动画顺序时（在 GSAP 中，或在推荐支持时间线的库时）。

description: Help users convert massive volumes of qualitative and quantitative feedback into high-confidence product decisions through rigorous synthesis and internal immersion.
description_zh: 帮助用户通过严谨的整合分析与深度内化，将海量定性与定量反馈转化为高置信度的产品决策。

description: Professional DOCX document creation and editing using OpenXML SDK. Useful for branded reports, polished proposals, and template-based authoring.
description_zh: 使用 OpenXML SDK 进行专业的 DOCX 文档创建与编辑。适用于品牌化报告、精心打磨的提案以及基于模板的文档撰写。

description: Use when a Lightning Web Component data need is described in ambiguous natural language — turn "get contact info" or "show account data" into a clear, PRD-ready data-requirements spec. TRIGGER when the user says "define data requirements for this LWC", "turn this PRD data section into validated object/field names", "recommend GraphQL vs UIAPI for this data need", "validate these Salesforce API names", or "spec out the LDS adapter for this component", or references LWC bundle files (`.js`, `.js-meta.xml`) whose data layer is not yet specified. DO NOT TRIGGER when the data layer is already fully specified, when authoring the actual query or adapter code from a known spec, or when implementing an LWC end-to-end (use experience-lwc-generate).
description_zh:
适用场景：当 Lightning Web 组件（LWC）的数据需求以模糊的自然语言描述时使用——将“获取联系信息”或“显示账户数据”转化为清晰、可直接用于产品需求文档（PRD）的数据需求规范。

触发条件：当用户说“为这个 Lightning Web 组件（LWC）定义数据需求”、“将此 PRD 数据章节转换为经过验证的对象/字段名称”、“针对此数据需求推荐使用 GraphQL 还是 UIAPI”、“验证这些 Salesforce API 名称”，或“为该组件制定 LDS 适配器规格”，或引用尚未指定数据层的 Lightning Web 组件（LWC）打包文件（`.js`、`.js-meta.xml`）时，触发。

请勿在以下情况触发：数据层已完全指定；依据已知规格编写实际的查询或适配器代码；或端到端实现 Lightning Web 组件（使用 experience-lwc-generate）。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to custom-metrics. Do not use this skill; invoke custom-metrics instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-custom-metrics still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 该技能已更名为 custom-metrics。请勿使用此技能；请改用 custom-metrics 调用。保留此重定向仅用于确保旧对 aiconfig-custom-metrics 的引用仍能将用户指向新名称。

description:
Release notes one-page HTML with highlights, Added, Fixed, Breaking changes,
Known issues, and Upgrade note. Writes explicit "None" style sections
whenever the user does not provide details.
description_zh: 单页 HTML 发布说明，包含亮点、新增、修复、破坏性变更、已知问题及升级说明。当用户未提供详细信息时，会明确写入类似于“无”的章节。

description: Work out and record the architecture decisions that keep separately built parts of a system consistent, in a short architecture document. Creates, updates, or validates one; works from a spec, a raw idea, or an existing codebase. Use when the user says "create the architecture", "create technical architecture", "architecture spine", or "create a solution design"
description_zh: 在一份简短的架构文档中，制定并记录确保系统中独立构建的各个部分保持一致的架构决策。创建、更新或验证其中之一；基于规格说明、原始想法或现有代码库进行操作。当用户说“创建架构”、“创建技术架构”、“架构骨架”或“创建解决方案设计”时使用。

description: Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes obvious.
description_zh: 在编写代码逻辑之前应用：选择核心类型和数据结构，安排脚手架与功能工作的顺序，询问并发演员共享什么。确保数据结构正确，使下游代码清晰可见。

description: Run a structured discovery session to build an Allium specification through conversation. Use when the user wants to create a new spec from scratch, elicit or gather requirements, capture domain behaviour, specify a feature or system, define what a system should do, or is describing functionality and needs help shaping it into a specification.
description_zh: 运行结构化的探索会议，通过对话来构建Allium规范。当用户想从头创建新的规范、提取或收集需求、捕获领域行为、指定一个功能或系统、定义系统应该做什么，或者在描述功能并需要帮助将其塑造成规范时，使用。

description: Analyze images — segment objects, detect, run OCR, describe, and answer visual questions via fal.ai vision models.
description_zh: 分析图像——对物体进行分割、检测、运行 OCR、描述，并通过 fal.ai 视觉模型回答视觉问题。

description: Generate spoken audio from text using OpenAI's API with built-in voices. Useful for narrated explainers, lecture audio, and quick voiceover tracks.
description_zh: 使用 OpenAI 的 API 及内置语音，根据文本生成语音音频。适用于叙述式讲解、讲座音频以及快速配音音轨。

description: Condense any input — an idea, brief, PRD, transcript, or mixed notes — into a short spec: SPEC.md plus supporting files that downstream skills build from. Also updates and validates existing specs, and can break a spec into stories. Use when the user says "create a spec", "distill this into a spec", "validate this spec", "update the spec", or "break this into stories"
description_zh: 将任何输入——无论是想法、简报、PRD、transcript、混合笔记——浓缩为一份简短规范：SPEC.md 及由下游技能据此构建的支持文件。同时更新并验证现有规范，也可以将规范拆分为多个故事。当用户表示“创建规范”、“将此内容提炼为规范”、“验证此规范”、“更新规范”或“将此内容拆分为故事”时使用。

description: Use this skill to find high-quality dividend growth stocks (12%+ annual dividend growth, 1.5%+ yield) that are experiencing temporary pullbacks, identified by RSI oversold conditions (RSI ≤40). This skill combines fundamental dividend analysis with technical timing indicators to identify buying opportunities in strong dividend growers during short-term weakness.
description_zh: 使用此技能，可寻找优质股息增长型股票（年度股息增长率12%以上，股息率1.5%以上）且正在经历暂时回调，这类股票以RSI超卖条件（RSI≤40）识别。该技能将基本面股息分析与技术分析时点指标相结合，以在强势股息增长者短期走弱时识别买入机会。

description: Upscale and enhance image and video resolution using AI super-resolution models hosted on fal.ai.
description_zh: 使用部署在 fal.ai 上的 AI 超分辨率模型，放大并提升图像与视频的分辨率。

description: Use the imsg CLI from OpenClaw agents for iMessage/SMS DMs, groups, replies, reactions, polls, watching, and private-API actions.
description_zh: 使用来自 OpenClaw 智能体的 imsg CLI 来处理 iMessage/SMS 私信、群组、回复、反应、投票、关注以及私有 API 操作。

description: 生成一个交互式 bash wizard，逐步引导人完成只有他们能执行的手动流程。用于 provisioning 基础设施、设置 credentials 或 CI secrets、走查不熟悉的第三方 dashboard，或运行一次性 migration 或 cutover。对于 agent 自己就能执行的步骤，不要调用它。
description_zh: 生成一个交互式 bash 向导，逐步引导用户完成仅有其权限可执行的手动流程。用于基础设施配置、设置凭据或 CI 机密信息、走查不熟悉的第三方仪表盘，或执行一次性迁移或切换。对于 agent 自身即可执行的步骤，不要调用它。

description: Use the Appllama MCP (mcp.appllama.io) well — research real top-grossing mobile apps, their screens, flows, and UI elements, then build from what you learn. Load when the Appllama MCP is connected and the task involves building a mobile app or screen, researching app design patterns, studying onboarding/paywall/feature flows, improving an existing screen, or whenever an appllama_* / search_apps / list_app_screens tool is available. Covers the tool map, pagination, expiring media, and the full build-from-research playbooks.
description_zh: 熟练运用 Appllama MCP (mcp.appllama.io) —— 研究真实的畅销移动应用、其屏幕、交互流程与界面元素，并基于所学进行构建。当 Appllama MCP 已连接，且任务涉及构建移动应用或屏幕、研究应用设计模式、研究新手引导/付费墙/功能交互流程、改进现有屏幕，或 appllama_* / search_apps / list_app_screens 工具可用时，请加载该功能。内容涵盖工具地图、分页、过期媒体以及完整的基于研究构建的流程指南。

description: Run file-based C# apps with the .NET CLI when the user explicitly wants C#/.NET code without creating a project. Use for C# language/API experiments, one-file C# apps, small multi-file C# apps composed with `#:include`/`#:exclude`, or C# file-based apps linked with `#:ref`. Do not use for language-agnostic throwaway scripts, generic computations, Python/PowerShell-style automation, full projects, or existing app integration.
description_zh: 当用户明确需要无需创建项目的C#/.NET代码时，使用.NET CLI运行基于文件的C#应用程序。用于C#语言/API实验、单文件C#应用程序、通过`#:include`/`#:exclude`组合的小型多文件C#应用程序，或通过`#:ref`链接的C#基于文件的应用程序。不要用于语言无关的临时脚本、通用计算、Python/PowerShell风格自动化、完整项目，或现有应用程序集成。

description:
Swiss-style user-research narrative template in warm-paper editorial aesthetics.
Use when users ask for a premium research deck or story-first live artifact with
minimalist typography, high-clarity layout, subtle motion, donut breakdowns,
and keyboard/click navigation across slides in a single HTML file.
description_zh:
具有暖纸编辑美学的瑞士风格用户研究叙事模板。
适用于用户请求制作高端研究演示文稿或以故事为先的实时成果时，该模板具备极简排版、高清晰度布局、微妙动态、环形图拆解与幻灯片间的键盘/点击导航，并整合于单个HTML文件中。

description: Build typed, content-driven Nuxt applications with @nuxt/content. Use when working with content.config.ts, collections, queryCollection, Markdown or MDC rendering, content databases, hooks, custom sources, search, or Content v2 migrations.
description_zh: 使用 @nuxt/content 构建类型化、内容驱动的 Nuxt 应用。适用于处理 content.config.ts、collections、queryCollection、Markdown 或 MDC 渲染、内容数据库、钩子、自定义数据源、搜索以及 Content v2 迁移等场景。

description: Plan a sprint with capacity estimation, story selection, dependency mapping, and risk identification. Use when preparing for sprint planning, estimating team capacity, selecting stories, or balancing sprint scope against velocity.
description_zh: 通过产能评估、用户故事选择、依赖关系映射和风险识别来规划冲刺。适用于为冲刺计划做准备、估算团队产能、选取用户故事，或平衡冲刺范围与团队速度。

description: Use this when someone says I don't know where to start or help me get going, asks where am I? in the six-stage journey, requests on-demand org feature detection for Data 360, OmniStudio, or DevOps Center, or asks what could help me do X / which plugin would help with X for a task no installed skill already covers. DO NOT TRIGGER for specific Salesforce tasks already owned by a leaf skill or for generic non-Salesforce help.
description_zh:
当出现以下情况时，使用此操作：有人表示不知道从哪里开始或需要帮助开始推进，并询问自己在六阶段旅程中的位置；有人请求为 Data 360、OmniStudio 或 DevOps Center 按需检测组织功能；有人询问对于尚未被任何已安装技能覆盖的任务，有什么可以帮助完成 X，或哪个插件可以帮助完成 X。

对于已由叶子技能负责的具体 Salesforce 任务，或针对通用非 Salesforce 的帮助请求，请勿触发。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Cloudflare Workers and Pages. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Cloudflare Workers", "install @sentry/cloudflare", or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, crons, or AI monitoring for Cloudflare Workers, Pages, Durable Objects, Queues, Workflows, or Hono on Cloudflare.
description_zh: Cloudflare Workers 和 Pages 的完整 Sentry SDK 配置。适用于被要求“向 Cloudflare Workers 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/cloudflare”，或为 Cloudflare Workers、Pages、Durable Objects、Queues、Workflows 或 Cloudflare 上的 Hono 配置错误监控、追踪、日志、定时任务（crons）或 AI 监控时使用。

description: Build a local SEO strategy covering Google Business Profile, local citations, reviews, and NAP consistency. Use when the user asks about local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Maps ranking, local pack, NAP consistency, local citations, review strategy, or ranking for "[service] near me" searches.
description_zh: 制定一个涵盖Google商家资料、本地引用、评价和NAP一致性的本地SEO策略。当用户询问本地SEO、Google商家资料、Google地图排名、本地包、NAP一致性、本地引用、评价策略，或对“[service]附近”搜索的排名时使用。

description: Professional React animation skill for creating Awwwards/FWA-level animations using GSAP (useGSAP), Motion (Framer Motion), Anime.js, and Lenis. Use when building premium scroll experiences, custom cursors, page transitions, text animations, parallax effects, micro-interactions, or any animation that needs to be 60fps and award-worthy. Triggers on requests for smooth scroll, ScrollTrigger, magnetic effects, reveal animations, horizontal scroll, pin sections, stagger effects, useScroll, useTransform, integration with Three.js/WebGL, algorithmic art, mathematical art, generative art, fractals, L-systems, flow fields, strange attractors, sacred geometry, geometric puzzles, Dudeney dissections, tangram, tessellations, Penrose tiles, kinetic typography, glitch effects, text explosion, morphing text, circular text, brutalist design, minimalist animation, neo-brutalism, or design philosophy mixing. React-first approach with proper cleanup and hooks.
description_zh: 专业的 React 动画技能，使用 GSAP（useGSAP）、Motion（Framer Motion）、Anime.js 和 Lenis 创建 Awwwards/FWA 级别的动画。适用于构建高端滚动体验、自定义光标、页面过渡、文字动画、视差效果、微交互，或任何需要达到 60fps 且具有获奖品质的动画。适用于以下请求：平滑滚动、ScrollTrigger、磁性效果、揭示动画、水平滚动、固定板块、交错效果、useScroll、useTransform、与 Three.js/WebGL 的集成、算法艺术、数学艺术、生成艺术、分形、L-systems、流场、奇异吸引子、神圣几何、几何谜题、杜德尼分割、七巧板、镶嵌、彭罗斯瓦片、动态排版、故障效果、文字爆炸、文字变形、圆形文字、粗野主义设计、极简动画、新粗野主义，或设计理念融合。采用 React 优先的方法，并包含适当的清理和钩子（hooks）。

description:
A Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page with collapsible accordion sections,
search functionality, and category filtering. Use when the brief asks for
"FAQ", "help center", "questions", or "support page".
description_zh: 常见问题（FAQ）页面，配备可折叠手风琴区块、搜索功能和分类筛选。当需求说明要求提供“FAQ”“帮助中心”“问题”或“支持页面”时使用。

description: Verify and debug native, React Native, Expo, or Flutter apps on an iOS Simulator with agent-device. Use when an agent needs to launch an app, inspect its live UI, tap, type, scroll, validate a code change, collect failure evidence, or reproduce a workflow on an iPhone or iPad Simulator.
description_zh: 验证并使用 agent-device 在 iOS 模拟器上对原生、React Native、Expo 或 Flutter 应用进行验证和调试。适用于：当 agent 需要在 iPhone 或 iPad 模拟器中启动应用、检查实时界面、点击、输入、滚动、验证代码修改、收集失败证据或重现工作流时使用。

description: Virtual try-on — see how clothes look on a person via fal.ai's hosted try-on models. Useful for ecommerce, lookbooks, and styling experiments.
description_zh: 虚拟试穿——通过 fal.ai 托管的试穿模型，查看衣物在真人身上呈现的效果。适用于电商、Lookbook 和造型实验。

description: Link workspace packages in monorepos (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun). USE WHEN: (1) you just created or generated new packages and need to wire up their dependencies, (2) user imports from a sibling package and needs to add it as a dependency, (3) you get resolution errors for workspace packages (@org/*) like "cannot find module", "failed to resolve import", "TS2307", or "cannot resolve". DO NOT patch around with tsconfig paths or manual package.json edits - use the package manager's workspace commands to fix actual linking.
description_zh: 链接单体仓库（npm、yarn、pnpm、bun）中的工作区包。使用场景： (1) 您刚创建或生成新包，需要配置其依赖；(2) 用户从同级包导入内容，需要将其添加为依赖；(3) 遇到工作区包（@org/*）的解析错误，如“找不到模块”、“导入解析失败”、“TS2307”或“无法解析”。请勿通过 tsconfig paths 或手动修改 package.json 来绕过问题，应使用包管理器的工作区命令解决实际的链接问题。

description: Detect and analyze trending market themes across sectors. Use when user asks about current market themes, trending sectors, sector rotation, thematic investing, what themes are hot or cold, or wants to identify bullish and bearish market narratives with lifecycle analysis.
description_zh: 检测和分析跨行业的市场热门主题。当用户询问当前市场主题、热门板块、板块轮动、主题投资、哪些主题热门或冷门，或希望识别结合生命周期分析的市场看涨与看跌叙事时，可使用本功能。

description: Generate SOX sample selections, testing workpapers, and control assessments. Use when planning quarterly or annual SOX 404 testing, pulling a sample for a control (revenue, P2P, ITGC, close), building a testing workpaper template, or evaluating and classifying a control deficiency.
description_zh: 生成SOX样本选择、测试工作底稿和控制评估。用于规划季度或年度SOX 404测试、从一项控制中抽取样本（收入、P2P、ITGC、关账）、构建测试工作底稿模板，或评估和分类控制缺陷。

description: ALWAYS USE whenever asked to write, add, or generate unit tests for existing code, including one helper, function, class, or missing regression case as well as project-wide suites. Also use for "cover this untested method", scaffolding tests where none exist, sparse workspaces, classic packages.config MSTest, and extending healthy suites. Focused requests use a proportional direct workflow; broad requests use the full pipeline. DO NOT USE for only running/diagnosing tests, coverage/audits, a test blocked on a missing production seam (testability-obstacle), or correcting supplied MSTest assertions, attributes, lifecycle, or configuration without designing new cases (writing-mstest-tests).
description_zh: 每当被要求为现有代码编写、添加或生成单元测试时，始终使用，包括单个辅助函数、函数、类、缺失的回归测试用例以及项目范围的测试套件。此外，对于“覆盖未测试方法”、为尚不存在测试的场合搭建测试脚手架、稀疏的工作空间、经典的 packages.config MSTest，以及扩展健康的测试套件，也应使用。对于聚焦的请求，使用比例恰当的直接工作流；对于广泛的请求，使用完整流程。对于仅运行/诊断测试、覆盖率/审计、受阻于缺失生产接缝（测试性障碍）的测试，或在不设计新用例的情况下修正所提供的 MSTest 断言、属性、生命周期或配置（编写 MSTest 测试），均不得使用。

description: Implement Google's Material Design 3 (Material You) UI system. Primary: Jetpack Compose Material3 (MaterialTheme, components, adaptive layout). Also Flutter and limited web (@material/web, maintenance mode). Covers tokens, 30+ components, layout, theming, M3 Expressive (platform matrix), and accessibility. Use when: "material design", "MD3", "material you", "Jetpack Compose", "MaterialTheme", "material component", "md3 button".
description_zh: 实现 Google 的 Material Design 3 (Material You) UI 系统。主要采用 Jetpack Compose Material3 (MaterialTheme, 组件, 自适应布局)。同时支持 Flutter 和有限的 Web (@material/web, 维护模式)。涵盖设计令牌、30多个组件、布局、主题化、M3 Expressive (平台矩阵) 以及无障碍功能。适用场景："material design", "MD3", "material you", "Jetpack Compose", "MaterialTheme", "material component", "md3 button"。

description: Run a full discovery cycle from problem hypothesis to validated solution. Use when a team needs a structured path through framing, interviews, synthesis, and experiments.
description_zh: 运行从问题假设到经过验证的解决方案的完整发现周期。当团队需要一条贯穿框架构建、访谈、综合与实验的结构化路径时，使用。

description: Analyze stocks using Mark Minervini's SEPA (Specific Entry Point Analysis) methodology. Use this skill whenever the user mentions SEPA, Minervini, superperformance, trend template, VCP (Volatility Contraction Pattern), Stage 2 uptrend, stage analysis, pivot point breakout, or asks about growth stock screening criteria. Also triggers when the user wants to evaluate whether a stock meets swing trading entry criteria, check moving average alignment (bullish stacking: price above 50MA above 150MA above 200MA), assess breakout quality with volume confirmation, calculate position sizing based on risk percentage, or identify consolidation patterns like cup-with-handle, flat base, bull flag, or high tight flag. Use this skill even when the user simply asks "should I buy this stock" or "is this a good setup" in the context of growth/momentum trading, or when they share a stock chart and want pattern analysis.
description_zh: 利用马克·明尼尔维（Mark Minervini）的SEPA（Specific Entry Point Analysis，特定入场点分析）方法论分析股票。当用户提及SEPA、Minervini、superperformance（超级表现）、趋势模板、VCP（Volatility Contraction Pattern，波动收缩形态）、第二阶段上升趋势（Stage 2 uptrends）、阶段分析、枢轴点突破（pivot point breakout），或询问成长股筛选标准时，使用本技能。当用户希望评估某只股票是否符合波段交易入场标准、检查移动平均线对齐（看涨叠加：价格高于50MA、50MA高于150MA、150MA高于200MA）、结合成交量确认评估突破质量、根据风险百分比计算仓位规模，或识别杯柄形态（cup-with-handle）、平底（flat base）、看涨旗形（bull flag）、高紧旗形（high tight flag）等盘整形态时，也使用本技能。即使用户仅以“我应该买入这只股票”或“这是不是一个好的布局”等方式提问，且处于成长/动量交易背景下，或用户分享股票图表并希望进行形态分析时，也使用本技能。

description: Generate, remix, and manage short video clips via OpenAI's Sora API. Useful for cinematic shots, b-roll, and rapid concept video iteration.
description_zh: 通过 OpenAI 的 Sora API 生成、混剪并管理短视频片段。适用于电影镜头、b-roll 素材和快速概念视频迭代。

description: Image edits, upscaling, and background removal via the Venice.ai API.
description_zh: 通过 Venice.ai API 进行图像编辑、放大和背景去除。

description: Apply Swift API Design Guidelines to name, label, and document Swift APIs. Covers argument label rules (prepositional phrase rule, grammatical phrase rule, first-label omission), mutating/nonmutating pair naming (-ed/-ing participle pattern, form- prefix, sort/sorted, formUnion/union), side-effect naming (noun for pure, verb for mutating), documentation comment structure (summary by declaration kind, O(1) complexity rule), clarity at call site, role-based naming, protocol naming (-able/-ible/-ing), default arguments over method families, casing conventions, and terminology. Use when designing new Swift APIs, reviewing naming and argument labels, writing documentation comments, or refactoring for call site clarity.
description_zh: 将 Swift API 设计规范应用于 Swift API 的命名、标注与文档编写。涵盖参数标注规则（介词短语规则、语法短语规则、省略首个标注）、可变/不可变成对命名（-ed/-ing 分词模式、-form- 前缀、sort/sorted、-formUnion/union）、副作用命名（纯函数使用名词、可变函数使用动词）、文档注释结构（按声明类型进行摘要、O(1) 复杂度规则）、调用点的清晰度、基于角色的命名、协议命名（-able/-ible/-ing）、默认参数优先于方法族、大小写规范与术语。在设计新的 Swift API、审查命名与参数标注、编写文档注释，或为提升调用点清晰度进行重构时使用。

description: 企业微信智能表格数据（记录）管理技能。提供智能表格记录的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询子表全部记录 (2) 添加一行或多行记录 (3) 更新已有记录 (4) 删除记录。当用户需要读取表格数据、写入新数据、修改或删除表格行时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
description_zh: 企业微信智能表格数据（记录）管理技能。提供智能表格记录的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询子表全部记录 (2) 添加一行或多行记录 (3) 更新已有记录 (4) 删除记录。当用户需要读取表格数据、写入新数据、修改或删除表格行时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。

description: Build or update a professional-grade design system library in Figma from a codebase. Useful for keeping the Figma source of truth in sync with shipped components.
description_zh: 从代码库构建或更新Figma中的专业级设计系统库。这对于保持Figma的源信息与已发布组件同步非常有用。

description: Design and optimize upgrade screens, paywalls, and upsell modals. Useful for SaaS conversion design and pricing-page experiments.
description_zh: 设计和优化升级页面、付费墙和增值销售弹窗。适用于 SaaS 转化设计与定价页实验。

description: Review any business decision, plan, or strategy through the minimalist entrepreneur lens. Use when someone wants a gut-check on a business decision, wants to simplify their approach, or needs to decide between options.
description_zh: 以极简主义企业家的视角审视任何商业决策、计划或策略。适用于当有人希望对商业决策进行直觉判断，希望简化其方法，或需要在选项之间做出选择时使用。

description: Restore and fix image quality — deblur, denoise, fix faces, and restore old documents using fal.ai's hosted restoration models.
description_zh: 恢复并修复图像质量 — 使用 fal.ai 托管的修复模型，实现去模糊、去噪、面部修正与旧文档修复。

description: Provides guidance on OpenTelemetry SDK setup, custom instrumentation, and sending data to Honeycomb. Trigger phrases: "instrument my app", "add tracing", "set up OpenTelemetry", "configure OTel", "add custom spans", "add attributes to spans", "send traces to Honeycomb", "set up OTLP", "configure sampling", "add span events", "add span links", "set up tracing for [any language]", "configure the OTel Collector", or any request about OpenTelemetry SDK setup, custom instrumentation, or sending data to Honeycomb.
description_zh: 提供有关 OpenTelemetry SDK 设置、自定义仪表化以及向 Honeycomb 发送数据的指导。触发短语：“instrument my app”、“add tracing”、“set up OpenTelemetry”、“configure OTel”、“add custom spans”、“add attributes to spans”、“send traces to Honeycomb”、“set up OTLP”、“configure sampling”、“add span events”、“add span links”、“set up tracing for [any language]”，或任何关于 OpenTelemetry SDK 设置、自定义仪表化或向 Honeycomb 发送数据的请求。

description: Generate tests from Allium specifications. Use when the user wants to propagate tests, generate test files from a spec, write tests for a specification, create property-based tests, produce state machine tests, check test coverage against spec obligations, or understand what tests a specification requires.
description_zh: 从 Allium 规范生成测试。当用户需要传播测试、从规范生成测试文件、为规范编写测试、创建基于属性的测试、生成状态机测试、检查测试覆盖率是否符合规范要求，或理解规范所要求的测试时使用。

description: 企业微信会议查询技能, 支持查询会议列表, 获取会议详情, 按关键词查找会议. 当用户需要"查看会议", "查询会议列表", "会议详情", "什么时候开会", "有哪些会议", "查找会议"时触发.
description_zh: 企业微信会议查询技能，支持查询会议列表、获取会议详情、按关键词查找会议。当用户需要“查看会议”、“查询会议列表”、“会议详情”、“什么时候开会”、“有哪些会议”、“查找会议”时触发。

description: Iterative design-to-code feedback loop. Critique → adjust → ship cycle for tightening visual fidelity between brief and built UI.
description_zh: 迭代式设计到代码的反馈循环：评审 → 调整 → 上线周期，用于提升设计简报与已构建界面之间的视觉保真度。

description: Understand audience demographics, preferences, behavior patterns, and engagement quality across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
description_zh: 在 Facebook、Instagram、YouTube 和 TikTok 上，了解受众的人口统计特征、偏好、行为模式以及互动质量。

description: Salesforce Industries DataPack deployment automation using Vlocity Build. TRIGGER when: user deploys or validates OmniStudio/Vlocity DataPacks with vlocity commands (packDeploy/packRetry/packExport/packGetDiffs), sets up DataPack CI/CD pipelines, or troubleshoots DataPack migration errors. DO NOT TRIGGER when: deploying Salesforce metadata with sf project deploy (use deploying-metadata), authoring OmniStudio artifacts (use building-omnistudio-*), or writing Apex/LWC business logic (use generating-apex/generating-lwc-components).
description_zh: 基于 Vlocity Build 的 Salesforce Industries DataPack 部署自动化。触发条件：用户使用 vlocity 命令（packDeploy/packRetry/packExport/packGetDiffs）部署或验证 OmniStudio/Vlocity DataPack、配置 DataPack CI/CD 流水线，或排查 DataPack 迁移错误时触发。请勿触发条件：使用 sf project deploy 部署 Salesforce 元数据（使用 deploying-metadata）、创建 OmniStudio 构件（使用 building-omnistudio-*）、或编写 Apex/LWC 业务逻辑（使用 generating-apex/generating-lwc-components）时请勿触发。

description: Text-to-speech models, voices, formats, and streaming via Venice.ai. Useful for narration, voiceover, and conversational agent voices.
description_zh: 文本转语音模型、语音、格式和流式传输，通过 Venice.ai。适用于旁白、配音以及对话式智能体语音。

description: Analyze a startup from three perspectives: VC investor, job applicant, and CEO/founder. Use this skill whenever the user wants to evaluate a startup, assess whether to invest in or join a startup, do due diligence, evaluate a job offer from a startup, understand a startup's competitive position, or assess company health and trajectory. Triggers: "analyze this startup", "should I join [company]", "is [company] a good investment", "evaluate [company]", "due diligence on [company]", "what do you think of [startup]", "should I take this startup job offer", "how healthy is [company]", "startup assessment", "company analysis", "is [company] worth joining", "what's the outlook for [company]", "research [company] for me", any mention of evaluating or assessing a startup or tech company from investment, career, or strategic perspectives — provide all three perspectives by default.
description_zh:
从以下三个视角分析一家初创公司：风险投资（VC）投资者、求职者以及创始人/CEO。当用户需要评估一家初创公司、评估是否投资或加入初创公司、进行尽职调查、评估初创公司提供的岗位offer、了解初创公司的竞争地位，或评估公司健康状况与发展轨迹时，请使用本技能。

触发词：
- "分析这家初创公司"
- "我是否应该加入 [公司]"
- "[公司] 是一个好的投资吗"
- "评估 [公司]"
- "对 [公司] 进行尽职调查"
- "你觉得 [初创公司] 怎么样"
- "我应该接受这家初创公司的岗位offer吗"
- "[公司] 状况健康吗"
- "初创公司评估"
- "公司分析"
- "[公司] 值得加入吗"
- "[公司] 的前景如何"
- "为我研究 [公司]"
- 任何涉及从投资、职业或战略角度评估或评估一家初创公司或科技公司的提及 —— 默认提供所有三个视角。

description: Editorial magazine meets e-ink: 10 layouts and 5 palettes (Ink, Indigo Porcelain, Forest Ink, Kraft Paper, Dune).
description_zh: 编辑型杂志邂逅电子墨水：10种版式与5种色板（墨色、靛蓝瓷色、森林墨色、牛皮纸色、沙丘色）

description: Edit existing videos using AI — remix style, upscale, remove background, and add audio via fal.ai's hosted video models.
description_zh: 使用AI编辑现有视频——借助fal.ai的托管视频模型，支持混剪风格、画质提升、去除背景和添加音频。

description: Connect Figma design components to code components using Code Connect so design-system updates flow into the codebase automatically.
description_zh: 使用 Code Connect 将 Figma 设计组件与代码组件连接起来，以便设计系统更新能够自动流入代码库。

description: Render and serialize Portable Text to React, Svelte, Vue, Astro, HTML, Markdown, and plain text. Use when implementing Portable Text rendering in any frontend framework, building custom serializers for non-standard block types, converting Portable Text to HTML strings server-side, converting Portable Text to Markdown, extracting plain text from Portable Text, or troubleshooting rendering issues with marks, blocks, lists, or custom types.
description_zh: 将 Portable Text 渲染并序列化为 React、Svelte、Vue、Astro、HTML、Markdown 和纯文本。适用于在任何前端框架中实现 Portable Text 渲染、为非标准区块类型构建自定义序列化器、服务端将 Portable Text 转换为 HTML 字符串、将 Portable Text 转换为 Markdown、从 Portable Text 中提取纯文本，以及排查因 marks、blocks、lists 或自定义类型导致的渲染问题。

description:
Provides comprehensive code review guidance for React 19, Vue 3, Angular 17+, Svelte 5,
Rust, TypeScript, Java, Java 8, PHP, Ruby, Rails, Python, Django, FastAPI, Go, C#/.NET, Kotlin, Swift,
Dart, Flutter, NestJS, C/C++, Zig, CSS/Less/Sass, Qt, and more.
Covers architecture review, performance review, security audit, code quality anti-patterns,
and common bugs across all ecosystems.
Use when: reviewing pull requests, conducting PR reviews, code review, reviewing code changes,
establishing review standards, mentoring developers, architecture reviews, security audits,
performance reviews, checking code quality, finding bugs, giving feedback on code.
description_zh:
为 React 19、Vue 3、Angular 17+、Svelte 5、Rust、TypeScript、Java、Java 8、PHP、Ruby、Rails、Python、Django、FastAPI、Go、C#/.NET、Kotlin、Swift、Dart、Flutter、NestJS、C/C++、Zig、CSS/Less/Sass、Qt 等更多技术提供全面的代码评审指导。

涵盖所有生态系统的架构评审、性能评审、安全审计、代码质量反模式以及常见缺陷。

适用场景：评审 pull requests、进行 PR 评审、代码评审、评审代码变更、制定评审标准、指导开发人员、架构评审、安全审计、性能评审、检查代码质量、查找缺陷、对代码提供反馈。

description: Wallets for AI agents with x402 and MPP payment signing, referral rewards, and policy-controlled actions.
description_zh: 支持x402与MPP支付签名、推荐奖励以及受策略控制动作的AI代理钱包。

description: Inspects Google Cloud Filestore capacity and utilization, evaluates storage scaling rules, and performs capacity autoscaling (scale UP for low free space or scale DOWN for cost optimization). Use when monitoring Filestore instance headroom, resizing instance shares, configuring automated growth/shrink thresholds (custom thresholds apply globally across projects in session memory), or preventing out-of-space outages. Don't use for Cloud Storage (GCS) buckets, Persistent Disk block storage, or NetApp Volumes.
description_zh: 检查谷歌云Filestore的容量与利用率，评估存储扩容规则，并执行容量自动扩展（空闲空间较低时扩容，或为优化成本而缩容）。适用于监控Filestore实例剩余容量、调整实例存储份额、配置自动增长/缩容阈值（自定义阈值在会话内存中跨项目全局生效），或防止因磁盘空间不足而导致的故障。不可用于云存储（GCS）存储桶、持久磁盘块存储或NetApp存储卷。

description: Extract an Allium specification from an existing codebase. Use when the user has existing code and wants to distil behaviour into a spec, reverse engineer a specification from implementation, generate a spec from code, turn implementation into a behavioural specification, or document what a codebase does in Allium terms.
description_zh: 从现有代码库中提取 Allium 规范。当用户拥有现有代码并希望将行为提炼为规范、从实现逆向工程规范、从代码生成规范、将实现转化为行为规范，或以 Allium 术语记录代码库的行为时使用。

description: 企业微信待办列表查询技能，支持按创建时间和提醒时间过滤，支持分页。在用户说"看看我的待办列表"、"我有哪些待办"、"这周的待办有哪些"、"最近有什么待办"、"查一下我的待办"、"列出所有待办"等需要浏览待办概览的场景时使用。注意：此技能仅返回待办概要信息（不含内容和分派人），如需完整详情请配合 wecomcli-get-todo-detail 使用。
description_zh: 企业微信待办列表查询技能，支持按创建时间和提醒时间过滤，支持分页。在用户说"看看我的待办列表"、"我有哪些待办"、"这周的待办有哪些"、"最近有什么待办"、"查一下我的待办"、"列出所有待办"等需要浏览待办概览的场景时使用。注意：此技能仅返回待办概要信息（不含内容和分派人），如需完整详情请配合 wecomcli-get-todo-detail 使用。

description: Convert photos into animated GIF stickers in Funko Pop / Pop Mart style via the MiniMax API. Useful for personalized chat stickers and avatar packs.
description_zh: 通过MiniMax API将照片转换为Funko Pop / Pop Mart风格的动态GIF贴纸。适用于个性化聊天贴纸和头像包。

description: Add AI navigation in Unity 6.3 LTS: bake a NavMesh with the AI Navigation package (NavMeshSurface), move agents with NavMeshAgent.SetDestination, and handle dynamic obstacles. Use when setting up pathfinding, making an enemy chase the player, baking navigation, or when the user mentions NavMesh, NavMeshAgent, NavMeshSurface, NavMeshObstacle, or Unity pathfinding.
description_zh: 在 Unity 6.3 LTS 中添加 AI 导航：使用 AI 导航包（NavMeshSurface）烘焙 NavMesh，使用 NavMeshAgent.SetDestination 移动智能体，并处理动态障碍物。在设置寻路、让敌人追逐玩家、烘焙导航，或当用户提及 NavMesh、NavMeshAgent、NavMeshSurface、NavMeshObstacle 或 Unity 寻路时使用。

description: 企业微信会议管理技能, 支持取消会议和更新会议受邀成员. 当用户需要"取消会议", "删除会议", "修改会议成员", "添加会议参与人", "移除会议成员"时触发.
description_zh: 企业微信会议管理技能，支持取消会议和更新会议受邀成员。当用户需要“取消会议”、“删除会议”、“修改会议成员”、“添加会议参与人”、“移除会议成员”时触发。

description: 企业微信智能表格结构管理技能。提供子表（Sheet）和字段（Field/列）的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询智能表格的子表列表 (2) 添加、更新、删除子表 (3) 查询子表的字段/列信息 (4) 添加、更新、删除字段/列。当用户需要管理智能表格的表结构、列定义、子表配置时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
description_zh: 企业微信智能表格结构管理技能。提供子表（Sheet）和字段（Field/列）的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询智能表格的子表列表 (2) 添加、更新、删除子表 (3) 查询子表的字段/列信息 (4) 添加、更新、删除字段/列。当用户需要管理智能表格的表结构、列定义、子表配置时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。

description: Control the user's currently open Chrome tab through the Playwriter CLI (no new browser launch). Use when you need to inspect live UI state, run scripted browser actions, capture console output, or reproduce frontend issues directly in the user's tab.
description_zh: 通过 Playwriter CLI 控制用户当前打开的 Chrome 标签页（无需启动新浏览器）。当您需要检查实时 UI 状态、执行脚本化的浏览器操作、捕获控制台输出，或直接在用户标签页中复现前端问题时使用。

description: Create a new blank Figma Design or FigJam file. Useful as the first step in scripted design-system or workshop workflows.
description_zh: 创建一个新的空白 Figma Design 或 FigJam 文件。作为程序化设计系统或工作坊工作流程的第一步，非常有用。

description: Use when building cloud-native apps. Keywords: kubernetes, k8s, docker, container, grpc, tonic, microservice, service mesh, observability, tracing, metrics, health check, cloud, deployment, 云原生, 微服务, 容器
description_zh: 构建云原生应用时使用。关键词：Kubernetes、k8s、Docker、容器、gRPC、tonic、微服务、服务网格、可观测性、追踪、指标、健康检查、云、部署、云原生、微服务、容器

description: Create a strategy for selling to your first 100 customers using the minimalist entrepreneur playbook. Use when someone has a product and needs to find customers, or is struggling with early sales.
description_zh: 使用极简创业者指南，为您的前100位客户制定销售策略。当有人拥有产品并需要寻找客户，或正在为早期销售而挣扎时使用。

description: Discover, compare, and run AI models using Replicate's API. Strong fit for image, audio, and video generation pipelines that swap models frequently.
description_zh: 通过 Replicate 的 API 发现、比较并运行 AI 模型。非常适合频繁切换模型的图像、音频和视频生成流水线。

description: Browser action engine. Provides up-to-date action manuals for the modern web — operate any website instantly, one tab or dozens, concurrently.
description_zh: 浏览器操作引擎。为现代网页提供最新操作指南——即时操作任何网站，一个标签页或数十个标签页，同步操作。

description: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead of working by hand. The tool is the artifact a reviewer can rerun.
description_zh: 应用于任何非平凡工作，而不仅是批量工作：编辑、迁移、分析、检查。构建能够完成该项工作或证明其可行性的工具（codemod、脚本、生成器，或子代理遵循的技能），而非手动操作。该工具是审查者可以重新运行的产物。

description: Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.
description_zh: 重构、评估 diff 规模，或倾向于添加抽象概念、层次或信号传递时，应适用。优先考虑删除以及解决该问题的最小改动。

description: Deploy validated metadata to a Production Salesforce org without re-running tests. TRIGGER when the user wants to deploy to production, says 'quick deploy', 'promote', 'ship to prod', or has just validated and wants to push the change live. REQUIRES a recent `sf project deploy validate` job ID (≤10 days old, ≤3 days for --use-most-recent). DO NOT TRIGGER for sandbox/scratch deploys (use platform-metadata-deploy) or unvalidated deploys (use platform-deploy-validate first).
description_zh: 部署已验证的元数据到生产环境的 Salesforce 组织，无需重新运行测试。当用户想要部署到生产环境时触发，包括使用"quick deploy"、"promote"、"ship to prod"等关键词，或用户刚完成验证并希望将更改上线时触发。需要提供一个最近的 `sf project deploy validate` 任务 ID（不超过10天，使用 `--use-most-recent` 时不超过3天）。禁止为沙盒/临时环境部署触发（应使用 platform-metadata-deploy），也禁止为未经验证的部署触发（应首先使用 platform-deploy-validate）。

description: Provide US dividend tax and account-location workflow for Kanchi-style income portfolios. Use when users ask about qualified vs ordinary dividends, 1099-DIV interpretation, REIT/BDC distribution treatment, holding-period checks, or taxable-vs-IRA account placement decisions for dividend assets.
description_zh: 为堪察风格收入投资组合提供美国股息税收及账户存放工作流程。当用户询问合格股息与普通股息、1099-DIV解释、REIT/BDC分配处理、持有期检查，或股息资产的应税账户与个人退休账户存放决策时使用。

description: 企业微信日程管理技能。适用于用户对企业微信日程的各类管理需求。当用户需要：(1) 查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取日程详细信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），(2) 创建新日程并设置提醒、参与人等，(3) 修改已有日程的标题、时间、地点等信息或取消日程，(4) 添加或移除日程参与人，(5) 查询多个成员的闲忙状态并分析共同空闲时段以安排会议时使用此技能。
description_zh: 企业微信日程管理技能。适用于用户对企业微信日程的各类管理需求。当用户需要：(1) 查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取日程详细信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），(2) 创建新日程并设置提醒、参与人等，(3) 修改已有日程的标题、时间、地点等信息或取消日程，(4) 添加或移除日程参与人，(5) 查询多个成员的闲忙状态并分析共同空闲时段以安排会议时，使用此技能。

description: OmniStudio Integration Procedure creation and validation with 110-point scoring. Use this skill when building server-side process orchestrations that combine Data Mapper actions, Apex Remote Actions, HTTP callouts, and conditional logic. TRIGGER when: user creates Integration Procedures, adds Data Mapper steps, configures Remote Actions, or reviews existing IP configurations. DO NOT TRIGGER when: building OmniScripts (use building-omnistudio-omniscript), creating Data Mappers directly (use building-omnistudio-datamapper), or analyzing cross-component dependencies (use analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies).
description_zh:
OmniStudio 集成流程创建与 110 分评分验证。当构建结合 Data Mapper 操作、Apex Remote Actions、HTTP 调用以及条件逻辑的服务器端流程编排时，请使用此技能。

触发条件：用户创建集成流程、添加 Data Mapper 步骤、配置 Remote Actions 或审查现有集成流程配置。

不触发条件：构建 OmniScript（使用 building-omnistudio-omniscript）、直接创建 Data Mapper（使用 building-omnistudio-datamapper）或分析跨组件依赖关系（使用 analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies）。

description: Tend the Allium garden. Use when the user wants to write, edit, update, add to, improve, clarify, refine, restructure, fix or migrate Allium specs. Covers adding entities, rules, triggers, surfaces and contracts, fixing syntax or validation errors, renaming or refactoring within specs, migrating specs to a new language version, and translating requirements into well-formed specifications. Pushes back on vague requirements.
description_zh: 维护 Allium 花园。在用户需要编写、编辑、更新、新增、改进、澄清、完善、重构、修复或迁移 Allium 规格时使用。涵盖添加实体、规则、触发器、界面和契约，修复语法或校验错误，在规格内重命名或重构，将规格迁移到新的语言版本，并将需求转化为格式规范、结构良好的规格。对模糊需求予以驳回。

description: Generate images and videos with Kling O3 — Kling's most powerful model family — via fal.ai.
description_zh: 使用 Kling O3（Kling 最强大的模型家族）通过 fal.ai 生成图片和视频。

description: Image generation endpoints and available styles via the Venice.ai API.
description_zh: 通过 Venice.ai API 提供的图像生成端点和可用样式。

description: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要"查看消息"、"看聊天记录"、"发消息给某人"、"最近有什么消息"、"给群里发消息"、"看看发了什么图片/文件"时触发。
description_zh: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要“查看消息”、“看聊天记录”、“发消息给某人”、“最近有什么消息”、“给群里发消息”、“看看发了什么图片/文件”时触发。

description: Salesforce Industries Common Core (OmniStudio/Vlocity) Apex callable generation and review skill with 120-point scoring. Use when creating, reviewing, or migrating Industries callable Apex implementations. TRIGGER when: user creates or reviews System.Callable classes, migrates VlocityOpenInterface or VlocityOpenInterface2, or builds Industries callable extensions used by OmniStudio, Integration Procedures, or DataRaptors. DO NOT TRIGGER when: generic Apex classes or triggers (use generating-apex), building Integration Procedures (use building-omnistudio-integration-procedure), authoring OmniScripts (use building-omnistudio-omniscript), configuring Data Mappers (use building-omnistudio-datamapper), or analyzing namespace/dependency issues (use analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies).
description_zh:
Salesforce 行业通用核心（OmniStudio/Vlocity）Apex 可调用的生成与审核技能（120 分评分）。用于创建、审核或迁移 Industries 可调用的 Apex 实现。

触发条件：当用户创建或审核 System.Callable 类、迁移 VlocityOpenInterface 或 VlocityOpenInterface2，或构建供 OmniStudio、Integration Procedures 或 DataRaptors 使用的 Industries 可调用的扩展时。

不要触发：通用（generic）的 Apex 类或触发器（使用 generating-apex）、构建 Integration Procedures（使用 building-omnistudio-integration-procedure）、编写 OmniScripts（使用 building-omnistudio-omniscript）、配置 Data Mappers（使用 building-omnistudio-datamapper），或分析命名空间/依赖问题（使用 analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies）。

description: 通讯录成员查询技能，获取当前用户可见范围内的通讯录成员，支持按姓名/别名本地筛选匹配。返回 userid、姓名和别名。⚠️ 仅返回当前用户有权限查看的成员，非全量成员。
description_zh: 通讯录成员查询技能，获取当前用户可见范围内的通讯录成员，支持按姓名/别名进行本地筛选匹配。返回 userid、姓名和别名。⚠️ 仅返回当前用户有权限查看的成员，非全量成员。

description: OmniStudio OmniScript creation and validation with 120-point scoring. Use when building guided digital experiences, multi-step forms, or interactive processes that orchestrate Integration Procedures and Data Mappers. TRIGGER when: user creates OmniScripts, designs step flows, configures element types, or reviews existing OmniScript configurations. DO NOT TRIGGER when: building FlexCards (use building-omnistudio-flexcard), creating Integration Procedures directly (use building-omnistudio-integration-procedure), or analyzing dependencies (use analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies).
description_zh: OmniStudio OmniScript 创建与验证（120分评分）。用于构建引导式数字体验、多步骤表单，或协调 Integration Procedures 和 Data Mappers 的交互流程。触发条件：当用户创建 OmniScripts、设计步骤流程、配置元素类型或审查现有 OmniScript 配置时。不触发条件：当构建 FlexCards（使用 building-omnistudio-flexcard）、直接创建 Integration Procedures（使用 building-omnistudio-integration-procedure）或分析依赖（使用 analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies）时。

description: Train custom AI models (LoRA) on fal.ai for personalized image generation tailored to a brand, character, or style.
description_zh: 在 fal.ai 上训练自定义 AI 模型（LoRA），为品牌、角色或风格定制个性化图像生成。

description: Create product backlog items in Why-What-Acceptance format — independent, valuable, testable items with strategic context. Use when writing structured backlog items, breaking features into work items, or using the WWA format.
description_zh: 以WH-A格式创建产品待办事项——独立、有价值、可测试且具备战略背景的条目。用于撰写结构化待办事项、将功能拆分为工作项，或在使用WWA格式时。

description: Write, configure, and deploy Netlify Edge Functions (Deno runtime at the network edge) in TypeScript/JavaScript. Use when adding request/response manipulation at the edge — auth middleware, geolocation redirects, A/B testing and personalization, content localization, redirects/rewrites, SSR at the edge, or transforming responses — or when configuring path routing, response caching, or edge error handling. Triggers on tasks like "add auth middleware", "geo-based redirect", "A/B testing at the edge", "rewrite requests", or editing files in netlify/edge-functions.
description_zh: 使用 TypeScript/JavaScript 编写、配置并部署 Netlify 边缘函数（网络边缘的 Deno 运行时）。当需要在边缘添加请求/响应处理时使用——包括身份验证中间件、地理位置重定向、A/B 测试与个性化、内容本地化、重定向/重写、边缘端服务端渲染或响应转换——以及配置路径路由、响应缓存或边缘错误处理时使用。适用于“添加身份验证中间件”、“基于地理位置的重定向”、“边缘 A/B 测试”、“重写请求”或编辑 netlify/edge-functions 文件等任务。

description: Detects Follow-Through Day (FTD) signals for market bottom confirmation using William O'Neil's methodology. Dual-index tracking (S&P 500 + NASDAQ) with state machine for rally attempt, FTD qualification, and post-FTD health monitoring. Use when user asks about market bottom signals, follow-through days, rally attempts, re-entry timing after corrections, or whether it's safe to increase equity exposure. Complementary to market-top-detector (defensive) - this skill is offensive (bottom confirmation).
description_zh: 使用威廉·奥尼尔的方法论检测跟涨日（FTD）信号，用于市场底部确认。采用标普500与纳斯达克的双指数追踪（S&P 500 + NASDAQ），并通过状态机实现行情上涨尝试、FTD 达标以及 FTD 后健康监控。适用于用户咨询市场底部信号、跟涨日、行情上涨尝试、修正后重新入场时机，或是否安全增加权益仓位等情况。与市场顶部检测器（防御性）互补——本技能为进攻性（底部确认）。

description: Cross-cutting OmniStudio analysis skill for namespace detection, dependency visualization, and impact analysis across OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures, and Data Mappers. TRIGGER when: user asks about OmniStudio dependencies, wants namespace detection (Core vs vlocity_cmt vs vlocity_ins), needs impact analysis, requests dependency graphs or Mermaid diagrams, or asks which components are affected by a change. DO NOT TRIGGER when: authoring OmniScripts (use building-omnistudio-omniscript), building FlexCards (use building-omnistudio-flexcard), creating Integration Procedures (use building-omnistudio-integration-procedure), or configuring Data Mappers (use building-omnistudio-datamapper).
description_zh:
跨组件的 OmniStudio 分析技能，用于在 OmniScripts、FlexCards、集成流程和数据映射器之间进行命名空间检测、依赖可视化及影响分析。

**触发条件：**
当用户询问 OmniStudio 依赖关系、需要命名空间检测（核心与 vlocity_cmt 与 vlocity_ins 的区分）、需要影响分析、请求依赖图表或 Mermaid 图表，或询问哪些组件会受变更影响时触发。

**不触发条件：**
当用户编写 OmniScripts（使用 building-omnistudio-omniscript）、构建 FlexCards（使用 building-omnistudio-flexcard）、创建集成流程（使用 building-omnistudio-integration-procedure）或配置数据映射器（使用 building-omnistudio-datamapper）时，不触发。

description: OmniStudio Data Mapper (formerly DataRaptor) creation and validation with 100-point scoring. Use when building Extract, Transform, Load, or Turbo Extract Data Mappers, mapping Salesforce object fields, or reviewing existing Data Mapper configurations. TRIGGER when: user creates Data Mappers, configures field mappings, works with OmniDataTransform metadata, or asks about DataRaptor/Data Mapper patterns. DO NOT TRIGGER when: building Integration Procedures (use building-omnistudio-integration-procedure), authoring OmniScripts (use building-omnistudio-omniscript), or analyzing cross-component dependencies (use analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies).
description_zh: OmniStudio 数据映射器（原名 DataRaptor）的创建与验证，采用 100 点评分。当构建提取、转换、加载或 Turbo Extract 数据映射器，映射 Salesforce 对象字段，或审查现有数据映射器配置时使用。触发条件：用户创建数据映射器、配置字段映射、处理 OmniDataTransform 元数据或询问 DataRaptor/Data Mapper 模式时。不触发条件：构建集成过程（使用 building-omnistudio-integration-procedure）、编写 OmniScripts（使用 building-omnistudio-omniscript）、或分析跨组件依赖（使用 analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies）时。

description: Execute the destructiveChanges.xml delete-and-deploy workflow against a Salesforce org. TRIGGER when the user asks to delete/remove a custom object, field, Apex class, flow, or any metadata component FROM an org, or to perform a 'destructive deploy' / removal as part of a release. Validates first and gates production with explicit confirmation. DO NOT TRIGGER for local file deletion (use Bash), or for net-new deploys (use platform-metadata-deploy).
description_zh: 针对 Salesforce 组织执行 destructiveChanges.xml 的删除并部署工作流。触发条件：当用户要求从 Salesforce 组织删除/移除自定义对象、字段、Apex 类、流程或任何元数据组件，或在发布过程中执行“破坏性部署”/移除时，触发。该工作流先进行验证，并需经显式确认后方可对生产环境进行门控。请勿针对本地文件删除触发（请使用 Bash），也请勿针对净新增部署触发（请使用 platform-metadata-deploy）。

description: Validate data quality in market analysis documents and blog articles before publication. Use when checking for price scale inconsistencies (ETF vs futures), instrument notation errors, date/day-of-week mismatches, allocation total errors, and unit mismatches. Supports English and Japanese content. Advisory mode -- flags issues as warnings for human review, not as blockers.
description_zh: 发布前验证市场分析文件与博客文章的数据质量。用于检查价格规模不一致（ETF与期货）、证券标识错误、日期与星期不匹配、配置总额错误以及单位不匹配等问题。支持英文和日文内容。建议模式——将问题标记为警告供人工审核，而非作为阻断因素。

description: 企业微信待办详情批量查询技能，根据待办 ID 列表获取完整信息（包含待办内容和分派人）。在用户说"看看这个待办的详情"、"待办内容是什么"、"这个待办分派给谁了"、"告诉我待办的具体信息"等需要查看待办完整内容的场景时使用。通常配合 wecomcli-get-todo-list 使用——先获取待办 ID 列表，再用本技能获取详情。
description_zh: 企业微信待办详情批量查询技能，根据待办 ID 列表获取完整信息（包含待办内容和分派人）。在用户说“看看这个待办的详情”、“待办内容是什么”、“这个待办分派给谁了”、“告诉我待办的具体信息”等需要查看待办完整内容的场景时使用。通常配合 wecomcli-get-todo-list 使用——先获取待办 ID 列表，再用本技能获取详情。

description: Capture the user's UX vision in two documents: DESIGN.md for how the product looks and EXPERIENCE.md for how it behaves. Use when the user says "lets create UX design" or "create UX specifications" or "help me plan the UX"
description_zh: 将用户的 UX 愿景记录在两个文档中：DESIGN.md 用于描述产品外观，EXPERIENCE.md 用于描述其行为表现。当用户说“lets create UX design”或“create UX specifications”或“help me plan the UX”时使用。

description: OmniStudio FlexCard creation and validation with 130-point scoring. Use when building at-a-glance UI cards, configuring data source bindings to Integration Procedures, or reviewing existing FlexCard definitions for accessibility and performance. TRIGGER when: user creates FlexCards, configures data sources, designs card layouts, or asks about OmniUiCard metadata. DO NOT TRIGGER when: building OmniScripts (use building-omnistudio-omniscript), creating Integration Procedures (use building-omnistudio-integration-procedure), or analyzing dependencies (use analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies).
description_zh: 带有130分评分的OmniStudio FlexCard创建与验证。用于构建一目了然式UI卡片、将数据源绑定配置至集成流程，或审查现有FlexCard定义以提升可访问性与性能时使用。触发条件：当用户创建FlexCard、配置数据源、设计卡片布局，或询问OmniUiCard元数据时触发。不触发条件：当构建OmniScripts（使用 building-omnistudio-omniscript）、创建集成流程（使用 building-omnistudio-integration-procedure），或分析依赖项（使用 analyzing-omnistudio-dependencies）时，不触发。

description: Build a PixiJS v8 render layer: create the async Application, load textures with Assets, compose the scene graph with Container and Sprite, drive the ticker loop, wire pointer events, and group draws with render groups. Use when building or debugging PixiJS v8 — when the user mentions PixiJS, Pixi, Application, app.stage, Container, Sprite, Assets.load, app.ticker, or eventMode. Pins the v8 async init() API.
description_zh: 构建 PixiJS v8 渲染层：创建异步 Application，使用 Assets 加载纹理，借助 Container 和 Sprite 组合场景图，驱动 ticker 循环，绑定指针事件，并通过渲染组分组绘制。适用于构建或调试 PixiJS v8 的场景——当用户提及 PixiJS、Pixi、Application、app.stage、Container、Sprite、Assets.load、app.ticker 或 eventMode 时使用。锁定 v8 异步 init() API。

description: Help to write Mojo code using current syntax and conventions. Always use this skill when writing any Mojo code, including when other Mojo-specific skills (e.g., mojo-gpu-fundamentals) also apply. Use when writing Mojo code, translating projects to Mojo, or otherwise generating Mojo. Use this skill to overcome misconceptions with how Mojo is written.
description_zh: 帮助使用当前语法和惯例编写 Mojo 代码。编写任何 Mojo 代码时，始终使用此技能，包括当其他 Mojo 专用技能（例如 mojo-gpu-fundamentals）也适用时。在编写 Mojo 代码、将项目转换为 Mojo，或以其他方式生成 Mojo 代码时，使用此技能。使用此技能，消除对 Mojo 编写方式的误解。

description: Real-time and streaming AI image generation via fal.ai. Suited for moodboard exploration, draft variations, and rapid creative iteration.
description_zh: 通过 fal.ai 实现实时与流式 AI 图像生成。适用于情绪板探索、草稿变体生成和快速创意迭代。

description: Configure, review, or troubleshoot Rsbuild applications, including build/dev commands, assets, type checking, and bundle optimization.
description_zh: 配置、审查或故障排除 Rsbuild 应用，包括构建/开发命令、资源、类型检查以及打包优化。

description: Create cinematic product videos from shot recipe cards, a validated template, and code/audio assets (Remotion + real page screenshots + 2.5D camera moves + beat-synced cuts + sound design). Use when the user asks to turn a frontend project or webpage into a product video, says "use video-shotcraft to make a video/promo", names the Ink Press template or asks to reproduce its effect, or wants a single shot card's motion. 用镜头配方卡 + 已验收模板 + 代码/音频资产制作电影感产品视频（Remotion + 真实页面截图 + 2.5D 运镜 + 节奏卡点 + 声音设计）。当用户要求"用 video-shotcraft 做视频/宣传片"、把前端项目/网页做成产品视频、点名 Ink Press 模板或要求复刻模板片效果，或要用镜头卡做单个动效镜头时使用。
description_zh: 用镜头配方卡 + 已验收模板 + 代码/音频资产制作电影感产品视频（Remotion + 真实页面截图 + 2.5D 运镜 + 节奏卡点 + 声音设计）。当用户要求"用 video-shotcraft 做视频/宣传片"、把前端项目/网页做成产品视频、点名 Ink Press 模板或要求复刻模板片效果，或要用镜头卡做单个动效镜头时使用。

description: 企业微信会议创建技能, 支持创建预约会议. 当用户需要"创建会议", "预约会议", "约会议", "安排会议"时触发.
description_zh: 企业微信会议创建技能，支持创建预约会议。当用户需要“创建会议”、“预约会议”、“约会议”、“安排会议”时触发。

description: Browser automation with persistent named pages via the dev-browser CLI. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, log into sites, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", "open the browser", or any browser interaction request.
description_zh: 通过 dev-browser CLI 实现持久化命名页面的浏览器自动化。适用于用户提出浏览网站、填写表单、截取屏幕截图、提取网页数据、测试 Web 应用、登录网站或自动化浏览器工作流程的需求。触发短语包括“前往 [url]”、“点击”、“填写表单”、“截取屏幕截图”、“抓取”、“自动化”、“测试网站”、“登录”、“打开浏览器”，或任何浏览器交互请求。

description: 企业微信待办事项编辑技能，支持创建、更新、删除待办及变更用户处理进度状态。在用户说"帮我创建一个待办"、"把这个任务分派给张三"、"标记待办完成"、"删掉那个待办"、"帮我建个提醒"、"更新一下待办内容"、"把提醒时间改到下周"、"接受这个待办"、"拒绝这个待办"等需要对待办进行写操作的场景时使用。
description_zh: 企业微信待办事项编辑技能，支持创建、更新、删除待办事项，以及变更用户的处理进度状态。在用户说“帮我创建一个待办”、“把这个任务分派给张三”、“标记待办完成”、“删掉那个待办”、“帮我建个提醒”、“更新一下待办内容”、“把提醒时间改到下周”、“接受这个待办”、“拒绝这个待办”等需要对待办进行写操作的场景时使用。

description: Use when developing embedded/no_std Rust. Keywords: embedded, no_std, microcontroller, MCU, ARM, RISC-V, bare metal, firmware, HAL, PAC, RTIC, embassy, interrupt, DMA, peripheral, GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART, embedded-hal, cortex-m, esp32, stm32, nrf, 嵌入式, 单片机, 固件, 裸机
description_zh: 用于开发嵌入式/no_std Rust。关键词：嵌入式, no_std, 单片机, MCU, ARM, RISC-V, 裸机, 固件, HAL, PAC, RTIC, embassy, 中断, DMA, 外设, GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART, embedded-hal, cortex-m, esp32, stm32, nrf, 嵌入式, 单片机, 固件, 裸机

description: Modern web design trends, principles, and implementation patterns for 2024-2025. Use this skill when designing websites, creating interactive experiences, implementing design systems, ensuring accessibility, or building performance-first interfaces. Triggers on tasks involving modern design trends, micro-interactions, scrollytelling, bold minimalism, cursor UX, glassmorphism, accessibility compliance, performance optimization, or design system architecture. References animation skills (GSAP, Framer Motion, React Spring), 3D skills (Three.js, R3F, Babylon.js), and component libraries for implementation guidance.
description_zh: 2024-2025年现代网页设计趋势、原则与实施模式。在网站设计、交互体验创建、设计系统实施、确保无障碍性，或构建性能优先的界面时，请使用该技能。适用于涉及现代设计趋势、微交互、滚动讲述、大胆极简主义、光标交互体验、毛玻璃效果、无障碍合规性、性能优化或设计系统架构的任务。参考动画技能（GSAP、Framer Motion、React Spring）、3D技能（Three.js、R3F、Babylon.js）及组件库，以提供实施指导。

description: This skill should be used when the user wants to visualize data. It intelligently selects the most suitable chart type from 26 available options, extracts parameters based on detailed specifications, and generates a chart image using a JavaScript script.
description_zh: 当用户需要可视化数据时，应使用此技能。它能够从26种可用的图表类型中智能选择最合适的图表，根据详细规格提取参数，并使用JavaScript脚本生成图表图像。

description: Pay-per-call API gateway for AI agents. 10 services available via x402 — no API keys, no subscriptions.
description_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的按调用计费 API 网关。通过 x402 提供 10 项服务——无需 API 密钥，无需订阅。

description: Integrates the Google Interactive Media Ads (IMA) Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) SDK into websites, web apps, mobile apps, or TV apps. Use when: - A video player needs to load and play HLS or DASH streams in web apps, Android apps, iOS apps, tvOS apps, Cast (CAF) receivers, or Roku channels. - The app needs to make use of a Google DAI livestream event asset key, or content source CMS ID, video ID for video on demand. Don't use this skill to load and play a VAST or VMAP URL.
description_zh:
将 Google 互动媒体广告（IMA）动态广告投放（DAI）SDK 集成到网站、网页应用、移动应用或电视应用中。适用场景：
- 视频播放器需要在网页应用、Android 应用、iOS 应用、tvOS 应用、Cast（CAF）接收器或 Roku 频道中加载并播放 HLS 或 DASH 流。
- 应用需要使用 Google DAI 直播事件资产密钥、内容源 CMS ID 或视频点播视频 ID。请勿使用本技能加载并播放 VAST 或 VMAP URL。

description: Calibrated grilling session for stress-testing a plan, design, idea, or decision. First assesses the user's topic knowledge, confidence, and desired pressure level, then asks one question at a time with recommended answers. Use when user says "grill me", "stress-test this", "challenge my plan", "interview me", or wants a plan probed without being overwhelmed.
description_zh: 校准式拷问会话，用于对计划、设计、想法或决策进行压力测试。首先评估用户的主题知识、自信度和期望压力水平，然后逐题提问，并提供推荐答案。当用户说“grill me”、“stress-test this”、“challenge my plan”、“interview me”，或希望在不被淹没的情况下探测计划时使用。

description: Create a minimalist marketing plan focused on building an audience through content, not ads. Use when someone has product-market fit (~100 customers) and wants to scale with marketing, or needs a content strategy.
description_zh: 创建一份以通过内容建立受众为核心、而非广告的极简营销计划。适用于在产品市场匹配（约100位客户）并希望借助营销实现规模化，或需要制定内容策略的人群。

description: Uses Chrome DevTools MCP and documentation to troubleshoot connection and target issues. Trigger this skill when list_pages, new_page, or navigate_page fail, or when the server initialization fails.
description_zh: 使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 及文档排查连接和目标问题。当 list_pages、new_page 或 navigate_page 功能失败，或服务器初始化失败时，触发此技能。

description: Facilitate a structured sprint retrospective — what went well, what didn't, and prioritized action items with owners and deadlines. Use when running a retrospective, reflecting on a sprint, creating action items from team feedback, or learning how to run effective retros.
description_zh: **促进开展结构化的冲刺复盘——总结做得好的地方与不足，并明确优先级的行动项，指定负责人与截止日期。适用于开展冲刺复盘、回顾冲刺、根据团队反馈制定行动项或学习如何有效开展复盘时。**

description: Sign in to the wallet. Use when you or the user want to log in, sign in, connect, or set up the wallet, or when any wallet operation fails with authentication or "not signed in" errors. This skill is a prerequisite before sending, trading, or funding.
description_zh: 登录钱包。当您或用户需要登录、连接或设置钱包，或当任何钱包操作因认证或"未登录"错误而失败时使用。在使用发送、交易或充值之前，本技能为必要前提。

description: Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards, arranged as a swipeable multi-card carousel.
description_zh: 小红书风格的知识卡片，以可滑动多卡轮播形式排列。

description: Validate and configure the local Salesforce development environment. Runs a prerequisite scan showing 🔴/🟡/🟢 status for all required tools (Salesforce CLI, Code Analyzer plugin, Node.js, NPM, Git, Salesforce MCP, Source Tracking) and offers to install or update missing/outdated items. TRIGGER when the user runs /salesforce-development:platform-environment-validate, asks to 'check my setup', 'validate tools', 'verify prerequisites', 'am I set up correctly', or reports that a tool is missing or not working. DO NOT TRIGGER for: org authentication issues (use /salesforce-development:login), deployment problems (use platform-metadata-deploy), or general status checks (use /salesforce-development:status).
description_zh: 验证并配置本地 Salesforce 开发环境。执行前置检查扫描，为所有必需工具（Salesforce CLI、代码分析器插件、Node.js、NPM、Git、Salesforce MCP、源追踪）显示 🔴/🟡/🟢 状态，并提供安装或更新缺失/过时项的操作建议。当用户运行 `/salesforce-development:platform-environment-validate`，询问“检查我的配置”、“验证工具”、“验证前置条件”、“我的设置是否正确”，或报告某工具缺失或无法使用时，触发该功能。不得针对以下情况进行触发：组织认证问题（使用 `/salesforce-development:login`）、部署问题（使用 `platform-metadata-deploy`）或常规状态检查（使用 `/salesforce-development:status`）。

description: Provides guidance for authoring Apache Airflow DAGs in Managed Service for Apache Airflow (MSAA; formerly Cloud Composer). Covers environment context discovery, Airflow 2 vs 3 compatibility, authoring best practices, and local/remote validation processes. Use when creating or extending an Airflow DAG. Don't use when authoring Python code unrelated to Airflow DAGs.
description_zh: 在 Managed Service for Apache Airflow（MSAA；前称 Cloud Composer）中编写 Apache Airflow DAG 的指南。涵盖环境上下文发现、Apache Airflow 2 与 3 的兼容性、编写最佳实践以及本地/远程验证流程。在创建或扩展 Apache Airflow DAG 时使用。请勿在编写与 Apache Airflow DAG 无关的 Python 代码时使用。

description: Auto-generate viral 9:16 YouTube Shorts (or TikTok / Reels clips) from a long-form video. Thin platform-aware wrapper around the AI Clipping skill — picks sensible defaults for short-form social platforms (9:16, 30–60s sweet spot) and delegates the actual highlight extraction + crop to muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint.
description_zh: 从长视频自动生成病毒式传播的 9:16 YouTube Shorts（或 TikTok / Reels 视频片段）。这是 AI 剪辑技能的轻量平台感知封装——为短视频社交平台设定合理默认值（9:16 比例，30–60 秒最佳区间），并将实际的精彩片段提取与裁剪任务委托给 muapi.ai 的 `/ai-clipping` 接口完成。

description: Detect backtest iteration stagnation and generate structurally different strategy pivot proposals when parameter tuning reaches a local optimum.
description_zh: 当参数调优达到局部最优时，检测回测迭代停滞，并生成结构不同的策略转向建议。

description: Salesforce Industries CME EPC product-modeling skill for Product2-based catalog creation. Use when creating EPC products, configuring product attributes, building offer bundles with Product Child Items, or reviewing EPC DataPack JSON metadata for product catalog changes. TRIGGER when: user creates or updates Product2 EPC records, AttributeAssignment payloads, AttributeMetadata/AttributeDefaultValues, Offer bundles, or ProductChildItem relationships. DO NOT TRIGGER when: designing OmniScripts/FlexCards/Integration Procedures (use building-omnistudio-omniscript, building-omnistudio-flexcard, or building-omnistudio-integration-procedure), implementing Apex business logic (use generating-apex), or troubleshooting deployment pipelines (use deploying-metadata).
description_zh: Salesforce Industries CME EPC 产品建模技能，用于基于 Product2 的目录创建。在创建 EPC 产品、配置产品属性、使用 Product Child Items 构建报价捆绑包，或审查 EPC DataPack JSON 元数据以进行产品目录变更时使用。触发条件：用户创建或更新 Product2 EPC 记录、AttributeAssignment 负载、AttributeMetadata/AttributeDefaultValues、报价捆绑包或 ProductChildItem 关系时。不触发条件：设计 OmniScripts/FlexCards/Integration Procedures（使用 building-omnistudio-omniscript、building-omnistudio-flexcard 或 building-omnistudio-integration-procedure）、实现 Apex 业务逻辑（使用 generating-apex）、或排查部署管道（使用 deploying-metadata）。

description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, or Toutiao drafts through a browser.
description_zh: 将Markdown转换为微信公众号HTML。当用户需要微信公众号文章排版、文章预览、微信草稿上传、文章配图生成、封面或信息图生成、图片帖创建、作家风格起草、标题建议、AI痕迹去除，或当前发现支持的服务商、主题、提示词和布局模块时，请使用此工具。同时，也可用于通过浏览器处理未发布的知乎、CSDN或头条草稿。

description: Serverless form handling on Netlify-hosted sites — detects HTML forms at deploy time, stores submissions, filters spam, and sends notifications. Use when adding a contact form, lead-capture form, file-upload form, or newsletter signup to a Netlify site; wiring AJAX form submission; setting up a custom thank-you page; adding a honeypot or reCAPTCHA to a form; getting forms working in Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, or Gatsby; reading form submissions via the Netlify API; or debugging missing submissions and forms that silently fail to register.
description_zh: Netlify 托管站点的无服务器表单处理——在部署时检测 HTML 表单，存储提交内容，过滤垃圾信息并发送通知。适用于在 Netlify 站点上添加联系表单、线索捕获表单、文件上传表单或新闻通讯注册功能；配置 AJAX 表单提交；设置自定义感谢页；在表单中添加蜜罐或 reCAPTCHA；在 Next.js、Nuxt、SvelteKit、Astro 或 Gatsby 中实现表单功能；通过 Netlify API 读取表单提交内容；或调试缺失的提交内容以及静默无法注册的表单。

description: Generate and edit images and videos with an 85+ API portfolio and build visually appealing website pages via Pixelbin.
description_zh: 借助85+ API作品集生成并编辑图像与视频，并通过Pixelbin构建视觉吸引人的网站页面。

description: Send mail from inboxes Cargo owns — provision mailboxes on a sending domain, run provider warm-up and the 5→40/day send ramp, deliver with the `sendEmail` action, and read back threads, replies, delivery events, and the workspace suppression list. Triggers: "set up a sending mailbox", "provision inboxes for outbound", "warm up this mailbox", "how many sends do I have left today", "send this from Cargo", "did they reply", "who unsubscribed", "suppress this recipient", "take me off your list", "never email them again", "what do mailboxes cost", "my mailbox is stuck pending". A mailbox is a recurring monthly credit charge, and every send is gated on basis, suppression, and relevance. Skip when: writing the copy or building the audience — use cargo-gtm; the mailbox belongs in git — use cargo-project.
description_zh: 从 Cargo 拥有的收件箱中发送邮件 — 在发送域名上配置邮箱，执行提供商预热和 5→40/天的发送速率爬坡，使用 `sendEmail` 操作进行投递，并回读邮件线程、回复、投递事件和工作区抑制列表。触发器：“设置发送邮箱”, “为外发配置收件箱”, “预热此邮箱”, “今天我还有多少发送额度”, “用 Cargo 发送此邮件”, “他们是否回复了”, “是谁退订的”, “屏蔽此收件人”, “将我移出您的列表”, “永远不再给他们发邮件”, “邮箱的费用是多少”, “我的邮箱卡在待处理状态”。邮箱是按月计费的周期性信用额度，每次发送均受基础条件、抑制规则和相关性因素的约束。当需要跳过时：撰写文案或构建受众群体 — 使用 cargo-gtm；邮箱属于版本控制 — 使用 cargo-project。

description: Investigates Google Cloud networking issues by analyzing logs, metrics, and diagnostics. Use when investigating VPC Flow Logs, NAT, firewall, or threat logs, querying latency and throughput metrics, or running Connectivity Tests for path diagnostics.
description_zh: 通过分析日志、指标和诊断来排查 Google Cloud 网络问题。适用于排查 VPC 流日志、NAT、防火墙或威胁日志，查询延迟与吞吐量指标，或运行连通性测试以进行路径诊断。

description: Designs complex generic types, refactors `any` types to strict alternatives, creates type guards and utility types, and resolves TypeScript compiler errors. Use when the user asks about TypeScript (TS) types, generics, type inference, type guards, removing `any` types, strict typing, type errors, `infer`, `extends`, conditional types, mapped types, template literal types, branded/opaque types, or utility types like `Partial`, `Record`, `ReturnType`, and `Awaited`.
description_zh: 设计复杂的泛型类型，将 `any` 类型重构为严格的替代方案，创建类型守卫和工具类型，并解决 TypeScript 编译器错误。当用户询问 TypeScript (TS) 类型、泛型、类型推断、类型守卫、移除 `any` 类型、严格类型、类型错误、`infer`、`extends`、条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量类型、标记/不透明类型，或类似 `Partial`、`Record`、`ReturnType` 和 `Awaited` 的工具类型时使用。

description: Generate images with Pruna P-Image models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Image, P-Image-LoRA, P-Image-Edit, P-Image-Edit-LoRA. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, multi-image compositing, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna, p-image, pruna image, fast image generation, optimized flux, pruna ai, p image, fast ai image, economic image generation, cheap image generation
description_zh: 使用 inference.sh CLI 通过 Pruna P-Image 模型生成图像。模型：P-Image、P-Image-LoRA、P-Image-Edit、P-Image-Edit-LoRA。功能：文生图、图像编辑、LoRA 风格、多图合成、快速推理。Pruna 优化模型速度，且不损失质量。触发词：pruna、p-image、pruna image、快速图像生成、优化版 flux、pruna ai、p image、fast ai image、经济图像生成、廉价图像生成。

description: Guide for building GraphQL servers with Apollo Server 5.x. Use this skill when: (1) setting up a new Apollo Server project, (2) writing resolvers or defining GraphQL schemas, (3) implementing authentication or authorization, (4) creating plugins or custom data sources, (5) troubleshooting Apollo Server errors or performance issues.
description_zh: Apollo Server 5.x GraphQL服务器构建指南。使用此技能适用于以下情况：(1) 设置新的Apollo Server项目，(2) 编写解析器或定义GraphQL模式，(3) 实现身份验证或授权，(4) 创建插件或自定义数据源，(5) 排查Apollo Server错误或性能问题。

description: Create animated GIFs optimized for Slack with validators for size constraints and composable animation primitives.
description_zh: 创建针对Slack优化的动画GIF，并具备大小约束验证器以及可组合的动画原语。
