description: Generates custom design system rules for the user's codebase. Use when user says "create design system rules", "generate rules for my project", "set up design rules", "customize design system guidelines", or wants to establish project-specific conventions for Figma-to-code workflows. Requires Figma MCP server connection.
description_zh: 为用户代码库生成自定义设计系统规则。当用户说“create design system rules”、“generate rules for my project”、“set up design rules”、“customize design system guidelines”，或希望为 Figma 到代码的工作流建立项目特定规范时使用。需要连接 Figma MCP 服务器。

description: Persist player data in Roblox with DataStoreService: GetDataStore, GetAsync/ SetAsync/UpdateAsync/IncrementAsync wrapped in pcall, load-on-join and save-on-leave plus BindToClose, retries, and OrderedDataStore leaderboards. Use when saving or loading persistent data in a Roblox experience — when the user mentions DataStore, DataStoreService, GetAsync, SetAsync, UpdateAsync, save player data, or leaderboards. For general Luau scripting use roblox-luau.
description_zh: 在 Roblox 中使用 DataStoreService 持久化玩家数据：使用 pcall 包装 GetDataStore、GetAsync、SetAsync、UpdateAsync、IncrementAsync，实现加入时加载（load-on-join）、离开时保存（save-on-leave）、BindToClose、重试机制以及 OrderedDataStore 排行榜功能。适用于在 Roblox 体验中保存或加载持久数据的场景——当用户提到 DataStore、DataStoreService、GetAsync、SetAsync、UpdateAsync、保存玩家数据或排行榜时使用。常规 Luau 脚本请使用 roblox-luau。

description: Weed the Allium garden. Find where Allium specifications and implementation code have diverged, and help resolve the divergences. Use when the user wants to check spec-code alignment, compare specs against implementation, audit for spec drift or violations, sync specs with code or code with specs, or verify whether the implementation matches what the spec says.
description_zh: 清理Allium花园。找出Allium规范与实现代码出现分歧之处，并协助解决这些分歧。适用于用户检查规范与代码对齐、对比规范与实现、审计规范漂移或违规、同步规范与代码或代码与规范、以及验证实现与规范一致性的场景。

description: Guide developers through capturing diagnostic artifacts to diagnose production .NET performance issues. Use when the user needs help choosing diagnostic tools, collecting performance data, or understanding tool trade-offs across different environments (Windows/Linux, .NET Framework/modern .NET, container/non-container).
description_zh: 引导开发者通过采集诊断产物诊断生产环境中的 .NET 性能问题。当用户需要帮助选择诊断工具、收集性能数据，或理解在不同环境（Windows/Linux、.NET Framework/现代 .NET、容器/非容器）中工具之间的权衡取舍时，请使用本指南。

description: Draft a detailed Non-Disclosure Agreement between two parties covering information types, jurisdiction, and clauses needing legal review. Use when creating confidentiality agreements or preparing an NDA for a partnership.
description_zh: 起草一份详细的双方非保密协议（NDA）草稿，涵盖信息类型、管辖权以及需法律审核的条款。该协议适用于创建保密协议或为合作事宜准备非保密协议（NDA）时使用。

description: Generate and prioritize US equity long-side edge research tickets from EOD observations, then export pipeline-ready candidate specs for trade-strategy-pipeline Phase I. Use when users ask to turn hypotheses/anomalies into reproducible research tickets, convert validated ideas into `strategy.yaml` + `metadata.json`, or preflight-check interface compatibility (`edge-finder-candidate/v1`) before running pipeline backtests.
description_zh: 从日终观察中生成并优先排序美国股票多头侧研究任务，随后导出可直接用于交易策略管线一期的候选规格。当用户请求将假设/异常转化为可复现的研究任务、将已验证的想法转化为 `strategy.yaml` 与 `metadata.json`，或在运行管线回测前对接口兼容性（`edge-finder-candidate/v1`）进行预检时使用。

description: Use when the user wants to performance-test, load-test, or stress-test a public website end-to-end with k6. Produces a hybrid (protocol + browser) test suite, SLO-backed thresholds, a load-generator monitor sidecar, and a Grafana-side investigation playbook for backends the user owns. Triggers on "perf test my site", "performance test my site", "load test this URL", "stress test my web app", "I want to load test [URL]", "set up k6 against my website", "write a k6 suite for [site]", "see if my site handles N concurrent users", or "how does my site perform under traffic". Use this skill whenever the user mentions k6, load testing, stress testing, performance testing, or wants to validate a website under traffic — even if they don't explicitly use the word "test" or ask for the specific outputs this skill produces.
description_zh: 当用户希望使用 k6 对公共网站进行端到端性能测试、负载测试或压力测试时使用。该功能将生成混合（协议 + 浏览器）测试套件、基于 SLO 的阈值、负载生成器监控 sidecar，以及针对用户自有后端的 Grafana 侧排查指南。当用户提及"perf test my site"、"performance test my site"、"load test this URL"、"stress test my web app"、"I want to load test [URL]"、"set up k6 against my website"、"write a k6 suite for [site]"、"see if my site handles N concurrent users"或"how does my site perform under traffic"时触发。只要用户提及 k6、负载测试、压力测试、性能测试，或希望验证网站在流量下的表现——即使未明确使用"test"一词或未要求本技能产生的特定输出——均应使用本技能。

description: Video generation and transcription workflows via the Venice.ai API.
description_zh: 通过 Venice.ai API 的视频生成与转录工作流。

description: WordPress Design System. Apply WordPress's official design tokens, typography, and component patterns to themes and sites.
description_zh: WordPress 设计系统。应用 WordPress 官方设计令牌、排版和组件模式到主题和网站。

description: Use this skill when the user asks to "set up monitoring", "configure observability", "onboard new service", "create saved view", "set up notifications", "configure webhook", "set up Slack integration", "outgoing webhook", "automation action", "webhook for alerts", "create view", "saved view", "view folder", "organize dashboards", "install integration", "configure extension", "contextual data", "connect external service", "create notification connector", "set up email alerts", "configure PagerDuty", "notification routing", "deploy extension", "test webhook", "notification preset", "test notification", "webhook actions", or wants to set up, configure, or manage the observability stack for a service or team.
description_zh: 当用户要求执行以下操作时，使用本技能：设置监控、配置可观测性、接入新服务、创建已保存的视图、设置通知、配置 Webhook、设置 Slack 集成、出站 Webhook、自动化操作、用于告警的 Webhook、创建视图、已保存的视图、视图文件夹、组织仪表盘、安装集成、配置扩展、上下文数据、连接外部服务、创建通知连接器、设置邮件告警、配置 PagerDuty、通知路由、部署扩展、测试 Webhook、通知预设、测试通知、Webhook 操作，或希望为某个服务或团队设置、配置或管理可观测性技术栈。

description: Generates a structured Bug Fix Brief (BFB) to document issue corrections. Includes root cause analysis, repro steps, fix options, and fix checklist. Use when user asks to create a BFB, document a bug fix, or generate a bug correction document.
description_zh: 生成结构化的 Bug 修复简报（BFB），用于记录问题修正。包含根因分析、复现步骤、修复方案和修复检查清单。当用户要求创建 BFB、记录 Bug 修复或生成 Bug 修正文档时使用。

description: Screen post-earnings gap-up stocks for PEAD (Post-Earnings Announcement Drift) patterns. Analyzes weekly candle formation to detect red candle pullbacks and breakout signals. Supports two input modes - FMP earnings calendar (Mode A) or earnings-trade-analyzer JSON output (Mode B). Use when user asks about PEAD screening, post-earnings drift, earnings gap follow-through, red candle breakout patterns, or weekly earnings momentum setups.
description_zh: 针对 PEAD（财报公告漂移）模式，筛选财报后跳空上涨的股票。分析周线K线形态，以检测红色K线回调与突破信号。支持两种输入模式：FMP 财报日历（模式 A）或财报交易分析器 JSON 输出（模式 B）。当用户询问 PEAD 筛选、财报后漂移、财报缺口跟进、红色K线突破形态或周线财报动量设置时使用。

description: Modern minimal resume, single A4 page, ready for print or PDF export.
description_zh: 现代简约简历，单页A4，可打印或导出为PDF。

description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".
description_zh: 持续就计划或设计向用户深入访谈，直至达成共识，并理清决策树的每一个分支。适用于用户希望对计划进行压力测试、在设计中接受拷问，或提到“拷问我”的场景。

description: Generate a report about a video
description_zh: 生成一份关于视频的报告

description: Cache dynamic and static responses on Netlify's CDN from Functions, Edge Functions, and proxies. Use when you add caching or cache-control headers to a function response, tune cache TTL or stale-while-revalidate, set up the durable cache, vary a cache key by query/header/cookie/country/language, purge or invalidate the cache by site or cache tag, use the programmatic Cache API (caches.open/match/put) or @netlify/cache helpers (fetchWithCache/cacheHeaders/getCacheStatus), speed up an expensive API call, add ISR or on-demand revalidation, or debug why a response is or isn't cached via the Cache-Status header.
description_zh: 在 Netlify 的 CDN 上缓存由 Functions、边缘函数和代理提供的动态与静态响应，适用于以下操作：为函数响应添加缓存或 cache-control 响应头、调整缓存 TTL 或 stale-while-revalidate（过期缓存重验证）机制、配置持久化缓存、根据查询参数、请求头、Cookie、国家或语言变化缓存键、按站点或缓存标签清除或失效缓存、使用编程式 Cache API（caches.open/match/put）或 @netlify/cache 辅助工具（fetchWithCache/cacheHeaders/getCacheStatus）、加速耗时较长的 API 调用、添加 ISR（增量静态再生）或按需重验证，以及通过 Cache-Status 请求头调试响应为何被缓存或被未缓存。

description: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.
description_zh: 在产品、UX或功能范围出现权衡时，应遵循此原则。选择用户愉悦而非实现便利；发布更少打磨精致的功能，而非更多粗糙的功能。

description: Abstract detector tickets and hints into reusable edge concepts with thesis, invalidation signals, and strategy playbooks before strategy design/export.
description_zh: 在策略设计与导出之前，将检测工单与提示抽象化为具备论点、无效化信号和策略剧本的可复用边缘概念。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "find a dashboard", "search dashboards", "does a dashboard exist for X", "find widgets that query Y", "which dashboards use this field", "find a dashboard about errors", "look up dashboards by description", "search for existing monitoring dashboards", "find widgets that reference a field", or wants to discover existing Coralogix dashboards or widgets using natural-language or field-based search.
description_zh: 当用户请求“查找仪表盘”、“搜索仪表盘”、“是否存在针对 X 的仪表盘”、“查找查询 Y 的组件”、“哪些仪表盘使用了此字段”、“查找关于错误的仪表盘”、“通过描述查找仪表盘”、“搜索现有的监控仪表盘”、“查找引用某个字段的组件”，或使用自然语言或基于字段的搜索方式发现现有的 Coralogix 仪表盘或组件时，应使用此技能。

description: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design. Redesign as if the requirement had been a foundational assumption from day one, instead of bolting it on.
description_zh: 在将新需求整合到现有设计时，应用此原则。重新设计时，应视该需求为从第一天起便作为基础假设，而非临时附加。

description: Analyze SaaS company valuation compression between funding rounds. Use this skill whenever the user asks about: how much a SaaS company's valuation multiple changed between rounds, why the ARR multiple compressed or expanded, comparing a company's compression to macro benchmarks, or explaining what drove valuation changes for any VC-backed software company. Trigger on phrases like "valuation compression", "ARR multiple", "round-to-round valuation", "multiple change", or when the user asks to compare a company's funding rounds. Always use this skill for any multi-round SaaS valuation analysis — do not try to answer from memory alone.
description_zh: 分析SaaS公司在融资轮次之间的估值压缩情况。当用户询问以下内容时，请使用此技能：SaaS公司在各轮次之间估值倍数发生了多大变化、ARR倍数为何压缩或扩张、将一家公司的压缩情况与宏观基准进行对比，或解释风险投资支持的任何软件公司的估值变化背后驱动因素。触发短语包括“估值压缩”、“ARR倍数”、“轮次间估值”、“倍数变化”，或用户要求对比公司融资轮次时。对于任何多轮SaaS估值分析，始终使用此技能——切勿仅凭记忆回答。

description: Browser automation skill for AI agents using the mb CLI. Use when the agent needs to browse the web, take screenshots, scrape text, fill forms, click elements, record screencasts, run JS in pages, or audit designs. Triggers on: "browse", "open a page", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "fill form", "click button", "web automation", "record screen", "design audit", "accessibility check".
description_zh: 使用 mb CLI 的浏览器自动化技能，面向 AI 智能体。当智能体需要执行以下操作时使用：浏览网页、截图、抓取文本、填写表单、点击元素、录制屏幕、在页面中运行JS、审计设计。触发关键词： "浏览", "打开页面", "截图", "抓取", "填写表单", "点击按钮", "网页自动化", "录制屏幕", "设计审计", "无障碍检查"。

description: Uncover customer jobs, pains, and gains in a structured JTBD format. Use when clarifying unmet needs, repositioning a product, or improving discovery and messaging.
description_zh: 以结构化的 JTBD（任务、意图与体验）格式，揭示客户的任务、痛点与收益。适用于澄清未满足的需求、重新定位产品，或改进调研与信息传达。

description: Interactive planning assistant that helps create focused, well-structured ralph-loop commands through collaborative conversation
description_zh: 通过协作对话，帮助创建聚焦、结构良好的 ralph-loop 命令的交互式规划助手

description: Topic router for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Give it a topic, a question, or a bug you are fighting, and it points at the exact lessons that teach it, plus the right next command. Trigger phrases: "where do I learn", "which lesson covers", "course guide", "I'm stuck on", "what should I do next", "teach me MCP", "teach me Agent Skills", "where do I prepare for a Claude certification"
description_zh:
为“从零开始 AI 工程”课程提供的主题路由器。
输入主题、问题或你正在解决的一个 Bug，即可精准指向教授该内容的对应课程，并提供正确的下一步指令。
触发短语：“我在哪里学习”、“哪节课涵盖了”、“课程指南”、“我卡在这里”、“接下来我该做什么”、“教我 MCP”、“教我 Agent 技能”、“我如何准备 Claude 认证”。

description: Extract edge hints from daily market observations and news reactions, with optional LLM ideation, and output canonical hints.yaml for downstream concept synthesis and auto detection.
description_zh: 从每日市场观察及新闻反应中提取边缘提示，可选用大语言模型进行构思，并输出规范的 hints.yaml，用于下游概念综合与自动检测。

description: Static iPhone and MacBook 3D-style showcase with real HTML embedded on screens, glass-lens refraction, and 360-degree turntable composition.
description_zh: 静态 iPhone 与 MacBook 的 3D 风格展示，在屏幕上嵌入真实 HTML，配合玻璃透镜折射效果与 360 度转盘构图。

description: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `use_figma` tool call. NEVER call `use_figma` directly without loading this skill first. Skipping it causes common, hard-to-debug failures. Trigger whenever the user wants to perform a write action or a unique read action that requires JavaScript execution in the Figma file context — e.g. create/edit/delete nodes, set up variables or tokens, build components and variants, modify auto-layout or fills, bind variables to properties, or inspect file structure programmatically.
description_zh: **强制前提条件**——你必须在每次 `use_figma` 工具调用之前调用此技能。切勿在未先加载此技能的情况下直接调用 `use_figma`。跳过此步骤会导致常见且难以调试的失败。每当用户希望在 Figma 文件上下文中执行写入操作，或执行需要 JavaScript 执行的独特读取操作时，均应触发该技能——例如创建/编辑/删除节点、设置变量或令牌、构建组件和变体、修改自动布局或填充、将变量绑定到属性，或程序化检查文件结构。

description: Build cross-platform desktop applications with Electron, covering main/renderer process architecture, IPC communication, BrowserWindow management, menus, tray icons, packaging, and security best practices. Use when the user asks about Electron, needs to create desktop applications, implement Electron features, or build cross-platform desktop apps.
description_zh: 使用Electron构建跨平台桌面应用，涵盖主进程/渲染进程架构、IPC通信、BrowserWindow管理、菜单、托盘图标、打包以及安全最佳实践等内容，适用于用户询问Electron相关内容、需要创建桌面应用、实现Electron功能或搭建跨平台桌面应用时的场景。

description: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.
description_zh: 顺序安排新增、重构或重写时，应用该方法。首先移除死代码、冗余校验器与桩引用，然后基于更简洁的基础进行构建。

description: Use this skill alongside figma-use when the task involves translating an application page, view, or multi-section layout into Figma. Triggers: 'write to Figma', 'create in Figma from code', 'push page to Figma', 'take this app/page and build it in Figma', 'create a screen', 'build a landing page in Figma', 'update the Figma screen to match code'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, screen, or view in Figma from code or a description. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles via search_design_system, imports them, and assembles screens incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.
description_zh: 当需要将应用程序页面、视图或多部分布局翻译到 Figma 时，请配合使用 figma-use 技能。触发条件包括：“写入 Figma”、“从代码在 Figma 中创建”、“将页面推送到 Figma”、“在 Figma 中构建此应用程序/页面”、“创建屏幕”、“在 Figma 中构建落地页”以及“更新 Figma 屏幕以匹配代码”。每当用户希望从代码或描述在 Figma 中构建或更新完整页面、屏幕或视图时，本技能即为首选工作流程技能。该技能通过 search_design_system 发现设计系统组件、变量和样式，将其导入，并基于设计系统标记而非硬编码值，逐部分逐步组装屏幕。

description: Bootstrap Trigger.dev into an existing project from scratch: authenticate the CLI, install @trigger.dev/sdk and @trigger.dev/build, write trigger.config.ts with the project ref and task dirs, scaffold a /trigger directory with a first task, wire tsconfig and .gitignore, set TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY, and run the dev server. Load this when a project has no trigger.config.ts yet and the user asks to "add Trigger.dev", "set up Trigger.dev", "initialize Trigger.dev", or get a first task running, including in a monorepo. Once the project is set up and you are writing task code, switch to the trigger-tasks skill.
description_zh: 从零开始在现有项目中引导 Trigger.dev：完成 CLI 认证，安装 @trigger.dev/sdk 和 @trigger.dev/build，编写包含项目引用和任务目录的 trigger.config.ts，使用脚手架创建 /trigger 目录并包含首个任务，配置 tsconfig 与 .gitignore，设置 TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY，并运行开发服务器。当项目尚无 trigger.config.ts，且用户请求“添加 Trigger.dev”、“设置 Trigger.dev”、“初始化 Trigger.dev”或运行首个任务时，加载此内容，包括在 monorepo（单仓库多包）中。项目设置完成后，当你正在编写任务代码时，切换到 trigger-tasks 技能。

description: Elastic ML anomaly detection — investigation/RCA, score explanation, job lifecycle troubleshooting, and job operations. Use when answering "what broke?"/"which entity?"/RCA, "why is score high/low?"/renormalization, "datafeed stopped"/"memory limit"/hard_limit, or configuring ML anomaly detection jobs. Reads results from `.ml-anomalies-*` and job state from ML REST APIs.
description_zh: Elastic ML 异常检测——调查/根因分析（RCA）、得分解释、作业生命周期故障排查及作业操作。适用于回答“发生了什么问题？/涉及哪个实体？/根因分析（RCA）”、“为什么得分偏高或偏低？/重归一化”、“数据流停止/内存限制/硬限制”，或配置 ML 异常检测作业时使用。读取自 `.ml-anomalies-*` 的结果，以及来自 ML REST API 的作业状态。

description: Use when building ML/AI apps in Rust. Keywords: machine learning, ML, AI, tensor, model, inference, neural network, deep learning, training, prediction, ndarray, tch-rs, burn, candle, 机器学习, 人工智能, 模型推理
description_zh: 在 Rust 中构建机器学习/人工智能应用时使用。关键词：机器学习, ML, AI, 张量, 模型, 推理, 神经网络, 深度学习, 训练, 预测, ndarray, tch-rs, burn, candle, 机器学习, 人工智能, 模型推理

description: Create and maintain gjkim_instruction.md, the root document for a loop-engineering effort. The document holds only the minimum requirements and confirmed decisions, and deliberately leaves everything else open so that later iterations are not locked into early guesses. Use whenever the user mentions gjkim_instruction.md, a root document or root doc for a loop, loop engineering, starting a long-running agent loop on a goal, or asks to record a requirement or a confirmed decision for such an effort. Also use at the start of a loop iteration to check what is already decided versus still open.
description_zh: 创建并维护 `gjkim_instruction.md`，这是循环工程工作的根文档。该文档仅包含最低要求与已确认的决策，并有意将其他所有内容留待后续确定，以确保后续迭代不会被早期假设所锁定。当用户提及 `gjkim_instruction.md`、循环或循环工程的根文档/根文档、为既定目标启动长期运行的智能体循环，或要求记录此类工作的需求或已确认决策时，均应使用该文档。此外，在每个循环迭代的起始阶段，应使用该文档检查哪些内容已经确定，哪些内容仍有待解决。

description: After Effects animation rendering for web and React applications. Use this skill when implementing Lottie animations, JSON vector animations, interactive animated icons, micro-interactions, or loading animations. Triggers on tasks involving Lottie, lottie-web, lottie-react, dotLottie, After Effects JSON export, bodymovin, animated SVG alternatives, or designer-created animations. Complements GSAP ScrollTrigger and Framer Motion for scroll-driven and interactive animations.
description_zh: 为 Web 和 React 应用提供 After Effects 动画渲染。当使用此技能实现 Lottie 动画、JSON 矢量动画、交互式动画图标、微交互或加载动画时使用。当涉及 Lottie、lottie-web、lottie-react、dotLottie、After Effects JSON 导出、bodymovin、动画 SVG 替代方案或设计师创建的动画等任务时触发。可与 GSAP ScrollTrigger 和 Framer Motion 配合，为滚动驱动和交互式动画提供补充。

description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.
description_zh: 什么？适用于用户希望对某项技术内容进行通俗易懂的拆解——明确谁、什么、哪里、为什么和何时。

description: Based on FeiShu(飞书) / Lark's OpenAPI MCP server, manage user information, chats, emails, cloud documents, multidimensional tables, tasks, calendars, etc.
description_zh: 基于飞书(FeiShu) / Lark 的 OpenAPI MCP 服务器，管理用户信息、聊天、邮件、云端文档、多维表、任务、日历等。

description: Review designs, products, and features with Steve Jobs' standards: ruthless simplicity, focus, and end-to-end excellence. Use when the user mentions "Steve Jobs review", "design review", "product review", "what would Steve do", "insanely great", "this feels too complicated", "too many features", "product taste", "saying no", or "is this good enough to ship". Also trigger when critiquing a UI, feature, or roadmap for focus and simplicity, cutting scope to the essential, or pressure-testing the whole experience from first run to daily use. Covers the simplicity audit, the no list, design-is-how-it-works, end-to-end ownership, demo culture, and a Jobs-style review protocol with binary verdicts. For visual design fundamentals, see refactoring-ui. For usability audits, see ux-heuristics. For detail polish, see microinteractions.
description_zh: 以史蒂夫·乔布斯的准则（冷酷的简洁、专注与端到端卓越）审查设计、产品与功能。当用户提及“史蒂夫·乔布斯审查”、“设计审查”、“产品审查”、“史蒂夫会怎么做”、“极其卓越”、“感觉过于复杂”、“功能过多”、“产品审美”、“说‘不’”或“这足够完善可以发布”时使用。此外，当针对UI、功能或路线图进行专注与简洁性的审视，将范围精简至核心需求，或对从首次运行到日常使用的完整体验进行压力测试时，也应触发。涵盖简洁性审计、“拒绝清单”、设计即如何运作、端到端所有权、演示文化，以及具备二元判定结果的乔布斯式审查流程。关于视觉设计基础，请参阅 refactoring-ui；关于可用性审计，请参阅 ux-heuristics；关于细节打磨，请参阅 microinteractions。

description: Review skills in any project using a dual-axis method: (1) deterministic code-based checks (structure, scripts, tests, execution safety) and (2) LLM deep review findings. Use when you need reproducible quality scoring for `skills/*/SKILL.md`, want to gate merges with a score threshold (for example 90+), or need concrete improvement items for low-scoring skills. Works across projects via --project-root.
description_zh: 使用双轴方法审查任何项目中的技能：(1) 确定性的代码检查（结构、脚本、测试、执行安全性）和 (2) LLM深度审查发现。当您需要为 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 进行可复现的质量评分、通过评分阈值（例如90+）把关合并，或需要为低分技能提供具体改进项时使用。通过 `--project-root` 支持跨项目使用。

description: Use when a request involves Ethereum, the EVM, or blockchain systems. Applies to building, auditing, deploying, or interacting with smart contracts, dApps, wallets, or DeFi protocols. Covers Solidity development, contract addresses, token standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-4626, etc.), Layer 2 networks (Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, zkSync, Polygon), and integrations with DeFi protocols such as Uniswap, Aave, and Curve. Includes topics such as gas costs, contract decimals, oracle safety, reentrancy, MEV, bridging, wallets, querying data from onchain, production deployment, and protocol evolution (EIP lifecycle, fork tracking, upcoming changes).
description_zh: 当请求涉及以太坊、EVM或区块链系统时使用。适用于构建、审计、部署或与智能合约、dApps、钱包或DeFi协议交互。涵盖Solidity开发、合约地址、代币标准（ERC-20、ERC-721、ERC-4626等）、二层网络（Base、Arbitrum、Optimism、zkSync、Polygon）以及与Uniswap、Aave、Curve等DeFi协议的集成。包括Gas费用、合约小数位、预言机安全性、重入、MEV、桥接、钱包、查询链上数据、生产环境部署以及协议演进（EIP生命周期、分叉追踪、即将到来的变更）等主题。

description: Store and retrieve unstructured data like file uploads, images, documents, JSON, and cache-like state with Netlify Blobs. It is a zero-config key/value store accessible from Functions, Edge Functions, and Build Plugins. Reach for this when you handle a file or image upload, persist Background Function output like sitemaps or processed media, cache API responses, store per-deploy assets, or need a simple key/value store from a serverless function. Covers creating site and deploy stores, reading and writing values and JSON, listing keys with metadata, atomic conditional writes, consistency modes, region selection, and file-based uploads. Not for per-user, transactional, or relational data — use Netlify DB for that.
description_zh: 使用 Netlify Blobs 存储和检索非结构化数据，如文件上传、图片、文档、JSON 以及类缓存状态。它是一个零配置键值存储，可从 Functions、Edge Functions 和 Build Plugins 访问。当您需要处理文件或图片上传、持久化 Background Function 的输出（如站点地图或处理后的媒体）、缓存 API 响应、存储每次部署的资产，或从无服务器函数中需要简单的键值存储时，请使用此功能。它涵盖创建站点和部署存储、读取和写入值和 JSON、列出带有元数据的键、原子条件写入、一致性模式、区域选择以及基于文件的上传。不适用于按用户、事务性或关系型数据——请使用 Netlify DB 来处理。

description: Turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph using Claude Code skills — explore, search, and ask questions about any project visually.
description_zh: 使用 Claude Code 技能，将任何代码库转化为可交互的知识图谱——直观探索、搜索，并针对任何项目提出问题。

description: Huashu / huashu-md-html-inspired magazine article layout for turning Markdown or notes into a polished long-form HTML essay.
description_zh: Huashu / huashu-md-html-inspired 杂志文章版式，用于将 Markdown 或笔记转换为精美的长篇 HTML 文章。

description: Perform comprehensive code reviews with best practices, security checks, and constructive feedback. Use when reviewing pull requests, analyzing code quality, checking for security vulnerabilities, or providing code improvement suggestions.
description_zh: 执行全面的代码审查，结合最佳实践、安全检查与建设性反馈。适用于审查Pull Request、分析代码质量、检查安全漏洞或提供代码改进建议时使用。

description: Transform, resize, crop, reformat, and optimize images on demand via Netlify Image CDN's /.netlify/images endpoint. Use when adding responsive images, generating thumbnails, converting formats (avif/webp/png), cropping to aspect ratios, tuning image quality, creating blurred placeholders, allowlisting remote image domains, serving user-uploaded images, or wiring framework image components (Next.js, Astro, Nuxt, Angular, Gatsby) to Netlify. Triggers on tasks like "optimize images", "add image thumbnails", "resize images on the fly", "serve images from an external domain", or "add blur placeholders".
description_zh: 通过 Netlify 图像 CDN 的 /.netlify/images 端点，按需变换、缩放、裁剪、重新格式化和优化图像。适用于添加响应式图片、生成缩略图、转换格式（avif/webp/png）、按比例裁剪、调整图像质量、创建模糊占位图、为远程图像域名设置白名单、服务用户上传的图片，或将框架图像组件（Next.js、Astro、Nuxt、Angular、Gatsby）与 Netlify 集成对接。触发以下任务：“优化图像”、“添加图片缩略图”、“即时缩放图像”、“从外部域名提供图像”或“添加模糊占位图”。

description: Help figure out pricing for a product or service using minimalist entrepreneur principles. Use when someone is setting prices, considering price changes, or struggling with what to charge.
description_zh: 运用极简创业者的原则，帮助确定产品或服务的定价。当有人设定价格、考虑价格调整，或为收费金额而难以抉择时使用。

description: 16-column grid, one saturated accent, and 22 locked layouts (Klein Blue, Lemon, Mint, Safety Orange).
description_zh: 16列网格，一种饱和强调色，以及22种锁定布局（克莱因蓝、柠檬、薄荷、安全橙）。

description: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.
description_zh: 当面对代码库中尚无先例的全新 UI 交互或架构决策时，应使用此方法。构建 2-3 个竞争原型，并进行并排对比，再做出最终决策。

description: Configure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for Salesforce Experience Site users. TRIGGER when: user wants to enable MFA on a community, enforce two-factor authentication for portal users, add MFA to a React Experience Site / Web App, configure ForceTwoFactor permission, create MFA permission sets for external users, or troubleshoot MFA not appearing on login. Also triggers on: MFA community, two-factor portal, ForceTwoFactor permission set, MFA Experience Cloud, MFA React site, identity verification community, MFA experience site, ForceTwoFactor permissionset-meta.xml, MFA permissionset-meta.xml. DO NOT TRIGGER when: configuring org-wide MFA for internal users (that's Setup > Identity Verification), building custom login UI components (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate), or generating generic permission sets without MFA context (use platform-permission-set-generate).
description_zh: 为 Salesforce Experience Site 用户配置多因素认证（MFA）。触发条件：当用户希望对社区启用 MFA、为门户用户强制实施双因素认证、为 React Experience Site / Web App 添加 MFA、配置 ForceTwoFactor 权限、为外部用户创建 MFA 权限集，或排查登录时 MFA 不显示的问题时，触发。另外，以下情况也会触发：MFA 社区、双因素门户、ForceTwoFactor 权限集、MFA Experience Cloud、MFA React 站点、身份验证社区、MFA 体验站点、ForceTwoFactor permissionset-meta.xml、MFA permissionset-meta.xml。不要触发：为内部用户配置机构范围 MFA（这属于设置 > 身份验证），构建自定义登录 UI 组件（使用 experience-ui-bundle-frontdoor-generate），或在不具备 MFA 上下文的条件下生成通用权限集（使用 platform-permission-set-generate）。

description: Authors and updates customization overrides for installed BMad skills. Use when the user says 'customize bmad', 'override a skill', 'change agent behavior', or 'customize a workflow'
description_zh: 为已安装的 BMad 技能编写并更新自定义覆盖设置。当用户说“customize bmad”、“override a skill”、“change agent behavior”或“customize a workflow”时使用。

description: Hyperframes / Remotion-compatible continuous frame animation with autoplay support.
description_zh: Hyperframes / 兼容 Remotion 的连续帧动画，支持自动播放。

description: Search academic literature using Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex APIs. Returns structured JSONL with title, authors, year, venue, abstract, citations, and BibTeX. Use when the user needs to find papers, check related work, or build a bibliography.
description_zh: 使用 Semantic Scholar、arXiv 和 OpenAlex 的 API 搜索学术文献。返回包含标题、作者、年份、发表场所、摘要、引用和 BibTeX 的结构化 JSONL。当用户需要查找论文、检查相关工作或构建参考文献列表时使用。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Python. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Python", "install sentry-sdk", "setup Sentry in Python", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, logging, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for Python applications. Supports Django, Flask, FastAPI, Celery, Starlette, AIOHTTP, Tornado, and more.
description_zh: Python 版 Sentry SDK 完整配置。当被要求执行“为 Python 添加 Sentry”、“安装 sentry-sdk”、“在 Python 中配置 Sentry”，或为 Python 应用程序配置错误监控、链路追踪、性能剖析、日志记录、指标、定时任务或 AI 监控时使用。支持 Django、Flask、FastAPI、Celery、Starlette、AIOHTTP、Tornado 等框架。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to review, analyze, critique, or summarize academic papers, research articles, preprints, or scientific publications. Supports comprehensive structured reviews covering methodology assessment, contribution evaluation, literature positioning, and constructive feedback generation. Trigger on queries involving paper URLs, uploaded PDFs, arXiv links, or requests like "review this paper", "analyze this research", "summarize this study", or "write a peer review".
description_zh: 当用户请求审阅、分析、批判性评价或总结学术论文、研究文章、预印本或科学出版物时，使用此技能。该技能支持全面的结构化评审，涵盖方法评估、贡献评价、文献定位以及建设性反馈生成。当查询涉及论文 URL、上传的 PDF、arXiv 链接，或包含“审阅该论文”、“分析这项研究”、“总结这项研究”或“撰写同行评审”等请求时触发。

description: Locked 1920x1080 canvas deck with React component-level free composition, not bound to a fixed template.
description_zh: 锁定 1920×1080 画布舞台，支持基于 React 组件的自由编排，且不绑定固定模板。

description: Use when building fintech apps. Keywords: fintech, trading, decimal, currency, financial, money, transaction, ledger, payment, exchange rate, precision, rounding, accounting, 金融, 交易系统, 货币, 支付
description_zh: 用于构建金融科技应用程序时。关键词：金融科技、交易、小数、货币、金融、资金、交易、账本、支付、汇率、精度、四舍五入、会计，金融、交易系统、货币、支付

description: Use this skill when the user asks to "set up parsing", "create parsing rule", "extract fields from logs", "regex extraction", "log parsing", "enrich logs", "add context to logs", "custom enrichment table", "lookup table", "geo enrichment", "create metric from logs", "events to metrics", "convert logs to metrics", "generate metrics from events", "recording rule", "precomputed metrics", "PromQL recording", "configure data pipeline", "transform log data", "data processing rules", "rule group", "enrichment settings", "E2M definition", "labels cardinality", "bulk delete rules", "enrichment limits", "search enrichment table", "what should I convert to metrics", "E2M not producing metrics", "E2M no series", "reduce log cost with E2M", "logs to metrics aggregation", "spans to metrics", or wants to configure how Coralogix processes, enriches, or transforms ingested data.
description_zh: 当用户请求使用以下功能时，请使用本技能："设置解析"、"创建解析规则"、"从日志中提取字段"、"正则提取"、"日志解析"、"丰富日志"、"为日志添加上下文"、"自定义丰富表"、"查找表"、"地理丰富"、"从日志创建指标"、"事件转为指标"、"将日志转为指标"、"从事件生成指标"、"记录规则"、"预计算指标"、"PromQL 记录"、"配置数据管道"、"转换日志数据"、"数据处理规则"、"规则组"、"丰富设置"、"E2M 定义"、"标签基数"、"批量删除规则"、"丰富限制"、"搜索丰富表"、"我应该将什么转换为指标"、"E2M 未生成指标"、"E2M 无序列"、"利用 E2M 降低日志成本"、"日志到指标的聚合"、"跨度转为指标"，或希望配置 Coralogix 如何处理、丰富或转换接入的数据。

description: Use Netlify AI Gateway to call OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, TypeSafe (Jev), or OpenRouter-hosted models (xAI/DeepSeek/Meta/Mistral/Qwen) from Netlify Functions or Edge Functions without managing provider accounts or API keys. Reach for this when adding an AI feature to a Netlify app — a chatbot, text summarizer, image generator, joke/content generator, form-submission routing or analysis, or any LLM call — or when wiring the OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/TypeSafe/OpenRouter SDK into a Netlify Function, choosing which env vars to use, streaming long generations, or debugging why gateway calls fail at build time or return 401.
description_zh: 通过 Netlify AI Gateway 从 Netlify Functions 或 Edge Functions 调用 OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、TypeSafe (Jev) 或 OpenRouter 托管的模型（xAI/DeepSeek/Meta/Mistral/Qwen），无需管理提供商账户或 API 密钥。当在 Netlify 应用中添加 AI 功能时——例如聊天机器人、文本摘要器、图像生成器、笑话/内容生成器、表单提交路由或分析，或进行任何 LLM 调用——或者需要将 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/TypeSafe/OpenRouter 的 SDK 集成到 Netlify Function，并选择使用哪些环境变量、流式传输较长的生成，或调试网关调用在构建时失败或返回 401 的原因时，均可借助此功能。

description: Use for CUDA-Q setup, simulation targets, QPU access, and @cudaq.kernel authoring guidance.
description_zh: 用于 CUDA-Q 设置、仿真目标、QPU 访问以及 @cudaq.kernel 内核编写指导。

description: Create a user story map that lays out activities, steps, tasks, and release slices. Use when planning a workflow, backlog, or MVP around the user journey.
description_zh: 创建一个用户故事地图，用于列出活动、步骤、任务及发布切片。在规划工作流、待办事项或MVP时，围绕用户旅程使用。

description: Install cuOpt for Python, C, or server via pip, conda, or Docker; verify the install. For building cuOpt from source, see cuopt-developer.
description_zh: 通过 pip、conda 或 Docker 为 Python、C 或服务端安装 cuOpt；验证安装。如需从源码构建 cuOpt，请参阅 cuopt-developer。

description: Help identify and evaluate communities to build a minimalist business around. Use when someone is looking for a business idea, trying to find their community, or wondering where to start as an entrepreneur.
description_zh: 帮助识别和评估社区，以围绕社区构建极简主义业务。适用于当有人寻找商业创意、寻找自己的社群，或作为企业家不知从何起步时。

description: Investigate Kubernetes workload, node, and control-plane issues using OTel telemetry (EDOT). Use when diagnosing pod failures (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, Error), node pressure, resource exhaustion, image pull failures, admission rejections, autoscaling anomalies, or correlating K8s state with application signals. OTel ingest path only — the legacy ECS Kubernetes integration shape is out of scope.
description_zh: 使用 OTel 遥测（EDOT）排查 Kubernetes 工作负载、节点及控制平面问题。适用于诊断 Pod 故障（CrashLoopBackOff、OOMKilled、Error）、节点压力、资源耗尽、镜像拉取失败、准入拒绝、自动扩缩容异常，以及关联 K8s 状态与应用信号等场景。仅支持 OTel 摄入路径——传统 ECS Kubernetes 集成模式不在适用范围。

description: Prepare PRs for review by cleaning noisy history, improving PR descriptions, and adding reviewer guidance without changing code behavior. Use for "make this easy to review", "tidy this PR", "clean up commits", or "annotate the diff".
description_zh: 为审核准备 PR：通过清理杂乱的历史记录、优化 PR 描述并添加评审指引，且不改变代码行为。适用于“使审核更轻松”、“整理该 PR”、“清理提交记录”或“标注差异”。

description: Pre-built animated React component collections combining Magic UI (150+ TypeScript/Tailwind/Motion components) and React Bits (90+ minimal-dependency animated components). Use this skill when building landing pages, marketing sites, dashboards, or interactive UIs requiring pre-made animated components instead of hand-crafting animations. Triggers on tasks involving animated UI components, Magic UI, React Bits, shadcn/ui integration, Tailwind CSS components, or component library selection. Alternative to manually implementing animations with Framer Motion or GSAP.
description_zh: 预构建的 React 动画组件集合，融合 Magic UI（150+ 个 TypeScript/Tailwind/Motion 组件）与 React Bits（90+ 个轻量级依赖动画组件）。在构建落地页、营销网站、仪表盘或交互式 UI，且需要预制动画组件而非手工编写动画时，请使用此技能。当涉及动画 UI 组件、Magic UI、React Bits、shadcn/ui 集成、Tailwind CSS 组件或组件库选型等任务时触发。替代使用 Framer Motion 或 GSAP 手动实现动画。

description: Convert HTML and Markdown content into Portable Text blocks for Sanity. Use when migrating content from legacy CMSs, importing HTML or Markdown into Sanity, building content pipelines that ingest external content, converting rich text between formats, or programmatically creating Portable Text documents. Covers @portabletext/markdown (markdownToPortableText), @portabletext/block-tools (htmlToBlocks), custom deserializers, and the Portable Text specification for manual block construction.
description_zh: 将HTML和Markdown内容转换为Portable Text块，以适配Sanity。适用于从旧版CMS迁移内容、将HTML或Markdown导入Sanity、构建摄取外部内容的内容管道、在不同格式间转换富文本，或程序化创建Portable Text文档等场景。涵盖@portabletop/markdown（markdownToPortableText）、@portabletop/block-tools（htmlToBlocks）、自定义反序列化器，以及用于手动构建块的Portable Text规范。

description: Use this skill to migrate your Jetpack Compose app to add adaptive edge-to-edge support and troubleshoot common issues. Use this skill to fix UI components (like buttons or lists) that are obscured by or overlapping with the navigation bar or status bar, fix IME insets, and fix system bar legibility.
description_zh: 使用此技能将您的 Jetpack Compose 应用迁移，以添加自适应边到边（edge-to-edge）支持并排查常见问题。使用此技能修复被导航栏或状态栏遮挡或重叠的 UI 组件（如按钮或列表），修复 IME 内边距，并修复系统栏可读性。

description: Oracle Database guidance for SQL, PL/SQL, SQLcl, ORDS, Oracle Vector SDK, administration, app development, performance, security, migrations, and agent-safe database workflows. Use when the user asks to write, edit, rewrite, review, format, debug, tune, or explain SQL; create or refactor PL/SQL; use Oracle VecDB through the Python SDK, REST API, or DBMS_VECTOR_DATABASE package; use SQLcl, Liquibase, ORDS, JDBC, node-oracledb, Python, Java, .NET, or database frameworks; troubleshoot vector tables, embeddings, vector search, reranking, queries, sessions, locks, waits, indexes, optimizer plans, AWR, ASH, migrations, schemas, users, roles, privileges, backup, recovery, Data Guard, RAC, multitenant, containers, monitoring, auditing, encryption, VPD, or safe agent database operations.
description_zh: Oracle数据库指南，涵盖SQL、PL/SQL、SQLcl、ORDS、Oracle向量SDK、管理、应用开发、性能、安全、迁移以及代理安全数据库工作流程等。当用户要求编写、编辑、重写、审查、格式化、调试、优化或解释SQL；创建或重构PL/SQL；通过Python SDK、REST API或DBMS_VECTOR_DATABASE程序包使用Oracle VecDB；使用SQLcl、Liquibase、ORDS、JDBC、node-oracledb、Python、Java、.NET或数据库框架；排查向量表、嵌入、向量搜索、重排序、查询、会话、锁、等待、索引、优化器计划、AWR、ASH、迁移、模式、用户、角色、权限、备份、恢复、Data Guard、RAC、多租户、容器、监控、审计、加密、VPD或安全代理数据库操作时使用。

description: Adversarial senior-engineer review for agent-generated plans, designs, and architectures. Treats the current output as junior work, constructs a senior reviewer whose domain expertise comes from live codebase research plus web research of current best practices, diagnoses altitude failures (too vague or too granular), then rewrites the plan into a scoped, state-of-the-art version. Use when the user says "junior to senior", "senior review", "review this like a staff engineer", when a plan feels hand-wavy or lost in details, or before committing to any agent-written plan.
description_zh: 针对智能体生成的计划、设计与架构，开展对抗式资深工程师评审。将当前输出视为初级工程师的工作，构建一名资深评审者，其领域专业知识来源于对实际代码库的调研，以及对当前最佳实践的网页调研；诊断定位不足（过于模糊或过于琐碎）的问题，随后将计划重写为一个范围界定清晰、处于行业前沿的版本。在用户提出“由初级到高级”“高级评审”“请以高级工程师（staff engineer）身份评审此内容”等要求时，当计划显得概念空泛或细节冗杂时，以及在与任何智能体生成的计划做出最终决定前使用。

description: Trigger.dev client/frontend surface: subscribe to runs in realtime (runs.subscribeToRun and the @trigger.dev/react-hooks hook useRealtimeRun), consume metadata and AI/text streams in React (useRealtimeStream), trigger tasks from the browser (useTaskTrigger, useRealtimeTaskTrigger), and mint scoped frontend credentials with auth.createPublicToken / auth.createTriggerPublicToken. Load when wiring a frontend (React/Next.js/Remix) or backend-for-frontend to show live run progress, status badges, token streams, trigger buttons, or wait-token approval UIs. NOT for writing the backend task itself (streams.define / metadata.set is trigger-tasks territory); this is the consumer side.
description_zh: Trigger.dev 客户端/前端界面功能：实时订阅运行（runs.subscribeToRun 与 @trigger.dev/react-hooks 钩子 useRealtimeRun），在 React 中消费元数据及 AI/文本流（useRealtimeStream），从浏览器触发任务（useTaskTrigger、useRealtimeTaskTrigger），并通过 auth.createPublicToken / auth.createTriggerPublicToken 签发作用域前端凭证。在为前端（React/Next.js/Remix）接线或构建面向前端的后端时加载此功能，用于展示实时运行进度、状态徽章、令牌流、触发按钮或等待令牌审批界面。不用于编写后端任务本身（streams.define / metadata.set 属于触发任务范畴）；本部分为消费端。

description: Build Unreal Engine 5 gameplay with Blueprint visual scripting: Blueprint Classes, the Event Graph and Construction Script, variables/functions/macros, and Blueprint communication (Cast, Interfaces, Event Dispatchers). Use when working in Blueprints, wiring an event graph, deciding how Blueprints talk to each other, or when the user mentions Blueprint, BP, event graph, construction script, or a Blueprint .uasset.
description_zh: 使用 Blueprint 可视化脚本构建 Unreal Engine 5 游戏玩法，涵盖 Blueprint 类、事件图与构造脚本、变量/函数/宏，以及 Blueprint 通信（Cast、接口、事件分发器）。适用于在 Blueprint 中操作、连接事件图、决定 Blueprint 之间如何交互，或用户提及 Blueprint、BP、事件图、构造脚本、Blueprint .uasset 等场景时使用。

description: Process raw source documents into wiki pages. Use when the user adds files to raw/ and wants them ingested, says "process this source", "ingest this article", "I added something to raw/", or wants to incorporate new material into their knowledge base.
description_zh: 将原始源文档处理成维基页面。当用户将文件添加到 raw/ 目录并希望进行摄取，或说“处理这个源文档”、“摄取这篇文章”，或“我在 raw/ 中添加了某些内容”，或希望将其新知识整合到其知识库中时使用。

description: 잡코리아 기업회원 로그인 세션으로 유료 열람 전 마스킹된 인재 이력서를 검색·비교해 채용 검토용 shortlist를 만듭니다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过Job Korea企业会员登录会话，在付费预览前对遮蔽的人才简历进行搜索与比较，创建招聘审查用短名单。在Dolsae中，通过官方界面执行后续行动。

description: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.
description_zh: 在审查或重构难以追踪的代码时使用。统计问题与回答之间的层级，以及读者心智中的隐藏状态；折叠单调用者包装器，缩小可变作用域。

description: Search, retrieve, and install Agent Skills from the prompts.chat registry using MCP tools. Use when the user asks to find skills, browse skill catalogs, install a skill for Claude, or extend Claude's capabilities with reusable AI agent components.
description_zh: 使用 MCP 工具从 prompts.chat 注册中心搜索、获取并安装 Agent 技能。当用户要求查找技能、浏览技能目录、为 Claude 安装技能，或使用可复用的 AI 智能体组件扩展 Claude 的能力时使用。

description: Compatibility alias for Loopy. Use only when an existing installation or older instruction explicitly invokes loop-library; use Loopy for new installations and requests. Provides the same discovery, recommendation, audit, repair, adaptation, guided crafting, bounded execution, run debrief, project loop saving, and publication-preparation workflows.
description_zh: Loopy 的兼容别名。仅在现有安装或旧版指令明确调用 loop-library 时使用；对新安装和请求使用 Loopy。提供相同的发现、推荐、审计、修复、适配、引导式制作、受限执行、运行复盘、项目循环保存及发布准备工作流程。

description: Comprehensive personal finance management system for analyzing transaction data, generating insights, creating visualizations, and providing actionable financial recommendations. Use when users need to analyze spending patterns, track budgets, visualize financial data, extract transactions from PDFs, calculate savings rates, identify spending trends, generate financial reports, or receive personalized budget recommendations. Triggers include requests like "analyze my finances", "track my spending", "create a financial report", "extract transactions from PDF", "visualize my budget", "where is my money going", "financial insights", "spending breakdown", or any finance-related analysis tasks.
description_zh: 综合性个人财务管理系统，用于分析交易数据、生成洞察、创建可视化，并提供可操作财务建议。当用户需要分析消费模式、跟踪预算、可视化财务数据、从 PDF 中提取交易记录、计算储蓄率、识别消费趋势、生成财务报告或获得个性化预算建议时使用。触发条件包括如“分析我的财务状况”、“跟踪我的支出”、“生成财务报告”、“从 PDF 中提取交易记录”、“可视化我的预算”、“我的钱花在哪里了”、“财务洞察”、“支出明细”，以及任何财务相关分析任务。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Qoder CLI (`qodercli`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user asks to have Qoder implement, fix, refactor, or run a queue of coding tasks while the orchestrator remains the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants code written directly without delegation.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Qoder CLI（`qodercli`）作为后台执行者，然后自行审查其差异并完成合并。当用户要求 Qoder 实施、修复、重构或运行一批编码任务，且编排者作为审查者时，应使用本方法。对于足够小可直接内联完成的任务，或用户要求无需委托直接编写代码的情况，请勿使用。

description: Copy and text skill for antislop. Use when writing or editing prose: headlines, tone, CTAs, and anti-AI-writing patterns. Load with the core.
description_zh: antislop 的复制与文本技能。在撰写或编辑文章时使用：标题、语气、行动号召和反人工智能写作模式。加载核心。

description: Design and implement a distinctive frontend within the product’s existing brand, accessibility, performance and framework constraints.
description_zh: 在产品的现有品牌、可访问性、性能及框架约束下，设计并实现一个独具特色的前端。

description: Curated text animation catalog with exact JSON specs for headings, labels, counters, and text swaps. Use when an agent needs to pick or translate named effects like soft blur in, typewriter, shared axis, line reveal, stagger, crossfade, or kinetic builds into WAAPI, Motion, Framer Motion, GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Rive, or similar stacks.
description_zh: 精选文本动画目录，为标题、标签、计数器及文本替换提供精确 JSON 规格说明。当智能体需要将柔和模糊进入、打字机效果、共享轴向、线条显现、交错、交叉淡化或动态构建等具名效果转换为 WAAPI、Motion、Framer Motion、GSAP、CSS、Lottie、Rive 或类似技术栈时使用。

description: Deep Core Web Vitals and page speed audit. Use when the user asks about page speed, Core Web Vitals, LCP, CLS, INP, FCP, TTFB, Lighthouse scores, why a page is slow, performance optimization, or resource size analysis. For broader technical SEO issues, see diagnose-seo.
description_zh: 深度核心网页指标与页面速度审计。当用户询问页面速度、核心网页指标、LCP、CLS、INP、FCP、TTFB、Lighthouse 评分、页面为何运行缓慢、性能优化或资源大小分析时使用。对于更广泛的 SEO 技术问题，请参阅 diagnose-seo。

description: Evaluate business decisions through the lens of sustainable, profitable growth. Use when someone is making decisions about spending, hiring, fundraising, or scaling their business.
description_zh: 从可持续的、盈利增长的视角来评估商业决策。当某人就支出、招聘、筹资或业务扩张做出决策时使用。

description: Use this skill when the user asks to "check data usage", "list TCO policies", "reduce Coralogix costs", "optimize observability spend", "lower our logging bill", "data budget exceeded", "TCO policy", "retention tier", "archive storage", "ingestion costs", "frequent search vs archive", "why is our bill so high", "spending too much on logs", "data retention settings", "cost analysis", "usage breakdown", "optimize log volume", "control data ingestion", "archive cold data", "billing units", "plan consumption", "daily plan", "overage", "PAYG", "usage anomaly", "usage trend", "cx_data_usage_units", or wants to investigate, analyze, or reduce Coralogix data costs.
description_zh: 当用户询问或要求执行以下操作，或希望调查、分析或降低 Coralogix 数据成本时，使用此技能：检查数据使用情况、列出 TCO 政策、降低 Coralogix 成本、优化可观测性支出、降低我们的日志账单、数据预算超出、TCO 政策、保留层级、归档存储、摄取成本、频繁搜索与归档对比、为何我们的账单如此高、在日志上花费过多、数据保留设置、成本分析、用量明细、优化日志量、控制数据摄入、归档冷数据、计费单位、计划消耗、每日计划、超额、PAYG、使用异常、使用趋势、cx_data_usage_units。

description: Track investment theses across their lifecycle — from screening idea to closed position with postmortem. Register theses from screener outputs, manage state transitions, attach position sizing, review due dates, and generate postmortem reports with P&L and MAE/MFE analysis. Trigger when user says "register thesis", "track this idea", "thesis status", "review due", "close position", "postmortem", or "trading journal".
description_zh: 跨越投资方案的全生命周期进行追踪——从筛选想法到平仓并完成事后复盘。从筛选器输出中登记投资方案，管理状态转换，关联头寸规模，审核到期日，并生成包含损益（P&L）及平均绝对误差（MAE）与最大均方误差（MFE）分析的事后复盘报告。当用户说出"register thesis"、"track this idea"、"thesis status"、"review due"、"close position"、"postmortem"或"trading journal"时触发。

description: Turn a long video into N viral-ready short clips with a single managed API call. Wraps muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint, which handles transcription, highlight ranking through a virality framework (hook / emotional peak / opinion bomb / revelation / conflict / quotable / story peak / practical value), overlap dedupe, and vertical face-tracking auto-crop server-side. No local Whisper, no local LLM, no GPU.
description_zh: 只需一次托管 API 调用，即可将长视频转换为 N 个适合病毒式传播的短视频片段。它封装了 muapi.ai 的 `/ai-clipping` 接口，该接口负责转录、通过病毒传播性框架对高光片段进行排名（钩子 / 情感峰值 / 观点炸弹 / 揭示 / 冲突 / 可引用 / 故事峰值 / 实用价值），实现重叠去重，以及服务端的纵向人脸跟踪自动裁剪。无需本地 Whisper，无需本地 LLM，无需 GPU。

description: Implement a research paper as an interactive marimo notebook together with the user. Start by understanding what the user wants to explore, fetch the paper via alphaxiv, then build a focused notebook.
description_zh: 与用户一起，将一篇研究论文实现为一个交互式 Marimo 笔记本。首先，理解用户想要探索的内容，通过 alphaxiv 获取论文，然后构建一个聚焦的笔记本。

description: Plan, generate, source, normalize, and validate cohesive visual game assets. Use for art direction, style bibles, sprites, tilesets, backgrounds, UI art, icons, textures, concept art, or 3D asset briefs.
description_zh:
规划、生成、获取、标准化和验证连贯一致的视觉游戏资源。
用于美术指导、风格指南、精灵、瓦片集、背景、界面美术、图标、纹理、概念美术或3D资产需求说明。

description: Write Unreal Engine 5 C++ gameplay code: the UCLASS/UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION reflection macros, the Gameplay Framework (GameMode, Pawn, Character, PlayerController, Actor components), and the module Build.cs. Use when writing or debugging UE C++, deriving from AActor/ACharacter/ AGameModeBase, exposing properties to the editor or Blueprints, or when the user mentions Unreal C++, UCLASS, GENERATED_BODY, GameMode, ACharacter, or .Build.cs.
description_zh: 编写 Unreal Engine 5 C++ 玩法代码：UCLASS/UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION 反射宏、Gameplay Framework（GameMode、Pawn、Character、PlayerController、角色组件）以及模块 Build.cs。适用于编写或调试 UE C++ 时，从 AActor、ACharacter、AGameModeBase 派生，将属性暴露给编辑器和蓝图；或当用户提及 Unreal C++、UCLASS、GENERATED_BODY、GameMode、ACharacter 或 .Build.cs 时使用。

description: Work with any Upstash product, SDK, or tool, including serverless Redis (caching, sessions, leaderboards, key-value storage), Ratelimit (rate limiting and throttling), QStash (message queue, cron schedules, background jobs), Workflow (durable long-running functions), Vector (vector database for embeddings, semantic search, and RAG), Search (full-text and semantic search), Box (sandboxed cloud containers for AI agents, TypeScript/JavaScript and Python), Blob (serverless S3-compatible file storage with direct browser uploads), the Upstash CLI, and no-signup scratch Redis for agents. Use when the user mentions Upstash or needs any of these capabilities in a serverless, edge, or Node.js app.
description_zh: 可与任何 Upstash 产品、SDK 或工具配合使用，包括无服务器 Redis（缓存、会话、排行榜、键值存储）、Ratelimit（速率限制与限流）、QStash（消息队列、cron 定时任务、后台任务）、Workflow（持久化长时间运行函数）、Vector（用于嵌入、语义搜索和 RAG 的向量数据库）、Search（全文搜索与语义搜索）、Box（用于 AI 代理的沙箱云容器，支持 TypeScript/JavaScript 和 Python）、Blob（支持浏览器直接上传的无服务器 S3 兼容文件存储）、Upstash CLI，以及为代理提供的无需注册的临时 Redis。当用户提及 Upstash 或在无服务器、边缘或 Node.js 应用中需要上述任一能力时使用。

description: Turns implementation work into working code, reviewed and verified. Use when the user delegates a feature, story, bug fix, or meaningful change; a bare story or issue link counts. Skip obvious, low-risk mechanical maintenance such as small ignore-file, typo-only, formatting-only, or configuration-hygiene edits. Explicit BMAD requests always qualify. Do not volunteer for user-directed interactive edits or version-control operations that only record existing work.
description_zh: 将实现工作转化为可运行的代码，并经过审查与验证。适用于用户委托功能、故事、 Bug 修复或重要变更时；仅引用故事或问题链接也视为适用。跳过明显的、低风险机械性维护工作，例如小型忽略文件、仅修正拼写、仅调整格式或配置卫生类编辑。明确的 BMAD 请求始终适用。不要主动承担用户直接要求的交互编辑，或仅记录已有工作的版本控制操作。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "chat with AI", "ask Olly", "ask the agent", "send message to AI", "continue a chat", "follow up on chat", "get artifact", "download artifact", "list artifacts", "retrieve generated content", "AI-generated charts", "AI analysis", "conversational observability", "natural language query", or wants to interact with the Coralogix Observability Agent (Olly) using the cx CLI.
description_zh: 当用户要求“与 AI 聊天”、“询问 Olly”、“询问该智能体”、“向 AI 发送消息”、“继续聊天”、“跟进聊天”、“获取产物”、“下载产物”、“列出产物”、“检索生成的内容”、“AI 生成的图表”、“AI 分析”、“对话式可观测性”、“自然语言查询”，或希望使用 cx CLI 与 Coralogix 可观测性智能体 (Olly) 进行交互时，应使用本技能。

description: Generates valid Cloud Monitoring ListTimeSeries requests and aggregation specifications from metric descriptors and resource parameters. Use when asked to create, generate, format, or build ListTimeSeries requests, JSON payloads, filter expressions, or aligner/reducer aggregations for Cloud Monitoring metrics and charts. Don't use for metric discovery or metric selection.
description_zh: 基于指标描述和资源参数，生成有效的云监控 ListTimeSeries 请求和聚合规范。当需要创建、生成、格式化或构建 ListTimeSeries 请求、JSON 载荷、过滤表达式，或为云监控指标和图表配置对齐/归约聚合时使用。不要用于指标发现或指标选择。

description: Add user authentication to a Netlify site with @netlify/identity — signup/login/logout, Google/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket OAuth, server-side getUser() checks, role-based access control, and Identity event functions. Use it when a task involves adding a login or signup form, gating content to members or roles, "auth middleware" or verifying users in Netlify Functions or Edge Functions, handling OAuth or email-confirmation callbacks, assigning roles at signup, or customizing Identity emails. For locking a whole site to your company or employees-only access, use netlify-access-control instead.
description_zh: 为使用@netlify/identity 的 Netlify 站点添加用户认证——包括注册/登录/登出、Google/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket OAuth、服务端 getUser() 检查、基于角色的访问控制以及 Identity 事件函数。当涉及添加登录或注册表单、将内容限制为会员或角色访问、实现"认证中间件"或在 Netlify Functions 或 Edge Functions 中验证用户、处理 OAuth 或邮件确认回调、在注册时分配角色，或自定义 Identity 邮件时，请使用它。如需将整个站点锁定为您的公司或仅限员工访问，请改用 netlify-access-control。

description: Warm parchment canvas (#f5f4ed), monochrome ink-blue accent (#1B365D), one serif family, and editorial-grade typography.
description_zh: 暖色羊皮纸画布（#f5f4ed），单色墨蓝点缀（#1B365D），单一衬线字体家族，以及编辑级排版。

description: Designs end-of-article CTAs — copy, layout, placement, A/B test plan, accessibility — for blog posts, newsletters, and essays. Use whenever the user asks to write, review, or improve a CTA at the bottom of an article; mentions "end-of-post CTA", "call-to-action", "signup box", "newsletter CTA", "subscribe block", or "what should I put at the bottom"; or asks how to turn readers into subscribers, leads, customers, or paying supporters. Covers personal blogs, paid newsletters (Substack, beehiiv, Ghost), and brand content-marketing blogs. Do NOT use for opening hooks, ledes, or post titles — use samber/cc-skills@copywriting-hooks instead. Not for landing-page, ad, or email copy.
description_zh: 设计文章末尾的行动号召（CTA）——包括文案、布局、位置、A/B 测试方案、无障碍访问——用于博客文章、电子通讯（Newsletter）和文章。当用户要求撰写、审查或改进文章底部的行动号召；提及“文章末尾的行动号召（CTA）”、“行动号召（CTA）”、“注册框”、“电子通讯行动号召”、“订阅区块”或“底部该放什么”；或询问如何将这些读者转化为订阅者、潜在客户、客户或付费支持者时，请使用此项。涵盖个人博客、付费电子通讯（Substack、beehiiv、Ghost）及品牌内容营销博客。不适用于开篇钩子、导语或文章标题——应改用 samber/cc-skills@copywriting-hooks。不适用于落地页、广告或邮件文案。

description: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.
description_zh: 在设计命令、生命周期步骤或运行于崩溃、重启和重试中的处理循环时，应采用本策略；无论之前的运行是否部分完成，最终都会收敛到相同的最终状态。

description: Help users build software using AI coding tools. Use when someone is using AI to generate code, building prototypes without deep technical skills, or exploring how non-engineers can create functional software through natural language.
description_zh:
帮助用户利用AI编程工具构建软件。
适用场景：当有人使用AI生成代码、无需深厚技术技能即可搭建原型，或探索非工程师如何通过自然语言创建功能性软件时。

description: Create data-driven presentation slides using React, Vite, and Recharts with Sentry branding. Use when asked to "create a presentation", "build slides", "make a deck", "create a data presentation", "build a Sentry presentation". Scaffolds a complete slide-based app with charts, animations, and single-file HTML output.
description_zh: 使用 React、Vite 和 Recharts 结合 Sentry 品牌设计，创建数据驱动的演示幻灯片。当被要求“创建演示文稿”、“制作幻灯片”、“制作演示文稿”、“创建数据演示文稿”或“制作 Sentry 演示文稿”时使用。它搭建了一个包含图表、动画以及单文件 HTML 输出的完整幻灯片应用。

description: Configures and enforces SwiftLint in Swift projects using build tool plugins, run scripts, and CI. Covers .swiftlint.yml configuration, disabled_rules, opt_in_rules, only_rules, analyzer_rules, baselines, autocorrect, swiftlint:disable suppressions, reporter formats (sarif, json, checkstyle), strict and lenient modes, SwiftLintBuildToolPlugin via SimplyDanny/SwiftLintPlugins, swift package plugin swiftlint, Xcode run script phases, CI integration, multiple configuration files, and rollout strategies for existing codebases. Use when setting up SwiftLint, configuring lint rules, suppressing warnings, creating baselines, choosing between build tool plugin and run script, or integrating SwiftLint into CI.
description_zh:
通过构建工具插件、运行脚本和 CI 为 Swift 项目配置并强制执行 SwiftLint。

涵盖 .swiftlint.yml 配置、disabled_rules（禁用规则）、opt_in_rules（主动启用规则）、only_rules（仅启用规则）、analyzer_rules（分析器规则）、baselines（基准）、autocorrect（自动纠正）、swiftlint:disable suppressions（swiftlint:disable 抑制设置）、reporter formats（报告格式，包括 sarif、json、checkstyle）、strict and lenient modes（严格模式和宽松模式）、通过 SimplyDanny/SwiftLintPlugins 实现的 SwiftLintBuildToolPlugin（SwiftLint 构建工具插件）、swift package plugin swiftlint（Swift 包插件 swiftlint）、Xcode 运行脚本阶段、CI 集成、多个配置文件，以及针对现有代码库的推广策略。

适用于设置 SwiftLint、配置代码规范规则、抑制警告、创建基准、在构建工具插件和运行脚本之间进行选择，或将 SwiftLint 集成到 CI 中时使用。

description: 사람인 기업회원 인재풀 로그인 세션에서 마스킹된 후보 정보를 검색·비교해 유료 열람 전 shortlist를 만듭니다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在 사람인 企业会员人才池登录会话中，通过搜索与比对脱敏后的候选人信息，在付费查阅前生成候选短名单。在 돌쇠 平台中，可通过官方渠道推进后续操作。

description: Store and retrieve memories (notes, facts, decisions, snippets, images) using a local SQLite database with full-text search. Use when you need to remember information across sessions, recall previous decisions, store code snippets, or search your knowledge base.
description_zh: 使用带全文搜索的本地 SQLite 数据库，存储和检索记忆（笔记、事实、决定、片段、图像）。当您需要跨会话记住信息、回顾之前的决定、存储代码片段或搜索您的知识库时使用。

description: Access and test Vercel deployments protected by Vercel Authentication, SSO, or Deployment Protection. Use when curl, agent-browser, Playwright, or another automated request reaches a Vercel login or protection page; when a protected preview or production URL returns 401 or 403; when TRUSTED_SOURCES_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH appears; or when choosing between `vercel curl` and the `x-vercel-trusted-oidc-idp-token` header.
description_zh: 访问并测试受 Vercel 认证、SSO 或部署保护保护的 Vercel 部署，在以下情况使用：curl、agent-browser、Playwright 或其他自动化请求访问 Vercel 登录或保护页面时；受保护的预览或生产 URL 返回 401 或 403 时；出现 TRUSTED_SOURCES_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH 时；或在 `vercel curl` 与 `x-vercel-trusted-oidc-idp-token` 头之间选择时。

description: Index of the engineering-team skills bundle for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw, and 6 more tools. Architecture, frontend, backend, QA, DevOps, security, AI/ML, data engineering, Playwright, Stripe, AWS, MS365 (stdlib-only Python tools). Use when browsing or choosing among engineering-team role skills — load only the one specialist SKILL.md you need, never bulk-load the bundle.
description_zh: Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 等 6 款工具的工程团队技能包索引。涵盖架构、前端、后端、QA、DevOps、安全、AI/ML、数据工程、Playwright、Stripe、AWS、MS365（仅使用标准库的 Python 工具）。在浏览或选择工程团队角色技能时使用——只需加载所需的那一个专项 SKILL.md，切勿批量加载整个包。

description: Ultimate AI agent memory system. Combines bulletproof WAL protocol, vector search, git-based knowledge graphs, cloud backup, and maintenance hygiene. Never lose context again. For Clawdbot, Moltbot, Claude, GPT agents.
description_zh: 终极AI智能体记忆系统。融合防崩塌WAL协议、向量搜索、基于Git的知识图谱、云端备份及维护卫生规范，彻底告别上下文丢失。适用于Clawdbot、Moltbot、Claude、GPT智能体。

description: Answer questions against the knowledge base wiki. Use when the user asks a question about their collected knowledge, wants to explore connections between topics, says "what do I know about X", or wants to search their wiki.
description_zh: 针对知识库维基回答用户的问题。当用户询问其已收集的知识、希望探索主题之间的联系、说“我关于 X 的了解是什么”，或希望搜索其维基时使用。

description: Compatibility alias for explicit qodo-pr-resolver requests. Follow the complete Qodo PR review workflow embedded here and use qodo-review-resolver for new invocations; lifecycle update provenance intentionally uses the canonical qodo-review-resolver release-index identity.
description_zh: 针对显式 qodo-pr-resolver 请求的兼容性别名。请遵循此处嵌入的完整 Qodo PR 审核工作流，并使用 qodo-review-resolver 进行新的调用；生命周期更新来源信息有意使用标准的 qodo-review-resolver release-index 身份。

description: Reference for how to call the Salesforce LSP MCP tools and what to do when they are unavailable. Use when the user asks how to use the Salesforce LSP, which LSP/MCP tools exist, what apex.diagnostics / validate_soql / complete_soql do, why an LSP tool returned an error like lsp_disabled or no_apex_workspace or no_org_connected, how to debug the LSP host, or how to turn the LSP off. Also the contract other skills follow when they call an LSP tool: which tool to prefer, how to read its result, and the fallback when the LSP host is absent. DO NOT TRIGGER for generating or editing Apex/LWC/metadata (use platform-apex-generate), running deploys (use platform-metadata-deploy), or SOQL authoring (use platform-soql-query); this skill is a reference and contract document — use it only when the question is specifically about the LSP layer or its MCP tools.
description_zh:
参考：如何调用 Salesforce LSP MCP 工具及工具不可用时的应对方法。适用于当用户询问如何使用 Salesforce LSP、有哪些 LSP/MCP 工具、apex.diagnostics / validate_soql / complete_soql 的功能、LSP 工具为何会返回如 lsp_disabled、no_apex_workspace 或 no_org_connected 等错误、如何排查 LSP 主机问题，或如何关闭 LSP 的情况。

其他技能调用 LSP 工具时遵循的契约：应优先选择哪个工具、如何读取其返回结果，以及在 LSP 主机缺失时的回退方案。

不得触发用于生成或编辑 Apex/LWC/元数据（使用 platform-apex-generate）、运行部署（使用 platform-metadata-deploy）或编写 SOQL（使用 platform-soql-query）；本技能是一份参考与契约文档，仅当问题具体涉及 LSP 层或其 MCP 工具时使用。

description: Use when adding animations with Motion Vue (motion-v) - provides motion component API, gesture animations, scroll-linked effects, layout transitions, and composables for Vue 3/Nuxt
description_zh: 添加动画时使用 Motion Vue (motion-v) - 为 Vue 3/Nuxt 提供 Motion 组件 API、手势动画、滚动联动效果、布局过渡及组合式函数

description: Guide for modernizing and migrating MSBuild project files to SDK-style format. USE FOR: converting legacy .csproj/.vbproj with verbose XML to SDK-style, migrating packages.config to PackageReference, removing Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs in favor of auto-generation, eliminating explicit <Compile Include> lists via implicit globbing, consolidating shared settings into Directory.Build.props. Indicators of legacy projects: ToolsVersion attribute, <Import Project="$(MSBuildToolsPath)">, .csproj files > 50 lines for simple projects. DO NOT USE FOR: projects already in SDK-style format, non-.NET build systems (npm, Maven, CMake), .NET Framework projects that cannot move to SDK-style.
description_zh:
将 MSBuild 项目文件现代化并迁移至 SDK 样式格式的指南。

适用场景（USE FOR）：将带有详细 XML 的旧版 .csproj/.vbproj 转换为 SDK 样式；将 packages.config 迁移至 PackageReference；以自动生成的方式替代 Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs；通过隐式 globbing 消除显式的 `<Compile Include>` 列表；将共享设置整合至 Directory.Build.props。

旧版项目特征（Indicators of legacy projects）：ToolsVersion 属性、` <Import Project="$(MSBuildToolsPath)">`、简单项目中的 .csproj 文件超过 50 行。

不适用于（DO NOT USE FOR）：已处于 SDK 样式格式的项目、非 .NET 构建系统（npm、Maven、CMake）、无法迁移至 SDK 样式的 .NET Framework 项目。

description: Look up Y Combinator companies, batches, and startup ecosystem data using the yc-oss API (read-only). Use this skill whenever the user wants to research YC-backed startups, find companies in a specific batch or industry, check which YC companies are hiring, explore top YC companies, or analyze startup trends by sector or tag. Triggers include: "YC companies in fintech", "who's in the latest YC batch", "YC startups hiring", "top Y Combinator companies", "find YC companies tagged AI", "W25 batch", "S24 companies", "YC stats", "Y Combinator portfolio", "startup research", "which YC companies do X", "venture research on YC", any mention of Y Combinator, YC batch, or YC-backed companies in the context of startup research, venture analysis, or market intelligence. This is a read-only data source — the API is a static JSON dataset updated daily.
description_zh: 使用 yc-oss API（只读）查询 Y Combinator 公司、批次和创业生态数据。当用户需要研究 YC 支持的初创企业、查找特定批次或行业的公司、查看哪些 YC 公司在招聘、探索顶尖 YC 公司，或按行业或标签分析创业趋势时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括："YC 公司的金融科技领域"、"谁在最新的 YC 批次中"、"YC 初创企业在招聘"、"顶尖的 Y Combinator 公司"、"查找带有 AI 标签的 YC 公司"、"W25 批次"、"S24 公司"、"YC 统计数据"、"Y Combinator 投资组合"、"创业研究"、"哪些 YC 公司在做 X"、"关于 YC 的创业研究"，以及在创业研究、创业分析或市场情报的语境下提到 Y Combinator、YC 批次或 YC 背靠公司。这是一个只读数据源——API 是每日更新的静态 JSON 数据集。

description: Expert Core Data guidance (iOS/macOS): stack setup, fetch requests & NSFetchedResultsController, saving/merge conflicts, threading & Swift Concurrency, batch operations & persistent history, migrations, performance, and NSPersistentCloudKitContainer/CloudKit sync.
description_zh: iOS/macOS 专家 Core Data 指导（数据栈搭建、获取请求与 NSFetchedResultsController、保存与合并冲突、多线程与 Swift Concurrency、批处理操作与持久化历史、数据迁移、性能，以及 NSPersistentCloudKitContainer / CloudKit 同步）

description: SVG curve connectors, sticky-note nodes, and cursor interaction with a whiteboard-brainstorm feel.
description_zh: SVG 曲线连接线、便利贴节点，以及带有白板头脑风暴质感的光标交互。

description: WebGL-style fluid displacement background with a quote overlay, suited to video intros, landing heroes, or posters.
description_zh: WebGL风格流体位移背景，带有引言叠加层，适用于视频开场、落地页英雄或海报。

description: 한국 구직자의 이력서·경력요약과 희망조건을 바탕으로 잡코리아·사람인 공개 채용공고를 검색하고 적합도와 지원 전략을 정리합니다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 以韩国求职者的简历、履历摘要和期望条件为基础，在JobKorea与People.인（잡코리아·사람인）的公开招聘公告中进行搜索，并整理匹配度与求职策略。在돌쇠方面，从通过官方渠道采取后续行动，直至全部执行到位。

description: Safely change and test untested codebases using Feathers' "Working Effectively with Legacy Code". Use when the user mentions "legacy code", "no tests", "untested codebase", "how do I test this", "seams", "characterization tests", "golden master", "sprout method", "afraid to change this code", "monster method", "dependency breaking", or "inherited a messy codebase". Also trigger when changing code without tests safely, getting a class under test when constructors, statics, or singletons block it, adding features to tangled modules, or planning incremental test coverage for an old codebase. Covers the legacy-code change algorithm, seams, characterization tests, sprout/wrap, and dependency-breaking techniques. For refactoring code that already has tests, see refactoring-patterns. For day-to-day code quality, see clean-code.
description_zh: 使用 Feathers 的《有效应对遗留代码》安全地更改和测试未经测试的代码库。当用户提到“遗留代码”、“没有测试”、“未经测试的代码库”、“我如何测试这个”、“seams”、“特征测试”、“golden master”、“sprout 方法”、“担心更改此代码”、“monster 方法”、“破坏依赖”或“继承了混乱的代码库”时使用。也应在以下情况下触发：安全地在不带测试的情况下更改代码；当构造函数、静态成员或单例阻碍被测类的获取时，能够获得被测类；向纠缠的模块添加功能；或为旧代码库规划增量测试覆盖。涵盖遗留代码变更算法、seams、特征测试、sprout/wrap 以及破坏依赖技术。对于已有测试的代码的重构，参见 refactoring-patterns。对于日常代码质量，参见 clean-code。

description: NYT-newsroom typography, staggered reveal animation, and editorial-grade charts (line, bar, or range band).
description_zh: NYT新闻编辑室排版、错落式揭示动画，以及编辑级图表（折线、柱状或区间带）。

description: Cut a release: bump versions, write changelogs, commit, tag.
description_zh: 发布版本：提升版本号，撰写变更日志，提交，打标签。

description: Use when building IoT apps. Keywords: IoT, Internet of Things, sensor, MQTT, device, edge computing, telemetry, actuator, smart home, gateway, protocol, 物联网, 传感器, 边缘计算, 智能家居
description_zh: 构建物联网应用时使用。关键词：IoT、物联网、传感器、MQTT、设备、边缘计算、遥测、执行器、智能家居、网关、协议、物联网、传感器、边缘计算、智能家居

description: Analyzes current state and user query to answer BMad questions or recommend the next skill(s) to use. Use when user asks for help, bmad help, what to do next, or what to start with in BMad. Also when the user asks to set up, update, or doctor this BMad installation.
description_zh: 分析当前状态与用户查询，以回答 BMad 问题，并推荐接下来要使用的技能（可多个）。当用户请求帮助、询问 BMad 帮助、了解下一步该做什么，或在 BMad 中应从何处开始，使用此功能。此外，当用户请求设置、更新或诊断此 BMad 安装时，也使用此功能。

description: Run Salesforce Code Analyzer to scan code for security, performance, best practice, and code style violations. Supports all engines (PMD, ESLint, CPD, RetireJS, Flow, SFGE, ApexGuru), targets (files, folders, git diff), categories, and severities. Also handles post-scan exploration: filtering results by engine/severity/category/file, and explaining what specific rules mean. TRIGGER when: user says 'scan my code', 'check for security issues', 'run PMD/ESLint', 'find duplicates', 'analyze Flows', 'check vulnerable libraries', 'AppExchange review', 'lint my LWC', 'static analysis', 'code quality', 'show only security violations', 'what is this rule', 'explain ApexCRUDViolation', 'filter results', or mentions engines/file types (.cls, .trigger, .js, .flow-meta.xml). Use this skill for scanning, exploring results, understanding rules, and listing available rules. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to fix code without scanning, or asks ONLY about installation/configuration.
description_zh:
运行 Salesforce Code Analyzer，扫描代码中的安全、性能、最佳实践和代码风格违规问题。支持所有引擎（PMD、ESLint、CPD、RetireJS、Flow、SFGE、ApexGuru）、扫描目标（文件、文件夹、git diff）、类别和严重程度。此外，还支持扫描后探索：按引擎、严重程度、类别、文件过滤结果，并解释具体规则的含义。

触发条件：当用户说“scan my code”、“check for security issues”、“run PMD/ESLint”、“find duplicates”、“analyze Flows”、“check vulnerable libraries”、“AppExchange review”、“lint my LWC”、“static analysis”、“code quality”、“show only security violations”、“what is this rule”、“explain ApexCRUDViolation”、“filter results”，或提及引擎/文件类型（.cls、.trigger、.js、.flow-meta.xml）时。

使用此技能进行扫描、探索结果、理解规则以及列出可用规则。

不要触发：当用户希望在不扫描的情况下修复代码，或仅询问安装/配置时。

description:
Produce a distinctive, LOCKED design language plus an implementation-ready UX/UI spec, written to
`.ulpi/design/`: a per-brief visual identity (palette, type, signature), the design system to build
on, user flows and states, component briefs, and accessibility constraints. Commits to a bold
aesthetic direction, bans AI-slop by name, and locks the identity so every screen and future session
stays consistent. Can visit inspiration links with the browse skill to extract real design DNA. Ends
with a build handoff that a delegated engineering agent implements — a DESIGN-SPEC skill that produces
the spec, never production UI code. Use for new features, redesigns, or design-system work where the
build should follow a locked spec.
description_zh: 生成独特且锁定的设计语言，并产出可直接实施的 UX/UI 规范，编写至 `.ulpi/design/`：涵盖针对每个需求的视觉识别（调色板、字体、标志性元素）、可供构建的设计系统、用户流程与状态、组件简报及无障碍限制。坚定贯彻大胆的美学方向，明确按名称禁用 AI-slop，并锁定视觉身份，确保每个屏幕及未来会话保持高度一致。可使用浏览技能访问灵感链接，提取真实的“设计 DNA”。以构建交接作为收尾，交由委派工程代理执行——这是一个仅用于产出规范、绝不产出生产环境 UI 代码的 DESIGN-SPEC 技能。适用于需要遵循锁定规范进行构建的新功能、重构或设计系统相关工作。

description: Film light leaks, grain, 16:9 letterbox, and large serif type for cinematic openings or chapter cards.
description_zh: 电影光泄漏、胶片颗粒、16:9 信箱模式，以及大衬线字体，适用于电影开场或章节卡片。

description: 조달청 나라장터 발주계획현황서비스로 물품·공사·용역·외자 발주계획 목록을 검색한다. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: 通过采购厅国家市场订单计划现状服务，搜索货物、工程、服务、外资订单计划列表。在돌쇠中，准备达到尽可能接近合法的正式阶段。

description: 사주팔자 정보를 인터뷰로 확인한 뒤 saju-fortune npm package를 사용해 연애운, 재물운, 직업운, 건강운, 한해 운세, 궁합을 대화형으로 풀이한다.
description_zh: 通过访谈确认八字信息后，使用 saju-fortune npm 包，以对话形式解析感情运、财运、事业运、健康运、年度运势以及婚配情况。

description: Audit a Google Business Profile, compare it to local competitors, and map Maps visibility around a location.
description_zh: 审计一个谷歌商家资料，将其与本地竞争对手进行比较，并映射某个位置周围的谷歌地图可见性。

description: Scaffold a brand-new Salesforce DX project from scratch — pick a template, generate the project, relocate this session into it, authenticate an org, set it as default, and enable source tracking. TRIGGER when the user asks to 'create a new Salesforce project', 'create a new project for me', 'start a new Salesforce project', 'new SFDX project', 'scaffold a project', 'sf project generate', or 'set up a new org project from scratch'. DO NOT TRIGGER for: validating tools on an existing project (use platform-environment-validate or /salesforce-development:setup), org authentication on a project that already exists (use /salesforce-development:login), showing an existing project's metadata stats (use /salesforce-development:project), or creating scratch orgs in an existing project (use dx-org-manage).
description_zh:
从零搭建全新的Salesforce DX项目——选择模板，生成项目，将本次会话迁移至项目中，认证组织，将其设为默认，并启用源代码跟踪。

当用户请求执行以下操作时触发：“创建新的Salesforce项目”、“为我创建新项目”、“启动新的Salesforce项目”、“新SFDX项目”、“搭建项目”、“sf项目生成”或“从零搭建新的组织项目”。

对于以下场景不触发：在现有项目中校验工具（使用platform-environment-validate或/salesforce-development:setup）、在已存在的项目中完成组织认证（使用/salesforce-development:login）、查看现有项目的元数据统计（使用/salesforce-development:project）、在现有项目中创建临时组织（使用dx-org-manage）。

description: 查询 AIHOT 的中文 AI 资讯、精选、当前热点和日报。用户询问今天或最近的 AI 新闻、AI 圈动态、大模型或产品发布、OpenAI／Anthropic／Google 最新消息、AI 论文、AI 日报、AIHOT 精选、当前最热事件，或需要同步当前全部精选时使用。必须通过 aihot.news 的匿名只读 API 获取当前数据，不凭训练记忆回答新闻；不需要 API Key 或 MCP server。
description_zh: 查询 AIHOT 的中文 AI 资讯、精选、当前热点和日报。用户询问今天或最近的 AI 新闻、AI 圈动态、大模型或产品发布、OpenAI／Anthropic／Google 最新消息、AI 论文、AI 日报、AIHOT 精选、当前最热事件，或需要同步当前全部精选时使用。必须通过 aihot.news 的匿名只读 API 获取当前数据，不凭训练记忆回答新闻；不需要 API Key 或 MCP server。

description: Digital glitch, chromatic offset, and data-corruption title frame for video transitions or cyberpunk heroes.
description_zh: 数字故障、色差偏移与数据损坏标题帧，适用于视频转场或赛博朋克英雄。

description: Segmented logo assembly, glow bloom, and tagline reveal for video outros or brand closing frames.
description_zh: 分段式标志组合、发光光晕与标语揭示，适用于视频片尾或品牌收尾画面。

description: Use XcodeBuildMCP to build, run, launch, and debug the current iOS project on a booted simulator. Trigger when asked to run an iOS app, interact with the simulator UI, inspect on-screen state, capture logs/console output, or diagnose runtime behavior using XcodeBuildMCP tools.
description_zh: 使用 XcodeBuildMCP 在已启动的模拟器上构建、运行、启动并调试当前 iOS 项目。当请求运行 iOS 应用、与模拟器界面交互、检查屏幕状态、捕获日志/控制台输出或诊断运行时行为时触发，并使用 XcodeBuildMCP 工具。

description: Post-writing SEO validation with pass/fail checklist covering title tag length and keyword placement, meta description quality, heading hierarchy and keyword density, internal/external link audit with anchor text analysis, canonical URL verification, Open Graph meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image), Twitter Card validation, structured data presence and validity, URL structure optimization, and image alt text presence. Produces prioritized fix list with specific recommendations. Use when user says "seo check", "check seo", "validate seo", "blog seo", "seo validation", "on-page seo", "title tag check", "meta description check", "heading check", "link audit".
description_zh: 写作后SEO验证，包含通过/不通过检查清单，涵盖标题标签长度与关键词位置、元描述质量、标题层级与关键词密度、内部/外部链接审计及锚文本分析、规范URL验证、Open Graph 元标签（og:title, og:description, og:image）、Twitter Card 验证、结构化数据存在性及有效性、URL 结构优化以及图片替代文本（alt text）存在性。生成包含具体建议的优先级修复清单。当用户说“SEO检查”、“检查SEO”、“验证SEO”、“博客SEO”、“SEO验证”、“页面SEO”、“标题标签检查”、“元描述检查”、“标题检查”、“链接审计”时使用。

description: Twitter quote or data card designed to pair with a post.
description_zh: 专为与帖子搭配设计的推特引用或数据卡片。

description: This skill should be used when setting up, auditing, or enforcing internationalization/localization in UI codebases (React/TS, i18next or similar, JSON locales), including installing/configuring the i18n framework, replacing hard-coded strings, ensuring en-US/zh-CN coverage, mapping error codes to localized messages, and validating key parity, pluralization, and formatting.
description_zh: 本技能应在设置、审计或执行 UI 代码库（React/TS、i18next 或类似框架、JSON 本地化文件）的国际化/本地化时使用，包括安装/配置 i18n 框架、替换硬编码字符串、确保 en-US/zh-CN 覆盖范围、将错误代码映射到本地化消息，以及验证键的对应性、复数形式与格式。

description: Load the coding rules from Qodo most relevant to the current coding task, using the qodo CLI's managed rules search — generate structured semantic queries from the assignment, retrieve the workspace's matching rules ranked by relevance, and apply them while writing the code. Use when the user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, when starting implementation planning, or on "get rules", "load qodo rules", "fetch coding rules", "relevant rules", "search rules"; skip if rules are already loaded in this conversation.
description_zh: 从 Qodo 加载与当前编码任务最相关的编码规则，使用 qodo CLI 的管理规则搜索功能——从任务分配中生成结构化的语义查询，检索工作区中按相关性排序的匹配规则，并在编写代码时应用它们。在用户要求编写、编辑、重构或审查代码、开始实现规划，或遇到"获取规则"、"加载 Qodo 规则"、"获取编码规则"、"相关规则"、"搜索规则"等指令时使用；若本对话中规则已加载，则跳过。

description: Help users build content marketing strategies. Use when someone is starting a blog, building SEO, creating thought leadership content, or deciding on content formats and distribution channels.
description_zh: 帮助用户制定内容营销策略。适用于在开始搭建博客、进行搜索引擎优化、创作思想领导力内容，或确定内容形式与分发渠道时使用。

description: Diagnoses and resolves memory leaks in JavaScript/Node.js applications. Use when a user reports high memory usage, OOM errors, or wants to capture, compare, or inspect heap snapshots with Chrome DevTools MCP memory tools.
description_zh: 诊断并解决 JavaScript/Node.js 应用中的内存泄漏。适用于用户报告高内存占用、OOM 错误，或需要使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 内存工具捕捉、比较、检查堆快照的情况。

description: When the user wants to optimize for local search, set up Google Business Profile, or build local citations. Also use when the user mentions "local SEO," "Google Business Profile," "Google Maps," "NAP," "citations," "local search," "local business," or "service area." For location pages, use programmatic-seo.
description_zh: 当用户需要进行本地搜索优化、设置 Google 商家资料或构建本地引用时。此外，当用户提及“本地 SEO”、“Google 商家资料”、“Google 地图”、“NAP”、“引用”、“本地搜索”、“本地企业”或“服务区域”时，亦需使用。对于位置页面，使用 programmatic-seo。

description: Configures and deploys enhanced chat Messaging Channels for Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW). Use when the user needs to create, deploy, and activate a messaging channel configured with Omni-Channel Flow, Omni-Channel Queue, User, or Agentforce Service Agent routing. Generates MessagingChannel metadata, deploys it to the target org, and activates the channel with User Verification, pre-chat forms, automated responses, consent settings, and all customizable channel options via Metadata API. TRIGGER when the user mentions messaging channel, MIAW, enhanced chat, in-app messaging, web messaging setup, or references a .messagingChannel-meta.xml file. DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is configuring legacy Live Agent chat, Embedded Service deployments without messaging, or standard Omni-Channel routing rules without a messaging channel.
description_zh:
配置并部署增强聊天消息通道（Messaging for In-App and Web，简称 MIAW）。当用户需要创建、部署并激活采用 Omni-Channel 流程、Omni-Channel 队列、用户或 Agentforce 服务代理路由配置的消息通道时使用。通过元数据 API 生成消息通道元数据，将其部署至目标组织，并使用用户验证、预聊天表单、自动化响应、同意设置及所有可自定义通道选项激活该通道。

当用户提及消息通道、MIAW、增强聊天、应用内消息、网页消息设置，或引用 .messagingChannel-meta.xml 文件时触发。当用户配置遗留 Live Agent 聊天、不含消息的嵌入式服务部署，或不含消息通道的标准 Omni-Channel 路由规则时，请勿触发。

description: Help define company values and culture for a minimalist business. Use when someone is setting up their company culture, preparing to hire, or wanting to codify what their company stands for.
description_zh: 帮助为简约型企业定义公司价值观与企业文化。适用于在建立公司文化、筹备招聘，或希望将公司所代表的核心理念固化为制度时使用。

description: Generate falsifiable trade strategy hypotheses from market data, trade logs, and journal snippets. Use when you have a structured input bundle and want ranked hypothesis cards with experiment designs, kill criteria, and optional strategy.yaml export compatible with edge-finder-candidate/v1.
description_zh: 从市场数据、交易日志和期刊片段中生成可证伪的交易策略假设。当您拥有结构化输入数据包，并希望获得排名的假设卡片（包含实验设计、终止标准及可选的、兼容 edge-finder-candidate/v1 的 strategy.yaml 导出）时使用。

description: Discord messaging workflows through OpenClaw's message tool.
description_zh: 通过 OpenClaw 的消息工具实现 Discord 消息工作流。

description: Use this skill when asked to create a pull request (PR). It ensures all PRs follow the repository's established templates and standards.
description_zh: 当被要求创建拉取请求（PR）时，请使用此技能。它确保所有 PR 遵循仓库既定的模板和标准。

description: Health-check the wiki for contradictions, orphan pages, stale claims, and missing cross-references. Use when the user says "audit", "health check", "lint", "find problems", or wants to improve wiki quality.
description_zh: 检查 wiki 中的矛盾、孤立页面、过时声明和缺失的交叉引用。当用户说“audit”、“health check”、“lint”、“find problems”，或希望提高 wiki 质量时使用。

description: Analyze a screen recording of a manual process and produce targeted, working automation scripts. Extracts frames and audio narration from video files, reconstructs the step-by-step workflow, and proposes automation at multiple complexity levels using tools already installed on the user machine.
description_zh: 分析手动流程的屏幕录像，并生成针对性强、可运行的自动化脚本。从视频文件中提取帧与音频旁白，重构分步工作流程，并利用用户机器上已安装的工具，在多个复杂程度级别上提出自动化方案。

description: Ingest Hermes agent history into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to mine their past Hermes sessions for knowledge, import their ~/.hermes folder, extract insights from previous Hermes conversations, or says things like "process my Hermes history", "add my Hermes memories to the wiki", "ingest ~/.hermes", or "what have I worked on in Hermes". Also triggers when the user mentions Hermes memories, Hermes sessions, ~/.hermes/memories, or Hermes skill logs.
description_zh: 将 Hermes 智能体历史导入 Obsidian 维基。当用户希望从过往的 Hermes 会话中挖掘知识、导入其 ~/.hermes 文件夹、从之前的 Hermes 对话中提取见解，或说出诸如“处理我的 Hermes 历史数据”、“将我的 Hermes 记忆添加到维基”、“导入 ~/.hermes”或“我在 Hermes 中做了哪些工作”等表述时，请使用此技能。当用户提及 Hermes 记忆、Hermes 会话、~/.hermes/memories 或 Hermes 技能日志时，也会触发此技能。

description: Runs one or more installed review lenses — adversarial critique, edge cases, verification gaps, structure, prose — and reports triaged findings. Use when, and only when, the user asks you to review a diff, a pull request, or an artifact — code or documents, one or many — and actually says "review"; an explicit skill:bmad-review directive from another skill counts as that ask. A request to act on feedback from an earlier review is a change, not a review. Never invoke this uninvited, including on edits you just made.
