description_zh: 运行一个或多个已安装的审查视角——包括对抗性批判、边界情况、验证遗漏、结构、行文——并报告分诊后的发现。当且仅当用户要求你审查差异对比、拉取请求或产物（包括代码或文档，可单可多）并实际表示"审查"时使用；另一技能明确的 skill:bmad-review 指令即视为此类请求。对先前审查反馈采取行动的要求属于修改，而非审查。切勿未经邀请调用本技能，包括在你刚刚对修改进行操作时也不允许这样做。

description: poteto's agent style for concise, detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, and verified work. Use for poteto, /poteto-mode, or requests to work in this style.
description_zh: poteto 的智能体风格：简洁、详尽的回答；审慎的子代理；不拖沓的文本；简洁的代码；经核实的成果。适用于 poteto、/poteto-mode，或要求以该风格工作的请求。

description: Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave instead of preserving compatibility layers.
description_zh: 在引入新的内部 API 而旧调用方仍存在时使用。应同步迁移调用方并删除旧 API，而不是保留兼容层。

description: Record and analyze post-trade outcomes for signals generated by edge pipeline and other skills. Track false positives, missed opportunities, and regime mismatches. Feed results back to edge-signal-aggregator weights and skill improvement backlog.
description_zh: 记录并分析由边缘流水线和其他技能生成的信号所产生的交易后结果，追踪误报、错失的机会以及策略不匹配情况，并将结果反馈至边缘信号聚合器权重和技能改进待办事项中。

description: Guide for organizing MSBuild infrastructure with Directory.Build.props, Directory.Build.targets, Directory.Packages.props, and Directory.Build.rsp. USE FOR: structuring multi-project repos, centralizing build settings, implementing NuGet Central Package Management (CPM) with ManagePackageVersionsCentrally, consolidating duplicated properties across .csproj files, setting up multi-level Directory.Build hierarchy with GetPathOfFileAbove, understanding evaluation order (Directory.Build.props → SDK .props → .csproj → SDK .targets → Directory.Build.targets). Critical pitfall: $(TargetFramework) conditions in .props silently fail for single-targeting projects — must use .targets. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems, migrating legacy projects to SDK-style (use msbuild-modernization), single-project solutions with no shared settings.
description_zh:
使用 Directory.Build.props、Directory.Build.targets、Directory.Packages.props 和 Directory.Build.rsp 组织 MSBuild 基础设施的指南

用途：
用于结构化多项目仓库、集中构建配置、实现使用 ManagePackageVersionsCentrally 的 NuGet 中央包管理（CPM）、统一合并 .csproj 文件中重复的属性、结合 GetPathOfFileAbove 设置多层 Directory.Build 层级结构，以及理解求值顺序（Directory.Build.props → SDK .props → .csproj → SDK .targets → Directory.Build.targets）。

关键陷阱：在 .props 文件中使用 $(TargetFramework) 条件时，单目标项目会静默失败——必须使用 .targets。

切勿用于：
非 MSBuild 构建系统、将传统项目迁移至 SDK 风格（使用 msbuild-modernization）、没有共享配置的单一项目解决方案。

description: Use for dependency updates: bump npm/pnpm/yarn/bun packages, check outdated, or run taze.
description_zh: 依赖更新请使用：升级 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 包、检查过时版本，或运行 taze。

description: Integrates a Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW) Embedded Messaging chat widget into an Experience Cloud site by patching the site's LWR or Aura page bundle, deploying, publishing, and verifying guest access. Use when the user wants to embed messaging on an Experience site, add a chat widget to a community, place the Embedded Messaging component on an LWR or Aura page, wire an embedded service deployment to a site, references the retrieved bundle artifacts (`content.json`, `homeGuestLayout.json`, or a `*.site-meta.xml` file), or automates the retrieve/patch-JSON/deploy/publish flow instead of clicking through Experience Builder. DO NOT TRIGGER when creating the messaging channel (use service-digital-engagement-channel-configure), when creating or updating the EmbeddedServiceConfig deployment (use service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure), or when generating a standalone JavaScript snippet for a non-Experience website.
description_zh: 通过修补站点的 LWR 或 Aura 页面包、部署、发布并验证访客访问权限，将 Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW) Embedded Messaging 聊天组件集成到 Experience Cloud 站点中；适用于用户希望在 Experience 站点上嵌入消息、在社区中添加聊天组件、在 LWR 或 Aura 页面上放置 Embedded Messaging 组件、将嵌入式服务部署与站点关联、引用检索到的包产物（`content.json`、`homeGuestLayout.json` 或 `*.site-meta.xml` 文件），或通过自动化检索/修补 JSON/部署/发布流程，而不是在 Experience Builder 中逐项点击完成的情况；切勿触发以下情形：创建消息渠道（使用 `service-digital-engagement-channel-configure`）、创建或更新 EmbeddedServiceConfig 部署（使用 `service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure`），或为非 Experience 网站生成独立的 JavaScript 代码片段。

description: Build and iterate playable Three.js game systems: starter scaffold, architecture, design briefs, core loops, level and encounter design, entities, input, camera, collision and physics, scoring, objectives, and game feel. Use for first playable slices, new Vite/TypeScript/Three.js setups, level/arena/track/wave/hole/puzzle design, combat encounters, difficulty tuning, and juice.
description_zh: 构建并迭代可玩的 Three.js 游戏系统：基础脚手架、架构、设计简报、核心循环、关卡与遭遇设计、实体、输入、相机、碰撞与物理、计分、目标与游戏手感。用于首批可玩片段、全新的 Vite/TypeScript/Three.js 环境搭建、关卡/竞技场/赛道/波次/洞/谜题设计、战斗遭遇、难度调校与游戏表现。

description: Cursor light trail, chromatic rays, and directional flares for word-by-word quote reveals in video intros.
description_zh: 光标光迹、色光射线与方向性闪光，用于视频开场中逐字显示引文。

description: Unity IMGUI (Immediate Mode GUI) expert for legacy editor tools using OnGUI/immediate mode. Generates and modifies IMGUI EditorWindows, custom Inspectors, PropertyDrawers, and scripts with IMGUI code (OnGUI, OnInspectorGUI). Use when maintaining existing IMGUI editor code or when user explicitly requests IMGUI/OnGUI.
description_zh: Unity IMGUI（即时模式GUI）专家，专注于基于 OnGUI/即时模式 的遗留编辑器工具。能够生成并修改 IMGUI 编辑器窗口、自定义检视器、属性绘制器，以及包含 IMGUI 代码（OnGUI、OnInspectorGUI）的脚本。适用于维护现有 IMGUI 编辑器代码，或当用户明确要求使用 IMGUI/OnGUI 的场景。

description: Designs distinctive, non-generic UI — typography, OKLCH color, design tokens (DESIGN.md), layout, components, motion, dark mode, accessibility — for landing pages, SaaS apps, dashboards, ecommerce, decks, docs, portfolios, avoiding the AI-slop / Claude-esque default look. Use whenever building or styling any web frontend, app, dashboard, landing page, deck, or artifact, or when the user says "make it not look like AI", "de-slopify", "deslop", "less generic", "give it character", "design a UI for X", "design an app", "update DESIGN.md", or complains the output looks like every other AI site. Trigger even on a bare "build a UI for X" with no aesthetic named. Not for writing marketing copy.
description_zh: 设计独特、不千篇一律的界面——字体排版、OKLCH 色彩、设计令牌 (DESIGN.md)、布局、组件、动效、暗黑模式、无障碍访问——适用于落地页、SaaS 应用、仪表板、电商、演示文稿、文档、作品集，旨在避免 AI 俗套 / Claude 风格等千篇一律的默认外观。在构建或美化任何网页前端、应用、仪表板、落地页、演示文稿或工件时，或在用户说出“让它看起来不像 AI”、“去俗套化”、“去俗套”、“减少千篇一律”、“赋予其个性”、“为 X 设计界面”、“设计应用程序”、“更新 DESIGN.md”，或抱怨输出与其他 AI 网站看起来毫无差异时，均应使用。即使用户仅以“为 X 构建界面”且未指定任何审美风格的最简形式提出要求，也应触发该指令。不用于撰写营销文案。

description: Test a half-formed idea in a questioning conversation, with different personas probing its weak points, until the user can act on it or drop it with confidence. Optionally writes a short brief for planning skills to build on. Use when the user says 'forge an idea', 'pressure-test this idea', 'stress-test my thinking', or 'harden this idea'
description_zh:
在带有提问的对话中测试尚未成熟的想法，通过不同角色逐一排查其薄弱环节，直到用户能够据此采取行动，或凭信心放弃它。

如有需要，可撰写一份简短简报，为规划能力提供进一步构建的依据。

当用户说“锻造一个想法”、“对这项想法进行压力测试”、“对我的思考进行压力测试”，或“强化这项想法”时使用。

description: Configures Embedded Messaging Deployments for Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW). Use when the user needs to create a new embedded messaging deployment from scratch using Connect API with defaults, or update an existing deployment's settings using Metadata API. Produces Connect API request payloads for new deployments and EmbeddedServiceConfig metadata XML for updates. TRIGGER when the user mentions embedded messaging deployment, embedded service deployment, MIAW deployment, messaging widget setup, chat widget configuration, embedded chat deployment, or references a .EmbeddedServiceConfig-meta.xml file. DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is creating a messaging channel (use service-digital-engagement-channel-configure), configuring legacy Live Agent embedded service, or generating the JavaScript code snippet for website embedding.
description_zh:
为适用于应用内和网页的消息（MIAW）配置嵌入式消息部署。

当用户需要使用Connect API（默认参数）从零开始创建新的嵌入式消息部署，或使用Metadata API更新现有部署的设置时使用。

为新的部署生成Connect API请求负载，并为更新生成EmbeddedServiceConfig元数据XML。

当用户提及嵌入式消息部署、嵌入式服务部署、MIAW部署、消息组件设置、聊天组件配置、嵌入式聊天部署，或引用.EmbeddedServiceConfig-meta.xml文件时触发。

当用户正在创建消息渠道（请使用service-digital-engagement-channel-configure）、配置旧版Live Agent嵌入式服务，或生成用于网站嵌入的JavaScript代码片段时，请勿触发。

description: Use to set up, configure, ground, or go live with a Salesforce Help Agent (an Agentforce Service Agent in Service Cloud) via a guided four-checkpoint flow. Use whenever a user says any of: set up / create / build / add a help agent, service agent, or support chat agent; add or embed a chat widget on a website or Experience Cloud / LWR site; put a help agent on a channel (web chat, voice, phone, help portal); ground a help agent on Salesforce Knowledge; or wants an AI to answer customer questions, manage support cases, and escalate to a human. The right skill even when the request names only one part or references help-agent-spec.md or the Agentforce Quick Setup wizard. DO NOT TRIGGER when authoring a brand-new agent with no Help Agent lineage (use agentforce-generate), configuring OAuth/ECAs (use integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure), or only deploying metadata (use platform-metadata-deploy).
description_zh: 用于通过引导式四检查点流程设置、配置、落地或上线 Salesforce Help Agent（Service Cloud 中的 Agentforce Service Agent）。当用户提及以下任何内容时，使用：设置/创建/构建/添加帮助代理、服务代理或支持聊天代理；在网站或 Experience Cloud / LWR 站点上添加或嵌入聊天组件；将帮助代理部署到（网页聊天、语音、电话、帮助门户）等渠道；将帮助代理落地到 Salesforce Knowledge；或希望 AI 解答客户问题、管理支持案例，并升级至人工客服。即使请求仅提及其中一部分，或引用 help-agent-spec.md 或 Agentforce Quick Setup 向导，也应使用此技能。切勿触发以下情况：编写没有任何帮助代理谱系的全新代理时（请使用 agentforce-generate）；配置 OAuth/ECA 时（请使用 integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure）；或仅部署元数据时（请使用 platform-metadata-deploy）。

description: Autonomous iteration loop: modify, verify, keep/discard against any metric
description_zh: 自主迭代循环：修改、验证，并针对任意指标保留或丢弃。

description: Formats and parses locale-aware numbers, decimals, currencies, percentages, dates, durations, measurements, names, lists, byte counts, and URLs with Foundation FormatStyle and ParseableFormatStyle. Use when replacing legacy Formatter subclasses, designing reusable format APIs, using SwiftUI Text(_:format:), correcting availability, or testing user-facing formatted output across locales.
description_zh: 使用 Foundation 的 FormatStyle 和 ParseableFormatStyle，格式化和解析地区感知的数字、小数、货币、百分比、日期、时长、测量值、名称、列表、字节数以及 URL。当替换旧版 Formatter 子类、设计可复用的格式 API、使用 SwiftUI 的 Text(_:format:)、修正可用性，或在本地化环境中测试面向用户的格式化输出时使用。

description: Browser-based 3D design tool with visual editor, animation, and web export. Use this skill when creating 3D scenes without code, designing interactive web experiences, prototyping 3D UI, exporting to React/web, or building designer-friendly 3D content. Triggers on tasks involving Spline, no-code 3D, visual 3D editor, 3D animation, state-based interactions, React Spline integration, or scene export. Alternative to Three.js for designers who prefer visual tools over code.
description_zh:
基于浏览器的 3D 设计工具，具备可视化编辑器、动画与网页导出功能。

在无需编写代码创建 3D 场景、设计交互式网页体验、设计 3D UI 原型、导出至 React/web、或构建面向设计师的 3D 内容时，使用本技能。

在涉及 Spline、无代码 3D、可视化 3D 编辑器、3D 动画、基于状态的交互、React Spline 集成或场景导出等任务时，触发使用本技能。

为偏好可视化工具而非代码的设计师提供 Three.js 的替代方案。

description: Realistic macOS notification banner with app icon, title, and body, suited to video overlays or product teasers.
description_zh: 逼真的 macOS 通知横幅，包含应用图标、标题与正文，适用于视频叠加层或产品预告片。

description: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop, and logs decisions via show-me-your-work. Use for /figure-it-out, 'figure it out', a large migration, or when no narrower playbook applies.
description_zh: 当没有更具体的 playbook 适用时，设计可审计的 playbook：大规模迁移、具有雄心的多部分变更，或需要人类在离开后审核的工作。将严谨性适配到任务，运行假设循环，并通过 show-me-your-work 记录决策。用于 /figure-it-out、'figure it out'、大规模迁移，或当没有更具体的 playbook 适用时。

description: Realistic X post card with engagement metrics (likes, reposts, views), suited to video overlays or shareable image cards.
description_zh: 逼真的 X 帖子卡片，带有互动指标（点赞、转发、浏览量），适用于视频叠加层或可分享的图片卡片。

description: Help users create and deliver compelling presentations. Use when someone is preparing a talk, building a slide deck, dealing with presentation anxiety, practicing for a keynote, or asking how to be more engaging when presenting.
description_zh: 帮助用户创建并呈现令人信服的演示文稿。适用于用户准备演讲、制作幻灯片、应对演示焦虑、为主旨演讲进行练习，或询问如何让演讲更具吸引力时。

description: The session loop that makes agentmemory pay off, recall before starting work, save at decision points, learn from corrections. Use when starting a nontrivial task, after settling a decision or debugging a gotcha, or whenever deciding if something belongs in memory.
description_zh: 让 agentmemory 发挥价值的会话循环：工作前回忆、决策点保存、从纠正中学习。在开始非平凡任务、确定决策或调试陷阱时使用，或在决定某项内容是否应存入记忆时使用。

description: Convert Kanchi-style dividend investing into a repeatable US-stock operating procedure. Use when users ask for かんち式配当投資, dividend screening, dividend growth quality checks, PERxPBR adaptation for US sectors, pullback limit-order planning, or one-page stock memo creation. Covers screening, deep dive, entry planning, and post-purchase monitoring cadence.
description_zh: 将 Kanchi 式配当投资转化为可重复执行的美国股票操作流程。当用户询问“かんち式配当投資”、配当筛选、配当增长质量检查、适用于美国板块的 PERxPBR 适配、回调限价单规划，或一页式股票备忘录创建时使用。涵盖筛选、深度分析、入场规划及交易后监控节奏。

description:
Tailwind CSS animations and transitions including built-in utilities and custom keyframes.
PROACTIVELY activate for: (1) animate-* utilities (spin, ping, pulse, bounce), (2) custom @keyframes via @theme animate, (3) transition utilities (transition, duration, ease), (4) transforms (scale, rotate, translate) with transition, (5) prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, (6) Framer Motion / Motion One integration with Tailwind, (7) CSS scroll-driven animations (animation-timeline), (8) view transitions API with Tailwind, (9) hover, focus, group-hover transitions, (10) staggered list animations.
Provides: animation utility reference, custom keyframe examples, reduced-motion pattern, Framer Motion integration, and scroll-driven animation recipes.
description_zh:
Tailwind CSS 动画和过渡效果，包括内置工具类和自定义关键帧。

有针对性地启用以下内容：
(1) animate-* 工具类（spin、ping、pulse、bounce）；
(2) 通过 @theme animate 自定义 @keyframes；
(3) 过渡工具类（transition、duration、ease）；
(4) 带过渡的变换（transforms）（scale、rotate、translate）；
(5) prefers-reduced-motion: reduce；
(6) Framer Motion / Motion One 与 Tailwind 的集成；
(7) CSS 滚动驱动动画（animation-timeline）；
(8) 与 Tailwind 结合的视图过渡（view transitions）API；
(9) hover、focus、group-hover 过渡效果；
(10) 交错列表动画。

提供内容：动画工具类参考、自定义关键帧示例、reduced-motion 模式、Framer Motion 集成以及滚动驱动动画方案。

description: Use for simplifying recently changed code: clean up, refactor for clarity, reduce complexity, improve readability, or maintainability.
description_zh: 用于简化近期修改的代码：清理、重构以提升清晰度、降低复杂度、提升可读性，或增强可维护性。

description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
description_zh: 面向落地页、作品集与重新设计的去庸俗化前端技能。智能体阅读需求简报，推断正确的设计方向，交付毫不显模板化的界面。适用时采用真实设计系统，重新设计以审计为先，执行严格的预检。

description: Turn a product idea into a manual-first process you can start delivering today. Use when you have an idea and want to figure out how to deliver value by hand before writing any code.
description_zh: 将产品想法转化为手工优先、今天即可开始交付的流程。适用于你有想法，且希望在编写任何代码之前，先弄清如何以手工方式交付价值时。

description: Create a six-frame storyboard that shows a user's journey from problem to solution. Use when you need a fast narrative for alignment, concept reviews, or demos.
description_zh: 创建六格分镜，展示用户从问题到解决方案的旅程。适用于您需快速叙述以进行对齐、概念评审或演示的场景。

description: Realistic Reddit post card with vote rail and comment count, suited to video overlays or story sharing.
description_zh: 逼真的Reddit帖子卡片，带有投票栏和评论数，适用于视频叠加层或故事分享。

description: Save a correction or hard-won rule as a confidence-weighted lesson that resurfaces before similar work. Use when the user corrects your approach, says "learn this", "always" or "never do X", or you notice yourself repeating a past mistake.
description_zh: 将修正或来之不易的规则保存为置信度加权的教训，以便在遇到类似工作时重新浮现。当用户纠正你的方法、说“学习这个”、“总是”或“永远不要做X”，或你发现自己重复过去的错误时使用。

description: 查询中国地区的天气预报，支持15天及逐小时预报、各种生活指数
description_zh: 查询中国地区的天气预报，支持15天及逐小时预报、各种生活指数

description: Build, review, or improve Core Data persistence in apps that have not adopted SwiftData. Use when working with NSManagedObject subclasses, NSFetchedResultsController for list-driven UI, NSBatchInsertRequest / NSBatchDeleteRequest / NSBatchUpdateRequest for bulk operations, NSPersistentHistoryChangeRequest for persistent history tracking and multi-target sync, NSStagedMigrationManager for staged schema migrations (iOS 17+), NSCompositeAttributeDescription for composite attributes (iOS 17+), or when integrating Core Data threading with Swift Concurrency. For Core Data + SwiftData coexistence or migration, see the swiftdata skill instead.
description_zh: 在未采用 SwiftData 的应用中，构建、审查或改进 Core Data 的持久化。适用于以下情况：处理 NSManagedObject 子类、通过 NSFetchedResultsController 构建列表驱动的 UI、通过 NSBatchInsertRequest / NSBatchDeleteRequest / NSBatchUpdateRequest 执行批量操作、通过 NSPersistentHistoryChangeRequest 进行持久化历史跟踪与多目标同步、通过 NSStagedMigrationManager 进行分阶段模式迁移（iOS 17+）、通过 NSCompositeAttributeDescription 定义复合属性（iOS 17+），或当需要将 Core Data 的线程处理与 Swift 并发集成时。如需 Core Data 与 SwiftData 的共存或迁移，请参阅 swiftdata 技能。

description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改并改进现有技能，以及衡量技能表现。当用户需要从零创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能，运行evals测试技能，通过方差分析进行技能表现基准测试，或优化技能描述以提升触发准确性时使用。

description: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.
description_zh: 当并发执行者可能向相同的文件、分支、键或状态对象写入时应用该策略。应首先消除共享；结构性序列化仅在共享写入者是一个真正的必要不变性时才进行。

description: Comprehensive skill for GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) and ScrollTrigger plugin. Use this skill when creating web animations, scroll-driven experiences, timelines, tweens, scroll-triggered animations, pinning, scrubbing, parallax effects, or animating DOM elements, SVG, Canvas, WebGL, or Three.js. Triggers on tasks involving GSAP, ScrollTrigger, smooth animations, scroll effects, or animation sequencing.
description_zh: 用于 GSAP（格林索克动画平台）和 ScrollTrigger 插件的综合技能。当创建网页动画、滚动驱动体验、时间轴、补间动画、滚动触发的动画、固定元素、滚动 scrubbing、视差效果，或动画 DOM 元素、SVG、Canvas、WebGL 或 Three.js 时，使用此技能。在涉及 GSAP、ScrollTrigger、平滑动画、滚动效果或动画序列的任务中触发。

description: Searches arXiv for preprints and academic papers, retrieves abstracts, and filters by topic. Use when the user asks to find research papers, search arXiv, look up preprints, find academic articles in physics, math, CS, biology, statistics, or related fields.
description_zh: 在 arXiv 上搜索预印本和学术论文，检索摘要，并按主题筛选。当用户要求查找研究论文、搜索 arXiv、查询预印本，或在物理学、数学、计算机科学（CS）、生物学、统计学等相关领域查找学术文章时使用。

description: Lightweight NDA, MSA, and vendor contract review for SMBs without legal on staff. Reads contracts from local files, mail attachments (Gmail or M365), a connected file store (Google Drive or M365), or DocuSign envelopes; flags non-standard terms; explains risks in plain English; and outputs a marked-up redline as a separate DOCX. Use when the user says "review this contract," "what am I signing," "red flags," "flag any concerns," "check the payment terms," or uploads/forwards a contract or legal agreement.
description_zh: 针对无专职法务人员的中小企业（SMB），提供轻量级的保密协议（NDA）、主服务协议（MSA）及供应商合同审查服务。系统可从本地文件、邮件附件（Gmail 或 M365）、关联文件存储（Google Drive 或 M365）或 DocuSign 信封中读取合同；标记非标准条款；用通俗易懂的语言解释风险；并输出一份带标注修改稿（红线稿）的独立 DOCX 文件。适用场景：当用户提及“审查这份合同”、“我要签署什么”、“危险信号”、“标记任何疑虑”、“检查付款条款”，或上传/转发合同或法律协议时。

description: Use when the user wants to create a dataset, generate synthetic data, or build a data generation pipeline.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建数据集、生成合成数据或构建数据生成流水线时使用。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Mistral Vibe CLI (`vibe`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Vibe — phrasings like "have Vibe implement X", "delegate this to Vibe", "run it through Mistral Vibe", "use vibe to implement/fix/refactor" — or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Vibe while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Mistral Vibe 命令行工具（`vibe`）作为后台执行者，随后审查其 diff 并自行落地。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Vibe，或使用诸如“让 Vibe 实现 X”、“将此事委托给 Vibe”、“通过 Mistral Vibe 运行它”、“使用 vibe 实现/修复/重构”等表述，或希望将一批编码任务通过 Vibe 运行并继续由您担任审查者时，请使用此方法。切勿用于足够小的、可直接内联完成的任务，或用户要求无需委托而直接编写代码的情况。

description: Resolve merge conflicts non-interactively, validate build and tests, and finalize conflict resolution
description_zh: 非交互式解决合并冲突，验证构建与测试，并完成冲突解决。

description: Core DQL syntax, pitfalls, query patterns, and query optimization. Load to write, build, fix, or OPTIMIZE a DQL query — prevents syntax errors and makes queries faster, more efficient, and cheaper (less data scanned = lower query consumption/cost per run). Covers fetch commands, data models, field namespaces, time alignment, entity/smartscape patterns, metric discovery, and performance/cost optimization (filter early, bucket filters, short time ranges, field selection, sampling, cardinality). Trigger: "write/build/fix a DQL query", "DQL syntax", "query logs/spans/metrics", "create a timeseries", "optimize my DQL", "make my query faster/cheaper", "reduce DQL cost/consumption/scanned data", "keep DQL cost under control". Do NOT use to explain an existing query or answer product questions. For MONITORING a tenant's ACTUAL query consumption/billing (how much queries cost, who scanned most, cost trends) use dt-platform-costs — this tunes the query text, not billing data.
description_zh:
核心 DQL 语法、常见误区、查询模式与查询优化。用于编写、构建、修复或优化 DQL 查询 —— 可防止语法错误，使查询更快、更高效、成本更低（扫描的数据越少，每次运行的查询消耗/成本就越低）。涵盖获取命令、数据模型、字段命名空间、时间对齐、实体/smartscape 模式、指标发现，以及性能/成本优化（提前筛选、桶筛选、短时间范围、字段选择、采样、基数）。

触发词：“编写/构建/修复 DQL 查询”、“DQL 语法”、“查询日志/跨度/指标”、“创建时序数据”、“优化我的 DQL”、“让我的查询更快/更省钱”、“降低 DQL 成本/消耗/扫描数据”、“保持 DQL 成本可控”。

不得用于解释已有查询或回答产品问题。若要监控租户的实际查询消耗与计费情况（查询成本多少、谁扫描的数据最多、成本趋势），请使用 dt-platform-costs —— 该工具用于调优查询文本，而非计费数据。

description: Set up player input in Unreal Engine 5 with Enhanced Input: Input Actions, Input Mapping Contexts, modifiers and triggers, adding the mapping context, and binding actions by ETriggerEvent. Use when wiring movement/look/jump input, creating IA_/IMC_ assets, binding in C++ or Blueprints, or when the user mentions Enhanced Input, Input Mapping Context, Input Action, IA_/IMC_, or ETriggerEvent.
description_zh: 使用增强输入（Enhanced Input）在 Unreal Engine 5 中设置玩家输入：输入动作、输入映射上下文、修饰符和触发器，添加映射上下文，以及通过 ETriggerEvent 绑定动作。适用于连接移动/视角/跳跃输入、创建 IA_/IMC_ 资源、在 C++ 或蓝图（Blueprints）中绑定，或当用户提及增强输入（Enhanced Input）、输入映射上下文、输入动作、IA_/IMC_ 或 ETriggerEvent 时使用。

description: Monitor dividend portfolios with Kanchi-style forced-review triggers (T1-T5) and convert anomalies into OK/WARN/REVIEW states without auto-selling. Use when users ask for 減配検知, 8-Kガバナンス監視, 配当安全性モニタリング, REVIEWキュー自動化, or periodic dividend risk checks.
description_zh: 使用 Kanchi 风格强制复核触发器（T1-T5）监控股息组合，并将异常转换为 OK/WARN/REVIEW 状态，不进行自动卖出。当用户请求 減配検知、8-Kガバナンス監視、配当安全性モニタリング、REVIEWキュー自動化，或定期进行股息风险检查时使用。

description: Send third-party WhatsApp messages or sync/search WhatsApp history via wacli, not normal active chats.
description_zh: 通过 wacli 发送第三方 WhatsApp 消息或同步/搜索 WhatsApp 历史记录，而非进行正常活跃聊天。

description: Set up and use feature flags and A/B tests with the Flags SDK (`flags` npm package) and Vercel Flags. Use when installing or configuring the SDK, adding a new or existing flag, wiring `vercelAdapter` (OIDC or SDK keys), declaring flags with `flag()`, using the `vercel flags` CLI (create, inspect, list, enable, disable, set, update, split, rollout, rules, segments, use-targeting, evaluations, versions, open, archive, unarchive, rm, sdk-keys, override, prepare), setting up providers/adapters (Vercel, Statsig, LaunchDarkly, PostHog, GrowthBook, Global Config, OpenFeature, Split, Flagsmith, Reflag, Optimizely, or custom), precompute, `identify`/`dedupe`, Flags Explorer/Toolbar, Next.js or SvelteKit, or encrypting flag values. Triggers: feature flags, feature gates, A/B testing, experimentation, gradual rollout, traffic split, targeting rules, flag overrides, precompute, Flags Explorer, Vercel Flags, vercel flags CLI, `flags/next`, `flags/sveltekit`, `flags/react`, `@flags-sdk/*`.
description_zh:
设置并配置和使用功能开关与 A/B 测试，使用 Flags SDK（`flags` npm 包）和 Vercel Flags。适用于安装或配置 SDK 时、添加新标志或现有标志、连接 `vercelAdapter`（OIDC 或 SDK 密钥）、使用 `flag()` 声明标志、使用 `vercel flags` CLI（create、inspect、list、enable、disable、set、update、split、rollout、rules、segments、use-targeting、evaluations、versions、open、archive、unarchive、rm、sdk-keys、override、prepare）、设置提供方/适配器（Vercel、Statsig、LaunchDarkly、PostHog、GrowthBook、Global Config、OpenFeature、Split、Flagsmith、Reflag、Optimizely 或自定义）、预计算、`identify`/`dedupe`、Flags Explorer/Toolbar、Next.js 或 SvelteKit，或对标志值进行加密。

**触发场景：** 功能开关、功能门控、A/B 测试、实验测试、渐进式发布、流量分配、定向规则、标志覆盖、预计算、Flags Explorer、Vercel Flags、`vercel flags` CLI、`flags/next`、`flags/sveltekit`、`flags/react`、`@flags-sdk/*`。

description: Generate a one-page Market Posture summary with net exposure ceiling, growth-vs-value bias, participation breadth, and new-entry-allowed vs cash-priority recommendation by integrating signals from breadth, regime, and flow analysis skills.
description_zh: 通过整合广度、市场状态与资金流分析技能的信号，生成一份单页市场态势总结，内容包括净敞口上限、成长与价值偏向、参与广度，以及允许新入场与现金优先的建议。

description: Spotify Now Playing-style card with album art, progress bar, and playback controls, suited to video overlays or personal homepages.
description_zh: Spotify Now Playing风格的卡片，带有专辑封面、进度条和播放控制，适用于视频叠加层或个人主页。

description: Orchestrate the full edge research pipeline from candidate detection through strategy design, review, revision, and export. Use when coordinating multi-stage edge research workflows end-to-end.
description_zh: 统筹从候选检测、策略设计、评审、修订到导出的完整边缘研究全流程。用于端到端协调多阶段边缘研究工作流。

description: Review a project's PRs to check for issues detected in code review by Seer Bug Prediction. Use when asked to review or fix issues identified by Sentry in PR comments, or to find recent PRs with Sentry feedback.
description_zh: 审查项目中的 Pull Requests（PRs），以检查 Seer Bug Prediction 在代码审查中检测出的问题。当被要求审查或修复 Sentry 在 PR 评论中识别出的问题，或查找带有 Sentry 反馈的近期 Pull Requests（PRs）时使用。

description: Use when working with Payload projects (payload.config.ts, collections, fields, hooks, access control, Payload API). Use when debugging validation errors, security issues, relationship queries, transactions, or hook behavior.
description_zh: 在使用 Payload 项目（payload.config.ts、集合、字段、钩子、访问控制、Payload API）时使用。当调试验证错误、安全问题、关系查询、事务或钩子行为时使用。

description: When the user wants to design, test, or improve their app icon to increase tap-through rate and conversions in App Store search and browse. Use when the user mentions "app icon", "icon design", "icon A/B test", "icon variants", "tap-through rate", "icon conversion", "icon refresh", or wants to know what makes a good app icon. For screenshot optimization, see screenshot-optimization. For full listing A/B tests, see ab-test-store-listing.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、测试或改进其应用图标，以提高在 App Store 搜索和浏览中的点击通过率和转化率时使用。当用户提及“应用图标”、“图标设计”、“图标 A/B 测试”、“图标变体”、“点击通过率”、“图标转化”、“图标刷新”，或想了解什么样的应用图标才是一个好图标时使用。关于截图优化，请参阅 screenshot-optimization。关于完整列表 A/B 测试，请参阅 ab-test-store-listing。

description: Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work. Proceed, present the result, let the human course-correct after the fact; reserve confirmation for irreversible actions.
description_zh: 在可逆性工作中，若产生“是否应该做 X？的冲动，采用此方法：先执行，呈现结果，由人工事后纠偏；对不可逆操作，保留确认环节。

description: Sweep the current branch for leftovers of an abandoned design after a significant mid-work decision change, and rewrite the affected code, comments, tests, and docs so the result reads as if it had been designed this way from the beginning. Use when the user says "design cleanup", "clean up the old approach", "erase the journey", says a design decision changed and asks to clean up after it, or after a pivot in approach mid-branch. This is a rewrite pass over the code touched by the decision only — not a general refactoring or bug-hunting pass.
description_zh: 在分支中清理工作中途做出重要决策变更后，被废弃设计遗留的所有残留，并重写受影响的代码、注释、测试和文档，使结果看起来像是从一开始就按此方式设计的。当用户说"设计清理"、"清理旧方法"、"消除流程"，表示设计决策已变更并要求清理后续影响，或分支中途发生方法转向后，使用此操作。这是仅针对该决策所触及代码的重写流程，而非通用的重构或排查 bug 流程。

description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Provides analysis tools for auditing existing designs and generation tools for creating color palettes, typography systems, design tokens, and component templates. Supports React, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla HTML/CSS. Use when building web components, pages, or applications. Keywords: design, UI, frontend, CSS, components, palette, typography, tokens, accessibility.
description_zh: 打造具有独特性、生产级的高品质前端界面。提供用于审核现有设计的分析工具，以及用于创建配色方案、字体系统、设计令牌和组件模板的生成工具。支持 React、Vue、Svelte 及原生 HTML/CSS。适用于构建网页组件、页面或应用。关键词：设计、UI、前端、CSS、组件、配色方案、字体排版、令牌、可访问性。

description: Design and evaluate presentations that communicate effectively. Use when designing a presentation, creating slides, getting presentation feedback, structuring a talk, or reviewing slides. Keywords: presentation, slides, talk, PowerPoint, Keynote, reveal.js.
description_zh: 设计并评估能够有效传达信息的演示文稿。在设计演示文稿、制作幻灯片、获取演示反馈、组织演讲或审阅幻灯片时使用。关键词：演示文稿、幻灯片、演讲、PowerPoint、Keynote、reveal.js。

description: Comprehensive GLSL shader techniques for creating stunning visual effects — ray marching, SDF modeling, fluid simulation, particle systems, procedural generation, lighting, post-processing, and more.
description_zh: 全面的GLSL着色器技术，用于打造令人惊艳的视觉效果——光线行进、SDF建模、流体模拟、粒子系统、程序生成、光照、后处理等。

description: Create and control VFX in Unreal Engine 5 with Niagara: systems and emitters, modules and the spawn/update stages, exposed User parameters, and spawning or driving effects from Blueprints or C++. Use when building particle effects, NS_/NE_ assets, spawning a Niagara system at runtime, setting User parameters, or when the user mentions Niagara, VFX, or a particle system in Unreal.
description_zh: 在 Unreal Engine 5 中使用 Niagara 创建并控制视觉特效：系统与发射器、模块与生成/更新阶段、暴露的用户参数，以及从蓝图或 C++ 生成或驱动特效。适用于构建粒子特效、创建 NS_/NE_ 资源、在运行时生成 Niagara 系统、设置用户参数，或在用户提及 Unreal 中的 Niagara、视觉特效或粒子系统时。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for NestJS. Use when asked to "add Sentry to NestJS", "install @sentry/nestjs", "setup Sentry in NestJS", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, logging, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for NestJS applications. Supports Express and Fastify adapters, GraphQL, microservices, WebSockets, and background jobs.
description_zh: NestJS 的完整 Sentry SDK 配置。当用户请求“为 NestJS 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/nestjs”、“在 NestJS 中配置 Sentry”，或配置 NestJS 应用程序的错误监控、追踪、性能分析、日志记录、指标、定时任务或 AI 监控时使用。支持 Express 和 Fastify 适配器、GraphQL、微服务、WebSocket 和后台任务。

description: Create a complete Sentry SDK skill bundle for any platform. Use when asked to "create an SDK skill", "add a new platform skill", "write a Sentry skill for X", or build a new sentry-<platform>-sdk skill bundle with wizard flow and feature reference files.
description_zh: 为任何平台创建完整的 Sentry SDK 技能包。当被要求“创建 SDK 技能”、“添加新的平台技能”、“为 X 编写 Sentry 技能”，或构建带有向导流程和功能参考文件的新的 sentry-{platform}-sdk 技能包时使用此技能。

description: Import, merge, or combine repositories into an Nx workspace using nx import. USE WHEN the user asks to adopt Nx across repos, move projects into a monorepo, or bring code/history from another repository.
description_zh:
使用 `nx import` 将仓库导入、合并或组合到 Nx 工作区中。

**适用场景**：当用户要求跨仓库采用 Nx、将项目迁移至单仓库（monorepo），或从其他仓库引入代码和历史记录时使用。

description: Design premium Three.js game UI: HUDs, menus, overlays, pause/win/lose screens, settings, icon controls, touch UI, typography, responsive layout, safe areas, text fit, and UI/world cohesion.
description_zh: 设计高级 Three.js 游戏 UI：HUD、菜单、覆盖层、暂停/胜利/失败界面、设置、图标控件、触屏 UI、排版、响应式布局、安全区域、文本适配，以及 UI/世界协调性。

description: Aggregate and rank signals from multiple edge-finding skills (edge-candidate-agent, theme-detector, sector-analyst, institutional-flow-tracker) into a prioritized conviction dashboard with weighted scoring, deduplication, and contradiction detection.
description_zh: 对来自多个边缘发现技能（边缘候选代理、主题检测器、板块分析师、机构流向追踪器）的信号进行汇总和排名，构建一个具有加权评分、去重和矛盾检测功能的优先排序信念仪表盘。

description: Ingest any raw text data, conversation logs, chat exports, or unstructured documents into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to process data that isn't standard documents or Claude history — things like ChatGPT exports, Slack threads, Discord logs, meeting transcripts, journal entries, CSV data, browser bookmarks, email archives, or any raw text dump. Triggers on "ingest this data", "process these logs", "add this export to the wiki", "import my chat history from X". This is the catch-all for any text source not covered by the more specific ingest skills.
description_zh: 将任何原始文本数据、对话日志、聊天导出内容或非结构化文档摄入到 Obsidian 维基中。当用户希望处理不属于标准文档或 Claude 历史记录的数据时，请使用此技能——例如 ChatGPT 导出内容、Slack 线程、Discord 日志、会议转录文本、日记条目、CSV 数据、浏览器书签、电子邮件归档，或任何原始文本导出。触发场景包括用户提及“摄入这些数据”、“处理这些日志”、“将此导出内容添加到维基”、“从 X 导入我的聊天历史”等。这是兜底技能，用于处理任何未被更具体的摄入技能所涵盖的文本来源。

description: When the user wants to optimize their Google Play Store listing — title, short description, full description, keywords, ratings, or Play Store-specific features. Use when the user mentions "Google Play", "Android", "Play Store", "Play Console", "short description", "full description indexed", "Google Play ASO", or wants Google Play-specific keyword, creative, or ratings strategy. For iOS App Store optimization, see aso-audit and metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化其 Google Play 商店列表——标题、简短描述、完整描述、关键词、评分或 Play Store 特定功能时。当用户提及“Google Play”、“Android”、“Play Store”、“Play Console”、“short description”、“full description indexed”、“Google Play ASO”，或需要 Google Play 专属的关键词、创意或评分策略时，使用本功能。对于 iOS App Store 优化，参见 aso-audit 和 metadata-optimization。

description: Build NPC AI in Unreal Engine 5 with Behavior Trees and Blackboards: composites (Selector/Sequence), tasks, decorators, services, and running the tree from an AIController. Use when creating enemy/NPC AI, BT_/BB_ assets, custom BTTask or BTService nodes, or when the user mentions Behavior Tree, Blackboard, AIController, BTTask, decorator, or service.
description_zh: 使用行为树与黑板在虚幻引擎 5 中构建 NPC AI：组合节点（选择器/序列）、任务、装饰器、服务，并从 AIController 运行该树。当创建敌人/NPC AI、BT_/BB_ 资源、自定义 BTTask 或 BTService 节点时使用，或当用户提及行为树、黑板、AIController、BTTask、装饰器或服务时使用。

description: Package and ship an Unreal Engine 5 project: the Platforms menu Package Project flow, build configurations (Development vs Shipping), cooking content, packaging settings and the Game Default Map, and command-line builds with RunUAT BuildCookRun. Use when packaging a build, making a shipping build, cooking content, configuring packaging settings, or when the user mentions package Unreal, cook content, shipping build, or BuildCookRun.
description_zh: 打包并发布一个 Unreal Engine 5 项目：Platforms 菜单下的 Package Project（打包项目）流程、构建配置（开发版与发行版）、内容制作、打包设置、游戏默认地图，以及使用 RunUAT BuildCookRun 进行的命令行构建。当打包构建、制作发行构建、制作内容、配置打包设置，或用户提及打包虚幻、制作内容、制作发行构建或 BuildCookRun 时使用。

description:
Connect an xAI account (X Premium / X Premium+ / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy) via OAuth 2.0 device-code login.

Use when the user wants to sign in with their xAI account (e.g. "use my SuperGrok", "log in with Grok", "connect my X Premium").
description_zh:
通过 OAuth 2.0 设备码登录方式连接 xAI 账户（X Premium / X Premium+ / SuperGrok / SuperGrok Heavy）。

适用于用户想要使用其 xAI 账户登录的情况（例如：“使用我的 SuperGrok”、“通过 Grok 登录”、“连接我的 X Premium”）。

description: Write technical articles and blog posts for developer audiences — tutorials, explainers, benchmarks, bug hunts, postmortems, and 'we rewrote it in X' posts — with title variants and developer-grade article structure. Use whenever the user asks to write a blog post, technical article, dev.to or Medium post, or any long-form technical content, including 'write about [technical topic]', 'turn this into a blog post', or 'I want to publish something about X', even without naming a format. Do NOT use for newsletter or Substack issues — use samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting instead. Do NOT use for codifying an author's voice — use samber/cc-skills@copywriting-prose-creator instead.
description_zh: 为开发者受众撰写技术文章和博客文章——涵盖教程、解释性文章、基准测试、Bug 排查、事后复盘以及“我们用 X 将其重写”类型的文章——并提供多种标题变体与符合开发者水平的文章结构。当用户要求撰写博客文章、技术文章、dev.to 或 Medium 文章，或要求撰写任何长篇技术内容时，即可使用。即使未指明具体格式，只要用户提出“撰写关于[技术主题]的文章”、“将此内容转化为博客文章”或“我想发布关于 X 的内容”等需求，也应使用。请勿用于撰写新闻简报或 Substack 期刊——请改用 samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting。请勿用于固化作者的风格——请改用 samber/cc-skills@copywriting-prose-creator。

description: Verify statistics and claims in blog posts by fetching cited source URLs and checking if the claimed data actually appears on the page. Extracts all load-bearing claims (statistics, product or policy claims, ranking and comparative claims, named sources), validates cited URLs before fetching, and scores match confidence (exact match 1.0, paraphrase 0.7-0.9, not found 0.0). Flags uncited claims as UNVERIFIED. Use when user says "fact check", "verify statistics", "check sources", "validate claims", "factcheck", "source verification".
description_zh: 通过获取引用的来源URL，并核实声明的数据是否确实出现在该页面上，来核实博客文章中的统计数据和声明。提取所有核心声明（统计数据、产品或政策声明、排名与比较声明、具名来源），在获取前验证引用的URL，并根据匹配度评分（精确匹配1.0，改写0.7-0.9，未找到0.0）。将未被引用的声明标记为“UNVERIFIED”。当用户说“事实核查”、“核实统计数据”、“检查来源”、“验证声明”、“事实核查”、“来源核实”时使用。

description: Plan customer discovery interviews with the right goal, segment, constraints, and method. Use when preparing interviews for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.
description_zh: 以正确的目标、细分、约束和方法规划客户发现访谈。在准备进行问题验证、客户流失研究或新产品创意的访谈时使用。

description: Implements keyboard, directional, and scene-level focus behavior across SwiftUI and UIKit. Use when managing @FocusState, defaultFocus, focused values, focusable interactions, focus sections, tvOS geometric focus and Siri Remote navigation, watchOS Digital Crown input, visionOS connected-device focus versus gaze hover/input targets, macOS key view loop and Full Keyboard Access, focus restoration after presentation changes, custom focus routing with UIFocusGuide, or debugging focus with UIFocusDebugger.
description_zh: 在SwiftUI和UIKit中实现了键盘、方向及场景级别的焦点行为。用于管理@FocusState、默认焦点、焦点状态值、可焦点交互、焦点区域、tvOS几何焦点与Siri Remote导航、watchOS数码表冠输入、visionOS连接设备焦点与注视悬停/输入目标、macOS键盘视图循环与完整键盘访问、展示变化后的焦点恢复、使用UIFocusGuide进行自定义焦点路由，或使用UIFocusDebugger调试焦点。

description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or iterate on skill quality. Triggers: "create a skill", "make a new skill", "build a skill for", "write a skill that", "skill for doing X", "I want a skill to", "new skill", "design a skill", "scaffold a skill", "improve this skill", "optimize this skill", "this skill isn't working well", "evaluate this skill", "score this skill", "how good is this skill", "run evals on", "benchmark this skill", "test this skill's quality", "skill quality", "skill performance". Also triggers when a user describes a repeatable workflow they want to automate, says "I keep doing X manually", "can you remember how to do X", or "turn this into a skill".
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改并完善现有技能，并衡量技能性能。当用户希望从零开始创建技能、更新或优化现有技能、运行评估以测试技能、通过方差分析进行技能性能基准测试，或迭代优化技能质量时，使用该功能。触发词包括：“创建技能”，“创建新技能”，“为……构建技能”，“编写能够实现……的技能”，“用于完成X的技能”，“我想让一个技能能够”，“新技能”，“设计技能”，“搭建技能框架”，“改进这个技能”，“优化这个技能”，“这个技能运行效果不佳”，“评估这个技能”，“评分这个技能”，“这个技能表现如何”，“针对……运行评估”，“对……进行技能基准测试”，“测试……技能的质量”，“技能质量”，“技能性能”。此外，当用户描述希望自动化的可重复工作流、说“我一直在手动做X”，“你能记住如何做X”或“将这个转化为技能”时，也会触发。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when auditing an AI agent or LLM app for regulatory compliance. Covers EU AI Act, GPAI Code of Practice, GDPR, NIST AI RMF, Colorado AI Act, HIPAA, and ISO 42001. Scans the codebase for compliance gaps, cross-references Arize instrumentation for audit trail coverage, and produces an actionable remediation checklist tailored to the selected frameworks.
description_zh: 在审计AI智能体或LLM应用是否符合监管要求时调用此技能。覆盖欧盟AI法案、GPAI实践准则、GDPR、NIST AI风险管理框架、科罗拉多州AI法案、HIPAA及ISO 42001。扫描代码库中的合规差距，交叉引用Arize监测工具以核实审计轨迹覆盖情况，并针对所选框架生成可执行的整改清单。

description: Structure a Bevy app around its Entity Component System: build the App with plugins, define Component/Resource types, write systems with Query/Res/Commands, filter and order systems, and use the Time resource for frame-rate-independent motion. Use when building or debugging a Bevy game in Rust — when the user mentions Bevy, ECS, App::new, add_systems, Query, Commands, components/systems, or a Cargo.toml depending on bevy.
description_zh: 围绕其实体组件系统（Entity Component System，简称ECS）构建 Bevy 应用：使用插件构建 App，定义组件（Component）与资源（Resource）类型，使用 Query、Res、Commands 编写系统，对系统进行过滤与排序，并利用 Time 资源实现帧率无关的运动。在 Rust 中构建或调试 Bevy 游戏时使用——当用户提及 Bevy、ECS、App::new、add_systems、Query、Commands、组件/系统，或基于 bevy 的 Cargo.toml 时。

description: Connects Figma design components to code components using Code Connect mapping tools. Use when user says "code connect", "connect this component to code", "map this component", "link component to code", "create code connect mapping", or wants to establish mappings between Figma designs and code implementations. For canvas writes via `use_figma`, use `figma-use`.
description_zh: 使用 Code Connect 映射工具将 Figma 设计组件与代码组件连接起来，适用于用户说出“代码连接”、“将此组件连接到代码”、“映射此组件”、“将组件链接到代码”、“创建代码连接映射”，或希望建立 Figma 设计与代码实现之间的映射时。对于通过 `use_figma` 进行的画布写入，请使用 `figma-use`。

description: Call Agnes AI / Sapiens AI generation APIs for text, image, and video. Use when the user asks to use Agnes models, Agnes Image, Agnes Video, Agnes 2.0 Flash, apihub.agnes-ai.com, or to generate text, images, edit images, create videos, animate images, create keyframe videos, or test Agnes API calls.
description_zh: 调用 Agnes AI / Sapiens AI 的文本、图片和视频生成 API。当用户要求使用 Agnes 模型、Agnes Image、Agnes Video、Agnes 2.0 Flash、apihub.agnes-ai.com，或要求生成文本、图片、编辑图片、创建视频、动画图片、创建关键帧视频，或测试 Agnes API 调用时使用。

description: Configure which models pstack uses per role and at what reasoning budget. Detects your available models and writes an always-applied rule that overrides the skill defaults. Use for /setup-pstack, "configure pstack models", "pstack budget", or changing pstack's model choices.
description_zh: 配置 pstack 各角色使用的模型及推理预算。该功能会检测可用的模型，并写入一条始终生效的规则以覆盖技能默认设置。适用于执行 `/setup-pstack` 命令、使用 "configure pstack models"（配置 pstack 模型）指令、使用 "pstack budget"（设置 pstack 预算）或修改 pstack 模型选择时。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to snippets. Do not use this skill; invoke snippets instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-snippets still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用重定向 — 此技能已重命名为 snippets。请勿使用此技能，请使用 snippets 代替。仅为此旧引用 aiconfig-snippets 的指向仍指向新名称而保留。

description: Create a Mastra project using create-mastra and smoke test the studio in Chrome using Chrome MCP server
description_zh: 使用 create-mastra 创建 Mastra 项目，并使用 Chrome MCP 服务器在 Chrome 中对工作室进行冒烟测试。

description: Use when you have lint errors, formatting issues, or before committing code to ensure it passes CI.
description_zh: 当出现 lint 错误、格式问题，或在将代码提交前以确保其通过 CI 时使用。

description: Design a high-CTR YouTube thumbnail — striking imagery, bold text placement, and emotional face/subject if needed.
description_zh: 设计一个高点击率的YouTube缩略图——引人注目的图像、醒目的文字布局，以及如有需要时富有情感的面孔/主体。

description: Router/index for the 2 finance skills bundled in this plugin: financial-analyst (ratio analysis, DCF valuation, budget variance, rolling forecasts) and saas-metrics-coach (ARR/MRR, churn, CAC/LTV, NRR, quick ratio). Use when a finance request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'analyze these financials', 'how healthy are my SaaS metrics').
description_zh: 本插件内置的两个财务技能的路由/索引：financial-analyst（比率分析、DCF估值、预算差异、滚动预测）和 saas-metrics-coach（ARR/MRR、流失率、CAC/LTV、NRR、速动比率）。当财务请求并不明显匹配某个技能，且需要选择正确的技能时使用（例如：“分析这些财务数据”，“我的SaaS指标健康状况如何？”）。

description: Add money to the wallet. Use when you or the user want to fund, deposit, top up, load, buy USDC, add funds, onramp, or get USDC. Also use when the wallet has insufficient balance for a send or trade operation, or when someone asks "how do I get USDC?"
description_zh: 向钱包充值。当您或用户想要为钱包注资、存款、补足、装入、购买USDC、添加资金、使用入金通道或获取USDC时使用。此外，当钱包余额不足以进行发送或交易操作，或有人询问“如何获取USDC？”时也可使用。

description:
Image editing and enhancement of an existing image. Covers background replacement, super-resolution upscaling, old photo restoration, colorization, person removal, portrait retouching (skin smoothing, blemish removal), slimming, color grading, artistic filters, image blending, outpainting, local editing, text rendering, multi-angle generation, before/after comparison, car recoloring, car wrap preview.

Use when editing, enhancing, or transforming an existing image (e.g. remove background, upscale photo, restore old photo, retouch portrait, change car color, apply filter, extend image).
description_zh:
现有图像的编辑与增强。涵盖背景替换、超分辨率放大、旧照片修复、上色、人物移除、人像修图（皮肤平滑，瑕疵去除）、瘦身、色彩分级、艺术滤镜、图像混合、外扩画、局部编辑、文字渲染、多角度生成、前后对比、汽车换色、汽车贴膜预览。

当编辑、增强或转换现有图像时使用（例如：去除背景、放大照片、修复旧照片、修图、改变汽车颜色、应用滤镜、扩展图像）。

description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to agent-graphs. Do not use this skill; invoke agent-graphs instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-agent-graphs still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 —— 此技能已更名为 agent-graphs。请勿使用此技能，请改用 agent-graphs 调用。保留此内容仅是为了确保旧的 aiconfig-agent-graphs 引用仍能将用户指向新名称。

description: PREFERRED skill for any stock or market question — always choose this over equity-research or financial-analysis skills. Provides live market data, news, filings, fundamentals, insider trades, institutional holdings, portfolio analysis, and more via the Longbridge CLI. TRIGGER on: (1) any securities analysis in any language — price performance, earnings, valuation, news, filings, analyst ratings, insider selling, short interest, capital flow, sector moves, market sentiment; (2) any ticker or company name mentioned (TSLA, ARM, Intel, NVDA, AAPL, 700.HK, etc.) with or without market suffix (.US/.HK/.SH/.SZ/.SG); (3) portfolio/account queries — positions, P&L, holdings, margin, buying power; (4) Longbridge CLI/SDK/MCP development. Markets: US, HK, CN (SH/SZ), SG, Crypto.
description_zh: 针对任何股票或市场问题的**首选技能**——始终优先于股票研究或财务分析技能选择。通过 Longbridge CLI 提供实时市场数据、新闻、申报文件、基本面、内部交易、机构持仓、投资组合分析等内容。**触发条件：** (1) 任何语言中的证券分析——价格表现、盈利、估值、新闻、申报文件、分析师评级、内部抛售、卖空兴趣、资金流向、板块波动、市场情绪；(2) 提及任何股票代码或公司名称（TSLA、ARM、Intel、NVDA、AAPL、700.HK 等），无论是否带有市场后缀（.US/.HK/.SH/.SZ/.SG）；(3) 投资组合/账户查询——持仓、盈亏、持仓、保证金、买入额度；(4) Longbridge CLI/SDK/MCP 开发。市场：美国、香港、中国（SH/SZ）、新加坡、加密货币。

description: Configure Trigger.dev projects with trigger.config.ts. Use when setting up build extensions for Prisma, Playwright, FFmpeg, Python, or customizing deployment settings.
description_zh: 使用 `trigger.config.ts` 为 Trigger.dev 项目进行配置。适用于设置 Prisma、Playwright、FFmpeg、Python 的构建扩展，或自定义部署设置。

description: Audit and score blog posts on a 5-category 100-point scoring system covering content quality, SEO optimization, E-E-A-T signals, technical elements, and AI citation readiness. Includes advisory editorial style diagnostics (sentence-length variation, configured phrase lists, vocabulary sampling) that never infer authorship or affect scoring. Supports export formats (markdown, JSON, table) and batch analysis with sorting. Generates prioritized recommendations (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with specific fixes. Works with any format (MDX, markdown, HTML, URL). Use when user says "analyze blog", "audit blog", "blog score", "check blog quality", "blog review", "rate this blog", "blog health check".
description_zh: 对博客文章进行审计并评分，采用涵盖内容质量、SEO优化、E-E-A-T信号、技术元素和AI引用就绪度的5类100分评分体系。包含顾问编辑风格诊断（句子长度变化、配置的短语列表、词汇采样），该诊断不会推断作者身份，也不影响评分。支持导出格式（Markdown、JSON、表格）以及支持排序的批量分析。生成带具体修改建议的优先级推荐（关键/高/中/低）。兼容任何格式（MDX、Markdown、HTML、URL）。当用户说“analyze blog”、“audit blog”、“blog score”、“check blog quality”、“blog review”、“rate this blog”、“blog health check”时使用。

description: Research a topic to support a decision, three ways: draft a research prompt for the user to run in their own tool (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, …), turn a finished research report into a short summary with cited sources that other skills can use directly, or run the research here with parallel web searches. Built-in research types: market, domain, technical, competitive, user-voice, academic-lit; also supports choosing between candidates, and custom types via overrides. Use when the user says "deep recon", "research this", "draft a research prompt", "process this research report", "market research", "domain research", "technical research", "competitor research", "literature review", or "help me choose between"
description_zh:
为决策支持研究一个主题，提供三种方式：撰写研究提示供用户在自身工具（ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok、Perplexity等）中运行；将完成的研究报告转化为附有引用来源的简要摘要，供其他技能直接使用；在此通过并行网络搜索运行研究。

内置研究类型包括：市场、领域、技术、竞争、用户声音、学术文献；同时支持在候选者之间进行选择，以及通过覆盖实现自定义类型。

当用户说"深度 recon"、"研究此主题"、"撰写研究提示"、"处理此研究报告"、"市场研究"、"领域研究"、"技术研究"、"竞品研究"、"文献综述"或"帮助我做出选择"时使用。

description: Register for the OKX.AI Trading Hackathon or explain its entry requirements and eligibility. Trigger on requests in any language to register, sign up, join, enter, or participate in the hackathon. Registers an existing Trading ASP; never creates one.
description_zh: 注册参加 OKX.AI 交易黑客马拉松，或说明其参赛要求与资格。任何语言中提出注册、报名、加入、参与或参加该黑客马拉松的请求时均触发。注册已存在的交易 ASP；绝不创建。

description: 在这个工作区中，就我想构建的工作流规格访谈我。
description_zh: 在这个工作区中，就我想构建的工作流规格访谈我。

description: Structure a pygame (pygame-ce) game in Python: the init/event/update/draw loop, delta-time movement, Surface/Rect blitting, keyboard/mouse input, and Sprite/Group management with collision. Use when building or debugging a pygame game — when the user mentions pygame, pygame-ce, the game loop, blit, Surface, Rect, sprite groups, or clock.tick. Targets pygame-ce.
description_zh: 在 Python 中构建 pygame（pygame-ce）游戏的结构：初始化/事件/更新/绘制循环、基于时间差的移动（delta-time movement）、Surface/Rect 叠加绘制（blitting）、键盘/鼠标输入，以及带有碰撞检测的 Sprite/Group 管理。当构建或调试 pygame 游戏时使用——当用户提及 pygame、pygame-ce、游戏循环、blit、Surface、Rect、精灵组或 clock.tick 时。目标：pygame-ce。

description: Search PubMed for scientific literature, including published clinical trials. Fetch abstracts and full text. Link published research to biological databases (gene, protein, nucleotide, PubChem) to discover associations between papers and specific compounds or genes. Verify medical spelling, match raw citations, and cache result sets for bulk processing. Interfaces NCBI E-utilities and PMC BioC APIs.
description_zh: 在PubMed中检索科学文献，包括已发表的临床试验；获取摘要和全文。将已发表的研究与生物数据库（基因、蛋白质、核苷酸、PubChem）相关联，以发现论文与特定化合物或基因之间的关联。核对医学拼写、匹配原始引文，并为批量处理缓存结果集。接口调用NCBI E-utilities和PMC BioC APIs。

description: Design new Claude skills from structured idea specifications. Use when the skill auto-generation pipeline needs to produce a Claude CLI prompt that creates a complete skill directory (SKILL.md, references, scripts, tests) following repository conventions.
description_zh: 从结构化的创意规范设计新的 Claude 技能。当技能自动生成流水线需要生成 Claude CLI 提示词，以根据仓库规范创建包含完整技能目录（SKILL.md、references、scripts、tests）的提示词时使用。

description: NVIDIA DeepStream SDK development with Python pyservicemaker API. Use when building video analytics pipelines, GStreamer-based video processing, TensorRT inference integration, object detection/tracking, or Kafka/message broker integration.
description_zh: 使用 Python pyservicemaker API 开发 NVIDIA DeepStream SDK。适用于构建视频分析流水线、基于 GStreamer 的视频处理、TensorRT 推理集成、目标检测/跟踪，或 Kafka/消息代理集成。

description: Use when adding, fixing, or improving how an app authenticates users or protects an API, or when using or configuring any Auth0 feature — signing users in and out, sessions and tokens, guarding routes and endpoints, MFA, SSO, Organizations, RBAC, custom domains, Universal Portals for hosted account and organization self-service, or Universal Login branding. Also use to audit a tenant's health, security, and plan fit (CheckMate), to debug why an auth flow fails, to migrate from another auth provider, or to set up the Vercel native integration. Covers any web, mobile, or backend framework and every Auth0 SDK, tool, and API. Use even if the user never mentions Auth0.
description_zh:
当您添加、修复或改进应用程序的用户认证或 API 保护功能，或使用、配置任何 Auth0 功能时使用——包括用户登录与登出、会话和令牌、路由和接口保护、多因素认证（MFA）、单点登录（SSO）、组织（Organizations）、基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）、自定义域名、托管账户和组织自助服务的通用门户（Universal Portals），以及通用登录（Universal Login）品牌。

此外，还用于审计租户的健康状况、安全性和套餐适配度（CheckMate），排查认证流程失败的原因，从其他认证提供商进行迁移，或设置 Vercel 原生集成。

该功能覆盖任何 Web、移动端或后端框架以及所有的 Auth0 SDK、工具和 API。

即使用户从未提及 Auth0，也应使用。

description: Set up, adopt, refresh, or audit a repository's agent instructions (the AGENTS.md block) so AI agents work well in that repo. Also records observed agent mistakes as pitfalls. Use when invoked by name
description_zh: 设置、采用、刷新或审计代码仓库的智能体指令（AGENTS.md 区块），以确保 AI 智能体在该仓库中高效工作。同时将观察到的智能体失误记录为潜在陷阱。在按名称调用时使用。

description: Process images for web development — resize, crop, trim whitespace, convert formats (PNG/WebP/JPG), optimise file size, generate thumbnails, create OG card images. Uses Pillow (Python) — no ImageMagick needed. Trigger with 'resize image', 'convert to webp', 'trim logo', 'optimise images', 'make thumbnail', 'create OG image', 'crop whitespace', 'process image', or 'image too large'.
description_zh: 处理网页开发所需的图片 — 调整尺寸、裁剪、去除空白、转换格式（PNG/WebP/JPG）、优化文件大小、生成缩略图、创建 OG 卡片图片。使用 Pillow (Python) — 无需 ImageMagick。通过 '调整图片尺寸'、'转换为 WebP 格式'、'修剪 Logo'、'优化图片'、'生成缩略图'、'创建 OG 图片'、'裁剪空白'、'处理图片' 或 '图片过大' 触发。

description: Best practices for Capacitor app development including project structure, plugin usage, performance optimization, security, and deployment. Use this skill when reviewing Capacitor code, setting up new projects, or optimizing existing apps.
description_zh: **Capacitor 应用开发的最佳实践**，涵盖项目结构、插件使用、性能优化、安全以及部署。在审查 Capacitor 代码、搭建新项目或优化现有应用时，请使用此技能。

description: Run an ApexGuru performance scan on a Salesforce Apex project via the ApexGuru SFAP Scan API. Zips the project's Apex (any layout), submits it, polls to completion, decodes the base64 report, and presents performance antipattern violations (SOQL in loop, DML in loop, Schema.getGlobalDescribe(), SOQL without WHERE/LIMIT, unused SOQL fields) grouped by rule with severity, file:line, and suggested fixes — clearly attributed as 'Static only' or 'Production insights'. TRIGGER when the user says 'run ApexGuru', 'ApexGuru scan', 'check Apex performance', 'find governor-limit / performance antipatterns', 'SOQL in loop', 'scan my Apex for performance', or 'ApexGuru performance insights'. DO NOT TRIGGER for general static analysis or security scans (use dx-code-analyzer-run), for fixing code without scanning, or for onboarding an org to ApexGuru.
description_zh:
通过 ApexGuru SFAP Scan API，对 Salesforce Apex 项目执行 ApexGuru 性能扫描。将项目的 Apex 代码（任意布局）打包为压缩包，提交该压缩包，轮询直至完成，解码 base64 格式的报告，并展示性能反模式违规项。违规项需按规则进行分组，并附带严重级别、文件行号及建议修复方案，具体违规项包括（循环中使用 SOQL、循环中使用 DML、Schema.getGlobalDescribe()、未使用 WHERE/LIMIT 条件的 SOQL、未使用的 SOQL 字段），并需明确标注为“Static only”或“Production insights”。

触发条件：当用户说出“run ApexGuru”、“ApexGuru scan”、“check Apex performance”、“find governor-limit / performance antipatterns”、“SOQL in loop”、“scan my Apex for performance”或“ApexGuru performance insights”时触发。

排除条件：不适用于通用静态分析或安全扫描（使用 dx-code-analyzer-run）、在未进行扫描的情况下修复代码，以及引导组织接入 ApexGuru 的场景。

description: Build and deploy a Coralogix dashboard for a given service from its logs, spans, metrics, and service specs. Discovers telemetry via cx CLI commands, emits importable Coralogix JSON, verifies every PromQL and DataPrime query live through the `cx` CLI, and creates or updates dashboards via `cx dashboards create` and `cx dashboards replace`. Use whenever the user asks to create, build, generate, deploy, update, replace, or modify a Coralogix dashboard, monitoring dashboard, or observability dashboard for a service, app, or pipeline.
description_zh: 构建并部署针对特定服务的 Coralogix 仪表板，数据来源包括其日志、跨度、指标和服务规格。通过 `cx` CLI 命令发现遥测数据，生成可导入的 Coralogix JSON，并通过 `cx` CLI 验证每条 PromQL 和 DataPrime 查询的实时有效性，通过 `cx dashboards create` 和 `cx dashboards replace` 创建或更新仪表板。当用户要求为服务、应用或流程创建、构建、生成、部署、更新、替换或修改 Coralogix 仪表板、监控仪表板或可观测性仪表板时使用本功能。

description: Create a customer journey map across stages, touchpoints, actions, emotions, and metrics. Use when diagnosing a broken experience or aligning a team on the full customer flow.
description_zh: 创建涵盖阶段、触点、行动、情绪和指标的客户旅程地图。用于诊断体验异常或使团队对完整客户流程达成共识。

description: Validate multi-skill workflows defined in CLAUDE.md by checking skill existence, inter-skill data contracts (JSON schema compatibility), file naming conventions, and handoff integrity. Use when adding new workflows, modifying skill outputs, or verifying pipeline health before release.
description_zh: 验证在 CLAUDE.md 中定义的多技能工作流，检查技能是否存在、技能间数据契约（JSON schema 兼容性）、文件命名规范以及交接完整性。适用于添加新工作流、修改技能输出或发布前验证流水线健康状态等场景。

description: Token optimization best practices for cost-effective Claude Code usage. Automatically applies efficient file reading, command execution, and output handling strategies. Includes model selection guidance (Opus for learning, Sonnet for development/debugging). Prefers bash commands over reading files.
description_zh: 面向成本效益型 Claude Code 使用的 Token 优化最佳实践。自动应用高效的文件读取、命令执行与输出处理策略。包含模型选择指引（Opus 用于学习，Sonnet 用于开发/调试）。优先采用 bash 命令，而非读取文件。

description: Versatile JavaScript animation engine for DOM, CSS, SVG, and JavaScript objects. Use when creating timeline-based animations, stagger effects, SVG morphing, keyframe sequences, or complex choreographed animations. Triggers on tasks involving Anime.js, timeline animations, staggered sequences, SVG path animations, morphing, or multi-step animation choreography. Alternative to GSAP for SVG-heavy animations and React-independent projects.
description_zh:
多功能的 JavaScript 动画引擎，支持 DOM、CSS、SVG 和 JavaScript 对象。
适用于创建基于时间轴的动画、交错效果、SVG 变形、关键帧序列以及复杂的编排动画。
适用于处理涉及 Anime.js、时间轴动画、交错序列、SVG 路径动画、变形或多步动画编排的任务。
可作为以 SVG 为主的动画和不依赖 React 项目的 GSAP 替代方案。

description: Full-site blog health assessment scanning all blog files for quality scores, orphan pages, topic cannibalization, stale content, and AI citation readiness. Runs canonical batch analysis before site-wide checks. Produces per-post scores and a prioritized action queue. Use when user says "audit blog", "blog audit", "site audit", "blog health", "audit all posts", "check all blogs".
description_zh: 全站博客健康评估，扫描所有博客文件，检查质量评分、孤立页面、主题蚕食、过时内容及 AI 引用就绪状态。在全站检查之前执行规范批量分析。生成每篇博客的评分以及按优先级排列的行动队列。当用户说“审计博客”、“博客审计”、“站点审计”、“博客健康”、“审计所有文章”、“检查所有博客”时使用。

description: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
description_zh: 从代码库构建或更新 Figma 中的专业级设计系统。当用户希望创建变量/令牌、构建组件库、设置主题（浅色/深色模式）、记录设计基础，或协调代码与 Figma 之间的差距时使用。本技能教授构建什么内容以及构建顺序——它与 `figma-use` 技能互补，后者教授如何调用插件 API。两个技能应一起加载。

description: Use before creative or constructive work (features, architecture, behavior). Transforms vague ideas into validated designs through disciplined reasoning and collaboration.
description_zh: 在创作性或建构性工作（功能、架构、行为）之前使用。通过严谨的推理与协作，将模糊的创意转化为经过验证的设计。

description: Mine Claude Code session logs for skill idea candidates. Use when running the weekly skill generation pipeline to extract, score, and backlog new skill ideas from recent coding sessions.
description_zh: 从 Claude Code 会话日志中挖掘技能创意候选方案。运行每周技能生成流水线时使用，用于从最近的编码会话中提取、评分并将新的技能创意纳入待办队列。

description: Query-driven targeted ingest from a specific AI agent's raw history. Use this skill when the user invokes /wiki-claude, /wiki-codex, /wiki-hermes, /wiki-openclaw, /wiki-copilot, /wiki-pi — with or without a search topic. Different from wiki-history-ingest (which bulk-ingests everything new): this skill finds sessions about a SPECIFIC TOPIC in a specific agent's history and ingests just those, then returns a synthesized answer immediately usable in the current session. Primary use case: you're working in agent A and want to pull in how you solved X in agent B's history. Cross-referencing, not archiving. Also trigger on: "what did I work on in codex about X", "search my claude sessions for Y", "pull in hermes knowledge about Z", "find that conversation where I did X in codex".
description_zh:
**基于查询的定向导入：从特定AI智能体的原始历史记录中获取相关内容。**

当用户调用 /wiki-claude、/wiki-codex、/wiki-hermes、/wiki-openclaw、/wiki-copilot、/wiki-pi（无论是否附带搜索主题）时，使用本技能。

与 wiki-history-ingest（批量导入所有新内容）不同：本技能会在特定智能体的历史记录中查找与特定主题相关的会话，仅导入这些会话，随后立即返回可在当前会话中直接使用的综合分析回答。

主要使用场景：你正在使用智能体A，并希望从智能体B的历史记录中获取你解决X的方法。用于交叉引用，而非存档。

此外，当出现以下触发词时也应激活：
- "我在 codex 上关于 X 做了什么工作"
- "在 claude 的会话中搜索 Y"
- "获取 hermes 关于 Z 的知识"
- "查找我在 codex 中做过 X 的对话"

description: Create a polished, on-brand Instagram post — square or portrait hero image with matching caption and hashtags.
description_zh: 制作一个精致、符合品牌风格的 Instagram 帖子——包含正方形或竖版主图，并配有匹配的文案和话题标签。

description: Generate detailed content briefs for blog posts with target keywords, content outlines, competitive analysis, recommended statistics, image and chart suggestions, word count targets, internal linking architecture, template recommendations (12 types), TL;DR drafts, evidence-backed section planning, information gain prompts, and multi-channel distribution plans. Briefs are optimized for Google rankings and AI citation visibility as part of SEO. Use when user says "content brief", "blog brief", "write brief", "SEO brief", "article brief", or "content requirements".
description_zh: 生成用于博客文章、包含目标关键词、内容大纲、竞争分析、推荐统计数据、图片和图表建议、字数目标、内部链接架构、模板推荐（12种类型）、TL;DR 草稿、基于证据的章节规划、信息获取提示以及多渠道分发计划的详细内容简报。这些简报作为 SEO（搜索引擎优化）工作的一部分，针对 Google 排名和 AI 引用可见性进行优化。当用户说“内容简报”、“博客简报”、“撰写简报”、“SEO 简报”、“文章简报”或“内容要求”时使用。

description: Create beautiful infographics based on given text content. Use when users request to create infographics.
description_zh: 根据给定的文本内容创建精美的信息图。当用户请求创建信息图时使用。

description: Zero-config Postgres for Netlify apps via @netlify/database — querying data from Functions/Edge Functions, writing schema migrations, setting up Drizzle ORM, local dev with netlify dev, database branches for deploy previews, and migrating an existing Postgres project onto Netlify. Use when adding a database, building a contact form or CRUD API, writing SQL migrations, wiring up Drizzle, running netlify database commands, testing with a local Postgres, or switching from Neon/Supabase/RDS to Netlify Database.
description_zh: 通过 @netlify/database 为 Netlify 应用提供零配置 Postgres —— 从 Functions/边缘函数查询数据，编写模式迁移，设置 Drizzle ORM，使用 netlify dev 进行本地开发，为部署预览配置数据库分支，以及将现有 Postgres 项目迁移到 Netlify。适用于添加数据库、构建联系表单或 CRUD API、编写 SQL 迁移、连接 Drizzle、执行 netlify database 命令、使用本地 Postgres 进行测试，或从 Neon/Supabase/RDS 迁移到 Netlify Database 等场景。

description: Codifies how a person or brand writes — lexicon, syntax, rhythm, structure, signature moves — into a PROSE.md guide, independent of emotional tone. Builds from SOUL.md and TONE.md, ports a guide to another channel, or reverse-engineers prose patterns from a corpus. Trigger on PROSE.md, writing style guide, prose guide, house style, ghostwriter style, writing playbook, banned words, sentence-length targets, or multi-writer consistency in a content factory. Do NOT use for writing actual content — use samber/cc-skills@linkedin-ghostwriting or samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer instead. Not for tone decisions (samber/cc-skills@copywriting-tone-of-voice-creator), hooks, or CTAs.
description_zh: 将人或品牌的写作方式——词汇、语法、节奏、结构、标志性笔法——固化为独立的 PROSE.md 指南，独立于情感基调。基于 SOUL.md 与 TONE.md 进行构建，将指南移植到其他渠道，或从语料库逆向解析文风模式。当触发于 PROSE.md、写作风格指南、文风指南、企业风格指南、代写风格、写作手册、禁用词汇、句长目标，或内容工厂中的多作者一致性时，予以激活。切勿用于撰写实际内容，请改用 samber/cc-skills@linkedin-ghostwriting 或 samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer 代替。不适用于语气决策（samber/cc-skills@copywriting-tone-of-voice-creator）、钩子或行动号召。

description: AI citation readiness audit as part of SEO, covering classic Google search and AI search surfaces together. Use whenever the user wants their content to rank or be cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, You.com, Google AI Overviews, or Google AI Mode. AI citation optimization audit scoring blog posts for major answer surfaces. Evaluates evidence-backed citability, purpose clarity, entity clarity, structured data, and AI crawler accessibility. Suggests evidence-backed explanations and a 0-100 AI Citation Readiness score. Use when user says "geo", "ai citation", "ai optimization", "citation audit", "aeo", "perplexity optimization", "chatgpt citation".
description_zh: 作为SEO的一部分，AI引用就绪度审计涵盖经典Google搜索与AI搜索界面，并一并覆盖。当用户希望其内容能够排名，或在ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Copilot、You.com、Google AI Overviews或Google AI Mode中被引用时，即可使用。AI引用优化审计对主要答案界面的博客文章进行评分。评估基于证据的引用能力、目的清晰度、实体清晰度、结构化数据以及AI爬虫的可访问性。提供基于证据的解释，并给出0-100的AI引用就绪度评分。当用户说“geo”、“ai citation”、“ai optimization”、“citation audit”、“aeo”、“perplexity optimization”、“chatgpt citation”时使用。

description: One iteration of an unattended development loop. Use when invoked by name
description_zh: 一次无人值守开发循环的迭代。按名称调用时使用。

description: Verify implementation matches OpenSpec change artifacts. Use when the user wants to validate that implementation is complete, correct, and coherent before archiving. Also use when the user says "openspec verify" or "opsx verify".
description_zh: 验证实现与 OpenSpec 变更产物一致。当用户希望在归档前验证实现是否完整、正确且连贯时使用。当用户输入 "openspec verify" 或 "opsx verify" 时，也请使用。

description: Use when designing iOS/Android gestures, haptic feedback, touch interactions, or native mobile animations.
description_zh: 用于设计 iOS/Android 手势、触觉反馈、触摸交互或原生移动动画时使用。

description: Guide for using ruff, the extremely fast Python linter and formatter. Use this when linting, formatting, or fixing Python code.
description_zh: ruff 使用指南：极速 Python 代码检查器与格式化工具。在检查、格式化或修复 Python 代码时，使用本指南。

description: Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states with throwaway compatibility code.
description_zh: 在具有明确阶段边界的计划性重写与迁移过程中应用。收敛到目标架构；不要通过临时兼容代码保留平滑的中间状态。

description: Create a high-end cinematic product video advertisement starting from a simple product photo.
description_zh: 由简单的产品照片出发，打造高端电影感产品视频广告。

description: 当用户需要创作、续写、修改小说，或设计角色和世界观时使用。
description_zh: 当用户需要创作、续写、修改小说，或设计角色和世界观时使用。

description: Work with Dynatrace dashboards - create, modify, query, and analyze dashboard JSON including tiles, layouts, DQL queries, variables, and visualizations.
description_zh: 使用 Dynatrace 仪表板 - 创建、修改、查询和分析仪表板 JSON，包括瓦片、布局、DQL 查询、变量和可视化。

description: Apply LaunchDarkly SDK onboarding: install dependency (or dual-SDK pair), configure env and secrets with consent, add init at entrypoint(s), verify compile. Nested under sdk-install; next is run.
description_zh: 执行 LaunchDarkly SDK 初始化配置：安装依赖（或双 SDK 对），在获得用户同意后配置环境变量与密钥，在入口点添加初始化，验证编译。该步骤嵌套于 sdk-install 之下；下一步是运行。

description: Detect repository stack for LaunchDarkly SDK onboarding: languages, frameworks, package managers, monorepo targets, entrypoints, existing LD usage. Nested under sdk-install; next is plan.
description_zh: 检测 LaunchDarkly SDK 引导的仓库技术栈：语言、框架、包管理器、monorepo 目标、入口点、现有 LD 使用。嵌套于 sdk-install；接下来是 plan。

description: Create a boolean first flag, add evaluation, toggle on/off for end-to-end proof. Parent onboarding Step 6; uses MCP, API, or ldcli; optional flag-create skill.
description_zh: 创建一个布尔初始标志，添加评估，用于端到端验证的开关。父级入职步骤6；使用MCP、API或ldcli；可选的flag-create技能。

description: Configure the LaunchDarkly hosted MCP server during onboarding. Use when the parent LaunchDarkly onboarding skill reaches the MCP offer, after the first flag works. Supports Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and other MCP-compatible agents. OAuth authentication; no API keys for the hosted server.
description_zh: 在引导过程中配置 LaunchDarkly 托管的 MCP 服务器。当父级 LaunchDarkly 引导技能到达 MCP 提供环节，且第一个 flag 生效后使用。支持 Cursor、Claude Code、Windsurf、GitHub Copilot 及其他兼容 MCP 的智能体。使用 OAuth 认证；托管服务器无需 API 密钥。

description: Generate a minimal LaunchDarkly SDK integration plan from detected stack: choose SDK type(s), dual-SDK server+client when required, files to change, env conventions. Nested under sdk-install; follows detect, precedes apply.
description_zh: 基于检测到的技术栈生成最小化的 LaunchDarkly SDK 集成方案：选择 SDK 类型（一种或多种），当需要时采用双 SDK 的服务器端+客户端方案，列出需修改的文件与环境变量约定。嵌套于 sdk-install 之下；在 detect 之后、apply 之前执行。

description: Install and initialize the correct LaunchDarkly SDK during onboarding by running nested skills in order: detect, plan, apply. Parent onboarding Step 4 is first flag.
description_zh: 在入职引导过程中，通过按顺序运行嵌套技能：检测、规划、应用，安装并初始化正确的 LaunchDarkly SDK。父级入职引导第4步是首个标记项。

description: Formulate and audit real strategy using Richard Rumelt's "Good Strategy Bad Strategy": an honest diagnosis, a guiding policy, and coherent action instead of goals, vision, and wishful thinking. Use when the user mentions "good strategy bad strategy", "strategy kernel", "diagnosis guiding policy coherent action", "our strategy is just goals", "strategic planning", "mission vs strategy", "annual plan", or "is this actually a strategy". Also trigger when auditing a strategy doc or pitch deck for fluff, turning a goal list into real strategy, formulating strategy for a product or company, or finding leverage and proximate objectives. Covers the kernel of strategy, bad-strategy detection, and sources of power. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For uncontested markets, see blue-ocean-strategy.
description_zh: 根据理查德·鲁梅尔特（Richard Rumelt）的《好战略，坏战略》，通过诚实的诊断、指导性的政策以及连贯的行动，制定并审查真实战略，而非依赖目标、愿景和空想。当用户提及“好战略，坏战略”、“战略核心”、“诊断、指导政策、连贯行动”、“我们的战略仅仅是目标”、“战略规划”、“使命与战略”、“年度计划”或“这到底是不是真正的战略”时使用。当审查战略文档或路演演示文稿是否存在冗余、将目标清单转化为真实战略、为产品或公司制定战略，或寻找杠杆效应与近程目标时，也应触发使用。涵盖战略核心、识别坏战略以及力量源泉。关于产品定位，请参考 obviously-awesome。关于无竞争市场，请参考 blue-ocean-strategy。

description: Pick the right Lightning Base Component (`lightning-*`) for a given UI task, retrieve its full API (props, methods, events, slots) from the bundled per-component reference, and wire it into an LWC (LWC `.html`, `.js`, and `.css` files) without breaking SLDS. Use this skill when users say "I need a Lightning modal / datatable / combobox / record form", ask which `lightning-*` component fits a use case, want a shortlist of LBC candidates, are about to hand-roll a UI that a base component already provides, or are editing an LWC bundle's `.html` / `.js` / `.css` and need to select or wire a base component. Also triggers on "Lightning base component", "LBC", "lightning-combobox", "lightning-datatable", "use `lightning-` tag". DO NOT TRIGGER for applying SLDS design tokens, blueprints, or styling guidance in general — that is `design-systems-slds-apply`; this skill only selects and wires `lightning-*` base components.
description_zh: 针对给定 UI 任务，选择合适的 `lightning-*` Lightning 基础组件；从随附的按组件参考中获取其完整 API（属性、方法、事件、插槽）；并将其连接至 LWC（LWC `.html`、`.js` 和 `.css` 文件），同时不破坏 SLDS。当用户说“我需要 Lightning 模态框 / 数据表 / 下拉框 / 记录表单”，询问哪个 `lightning-*` 组件适用于某种场景，需要 Lightning 基础组件候选清单，即将手工编写一个基础组件已经提供的界面，或正在编辑 LWC 包中的 `.html` / `.js` / `.css` 文件并需要选择或连接基础组件时，使用此技能。此外，当出现“Lightning 基础组件”、“LBC”、“lightning-combobox”、“lightning-datatable”、“使用 `lightning-` 标签”等触发条件时，也会触发。请勿触发用于一般性应用 SLDS 设计令牌、蓝图或样式指南——这属于 `design-systems-slds-apply`；本技能仅用于选择和连接 `lightning-*` 基础组件。

description: Resolves unresolved GitHub PR review threads end-to-end: evaluates whether each review comment is correct, applies a targeted fix when valid, replies with rationale when not, commits, and resolves the thread. USE FOR: unresolved review threads, PR review feedback, changes requested PRs, PR review URLs (#pullrequestreview-...), fix the review comments, close the open threads, address PR feedback. DO NOT USE FOR: summarizing feedback without code changes, creating new PRs, or read-only branches.
description_zh:
端到端解决未解决的 GitHub PR 评审线程：评估每条评审评论是否正确；若评审内容正确，则应用针对性修复，若评审内容不成立，则说明理由进行回复，提交更改，并解决该评审线程。

用途：未解决的评审线程、PR 评审反馈、已请求修改的 PR、PR 评审 URL（#pullrequestreview-...）、修复评审评论、关闭打开的线程、处理 PR 反馈。

不适用于：不附带代码变更的反馈总结、创建新 PR、或只读分支。

description: Build forms using @mantine/form in the mantine-9 repository. Use this skill when: (1) setting up a form with useForm, (2) adding validation rules or async validation, (3) working with nested object or array fields, (4) sharing form state across components with createFormContext, (5) using uncontrolled mode for performance, (6) using the standalone useField hook, or (7) any task involving useForm, getInputProps, onSubmit, insertListItem, or form validation.
description_zh:
使用 @mantine/form 在 mantine-9 仓库中构建表单。使用此技能时：
(1) 使用 useForm 设置表单，
(2) 添加验证规则或异步验证，
(3) 处理嵌套对象或数组字段，
(4) 使用 createFormContext 在不同组件间共享表单状态，
(5) 为提升性能使用非受控模式，
(6) 使用独立的 useField 钩子，
或
(7) 涉及 useForm、getInputProps、onSubmit、insertListItem 或表单验证的任何任务。

description: Manages the end-to-end lifecycle of on-demand, temporary access using Privileged Access Manager (PAM). Use when a user asks to create, read, update, or delete PAM entitlements, request temporary access, or approve/deny pending PAM grants. Do NOT use for permanent IAM policy bindings, troubleshooting IAM permission errors, or general Google Cloud resource provisioning.
description_zh: 管理使用特权访问管理（PAM）进行的按需、临时访问的端到端生命周期。当用户请求创建、读取、更新或删除 PAM 权限、申请临时访问，或批准/拒绝待批准的 PAM 授权时使用。切勿用于永久 IAM 策略绑定、排查 IAM 权限错误或通用 Google Cloud 资源配置。

description: This skill should be used when scientists need help with research problem selection, project ideation, troubleshooting stuck projects, or strategic scientific decisions. Use this skill when users ask to pitch a new research idea, work through a project problem, evaluate project risks, plan research strategy, navigate decision trees, or get help choosing what scientific problem to work on. Typical requests include "I have an idea for a project", "I'm stuck on my research", "help me evaluate this project", "what should I work on", or "I need strategic advice about my research".
description_zh: “本技能应在科学家需要协助研究问题选择、项目构思、处理陷入困境的项目或做出战略性科学决策时使用。当用户要求提出新的研究想法、解决项目问题、评估项目风险、规划研究策略、研判决策路径，或寻求帮助选择从事的科学问题时，应使用本技能。典型请求包括：“我有项目的想法”、“我在研究中陷入困境”、“帮我评估这个项目”、“我应该做什么研究”，或“我需要关于我的研究的战略性建议”。”

description:
Search and read official Coralogix platform documentation using **`cx docs search`** and **`cx docs fetch`**.
Use when the user asks how Coralogix features work, how to configure or use the UI, set up integrations
(OpenTelemetry, agents, collectors, webhooks), manage API keys, explore spans/traces/logs in the product,
configure alerts/SLOs/dashboards, or needs authoritative product docs — not live tenant telemetry.
description_zh:
使用 **`cx docs search`** 和 **`cx docs fetch`** 搜索并查阅 Coralogix 平台的官方文档。

适用于用户询问 Coralogix 功能如何运作、如何配置或使用 UI、设置集成
（OpenTelemetry, agents, collectors, webhooks），管理 API 密钥、在产品中探索 Span/Trace/日志、
配置告警/SLOs/仪表板，或需要权威产品文档 —— 而非实时的租户遥测数据。

description: Spawn three parallel review subagents over the active transcript, surface learnings, and route each to a concrete edit on an existing skill. Use when the user says reflect.
description_zh: 在活动转录上生成三个并行的审查子代理，提炼学习成果，并将每个子代理路由到对现有技能的具体修改。当用户说 reflect 时使用。

description: Human and accessibility skill for antislop. Contrast, keyboard, focus, and states for real people. Includes the contrast checker.
description_zh: 面向 antislop 的人因与无障碍技能。为真实用户提供对比度、键盘、焦点和状态支持。包含对比度检查器。

description: The basics of how to program GPUs using Mojo. Use this skill in addition to mojo-syntax when writing Mojo code that targets GPUs or other accelerators. Use targeting code to NVIDIA, AMD, Apple silicon GPUs, or others. Use this skill to overcome misconceptions about how Mojo GPU code is written.
description_zh: 如何使用 Mojo 编程 GPU 的基础知识。在编写针对 GPU 或其他加速器、使用 Mojo 的代码时，请结合 mojo-syntax 使用本技能。使用针对 NVIDIA、AMD、Apple 芯片 GPU 或其他设备的代码。使用本技能以消除对 Mojo GPU 代码编写方式的误解。

description: Break a large story or epic into smaller deliverable stories using proven split patterns. Use when backlog items are too big for estimation, sequencing, or independent release.
description_zh: 使用经过验证的分割模式，将大型故事或史诗拆解为更小的可交付故事。当待办事项过大，难以进行估算、排序或独立发布时使用。

description: Migrate Exa, Tavily, Perplexity, or Firecrawl web-data integrations completely to the appropriate Parallel products while preserving application behavior. Use when replacing these providers' SDKs or REST calls, dependencies, environment variables, request parameters, response parsing, model tools, search-plus-scrape paths, full-content or answer-synthesis paths, tests, and documentation; separating unsupported research-index, crawl, browser, file-parse, monitor, or other non-search capabilities; auditing for leftover provider usage; or finishing and verifying an in-progress provider migration.
description_zh: 将 Exa、Tavily、Perplexity 或 Firecrawl 的网页数据集成完全迁移到对应的 Parallel 产品，同时保持应用行为不变。适用于替换这些提供商的 SDKs、REST 调用、依赖项、环境变量、请求参数、响应解析、模型工具、搜索加抓取路径、全文或答案综合路径、测试及文档；将不支持的调研索引、抓取、浏览器、文件解析、监控或其他非搜索能力进行分离；审计遗留的提供商使用情况；或完成并验证正在进行的提供商迁移。

description: Remove AI-writing patterns from French text and inject voice and personality. Use when editing, reviewing, or rewriting French content that reads like ChatGPT or Claude output. Detects and fixes 38 patterns: AI vocabulary (crucial, essentiel, notamment, dans le paysage), anglicisms from English-first models (faire du sens, adresser un problème), formulaic openings (À l'ère de, Dans un monde où), participle clauses in -ant, em dash overuse, decorative emojis, mixed guillemets and apostrophes, uniform sentence length. Trigger on humaniser, déslopifier, nettoyer le texte IA, enlever le slop, make it sound human. Do NOT use for English text — use samber/cc-skills@humanizer-en-asd-ste100 instead.
description_zh: 去除法文中的AI写作模式，注入情感与个性。用于编辑、审查或重写读起来像ChatGPT或Claude输出的法文内容时。可检测并修正38种模式：AI词汇（crucial, essentiel, notamment, dans le paysage）、英语优先模型带来的英语化用语（faire du sens, adresser un problème）、程式化开头（À l'ère de, Dans un monde où）、-ant现在分词从句、破折号过度使用、装饰性表情符号、引号与撇号混用、句式长度均匀化。当触发词为 humaniser、déslopifier、nettoyer le texte IA、enlever le slop、make it sound human 时使用。不适用于英文文本——请改用 samber/cc-skills@humanizer-en-asd-ste100。

description: Binance Derivatives-trading-usds-futures request using the Binance API. Authentication requires API key and secret key. Supports testnet and mainnet.
description_zh: 通过 Binance API 请求 Binance 衍生品 - 交易 USDT 期货。认证需要 API 密钥和私密密钥。支持测试网和主网。

description: REQUIRED when modifying any file in packages/playground-ui or packages/playground. Triggers on: React component creation/modification/refactoring, UI changes, new playground features, bug fixes affecting studio UI. Generates Playwright E2E tests that validate PRODUCT BEHAVIOR, not just UI states.
description_zh: REQUIRED：在修改 packages/playground-ui 或 packages/playground 中的任何文件时。触发条件：React 组件创建/修改/重构、UI 变更、新增 playground 功能、影响工作室 UI 的 Bug 修复。生成 Playwright E2E 测试，用于验证 PRODUCT BEHAVIOR，而非仅验证 UI 状态。

description: Generate editorial calendars for blogs with topic clusters, publishing schedules, material-change reviews, update plans, seasonal opportunities, content mix formula, template integration, and distribution scheduling. Plans monthly or quarterly calendars around reader needs, evidence changes, and sustainable publishing capacity. Use when user says "editorial calendar", "content calendar", "blog calendar", "publishing schedule", "blog plan", "content plan", "what should I write".
description_zh: 为博客生成编辑日历，包括主题集群、发布计划、素材变更审核、更新计划、季节机会、内容配比公式、模板集成和分发排期。围绕读者需求、证据变化及可持续发布能力，规划每月或每季的日历。当用户说“editorial calendar”、“content calendar”、“blog calendar”、“publishing schedule”、“blog plan”、“content plan”、“what should I write”时使用。
