description: Write new blog articles from scratch optimized for Google rankings and AI citations. Generates full articles with template selection, answer-first formatting, Key Takeaways summary box, information gain markers, evidence-backed explanations, sourced statistics, Pixabay/Unsplash images, built-in SVG chart generation, optional FAQ sections, internal linking zones, and proper heading hierarchy. Supports MDX, markdown, and HTML output. Use when user says "write blog", "new blog post", "create article", "write about", "draft blog", "generate blog post".
description_zh: 从零开始撰写优化以适配Google排名和AI引用的新博客文章。生成包含模板选择、以答案为优先的格式、关键要点摘要框、信息增益标记、基于证据的解释、来源统计、Pixabay/Unsplash图片、内置SVG图表生成、可选的常见问题部分、内部链接区域以及正确标题层级的完整文章。支持MDX、Markdown和HTML输出。当用户说出“撰写博客”、“新博客文章”、“创建文章”、“关于...撰写”、“起草博客”、“生成博客文章”时使用。

description: AI agent patterns with Trigger.dev - orchestration, parallelization, routing, evaluator-optimizer, and human-in-the-loop. Use when building LLM-powered tasks that need parallel workers, approval gates, tool calling, or multi-step agent workflows.
description_zh: 基于 Trigger.dev 的 AI 代理模式——包括编排、并行化、路由、评估器-优化器以及人在回路机制。适用于构建需要并行工作器、审批关卡、工具调用或多步骤代理工作流程的由大语言模型驱动的任务。

description: Directory and router for the marketing skills library. Use when you need to find the right marketing skill for a task, see what marketing capabilities exist, or get oriented in this plugin. 44 specialist skills across 8 pods (content, SEO + AEO, CRO, channels, growth, intelligence, sales enablement, ops), 59 stdlib Python tools. Routes to one skill — it does not execute marketing work itself.
description_zh: 营销技能库的目录与路由。当您需要为任务查找合适的营销技能、了解现有的营销能力，或熟悉本插件时使用。涵盖8个模块（内容、SEO + AEO、CRO、渠道、增长、智能、销售赋能、运营）共44项专业技能，以及59个Python标准库工具。路由至单项技能——其本身不执行营销工作。

description: Continue working on an OpenSpec change by creating the next artifact. Use when the user wants to progress their change, create the next artifact, or continue their workflow. Also use when the user says "openspec continue" or "opsx continue".
description_zh: 通过创建下一个工件，继续推进 OpenSpec 变更工作。当用户想要推进变更、创建下一个工件或继续其工作流程时使用。当用户输入“openspec continue”或“opsx continue”时，也可使用。

description: Headless UI for virtualizing large element lists at 60FPS in TS/JS, React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Lit & Angular.
description_zh: Headless UI 用于在 TS/JS、React、Vue、Solid、Svelte、Lit 与 Angular 中，以 60FPS 虚拟化大型元素列表。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or produce podcasts from text content. Converts written content into a two-host conversational podcast audio format with natural dialogue.
description_zh: 当用户要求根据文本内容生成、创建或制作播客时，使用此技能。该技能将书面内容转换为包含自然对话的双主持对话播客音频格式。

description: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next, and order delivery so the sequence proves itself to a reviewer.
description_zh: 适用于多步骤工作（如清扫、迁移、执行同类修改），以及如何堆叠提交与 PR。将工作拆解为小单元，每个单元都必须以可验证的状态结束，在进入下一项之前逐一检查，并合理安排交付顺序，使流程序列能够为审查者提供验证依据。

description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.
description_zh: 从成果到机会、解决方案和测试构建机会解决方案树。当利益相关方请求在决定构建什么之前需要问题框架时使用。

description: 把当前对话交接给一个全新的 background agent，让它立即接手工作。
description_zh: 把当前对话交接给一个全新的 background agent，让它立即接手工作。

description: Product discovery and requirements analysis specialist. Conducts stakeholder interviews, market research, problem discovery, and creates product briefs. Use for product brief, brainstorm, research, discovery, requirements gathering, problem analysis, user needs, competitive analysis, and setting foundation before product planning. Hands off to product manager when analysis complete.
description_zh: 产品或需求分析专家。负责开展利益相关者访谈、市场调研、问题挖掘，并编写产品简报。适用于产品简报、头脑风暴、调研、发现、需求收集、问题分析、用户需求分析、竞品分析，以及产品规划前的筹备奠基等场景。分析工作完成后，移交给产品经理。

description: Structure and debug a LÖVE (Love2D) game in Lua: the love.load/update/draw loop, delta-time movement, input, and screen states. Use when building a LÖVE 11.x game (main.lua, conf.lua, .love).
description_zh: 使用 Lua 构建并调试 LÖVE（Love2D）游戏：love.load/update/draw 循环、基于时间增量的移动、输入和屏幕状态。适用于构建 LÖVE 11.x 游戏（main.lua、conf.lua、.love）。

description: Guided onboarding for OpenSpec - walk through a complete workflow cycle with narration and real codebase work. Also use when the user says "openspec onboard" or "opsx onboard".
description_zh: OpenSpec 引导式入门 - 通过旁白讲解和真实代码库操作，带您走完全部工作流程周期。当用户说“openspec onboard”或“opsx onboard”时，也使用此项功能。

description: Visual whiteboard collaboration for Copilot CLI. Creates an interactive whiteboard that opens in your browser — draw, sketch, add sticky notes, then share everything back with Copilot. Copilot sees your drawings and text, and responds with analysis, suggestions, and ideas.
description_zh: 面向 Copilot CLI 的可视化白板协作。创建一个在浏览器中打开的交互式白板——可绘制、草绘、添加便利贴，随后将全部内容共享回 Copilot。Copilot 可以查看您的绘图和文本，并以分析、建议和创意进行回应。

description: Deep research and analysis tool. Generates comprehensive HTML reports on any topic, domain, paper, or technology. Enhanced with advanced browser automation — SPA handling, network idle wait, batch operations, stealth browsing, and intelligent page analysis. Use when user asks to research, analyze, investigate, deep-dive, or generate a report on any subject.
description_zh: 深度研究与分析工具。可针对任何主题、领域、论文或技术生成全面的HTML报告。集成高级浏览器自动化功能——支持单页应用（SPA）处理、网络空闲等待、批量操作、隐身浏览以及智能页面分析。适用于用户要求对任何主题进行调研、分析、调查、深入探究或生成报告时使用。

description: Generate dark-mode-compatible inline SVG data visualization charts for blog posts. Supports horizontal bar, grouped bar, donut, line, lollipop, area, and radar charts with automatic platform detection (HTML vs JSX/MDX). Enforces chart type diversity, accessible markup (role=img, aria-labelledby), source attribution, and transparent backgrounds. Use when user says "blog chart", "generate chart", "data visualization", "svg chart", "blog graph", or "visualize data".
description_zh: 为博客文章生成兼容暗色模式的内联 SVG 数据可视化图表。支持水平条形图、分组条形图、环形图、折线图、棒棒糖图、面积图和雷达图，并具备自动平台检测（HTML 与 JSX/MDX）功能。强制图表类型多样化、采用无障碍标记（role=img, aria-labelledby）、标注来源，并使用透明背景。当用户说“blog chart”、“generate chart”、“data visualization”、“svg chart”、“blog graph”或“visualize data”时使用。

description: AI image generation and editing for blog content powered by Gemini via MCP. Generates hero images, inline illustrations, social preview cards, and OG images, and edits existing ones. Supports 6 domain modes (Editorial, Product, Landscape, UI/Web, Infographic, Abstract). Works standalone or internally from blog-write and blog-rewrite; falls back gracefully when MCP is unavailable. Use when user says "blog image", "generate hero image", "blog illustration", "edit blog image", "OG image".
description_zh: 由 Gemini 通过 MCP 驱动，为博客内容提供 AI 图像生成与编辑。生成主图、内嵌插画、社交预览卡片和 OG 图像，并编辑现有图像。支持 6 种领域模式（编辑、产品、风景、UI/网页、信息图、抽象）。可独立运行，也可从博客撰写和博客重写功能内部调用；当 MCP 不可用时，可优雅回退。当用户提到“博客图片”、“生成主图”、“博客插画”、“编辑博客图片”、“OG 图像”时使用。

description: SERP-informed outline generation with H2/H3 heading hierarchy, competitive content gap analysis, section-by-section word count targets, chart and image placement markers, optional FAQ question planning, and internal linking zones. Skeleton only: structure, H2/H3 hierarchy, word counts, optional FAQ slots. Use blog-brief instead if you need full competitive analysis, statistics research, and image suggestions. Lighter than a full content brief, generates article skeleton and structure only, ready for /blog write to consume. Use when user says "outline", "blog outline", "content outline", "structure blog", "plan sections", "article skeleton", "heading structure", "SERP analysis", "competitive outline", "plan article".
description_zh: 基于 SERP 信息的大纲生成，支持 H2/H3 标题层级、竞争内容差距分析、逐章节字数目标、图表与图片放置标记、可选的 FAQ 问题规划以及内部链接区域。仅骨架：结构、H2/H3 层级、字数、可选 FAQ 位置。如果需要完整竞争分析、数据统计研究与图片建议，请改用 blog-brief。相比完整内容简报更轻量，仅生成文章骨架与结构，可直接供 /blog write 使用。当用户说“大纲”、“博客大纲”、“内容大纲”、“组织博客结构”、“规划章节”、“文章骨架”、“标题结构”、“SERP 分析”、“竞争大纲”、“规划文章”时使用。

description:
Comprehensive game design theory covering MDA framework, player psychology,
balance principles, and progression systems. Master why games are fun.

description: Fast-forward through OpenSpec artifact creation. Use when the user wants to quickly create all artifacts needed for implementation without stepping through each one individually. Also use when the user says "openspec ff" or "opsx ff".

description: Filesystem RAG benchmarks: corpus/, train.json, evaluate_rag.py (RAGAS quality). Not for prod monitoring, latency/throughput benchmarking (use rag-perf), or evals outside this repo layout.
description_zh: 文件系统RAG基准测试：corpus/, train.json, evaluate_rag.py (RAGAS 质量)。不适用于生产监控、延迟/吞吐量基准测试（使用 rag-perf），或超出本仓库布局范围的评估。

description: Use when creating Nuxt modules: (1) Published npm modules (@nuxtjs/, nuxt-), (2) Local project modules (modules/ directory), (3) Runtime extensions (components, composables, plugins), (4) Server extensions (API routes, middleware), (5) Releasing/publishing modules to npm, (6) Setting up CI/CD workflows for modules. Provides defineNuxtModule patterns, Kit utilities, hooks, E2E testing, and release automation.
description_zh:
创建 Nuxt 模块时使用：
（1）发布到 npm 的模块（@nuxtjs/、nuxt-）；
（2）本地项目模块（modules/ 目录）；
（3）运行时扩展（components、composables、plugins）；
（4）服务端扩展（API 路由、middleware）；
（5）将模块发布到 npm；
（6）为模块设置 CI/CD 工作流。
提供 defineNuxtModule 模式、Kit 工具、钩子、端到端测试和发布自动化功能。

description: 29 production-ready scripts for iOS app testing, building, and automation. Provides semantic UI navigation, build automation, accessibility testing, and simulator lifecycle management. Optimized for AI agents with minimal token output.
description_zh: 为iOS应用测试、构建和自动化提供29个生产就绪脚本。提供语义化UI导航、构建自动化、无障碍测试及模拟器生命周期管理功能。针对AI智能体进行优化，具备最小化令牌输出的特性。

description: Upgrade Three.js games from prototype visuals to premium browser graphics: art-direction critique, procedural model building, material and texture libraries, world prop kits, shaders, VFX, lighting and render pipeline, LOD and instancing, render budgets, and a 10-category visual scorecard. Use when screenshots still look basic or the user asks for premium, AAA, high-fidelity, showcase, or less-basic graphics.
description_zh: 将 Three.js 游戏从原型视觉效果升级为高端浏览器图形：提供艺术指导点评、程序化模型构建、材质与纹理库、世界道具套件、着色器、VFX、光照与渲染管线、LOD 与实例化、渲染预算，以及十类视觉评分卡。适用于截图仍显基础，或用户要求高端、AAA级、高保真、展示级或基础较低的图形的场景。

description: Mobile layout skill for antislop. Use for layouts that reflow across screen sizes, phone to desktop: grids, overflow, tap targets. Load with the core.
description_zh: 用于 antislop 的移动布局技能。适用于跨越屏幕尺寸重排、从手机到桌面端的布局：网格、溢出、点击目标。随核心加载。

“谁有访问权限”，
“审计权限”，
“检查用户角色”，

description: Pre-built shadcn/ui components for json-render. Use when working with @json-render/shadcn, adding standard UI components to a catalog, or building web UIs with Radix UI + Tailwind CSS components.
description_zh: 为 json-render 预置的 shadcn/ui 组件。适用于与 @json-render/shadcn 配合使用、向目录中添加标准 UI 组件，或使用 Radix UI + Tailwind CSS 组件构建 Web UI。

description: Convert files and office documents to Markdown. Supports PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images (with OCR), audio (with transcription), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP, YouTube URLs, EPubs and more.
description_zh: 将文件和办公文档转换为 Markdown。支持 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、图片（支持 OCR）、音频（支持语音转写）、HTML、CSV、JSON、XML、ZIP、YouTube URL、EPUB 等。

description: Cloud design patterns for distributed systems architecture covering 42 industry-standard patterns across reliability, performance, messaging, security, and deployment categories. Use when designing, reviewing, or implementing distributed system architectures.
description_zh: 覆盖42个行业标准模式的分布式系统架构云设计模式，涵盖可靠性、性能、消息传递、安全与部署类别。适用于设计、评审或实现分布式系统架构。

description: Official integration patterns for Mapbox GL JS across popular web frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular). Covers setup, lifecycle management, token handling, search integration, and common pitfalls. Based on Mapbox's create-web-app scaffolding tool.
description_zh: Mapbox GL JS 官方集成模式：适用于 React、Vue、Svelte、Angular 等主流 Web 框架。涵盖设置配置、生命周期管理、令牌处理、搜索集成及常见易错点。基于 Mapbox 的 create-web-app 脚手架工具。

description: Run the daily wiki maintenance cycle: check all source freshness, update the index, and regenerate hot.md. Use this skill when the user says "/daily-update", "run the daily update", "update everything", "morning sync", "refresh the wiki index", or when triggered by the launchd cron at 9 AM. Also use to set up or verify the cron + terminal notification infrastructure for the first time ("set up the daily cron", "install the terminal notification", "how do I get the morning reminder?").
description_zh: 运行每日维基维护周期：检查所有源内容的时效性，更新索引，并重新生成 hot.md。当用户输入“/daily-update”、“运行每日更新”、“更新全部内容”、“晨间同步”、“刷新维基索引”，或在上午 9 点由 launchd 计划任务触发时，使用本技能。同时，首次用于设置或验证 cron 与终端通知基础设施（“设置每日计划任务”、“安装终端通知”、“如何获取晨间提醒？”）。

description: Browse and compare wiki knowledge by which AI tool originally produced it. Use this skill when the user says "/memory-bridge", "browse codex memory", "what did codex know about X", "show me claude knowledge", "cross-tool memory", "what does hermes know that claude doesn't", "show me knowledge from <tool>", "compare my AI tool memories", or wants to explore knowledge gaps between tools. Works from any project. Diff mode ("what's different", "unique to codex", "gaps between tools") is the killer feature — it surfaces blind spots between tools that the user may not know exist.
description_zh: 根据最初由哪个 AI 工具生成的，浏览并对比维基知识。当用户输入“/memory-bridge”、“浏览 codex 记忆”、“codex 对 X 的了解是什么”、“展示 Claude 的知识”、“跨工具记忆”、“Hermes 知道什么而 Claude 不知道”、“展示来自 <tool 的知识”、“比较我的 AI 工具记忆”，或想要探索工具间的知识差距时，请使用此技能。适用于任何项目。差异模式（“有何不同”、“codex 独有”、“工具间的差距”）是其杀手特性——能够揭示用户可能不知晓的工具间的盲点。

description: E2E and integration testing for TypeScript/NestJS projects using Jest, supertest, and real infrastructure via Docker (Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) with the Given-When-Then pattern. Use whenever the user is working on `.e2e-spec.ts` files or anything under `test/e2e/`, or asks to set up, write, review, run, debug, or optimize E2E or integration tests — including flaky tests, docker-compose for tests, Kafka/Redpanda consumers, test isolation, or GWT compliance.
description_zh: 针对使用 Jest、supertest，并通过 Docker（Kafka、PostgreSQL、MongoDB、Redis）提供真实基础设施的 TypeScript/NestJS 项目的 E2E 与集成测试，采用给定-当-则模式。当用户正在处理 `.e2e-spec.ts` 文件或 `test/e2e/` 下的任何内容，或询问搭建、编写、审阅、运行、调试或优化 E2E 或集成测试时使用，涵盖内容包括不稳定测试、用于测试的 docker-compose、Kafka/Redpanda 消费者、测试隔离或 GWT 合规性。

description: Selects, deploys, and customizes AI models on Amazon SageMaker. Fine-tuning (SFT, DPO, RLVR, RLAIF), model selection, dataset preparation, evaluation, deployment to SageMaker endpoints or Bedrock, inference optimization and endpoint diagnostics. Covers the full lifecycle from planning through production. Use when fine-tuning models on SageMaker, choosing/selecting which base model to customize or fine-tune from SageMaker Hub, finding a model to deploy without fine-tuning, transforming datasets for training, checking data readiness, evaluating model quality, deploying to endpoints, benchmarking or optimizing inference, setting up IAM roles and S3 buckets for training jobs, or managing a SageMaker Managed MLflow app. Also use to check endpoint health, diagnose failures, debug latency or errors, or view container logs and CloudWatch metrics. Covers Serverless Model Customization, Nova and OSS deployment paths, and PySDK v3. NOT for Ground Truth labeling, Feature Store, or general-purpose AWS infrastructure.
description_zh: 在亚马逊 SageMaker 上选择、部署和定制 AI 模型。涵盖微调（SFT、DPO、RLVR、RLAIF）、模型选择、数据集准备、评估、部署至 SageMaker 端点或 Bedrock、推理优化和端点诊断。覆盖从规划到生产的完整生命周期。适用于在 SageMaker 上微调模型、从 SageMaker Hub 选择或挑选基础模型进行定制或微调、寻找无需微调即可部署的模型、转换训练数据集、检查数据就绪状态、评估模型质量、部署至端点、进行推理基准测试或优化、设置 IAM 角色和 S3 存储桶以支持训练任务、或管理 SageMaker 托管 MLflow 应用等场景。同时可用于检查端点健康状况、诊断故障、调试延迟或错误、查看容器日志和 CloudWatch 指标。涵盖无服务器模型定制、Nova 和 OSS 部署路径以及 PySDK v3。不适用于真值标注、特征存储或通用 AWS 基础设施。

description: Start voice calls via the OpenClaw voice-call plugin.
description_zh: 通过 OpenClaw 语音通话插件开始语音通话。

description: Diagnose requirements problems and guide discovery of real needs and constraints
description_zh: 诊断需求问题，引导发现真实需求与约束

description: When the user wants to set up, audit, or optimize analytics tracking (GA4, events, conversions). Also use when the user mentions "Google Analytics," "GA4," "event tracking," "conversions," "attribution model," "gtag," "data layer," "GA4 setup," "conversion tracking," "event setup," "User ID tracking," or "CTA attribution." For traffic insights, use traffic-analysis.
description_zh: 当用户需要设置、审计或优化分析追踪（GA4、事件、转化）时使用。当用户提到“Google Analytics”、“GA4”、“事件追踪”、“转化”、“归因模型”、“gtag”、“数据层”、“GA4 设置”、“转化追踪”、“事件设置”、“用户 ID 追踪”或“CTA 归因”时，也使用。针对流量洞察，使用 traffic-analysis。

description: Security guidelines for writing secure code. Use when writing code, reviewing code for vulnerabilities, or asking about secure coding practices like 'check for SQL injection' or 'review security'. IMPORTANT: Always consult this skill when writing or reviewing any code that handles user input, authentication, file operations, database queries, network requests, cryptography, or infrastructure configuration (Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions) — even if the user doesn't explicitly mention security. Also use when users ask to 'review my code', 'check this for bugs', or 'is this safe'.
description_zh:
编写安全代码的安全指南。当编写代码、审查代码中的漏洞，或询问诸如“检查 SQL 注入”或“审查安全”等安全编码实践时使用。

重要：编写或审查任何处理用户输入、身份验证、文件操作、数据库查询、网络请求、密码学或基础设施配置（Terraform、Kubernetes、Docker、GitHub Actions）的代码时，始终咨询此技能——即使用户未明确提及安全。当用户询问“审查我的代码”、“检查此代码是否存在缺陷”或“这安全吗”时，也使用。

description: Configure the OpenTelemetry Collector with Sentry Exporter for multi-project routing and automatic project creation. Use when setting up OTel with Sentry, configuring collector pipelines for traces and logs, or routing telemetry from multiple services to Sentry projects.
description_zh: 使用 Sentry Exporter 配置 OpenTelemetry Collector，实现多项目路由和自动项目创建。适用于在设置 OTel 与 Sentry 集成、配置采集器流水线以处理追踪和日志，或将从多个服务路由遥测数据至 Sentry 项目时使用。

description: Design products and pricing around validated willingness to pay, from Ramanujam & Tacke's "Monetizing Innovation". Use when the user mentions "pricing", "how much should we charge", "willingness to pay", "pricing page", "packaging", "freemium vs free trial", "are we leaving money on the table", "nobody buys at this price", "price increase", or "good-better-best". Also trigger when designing or auditing pricing and packaging, validating willingness to pay before building, segmenting customers by value, or choosing between subscription, usage-based, and freemium models. Covers price-before-product, willingness-to-pay talks, the four failures (feature shock, minivation, hidden gem, undead), leader/filler/killer packaging, and behavioral pricing. For offers and guarantees, see hundred-million-offers. For what customers value, see jobs-to-be-done.
description_zh:
基于 Ramanujam & Tacke 的《将创新货币化》，围绕经过验证的支付意愿设计产品与定价。

适用于用户提及以下内容时："定价"、"我们应该收取多少费用"、"支付意愿"、"定价页面"、"产品打包"、" freemium 与免费试用"、"我们是否浪费了潜在收益"、"没有人在这个价格下购买"、"价格上调"或"优质、优秀、卓越"。

此外，当开展定价与产品打包的设计或审核、构建前验证支付意愿、按价值对客户进行细分，或在订阅制、按用量计费与 freemium 模式之间进行选择时，也应触发使用。

涵盖以下内容：产品定价前、支付意愿沟通、四种失败模式（功能冲击、最小化（Minivation）、隐藏宝藏、不死者）、头部、填充、杀手级产品打包以及行为定价。

关于优惠与保障，请参阅“一亿优惠”。

关于客户看重什么，请参阅“待完成的 job”。

description: Detect keyword cannibalization across blog posts by extracting primary keywords from titles and headings, clustering semantically similar targets, and flagging posts competing for the same search intent. Supports local-only mode (grep-based) and DataForSEO API mode (Page Intersection endpoint at ~$0.01/call). Outputs severity-scored report with merge or differentiate recommendations. Use when user says "cannibalization", "keyword overlap", "competing pages", "duplicate keywords", "cannibalize".
description_zh: 检测在博客文章中是否发生关键词蚕食现象：通过从标题和标题中提取主要关键词，对语义相近的目标进行聚类，并标记出争夺相同搜索意图的博文。支持仅本地模式（基于 grep 方式）和 DataForSEO API 模式（使用 Page Intersection 接口，约 $0.01/次调用）。输出带有严重程度评分的报告，并提供合并或区分处理建议。当用户使用"cannibalization"、"keyword overlap"、"competing pages"、"duplicate keywords"或"cannibalize"等表述时使用。

description: Help the user define a concrete, measurable goal before starting work, especially when they ask to use the goal tool, create a goal, set an objective, clarify success criteria, or turn a fuzzy intention into a quantitative outcome. Use this skill for goal creation and goal refinement only; it does not manage durable snapshots, decision logs, or long-running execution artifacts.
description_zh: 在开始工作前，协助用户制定具体、可衡量的目标，尤其是在用户要求使用目标工具、创建目标、设定目标、明确成功标准，或将其模糊意图转化为量化结果时。仅将此技能用于目标创建与目标优化；该技能不管理持久快照、决策日志或长期执行产物。

description: Deep research on any topic — broad parallel web searches, multi-source validation, confidence tracking, and a cited Markdown report. Use whenever the deliverable is a thorough sourced report rather than a quick answer: 'research <topic>', 'deep dive on X', 'analyze the landscape', 'competitive analysis', 'compare these options', 'who are the players in Z', 'literature review', 'background on Y', 'what papers exist on X', 'product teardown', 'regulatory overview', 'funding landscape', 'what trends are emerging in X', 'patent landscape', 'community health', or any request requiring scanning many sources and producing a cited written analysis. Covers 11 research types: market (TAM/SAM, segments, pricing, trends), domain (industry structure, ecosystem, regulatory overview), technical (architecture, tooling, benchmarks, technology evaluation), competitive (competitor teardown, positioning, win/loss), product (feature analysis, reviews, teardowns, roadmap signals), academic (literature survey, citation networks, key authors), person/org (due diligence on a company or public figure), financial (funding landscape, valuation multiples, revenue signals), legal (IP, patent landscape, litigation, compliance), trend (emerging signals, foresight, scenario mapping), community (ecosystem health, key voices, governance, fragmentation). Trigger even when phrased casually: 'look into X', 'what's the deal with Y', 'dig into Z', 'I need to understand the space', 'catch me up on X'. Do NOT use for single-fact lookups or one-off web questions.
description_zh: 任何主题的深度研究——广泛的并行网络搜索、多源验证、置信度追踪，以及引用的 Markdown 报告。当交付成果是需要全面、有来源的报告而非快速回答时使用：'研究 <主题>'、'对 X 的深度探讨'、'分析格局'、'竞争分析'、'对比这些选项'、'Z 领域的参与者有哪些'、'文献综述'、'Y 的背景'、'X 方面有哪些论文'、'产品拆解'、'监管概述'、'融资格局'、'X 领域涌现的趋势'、'专利格局'、'社区健康'，或任何需要扫描大量来源并产出带引用的书面分析的需求。涵盖 11 类研究类型：市场（TAM/SAM、细分市场、定价、趋势）、领域（行业结构、生态系统、监管概述）、技术（架构、工具、基准、技术评估）、竞争（竞争对手拆解、定位、胜负）、产品（功能分析、评测、拆解、路线图信号）、学术（文献综述、引用网络、关键作者）、人物/机构（对公司或公众人物的尽职调查）、财务（融资格局、估值倍数、营收信号）、法律（IP、专利格局、诉讼、合规）、趋势（新兴信号、前瞻、情景映射）、社区（生态系统健康、关键声音、治理、碎片化）。即使以非正式方式表述，也应触发：'深入 X'、'Y 是怎么回事'、'深入探究 Z'、'我需要了解该领域的状况'、'让我了解 X 的最新情况'。请勿用于单次事实查询或一次性网络提问。

description: Follow-up design polish skill inspired by Impeccable. Use after a web or HTML artifact exists to audit, critique, polish, animate, harden, and prepare the page for a live/share pass.
description_zh: 受 Impeccable 启发的后续设计润色技能。在网页或 HTML 产物存在后使用，用于审计、批注、润色、动画化、加固，并为页面的上线/分享发布做好准备。

description: Critically analyse the reasoning in written content (articles, blogs, transcripts, reports), not code. Use only when explicitly asked to critically analyse or critique an argument.
description_zh: 批判性分析书面内容（文章、博客、文字记录、报告）中的推理，而非代码。仅在明确要求对论点进行批判性分析或评论时使用。

description: Rewrite and optimize existing blog posts for Google SEO (May 2026 Core Update, E-E-A-T) and AI citation visibility as one SEO discipline. For AI-citation-only audit (no Google work), use blog-geo instead. Replaces fabricated statistics with sourced data, applies answer-first formatting, adds images, generates SVG charts, and updates freshness signals. Works with any blog format (MDX, markdown, HTML). Use when user says "rewrite blog", "optimize blog", "update blog", "improve blog", "fix blog".
description_zh: 以 Google SEO（2026 年 5 月核心更新、E-E-A-T）与 AI 引用可见性为统一 SEO 维度，改写并优化现有博客文章。若仅进行 AI 引用审计（不涉及 Google 工作），请改用 blog-geo。用有来源的数据替代虚构的统计数据，采用答案优先的格式，添加图片，生成 SVG 图表，并更新新鲜度信号。适用于任何博客格式（MDX、Markdown、HTML）。当用户说“改写博客”、“优化博客”、“更新博客”、“改进博客”、“修复博客”时使用。

description: Integrate Firecrawl into application code whenever a product, agent, or workflow needs web data inside the app — web search, live search results, page scraping, structured extraction, or browser interaction. Use when building any feature that needs data from the web in code, even if the user does not mention Firecrawl explicitly and only describes wanting web data, website content, search, scraping, or interaction in an application. Trigger for Firecrawl requests, "fire girl" shorthand, and generic app-level web-data needs that should map to `/scrape`, `/search`, or `/interact`. Do not use this skill for one-off terminal-only web tasks during the current session; use `firecrawl/cli` for those.
description_zh: 在需要应用内网络数据时，应将 Firecrawl 集成到应用代码中——包括网页搜索、实时搜索结果、页面抓取、结构化提取或浏览器交互。在构建任何需要在代码中获取网络数据的功能时使用，即使用户未明确提及 Firecrawl，仅描述希望获得网络数据、网站内容、搜索、抓取或应用内交互。触发条件包括 Firecrawl 请求、“fire girl”简写，以及应映射到 `/scrape`、`/search` 或 `/interact` 的通用应用级网络数据需求。请勿将此技能用于当前会话中仅限终端的一次性网页任务；对于此类任务，请使用 `firecrawl/cli`。
