description: Repurpose blog posts for social media, email, video, podcast, and community channels. Generates Twitter/X threads, LinkedIn posts and articles, Threads, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and long-form scripts, Reddit, newsletter, podcast, Discord, and Slack variants. Adapts tone for each platform. Use when user says "repurpose", "blog repurpose", "share blog", "social media", "twitter thread", "linkedin post", "youtube script", "reddit post".
description_zh: 将博客文章重新用于社交媒体、邮件、视频、播客和社区渠道。生成 Twitter/X 线程、LinkedIn 帖子与文章、Threads、Bluesky、TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts 及长篇脚本、Reddit、邮件通讯、播客、Discord 和 Slack 的多种变体。为每个平台调整语气。当用户说出以下内容时使用：“重新利用”、“博客重新利用”、“分享博客”、“社交媒体”、“Twitter/X 线程”、“LinkedIn 帖子”、“YouTube 脚本”、“Reddit 帖子”。

description:
Company discovery and deep research skill. Researches a company's product and ICP,
discovers target companies to sell to using Browserbase Search API, deeply researches
each using a Plan→Research→Synthesize pattern, and scores ICP fit — compiled into
a scored research report and CSV. Supports depth modes (quick/deep/deeper) for
balancing scale vs intelligence.
Use when the user wants to: (1) find companies to sell to, (2) research potential
customers, (3) discover companies matching an ICP, (4) build a target company list,
(5) do market research on prospects. Triggers: "find companies to sell to",
"company research", "find prospects", "ICP research", "target companies",
"who should we sell to", "market research", "lead research", "prospect list".
description_zh:
公司发现与深度研究技能。研究公司产品与 ICP，使用 Browserbase Search API 发现目标公司，以便销售；通过 Plan→Research→Synthesize 模式对每家公司进行深度研究，并评估 ICP 匹配度——汇总为带评分的研究报告和 CSV。支持深度模式（快速/深度/更深），以平衡规模与智能程度。

当用户希望：(1) 寻找可销售的公司，(2) 研究潜在客户，(3) 发现符合 ICP 的公司，(4) 构建目标公司清单，(5) 对潜在客户进行市场调研时使用。

触发词："寻找可销售的公司"、"公司研究"、"寻找潜在客户"、"ICP 研究"、"目标公司"、"我们该卖给谁"、"市场调研"、"线索研究"、"潜在客户清单"。

description: Performs quality control on single-cell RNA-seq data (.h5ad or .h5 files) using scverse best practices with MAD-based filtering and comprehensive visualizations. Use when users request QC analysis, filtering low-quality cells, assessing data quality, or following scverse/scanpy best practices for single-cell analysis.
description_zh: 采用 scverse 最佳实践，结合基于 MAD 的过滤与全面可视化，对单细胞 RNA-seq 数据（.h5ad 或 .h5 文件）执行质量控制。适用于用户请求质量控制分析、过滤低质量细胞、评估数据质量，或需遵循 scverse/scanpy 单细胞分析最佳实践时使用。

description: Create a new blank Figma file. Use when the user wants to create a new Figma design or FigJam file, or when you need a new file before calling use_figma. Handles plan resolution via whoami if needed. Usage — /figma-create-new-file [editorType] [fileName] (e.g. /figma-create-new-file figjam My Whiteboard)
description_zh: 创建一个新的空白 Figma 文件。当用户需要创建新的 Figma 设计文件或 FigJam 文件，或在调用 use_figma 之前需要新文件时使用。如需，通过 whoami 处理计划解析。用法 — /figma-create-new-file [editorType] [fileName]（例如 /figma-create-new-file figjam My Whiteboard）

description: Choose and audit startup metrics using Croll and Yoskovitz's "Lean Analytics". Use when the user mentions "what metrics should we track", "KPIs", "north star metric", "One Metric That Matters (OMTM)", "vanity metrics", "analytics dashboard", "DAU/MAU", "churn benchmark", or "measure product-market fit". Also trigger when choosing metrics for a startup or feature, auditing a dashboard for vanity metrics, setting metric targets and baselines, or instrumenting a product by business model and stage. Covers good-vs-vanity metrics, the One Metric That Matters, metrics by business model, the five startup stages, and benchmarks. For the build-measure-learn loop, see lean-startup. For fixing activation and retention, see improve-retention.
description_zh:
使用克罗尔和约斯科维茨的《精益分析》，选择并审计创业公司指标。

当用户提及“我们应该跟踪哪些指标”、“关键绩效指标（KPI）”、“北极星指标”、“至关重要的单一指标（OMTM）”、“虚荣指标”、“分析仪表盘”、“DAU/MAU”、“流失基准”或“衡量产品市场匹配度”时，使用该内容。

此外，当为初创公司或功能选择指标、审计仪表盘中的虚荣指标、设定指标目标与基准，或根据业务模式与阶段为产品或指标进行设置时，亦触发使用。

该内容涵盖优质指标与虚荣指标的对比、《至关重要的单一指标》、按业务模式划分的指标、创业公司的五个阶段以及基准。

关于“构建-度量-学习”循环，参阅“精益创业”；关于解决激活与留存问题，参阅“提升留存率”。

description: Framework for building competitive landscape decks — market positioning, competitor deep-dives, comparative analysis, strategic synthesis. Use when the user asks for a competitive landscape, competitor analysis, peer comparison, market positioning assessment, strategic review, or investment memo deck. Also triggers on "who are the competitors to X", "benchmark X against peers", "build a market map", or any request to systematically evaluate competitive dynamics across an industry.
description_zh: 构建竞争格局演示文稿的框架——市场定位、竞争对手深度剖析、对比分析、战略综合。适用于用户提出竞争格局、竞争对手分析、同行对比、市场定位评估、战略回顾或投资备忘录演示文稿等需求时。触发条件还包括“X的主要竞争对手是谁”、“将X与同行进行对标”、“构建市场地图”，或任何要求系统评估特定行业竞争动态的请求。

description: Aids in writing Mojo code that interoperates with Python using current syntax and conventions. Use this skill in addition to mojo-syntax when writing Mojo code that interacts with Python, calls Python libraries from Mojo, or exposes Mojo types/functions to Python. Also use when the user wants to build Python extension modules in Mojo, wrap Mojo structs for Python consumption, or convert between Python and Mojo types.
description_zh: 有助于编写使用当前语法和约定与 Python 互操作的 Mojo 代码。在编写与 Python 交互、从 Mojo 调用 Python 库、或向 Python 暴露 Mojo 类型/函数的 Mojo 代码时，请在使用 mojo-syntax 的同时使用本技能。当用户需要使用 Mojo 构建 Python 扩展模块、封装供 Python 使用的 Mojo 结构体，或在 Python 类型与 Mojo 类型之间进行转换时，也应使用本技能。

description: Generate audio narration of blog posts using Google Gemini TTS. Supports summary narration, full article read-aloud, and two-speaker podcast/dialogue mode with 30 voice options. Outputs MP3 with HTML5 audio embed code. Works standalone via /blog audio or internally from blog-write. Falls back gracefully when API key is not configured. Use when user says "blog audio", "narrate blog", "audio version", "text to speech", "tts", "podcast mode", "read aloud", "audio narration", "voice", "narration", "generate audio".
description_zh: 使用 Google Gemini TTS 为博客文章生成音频旁白。支持摘要旁白、全文朗读，以及双人播客/对白模式，并提供 30 种声音选项。输出 MP3 及 HTML5 音频嵌入代码。可通过 /blog audio 独立运行，或从 blog-write 内部运行。当未配置 API 密钥时，可优雅回退。当用户提到“blog audio”、“narrate blog”、“audio version”、“文本转语音”、“tts”、“podcast mode”、“read aloud”、“audio narration”、“voice”、“narration”、“generate audio”时使用。

description: Analyze historical downtrend durations and generate interactive HTML histograms showing typical correction lengths by sector and market cap.
description_zh: 分析历史下跌趋势，并生成交互式HTML直方图，展示按行业及市值划分的典型回调长度。

description: Make .NET projects compatible with Native AOT and trimming by systematically resolving IL trim/AOT analyzer warnings. USE FOR: making projects AOT-compatible, fixing trimming warnings, resolving IL warnings (IL2026, IL2070, IL2067, IL2072, IL3050), adding DynamicallyAccessedMembers annotations, enabling IsAotCompatible. DO NOT USE FOR: publishing native AOT binaries, optimizing binary size, replacing reflection-heavy libraries with alternatives. INVOKES: no tools — pure knowledge skill.
description_zh:
通过系统地解决 IL 裁剪/AOT 分析器警告，使 .NET 项目与 Native AOT 和裁剪（Trimming）兼容。

**适用场景：** 使项目具备 AOT 兼容性；修复裁剪警告；解决 IL 警告（IL2026、IL2070、IL2067、IL2072、IL3050）；添加 DynamicallyAccessedMembers 注解；启用 IsAotCompatible。

**不要用于：** 发布原生 AOT 二进制文件；优化二进制体积；用其他方案替换依赖反射较多的库。

**调用方式：** 无需工具 —— 纯知识技能。

description: Add a new sound effect to @remotion/sfx
description_zh: 在 @remotion/sfx 中添加一个新的音效

description: Generate a high-converting ad creative set — hero image, ad copy variations, and platform-optimized crops for Meta, Google Display, and LinkedIn.
description_zh: 生成一套高转化广告创意素材——主图、广告文案变体，以及针对 Meta、Google 展示广告和 LinkedIn 的平台优化裁剪图。

description: Archive multiple completed OpenSpec changes at once. Use when archiving several parallel changes. Also use for a plural archive request - "openspec bulk-archive", "opsx bulk-archive", "openspec archive all", or "openspec archive these changes".
description_zh:
一次性归档多个已完成的 OpenSpec 变更。

归档多个并行变更时使用。

此外，适用于批量归档请求——"openspec bulk-archive"、"opsx bulk-archive"、"openspec archive all" 或 "openspec archive these changes"。

description:
Stepwise scaffolding, brainstorming, and draft-generation for literary novels using interactive interviews.

TRIGGERS - Use this skill when user says:
- "create a novel project" / "start a new novel"
- "help me brainstorm my novel" / "plan my story"
- "/novel-architect [language] novel named [name] [core idea]"
- "set up novel structure" / "initialize my book project"
- Any request about creating fiction writing projects or story planning

Creates full novel directory with foundation files, character sheets, and chapter scaffolding.
Uses gentle, reflective interview process to discover emotional truth before structure.
description_zh:
通过交互式访谈，进行文学小说的分步搭建、头脑风暴与草稿生成。

触发条件 - 当用户说：
- “创建小说项目” / “开始新小说”
- “帮助我构思我的小说” / “规划我的故事”
- “/novel-architect [语言] 命名为 [名称]、核心创意为 [核心想法] 的小说”
- “设置小说结构” / “初始化我的书籍项目”
- 任何关于创建虚构写作项目或故事规划的要求

创建包含基础文件、角色表和章节搭建的完整小说目录。
采用温和而反思的访谈流程，于搭建结构之前发掘情感真实。

description: Build or review messaging agents with Photon Spectrum (`spectrum-ts`). Use for Spectrum setup, messages and content, spaces and users, provider capabilities, iMessage/WhatsApp/Terminal integrations, custom platforms, lifecycle, or production message-processing architecture.
description_zh: 使用 Photon Spectrum (`spectrum-ts`) 构建或审查消息代理。适用于进行谱系配置、消息与内容、空间与用户、服务商能力、iMessage/WhatsApp/Terminal 集成、自定义平台、生命周期，或生产环境消息处理架构等工作。

description:
Identity-consistent portrait generation from a reference photo. Covers professional headshots, dating photos, style transfers, themed portraits, photo series, avatars, ID photos.

Use when generating styled portraits from a reference photo (e.g. professional headshot, anime avatar, cyberpunk portrait, travel photo, dating profile photo, ID photo).
description_zh:
基于参考照片的保持身份一致的肖像生成。涵盖职业头照、约会照片、风格迁移、主题肖像、照片系列、头像和身份证照片。

当基于参考照片生成风格化肖像时使用（例如：职业头照、动漫头像、赛博朋克肖像、旅行照片、约会主页照片、身份证照片）。

description: Coordinate the end-to-end CAD/source-asset to SimReady workflow. Use for broad requests such as CAD to SimReady, source asset to simulation-ready USD, or prop packaging that require conversion, material/physics assignment, SimReady conformance, validation, and optional package creation; deploy or verify Content Agents services first when property assignment is enabled; route single-stage work through nested references.
description_zh: 协调端到端 CAD/源资产至 SimReady 的工作流。适用于广泛请求，例如 CAD 到 SimReady、源资产到模拟就绪 USD，或需要转换、材料/物理属性分配、SimReady 合规性、验证及可选包创建的道具打包；当属性分配启用时，优先部署或验证 Content Agents 服务；通过嵌套引用路由单阶段工作。

description: Transcribe audio files using Qwen ASR. Use when the user sends voice messages and wants them converted to text.
description_zh: 使用 Qwen ASR 对音频文件进行转写。当用户发送语音消息并希望将其转换为文本时使用。

description: Populates investment banking pitch deck templates with data from source files. Use when: user provides a PowerPoint template to fill in, user has source data (Excel/CSV) to populate into slides, user mentions populating or filling a pitch deck template, or user needs to transfer data into existing slide layouts. Not for creating presentations from scratch.
description_zh:
将源文件的数据填充至投资银行路演演示模板中。

适用场景：
- 用户提供用于填充的 PowerPoint 模板；
- 用户拥有用于填入幻灯片的源数据（Excel/CSV）；
- 用户提及填充或填写路演演示模板；
- 用户需要将数据导入现有的幻灯片版式。

不适用于从零开始创建演示文稿。

description: Guide teams through MITRE's Problem Framing Canvas. Use when you need a clearer problem statement before jumping to solutions.
description_zh: 引导团队使用 MITRE 的问题框架画布。在需要先获得更清晰的问题陈述，再转向解决方案时使用。

description: Provision instant temporary Postgres databases via Claimable Postgres by Neon (neon.new) with no login, signup, or credit card. Supports REST API, CLI, and SDK. Use when users ask for a quick Postgres environment, a throwaway DATABASE_URL for prototyping/tests, or "just give me a DB now". Triggers include: "quick postgres", "temporary postgres", "no signup database", "no credit card database", "instant DATABASE_URL", "npx neon-new", "neon.new", "neon.new API", "claimable postgres API".
description_zh: 通过 Claimable Postgres by Neon (neon.new) 即时提供临时 Postgres 数据库，无需登录、注册或信用卡。支持 REST API、CLI 和 SDK。当用户请求快速 Postgres 环境、用于原型设计和测试的一次性 DATABASE_URL，或“just give me a DB now”时使用。触发条件包括：“quick postgres”、“temporary postgres”、“no signup database”、“no credit card database”、“instant DATABASE_URL”、“npx neon-new”、“neon.new”、“neon.new API”、“claimable postgres API”。

description: When the user wants to write, generate, or create article body content—blog post body, long-form content, how-to guide, listicle. Also use when the user mentions "write article," "article content," "blog post content," "article body," "long-form content creation," "generate article," "article draft," "how-to guide content," "listicle content," "information gain," or "content density." For single post page structure, schema, and SEO metadata, use article-page-generator. For blog index/listing page, use blog-page-generator. For short ad, landing, or email copy, use copywriting.
description_zh: 当用户需要撰写、生成或创建文章正文内容时使用——包括博客文章正文、长文内容、操作指南、清单文章。当用户提及以下内容时，也使用此功能："写文章"、"文章内容"、"博客文章内容"、"文章正文"、"长文内容创作"、"生成文章"、"文章草稿"、"操作指南内容"、"清单内容"、"信息获取"或"内容密度"。对于单篇文章页面的结构、schema 和 SEO 元数据，使用 article-page-generator。对于博客索引/列表页，使用 blog-page-generator。对于短广告、落地页或邮件文案，使用 copywriting。

description: Code comment hygiene for AI coding agents: remove generic AI-slop comments, keep the valuable ones, never touch the code.
description_zh: AI 编程代理的代码注释卫生：删除通用的 AI 套话注释，保留有价值的注释，绝不改动代码。

description: Processes GCP infrastructure design and deployment workflows within Application Design Center (ADC). Use when: - Designing GCP infrastructure with Terraform. - Validating local HCL. - Performing best-practice plan scans. - Importing templates to Application Design Center (ADC). - Deploying templates. - Troubleshooting deployment failures. Boundaries: - Only use for GCP-specific cloud infrastructure. - Only use for Terraform coding within the ADC context.
description_zh:
处理应用设计中心（ADC）内 GCP 基础设施的设计与部署工作流程。使用场景：
- 使用 Terraform 设计 GCP 基础设施。
- 校验本地 HCL。
- 执行最佳实践计划扫描。
- 将模板导入应用设计中心（ADC）。
- 部署模板。
- 排查部署失败问题。

边界：
- 仅用于 GCP 特定云基础设施。
- 仅用于 ADC 上下文内的 Terraform 编码。

description: Generate complete JSON-LD schema markup for blog posts with Article/BlogPosting, Person, Organization, BreadcrumbList, ImageObject, and optional FAQPage. Validates against Google requirements and warns about deprecated types. Use when user says "schema", "blog schema", "json-ld", "structured data", "schema markup", "generate schema".
description_zh: 为博客文章生成包含 Article/BlogPosting、Person、Organization、BreadcrumbList、ImageObject 以及可选 FAQPage 的完整 JSON-LD schema 标记。对照 Google 要求验证，并对已弃用类型发出警告。当用户说“schema”、“blog schema”、“json-ld”、“structured data”、“schema markup”、“generate schema”时使用。

description: Use when searching, extracting, ingesting, or querying a document collection with the NeMo Retriever 26.8.1 CLI, including local LanceDB indexes and deployed Retriever services. Use for PDFs, images, Office files, HTML, text, audio, and video; not for editing documents or web search.
description_zh: 适用于使用 NeMo Retriever 26.8.1 CLI 对文档集进行搜索、提取、摄入或查询的场景，包括本地 LanceDB 索引和已部署的 Retriever 服务。用于 PDF、图像、Office 文件、HTML、文本、音频和视频；不用于编辑文档或网络搜索。

description: Generate Minervini-style breakout trade plans from VCP screener output with worst-case risk calculation, portfolio heat management, and Alpaca-compatible order templates (stop-limit bracket for pre-placement, limit bracket for post-confirmation). Use when user has VCP screener results and wants actionable trade plans with entry/stop/target levels and position sizing.
description_zh: 基于VCP筛选器输出，生成Minervini风格的突破交易计划，包含最坏情况风险计算、组合热度管理以及兼容Alpaca的订单模板（预设置时采用止损限价单，确认后采用限价单）。当用户已获得VCP筛选器结果，并需要获取具备进场、止损、目标价位和仓位管理的可操作交易计划时使用。

description: Writes and structures long-form blog posts, creates tutorial outlines, and optimizes content for SEO with cover image generation. Use when the user asks to write a blog post, article, how-to guide, tutorial, technical writeup, thought leadership piece, or long-form content.
description_zh: 撰写并结构化长篇博客文章，创建教程大纲，并通过生成封面图片对内容进行SEO优化。当用户要求撰写博客文章、文章、操作指南、教程、技术文档、思想领导力文章或长文内容时使用。

description: When the user wants to improve their app's onboarding experience, increase activation rate, reduce Day 1 drop-off, or optimize the first-run flow. Use when the user mentions "onboarding", "first-run", "activation", "tutorial", "day 1 retention", "new user flow", "permission prompts", "sign-up conversion", "onboarding funnel", or "users dropping off early". For overall retention strategy, see retention-optimization. For paywall placement, see monetization-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户希望改善其应用的引导体验、提高激活率、降低首日流失率，或优化首次运行流程时。当用户提到“引导”、“首次启动”、“激活”、“教程”、“首日留存”、“新用户流程”、“权限提示”、“注册转化”、“引导漏斗”，或“用户早期流失”时，请使用。如需了解整体留存策略，请参阅留存优化。如需了解付费墙布局，请参阅变现策略。

description: Guide a human review of a commit, PR, file, or directory. Use when invoked by name
description_zh: 指导对提交、PR、文件或目录的人工审核。在按名称调用时使用。

description: Frida 17 JavaScript API compatibility checker and fixer. Use when writing, reviewing, or fixing Frida scripts, especially when migrating from older Frida versions. Detects deprecated APIs removed in Frida 17 (May 2025) and provides correct replacements. Covers Module, Memory, Process APIs and common naming conflicts.
description_zh: Frida 17 JavaScript API 兼容性检查器与修复工具。在编写、审查或修复 Frida 脚本时使用，特别是在从旧版本 Frida 迁移时。能够检测在 Frida 17（2025 年 5 月）中移除的已废弃 API，并提供正确的替代方案。涵盖 Module、Memory、Process 等 API 以及常见的命名冲突问题。

description: Activation requires either supplied .NET coverage reports/percentages/line, branch, or condition metrics, or an explicit request to collect .NET coverage for analysis. USE FOR: interpreting that evidence, including Cobertura data, partial conditions, plateaus, target arithmetic, project-wide coverage-backed CRAP, and coverage-backed refactoring safety. Analyze supplied reports directly without rerunning tests or installing tools. DO NOT USE FOR: requests with neither coverage evidence nor explicit coverage-collection intent, including hypothetical change-survival questions (use test-gap-analysis); CRAP or refactoring safety for one named target (use crap-score); or requests owned by test-tagging, find-untested-sources, test-anti-patterns, run-tests, or code-testing-agent.
description_zh:
激活需要提供 .NET 覆盖率报告、百分比、行、分支或条件指标，或明确请求收集 .NET 覆盖率以供分析。

**用途：** 解读此类证据，包括 Cobertura 数据、部分条件、平台期、目标算术、项目级覆盖率支持的 CRAP，以及覆盖率支持的重构安全性。

直接分析提供的报告，无需重新运行测试或安装工具。

**不得用于：** 既无覆盖率证据又无明确覆盖率收集意图的请求，包括假设性的变更存活问题（请使用 test-gap-analysis）；针对单一指定目标的 CRAP 或重构安全性（请使用 crap-score）；或属于测试标记、查找未测试源码、测试反模式、运行测试或代码测试代理的请求。

description: Version release workflow — release process and GitHub Release notes (not docs/changelog pages).
description_zh: 版本发布工作流 — 发布流程和 GitHub Release 说明（非 docs/changelog 页面）

description: Break down epics into user stories with Humanizing Work split patterns. Use when a backlog item is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely.
description_zh: 通过人性化工作拆分模式，将史诗拆分为用户故事。当待办事项过大，无法安全估算、排序和交付时使用。

description: Calculate SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics. Use when diagnosing momentum, churn, expansion, or product-market-fit signals.
description_zh: 计算 SaaS 收入、留存以及增长指标。用于诊断势头、流失、扩展或产品与市场契合度信号时。

description: Use this skill to bring a supported object-detection vision model from HuggingFace or NVIDIA NGC into an NVIDIA DeepStream pipeline with end-to-end automation: ONNX download, SafeTensors export, TRT engine build, custom nvinfer bbox parser, multi-stream benchmark, and PDF report. Object detection models only.
description_zh: 使用此技能，通过端到端自动化，将来自 HuggingFace 或 NVIDIA NGC 的受支持物体检测视觉模型集成到 NVIDIA DeepStream 流程中，包括：ONNX 下载、SafeTensors 导出、TRT 引擎构建、自定义 nvinfer 边界框解析器、多流基准测试及 PDF 报告。仅支持物体检测模型。

description: Google API integration for blog performance: PageSpeed Insights, CrUX Core Web Vitals with 25-week history, Search Console performance, URL Inspection, Indexing API, GA4 organic traffic, NLP entity analysis for E-E-A-T, YouTube video search for embedding, and Google Ads Keyword Planner. Progressive feature availability based on credential tier (API key, OAuth/service account, GA4, Ads). Shares config with claude-seo at ~/.config/claude-seo/google-api.json. Use when user says "google data", "page speed", "core web vitals", "search console", "indexation", "GA4", "keyword research", "nlp entities", "blog performance", "youtube search", "google api setup".
description_zh: 博客性能 Google API 集成：PageSpeed Insights、CrUX 核心 Web 指标（含 25 周历史数据）、Search Console 性能、URL 检查、索引 API、GA4 自然流量、基于 E-E-A-T 的 NLP 实体分析、用于嵌入的 YouTube 视频搜索以及 Google Ads 关键词规划师。根据凭证层级（API 密钥、OAuth/服务账号、GA4、Ads）提供渐进式功能可用性。配置共享至 claude-seo，路径为 ~/.config/claude-seo/google-api.json。当用户提及 "google data"、"page speed"、"core web vitals"、"search console"、"indexation"、"GA4"、"keyword research"、"nlp entities"、"blog performance"、"youtube search"、"google api setup" 时使用。

description: Blog strategy development including topic cluster architecture with hub-and-spoke design, audience mapping, competitive landscape analysis, AI citation surface strategy across ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews, distribution channel planning (YouTube, Reddit, review platforms for AI-citation SEO), content scoring targets, measurement framework, and content differentiation through original research and first-hand experience. Use when user says "blog strategy", "content strategy", "blog positioning", "what should I blog about", "blog topics", "content pillars", "blog ideation".
description_zh: 涵盖以枢纽-放射式设计构建的主题集群架构、受众映射、竞争格局分析、针对 ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews 的 AI 引用呈现策略、分发渠道规划（YouTube、Reddit、面向 AI 引用 SEO 的评测平台）、内容评分目标、衡量框架，以及通过原创研究和亲身体验实现内容差异化。当用户提到“博客策略”、“内容策略”、“博客定位”、“我应该写什么博客内容”、“博客主题”、“内容支柱”、“博客构思”时使用。

description: Organize business and technology teams for fast flow using Skelton & Pais's "Team Topologies". Use when the user mentions "team topologies", "Conway's law", "platform team", "stream-aligned team", "team boundaries", "cognitive load", "how should we split teams", "who owns this service", "team dependencies", or "reorg". Also trigger when reorganizing engineering teams, aligning team and service boundaries, splitting a monolith and deciding ownership, reducing cross-team handoffs, or designing an internal platform. Covers the four team types, three interaction modes, the inverse Conway maneuver, and fracture planes. For bounded contexts, see domain-driven-design. For dependency direction in code, see clean-architecture.
description_zh: 使用 Skelton & Pais 的"团队拓扑"，组织业务和技术团队以实现快速流转。当用户提及"团队拓扑"、"康威定律"、"平台团队"、"流对齐团队"、"团队边界"、"认知负荷"、"团队应如何拆分"、"该服务由谁负责"、"团队依赖关系"或"重组"时，使用。当重组工程团队、对齐团队与服务边界、拆分单体架构并决定所有权、减少跨团队交接，或设计内部平台时，也触发使用。涵盖四种团队类型、三种交互模式、逆向康威操作和断裂平面。关于有界上下文，请参阅领域驱动设计。关于代码中的依赖方向，请参阅干净架构。

description: Create and manage writing personas with NNGroup 4-dimension tone framework (Funny-Serious, Formal-Casual, Respectful-Irreverent, Enthusiastic-Matter-of-fact). Personas define readability targets, sentence length distribution, vocabulary tier, contraction frequency, and summary box label. Used by blog-write and blog-rewrite to enforce consistent voice. Use when user says "persona", "voice", "tone", "writing style", "brand voice", "create persona", "use persona".
description_zh: 使用 NNGroup 四维语气框架（幽默-严肃、正式-随意、尊重-不拘、热情-平实）创建并管理写作人设。人设用于定义可读性目标、句子长度分布、词汇等级、缩写频率及摘要框标签，博客撰写与博客重写功能据此确保语气一致性。当用户提及"persona"、"voice"、"tone"、"writing style"、"brand voice"、"create persona"或"use persona"时使用。

description: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, "make a control skill for this repo", or when a project has no scripted way to prove UI/CLI/service behavior.
description_zh: 生成项目本地的验证技能，该技能以用户的方式驱动您的应用程序——支持任何语言、框架或平台。适用于 /create-verification-skill、"为这个仓库创建一个控制技能"，或当项目没有脚本化的方式来验证 UI/CLI/服务行为时。

description: Orchestrate object-based Lightning Type + HXL widget generation to render the output of a custom MCP server tool backed by an Apex Invocable Action. TRIGGER only when the prompt EXPLICITLY involves rendering an MCP tool result: user says 'MCP server', 'MCP tool', 'custom MCP server', references a tool 'output schema' / 'tool output' / 'outputValues' envelope, names an 'invocable action' backing an MCP tool, or asks to build a widget or rich UI rendition for the output of an Apex-invocable-backed MCP tool. DO NOT TRIGGER when: customizing an Apex-backed agent action output (use platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate), authoring only a Custom Lightning Type (use platform-custom-lightning-type-generate), authoring only an Apex class (use platform-apex-generate), or building a standalone widget with no Lightning Type or MCP tool involved (use platform-widget-generate).
description_zh:
编排基于对象（Object-based）的 Lightning Type 和 HXL 组件生成，以渲染由 Apex Invocable Action 支持的自定义 MCP 服务器工具的输出。

**仅在 prompt 明确涉及渲染 MCP 工具结果时触发**，具体触发条件包括：
- 用户提及“MCP server”、“MCP tool”或“custom MCP server”；
- 引用工具的“output schema”、“tool output”或“outputValues”包装器；
- 提及支撑 MCP 工具的“invocable action”；
- 要求为 Apex-invocable 支撑的 MCP 工具的输出构建组件或富文本 UI 呈现。

**不要触发**，当出现以下情况时：
- 定制 Apex 支撑的 agent 动作输出（使用 platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate）；
- 仅编写 Custom Lightning Type（使用 platform-custom-lightning-type-generate）；
- 仅编写 Apex 类（使用 platform-apex-generate）；
- 构建与 Lightning Type 或 MCP 工具无关的独立组件（使用 platform-widget-generate）。

description: Add an interactive demo to the Remotion documentation. Use when creating a new <Demo> component for docs pages.
description_zh: 在 Remotion 文档中添加交互式演示。在创建文档页面的新 <Demo} component 时使用。

description: Slack messaging workflows through OpenClaw's message tool.
description_zh: 通过 OpenClaw 的消息工具实现 Slack 消息工作流。

description: Redis client and connection guidance covering connection pooling, multiplexing, pipelining, client-side caching with RESP3, avoiding slow commands (KEYS, SMEMBERS, HGETALL), and tuning socket timeouts. Use when configuring a Redis client (redis-py, Jedis, Lettuce, NRedisStack), batching commands for throughput, eliminating per-request connection creation, iterating large keyspaces with SCAN, enabling client-side caching for read-heavy workloads, or setting connect and read timeouts.
description_zh: Redis 客户端与连接使用指南涵盖：连接池、多路复用、管道化、基于 RESP3 的客户端缓存、规避慢命令（KEYS、SMEMBERS、HGETALL）以及调整套接字超时。适用于为 Redis 客户端（redis-py、Jedis、Lettuce、NRedisStack）配置，并通过命令批处理提升吞吐量、避免逐请求创建连接、使用 SCAN 遍历大型键空间、为读密集型负载启用客户端缓存，或设置连接与读取超时。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing business sales and revenue data from CSV files to identify weak areas, generate statistical insights, and provide strategic improvement recommendations. Use when the user requests a business performance report, asks to analyze sales data, wants to identify areas of weakness, or needs recommendations on business improvement strategies.
description_zh: 当需要分析CSV文件中的业务销售与营收数据，以识别薄弱环节、生成统计洞察并提供战略改进建议时，应使用此技能。当用户请求业务绩效报告、要求分析销售数据、希望识别薄弱环节，或需要业务改进策略建议时，应使用此技能。

description: Review, convert, and improve UI code using Chakra UI v3. Use this skill whenever a user wants to review Chakra UI code for issues, convert plain HTML/CSS, Tailwind, CSS Modules, or styled-components to Chakra UI, clean up messy Chakra components, fix layout structure or token usage, or asks anything like "is this correct", "what's wrong with this", "review my component", "refactor this", "clean up", "convert", or "chakra-ify this" — even without the words "review" or "refactor". Trigger on any request to check, improve, or convert Chakra UI code, however casually phrased.
description_zh: 使用 Chakra UI v3 审查、转换和改进 UI 代码。当用户希望审查 Chakra UI 代码以发现问题、将普通 HTML/CSS、Tailwind、CSS Modules 或 styled-components 转换为 Chakra UI、清理杂乱的 Chakra 组件、修复布局结构或 Token 使用，或提出诸如“这个是否正确”、“这里有什么问题”、“审查我的组件”、“重构这个”、“清理”、“转换”或“用 Chakra UI 化这个”等任何请求时，请使用此技能——即使没有使用“审查”或“重构”这两个词。对于任何检查、改进或转换 Chakra UI 代码的请求，无论表述多么随意，都应触发。

description: Conventional Commits v1.0.0 branch naming, worktree naming, and commit message standards for GitHub and GitLab projects. Use when creating branches, naming worktrees, writing commits, generating commit messages, reviewing branch conventions, or setting up changelog automation. Apply when your project needs consistent git history, SemVer-driven releases, parseable changelog generation, or automatic issue closing. Trigger when the user asks how to name a worktree, create a git worktree, or organize worktrees alongside branches.
description_zh: 适用于 GitHub 和 GitLab 项目的 Conventional Commits v1.0.0 分支命名、工作树命名与提交信息标准。当创建分支、命名工作树、编写提交、生成提交信息、审查分支规范或设置变更日志自动化时使用。当项目需要一致的 Git 历史、基于 SemVer 的发布、可解析的变更日志生成或自动关闭 issue 时适用。当用户询问如何命名工作树、创建 Git 工作树或在分支与工作树并列的情况下组织工作树时触发。

description: Add existing screenshots or screen recordings to a GitHub pull request as a before/after or preview block. Use when a PR needs visual media attached to its description. Browser navigation and capture belong to agent-browser.
description_zh: 将现有的截图或屏幕录制添加到 GitHub 拉取请求中，作为前后对比或预览区块。当拉取请求的描述需要附带视觉媒体时使用。浏览器导航与截取属于 agent-browser。

description: Run nf-core bioinformatics pipelines (rnaseq, sarek, atacseq) on sequencing data. Use when analyzing RNA-seq, WGS/WES, or ATAC-seq data—either local FASTQs or public datasets from GEO/SRA. Triggers on nf-core, Nextflow, FASTQ analysis, variant calling, gene expression, differential expression, GEO reanalysis, GSE/GSM/SRR accessions, or samplesheet creation.
description_zh: 在测序数据上运行 nf-core bioinformatics 流水线（rnaseq、sarek、atacseq）。用于分析 RNA-seq、WGS/WES 或 ATAC-seq 数据时使用——无论是本地的 FASTQ 文件，还是来自 GEO/SRA 的公共数据集。触发条件为 nf-core、Nextflow、FASTQ 分析、变异检测、基因表达、差异表达、GEO 再分析、GSE/GSM/SRR 条目，或样本表创建。

description: Mounts Cloud Storage buckets as a POSIX file system with Cloud Storage FUSE (gcsfuse). Use when interacting with gcsfuse: decide whether FUSE, native gs:// reads, or Filestore/Managed Lustre fits a workload, deploy tuned mounts on GKE, Compute Engine, or Cloud Run, enable and size file, stat, and list caches, tune mount flags or config-file settings, apply workload profiles, keep ML checkpointing safe (rename atomicity, hierarchical namespace/HNS, close-time finalization, concurrent writers), or diagnose slow training, low throughput, or bill spikes with gcsfuse metrics. Covers mount semantics, gcsfuse CLI and config files, GKE gcsfuse CSI driver (Workload Identity principal:// bindings, profile StorageClasses, sidecar sizing), and Cloud Run volume mounts. Don't use for bucket administration or data management without a mount (google-cloud-storage-basics) or fully POSIX-compliant shared file systems (Filestore, Managed Lustre).
description_zh:
使用 Cloud Storage FUSE (gcsfuse) 将云存储桶挂载为 POSIX 文件系统。使用 gcsfuse 进行交互时：需判断 FUSE、原生 gs:// 读取或 Filestore/Managed Lustre 哪种方案适合工作负载；在 GKE、Compute Engine 或 Cloud Run 上部署调优后的挂载；启用并调整文件、stat 与列表缓存；调优挂载标志或配置文件设置；应用工作负载配置文件；确保 ML 检查点安全（重命名原子性、分层命名空间/HNS、关闭时最终处理、并发写入）；或使用 gcsfuse 指标诊断训练缓慢、吞吐量低或账单激增问题。涵盖挂载语义、gcsfuse CLI 与配置文件、GKE gcsfuse CSI 驱动（工作负载身份 principal:// 绑定、配置文件 StorageClasses、sidecar 规模调整）以及 Cloud Run 卷挂载。

若无挂载，请勿用于桶管理或数据管理（google-cloud-storage-basics），或使用完全符合 POSIX 规范的共享文件系统（Filestore、Managed Lustre）。

description: 将当前对话上下文转成 PRD，并发布到项目 issue tracker。适用于用户想基于当前上下文创建 PRD 时。
description_zh: 将当前对话上下文转成 PRD，并发布到项目 issue tracker。适用于用户想基于当前上下文创建 PRD 时。

description: Discipline for giving design work narrative structure that makes people care. Provides four canonical patterns — protagonist-arc, choreography, situation/complication/resolution, what-is/what-could-be — each with a goal, shape, and named pathology. Use when design work needs narrative structure, when stakeholders need to see the user's experience as a story, when presenting design rationale to non-design audiences, or when a journey, blueprint, brief, or deck feels lifeless. Trigger phrases: "what's the story here?", "tell the story", "story mode", "narrative mode". Restated inline in journey, blueprint, strategize, evaluate (and presentation when that skill ships). Refuses to smooth user data into clean arcs, manufacture strategic tension, substitute emotional appeal for evidence, assume conflict arcs are universal, or engineer stakeholder assent by shortcut.
description_zh:
**为设计工作赋予引人关注叙事结构的准则。**

提供四种经典模式——主角弧线、编排、情境/困境/解决、是什么/本该是什么——每种模式均包含目标、形态及具名缺陷。在以下场景中适用：设计工作需要叙事结构时；利益相关方需要将用户体验视为故事时；向非设计受众呈现设计依据时；或旅程、蓝图、简报或演示文稿缺乏生命力时。

**触发短语：**
"此处有何故事？"、"讲述故事"、"故事模式"、"叙事模式"。

**在旅程、蓝图、策略、评估（及该技能上线时的呈现）中内联同步说明。**

**拒绝：**将用户数据平滑处理为干净弧线、制造战略张力、以情感吸引力替代证据、假设冲突弧线具有普遍性，或以捷径工程化利益相关方的认同。

description: Expert guidance for Odoo ERP development including Python ORM, XML views, and module architecture
description_zh: 针对 Odoo ERP 开发的专家指导，涵盖 Python ORM、XML 视图与模块架构。

description: Write professional press releases for any occasion, media type, and region. Use when the user wants to write, draft, or improve a press release, communiqué de presse, media announcement, or news release — including product launches, funding rounds, partnerships, crisis communications, executive hires, events, M&A, and open source milestones. Covers media targets (print, digital/wire, broadcast, social/SMPR, trade press) and region-specific conventions worldwide. Also trigger on 'I need to announce something' or 'how do I tell the press about X'. Do NOT use for blog posts or technical articles — use samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer instead; for newsletter issues, use samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting.
description_zh: 针对任何场合、媒体类型及地区，撰写专业的新闻稿。当用户需要撰写、起草或改进新闻稿、新闻公报、媒体公告或新闻发布稿时使用——包括产品发布、融资轮次、合作、危机沟通、高管招聘、活动、并购（M&A）及开源里程碑等。涵盖目标媒体（印刷媒体、数字/有线、广播、社交/SMPR、行业媒体）及全球各地的地区性惯例。当用户表达“我需要宣布某事”或“如何向媒体发布 X”时，也会触发。不可用于博客文章或技术文章——请改用 samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer 替代；针对通讯稿相关事宜，请使用 samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting。

description: PRやコード変更の汎用コードレビューを実施します。コードの品質、セキュリティ、設計を共通基準で評価し、approve/rejectを判断します。「このPRをレビュー」「コードレビューして」「マージ前チェック」などの依頼や、gh pr viewコマンドの実行時に使用してください。
description_zh: 对PR及代码变更进行通用代码评审。按照共同标准评估代码质量、安全性与设计，并做出批准或拒绝判断。适用于“审查此PR”、“进行代码评审”、“合并前检查”等请求，以及gh pr view命令执行时。

description: Explicit compatibility entry for Zustand data-shape guidance.
description_zh: 用于 Zustand 数据形状指导的显式兼容性条目

description: 생년월일시와 성씨·후보 이름을 바탕으로 사주 오행과 성명학 점수를 참고해 어울리는 한국 이름을 추천한다.
description_zh: 基于出生年月日时及姓氏、备选姓名，参考四柱五行与姓名学评分，推荐相配的韩国姓名。

description: Write, optimize, and grow Substack content — newsletter issues (email-first) and web posts (web-first essays). Covers voice matching, Substack algorithm and Notes strategy, email formatting, SEO, growth tactics, and paid-subscriber monetization. Use when the user mentions Substack, a newsletter issue, a Substack post or article, evergreen content, newsletter growth, Notes, paid subscribers, 'ghostwrite for', or 'write in the style of' — and for newsletter or essay writing even when Substack is not named, or when adapting a blog post, talk, or thread into newsletter format. Do NOT use for generic blog post writing without a newsletter context — use samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer instead.
description_zh: 撰写、优化并拓展 Substack 内容——包括时事通讯专题（以邮件为主）和网络文章（基于网页的散文）。涵盖语调匹配、Substack 算法与笔记策略、邮件排版、SEO、增长策略以及付费订阅者变现等内容。当用户提及 Substack、时事通讯专题、Substack 文章或文章、常青内容、时事通讯增长、笔记、付费订阅者、'ghostwrite for'（代写）或 'write in the style of'（以……的风格写作）时使用；即使未提及 Substack，也适用于时事通讯或散文写作，或当将博客文章、演讲或线程转化为时事通讯格式时。请勿用于无时事通讯背景的通用博客文章写作——应使用 samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer 代替。

description: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Retrieves financial data from SEC filings and analyst reports, builds comprehensive cash flow projections with proper WACC calculations, performs sensitivity analysis, and outputs professional Excel models with executive summaries. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
description_zh: 用于股权估值的真实DCF（折现现金流）模型创建。从SEC备案文件和分析师报告中提取财务数据，构建包含正确加权平均资本成本（WACC）计算的全面现金流预测，进行敏感性分析，并输出包含执行摘要的专业Excel模型。当用户需要使用DCF方法对公司进行估值、请求内在价值分析，或要求包含增长预测和终值计算的详细财务建模时使用。

description: Generate comprehensive, developer-friendly API documentation from code, including endpoints, parameters, examples, and best practices
description_zh: 从代码生成全面、面向开发者的 API 文档，涵盖端点、参数、示例和最佳实践。

description: Deep learning for single-cell analysis using scvi-tools. This skill should be used when users need (1) data integration and batch correction with scVI/scANVI, (2) ATAC-seq analysis with PeakVI, (3) CITE-seq multi-modal analysis with totalVI, (4) multiome RNA+ATAC analysis with MultiVI, (5) spatial transcriptomics deconvolution with DestVI, (6) label transfer and reference mapping with scANVI/scArches, (7) RNA velocity with veloVI, or (8) any deep learning-based single-cell method. Triggers include mentions of scVI, scANVI, totalVI, PeakVI, MultiVI, DestVI, veloVI, sysVI, scArches, variational autoencoder, VAE, batch correction, data integration, multi-modal, CITE-seq, multiome, reference mapping, latent space.
description_zh:
基于 scvi-tools 的深度学习单细胞分析

此技能应在用户需要以下情况时使用：(1) 使用 scVI/scANVI 进行数据整合与批次校正，(2) 使用 PeakVI 进行 ATAC-seq 分析，(3) 使用 totalVI 进行 CITE-seq 多模态分析，(4) 使用 MultiVI 进行 multiome RNA+ATAC 分析，(5) 使用 DestVI 进行空间转录组解卷积，(6) 使用 scANVI/scArches 进行标签迁移与参考映射，(7) 使用 veloVI 进行 RNA 速度分析，或 (8) 任何基于深度学习的单细胞方法。触发条件包括提及 scVI、scANVI、totalVI、PeakVI、MultiVI、DestVI、veloVI、sysVI、scArches、变分自编码器、VAE、批次校正、数据整合、多模态、CITE-seq、multiome、参考映射、潜在空间。

description: Write a user-centered problem statement with who is blocked, what they are trying to do, why it matters, and how it feels. Use when framing discovery, prioritization, or a PRD.
description_zh: 撰写一份以用户为中心的问题陈述，需明确被阻塞的用户是谁、他们试图完成什么、为何重要以及他们的感受如何。在定义发现、优先级或产品需求文档（PRD）时使用。

description: Interactive quiz tutor for Obsidian StudyVault learning. Use when the user wants to: (1) Take a diagnostic assessment of their knowledge, (2) Study or review specific sections/topics, (3) Drill weak areas identified in previous sessions, (4) Check their learning progress or dashboard, or says things like "quiz me", "test me", "let's study", "/tutor", "학습", "퀴즈", "평가".
description_zh:
面向 Obsidian StudyVault 学习的互动测验辅导工具。当用户需要进行以下操作时使用：
（1）对其知识进行诊断性评估，
（2）学习或复习特定章节/主题，
（3）针对上一轮会话中识别出的薄弱环节进行专项练习，
（4）查看其学习进度或仪表板，或使用类似“quiz me”“test me”“let's study”“/tutor”“학습”“퀴즈”“평가”等表述时。

description: DAVIS problem analysis including root cause identification, impact assessment, and correlation with other telemetry. Use when querying or investigating detected problems. Trigger: "active problems", "root cause analysis", "problem impact", "affected users", "list problems", "P-12345 details", "recurring problems", "problem history", "problem trending", "blast radius", "which entity caused the problem", "problems affecting Kubernetes", "problems by service". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, generic log searching, distributed tracing, or host-level resource monitoring.
description_zh:
DAVIS 问题分析，包括根因识别、影响评估，以及与其它遥测数据的关联。适用于查询或调查已检测到的问题。

触发："active problems"、"root cause analysis"、"problem impact"、"affected users"、"list problems"、"P-12345详情"、"recurring problems"、"problem history"、"problem trending"、"爆炸半径"、"哪个实体导致了该问题"、"problems affecting Kubernetes"、"problems by service"。

不要用于解释现有查询、产品文档问题、通用日志搜索、分布式追踪或主机级别资源监控。

description: Log querying, filtering, pattern analysis, and error rate calculation. Use when searching application or infrastructure logs, analyzing error patterns, or correlating log data. Trigger: "show error logs", "search logs for keyword", "log error rate", "recent errors", "logs from last hour", "find log entries", "top error messages", "log patterns", "parse JSON logs", "logs by process group", "log trends over time", "log entry counts per minute". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, distributed tracing or span analysis (use dt-obs-tracing).
description_zh: 日志查询、过滤、模式分析与错误率计算。用于搜索应用或基础设施日志、分析错误模式或关联日志数据时。触发词："显示错误日志"、"按关键字搜索日志"、"日志错误率"、"近期错误"、"最近一小时的日志"、"查找日志条目"、"错误消息排行"、"日志模式"、"解析 JSON 日志"、"按进程组获取日志"、"随时间变化的日志趋势"、"每分钟日志条目数量"。请勿用于解释现有查询、产品文档问题、分布式追踪或跨度分析（请使用 dt-obs-tracing）。

description: Refactor and review SwiftUI view files with strong defaults for small dedicated subviews, MV-over-MVVM data flow, stable view trees, explicit dependency injection, and correct Observation usage. Use when cleaning up a SwiftUI view, splitting long bodies, removing inline actions or side effects, reducing computed `some View` helpers, or standardizing `@Observable` and view model initialization patterns.
description_zh: 重构并审查具备强默认值的 SwiftUI 视图文件，需涵盖小型专用子视图、MV 在 MVVM 之上的数据流、稳定的视图树、显式依赖注入以及正确的 Observation 使用。适用于清理 SwiftUI 视图、拆分冗长代码体、移除行内操作或副作用、减少计算型 `some View` 辅助视图，或标准化 `@Observable` 与视图模型初始化模式时的使用场景。

description: Query Google NotebookLM notebooks for source-grounded, citation-backed answers from user-uploaded documents. Manages notebook library, handles Google authentication, and supports smart discovery. Works standalone via /blog notebooklm or internally from blog-write and blog-researcher for source-grounded research context. Falls back gracefully when not configured. Use when user says "notebooklm", "notebook", "query notebook", "ask notebook", "notebook research", "source grounded research", "document query", "notebook library".
description_zh: 查询 Google NotebookLM 笔记本，从用户上传的文档中获取基于来源、引用可靠的回答。管理笔记本库，处理 Google 认证，并支持智能发现。可通过 /blog notebooklm 独立运行，或从 blog-write 和 blog-researcher 内部调用，为基于来源的研究场景提供支持。未配置时能够优雅地回退。当用户说“notebooklm”、“notebook”、“query notebook”、“ask notebook”、“notebook research”、“source grounded research”、“document query”、“notebook library”时使用。

description: Keeps a long Claude Code task on-track — breaks out of looping/circular thinking, watches the context budget, bounds internal reasoning, and triggers a clean handoff before the window fills. Use when the model is repeating steps, re-reading the same files, second-guessing in circles, stuck or spinning, or running a long multi-step task at risk of exhausting context. Also use when the user says it is "looping", "going in circles", "stuck", "repeating itself", or asks for a handoff before running out of context.
description_zh: 保持 Claude Code 的长时间任务不偏离轨道——跳出循环/重复性思考，监控上下文预算，约束内部推理，并在上下文窗口填满前触发干净交接。适用于模型重复步骤、反复重读相同文件、在原地反复自我质疑、卡住或陷入循环、或执行较长的多步骤任务存在耗尽上下文的危险时。当用户表示“在循环”“原地打转”“卡住”“重复自身”，或在上下文即将耗尽前要求交接时，也使用。

description: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').
description_zh: 本插件捆绑的4项业务与增长技能路由/索引：客户成功经理（健康评分、流失风险、扩展）、销售工程师（RFP分析、竞争矩阵、PoC规划）、营收运营（销售管道、预测准确性、GTM效率）、合同与提案撰写者。适用于当增长/收入需求并不明显对应某项技能、且你需要选择正确技能时（例如：“哪些账户面临风险”，“我们是否应该对本次RFP进行竞标”）。

description: Specialist in pixel art creation, sprite animation, and limited palette designUse when "pixel art, sprites, sprite sheet, sprite animation, retro game art, 8-bit, 16-bit, character sprites, tile art, pixel animation, aseprite, pixel-art, sprites, animation, game-art, retro, indie-games, 2d-graphics, sprite-sheets" mentioned.
description_zh: 像素艺术创作、精灵动画与有限调色板设计的专家。当提及“像素艺术、精灵、精灵图、精灵动画、复古游戏艺术、8位、16位、角色精灵、瓦片艺术、像素动画、aseprite、像素艺术、精灵、动画、游戏艺术、复古、独立游戏、2D图形、精灵图表”时使用。

description: Convert laboratory instrument output files (PDF, CSV, Excel, TXT) to Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON format or flattened 2D CSV. Use this skill when scientists need to standardize instrument data for LIMS systems, data lakes, or downstream analysis. Supports auto-detection of instrument types. Outputs include full ASM JSON, flattened CSV for easy import, and exportable Python code for data engineers. Common triggers include converting instrument files, standardizing lab data, preparing data for upload to LIMS/ELN systems, or generating parser code for production pipelines.
description_zh: 将实验室仪器输出文件（PDF、CSV、Excel、TXT）转换为Allotrope Simple Model（ASM）JSON格式或展平后的二维CSV。当科学家需要将仪器数据标准化以用于实验室信息管理系统（LIMS）系统、数据湖或下游分析时，请使用此技能。支持仪器类型的自动检测。输出包括完整的ASM JSON、便于导入的展平CSV，以及可供导出的Python代码，供数据工程师使用。常见触发场景包括：转换仪器文件、标准化实验室数据、为上传至LIMS/ELN系统做准备，或为生产流水线生成解析代码。

description: Complete toolkit for senior architect with modern tools and best practices.
description_zh: 面向资深架构师的全套现代化工具与最佳实践工具包

description: Guide for working with Next.js App Router (Next.js 13+). Use when migrating from Pages Router to App Router, creating layouts, implementing routing, handling metadata, or building Next.js 13+ applications. Activates for App Router migration, layout creation, routing patterns, or Next.js 13+ development tasks.
description_zh: Next.js 应用路由（Next.js 13+）使用指南。适用于从 Pages 路由迁移至 App 路由、创建布局、实现路由、处理元数据或构建 Next.js 13+ 应用。适用于 App 路由迁移、布局创建、路由模式或 Next.js 13+ 开发任务。

description: Use for "automate me", "create/update/refresh my -mode skill", "turn/capture my preferences or working style into a skill", or wanting agents to follow how the user works. Drafts or revises a personal -mode skill via create-skill + unslop, optionally pulling fresh evidence from recent transcripts.
description_zh: 适用于执行"自动化我"、"创建/更新/刷新我的 -mode 技能"、"将我的偏好或工作方式转化为技能"，或希望智能体遵循用户工作方式的需求。通过 create-skill + unslop 草拟或修订个人 -mode 技能，并可从近期转录记录中拉取最新证据。

description: Use this skill to review a Lightning Web Component (.html, .js, .css files) for right-to-left (RTL) internationalization correctness, producing a finding list with code-level fixes covering CSS logical properties, bidirectional text handling, keyboard semantics, and RTL-aware SLDS class usage. TRIGGER when the user says "review this LWC for RTL", "audit i18n compliance", "fix bidirectional text rendering", "replace left/right CSS with logical properties", "check RTL layout issues", "verify SLDS RTL classes", "review my component for Arabic/Hebrew layout", "ensure this LWC works in RTL locales", or "check bidi text handling". DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is building a new LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), refactoring SLDS classes themselves (use design-systems-slds-apply or design-systems-slds2-migrate), or performing accessibility/security review.
description_zh:
使用本技能对 Lightning Web 组件（.html、.js、.css 文件）进行从右到左（RTL）国际化正确性审查，生成包含代码级修复的发现列表，涵盖 CSS 逻辑属性、双向文本处理、键盘语义以及 RTL 感知的 SLDS 类使用。

触发条件：当用户说出“审查此 LWC 的 RTL 设置”、“审计 i18n 合规性”、“修复双向文本渲染问题”、“用逻辑属性替换左/右 CSS”、“检查 RTL 布局问题”、“验证 SLDS 的 RTL 类”、“审查我的组件在阿拉伯语/希伯来语布局方面的情况”、“确保此 LWC 在 RTL 语言区域中可用”或“检查双向文本处理”时。

当用户正在构建新的 LWC（使用 experience-lwc-generate）、重构 SLDS 类本身（使用 design-systems-slds-apply 或 design-systems-slds2-migrate），或进行无障碍/安全审查时，请勿触发。

description: When the user wants to create Reddit post copy, comments, or optimize for Reddit. Also use when the user mentions "Reddit post," "subreddit," "r/," "Reddit marketing," "post to Reddit," "Reddit thread," "Reddit comment," "Reddit copy," "Reddit content," or "Reddit engagement." For Reddit ads, use reddit-ads.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建 Reddit 帖子文案、评论或针对 Reddit 进行优化时。当用户提到“Reddit 帖子”、“子版块”、“r/”、“Reddit 营销”、“发布到 Reddit”、“Reddit 帖子或线程”、“Reddit 评论”、“Reddit 文案”、“Reddit 内容”或“Reddit 互动”时，也请使用。对于 Reddit 广告，使用 reddit-ads。

description: When the user wants to plan, create, or repurpose visual content (images, infographics, social post images) across channels. Also use when the user mentions "content images," "social media images," "infographic," "visual content," "post image," "image specs," "visual repurposing," "content visuals," or "image for social post." For Pinterest, use pinterest-posts.
description_zh: 当用户希望跨渠道规划、创建或重新利用视觉内容（图片、信息图、社交帖子图片）时，使用相应功能。同时，当用户提到“content images”、“social media images”、“infographic”、“visual content”、“post image”、“image specs”、“visual repurposing”、“content visuals”或“image for social post”时，也使用相应功能。针对Pinterest，使用pinterest-posts。

description: Build Chrome extensions with Manifest V3. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Chrome extension, browser extension, manifest.json, content script, service worker (in extension context), popup, side panel, chrome.runtime, chrome.tabs, chrome.storage, chrome.scripting, or any Chrome extension API. Also trigger when the user wants to inject scripts into web pages, communicate between page and background, bypass CSP from a content script, build an RPC layer over chrome messaging, or publish to the Chrome Web Store. Covers both new extension projects and adding features to existing ones. Do NOT use for CRXJS/Vite-based builds with HMR — use samber/cc-skills@crxjs instead.
description_zh: 使用 Manifest V3 构建 Chrome 扩展。当用户提及 Chrome 扩展、浏览器扩展、manifest.json、内容脚本、service worker（在扩展上下文内）、弹窗、侧边栏、chrome.runtime、chrome.tabs、chrome.storage、chrome.scripting 或任何 Chrome 扩展 API 时，请使用本技能。当用户希望向网页注入脚本、在页面与扩展后台之间进行通信、从内容脚本绕过 CSP、基于 chrome 消息构建 RPC 层，或发布至 Chrome Web Store 时，也需触发本技能。本技能既适用于全新扩展项目的构建，也适用于为现有扩展添加功能。请勿用于基于 CRXJS/Vite 并使用 HMR 的构建——请使用 samber/cc-skills@crxjs 替代。

description: Start and scale networked products using Andrew Chen's "The Cold Start Problem" framework for network effects. Use when the user mentions "network effects", "chicken and egg", "cold start", "two-sided marketplace", "atomic network", "hard side", "liquidity", "critical mass", "invite-only launch", "how do I get my first users", or "the marketplace has no buyers or sellers". Also trigger when launching a marketplace, social, or collaboration product that is worthless without other users, deciding launch sequencing and seeding tactics, or diagnosing stalled network growth at scale. Covers the five stages: cold start, tipping point, escape velocity, hitting the ceiling, and the moat. For word-of-mouth virality, see contagious. For habit-driven retention, see hooked-ux.
description_zh: 使用安德鲁·陈的《冷启动问题》框架，基于网络效应，启动并扩展网络化产品。当用户提及“网络效应”、“鸡和蛋”、“冷启动”、“双边市场”、“原子网络”、“硬侧”、“流动性”、“临界质量”、“邀请制首发”、“我如何获取首批用户”或“该市场没有买家或卖家”时，使用此框架。当推出在无其他用户情况下毫无价值的市场、社交或协作产品，决定发布顺序与种子策略，或诊断大规模网络增长停滞时，也应触发。该框架涵盖五个阶段：冷启动、临界点、逃逸速度、触及天花板与护城河。针对口碑病毒式传播，参见 contagious。针对习惯驱动留存，参见 hooked-ux。

description: Use this skill when the user wants a systematic literature review, survey, or synthesis across multiple academic papers on a topic. Also covers annotated bibliographies and cross-paper comparisons. Searches arXiv and outputs reports in APA, IEEE, or BibTeX format. Not for single-paper tasks — use academic-paper-review for reviewing one paper.
description_zh: 当用户需要针对某一主题对多篇学术论文进行系统性文献综述、综述或综合分析时，请使用本技能。该技能还涵盖注释文献目录及跨论文比较。检索 arXiv，并以 APA、IEEE 或 BibTeX 格式输出报告。不适用于单篇论文任务——审阅单篇论文时请使用 academic-paper-review。

description: 使用并行子代理为模块生成多个显著不同的接口设计。适用于用户想设计 API、探索接口选项、比较模块形状，或提到 “design it twice” 时。
description_zh: 使用并行子代理为模块生成多个显著不同的接口设计。适用于用户想设计 API、探索接口选项、比较模块形状，或提到“design it twice”时。

description: Delegation mode for open-code-review (OCR). Instead of OCR calling an LLM endpoint, this skill instructs the host agent to perform the code review itself, using OCR only for deterministic engineering: file selection and rule resolution. Use when the host agent should drive the review with its own LLM capabilities.
description_zh: 开放代码审查（OCR）的委托模式。而非 OCR 调用大语言模型（LLM）接口，本技能指示宿主代理自主执行代码审查，仅利用 OCR 进行确定性工程：文件选择与规则解析。适用于宿主代理需以其自身的大语言模型能力驱动审查的场景。

description: Iterate on the Cardputer-Adv MicroPython app bundle (Claude Buddy, Snake, Hello) after the device is already provisioned via m5-onboard. Use when the user wants to add a new app, push a single changed .py without re-flashing, watch device serial logs, or run a one-shot REPL command. Trigger on "add an app", "push to the cardputer", "tail the device", "run on the device", or follow-up work after /maker-setup.
description_zh: 在设备已通过 m5-onboard 完成配置后，迭代 Cardputer-Adv MicroPython 应用包（Claude Buddy、Snake、Hello）。当用户需要添加新应用、在不重新刷机的前提下推送单个修改后的 .py 文件、查看设备串口日志或执行一次性 REPL 命令时使用。触发条件包括"添加应用"、"推送到 Cardputer"、"跟踪设备"、"在设备上运行"，或在 /maker-setup 之后的后续工作中。

description: Comprehensive security and correctness audit of a branch's changes. Use for thermo nuclear, thermonuclear, or deep review requests, or branch/PR diff audits focused on bugs, breaking changes, security issues, devex regressions, and feature-gate leaks.
description_zh: 分支变更的全面安全与正确性审计，适用于热核、热核或深度审查请求，或针对缺陷、破坏性变更、安全问题、devex回归和特性门泄漏等开展分支/PR差异审计。

description: Search Europe PMC for scientific literature and download open-access full texts and PDFs. Retrieve full-text XML/plain text by PMCID, get citation lists and bibliography.
description_zh: 在 Europe PMC 中检索科研文献，下载开放获取全文和 PDF 文件。通过 PMCID 检索全文 XML/纯文本，获取引用列表和参考文献。

description: End-to-end onboarding for a freshly-plugged-in M5Stack ESP32 device (Cardputer, Cardputer-Adv, Core, CoreS3, Stick) — detect on USB, flash UIFlow 2.0 firmware, and install the Claude Buddy MicroPython app bundle. Use whenever the user plugs in or wants to flash/provision/reset an M5Stack or ESP32 board, or says "m5-onboard go".
description_zh: 刚接入的 M5Stack ESP32 设备（Cardputer、Cardputer-Adv、Core、CoreS3、Stick）端到端引导：检测 USB 连接、刷写 UIFlow 2.0 固件，并安装 Claude Buddy MicroPython 应用包。用户插拔设备、需要刷写、配置或重置 M5Stack 或 ESP32 板卡，或说出“m5-onboard go”时，即可使用。

description: Top-level workflow skill for USD performance diagnosis and optimization. Handles slow loading, high memory, low FPS, and broad scene-optimization requests; delegates auth/runtime setup to Phase 0 owners.
description_zh: USD性能诊断与优化顶层工作流技能。负责处理加载缓慢、内存占用高、低FPS及广泛场景优化请求；将认证/运行时设置委托给阶段0负责人。

description: CloudBase WeChat Mini Program native authentication guide. This skill should be used when users need mini program identity handling, OPENID/UNIONID access, or `wx.cloud` auth behavior in projects where login is native and automatic.
description_zh: CloudBase 微信小程序原生鉴权指南。当用户在登录为原生且自动的项目中需要小程序身份处理、OPENID/UNIONID 访问、或 `wx.cloud` 鉴权行为时，应使用本技能。

description: 交互式 QA 会话，用户以对话方式报告缺陷或问题，代理创建 GitHub issues。后台探索代码库以获取上下文和领域语言。适用于用户想报告缺陷、执行 QA、以对话方式提交 issues，或提到 “QA session” 时。
description_zh: 交互式 QA 会话，用户以对话方式报告缺陷或问题，代理创建 GitHub 问题。后台探索代码库以获取上下文和领域语言。适用于用户想报告缺陷、执行 QA、以对话方式提交问题，或提到“QA 会话”时。

description: Work with Dynatrace notebooks - create, modify, query, and analyze notebook JSON including sections, DQL queries, and visualizations.
description_zh: 与 Dynatrace 笔记本协作——创建、修改、查询和分析笔记本 JSON，包括章节、DQL 查询和可视化。

description: Add a new expert to the Remotion experts page
description_zh: 向 Remotion 专家页面添加一名新专家

description: 通过重组章节、提升清晰度、收紧文字来编辑并改进文章。适用于用户想编辑、修订或改进文章草稿时。
description_zh: 通过重组章节、提升清晰度、收紧文字来编辑并改进文章。适用于用户编辑、修订或改进文章草稿时。

description:
Football (soccer) data across the world's major leagues — standings, schedules, match stats, xG, transfers, player profiles, head-to-head history, team strength (Elo), and match forecasts. Zero config, no API keys. Covers Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, MLS, Champions League, World Cup, Championship, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Serie A Brazil, Russian Premier League, Scottish/Belgian/Turkish top flights, European Championship, and more (call get_competitions for the live list).

Use when: user asks about football/soccer standings, fixtures, match stats, xG, lineups, player values, transfers, injury news, league tables, daily fixtures, player profiles, head-to-head records, team strength/Elo ratings, or match odds/forecasts.
Don't use when: user asks about American football/NFL (use nfl-data), college football (use cfb-data), NBA (use nba-data), WNBA (use wnba-data), college basketball (use cbb-data), NHL (use nhl-data), MLB (use mlb-data), tennis (use tennis-data), golf (use golf-data), cricket (use cricket-data), Formula 1 (use fastf1), or betting odds (use polymarket or kalshi). Don't use for live/real-time scores — data updates post-match. Don't use get_season_leaders or get_missing_players for non-Premier League leagues (they return empty). Don't use get_event_xg for leagues outside the top 5 (EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1).
description_zh:
覆盖全球主要联赛的足球（ soccer ）数据——积分榜、赛程、比赛统计、xG、转会、球员资料、交锋历史、球队实力（Elo）和比赛预测。零配置，无需API密钥。覆盖英超、西甲、德甲、意甲、法甲、MLS、欧冠、世界杯、英冠、荷甲、葡超、巴西甲级联赛、俄罗斯足球甲级联赛、苏格兰/比利时/土耳其顶级联赛、欧洲锦标赛等更多联赛（调用 get_competitions 获取实时列表）。

使用场景：当用户询问足球/ soccer 积分榜、赛程、比赛统计、xG、阵容、球员价值、转会、伤情新闻、联赛排名、每日赛程、球员资料、交锋记录、球队实力/Elo评分，或比赛赔率/预测时使用。

不适用场景：当用户询问美式橄榄球/NFL（使用 nfl-data）、大学橄榄球（使用 cfb-data）、NBA（使用 nba-data）、WNBA（使用 wnba-data）、大学篮球（使用 cbb-data）、NHL（使用 nhl-data）、MLB（使用 mlb-data）、网球（使用 tennis-data）、高尔夫（使用 golf-data）、板球（使用 cricket-data）、一级方程式赛车（使用 fastf1），或投注赔率（使用 polymarket 或 kalshi）时，不要使用。不要用于实时比分——数据在赛后更新。不要对非英超联赛使用 get_season_leaders 或 get_missing_players（它们返回空结果）。不要对前五联赛以外的联赛使用 get_event_xg（英超、西甲、德甲、意甲、法甲）。

description: 在 Obsidian vault 中使用 wikilinks 和索引笔记搜索、创建并管理笔记。适用于用户想在 Obsidian 中查找、创建或组织笔记时。
description_zh: 在 Obsidian 库中使用 wiki 链接和索引笔记进行搜索、创建和管理笔记。适用于用户希望在 Obsidian 中查找、创建或组织笔记时。

description: Vite build tool configuration, plugin API, SSR, and Vite 8 Rolldown migration. Use when working with Vite projects, vite.config.ts, Vite plugins, or building libraries/SSR apps with Vite.
description_zh: Vite 构建工具配置、插件 API、SSR 以及 Vite 8 Rolldown 迁移。适用于在 Vite 项目、vite.config.ts、Vite 插件或通过 Vite 构建库/SSR 应用时使用。

description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改并改进现有技能，并评估技能表现。当用户需要从零开始创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能，运行评估以测试技能，使用方差分析对技能表现进行基准化，或优化技能描述以提升触发准确性时使用。

description: 使用 tracer-bullet 垂直切片，把计划、规格或 PRD 拆成项目 issue tracker 上可独立领取的 issues。适用于用户想把计划转成 issues、创建实现议题，或把工作拆成 issues 时。
description_zh: 使用 tracer-bullet 进行垂直切片，将计划、规格或 PRD 拆分为项目 issue tracker 上可独立领取的 issues。适用于用户需要将计划转换为 issues、创建实现议题，或将工作拆分为 issues 的场景。

description: 중앙선거관리위원회 선거통계시스템 공개 통합검색으로 한국 지방선거 후보자 정보를 이름/선거종류/지역 기준으로 조회한다.
description_zh: 通过中央选举管理委员会选举统计系统的公开综合检索，以姓名、选举种类、地区为基准查询韩国地方选举候选人信息。

description: Build macroeconomic and rates dashboards combining macro indicators, yield curves, inflation breakevens, and swap rates. Use when monitoring macro conditions, analyzing yield curve shape, decomposing real vs nominal rates, assessing policy rate expectations, or evaluating financial conditions.
description_zh: 构建融合宏观经济指标、收益率曲线、通胀盈亏平衡收益率及互换利率的宏观经济与利率看板。用于监测宏观条件、分析收益率曲线形态、分解实际利率与名义利率、评估政策利率预期，或评估金融条件。

description: Entrypoint for building, upgrading, and finishing Three.js browser games. Routes work across the sibling threejs-* skills for gameplay, graphics, UI, 3D/image/audio asset generation, debugging, and release. Use for build-a-game, upgrade, polish, premium, AAA, high-fidelity, showcase, from-scratch, endless runner, arcade, action, and release-ready requests.
description_zh: Three.js 浏览器游戏的构建、升级与完善入口。路由覆盖兄弟 threejs-* 技能，涵盖游戏玩法、图形、UI、3D/图片/音频素材生成、调试与发布等环节。适用于构建游戏、升级、打磨、高级、AAA、高保真、展示、从零、无尽跑酷、街机、动作以及发布就绪等需求。

description: Use when converting an existing JavaScript Lightning Web Component (.js, .html, .css) to TypeScript with full type annotations and a matching `.d.ts` file that exposes only the component's `@api` surface. TRIGGER when the user says "convert LWC to TypeScript", "migrate LWC to TS", "rename .js to .ts for this component", "add types to my LWC", "generate .d.ts for this LWC", "type-annotate @api properties", or "produce declare module 'c/componentName' definitions". DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is authoring a brand-new LWC from scratch (use experience-lwc-generate), generating Jest tests for an existing LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), or migrating an Aura component to LWC.
description_zh: 在将现有 JavaScript Lightning Web Component（.js、.html、.css）转换为 TypeScript，并添加完整类型标注及匹配的 `.d.ts` 文件（仅暴露组件的 `@api` 接口）时使用。当用户说“convert LWC to TypeScript”、“migrate LWC to TS”、“rename .js to .ts for this component”、“add types to my LWC”、“generate .d.ts for this LWC”、“type-annotate @api properties”或“produce declare module 'c/componentName' definitions”时触发。当用户从零开始编写新的 LWC（应使用 experience-lwc-generate）、为现有 LWC 生成 Jest 测试（应使用 experience-lwc-generate）或将 Aura 组件迁移为 LWC 时，不要触发。

description: Optimize strategy parameters using VectorBT. Tests parameter combinations and generates heatmaps.
description_zh: 使用 VectorBT 优化策略参数。测试参数组合并生成热图。

description: Use only to generate or update a governance skill card for a specified existing agent skill directory. Do not use for explaining, listing, comparing, or discussing skill capabilities.
description_zh: 仅用于为指定的现有智能体技能目录生成或更新治理技能卡片。不得用于解释、列出、比较或讨论技能能力。

description: Turn a person photo + a product photo + an optional script into a vertical 9:16 UGC-style video ad. Generates a lifestyle hero image (Nano-Banana Pro Edit), then animates it with native audio using Seedance 2.0 VIP image-to-video.
description_zh: 将一张人物照片、一张产品照片以及（可选的）脚本，转化为垂直9:16的UGC风格视频广告。通过Nano-Banana Pro Edit生成生活方式主视觉图，再使用Seedance 2.0 VIP图像转视频功能，为画面添加原生音频并完成动画处理。

description: Use when working with color naming, color theory, color spaces, color definitions, or any task involving color knowledge - palettes, ramps, gradients, conversions, accessibility, perceptual matching, pigment mixing, print-vs-screen color, CSS color syntax, or historical color terminology. Use this skill whenever the user is choosing, comparing, generating, naming, converting, or explaining colors, even if they do not explicitly ask for "color theory."
description_zh: 适用于处理颜色命名、色彩理论、色彩空间、颜色定义，或任何涉及色彩知识的工作——调色板、色阶、渐变、转换、无障碍、感知匹配、颜料混合、打印与屏幕色彩、CSS 颜色语法，或历史色彩术语。每当用户选择、比较、生成、命名、转换或解释颜色时，请使用本技能，即使用户没有明确要求“色彩理论”。

description: Use when making code changes to ensure they pass VS Code's hygiene checks. Covers the pre-commit hook, unicode restrictions, string quoting rules, copyright headers, indentation, formatting, ESLint, and stylelint. Run the hygiene check before declaring work complete.
description_zh: 在修改代码时使用，以确保其通过 VS Code 卫生检查。涵盖提交前钩子、Unicode 限制、字符串引用规则、版权页眉、缩进、格式化和 ESLint、stylelint。在宣布工作完成前运行卫生检查。

description: Find and fix issues from Sentry using MCP. Use when asked to fix Sentry errors, debug production issues, investigate exceptions, or resolve bugs reported in Sentry. Methodically analyzes stack traces, breadcrumbs, traces, and context to identify root causes.
description_zh: 使用 MCP 从 Sentry 查找并修复问题。当被要求修复 Sentry 错误、排查生产环境问题、调查异常或解决 Sentry 中报告的缺陷时使用。系统地分析堆栈追踪、面包屑、追踪信息及上下文，以识别根本原因。

description: Build robust backend systems with modern technologies (Node.js, Python, Go, Rust), frameworks (NestJS, FastAPI, Django), databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis), APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), authentication (OAuth 2.1, JWT), testing strategies, security best practices (OWASP Top 10), performance optimization, scalability patterns (microservices, caching, sharding), DevOps practices (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), and monitoring. Use when designing APIs, implementing authentication, optimizing database queries, setting up CI/CD pipelines, handling security vulnerabilities, building microservices, or developing production-ready backend systems.
description_zh: 使用现代技术（Node.js、Python、Go、Rust）、框架（NestJS、FastAPI、Django）、数据库（PostgreSQL、MongoDB、Redis）、API（REST、GraphQL、gRPC）、认证（OAuth 2.1、JWT）、测试策略、安全最佳实践（OWASP Top 10）、性能优化、扩展模式（微服务、缓存、分片）、DevOps 实践（Docker、Kubernetes、CI/CD）及监控，构建健壮的后端系统。适用于设计API、实现认证、优化数据库查询、配置CI/CD流水线、处理安全漏洞、构建微服务或开发生产级后端系统时使用。

description: Review the current branch for bugs, intent fit, and test coverage; run or write tests; commit focused work; open or update a PR.
description_zh: 审查当前分支的缺陷、意图符合度和测试覆盖率；运行或编写测试；提交聚焦的工作；打开或更新一个PR。

description: Manage shell hooks — user scripts that run at agent lifecycle points to block, rewrite, or warn on actions, via the /hooks command.
description_zh: 管理 Shell 钩子——在智能体生命周期节点运行的脚本，用于对操作进行阻止、改写或警告，通过 /hooks 命令进行管理。

description: Manage for output using Grove's "High Output Management": a manager's output is their organization's output, raised by high-leverage activities. Use when the user mentions "high output management", "managerial leverage", "one-on-ones", "1:1 agenda", "OKRs", "performance review", "task-relevant maturity", "delegation", "meeting overload", "new manager", "how do I run a 1:1", or "just got promoted to manager". Also trigger when structuring a manager's calendar and meeting cadence, designing team metrics, running planning, coaching delegation, or preparing performance reviews. Covers leverage, production principles, meetings as the medium of management, decisions, OKRs, and task-relevant maturity. For intrinsic motivation, see drive-motivation. For a company operating system, see traction-eos.
description_zh: 使用 Grove 的“High Output Management”进行产出管理：管理者的产出即为其组织的产出，通过高杠杆活动得以提升。当用户提及“high output management”、“managerial leverage”、“one-on-ones”、“1:1 agenda”、“OKRs”、“performance review”、“task-relevant maturity”、“delegation”、“meeting overload”、“new manager”、“how do I run a 1:1”，或“just got promoted to manager”时使用。当构建管理者的日程安排与会议节奏、设计团队指标、开展规划、指导委派或准备绩效评估时，也应触发。涵盖杠杆、产出原则、会议作为管理媒介、决策、OKRs 以及任务相关成熟度。关于内在动力，见 drive-motivation。关于企业操作系统，见 traction-eos。

description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
description_zh: 审查UI代码是否符合网页界面指南合规要求。当被要求执行“审查我的UI”、“检查可访问性”、“审计设计”、“审查UX”或“检查我的网站是否符合最佳实践”时使用。

description: Vehicle routing (VRP, TSP, PDP) with cuOpt — Python API only. Use when the user is building or solving routing in Python.
description_zh: 基于 cuOpt 的车辆路径规划（VRP、TSP、PDP）——仅支持 Python API。适用于用户在 Python 中构建或求解路径规划的场景。

description: Influence and negotiation toolkit for any interaction needing another person's agreement, even when the user never says 'negotiation'. Covers B2B sales, salary reviews and raise asks, collective bargaining and unions, hard 1:1s, recruitment closes, cross-cultural deals, mediation, and diplomatic messages — declining, pushing back on scope, justifying a delay, raising a concern, getting alignment. Use when the user says 'they just said X, what do I say' or 'draft a reply', or mentions a buyer, champion, procurement, RFP, sponsor, HR, union, or candidate, or a pushback, refusal, ghosting, no-decision, escalation, fixed budget, counter-offer, comp band, strike, BATNA, anchor, or concession.
description_zh: 适用于任何需要他人同意的互动（即便用户从未提及“谈判”）的影响力与谈判工具包。涵盖 B2B 销售、薪资审查与调薪请求、集体谈判与工会、严格的 1:1 会议、招聘结案、跨文化商务合作、调解以及外交沟通——包括婉拒、对范围提出异议、为延期提供正当理由、提出顾虑以及达成共识。当用户说“他们刚说了 X，我该怎么说”或“起草回复”，或提及买家、关键人、采购、RFP、赞助人、HR、工会或候选人，或涉及反对意见、拒绝、无故失联、不决策、升级、固定预算、反要约、薪酬级别、罢工、BATNA、锚定或让步时使用。

description: 通过用户访谈创建带小提交的详细重构计划，然后作为 GitHub issue 提交。适用于用户想规划重构、创建重构 RFC，或把重构拆成安全的增量步骤时。
description_zh: 通过用户访谈创建包含小提交的详细重构计划，然后作为 GitHub issue 提交。适用于用户想规划重构、创建重构 RFC，或把重构拆分为安全的增量步骤时。

description: Semantic topic cluster planning and automated execution engine for claude-blog. Performs SERP-based keyword research, groups keywords by search intent and SERP overlap, builds a hub-and-spoke cluster architecture, generates an interactive SVG cluster map, and executes the full cluster by orchestrating blog-write calls with shared cluster context and automatic internal-link injection. Fills the strategy-to-execution gap: blog-strategy plans the blueprint, blog-cluster builds the house. Use when user says "blog cluster", "topic cluster", "content cluster", "cluster plan", "cluster execute", "pillar content", "hub and spoke", "content ecosystem", "cluster map".
description_zh: 用于 claude-blog 的语义主题集群规划与自动化执行引擎。执行基于 SERP 的关键词研究，根据搜索意图和 SERP 重叠度对关键词进行分组，构建中枢-辐射集群架构，生成可交互的 SVG 集群地图，并通过编排博客撰写调用、共享集群上下文并自动注入内链来执行整个集群。填补策略到执行的差距：blog-strategy 规划蓝图，blog-cluster 建造房屋。当用户说出“blog cluster”、“topic cluster”、“content cluster”、“cluster plan”、“cluster execute”、“pillar content”、“hub and spoke”、“content ecosystem”、“cluster map”时使用。

description: Delegate menial, well-scoped coding tasks to a cheap Qwen-backed subagent via the `claude-9arm` command instead of burning Claude tokens/quota. Use when the work is mechanical and low-risk — bulk renames, formatting, boilerplate, find-replace, grep-style search & summarization, reading/condensing logs or files, test/docstring/comment scaffolding, or running builds/linters/tests and reporting pass-fail. Also use when the user says "use qwen", "delegate this", "send it to 9arm/qwen", or "do this cheaply". Do NOT use for architecture, design, debugging judgment, security-sensitive edits, or anything needing this conversation's context.
description_zh: 通过 `claude-9arm` 命令，将琐碎且范围明确的编码任务委托给经济实惠的基于 Qwen 的子代理，而非消耗 Claude 的 token 与额度。适用于工作内容属于机械性且低风险的任务，例如：批量重命名、格式化、生成样板代码、查找替换、grep 风格的搜索与摘要、读取/精简日志或文件、搭建测试/文档字符串/注释的基础结构，以及运行构建、代码检查器/测试并报告通过/失败状态。此外，当用户表述为“使用 qwen”、“将此任务委托出去”、“发送给 9arm/qwen”或“以低成本完成此任务”时，也应使用。严禁用于架构、设计、调试判断、涉及安全敏感性的修改，或任何需要本对话上下文的场景。
