description: Redis development best practices for caching, data structures, and high-performance key-value operations
description_zh: Redis缓存、数据结构及高性能键值操作开发最佳实践

description: Analyze MSBuild binary logs to diagnose build failures. USE FOR: build errors that are unclear from console output, diagnosing cascading failures across multi-project builds, tracing MSBuild target execution order, and generally any MSBuild build issues. Requires an existing .binlog file. DO NOT USE FOR: generating binlogs (use binlog-generation), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
分析 MSBuild 二进制日志，以诊断构建失败。

适用场景：处理从控制台输出中难以清晰辨别的构建错误、诊断多项目构建中的级联失败、追踪 MSBuild 目标执行顺序，以及处理各类 MSBuild 构建问题。

需要已有 .binlog 文件。

不可用于：生成二进制日志（请使用 binlog-generation）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: Lightweight 3D effects for decorative elements and micro-interactions using Zdog, Vanta.js, and Vanilla-Tilt.js. Use this skill when adding pseudo-3D illustrations, animated backgrounds, parallax tilt effects, decorative 3D elements, or subtle depth effects without heavy frameworks. Triggers on tasks involving Zdog pseudo-3D, Vanta.js backgrounds, Vanilla-Tilt parallax, card tilt effects, hero section animations, or lightweight landing page visuals. Ideal for performance-focused designs.
description_zh: 使用 Zdog、Vanta.js 和 Vanilla-Tilt.js 实现的用于装饰元素和微交互的轻量级 3D 效果。当为伪 3D 插画、动态背景、视差倾斜效果、装饰性 3D 元素或微妙深度效果添加内容，且无需使用重型框架时，使用此技能。适用于涉及 Zdog 伪 3D、Vanta.js 背景、Vanilla-Tilt 视差、卡片倾斜效果、首屏动画或轻量级落地页视觉的任务。非常适合注重性能的设计。

description:
WeRead-inspired HyperFrames video template for vertical annual reading reports,
personal reading dashboards, book-note recaps, and shareable year-in-review
stories. Use when users want a 9:16 HTML-to-MP4 reading report with warm paper
texture, editorial Chinese typography, book-page metaphors, data highlights,
and deterministic motion.
description_zh: 受WeRead启发的HyperFrames竖版视频模板，适用于年度阅读报告、个人阅读仪表盘、读书笔记回顾及可分享的年度回顾故事。适用于用户需要9:16 HTML转MP4阅读报告的场景，具备温暖的纸张质感、编辑级中文排版、书本页面隐喻、数据亮点与确定性动效。

description: One-command multilingual blog creation. Writes a blog post, translates it into user-specified languages, applies cultural adaptation, and emits hreflang tags, sitemap entries, and a CMS-ready language map. The complete write-to-publish pipeline for international content. Orchestrates blog-write, blog-translate, blog-localize, and (optionally) seo-hreflang. Use when user says "multilingual blog", "blog multilingual", "write in multiple languages", "international blog", "mehrsprachiger Blog", "blog multilingue", "blog multilingue", "create blog in German and French".
description_zh: 一键式多语言博客创建。撰写博客文章，将其翻译成用户指定语言，应用文化适配，并输出 hreflang 标签、站点地图条目和 CMS 就绪的语言映射。面向国际内容的完整撰写到发布流水线。统筹博客撰写、博客翻译、博客本地化，以及（可选的）seo-hreflang。当用户说出“multilingual blog”、“blog multilingual”、“write in multiple languages”、“international blog”、“mehrsprachiger Blog”、“blog multilingue”、“blog multilingue”或“create blog in German and French”时使用。

description: PROACTIVELY use whenever the user needs data outside your training set or requires a live network call — web search, URL scraping, news, social media (any platform), market prices (crypto/stocks/FX), on-chain data, e-commerce product data, business/company data, weather, travel (flights/hotels). The provider catalog is dynamic and grows over time; if unsure whether a provider exists, call find_tools first to discover it. Not needed for conceptual, code, or local-file work.
description_zh: 应主动使用，当用户需要训练集之外的数据或需要实时网络调用时——网络搜索、URL 抓取、新闻、社交媒体（任何平台）、市场行情（加密货币/股票/外汇）、链上数据、电子商务产品数据、商业/公司数据、天气、旅行（航班/酒店）。提供商目录是动态的，并随时间增长；如果不确定是否存在提供商，请先调用 find_tools 进行发现。不适用于概念、代码或本地文件工作。

description: 编写和编辑优秀 skills 的参考：让技能可预测的词汇和原则。
description_zh: 编写和编辑优秀 skills 的参考：使技能具备可预测性的词汇和原则。

description:
Vision-driven HarmonyOS NEXT device automation using Midscene. Operates entirely from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels required. Can interact with all visible elements on screen regardless of technology stack. Control HarmonyOS devices with natural language commands via HDC. Perform taps, swipes, text input, app launches, screenshots, and more.
Trigger keywords: harmony, harmonyos, 鸿蒙, hdc, huawei device, harmony app, harmony automation, harmony phone, harmony tablet, test harmony app, verify on harmonyos, QA on 鸿蒙, check the app on harmony, test on huawei device, see if the app works on harmony, end-to-end test on harmonyos, visual verification on 鸿蒙
Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)
description_zh:
使用 Midscene 的视觉驱动 HarmonyOS NEXT 设备自动化。完全基于截图运行——无需 DOM 或无障碍标签。无论技术栈如何，均可与屏幕上的所有可见元素进行交互。通过 HDC 使用自然语言命令控制 HarmonyOS 设备。执行点击、滑动、文本输入、应用启动、截图等操作。

触发关键词：鸿蒙、HarmonyOS、鸿蒙、HDC、华为设备、鸿蒙应用、鸿蒙自动化、鸿蒙手机、鸿蒙平板、测试鸿蒙应用、在 HarmonyOS 上验证、鸿蒙环境 QA、在鸿蒙上检查应用、在华为设备上测试、检查应用是否在鸿蒙上正常运行、在 HarmonyOS 上进行端到端测试、鸿蒙视觉验证

由 Midscene.js 提供支持（https://midscenejs.com）

description: Interactive training for the GitHub Copilot CLI. Guided lessons, quizzes, scenario challenges, and a full reference covering slash commands, shortcuts, modes, agents, skills, MCP, and configuration. Say "cliexpert" to start.
description_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 的交互式培训。提供指导课程、测验、场景挑战，以及涵盖斜杠命令、快捷键、模式、智能体、技能、MCP 及配置的完整参考资料。输入“cliexpert”即可开始。

description: Create beautiful, performant SVG animations and illustrations. Use this skill when the user asks to create SVG graphics, icons, illustrations, animated logos, path animations, morphing shapes, loading spinners, or any animated SVG content. Covers SMIL animations, CSS-driven SVG animation, path drawing effects, shape morphing, motion paths, gradients, masks, and filters.
description_zh: 创建精美、性能优化的 SVG 动画与插画。当用户要求创建 SVG 图形、图标、插画、动态 Logo、路径动画、形状变形、加载旋转器等任何动态 SVG 内容时，请使用此技能。涵盖 SMIL 动画、CSS 驱动的 SVG 动画、路径绘制效果、形状变形、运动路径、渐变、遮罩和滤镜。

description: Service performance monitoring with RED metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration) and runtime-specific telemetry for Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, and Go. Use when analyzing service health, SLA compliance, or runtime issues. Trigger: "service response time", "error rate", "throughput", "SLA compliance", "service mesh overhead", "JVM GC", "Java heap", "Node.js event loop", ".NET CLR", "Python threads", "PHP OPcache", "Go goroutines", "service performance", "p95 latency", "request failures", "database response time by name". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, infrastructure metrics (use dt-obs-hosts), log analysis (use dt-obs-logs), or distributed tracing workflows (use dt-obs-tracing).
description_zh: 支持对 Java、.NET、Node.js、Python、PHP 和 Go 进行服务性能监控，内置 RED 指标（Rate, Errors, Duration，即速率、错误率、持续时间）与运行时特定遥测。该功能用于分析服务健康、SLA 合规性或运行时问题。触发条件：“服务响应时间”、“错误率”、“吞吐量”、“SLA 合规性”、“服务网格开销”、“JVM 垃圾回收（GC）”、“Java 堆”、“Node.js 事件循环”、“.NET 公共语言运行时（CLR）”、“Python 线程”、“PHP OPcache”、“Go 协程（goroutine）”、“服务性能”、“P95 延迟”、“请求失败”、“按名称的数据库响应时间”。不得用于解释现有查询、产品文档问题、基础设施指标（使用 dt-obs-hosts）、日志分析（使用 dt-obs-logs）或分布式追踪工作流（使用 dt-obs-tracing）。

description: Distributed traces, spans, service dependencies, and request flow analysis. Use when investigating span-level details, failures, performance bottlenecks, or trace correlation. Trigger: "trace analysis", "slow requests", "failed spans", "service dependencies", "distributed trace", "span details", "HTTP status codes in traces", "database query spans", "messaging spans", "gRPC calls", "Lambda cold starts", "trace ID lookup", "exception analysis", "correlate logs and traces", "request attributes". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation or configuration questions, service-level RED metrics (use dt-obs-services), log searching (use dt-obs-logs), or problem analysis (use dt-obs-problems).
description_zh: 分布式追踪、跨度、服务依赖与请求流程分析。用于调查跨度级细节、故障、性能瓶颈或追踪关联。触发：“追踪分析”、“慢请求”、“失败跨度”、“服务依赖”、“分布式追踪”、“跨度详情”、“追踪中的 HTTP 状态码”、“数据库查询跨度”、“消息传递跨度”、“gRPC 调用”、“Lambda 冷启动”、“追踪 ID 查询”、“异常分析”、“关联日志与追踪”、“请求属性”。不得用于解释现有查询、产品文档或配置问题、服务级 RED 指标（使用 dt-obs-services）、日志检索（使用 dt-obs-logs）或问题分析（使用 dt-obs-problems）。

description: State machine-based vector animation with runtime interactivity and web integration. Use this skill when creating interactive animations, state-driven UI, animated components with logic, or designer-created animations with runtime control. Triggers on tasks involving Rive, state machines, interactive vector animations, animation with input handling, ViewModel data binding, or React Rive integration. Alternative to Lottie for animations requiring state machines and two-way interactivity.
description_zh: 具有运行时交互性和网页集成的基于状态机的矢量动画。在创建交互式动画、由状态驱动的用户界面、带有逻辑的动画组件，或具有运行时控制的由设计师创建的动画时，使用此技能。在涉及Rive、状态机、交互式矢量动画、带有输入处理的动画、ViewModel数据绑定或React Rive集成等任务时触发。作为需要状态机和双向交互性的动画的替代方案。

description: Migrate supported instruction files, skills, agents, and MCP config into Codex project and global files.
description_zh: 将受支持的指令文件、技能、代理和 MCP 配置迁移到 Codex 项目和全局文件中。

description: 从当前对话提取 DDD 风格的 ubiquitous language glossary，标记歧义并提出标准术语。保存到 UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md。适用于用户想定义领域术语、构建词汇表、收紧术语、创建通用语言，或提到 “domain model” / “DDD” 时。
description_zh: 从当前对话提取 DDD 风格的通用语言词汇表，标记歧义并提出标准术语。保存至 UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md。适用于用户希望定义领域术语、构建词汇表、收紧术语、创建通用语言，或提及 “domain model” / “DDD” 时。

description: Extract, suggest, and sync tags and categories for blog posts across all major CMS platforms. Supports WordPress REST API, Shopify GraphQL, Ghost Content API, Strapi REST/GraphQL, and Sanity GROQ. Generates tag suggestions from content analysis (keyword frequency, heading extraction, semantic grouping), enforces minimum post-count thresholds to prevent thin tag archives, and syncs taxonomy via authenticated API calls. Use when user says "tags", "categories", "taxonomy", "tag suggestions", "sync tags", "WordPress tags", "Shopify tags".
description_zh: 为所有主要内容管理系统（CMS）平台上的博客文章提取、建议并同步标签与分类。支持 WordPress REST API、Shopify GraphQL、Ghost 内容 API、Strapi REST/GraphQL 和 Sanity GROQ。通过分析内容生成标签建议（包括关键词频率、标题提取和语义分组），通过强制执行最低文章数量阈值以防止标签归档内容单薄，并通过经过身份验证的 API 调用同步分类体系。当用户说出“标签”、“分类”、“分类体系”、“标签建议”、“同步标签”、“WordPress 标签”和“Shopify 标签”时使用。

description: Generate the JSON config file that the Salesforce sandbox post-copy automation tool consumes, from a customer SOP in any format (PDF, xlsx, csv, JSON, docx, Markdown, plain text, or a screenshot of an endpoint table). Use when the user asks to create, build, generate, produce, or convert a post-copy or post-refresh automation config — turning a sandbox-refresh SOP into a JSON array of OutboundMessages, RemoteSiteSettings, and ScheduledApex entries with ConfigurationName, Label, Fields, IsActive, and ExecutionOrder. Also trigger for phrasings like "post-copy config", "post-refresh automation JSON", "update the outbound message (OBM) endpoints after refresh", "convert this SOP to config", "remote site settings JSON", "refresh planner to JSON", or "sandbox refresh config". DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to deploy the generated config to an org (use platform-metadata-deploy), or apply/execute/run/dry-run the post-copy automation JSON against a sandbox (use automation-sandbox-post-copy-configure).
description_zh:
从客户SOP（以任何格式，如PDF、xlsx、csv、JSON、docx、Markdown、纯文本或端点表格的截图）生成供Salesforce沙盒复制后自动化工具消费的JSON配置文件。当用户要求创建、构建、生成、制作或转换复制后或刷新后自动化配置时使用。该配置将沙盒刷新SOP转换为OutboundMessages、RemoteSiteSettings和ScheduledApex条目的JSON数组，包含ConfigurationName、Label、Fields、IsActive和ExecutionOrder字段。

同时适用于类似以下表述的请求："复制后配置"、"刷新后自动化JSON"、"刷新后更新Outbound Message（OBM）端点"、"将此SOP转换为配置"、"远程站点设置JSON"、"将刷新计划器转换为JSON"或"沙盒刷新配置"。

当用户要求将生成的配置部署到某个组织（使用platform-metadata-deploy），或将复制后自动化JSON应用到、执行、运行或执行试运行沙盒（使用automation-sandbox-post-copy-configure）时，请勿触发。

description:
WeChat binding: QR scan, bind, unbind, reconnect, status check.

Use when setting up or repairing WeChat delivery (e.g. connect WeChat, scan QR, why isn't WeChat pushing, disconnect WeChat).
description_zh:
微信绑定：扫码、绑定、解绑、重连、状态检查。

适用于设置或修复微信推送（例如：连接微信、扫码、微信为何未推送、断开微信）。

description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.
description_zh: 面向创始人、产品经理和AI辅助构建者的产品与功能构建前风险评审。当用户即将构建落地页、MVP（最小可行性产品）、SaaS产品、内部工具、智能体工作流或重大功能，并在实施开始前需要检查需求、定位、变现、留存、信任、分发及采用风险时，请使用此技能。

description: FLOW framework integration for bloggers. Evidence-led content workflow using the Find, Optimize, Win loop with stage-specific AI prompts from the FLOW knowledge base (30 blog-applicable prompts, CC BY 4.0). Use when user says "FLOW", "FLOW framework", "blog flow", "evidence-led blogging", "find optimize win", or wants stage-specific blog prompts.
description_zh: 面向博主的FLOW框架集成。利用Find、Optimize、Win循环以及来自FLOW知识库的针对特定阶段的AI提示词，构建以证据为核心的内容工作流（30个适用于博客的提示词，CC BY 4.0）。当用户说“FLOW”、“FLOW framework”、“blog flow”、“evidence-led blogging”、“find optimize win”，或需要特定阶段的博客提示词时使用。

description: Scan Apple's SwiftUI documentation for deprecated APIs and update the SwiftUI Expert Skill with modern replacements. Use when asked to "update latest APIs", "refresh deprecated SwiftUI APIs", "check for new SwiftUI deprecations", "scan for API changes", or after a new iOS/Xcode release. Requires the Sosumi MCP to be available.
description_zh: 扫描 Apple 的 SwiftUI 文档，查找已弃用的 API，并使用现代替代方案更新 SwiftUI 专家技能。当被要求执行 "update latest APIs"、 "refresh deprecated SwiftUI APIs"、 "check for new SwiftUI deprecations"、 "scan for API changes" 或在新版 iOS/Xcode 发布后时使用。需要 Sosumi MCP 可用。

description: Use when running inside Claude Design specifically. Produces a valid, brand-accurate HyperFrames video draft using pre-valid skeletons. For Claude Code / Cursor / Codex, use the `hyperframes` skill instead.
description_zh: 仅在 Claude Design 内部运行时使用。使用预先验证的骨架，生成有效且符合品牌风格的 HyperFrames 视频草稿。对于 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex，请改用 `hyperframes` 技能。

description: When the user wants to translate content, create translation workflows, manage terminology, or optimize translation quality. Also use when the user mentions "translate," "translation," "localization copy," "glossary," "terminology," "style guide translation," "machine translation," "human translation," "TMS," or "multilingual content." For strategy, use localization-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户需要翻译内容、创建翻译工作流、管理术语或优化翻译质量时，使用。用户提及“翻译”、“翻译”、“本地化文案”、“术语表”、“术语”、“风格指南翻译”、“机器翻译”、“人工翻译”、“TMS”或“多语言内容”时，也使用。策略方面，使用 localization-strategy。

description: Load when the user is writing, reviewing, or debugging Pulumi TypeScript/Python programs; asks about Output<T> or apply() usage; wants to create ComponentResource classes; needs to refactor resources without destroying them (aliases); is setting up secrets or config; or is configuring a pulumi preview/up CI workflow. Also load for questions about resource dependency order, parent/child resource relationships, or pulumi.interpolate.
description_zh: 当用户在编写、审阅或调试 Pulumi TypeScript/Python 程序时加载；询问 Output<T 或 apply() 的使用；想要创建 ComponentResource 类；需要在不破坏资源（使用别名）的情况下重构资源；正在设置密钥或配置；或正在配置 pulumi preview/up CI 工作流。对于资源依赖顺序、父子资源关系或 pulumi.interpolate 相关的问题，也应加载。

description: Expert in Expo React Native TypeScript mobile development with best practices
description_zh: 精通 Expo React Native TypeScript 移动开发，运用最佳实践的专业专家

description: Create a PR for the current branch (targets `canary` by default), including splitting one cross-layer branch into ordered stacked PRs so a lower layer (db / shared package / server TRPC) merges before its callers (desktop / CLI / UI). Use when the user asks to create / submit a PR, or to split a branch because clients call a server contract that isn't on the trunk yet. Triggers on 'pr', 'create pr', 'submit pr', 'open a PR', 'pull request', 'split this PR', 'stacked PR', 'backend should merge first', '提 PR', '提个 PR', '新建 PR', '拆 PR', '后端先合', '分层合并'.
description_zh: 为当前分支创建 PR（默认为 `canary`），包括将一个跨层分支拆分为有序堆叠的 PR，使底层（db / 共享包 / 服务端 TRPC）在其调用方（桌面 / CLI / UI）之前合并。当用户要求创建/提交 PR，或因客户端调用了尚未合并到主干的服务端契约而需要拆分分支时使用。触发条件包括 'pr'、'create pr'、'submit pr'、'open a PR'、'pull request'、'split this PR'、'stacked PR'、'backend should merge first'、'提 PR'、'提个 PR'、'新建 PR'、'拆 PR'、'后端先合'、'分层合并'。

description: Deep cultural adaptation of translated blog posts. Run after blog-translate completes. Goes beyond translation to swap brand examples, adapt CTAs, substitute legal references, localize statistic sources where possible, and adjust formality (Sie/du, tu/vous, formal/informal). Built-in profiles for DACH, Francophone, Hispanic, and Japanese markets. Use when user says "localize blog", "blog localize", "cultural adaptation", "adapt for Germany", "lokalisieren", "localiser", "adaptar".
description_zh: 对已翻译博客文章的深度文化适配。在博客翻译完成后运行。超越翻译，以替换品牌示例、调整行动号召（CTA）、替换法律引用、尽可能本地化统计来源，并调整正式程度（如德语 Sie/du、法语 tu/vous，正式/非正式）。内置 DACH、法语文化区、西班牙语文化区及日本市场的配置文件。当用户说“localize blog”、“blog localize”、“cultural adaptation”、“adapt for Germany”、“lokalisieren”、“localiser”、“adaptar”时使用。

description: Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files. Encode the domain in a structure instead of scattered conditionals.
description_zh: 在编写有状态逻辑时，或在代码分支较多、或跨文件时重复相同的结构假设时采用。用结构对领域进行编码，而非分散的条件判断。

description: Safely simulates and applies Google Cloud IAM v1 (Allow) policy changes. Uses the Policy Simulator to replay historical access logs against proposed policies to prevent breaking active workloads before applying the changes. Use when simulating or applying IAM v1 allow policies across Projects, Folders, or Organizations. Don't use for analyzing IAM v2 deny policies, VPC Service Controls, or performing general policy troubleshooting.
description_zh: 安全地模拟和应用 Google Cloud IAM v1（允许）策略变更。使用策略模拟器将历史访问日志重放并对照拟议策略，以防止在应用变更前破坏正在运行的工作负载。在模拟或应用跨项目、文件夹或组织的 IAM v1（允许）策略时使用。不得用于分析 IAM v2 拒绝策略、VPC 服务控制或进行一般策略故障排查。

description:
Trigger when: (1) User wants to create an educational/explainer video, (2) User has a vague concept they want visualized, (3) User mentions "3b1b style" or "explain like 3Blue1Brown", (4) User wants to plan a Manim video or animation sequence, (5) User asks to "compose" or "plan" a math/science visualization.

Transforms vague video ideas into detailed scene-by-scene plans (scenes.md). Conducts research, asks clarifying questions about audience/scope/focus, and outputs comprehensive scene specifications ready for implementation with ManimCE or ManimGL.

Use this BEFORE writing any Manim code. This skill plans the video; use manimce-best-practices or manimgl-best-practices for implementation.
description_zh:
触发条件：
(1) 用户想要制作教育/讲解视频；
(2) 用户有模糊的概念，希望进行可视化；
(3) 用户提及“3b1b 风格”或“像 3Blue1Brown 那样讲解”；
(4) 用户想要规划 Manif 视频或动画序列；
(5) 用户要求为数学/科学可视化“创作”或“规划”。

将模糊的视频创意转化为详细的场景逐场计划（scenes.md）。进行调研，就受众、范围、重点等问题提出澄清性问题，并输出可直接用于 ManifCE 或 ManifGL 实施的综合场景规格说明。

在编写任何 Manif 代码之前使用本方法。本技能用于规划视频；实施时请使用 manifce-best-practices 或 manigl-best-practices。

description: Summarize authored commits over a user-specified time period into a concise update

description: CLI for querying Prometheus and PromQL-compatible engines (Thanos, Cortex, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana Mimir, Grafana Tempo...) — instant queries, range queries, metric discovery (metrics/labels/meta subcommands), output formats (table/csv/json/graph). Apply when executing PromQL queries, troubleshooting performance issues on a software having observability, investigating latency/error rates/saturation, or analyzing time series data.
description_zh: 用于查询 Prometheus 及 PromQL 兼容引擎（Thanos、Cortex、VictoriaMetrics、Grafana Mimir、Grafana Tempo 等）的 CLI — 支持即时查询、范围查询、指标发现（metrics/labels/meta 子命令），输出格式（表格/csv/json/图）。适用于执行 PromQL 查询、排查具备可观测性的软件性能问题、调查延迟、错误率与饱和情况，或分析时序数据时使用。

description: Extract and organize frames from a Bilibili video (bangumi episode, UP upload, or a local file) into scenery shots and per-character image groups, using anime-specific person detection + CCIP character-identity embeddings. Two modes — cluster everyone, or pull out one (or several) named characters via reference folders. Use when the user wants to collect, extract, or organize anime frames/screenshots by character or by scenery from a Bilibili video. Read-only download for personal viewing/analysis; uploads nothing.
description_zh: 从哔哩哔哩视频（番剧剧集、UP上传或本地文件）中提取并整理帧，将其划分为场景镜头与按角色分组的图像组，基于动漫专用人物检测与CCIP角色身份嵌入技术。提供两种模式——所有人聚类，或通过参考文件夹提取一个（或多个）命名角色。当用户需要从哔哩哔哩视频中按角色或按场景收集、提取或整理动漫帧/截图时使用。仅供个人查看/分析下载；不会上传任何内容。

description: wx-cli — 从本地微信数据库查询聊天记录、联系人、会话、收藏等。用户提到微信聊天记录、联系人、消息历史、群成员、收藏内容时，使用此 skill 安装并调用 wx-cli。
description_zh: wx-cli — 从本地微信数据库查询聊天记录、联系人、会话、收藏等内容。当用户提及微信聊天记录、联系人、消息历史、群成员、收藏内容时，使用此 skill 安装并调用 wx-cli。

description: Emil Kowalski's animation best practices for web interfaces. Use when writing, reviewing, or implementing animations in React, CSS, or Framer Motion. Triggers on tasks involving transitions, easing, gestures, toasts, drawers, or motion.
description_zh: Emil Kowalski 的网页界面动画最佳实践。在 React、CSS 或 Framer Motion 中编写、审查或实现动画时使用。在涉及过渡、缓动、手势、提示框、抽屉或动态的任务中触发。

description: Generate custom favicons from logos, text, or brand colours. Produces favicon.svg, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, icon-192/512.png, and web manifest. Use whenever the user wants a favicon, mentions replacing a CMS default favicon, converting a logo into a favicon, creating branded initials icons, or troubleshooting favicon not displaying / iOS black square / missing manifest.
description_zh: 从logo、文字或品牌颜色生成自定义网站图标。生成favicon.svg、favicon.ico、apple-touch-icon.png、icon-192/512.png及web manifest等文件。当用户需要网站图标、提及替换CMS默认网站图标、将logo转换为网站图标、创建品牌字母图标，或排查网站图标无法显示、iOS黑方块、manifest缺失等问题时使用。

description: Audit a directory of multilingual blog content for completeness, consistency, hreflang correctness, meta-tag parity, and freshness. Builds a translation coverage matrix, flags stale translations, validates hreflang and schema, and emits a prioritized report with runnable fix commands. Use when user says "locale audit", "blog locale-audit", "check translations", "multilingual audit", "translation check", "hreflang check", "Uebersetzungen pruefen".
description_zh:
对多语言博客内容目录进行审计，检查其完整性、一致性、hreflang 正确性、meta 标签一致性及时效性。
构建翻译覆盖矩阵，标记过时翻译，验证 hreflang 与 Schema，并输出包含可执行修复命令的优先级报告。
当用户输入“locale audit”、“blog locale-audit”、“check translations”、“multilingual audit”、“translation check”、“hreflang check”或“Uebersetzungen pruefen”时使用。

description: Debug and profile Three.js browser games: blank canvases, render and runtime bugs, asset and audio loading, animation, resize, mobile input, plus performance profiling of draw calls, triangles, textures, memory, shader and post-processing cost, and bundle size.
description_zh: 调试与性能分析 Three.js 浏览器游戏：包括空白画布、渲染与运行时错误、资源与音频加载、动画、窗口尺寸调整、移动端输入等调试问题，以及绘制调用、三角形、纹理、内存、着色器、后处理成本等性能分析，并评估包体大小。

description: Use for Upstash Workflow/QStash handlers, triggers, durable steps and async fan-out.
description_zh: 用于 Upstash Workflow/QStash 处理程序、触发器、持久步骤和异步扇出。

description: Structured diagnostic for technical SEO problems. Use when the user asks about crawl issues, indexation problems, why pages aren't being indexed, robots.txt questions, canonical errors, sitemap issues, rendering problems, or general technical SEO troubleshooting. For Core Web Vitals and page speed, see audit-speed.
description_zh: 技术SEO问题的结构化诊断。当用户询问爬取问题、索引问题、为何页面未被索引、robots.txt相关问题、规范错误、站点地图问题、渲染问题或一般技术SEO故障排查时使用。有关核心网页指标和页面速度，请参阅 audit-speed。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Android. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Android", "install sentry-android", "setup Sentry in Android", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, or logging for Android applications. Supports Kotlin and Java codebases.
description_zh: 完整的 Android 版 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求“为 Android 添加 Sentry”、“安装 sentry-android”、“在 Android 中配置 Sentry”，或为 Android 应用程序配置错误监控、调用链追踪、性能分析、会话重放或日志记录时使用。支持 Kotlin 和 Java 代码库。

description:
Telegram bot binding: create the bot, connect to Starchild, verify, troubleshoot.

Two ways to bind: (1) scan-to-create (recommended, auto-bind) or (2) manual BotFather + token + verify.

Use when setting up Telegram delivery (e.g. add my TG bot, bot binding code, fix "telegram not pushing", whitelist a TG username).
description_zh:
Telegram 机器人绑定：创建机器人、连接到 Starchild、验证、故障排查。

绑定方式有两种：（1）扫码创建（推荐，自动绑定）或（2）手动使用 BotFather + token + 验证。

在设置 Telegram 推送时使用（例如：添加我的 TG 机器人、机器人绑定代码、修复“Telegram 未推送”问题、为 TG 用户账号添加白名单）。

description: Establish durable brand and voice context for cross-skill consumption. Generates BRAND.md (audience, positioning, do/don't editorial rules, taboo phrases, competitor differentiation) and VOICE.md (existing persona JSON re-expressed as readable prose), both written to the project root. When present, the blog orchestrator auto-loads these files for write, rewrite, brief, outline, calendar, and strategy workflows. Pairs with blog-persona, which manages the structured persona JSON. Use when user says "blog brand", "create brand context", "brand voice doc", "BRAND.md", "VOICE.md", "establish editorial brand", "brand guidelines for blog".
description_zh: 为跨技能场景下的使用建立持久、稳定的品牌与声音语境。生成 BRAND.md（受众、定位、应做/不应做编辑规则、禁忌用语、竞品差异化）与 VOICE.md（将既有角色 JSON 重新表达为可读的叙述文本），两者均写入项目根目录。当存在时，博客编排器会自动加载这些文件，以支持撰写、重写、简报、大纲、日历和策略等工作流。与 blog-persona 配套使用，blog-persona 负责管理结构化的角色 JSON。当用户说“博客品牌”、“创建品牌语境”、“品牌声音文档”、“BRAND.md”、“VOICE.md”、“确立编辑品牌”、“博客品牌指南”时使用。

description: When the user wants to optimize their subscription business end-to-end — from trial start through renewal, cancellation, and win-back. Use when the user mentions "subscription lifecycle", "trial conversion", "churn", "cancellation", "win-back", "lapsed subscribers", "dunning", "billing retry", "grace period", "renewal rate", "subscriber LTV", or "resubscribe". For paywall design and pricing strategy, see monetization-strategy. For subscription analytics dashboards, see app-analytics.
description_zh: 当用户想要端到端优化其订阅业务——从试用启动，经历续订、取消与召回。当用户提及“订阅生命周期”、“试用转化”、“流失”、“取消”、“召回”、“流失订阅用户”、“催收”、“计费重试”、“宽限期”、“续订率”、“订阅用户生命周期价值（LTV）”、“重新订阅”时使用。关于付费墙设计与定价策略，请参阅 monetization-strategy。关于订阅分析仪表板，请参阅 app-analytics。

description: Correctly call native (C/C++) libraries from .NET using P/Invoke and LibraryImport. Covers function signatures, string marshalling, memory lifetime, SafeHandle, and cross-platform patterns. USE FOR: writing new P/Invoke or LibraryImport declarations, reviewing or debugging existing native interop code, wrapping a C or C++ library for use in .NET, diagnosing crashes, memory leaks, or corruption at the managed/native boundary. DO NOT USE FOR: COM interop, C++/CLI mixed-mode assemblies, or pure managed code with no native dependencies.
description_zh: 正确使用 P/Invoke 和 LibraryImport 从 .NET 调用原生（C/C++）库。涵盖函数签名、字符串封送、内存生命周期、SafeHandle 以及跨平台模式。用途：编写新的 P/Invoke 或 LibraryImport 声明，审查或调试现有原生互操作代码，将 C 或 C++ 库封装以便在 .NET 中使用，诊断托管/原生边界处的崩溃、内存泄漏或损坏。不适用于：COM 互操作、C++/CLI 混合模式程序集，或纯托管代码且无原生依赖的情况。

description:
Create a persistent HeyGen avatar — a reusable face + voice identity for the agent,
the user, or any named character — powered by HeyGen Avatar V technology.
Prompt-based creation by default (description → HeyGen builds it); photo upload is
optional for real-person digital twins.
Use when: (1) giving the agent a face + voice so it can present videos
("bring yourself to life", "create your avatar", "give yourself an avatar",
"design a presenter", "set up an avatar", "let's make an avatar"),
(2) the user wants to appear in videos as themselves ("create my avatar",
"I want my face in a video", "digital twin of me", "build me an avatar"),
(3) building a named character presenter ("create an avatar called Cleo",
"design a character named X"), (4) establishing HeyGen identity before making videos —
the correct FIRST step when no avatar exists yet.
Chain signal: when the user says both an identity/avatar action AND a video action in the same
request ("create an avatar AND make a video", "set up identity THEN create a video",
"design a presenter AND immediately record"), run heygen-avatar first, then heygen-video.
Returns avatar_id + voice_id — pass directly to heygen-video to create HeyGen videos.
NOT for: generating videos (use heygen-video), translating videos, or TTS-only tasks.
description_zh:
创建一个持久的HeyGen头像——为代理、用户或任何指定名称的角色提供可重用的面部+声音身份，基于HeyGen Avatar V技术。
默认基于提示词创建（描述 → HeyGen构建它）；上传照片对于真实人物数字替身是可选的。
使用场景：(1) 为代理提供面部+声音，使其能够呈现视频（“赋予生命”，“创建您的头像”，“给您一个头像”，“设计演示者”，“设置头像”，“让我们创建一个头像”），
(2) 用户希望以自身形象出现在视频中（“创建我的头像”，“我想在视频中展示我的脸”，“我的数字替身”，“为我构建一个头像”），
(3) 构建具有指定名称的角色演示者（“创建名为Cleo的头像”，“设计名为X的角色”），
(4) 在制作视频之前确立HeyGen身份——这是在没有头像存在时的正确第一步。
链式信号：当用户在同一请求中同时提及身份/头像动作和视频动作（“创建头像且制作视频”，“设置身份然后制作视频”，“设计演示者且立即录制”），首先运行heygen-avatar，然后运行heygen-video。
返回avatar_id和voice_id——直接将其传递给heygen-video以创建HeyGen视频。
不适用于：生成视频（使用heygen-video）、翻译视频或仅用于TTS的任务。

description: Mem0 Platform SDK for adding persistent memory to AI applications. Also covers the open-source self-hosted Memory class. This is the DEFAULT mem0 skill for ambiguous queries. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user asks about CLI commands, terminal usage, or shell scripts (use mem0-cli), or Vercel AI SDK / @mem0/vercel-ai-provider / createMem0 (use mem0-vercel-ai-sdk).

description: Review generated or changed WordPress code — plugins, themes, and blocks — before it ships. Best used reactively after an agent writes, edits, or reviews code touching WordPress APIs: add_action/add_filter, shortcodes, meta boxes, AJAX handlers, REST routes, WP_Query or $wpdb, widgets, or WP-CLI commands. Use on 'review this plugin', 'is this safe to ship', 'make this translatable', 'speed up this query', or after tasks like 'write a plugin' or 'add an endpoint/shortcode/meta box'. Enforces escaping and sanitization, nonces plus capability checks, prepared database queries, core-API-first development, translation-ready strings, and query/caching discipline. DO NOT USE for WooCommerce-specific order, product, or checkout logic (use woo-guard), non-WordPress PHP, generic code quality review (use clean-code-guard), test code review (use test-guard), server or hosting configuration, or conceptual WordPress questions.
description_zh: 在代码发布前，审查生成的或修改过的 WordPress 代码——插件、主题和区块——确保其安全。最佳使用场景是：在智能体编写、编辑或审查涉及 WordPress API 的代码后及时（响应式）使用，例如：add_action/add_filter、shortcodes、元数据框、AJAX 处理程序、REST 路由、WP_Query 或 $wpdb、小部件或 WP-CLI 命令。适用于“审查此插件”、“此插件是否可以安全发布”、“将此功能改为可翻译”、“加速此查询”等场景，或在“编写插件”或“添加端点/短代码/元数据框”等任务完成后使用。该工具强制执行转义与净化、nonce 验证与权限检查、预处理数据库查询、以核心 API 优先的开发方式、可翻译字符串，以及查询与缓存规范。禁止用于 WooCommerce 特有的订单、商品或结账逻辑（请使用 woo-guard）、非 WordPress 的 PHP 代码、通用代码质量审查（请使用 clean-code-guard）、测试代码审查（请使用 test-guard）、服务器或托管配置，或涉及概念性的 WordPress 问题。

description: Host and process metrics including CPU, memory, disk, network, containers, and process-level telemetry. Use when analyzing infrastructure health, resource utilization, process consumption, or host discovery. Also use when building timeseries queries for host metrics that feed into analytical workflows like anomaly detection, forecasting, or seasonality analysis. Trigger: "show hosts", "CPU usage", "memory utilization", "disk space", "high CPU", "top hosts by CPU", "top processes by memory", "Linux hosts in AWS", "what databases are running", "infrastructure costs by cost center", "hosts running EOL Java", "container monitoring", "listening ports", "process resource consumption", "CPU forecast", "memory anomaly", "host seasonality", "OneAgent mode", "OneAgent version", "GCP hosts". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, Kubernetes pod/workload queries (use dt-obs-kubernetes), AWS cloud resource inventory (use dt-obs-aws), or service-level metrics (use dt-obs-services).
description_zh:
**描述：**
主机与进程指标，涵盖 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、容器及进程级遥测。适用于分析基础设施健康状况、资源利用率、进程消耗情况或进行主机发现。此外，用于构建主机指标的时序查询，将其作为异常检测、预测或季节性分析等分析工作流的输入数据。

**触发命令：**
- "show hosts"
- "CPU usage"
- "memory utilization"
- "disk space"
- "high CPU"
- "top hosts by CPU"
- "top processes by memory"
- "Linux hosts in AWS"
- "what databases are running"
- "infrastructure costs by cost center"
- "hosts running EOL Java"
- "container monitoring"
- "listening ports"
- "process resource consumption"
- "CPU forecast"
- "memory anomaly"
- "host seasonality"
- "OneAgent mode"
- "OneAgent version"
- "GCP hosts"

**禁止用于：**
解释现有查询、回答产品文档相关问题、执行 Kubernetes pod/workload 查询（使用 dt-obs-kubernetes）、盘点 AWS 云端资源（使用 dt-obs-aws），或查询服务级别指标（使用 dt-obs-services）。

description: Kubernetes cluster, pod, node, and workload monitoring. Use when analyzing K8s health, resource optimization, pod failures, OOMKills, scheduling, or security posture. Also use for Kubernetes operational events like pod restarts, OOM events, evictions, and cluster event history. Trigger: "Kubernetes pods", "K8s cluster health", "OOMKill", "pod restarts", "container CPU", "namespace resource usage", "over-provisioned pods", "privileged containers", "pod placement", "K8s node capacity", "running containers by cluster", "workload scheduling", "pod evictions", "K8s labels and annotations", "kubernetes events", "pod restart events", "OOM events", "K8s event history". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, AWS-specific resource queries, service-level RED metrics, distributed tracing, or log analysis — use the relevant skill instead.
description_zh:
Kubernetes集群、Pod、Node和工作负载监控。用于分析K8s健康状态、资源优化、Pod故障、OOMKills、调度或安全态势。也用于处理Kubernetes运维事件，如Pod重启、OOM事件、驱逐、集群事件历史等。

**Trigger：**"Kubernetes pods"、"K8s cluster health"、"OOMKill"、"pod restarts"、"container CPU"、"namespace resource usage"、"over-provisioned pods"、"privileged containers"、"pod placement"、"K8s node capacity"、"running containers by cluster"、"workload scheduling"、"pod evictions"、"K8s labels and annotations"、"kubernetes events"、"pod restart events"、"OOM events"、"K8s event history"。

**Do NOT use for** 解释已有查询、产品文档问题、特定于AWS的资源查询、服务级别RED指标、分布式追踪或日志分析——请改用相关技能。

description: Use the Modern Go Guidelines CLI whenever writing, modifying, fixing, or refactoring Go code. Apply its version-specific guidance to generated changes.
description_zh: 在编写、修改、修复或重构 Go 代码时，请始终使用 Modern Go Guidelines CLI。将针对特定版本的指导应用于生成的更改。

description: Review generated or changed WooCommerce code — extensions, payment and shipping integrations, checkout customizations, and order/product logic — before it ships. Best used reactively after an agent writes, edits, or reviews code touching WooCommerce APIs: wc_get_order, wc_get_orders, wc_get_product, WC() cart or session, woocommerce_* hooks, Store API endpoints, payment gateways, order or product meta, HPOS, subscriptions, or bookings. Use on 'review this Woo plugin', 'is this HPOS compatible', or after tasks like 'write a WooCommerce extension', 'add a checkout field', 'hook into the order flow', or 'update stock'. Enforces HPOS-safe order access, CRUD over direct meta, feature-compatibility declarations, server-side checkout validation, money-handling discipline, and hooks over template overrides. DO NOT USE for WordPress code without WooCommerce APIs (use wp-guard), generic code review (use clean-code-guard), test review (use test-guard), or store configuration and admin-screen questions.
description_zh: 发布前，需审查生成的或修改的WooCommerce代码——扩展、支付与运输集成、结账自定义以及订单/产品逻辑。最佳用法：在代理编写、编辑或审查触及WooCommerce API的代码后立即使用，例如：wc_get_order、wc_get_orders、wc_get_product、WC() 购物车或会话、woocommerce_* 钩子、Store API端点、支付网关、订单或产品元数据、HPOS、订阅或预订。在“审查这个Woo插件”、“检查该HPOS是否兼容”，或在执行诸如“编写一个WooCommerce扩展”、“添加结账字段”、“接入订单流程”或“更新库存”等任务后使用。该工具强制执行安全的HPOS订单访问、直接元数据上的增删改查、功能兼容性声明、服务器端结账验证、资金处理纪律，以及钩子覆盖模板覆盖。切勿用于没有WooCommerce API的WordPress代码（使用wp-guard）、通用代码审查（使用clean-code-guard）、测试审查（使用test-guard），或存储配置和管理界面问题。

description: Calculates CRAP (Change Risk Anti-Patterns) for a named .NET method, class, or file. USE FOR: explicit CRAP calculation or coverage-and-complexity risk within that named target, including which tests to prioritize. DO NOT USE FOR: project-wide coverage/CRAP, plateaus, or project-wide blockers/priorities (coverage-analysis); behavioral/pseudo-mutation gaps (test-gap-analysis); writing tests; test runs without CRAP context.
description_zh: 为指定的.NET方法、类或文件计算CRAP（变更风险反模式）。用途：针对该指定目标的明确CRAP计算、覆盖率和复杂度风险，包括应优先执行的测试。不要用于：项目级覆盖/CRAP、平台期，或项目级阻塞/优先级（覆盖率分析）；行为/伪变异缺口（测试缺口分析）；编写测试；未提供CRAP上下文的测试运行。

description: When the user wants to optimize for entity recognition, Knowledge Graph, or entity-based SEO. Also use when the user mentions "entity SEO," "entity optimization," "Knowledge Graph," "Knowledge Panel," "entity signals," "brand entity," "entity linking," "entity relationships," or "entity-first content." For structured data, use schema-markup.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化实体识别、知识图谱或基于实体的SEO时。当用户提到“实体SEO”、“实体优化”、“知识图谱”、“知识面板”、“实体信号”、“品牌实体”、“实体链接”、“实体关系”或“实体优先内容”时，也应使用。对于结构化数据，使用 schema 标记。

description: Help users identify the drivers of long-term retention and implement behavioral mechanics that keep customers coming back. This guide focuses on measuring the survival curve of users and optimizing the product environment for high frequency usage.
description_zh: 帮助用户识别长期留存的驱动因素，并实施能够留住客户持续回访的行为机制。本指南专注于测量用户的留存曲线，并为高频使用优化产品环境。

description: Handles GitHub issue resolution end-to-end for prompts like "solve #123", "lets solve #123", "work on #123", "work on https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123", or by pasting a direct GitHub issue URL as the request. USE FOR: solve #123, continue work on issue #123, work on https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123, paste a GitHub issue URL for implementation work. DO NOT USE FOR: issue drafting only, PR review only, or non-implementation research.
description_zh:
用于处理诸如 "solve #123"、"lets solve #123"、"work on #123"、"work on https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123" 或直接粘贴 GitHub 问题 URL 作为请求等提示词，实现 GitHub 问题的端到端解决。

**适用用途：** 解决 #123、继续处理 #123 问题、处理 https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123、粘贴 GitHub 问题链接以开展实施工作。

**不适用场景：** 仅用于问题撰写、仅用于 PR 审查，或非实施性研究。

description: Fast, lightweight 2D rendering engine for creating interactive graphics, particle effects, and canvas-based applications using WebGL/WebGPU. Use this skill when building 2D games, particle systems, interactive canvases, sprite animations, or UI overlays on 3D scenes. Triggers on tasks involving PixiJS, 2D rendering, sprite sheets, particle effects, filters, or high-performance canvas graphics. Alternative to Canvas2D with WebGL acceleration for rendering thousands of sprites at 60 FPS.
description_zh: 基于 WebGL/WebGPU 快速、轻量级的 2D 渲染引擎，用于使用 WebGL/WebGPU 创建交互式图形、粒子效果和基于画布的的应用程序。在构建 2D 游戏、粒子系统、交互式画布、精灵动画或 3D 场景中的 UI 叠层时使用此技能。当任务涉及 PixiJS、2D 渲染、精灵图、粒子效果、滤镜或高性能画布图形时触发。作为 Canvas2D 借助 WebGL 加速以 60 FPS 渲染数千个精灵的替代方案。

description: Review TypeScript and JavaScript code changes for compliance with Metabase coding standards, style violations, and code quality issues. Use when reviewing pull requests or diffs containing TypeScript/JavaScript code.
description_zh: 审查 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 代码变更是否符合 Metabase 编码标准、风格违规及代码质量问题。在审查包含 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码的拉取请求或差异时使用。

description: Research what people are actually saying about a topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X / Twitter, YouTube, Hacker News, dev.to, Medium, and other public discourse platforms. API-free; uses WebSearch with platform-targeted site operators plus recency filters. Produces DISCOURSE.md (a structured brief) and JSON output the writer can consume. Complements blog-researcher (which focuses on authority sources) with a recency-and-engagement lens. Use when user says "blog discourse", "discourse research", "what are people saying about", "research what people are saying", "voice of customer", "social listening", "30-day research", "trend research", "what's the discussion on", "real-time research", "practitioner discourse", "/blog discourse".
description_zh: 在 Reddit、X / Twitter、YouTube、Hacker News、dev.to、Medium 及其他公共话语平台上，研究近 30 天内人们对某一主题的真实言论。无需 API；使用 WebSearch，结合平台定向站点运算符以及时效性过滤条件。生成 DISCOURSE.md（结构化简报）以及供撰稿人使用的 JSON 输出。与专注于权威来源的 blog-researcher 互补，并引入时效性与互动度视角。当用户提及“博客话语”、“话语研究”、“关于人们都在说什么”、“研究人们都在说什么”、“客户之声”、“社会聆听”、“30 天研究”、“趋势研究”、“讨论焦点”、“实时研究”、“从业者话语”、“/博客话语”时使用。

description: Create a delightful, unexpected "wow" experience for the user by dynamically discovering and creatively combining other enabled skills. Triggers when the user says "surprise me" or any request expressing a desire for an unexpected creative showcase. Also triggers when the user is bored, wants inspiration, or asks for "something interesting".
description_zh: 通过动态发现并创意组合其他已启用的技能，为用户创造令人愉悦、意想不到的“wow”体验。当用户说“让我惊喜”，或提出任何表达对意想不到的创意展示的渴望的请求时，触发。此外，当用户感到无聊、需要灵感，或询问“一些有趣的内容”时，也会触发。

description: Scaffolds new agent skills for the dotnet/skills repository. Use when creating a new skill, generating SKILL.md files, writing a skill description that the runtime will actually route to, or setting up skill directory structures. Handles frontmatter generation, section templates, and validation guidance. Do not use for fixing a skill that already fails its evaluation (use improve-skill-quality) or for writing eval.yaml (use create-skill-test).
description_zh: 为 dotnet/skills 仓库搭建新的智能体技能。当需要创建新技能、生成 SKILL.md 文件、编写运行时将实际路由到的技能描述，或设置技能目录结构时使用。负责前置元数据生成、章节模板及校验指导。请勿用于修复已无法通过评估的技能（请使用 improve-skill-quality），也不得用于编写 eval.yaml（请使用 create-skill-test）。

description: Frame an epic as a testable hypothesis with target user, expected outcome, and validation method. Use when defining a major initiative before roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning.
description_zh: 将 Epic 构建为可验证的假设，并明确其目标用户、预期结果和验证方法。在规划路线图、开展发现或进行交付规划之前，用于定义重大举措时。

description: Diagnose MSBuild build performance bottlenecks using binary log analysis. USE FOR: identifying why builds are slow by analyzing binlog performance summaries, detecting ResolveAssemblyReference (RAR) taking >5s, Roslyn analyzers consuming >30% of Csc time, single targets dominating >50% of build time, node utilization below 80%, excessive Copy tasks, NuGet restore running every build. Covers timeline analysis, Target/Task Performance Summary interpretation, and 7 common bottleneck categories. Use after build-perf-baseline has established measurements. DO NOT USE FOR: establishing initial baselines (use build-perf-baseline first), fixing incremental build issues (use incremental-build), parallelism tuning (use build-parallelism), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
通过二进制日志分析诊断MSBuild构建性能瓶颈。

**USE FOR**：通过分析binlog性能摘要识别构建缓慢的原因；检测ResolveAssemblyReference（RAR）耗时超过5秒的情况；检测Roslyn分析器占用Csc时间超过30%；检测单个目标占用构建时间超过50%；检测节点利用率低于80%；检测过度的Copy任务；检测NuGet还原在每次构建中均执行。涵盖时间线分析、目标/任务性能摘要解读及7类常见瓶颈类别。在已通过build-perf-baseline建立测量数据后使用。

**DO NOT USE FOR**：建立初始基线（应先使用build-perf-baseline）、修复增量构建问题（应使用incremental-build）、并行度调优（应使用build-parallelism）及非MSBuild构建系统。

description: Database design principles and decision-making. Schema design, indexing strategy, ORM selection, serverless databases.
description_zh: 数据库设计原则与决策。模式设计、索引策略、ORM选择、无服务器数据库。

description: Detect IBD-style Distribution Days for QQQ/SPY (close down at least 0.2% on higher volume), track 25-session expiration and 5% invalidation, count d5/d15/d25 clusters, classify market risk (NORMAL/CAUTION/HIGH/SEVERE), and emit TQQQ/QQQ exposure recommendations. Use after market close, before TQQQ exposure changes, or as input to FTD/market-state frameworks. Does not execute trades.
description_zh: 检测QQQ/SPY的IBD式派发日（在高成交量下下跌至少0.2%），跟踪25个交易日到期与5%无效化情况，统计d5/d15/d25聚类，对市场风险进行分类（NORMAL/CAUTION/HIGH/SEVERE），并发出TQQQ/QQQ敞口建议。应在收盘后使用，或在TQQQ敞口发生变化前使用，或作为FTD/市场状态框架的输入。不执行交易。

description: Evaluate feature investments using revenue impact, cost structure, ROI, and strategy. Use when deciding whether a feature deserves investment.
description_zh: 评估功能投资时，依据收入影响、成本结构、ROI（投资回报率）及策略。用于判断某项功能是否值得投资时使用。

description: Facilitate workshop sessions in a one-step, multi-turn flow. Use when an interactive skill needs consistent pacing, options, and progress tracking.
description_zh: 在一步式、多轮流程中引导工作坊活动。适用于需要一致的节奏、选项和进度跟踪的交互式技能。

description: 법원 전자소송 지급명령 신청을 위해 채권자·채무자·청구금액·청구원인·증빙 정보를 인터뷰하고, 신청서 초안과 공식 전자소송 브라우저 입력 handoff를 준비한다. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: 为办理法院电子诉讼支付命令申请，对债权人、债务人、请求金额、请求原因及证明信息等进行访谈，并准备申请草稿与正式电子诉讼浏览器输入的交接流程。在돌쇠中，推进至尽可能接近的合法正式流程。

description: Establish build performance baselines and apply systematic optimization techniques. USE FOR: diagnosing slow builds, establishing before/after measurements (cold, warm, no-op scenarios), applying optimization strategies like static graph builds, artifacts output, and dependency graph trimming. Start here before diving into build-perf-diagnostics, incremental-build, or build-parallelism. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems, detailed bottleneck analysis (use build-perf-diagnostics after baselining).
description_zh: 建立构建性能基线，并应用系统化优化技术。用途：诊断缓慢构建、建立前后测量数据（涵盖冷启动、温启动、无操作场景），以及应用静态图构建、产物输出、依赖图精简等优化策略。在深入构建性能诊断、增量构建或构建并行性之前，请从这里开始。不可用于：非 MSBuild 构建系统，以及详细的瓶颈分析（在建立基线后使用构建性能诊断）。

description: Use this skill to manage the full lifecycle of a DevOps Center pipeline — list all pipelines, get a single pipeline's details, create a new pipeline linked to a Git repository, add or remove stages, rename a stage, add or remove Salesforce environments on stages, attach or detach projects, and activate or deactivate the pipeline. Invoke when the user wants to set up a release pipeline, wire promotion stages across integration, UAT, staging, and production orgs, connect environments to stages, attach a project, or activate a continuous delivery pipeline. Uses sf devops pipeline and sf devops stage commands with --json output. DO NOT TRIGGER for work-item lifecycle, promotion or deployment execution, conflict detection, or standalone project creation (separate skills).
description_zh: 使用此技能管理 DevOps Center 流水线全生命周期——列出所有流水线，获取单个流水线的详情，创建与 Git 仓库关联的新流水线，添加或删除阶段，重命名阶段，在阶段中添加或移除 Salesforce 环境，附加或分离项目，以及激活或停用流水线。当用户需要设置发布流水线、在集成、UAT、预发布和生产组织之间衔接推广阶段、将环境连接到阶段、附加项目或激活持续交付流水线时调用本技能。使用带有 --json 输出的 sf devops pipeline 和 sf devops stage 命令。切勿为工作项生命周期、推广或部署执行、冲突检测，或独立项目创建（由其他独立技能处理）而触发。

description: Convert files between formats — PDF to Word, HEIC to JPG, MP4 to MP3, CSV to JSON, EPUB to MOBI, and 999 total routes across images, video, audio, documents, data, fonts, ebooks, and archives. Free via changethisfile.com, no API key or signup. Use when the user needs a file converted to a different format.
description_zh: 在不同格式之间转换文件——支持 PDF 转 Word、HEIC 转 JPG、MP4 转 MP3、CSV 转 JSON、EPUB 转 MOBI，涵盖图像、视频、音频、文档、数据、字体、电子图书和档案等，共 999 条转换路径。通过 changethisfile.com 免费使用，无需 API 密钥或注册。当用户需要将文件转换为不同格式时即可使用。

description: Migrate a .NET 9 project or solution to .NET 10 and resolve all breaking changes. USE FOR: upgrading TargetFramework from net9.0 to net10.0, fixing build errors after updating the .NET 10 SDK, resolving source and behavioral changes in .NET 10 / C# 14 / ASP.NET Core 10 / EF Core 10, updating Dockerfiles for Debian-to-Ubuntu base images, resolving obsoletion warnings (SYSLIB0058-SYSLIB0062), adapting to SDK/NuGet changes (NU1510, PrunePackageReference), migrating System.Linq.Async to built-in AsyncEnumerable, fixing OpenApi v2 API changes, cryptography renames, and C# 14 compiler changes (field keyword, extension keyword, span overloads). DO NOT USE FOR: .NET Framework migrations, upgrading from .NET 8 or earlier (use migrate-dotnet8-to-dotnet9 first), greenfield .NET 10 projects, or cosmetic modernization. LOADS REFERENCES: csharp-compiler, core-libraries, sdk-msbuild (always); aspnet-core, efcore, cryptography, extensions-hosting, serialization-networking, winforms-wpf, containers-interop (selective).
description_zh:
将 .NET 9 项目或解决方案迁移到 .NET 10，并解决所有破坏性变更。

用途：
- 将 TargetFramework 从 net9.0 升级到 net10.0；
- 在更新 .NET 10 SDK 后修复构建错误；
- 解决 .NET 10 / C# 14 / ASP.NET Core 10 / EF Core 10 中的源代码与行为变更；
- 更新用于 Debian 至 Ubuntu 基础镜像的 Dockerfile；
- 解决弃用警告（SYSLIB0058-SYSLIB0062）；
- 适配 SDK/NuGet 变更（NU1510、PrunePackageReference）；
- 将 System.Linq.Async 迁移到内置的 AsyncEnumerable；
- 修复 OpenApi v2 的 API 变更；
- cryptography 相关重命名；
- 以及 C# 14 编译器变更（字段关键字、扩展关键字、span 重载）。

不适用于：
- .NET Framework 迁移；
- 从 .NET 8 或更早版本升级（请先使用 migrate-dotnet8-to-dotnet9）；
- 全新 .NET 10 项目；
- 或用于外观现代化。

加载的引用：
csharp-compiler, core-libraries, sdk-msbuild（始终）；aspnet-core, efcore, cryptography, extensions-hosting, serialization-networking, winforms-wpf, containers-interop（选择性）。

description: Survey a whole React codebase as a senior React engineer, using React Doctor's scan as evidence, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the React code", "audit this codebase", "make this app faster / more robust", or wants a roadmap of fixes rather than a review of a single diff. For a regression check or a fix-it-now pass, use the `react-doctor` skill instead.
description_zh: 以资深 React 工程师身份，对完整的 React 代码库进行全面审查，以 React Doctor 的扫描结果作为证据，随后为其他 agent（或更经济的模型）产出经过优先级排序的审计结果与自包含实施计划供其执行。该流程对源代码只读——仅规划改进，不实施改动。当用户要求“改进 React 代码”、“审计此代码库”、“让此应用更快/更健壮”，或希望获得修复路线图而非单次 diff 评审时使用。若需要进行回归检查或即时修复，请改用 `react-doctor` 技能。

description: Generate AI images with GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve and 50+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2, FLUX Dev LoRA, FLUX.2 Klein LoRA, Gemini 3 Pro Image, Grok Imagine, Seedream 4.5, Reve, ImagineArt. Capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, text rendering. Use for: AI art, product mockups, concept art, social media graphics, marketing visuals, illustrations. Triggers: flux, image generation, ai image, text to image, stable diffusion, generate image, ai art, midjourney alternative, dall-e alternative, text2img, t2i, image generator, ai picture, create image with ai, generative ai, ai illustration, grok image, gemini image, gpt image, openai image, chatgpt image
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI，使用 GPT-Image-2、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 和 50 多个模型生成 AI 图像。模型：GPT-Image-2、FLUX Dev LoRA、FLUX.2 Klein LoRA、Gemini 3 Pro Image、Grok Imagine、Seedream 4.5、Reve、ImagineArt。功能：文本生成图像、图像到图像、重绘、LoRA、图像编辑、图像放大、文字渲染。用途：AI 艺术、产品原型图、概念艺术、社交媒体配图、营销视觉素材、插画。触发词：flux、图像生成、AI 图像、文本生成图像、Stable Diffusion、生成图像、AI 艺术、Midjourney 替代方案、dall-e 替代方案、文本生成图像、t2i、图像生成器、AI 图片、使用 AI 创建图像、生成式 AI、AI 插画、Grok 图像、Gemini 图像、GPT 图像、OpenAI 图像、ChatGPT 图像

description: Generate MSBuild binary logs (binlogs) for build diagnostics and analysis. USE FOR: adding /bl:{} to any dotnet build, test, pack, publish, or restore command to capture a full build execution trace, prerequisite for binlog-failure-analysis and build-perf-diagnostics skills, enabling post-build investigation of errors or performance. Requires MSBuild 17.8+ / .NET 8 SDK+ for {} placeholder; PowerShell needs -bl:{{}}. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems (npm, Maven, CMake), analyzing an existing binlog (use binlog-failure-analysis instead).
description_zh: 生成 MSBuild 二进制日志（binlogs），用于构建诊断与分析。**用途：** 在任何 dotnet 构建、测试、打包、发布或还原命令中添加 /bl:{}，以捕获完整的构建执行轨迹；这是 binlog-失败分析 与 构建性能诊断 技能的前提条件，支持构建后进行错误或性能排查。需要 MSBuild 17.8+ / .NET 8 SDK+ 及 {} 占位符；PowerShell 需使用 -bl:{{}}。**切勿用于：** 非 MSBuild 构建系统（npm、Maven、CMake），以及分析现有 binlog 的情况（请改用 binlog-失败分析技能）。

description: Write publication-ready ML/AI papers for NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, AAAI, COLM. Use when drafting papers from research repos, structuring arguments, verifying citations, or preparing camera-ready submissions. For systems venues (OSDI, NSDI, ASPLOS, SOSP), use systems-paper-writing instead.
description_zh: 为 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、ACL、AAAI、COLM 撰写发表就绪的机器学习与人工智能论文。在从研究仓库起草论文、构建论点、核对引用或准备投稿定稿时使用。对于系统类会议（OSDI、NSDI、ASPLOS、SOSP），请改用系统论文写作。

description: Multi-agent swarm coordination for complex tasks. Uses hierarchical topology with specialized agents to break down and execute complex work across multiple files and modules. Use when: 3+ files need changes, new feature implementation, cross-module refactoring, API changes with tests, security-related changes, performance optimization across codebase, database schema changes. Skip when: single file edits, simple bug fixes (1-2 lines), documentation updates, configuration changes, quick exploration.
description_zh:
多智能体群协同处理复杂任务。采用层次化拓扑结构及专用智能体，分解并执行跨越多个文件与模块的复杂工作。

适用场景：
- 涉及3个及以上文件需修改
- 新功能实现
- 跨模块重构
- API变更（含测试）
- 安全相关变更
- 跨代码库的性能优化
- 数据库模式变更

跳过场景：
- 单文件编辑
- 简单Bug修复（1-2行）
- 文档更新
- 配置变更
- 快速探索

description: Validate whether an implementation matches its stated goal. Use this skill when a skill or agent wants a second opinion on its own output, when the user says "check this implementation", "validate what you did", "is this correct?", "review the output", or "did you do this right?". Also spawned automatically as a subagent by other skills (memory-bridge, daily-update) to self-check their outputs before presenting to the user. Returns a structured pass/warn/fail verdict with specific actionable issues.
description_zh: 验证实现是否与其既定目标相匹配。当技能或智能体希望对自身输出提出第二意见，或用户表示“检查此实现”“验证我的操作”“这是否正确”“审查输出”或“你是否正确执行此操作？”，以及当其他技能（memory-bridge、daily-update）自动将其作为子智能体派发，在向用户呈现前自查其输出时，使用本技能。该技能返回带有具体可操作问题的结构化通过/警告/不通过判定结论。

description: Turn competitor SEO data into a prioritized attack plan. Use when the user asks about competitor analysis, competitive gaps, how to outrank competitors, what competitors rank for, keyword overlap, or competitive positioning strategy. For building content to fill gaps, see brief and build-clusters.
description_zh: 将竞争对手的SEO数据转化为优先排序的攻击计划。当用户询问竞争对手分析、竞争差距、如何超越竞争对手、竞争对手排名的关键词、关键词重叠度或竞争定位策略时使用。如需填补空白构建内容，请参阅简报（brief）和构建集群（build-clusters）。

description: Diagnose and fix under-parallelized MSBuild builds. USE WHEN a multi-project solution build is slower than expected, doesn't speed up when you add cores, pegs a single core while others idle, or you want to know why `-m` isn't helping. Note: `/maxcpucount` default is 1 (sequential) — always pass `-m` for parallel builds. Covers finding the critical path (longest serial ProjectReference chain), graph build (`/graph`), BuildInParallel, and solution filters (`.slnf`). DO NOT USE FOR: single-project builds, incremental issues (use incremental-build), compilation slowness inside one project (use build-perf-diagnostics), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
诊断并修复并行度不足的 MSBuild 构建。

**适用场景（USE WHEN）**：当多项目解决方案构建比预期慢、添加核心后无法加速、占用单个核心而其他核心空闲，或您想知道为何 `-m` 不起作用时使用。

**注意（Note）**：`/maxcpucount` 默认为 1（顺序执行）——并行构建时始终需传入 `-m`。涵盖查找关键路径（最长的串行 ProjectReference 链）、图构建（`/graph`）、`BuildInParallel` 以及解决方案过滤器（`.slnf`）。

**切勿使用（DO NOT USE FOR）**：单项目构建、增量构建问题（使用 incremental-build）、单个项目内部的编译速度慢（使用 build-perf-diagnostics）以及非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: Use this skill when releasing OpenSpec: audit merged work and changeset coverage, decide whether a catch-up changeset PR is needed, prepare or resume the Changesets Version Packages PR, cut a beta or stable release, verify publishing, and polish GitHub release notes. Also use when asked whether an open release PR is complete, what the next release step is, or to continue a release paused for human approval.
description_zh: 在使用 OpenSpec 发布时使用本技能：审计已合并的工作和变更集覆盖范围，判断是否需要追加的变更集 PR，准备或恢复 Changesets 版本包 PR，发布 beta 或稳定版本，验证发布，并润色 GitHub 发布说明。当被询问开放的发布 PR 是否完整、下一步发布步骤是什么，或需要继续因人工审批而暂停的发布时，也使用本技能。

description: Help users craft product positioning and messaging. Use when someone is launching a product, differentiating from competitors, writing marketing copy, struggling to explain what their product does, or working on value propositions and taglines.
description_zh: 协助用户制定产品定位与传播信息。适用于产品发布、区别于竞争对手、撰写营销文案、难以解释产品功能，或构思价值主张与标语等场景。

description: Compliance expert for snyk-agent-scan — the agent skill file scanner — NOT for other Snyk CLI tools (snyk test, snyk code SAST, snyk iac, snyk container). Fixes alerts through content restructuring, never by suppressing or deleting information. Covers every file in a skill directory: SKILL.md, references/, assets/, and any secondary markdown. Apply when authoring a new skill, editing an existing one, triaging a failed snyk-agent-scan run locally or in CI, or unblocking a PR held by agent scanner failures. Not applicable to dependency vulnerabilities, code security findings, or infrastructure misconfigurations — those are out of scope.
description_zh: snyk-agent-scan（智能体技能文件扫描器）合规专家——不适用于其他 Snyk CLI 工具（snyk test、snyk code SAST、snyk iac、snyk container）。通过内容重构修复警报，绝不通过抑制或删除信息来修复。覆盖技能目录中的所有文件：SKILL.md、references/、assets/ 以及任何辅助 Markdown 文件。在编写新技能、编辑现有技能、在本地或 CI（持续集成）中排查 snyk-agent-scan 运行失败，或解除因智能体扫描器失败而阻塞的 PR 时应用。不适用于依赖漏洞、代码安全发现或基础设施配置错误——这些均不在适用范围之内。

description: Design, scaffold, build, and validate a new Contentful App Framework custom app for a customer's own repository or workspace. Use when users want to create a custom app from an idea, choose App Framework locations, build a sidebar app, field editor app, page app, dialog, configuration screen, App Action, or Function-backed app, scaffold with create-contentful-app, or make a locally testable app for an organization-specific Contentful workflow. Also triggers on "build a Contentful app", "custom app from scratch", "App Framework app", "sidebar app", "field editor app", "page app", "app action", and "app function". Not for generic Contentful API examples (contentful-api), content model migrations (contentful-migration), or website integration (contentful-nextjs).
description_zh: 为客户自身仓库或工作区设计、搭建、构建并验证新的内容创客应用框架自定义应用。适用于用户希望从想法创建自定义应用、选择应用框架位置、构建侧边栏应用、字段编辑器应用、页面应用、对话框、配置界面、应用操作或基于函数的应用、使用 create-contentful-app 进行脚手架搭建，或为特定组织的内容创客工作流创建可在本地测试的应用的场景。触发场景还包括“构建内容创客应用”、“从零创建自定义应用”、“应用框架应用”、“侧边栏应用”、“字段编辑器应用”、“页面应用”、“应用操作”和“应用函数”。不适用于通用的内容创客 API 示例（contentful-api）、内容模型迁移（contentful-migration）或网站集成（contentful-nextjs）。

description: Ingest OpenClaw agent history into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to mine their past OpenClaw sessions for knowledge, import their ~/.openclaw folder, extract insights from previous OpenClaw conversations, or says things like "process my OpenClaw history", "add my OpenClaw sessions to the wiki", "ingest ~/.openclaw", or "what have I worked on in OpenClaw". Also triggers when the user mentions OpenClaw session logs, MEMORY.md, daily notes, or ~/.openclaw/workspace.
description_zh: 将OpenClaw智能体的历史记录导入Obsidian wiki。当用户想要挖掘其过往OpenClaw会话中的知识、导入其~/.openclaw文件夹、从之前的OpenClaw对话中提取见解，或说"处理我的OpenClaw历史记录"、"将我的OpenClaw会话添加到wiki"、"导入~/.openclaw"或"我在OpenClaw中完成了哪些工作"等表述时，请使用此技能。当用户提及OpenClaw会话日志、MEMORY.md、日常笔记或~/.openclaw/workspace时，也会触发此技能。

description: Verify and debug native, React Native, Expo, or Flutter apps on an Android Emulator with agent-device. Use when an agent needs to launch an app, inspect its live UI, tap, type, scroll, validate a code change, collect failure evidence, or reproduce a workflow on an Android virtual device.
description_zh: 使用 agent-device 在 Android 模拟器中验证并调试原生、React Native、Expo 或 Flutter 应用。当 Agent 需要在 Android 虚拟设备上启动应用、检查其实时界面、点击、输入、滚动、验证代码更改、收集失败证据或重现工作流程时使用。

description: Guide a website migration without losing rankings — domain moves, CMS switches, URL restructures, HTTP to HTTPS, or redesigns. Use when the user asks about site migration, domain change, CMS migration, URL restructure, redesign SEO impact, redirect mapping, or how to move a site safely.
description_zh: 指导网站迁移，确保排名不丢失——涵盖域名迁移、内容管理系统（CMS）切换、URL 重构、HTTP 到 HTTPS 转换，或重新设计。当用户咨询网站迁移、域名变更、内容管理系统迁移、URL 重构、重新设计对 SEO 的影响、重定向映射，或如何安全迁移网站时使用。

description: Pre-launch checklist for shipping a new website or web app. Scope: analytics (GA4, PostHog, Google Search Console, Ahrefs), DNS, TLS and backups, legal and CNIL/GDPR compliance, security headers, SEO and GEO (robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt, hreflang, schema markup, keyword research), copywriting voice via TONE.md and a humanizer pass, OpenGraph and social previews, favicons and web manifest, Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals and WCAG quality gates, directory submissions, Product Hunt, G2/Capterra reviews, post-launch monitoring. Use when the user says 'checklist for the site', 'ready to ship', 'before I go live', 'ready for prod', 'audit before launch', or asks for a site review, pre-launch audit, or help launching a site or app, deploying a domain to production, or shipping a marketing, docs, SaaS, or lead-magnet site.
description_zh:
**新网站或 Web 应用上线前检查清单**

**适用范围：** 分析（GA4、PostHog、Google Search Console、Ahrefs）、DNS、TLS 与备份、法律及 CNIL/GDPR 合规性、安全头部信息、SEO 和 GEO（robots.txt、sitemaps、llms.txt、hreflang、schema markup、关键词研究）、通过 TONE.md 制定文案风格并经过人工优化处理的文案语调、OpenGraph 与社交预览、favicons 与 Web manifest、Lighthouse、Core Web Vitals 及 WCAG 质量门槛、目录提交、Product Hunt、G2/Capterra 评论、上线后监控。

**适用场景：** 当用户提及"网站检查清单"、"准备上线"、"上线前"、"准备投产"、"上线前审计"，或要求对网站进行审查、上线前审计、帮助发布网站或应用、将域名部署至生产环境，或发布营销类、文档类、SaaS 类或潜在客户诱饵类网站时使用。

description: Write modern, high-performance C# code using records, pattern matching, value objects, async/await, Span<T>/Memory<T>, and best-practice API design patterns. Emphasizes functional-style programming with C# 12+ features.
description_zh: 使用记录、模式匹配、值对象、async/await、Span<T>/Memory<T>& 以及最佳实践 API 设计模式，编写现代化、高性能的 C# 代码。强调基于 C# 12+ 特性的函数式编程。

description: Provides instructions for installing and using the `android` CLI. The `android` command-line tool is a critical tool for Android development and helps you create new Android projects, run Android apps on devices, manage and interact with Android virtual devices (including screenshots and UI inspection), manage Android SDK components, look up official Android documentation, and discover and install official Android skills.
description_zh: 为安装和使用 `android` CLI 提供说明。`android` 命令行工具是 Android 开发的关键工具，可帮助您创建新的 Android 项目、在设备上运行 Android 应用、管理和与 Android 虚拟设备（包括截图和 UI 检查）交互，管理 Android SDK 组件、查找官方 Android 文档，并发现和安装官方 Android 技能。

description: Locates and loads the right Google product skill on demand from a remote catalog index, instead of preloading every skill. Use at the START of any request touching a Google product, API, or developer platform - including Google Cloud (GKE, Cloud Run, IAM, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Spanner), Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Admin SDK), Chrome and Chrome extensions, Android, Firebase, YouTube, Google Maps, Gemini and the Gemini API, Google Play, and Flutter. Consult the index before answering from memory or searching the web. Don't use for non-Google products.
description_zh: 从远程目录索引按需定位并加载正确的 Google 产品技能，而不是预加载所有技能。在任何涉及 Google 产品、API 或开发者平台的请求开始时使用——包括 Google 云（GKE、Cloud Run、IAM、BigQuery、Vertex AI、Spanner）、Google 广告、Google 分析、Google 工作空间（Gmail、Drive、Admin SDK）、Chrome 及 Chrome 扩展程序、Android、Firebase、YouTube、Google Maps、Gemini 及 Gemini API、Google Play 和 Flutter。在凭记忆回答或搜索网络之前，请查阅该索引。不应用于非 Google 产品。

description: Work with Figma .fig design files and the running OpenPencil editor — inspect structure, query nodes, analyze design tokens, export PNG/SVG/PDF/JSX, and modify designs programmatically. Use when asked to open, inspect, export, analyze, or edit .fig files, or to control the running OpenPencil app.
description_zh: 使用 Figma .fig 设计文件和正在运行的 OpenPencil 编辑器工作——检查结构、查询节点、分析设计令牌、导出 PNG/SVG/PDF/JSX，并以编程方式修改设计。当被要求打开、检查、导出、分析或编辑 .fig 文件，或控制正在运行的 OpenPencil 应用时使用。

description: Create a modular type scale with size, weight, and line-height relationships. Use when establishing typographic structure. For line length only use `readable-measure`; for judging type on an existing screen use `critique-typography` (visual-critique).
description_zh: 创建具有尺寸、字重和行高关系的模块化字体尺度。用于建立排版结构时使用。仅用于行长度计算时使用 `readable-measure`；用于在现有屏幕上评估字体时使用 `critique-typography`（视觉评审）。

description: 국방전자조달시스템(D2B) 공개 입찰공고 검색 화면에서 공고건명·공고구분·공고/개찰일·G2B공고번호·발주기관 조건으로 공고를 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: 在国防电子采购系统(D2B)公开招标公告搜索界面中，以公告标题、公告分类、公告/截止日、G2B公告编号、发布机构条件查询公告。在硬件中，尽可能准备至最接近的合法正式程序。

description: Interact with local Chrome browser session (only on explicit user approval after being asked to inspect, debug, or interact with a page open in Chrome)
description_zh: 与本地 Chrome 浏览器会话交互（仅在用户明确批准后，因需检查、调试或操作 Chrome 中打开的页面）

description: When the user wants to create, plan, or optimize App Store In-App Events — the event cards that appear on the Today tab, search results, and your product page. Use when the user mentions "in-app event", "App Store event", "event card", "Today tab", "live event", "challenge", "game event", "seasonal event card", or wants visibility beyond organic search. For general ASO, see aso-audit. For seasonal keyword strategy, see seasonal-aso.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建、规划或优化 App Store 应用内活动——即在“今日”标签、搜索结果以及您的产品页面中展示的活动卡片。当用户提到“应用内活动”、“App Store 活动”、“活动卡片”、“今日标签”、“直播活动”、“挑战”、“游戏活动”、“季节性活动卡片”，或希望获得自然搜索之外的曝光时，使用此内容。对于通用的 ASO，请参阅 aso-audit。对于季节性关键词策略，请参阅 seasonal-aso。

description: Evaluate SaaS unit economics and capital efficiency. Use when deciding whether the business can scale efficiently or needs correction.
description_zh: 评估 SaaS 单位经济性与资本效率。用于判断业务能否高效扩张，或是否需要调整。

description: Diagnoses and fixes .NET MAUI development environment issues. Validates .NET SDK, workloads, Java JDK, Android SDK, Xcode, and Windows SDK. All version requirements discovered dynamically from NuGet WorkloadDependencies.json — never hardcoded. Use when: setting up MAUI development, build errors mentioning SDK/workload/JDK/Android, "Android SDK not found", "Java version" errors, "Xcode not found", environment verification after updates, or any MAUI toolchain issues. Do not use for: non-MAUI .NET projects, Xamarin.Forms apps, runtime app crashes unrelated to environment setup, or app store publishing issues. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
description_zh:
诊断并修复 .NET MAUI 开发环境问题。验证 .NET SDK、工作负载、Java JDK、Android SDK、Xcode 和 Windows SDK。所有版本要求均从 NuGet WorkloadDependencies.json 中动态发现——从未使用硬编码方式。

**适用场景：** 设置 MAUI 开发环境时，构建错误涉及 SDK/工作负载/JDK/Android，出现 "Android SDK not found"、"Java version" 错误、"Xcode not found"、更新后的环境验证，或任何 MAUI 工具链问题时使用。

**不适用场景：** 非 MAUI .NET 项目、Xamarin.Forms 应用、与开发环境设置无关的运行时应用程序崩溃，或应用商店发布问题。

支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 系统。

description: Comprehensive skill for Babylon.js 3D web rendering engine. Use this skill when building real-time 3D experiences, browser-based games, interactive visualizations, or immersive web applications. Triggers on tasks involving Babylon.js, 3D scenes, WebGL/WebGPU rendering, entity-component systems, physics simulations, PBR materials, shadow mapping, or 3D model loading. Alternative to Three.js with built-in editor integration and game engine features.
description_zh: Babylon.js 3D 网页渲染引擎的全面技能。在构建实时 3D 体验、浏览器游戏、交互式可视化或沉浸式网页应用时，使用此技能。在涉及 Babylon.js、3D 场景、WebGL/WebGPU 渲染、实体组件系统、物理模拟、PBR 材质、阴影映射或 3D 模型加载的任务时触发。作为 Three.js 的替代方案，具备内置编辑器集成和游戏引擎功能。

description:
iOS application development guide covering UIKit, SnapKit, and SwiftUI. Includes touch targets, safe areas, navigation patterns, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, accessibility, collection views, common UI components, and SwiftUI design guidelines. For detailed references on specific topics, see the reference files.
Use when: developing iOS apps, implementing UI, reviewing iOS code, working with UIKit/SnapKit/SwiftUI layouts, building iPhone interfaces, Swift mobile development, Apple HIG compliance, iOS accessibility implementation.
description_zh:
涵盖 UIKit、SnapKit 和 SwiftUI 的 iOS 应用开发指南。内容包括触控目标、安全区域、导航模式、动态字体、深色模式、无障碍访问、集合视图、常见 UI 组件以及 SwiftUI 设计指南。如需查看特定主题的详细参考，请参阅参考资料文件。

适用场景：开发 iOS 应用、实现 UI、审查 iOS 代码、使用 UIKit/SnapKit/SwiftUI 布局、构建 iPhone 界面、Swift 移动开发、符合 Apple HIG 规范、实施 iOS 无障碍功能。

description: Use as the top-level router for Omniverse Realtime Viewer USD app requests and focused viewer reference documents.
description_zh: 作为 Omniverse Realtime Viewer 的 USD 应用请求和聚焦查看器参考文档的顶层路由器使用。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Cline coding agent CLI (`cline`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Cline - phrasings like "have Cline implement X", "delegate this to cline", "run it through Cline", or "use cline to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Cline while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Cline 编程智能体 CLI（`cline`），作为后台实现者，然后审查其 diff 并自行落地。当用户希望将实现工作委托给 Cline——例如提出“让 Cline 实现 X”、“将此项委托给 cline”、“让 Cline 处理该任务”，或“使用 cline 实现/修复/重构”等表述，或者希望将一组编码任务通过 Cline 处理、同时由您担任审查者时，请使用此方法。请勿用于足够简单、可直接内联完成的（任务），也不要用于用户要求不委托、直接编写代码的情况。

description: MUST activate to localize / internationalize a uiBundles/*/src/ project (React or Angular): extract hardcoded user-facing strings into Custom Labels, wire a runtime i18n library over the Platform SDK backend, add labels for another language, or troubleshoot label rendering across locales. Triggers: user-facing string literals in component files, a CustomLabels.labels-meta.xml, a src/i18n/ directory or label-manifest.ts, translation call sites, or requests to 'translate / localize / internationalize / support another language.' Scope: authenticated B2E UI Bundles and B2C site bundles. Use experience-ui-bundle-site-generate instead for site language configuration or sfdc_cms__languageSettings. DO NOT TRIGGER for B2B site bundles, building app shell/UI or styling, reading/writing/refreshing records (use experience-ui-bundle-salesforce-data-access), generating a new bundle (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate), deploying (use experience-ui-bundle-deploy), or authoring translations in Translation Workbench.
description_zh:
必须激活以本地化 / 国际化 uiBundles/*/src/ 项目（React 或 Angular）：将硬编码的用户界面字符串提取到 Custom Labels 中，在 Platform SDK 后端之上连接运行时 i18n 库，为另一种语言添加标签，或调试跨本地化区域的标签渲染。

触发条件：组件文件中的用户界面字符串字面量、CustomLabels.labels-meta.xml、src/i18n/ 目录或 label-manifest.ts、翻译调用点，或对“翻译 / 本地化 / 国际化 / 支持另一种语言”的请求。

适用范围：经过身份验证的 B2E UI Bundles 和 B2C 站点 Bundles。

如需站点语言配置或 sfdc_cms__languageSettings，请改用 experience-ui-bundle-site-generate。

不要针对 B2B 站点 Bundles、构建应用外壳/UI 或样式、读取/写入/刷新记录（使用 experience-ui-bundle-salesforce-data-access）、生成新 Bundle（使用 experience-ui-bundle-fronten-generate）、部署（使用 experience-ui-bundle-deploy）或在翻译工作台编写翻译的情况触发。

description: Browse, filter, and download life sciences, biology, and medical preprints from bioRxiv and medRxiv. Supports fetching paper metadata by DOI, and browsing by date range with category and keyword filters. Keyword filtering is local, so date ranges MUST be narrow (1-4 weeks) with a category to prevent timeouts.
description_zh: 浏览、筛选并下载 bioRxiv 和 medRxiv 上的生命科学、生物学及医学预印本。支持通过 DOI 获取论文元数据，并按日期范围浏览、结合类别和关键词进行筛选。关键词筛选在本地进行，因此为防止超时，日期范围必须较窄（1-4 周），并需选择相应类别。

description: Screen US equities for parabolic exhaustion patterns and generate conditional pre-market short plans, then evaluate intraday trigger fires from live 5-min bars. Phase 1 daily 5-factor scorer (MA extension / acceleration / volume climax / range expansion / liquidity), Phase 2 per-candidate plans for ORL break / first-red 5-min / VWAP fail with explicit borrow / SSR / manual-confirmation gating, Phase 3 one-shot intraday FSM that detects trigger fires and resolves concrete share counts. Covers Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3.
description_zh: 对美股进行抛物线衰竭形态筛选，并生成条件性盘前做空计划，随后基于实时5分钟K线评估日内触发事件。第一阶段为每日五因子评分器（均线延伸 / 加速 / 成交量高潮 / 区间扩张 / 流动性），第二阶段为每候选标的针对 ORL 突破 / 首根红K线5分钟 / VWAP 未跌破的计划，并设置明确借券 / SSR / 手动确认门槛；第三阶段为一次性日内有限状态机（FSM），检测触发事件并确定具体股数。涵盖第一阶段 + 第二阶段 + 第三阶段。

description: Configure and collect crash dumps for modern .NET applications. USE FOR: enabling automatic crash dumps for CoreCLR or NativeAOT, capturing dumps from running .NET processes, setting up dump collection in Docker or Kubernetes, using dotnet-dump collect or createdump. DO NOT USE FOR: analyzing or debugging dumps, post-mortem investigation with lldb/windbg/dotnet-dump analyze, profiling or tracing, or for .NET Framework processes.
description_zh:
为现代 .NET 应用程序配置并收集崩溃转储。

用途：为 CoreCLR 或 NativeAOT 启用自动崩溃转储，捕获运行中 .NET 进程的转储，在 Docker 或 Kubernetes 中配置转储收集，使用 dotnet-dump collect 或 createdump。

请勿用于：分析或调试转储，使用 lldb/windbg/dotnet-dump analyze 进行事后分析，性能分析或跟踪，或用于 .NET Framework 进程。

description: Use when writing blog posts or documentation markdown files - provides writing style guide (active voice, present tense), content structure patterns, and MDC component usage. Overrides brevity rules for proper grammar. Use nuxt-content for MDC syntax, nuxt-ui for component props.
description_zh: 在撰写博客文章或文档 Markdown 文件时使用 - 提供写作风格指南（主动语态、现在时态）、内容结构模式及 MDC 组件使用说明。为符合正确语法，覆盖简洁规则。使用 nuxt-content 处理 MDC 语法，使用 nuxt-ui 处理组件属性。

description: Translate existing blog posts into one or more target languages with SEO-optimized localization. Produces native-quality translations that preserve markdown structure, frontmatter, schema JSON-LD, image and chart embeds, and evidence-backed explanations. Localizes keywords, meta tags, numbers, dates, currencies, and quote styles per locale. Flags machine-translation artifacts for review. Run BEFORE blog-localize: this handles language conversion; localize handles cultural adaptation after translation completes. Use when user says "translate blog", "blog translate", "uebersetzen", "traduire", "traducir", "translate post", "blog auf Deutsch", "blog en espanol".
description_zh: 使用基于SEO优化的本地化，将现有博客文章翻译为一种或多种目标语言。生成原生质量的翻译，并保留Markdown结构、前置元数据、schema JSON-LD、图片和图表嵌入以及基于证据的解释。根据地区（语言环境）对关键词、元标签、数字、日期、货币及引用样式进行本地化。标记机器翻译产生的瑕疵，以供人工审核。在 blog-localize 之前运行：本功能负责语言转换；blog-localize 则负责翻译完成后的文化适配。当用户说出“translate blog”、“blog translate”、“uebersetzen”、“traduire”、“traducir”、“translate post”、“blog auf Deutsch”、“blog en espanol”时使用。

description:
Paul Graham的思维框架与表达方式。基于200+篇essays、12个播客/访谈、
Twitter/X分析、7位核心批评者视角和完整人生时间线的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用PG的视角分析创业、写作、产品和人生选择。
当用户提到「用PG的视角」「Paul Graham会怎么看」「PG模式」「paul graham perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「帮我用PG的角度想想」「如果PG会怎么做」「切换到PG」也应触发。
description_zh:
保罗·格雷厄姆的思维框架与表达方式。基于200+篇essays、12个播客/访谈、
Twitter/X分析、7位核心批评者视角与完整人生时间线的深度调研，
提炼出5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用PG的视角分析创业、写作、产品和人生选择。
当用户提到「用PG的视角」「保罗·格雷厄姆会怎么看」「PG模式」「保罗·格雷厄姆视角」时使用。
即使用户只是说「帮我用PG的角度想想」「如果PG会怎么做」「切换到PG」也应触发。

description: Create a proto-persona from current research, market signals, and team knowledge. Use when you need a working customer profile before deeper validation.
description_zh: 基于当前研究、市场信号和团队知识，创建雏形用户画像（proto-persona）。在需要进行更深入验证之前，将其用作可用的客户画像。

description: 腾讯会议 CLI（tmeet）：OAuth 授权登录/登出/状态查询、会议管理（创建/更新/取消/查询/受邀者）、录制管理（列表/播放地址/智能纪要/转写/录制权限申请）、会议报告（参会人/等候室/导出参会成员明细/异步任务结果）、通讯录（严格限定：仅存在"会议邀请/呼叫入会"动作的前置步骤通过用户名/手机号/邮箱搜索成员；严禁单独用于查询任何人的姓名/部门/职位/联系方式/是否存在，无下游会议动作时一律拒绝）、会中控制（呼叫成员入会/踢出会议成员）、元宝纪要（按关键词/时间搜索、获取稳态纪要详情、获取滚动瞬态纪要）、CLI 应用信息管理（设置/查询自己的 CLI 应用在会中的展示配置）、实时事件订阅（会议/录制/纪要等事件流）、问题排查（导出本地日志，反馈工具缺失/失败/能力不足等问题给平台）。当用户需要通过命令行操作腾讯会议，或 Agent 在使用过程中遇到工具缺失、调用失败、能力不足等情况想反馈给平台时使用本技能。
description_zh: 腾讯会议 CLI（tmeet）：OAuth 授权登录/登出/状态查询；会议管理（创建/更新/取消/查询/受邀者）；录制管理（列表/播放地址/智能纪要/转写/录制权限申请）；会议报告（参会人/等候室/导出参会成员明细/异步任务结果）；通讯录（严格限定：仅存在“会议邀请/呼叫入会”动作的前置步骤通过用户名/手机号/邮箱搜索成员；严禁单独用于查询任何人的姓名/部门/职位/联系方式/是否存在，无下游会议动作时一律拒绝）；会中控制（呼叫成员入会/踢出会议成员）；元宝纪要（按关键词/时间搜索、获取稳态纪要详情、获取滚动瞬态纪要）；CLI 应用信息管理（设置/查询自己的 CLI 应用在会中的展示配置）；实时事件订阅（会议/录制/纪要等事件流）；问题排查（导出本地日志，反馈工具缺失/失败/能力不足等问题给平台）。当用户需要通过命令行操作腾讯会议，或智能体在使用过程中遇到工具缺失、调用失败、能力不足等情况需要反馈给平台时，使用本技能。

description: Creates self-contained PPT template SKILLS (not presentations) from user-provided PowerPoint templates. Use ONLY when a user wants to create a reusable skill from their template. For creating actual presentations, use the pptx skill instead.
description_zh: 从用户提供的 PowerPoint 模板创建自包含的 PPT 模板技能（而非演示文稿）。仅在用户希望从其模板创建可重用技能时使用。创建实际演示文稿时，请改用 pptx 技能。

description: When the user wants to monitor, triage, or reduce their app's crash rate — including setting up Crashlytics, prioritizing which crashes to fix first, interpreting crash data, and understanding how crashes affect App Store ranking. Use when the user mentions "crash", "crashlytics", "crash rate", "ANR", "app not responding", "crash-free sessions", "crash-free users", "symbolication", "stability", "firebase crashes", "app crashing", or "crash report". For overall analytics setup, see app-analytics.
description_zh: 当用户想要监控、分类或降低其应用的崩溃率——包括设置 Crashlytics、优先确定首先修复哪些崩溃、解读崩溃数据，以及理解崩溃如何影响 App Store 排名。当用户提及“crash”、“crashlytics”、“crash rate”、“ANR”、“app not responding”、“crash-free sessions”、“crash-free users”、“symbolication”、“stability”、“firebase crashes”、“app crashing”或“crash report”时，请使用此功能。如需整体分析设置，请参阅 app-analytics。

description: Bash scripting workflow for creating production-ready shell scripts with defensive patterns, error handling, and testing.
description_zh: 创建生产就绪 Shell 脚本的 Bash 脚本工作流程，包含防御性模式、错误处理和测试。

description: Ask the user for a code review by opening the changes in difit, a local diff viewer. Explicit opt-in only — use when the user names difit, asks to open or show the diff in the viewer, or has a standing instruction to request reviews through difit after changes. Do not use it for ordinary requests to review code, diffs, commits, branches, or pull requests.
description_zh: 通过打开 difit（一个本地差异查看器）中的更改，向用户请求代码审查。仅需在明确同意后使用——当用户提及 difit、要求打开或在查看器中显示差异，或在对更改后要求通过 difit 请求审查的固定指令时使用。不得将其用于普通代码、差异、提交、分支或拉取请求的审查请求。

description: Create tiny no-text Milvus-style sticker memes for technical marketing, WeChat-style article moments, community posts, and developer-group reactions. Use when the user wants an original meme/sticker with an abstract Milvus bird/eagle mascot, strong exaggerated emotion, internet-native sticker energy, light-blue accents without making the whole character blue, and deterministic small-size exports such as 512, 240, 120, or 50 px.
description_zh: 为技术营销、微信风格的文章时刻、社区帖子及开发者群反应，创建微小的无文字Milvus风格贴纸迷因。当用户需要带有抽象Milvus鸟/鹰吉祥物、强烈夸张情绪、原生互联网贴纸感、浅蓝色点缀（不使整个角色呈现蓝色）的原创迷因/贴纸时使用。需支持确定性的小尺寸导出，如512、240、120或50像素（px）。

description: Use when reading or writing Python files (.py, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt).
description_zh: 用于阅读或编写 Python 文件（.py、pyproject.toml、requirements.txt）时使用。

description: This skill should be used whenever the user runs any cx command, uses the cx CLI, Coralogix CLI, or mentions cx in the context of Coralogix observability. This skill provides cross-cutting concerns like update notifications that apply to all cx commands.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户执行任何 cx 命令、使用 cx CLI、Coralogix CLI，或在 Coralogix 可观测性上下文中提及 cx 时使用。本技能提供适用于所有 cx 命令的横切关注点，例如更新通知。

description: Help users master professional writing to bridge gaps between stakeholders, scale their leadership influence, and ensure organizational clarity through structured narratives and async-first norms.
description_zh: 帮助用户掌握专业写作，以弥合利益相关者间的差距，扩大其领导影响力，并确保组织清晰度，通过结构化叙事与异步优先的规范。

description: Guides technology selection and implementation of AI and ML features in .NET 8+ applications using ML.NET, Microsoft.Extensions.AI (MEAI), Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), GitHub Copilot SDK, ONNX Runtime, and OllamaSharp. Covers the full spectrum from classic ML through modern LLM orchestration to local inference. Use when adding classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, recommendation, LLM integration (text generation, summarization, reasoning), RAG pipelines with vector search, agentic workflows with tool calling, Copilot extensions, or custom model inference via ONNX Runtime to a .NET project. DO NOT USE FOR projects targeting .NET Framework (requires .NET 8+), the task is pure data engineering or ETL with no ML/AI component, or the project needs a custom deep learning training loop (use Python with PyTorch/TensorFlow, then export to ONNX for .NET inference).
description_zh: 使用 ML.NET、Microsoft.Extensions.AI (MEAI)、Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)、GitHub Copilot SDK、ONNX Runtime 和 OllamaSharp，指导 .NET 8+ 应用中 AI 与 ML 技术的选型与实现。涵盖从经典机器学习（ML）到现代 LLM 编排，再到本地推理的全流程。当向 .NET 项目添加分类、回归、聚类、异常检测、推荐、LLM 集成（文本生成、摘要、推理）、基于向量搜索的 RAG 流水线、具有工具调用的 Agent 工作流、Copilot 扩展，或通过 ONNX Runtime 进行自定义模型推理时使用。请勿用于面向 .NET 框架的项目（需要 .NET 8+）、任务为纯数据工程或 ETL 且无 ML/AI 组件的项目，或需要自定义深度学习训练循环的项目（请使用 Python 及 PyTorch/TensorFlow，然后导出至 ONNX 供 .NET 推理）。

description: Creates a new Mojo or MAX project. Use when wanting to start a new Mojo or MAX project, initializing the `pixi` or `uv` environment to use Mojo or MAX, or when the user wants to begin a new Mojo or MAX project from scratch.
description_zh: 创建新的 Mojo 或 MAX 项目。在需要启动新的 Mojo 或 MAX 项目、初始化 `pixi` 或 `uv` 环境以使用 Mojo 或 MAX，或用户希望从零开始启动新的 Mojo 或 MAX 项目时使用。

description: Produce a professional training/workshop report as a .docx file.
