Use this skill whenever the user mentions "training report", "workshop report", "compte rendu", "compte rendu de formation", "formation report", "debriefing a workshop", "write up a training session", "résumé de formation", or any request to document a training session, workshop, or onboarding event with individual participant feedback and recommendations. Also trigger when the user says things like "I just ran a workshop and need to write it up", "help me summarize what happened in my training session", or "I need to report back to management about a session I ran". Always use this skill — for short or long sessions, across any discipline (technical, soft skills, creative, compliance, onboarding, etc.) — whenever a structured written deliverable about a training event is needed.
description_zh: 以 .docx 文件格式生成一份专业的培训/研讨会报告。只要用户提到“培训报告”、“研讨会报告”、“纪要”、“培训纪要”、“培训报告”、“研讨会复盘”、“撰写培训环节报告”、“培训总结报告”，或任何要求记录包含每位参与者的反馈与建议的培训环节、研讨会或入职活动的请求，就使用此技能。当用户提及诸如“我刚举办完一场研讨会，需要将其整理成报告”、“帮助我总结培训环节发生的情况”，或“我需要就我举办/主持的培训环节向管理层汇报”等表述时，也触发该技能。无论培训环节时间长短、学科领域（技术、软技能、创意、合规、入职等）如何，只要需要生成关于培训活动的结构化书面交付成果，就始终使用此技能。

description:
Pure text-to-image generation for all creative scenarios (no reference photo). Covers logo design, poster design, illustration, meme, game assets, social media content, 3D rendering, education, fashion, food, pet, wedding, holiday marketing, and artistic styles.

Use when generating images from text descriptions without a reference photo (e.g. design a logo, create a poster, generate game art, make a meme, 3D render).
description_zh:
纯文本转图像生成，适用于所有创意场景（无需参考照片）。涵盖标志设计、海报设计、插画、表情包、游戏资产、社交媒体内容、3D 渲染、教育、时尚、美食、宠物、婚礼、节日营销以及艺术风格。

在根据文本描述生成图像且无需参考照片时使用（例如：设计标志、制作海报、生成游戏美术、制作表情包、3D 渲染）。

description: Calculate TAM, SAM, and SOM with explicit assumptions, methods, and caveats. Use when sizing a market for a product idea, business case, or executive review.
description_zh: 结合明确的假设、方法和注意事项，计算 TAM、SAM 和 SOM。适用于为产品创意、商业案例或高管评审测算市场规模。

description:
Authoritative guide for implementing stunning, accessible, performant UI. Synthesizes
design engineering philosophy, accessibility standards, animation principles, spatial design,
typography, color systems, and component craft into a single actionable reference.
Complements the design-system skill (which covers DESIGN.md spec writing) by covering
the HOW of implementation.
Trigger phrases: "build UI", "create component", "landing page", "make it look good",
"frontend", "design", "polish UI", "implement design", "make it beautiful",
"UI implementation", "component styling", "animation", "accessibility"
description_zh:
权威指南，用于实现惊艳、无障碍、高性能的UI。融合设计工程理念、无障碍标准、动画原则、空间设计、排版、色彩系统和组件工艺，形成一份单一可操作的参考。

该指南通过覆盖实现方法，来补充设计系统技能（该技能涵盖DESIGN.md规范编写）。

触发短语：“构建UI”、“创建组件”、“落地页”、“使其看起来不错”、“前端”、“设计”、“润色UI”、“实现设计”、“使其美观”、“UI实现”、“组件样式”、“动画”、“无障碍”

description: Design and coordinate multi-agent systems where specialized agents work together to solve complex problems. Covers agent communication, task delegation, workflow orchestration, and result aggregation. Use when building coordinated agent teams, complex workflows, or systems requiring specialized expertise across domains.
description_zh: 设计并协调多智能体系统，使专门智能体协同解决复杂问题。涵盖智能体通信、任务委派、工作流编排和结果汇总。适用于构建协调的智能体团队、复杂工作流，或需要跨领域专业知识支持的系统。

description: Compare multiple strategies or directions (long vs short vs both) on the same symbol. Generates side-by-side stats table.
description_zh: 在同一标的上对比多种策略或方向（做多、做空、双向），生成并排统计表格。

description: Testing best practices for the frontend. Emphasizes E2E tests over unit tests, minimal mocking, and testing behavior over implementation details. Use when writing tests or reviewing test code.
description_zh: 前端测试最佳实践。强调以端到端（E2E）测试优于单元测试、尽量减少模拟，并关注行为而非实现细节。编写测试或审查测试代码时使用。

description: Create AI avatar and talking head videos via inference.sh CLI. Recommended: P-Video-Avatar (fastest, cheapest, built-in TTS). Also: OmniHuman, Fabric, PixVerse. Audio: Inworld TTS-2 (100+ languages, emotion steering for characters), ElevenLabs, Kokoro. Capabilities: audio-driven avatars, text-to-avatar, lipsync videos, talking head generation, virtual presenters, UGC content. Use for: AI presenters, explainer videos, virtual influencers, dubbing, marketing videos, UGC ads, gaming avatars, NPC dialogue. Triggers: ai avatar, talking head, lipsync, avatar video, virtual presenter, ai spokesperson, audio driven video, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, talking avatar, lip sync, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, ugc, ugc video, ugc ad, avatar ugc
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh CLI 创建 AI 虚拟形象和口播视频。

推荐：P-Video-Avatar（最快、最便宜、内置 TTS）。此外还有：OmniHuman、Fabric、PixVerse。

音频：Inworld TTS-2（支持 100 多种语言及角色情感引导），ElevenLabs、Kokoro。

功能：音频驱动虚拟形象、文本转虚拟形象、唇形同步视频、口播视频生成、虚拟主持人、UGC 内容。

用途：AI 主持人、解说视频、虚拟网红、配音、营销视频、UGC 广告、游戏虚拟形象、NPC 对话。

触发词：AI 虚拟形象、口播、唇形同步、虚拟形象视频、虚拟主持人、AI 发言人、音频驱动视频、HeyGen 替代方案、Synthesia 替代方案、口播虚拟形象、唇形同步、视频虚拟形象、AI 主持人、数字人、UGC、UGC 视频、UGC 广告、虚拟形象 UGC

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for PHP. Use when asked to "add Sentry to PHP", "install sentry/sentry", "setup Sentry in PHP", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, logging, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for PHP applications. Supports plain PHP, Laravel, and Symfony.
description_zh:
PHP 的完整 Sentry SDK 设置。

当被要求将 Sentry 添加到 PHP 中、安装 sentry/sentry、在 PHP 中设置 Sentry，或为 PHP 应用配置错误监控、追踪、性能分析、日志记录、指标、定时任务（crons）或 AI 监控时使用。

支持纯 PHP、Laravel 和 Symfony。

description: Next.js App Router SEO optimization and auditing. Use when implementing or fixing SEO in a Next.js app — metadata and generateMetadata, viewport/themeColor, Open Graph and og/twitter images (file conventions + ImageResponse), web app manifest, favicons/icons, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, canonical URLs, hreflang/i18n alternates, JSON-LD structured data and rich results, Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP/CLS), AI search/GEO and AI crawler rules (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot), or diagnosing Google indexing problems (Search Console, "Discovered/Crawled - currently not indexed"). Also use to run an SEO audit checklist. Not for general Next.js feature work unrelated to SEO.
description_zh: Next.js App Router 的 SEO 优化与审计。在 Next.js 应用中实施或修复 SEO 时使用——处理 metadata 与 generateMetadata、viewport 与 themeColor、Open Graph 与 og/twitter 图片（文件约定 + ImageResponse）、Web 应用 manifest、favicons/图标、sitemap.xml、robots.txt、canonical URL、hreflang/i18n 备选链接、JSON-LD 结构化数据与丰富结果、Core Web Vitals（LCP/INP/CLS）、AI 搜索/GEO 与 AI 爬虫规则（GPTBot、OAI-SearchBot），或诊断 Google 索引问题（Search Console、“已发现/已抓取 - 当前未被索引”）。也可用于执行 SEO 审计检查清单。不适用于与 SEO 无关的通用 Next.js 功能工作。

description: Recommend the right trading workflow, skillset, API profile, and setup path from a natural-language goal. Use this as the on-ramp when a user expresses a trading or investing goal and needs to know which skill/workflow to use, where to start, or whether something works without paid API keys — e.g. "where do I start", "which skill should I use", "I want to swing trade only when the market is favorable", "what works without API keys", "どれを使えばいい", "API キー無しで 使えるものは". Routes and explains only; it never executes trades or auto-runs other skills, and it is honest when no workflow has shipped yet.
description_zh: 根据用户以自然语言表达的目标，推荐合适的交易工作流、技能组合、API 配置方案和设置路径。当用户表达交易或投资目标，并需要了解应使用哪个技能/工作流、从哪里开始，或某项功能在无需付费 API 密钥的情况下即可使用时，将其作为入口引导，例如：“我该如何开始”、“应该使用哪个技能”、“我希望只在市场有利时进行波段交易”、“什么无需 API 密钥即可使用”、“どれを使えばいい”、“API キー無しで 使えるものは”。仅提供路径指引和说明；不会执行交易，也不会自动运行其他技能，且在尚未发布任何工作流时也会如实说明。

description: A collection of specialized AI agent personalities for Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Windsurf, and other AI coding tools — covering engineering, design, marketing, sales, and more.
description_zh: 专为Claude Code、Cursor、Aider、Windsurf等AI编程工具打造的一系列专项AI智能体人设，涵盖工程、设计、营销、销售等多个领域。

description: Generate an interactive PR review walkthrough as an HTML page. Fetches PR data via gh API, categorizes files into core vs mechanical changes, adds reviewer annotations, and renders diffs with moved-code detection. Use when the user pastes a GitHub PR URL and asks for a review, walkthrough, or summary, or says "review this PR".
description_zh: 生成一个交互式的PR评审操作指南HTML页面。通过gh API获取PR数据，将文件分类为核心变更与机械变更，添加评审者批注，并渲染带有移动代码检测功能的差异。当用户粘贴GitHub PR链接并请求评审、操作指南或总结，或说“review this PR”时使用。

description: Prompting techniques for AI image generation and editing models on Replicate. Use when writing prompts for image models or building image generation features.
description_zh: Replicate 上 AI 图像生成与编辑模型的提示词技巧。用于为图像模型编写提示词或构建图像生成功能。

description: A collection of best practices and tips for developing applications using Vue.js. This skill MUST be apply when developing, refactoring or reviewing Vue.js or Nuxt projects.
description_zh: 一套使用 Vue.js 开发应用程序的最佳实践和技巧。在使用 Vue.js 或 Nuxt 项目进行开发、重构或审查时，此技能必须应用。

description: Guide for diagnosing and improving MSBuild project evaluation performance. USE FOR: builds slow before any compilation starts, high evaluation time in binlog analysis, expensive glob patterns walking large directories (node_modules, .git, bin/obj), deep import chains (>20 levels), preprocessed output >10K lines indicating heavy evaluation, property functions with file I/O ($([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...))), multiple evaluations per project. Covers the 5 MSBuild evaluation phases, glob optimization via DefaultItemExcludes, import chain analysis with /pp preprocessing. DO NOT USE FOR: compilation-time slowness (use build-perf-diagnostics), incremental build issues (use incremental-build), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
**MSBuild 项目评估性能诊断与优化指南**

**使用场景：**
- 在编译开始前构建即变慢
- binlog 分析中评估耗时过高
- 在大目录（node_modules、.git、bin/obj）中遍历 glob 模式成本过高
- 存在深层导入链（超过 20 层）
- 预处理输出超过 10K 行，表明评估负担较重
- 属性函数中包含文件 I/O（$([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...))）
- 每个项目多次进行评估

**涵盖内容：**
- 5 个 MSBuild 评估阶段
- 通过 DefaultItemExcludes 进行 glob 优化
- 借助 /pp 预处理进行导入链分析

**禁止使用场景：**
- 编译时变慢（应使用 build-perf-diagnostics）
- 增量构建问题（应使用 incremental-build）
- 非 MSBuild 构建系统

description: Activate this skill when BenchmarkDotNet (BDN) is involved in the task — creating, running, configuring, or reviewing BDN benchmarks. Also activate when microbenchmarking .NET code would be useful and BenchmarkDotNet is the likely tool. Consider activating when answering a .NET performance question requires measurement and BenchmarkDotNet may be needed. Covers microbenchmark design, BDN configuration and project setup, how to run BDN microbenchmarks efficiently and effectively, and using BDN for side-by-side performance comparisons. Do NOT use for profiling/tracing .NET code (dotnet-trace, PerfView), production telemetry, or load/stress testing (Crank, k6).
description_zh:
当任务涉及 BenchmarkDotNet（BDN）——创建、运行、配置或审查 BDN 基准测试时，激活此技能。当对 .NET 代码进行微基准测试具有实用性且 BenchmarkDotNet 很可能是推荐工具时，也请激活此技能。当回答 .NET 性能问题需要测量，且可能需要 BenchmarkDotNet 时，请考虑激活此技能。

该技能涵盖微基准测试设计、BDN 配置与项目设置、如何高效且有效地运行 BDN 微基准测试，以及使用 BDN 进行并排性能对比。请勿将此技能用于 .NET 代码的性能剖析/追踪（dotnet-trace, PerfView）、生产环境遥测，或负载/压力测试（Crank, k6）。

description: cuOpt REST server — start server, endpoints, Python/curl client examples. Use when the user is deploying or calling the REST API.
description_zh: cuOpt REST 服务器 — 启动服务器、接口端点、Python/curl 客户端示例。适用于用户部署或调用 REST API 时使用。

description: Migrate a .NET 10 project or solution to .NET 11 and resolve all breaking changes. This is a MIGRATION skill — use it when upgrading from .NET 10 to .NET 11, NOT for writing new programs. USE FOR: upgrading TargetFramework from net10.0 to net11.0, fixing build errors after updating the .NET 11 SDK, resolving source-breaking and behavioral changes in .NET 11 runtime, C# 15 compiler, and EF Core 11, adapting to updated minimum hardware requirements (x86-64-v2, Arm64 LSE), and updating CI/CD pipelines and Dockerfiles for .NET 11. DO NOT USE FOR: .NET Framework migrations, upgrading from .NET 9 or earlier, greenfield .NET 11 projects, or cosmetic modernization unrelated to the upgrade. NOTE: .NET 11 is in preview. Covers breaking changes through Preview 3.
description_zh:
将 .NET 10 项目或解决方案迁移至 .NET 11，并解决所有破坏性变更。这是一个迁移技能——在从 .NET 10 升级到 .NET 11 时使用，而非用于编写新程序。

适用场景：
将 TargetFramework 从 net10.0 升级至 net11.0、在更新 .NET 11 SDK 后修复构建错误、解决 .NET 11 运行时、C# 15 编译器及 EF Core 11 中的源破坏性和行为变更、适配更新后的最低硬件要求（x86-64-v2、Arm64 LSE），以及为 .NET 11 更新 CI/CD 流水线和 Dockerfiles。

不适用场景：
.NET Framework 迁移、从 .NET 9 或更早版本升级、全新 .NET 11 项目，或与此升级无关的纯外观现代化。

注意：.NET 11 处于预览阶段，涵盖至 Preview 3 阶段的破坏性变更。

description:
Build institutional-grade comparable company analyses with operating metrics, valuation multiples, and statistical benchmarking in Excel/spreadsheet format.

**Perfect for:**
- Public company valuation (M&A, investment analysis)
- Benchmarking performance vs. industry peers
- Pricing IPOs or funding rounds
- Identifying valuation outliers (over/under-valued)
- Supporting investment committee presentations
- Creating sector overview reports

**Not ideal for:**
- Private companies without comparable public peers
- Highly diversified conglomerates
- Distressed/bankrupt companies
- Pre-revenue startups
- Companies with unique business models
description_zh:
以 Excel/电子表格格式，构建包含运营指标、估值倍数及统计基准对比的机构级可比公司分析。

**适用于：**
- 上市公司估值（并购、投资分析）
- 与行业同行对业绩进行基准对比
- 为 IPO 或融资轮次定价
- 识别估值异常值（高估/低估）
- 为投资委员会演示提供支持
- 编制行业概览报告

**不适用于：**
- 没有可比公开同行的私有公司
- 高度多元化的综合集团
- 困境/破产公司
- 尚未产生收入的初创公司
- 商业模式独特的企业

description: Evaluate pricing changes using ARPU, conversion, churn risk, NRR, and payback. Use when deciding whether a pricing move should ship.
description_zh: 使用 ARPU、转化率、流失风险、NRR 和回本周期评估定价调整。用于判断定价调整是否应实施。

description: Convert .NET projects and solutions (.sln, .slnx) to NuGet Central Package Management (CPM) using Directory.Packages.props. USE FOR: converting to CPM, centralizing or aligning NuGet package versions across multiple projects, inlining MSBuild version properties from Directory.Build.props into Directory.Packages.props, resolving version conflicts or mismatches across a solution or repository, updating or bumping or syncing package versions across projects. Also activate when packages are out of sync, drifting, or inconsistent -- even without the user mentioning CPM. Provides baseline build capture, version conflict resolution, build validation with binlog comparison, and a structured post-conversion report. DO NOT USE FOR: packages.config projects (must migrate to PackageReference first) or repositories that already have CPM fully enabled.
description_zh:
使用 Directory.Packages.props，将 .NET 项目与解决方案（.sln、.slnx）转换为 NuGet 中央包管理（CPM）。

用途：将项目转换为 CPM，在多个项目之间集中或统一 NuGet 包版本，将 Directory.Build.props 中的 MSBuild 版本属性内联至 Directory.Packages.props，解决解决方案或仓库中的版本冲突或不一致，以及在项目之间更新、提升或同步包版本。

激活条件：当包版本不同步、漂移或不一致时激活——即使用户未提及 CPM。

提供能力：基线构建捕获、版本冲突解决、结合 binlog 对比的构建验证，以及结构化的转换后报告。

禁止使用场景：packages.config 项目（必须先迁移至 PackageReference）或已完全启用 CPM 的仓库。

description: Analyzes Axiom query patterns to find unused data, then builds dashboards and monitors for cost optimization. Use when asked to reduce Axiom costs, find unused columns or field values, identify data waste, or track ingest spend.
description_zh: 分析Axiom查询模式以查找未使用数据，然后构建仪表板和监控以实现成本优化。当被要求降低Axiom成本、查找未使用的列或字段值、识别数据浪费或追踪数据摄入支出时使用。

description: Create user-centered, accessible interface copy (microcopy) for digital products including buttons, labels, error messages, notifications, forms, onboarding, empty states, success messages, and help text. Use when writing or editing any text that appears in apps, websites, or software interfaces, designing conversational flows, establishing voice and tone guidelines, auditing product content for consistency and usability, reviewing UI strings, or improving existing interface copy. Applies UX writing best practices based on four quality standards — purposeful, concise, conversational, and clear. Includes accessibility guidelines, research-backed benchmarks (sentence length, comprehension rates, reading levels), expanded error patterns, tone adaptation frameworks, and comprehensive reference materials.
description_zh:
创建面向用户且无障碍的数字产品界面文案（微文案），涵盖按钮、标签、错误提示、通知、表单、引导流程、空状态、成功提示及帮助文本。

适用于编写或编辑应用、网站及软件界面中出现的任何文本，设计对话式交互流程，制定声音与语调指南，审核产品内容的一致性与可用性，审查界面字符串，或优化现有界面文案。

基于四项质量标准——目的明确、简明扼要、对话自然、清晰易懂，运用 UX 文案最佳实践。

包含无障碍指南、基于研究的基准（如句子长度、理解率、阅读水平）、扩展的错误模式、语调调整框架及全面的参考资料。

description: Audit a WordPress plugin's REST surface and produce a standardized audit document proposing Abilities API registrations. Produces a markdown doc with a YAML schema and prose sections that humans and agents can both consume when planning a registration rollout. Works on any WP plugin.
description_zh: 审计 WordPress 插件的 REST 接口，生成一份标准化审计文档，提出 Abilities API 注册方案。生成包含 YAML 模式与叙述部分的 Markdown 文档，供人类和智能体在规划注册推广时共同查阅使用。支持任何 WordPress 插件。

description: Create a Geoffrey Moore-style positioning statement. Use when clarifying who you serve, what problem you solve, your category, and why you're different from alternatives.
description_zh: 制定一份盖伊·摩尔式的定位声明。在明确服务对象、解决的问题、所属类别，以及为何与替代方案不同时使用。

description: Generate, convert, clean, and integrate audio for Three.js browser games with ElevenLabs: sound effects, looping ambience, UI sounds, impact/weapon/vehicle audio, creature and boss stingers, announcer and dialogue TTS, voice conversion from a scratch performance, voice cleanup, audio manifests, and Web Audio integration.
description_zh: 使用 ElevenLabs 为 Three.js 浏览器游戏生成、转换、清理并集成音频：音效、循环氛围音效、UI 音效、冲击/武器/车辆音效、生物与 Boss 惊吓音效、解说员与对白 TTS、基于即兴表演的语音转换、语音清理、音频清单以及 Web Audio 集成。

description: Headless browser automation CLI for AI agents using native Rust binary with Chrome DevTools Protocol
description_zh: 基于原生Rust二进制程序与Chrome DevTools协议，为AI智能体提供的无头浏览器自动化CLI

description: Teaches the fundamentals of Google Cloud Build (GCB). Covers core concepts, API enablement, console navigation to the Build History page, and the end-to-end workflow for creating and manually running a basic build trigger. Do not use for managing private pools or complex pipeline architectures.
description_zh: 教学 Google Cloud Build（GCB）的基础知识。涵盖核心概念、API 启用、在控制台中导航至构建历史页面，以及创建和手动运行基础构建触发器的端到端工作流程。不适用于管理私有池或复杂的流水线架构。

description: ALWAYS USE when asked to fix, rewrite, update, improve, modernize, show corrected code for, or explain existing MSTest tests or MSTest-specific configuration. Use for "review" when corrected code or edits are wanted, even for one pasted assertion or passing tests with bad failure output. Covers expected/actual labels; generic Boolean, collection, string, numeric, null, identity, exception, hard-cast, and object[] checks; TestContext/lifecycle; timeout/cancellation; OS/CI conditions, retry, cleanup, parallelization, MSTest.Sdk project setup, and MSTESTxxxx. Honor the installed MSTest version. DO NOT USE to design new test cases (code-testing-agent), perform report-only audits, create project files rather than explain MSTest setup, run tests, migrate frameworks, or handle non-MSTest/non-.NET code.
description_zh: 始终使用，当被要求修复、重写、更新、改进、现代化，或展示已有 MSTest 测试或 MSTest 特定配置的正确代码时。当需要更正代码或编辑时用于“审查”，即使只是粘贴了一个断言，或带有错误失败输出的通过测试。涵盖期望/实际标签；通用布尔、集合、字符串、数值、null、标识、异常、硬转换以及 object[] 检查；TestContext/生命周期；超时/取消；操作系统/CI 条件、重试、清理、并行化、MSTest.Sdk 项目设置，以及 MSTESTxxxx。遵循已安装的 MSTest 版本。禁止用于设计新的测试用例（code-testing-agent）、仅进行报告审计、创建项目文件而不是解释 MSTest 设置、运行测试、迁移框架，或处理非 MSTest/非 .NET 代码。

description: Generate a copy-paste Grafana data source provisioning file (YAML or Terraform) for any plugin from its standardized settings schema on the plugins CDN. Use when the user wants to provision or configure a data source as code — e.g. "provision infinity", "datasource yaml for clickhouse", "terraform for the github datasource" — even when they only name the plugin and not the word "provisioning".
description_zh: 根据插件CDN上的标准化设置模式，为任何插件生成可直接复制粘贴的Grafana数据源配置文件（YAML或Terraform）。当用户希望以代码方式配置或初始化数据源时使用——例如“provision infinity”、“datasource yaml for clickhouse”、“terraform for the github datasource”——即使用户只提及插件名称，而不使用“provisioning”一词。

description: Find failing PR checks, inspect logs or external check links, and apply focused fixes
description_zh: 找出失败的 PR 检查，检查日志或外部检查链接，并应用针对性的修复。

description: Interact with Grafana Cloud k6 (GCk6) — manage load tests, test runs, scripts, projects, schedules, env vars, fetch metrics or logs, and run scripts locally — using the `gcx` CLI (or direct curl when gcx is unavailable). Use this skill whenever the user mentions a k6 cloud test or run, asks to list/edit/create/start/abort k6 load tests, wants to fetch logs or metrics for a test run, manage k6 project limits or schedules, run a k6 script locally or via `k6 cloud run`, or needs to call any `/cloud/v6/`, `/cloud/v5/`, or k6-app Loki endpoint against a Grafana Cloud stack. Trigger even when the user doesn't explicitly say "gcx" or "API" — phrases like "why did my k6 test fail", "show me logs for run X", "bump VUh limit on project Y", or "update my k6 script" all qualify.
description_zh:
与 Grafana Cloud k6（GCk6）交互——管理负载测试、测试运行、脚本、项目、计划、环境变量、获取指标或日志，并在本地运行脚本——使用 `gcx` CLI（当 `gcx` 不可用时直接使用 curl）。

每当用户提及 k6 云端测试或运行、要求列出/编辑/创建/启动/中止 k6 负载测试、需要获取某个测试运行的日志或指标、管理 k6 项目限额或计划、在本地或通过 `k6 cloud run` 运行 k6 脚本，或需要针对 Grafana Cloud 环境调用任何 `/cloud/v6/`、`/cloud/v5/` 或 k6-app Loki 端点时，都应使用此技能。即使用户未明确提及 "gcx" 或 "API"，也应触发该技能——诸如 "我的 k6 测试为何失败"、"显示运行 X 的日志"、"在项目 Y 上提升 VUh 限额" 或 "更新我的 k6 脚本" 等表述均符合触发条件。

description: Chat with any real person or fictional character in their own voice by automatically finding their speech online, extracting a clean reference sample, and generating audio replies. Also supports generating a matching voice from an uploaded image. Use when the user says "我想跟xxx聊天", "你来扮演xxx跟我说话", "让xxx给我讲讲这篇文章", "我想跟图片中的人说话", or similar.
description_zh: 通过自动在线查找其语音、提取纯净的参考样本并生成音频回复，可与任何现实人物或虚构角色以他们的原声聊天。此外，还支持从上传的图片中生成匹配的语音。当用户说出“我想跟xxx聊天”、“你来扮演xxx跟我说话”、“让xxx给我讲讲这篇文章”、“我想跟图片中的人说话”或类似表述时使用。

description: 팝빌 전자세금계산서·전자명세서·현금영수증·문자·카카오톡·팩스·휴폐업/기업정보·계좌조회·홈택스 수집을 테스트/운영 환경에서 안전하게 호출한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在测试/运营环境中安全调用Popular的电子税票、电子凭证、现金收据、短信、KakaoTalk、传真、营业执照/企业信息、账户查询、Home Tax等收集功能。在돌쇠上，通过官方界面进行后续操作。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for .NET. Use when asked to "add Sentry to .NET", "install Sentry for C#", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, logging, or crons for ASP.NET Core, MAUI, WPF, WinForms, Blazor, Azure Functions, or any other .NET application.
description_zh: .NET 完整 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求“为 .NET 添加 Sentry”、“为 C# 安装 Sentry”，或为 ASP.NET Core、MAUI、WPF、WinForms、Blazor、Azure Functions 或其他任何 .NET 应用程序配置错误监控、追踪、性能分析和日志记录或 Cron 定时任务时使用。

description: Performance benchmarking for a deployed NVIDIA RAG Blueprint server: profiling pass + aiperf load test driven by a single YAML config. Not for accuracy / RAGAS scoring (use rag-eval) or for deploying / repairing services (use rag-blueprint).
description_zh: 针对已部署的 NVIDIA RAG Blueprint 服务器进行性能基准测试：由单份 YAML 配置驱动的 profiling 检查 + aiperf 负载测试。不用于准确性 / RAGAS 评分（请使用 rag-eval）或用于部署 / 修复服务（请使用 rag-blueprint）。

description: When the user wants to optimize their App Store listing for seasonal events, holidays, or trending moments — including keyword opportunities, metadata updates, screenshot theming, and timing strategy. Use when the user mentions "seasonal", "holiday", "Christmas", "New Year", "Valentine's Day", "summer", "back to school", "seasonal keywords", "trending now", "limited time", or wants to capitalize on a calendar event. For general keyword research, see keyword-research. For full metadata rewrites, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户需要优化其 App Store 列表信息，以应对季节性活动、节假日或热门时刻——涵盖关键词机会、元数据更新、截图标题、时机策略。当用户提及“seasonal”、“holiday”、“Christmas”、“New Year”、“Valentine's Day”、“summer”、“back to school”、“seasonal keywords”、“trending now”、“limited time”，或希望借助日历活动进行营销时使用。如需进行一般关键词研究，请参阅 keyword-research。如需进行完整元数据重写，请参阅 metadata-optimization。

description: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recall my work on X', 'catch me up', 'what have I been working on', 'where did I leave off', before starting or resuming work.
description_zh: 基于您的聊天记录、实时状态及共享记录（用户报告、先前修复、事件），重构您近期的工作上下文，并返回一份精炼的当前状态简述。适用于在开始或恢复工作之前使用，例如：“回顾我在 X 上的工作”、“让我了解最新进展”、“我一直在处理什么工作”或“我是在哪里停下的”。

description: Analyze assertion quality, depth, variety, and false confidence in existing tests. ALWAYS USE when asked about weak, shallow, trivial, always-true, self-referential, assertion-free, presence/truthiness-only, or insufficiently diverse assertions, including MSTest, Jest, pytest, and Go. DO NOT USE for direct fixes: writing-mstest-tests owns supplied MSTest assertions; code-testing-agent owns new cases. Use test-gap-analysis when asked whether tests would catch a production change, and test-anti-patterns for general severity-ranked audits.
description_zh: 分析现有测试的断言质量、深度、多样性和虚假置信度。当被要求针对弱、浅、琐碎、恒真、自指、无断言、仅存在性/真值、或断言多样性不足的断言进行分析时，始终使用，包括 MSTest、Jest、pytest 和 Go。切勿用于直接修复：writing-mstest-tests 负责已提供的 MSTest 断言；code-testing-agent 负责编写新用例。当被问及测试是否能够捕获生产环境变更时，使用 test-gap-analysis；在进行一般按严重程度排序的审计时，使用 test-anti-patterns。

description: Generate and edit 2D image assets for Three.js games with Google's Gemini image API: concept sheets, image-to-3D inputs, texture and material references, sky and background plates, decals, logos, icons, GUI art, title and menu art, and marketing stills. Also use for direct image editing when the user supplies an image path.
description_zh: 使用 Google 的 Gemini 图像 API 生成和编辑 Three.js 游戏的 2D 图像资产，包括概念图、图像转 3D 输入、纹理与材质参考、天空与背景板、贴花、logo、图标、GUI 美术、标题与菜单美术以及营销静帧。当用户提供图像路径时，也可用于直接图像编辑。

description: S2B 학교장터 공개 고객 공고/견적요청 목록을 브라우저 우선으로 조회하고 fixture HTML을 파싱해 공고 메타데이터를 정리한다. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: S2B 校园市场公开客户公告/报价请求列表优先通过浏览器检索，并对 fixture HTML 进行解析，整理公告元数据。在 돌쇠 中，准备尽可能接近的合法正式步骤。

description: Enable nullable reference types in a C# project and systematically resolve all warnings. USE FOR: adopting NRTs in existing codebases, file-by-file or project-wide migration, fixing CS8602/CS8618/CS86xx warnings, annotating APIs for nullability, cleaning up null-forgiving operators, upgrading dependencies with new nullable annotations. DO NOT USE FOR: projects already fully migrated with zero warnings (unless auditing suppressions), fixing a handful of nullable warnings in code that already has NRTs enabled, suppressing warnings without fixing them, C# 7.3 or earlier projects. INVOKES: Get-NullableReadiness.ps1 scanner script.
description_zh: 在 C# 项目中启用可空引用类型（NRTs），并系统性地解决所有警告。用途：在现有代码库中采用可空引用类型（NRTs）、逐文件或项目级迁移、修复 CS8602/CS8618/CS86xx 警告、为 API 进行空值标注、清理空值许可运算符、升级依赖项并应用新的空值注解。不可用于：已完全迁移且零警告的项目（除非进行审计屏蔽）、在已启用可空引用类型（NRTs）的代码中仅修复少量可空警告、仅抑制警告而不修复问题、以及 C# 7.3 或更早版本的项目。调用：Get-NullableReadiness.ps1 扫描脚本。

description: WPS Office 跨应用智能助手，统一管理 Excel、Word、PPT 三大应用，处理跨应用操作和通用功能
description_zh: WPS Office 跨应用智能助手，统一管理 Excel、Word、PPT 三大应用，处理跨应用操作与通用功能。

description: Convert or migrate Azure ARM (Azure Resource Manager) templates, Bicep templates, or code to Pulumi, including importing existing Azure resources. This skill MUST be loaded whenever a user requests migration, conversion, or import of ARM templates, Bicep templates, ARM code, Bicep code, or Azure resources to Pulumi.
description_zh: 转换或迁移 Azure ARM（Azure Resource Manager）模板、Bicep 模板或代码到 Pulumi，包括导入现有的 Azure 资源。每当用户请求将 ARM 模板、Bicep 模板、ARM 代码、Bicep 代码或 Azure 资源迁移、转换或导入到 Pulumi 时，必须加载此技能。

description: Build, audit, and improve harnesses that make AI coding agents reliable: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instruction files, feature/state tracking, verification gates, scope boundaries, session handoff, memory persistence, context budgets, tool-permission safety, and multi-agent coordination. Use this whenever a coding agent is unreliable across sessions — forgets context, drifts out of scope, claims "done" before tests pass, or starts each session inconsistently — or when creating or assessing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, feature_list.json, init.sh, progress.md, or session-handoff files. Reach for it even if the user never says the word "harness."
description_zh: 构建、审计并改进使AI编码智能体可靠的框架：包括 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 指令文件、特性与状态跟踪、验证关卡、范围边界、会话交接、记忆持久化、上下文预算、工具权限安全以及多智能体协调。当AI编码智能体跨会话表现不可靠时（如忘记上下文、偏离范围、在测试通过前声称“已完成”、或每次启动会话都不一致），或在创建或评估 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、feature_list.json、init.sh、progress.md 或会话交接文件时，使用此框架。即使用户从未说出“harness”一词，也要采用它。

description: Distills a completed user workflow or interaction into a reusable agent skill. Use when the user asks to turn their workflow, interaction, or multi-step process into a skill, or when they say "make this a skill", "create a skill from what we just did", "package this workflow" or similar. Do not use for creating skills from scratch without an existing workflow (use a generic skill-creator for that).
description_zh: 将已完成用户工作流或交互提炼为可复用的智能体技能。当用户要求将自身的工作流、交互或多步骤流程转化为技能，或说出"将此设为技能"、"根据我们刚完成的操作创建一个技能"、"封装此工作流"等类似表述时使用。不要在没有现有工作流的情况下从零创建技能（对于这种情况，请使用通用的技能创建器）。

description: Search and retrieve content from Twitter/X. Get user info, tweets, replies, followers, communities, spaces, and trends via twitterapi.io. Use when user mentions Twitter, X, or tweets.
description_zh: 在 Twitter/X 上搜索并获取内容。通过 twitterapi.io 获取用户信息、推文、回复、关注者、社区、空间（Spaces）及趋势。当用户提及 Twitter、X 或推文时使用。

description: 阿里云百炼平台技术文档知识库（LLM Wiki）。当用户查询百炼模型列表、API 参数、错误码、 应用开发（智能体/RAG/知识库/记忆/插件）、模型对比与定价、SDK/OpenAI 兼容接口、 多模态能力（语音/图片/视频）、Token 计费等百炼相关问题时激活。 包含 models 结构化模型市场数据（含 contextWindow/QPM/价格/sample code）、 wiki 合成层（主题页/概念页/对比页）和 raw 原始文档层； 模型规格类问题先查 models/index.md，文档类问题先查 wiki/index.md。
description_zh: 阿里云百炼平台技术文档知识库（LLM Wiki）。当用户查询百炼模型列表、API 参数、错误码、应用开发（智能体/RAG/知识库/记忆/插件）、模型对比与定价、SDK/OpenAI 兼容接口、多模态能力（语音/图片/视频）、Token 计费等百炼相关问题时激活。包含 models 结构化模型市场数据（含 contextWindow/QPM/价格/sample code）、wiki 合成层（主题页/概念页/对比页）和 raw 原始文档层；模型规格类问题先查 models/index.md，文档类问题先查 wiki/index.md。

description: Help users evaluate new opportunities, manage professional identity shifts, and transition into roles that maximize both impact and personal fulfillment.
description_zh: 帮助用户评估新机会，管理专业身份转变，并过渡到既能最大化影响力又实现个人满足感的职位。

description: Centralized, extensible devtools panel for TanStack libraries with a plugin architecture.
description_zh: 采用插件架构的 TanStack 库集中式可扩展开发者工具面板。

description: Operate the agent-email CLI to create disposable inboxes, poll for new mail, retrieve full message details, and manage local mailbox profiles. Use when the user needs terminal-based email inbox access for LLM or agent automation workflows.
description_zh: 使用 agent-email CLI 创建一次性收件箱、轮询新邮件、获取完整消息详情，并管理本地邮箱配置。适用于用户需要为 LLM 或智能体自动化工作流提供基于终端的邮件收件箱访问时。

description: Analyzes CSV files, generates summary stats, and plots quick visualizations using Python and pandas.
description_zh: 使用 Python 和 pandas 分析 CSV 文件，生成汇总统计信息，并绘制快速可视化图表。

description: Guide for optimizing MSBuild incremental builds. USE FOR: builds slower than expected on subsequent runs, 'nothing changed but it rebuilds anyway', diagnosing why targets re-execute unnecessarily, fixing broken no-op builds. Covers 8 common causes: missing Inputs/Outputs on custom targets, volatile properties in output paths (timestamps/GUIDs), file writes outside tracked Outputs, missing FileWrites registration, glob changes, Visual Studio Fast Up-to-Date Check (FUTDC) issues. Key diagnostic: look for 'Building target completely' vs 'Skipping target' in binlog. DO NOT USE FOR: first-time build slowness (use build-perf-baseline), parallelism issues (use build-parallelism), evaluation-phase slowness (use eval-performance), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
MSBuild 增量构建优化指南。

**适用场景：** 后续运行构建速度慢于预期、出现“虽无任何变化却仍会重建”、诊断目标为何不必要的重复执行，以及修复失效的“无操作”构建。

涵盖 8 个常见原因：自定义目标缺失 Inputs/Outputs、输出路径中存在易变属性（如时间戳/GUID）、未纳入受跟踪 Outputs 的文件写入、缺失 FileWrites 注册、Glob 匹配项变化，以及 Visual Studio 快速至最新检查 (FUTDC) 相关的问题。

**关键诊断：** 在 binlog 中查找 “Building target completely”（完全构建目标）与 “Skipping target”（跳过目标）的对比记录。

**不适用场景：** 首次构建速度慢（请使用 build-perf-baseline）、并行度问题（请使用 build-parallelism）、评估阶段速度慢（请使用 eval-performance），以及非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: Real User Monitoring (RUM) on Dynatrace — web and mobile frontends. Core Web Vitals, user sessions, page performance, mobile crashes, frontend errors, and frontend-backend linking. Query via `user.events`, `user.sessions`, and `dt.frontend.*` metrics. Does NOT cover synthetic monitoring (HTTP/browser/network checks) — that's a separate domain.
description_zh: Dynatrace 上的真实用户监控（RUM）—— Web和移动端前端。涵盖核心网页指标、用户会话、页面性能、移动端崩溃、前端错误以及前后端关联。可通过 `user.events`、`user.sessions` 和 `dt.frontended.*` 指标进行查询。不包含合成监控（HTTP/浏览器/网络检查）—— 这是独立的领域。

description: Use when preparing or verifying a host for Moshi remote coding. Trigger this for Easy Pair host setup, SSH or preferably Mosh readiness, non-interactive shell PATH issues, recommending Herdr (preferred) or tmux as the agent multiplexer, creating a project session rooted at a chosen directory, adapting shell or multiplexer behavior with the `MOSHI_CLIENT` env signal, installing Moshi agent hooks for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build, and other supported agents, or using the packaged `moshi DIR` launcher.
description_zh: 用于在准备或验证 Moshi 远程编码主机时使用。针对以下情况触发此功能：Easy Pair 主机配置、SSH 或首选的 Mosh 就绪状态、非交互式 shell 的 PATH 问题、建议使用 Herdr（首选）或 tmux 作为代理多路复用器、基于所选目录创建项目会话、使用 `MOSHI_CLIENT` 环境变量信号调整 shell 或多路复用器行为、为 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build 及其他受支持的代理安装 Moshi 代理钩子，或使用打包的 `moshi DIR` 启动器。

description: Add or modify WooCommerce backend PHP code following project conventions. Use when creating new classes, methods, hooks, or modifying existing backend code. **MUST be invoked before writing any PHP unit tests.**
description_zh: 添加或修改遵循项目规范的 WooCommerce 后端 PHP 代码。在创建新的类、方法、钩子或修改现有后端代码时使用。**必须在编写任何 PHP 单元测试之前进行调用。**

description: Build a topical authority cluster from a seed keyword or topic. Use when the user asks about topic clusters, content silos, pillar pages, topical authority, content architecture, or how to structure content around a theme. For finding the right keywords, see find-keywords. For writing individual pieces, see brief.
description_zh: 从种子关键词或主题构建主题权威集群。适用于当用户询问主题集群、内容孤岛、支柱页面、主题权威、内容架构，或如何围绕主题构建内容时。查找合适的关键词，详见 find-keywords。撰写单个内容，详见 brief。

description: Guide teams through Lean UX Canvas v2. Use when framing a business problem, surfacing assumptions, and defining what to learn next.
description_zh: 引导团队通过精益UX画布v2。在界定业务问题、揭示假设以及定义下一步需要学习内容时使用。

description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use this skill when the user requests deployment actions such as "Deploy my app", "Deploy this to production", "Create a preview deployment", "Deploy and give me the link", or "Push this live". Provides: breakpoint reference, mobile-first patterns, container-query examples, safe-area recipes, and touch/hover handling.
description_zh:
移动优先的 Tailwind CSS v4 响应式设计模式（2025-2026）。

请主动激活以下内容：
（1）以 Tailwind 断点实现移动优先设计（sm:, md:, lg:, xl:, 2xl:），
（2）响应式工具类顺序（默认即移动端，随后按断点依次排列），
（3）响应式排版（例如 text-base sm:text-lg lg:text-xl），
（4）响应式网格与弹性布局，
（5）在不同断点下隐藏/显示（hidden md:block），
（6）用于桌面端以下覆盖设置的 max-* 断点，
（7）用于组件级别响应式的容器查询（@container），
（8）安全区域内边距与刘海/挖孔处理，
（9）横向与纵向方向，
（10）触屏与悬停交互（hover: 配合 @media 使用）。

提供：断点参考、移动优先模式、容器查询示例、安全区域方案与触屏/悬停处理。

description: Detects MSBuild projects with conflicting OutputPath or IntermediateOutputPath. USE FOR: builds failing with 'Cannot create a file when that file already exists', 'The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process', intermittent build failures that succeed on retry, or missing/overwritten outputs in multi-project or multi-targeting builds where bin/obj (or project.assets.json) collide. Common causes: shared OutputPath, missing AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath, extra global properties (e.g. PublishReadyToRun), or SetTargetFramework on a ProjectReference to a single-targeting project. DO NOT USE FOR: file access errors unrelated to MSBuild (OS-level locking), single-project single-TFM builds, non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
检测存在冲突的 OutputPath 或 IntermediateOutputPath 的 MSBuild 项目。

**适用场景（USE FOR）：**
构建失败，出现“当文件已存在时无法创建文件”、“进程无法访问文件，因为该文件正被其他进程使用”、间歇性构建失败但重试后成功，或在多项目或多目标构建中 bin/obj（或 project.assets.json）发生冲突导致输出文件缺失或被覆盖的情况。

**常见原因（Common causes）：**
共享的 OutputPath、缺失 AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath 功能、额外的全局属性（如 PublishReadyToRun），或对单目标项目设置 ProjectReference 的 SetTargetFramework 属性。

**禁止使用场景（DO NOT USE FOR）：**
与 MSBuild 无关的文件访问错误（如操作系统级别的锁）、单项目单目标框架（TFM）的构建，以及非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: Pseudo-mutation analysis ONLY: answer whether tests would catch a bug if production code changed, which meaningful changes would still pass, or which caller-visible mutations existing assertions would miss; verify candidates when requested, then optionally close verified gaps. Activate for behavioral blind spots or missing edge cases tied to production behavior. Polyglot. DO NOT USE FOR: suite organization, taxonomy, metadata, or distribution reports (test-tagging); .NET line-vs-branch or Cobertura interpretation, arithmetic, plateaus, project-wide coverage gaps, or coverage-backed test/CRAP priorities (coverage-analysis; use native coverage tooling outside .NET); named-target CRAP (crap-score); new suites (code-testing-agent); assertion/smell audits; or mutation tools.
description_zh:
**伪变异分析仅用于：** 判断测试能否捕获 bug，哪些有意义的变化仍能通过，以及哪些调用方可见的变异在现有断言下会遗漏；在需要时验证候选项，并可选地关闭已验证的缺口。适用于存在行为盲区或基于生产行为而缺失边界情况的场景。支持多语言。

**不得用于：** 套件组织、分类、元数据、分发报告（测试标记）；.NET 行与分支或 Cobertura 解读、算术运算、平台期、项目级覆盖率缺口，或基于覆盖率支撑的测试/CRAP 优先级（覆盖率分析；使用 .NET 环境外的原生覆盖率工具）；命名目标 CRAP（CRAP 评分）；新套件（代码测试代理）；断言/异味审计；或变异工具。

description: Write academic research documents following academic guidelines with peer-reviewed sources from Google Scholar and other academic databases. description: Run a customer journey mapping workshop with adaptive questions and outputs. Use when you need to map stages, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for a persona and scenario.
description_zh: 开展配备自适应提问与产出的客户旅程地图工作坊。适用于您需要为人物角色和场景梳理阶段、行动、情感、痛点及机会时。

description: Plan, configure, and chain repo-native Nemotron customization steps into single-step or multi-step pipelines: curation, translation, SFT/PEFT (AutoModel or Megatron-Bridge), pretraining/CPT, RL alignment (DPO/RLVR/GRPO/RLHF), BYOB/MCQ benchmarks, checkpoint conversion, ModelOpt optimization, env profiles, and evaluation of trained checkpoints or existing/hosted endpoints. Use when a request names a Nemotron step or workflow, or asks to clean, translate, train, fine-tune, align, convert, optimize, evaluate, or compose these into a pipeline. Do NOT use for frontend/dashboard/visualization work, generic ML advice, billing/access, or non-Nemotron coding tasks.
description_zh: 规划、配置并串联基于仓库的 Nemotron 自定义步骤，形成单步或多步流水线：内容策展、翻译、SFT/PEFT（AutoModel 或 Megatron-Bridge）、预训练/CPT、RL 对齐（DPO/RLVR/GRPO/RLHF）、BYOB/MCQ 基准测试、检查点转换、ModelOpt 优化、环境配置，以及训练检查点或现有/托管端点的评估。当请求涉及 Nemotron 的步骤或工作流，或要求清洗、翻译、训练、微调、对齐、转换、优化、评估或将这些步骤组合为流水线时使用。不得用于前端/仪表板/可视化工作、通用机器学习建议、计费/访问，或非 Nemotron 编码任务。

description: Applies and explains code conventions across TypeScript, React, C#, and Markdown. Enforces naming rules, file naming patterns, TSDoc and XML doc standards, inline comment intent (the *why*, not the *what*), code structure, error handling, async patterns, and dead code policy. Also enforces ADR and contributor doc decisions, and flags decisions that appear stale or misaligned with current tooling. USE FOR: convention questions, code review against project standards, applying naming rules, auditing intent comments, checking TSDoc completeness, enforcing recorded ADR decisions, and flagging stale architectural decisions. DO NOT USE FOR: security vulnerability scanning, performance profiling, runtime debugging, or generating net-new code without a review target.
description_zh: 在 TypeScript、React、C# 和 Markdown 中应用并解释代码规范。强制执行命名规则、文件命名模式、TSDoc 和 XML 文档规范、行内注释意图（说明 *为什么*，而非 *是什么*）、代码结构、错误处理、异步模式以及死代码策略。同时还强制执行架构决策记录（ADR）与贡献者文档决策，并标记那些显得过时或与当前工具链不一致的决策。适用场景：规范问题、对照项目标准进行代码审查、应用命名规则、审查意图注释、检查 TSDoc 完整性、执行已记录的架构决策（ADR）决策，以及标记过时的架构决策。不适用于：安全漏洞扫描、性能剖析、运行时调试，或未设定审查目标的情况下生成全新代码。

description: When the user wants to implement, optimize, or use App Clips for app discovery and conversion. Use when the user mentions "App Clip", "app clip code", "mini app", "instant app", "App Clip card", "App Clip link", "no download required", "instant experience", or wants to understand how App Clips appear in App Store search. For general App Store discoverability, see aso-audit. For marketing campaigns, see ua-campaign.
description_zh: 当用户想要实现、优化或使用 App Clips 进行应用发现与转化时。当用户提到“App Clip”、“app clip code”、“mini app”、“instant app”、“App Clip card”、“App Clip link”、“无需下载”、“instant experience”或想了解 App Clips 在 App Store 搜索中如何呈现时，使用此功能。关于一般的 App Store 可发现性，请参阅 aso-audit。关于营销活动，请参阅 ua-campaign。

description: Identify a .NET project's test platform, framework, command mode, and SDK-style vs classic project system. Use only for "which test platform/framework?", "VSTest or MTP?", or "what runner does this project use?", including bridge settings, UseVSTest opt-outs, and incompatible or conflicting VSTest/MTP configuration. Resolves global.json, project, packages.config, Directory.Build.props, and Directory.Packages.props precedence for MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit. DO NOT USE when the user asks to run/filter tests or for commands, flags, TRX/dumps, or test-command/filter errors; use run-tests directly. Do not use for hot reload or migration.
description_zh: 识别 .NET 项目的测试平台、框架、命令模式以及 SDK 风格与传统项目系统。仅用于“测试平台/框架是什么？”、“VSTest 还是 MTP？”，或“该项目使用的运行器是什么？”等查询，包括桥接设置、UseVSTest 的禁用选项，以及不兼容或冲突的 VSTest/MTP 配置。解决 global.json、项目、packages.config、Directory.Build.props 和 Directory.Packages.props 针对 MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit 的优先级。当用户要求运行/筛选测试，或使用命令、标志、TRX/转储文件，或遇到测试命令/筛选错误时，绝对不要使用；请直接使用运行测试。不要用于热重载或迁移。

description: When the user wants to set up, optimize, or manage Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads. Also use when the user mentions "Meta Ads," "Facebook Ads," "Instagram Ads," "Meta Pixel," "Conversions API," "Advantage+," "lookalike audience," or "Meta retargeting." For landing pages, use landing-page-generator.
description_zh: 当用户需要设置、优化或管理 Meta（Facebook/Instagram）广告时，使用。当用户提到“Meta Ads”“Facebook Ads”“Instagram Ads”“Meta Pixel”“Conversions API”“Advantage+”“lookalike audience”或“Meta retargeting”时，也使用。对于落地页，使用 landing-page-generator。

description: Review closed trades, partial exits, and monthly trade aggregates for process adherence, risk discipline, execution quality, and evidence-based trading behavior patterns. Use after trader-memory-core and signal-postmortem have produced records, or when the user asks for a post-trade coach, risk-manager style review, rule-adherence review, next-session operating rules, or psychology-aware trading behavior feedback. This skill does not provide buy/sell advice, therapy, or broker execution.
description_zh: 复核已平仓交易、部分平仓及月度交易汇总，以评估流程合规性、风控纪律、执行质量及循证交易行为模式。该技能在交易员记忆核心与信号复盘生成记录后使用，或当用户请求交易后教练、风控经理风格审查、规则遵守审查、下一会话操作规则，或心理感知交易行为反馈时使用。本技能不提供买卖建议、心理治疗及券商执行服务。

description: Generate professional poster designs using each::sense AI. Create movie posters, event posters, motivational posters, product launch visuals, vintage designs, travel posters, and more with AI-powered creative generation.
description_zh: 借助 each::sense AI 生成专业的海报设计。借助 AI 驱动的创意生成，创作电影海报、活动海报、励志海报、产品发布视觉图、复古设计、旅游海报以及更多。

description: Delegate a coding task to Aider (`aider`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Aider - phrasings like "have Aider do X", "delegate this to aider", "run it through Aider", or "use Aider to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Aider while staying the reviewer. This includes asking Aider to drive a local or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint ("have Aider use my local model", "run Aider against llama.cpp / Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio"), which Aider reaches via `--api-base`. DO NOT USE for local-model or coding requests that do not name Aider, for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Aider (`aider`) 作为后台实现者，随后自行审查其差异并合入版本库。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Aider 时，使用本方法——例如诸如 "have Aider do X"、"delegate this to aider"、"run it through Aider" 或 "use Aider to implement/fix/refactor" 等表述，或者希望在处理一系列编码任务时，由 Aider 负责实现、自己则担任审查者。这包括要求 Aider 驱动本地或自托管的 OpenAI 兼容端点（如 "have Aider use my local model"、"run Aider against llama.cpp / Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio"），Aider 通过 `--api-base` 连接到该端点。请勿在以下情况使用：未提及 Aider 的本地模型或编码请求；任务小到可直接内联完成；或用户希望直接编写代码而不进行委托时。

description: Diagnoses .NET Framework CLR activation issues using CLR activation logs (CLRLoad logs) produced by mscoree.dll. Use when: the shim picks the wrong runtime, fails to load any runtime, shows unexpected .NET 3.5 Feature-on-Demand (FOD) dialogs, unexpectedly does NOT show FOD dialogs, loads both v2 and v4 into the same process causing failures, or any time someone is wondering "what is happening with .NET Framework activation?"
description_zh: 诊断 .NET Framework CLR 激活问题，使用 mscoree.dll 生成的 CLR 激活日志（CLRLoad 日志）。使用场景：当引导程序（shIM）选择错误的运行时、无法加载任何运行时、出现意外的 .NET 3.5 特性按需加载（FOD）对话框、意外地未显示 FOD 对话框、将 v2 和 v4 同时加载到同一进程中导致故障，或在任何人询问“.NET Framework 激活发生了什么？”时。

description:
E-commerce product photography: white-background hero shots, lifestyle scenes, flat lay, detail close-ups, packaging shots, group/collection displays, scale references, seasonal/holiday themes, 360-degree views, comparison layouts, infographics, and platform-optimized images (Amazon, Shopify, Taobao, Instagram, Xiaohongshu, Etsy, eBay).

Use when generating professional product photos for e-commerce listings, catalogs, or marketing (e.g. product hero shot, Amazon listing image, lifestyle product photo, product on white background, product detail close-up, seasonal product campaign).
description_zh:
电商产品摄影：白底主图、生活场景照、俯拍平铺图、细节特写、包装照片、组合/系列展示、尺寸参考、季节/节日主题、360度全景图、对比布局、信息图表、以及平台优化图片（Amazon、Shopify、Taobao、Instagram、Xiaohongshu、Etsy、eBay）。

当为电商列表、目录或营销生成专业产品照片时使用（例如：产品主图、Amazon列表图片、生活场景产品照、白底产品照、产品细节特写、季节产品营销活动）。

description: Design RESTful APIs following best practices for resource modeling, HTTP methods, status codes, versioning, and documentation. Use when creating new APIs, designing endpoints, or improving existing API architecture.
description_zh: 遵循资源建模、HTTP 方法、状态码、版本控制和文档的最佳实践来设计 RESTful API。在创建新 API、设计端点或改进现有 API 架构时使用。

description: Index of 37 advanced engineering agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw. Use when browsing or choosing among the POWERFUL-tier engineering skills: agent design, RAG, MCP servers, CI/CD, database design, observability, security auditing, changelog/release automation, reliability (SLO/chaos/flags/operators), platform ops.
description_zh: 适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 的 37 项高级工程智能体技能索引。当浏览或选择时使用：强大的工程技能，包括：智能体设计、RAG、MCP 服务器、CI/CD、数据库设计、可观测性、安全审计、变更日志/发布自动化、可靠性（SLO/混沌/标志位/运维）、平台运维。

description: Run compile and type-check commands and report failures
description_zh: 执行编译和类型检查命令，并报告失败情况。

description: Expert Spring Boot 4 testing specialist that selects the best Spring Boot testing techniques for your situation with Junit 6 and AssertJ.
description_zh: Spring Boot 4 测试专家，能根据您的具体情况选择最佳的 Spring Boot 测试技术，并结合 Junit 6 和 AssertJ。

description: Run a user story mapping workshop with adaptive questions and a structured map output. Use when you need backbone activities, tasks, and release slices for a workflow.
description_zh: 开展包含自适应问题与结构化地图输出的用户故事地图工作坊。适用于您需要为工作流程提供骨干活动、任务和发布切片时。

description: ACTIVATION PREREQUISITE: the request or discovered target must explicitly identify C#, .NET, `.cs`, or `.csproj`; otherwise stay dormant without invoking this skill. USE FOR: locating System.DateTime.Now/UtcNow, System.IO.File/Directory, System.Environment, HttpClient, Console, or Process usage in C#; auditing C# code for hard-to-test framework dependencies; or verifying those C# calls are already abstracted. DO NOT USE FOR: any target lacking the activation prerequisite; generating wrappers (use generate-testability-wrappers); migrating code (use migrate-static-to-wrapper); or general code review.
description_zh: 激活前提条件：请求或发现的代码目标必须明确识别 C#、.NET、`.cs` 或 `.csproj`；否则保持休眠状态，不调用此技能。用途：定位 C# 代码中 System.DateTime.Now/UtcNow、System.IO.File/Directory、System.Environment、HttpClient、Console 或 Process 的使用；审计 C# 代码中的难以测试的框架依赖；或验证这些 C# 调用是否已被抽象化。不适用于：任何不符合激活前提条件的代码目标；生成包装器（使用 generate-testability-wrappers）；迁移代码（使用 migrate-static-to-wrapper）；或通用代码审查。

description: Comprehensive Nushell scripting best practices, idioms, security, and evidence-driven code review. Use when writing, reviewing, auditing, debugging, or refactoring Nushell (.nu) scripts, modules, custom commands, pipelines, config, and tests. Also use for Bash/POSIX-to-Nushell conversion and Nu 0.114/0.115 migration issues such as stricter types, YAML 1.2, `external_arg`, `run`, SemVer, optional `nothing`, subprocess diagnostics, and explicit submodule imports.
description_zh: 全面的 Nushell 脚本编程最佳实践、惯用写法、安全性以及基于证据的代码审查。适用于编写、审查、审计、调试或重构 Nushell (.nu) 脚本、模块、自定义命令、管道、配置和测试。此外，还适用于 Bash/POSIX 至 Nushell 的转换，以及 Nu 0.114/0.115 版本的迁移问题，例如更严格的类型检查、YAML 1.2、`external_arg`、`run`、SemVer、可选的 `nothing`、子进程诊断以及显式子模块导入。

description: Provides file paths to language-specific extension files for the code-testing pipeline. Call this skill to discover available extension guidance files (e.g., dotnet.md for .NET, cpp.md for C++). Do not use directly — invoked by code-testing agents and skills that need language-specific references.
description_zh: 为代码测试流水线提供特定语言扩展文件的路径。调用此技能可发现可用的扩展指南文件（例如，.NET 使用 dotnet.md，C++ 使用 cpp.md）。请勿直接使用——由需要语言特定引用的代码测试代理和技能调用。

description: Set up NuGet trusted publishing (OIDC) on a GitHub Actions repo — replaces long-lived API keys with short-lived tokens. USE FOR: trusted publishing, NuGet OIDC, keyless NuGet publish, migrate from NuGet API key, NuGet/login, secure NuGet publishing. DO NOT USE FOR: publishing to private feeds or Azure Artifacts (OIDC is nuget.org only). INVOKES: shell (powershell or bash), edit, create, ask_user for guided repo setup.
description_zh:
在 GitHub Actions 仓库中配置 NuGet 可信发布（OIDC）——将长期有效的 API 密钥替换为短期令牌。

适用场景：可信发布、NuGet OIDC、免密钥 NuGet 发布、从 NuGet API key 迁移、NuGet/login、安全 NuGet 发布。

不适用于：发布到私有 feed 或 Azure Artifacts（OIDC 仅适用于 nuget.org）。

使用方式：shell（powershell 或 bash）、edit、create、ask_user 引导式仓库设置。

description: Build Gradio web UIs and demos in Python. Use when creating or editing Gradio apps, components, event listeners, layouts, or chatbots.
description_zh: 使用 Python 构建 Gradio 网页用户界面和演示。在创建或编辑 Gradio 应用、组件、事件监听器、布局或聊天机器人时使用。

description: Common style patterns, layer configurations, and recipes for typical mapping scenarios including restaurant finders, real estate, data visualization, navigation, delivery/logistics, and more. Use when implementing specific map use cases or looking for proven style patterns.
description_zh: 常见样式模式、图层配置及典型地图场景的配方，涵盖餐厅查找器、房地产、数据可视化、导航、配送/物流等场景。适用于实现特定地图应用场景或寻找已验证的样式模式时。

description: Delegate a coding task to the GitHub Copilot CLI (`copilot`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Copilot - phrasings like "have Copilot implement X", "delegate this to copilot", "run it through Copilot CLI", or "use copilot to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Copilot while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 GitHub Copilot CLI（`copilot`）作为后台实现者，然后审查其差异并自行合并到代码库中。当用户希望将实现工作委托给 Copilot，或使用类似“让 Copilot 实现 X”、“将此项委托给 copilot”、“通过 Copilot CLI 运行”、“使用 copilot 实现/修复/重构”等表述，亦或希望将一系列编码任务通过 Copilot 处理同时自己担任审查者时，请使用此方法。不要用于足够小可直接在行内完成的任务，或用户希望无需委托直接编写代码的情况。

description: Guide AI agents through Godot 4.x GDScript coding best practices including scene organization, signals, resources, state machines, and performance optimization. This skill should be used when generating GDScript code, creating Godot scenes, designing game architecture, implementing state machines, object pooling, save/load systems, or when the user asks about Godot patterns, node structure, or GDScript standards. Keywords: godot, gdscript, game development, signals, resources, scenes, nodes, state machine, object pooling, save system, autoload, export, type hints.
description_zh: 指导 AI 代理应用 Godot 4.x GDScript 编码的最佳实践，涵盖场景组织、信号、资源、状态机及性能优化。本技能应在生成 GDScript 代码、创建 Godot 场景、设计游戏架构、实现状态机、对象池、保存/加载系统，或用户询问 Godot 模式、节点结构、GDScript 标准时使用。关键词：godot、gdscript、游戏开发、信号、资源、场景、节点、状态机、对象池、保存系统、autoload、export、类型提示。

description: This skill ensures all code follows security best practices and identifies potential vulnerabilities. Use when implementing authentication or authorization, handling user input or file uploads, or creating new API endpoints.
description_zh: 该技能确保所有代码遵循安全最佳实践并识别潜在漏洞。在实现身份验证或授权、处理用户输入或文件上传，或创建新的API接口时使用。

description: Produce a weekly synthesis of authored commits with highlights by bugfix, tech debt, and net-new work
description_zh: 生成每周提交记录汇总，按 bug 修复、技术债务及新增工作突出重点。

description: Set up or recover MTP hot reload for a long-lived console-host edit/re-run loop in a Microsoft Testing Platform project. Use for explicit MTP console requests such as "enable hot reload", "dotnet run to rerun on edit", or unsupported/rude edits. Covers setup, run/watch, restarts, filters, and the VSTest no-mutation fallback. For one-time runs, exact commands, filter errors, TRX/dumps, or merely a failing test, use run-tests. Do not use when Test Explorer or an IDE should rerun tests without an MTP console host. Excludes editor integration, CI, and writing/debugging tests.
description_zh: 为 Microsoft Testing Platform 项目中的长生命周期控制台主机编辑/重新运行循环设置或恢复 MTP 热重载。用于明确的 MTP 控制台请求，例如“启用热重载”、“使用 dotnet run 在编辑时重新运行”，或不受支持/粗鲁的编辑。涵盖设置、运行/监控、重启、筛选器，以及 VSTest 无变异回退。对于一次性运行、精确命令、筛选器错误、TRX/转储文件，或仅仅是失败测试，请使用 run-tests。当 Test Explorer 或 IDE 应在没有 MTP 控制台主机的情况下重新运行测试时，不要使用。排除编辑器集成、CI 以及编写/调试测试。

description: Physics-based animation library combining React Spring (spring dynamics, gesture integration, 60fps animations) and Popmotion (low-level composable animation utilities, reactive streams). Use when building fluid, natural-feeling UI animations, gesture-driven interfaces, physics simulations, or spring-loaded interactions. Triggers on tasks involving React Spring hooks, spring physics, inertia scrolling, physics-based motion, animation composition, or natural UI movements. Alternative physics approach to motion-framer for more physically accurate animations.
description_zh: 基于物理的动画库，结合 React Spring（弹簧动力学、手势集成、60fps 动画）与 Popmotion（底层可组合动画工具、响应式流）。适用于构建流畅、自然感的 UI 动画、手势驱动界面、物理模拟或弹簧驱动交互，适用于涉及 React Spring 钩子、弹簧物理、惯性滚动、基于物理的运动、动画组合或自然 UI 动效等任务。这是 motion-framer 的另一种物理实现方案，能够生成更符合物理规律、物理更准确的动画。

description: DALI imperative dynamic mode (`nvidia.dali.experimental.dynamic`, ndd): use when working on ndd code or migrating pipelines; skip pipeline-only tasks.
description_zh: DALI 命令式动态模式（`nvidia.dali.experimental.dynamic`，ndd）：当处理 ndd 代码或迁移流水线时使用；跳过仅针对流水线的任务。

description: Write an Amazon-style press release that defines customer value before building. Use when aligning stakeholders on a new product, feature, or strategic bet.
description_zh: 撰写一份亚马逊风格的新闻稿，在构建产品前先定义客户价值。在产品、功能或战略赌注方面对齐利益相关者时使用。

description: Migrate a .NET 8 project to .NET 9 and resolve all breaking changes. USE FOR: upgrading TargetFramework from net8.0 to net9.0, fixing build errors after updating the .NET 9 SDK, resolving behavioral changes in .NET 9 / C# 13 / ASP.NET Core 9 / EF Core 9, replacing BinaryFormatter (now always throws), resolving SYSLIB0054-SYSLIB0057, adapting to params span overload resolution, fixing C# 13 compiler changes, updating HttpClientFactory for SocketsHttpHandler, and resolving EF Core 9 migration/Cosmos DB changes. DO NOT USE FOR: .NET Framework migrations, upgrading from .NET 7 or earlier, greenfield .NET 9 projects, or cosmetic modernization unrelated to the upgrade.
description_zh: 将 .NET 8 项目迁移至 .NET 9，并解决所有破坏性变更。用途：将 TargetFramework 从 net8.0 升级至 net9.0；在更新 .NET 9 SDK 后修复构建错误；解决 .NET 9 / C# 13 / ASP.NET Core 9 / EF Core 9 中的行为变化；替换 BinaryFormatter（现已始终抛出异常）；解决 SYSLIB0054-SYSLIB0057；适配 params span 重载解析；修复 C# 13 编译器变更；更新用于 SocketsHttpHandler 的 HttpClientFactory；以及解决 EF Core 9 迁移/Cosmos DB 变更。不适用于：.NET Framework 迁移；从 .NET 7 或更早版本升级；全新 .NET 9 项目；与升级无关的外观现代化。

description: Guide for interpreting ResolveProjectReferences time in MSBuild performance summaries. Activate when ResolveProjectReferences appears as the most expensive target and developers are trying to optimize it directly. Explains that the reported time includes wait time for dependent project builds and is misleading. Guides users to focus on task self-time instead. Do not activate for general build performance -- use build-perf-diagnostics instead.
description_zh: MSBuild性能摘要中ResolveProjectReferences耗时解读指南。当ResolveProjectReferences作为最耗时的目标出现，且开发者正试图直接对其进行优化时，激活本指南。说明报告的时间包含了依赖项目构建的等待时间，且具有误导性，指导用户转而关注任务自身耗时。请勿为通用构建性能问题激活本指南，应使用build-perf-diagnostics替代。

description: Help users navigate the end-to-end lifecycle of funding a startup, from choosing between bootstrapping and VC to closing a Series A or managing a strategic exit.
description_zh: 帮助用户管理初创企业融资的端到端生命周期，从在自主创业与风险投资（VC）之间做出选择，到完成A轮融资或管理战略退出。

description: Generate AI videos with Google Veo, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse, Wan, Grok and 40+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse 1.0, Wan 2.5, Grok Imagine Video, OmniHuman, Fabric, HunyuanVideo. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, video upscaling, foley sound. Use for: social media videos, marketing content, explainer videos, product demos, AI avatars. Triggers: video generation, ai video, text to video, image to video, veo, animate image, video from image, ai animation, video generator, generate video, t2v, i2v, ai video maker, create video with ai, runway alternative, pika alternative, sora alternative, kling alternative, seedance, happyhorse
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 Google Veo、Seedance 2.0、HappyHorse、Wan、Grok 以及 40 多个模型生成 AI 视频。模型：Veo 3.1、Veo 3、Seedance 2.0、HappyHorse 1.0、Wan 2.5、Grok Imagine Video、OmniHuman、Fabric、HunyuanVideo。功能：文生视频、图生视频、参考视频生成、视频剪辑、唇部同步、虚拟人动画、视频放大、拟音。用途：社交媒体视频、营销内容、解释性视频、产品演示、AI 虚拟人。触发词：视频生成、AI 视频、文生视频、图生视频、Veo、图像动画、从图像生成视频、AI 动画、视频生成器、生成视频、t2v、i2v、AI 视频制作工具、使用 AI 创建视频、Runway 替代方案、Pika 替代方案、Sora 替代方案、Kling 替代方案、Seedance、HappyHorse。

description: Design or audit internal link structure for a website. Use when the user asks about internal linking, link architecture, orphan pages, PageRank flow, anchor text, site structure, silo architecture, or why pages aren't ranking despite good content. For external link building, see build-links.
description_zh: 为网站设计或审计内部链接结构。适用于用户询问内部链接、链接架构、孤立页面、PageRank 流量流向、锚文本、网站结构、层级架构（silo architecture），或为何内容优质但页面仍无法排名时。有关外部链接建设，见 build-links。

description: Use this skill for Hugging Face Dataset Viewer API workflows that fetch subset/split metadata, paginate rows, search text, apply filters, download parquet URLs, and read size or statistics.
description_zh: 使用此技能适用于 Hugging Face 数据集查看器 API 工作流程，该流程包括获取子集/分割元数据、分页浏览行、搜索文本、应用筛选条件、下载 parquet 文件 URL 以及读取大小或统计信息。

description: Single entry skill for open-websearch setup and focused live retrieval, preferring local CLI/daemon paths while remaining compatible with workspace-exposed MCP tools.
description_zh: 用于 open-websearch 搭建与精准实时检索的单一入口技能，优先采用本地 CLI/守护进程方案，同时兼容工作区暴露的 MCP 工具。

description: Astro framework specialist for building fast, content-driven websites with islands architecture. Use when creating Astro components, configuring hydration (client:load/idle/visible/media), using server:defer (server islands), Content Layer API (glob/file loaders, live loaders), sessions, astro:env, i18n routing, actions, SSR adapters, view transitions, or integrating React/Vue/Svelte/Solid. Not for full-SPA frameworks (Next.js, Remix, SvelteKit).
description_zh: 用于构建快速、内容驱动且采用岛屿架构的网站的Astro框架专家。适用于创建Astro组件、配置水合（client:load/idle/visible/media）、使用 server:defer（服务端岛屿）、内容层API（全局/文件加载器，实时加载器）、会话、astro:env、国际化路由、动作、SSR适配器、视图过渡，或集成 React/Vue/Svelte/Solid。不适用于完整SPA框架（Next.js、Remix、SvelteKit）。

description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能，修改和提升现有技能，并衡量技能表现。当用户需要从零开始创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能，运行评估测试技能、使用方差分析对技能表现进行基准测试，或优化技能描述以提高触发准确性时使用。

description: Translate and dub videos from one language to another, replacing the original audio with TTS while keeping the video intact.
description_zh: 将一种语言的视频翻译成另一种语言并配音，用 TTS 替换原始音频，同时保持视频完整。

description: Fetch and summarize review comments from the active pull request
description_zh: 获取并总结来自活跃拉取请求的评审评论

description: Manages Arize users, organizations, spaces, projects, roles, role bindings, resource restrictions, and API keys via the ax CLI. Use for enterprise admin workflows: inviting and offboarding users, onboarding new teams, creating custom roles for SAML/SSO mappings, assigning roles to users, restricting project-level access, and managing service keys for multi-tenant architectures. Covers ax users, ax organizations, ax spaces, ax projects, ax roles, ax role-bindings, and ax api-keys.
description_zh: 通过 ax CLI 管理 Arize 用户、组织、空间、项目、角色、角色绑定、资源限制和 API 密钥。用于企业管理员工作流：用户邀请与离场、新团队入职、为 SAML/SSO 映射创建自定义角色、为用户分配角色、限制项目级访问权限，以及为多租户架构管理服务密钥。涵盖 ax users、ax organizations、ax spaces、ax projects、ax roles、ax role-bindings 和 ax api-keys。

description: Run a positioning workshop that surfaces target customer, unmet need, category, benefits, and differentiation. Use when your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned.
description_zh: 开展定位工作坊，梳理目标客户、未满足需求、品类、利益点与差异化优势。当产品信息传达模糊、泛泛而谈或定位错位时使用。

description: Verify a claim with fresh local evidence: restate it falsifiably, capture baseline and treatment, compare artifacts, and return VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
description_zh: 使用新鲜本地证据验证断言：以可证伪的方式复述断言，记录基线与治疗情况，比较工件，并返回 VERIFIED、NOT VERIFIED 或 INCONCLUSIVE。

description: Fix MSBuild targets that generate files during the build but those files are missing from compilation or output. USE FOR: generated source files not compiling (CS0246 for a type that should exist), custom build tasks that create files but they are invisible to subsequent targets, globs not capturing build-generated files because they expand at evaluation time before execution creates them, ensuring generated files are cleaned by the Clean target. Covers correct BeforeTargets timing (CoreCompile, BeforeBuild, AssignTargetPaths), adding to Compile/FileWrites item groups, using $(IntermediateOutputPath) instead of hardcoded obj/ paths. DO NOT USE FOR: C# source generators that already work via the Roslyn pipeline, T4 design-time generation that runs in Visual Studio, non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
修复构建时生成文件，但该文件未包含在编译或输出中的 MSBuild 目标。
适用场景：生成的源文件无法编译（预期存在但实际无法编译的类型报 CS0246 错误），自定义构建任务创建了文件但对后续目标不可见，通配符在评估阶段展开时构建生成的文件尚未创建因而无法捕获，确保生成的文件被 Clean 目标清理。
覆盖正确的 BeforeTargets 时机（CoreCompile、BeforeBuild、AssignTargetPaths），添加到 Compile/FileWrites 项组，使用 $(IntermediateOutputPath) 而非硬编码的 obj/ 路径。
不建议使用：已通过 Roslyn 流程正常工作的 C# 源生成器、在 Visual Studio 中运行的 T4 设计时生成、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: Searches, retrieves, and synthesizes official Google developer documentation across Google Cloud, AI/Gemini, Android, Chrome, Web, Flutter, Go, Firebase, and other Google developer platforms. Integrates with the Developer Knowledge MCP server (search_documents, get_documents, answer_query) or the Developer Knowledge REST API fallback. Use when searching for gcloud CLI commands, API syntax, IAM permissions, official documentation, architectural comparisons, or product choice overviews. Don't use for local filesystem lookups or non-Google documentation.
description_zh: 搜索、检索并综合 Google Cloud、AI/Gemini、Android、Chrome、Web、Flutter、Go、Firebase 及其他 Google 开发者平台上的官方 Google 开发者文档。集成 Developer Knowledge MCP 服务器（search_documents、get_documents、answer_query）或 Developer Knowledge REST API 备用方案。适用于搜索 gcloud CLI 命令、API 语法、IAM 权限、官方文档、架构对比或产品选型概览。不适用于本地文件系统查找或非 Google 文档。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Flutter and Dart. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Flutter", "install sentry_flutter", "setup Sentry in Dart", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, or logging for Flutter applications. Supports Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and Web.
description_zh: 完整的 Flutter 和 Dart Sentry SDK 设置。当被要求“为 Flutter 添加 Sentry”、“安装 sentry_flutter”、“在 Dart 中设置 Sentry”，或为 Flutter 应用配置错误监控、链路追踪、性能分析、会话回放或日志记录功能时使用。支持 Android、iOS、macOS、Linux、Windows 和 Web。

description: Amazon Redshift is NOT PostgreSQL — corrects PostgreSQL-derived LLM mistakes; covers Redshift-specific SQL, DDL, COPY/UNLOAD, system views, metadata discovery, and operational patterns. Applies ONLY when the task is about Redshift itself (cluster, Serverless workgroup, or Redshift SQL). Pushes back on: CREATE INDEX, string_agg, pg_catalog, text type, SERIAL, stl_query, LATERAL, RETURNING. Triggers on: Redshift SQL, Redshift CREATE TABLE, Redshift COPY/UNLOAD, slow Redshift query, Redshift permission denied, Redshift disk full, Redshift system views, QUALIFY, PIVOT, MERGE, Redshift Data API, Redshift WLM, concurrency scaling, Redshift resize, Redshift Spectrum external tables. Does NOT apply to (defer to that service's own skill): Amazon S3 storage/bucket policies, Athena or Glue queries/catalogs, data-lake or Iceberg work outside Redshift, Aurora, RDS, or DynamoDB — but S3/Glue ARE in scope for Redshift COPY, UNLOAD, or data-lake queries (external schemas/tables on S3).
description_zh:
**Amazon Redshift 并非 PostgreSQL——纠正源自 PostgreSQL 的 LLM 错误；涵盖 Redshift 专属 SQL、DDL、COPY/UNLOAD、系统视图、元数据发现及运维模式。仅在任务涉及 Redshift 本身时适用（包括集群、Serverless 工作组或 Redshift SQL 场景）。**

**反驳以下内容：** CREATE INDEX、string_agg、pg_catalog、文本类型、SERIAL、stl_query、LATERAL、RETURNING。

**触发条件：** Redshift SQL、Redshift CREATE TABLE、Redshift COPY/UNLOAD、Redshift 查询变慢、Redshift 权限被拒绝、Redshift 磁盘空间不足、Redshift 系统视图、QUALIFY、PIVOT、MERGE、Redshift Data API、Redshift WLM、并发扩展、Redshift 调整规模、Redshift Spectrum 外部表。

**不适用（应转交该服务自身技能处理）：** Amazon S3 存储/存储桶策略、Athena 或 Glue 查询/目录、Redshift 范围外的数据湖或 Iceberg 工作、Aurora、RDS 或 DynamoDB——但 S3/Glue 在 Redshift COPY、UNLOAD 或数据湖查询（涉及 S3 上的外部模式/表）中仍在范围内。

description: Progressive Domain Crystallization (PDC) — a skill for building and maintaining a living domain knowledge base for any custom business application. Use this skill whenever the user is developing a business application and wants the AI to accumulate understanding of internal terminology, entities, relationships, and business rules over time — especially when that knowledge is not fully defined upfront and grows across sessions. Trigger on any of: "remember how our system works", "learn our domain", "track business entities", "build domain knowledge", "understand our terminology", "grow AI context over time", "domain model", "business rules documentation", or whenever a user says the AI doesn't understand their business-specific language or data model. Also use at the start of any session where a .tasks/domain.md file exists in the project — always read it before doing any work.
description_zh:
渐进式领域结晶（PDC）—— 为任何定制业务应用构建并维护活跃领域知识库的一项技能。

当用户开发业务应用且希望AI随时间积累对内部术语、实体、关系及业务规则的深入理解时，请使用此技能——尤其是在这些知识并非在初期完全定义，而是随着会话的推进不断积累时。

触发条件包括以下任意一项："记住我们的系统如何运行"、"学习我们的领域"、"追踪业务实体"、"构建领域知识"、"理解我们的术语"、"随时间增长AI上下文"、"领域模型"、"业务规则文档"，或者当用户表示AI不理解其业务特定语言或数据模型时。

如果在项目中存在 `.tasks/domain.md` 文件，则在会话开始时也使用此技能——在开展任何工作之前，始终先读取该文件。

description: Use when authoring TypeScript libraries or npm packages - covers project setup, package.json exports, build tooling (tsdown/unbuild), API design patterns, type inference tricks, testing, and publishing to npm. Use when bundling, configuring dual CJS/ESM output, or setting up release workflows.
description_zh: 在编写 TypeScript 库或 npm 包时使用——涵盖项目设置、package.json 导出、构建工具（tsdown/unbuild）、API 设计模式、类型推断技巧、测试以及发布到 npm。在打包、配置 CJS/ESM 双格式输出或设置发布工作流时使用。

description: Verify a WordPress plugin's Abilities API registrations: enumerate abilities, check that callback behavior matches each annotation's claim (the adversarial readonly-but-writes detection), validate permissions and schemas, and validate audit documents produced by wp-abilities-audit.
description_zh: 验证 WordPress 插件的能力 API 注册：枚举能力，检查回调行为是否与每个注解所声明的内容一致（对抗性“只读但写入”检测），验证权限和模式，并验证 wp-abilities-audit 生成的审计文档。

description: Simple scroll-triggered reveal animations using AOS (Animate On Scroll). Use this skill when building marketing pages, landing pages, or content-heavy sites requiring basic fade/slide effects without complex animation orchestration. Triggers on tasks involving scroll animations, scroll-triggered reveals, AOS, simple animations, or basic scroll effects. Alternative to GSAP ScrollTrigger and Locomotive Scroll for simpler use cases. Compare with motion-framer for React-specific animations.
description_zh: 使用 AOS（Animate On Scroll）实现简单的滚动触发的显现动画。在构建营销页面、落地页或内容密集型网站时使用本技能，当这些页面需要基本淡入/滑动效果且无需复杂动画编排时，适用本技能。适用于涉及滚动动画、滚动触发的显现、AOS、简单动画或基础滚动效果的任务。对于更简单的应用场景，可作为 GSAP ScrollTrigger 和 Locomotive Scroll 的替代方案。如需对比针对 React 的动画方案，请与 motion-framer 进行对比。

description: Use for code/PR review, audits, bug/security checks, reviewing diffs or changes, and finding issues in code.
description_zh: 用于代码/PR 审查、审计、bug/安全检查、审阅 diff 或变更，以及发现代码中的问题。

description: Help users set effective OKRs and goals. Use when someone is creating quarterly objectives, defining key results, setting team goals, planning annual targets, or struggling with goal alignment across their organization.
description_zh: 帮助用户制定有效的OKR和目标。当用户创建季度目标、定义关键结果、设定团队目标、规划年度目标，或面临组织内目标对齐问题时使用。

description: Generate a periodic knowledge digest — a human-readable newsletter-style summary of what was learned, updated, and connected in your wiki over a specified period (day/week/month). Use when the user says "what did I learn this week", "give me a digest", "weekly summary", "knowledge report", "what's new in my wiki", "/wiki-digest [period]", "summarize my recent learning", or wants a readable overview of recent wiki activity. Distinct from wiki-status (which reports ingestion delta of sources) — wiki-digest summarizes *knowledge*, not sources.
description_zh: 生成周期性知识摘要——这是针对指定时间段（日/周/月）内，在您的 wiki 中学习、更新和关联内容的、面向人类阅读的新闻通讯式摘要。当用户说“我这一周学到了什么”、“给我一份摘要”、“每周摘要”、“知识报告”、“我的 wiki 有什么新内容”、“/wiki-digest [period]”、“总结我最近的学习”，或需要近期 wiki 活动的可读概览时使用。与 wiki-status（报告来源的摄入增量）不同——wiki-digest 总结的是 *知识*，而非 *来源*。

description: Define an illustration style guide — visual language, colour usage, and application rules. Use when commissioning or standardising illustration. For icons, use `icon-system` (design-systems).
description_zh: 定义插画风格指南——视觉语言、色彩使用与应用规范。用于委托或规范插画。对于图标，使用 `icon-system`（设计系统）。

description: Build or adapt a local browser/CDP harness to drive and inspect a web, IDE, or Electron UI. Use for local UI verification, screenshots, accessibility snapshots, perf profiles, visual diffs, or reproducing UI bugs.
description_zh: 构建或改造本地浏览器/CDP 测试框架，以驱动并检查网页、IDE 或 Electron 界面。用于本地界面验证、截图、无障碍快照、性能分析、视觉差异比对，或复现界面缺陷。

description: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use for /maintain-verification-skill or "audit the verify skill".
description_zh: 周期性校验：保持项目验证技能与功能地图真实可靠——每个功能并行配置多个源读取者，由一个实时会话驱动所有功能，最多提交一个经证实的修正（PR）。用于 /maintain-verification-skill 或“审计验证技能”。

description: 微信公众号文章排版引擎，将 Markdown 转换为可直接粘贴到公众号编辑器的 HTML。主题风格从 references/theme-index.md 注册的自定义主题库中选取，自动章节编号、关键词下划线标记、引言卡片、目录导航、代码块、图片/GIF、作者签名。支持 Markdown / Word(.docx) / PDF / 纯文本输入（非 Markdown 先自动归一化），也支持"一键自动排版"（自动推断结构+选主题），还支持根据用户描述/参考图生成自定义主题组件库并保存本地复用。触发场景：(1) 用户提到"公众号排版""公众号文章""微信排版""gzh"，(2) 用户想把文章（md/docx/pdf/纯文本）转成公众号 HTML，(3) 用户说"自动排版""一键排版"公众号内容，(4) 用户想为公众号排版"生成新主题/自定义风格/按这张图做一套组件库"。不用于生成普通网页/落地页/PPT（用前端或 PPT 类 skill）。
description_zh: 微信公众号文章排版引擎，将 Markdown 转换为可直接粘贴到公众号编辑器的 HTML。主题风格从 references/theme-index.md 注册的自定义主题库中选取，自动章节编号、关键词下划线标记、引言卡片、目录导航、代码块、图片/GIF、作者签名。支持 Markdown / Word(.docx) / PDF / 纯文本输入（非 Markdown 先自动归一化），也支持"一键自动排版"（自动推断结构+选主题），还支持根据用户描述/参考图生成自定义主题组件库并保存本地复用。触发场景：(1) 用户提到"公众号排版""公众号文章""微信排版""gzh"，(2) 用户想把文章（md/docx/pdf/纯文本）转成公众号 HTML，(3) 用户说"自动排版""一键排版"公众号内容，(4) 用户想为公众号排版"生成新主题/自定义风格/按这张图做一套组件库"。不用于生成普通网页/落地页/PPT（用前端或 PPT 类 skill）。

description: Integrate Uniswap swaps into applications. Use when user says "integrate swaps", "uniswap", "trading api", "add swap functionality", "build a swap frontend", "create a swap script", "smart contract swap integration", "use Universal Router", "Trading API", or mentions swapping tokens via Uniswap.

description:
Convert photos (people, pets, objects, logos) into 4 animated GIF stickers with captions.
Use when: user wants to create cartoon stickers, GIF expressions, emoji packs, animated avatars,
or convert photos to Funko Pop / Pop Mart blind box style animations.

将照片（人物、宠物、物品、标志）转换为4张带有文字说明的动画GIF贴纸。

description: Guides Amazon SES onboarding for domain-based email sending. Covers identity configuration, production access, an optional first test send, and troubleshooting setup, authentication, or sending failures. Use when setting up SES, resuming incomplete onboarding, or leaving the sandbox. Does not cover inbound email or Mail Manager, SMS/voice, WhatsApp, SNS, Pinpoint, or WorkMail.
description_zh: 亚马逊 SES 域名邮件发送入门设置指南。涵盖身份配置、生产环境访问、可选的首次测试发送，以及针对设置、认证或发送失败的故障排除。在设置 SES、恢复未完成的入门设置或离开沙盒环境时使用。不涵盖入站邮件或 Mail Manager、短信/语音、WhatsApp、SNS、Pinpoint 或 WorkMail。

description: Query ClinicalTrials.gov via APIv2. Use when you want to search for trials by condition, drug, location, status, or phase; retrieve trial details by NCT ID; check eligibility/inclusion criteria; count trials across conditions or time periods; identify a sponsor's trial portfolio; find recruiting trials for patient matching.

description: Handle LaTeX formatting, templates, and styling for academic papers. Set up conference templates (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, AAAI, ACL), fix formatting issues, manage packages, and ensure venue-specific compliance. Use when the user needs to set up a paper template, fix LaTeX formatting, or prepare for submission.

description: Use when reviewing code for security vulnerabilities, implementing authentication/authorization, handling user input, or discussing web application security. Covers OWASP Top 10:2025, ASVS 5.0, LLM Top 10 (2025), and Agentic AI security (2026).
description_zh: 适用场景：当审查代码中的安全漏洞、实现认证/授权、处理用户输入，或讨论 Web 应用安全时使用。覆盖 OWASP Top 10:2025、ASVS 5.0、LLM Top 10（2025）和 Agentic AI 安全（2026）。

description: Comprehensive guide for setting up and configuring CodeQL code scanning via GitHub Actions workflows and the CodeQL CLI. This skill should be used when users need help with code scanning configuration, CodeQL workflow files, CodeQL CLI commands, SARIF output, security analysis setup, or troubleshooting CodeQL analysis.
description_zh: 综合指南：通过 GitHub Actions 工作流和 CodeQL CLI 设置与配置 CodeQL 代码扫描。当用户需要帮助进行代码扫描配置、编写 CodeQL 工作流文件、执行 CodeQL CLI 命令、查看 SARIF 输出、设置安全分析，或排查 CodeQL 分析问题时，应使用本技能。

description:
Vision-driven desktop automation using Midscene. Control your local desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) or a remote Windows desktop over RDP with natural language commands.
Operates entirely from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels required. Can interact with all visible elements on screen regardless of technology stack.

⚠️ In local mode this takes over the user's real mouse and keyboard. For web apps, prefer "Browser Automation" instead.
Only use this for desktop-native apps (Electron, Qt, native macOS/Windows/Linux) that cannot run in a browser, or for driving a remote Windows host via RDP.

Triggers: open app, press key, desktop, computer, click on screen, type text, screenshot desktop,
launch application, switch window, desktop automation, control computer, mouse click, keyboard shortcut,
screen capture, find on screen, read screen, verify window, close app, test Electron app,
rdp, remote desktop, windows server, connect via rdp

Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)
description_zh:
基于 Midscene 的视觉驱动桌面自动化。使用自然语言命令控制您的本地桌面（macOS、Windows、Linux）或通过 RDP 远程访问的 Windows 桌面。

完全基于截图运行——无需 DOM 或无障碍标签。无论技术栈如何，均可与屏幕上的所有可见元素交互。

⚠️ 本地模式下，该工具会接管用户的真实鼠标和键盘。对于网页应用，建议使用“浏览器自动化”代替。

仅限用于无法在浏览器中运行的桌面原生应用（Electron、Qt、原生 macOS/Windows/Linux），或通过 RDP 驱动远程 Windows 主机。

触发词：打开应用，按按键，桌面，电脑，点击屏幕，输入文本，截取桌面截图，
启动应用程序，切换窗口，桌面自动化，控制电脑，鼠标点击，键盘快捷键，
屏幕捕捉，在屏幕上查找，读取屏幕，验证窗口，关闭应用，测试 Electron 应用，
RDP，远程桌面，Windows 服务器，通过 RDP 连接

由 Midscene.js（https://midscenejs.com）提供支持

description: Switch between multiple Obsidian wiki vault profiles. Use this skill when the user says "/wiki-switch NAME", "switch to my work wiki", "switch vault", "change wiki", "which wiki am I on", "list my wikis", "show my vaults", "create a new vault config", or "add a new wiki profile". The skill manages named config files at <global config dir>/config.NAME and activates one by symlinking it to <global config dir>/config.
description_zh: 在多个 Obsidian wiki 仓库配置之间切换。当用户说出 "/wiki-switch NAME"、"切换到我的工作 wiki"、"切换仓库"、"更改 wiki"、"我当前在哪个 wiki"、"列出我的 wiki"、"显示我的仓库"、"创建新的仓库配置" 或 "添加新的 wiki 配置" 时，请使用此技能。该技能管理位于 <global config dir>/config.NAME 的命名配置文件，并通过将其符号链接至 <global config dir>/config 来激活对应的配置。

Pay-per-call x402/MPP APIs (USDC on Base, Solana, Tempo). No API keys—wallet pays per request.

Only search when NO listed origin fits.

若任务匹配下方任一 SERVICES 服务，跳过搜索，直接进入「发现 → 获取」。

仅在没有任何已列出的服务匹配时进行搜索。

SERVICES：
stableenrich（人物/公司、网页搜索、数据抓取、地图、LinkedIn、邮箱验证、新闻）
stablesocial（TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook、Reddit、LinkedIn、GitHub）

description: Laravel 13 conventions and best practices. Use when creating controllers, models, migrations, validation, services, or structuring Laravel applications. Triggers on tasks involving Laravel architecture, Eloquent, database, API development, or PHP patterns.
