description: Tailwind CSS styling guidelines for Mastra Playground UI. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring styling code in packages/playground-ui and packages/playground to ensure design system consistency. Triggers on tasks involving Tailwind classes, component styling, or design tokens.
description_zh: Mastra Playground UI 的 Tailwind CSS 样式指南。当在 packages/playground-ui 和 packages/playground 中编写、审查或重构样式代码时，应使用本技能，以确保设计系统的一致性。该技能适用于涉及 Tailwind 类、组件样式或设计令牌的任务。

description: Clean Architecture principles and best practices from Robert C. Martin's book. This skill should be used when designing software systems, reviewing code structure, or refactoring applications to achieve better separation of concerns. Triggers on tasks involving layers, boundaries, dependency direction, entities, use cases, or system architecture.
description_zh: 来自 Robert C. Martin 的《清洁架构》原则与最佳实践。当设计软件系统、审查代码结构或重构应用程序以实现更好的关注点分离时，应使用该技能。在涉及分层、边界、依赖方向、实体、用例或系统架构的任务时触发。

description: Help users navigate complex product decisions by weighing competing priorities and calculating long-term value. This skill covers build-vs-buy logic, technical debt evaluation, and communicating tradeoffs to senior leadership.
description_zh: 帮助用户通过权衡相互竞争的优先级并评估长期价值，处理复杂的产品决策。本技能涵盖构建与采购的逻辑、技术债务评估，以及向高层领导沟通权衡取舍。

description: antfu-style design conventions, broadened. UnoCSS-first, class-based semantic tokens with dual light/dark for tooling and devtools UIs, plus design-read, anti-slop, and micro-interaction polish for landing pages and product surfaces. Use when building or refactoring any interface with UnoCSS.
description_zh: 扩展了 Antfu 风格的设计规范。采用 UnoCSS 优先、支持工具与开发工具界面双色（浅色/深色）模式的基于类别的语义令牌，并针对落地页及产品界面优化了设计可读性、避免设计俗套以及微交互细节。适用于使用 UnoCSS 构建或重构任何界面。

description: Create polished dark-themed architecture diagrams as self-contained HTML+SVG files. Use when the user asks for system, infrastructure, cloud, security, or network topology diagrams.
description_zh: 创建精致的深色主题架构图，以自包含的HTML+SVG文件形式。当用户需要制作系统、基础设施、云、安全或网络拓扑图时使用。

description: Complete reference for integrating with 300+ AI models through the OpenRouter TypeScript SDK using the callModel pattern

description: Drive Cargo from its hosted MCP server at https://mcp.getcargo.io/mcp — connect a client, discover and price an action, run it over one record or a batch, poll it, and read workspace models, with no CLI install. Also when to call an MCP tool instead of shelling out to `cargo-ai`. Triggers: "connect Cargo to Claude Desktop", "add Cargo to ChatGPT", "Cargo MCP server", "mcp.getcargo.io", "use Cargo without installing anything", "which Cargo tool do I call", "search_actions", "execute_action_batch", "MCP server is showing the wrong workspace". Tools: whoami, search_actions, get_action_schema, execute_action, execute_action_batch, get_run, query_models. Skip when: you have a shell and the job is a workflow, a CDK deploy, warehouse SQL, or a mailbox — use the CLI skills; when publishing an MCP server out of your own workspace or attaching one to a Cargo agent — use cargo-ai.
description_zh:
通过托管在 https://mcp.getcargo.io/mcp 的 MCP 服务器驱动 Cargo——连接客户端、发现并定价操作、针对单条记录或批次运行该操作、轮询其结果，并读取工作空间模型，无需进行 CLI 安装。此外，在何种情况下应调用 MCP 工具而非通过 shell 调用 `cargo-ai`：触发词包括"连接 Cargo 至 Claude Desktop"、"将 Cargo 添加到 ChatGPT"、"Cargo MCP 服务器"、"mcp.getcargo.io"、"无需安装任何组件使用 Cargo"、"我应该调用哪个 Cargo 工具"、"search_actions"、"execute_action_batch"、"MCP 服务器显示错误的工作空间"。

工具：whoami、search_actions、get_action_schema、execute_action、execute_action_batch、get_run、query_models。

跳过场景：当您具备 shell 环境，且任务属于工作流、CDK 部署、仓储 SQL 或邮件箱处理时，应使用 CLI 技能；当您从自己的工作空间发布 MCP 服务器或将其附加到 Cargo 代理时，应使用 cargo-ai。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Svelte and SvelteKit. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Svelte", "add Sentry to SvelteKit", "install @sentry/sveltekit", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, or logging for Svelte or SvelteKit applications.
description_zh: 完整的 Sentry SDK 设置，适用于 Svelte 和 SvelteKit。当被要求“为 Svelte 添加 Sentry”、“为 SvelteKit 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/sveltekit”，或为 Svelte 或 SvelteKit 应用程序配置错误监控、追踪、会话重放或日志记录时使用。

description: Extract transcripts from YouTube videos and generate comprehensive, detailed summaries using intelligent analysis frameworks
description_zh: 从 YouTube 视频中提取转录文本，并使用智能分析框架生成全面、详细的摘要。

description: Creates VS Code custom agent files (.agent.md) for specialized AI personas with tools, instructions, and handoffs. Use when scaffolding new custom agents, configuring agent workflows, or setting up agent-to-agent handoffs.
description_zh: 创建用于专用 AI 角色的 VS Code 自定义智能体文件（.agent.md），文件包含工具、指令和交接流程。适用于搭建新的自定义智能体、配置智能体工作流或设置智能体之间的交接场景。

description: When the user wants to create Pinterest Pins, optimize Pin descriptions, or grow Pinterest presence. Also use when the user mentions "Pinterest," "Pin," "Pinterest SEO," "Pinterest description," "Pinterest board," or "Pinterest marketing." For asset specs, use visual-content.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建Pinterest Pin、优化Pin描述，或扩大Pinterest影响力时，请使用。当用户提到“Pinterest”、“Pin”、“Pinterest SEO”、“Pinterest 描述”、“Pinterest 板块”或“Pinterest 营销”时，也请使用。对于素材规格，使用 visual-content。

description: Look up SaaS finance metrics, formulas, and benchmarks fast. Use when you need a quick metric definition, formula, or benchmark during analysis.
description_zh: 快速查询SaaS财务指标、公式及基准。在分析过程中需要快速获取指标定义、公式或基准时使用。

description: Convert a Streamlit app to a marimo notebook
description_zh: 将 Streamlit 应用转换为 marimo 笔记本

description: a set of guidelines to build with Botpress's Agent Development Kit (ADK) - use these whenever you're tasked with building a feature using the ADK
description_zh: 使用 Botpress 智能体开发工具包（ADK）构建的一套指南——每当您被指派使用 ADK 构建功能时，请使用上述指南。

description:
3D-style image generation: 3D characters, product renders, isometric dioramas, 3D icons, 3D text, interior design renders, architectural visualization, 3D scenes, game assets.

Use when generating 3D-style 2D images from text descriptions or reference photos (e.g. 3D character design, isometric diorama, 3D product render, interior design visualization, architectural render, 3D app icon, 3D text effect, game asset render).
description_zh:
3D风格图像生成：3D角色、产品渲染、等距场景、3D图标、3D文字、室内设计渲染、建筑可视化、3D场景、游戏素材。

适用于根据文本描述或参考照片生成3D风格2D图像（例如3D角色设计、等距场景、3D产品渲染、室内设计可视化、建筑渲染、3D应用图标、3D文字效果、游戏素材渲染）。

description: 네이버 검색광고(키워드광고)의 노출수·클릭수·광고비·CTR·CPC·전환수를 조회한다. 캠페인/광고그룹/키워드 목록, 기간별 성과, 연관키워드·월간 조회수 도구 포함. 읽기 전용, 로컬 실행 전용. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 支持查询네이버搜索广告（关键词广告）的展示量、点击量、广告费、CTR、CPC与转化数。包含活动、广告组、关键词列表、分时段业绩、相关关键词与月查询量的查询工具。仅读取专用，仅本地执行专用。开关可执行从官方界面发起的后续操作。

description: Use when coordinating product work across the 12 bundled product sub-skills (RICE, OKRs, UX research, design tokens, competitive teardown, analytics, experiments, discovery, roadmaps, spec-to-repo, landing pages, SaaS scaffolding) or the 4 standalone product-team plugins (user stories, Apple HIG, code-to-PRD, research summarizer). Triggers on 'help me prioritize', 'plan a product experiment', 'we ship features nobody uses', 'run the discovery loop', 'is our OST sound'. Forks context to route to one sub-skill via a deterministic signal router and returns a digest; can also drive a continuous-discovery loop (Torres cadence tracker + OST linter as machine gates) or a full goal→plan→execute→verify→close run through the repo-wide agent-harness. Distinct from project-management (how to deliver vs what to build), marketing/landing (from-scratch pages), and engineering/agent-harness (the generic loop engine this orchestrator plugs into).
description_zh: 用于在 12 个捆绑的产品子技能（RICE、OKRs、用户研究、设计令牌、竞品拆解、数据分析、实验、探索、路线图、规格到仓库、落地页、SaaS 脚手架）以及 4 个独立的产品团队插件（用户故事、Apple HIG、代码到PRD、研究总结器）之间协调产品工作。在“帮助我优先排序”、“规划产品实验”、“我们上线了无人使用的功能”、“运行探索循环”、“我们的 OST 是否有问题”等触发词时触发。通过确定性信号路由器将上下文分叉并路由至特定的子技能，并返回摘要；同时也可驱动连续的探索循环（以 Torres 节奏追踪器与 OST 校验器作为机器门禁），或通过仓库级代理框架运行完整的“目标→计划→执行→验证→收尾”流程。与项目管理（侧重于如何交付与构建什么）、营销/落地页（从零起步的页面）以及工程/代理框架（本编排器所接入的通用循环引擎）区分开来。

description: Draft, revise, and audit scientific manuscripts or reports with explicit evidence provenance, reporting-guideline coverage, authorship accountability, confidentiality controls, and local consistency checks. Use for manuscript sections, references, declarations, tables, figures, or submission preparation when scientific accuracy and traceability matter.
description_zh: 起草、修订并审核具备明确证据来源、报告指南覆盖、作者署名责任、保密控制及本地一致性检查的科学稿件或报告。当科学准确性与可追溯性至关重要时，用于稿件章节、参考文献、声明、表格与图表或提交准备。

description: Help users apply behavioral science to product design. Use when someone is designing for habit formation, reducing friction, applying psychology to UX, increasing retention through behavioral principles, or using nudges to influence user behavior.
description_zh: 帮助用户将行为科学应用于产品设计。适用于以下设计场景：当设计侧重习惯养成、减少摩擦、将心理学应用于用户体验、通过行为原则提高留存，或使用助推影响用户行为时。

description: Guides migration of .NET Framework Thread.Abort usage to cooperative cancellation in modern .NET. USE FOR: modernizing code that calls Thread.Abort, catching ThreadAbortException, replacing Thread.ResetAbort, replacing Thread.Interrupt for thread termination, resolving PlatformNotSupportedException or SYSLIB0006 after retargeting to .NET 6+, migrating ASP.NET Response.End or Response.Redirect(url, true) which internally call Thread.Abort. DO NOT USE FOR: code that only uses Thread.Join, Thread.Sleep, or Thread.Start without any abort, interrupt, or ThreadAbortException usage — these APIs work identically in modern .NET and need no migration. Also not for projects staying on .NET Framework, or Thread.Abort usage inside third-party libraries you do not control.
description_zh:
指南：将 .NET Framework 中的 Thread.Abort 使用方式迁移至现代 .NET 的合作式取消。

适用场景：对调用 Thread.Abort 的代码进行现代化改造，捕获 ThreadAbortException，替换 Thread.ResetAbort，用 Thread.Interrupt 替换以实现线程终止，在重定向至 .NET 6+ 后解决 PlatformNotSupportedException 或 SYSLIB0006 错误，以及迁移内部调用 Thread.Abort 的 ASP.NET Response.End 或 Response.Redirect(url, true) 方法。

不适用场景：仅使用 Thread.Join、Thread.Sleep 或 Thread.Start，且不存在任何中止、中断或 ThreadAbortException 使用的代码——这些 API 在现代 .NET 中表现完全一致，无需进行迁移。此外，不适用于仍停留在 .NET Framework 的项目，或您无法控制的第三方库中使用的 Thread.Abort 代码。

description: DO NOT USE when the target already consumes an injected interface or built-in abstraction such as IFileSystem or TimeProvider, even if the request says "generate a wrapper"; no new wrapper is needed. Use only when C# source calls an ambient/static dependency and no injectable seam exists: first-time TimeProvider, IHttpClientFactory, or System.IO.Abstractions adoption; minimal Environment/Console/Process wrappers; IProcessRunner; DI registration; or an ambient seam that preserves a static API. Exclude static detection (detect-static-dependencies), migration to an existing/registered abstraction (migrate-static-to-wrapper), one blocked behavior plus deterministic tests (testability-obstacle), and general interface design.
description_zh: 当目标已依赖注入接口或内置抽象（如 IFileSystem 或 TimeProvider）时，即使请求要求“生成包装器”，也不应使用；无需创建新的包装器。仅在 C# 源代码调用环境/静态依赖且不存在可注入接缝的情况下使用：首次引入 TimeProvider、IHttpClientFactory 或 System.IO.Abstractions 时的采用；极简的 Environment/Console/Process 包装器；IProcessRunner；依赖注入 (DI) 注册；或者环境接缝（保持静态 API）的场合。排除静态依赖检测 (detect-static-dependencies)、迁移至现有/已注册抽象 (migrate-static-to-wrapper)、仅阻塞一项行为并配合确定性测试 (testability-obstacle) 以及一般接口设计。

description: Helps find, inspect, and compare (at a high level) .NET project templates. Resolves natural-language project descriptions to ranked template matches with pre-filled parameters. USE FOR: finding the right dotnet new template for a task, inspecting a template's parameters and constraints, understanding what a template produces before creating a project, resolving intent like "web API with auth" to concrete template + parameters. DO NOT USE FOR: actually creating projects (use template-instantiation), authoring custom templates (use template-authoring), producing a detailed side-by-side comparison (use template-comparison), choosing cross-parameter defaults during creation (use template-smart-defaults), MSBuild or build issues (use dotnet-msbuild plugin), NuGet package management unrelated to template packages.
description_zh:
有助于查找、检查并（在高层级）对比 .NET 项目模板。将自然语言的.项目描述解析为带有预设参数的排序后的模板匹配结果。

适用场景：为任务查找合适的 `dotnet new` 模板，检查模板的参数和约束条件，在创建项目前了解模板将生成的内容，将类似“带鉴权的 Web API”的意图解析为具体的模板及参数。

不适用于：实际创建项目（请使用 template-instantiation），编写自定义模板（请使用 template-authoring），生成详细的并排对比（请使用 template-comparison），创建时选择跨参数默认值（请使用 template-smart-defaults），MSBuild 或构建问题（请使用 dotnet-msbuild 插件），与模板包无关的 NuGet 包管理。

description_zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的 A/H/US 股票智能分析系统，集成多源数据、实时新闻、AI 决策看板及通过 GitHub Actions 进行的多渠道推送通知功能。

description: Write TypeScript and JavaScript code following Metabase coding standards and best practices. Use when developing or refactoring TypeScript/JavaScript code.
description_zh: 遵循 Metabase 编码规范和最佳实践，编写 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 代码。开发或重构 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码时使用。

description: Guidance for the bundled Zoom MCP connectors. Use after routing to an MCP workflow when planning or troubleshooting tool-based access to meetings, recordings, meeting assets, or transcripts. Route Zoom Docs requests to the dedicated Docs MCP server and Whiteboard-specific requests to `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`.
description_zh: 捆绑的 Zoom MCP 连接器使用指南。在规划或排障对会议、录制、会议资产或转录内容进行工具访问时，请于将请求路由至 MCP 工作流之后使用。请将 Zoom Docs 请求路由至专用的 Docs MCP 服务器，并将特定于白板的请求路由至 `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`。

description: Assess whether your product work is AI-first or AI-shaped. Use when evaluating AI maturity and choosing the next team capability to build.
description_zh: 评估你的产品工作是否以AI优先，还是由AI塑造。用于评估AI成熟度并选择下一步团队能力建设方向时使用。

description: Extracts, retrieves, and applies CMS brand guidelines (voice, tone, style, colors, typography) to generated content. Use this skill ANY TIME a user request involves branding, brand voice, brand tone, brand guidelines, brand identity, brand styling, or applying a brand to content. Triggers for requests like "apply my brand", "use our brand voice", "match our brand guidelines", "find my brand", "search for brand", "get brand instructions", "apply brand tone". Handles the full workflow: searching for brands in Salesforce CMS, extracting brand instructions, and applying brand voice/tone/guidelines to generated content. Does not apply to media/image search (use searching-media skill), logo search, or creating new brand definitions.
description_zh: 提取、检索并应用 CMS 品牌指南（声音、语气、风格、颜色、字体）到生成内容。当用户请求涉及品牌、品牌声音、品牌语气、品牌指南、品牌标识、品牌样式或对内容应用品牌时，随时使用此技能。触发条件包括类似“应用我的品牌”、“使用我们的品牌声音”、“匹配我们的品牌指南”、“查找我的品牌”、“搜索品牌”、“获取品牌指令”、“应用品牌语气”的请求。负责完整工作流程：在 Salesforce CMS 中搜索品牌、提取品牌指令，并将品牌声音/语气/指南应用到生成内容。不适用于媒体/图片搜索（使用 searching-media skill）、logo 搜索，或创建新的品牌定义。

description: Write copy following Sentry brand guidelines. Use when writing UI text, error messages, empty states, onboarding flows, 404 pages, documentation, marketing copy, or any user-facing content. Covers both Plain Speech (default) and Sentry Voice tones.
description_zh: 遵循Sentry品牌指南撰写文案。用于撰写UI文本、错误消息、空状态、引导流程、404页面、文档、营销文案或任何面向用户的内容。涵盖Plain Speech（默认）和Sentry Voice两种语气。

description: Corporate due-diligence workflow — resolve a brand or website to its registered legal entity, map group structure and beneficial ownership, profile officers and directors, enumerate the digital estate, and screen litigation, insolvency, procurement, sanctions, PEP and adverse media. Use when asked to check out, vet or research a company, verify a supplier or counterparty before signing or paying, or assess whether a business is real. Applies to vendor and third-party risk, KYC and KYB onboarding, M&A and investor diligence, procurement integrity, and shell-company assessment. Reference at useosint.com/skills/x-ray-a-company.
description_zh:
企业尽职调查流程 — 将品牌或网站追溯至其注册的法律实体，绘制集团结构与受益所有权，梳理高级管理人员和董事的档案信息，清点数字资产，并筛查诉讼、破产、采购、制裁、PEP（政治公众人物）及负面舆情。

当被要求检查、评估或研究一家公司，或需在签署或付款前验证供应商或交易对手，或需评估企业是否真实存在时使用。适用于供应商和第三方风险、KYC（了解你的客户）和KYB（了解你的业务）准入、并购与投资者尽职调查、采购诚信以及壳公司评估。

参考链接：useosint.com/skills/x-ray-a-company。

description: 국민건강보험공단 장기요양기관·건강검진기관을 조회하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 연락·예약 가능 표면까지 이어간다.
description_zh: 国民健康保险公团查询长期照护机构、健康体检机构，并在石碑上延伸至可进行正式联系与预约的展示面。

description: Deploy HTML content to EdgeOne Pages, return the public URL.
description_zh: 将HTML内容部署到EdgeOne Pages，返回公共URL。

description: Use when coordinating project-delivery work across the 8 project-management sub-skills — sprint/velocity analytics, portfolio health, Jira/JQL, Confluence, Atlassian admin, templates, meeting analysis, team comms. Triggers on 'our sprints feel off', 'project health report', 'audit our Jira permissions', 'when will it be done', 'run the delivery loop'. Forks context to route to one sub-skill via a deterministic signal router and returns a digest; can also drive a full goal→plan→execute→verify→close delivery loop through the repo-wide agent-harness with Jira MCP data bridged into the domain's analytics tools. Distinct from product-team (what to build vs how to deliver it), business-operations (internal ops), and engineering/agent-harness (the generic loop engine this orchestrator plugs into).
description_zh:
用于协调涉及8个项目管理子技能（冲刺/速度分析、项目组合健康度、Jira/JQL、Confluence、Atlassian管理、模板、会议分析及团队沟通）的项目交付工作。

触发条件包括“我们的冲刺感觉不对”、“项目健康报告”、“审核我们的Jira权限”、“何时能完成”、“运行交付循环”。其通过确定性的信号路由器将上下文分叉，以路由至对应的子技能并返回摘要；同时，还可通过仓库范围的agent-harness，将Jira MCP数据桥接至领域分析工具，驱动完整的“目标→计划→执行→验证→关闭”交付循环。

与产品团队（构建什么与如何交付）、业务运营（内部运营）以及工程/agent-harness（本协调器插接的通用循环引擎）相互区分。

description: Scaffolds eval.yaml evaluation specs for agent skills in the dotnet/skills repository. Use when creating skill tests, writing evaluation stimuli, defining graders and rubrics, sizing an eval for statistical power, or setting up test fixture files. Handles the Vally eval.yaml schema, fixture organization, and overfitting avoidance. Do not use for running or debugging existing evals (use improve-skill-quality) nor for skills authoring (use create-skill).
description_zh: 在 dotnet/skills 代码仓库中，为智能体技能构建 eval.yaml 评估规范。在创建技能测试、编写评估刺激、定义评分员与评分标准、为评估确定统计功效或设置测试夹具文件时使用。处理 Vally eval.yaml 模式、测试夹具组织及防止过拟合。不得用于运行或调试现有评估（请使用 improve-skill-quality），也不用于技能编写（请使用 create-skill）。

description: Help users qualify sales leads effectively. Use when someone is wasting time on bad leads, struggling with low conversion rates, needs to build a qualification framework, or wants to improve their discovery process.
description_zh: 帮助用户有效完成销售线索的资质审核。适用于在无效线索上浪费时间、面临低转化率困扰、需要建立资质框架或希望改进线索挖掘流程的情况。

description: Migrate Dynatrace classic and Gen2 entity-based DQL to Smartscape equivalents. Covers three scenarios. (1) mass data queries filtered by classic entity conditions — migrate to direct dimension filters first, Smartscape only as fallback; (2) mass data queries using entity subqueries for filtering — same dimension-first strategy; (3) pure entity list queries — migrate fetch dt.entity.* to smartscapeNodes. Also handles entityName, entityAttr, classicEntitySelector, and classic relationship patterns.
description_zh:
将 Dynatrace 经典版和 Gen2 实体版 DQL 迁移至 Smartscape 的等价实现。覆盖三种场景：
（1）基于经典实体条件过滤的批量数据查询——先迁移至直接维度过滤，Smartscape 仅作为备选方案；
（2）使用实体子查询进行过滤的批量数据查询——采用相同的“先维度、后实体”策略；
（3）纯实体列表查询——将 fetch dt.entity.* 迁移至 smartscapeNodes。
此外，还处理 entityName、entityAttr、classicEntitySelector 以及经典关系模式。

description: BullMQ expert for Redis-backed job queues, background processing, and reliable async execution in Node.js/TypeScript applications.
description_zh: BullMQ 专家，专注于基于 Redis 的任务队列、后台处理，以及 Node.js/TypeScript 应用中的可靠异步执行。

description: Evaluate an AI product idea across outcomes, hypotheses, risks, and positioning. Use when deciding whether an AI solution deserves investment or recommendation.
description_zh: 从成果、假设、风险与定位等方面评估AI产品构想。适用于判断AI解决方案是否值得投资或推荐。

description: Blender MCP expert for scene inspection, Python scripting, GLTF export, and material/animation extraction. Activate when: (1) using Blender MCP tools (get_scene_info, execute_python, screenshot, etc.), (2) writing Blender Python scripts for extraction or manipulation, (3) exporting scenes to GLTF/GLB for web (Three.js, R3F), (4) debugging material or texture export losses, (5) optimizing GLB files with gltf-transform, (6) using asset integrations (PolyHaven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D Rodin, Hunyuan3D). Covers critical export gotchas, material mapping survival, texture optimization pipeline, headless CLI patterns, and known failure modes.
description_zh: Blender MCP 专家，擅长场景检视、Python 脚本编程、GLTF 导出以及材质/动画提取。激活条件包括：(1) 使用 Blender MCP 工具（如 get_scene_info、execute_python、screenshot 等）；(2) 编写用于提取或处理的 Blender Python 脚本；(3) 将场景导出为 GLTF/GLB 以供网页（Three.js、R3F）使用；(4) 排查材质或纹理导出损失问题；(5) 使用 gltf-transform 优化 GLB 文件；(6) 使用资产集成（PolyHaven、Sketchfab、Hyper3D Rodin、Hunyuan3D）。涵盖关键导出陷阱、材质映射保持有效、纹理优化流程、无头 CLI 模式及已知故障模式。

description: Creates .NET projects from templates with validated parameters, smart defaults, Central Package Management adaptation, and latest NuGet version resolution. USE FOR: creating new dotnet projects, scaffolding solutions with multiple projects, installing or uninstalling template packages, creating projects that respect Directory.Packages.props (CPM), composing multi-project solutions (API + tests + library), getting latest NuGet package versions in newly created projects. DO NOT USE FOR: finding templates (use template-discovery), producing a detailed side-by-side comparison of templates (use template-comparison), authoring custom templates (use template-authoring), deciding cross-parameter defaults such as which framework to pair with native AOT or whether to keep HTTPS when auth is enabled (use template-smart-defaults), modifying existing projects or adding NuGet packages to existing projects.
description_zh:
从模板创建 .NET 项目，支持经过校验的参数、智能默认值、中央包管理适配及最新 NuGet 版本解析。

用途：创建新的 dotnet 项目，为包含多个项目的解决方案进行脚手架搭建，安装或卸载模板包，创建遵循 Directory.Packages.props（CPM）的项目，构建多项目解决方案（API + 测试 + 库），在新创建的项目中获取最新 NuGet 包版本。

请勿使用：查找模板（使用 template-discovery），生成模板的详细逐项对比（使用 template-comparison），编写自定义模板（使用 template-authoring），确定跨参数默认值，例如将哪种框架与原生 AOT 搭配，或在启用身份验证时是否保留 HTTPS（使用 template-smart-defaults），修改现有项目或将 NuGet 包添加到现有项目中。

description: Audits existing tests in any language using formal, research-backed test smell names and the testsmells.org 19-smell academic taxonomy. Use when the caller asks for an academic or citable test-smell review, named smell categories, or a formal severity-ranked smell assessment. Covers Assertion Roulette, Conditional Test Logic, Mystery Guest, Eager Test, Sleepy Test, Unknown Test, Sensitive Equality, and the rest of the catalog across .NET, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, Ruby, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, PowerShell, and C++. DO NOT USE FOR a quick pragmatic test review (use test-anti-patterns), writing or running tests, framework migration, coverage, or assertion-diversity metrics.
description_zh: 对任意语言的现有测试进行审计，使用正式且有研究支撑的测试异味名称以及 testsmells.org 的 19 种异味学术分类。当调用者要求进行学术性或可引用的测试异味审查、指定异味类别，或正式的按严重程度排序的异味评估时使用。涵盖 Assertion Roulette（断言轮盘）、Conditional Test Logic（条件测试逻辑）、Mystery Guest（神秘客人）、Eager Test（急切测试）、Sleepy Test（迟钝测试）、Unknown Test（未知测试）、Sensitive Equality（敏感相等性），以及 .NET、Python、JavaScript/TypeScript、Java、Go、Ruby、Rust、Swift、Kotlin、PowerShell 和 C++ 的其余目录内容。不得用于快速务实的测试审查（使用测试反模式）、编写或运行测试、框架迁移、覆盖率或断言多样性指标。

description: Analyze a project description or site requirements and synthesize a project constitution into SITE.md for the Stitch Build Loop
description_zh: 分析项目描述或网站要求，并综合形成项目章程，写入SITE.md用于Stitch Build Loop

description: Generates valid PromQL queries from Cloud Monitoring metric descriptors and resource parameters. Use when asked to create, generate, write, or format PromQL queries, PromQL strings, or PromQL aggregations for Cloud Monitoring metrics and resources. Don't use for raw metric discovery or metric selection.
description_zh: 从 Cloud Monitoring 指标描述符和资源参数生成有效的 PromQL 查询。当被要求为 Cloud Monitoring 指标和资源创建、生成、编写或格式化 PromQL 查询、PromQL 字符串或 PromQL 聚合时使用。不得用于原始指标发现或指标选择。

description: KOPIS 공연 목록·상세·시설을 조회한다. 조회 전용.
description_zh: 查询 KOPIS 演出列表、详情、设施。仅查询。

description: Binance Alpha request using the Binance API. Authentication requires API key and secret key.
description_zh: 使用 Binance API 发起 Binance Alpha 请求。身份验证需要 API 密钥和 Secret Key。

description: Make websites accessible for AI agents. Navigate, click, type, extract, wait — using Chrome with existing login sessions. No LLM API key needed.
description_zh: 让网站对AI智能体变得可访问。利用Chrome浏览器及现有的登录会话完成导航、点击、输入、提取、等待操作。无需LLM API密钥。

description: Pre-migration readiness assessor for porting NumPy to cuPyNumeric. Use BEFORE substantial porting work begins when the user asks whether code will scale on GPU, whether they should migrate to cuPyNumeric, which NumPy patterns transfer cleanly, what must be refactored before porting, or mentions pre-port assessment, scaling analysis, or refactor planning. Inspect the user's source code, look up NumPy usage, cross-reference the cuPyNumeric API support manifest, and distinguish distributed-scaling-friendly patterns from blockers such as unsupported APIs, scalar synchronization, host round-trips, Python/object-heavy control flow, shape/data-dependent branching, and in-place mutation hazards. Produce a verdict of READY, LIGHT REFACTOR, SIGNIFICANT REFACTOR, or NOT RECOMMENDED, with concrete refactor pointers.
description_zh: 将 NumPy 迁移至 cuPyNumeric 的迁移前就绪性评估者。在开始实质性迁移工作之前使用，适用于用户询问代码是否能在 GPU 上扩展、是否应迁移至 cuPyNumeric、哪些 NumPy 模式能够顺利迁移、迁移前需要重构什么，或提及迁移前评估、扩展性分析或重构规划时使用。检查用户源代码，查询 NumPy 使用方式，对照 cuPyNumeric API 支持清单进行交叉核对，并区分有利于分布式扩展的模式与阻碍，如不受支持的 API、标量同步、主机往返、Python/对象密集控制流、依据形状/数据依赖的分支，以及就地修改风险。输出 READY、LIGHT REFACTOR、SIGNIFICANT REFACTOR 或 NOT RECOMMENDED 的结论，并提供具体的重构指引。

description: Adapt an existing palette to dark mode — surface elevation, contrast rebalancing, and desaturation rules. Use when you already have a light palette to translate. For building the base palette first, use `color-system`.
description_zh: 将现有调色板适配为深色模式——表面层级调整、对比度平衡及去饱和规则。当您已有需要转换的浅色调色板时使用。若要首先构建基础调色板，请使用 `color-system`。

description: .NET MAUI app lifecycle guidance — the four app states, cross-platform Window lifecycle events (Created, Activated, Deactivated, Stopped, Resumed, Destroying), platform-specific lifecycle mapping, backgrounding and resume behavior, and state-preservation patterns. USE FOR: "app lifecycle", "window lifecycle events", "save state on background", "resume app", "OnStopped", "OnResumed", "backgrounding", "deactivated event", "ConfigureLifecycleEvents", "platform lifecycle hooks". DO NOT USE FOR: navigation events (use maui-shell-navigation), dependency injection setup (use maui-dependency-injection), platform API invocation (use conditional compilation and partial classes).
description_zh: .NET MAUI 应用生命周期指南——四种应用状态、跨平台窗口生命周期事件（Created、Activated、Deactivated、Stopped、Resumed、Destroying）、平台特定的生命周期映射、后台挂起与恢复行为，以及状态保持模式。适用场景："app lifecycle"、"window lifecycle events"、"save state on background"、"resume app"、"OnStopped"、"OnResumed"、"backgrounding"、"deactivated event"、"ConfigureLifecycleEvents"、"platform lifecycle hooks"。不适用场景："navigation events"（使用 maui-shell-navigation）、"dependency injection setup"（使用 maui-dependency-injection）、"platform API invocation"（使用条件编译和部分类）。

description: Build, fix, review, and validate adaptive or responsive Flutter UIs for mobile, tablet, desktop, web, large screens, foldables, and mixed input devices. Use when creating breakpoint-driven layouts, responsive navigation, adaptive dialogs/lists/grids, keyboard/mouse/touch behavior, window-size decisions with MediaQuery or LayoutBuilder, or Capability and Policy patterns for platform-specific behavior.
description_zh: 构建、修复、审查并验证针对移动端、平板、桌面端、网页、大屏幕、折叠屏及混合输入设备的自适应或响应式 Flutter 界面。适用于创建基于断点的布局、响应式导航、自适应对话框/列表/网格、键盘/鼠标/触摸行为，使用 MediaQuery 或 LayoutBuilder 进行窗口尺寸决策，或应用能力与策略模式实现平台特定行为。

description: Use autocli CLI to interact with 55+ social/content websites (HackerNews, Reddit, Twitter/X, Bilibili, Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, YouTube, Medium, Substack, Douban, WeRead, Linux-do, V2EX, Bloomberg, Google, Arxiv, Wikipedia, StackOverflow, Steam, Hugging Face, Apple Podcasts, Xiaoyuzhou, BBC, SinaFinance, DevTo, Lobsters, Xueqiu, BOSS直聘, Jike, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reuters, SMZDM, Ctrip, Coupang, Yahoo Finance, Barchart, Grok, Jimeng, Yollomi, Chaoxing, Weixin, Doubao, Cursor, Codex, ChatWise, ChatGPT, Notion, Discord, Antigravity etc.) via the user's Chrome login session. ALWAYS prefer autocli over playwright/browser automation for supported sites. Triggers when user asks to browse, search, fetch hot/trending content, post, or read messages on any website; also use 'autocli read <url>' to extract main article content as Markdown (prefer over WebFetch for JS-rendered or login-gated pages).
description_zh: 使用 autocli CLI 通过用户的 Chrome 登录会话，与 55+ 个社交/内容网站（HackerNews、Reddit、Twitter/X、Bilibili、知乎、微博、小红书、YouTube、Medium、Substack、豆瓣、微信读书、Linux.do、V2EX、Bloomberg、Google、arXiv、维基百科、Stack Overflow、Steam、Hugging Face、Apple Podcasts、小宇宙、BBC、新浪财经、DevTo、Lobsters、雪球、BOSS直聘、极客、Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn、路透社、SMZDM、携程、Coupang、Yahoo Finance、Barchart、Grok、即梦、Yollomi、超星、微信、豆包、Cursor、Codex、ChatWise、ChatGPT、Notion、Discord、Antigravity 等）进行交互。对于受支持网站，始终优先使用 autocli，而非 playwright/浏览器自动化。当用户要求在任何网站上进行浏览、搜索、获取热门/趋势内容、发布或阅读消息时触发；并使用 'autocli read <url>' 将主要文章内容提取为 Markdown（对于 JS 渲染或登录受限页面，优先于 WebFetch）。

description: Use when creating After Effects compositions, Premiere Pro motion, video titles, explainer videos, or broadcast motion graphics.
description_zh: 用于创建 After Effects 合成、Premiere Pro 动态、视频标题、讲解视频或广播动态图形。

description: Create a fresh branch, complete work, and open a pull request
description_zh: 创建新分支，完成工作，并提交 Pull 请求。

description: Guides users through discovering their database requirements, recommends a Google Cloud database based on a recommendation matrix, and assists in database creation. Use when a user asks 'What database service should I use?', 'Help me pick a database', or when a user wants to create a new database on Google Cloud. Don't use for general Google Cloud maintenance, managing existing databases, or database migrations.
description_zh: 引导用户发现其数据库需求，基于推荐矩阵推荐 Google Cloud 数据库，并协助数据库创建。当用户询问"我应该使用哪种数据库服务？"、"帮我选择合适的数据库"，或用户希望在 Google Cloud 上创建新数据库时使用。不适用于通用 Google Cloud 维护、管理现有数据库或数据库迁移。

description: Use the Helmor CLI to remote-control Helmor from the terminal. Use when the user asks to inspect Helmor data/settings, manage repositories/workspaces/sessions/files, send prompts to agents, list models, use GitHub integration, inspect scripts, run Helmor as an MCP server, generate shell completions, quit a running app, check/install/update the Helmor CLI beta, install/update Helmor skills through the beta app flow, or needs the Helmor command reference. Also plan and build a large change as a stack of dependent PRs (`/helmor-cli stack`), split a change you've already written into a stack (`/helmor-cli break`), and re-sync a stack after lower layers change or merge (`/helmor-cli restack`).
description_zh: 使用 Helmor CLI 在终端中远程控制 Helmor。当用户要求检查 Helmor 数据/设置、管理仓库/工作区/会话/文件、向代理发送提示、列出模型、使用 GitHub 集成、检查脚本、以 MCP 服务器模式运行 Helmor、生成 shell 补全、退出正在运行的应用、检查/安装/更新 Helmor CLI beta、通过 beta 应用流程安装/更新 Helmor 技能，或需要 Helmor 命令参考时，使用 Helmor CLI。此外，还可以作为一组相互依赖的 PR（`/helmor-cli stack`）规划和构建大型更改；将已完成的更改分割为堆栈（`/helmor-cli break`）；以及在底层发生更改或合并后重新同步堆栈（`/helmor-cli restack`）。

description: 공공데이터포털 WHOIS 도메인/IP 정보 API를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 호출해 .kr/.한국 도메인, IP 주소, AS 번호의 공개 등록정보를 조회한다. 조회 전용. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 调用公共数据门户 WHOIS 域名/IP 信息 API，查询 .kr/.韩国域名、IP 地址、AS 号码的公开注册信息。查询专用。在 돌쇠 中，会执行通过官方表面进行的后续操作。

description: Use when planning, debugging, tuning, evaluating, exporting, or deploying public Nemotron `embed`/`rerank` retrieval recipes.
description_zh: 在规划、调试、调优、评估、导出或部署公开 Nemotron `embed`/`rerank` 检索配方时使用。

description: Memory is the cornerstone of intelligent agents. Without it, every interaction starts from zero. This skill covers the architecture of agent memory: short-term (context window), long-term (vector stores), and the cognitive architectures that organize them.
description_zh: 记忆是智能体的基石。没有它，每一次交互都从零开始。本技能涵盖智能体记忆的架构：短期（上下文窗口）、长期（向量存储），以及用于组织它们的认知架构。

description: Define a Proof of Life probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply. Use when you need harsh truth before building real product.
description_zh: 定义一个生命证明探针，用于以低成本测试一个有风险的假设。在构建真实产品之前，当你需要铁证如山的真相时使用。

description: Queries and retrieves active security findings, external exposures, toxic combinations, vulnerabilities, threats, and sensitive data risks from Google Cloud Security Command Center. Use when retrieving details for a security finding by its name, validating finding scope (e.g., verifying findingClass is TOXIC_COMBINATION, VULNERABILITY, EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE, or THREAT), or fetching finding details for triage. Don't use to draft remediations, apply patches, or execute configurations.
description_zh: 从 Google Cloud 安全指挥中心查询和检索活跃安全发现、外部暴露、有毒组合、漏洞、威胁及敏感数据风险。用于通过名称检索安全发现详细信息、验证发现范围（例如，验证 findingClass 是否为 TOXIC_COMBINATION、VULNERABILITY、EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE 或 THREAT），或获取发现详细信息以进行分诊。勿用于草拟修复方案、应用补丁或执行配置。

description: 강남언니 공개 검색 페이지에서 성형외과·피부과 병원 후보, 평점, 리뷰 수, 지원 언어, 공개 병원 링크를 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在江南姐姐公开搜索页面中，可查询整形外科·皮肤科医院候选、平均分、评论数、申请语言及公开医院链接。在돌쇠中，将推进包括通过官方界面进行的后续行动。

description: Routes NVIDIA Nemotron Speech (Formerly Riva) NIM tasks — deploys, runs, and tests ASR, TTS, and NMT NIMs on build.nvidia.com or self-hosted.
description_zh: 路由 NVIDIA Nemotron Speech（前身为 Riva）NIM 任务——在 build.nvidia.com 或自托管环境中部署、运行和测试 ASR、TTS 和 NMT NIM。

description: Automatically add PostHog analytics instrumentation to code. Triggers when user asks to add tracking, instrument events, add analytics, or implement feature flags in their codebase.
description_zh: 自动将 PostHog 分析埋点集成到代码中。当用户要求在其代码库中添加跟踪、对事件进行埋点、添加分析或实现功能开关时触发。

description: Review dependency PRs with structured research, existing-PR-discussion capture, multi-lens analysis (security, code quality, impact), and a repeatable verdict template. USE FOR: dependency update PRs, Renovate/Dependabot PRs, library upgrade reviews, "review this dependency PR", "should we merge this update". DO NOT USE FOR: feature PRs, application code reviews, dependency automation/bot configuration, or unattended merge without confirmation.
description_zh: 通过结构化研究、已有PR讨论内容记录、多维度分析（安全、代码质量、影响）及可重复使用的判定模板，审查依赖PR。适用场景：依赖更新PR、Renovate/Dependabot PR、库升级审查、“审查此依赖PR”、“是否应该合并此更新”。不适用场景：功能PR、应用代码审查、依赖自动化/机器人配置，或未经确认的无人合并。

description: When the user wants to plan a posting schedule, create a content calendar, or organize when and what to post. Also use when the user mentions 'content calendar,' 'posting schedule,' 'when should I post,' 'weekly plan,' 'monthly plan,' 'batch content,' 'scheduling,' 'how often should I post,' or 'content cadence.' For deciding what topics to cover, see content-strategy-sms. For writing the actual posts, see post-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要规划发布日程、创建内容日历，或组织何时发布什么内容时，使用相应功能。当用户提到“内容日历”、“发布日程”、“何时发布”、“每周计划”、“每月计划”、“批量内容”、“排期”、“多久发布一次”或“内容节奏”时，也使用相应功能。若要决定涵盖哪些主题，请参见 content-strategy-sms。若要撰写实际帖子，请参见 post-writer-sms。

description: Work with Notion from the terminal using the `notion` CLI. Use when the user needs to read, create, update, query, or manage Notion pages, databases, blocks, comments, users, or files programmatically. Covers the entire Notion API with 50+ commands. Triggers: Notion workspace automation, database queries, page creation, block manipulation, comment threads, file uploads, relation management, database export, multi-workspace management, or any Notion API interaction from the command line.
description_zh: 使用 `notion` CLI 从终端与 Notion 协作。当用户需要以编程方式读取、创建、更新、查询或管理 Notion 页面、数据库、块、评论、用户或文件时使用。覆盖完整的 Notion API，包含 50 余条命令。触发场景：Notion 工作区自动化、数据库查询、页面创建、块操作、评论线程、文件上传、关系管理、数据库导出、多工作区管理，或通过命令行进行任何 Notion API 交互。

description: Conduct comprehensive, systematic literature reviews using multiple academic databases (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar, etc.). This skill should be used when conducting systematic literature reviews, meta-analyses, research synthesis, or comprehensive literature searches across biomedical, scientific, and technical domains. Creates professionally formatted markdown documents and PDFs with verified citations in multiple citation styles (APA, Nature, Vancouver, etc.).
description_zh: 通过多个学术数据库（PubMed、arXiv、bioRxiv、Semantic Scholar 等）开展全面、系统性的文献综述。本技能适用于开展系统文献综述、meta 分析、研究综合，或跨生物医学、科学和技术领域进行全面文献检索。生成专业格式化的 Markdown 文档和 PDF，并带有经核验的多引用格式（APA、Nature、Vancouver 等）引用。

description: Select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe based on hypothesis, risk, and resources. Use this to match the validation method to the real learning goal, not tooling comfort.
description_zh: 根据假设、风险与资源，选择合适的 Proof of Life (PoL) 探针。以此将验证方法与实际学习目标相匹配，而非工具使用的舒适度。

description: Page transitions library for creating fluid, smooth transitions between website pages. Use this skill when implementing page transitions, creating SPA-like experiences, adding animated route changes, or building websites with smooth navigation. Triggers on tasks involving Barba.js, page transitions, routing, view management, transition hooks, GSAP integration, or smooth page navigation. Works with gsap-scrolltrigger for transition animations.
description_zh: 用于在网页页面间创建流畅、平滑转场的页面过渡库。在实现页面过渡、打造类单页应用（SPA）体验、添加动画路由切换，或构建具备流畅导航功能的网站时，使用此技能。适用于涉及 Barba.js、页面过渡、路由、视图管理、过渡钩子、GSAP 集成或页面流畅导航的任务。可与 gsap-scrolltrigger 协同工作，用于转场动画。

description: Create, synthesize, and iteratively improve agent skills following the Agent Skills specification. Use when asked to "create a skill", "write a skill", "synthesize sources into a skill", "improve a skill from positive/negative examples", "update a skill", or "maintain skill docs and registration". Handles source capture, precision passes, authoring, registration, and validation.
description_zh: 遵循Agent技能规范，创建、综合并迭代改进智能体技能。当被要求"创建技能"、"编写技能"、"将来源素材综合为技能"、"基于正面和负面示例改进技能"、"更新技能"或"维护技能文档与注册信息"时使用。处理来源采集、精确校验、编写、注册及验证工作。

description: Formal mathematical reasoning for research papers — derive equations, write proofs, formalize problem settings, select statistical tests, and generate LaTeX math notation. Use when the user needs mathematical derivations, theorem proofs, notation tables, or statistical analysis formalization.
description_zh: 学术论文的正式数学推理 —— 推导方程、撰写证明、形式化问题设定、选择统计检验，并生成LaTeX数学记法。当用户需要数学推导、定理证明、符号表格或统计分析形式化时使用。

description: Core skill for the deep research and writing tool. Write scientific manuscripts in full paragraphs (never bullet points). Use two-stage process: (1) create section outlines with key points using research-lookup, (2) convert to flowing prose. IMRAD structure, citations (APA/AMA/Vancouver), figures/tables, reporting guidelines (CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA), for research papers and journal submissions.
description_zh: 深度研究与写作工具的核心技能。以完整段落撰写科学文稿（严禁使用项目符号）。采用两阶段处理流程：(1) 利用文献检索功能创建包含要点的章节大纲；(2) 将内容转化为流畅的叙述文。涵盖研究论文和期刊投稿所需的 IMRAD 结构、参考文献（APA/AMA/Vancouver）、图表，以及报告指南（CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA）。

description: Use this skill when the user explicitly asks to map, document, or onboard into an existing codebase. Trigger for prompts like "map this codebase", "document this architecture", "onboard me to this repo", or "create codebase docs". Do not trigger for routine feature implementation, bug fixes, or narrow code edits unless the user asks for repository-level discovery.
description_zh: 当用户明确要求映射、文档化或接入现有代码库时，使用此技能。以下提示词即为触发条件，例如：“映射此代码库”、“文档化此架构”、“将我接入此代码仓库”或“创建代码库文档”。对于常规功能实现、Bug 修复或范围狭窄的代码修改，除非用户要求进行仓库级探查，否则不触发此技能。

description: Guide for using ty, the extremely fast Python type checker and language server. Use this when type checking Python code or setting up type checking in Python projects.
description_zh: ty 使用指南：ty 是一款极其快速的 Python 类型检查器和语言服务器。当需要对 Python 代码进行类型检查，或在 Python 项目中设置类型检查时，使用本指南。

description: MUST be used whenever reviewing a Flows app for code quality, maintainability, or clean code issues — before a PR review, after a feature is complete, or when the user asks for a code review. Do NOT skip linting steps. Triggers: code quality, code review, clean code, refactor, maintainability, technical debt, any type, naming, dead code, duplication, DRY, single responsibility, component size, lint, linting, TypeScript strict, dependency injection, file structure.
description_zh:
在审查 Flows 应用的代码质量、可维护性或清洁代码问题时，必须使用。在 PR 评审前、功能开发完成后，或当用户要求代码评审时，均需使用。请勿跳过 linting 步骤。

触发条件：代码质量、代码评审、清洁代码、重构、可维护性、技术债务、任何类型、命名、死代码、重复、DRY、单一职责、组件大小、lint、linting、TypeScript 严格模式、依赖注入、文件结构。

description: Debug failing Power Automate cloud flows using the FlowStudio MCP server. The Graph API only shows top-level status codes. This skill gives your agent action-level inputs and outputs to find the actual root cause. Load this skill when asked to: debug a flow, investigate a failed run, why is this flow failing, inspect action outputs, find the root cause of a flow error, fix a broken Power Automate flow, diagnose a timeout, trace a DynamicOperationRequestFailure, check connector auth errors, read error details from a run, or troubleshoot expression failures. Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription — see https://mcp.flowstudio.app
description_zh: 使用 FlowStudio MCP 服务器调试失败的 Power Automate 云流程。Graph API 仅显示顶层状态码。此技能为您的代理提供操作级别的输入和输出，以便查找实际根本原因。当需要调试流程、调查失败的运行、了解流程为何失败、检查操作输出、查找流程错误的根本原因、修复损坏的 Power Automate 流程、诊断超时、追踪 DynamicOperationRequestFailure、检查连接器认证错误、阅读运行错误详情或排查表达式失败问题时，请加载此技能。需要 FlowStudio MCP 订阅——参见 https://mcp.flowstudio.app

description:
Backtest crypto and traditional trading strategies against historical data.
Calculates performance metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown), generates equity curves,
and optimizes strategy parameters. Use when user wants to test a trading strategy,
validate signals, or compare approaches.
Trigger with phrases like "backtest strategy", "test trading strategy", "historical performance",
"simulate trades", "optimize parameters", or "validate signals".
description_zh:
基于历史数据，回测加密货币与传统交易策略。
计算绩效指标（夏普比率、索提诺比率、最大回撤），生成权益曲线，并优化策略参数。当用户需要测试交易策略、验证信号或比较方法时使用。
使用类似“回测策略”、“测试交易策略”、“历史表现”、“模拟交易”、“优化参数”或“验证信号”等短语触发。

description: Use when the user wants Codex to build, refine, test, validate, or list CLI-Anything harnesses for GUI applications or source repositories. Adapts the full CLI-Anything methodology to Codex without changing the generated Python harness format.
description_zh: 当用户需要 Codex 为 GUI 应用程序或源代码仓库构建、优化、测试、验证或列出 CLI-Anything 工具时使用。它将完整的 CLI-Anything 方法论适配到 Codex，同时不改变生成的 Python 工具格式。

description: INVOKE THIS SKILL for Arize Prompt Hub and `ax prompts` workflows: author or import templates and save (Workflows A–B), label/promote (C), or list/get/edit/delete/duplicate (D). Use when the user mentions ax prompts, Prompt Hub, creating/editing/saving a prompt, `{variable}` placeholders, or production/staging labels. For improving prompt text using traces or eval scores, use arize-prompt-optimization. For running experiments, use arize-experiment.
description_zh: 调用此技能用于 Arize Prompt Hub 和 `ax prompts` 工作流：编写或导入模板并保存（工作流 A–B）、标记/提升（C），或列出/获取/编辑/删除/复制（D）。当用户提及 ax prompts、Prompt Hub、创建/编辑/保存提示、`{变量}` 占位符或生产/预发布标签时使用。使用 traces 或 eval scores 优化提示文本时，请使用 arize-prompt-optimization。运行实验时，请使用 arize-experiment。

description: The entry point for Intent, a UX and design strategy system. Sets project context, routes to specialized skills, and loads foundational UX knowledge. Activate when starting any UX or product design work, setting project context, routing to other skills, evaluating an existing product's UX, or when the user asks about design intent, user experience strategy, ethical design, dark patterns, or design systems thinking.
description_zh: 意图（Intent）的入口，属于用户体验与设计策略系统。用于设置项目上下文，路由至专项技能，并加载基础用户体验知识。在开始任何用户体验或产品设计工作、设定项目上下文、路由至其他技能、评估现有产品的用户体验，或用户询问设计意图、用户体验策略、伦理设计、暗黑模式或设计系统思维时，激活此入口。

description: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Python. Use when the user asks about Genkit, AI agents, flows, or tools in Python, or when encountering Genkit errors, import issues, or API problems.
description_zh: 使用 Genkit 在 Python 中开发 AI 驱动的应用程序。当用户询问 Genkit、AI 智能体、流或 Python 中的工具，或遇到 Genkit 错误、导入问题或 API 问题时使用。

description: Symbolicate the .NET runtime frames in an Android tombstone file. Extracts BuildIds and PC offsets from the native backtrace, downloads debug symbols from the Microsoft symbol server, and runs llvm-symbolizer to produce function names with source file and line numbers. USE FOR triaging a .NET MAUI or Mono Android app crash from a tombstone, resolving native backtrace frames in libmonosgen-2.0.so or libcoreclr.so to .NET runtime source code, or investigating SIGABRT, SIGSEGV, or other native signals originating from the .NET runtime on Android. DO NOT USE FOR pure Java/Kotlin crashes, managed .NET exceptions that are already captured in logcat, or iOS crash logs. INVOKES Symbolicate-Tombstone.ps1 script, llvm-symbolizer, Microsoft symbol server.
description_zh:
在 Android 墓碑文件中对 .NET 运行时帧进行符号化。从原生回溯信息中提取 BuildId 和 PC 偏移量，从微软符号服务器下载调试符号，并运行 llvm-symbolizer 以生成带有源文件和行号的函数名。

用途：从墓碑文件排查 .NET MAUI 或 Mono Android 应用的崩溃问题，将 libmonosgen-2.0.so 或 libcoreclr.so 中原生回溯栈的帧解析至 .NET 运行时源代码，或调查源自 Android 平台上 .NET 运行时的 SIGABRT、SIGSEGV 及其他原生信号。

不适用于纯 Java/Kotlin 崩溃、已在 logcat 中捕获的托管 .NET 异常，或 iOS 崩溃日志。

调用 Symbolicate-Tombstone.ps1 脚本、llvm-symbolizer 与微软符号服务器。

description: Reduces JavaScript dependency footprint with pnpm while preserving lockfile, workspace layout, and dependency range style. Runs /check-npm first, then removes unused deps, dedupes versions, ranks transitive closure, and reports Keep/Replace/Remove triage. Use when cleaning up pnpm dependencies, reducing lockfile size, or shrinking node_modules in Grafana plugins; not for Go modules or full GitHub Actions workflow audits.
description_zh: 使用 pnpm 可在保持 lockfile、workspace 布局和依赖范围样式的同时，减小 JavaScript 依赖足迹。首先运行 /check-npm，然后移除未使用的依赖、去重版本、对传递闭包进行排序，并报告 Keep/Replace/Remove 分类。在清理 pnpm 依赖、减小 lockfile 大小或缩小 Grafana 插件中的 node_modules 时使用；不适用于 Go 模块或完整的 GitHub Actions 工作流审计。

description: Structure information so people can find what they need, understand where they are, and navigate confidently. Covers navigation pattern design, taxonomy, labeling systems, search and browse strategy, wayfinding, and IA research methods. Trigger when designing navigation structures, categorization schemes, site maps, taxonomies, labeling systems, search experiences, or asking "how should we organize this?" Also trigger for card sorting, tree testing, information findability problems, or when users report they can't find things. Use this skill any time the structural organization of information is the problem — not the flow through it, not the words in it, not the visual presentation of it.
description_zh: 将信息结构组织得使人能够找到所需内容、明确自身所处位置，并自信地进行导航。涵盖导航模式设计、分类体系、标注体系、搜索与浏览策略、寻路引导以及用户体验（IA）研究方法。在设计与导航结构、分类方案、站点地图、分类体系、标注体系、搜索体验，或提出“我们该如何组织这些信息？”等场景时触发。在卡片排序、树状测试、信息可发现性问题的排查，或用户反馈无法找到相关内容时亦应触发。当问题的核心在于信息的结构化组织时，即可使用本技能——而非信息的流程推进、内容用词，亦非其视觉呈现。

description: Audit a JavaScript/TypeScript repo's npm, yarn, or pnpm configuration for supply-chain hardening: tool version, lifecycle scripts, unsafe dependency protocols, and minimum release age ≥3 days. Use when the user invokes /check-npm or asks to audit package manager security, lifecycle scripts, git dependencies, ignore-scripts, min-release-age, allow-git, approvedGitRepositories, strictDepBuilds, or blockExoticSubdeps in a Grafana plugin or JS/TS project.
description_zh: 审计 JavaScript/TypeScript 仓库的 npm、yarn 或 pnpm 配置，以进行供应链加固，包括工具版本、生命周期脚本、不安全的依赖协议以及最小发布年龄≥3天。当用户在 Grafana 插件或 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目中调用 /check-npm 命令，或请求审计包管理器安全、生命周期脚本、git 依赖、忽略脚本、最小发布年龄、允许 git、已批准 Git 仓库、严格依赖构建或阻止奇特子依赖等内容时使用。

description: Complete, populate and fill out 3-statement financial model templates (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) . Use when asked to fill out model templates, complete existing model frameworks, populate financial models with data, complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework, or link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure. Triggers include requests to fill in, complete, or populate a 3-statement model template
description_zh: 完成、填充并填写三张报表财务模型模板（利润表、资产负债表、现金流量表）。当被要求填写模型模板、完成现有模型框架、向财务模型填入数据、完成部分已填写的利润表/资产负债表/现金流量表框架，或在现有模板结构内链接综合财务报表时使用。触发条件包括要求填写、完成或填充三张报表模型模板的请求。

description: Motion-design follow-up skill inspired by Emil Kowalski's animation guidance. Use after an interface exists to add tasteful micro-interactions, state transitions, and page motion with product-grade restraint.
description_zh: 受 Emil Kowalski 动画指导启发的动态设计后续技能。在界面已构建完成后使用，以产品级克制的标准，添加精致的微交互、状态转换与页面动效。

description: Extend Pydantic AI agents with batteries-included capabilities from pydantic-ai-harness -- Code Mode (collapse many tool calls into one sandboxed Python execution), a filesystem and shell, sub-agents, planning, context compaction, and more. Use when the user mentions pydantic-ai-harness, CodeMode, Monty, code mode, or tool sandboxing, when they want first-party filesystem/shell/sub-agent/planning/compaction capabilities for a Pydantic AI agent, when they want an agent to run agent-written Python, or when a Pydantic AI agent would benefit from orchestrating multiple tool calls in a single sandboxed script.
description_zh: 将开箱即用的 pydantic-ai-harness 能力扩展至 Pydantic AI 代理 —— Code Mode（将多次工具调用合并为一次沙盒化的 Python 执行）、文件系统与 Shell、子代理、规划、上下文压缩等。当用户提及 pydantic-ai-harness、CodeMode、Monty、code mode 或工具沙盒时使用；当需要为 Pydantic AI 代理提供第一方文件系统/Shell/子代理/规划/压缩能力时使用；当希望代理运行由代理编写的 Python 时使用；或当 Pydantic AI 代理能从在单个沙盒脚本中协调多次工具调用中受益时使用。

description: Use this skill before answering, planning, or editing whenever .NET tests or CI are switching from VSTest to Microsoft.Testing.Platform (MTP), or an MTP migration behaves differently. Triggers include "switch from VSTest"; MSTest/NUnit/xUnit MTP enablement; OutputType=Exe only for test projects in Directory.Build.props; EnableMSTestRunner, EnableNUnitRunner, UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner, or YTest.MTP.XUnit2; .NET 10 global.json test.runner and TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport; translating VSTest filters, logger, coverage, blame, or dump arguments; replacing VSTest@3; and exit code 8 or zero tests. Also use for xUnit v3 MTP filters during a v2-to-v3 upgrade. Do not use for framework conversion, TFM, UWP, or WinUI.
description_zh: 在 .NET 测试或 CI 从 VSTest 切换至 Microsoft.Testing.Platform（MTP）时，或者在 MTP 迁移行为存在差异时，在回答、规划或编辑之前，使用此技能。触发条件包括：“从 VSTest 切换”；启用 MSTest/NUnit/xUnit 的 MTP；在 Directory.Build.props 中，仅对测试项目设置 OutputType=Exe；启用 EnableMSTestRunner、EnableNUnitRunner、UseMicrosoftTestingPlatformRunner 或 YTest.MTP.XUnit2；在 .NET 10 的 global.json 中设置 test.runner 和 TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport；翻译 VSTest 的 filters、logger、coverage、blame 或 dump 参数；替换 VSTest@3；以及退出码 8 或零测试通过。此外，在从 v2 升级到 v3 的过程中，对于 xUnit v3 的 MTP filters，也需要使用此技能。不用于框架转换、TFM、UWP 或 WinUI。

description: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Node.js/TypeScript. Use when the user asks about Genkit, AI agents, flows, or tools in JavaScript/TypeScript, or when encountering Genkit errors, validation issues, type errors, or API problems.
description_zh: 使用 Genkit 在 Node.js/TypeScript 中开发 AI 驱动的应用程序。当用户询问 Genkit、AI 智能体、流程或工具（在 JavaScript/TypeScript 中），或在遇到 Genkit 错误、验证问题、类型错误或 API 问题时使用。

description: Add "Open in molab" badge(s) linking to marimo notebooks. Works with READMEs, docs, websites, or any markdown/HTML target.
description_zh: 添加链接至 marimo 笔记本的“在 molab 中打开”徽标。适用于 README、文档、网站，或任何 Markdown/HTML 目标。

description: Use when building NuxtHub v0.10.6 applications - provides database (Drizzle ORM with sqlite/postgresql/mysql), KV storage, blob storage, and cache APIs. Covers configuration, schema definition, migrations, multi-cloud deployment (Cloudflare, Vercel), and the new hub:db, hub:kv, hub:blob virtual module imports.
description_zh: 用于构建 NuxtHub v0.10.6 应用程序——提供数据库（基于 sqlite/postgresql/mysql 的 Drizzle ORM）、KV 存储、Blob 存储和缓存 API。涵盖配置、模式定义、迁移、多云部署（Cloudflare、Vercel），以及新的 hub:db、hub:kv、hub:blob 虚拟模块导入。

description: Recover deleted, edited or historical web content using the Wayback Machine and its CDX API, archive.today, Common Crawl and Memento/Timetravel. Use when a page is deleted, changed or 404s, checking what a site used to say, finding old team or staff pages, prior pricing, removed posts, pre-redaction wording or old contact details, enumerating every archived URL for a domain, or preserving evidence before it disappears. Applies to litigation and evidence preservation, regulatory and disclosure review, due diligence on a company's history, and journalism. Reference at useosint.com/skills/read-deleted-pages.
description_zh: 使用 Wayback Machine 及其 CDX API、archive.today、Common Crawl 与 Memento/Timetravel，恢复已删除、已编辑或历史网络内容。适用于页面被删除、修改或出现 404 错误时，查看网站曾经的内容、查找旧版团队或员工页面、过往定价、已删除文章、脱敏前的措辞或旧联系方式、列举某域名下的全部已归档 URL，或于内容消失前保存证据。适用于诉讼与证据保全、监管与披露审查、公司历史尽职调查及新闻报道。参考用法：useosint.com/skills/read-deleted-pages。

description: De-slop pass for any text: detects and erases the statistical fingerprints of AI writing (negative parallelism / "not X but Y", em-dash abuse, rule-of-three, false ranges, puffery vocabulary, uniform cadence, hedged both-sidesing) and rewrites the text into its target register — academic article, tweet, reddit post, email, blog, anything between. Use when the user says "fuck slop", "f*ck slop", "deslop", "de-slop this", "remove the AI tells", "humanize this", "make this not sound like AI", or invokes /fuck-slop. Also use before publishing any agent-drafted prose.
description_zh: 对任意文本的 De-slop 处理：检测并消除 AI 写作的统计特征（否定性并列 /“不是 X 而是 Y”、破折号滥用、三连词法则、虚假区间、浮夸词汇、节奏统一、双向缓和措辞），并将文本改写为对应的目标语域——学术文章、推文、Reddit 帖子、邮件、博客，以及两者之间的任何体裁。当用户说“fuck slop”、“f*ck slop”、“deslop”、“de-slop this”、“remove the AI tells”、“humanize this”、“make this not sound like AI”，或调用 /fuck-slop 时使用。在发布任何由 Agent 起草的文本之前，也请使用。

description: Create and audit truthful, accessible, publication-ready scientific figures with Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly. Use for figure design, multi-panel layouts, uncertainty and missing-data displays, color/contrast review, image metadata validation, and journal export planning.
description_zh: 使用 Matplotlib、Seaborn 或 Plotly，创建并审核真实、易读且可直接用于发表的科学研究图表。用于图表设计、多面板布局、不确定性与缺失数据展示、颜色与对比度审查、图像元数据验证以及期刊导出规划。

description: Provides comprehensive guidance for Element Plus Vue 3 component library including installation, components, themes, internationalization, and API reference. Use when the user asks about Element Plus for Vue 3, needs to build Vue 3 applications with Element Plus, or customize component styles.
description_zh: 为 Element Plus Vue 3 组件库提供全面指南，涵盖安装、组件、主题、国际化及 API 参考。当用户询问 Vue 3 的 Element Plus、需要使用 Element Plus 构建 Vue 3 应用，或自定义组件样式时，使用本指南。

description: Bulk-migrate metadata to GitHub issue fields from two sources: repo labels (e.g. priority labels to a Priority field) and Project V2 fields. Use when users say "migrate my labels to issue fields", "migrate project fields to issue fields", "convert labels to issue fields", "copy project field values to issue fields", or ask about adopting issue fields. Issue fields are org-level typed metadata (single select, text, number, date) that replace label-based workarounds with structured, searchable, cross-repo fields.
description_zh: 将元数据从两个来源批量迁移至 GitHub Issue 字段：仓库标签（例如：将优先级标签迁移至 Priority 字段）以及 Project V2 字段。适用于用户说“将我的标签迁移到 Issue 字段”、“将项目字段迁移到 Issue 字段”、“将标签转换为 Issue 字段”、“将项目字段值复制到 Issue 字段”，或询问采用 Issue 字段时使用。Issue 字段是组织级类型化元数据（单选、文本、数字、日期），用结构化、可搜索、跨仓库的字段替代基于标签的变通方案。

description: Reverse-engineer and clone one or more websites in one shot — extracts assets, CSS, and content section-by-section and proactively dispatches parallel builder agents in worktrees as it goes. Use this whenever the user wants to clone, replicate, rebuild, reverse-engineer, or copy any website. Also triggers on phrases like "make a copy of this site", "rebuild this page", "pixel-perfect clone". Provide one or more target URLs as arguments.
description_zh: 一次性逆向工程并克隆一个或多个网站——在处理过程中逐部分提取资源、CSS 和内容，并在工作树中主动派发并行的构建 Agent。当用户需要克隆、复制、重建、逆向工程或拷贝任何网站时，请使用此功能。当出现诸如“复制此网站”、“重建此页面”、“像素级完美克隆”等表述时也会触发。作为参数提供一个或多个目标网址。

description: Use when writing or editing novels, short stories, or any fiction manuscript. Trigger on: 'write fiction', 'edit my novel', 'developmental edit', 'line edit', 'character voice', 'plot hole', 'brainstorm', or fiction writing tasks.
description_zh: 适用于撰写或编辑小说、短篇小说或任何虚构手稿时使用。触发条件：'write fiction', 'edit my novel', 'developmental edit', 'line edit', 'character voice', 'plot hole', 'brainstorm', 或虚构写作任务。

description: Enhances Vitest with Midscene for AI-powered UI testing across Web (Playwright), Android (ADB), and iOS (WDA). Scaffolds new projects, converts existing projects, and creates/updates/debugs/runs E2E tests using natural-language UI interactions. Triggers: write test, add test, create test, update test, fix test, debug test, run test, e2e test, midscene test, new project, convert project, init project, 写测试, 加测试, 创建测试, 更新测试, 修复测试, 调试测试, 运行测试, 新建工程, 转化工程.
description_zh: 使用 Midscene 增强 Vitest，用于在 Web（Playwright）、Android（ADB）和 iOS（WDA）上开展 AI 驱动的 UI 测试。搭建新项目，转换现有项目，并利用自然语言 UI 交互创建、更新、调试和运行 E2E 测试。触发条件：写测试, 加测试, 创建测试, 更新测试, 修复测试, 调试测试, 运行测试, e2e 测试, midscene 测试, 新建工程, 转化工程, 初始化项目, 写测试, 加测试, 创建测试, 更新测试, 修复测试, 调试测试, 运行测试, 新建工程, 转化工程。

description: Create system architecture diagrams using Mermaid, PlantUML, C4 model, flowcharts, and sequence diagrams. Use when documenting architecture, system design, data flows, or technical workflows.
description_zh: 使用 Mermaid、PlantUML、C4 模型、流程图与序列图创建系统架构图，用于记录架构、系统设计、数据流或技术工作流程。

description: Design any user-facing experience end-to-end: task flows, multi-step workflows, navigation structures, onboarding, settings, search, content creation, collaboration, signup, checkout, dashboards, notifications, error recovery, and more. Handles cross-platform adaptation (mobile/web/TV/embedded), device-aware design, accessibility, interaction specifications, and multi-channel journey mapping. Trigger when designing user flows of any kind, mapping screen sequences, optimizing task completion, specifying interactions, designing navigation, or asking "how should the user experience X?" Use this skill broadly — any time someone is working through how a user moves through a product experience, this skill applies.
description_zh:
全面设计任何面向用户的体验：涵盖任务流程、多步骤工作流、导航结构、引导、设置、搜索、内容创作、协作、注册、结账、仪表盘、通知、错误恢复等。负责跨平台适配（移动端/网页/电视/嵌入式）、设备感知设计、无障碍设计、交互规范以及多通道旅程映射。

在以下场景中触发：设计任意类型的用户流程、映射屏幕序列、优化任务完成度、规定交互方式、设计导航，或提出“用户应该如何体验X？”的问题。

广泛使用本技能——每当有人研究用户如何通过产品体验进行操作时，本技能均适用。

description: Reference skill for Zoom REST API. Use after choosing an API-based workflow when you need endpoint selection, resource-management patterns, OAuth requirements, rate-limit awareness, or API error debugging.
description_zh: Zoom REST API 参考技能。在选择了基于 API 的工作流后，当需要端点选择、资源管理模式、OAuth 要求、速率限制意识或 API 错误调试时使用。

description: Turn raw PM content into a compliant, publish-ready skill. Use when creating or updating a repo skill without breaking standards.
description_zh: 将原始 PM 内容转化为合规、可直接发布的技能。在创建或更新仓库技能且不违反标准时使用。

description: Migrate a React Native project from NativeWind to Uniwind. Use when the user wants to replace NativeWind with Uniwind, upgrade from NativeWind, switch to Uniwind, or mentions NativeWind-to-Uniwind migration. Handles package removal, config migration, Tailwind 4 upgrade, cssInterop removal, theme conversion, and all breaking changes.
description_zh: 将 React Native 项目从 NativeWind 迁移到 Uniwind。当用户想要替换 NativeWind 为 Uniwind、从 NativeWind 升级、切换到 Uniwind，或提及 NativeWind 至 Uniwind 迁移时使用。支持包移除、配置迁移、Tailwind 4 升级、cssInterop 移除、主题转换，以及所有破坏性变更。

description: Run Playwright smoke tests, debug failures, and verify fixes
description_zh: 执行 Playwright 冒烟测试、调试失败，并验证修复。

description: Guides creation and validation of custom dotnet new templates from existing projects. Generates a .template.config/template.json that preserves the source project's conventions. USE FOR: creating a reusable dotnet new template from an existing project, bootstrapping .template.config/template.json with correct identity, shortName, parameters, and post-actions, adding parameters or conditional content to a template you are authoring, validating the template.json you are authoring before publishing, packaging templates as NuGet packages for distribution. DO NOT USE FOR: validating an existing template.json as a standalone task (use template-validation), finding or using existing templates (use template-discovery and template-instantiation), MSBuild project file issues unrelated to template authoring, NuGet package publishing (only template packaging structure).
description_zh:
指导从现有项目创建和验证自定义 dotnet new 模板。生成保留源项目约定规范的 `.template.config/template.json`。

**用途：**
- 从现有项目创建可复用的 dotnet new 模板
- 为 `.template.config/template.json` 初始化正确的标识、短名、参数和后置操作
- 在编写模板时为其添加参数或条件内容
- 在发布前验证正在编写的 template.json
- 将模板作为 NuGet 包进行打包以进行分发

**不可用于：**
- 将现有的 template.json 作为独立任务进行验证（请使用 template-validation）
- 查找或使用现有模板（请使用 template-discovery 和 template-instantiation）
- 与模板编写无关的 MSBuild 项目文件问题
- NuGet 包发布（仅限模板打包结构）

description: Use when running video data augmentation and auto-labeling workflows on OSMO: flow selection, preflight, submit-time interpolation, monitoring, and output retrieval. Trigger keywords: video data augmentation, data enrichment, auto labeling, VDA demo, OSMO workflow, pseudo labeling.
description_zh: 用于在OSMO中运行视频数据增强与自动标注工作流：流程选择、预检、提交时插值、监控以及输出检索。触发关键词：视频数据增强、数据丰富、自动标注、VDA演示、OSMO工作流、伪标注。

description: Route users to OKX.AI customer support / Help Center. Use when the user wants to contact support, talk to a human, file a complaint, give feedback, report a system error or bug, or find the FAQ / help docs. Triggers: 'contact support', 'talk to a human', 'customer service', 'file a complaint', 'give feedback', 'help center', 'FAQ', 'user guide', 'system error', 'system bug', 'something is broken', 'find help docs', 'OKX AI support', 'OnchainOS support', 'human agent'.
description_zh: 将用户引导至OKX.AI客户支持/帮助中心。当用户想要联系支持、与人工对话、提交投诉、提供反馈、报告系统错误或漏洞，或查找常见问题解答/帮助文档时使用。触发词：“联系支持”、“与人工对话”、“客户服务”、“提交投诉”、“提供反馈”、“帮助中心”、“常见问题解答”、“用户指南”、“系统错误”、“系统漏洞”、“出现问题”、“查找帮助文档”、“OKX AI支持”、“OnchainOS支持”、“人工代理”。

description: Integrate Salesforce B2B Commerce open source components from GitHub into B2B Commerce stores. Use when users mention "integrate open code components", "open source B2B commerce", "add open code components", "forcedotcom/b2b-commerce-open-source-components", or want to add open source commerce components to their store. Copies all components and labels so they become available in Experience Builder.
description_zh: 将GitHub上的Salesforce B2B Commerce开源组件集成到B2B Commerce店铺中。当用户提及"集成开源代码组件"、"开源B2B商务"、"添加开源代码组件"、"forcedotcom/b2b-commerce-open-source-components"，或想要将其开源商务组件添加到店铺时使用。复制所有组件和标签，使其在Experience Builder中可用。

description: Expert guidance on choosing the right geospatial tool based on problem type, accuracy requirements, and performance needs
description_zh: 根据问题类型、精度要求和性能需求选择合适地理空间工具的专家指导

description:
Flutter cross-platform development guide covering widget patterns, Riverpod/Bloc state management, GoRouter navigation, performance optimization, and platform-specific implementations. Includes const optimization, responsive layouts, testing strategies, and DevTools profiling.
Use when: building Flutter apps, implementing state management (Riverpod/Bloc), setting up GoRouter navigation, creating custom widgets, optimizing performance, writing widget tests, cross-platform development.
description_zh:
Flutter跨平台开发指南，涵盖组件模式、Riverpod/Bloc状态管理、GoRouter导航、性能优化及特定平台实现。内容包括const优化、响应式布局、测试策略及DevTools性能分析。

适用于：构建Flutter应用、实现状态管理（Riverpod/Bloc）、配置GoRouter导航、创建自定义组件、优化性能、编写组件测试、跨平台开发。

description: Binance Margin-trading request using the Binance API. Authentication requires API key and secret key.
description_zh: 通过 Binance API 发起 Binance 保证金交易请求。认证需要 API 密钥和 secret key。

description: Extract durable working preferences from recent Cursor chats and convert them into skills, rules, or workflow docs. Use when asked to learn preferences, mine feedback, personalize workflows, or generate team/person-specific agent guidance.
description_zh: 从最近的 Cursor 对话中提取持久的工作偏好，并将其转化为技能、规则或工作流文档。当被要求了解偏好、挖掘反馈、个性化工作流或生成团队/个人专属的代理指导时使用。

description: Explain what Fusion MCP is and guide users through setting it up when they need Fusion-aware MCP capabilities in Copilot workflows.
description_zh: 解释 Fusion MCP 是什么，并在用户在 Copilot 工作流程中需要与 Fusion 相关的 MCP 能力时，引导用户完成其设置。

description: Load a sharded, on-disk dataset (sharded .npy, Parquet/Arrow, raw binary, sharded HDF5, custom layouts) into a distributed cuPyNumeric ndarray via a manual partition + leaf @task launch with CPU/OMP/GPU variants. Use when no single-call loader fits, including when per-shard row counts differ across files. Prefer cupynumeric.load or legate.io.hdf5.from_file when they apply.
description_zh: 通过手动分区 + 叶节点 @task 启动，将分片、存储在磁盘上的数据集（分片 .npy、Parquet/Arrow、原始二进制、分片 HDF5、自定义布局）加载为分布式的 cuPyNumeric ndarray，支持 CPU/OMP/GPU 变体。当没有单次调用加载器能够适配时使用，包括各分片文件中的行数不同的情况。当适用时，优先使用 cupynumeric.load 或 legate.io.hdf5.from_file。

description: Configures alerting policies in Terraform for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters, workloads, and services using PromQL and Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus. Use when writing, analyzing, validating, or deploying Terraform alerting policies to monitor GKE service latency, traffic, error rates using Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate SLO alerts, memory saturation, and cluster health such as CrashLoopBackOff and Node NotReady conditions. Don't use for non-GKE compute runtimes such as standalone Compute Engine VMs or standalone Cloud Run services without GKE.
description_zh: 在 Terraform 中，使用 PromQL 和 Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus 为 Google Kubernetes Engine（GKE）集群、工作负载和服务配置告警策略。适用于编写、分析、验证或部署 Terraform 告警策略，以监控 GKE 服务的延迟、流量和错误率，以及内存饱和和集群健康状态（如 CrashLoopBackOff 和 Node NotReady 条件）。请勿用于非 GKE 计算运行时，例如独立的 Compute Engine 虚拟机或未使用 GKE 的独立 Cloud Run 服务。

description: Use when exploring unfamiliar codebases, before searching for code, or after editing files. Builds a structural AST index (classes, functions, imports, call graph) from 12 languages via tree-sitter. Trigger: /graphify
description_zh: 用于探索不熟悉的代码库、在搜索代码之前或编辑文件后。通过 tree-sitter 从 12 种语言构建结构性 AST 索引（类、函数、导入、调用图）。触发：/graphify

description: Produce thoughtful, high-fidelity design artifacts in HTML — landing pages, slide decks, interactive prototypes, animated videos, posters, wireframes, and visual explorations. Use whenever the user asks to design, mock up, prototype, visualize, storyboard, or explore UI options — including phrases like "make a deck", "design a landing page", "prototype this flow", "animate this concept", "build a pitch deck", "create a poster", "visualize this idea", or "design something for a brand". Enforces fact verification (WebSearch before assuming a product exists or its version), the Core Asset Protocol for branded work (logo, product shots, and UI screenshots are first-class, not just colors and fonts), a Design Direction Advisor fallback that offers 3 differentiated directions from 10 design philosophies when the brief is too vague, commits to a visual system up front, presents multiple variations, and avoids AI-design tropes (aggressive gradients, emoji bullets, generic templates).
description_zh: 制作富有思想性、高保真的 HTML 设计工件——落地页、演示文稿、交互原型、动画视频、海报、线框图以及视觉探索。当用户要求设计、模拟、原型化、可视化、分镜或探索 UI 选项时，随时使用——包括诸如“制作演示文稿”、“设计落地页”、“原型化此流程”、“动画化此概念”、“构建展示文稿”、“创建海报”、“可视化此想法”或“为品牌设计某物”等表述。强制执行事实核查（在产品存在或版本存在之前进行 WebSearch），面向品牌工作的核心资产协议（标识、产品照片和 UI 截图属于一级资产，而不仅仅是颜色和字体），当需求说明过于模糊时，提供 10 种设计理念中 3 个不同方向的“设计方向顾问”作为备选方案，在前期确定视觉系统，提供多种变体，并避免 AI 设计常见的陈词滥调（如激进的渐变、表情符号项目符号、通用模板）。

description: Use this skill before answering or editing whenever an MSTest v1/v2 project is being upgraded or repaired for v3. Triggers include QualityTools assembly references; MSTest.TestFramework/TestAdapter 1.x-2.x; "upgrade to MSTest v3"; comparing v1 and v2 migration paths; choosing MSTest or MSTest.Sdk; CS0411/CS1503 after a v3 package bump; DataRow type mismatch, MSTEST0014, or "Test data doesn't match method parameters"; .testsettings/LegacySettings to .runsettings; timeout changes; and net5.0 or other dropped v3 TFMs. Still use it when packages say 3.x but migration source errors or legacy settings remain. Preserve VSTest/MTP. Do not use for a clean v3 project, v3-to-v4, framework conversion, or runner-only migration.
description_zh: 每当 MSTest v1/v2 项目为 v3 进行升级或修复时，应在回答或编辑之前使用此技能。触发条件包括 QualityTools 程序集引用；MSTest.TestFramework/TestAdapter 1.x-2.x；“升级至 MSTest v3”；比较 v1 和 v2 的迁移路径；选择 MSTest 或 MSTest.Sdk；v3 包升级后出现的 CS0411/CS1503；DataRow 类型不匹配、MSTEST0014，或“测试数据与方法参数不匹配”；将 .testsettings/LegacySettings 转换为 .runsettings；超时设置变更；以及 net5.0 或其他已移除的 v3 目标框架（TFMs）。即使包标注为 3.x，但如果迁移源存在错误或遗留设置仍然存在，仍应使用此技能。保留 VSTest/MTP。不得用于干净的 v3 项目、v3-to-v4 迁移、框架转换或仅运行器迁移。

description: Use this skill before answering, planning, or editing any MSTest 3.x-to-4.x upgrade or post-upgrade failure. Triggers include "MSTest v4 breaking changes"; CS0507/CS0103/CS1061/CS1615; ExecuteAsync, CallerInfo, DisplayName, or custom TestMethodAttribute; ClassCleanupBehavior; ContainsKey; ThrowsExactly or ExpectedException; IsInstanceOfType out parameters; TestTimeout.Infinite; ManagedType; net6/net7 compatibility; TestCase.Id history; TestName in ClassInitialize; TreatDiscoveryWarningsAsErrors; discovery errors after a clean build; and MSTest.Sdk/MTP or vstest.console discovery changes. Do not use for v1/v2-to-v3 leftovers, framework conversion, runner-only migration, or a general .NET upgrade.
description_zh: 在回答、规划或编辑任何 MSTest 3.x-to-4.x 升级或升级后故障之前，请使用本技能。触发条件包括“MSTest v4 breaking changes”；CS0507/CS0103/CS1061/CS1615；ExecuteAsync、CallerInfo、DisplayName 或自定义 TestMethodAttribute；ClassCleanupBehavior；ContainsKey；ThrowsExactly 或 ExpectedException；IsInstanceOfType 出参；TestTimeout.Infinite；ManagedType；net6/net7 兼容性；TestCase.Id 历史；TestName in ClassInitialize；TreatDiscoveryWarningsAsErrors；干净构建后的发现错误；以及 MSTest.Sdk/MTP 或 vstest.console discovery changes。不得用于 v1/v2-to-v3 遗留问题、框架转换、仅运行器迁移，或一般的 .NET 升级。

description: Migrate .NET test projects from xUnit.net v2 to xunit.v3 and fix v3 breaks. Do not use for framework conversion or a runner-only migration. For xUnit v3 MTP filter syntax, also use migrate-vstest-to-mtp.

Scores, categorizes, and prioritizes findings — then maps every issue to the skill that fixes it. Trigger on: UX review, design audit, heuristic evaluation, usability assessment, "review this design", "what's wrong with this", "evaluate the experience", "is this accessible", "check for dark patterns", "how good is this UX", "rate this design", "find the problems", or any request to systematically assess the quality of a user experience. This is the diagnostic entry point of the Intent system — the UX doctor that diagnoses issues and refers to specialists.
description_zh: **结构化的用户体验评估：生成定量评估结果，识别具体问题，并路由至相应的意图技能进行解决。属于意图设计策略系统的组成部分。执行启发式评估、认知走查、反模式检测和任务成功分析。对发现的问题进行评分、分类与优先级排序，并将每个问题映射至能够修复该问题的技能。触发条件包括：用户体验评审、设计审计、启发式评估、可用性评估、"审查此设计"、"此设计存在什么问题"、"评估体验"、"此设计是否具备无障碍功能"、"检查是否存在暗黑模式"、"此用户体验质量如何"、"评估此设计"、"查找问题"，或任何要求系统系统评估用户体验质量的请求。这是意图系统的诊断入口点——作为诊断问题并转诊至专业专家的"用户体验医生"。**

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Ruby. Use when asked to add Sentry to Ruby, install sentry-ruby, setup Sentry in Rails/Sinatra/Rack, or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, metrics, profiling, or crons for Ruby applications. Also handles migration from AppSignal, Honeybadger, Bugsnag, Rollbar, or Airbrake. Supports Rails, Sinatra, Rack, Sidekiq, and Resque.
description_zh: Ruby 的完整 Sentry SDK 配置。适用于被要求为 Ruby 添加 Sentry、安装 sentry-ruby、在 Rails/Sinatra/Rack 中配置 Sentry，或为 Ruby 应用配置错误监控、追踪、日志记录、指标、性能剖析及定时任务（crons）时使用。同时支持从 AppSignal、Honeybadger、Bugsnag、Rollbar 或 Airbrake 迁移。支持 Rails、Sinatra、Rack、Sidekiq 及 Resque。

description: Discovers golden base images for creating GKE custom node images based on technical specifications or context clues. Use when finding the golden base image for custom GKE node creation, mapping cluster configuration parameters (GKE version, OS, architecture, accelerators, gVisor, cgroups) to image names, or querying GKE base image maps. Don't use for general GKE cluster creation (use gke-cluster-creation) or standard node pool management (use gke-basics).
description_zh: 基于技术规格或上下文线索，发现用于创建GKE自定义节点镜像的黄金基镜像。当需要查找自定义GKE节点创建所需的黄金基镜像、将集群配置参数（GKE版本、操作系统、架构、加速器、gVisor、cgroups）映射为镜像名称，或查询GKE基础镜像映射时使用。勿用于通用GKE集群创建（使用gke-cluster-creation）或标准节点池管理（使用gke-basics）。

description: Expert guidance for building web scrapers and crawlers using the Scrapy Python framework with best practices for spider development, data extraction, and pipeline management.
description_zh: 利用 Scrapy Python 框架构建网页爬虫与爬虫的专家指导，涵盖蜘蛛开发、数据提取与管道管理的最佳实践。

description: Resume any open PR — started by `om-auto-create-pr` or opened outside the pipeline. Claims it, resumes in an isolated worktree from the first unchecked step of its execution plan; a PR with no plan is adopted — the goal is reconstructed from its description, comments, review feedback, linked issues and diff, then executed. Usage - /om-auto-continue-pr <PR-number>
description_zh: 恢复任意已开启的 PR——由 `om-auto-create-pr` 启动，或在流水线之外打开的。将其认领，并在隔离的工作树中从该 PR 执行计划的第一个未检查步骤继续执行；没有执行计划的 PR 也会被采用——从描述、评论、评审反馈、关联问题和 diff 中重建目标，然后执行。用法 - /om-auto-continue-pr <PR-number>>

description: Find internet-exposed hosts, ports, services and devices using third-party internet-scan data instead of touching the target. Covers Shodan and Censys query syntax, service banners, favicon-hash and TLS-certificate pivots, origin-IP discovery behind Cloudflare or a CDN, and exposed databases, dashboards, cameras and ICS devices. Use when asked what a company has exposed to the internet, to check open ports on an IP or netblock, or to write a Shodan filter query. Applies to external attack-surface management, third-party and vendor security review, M&A technical diligence, and pre-engagement reconnaissance. Reference at useosint.com/skills/find-exposed-servers.
description_zh: 使用第三方互联网扫描数据查找互联网暴露的主机、端口、服务和设备，无需接触目标系统。涵盖 Shodan 与 Censys 的查询语法、服务横幅、网站图标哈希（favicon）及 TLS 证书利用，Cloudflare 或 CDN 之后的源 IP 发现，以及暴露的数据库、控制台、摄像头和 ICS 设备。适用于当被询问某公司已向互联网暴露的内容时，检查 IP 或网块的开放端口，或编写 Shodan 过滤查询。适用于外部攻击面管理、第三方及供应商安全审查、并购技术尽职调查以及会前侦察等场景。参考资源：useosint.com/skills/find-exposed-servers。

description: Explain a body of work plainly so a person actually understands it. Runs the `how` and `why` skills and weaves what they find into one clear explanation. Use for 'teach me this', 'help me really understand X', 'explain this change or subsystem to me'.
description_zh: 将一系列工作清晰地解释清楚，确保对方真正理解。运用 `how` 和 `why` 技能，将发现的内容整合成一份清晰的解释。适用于‘教我这项内容’、‘帮助我真正理解X’、‘向我解释这项变更或子系统’等场景。

description: Creates or modernizes repository skills with clear activation cues, purposeful support files, and practical review loops. USE FOR: creating a new skill, tightening an existing skill, improving discovery wording, and structuring references/assets/optional helper agents when they genuinely add value. DO NOT USE FOR: product-code changes, routine copy edits outside skills/, or documentation that should not become an installable skill.
description_zh: 创建或现代化仓库技能，具备清晰的激活提示、具有明确目的的支持文件以及实用的审查循环。适用场景：创建新技能、完善现有技能、优化发现性表述，以及当参考资料、资产和可选辅助代理确实能带来价值时，合理组织这些内容。请勿用于：产品代码变更、在 skills/ 目录之外进行常规文案修改，或不应转化为可安装技能的文档。

description: Search domains, compare prices, find promo codes, get purchase recommendations. Use when user wants to buy a domain, check domain prices, find domain deals, compare registrars, or search for .ai/.com domains.
description_zh: 搜索域名，比较价格，查找促销码，获取购买建议。当用户想要购买域名、查看域名价格、寻找域名优惠、比较注册商或搜索 .ai/.com 域名时使用。

description: Run Semgrep static analysis scans and create custom detection rules. Use when asked to scan code with Semgrep, find security vulnerabilities, write custom YAML rules, or detect specific bug patterns. IMPORTANT: Also use this skill when users ask to 'scan for bugs', 'check code quality', 'find vulnerabilities', 'static analysis', 'lint for security', 'audit this code', or want to enforce coding standards — even if they don't mention Semgrep by name. Semgrep is the right tool for pattern-based code scanning across 30+ languages.
description_zh: 运行 Semgrep 静态分析扫描并创建自定义检测规则。当被要求使用 Semgrep 扫描代码、发现安全漏洞、编写自定义 YAML 规则或检测特定 bug 模式时使用。重要：当用户询问“扫描 bug”“检查代码质量”“查找漏洞”“静态分析”“安全 lint”“审计此代码”，或希望强制执行编码标准时，也使用本技能——即使他们未以名称提及 Semgrep。Semgrep 是跨 30 多种语言进行基于模式的代码扫描的正确工具。

description: Clean up messy spreadsheet data — trim whitespace, fix inconsistent casing, convert numbers-stored-as-text, standardize dates, remove duplicates, and flag mixed-type columns. Use when data is messy, inconsistent, or needs prep before analysis. Triggers on "clean this data", "clean up this sheet", "normalize this data", "fix formatting", "dedupe", "standardize this column", "this data is messy".
description_zh: 清理混乱的电子表格数据——去除空格、修正大小写不一致、将存储为文本的数字转换为数字、统一日期格式、去除重复项，并标记混合类型列。当数据混乱、不一致，或需要在进行分析前进行预处理时使用。触发词包括“清理这些数据”、“清理此工作表”、“标准化这些数据”、“修复格式”、“去重”、“标准化此列”、“这些数据很混乱”。

description: Write a right-sized EOL announcement — brief notice through full phased comms — with rationale, customer impact, and next steps. Use when retiring a product, feature, or plan.
description_zh: 撰写一份规模适中的 EOL 公告——从简洁通知到完整分阶段沟通——包含理由、客户影响和后续步骤。在产品、功能或计划退役时使用。

description: Create and modify NeMo AutoModel training and evaluation recipes, including YAML structure, builders, and execution flow.
description_zh: 创建并修改 NeMo AutoModel 的训练和评估配方，包括 YAML 结构、构建器和执行流程。

description: Find and own a defensible market position. Use when messaging sounds like competitors, conversion is weak despite awareness, repositioning a product, or testing positioning claims. Includes Crawl-Walk-Run rollout methodology and the word change that improved enterprise deal progression.
description_zh: 找到并拥有具有防御性的市场地位。当信息传达与竞争对手类似、尽管有认知但转化效果弱、调整产品定位或测试定位主张时使用。包括爬行-行走-奔跑的推广方法论，以及改善企业交易推进的词汇调整。

description: Evaluate scientific claims and evidence quality. Use for assessing experimental design validity, identifying biases and confounders, applying evidence grading frameworks (GRADE, Cochrane Risk of Bias), or teaching critical analysis. Best for understanding evidence quality, identifying flaws. For formal peer review writing use peer-review.
description_zh: 评估科学主张和证据质量。用于评估实验设计有效性、识别偏倚和混杂因素、应用证据分级框架（GRADE、Cochrane偏倚风险评估），或用于教学批判性分析。最适合理解证据质量、识别缺陷。用于正式同行评审写作时，使用同行评审。

description: Run an arbitrary autonomous task end-to-end and ship it as a PR against the configured base branch. Drafts a Progress-tracked execution plan, commits on a fresh worktree branch, implements phase-by-phase, runs the configured validation gate, applies pipeline labels. Long plans hand off to om-auto-create-pr-loop automatically. Resumable via om-auto-continue-pr.
description_zh: 端到端执行任意自主任务，并将其作为 Pull Request 提交至配置的基准分支。起草由 Progress 跟踪的执行计划，在全新的工作树分支上提交代码，逐阶段实现功能，运行配置的验证门，应用流水线标签。长计划会自动交接给 om-auto-create-pr-loop，可通过 om-auto-continue-pr 恢复。

description: Define a responsive grid — columns, gutters, margins, and breakpoint behaviour. Use when establishing page structure. For the spacing scale inside components use `spacing-system`; for cross-device behaviour use `responsive-design`.
description_zh: 定义响应式网格——列、栏间距、外边距和断点行为。用于建立页面结构。组件内部的空间尺度使用 `spacing-system`；跨设备行为使用 `responsive-design`。

description:
塔勒布(Nassim Nicholas Taleb)的思维框架与表达方式。基于40+个来源的深度调研，
提炼6个核心心智模型、9条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用塔勒布的视角分析问题、审视决策、质疑主流叙事。
当用户提到「用塔勒布的视角」「塔勒布会怎么看」「塔勒布模式」「反脆弱视角」「taleb perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「会不会黑天鹅」「这个有尾部风险吗」「skin in the game」「有没有反脆弱的方法」「杠铃策略怎么用」也可触发。
不要在用户只是做一般风险评估或问「靠不靠谱」时触发——只在涉及极端风险、反脆弱、预防原则等塔勒布核心概念时激活。
description_zh:
塔勒布（Nassimag Nicholas Taleb）的思维框架与表达方式。基于40多个来源的深度调研，
提炼6个核心心智模型、9条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，运用塔勒布的视角分析问题、审视决策、质疑主流叙事。
当用户提到「用塔勒布的视角」「塔勒布会怎么看」「塔勒布模式」「反脆弱视角」「taleb perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「会不会黑天鹅」「这个有尾部风险吗」「skin in the game」「有没有反脆弱的方法」「杠铃策略怎么用」也可触发。
不要在用户只是做一般风险评估或问「靠不靠谱」时触发——只在涉及极端风险、反脆弱、预防原则等塔勒布核心概念时激活。

description: Guide for integrating REST APIs into GraphQL supergraphs using Apollo Connectors with @source and @connect directives. Use this skill when the user: (1) mentions "connectors", "Apollo Connectors", or "REST Connector", (2) wants to integrate a REST API into GraphQL, (3) references @source or @connect directives, (4) works with files containing "# Note to AI Friends: This is an Apollo Connectors schema".
