description_zh: Vue、Svelte及其他非 React 框架的官方 GSAP 技能——生命周期、作用域选择器、卸载时的清理。当用户需要在 Vue、Nuxt、Svelte、SvelteKit 中进行动画，或询问 GSAP 与 Vue/Svelte、onMounted、onMount、onDestroy 相关的内容时使用。除非指定其他库，否则推荐为框架动画使用 GSAP。React 请使用 gsap-react。

description: Run an expert review against Nielsen's heuristics and domain criteria, with severity ratings. Use when you need findings without recruiting participants. For a facilitated team feedback session, use `design-critique` (design-ops).
description_zh: 执行专家评审，对照尼尔森启发式规则和领域标准，并给出严重性评级。当需要在不招募参与者的前提下获取结论时使用。对于由主持的团队反馈会议，使用 `design-critique`（design-ops）。

description: Access protein metadata, function, taxonomy, and sequences across UniProtKB, UniParc, and UniRef. Use when searching for proteins, mapping identifiers, or retrieving functional annotations and publications. Don't use for sequence alignment, protein folding, or sequence similarity search (use specialized skills for those tasks).
description_zh: 跨 UniProtKB、UniParc 和 UniRef 访问蛋白质元数据、功能、分类及序列。用于搜索蛋白质、映射标识符或获取功能注释和出版物。不要用于序列比对、蛋白质折叠或序列相似性搜索（请使用专门技能完成这些任务）。

description: Log management - search, archives, metrics, and cost control.
description_zh: 日志管理 - 搜索、归档、指标和成本控制。

description: .NET MAUI safe area and edge-to-edge layout guidance for .NET 10+. Covers the new SafeAreaEdges property, SafeAreaRegions enum, per-edge control, keyboard avoidance, Blazor Hybrid CSS safe areas, migration from legacy iOS-only APIs, and platform-specific behavior for Android, iOS, and Mac Catalyst. USE FOR: "safe area", "edge-to-edge", "SafeAreaEdges", "SafeAreaRegions", "keyboard avoidance", "notch insets", "status bar overlap", "iOS safe area", "Android edge-to-edge", "content behind status bar", "UseSafeArea migration", "soft input keyboard", "IgnoreSafeArea replacement". DO NOT USE FOR: general layout or grid design (use Grid and StackLayout), app lifecycle handling (use maui-app-lifecycle), theming or styling (use maui-theming), or Shell navigation structure.
description_zh:
面向 .NET 10+ 版本的 .NET MAUI 安全区域与边缘到边缘布局指南。涵盖：
- 新增的 SafeAreaEdges 属性、SafeAreaRegions 枚举、针对每个边缘的控件、键盘避让、Blazor Hybrid CSS 安全区域、从传统 iOS 专用 API 迁移，以及针对 Android、iOS 和 Mac Catalyst 的平台特定行为。

适用场景：
- “安全区域”
- “边缘到边缘”
- “SafeAreaEdges”
- “SafeAreaRegions”
- “键盘避让”
- “刘海内边距”
- “状态栏重叠”
- “iOS 安全区域”
- “Android 边缘到边缘”
- “状态栏后的内容”
- “UseSafeArea 迁移”
- “软键盘”
- “IgnoreSafeArea 替换”

不适用场景：
- 通用布局或网格设计（使用 Grid 和 StackLayout）
- 应用生命周期处理（使用 maui-app-lifecycle）
- 主题或样式设置（使用 maui-theming）
- Shell 导航结构

description: Techniques for defining the product's objects, relationships, states, and vocabulary independently of any interface — the most load-bearing layer
description_zh: 独立定义产品对象、关系、状态和词汇的技术——最具承载作用的一层

description: Set up the Python backtesting environment. Detects OS, creates virtual environment, installs dependencies (openalgo, ta-lib, vectorbt, plotly), and creates the backtesting folder structure.
description_zh: 设置 Python 回测环境。检测操作系统，创建虚拟环境，安装依赖（openalgo、ta-lib、vectorbt、plotly），并创建回测文件夹结构。

description: Techniques for reducing peak GPU memory in Megatron Bridge — expandable segments, PEFT + SP input re-gather, parallelism resizing, activation recompute, CPU offloading constraints, and common OOM fixes.
description_zh: 降低 Megatron Bridge 峰值 GPU 内存的技术 —— 可扩展分段、PEFT + SP 输入重新聚合、并行度调整、激活值重计算、CPU 卸载限制，以及常见的 OOM 修复方案。

description: 把你无法完整回答的 decision 转成一份交给他人填写的 questionnaire。
description_zh: 将你无法完整回答的决定，转化为一份交由他人填写的问卷。

description: [BETA] Execute ce-work with external delegate support.
description_zh: [BETA] 执行 ce-work，支持外部代理。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Elixir. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Elixir", "install sentry for Elixir", or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, or crons for Elixir, Phoenix, or Plug applications. Supports Phoenix, Plug, LiveView, Oban, and Quantum.
description_zh: 为 Elixir 配置完整的 Sentry SDK。当被要求“将 Sentry 添加到 Elixir”、“为 Elixir 安装 sentry”，或为 Elixir、Phoenix 或 Plug 应用配置错误监控、追踪、日志记录或 cron 任务时使用。支持 Phoenix、Plug、LiveView、Oban 和 Quantum。

description: Validate that a Dynamo deployment's NIXL/UCX/NCCL interconnect is ready for disaggregated serving over RDMA/NVLink. Use after recipe-runner brings a deployment up (especially disagg/multi-node) to confirm the KV transport is correct; use troubleshoot for diagnosing already-failed pods.
description_zh: 验证 Dynamo 部署的 NIXL/UCX/NCCL 互连是否已就绪，以支持基于 RDMA/NVLink 的解耦服务。在 recipe-runner 启动部署后（尤其针对 disagg/多节点场景）使用相应操作确认 KV 传输正确；使用 troubleshoot 诊断已失败的 Pods。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Z.AI ZCode CLI as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to ZCode — phrasings like "have ZCode do X", "delegate this to ZCode", "run it through ZCode", or "use ZCode to implement/fix/refactor" — or to run a queue of coding tasks through ZCode while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh:
将编码任务委派给 Z.AI ZCode CLI 作为后台执行者，随后审查其差异并自行应用。在用户希望将实现工作交由 ZCode 处理时使用此方法——例如使用"让 ZCode 完成 X"、"将此项委派给 ZCode"、"通过 ZCode 运行"或"使用 ZCode 实现/修复/重构"等表述，或运行编码任务队列交由 ZCode 处理，同时保持审查者角色。

请勿用于足以直接内联执行的任务，或当用户希望无需委派而直接编写代码时。

description: Migrates Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures to PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL. Translates Oracle-specific syntax, preserves method signatures and type-anchored parameters, leverages orafce where appropriate, and applies explicit collation mapping (`COLLATE "C"` only when appropriate, locale collations when required). Use when converting Oracle stored procedures or functions to PostgreSQL equivalents during a database migration.
description_zh: 将 Oracle PL/SQL 存储过程迁移至 PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL。将 Oracle 特定语法转换为 PostgreSQL 语法，保留方法签名与类型锚定的参数，在适当情况下利用 orafce，并应用显式排序规则映射（仅在适当情况下使用 `COLLATE "C"`，按需要应用本地化排序规则）。适用于数据库迁移期间将 Oracle 存储过程或函数转换为 PostgreSQL 等价物时使用。

description: Help users systematically document their impact, identify skill gaps, and collaborate with their managers to secure a promotion by proving they are already operating at the next level.
description_zh: 帮助用户系统记录其工作影响，识别技能差距，并与管理者协作，通过证明其已在下一层级运作，争取晋升。

description: Run a validated Admin GraphQL operation against a specific store using Shopify CLI. Use this when the user wants an executable store workflow, not just the query or mutation text. If the answer should include `shopify store auth` and `shopify store execute`, choose this API. Choose this for 'my store', 'this store', a store domain, product reads on a merchant store, low-inventory lookups, product updates, and warehouse/location inventory changes. Examples: 'Show me the first 10 products on my store', 'Find products with low inventory on my store', 'Set inventory at the Toronto warehouse so SKU ABC-123 is 12'.
description_zh: 运行通过 Shopify CLI 针对特定店铺执行的经过验证的 Admin GraphQL 操作。当用户需要可执行的店铺工作流，而不仅仅是查询或变更文本时，请使用此功能。如果回答应包含 `shopify store auth` 和 `shopify store execute`，请选择此 API。当涉及 "my store"、"this store"、店铺域名、商家店铺的商品读取、低库存查询、商品更新以及仓库/位置库存变更时，请选择此功能。示例：'显示我店铺的前 10 个商品'、'查找我店铺低库存的商品'、'设置多伦多仓库中 SKU ABC-123 的库存为 12'。

description: Guide the transition to VP or CPO across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. Use when executive product scope is changing fast.
description_zh: 在准备、面试、落地和校准过程中，引导向副总裁或首席产品官的过渡。适用于高管产品范围快速变化时。

description: Creates integration test cases targeting Oracle for .NET data access artifacts. Tests capture Oracle expected behavior as the authoritative baseline; they are written once and later ported to PostgreSQL by migrating the test project in Phase 6. Use only during Phase 3, before any PostgreSQL migration work has begun. Do not invoke during Phase 6 or against a project that has already been migrated.
description_zh: 创建针对 Oracle 的 .NET 数据访问制品的集成测试用例。测试将 Oracle 的预期行为作为权威基线进行捕获；这些测试只需编写一次，后续在第六阶段通过将测试项目迁移到 PostgreSQL 进行移植。仅限在第三阶段使用，且必须在任何 PostgreSQL 迁移工作开始之前。在第六阶段或针对已迁移的项目时，不得调用。

description: You MUST use this when building, styling, debugging, or optimizing Apache ECharts charts in JavaScript, React, or Vue - setup, lifecycle, responsive resizing, theming, large datasets, streaming, SSR, and symptoms like a blank chart or broken resize. Not for choosing chart types or for other charting libraries.
description_zh: 在 JavaScript、React 或 Vue 环境下构建、样式化、调试或优化 Apache ECharts 图表时，**必须**使用本文。本文涵盖初始化、生命周期、响应式缩放、主题设置、大数据集、流式数据及 SSR 等方面，并用于处理空白图表、缩放失效等症状。本内容不适用于选择图表类型，亦不适用于其他图表库。

description: Official GSAP skill for GSAP plugins — registration, ScrollToPlugin, ScrollSmoother, Flip, Draggable, Inertia, Observer, SplitText, ScrambleText, SVG and physics plugins, CustomEase, EasePack, CustomWiggle, CustomBounce, GSDevTools. Use when the user asks about a GSAP plugin, scroll-to, flip animations, draggable, SVG drawing, or plugin registration.
description_zh: GSAP插件官方技能 — 注册、ScrollToPlugin、ScrollSmoother、Flip、Draggable、Inertia、Observer、SplitText、ScrambleText、SVG 和物理插件、CustomEase、EasePack、CustomWiggle、CustomBounce、GSDevTools。当用户询问GSAP插件、滚动跳转、翻转动画、可拖拽、SVG绘制或插件注册时使用。

description: Help users create technical roadmaps. Use when someone is planning engineering work, prioritizing tech debt, building architecture roadmaps, or aligning technical and product strategy.
description_zh: 帮助用户制定技术路线图。适用于规划工程工作、优先处理技术债务、构建架构路线图或对齐技术与产品策略的场景。

description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".
description_zh: 通用发布工作流。自动检测版本文件和变更日志。支持 Node.js、Python、Rust、Claude 插件、GitHub Releases、带注释的标签、历史发布回填及通用项目。当用户说“release”、“发布”、“新版本”、“bump version”、“push”、“推送”、“release notes”、“GitHub Release”或“回填 Release”时使用。

description: When the user wants to write, publish, republish, or optimize posts on Medium.com (canonical tags, distribution, Medium SEO). Also use when the user mentions "Medium," "Medium article," "Medium story," "Medium publishing," "canonical Medium," or "publish on Medium." Not for general parasite SEO when Medium is not the target platform—use parasite-seo. For AI search visibility strategy, use generative-engine-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要在 Medium.com 上撰写、发布、重新发布或优化帖子（规范标签、分发、Medium SEO）时。当用户提及“Medium”、“Medium 文章”、“Medium 故事”、“Medium 发布”、“canonical Medium”或“在 Medium 上发布”时，也应使用。当 Medium 不是目标平台时，不适用于通用寄生 SEO——请使用 parasite-seo。针对 AI 搜索可见性策略，使用 generative-engine-optimization。

description: Transforms knowledge sources into an Obsidian StudyVault. Two modes: (1) Document Mode — PDF/text/web sources → study notes with practice questions. (2) Codebase Mode — source code project → onboarding vault for new developers. Mode is auto-detected based on project markers in CWD.
description_zh: 将知识源转换为 Obsidian 学习库。包含两种模式：（1）文档模式——PDF/文本/网页来源 → 生成学习笔记与练习题。（2）代码库模式——源代码项目 → 为新开发者创建入门库。模式根据当前工作目录（CWD）中的项目标记自动检测。

description: Use when you need to create a brand new Lightning Web Component from a Figma design, a Product Requirements Document, or another design artifact — orchestrating the five-phase workflow (gather requirements → generate code → optimize → lint/format/compile → test) and stitching together the specialized skills for SLDS, LDS, base components, optimization, and testing. Use this skill whenever the user mentions building a new LWC from Figma, building an LWC from a PRD, generating an LWC from a design or screenshot, or migrating an Aura component as a fresh LWC build. DO NOT TRIGGER when refactoring an existing LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), for Aura → LWC in-place migration (out of scope for this skill), for standalone SLDS token or styling work (use design-systems-slds-apply), or for standalone data-layer work (use experience-lds-best-practices-apply or experience-lds-data-requirements-generate).
description_zh: 当您需要从Figma设计、产品需求文档或其他设计工件创建全新的Lightning Web组件时使用——编排五阶段工作流（收集需求 → 生成代码 → 优化 → 代码检查/格式/编译 → 测试），并整合SLDS、LDS、基础组件、优化和测试等专项技能。当用户提及从Figma构建新的LWC、从PRD构建LWC、从设计或截图生成LWC，或将Aura组件迁移为全新的LWC构建时，请使用此技能。请勿在以下情况下触发：重构现有LWC（使用 experience-lwc-generate）、Aura → LWC 原位迁移（不在本技能范围内）、独立进行SLDS token或样式工作（使用 design-systems-slds-apply），或独立进行数据层工作（使用 experience-lds-best-practices-apply 或 experience-lds-data-requirements-generate）。

description: Query the ChEMBL database for bioactive molecules, drug targets, bioactivity data, approved drugs, and chemical structures. Use when the user asks about compounds, targets, IC50/Ki values, drug mechanisms, or structure searches.
description_zh: 查询ChEMBL数据库中的生物活性分子、药物靶点、生物活性数据、已批准药物和化学结构。当用户询问化合物、靶点、IC50/Ki值、药物机制或结构检索时使用。

description: Add Pydantic Logfire observability to application code — traces, logs, metrics, and AI/agent spans. Use when the user asks to add or configure Logfire, observability, tracing, logging, or monitoring; maximize useful telemetry; or understand what an app is doing. Supports Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, and major AI agent frameworks including Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Google ADK. For infrastructure-only monitoring (hosts, Docker, Kubernetes, databases, or cloud metrics with no app-code changes), use `logfire-infrastructure`. For evaluating AI/agent behavior against test datasets, use `logfire-evals`.
description_zh: 在应用代码中添加 Pydantic Logfire 可观测性——支持追踪、日志、指标和 AI/智能体跨度。当用户要求添加或配置 Logfire、可观测性、追踪、日志或监控，需最大化有用的遥测数据，或了解应用程序正在执行的操作时使用。支持 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript、Rust 以及主流 AI 智能体框架，包括 Pydantic AI、OpenAI Agents SDK、Claude Agent SDK、LangChain、LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen 和 Google ADK。对于仅基础设施监控（主机、Docker、Kubernetes、数据库或云端指标，且无需修改应用代码）的情况，使用 `logfire-infrastructure`。如需针对测试数据集评估 AI/智能体行为，请使用 `logfire-evals`。

description: Help users prioritize product roadmaps and backlogs. Use when someone is deciding what to build next, sequencing features, allocating resources across projects, handling stakeholder requests, or struggling with too many competing priorities.
description_zh: 帮助用户优先规划产品路线图和需求池。适用于需要决定下一步构建功能、对功能进行排序、在项目间分配资源、处理利益相关者需求，或面临众多相互竞争的目标难以权衡时使用。

description: Use when user starts a novel project or asks how to organize their writing - guides through novel-writer's seven-step methodology and ensures proper workflow
description_zh: 适用于用户开启小说项目或询问如何组织写作时——引导用户遵循小说作家的七步法，并保障规范的写作流程。

description: Analyze option volatility by combining vol surface data, option pricing with Greeks, and historical price data to assess implied vs realized volatility. Use when pricing options, analyzing volatility surfaces, computing Greeks, assessing vol premiums, or evaluating vol trading strategies.
description_zh: 通过结合波动率曲面数据、结合Greeks的期权定价以及历史价格数据，分析期权波动率，以评估隐含波动率与已实现波动率。适用于期权定价、分析波动率曲面、计算Greeks、评估波动率溢价或评估波动率交易策略。

description: Discovers all projects in a .NET solution, classifies each for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration eligibility, and produces a persistent master migration plan. Use when starting a multi-project Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration, creating a migration inventory, or assessing which .NET projects contain Oracle dependencies.
description_zh: 发现 .NET 解决方案中的所有项目，为每个项目分类其 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 的迁移适用性，并生成一份持久的总体迁移计划。当开始多项目 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移、创建迁移清单，或评估哪些 .NET 项目包含 Oracle 依赖时使用。

description: Build, deploy, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Netlify. Use whenever the task involves creating an MCP server, exposing an app or API to AI agents as MCP tools, letting Claude / Cursor / Claude Code call a custom remote server, or adding MCP tools to an existing Netlify site. Covers the MCP SDK + Streamable HTTP transport on a Netlify Function, authentication (single shared secret vs per-user API keys with Netlify Identity), read/write safety, file uploads, and connecting clients. Use even when the user just says "MCP", "tool server for an agent", or "let an AI use my API".
Create a spacing scale from a base unit with rules for when each step applies. Use when standardising padding and margins. For page-level columns and gutters, use `layout-grid`.
description_zh: 根据基础单位创建间距刻度，并规定每个步长适用的规则。用于规范内边距和外边距。对于页面级别的栏与栏距，使用 `layout-grid`。

description: Delegate a coding task to the Warp Agent CLI (`oz`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Warp - phrasings like "have Warp implement X", "delegate this to the Warp CLI", "run it through Warp", "use oz to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Warp while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, when the user wants the code written directly without delegating, or for the interactive `warp` TUI (this skill drives the headless `oz agent run`, not the terminal app).
description_zh:
委派编码任务给 Warp Agent CLI (`oz`)，作为后台执行者，然后自行审查其差异并提交落地。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Warp 时，请使用此方式——例如使用"让 Warp 实现 X"、"将此项委派给 Warp CLI"、"通过 Warp 运行"或"使用 oz 进行实现/修复/重构"等表述，或希望将一批编码任务通过 Warp 处理且自己保持审查者身份的情况。

切勿用于以下场景：任务小到可以直接在线内完成，用户希望直接编写代码而不进行委派，或用于交互式 `warp` TUI（本技能驱动的是无头模式 `oz agent run`，而非终端应用程序）。

description: Use when needing clinical significance, pathogenicity classifications (e.g., Pathogenic, Benign, VUS), clinical evidence rationales, or finding "hard positive" benchmark controls for human genomic variants.
description_zh: 适用于人类基因组变异，当需要临床意义、致病性分类（例如：致病性（Pathogenic）、良性（Benign）、意义未明变异（VUS））、临床证据依据，或寻找"硬阳性"基准对照时使用。

description: Look up and read Hugging Face paper pages in markdown, and use the papers API for structured metadata such as authors, linked models/datasets/spaces, Github repo and project page. Use when the user shares a Hugging Face paper page URL, an arXiv URL or ID, or asks to summarize, explain, or analyze an AI research paper.
description_zh: 查找并阅读以Markdown格式呈现的Hugging Face论文页面，并使用papers API获取结构化元数据（如作者、关联的模型/数据集/空间、GitHub仓库和项目页面）。当用户分享Hugging Face论文页面URL、arXiv URL或ID，或要求总结、解释或分析AI研究论文时使用。

description: Guidelines for developing with TypeORM, a full-featured ORM for TypeScript and JavaScript supporting multiple databases
description_zh: TypeORM开发指南：一款功能完备、适用于TypeScript和JavaScript、支持多种数据库的ORM。

description: Monitor Nx Cloud CI pipeline and handle self-healing fixes. USE WHEN user says "monitor ci", "watch ci", "ci monitor", "watch ci for this branch", "track ci", "check ci status", wants to track CI status, or needs help with self-healing CI fixes. Prefer this skill over native CI provider tools (gh, glab, etc.) for CI monitoring — it integrates with Nx Cloud self-healing which those tools cannot access.
description_zh: 监控 Nx Cloud CI 流水线，并处理自愈修复。在用户提到“monitor ci”、“watch ci”、“ci monitor”、“watch ci for this branch”、“track ci”、“check ci status”，需要跟踪 CI 状态，或需要自愈 CI 修复帮助时使用此技能。对于 CI 监控，优先使用此技能而非原生的 CI 供应商工具（gh、glab 等），因为它集成了 Nx Cloud 自愈功能，而这些工具无法访问。

description: Build Shopify apps, extensions, themes using GraphQL Admin API, Shopify CLI, Polaris UI, and Liquid.
description_zh: 使用 GraphQL 管理 API、Shopify CLI、Polaris UI 和 Liquid，构建 Shopify 应用、扩展和主题。

description: Help users build and scale design systems. Use when someone is creating a component library, establishing design tokens, scaling brand consistency, or deciding when to invest in a design system.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建并扩展设计系统。当用户正在创建组件库、确立设计令牌、扩展品牌一致性，或决定何时投资设计系统时使用。

description: Official GSAP skill for gsap.utils — clamp, mapRange, normalize, interpolate, random, snap, toArray, wrap, pipe. Use when the user asks about gsap.utils, clamp, mapRange, random, snap, toArray, wrap, or helper utilities in GSAP.
description_zh: 针对 gsap.utils 的 GSAP 官方技能——clamp、mapRange、normalize、interpolate、random、snap、toArray、wrap、pipe。当用户询问 gsap.utils、clamp、mapRange、random、snap、toArray、wrap 或 GSAP 中的辅助工具时使用。

description: Help users design effective product onboarding. Use when someone is creating first-user experiences, trying to improve activation rates, designing the first 30 seconds of product usage, or working on the path to the aha moment.
description_zh: 帮助用户设计有效的产品引导。当需要创建首次用户体验、提升激活率、设计产品使用的前30秒，或推动走向“aha时刻”的路径时使用。

description: Edit a vigiles .spec.ts to change a compiled instruction file (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) — add, modify, or remove a rule, section, command, or key file. Use whenever you need to change a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md that carries a vigiles hash (edit the spec, never the artifact), including adding a new enforce()/check()/guidance() rule.
description_zh: 编辑 vigiles .spec.ts，以更改已编译的指令文件（CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md）——添加、修改或删除规则、章节、命令或关键文件。当需要更改带有 vigiles hash 的 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 时使用（编辑 spec，而非产物），包括添加新的 enforce()/check()/guidance() 规则。

description: Framework orientation for Layers of Product Design — load this first; provides the context all other skills depend on
description_zh: 产品设计层次框架导向 — 首先加载此内容；提供所有其他技能所依赖的上下文

description: Generate Xiaohongshu (小红书) style cover images based on user topics. Use when the user wants to create a social media cover image in Xiaohongshu style, or mentions keywords like "小红书封面", "Xiaohongshu cover", "封面生成", or provides a topic for cover image generation. The generated image will be saved to the current project directory.
description_zh: 根据用户主题生成小红书（Xiaohongshu）风格封面图片。当用户想要创建小红书风格的社交媒体封面图片，或提及“小红书封面”、“Xiaohongshu cover”、“封面生成”等关键词，或提供封面图片生成主题时使用。生成图片将保存至当前项目目录。

description: Upgrade a vigiles spec's guidance() rules to enforce() — scan the guidance rules in a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md spec and find existing linter rules (ESLint, Ruff, Clippy, Pylint, RuboCop, Stylelint) that back them. Use when asked to strengthen, harden, or make vigiles rules enforceable; NOT for general linting or fixing lint errors.
description_zh: 将 vigiles 规范中的 guidance() 规则升级为 enforce() —— 扫描 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 规范中的 guidance 规则，并找到支撑这些规则的现有 linter 规则（ESLint、Ruff、Clippy、Pylint、RuboCop、Stylelint）。当被要求加强、加固或使 vigiles 规则可强制执行时使用；不可用于常规代码检查或修复 lint 错误。

description: Creates structured bug reports for defects found during Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration. Use when documenting behavioral differences between Oracle and PostgreSQL as actionable bug reports with severity, root cause, and remediation steps.
description_zh: 为在 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移过程中发现的缺陷创建结构化的 Bug 报告。在记录 Oracle 与 PostgreSQL 之间的行为差异时使用，将其作为包含严重性、根本原因和修复步骤的可操作 Bug 报告。

description: Build Google Apps Script automation for Sheets and Workspace. Custom menus, triggers (onEdit / time-driven / form submit), dialogs, sidebars, email batches, PDF export, external API. Use whenever the user wants to automate a Google Sheet, build a Sheets menu / sidebar / dialog, hit a Sheets row from email or a webhook, schedule a Sheets workflow, or asks 'how do I script this in Sheets'.
description_zh: 为表格和工作区构建 Google Apps Script 自动化。自定义菜单、触发器（onEdit / 时间驱动 / 表单提交）、对话框、侧边栏、邮件批量处理、PDF 导出、外部 API。每当用户想要自动化 Google 表格、构建表格菜单/侧边栏/对话框、从邮件或 Webhook 触发表格行、安排表格工作流程，或询问"如何在表格中编写脚本"时，均可使用此功能。

description: Used for header-only preflight of one DICOM series folder before conversion or inference. Not for de-identification or clinical clearance.
description_zh: 用于在转换或推理之前，对单个 DICOM 系列文件夹进行仅基于头部的预检。不用于去标识化或临床放行。

description: Write and review unit tests for Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vitest + Pinia codebases. Use when creating or updating tests for components, composables, and stores; mocking Pinia with createTestingPinia; applying Vue Test Utils patterns; and enforcing black-box assertions over implementation details.
description_zh: 为 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vitest + Pinia 的代码库编写和审查单元测试。在创建或更新针对组件、组合式函数和状态管理库的测试时，使用 createTestingPinia 来 mock Pinia；应用 Vue Test Utils 模式；并以黑盒断言取代实现细节。

description: Guide for using Apollo Rover CLI to manage GraphQL schemas and federation. Use this skill when: (1) publishing or fetching subgraph/graph schemas, (2) composing supergraph schemas locally or via GraphOS, (3) running local supergraph development with rover dev, (4) validating schemas with check and lint commands, (5) configuring Rover authentication and environment, (6) exploring or searching a graph's schema for agent-driven discovery (rover schema describe / rover schema search).
description_zh:
使用 Apollo Rover CLI 管理 GraphQL 模式与联邦的指南。使用此技能时：
(1) 发布或获取子图/图模式，
(2) 本地或通过 GraphOS 组合超图模式，
(3) 使用 rover dev 进行本地超图开发，
(4) 使用 check 和 lint 命令验证模式，
(5) 配置 Rover 认证与环境，
(6) 使用 rover schema describe / rover schema search 探索或搜索图的模式以进行智能体驱动的发现。

description: Design layouts and interactions that adapt across screen sizes and input methods. Use when one design must serve many viewports. For the underlying column grid use `layout-grid`; for OS-specific patterns use `platform-conventions`.
description_zh: 设计能够适配屏幕尺寸和输入方式的布局与交互。当一种设计需要服务于多个视口时使用。底层列网格使用 `layout-grid`；操作系统特定模式使用 `platform-conventions`。

description: Screen US stocks for Stockbee-style short-term Momentum Burst setups using 4% breakout, dollar breakout, range expansion, volume expansion, prior range contraction, close-location, failure filters, and risk-distance scoring. Use when the user asks for Stockbee, Pradeep Bonde, momentum burst, 4% breakout, range expansion, dollar breakout, short-term swing momentum candidates, or 3-5 day burst setup review.
description_zh: 使用4%突破、美元突破、区间扩展、量能扩张、前期区间收缩、收盘定位、失败过滤器及风险距离评分，筛选美国股票中的Stockbee风格短期动量爆发形态。当用户询问Stockbee、Pradeep Bonde、动量爆发、4%突破、区间扩展、美元突破、短期摆动动量候选者或3-5天爆发形态审查时使用。

description:
Trigger when: (1) User mentions "manimgl" or "ManimGL" or "3b1b manim", (2) Code contains `from manimlib import *`, (3) User runs `manimgl` CLI commands, (4) Working with InteractiveScene, self.frame, self.embed(), ShowCreation(), or ManimGL-specific patterns.

Best practices for ManimGL (Grant Sanderson's 3Blue1Brown version) - OpenGL-based animation engine with interactive development. Covers InteractiveScene, Tex with t2c, camera frame control, interactive mode (-se flag), 3D rendering, and checkpoint_paste() workflow.

NOT for Manim Community Edition (which uses `manim` imports and `manim` CLI).
description_zh:
**触发条件：**

(1) 用户提及 "maninggl"、"ManigL" 或 "3b1b maninm"，

(2) 代码中包含 `from maninglmode import *`，

(3) 用户运行 `maningl` CLI 命令，

(4) 与 InteractiveScene、self.frame、self.embed()、ShowCreation() 或 ManigL 特定模式进行交互。

**ManigL 最佳实践（Grant Sanderson 的 3Blue1Brown 版本）** —— 基于 OpenGL 的带交互开发的动画引擎，涵盖 InteractiveScene、带 t2c 的 Tex、相机取景控制、交互模式（-se 参数）、3D 渲染以及 checkpoint_paste() 工作流。

**不适用于 ManinG 社区版本（使用 `manin` 导入和 `manin` CLI）。**

description: Techniques for auditing and deciding the surface against the layers below — vocabulary, object consistency, completeness, feedback, hierarchy, accessibility
description_zh: 用于审查并判定表面与下层关系的技术——词汇、对象一致性、完整性、反馈、层级、可访问性

description: Stage 1 of Clinical ASR Flywheel. Use when bootstrapping a cycle: NVCF+MW disclosure, NVIDIA_API_KEY check, deps install, TTS+ASR smoke test.
description_zh: 临床 ASR 飞轮第一阶段。在初始化周期时使用：NVCF+MW 披露、NVIDIA_API_KEY 检查、依赖安装、TTS+ASR 冒烟测试。

description: Guide installing Earth2Studio via uv or pip, selecting model extras, and configuring the environment. Do NOT use for writing inference code, choosing models, or PhysicsNeMo questions.
description_zh: 关于通过 uv 或 pip 安装 Earth2Studio、选择模型附加组件以及配置环境的指南。不得用于编写推理代码、选择模型或解答 PhysicsNeMo 相关问题。

description: Establish who registered and who operates a domain using WHOIS, RDAP and DNS. Use when running a whois lookup, querying RDAP, digging A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA or CAA records, reading SPF includes, DKIM selectors or DMARC rua addresses, finding the registrar, registrant or nameservers, doing reverse DNS, PTR, ASN or netblock lookups, or hunting historical WHOIS and passive DNS. Applies to phishing and brand-abuse takedown, domain-dispute and UDRP evidence, vendor verification before payment, and infrastructure attribution. Reference at useosint.com/skills/who-owns-this-domain.
description_zh: 利用WHOIS、RDAP和DNS确定域名的注册者与运营者。适用于执行WHOIS查询、RDAP查询、查询A、AAAA、MX、NS、TXT、SOA或CAA记录，解析SPF include、DKIM选择器或DMARC rua地址，查找注册商、注册人或名称服务器，进行反向DNS、PTR、ASN或netblock查询，或查找历史WHOIS记录与被动DNS数据。适用于钓鱼及品牌滥用内容下架、域名纠纷与UDRP证据、付款前供应商核验，以及基础设施归属。参考 useosint.com/skills/who-owns-this-domain。

description: Swift Concurrency review and remediation for Swift 6.2+. Use when asked to review Swift Concurrency usage, improve concurrency compliance, or fix Swift concurrency compiler errors in a feature or file. Concrete actions include adding Sendable conformance, applying @MainActor annotations, resolving actor isolation warnings, fixing data race diagnostics, and migrating completion handlers to async/await.
description_zh: Swift 6.2+ 的 Swift 并发审查与整改。当被要求审查 Swift 并发的使用、提升并发合规性，或在功能或文件中修复 Swift 并发编译器错误时使用。具体措施包括添加 Sendable 一致性、应用 @MainActor 注解、解决 actor 隔离警告、修复数据竞争诊断，以及将完成回调迁移至 async/await。

description: Techniques for mapping interaction structure and flow — places, affordances, edge cases, and failure paths — without committing to visual form
description_zh: 映射交互结构与流程的技术——位置、可达性、边缘情况与失败路径——不锁定视觉形态

description: Guided statistical analysis for research data - test selection, assumption checking, effect sizes, power analysis, Bayesian alternatives, and APA-formatted reporting. Use whenever a user wants to compare groups, test a hypothesis, analyze experimental or survey data, check statistical assumptions, compute required sample sizes, or write up results - even if they never name a specific test. Covers t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square, correlation, regression, non-parametric and Bayesian methods. For low-level model APIs, see the statsmodels and pymc skills.
description_zh: 研究数据的引导式统计分析——检验选择、假设检查、效应量、功效分析、贝叶斯替代方案与APA格式报告。当用户需要比较组别、检验假设、分析实验或调查数据、检查统计假设、计算所需样本量或撰写结果时，可随时使用此功能，即使他们从未指定具体的检验方法。涵盖t检验、方差分析、卡方检验、相关性、回归分析、非参数方法及贝叶斯方法。针对低级模型API，请参阅statsmodels与pymc技能。

description: Design UIs in Pencil (.pen files) and generate production code from them. Use when working with .pen files, designing screens or components in Pencil, or generating code from Pencil designs. Triggers on tasks involving Pencil, .pen files, design-to-code workflows, or UI design with the Pencil MCP tools.
description_zh: 在 Pencil (.pen 文件) 中设计 UI（界面）并从中生成生产代码。适用于使用 .pen 文件、在 Pencil 中设计屏幕或组件，或根据 Pencil 设计生成代码的场景。在涉及 Pencil、.pen 文件、设计到代码的工作流，或使用 Pencil MCP 工具进行 UI 设计等任务时触发。

description: Render Mermaid diagrams as SVG and PNG using the Beautiful Mermaid library. Use when the user asks to render a Mermaid diagram.
description_zh: 使用 Beautiful Mermaid 库将 Mermaid 图表渲染为 SVG 和 PNG。当用户要求渲染 Mermaid 图表时使用。

description: Guides authentication in Nuxt apps using @nuxtjs/better-auth. Use when installing or configuring the module, using its client or server APIs, protecting routes, refreshing sessions, or integrating Better Auth plugins.
description_zh: 使用 @nuxtjs/better-auth 在 Nuxt 应用中引导认证。在安装或配置该模块、调用其客户端或服务器端 API、保护路由、刷新会话或集成 Better Auth 插件时使用。

description: Build self-serve acquisition and expansion motions. Use when deciding PLG vs sales-led, optimizing activation, driving freemium conversion, building growth equations, or recognizing when product complexity demands human touch. Includes the parallel test where sales-led won 10x on revenue.
description_zh: 构建自助获客与拓展举措。适用于在决定产品驱动增长（PLG）与销售主导模式、优化用户激活、推动免费增值转化、构建增长模型，或判断产品复杂性是否需要人工介入时使用。包含一项并行测试案例，该测试中销售主导模式在营收上实现了10倍增长。

description: Query the Ensembl database to resolve gene, transcript, and protein IDs, fetch genomic or protein sequences, retrieve gene structures (exons), and get variant consequence and effect predictions (VEP). Use this skill as a primary ID translator, genomic sequence database and variant effect prediction tool.
description_zh: 查询 Ensembl 数据库以解析基因、转录本和蛋白质 ID，获取基因组或蛋白质序列，检索基因结构（外显子），并获取变异后果和效应预测（VEP）。将此技能作为主要的 ID 翻译工具、基因组序列数据库以及变异效应预测工具使用。

description: Techniques for connecting user opportunities to business outcomes and solution bets, and testing the riskiest assumptions cheaply
description_zh: 用于将用户机会与企业成果及解决方案投注相连接，并以低成本测试风险最高假设的技巧

description: Stage 2 of the Clinical ASR Flywheel. Use when curating clinical terms, tagging IPA, and synthesizing a NeMo manifest. NOT for scoring (use /digital-health-clinical-asr-eval).
description_zh: 临床ASR飞轮第二阶段。在整理临床术语、标注IPA、合成NeMo清单时使用。不用于评分（使用 /digital-health-clinical-asr-eval）。

description: When the user wants to plan a social media content strategy, decide what to post, or figure out topic clusters and content mix. Also use when the user mentions 'content strategy,' 'what should I post,' 'content ideas,' 'topic clusters,' 'content pillars,' 'content planning,' 'content mix,' 'I don't know what to post,' or 'social media strategy.' Use this to define the what and why of posting. For writing actual posts, see post-writer-sms. For scheduling, see content-calendar-sms. For platform-specific tactics, see platform-strategy-sms.
description_zh: 当用户需要规划社交媒体内容策略、决定发布内容，或确定话题集群与内容配比时，使用此功能。当用户提及“内容策略”、“我应该发布什么”、“内容创意”、“话题集群”、“内容支柱”、“内容规划”、“内容配比”、“我不知道发布什么”或“社交媒体策略”时，同样适用此功能。使用此功能来明确发布内容的内容与目的。如需撰写实际帖子，请参阅 post-writer-sms；如需安排发布，请参阅 content-calendar-sms；如需制定特定平台策略，请参阅 platform-strategy-sms。

description: Searches for homologous protein sequences using MMseqs2 (fast, default) or BLAST (comprehensive, fallback). Trigger this whenever the user provides a protein sequence or FASTA file and asks to find homologues, sequence matches, or wants to infer protein function based on sequence similarity, but not when the user wants to infer protein function based on structural similarity.
description_zh: 同源蛋白序列搜索：使用 MMseqs2（快速、默认）或 BLAST（全面、备选）。当用户提供蛋白序列或 FASTA 文件，并要求查找同源蛋白、序列匹配，或基于序列相似性推断蛋白功能时触发此功能；但用户基于结构相似性推断蛋白功能时，不触发此功能。

description: 一本书 → 一幅清晰的「取景框」意向画面 → 一张 2050 图书馆借书卡（PNG）。取景框 = 作者从哪个角度看什么问题、看到了哪幅画面；卡上有真实封面、作者头像、书目信息。取景框 block 用费曼式讲解把这幅意向画面讲得通俗又准确；图解 block 用 AI 生图把这幅画面画出来，继刚是固定主角（从其墨像参考生成、认得出的他）。图解风格：吉田诚治式绘本感（异世界日常空间、暖光斜射、治愈又精致）。浅色光学玻璃卡身、强调色从封面动态提取、宽高自适应。合上书记住这幅画面，就没白读。Use when user says '取景框卡', '图书馆卡', 'library card', '书卡', '铸书卡', '一本书一句话一张卡', '/ljg-library', or provides a book name and wants it distilled into one collectible card. NOT FOR 拆书结构分析（用 ljg-book）、纯文字金句（用 ljg-card -b）、信息图（用 ljg-card -i）、视觉笔记（用 ljg-card -v）。
description_zh:
一本书 → 一幅清晰的「取景框」意向画面 → 一张 2050 图书馆借书卡（PNG）。取景框 = 作者从哪个角度看什么问题、看到了哪幅画面；卡上有真实封面、作者头像、书目信息。取景框 block 用费曼式讲解把这幅意向画面讲得通俗又准确；图解 block 用 AI 生图把这幅画面画出来，继刚是固定主角（从其墨像参考生成、认得出的他）。图解风格：吉田诚治式绘本感（异世界日常空间、暖光斜射、治愈又精致）。浅色光学玻璃卡身、强调色从封面动态提取、宽高自适应。合上书记住这幅画面，就没白读。

适用场景：当用户说出“取景框卡”、“图书馆卡”、“library card”、“书卡”、“铸书卡”、“一本书一句话一张卡”或提供书名并希望将其凝练为一张收藏级卡片时。不适用于：拆书结构分析（使用 ljg-book）、纯文字金句（使用 ljg-card -b）、信息图（使用 ljg-card -i）、视觉笔记（使用 ljg-card -v）。

description: Stage 4 of the Clinical ASR Flywheel. Use when priority KER is above 0.3 to run stock NeMo SFT on Parakeet TDT v2 and offline cycle N+1 re-eval. NOT for generic word boosting (use /finetune-asr).
description_zh: 临床 ASR 飞轮的第四阶段。当优先级 KER 高于 0.3 时使用，在 Parakeet TDT v2 上运行原始 NeMo SFT 并执行离线周期 N+1 重新评估。不用于通用词汇增强（使用 /finetune-asr）。

description: Playbook for launching, monitoring, stopping, and debugging NeMo-RL recipes on a Kubernetes cluster via the nrl-k8s CLI. Covers ephemeral vs long-lived RayCluster modes, iterating on runs, and debugging hung or failed training jobs.
description_zh: 通过 nrl-k8s CLI 在 Kubernetes 集群上启动、监控、停止和调试 NeMo-RL 配方的操作指南。涵盖临时与长期运行的 RayCluster 模式、在运行过程中迭代优化，以及调试卡死或失败的训练任务。

description: Use this skill to run top-level VSS fusion search on archived video, or to ingest video files / RTSP streams for search. Do NOT use for ad-hoc visual Q&A (use vss-ask-video), live captioning (use vss-deploy-dense-captioning), or video summarization and reports (use vss-summarize-video).
description_zh: 使用此技能对归档视频执行顶层 VSS 融合搜索，或将视频文件/RTSP 流摄取用于搜索。请勿将此技能用于即时视觉问答（请使用 vss-ask-video）、实时字幕（请使用 vss-deploy-dense-captioning）或视频摘要与报告（请使用 vss-summarize-video）。

description: Performs multiple sequence alignment of proteins with EBI Clustal Omega. Use when you need to align multiple sequences to assess similarity, domain conservation, or key residue conservation. Supports up to 4000 sequences and a maximum file size of 4 MB. Do not use to search for homologous proteins in a database (use MMseqs2, BLAST), align non-protein sequences (DNA, RNA), perform structural alignment (use Foldseek, PyMOL), or if you only have a single sequence.
description_zh: 使用 EBI Clustal Omega 对蛋白质进行多序列比对。当需要比对多条序列以评估序列相似性、结构域保守性或关键氨基酸残基保守性时使用。支持最多 4000 条序列，最大文件大小为 4 MB。不适用于在数据库中搜索同源蛋白（请使用 MMseqs2、BLAST）、比对非蛋白质序列（DNA、RNA）、进行结构比对（请使用 Foldseek、PyMOL），以及仅有一条序列的情况。

description: Diagnostic audit across all seven layers — identifies the bottleneck layer and recommends where to focus
description_zh: 覆盖全部七层的诊断审计——识别瓶颈层并建议重点关注的环节

description: Manages WhatsApp messaging through AWS End User Messaging Social. Covers managing templates (create, update, delete, library), sending messages (utility/marketing/auth templates and freeform), uploading and managing media, configuring event destinations for delivery tracking, and troubleshooting delivery failures. Applicable when a user needs to send WhatsApp messages, create or manage templates, upload media, configure delivery notifications, or diagnose messaging issues.
description_zh: 通过 AWS End User Messaging Social 管理 WhatsApp 消息。涵盖模板管理（创建、更新、删除、库管理）、消息发送（工具/营销/认证模板及自由格式）、媒体上传与管理、为投递跟踪配置事件目的地，以及投递故障排查。适用于用户需要发送 WhatsApp 消息、创建或管理模板、上传媒体、配置投递通知或诊断消息问题的场景。

description: Use when you want to retrieve semi-quantitative protein expression and spatial localisation data from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA).
description_zh: 用于从人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）获取半定量蛋白质表达与空间定位数据。

description: Query Open Targets Platform for target-disease associations, drug target discovery, tractability/safety data, genetics/omics evidence, known drugs, for therapeutic target identification.
description_zh: 在开放靶点平台（Open Targets）中查询靶点-疾病关联、药物靶点发现、药物可及性/安全性数据、遗传/组学证据、已知药物等信息，以用于治疗靶点识别。

description: Stage 3 of Clinical ASR Flywheel. Score a NeMo manifest, produce the five-section KER leaderboard (by-ipa_source diagnostic). Not for ASR auth (/riva-asr).
description_zh: 临床 ASR 飞轮第 3 阶段：对 NeMo 清单进行评分，生成五段式 KER 排行榜（按 ipa_source 诊断）。不用于 ASR 认证（/riva-asr）。

description: Use people-search aggregators and primary public records to find addresses, phone numbers, relatives, age and background on a person, and to audit and remove your own exposure. Covers Spokeo, BeenVerified, Whitepages, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, That'sThem, Radaris, Intelius and Pipl, plus voter files and county court and property records. Use when running a people search or reverse address lookup, tracing a debtor or missing person, building a subject's address history, or removing yourself from broker sites. Applies to skip tracing and debt recovery, asset investigation, executive protection, and personal exposure audits. Explains the FCRA limits that bar broker data from employment, tenancy, insurance and credit decisions, and the GDPR position. Reference at useosint.com/skills/dig-through-data-brokers.
description_zh: 使用人员搜索聚合器和主要公共记录来查找某人的地址、电话号码、亲属关系、年龄和背景，并审计和消除自身的暴露风险。涵盖 Spokeo、BeenVerified、Whitepages、TruePeopleSearch、FastPeopleSearch、That'sThem、RadarIs、Intelius 和 Pipl，以及选民文件、县级法院和财产记录。当进行人员搜索或反向地址查询、追踪债务人或失踪人员、构建某人的地址历史，或从中介网站中清除自身信息时使用。适用于跳跃追踪、债务追偿、资产调查、高管保护以及个人暴露审计。解释了 FCRA 的限制，这些限制禁止将中介数据用于就业、租户、保险和信贷决策，以及 GDPR 的相关立场。参考网址 useosint.com/skills/dig-through-data-brokers。

description: Use when the user wants to know what will break if they change something, or needs safety analysis before editing code. Examples: "Is it safe to change X?", "What depends on this?", "What will break?"
description_zh: 当用户想要了解更改某处后会引发什么（崩溃、报错或其他问题），或在编辑代码前需要安全性分析时使用。示例：“X 更改是否安全？”，“该功能依赖什么？”，“会出现什么问题？”

description: Recommend and customize Megatron Bridge library and benchmark recipes for a user's model, GPU count, hardware, sequence length, and pretrain/SFT/PEFT goal. Use when selecting a starting recipe, comparing library and benchmark configs, resizing parallelism for a GPU allocation, or distinguishing convergence changes, semantics-preserving execution tuning, and benchmark-only shortcuts.
description_zh: 根据用户的模型、GPU 数量、硬件、序列长度以及预训练/SFT/PEFT 的目标，推荐并定制 Megatron Bridge 库和基准测试配方。适用于选择起始配方、对比库和基准测试配置、调整 GPU 分配中的并行度，以及区分收敛性变化、语义保持的执行调优和仅用于基准测试的快捷方式。

description: Swift iOS architecture guidance and playbooks for MVVM, MVI, TCA, Clean Architecture, VIPER, MVP, Coordinator, and Reactive patterns. Use when designing, implementing, refactoring, or reviewing the architecture of a SwiftUI or UIKit feature, module, or codebase.
description_zh: Swift iOS 架构的 MVVM、MVI、TCA、Clean Architecture、VIPER、MVP、协调器及响应式模式指南与最佳实践。适用于设计、实现、重构或审查 SwiftUI 或 UIKit 功能、模块或代码库的架构。

description:
Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when the user mentions
'sounds like AI,' 'too robotic,' 'humanize this,' 'make it sound human,'
'de-AI this,' 'sounds like ChatGPT,' 'make it natural,' or 'doesn't sound
like a person wrote it.' Detects and fixes AI writing patterns including
inflated significance, promotional language, formulaic structure, AI vocabulary,
superficial analyses, vague attributions, hedging, robotic rhythm, em dash and
boldface overuse, chatbot artifacts, and missing personality. Based on
Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide and editorial best practices.
description_zh: 从文本中去除AI生成内容的痕迹。当用户提到“听起来像AI”“过于机械”“将本文人性化”“使其听起来有人性”“将本文去AI化”“听起来像ChatGPT”“使其更自然”“听起来不像人写的”时使用。检测并修正AI写作模式，包括夸大重要性、宣传性语言、程式化结构、AI词汇、表面分析、模糊归因、留有余地的表述、机械节奏、破折号和加粗字体的过度使用、聊天机器人特征以及缺乏个性。基于维基百科《人工智能写作的迹象》指南和编辑最佳实践。

description: Search Slack for interpreted organizational context -- decisions, constraints, and discussion arcs -- and produce a synthesized research digest with cross-cutting analysis. Use when the user says 'search slack for', 'what did we discuss about', 'slack context for', or 'what does the team think about'. Differs from slack:find-discussions, which returns raw message results without synthesis.
description_zh: 在 Slack 中搜索解读后的组织上下文——决策、约束和讨论脉络——，并生成包含交叉分析的综合研究简报。当用户说出 'search slack for'、'what did we discussed about'、'slack context for' 或 'what does the team think about' 时使用此功能。该功能与 slack:find-discussions 不同，后者返回未经合成的原始消息结果。

description: Analyzes genetic variant effects on gene expression (RNA-seq), chromatin accessibility (DNASE), histone marks (ChIP), and transcription factors using the AlphaGenome API. Use when the user asks about non-coding variant effects, pathogenicity, clinical significance, disease associations, functional effects, gene expression changes, splicing disruption, or regulatory effects in promoters and enhancers. Also use for resolving biological terms to tissue/cell-type ontologies (UBERON/CL) or analyzing variants in chr:pos:ref>alt format.
description_zh: 使用 AlphaGenome API 分析遗传变异对基因表达（RNA-seq）、染色质可及性（DNASE）、组蛋白标记（ChIP）和转录因子的影响。当用户询问非编码变异效应、致病性、临床意义、疾病关联、功能效应、基因表达变化、剪接破坏或启动子和增强子中的调控效应时使用。此外，也用于将生物学术语解析为组织/细胞类型本体（UBERON/CL），或分析格式为 chr:pos:ref > alt 的变异。

description:
Background removal: transparent PNGs, cutouts, product photos, portraits, pets, group photos.
Uses dedicated Bria RMBG 2.0 model — no prompt needed, fast (~3s), cheap ($0.01).

Use when removing backgrounds, creating transparent PNGs, making cutouts, extracting foreground subjects, or preparing images for compositing.
description_zh:
背景去除：透明PNG图、抠图、产品照片、人像、宠物、合影。
采用专用的Bria RMBG 2.0模型——无需提示词，快速（约3秒），便宜（$0.01）。

适用于去除背景、创建透明PNG图、制作抠图、提取前景主体，或为图像合成做准备。

description: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis on scientific data files across 200+ file formats. This skill should be used when analyzing any scientific data file to understand its structure, content, quality, and characteristics. Automatically detects file type and generates detailed markdown reports with format-specific analysis, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations. Covers chemistry, bioinformatics, microscopy, spectroscopy, proteomics, metabolomics, and general scientific data formats.
description_zh: 在 200+ 种文件格式的科学数据文件上，进行全面的探索性数据分析。当需要分析任何科学数据文件以了解其结构、内容、质量及特性时，应使用此技能。该技能可自动检测文件类型，并生成详细的 Markdown 报告，报告包含格式特定分析、质量指标及下游分析建议。覆盖化学、生物信息学、显微学、光谱学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学及通用科学数据格式。

description: Techniques for mapping a domain's concepts, terminology conflicts, and bounded contexts — the raw material the conceptual model is built from
description_zh: 用于映射领域概念、术语冲突与有限上下文的技术——概念模型构建的原始素材

description: 剪映 (JianYing) AI自动化剪辑的高级封装 API (JyWrapper)，提供开箱即用的 Python 接口，支持录屏、素材导入、字幕生成、Web 动效合成及项目导出。全面适配 MacOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) 与 Windows，支持 v5.9+ (draft_info.json) 架构、工程自修复、智能配音字幕及录屏变焦。
description_zh: 剪映 (JianYing) AI自动化剪辑的高级封装 API (JyWrapper)，提供开箱即用的 Python 接口，支持录屏、素材导入、字幕生成、Web 动效合成及项目导出。全面适配 MacOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) 与 Windows，支持 v5.9+ (draft_info.json) 架构、工程自修复、智能配音字幕及录屏变焦。

description: Validate and use selective and full activation recompute in Megatron Bridge to reduce GPU memory usage at the cost of extra compute. Use for activation memory OOMs or regressions involving recompute_granularity, recompute_num_layers, recompute_modules, recompute_method, selective recompute, full recompute, or activation checkpointing.
description_zh: 在Megatron Bridge中验证并使用选择性激活重计算和完整激活重计算，以额外的计算开销为代价降低GPU显存占用。适用于激活内存OOM或涉及recompute_granularity、recompute_num_layers、recompute_modules、recompute_method、选择性重计算、完整重计算或激活检查点的情况。

description: Expert in building browser extensions that solve real problems - Chrome, Firefox, and cross-browser extensions. Covers extension architecture, manifest v3, content scripts, popup UIs, monetization strategies, and Chrome Web Store publishing.
description_zh: 擅长构建解决实际问题的浏览器扩展专家—支持 Chrome、Firefox 及跨浏览器扩展。涵盖扩展架构、Manifest v3、内容脚本、弹窗 UI、变现策略以及 Chrome Web Store 上架发布。

description: Symbolicate .NET runtime frames in Apple platform .ips crash logs (iOS, tvOS, Mac Catalyst, macOS). Extracts UUIDs and addresses from the native backtrace, locates dSYM debug symbols, and runs atos to produce function names with source file and line numbers. Automatically downloads .dwarf symbols from the Microsoft symbol server using Mach-O UUIDs. USE FOR triaging a .NET MAUI or Mono app crash from an .ips file on any Apple platform, resolving native backtrace frames in libcoreclr or libmonosgen-2.0 to .NET runtime source code, retrieving .ips crash logs from a connected iOS device or iPhone, or investigating EXC_CRASH, EXC_BAD_ACCESS, SIGABRT, or SIGSEGV originating from the .NET runtime. DO NOT USE FOR pure Swift/Objective-C crashes with no .NET components, or Android tombstone files. INVOKES Symbolicate-Crash.ps1 script, atos, dwarfdump, idevicecrashreport.
description_zh:
将 Apple 平台（iOS、tvOS、Mac Catalyst、macOS）的 .ips 崩溃日志中的 .NET 运行时帧符号化。从原生回溯中提取 UUID 和地址，定位 dSYM 调试符号，并运行 atos 以生成带源文件和行号的函数名。通过 Mach-O UUID 自动从 Microsoft 符号服务器下载 .dwarf 符号。

用途：对任何 Apple 平台上源自 .ips 文件的 .NET MAUI 或 Mono 应用崩溃进行排查，将 libcoreclr 或 libmonosgen-2.0 中的原生回溯帧解析为 .NET 运行时源代码，从已连接的 iOS 设备或 iPhone 获取 .ips 崩溃日志，或调查源自 .NET 运行时的 EXC_CRASH、EXC_BAD_ACCESS、SIGABRT 或 SIGSEGV。

不可用于无 .NET 组件的纯 Swift/Objective-C 崩溃，或 Android tombstone 文件。

调用 Symbolicate-Crash.ps1 脚本、atos、dwarfdump 和 idevicecrashreport。

description: Techniques for eliciting and prioritising user needs, pains, and desires — the opportunities that feed product strategy
description_zh: 收集和优先排序用户需求、痛点与渴望的技术——这些机会为产品策略注入动力

description: Find Earth2Studio models, data sources, and examples for a weather/climate use case. Do NOT use for writing inference code, downloading data, or installation.
description_zh: 查找适用于天气/气候用例的 Earth2Studio 模型、数据源和示例。请勿用于编写推理代码、下载数据或安装。

description: Use this skill when producing a VSS analysis report — Mode A per-clip VLM, Mode B incident-range via video-analytics. Not for standalone video summarization, real-time alerts or ad-hoc Q&A.
description_zh: 在生成VSS分析报告时使用本技能——模式A：逐片段视觉语言模型（VLM），模式B：基于视频分析的事件范围分析。不适用于独立视频摘要、实时告警或临时问答。

description: Specify one micro-interaction completely — trigger, rules, feedback, loops, and modes. Use when handing a single interaction to engineering. For motion craft alone use `animation-principles`; for multi-state components use `state-machine`.
description_zh: 完全定义一个微交互——触发、规则、反馈、循环与模式。当将单个交互交付给工程团队时使用。仅针对动态制作，使用 `animation-principles`；针对多状态组件，使用 `state-machine`。

description: You MUST use this when interacting with or testing local web applications with Playwright - verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, or viewing browser console logs.
description_zh: 您必须在使用 Playwright 与本地 Web 应用交互或测试时使用此——验证前端功能、调试 UI 行为、捕获浏览器截图，或查看浏览器控制台日志。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

Use when you want to look up, map, and search for short genetic variants (SNPs, indels) in NCBI's dbSNP database. Resolves between rsIDs, genomic coordinates in VCF format, and HGVS strings. For an rsID, returns variant type, gene associations, clinical significance, allele frequencies, and genomic coordinates (GRCh38).
description_zh: 适用于在 NCBI 的 dbSNP 数据库中查询、映射和搜索短遗传变异（SNPs、indels）。在 rsID、VCF 格式的基因组坐标和 HGVS 字符串之间进行转换。针对 rsID，返回变异类型、基因关联、临床意义、等位基因频率以及基因组坐标（GRCh38）。

description: Search 18 scholarly APIs for papers, preprints, citations, open-access full text, repository records, and journal OA status, and return results with reproducible provenance. Covers PubMed, PMC, Europe PMC, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, CORE, Unpaywall, OpenCitations, PubTator3, Zenodo, Figshare, ROR, BioStudies, and DOAJ. Use when searching for papers, citations, DOI/PMID/arXiv lookups, abstracts, full text, open-access PDFs, preprints, citation graphs, author publications, biomedical entity annotations, deposited records (Zenodo, Figshare, BioStudies), institution ROR IDs, or any scholarly literature query. Triggers on mentions of any supported database or requests like "find papers on X", "look up this DOI", "who cites this paper", or "get me the PDF".
description_zh:
检索 18 个学术 API，用于获取论文、预印本、引用、开放获取全文、仓库记录及期刊开放获取（OA）状态，并以可复现的溯源信息返回结果。覆盖的数据库包括 PubMed、PMC、Europe PMC、bioRxiv、medRxiv、arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、CORE、Unpaywall、OpenCitations、PubTator3、Zenodo、Figshare、ROR、BioStudies 和 DOAJ。

适用于检索论文、引用、DOI/PMID/arXiv 查询、摘要、全文、开放获取 PDF、预印本、引用图谱、作者发表记录、生物医学实体注释、已存档记录（Zenodo、Figshare、BioStudies）、机构 ROR ID，或进行任何学术文献查询时使用。当提及任何受支持的数据库，或提出诸如"在 X 上查找论文"、"查询此 DOI"、"谁引用了这篇论文"或"给我 PDF"等请求时触发。

description: Used for converting one CT DICOM series folder to a HU NIfTI volume with affine evidence. Not for multi-frame DICOM or clinical use.
description_zh: 用于将单个 CT DICOM 序列文件夹转换为带仿射证据的 HU NIfTI 体。不适用于多帧 DICOM 或临床用途。

description: Help users create compelling product visions. Use when someone is writing a vision statement, defining a long-term product direction, aligning teams on the future state, or distinguishing vision from strategy.
description_zh: 帮助用户创建具有说服力的产品愿景。适用于撰写愿景声明、明确长期产品方向、统一团队对未来状态的认知，以及区分愿景与战略的场景。

description: Install vigiles and test a Claude Code harness — hooks, skills, agents, settings, CLAUDE.md — by picking the right tier (unit / deterministic / eval) and writing a test that passes. Use to check that a hook fires or blocks, that a skill triggers, that injected context lands; or to observe a run — which tools it called, whether it stayed inside its declared allowed-tools, what files and side effects it produced, how to intercept a call without executing it.
description_zh: 安装 vigiles 并测试 Claude Code 框架（hooks、skills、agents、settings、CLAUDE.md）——通过选择正确的层级（单元/确定性/评估）编写通过的测试。用于检查钩子是否触发或阻止、技能是否触发、注入的上下文是否生效；或用于观察运行——它调用了哪些工具、是否保持在声明的允许工具范围内、产生了哪些文件和副作用，以及如何在不执行调用的情况下拦截调用。

description: Turn a website's observable HTTP traffic into a best-effort OpenAPI 3.1 spec by analyzing a `browser-trace` capture. Use when the user wants to discover/extract API endpoints from a browser session, build an OpenAPI doc from network traffic, or document a third-party site's XHR/fetch surface for client integration.
description_zh: 通过分析 `browser-trace` 捕获，将网站的可见 HTTP 流量转换为尽力而为的 OpenAPI 3.1 规范。当用户需要从浏览器会话中发现/提取 API 端点、从网络流量构建 OpenAPI 文档，或为客户端集成记录第三方网站的 XHR/fetch 接口面时使用。

description: Query the Reactome database (Analysis and Content Services). Use when the user asks about pathway analysis, gene list enrichment, retrieving results by token, finding unmapped or not-found identifiers, mapping identifiers, reaction participants (inputs, outputs), pathway hierarchy (including top-level pathways), diagram export, cross-reference mapping, or searching the knowledgebase.
description_zh: 查询 Reactome 数据库（Analysis and Content Services）。当用户询问通路分析、基因列表富集分析、按 token 获取结果、查找未映射或未找到的标识符、标识符映射、反应参与者（输入、输出）、通路层级（包括顶层通路）、图表导出、交叉引用映射或搜索知识库时使用。

description: Fetch weather/climate data via Earth2Studio data sources for specific variables and times. Do NOT use for inference pipelines, model discovery, or installation.
description_zh: 通过 Earth2Studio 数据源获取特定变量和时间的天气/气候数据。请勿用于推理流水线、模型发现或安装。

description: Build deterministic forecast scripts with Earth2Studio (model, data source, IO, inference). Do NOT use for ensemble, diagnostics, data-only fetch, or install.
description_zh: 使用 Earth2Studio 构建确定性预测脚本（模型、数据源、I/O、推理）。请勿用于集成、诊断、仅获取数据或安装。

description: Deploy and operate the RTVI-CV-3D microservice as MV3DT (`MODE=mv3dt`): per-camera DeepStream perception plus BEV Fusion over calibrated cameras. Supports the bundled sample dataset, custom video files, and RTSP streams, and chains to `vss-generate-video-calibration` when calibration is missing. Use `vss-deploy-profile` for the full warehouse blueprint and `vss-deploy-detection-tracking-2d` for single-camera 2D detection.
description_zh: 以 MV3DT（`MODE=mv3dt`）部署并运行 RTVI-CV-3D 微服务：基于校准相机进行逐相机 DeepStream 感知与 BEV 融合。支持随附示例数据集、自定义视频文件和 RTSP 流，并在缺少校准数据时链式调用 `vss-generate-video-calibration`。使用 `vss-deploy-profile` 部署完整仓库蓝图，使用 `vss-deploy-detection-tracking-2d` 进行单相机 2D 检测。

description: Identify domains, families, and sites in proteins; find all proteins in a family or sharing a domain; explore species distribution for a domain; annotate genomes with protein families and GO terms. InterPro combines 14 databases (e.g., Pfam, CDD) into one searchable resource. InterPro-N significantly expands annotation and sequence coverage with deep learning. Includes domain architecture (IDA) search.
description_zh: 识别蛋白质中的结构域、家族和位点；查找同一家族或具有相同结构域的所有蛋白质；探索结构域在物种中的分布；使用蛋白质家族和GO术语对基因组进行注释。InterPro将14个数据库（例如Pfam、CDD）整合为一个可搜索的资源。InterPro-N借助深度学习显著扩展了注释和序列覆盖范围。包含结构域架构（IDA）搜索。

description: Query the STRING database for protein-protein interactions (PPIs), functional enrichment, and homology. Use when the user asks about interactions between specific proteins, interaction evidence, confidence scores, protein interaction partners, or pathway enrichments.
description_zh: 查询 STRING 数据库中的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）、功能富集和同源关系。在用户询问特定蛋白质之间的相互作用、相互作用证据、置信度评分、蛋白质相互作用伙伴或通路富集时使用。

description: Run Megatron-LM (MLM) and Megatron Bridge training with mock or real data. Covers correlation testing, available recipes, and multi-GPU examples.
description_zh: 使用模拟数据或真实数据运行 Megatron-LM（MLM）和 Megatron Bridge 训练。涵盖相关性测试、可用配方以及多 GPU 示例。

description: Redis observability guidance — which metrics to monitor (memory, connections, hit ratio, ops/sec, rejected connections), which built-in commands to reach for during incident triage (SLOWLOG, INFO, MEMORY DOCTOR, CLIENT LIST, FT.PROFILE), and when to use the Redis Insight GUI. Use when setting up monitoring or alerts for a Redis instance, diagnosing a performance regression, profiling a slow FT.SEARCH query, or wiring Redis metrics into Prometheus, Datadog, or similar.
description_zh: Redis 可观测性指南——应监控哪些指标（内存、连接数、命中率、每秒操作数、被拒绝连接数），在事故排查时应使用哪些内置命令（SLOWLOG、INFO、MEMORY DOCTOR、CLIENT LIST、FT.PROFILE），以及何时使用 Redis Insight 图形界面。适用于为 Redis 实例设置监控或告警、诊断性能回归问题、对缓慢的 FT.SEARCH 查询进行性能剖析，或将 Redis 指标接入 Prometheus、Datadog 或类似系统时使用。

description: Help users master the art of proactive communication and alignment with their managers and founders to unlock autonomy, secure resources, and drive business impact.
description_zh: 帮助用户掌握与管理者及创始人主动沟通与协同对齐的艺术，以解锁自主性、保障资源并提升业务影响力。

description: Manages spartan/ui, the Angular UI library - adding, composing, fixing, debugging, and styling UI with the Brain (headless primitives) and Helm (styled) layers. Provides project context, component APIs, and usage examples. Applies when working with spartan/ui, @spartan-ng/brain, @spartan-ng/helm, the @spartan-ng/cli generators, or any Angular project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "spartan init", "add a spartan component", or "set up spartan/ui".
description_zh: 管理 spartan/ui（Angular UI 库）——使用 Brain（无头原语）和 Helm（已样式）层对 UI 进行添加、组合、修复、调试与样式化。提供项目上下文、组件 API 和使用示例。当使用 spartan/ui、@spartan-ng/brain、@spartan-ng/helm、@spartan-ng/cli 生成器，或在任何包含 components.json 文件的 Angular 项目时生效。亦适用于执行“spartan init”、“添加 spartan 组件”或“设置 spartan/ui”等操作。

description: Use when YouTube is or could be relevant — even if not mentioned: pasted video/channel/playlist links, video IDs, @handles, creator lookups, video summaries, quotes, translations, topic research, tutorials, talks, lectures, expert discussions, product reviews, how-to guides, new product announcements, first looks, or anything where video content is fresher or richer than text search. Covers transcripts, video/channel search, channel browsing, playlists, and within-channel search. Not for uploads, account management, or written-source-only research.
description_zh: 当YouTube相关内容适用或可能被引用时使用（即使未提及）：包括粘贴的视频、频道或播放列表链接，视频ID，@用户名，创作者检索，视频摘要，引文，翻译，主题研究，教程，演讲，讲座，专家讨论，产品评测，操作指南，新品发布，首次亮相，以及任何视频内容比文本搜索更新鲜、更丰富的场景。涵盖字幕、视频与频道搜索、频道浏览、播放列表及频道内搜索。不适用于上传、账户管理或仅基于文本资料的研究。

description: Query and search the EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) for biomedical ontology terms, definitions, and hierarchies across 250+ ontologies (e.g., GO, DOID, HP). Use when the user asks to search for terms, retrieve details, navigate hierarchies (parents, children, ancestors), look up properties and individuals, get autocomplete suggestions, or access ontology metadata and statistics.
description_zh: 查询和搜索 EMBL-EBI 本体查找服务（OLS）中的生物医学本体术语、定义和层级结构，涵盖 250 多个本体（例如 GO、DOID、HP）。当用户要求搜索术语、检索详细信息、浏览层级结构（父节点、子节点、祖先节点）、查询属性和个体、获取自动补全建议或访问本体元数据和统计信息时使用。

description: Practical guidance for training MoE VLMs in Megatron Bridge. Compares FSDP and 3D-parallel approaches, using rounded lessons from Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-Next, and other multimodal experiments.
description_zh: 在 Megatron Bridge 中训练 MoE VLMs 的实践指导。本文对比了 FSDP 与 3D 并行方法，并基于 Qwen3-VL、Qwen3-Next 及其他多模态实验所积累的实战经验。

description: Use to select, configure, deploy, verify, debug, or tear down a VSS profile (base, search, lvs, warehouse, edge). Not for standalone microservices — use the vss-deploy-* skill.
description_zh: 用于选择、配置、部署、验证、调试或拆除 VSS 配置文件（基础、搜索、lvs、仓库、边缘）。不适用于独立微服务，请使用 vss-deploy-* 技能。

description: 百度 AI 搜索。支持网页搜索、百度百科、秒懂百科、AI 智能生成四种模式。自动包含当前日期上下文。当用户要求搜索信息、查询百科、获取最新资讯、搜索新闻、查找资料时使用。
description_zh: 百度 AI 搜索。支持网页搜索、百度百科、秒懂百科、AI 智能生成四种模式。自动包含当前日期上下文。当用户要求搜索信息、查询百科、获取最新资讯、搜索新闻、查找资料时使用。

description: Specify wireframe layout — content priority, component placement, and annotation. Use when defining structure before visual design. For grid mechanics, use `layout-grid` (ui-design).
description_zh: 指定线框布局——内容优先级、组件位置与标注。用于在视觉设计之前定义结构。对于网格机制，请使用 `layout-grid`（ui-design）。

description: Plan and break down user-story issues into ordered, traceable task issue drafts with explicit publish gates.
description_zh: 规划并分解用户故事问题，形成带有明确发布门禁的有序、可追溯的任务问题草稿。

description: Make a demo of a research paper in a marimo notebook fully automatically without extra user input.
description_zh: 完全自动地在 marimo 笔记本中生成一份研究论文的演示，且无需额外用户输入。

description: Validate and use MoE expert-parallel communication overlap in Megatron-Bridge, including overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm, delay_wgrad_compute, and flex dispatcher backends such as DeepEP and HybridEP.
description_zh: 在 Megatron-Bridge 中验证并使用 MoE专家并行通信重叠，包括 overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm、delay_wgrad_compute，以及 DeepEP 和 HybridEP 等灵活调度后端。

description: Validate and use packed sequences and long-context training in Megatron-Bridge, including offline LLM packing, collate-time VLM packing, Energon online packing, and CP constraints.
description_zh: 在 Megatron-Bridge 中验证并采用打包序列与长上下文训练，包括离线 LLM 打包、收集阶段 VLM 打包、Energon 在线打包及 CP 约束。

description: Apply Strunk's timeless writing rules to ANY prose humans will read—documentation, commit messages, error messages, explanations, reports, or UI text. Makes your writing clearer, stronger, and more professional.
description_zh: 将 Strunk 永不过时的写作规则应用于任何人类会阅读的文本——文档、提交信息、错误信息、说明、报告或界面文本。让你的写作更清晰、更有力量、更专业。

description: Performs 3D structural searches of proteins against various databases (PDB, AlphaFold, CATH, MGnify, etc.) using the Foldseek API. Use ONLY when the user provides a physical 3D coordinate file (.cif, .mmcif, or .pdb) and wants to find structurally similar proteins. Do NOT use if the user only provides a protein sequence, gene name, or UniProt ID.
description_zh: 利用Foldseek API对蛋白质执行针对各类数据库（PDB、AlphaFold、CATH、MGnify等）的3D结构搜索。仅在用户提供物理3D坐标文件（.cif、.mmcif或.pdb）并希望查找结构相似蛋白质时使用。若用户仅提供蛋白质序列、基因名称或UniProt ID，则不得使用。

description: Convert single-node scripts to multi-node Slurm sbatch jobs and debug common multi-node failures. Covers srun-native vs uv run torch.distributed approaches, container setup, NCCL timeouts, OOM sizing for MoE models, and interactive allocation.
description_zh: 将单节点脚本转换为多节点 Slurm sbatch 作业，并排查常见多节点故障。涵盖 srun 原生方式与 uv run torch.distributed 方式、容器配置、NCCL 超时、MoE 模型的 OOM 内存配置，以及交互式资源分配。

description: Evidence-gated workflow for MoE performance optimization in Megatron Bridge. Covers measurement contracts, the Three Walls framework, parallel folding, profiling, matched A/B tuning, and final validation.
description_zh: Megatron Bridge 中面向混合专家模型性能优化的证据门控工作流。涵盖度量合约、Three Walls 框架、并行折叠、性能剖析、匹配的 A/B 调优和最终验证。

description: Operational guide for choosing and combining parallelism strategies in Megatron Bridge, including sizing rules, hardware topology mapping, and combined parallelism configuration.
description_zh: Megatron Bridge 并行策略选择与组合操作指南，包括规模规则、硬件拓扑映射及组合并行配置。

description: Add a new cuTile GPU kernel operator to TileGym. Covers dispatch registration in ops.py, cuTile backend implementation, __init__.py exports, test creation, and benchmark in tests/benchmark. Use when adding, creating, or implementing a new cuTile operator/kernel in TileGym, or when asking how to register a new cuTile op.
description_zh: 在 TileGym 中添加新的 cuTile GPU 内核算子。涵盖 ops.py 中的调度注册、cuTile 后端实现、__init__.py 导出、测试创建，以及 tests/benchmark 中的基准测试。在 TileGym 中添加、创建或实现新的 cuTile 算子/内核时使用，或在询问如何注册新的 cuTile 算子时使用。

description: Use when making UI/frontend changes guided by visual context, when the user selects elements visually, draws annotations, or provides screenshots alongside change requests. Also use when editing components where spatial context (element identity, DOM references, layout data) supplements text instructions.
description_zh: 适用于基于视觉上下文进行UI/前端更改、用户通过视觉方式选择元素、绘制标注，或提供与更改请求相关的截图等场景。也适用于编辑组件时，空间上下文（元素标识、DOM引用、布局数据）补充文本说明的情形。

description: Creates an integration testing plan for .NET data access artifacts during Oracle-to-PostgreSQL database migrations. Analyzes a single project to identify repositories, DAOs, and service layers that interact with the database, then produces a structured testing plan. Use when planning integration test coverage for a migrated project, identifying which data access methods need tests, or preparing for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration validation.
description_zh: 在 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移期间，为 .NET 数据访问制品创建集成测试计划。分析单个项目，以识别与数据库交互的仓储、DAO 和服务层，并生成结构化的测试计划。适用于为迁移后的项目规划集成测试覆盖、识别需要测试的数据访问方法，或准备 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移验证。

description: Comprehensive guide for FinLab quantitative trading package across global stock markets (TW, US, KR, JP, HK; both single-name equities and ETFs/funds). Use when working with trading strategies, backtesting, stock data, FinLabDataFrame, factor analysis, stock selection, or when the user mentions FinLab, trading, quant trading, US equity, S&P 500 / NASDAQ 100, SPY / QQQ, sector or leveraged ETFs, ETF rotation, 美股, or stock market analysis. Includes data access, strategy development, backtesting workflows, best practices, and US-market specifics (data availability map, filing-date-aligned quarterly fundamentals, US universe construction, USMarket vs. USFundMarket defaults, and ETF backtesting).
description_zh: 全球股票市场FinLab量化交易包综合指南（TW、US、KR、JP、HK，涵盖个股与ETF/基金）。适用于在使用交易策略、回测、股票数据、FinLabDataFrame、因子分析、选股，或当用户提及FinLab、交易、量化交易、美股、标普500/纳斯达克100、SPY/QQQ、行业或杠杆ETF、ETF轮动、美股或股票市场分析时。内容包括数据访问、策略开发、回测流程、最佳实践，以及美国市场特定内容（数据可用性地图、与申报日期对齐的季度基本面、美国标的池构建、USMarket与USFundMarket默认设置和ETF回测）。

description: Validate and use CPU offloading in Megatron Bridge, including layer-level activation offloading and fractional optimizer state offloading with HybridDeviceOptimizer.
description_zh: 验证并应用 Megatron Bridge 中的 CPU 卸载功能，包括使用 HybridDeviceOptimizer 进行层级激活卸载和分数优化器状态卸载。

description: Summarize Douyin (TikTok China) videos by extracting audio, transcribing with whisper.cpp, and generating structured summaries. Use when a user shares a Douyin link and wants a text summary of the video content. Supports optional sync to Feishu (Lark) docs. Triggers on Douyin URLs (v.douyin.com, douyin.com/video/).
description_zh: 通过提取音频、使用 whisper.cpp 进行转写并生成结构化摘要，对抖音（TikTok中国）视频进行总结。当用户分享抖音链接并希望获取视频内容的文本摘要时使用。支持可选同步至飞书（Lark）文档。支持基于抖音网址（v.douyin.com、douyin.com/video/）触发。

description: Agent harness performance system for Claude Code and other AI coding agents — skills, instincts, memory, hooks, commands, and security scanning
description_zh: 适用于 Claude Code 及其他 AI 编码智能体的智能体工具链性能系统——技能、本能、记忆、钩子、命令及安全扫描

description: Generate a weekly performance summary from closed trader-memory-core theses — win rate, expectancy, profit factor, R-multiple, MAE/MFE, and win/loss pattern analysis by source skill, exit reason, thesis type, sector, and mechanism. No API required; pure local calculation.
description_zh: 基于 trader-memory-core 已结束的交易案例，生成每周绩效总结——包括胜率、期望值、盈利因子、R-倍数、MAE/MFE，以及按来源技能、退出原因、案例类型、板块和机制进行的胜败模式分析。无需 API，纯本地计算。

description: Odoo 19 development knowledge base with 18 specialized guides covering Actions (ir.actions.*, cron jobs, server actions), Controllers (HTTP routing, endpoints, auth types), Data files (XML/CSV records, shortcuts, noupdate), API Decorators (@api.depends, @api.constrains, @api.ondelete, @api.onchange, @api.model, @api.private), SQL Constraints (models.Constraint replacing _sql_constraints), Database Indexes (models.Index), Module development (manifest, wizards, reports), Field types (Char, Text, Monetary, relational fields), Manifest configuration (__manifest__.py, dependencies, asset bundles), Mixins (mail.thread, mail.activity.mixin, mail.alias.mixin, utm.mixin), ORM Model methods (search, CRUD, domain filters, recordsets, CamelCase model naming), Migration scripts (pre/post/end hooks, data migration), OWL frontend components (hooks, services, lifecycle), Performance optimization (N+1 prevention, batch ops, _read_group), QWeb Reports (PDF/HTML, paper formats, barcodes, t-out), Security/ACL (record rules, field permissions, privilege-based groups, @api.private), Testing (TransactionCase, HttpCase, mocking, query count assertions), Transactions (savepoints, UniqueViolation, serialization failures), Translations (i18n, PO files, translatable fields), XML Views (list/form/search, kanban card templates, xpath inheritance, QWeb templates). Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging any Odoo 19 Python or XML code, creating or modifying modules, fixing performance issues, or looking up Odoo 19 API patterns and best practices. Includes CSS/SCSS asset authoring and review for Odoo addons.
description_zh:
**Odoo 19 开发知识库**（包含 18 个专项指南，覆盖……）。在编写、审查、调试任何 Odoo 19 Python 或 XML 代码时使用；在创建或修改模块时使用；在解决性能问题时使用；用于查找 Odoo 19 API 模式与最佳实践。包含 Odoo 插件 CSS/SCSS 资源编写与审查。

**专项指南内容**：
*   **动作 (Actions)**：`ir.actions.*`、定时任务、服务端动作。
*   **控制器 (Controllers)**：HTTP 路由、端点、认证类型。
*   **数据文件 (Data files)**：XML/CSV 记录、快捷方式、noupdate。
*   **API 装饰器 (API Decorators)**：`@api.depends`、`@api.constrains`、`@api.ondelete`、`@api.onchange`、`@api.model`、`@api.private`。
*   **SQL 约束 (SQL Constraints)**：`models.Constraint`（替代 `_sql_constraints`）。
*   **数据库索引 (Database Indexes)**：`models.Index`。
*   **模块开发 (Module development)**：清单、向导、报表。
*   **字段类型 (Field types)**：Char、Text、Monetary、关联字段。
*   **清单配置 (Manifest configuration)**：`__manifest__.py`、依赖、资源包。
*   **混入 (Mixins)**：`mail.thread`、`mail.activity.mixin`、`mail.alias.mixin`、`utm.mixin`。
*   **ORM 模型方法 (ORM Model methods)**：search（查询）、CRUD、domain 过滤、recordsets（记录集）、驼峰式模型命名。
*   **迁移脚本 (Migration scripts)**：前置钩子、后置钩子、终态钩子、数据迁移。
*   **OWL 前端组件 (OWL front end components)**：钩子、服务、生命周期。
*   **性能优化 (Performance optimization)**：防止 N+1 查询、批量操作、`_read_group`。
*   **QWeb 报表 (QWeb Reports)**：PDF/HTML、纸张格式、条码、t-out。
*   **安全/访问控制 (Security/ACL)**：记录规则、字段权限、基于权限的组、`@api.private`。
*   **测试 (Testing)**：TransactionCase、HttpCase、Mocking、查询次数断言。
*   **事务 (Transactions)**：保存点、UniqueViolation、序列化失败。
*   **翻译 (Translations)**：i18n、PO 文件、可翻译字段。
*   **XML 视图 (XML Views)**：列表/表单/搜索视图、看板卡片模板、XPath 继承、QWeb 模板。

description: Generate statistical analysis code with 4-round review. Select appropriate statistical tests, interpret results, and produce analysis reports with p-values, effect sizes, and confidence intervals. Use when analyzing experimental data for a paper.
description_zh: 生成经过4轮审核的统计分析代码。选择合适的统计检验方法，解读结果，并生成包含p值、效应量和置信区间的分析报告。用于论文中实验数据的分析。

description: MoE expert-parallel communication overlap in Megatron Bridge. Covers dispatch/combine overlap, flex dispatcher backends, and expert wgrad scheduling.
description_zh: Megatron Bridge 中的 MoE 专家并行通信重叠。涵盖调度/合并重叠、弹性调度器后端以及专家权重梯度调度。

description: Long-context MoE training guidance for Megatron Bridge. Covers CP sizing, selective recompute, dispatcher choices, and practical patterns from DSV3, Qwen3, and Qwen3-Next long-context experiments.
description_zh: 长上下文 MoE 训练指南（适用于 Megatron Bridge）。涵盖计算单元规模配置、选择性重计算、调度器选择，以及基于 DSV3、Qwen3 和 Qwen3-Next 长上下文实验的实用经验模式。

description: Help users define problems clearly before jumping to solutions. Use when someone is scoping a new feature, validating a product idea, struggling to articulate what they're building, or falling into the "shiny object trap" with new technology.
description_zh: 帮助用户在寻求解决方案之前，清晰界定问题。适用于规划新功能、验证产品构想、难以清晰表述正在构建的内容，或在新技术面前陷入“亮丽事物陷阱”时使用。

description: Mine GitHub, GitLab and git history for identities, infrastructure and leaked credentials using commit author emails, GitHub code search, the commit .patch endpoint, trufflehog, gitleaks, git log pickaxe and full-ref history scans. Use when investigating a developer or organisation on GitHub, finding leaked API keys, AWS keys or tokens in code, enumerating org members and their personal repos, or recovering secrets deleted from HEAD but still present in history or forks. Applies to software supply-chain risk, credential exposure response, M&A technical diligence, and insider-threat investigation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/secrets-in-git-history.
description_zh: 在GitHub、GitLab及git历史中，通过提交作者邮箱、GitHub代码搜索、提交.patch端点、trufflehog、gitleaks、git log pickaxe及全引用历史扫描等方式，检索身份信息、基础设施与泄露凭证。适用于在GitHub上调查开发者或组织、在代码中查找泄露的API密钥、AWS密钥或令牌、枚举组织成员及其个人仓库，或恢复已从HEAD删除但仍存在于历史记录或分叉中的机密信息。适用于软件供应链风险、凭证泄露应对、M&A技术尽职调查及内部威胁调查。使用参考：useosint.com/skills/secrets-in-git-history。

description: 10 C-level advisory agent skills and plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw. CEO, CTO, COO, CPO, CMO, CFO, CRO, CISO, CHRO, Executive Mentor. Multi-role board meetings, strategy routing, structured recommendations. For founders needing executive-level decision support.
description_zh: 10 项面向 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 的 C 级顾问智能体技能与插件。涵盖 CEO、CTO、COO、CPO、CMO、CFO、CRO、CISO、CHRO、高管导师等角色。提供多角色董事会会议、策略路由与结构化建议。专为需要高管级决策支持的创始人而设。

description: Build applications where agents are first-class citizens. Use this skill when designing autonomous agents, creating MCP tools, implementing self-modifying systems, or building apps where features are outcomes achieved by agents operating in a loop.
description_zh: 构建将智能体视为一等公民的应用程序。当设计自主智能体、创建MCP工具、实现自修改系统，或构建由智能体在循环中运行以达成功能成果的应用程序时，使用此技能。

description: Use when running Salesforce Lightning Preview for an app or a single LWC component to extract the runtime DOM for inspection. TRIGGER when the user says "preview an LWC locally", "run sf lightning dev", "launch Local Dev", "inspect a component's shadow DOM at runtime", "grab rendered HTML from a live preview", "troubleshoot what actually renders versus the template", "set up Salesforce Live Preview plugin", "lightning preview", "local dev server", or "extract runtime DOM". DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is authoring or editing LWC source code (use experience-lwc-generate) or reviewing component code statically without running it.
description_zh: 当运行 Salesforce Lightning Preview 以提取 App 或单个 LWC 组件的运行时 DOM 以供检查时使用。触发条件：当用户说出“preview an LWC locally”、“run sf lightning dev”、“launch Local Dev”、“inspect a component's shadow DOM at runtime”、“grab rendered HTML from a live preview”、“troubleshoot what actually renders versus the template”、“set up Salesforce Live Preview plugin”、“lightning preview”、“local dev server”或“extract runtime DOM”时。不要触发：当用户正在编写或编辑 LWC 源代码（使用 experience-lwc-generate），或在不运行组件代码的情况下静态审查组件代码时。

description: Techniques for planning user research and synthesising it into grounded, confidence-rated findings about what users actually do
description_zh: 规划用户研究并将其整合为基于实际、带置信度评级的发现，以揭示用户真实行为的技术方法

description: Use this skill when the user wants to deploy, run, debug, tear down, or call the REST API of the RTVI-CV 2D detection / tracking microservice. Trigger when the user says things like 'deploy rtvi-cv', 'start warehouse 2d', 'add a stream', 'check rtvi-cv health', or 'stop the perception container'. Not for VLM, embedding, or analytics — use the matching vss-* skill.
description_zh: 当用户需要部署、运行、调试、拆除或调用 RTVI-CV 2D 检测/跟踪微服务的 REST API 时，请使用本技能。当用户提到类似"部署 rtvi-cv"、"启动仓库 2D"、"添加流"、"检查 rtvi-cv 健康状态"或"停止感知容器"等表述时触发。本技能不适用于 VLM、向量嵌入或分析，请使用对应的 vss-* 技能。

description: Model component behaviour as explicit states, events, and transitions. Use when a component has many interacting states that must be exhaustive. For the feel and feedback of a single interaction, use `micro-interaction-spec`.
description_zh: 将组件的行为建模为显式状态、事件和转换。当组件具有许多交互状态，且这些状态必须穷尽时使用。对于单次交互的反馈与感受，使用 `micro-interaction-spec`。

description: You MUST use this when configuring tsconfig, resolving compiler errors, debugging slow type-checking, fixing module resolution or ESM/CJS issues, hardening strictness, migrating JavaScript or a new compiler major, or setting up type-checking in monorepos. Not for general feature work in TypeScript code.
description_zh: 您必须在配置 tsconfig、解决编译错误、排查类型检查缓慢问题、修复模块解析或 ESM/CJS 问题、强化严格性、迁移 JavaScript 或新编译器大版本、或在 monorepo 中设置类型检查时使用此工具。不适用于 TypeScript 代码中的一般功能开发。

description: Imperative guidance for the System.Text.Json APIs added in .NET 11: the built-in `JsonNamingPolicy.PascalCase` naming policy, and the strongly-typed `JsonSerializerOptions.GetTypeInfo<T>()` and `JsonSerializerOptions.TryGetTypeInfo<T>(out JsonTypeInfo<T>? info)` metadata accessors. USE ONLY when the user is targeting net11.0 or later and needs PascalCase JSON property or dictionary-key names without writing a custom naming policy, a strongly-typed `JsonTypeInfo<T>` instead of the non-generic `JsonTypeInfo`, or a no-throw way to probe whether a type's serialization metadata is resolved. DO NOT USE when the target is earlier than net11.0, the requested behavior uses an established pre-net11 naming policy, or the user explicitly selected another JSON library.
description_zh: 关于 .NET 11 新增的 System.Text.Json API 的强制性使用指南：内置的 `JsonNamingPolicy.PascalCase` 命名策略，以及强类型的 `JsonSerializerOptions.GetTypeInfo<T>()` 和 `JsonSerializerOptions.TryGetTypeInfo<T>(out JsonTypeInfo<T>()? info)` 元数据访问器。仅在用户目标为 net11.0 或更高版本，且需要在不编写自定义命名策略的情况下使用 PascalCase 的 JSON 属性或字典键名、需要使用强类型的 `JsonTypeInfo<T>` 而非非泛型 `JsonTypeInfo`，或需要一种无抛出方式来探测类型的序列化元数据是否已解析时使用。当目标早于 net11.0、所请求的行为使用已存在的 net11 之前命名策略，或用户明确选择了其他 JSON 库时，请勿使用。

description: Use this skill when deploying standalone RT-VLM dense captioning or calling its REST API (uploads, captions, streams, chat-completions, Kafka). Not for VSS profile deploy or video-search ingestion.
description_zh: 使用本技能，适用于在独立部署 RT-VLM 稠密字幕或调用其 REST API（上传、字幕、流、对话补全、Kafka）的场景。不适用于 VSS 配置部署或视频搜索数据摄入。

description: Use this skill when deploying, operating, or integrating the VSS 3.2 GA RT-Embed Video Embedding microservice. Covers Docker Compose bring-up, GPU and storage prerequisites, the `/v1` REST API (file uploads, text and video embeddings, live RTSP streams, health and metrics), Redis/Kafka/OTel integration, common failure modes, and teardown.
description_zh: 当部署、运行或集成 VSS 3.2 GA RT-Embed Video Embedding 微服务时，请使用本技能。本技能涵盖 Docker Compose 启动、GPU 与存储的依赖条件、`/v1` REST API（文件上传、文本与视频嵌入、实时 RTSP 流、健康检查与指标）、Redis/Kafka/OTel 集成、常见故障模式以及拆除操作。

description: Query the QuickGO and Evidence & Conclusion Ontology (ECO) REST API. Use this when you need to map genes to biological processes, molecular functions, or cellular components, find genes associated with a specific pathway/GO term, or explore the Gene Ontology hierarchy. Do not use for querying drug targets (use OpenTargets) or mechanistic signaling pathway diagrams (use KEGG).
description_zh: 查询 QuickGO 和证据与结论本体（ECO）的 REST API。当您需要将基因映射到生物过程、分子功能或细胞组分，查找与特定通路/GO术语相关的基因，或探索基因本体（Gene Ontology）层级时，请使用此功能。请勿用于查询药物靶点（请使用 OpenTargets）或机制性信号通路图（请使用 KEGG）。

description: Representative, point-in-time MoE training playbooks by hardware and model family. Use them as candidate seeds, then revalidate the exact runtime, semantics, topology, and steady-state throughput.
description_zh: 代表性的、特定时点的基于硬件和模型家族的MoE训练方案。将其作为候选种子，随后重新验证确切的运行时间、语义、拓扑结构与稳态吞吐量。

description: Create, schedule, and manage social media posts via Typefully. ALWAYS use this skill when asked to draft, schedule, post, or check tweets, posts, threads, or social media content for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, or Substack Notes, or when the user drops a Typefully draft URL such as https://typefully.com/?a=<social_set_id>&d=<draft_id>.
description_zh: 通过 Typefully 创建、安排和管理社交媒体帖子。当被要求为 Twitter/X、LinkedIn、Threads、Bluesky、Mastodon 或 Substack Notes 起草、安排、发布或检查推文、帖子、线程或社交媒体内容时，务必始终使用此技能，或当用户提供 Typefully 草稿网址，例如 https://typefully.com/?a=<<social_set_id>&d=<<draft_id>> 时。

description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
description_zh:
打造独具特色、达生产级标准且设计质量出众的前端界面。
当用户请求构建网页组件、页面、产物、海报或应用程序时，使用本技能（示例包括网站、落地页、仪表盘、React组件、HTML/CSS布局，或对任意Web界面进行样式美化时）。
生成创意、精良的代码与UI设计，避免通用的AI审美风格。

description: Build web interfaces with genuine design quality, not AI slop. Use for any frontend work - landing pages, web apps, dashboards, admin panels, components, interactive experiences. Activates for both greenfield builds and modifications to existing applications. Detects existing design systems and respects them. Covers composition, typography, color, motion, and copy. Verifies results via screenshots before declaring done.
description_zh: 用真正的设计品质打造网页界面，而非 AI 生成的粗糙产物。适用于各类前端工作——落地页、网页应用、仪表盘、管理后台、组件及交互体验。适用于全新开发以及现有应用的修改。能识别现有设计系统并予以遵循。涵盖构图、排版、色彩、动效与文案。通过截图验证效果，方可确认完成。

description: Operational guide for enabling hierarchical context parallelism in Megatron-Bridge, including config knobs, code anchors, pitfalls, and verification.
description_zh: 启用 Megatron-Bridge 层级上下文并行的运维指南：涵盖配置项、代码锚点、潜在陷阱与验证。

description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.
description_zh: 学术研究全面的引用管理。在 OpenAlex、PubMed 和 Google Scholar 中搜索论文，提取准确的元数据，验证引用，并生成格式正确的 BibTeX 条目。当您需要查找论文、核实引用信息、将 DOI 转换为 BibTeX，或在科学写作中确保参考文献准确性时，应使用此技能。

description: Migrates Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) projects to Android Gradle Plugin 9.0+.
