Handles plugin replacement (com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library), module splitting, DSL migration, and the new default project structure. Use when upgrading AGP, when build fails due to KMP+AGP incompatibility, or when the user mentions AGP 9.0, android multiplatform plugin, KMP migration, or com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library.
description_zh: 将 Kotlin 多平台 (KMP) 项目迁移至 Android Gradle Plugin 9.0 及以上版本。处理插件替换（com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library）、模块拆分、DSL 迁移以及新的默认项目结构。适用于升级 AGP、因 KMP 与 AGP 不兼容导致构建失败，或用户提及 AGP 9.0、Android 多平台插件、KMP 迁移或 com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library 的场景。

description: OpenAI Agents SDK (Python) development. Use when building AI agents, multi-agent handoffs, function tools, guardrails, sessions, streaming, or tracing with the `openai-agents` / `agents` Python package — including Azure OpenAI via LiteLLM. Triggers on imports from `agents`, uses of `Runner.run_sync`/`Runner.run_streamed`, `@function_tool`, `AgentOutputSchema`, `SQLiteSession`, or questions about the openai-agents-python SDK. Python only — not the TypeScript `@openai/agents` SDK.
description_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK (Python) 开发。适用于使用 `openai-agents` / `agents` Python 包构建 AI 代理、多代理交接、函数工具、护栏、会话、流式传输或追踪，包括通过 LiteLLM 使用 Azure OpenAI 时。触发条件包括从 `agents` 导入、使用 `Runner.run_sync` / `Runner.run_streamed`、`@function_tool`、`AgentOutputSchema`、`SQLiteSession`，或关于 openai-agents-python SDK 的问题。仅 Python — 非 TypeScript `@openai/agents` SDK。

description: Expert guidance on map design principles, color theory, visual hierarchy, typography, and cartographic best practices for creating effective and beautiful maps with Mapbox. Use when designing map styles, choosing colors, or making cartographic decisions.
description_zh: 使用Mapbox创建有效且美观地图的专家指导，涵盖地图设计原则、色彩理论、视觉层级、字体排版与制图最佳实践。适用于地图样式设计、颜色选择及制图决策阶段。

description: Add authentication to a new app. Use for "add auth", "add login", Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth), identity routing, sign-up, sign-in, password reset, email OTP, magic links, organizations, phone OTP, OAuth, passkeys, MFA, trusted domains, invalid domain, and @neondatabase/auth. No existing identity: default to Managed Better Auth. Keep working Better Auth, Clerk, Supabase Auth, or another IdP. User asked to migrate from Supabase Auth: Managed Better Auth. A required plugin outside Managed support: self-managed Better Auth on a Neon Function or the existing app host. Also use for auth APIs in @neondatabase/neon-js.
description_zh:
为新的应用添加认证。用于：“add auth”、“add login”、Neon Auth（Managed Better Auth）、身份路由、注册、登录、密码重置、邮箱 OTP、魔法链接、组织、手机 OTP、OAuth、passkeys、MFA、可信域名、无效域名，以及 @neondatabase/auth。

没有现有身份标识：默认使用 Managed Better Auth。继续支持 Better Auth、Clerk、Supabase Auth 或另一种 IdP。用户要求从 Supabase Auth 迁移：使用 Managed Better Auth。超出 Managed 支持范围时，必须使用的插件是：在 Neon Function 或现有应用主机上运行的自管 Better Auth。同样用于 @neondatabase/neon-js 中的认证 API。

description: Use to call the VIOS REST API (sensor list, timelines, clip extraction, snapshots, add/delete sensors and streams). Not for VLM inference or search.
description_zh: 用于调用 VIOS REST API（传感器列表、时间线、剪辑提取、快照、添加/删除传感器和流）。不适用于 VLM 推理或搜索。

description: Use to deploy the vss-video-analytics-api REST service standalone (config-source, data-log bind, Elasticsearch, optional Kafka). Not for full warehouse deploy.
description_zh: 用于独立部署 vss-video-analytics-api REST 服务（配置源、数据日志绑定、Elasticsearch，可选 Kafka）。不适用于完整的仓库部署。

description: Install a per-turn canary signal (e.g. starting every reply with the user's name and a turn counter) so silent context degradation becomes visible the moment it happens, and run a recovery protocol when the canary trips. Use when the user mentions a "canary", "context canary", or "canary check", asks to detect context rot / compaction / drift, says "you stopped using my name" or "did you lose context", asks "how degraded is your context", or wants an early-warning system for long agent sessions.
description_zh: 安装一个每轮的金丝雀信号（例如，在每次回复开头加入用户的姓名和轮次计数器），以便在上下文退化无声发生时能立即显现，并在金丝雀触发时执行恢复协议。当用户提到“金丝雀”、“上下文金丝雀”或“金丝雀检查”，要求检测上下文腐烂/压缩/漂移，说“你不再使用我的姓名”或“你是否丢失了上下文”，询问“你的上下文退化到什么程度”，或希望为长代理会话建立预警系统时使用。

description: Resiliency features in Megatron Bridge including fault tolerance, straggler detection, in-process restart, preemption, and re-run state machine.
description_zh: Megatron Bridge 中的弹性特性包括容错、拖尾任务检测、进程内重启、抢占以及重跑状态机。

description: You MUST use this when configuring, writing, debugging, running, migrating, or auditing Vitest tests in JavaScript/TypeScript projects - Vite, Vue, Nuxt, React, Next.js, Node libraries, workspaces, coverage, mocks, snapshots, flaky tests, CI parity, or Jest migration.
description_zh: 在配置、编写、调试、运行、迁移或审计 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目中的 Vitest 测试时，必须使用此方法——Vite、Vue、Nuxt、React、Next.js、Node 库、工作空间、覆盖率、模拟、快照、不稳定测试、CI 一致性或 Jest 迁移。

description: Use when you want to retrieve quantitative RNA expression data and variant eQTL information from the GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression) Project across 54 non-diseased tissue sites.
description_zh: 用于从 GTEx（Genotype-Tissue Expression，基因型-组织表达）项目获取覆盖 54 个非疾病组织位点的定量 RNA 表达数据及变异 eQTL 信息。

description: Query the JASPAR database for Transcription Factor (TF) binding profiles. Use when retrieving Position Frequency Matrices (PFMs) or Position Weight Matrices (PWMs) for specific TFs, resolving gene symbols to JASPAR Matrix IDs, or getting TF metadata. Supports multiple output formats (MEME, TRANSFAC, PFM, JASPAR, YAML).
description_zh: 查询 JASPAR 数据库中的转录因子（TF）结合谱。用于获取特定转录因子的位置频率矩阵（PFMs）或位置权重矩阵（PWMs），将基因符号解析为 JASPAR 矩阵ID，或获取转录因子元数据。支持多种输出格式（MEME、TRANSFAC、PFM、JASPAR、YAML）。

description: Use when working on complex multi-step tasks, when a session is getting long (40+ tool calls), when the agent starts ignoring rules it followed earlier, when conventions drift, when output quality seems to degrade, or after any context compaction event. Prevents long-session corruption AND context compaction amnesia through behavioral self-enforcement.
description_zh: 在以下情况时使用：处理复杂多步骤任务、会话时长超过40次工具调用、智能体开始忽视此前遵循的规则、规范发生漂移、输出质量似乎下降，或任何上下文压缩事件发生后。通过行为自我强化，防止长会话损坏和上下文压缩遗忘。

description: Maintain and improve existing k6 test scripts. Covers threshold tightening based on trend data, version migration between k6 releases, auto-fixing tests when the underlying service changes, refactoring for cleanliness, and auditing scripts against current best practices from docs. Use when the user asks to fix a failing k6 test, tighten thresholds, migrate a script to a new k6 version, refactor a test, update a script after a service change, or improve a script with best practices. Trigger on phrases like "fix my k6 test", "tighten my thresholds", "migrate to k6 v2", "update my test script", "refactor this k6 test", "my test is failing after a deploy", "apply best practices to my script", "modernize my k6 test", or "the service changed and my test broke". Also trigger when another skill (k6-trend-analysis or k6-cloud-investigate-test) hands off with a recommendation to edit a script.
description_zh:
维护并优化现有的 k6 测试脚本。
涵盖以下工作：基于趋势数据的阈值收紧、k6 版本间的版本迁移、底层服务发生变更时的测试自动修复、为提升代码整洁性进行的重构，以及对照文档中的最新最佳实践对脚本进行审计。
当用户提出修复失败的 k6 测试、收紧阈值、将脚本迁移至新的 k6 版本、重构测试、在服务变更后更新脚本，或基于最佳实践改进脚本时使用。
当出现诸如“修复我的 k6 测试”、“收紧我的阈值”、“迁移至 k6 v2”、“更新我的测试脚本”、“重构这个 k6 测试”、“部署后我的测试失败”、“将最佳实践应用于我的脚本”、“现代化我的 k6 测试”，或“服务发生变更且我的测试已损坏”等表述时触发。
当其他技能（k6-trender-analysis 或 k6-cloud-investigate-test）将编辑脚本的建议转交时，亦触发。

description: Use Transformers.js to run state-of-the-art machine learning models directly in JavaScript/TypeScript. Supports NLP (text classification, translation, summarization), computer vision (image classification, object detection), audio (speech recognition, audio classification), and multimodal tasks. Works in browsers and server-side runtimes (Node.js, Bun, Deno) with WebGPU/WASM using pre-trained models from Hugging Face Hub.
description_zh: 使用 Transformers.js 直接在 JavaScript/TypeScript 中运行最先进的机器学习模型。支持自然语言处理（文本分类、翻译、摘要）、计算机视觉（图像分类、目标检测）、音频（语音识别、音频分类）以及多模态任务。支持在浏览器和服务器端运行时（Node.js、Bun、Deno）中使用 WebGPU/WASM 及来自 Hugging Face Hub 的预训练模型。

description: Use to run AutoMagicCalib on local MP4s, RTSP, or the bundled sample dataset, and to deploy vss-auto-calibration when needed. Do not use for non-AMC calibration or runtime analytics.
description_zh: 用于在本地 MP4、RTSP 或随附示例数据集上运行 AutoMagicCalib，并在需要时部署 vss-auto-calibration。不得用于非 AMC 校准或运行时分析。

description: Use for VSS alert workflows — real-time monitoring, Alert-Bridge subscriptions, Slack notifications, incident queries, camera onboarding. Not for non-alert analytics.
description_zh: 用于VSS警报工作流程——实时监控、Alert-Bridge订阅、Slack通知、事件查询、摄像头上线。不适用于非警报分析。

description: Scaffolds an xUnit integration test project targeting Oracle in .NET solutions. Creates the test project, transaction-rollback base class, and seed data manager. Use only during Phase 3, before writing Oracle baseline integration tests. Do not invoke during Phase 6 — the PostgreSQL test project is produced by migrating this project, not by running this skill again.
description_zh: 为 .NET 解决方案搭建针对 Oracle 目标的 xUnit 集成测试项目。创建测试项目、事务回滚基类和种子数据管理器。仅在第三阶段使用，即在编写 Oracle 基准集成测试之前。第六阶段请勿调用——PostgreSQL 测试项目由迁移本项目生成，而非再次运行此技能。

description: Query the Genome Aggregation Database (gnomAD). Use when determining the rarity or allele frequency of specific genetic variants, retrieving gene constraint metrics (pLI, LOEUF) to assess loss-of-function intolerance, finding variants in a genomic region or gene, or querying structural variants. Don't use for analyzing individual patient genomes, tracking somatic mutations in cancer (use COSMIC), or requesting raw sequencing reads (use ENA).
description_zh: 查询基因组聚合数据库（gnomAD）。用于确定特定遗传变异的稀有性或等位基因频率，获取基因约束指标（pLI、LOEUF）以评估功能缺失耐受性，查找基因组区域或基因中的变异，或查询结构变异。请勿用于分析单个患者基因组、追踪癌症中的体细胞突变（使用 COSMIC），或请求原始测序读段（使用 ENA）。

description: Patterns for visualizing data on maps including choropleth maps, heat maps, 3D visualizations, data-driven styling, and animated data. Covers layer types, color scales, and performance optimization.
description_zh: 地图数据可视化模式，包括分级设色图、热力图、三维可视化、数据驱动的样式设计以及动态数据。涵盖图层类型、颜色标度与性能优化。

description: When the user wants to write content for a LinkedIn carousel, Instagram carousel, Facebook carousel, TikTok photo carousel, Pinterest Idea Pin, or any swipeable multi-slide format. Also use when the user mentions 'carousel,' 'slides,' 'LinkedIn carousel,' 'Instagram carousel,' 'IG carousel,' 'photo carousel,' 'TikTok photo carousel,' 'Idea Pin,' 'Pinterest Idea Pin,' 'swipe post,' 'slide deck,' or 'visual content.' Outputs slide-by-slide text content (not visual design). For single posts, see post-writer-sms. For threads, see thread-writer-sms. For caption copy under each slide post, see caption-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户需要为 LinkedIn 轮播图、Instagram 轮播图、Facebook 轮播图、TikTok 照片轮播图、Pinterest 灵感贴纸，或任何可滑动的多幻灯片格式撰写内容时使用。当用户提及“轮播图”、“幻灯片”、“LinkedIn 轮播图”、“Instagram 轮播图”、“IG 轮播图”、“照片轮播图”、“TikTok 照片轮播图”、“灵感贴纸”、“Pinterest 灵感贴纸”、“滑动帖子”、“幻灯片演示文稿”或“视觉内容”时，也使用。输出逐页的文本内容（而非视觉设计）。对于单篇帖子，参见 post-writer-sms。对于线程，参见 thread-writer-sms。对于每张幻灯片帖子下方的描述文案，参见 caption-writer-sms。

description: Schema validation with Valibot, the modular and type-safe schema library. Use when the user needs to validate data, create schemas, parse inputs, or work with Valibot in their project. Also use when migrating from Zod to Valibot.
description_zh: 使用 Valibot 进行模式校验，这是一款模块化且类型安全的模式库。当用户需要校验数据、创建模式、解析输入或在项目中与 Valibot 协同工作时使用；从 Zod 迁移到 Valibot 时也应使用。

description: 【DEPRECATED · 已废弃】本 skill 已于 2026-08-07 停止维护。对作者本机环境：其方法论已整体并入 deck-creator（私有仓 daymade-skills-pro 的 Route B · draft），装有 deck-creator 的环境不要调用本 skill。 对外部用户：这是最终版本，保留安装兼容，不再接收更新——你可以继续按本文档使用， 但请知悉上游已冻结。将在 daymade-docs v2.0.0 中物理移除。
description_zh: 【DEPRECATED · 已废弃】本 skill 已于 2026-08-07 停止维护。针对作者本机环境：其方法论已整体并入 deck-creator（私有仓 daymade-skills-pro 的 Route B · draft），安装了 deck-creator 的环境不要调用本 skill。对外部用户：这是最终版本，保留安装兼容性，不再接收更新——你可以继续按照本文档使用，但请知悉上游已冻结。将在 daymade-docs v2.0.0 中物理移除。

description: Query the ENCODE Registry of cis-Regulatory Elements (cCREs) via the SCREEN GraphQL API, or make custom queries to the ENCODE Portal REST API for experiments and files (ChIP-seq peaks, etc.). Use when you want to query regulatory annotations or raw experimental data across human cell types.
description_zh: 通过 SCREEN GraphQL API 查询 ENCODE 顺式调控元件注册库（cCREs），或为实验和文件（ChIP-seq 峰区等）向 ENCODE Portal REST API 发起自定义查询。在需要跨人类细胞类型查询调控注释或原始实验数据时使用。

description: Use when the user wants to create a dataset, generate synthetic data, or build a data generation pipeline.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建数据集、生成合成数据或构建数据生成流水线时使用。

description: Generates BYO custom safety policies for NVIDIA Nemotron content-safety guardrails — Nemotron-Content-Safety-Reasoning-4B (text) and multimodal Nemotron-3-Content-Safety. Produces a Markdown policy, JSON taxonomy, and drop-in inference prompts. Maps rough words or an existing policy to V2 categories, adding custom categories or topic-following rules.
description_zh: 为 NVIDIA Nemotron 内容安全护栏生成用户自带（BYO）自定义安全策略——支持 Nemotron-Content-Safety-Reasoning-4B（文本）和多模态 Nemotron-3-Content-Safety。生成 Markdown 策略、JSON 分类体系以及可直接使用的推理提示词。将粗糙词汇或现有策略映射至 V2 类别，并支持添加自定义类别或话题相关规则。

description: Bash/Linux terminal patterns. Critical commands, piping, error handling, scripting. Use when working on macOS or Linux systems.
description_zh:
Bash/Linux 终端模式

关键命令、管道处理、错误处理、脚本编写。适用于在 macOS 或 Linux 系统上工作。

description: Diagnose and fix Claude in Chrome MCP extension connectivity issues. Use when mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools fail, return "Browser extension is not connected", or behave erratically.
description_zh: 诊断并修复 Claude 在 Chrome MCP 扩展中的连接问题。当 mcp__claude-in-chrome__* 工具失败、返回“浏览器扩展未连接”，或表现异常时使用。

description:
Analyze or explore a codebase (remote or local repository) by packing it with the Repomix CLI, then reading and searching the generated output. Use when the user wants a high-level understanding of an unfamiliar or large repo, not a targeted edit.

Trigger for:
- Structure/overview: "analyze this repo", "what's the structure", "explain this codebase", "what's in vercel/next.js"
- Pattern discovery across many files: "find all auth code", "where are the API endpoints", "show me all React components"
- Metrics: "how many files/tokens", "largest files", "TypeScript vs JavaScript ratio"
- Remote repos: any github.com URL or "owner/repo" the user wants explored

DO NOT trigger for:
- Editing, refactoring, or writing code in the current project
- Reading or searching a known file/path in the local project (use Read or grep directly)
- Single-symbol lookups in the local project answerable with one grep
- Git operations, running tests, builds, or installs
description_zh:
使用 Repomix CLI 对代码库（远程或本地仓库）进行打包分析或探索，然后阅读并搜索生成的输出。适用于用户需要对不熟悉或大型代码库进行宏观理解，而非进行针对性修改的场景。

触发条件：
- 结构与概览："analyze this repo"、"what's the structure"、"explain this codebase"、"what's in vercel/next.js"
- 跨多文件模式发现："find all auth code"、"where are the API endpoints"、"show me all React components"
- 指标："how many files/tokens"、"largest files"、"TypeScript vs JavaScript ratio"
- 远程仓库：用户希望探索的任何 github.com 网址或 "owner/repo"

禁止触发场景：
- 编辑、重构或在当前项目中编写代码
- 读取或搜索本地项目中已知的文件/路径（请直接使用 Read 或 grep）
- 本地项目中仅需一次 grep 即可回答的单一符号查询
- Git 操作、运行测试、构建或安装

description: Operational guide for enabling Megatron FSDP in Megatron-Bridge, including config knobs, code anchors, pitfalls, and verification.
description_zh: 启用 Megatron-Bridge 中 Megatron FSDP 的操作指南，包括配置选项、代码锚点、常见陷阱与验证。

description: Choose the right MoE token dispatcher (`alltoall`, DeepEP, or HybridEP) for the hardware, EP degree, and optimization stage. Summarizes patterns from DSV3, Qwen3, Qwen3-Next, and VLM bring-up work.
description_zh: 根据硬件、EP 度和优化阶段选择合适的 MoE token 调度器（`alltoall`、DeepEP 或 HybridEP）。总结了 DSV3、Qwen3、Qwen3-Next 以及 VLM 上线工作的模式。

description: Use this skill when reading video-analytics metrics, incidents, alerts, and sensor data via the VA-MCP server (port 9901). Not for live VLM or incident-range narrative reports.
description_zh: 使用此技能，通过 VA-MCP 服务器（端口 9901）读取视频分析指标、事件、告警和传感器数据。不适用于实时 VLM 或事件范围叙述报告。

description: Help users conduct effective usability testing. Use when someone is planning user tests, designing prototype validation, preparing usability studies, or trying to understand why users struggle with their product.
description_zh: 帮助用户进行有效的可用性测试。当规划用户测试、设计原型验证、准备可用性研究，或尝试理解用户为何难以使用其产品时使用。

description: Facilitate a structured team critique — framing, feedback rules, and actionable outcomes. Use when running a session with people in the room. For a solo expert review, use `heuristic-evaluation` (prototyping-testing).
description_zh: 主持结构化团队点评：明确框架、反馈规则与可执行成果。在与在场的与会者进行会议时使用。若为单人专家评审，使用 `heuristic-evaluation`（原型测试）。

description: Operational guide for enabling TP, DP, and PP communication overlap in Megatron-Bridge, including config knobs, code anchors, pitfalls, and verification.
description_zh: Megatron-Bridge 启用张量并行（TP）、数据并行（DP）与流水线并行（PP）通信重叠的操作指南，涵盖配置旋钮、代码锚点、潜在陷阱及验证。

description: This skill should be used whenever users ask food-related questions, meal suggestions, nutrition advice, recipe recommendations, or dietary planning. On first use, the skill collects comprehensive user preferences (allergies, dietary restrictions, goals, likes/dislikes) and stores them in a persistent database. All subsequent food-related responses are personalized based on these stored preferences.
description_zh: 此技能应在用户提出与食物相关的提问、餐食建议、营养建议、食谱推荐或饮食规划时使用。首次使用时，该技能收集全面的用户偏好（过敏情况、饮食限制、目标、喜好/不喜欢）并存储在持久数据库中。此后所有与食物相关的回复均根据这些存储的偏好进行个性化。

description: This skill should be used when writing Ruby and Rails code in DHH's distinctive 37signals style. It applies when writing Ruby code, Rails applications, creating models, controllers, or any Ruby file. Triggers on Ruby/Rails code generation, refactoring requests, code review, or when the user mentions DHH, 37signals, Basecamp, HEY, or Campfire style. Embodies REST purity, fat models, thin controllers, Current attributes, Hotwire patterns, and the "clarity over cleverness" philosophy.
description_zh: 当在 DHH 标志性的 37signals 风格下编写 Ruby 和 Rails 代码时，应使用该技能。该技能适用于编写 Ruby 代码、构建 Rails 应用、创建模型、控制器或任何 Ruby 文件。当出现 Ruby/Rails 代码生成、重构请求、代码审查，或用户提及 DHH、37signals、Basecamp、HEY 或 Campfire 风格时，即会触发该技能。该技能体现了纯 REST 风格、胖模型、瘦控制器、当前属性、Hotwire 模式，以及“以清晰胜于巧妙”的哲学。

description: Create or update standardized object-oriented component documentation using a shared template plus mode-specific guidance for new and existing docs.
description_zh: 使用共享模板以及针对新文档和现有文档特定模式的具体指导，创建或更新标准化的面向对象组件文档。

description: Linting and formatting for Megatron-LM. Covers running autoformat.sh, tools (ruff, black, isort, pylint, mypy), and code style rules.
description_zh: Megatron-LM 的代码检查与格式化。涵盖运行 autoformat.sh、工具 (ruff, black, isort, pylint, mypy) 以及代码风格规则。

description: Create an implementation plan artifact in Alan
description_zh: 在 Alan 中创建实施计划工件。

description: Scope coverage, build a testing strategy, test the feature with agent-browser, capture screenshots/video (always mandatory), upload to S3, and create a structured test report (never skip)
description_zh: 范围覆盖，制定测试策略，使用 agent-browser 测试该功能，捕获截图/视频（始终强制），上传至 S3，并创建结构化的测试报告（切勿跳过）

description: Use to deploy the vss-behavior-analytics service standalone (entrypoint, config-source, optional calibration). Not for the full warehouse deploy.
description_zh: 用于独立部署 vss-behavior-analytics 服务（入口点、配置源、可选校准）。不适用于完整仓库部署。

description: Help users run better customer and user interviews. Use when someone is preparing for user research, planning discovery interviews, writing interview questions, analyzing interview findings, or trying to understand customer needs.
description_zh: 帮助用户开展更优质的客户与用户访谈。适用于用户准备进行用户研究、规划发现访谈、编写访谈问题、分析访谈结果或试图理解客户需求时。

description:
Manage short-code bundles that authorize the local starchild CLI to talk to this agent, including the agent-shell local-exec channel and the local MCP proxy (stdio MCP servers on the user's machine).

Use when connecting or disconnecting the starchild CLI (e.g. mint a CLI bridge code, list my CLI bundles, revoke an old CLI session, let the agent run shell commands on the user's own machine, or drive a local app via a stdio MCP server — Blender, Figma, Godot, computer-use, etc.).
description_zh:
管理用于授权本地 starchild CLI 与本代理进行通信的短代码包，包括 agent-shell 本地执行通道和本地 MCP 代理（用户机器上的 stdio MCP 服务器）。

用于连接或断开 starchild CLI（例如：生成 CLI 桥接码、列出我的 CLI 包、撤销旧的 CLI 会话、允许代理在用户自身机器上执行 shell 命令，或通过 stdio MCP 服务器驱动本地应用——如 Blender、Figma、Godot、电脑使用等应用）。

description: Review a GitHub pull request using Alan's GitHub MCP tools
description_zh: 使用 Alan 的 GitHub MCP 工具审查 GitHub 拉取请求

description: Analyze Grafana Cloud k6 test run trends over time. Detects slow metric drift (e.g., P95 latency creeping up while still passing thresholds), computes headroom to thresholds, flags anomalies, and recommends threshold tightening. Use when the user asks about test performance trends, wants to know if metrics are degrading, asks whether thresholds should be tightened, or wants a health check across recent runs for a specific test. Trigger on phrases like "how is my test trending", "is P95 getting worse", "check for performance regression", "should I tighten thresholds", "are my tests degrading", "show me trends for test X", "analyze my k6 test runs", or "is my test getting slower". Also trigger when a user asks to check all tests in a project -- run this skill once per test and synthesize.
description_zh:
分析 Grafana Cloud k6 测试运行的时间趋势。检测指标缓慢漂移（例如，P95 延迟持续上升但仍低于阈值），计算与阈值的余量，标记异常，并建议收紧阈值。

适用于用户询问测试性能趋势、想知道指标是否正在退化、询问是否应收紧阈值，或希望对特定测试的最近运行情况进行健康检查时。

当出现以下表述时触发：例如“我的测试趋势如何”、“P95 是否正在变差”、“检查性能是否出现退化”、“是否应该收紧阈值”、“我的测试是否正在退化”、“展示测试 X 的趋势”、“分析我的 k6 测试运行”或“我的测试是否变慢”。当用户要求检查项目中的所有测试时，同样触发——对每个测试运行一次该技能，并进行综合分析。

description: Documentation conventions for NeMo-RL. Covers docs/index.md updates and docstring format. Do NOT use for: bug fixes, test fixes, dependency bumps, refactoring, CI/CD changes, performance tuning, or any task that does not involve writing or updating documentation.
description_zh: NeMo-RL 文档规范。涵盖 docs/index.md 更新及 docstring 格式。禁止用于：bug 修复、测试修复、依赖升级、重构、CI/CD 变更、性能调优，或不涉及编写或更新文档的任务。

description: Use when designing, reviewing, or refactoring a CLI that must serve AI agents alongside humans, or when converting an API or SDK into an agent-usable CLI interface.
description_zh: 适用于设计、审查或重构必须同时服务于人类用户与 AI 智能体的 CLI，或将 API 或 SDK 转换为可供 AI 智能体使用的 CLI 接口时使用。

description: Expert in web animations, transitions, and motion design using Framer Motion and CSS
description_zh: 使用Framer Motion和CSS的网页动画、过渡与动态设计专家

description: Low-level plotting library for full customization. Use when you need fine-grained control over every plot element, creating novel plot types, or integrating with specific scientific workflows. Export to PNG/PDF/SVG for publication. For quick statistical plots use seaborn; for interactive plots use plotly; for publication-ready multi-panel figures with journal styling, use scientific-visualization.
description_zh: 完全定制化的底层绘图库。当您需要精细控制每个绘图元素、创建新型绘图类型或集成特定科学工作流时，请使用本库。支持导出为 PNG/PDF/SVG 以用于出版。快速生成统计图表请使用 seaborn；交互式图表请使用 plotly；符合期刊样式要求的出版级多面板图表请使用 scientific-visualization。

description: Create publication-quality scientific diagrams using Nano Banana 2 AI with smart iterative refinement. Uses Gemini 3.6 Flash for quality review. Only regenerates if quality is below threshold for your document type. Specialized in neural network architectures, system diagrams, flowcharts, biological pathways, and complex scientific visualizations.
description_zh: 使用 Nano Banana 2 AI 及智能迭代优化功能，创建出版级科学示意图。采用 Gemini 3.6 Flash 进行质量审核，仅当针对您的文档类型的质量低于阈值时才会重新生成。专注于神经网络架构、系统图、流程图、生物通路及复杂科学可视化。

description: Run AI agent tasks remotely on Netlify using Claude, Codex, or Gemini. Use when the user wants to run an AI agent on their site, get a second opinion from another model, or delegate development tasks to run remotely against their repo.
description_zh: 在 Netlify 上使用 Claude、Codex 或 Gemini 远程运行 AI 智能体任务。适用于用户希望在站点上运行 AI 智能体、从其他模型获得第二意见，或将开发任务委派到远程，针对其代码仓库运行的情况。

description: Guides Holoscan SDK installation: inspects the host, assesses platform compatibility, recommends an install method, and delegates to the matching install skill.
description_zh: 指导 Holoscan SDK 安装：检查主机，评估平台兼容性，推荐安装方法，并委派给匹配的安装技能。

description: 钉钉知识库和文档管理操作。当用户提到"钉钉文档"、"知识库"、"新建文档"、"查看文档目录"、"读取文档内容"、"写入文档"、"更新文档"、"文档成员"、"dingtalk doc"、"knowledge base"时使用此技能。支持：创建知识库、查询知识库列表、新建文档/文件夹、读取/写入文档正文内容、管理成员权限等全部文档类操作。
description_zh: 钉钉知识库和文档管理操作。当用户提到"钉钉文档"、"知识库"、"新建文档"、"查看文档目录"、"读取文档内容"、"写入文档"、"更新文档"、"文档成员"、"dingtalk doc"、"knowledge base"时使用此技能。支持：创建知识库、查询知识库列表、新建文档/文件夹、读取/写入文档正文内容、管理成员权限等全部文档类操作。

description: APM - install, onboard, instrument, enable, set up, configure, traces, services, dependencies, performance analysis. Use for any request involving Datadog APM setup, instrumentation (SSI, ddtrace, agent install), or analysis.
description_zh: APM - 安装、接入、插桩、启用、搭建、配置、追踪、服务、依赖项、性能分析。适用于涉及 Datadog APM 设置、插桩（SSI、ddtrace、agent 安装）或分析的任何请求。

description: Build slide decks and presentations for research talks. Use this for making PowerPoint slides, conference presentations, seminar talks, research presentations, thesis defense slides, or any scientific talk. Provides slide structure, design templates, timing guidance, and visual validation. Works with PowerPoint and LaTeX Beamer.
description_zh: 为研究演讲制作幻灯片演示文稿。可用于制作 PowerPoint 幻灯片、会议演示文稿、研讨会演讲、研究演示文稿、论文答辩幻灯片，或任何科学演讲。提供幻灯片结构、设计模板、时间指导以及视觉验证。兼容 PowerPoint 和 LaTeX Beamer。

description: Create institutional-quality equity research initiation reports through a 5-task workflow. Tasks must be executed individually with verified prerequisites - (1) company research, (2) financial modeling, (3) valuation analysis, (4) chart generation, (5) final report assembly. Each task produces specific deliverables (markdown docs, Excel models, charts, or DOCX reports). Tasks 3-5 have dependencies on earlier tasks.
description_zh: 通过一个5项任务工作流创建机构级股权研究启动报告。任务必须逐个执行，并验证前置条件——（1）公司研究，（2）财务建模，（3）估值分析，（4）图表生成，（5）最终报告组装。每个任务产出特定的交付物（markdown文档、Excel模型、图表或DOCX报告）。任务3-5依赖于早期任务。

description: Explore and understand PUDL energy data: discover which tables exist, look up column meanings and usage warnings, and load Parquet files from S3 or a local directory. No PUDL Python package required. Use this skill whenever a user asks what PUDL data contains, wants to understand a specific table or column, asks about data quality or limitations, needs help loading data into a notebook or script, or wants to know which table covers a topic like electricity generation, utility financials, fuel costs, power plant locations, emissions, capacity factors, FERC financial data, or EIA survey data. Also use when the user mentions PUDL, Catalyst Cooperative energy data, or any of the specific data sources PUDL ingests (EIA-860, EIA-861, EIA-923, FERC Form 1, FERC Form 714, FERC EQR, EPA CEMS, EPA CAMD, etc.).
description_zh: 探索并理解 PUDL 能源数据：发现现有表格，查询列含义与使用警告，并从 S3 或本地目录加载 Parquet 文件。无需 PUDL Python 包。当用户询问 PUDL 数据包含哪些内容、希望了解某个具体表格或列、询问数据质量或限制、需要帮助将数据加载到笔记本或脚本中，或想了解哪个表格涵盖电力生产、公用事业财务、燃料成本、电厂位置、排放、容量因子、FERC 财务数据或 EIA 调查数据等主题时，均需使用本技能。当用户提及 PUDL、Catalyst Cooperative 能源数据，或 PUDL 导入的任何具体数据源（EIA-860、EIA-861、EIA-923、FERC 表格 1、FERC 表格 714、FERC EQR、EPA CEMS、EPA CAMD 等）时，也使用本技能。

description: Use when reviewing or implementing Lightning Data Service best practices in an LWC (.js, .html, .js-meta.xml) — UIAPI vs Apex, refreshApex / notifyRecordUpdateAvailable, @salesforce/schema imports, LDS record-form data patterns. TRIGGER on "apply LDS best practices to this LWC", "review this LWC for LDS best-practice issues", "review this component for Lightning Data Service issues", "UIAPI or Apex for this data?", "fix stale data after record save", "sync LDS cache", "use @salesforce/schema for field names", "choose between getRecord and Apex". DO NOT TRIGGER when building a new LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), applying SLDS design tokens (use design-systems-slds-apply), picking or wiring a `lightning-*` base component's props/events/slots generically (use experience-lwc-base-components-integrate — this skill covers only the LDS data-layer rationale, even when the fix involves a base record form), or for security / RTL / accessibility reviews (separate passes).
description_zh:
当在LWC（.js、.html、.js-meta.xml）中审查或实施闪电数据服务最佳实践时使用 — UI API与Apex，refreshApex / 通知记录更新可用，@salesforce/schema导入，LDS记录表单数据模式。

触发以下内容：“应用LDS最佳实践到此LWC”、“审查此LWC是否存在LDS最佳实践问题”、“审查此组件是否存在闪电数据服务问题”、“此数据使用UI API还是Apex？”、“记录保存后修复陈旧数据”、“同步LDS缓存”、“使用@salesforce/schema定义字段名称”、“在getRecord与Apex之间做出选择”。

当构建新的LWC（使用experience-lwc-generate）、应用SLDS设计令牌（使用design-systems-slds-apply）、或一般性地选择或连接`lightning-*`基础组件的props/events/slots（使用experience-lwc-base-components-integrate——此技能仅涵盖LDS数据层原理，即使修复涉及基础记录表单）、或进行安全/从右到左/无障碍审查（单独流程）时，不要触发。

description: Fetch Evolutionary Conservation scores (phyloP, phastCons) and Transcription Factor Binding Sites (TFBS) from the UCSC Genome Browser. Use when analyzing whether genomic variants or regions are evolutionarily conserved, functionally important, or bounded by TF regulators across major projects (ENCODE, JASPAR, ReMap).
description_zh: 从UCSC基因组浏览器中获取进化保守性评分（phyloP、phastCons）及转录因子结合位点（TFBS）。在主要项目（ENCODE、JASPAR、ReMap）中，用于分析基因组变异或区域是否在进化上保守、功能上重要，或受转录因子调控边界限制。

description: Prepare evidence-bounded, constructive peer-review drafts and structured manuscript assessments. Use for authorized review of scientific manuscripts, protocols, preprints, or research proposals; reporting-guideline selection; claim–evidence checks; methods, statistics, reproducibility, ethics, figure/table, and citation critique; or revision-response planning.
description_zh: 准备证据边界清晰、建设性的同行评审草稿及结构化稿件评估。用于授权评审科学稿件、方案、预印本或研究提案；报告准则选择；论断—证据核查；方法、统计、可重复性、伦理、图表及引用批判；或修订回复规划。

description: Complete App Store Optimization (ASO) toolkit for researching, optimizing, and tracking mobile app performance on Apple App Store and Google Play Store
description_zh: 用于研究、优化与追踪 Apple App Store 和 Google Play Store 上移动应用性能的完整 App Store 优化（ASO）工具包

description: Regenerates documentation files (agents.md, agent-skills.md, plugins.md, usage.md) from marketplace data using Jinja templates. Use when plugins are added, updated, or removed to keep documentation in sync.
description_zh: 基于市场数据使用 Jinja 模板重新生成文档文件（agents.md、agent-skills.md、plugins.md、usage.md）。当插件被添加、更新或移除时使用，以保持文档同步。

description: Apply animation principles — easing, staging, follow-through — to one specific UI motion. Use when tuning how an animation feels. For product-wide duration and easing tokens use `motion-system` (design-systems); for a full interaction spec use `micro-interaction-spec`.
description_zh: 应用动画原则——缓动、阶段化、余动——到特定的 UI 动效中。用于调整动画质感时使用。全产品的持续时间与缓动令牌请使用 `motion-system`（设计系统）；如需完整的交互规范，请使用 `micro-interaction-spec`。

description: Universal UI/UX design principles covering visual hierarchy, interaction laws, typography foundations, and WCAG accessibility requirements. Use when making design decisions not covered by a specific design system, validating principle compliance, or resolving conflicts between aesthetics and accessibility. Design-system-agnostic and applies to every surface.
description_zh: 涵盖视觉层次、交互规则、排版基础及WCAG无障碍要求的通用UI/UX设计原则。在特定设计系统未涵盖的设计决策制定、原则合规性验证或解决美观与无障碍冲突时使用。该原则与设计系统无关，适用于所有界面。

description: Queries the UniBind database for experimentally validated transcription factor (TF) binding sites. Use when retrieving direct TF-DNA interaction datasets, downloading binding site coordinates (BED/FASTA) for local analysis, or listing available datasets by species, cell line, or TF name. Don't use to query specific intervals, locations, genes, motif models or expression data.
description_zh: 查询UniBind数据库中经实验验证的转录因子（TF）结合位点。用于检索直接的TF-DNA相互作用数据集、下载结合位点坐标（BED/FASTA格式）进行本地分析，或按物种、细胞系或TF名称列出可用数据集。请勿用于查询特定区间、位置、基因、基序模型或表达数据。

description: Create banners using AI image generation. Discuss format/style, generate variations, iterate with user feedback, crop to target ratio. Use when user wants to create a banner, header, hero image, cover image, GitHub banner, Twitter header, or readme banner.
description_zh: 使用 AI 图像生成创建横幅。讨论格式/风格，生成变体，根据用户反馈进行迭代，裁剪至目标比例。当用户需要创建横幅、页头、首屏图、封面图、GitHub 横幅、Twitter 页头或 README 横幅时使用。

description: Connect to a running ComfyUI instance, queue workflows, monitor execution, and retrieve results. Supports both online (REST API) and offline (JSON export) modes. Use when executing ComfyUI workflows or checking server status.
description_zh: 连接正在运行的 ComfyUI 实例，排队工作流、监控执行并获取结果。支持在线（REST API）和离线（JSON 导出）两种模式。适用于执行 ComfyUI 工作流或检查服务器状态时。

description: Help users write effective specs and design documents. Use when someone is creating technical specs, feature specs, design docs, or trying to communicate product requirements to engineering and design teams.
description_zh: 帮助用户编写有效的规格与设计文档。当需要创建技术规格、功能规格、设计文档，或向工程和设计团队传达产品需求时使用。

description: Comprehensive document creation, editing, and analysis with support for tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, and text extraction. When Claude needs to work with professional documents (.docx files) for: (1) Creating new documents, (2) Modifying or editing content, (3) Working with tracked changes, (4) Adding comments, or any other document tasks
description_zh: 支持跟踪修订、批注、格式保留和文本提取，实现全面的文档创建、编辑与分析。当 Claude 需要为以下情况处理专业文档（.docx 文件）时：(1) 创建新文档，(2) 修改或编辑内容，(3) 处理跟踪修订，(4) 添加批注，或执行其他文档任务。

description: Check and resize images for social media platforms. Run scripts/check.js to validate any image against specs for Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Snapchat, and Threads — get a ranked match list with exact resize commands. Run scripts/resize.js to export a correctly-sized copy. Use when a user asks to validate image dimensions, resize an image for a platform, check if an image fits a spec, or prep assets for social media posting or ads.
description_zh: 检查并调整社交媒体平台的图片大小。运行 `scripts/check.js` 来验证任何图片是否符合 Instagram、Facebook、X（Twitter）、LinkedIn、TikTok、YouTube、Pinterest、Snapchat 和 Threads 的规格，获取按优先级排列的匹配列表及精确的调整大小命令。运行 `scripts/resize.js` 导出尺寸正确的副本。适用于用户要求验证图片尺寸、为平台调整图片大小、检查图片是否符合规格，或为社交媒体发布或广告准备素材的场景。

description: Explore and query any dataset annotated with a Frictionless Data Package descriptor (datapackage.json). Use this skill whenever a user wants to discover what tables or resources a dataset contains, look up column names and descriptions, surface usage warnings embedded in metadata, or understand how to load data from Parquet files, DuckDB or SQLite databases, or CSV files described by a datapackage.json. Also use when the user has a datapackage.json and wants to know what's in it, how to query it efficiently, or how to connect its metadata to actual data files. Pairs well with dataset-specific skills (like `pudl`) that layer domain knowledge on top.
description_zh: 探索并查询任何已使用 Frictionless Data Package 描述符（datapackage.json）进行标注的数据集。当用户需要发现数据集包含哪些表格或资源、查询列名与描述、呈现嵌入元数据中的使用警告，或了解如何从由 datapackage.json 描述的数据集加载数据（包括从 Parquet 文件、DuckDB 或 SQLite 数据库以及 CSV 文件中加载）时，均应使用此技能。当用户拥有 datapackage.json 并希望了解其内容、如何高效查询，或如何将元数据与实际数据文件关联时，也应使用此技能。该技能与数据集特定技能（如 `pudl`）配合使用效果良好，后者在此基础上叠加领域知识。

description: Expert knowledge for deploying to Vercel with Next.js
description_zh: 使用 Next.js 部署到 Vercel 的专家知识

description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.
description_zh: 可规模化扩展的 React 组合模式。适用于在具有过多布尔属性的组件上进行重构、构建灵活组件库或设计可复用 API 的场景。适用于涉及组合组件、渲染属性、上下文提供者或组件架构的任务。包含 React 19 API 变更。

description: 股票投资调研执行引擎，执行8阶段投资尽调流程。接收stock-question-refiner生成的结构化调研指令，部署多智能体并行研究，生成带引用的投资尽调报告。覆盖：公司事实底座、行业周期、业务拆解、财务质量、股权治理、市场分歧、估值护城河、综合报告。当用户需要进行股票投资研究、基本面分析、投资尽调时使用此技能。
description_zh: 股票投资调研执行引擎，执行8阶段投资尽调流程。接收stock-question-refiner生成的结构化调研指令，部署多智能体并行研究，生成带引用的投资尽调报告。覆盖：公司事实底座、行业周期、业务拆解、财务质量、股权治理、市场分歧、估值护城河、综合报告。当用户需要进行股票投资研究、基本面分析、投资尽调时，使用此技能。

description: When the user wants help writing opening lines, hooks, first sentences, video hooks, thumbnails titles, or pin titles that grab attention. Also use when the user mentions 'hook,' 'opening line,' 'first line,' 'scroll stopper,' 'attention grabber,' 'headline,' 'video hook,' 'on-screen hook,' 'YouTube title,' 'thumbnail text,' 'pin title,' 'how to start my post,' or 'nobody reads past my first line.' Covers text-first platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Threads, Bluesky) and visual-first platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube). Can be used standalone or invoked by other creation skills. For writing full posts, see post-writer-sms. For threads, see thread-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户需要帮助撰写开场句、钩子、首句、视频钩子、缩略图标题或能吸引注意力的置顶标题时。当用户提及“钩子”、“开场句”、“首句”、“滚动止动器”、“注意力抓取器”、“标题”、“视频钩子”、“屏幕钩子”、“YouTube标题”、“缩略图文字”、“置顶标题”、“如何开始我的帖子”或“没有人会读到我第一句之后的内容”时。涵盖文本优先平台（LinkedIn、Twitter/X、Threads、Bluesky）和视觉优先平台（Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube）。可独立使用，也可被其他创作技能调用。撰写完整帖子请参见 post-writer-sms。撰写线程请参见 thread-writer-sms。

description: Install Holoscan SDK via the NGC Docker container. Use for container-based installs; not for native apt/pip/Conda installs.
description_zh: 通过 NGC Docker 容器安装 Holoscan SDK。适用于容器化安装；不适用于 apt/pip/Conda 原生安装。

description: This skill should be used whenever users need YouTube video scripts written. On first use, collects comprehensive preferences including script type, tone, target audience, style, video length, hook style, use of humor, personality, and storytelling approach. Generates complete, production-ready YouTube scripts tailored to user's specifications for any topic. Maintains database of preferences and past scripts for consistent style.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户需要撰写 YouTube 视频脚本时使用。首次使用时会收集综合偏好，包括脚本类型、语调、目标受众、风格、视频时长、钩子风格、幽默运用、个性以及叙事方式。根据用户的具体要求，为任何主题生成完整、可直接用于制作的 YouTube 脚本。同时维护偏好和历史脚本数据库，以确保风格的一致性。

description: Summarize recent compound-engineering plugin releases, or answer a specific question about a past release with a version citation. Use when the user types `/ce-release-notes` or asks "what changed in compound-engineering recently?" or "what happened to `<skill-name>`?".
description_zh: 总结 compound-engineering 插件近期版本的发布情况，或针对某次过往发布的具体问题，并附上版本引用进行回答。当用户输入 `/ce-release-notes`，或询问“compound-engineering 最近有哪些变化？”或询问“`在 `<skill-name>` 上发生了什么？`”时使用。

description: Investigate a Grafana Cloud k6 test — describe the script, list run history, identify pass/fail status, pull raw metric time-series and log lines for one or more runs, and (if asked) safely edit the test script. Use when the user asks about a specific k6 cloud test or run, gives a `/a/k6-app/tests/<id>` or `/a/k6-app/runs/<id>` URL, asks "is this test passing", "why are my k6 tests failing", "show me metrics for run X", "show me logs for run X", or wants to add thresholds / fix a failing test. Trigger this skill even when the user doesn't explicitly say "investigate" — pasted `/a/k6-app/...` URLs, "why did run X fail", "what happened with my test", "is my test healthy", "the latest run looks weird", "checks are failing but the run says passed", or any request to diagnose a Grafana Cloud k6 run all qualify.
description_zh:
调查一个 Grafana Cloud k6 测试——描述脚本内容，列出运行历史，识别通过/失败状态，为一次或多次运行拉取原始指标时序数据及日志行，并根据要求安全编辑测试脚本。

当用户询问具体的 k6 云端测试或运行情况、提供 `/a/k6-app/tests/<id>` 或 `/a/k6-app/runs/<id>` URL、询问"这个测试是否通过"、"我的 k6 测试为何失败"、"显示运行 X 的指标"、"显示运行 X 的日志"，或需要添加阈值/修复失败的测试时使用。

即使用户没有明确说"调查"，也需触发此技能——粘贴的 `/a/k6-app/...` URL、"运行 X 为何失败"、"我的测试发生了什么"、"我的测试是否健康"、"最新一次运行看起来很异常"、"检查失败但运行结果显示通过"，或任何要求诊断 Grafana Cloud k6 运行情况的请求，均符合触发条件。

description: Build a QA checklist for verifying that a build matches the design. Use at implementation review. For the spec engineers build from, use `handoff-spec`.
description_zh: 创建一份 QA 检查清单，用于验证构建与设计是否一致。在实施评审中使用。规格工程师所依据的规格使用 `handoff-spec`。

description: Design waiting experiences — spinners, skeletons, optimistic updates, and progressive reveal. Use when content takes time to arrive. For the latency budget itself use `doherty-threshold`; for success confirmation use `feedback-patterns`.
description_zh: 设计等待体验——加载旋转、骨架屏、乐观更新与渐进式展示。当内容需要较长时间加载时使用。针对延迟预算本身，使用 `doherty-threshold`；针对成功确认，使用 `feedback-patterns`。

description: Provides final code cleanup after task review approval. Removes debug logs, temporary comments, dead code, optimizes imports, and improves readability. Use when asked to clean up code, polish, finalize, tidy up, remove technical debt, or prepare code for completion after review. Not for refactoring logic or fixing bugs—focused solely on cosmetic and hygiene cleanup.
description_zh: 在任务评审通过后进行最终代码清理。移除调试日志、临时注释、死代码，优化导入并提升可读性。当需要清理代码、打磨、定稿、整理、消除技术债务，或在评审后为代码完成做准备时使用。不用于重构逻辑或修复缺陷——仅专注于外观与卫生性清理。

description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focuses on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise.
description_zh: 为提升清晰度、一致性和可维护性，简化并优化代码，同时保留所有功能。除非另有指示，重点处理近期修改的代码。

description: Drafts overdue-invoice reminder emails from the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) plus PayPal, Stripe, and Airwallex data, matched to each customer's payment history and tone (gentle for good customers, firm for repeat late payers). Sends via PayPal with owner approval; everything else queues as a mail draft, with the Airwallex hosted pay link included where one exists. Use when the user asks "who owes me money," mentions overdue invoices, or wants to follow up on unpaid invoices.
description_zh: 根据账本（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）以及 PayPal、Stripe 和 Airwallex 的数据，起草逾期发票提醒邮件，并匹配每个客户的支付记录与语气（对优质客户采用温和语气，对多次逾期付款的客户采用坚决语气）。通过 PayPal 发送邮件，需经负责人审批；其余内容作为邮件草稿加入队列，若存在 Airwallex 托管支付链接，则一并包含在内。当用户询问“谁该还我钱”、提及逾期发票或希望跟进未付发票时使用。

description: AI-native tutor and onboarding workflow for the four independent Claude certification tracks in AI Engineering from Scratch. Use when a learner wants to choose a Claude certification, prepare for CCAO-F, CCDV-F, CCAR-F, or CCAR-P, resume a certification path, learn the next lesson interactively, run and verify practical labs, build scored artifacts, take a diagnostic or mock exam, or remediate weak exam domains from GitHub with Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another agent.
description_zh: AI工程从零开始的四个独立Claude认证路径的AI原生导师与引导工作流。当学习者需要选择Claude认证、准备CCAO-F、CCDV-F、CCAR-F或CCAR-P，续接认证路径，交互式学习下一课，运行并验证实践实验，构建评分工件，参加诊断或模拟考试，或借助Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor或其他智能体从GitHub修复薄弱考试领域时使用。

description: Review or re-review a PR by number in an isolated worktree. Runs the `om-code-review` skill — or, for spec-only design PRs, a specification review — submits approve/request-changes, manages pipeline labels. On changes-requested, the autofix loop (fix/test/validate/re-review until merge-ready) runs on the automation's own PRs or with --autofix; other authors' PRs get review + handoff only. Usage - /om-auto-review-pr <PR-number> [--autofix]
description_zh: 在隔离的工作树中，按编号审查或重新审查一个PR。运行 `om-code-review` 技能——或针对仅规格设计的PR进行规范审查——提交批准/请求变更，管理流水线标签。当请求变更时，自动修复循环（fix/test/validate/re-review，直到合并就绪）在自动化自身的PR上运行，或使用 --autофикс；其他作者的PR仅进行审查和交接。用法：/om-auto-review-pr <PR-number] [--autофикс]

description: Chinese financial data access using AkShare library. Fetch real-time and historical data for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, futures, funds, and macroeconomic indicators. Use when user requests Chinese market data, stock prices, market analysis, or financial information from Chinese exchanges. Supports stock quotes, historical data, futures market data, fund information, macroeconomic indicators, and real-time market updates.
description_zh: 使用 AkShare 库进行中文金融数据访问，可获取 A 股、香港股票、美国股票、期货、基金及宏观经济指标的实时和历史数据。当用户请求中文交易所的市场数据、股票价格、市场分析或金融信息时使用。支持股票行情、历史数据、期货市场数据、基金信息、宏观经济指标及实时市场动态。

description: Deep linter reference for authoring or debugging a vigiles enforce() rule — plugin tables, AST selectors, type-aware rules, auto-fix, and edge cases for ESLint, Ruff, Pylint, RuboCop, Stylelint, and Clippy. Use when you need the exact rule name or config for a specific linter, not for running a linter. (JVM/Go linters — detekt, ktlint, Checkstyle, golangci-lint — and Cedar have no deep-dive file yet; their reference lives in docs/linter-support.md.)
description_zh: 编写或调试 vigiles enforce() 规则的深度检查器参考指南——涵盖 ESLint、Ruff、Pylint、RuboCop、Stylelint 及 Clippy 的插件表、AST 选择器、类型感知规则、自动修复与边界情况。当您需要针对特定检查器获取准确的规则名称或配置时使用，而非用于运行检查器。(JVM/Go 检查器——detekt、ktlint、Checkstyle、golangci-lint——以及 Cedar 尚无深度解析文档；其参考内容位于 docs/linter-support.md。)

description: Machine learning in Python with scikit-learn. Use when working with supervised learning (classification, regression), unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction), model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, preprocessing, or building ML pipelines. Provides comprehensive reference documentation for algorithms, preprocessing techniques, pipelines, and best practices.
description_zh:
Python 中的机器学习（使用 scikit-learn）

适用于进行监督学习（分类、回归）、无监督学习（聚类、降维）、模型评估、超参数调优、数据预处理，或构建机器学习流水线时的使用。为算法、预处理技术、流水线及最佳实践提供全面的参考文档。

description: Comprehensive GitLab CLI (glab) command reference and workflows for all GitLab operations via terminal. Use when user mentions GitLab CLI, glab commands, GitLab automation, MR/issue management via CLI, CI/CD pipeline commands, Artifact Registry token exchange, repo operations, authentication setup, or any GitLab terminal operations. Routes to specialized sub-skills for auth, CI, MRs, issues, releases, repos, and 30+ other glab commands. Triggers on glab, GitLab CLI, GitLab commands, GitLab terminal, GitLab automation.
description_zh: 面向终端的全面 GitLab CLI（glab）命令参考与工作流程，覆盖所有 GitLab 操作。当用户提及 GitLab CLI、glab 命令、GitLab 自动化、通过 CLI 进行 MR/问题管理、CI/CD 流水线命令、Artifact Registry 令牌交换、仓库操作、身份验证设置，或任何 GitLab 终端操作时使用。将请求路由至针对认证、CI、MR、问题、发布、仓库以及 30 多项其他 glab 命令的专用子技能。触发条件包括 glab、GitLab CLI、GitLab 命令、GitLab 终端、GitLab 自动化。

description: When the user wants to turn one piece of content into multiple formats or adapt content across text-first and visual-first platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube). Also use when the user mentions 'repurpose,' 'turn this into,' 'adapt this for,' 'cross-post,' 'reformat,' 'blog to social,' 'newsletter to posts,' 'video to posts,' 'YouTube to clips,' 'Reels from a podcast,' or 'get more from this content.' For writing original posts, see post-writer-sms. For threads, see thread-writer-sms. For carousels, see carousel-writer-sms. For visual-first captions, see caption-writer-sms.
description_zh:
当用户希望将某一段内容转换为多种格式，或针对以文本为主的平台和以视觉为主的平台（LinkedIn、Twitter/X、Threads、Bluesky、Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube）对内容进行适配时，应使用本功能。

此外，当用户提及“重新利用”、“将此内容转换为”、“为……调整此内容”、“跨平台发布”、“重新格式化”、“将博客内容发布至社交媒体”、“将通讯稿转换为帖文”、“将视频转换为帖文”、“将 YouTube 内容转换为片段”、“从播客中制作 Reels”、或“从该内容中获取更多价值”时，也应使用本功能。

如需撰写原创帖文，请参阅 post-writer-sms；如需撰写多线程内容，请参阅 thread-writer-sms；如需制作轮播图，请参阅 carousel-writer-sms；如需撰写以视觉为主的配文，请参阅 caption-writer-sms。

description: How to launch distributed Megatron-LM training jobs on a SLURM cluster. Covers a minimal sbatch skeleton, environment-variable setup for torch.distributed.run, CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS rules across hardware and parallelism modes, container conventions, monitoring, and per-rank failure diagnosis.
description_zh: 如何在SLURM集群上启动分布式Megatron-LM训练任务。本文涵盖最小sbatch骨架、torch.distributed.run的环境变量配置、跨硬件与并行模式的CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS规则、容器规范、监控以及各rank故障诊断。

description: Install Holoscan SDK v4.3+ via Conda in a CUDA 13 environment. Use for Conda installs; redirect CUDA 12 hosts to container/wheel.
description_zh: 在CUDA 13环境下通过Conda安装Holoscan SDK v4.3+。用于Conda安装；将CUDA 12主机重定向至容器/Wheel。

description: Investigate a failing GitHub Actions run or job and create a GitHub issue for the failure.
description_zh: 排查失败的 GitHub Actions 运行或任务，并针对该失败创建 GitHub Issue。

description: Install Holoscan SDK Python wheel via pip into a venv. Use for Python installs; not for native C++/apt or Conda installs.
description_zh: 通过 pip 在虚拟环境（venv）中安装 Holoscan SDK Python wheel。仅用于 Python 安装；不可用于原生 C++/apt 或 Conda 安装。

description: You are a senior backend engineer operating production-grade services under strict architectural and reliability constraints. Use when routes, controllers, services, repositories, express middleware, or prisma database access.
description_zh: 你是一位在严格的架构与可靠性约束下运行生产级服务的资深后端工程师。在处理路由、控制器、服务、仓库、Express 中间件或 Prisma 数据库访问时使用。

description: Test system for Megatron-LM. Covers test layout, recipe YAML structure, adding and running unit and functional tests, golden values, marker filters, and CI parity.
description_zh: 用于 Megatron-LM 的测试系统。涵盖测试布局、配方 YAML 结构、添加与执行单元测试和功能测试、黄金值、标记过滤器以及 CI 一致性。

description: Used for generating synthetic T1, T2, FLAIR, SWI, or MRA brain MRI volumes with NV-Generate-CTMR MR-Brain v1. Not for production training data.
description_zh: 用于使用 NV-Generate-CTMR MR-Brain v1 生成合成 T1、T2、FLAIR、SWI 或 MRA 脑 MRI 体体积。不适用于生产训练数据。

description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.
description_zh: 超高压缩沟通模式。通过去除填充词、冠词和客套话，将 token 使用量减少约 75%，同时保持完全的技术准确性。当用户说“原始人模式”、“像原始人一样说话”、“使用原始人”、“减少 token”、“简短一些”，或调用 /caveman 时使用。

description: Evaluate account-level drawdown circuit breaker rules from trader-memory-core state and decide whether new trade risk is allowed today. Uses realized P&L, losing-streak cooldowns, and weekly/monthly drawdown limits without any external API.
description_zh: 评估基于交易员记忆核心状态的账户级回撤熔断规则，并决定今日是否允许新的交易风险。系统使用已实现盈亏、亏损连击冷却以及周度/月度回撤限额，且无需任何外部API。

description: Build Holoscan SDK from source via the in-tree ./run script. Use only when published packages don't meet the user's needs.
description_zh: 通过树内 ./run 脚本从源码构建 Holoscan SDK。仅在发布的包无法满足用户需求时使用。

description: Brev instance operating guidance for NeMo-RL agents working in /home/ubuntu/RL with limited workspace disk, a larger /ephemeral volume, and optional /home/ubuntu/RL/.env secrets. Use when running nemo-rl-auto-research campaigns, experiments, training jobs, model or dataset downloads, shared cache-heavy commands, log-producing runs, checkpoint generation, W&B or Hugging Face authenticated workflows, or any workflow that may create large files on Brev.
description_zh: Brev 实例操作指南：针对在 /home/ubuntu/RL 目录下、工作区磁盘容量有限、/ephemeral volume 较大且可选 /home/ubuntu/RL/.env 密钥的 NeMo-RL 智能体。用于运行 nemo-rl-auto-research 任务、实验、训练作业、模型或数据集下载、缓存密集的共享命令、生成日志的运行、检查点生成、W&B 或 Hugging Face 认证工作流，以及任何可能在 Brev 上生成大文件的工作流。

description: Install Holoscan SDK natively on Ubuntu via apt. Use for C++ installs on Ubuntu; pair with /holoscan-install-wheel for Python.
description_zh: 通过 apt 在 Ubuntu 上原生安装 Holoscan SDK。用于 Ubuntu 上的 C++ 安装；搭配 /holoscan-install-wheel 用于 Python。

description: Evaluate models, datasets, and agents with the NeMo Evaluator plugin. Use for metric selection, SDK checks, platform jobs, and result retrieval.
description_zh: 通过 NeMo Evaluator 插件评估模型、数据集和智能体。用于指标选择、SDK 检查、平台任务与结果检索。

description: Writes marketing copy for landing pages, emails, and social media posts. Use when creating promotional content, sales copy, or brand messaging.
description_zh: 撰写落地页、电子邮件及社交媒体帖子的营销文案。在创建推广内容、销售文案或品牌信息时使用。

description: This skill should be used when establishing comprehensive QA testing processes for any software project. Use when creating test strategies, writing test cases following Google Testing Standards, executing test plans, tracking bugs with P0-P4 classification, calculating quality metrics, or generating progress reports. Includes autonomous execution capability via master prompts and complete documentation templates for third-party QA team handoffs. Implements OWASP security testing and achieves 90% coverage targets.
description_zh: 此技能应在为任何软件项目建立全面的QA测试流程时使用。在创建测试策略、按照Google测试标准编写测试用例、执行测试计划、使用P0-P4分类跟踪Bug、计算质量指标或生成进度报告时使用。包括通过主提示词实现自主执行能力，以及为第三方QA团队交接提供完整的文档模板。实现OWASP安全测试，并达成90%覆盖率目标。

description: Split a PR into multiple PRs to reduce the number of required CODEOWNERS reviewer groups.
description_zh: 将一个 PR 拆分为多个 PR，以减少所需 CODEOWNERS 审查组数量。

description: Apply a Salesforce sandbox post-copy automation JSON config against a target org. For each entry, the skill derives the correct Tooling API sobject from the entry's `ConfigurationName`, verifies the derivation via a describe probe, resolves the record Id via SOQL-over-REST, then PATCHes the record via the compound `Metadata` field using `sf api request rest`. `ScheduledApex` entries run anonymous Apex `System.schedule(...)` via `sf apex run` (because `CronTrigger` is read-only) and verify via a `CronTrigger` SOQL read-back. Use when the user asks to apply, run, execute, dry-run, or preview a post-copy or post-refresh config file (e.g. `post-copy-config.json`) against a sandbox. Trigger phrases: "apply post-copy config", "run post-copy automation", "execute sandbox post-refresh JSON", "apply sandbox refresh config", "configure sandbox after refresh". DO NOT TRIGGER for generating the config JSON from an SOP (delegate to `automation-sandbox-post-copy-config-generate`), or for deploying metadata XML.
description_zh: 针对目标组织应用 Salesforce 沙箱复制后自动化 JSON 配置。对每个条目，该技能根据条目的 `ConfigurationName` 推导出正确的 `Tooling API` sobject，通过描述探测验证推导结果，通过 SOQL-over-REST 解析记录 Id，然后通过复合 `Metadata` 字段使用 `sf api request rest` 对记录执行 PATCH 操作。`ScheduledApex` 条目通过 `sf apex run` 执行匿名 Apex 的 `System.schedule(...)`（因为 `CronTrigger` 为只读），并通过 `CronTrigger` 的 SOQL 读取回显进行验证。适用于用户请求针对沙箱应用、运行、执行、试运行或预览复制后或刷新后的配置文件（例如 `post-copy-config.json`）的场景。触发短语：“应用复制后配置”、“运行复制后自动化”、“执行沙箱刷新后 JSON”、“应用沙箱刷新配置”、“刷新后配置沙箱”。请勿用于根据标准操作流程（SOP）生成配置文件 JSON（需委派至 `automation-sandbox-post-copy-config-generate`），或用于部署元数据 XML。

description: Use this skill to analyze a Salesforce Aura component bundle (.cmp, .app, .evt, .intf, Controller.js, Helper.js, Renderer.js) and produce a framework-agnostic migration blueprint (PRD.yaml / PRD.md / PRD.json) capturing public API, data requirements, slots, events, states, accessibility, styling, localization, and security posture. This is Phase 1 (analysis + PRD) only — it does NOT author or edit component code, wire adapters, or Jest tests, and does not write .html/.js/.css/.js-meta.xml. TRIGGER when the user says "analyze this Aura component", "migrate Aura", "convert .cmp", "produce a migration blueprint", "generate a PRD for this Aura component", or mentions aura:attribute, aura:handler, force:recordData, $Label, $Resource, component.get, cmp.find, or an input directory containing .cmp files. DO NOT TRIGGER when there is no Aura source (delegate downstream LWC authoring to experience-lwc-generate), for post-migration scoring, or for refactoring an existing modern component.
description_zh: 使用此技能，分析 Salesforce Aura 组件包（.cmp、.app、.evt、.intf、Controller.js、Helper.js、Renderer.js），并产出框架无关的迁移蓝图（PRD.yaml / PRD.md / PRD.json），涵盖公共 API、数据需求、插槽、事件、状态、可访问性、样式、本地化和安全姿态。这是第一阶段（分析 + PRD）——它不编写或编辑组件代码、适配器或 Jest 测试，也不编写 .html/.js/.css/.js-meta.xml。当用户说“分析此 Aura 组件”、“迁移 Aura”、“转换 .cmp”、“产出迁移蓝图”、“为该 Aura 组件生成 PRD”，或提及 aura:attribute、aura:handler、force:recordData、$Label、$Resource、component.get、cmp.find，或包含 .cmp 文件的输入目录时，触发本技能。当不存在 Aura 源（需将下游 LWC 编写委托给 experience-lwc-generate）、用于迁移后评分，或用于重构现有现代组件时，不要触发本技能。

description: Evaluate a local pre-trade checklist before manual order entry, blocking planless, oversized, revenge-risk, market-regime-blocked, or circuit-breaker-blocked entries while journaling the decision for trader-memory-core review.
description_zh: 在手动下单之前，评估本地交易前的检查清单，拦截无计划、超规模、存在报复风险、受市场制度阻碍或熔断器阻断的入场，同时记录决策以供交易员记忆核心审查。

description:
Alibaba Cloud SLS (Simple Log Service) log query & analysis skill. Use this skill to help users write, explain, optimize, execute, or troubleshoot SLS index search, SQL analytics, and SPL scan/pipeline statements through the aliyun CLI.
Triggers: "SLS 查询", "SLS 分析", "日志查询", "日志分析", "log query", "analyze sls logs", "aliyun log query".
description_zh:
阿里云 SLS（简单日志服务）日志查询与分析技能。使用本技能通过 aliyun CLI 帮助用户编写、解释、优化、执行或排查 SLS 索引检索、SQL 分析以及 SPL 扫描/流水线语句。

触发词：“SLS 查询”、“SLS 分析”、“日志查询”、“日志分析”、“log query”、“analyze sls logs”、“aliyun log query”。

description: Generate cohesive, project-specific SVG icon sets for websites and applications. Use this skill whenever the user needs custom icons, an icon set for a website or app, icons for a client project, or mentions needing SVG icons that look consistent together. Also trigger when the user describes a project and icons would naturally be part of the deliverable — e.g. 'I'm building a site for a plumber' implies they'll need service icons. Trigger on: 'icons for', 'icon set', 'custom icons', 'SVG icons', 'make me icons', 'I need icons', 'website icons', 'project icons', or any request for consistent visual assets for a web project. Produces individual SVG files with a consistent style engine, not generic icon library lookups.
description_zh: 为网站和应用生成协调一致且符合项目特定需求的SVG图标集。每当用户需要自定义图标、网站或应用图标集、客户项目图标，或提到需要整体看起来协调一致的SVG图标时，请使用此技能。当用户描述一个项目且图标自然成为交付成果的一部分时，也需触发——例如，“我为一名水管工搭建网站”意味着他们需要服务图标。触发条件包括：“icons for”（图标）、“icon set”（图标集）、“custom icons”（自定义图标）、“SVG icons”（SVG图标）、“make me icons”（为我生成图标）、“I need icons”（我需要图标）、“website icons”（网站图标）、“project icons”（项目图标），以及任何要求为Web项目提供一致视觉资源的请求。产出带有统一风格引擎的独立SVG文件，而非通用图标库的外观。

description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Uses live web data via the Bright Data CLI for accurate detection of JS-injected schema, hreflang, canonicals, and live SERP-based ranking checks. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," "SEO health check," "my traffic dropped," "lost rankings," "not showing up in Google," "site isn't ranking," "Google update hit me," "page speed," "core web vitals," "crawl errors," or "indexing issues." Use this even if the user just says something vague like "my SEO is bad" or "help with SEO" — start with an audit. For building pages at scale to target keywords, see programmatic-seo. For implementing structured data, see schema-markup. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.
description_zh: 当用户想要对其网站进行SEO问题的审计、审查或诊断时。通过Bright Data CLI的实时网页数据，准确检测由JS注入的schema、hreflang、canonicals以及基于实时SERP的排名检查。当用户提及“SEO审计”、“技术SEO”、“为什么我没有排名”、“SEO问题”、“页面SEO”、“meta标签审查”、“SEO健康检查”、“我的流量下降”、“排名丢失”、“没有在Google上显示”、“网站没有排名”、“Google更新影响了我的网站”、“页面速度”、“核心网页指标”、“爬取错误”或“索引问题”时，也要使用此功能。即使用户只是说一些模糊的表述，如“我的SEO很糟糕”或“帮助进行SEO”，也要使用此功能——以审计开始。若要规模化构建以关键词为目标的页面，参见 programmatic-seo。若要实施结构化数据，参见 schema-markup。若要优化AI搜索，参见 ai-seo。

description:
Translates an image (or a set of image references — screenshots,
mockups, Figma URLs, live websites) into two mirrored design-system
artifacts: `docs/design.md` (YAML tokens + prose, following Google's open
[design.md](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md) format, for the
coding agent) and `docs/design.html` (a self-contained, token-driven style
guide rendering every token and component live, for the human to read).
Reads the imagery, asks targeted clarifying questions, derives the design
tokens (colors, typography, spacing, rounded, components), and writes both
files. Fully standalone — requires no other document or skill. Use when the
founder says "create a design system", "design from image",
"translate image to design", "create design.md", "image to design
system", "extract design tokens", or shares an image with no other
clear intent.
description_zh: 将图像（或一组图像引用——屏幕截图、演示稿、Figma URL、在线网站）转换为两份镜像设计系统产物：`docs/design.md`（YAML 令牌 + 正文，遵循 Google 开源 [design.md](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md) 格式，供编码代理使用）以及 `docs/design.html`（自包含、由令牌驱动的风格指南，实时渲染所有令牌和组件，供人类阅读）。读取图像，提出针对性澄清问题，推导设计令牌（颜色、排版、间距、圆角、组件），并生成这两个文件。完全独立运行——无需其他文档或技能。当创始人提出“创建设计系统”、“从图像设计”、“将图像转换为设计”、“创建 design.md”、“图像至设计系统”、“提取设计令牌”，或分享图像但缺乏其他明确意图时使用。

description: Expert guidance for browser automation using Puppeteer with best practices for web scraping, testing, screenshot capture, and JavaScript execution in headless Chrome.

description: Use ALWAYS when a prompt mentions GraphQL, lightning/uiGraphQLApi, @wire(graphql, ...), or gql template tags in an LWC context — even if the surface ask is "build an LWC". Owns the ENTIRE flow: introspect the org's LDS GraphQL schema, identify entities/fields, construct the schema-validated gql query or mutation, wire it into the LWC via lightning/uiGraphQLApi, verify against a connected org. REQUIRED whenever a prompt asks to render, list, or edit Salesforce records (Account, Contact, Case, custom objects) via GraphQL — the .html and .js scaffolding IS in scope. DO NOT delegate to experience-lwc-generate: that skill has NO GraphQL schema introspection, NO create_lds_graphql_read_query binding, and defaults to getRecord/getRelatedListRecords wire adapters which will not satisfy a GraphQL prompt. DO NOT TRIGGER only if the prompt forbids GraphQL, chooses UIAPI/Apex (use experience-lds-best-practices-apply), or asks for data requirements (use experience-lds-data-requirements-generate).
description_zh:
当提示词中在 LWC 上下文中提及 GraphQL、lightning/uiGraphQLApi、@wire(graphql, ...) 或 gql 模板标签时，**必须使用**（Use ALWAYS）——即使表面要求仅为“构建一个 LWC”。

**完全掌控整个流程**：内省组织（org）的 LDS GraphQL 模式，识别实体/字段，构建经过模式校验的 gql 查询或 mutation，通过 lightning/uiGraphQLApi 将其接入 LWC，并在已连接的组织中进行验证。

每当提示词要求通过 GraphQL 渲染、列出或编辑 Salesforce 记录（Account、Contact、Case、自定义对象）时，**必须使用**（REQUIRED）——.html 和 .js 的脚手架均在此范围内。

**切勿委托给** experience-lwc-generate：该技能**不具备** GraphQL 模式内省能力，**缺少** create_lds_graphql_read_query 绑定，且默认使用 getRecord/getRelatedListRecords 的 wire 适配器，这些适配器无法满足 GraphQL 提示词的需求。

**仅在以下情况**才**不应触发**：提示词禁止使用 GraphQL、选择使用 UIAPI/Apex（使用 experience-lds-best-practices-apply），或询问数据需求（使用 experience-lds-data-requirements-generate）。

description: QianWenAI cash balance query and fixed-amount Alipay recharge orchestration. Owns the outer recharge lifecycle while delegating the payment-side step to `alipay-payment-skill` when selected. Covers balance, recharge orders, order results, recharge history, missing current-order QR recovery, Token Plan redirects, and recharge page guidance. TRIGGER when: explicit QianWenAI balance query, confirmed recharge request with amount, model-call error explicitly reporting insufficient QianWenAI balance or account overdue, recharge result/history query, the user reports that the current QianWenAI recharge QR was not displayed, Token Plan purchase redirect, user wants guidance for the QianWenAI recharge page, or user explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qianwen-payment). DO NOT TRIGGER when: usage/billing/subscription queries (use qianwen-usage), incoming Alipay payment links or unrelated merchant orders (use alipay-payment-skill), refunds, non-QianWenAI products.
description_zh:
**QianWenAI 现金余额查询与固定金额支付宝充值编排**

负责充值的外部生命周期管理，当选定时，将支付环节委托给 `alipay-payment-skill`。涵盖余额、充值订单、订单结果、充值历史、当前订单二维码缺失恢复、Token Plan 跳转及充值页面指引。

**TRIGGER when：** 明确的 QianWenAI 余额查询、已确认的带金额充值请求、模型调用错误明确报告 QianWenAI 余额不足或账户逾期、充值结果/历史查询、用户报告当前 QianWenAI 充值二维码未显示、Token Plan 购买跳转、用户需要 QianWenAI 充值页面指引、或用户明确以名称调用本技能（例如使用 qianwen-payment）。

**DO NOT TRIGGER when：** 使用/计费/订阅查询（使用 qianwen-usage）、传入的支付宝支付链接或无关商户订单（使用 alipay-payment-skill）、退款、非 QianWenAI 产品。

description: Build a Stockbee-style setup model book from momentum-burst screener candidates, then update 3-day and 5-day forward outcomes with MFE/MAE, stop-hit status, outcome tags, and cohort statistics. - taste-skill is invoked inside the ui-design workflow for style decisions

MUST USE together with project-builder whenever a project produces visual HTML/CSS/JS.

description: Instructions to make or update an app's UI so that it adapts to different Android devices including phones, tablets, foldables, laptops, desktop, TV, Auto and XR. It includes how to handle different window sizes, pointing devices (such as mouse) and text entry devices (such as keyboard) using the Compose MediaQuery API. It also covers multi-pane layouts using Navigation3 Scenes, adaptive UI components (such as buttons) with varying target sizes, and adaptive layouts (including navigation areas - nav rails and nav bars) using the Compose Grid and FlexBox APIs.
description_zh: 关于创建或更新应用界面，使其能够适配包括手机、平板、折叠屏、笔记本电脑、台式机、电视、汽车（Auto）和XR设备在内的各类Android设备的说明。该内容涵盖如何使用Compose MediaQuery API处理不同的窗口尺寸、指向设备（如鼠标）和文本输入设备（如键盘）；同时介绍如何利用Navigation3场景实现多分区布局，以及使用Compose Grid和FlexBox API实现具有不同目标尺寸的响应式UI组件（如按钮）和响应式布局（包括导航区域——导航栏与导航轨）。

description: Create and manage Axiom monitors and notifiers via the v2 public API. Use when building alerting, routing notifications, validating monitor behavior, and maintaining alert configurations end-to-end.
description_zh: 通过 v2 公共 API 创建并管理 Axiom 监控与通知器。用于在构建告警、路由通知、验证监控行为以及端到端维护告警配置时使用。

description: Launch new products from idea to first customers. Use when launching products, finding early adopters, building launch week playbooks, diagnosing why adoption stalls, or learning that press coverage does not equal growth. Includes the three-layer diagnosis, the 2-week experiment cycle, and the launch that got 50K impressions and 12 signups.
description_zh: 推动新产品从创意落地到首批客户。适用于产品发布、寻找早期采用者、制定发布周运营方案、诊断采用停滞原因，或厘清媒体报道与增长之间的关系。涵盖三层诊断法、两周实验周期，以及实现5万次曝光与12次注册的发布案例。

description: Give your agents capabilities through tools (function calling). Helps you identify what your agent needs to do, create tool definitions, and attach them to config variations.
description_zh: 通过工具（函数调用）为你的智能体赋予能力。它帮助你识别智能体需要做什么、创建工具定义，并将它们关联到配置变体。

description: Used for generating synthetic CT volumes and masks with NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-ct. Not for production training data without review.
description_zh: 用于通过 NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-ct 生成合成 CT 体积和掩码。未经审核不得用于生产训练数据。

description:
Alibaba Cloud DMS Database Read/Write Skill. Use this skill to search for target databases in DMS and execute SQL queries and data modifications.
Triggers: "DMS query", "database query", "execute SQL", "search database", "DMS SQL", "insert data", "update data".
description_zh:
阿里云 DMS 数据库读写技能。使用此技能在 DMS 中搜索目标数据库并执行 SQL 查询和数据修改。

触发词：“DMS 查询”、“数据库查询”、“执行 SQL”、“搜索数据库”、“DMS SQL”、“插入数据”、“更新数据”。

description: Production-ready CSS transitions for web apps. Use when implementing notification badges, dropdowns, modals, panel reveals, page transitions, card resizes, number pop-ins, text swaps, icon swaps, success checks, avatar group hovers, or error state shakes. Triggers on "add a transition", "animate the dropdown", "make the modal open smoothly", "swap icon", "page slide", "stagger animation", "open / close transition", "make it animate", "tween the size", "fade between", "smooth open", "smooth close", "success animation", "checkmark animation", "confirmation animation", "form error", "shake on invalid", "validation feedback", "hover lift", "avatar stack hover", "chip group hover".
description_zh: 适用于Web应用的生产级CSS过渡效果。在实现通知徽标、下拉菜单、模态框、面板展开、页面过渡、卡片缩放、数字弹出、文本切换、图标切换、成功提示、头像组悬停或错误状态抖动时使用。在以下操作时触发：“添加过渡效果”、“动画化下拉菜单”、“使模态框平滑打开”、“切换图标”、“页面滑动”、“错开动画”、“打开/关闭过渡”、“使其动画化”、“调整尺寸”、“在...之间淡入淡出”、“平滑打开”、“平滑关闭”、“成功动画”、“对勾动画”、“确认动画”、“表单错误”、“无效时抖动”、“验证反馈”、“悬停提升”、“头像堆叠悬停”、“标签组悬停”。

description: Screen US stocks for Stockbee-style selling-exhaustion hammer setups using prior momentum, pullback depth, undercut/reclaim, long lower-wick geometry, close-location, volume confirmation, quality/liquidity gates, and risk-distance scoring. Use when the user asks for Stockbee, Pradeep Bonde, exhaustion setup, selling exhaustion, hammer reversal, undercut reclaim, near-close reversal candidates, or pullback entries in high-quality funds-owned stocks.
description_zh: 利用先前动能、回调深度、下插/收回、长下影线形态、收盘位置、量能确认、质量/流动性门槛和风险距离评分，筛选美国股票市场中的“Stockbee”风格抛售衰竭锤子形态。当用户询问Stockbee、Pradeep Bonde、抛售衰竭形态、抛售衰竭、锤子反转、下插收回、接近收盘的反转候选，或在高质量基金持仓股票中寻求回调入场机会时使用。

description: SQLAlchemy ORM and Alembic migration best practices for building safe, performant database schemas. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, or database query patterns. Triggers on tasks involving SQLAlchemy ORM, Alembic migrations, database schema changes, or query optimization.
description_zh: SQLAlchemy ORM 与 Alembic 迁移最佳实践：用于构建安全、高效的数据库架构。本技能在编写、审查或重构 SQLAlchemy 模型、Alembic 迁移或数据库查询模式时应使用。适用于涉及 SQLAlchemy ORM、Alembic 迁移、数据库架构变更或查询优化的任务。

description: Add authentication and authorization to a Blazor Web App, accounting for the app's render mode. USE WHEN the user needs [Authorize] on pages, AuthorizeView, role or policy-based access, login/logout Identity pages, or AuthenticationStateProvider. Also USE WHEN auth state is null after WebAssembly loads, SignInManager throws in an interactive component, <NotAuthorized> content never renders in static SSR, or HttpContext.User is null in an interactive component. DO NOT USE for general component authoring (see author-component), for prerendering concerns unrelated to auth (see support-prerendering), or for managing non-auth cascading state (see coordinate-components).
description_zh: 为 Blazor Web App 添加身份认证与授权，并考虑应用的渲染模式。适用场景：当用户需要在页面、AuthorizeView、基于角色或策略的访问控制上使用 [Authorize]、登录/登出 Identity 页面，或 AuthenticationStateProvider 时。另外，当 WebAssembly 加载后认证状态为 null、交互式组件中 SignInManager 抛出异常、静态 SSR 中 <NotAuthorized] 内容始终不渲染，或交互式组件中 HttpContext.User 为 null 时，也应适用。不应用于：一般组件编写（参见 author-component）、与身份认证无关的预渲染问题（参见 support-prerendering），或管理非身份认证级联状态（参见 coordinate-components）。

description: Report a bug in the compound-engineering plugin
description_zh: 向 compound-engineering 插件报告错误

description: Install npm packages in a Docker sandbox environment. Use this skill whenever you need to install, reinstall, or update node_modules inside a container where the workspace is mounted via virtiofs. Native binaries (esbuild, lightningcss, rollup) crash on virtiofs, so packages must be installed on the local ext4 filesystem and symlinked back.
description_zh: 在 Docker 沙箱环境中安装 npm 包。当您需要在通过 virtiofs 挂载工作区的容器内安装、重新安装或更新 node_modules 时，请使用此技能。原生二进制文件（esbuild、lightningcss、rollup）在 virtiofs 上会崩溃，因此包必须在本地 ext4 文件系统上安装，并符号链接回。

description: Ralph Wiggum-inspired automation loop for specification-driven development. Orchestrates task implementation, review, cleanup, and synchronization using a Python script. Use when: user runs /loop command, user asks to automate task implementation, user wants to iterate through spec tasks step-by-step, or user wants to run development workflow automation with context window management. One step per invocation. State machine: init → choose_task → implementation → review → fix → cleanup → sync → update_done. Supports --from-task and --to-task for task range filtering. State persisted in fix_plan.json.
description_zh: 以 Ralph Wiggum 为灵感的规格驱动开发自动化循环。使用 Python 脚本编排任务实施、审查、清理与同步。适用场景：用户运行 /loop 命令，用户要求自动化任务实施，用户希望逐步迭代规格任务，或用户需要结合上下文窗口管理运行开发工作流自动化。每次调用执行一步。状态机：初始化 → 选择任务 → 实施 → 审查 → 修复 → 清理 → 同步 → 更新完成。支持 --from-task 和 --to-task 参数进行任务范围过滤。状态持久化保存在 fix_plan.json 中。

description: Used for command-shape or live NV-Reason-CXR chest X-ray reasoning smoke tests. Not for diagnosis or clinical reporting.
description_zh: 用于命令式或实时 NV-Reason-CXR 胸部 X 射线推理冒烟测试。不用于诊断或临床报告。

description: Used for running NV-Segment-CTMR on CT or MRI NIfTI volumes and recording label-map evidence. Not for clinical interpretation.
description_zh: 用于在CT或MRI的NIfTI体数据上运行NV-Segment-CTMR，并记录标签图证据。不用于临床解读。

description: End-to-end passive reconnaissance for a domain, website or IP — builds an asset inventory covering registration, DNS, subdomains, infrastructure, tech stack, history and ownership without sending a single packet to the target. Use when asked to research or profile a domain or website, map what an organisation runs, or investigate a suspicious site without alerting its operator. Applies to vendor and third-party risk assessment, attack-surface review, M&A technical diligence, phishing and fraud-site investigation, and pre-engagement scoping. Reference at useosint.com/skills/recon-a-domain-passively.
description_zh: 端到端被动侦察——针对域名、网站或IP地址，构建涵盖注册信息、DNS、子域名、基础设施、技术栈、历史记录及所有权信息的资产清单，全程不向目标发送任何数据报文。当被要求研究或分析某个域名或网站、梳理组织运行资源，或在不惊动运营者的前提下调查可疑网站时使用。适用于供应商与第三方风险评估、攻击面审查、并购技术尽职调查、钓鱼网站与欺诈网站调查，以及项目前期范围界定。参考 useosint.com/skills/recon-a-domain-passively。

description: Use when the user asks to look up a Korean building-register title record by address, PNU, legal-dong code, or parcel number.
description_zh: 当用户要求按地址、PNU、法律洞代码或地块编号查询韩国建筑登记产权记录时使用。

description: Routes human attention to decisions that matter in agent-generated code. Active during planning, implementing, fixing. Defines when and how to place DECISION markers in code comments. Also applies when reviewing a diff/PR on request.
description_zh: 将人类注意力引导至代理生成的代码中至关重要的决策。在规划、实施和修复过程中生效。定义何时以及如何向代码注释添加 DECISION 标记。在应要求审查 diff/PR 时同样适用。

description: Mobile-first design thinking and decision-making for iOS and Android apps. Touch interaction, performance patterns, platform conventions. Teaches principles, not fixed values. Use when building React Native, Flutter, or native mobile apps.
description_zh: 面向 iOS 和 Android 应用的移动优先设计思维与决策：触控交互、性能模式、平台规范。传授原则，而非固定数值。适用于构建 React Native、Flutter 或原生移动应用时使用。

description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.
description_zh: 对明确支持的科学文件执行有界、局部探索性分析。用于脱敏 CSV/TSV/JSON 数据画像；可选的 NumPy、HDF5、FASTA/FASTQ 以及基础图像元数据检查；缺失性/泄露性审计；离群点及变换敏感性；以及严谨的探索性数据分析（EDA）报告框架。其他领域格式仅作为参考，未知格式默认关闭。

description: Build and maintain a Stockbee-style daily 20% mover study for US equities by scanning +20%/-20% movers, classifying catalysts and setup context, updating forward outcomes, and summarizing cohort patterns. Use when the user asks to run a daily 20% study, backfill historical 20% movers, find recurring edge patterns, or build a model book of explosive market moves.
description_zh: 通过扫描涨跌幅达20%的股票，分类催化剂与形态背景，更新前瞻结果，并总结批次规律，构建并维护一款面向美国股市的、类似 Stockbee 风格的每日20%异动研究。当用户要求执行每日20%研究、回填历史20%异动数据、查找反复出现的优势模式，或构建爆发行情的模型库时使用。

description: World-class data engineering skill for building scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT systems, and data infrastructure. Expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, and modern data stack. Includes data modeling, pipeline orchestration, data quality, and DataOps. Use when designing data architectures, building data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, or implementing data governance.
description_zh: 构建可扩展的数据管道、ETL/ELT 系统及数据基础设施的世界级数据工程技能。精通 Python、SQL、Spark、Airflow、dbt、Kafka 及现代数据栈，涵盖数据建模、管道编排、数据质量与 DataOps。适用于设计数据架构、构建数据管道、优化数据工作流或实施数据治理场景。

description: Runs standard or fixed-channel softmax finetuning of NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D on CT NIfTI image/label datasets, with optional MONAI-native MLflow tracking and checkpoint evidence. Uses softmax for predefined, mutually exclusive classes; keeps the standard workflow when point prompts or runtime-variable classes are needed. Not for clinical validation.
description_zh: 在CT NIfTI图像/标签数据集上对NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D运行标准或固定通道的softmax微调，可选使用MONAI原生的MLflow追踪及检查点证据。使用softmax对预定义且互斥的类别进行运算；当需要点提示或运行时变量类别时，保留标准流程。不适用于临床验证。

description: Audit token usage across a product for coverage, drift, and hard-coded values. Use when tokens exist and you suspect they are being bypassed. For defining tokens in the first place, use `design-token` (design-systems).
description_zh: 审计产品内 token 的使用情况，检查覆盖率、漂移与硬编码值。当 token 存在且你怀疑它们被绕过时使用。首次定义 token 时，使用 `design-token`（design-systems）。

description: Help users assess and achieve product-market fit. Use when someone is trying to determine if they have PMF, measuring user engagement and retention, running the Sean Ellis survey, or figuring out if they should scale or keep iterating.
description_zh: 帮助用户评估并实现产品市场契合度。适用于当某人尝试确定是否已达到PMF、衡量用户参与度和留存率、开展西恩·埃利斯调查，或判断是应扩大规模还是继续迭代时使用。

description: Find AI models on Replicate using search and curated collections.
description_zh: 通过搜索和精选合集，在 Replicate 上查找 AI 模型。

description: Typst document creation and package development. Use when: (1) Working with .typ files, (2) User mentions typst, typst.toml, or typst-cli, (3) Creating or using Typst packages, (4) Developing document templates, (5) Converting Markdown/LaTeX to Typst
description_zh:
Typst 文档创建与包开发。适用场景：
（1）处理 .typ 文件，
（2）用户提及 typst、typst.toml 或 typst-cli，
（3）创建或使用 Typst 包，
（4）开发文档模板，
（5）将 Markdown/LaTeX 转换为 Typst

description: Delegate a coding task to the Command Code CLI (`cmd`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Command Code — phrasings like "have Command Code do X", "delegate this to commandcode", "run it through cmd", or "use Command Code to implement/fix/refactor" — or to run a queue of coding tasks through Command Code while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Command Code CLI（`cmd`）作为后台执行者，然后自行审查其 diff 并落地。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Command Code 时，使用此方法——例如使用“让 Command Code 执行 X”、“将此任务委托给 commandcode”、“通过 cmd 运行它”或“使用 Command Code 实现/修复/重构”等表述；或者同时让多个编码任务队列通过 Command Code 处理，同时自己担任审查者。对于足够小可以直接内联完成的任务，或者用户要求直接编写代码而不进行委托时，请勿使用。

description: Contributes to and debugs Node.js core, including nodejs/node commit and PR tone, contribution workflows, native crashes, V8 performance, node-gyp builds, N-API bindings, and libuv issues. Use when drafting or reviewing a Node.js core commit or pull request, working in nodejs/node, or diagnosing C++ addons, binding.gyp failures, segfaults, native leaks, V8 deoptimizations, and event-loop internals.
description_zh: 参与并调试 Node.js 核心，包括 nodejs/node 提交与拉取请求的风格、贡献工作流、原生崩溃、V8 性能、node-gyp 构建、N-API 绑定以及 libuv 问题。起草或审查 Node.js 核心提交或拉取请求、在 nodejs/node 中工作，或诊断 C++ 插件、binding.gyp 失败、段错误、原生内存泄漏、V8 反优化以及事件循环内部问题时使用。

description: Used for finetuning the NV-Generate-CTMR MAISI VAE from CT/MRI NIfTI datalists. Not for clinical or production data approval.
description_zh: 用于基于 CT/MRI NIfTI datalists 对 NV-Generate-CTMR MAISI VAE 进行微调。不适用于临床或生产数据审批。

description: Use to extend an existing agent project with memory, app integration, VPC, multi-agent, migration, model, browser, code interpreter, payments, or resource removal. Triggers: "add memory", "remember across sessions", "call agent from app", "invoke agent from code", "agent auth", "streaming", "VPC", "VPC connectivity", "can't reach from VPC", "multi-agent", "A2A", "A2A auth", "orchestrator not delegating", "specialist not called", "migrate Bedrock Agent", "migration issue", "change model", "browser tool", "code interpreter", "delete agent", "tear down", "agentcore remove", "cross-account memory", "add payments capability to my agent", "wire payments plugin", "integrate x402 payments with the agent I'm building", "add MPP payments", "Machine Payments Protocol". External APIs via Gateway: use agents-connect. New project: use agents-get-started. CLI/dev-server errors: use agents-debug. Runtime x402/MPP payments: use agents-pay. Migration-specific Strands vs LangGraph routes here.
description_zh:
用于在现有的智能体项目中集成记忆、应用集成、VPC、多智能体、迁移、模型、浏览器、代码解释器、支付功能，或移除资源。

*   "VPC 连接"
*   "VPC 中无法连接"
*   "多智能体"

*   "A2A 认证"
*   "编排器未委派"
*   "未调用专家"
*   "迁移 Bedrock 智能体"
*   "迁移问题"
*   "更换模型"
*   "浏览器工具"
*   "代码解释器"
*   "删除智能体"
*   "拆卸"
*   "agentcore 移除"
*   "跨账户记忆"
*   "为我的智能体添加支付功能"

通过网关调用外部 API：使用 agents-connect。

运行时 x402/MPP 支付：使用 agents-pay。

迁移相关：此处处理 Strands 与 LangGraph 的路由。

description: Use when the user asks for a code review by a fleet of specialized reviewer agents, wants multiple independent reviewer perspectives, or asks to run reviewers in single-pass or iterative fix-until-clean mode. Launches focused subagents for correctness, security, architecture, conventions, simplicity, UX, reliability, telemetry, testing, compatibility, and documentation review.
description_zh: 适用于当用户要求由一组专用评审代理进行代码评审、需要多个独立评审视角，或要求以单次通过或迭代修复直至通过的方式运行评审代理时。启动针对正确性、安全性、架构、规范、简洁性、UX、可靠性、遥测、测试、兼容性以及文档审查的专注子代理。
