description: Create and configure configs in LaunchDarkly. Helps you choose between agent vs completion mode, create the config, add variations with models and prompts, and verify the setup.
description_zh: 在 LaunchDarkly 中创建并配置配置。帮助您选择智能体模式与完成模式、创建配置、添加带有模型和提示词的变体，并验证设置。

description: Guidance on how to use Claude Code effectively — covering context management, verification strategies, the explore-plan-implement workflow, prompting techniques, session management, parallel sessions, and common failure patterns. Use this skill whenever the user asks how to get the most out of Claude Code, how to write better prompts, how to manage context, when to use plan mode, how to automate tasks, or when they describe a frustrating pattern like Claude repeating mistakes or losing track of instructions.
description_zh: 关于如何有效使用 Claude Code 的指导——涵盖上下文管理、验证策略、explore-plan-implement 工作流、提示技巧、会话管理、并行会话以及常见失败模式。当用户询问如何最大程度利用 Claude Code、如何编写更好的提示词、如何管理上下文、何时使用计划模式、如何自动化任务，或描述诸如 Claude 重复错误或偏离指令等令人沮丧的模式时，请使用本技能。

description: Craft a portfolio case study with narrative arc, process evidence, and outcomes. Use when telling a project's story to an external audience. For an internal stakeholder deck, use `presentation-deck`.
description_zh: 制作具有叙事弧线、过程证据和成果的作品集案例研究。用于向外部受众讲述项目故事时。针对内部利益相关者演示文稿，使用 `presentation-deck`。

description: Guide for creating, structuring, and improving Claude skills (SKILL.md). Use when building a new skill, reviewing an existing skill, writing SKILL.md frontmatter, defining trigger conditions, troubleshooting skill problems (not triggering, over-triggering, instructions not followed), or planning skill distribution. When working on any skill in this repository: also load the cc-best-practices skill, and always update both CLAUDE.md and README.md skill tables after any skill change. Do NOT use for general Claude Code configuration or hook setup.
description_zh: Claude 技能创建、结构化与优化指南 (SKILL.md)。在构建新技能、审查现有技能、编写 SKILL.md 前置元数据、定义触发条件、排查技能问题（如未触发、过度触发、指令未遵循）或规划技能分发时使用。在此仓库中处理任何技能时：此外还需加载 cc-best-practices 技能，并在任何技能变更后，始终更新 CLAUDE.md 和 README.md 中的技能表格。不用于一般性的 Claude Code 配置或钩子设置。

description: Run a spec-driven agent loop where coding tasks live as markdown specs that move through inbox → active → archive, get implemented by Claude Code or Codex, and pass a review gate before they count as done. Use when the user mentions "loop factory", a "spec-driven loop", an "agent factory", wants repeatable/reviewable agent work, or when a repo has a factory/specs/inbox or factory/specs/active directory. Also covers installing and scaffolding the loop-factory CLI into a project.
description_zh: 运行一个基于规格驱动的智能体循环，其中编码任务以 Markdown 规格形式，在收件箱 → 活跃 → 归档之间流转，由 Claude Code 或 Codex 实现，并在计入完成前通过审查关卡。适用于当用户提及“循环工厂”、“规格驱动循环”、“智能体工厂”，需要可重复、可审查的智能体工作，或当代码仓库包含工厂/规格/收件箱，或工厂/规格/活跃目录时的场景。同时也涵盖将循环工厂 CLI 安装并搭建到项目中的操作。

description: Experiment with configs by creating and managing variations. Helps you test different models, prompts, and parameters to find what works best through systematic experimentation.
description_zh: 通过创建和管理变体来实验配置。帮助你通过系统化实验，测试不同的模型、提示词和参数，以找到最佳方案。

description: Operate Bitbucket Cloud or Data Center repositories, pull requests, branches, issues, pipelines, permissions, and webhooks with bkt. Use when a request names Bitbucket or bkt; confirm the platform before platform-specific commands.
description_zh: 使用 bkt 操作 Bitbucket Cloud 或数据中心的仓库、拉取请求、分支、问题、流水线、权限和 Webhooks。当请求中提及 Bitbucket 或 bkt 时使用；在运行平台特定命令之前，请先确认平台。

description: Generates a Markdown compatibility matrix for Apache Camel Spring Boot, Spring Boot, and Apache CXF versions by running the camel-springboot-matrix.sh script. Use when the user asks to generate or update the Camel compatibility matrix, check Camel Spring Boot version compatibility, or run the camel-springboot-matrix script. Supports optional version range arguments (min max).
description_zh: 通过运行 `camel-springboot-matrix.sh` 脚本，生成 Apache Camel Spring Boot、Spring Boot 和 Apache CXF 版本的 Markdown 兼容矩阵。适用于用户请求生成或更新 Camel 兼容矩阵、检查 Camel Spring Boot 版本兼容性，或运行 `camel-springboot-matrix.sh` 脚本的场景。支持可选的版本范围参数（min max）。

description: Create, update, refactor, explain, or review Semantic Kernel solutions using shared guidance plus language-specific references for .NET and Python.
description_zh: 创建、更新、重构、解释或审查 Semantic Kernel 解决方案，利用针对 .NET 和 Python 的共享指导及语言特定参考资料。

description: Look up conventions, patterns, and concrete implementations from your own GitHub repositories checked out locally under ~/projects/referenzen/. Use this skill whenever there is uncertainty about how something is done in your codebase family — e.g. Helm chart structure, Kubernetes manifests, framework configuration patterns, Docker Compose conventions, CI/CD pipeline setup, or any other recurring architectural decision. Invoke it proactively before guessing at a convention; always cite the source project and path when a pattern is adopted. Also use when the user asks to check out, update, or search reference repositories, or to generate an overview/report of GitHub Actions triggers (push, pull_request, schedule/cron) across repositories.
description_zh:
查阅你本地检出至 ~/projects/referenzen/ 目录下的自己 GitHub 仓库中的约定、模式及具体实现。

当你对代码库家族中某项操作的执行方式存在不确定性时，请使用本技能，例如 Helm chart 结构、Kubernetes manifests、框架配置模式、Docker Compose 约定、CI/CD 流水线配置，或任何其他反复出现的架构决策。在自行猜测约定之前，请主动调用该技能；采纳某一模式时，务必引用来源项目和路径。

当用户要求检出、更新或搜索参考仓库，或要求生成 GitHub Actions 触发器（push、pull_request、schedule/cron）在多个仓库中的概览/报告时，也请使用本技能。

description: Django access control and IDOR security review. Use when reviewing Django views, DRF viewsets, ORM queries, or any Python/Django code handling user authorization. Trigger keywords: "IDOR", "access control", "authorization", "Django permissions", "object permissions", "tenant isolation", "broken access".
description_zh: Django 访问控制与 IDOR 安全评审。用于审查 Django 视图、DRF 视图集、ORM 查询，或任何处理用户授权的 Python/Django 代码时使用。触发关键词："IDOR"，"访问控制"，"授权"，"Django 权限"，"对象权限"，"租户隔离"，"访问失效"。

description: Configure config targeting rules to control which variations serve to different users. Enable percentage rollouts, attribute-based rules, segment targeting, and guarded rollouts.
description_zh: 配置配置定向规则，以控制不同用户所服务的不同变体。启用按百分比放量、基于属性的规则、分群定向及受保护放量。

description: Update, archive, and delete LaunchDarkly configs and their variations. Use when you need to modify config properties, change model parameters, update instructions or messages, archive unused configs, or permanently remove them.
description_zh: 更新、归档并删除 LaunchDarkly 配置及其变体。当您需要修改配置属性、更改模型参数、更新指令或消息、归档未使用的配置或永久删除它们时使用。

description: Define and organise tokens for colour, spacing, type, and elevation with naming and usage rules. Use when establishing the token layer. For auditing existing usage use `design-token-audit` (designer-toolkit); for multi-brand mapping use `theming-system`.
description_zh: 定义并组织颜色、间距、字体与层级令牌，并制定命名和使用规则。在建立令牌层时使用。审计现有用法时使用 `design-token-audit`（designer-toolkit）；进行多品牌映射时使用 `theming-system`。

description:
Video understanding for any model — native passthrough for small files,
frame extraction + audio transcription fallback for large files.

Use when the user asks to analyze, describe, or understand a video file
(e.g. "what's in this video", "summarize this clip", "transcribe this recording").
description_zh:
任意模型的视频理解——小文件原生透传，大文件抽帧 + 音频转写作为兜底。

当用户请求分析、描述或理解视频文件时使用
（例如：“这段视频里有什么？”“总结这个片段”“转写这段录音”）。

description: Call APIs, load data into components, and handle the async lifecycle in Blazor. USE FOR fetching data from a backend, submitting data to an API, displaying loading/error states, registering HttpClient, building service abstractions for Auto/WebAssembly render modes. DO NOT USE for form validation (see collect-user-input), prerendering persistence (see support-prerendering), or project scaffolding (see create-blazor-project).
description_zh: 在 Blazor 中调用 API、将数据加载到组件、处理异步生命周期。**用于**：从后端获取数据、向 API 提交数据、显示加载/错误状态、注册 HttpClient、为 Auto/WebAssembly 渲染模式构建服务抽象。**不要用于**：表单验证（参见 collect-user-input）、预渲染持久化（参见 support-prerendering）或项目脚手架（参见 create-blazor-project）。

description: Define actionable principles that resolve trade-offs when the team disagrees. Use when the same decisions keep getting relitigated. For a single project's framing, use `design-brief`.
description_zh: 定义解决团队分歧时权衡问题的可操作原则。当相同决策反复争议时使用。针对单个项目的框架，使用 `design-brief`。

description: Install and operate Hermes Tweet, a Hermes Agent plugin for X/Twitter research, timeline reading, tweet analysis, and approval-gated private or state-changing operations. Use this skill when installing Hermes Tweet, researching X/Twitter accounts, monitoring launch signals, investigating mentions, auditing giveaways, or preparing gated X operations. Use proactively when a Hermes Agent workflow needs current X/Twitter context. Requires XQUIK_API_KEY for read and action tools.
description_zh: 安装并操作 Hermes Tweet，这是一款 Hermes Agent 插件，用于X/Twitter的研究、时间线阅读、推文分析及经审批控制的私有或状态变更操作。在安装Hermes Tweet、研究X/Twitter账号、监控发布信号、调查提及、审计赠品活动或准备有门槛的X操作时，请使用本技能。当Hermes Agent的工作流程需要当前的X/Twitter上下文时，应主动使用本技能。读取和操作工具需要 XQUIK_API_KEY。

description: Create and manage agent graphs — directed graphs of configs connected by edges with handoff logic. Use when building multi-agent workflows where configs route to each other.
description_zh: 创建和管理智能体图——由配置通过带有交接逻辑的边连接的有向图。用于构建多智能体工作流，其中配置之间相互路由时使用。

description: Create and manage prompt snippets — reusable text blocks referenced inside config variation prompts. Keeps common instructions, personas, and guardrails consistent across multiple configs.
description_zh: 创建和管理提示词片段——可复用的文本块，在配置变体提示词中引用。使多个配置间的常见指令、角色设定和护栏保持一致。

description: Instrument an existing codebase with LaunchDarkly config tracking. Walks the four-tier ladder (managed runner → provider package → custom extractor + trackMetricsOf → raw manual) and picks the lowest-ceremony option that still captures duration, tokens, and success/error.
description_zh: 为现有代码库配置 LaunchDarkly 配置追踪。沿四层阶梯（受管运行器 → 提供者包 → 自定义提取器 + trackMetricsOf → 原始手动）遍历，选择最低仪式成本且仍能捕获时长、令牌及成功/错误状态的方案。

description: Design error prevention, detection, and recovery across a product — message content, placement, and escape routes. Use when errors span multiple flows. For validation inside a single form, use `form-design`.
description_zh: 产品级设计错误预防、检测与恢复——消息内容、放置位置与逃生路线。当错误跨越多个流程时使用。在单个表单内进行校验时，请使用 `form-design`。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
description_zh: 当用户需要对 PDF 文件做任何操作时，请使用此技能。这包括从 PDF 中读取或提取文本/表格、将多个 PDF 合并为一个、将 PDF 拆分、旋转页面、添加水印、创建新的 PDF、填写 PDF 表格、对 PDF 进行加密/解密、提取图像，以及通过 OCR 对扫描的 PDF 进行识别，使其可搜索。如果用户提到 .pdf 文件或要求生成此类文件，请使用此技能。

description: When the user wants to add recommendations, links, or content to Grokipedia. Also use when the user mentions "Grokipedia," "GEO wiki," "AI encyclopedia," "suggest Grokipedia article," "Grokipedia citation," "Grokipedia listing," "AI search citation," "GEO visibility," or "Grokipedia optimization." For multi-platform parasite SEO strategy, use parasite-seo. For broad AI search visibility, use generative-engine-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要为Grokipedia添加推荐、链接或内容时，使用。当用户提及“Grokipedia”、“GEO wiki”、“AI encyclopedia”、“建议Grokipedia文章”、“Grokipedia引用”、“Grokipedia列表”、“AI搜索引用”、“GEO可见性”或“Grokipedia优化”时，也使用。针对多平台寄生虫SEO策略，使用parasite-seo。针对广泛的AI搜索可见性，使用generative-engine-optimization。

description: Comprehensive PostgreSQL database engineering skill covering indexing strategies, query optimization, performance tuning, partitioning, replication, backup and recovery, high availability, and production database management. Master advanced PostgreSQL features including MVCC, VACUUM operations, connection pooling, monitoring, and scalability patterns.
description_zh: 全面掌握PostgreSQL数据库工程技能，涵盖索引策略、查询优化、性能调优、分区、复制、备份与恢复、高可用性及生产数据库管理等方面。深入掌握MVCC、VACUUM操作、连接池、监控及可扩展性模式等高级PostgreSQL功能。

description: Design a usability study — research questions, methodology, participant criteria, metrics, and facilitation guide. Use when planning the study as a whole. For writing the task scenarios inside it, use `test-scenario` (prototyping-testing).
description_zh: 设计可用性研究——研究问题、方法论、参与者标准、指标和引导指南。在规划整个研究时使用。在编写其内部的任务场景时，使用 `test-scenario`（原型测试）。

description: Audit animation code against Disney's 12 principles adapted for web. Use when reviewing motion, implementing animations, or checking animation quality. Outputs file:line findings.
description_zh: 对照适配网页的迪士尼12原则，审计动画代码。在审查动态效果、实现动画或检查动画质量时使用。输出文件:行号发现结果。

description: 面向棘手 bug 和性能回退的纪律化 diagnosis loop。Reproduce → minimise → hypothesise → instrument → fix → regression-test. Use when user says "diagnose this" / "debug this", reports a bug, says something is broken/throwing/failing, or describes a performance regression.
description_zh: 面向棘手 bug 和性能回退的纪律化诊断循环。复现 → 最小化 → 假设 → 插桩 → 修复 → 回归测试。当用户说“诊断这个”/“调试这个”，报告 bug，表示程序出错、抛出异常或运行失败，或描述性能回退时使用。

description: Guide for setting up LaunchDarkly projects in your codebase. Helps you assess your stack, choose the right approach, and integrate project management that makes sense for your architecture.
description_zh: LaunchDarkly 项目配置指南。帮助您评估技术栈、选择合适的方案，并将契合您架构的项目管理集成到代码库中。

description: Run AI models on Replicate via predictions, webhooks, and streaming.
description_zh: 通过预测、Webhook 和流式传输，在 Replicate 上运行 AI 模型。

description: Create, track, retrieve, update, and delete custom business metrics for configs. Covers full lifecycle: define metric kinds via API, emit events via SDK, and query results.
description_zh: 为配置创建、跟踪、检索、更新和删除自定义业务指标，覆盖完整生命周期：通过API定义指标类型，通过SDK发布事件，并查询结果。

description: Attach judges to config variations for automatic LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Create custom judges, configure sampling rates, and monitor quality scores.
description_zh: 为自动 LLM 作为评审的评估，将评审员关联至配置变体。创建自定义评审员、配置采样率，并监控质量分数。

description: Implement web page content extraction capabilities using the z-ai-web-dev-sdk. Use this skill when the user needs to scrape web pages, extract article content, retrieve page metadata, or build applications that process web content. Supports automatic content extraction with title, HTML, and publication time retrieval.
description_zh: 使用 z-ai-web-dev-sdk 实现网页内容提取功能。当用户需要抓取网页、提取文章内容、获取页面元数据，或构建处理网页内容的程序时，请使用此技能。支持自动提取内容，可获取标题、HTML 和发布时间。

description: Generate complete SEO setup for local business websites — HTML head tags, JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema, robots.txt, sitemap.xml. Australian-optimised with +61 phone, ABN, suburb patterns. Use whenever the user wants SEO for a local business (tradesman, café, clinic, agency, retailer), needs JSON-LD structured data, asks for LocalBusiness schema, or wants meta tags / robots.txt / sitemap for a suburb-serving business.
description_zh: 为本地企业网站生成完整的SEO设置——包括HTML头部标签、JSON-LD LocalBusiness 模式、robots.txt、sitemap.xml。针对澳大利亚优化，包含+61电话、ABN和郊区模式。当用户需要本地企业（如工匠、咖啡馆、诊所、代理机构、零售商）的SEO服务、需要JSON-LD结构化数据、要求LocalBusiness模式，或需要为服务特定郊区的企业配置元标签/robots.txt/sitemap.xml时，可随时使用。

description: General Correctness rules, Rust patterns, comments, avoiding over-engineering. When writing code always take these into account
description_zh: 通用正确性规则、Rust 模式、注释、避免过度设计。编写代码时，始终要综合考虑这些因素。

description: Migrate an application with hardcoded LLM prompts to a full LaunchDarkly AgentControl implementation in five stages: audit the code, wrap the call, move the tools, add tracking, attach evaluators. Use when the user wants to externalize model/prompt configuration, move from direct provider calls (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, Strands) to a managed config, or stage a full hardcoded-to-LaunchDarkly migration.
description_zh: 将带有硬编码 LLM 提示词的应用迁移到完整的 LaunchDarkly AgentControl 实现，需经历五个阶段：审计代码、封装调用、迁移工具、添加跟踪、挂载评估器。适用场景包括：用户希望将模型/提示词配置外部化、将调用从直接供应商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Bedrock、Gemini、Strands）迁移至受管配置，或推进硬编码到 LaunchDarkly 的全面迁移。

description: Analyze and create a testing strategy for native Android apps - install testing libraries, set up test infrastructure, create harnesses for unit tests, UI tests, screenshot tests, and end-to-end tests.
description_zh: 为原生Android应用分析并制定测试策略——安装测试库，搭建测试基础设施，为单元测试、UI测试、截图测试和端到端测试创建测试框架。

description: Use when complex problems require systematic step-by-step reasoning with ability to revise thoughts, branch into alternative approaches, or dynamically adjust scope. Ideal for multi-stage analysis, design planning, problem decomposition, or tasks with initially unclear scope.
description_zh: 适用于复杂问题需要系统化分步推理、并具备修改思路、分支多种备选方案、动态调整范围能力的场景。特别适用于多阶段分析、设计规划、问题分解，或初始范围尚不明确的任务。

description: Write interface copy — microcopy, error messages, empty states, and CTAs. Use when the words are the deliverable. For content structure and ownership, use `content-strategy` (ux-strategy).
description_zh: 撰写界面文案——微文案、错误信息、空状态和 CTAs。当文本本身即为交付成果时使用。对于内容结构与所有权，使用 `content-strategy` (ux-strategy)。

description: Extract and interpret embedded file metadata with exiftool — EXIF GPS coordinates, camera make, model and serial, DateTimeOriginal and CreateDate timestamps, XMP and IPTC fields, and Office and PDF properties such as Author, Company, LastModifiedBy, template paths and revision counts. Use when reading EXIF from a photo, checking who really wrote a document, dating a file, fingerprinting a camera or phone, or investigating provenance in JPEG, HEIC, RAW, MP4, DOCX, XLSX or PDF. Applies to document-provenance disputes, insider-leak attribution, evidence handling, and pre-publication redaction checks. Reference at useosint.com/skills/secrets-in-file-metadata.
description_zh:
使用 exiftool 提取并解析嵌入文件元数据——EXIF 地理坐标、相机品牌、型号与序列号、DateTimeOriginal 和 CreateDate 时间戳、XMP 与 IPTC 字段，以及 Office 和 PDF 属性，例如作者、公司、最后修改者、模板路径和修订次数。

适用于从照片中读取 EXIF 信息、核实文档的真正撰写者、为文件确定时间、对相机或手机进行标识，以及在 JPEG、HEIC、RAW、MP4、DOCX、XLSX 或 PDF 文件中调查来源信息。

适用于文档来源争议、内部泄露溯源、证据处理以及发布前脱敏检查。

参考 useosint.com/skills/secrets-in-file-metadata。

description: Investigate a phone number — E.164 normalisation with libphonenumber, phoneinfoga scanning, carrier and line-type identification, VoIP and burner detection, messaging-app registration checks, and reverse-lookup and caller-ID sources. Use for phone OSINT and reverse phone lookup, "who owns this number", identifying a burner or VoIP number, or checking whether a number is registered on WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal. Applies to vishing and business email compromise investigation, verifying a counterparty before sending payment, recruitment and marketplace scam checks, and fraud triage. Reference at useosint.com/skills/whose-number-is-this.
description_zh: 调查电话号码——使用 libphonenumber 进行 E.164 标准化、phoneinfoga 扫描、运营商和线路类型识别、VoIP 和虚拟号码检测、即时通讯应用注册验证以及反向查询和来电号码来源。用于手机 OSINT 和电话反向查询，查询"这个号码是谁的"、识别虚拟号码或 VoIP 号码，或检查号码是否在 WhatsApp、Telegram 或 Signal 上注册。适用于语音钓鱼和商业邮件钓鱼调查、发送付款前验证交易对方、招聘及市场交易诈骗检查以及欺诈分类。参考 useosint.com/skills/whose-number-is-this。

description: Conduct design interviews, generate five distinct UI variations in a temporary design lab, collect feedback, and produce implementation plans. Use when the user wants to explore UI design options, redesign existing components, or create new UI with multiple approaches to compare.
description_zh: 进行设计访谈，在临时设计实验室中生成五种不同的UI变体，收集反馈，并制定实施计划。当用户想要探索UI设计选项、重新设计现有组件，或使用多种方法创建新UI以便对比时使用。

description: Takes an approved content brief and executes a campaign end-to-end: builds the posting calendar, generates Canva designs for social posts, drafts caption and email copy, and stages social sends in HubSpot. Canva is used for social posts only (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn) — email content is drafted as plain text and surfaced inline for the owner to send from their own tool. Every step requires explicit owner approval. This is the one-shot campaign executor: a finished brief goes in, a complete campaign comes out. Use when the owner hands off an approved brief or points at one — "run this brief," "execute the campaign," "turn this brief into posts," "build the campaign from the plan we approved." For day-to-day posting with no brief — "I need to post more," "what should we post" — use social-content-engine instead; it owns the standing calendar.
description_zh: 接收已批准的内容简报，并端到端执行一场活动：搭建发布日历，为社交帖子生成 Canva 设计稿，起草配文与邮件文案，并在 HubSpot 中排期社交发布。Canva 仅用于社交帖子（Instagram、Facebook、X、LinkedIn）——邮件内容以纯文本起草，并在界面内联呈现，由所有者从自己的工具发送。每个步骤均需所有者明确批准。这是一次性的活动执行器：提交一份完成的简报，即可产出完整活动。在所有者移交已批准简报或指向某份简报时使用——例如“执行该简报”“执行活动”“将该简报转化为帖子”“根据我们已批准的方案构建活动”。若用于日常发布且没有简报——例如“我需要再发布更多内容”“我们应该发布什么”——则改用 social-content-engine；它负责维护固定日历。

description: Statistical models library for Python. Use when you need specific model classes (OLS, GLM, mixed models, ARIMA) with detailed diagnostics, residuals, and inference. Best for econometrics, time series, rigorous inference with coefficient tables. For guided statistical test selection with APA reporting use statistical-analysis.
description_zh: Python 统计模型库。当您需要特定模型类（OLS、GLM、混合模型、ARIMA）以及详细的诊断、残差和推断功能时使用。最适合计量经济学、时间序列分析，以及配合系数表进行严谨推断。如需进行指导性的统计检验选择及 APA 报告撰写，请使用 statistical-analysis。

description: Choose prototype fidelity and method to match the design question and the decision at stake. Use before building a prototype. For what to test once it exists, use `test-scenario`.
description_zh: 选择与设计和关键决策相匹配的原型保真度和方法。在构建原型之前使用。原型确定后，测试的内容请使用 `test-scenario`。

description: AI Native Camp Day 1 온보딩. Claude와 대화하면서 Claude Code를 익힌다. "1일차", "Day 1", "온보딩" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp Day 1 온보딩。通过与 Claude 对话，掌握 Claude Code。用于 '1일차'、'Day 1'、'온보딩' 的请求。

description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.
description_zh: 引导用户通过协同编写文档的结构化工作流程。当用户需要撰写文档、提案、技术规范、决策文档或其他类似结构化内容时使用。该工作流程帮助用户高效传递上下文，通过迭代完善内容，并验证文档是否适用于读者。当用户提及编写文档、创建提案、起草规范或类似文档任务时触发。

description: Convert heterogeneous documents and selected URIs to Markdown with Microsoft MarkItDown for text analysis, search, and LLM/RAG ingestion. Covers safe local conversion, streams, Office/PDF/data formats, batch workflows, plugins, vision OCR, Azure extraction, and the official MCP server.
description_zh: 通过 Microsoft MarkItDown 将异构文档和选定 URI 转换为 Markdown，以支持文本分析、搜索以及 LLM/RAG 数据摄取。涵盖安全的本地转换、流式处理、Office、PDF 及数据格式、批处理工作流、插件、视觉 OCR、Azure 提取与官方 MCP 服务器。

description: Specify one component — props, states, variants, accessibility, and usage rules. Use when defining a library component. For the reusable doc scaffold use `documentation-template`; for a problem-solution pattern use `pattern-library`.
description_zh: 指定一个组件——属性（props）、状态（states）、变体（variants）、可访问性（accessibility）和使用规则。在定义库组件时使用。对于可复用的文档脚手架，使用 `documentation-template`；对于问题-解决方案模式，使用 `pattern-library`。

description: Use when the user asks for ugc ads or a task matching the examples below. Multi-cut jump-cut UGC product ad — HOOK + 3 JUMP CUTs + OUTRO, 15s, 9:16 vertical (3:4 optional, seedance only), POV first-person talking-head selfie, every beat has spoken dialogue with native lip-sync, 5-act narrative arc (set → name → reveal → twist → punchline). Six category essences (HAUL / APP / FOOD / BEAUTY / FITNESS / TECH) auto-picked from the input URL. Creator-style raw UGC talking-head with multi-beat conversational dialogue. Use when the user asks to "make a UGC ad", "jump-cut product ad", "POV product reveal", "creator-style ad", "haul-style ad", "unboxing ad", "TikTok-style product video", or "talking-head ad about [URL]".
description_zh:
当用户要求UGC广告或匹配以下示例的任务时使用。
多切跳剪UGC产品广告——钩子（HOOK）+ 3次跳剪（JUMP CUTs）+ 结尾（OUTRO），时长15秒，9:16竖屏（3:4可选，仅Seedance支持），第一人称POV对话式自拍口播，每个节奏点均配备带原生唇动的口语对话，5幕叙事弧（设定 → 介绍 → 揭示 → 反转 → 梗点）。
六大类目精华（HAUL / APP / FOOD / BEAUTY / FITNESS / TECH）根据输入网址自动选取。
创作者风格的原始UGC口播视频，包含多节奏对白对话。
当用户要求“制作UGC广告”、“跳剪产品广告”、“POV产品展示”、“创作者风格广告”、“HAUL式广告”、“开箱广告”、“TikTok风格产品视频”，或“关于[URL]的口播广告”时使用。

description: This skill should be used when completing LBO (Leveraged Buyout) model templates in Excel for private equity transactions, deal materials, or investment committee presentations. The skill fills in formulas, validates calculations, and ensures professional formatting standards that adapt to any template structure.
description_zh: 该技能适用于在 Excel 中为私募股权交易制作 LBO（杠杆收购）模型模板、编写交易文件或向投资委员会进行演示时的场景。该技能负责填充公式、验证计算结果，并确保符合适应各类模板结构的专业格式标准。

description: Expert guidance for deep learning, transformers, diffusion models, and LLM development with PyTorch, Transformers, Diffusers, and Gradio.
description_zh: 使用 PyTorch、Transformers、Diffusers 和 Gradio 进行深度学习、Transformer、扩散模型以及大语言模型（LLM）开发的专业指南。

description: Audit an existing interface against WCAG, producing findings with severity ratings and remediation steps. Use when you have a design or build to assess now. Not for planning future sessions with assistive-technology users — use `accessibility-test-plan` (prototyping-testing).
description_zh: 对现有界面进行 WCAG 合规性审计，生成包含严重程度评级与整改步骤的审计发现。当您有需要立即评估的设计或已构建界面时使用。不适用于规划未来涉及辅助技术用户的会话——请使用 `accessibility-test-plan`（原型测试）。

description: Use when deploying your agent to AWS, or when a deploy has failed. Handles pre-flight validation, CDK/IAM/quota error diagnosis, version management, rollback, and canary deployments. Triggers on: "deploy my agent", "agentcore deploy", "deploy failed", "CDK error", "rollback", "canary deploy", "pin version", "redeploy", "deploy stuck". Not for production hardening — use agents-harden. Not for adding capabilities before deploy — use agents-build or agents-connect. Not for VPC configuration errors — use agents-build.
description_zh:
将你的智能体部署到 AWS，或在部署失败时使用。处理部署前验证、CDK/IAM/配额错误诊断、版本管理、回滚及金丝雀部署。

触发条件：
- "deploy my agent"
- "agentcore deploy"
- "deploy failed"
- "CDK error"
- "rollback"
- "canary deploy"
- "pin version"
- "redeploy"
- "deploy stuck"

不用于生产环境加固——使用 agents-harden。
不用于在部署前添加功能——使用 agents-build 或 agents-connect。
不适用于 VPC 配置错误——使用 agents-build。

description: Use when the user asks to search Korean theses, academic articles, research reports, journals, or university-library catalog metadata through KERIS RISS. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户通过KERIS RISS搜索韩语论文、学术论文、研究报告、期刊或大学图书馆目录元数据时使用。在돌쇠中，会通过正式界面执行后续操作。

description: Searches for and downloads ethically-licensed stock images via the media-management MCP server. Use this skill whenever a user wants an image, photo, or picture — for BOTH requests to find existing imagery ("find a stock image", "search for a photo of X", "get a royalty-free image", "find an ethical image", editorial/news photography) AND requests phrased ambiguously as creating or generating one ("create an image of a sunset", "generate a picture of a team meeting", "make me a mountain image") — treat these as stock search requests, since this skill searches a stock photo library, it does not generate images. Do NOT offer alternative search methods or ask the user to pick one. Does not apply to searching internal CMS / Data Cloud media (use experience-search-coordinate). Does not apply when the user explicitly asks for AI-generated, synthetic, or computer-generated imagery — this skill only searches licensed stock photography and has no image-generation capability.
description_zh:
通过媒体管理MCP服务器搜索并下载经道德许可的库存图片。当用户需要图片、照片或图画时，请始终使用此技能——无论是用于查找现有图片的请求（如“查找库存图片”、“搜索X的照片”、“获取免版税图片”、“查找道德图片”、“编辑/新闻摄影”），还是措辞模糊、要求生成或创作的请求（如“创作一幅日落的图像”、“生成一张团队会议的图片”、“制作一张山景图片”）——均将其视为库存图片搜索请求，因为本技能搜索的是库存图片库，并不具备生成图片的能力。

不适用于搜索内部CMS / 数据云媒体（请使用 experience-search-coordinate）。当用户明确要求使用AI生成、合成或计算机生成的图像时，本技能不适用——该技能仅搜索授权库存摄影，且不具备图像生成能力。

description: Review pull requests for the MiniMax Skills repository. Use when reviewing PRs, validating new skill submissions, or checking existing skills for compliance. Run the validation script first for hard checks, then apply quality guidelines for content review. Triggers: PR review, pull request, validate skill, check skill.
description_zh: 审查 MiniMax Skills 仓库的 Pull Request。在审查 PR、验证新的技能提交或检查现有技能是否符合合规要求时使用。首先运行验证脚本进行硬性检查，然后根据质量指南进行内容审查。触发条件：PR 审查、Pull Request、验证技能、检查技能。

description: Remove the visible Gemini AI watermark from images using reverse alpha blending. Use when asked to strip Gemini watermarks, batch-process Gemini images, or build/modify a CLI script that removes the bottom-right Gemini watermark without HTML or server-side components.
description_zh: 使用反向 alpha 混合，移除图像中可见的 Gemini AI 水印。当被要求去除 Gemini 水印、批量处理 Gemini 图像，或构建/修改用于移除右下角 Gemini 水印的 CLI 脚本（无需使用 HTML 或服务器端组件）时使用。

description: Presentation creation, editing, and analysis. When Claude needs to work with presentations (.pptx files) for: (1) Creating new presentations, (2) Modifying or editing content, (3) Working with layouts, (4) Adding comments or speaker notes, or any other presentation tasks
description_zh: 演示文稿的创建、编辑与分析。当Claude需要为以下情况处理演示文稿（.pptx文件）时： (1) 创建新的演示文稿， (2) 修改或编辑内容， (3) 处理版式， (4) 添加批注或演讲者备注，或执行任何其他演示文稿相关任务。

description: Comprehensive markdown and Mermaid diagram writing skill. Use when creating any scientific document, report, analysis, or visualization. Establishes text-based diagrams as the default documentation standard with full style guides (markdown + mermaid), 24 diagram type references, and 9 document templates.
description_zh: 全面的 Markdown 与 Mermaid 图表编写技能。适用于创建任何科学文档、报告、分析或可视化内容。将基于文本的图表确立为默认文档标准，并提供完整的样式指南（Markdown + Mermaid）、24种图表类型参考以及9个文档模板。

description: Help users plan and execute product launches. Use when someone is planning a product launch, preparing PR outreach, coordinating a go-to-market campaign, launching on Product Hunt, or asking how to generate buzz for a new feature or product.
description_zh: 帮助用户规划并执行产品发布。适用于用户规划产品发布、准备公关外联、协调上市活动、在Product Hunt上发布，或询问如何为新功能或产品制造话题热度的场景。

description: Trace cryptocurrency addresses and transactions on public blockchains using block explorers including Etherscan, Blockchair, mempool.space and Blockscout. Covers common-input clustering, ENS resolution, exchange deposit addresses, mixers, CoinJoin, Tornado-style pools, cross-chain bridges, and OFAC sanctions screening. Use when following a Bitcoin or Ethereum wallet, investigating where a ransom or scam payment went, or checking an address against sanctions listings. Applies to ransomware incident response, AML and sanctions compliance, fraud recovery and asset tracing, and financial-crime investigation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/follow-the-crypto.
description_zh: 使用包括Etherscan、Blockchair、mempool.space和Blockscout在内的区块浏览器，追踪公共区块链上的加密货币地址和交易。涵盖常见输入聚类、ENS解析、交易所入金地址、混币器、CoinJoin、Tornado式钱包池、跨链桥接以及OFAC制裁筛查。用于追踪比特币或以太坊钱包、调查勒索或诈骗付款去向，或核对地址与制裁名单的场景。适用于勒索软件事件响应、反洗钱（AML）与制裁合规、诈骗恢复与资产追踪，以及金融犯罪调查等领域。参考：useosint.com/skills/follow-the-crypto。

description: Use when the user asks for Korean EV charging-station locations, charger types, or current charger status by region, station, or location text. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户根据地区、站点或地点文本，询问韩国EV充电站位置、充电类型或当前充电状态时使用。在돌쇠中，通过官方表面执行后续动作。

description: Pricing strategy for technical products. Use when choosing usage-based vs seat-based, designing freemium thresholds, structuring enterprise pricing conversations, deciding when to raise prices, or using price as a positioning signal.
description_zh: 技术产品的定价策略。适用于在基于使用量的计费与基于席位的计费之间做出选择，设计免费增值门槛，构建企业定价沟通，决定何时提价，以及将价格作为定位信号使用。

description: 한국 지자체별 전기차 구매보조금 민간공고·접수·출고·출고잔여 대수와 공고 상태를 환경부 무공해차 통합누리집에서 조회한다. 사용자가 사는 지역의 전기승용·전기화물·전기승합 보조금 잔여 현황, 접수 가능 여부, 마감·소진·추경 예정, 특정 모델 기준 보조금 환산치를 물을 때 사용한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 可在环境部“无公害车综合门户”查询韩国各地方政府电动车的购车补贴公告、申报、交付及交付剩余数量与公告状态。用户查询其居住区域的电动乘用车、电动货车、电动客运车辆补贴剩余情况、申报资格、截止、取消、延期等预计，以及按特定车型标准计算的补贴折算金额时使用。돌쇠通过官方界面执行后续操作。

description: Review a specific diff (branch, commit, or GitHub PR) and show the findings as comments inside difit, the local diff viewer. Explicit opt-in only — use when the user explicitly names difit, asks to open or annotate the review in the difit viewer, or invokes this skill by name. For ordinary requests to review code, diffs, commits, branches, or pull requests, review normally and respond in the conversation without launching difit.
description_zh: 审查特定的差异（分支、提交或 GitHub PR），并在本地差异查看器 difit 中显示发现结果作为评论。仅限明确 opt-in — 仅在用户明确提及 difit、要求打开或在 difit 查看器中为审查进行标注，或通过名称调用本技能时使用。对于常规的代码、差异、提交、分支或拉取请求审查请求，正常审查，并在对话中回复，无需启动 difit。

description: Review fixed income portfolios by pricing multiple bonds, retrieving reference data, analyzing cashflows, and running scenario analysis. Use when reviewing bond portfolios, computing portfolio duration and DV01, analyzing cashflow waterfalls, stress testing rate scenarios, or assessing portfolio composition.
description_zh: 通过为多个债券定价、获取参考数据、分析现金流和开展情景分析，审查固定收益组合。适用于审查债券组合、计算组合久期与DV01、分析现金流瀑布、对利率情景进行压力测试，或评估组合构成。

description: Build production-ready Bright Data integrations with best practices baked in. Reference documentation for developers using coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to implement web scraping, search, browser automation, and structured data extraction. Covers Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, and Browser API (Scraping Browser).
description_zh: 构建内置最佳实践、可直接用于生产环境的 Bright Data 集成。面向使用代码助手（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）的开发者，提供实现网页抓取、搜索、浏览器自动化和结构化数据提取的参考文档。涵盖 Web Unlocker API、SERP API、Web Scraper API 及浏览器 API（Scraping Browser）。

description: Statistical visualization with pandas integration. Use for quick exploration of distributions, relationships, and categorical comparisons with attractive defaults. Best for box plots, violin plots, pair plots, heatmaps. Built on matplotlib. For interactive plots use plotly; for publication styling use scientific-visualization.
description_zh: 结合 pandas 集成的统计可视化。适用于快速探索分布、关系与分类比较，并配备美观的默认设置。非常适合箱线图、小提琴图、配对图及热力图。基于 Matplotlib 构建。若需交互式图表，请使用 plotly；若需出版级样式，请使用 scientific-visualization。

description: Enumerate a username across hundreds of platforms with sherlock, maigret and WhatsMyName, then correlate and confirm which accounts genuinely belong to the same person. Use for username OSINT and handle enumeration, "find all accounts for this username", cross-platform account correlation, nickname and screen-name pivots, or turning a handle into a real name. Applies to fraud and synthetic-identity investigation, recruitment and marketplace scam checks, trust-and-safety enforcement, insider-threat work, and personal exposure audits. Reference at useosint.com/skills/hunt-a-handle.
description_zh: 使用Sherlock、Maigret和WhatsMyName工具，对数百个平台进行用户名枚举，进而关联并确认哪些账号确实属于同一人。可用于用户名开源情报与账号枚举、"查找该用户名下的所有账号"、跨平台账号关联、昵称与网名转换，或将网名转化为真实姓名。适用于欺诈与合成身份调查、招聘及市场平台诈骗核查、信任与安全执法、内部威胁工作以及个人暴露审计。参考链接：useosint.com/skills/hunt-a-handle

description: 支持四引擎的PDF OCR识别技能，可从影印版PDF文件和图片文件中提取中英文文字内容 | PDF OCR Skill with quadruple-engine support, capable of extracting Chinese and English text from scanned PDF files and image files
description_zh: 支持四引擎的PDF OCR识别技能，可从扫描版PDF文件和图片文件中提取中英文文字内容 | 支持四引擎的PDF OCR技能，可从扫描版PDF文件和图片文件中提取中英文文字内容

description: Guide for creating effective skills for Apollo GraphQL and GraphQL development. Use this skill when: (1) users want to create a new skill, (2) users want to update an existing skill, (3) users ask about skill structure or best practices, (4) users need help writing SKILL.md files.
description_zh: 为Apollo GraphQL和GraphQL开发创建有效技能的指南。使用本技能的情况包括：(1) 用户想要创建新的技能，(2) 用户想要更新现有技能，(3) 用户询问技能结构或最佳实践，(4) 用户需要帮助编写SKILL.md文件。

description: Build a sourced, corroborated profile of a named individual from public records, social platforms, professional networks, court and property filings, licensing boards, patents, papers and obituaries — anchoring the name to a second selector first so you never fuse two people into one dossier. Use when asked to find, identify, background-check or profile a person, verify someone's claimed employment or credentials, or locate a missing or hard-to-reach individual. Applies to counterparty and investor due diligence, fraud and asset investigation, journalism, skip tracing, missing persons, pre-employment integrity checks on fiduciary roles, and self-exposure audits. Reference at useosint.com/skills/find-anyone.
description_zh:
建立基于来源并经佐证的人物档案，整合公共记录、社交平台、专业社交网络、法院与财产申报文件、执照委员会、专利、论文及讣告等多渠道信息，**首先将姓名与第二个筛选条件进行锚定**，确保不会将不同的人合并为一个档案。

当被要求查找、识别、背景调查或画像某个人时使用此技能，用于核实某人声称的工作或资质，或定位失踪或难以接触的个人。该技能适用于交易对手方与投资者的尽职调查、欺诈与资产调查、新闻报道、人员追踪、失踪人员工作、对受托职位的入职前诚信核查，以及自我暴露审计等场景。使用参考 useosint.com/skills/find-anyone。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or improve documentation for code, APIs, libraries, repositories, or software projects. Supports README generation, API reference documentation, inline code comments, architecture documentation, changelog generation, and developer guides. Trigger on requests like "document this code", "create a README", "generate API docs", "write developer guide", or when analyzing codebases for documentation purposes.
description_zh: 当用户请求为代码、API、库、仓库或软件项目生成、创建或改进文档时，请使用此技能。支持 README 生成、API 参考文档、行内代码注释、架构文档、变更日志生成与开发者指南。在类似“为代码编写文档”、“创建 README”、“生成 API 文档”、“编写开发者指南”的请求，或在为文档目的分析代码库时，触发本技能。

description: Use this skill when users need help with business finances, tax planning, bookkeeping, profit/loss analysis, cash flow management, or multi-business financial tracking. Activates for "am I profitable," tax questions, accounting setup, or financial health checks.
description_zh: 当用户需要商业财务、税务规划、簿记、盈亏分析、现金流管理或多业务财务跟踪方面的帮助时，使用此技能。适用于“是否盈利”、税务问题、会计设置或财务健康检查。

description: Zustand adapter for json-render's StateStore interface. Use when integrating json-render with Zustand for state management via @json-render/zustand.
description_zh: 用于 json-render 的 StateStore 接口的 Zustand 适配器。在通过 @json-render/zustand 将 json-render 与 Zustand 集成以实现状态管理时使用。

description: Create, triage, advance, and close HubSpot support tickets — pipeline discovery, contact/company association, priority queues, bulk stage moves, resolution close-out.
description_zh: 创建、分诊、推进和关闭 HubSpot 支持工单——工单流程管道发现、联系人与企业关联、优先级队列、批量阶段流转、解决结案。

description: When the user wants to define, audit, or apply brand strategy—purpose, values, positioning, storytelling, voice, narrative (not only visuals). Also use when the user mentions "brand strategy," "brand story," "brand storytelling," "brand voice," "brand identity," "brand guidelines," "brand purpose," "brand values," "origin story," "brand narrative," "brand personality," "brand archetype," "slide deck branding," "PPT brand colors," or "document style guide." For typography, colors, design tokens, and frontend visuals, use brand-visual-generator.
description_zh: 当用户希望定义、审查或应用品牌策略（宗旨、价值观、定位、叙事、声音，不仅限于视觉）时。当用户提及“品牌策略”、“品牌故事”、“品牌叙事”、“品牌声音”、“品牌身份”、“品牌指南”、“品牌宗旨”、“品牌价值观”、“起源故事”、“品牌叙事”、“品牌个性”、“品牌原型”、“幻灯片品牌设计”、“PPT 品牌色彩”或“文档风格指南”时，也使用。对于排版、色彩、设计令牌和前端视觉元素，使用 brand-visual-generator。

description: Design theming architecture — brand variants, dark mode, and high-contrast — mapped through token layers. Use when one system must serve multiple themes. For a single palette use `color-system` (ui-design); for dark mode craft use `dark-mode-design` (ui-design).
description_zh: 设计可主题化架构——品牌变体、深色模式和高对比度——通过 token 层进行映射。当单一系统需要服务于多种主题时使用。对于单一调色板使用 `color-system` (ui-design)；为深色模式定制使用 `dark-mode-design` (ui-design)。

description: Comprehensive reference for building Mintlify documentation sites. Use when creating pages, configuring docs.json, adding components, setting up navigation, or working with API references. Routes to detailed reference files for all components and configuration options.
description_zh: 构建 Mintlify 文档站点的全面参考。适用于创建页面、配置 docs.json、添加组件、设置导航，或处理 API 参考。指向所有组件和配置选项的详细参考文件。

description: When the user wants to plan, create, or market a podcast. Also use when the user mentions "podcast," "podcast strategy," "podcast SEO," "show notes," "podcast distribution," "Spotify podcast," "Apple Podcasts," "podcast discoverability," "PodcastEpisode schema," or "podcast repurposing." For show notes, use article-content.
description_zh: 当用户想要规划、创建或营销播客时使用。当用户提及“播客”、“播客策略”、“播客SEO”、“节目笔记”、“播客分发”、“Spotify播客”、“Apple Podcasts”、“播客可发现性”、“PodcastEpisode schema”或“播客再利用”时，也使用。对于节目笔记，使用 article-content。

description: Open the diffity diff viewer in the browser to see your changes
description_zh: 在浏览器中打开 Diffity diff 查看器，查看您的更改。

description: 한국은행 ECOS Open API로 기준금리, 환율, 소비자물가지수, 통화량 등 중앙은행 경제통계 시계열과 100대 핵심지표를 조회한다. Use when the user asks 기준금리, 환율 추이, 물가지수, M2, 국고채 금리, 거시경제 통계. Not for 주식 시세(korean-stock-search) or KOSIS 일반 통계(kosis-stats).
description_zh: 通过韩国银行 ECOS Open API 查询中央银行的宏观经济统计时间序列及100项核心指标，包括利率、汇率、消费者物价指数、货币供应量等。当用户询问利率、汇率趋势、物价指数、M2、国债利率、宏观经济统计时使用。不适用于股票行情（korean-stock-search）或KOSIS一般统计（kosis-stats）。

description: MUST activate when the user wants to package, distribute, or install/upgrade/uninstall/promote a UI Bundle as a Salesforce second-generation (2GP) package (project may contain uiBundles/ or sfdx-project.json for packaging tasks; install/upgrade tasks may lack local bundle files). Handles making a bundle packageable, choosing managed/unlocked flavor, creating package/version with sf package, installing/upgrading in another org, and debugging failures. TRIGGER on packaging, 2GP, managed package, unlocked package, AppExchange, package version, sf package, sf package install, sf package upgrade, install a package, upgrade a package, cross-org distribution. DO NOT TRIGGER for plain source deploy to one org (use experience-ui-bundle-deploy) or scaffolding a new bundle (use experience-ui-bundle-project-generate). Apply piecemeal — do ONLY the part asked.
description_zh: 当用户想要将 UI Bundle 打包、分发，或安装、升级、卸载、提升为 Salesforce 第二代（2GP）包时，必须激活（打包任务的项目中可能包含 uiBundles/ 或 sfdx-project.json；安装/升级任务可能缺少本地包文件）。负责使包可打包、选择托管/解锁类型、使用 sf package 创建包/版本、在另一个组织安装/升级，以及调试故障。在打包、2GP、托管包、解锁包、AppExchange、包版本、sf package、sf package 安装、sf package 升级、安装包、升级包、跨组织分发时触发。不要在单纯将源文件部署到一个组织（使用 experience-ui-bundle-deploy）或搭建新的包（使用 experience-ui-bundle-project-generate）时触发。逐步应用——仅执行要求的内容。

description: Use when connecting your agent to external APIs, tools, or services via Gateway, or restricting tool access with Cedar policies. Handles gateway setup, target types, outbound auth (OAuth, API key, IAM), credentials, and Cedar policy authoring. Triggers on: "connect to API", "add gateway", "connect to MCP server", "Lambda tools", "OpenAPI", "gateway target", "Cedar policy", "restrict tools", "policy engine", "gateway auth error", "store API key", "outbound credential", "env var API key", "API key None after deploy", "credential not available after deploy", "should this be a gateway target", "give my agent tools", "add tools to agent". Not for inbound auth (who can call your agent) — use agents-harden. Not for debugging agent behavior — use agents-debug. Not for VPC networking errors (agent can't reach APIs due to VPC) — use agents-build. Not for creating or hosting a new MCP server project — use agents-get-started.
description_zh:
在通过网关（Gateway）将代理（agent）连接到外部API、工具或服务，或使用Cedar策略限制工具访问时使用。负责网关配置、目标类型、出站认证（OAuth、API密钥、IAM）、凭据以及Cedar策略编写。在以下情况下触发：

- "connect to API"
- "add gateway"
- "connect to MCP server"
- "Lambda tools"
- "OpenAPI"
- "gateway target"
- "Cedar policy"
- "restrict tools"
- "policy engine"
- "gateway auth error"
- "store API key"
- "outbound credential"
- "env var API key"
- "API key None after deploy"
- "credential not available after deploy"
- "should this be a gateway target"
- "give my agent tools"
- "add tools to agent"

不用于入站认证（即谁可以调用您的代理）——请使用 agents-harden。不用于调试代理行为——请使用 agents-debug。不用于VPC网络错误（由于VPC导致代理无法访问API）——请使用 agents-build。不用于创建或托管新的MCP服务器项目——请使用 agents-get-started。

description: Use when your agent or environment is broken — wrong answers, errors, timeouts, tool failures, or CLI issues. Reads traces and logs to diagnose root causes. Also checks prerequisites when the CLI itself isn't working. Triggers on: "agent not working", "wrong answer", "agent error", "tool call failing", "debug agent", "check logs", "read traces", "broken", "500 error", "424 error", "model access denied", "command not found", "stuck in DELETING", "maxVms exceeded", "cold start diagnosis", "cold start slow", "agentcore create error", "create failed", "exit code 7", "connection refused local dev". Not for deploy failures — use agents-deploy. Not for performance tuning without errors — use agents-optimize. Not for VPC configuration — use agents-build. Not for observability setup or missing logs — use agents-optimize.
description_zh: 当你的智能体或环境出现故障——答案错误、错误、超时、工具失败或命令行工具问题时使用。读取追踪记录和日志，以诊断根本原因。当 CLI 本身无法工作时，也会检查先决条件。触发条件包括：“智能体无法运行”、“答案错误”、“智能体错误”、“工具调用失败”、“调试智能体”、“检查日志”、“读取追踪”、“故障”、“500 错误”、“424 错误”、“模型访问被拒绝”、“命令未找到”、“卡在 DELETING 中”、“maxVms 超限”、“冷启动诊断”、“冷启动缓慢”、“agentcore 创建错误”、“创建失败”、“退出码 7”、“本地开发时连接被拒绝”。不适用于部署故障——请使用 agents-deploy。不适用于无错误情况下的性能调优——请使用 agents-optimize。不适用于 VPC 配置——请使用 agents-build。不适用于可观测性配置或缺少日志——请使用 agents-optimize。

description: 数学建模竞赛工作流入口。用于启动完整建模流程：询问用户偏好，生成 plan.md 和 todo.md，并按阶段调用赛题分析、建模、代码与图表、流程图、论文撰写、验证验收等 skills。
description_zh: 数学建模竞赛工作流入口。用于启动完整建模流程：询问用户偏好，生成 plan.md 和 todo.md，并按阶段调用赛题分析、建模、代码与图表、流程图、论文撰写、验证验收等 skills。

description: Quantifies crypto market regime health using free, keyless public data (CoinGecko + Binance funding). Generates a 0-100 composite score across 6 components (100 = risk-on) with a posture recommendation. No API key required. Use when user asks about crypto market conditions, whether it's alt season, BTC dominance, crypto risk-on vs risk-off, funding rates, or whether crypto exposure should be increased or reduced.
description_zh: 使用免费、无需密钥的公开数据（CoinGecko + Binance资金费率），量化加密市场周期健康度。生成涵盖6个维度的0-100综合评分（100代表风险偏好），并提供投资态度建议。无需API密钥。当用户询问加密市场状况、是否处于山寨币季节、BTC主导地位、加密市场风险偏好（risk-on）与风险规避（risk-off）对比、资金费率，或加密资产敞口应增加还是减少时使用。

description: Setup and initialization guide for developing AWS CDK (Cloud Development Kit) applications in Python. This skill enables users to configure environment prerequisites, create new CDK projects, manage dependencies, and deploy to AWS.
description_zh: AWS CDK（Cloud Development Kit）Python 应用开发设置与初始化指南。该技能使用户能够配置环境要求、创建新的 CDK 项目、管理依赖项并部署到 AWS。

description: Formulate evidence-bounded scientific questions, candidate hypotheses, rival explanations, causal or associational claims, discriminating predictions, measurements, and preregistration-ready analysis plans. Use when turning observations or preliminary findings into transparent, testable research plans without treating hypotheses as facts.
description_zh: 拟定基于证据边界的科学问题、候选假设、竞争性解释、因果性或关联性主张、区分性预测、测量，以及可供预先注册使用的分析计划。用于将观察或初步发现转化为透明、可检验的研究计划，而不将假设视为事实。

description: Conduct systematic academic literature reviews in 6 phases, producing structured notes, a curated paper database, and a synthesized final report. Output is organized by phase for clarity.
description_zh: 在六个阶段中开展系统性的学术文献综述，生成结构化的笔记、精选的论文数据库以及综合的最终报告。输出按阶段组织，以确保清晰性。

description: Discovers requirements and generates architectural, design, and deployment guidance for dynamic hybrid search systems by combining semantic search and keyword search. Optimized for AlloyDB hybrid search use cases in Google Cloud. Use when users need vector search combined with structured SQL filtering, faceted attributes, semantic reranking, in-database AI validation, or serverless hosting across transactional relational databases, analytical data warehouses, or managed database engines. DON'T use this skill for simple keyword-only search, or when a standalone non-relational vector database is required.
description_zh: 通过结合语义搜索与关键词搜索，发现需求，并为动态混合搜索系统生成架构、设计及部署指导。针对 Google Cloud 上的 AlloyDB 混合搜索用例进行了优化。适用于用户需要在事务型关系数据库、分析型数据仓库或托管数据库引擎上，将向量搜索与结构化 SQL 过滤相结合，并利用分面属性、进行语义重排序、实现数据库内 AI 验证或无服务器托管等能力时使用。不得用于仅基于关键词的简单搜索，或需要独立非关系型向量数据库的情形。

description: Help users implement product-led sales motions. Use when someone is transitioning from pure PLG to sales-assisted, defining PQLs, building sales handoff processes, or trying to expand self-serve users into enterprise contracts.
description_zh: 帮助用户实施产品驱动的销售动作。当用户从纯PLG（产品驱动增长）向销售辅助模式过渡、定义PQL（产品认知潜在用户）、构建销售交接流程，或试图将自助服务用户转化为企业合同时使用。

description:
Browser automation using Playwright MCP. Navigate websites, fill forms, click elements,
take screenshots, and extract data. Use when tasks require web browsing, form submission,
web scraping, UI testing, or any browser interaction. NOT when only fetching static
content (use curl/wget instead).
description_zh: 使用 Playwright MCP 实现浏览器自动化。支持浏览网站、填写表单、点击元素、截图及数据提取。适用于需要网页浏览、表单提交、网页抓取、UI 测试或任何浏览器交互的任务场景。不适用于仅获取静态内容的情况（改用 curl/wget 代替）。

description: When the user wants to analyze Google Search Console data, use the GSC API, or interpret search performance. Also use when the user mentions "GSC," "Search Console," "indexing report," "Core Web Vitals," "Enhancements," "Insights report," "search performance," "search queries," "search performance report," "URL inspection," "impressions," "CTR," "average position," "index coverage," "GSC data analysis," "Search Console API," or "searchanalytics.query." When the user wants to rewrite title tags (not only report on them), use title-tag. For meta description rewrites, use meta-description.
description_zh: 当用户想要分析 Google 搜索控制台数据时，使用 GSC API 或解读搜索表现。此外，当用户提到“GSC”、“搜索控制台”、“索引报告”、“核心网页指标”、“提升”、“洞察报告”、“搜索表现”、“搜索查询”、“搜索表现报告”、“URL 检查”、“展示量”、“CTR”、“平均排名”、“索引覆盖率”、“GSC 数据分析”、“搜索控制台 API”或“searchanalytics.query”时，也应使用。当用户想要重写标题标签（不仅仅对它们进行报告）时，使用 title-tag。对于 meta description 的重写，使用 meta-description。

description: Expert guidance on validating, optimizing, and ensuring quality of Mapbox styles through validation, accessibility checks, and optimization. Use when preparing styles for production, debugging issues, or ensuring map quality standards.
description_zh: 通过验证、无障碍检查与优化，为 Mapbox 样式提供验证、优化及质量保障的专家指导。适用于为生产准备样式、调试问题或确保地图质量标准。

description: Search official Korean national heritage records, details, locations, and monthly heritage events from the Korea Heritage Service Open API.
description_zh: 通过韩国文化遗产厅开放API，搜索韩国国家官方遗产记录、详情、位置及每月遗产活动。

description: Help users build and grow product communities. Use when someone is starting a community, scaling an ambassador program, driving community-led growth, or choosing between user, developer, or partner communities.
description_zh: 帮助用户建立和成长产品社区。适用于启动社区、扩展大使计划、推动社区驱动的增长，或在用户、开发者、合作伙伴社区之间进行选择时。

description:
唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）的思维框架与行为逻辑。基于著作、长访谈、辩论、
心理分析、前幕僚回忆录、重大决策记录共6个维度的深度调研（320KB+原始资料），
提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：（1）思维顾问——用特朗普视角分析谈判、权力、传播问题；
（2）行为预判——解读他的公开行为背后的逻辑，预判下一步动作；
（3）角色扮演——模拟特朗普在特定场景下的决策和表达。
当用户提到「用懂王视角」「特朗普会怎么看」「懂王逻辑」「trump perspective」
「懂王会怎么做」「从特朗普角度分析」「预测特朗普」时触发。
description_zh:
唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）的思维框架与行为逻辑。基于著作、长访谈、辩论、心理分析、前幕僚回忆录、重大决策记录共6个维度的深度调研（320KB+原始资料），提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。

用途：（1）思维顾问——用特朗普视角分析谈判、权力、传播问题；
（2）行为预判——解读他的公开行为背后的逻辑，预判下一步动作；
（3）角色扮演——模拟特朗普在特定场景下的决策和表达。

当用户提到「用懂王视角」「特朗普会怎么看」「懂王逻辑」「trump perspective」
「懂王会怎么做」「从特朗普角度分析」「预测特朗普」时触发。

description: MSBuild property definition patterns: conditional defaults, composition/concatenation, path normalization, trailing-slash handling, TFM detection helpers, and evaluation order. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing property definition issues and shared-property anti-patterns in .props/.csproj; DefineConstants or NoWarn overwritten instead of appended; unconditional assignments that block project-level overrides; unquoted conditions that fail on empty properties; hardcoded paths that break cross-platform builds; setting overridable defaults; property evaluation order and last-write-wins semantics. DO NOT USE FOR: props vs targets placement (use directory-build-organization), item operations (use item-management), target structure (use target-authoring), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
MSBuild 属性定义模式：条件默认值、组合/连接、路径规范化、尾部斜杠处理、TFM检测辅助工具及求值顺序。
用途：诊断和修复 .props/.csproj 中的属性定义问题及共享属性反模式；DefineConstants 或 NoWarn 被覆盖而非追加；阻止项目级覆盖的无条件赋值；在空属性上失败的未加引号的条件；导致跨平台构建失败的硬编码路径；设置可覆盖的默认值；属性求值顺序及后写胜出语义。
不适用于：.props 与 .targets 放置位置（使用 directory-build-organization），项操作（使用 item-management），目标结构（使用 target-authoring），一般性反模式（使用 msbuild-antipatterns），非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: Map one persona's end-to-end experience with stages, touchpoints, emotions, and pain points. Use when improving an existing experience. For the multi-channel ecosystem use `experience-map` (ux-strategy); for screen-level paths use `user-flow-diagram` (prototyping-testing).
description_zh: 涵盖阶段、触点、情绪和痛点，绘制某角色的端到端体验。用于改进现有体验时使用。在多渠道生态系统中使用 `experience-map`（ux-strategy）；在屏幕级路径中使用 `user-flow-diagram`（prototyping-testing）。

description: Create or review Blazor components (.razor files) with correct architecture. USE FOR: writing new Blazor components that do NOT involve JavaScript interop, implementing parameters and EventCallback, RenderFragment slots, component lifecycle (OnInitializedAsync, OnParametersSet), async patterns, IAsyncDisposable, CancellationToken, CSS isolation, code-behind. DO NOT USE FOR: creating new projects (use create-blazor-project), JavaScript interop or calling browser APIs from Blazor (use use-js-interop), forms and validation (use collect-user-input), prerendering issues (use support-prerendering), HTTP data fetching patterns (use fetch-and-send-data), coordinating state between unrelated components (use coordinate-components).
description_zh: 使用正确的架构创建或审查 Blazor 组件（.razor 文件）。适用场景：编写不涉及 JavaScript 互调的新的 Blazor 组件，实现参数与 EventCallback、RenderFragment 插槽、组件生命周期（OnInitializedAsync, OnParametersSet）、异步模式、IAsyncDisposable、CancellationToken、CSS 隔离及代码后端。不适用场景：创建新项目（使用 create-blazor-project）、JavaScript 互调或从 Blazor 调用浏览器 API（使用 use-js-interop）、表单与验证（使用 collect-user-input）、预渲染问题（使用 support-prerendering）、HTTP 数据获取模式（使用 fetch-and-sent-data）、协调不相关组件之间的状态（使用 coordinate-components）。

description: Create a new ASP.NET Core web application or web site using Blazor. USE FOR: creating a new Blazor web app, scaffolding a new web project, starting a new web site, choosing render modes (Static SSR, Interactive Server, Interactive WebAssembly, Auto), running dotnet new blazor with the right options, setting up initial project structure. DO NOT USE FOR: adding features to existing projects, changing how an existing app renders, or component authoring (use author-component).
description_zh:
使用 Blazor 创建一个新的 ASP.NET Core Web 应用或网站。

适用场景：
- 创建新的 Blazor Web 应用
- 搭建新的 Web 项目
- 启动新网站
- 选择渲染模式（静态服务端渲染、交互式服务端、交互式 WebAssembly、自动）
- 使用正确的选项运行 dotnet new blazor
- 设置初始项目结构

不适用于：
- 向现有项目添加功能
- 更改现有应用的渲染方式
- 组件开发（使用 author-component）

description: Help users build effective AI applications. Use when someone is building with LLMs, writing prompts, designing AI features, implementing RAG, creating agents, running evals, or trying to improve AI output quality.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建有效的AI应用。当使用LLM构建、编写提示词、设计AI功能、实现RAG、创建智能体、运行评估，或尝试提升AI输出质量时使用。

description: Launch both thermo-nuclear review subagents in parallel, then synthesize their findings. Use for thermos, double thermo review, or combined bug/security and code-quality branch audits.
description_zh: 并行启动两个热核审查子代理，随后汇总它们的结果。适用于 thermos、双重热核审查，或结合 bug/安全与代码质量的分支审计。

description: 数学建模赛题分析与建模设计合并阶段。用于读取题面和附件，完成子问题拆解、数据理解、假设预检、变量定义、模型公式、目标函数、约束条件、求解策略和可交给代码实现的建模报告。
description_zh: 数学建模赛题分析与建模设计合并阶段。用于读取题面和附件，完成子问题拆解、数据理解、假设预检、变量定义、模型公式、目标函数、约束条件、求解策略和可交给代码实现的建模报告。

description: Resolve `/flag` style requests into the right LaunchDarkly flag lookup flow. Use when the user types `/flag`, asks to quickly find a flag by name/key, wants a direct flag detail summary, or needs fast disambiguation between similar flags.
description_zh: 将 `/flag` 格式的请求解析为正确的 LaunchDarkly 旗标查找流程。当用户输入 `/flag`、要求通过名称/键名快速查找旗标、需要直接的旗标详情摘要，或需要在相似旗标之间快速消歧时使用。

description: Use when measuring or improving agent quality and performance — set up evaluators, online monitoring, CI/CD quality gates, observability, or cost optimization. Triggers on: "evaluate my agent", "add evaluator", "measure quality", "quality gate", "run evals", "agent too slow", "why is it slow", "reduce latency", "set up observability", "CloudWatch dashboard", "how much does my agent cost", "cost optimization", "logs not showing up", "logs missing", "spans not found", "eval failing", "eval error", "dev traces", "local traces", "agentcore dev traces", "traces to CloudWatch". Not for debugging errors or crashes — use agents-debug. Slow but correct routes here; broken routes to debug.
description_zh:
用于衡量或提升智能体质量与性能时使用——配置评估器、在线监控、CI/CD 质量门禁、可观测性，或进行成本优化。

触发场景包括：“评估我的智能体”、“添加评估器”、“衡量质量”、“质量门禁”、“运行评估”、“智能体运行过慢”、“为何速度过慢”、“降低延迟”、“配置可观测性”、“CloudWatch 仪表盘”、“我的智能体消耗多少成本”、“成本优化”、“日志未显示”、“日志缺失”、“未找到追踪段”、“评估失败”、“评估错误”、“开发追踪”、“本地追踪”、“agentcore 开发追踪”以及“追踪至 CloudWatch”。

不用于调试错误或崩溃——请使用 agents-debug。慢但正确的路径在此处，错误路径请路由至调试。

description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
description_zh: 在任何情况下，只要 .pptx 或 .potx 文件以任何方式涉及——无论是作为输入、输出，还是两者兼有，请使用此技能。这包括：创建幻灯片演示文稿、路演演示文稿或演示文稿；阅读、解析或提取任何 .pptx 或 .potx 文件中的文本（即使提取的内容将用于其他地方，例如邮件或摘要）；编辑、修改或更新现有演示文稿；合并或拆分幻灯片文件；处理模板（.potx）、版式、演讲者备注或批注。只要用户提到“deck”、“slides”、“presentation”或引用 .pptx 或 .potx 文件名，无论其计划在之后对内容进行何种操作，都应触发此技能。如果 .pptx 或 .potx 文件需要被打开、创建或处理，请使用此技能。

description: Approve (submit an approving review) and squash-merge a PR given only its number, refusing when the QA gate or a blocking label forbids it. Routes fixable blockers to om-auto-fix-pr (red CI via its --ci-only mode, or conflicts and review problems via the full loop). Optionally file a follow-up issue at the same time. Use when the user says "approve and merge PR 123", "ship PR 123", or gives a PR number with intent to merge.
description_zh: 根据仅有的 PR 编号进行批准（提交审核通过）并执行 Squash 合并，若 QA 门禁或阻塞性标签禁止，则予以拒绝。将可修复的阻塞问题路由至 om-auto-fix-pr（通过其 --ci-only 模式处理红色 CI，或通过完整流程处理冲突与审核问题）。可选择同时提交一个后续 issue。当用户表示“批准并合并 PR 123”、“发布 PR 123”或仅提供 PR 编号且意图为合并时，使用本功能。

description: Use when a developer wants to create a new agent project or get started with AgentCore. Handles framework selection, project scaffolding, first deploy, and first invocation. Triggers on: "build an agent", "create an agent", "get started", "new project", "agentcore create", "which framework", "Strands vs LangGraph", "hello world agent", "first agent", "create MCP server", "host MCP server", "agentcore dev", "dev server", "what port", "local development". Not for adding capabilities to existing projects — use agents-build or agents-connect. Strands vs LangGraph in a migration context routes to agents-build, not here. Connecting to an existing MCP server routes to agents-connect, not here.
description_zh:
开发者创建新智能体项目或开始使用 AgentCore 时使用。负责框架选择、项目脚手架搭建、首次部署和首次调用。

触发条件：
"build an agent"、"create an agent"、"get started"、"new project"、"agentcore create"、"which framework"、"Strands vs LangGraph"、"hello world agent"、"first agent"、"create MCP server"、"host MCP server"、"agentcore dev"、"dev server"、"what port"、"local development"

不适用于为现有项目添加功能——请使用 agents-build 或 agents-connect。在迁移场景下涉及 Strands 与 LangGraph 的匹配会路由到 agents-build，而非本工具。连接到现有 MCP 服务器的操作会路由到 agents-connect，而非本工具。

description: Use ONLY to update or initialize README.md, CLAUDE.md, or AGENTS.md. Do not trigger for other Markdown files.
description_zh: 仅用于更新或初始化 README.md、CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md，不适用于其他 Markdown 文件。

description: Turn findings into a defensible intelligence product — BLUF key judgements, standardised estimative probability language, per-claim sourcing with timestamps and archived copies, separated observation, inference and assessment, documented negative findings and gaps, chain of custody and hashing, and redaction of uninvolved parties. Use when writing an intelligence report, due-diligence memo, evidence pack or executive summary, or when asked to write up an investigation so it survives challenge. Applies to regulated compliance reporting, litigation and disclosure, board and investment committee reporting, and law-enforcement referral. Reference at useosint.com/skills/write-the-intel-brief.
description_zh: 把发现转化为经得起推敲的情报产品——BLUF核心判断、标准化估算概率表述、逐项主张的来源标注（含时间戳与存档副本）、明确区分观察、推断与评估、记录负向发现与缺口、链条式保管与哈希校验、对无关方进行脱敏处理。在撰写情报报告、尽职调查备忘录、证据包或执行摘要，或应要求撰写调查报告以确保其能够经受挑战时使用。适用于受监管合规报告、诉讼与披露、董事会与投资委员会报告及执法部门转办等场景。引用地址：useosint.com/skills/write-the-intel-brief。

description: Generate a concise 4-5 page equity research earnings preview for a single company. Analyzes the most recent earnings transcript, competitor landscape, valuation, and recent news to produce a professional HTML report.
description_zh: 针对单一公司生成一份简洁的4至5页权益研究业绩预览。该预览分析最新财报电话会议记录、竞争对手格局、估值及近期新闻，并生成一份专业的HTML报告。

description: Ingest GitHub Copilot CLI session history into an Obsidian wiki as distilled knowledge pages. Use this skill when the user wants to capture their Copilot CLI sessions into a personal wiki — extracting architecture decisions, debug notes, and patterns into searchable Obsidian pages. Triggers on phrases like "ingest my copilot sessions into obsidian", "add my copilot history to my wiki", "pull my copilot session history into the vault", "capture what I've learned from copilot into obsidian", "just the new sessions since last time", or "mine patterns across my copilot sessions". Also triggers when the user mentions session-store.db, ~/.copilot/session-state, or VS Code copilot-chat transcripts in the context of building a wiki or knowledge base. Does NOT trigger for general copilot usage questions, searching sessions, or backing up history.
description_zh:
将GitHub Copilot CLI会话历史摄入到Obsidian维基中，转化为精炼的知识页面。当用户想要将Copilot CLI会话捕获到个人维基中时，使用此技能——将架构决策、调试记录和模式提取为可搜索的Obsidian页面。

当出现诸如"将我的Copilot会话摄入到Obsidian"、"将我的Copilot历史添加到我的维基"、"将我的Copilot会话历史拉取到仓库"、"从Copilot中捕获我所学内容并导入Obsidian"、"仅获取上次之后的新会话"或"跨我的Copilot会话挖掘模式"等短语时触发。当用户在构建维基或知识库的背景下提及session-store.db、~/.copilot/session-state或VS Code copilot-chat转录文件时，也会触发。

不适用于一般Copilot使用问题、搜索会话或备份历史。

description: Use when the user asks for build a brand or a task matching the examples below. Build a practical brand identity from any input — an idea, an existing website, a list of reference brands, product photos, or "I want to rebrand X". Default to a fast quick-brand path for founder-kit users, and offer the full 14-16-page guidelines as an opt-in upgrade. Use when someone wants a brand identity but does NOT need a full commerce launch (no Shopify, no product listings, no social posting). Trigger phrases: "build me a brand", "make me a brand", "design a brand identity", "brand guidelines for [X]", "i want a brand book", "create a brand from scratch", "brand for [idea]", "i want a brand that feels like [X] + [Y]", "rebrand my [thing]", "visual identity for [thing]", "build-a-brand".
description_zh: 适用场景：当用户请求构建品牌或执行符合以下示例的任务时。根据任何输入（如想法、现有网站、参考品牌列表、产品照片，或“我想为 X 重新品牌”）构建实用的品牌身份。为 founder-kit 用户默认采用快速品牌路径，并提供完整的 14-16 页指南作为可选升级方案。适用场景：当用户需要品牌身份但不需要完整的商业上线（无需 Shopify、产品列表或社交发布）时。触发短语：“build me a brand”、“make me a brand”、“design a brand identity”、“brand guidelines for [X]”、“i want a brand book”、“create a brand from scratch”、“brand for [idea]”、“i want a brand that feels like [X] + [Y]”、“rebrand my [thing]”、“visual identity for [thing]”、“build-a-brand”。

description: 超压缩 communication mode。Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.
description_zh: 超压缩通信模式。通过减少填充词、冠词和客套话，将token使用量减少约75%，同时保持完全的技术准确性。当用户说“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”、“use caveman”、“less tokens”、“be brief”，或调用 /caveman 时使用。

description: Provides file paths to language-specific reference files for the test ANALYSIS skills (assertion-quality, test-anti-patterns, test-gap-analysis, test-smell-detection, test-tagging). Call this skill to discover available extension files (e.g., dotnet.md for .NET/MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit, python.md for pytest/unittest, typescript.md for Jest/Vitest/Mocha, java.md for JUnit/TestNG, etc.). Do not use directly — invoked by the test-quality-auditor agent and polyglot analysis skills that need framework-specific lookup tables (test markers, assertion APIs, skip annotations, sleep patterns, mystery guest indicators, integration markers, setup/teardown, tag-support capability).
description_zh: 为测试分析技能（断言质量、测试反模式、测试缺口分析、测试异味检测、测试标注）提供特定语言参考文件的文件路径。调用此技能以发现可用的扩展文件（例如，dotnet.md 用于 .NET/MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit，python.md 用于 pytest/unittest，typescript.md 用于 Jest/Vitest/Mocha，java.md 用于 JUnit/TestNG 等）。请勿直接使用——由 test-quality-auditor 代理和多语言分析技能调用，这些技能需要框架特定的查询表（测试标记、断言 API、skip 注解、睡眠模式、神秘访客指示器、集成标记、设置/清理、标签支持能力）。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
description_zh: 在用户需要创建、读取、编辑或操作 Word 文档（.docx 文件）或 Word 模板（.dotx 文件）时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：出现对 'Word doc'、'word document'、'.docx'、'.dotx' 的提及，或要求制作带有目录、标题、页码或信头等专业格式的文档。此外，当从 .docx 或 .dotx 文件中提取或重新组织内容、在文档中插入或替换图片、在 Word 文件中进行查找与替换、处理修订或批注，或将内容转换为格式完善的 Word 文档时，也请使用此技能。如果用户要求以 Word 或 .docx 文件形式交付 '报告'、'备忘录'、'信函'、'模板' 或类似交付物，请使用此技能。不得用于 PDF、电子表格、Google Docs 或任何与文档生成无关的通用编程任务。

description:
Korean apartment and individual-house official price lookup through the public
realtyprice.kr web data surface. Use when the user asks for 공동주택가격,
개별주택가격, 아파트 공시가격, 단독주택 공시가격, or housing official price
history. This is not land official price, transaction price, or building
register metadata.
description_zh: 通过公开的realtyprice.kr网络数据界面查询韩国公寓和独栋住宅的官方价格。当用户询问공동주택가격、개별주택가격、아파트 공시가격、단독주택 공시가격或住房官方价格历史时使用。此并非土地官方价格、交易价格或房屋登记元数据。

description: Write a project brief — problem space, constraints, audience, and success criteria. Use at kickoff for one specific project. For long-horizon aspiration use `north-star-vision`; for reusable decision rules use `design-principles`.
description_zh: 撰写项目简报——问题空间、约束条件、目标受众和成功标准。在项目启动时，针对某个特定项目使用。长期愿景使用 `north-star-vision`；可复用决策规则使用 `design-principles`。

description: Help users understand and build design engineering capabilities. Use when someone is creating a design engineering function, hiring design engineers, or bridging the gap between design and engineering teams.
description_zh: 帮助用户理解并构建设计工程能力。适用于创建设计工程职能、招聘设计工程师或搭建设计团队与工程团队之间桥梁时。

description: Use when preparing your agent for production — IAM scoping, inbound auth (JWT, SigV4), secrets management, cold start optimization, session lifecycle, rate limiting, input validation, and quota guidance. Triggers on: "production checklist", "harden agent", "production ready", "secure agent", "inbound auth", "going live", "cold start optimization", "session lifecycle", "StopRuntimeSession", "quota", "throttling", "maxVms", "rate limit", "security audit of outbound API calls", "gateway target audit for production", "restrict who can call", "lock down endpoint", "only our app can call". Not for Cedar tool-restriction policies — use agents-connect. Not for quality measurement — use agents-optimize. Not for outbound credential storage or API key wiring — use agents-connect. Not for A2A agent-to-agent auth — use agents-build. Cold start observation and diagnosis (not optimization) routes to agents-debug.
description_zh: 在准备您的代理用于生产环境时使用——进行IAM作用域配置、入站认证（JWT、SigV4）、密钥管理、冷启动优化、会话生命周期、速率限制、输入验证和配额指导。触发条件：当出现“production checklist”、“harden agent”、“production ready”、“secure agent”、“inbound auth”、“going live”、“cold start optimization”、“session lifecycle”、“StopRuntimeSession”、“quota”、“throttling”、“maxVms”、“rate limit”、“security audit of outbound API calls”、“gateway target audit for production”、“restrict who can call”、“lock down endpoint”、“only our app can call”时。不适用于 Cedar 工具限制策略——请使用 agents-connect。不适用于质量度量——请使用 agents-optimize。不适用于出站凭证存储或 API 密钥配置——请使用 agents-connect。不适用于 A2A 代理间认证——请使用 agents-build。冷启动观测与诊断（非优化）路由至 agents-debug。

description: Test website responsiveness across viewport widths using browser automation. Resizes a single session through breakpoints, screenshots each width, and detects layout transitions (column changes, nav switches, overflow). Produces comparison reports showing exactly where layouts break. Trigger with 'responsiveness check', 'check responsive', 'breakpoint test', 'viewport test', 'responsive sweep', 'check breakpoints', or 'test at mobile'.
description_zh: 使用浏览器自动化测试网站在不同视口宽度下的响应能力。通过断点调整单个会话的尺寸，截取每个宽度的截图，并检测布局变化（包括列变化、导航切换和溢出）。生成对比报告，精确展示布局失效的具体位置。可通过“响应能力检查”、“检查响应能力”、“断点测试”、“视口测试”、“响应式扫描”、“检查断点”或“移动端测试”触发。

description: Compare UX patterns, features, strengths, and gaps across rival products. Use when you need to know what others actually do. For deliberately adopting their conventions, use `jakobs-law` (interaction-design).
description_zh: 在竞品之间比较 UX 模式、功能、优势与不足。当你需要了解他人实际做法时使用。若要有意采纳其惯例，使用 `jakobs-law`（交互设计）。

description: When the user wants to use GitHub for SEO, parasite SEO, GEO, open source marketing, README optimization, or curated Awesome lists. Also use when the user mentions "GitHub," "GitHub SEO," "GitHub parasite SEO," "GitHub GEO," "awesome list," "GitHub README," "profile README," "pinned repositories," "Trending," "Explore," "repository name," "About section," "GitHub description," "GitHub topics," "Website field," "GitHub Pages," "github.io," "user site," "project site," "GitHub gist," "curated list," or "navigation list." Not for Medium or other non-GitHub platforms—use parasite-seo or medium-posts. For OSS business model, use open-source-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户希望使用 GitHub 进行 SEO、parasite SEO、GEO、开源营销、README 优化或精选 Awesome 列表时。当用户提到“GitHub”，“GitHub SEO”，“GitHub parasite SEO”，“GitHub GEO”，“awesome list”，“GitHub README”，“profile README”，“pinned repositories”，“Trending”，“Explore”，“repository name”，“About section”，“GitHub description”，“GitHub topics”，“Website field”，“GitHub Pages”，“github.io”，“user site”，“project site”，“GitHub gist”，“curated list”或“navigation list”时，也使用。不适用于 Medium 或其他非 GitHub 平台——请使用 parasite-seo 或 medium-posts。对于 OSS 商业模式，使用 open-source-strategy。

description: Reconstruct data structures by analyzing memory access patterns across functions
description_zh: 通过分析跨函数的内存访问模式来重建数据结构

description: Test-driven development via red-green-refactor with an auditable commit protocol. Use when implementing any feature, bugfix, refactor, or behavior change before writing implementation code, or when the user mentions TDD, red-green-refactor, or test-first development.
description_zh: 通过红-绿-重构的测试驱动开发，并采用可审计的提交协议。在编写实现代码之前实现任何功能、修复缺陷、进行重构或行为变更时使用，或者在用户提及测试驱动开发、红-绿-重构或测试优先开发时使用。

description: Use when a user asks to build, optimize, backtest, rebalance, or analyze a stock portfolio with Mean-CVaR, efficient frontiers, scenario generation, or NVIDIA cuOpt.
description_zh: 当用户请求构建、优化、回测、再平衡或分析包含均值-CVaR、有效前沿、情景生成或 NVIDIA cuOpt 的股票组合时使用。

description: Creates viral social media hooks using proven psychological patterns and trigger words. Use when user needs attention-grabbing openings for posts, threads, videos, or content.
description_zh: 利用已验证的心理模式与触发词，生成社交媒体爆款钩子。适用于用户需要为帖子、动态、视频或内容制作吸引注意力的开场文案时。

description: Delegate a coding task to Oh My Pi (`omp`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Oh My Pi / omp - phrasings like "have omp implement X", "delegate this to oh my pi", "run it through omp", "use oh-my-pi to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through omp while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, when the user wants the code written directly without delegating, or when they mean the original Pi CLI (`pi`) — that is pi-delegate.
description_zh:
将编码任务委托给 Oh My Pi (`omp`)，作为后台实现者，然后审查其差异（diff）并自行合并。在以下情况下使用此方法：用户希望将实现工作委托给 Oh My Pi / omp，例如使用 "have omp implement X"、"delegate this to oh my pi"、"run it through omp"、"use oh-my-pi to implement/fix/refactor" 等表述，或希望将一系列编码任务通过 omp 执行但自己保持审查者身份。

切勿用于以下情况：任务小到可以直接内联完成；用户希望直接编写代码而无需进行委托；或用户指的是原始的 Pi CLI (`pi`)（即 pi-delegate）。

description: Audits an implementation plan for requirements traceability, avoidable complexity, risky assumptions, and evidence gaps. Use when reviewing an AI-generated or human-authored plan, design proposal, implementation outline, task breakdown, or architecture plan and the user wants a standalone audit report without overwriting the source plan.
description_zh: 对实施方案进行审计，核查需求可追溯性、可避免的复杂性、存在风险的假设与证据缺口。适用于审核由AI生成或人工编写的方案、设计提案、实施方案大纲、任务分解或架构方案时，满足用户获取独立审计报告且不覆盖原始方案的需求。

description: Query documented public database APIs with explicit endpoints, filters, pagination, and provenance. Use when a scientific, regulatory, financial, or other database-backed fact must be retrieved reproducibly from a named source rather than inferred from general knowledge.
description_zh: 查询带有明确端点、过滤条件、分页及溯源信息的已文档化公共数据库API。当需要从指定来源可重复地检索科学、监管、金融或其他基于数据库的事实，而非从一般知识中推断时，使用本方法。

description: Map the full ecosystem of touchpoints, channels, and relationships across a service. Use when the experience spans more than one product. For one persona's linear journey use `journey-map` (design-research); for backstage operations use `service-blueprint`.
description_zh: 映射服务覆盖的触点、渠道与关系，形成完整的生态系统。当体验跨越多个产品时使用。针对单一用户画像的线性旅程，使用 `journey-map`（设计研究）；针对后台运营，使用 `service-blueprint`。

description: Design gesture interactions for touch and pointer — swipe, drag, long-press, and their discoverability. Use when input is gestural. For OS-standard gestures on iOS and Android, use `platform-conventions` (ui-design).
description_zh: 为触控与指针设计手势交互——滑动、拖动、长按及其可发现性。当输入为手势时使用。对于 iOS 和 Android 上的操作系统标准手势，使用 `platform-conventions`（ui-design）。

description: Game UI/UX designer that analyzes and improves the visual polish, atmosphere, and player experience of browser games. Use when a game needs visual improvements, better backgrounds, particles, animations, screen transitions, juice/feel, or overall aesthetic upgrades.
description_zh: 游戏UI/UX设计师，负责分析并提升网页游戏的视觉打磨度、氛围与玩家体验。适用于需要视觉优化、更优质背景、粒子效果、动画、屏幕转场、操作手感或整体美学升级的游戏场景。

description: Qdrant provides client SDKs for various programming languages, allowing easy integration with Qdrant deployments.
description_zh: Qdrant 为多种编程语言提供客户端 SDK，便于与 Qdrant 部署进行集成。

description: Brand strategy and identity design for businesses and products. Use when creating brand guidelines, developing visual identity systems, or defining brand positioning.
description_zh: 面向企业及产品的品牌策略与身份设计。在制定品牌指南、开发视觉识别系统或确立品牌定位时使用。

description: 让 agent zoom out，并给出更广的 context 或更高层 perspective。Use when you're unfamiliar with a section of code or need to understand how it fits into the bigger picture.
description_zh: 让 agent 拉远视角，并给出更广泛的上下文或更高层次的视角。当你不熟悉代码的某个部分，或需要理解其在大局中的定位时使用。

description: Help users run effective decision-making processes. Use when someone is facing a high-stakes decision, dealing with analysis paralysis, needs to align stakeholders on a choice, or wants to establish decision frameworks like DACI or RAPID.
description_zh: 帮助用户开展有效的决策流程。适用于面临高风险决策、应对分析瘫痪、需在选择上统一相关方意见，或想要建立如DACI或RAPID等决策框架的情况。

description: Monitor management - list, search, file-based create, and alerting best practices.
description_zh: 监控管理 - 列表、搜索、基于文件创建和告警的最佳实践。

description: Use when users need visual direction, interface hierarchy, layout decisions, design specifications, or prototypes before implementing a Web or mini program UI.
description_zh: 当用户需要在实施Web或小程序UI之前获得视觉方向、界面层级、布局决策、设计规范或原型时使用。

description: Build research-grounded personas with goals, frustrations, and behavioural patterns. Use when decisions need a consistent user reference. For one session's emotional snapshot use `empathy-map`; for motivation framing use `jobs-to-be-done`.
description_zh: 构建基于研究的用户画像，包含目标、挫败感与行为模式。当需要统一的用户参考来辅助决策时使用。单个会话的情感快照使用 `empathy-map`；动机框架使用 `jobs-to-be-done`。

description: Apple Human Interface Guidelines for iPhone. Use when building, reviewing, or refactoring SwiftUI/UIKit interfaces for iOS. Triggers on tasks involving iPhone UI, iOS components, accessibility, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, or HIG compliance.
description_zh: 《iPhone 人机界面指南》。在构建、审查或重构 iOS 的 SwiftUI/UIKit 界面时使用。适用于涉及 iPhone 界面、iOS 组件、无障碍功能、动态字体、深色模式或 HIG 合规性任务。

description: Generate Drizzle ORM schemas for Cloudflare D1 databases with correct D1-specific patterns. Produces schema files, migration commands, type exports, and DATABASE_SCHEMA.md documentation. Handles D1 quirks: foreign keys always enforced, no native BOOLEAN/DATETIME types, 100 bound parameter limit, JSON stored as TEXT. Use when creating a new database, adding tables, or scaffolding a D1 data layer.
description_zh: 为 Cloudflare D1 数据库生成包含正确 D1 特定模式的 Drizzle ORM 模式。生成模式文件、迁移命令、类型导出以及 DATABASE_SCHEMA.md 文档。处理 D1 特殊之处：外键始终强制生效，无原生 BOOLEAN/DATETIME 类型，绑定参数限制为 100，JSON 以 TEXT 存储。适用于创建新数据库、添加表或搭建 D1 数据层。

description: Design, refactor, review, or implement Flutter app architecture using MVVM, layered UI/Data/optional Domain boundaries, feature-first or layer-first project structure, repositories, services, dependency injection, Result and Command patterns, offline-first or optimistic UI flows. Use when asked to add a Flutter feature, audit layer dependencies, fix cross-feature imports, migrate to feature-first, choose architecture for a Flutter project, or create scalable maintainable Flutter code organization.
description_zh: 使用 MVVM 设计、重构、评审或实现 Flutter 应用架构，采用分层 UI/数据/可选领域边界、以功能优先或以分层优先的项目结构、仓库、服务、依赖注入、Result 和 Command 模式，以及离线优先或乐观 UI 流程。适用于当被要求添加 Flutter 功能、审计分层依赖、修复跨功能导入、迁移至功能优先架构、为 Flutter 项目选择架构，或创建可扩展且可维护的 Flutter 代码组织时使用。

description: Create or edit digital 3D assets with Meshy: models, textures, rigging, animation, and reference images. For physical printing, use meshy-3d-printing.
description_zh: 使用 Meshy 创建或编辑数字 3D 资产：模型、纹理、绑定、动画和参考图。如需物理打印，请使用 meshy-3d-printing。

description: This skill provides instructions for interacting with Todoist using the td CLI tool. It covers CRUD operations for tasks/projects/sections/labels/comments, and requires confirmation before destructive actions. Use this skill when the user wants to read, create, update, or delete Todoist data.
description_zh: 该技能提供使用 td CLI 工具与 Todoist 交互的说明。它涵盖任务、项目、分区、标签、评论的 CRUD 操作，并在执行破坏性操作前需确认。当用户需要读取、创建、更新或删除 Todoist 数据时，请使用此技能。

description: Provide qualitative-first, evidence-traceable developmental review of scholarly works and audit low-stakes research-assessment rubrics with optional local quality controls. Never use for ranking people or consequential decisions.
description_zh: 提供以定性评估为先、证据可追溯的学术著作发展性评审，并审计低风险研究评估标准，支持可选的本地质量控制。不得用于对人排名或作出重大决策。

description: Query the user's LLM Wiki knowledge base (the LLM Wiki desktop app at 127.0.0.1:19828 — NOT Obsidian, Notion, Apple Notes, Logseq, or any other PKM tool).
