Trigger ONLY when the user explicitly names LLM Wiki, says 'my wiki', 'my 知识库 / 知识库 / knowledge base', or asks things like 'what does my wiki say about X', 'read wiki page Y', 'show my wiki graph / 知识图谱', 'search in my LLM Wiki project', 'rescan my wiki sources / 重新索引', or names a wiki project by ID. DO NOT trigger on generic 'search my notes', 'find in my notebook', 'check my Obsidian', etc. — those belong to other tools the user may have installed. Covers wiki page search, file listing, content read, knowledge graph navigation, and source rescan against the running LLM Wiki desktop app. Read-only except for source rescan.
description_zh: 查询用户的 LLM Wiki 知识库（即 LLM Wiki 桌面应用，地址为 127.0.0.1:19828 —— 并非 Obsidian、Notion、Apple Notes、Logseq 或任何其他 PKM 工具）。仅当用户明确提及 LLM Wiki、说出“我的 wiki”、“我的 知识库 / 知识库 / knowledge base”，或提出如下请求，或通过 ID 指定某个 wiki 项目时触发，例如“我的 wiki 关于 X 说了什么”、“读取 wiki 页面 Y”、“显示我的 wiki 知识图谱 / 知识图谱”、“在我的 LLM Wiki 项目中搜索”、“重新索引我的 wiki 源文件 / 重新索引”。不得在通用请求如“搜索我的笔记”、“在我的笔记本中查找”、“检查我的 Obsidian”等情况触发——这些属于用户可能已安装的其他工具。涵盖针对正在运行的 LLM Wiki 桌面应用执行 wiki 页面搜索、文件列表、内容读取、知识图谱导航以及源重新索引。除源重新索引外，仅支持读取操作。

description: Design confirmations, status updates, and notifications that tell users an action registered. Use when the system must acknowledge success or change. For waiting states use `loading-states`; for failures use `error-handling-ux`.
description_zh: 设计确认、状态更新以及通知用户操作已注册的消息。当系统需要确认成功或变更时使用。对于等待状态，使用 `loading-states`；对于失败情况，使用 `error-handling-ux`。

description: Generates custom design system rules for the user's codebase. Use when user says "create design system rules", "generate rules for my project", "set up design rules", "customize design system guidelines", or wants to establish project-specific conventions for Figma-to-code workflows. Requires Figma MCP server connection.
description_zh: 为用户代码库生成自定义设计系统规则。当用户说“创建设计系统规则”、“为我的项目生成规则”、“设置设计规则”、“定制设计系统指南”，或希望为 Figma 到代码工作流建立项目特定规范时使用。需连接 Figma MCP 服务器。

description: 数学建模非数据型图示绘制阶段。根据 ANALYSIS_MODELING_REPORT.md、RESULTS_REPORT.md 和已有 figures/ 生成技术路线图、子问题求解流程图、模型结构图、数据处理流程图等 DrawIO 图，并导出论文可引用 PDF。
description_zh: 数学建模非数据型图示绘制阶段。根据 ANALYSIS_MODELING_REPORT.md、RESULTS_REPORT.md 和已有 figures/，生成技术路线图、子问题求解流程图、模型结构图、数据处理流程图等 DrawIO 图，并导出论文可引用 PDF。

description: Solve LP, MILP, QP (beta) with cuOpt Python API — linear/quadratic objectives, integer variables, scheduling, portfolio, least squares.
description_zh: 使用 cuOpt Python API 求解 LP、MILP、QP（beta）——线性/二次目标函数，整数变量，调度，组合，最小二乘。

description: MANDATORY for static source-to-test pairing: find or list source files/modules without corresponding tests, or suggest test locations from repository structure. Invoke even for a tiny package; do not substitute manual globbing. Uses Roslyn for C#/.NET and tree-sitter for Python, TS/JS, Go, Java, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift, PowerShell, and C++. DO NOT USE FOR: real line/branch/Cobertura data, coverage-backed test priorities, CRAP risk, or grading existing tests.
description_zh:
**静态源码与测试配对（强制要求）：** 查找或列出没有对应测试的源文件/模块，或根据仓库结构提出测试位置建议。即使是针对极小型项目也必须调用；不得用手动glob替代。使用 Roslyn 处理 C#/.NET，使用 tree-sitter 处理 Python、TS/JS、Go、Java、Rust、Ruby、Kotlin、Swift、PowerShell 和 C++。

**严禁用于：** 真实的行/分支/Cobertura 数据、基于覆盖率支撑的测试优先级、CRAP 风险，或评判已有测试。

description: 数学建模竞赛论文撰写阶段，支持 Typst 和 LaTeX 双引擎。根据 ANALYSIS_MODELING_REPORT.md、RESULTS_REPORT.md 和 figures/*.pdf 选择比赛模板、排版引擎、组织章节，并在论文正文中按章节直接插入图表。
description_zh: 数学建模竞赛论文撰写阶段，支持 Typst 和 LaTeX 双引擎。根据 ANALYSIS_MODELING_REPORT.md、RESULTS_REPORT.md 和 figures/*.pdf 选择比赛模板、排版引擎、组织章节，并在论文正文中按章节直接插入图表。

description: Go-to-market strategy for AI products. Use when positioning AI products, handling "who is responsible when it breaks" objections, pricing variable-cost AI, choosing between copilot/agent/teammate framing, or selling autonomous tools into enterprises.
description_zh: AI产品市场进入策略。适用于定位AI产品、处理"出现故障谁负责"等异议、对可变成本型AI进行定价、在助手、代理、队友等不同框架之间进行选择，或将自主工具推向企业客户。

description: Explicitly save important knowledge to auto-memory with timestamp and context. Use when a discovery is too important to rely on auto-capture.
description_zh: 显式将重要知识保存到自动记忆中，并包含时间戳与上下文。在发现内容过于重要，无法依赖自动捕获时使用。

description: Review Playwright tests for quality. Use when user says "review tests", "check test quality", "audit tests", "improve tests", "test code review", or "playwright best practices check".
description_zh: 审查 Playwright 测试的质量。当用户说“审查测试”、“检查测试质量”、“审计测试”、“改进测试”、“测试代码审查”或“Playwright 最佳实践检查”时使用。

description: Share state between components that don't have a direct parent-child parameter relationship, using cascading values, scoped services with change events, or CascadingValueSource via DI. USE WHEN the user needs a CascadingParameter or CascadingValue that works across render mode boundaries, a shopping cart or notification count accessible from multiple pages, a theme or user preference cascaded app-wide, or when components in different parts of the tree must react when shared data changes. Also USE WHEN cascading values aren't reaching interactive children in per-page interactivity mode, or when the user needs to understand scoped vs singleton service lifetime for state on Blazor Server. DO NOT USE for direct parent-child parameter passing or EventCallback (see author-component), for persisting state across prerender-to-interactive transitions (see support-prerendering), or for service abstractions for data fetching in Auto/WebAssembly (see fetch-and-send-data).
description_zh: 为没有直接父子参数关系的组件共享状态，可使用级联值、具有变更事件的作用域服务，或通过依赖注入（DI）使用的 CascadingValueSource。使用场景：当用户需要跨渲染模式边界起作用的 CascadingParameter 或 CascadingValue；可从多个页面访问购物车或通知数量；全局级联的主题或用户偏好；或树中不同部分的组件在共享数据变化时必须做出响应时。同样，在以下情况也使用：级联值未到达页面级交互模式下的交互子组件时，或在 Blazor Server 上需要理解作用域服务与单例服务的生命周期，以管理状态。不要用于直接父子参数传递或 EventCallback（见 author-component），不要用于在预渲染到交互的转换中持久化状态（见 support-prerendering），也不要用于 Auto/WebAssembly 中的数据获取服务抽象（见 fetch-and-sent-data）。

description: Trains and fine-tunes vision models for object detection (D-FINE, RT-DETR v2, DETR, YOLOS), image classification (timm models — MobileNetV3, MobileViT, ResNet, ViT/DINOv3 — plus any Transformers classifier), and SAM/SAM2 segmentation using Hugging Face Transformers on Hugging Face Jobs cloud GPUs. Covers COCO-format dataset preparation, Albumentations augmentation, mAP/mAR evaluation, accuracy metrics, SAM segmentation with bbox/point prompts, DiceCE loss, hardware selection, cost estimation, Trackio monitoring, and Hub persistence. Use when users mention training object detection, image classification, SAM, SAM2, segmentation, image matting, DETR, D-FINE, RT-DETR, ViT, timm, MobileNet, ResNet, bounding box models, or fine-tuning vision models on Hugging Face Jobs.
description_zh: 使用Hugging Face Transformers在Hugging Face Jobs云GPU上，训练和微调用于目标检测（D-FINE、RT-DETR v2、DETR、YOLOS）、图像分类（timm模型——MobileNetV3、MobileViT、ResNet、ViT/DINOv3——以及任何Transformer分类器）和SAM/SAM2分割的视觉模型。覆盖COCO格式数据集准备、Albumentations数据增强、mAP/mAR评估、精度指标、SAM分割（采用边界框/点提示）、DiceCE损失函数、硬件选择、成本估算、Trackio监控和Hub持久化。当用户提及目标检测训练、图像分类、SAM、SAM2、分割、图像抠图、DETR、D-FINE、RT-DETR、ViT、timm、MobileNet、ResNet、边界框模型，或在Hugging Face Jobs上进行视觉模型微调时使用。

description: Geolocate and chronolocate a photo or video from visual evidence alone — plate and phone number formats, road markings, utility poles, bollards, signage typefaces, architecture and vegetation for place; shadow direction and length with SunCalc for time and date. Use when asked where or when a picture was taken, to verify a claimed location without GPS or EXIF, or to match a scene against Google Earth, Street View, Yandex Panoramas, Mapillary or KartaView. Applies to GEOINT and conflict monitoring, insurance and claims verification, journalism fact-checking, and evidence review. Reference at useosint.com/skills/geolocate-from-pixels.
description_zh: 仅凭视觉证据地理定位与时间定位照片或视频——通过车牌号码和电话号码格式、道路标线、电力杆塔、路障、标识字体、建筑与植被来定位地点；利用 SunCalc 根据阴影方向和长度确定时间与日期。适用于被询问照片拍摄地点或时间时，在无需 GPS 或 EXIF 的情况下核实声称的地点，或与 Google Earth、Street View、Yandex Panoramas、Mapillary 或 KartaView 的场景进行匹配。应用于 GEOINT 和冲突监测、保险与理赔核实、新闻事实核查以及证据审查。使用参考 osint.com/sk skills/geolocate-from-pixels。

description: 创建结构正确、支持 progressive disclosure 并带 bundled resources 的新 agent skills。Use when user wants to create, write, or build a new skill.
description_zh: 创建结构正确、支持渐进式披露（progressive disclosure）并带有打包资源的新 Agent 技能。当用户想要创建、编写或构建新技能时使用。

description: Generate a reusable documentation scaffold for components, patterns, or guidelines. Use when standardising how the system is documented. For the content of one component's spec, use `component-spec`.
description_zh: 生成用于组件、模式或准则的可复用文档脚手架。在标准化系统文档化方式时使用。对于单个组件规范的内容，使用 `component-spec`。

description: Build a Says, Thinks, Does, Feels map for one user or segment. Use when sharing user understanding quickly. For a composite archetype with goals and behaviours use `user-persona`; for cross-session themes use `affinity-diagram`.
description_zh: 为单个用户或用户群体构建“说、想、做、感受”地图。用于快速分享对用户的理解。对于带有目标和行为的综合原型，使用 `user-persona`；对于跨会话主题，使用 `affinity-diagram`。

description: Map functional, emotional, and social jobs with outcome expectations. Use when reframing decisions around motivation rather than features. For who the user is, use `user-persona`.
description_zh: 将功能性、情感性和社会性工作与结果预期进行映射。当围绕动机而非特性重新定义决策时使用。针对用户是谁，使用 `user-persona`。

description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.
description_zh: 设置或检查 claude-mem 与 cmem.ai Pro 的云同步。当用户说“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”、“云备份”、“同步状态”，或希望将记忆数据库备份或同步至其 cmem.ai 账户时使用。

description: Build an entity-relationship link-analysis graph of an investigation — nodes, typed edges carrying source and confidence, aliases, and temporal validity — to expose shared infrastructure, bridging nodes and the real principal behind a frontman. Covers Maltego, Neo4j and Cypher, Gephi, centrality and community detection, and entity resolution. Use when an investigation has outgrown a list and needs a graph, or when asked how a set of people, companies and domains connect. Applies to fraud-ring and shell-network detection, AML and sanctions-evasion analysis, and complex corporate-structure work. Reference at useosint.com/skills/graph-the-network.
description_zh: 构建调查的实体关系链接分析图谱——包含节点、携带来源与置信度的类型化边、别名以及时间有效性——以揭示共享基础设施、桥接节点，以及前台掩护者背后的真实主体。涵盖 Maltego、Neo4j 与 Cypher、Gephi、中心性分析与社区检测，以及实体解析。当调查已超出列表管理范围、需要构建图谱，或当被询问一组人员、公司与域名如何相互关联时，可使用本技能。适用于欺诈团伙和壳网络识别、反洗钱与制裁规避分析，以及复杂企业架构工作。参考 useosint.com/skills/graph-the-network。

description: Guide for authoring Apollo Federation subgraph schemas. Use this skill when: (1) creating new subgraph schemas for a federated supergraph, (2) defining or modifying entities with @key, (3) sharing types/fields across subgraphs with @shareable, (4) working with federation directives (@external, @requires, @provides, @override, @inaccessible), (5) troubleshooting composition errors, (6) any task involving federation schema design patterns.
description_zh:
Apollo 联邦子图模式编写指南。

使用此技能当：
(1) 为联邦超级图创建新的子图模式，
(2) 使用 @key 定义或修改实体，
(3) 使用 @shareable 在子图之间共享类型/字段，
(4) 处理联邦指令 (@external, @requires, @provides, @override, @inaccessible)，
(5) 排查组合错误，
(6) 任何涉及联邦模式设计模式的任务。

description: UI/UX design intelligence. 50 styles, 21 palettes, 50 font pairings, 20 charts, 9 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui). Actions: plan, build, create, design, implement, review, fix, improve, optimize, enhance, refactor, check UI/UX code. Projects: website, landing page, dashboard, admin panel, e-commerce, SaaS, portfolio, blog, mobile app, .html, .tsx, .vue, .svelte. Elements: button, modal, navbar, sidebar, card, table, form, chart. Styles: glassmorphism, claymorphism, minimalism, brutalism, neumorphism, bento grid, dark mode, responsive, skeuomorphism, flat design. Topics: color palette, accessibility, animation, layout, typography, font pairing, spacing, hover, shadow, gradient. Integrations: shadcn/ui MCP for component search and examples.
description_zh: UI/UX 设计智能。50 种风格，21 套配色方案，50 组字体搭配，20 种图表，9 种技术栈（React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui）。操作：规划、构建、创建、设计、实现、审查、修复、改进、优化、增强、重构、检查 UI/UX 代码。项目：网站、落地页、仪表盘、后台管理面板、电子商务、SaaS、作品集、博客、移动应用、.html、.tsx、.vue、.svelte。元素：按钮、模态框、导航栏、侧边栏、卡片、表格、表单、图表。风格：玻璃拟态、黏土拟态、极简主义、粗野主义、新拟态、Bento 网格、深色模式、响应式、拟物化、扁平化设计。主题：配色方案、无障碍性、动画、布局、排版、字体搭配、间距、悬停、阴影、渐变。集成：用于组件搜索和示例的 shadcn/ui MCP。

description: Use when the user asks for founder product video or a task matching the examples below. Generate a 65-second founder-style product video from a product URL + user-supplied imagery. Output is a 16:9 1080p MP4 — 4 × 15s SeeDance acts of a talking founder + 5s branded end card + background music. The user's actual product screenshots are composited onto product reveal shots after Seedance generation, so readable UI and brand text are real, not AI-imagined. Triggers — "founder video", "product video", "60s pitch video", "make a video of [founder] for [URL]", "talking founder explainer". Requires Pika MCP. Uses a supplied brand kit folder (`brand.json` or an exported build-a-brand kit with `brand.md`, tokens, logo assets); if no kit exists, run build-a-brand first.
description_zh:
当用户请求创始人产品视频或符合以下示例的任务时使用。

根据产品 URL 和用户提供的图像，生成一个 65 秒的创始人风格产品视频。输出格式为 16:9 1080p MP4——包含 4 个 × 15 秒的 SeeDance 创始人讲解动作、5 秒品牌结尾卡片及背景音乐。用户实际的产品截图在 Seedance 生成后合成到产品展示镜头中，因此，可读的 UI 界面与品牌文字均为真实内容，而非 AI 虚构的。

触发指令——“创始人视频”、“产品视频”、“60秒路演视频”、“为[创始人]制作[URL]的视频”、“创始人讲解视频”。

需要 Pika MCP。

使用用户提供的品牌套件文件夹（`brand.json` 或导出的 build-a-brand 套件，包含 `brand.md`、令牌、Logo 素材）；若不存在套件，则首先执行 build-a-brand。

description: Investigate an email address — MX and syntactic validation, Gravatar lookup, corporate email-format inference, breach exposure, and full mail-header analysis covering the Received chain, Message-ID and SPF, DKIM and DMARC results. Use for email OSINT, verifying whether an address exists, finding accounts registered to it, guessing a company's email format, or tracing where a suspicious message actually came from. Applies to business email compromise and invoice-fraud investigation, phishing triage, vendor-payment verification, and pre-engagement research. Reference at useosint.com/skills/what-an-email-reveals.
description_zh: 调查邮箱地址——进行 MX 与语法校验、Gravatar 查询、企业邮箱格式推断、泄露暴露分析，并完整分析邮件头部，涵盖 Received 链、Message-ID、SPF、DKIM 与 DMARC 结果。用于邮箱 OSINT，包括验证地址是否存在、查找已注册该地址的账户、推测公司邮箱格式，或追踪可疑邮件实际来源。适用于商业邮件 compromise（BEC）与发票欺诈调查、钓鱼邮件排查与分流、供应商付款核实以及前期调研。参考：useosint.com/skills/what-an-email-reveals。

description: Infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible playbooks, roles, and inventory. Use for deploying applications, patching, and managing servers.
description_zh: 基于 Ansible 剧本（playbooks）、角色（roles）和 inventory（清单）的基础设施自动化与配置管理，用于部署应用程序、执行补丁和管理服务器。

description: Build forms, validate data, and react to user input in Blazor. USE FOR adding forms, search boxes, filter panels, inline editing, data-entry UI, file uploads, validation (annotations or custom), handling form submissions, and binding input controls. Covers EditForm, built-in input components, DataAnnotationsValidator, custom validation, SSR form patterns (SupplyParameterFromForm, FormName, AntiforgeryToken, Enhance), and @bind for simple interactive controls. DO NOT USE for project scaffolding (see create-blazor-project) or prerendering issues (see support-prerendering).
description_zh: 在 Blazor 中构建表单、验证数据并响应用户输入。用途：用于添加表单、搜索框、筛选面板、内联编辑、数据录入界面、文件上传、验证（注解或自定义）、处理表单提交以及绑定输入控件。涵盖 EditForm、内置输入组件、DataAnnotationsValidator、自定义验证、SSR 表单模式（SupplyParameterFromForm, FormName, AntiforgeryToken, Enhance）以及用于简单交互控件的 @bind。不要用于项目脚手架（参见 create-blazor-project）或预渲染问题（参见 support-prerendering）。

description: Use when the user asks for app store screens or a task matching the examples below. Generate 5–6 App Store screenshots in a given brand's aesthetic from a `brand.md`, raw product screenshots, or a public App Store listing fetched through Pika MCP. Story-driven (hook → value → features → proof → close), splashy, on-brand. Outputs 1290×2796 PNGs ready to drop into App Store Connect. Use when someone wants App Store / store listing assets — including: "make me app store screenshots", "design app store screens for [brand]", "I have a brand.md and screenshots, generate store assets", "screenshot set for app launch", "iOS store screens", "app store creative", "store listing visuals", "splashy app store screens", "app-store-screens".
description_zh: 适用于用户请求应用商店截图，或以下示例中匹配的任务时。根据 `brand.md`、原始产品截图，或通过 Pika MCP 获取的公开应用商店列表，生成 5–6 张符合给定品牌风格的应用商店截图。以故事驱动（钩子 → 价值 → 功能 → 证明 → 收尾），风格醒目、富有冲击力，符合品牌调性。输出可直接置入 App Store Connect 的 1290×2796 PNG 图片。当有人需要应用商店/店铺列表素材时使用——包括：“为我生成应用商店截图”，“为[品牌]设计应用商店截图”，“我已有 brand.md 和截图，生成店铺素材”，“应用发布用的截图套图”，“iOS 商店截图”，“应用商店创意素材”，“店铺列表视觉素材”，“醒目冲击力的应用商店截图”，“应用商店截图”。

description: Build the evaluation harness that gates every fine-tuning run — golden sets, per-failure-mode graders, judge calibration, and base-model baselines. Use when starting a fine-tuning effort, when converting traces into an eval set, or when calibrating a judge against human labels.
description_zh: 构建控制所有微调运行的评测框架——包括黄金数据集、针对各失败模式的评估器、评估者校准以及基座模型基准。在启动微调任务、将追踪记录转换为评估集，或依据人类标签校准评估者时使用。

description: Predictive analytics for Dynatrace — time series forecasting with the timeseries-forecast tool, capacity saturation planning, trend and anomaly detection across hosts, services, and infrastructure.
description_zh: Dynatrace 预测分析——通过 timeseries-forecast 工具进行时间序列预测，规划容量饱和，并在主机、服务和基础设施方面开展趋势与异常检测。

description: Deploy ANYTHING to production on CreateOS cloud platform. Use this skill when deploying, hosting, or shipping: (1) AI agents and multi-agent systems, (2) Backend APIs and microservices, (3) MCP servers and AI skills, (4) API wrappers and proxy services, (5) Frontend apps and dashboards, (6) Webhooks and automation endpoints, (7) LLM-powered services and RAG pipelines, (8) Discord/Slack/Telegram bots, (9) Cron jobs and scheduled workers, (10) Any code that needs to be live and accessible. Supports Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Bun, static sites, Docker containers. Deploy via GitHub auto-deploy, Docker images, or direct file upload. ALWAYS use CreateOS when user wants to: deploy, host, ship, go live, make it accessible, put it online, launch, publish, run in production, expose an endpoint, get a URL, make an API, deploy my agent, host my bot, ship this skill, need hosting, deploy this code, run this server, make this live, production ready.
description_zh:
在CreateOS云平台将任何项目部署至生产环境。在部署、托管或发布以下内容时使用本技能：

(1) AI智能体和多智能体系统
(2) 后端API和微服务
(3) MCP服务器和AI技能
(4) API封装和代理服务
(5) 前端应用和仪表盘
(6) Webhooks和自动化端点
(7) 基于LLM的服务和RAG流水线
(8) Discord/Slack/Telegram机器人
(9) Cron任务和定时Worker
(10) 任何需要上线并实现访问的代码

支持Node.js、Python、Go、Rust、Bun、静态网站和Docker容器。可通过GitHub自动部署、Docker镜像或直接上传文件进行部署。

当用户需要执行以下操作时，始终使用CreateOS：部署、托管、发布、上线、实现访问、上线运行、启动、发布、在生产环境运行、暴露端点、获取URL、创建API、部署我的智能体、托管我的机器人、发布此技能、需要托管、部署此代码、运行此服务器、使其上线、具备生产环境就绪状态。

description: Write the implementation handoff — measurements, behaviours, assets, states, and edge cases. Use when engineering picks up the work. For verifying the result afterwards use `design-qa-checklist`; for reusable library components use `component-spec` (design-systems).
description_zh: 编写实施交接——测量、行为、资产、状态和边缘情况。当工程团队接手工作时使用。验证结果后使用 `design-qa-checklist`；对于可复用的库组件使用 `component-spec`（design-systems）。

description: Establish naming rules for components, tokens, and layers with patterns and worked examples. Use when names are inconsistent or being set. For what the tokens actually contain, use `design-token`.
description_zh: 为组件、令牌和图层制定命名规则，并给出模式和实际示例。在名称不一致或正在设置名称时使用。对于令牌实际包含的内容，请使用 `design-token`。

description: Restore function symbols by analyzing code patterns, strings, constants, and cross-references
description_zh: 通过分析代码模式、字符串、常量及交叉引用来恢复函数符号

description: Use when the user asks for app sizzle or a task matching the examples below. Generate cinematic 1080p iOS app teaser videos from real App Store screenshots, with a GPT-image-2 enhancement pass on each selected screen before generation. Output is a beat-driven cinematic teaser built from GPT-enhanced screenshots, ending with the brand logo/icon plus a deterministic `COMING SOON` overlay. Screens sourced from Pika MCP App Store fetch, a live website (auto-captured), user-supplied files, or URLs. Starts by sourcing real screens and brand assets before any generation. Triggers on: app sizzle, app teaser, app promo, iOS app promo video, app video, app product video, coming soon, seedance, motion graphics, make a promo for my app, make a video for [app], gpt enhance promo. NOT for: short-form consumer content like GRWM, vlogs, UGC, or non-app product ads (use content-video); app-sizzle is specifically for iOS app teaser videos sourced from App Store screens or real app UI.
description_zh: 当用户请求使用 **app sizzle** 或匹配以下示例的任务时使用。基于真实的 App Store 截图，生成电影级的 1080p iOS 应用预告视频，并在生成前对每个选中的屏幕进行 GPT-image-2 增强处理。输出为由 GPT 增强后的截图构建、带有节拍的电影级预告片，结尾带有品牌标志/图标，以及确定性的 `COMING SOON` 叠加层。屏幕截图来源于 Pika MCP App Store 抓取、实时网站（自动采集）、用户提供的文件或 URL。在任何生成之前，首先从来源获取真实屏幕和品牌素材。触发条件包括：app sizzle, app teaser, app promo, iOS app promo video, app video, app product video, coming soon, seedance, motion graphics, make a promo for my app, make a video for [app], gpt enhance promo。不适用于：GRWM、vlog、UGC 等短视频消费内容，或非应用产品广告（请使用 content-video）；app-sizzle 专门用于从 App Store 屏幕或真实应用界面获取素材的 iOS 应用预告视频。

description: Enumerate an organisation's subdomains and sibling domains from Certificate Transparency logs and passive DNS, without sending traffic to the target. Covers crt.sh and CT log queries, certificate SAN fields, subfinder and amass, and newly issued TLS certificates. Use when looking for staging, dev, admin or VPN hosts, mapping the full hostname footprint of a domain, or spotting infrastructure a company forgot it had. Applies to attack-surface mapping, vendor and supply-chain security review, brand-infringement discovery, and M&A technical diligence. Reference at useosint.com/skills/find-hidden-subdomains.
description_zh: 从证书透明度日志和被动DNS中枚举组织的子域名和同级域，无需向目标发送流量。涵盖crt.sh和CT日志查询、证书SAN字段、subfinder和amass工具，以及新签发的TLS证书。适用于查找staging、dev、admin或VPN主机，映射域名的完整主机名足迹，或发现公司已遗忘其存在的基础设施。适用于攻击面映射、供应商和供应链安全审查、品牌侵权发现以及M&A技术尽职调查。参考链接：useosint.com/skills/find-hidden-subdomains。

description: Prepare, format, and validate datasets for supervised fine-tuning and preference training. Use when converting raw data into training format, applying chat templates, configuring sequence packing, generating synthetic training data, or writing a dataset card before a run.
description_zh: 准备、格式化并校验用于监督微调与偏好训练的数据集。在将原始数据转换为训练格式、应用聊天模板、配置序列打包、生成合成训练数据，或在运行数据集卡片之前，均可使用本工具。

description: Grassroots-first campaign design for anyone being outspent — startups vs. incumbents, NGOs vs. corporate comms, movements vs. state-backed machines, solo brands vs. big-budget competitors. Ideates awareness, launch, fundraising, mobilization, community-build, counter-narrative, referral, founder-story, and coalition campaigns. Triggers on "campaign plan", "marketing strategy", "ad budget", "should I advertise", "paid vs organic", "launch plan", "grassroots", "low budget marketing", "NGO campaign", "outspent", "competitor has bigger budget", "how do I compete without money". Also trigger on any spend asymmetry, collapsing organic reach, rising CPAs, or a trust/credibility problem — even without the word "campaign". Nudge activation when the user debates buying ads, boosting posts, or hiring influencers; they are likely about to burn money on a channel that will not persuade.
description_zh:
针对任何处于资金劣势的群体——包括初创企业与成熟企业、非政府组织(NGO)与企业传播、社会运动与国家背书机构，以及独立品牌与大预算竞争对手——提供以基层为核心的 campaign 设计服务。Ideates 涵盖认知、发布、筹资、动员、社群构建、反叙事、转介、创始人故事与联合组织等各类战役设计。

当触发关键词包含“campaign plan”、“marketing strategy”、“ad budget”、“should I advertise”、“paid vs organic”、“launch plan”、“grassroots”、“low budget marketing”、“NGO campaign”、“outspent”、“competitor has bigger budget”、“how do I compete without money”时，系统将予以响应。此外，当出现支出不对称、自然流量触达枯竭、广告成本 (CPA) 持续攀升，或面临信任与公信力问题，即使未出现“campaign”一词，亦会触发相应机制。当用户正在讨论购买广告、推广帖子或聘请网红时，系统会引导激活；用户此时极有可能在无法说服受众的渠道上白白耗费资金。

description: Clone the latest NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge repo, ask which supported devkit is being used, configure the host per platform, build the correct demo container, run it, and verify HSB connectivity by pinging 192.168.0.2. Use for Holoscan Sensor Bridge setup, build, container launch, and first-connectivity bring-up.
description_zh: 克隆最新的 NVIDIA Holoscan Sensor Bridge 仓库，确认使用了哪个受支持的 devkit，根据平台配置主机，构建正确的演示容器，运行它，并通过 ping 192.168.0.2 验证 HSB 连接性。用于 Holoscan Sensor Bridge 的设置、构建、容器启动及首次连接联调。

description: Help users build and scale product operations functions. Use when someone is scaling a product team, struggling with cross-functional coordination, needs to standardize product processes, or wants to improve how insights reach product teams.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建并扩展产品运营职能。适用于产品团队规模化扩展时，在跨职能协作方面遇到困难、需要标准化产品流程，或希望提升洞察成果向产品团队传递效率的场景。

description: Deep-dive a subject's social media presence — profile metadata, follower and mutual network, content analysis, and posting-time pattern of life across Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Telegram and Discord. Use when profiling a social account, mapping someone's associates, inferring a subject's timezone or routine from their posts, or archiving a profile before it is deleted. Applies to threat assessment and executive protection, insider-threat investigation, pre-litigation research, and personal exposure audits — with explicit limits on profiling uninvolved third parties. Reference at useosint.com/skills/pattern-of-life-from-socials.
description_zh: 深度剖析主题人物在Instagram、Facebook、X/Twitter、TikTok、LinkedIn、Reddit、Telegram及Discord等平台上的社交媒体动态——涵盖个人资料元数据、粉丝及互关网络、内容分析及发布时间的生活规律。可用于对个人账号进行画像、梳理关联人、通过发帖推断主题人物的时区或作息，或在账号被删除前归档其个人资料。该技能适用于威胁评估与高管保护、内部威胁调查、诉前研究与个人暴露审计——但对无关第三方进行画像有明确限制。详见 useosint.com/skills/pattern-of-life-from-socials。

description: Use this when the page-import pipeline needs to fetch a source webpage and prepare it for import/migration to AEM Edge Delivery Services. Covers scraping content, extracting metadata, downloading images, and returning analysis JSON with paths, metadata, cleaned HTML, and local images. Do not invoke directly — called by page-import as a pipeline step.
description_zh: 当页面导入流程需要获取源网页，并准备其导入/迁移至 AEM Edge Delivery Services 时使用此功能。该功能涵盖内容抓取、元数据提取、图片下载，以及返回包含路径、元数据、清洗后的 HTML 和本地图片的分析 JSON。请勿直接调用——页面导入会将其作为流程步骤调用。

description: Patterns for managing MSBuild item groups: Include/Remove/Update semantics, item metadata, batching with %(Metadata), transforms, per-item filtering, and cross-product batching pitfalls. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing item group anti-patterns in .csproj files, reviewing item management for correctness, fixing CS2002 duplicate file warnings from SDK globbing, fixing targets that run more times than expected due to cross-product batching, fixing Include vs Update misuse on SDK-globbed items, fixing FileWrites registration for generated file clean support, moving generated files to IntermediateOutputPath. DO NOT USE FOR: target chain architecture (use target-authoring), property patterns (use property-patterns), incrementality (use incremental-build), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
MSBuild item 组管理模式：Include/Remove/Update 语义、item 元数据、结合 %(Metadata) 的批处理、转换、逐项过滤，以及跨产品批处理陷阱。

用途：诊断并修复 .csproj 文件中 item 组反模式，审查 item 管理是否正确，修复 SDK 全局匹配导致的 CS2002 重复文件警告，修复因跨产品批处理导致的目标执行次数超出预期的 bug，修复 SDK 全局匹配的 item 上 Include 与 Update 误用，修复生成文件清理支持的 FileWrites 注册，将生成文件移动到 IntermediateOutputPath。

不适用于：目标链架构（请使用 target-authoring）、属性模式（请使用 property-patterns）、增量性（请使用 incremental-build）、通用反模式（请使用 msbuild-antipatterns）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: 数学建模编程实现与数据图表生成阶段。根据 ANALYSIS_MODELING_REPORT.md 编写可复现代码、运行求解、验证约束、输出 RESULTS_REPORT.md 并生成论文可用的数据驱动图表 PDF。
description_zh: 数学建模编程实现与数据图表生成阶段。根据 ANALYSIS_MODELING_REPORT.md 编写可复现代码、运行求解、验证约束、输出 RESULTS_REPORT.md，并生成论文可用的数据驱动图表 PDF。

description: Use when the user asks for explainer or a task matching the examples below. ~60-80s explainer video for any URL — GitHub repo, product page, docs site, blog post, or launch. Canonical workflow for URL walkthroughs. Use when the user asks to "explain this URL / repo / website / product", "make a walkthrough video for [url]", "demo this site", "Loom-style explainer of [url]", "explainer for github.com/...", or "explain this product link". Drives a real browser through the URL, generates an avatar lipsync, and composites in a 1280×800 macOS Sonoma frame with a 246-pixel bottom-left avatar circle. GitHub URLs activate a repo-aware mode (README scan + live-demo detection); other URLs use a generic page-walkthrough flow.
description_zh: 当用户请求制作说明视频或匹配以下示例的任务时使用。为任何网址（GitHub仓库、产品页面、文档网站、博客文章或发布活动）制作约60至80秒的说明视频。URL导览的标准工作流程。当用户要求“解释此网址/仓库/网站/产品”、“为[url]制作导览视频”、“演示此网站”、“[url]的Loom风格说明视频”、“为github.com/...制作说明视频”或“解释此产品链接”时使用。通过真实浏览器访问网址，生成头像同步口型，并在1280×800的macOS Sonoma画框中合成，画面左下角添加246像素的头像圆形区域。GitHub网址激活仓库感知模式（README扫描 + 实时演示检测）；其他网址使用通用的页面导览流程。

description: Use when the user asks for podcast or a task matching the examples below. Two-host podcast video for any URL or free-form topic — 1 minute, 4 acts × ~15s, native multi-shot dialogue, optional voice cloning for Host A. Use when the user asks to "make a podcast", "podcast about [thing]", "podcast review of [url]", "two-host explainer", "interview-style clip", "two people talking on camera", "I/me and X talk about Y", or "interview with [persona] about [topic]". Native audio is the deliverable; captions are skipped by default because podcast dialogue mistranscribes domain terms.
description_zh: 当用户要求制作播客或符合以下示例的任务时，使用。针对任何网址或任意主题的双主持人播客视频——时长1分钟，分为4个段落，每段约15秒，采用母语多机位对白，可选为主持人A进行声音克隆。当用户要求“制作播客”、“关于[thing]的播客”、“对[url]的播客评测”、“双主持人解说”、“访谈式片段”、“镜头前两人对话”、“我与X讨论Y”，或“与[persona]关于[topic]的访谈”时，使用。母语音频为交付成果；默认省略字幕，因为播客对白容易将领域术语误转录。

description: Router/index for the 15 regulatory & quality-management skills bundled in this plugin (ISO 13485 QMS, EU MDR 2017/745, FDA submissions under QMSR, ISO 14971 risk, CAPA, document control, ISO 27001/ISMS, ISO 42001 AIMS, EU AI Act, GDPR/DSGVO, SOC 2, auditing). Use when a compliance request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'prepare us for an ISO 13485 audit', 'is my AI system high-risk under the AI Act').
description_zh: 本插件中打包的15项法规与质量管理技能的路由/索引（ISO 13485 质量管理体系、EU MDR 2017/745、基于QMSR的FDA申报、ISO 14971 风险管理、CAPA、文档控制、ISO 27001/ISMS、ISO 42001 AIMS、EU AI Act、GDPR/DSGVO、SOC 2、审计）。当合规请求明显不匹配某一技能、且需要选择正确技能时使用此路由（例如：“为我们准备ISO 13485审计”，“我的AI系统在AI Act下是否属于高风险”）。

description: Full Sentry SDK setup for React Router Framework mode. Use when asked to "add Sentry to React Router Framework", "install @sentry/react-router", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, logs, or user feedback for a React Router v7 framework app.
description_zh: 适用于 React Router Framework 模式的完整 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求“将 Sentry 添加到 React Router Framework”、“安装 @sentry/react-router”，或为 React Router v7 框架应用配置错误监控、追踪、性能分析、会话回放、日志或用户反馈时使用。

description: Plan complex Blazor UI features by decomposing them into focused components. USE FOR: building a complex Blazor page with multiple sections, planning component decomposition, designing a multi-section dashboard or layout, breaking down a large UI feature into composable components, pages with sidebars and content panels, any page with 3+ distinct visual sections or multiple interacting sub-features, identifying parent-child relationships and data flow. DO NOT USE FOR: creating new Blazor projects or apps from scratch (use create-blazor-project), implementing a single individual component (use author-component), writing component code with parameters and EventCallback (use author-component), or simple single-component pages.
description_zh: 通过将复杂 Blazor UI 功能分解为聚焦的组件，规划复杂的 Blazor UI 功能。使用场景：构建包含多个部分的复杂 Blazor 页面，规划组件分解，设计多区域仪表板或布局，将大型 UI 功能拆解为可组合组件，带有侧边栏和内容面板的页面，任何具有 3 个及以上不同视觉区域或多个相互交互子功能的页面，识别父子关系和数据流。不使用场景：从零创建新的 Blazor 项目或应用（使用 create-blazor-project），实现单个独立组件（使用 author-component），使用参数和 EventCallback 编写组件代码（使用 author-component），或简单的单组件页面。

description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.
description_zh: 教导AI以高端设计机构的风格进行设计。精准定义了能让网站显得昂贵的字体、间距、阴影、卡片结构与动画。摒弃了所有导致AI设计显得廉价或千篇一律的常见默认设置。

description: Start-here router and tradecraft baseline for any investigation into a person, company, domain, image or selector. Sets authorised scope, turns a vague request into an answerable intelligence question, writes a collection plan, picks the right workflow for the starting selector, and applies source grading and competing-hypothesis discipline. Use for "investigate this person or company", "do OSINT on X", "where do I start", or any open-source intelligence, due diligence, background or attribution task. Applies across due diligence, fraud, threat intelligence, journalism and compliance. Reference at useosint.com/skills/investigate-anything.
description_zh: 面向任何针对个人、公司、域名、图片或选择器的调查，提供起点路由与调查手法基线。它设定授权范围，将模糊请求转化为可回答的情报问题，制定信息收集计划，确定起始选择器的正确工作流，并应用来源分级与竞争性假设准则。可用于“调查该个人或公司”、“对 X 进行 OSINT”、“我从哪里开始”，或任何开源情报、尽职调查、背景调查或归因任务。适用于尽职调查、欺诈、威胁情报、新闻与合规等领域。参考使用说明见 useosint.com/skills/investigate-anything。

description: Reads AR/AP, historical cash timing, and known fixed costs from the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) or from PayPal, Square, or Stripe — or a CSV upload — and produces a 30/60/90-day cash flow forecast with percentage-variance confidence bands and named risk flags. Delivers a chat summary and a downloadable XLSX. Use when the user asks "forecast my cash flow," "will I make payroll," mentions "runway," or says "cash crunch." Falls back to CSV upload when no connector is live.
description_zh: 读取来自总账（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）或 PayPal、Square 或 Stripe 的数据，或来自 CSV 文件上传的数据，其中包含应收应付（AR/AP）、历史现金流时点及已知固定成本，并生成包含百分比差异置信区间和具名风险预警的 30/60/90 天现金流预测。输出聊天摘要及可下载的 XLSX 文件。当用户询问"预测我的现金流"、"我是否能按时发工资"、提及"runway"或表示"资金紧张"时使用。若未启用任何连接器，则回退至 CSV 文件上传。

description: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.
description_zh: 生成 Comment Sicko 的评论，修复已接受的发现，并为声明的约束条件提供编码。

description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.
description_zh: 通过 BGPT MCP 服务器检索科学论文，并从全文研究中提取结构化实验数据。每篇论文返回 25+ 个字段，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分和结论。用于文献综述、证据综合，以及查找仅凭摘要无法获得的实验细节。

description: Create and audit editable scientific posters in macro-free PowerPoint (.pptx) from author-approved local content and assets. Use when the requested deliverable is a PowerPoint research/conference poster and exact physical, printer, accessibility, provenance, and package-security checks are required.
description_zh: 基于作者审核通过的本地内容和资源，在不含宏的 PowerPoint (.pptx) 中创建并审核可编辑的科学海报。适用于需要交付 PowerPoint 学术/会议海报，且需进行精确物理、打印、可访问性、出处及打包安全校验的情形。

description: Retrieve DNA/RNA/protein sequences from NCBI and ENA with disambiguation. Quality hierarchy: RefSeq (NM_/NP_) > RefSeq predicted (XM_/XP_) > GenBank submissions. Use for fetching specific sequences by accession, gene-symbol-to-sequence lookup, transcript-isoform retrieval, and curated-vs-raw-submission preference.
description_zh:
从 NCBI 和 ENA 获取带有歧义消解功能的 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列。

质量层级：RefSeq（NM_/NP_） > RefSeq 预测序列（XM_/XP_） > GenBank 提交记录。

用于按 accession 获取特定序列、按基因符号查询序列、获取转录本异构体，以及根据已整理提交与原始提交之间的偏好进行获取。

description: Execute QA test plans on Holoscan Sensor Bridge hardware. Reads a user-provided test document, filters tests by the user's setup, determines which tests can run automatically, executes them with pass/fail evaluation, and produces a structured test results report.
description_zh: 在Holoscan传感器桥硬件上执行QA测试计划。读取用户提供的测试文档，根据用户设置筛选测试，确定哪些测试可以自动运行，以通过/失败评估方式执行这些测试，并生成结构化测试报告。

description: Plan accessibility testing — assistive technologies, participant criteria, WCAG coverage, and session protocol. Use when scheduling testing with real AT users. Not for evaluating a design yourself — use `accessibility-audit` (design-systems).
description_zh: 规划无障碍测试 —— 辅助技术、参与者标准、WCAG覆盖范围及会话流程。当与真实的辅助技术用户安排测试时使用。不用于自行评估设计——请使用 `accessibility-audit`（设计系统）。

description: Guide for MSBuild extensibility: CustomBefore/CustomAfter hooks, wildcard imports with alphabetic ordering, import gating with control properties, NuGet package build extension layout (build/buildTransitive), and the MicrosoftCommonPropsHasBeenImported guard. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing MSBuild import and hook patterns, reviewing and fixing extension point anti-patterns in Directory.Build files, fixing missing Exists() guards on imports that break fresh clones, fixing NuGet package hooks being silently dropped instead of appended, making build targets extensible for other projects, injecting custom logic into the build pipeline, creating NuGet packages that extend the build, conditionally disabling imports. DO NOT USE FOR: target authoring patterns (use target-authoring), props vs targets placement (use directory-build-organization), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh:
MSBuild 扩展性指南：CustomBefore/CustomAfter 钩子、按字母顺序排序的通配符导入、通过控制属性进行导入门控、NuGet 包构建扩展布局（build/buildTransitive），以及 `MicrosoftCommonPropsHasBeenImported` 守卫。

使用场景（USE FOR）：诊断并修复 MSBuild 导入与钩子模式；审查并修复 Directory.Build 文件中的扩展点反模式；修复导入缺失 Exists() 守卫导致全新克隆失败的问题；修复 NuGet 包钩子被静默丢弃而非追加的问题；使构建目标对其他项目可扩展；将自定义逻辑注入构建流水线；创建用于扩展构建的 NuGet 包；条件性禁用导入。

禁止使用（DO NOT USE FOR）：目标编写模式（使用 target-authoring）；props 与 targets 的放置位置（使用 directory-build-organization）；通用反模式（使用 msbuild-antipatterns）；非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: High-performance DataFrame library for Python ETL, analytics, and pandas migration. Use for expression-based data manipulation with lazy query optimization, parallel execution, streaming out-of-core processing, Arrow interoperability, and optional GPU execution.
description_zh: 高性能 Python ETL、分析与 pandas 迁移的 DataFrame 库。用于基于表达式的数据操作，支持惰性查询优化、并行执行、流式外存处理、Arrow 互操作性以及可选的 GPU 执行。

description: Design an A/B experiment — hypothesis, variants, primary metric, and sample size. Use when a change can be measured quantitatively at scale. For observing behaviour qualitatively, use `test-scenario`.
description_zh: 设计 A/B 实验——假设、变体、主要指标和样本量。当变更能够在大规模上以量化方式被衡量时使用。若要定性观察行为，使用 `test-scenario`。

description: Write rationale connecting decisions to user needs, business goals, and principles. Use when a decision needs defending in writing. For a live conversation, use `design-negotiation`.
description_zh: 撰写理由说明，将决策与用户需求、业务目标和原则相联系。当需要书面辩护决策时使用。对于实时对话，使用 `design-negotiation`。

description: Compare Replicate models by cost, speed, quality, and capabilities.
description_zh: 按成本、速度、质量与能力对比 Replicate 模型。

description: Frosted glass effect with translucent layers, subtle blur, and luminous borders for depth and modern elegance.
description_zh: 带有磨砂玻璃效果、半透明层次、柔和模糊与发光边框，以营造层次感与展现现代优雅。

description: MANDATORY prerequisite — load this skill BEFORE every `generate_diagram` tool call. NEVER call `generate_diagram` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user asks to create, generate, draw, render, sketch, or build a diagram — flowchart, architecture diagram, sequence diagram, ERD or entity-relationship diagram, state diagram or state machine, gantt chart, or timeline. Also trigger when the user mentions Mermaid syntax or wants a system architecture, decision tree, dependency graph, API call flow, auth handshake, schema, or pipeline visualized in FigJam. Routes to type-specific guidance, sets universal Mermaid constraints, and tells you when to use a different diagram type or skip the tool entirely (mindmaps, pie charts, class diagrams, etc.).
description_zh:
强制性前置条件——在每次调用 `generate_diagram` 工具之前，必须加载此技能。切勿在未先加载此技能的情况下直接调用 `generate_diagram`。

当用户要求创建、生成、绘制、渲染、草绘或构建图表时触发，包括流程图、架构图、时序图、ERD 或实体关系图、状态图或状态机、甘特图或时间轴；当用户提及 Mermaid 语法，或希望使用 FigJam 对系统架构、决策树、依赖图、API 调用流程、身份验证握手、模式或流程进行可视化时，也需触发。

该技能根据图表类型提供特定指引，设定通用的 Mermaid 约束，并告知何时应使用不同类型的图表或完全跳过该工具（如思维导图、饼图、类图等）。

description: Playbook for designing SaaS and startup products that convert, retain, and monetize — landing pages & CRO, checkout & forms, onboarding/activation, churn reduction, pricing psychology, dashboards, behavioral-science tactics, feature discipline, positioning/ICP, go-to-market, and AI-era differentiation. Use when advising on product design, UX, conversion, landing pages, checkout, onboarding, trials, pricing, retention/churn, growth, or positioning for a startup or SaaS. Distilled from product designer Richard (@richardrx). Not for use on gambling, betting, or casino products.
description_zh: 用于设计能够转化、留存并实现变现的SaaS及初创产品的方法指南——涵盖着陆页与转化优化（CRO）、结账与表单、引导与激活、流失率降低、定价心理学、仪表盘、行为科学策略、功能纪律、定位与目标客户群（ICP）、市场进入及AI时代差异化。适用于为初创公司或SaaS产品提供产品设计与用户体验（UX）、转化、着陆页、结账、引导、试用、定价、留存/流失、增长或定位方面的咨询指导。由产品设计师Richard（@richardrx）提炼而成。不得用于赌博、博彩或赌场产品。

description: Analyse open or closed card sort results into a proposed grouping and label set. Use after running a sort study. For turning that evidence into a full structure, use `information-architecture` (ux-strategy).
description_zh: 分析开放式或封闭式卡片排序结果，形成提议的分组和标签集。在运行排序研究后使用。要将该证据转化为完整结构，使用 `information-architecture` (ux-strategy)。

description: Benchmark CodeGraph retrieval quality on a real codebase by comparing agent behavior with vs without CodeGraph. Use when the user runs /agent-eval or asks to test, benchmark, audit, or validate a codegraph version (the local dev build or a published npm version) against a language's repo.
description_zh: 在实际代码库上，通过比较使用与未使用 CodeGraph 时智能体的行为，对 CodeGraph 的检索质量进行基准测试。适用于用户运行 /agent-eval 命令，或要求测试、基准测试、审计或验证某个 codegraph 版本（本地开发构建版本或已发布的 npm 版本）针对某语言代码仓库的场景。

description: Orchestrator skill for enabling CMDB (Configuration Management Database) end-to-end in Service Cloud ITSM against a production or sandbox org. Use when the user asks to set up CMDB, enable Configuration Management Database, configure the ITSM CMDB, onboard CMDB from scratch, wants a guided walkthrough of CMDB enablement, or asks what CMDB setup steps are available. Triggers on: set up CMDB, enable CMDB, configure CMDB, CMDB onboarding, Configuration Management Database setup, ITSM CMDB walkthrough. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user asks about a specific CMDB sub-step directly (e.g. only installing a bundle, only assigning permission sets), CMDB record CRUD (creating CIs, relationships), Discovery/Service Graph Connector configuration, or general ITSM queries without CMDB setup intent.
description_zh: 用于在生产环境或沙盒组织中对服务云ITSM启用CMDB（配置管理数据库）端到端的编排技能。适用于用户要求设置CMDB、启用配置管理数据库、配置ITSM CMDB、从零开始接入CMDB、需要CMDB启用引导式操作指南，或询问可用CMDB设置步骤时使用。触发条件包括：设置CMDB、启用CMDB、配置CMDB、CMDB接入、配置管理数据库设置、ITSM CMDB引导操作。请勿在以下情况下触发：用户直接询问具体的CMDB子步骤（例如仅安装包、仅分配权限集）、CMDB记录增删改查（创建配置项、关系），或发现/服务图连接配置，或无CMDB设置意图的一般ITSM查询。

description: Review current diff and leave comments using diffity agent commands
description_zh: 使用 diffity 代理命令查看当前差异并留下评论

description: Flash the FPGA on an HSB board connected to an NVIDIA devkit. Supports HSB Lattice boards (FPGA versions 2407, 2412, 2507, 2510) and Leopard Imaging VB1940 "all-in-one" cameras (FPGA versions 2507, 2510). Uses release-specific YAML manifests and board-type-specific program commands. Lattice and VB1940 commands must never be mixed.
description_zh: 烧录连接至NVIDIA开发套件的HSB板上的FPGA。支持HSB Lattice板（FPGA版本2407、2412、2507、2510）以及Leopard Imaging VB1940“一体化”相机（FPGA版本2507、2510）。使用特定发布的YAML清单和板卡类型特定的程序命令。Lattice与VB1940命令绝不能混用。

description: Cluster many qualitative data points into themes and insight statements. Use when synthesising across multiple sessions or sources. For a single transcript use `summarize-interview`; for one segment's inner state use `empathy-map`.
description_zh: 将大量定性数据点聚类为主题与洞察陈述。在跨多个会话或来源进行综合时使用。对于单条转录稿，使用 `summarize-interview`；对于某个片段的内心状态，使用 `empathy-map`。

description: Saleor e-commerce API patterns for building storefronts. Use when working with Saleor's GraphQL API, products, variants, checkout, channels, permissions, or debugging API behavior. Framework-agnostic — applies to any Saleor storefront.
description_zh: Saleor 电子商务 API 模式，用于构建店面。适用于使用 Saleor 的 GraphQL API、产品、变体、结账、渠道、权限，或调试 API 行为时。框架无关 ——适用于任何 Saleor 店面。

description: Track aircraft and vessels from public ADS-B and AIS broadcasts using ADS-B Exchange, Flightradar24, FlightAware, MarineTraffic, VesselFinder and Equasis. Use when following a tail number or flight, looking up an ICAO 24-bit hex code, registration or callsign, tracing a ship by IMO number or MMSI, checking a flag of convenience or port-call history, finding who owns a private jet or vessel, or analysing AIS gaps and dark-fleet behaviour. Applies to sanctions-evasion detection, trade and supply-chain compliance, asset tracing and recovery, and investigative journalism. Reference at useosint.com/skills/track-planes-and-ships.
description_zh: 使用 ADS-B Exchange、Flightradar24、FlightAware、MarineTraffic、VesselFinder 和 Equasis，从公开的 ADS-B 与 AIS 广播中追踪飞机和船舶。适用于追踪尾号或航班、查询 ICAO 24 位十六进制代码、注册号或呼号、通过 IMO 编号或 MMSI 追踪船舶、检查方便旗或港口靠泊历史、查找私人飞机或船舶的所有者，以及分析 AIS 盲区与隐秘船队行为等场景。适用于制裁规避检测、贸易与供应链合规、资产追踪与追回及调查性报道。参考：useosint.com/skills/track-planes-and-ships。

description: 抖音爆款文案智能生成器。当用户说"生成新文案"、"创作抖音内容"、"写短视频文案"时自动触发。自动执行：(1) 读取历史数据分析 (2) 应用9大爆款要素优化 (3) 多维度打分评估 (4) 自动迭代优化直到达到5星标准 (5) 智能预估播放量 (6) 输出完整优化文案。完全自动化，无需手动指定任何分析或优化任务。
description_zh: 抖音爆款文案智能生成器。当用户说"生成新文案"、"创作抖音内容"、"写短视频文案"时自动触发。自动执行：(1) 读取历史数据分析 (2) 应用9大爆款要素优化 (3) 多维度打分评估 (4) 自动迭代优化直到达到5星标准 (5) 智能预估播放量 (6) 输出完整优化文案。完全自动化，无需手动指定任何分析或优化任务。

description: Set up Playwright in a project. Use when user says "set up playwright", "add e2e tests", "configure playwright", "testing setup", "init playwright", or "add test infrastructure".
description_zh: 在项目中设置 Playwright。当用户说“设置 Playwright”、“添加 e2e 测试”、“配置 Playwright”、“测试设置”、“初始化 Playwright”或“添加测试基础设施”时使用。

description: Reference skill for Zoom Video SDK UI Toolkit. Use after routing to a web video workflow when you want prebuilt React UI instead of building a fully custom Video SDK interface.
description_zh: Zoom Video SDK UI Toolkit 参考技能。当需要预构建的 React UI 而非构建完全自定义的视频 SDK 界面时，在路由至 Web 视频工作流时使用。

description: MUST be used when migrating a legacy Dune app to the new Flows app hosting infrastructure. Orchestrates the full migration: audits current state, updates app.json to appsApi infra, delegates auth wiring to setup-flows-auth, creates or updates manifest.json network permissions, and updates deploy scripts to @cognite/cli. Use this whenever a user says 'migrate to Flows', 'migrate to new infra', 'move from dune to flows', 'migrate legacy app', or wants to move their existing app to the new Flows app hosting.
description_zh: 在将遗留 Dune 应用迁移至新的 Flows 应用托管基础设施时，必须使用。它负责协调完整的迁移流程：审计当前状态，将 app.json 更新为 appsApi 基础设施，将认证配置委托给 setup-flows-auth，创建或更新 manifest.json 的网络权限，并更新部署脚本以使用 @cognite/cli。每当用户提出"迁移至 Flows"、"迁移至新基础设施"、"从 Dune 迁移至 Flows"、"迁移遗留应用"，或希望将现有应用迁移至新的 Flows 应用托管时，请使用此功能。

description: Discover and run Holoscan Sensor Bridge example applications on a connected devkit. Filters available apps by the user's platform, HSB software version, board type, and sensors. Supports timed execution, failure analysis, code-edit suggestions, and iterative re-runs.
description_zh: 在已连接的开发套件上发现并运行 Holoscan Sensor Bridge 示例应用。应用可按用户平台、HSB 软件版本、开发板类型和传感器进行筛选。支持定时执行、故障分析、代码编辑建议及迭代重新运行。

description: Structure a pattern entry — problem context, solution, usage examples, and related patterns. Use when documenting a recurring solution rather than a component. For a single component's API, use `component-spec`.
description_zh: 构建模式条目，包含问题背景、解决方案、使用示例及相关模式。当记录重复性解决方案（而非组件）时使用。针对单一组件的 API，使用 `component-spec`。

description: Specialized skill for building production-ready Discord bots. Covers Discord.js (JavaScript) and Pycord (Python), gateway intents, slash commands, interactive components, rate limiting, and sharding.
description_zh: 构建生产就绪型 Discord 机器人的专业技能。涵盖 Discord.js（JavaScript）、Pycord（Python）、网关意图、斜杠命令、交互式组件、速率限制及分片。

description: Guides conversion of a pre-.NET 8 Blazor Server app into a .NET 8+ Blazor Web App. USE FOR: migrating apps that use AddServerSideBlazor and MapBlazorHub to the AddRazorComponents/MapRazorComponents model, converting _Host.cshtml to an App.razor root component, replacing blazor.server.js with blazor.web.js, migrating CascadingAuthenticationState to a service, adopting new Blazor Web App features like enhanced navigation and streaming rendering. DO NOT USE FOR: apps that are already Blazor Web Apps (already use AddRazorComponents and MapRazorComponents), Blazor WebAssembly or hosted Blazor WebAssembly apps (different migration path), apps that should stay on the Blazor Server hosting model without converting, or apps still targeting .NET Framework.
description_zh:
指南：将预 .NET 8 的 Blazor Server 应用转换为 .NET 8+ 的 Blazor Web App。

适用场景：
- 迁移使用 AddServerSideBlazor 和 MapBlazorHub 的应用，将其转换为 AddRazorComponents/MapRazorComponents 模型；
- 将 _Host.cshtml 转换为 App.razor 根组件；
- 将 blazor.server.js 替换为 blazor.web.js；
- 将 CascadingAuthenticationState 迁移到服务；
- 采用 Blazor Web App 的新特性，如增强的导航和流渲染。

不适用于：
- 已经是 Blazor Web App 的应用（已使用 AddRazorComponents 和 MapRazorComponents）；
- Blazor WebAssembly 或托管的 Blazor WebAssembly 应用（有不同迁移路径）；
- 应保持在 Blazor Server 托管模型且不转换的应用；
- 仍针对 .NET Framework 的应用。

description: Use this skill PROACTIVELY when the user indicates they are done working, ending the session, wrapping up, or saying goodbye. Also use when significant work has been completed and the user hasn't explicitly asked to continue. Analyzes the session to evolve skills/commands/agents and propagates useful project permissions to global settings.
description_zh: 当用户表示已完成工作、结束会话、收尾或表示告别时，积极使用此技能。此外，当重要工作已完成且用户未明确要求继续时，也应使用。分析会话以演进技能、命令和智能体，并将有用的项目权限传播至全局设置。

description: Set up Vitest testing in any project — detects type (Cloudflare Workers, React, Node, library), generates vitest.config.ts, test setup, utilities, and a sample test. Covers mocking patterns, coverage config, workspace setup, Jest migration. Use whenever the user mentions adding tests, setting up Vitest, configuring tests, migrating from Jest, fixing testing infrastructure, or asks 'how do I test this'.
description_zh: 在任何项目中配置 Vitest 测试 — 自动检测项目类型（Cloudflare Workers、React、Node、库），生成 vitest.config.ts、测试配置、工具函数及示例测试。涵盖 Mock 模式、覆盖率配置、工作区设置与 Jest 迁移。当用户提及添加测试、设置 Vitest、配置测试、从 Jest 迁移、修复测试基础设施，或询问“我该如何测试这个”时使用。

description: Design a diary study — prompts, cadence, duration, participant criteria, and analysis frame. Use when behaviour unfolds over days or weeks. For a single-session study, use `usability-test-plan`.
description_zh: 设计日记研究 —— 提示、频率、时长、参与者标准和分析框架。当行为在数天或数周内展开时使用。对于单次会话的研究，使用 `usability-test-plan`。

description: Diagnoses and improves Qdrant search relevance. Use when someone reports 'search results are bad', 'wrong results', 'low precision', 'low recall', 'irrelevant matches', 'missing expected results', or asks 'how to improve search quality?', 'which embedding model?', 'should I use hybrid search?', 'how to combine keyword and vector search / fusion / RRF / prefetch?', 'should I use reranking?', 'relevance feedback?', 'how to measure retrieval quality?', 'build a golden set', 'ground truth dataset', or 'how to score recall@k?'. Also use when search quality degrades after quantization, model change, or data growth.
description_zh: 诊断并提升Qdrant搜索相关性。当用户报告“搜索结果不佳”、“错误结果”、“精度低”、“召回率低”、“匹配不相关”、“缺失预期结果”，或询问“如何提升搜索质量？”、“使用哪个嵌入模型？”、“是否应该采用混合搜索？”、“如何结合关键词与向量搜索、融合、RRF、预取？”、“是否应该使用重排序（reranking）？”、“相关性反馈？”、“如何衡量检索质量？”、“如何构建黄金数据集”、“ground truth数据集”，或“如何计算recall@k？”时，适用本功能。同时，当搜索质量在量化、模型变更或数据增长后下降时，也应使用。

description: Write a structured interview guide — warm-up, core exploration, and wrap-up. Use before running interviews. For analysing what comes back, use `summarize-interview`.
description_zh: 撰写一份结构化的访谈指南——热身、核心探讨和收尾。在开展访谈前使用。用于分析访谈返回的内容时，使用 `summarize-interview`。

description: Use when the user asks for baseball trend or a task matching the examples below. Viral fake "ESPN behind-home-plate broadcast cutaway" of a user — broadcast-style still + 15s Kling-omni clip with native two-announcer commentary that names the user. Fixed trend: Yankees vs Red Sox ALCS Game 3 at Fenway Park, premium seats, scorebug + chyron with the user's name. Triggers: "make me a behind-home-plate cutaway", "fake MLB broadcast of me", "AI ESPN baseball crowd shot", "viral MLB broadcast trend", "Yankees Red Sox cutaway with me". Needs the user's name + one reference photo.
description_zh:
当用户请求棒球趋势或符合以下示例的任务时使用。
用户版病毒式仿制“ESPN 本垒板后广播剪辑”内容——播报风格静态图 + 15秒 Kling-omni 剪辑，附带原生两位解说员评论并提及用户姓名。
固定趋势：洋基队对红袜队美联职业比赛第三场（ALCS Game 3）芬威球场，高级座位，分数提示器（scorebug）和标识（chyron）显示用户姓名。
触发条件：“制作本垒板后剪辑”，“仿制 MLB 广播我”，“AI ESPN 棒球观众画面”，“病毒式 MLB 广播趋势”，“洋基红袜本垒板后剪辑含我”。
需要用户姓名 + 一张参考照片。

description: Help users develop product taste and intuition. Use when someone wants to improve their product judgment, struggles to evaluate design quality, needs to make decisions without complete data, or wants to build better product instincts.
description_zh: 帮助用户培养产品品味与直觉。适用于希望提升产品判断力、难以评估设计质量、需要在缺乏完整数据的情况下做决策，或希望构建更佳产品直觉的用户。

description: Help users decide when and how to pivot their startup. Use when someone is questioning their current direction, seeing poor traction, considering a major strategy change, or stuck in the pre-PMF stage.
description_zh: 帮助用户决定何时以及如何转型其创业公司。适用于有人质疑当前方向、增长乏力、考虑重大战略调整，或卡在产品市场契合度（PMF）前的阶段时。

description: MUST be used when adding AI, Atlas, an agent, a chat UI, or LLM features to a Flows/Fusion app. Use the Atlas/EOS sidebar via @cognite/app-sdk — not useAtlasChat, vendored atlas-agent, or per-row chat completions. Triggers: atlas, EOS, PAIA, agent chat, chat UI, sendAgentMessage, sendAgentLayoutMode, registerAgentServer, connectToHostApp, useAtlasChat, LLM. In-app chat: integrate-atlas-chat only if the host sidebar cannot work.
description_zh: 必须用于在 Flows/Fusion 应用中添加 AI、Atlas、智能体、聊天界面或 LLM 功能时。通过 @cognite/app-sdk 使用 Atlas/EOS 侧边栏——不要使用 useAtlasChat、vendored atlas-agent 或按行聊天补全。触发器：atlas, EOS, PAIA, agent chat, chat UI, sendAgentMessage, sendAgentLayoutMode, registerAgentServer, connectToHostApp, useAtlasChat, LLM。应用内聊天：仅在宿主侧边栏无法工作的情况下集成 integrate-atlas-chat。

description: [DEPRECATED] Use `create-video` for prompt-based video generation or `avatar-video` for precise avatar/scene control. This legacy skill combines both workflows — the newer focused skills provide clearer guidance.
description_zh: [已弃用] 请使用 `create-video` 进行基于提示的视频生成，或 `avatar-video` 进行精准的人像/场景控制。此旧版技能结合了这两种工作流程——更新的专注型技能可提供更清晰的指导。

description: Detect crowded speculative positioning in CFTC futures markets (COT report analysis) to find contrarian setups using Jason Shapiro's methodology. Screens large-speculator ("non-commercial") net positioning across 65 futures markets (indices, rates, FX, metals, energy, crypto) via the FMP Commitment of Traders API, computes a 3-year and 26-week COT Index per market, and classifies extremes as CROWDED_LONG / CROWDED_SHORT. Use when the user asks about COT report analysis, crowded positioning, "who is trapped", speculative positioning extremes, contrarian futures setups, or wants to run Jason Shapiro-style analysis. This skill automates crowding DETECTION only (step 1 of 5) — it does not generate trade signals by itself.
description_zh: 使用Jason Shapiro的方法论，检测美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）期货市场中的拥挤投机持仓（基于COT报告分析），以寻找逆向交易策略。通过FMP持仓交易者API，筛选65个期货市场（指数、利率、外汇、金属、能源、加密货币）中大型投机者（“非商业”）的净持仓；计算每个市场的3年和26周COT指数，并将极端持仓分类为CROWDED_LONG / CROWDED_SHORT。当用户询问COT报告分析、拥挤持仓、“谁被套牢”、投机持仓极端、逆向期货设置，或想要运行Jason Shapiro风格的这类分析时使用本技能。本技能仅自动执行拥挤度检测（5个步骤中的第一步）——它本身不会生成交易信号。

description: Laravel + Inertia.js + React integration patterns. Use when building Inertia page components, handling forms with useForm, managing shared data, or implementing persistent layouts. Triggers on tasks involving Inertia.js, page props, form handling, or Laravel React integration.
description_zh: Laravel + Inertia.js + React 集成模式。当构建 Inertia 页面组件、使用 useForm 处理表单、管理共享数据或实现持久化布局时使用。在涉及 Inertia.js、页面属性、表单处理或 Laravel React 集成等任务时触发。

description: Build and scale partner ecosystems that drive revenue and platform adoption. Use when building partner programs from scratch, tiering partnerships, managing co-marketing, making build-vs-partner decisions, or structuring crawl-walk-run partner deployment.
description_zh: 构建并扩展推动收入增长与平台采用的合作伙伴生态系统。适用于从零开始构建合作伙伴项目、合作伙伴分层管理、联合营销管理、做出构建与合作伙伴的决策，或结构化规划爬-走-跑合作伙伴部署等场景。

description: 한국도로공사·국가교통정보센터 공개 API로 고속도로 실시간 소통(구간별 속도/교통량/정체 등급)과 CCTV 스트림 메타데이터를 조회한다. Use when the user asks 고속도로 정체, 교통 상황, 노선/구간 소통, 고속도로 CCTV. Not for 대중교통 길찾기 or 자동차 경로 안내.
description_zh:
通过韩国道路公团·国家交通信息中心公开API，查询高速公路实时交通信息（区间/路段车速、交通量、拥堵等级）及CCTV监控画面元数据。
当用户询问高速公路拥堵、交通状况、线路/路段交通信息、高速公路CCTV时使用。不适用于大众交通路线查找或汽车行程导航。

description: Define UX metrics and KPIs that connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. Use when choosing what to measure. For presenting the results afterwards, use `design-impact-reporting` (design-ops).
description_zh: 定义连接设计决策与可衡量结果的 UX 指标和 KPI。在选择测量内容时使用。用于后续呈现结果时，使用 `design-impact-reporting`（design-ops）。

description: Help users conduct effective hiring interviews. Use when someone is designing an interview loop, crafting interview questions, evaluating candidates in real-time, or building a structured interview process.
description_zh: 帮助用户进行有效的招聘面试。适用于设计面试流程、编写面试问题、实时评估候选人或构建结构化面试流程时。

description: Help users define their North Star metric. Use when someone is choosing their primary success metric, trying to align the team around a key measure, struggling with metric proliferation, or setting up their measurement strategy.
description_zh: 帮助用户定义北极星指标。当用户选择主要成功指标、围绕关键指标对齐团队、应对指标泛滥问题，或制定度量策略时使用。

description: Analyze test coverage gaps. Use when user says "test coverage", "what's not tested", "coverage gaps", "missing tests", "coverage report", or "what needs testing".
description_zh: 分析测试覆盖差距。适用于用户提到“测试覆盖”、“未测试的内容”、“覆盖差距”、“缺失的测试”、“覆盖报告”或“需要测试的内容”。

description: Generate test report. Use when user says "test report", "results summary", "test status", "show results", "test dashboard", or "how did tests go".
description_zh: 生成测试报告。当用户说“test report”、“results summary”、“test status”、“show results”、“test dashboard”或“how did tests go”时使用。

description:
Produce an intensive, cited analytical report: executive summary, multi-angle
findings, contrarian views, open questions, and full sources. Use only when the
user needs rigorous synthesis of a complex topic (scientific, technical, policy,
or market-analytical) that cannot be answered with a short search, and wants
a formal written report, not a recommendation list.

Do not use for product picks, top-N lists, quick lookups, or routine "find out
about X" tasks. If the request does not clearly need this kind of report, do
not use this skill.

Do not use for a literature review over published papers. This skill collects
evidence from the open web. A request for the literature on a biomedical,
clinical, life-science, or other scientific topic — papers, studies, trials,
preprints — belongs to firecrawl-research-papers, which queries Firecrawl's
paper index (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv) instead of searching websites.
description_zh:
产出一份深入、有引用的分析报告：执行摘要、多角度发现、逆向观点、开放问题以及完整资料来源。仅在用户需要复杂主题（科学、技术、政策或市场分析）的严谨综合时使用，这类复杂主题无法通过简短搜索回答，且用户需要正式的书面报告，而非建议清单。

不得用于产品推荐、top-N 列表、快速查询，或常规“了解 X”类任务。如果请求并未明确需要此类报告，不要使用本技能。

不得用于对已发表论文的文献综述。本技能从公开网络收集证据。关于生物医学、临床、生命科学或其他科学主题的文献检索请求——论文、研究、试验、预印本——归属于 firecrawl-research-papers，该技能会查询 Firecrawl 的论文索引（PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv、arXiv），而非搜索网站。

description: Enable the CMDB (Configuration Management Database) feature in Service Cloud ITSM against a production or sandbox org: verify the CMDB org SKU, provision the CMDB tenant, and enable the service-cloud-itsm-cmdb-integration feature that lifts the CMDB access gate. Use when the user asks to enable CMDB, turn on the Configuration Management Database, provision the CMDB tenant, enable the CMDB feature, or fix a CMDB 403 FUNCTIONALITY_NOT_ENABLED error. Triggers on: enable CMDB feature, provision CMDB tenant, turn on CMDB, CMDB not enabled, CMDB 403 error, service-cloud-itsm-cmdb-integration. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user only wants to assign CMDB permission sets to users, only install a CMDB content bundle, or work with CMDB records directly.
description_zh:
在 Service Cloud ITSM 中，针对生产或沙盒组织启用 CMDB（配置管理数据库）功能：验证 CMDB 组织 SKU，配置 CMDB 租户，并启用 service-cloud-itsm-cmdb-integration 功能，以解除 CMDB 访问限制。

当用户要求启用 CMDB、开启配置管理数据库、配置 CMDB 租户、启用 CMDB 功能或修复 CMDB 403 FUNCTIONALITY_NOT_ENABLED 错误时使用。

触发条件：启用 CMDB 功能、配置 CMDB 租户、开启 CMDB、CMDB 未启用、CMDB 403 错误、service-cloud-itsm-cmdb-integration。

当用户仅要求将 CMDB 权限集分配给用户、仅安装 CMDB 内容包，或直接处理 CMDB 记录时，请勿触发。

description: 数学建模竞赛最终验证和验收阶段，支持 Typst 和 LaTeX 双引擎。用于论文写完后检查章节数量、标题顺序、图表引用、数值一致性、占位符、内部文件泄露、参考文献、代码可复现性、编译和提交就绪状态。
description_zh: 数学建模竞赛的最终验证与验收阶段，支持 Typst 和 LaTeX 双引擎。用于论文撰写完成后检查章节数量、标题顺序、图表引用、数值一致性、占位符、内部文件泄露、参考文献、代码可复现性、编译及提交就绪状态。

description: Create professional research posters in LaTeX using beamerposter, tikzposter, or baposter. Support for conference presentations, academic posters, and scientific communication. Includes layout design, color schemes, multi-column formats, figure integration, and poster-specific best practices for visual communication.
description_zh: 使用 beamerposter、tikzposter 或 baposter 在 LaTeX 中制作专业的科研海报。支持会议演示、学术海报及科学传播。内容涵盖版式设计、配色方案、多栏格式、图表集成，以及视觉传达方面的海报专属最佳实践。

description: Judge whether a market FAILED to react to news favorable to a crowded speculative position — step 2 of Jason Shapiro's COT contrarian process. Consumes a cot-contrarian-detector report (or an explicit direction) plus a Claude-curated events JSON, fetches the underlying price series with a documented fallback chain, and produces a fail-closed CONFIRMED / NOT_CONFIRMED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict using a statistically validated drift-significance test (not a naive failure-ratio, which false-confirms on pure noise). Generic beyond COT — reusable for PEAD and macro-crowding news-failure checks. Use when the user asks to check news-failure confirmation, whether a crowded market "shrugged off" good/bad news, or wants to run Shapiro step 2 on a CROWDED_LONG/CROWDED_SHORT market.
description_zh: 判断市场是否未能对有利于拥挤投机头寸的新闻作出反应——这是Jason Shapiro的COT逆向流程的第二步。其接收一份COT逆向检测报告（或明确的指令）及一份由Claude整理的事件JSON，通过文档化回退链获取底层价格序列，并使用经统计验证的漂移显著性检验，产出fail-closed的 CONFIRMED / NOT_CONFIRMED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE 判定结果（而非朴素的失败率，后者在纯噪声中会导致误确认）。该功能超越COT，可复用于PEAD及宏观拥挤度新闻失败检查。当用户要求检查新闻失败确认情况、判断拥挤市场是否对利好/利空新闻“视而不见”，或希望对拥挤多头（CROWDED_LONG）/拥挤空头（CROWDED_SHORT）市场运行Shapiro第二步时使用。

description: State-of-the-art text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion models via HuggingFace Diffusers. Use when generating images from text prompts, performing image-to-image translation, inpainting, or building custom diffusion pipelines.
description_zh: 通过 HuggingFace Diffusers 使用 Stable Diffusion 模型，实现最先进的文本到图像生成。适用于从文本提示生成图像、进行图像到图像翻译、图像修补或构建自定义扩散流水线。

description: Grant a specific user access to CMDB (Configuration Management Database) data in Service Cloud ITSM against a production or sandbox org by assigning the license-backed CMDB permission sets (Configuration Item Reader, Owner, Type Reader, Type Manager) and their permission-set licenses. Use when the user asks to give someone CMDB access, assign CMDB permission sets, grant a user the Configuration Item Reader/Owner role, or fix a CMDB 403 FUNCTIONALITY_NOT_ENABLED that a user still hits after the CMDB feature is already enabled. Triggers on: assign CMDB permission set, grant CMDB access, give user Configuration Item access, CMDB access for user, user still gets CMDB 403 after enable. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user wants to turn on the CMDB feature or provision the CMDB tenant for the whole org (that is the CMDB feature-enable skill), only install a CMDB content bundle, work with CMDB records directly, or assign general (non-CMDB) permission sets to users (use dx-org-permission-set-assign).
description_zh:
为特定用户授权访问 Service Cloud ITSM 中生产环境或沙箱组织内的 CMDB（Configuration Management Database，配置管理数据库）数据，需通过分配基于许可的 CMDB 权限集（配置项阅读器、所有者、类型阅读器、类型管理器）及其权限集许可证来实现。

适用于用户要求为他人提供 CMDB 访问权限、分配 CMDB 权限集、授予用户配置项阅读器/所有者角色，或修复用户在使用 CMDB 功能已启用后仍遇到的 CMDB 403 FUNCTIONALITY_NOT_ENABLED（功能未启用）错误的情况。

触发条件：分配 CMDB 权限集、授予 CMDB 访问权限、为用户提供配置项访问权限、用户获得 CMDB 访问权限、用户启用后仍获取到 CMDB 403。

不触发条件：用户需要启用 CMDB 功能或为整个组织配置 CMDB 租户（即 CMDB 功能启用技能），仅安装 CMDB 内容包，直接处理 CMDB 记录，或将一般（非 CMDB）权限集分配给用户（请使用 dx-org-permission-set-assign）。

description: Board meeting preparation, investor updates, and executive communication. Use when preparing board decks, writing investor updates, handling bad news with the board, structuring QBRs, or building board-level metric discipline. Includes the "Three Things" narrative model, the 4-tier metric hierarchy, and the pre-brief pattern that prevents board surprises.
description_zh: 董事会会议筹备、投资者动态与高管沟通。适用于筹备董事会汇报材料、撰写投资者更新、与董事会沟通负面信息、规划季度业务回顾（QBR）结构，以及构建董事会层面的指标管控。涵盖“三件事”叙事模型、四级指标层级，以及防止董事会出现意外的预简报模式。

description: Use when the user asks for kiss cam or a task matching the examples below. Generate a viral fake "in-arena Kiss Cam moment" of any two subjects — a fan-filmed phone shot of the MSG Jumbotron with retro Kiss Cam graphic + scoreboard, plus a 15s Kling v3-omni clip with PA-announcer commentary and crowd reaction. Any subject styles (human, 3D toy, illustrated avatar). No names. Triggers: "make me a kiss cam moment", "kiss cam version of these two", "Jumbotron kiss cam trend", "fake NBA kiss cam". Requires the pika MCP.
description_zh: 当用户要求生成 kiss cam 或符合以下示例的任务时使用。生成任意两位参与者的病毒式虚假“场内 kiss cam 瞬间”——一段粉丝用手机拍摄的 [MSG] Jumbotron（巨型显示屏）画面，搭配复古 kiss cam 图形与记分牌，以及一段包含主持人（PA）解说与观众反应的 15 秒 Kling v3-omni 片段。参与者风格不限（人类、3D 玩具、插画化身）。不含人物姓名。触发词：“为我制作一个 kiss cam 瞬间”、“这些人的 kiss cam 版本”、“Jumbotron kiss cam 趋势”、“虚假 NBA kiss cam”。需要 pika MCP。

description: Enable and configure Moltbot/Clawdbot memory search for persistent context. Use when setting up memory, fixing "goldfish brain," or helping users configure memorySearch in their config. Covers MEMORY.md, daily logs, and vector search setup.
description_zh: 启用并配置 Moltbot/Clawdbot 的持久上下文记忆搜索。适用于设置记忆、修复“金鱼脑”或帮助用户在其配置中配置 memorySearch。涵盖 MEMORY.md、每日日志和向量搜索设置。

description: Configure LoRA and QLoRA supervised fine-tuning with current best-practice hyperparameters. Use when writing or reviewing a LoRA/QLoRA training configuration, choosing rank/alpha/target modules, or deciding between LoRA, QLoRA, and full fine-tuning.
description_zh: 使用当前最佳实践的超参数配置 LoRA 与 QLoRA 的监督微调。在编写或审查 LoRA/QLoRA 训练配置、选择 rank/alpha/目标模块，或决定采用 LoRA、QLoRA 还是全量微调时使用。

description: Generate professional PowerPoint pitch decks for startups and businesses. Use this skill when users request help creating investor pitch decks, sales presentations, or business pitch presentations. The skill follows standard 10-slide pitch deck structure and includes best practices for content and design.
description_zh: 生成面向初创企业和商业企业的专业PowerPoint路演演示文稿。当用户请求帮助创建投资者路演演示文稿、销售演示文稿或商业路演演示文稿时，请使用此技能。该技能遵循标准的10页路演演示文稿结构，并包含内容与设计的最佳实践。

description: Grade specified test methods individually and produce a concise PR-ready table with each fully qualified test name, an A-F grade, score band, and one-line note. USE FOR per-test feedback on a curated list such as new or modified tests in a pull request, not a suite-wide audit. Polyglot: .NET, Python, TS/JS, Java, Go, Ruby, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, PowerShell, C++. Inputs may be test methods, method bodies, or file-and-line spans. DO NOT USE FOR: full suite audits (use test-quality-auditor agent or test-anti-patterns), writing new tests (use code-testing-generator agent or writing-mstest-tests), fixing failures, or measuring code coverage.
description_zh:
为指定的测试方法逐一评分，并生成一份简洁、可直接用于 PR 的表格，表格中包含每个完全限定测试名称、A-F 评级、分数区间和一句说明。

适用场景：针对一份精选列表（例如 Pull Request（PR）中的新增或修改的测试）进行逐测试反馈，而非对整个测试套件的全面审计。

多语言支持：.NET、Python、TS/JS、Java、Go、Ruby、Rust、Swift、Kotlin、PowerShell、C++。

输入可以是测试方法、方法体或文件与行号跨度。

禁止用于：全测试套件审计（请使用 test-quality-auditor agent 或 test-anti-patterns），编写新测试（请使用 code-testing-generator agent 或 writing-mstest-tests），修复失败，或测量代码覆盖率。

description: Articulate a long-horizon product vision that aligns teams and anchors strategy. Use when direction is contested or absent. For near-term project scope, use `design-brief`.
description_zh: 阐述具有长远视角的产品愿景，以统一团队并锚定战略。在方向存在争议或缺失时使用。针对近期项目范围，使用 `design-brief`。

description: Build alignment artifacts — responsibility matrices, decision rights, and communication plans. Use when unclear ownership stalls decisions. For persuading in the moment, use `design-negotiation` (designer-toolkit).
description_zh: 构建对齐产物——包括职责矩阵、决策权与沟通计划。当所有权不明确导致决策停滞时使用。用于即时说服时，使用 `design-negotiation`（设计工具包）。

description: Calculate contract-based futures position sizes from a direction, entry, and stop-loss, using verified per-symbol contract specs (multiplier, tick size, tick value). Use when the user asks how many futures contracts to trade, wants to size a futures position (ES, NQ, ZB, GC, CL, 6E/E6, VX, BT, ...), or is handing off a contrarian-setup-gate READY_FOR_PLAN direction/invalidation_level for sizing. Pure, offline calculation -- no API keys, no network.
description_zh: 依据方向、入场点与止损，利用已验证的单品种合约规格（乘数、最小变动价位、最小变动价值），计算基于合约的期货头寸规模。适用于以下场景：用户询问需交易多少期货合约、需要为期货头寸（ES、NQ、ZB、GC、CL、6E/E6、VX、BT……）进行仓位规模测算，或将反向建仓闸门的 READY_FOR_PLAN 方向/无效化级别移交用于仓位测算。纯离线计算——无需 API 密钥，无需联网。

description: Deploy (install) the CMDB Foundation base content bundle in Service Cloud ITSM against a production or sandbox org, after the CMDB feature is enabled. Use when the user asks to install the CMDB bundle, deploy CMDB Foundation, set up the CMDB base content, install CMDB out-of-the-box content, or finish CMDB setup with the base bundle. Triggers on: install CMDB bundle, deploy CMDB Foundation, CMDB base content, CMDB content bundle, bundleInstallation, finish CMDB setup. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user wants to enable the CMDB feature for the org (that is the CMDB feature-enable skill), assign CMDB permission sets to a user (that is the CMDB access-assign skill), install optional non-base add-on bundles, deploy general (non-CMDB) metadata or packages, or work with CMDB records directly.
description_zh:
在CMDB功能已启用后，针对生产环境或沙盒组织，于Service Cloud ITSM中部署（安装）CMDB基础内容包。当用户要求安装CMDB包、部署CMDB基础架构、设置CMDB基础内容、安装CMDB开箱即用内容，或使用基础包完成CMDB设置时使用。

触发条件：安装CMDB包、部署CMDB基础架构、CMDB基础内容、CMDB内容包、bundleInstallation、完成CMDB设置。

不应触发：用户希望对组织启用CMDB功能（即CMDB功能启用技能）、将CMDB权限组分配给用户（即CMDB访问分配技能）、安装可选的非基础附加包、部署通用（非CMDB）元数据或包，或直接处理CMDB记录。

description: Enable CMDB Asset Discovery in Service Cloud ITSM against a production or sandbox org by turning on the service-cloud-itsm-discovery-integration feature, then grant a user the Discovery page by assigning the IT Service Discovery Manager permission set and its license — the final CMDB setup layer, run after the CMDB feature, user access, and content bundle are in place. Use when the user asks to enable CMDB discovery, turn on asset discovery, enable service-cloud-itsm-discovery-integration, grant Discovery page access, or assign the Discovery Manager permission set. Triggers on: enable CMDB discovery, turn on asset discovery, service-cloud-itsm-discovery-integration, assign Discovery Manager access, CMDB discovery not enabled. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user wants to enable the base CMDB feature, provision the CMDB tenant, assign the four CMDB Configuration-Item permission sets, install a CMDB content bundle, or work with CMDB records directly — those are earlier CMDB layers.
description_zh: 在 Service Cloud ITSM 的生产或沙盒组织上，通过启用 service-cloud-itsm-discovery-integration 功能来启用 CMDB 资产发现，然后分配 IT Service Discovery Manager 权限集及其许可给用户，以授予用户 Discovery 页面访问权限——这是最终的 CMDB 设置层，在 CMDB 功能、用户访问和内容包就绪后运行。当用户请求启用 CMDB 发现、开启资产发现、启用 service-cloud-itsm-discovery-integration、授予 Discovery 页面访问权限或分配 Discovery Manager 权限集时使用。触发条件：启用 CMDB 发现、开启资产发现、启用 service-cloud-itsm-discovery-integration、分配 Discovery Manager 访问权限、CMDB 发现未启用。不要触发的情况：当用户想要启用基础 CMDB 功能、配置 CMDB 租户、分配四个 CMDB Configuration-Item 权限集、安装 CMDB 内容包或直接处理 CMDB 记录时，不予触发——这些是更早的 CMDB 层级。

description: Make every number in the final PDF traceable to the exact code line that produced it. Uses \hypertarget/\hyperlink LaTeX commands and \num{formula} evaluated at compile time. Use for reproducibility and data integrity verification.
description_zh: 使最终 PDF 中的每一个数字都能追溯到生成它的确切代码行。使用 \hypertarget/\hyperlink LaTeX 命令以及编译时求值的 \num{formula}。用于可重复性和数据完整性验证。

description: Rebuild slide images, scanned or image-based PPT/PPTX files, and PDF decks into object-level editable PowerPoint (.pptx), preserving speaker notes when supplied. Use for making visual slides editable or reconstructing slides from screenshots; not for authoring new presentations from scratch.
description_zh: 将幻灯片图像、扫描或基于图像的 PPT/PPTX 文件以及 PDF 演示文稿，重建为支持对象级编辑的 PowerPoint（.pptx）格式；当提供时保留演讲者备注。可用于将可视化幻灯片转换为可编辑状态，或从截图重建幻灯片；不适用于从零开始创建新演示文稿。

description: Establish review gates — criteria, checkpoints, and approval flow. Use when work ships without consistent review. For running one individual session, use `design-critique`.
description_zh: 建立审查关卡——标准、检查点和审批流程。当工作未进行一致审查时使用。进行单次单独会话时，使用 `design-critique`。

description: Decide whether to fine-tune at all, and route to the right method (SFT, DPO/ORPO/KTO, GRPO/RLVR, continued pretraining) and base model. Use when starting any fine-tuning effort, when unsure whether RAG or prompting would suffice, or when choosing between preference-optimization and reinforcement methods.
description_zh: 决定是否需要进行微调，并选择正确的方案（SFT、DPO/ORPO/KTO、GRPO/RLVR、持续预训练）及基座模型。适用于启动任何微调工作、不确定 RAG 或提示工程是否足够，或需要在偏好优化与强化学习方法之间进行选择时。

description: Canonical patterns for writing custom MSBuild targets. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing custom target authoring anti-patterns; broken SDK target chains across files (e.g., Directory.Build.targets silently redefining SDK targets); targets that replace CompileDependsOn instead of extending it with $(CompileDependsOn); query targets returning stale results from Outputs vs Returns misuse; missing Inputs/Outputs causing unnecessary rebuilds; missing FileWrites registration. Covers DependsOnTargets vs BeforeTargets vs AfterTargets, the Build→CoreBuild three-level pattern, and the $(XxxDependsOn) chain-extension pattern. DO NOT USE FOR: incremental build tuning (use incremental-build), parallelization (use build-parallelism), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: MSBuild自定义目标编写规范模式。用途：诊断和修复自定义目标编写反模式；跨文件损坏的SDK目标链（例如，Directory.Build.targets 静默重新定义SDK目标）；替换CompileDependsOn而非通过$(CompileDependsOn)扩展编译目标依赖的目标；查询目标因错误使用Outputs与Returns而返回过期结果；缺少Inputs/Outputs导致不必要的重新构建；缺少FileWrites注册。涵盖DependsOnTargets与BeforeTargets与AfterTargets的区别、Build→CoreBuild三层模式，以及$(XxxDependsOn)链扩展模式。不适用于：增量构建调优（使用incremental-build）、并行化（使用build-parallelism）、通用反模式（使用msbuild-antipatterns）以及非MSBuild构建系统。

description: Review WooCommerce code changes for coding standards compliance. Use when reviewing code locally, performing automated PR reviews, or checking code quality.
description_zh: 审查 WooCommerce 代码变更是否符合编码标准。适用于本地代码审查、执行自动化 PR 审查或检查代码质量。

description: Use when adding Auth0 login, logout, protected pages, or middleware to a Next.js application. Supports App Router and Pages Router with @auth0/nextjs-auth0 — use even if the user says "add login to my Next.js app" or "protect my Next.js routes".
description_zh: 在向 Next.js 应用添加 Auth0 登录、登出、受保护页面或中间件时使用。支持基于 @auth0/nextjs-auth0 使用 App Router 和 Pages Router——即使用户表示“为我的 Next.js 应用添加登录”或“保护我的 Next.js 路由”，也应使用。

description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, write, or draft a newsletter, email digest, weekly roundup, industry briefing, or curated content summary. Supports topic-based research, content curation from multiple sources, and professional formatting for email or web distribution. Trigger on requests like "create a newsletter about X", "write a weekly digest", "generate a tech roundup", or "curate news about Y".
description_zh: 当用户使用本技能时，适用于用户请求生成、创建、撰写或起草新闻简报、邮件摘要、每周综述、行业简报或精选内容摘要的场景。该技能支持基于主题的研究、从多个来源进行内容策展，以及为邮件或网络分发提供专业排版。当出现“创建关于X的新闻简报”“撰写每周摘要”“生成科技综述”或“策展Y相关新闻”等请求时触发。

description: Vet ClawHub skills before installation. Use when the user asks about evaluating, auditing, or safely installing OpenClaw/ClawHub skills, or when a skill’s trustworthiness is in question.
description_zh: 在安装 ClawHub 技能前，请审查该技能。当用户询问评估、审计或安全安装 OpenClaw/ClawHub 技能，或当技能的可信度受到质疑时使用。

description: Autonomous white-box AI pentester for web applications and APIs using source code analysis and live exploit execution
description_zh: 针对网页应用与API的自主白盒AI渗透测试工具，基于源代码分析与实时漏洞利用执行

description: Monitor competitor pricing, features, changelogs, dashboards, and product changes with Firecrawl. Use for recurring competitive intelligence, pricing tier extraction, feature change tracking, or structured competitor alerts.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 监控竞争对手的定价、功能、更新日志、仪表盘和产品变更。用于定期竞争情报、定价层级提取、功能变更跟踪或结构化竞争对手预警。

description: Read open review comments and resolve them by making code fixes
description_zh: 读取待处理的评审评论，并通过代码修复予以解决。

description: Fix failing or flaky Playwright tests. Use when user says "fix test", "flaky test", "test failing", "debug test", "test broken", "test passes sometimes", or "intermittent failure".
description_zh: 修复失败的或不稳定的 Playwright 测试。当用户说“修复测试”、“不稳定测试”、“测试失败”、“调试测试”、“测试故障”、“测试有时通过”或“间歇性失败”时使用。

description: Configures the Incident Priority Matrix for Salesforce ITSM through the sf CLI — enabling or disabling the matrix, shaping the Impact x Urgency grid that derives Priority on Incident records, toggling the manual-override preference, and reading or setting the default fallback priority. Reads every value before writing, is idempotent, and requires explicit user confirmation before any mutation. Use when the user wants to view, enable, disable, set up, seed, add to, change, or remove priority matrix configuration for Incident records, change the default incident priority, or asks about incident priority setup, impact/urgency mapping, override, or the ITSM incident priority matrix. DO NOT TRIGGER for Problem or ChangeRequest priority matrices, Case priority fields, standard Priority picklists outside ITSM, SLA or milestone configuration, or enabling Incident Management itself (use the service-itsm-incident-mgmt-configure skill).
description_zh:
通过 sf CLI 为 Salesforce ITSM 配置事件优先级矩阵——启用或禁用该矩阵，设置从事件记录派生优先级的“影响x紧急程度”网格，切换手动覆盖偏好设置，以及读取或设置默认回退优先级。

在写入任何值之前读取所有值，具备幂等性，并在任何变更操作前均需明确的用户确认。

适用于当用户需要查看、启用、禁用、设置、初始化、添加、修改或删除事件记录优先级矩阵配置，修改默认事件优先级，或询问事件优先级设置、影响/紧急程度映射、覆盖设置或 ITSM 事件优先级矩阵的情况。

不得用于针对问题或变更请求优先级矩阵、案例优先级字段、ITSM 范围外的标准优先级下拉选择列表、SLA 或里程碑配置，或启用事件管理本身时触发（请使用 service-itsm-incident-mgmt-configure 技能）。

description: Write competitive research proposals for NSF, NIH, DOE, DARPA, and Taiwan NSTC. Agency-specific formatting, review criteria, budget preparation, broader impacts, significance statements, innovation narratives, and compliance with submission requirements.

Frontend design skill that generates, restyles, and guides UI development in mager's actual design taste — concept-led interfaces that feel authored, tactile, expressive, and highly usable, spanning editorial warmth, bright modern product design, and high-contrast neon systems. Use this skill when building or reviewing any frontend UI.
description_zh: 能够契合Mager真实设计品味，用于生成、重新设计并指导UI开发的前端设计技能——以概念驱动，打造出富有作者创作感、触感敏锐、表现力充沛且高度易用的界面，涵盖编辑式温暖、明亮的现代产品设计与高对比度霓虹系统。在构建或审核任何前端UI时，请使用此技能。

description: Design the team's operating rhythm — task management, collaboration rituals, and tooling. Use when the day-to-day cadence needs structure. For a time-boxed sprint, use `design-sprint-plan`.
description_zh:
设计团队的运营节奏——任务管理、协作仪式与工具。  
当日常节奏需要结构化时使用。  
针对限时冲刺，使用 `design-sprint-plan`。
