description: Help users plan products and strategy when outcomes are unpredictable. Use when someone is dealing with ambiguous timelines, building in fast-moving markets, planning AI/ML projects, or asking how to make commitments when they don't know what will happen.
description_zh: 帮助用户在结果不可预测时规划产品与策略。适用于处理时间线模糊、在快速变化的市场中开展业务、规划人工智能/机器学习项目，或在不确定未来会发生什么的情况下询问如何做出承诺的场景。

description: Analyze the bond futures basis by pricing futures, identifying the cheapest-to-deliver, and comparing with yield curves to assess delivery option value and basis trading opportunities. Use when analyzing bond futures, computing the basis, identifying CTD bonds, calculating implied repo rates, or evaluating basis trades.
description_zh: 通过期货定价、识别最便宜可交割（CTD）债券，并与收益率曲线进行对比，分析债券期货基差，以评估交割期权价值和基差交易机会。适用于分析债券期货、计算基差、识别CTD债券、计算隐含回购利率或评估基差交易。

description: Strategic account planning and execution for enterprise deals. Use when planning complex sales cycles, managing multiple stakeholders, applying MEDDICC qualification, tracking deal health, or building mutual action plans. Includes the "stale MAP equals dead deal" pattern.
description_zh: 面向企业级交易的战略账户规划与执行。适用于规划复杂销售周期、管理多个利益相关方、应用 MEDDICC 资格评估、跟踪交易健康度，或制定共同行动计划。包含“MAP 停滞即交易终结”这一模式。

description: PRの変更内容をトリアージし、変更カテゴリ分類・表層チェック・必要リファレンス判定を行います。結果を`.pr-triage.json`に出力し、後続のコードレビューフェーズで活用します。CI環境でのコスト最適化に使用してください。
description_zh: 对 PR 的变更内容进行分诊、变更类别分类、表层检查与必要引用判定。结果输出至 `.pr-triage.json`，供后续代码审查阶段使用。请用于 CI 环境的成本优化。

description: Use when the user is debugging a bug, tracing an error, or asking why something fails. Examples: "Why is X failing?", "Where does this error come from?", "Trace this bug"
description_zh: 当用户排查bug、追踪错误或询问某事为何失败时使用。示例："X为何会失败？"、"这个错误来源于哪里？"、"追踪此bug"

description: Extract structured company lists from directories with Firecrawl. Use for scraping YC, Crunchbase, Product Hunt, G2, startup directories, category directories, or custom company databases into JSON, CSV, CRM-ready lists, or research tables.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 从目录中提取结构化的企业列表。可用于抓取 YC、Crunchbase、Product Hunt、G2、初创公司目录、行业目录或自定义企业数据库，并将其转换为 JSON、CRM 就绪列表或研究表格。

description: Create, edit, analyze, or convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx) where the workbook file is the primary deliverable. Use for formulas, formatting, financial models, multi-sheet workbooks, and tabular cleanup exported to Excel. Also applies to .csv/.tsv when the user wants spreadsheet output. Do NOT use for Word documents, HTML reports, standalone Python scripts, database pipelines, or Google Sheets API work.
description_zh: 创建、编辑、分析或转换 Excel 电子表格（.xlsx、.xlsm、.xltx），当工作簿文件是主要交付物时。适用于公式、格式、财务模型、多工作表工作簿，以及对导出至 Excel 的表格数据的清理工作。当用户需要电子表格输出时，也适用于 .csv/.tsv 文件。切勿用于 Word 文档、HTML 报告、独立的 Python 脚本、数据库管道或 Google Sheets API 相关任务。

description: Write realistic usability task scenarios with success criteria and facilitation notes. Use when you have a study and need the tasks. For the surrounding study design, use `usability-test-plan` (design-research).
description_zh: 编写实际可用性任务场景，包含成功标准与引导说明。当您已有研究并需要相关任务时使用。对于整体研究设计，使用 `usability-test-plan`（design-research）。

description: Research companies, directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial ownership in official corporate registries, filings and offshore datasets — OpenCorporates, UK Companies House and the PSC register, SEC EDGAR, US Secretary of State registries, EU business registers, GLEIF LEI records, OpenOwnership, OpenSanctions and the ICIJ Offshore Leaks database. Use when asked who owns or controls a company, to find a person's other directorships, or to unpick a group structure. Applies to KYB and UBO verification, AML and sanctions screening, nominee and shell-company detection, procurement integrity, and M&A diligence. Reference at useosint.com/skills/who-really-owns-it.
description_zh: 研究官方企业注册簿、申报文件及离岸数据集中的公司、董事、股东及最终受益所有权信息——包括 OpenCorporates、英国公司注册处及 PSC 登记册、SEC EDGAR、美国州务卿注册簿、欧盟企业注册簿、GLEIF LEI 记录、OpenOwnership、OpenSanctions 及 ICIJ Offshore Leaks 数据库。用于在询问公司由谁拥有或控制时，查找某人的其他董事任职情况，或拆解集团结构。适用于 KYB 与 UBO 核实、反洗钱（AML）与制裁筛查、代理人及空壳公司识别、采购诚信以及并购尽职调查。参考地址：useosint.com/skills/who-really-owns-it。

description: Use when writing or reviewing Jetpack Compose UI tests, screenshot tests, previews, semantics assertions, fake image loading, keyboard input, focus assertions, interaction state (hover/pressed/focused), or tests for plain state-driven UI composables.
description_zh: 用于编写或审查 Jetpack Compose UI 测试、截图测试、预览、语义断言、模拟图片加载、键盘输入、焦点断言、交互状态（悬停/按下/聚焦），或针对纯状态驱动的 UI 组合式函数的测试时。

description: Add, review, or fix JavaScript interop in Blazor components. USE FOR: calling JavaScript from Blazor, calling .NET from JavaScript, collocated .razor.js modules, IJSRuntime, IJSObjectReference lifecycle, DotNetObjectReference, ElementReference, timing rules for when JS is available, IAsyncDisposable disposal of JS references, server-side JS interop safety. DO NOT USE FOR: general Blazor component authoring without JS interop needs (use author-component), forms (use collect-user-input).
description_zh:
在 Blazor 组件中添加、审查或修复 JavaScript 互操作。

**用途：** 从 Blazor 调用 JavaScript，从 JavaScript 调用 .NET，并置 .razor.js 模块，IJSRuntime，IJSObjectReference 生命周期，DotNetObjectReference，ElementReference，JS 可用时的定时规则，使用 IAsyncDisposable 释放 JS 引用，服务端 JavaScript 互操作的安全性。

**切勿使用：** 不涉及 JavaScript 互操作的一般 Blazor 组件开发（使用 author-component），表单（使用 collect-user-input）。

description: Use when the user wants to rename, extract, split, move, or restructure code safely. Examples: "Rename this function", "Extract this into a module", "Refactor this class", "Move this to a separate file"
description_zh: 适用于用户希望安全地重命名、提取、拆分、移动或重组代码时使用。示例：“重命名此函数”、“将此提取到模块中”、“重构此类”、“将此移动到独立文件中”。

description: Use when a superpowers session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the superpowers maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.
description_zh: 用于当超能力会话出现异常，而你的人类合作伙伴想要了解原因时——例如出现重复工作、计划被忽略、失误、效果不佳、技能未触发、“耗时太长”、“为什么这么贵”、“它在做什么”——或者想要为超能力维护者构建一个针对当前会话或通过 ID 或路径识别的过往会话的错误报告，适用于任何运行环境。

description: Identify, score, and prioritise design opportunities against impact and effort. Use when there are more ideas than capacity. For framing the one you choose, use `design-brief`.
description_zh: 根据影响力和投入度，识别、评分并优先排序设计机会。当想法多于能力时使用。为所选机会拟定框架时，使用 `design-brief`。

description: Convert documents and files to Markdown using markitdown. Use when converting PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx, .xls), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, images (with EXIF/OCR), audio (with transcription), ZIP archives, YouTube URLs, or EPubs to Markdown format for LLM processing or text analysis.
description_zh: 使用 markitdown 将文档和文件转换为 Markdown。适用于将 PDF、Word (.docx)、PowerPoint (.pptx)、Excel (.xlsx, .xls)、HTML、CSV、JSON、XML、图片（含 EXIF/OCR）、音频（含转录）、ZIP 压缩包、YouTube 链接或 EPUB 转换为 Markdown 格式，用于大语言模型（LLM）处理或文本分析。

description: Use when tasks involve creating, editing, analyzing, or formatting spreadsheets (`.xlsx`, `.csv`, `.tsv`) with formula-aware workflows, cached recalculation, and visual review.
description_zh: 当任务涉及创建、编辑、分析或格式化电子表格（`.xlsx`、`.csv`、`.tsv`），需采用公式感知工作流程、缓存重算及可视化审查功能时使用。

description: Create adoption strategy and enablement materials to drive design system usage. Use when the system exists but teams ignore it. For contribution and versioning rules, use `design-system-governance` (design-systems).
description_zh: 制定采用策略与赋能材料，以推动设计系统的使用。当系统已存在但团队忽视其使用时，使用。关于贡献与版本规则，使用 `design-system-governance` (design-systems)。

description: Team of specialist AI workflows for Claude Code with CEO review, engineering planning, code review, shipping, QA testing, and browser automation
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 配备的专家级 AI 工作流程团队，支持 CEO 审查、工程规划、代码审查、发布、QA 测试和浏览器自动化。

description: Use when implementing ANY computer vision feature — image analysis, pose detection, person segmentation, subject lifting, text recognition, barcode scanning.
description_zh: 在实现任何计算机视觉功能时使用——图像分析、姿态检测、人物分割、主体提取、文本识别、条码扫描。

description: MUST activate when the project contains a uiBundles/*/src/ directory and the task involves creating or configuring a Custom Application for hosting a UI bundle in Lightning Experience. Use this skill when creating a CustomApplication metadata record to surface the UI bundle in the App Launcher. Activate when files matching applications/*.app-meta.xml exist and need modification, or when the user wants to expose their app via the Lightning App Launcher without a Digital Experience Site. Do NOT use generating-custom-application for this — UI bundle apps do not use tabs, action overrides, or flexipages.

Host setup for TAO GPU backends. Checks and, after user approval, installs minimum-compatible NVIDIA driver, CUDA Toolkit, and NVIDIA Container Toolkit versions for Docker/local-Docker and Kubernetes GPU worker hosts. TAO-wide defaults can be overridden by the selected model's runtime profile. The `--check-only` path works on any Linux distribution; `--install` automates debian-family (Ubuntu/Debian/Pop!_OS/Mint/Zorin/Raspbian), rhel-family (Fedora/RHEL/Rocky/AlmaLinux), and suse-family (openSUSE/SLES) hosts, and prints actionable manual-install steps for everything else. Use when the user asks to "set up an NVIDIA GPU host", "check TAO Docker GPU runtime", or prepare a Kubernetes GPU worker for TAO.
description_zh: TAO GPU 后端主机设置。检查并在用户确认后，为 Docker/本地 Docker 及 Kubernetes GPU 工作节点主机安装最低兼容的 NVIDIA 驱动、CUDA Toolkit 与 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 版本。TAO 全局默认配置可被所选模型的运行时配置覆盖。`--check-only` 路径适用于任何 Linux 发行版；`--install` 可自动为 debian 系（Ubuntu/Debian/Pop!_OS/Mint/Zorin/Raspbian）、rhel 系（Fedora/RHEL/Rocky/AlmaLinux）及 suse 系（openSUSE/SLES）主机进行配置，并针对其他所有情况打印可操作的手动安装步骤。适用于用户要求设置 NVIDIA GPU 主机、检查 TAO Docker GPU 运行状态，或为 TAO 准备 Kubernetes GPU 工作节点时。

description: Plan and facilitate a design sprint from challenge framing through prototype testing. Use when compressing discovery into days. For ongoing team cadence, use `team-workflow`.
description_zh: 规划并促进从挑战界定到原型测试的设计冲刺。用于将探索发现压缩到天数内。对于持续的团队节奏，使用 `team-workflow`。

description: End-to-end testing patterns with Playwright for full-stack Python/React applications. Use when writing E2E tests for complete user workflows (login, CRUD, navigation), critical path regression tests, or cross-browser validation. Covers test structure, page object model, selector strategy (data-testid > role > label), wait strategies, auth state reuse, test data management, and CI integration. Does NOT cover unit tests or component tests (use pytest-patterns or react-testing-patterns).
description_zh: 针对全栈 Python/React 应用的 Playwright 端到端测试模式。适用于编写完整用户流程（登录、增删改查、导航）的端到端测试、关键路径回归测试或跨浏览器验证。涵盖测试结构、页面对象模型、选择器策略（data-testid > role > label）、等待策略、认证状态复用、测试数据管理以及 CI 集成。不涵盖单元测试或组件测试（请使用 pytest-patterns 或 react-testing-patterns）。

description: Generate novel research ideas with iterative refinement and novelty checking against literature. Score ideas on Interestingness, Feasibility, and Novelty. Use when brainstorming research directions or validating idea novelty.
description_zh: 通过迭代优化和对照文献进行新颖性检查，生成新颖的研究想法。根据趣味性、可行性和新颖性对想法进行评分。用于头脑风暴研究方向或验证想法新颖性。

description: Gate fine-tuned checkpoints with drift budgets, paired comparison, and forgetting checks before promotion. Use after a training run produces a checkpoint, when deciding whether a tuned model ships, or when a promoted model needs re-gating against updated goldens.
description_zh: 在模型提升之前，需使用漂移预算、配对对比和遗忘检查对微调检查点进行门控检查。在训练运行生成检查点之后，可用于判断是否将微调模型发布上线，或在已提升的模型需依据更新后的标准进行重新门控检查时使用。

description: Align a fine-tuned model with preference data using DPO, ORPO, KTO, or SimPO. Use when preference pairs or thumbs-up/down feedback exist, when choosing between preference-optimization methods, or when a DPO run needs hyperparameters or debugging.
description_zh: 使用 DPO、ORPO、KTO 或 SimPO 将经过微调的模型与偏好数据对齐。当存在偏好对或点赞/踩反馈，或需在偏好优化方法间进行选择，或 DPO 运行需要超参数或调试时使用。

description: Verifies Kelos skills.sh installation. Use when asked to run the Kelos e2e skill check.
description_zh: 验证 Kelos skills.sh 的安装。当要求运行 Kelos e2e 技能检查时使用。

description: Synthesize the three Jason Shapiro contrarian-pipeline verdicts (COT crowding, news-reaction failure, weekly price-action confirmation) into one actionable setup_status via a fail-closed precedence state machine. Pure, offline synthesis -- no network, no API keys, no computation beyond validation and precedence.
description_zh: 将 Jason Shapiro 的三个逆势流程判定（COT 人群拥挤度、新闻反应失败、周度价格动作确认）通过一个失败安全优先状态机综合为一项可操作的 setup_status。纯、离线综合——无需网络，无需 API 密钥，无需超出验证与优先级的计算。

description: Make interactive Blazor components work correctly with prerendering. USE FOR fixing duplicate data loads, UI flicker during prerender-to-interactive handoff, null references during prerender, persisting state across prerender, disabling prerendering, excluding pages from interactive routing, or detecting whether a component is currently prerendering. DO NOT USE for choosing which render mode to use (see create-blazor-project) or general component authoring (see author-component).
description_zh: 使交互式 Blazor 组件能够正确与预渲染配合工作。用途：修复重复的数据加载、预渲染到交互式切换期间的 UI 闪烁、预渲染期间出现空引用、跨预渲染保持状态、禁用预渲染、将页面从交互式路由中排除，或检测组件是否正在预渲染。请勿用于选择应使用的渲染模式（参见 create-blazor-project）或进行通用组件开发（参见 author-component）。

description: Build a knowledge base from web content with Firecrawl. Use for local reference docs, RAG-ready chunks, fine-tuning datasets, documentation mirrors, topic corpora, or LLM-ready markdown organized from web sources.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 从网页内容构建知识库，可用于本地参考文档、RAG 就绪分块、微调数据集、文档镜像、主题语料库，或基于网页来源组织的 LLM 就绪 Markdown。

description: Turn one interview transcript into themes, supporting quotes, and action items. Use immediately after a session. For synthesising many sessions at once, use `affinity-diagram`.
description_zh: 将一份面试记录转化为主题、支持性引述和行动项。在会话结束后立即使用。若需同时综合多个会话，请使用 `affinity-diagram`。

description: Build professional financial services data packs from various sources including CIMs, offering memorandums, SEC filings, web search, or MCP servers. Extract, normalize, and standardize financial data into investment committee-ready Excel workbooks with consistent structure, proper formatting, and documented assumptions. Use for M&A due diligence, private equity analysis, investment committee materials, and standardizing financial reporting across portfolio companies. Do not use for simple financial calculations or working with already-completed data packs.
description_zh: 从CIMs、备忘录、SEC文件、网络搜索或MCP服务器等多种来源构建专业的金融服务数据包。提取、规范化并标准化财务数据，生成结构一致、格式规范且假设有据可查的投资委员会可用Excel工作簿。用于并购尽职调查、私募股权分析、投资委员会材料，以及跨投资组合公司统一财务报告。不得用于简单的财务计算或处理已完成的财务数据包。

description: When the user wants to write a social media post for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or YouTube. Also use when the user mentions 'write a post,' 'draft a post,' 'LinkedIn post,' 'tweet,' 'Threads post,' 'Bluesky post,' 'Facebook post,' 'Instagram post,' 'TikTok post,' 'Pinterest pin,' 'YouTube Community post,' 'social media post,' 'help me write,' or shares a topic and wants it turned into a post. For deeper visual-platform caption writing, see caption-writer-sms. For multi-part content, see thread-writer-sms. For carousels, see carousel-writer-sms. For opening lines, see hook-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要为LinkedIn、Twitter/X、Threads、Bluesky、Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、Pinterest或YouTube撰写社交媒体帖子时，使用。当用户提到‘撰写帖子’、‘起草帖子’、‘LinkedIn帖子’、‘推文’、‘Threads帖子’、‘Bluesky帖子’、‘Facebook帖子’、‘Instagram帖子’、‘TikTok帖子’、‘Pinterest置顶’、‘YouTube社区帖子’、‘社交媒体帖子’、‘帮我写’，或分享主题并希望将其转化为帖子时，也使用。对于更深入的可视化平台文案撰写，参见 caption-writer-sms。对于多部分内容，参见 thread-writer-sms。对于轮播图，参见 carousel-writer-sms。对于开场白，参见 hook-writer-sms。

description: Pull metrics from analytics dashboards and internal web tools with Firecrawl browser. Use when the user needs dashboard reporting, cross-platform metric summaries, authenticated analytics extraction, date-range reports, or structured metrics from web dashboards.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl browser 从分析仪表板和内部网页工具中拉取指标。当用户需要仪表板报告、跨平台指标摘要、鉴权分析提取、日期范围报告，或从网页仪表板获取结构化指标时使用。

description: Design first-click and click tests for findability and navigation. Use when testing whether people can locate something. For full task-based observation, use `test-scenario`.
description_zh: 为可发现性与导航设计首点击和点击测试。用于测试人们是否能够定位某项内容。如需进行完整的任务式观察，请使用 `test-scenario`。

description: Export a promoted fine-tuned model in the right deployment format — merged safetensors, LoRA-only, GGUF with imatrix, or FP8. Use after a checkpoint passes promotion, when choosing a quantization format for a target device, or when an exported model fails its smoke test.
description_zh: 以正确的部署格式导出已推广的微调模型——合并的 safetensors、仅 LoRA、带 imatrix 的 GGUF，或 FP8。当 checkpoint 通过推广、为目标设备选择量化格式，或导出的模型未通过冒烟测试时使用。

description: UI design system toolkit for Senior UI Designer including design token generation, component documentation, responsive design calculations, and developer handoff tools. Use for creating design systems, maintaining visual consistency, and facilitating design-dev collaboration.
description_zh: 面向高级 UI 设计师的 UI 设计系统工具包，包括设计令牌生成、组件文档、响应式设计计算和开发者交接工具。用于创建设计系统、保持视觉一致性以及促进设计与开发的协作。

description: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the FigJam context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.
description_zh: 此技能帮助智能体在 FigJam 上下文中使用 Figma 的 use_figma MCP 工具。可以与 figma-use 一起使用，figma-use 为使用 use_figma 工具提供了基础上下文。

description: Dump DEX files from a running Android app for unpacking/deobfuscation. Activate when the user wants to unpack an Android APK, dump DEX from memory, extract decrypted DEX files, or defeat class-loading packing.
description_zh: 从正在运行的Android应用中导出DEX文件，用于解包/去混淆。在用户需要解包Android APK、从内存中导出DEX文件、提取已解密的DEX文件或破解类加载混淆时激活。

description: .NET timezone handling guidance for C# applications. Use when working with TimeZoneInfo, DateTimeOffset, NodaTime, UTC conversion, daylight saving time, scheduling across timezones, cross-platform Windows/IANA timezone IDs, or when a .NET user needs the timezone for a city, address, region, or country and copy-paste-ready C# code.
description_zh: C# 应用程序的 .NET 时区处理指南。适用于在 TimeZoneInfo、DateTimeOffset、NodaTime、UTC 转换、夏令时、跨时区调度、跨平台 Windows/IANA 时区 ID 等方面工作，或当 .NET 用户需要为城市、地址、地区或国家查找时区，并获取可直接复制使用的 C# 代码时使用。

description: Create, analyze, and visualize complex networks and graphs in Python with NetworkX. Use when working with network/graph data structures, computing graph algorithms (shortest paths, centrality, clustering), detecting communities, generating synthetic networks (random, scale-free, small-world), reading/writing graph file formats, or drawing network topologies. Common applications include social, biological, transportation, and citation networks.
description_zh: 使用 NetworkX 在 Python 中创建、分析并可视化复杂网络与图。在处理网络/图数据结构、计算图算法（最短路径、中心性、聚类）、检测社区、生成合成网络（随机、无标度、小世界）、读写图文件格式，或绘制网络拓扑时使用。常见应用包括社交、生物、交通和引用网络。

description: Deep learning framework (PyTorch Lightning / lightning package). Organize PyTorch code into LightningModules, configure Trainers for multi-GPU/TPU, implement data pipelines, callbacks, logging (W&B, TensorBoard, MLflow), distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed), for scalable neural network training.
description_zh: 深度学习框架（PyTorch Lightning / lightning 包）。将 PyTorch 代码组织为 LightningModules，为多 GPU/TPU 配置 Trainer，实现数据管道、回调及日志记录（W&B、TensorBoard、MLflow），进行分布式训练（DDP、FSDP、DeepSpeed），以支持可扩展的神经网络训练。

description: Fine-tune any HuggingFace CV / VLM / LLM model on local NVIDIA GPUs inside an NGC PyTorch container when no dedicated TAO model skill matches. Use when the user wants to fine-tune a HuggingFace model (full or LoRA), train a vision / VLM / LLM model end-to-end, generate a reproducible HF training pipeline, smoke-test a HuggingFace model locally before scale-up, push a fine-tuned model to the HF Hub with a model card, or emit a self-contained rerun skill for an existing HuggingFace finetune. Supports image classification, object detection, semantic / instance / panoptic segmentation, depth estimation, image-text-to-text VLM (SFT / LoRA), and LLM SFT / DPO / GRPO. Six-step workflow: inspect and qualify, hardware and NGC image, research, generate and smoke, train + eval + infer, push and emit rerun skill. Do not use for any Hugging Face model ID claimed by a dedicated `skills/models/*` skill; the model skill and its declared execution environment take precedence.
description_zh:
在NGC PyTorch容器内的本地NVIDIA GPU上，当没有匹配的专用TAO模型技能时，可对任意HuggingFace计算机视觉（CV）、视觉语言模型（VLM）或大语言模型（LLM）模型进行微调。

适用于当用户需要微调一个HuggingFace模型（全量或LoRA）、端到端训练视觉/VLM/LLM模型、生成可复现的HuggingFace训练流程、在扩展前于本地冒烟测试一个HuggingFace模型、使用模型卡片将微调后的模型推送至HF Hub，或为现有的HuggingFace微调生成自包含的重运行技能的情形。

支持图像分类、目标检测、语义/实例/全景分割、深度估计、图像-文本到文本的VLM（SFT/LoRA），以及LLM的SFT/DPO/GRPO。

六步工作流程：检查与评估，硬件与NGC镜像，研究，生成与冒烟测试，训练+评估+推理，推送与生成重运行技能。

切勿将此用于任何由专用 `skills/models/*` 技能所声明的 HuggingFace 模型 ID；模型技能及其声明的执行环境具有优先权。

description: Use a file-based PARA memory system to store, retrieve, and organize durable knowledge across sessions. Trigger on saving facts, daily notes, entity records, weekly synthesis, recall, tacit user patterns, or plan memory.
description_zh: 使用基于文件的PARA记忆系统，在跨会话期间存储、检索和整理持久知识。在保存事实、每日笔记、实体记录、每周汇总、回忆、隐性用户模式或计划记忆时触发。

description:
OKX OnChainOS: on-chain trading, analytics, security, DeFi across 20+ chains.

Use when running OKX-routed on-chain ops (e.g. swap on Ethereum, scan token risk, track smart money, check wallet portfolio).

Wallet: default to the user's Agent Wallet (via the `wallet` skill). Only use the OnchainOS TEE wallet (`onchainos wallet login <email>`) when the user explicitly asks for it.
description_zh:
OKX OnChainOS：覆盖 20+ 条链的链上交易、分析、安全与 DeFi。

适用于运行 OKX 路由的链上操作（例如在以太坊上交换、扫描代币风险、追踪聪明钱、检查钱包投资组合）。

钱包：默认使用用户的 Agent Wallet（通过 `wallet` 技能）。仅在用户明确要求时，才使用 OnchainOS TEE 钱包（`onchainos wallet login <email>`）。

description: Find leaked or mentioned selectors circulating in pastes, leak forums, Telegram channels and dump markets, and judge whether a claimed leak is genuine or a recycled combolist. Covers paste aggregators, site: searches over paste hosts, channel indexes and leak-search services. Use when checking whether a name, email, domain or credential is circulating, verifying a breach claim made against your organisation, or setting up ongoing leak monitoring. Applies to incident response and breach triage, threat intelligence, brand and executive protection, and extortion-claim validation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/find-leaks-in-the-wild.
description_zh: 查找在帖子、泄露论坛、Telegram 频道及转售市场流传的已泄露或被提及的选择器，并判断声称的泄露信息是真实的，还是已被重复使用的组合列表。涵盖帖子聚合平台、对帖子托管站进行的 site: 搜索、频道索引及泄露搜索服务。用于核查名称、电子邮件、域名或凭据是否在流传，验证针对贵组织提出的泄露声明，或设置持续的泄露监控。适用于事件响应与泄露分诊、威胁情报、品牌保护与高管保护，以及勒索赎金声明验证。参考：useosint.com/skills/find-leaks-in-the-wild。

description: AI Native Camp Day 2 Context Sync 스킬 만들기. 여러 외부 도구에서 컨텍스트를 수집하여 하나의 sync 문서로 만드는 나만의 스킬을 직접 구축한다. "2일차", "Day 2", "context sync", "컨텍스트 싱크", "sync 스킬", "스킬 만들기", "정보 수집 스킬" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp Day 2 Context Sync 技能制作。从多个外部工具收集上下文，整合为一份同步文档，亲自构建属于自己的技能。用于请求“2일차”、“Day 2”、“context sync”、“컨텍스트 싱크”、“sync 스� Kiln”、“스� Kiln 만들기”、“정보 수집 스� Kiln”。

description: Generate Playwright tests. Use when user says "write tests", "generate tests", "add tests for", "test this component", "e2e test", "create test for", "test this page", or "test this feature".
description_zh: 生成 Playwright 测试。当用户说“编写测试”、“生成测试”、“为……添加测试”、“测试此组件”、“e2e 测试”、“为……创建测试”、“测试此页面”或“测试此功能”时使用。

description: Help users run effective design reviews and critiques. Use when someone is giving design feedback, establishing design review processes, struggling to evaluate designs, or wants to improve how their team discusses design work.
description_zh: 帮助用户开展有效的设计评审与评价。当有人提供设计反馈、建立设计评审流程、在评估设计时遇到困难，或希望提升团队在设计工作上的讨论方式时使用。

description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.
description_zh: 本技能适用于包含分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割和相似度搜索等任务的时间序列机器学习任务。当处理时间数据、序列模式或时间索引观测数据，且需要采用标准机器学习方法之外的专业算法时使用。特别适用于具有 scikit-learn 兼容 API 的一元和多元时间序列分析。

description: Interact with Zotero reference management libraries using the pyzotero Python client. Retrieve, create, update, and delete items, collections, tags, and attachments via the Zotero Web API v3. Use this skill when working with Zotero libraries programmatically, managing bibliographic references, exporting citations, searching library contents, uploading PDF attachments, or building research automation workflows that integrate with Zotero.
description_zh: 使用 pyzotero Python 客户端与 Zotero 参考文献管理库交互。通过 Zotero Web API v3 检索、创建、更新和删除条目、集合、标签和附件。当需要以编程方式处理 Zotero 库、管理书目参考文献、导出引用、搜索库内容、上传 PDF 附件，或构建与研究 Zotero 集成的自动化研究工作流程时，请使用本技能。

description: nuqs (type-safe URL query state) best practices for Next.js and other React frameworks. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code that uses nuqs for URL state management. Triggers on tasks involving useQueryState, useQueryStates, search params, URL state, query parameters, nuqs parsers, limitUrlUpdates, Standard Schema, NuqsAdapter, or Next.js routing with state.
description_zh: nuqs（类型安全的 URL 查询状态）面向 Next.js 及其他 React 框架的最佳实践。本技能应在编写、审查或重构使用 nuqs 进行 URL 状态管理的代码时使用。适用于涉及 useQueryState、useQueryStates、搜索参数、URL 状态、查询参数、nuqs 解析器、limitUrlUpdates、Standard Schema、NuqsAdapter 或 Next.js 带状态路由的任务。

description: Help users run effective post-mortems and retrospectives. Use when someone is reviewing a project that succeeded or failed, wants to establish learning practices, is dealing with failure aftermath, or needs to improve team learning loops.
description_zh: 帮助用户有效开展复盘和回顾。适用于审查成功或失败的项目、建立学习实践、处理失败后果，或需要改进团队学习循环的情形。

description: Train reasoning and verifiable-task behavior with GRPO and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). Use when task success is algorithmically checkable (math, code, tool calls, structured output), when designing GRPO reward functions, or when a GRPO run diverges or reward-hacks.
description_zh: 使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）和基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来训练推理与可验证任务行为。适用于任务成功结果可通过算法检查（如数学、代码、工具调用、结构化输出）的场景、设计GRPO奖励函数时，以及GRPO运行偏离或出现奖励作弊的情况。

description: Ingest public or authenticated knowledge bases and docs portals with Firecrawl browser. Use for JS-heavy docs, login-gated portals, paginated help centers, support knowledge bases, or structured JSON/markdown extraction from documentation sites.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器摄取公开或经过认证的知识库和文档门户。适用于大量 JS 的文档、需登录访问的门户、分页的帮助中心、支持知识库，或从文档站点进行结构化 JSON/Markdown 提取。

description: Use when you need exact symbolic math in Python — algebra, calculus, equation solving, symbolic linear algebra, or code generation via lambdify/LaTeX. Prefer NumPy or SciPy when floating-point approximations are sufficient.
description_zh: 当需要在 Python 中进行精确符号数学运算时使用——包括代数、微积分、方程求解、符号线性代数，或通过 lambdify/LaTeX 生成代码。当浮点近似足够时，优先使用 NumPy 或 SciPy。

description: Use when starting, designing, organizing, finishing, or shipping an n8n workflow. Covers visual layout (sticky notes), descriptions that capture the *why*, node names, validation, testing, folders/projects, and publishing. Triggers on create_workflow_from_code, update_workflow, validate_workflow, publish_workflow, archive_workflow, "design", "lay out", "organize", "structure", "sticky", "describe this workflow", "ship", "deploy", "publish", "name this workflow", or any folder/project organization request.
description_zh: 用于开始、设计、组织、完成或发货 n8n 工作流时。涵盖可视化布局（便利贴）、能说明*为什么*的描述、节点名称、验证、测试、文件夹/项目以及发布。在 create_workflow_from_code、update_workflow、validate_workflow、publish_workflow、archive_workflow、“设计”、“布局”、“组织”、“结构”、“便利贴”、“描述此工作流”、“发货”、“部署”、“发布”、“命名此工作流”，以及任何文件夹/项目组织请求时触发。

description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.
description_zh: 构建并精炼项目的领域模型。用于用户希望明确领域术语或通用语言、记录架构决策，或者当其他技能需要维护领域模型时。

description: Day 2 보충 자료 - MCP 딥다이브. Claude Code에 외부 도구를 연결하는 MCP를 체계적으로 배운다. "MCP 배우기", "MCP 보충", "MCP 강의", "MCP 학습" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: 第2天补充资料 - MCP深度解析。系统学习将外部工具连接至 Claude Code 的 MCP。适用于“MCP学习”“MCP补充”“MCP课程”“MCP学习”请求。

description: Creates, optimizes, and iteratively refines agent prompts, system prompts, developer prompts, and reusable prompt templates. Use when asked to improve a prompt, optimize a system prompt, rewrite an agent prompt, tune prompt wording, make a prompt more reliable, port prompts between OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini, or build prompt evals.
description_zh: 创建、优化并持续迭代优化智能体提示词、系统提示词、开发者提示词和可复用提示模板。当被要求改进提示词、优化系统提示词、重写智能体提示词、调整提示词措辞、提升提示词可靠性、在不同平台间迁移提示词（如OpenAI、Claude或Gemini），或构建提示词评测时使用。

description: Four-phase framework for onboarding enterprise customers from contract to value realization. Use when implementing new enterprise customers, preventing churn during onboarding, or solving the adoption cliff that kills deals post-go-live. Includes the Week 4 ghosting pattern.
description_zh: 用于企业客户入职的四阶段框架：从合同签订到价值实现。适用于实施新企业客户、防止入职期间流失，以及解决上线后导致交易终止的采用鸿沟。包含第四周的失联模式。

description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.
description_zh: 通过OpenRouter Image API（Gemini、Seedream、Recraft、GPT-Image、Riverflow）使用AI模型生成或编辑图像。用于照片、插画、艺术作品、概念艺术、视觉素材、标志，以及基于参考图片的图片编辑或合成。对于流程图、电路图、路径图及其他技术图表，请改用科学图表技能（scientific-schematics）。

description: Use when converting Java source files to idiomatic Kotlin, when user mentions "java to kotlin", "j2k", "convert java", "migrate java to kotlin", or when working with .java files that need to become .kt files. Handles framework-aware conversion for Spring, Lombok, Hibernate, Jackson, Micronaut, Quarkus, Dagger/Hilt, RxJava, JUnit, Guice, Retrofit, and Mockito.
description_zh: 适用于将 Java 源代码文件转换为符合规范的 Kotlin 代码时使用；当用户提及 "java to kotlin"、"j2k"、"convert java"、"migrate java to kotlin"，或使用需要转换为 .kt 文件的 .java 文件时。支持对 Spring、Lombok、Hibernate、Jackson、Micronaut、Quarkus、Dagger/Hilt、RxJava、JUnit、Guice、Retrofit 和 Mockito 等框架的感知型转换。

description: Turn a proven pattern or debugging solution into a standalone reusable skill with SKILL.md, reference docs, and examples. Use when the user runs /si:extract or asks to package a recurring solution from memory into a skill.
description_zh: 将经过验证的模式或调试方案，转化为包含 SKILL.md、参考文档和示例的独立可复用技能。当用户运行 /si:extract 或要求将记忆中的重复性方案打包为技能时使用。

description: Produce pre-meeting lead intelligence briefs with Firecrawl. Use when the user needs company research, person research, recent news, talking points, pain points, or outreach preparation before a sales call, partnership meeting, investor conversation, or customer interview.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 生成会前潜在客户情报简报。适用于在销售通话、合作会议、投资者交流或客户访谈前，当用户需要公司调研、人员调研、近期新闻、对话要点、痛点或外联准备等需求时使用。

description: Extract market, financial, earnings, industry, and company metrics with Firecrawl. Use when the user asks for market research, industry trends, public company data, financial comparisons, earnings research, or structured market reports.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 提取市场、财务、盈利、行业与公司指标。当用户需要市场研究、行业趋势、上市公司数据、财务对比、盈利研究或结构化市场报告时使用。

description: Assess research idea novelty through systematic literature search. Multi-round search-evaluate loops with harsh critic persona. Binary novel/not-novel decision with justification. Use before committing to a research direction.
description_zh: 通过系统性文献检索评估研究想法的新颖性。采用严苛批判者人设进行多轮检索-评估循环。作出“新颖/不新颖”的二选一决定，并给出理由。在决定研究方向之前使用。

description: Build local constrained-browser agents with a safe_browser tool that owns CDP, enforces a domain allowlist with Fetch interception, and lets a runtime Claude Agent SDK agent complete browsing tasks without raw browser, shell, or CDP access. Use when the user wants an agent to browse or scrape while staying on approved domains, demo blocked off-domain navigation, or generate a safe browser client.
description_zh: 使用 safe_browser 工具构建本地受限浏览器智能体，该工具拥有 CDP 控制权，通过 Fetch 拦截实施域名白名单校验，并允许运行时的 Claude Agent SDK 智能体在完成浏览任务时，无需获得原始浏览器、shell 或 CDP 访问权限。适用于用户需要智能体在已批准域名内进行浏览或内容抓取、演示跨域导航被拦截，或生成安全浏览器客户端的场景。

description:
Vision intake conversation followed by generation of three product
documents — `docs/product-vision.md` (strategy and brand),
`docs/prd.md` (technical spec for coding agents), and
`docs/product-roadmap.md` (phased build plan with task checkboxes).
Also captures the founder's answers as `docs/VISION.md`. Use when the
founder says "plan my product", "plan a product", "define my vision",
"generate a PRD", "create a roadmap", "spec out my idea", "help me
build something", or wants to convert an idea into shippable spec
documents.
description_zh:
愿景采集对话，随后生成三份产品文档——
`docs/product-vision.md`（策略与品牌），
`docs/prd.md`（供编码智能体使用的技术规范），以及
`docs/product-roadmap.md`（包含任务复选框的阶段性构建计划）。
同时将创始人答复记录为 `docs/VISION.md`。当创始人说
“规划我的产品”，“规划一个产品”，“定义我的愿景”，
“生成 PRD”，“创建路线图”，“明确我的想法规格”，“帮助我构建某种产品”，
或希望将想法转化为可交付的规格文档时使用。

description: Walk through a product's key flows with Firecrawl browser and produce a structured UX/product walkthrough. Use for signup, onboarding, pricing, docs, dashboard, product demo prep, UX teardown, and first-run experience analysis.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器遍历产品关键流程，并产出结构化的 UX/产品走查。适用于注册、新手引导、定价、文档、仪表盘、产品演示准备、UX 拆解及首次运行体验分析。

description: Generate structured lead lists from prospect databases and web directories with Firecrawl browser. Use for finding prospects by role, company type, industry, stage, location, technologies, or other criteria and exporting CRM-ready JSON or CSV.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器，从潜在客户数据库和网页目录生成结构化线索列表。可用于按角色、公司类型、行业、阶段、地点、技术或其他标准查找潜在客户，并导出可直接导入 CRM 的 JSON 或 CSV 文件。

description: Help users apply the working backwards methodology. Use when someone is defining a new product, writing a PR/FAQ, planning from a future state, or trying to clarify a product's value proposition before building.
description_zh: 帮助用户应用以终为始的方法论。当需要定义新产品、编写公关/常见问题（FAQ）、从未来状态进行规划，或在构建前明确产品价值主张时使用。

description: Excel MCP Server skill for Windows workbook automation. Use when an assistant needs rich MCP tools to create, inspect, modify, format, or analyze Excel files. Supports Power Query (M), Data Model/DAX, PivotTables, Tables, Ranges, Charts, Slicers, formatting, screenshots, VBA macros, connections, and calculation mode. Triggers: Excel, spreadsheet, workbook, xlsx, xlsm, Power Query, DAX, PivotTable, chart, dashboard, VBA, MCP.
description_zh: 用于 Windows 工作簿自动化的 Excel MCP Server 技能。当助手需要丰富的 MCP 工具来创建、检查、修改、格式化或分析 Excel 文件时使用。支持 Power Query（M）、数据模型/DAX、数据透视表、表格、范围、图表、切片器、格式化、截图、VBA 宏、连接以及计算模式。触发词：Excel、电子表格、工作簿、xlsx、xlsm、Power Query、DAX、PivotTable、图表、仪表板、VBA、MCP。

description: File new notes into the right folder and audit/reorganize folder structure in the user's Obsidian vault, using the `obsidian` CLI and a single source-of-truth map note (`00_Index/Folder_Map.md`) that lives inside the vault. Use this whenever a note needs to be placed, filed, sorted, or moved into the vault; whenever the user asks where a note "belongs" or "should go"; and whenever they want to clean up, reorganize, deduplicate, audit, or restructure vault folders (e.g. orphaned notes, dead-end notes, near-duplicate titles, overlapping folders). Trigger even when the user just says "add this to my vault", "put this somewhere sensible", or "tidy up the cellchat notes" without naming a folder. Requires the Obsidian desktop app to be running.
description_zh: 将新笔记归档到正确的文件夹，并在用户 Obsidian 仓库中审计/重组文件夹结构，使用 `obsidian` CLI 和一份位于仓库内的唯一真实来源映射笔记（`00_Index/Folder_Map.md`）。每当需要把某条笔记放入、归档、排序或移动到仓库时，均使用此操作；每当用户询问某条笔记“属于哪里”或“应该放在哪里”时；以及当他们希望清理、重组、去重、审计或重新调整仓库文件夹时（例如：孤立笔记、死路笔记、近似重复的标题、重叠的文件夹）。即使用户仅说“把这个添加到我的仓库”、“把它放到一个合理的位置”，或“整理一下 cellchat 笔记”而未指定文件夹时，也应触发此操作。需要 Obsidian 桌面应用正在运行。

description: Run tests on BrowserStack. Use when user mentions "browserstack", "cross-browser", "cloud testing", "browser matrix", "test on safari", "test on firefox", or "browser compatibility".
description_zh: 在 BrowserStack 上运行测试。当用户提及 "browserstack"、"cross-browser"、"cloud testing"、"browser matrix"、"test on safari"、"test on firefox" 或 "browser compatibility" 时使用。

description: Work with MongoDB databases using best practices. Use when designing schemas, writing queries, building aggregation pipelines, or optimizing performance. Triggers on MongoDB, Mongoose, NoSQL, aggregation pipeline, document database, MongoDB Atlas.
description_zh: 遵循最佳实践与 MongoDB 数据库协同工作。在设计数据库模式、编写查询、构建聚合管道或优化性能时使用。触发条件：MongoDB、Mongoose、NoSQL、聚合管道、文档数据库、MongoDB Atlas。

description: Help users design and execute platform business strategies. Use when someone is building a marketplace, creating an ecosystem, deciding on API strategy, thinking about multi-sided network effects, or building developer platforms.
description_zh: 帮助用户制定并执行平台业务策略。适用于搭建交易市场、构建生态、确定API策略、考量多边网络效应或构建开发者平台等场景。

description: End-to-end workflow to establish where and when a photo or video was captured and whether it is authentic — evidentiary handling, metadata extraction, reverse image search for provenance, visual geolocation, chronolocation from shadows, and manipulation checks, ending in a location finding with a stated confidence radius. Use when asked to verify where an image was taken, confirm or refute a claimed location or date, or authenticate media before relying on it. Applies to insurance claims, litigation evidence, disinformation analysis, and conflict and human-rights documentation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/where-was-this-taken.
description_zh: 端到端工作流程，用于确定照片或视频的拍摄地点和时间及其是否真实——包括取证处理、元数据提取、用于溯源的反向图片搜索、视觉地理定位、基于阴影的拍摄时间地点推断以及篡改检查，最终得出一个带有明确置信度半径的定位结果。当被要求核实图像拍摄地点、确认或反驳所声称的地点或日期，或在依赖媒体之前进行验证时使用。适用于保险索赔、诉讼证据、虚假信息分析以及冲突与人权记录。参考 useosint.com/skills/where-was-this-taken。

description: Convert evaluation traces and production logs into SFT examples and preference pairs. Use when graded traces or failure examples exist and need to become training data, when applying rejection sampling to model outputs, or when building DPO pairs from passing and failing runs.
description_zh: 将评估轨迹和生产日志转换为 SFT 示例和偏好对。在存在已评分的轨迹或失败示例且需要转化为训练数据时、对模型输出进行拒绝采样时，或从通过和失败的运行中构建 DPO 对时使用。

description: Hugging Face Transformers for loading Hub models, running pipeline inference, text generation, and Trainer fine-tuning on NLP, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. Use when working with AutoModel, pipelines, tokenizers, or TrainingArguments—not for general ML outside the Transformers library.
description_zh: Hugging Face Transformers 用于加载 Hub 模型、运行流程推理、文本生成，并针对自然语言处理、视觉、音频及多模态任务进行 Trainer 微调。适用于 AutoModel、pipelines、tokenizer 或 TrainingArguments 相关的操作，不用于 Transformers 库之外的通用机器学习。

description: Define version control for design files, components, and libraries — branching, naming, and release. Use when file history is chaotic. For design system contribution rules, use `design-system-governance` (design-systems).
description_zh: 为设计文件、组件和库定义版本控制——分支、命名和发布。当文件历史混乱时使用。针对设计系统贡献规则，使用 `design-system-governance` (design-systems)。

description: Generate Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory visuals, material-styled chart illustrations, and data-first editorial images from articles, notes, product concepts, workplace reports, creator posts, tutorials, school materials, humanities topics, science explanations, screenshots, or chart data. Use when the user asks for 配图, 带字插图, 解释图, 图解插画, 概念拆解图, 图表美化, 数据图美化, 3D 图表, 汇报配图, 内容配图, 小学课文配图, 生物/化学/物理解释图, 人文类配图, process/loop/system diagrams, or wants GPT-Image / image generation to create supporting images that can sit inside social cards, docs, slides, PPTs, or posts.
description_zh: 生成郭志刚风格素材插图、带标注的解释性视觉图、素材风格的图表插图，以及从文章、笔记、产品概念、工作汇报、创作者帖子、教程、学校材料、人文主题、科学解释、截图或图表数据等素材生成的优先数据导向编辑配图。当用户需要配图、带字插图、解释图、图解插画、概念拆解图、图表美化、数据图美化、3D 图表、汇报配图、内容配图、小学课文配图、生物/化学/物理解释图、人文类配图、流程/循环/系统示意图，或需要由 GPT-Image / 图像生成工具生成可嵌入社交媒体卡片、文档、幻灯片、PPT 或帖子中的配图时使用。

description: Expert backend architect specializing in scalable API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
description_zh: 专注可扩展 API 设计、微服务架构及分布式系统领域的资深后端架构师。

description: Scan the Obsidian wiki for page-level identity collisions — different pages covering the same concept under different names (e.g. "RSC" vs "React Server Components") — and merge them. Use this skill when the user says "dedup my wiki", "find duplicate pages", "merge duplicates", "identity resolution", "consolidate my wiki", "I have duplicate pages", or "my wiki has two pages for the same thing". Distinct from wiki-lint (which checks structure) and cross-linker (which adds links) — this skill makes destructive page-level merges and requires careful confirmation.
description_zh: 扫描 Obsidian 维基中的页面级身份冲突——即不同页面以不同名称覆盖同一概念（例如“RSC”与“React Server Components”），并将其合并。当用户提及“去重我的维基”、“查找重复页面”、“合并重复项”、“身份解析”、“整合我的维基”、“我有重复页面”或“我的维基中有两个页面描述同一事物”时，使用此技能。此技能与 wiki-lint（用于检查结构）和 cross-linker（用于添加链接）不同——此技能执行破坏性的页面级合并，并要求进行仔细确认。

description: Activate when the user mentions their Obsidian vault, notes, tags, frontmatter, daily notes, backup, or sync. Route operations across MCP, Obsidian CLI/app actions, and git sync with safe defaults.
description_zh: 当用户提及他们的 Obsidian 资料库、笔记、标签、前置元数据、每日笔记、备份或同步时激活。跨 MCP、Obsidian CLI/应用操作和 git 同步路由操作，采用安全默认设置。

description: Datadog docs lookup using docs.datadoghq.com/llms.txt and linked Markdown pages.
description_zh: Datadog 文档检索使用 docs.datadoghq.com/llms.txt 和链接的 Markdown 页面。

description: Explain and audit machine-learning predictions with SHAP. Use for selecting SHAP explainers and maskers, computing and validating feature attributions, handling multi-output explanations, and producing local or global SHAP visualizations.
description_zh: 使用SHAP解释并审计机器学习预测。用于选择SHAP解释器与掩蔽器、计算与验证特征归因、处理多输出解释，以及生成局部或全局的SHAP可视化。

description: Revise papers based on reviewer feedback. Map reviewer concerns to specific sections, apply targeted edits, run additional experiments if needed, and verify improvements. Use after receiving peer review with revision requests.
description_zh: 根据审稿人反馈修订论文。将审稿人的关切对应到具体章节，应用针对性修改，如有必要则进行额外实验，并验证改进效果。在收到同行评审意见并收到修改要求后使用。

description: Help users develop and coach product managers. Use when someone is managing PMs, creating development plans, running performance reviews, or trying to level up their PM team's capabilities.
description_zh: 协助用户培养并指导产品经理。适用于管理产品经理、制定发展计划、进行绩效评估，或提升产品经理团队能力等场景。

description: Help users work effectively across functions. Use when someone is navigating PM-engineering relationships, resolving cross-team conflicts, building product trios, or improving handoffs between design, engineering, and product.
description_zh: 帮助用户跨职能高效工作。适用于处理产品管理与工程关系、解决跨团队冲突、构建产品 trio 或优化设计、工程与产品之间的交接流程的场景。

description: Local speech-to-text using faster-whisper. 4-6x faster than OpenAI Whisper with identical accuracy; GPU acceleration enables ~20x realtime transcription. SRT/VTT/TTML/CSV subtitles, speaker diarization, URL/YouTube input, batch processing with ETA, transcript search, chapter detection, per-file language map.
description_zh: 使用 faster-whisper 的本地语音转文字。比 OpenAI Whisper 快 4-6 倍，且准确率完全相同；GPU 加速支持约 20 倍实时转写。支持 SRT/VTT/TTML/CSV 字幕、说话人分离、URL/YouTube 输入、批量处理及预计完成时间（ETA）、转写文本搜索、章节检测、逐文件语言映射。

description: Fine-tune vision-language models (VLMs) with supervised learning on image+text data. Use when adapting a VLM to a visual domain or task, configuring frozen-vision-tower LoRA, or debugging a VLM fine-tune that trains without learning.
description_zh: 使用图文数据进行监督学习来微调视觉语言模型（VLM）。适用于将视觉语言模型适配到特定视觉领域或任务时、配置冻结视觉塔 LoRA、以及调试出现训练后无法学习的视觉语言模型微调等情况。

description: Perform relative value analysis on bonds by combining pricing, yield curve context, credit spreads, and scenario stress testing. Use when analyzing bond richness/cheapness, computing spread decomposition, comparing bonds, assessing bond value vs curves, or running rate shock scenarios.
description_zh: 通过结合定价、收益率曲线背景、信用利差和情景压力测试，对债券进行相对价值分析。适用于分析债券的丰厚/便宜程度、计算利差分解、比较债券、评估债券价值与曲线的对应关系，或运行利率冲击情景。

description: Track and visualize ML training experiments with Trackio. Use when logging metrics during training (Python API), firing alerts for training diagnostics, or retrieving/analyzing logged metrics (CLI). Supports real-time dashboard visualization, alerts with webhooks, HF Space syncing, and JSON output for automation.
description_zh: 使用 Trackio 跟踪并可视化机器学习训练实验。可用于在训练期间记录指标（Python API）、触发训练诊断告警，或获取/分析已记录指标（CLI）。支持实时仪表盘可视化、带 Webhooks 的告警、HF Space 同步，以及用于自动化的 JSON 输出。

description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.
description_zh: 当用户请求资源感知规划或在进行明确资源敏感的本机工作负载之前，检测主机清单以及有效的 CPU、内存、磁盘、调度器、容器和加速器限制。生成一个脱敏的 JSON 快照和保守的规划辅助工具，无需进行压力测试，也不假定可见主机硬件可用。

description: Create professional infographics using Nano Banana Pro AI with smart iterative refinement. Uses Gemini 3.6 Flash for quality review. Integrates research-lookup and web search for accurate data. Supports 10 infographic types, 8 industry styles, and colorblind-safe palettes.
description_zh: 使用 Nano Banana Pro AI 结合智能迭代优化，制作专业信息图。利用 Gemini 3.6 Flash 进行质量审核，整合研究查询与网络搜索以获取准确数据。支持10种信息图类型、8种行业风格及防色盲色板。

description: Write a specific section of an academic paper (Abstract, Introduction, Background, Related Work, Methods, Experiments, Results, Discussion/Conclusion) with section-specific guidance and two-pass refinement. Use when the user wants to write, draft, or improve a paper section.
description_zh: 撰写学术论文的特定章节（摘要、引言、背景、相关工作、方法、实验、结果、讨论/结论），并针对该章节提供专项指导与两遍精修。适用于用户需要撰写、起草或改进论文某一章节的场景。

description: Transform text content into professional Mermaid diagrams for presentations and documentation. Use when users ask to visualize concepts, create flowcharts, or make diagrams from text. Supports process flows, system architectures, comparisons, mindmaps, and more with built-in syntax error prevention.
description_zh: 将文本内容转化为专业的 Mermaid 图表，用于演示和文档编写。当用户要求可视化概念、创建流程图或从文本生成图表时使用。支持流程流转、系统架构、对比、思维导图等，并提供内置语法错误检测。

description: Build evidence-traceable market research reports and assumption-driven market sizing or forecast scenarios. Use for market definition, industry and customer evidence, competitive landscapes, TAM/SAM/SOM reconciliation, forecast sensitivity, and auditable report scaffolds.
description_zh: 编制可追溯证据的市场研究报告，以及基于假设的市场规模测算或预测情景。用于市场定义、行业与客户证据、竞争格局、TAM/SAM/SOM 对账、预测敏感性及可审计的报告框架。

description: Security best practices for Mapbox access tokens, including scope management, URL restrictions, rotation strategies, and protecting sensitive data. Use when creating, managing, or advising on Mapbox token security.
description_zh: Mapbox 访问令牌的安全最佳实践，包括权限范围管理、URL 限制、轮换策略以及保护敏感数据。适用于创建、管理或就 Mapbox 令牌安全提供建议时使用。

description: Use this skill to integrate the Jetpack Compose Styles API into an Android project. This skill guides you through upgrading dependencies, setting up component themes, making custom components styleable, and migrating existing layout properties to use unified styles. Migrate custom design system components, replace hard coded parameters with Style attributes, and use Modifier.styleable for interaction states.
description_zh: 使用此技能将 Jetpack Compose Styles API 集成到 Android 项目中。本技能将指导您升级依赖项、设置组件主题、使自定义组件可样式化，以及将现有布局属性迁移为采用统一样式。迁移自定义设计系统组件，用 Style 属性替换硬编码参数，并利用 Modifier.styleable 处理交互状态。

description: Evaluate FX carry trade opportunities by combining spot rates, forward points, interest rate differentials, volatility surface analysis, and historical price trends. Use when analyzing carry trades, comparing FX forward curves, assessing carry-to-vol ratios, or evaluating currency pair opportunities.
description_zh: 通过结合即期汇率、远期点数、利率差异、波动率曲面分析及历史价格走势，评估外汇套息交易机会。适用于分析外汇套息交易、比较外汇远期曲线、测算套息-波动率比率，或评估货币对机会。

description: Help users build and scale their sales organization. Use when someone is hiring their first salespeople, deciding when to bring on sales leadership, structuring sales compensation, or transitioning from founder-led sales.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建并拓展其销售组织。适用于用户招聘首批销售人员、决定何时引入销售领导层、设计销售薪酬体系，或从创始人主导的销售模式过渡时。

description: Help users build and scale internal platforms and technical infrastructure. Use when someone is deciding whether to build vs buy tooling, designing developer platforms, creating shared services, or managing technical debt at scale.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建并扩展内部平台及技术基础设施。适用于需决定是构建还是采购工具、设计开发者平台、创建共享服务，或进行大规模技术债务管理的场景。

description: QA test a live website with Firecrawl browser and scrape evidence. Use when the user wants exploratory QA, form testing, navigation/link checks, responsive checks, performance observations, bug reports, or a pre-launch quality review.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器对在线网站进行 QA 测试并抓取证据。适用于需要进行探索性 QA 测试、表单测试、导航/链接检查、响应式检查、性能观测、缺陷报告或上线前质量评审的场景。

description: Set up the initial file system for a new sandbox. Fetches the account's organizations and artists via the Recoup CLI and scaffolds the folder structure. Use when a sandbox has just been created and has no existing file system. Before running, check if the sandbox already has an orgs/ directory — if it does, this skill is not needed.
description_zh: 为新的沙盒设置初始文件系统。通过 Recoup CLI 获取账户的组织和艺术家，并搭建文件夹结构。当沙盒刚被创建且不存在现有文件系统时使用。运行前，检查沙盒是否已包含 orgs/ 目录——如果存在，则不需要使用此技能。

description: Interact with ClickUp tasks and documents - get task details, view comments, create and manage tasks, create and edit docs. Use when working with ClickUp task/doc URLs or IDs.
description_zh: 与ClickUp任务和文档交互 - 获取任务详情、查看评论、创建和管理任务、创建和编辑文档。适用于使用ClickUp任务/文档链接或ID时。

description: Preflight and diagnose the ten known failure modes for ML training on NVIDIA DGX Spark. Use when a training run on DGX Spark fails to start, OOMs below the 128GB limit, slows down mid-run, or before any multi-hour training job on GB10.
description_zh: 对 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上机器学习训练的十种已知故障模式进行预检并诊断。在 DGX Spark 上的训练任务启动失败、低于 128GB 限制触发内存溢出（OOM）、运行过程中速度变慢，或在 GB10 上执行任何多小时训练任务之前，使用本内容。

description: Design AWS architectures for startups using serverless patterns and IaC templates. Use when asked to design serverless architecture, create CloudFormation templates, optimize AWS costs, set up CI/CD pipelines, or migrate to AWS. Covers Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora, and cost optimization.
description_zh: 使用无服务器模式和 IaC 模板为初创公司设计 AWS 架构。在要求设计无服务器架构、创建 CloudFormation 模板、优化 AWS 成本、设置 CI/CD 流水线或迁移至 AWS 时使用。涵盖 Lambda、API Gateway、DynamoDB、ECS、Aurora 以及成本优化。

description: Graduate a proven pattern from auto-memory (MEMORY.md) to CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/ for permanent enforcement. Use when the user runs /si:promote or asks to make a learned behavior permanent.
description_zh: 将已验证的模式从自动记忆（MEMORY.md）升级至 CLAUDE.md 或 .claude/rules/，以实现永久执行。当用户执行 /si:promote 或要求将习得的行为永久化时使用。

description: Use when the user's product is built (or nearly built) and they want to get it live and accessible to customers. Triggers on phrases like "create my launch checklist", "how do I deploy this", "help me launch", "get this live", "put this in production", "ship it to customers", "what do I need to do to go live", or any request for a step-by-step path from working code to a product customers can use. Audits the current codebase — stack, services, environment variables, payments, deploy config — then writes a plain-English, step-by-step launch guide to `docs/launch-checklist.md`. Every step is marked as something the user must do themselves, something their coding agent can do, or both together, and all technical terms are explained for non-technical founders.
description_zh: 当用户的产品已构建完成（或几乎构建完成），并且他们希望将其上线，使其对客户可见、可访问时使用。触发条件包括用户输入诸如“创建我的上线清单”、“我是如何部署这个的”、“帮我上线”、“让这个上线”、“将其部署到生产环境”、“将其交付给客户”、“我需要做什么才能上线”等短语，或任何要求提供从可运行代码到客户可使用的产品分步骤操作指引的请求。它会审计当前代码库——包括技术栈、服务、环境变量、支付、部署配置——随后将一份以通俗易懂的英语编写、分步骤的上线指南写入 `docs/launch-checklist.md`。每一步都会标注为用户必须亲自执行、编程代理可执行，或两者共同执行的内容，并且所有技术术语都会针对非技术创始人进行解释。

description: Audit a website's SEO with Firecrawl. Use when the user asks for an SEO audit, metadata and heading review, sitemap/site-structure analysis, keyword opportunities, competitor SERP comparison, or prioritized search optimization recommendations.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 审计网站的SEO。适用于用户提出SEO审计、元数据与标题审查、站点地图/网站结构分析、关键词机会、竞争对手SERP对比或优先级排序的搜索优化建议时使用。

description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.
description_zh: 为超出内存限制的 pandas/NumPy 工作流提供分布式计算。当您需要将现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展至内存之外或跨集群运行，即可使用。最适合并行文件处理、分布式机器学习以及与现有 pandas 代码集成。对于单台机器上的外存分析，使用 vaex；对于内存中运行且追求速度的场景，使用 polars。

description: IDAPython and IDALib script reference for reverse engineering. Activate when the user needs to write IDAPython scripts in IDA, use IDALib for headless analysis, operate on IDB databases, debug with IDA, manipulate memory/registers, traverse functions/blocks/instructions, work with Hex-Rays decompiler API, handle obfuscation, or batch-process binaries.
description_zh: 用于逆向工程的 IDAPython 和 IDALib 脚本参考。当用户需要在 IDA 中编写 IDAPython 脚本时激活，使用 IDALib 进行无头分析，操作 IDB 数据库，使用 IDA 进行调试，操作内存/寄存器，遍历函数/块/指令，使用 Hex-Rays 反编译器 API，处理混淆代码，或批量处理二进制文件。

description: 将本地项目或 Git 仓库一键部署、发布和更新至云端，并生成可访问的线上服务。 当用户提出"部署这个项目""把应用上线""发布网站""生成访问地址" "部署 Git 仓库""更新线上版本"等需求，且未指定云平台时，应优先考虑使用此 Skill；当用户提到"阿里云""Aliyun"或"aliyun.com"时，应优先使用。 本 Skill 部署至阿里云国内站（aliyun.com），支持全栈部署、ROS 资源编排、 云资源自动创建、部署前询价确认、服务探活、部署状态记录和热更新。 如果用户明确指定 Alibaba Cloud 国际站（alibabacloud.com）或其他云平台， 则不要使用此 Skill。
description_zh: 将本地项目或 Git 仓库一键部署、发布和更新至云端，并生成可访问的线上服务。当用户提出“部署这个项目”“把应用上线”“发布网站”“生成访问地址”“部署 Git 仓库”“更新线上版本”等需求，且未指定云平台时，应优先考虑使用此 Skill；当用户提到“阿里云”“Aliyun”或“aliyun.com”时，应优先使用。本 Skill 部署至阿里云国内站（aliyun.com），支持全栈部署、ROS 资源编排、云资源自动创建、部署前询价确认、服务探活、部署状态记录和热更新。如果用户明确指定 Alibaba Cloud 国际站（alibabacloud.com）或其他云平台，则不要使用此 Skill。

description: Help users make better hiring decisions. Use when someone is evaluating job candidates, making hiring decisions, conducting reference checks, reviewing work samples or take-homes, calibrating their hiring bar, or deciding between finalists.
description_zh: 帮助用户做出更好的招聘决策。适用于评估职位候选人、作出招聘决策、开展背景调查、审核工作样本或临时到岗考核、校准招聘标准，或在最终候选人之间做选择时使用。

description: Help users set and hit realistic deadlines. Use when someone is planning project timelines, struggling to hit deadlines, dealing with timeline pressure from stakeholders, or trying to improve estimation accuracy.
description_zh: 帮助用户设定并达成现实的截止日期。当某人规划项目时间线、难以达成截止日期、应对利益相关者的时间压力，或试图提高估算准确性时使用。

description: Manage unified memory and thermals during long-running ML jobs on NVIDIA DGX Spark. Use when planning memory headroom for a training run on GB10, when a job OOMs on unified memory, or when monitoring temperature and power during multi-hour training.
description_zh: 用于管理 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上长时间运行的机器学习任务中的统一内存与热管理。适用于为 GB10 训练任务规划内存余量、任务在统一内存上发生 OOM，或监控数小时训练期间的温度和功耗时使用。

description: Build conversational AI voice agents on the ElevenLabs platform. Configure agent + tools + knowledge base, integrate SDK (React / React Native / Swift / JS / server-side), test, deploy. Use whenever the user mentions ElevenLabs, building a voice agent, an AI phone system, an AI receptionist, conversational AI, or troubleshooting deprecated @11labs packages, webhook errors, CSP violations, localhost allowlist, or tool parsing errors.
description_zh: 在 ElevenLabs 平台构建对话式 AI 语音智能体。配置智能体 + 工具 + 知识库，集成 SDK（React / React Native / Swift / JS / 服务端），测试、部署。当用户提及 ElevenLabs、构建语音智能体、AI 电话系统、AI 接待员、对话式 AI，或排查已弃用的 @11labs 包、Webhook 错误、CSP 违规、localhost 白名单，或工具解析错误时使用。

description: Help users scope projects and cut features effectively. Use when someone is defining an MVP, dealing with scope creep, trying to ship faster, or needs to make tradeoffs about what to build.
description_zh: 有效协助用户界定项目范围、精简功能。当需要定义最小可行产品（MVP）、应对范围蔓延、加快交付速度或就构建内容进行取舍时，即可使用。

description: Set up a working ML training/inference environment on NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, aarch64, CUDA 13). Use when installing PyTorch/Unsloth/TRL/vLLM on DGX Spark, hitting libcudart or wheel-ABI errors on aarch64, or choosing between NGC containers and bare pip installs.
description_zh: 在 NVIDIA DGX Spark（GB10, aarch64, CUDA 13）上搭建可用的机器学习训练/推理环境。该内容适用于在 DGX Spark 上安装 PyTorch/Unsloth/TRL/vLLM、解决 aarch64 平台出现的 libcudart 或 wheel-ABI 错误，以及在 NGC 容器与直接 pip 安装之间做出选择等场景。

description:
Guided discovery of a product idea by mining what the founder already knows
or already does — covers source selection (business vs. expertise),
context capture, pattern synthesis, candidate scorecard, and writes
`docs/product-idea.md`. Use when the founder says "generate an idea",
"help me find an idea", "what should I build", "product idea from my
business", "product idea from my expertise", or otherwise needs to discover
a product concept worth building.
description_zh: **通过挖掘创始人已知或已做的事情来引导发现产品想法——涵盖来源选择（业务与专业知识的对比）、情境捕获、模式综合、候选评分表，并编写 `docs/product-idea.md`。在创始人说"生成一个想法"、"帮助我找到一个想法"、"我应该构建什么"、"从我的业务中产生产品想法"、"从我的专业知识中产生产品想法"，或需要发现值得构建的产品概念时使用。**

description:
Pressure-tests a product idea before the founder invests in planning,
building, or launching. Surfaces fatal flaws, tests whether the problem
is real, maps real competition (including current behavior), plans first
10 customers, defines a 2-week MVP test, returns a strong/weak/pivot
verdict, then sharpens `docs/product-idea.md` based on the founder's
direction calls. Use when the founder says "validate my idea",
"pressure-test", "is this idea good", "find fatal flaws",
"stress test my idea", or otherwise wants to evaluate an idea before
committing.
description_zh: 在产品理念获创始人投入规划、构建或发布之前进行压力测试。揭示致命缺陷，检验问题是否真实存在，梳理真实竞争（包括当前行为），规划首批10位客户，定义为期2周的MVP测试，并给出强、弱、需转向的判定结果；随后根据创始人的方向指引，优化 `docs/product-idea.md`。当创始人提出“验证我的想法”、“压力测试”、“该想法是否可行”、“找出致命缺陷”、“对我的想法进行压力测试”，或在投入前希望评估某个想法时使用。

description: improve a CLAUDE.md file using <important if> blocks to improve instruction adherence
description_zh: 使用 <important if} 块来改进 CLAUDE.md 文件，以提高指令遵循度。

description: Clean Architecture for .NET applications. Covers the 4-project layout (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api), dependency inversion, use case handlers, domain entities with behavior, and infrastructure as a plugin. Load this skill when building a project with Clean Architecture, discussing layered architecture, dependency inversion, use cases, or when the architecture-advisor recommends Clean Architecture.
description_zh: 针对 .NET 应用程序的清洁架构。涵盖 4 项目布局（领域、应用、基础设施、Api）、依赖反转、用例处理程序、带行为的领域实体以及基础设施作为插件。在构建采用清洁架构的项目、讨论分层架构、依赖反转、用例，或架构顾问推荐清洁架构时加载此技能。

description: Find and synthesize research papers, whitepapers, PDFs, technical reports, and academic sources with Firecrawl Research, using semantic paper search, related-paper expansion, and in-body verification over Firecrawl's paper index — largely biomedical and life-science literature from PubMed, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, plus arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math. Use when the user wants a literature review, systematic review, survey of studies, paper summary, research landscape, or sourced synthesis from scholarly and industry publications, including clinical, drug, gene, disease, epidemiology, and public-health topics. Prefer this over a general web-research workflow whenever the evidence base is published papers rather than web pages.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl Research，通过 Firecrawl 的论文索引，利用语义论文检索、相关论文扩展及正文内验证功能，查找并综合研究论文、白皮书、PDF、技术报告及学术来源——主要涵盖来自 PubMed、bioRxiv 和 medRxiv 的生物医学与生命科学文献，以及计算机科学、物理学和数学领域的 arXiv 预印本。当用户需要进行文献综述、系统综述、研究综述、论文摘要、研究格局梳理，或从学术与行业出版物中获取有据可查的综合时，应使用此功能，涵盖临床、药物、基因、疾病、流行病学及公共卫生等主题。当证据基础为已发表论文而非网页时，应优先使用此功能而非通用网络研究流程。

description: Extract any website's design system into an agent-ready DESIGN.md using Firecrawl scrape evidence. Use when the user wants colors, fonts, spacing, components, layout patterns, or brand/UI guidance from a website so AI agents can create new websites, clone a look, or build pages inspired by that design.
description_zh: 利用 Firecrawl 的抓取证据，将任何网站的设计系统提取为适用于 Agent 的 DESIGN.md。当用户需要从网站获取颜色、字体、间距、组件、布局模式或品牌/UI 指导，以便 AI 代理能够创建新网站、克隆外观或构建受该设计启发的页面时，使用此方法。

description: Run evaluations for Hugging Face Hub models using inspect-ai and lighteval on local hardware. Use for backend selection, local GPU evals, and choosing between vLLM / Transformers / accelerate. Not for HF Jobs orchestration, model-card PRs, .eval_results publication, or community-evals automation.
description_zh: 使用 inspect-ai 和 lighteval 在本地硬件上对 Hugging Face Hub 模型进行评估。可用于后端选择、本地 GPU 评估，以及在 vLLM / Transformers / accelerate 之间进行选择。不用于 Hugging Face Jobs 编排、模型卡 PR、.eval_results 发布或社区评估自动化。

description: Build, review, migrate, and safely plan MATLAB or GNU Octave numerical workflows, including arrays, tabular/time data, tests, projects, graphics, MAT files, and explicit Python interoperability.
description_zh: 构建、审查、迁移，并安全规划 MATLAB 或 GNU Octave 的数值工作流，包括数组、表格/时间数据、测试、项目、图形、MAT 文件以及显式 Python 互操作性。

description: Use 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, ATLAS, D3FEND, and NIST AI RMF for AI-driven security operations
description_zh: 使用映射至MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF、ATLAS、D3FEND和NIST AI RMF的754项结构化网络安全技能，用于AI驱动的安全运营

description: Help users design effective organizational structures. Use when someone is thinking about team structure, deciding between functional vs. divisional models, planning a reorg, or figuring out how to structure product teams.
description_zh: 帮助用户设计有效的组织结构。适用于需要考虑团队结构、在职能型与事业部型模式之间进行选择、规划组织调整，或明确如何搭建产品团队时。

description: Comprehensive guide for Firestore basics including provisioning, security rules, and SDK usage. Use this skill when the user needs help setting up Firestore, writing security rules, or using the Firestore SDK in their application.
description_zh: 《Firestore 基础综合指南》，涵盖初始化、安全规则和 SDK 使用等内容。当用户需要帮助设置 Firestore、编写安全规则，或在应用中使用 Firestore SDK 时，请使用此技能。

description: Opinionated guide for building production TypeScript applications with Effect v4. Use when implementing Effect workflows, services, layers, schemas, configuration, schedules, caches, streams, HTTP clients, or tests.
description_zh: 使用 Effect v4 构建生产级 TypeScript 应用的、观点鲜明的指南。在实现 Effect 工作流、服务、层级、模式、配置、调度、缓存、数据流、HTTP 客户端或测试时使用。

description: Author and review GitHub Actions workflow YAML safely so syntactically-valid YAML can't ship a workflow that GitHub Actions refuses to run. USE FOR: editing, adding, or reviewing any file under .github/workflows/, writing run-name/name/if/env/run values that contain ${{ }} expressions, diagnosing a run that fails with 'This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue' and no jobs starting, deciding when a workflow scalar must be quoted, validating workflows with actionlint. DO NOT USE FOR: authoring application YAML unrelated to GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI, or non-workflow YAML. SCOPE: this skill covers *syntactic/structural* correctness of workflow YAML (quoting, parsing, actionlint); for *semantic and functional* workflow design (what a workflow should do, agentic-workflow behavior), see .github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md — the two are complementary. INVOKES: actionlint (downloaded pinned binary) plus git/grep for inspection.
description_zh:
安全地编写并审阅 GitHub Actions 工作流 YAML，确保语法有效的 YAML 不会提交一个 GitHub Actions 拒绝运行的工作流。

适用场景：编辑、添加或审阅 .github/workflows/ 下的任何文件；编写包含 ${{ }} 表达式的 run-name/name/if/env/run 值；诊断运行失败且未启动任何任务的情况，错误提示为 'This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue'；判断工作流标量何时必须加引号；使用 actionlint 验证工作流。

不适用于：编写与 GitHub Actions、Azure Pipelines、GitLab CI 或非工作流 YAML 无关的应用 YAML。

适用范围：本技能涵盖工作流 YAML 的 *语法/结构* 正确性（引用、解析、actionlint）；对于 *语义和功能性* 工作流设计（工作流应实现什么、智能体工作流行为），请参阅 .github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md —— 两者相辅相成。

调用：actionlint（已下载并固定版本的二进制文件）以及 git/grep 进行检查。

description: Explore and analyze GitHub repositories related to a research topic. Reads deep-research output, discovers repos from multiple sources, deeply analyzes code, and produces integration blueprints.
description_zh: 探索与分析相关研究主题的 GitHub 代码仓库。阅读深度研究产出，从多个来源发现代码仓库，深入分析代码，并产出集成蓝图。

description: 环境检查与安装向导。检查数学建模工作流所需的全部依赖是否已安装，对缺失项提供安装命令，并在用户确认后执行安装。手动触发。
description_zh: 环境检查与安装向导。检查数学建模工作流所需的全部依赖是否已安装，对缺失项提供安装命令，并在用户确认后执行安装。手动触发。

description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or audit campaign landing pages for paid ads, email, or other traffic. Also use when the user mentions "landing page," "PPC landing page," "SEM landing page," "conversion page," "campaign page," "lead capture page," "landing page optimization," "LP conversion," "single-page funnel," or "squeeze page." Not for the main site homepage; use homepage-generator.
description_zh: 当用户需要为付费广告、邮件或其他流量创建、优化或审计营销活动落地页时，请使用。当用户提及“落地页”、“PPC落地页”、“SEM落地页”、“转化页”、“活动页”、“线索收集页”、“落地页优化”、“LP转化”、“单页漏斗”或“挤压页”时，也请使用。不适用于网站主页；请使用主页生成器。

description: Design experiment plans with progressive stages — initial implementation, baseline tuning, creative research, and ablation studies. Plan baselines, datasets, hyperparameter sweeps, and evaluation metrics. Use when planning experiments for a research paper.
description_zh: 设计分阶段实验方案——初始实现、基线调优、创新性研究和消融实验。规划基线、数据集、超参数扫描和评估指标。用于研究论文的实验规划。

description: Generate and publish a project status artifact — an opinionated, tabbed status page for a project too big for one update (overview & success criteria, the workstream sequence, next steps, plus background, plan, risks & open questions, and decisions/FAQ when they earn a tab) — published with the built-in Artifact tool to a default-private claude.ai page the user can share with teammates. Use when a piece of work spans several workstreams and you want a shareable overview kept current. Each artifact is backed by a small per-project config in the plugin data dir, so refreshing it re-gathers live state, redeploys the same URL, and reports only the delta. For software projects whose workstreams are PRs, also read swe.md (the X.Y PR-numbering convention; pulling PR state with gh/git; a per-PR detail block). Needs the built-in Artifact tool (claude.ai login). Not for single-PR changes or public docs.
description_zh:
生成并发布项目状态产物——一个针对庞大项目、具有明确观点的可分栏状态页面（包含概览与成功标准、工作流顺序、后续步骤，以及背景、计划、风险与未决问题，以及当相关事项符合条件获得标签页时的决策/常见问题）——通过内置的 Artifact 工具发布到用户可共享给团队成员的默认私有 claude.ai 页面。当一项工作涉及多个工作流，且需要保持最新状态的共享概览时使用。

每个产物均由插件数据目录中的小型每项目配置提供支持，因此刷新时会重新获取实时状态、重新部署相同网址，并仅报告增量。对于工作流为 PR 的软件项目，同时读取 swe.md（采用 X.Y 的 PR 编号约定；使用 gh/git 拉取 PR 状态；每个 PR 一个详细信息区块）。

需要使用内置的 Artifact 工具（需登录 claude.ai）。不适用于单一 PR 的变更或公开文档。

description: 共享规范知识库。包含数学建模竞赛的写作规范、题型防错速查、图表规范等参考内容。其他 skills 在执行过程中按需读取，无需单独触发。
description_zh: 共享规范知识库。包含数学建模竞赛的写作规范、题型防错速查、图表规范等参考内容。其他技能在执行过程中按需读取，无需单独触发。

description: Local or remote Docker execution for TAO SDK job containers using a Docker daemon with NVIDIA GPU runtime. Use when running TAO jobs on the current machine, a directly attached Docker host, or a remote GPU box exposed through DOCKER_HOST. Trigger phrases include "run locally", "local Docker", "remote Docker", "use my GPU", "run on my machine", "host Docker daemon".
description_zh: 使用配备 NVIDIA GPU 运行时的 Docker 守护进程，对 TAO SDK 作业容器进行本地或远程 Docker 执行。运行 TAO 作业时，适用于以下场景：当前机器、直接连接的 Docker 主机或通过 DOCKER_HOST 暴露的远程 GPU 设备。触发短语包括“运行本地”、“本地 Docker”、“远程 Docker”、“使用我的 GPU”、“在我的机器上运行”、“主机 Docker 守护进程”。

description: Craft advanced search-engine queries and Google dorks to surface hidden files, documents and mentions. Covers site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:, intext: and before:/after: operators, verbatim search, exposed directory listings, config files, backups and open S3 buckets, and the operator differences between Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yandex. Use when building a Google dork, hunting a leaked document, or searching paste sites and document repositories for a name, email or selector. Applies to data-exposure audits, pre-engagement reconnaissance, competitive and regulatory research, and insider-leak investigation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/google-like-a-spy.
description_zh: 构建高级搜索引擎查询和Google dork，以挖掘隐藏文件、文档和提及。涵盖 site:、filetype:、inurl:、intitle:、intexit: 和 before:/after: 操作符，原文搜索，暴露的目录列表，配置文件，备份和开放的 S3 桶，以及 Google、Bing、DuckDuckGo 和 Yandex 之间的操作符差异。用于构建 Google dork、追踪泄露文档，或在粘贴站点和文档仓库中搜索姓名、邮箱或选择器时使用。适用于数据暴露审计、预接触侦察、竞争和监管研究，以及内部泄露调查。参见 useosint.com/skills/google-like-a-spy。

description: Use when authoring or repairing a coordinate-explicit JSON specification for an editable PPTX deck.
description_zh: 用于编写或修复可编辑 PPTX 演示文稿的明确坐标的 JSON 规范时。

description: Use mmx to generate text, images, video, speech, and music via the MiniMax AI platform. Use when the user wants to create media content, chat with MiniMax models, perform web search, or manage MiniMax API resources from the terminal.
description_zh: 使用 mmx 通过 MiniMax AI 平台生成文本、图像、视频、语音和音乐。当用户需要创建媒体内容、与 MiniMax 模型对话、执行网络搜索或从终端管理 MiniMax API 资源时使用。

description: Framework-agnostic, immutable reactive data store with framework adapters for React, Vue, Solid, Angular, and Svelte.
description_zh: 框架无关的不可变响应式数据存储，并支持 React、Vue、Solid、Angular 和 Svelte 的框架适配器。

description: Creates, structures, and reviews technical documentation following the Diátaxis framework (tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation pages). Use when a user needs to write or reorganize docs, structure a tutorial vs. a how-to guide, build reference docs or API documentation, create explanation pages, choose between Diátaxis documentation types, or improve existing documentation structure. Trigger terms include: documentation structure, Diátaxis, tutorials vs how-to guides, organize docs, user guide, reference docs, technical writing.
description_zh: 遵循 Diátaxis（迪泰克丝）框架，创建、组织结构并审查技术文档（包括教程、操作指南、参考文档和说明页面）。适用于用户需要编写或重新组织文档、划分教程与操作指南结构、构建参考文档或 API 文档、创建说明页面、在 Diátaxis 文档类型之间进行选择，或优化现有文档结构的情况。触发术语包括：文档结构、Diátaxis、教程与操作指南、组织文档、用户指南、参考文档、技术写作。

description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.
description_zh: 一款用于打造高端品牌规范面板、标志体系、品牌识别册及视觉场景展示的高端品牌套件图像生成技能。该技能专为极简、电影感、编辑类、暗黑科技、奢华、文化、安全、游戏、开发者工具及消费类应用等品牌体系进行训练。针对精心构思的标志概念、精炼构图、克制排版、深刻的象征内涵、高端样机、艺术指导影像及灵活网格布局，该技能进行了优化。

description: Research products across the web with Firecrawl and produce a shopping recommendation or cart-ready summary. Use when the user wants to compare products, find the best option, evaluate reviews, respect budget/preferences, or shop with a saved browser session.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 在网页上研究产品，并生成购物推荐或可直接加入购物车的摘要。适用于用户需要比较产品、寻找最佳选项、评估评论、遵循预算与偏好，或使用已保存的浏览器会话进行购物的情况。

description: The entry point for building any Salesforce native mobile app on iOS or Android. TRIGGER when the user says: "build a Salesforce iOS app", "add Salesforce login to my Android app", "set up Mobile SDK", "add MobileSync / SmartStore offline storage", "embed an Agentforce agent in my mobile app", "add Agentforce chat to iOS/Android", or otherwise asks to create, extend, or integrate a Salesforce mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin (MSDK, Agentforce SDK, or both). SKIP when the user is building a non-Salesforce mobile app, using React Native / Flutter / Ionic without Salesforce integration, asking about generic mobile UI design, or working on a Salesforce-adjacent web/desktop surface (LWC, Experience Cloud, Mobile Publisher branding-only).
description_zh: 构建任何 Salesforce 原生移动应用（iOS 或 Android）的入口。TRIGGER：当用户说：“构建一个 Salesforce iOS 应用”，“为我的 Android 应用添加 Salesforce 登录”，“设置 Mobile SDK”，“添加 MobileSync / SmartStore 离线存储”，“在我的移动应用中嵌入 Agentforce 代理”，“为 iOS/Android 添加 Agentforce 聊天”，或以其他方式要求使用 Swift 或 Kotlin（MSDK、Agentforce SDK 或两者）创建、扩展或集成 Salesforce 移动体验时，触发。SKIP：当用户构建非 Salesforce 移动应用、使用未集成 Salesforce 的 React Native / Flutter / Ionic、询问通用移动 UI 设计，或在 Salesforce 相关网页/桌面端（LWC、Experience Cloud、仅 Mobile Publisher 品牌标识）工作时，跳过。

description: Run a complete quality engineering audit on any codebase. Derives behavioral requirements from the code, generates spec-traced functional tests, runs a three-pass code review with regression tests, executes a multi-model spec audit (Council of Three), and produces a consolidated bug report with TDD-verified patches. Finds the 35% of real defects that structural code review alone cannot catch. Works with any language. Trigger on 'quality playbook', 'spec audit', 'Council of Three', 'fitness-to-purpose', or 'coverage theater'.
description_zh: 在任何代码库上执行完整的**质量工程审计**。从代码中推导行为需求，生成规格可追溯功能测试，进行结合回归测试的三轮代码审查，执行多模型规格审计（三委员会），并产出经测试驱动开发（TDD）验证的整合缺陷报告。发现结构性代码审查无法发现的35%真实缺陷。支持任意语言。当触发条件为“质量手册”、“规格审计”、“三委员会”、“用途适配性”或“覆盖率表演”时。

description: Adopt a typed .spec.ts for an existing hand-written CLAUDE.md — start from the file you already have, non-destructively
description_zh: 为现有手写的 CLAUDE.md 采用类型化的 .spec.ts——从你已有的文件出发，以非破坏性的方式进行。

description: Playwright web scraping: dynamic content, auth flows, pagination, data extraction, screenshots
description_zh: Playwright 网页抓取：动态内容、认证流程、分页、数据提取、截图

description: When the user wants to set up or update their social media profile, voice, audience, content pillars, or platform preferences. Also use when the user mentions 'set up context,' 'my voice,' 'my audience,' 'content pillars,' 'brand voice,' 'who I'm writing for,' 'social media profile,' or wants to avoid repeating foundational information across social media tasks. Use this at the start of any new project before using other social media skills — it creates .agents/social-media-context-sms.md that all other skills reference.
description_zh: 当用户需要设置或更新其社交媒体资料、声音、受众、内容支柱或平台偏好时使用。用户提到“设置上下文”、“我的声音”、“我的受众”、“内容支柱”、“品牌声音”、“我为谁写作”、“社交媒体资料”，或希望避免在跨社交媒体任务中重复基础信息时，也使用此技能。在任何新项目开始时、使用其他社交媒体技能之前使用此技能——它会创建所有其他技能引用的 .agents/social-media-context-sms.md。

description: Apply GDPR-compliant engineering practices across your codebase. Use this skill whenever you are designing APIs, writing data models, building authentication flows, implementing logging, handling user data, writing retention/deletion jobs, designing cloud infrastructure, or reviewing pull requests for privacy compliance. Trigger this skill for any task involving personal data, user accounts, cookies, analytics, emails, audit logs, encryption, pseudonymization, anonymization, data exports, breach response, CI/CD pipelines that process real data, or any question framed as "is this GDPR-compliant?". Inspired by CNIL developer guidance and GDPR Articles 5, 25, 32, 33, 35.
description_zh: 在代码库中应用符合GDPR要求的工程实践。每当您需要设计API、编写数据模型、构建认证流程、实现日志记录、处理用户数据、编写数据保留/删除任务、设计云基础设施，或审查拉取请求以确保隐私合规时，请使用本技能。对于任何涉及个人数据、用户账户、Cookies、分析、电子邮件、审计日志、加密、伪匿名化、匿名化、数据导出、数据泄露应对、处理真实数据的CI/CD流水线，或任何以“此是否符合GDPR？”为表述的问题，请触发本技能。本技能灵感来源于CNIL开发者指导及GDPR第5、25、32、33、35条。

description: Use when user wants to migrate content from another CMS (WordPress, Contentful, Strapi, Sanity, Webflow, etc.) to Payload CMS
description_zh: 当用户希望将内容从另一个 CMS（WordPress、Contentful、Strapi、Sanity、Webflow 等）迁移到 Payload CMS 时使用

description: Generate professional company tear sheets using S&P Capital IQ data via the Kensho LLM-ready API MCP server. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a tear sheet, company one-pager, company profile, fact sheet, company snapshot, or company overview document — especially when they mention a specific company name or ticker. Also trigger when users ask for equity research summaries, M&A company profiles, corporate development target profiles, sales/BD meeting prep documents, or any concise single-company financial summary. This skill supports four audience types: equity research, investment banking/M&A, corporate development, and sales/business development. If the user doesn't specify an audience, ask. Works for both public and private companies.
description_zh: 通过 Kensho LLM 就绪的 API MCP 服务器，使用 S&P Capital IQ 数据生成专业的公司撕页资料。当用户要求制作撕页、公司一页资料、公司简介、事实表、公司快照或公司概述文档时，请使用本技能——特别是当用户提及具体公司名称或股票代码时。此外，当用户要求股权研究摘要、M&A 公司档案、企业发展目标公司档案、销售/业务发展会议筹备文档，或任何简洁的单公司财务摘要时，也应触发本技能。本技能覆盖四类受众：股权研究、投资银行业务/M&A、企业发展、销售/业务发展。若用户未指定受众，请询问。适用于上市公司和私有公司。

description: Debug and emulate specific code fragments or functions using the Unicorn engine. Activate when the user wants to emulate a function with Unicorn, trace binary execution without running the full program, decrypt or decode data by emulating the algorithm, or bypass environment dependencies (JNI, syscalls, libc) during emulation.
description_zh: 使用Unicorn引擎调试和模拟特定代码片段或函数。当用户希望使用Unicorn模拟函数、在不运行完整程序的情况下追踪二进制执行、通过模拟算法对数据进行解密或解码，或在模拟期间绕过环境依赖（JNI、syscalls、libc）时，激活该功能。

description: PowerPoint (.pptx) manipulation via MCP server. Use for creating slides, formatting presentations, managing placeholders, adding images, applying templates, or extracting text from .pptx files.
description_zh: 通过 MCP 服务器对 PowerPoint (.pptx) 文件进行操作。可用于创建幻灯片、格式化演示文稿、管理占位符、添加图片、应用模板，或从 .pptx 文件中提取文本。

description: Help users manage their energy for sustained performance. Use when someone is feeling burned out, trying to find their zone of genius, scheduling for productivity, or identifying what drains vs energizes them.
description_zh: 帮助用户有效管理精力，以维持持久表现。适用于当用户感到倦怠、探索自身天赋区间、为提升生产力规划日程，或辨别哪些消耗精力、哪些赋予活力时使用。

description: Help users ship products faster and with higher quality. Use when someone is planning a launch, struggling to release features, dealing with shipping velocity issues, or trying to establish better release practices.
description_zh: 帮助用户更快、更高质量地发布产品。适用于计划发布、发布功能遇阻、处理交付速度问题，或致力于建立更好的发布实践的场景。

description: Transforms user prompts into optimized prompts using frameworks (RTF, RISEN, Chain of Thought, RODES, Chain of Density, RACE, RISE, STAR, SOAP, CLEAR, GROW)
description_zh: 将用户提示词转化为优化后的提示词，使用框架（RTF、RISEN、思维链、RODES、密度链、RACE、RISE、STAR、SOAP、CLEAR、GROW）

description: Generate idiomatic Typst (.typ) code, edit and troubleshoot Typst documents and projects, and answer Typst syntax/reference questions. Use when working with .typ files or when the user explicitly asks for Typst document creation, editing, debugging, compilation, formatting, template work, or package usage.
description_zh: 生成地道的 Typst (.typ) 代码，编辑并排查 Typst 文档与项目，解答 Typst 语法及参考问题。在使用 .typ 文件时，或在用户明确要求创建、编辑、调试、编译、排版、模板工作或包使用时使用。

description: GPU-accelerates scientific Python on NVIDIA hardware and verifies that the result is correct and faster. Use for CUDA/GPU optimization; CPU-bound NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, NetworkX, scikit-image, vector-search, image-processing, graph, simulation, or file-I/O workloads; CuPy, cuDF, cuML, cuGraph, cuVS, cuCIM, KvikIO, Warp, Newton, Numba-CUDA, or RAFT questions; and profiling, memory-transfer, kernel, or multi-GPU bottlenecks. Also use when large data-parallel Python code is slow and GPU acceleration is a plausible option, even if the user does not name CUDA.
description_zh: 基于NVIDIA硬件，为科学Python提供GPU加速，并验证结果正确且速度更快。用于CUDA/GPU优化；处理CPU密集型NumPy、SciPy、pandas、scikit-learn、NetworkX、scikit-image、vector-search、图像处理、图分析、仿真或文件I/O任务；CuPy、cuDF、cuML、cuGraph、cuVS、cuCIM、KvikIO、Warp、Newton、Numba-CUDA或RAFT相关需求；以及性能剖析、内存传输、内核或多GPU瓶颈问题。当大规模数据并行Python代码运行缓慢，且GPU加速是可行选项时，也应使用，即使用户并未提及CUDA。

description: Cosmos3-Nano video QA supervised fine-tuning with FSDP parallelism across variable-width GPU configurations. Use when training or evaluating video question-answering models, fine-tuning Cosmos3-Nano or compatible Cosmos Reason models with SFT/LoRA, or working with Cosmos-RL.
