Trigger phrases include "fine-tune Cosmos", "Cosmos3 Nano Reasoner", "Cosmos-RL SFT", "video QA fine-tune", "Cosmos3-Nano training".
description_zh: Cosmos3-Nano 视频问答监督微调，支持可变宽度 GPU 配置下的 FSDP 并行性。适用于训练或评估视频问答模型、使用 SFT/LoRA 对 Cosmos3-Nano 或兼容的 Cosmos Reason 模型进行微调，或涉及 Cosmos-RL 的工作。触发短语包括“fine-tune Cosmos”、“Cosmos3 Nano Reasoner”、“Cosmos-RL SFT”、“video QA fine-tune”、“Cosmos3-Nano training”。

description: Expert in building Telegram Mini Apps (TWA) - web apps that run inside Telegram with native-like experience. Covers the TON ecosystem, Telegram Web App API, payments, user authentication, and building viral mini apps that monetize.
description_zh: 构建 Telegram Mini Apps (TWA) 的专家 —— 在 Telegram 内运行、具备原生般体验的网页应用。涵盖 TON 生态系统、Telegram Web App API、支付、用户认证，以及构建病毒式传播的 Mini Apps 并实现变现。

description: Go back through the previous year of work and create a Notion doc that groups relevant links into projects that can then be documented as SRED projects.
description_zh: 回顾过去一年的工作内容，创建一份Notion文档，将相关链接归入对应项目，以便后续将这些项目记录为SRED项目。

description: Cosmos-Embed1 video-text embedding for text-to-video retrieval, video-to-video search, semantic deduplication, and fine-tuning. Use when the user asks to "fine-tune Cosmos-Embed1", "run cosmos-embed inference", "export Cosmos-Embed1", "embed videos", or "search videos with text".
description_zh: Cosmos-Embed1 视频-文本嵌入，用于文本到视频检索、视频到视频搜索、语义去重及微调。当用户要求执行 'fine-tune Cosmos-Embed1'、'run cosmos-embed inference'、'export Cosmos-Embed1'、'embed videos' 或 'search videos with text' 时使用。

description: Fetch official FXMacroData macro release-calendar events for trade planning, macro regime checks, and event-risk filters. Use before CPI, NFP, GDP, PCE, retail sales, PMI, and central-bank decision windows.
description_zh: 获取 FXMacroData 官方宏观发布日历事件，用于交易规划、宏观形势核查与事件风险筛选。请在 CPI、NFP、GDP、PCE、零售销售、PMI 和央行决策窗口之前使用。

description: Use when preparing the narrative, sources, and design context for a new editable PPTX deck.
description_zh: 用于在新可编辑的 PPTX 演示文稿中准备叙事、来源和设计背景时使用。

description: Use when selecting and placing approved supporting icons, images, SVGs, diagrams, or infographics in an editable PPTX deck.
description_zh: 用于在可编辑的 PPTX 演示文稿中选择和放置经批准的辅助图标、图像、SVG、图表或信息图。

description: Migrate from Cypress or Selenium to Playwright. Use when user mentions "cypress", "selenium", "migrate tests", "convert tests", "switch to playwright", "move from cypress", or "replace selenium".
description_zh: 从 Cypress 或 Selenium 迁移到 Playwright。当用户提及“cypress”、“selenium”、“migrate tests”、“convert tests”、“switch to playwright”、“move from cypress”或“replace selenium”时使用。

description: Run outcome-focused Firecrawl workflows that produce deliverables such as research reports, literature reviews over published papers, SEO audits, QA reports, lead lists, knowledge bases, website design systems, and other structured web-data artifacts. Use when the user wants Firecrawl to complete a business, marketing, product, or creative workflow rather than merely scrape a page or integrate API calls into code.
description_zh: 运行以结果为导向的 Firecrawl 工作流，可生成研究报告、针对已发表论文的文献综述、SEO 审计、QA 报告、潜在客户列表、知识库、网站设计系统以及其他结构化网页数据产物等交付物。当用户希望 Firecrawl 完成业务、营销、产品或创意工作流，而不仅仅是抓取页面或将 API 调用集成到代码中时，即可使用此工作流。

description: Build and scale developer-led adoption through ecosystem programs. Use when deciding open vs curated ecosystems, building developer programs, scaling platform adoption, or designing student program pipelines.
description_zh: 通过生态系统项目，构建并扩大开发者驱动的采用。用于在决定开放型还是精选型生态系统、构建开发者项目、扩大平台采用或设计学生项目流程时。

description: Build, evaluate, and audit right-censored or competing-risk survival workflows with scikit-survival, including leakage-safe preprocessing, model selection, probability prediction, and censoring-aware metrics.
description_zh: 使用 scikit-survival 构建、评估和审计右截尾或竞争风险生存分析工作流，包括防数据泄漏的预处理、模型选择、概率预测以及考虑截尾的指标。

description: Shared launch intake for any TAO workflow or action. Use when the user wants to run TAO AutoML, train, evaluate, infer, export, generate TensorRT engines, or launch DEFT/workflow jobs on an execution platform.
description_zh: 适用于任何 TAO 工作流或操作的共享启动入口。当用户需要运行 TAO AutoML、训练、评估、推理、导出，或生成 TensorRT 引擎、在执行平台上启动 DEFT/工作流任务时使用。

description: Expert cuTile programming assistant. Write high-performance GPU kernels using cuTile's tile-based programming model with proper validation and optimization. Supports deep agent orchestration for complex multi-kernel tasks.
description_zh: 专家 cuTile 编程助手。使用 cuTile 基于瓦片的编程模型，结合完善的验证与优化，编写高性能 GPU 内核。支持复杂多内核任务所需的深度智能体编排。

description: Design meeting rhythms, metric reporting, quarterly planning, and decision-making velocity for scaling companies. Use when decisions are slow, planning is broken, the company is growing but alignment is worse, or leadership meetings consume all time without producing decisions.
description_zh: 为规模扩张型企业设计会议节奏、指标报告、季度规划与决策速度。当决策迟缓、规划失效、企业虽在增长但对齐状况更差，或领导层会议占满所有时间却未能做出决策时使用。

description: Drive an open PR to merge-ready from its number — merges the latest base, then loops review-autofix (om-auto-review-pr), built-in CI stabilization, and UI verification (om-auto-qa-pr) until approvable, green, and QA-evidenced. A --ci-only mode drives just CI green on a PR or a plain branch. Files follow-up issues for nits, normalizes labels, hands off to om-approve-merge-pr — never merges itself. Use for "get PR 123 merge-ready".
description_zh: 驱动开放PR从指定编号出发，进入可直接合并的状态——合并最新基线，随后循环执行审查自动修复（om-auto-review-pr）、内置CI稳定性验证以及UI验证（om-auto-qa-pr），直至满足可批准、通过绿色检查且具备QA证据的状态。--ci-only模式仅针对PR或普通分支驱动CI通过。处理后续问题修正（nits），规范化标签，随后将工作移交至om-approve-merge-pr——绝不自行合并。用于实现"使PR 123达到可合并状态"的目标。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks about service status, wants to rename a service, change service icons, link services, or create services with Docker images. For creating services with local code, prefer the `new` skill. For GitHub repo sources, use `new` skill to create empty service then `environment` skill to configure source.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户询问服务状态、希望重命名服务、更改服务图标、关联服务，或使用 Docker 镜像创建服务时使用。在使用本地代码创建服务时，建议使用 `new` 技能。对于 GitHub 仓库来源，使用 `new` 技能创建空服务，然后使用 `environment` 技能配置源。

description: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
description_zh: 使用并行子代理将书籍（PDF/DOCX/EPUB）翻译到任意语言。转换流程：输入 → Markdown 片段 → 翻译后的片段 → HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF。

description: Self-hosted, open-source alternative to Google NotebookLM for AI-powered research and document analysis. Use when organizing research materials into notebooks, ingesting diverse content sources (PDFs, videos, audio, web pages, Office documents), generating AI-powered notes and summaries, creating multi-speaker podcasts from research, chatting with documents using context-aware AI, searching across materials with full-text and vector search, or running custom content transformations. Supports 16+ AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, Groq, and Mistral with complete data privacy through self-hosting.
description_zh: 为 AI 驱动的研究与文档分析提供自托管、开源的 Google NotebookLM 替代方案。适用于将研究资料整理到笔记中、摄入多样化内容来源（PDF、视频、音频、网页、Office 文档）、生成 AI 驱动的笔记和摘要、基于研究制作多说话者播客、借助具备上下文感知能力的 AI 与文档对话、跨材料进行全文检索与向量检索，或运行自定义内容转换。支持 16 家以上 AI 提供商，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Ollama、Groq 和 Mistral，通过自托管实现完整的数据隐私保障。

description: Complete workflow for implementing Mapbox search in applications - from discovery questions to production-ready integration with best practices
description_zh: Mapbox 搜索在应用中的完整实施流程：从探索性问题到结合最佳实践的生产就绪集成

description: Help users navigate tough feedback, performance conversations, and conflict. Use when someone needs to give hard feedback, have a performance conversation, fire someone, address conflict with a colleague, or deliver disappointing news like a denied promotion.
description_zh: 帮助用户应对棘手的反馈、绩效沟通与冲突。当有人需要给出严厉的反馈、进行绩效沟通、解雇员工、处理与同事的冲突，或告知如晋升被拒绝等令人失望的消息时使用。

description: Debug LLM applications using the Phoenix CLI. Fetch traces, spans, and sessions, annotate them, analyze errors, inspect datasets, review experiments, query annotation configs, and use the GraphQL API. Use whenever the user works with a Phoenix instance from the terminal.
description_zh: 使用 Phoenix CLI 调试 LLM 应用。获取跟踪、跨度与会话，对其进行标注，分析错误，检查数据集，审查实验，查询标注配置，并使用 GraphQL API。当用户从终端使用 Phoenix 实例时，请使用。

description: Use Parallel CLI for web search, URL extraction, deep research, structured data enrichment, entity discovery, and recurring web monitoring. Best for requests that explicitly need current web evidence, academic-source discovery, repeated entity lookups, exhaustive reports, or ongoing change tracking.
description_zh: 使用 Parallel CLI 进行网页搜索、URL 提取、深度研究、结构化数据丰富、实体发现和周期性网页监控。最适合明确需要当前网页证据、学术来源发现、重复实体查询、详尽报告或持续变化追踪的请求。

description: Use when analyzing a reference PPTX for read-only structure, theme, typography, layout rhythm, diagnostics, derived template catalogs, or safe OOXML package inspection.
description_zh: 在分析参考PPTX时，用于以只读方式检查结构、主题、排版、布局节奏、诊断、派生模板目录，或安全地进行OOXML包检查。

description: Sync tests with TestRail. Use when user mentions "testrail", "test management", "test cases", "test run", "sync test cases", "push results to testrail", or "import from testrail".
description_zh: 将测试与 TestRail 同步。用户提到“testrail”、“test management”、“test cases”、“test run”、“sync test cases”、“push results to testrail”或“import from testrail”时使用。

description: Bayesian modeling with PyMC. Build hierarchical models, MCMC (NUTS), variational inference, LOO/WAIC comparison, posterior checks, for probabilistic programming and inference.
description_zh: 基于 PyMC 的贝叶斯建模。构建层级模型、MCMC (NUTS)、变分推断、LOO/WAIC 比较与后验检验，适用于概率编程与推断。

description: Use UMAP-learn for nonlinear dimensionality reduction, 2D/3D embeddings, clustering preprocessing, supervised or semi-supervised UMAP, DensMAP, AlignedUMAP, and Parametric UMAP workflows.
description_zh: 使用 UMAP-learn 实现非线性降维、2D/3D 嵌入、聚类预处理、监督或半监督 UMAP、DensMAP、AlignedUMAP 和 Parametric UMAP 等工作流程。

description: Expert skill for using DeepSeek-OCR, a vision-language model for optical character recognition with context optical compression supporting documents, PDFs, and images.
description_zh: 使用 DeepSeek-OCR 的专家技能，这是一种具备上下文光学压缩、支持文档、PDF 和图像的光学字符识别视觉语言模型。

description: Microsoft Sharepoint integration. Manage Sites. Use when the user wants to interact with Microsoft Sharepoint data.
description_zh: Microsoft SharePoint 集成。管理站点。当用户希望与 Microsoft SharePoint 数据交互时使用。

description: Send messages and interactive cards to Feishu (飞书) and Lark channels via webhooks or Bot API. Create rich-text announcements, marketing updates, and team notifications. Trigger phrases: "post to feishu", "feishu message", "lark message", "feishu webhook", "lark webhook", "send to feishu", "send to lark", "feishu bot", "lark bot", "飞书", "飞书机器人".
description_zh: 通过 Webhook 或机器人 API，向飞书（Feishu）和 Lark 渠道发送消息及交互式卡片。创建富文本公告、营销更新和团队通知。触发短语："发布到飞书"、"飞书消息"、"Lark消息"、"飞书Webhook"、"LarkWebhook"、"发送到飞书"、"发送到Lark"、"飞书机器人"、"Lark机器人"、"飞书"、"飞书机器人"。

description: Version-aware guide for configuring and running Apollo Router for federated GraphQL supergraphs. Generates correct YAML for both Router v1.x and v2.x. Use this skill when: (1) setting up Apollo Router to run a supergraph, (2) configuring routing, headers, or CORS, (3) implementing custom plugins (Rhai scripts or coprocessors), (4) configuring telemetry (tracing, metrics, logging), (5) troubleshooting Router performance or connectivity issues, (6) securing the graph with JWT, declarative field-level authorization directives, or persisted-query safelisting, (7) managing router.yaml as version-controlled config with CI/CD validation.
description_zh: 面向联合 GraphQL 超级图配置与运行的 Apollo Router 版本感知指南。可为 Router v1.x 与 v2.x 生成正确的 YAML 配置。使用此技能时：(1) 配置 Apollo Router 以运行超级图；(2) 配置路由、请求头或 CORS；(3) 实现自定义插件（Rhai 脚本或协处理器）；(4) 配置遥测（追踪、指标、日志）；(5) 排查 Router 性能或连接性问题；(6) 使用 JWT、声明式字段级授权指令或持久化查询安全白名单来保护该图；(7) 将 router.yaml 作为版本受控配置进行管理，并进行 CI/CD 验证。

description: Use when the task asks for a visually strong landing page, website, app, prototype, demo, or game UI. This skill enforces restrained composition, image-led hierarchy, cohesive content structure, and tasteful motion while avoiding generic cards, weak branding, and UI clutter.
description_zh: 当任务要求视觉表现力强的落地页、网站、应用、原型、演示或游戏界面时，使用本技能。本技能强制要求构图克制简洁、以图像为主导的层级、内容结构连贯统一，并采用自然得体的动态效果，同时避免通用卡片、薄弱品牌设计与界面杂乱。

description: PyTorch Geometric (PyG) for graph neural networks — node/link/graph classification, message passing (GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, GIN), heterogeneous graphs, neighbor sampling, and custom datasets. Use when working with torch_geometric, not for general NetworkX analytics or non-graph PyTorch models.
description_zh: PyTorch Geometric（PyG）用于图神经网络——节点/边/图分类、消息传递（GCN、GAT、GraphSAGE、GIN）、异质图、邻居采样及自定义数据集。适用于使用 torch_geometric 的场景，不适用于一般的 NetworkX 分析或非图的 PyTorch 模型。

description: Answer what the TAO Skill Bank plugin can do by generating the response from packaged application, data, model, AutoML, and platform manifests. Use when the user asks "what can TAO Skill Bank do", "list TAO models", "which TAO workflows are available", or "what supports AutoML".
description_zh: 通过从打包的应用、数据、模型、AutoML 和平台清单中生成响应，来回答 TAO Skill Bank 插件可以做什么。当用户询问“TAO Skill Bank 能做什么”、“列出 TAO 模型”、“有哪些可用的 TAO 工作流”或“哪些支持 AutoML”时使用。

description: Help users write effective job descriptions. Use when someone is creating a job posting, defining a new role, preparing to hire, or trying to attract the right candidates for an open position.
description_zh: 帮助用户撰写有效的职位描述。适用于创建职位发布、定义新职位、准备招聘或吸引合适的候选人填补空缺职位。

description: Guide for using Microsoft MarkItDown - a Python utility for converting files to Markdown. Use when converting PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, audio, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP, YouTube URLs, EPubs, Jupyter notebooks, RSS feeds, or Wikipedia pages to Markdown format. Also use for document processing pipelines, LLM preprocessing, or text extraction tasks.
description_zh: Microsoft MarkItDown 使用指南——一款用于将文件转换为 Markdown 的 Python 工具。适用于将 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、图片、音频、HTML、CSV、JSON、XML、ZIP、YouTube 链接、EPUB、Jupyter 笔记本、RSS 订阅源或维基百科页面转换为 Markdown 格式。同时适用于文档处理流水线、LLM 预处理或文本提取任务。

description: Prepare journal manuscripts, conference papers, research posters, and grant documents using venue-specific formatting guidance and bundled LaTeX scaffolds. Use when selecting an official template, checking current page or anonymity rules, adapting academic writing to a venue, or inspecting a submission PDF.
description_zh: 使用针对特定会议与期刊的排版指导及配套的LaTeX模板框架，准备期刊稿件、会议论文、研究海报和项目资助文件。适用于选择官方模板、检查当前页面或匿名规则、将学术写作适配至特定会议，或检查投稿PDF的情况。

description: CLIP vision-language model for image-text retrieval, zero-shot classification, embedding extraction, ONNX export, and TensorRT deployment. Use when fine-tuning or training CLIP, running zero-shot classification, computing image embeddings, or deploying CLIP to ONNX/TensorRT.
description_zh: CLIP 视觉语言模型，支持图像-文本检索、零样本分类、嵌入提取、ONNX 导出及 TensorRT 部署。适用于微调或训练 CLIP、运行零样本分类、计算图像嵌入，或将 CLIP 部署到 ONNX/TensorRT。

description: Integrate a HuggingFace Computer Vision model into the NVIDIA TAO Toolkit ecosystem (tao-core config, tao-pytorch trainer, tao-deploy TensorRT pipeline). Use when the user asks to "integrate a HuggingFace model into TAO", "add an HF model to TAO Toolkit", "wire a HuggingFace ViT/DETR/ SegFormer into tao-pytorch", "build a TAO trainer + deploy pipeline for an HF CV model", or pastes a HuggingFace model URL/ID and wants it turned into a TAO model. Covers the full 7-phase loop: prerequisites check, HuggingFace inspection and validation, codebase exploration, tao-core configuration and native trainer implementation, ONNX export plus TensorRT deploy integration, packaging and L0 testing, container-based end-to-end validation, and (conditional) accuracy/latency tuning. Supports classification, object detection, semantic / instance / panoptic segmentation, zero-shot detection, and depth estimation.
description_zh: 将 HuggingFace 计算机视觉模型集成到 NVIDIA TAO 工具包生态系统（tao-core 配置、tao-pytorch 训练器、tao-deploy TensorRT 流水线）。当用户询问“将 HuggingFace 模型集成到 TAO”、“向 TAO 工具包添加 HF 模型”、“将 HuggingFace ViT/DETR/SegFormer 接入 tao-pytorch”、“为 HF 计算机视觉模型构建 TAO 训练器 + 部署流水线”，或粘贴 HuggingFace 模型 URL/ID 并希望将其转化为 TAO 模型时使用。涵盖完整七阶段循环：前置条件检查、HuggingFace 检查与验证、代码库探索、tao-core 配置与原生训练器实现、ONNX 导出与 TensorRT 部署集成、打包与 L0 测试、基于容器的端到端验证，以及（条件性的）精度/延迟调优。支持分类、目标检测、语义/实例/全景分割、零样本检测和深度估计。

description: Run container-backed AutoML / hyperparameter optimization (HPO) for NVIDIA TAO networks using AutoMLRunner. Handles algorithm selection (bayesian, hyperband, asha, bohb, llm, hybrid, autoresearch), WandB experiment tracking, job execution on any TAO SDK platform, result interpretation, and per-rec custom evaluation hooks. Use when the user mentions TAO AutoML, hyperparameter optimization, HPO, automl, automl_settings, AutoMLRunner, tao_automl, bayesian search, hyperband, ASHA, LLM-guided search, autoresearch, or wants to tune train/distill/prune/quantize action parameters for any TAO network. Model actions use the model skill's resolved container image by default; venv training requires an explicit user request. Platform-agnostic — runs on any SDK (Brev, SLURM, Kubernetes, Docker).
description_zh: 使用 AutoMLRunner 运行 NVIDIA TAO 网络的容器后端 AutoML / 超参数优化（HPO）。可处理算法选择（贝叶斯、超带宽、ASHA、BOHB、LLM、混合、AutoResearch），支持 WandB 实验跟踪，可在任意 TAO SDK 平台上执行任务，进行结果解读，以及每个记录的定制化评估钩子。当用户提及 TAO AutoML、超参数优化、HPO、automl、automl_settings、AutoMLRunner、tao_automl、贝叶斯搜索、超带宽、ASHA、LLM 引导搜索、AutoResearch，或希望为任意 TAO 网络调整训练/蒸馏/剪枝/量化操作参数时使用。模型操作默认使用模型技能解析的容器镜像；虚拟环境训练需明确的用户请求。平台无关——支持 Brev、SLURM、Kubernetes、Docker 等任意 SDK 运行。

description: Documentation templates and structure guidelines. README, API docs, code comments, and AI-friendly documentation.
description_zh: 文档模板与结构指南。README、API 文档、代码注释和 AI 友好文档。

description: Generate a polished one-page PowerPoint slide summarizing key takeaways from recent funding rounds and notable capital markets activity across a user's watched sectors or companies. Use this skill when the user asks for a deal flow summary, weekly recap, funding digest, transaction roundup, or capital markets briefing. Triggers on: 'deal flow digest', 'weekly funding recap', 'deal roundup', 'transaction summary this week', 'what happened in [sector] this week', 'capital markets update', or any request to compile recent funding activity into a briefing slide. Produces a professional single-slide PPTX with key takeaways, valuation data, and Capital IQ deal links.
description_zh: 生成一份经过润色的单页 PowerPoint 幻灯片，汇总用户所关注行业或公司的近期融资轮次及重要资本市场活动的关键要点。当用户要求交易动态汇总、周度回顾、融资摘要、交易轮次汇总或资本市场简报时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括："deal flow digest"（交易动态摘要）、"weekly funding recap"（周度融资回顾）、"deal roundup"（交易汇总）、"transaction summary this week"（本周交易摘要）、"what happened in [sector] this week"（本周[行业]动态）、"capital markets update"（资本市场动态），或任何要求将近期融资活动汇编为简报幻灯片的请求。生成包含关键要点、估值数据及 Capital IQ 交易链接的专业单页 PPTX。

description: Use when building features with **Claude Code** in any codebase and the work should go through a disciplined build → review → test → fix loop. Triggers on "run the build loop", "build the next task", "continue the plan", "build this feature properly", or any request to implement work from a plan file or a direct feature prompt. Builds from the plan (or the prompt if no plan exists), runs Claude Code's `/review` (plus `/security-review` for sensitive surfaces) and fixes every issue found, tests and verifies the feature end to end, fixes anything testing surfaces, and reports back once complete. Repeats until all plan tasks are checked off.
description_zh: 适用于在任何代码库中使用 **Claude Code** 构建功能，且工作需经过严格规范的构建 → 审查 → 测试 → 修复循环的场景。触发条件包括“运行构建循环”、“构建下一个任务”、“继续执行计划”、“规范地构建此功能”，或任何要求根据计划文件或直接功能提示实施工作的请求。从计划（或如不存在计划则从提示）出发进行构建，运行 Claude Code 的 `/review`（针对敏感区域则添加 `/security-review`），并修复发现的每个问题；对功能进行端到端测试与验证，修复任何测试环节暴露的问题，并在完成后进行反馈报告。持续重复，直至计划中的所有任务全部完成。

description: Multi-step video annotation pipeline that turns raw videos into Chain-of-Thought training data — multi-level captions, structured descriptions, and QA pairs (MCQ, binary, open-ended) with reasoning traces, via VLM/LLM distillation. Use when the user wants to "create video training data", "generate video QA datasets", "build CoT reasoning traces from videos", "auto-label videos", or run the video_reasoning_annotation pipeline. Triggers include "video annotation", "video CoT", "video QA", "chain-of-thought", "video captioning pipeline", "video distillation".
description_zh: 多步骤视频标注流水线，将原始视频转化为思维链训练数据——提供多层次字幕、结构化描述，以及包含推理轨迹的问答对（单选题、二分类、开放式问答），通过VLM/LLM蒸馏实现。适用于用户需要“创建视频训练数据”、“生成视频问答数据集”、“从视频构建CoT推理轨迹”、“自动标注视频”或运行视频推理标注流水线的情况。触发词包括“视频标注”、“视频CoT”、“视频问答”、“思维链”、“视频字幕生成流水线”、“视频蒸馏”。

description: Security audit guidelines for web applications and REST APIs based on OWASP Top 10 and web security best practices. Use when checking code for vulnerabilities, reviewing auth/authz, auditing APIs, or before production deployment.
description_zh: 针对Web应用程序和REST API的、基于OWASP十大安全风险和Web安全最佳实践的安全审计指南。适用于检查代码漏洞、审查认证/授权、审计API或生产部署前的场景。

description: Take a list of projects and their related documentation, and organize them into the SRED format for submission.
description_zh: 获取项目及其相关文档的清单，并将其整理为提交所需的 SRED 格式。

description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.
description_zh: 全面的分子生物学工具包。可用于序列操纵、文件解析（FASTA/GenBank/PDB）、系统发育，以及通过程序访问 NCBI/PubMed（Bio.Entrez）。最适合批量处理、定制化生物信息学流程、BLAST 自动化。快速查找请使用 gget；多服务集成请使用 bioservices。

description: Run `tao-daft convert` to convert NVIDIA TAO DAFT datasets between supported formats. Do not use for non-DAFT data. Use when the user asks to convert a DAFT dataset, change DAFT format, change a TAO dataset format, or run `tao-daft convert`.
description_zh: 运行 `tao-daft convert` 将 NVIDIA TAO DAFT 数据集在不同受支持的格式之间进行转换。不要用于非 DAFT 数据。当用户要求转换 DAFT 数据集、更改 DAFT 格式、更改 TAO 数据集格式或运行 `tao-daft convert` 时使用。

description: Use when validating or repairing an editable PPTX deck for geometry, accessibility, native editability, source lineage, and OOXML package integrity.
description_zh: 用于验证或修复可编辑PPTX演示文稿的几何、无障碍、原生可编辑性、源文件溯源及OOXML包完整性。

description: Creates professional investment banking strip profiles (company profiles) for pitch books, deal materials, and client presentations. Generates 1-4 information-dense slides with quadrant layouts, charts, and tables.
description_zh: 为路演文件、交易材料和客户演示文稿创建专业投资银行条状核心简介（公司简介）。生成1至4张信息密集的幻灯片，包含象限布局、图表和表格。

description: Analyzes sales data from PayPal and QuickBooks to find top performers and slow movers, layers in seasonality, and produces a prioritized 30-day content brief: what to push, what offers to run, what to hold. Strategic output only — no calendars or assets. Use when the user asks what to post, wants a content plan, asks what's selling, or what to promote this month.
description_zh: 分析 PayPal 与 QuickBooks 的销售数据，以找出表现突出者与增长滞缓者，纳入季节性因素，并生成一份优先排序的 30 天内容简报：需推广的内容、需执行的优惠方案、需保留的内容。仅输出战略成果——不含日历或素材。当用户询问发布什么、需要内容规划、询问当前销售情况或本月需推广的内容时使用。

description: Prepares tax materials as a two-link chain — month-end-prep confirms the books are closed and reconciled first, then tax-season-organizer calculates the quarterly estimated payment or builds the year-end 1099-NEC list and accountant packet from those closed numbers. Requires a ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books); uses Gusto, PayPal, and Stripe when connected, else CSV upload. US federal tax math; a non-US business gets the closed-books packet. Prep material for a CPA, never tax advice, nothing filed. Trigger on "quarterly taxes," "estimated tax payment," "how much should I set aside," "1099s," "1099-NEC," "W-9s," "year-end tax prep," "get my books ready for my accountant," any phrasing that suggests a tax deadline is coming, or a question about net profit or YTD income that sounds like worry about a tax bill. An owner who says the period's books are already closed routes to tax-season-organizer directly.
description_zh: 作为双链流程准备税务材料——月末准备环节先确认账簿已关账并核对完成，随后税务季节整理者根据这些关账数据计算季度预估税额，或根据关账数据生成年终1099-NEC清单及会计资料包。需要关联一个账本（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books）；若已连接则使用Gusto、PayPal和Stripe，否则进行CSV文件上传。适用于美国联邦税务计算；非美国企业将获得关账资料包。为CPA准备资料，绝非税务建议，不提交任何文件。触发条件包括：“季度税务”“预估税额缴纳”“我应该预留多少金额”“1099s”“1099-NEC”“W-9s”“年终税务准备”“让我的账簿为会计准备好”“任何暗示即将面临税务截止日的表述，或关于净利润或年内收入的问题，若听起来像是对税务账单的担忧”。若所有者表示该期间的账簿已关账，则直接路由至税务季节整理者。

description: ARS-Codex research, academic writing, manuscript review, and experiment planning. Use for deep research, literature or systematic reviews, meta-analysis, research questions, paper drafts, revisions, revision roadmaps, abstracts, citations, integrity checks, peer review, and research-to-paper workflows. Korean: 논문 심사, 논문 수정, 초록 작성, 체계적 문헌고찰, 연구부터 논문까지. Español: revisión de literatura, revisar artículo, enmendar mi artículo, escribir resumen, investigación a artículo. Also use for ARS aliases: /ars-plan, /ars-outline, /ars-abstract, /ars-lit-review, /ars-citation-check, /ars-disclosure, /ars-format-convert, /ars-3w, /ars-revision-coach, /ars-revision, /ars-reviewer, /ars-mark-read, /ars-unmark-read, /ars-cache-invalidate, /ars-rebuttal-audit, /ars-full. Role prompts, references, templates, and handoff schemas live under ars/.
description_zh:
ARS-Codex 研究、学术写作、稿件审阅和实验规划。适用于深度研究、文献或系统综述、Meta 分析、研究问题、论文草稿、修订、修订路线图、摘要、引用、完整性检查、同行评审以及从研究到论文的工作流程。

韩语：论文审阅、论文修改、摘要撰写、系统性文献综述、从研究到论文。
西语：文献综述、审阅文章、修改我的文章、撰写摘要、从研究到文章。

亦适用于 ARS 别名：/ars-plan、/ars-outline、/ars-abstract、/ars-lit-review、/ars-citation-check、/ars-disclosure、/ars-format-convert、/ars-3w、/ars-revision-coach、/ars-revision、/ars-reviewer、/ars-mark-read、/ars-unmark-read、/ars-cache-invalidate、/ars-rebuttal-audit、/ars-full。

角色提示词、参考文献、模板和交接模式位于 ars/ 目录下。

description: Create and manage WordPress posts, pages, media, categories, tags, and menus via WP-CLI or the REST API. Use whenever the user wants to publish a blog post on WordPress, update a page, upload media, manage categories or tags, update navigation menus, schedule posts, or do bulk content operations on a WordPress site.
description_zh: 通过 WP-CLI 或 REST API 创建和管理 WordPress 的帖子、页面、媒体、分类、标签与菜单。当用户需要在 WordPress 上发布博客文章、更新页面、上传媒体、管理分类或标签、更新导航菜单、安排发布帖子，或对 WordPress 站点执行批量内容操作时，可使用本功能。

description: Navigation hub linking sub-skills for proactive Qdrant tuning: search speed, indexing performance, and memory usage optimization. Use when planning configuration or capacity changes to improve speed and efficiency. For diagnosing an active production slowdown or analyzing live metrics, use qdrant-monitoring instead.
description_zh: 导航枢纽关联子技能，用于主动调优Qdrant：搜索速度、索引性能及内存使用优化。当规划配置或容量变更以提升速度与效率时使用。若需诊断生产环境实时性能下降或分析实时指标，请改用qdrant-monitoring。

description: Diagnoses and safely reclaims macOS disk space. Use when a Mac is low on storage, reports “Caching needs more space,” shows large Apple Content Caching or AssetCacheManagerUtil usage, or needs analysis of caches, logs, application remnants, large or duplicate files, Docker or OrbStack, Chromium code-sign clones, Homebrew, npm, pip, Xcode, and other developer storage. Routes known suspects to targeted read-only diagnosis before broad scans, distinguishes nominal path accounting from physical release, requires an impact-and-recovery plan plus explicit confirmation before state changes, and verifies disk space and co-resident services afterward.
description_zh: 诊断并安全回收 macOS 磁盘空间。当 Mac 存储空间不足、报告“Caching needs more space”，显示 Apple Content Caching 或 AssetCacheManagerUtil 的大规模占用，或需要对缓存、日志、应用程序残留、大文件或重复文件、Docker 或 OrbStack、Chromium 代码签名副本、Homebrew、npm、pip、Xcode 及其他开发者存储进行分析时使用。在全面扫描之前，将已知嫌疑对象路由到定向只读诊断，区分名义路径计算与实际释放，在状态变更前要求制定影响与恢复计划并提供明确确认，并在之后验证磁盘空间和共存服务。

description: Help users manage technical debt strategically. Use when someone is dealing with legacy code, planning refactoring work, deciding between rewrites vs. incremental fixes, trying to get buy-in for tech debt reduction, or balancing new features with maintenance.
description_zh: 帮助用户战略性地管理技术债务。在应对遗留代码、规划重构工作、在重写与渐进式修复之间抉择、争取对技术债务削减的认可，或平衡新功能与维护工作时，适用本工具。

description: Show experiment dashboard with results, active loops, and progress. Use when the user runs /ar:status or asks how an autoresearch experiment is going.
description_zh: 显示包含结果、活跃循环和进度的实验仪表板。当用户运行 /ar:status 或询问自动研究实验进展如何时使用。

description: Selects, investigates, and compares AWS object, file, and block storage services, and answers cost, performance, configuration, security, and troubleshooting questions about storage services. Applies when a user asks where to store or archive data based on their usage patterns; which storage service to choose or how two compare; how to migrate data from on-premises or between AWS services; how to protect, replicate, or recover data; how to optimize storage costs; where to deploy shared NFS, SMB, or POSIX file systems; where to store vector embeddings or tabular data; what storage backs enterprise file shares, self-managed databases on EC2, VMware, or stateful containers; or asks what an AWS storage service can do or how it works. Relevant for storage needs for workloads such as AI/ML, analytics, EDA, HPC, media, genomics, or financial trading. Not applicable for SQL query engines (Athena, Spark, Redshift, EMR), ETL (Glue), streaming (Kafka, MSK, Kinesis), or managed database services (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB).
description_zh: 选择、调查并比较AWS对象存储、文件存储和块存储服务，并回答关于存储服务的成本、性能、配置、安全和故障排查问题。适用于当用户根据使用模式询问数据存储或归档位置；询问选择哪种存储服务或如何比较两种存储服务；询问如何将数据从本地迁移或在不同AWS服务之间迁移；询问如何保护、复制或恢复数据；询问如何优化存储成本；询问共享NFS、SMB或POSIX文件系统的部署位置；询问向量嵌入或表格数据的存储位置；询问企业文件共享、在EC2、VMware或有状态容器上运行的自管理数据库由何种存储支撑；或询问AWS存储服务能做什么以及如何工作。适用于AI/ML、分析、EDA、HPC、媒体、基因组学或金融交易等工作负载的存储需求。不适用于SQL查询引擎（Athena、Spark、Redshift、EMR）、ETL（Glue）、流处理（Kafka、MSK、Kinesis）或托管数据库服务（RDS、Aurora、DynamoDB）。

description: Install a .NET SDK locally for safe preview testing, specific-version pinning, or reproducible team setups — without modifying the system-wide installation. USE FOR: trying .NET previews safely, testing specific SDK versions, installing MAUI or other workloads on a preview, updating or replacing an existing local SDK, creating reproducible team/CI install scripts, configuring global.json paths. DO NOT USE FOR: system-wide SDK installs, .NET hosts older than 10, runtime-only installs, or projects not using SDK-style commands.
description_zh:
本地安装 .NET SDK，用于安全进行预览测试、特定版本锁定或可复现的团队环境配置——无需修改系统级安装。

使用场景：安全尝试 .NET 预览版、测试特定 SDK 版本、在预览环境中安装 MAUI 或其他工作负载、更新或替换现有本地 SDK、创建可复现的团队/CI 安装脚本、配置 global.json 路径。

禁止使用场景：系统级 SDK 安装、版本号低于 10 的 .NET 宿主、仅安装运行时，或不使用 SDK 风格命令的项目。

description: Read Telegram channels and groups for financial news and market research using tdl (read-only). Use this skill whenever the user wants to read Telegram channels, export messages from financial Telegram groups, list their Telegram chats, search for news in Telegram channels, or gather market intelligence from Telegram. Triggers include: "check my Telegram", "read Telegram channel", "Telegram news", "what's new in my Telegram channels", "export messages from", "list my Telegram chats", "financial news on Telegram", "crypto Telegram", "market news Telegram", any mention of Telegram in context of reading financial news, crypto signals, or market research. This skill is READ-ONLY — it does NOT support sending messages, joining channels, or any write operations.
description_zh:
使用 tdl（只读）读取 Telegram 频道和群组中的财经新闻及市场研究内容

每当用户需要使用此技能读取 Telegram 频道、从财经类 Telegram 群组中导出消息、列出其 Telegram 聊天、在 Telegram 频道中搜索新闻，或从 Telegram 收集市场情报时，即应使用本技能。触发条件包括："检查我的 Telegram"、"读取 Telegram 频道"、"Telegram 新闻"、"我的 Telegram 频道有什么新动态"、"导出来自...的消息"、"列出我的 Telegram 聊天"、"Telegram 上的财经新闻"、"加密货币 Telegram"、"Telegram 市场新闻"，以及在任何涉及读取财经新闻、加密货币信号或市场研究的 Telegram 上下文中的任何 Telegram 提及。本技能为只读模式——不支持发送消息、加入频道或执行任何写入操作。

description: Design research plans and paper architectures. Given a research topic or idea, generate structured plans with methodology outlines, paper structure, dependency-ordered task lists, UML diagrams, and experiment designs. Use when starting a new research project or paper.
description_zh: 设计研究计划与论文架构。给定一个研究课题或想法，生成包含方法概述、论文结构、按依赖顺序排列的任务列表、UML图和实验设计的结构化计划。用于开始新的研究项目或论文。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
description_zh: 创建有效技能的指南。当用户需要创建新技能（或更新现有技能），通过专业知识、工作流或工具集成的形式扩展Claude的能力时，应使用此技能。

description: 搜索微信公众号文章技能。通过微信搜索获取文章列表，覆盖科技/AI、社会热点、财经、教育、职场等各类中文资讯；可按关键词检索并返回标题、概要、发布时间、来源公众号与链接。当用户需要查找微信公众号文章、整理参考资料或快速获取文章信息时使用此技能。
description_zh: 搜索微信公众号文章技能。通过微信搜索获取文章列表，覆盖科技/AI、社会热点、财经、教育、职场等各类中文资讯；可按关键词检索并返回标题、概要、发布时间、来源公众号与链接。当用户需要查找微信公众号文章、整理参考资料或快速获取文章信息时使用此技能。

description: Investment banking presentation quality checker. Reviews a pitch deck or client-ready presentation for (1) number consistency across slides, (2) data-narrative alignment, (3) language polish against IB standards, (4) visual and formatting QC. Use whenever the user asks to review, check, QC, proof, or do a final pass on a deck, pitch, or client materials — including requests like "check my numbers", "reconcile figures across slides", "is this client-ready", or "what am I missing before I send this out".
description_zh: 投资银行演示文稿质量检查工具。对路演演示文稿或可直接用于客户的演示文稿进行审核，涵盖以下内容：（1）幻灯片间的数字一致性；（2）数据与叙事的一致性；（3）符合投行标准的语言润色；（4）视觉与格式质量检查。在用户要求审核、检查、QC、校对或对演示文稿、推介材料或客户材料进行最终检查时，均可使用此工具——包括用户提出"检查我的数字"、"跨幻灯片核对数据"、"这份客户材料是否可直接使用"、"在发送此材料前我遗漏了什么"等请求时。

description: Cut a stable release of Paseo (fresh patch or minor, or promote from beta). Use when the user says "release stable", "ship stable", "promote", "release:patch", "release:minor", "release:promote", or "/release-stable".
description_zh: 发布 Paseo 的稳定版（新补丁或小版本，或从 Beta 版提升至稳定版）。当用户说“release stable”、“ship stable”、“promote”、“release:patch”、“release:minor”、“release:promote”，或“/release-stable”时使用。

description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
description_zh: 将现有网站和应用程序升级至高端品质。审计当前设计，识别通用 AI 模式，并在不破坏功能的前提下应用高端设计标准。兼容任何 CSS 框架或原生 CSS。

description: PyTorch-based TAO image classification. Supports a wide range of backbones (FAN, EfficientNet, ResNet, etc.) with distillation and quantization for deployment. Use when training, evaluating, distilling, quantizing, exporting, or running inference for a TAO image-classification (PyT) model. Trigger phrases include "train image classifier", "TAO classification", "ResNet/EfficientNet/FAN backbone classifier", "classification-pyt".
description_zh: 基于 PyTorch 的 TAO 图像分类。支持广泛的骨干网络（FAN、EfficientNet、ResNet 等），并支持蒸馏与量化以用于部署。可用于训练、评估、蒸馏、量化、导出，或对 TAO 图像分类（PyT）模型进行推理。触发短语包括“train image classifier”、“TAO classification”、“ResNet/EfficientNet/FAN backbone classifier”、“classification-pyt”。

description: OCRNet for scene text recognition. Recognizes text content from cropped text-region images and supports CTC and attention-based decoders. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, pruning, quantizing, retraining, or running inference for a TAO OCRNet model. Trigger phrases include "train OCRNet", "scene text recognition", "OCR cropped text", "CTC / attention text decoder".
description_zh: OCRNet 用于 scene text recognition。从裁剪后的文本区域图像中识别文本内容，并支持 CTC 和基于注意力机制的解码器。适用于为 TAO OCRNet 模型进行训练、评估、导出、剪枝、量化、重新训练或运行推理。触发短语包括“train OCRNet”、“scene text recognition”、“OCR cropped text”、“CTC / attention text decoder”。

description: Help users evaluate emerging technologies. Use when someone is assessing new tools, making build vs buy decisions, evaluating AI vendors, or deciding on technical architecture.
description_zh: 帮助用户评估新兴技术。适用于评估新工具、进行构建与购买决策、评估AI供应商或决定技术架构时使用。

description: Guidelines for building frontend applications that integrate with Botpress ADK bots - covering authentication, type generation, client setup, and calling bot actions
description_zh: 构建集成 Botpress ADK 机器人前端应用的指南——涵盖身份验证、类型生成、客户端设置及调用机器人操作

description:
Translate and dub a video into another language with voice cloning and lip-sync,
powered by HeyGen Video Translation. The presenter keeps their face, their voice
is cloned into the target language, and lips re-sync to the new audio — viewers
see the same person speaking natively.
Use when: (1) localizing an existing video into one or more languages
("translate this video to Spanish", "make this in French and German",
"dub this into Japanese", "I need this in 10 languages for a launch"),
(2) the user has a finished video and wants the SAME presenter speaking another
language (not a new presenter — that's heygen-video),
(3) podcast / audio-only translation ("translate this podcast", "dub the audio
but keep my video"),
(4) high-stakes translations where the user wants to review/edit subtitles
before final render (the proofreads workflow),
(5) "translate my video", "dub this", "localize this clip", "make a multilingual
version", "subtitle and dub".
Returns the translated video URL (or audio file for audio-only mode), one per
target language.
Chain signal: if the user wants to CREATE a new video in another language (no
source video exists yet), route to heygen-video and write the script in the
target language — do not use heygen-translate. Use heygen-translate only when
there is an existing source video to localize.
NOT for: creating new videos from scratch (use heygen-video), avatar creation
(use heygen-avatar), TTS-only synthesis (use heygen-video with audio-only
output), or text-only translation.
description_zh:
通过 HeyGen 视频翻译，使用语音克隆与口型同步，将视频翻译成另一种语言并进行配音。主讲人保留原脸，语音被克隆为目标语言，口型与新的音频重新同步——观众可以看到同一个人用母语进行演讲。

适用场景：
(1) 将现有视频本地化，翻译成一种或多种语言
（"将这段视频翻译成西班牙语"、"用法语和德语制作此内容"、"将此视频配音成日语"、"我需要为发布准备 10 种语言的版本"），
(2) 用户已有成片视频，希望由相同的演示者以另一种语言进行讲解（而非使用新的演示者——那是 heygen-video），
(3) 播客 / 纯音频翻译（"翻译这段播客"、"配音音频但保留我的视频"），
(4) 关键翻译场景，用户希望在最终渲染前审阅或编辑字幕（校对流程），
(5) "翻译我的视频"、"为此配音"、"本地化此片段"、"制作多语言版本"、"添加字幕并配音"。

返回：
按每种目标语言分别返回翻译后的视频链接（纯音频模式下返回音频文件）。

信号链路：
如果用户想要以另一种语言创建新视频（尚未存在源视频），则路由至 heygen-video，并在目标语言中撰写脚本——不要使用 heygen-translate。仅在存在需要本地化的现有源视频时，才使用 heygen-translate。

不可用于：从零开始创建新视频（使用 heygen-video）、创建虚拟形象（使用 heygen-avatar）、仅进行 TTS 合成（使用 heygen-video 并输出纯音频）、仅进行文本翻译。

description: Zero-shot time series forecasting with Google's TimesFM foundation model. Use for any univariate time series (sales, sensors, energy, vitals, weather) without training a custom model. Supports CSV/DataFrame/array inputs with point forecasts and prediction intervals. Includes a preflight system checker script to verify RAM/GPU before first use.
description_zh: 基于 Google TimesFM 基础模型的零样本时间序列预测。适用于任何单变量时间序列（如销售、传感器、能源、生命体征、天气）的预测，无需训练自定义模型。支持以 CSV、DataFrame 或数组作为输入，并提供点预测与预测区间。包含一个预检系统检查脚本，用于在使用前验证内存（RAM）与 GPU。

description: Art-direct and implement distinctive, motion-rich marketing, editorial, portfolio, and landing websites with original reference-inspired imagery, standout heroes, GSAP choreography, one smooth-scroll engine, optional Three.js shaders, honest icon and logo sourcing, photo avatars, accessibility, and performance safeguards. Use when a user asks for an Awwwards-quality, premium, cinematic, interactive, high-concept, or motion-led website, or explicitly requests this visual and motion system.
description_zh: 进行艺术指导并实现独具特色、动态丰富的营销、编辑、作品集及落地页网站，运用原创参考意象衍生的图像、醒目的核心视觉元素、GSAP 编排、统一平滑滚动引擎、可选 Three.js 着色器、诚信来源的图标与标志、照片头像、无障碍设计及性能保障。适用于当用户要求获得 Awwwards 品质的高端、电影感、交互、高概念或动态主导的网站，或明确要求本视觉与动态系统时。

description: Kubernetes execution platform — submits TAO container jobs as single-pod k8s Jobs with NVIDIA GPU scheduling. Use when running on EKS / GKE / AKS / on-prem clusters with the NVIDIA GPU Operator installed, or when integrating TAO into an existing k8s-native ML platform.
description_zh: Kubernetes 执行平台——将 TAO 容器任务提交为支持 NVIDIA GPU 调度的单 Pod k8s 任务。适用于在已安装 NVIDIA GPU Operator 的 EKS / GKE / AKS / 本地（on-prem）集群上运行，或将 TAO 集成到现有的 k8s 原生 ML 平台时。

description: Biological data toolkit. Sequence analysis, alignments, phylogenetic trees, diversity metrics (alpha/beta, UniFrac), ordination (PCoA), PERMANOVA, FASTA/Newick I/O, for microbiome analysis.
description_zh: 生物数据工具包。序列分析、比对、系统发育树、多样性指标（α/β、UniFrac）、排序（PCoA）、PERMANOVA、FASTA/Newick I/O，用于微生物组分析。

description: Production-ready reinforcement learning algorithms (PPO, SAC, DQN, TD3, DDPG, A2C) with scikit-learn-like API. Use for standard RL experiments, quick prototyping, and well-documented algorithm implementations. Best for single-agent RL with Gymnasium environments. For high-performance parallel training, multi-agent systems, or custom vectorized environments, use pufferlib instead.
description_zh: 提供生产就绪的强化学习算法（PPO、SAC、DQN、TD3、DDPG、A2C），具备类似scikit-learn的API。适用于标准强化学习实验、快速原型开发及文档完善的算法实现。最适合带有Gymnasium环境的单智能体强化学习。如需进行高性能并行训练、多智能体系统或自定义向量化环境，请改用pufferlib。

description: Two-step image grounding pipeline: extracts referring expressions from (image, caption) pairs and grounds them to pixel-space bounding boxes via a VLM. Use when the user wants to ground captions to bboxes, generate phrase-grounded annotations, auto-label images for grounding, or run the image_grounding pipeline. Triggers include 'image grounding', 'phrase grounding', 'ground captions', 'auto-label image grounding', 'image_grounding'.
description_zh: 两阶段图像定位流水线：从（图像，描述）对中提取指代表达，并通过视觉语言模型（VLM）将其定位到像素空间边界框。适用于用户需要以下场景时：将描述定位到边界框、生成基于短语的定位标注、自动为图像定位进行标注，或运行 image_grounding 流水线。触发词包括 'image grounding'、'phrase grounding'、'ground captions'、'auto-label image grounding'、'image_grounding'。

description: Performs deep Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on NVIDIA TAO Visual ChangeNet classification experiments with image-evidence-driven investigation. Use when analyzing ChangeNet model failures, investigating poor recall / FAR / PASS-NO_PASS metrics, auditing visual inspection pipeline quality, or running an RCA report for an AOI defect-detection model. Trigger phrases include "RCA on my ChangeNet model", "why is my AOI model failing", "audit ChangeNet predictions", "investigate FAR regressions", "root cause analysis on visual-changenet".
description_zh: 对 NVIDIA TAO Visual ChangeNet 分类实验执行深入的根因分析（RCA），并以图像证据驱动的方式开展排查。适用于分析 ChangeNet 模型故障、排查召回率/FAR/PASS-NO_PASS 指标不佳、审计视觉检查流程质量，或为 AOI 缺陷检测模型生成 RCA 报告。触发短语包括：“对我的 ChangeNet 模型进行 RCA”、“我的 AOI 模型为何会失败”、“审计 ChangeNet 预测结果”、“排查 FAR 回归问题”、“对 Visual ChangeNet 进行根因分析”。

description: Manage music releases using RELEASE.md documents stored in releases/{release-slug}/ within an artist workspace. Triggers when the user mentions an artist's album, EP, single, or project — or asks about release planning, DSP pitches, metadata, marketing, press materials, physical production, or tour coordination. First infer which artist and release the user means, then find or create the RELEASE.md. Use this skill to create, update, or pull data from release documents, and to generate deliverables like DSP pitches, press one-sheets, and production specs.
description_zh: 使用存储在艺术家工作区 releases/{release-slug}/ 目录下的 RELEASE.md 文档来管理音乐发行。当用户提及艺术家的专辑、EP、单曲或项目，或在询问发行规划、DSP 提案、元数据、营销、新闻稿资料、实体制作或巡演安排时触发。首先推断用户所指的艺术家和发行作品，然后查找或创建 RELEASE.md。使用此技能创建、更新或从发行文档中提取数据，并生成如 DSP 提案、新闻推广单页和制作规格等交付成果。

description: Designs and implements backend systems including REST APIs, microservices, database architectures, authentication flows, and security hardening. Use when the user asks to "design REST APIs", "optimize database queries", "implement authentication", "build microservices", "review backend code", "set up GraphQL", "handle database migrations", or "load test APIs". Covers Node.js/Express/Fastify development, PostgreSQL optimization, API security, and backend architecture patterns.
description_zh: 设计并实现包括REST API、微服务、数据库架构、认证流程以及安全加固在内的后端系统。当用户请求进行“设计REST API”、“优化数据库查询”、“实现认证”、“构建微服务”、“审查后端代码”、“配置GraphQL”、“处理数据库迁移”或“对API进行负载测试”时使用。涵盖Node.js/Express/Fastify开发、PostgreSQL优化、API安全以及后端架构模式。

description: Run multi-indicator technical analysis on crypto or market OHLCV data. Use for deterministic trend, momentum, volume, and divergence analysis.
description_zh: 对加密货币或市场 OHLCV 数据执行多指标技术分析。用于确定性趋势、动量、成交量及背离分析。

description: Use when implementing Disney's 12 animation principles with Framer Motion in React applications
description_zh: 用于在 React 应用中使用 Framer Motion 实现迪士尼 12 条动画原则

description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.
description_zh: 对任何问题、决定或创意挑战，开展多视角心智委员会审议。当用户需要多元观点、需要帮助做出艰难决定、请求委员会/小组/理事会讨论、想要从多个角度探索问题、请求魔鬼代言人分析，或说出诸如“不同专家会如何看待这件事”、“帮助我从所有角度思考这件事”、“委员会模式”、“心智委员会”或“就此进行审议”时，使用此技能。另外，当用户面临困境、权衡取舍或无明显答案的复杂选择时，也应触发此技能。

description: Action recognition from video sequences. Supports RGB, optical flow, and joint (multi-stream) input types for classifying temporal actions in video clips. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference on a TAO action-recognition model. Trigger phrases include "train action recognition", "video action classification", "RGB + optical flow action model", "TAO ActionRecognition".
description_zh: 从视频序列进行动作识别。支持RGB、光流以及联合（多流）输入类型，用于在视频片段中对时序动作进行分类。在TAO动作识别模型上进行训练、评估、导出或运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练动作识别”、“视频动作分类”、“RGB+光流动作模型”、“TAO ActionRecognition”。

description: Optical Inspection for defect detection using Siamese networks. Compares image pairs to detect manufacturing defects, anomalies, or quality issues. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO Optical Inspection model on AOI / quality-control data. Trigger phrases include "train optical inspection", "AOI defect detection", "Siamese defect classifier", "PCB / manufacturing inspection".
description_zh: 基于Siamese网络的光学缺陷检测。通过对比图像对以检测制造缺陷、异常或质量问题。在基于AOI/质量控制数据对TAO光学检测模型进行训练、评估、导出或运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练光学检测”、“AOI缺陷检测”、“Siamese缺陷分类器”、“PCB/制造检测”。

description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.
description_zh: 用于直接使用GeoPandas GeoSeries、GeoDataFrame、空间操作或向量数据I/O的Python工作流的指南和本地审计工具

description: Plans and audits use of ChicagoHAI HypoGeniC/HypoRefine for LLM-assisted hypothesis generation from labeled text datasets. Use for the `hypogenic` package, its task configs, hypothesis banks, or HypoBench datasets—not for manual hypothesis formulation or scientific validation.
description_zh: 关于使用芝加哥HAI HypoGeniC/HypoRefine 从标注文本数据集中生成 LLM 辅助假设的计划与审计。该工具适用于 `hypogenic` 包、其任务配置、假设库或 HypoBench 数据集——不可用于手动假设制定或科学验证。

description: Start, query, and stop a network-specific TAO inference microservice ({network_arch}-inference-microservice) by delegating container execution to the appropriate platform skill. Handles container image resolution, job-payload JSON construction, and the service registry. Use when the user wants to run inference on a TAO model checkpoint using a microservice container, deploy a TAO inference endpoint, or stop a running inference container.
description_zh: 通过委托容器执行至相应的平台技能，启动、查询和停止网络专用的TAO推理微服务（{network_arch}-inference-microservice）。其负责容器镜像解析、任务负载JSON构造以及服务注册。适用于用户需要使用微服务容器对TAO模型检查点进行推理、部署TAO推理端点或停止正在运行的推理容器时。

description: Grounding DINO for open-set object detection. Combines DINO-style detection with a BERT text encoder for language-guided detection — detects objects described by text prompts without a fixed class vocabulary. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Grounding DINO model. Trigger phrases include "train Grounding DINO", "open-vocabulary detection", "text-prompted detector", "language-guided object detection".
description_zh: 开放集目标检测的 Grounding DINO。它结合了 DINO 风格检测与 BERT 文本编码器，实现语言引导检测——在不依赖固定类别词汇表的情况下，检测由文本提示描述的物体。适用于对 TAO Grounding DINO 模型进行训练、评估、导出、量化及运行推理。触发短语包括“训练 Grounding DINO”、“开放词汇检测”、“文本提示检测器”和“语言引导目标检测”。

description: Help users build strategic partnerships and business development deals. Use when someone is pursuing a partnership, negotiating a BD deal, working with platforms like Google or Facebook, or trying to build distribution through partners.
description_zh: 帮助用户建立战略合作伙伴关系和业务发展协议。当有人寻求合作伙伴关系、谈判业务发展（BD）协议、与Google或Facebook等平台合作，或试图通过合作伙伴建立分销渠道时使用。

description: Help users run more effective meetings. Use when someone is dealing with meeting overload, wants to improve meeting culture, is preparing an important meeting, or struggles to get decisions made in meetings.
description_zh: 帮助用户高效召开会议。适用于应对会议过载、改善会议文化、准备重要会议或难以在会议中作出决策的情况。

description: Analyze the interest rate swap curve by pricing swaps at multiple tenors, overlaying government and inflation curves, and identifying curve trade opportunities. Use when analyzing swap curves, computing swap spreads, decomposing real rates, identifying steepener/flattener/butterfly trades, or comparing swap rates across currencies.
description_zh: 通过针对多个期限对互换进行定价、叠加政府及通胀曲线，识别曲线交易机会，来分析利率互换曲线。适用于分析互换曲线、计算互换价差、分解实际利率、识别陡峭/平坦/蝴蝶交易，或比较不同货币间的互换利率。

description: One-click contribution flow for OpenDesign (nexu-io/open-design) — even for non-coders. Pick one of four cards (ship a Skill or Design System you made with OD; translate docs; fix a typo / write a blog; report a bug), the agent validates and opens a PR (or issue) for you. Trigger words contribute to open design, ship my OD skill, ship my OD design system, translate OD docs, report an OD bug, od-contribute.
description_zh: OpenDesign（nexu-io/open-design）的一键贡献流程——即使非编码人员也能使用。从四张卡片中选择一项（使用 OD 发布你制作的 Skill 或设计系统；翻译文档；修正拼写错误 / 撰写博客；报告 bug），智能体会验证并为你打开 PR（或 issue）。触发关键词：contribute to open design、ship my OD skill、ship my OD design system、translate OD docs、report an OD bug、od-contribute。

description: Performs gap analysis on NVIDIA TAO VCN Classify (Visual Component Net) experiments by invoking the pinned TAO data-services container directly via `docker run … gap_analysis vcn_aoi …` — picks the optimal decision threshold, ranks per-sample weakness, and emits a top-K weakest parquet expanded per-lighting for downstream augmentation. Use when analyzing VCN classification failures, picking SDA augmentation targets, or auditing PASS/NO_PASS boundary cases.
description_zh: 通过直接调用固定的 TAO 数据服务容器执行 `docker run … gap_analysis vcn_aoi …`，对 NVIDIA TAO VCN Classify（视觉组件网络）实验进行差距分析——选取最优决策阈值，对逐样本弱点进行排序，并为下游数据增强生成按照明条件展开的前 K 个最弱 parquet 文件。适用于分析 VCN 分类失败、选取 SDA 增强目标，或审计 PASS/NO_PASS 边界情况。

description: NVPanoptix3D for panoptic 3D scene reconstruction from posed RGB images. Produces 3D panoptic segmentation (semantic, instance, and panoptic masks) with occupancy completion. Built on a VGGT backbone with a Mask2Former-style head and 3D frustum reconstruction. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO NVPanoptix3D model. Trigger phrases include "train NVPanoptix3D", "panoptic 3D reconstruction", "3D scene segmentation", "occupancy completion".
description_zh: NVPanoptix3D 用于从姿态RGB图像进行全景3D场景重建。生成带有占据补全的3D全景分割（语义、实例和全景掩膜）。基于VGGT骨干网络，配备Mask2Former风格头和3D视锥重建。适用于训练、评估、导出或运行TAO NVPanoptix3D模型的推理。触发短语包括"train NVPanoptix3D"、"panoptic 3D reconstruction"、"3D scene segmentation"、"occupancy completion"。

description: Pose classification using ST-GCN (Spatial Temporal Graph Convolutional Network). Classifies skeleton sequences into action categories from pose-keypoint data. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO pose-classification model. Trigger phrases include "train pose classification", "skeleton action recognition", "ST-GCN", "keypoint sequence classifier".
description_zh: 基于 ST-GCN（空间时间图卷积网络）的姿态分类。从姿态关键点数据将骨架序列分类为动作类别。用于为 TAO 姿态分类模型进行训练、评估、导出或运行推理。触发短语包括“train pose classification”，“skeleton action recognition”，“ST-GCN”，“keypoint sequence classifier”。

description: Bring existing tracker issues up to standard without implementing anything — applies missing SDLC labels, clarifies laconic issues (analyzing attached screenshots), posts a read-only implementation-prep analysis, checks each issue against SDLC.md's Definition of Ready (READY_STATUS, not-ready comment), and flags feature issues lacking a covering spec (optionally authoring one with --write-missing-specs). Single issue or a batch (last ~25 open, worst-described first). Idempotent, claim-aware.
description_zh: 在无需进行任何实现操作的情况下，将现有追踪器问题统一至标准水平——应用缺失的SDLC标签，澄清简略问题（分析附带的截图）；发布只读的实施准备分析报告；对照SDLC.md的“定义就绪”（READY_STATUS、未就绪评论）逐一检查每个问题；标记缺少覆盖规范的功能问题（可选使用--write-missing-specs撰写补充规范）。支持处理单个问题或批量任务（最后约25个未关闭的，按描述最简者优先），具有幂等性且支持认领。

description: Help users delegate effectively. Use when someone is struggling to let go of tasks, deciding what to delegate, building team autonomy, or balancing being hands-on vs hands-off.
description_zh: 帮助用户有效委派任务。适用于用户难以放手任务、决定委派事项、培养团队自主性，或平衡亲自参与与放手式管理的情况。

description: Run structured What-If scenario analysis with 4–6 branch possibility exploration (best, likely, worst, wild card, contrarian, second-order). Use when the user asks speculative what-if questions about uncertain futures, strategic forks, contingency planning, or stress-testing a decision before committing.
description_zh: 执行结构化的“如果-那么”情景分析，探索 4–6 种分支可能性（最佳、大概率、最坏、意外变量、逆向、二阶）。适用于用户提出关于不确定未来、战略分支、应急规划，或在做出决策前对决策进行压力测试的推测性“如果-那么”问题时。

description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.
description_zh: 顶尖UX/UI与高级GSAP动效工程师。严格落实基于Python驱动的布局差异真正随机化，推行严格的AIDA页面结构，采用宽幅编辑排版（禁止6行换行），构建无缝Bento网格，严格执行GSAP ScrollTriggers（包含固定、堆叠与滚动联动），内联微缩图片，并实施大幅区块间距。

description: Updates a presentation with new numbers — quarterly refreshes, earnings updates, comp rolls, rebased market data. Use whenever the user asks to "update the deck with Q4 numbers", "refresh the comps", "roll this forward", "swap in the new earnings", "change all the $485M to $512M", or any request to swap figures across an existing deck without rebuilding it.
description_zh: 为演示文稿更新新数据——进行季度刷新、财报更新、comps 滚动以及重基准化的市场数据。当用户要求“用 Q4 数据更新演示文稿”、“刷新 comps”、“将该数据向前滚动”、“用新财报数据替换”、“将所有的 $485M 改为 $512M”，或在现有演示文稿中替换数据而无需重新构建时，均可使用。

description: Run the technical (code) review step of Flows app certification in a local git app. Loads flows-review-checks for the actual bar, then writes artifacts under reviews/code-review/feedback-round-<N>/. Use when the user asks for a Flows code review, technical review, pre-submit review, app certification code review, or "run flows-code-review". Re-run until 0 open Must Fix items remain before moving on to flows-design-review.
description_zh: 在本地 Git 应用中执行 Flows 应用认证的技术（代码）审查步骤。加载实际 bar 对应的 flows-review-checks，随后在 reviews/code-review/feedback-round-<-N>-/ 目录下写入产物。适用场景：当用户请求 Flows 代码审查、技术审查、预提交审查、应用认证代码审查，或执行 "run flows-code-review" 时使用。重新运行，直到 open Must Fix 项为 0，再继续执行 flows-design-review。

description: Guide for using MSBuild Server to improve CLI build performance. Activate when developers report slow incremental builds from the command line, or when CLI builds are noticeably slower than IDE builds. Covers MSBUILDUSESERVER=1 environment variable for persistent server-based caching. Do not activate for IDE-based builds (Visual Studio already uses a long-lived process).
description_zh: 使用 MSBuild Server 提升 CLI 构建性能的指南。当开发者反馈命令行增量构建缓慢，或 CLI 构建明显慢于 IDE 构建时，启用。涵盖用于实现持久化服务器缓存的 MSBUILDUSESERVER=1 环境变量。不要为基于 IDE 的构建启用（Visual Studio 已使用长期运行的进程）。

description: Build, inspect, test, and analyze bounded process-based discrete-event simulations with SimPy, including events, resources, interrupts, monitoring, replications, warm-up, and reproducible output analysis.
description_zh: 使用 SimPy 构建、检查、测试并分析有界基于过程的离散事件仿真，包括事件、资源、中断、监控、重复运行、预热以及可复现输出分析。

description: Picks the right Netlify site-protection layer and disambiguates the three unrelated "auth" concepts users conflate — app-user login (Netlify Identity), site-load gating (Password Protection / project visibility), and dashboard SAML SSO. Use it when asked to password-protect a site or Deploy Preview, make a project private/public, restrict a site to your team, require SSO to view a site, set up company-wide app SSO, or invite users to a private project. Also use it for SSO-session symptoms on protected sites: "logged out mid-session", 401s after about an hour, or token expiry/refresh questions. Not for wiring auth code — route app-login setup to netlify-identity.
description_zh: 选择正确的 Netlify 站点保护层，并消除用户混淆的三个互不相关的“认证”概念——应用用户登录（Netlify Identity）、站点加载门控（密码保护 / 项目可见性）以及仪表盘 SAML SSO。当被要求对站点或部署预览进行密码保护、将项目设为私有或公开、将站点限制为您团队、要求使用 SSO 查看站点、设置公司级应用 SSO，或邀请用户加入私有项目时，使用它。同时，针对受保护站点上的 SSO 会话症状——如“会话中途登出”、大约一小时后出现 401 错误，或令牌过期/刷新相关疑问——也应使用它。不用于编写认证代码——将应用登录配置路由至 netlify-identity。

description: Monocular depth estimation using Metric Depth Anything v2 or Relative Depth Anything architectures. Predicts per-pixel depth from single RGB images. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO monocular depth model. Trigger phrases include "train monocular depth", "DepthAnything v2", "metric depth from single image", "monocular depth estimation".
description_zh: 基于 Metric Depth Anything v2 或 Relative Depth Anything 架构的单目深度估计。从单张 RGB 图像预测每个像素的深度。适用于训练、评估、导出或对 TAO 单目深度模型进行推理。触发短语包括：“train monocular depth”、“DepthAnything v2”、“metric depth from single image”、“monocular depth estimation”。

description: Mask2Former for universal image segmentation (panoptic, instance, and semantic). Transformer-based with masked attention for high-quality segmentation results. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Mask2Former model. Trigger phrases include "train Mask2Former", "universal segmentation", "panoptic / instance / semantic segmentation", "masked-attention transformer segmenter".
description_zh: Mask2Former 用于通用图像分割（全景、实例和语义）。基于Transformer架构、采用掩码注意力机制，可实现高质量分割结果。适用于为TAO Mask2Former模型训练、评估、导出、量化或推理。触发短语包括“训练Mask2Former”、“通用分割”、“全景分割/实例分割/语义分割”、“掩码注意力Transformer分割器”。

description: Tinybird file formats, SQL rules, optimization patterns, and best practices for datasources, pipes, endpoints, and materialized views.
description_zh: Tinybird 文件格式、SQL 规则、优化模式，以及数据源、管道、端点、物化视图的最佳实践。

description: Start an autonomous experiment loop with user-selected interval (10min, 1h, daily, weekly, monthly). Uses CronCreate for scheduling. Use when the user runs /ar:loop or asks to run an autoresearch experiment continuously on a schedule.
description_zh: 以用户选择的时间间隔（10分钟、1小时、每天、每周、每月）启动自主实验循环。使用 CronCreate 进行调度。当用户运行 `/ar:loop` 或要求按计划持续运行自动研究实验时使用。

description: Multi-objective optimization framework. NSGA-II, NSGA-III, MOEA/D, Pareto fronts, constraint handling, benchmarks (ZDT, DTLZ), for engineering design and optimization problems.
description_zh: 多目标优化框架。遗传算法II、遗传算法III、决策集优化算法、帕累托前沿、约束处理、基准测试（ZDT, DTLZ），用于工程设计与优化问题。

description: Generate talking head avatar videos with Pruna P-Video-Avatar via inference.sh CLI. Turn a portrait image into a realistic speaking video with built-in TTS. 18x faster and 6x cheaper than competitors. Models: P-Video-Avatar, P-Image (for portrait generation). Capabilities: text-to-avatar, audio-driven avatars, 30 voices, 10 languages, 720p/1080p, built-in TTS, dynamic backgrounds, full-body control. Use for: AI presenters, product demos, explainer videos, virtual influencers, marketing, education, multilingual content, UGC, gaming avatars. Triggers: avatar video, talking head, ai avatar, p-video-avatar, pruna avatar, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, virtual presenter, lipsync, talking avatar, ai spokesperson, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, veed alternative, fabric alternative, omnihuman alternative
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 Pruna P-Video-Avatar 生成口播头像视频。利用内置 TTS，将人像图像转化为真实的说话视频。比竞争对手快 18 倍、便宜 6 倍。

模型：P-Video-Avatar、P-Image（用于人像生成）。

功能：文本转头像、音频驱动头像、30 种语音、10 种语言、720p/1080p、内置 TTS、动态背景、全身控制。

适用场景：AI 主持人、产品演示、解说视频、虚拟网红、营销、教育、多语言内容、UGC、游戏头像。

触发词：头像视频、口播、AI 头像、P-Video-Avatar、Pruna 头像、视频头像、AI 主持人、数字人、虚拟主持人、唇动同步、口播头像、AI 发言人、heygen 替代方案、synthesia 替代方案、veed 替代方案、fabric 替代方案、omnihuman 替代方案。

description: Extract false-positive and false-negative gaps from VLM binary-classification-question (BCQ, yes/no) predictions. Use when the user asks to "analyze VLM BCQ gaps", "extract VLM false positives and false negatives", or identify failure cases from a predictions JSON for DEFT root-cause analysis on a binary-classification VLM workflow.
description_zh: 从 VLM 二分类问题（BCQ，是/否）的预测结果中提取误报和漏报偏差。当用户要求“分析 VLM BCQ 偏差”、“提取 VLM 误报和漏报”，或在二分类 VLM 工作流中针对 DEFT 进行根因分析时，从预测结果 JSON 中识别失败案例。

description: Person re-identification (ReID). Learns discriminative embeddings to match the same person across different camera views, based on metric learning. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO person re-identification model. Trigger phrases include "train ReID", "person re-identification", "cross-camera person matching", "ReID embeddings", "person re-id".
description_zh: 人员再识别（ReID）。基于度量学习，学习判别性嵌入，在不同摄像头视角下匹配同一个人。用于训练、评估、导出或运行推理的TAO人员再识别模型。触发短语包括"train ReID"、"人员再识别"、"跨摄像头人员匹配"、"ReID嵌入"、"person re-id"。

description: Implement an existing spec and ship a verified, reviewed, ready PR. Resolves the spec by path, name, issue, or spec-PR number (clean stop with candidates when not found). A spec PR stays design-only — implementation ships on its own PR referencing it. Delegates to om-auto-create-pr (om-auto-continue-pr for an existing implementation PR), then runs the review loop and UI verification with screenshots. Use for "implement the spec X", "build spec from issue 123".
description_zh: 实现现有规范，并发布一个已验证、已评审、就绪的 PR。可通过路径、名称、议题或规范 PR 编号定位规范（若未找到则正常终止并展示候选结果）。规范 PR 仅用于设计，实现将通过引用该 PR 的独立 PR 发布。调用 om-auto-create-pr（针对已存在的实现 PR 则调用 om-auto-continue-pr），随后运行评审循环并使用截图进行 UI 验证。适用于“实现规范 X”、“根据议题 123 构建规范”等场景。

description: Runs the payroll-confidence chain end to end — forecasts cash across the payroll window with cash-flow-snapshot, ranks and drafts overdue-invoice reminders with invoice-chase to close any gap, then assembles timesheets, flags every anomaly, and stages the run with payroll-prep. On Gusto the run is staged for the owner to submit; on QuickBooks Payroll, or with no payroll system, the last step is a validated run sheet the owner keys in. This chain never presses the payroll button. Builds on the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), with Gmail or M365, PayPal, Square, Stripe, and either Gusto or QuickBooks Payroll adding detail, and falls back to CSV and timesheet uploads. Use it whenever payroll is the worry, including "can I make payroll," "payroll is due Friday," "plan payroll," "will I have enough to pay the crew," or "I need to run payroll but money is tight." Accepts optional horizon and payroll-date arguments.
description_zh: 端到端运行支付工资保障链条——使用现金流快照在工资发放窗口期预测现金流，运用发票追缴对逾期票据提醒进行排序并草拟，以弥补任何缺口；随后汇总工时表，标记每一个异常情况，并配合工资准备（payroll-prep）为运行流程进行排期。在 Gusto 上，运行流程暂存以待业主提交；在 QuickBooks Payroll 上，或未配置任何工资系统时，最后一步是业主录入经核验的运行表。此链条绝不会直接按下工资确认按钮。基于总账（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）构建，接入 Gmail 或 M365、PayPal、Square、Stripe 以及 Gusto 或 QuickBooks Payroll 以补充细节，并回退至 CSV 与工时表上传。在工资发放成为核心顾虑时使用，包括“我能否发放工资”、“工资于周五到期”、“规划工资发放”、“我有足够资金支付员工团队吗”，或“我需要发放工资但资金紧张”。接受可选的周期（horizon）和工资发放日期（payroll-date）参数。

description: SCSS/Sassy CSS best practices and coding guidelines for maintainable, scalable stylesheets
description_zh: SCSS/Sassy CSS 用于可维护、可扩展样式表的最佳实践与编码指南

description: DINO (DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes) for 2D object detection. Transformer-based detector with denoising training, multi-scale features, and optional distillation support. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, distilling, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO DINO detector. Trigger phrases include "train DINO", "DETR object detection", "TAO 2D detection", "DINO with distillation".
description_zh: DINO（改进去噪锚框的 DETR）用于二维目标检测。这是一款基于 Transformer 的检测器，具备去噪训练、多尺度特征以及可选的蒸馏支持。适用于为 TAO DINO 检测器进行训练、评估、导出、蒸馏、量化或运行推理。触发短语包括“train DINO”、“DETR object detection”、“TAO 2D detection”、“DINO with distillation”。

description: Metric-learning recognition (ml-recog) for fine-grained visual recognition. Learns embeddings for retrieval-based matching (e.g., retail product recognition) using triplet / contrastive losses. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO metric-learning recognition model. Trigger phrases include "train metric learning", "ml-recog", "retrieval embeddings", "triplet loss recognition", "fine-grained matching".
description_zh: 用于细粒度视觉识别的度量学习识别（ml-recog）。使用三元组/对比损失学习用于检索式匹配（例如，零售产品识别）的嵌入。用于训练、评估、导出或运行 TAO 度量学习识别模型的推理。触发短语包括“train metric learning”、“ml-recog”、“retrieval embeddings”、“triplet loss recognition”、“fine-grained matching”。

description: Help users negotiate job offers and compensation. Use when someone is negotiating salary, equity, or other terms of a job offer, preparing for a compensation conversation, or asking how to ask for more money.
description_zh: 帮助用户协商工作录用与薪酬。当有人协商薪资、股权或其他工作录用条款，准备薪酬沟通，或询问如何要求更高薪酬时使用。

description: Deep security review patterns for authorization logic, data access boundaries, action isolation, rate limiting, and protecting sensitive operations
description_zh: 针对授权逻辑、数据访问边界、操作隔离、限流及敏感操作保护的深度安全审查模式

description: Azure cloud resources including VMs, VMSS, SQL Database, Storage, AKS, App Service, Functions, VNet networking, load balancers, Event Hubs, Container Apps, and Key Vault. Monitor Azure infrastructure, analyze resource usage, audit security posture, and manage organizational hierarchy across subscriptions and resource groups.
description_zh: Azure云资源包括虚拟机、虚拟机规模集、SQL数据库、存储、AKS、应用服务、函数、VNet网络、负载均衡器、事件中心、容器应用和密钥保管库。监控Azure基础设施，分析资源使用，审计安全态势，并管理跨订阅和资源组的组织层级。

description: Generates and reviews Salesforce Apex code with 150-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user writes, reviews, or fixes Apex classes, triggers, test classes, batch/queueable/schedulable jobs, or touches .cls/.trigger files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: LWC JavaScript (use sf-lwc), Flow XML (use sf-flow), SOQL-only queries (use sf-soql), or non-Salesforce code.
description_zh:
生成并审查采用 150 分评分的 Salesforce Apex 代码。

触发条件：当用户编写、审查或修复 Apex 类、触发器、测试类、批处理/队列任务/可调度任务，或触及 .cls/.trigger 文件时。

不得触发：当使用 LWC JavaScript（使用 sf-lwc）、Flow XML（使用 sf-flow）、仅使用 SOQL 的查询（使用 sf-soql），或非 Salesforce 代码时。

description: Compile current scholarly evidence for a scientific manuscript or research brief. Use when the user explicitly asks to gather literature, references, background evidence, competing findings, or a manuscript research packet. Uses Parallel Search by default, Parallel Extract for source verification, Parallel Research for explicitly deep/exhaustive work, optional explicit Parallel Chat, and optional Perplexity only when requested or allowed as a failure fallback.
description_zh: 汇总当前学术证据，用于科学论文或研究简报。在用户明确要求收集文献、参考文献、背景证据、不同研究结果，或论文研究资料包时使用。默认使用 Parallel Search，源验证使用 Parallel Extract，用于明确深度/详尽研究时使用 Parallel Research，可选明确使用 Parallel Chat，仅在请求或允许作为失败回退时使用 Perplexity。

description: TAO Execution SDK for submitting and monitoring GPU training jobs on supported platforms (Brev, SLURM, local Docker, Kubernetes). Use when the user wants to run TAO jobs through the SDK, get job tracking, S3 I/O wrapping, multi-node distributed training, or platform-specific features that docker-run can't provide. Trigger phrases include "use the TAO SDK", "call tao_sdk", "AutoMLRunner", "ActionWorkflow", "Job handles", "S3 I/O wrapping", "TAO platform run".
description_zh: TAO 执行 SDK：用于在支持的平台（Brev、SLURM、本地 Docker、Kubernetes）上提交与监控 GPU 训练任务。当用户希望通过 SDK 运行 TAO 任务、获取任务跟踪、进行 S3 I/O 封装、执行多节点分布式训练，或使用 docker-run 无法提供的平台特定功能时使用。触发短语包括"使用 TAO SDK"、"调用 tao_sdk"、"AutoMLRunner"、"ActionWorkflow"、"Job handles"、"S3 I/O wrapping"、"TAO platform run"。

description: RT-DETR (Real-Time DEtection TRansformer) for 2D object detection. Designed for real-time inference with competitive accuracy and supports distillation and quantization for deployment optimization. Use when training, evaluating, distilling, quantizing, exporting, or running inference for a TAO RT-DETR model. Trigger phrases include "train RT-DETR", "real-time DETR", "low-latency object detection", "RT-DETR distillation / quantization".
description_zh: RT-DETR（Real-Time DEtection TRansformer）是一款面向二维目标检测的模型。其设计专注于实时推理，具备高准确性，并支持知识蒸馏与量化，以实现部署优化。适用于对 TAO RT-DETR 模型进行训练、评估、知识蒸馏、量化、导出或运行推理。触发短语包括："train RT-DETR"、"real-time DETR"、"低延迟目标检测"、"RT-DETR 知识蒸馏/量化"。

description: Visual ChangeNet for binary image classification and segmentation in AOI defect detection. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for PCB defect detection or visual inspection, comparing image pairs for PASS/NO_PASS classification, or producing change-segmentation masks. Trigger phrases include "train Visual ChangeNet", "ChangeNet classify", "ChangeNet segment", "AOI defect detection", "PCB inspection model".
description_zh: Visual ChangeNet 用于 AOI 缺陷检测中的二值图像分类与分割。在 PCB 缺陷检测或视觉检测中，用于训练、评估、导出或运行推理，对比图像对进行 PASS/NO_PASS 分类，或生成变化分割掩码。触发短语包括“训练 Visual ChangeNet”、“ChangeNet 分类”、“ChangeNet 分割”、“AOI 缺陷检测”、“PCB 检测模型”。

description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.
description_zh: 涵盖遥感、GIS、空间分析、对地观测机器学习及30多个科学领域的全面地理空间科学技能。支持卫星影像处理（Sentinel、Landsat、MODIS、SAR、高光谱）、矢量与栅格数据操作、空间统计、点云处理、网络分析、云原生工作流（STAC、COG、行星计算机），以及8种编程语言（Python、R、Julia、JavaScript、C++、Java、Go、Rust）和500多个代码示例。可用于遥感工作流程、GIS分析、空间机器学习、对地观测数据处理、地形分析、水文学建模、海洋空间分析、大气科学及任何地理空间计算任务。

description: Four-step image referring-expression pipeline: turns images plus KITTI bounding-box labels into region descriptions, scene captions, grounded referring expressions, and (optionally) verified expressions via VLM distillation. Use when the user wants to generate referring-expression annotations from images with KITTI labels, build region descriptions, produce grouped grounding phrases tied to bboxes, run a double-check verification pass on grounding expressions, auto-label traffic / scene images for referring datasets, or run the image_referring_expression pipeline. Triggers include 'referring expression', 'region description', 'KITTI labels', 'spatial relationship annotation', 'auto-label image referring expression', 'image_referring_expression'.
description_zh: 四步图像指代表达式流水线：将图像与 KITTI 边界框标签转化为区域描述、场景描述、接地指代表达式，并（可选）通过 VLM 蒸馏生成已验证表达式。适用于用户需要从带 KITTI 标签的图像中生成指代表达式标注、构建区域描述、生成与边界框绑定的分组接地短语、对接地表达式进行双重校验验证、为指代数据集自动标注交通或场景图像，或运行 image_referring_expression 流水线的情况。触发条件包括 'referring expression'、'region description'、'KITTI labels'、'spatial relationship annotation'、'auto-label image referring expression'、'image_referring_expression'。

description: NVDINOv2 for self-supervised visual representation learning. Trains vision transformers via self-distillation (teacher-student) without labels and produces general-purpose visual features. Use when training, exporting, or running inference for a TAO NVDINOv2 backbone. Trigger phrases include "train NVDINOv2", "self-supervised ViT pretraining", "DINOv2 backbone", "visual representation learning".
description_zh: NVDINOv2 用于自监督视觉表征学习。通过自蒸馏（教师-学生）方式训练视觉 Transformer，无需标签，并生成通用视觉特征。适用于为 TAO NVDINOv2 骨干网络进行训练、导出或运行推理。触发短语包括“train NVDINOv2”、“self-supervised ViT pretraining”、“DINOv2 backbone”、“visual representation learning”。

description: CenterPose for keypoint / pose estimation. Detects object centers and regresses keypoint locations for 6-DoF object pose estimation. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO CenterPose model. Trigger phrases include "train CenterPose", "6-DoF object pose", "keypoint estimation", "object pose regression".
description_zh: 用于关键点/姿态估计的CenterPose。检测物体中心，并回归关键点位置，用于6自由度物体姿态估计。用于训练、评估、导出或运行TAO CenterPose模型的推理。触发短语包括"训练 CenterPose"、"6自由度物体姿态"、"关键点估计"、"物体姿态回归"。

description: Masked Auto-Encoder (MAE) for self-supervised pretraining and fine-tuning. Masks random patches and reconstructs them to learn visual representations; supports pretrain and finetune stages. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO MAE backbone. Trigger phrases include "pretrain MAE", "self-supervised vision pretraining", "Masked Autoencoder", "Mask Auto-Encoder", "MAE fine-tune".
description_zh: 掩码自编码器（MAE）用于自监督预训练和微调。通过掩蔽随机补丁并对其进行重建，学习视觉表征；支持预训练和微调阶段。用于训练、评估、导出或运行 TAO MAE 主干网络。触发短语包括 "pretrain MAE"、"self-supervised vision pretraining"、"Masked Autoencoder"、"Mask Auto-Encoder"、"MAE fine-tune"。

description: MAL (Mask Auto-Label) for weakly-supervised segmentation. Produces segmentation masks from minimal annotations (point or box annotations) using a ViT-MAE backbone. Use when training, evaluating, or running inference for a TAO MAL model. Trigger phrases include "train MAL", "Mask Auto-Label", "weakly-supervised segmentation", "box-prompted segmentation", "minimal-annotation mask prediction".
description_zh: MAL（Mask Auto-Label）用于弱监督分割。使用 ViT-MAE 骨干网络，从最少标注（点标注或框标注）生成分割掩码。适用于训练、评估或对 TAO MAL 模型进行推理。触发短语包括“train MAL”、“Mask Auto-Label”、“weakly-supervised segmentation”、“box-prompted segmentation”、“minimal-annotation mask prediction”。

description: Type-safe SQL ORM for TypeScript with zero runtime overhead
description_zh: 用于 TypeScript 的类型安全 SQL ORM，零运行时开销

description: 钉钉消息发送。当用户提到"钉钉消息"、"发消息"、"发通知"、"群通知"、"群消息"、"Webhook"、"机器人消息"、"机器人发消息"、"工作通知"、"单聊消息"、"群聊消息"、"撤回消息"、"消息已读"、"发送Markdown"、"发卡片消息"、"ActionCard"、"@某人"、"@员工"、"at某人"、"提醒某人"、"dingtalk message"、"send message"、"robot message"、"work notification"时使用此技能。支持：群自定义 Webhook 机器人（文本/Markdown/ActionCard/Link/FeedCard + 加签 + @某人）、企业内部应用机器人单聊和群聊发送、消息撤回、已读查询、工作通知等全部消息类操作。
description_zh:
钉钉消息发送。当用户提到"钉钉消息"、"发消息"、"发通知"、"群通知"、"群消息"、"Webhook"、"机器人消息"、"机器人发消息"、"工作通知"、"单聊消息"、"群聊消息"、"撤回消息"、"消息已读"、"发送Markdown"、"发卡片消息"、"ActionCard"、"@某人"、"@员工"、"at某人"、"提醒某人"、"dingtalk message"、"send message"、"robot message"、"work notification"时使用此技能。

支持：群自定义 Webhook 机器人（文本/Markdown/ActionCard/Link/FeedCard + 加签 + @某人）、企业内部应用机器人单聊和群聊发送、消息撤回、已读查询、工作通知等全部消息类操作。

description: Run the canonical NVIDIA AOI three-phase training pipeline — Phase 1 AutoML baseline (HPO), Phase 2 DEFT loop (RCA → SDG → mining → plain-train retrain), Phase 3 AutoML refinement on the DEFT-augmented dataset. Use when the user asks to "run the AOI workflow", "fine-tune my PCB AOI model end-to-end", "improve my AOI ChangeNet model", or "AOI workflow with AutoML" request — route here instead of tao-run-deft-aoi directly unless the user explicitly asks for the DEFT loop ONLY (e.g. "run JUST the DEFT loop", "skip AutoML, only DEFT"). Also handles the same three-phase pattern for non-AOI DEFT applications — AutoML baseline then DEFT loop warm-started from AutoML's winning HPs then post-DEFT AutoML refinement on the iteration-augmented dataset. Trigger phrases include "run the AOI workflow", "AOI end-to-end", "AutoML + DEFT", "AutoML then DEFT", "tune hyperparameters then DEFT", "DEFT with AutoML at both ends", "warm-start DEFT", "improve my AOI model".
description_zh: 运行标准的NVIDIA AOI三阶段训练管线——第一阶段AutoML基线（超参数优化，HPO），第二阶段DEFT循环（RCA → SDG → 数据挖掘 → 普通训练重训练），第三阶段在DEFT增强数据集上进行AutoML精调。当用户询问"运行AOI工作流"、"端到端微调我的PCB AOI模型"、"改进我的AOI ChangeNet模型"或"带有AutoML的AOI工作流"请求时使用——除非用户明确只要求执行DEFT循环（例如"仅运行DEFT循环"、"跳过AutoML，仅执行DEFT"），否则不要直接路由到tao-run-deft-aoi。同时，也处理非AOI的DEFT应用中相同的三阶段模式——先进行AutoML基线，然后从AutoML获胜的超参数热启动DEFT循环，最后在迭代增强数据集上进行DEFT后的AutoML精调。触发短语包括"运行AOI工作流"、"AOI端到端"、"AutoML + DEFT"、"AutoML然后DEFT"、"先优化超参数然后DEFT"、"两端均使用AutoML的DEFT"、"热启动DEFT"、"改进我的AOI模型"。

description: Run the full DEFT AOI improvement loop for NVIDIA TAO VisualChangeNet / ChangeNet PCB inspection models: baseline evaluate, RCA, Cosmos AnomalyGen / AMP synthetic defects, k-NN mining, retraining, and deployment gating until FAR / recall KPI targets are met. Use for prompts like "run the DEFT loop", "fine-tune until FAR below 0.1% at recall=100%", or "improve my AOI ChangeNet model with RCA and synthetic defects"; do not use for standalone TAO training, one-off inference, generic anomaly generation, or RCA-only analysis.
description_zh: 运行完整的DEFT AOI改进循环，用于NVIDIA TAO VisualChangeNet / ChangeNet PCB检测模型：基线评估、RCA、Cosmos AnomalyGen / AMP合成缺陷、k-NN挖掘、重新训练和部署门控，直至FAR/召回率KPI目标达标。用于类似“运行DEFT循环”、“在召回率为100%时持续微调，直至FAR降至0.1%以下”或“使用RCA和合成缺陷改进我的AOI ChangeNet模型”等提示词；不得用于独立的TAO训练、一次性推理、通用异常生成或仅RCA分析。

description: Standard single-step train/eval/export workflow for any TAO model. Use when training a TAO model on a dataset without iterative data augmentation, AutoML, or DEFT loops. Trigger phrases include "single train run", "train then evaluate then export", "plain TAO training", "normal training", "no AutoML", "skip the loop". Routes through the per-model SKILL.md for action specifics and through `tao-launch-workflow` for platform/credentials/dataset intake.
description_zh: 标准单步训练/评估/导出工作流，适用于任何 TAO 模型。在数据集上训练 TAO 模型、且不进行迭代式数据增强、AutoML 或 DEFT 循环时使用。触发短语包括“单次训练运行”、“先训练、再评估、再导出”、“普通 TAO 训练”、“常规训练”、“不使用 AutoML”、“跳过循环”。通过各模型的 SKILL.md 处理具体操作细节，并通过 `tao-launch-workflow` 处理平台、凭证与数据集接入。

description: Manage Coralogix SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions with the `cx slos` CLI — list and inspect SLOs, check whether targets and error budgets are healthy, and create, update, or delete SLO definitions from JSON. Use when the user asks to "list SLOs", "check SLO status", "is an SLO breaching", "error budget", "create an SLO", "update an SLO", "delete an SLO", or "service level objective".
description_zh: 使用 `cx slos` 命令行界面（CLI）管理 Coralogix SLO（服务级别目标）定义——列出并检查 SLO，确认目标与错误预算是否健康，并通过 JSON 创建、更新或删除 SLO 定义。适用于用户提出以下需求时："列出 SLO"、"检查 SLO 状态"、"SLO 是否触发"、"错误预算"、"创建 SLO"、"更新 SLO"、"删除 SLO"或"服务级别目标"。

description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.
description_zh: 单细胞分析中的带注释矩阵的数据结构。当处理 .h5ad 文件或集成 scverse 生态系统时使用。这是数据格式技能——进行数据分析工作流时使用 scanpy；进行概率模型使用时使用 scvi-tools；进行大规模人群查询时使用 cellxgene-census。

description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.
description_zh: 面向40+生物信息服务的统一Python接口。适用于在单一工作流中查询多个数据库（UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome），并具备统一API的场景。最适合跨数据库分析与跨服务ID映射。若需快速进行单数据库查询，请使用 gget；如需进行序列/文件操作，请使用 biopython。

description: Create safety-bounded draft structures and run local deterministic checks for clinical case, diagnostic, trial, safety, and aggregate research reports. Use only with synthetic, de-identified, or aggregate inputs and verified source-fact manifests; every output requires qualified review.
description_zh: 创建受安全约束的草稿结构，并针对临床病例、诊断报告、试验、安全及汇总研究报告执行本地确定性检查。仅允许使用合成数据、去标识化数据或汇总数据及已验证的源事实清单；每个输出均需经过资质审查。
