description: Mask Grounding DINO for grounded instance segmentation. Extends Grounding DINO with a mask-prediction head for open-set segmentation guided by text prompts. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Mask-Grounding-DINO model. Trigger phrases include "train Mask Grounding DINO", "open-vocabulary segmentation", "text-prompted instance segmentation", "grounded mask DETR".
description_zh: 用于基于文本引导的实例分割的Mask Grounding DINO。在Grounding DINO基础上增加了用于文本提示引导的开集分割的掩码预测头。用于TAO Mask-Grounding-DINO模型训练、评估、导出、量化及运行推理。触发短语包括“train Mask Grounding DINO”、“开放词汇分割”、“基于文本提示的实例分割”、“grounded mask DETR”。

description: SegFormer for semantic segmentation. Lightweight transformer-based architecture with hierarchical feature extraction, efficient for real-time segmentation tasks. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO SegFormer model. Trigger phrases include "train SegFormer", "semantic segmentation", "lightweight transformer segmenter", "real-time semantic segmentation".
description_zh: SegFormer 用于语义分割。基于Transformer的轻量级架构，具有层次化特征提取，高效适用于实时分割任务。用于训练、评估、导出、量化或为 TAO SegFormer 模型运行推理。触发短语包括'训练 SegFormer'、'语义分割'、'轻量级Transformer分割器'、'实时语义分割'。

description: Help users transform organizations toward modern product practices. Use when someone is trying to shift from feature teams to product teams, introduce empowered teams, modernize legacy processes, or drive cultural change in how product is built.
description_zh: 帮助用户将组织转型为现代产品实践。当有人试图从功能团队转向产品团队、引入授权团队、使遗留流程现代化，或推动产品构建方式的文化变革时使用。

description: Multi-platform AI image generation via DashScope/Ark/Hunyuan/Zhipu/StepFun plus Grok/OpenAI/Gemini/FLUX (international), specializing in Chinese text rendering and photorealistic images
description_zh: 基于DashScope、Ark、Hunyuan、Zhipu、StepFun及Grok、OpenAI、Gemini、FLUX（国际平台）的多平台AI图像生成，专注于中文文本渲染与写实图像。

description: Brev managed GPU instances with Docker support. Use when running TAO training, evaluation, or inference on Brev GPU instances, managing Brev deployments, or dispatching TAO jobs through the Brev CLI. Trigger phrases include "run on Brev", "Brev GPU instance", "submit job to Brev", "Brev CLI deployment".
description_zh: Brev 管理支持 Docker 的 GPU 实例。在 Brev GPU 实例上运行 TAO 训练、评估或推理，管理 Brev 部署，或通过 Brev CLI 调度 TAO 任务时使用。触发短语包括："在 Brev 上运行"、"Brev GPU 实例"、"提交任务至 Brev"、"Brev CLI 部署"。

description: BEVFusion for multi-sensor 3D object detection. Fuses LiDAR point clouds and camera images in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space, used in autonomous driving for robust 3D perception. Use when training, evaluating, or running inference for a TAO BEVFusion model. Trigger phrases include "train BEVFusion", "LiDAR + camera fusion", "BEV 3D detection", "multi-sensor 3D perception".
description_zh: 用于多传感器三维物体检测的BEVFusion。在鸟瞰视角（BEV）空间中融合LiDAR点云和相机图像，用于自动驾驶的鲁棒3D感知。在训练、评估或为TAO BEVFusion模型运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练BEVFusion”、“LiDAR与相机融合”、“BEV三维检测”、“多传感器三维感知”。

description: OCDNet for scene text detection. Detects arbitrary-oriented text regions in natural images using a differentiable binarization approach. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, pruning, quantizing, retraining, or running inference for a TAO OCDNet model. Trigger phrases include "train OCDNet", "scene text detection", "arbitrary-oriented text boxes", "differentiable binarization detector".
description_zh: 场景文本检测 OCDNet。基于可微二值化方法，对自然图像中的任意方向文本区域进行检测。适用于在 TAO OCDNet 模型上进行训练、评估、导出、剪枝、量化、重训练或运行推理。触发短语包括：“train OCDNet”、“scene text detection”、“arbitrary-oriented text boxes”、“differentiable binarization detector”。

description: OneFormer for universal image segmentation. Unifies panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation with a single architecture using task-conditioned queries. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO OneFormer model. Trigger phrases include "train OneFormer", "universal segmentation", "task-conditioned segmentation", "panoptic / instance / semantic in one model".
description_zh: OneFormer 通用图像分割。采用任务条件查询，以单一架构统一全景分割、实例分割和语义分割。适用于为 TAO OneFormer 模型进行训练、评估、导出、量化或运行推理。触发短语包括“train OneFormer”、“universal segmentation”、“task-conditioned segmentation”、“panoptic / instance / semantic in one model”。

description: PointPillars for 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds. Encodes point clouds into a pseudo-image via a pillar-based representation, then applies 2D detection — used in autonomous driving and robotics. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, pruning, retraining, or running inference for a TAO PointPillars model. Trigger phrases include "train PointPillars", "LiDAR 3D detection", "point-cloud object detection", "pillar-based 3D detector".
description_zh: 基于LiDAR点云的PointPillars，用于3D目标检测。该方法通过柱体表示将点云编码为伪图像，随后应用二维检测，广泛应用于自动驾驶和机器人技术领域。适用于对TAO PointPillars模型进行训练、评估、导出、剪枝、再训练或运行推理。触发短语包括"train PointPillars"、"LiDAR 3D detection"、"point-cloud object detection"、"pillar-based 3D detector"。

description: Generate structured narrative text visualizations from data using T8 Syntax. Use when users want to create data interpretation reports, summaries, or structured articles with semantic entity annotations. T8 is designed for unstructured data visualization where T stands for Text and 8 represents a byte of 8 bits, symbolizing deep insights beneath the text.
description_zh: 使用 T8 语法从数据生成结构化叙事文本可视化。适用于用户创建数据解读报告、摘要或带有语义实体标注的结构化文章。T8 专为非结构化数据可视化设计，其中 T 代表文本，8 代表一个 8 位字节，象征文本之下蕴含的深度洞察。

description: Complete reference for writing, running, and iterating on evals (automated conversation tests) for ADK agents. Covers eval file format, all assertion types, CLI usage, and per-primitive testing patterns.
description_zh: ADK 智能体评估（自动化对话测试）的编写、运行与迭代完整参考指南。涵盖评估文件格式、所有断言类型、CLI 使用，以及针对每种原语的测试模式。

description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT-Image-2 via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, mask-based editing, multi-image reference, batch generation. Use for: product mockups, marketing visuals, image editing, concept art, inpainting, photo manipulation. Triggers: gpt image, gpt-image-2, openai image, chatgpt image, dall-e, dalle, openai image generation, gpt image edit, gpt inpainting, openai dall-e, gpt 4o image
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI，使用 OpenAI GPT-Image-2 生成和编辑图像。模型：GPT-Image-2。功能：文生图、图像编辑、图像修复、基于遮罩的编辑、多图像参考、批量生成。用途：产品原型、营销视觉图、图像编辑、概念艺术、图像修复、照片处理。触发词：gpt image、gpt-image-2、openai image、chatgpt image、dall-e、dalle、openai image generation、gpt image edit、gpt inpainting、openai dall-e、gpt 4o image

description: Run `tao-daft validate` to check NVIDIA TAO DAFT datasets for structure, schema, and cross-reference errors. Do not use for non-DAFT formats. Use when the user asks to validate a DAFT dataset, check DAFT schema, validate a TAO dataset format, or run `tao-daft validate`.
description_zh: 运行 `tao-daft validate` 以检查 NVIDIA TAO DAFT 数据集的结构、模式（schema）及交叉引用错误。不可用于非 DAFT 格式。当用户要求验证 DAFT 数据集、检查 DAFT 模式（schema）、验证 TAO 数据集格式或运行 `tao-daft validate` 时使用。

description: Help users onboard new team members effectively. Use when someone is planning onboarding for a new hire, starting a new job themselves, designing a first-90-days plan, or trying to ramp up new employees faster.
description_zh: 帮助用户有效引导新团队成员入职。当为新人规划入职、自行开始新工作、设计入职前90天计划，或尝试加快新员工上手速度时使用。

description: Scans the developer's machine for dead side projects, autopsies each one from its git history (died at the payments wall, killed by a newer project, finished but never shipped), surfaces their personal death patterns, and picks the corpse most worth resurrecting — then helps ship it. Use when the user mentions abandoned, unfinished, or old side projects, asks "what should I finish", wants to revive or resurrect a project, says "run the graveyard", wonders why they never finish anything, or is about to start a new project that sounds like one they already built. Runs entirely locally.
description_zh: 扫描开发者的机器，查找已失效的副项目；根据各自的 git 历史进行深入尸检，分析其在支付环节受阻、被更新的项目取代而夭折，或开发完成但从未发布等情况下的“死亡规律”，挑选出最值得复活的“遗体”，并协助将其发布上线。适用场景：当用户提及被搁置、未完成或陈旧的副项目，询问“我该完成什么”，想要复活或重启项目，说“运行墓地”，疑惑为何从未完成任何项目，或即将启动一个听起来像自己曾做过的项目时使用。完全在本地运行。

description: Strict frontend design guardrails for building modern, minimal-visual-noise, airy, non-generic app UIs. Use whenever creating or changing frontend UI, React components, shadcn/ui themes, Tailwind styles, app layouts, or first-version product screens. This skill complements vertical/domain skills like CPQ, CRM, and similar app builders: follow the selected domain skill's workflow and layout requirements, then enforce this skill's shared visual rules for brand-aware theming, generous spacing, typography, contrast, roundedness, shadows, surface hierarchy, cardless defaults, no-sidebar defaults, and anti-pattern avoidance.
description_zh: 构建现代、视觉极简、通透且不千篇一律的应用界面，需遵循严格的前端设计规范。在创建或更改前端界面、React 组件、shadcn/ui 主题、Tailwind 样式、应用布局或首版产品屏幕时，均需使用本规范。本技能可与 CPQ、CRM 等垂直/领域技能及同类应用构建工具协同使用：在遵循所选领域技能的工作流与布局要求后，再执行本技能共享的视觉规则，涵盖品牌感知的主题、充裕的间距、排版、对比度、圆角、阴影、表面层级、默认无卡片设计、默认无侧边栏设计以及避免不良设计模式。

description: Convert .NET tests from xUnit.net v2/v3 to MSTest v4 while preserving VSTest or MTP. Use for replacing xunit packages, Fact/Theory/InlineData/MemberData, assertions, IClassFixture/ICollectionFixture, ITestOutputHelper, TestContext cancellation, traits/Owner, skips, timeouts, and xUnit parallelization. Also use when a "convert xUnit to MSTest" request may already be migrated: inspect and report the no-op. Do not use for xUnit v2-to-v3, MSTest upgrades, NUnit/TUnit conversion, or runner-only VSTest-to-MTP migration.
description_zh: 将 .NET 测试从 xUnit.net v2/v3 转换为 MSTest v4，同时保留 VSTest 或 MTP。用于替换 xunit 程序包、Fact/Theory/InlineData/MemberData、断言、IClassFixture/ICollectionFixture、ITestOutputHelper、TestContext 取消机制、traits/Owner、跳过、超时以及 xUnit 并行化。当“将 xUnit 转换为 MSTest”的请求可能已经迁移完成时，也使用：检查并报告 no-op。不得用于 xUnit v2 至 v3 转换、MSTest 升级、NUnit/TUnit 转换，或仅运行器的 VSTest 至 MTP 迁移。

description: Help users build and maintain strong team culture. Use when someone is defining team values, creating psychological safety, onboarding to a new team, navigating cultural change, or building distributed team norms.
description_zh: 帮助用户建立并维持强大的团队文化。当需要定义团队价值观、营造心理安全感、加入新团队、应对文化变革或建立分布式团队规范时使用。

description: 理论溯源与案例重释。审查 PPT、课程、文案或方法论中的经验判断，先判断命题是否成立，再匹配并核实可信理论，用该理论重释案例并标明边界。适用于给自创理论找依据、给 PPT 补理论来源、判断一句话能否上升为理论、检查是否硬套名人；聚焦单次理论锚定，不默认展开历史同构研究。
description_zh: 理论溯源与案例重释。审查 PPT、课程、文案或方法论中的经验判断，先判断命题是否成立，再匹配并核实可信理论，用该理论重释案例并标明边界。适用于为自创理论寻找依据、为 PPT 补充理论来源、判断一句话能否上升为理论、检查是否硬套名人；聚焦单次理论锚定，不默认展开历史同构研究。

description: Create publication figures with matplotlib/seaborn/plotly. Multi-panel layouts, error bars, significance markers, colorblind-safe, export PDF/EPS/TIFF, for journal-ready scientific plots.
description_zh: 使用 matplotlib/seaborn/plotly 创建出版图表。支持多面板布局、误差条、显著性标记、色盲友好，可导出 PDF/EPS/TIFF，适用于制作期刊级别的科学图表。

description: Diagnose and fix browser, preview, or Electron export/download failures, especially image export issues involving Save As, Blob/Data URLs, the File System Access API, createWritable failures, and 0 KB files.
description_zh: 诊断并修复浏览器、预览或 Electron 的导出/下载失败问题，特别是涉及 Save As、Blob/数据 URL、文件系统访问 API、createWritable 失败以及 0 KB 文件的图片导出问题。

description: Deformable DETR for 2D object detection. Uses deformable attention for efficient multi-scale feature processing, lighter than DINO with competitive accuracy. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Deformable-DETR model. Trigger phrases include "train deformable-detr", "Deformable DETR object detection", "lightweight DETR detector".
description_zh: 用于二维目标检测的可变形 DETR。使用可变形注意力实现高效的多尺度特征处理，比 DINO 更轻量，且具有竞争力精度。用于训练、评估、导出、量化或运行推理的 TAO 可变形 DETR 模型。触发短语包括“train deformable-detr”、“Deformable DETR object detection”、“lightweight DETR detector”。

description: Integrate TileGym kernels into Hugging Face `transformers` models by replacing the library's submodule(s) and certain class(es)' implementations, and patching certain class(es)' init/forward/load weight methods prior to instantiating models. Used when the user requires integrating TileGym kernels into `transformers` models.
description_zh: 将 TileGym 内核集成到 Hugging Face `transformers` 模型中，通过替换库的子模块和某些类的实现，并在实例化模型之前修补某些类的 `init`、`forward` 和加载权重（`load weight`）方法。用于当用户需要将 TileGym 内核集成到 `transformers` 模型时。

description: Help users build strong engineering culture. Use when someone is improving developer experience, fostering technical excellence, designing engineering practices, or scaling an engineering organization.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建强大的工程文化。在提升开发者体验、培养技术卓越、设计工程实践或扩展工程组织时使用。

description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.
description_zh: 自动化浏览器交互，测试网页，并配合 Playwright 测试工作。

description: Migrate Chakra UI projects from v2 to v3, covering package changes, codemods, provider setup, color mode, prop renaming, compound components, theming, recipes, and Next.js updates. Use this skill whenever a user is upgrading Chakra UI versions, encountering breaking changes after an upgrade, converting old v2 patterns (ColorModeScript, useColorModeValue, styleConfig, extendTheme, isDisabled, colorScheme, @chakra-ui/icons, framer-motion dependency), fixing compound component patterns, or asking about differences between Chakra UI v2 and v3 — even if they don't say "migrate" or "upgrade" explicitly.
description_zh: 将 Chakra UI 项目从 v2 迁移到 v3，涵盖包变更、codemods、提供程序设置、颜色模式、属性重命名、复合组件、主题、配方和 Next.js 更新。当用户升级 Chakra UI 版本、在升级后遇到破坏性变更、转换旧版 v2 模式（ColorModeScript、useColorModeValue、styleConfig、extendTheme、isDisabled、colorScheme、@chakra-ui/icons、framer-motion 依赖项）、修复复合组件模式，或询问 Chakra UI v2 与 v3 之间的差异时，应使用此技能——即使他们没有明确提及“迁移”或“升级”。

description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.
description_zh: 支持快速的CLI/Python查询，可访问20多个生物信息学数据库。用于快速查询：基因信息、BLAST/BLAT、病毒序列下载、AlphaFold结构、富集分析、OpenTargets、COSMIC、CELLxGENE以及8cube小鼠特异性和表达数据。最适合交互式探索和简单查询。如需批量处理或高级BLAST查询，请使用biopython；如需跨数据库的Python工作流，请使用bioservices。

description: Dump Unity IL2CPP symbols from iOS/Android builds. Extract method names, addresses, and type info from IL2CPP binaries and global-metadata.dat, then generate IDA/Ghidra import scripts.
description_zh: 从 iOS/Android 构建版本中导出 Unity IL2CPP 符号。从 IL2CPP 二进制文件和 global-metadata.dat 中提取方法名称、地址和类型信息，然后生成 IDA/Ghidra 导入脚本。

description: Understand images and videos with Qwen vision models. TRIGGER when: user wants to analyze, describe, or extract information from images or videos, OCR text extraction, chart/table reading, visual reasoning, multi-image comparison, screenshot understanding, video comprehension, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-vision). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to generate/create images (use qwencloud-image-generation), generate videos (use qwencloud-video-generation), text-only tasks without visual input, or non-Qwen vision tasks.
description_zh: 使用 Qwen 视觉模型理解图片和视频。触发条件：当用户希望对图片或视频进行分析、描述或提取信息，进行 OCR 文本提取、图表/表格阅读、视觉推理、多图比较、截图理解、视频理解，或明确以名称调用本技能（例如使用 qwencloud-vision）时。不得触发的情况：当用户希望生成/创建图片（使用 qwencloud-image-generation）、生成视频（使用 qwencloud-video-generation）、仅文本任务且无视觉输入，或非 Qwen 视觉任务时。

description: Fully autonomous research pipeline that turns a topic idea into a complete academic paper with real citations, experiments, and conference-ready LaTeX.
description_zh: 一种将主题想法转化为包含真实引用、实验及会议级LaTeX的完整学术论文的完全自主研究管线。

description: OpenInference semantic conventions and instrumentation for Phoenix AI observability. Use when implementing LLM tracing, creating custom spans, or deploying to production.
description_zh: OpenInference Phoenix AI 可观测性语义约定与监控插桩。当实现 LLM 追踪、创建自定义 span 或部署到生产环境时使用。

description: Systematic debugging for ADK agents — trace reading, log analysis, common failure diagnosis, and the debug loop.
description_zh: 针对 ADK 智能体的系统化调试——追踪阅读、日志分析、常见问题诊断与调试循环。

description: Use inside a product repository when the user wants the full MVP built from their BuilderOS spec documents. Triggers on phrases like "build my MVP", "build the app", "execute the roadmap", "start the build", "work through the whole roadmap", "build everything", or any request to implement the entire plan rather than a single task or phase. Requires `docs/prd.md` and `docs/product-roadmap.md` (plus `docs/product-vision.md` and `docs/design.md` for context). Works through every roadmap task in order — implementing, testing, and verifying each before moving on, marking checkboxes and updating the status line — and runs until all tasks are complete and the magic moment works end to end, then initializes git with an initial commit and offers to connect a remote repo.
description_zh: 当用户希望从自己的 BuilderOS 规格文档构建完整的 MVP 时，可在某个产品仓库中使用该功能。触发条件为出现以下短语：“build my MVP”、“build the app”、“execute the roadmap”、“start the build”、“work through the whole roadmap”、“build everything”，或任何要求实施整个计划而非单个任务或阶段的请求。需要 `docs/prd.md` 和 `docs/product-roadmap.md`（以及 `docs/product-vision.md` 和 `docs/design.md` 作为上下文参考）。它会按顺序处理路线图中的每一项任务——在实施、测试并验证每一项之后再进行下一步，标记复选框并更新状态行——并运行直至所有任务均已完成，且魔法时刻实现端到端运行，随后使用初始提交初始化 git，并提议连接远程仓库。

description: Use when user wants to generate music, songs, or audio tracks. Triggers on any request involving music creation, song writing, lyrics generation, audio production, or covers. Also triggers when user provides lyrics and wants them turned into a song, or describes a mood/scene and wants background music. Supports multilingual triggers — match equivalent phrases in any language. Do NOT use for music playback of existing files, music theory questions, or music recommendation without generation.
description_zh: 适用于用户想要生成音乐、歌曲或音频曲目时。当涉及音乐创作、歌曲写作、歌词生成、音频制作或翻唱的任何请求时，均会触发。此外，当用户提供歌词并希望将其转化为歌曲，或描述情绪/场景并希望获得背景音乐时，也会触发。支持多语言触发——匹配任意语言的等效表达。请勿用于播放已有音频文件、音乐理论问题或无需生成的音乐推荐。

description: Prepare and validate research-only clinical decision-support evaluation, evidence-profile, cohort, survival, biomarker/model, privacy, and governance artifacts. Use for aggregate or synthetic research documentation and traceability—not patient care or live clinical operation.
description_zh: 准备并验证仅用于研究的临床决策支持评估、证据档案、队列、生存分析、生物标志物/模型、隐私及治理制品。用于汇总或合成的科研文档与可追溯性——不可用于患者照护或实时临床运营。

description: Runs the DEFT embed-then-mine workflow for VCN AOI iterations — embeds the gap-analysis target parquet, embeds a source pool, and mines nearest-neighbour source images for downstream augmentation. Use as the immediate next step after `tao-route-visual-changenet-samples` when expanding a real-image augmentation queue from the mining subset.
description_zh: 运行 DEFT 的 embed-then-mine 工作流，用于 VCN AOI 迭代 — 嵌入差距分析目标 parquet，嵌入源池，并挖掘最近的邻域源图像，用于下游数据增强。当从挖掘子集中扩展真实图像数据增强队列时，将其作为紧随 `tao-route-visual-changenet-samples` 之后的步骤使用。

description: Remote SLURM GPU cluster execution over SSH with sbatch/srun, Pyxis/Enroot containers, and Lustre-backed results. Use when running TAO training/eval/inference jobs on an on-prem or DGX SLURM cluster. Trigger phrases include "run on SLURM", "submit sbatch", "DGX SLURM cluster", "Pyxis/Enroot container", "Lustre dataset".
description_zh: 通过 SSH 远程执行 SLURM GPU 集群任务，使用 sbatch/srun、Pyxis/Enroot 容器以及基于 Lustre 的结果。适用于在本地或 DGX SLURM 集群上运行 TAO 训练/评估/推理任务。触发短语包括“run on SLURM”、“submit sbatch”、“DGX SLURM cluster”、“Pyxis/Enroot container”、“Lustre dataset”。

description: Produces a one-page cross-functional business snapshot for SMB owners — cash position (the ledger: MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), sales trend (PayPal/Square/Stripe), pipeline movement (HubSpot), this week's commitments (Calendar), urgent watch-list items (Gmail or M365, Slack), and the single most important thing needing attention today. Proactively tries every available connector and gracefully scopes to whatever is connected — one connector gives a partial pulse; the full stack gives the full picture. Trigger when the user asks how the business is doing, wants a snapshot, a daily brief, a Friday recap, or says anything like "what am I missing" or "catch me up on the business." A start-of-week briefing routes to /monday-brief, which runs this skill as its first link.
description_zh:
为中小型企业主生成一页式的跨职能业务快照——包含现金流状况（账簿：MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）、销售趋势（PayPal/Square/Stripe）、线索管道动态（HubSpot）、本周承诺事项（Calendar）、紧急关注清单（Gmail 或 M365、Slack），以及今日最需关注的核心事项。
主动尝试所有可用连接器，并根据已连接的内容进行合理适配——一个连接器可提供局部脉搏，全栈则提供完整全貌。
当用户询问业务现状如何、需要一份快照、每日简报或周五回顾，或说出诸如“我漏了什么”或“让我了解业务动态”等类似表述时，即触发。
周初简报会路由至 /monday-brief，该流程将本技能作为其首个环节运行。

description: Full brand naming workflow for founders, agencies, and businesses. Use this skill whenever the user says "help me name this brand", "brand naming", "I need a name for", "name ideas for", "what should I call my brand/company/product", "naming a startup", "brand name suggestions", "help with naming", or shares a brand brief and asks for name options. Also triggers when the user shares existing name options and asks for feedback, evaluation, ranking, or scoring of those names. Auto-detects whether to run the full generation workflow or the evaluation workflow based on what the user provides. Always use this skill for any brand or product naming task — even if the user just casually mentions needing a name.
description_zh: 面向创始人、机构和企业的品牌命名完整工作流。用户每当使用以下表述时，请使用本技能："help me name this brand"、"品牌命名"、"I need a name for"、"name ideas for"、"what should I call my brand/company/product"、"naming a startup"、"brand name suggestions"、"help with naming"，或提供品牌简报并寻求名称选项时。当用户提供现有名称选项并寻求反馈、评估、排序或评分时，也会触发本技能。根据用户提供的信息，自动判断是运行完整的生成工作流还是评估工作流。对于任何品牌或产品命名任务，始终使用本技能——即使用户只是随意提及需要命名。

description: Version-aware guidance for PufferLib reinforcement-learning environments, vectorization, policies, PuffeRL training, evaluation, and safe checkpoint review. Use when adapting Gymnasium/PettingZoo environments to published PufferLib 3.0.0 or working with the redesigned native 4.0 source line.
description_zh: PufferLib强化学习环境、向量化、策略、PuffeRL训练、评估及安全检查点审查的版本感知指南。适用于将Gymnasium/PettingZoo环境适配至已发布的PufferLib 3.0.0版本，或在处理重新设计的原生4.0源码版本线时使用。

description: Real-time stereo depth estimation using FastFoundationStereo (FFS), the distilled bp2 commercial variant of FoundationStereo. Predicts disparity maps from stereo image pairs with ~10× lower latency than full FoundationStereo. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO FastFoundationStereo (FFS) model. Trigger phrases include "train fast stereo", "real-time stereo disparity", "FastFoundationStereo", "distilled stereo depth".
description_zh: 基于FastFoundationStereo (FFS)的实时立体深度估计，FastFoundationStereo是FoundationStereo的蒸馏bp2商用变体。该模型能从立体图像对中预测视差图，相比完整的FoundationStereo延迟降低约10倍。适用于训练、评估、导出或运行TAO FastFoundationStereo (FFS)模型的推理任务。触发短语包括"train fast stereo"、"real-time stereo disparity"、"FastFoundationStereo"、"distilled stereo depth"。

description: Stereo depth estimation using FoundationStereo. Predicts disparity maps from stereo image pairs for 3D reconstruction. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO FoundationStereo model. Trigger phrases include "train stereo depth", "FoundationStereo", "stereo disparity estimation", "3D reconstruction from stereo".
description_zh: 基于 FoundationStereo 的立体深度估计。从立体图像对预测视差图，用于三维重建。当对 TAO FoundationStereo 模型进行训练、评估、导出或运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“train stereo depth”、“FoundationStereo”、“stereo disparity estimation”、“3D reconstruction from stereo”。

description: Set up React Three Fiber scenes, Canvas, typed JSX, hooks, and resource ownership. Use for scene architecture and render-loop setup, rather than detailed materials or effects.
description_zh: 设置 React Three Fiber 场景、Canvas、类型化 JSX、Hooks 及资源所有权。用于场景架构和渲染循环设置，而非详细材质或特效。

description: Use pydicom to read, inspect, write, transform, and safely preflight local DICOM datasets and pixel data. Applies to DICOM metadata, transfer syntaxes, compression plugins, frames, private elements, JSON, and bounded de-identification review.
description_zh: 使用 pydicom 读取、检查、写入、转换并安全预检本地 DICOM 数据集与像素数据。适用于 DICOM 元数据、传输语法、压缩插件、帧、私有元素、JSON 以及有界去标识化审查。

description: Sparse4D for multi-camera temporal 3D object detection and tracking. Uses sparse queries with deformable attention across camera views and time for end-to-end 3D perception, with an instance bank for temporal tracking. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Sparse4D model. Trigger phrases include "train Sparse4D", "multi-camera 3D detection", "temporal 3D tracker", "sparse query 3D perception".
description_zh: Sparse4D 用于多相机时序 3D 目标检测与跟踪。采用稀疏查询，并结合跨相机视角与时间域的可变形注意力，实现端到端的 3D 感知，并配备实例库用于时序跟踪。适用于对 TAO Sparse4D 模型进行训练、评估、导出、量化或运行推理。触发短语包括“train Sparse4D”、“multi-camera 3D detection”、“temporal 3D tracker”、“sparse query 3D perception”。

description: Help users design sales compensation plans. Use when someone is hiring their first sales rep, restructuring sales comp, trying to align sales incentives with business goals, or dealing with comp plan issues like sandbagging or churn.
description_zh: 帮助用户设计销售薪酬方案。适用于用户招聘首位销售代表、重组销售薪酬、将销售激励与业务目标对齐，或处理诸如藏水、客户流失等薪酬方案问题时。

description: AI Native Camp Day 1 온보딩. Claude와 대화하면서 Claude Code를 익힌다. "1일차", "Day 1", "온보딩" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI原生训练营第1天入职引导。通过与Claude对话，熟悉Claude Code。用于“1일차”，“Day 1”，“온보딩”请求。

description: Build Jenkins declarative and scripted pipelines with stages, agents, parameters, and plugins. Implement multi-branch pipelines and deployment automation.
description_zh: 使用阶段、代理、参数和插件构建 Jenkins 声明式与脚本式流水线。实现多分支流水线与部署自动化。

description: SOLID principles, design patterns, DRY, KISS, and clean code fundamentals. Use when reviewing architecture, checking code quality, refactoring, or discussing design decisions. Triggers on "review architecture", "check code quality", "SOLID principles", "design patterns", or "clean code".
description_zh: SOLID 原则、设计模式、DRY、KISS 以及 clean code 基本原则。用于评审架构、检查代码质量、重构或讨论设计决策。触发词为“评审架构”、“检查代码质量”、“SOLID 原则”、“设计模式”或“clean code”。

description: Modal is a serverless cloud platform for running Python on demand, including on-demand GPUs. Use when deploying or serving AI/ML models, running GPU-accelerated workloads (training, fine-tuning, inference), serving web endpoints, scheduling batch jobs, or scaling Python code to cloud containers with the Modal SDK.
description_zh: Modal 是一款无服务器云平台，支持按需运行 Python（包括按需 GPU）。适用于部署或服务人工智能/机器学习模型，运行 GPU 加速工作负载（训练、微调、推理），提供 Web 端点服务，调度批处理任务，或使用 Modal SDK 将 Python 代码部署至云容器。

description: Use this skill for processing and analyzing large tabular datasets (billions of rows) that exceed available RAM. Vaex excels at out-of-core DataFrame operations, lazy evaluation, fast aggregations, efficient visualization of big data, and machine learning on large datasets. Apply when users need to work with large CSV/HDF5/Arrow/Parquet files, perform fast statistics on massive datasets, create visualizations of big data, or build ML pipelines that do not fit in memory.
description_zh: 使用此技能处理和分析超过可用内存的、包含数十亿行的超大表格数据集。Vaex 擅长外存 DataFrame 操作、延迟求值、快速聚合、大数据的高效可视化以及在大数据集上的机器学习。当用户需要处理大型 CSV/HDF5/Arrow/Parquet 文件、对海量数据集进行快速统计分析、创建大数据可视化或构建不适合内存的机器学习流水线时，请使用本技能。

description: Standard single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline. Use for QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction (PCA/UMAP/t-SNE), clustering, differential expression, visualization, and converting R-friendly single-cell formats such as Seurat or SingleCellExperiment RDS files into h5ad for Scanpy. Best for exploratory scRNA-seq analysis with established workflows. For deep learning models use scvi-tools; for data format questions use anndata.
description_zh: 标准单细胞RNA-seq分析流程。可用于质量控制（QC）、归一化、降维（PCA/UMAP/t-SNE）、聚类、差异表达、可视化，以及将Seurat或SingleCellExperiment等兼容R的单细胞格式（如RDS文件）转换为Scanpy所需的h5ad格式。非常适合采用成熟工作流程的探索性scRNA-seq分析。如需使用深度学习模型，请使用scvi-tools；若有关于数据格式的问题，请使用anndata。

description: Routes the weakest VCN samples (output of `tao-analyze-gaps-visual-changenet`) into per-augmentation-module subsets based on each module's label eligibility. Use when the user asks to "route VCN gap samples", "split AOI gaps for k-NN mining and AnomalyGen", or prepare the immediate next step after DEFT gap analysis in a VCN AOI SDA iteration.
description_zh: 根据每个模块的标签资格，将最弱的VCN样本（`tao-analyze-gaps-visual-changenet`的输出）划分为各个增强模块的子集。当用户要求“route VCN gap samples”、“split AOI gaps for k-NN mining and AnomalyGen”，或在VCN AOI SDA迭代中，于DEFT间隙分析后准备下一步操作时使用。

description: Create multiple UI design mockups in parallel. Use when asked to create mockups, wireframes, or design variations for a feature. Creates HTML files using Mantine v7 + Tailwind following Civitai's design system.
description_zh: 并行创建多个 UI 设计原型。当被要求为某个功能创建原型、线框图或设计变体时使用。使用 Mantine v7 和 Tailwind 创建 HTML 文件，遵循 Civitai 的设计系统。

description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.
description_zh: NGS分析工具包。BAM转bigWig转换、QC（相关性分析、主成分分析、指纹）、热图/图谱（转录起始位点、峰），适用于ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq的可视化分析。

description: Safely track pull request feedback, resolve review comments or merge conflicts, validate fixes, and use a read-only cross-review before committing or pushing follow-up changes.
description_zh: 安全跟踪拉取请求反馈，解决审查意见或合并冲突，验证修复，并在提交或推送后续变更之前进行只读交叉审查。

description: Route gh-aw workflow design/create/debug/upgrade requests to the right prompts.
description_zh: 将 gh-aw workflow 设计/创建/调试/升级请求路由到正确的提示词。

description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.
description_zh: 具备多种特征化器和预构建数据集的分子机器学习。当您希望拥有广泛的特征化选项和 MoleculeNet 基准时，可用于使用传统机器学习（ML）或图神经网络（GNN）进行属性预测（ADMET、毒性）。最适合使用预训练模型和多样化分子表示进行快速实验。对于基于图的 PyTorch 工作流，请使用 torchdrug；对于基准数据集，请使用 pytdc。

description: Cheminformatics toolkit for fine-grained molecular control. SMILES/SDF parsing, descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA), fingerprints, substructure search, 2D/3D generation, similarity, reactions. For standard workflows with simpler interface, use datamol (wrapper around RDKit). Use rdkit for advanced control, custom sanitization, specialized algorithms.
description_zh: 用于细粒度分子控制的化学信息学工具包。提供 SMILES/SDF 解析、描述符（MW、LogP、TPSA）、指纹、子结构检索、2D/3D 生成、相似性、反应等功能。对于标准工作流程且界面更简单的场景，使用 datamol（RDKit 的封装）。使用 rdkit 进行高级控制、自定义净化、专用算法。

description: Apply this skill whenever writing, reviewing, or refactoring Laravel PHP code. This includes creating or modifying controllers, models, migrations, form requests, policies, jobs, scheduled commands, service classes, and Eloquent queries. Triggers for N+1 and query performance issues, caching strategies, authorization and security patterns, validation, error handling, queue and job configuration, route definitions, and architectural decisions. Also use for Laravel code reviews and refactoring existing Laravel code to follow best practices. Covers any task involving Laravel backend PHP code patterns.
description_zh: 在编写、审查或重构 Laravel PHP 代码时，请应用此技能。这包括创建或修改控制器、模型、迁移、表单请求、策略、作业、定时命令、服务类以及 Eloquent 查询。适用于 N+1 查询问题与查询性能问题、缓存策略、授权与安全模式、验证、错误处理、队列与作业配置、路由定义及架构决策等触发场景。同时用于 Laravel 代码审查，以及重构现有 Laravel 代码以遵循最佳实践。涵盖任何涉及 Laravel 后端 PHP 代码模式的任务。

description: QA a PR's UI change in a real browser through the configured browser-provider descriptor — first ensuring the PR has been reviewed (invoking om-auto-review-pr when it has not), then capturing screenshots and a pass/fail report, and optionally posting tracker evidence or self-QA labels without modifying source. Also runs in a local, tracker-less mode against the current worktree.
description_zh: 通过配置的浏览器提供器描述符，在真实浏览器中对 PR 的 UI 变更进行 QA——首先确保该 PR 已通过评审（若未评审，则调用 om-auto-review-pr），随后捕获截图和通过/失败报告，并可选地发布 tracker 证据或自 QA 标签，且不会修改源码。同时会在当前工作树上以本地、无追踪器模式运行。

description: Help users run effective one-on-one meetings. Use when someone is a new manager setting up 1:1s, struggling to make 1:1s productive, wants to improve career conversations with reports, or needs to handle difficult 1:1 situations.
description_zh: 帮助用户进行有效的1对1会议。适用于新人管理者建立1对1会议、在努力让1对1会议更具成效、希望改善与下属的职业沟通，或需要处理困难的1对1会议情况时使用。

description: Firebase gives you a complete backend in minutes - auth, database, storage, functions, hosting. But the ease of setup hides real complexity. Security rules are your last line of defense, and they're often wrong.
description_zh: Firebase 为您在几分钟内提供完整的后端——认证、数据库、存储、函数和托管。但便捷的设置背后隐藏着实际的复杂性。安全规则是您的最后一道防线，但它们往往设置错误。

description: guidelines for creating, reviewing, updating, and searching ADK documentation - use when users ask about writing, maintaining, or auditing ADK bot docs
description_zh: ADK 文档创建、审查、更新和检索指南——用户在询问撰写、维护或审计 ADK 机器人文档时使用

description: Use when the user asks about finding the best, top, or recommended model for a task, wants to know what AI model to use, or wants to compare models by benchmark scores. Triggers on: "best model for X", "what model should I use for", "top models for [task]", "which model runs on my laptop/machine/device", "recommend a model for", "what LLM should I use for", "compare models for", "what's state of the art for", or any question about choosing an AI model for a specific use case. Always use this skill when the user wants model recommendations or comparisons, even if they don't explicitly mention HuggingFace or benchmarks.
description_zh: 当用户询问如何为某项任务寻找最佳、顶尖或推荐模型，想了解应使用哪种 AI 模型，或想根据基准测试分数对比模型时使用。触发场景包括：“为 X 寻找最佳模型”、“为……应使用哪种模型”、“针对 [task] 的顶尖模型”、“我的笔记本电脑/机器/设备运行哪种模型”、“为……推荐某模型”、“为……应使用哪种 LLM（大语言模型）”、“对比模型（针对……）”、“当前技术最先进的是（针对……）”，或任何关于为特定使用场景选择 AI 模型的问题。只要用户需要模型推荐或对比，即使其未明确提及 HuggingFace 或基准测试，始终使用本技能。

description: Scaffold Hono API routes for Cloudflare Workers. Produces route files, middleware, typed bindings, Zod validation, error handling, and API_ENDPOINTS.md documentation. Use after a project is set up with cloudflare-worker-builder or vite-flare-starter, when you need to add API routes, create endpoints, or generate API documentation.
description_zh: 为 Cloudflare Workers 搭建 Hono API 路由。生成路由文件、中间件、类型化绑定、Zod 校验、错误处理以及 API_ENDPOINTS.md 文档。在项目已通过 cloudflare-worker-builder 或 vite-flare-starter 搭建完成后，当您需添加 API 路由、创建端点或生成 API 文档时使用。

description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.
description_zh: Benchling Python SDK 与 REST API 集成，支持注册实体、库存、ELN 条目、工作流、Benchling Apps 及数据仓库查询。适用于使用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 进行实验室数据自动化时。

description: When the user wants to design, test, or optimize their app's paywall — layout, copy, pricing display, trial offers, plan structure, hard vs soft paywall, paywall placement, or paywall A/B tests. Use when the user mentions "paywall", "paywall design", "paywall conversion", "trial-to-paid", "soft paywall", "hard paywall", "paywall A/B test", "paywall copy", "plan picker", "annual vs monthly display", "best paywall", "RevenueCat paywall", "Superwall", "Adapty", or "my paywall isn't converting". For overall pricing strategy and monetization model choice, see monetization-strategy. For trial nurture, dunning, and churn, see subscription-lifecycle. For where in the onboarding the paywall fires, see onboarding-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户需要设计、测试或优化其应用的付费墙——涵盖布局、文案、价格展示、试用优惠、计划结构、硬付费墙与软付费墙、付费墙放置位置，或付费墙A/B测试等。当用户提及“付费墙”、“付费墙设计”、“付费墙转化”、“试用转付费”、“软付费墙”、“硬付费墙”、“付费墙A/B测试”、“付费墙文案”、“计划选择器”、“年付与月付展示”、“最佳付费墙”、“RevenueCat付费墙”、“Superwall”、“Adapty”或“我的付费墙转化不佳”时，可使用本内容。如需了解整体定价策略与变现模式选择，请参阅变现策略；如需了解试用培育、催费及流失相关内容，请参阅订阅生命周期；如需了解付费墙在引导流程中触发的位置，请参阅引导流程优化。

description: Generate complete academic survey papers using multi-LLM parallel outline generation, RAG-based subsection writing, citation validation, and local coherence enhancement. Based on AutoSurvey pipeline. Use for writing comprehensive literature surveys.
description_zh: 利用多大模型并行大纲生成、基于RAG的小节撰写、引用校验和局部连贯性增强，生成完整的学术综述论文。基于 AutoSurvey 流水线，用于撰写全面的文献综述。

description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
description_zh: 面向 Google Stitch 的语义化设计系统技能。生成智能体友好的 DESIGN.md 文件，强制遵循高端且避免千篇一律的界面标准——严谨的字体排版、经过校准的颜色、非对称布局、持续的微动效以及硬件加速性能。

description: Code simplification skill for improving clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving exact behavior. Use when simplifying code, reducing complexity, cleaning up recent changes, applying refactoring patterns, or improving readability. Triggers on tasks involving code cleanup, simplification, refactoring, or readability improvements.
description_zh: 代码简化技能，用于在保持精确行为的同时提升清晰度、一致性和可维护性。在简化代码、降低复杂度、清理近期变更、应用重构模式或提升可读性时使用。当任务涉及代码清理、简化、重构或提升可读性时触发。

description: Redis LangCache guidance for semantic caching of LLM responses on Redis Cloud — calling search/set via the SDK or REST API, tuning the similarity threshold, separating caches per task type, and filtering with custom attributes. Use when caching LLM completions or RAG answers to cut API cost and latency, building a cache-aside layer in front of OpenAI / Anthropic / etc., tuning hit rate vs precision, or splitting one app's LLM workloads into multiple LangCache caches.
description_zh: Redis LangCache 在 Redis 云上的 LLM 响应语义缓存指南：通过 SDK 或 REST API 调用 search/set，调整相似度阈值，根据任务类型分离缓存，并使用自定义属性进行过滤。适用于以下场景：缓存 LLM 补全或 RAG 回答以降低 API 成本和延迟，在 OpenAI / Anthropic 等前端构建缓存旁路层，调整命中率与精确率之间的平衡，或将一个应用的 LLM 工作负载拆分为多个 LangCache 缓存等。

description: 解释火山 AI 音视频互动的产品能力、适用边界与最新官方文档；生成或修改 VoiceChat/Aibot 配置；并帮助用户搭建、运行和分阶段排查最小 InteractAI VoiceChat Web Demo。
description_zh: 解释火山 AI 音视频互动的产品能力、适用边界与最新官方文档；生成或修改 VoiceChat/Aibot 配置；并帮助用户搭建、运行和分阶段排查最小 InteractAI VoiceChat Web Demo。

description: Domain-Driven Design tactical patterns for .NET applications. Covers aggregates, aggregate roots, value objects, domain events, domain services, strongly-typed IDs, and repository patterns for aggregate persistence. Load this skill when implementing DDD, working with aggregates, value objects, domain events, bounded contexts, or when the architecture-advisor recommends DDD + Clean Architecture. Pair with the clean-architecture skill.
description_zh:
适用于 .NET 应用程序的领域驱动设计（DDD）战术模式。

涵盖聚合、聚合根、值对象、领域事件、领域服务、强类型 ID，以及用于聚合持久化的仓储模式。

在实施 DDD、处理聚合、值对象、领域事件、限界上下文，或当架构顾问推荐采用 DDD + 整洁架构时，加载此技能。

与 clean-architecture 技能配合使用。

description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.
description_zh: 基于 RDKit 的 Pythonic 封装，具备简化的接口与合理的默认设置。适用于标准药物发现，包括 SMILES 解析、标准化、描述符、指纹、聚类、3D 构象及并行处理。返回原生的 rdkit.Chem.Mol 对象。如需高级控制或自定义参数，请直接使用 RDKit。

description: Differential gene expression analysis for bulk RNA-seq with PyDESeq2, including formulaic designs, Wald tests, FDR correction, LFC shrinkage, and result visualization.
description_zh: 基于 PyDESeq2 的 bulk RNA-seq 差异基因表达分析，包括公式设计、Wald 检验、FDR 校正、LFC 收缩及结果可视化。

description: Build clinical/healthcare deep-learning pipelines with PyHealth — loading EHR/signal/imaging datasets (MIMIC-III/IV, eICU, OMOP, SleepEDF, ChestXray14, EHRShot), defining tasks (mortality, readmission, length-of-stay, drug recommendation, sleep staging, ICD coding, EEG events), instantiating models (Transformer, RETAIN, GAMENet, SafeDrug, MICRON, StageNet, AdaCare, CNN/RNN/MLP), training with the PyHealth Trainer, computing clinical metrics, and using medical code utilities (ICD/ATC/NDC/RxNorm lookup and cross-mapping). Use this skill whenever the user mentions PyHealth, MIMIC, eICU, OMOP, EHR modeling, clinical prediction, drug recommendation, sleep staging, medical code mapping, ICD/ATC codes, or any healthcare ML pipeline that fits the dataset → task → model → trainer → metrics pattern, even if "PyHealth" isn't named explicitly.
description_zh: 使用 PyHealth 构建临床/医疗深度学习流水线，加载 EHR/信号/影像数据集（MIMIC-III/IV、eICU、OMOP、SleepEDF、ChestXray14、EHRShot），定义任务（死亡率、再入院、住院时长、药物推荐、睡眠分期、ICD 编码、EEG 事件），实例化模型（Transformer、RETAIN、GAMENet、SafeDrug、MICRON、StageNet、AdaCare、CNN/RNN/MLP），使用 PyHealth Trainer 进行训练，计算临床指标，并使用医学代码工具（ICD/ATC/NDC/RxNorm 查询与交叉映射）。每当用户提及 PyHealth、MIMIC、eICU、OMOP、EHR 建模、临床预测、药物推荐、睡眠分期、医学代码映射、ICD/ATC 编码，或任何符合数据集 → 任务 → 模型 → 训练器 → 指标模式的医疗 ML 流水线时，均应使用此技能，即使未明确提及“PyHealth”。

Use when code imports torchdrug or needs its datasets, models, tasks, or Engine.
