description_zh: 确保由AI构建（氛围编码风格）的应用在发货前可审查的持久文档集。每个应用都需要的小核心部分——架构、用户与权限流程、权限、变量与密钥以及测试覆盖映射图——以及仅在适用时添加的条件性文档：邮件、定时任务、SEO、嵌入式智能体/自动化。明确每份文档必须记录的内容，以及审查者或审计者如何使用它。用于记录代码库交接文档、映射用户旅程与信任边界穿越、规划测试覆盖，或为安全或性能审计做准备时使用。

description: Reverse-engineer and clone one or more websites in one shot — extracts assets, CSS, and content section-by-section and proactively dispatches parallel builder agents in worktrees as it goes. Use this whenever the user wants to clone, replicate, rebuild, reverse-engineer, or copy any website. Also triggers on phrases like "make a copy of this site", "rebuild this page", or "pixel-perfect clone". The request must include one or more target URLs.
description_zh: 一次性逆向工程并克隆一个或多个网站——逐部分提取资源、CSS 和内容，并在子工作树中动态调度并行构建代理。当用户需要克隆、复刻、重建、逆向工程或复制任何网站时，请使用此功能。该功能也会触发于“复制此网站”、“重建此页面”或“像素级完美克隆”等短语。请求必须包含一个或多个目标 URL。

description: AI Native Camp Day 4 Wrap & Analyze. session-wrap 스킬을 직접 만들고, history-insight와 session-analyzer로 세션을 분석한다. "4일차", "Day 4", "wrap", "세션 분석", "session wrap", "세션 래핑" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI 原生 Camp Day 4 总结与分析。直接创建 session-wrap 技能，并使用 history-insight 和 session-analyzer 来分析会话。“4일차”、“Day 4”、“wrap”、“세션 분석”、“session wrap”、“세션 래핑” 用于请求。

description: MCP-powered multi-dimensional code review for .NET projects. Uses Roslyn analysis tools for antipatterns, diagnostics, references, and dependency graphs combined with structured manual review. Prioritizes effort with blast-radius scoring — data access, security, concurrency, and integration boundaries before style — and produces severity-categorized findings with actionable fixes. Use when: "review", "code review", "PR review", "review this", "review my code", "check code quality", "review changes", "what should I review", "review priorities", "blast radius", "critical path".
description_zh:
MCP驱动的.NET项目多维度代码审查。利用Roslyn分析工具对反模式、诊断、引用和依赖图进行检测，并结合结构化人工审查。通过爆炸半径评分优先分配审查精力——数据访问、安全性、并发性与集成边界的检查优先于风格检查——并产出按严重程度分类的发现项，附带可操作的修复方案。

适用场景："review"、"code review"、"PR review"、"review this"、"review my code"、"check code quality"、"review changes"、"what should I review"、"review priorities"、"blast radius"、"critical path"。

description:
Prepares tax-season materials for the owner's accountant, not tax advice. US federal tax; a non-US business gets its closed-books packet instead. Two modes: (1) quarterly estimated tax from YTD net income in the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books); (2) year-end 1099 prep, scanning the ledger, PayPal, and Stripe for contractors paid over USD 600 into a 1099-NEC list with missing W-9 flags.
Any tax request routes first to /tax-prep, which confirms the books are closed and reconciled before running this skill. Use this skill directly only when the owner says the period's books are already closed: "books are closed, now do the 1099s," "run the quarterly estimate off the closed numbers," or "just the contractor W-9 list."
description_zh:
为业主的会计师准备报税季资料，而非税务建议。美国联邦税务；非美国企业则获取其已关闭账簿的资料包。有两种模式：（1）根据账本中的年初至今净收入计算季度估算税款（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）；（2）年底1099准备，扫描账本、PayPal 和 Stripe，将向承包商支付的超过600美元的款项录入1099-NEC清单，并标注缺失的W-9标志。
任何税务请求首先路由至 /tax-prep，在运行此技能前，确认账簿已关闭并对账。仅在业主表示该期间的账簿已经关闭时直接使用此技能，例如：“账簿已关闭，现在进行1099工作，”“根据已关闭的数据运行季度估算，”“仅处理承包商的W-9清单。”

description: Enables Redshift system-table (SYS_*) log publishing to S3 Tables in Apache Iceberg format for both Provisioned clusters and Serverless namespaces, verifies publishing status, and queries the published logs via any Iceberg-compatible engine including Redshift and Athena. Covers system tables such as sys_query_history, sys_query_text, sys_connection_log, sys_query_detail, and sys_session_history. Applies when turning on S3 Tables log publishing for a cluster or namespace, confirming publishing status and locating the S3 Tables namespace, querying non-realtime data from Redshift system tables off-cluster at scale, or building dashboards for Redshift monitoring and auditing, especially for historical or high-volume system-table data beyond the in-cluster SYS_ view retention window. Trigger phrases: publish redshift system table log to s3 tables, enable-logging s3 tables, describe redshift logging status, query redshift system tables in athena or redshift, redshift log exports to iceberg.
description_zh:
支持将 Redshift 系统表（SYS_*）日志发布到 Apache Iceberg 格式的 S3 表中，支持预配集群和 Serverless 命名空间，验证发布状态，并通过 Redshift、Athena 等任意兼容 Iceberg 的引擎查询已发布的日志。涵盖 sys_query_history、sys_query_text、sys_connection_log、sys_query_detail 和 sys_session_history 等系统表。

适用于以下场景：为集群或命名空间开启 S3 表日志发布、确认发布状态并定位 S3 表命名空间、大规模查询集群外 Redshift 系统表的非实时数据，以及为 Redshift 监控和审计构建仪表盘，特别是针对超出集群内 SYS_ 视图保留窗口的历史或高吞吐量系统表数据。

触发短语：将 Redshift 系统表日志发布到 S3 表、启用日志 S3 表、查询 Redshift 日志状态、在 Athena 或 Redshift 中查询 Redshift 系统表、将 Redshift 日志导出至 Iceberg。

description: AI Native Camp Day 2 MCP & Context Sync. MCP를 배우고 나만의 Context Sync 스킬을 만든다. "2일차", "Day 2", "MCP", "context sync" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI原生训练营第二天 MCP与上下文同步。通过掌握MCP，打造专属的上下文同步技能。适用于“2일차”、“Day 2”、“MCP”、“context sync”的请求。

description: Read Discord for financial research using opencli (read-only). Use this skill whenever the user wants to read Discord channels, search for messages in trading servers, view guild/channel info, monitor crypto or market discussion groups, or gather financial sentiment from Discord. Triggers include: "check my Discord", "search Discord for", "read Discord messages", "what's happening in the trading Discord", "show Discord channels", "list my servers", "Discord sentiment on BTC", "what are people saying in Discord about AAPL", "monitor crypto Discord", any mention of Discord in context of reading financial news, market research, or trading community discussions. This skill is READ-ONLY — it does NOT support sending messages, reacting, or any write operations.
description_zh: 使用 opencli（只读）读取 Discord 进行金融研究。当用户需要阅读 Discord 频道、在交易服务器中搜索消息、查看服务器/频道信息、监控加密货币或市场讨论群组，或从 Discord 获取金融情绪时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：“查看我的 Discord”、“在 Discord 中搜索”、“阅读 Discord 消息”、“交易 Discord 中发生了什么”、“显示 Discord 频道”、“列出我的服务器”、“Discord 关于 BTC 的情绪”、“在 Discord 里关于 AAPL，人们在说什么”、“监控加密货币 Discord”、任何提及 Discord 且语境涉及阅读财经新闻、市场研究或交易社区讨论的内容。本技能为只读（READ-ONLY）——不支持发送消息、进行互动，或任何写入操作。

description: Expert guidance for data analysis, visualization, and Jupyter Notebook development with pandas, matplotlib, seaborn, and numpy.
description_zh: 使用pandas、matplotlib、seaborn和numpy进行数据分析、可视化和Jupyter Notebook开发的专业指导。

description: Guidelines for implementing JWT authentication with security best practices for token creation, validation, and storage
description_zh: JWT认证实施指南：令牌创建、验证与存储的安全最佳实践

description: AI Native Camp Day 4 Wrap & Analyze + 콘텐츠 소화. session-wrap 스킬을 직접 만들고, history-insight와 session-analyzer로 세션을 분석하고, 콘텐츠 소화 파이프라인을 체험한다. "4일차", "Day 4", "wrap", "세션 분석", "session wrap", "세션 래핑", "fetch", "콘텐츠" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI原生营第4天总结与分析 + 内容消化。直接制作 session-wrap 技能，用 history-insight 和 session-analyzer 分析会话，体验内容消化流程。““4일차”, “Day 4”, “wrap”, “세션 분석”, “session wrap”, “세션 랩핑”, “fetch”, “콘텐트” 用于请求。

description: Trace code or test a recurring pattern to answer one cited question. Use when: uncertainty needs evidence. Not for external feature teardowns; use reverse-engineer.
description_zh: 追踪代码或测试一个重复出现的模式，以回答一个被引用的疑问。使用场景：当存在不确定性时需有证据。不适用于外部功能拆解；请使用逆向工程。

description: USE FOR news search. Returns news articles with title, URL, description, age, thumbnail, profile. Supports freshness and date range filtering, SafeSearch filter and Goggles for custom ranking.
description_zh: 用途：新闻搜索。返回包含标题、URL、描述、年龄、缩略图和资料的新闻文章。支持新鲜度与日期范围筛选、SafeSearch 筛选以及 Goggles 自定义排名。

description: Create LinkedIn post graphics. Decides between an HTML/CSS structured graphic or an AI-generated infographic based on the post content. Use this skill whenever the user says "design a graphic", "create a visual", "make an image", "graphic for my post", "LinkedIn image", or wants any visual content to pair with a LinkedIn post. Also trigger when the user finishes writing a post and wants a matching graphic.
description_zh: 创建LinkedIn帖子图形。根据帖子内容，在HTML/CSS结构化图形与AI生成的信息图表之间做出选择。当用户说“设计图形”、“创建视觉效果”、“制作图片”、“为我的帖子设计图形”、“LinkedIn图片”，或想要任何与LinkedIn帖子搭配的视觉内容时，使用此技能。当用户写完帖子后想要匹配的图形时，也触发此技能。

description: Improve academic paper writing quality for ML/CV/NLP-style papers with clear section structure, paragraph flow, and reviewer-facing presentation. Use when drafting or revising Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Method, Experiments, or Conclusion; polishing figures/tables; checking claim-support alignment; or performing self-review before submission.
description_zh: 提升面向机器学习（ML）、计算机视觉（CV）与自然语言处理（NLP）类论文的写作质量，具备清晰的章节结构、段落逻辑与面向审稿人的呈现方式。在起草或修订摘要、引言、相关工作、方法、实验或结论时使用；润色图表；核对论点与论据的一致性；或在投稿前进行自我审查。

description: Modern React UI patterns for loading states, error handling, and data fetching. Use when building UI components, handling async data, or managing UI states.
description_zh: 现代 React UI 模式：加载状态、错误处理和数据获取。适用于构建 UI 组件、处理异步数据或管理 UI 状态。

description: Operate AgentMail from a shell with the official CLI. Use when the user wants commands for listing or creating inboxes, reading or searching mail, sending or replying, managing drafts, or scripting JSON/YAML output; do not use for SDK code, MCP setup, or framework adapters.
description_zh: 使用官方命令行工具（CLI）在终端中操作 AgentMail。当用户需要列出或创建收件箱、读取或搜索邮件、发送或回复、管理草稿或脚本化 JSON/YAML 输出的命令时使用；不得用于 SDK 代码、MCP 配置或框架适配器。

description: Board meeting preparation for the adversarial scenario, not the friendly one. Forces numbers-cold mastery, anticipates hard questions, builds a narrative that acknowledges weakness without losing the room. Use when preparing for a board meeting, an investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review where every number must live in your head not just on a slide.
description_zh: 针对对抗性场景的董事会会议筹备，而非友好场合。这要求对数字进行冷静精准的掌控，预判尖锐问题，构建一种承认弱点却不失阵地的叙事。适用于筹备董事会会议、投资者通报、融资路演，或任何高风险对抗性评审，在这些场合中，每一个数字都必须内化于心，而不仅仅是印在幻灯片上。

description: Structure a spoken PM product-sense answer with assumptions, segmentation, pain-point prioritization, and MVP tradeoffs. Use when practicing design, improve, or build-next interview questions.
description_zh: 构建一个包含假设、用户分层、痛点优先级排序和 MVP 取舍的产品经理产品感知型口头回答。适用于练习设计、优化或构建下一阶段面试问题时使用。

description: Review a diff, branch, or PR against correctness, security, breaking-change, and quality standards — runs the validation gate, applies the built-in checklist plus any repo-local one, and produces severity-ranked findings with an approve/request-changes verdict. The review engine behind om-auto-review-pr and om-review-prs.
description_zh: 针对正确性、安全性、破坏性变更和质量标准，审查差异、分支或拉取请求——运行验证关卡，应用内置检查清单及任何仓库本地的检查清单，并生成按严重程度分级的发现及“批准/请求修改”的判定结论。这是 om-auto-review-pr 和 om-review-prs 背后的审查引擎。

description: Guided journey from a working-but-untested vibe-coded prototype to a production-ready product with tests, clean structure, a business-rules boundary, and resilience at scale. Orchestrates nine skills phase by phase - working-with-legacy-code, clean-code, refactoring-patterns, software-design-philosophy, clean-architecture, pragmatic-programmer, release-it, system-design, ddia-systems - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (TESTING.md, TECH-DEBT.md, IMPROVE-CODE-QUALITY-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to harden an AI-generated prototype, add tests before refactoring, make code safe to change, or says 'this works on my machine but I am scared to touch it'. For an aged codebase, remove-technical-debt; for greenfield structure, design-code-architecture; for a product and UX pass, improve-app; to optimize speed and structure, architecture-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh:
从经过初步运行但缺乏充分测试的氛围驱动原型，过渡到具备测试、清晰结构、业务规则边界以及高规模下韧性的生产就绪产品，实现引导之旅。此流程分阶段编排九项技能：遗留代码处理、清洁代码、重构模式、软件设计理念、清洁架构、务实开发者、版本发布与部署、系统设计、ddia-systems——在每个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目 docs/ 文件夹中（TESTING.md、TECH-DEBT.md、IMPROVE-CODE-QUALITY-PLAN.md），以便在多次会话间恢复并继续该旅程。

当用户希望对AI生成的原型进行加固、在重构前添加测试、使代码能够安全变更，或表示“这在我的机器上能运行，但我不敢去触碰它”时，使用此流程。针对陈旧代码库，执行 remove-technical-debt（去除技术债务）；针对全新结构的代码库，执行 design-code-architecture（设计代码架构）；针对产品与用户体验的全面优化，执行 improve-app；为优化速度与结构，执行 architecture-optimization。当单独针对某一个框架时，直接调用该项技能。

description: Guides Qdrant monitoring and observability setup. Use when someone asks 'how to monitor Qdrant', 'what metrics to track', 'is Qdrant healthy', 'optimizer stuck', 'why is memory growing', 'requests are slow', 'set up alerts', 'cluster health check', or needs to set up Prometheus, Grafana, health checks, or log centralization. Also use when debugging production issues that require metric analysis.
description_zh: 指导 Qdrant 监控与可观测性配置。当用户询问“如何监控 Qdrant”、“需要跟踪哪些指标”、“Qdrant 是否健康”、“优化器卡顿”、“内存为何增长”、“请求变慢”、“设置告警”、“集群健康检查”，或需要配置 Prometheus、Grafana、健康检查或日志集中化时，使用本指南。此外，在调试需要指标分析的生产环境问题时，也应使用本指南。

description: Guided journey from an app idea to a deliberate architecture: boundaries, domain model, data decisions, and resilience, making only the expensive-to-reverse decisions and deferring the rest. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - clean-architecture, domain-driven-design, system-design, ddia-systems, software-design-philosophy, release-it, pragmatic-programmer, 37signals-way - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN-CODE-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to design a new app's architecture, choose boundaries and a domain model, decide monolith versus microservices, or says 'how should I structure this app'. If a codebase already exists, use remove-technical-debt (aged), improve-code-quality (fresh prototype), or architecture-optimization (slow but working); if unvalidated, run create-business or create-app first. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从应用想法到刻意架构的引导式旅程：边界、领域模型、数据决策与韧性，仅做出逆转成本极高的决策，其余则暂缓。分阶段协调八个技能——clean-architecture、domain-driven-design、system-design、ddia-systems、software-design-philosophy、release-it、pragmatic-programmer、37signals-way——并在每个决策点向用户提问，将结果记录在项目文档文件夹 docs/ 中（ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN-CODE-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md），以便跨会话恢复旅程。当用户希望设计新应用的架构、选择边界和领域模型、决定采用单体还是微服务架构，或表示“这个应用该如何结构化”时使用。若已有代码库，使用 remove-technical-debt（老化后）、 improve-code-quality（新原型）、或 architecture-optimization（缓慢但可行）；若尚未验证，先运行 create-business 或 create-app。若仅为单独框架，直接调用该技能。

description: Run a comprehensive 7-phase verification pipeline for .NET projects: build, analyzers, antipattern detection, tests, security, formatting, and diff review. Each phase produces PASS/FAIL with actionable output and the pipeline short-circuits on critical failures. Also the authority on verification strategy: which phases to run for a given change, quality gates, and fix-and-retry loops. Use when: "verify", "check everything", "is this ready", "pre-PR check", "run all checks", "quality gate", "verification strategy", "which checks should run", or after completing a feature or refactor.
description_zh: 为.NET项目运行全面的7阶段验证流水线：构建、分析器、反模式检测、测试、安全性、格式化及差异审查。每个阶段均输出PASS/FAIL结果及可操作输出内容，并在出现关键故障时使流水线短路。同时，作为验证策略的权威：确定针对特定变更应运行哪些阶段、设置质量门禁以及执行修复重试循环。适用场景："verify"、"check everything"、"is this ready"、"pre-PR check"、"run all checks"、"quality gate"、"verification strategy"、"which checks should run"，或在完成功能或重构后使用。

description: Critique a rendered screen's composition — balance, whitespace, rhythm, and gestalt grouping. Use when a layout feels off but hierarchy is fine. For emphasis and eye flow specifically, use `critique-visual-hierarchy`.
description_zh: 评析渲染屏幕的构图——平衡、留白、节奏与格式塔分组。当布局感觉不协调，但层级结构合理时使用。若需特别针对强调和视觉流向，请使用 `critique-visual-hierarchy`。

description: Comprehensive macOS development guidance including Swift 6+, SwiftUI, SwiftData, architecture patterns, AppKit bridging, and macOS 26 Tahoe APIs. Use for macOS code review, best practices, UI review, or platform-specific features.
description_zh: 涵盖 Swift 6+、SwiftUI、SwiftData、架构模式、AppKit 桥接及 macOS 26 Tahoe API 的全面 macOS 开发指南。适用于 macOS 代码审查、最佳实践、UI 审查及平台专属功能。

description: Creates professional PDF whitepapers from Markdown files. Use when the user wants to create a whitepaper, technical document, or PDF with professional formatting and typography.
description_zh: 从 Markdown 文件创建专业 PDF 白皮书。当用户需要创建白皮书、技术文档或具有专业格式与排版的 PDF 时使用。

description: 实现新功能或功能改造。不用于纯 bug 修复（cs-issue）、行为等价重构（cs-refactor）、大需求拆解（cs-epic）。
description_zh: 实现新功能或功能改造。不用于纯 bug 修复（cs-issue）、行为等价重构（cs-refactor）、大需求拆解（cs-epic）。

description: Interactive project initialization. Detects project type, asks architecture questions, and generates a customized CLAUDE.md — no manual template copying. Use when: "init project", "setup project", "initialize", "new project setup", "generate CLAUDE.md", "configure for dotnet-claude-kit", or starting Claude Code on a fresh or existing .NET codebase.
description_zh: 交互式项目初始化。检测项目类型、询问架构问题，并生成定制化的 CLAUDE.md，无需手动复制模板。使用场景："init project"、"setup project"、"initialize"、"new project setup"、"generate CLAUDE.md"、"configure for dotnet-claude-kit"，或在全新的或现有的 .NET 代码库上启动 Claude Code。

description: Owns the session handoff lifecycle: the end-of-session ritual that captures completed work, pending tasks, and learnings into .claude/handoff.md, and the session-start protocol that loads it back. Triggers on: /wrap-up, "wrap up", "done for today", "that's all", "end session", "signing off", "handoff" — and at session start: "start session", "session start", "load handoff", "pick up where we left off", "what were we working on".
description_zh:
负责会话交接生命周期：完成结束会话仪式，将已完成的工作、待办事项和学习成果记录至 .claude/handoff.md，并执行会话开始时的加载协议，重新加载该记录。

触发条件：/wrap-up、"wrap up"、"done for today"、"that's all"、"END SESSION"、"signing off"、"handoff"，以及会话开始时："start session"、"session start"、"load handoff"、"pick up where we left off"、"what were we working on"。

description: Amazon listing builder and optimizer for sellers. Two modes: (A) Create — build keyword-optimized listings from scratch using keyword lists + product characteristics + AI copywriting, (B) Optimize — audit existing listings, find keyword gaps, score across 8 dimensions, and rewrite with missing keywords. Integrates with amazon-keyword-research for keyword input. Works on 12 Amazon marketplaces. No API key required. Use when: (1) creating a new Amazon listing from keywords, (2) auditing an existing listing for SEO and conversion, (3) checking keyword coverage in title/bullets/description, (4) generating listing copy with target keywords and tone, (5) comparing listings against competitors, (6) preparing a listing for launch or relaunch.
description_zh:
面向卖家的亚马逊商品列表构建与优化工具。两种模式：

（A）**创建**——使用关键词列表 + 产品特性 + AI 文案撰写，从零开始构建关键词优化的商品列表；

（B）**优化**——审计现有商品列表，找出关键词缺口，从 8 个维度进行评分，并补充缺失关键词后重新撰写。

与 amazon-keyword-research 集成，用于关键词输入。适用于 12 个亚马逊市场平台。无需 API 密钥。

适用场景：
(1) 根据关键词创建新的亚马逊商品列表；
(2) 审计现有商品列表的 SEO 与转化效果；
(3) 检查标题、卖点、描述中的关键词覆盖情况；
(4) 根据目标关键词和语气生成商品列表文案；
(5) 将商品列表与竞争对手进行对比；
(6) 为商品列表的首次发布或重新发布做好准备。

description: Review and promote staged wiki pages to their final locations. Use when WIKI_STAGED_WRITES=true and the user says "/wiki-stage-commit", "review staged pages", "commit staged writes", "promote staged pages", "approve staged changes", or "what's waiting in staging". Shows each staged file, lets the user accept or reject it, and moves accepted files to their final wiki locations. Rejected files are moved back to _raw/ for manual editing.
description_zh: 审查并推广暂存中的 wiki 页面至其最终位置。当 WIKI_STAGED_WRITES=true 且用户输入"/wiki-stage-commit"、"review staged pages"、"commit staged writes"、"promote staged pages"、"approve staged changes"或"what's waiting in staging"时使用。该功能展示每个暂存文件，供用户接受或拒绝，并将被接受的文件移至其最终 wiki 位置。被拒绝的文件会移回 _raw/ 以便手动编辑。

description: This skill should be used when working with Shadertoy shaders, GLSL fragment shaders, or creating procedural graphics for the web. Use when writing .glsl files, implementing visual effects, creating generative art, or working with WebGL shader code. This skill provides GLSL ES syntax reference, common shader patterns, and Shadertoy-specific conventions.
description_zh: 当处理 Shadertoy 着色器、GLSL 片段着色器或为网页创建程序化图形时，应使用本技能。在编写 .glsl 文件、实现视觉效果、创作生成式艺术或处理 WebGL 着色器代码时使用本技能。本技能提供 GLSL ES 语法参考、常见着色器模式以及 Shadertoy 特定规范。

description: When the user wants to write a multi-part thread or content series for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram (Reel/carousel/Story series), TikTok (multi-part videos), YouTube (video series, multi-Short series), or Facebook. Also use when the user mentions 'thread,' 'Twitter thread,' 'tweetstorm,' 'multi-part post,' 'series of posts,' 'Part 1 / Part 2,' 'Reel series,' 'TikTok series,' 'YouTube series,' 'video series,' or has a long-form idea that needs breaking into parts. For single posts, see post-writer-sms. For carousels, see carousel-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要为 Twitter/X、LinkedIn、Threads、Instagram（Reel/carousel/Story 系列）、TikTok（多视频）、YouTube（视频系列、多 Short 系列）、或 Facebook 撰写多部分推文链或内容系列时。当用户提及 '推文链,' 'Twitter 推文链,' '推文风暴,' '多部分帖子,' '帖子系列,' '第一部分 / 第二部分,' 'Reel 系列,' 'TikTok 系列,' 'YouTube 系列,' '视频系列,' 或具有需要拆分为部分的长篇想法时，也应使用。对于单条帖子，参见 post-writer-sms。对于轮播图，参见 carousel-writer-sms。

description: Guided test-driven development workflow for .NET 10 using xUnit v3, WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, and Verify snapshots. Follows the strict red-green-refactor cycle. Use when: "TDD", "test-driven", "let's TDD this", "red green refactor", "write the test first", or when building a feature with clear acceptance criteria.
description_zh: .NET 10 使用 xUnit v3、WebApplicationFactory、Testcontainers 和 Verify 快照的引导式测试驱动开发工作流。严格遵循红绿重构循环。适用场景：执行“TDD”、“测试驱动”、“让我们采用 TDD”、“红绿重构”或“先编写测试”，或在进行具有明确验收标准的功能构建时使用。

description: Security hardening reviewer for GitHub Actions workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml). Reasons about the Actions threat model that pattern matchers and general code linters miss — untrusted-input script injection, privileged triggers running fork code, mutable action references, and over-scoped tokens. Use this skill when asked to review, audit, harden, or secure a GitHub Actions workflow, when writing a new workflow, or for any request like "is this workflow safe?", "review my CI for security issues", "why is pull_request_target dangerous here?", "pin my actions", or "lock down GITHUB_TOKEN permissions". Covers script injection via ${{ }} interpolation, pull_request_target / workflow_run privilege escalation, SHA-pinning of third-party actions, least-privilege permissions, GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_OUTPUT injection, secret exposure, OIDC over long-lived credentials, and self-hosted runner exposure on public repositories.
description_zh: GitHub Actions 工作流文件（.github/workflows/*.yml）的安全加固审查员。解释模式匹配器和通用代码 linters 会遗漏的 Actions 威胁模型中的原因——不受信任输入的脚本注入、特权触发器运行 fork 代码、可变 action 引用，以及权限范围过大的 token。当被要求审查、审计、加固或保护 GitHub Actions 工作流、在编写新的工作流时，或针对任何类似 "此工作流安全吗？", "为我的 CI 审查安全问题", "这里为什么 pull_request_target 是危险的？", "锁定我的 action", 或 "限制 GITHUB_TOKEN 权限" 的请求时，使用此技能。涵盖通过 ${{ }} 插值的脚本注入、pull_request_target / workflow_run 的权限升级、第三方 action 的 SHA 固定、最小权限权限、GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_OUTPUT 注入、密钥暴露、使用长期凭据的 OIDC，以及公共仓库上的自托管运行器暴露。

description: Salesforce metadata generation and querying with 120-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user creates custom objects, fields, validation rules, or touches .object-meta.xml, .field-meta.xml, .profile-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: permission set analysis (use sf-permissions), deploying metadata (use sf-deploy), or Flow XML (use sf-flow).
description_zh:
Salesforce 元数据生成与查询（基于 120 分评分）。

触发条件：用户创建自定义对象、字段、验证规则，或触及 `.object-meta.xml`、`.field-meta.xml`、`.profile-meta.xml` 文件。

不触发条件：权限集分析（使用 `sf-permissions`）、元数据部署（使用 `sf-deploy`），或 Flow XML（使用 `sf-flow`）。

description: Open the diffity file tree browser to browse and comment on repository files
description_zh: 打开 diffity 文件树浏览器，浏览并评论仓库文件。

description: Converts cuTile Python GPU kernels (@ct.kernel) to cuTile.jl Julia equivalents. Handles kernel syntax translation, 0-indexed to 1-indexed conversion, broadcasting differences, memory layout (row-major to column-major), type system mapping, and launch API differences. Use when converting, porting, or translating cuTile Python kernels to Julia cuTile.jl, or debugging/optimizing existing Julia cuTile translations.
description_zh: 将 cuTile Python GPU 内核（@ct.kernel）转换为 cuTile.jl Julia 的对应版本。处理内核语法转换、从0索引到1索引的转换、广播机制差异、内存布局（行优先到列优先）、类型系统映射以及启动API差异。适用于将 cuTile Python 内核转换为 Julia cuTile.jl、进行移植或翻译，或用于调试与优化现有的 Julia cuTile 翻译。

description: Connect to a WordPress site via WP-CLI over SSH or the REST API. Check CLI, test SSH, set up auth, verify access, save config. Use whenever the user wants to connect to a WordPress site, set up WP-CLI access, create an Application Password, or troubleshoot WordPress connection / auth issues.
description_zh: 通过 WP-CLI 在 SSH 或 REST API 上连接到 WordPress 网站。检查 CLI，测试 SSH，设置认证，验证访问权限，保存配置。在用户需要连接到 WordPress 网站、设置 WP-CLI 访问权限、创建应用密码或排查 WordPress 连接/认证问题时使用。

description: Day 1 테스트 스킬. "/day1-test-skill" 입력 시 실행된다. Skill이 어떻게 동작하는지 직접 체험하는 용도.
description_zh: Day 1 测试技能。 "/day1-test-skill" 输入时执行。 直接体验技能如何运作的用途。

description: Analyzes unit economics by product or service using PayPal merchant insights and QuickBooks cost data, benchmarks against inflation and cost changes, and shows pricing-scenario data (e.g. "a 5% increase historically correlates with ~3% volume drop"). Surfaces analysis only — does not recommend a price. Use when the user asks about raising prices, pricing, margin analysis, what to charge, whether costs are eating into profit, or how a price change might affect their business. Trigger even if the user doesn't say "margin" explicitly — phrases like "am I making enough?", "should I charge more?", or "my costs are going up" all call for this skill.
description_zh: 通过分析 PayPal 商家洞察与 QuickBooks 成本数据，基于产品或服务对单位经济进行剖析，与通货膨胀及成本变动进行基准对标，并展示定价情景数据（例如"历史上5%的涨幅与约3%的销量下降相关联"）。仅呈现分析结果，不提供价格建议。适用于用户询问提价、定价、利润率分析、收费标准、成本是否侵蚀利润或价格变动可能如何影响业务等场景。即使用户未明确提及"利润率"，像"我的盈利是否足够？"、"是否应该收费更高？"、"我的成本在上升"等表述也均触发本技能。

description: Enter plan mode for .NET projects with architecture awareness. Analyzes tasks through the lens of supported architectures (VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith) and produces structured implementation plans before any code is written. Use when: "plan", "let's plan", "think through", "design this", "how should I implement", or any non-trivial task requiring 3+ steps.
description_zh: 进入具备架构意识的 .NET 项目规划模式。从支持的系统架构（VSA、清洁架构、领域驱动设计、模块化单体）的视角分析任务，并在编写任何代码之前生成结构化的实施计划。适用场景：“plan”、“let's plan”、“think through”、“design this”、“how should I implement”，或任何需要 3 个及以上步骤的非平凡任务。

description: Use this skill in the MathModel LaTeX sandbox when the user asks to reproduce built-in scientific visualization templates, especially prompts from the Improve tab mentioning $mathmodel-figure-templates, 科研绘图模板, SHAP蜂群柱状图, 配对云雨图, 交叉验证ROC, 泰勒图, 相关矩阵组合图, 预测真实值边缘分布图, TPE调参3D曲面, 下三角相关矩阵半边小提琴图, 分组环形热图, 城市公园降温组合图, or Nature和弦图. It provides ready-to-run Python scripts bundled inside the skill.
description_zh: 在 MathModel LaTeX 沙盒中使用此技能，当用户要求复现内置科学可视化模板时，尤其是当 Improve 标签页中提及以下内容（$mathmodel-figure-templates、科研绘图模板、SHAP蜂群柱状图、配对云雨图、交叉验证ROC、泰勒图、相关矩阵组合图、预测真实值边缘分布图、TPE调参3D曲面、下三角相关矩阵半边小提琴图、分组环形热图、城市公园降温组合图或 Nature和弦图）的提示时。该技能提供内置在其中的可运行 Python 脚本。

description: Guided journey from a large aged codebase everyone fears to touch to one that is safe to change, legible, bounded, and resilient - paid down in place without a rewrite. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - working-with-legacy-code, refactoring-patterns, clean-code, software-design-philosophy, clean-architecture, pragmatic-programmer, release-it, domain-driven-design - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (TESTING.md, TECH-DEBT.md, REMOVE-TECHNICAL-DEBT-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to tame a legacy codebase, pay down technical debt safely, avoid a big-bang rewrite, or says 'we are afraid to touch this code'. For a fresh vibe-coded prototype, improve-code-quality; for greenfield structure, design-code-architecture; for a product-and-UX pass, improve-app; to optimize a working codebase for speed, architecture-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从大型老旧代码库（所有人都害怕触碰）到安全可更改、清晰可读、边界明确、具有弹性的代码库的引导式旅程——在不进行重写的前提下，原地偿还技术债务。按阶段编排八项技能——working-with-legacy-code、refactoring-patterns、clean-code、software-design-philosophy、clean-architecture、pragmatic-programmer、release-it、domain-driven-design——在每个决策点询问用户问题，并将结果记录到 project docs/ 文件夹（TESTING.md、TECH-DEBT.md、REMOVE-TECHNICAL-DEBT-PLAN.md）中，以便旅程在不同会话中延续。当用户希望治理老旧代码库、安全地偿还技术债务、避免大规模重写，或表示“我们害怕触碰这段代码”时使用。针对新生的 vibe-coded 原型，使用 improve-code-quality；针对绿地结构，使用 design-code-architecture；针对产品与 UX 交付，使用 improve-app；为优化运行中代码库的性能，使用 architecture-optimization。对于单独使用某一个框架的情况，直接调用对应的技能。

description: 诊断或修复 bug、报错、性能回退或既有行为异常。不用于新功能（cs-feat）或行为等价重构（cs-refactor）。
description_zh: 诊断或修复 Bug、报错、性能回退或既有行为异常。不用于新功能（cs-feat）或行为等价重构（cs-refactor）。

description: Bundle TypeScript and JavaScript libraries with blazing-fast speed powered by Rolldown. Use when building libraries, generating type declarations, bundling for multiple formats, or migrating from tsup.
description_zh: 使用由 Rolldown 驱动的极速，打包 TypeScript 与 JavaScript 库。用于构建库、生成类型声明、为多种格式打包，或从 tsup 迁移。

description: Mid-session save point: create a descriptive git commit and a brief handoff note, then keep working. Use before a risky change or refactor, when switching tasks, or to bank progress without ending the session. Triggers on: /checkpoint, "checkpoint", "save progress", "commit and handoff", "save state", "pause here", "before a risky change". For the full end-of-session ritual with learning extraction, use /wrap-up instead.
description_zh: 会话中期保存点：创建一段描述性的 git 提交，并编写一份简短的交接说明，然后继续工作。适用于风险变更或重构之前、切换任务时，或在不结束会话的情况下暂存进度。触发词：/checkpoint、"checkpoint"、"save progress"、"commit and handoff"、"save state"、"pause here"、"before a risky change"。如需进行包含学习提取的完整会话结束仪式，请使用 /wrap-up 代替。

description: Architecture-aware feature scaffolding for .NET 10 projects. Detects the project's architecture (VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith) and generates complete feature slices with all required layers: endpoint, handler, validator, DTOs, EF configuration, and integration tests — with the completeness checklist and per-architecture code templates every generated feature must satisfy. Use when: "scaffold", "create feature", "add feature", "new endpoint", "generate", "add entity", "scaffold a module", "add module", or when customizing generation templates or defining what a complete feature slice includes.
description_zh:
针对 .NET 10 项目的架构感知特性脚手架。识别项目的架构（VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith），并生成包含所有必需层级的完整功能切片，包括接口端点、处理程序、验证器、数据传输对象（DTOs）、EF 配置和集成测试——同时附带完整性清单以及每个生成功能必须遵循的各架构代码模板。

适用场景：当使用“脚手架”、“创建功能切片”、“添加功能切片”、“新建接口端点”、“生成”、“添加实体”、“脚手架模块”或“添加模块”等操作，或自定义生成模板，或定义完整功能切片包含的内容时。

description: Turn a vague feature or product idea into an agreed, persisted specification through relentless structured questioning. Never assumes — every gap, ambiguity, or "probably" becomes a question to the developer, and the spec cannot be approved while open questions remain. Produces docs/specs/<NNN>-<slug>.md with acceptance criteria that /plan, /scaffold, and /tdd consume. Use when: "spec", "write a spec", "spec this out", "requirements", "PRD", "acceptance criteria", "define the feature", "user stories", "what should we build", or before planning any feature too big to describe in one sentence.
description_zh:
通过不懈的结构化提问，将模糊的功能或产品想法转化为经过确认并持久化的规范。绝不假设——任何差距、模糊之处或“可能”都将转化为向开发者提出的问题，且只要存在未解决的问题，规范就无法获得批准。它将生成 docs/specs/<NNN>-<slug>.md 文件，其中包含 `/plan`、`/scaffold` 和 `/tdd` 所消耗的验收标准。

适用场景：“spec”、“编写规范”、“将此规范明确化”、“需求”、“PRD”、“验收标准”、“定义功能”、“用户故事”、“应构建什么”，或在规划任何一句话都无法描述完的过大功能之前使用。

description: Create GitHub Pull Request from specification using pull_request_template.md. Use when: spec needs to be converted to PR, spec is ready for review/merge, need to automate PR creation from specification file with template-based body and title.
description_zh:
使用 `pull_request_template.md` 从规范创建 GitHub Pull Request。

使用场景：规范需要转换为 Pull Request，规范已准备好审核/合并，需要从规范文件自动创建 Pull Request，并根据模板生成正文与标题。

description: Vitess best practices, query optimization, and connection troubleshooting for PlanetScale Vitess databases. Load when working with Vitess databases, sharding, VSchema configuration, keyspace management, or MySQL scaling issues.
description_zh: PlanetScale Vitess 数据库的最佳实践、查询优化与连接故障排查。当使用 Vitess 数据库、分片、VSchema 配置、键空间管理或处理 MySQL 扩展问题时加载。

description: Install and use Marketing Skills for AI agents — CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering skills for Claude Code and other coding agents.
description_zh: 安装并使用面向 AI 智能体的营销技能——CRO、文案撰写、SEO、数据分析及增长工程技能，适用于 Claude Code 及其他编码智能体。

description: Score and route an inbound lead, or rank a backlog of leads, against your ICP and qualification framework, then recommend a priority and next action. Use when the user asks "triage this lead", "triage my leads", "rank my lead backlog", "is [company] a good lead", "qualify [lead]", or pastes or uploads lead info.
description_zh: 根据您的 ICP 和资质框架，对来访线索进行评分和分流，或对线索积压进行排序，然后推荐优先级和下一步行动。当用户要求“triage this lead”、“triage my leads”、“rank my lead backlog”、“is [company] a good lead”、“qualify [lead]”，或粘贴或上传线索信息时使用。

description: Guided, safe migration workflow covering EF Core schema migrations, .NET version upgrades, and NuGet dependency updates — each with rollback strategies and verification steps. Invoke when: "add migration", "update database", "create migration", "schema change", "new table", "rename column", "upgrade nuget", "update packages", "dependency update", "version upgrade", ".NET upgrade".
description_zh: 引导式安全迁移工作流，涵盖 EF Core 模式迁移、.NET 版本升级以及 NuGet 依赖更新——每项均包含回滚策略和验证步骤。触发条件：“添加迁移”、“更新数据库”、“创建迁移”、“模式变更”、“新增表”、“重命名列”、“升级 nuget”、“更新包”、“依赖更新”、“版本升级”、“.NET 升级”。

description: Decompose research ideas into atomic, self-contained concepts with bidirectional math-code mapping. For each concept, extract the math formula from papers and find code implementations. Use for complex system papers requiring formal grounding.
description_zh: 将研究思路分解成具有双向数学-代码映射的原子级自包含概念。对于每个概念，从论文中提取数学公式，并寻找代码实现。用于需要形式化基础的复杂系统论文。

description: Convert a completed paper into presentation slides (Beamer LaTeX) or poster. Extract key figures, tables, equations, and create a narrative flow for oral presentation. Identified gap in existing tools — designed from best practices.
description_zh: 将已完成的论文转换为演示幻灯片（Beamer LaTeX）或海报。提取关键图表、表格和公式，并为口头演示构建叙事流程。指出了现有工具存在的不足——依据最佳实践进行设计。

description: Comprehensive web accessibility audit using WCAG 2.1/2.2 guidelines. Evaluate compliance across 4 POUR principles (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust) with A, AA, AAA conformance levels.
description_zh: 基于WCAG 2.1/2.2标准的全面网页无障碍审计。依据A、AA、AAA合规等级，评估4项POUR原则（可感知、可操作、可理解、稳健）的合规情况。

description: When the user wants to design, deploy, or measure Apple Custom Product Pages (CPP) — the alternate App Store product pages with different screenshots, preview videos, and promo text shown to users coming from specific URLs (typically ad campaigns or social posts). Use when the user mentions "Custom Product Page", "CPP", "alternate product page", "App Store URL variant", "ASA CPP", "campaign-specific landing page", "product page per audience", "App Store Connect CPP", "ppoUrl", "?cpp=" parameter, or "show different screenshots to different ad audiences". For App Store A/B tests on the default page, see ab-test-store-listing. For paid ad campaigns that route to CPPs, see apple-search-ads or ua-campaign.
description_zh:
当用户需要设计、部署或测量 Apple 自定义产品页面（CPP）时——CPP 是一种面向来自特定 URL（通常为广告活动或社交媒体帖子）的用户展示不同截图、预览视频和推广文案的替代应用商店产品页面。当用户提及"Custom Product Page"、"CPP"、"alternate product page"、"App Store URL variant"、"ASA CPP"、"特定广告活动的落地页"、"针对受众的产品页面"、"App Store Connect CPP"、"ppoUrl"、"?cpp="参数，或"向不同的广告受众展示不同的截图"时使用。

如需对默认页面进行应用商店 A/B 测试，请参阅 ab-test-store-listing。如需了解将流量路由至 CPP 的付费广告活动，请参阅 apple-search-ads 或 ua-campaign。

description: When the user wants concrete recommendations on how to improve their social media performance. Also use when the user mentions 'what should I do next,' 'how do I improve,' 'optimize my social media,' 'recommendations,' 'suggestions,' 'next steps,' 'what's my biggest opportunity,' or 'help me grow.' Synthesizes insights from performance, audience, and pattern analysis into prioritized actions. For raw analytics, see performance-analyzer-sms. For growth tracking, see audience-growth-tracker-sms. For pattern detection, see content-pattern-analyzer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户需要获取关于如何提升其社交媒体绩效的具体建议时，会使用本功能。同样，当用户提及“下一步该做什么”、“如何提升”、“优化我的社交媒体”、“建议”、“方案”、“下一步计划”、“我的最大机遇”或“帮助我成长”时，也会使用本功能。该功能将绩效、受众与模式分析中的见解，整合为按优先级排序的行动方案。有关原始数据分析，请参阅 performance-analyzer-sms；有关增长追踪，请参阅 audience-growth-tracker-sms；有关模式检测，请参阅 content-pattern-analyzer-sms。

description: Autonomous iteration loops for .NET: drive a broken build or failing test suite to green with bounded iterations, progress detection, and fail-safe guards that prevent infinite retries and wasted tokens. The build-fix loop (dotnet build, parse, categorize, fix, rebuild) is the primary flow; the test-fix loop is a first-class variant. Invoke when the build is broken, after a major refactor or dependency update, or when the user says "fix the build", "build is broken", "make it compile", "make the tests pass", "fix failing tests", "keep going until it works", "autonomous", "loop", "auto-fix", or "keep fixing".
description_zh: 针对.NET的自主迭代循环：通过有限次迭代、进度检测以及防止无限重试与浪费令牌的安全保护机制，可将损坏的构建或失败的测试套件驱动至通过状态。构建修复循环（dotnet build、解析、分类、修复、重新构建）为主要流程，测试修复循环为一等变体。当构建已损坏，或在重大重构或依赖更新后，或当用户说出“修复构建”、“构建已损坏”、“使其编译通过”、“使测试通过”、“修复失败的测试”、“继续直到它正常工作”、“自主”、“循环”、“自动修复”或“继续修复”时，触发该循环。

description: Query Cournot probabilities and manage prepaid calls, balances, and API keys. Use only for /cournot or an explicit request to use Cournot, not for casual odds questions.
description_zh: 查询 Cournot 概率，并管理预付费通话、余额和 API 密钥。仅用于 /cournot 或明确的 Cournot 使用请求，不用于随意询问赔率问题。

description: Choose and configure React Three Fiber surface materials, PBR, transparency, and transmission. Use for mesh appearance and material cost; use shader guidance for custom GLSL or TSL code.
description_zh: 选择并配置 React Three Fiber 表面材质、PBR、透明度和透射。用于网格外观与材质成本；使用着色器指导编写自定义 GLSL 或 TSL 代码。

description: Configure React Three Fiber postprocessing, bloom, selection effects, ambient occlusion, and depth of field. Use for composer pipelines and screen-space effects, rather than mesh material shaders.
description_zh: 配置 React Three Fiber 后处理，包括 bloom、选区效果和环境光遮蔽、景深。用于合成管线和屏幕空间效果，而非网格材质着色器。

description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor
description_zh:
使用 inference.sh CLI，通过阿里 HappyHorse 1.0 模型生成和编辑视频。

模型：HappyHorse T2V、I2V、R2V、Video Edit。

能力：文生视频、图生视频、参考视频生成、自然语言视频编辑、角色保留、720P/1080P、最长15秒。

适用场景：物理真实感视频、视频编辑、角色一致内容、产品演示、社交媒体。

触发词：happyhorse、happy horse、alibaba video、happyhorse 1.0、dashscope video、alibaba happyhorse、video editing ai、ai video editor

description: Use when building any webhook-triggered workflow, scheduled/production-bound workflow, wiring a per-node error output, or any workflow where silent failure would drop user-visible work. Triggers on "webhook", "respond to webhook", "API", "production", "error", "failure", "5xx", "try/catch", "error workflow", "onError", "continueErrorOutput", "error branch", "node error output", "output(1)", "main[1]", "scheduled", or any workflow that runs unattended.
description_zh: 适用于构建任何基于webhook触发的工作流、定时/生产绑定的工作流、为每个节点配置错误输出，或任何静默失败会导致用户可见工作丢失的工作流。触发条件包括"webhook"、"respond to webhook"、"API"、"production"、"error"、"failure"、"5xx"、"try/catch"、"error workflow"、"onError"、"continueErrorOutput"、"error branch"、"node error output"、"output(1)"、"main[1]"、"scheduled"，或任何无人值守运行的工作流。

description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.
description_zh: 原始的 v1 taste-skill，为依赖其精确行为的项目保留。当前的默认值为 `design-taste-frontview`（v2 实验版本），这是一次大幅重写。仅在需要精确向后兼容时，才使用此 v1 安装名称。

description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.
description_zh: 用于生成高端、注重转化效果的网站设计参考图的顶级前端图像导向技能。关键输出规则——为每个部分生成一张独立的水平图像。包含8个部分的落地页将生成8张图像。绝不可将多个部分压缩为一张图像。强制构图多样性（并非总是采用左文右图）、背景图像自由、多样化的行动号召（CTA）、多样化的首屏尺寸（巨幅/中等/极简微型）、叙事概念主线、二次阅读亮点，以及所有图像间保持单一且一致的颜色调色板。针对落地页、营销网站和产品效果图进行了优化，开发者或编程模型能够准确复现。

description: Pre-mortem plan analysis. Imagine the plan failed 12 months from now and work backwards to find the weaknesses. Surfaces assumptions, dependencies, and execution risks before committing resources. Use when before significant resource commitment, before presenting to a board or investors, when feedback has been one-sidedly positive, or when there is pressure to move fast and figure it out later.
description_zh:
事前镜检计划分析。

设想计划在12个月后失败，并逆向推演以找出薄弱环节。在投入资源前，揭示假设、依赖关系与执行风险。适用于在重大资源投入之前、在向董事会或投资者展示之前、当反馈单一且偏正面，或当存在急于快速推进、将问题留待后续解决的压力时。

description: Handles an incoming customer complaint end-to-end — pulls context, drafts a response, and suggests an operational fix. Accepts optional email or ticket ID argument.
description_zh: 端到端处理新收到的客户投诉——提取上下文，起草回复，并提出运营修复建议。接受可选的邮件或工单ID参数。

description: List, inspect, create, update, and delete HubSpot workflows (v4 flows API) from the `hubspot` agent CLI, not the `hs` developer CLI.
description_zh: 使用 `hubspot` 代理 CLI 列出、检查、创建、更新和删除 HubSpot 工作流（v4 工作流 API），而非使用 `hs` 开发者 CLI。

description: Generate FFmpeg commands from natural language video editing requests - cut, trim, convert, compress, change aspect ratio, extract audio, and more.
description_zh: 根据自然语言视频编辑请求生成 FFmpeg 命令 - 支持剪切、修剪、转换、压缩、调整宽高比、提取音频等更多功能。

description: Launch N parallel subagents in isolated git worktrees to compete on the session task. Use when the user runs /hub:spawn or asks to start the competing agents for an initialized AgentHub session.
description_zh: 启动 N 个并行子代理，并在隔离的 git 工作树中竞争会话任务。当用户执行 `/hub:spawn` 或要求为已初始化的 AgentHub 会话启动竞争性代理时使用。

description: /em:stress-test — Business assumption stress testing. Use before betting on a plan whose core assumptions are unvalidated — e.g. stress-testing 'enterprise buyers will tolerate a 6-month pilot' or a hockey-stick revenue model.
description_zh: /em:stress-test — 业务假设压力测试。在押注于核心假设未经验证的计划之前使用 — 例如，对“企业客户将容忍6个月试点”进行压力测试，或对“曲棍球杆式收入模型”进行压力测试。

description: Expert in TailwindCSS utility-first styling with responsive design patterns
description_zh: 精通 TailwindCSS 工具优先样式设计与响应式设计模式

description: Compile LaTeX papers to PDF with automatic error detection, chktex style checking, and citation/reference validation. Runs the full pdflatex + bibtex pipeline. Use when the user wants to compile a paper, fix compilation errors, or debug LaTeX.
description_zh: 将 LaTeX 论文编译为 PDF，支持自动错误检测、chktex 样式检查以及引用/参考文献验证。执行完整的 pdflatex + bibtex 流程。当用户需要编译论文、修复编译错误或调试 LaTeX 时使用。

description: Download videos and extract audio from various platforms using yt-dlp. Use when user provides a video URL, asks to download a video, or when conversation contains video links from YouTube, Twitter/X, Vimeo, TikTok, Instagram, etc.
description_zh: 使用 yt-dlp 从各种平台下载视频并提取音频。当用户提供视频URL、要求下载视频，或对话中包含来自YouTube、Twitter/X、Vimeo、TikTok、Instagram等平台的视频链接时使用。

description: Architecture conformance check: verifies an existing codebase against its declared architecture (VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith) — dependency direction, layer violations, module boundary leaks, and cycles — using token-cheap Roslyn MCP analysis. Invoke when: "check architecture", "architecture violations", "layer violations", "dependency direction", "module boundaries", "arch check", "is my architecture clean", "enforce architecture", "conformance check". For CHOOSING an architecture, use architecture-advisor instead.
description_zh: 架构符合性检查：验证现有代码库是否符合其声明的架构（VSA、Clean Architecture、DDD、Modular Monolith）——依赖方向、层级违规、模块边界泄漏以及循环依赖——使用 token 成本较低的 Roslyn MCP 分析。调用时机：“check architecture”、“architecture violations”、“layer violations”、“dependency direction”、“module boundaries”、“arch check”、“is my architecture clean”、“enforce architecture”、“conformance check”。如需选择架构，请改用 architecture-advisor。

description: SOQL query generation, optimization, and analysis with 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user writes, optimizes, or debugs SOQL/SOSL queries, touches .soql files, or asks about relationship queries, aggregates, or query performance. DO NOT TRIGGER when: bulk data operations (use sf-data), Apex DML logic (use sf-apex), or report/dashboard queries.
description_zh: 基于100分评分的SOQL查询生成、优化与分析。**触发条件**：当用户编写、优化或调试SOQL/SOSL查询，涉及.soql文件，或询问关系查询、聚合或查询性能相关问题时触发。**不触发条件**：批量数据处理（使用sf-data）、Apex DML逻辑（使用sf-apex），或报表/仪表盘查询。

description: Guided journey from raw idea to a validated, positioned, priced business with a chosen beachhead. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - jobs-to-be-done, mom-test, design-sprint, lean-startup, good-strategy-bad-strategy, blue-ocean-strategy, obviously-awesome, hundred-million-offers, monetizing-innovation, crossing-the-chasm - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (CUSTOMER.md, POSITIONING.md, OFFER.md, CREATE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to start a new business, validate a startup idea, find product-market fit before building, or says 'I have an idea for a company'. Do not use once the business has paying customers: use grow-business to add revenue and customers, or improve-business to fix strategy and operations. For building the product itself use create-app or create-website. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从原始想法到拥有经验证、明确定位、具备定价并选定立足点的业务的引导式旅程：分阶段编排十项技能——jobs-to-be-done、mom-test、design-sprint、lean-startup、good-strategy-bad-strategy、blue-ocean-strategy、obviously-awesome、hundred-million-offers、monetizing-innovation、crossing-the-chasm；在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目 docs/ 文件夹中（CUSTOMER.md、POSITIONING.md、OFFER.md、CREATE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md），以便旅程能在多次会话中继续推进。当用户希望开启新业务、验证创业想法、在构建前寻找产品与市场契合度（product-market fit），或表示“我有一个公司的想法”时使用。一旦业务已产生付费客户，则不要使用：请使用 grow-business 来增加营收与客户，或使用 improve-business 来完善策略与运营。若要构建产品本身，请使用 create-app 或 create-website。如需单独使用某项框架，请直接调用该技能。

description: Dependency health report for .NET solutions: outdated NuGet packages, vulnerable versions, and commercial-license traps (MediatR, MassTransit, FluentAssertions, AutoMapper) — powered by the get_nuget_packages MCP tool. Invoke when: "outdated packages", "check dependencies", "stale packages", "package audit", "dependency health", "are my packages up to date", "license check", "vulnerable packages", "nuget audit".
description_zh:
.NET 解决方案的依赖健康报告：过期的 NuGet 包、存在漏洞的版本以及商业许可陷阱（MediatR、MassTransit、FluentAssertions、AutoMapper）——由 get_nuget_packages MCP 工具驱动。

调用时：当出现“过期的包”、“检查依赖项”、“过时的包”、“包审计”、“依赖健康”、“我的包是否为最新版本”、“许可检查”、“存在漏洞的包”或“NuGet 审计”时。

description: Material Design 3 and Android platform guidelines. Use when building Android apps with Jetpack Compose or XML layouts, implementing Material You, navigation, or accessibility. Triggers on tasks involving Android UI, Compose components, dynamic color, or Material Design compliance.
description_zh: Material Design 3 与 Android 平台指南。适用于使用 Jetpack Compose 或 XML 布局构建 Android 应用、实现 Material You、导航及无障碍功能的情况。适用于涉及 Android UI、Compose 组件、动态配色或 Material Design 合规性的任务。

description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.
description_zh: 精英移动应用图像生成技能，用于创建高品质、应用原生的屏幕概念与流程。专为 iOS、Android 及跨平台移动产品设计。注重清晰的层次结构、舒适易读的文本、强烈的多屏幕一致性、受控的色彩配色方案、非通用的创意方向、质感表面、以图像为导向的构图、雅致的自定义图标设计以及整洁的手机原型框架。默认情况下，屏幕应展示在精致的 iPhone 或类似手机模型内，并带有可见的边框，同时主要焦点仍置于应用内容本身。该技能仅生成图像，不编写代码。

description: Configure safe agent behavior around PlanetScale MCP, Insights, schema recommendations, and repository work without autonomous production mutation.
description_zh: 配置针对 PlanetScale MCP、Insights、模式推荐和仓库工作的安全智能体行为，不进行自主生产变更。

description: Use when writing READMEs, architecture, changelogs, release notes, runbooks, notebook docs, install docs, or security articles; produces docs. Do not trigger for API docs, AGENTS.md, or diagrams.
description_zh: 适用于编写 README、架构、变更日志、发布说明、运行手册、笔记本文档、安装文档或安全文章，用于生成文档。不适用于 API 文档、AGENTS.md 或图表。

description: Expert in launching small, focused SaaS products fast - the indie hacker approach to building profitable software. Covers idea validation, MVP development, pricing, launch strategies, and growing to sustainable revenue. Ship in weeks, not months.
description_zh: 擅长快速推出小型、聚焦SaaS产品——以独立黑客方式构建盈利软件。涵盖创意验证、MVP开发、定价、发布策略及实现可持续收入的增长。以周为单位交付，而非以月为单位。

description: Implement custom GLSL or TSL materials in React Three Fiber, including uniforms and vertex deformation. Use for shader code and shader debugging, rather than ordinary PBR settings or composer effects.
description_zh: 在 React Three Fiber 中实现自定义 GLSL 或 TSL 材质，包括 uniform 和顶点变形。用于着色器代码与着色器调试，而非普通的 PBR 设置或合成器效果。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "design system architecture", "evaluate microservices vs monolith", "create architecture diagrams", "analyze dependencies", "choose a database", "plan for scalability", "make technical decisions", or "review system design". Use for architecture decision records (ADRs), tech stack evaluation, system design reviews, dependency analysis, and generating architecture diagrams in Mermaid, PlantUML, or ASCII format.
description_zh: 本技能应在用户要求“设计系统架构”“评估微服务与单体架构”“创建架构图”“分析依赖关系”“选择数据库”“规划可扩展性”“做出技术决策”或“评审系统设计”时使用。可用于架构决策记录（ADR）、技术栈评估、系统设计评审、依赖分析，以及以 Mermaid、PlantUML 或 ASCII 格式生成架构图。

description: When the user wants to set up, debug, or interpret app install attribution — including SKAdNetwork (SKAN), Apple's AdAttributionKit, Google Play Install Referrer, MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Branch, Kochava), deep links, deferred deep links, conversion values, postback windows, or privacy thresholds. Use when the user mentions "SKAdNetwork", "SKAN", "SKAN 4", "AdAttributionKit", "AAK", "MMP", "AppsFlyer", "Adjust", "Singular", "Branch", "attribution", "conversion value", "postback", "Install Referrer", "deferred deep link", "iOS 14.5", "ATT", "App Tracking Transparency", "IDFA", or "I can't measure my ad campaigns". For paid campaign strategy, see ua-campaign and apple-search-ads. For analytics events, see app-analytics.
description_zh: 当用户需要设置、调试或解读应用安装归因——包括SKAdNetwork (SKAN)、Apple的AdAttributionKit、Google Play Install Referrer、MMPs（AppsFlyer、Adjust、Singular、Branch、Kochava）、深度链接、延迟深度链接、转化值、回传窗口或隐私阈值时，请使用本指南。当用户提及"SKAdNetwork"、"SKAN"、"SKAN 4"、"AdAttributionKit"、"AAK"、"MMP"、"AppsFlyer"、"Adjust"、"Singular"、"Branch"、"attribution"、"conversion value"、"postback"、"Install Referrer"、"deferred deep link"、"iOS 14.5"、"ATT"、"App Tracking Transparency"、"IDFA"或"I can't measure my ad campaigns"时使用。关于付费活动策略，请参阅ua-campaign和apple-search-ads。关于分析事件，请参阅app-analytics。

description: Full STRIDE-A threat model analysis and incremental update skill for repositories and systems. Supports two modes: (1) Single analysis — full STRIDE-A threat model of a repository, producing architecture overviews, DFD diagrams, STRIDE-A analysis, prioritized findings, and executive assessments. (2) Incremental analysis — takes a previous threat model report as baseline, compares the codebase at the latest (or a given commit), and produces an updated report with change tracking (new, resolved, still-present threats), STRIDE heatmap, findings diff, and an embedded HTML comparison. Only activate when the user explicitly requests a threat model analysis, incremental update, or invokes /threat-model-analyst directly.
description_zh:
完整 STRIDE-A 威胁模型分析与增量更新技能，面向代码库和系统。支持两种模式：
(1) 单次分析：为代码库生成完整的 STRIDE-A 威胁模型，产出架构概览、DFD 图、STRIDE-A 分析、优先发现的问题以及高管评估。
(2) 增量分析：以前面的威胁模型报告为基线，与最新（或指定提交）的代码库进行对比，生成包含变更跟踪（新出现、已解决、仍存在的问题）、STRIDE 热力图、发现差异和内嵌 HTML 对比的更新报告。
仅在用户明确要求进行威胁模型分析、增量更新，或直接调用 /threat-model-analyst 时激活。

description: You are a senior frontend engineer operating under strict architectural and performance standards. Use when creating components or pages, adding new features, or fetching or mutating data.
description_zh: 你是一名在严格的技术架构与性能标准下工作的资深前端工程师。在创建组件或页面、添加新功能，或获取或修改数据时，请遵循此规则。

description: Internal command support for dynamic Rust crate skill management. Use only when explicitly invoked by /sync-crate-skills, /clean-crate-skills, or /update-crate-skill.
description_zh: 为 Rust crate 技能的动态管理提供内部命令支持。仅在 /sync-crate-skills、/clean-crate-skills 或 /update-crate-skill 显式调用时使用。

description: Read, write, and browse the AgentHub message board for agent coordination. Use when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between competing AgentHub agents.
description_zh: 阅读、发布并浏览 AgentHub 消息板，用于代理协调。当用户运行 /hub:board 或要求发布、阅读或检查竞争性 AgentHub 代理之间的协调消息时使用。

description: Wire n8n error handling so failures are loud, structured, and recoverable. Use when building any webhook/API workflow, a scheduled or unattended workflow, or any path where a silent failure would drop user-visible work — and whenever the user mentions error handling, onError, continueErrorOutput, error branches/outputs, retries, retryOnFail, Respond to Webhook status codes, 4xx/5xx, Error Trigger, or "my workflow fails silently". Covers per-node error outputs and wiring, retry/self-healing, error-trigger workflows, and 4xx/5xx response shapes.
description_zh:
配置 n8n 错误处理，确保失败被明确、结构化且可恢复。

构建任何 Webhook/API 工作流、定时或无人值守工作流，或任何存在静默失败会导致用户可见工作失效的路径时使用；且当用户提及错误处理、onError、continueErrorOutput、错误分支/输出、重试、retryOnFail、响应 Webhook 状态码、4xx/5xx、Error Trigger，或“我的工作流静默失败”时使用。

涵盖各节点的错误输出与连接配置、重试/自愈机制、基于错误触发的工作流，以及 4xx/5xx 响应格式。

description: Extract design systems from reference UI images and generate implementation-ready UI design prompts. Use when users provide UI screenshots/mockups and want to create consistent designs, generate design systems, or build MVP UIs matching reference aesthetics.
description_zh: 从参考 UI 图片中提取设计系统，生成可直接实施的设计提示词。适用于用户提供 UI 截图/原型图，并希望创建一致设计、生成设计系统或构建与参考风格匹配的 MVP UI 的场景。

description: Guided journey from a shipped app that works but feels rough to a product that fits the job, flows without friction, reads clearly, and persuades honestly. Orchestrates nine skills phase by phase - jobs-to-be-done, ux-heuristics, design-everyday-things, refactoring-ui, microinteractions, made-to-stick, influence-psychology, high-perf-browser, steve-jobs-design-review - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (CUSTOMER.md, DESIGN.md, POSITIONING.md, IMPROVE-APP-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to fix a clunky product, cut UX friction, sharpen in-app copy, or says 'the app works but feels rough'. Not for code, tests, or hardening - use improve-code-quality (fresh prototype) or remove-technical-debt (aged); no app yet, create-app; needs growth loops, grow-app; marketing-site friction, improve-website; one leaking flow, conversion-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从已发布且可运行但感觉粗糙的应用出发，引导走向契合用户任务、流畅无摩擦、清晰易读、真诚有说服力的产品。按阶段依次统筹九项技能——jobs-to-be-done、ux-heuristics、design-everyday-things、refactoring-ui、microinteractions、made-to-stick、influence-psychology、high-perf-browser、steve-jobs-design-review——在每个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录到项目 docs/ 文件夹中（CUSTOMER.md、DESIGN.md、POSITIONING.md、IMPROVE-APP-PLAN.md），使旅程能够在多次会话中续接。当用户需要修复笨重粗糙的产品、削减 UX 摩擦、精炼应用内文案，或表示“应用可用但感觉粗糙”时使用。不适用于代码、测试或加固——如需提升代码质量（用于全新原型）请使用 improve-code-quality，或需移除技术债（用于老旧）请使用 remove-technical-debt；尚无应用时使用 create-app；需要增长闭环时使用 grow-app；营销站点存在摩擦时使用 improve-website；存在一个流失环节时使用 conversion-optimization。若单独针对某个框架，请直接调用该技能。

description: Implements approved specification proposals by working through tasks sequentially with testing and validation. Use when implementing changes, applying proposals, executing spec tasks, or building from approved plans. Triggers include "openspec implement", "implement", "apply change", "execute spec", "work through tasks", "build feature", "start implementation".
description_zh: 通过依次执行任务，并进行测试与验证，实现已批准的规范提案。当实施变更、应用提案、执行规范任务或基于已批准的方案构建时使用。触发器包括“openspec implement”，“ implement”，“apply change”，“execute spec”，“work through tasks”，“build feature”，“start implementation”。

description: Workflow automation is the infrastructure that makes AI agents reliable. Without durable execution, a network hiccup during a 10-step payment flow means lost money and angry customers. With it, workflows resume exactly where they left off.
description_zh: 工作流自动化是保障AI智能体可靠的基础设施。如果没有持久执行，十步支付流程中的网络卡顿，将导致资金损失和客户不满。有了它，工作流便能精确恢复到中断前的状态。

description: When the user wants to design or optimize the funnel that takes web visitors into installing and onboarding the app — including smart app banners, web-to-app deep links, deferred deep links, web onboarding (Stripe-paid web flow before app install), QR codes, "open in app" CTAs, and the trade-off between paying on web vs in-app. Use when the user mentions "web to app", "smart app banner", "Stripe before app", "web paywall before install", "Branch web SDK", "web funnel for app", "AppsFlyer OneLink web", "Universal Links", "App Links", "QR code to app", "open in app", "deferred deep link from web", or "should I sell on web first then push to app". For pure in-app onboarding, see onboarding-optimization. For deep link infra, see attribution-setup.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计和优化将网页访问者引导至安装和应用引导的流程时——包括智能应用横幅、网页到应用深度链接、延迟深度链接、网页引导（应用安装前的 Stripe 付费流程）、二维码、“在应用中打开”CTA，以及网页支付与应用中支付的权衡。当用户提到“网页到应用”、“智能应用横幅”、“Stripe 应用前”、“安装前网页付费墙”、“Branch 网页 SDK”、“应用网页漏斗”、“AppsFlyer OneLink 网页”、“通用链接”、“应用链接”、“二维码到应用”、“在应用中打开”、“网页延迟深度链接”或“我应该先在网上销售然后推送至应用”时使用。对于纯应用内引导，请参见 onboarding-optimization。对于深度链接基础设施，请参见 attribution-setup。

description: Define intended behavior, review write scope and assess reversible decisions. Use when: acceptance or approach is unclear before coding; stop once actionable.
description_zh:
定义预期行为，审查写入范围并评估可逆决策。

使用时机：编码前若未明确验收标准或方案；一旦可执行，即停止。

description: Cut a beta release of Paseo. Use when the user says "release beta", "cut a beta", "ship a beta", "beta release", or "/release-beta".
description_zh: 发布 Paseo 的 Beta 版本。当用户说“release beta”、“cut a beta”、“ship a beta”、“beta release”或“/release-beta”时使用。

description:
Betting analysis — odds conversion, de-vigging, edge detection, Kelly criterion, arbitrage detection, parlay analysis, and line movement. Pure computation, no API calls. Works with odds from any source: ESPN (American odds), Polymarket (decimal probabilities), Kalshi (integer probabilities).

Use when: user asks about bet sizing, expected value, edge analysis, Kelly criterion, arbitrage, parlays, line movement, odds conversion, or comparing odds across sources. Also use when you have odds from ESPN and a prediction market price and want to evaluate whether a bet has positive expected value.
Don't use when: user asks for live odds or market data — use polymarket, kalshi, or the sport-specific skill to fetch odds first, then use this skill to analyze them.
description_zh:
投注分析——赔率换算、赔率去水、优势检测、凯利准则、套利检测、串关分析及盘口走势。纯计算，无 API 调用。兼容任意来源的赔率：ESPN（美式赔率）、Polymarket（十进制概率）、Kalshi（整数概率）。

适用场景：当用户询问下注金额、期望值、优势分析、凯利准则、套利、串关或盘口走势，以及赔率换算或跨来源比较赔率时；当用户持有 ESPN 赔率与预测市场价格，并希望评估该下注是否具有正期望值时。

不适用场景：当用户要求获取实时赔率或市场数据时——应优先使用 polymarket、kalshi 或专项运动技能获取赔率，随后再使用本技能进行分析。

description: Write compact caller-authored session evidence without choosing continuation. Triggers: "handoff", "write compact session handoff".
description_zh: 编写调用者撰写的精简会话证据，无需选择后续。触发词："交接"、"编写精简会话交接"。

description: Read open comments from the tree browser and resolve them by making code fixes
description_zh: 从树形浏览器中读取未解决的评论，并通过代码修复予以解决。

description: Expert in building portfolios that actually land jobs and clients - not just showing work, but creating memorable experiences. Covers developer portfolios, designer portfolios, creative portfolios, and portfolios that convert visitors into opportunities.
description_zh: 作品集构建专家，能打造出真正能获得工作与客户的作品集——不只是展示作品，而是创造令人难忘的体验。涵盖开发者作品集、设计师作品集、创意作品集，以及能将访客转化为机会的作品集。

description: Integrate a raw customer agent repo with Veris end to end. Installs or verifies veris-cli, logs in, creates or reuses a Veris environment, analyzes the repo, generates or updates `.veris/veris.yaml`, `.veris/Dockerfile.sandbox`, `.veris/.dockerignore`, configures runtime env vars, and can finish with `veris env push`. Use when a repo has no Veris setup yet, or when an existing `.veris/` integration is stale and needs to be refreshed.
description_zh: 将原始客户代理仓库与 Veris 进行端到端集成。安装或验证 veris-cli，登录，创建或复用 Veris 环境，分析仓库，生成或更新 `.veris/veris.yaml`、`.veris/Dockerfile.sandbox`、`.veris/.dockerignore`，配置运行时环境变量，并可通过 `veris env push` 完成。适用于仓库尚未配置 Veris，或现有 `.veris/` 集成过时且需要刷新的情况。

description: Generate project handover documentation for AEM Edge Delivery Services projects. Creates comprehensive guides for content authors, developers, and administrators. Use for "handover docs", "project documentation", "generate handover", "create guides".
description_zh: 为 AEM Edge Delivery Services 项目生成项目交接文档。为内容作者、开发者和管理员创建全面的指南。适用于“交接文档”、“项目文档”、“生成交接”、“创建指南”。

description: The Claude Security menu — pick a job: scan the codebase (the whole repository or a scoped part of it), scan changes (this branch's or a pull request's diff, or one commit), or suggest patches (findings turned into targeted patch files, each verified by a panel of agents, that you apply when you choose).
description_zh: Claude 安全菜单——选择任务：扫描代码库（整个仓库或范围限定部分）、扫描变更（此分支或拉取请求的差异，或单个提交），或建议补丁（将发现转化为针对性的补丁文件，每个均由智能体小组验证，并在你选择时应用）。

description: Scans HubSpot for stale deals, duplicate contacts, and missing fields, then fixes what the owner approves. Accepts optional scope argument for deals, contacts, or all.
description_zh: 扫描 HubSpot 中的过期交易、重复联系人和缺失字段，随后修复所有者批准的内容。支持可选的作用域参数，可选范围为交易、联系人或全部。

description: Use when the requested deliverable includes creating, reviewing, moving, splitting, or updating a repository AGENTS.md; produces scoped repo guidance. Do not trigger for standalone skills, prompts, non-AGENTS instruction files, READMEs, changelogs, or architecture docs.
description_zh: 当请求交付物包括对仓库的 AGENTS.md 进行创建、审查、移动、拆分或更新时使用；生成限定范围的仓库指导。不得对独立技能、提示词、非 AGENTS 指令文件、README、变更日志或架构文档进行触发。

description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or structure legal pages (Privacy, Terms, etc.). Also use when the user mentions "privacy policy," "terms of service," "legal pages," "cookie policy," "terms and conditions," "legal footer," "legal section," "compliance pages," or "legal requirements." For Privacy Policy content, use privacy-page-generator. For Terms of Service, use terms-page-generator. For Cookie Policy, use cookie-policy-page-generator.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建、优化或构建法律页面（隐私、条款等）时，也使用。当用户提及“隐私政策”“服务条款”“法律页面”“Cookie 政策”“条款和条件”“法律页脚”“法律部分”“合规页面”或“法律要求”时，也使用。对于隐私政策内容，使用 privacy-page-generator。对于服务条款，使用 terms-page-generator。对于 Cookie 政策，使用 cookie-policy-page-generator。

description: Manage context-mode GitHub issues, PRs, releases, and marketing with parallel subagent army. Orchestrates 10-20 dynamic agents per task. Use when triaging issues, reviewing PRs, releasing versions, writing LinkedIn posts, announcing releases, fixing bugs, merging contributions, validating ENV vars, testing adapters, or syncing branches.
description_zh: 通过并行子代理军团管理 context-mode 的 GitHub 议题、拉取请求、版本发布与营销内容。每项任务协调 10-20 个动态代理。适用于问题分诊、审查拉取请求、发布版本、撰写 LinkedIn 帖子、宣布发布、修复 Bug、合并贡献、验证 ENV 变量、测试适配器，或同步分支。

description: Skill for using Paperclip — open-source orchestration platform for running autonomous AI-agent companies with org charts, budgets, governance, and heartbeats.
description_zh: 使用 Paperclip 的技能 —— 用于自主运营 AI 智能体公司的开源编排平台，涵盖组织架构图、预算、治理与心跳监控。

description: Responsive design with Container Queries, fluid typography, cqi/cqb units, subgrid, intrinsic layouts, foldable devices, and mobile-first patterns for React applications. Use when building responsive layouts or container queries.
description_zh: 为 React 应用提供基于容器查询的响应式设计、流式排版、cqi/cqb 单位、子网格、固有布局、折叠设备以及移动优先模式。适用于构建响应式布局或容器查询。

description: Develop native Android apps with Kotlin. Covers MVVM with Jetpack, Compose for modern UI, Retrofit for API calls, Room for local storage, and navigation architecture.
description_zh: 使用 Kotlin 开发原生 Android 应用。涵盖使用 Jetpack 的 MVVM 架构、用于现代 UI 的 Compose、用于 API 调用的 Retrofit、用于本地存储的 Room 以及导航架构。

description: AI-native terminal multiplexer with programmable socket API, full Playwright-equivalent browser automation, and agent team coordination — built for Claude Code and autonomous agent workflows
description_zh: AI原生终端多路复用器，配备可编程套接字API、完整的Playwright等效浏览器自动化，以及智能体团队协调功能——专为Claude Code和自主智能体工作流打造

description: Use when building features with **Codex** (OpenAI Codex CLI) in any codebase and the work should go through a disciplined build → review → test → fix loop. Triggers on "run the build loop", "build the next task", "continue the plan", "build this feature properly", or any request to implement work from a plan file or a direct feature prompt. Builds from the plan (or the prompt if no plan exists), runs Codex's `/review` on uncommitted changes and fixes every issue found, tests and verifies the feature end to end, fixes anything testing surfaces, and reports back once complete. Repeats until all plan tasks are checked off.
description_zh: 当在任何代码库中使用 **Codex**（OpenAI Codex CLI）构建功能，且工作需经过严格的构建 → 审查 → 测试 → 修复循环时使用。触发场景包括“运行构建循环”、“构建下一个任务”、“继续计划”、“正确构建此功能”，或任何要求根据计划文件或直接功能提示实施工作的请求。根据计划（若无计划则根据提示词）进行构建，对未提交的变更运行 Codex 的 `/review` 并修复发现的所有问题，对功能进行端到端测试并验证，修复测试中暴露出的任何问题，并在完成后进行汇报。持续循环，直至所有计划任务均标记为已完成。

description: Design n8n AI agents the right way. Use when building or editing any @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.* AI node — an AI Agent, LLM chain, Text Classifier, or Information Extractor — and whenever the user mentions AI agents, LLM with tools, tool calling, $fromAI, system prompts, agent memory, sessionId, structured/JSON output, output parser, RAG, vector store, a chat assistant/bot, or human-in-the-loop review. Covers Agent-vs-chain-vs-classifier choice, the model/memory/tools/outputParser slots, tool names/descriptions as prompt, structured output with autoFix, memory, RAG, human review, and chat topologies.
description_zh: 正确设计 n8n AI 智能体。在构建或编辑任何 @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.* AI 节点（即 AI 智能体、LLM 链、文本分类器或信息提取器）时使用，以及在用户提及 AI 智能体、带工具的 LLM、工具调用、$fromAI、系统提示词、智能体记忆、sessionId、结构化/JSON 输出、输出解析器、RAG、向量存储、聊天助手/机器人或人工审核时触发。涵盖 AI 智能体与 LLM 链与文本分类器的选择、模型/记忆/工具/输出解析器参数槽位、将工具名称/描述作为提示词、带自动修复（autoFix）的结构化输出、记忆、RAG、人工审核以及聊天拓扑结构。

description: Expert in designing and building autonomous AI agents. Masters tool use, memory systems, planning strategies, and multi-agent orchestration.
description_zh: 专注于自主AI智能体设计与构建的专家。精通工具使用、记忆系统、规划策略与多智能体编排。

description: Builds today's call list. Runs lead-triage to rank the top-5 leads most worth calling, supplies talking points from email history, blocks time on the calendar, and drafts follow-up messages. Trigger on "call list," "who am I calling today," "top five to call today," or "block time for calls." An owner who wants leads scored or ranked with no calendar blocks routes to lead-triage directly. Accepts optional count and date arguments.
description_zh: 构建今天的通话列表。执行线索筛选（lead-triage），对最具通话价值的五大线索进行排名，从邮件历史中提取交谈要点，在日历中锁定时间，并起草后续跟进消息。触发关键词为“通话列表”、“今天要拨打谁的电话”、“今日通话 Top 5”或“为通话锁定时间”。若所有者希望进行线索评分与排名，且无需在日历中锁定时间，则直接跳转至线索筛选（lead-triage）流程。支持可选的计数与日期参数。

description: Apply the outcome-to-judgment charter. Use when: the caller explicitly selects RPI; ordinary coding, delegation and native goals do not require this workflow.
description_zh: 应用成果-判定章程。适用场景：调用者显式选择 RPI；常规编码、委派和原生目标无需此工作流程。

description: Salesforce debug log analysis and troubleshooting with 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user analyzes debug logs, hits governor limits, reads stack traces, or touches .log files from Salesforce orgs. DO NOT TRIGGER when: running Apex tests (use sf-testing), fixing Apex code (use sf-apex), or Agentforce session tracing (use sf-ai-agentforce-observability).
description_zh:
带有100分评分的Salesforce调试日志分析与故障排除。

**触发条件：** 用户分析调试日志、触及 governor 限制、读取堆栈跟踪信息，或接触来自 Salesforce 组织的 .log 文件。

**不要触发：** 运行 Apex 测试（使用 sf-testing）、修复 Apex 代码（使用 sf-apex），或进行 Agentforce 会话追踪（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-observability）。

description: Write ML experiment code with iterative improvement. Generate training/evaluation pipelines, debug errors, and optimize results through code reflection. Use when implementing experiments for a research paper.
description_zh: 以迭代改进的方式编写机器学习实验代码。通过代码反思生成训练/评估流水线，调试错误并优化结果。用于研究论文实验的实施。

description: Internal maintenance support for checking and fixing generated Rust skill documentation references. Use only when explicitly invoked by /fix-skill-docs.
description_zh: 用于检查并修复生成的 Rust 技能文档引用的内部维护支持。仅在显式调用 /fix-skill-docs 时使用。

description: Best practices for building Stripe integrations. Use when implementing payment processing, checkout flows, subscriptions, webhooks, Connect platforms, or any Stripe API integration.
description_zh: 构建 Stripe 集成的最佳实践。适用于实现支付处理、结账流程、订阅、Webhooks、Connect 平台，或任何 Stripe API 集成的场景。

description: Operate the local 5dive runtime: coordinate sibling agents and inspect or update shared tasks. Use for delegation, inter-agent messaging and task-queue operations; use `5dive-cli-extras` for runtime administration beyond those.
description_zh: 操作本地 5dive 运行时：协调同级代理，检查或更新共享任务。用于委托、代理间通信和任务队列操作；超出上述功能的运行时管理，请使用 `5dive-cli-extras`。

description: Use when designing visual motion systems, creating animation specifications, or when a designer needs guidance on crafting beautiful, meaningful movement.
description_zh: 适用于设计视觉动效系统、编写动画规范，或当设计师需要指导如何打造优美、富有意义的动态时。

description: Orchestrate the full paper pipeline end-to-end. Manage state propagation between phases (literature → plan → code → experiments → figures → tables → writing → review), support checkpointing and resumption. Use for assembling a complete paper from components.
description_zh: 端到端地统筹整个论文流水线。管理各阶段之间的状态传播（文献 → 计划 → 代码 → 实验 → 图表 → 写作 → 审阅），支持检查点与恢复。用于从组件组装完整论文。

description: Convert an ML research paper into a complete, runnable code repository. 3-stage pipeline from Paper2Code — Planning (UML + dependency graph) → Analysis (per-file logic) → Coding (dependency-ordered generation). Use for reproducing paper methods.
description_zh: 将一篇机器学习研究论文转换为完整、可运行的代码仓库。来自 Paper2Code 的三阶段流水线——规划（UML + 依赖图）→ 分析（逐文件逻辑）→ 编码（按依赖顺序生成）。可用于复现论文方法。

description: Generate videos with Pruna P-Video and WAN models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Video, WAN-T2V, WAN-I2V. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, audio support, 720p/1080p, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna video, p-video, pruna ai video, fast video generation, optimized video, wan t2v, wan i2v, economic video generation, cheap video generation, pruna text to video, pruna image to video
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI，利用 Pruna P-Video 及 WAN 模型生成视频。模型：P-Video、WAN-T2V、WAN-I2V。功能：文生视频、图生视频、音频支持、720p/1080p、快速推理。Pruna 在保持画质的同时，优化模型以提升速度。触发词：pruna video、p-video、pruna ai video、快速视频生成、优化视频、wan t2v、wan i2v、经济型视频生成、低成本视频生成、pruna 文生视频、pruna 图生视频。

description: Internal support skill for actionbook MCP selectors used by Rust documentation research workflows. Use only when another rust-skills workflow explicitly requests actionbook-backed selectors.
description_zh: 用于 Rust 文档研究工作流程的 actionbook MCP 选择器的内部支持技能。仅在另一个 rust-skills 工作流程明确请求 actionbook 支持的选择器时使用。

description: Stripped-back design emphasizing whitespace, clean typography, and restrained color for maximum clarity and focus.
description_zh: 极简设计强调留白、简洁的字体与克制的色彩，以实现最大的清晰度与专注力。

description: Use when handling any auth, API keys, tokens, OAuth, bearer tokens, basic auth, or secret values in n8n workflows. Triggers on "API key", "token", "bearer", "OAuth", "secret", "auth", "credentials", "Authorization header", "x-api-key", or any node configuration that mentions a third-party service.
description_zh: 用于处理 n8n 工作流中的任何认证、API 密钥、令牌、OAuth、Bearer 令牌、基本认证或秘密值时使用。当触发关键词"API key"、"token"、"bearer"、"OAuth"、"secret"、"auth"、"credentials"、"Authorization header"、"x-api-key"，或提及第三方服务的任何节点配置时触发。

description: Synthesize speech from text with Qwen TTS models. TRIGGER when: user wants to convert text to speech, create voiceovers, generate audio narration, read text aloud, build TTS applications, mentions speech synthesis/voice generation/audio output from text, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-audio-tts). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants speech recognition/ASR, text generation without audio, non-Qwen audio tasks.
description_zh: 使用Qwen TTS模型从文本合成语音。触发条件：当用户想要将文本转换为语音，创建配音，生成音频旁白，朗读文本，构建TTS应用，提及语音合成/语音生成/文本音频输出，或明确使用该技能名称（例如使用qwencloud-audio-tts）时。不触发条件：当用户想要语音识别/ASR，不带音频的文本生成，非Qwen音频任务时。

description: Merge the winning agent's branch into base, archive losers, and clean up worktrees. Use when the user runs /hub:merge or asks to land the winning AgentHub result and tidy the session.
description_zh: 将获胜代理的分支合并到基础分支，归档落败者，并清理工作树。适用于用户运行 /hub:merge，或要求将获胜 AgentHub 结果落地并整理会话时。

description: Understand, generate, and edit footage with Diffusion Studio: analyze video/audio/images, generate them with AI, and compose video compositions. Use for any media analysis, media generation, or video editing task.
description_zh: 使用Diffusion Studio理解和生成、编辑素材：分析视频、音频和图像，利用AI进行生成，并完成视频合成。适用于各类媒体分析、媒体生成及视频编辑任务。

description: Use when the user reaches for a Code node, mentions writing JavaScript or Python in n8n, or any custom logic comes up in workflow design. Triggers on "Code node", "Code", "JavaScript", "Python", "custom logic", "transform data", "$input", "$json transformation", "loop in code", "write a function", or any time the obvious answer seems to be "just put it in code."
description_zh: 当用户需要使用 Code节点、在 n8n 中提及编写 JavaScript 或 Python，或在工作流设计中涉及任何自定义逻辑时使用。触发于：“Code节点”、“Code”、“JavaScript”、“Python”、“自定义逻辑”、“数据转换”、“$input”、“$json transformation”、“代码中的循环”、“编写函数”，或任何情况下明显答案为“将其放入代码中”时。

description: /em:hard-call — Framework for decisions with no good options. Use when every option is painful and a structured 10/10/10 + regret-minimization pass is needed — e.g. choosing between a layoff and a down round, or killing a beloved product line.
description_zh: /em:hard-call — 用于没有较好选项的决策框架。当所有选项都痛苦，需要经过结构化 10/10/10 + 遗憾最小化流程时使用——例如：在裁员与下行融资轮之间做取舍，或终止备受喜爱的产品线。

description: Surfaces top and bottom sellers, identifies seasonality patterns, and produces a 2-week content brief to push winners and clear slow movers. Accepts optional lookback window of 30, 60, or 90 days.
description_zh: 呈现表现最佳的卖家与表现最差的卖家，识别季节性模式，并生成一份为期两周的内容简报，以推动表现优秀的卖家，并清退表现滞后的卖家。支持可选的回溯窗口，可选30天、60天或90天。

description: Creates, updates, validates, and displays the architectural DNA of a project through two shared documents: docs/specs/architecture.md (technology stack, architectural rules, security constraints, AI guardrails) and docs/specs/ontology.md (domain glossary / Ubiquitous Language). Use BEFORE brainstorm as a project setup step, or at any point in the SDD lifecycle to validate specs/tasks against architecture principles. Triggers on 'create constitution', 'update constitution', 'constitution check', 'validate against constitution', 'project principles', 'architectural guardrails', 'setup project architecture', 'define ontology'.
description_zh: 通过两个共享文档创建、更新、验证并展示项目的架构DNA：docs/specs/architecture.md（技术栈、架构规则、安全约束、AI护栏）以及 docs/specs/ontology.md（领域词汇表/通用语言）。可作为项目设置步骤使用BEFORE 头脑风暴，或在SDD生命周期的任何阶段用于验证规格/任务是否符合架构原则。触发条件包括“创建宪章”、“更新宪章”、“宪章检查”、“对照宪章验证”、“项目原则”、“架构护栏”、“设置项目架构”和“定义本体”。

description: Raw mechanical interfaces fusing Swiss typographic print with military terminal aesthetics. Rigid grids, extreme type scale contrast, utilitarian color, analog degradation effects. For data-heavy dashboards, portfolios, or editorial sites that need to feel like declassified blueprints.
description_zh: 原始机械接口，融合瑞士排版印刷风格与军事终端美学。刚性网格、极致字体比例对比、实用主义色彩、模拟退化效果。适用于数据密集型仪表盘、作品集或编辑类网站，需呈现出解密蓝图般的质感。

description: Salesforce DevOps automation using sf CLI v2. TRIGGER when: user deploys metadata, creates/manages scratch orgs or sandboxes, sets up CI/CD pipelines, or troubleshoots deployment errors with sf project deploy. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex/LWC code (use sf-apex/sf-lwc), creating metadata XML (use sf-metadata), or querying org data (use sf-data).
description_zh:
基于 sf CLI v2 的 Salesforce DevOps 自动化

触发条件：当用户部署元数据、创建/管理临时环境（scratch orgs）或沙箱、搭建 CI/CD 流水线，或使用 sf project deploy 排查部署错误时。

禁止触发：当编写 Apex/LWC 代码（使用 sf-apex/sf-lwc）、创建元数据 XML（使用 sf-metadata），或查询组织数据（使用 sf-data）。

description: Evaluate and rank agent results by metric or LLM judge for an AgentHub session. Use when the user runs /hub:eval or asks to score, compare, or pick a winner among completed AgentHub agents.
description_zh: 针对 AgentHub 会话，通过指标或 LLM 评判对智能体结果进行评估和排序。在用户运行 /hub:eval 命令或要求对已完成的 AgentHub 智能体进行评分、比较或挑选获胜者时使用。

description: TypeGPU is type-safe WebGPU in TypeScript. Use whenever the user writes, debugs, or designs TypeGPU code: 'use gpu' shader functions, tgpu.fn, buffers, textures, bind groups, compute and render pipelines, command encoders, render passes, render bundles, vertex layouts, slots, accessors, @typegpu/react hooks (useRoot, useFrame, useUniform), React Native worklet rendering, and any TypeGPU API. Shader logic and CPU-side resources are tightly coupled - handle both sides here even if the user only mentions one (e.g. "how do I write a shader", "how do I create a buffer"). Trigger on any mention of typegpu, tgpu, "use gpu", TypedGPU, or WebGPU code written using TypeGPU's schema API (d.*, tgpu.*, std.*). Do NOT trigger for raw WebGPU (using GPUDevice/GPURenderPipeline directly without tgpu), WGSL-only questions, Three.js, Babylon.js, or WebGL.
description_zh:
TypeGPU 是 TypeScript 中的类型安全 WebGPU。当用户编写、调试或设计 TypeGPU 代码时，使用：'use gpu' shader 函数、tgpu.fn、缓冲区、纹理、绑定组、计算和渲染管线、命令编码器、渲染通道、渲染组、顶点布局、插槽、访问器、@typegpu/react hooks（useRoot、useFrame、useUniform）、React Native worklet 渲染，以及任何 TypeGPU API。

着色器逻辑与 CPU 端资源紧密耦合——即使用户只提及其中一方面，也需在此同时处理两端（例如：“我如何编写着色器”、“我如何创建缓冲区”）。

当任何地方提及 typegpu、tgpu、'use gpu'、TypedGPU，或基于 TypeGPU 的 schema API（d.*、tgpu.*、std.*）编写的 WebGPU 代码时触发。不对原始 WebGPU（直接使用 GPUDevice/GPURenderPipeline 且未使用 tgpu）、仅 WGSL 相关的问题、Three.js、Babylon.js 或 WebGL 触发。

description:
Research high-performing Instagram content (posts and reels) from tracked accounts using Apify's Instagram Scraper.
