Identifies outlier content, analyzes top 5 videos with AI, and generates reports with actionable hook formulas.

Use when asked to:
- Find trending Instagram content in a niche
- Research what's performing on Instagram
- Identify high-performing reel patterns
- Analyze competitors' Instagram content
- Generate content ideas from Instagram trends
- Run Instagram research
- Find viral reels
- Analyze hooks and content structure

Triggers: "instagram research", "ig research", "find trending reels", "analyze instagram accounts",
"what's working on instagram", "content research instagram", "reel analysis", "instagram trends"
description_zh:
使用 Apify 的 Instagram 抓取工具，研究追踪账号的高表现内容（帖子与短视频）。
通过 AI 识别异常内容，分析前 5 个热门视频，并生成包含可操作钩子公式的报告。

适用场景：
- 在特定垂直领域内寻找热门 Instagram 内容
- 研究 Instagram 平台上的内容表现
- 识别高表现短视频模式
- 分析竞争对手的 Instagram 内容
- 从 Instagram 趋势中生成内容创意
- 开展 Instagram 研究
- 寻找病毒式传播短视频
- 分析钩子与内容结构

触发词："instagram research", "ig research", "find trending reels", "analyze instagram accounts", "what's working on instagram", "content research instagram", "reel analysis", "instagram trends"

description: Agent skill for arch-system-design - invoke with $agent-arch-system-design
description_zh: 智能体技能用于架构系统设计 - 通过 $agent-arch-system-design 调用

description: Create or edit the Universal Editor component configuration (component-definition.json, component-models.json, component-filters.json) for AEM Edge Delivery Services blocks. Use this skill whenever the user mentions component models, component definitions, component filters, block configuration for the Universal Editor, UE block setup, adding a new block to UE, configuring block properties, block authoring fields, or any task involving the three JSON config files that control how blocks appear in the Universal Editor. Also trigger when the user wants to create a new EDS/Franklin block with UE support, modify block fields, add a block to the section filter, or asks about how blocks connect to the Universal Editor.
description_zh: 为 AEM Edge Delivery Services 区块创建或编辑 Universal Editor 组件配置（component-definition.json、component-models.json、component-filters.json）。当用户提及组件模型、组件定义、组件过滤器、Universal Editor 区块配置、UE 区块设置、向 UE 添加新区块、配置区块属性、区块编写字段，或任何涉及控制区块在 Universal Editor 中显示方式的三个 JSON 配置文件的任务时，请使用此技能。当用户需要创建带有 UE 支持的 EDS/Franklin 区块、修改区块字段、将区块添加到区块分区过滤器，或询问区块如何与 Universal Editor 连接时，也请触发。

description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
description_zh: 打造独具特色、生产级且设计精良的前端界面。当用户要求构建网页组件、页面或应用程序时，请使用此技能。生成富有创意、精致流畅的代码，避免千篇一律的AI风格。

description: Runs the owner's Monday morning briefing as a two-link chain — business-pulse for the cross-connector snapshot of cash, sales, and pipeline, and report-builder for any saved KPI reports the owner has already defined — then reads the week ahead straight from Calendar and mail and merges all three parts into a single one-page Monday document, delivered per the owner's stored output preference. Requires no connectors and degrades gracefully, building from whatever of the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), Calendar, DocuSign, Expensify, Gmail or M365, HubSpot, PayPal, Ramp, RingEx Chat, Shopify, Slack, Stripe, and TikTok Ads is connected, or from pasted and uploaded data when none are. Trigger on "Monday brief," "start my week," "what do I need to know this week," "weekly briefing," "catch me up before Monday," or when the owner schedules a recurring start-of-week update.
description_zh: 以双链路方式运行所有者的周一晨会简报—business-pulse 部分用于提供现金、销售和管道的跨连接器快照，report-builder 部分用于构建所有者已定义的任一已保存的 KPI 报告—随后，直接从 Calendar 和邮件中读取下周内容，并将三部分内容合并成一份单页周一文档，按照所有者的存储输出偏好进行交付。无需连接器，且能优雅降级，可根据所连接的数据源（包括账本如 MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books，以及 Calendar、DocuSign、Expensify、Gmail 或 M365、HubSpot、PayPal、Ramp、RingEx Chat、Shopify、Slack、Stripe 和 TikTok Ads）构建，若无已连接的数据源，则使用粘贴和上传的数据。触发条件包括：“周一简报”、“开始我这一周”、“这周我需要知道什么”、“每周简报”、“周一前更新我”，或当所有者安排周期性每周起始更新时。

description: Common patterns for building store locators, restaurant finders, and location-based search applications with Mapbox. Covers marker display, filtering, distance calculation, and interactive lists.
description_zh: 使用 Mapbox 构建店铺定位器、餐厅查找器和基于位置的搜索应用的常见模式。涵盖标记显示、筛选、距离计算与交互式列表。

description: Creates a new AEM Edge Delivery site from scratch — GitHub repo from the boilerplate, aem-code-sync installation, initial DA content (nav, footer, homepage), and a live preview URL. Use this skill whenever a user wants to create a new AEM Edge Delivery site and no repository or DA content exists yet.
description_zh: 从零开始创建一个新的 AEM Edge Delivery 站点——包括基于 boilerplate（模板）创建的 GitHub 仓库、aem-code-sync 安装、初始 DA 内容（导航、页脚、主页）以及实时预览 URL。当用户需要创建新的 AEM Edge Delivery 站点，且尚不存在仓库或 DA 内容时，请使用此技能。

description: Reads a forwarded customer email or ticket, pulls order and refund status from a payments connector (PayPal, Square, or Stripe) or Shopify, account history from the CRM, and open tickets from a support desk (Zoho Desk), drafts a tone-matched reply in the owner's writing voice, and can issue a refund through the payments connector with explicit owner approval. With Shopify connected it also runs a proactive order-triage mode that surfaces orders needing attention — unfulfilled past the promised window, payment problems, pending refunds, stuck shipments — and drafts the next action for each before the customer has to ask. Use when the user says "draft a response," "answer this customer," "where's my order," "I want a refund," "check my orders," or "anything about to blow up."
description_zh: 读取转发的客户邮件或工单，从支付连接工具（PayPal、Square 或 Stripe）或 Shopify 获取订单与退款状态，从 CRM 获取账户历史，并从支持台（Zoho Desk）获取未解决工单，根据语气匹配，以负责人的写作风格草拟回复，并可在获得负责人明确批准后，通过支付连接工具发起退款。若已连接 Shopify，则运行主动订单分诊模式，突出显示需要关注的订单——包括逾期未履行的订单、支付问题、待处理退款及运输受阻的订单——并在客户提出请求前，为每笔订单草拟下一步行动。当用户说“草拟回复”、“答复此客户”、“我的订单在哪里”、“我要退款”、“检查我的订单”或“有任何即将出问题的情况”时使用。

description: Choosing an MSBuild CopyToOutputDirectory / CopyToPublishDirectory mode: Never, PreserveNewest, Always, and IfDifferent (MSBuild 17.13+), plus $(SkipUnchangedFilesOnCopyAlways). USE FOR: removing the per-build Always copy perf hit; resetting output files mutated between builds. DO NOT USE FOR: general incremental-build diagnosis (use incremental-build); non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 为 MSBuild 的 CopyToOutputDirectory / CopyToPublishDirectory 属性选择模式：Never、PreserveNewest、Always、IfDifferent（MSBuild 17.13+），以及 $(SkipUnchangedFilesOnCopyAlways)。用途：消除每次构建的 Always 复制性能开销；重置构建之间发生变更的输出文件。请勿用于：一般增量构建诊断（使用 incremental-build）；非 MSBuild 构建系统。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks about libraries, frameworks, API references, or needs code examples. Activates for setup questions, code generation involving libraries, or mentions of specific frameworks like React, Vue, Next.js, Prisma, Supabase, etc.
description_zh: 当用户询问库、框架、API 参考，或需要代码示例时，应使用此技能。适用于设置相关咨询、涉及库的代码生成，或提及 React、Vue、Next.js、Prisma、Supabase 等特定框架的场景。

description: Write or review PostgreSQL schemas, queries, migrations, and Drizzle ORM code. Use for Postgres/Drizzle relations, indexing, pooling, or query performance; not for unrelated databases or generic backend work.
description_zh: 编写或审查 PostgreSQL 模式、查询、迁移和 Drizzle ORM 代码。用于 Postgres/Drizzle 关系、索引、连接池或查询性能；不适用于无关数据库或通用后端工作。

description: Entrypoint for all Fusion skill lifecycle operations. USE FOR: finding, installing, updating, syncing, or greenkeeping skills; setting up skill automation; creating or authoring a new skill; reporting a bug with a skill. DO NOT USE FOR: resolving GitHub issues, reviewing PRs, planning task breakdowns, or authoring GitHub issues — those are handled by other Fusion skills.
description_zh: 所有 Fusion 技能生命周期操作的入口点。用途：查找、安装、更新、同步或维护技能；设置技能自动化；创建或编写新技能；报告技能相关的 Bug。不得用于：解决 GitHub 问题、审查 PR、规划任务分解或编写 GitHub 问题——这些由其他 Fusion 技能处理。

description: Author Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring checks, with deep coverage of k6 scripted and browser checks: SM's single-VU/single-iteration execution model, assertions that actually fail probe_success (expect() and fail() vs bare check()), secrets, deterministic scripts, robust browser locators, local validation with k6 run, deployment via UI/API/Terraform, verifying probe_success, and rollback. Also helps choose the simplest sufficient check type (HTTP/ping/DNS/TCP, MultiHTTP, scripted, browser). Use when writing a synthetic check, monitoring a login/checkout/signup flow in production, converting a k6 script or an OpenAPI spec into a check, authoring a browser check, validating a user journey, or asking "is my site up from multiple regions". NOT for load, stress, or performance testing — SM runs one iteration per execution; for load tests use the grafana-k6 plugin or Grafana Cloud k6. For the broad Grafana Cloud Testing overview (SM + k6 Cloud + Faro), use the testing skill.
description_zh: Grafana Cloud 合成监控检查，对 k6 脚本和浏览器检查具备深度覆盖：SM 的单一虚拟用户/单次迭代执行模型，能够真正导致 probe_success 失败的断言（expect() 和 fail() 与裸 check() 的区别）、密钥管理、确定性脚本、稳健的浏览器定位器、使用 k6 run 进行本地验证、通过 UI/API/Terraform 进行部署、验证 probe_success 并支持回滚。同时帮助选择最简洁且足够满足需求的检查类型（HTTP/ping/DNS/TCP、MultiHTTP、脚本检查、浏览器检查）。在编写合成检查、生产环境监控登录/结账/注册流程、将 k6 脚本或 OpenAPI 规范转换为检查、编写浏览器检查、验证用户旅程，或询问“从多个区域我的网站是否正常”时使用。不适用于负载、压力或性能测试——SM 每次执行仅运行一次迭代；负载测试请使用 grafana-k6 插件或 Grafana Cloud k6。对于涵盖 Grafana Cloud 测试概览（SM + k6 Cloud + Faro）的全面内容，请使用 testing 技能。

description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or structure Terms of Service page. Also use when the user mentions "terms of service," "terms and conditions," "terms of use," "user agreement," "ToS," "legal terms," "service agreement," or "terms page." For legal overview page, use legal-page-generator.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建、优化或构建服务条款（Terms of Service）页面时，使用。当用户提及“服务条款”、“服务条款与条件”、“使用条款”、“用户协议”、“ToS”、“法律条款”、“服务协议”或“条款页面”时，也使用。对于法律概览页面，使用 legal-page-generator。

description: Guided journey from a website with traffic it under-converts to a research-driven growth engine that captures more leads, persuades more buyers, sells a sharper offer, and earns referrals. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - cro-methodology, scorecard-marketing, storybrand-messaging, made-to-stick, influence-psychology, hundred-million-offers, contagious, one-page-marketing - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (WEBSITE.md, OFFER.md, MARKETING.md, GROW-WEBSITE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to raise conversion on a site that already has traffic, capture more leads, sharpen a weak offer, add referral loops, or says 'my site gets visitors but nobody buys'. If a broken funnel or usability friction is the real blocker, run improve-website first; if there is no site yet, use create-website; for one leaking flow, conversion-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从流量转化不足的网站，引导至研究驱动的增长引擎——能够吸引更多潜在客户、说服更多买家、销售更精准的报价，并赚取推荐。按阶段编排八项技能：cro-methodology、scorecard-marketing、storybrand-messaging、made-to-stick、influence-psychology、hundred-million-offers、contagious、one-page-marketing。在每个决策点向用户提问，并在项目文档/文件夹（WEBSITE.md、OFFER.md、MARKETING.md、GROW-WEBSITE-PLAN.md）中记录结果，以便旅程可在多次会话中续接。当用户希望提升已有流量的网站的转化率、获取更多潜在客户、优化薄弱报价、增加推荐循环，或表示“我的网站有访客但无人购买”时使用。如果真正的阻碍是漏斗损坏或可用性摩擦，优先运行 improve-website；如果没有网站，使用 create-website；针对单一流失的流程，使用 conversion-optimization。若仅针对单一框架单独使用，则直接调用该技能。

description: Claude as the trainer. Walks an SMB owner through connecting their first two tools, runs one recipe to prove immediate value, interviews them about their business (industry, size, top three headaches), stores that context persistently so every other skill benefits, and sets a weekly check-in cadence. Use when the owner is getting started or says any of: "set me up," "setup," "help me get set up," "get started," "help me get started," "get me started," "what can you do," "I'm new to this," or is in their first session.
description_zh:
Claude 作为训练师。它引导 SMB 企业主连接前两个工具，演示一个操作流程以证明即时价值，与其就业务（行业、规模、三大痛点）进行访谈，持久保存该上下文以便其他技能均能受益，并设定每周跟进节奏。

使用场景：当企业主刚开始起步、说出以下任何内容，或处于首次会话时：“帮我设置”、“设置”、“帮我完成设置”、“开始使用”、“帮我开始使用”、“让我开始使用”、“你能做什么”、“我是新手”。

description: When the user wants to track follower growth, understand what drives new followers, or analyze audience development. Also use when the user mentions 'follower growth,' 'followers,' 'audience growth,' 'gaining followers,' 'losing followers,' 'who follows me,' or 'grow my audience.' Uses BlackTwist follower data when available. For post-level metrics, see performance-analyzer-sms. For content patterns, see content-pattern-analyzer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要跟踪粉丝增长、了解驱动新粉丝的因素，或分析受众发展时，也应使用。当用户提到“粉丝增长”、“粉丝”、“受众增长”、“获得粉丝”、“失去粉丝”、“谁关注我”或“增长我的受众”时，也应使用。在数据可用时，使用 BlackTwist 粉丝数据。关于帖子级别的指标，参见 performance-analyzer-sms。关于内容模式，参见 content-pattern-analyzer-sms。

description: Draft and review professional emails that match your personal writing style. Analyzes your sent emails for tone, greeting, structure, and sign-off patterns via WorkIQ, then generates context-aware drafts for any recipient. USE FOR: draft email, write email, compose email, reply email, follow-up email, analyze email tone, email style.
description_zh: 起草并审阅符合您个人写作风格的专业邮件。通过 WorkIQ 分析您发送的邮件的语调、问候、结构与结尾模式，随后为任何收件人生成上下文感知的草稿。用途：起草邮件、撰写邮件、编写邮件、回复邮件、跟进邮件、分析邮件语气、邮件风格。

description: Generates a full QBR narrative — revenue trend, margin trend, customer health, top opportunities and risks — as a presentation-ready PDF or deck. Accepts optional quarter and save-to arguments.
description_zh: 生成完整的快速业务回顾（QBR）叙述——营收趋势、利润率趋势、客户健康度、主要机会及风险——并输出为适用于演示的PDF或幻灯片。接受可选的季度和保存目标参数。

description: Simplicity-focused design with ample whitespace, legible typography, and a limited color palette to reduce visual clutter.
description_zh: 以简洁为导向的设计，通过充足的留白、清晰易读的字体以及有限的色彩搭配，减少视觉杂乱感。

description: Expo React Native performance optimization guidelines. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Expo React Native code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React Native components, lists, animations, images, or performance improvements.
description_zh: Expo React Native 性能优化指南。本技能应在编写、审查或重构 Expo React Native 代码以确保最优性能模式时使用。适用于涉及 React Native 组件、列表、动画、图片或性能优化的任务。

description: Tailwind CSS v4 principles. CSS-first configuration, container queries, modern patterns, design token architecture.
description_zh: Tailwind CSS v4 原则。CSS 优先配置，容器查询，现代模式，设计令牌架构。

description: When the user wants to design, launch, or optimize an in-app referral / invite / share-to-earn program — including reward structure, mechanics, fraud prevention, deep link setup, and viral coefficient measurement. Use when the user mentions "referral program", "invite a friend", "refer and earn", "share to earn", "viral loop", "viral coefficient", "K-factor", "double-sided rewards", "give X get X", "referral rewards", "invite link", "share sheet", "Branch referrals", "in-app invites", or "how to make my app go viral". For deep link infrastructure that referrals depend on, see attribution-setup. For organic content-driven virality (UGC, creator), see creator-ugc-marketing.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、启动或优化应用内推荐/邀请/分享赚收益计划时——包括奖励结构、机制、防欺诈、深度链接配置以及病毒系数测量。当用户提及"推荐计划"、"邀请好友"、"推荐赚钱"、"分享赚收益"、"病毒式传播循环"、"病毒系数"、"K因子"、"双向奖励"、"赠X得X"、"推荐奖励"、"邀请链接"、"分享面板"、"Branch推荐"、"应用内邀请"或"如何让我的应用病毒式传播"时使用。对于推荐所依赖的深度链接基础设施，请参阅"归因设置"（attribution-setup）。对于由有机内容驱动的病毒式传播（UGC、创作者），请参阅"创作者UGC营销"（creator-ugc-marketing）。

description: OpenAI's general-purpose speech recognition model. Supports 99 languages, transcription, translation to English, and language identification. Six model sizes from tiny (39M params) to large (1550M params). Use for speech-to-text, podcast transcription, or multilingual audio processing. Best for robust, multilingual ASR.
description_zh: OpenAI 通用语音识别模型。支持 99 种语言、转写、翻译成英语及语言识别。提供六种模型尺寸，从 tiny（39M 参数）到 large（1550M 参数）。适用于语音转写、播客转写或多语言音频处理。最适合稳健、多语言的 ASR。

description: Match external CSV/JSONL records to CRM contacts (by email) or companies (by domain) and write enriched data back in one pass using `hubspot objects upsert`.
description_zh: 将外部CSV/JSONL记录匹配至CRM联系人（按邮箱）或公司（按域名），并使用`hubspot objects upsert`一次性回写增强后的数据。

description: Run the full deal lifecycle from CLI — discover pipelines/stages, qualify MQLs into deals with associations, advance/reassign in bulk, hunt stalled deals, and close.
description_zh: 从 CLI 运行完整的交易生命周期 — 发现流水线/阶段，将 MQLs 判定为交易并设置关联关系，批量推进/重新分配，查找停滞的交易，并关闭。

description: Discover scientific equations from data using LLM-guided evolutionary search (LLM-SR). Multi-island algorithm with softmax-based cluster sampling, island reset, and LLM-proposed equation mutations. Use for symbolic regression and equation discovery.
description_zh: 利用LLM引导的进化搜索（LLM-SR）从数据中发现科学方程。采用基于softmax的聚类采样、岛重置以及LLM提出的方程突变的多岛算法。适用于符号回归与方程发现。

description: Work with the @upstash/qstash TypeScript/JavaScript SDK, an HTTP-based message queue, task scheduler, and background job system for serverless and edge runtimes (Next.js, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Node.js). Use when publishing messages to HTTP endpoints or URL groups, running background jobs without a long-running worker process, scheduling with cron expressions, delaying messages, building FIFO queues with parallelism and flow control, configuring retries and callbacks, handling a dead letter queue (DLQ), deduplicating messages, fanning out to multiple endpoints, verifying QStash webhook signatures (Next.js App Router, Pages Router, and Edge Runtime), running a local QStash dev server, or migrating regions. Also use when the user asks for a serverless cron job, async task queue, job scheduler, delayed delivery, webhook delivery with retries, or event-driven messaging between services.
description_zh: 与 @upstash/qstash TypeScript/JavaScript SDK 协作，这是一个基于 HTTP 的消息队列、任务调度器及后台任务系统，适用于无服务器和边缘运行时环境（Next.js、Vercel、Cloudflare Workers、Deno、Node.js）。当需要向 HTTP 端点或 URL 分组发布消息、无需长时间运行的 worker 进程即可运行后台任务、使用 cron 表达式进行调度、延迟消息、构建具有并发与流量控制的 FIFO 队列、配置重试与回调、处理死信队列（DLQ）、消息去重、向多个端点分发、验证 QStash Webhook 签名（Next.js 应用路由、页面路由和边缘运行时）、运行本地 QStash 开发服务器或迁移区域时，均适用。当用户请求无服务器 cron 任务、异步任务队列、任务调度器、延迟投递、带重试的 Webhook 投递，或服务间的事件驱动消息传递时，也请使用。

description: Retrieve activity history (calls, emails, notes, meetings, tasks) for a CRM record and assemble pre-call briefs.
description_zh: 获取某条CRM记录的活动历史（通话、邮件、笔记、会议、任务），并整理会前简报。

description: Daily briefings, pipeline snapshots, and win/loss analysis from the terminal — closing-this-week, open pipeline by stage/owner, and closed-won vs closed-lost over a period.
description_zh: 来自终端的每日简报、商机管道快照与赢/输单分析——本周即将关闭的商机管道、按阶段/负责人划分的开放商机管道，以及某段时期内已赢单与已输单的对比。

description: 中国国家统计局公开数据查询技能，当用户想查询经济、CPI、GDP、人口、房价指数等数据时触发。
description_zh: 中国国家统计局公开数据查询技能，当用户想查询经济、CPI、GDP、人口、房价指数等数据时触发。

description: Create or update the feature specification from a natural language feature description.
description_zh: 根据自然语言功能描述创建或更新功能规格说明。

description: Discover, create, update, and delete custom CRM object schemas. Use when defining a new object type, inspecting existing schemas, or removing one. Record CRUD on custom objects is identical to standard objects — see `bulk-operations`.
description_zh: 发现、创建、更新和删除自定义CRM对象架构。用于定义新的对象类型、检查现有架构或删除其中一项。记录自定义对象的CRUD操作与标准对象相同——参见 `bulk-operations`。

description: Route a vague Prisma Next prompt to the right specific skill. Use for "help me with Prisma Next", "what is Prisma Next", "explain Prisma Next", "I'm new to PN", "where do I start", "what can I do with Prisma Next", "what can I do next with Prisma", "just ran createprisma", "tour of Prisma Next", "Prisma Next overview", and comparison questions like "Prisma Next vs Prisma 7", "PN vs Drizzle", "PN vs Kysely", "PN vs TypeORM". Do NOT use when the prompt clearly matches a workflow skill — adoption / quickstart / first-touch orientation / brownfield introspection, schema / contract editing, migration authoring (db update / migration plan / migrate), migration review on deploy / concurrent migrations, queries / db.orm / db.sql / TypedSQL, Supabase / RLS / role binding, runtime / db.ts / middleware wiring, build / Vite plugin / Next.js plugin, debug / structured error envelopes / PN-* error codes, or feedback / bug report / feature request — load that sibling skill directly.
description_zh: 将模糊的Prisma Next提示词路由到正确的特定技能。用于"帮助我解决Prisma Next问题"、"Prisma Next是什么"、"解释Prisma Next"、"我是Prisma Next的新用户"、"我该如何开始"、"我可以用Prisma Next做什么"、"之后我可以用Prisma做什么"、"刚运行了createprisma"、"Prisma Next导览"、"Prisma Next概览"，以及类似"Prisma Next vs Prisma 7"、"PN vs Drizzle"、"PN vs Kysely"、"PN vs TypeORM"的比较问题。当提示词明确匹配工作流技能时，切勿使用——即采用/快速开始/首次接触引导/存量环境检查、模式/契约编辑、迁移编写（db update / migration plan / migrate）、部署时的迁移评审/并发迁移、查询/db.orm/db.sql/TypedSQL、Supabase/RLS/角色绑定、运行时/db.ts/中间件配置、构建/Vite插件/Next.js插件、调试/结构化错误封装/PN-*错误码，或反馈/ bug报告/功能请求——请直接加载该同级技能。

description: Guided journey from a business with lucky months to a repeatable growth engine that produces a forecast. Orchestrates nine skills phase by phase - one-page-marketing, hundred-million-offers, predictable-revenue, contagious, influence-psychology, crossing-the-chasm, cold-start-problem, lean-analytics, negotiation - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (MARKETING.md, OFFER.md, METRICS.md, GROW-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to build a marketing and sales system, manufacture predictable pipeline, engineer word-of-mouth and referrals, or says 'revenue is real but lumpy and I need growth that repeats'. If the offer, retention, or operations underneath are broken, run improve-business first; with no paying customers yet, start with create-business; when the product itself must carry the growth loops, use grow-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从月份走运的业务，引导至能够产出预测的可重复增长引擎的旅程。逐步编排九项技能——one-page-marketing、hundred-million-offers、predictable-revenue、contagious、influence-psychology、crossing-the-chasm、cold-start-problem、lean-analytics、negotiation——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目 docs/ 文件夹中（MARKETING.md、OFFER.md、METRICS.md、GROW-BUSINESS-PLAN.md），以便旅程能在会话之间继续。当用户希望构建营销和销售系统、制造可预测的 pipeline、打造口碑与转介绍，或说出“收入是真实的，但波动大，我需要能够重复的增长”时，使用此技能。如果底层的报价、留存或运营出现问题，优先运行 improve-business；如果尚未有付费客户，则先启动 create-business；当产品本身必须承载增长循环时，使用 grow-app。若单独使用一个框架，直接调用该技能即可。

description: Guides the agent through installing, configuring, and using Capacitor plugins from six sources — official Capacitor plugins, Capawesome plugins, Capacitor Community plugins, Capacitor Firebase plugins, Capacitor MLKit plugins, and RevenueCat plugins. Covers installation, platform-specific configuration (Android and iOS), and basic usage examples. Do not use for migrating Capacitor apps or plugins to a newer version, setting up Capacitor Live Updates, or non-Capacitor mobile frameworks.
description_zh: 引导该代理通过六个来源进行安装、配置和使用——包括官方 Capacitor 插件、Capawesome 插件、Capacitor 社区插件、Capacitor Firebase 插件、Capacitor MLKit 插件和 RevenueCat 插件。内容涵盖安装、特定平台配置（Android 和 iOS）以及基础使用示例。该内容不适用于将 Capacitor 应用或插件迁移至新版本、配置 Capacitor 实时更新，或用于非 Capacitor 移动框架。

description: Typst paper assistant for existing .typ manuscripts in English or Chinese. Use for compile/export diagnosis, venue formatting, BibTeX/Hayagriva checks, grammar, logic, abstract/title, tables, pseudocode, related work, research-gap framing, adaptation, de-AI polish, translation, and submission readiness; use LaTeX skills for .tex.
description_zh: Typst论文助手，适用于现有的英文或中文 .typ 手稿。可用于编译与导出诊断、期刊格式排版、BibTeX/Hayagriva 检查、语法与逻辑检查、摘要与标题校对、表格、伪代码、相关工作、研究空白框架设定、适配调整、去AI润色、翻译以及投稿准备；处理 .tex 文件时请使用 LaTeX 技能。

description: Agent skill for workflow - invoke with $agent-workflow
description_zh: 工作流 Agent 技能 - 使用 $agent-workflow 调用

description:
MrBeast（Jimmy Donaldson）的内容创造操作系统。基于泄露的36页内部培训手册、
6个深度播客、决策记录和外部批评的深度调研，提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、
完整的标题/缩略图/Hook/节奏公式，和4个可运行的内容分析脚本。
激活后沉浸式扮演MrBeast，直接以「我」的视角给出内容创作建议。
当用户提到「用MrBeast的视角」「MrBeast会怎么做」「Beast模式」「mrbeast perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「视频CTR怎么提升」「标题不够吸引人」「retention曲线怎么优化」「缩略图要改吗」也应触发。
不要在用户只是说「内容创作建议」「怎么做内容」等一般性问题时触发——只在涉及视频优化、标题/缩略图/Hook/留存率等YouTube方法论时激活。
description_zh:
MrBeast（Jimmy Donaldson）内容创作操作系统。基于泄露的36页内部培训手册、
6个深度播客、决策记录和外部批评的深度调研，提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、
完整的标题/缩略图/Hook/节奏公式，和4个可运行的内容分析脚本。

激活后，沉浸式扮演MrBeast，直接以「我」的视角给出内容创作建议。

当用户提及「用MrBeast的视角」「MrBeast会怎么做」「Beast模式」「mrbeast perspective」时使用。

即使用户只是说「视频CTR怎么提升」「标题不够吸引人」「留存曲线怎么优化」「缩略图要改吗」，也应触发。

不要在用户只是说「内容创作建议」「怎么做内容」等一般性问题时触发——仅在涉及视频优化、标题/缩略图/Hook/留存率等YouTube方法论时激活。

description: Keeps HubSpot current without the owner opening it: creates and updates contacts and deals from email and calendar context, logs notes and calls, and flags stale records. The "stop doing data entry" skill. Use when the user asks to update the CRM, log a call, clean up HubSpot, or add context to a deal.
description_zh: 无需所有者打开即可保持 HubSpot 实时更新：根据邮件和日历上下文创建并更新联系人及商机，记录笔记与通话，并标记过时记录。这是“停止录入数据”技能。当用户要求更新 CRM、记录通话、整理 HubSpot 或为商机添加上下文时使用。

description: Implement accepted behavior, repair defects or execute a selected wave with per-lane evidence. Use when: coding is authorized and ready; return facts, not a binding verdict.
description_zh: 实施已接受的行为，修复缺陷，或执行所选轮次并附带逐车道证据。使用条件：编码已授权且就绪；返回事实，而非有约束力的结论。

description: Guided journey from a raw app idea to a validated, cleanly architected first version that ships on a sustainable cadence. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - lean-startup, design-sprint, clean-architecture, domain-driven-design, clean-code, pragmatic-programmer, system-design, ios-hig-design, 37signals-way, software-design-philosophy - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (PRODUCT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, EXPERIMENTS.md, CREATE-APP-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to build a new app, validate an idea before writing code, architect an MVP that will not need a rewrite, or says 'help me build my app the right way'. App already exists: use improve-app or grow-app. Business idea not yet validated: run create-business first. Marketing site only: use create-website. Architecture-only question: design-code-architecture. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从原始应用想法到经过验证、架构清晰并可持续发布的首个版本的引导式旅程。分阶段协调十个技能——lean-startup、design-sprint、clean-architecture、domain-driven-design、clean-code、pragmatic-programmer、system-design、ios-hig-design、37signals-way、software-design-philosophy——在每个决策点询问用户问题，并在项目 docs/ 文件夹（PRODUCT.md、ARCHITECTURE.md、EXPERIMENTS.md、CREATE-APP-PLAN.md）中记录结果，以便跨会话延续旅程。适用于用户想要构建新应用、在编写代码前验证想法、架构一个无需重写的 MVP，或用户说“help me build my app the right way”的情况。应用已存在：使用 improve-app 或 grow-app。业务想法尚未验证：先运行 create-business。仅营销网站：使用 create-website。仅架构问题：design-code-architecture。对于单独使用某个框架，直接调用该技能。

description: Create wireframes and interactive prototypes to visualize user interfaces and gather feedback early. Use tools and techniques to communicate design ideas before development.
description_zh: 创建线框图和交互原型，以可视化用户界面并尽早收集反馈。借助工具和技巧，在开发前沟通设计想法。

description: Image renderer for json-render that turns JSON specs into SVG and PNG images via Satori. Use when working with @json-render/image, generating OG images from JSON, creating social cards, or rendering AI-generated image specs.
description_zh: 用于 json-render 的图像渲染器，通过 Satori 将 JSON 规格转换为 SVG 和 PNG 图像。适用于与 @json-render/image 配合使用、从 JSON 生成 OG 图像、创建社交媒体卡片，或渲染 AI 生成的图像规格的场景。

description: Permission Set analysis, hierarchy viewer, and access auditing. TRIGGER when: user asks "who has access to X?", analyzes permission sets/groups, or touches .permissionset-meta.xml / .permissionsetgroup-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating new metadata (use sf-metadata), deploying permission sets (use sf-deploy), or Apex sharing logic (use sf-apex).
description_zh:
权限集分析、层级查看器和访问审计。

触发条件：当用户询问“谁有权访问 X？”、分析权限集/组，或访问 .permissionset-meta.xml / .permissionsetgroup-meta.xml 文件时。

不触发条件：创建新元数据（使用 sf-metadata）、部署权限集（使用 sf-deploy），或 Apex 共享逻辑（使用 sf-apex）。

description: Apex test execution, coverage analysis, and test-fix loops with 120-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user runs Apex tests, checks code coverage, fixes failing tests, or touches *Test.cls / *_Test.cls files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex production code (use sf-apex), Agentforce agent testing (use sf-ai-agentforce-testing), or Jest/LWC tests (use sf-lwc).
description_zh:
120分评分的 Apex 测试执行、覆盖率分析与测试修复循环。

**触发条件：** 当用户运行 Apex 测试、检查代码覆盖率、修复失败测试，或修改 *Test.cls / *_Test.cls 文件时触发。

**不触发条件：** 编写 Apex 生产代码（使用 sf-apex）、进行 Agentforce 智能体测试（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-testing）或执行 Jest/LWC 测试（使用 sf-lwc）时不触发。

description: Generate and edit images using Wan and Qwen Image models. Supports text-to-image, image editing (style transfer, subject consistency, text rendering), and interleaved text-image output. TRIGGER when: user wants to create illustrations, product images, artistic designs, posters, text-to-image generation, edit/transform existing images, apply style transfer, generate images based on reference photos, interleaved text-image content, mentions Wan/Qwen Image models/AI art creation, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-image-generation). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to understand/analyze existing images or OCR (use qwencloud-vision), video generation (use qwencloud-video-generation), text-only tasks.
description_zh:
使用万（Wan）和通义千问图像（Qwen Image）模型生成并编辑图像。支持文生图、图像编辑（风格迁移、主体一致性、文字渲染）以及交错图文输出。

**触发条件：** 当用户需要创作插画、产品图像、艺术设计、海报、文生图生成、编辑或转换现有图像、应用风格迁移、基于参考照片生成图像、生成交错图文内容、提及万/通义千问图像模型/AI艺术创作，或明确通过技能名称调用本技能（例如使用 qwencloud-image-generation）时触发。

**不触发条件：** 当用户需要了解/分析现有图像或OCR（使用 qwencloud-vision）、视频生成（使用 qwencloud-video-generation）、或仅执行文本任务时，不触发。

description: OpenMAIC — Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom platform for generating immersive AI-powered learning experiences with slides, quizzes, simulations, and multi-agent discussions.
description_zh: OpenMAIC — 开放多智能体交互课堂平台，用于生成结合幻灯片、测验、模拟及多智能体讨论的沉浸式AI驱动学习体验。

description: Scaffold and deploy Cloudflare Workers with Hono routing, Vite plugin, and Static Assets. Describe project, scaffold structure, configure bindings, deploy. Use whenever the user wants to create a Worker project, set up Hono on Cloudflare, configure D1 / R2 / KV / Queues bindings, or troubleshoot Worker export syntax, API route conflicts, HMR issues, or deployment failures.
description_zh: 搭建并部署集成 Hono 路由、Vite 插件与静态资源的 Cloudflare Workers。详细描述项目、脚手架结构、绑定配置及部署流程。当用户需要创建 Worker 项目、在 Cloudflare 上设置 Hono、配置 D1 / R2 / KV / 队列绑定，或排查 Worker 导出语法、API 路由冲突、HMR 问题及部署失败等问题时使用。

description: 100+ animated React components (Aceternity UI) for Next.js with Tailwind. Use for hero sections, parallax, 3D effects, or encountering animation, shadcn CLI integration errors.
description_zh: 100+ 动画 React 组件（Aceternity UI），适用于 Next.js 与 Tailwind。可用于 Hero 区域、视差、3D 效果，或解决动画及 shadcn CLI 集成错误等问题。

description: Use when the user asks to "write SEO content", "draft a blog post / landing page", "update outdated content", or "fix traffic/ranking decay"; two modes — new drafts pages with keywords, headers, snippets, and evidence boundaries; refresh scores decay, prioritizes update work, and produces a republish plan with GEO guidance. Not for AI-citation/GEO readiness scoring — use geo-content-optimizer; not for publish-gate scoring — use content-quality-auditor. SEO文章写作/内容更新/排名恢复
description_zh: 适用于用户要求“撰写SEO内容”、“起草博客文章/落地页”、“更新过时内容”或“修复流量/排名衰减”时使用；具备两种模式——生成包含关键词、标题、摘要及证据边界的新稿页面；刷新评分衰减、优先处理更新工作，并输出包含GEO指导的重新发布计划。不适用于AI引用/GEO就绪性评分——请使用geo-content-optimizer；不适用于发布门槛评分——请使用content-quality-auditor。SEO文章写作/内容更新/排名恢复

description: Log sales activities — calls, notes, meetings, tasks — against contacts and deals, with the mandatory create-then-associate step that makes them visible in the CRM.
description_zh: 记录销售活动——通话、笔记、会议、任务——与联系人及交易对应，并具备强制性的“创建-关联”步骤，使其在CRM中可见。

description:
FIFA World Cup 2026 — match schedules, live scores, results, and the prediction game (place/cancel bets with points, betting stats, leaderboard).

Use whenever the user mentions the World Cup: today's / upcoming / live / finished matches, a specific match, placing or cancelling a prediction, staking points, their betting balance or win rate, or the predictor leaderboard.
description_zh: 2026年国际足联世界杯 —— 赛程安排、实时比分、赛果及预测游戏（用积分下注/取消下注，投注数据，排行榜）。

description: Guided journey from a stalled, plateaued business to one with an honest diagnosis, a working operating rhythm, and offers repriced to real value. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - good-strategy-bad-strategy, traction-eos, high-output-management, team-topologies, drive-motivation, lean-analytics, negotiation, monetizing-innovation - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (STRATEGY.md, OPERATIONS.md, METRICS.md, IMPROVE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to fix a business that has plateaued, diagnose why growth stalled, tighten strategy and execution, re-motivate a team, or says 'revenue is flat and I do not know why'. Starting from scratch with no customers: use create-business. Once the fundamentals work and the goal is expansion: use grow-business. When the product itself drags the business down: use improve-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 引导式旅程，从停滞、陷入高原期的业务，过渡到具备坦诚诊断、有效运营节奏，并将报价重新调整为真实价值的业务。分阶段统筹八个技能——good-strategy-bad-strategy、traction-eos、high-output-management、team-topologies、drive-motivation、lean-analytics、negotiation、monetizing-innovation——在每个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目 docs/ 文件夹中（STRATEGY.md、OPERATIONS.md、METRICS.md、IMPROVE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md），以便旅程能在跨会话中继续推进。当用户需要解决陷入高原期的业务、诊断增长停滞的原因、收紧战略与执行、重新激励团队，或表示“收入持平且我不知道原因”时使用。从零开始且没有客户时：使用 create-business。一旦基础工作完成且目标为扩张时：使用 grow-business。当产品本身拖累业务时：使用 improve-app。若仅针对某个框架单独使用，直接调用该技能即可。

description: ADR templates in the Nygard format with context, decision, consequences, and alternatives. Use when writing ADRs, recording an architectural decision, or evaluating options.
description_zh: 采用包含上下文、决策、后果和替代方案的 Nygard 格式的 ADR 模板。用于撰写架构决策记录、记录架构决策或评估方案时使用。

description: Deploy a production self-hosted n8n end-to-end to a fresh Linux VM over SSH, using Docker Compose behind a Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS. Use whenever the user wants to self-host, install, provision, or deploy n8n on their own server/VPS (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, AWS EC2, bare metal) — single/regular mode or queue mode with workers — or to update, back up, restore, or harden such an instance, or make Python Code nodes run on it (task runners). For SELF-HOSTED n8n (Docker), not n8n Cloud and not building workflows. The skill makes the agent ask single-vs-queue first, collect domain/SSH/timezone inputs, generate fresh secrets on the box, and bring the stack up with TLS. Trigger on "deploy n8n", "self-host n8n", "n8n docker compose", "n8n queue mode / workers", "n8n reverse proxy / SSL", "back up / update my n8n", "Python runner unavailable" / "n8nio/runners sidecar", or "we don't want to give every user the OAuth client secret" / "enable Sign in with Google" (credential overwrites).
description_zh:
在 SSH 上将生产环境的自托管 n8n 完整部署至全新的 Linux VM，使用 Docker Compose 配合 Caddy 反向代理（内置自动 HTTPS）。

在任何用户需要自行托管、安装、配置或部署 n8n 到其自有服务器/VPS（Hetzner、DigitalOcean、AWS EC2、裸金属服务器）时使用——支持单模式/常规模式或带工作者的队列模式——或用于更新、备份、恢复或加固此类实例，或让 Python Code 节点在其上运行（任务执行器）。适用于 SELF-HOSTED n8n（Docker），不适用于 n8n Cloud，也不涉及工作流构建。

该技能使代理首先询问单模式与队列模式，收集域名、SSH 和时区输入，在本地生成全新密钥，并以 TLS 启动整个技术栈。

触发场景包括："部署 n8n"、"自托管 n8n"、"n8n docker compose"、"n8n 队列模式 / 工作者"、"n8n 反向代理 / SSL"、"备份 / 更新我的 n8n"、"Python 执行器不可用" / "n8nio/执行器 sidecar"，或"不希望给每位用户 OAuth 客户端密钥"、"启用 Google 登录"（凭证覆盖）。

description: WPS 表格智能助手，通过自然语言操控 Excel，解决公式编写、数据清洗、图表创建等痛点问题
description_zh: WPS 表格智能助手，通过自然语言操控 Excel，解决公式编写、数据清洗、图表创建等痛点问题

description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.
description_zh: 覆盖默认LLM截断行为。强制完整代码生成，禁止占位符模式，并妥善处理token限制分割。适用于任何要求详尽、未截断输出的任务。

description: Guide for writing Apollo Router native Rust plugins. Use this skill when: (1) users want to create a new router plugin, (2) users want to add service hooks (router_service, supergraph_service, execution_service, subgraph_service), (3) users want to modify an existing router plugin, (4) users need to understand router plugin patterns or the request lifecycle. (5) triggers on requests like "create a new plugin", "add a router plugin", "modify the X plugin", or "add subgraph_service hook".
description_zh:
编写 Apollo Router 原生 Rust 插件的指南。使用此技能时：
(1) 用户想要创建新的路由插件；
(2) 用户想要添加服务钩子（router_service、supergraph_service、execution_service、subgraph_service）；
(3) 用户想要修改现有的路由插件；
(4) 用户需要理解路由插件模式或请求生命周期。
(5) 当出现类似“创建新插件”、“添加路由插件”、“修改 X 插件”或“添加 subgraph_service 钩子”的请求时触发。

description: Define motion tokens — durations, easing vocabulary, and reduced-motion handling — for consistency product-wide. Use when standardising motion across a system. For crafting one specific animation, use `animation-principles` (interaction-design).
description_zh: 统一定义动效令牌（时长、缓动词汇和减弱动态效果处理），以确保全产品的一致性。用于在系统中标准化动效。为创作单个特定动画时，使用 `animation-principles` (interaction-design)。

description: Build reusable, composable n8n sub-workflows. Use when extracting shared logic, building anything multi-step or reused across workflows, or any workflow over ~10 nodes — and whenever the user mentions sub-workflows, Execute Workflow, reuse, shared/common logic, modular workflows, "Define Below" inputs, waitForSubWorkflow, mode each vs all, or exposing a workflow as an agent tool. Covers typed sub-workflow inputs, all-vs-each execution, verb-first naming for discovery, stateless vs stateful design, and splitting by input shape.
description_zh: 构建可复用、可组合的 n8n 子工作流。当需要提取共享逻辑、构建任何多步骤或跨工作流复用的内容，或处理超过约 10 个节点的任何工作流时使用——以及当用户提及子工作流、Execute Workflow、复用、共享/通用逻辑、模块化工作流、"Define Below"输入、waitForSubWorkflow、mode each vs all，或将以工作流作为智能体工具暴露时。涵盖类型化子工作流输入、all-vs-each 执行、以动词开头的命名方式（便于发现）、无状态与有状态设计，以及按输入形态拆分。

description: Plans, configures, and hardens Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) security. Covers Workload Identity Federation, Secret Manager integration, RBAC hardening, Binary Authorization, Network Policies (Dataplane V2), Pod Security Standards, and IAM roles. Use when securing GKE clusters, setting up Workload Identity, hardening RBAC configurations, or configuring GKE secrets. Don't use for general network routing configuration (use gke-networking instead).
description_zh: 规划、配置并加固 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 的安全。覆盖工作负载身份联合、Secret Manager 集成、基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）加固、二进制备份授权、网络策略（Dataplane V2）、Pod 安全标准及 IAM 角色。适用于保护 GKE 集群、设置工作负载身份、加固 RBAC 配置或配置 GKE 的 Secret。不适用于一般网络路由配置（请改用 gke-networking）。

description: Salesforce data operations with 130-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user creates test data, performs bulk import/export, uses sf data CLI commands, or needs data factory patterns for Apex tests. DO NOT TRIGGER when: SOQL query writing only (use sf-soql), Apex test execution (use sf-testing), or metadata deployment (use sf-deploy).
description_zh:
Salesforce 数据操作（130 分评分）。

触发：当用户创建测试数据、执行批量导入/导出、使用 sf 数据命令行命令，或需要为 Apex 测试使用数据工厂模式时。

禁止触发：仅编写 SOQL 查询（使用 sf-soql）、执行 Apex 测试（使用 sf-testing），或进行元数据部署（使用 sf-deploy）时。

description: Author Prisma Next migrations — choose db update vs migration plan, edit the framework-rendered migration.ts (replace placeholder sentinels with dataTransform closures), recover from MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH or PN-MIG-2001 unfilled placeholder. Use for prisma migrate dev, prisma migrate deploy, prisma db push, db update, db update --dry-run, migration plan, migrate, migration new, migration show, db verify, db sign, data migration, this.dataTransform, dataTransform, placeholder, generated migration.ts, edit migration.ts, MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH, schema drift.
description_zh: 编写 Prisma Next 迁移——选择 db update 还是 migration plan，编辑框架渲染的 migration.ts（用 dataTransform 闭包替换占位符标记），从 MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH 或 PN-MIG-2001 未填写的占位符恢复。适用于 prisma migrate dev、prisma migrate deploy、prisma db push、db update、db update --dry-run、migration plan、migrate、migration new、migration show、db verify、db sign、data migration、this.dataTransform、dataTransform、placeholder、generated migration.ts、edit migration.ts、MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH、schema drift。

description: Select the best MetaTrader 5 trading robots (Expert Advisors) that have not been backtested yet, by running the MT5 Strategy Tester from the command line through a 3-round pipeline. Use when the user wants to batch-test MT5 bots/EAs, screen robots across all symbols, optimize EA parameters, or move candidate bots to finalists based on profit, drawdown, positive months/years and equity-curve criteria. Runs terminal64.exe headless; Windows + MetaTrader 5 required at run time.
description_zh: 通过命令行运行 MT5 策略测试器并进行三轮流水线处理，以选择尚未经过回测的 MetaTrader 5 交易机器人（专家顾问）中的最佳者。适用于用户需要批量测试 MT5 机器人/EAs、在所有交易符号上筛查机器人、优化 EA 参数，或根据收益、回撤、正收益月份/年份以及权益曲线标准，将候选机器人移至最终入围名单的场景。运行时会以无头模式执行 terminal64.exe；运行时需要 Windows 系统和 MetaTrader 5。

description: Guided journey from an app people sign up for and then quietly abandon to a sealed retention engine with a habit loop, an activated first run, and one metric the whole team trusts. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - hooked-ux, improve-retention, continuous-discovery, lean-ux, inspired-product, lean-analytics, microinteractions, drive-motivation - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (PRODUCT.md, METRICS.md, GROW-APP-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to lift activation and retention, design a habit loop, fix a leaky onboarding funnel, or says 'users sign up then disappear'. Do not use to fix broken UX or performance that no engagement mechanic can paper over - run improve-app first; if there is no app yet, use create-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh:
这是一条引导式旅程，从人们注册却随后悄然放弃的应用，通向具备习惯循环、激活的首启以及全团队信任的单一指标的封闭留存引擎。

分阶段编排八个技能——hooked-ux、 improve-retention、 continuous-discovery、 lean-ux、 inspired-product、 lean-analytics、 microinteractions、 drive-motivation——在每个决策点向用户提问，并在项目 docs/ 文件夹（PRODUCT.md, METRICS.md, GROW-APP-PLAN.md）中记录结果，从而使得该旅程能在跨会话中恢复。

当用户希望提升激活与留存、设计习惯循环、修复新手引导漏斗的漏水问题，或用户表示“用户注册后消失”时使用。

不可用于修复无法被任何参与机制掩盖的损坏 UX 或性能问题——需优先运行 improve-app；若尚不存在应用，则使用 create-app。

针对单一框架单独使用时，直接调用该技能。

description: The front door to the Small Business plugin. Listens to what the owner needs right now — vague or specific — and routes them to the best skill or slash command for the moment. Also serves as a guide: explains what's available, suggests what to try next, and adapts recommendations based on stored business context. Trigger whenever the owner asks "what can you do," "help me with my business," "what should I focus on," "I don't know where to start," or any open-ended business request that doesn't clearly match a single skill.
description_zh: Small Business 插件的入口。它倾听用户当前需要什么需求——无论是模糊的还是明确的——并将用户引导至当前最佳技能和斜杠命令。同时作为一个向导：解释有哪些可用，建议接下来尝试什么，并根据存储的业务上下文调整建议。当用户询问“你能做什么”“帮我处理业务”“我应该专注于什么”“我不知道从哪里开始”，或任何不明确匹配单一技能的开放式业务请求时触发。

description: Official Capacitor package guide plus Capgo ecosystem plugin recommendations. Use this skill when users need native functionality, want the right official Capacitor package, or need a stronger Capgo/community plugin when the official package is missing or too limited.
description_zh: 官方 Capacitor 包指南及 Capgo 生态系统插件推荐。当用户需要原生功能、想要合适的官方 Capacitor 包，或在官方包缺失或过于有限时，需要更强效的 Capgo/社区插件时，请使用此技能。

description: Turn an object or character reference image into a quality-gated, animation-ready procedural Three.js model built in code. Use for image-to-3D reconstruction, detail-accurate object rebuilds, stylized/likeness-maximized human characters, sculpt specs, and staged code generation.
description_zh: 将物体或角色参考图转换为通过代码构建、经过质量过滤且可直接用于动画的Three.js程序化模型。适用于图像到3D重建、细节精确的物体重建、风格化且最大程度还原真人特征的人物角色、雕塑规范以及分阶段代码生成。

description: PostgreSQL development best practices for schema design, query optimization, and database administration
description_zh: PostgreSQL开发中模式设计、查询优化与数据库管理的最佳实践

description: Run and create integration/E2E tests by exploring the live app with the configured browser provider, preserving repository-native runners, reusing the shared test environment, and diagnosing failures from concrete artifacts.
description_zh: 通过已配置的浏览器提供商探索实时应用，运行并创建集成/E2E（端到端）测试，保留仓库原生运行器，复用共享测试环境，并从具体工件诊断失败。

description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard with AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking
description_zh: 集AI驱动的新闻聚合、地缘政治监控与基础设施追踪于一体的实时全球情报仪表盘

description: Install and use the Edict (三省六部) multi-agent orchestration system with 12 specialized AI agents, real-time kanban dashboard, and audit trails
description_zh: 安装并使用配备12个专业AI智能体、实时看板与审计追踪的《Edict》（三省六部）多智能体编排系统。

description: Develop lightweight Flask APIs with routing, blueprints, database integration, authentication, and request/response handling. Use when building RESTful APIs, microservices, or lightweight web services with Flask.
description_zh: 开发具备路由、蓝图、数据库集成、认证及请求/响应处理功能的轻量级 Flask 应用接口。适用于使用 Flask 构建 RESTful 应用接口、微服务或轻量级网络服务的场景。

description: Installs, troubleshoots, and personalizes the official Tencent IMA skill (a wrapper layer that orchestrates upstream ima-skill, not a replacement). Use when the user mentions IMA, 腾讯 IMA, ima.qq.com, ima-skill, installing or configuring ima-skill, IMA API key / credentials, searching across IMA knowledge bases, 知识库搜索, 笔记搜索, fan-out search with preferred KBs / priority boosting, or wants to diagnose, repair, or personalize an ima-skill install. Also trigger on the missing-YAML-frontmatter bug in ima-skill submodule SKILL.md files and errors like "Skipped loading skill(s) due to invalid SKILL.md".
description_zh: 安装、排查并个性化配置官方腾讯 IMA 技能（一个编排上游 ima-skill 的包装层，而非替代品）。当用户提及 IMA、腾讯 IMA、ima.qq.com、ima-skill、安装或配置 ima-skill、IMA API key / credentials、跨 IMA 知识库搜索、知识库搜索、笔记搜索、按偏好知识库进行扇出搜索及优先级提升，或希望诊断、修复或个性化配置 ima-skill 安装时使用。此外，在 ima-skill 子模块 SKILL.md 文件出现缺少 YAML frontmatter 的 Bug，以及出现类似 "Skipped loading skill(s) due to invalid SKILL.md" 的错误时，也应触发。

description: Pattern: create or update WordPress block patterns (starter pages, templates, template parts, Query Loop layouts), review pattern registration, block markup, categories, accessibility, or i18n/escaping, or improve pattern design quality. Route custom blocks to wp-block-development; route frontend interactivity to wp-interactivity-api.
description_zh: 模式：创建或更新 WordPress 块模式（起始页面、模板、模板部件、查询循环布局），审查模式注册、区块标记、分类、无障碍、i18n/转义，或提升模式设计质量。将自定义区块路由至 wp-block-development；将前端交互路由至 wp-interactivity-api。

description: Create or refine PRODUCT.md while separating evidence, aspiration, users, value, and non-goals. Triggers: "product", "create PRODUCT.md", "product boundary".
description_zh: 创建或完善 PRODUCT.md，将证据、愿景、用户、价值与非目标进行区分。触发词："product"、"create PRODUCT.md"、"product boundary"。

description: Provider-agnostic, type-safe AI SDK for streaming, tool calling, structured output, and multimodal content.
description_zh: 与提供商无关、类型安全的 AI SDK，适用于流式传输、工具调用、结构化输出以及多模态内容。

description: Generate a complete, deployable landing page from a brief. Produces a single self-contained HTML file with Tailwind CSS (via CDN), responsive design, dark mode, semantic HTML, and OG meta tags. Sections: hero with CTA, features, social proof, pricing (optional), FAQ, footer. Use when building a marketing page, product launch page, coming soon page, or any standalone landing page. Triggers: 'landing page', 'create a page', 'marketing page', 'launch page', 'coming soon page', 'one-page site'.
description_zh: 根据简要描述生成完整的、可部署的落地页。生成一个单一、自包含的 HTML 文件，其中包含通过 CDN 引入的 Tailwind CSS、响应式设计、深色模式、语义化 HTML 及 OG 元标签。版块：包含行动号召（CTA）的 hero 区域、功能特性、社会证明、定价（可选）、常见问题（FAQ）和页脚。适用于构建营销页面、产品发布页面、即将上线页面，或任何独立落地页。触发词：‘landing page’，‘create a page’，‘marketing page’，‘launch page’，‘coming soon page’，‘one-page site’。

description: Design a form end to end — field order, grouping, validation, and completion. Use when the artifact is a form. For product-wide error strategy use `error-handling-ux`; for first-run signup use `onboarding-design`.
description_zh: 端到端设计表单 —— 字段顺序、分组、验证与完成。当制品为表单时使用。针对全局错误策略使用 `error-handling-ux`；首次注册使用 `onboarding-design`。

description: Implements the minimal code change identified by the om-root-cause step, adds regression tests, and runs the configured validation gate. Claims the tracker issue at start (assignee + in-progress label + claim comment) so concurrent automation backs off. Does not commit, push, or open a PR — that is the om-open-pr step's job.
description_zh: 实现由 om-root-cause 步骤识别出的最小代码变更，添加回归测试，并运行已配置的验证门禁。在开始阶段认领跟踪器问题（负责人 + 进行中标签 + 认领评论），以便并发自动化让路。不进行提交、推送或打开 PR — 那是 om-open-pr 步骤的职责。

description: Comprehensive guide for contributing to and working with freeCodeCamp's open-source codebase and curriculum platform
description_zh: freeCodeCamp 开源代码库及课程平台贡献与协作全面指南

description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation patterns for grounded LLM responses. Use when building RAG pipelines, embedding documents, implementing hybrid search, contextual retrieval, HyDE, agentic RAG, multimodal RAG, query decomposition, reranking, or pgvector search.
description_zh: 用于使大语言模型（LLM）回复有依据的检索增强生成（RAG）模式。在构建RAG流水线、嵌入文档、实现混合搜索、上下文检索、HyDE、智能体RAG、多模态RAG、查询分解、重排序或pgvector搜索时使用。

description: Produces a margin-by-product table and three pricing-scenario data views so the owner can see the full financial picture before making a pricing decision. Accepts optional product name argument.
description_zh: 生成按产品划分的利润表及三种定价情景数据视图，供所有者在进行定价决策前查看完整的财务概览。支持可选的产品名称参数。

description: Expert in designing effective prompts for LLM-powered applications. Masters prompt structure, context management, output formatting, and prompt evaluation. Use when: prompt engineering, system prompt, few-shot, chain of thought, prompt design.
description_zh: 精通为基于大语言模型（LLM）的应用设计有效提示词。熟练掌握提示词结构、上下文管理、输出格式化及提示词评估。适用场景：提示词工程、系统提示词、few-shot、思维链、提示词设计。

description: Assign and reassign CRM record ownership, audit who-owns-what across object types, and handle rep transitions. Built on `bulk-operations`.
description_zh: 分配并重新分配 CRM 记录的所有权，审计不同对象类型下的归属情况，并处理销售代表变更。基于 `bulk-operations` 构建。

description: 一套模板驱动的数据可视化与报告生成 skill，既能严格从 Lupi、Basics、Glance、Maps 与 Interactive gallery 的真实实现生成 HTML 图表，也能从 12 套中英文整页报告模板生成可发布的 HTML 报告；以 Mono 为保底，能按数据语义自动选择内置彩色预设，也支持用户明确提供的自定义色板。地图仅在用户明确要求时启用，同一交付禁止混用色系。
description_zh: 一套模板驱动的数据可视化与报告生成 skill，既能严格从 Lupi、Basics、Glance、Maps 与 Interactive gallery 的真实实现生成 HTML 图表，也能从 12 套中英文整页报告模板生成可发布的 HTML 报告；以 Mono 为保底，能按数据语义自动选择内置彩色预设，也支持用户明确提供的自定义色板。地图仅在用户明确要求时启用，同一交付禁止混用色系。

description: Game asset engineer that creates pixel art sprites, animated characters, and visual entities for browser games. Use when a game needs better character art, enemy sprites, item visuals, or any upgrade from basic geometric shapes to recognizable pixel art.
description_zh: 为浏览器游戏创建像素艺术精灵、动画角色及视觉实体的游戏资产工程师。适用于游戏需要更出色的角色美术、敌人精灵、物品视觉，或将基础几何图形升级为可识别像素艺术的任何需求时。

description: Deploy and configure MetaClaw — an agent that meta-learns and evolves from live conversations using skills injection, RL training, and smart scheduling.
description_zh: 部署和配置 MetaClaw——一个通过实时对话，利用技能注入、强化学习训练和智能调度进行元学习和进化的智能体。

description: Guides Qdrant scaling decisions. Use when someone asks 'how many nodes do I need', 'data doesn't fit on one node', 'need more throughput or QPS', 'CPU is pegged / can't keep up with the request rate', 'one query is slow / p99 or tail latency too high', 'cluster is slow', 'too many tenants', 'vertical or horizontal', 'how to shard', 'need to add capacity', 'large limit / pagination / scroll is slow', or 'only recent data matters / expiring old vectors / retention window'.
description_zh: 指导 Qdrant 的扩展决策。适用于当有人提出以下问题时使用：“我需要多少个节点”、“数据无法在单个节点上容纳”、“需要更高的吞吐量或 QPS”、“CPU 占用已达极限/无法应对请求速率”、“单次查询缓慢 / p99 或尾部延迟过高”、“集群运行缓慢”、“租户过多”、“纵向扩展还是横向扩展”、“如何分片”、“需要增加容量”、“大 limit / 分页 / scroll 操作缓慢”，或“仅最近数据重要 / 过期旧向量 / 保留窗口”。

description: UI component library patterns for shadcn/ui and Radix Primitives. Use when building accessible component libraries, customizing shadcn components, using Radix unstyled primitives, or creating design system foundations.
description_zh: shadcn/ui 和 Radix 原语的 UI 组件库模式。适用于构建无障碍组件库、定制 shadcn 组件、使用 Radix 无样式原语或创建设计系统基础时使用。

description: Dark-themed cloud-platform aesthetic with modular grids, glass-like panels, and strong data hierarchy for productivity dashboards.
description_zh: 采用深色主题的云平台设计风格，配备模块化网格、玻璃质感面板与清晰的数据层级，打造高效的生产力仪表盘。

description: Create an on-scroll animation trigger using IntersectionObserver with Tailwind-friendly animation classes and keyframes. Use when asked for scroll-reveal, animate-on-scroll, or sequencing element animations when they enter the viewport.
description_zh: 使用 IntersectionObserver 创建滚动动画触发器，并配合适配 Tailwind 的动画类与关键帧。当需要实现滚动显现、滚动触发动画，或元素进入视口时的序列化动画效果时使用。

description: AI coding agent skill for Antigravity Manager — a Tauri v2 + Rust desktop app and Docker service that manages multiple Google/Anthropic accounts and proxies them as standard OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini API endpoints with intelligent account rotation.
description_zh: Antigravity Manager 的 AI 编程代理技能 — 一款基于 Tauri v2 + Rust 的桌面应用和 Docker 服务，可管理多个 Google/Anthropic 账户，将其代理为标准 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini API 端点，并支持智能账户轮换。

description: Comprehensive security scanning and vulnerability detection. Includes input validation, path traversal prevention, CVE detection, and secure coding pattern enforcement. Use when: authentication implementation, authorization logic, payment processing, user data handling, API endpoint creation, file upload handling, database queries, external API integration. Skip when: read-only operations on public data, internal development tooling, static documentation, styling changes.
description_zh: 全面安全扫描与漏洞检测。包括输入验证、路径遍历防护、CVE检测以及安全编码规范执行。适用于：认证实现、授权逻辑、支付处理、用户数据处理、API 接口创建、文件上传处理、数据库查询及外部 API 集成。不适用于：公开数据的只读操作、内部开发工具、静态文档及样式更改。

description: Write Prisma Next queries for Postgres, SQLite, or Mongo — pick a lane (Postgres/SQLite `db.orm.<Model>` + `db.sql.<table>`; Mongo `db.orm.<root>` + `db.query.from(...)` pipeline builder), filter / project / sort / paginate, eager-load with `.include(...)`, Postgres/SQLite `db.transaction(...)`, Postgres/SQLite ORM `.aggregate(...)`, Mongo aggregations via query builder, namespace-aware accessors (`db.orm.<ns>.<Model>`, `db.sql.<ns>.<table>`). Triggers: query, where, match, select, project, orderBy, take, skip, include, lookup, first, all, count, aggregate, group, create, update, delete, upsert, returning, transaction, db.close, script teardown, variant, polymorphism, drizzle-style, kysely-style. Notes: `.all()` is a Thenable (just `await` it), iterators are single-use (`RUNTIME.ITERATOR_CONSUMED`), Postgres `count` is `number` while sum/avg/min/max are `number | null`, ranges use chained `.where()` or `and(...)` (no `.between(...)`).
description_zh:
为 Postgres、SQLite 或 Mongo 编写 Prisma Next 查询——选择数据轨道（Postgres/SQLite 使用 `db.orm.<Model>` + `db.sql.<table>`；Mongo 使用 `db.orm.<root>` + `db.query.from(...)` 管道构建器），支持过滤、投影、排序和分页，使用 `.include(...)` 进行预加载，使用 Postgres/SQLite `db.transaction(...)` 执行事务，使用 Postgres/SQLite ORM `.aggregate(...)` 执行聚合，通过查询构建器进行 Mongo 聚合，以及命名空间感知访问器（`db.orm.<ns>. <Model>`，`db.sql.<ns>. <table>`）。

触发器：query, where, match, select, project, orderBy, take, skip, include, lookup, first, all, count, aggregate, group, create, update, delete, upsert, returning, transaction, db.close, script teardown, variant, polymorphism, drizzle-style, kysely-style。

注意事项：`.all()` 是 Thenable（只需 `await` 它），迭代器为单次使用（`RUNTIME.ITERATOR_CONSUMED`），Postgres 中 `count` 类型为 `number`，而 sum/avg/min/max 类型为 `number | null`，范围查询使用链式 `.where()` 或 `and(...)`（不使用 `.between(...)`）。

description: Symphony turns project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs, allowing teams to manage work instead of supervising coding agents.
description_zh: Symphony 将项目工作转化为独立、自主的实施运行，使团队能够管理工作，而无需监督编码代理。

description: Generate a sound effect from a text description using Sonilo — a UI chime, a whoosh, an impact, ambience, a stylized cue — when there is no video to match. Use when the user describes the sound they want in words, with or without a length. For SFX matched to footage, use the video-to-sfx skill; for music, use text-to-music.
description_zh: 在无法匹配视频时，使用 Sonilo 根据文本描述生成音效——如 UI 提示音、呼啸声、冲击声、环境音、风格化提示音——。当用户用文字描述所需音效（可带或不带长度说明）时使用。对于匹配视频的音效，使用 video-to-sfx 技能；对于音乐，使用 text-to-music。

description: Expert knowledge of Godot Engine game development including scene creation, node management, GDScript programming, and project structure. Use when working with Godot projects, creating or modifying scenes, adding nodes, writing game scripts, or solving Godot-specific problems.
description_zh: 精通 Godot 引擎游戏开发，涵盖场景创建、节点管理、GDScript 编程和项目结构。适用于在 Godot 项目中开展工作、创建或修改场景、添加节点、编写游戏脚本或解决 Godot 相关问题。

description: Terminal tool that detects your hardware and recommends which LLM models will actually run well on your system
description_zh: 检测您的硬件，并推荐在您的系统上实际运行良好的 LLM 模型的终端工具

description: Expert guide for Unreal Engine 5.x C++ development, covering UObject hygiene, performance patterns, and best practices.
description_zh: Unreal Engine 5.x C++ 开发专家指南，涵盖 UObject 卫生规范、性能模式与最佳实践。

description: Modern take on brutalism with bold borders, vivid accent colors, and raw, high-contrast layouts on warm surfaces.
description_zh: 在温暖底色之上，以粗犷的边框、鲜艳的强调色以及原始、高对比度的布局，呈现粗野主义的现代演绎。

description: Generate or edit images using AI models (FLUX, Gemini). Use for general-purpose image generation including photos, illustrations, artwork, visual assets, concept art, and any image that isn't a technical diagram or schematic. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.
description_zh: 使用AI模型（FLUX、Gemini）生成或编辑图像。适用于通用图像生成，涵盖照片、插画、艺术作品、视觉素材、概念艺术，以及任何非技术示意图或原理图的图像。对于流程图、电路、路径及技术示意图，请改用科学示意图技能。

description: Add Rapier rigid bodies, colliders, forces, sensors, and joints to React Three Fiber. Use for collision-driven movement and simulation; use animation guidance for purely visual motion.
description_zh: 将 Rapier 刚体、碰撞器、力、传感器和关节添加到 React Three Fiber。用于基于碰撞的运动与模拟；使用动画引导实现纯视觉运动。

description: NVIDIA NemoClaw plugin for secure sandboxed installation and orchestration of OpenClaw always-on AI assistants via OpenShell
description_zh: NVIDIA NemoClaw 插件：通过 OpenShell 以安全沙盒方式安装并编排 OpenClaw 始终运行的 AI 助手。

description: Manage OpenClaw bot configuration - channels, agents, security, and autopilot settings
description_zh: 管理 OpenClaw bot 配置 – 频道、智能体、安全与自动驾驶设置

description: How to use the Appwrite CLI well. Covers when to use appwrite.config.json vs `appwrite client`, pull/push vs one-shot service calls, type-safe SDK and model generation, query flags, CI auth, Cloud regional endpoints, function/site variables, and traps that `--help` will not mention. Does not catalog commands — run `appwrite <command> --help` for flags. Use whenever running `appwrite`, deploying or pulling functions/sites/tables, generating application code from a table schema, initializing or linking a project, scripting Appwrite, or when the user mentions the Appwrite CLI, appwrite.config.json, `appwrite generate`, `appwrite types`, or `appwrite client`.
description_zh: 如何正确使用 Appwrite CLI。涵盖何时使用 appwrite.config.json 而非 `appwrite client`、pull/push 与一次性服务调用、类型安全的 SDK 与模型生成、查询标志、CI 认证、Cloud 区域端点、函数/站点变量，以及 `--help` 不会提及的陷阱。不列出命令——运行 `appwrite <command>` --help 获取标志。每当运行 `appwrite`、部署或拉取函数/站点/表格、根据表模式生成应用程序代码、初始化或关联项目、编写 Appwrite 脚本，或用户提到 Appwrite CLI、appwrite.config.json、`appwrite generate`、`appwrite types` 或 `appwrite client` 时，都应使用。

description: Handle files and binary data in n8n correctly. Use when working with files, images, PDFs, attachments, uploads or downloads, base64, vision/multimodal input, or when an AI agent needs a file as tool input or output — and whenever the user mentions $binary, binaryPropertyName, "read the PDF", "attach the file", "send the image", Merge losing binary, or a CDN for chat images. Covers the $binary vs $json split, reading/writing binary, keeping binary alive across transforms with Merge, the agent-tool binary boundary, and the CDN/URL requirement for chat surfaces.
description_zh: 正确地在 n8n 中处理文件和二进制数据。在涉及文件、图像、PDF、附件、上传或下载、base64、视觉/多模态输入时使用；或者当 AI 代理需要将文件作为工具输入或输出时使用——以及每当用户提到 $binary、binaryPropertyName、"读取 PDF"、"附加文件"、"发送图像"、Merge 导致二进制数据丢失，或用于聊天图像的 CDN 时。涵盖了 $binary 与 $json 的分离、读写二进制数据、使用 Merge 在转换过程中保持二进制数据存活、代理与工具的二进制数据边界，以及聊天界面的 CDN/URL 要求。

description: Build the product catalog, assemble quotes (line items + associations to deals), and track invoices and subscriptions through to revenue.
description_zh: 构建产品目录，组装报价（明细项 + 与交易的关联），并将发票与订阅跟踪直至实现收入。

description: Programmatic canvas toolkit for creating, editing, and refining Excalidraw diagrams via MCP tools with real-time canvas sync. Use when an agent needs to (1) draw or lay out diagrams on a live canvas, (2) iteratively refine diagrams using describe_scene and get_canvas_screenshot to see its own work, (3) export/import .excalidraw files or PNG/SVG images, (4) save/restore canvas snapshots, (5) convert Mermaid to Excalidraw, or (6) perform element-level CRUD, alignment, distribution, grouping, duplication, and locking. Requires a running canvas server (EXPRESS_SERVER_URL, default http://localhost:3000).
description_zh: 基于 MCP 工具的编程式画布工具包，支持创建、编辑和精修 Excalidraw 图表，具备实时画布同步能力。当智能体需要（1）在实时画布上绘制或布局图表，（2）使用 describe_scene 和 get_canvas_screenshot 迭代优化图表，以查看自身工作，（3）导出/导入 .excalidraw 文件或 PNG/SVG 图片，（4）保存/恢复画布快照，（5）将 Mermaid 转换为 Excalidraw，或（6）执行元素级增删改查（CRUD）、对齐、分布、分组、复制和锁定操作时使用。需要运行中的画布服务器（EXPRESS_SERVER_URL，默认 http://localhost:3000）。

description: Dub audio and video into other languages using the ElevenLabs Dubbing API (dubbing_v2), preserving the original speakers' voices. Use when translating videos, podcasts, or recordings into other languages, localizing media content, reviewing or correcting dubbing transcripts and translations, or regenerating a dub after edits.
description_zh: 使用 ElevenLabs Dubbing API（dubbing_v2）将音频和视频配音成其他语言，保留原始说话者的声音。适用于将视频、播客或录制内容翻译为其他语言，对媒体内容进行本地化，审阅或修正配音稿与翻译，或在编辑后重新生成配音。

description: Use this skill for generative video editing, text-to-video, image-referenced video generation, first-frame-to-video, first-and-last-frame transitions, and video extensions using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) via the official google-genai SDK. Includes workflows for pre-processing/optimizing high-resolution or long source videos with ffmpeg, stripping audio for full sound regeneration, and handling turn-by-turn video editing and parallel execution.

Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.
description_zh: 该技能适用于用户在生物学、化学、物理学、天文学、气候、基因组学、材料科学、医学、生态学、能源、工程、数学、药物发现、蛋白质设计、天气建模、定理证明、单细胞或偏微分方程（PDE）求解等科学领域进行人工智能（AI）/机器学习（ML）工作时使用。Hugging Science 是一个精选的科学数据集、模型、博客文章和交互式空间的目录。该技能可帮助用户通过 `datasets`、`transformers`、HF 推理 API、`gradio_client` 及方法论引用，发现并使用这些资源。

description: Authenticate with AEM Edge Delivery Services. Opens browser for login and captures token. Works for admin.hlx.page and Config Service APIs regardless of content source (Document Authoring, SharePoint, or Google Drive).
description_zh: 通过 AEM 边缘交付服务进行身份验证。将打开浏览器进行登录并捕获令牌。无论内容来源（文档创作、SharePoint 或 Google Drive）如何，均适用于 admin.hlx.page 与配置服务 API。

description: Delivers the Friday end-of-week pulse — revenue vs prior week, top sellers, wins and watches. Accepts optional lookback window of 7 or 14 days.
description_zh: 提供周五周末脉搏——收入与上周对比、畅销品、赢单和关注品。支持可选回溯窗口，可选7天或14天。

description:
Use when users ask for World Cup or 世界杯 AI match predictions, WC assistant probabilities,
World Cup news insights, master analysis, recomputing football match win rates with custom
correction signals, or trading a related prediction market after reviewing the AI analysis.
description_zh: 当用户请求世界杯或世界杯AI比赛预测、WC助手预测概率、世界杯新闻洞察、权威分析、根据自定义修正信号重新计算足球比赛胜率，或在审查AI分析后交易相关预测市场时使用。

description: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the Slides context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.
description_zh: 该技能帮助代理在幻灯片（Slides）语境中使用 Figma 的 use_figma MCP 工具。可与 figma-use 配合使用，该工具提供了使用 use_figma 工具的基础上下文。

description: Base rules for end users calling NVIDIA cuOpt (routing/LP/MILP/QP/install/server). Not for cuOpt internals — use cuopt-developer for those.
description_zh: 面向终端用户调用NVIDIA cuOpt（routing/LP/MILP/QP/install/server）的基础规则。不适用于cuOpt内部功能——请使用cuopt-developer处理这些。

description: Guides Qdrant deployment selection. Use when someone asks 'how to deploy Qdrant', 'Docker vs Cloud', 'local mode', 'embedded Qdrant', 'Qdrant EDGE', 'which deployment option', 'self-hosted vs cloud', or 'need lowest latency deployment'. Also use when choosing between deployment types for a new project.
description_zh: 指导 Qdrant 部署选择。当有人询问“如何部署 Qdrant”、“Docker 与云”、“本地模式”、“嵌入式 Qdrant”、“Qdrant EDGE”、“选择何种部署方案”、“自托管与云”或“需要最低延迟的部署”时使用。同时，在为新项目选择部署类型时也可使用。

description: Shadcn/ui-inspired design with minimal, clean components, monochrome palette, and utility-first patterns.
description_zh: 采用受 Shadcn/ui 启发的极简设计，搭配简洁组件、单色配色，以及以实用为先的模式。

description: Report observable AgentOps evidence without selecting work. Triggers: "status", "show AgentOps status".
description_zh: 报告可观测的 AgentOps 证据，无需选择工作。触发器：“status”、“show AgentOps status”。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to integrate Loops from application code, backend services, webhook handlers, or server-side automation. This includes the Loops HTTP API and official SDKs for server-side contact, contact-property, mailing-list, event, API-key-validation, transactional-email, content editing (campaigns, groups, audience segments, email messages, themes, and components), workflow graph/node mutation, and inbound Loops webhooks. Trigger on phrases like "Loops API", "Loops SDK", "create a campaign via API", "update email message LMX", "create a theme via API", "create a workflow via API", "add a workflow node", "Loops webhook", "send a Loops event from my app", "add a contact to Loops in a webhook", "send a transactional email from backend code", or any time the user wants to integrate Loops into their app, backend, webhook, or automation. Do not trigger for CLI or shell-only requests.
description_zh: 当用户希望从应用代码、后端服务、Webhook 处理器或服务端自动化中集成 Loops 时，请使用此技能。这包括 Loops HTTP API 及官方 SDK，用于服务端联系人、联系人属性、邮件列表、事件、API 密钥验证、事务性邮件、内容编辑（营销活动、群体、受众细分、电子邮件消息、主题和组件）、工作流图/节点变更，以及入站 Loops webhook。当出现类似以下表述时触发，例如“Loops API”、“Loops SDK”、“通过 API 创建营销活动”、“更新邮件消息 LMX”、“通过 API 创建主题”、“通过 API 创建工作流”、“添加工作流节点”、“Loops webhook”、“从我的应用中发送 Loops 事件”、“通过 Webhook 将联系人添加至 Loops”、“从后端代码发送事务性邮件”，或用户任何时候希望将其集成到其应用、后端、Webhook 或自动化中的情况。不要对仅使用 CLI 或 shell 发起的请求进行触发。

description: Amazon keyword research and market opportunity analysis for sellers. Retrieve autocomplete suggestions (long-tail keywords), analyze competitor landscape, and assess market opportunity for any keyword on 12 Amazon marketplaces (US/UK/DE/FR/IT/ES/JP/CA/AU/IN/MX/BR). No API key required. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions Amazon product research, finding products to sell on Amazon, Amazon keyword ideas, niche analysis, competition analysis for Amazon, market opportunity on Amazon, comparing Amazon keywords, evaluating whether a product is worth selling, Amazon autocomplete data, seasonal demand for Amazon products, or anything related to researching what to sell on Amazon — even if they don't explicitly say 'keyword research'. Also trigger when the user asks vague questions like 'is this a good product to sell?', 'what's the competition like for X on Amazon?', 'should I sell X or Y?', or 'what are people searching for on Amazon?'.
description_zh: 为卖家提供亚马逊关键词研究与市场机会分析。获取（长尾关键词）自动补全建议，分析竞争对手格局，并对任何关键词在12个亚马逊平台（US/UK/DE/FR/IT/ES/JP/CA/AU/IN/MX/BR）上评估市场机会。无需API密钥。确保在用户提及亚马逊产品研究、在亚马逊上寻找销售产品、亚马逊关键词思路、利基市场分析、亚马逊竞争分析、亚马逊市场机会、对比亚马逊关键词、评估产品是否值得销售、亚马逊自动补全数据、亚马逊产品季节性需求，或与在亚马逊上研究销售什么相关时，使用此技能——即使用户没有明确说明“关键词研究”。同时，当用户提出诸如“这是适合销售的好产品吗？”、“在亚马逊上X的竞争情况如何？”、“我应该销售X还是Y？”或“人们在亚马逊上搜索什么？”等模糊问题时，也需触发该技能。

description: Read a Prisma Next structured error envelope and route to the right recovery — code, domain, severity, why, fix, meta. Use for error, exception, my emit failed, my query won't typecheck, my query crashed, my migration won't apply, MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH, BUDGET.ROWS_EXCEEDED, BUDGET.TIME_EXCEEDED, RUNTIME.ABORTED, PLAN.HASH_MISMATCH, CONTRACT.MARKER_MISSING, PN-RUN-3001, PN-RUN-3002, PN-RUN-3030, PN-MIG-2001, PN-CLI-4011, PN-SCHEMA-0001, drift, capability missing, planner conflict, prisma studio, EXPLAIN, query log, db.end, db.close, script won't exit, hangs, close connection, pool.end, client is closed.
description_zh: 读取 Prisma Next 的结构化错误封装，并路由到正确的恢复措施——包括代码、领域、严重程度、原因、修复方法和元数据。适用于错误、异常、我的 emit 失败、我的查询无法通过类型检查、我的查询崩溃、我的迁移无法应用、MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH、BUDGET.ROWS_EXCEEDED、BUDGET.TIME_EXCEEDED、RUNTIME.ABORTED、PLAN.HASH_MISMATCH、CONTRACT.MARKER_MISSING、PN-RUN-3001、PN-RUN-3002、PN-RUN-3030、PN-MIG-2001、PN-CLI-4011、PN-SCHEMA-0001、漂移、能力缺失、规划器冲突、Prisma Studio、EXPLAIN、查询日志、db.end、db.close、脚本无法退出、挂起、关闭连接、pool.end、客户端已关闭。

description: Odoo 18 development reference for Python models and ORM (search, domain, read_group, compute fields), XML/CSV data and views, OWL/JS client code, QWeb reports, security (ACL, record rules, groups), cron and server actions, migrations and module upgrades, tests, i18n, and performance. Use this skill whenever work involves Odoo 18 or custom addons—even if the user only pastes a traceback, mentions addons/ or __manifest__.py, describes form/list/kanban/XML errors, HTTP controllers, or business rules on models—including building features, fixing bugs, refactoring, or reviewing addon code. Includes CSS/SCSS asset authoring and review for Odoo addons.
description_zh: 涵盖 Python 模型与 ORM（搜索、域、读取分组、计算字段）、XML/CSV 数据与视图、OWL/JS 客户端代码、QWeb 报表、安全（ACL、记录规则、组）、定时任务与服务器动作、迁移与模块升级、测试、i18n 及性能等内容的 Odoo 18 开发参考。只要工作涉及 Odoo 18 或自定义模块，就应使用此技能——即使用户仅粘贴堆栈跟踪、提及 addons/ 或 __manifest__.py、描述表单/列表/看板/XML 错误、HTTP 控制器或模型上的业务规则，包括构建功能、修复 Bug、重构或审查模块代码。此外还涵盖为 Odoo 模块编写与审查 CSS/SCSS 资源。

description: Runs an end-to-end marketing campaign — sales analysis, content brief, Canva assets, HubSpot send. Accepts optional lookback and channel arguments.
description_zh: 运行端到端营销活动——销售分析、内容简报、Canva 素材、HubSpot 发送。支持可选的回溯参数和渠道参数。

description: Review what Prisma Next migrations will run on merge or deploy, render the migration graph, resolve concurrent / diamond-convergence conflicts, and configure environment refs for CI. Use for "what migrations are going to run", "what runs on deploy", merge conflict, diamond convergence, concurrent migrations, migration status, ref management, staging, production, MIGRATION.DIVERGED, MIGRATION.NO_MARKER, MIGRATION.MARKER_NOT_IN_HISTORY, prisma migrate status, prisma migrate diff, prisma migrate resolve.
description_zh: 审查 Prisma Next 迁移在合并或部署时将运行的内容，渲染迁移图，解决并发/菱形收敛冲突，并为 CI 配置环境引用。适用于“将运行的迁移”、“部署时运行的内容”、“合并冲突”、“菱形收敛”、“并发迁移”、“迁移状态”、“引用管理”、“预发布”、“生产”、“MIGRATION.DIVERGED”、“MIGRATION.NO_MARKER”、“MIGRATION.MARKER_NOT_IN_HISTORY”、“prisma migrate status”、“prisma migrate diff”、“prisma migrate resolve”。

description: AI-assisted academic conference poster generation from Overleaf source using Claude Code
description_zh: 使用 Claude Code 从 Overleaf 源文件生成 AI 辅助学术会议海报

description: Architectural decision-making framework. Requirements analysis, trade-off evaluation, ADR documentation. Use when making architecture decisions or analyzing system design.
description_zh: 架构决策框架。需求分析、权衡评估、ADR文档。用于架构决策或系统设计分析时。

description: Generate a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for a new feature. Use when planning a feature, starting a new project, or when asked to create a PRD. Triggers on: create a prd, write prd for, plan this feature, requirements for, spec out.
description_zh: 为新的功能生成产品需求文档（PRD）。在规划功能、启动新项目，或当被要求创建PRD时使用。触发条件：创建prd、撰写prd、规划此功能、需求制定、规格说明。

description: Comprehensive checklist for conducting thorough code reviews covering functionality, security, performance, and maintainability
description_zh: 涵盖功能、安全、性能和可维护性的全面代码审查检查清单

description: Configure Nginx web server for high-performance reverse proxy, load balancing, SSL/TLS, caching, and API gateway functionality.
description_zh: 为 Nginx Web 服务器配置高性能反向代理、负载均衡、SSL/TLS、缓存及 API 网关功能。

description: 模糊想法分诊。触发：用户想先聊、brainstorm、方向摇摆；不处理 bug/重构。
description_zh: 模糊想法分诊。触发：用户希望先聊天、头脑风暴、方向摇摆；不处理 bug/重构。

description: Wire the Prisma Next runtime — `db.ts` setup using `postgres<Contract>(...)` from `@prisma-next/postgres/runtime`, `sqlite<Contract>(...)` from `@prisma-next/sqlite/runtime`, or `mongo<Contract>(...)` from `@prisma-next/mongo/runtime`; middleware composition (telemetry from `@prisma-next/middleware-telemetry`; lints and budgets), `DATABASE_URL` config, per-environment branching, switching between Postgres, SQLite, and Mongo façades. Use for db.ts, postgres(), sqlite(), mongo(), middleware, telemetry, lints, budgets, DATABASE_URL, .env, connection pool, poolOptions, dev vs prod config, transactions, db.transaction, read replicas, multi-database, script won't exit, hangs, close connection, db.end, db.close, pool.end, [Symbol.asyncDispose], await using.

Use when the user has footage that needs sound design. For SFX from a text description alone, use the text-to-sfx skill; for music, use video-to-music.

Also covers rank tracking input, competitive research, and search-result monitoring without Google's own Custom Search API quota and billing.

description: Adopt Prisma Next into a new project, onto an existing database, or as the first move after a bootstrap tool dropped you into a scaffold. Use for "what can I do with Prisma Next", "what can I do next with Prisma", "where do I start", "what should I do first", "just ran createprisma", "createprisma", "npx createprisma", "npx create-prisma", "first steps", "first query", "I have a scaffolded Prisma Next project what now"; for `pnpm dlx prisma-next init` greenfield setup; and for `prisma-next contract infer` + `db sign` against an existing database. Also covers the connect-write-read first-arc orientation, the day-to-day commands (`contract emit`, `db init`, `db update`, `migration plan`, `migrate`, `db schema`, `db verify`), and routing to `prisma-next-contract` / `prisma-next-queries` / `prisma-next-runtime` for the next move. Flags: --target, --authoring, --schema-path, --probe-db, --output.
description_zh: 将 Prisma Next 引入新项目、迁移至现有数据库，或作为引导工具将您带入脚手架后的第一步。用于处理“我可以用 Prisma Next 做什么”、“使用 Prisma，下一步我能做什么”、“我应该从哪里开始”、“我应该先做什么”、“我刚运行了 createprisma”、“运行 createprisma”、“执行 npx createprisma”、“执行 npx create-prisma”、“第一步”、“首次查询”、“我有一个用 Prisma Next 搭建的脚手架项目，接下来该做什么？”；用于 `pnpm dlx prisma-next init` 的绿地搭建；以及针对现有数据库的 `prisma-next contract infer` + `db sign`。此外，涵盖连接-写入-读取的首次弧线（first-arc）方向，日常命令（`contract emit`、`db init`、`db update`、`migration plan`、`migrate`、`db schema`、`db verify`），并为下一步指引至 `prisma-next-contract` / `prisma-next-queries` / `prisma-next-runtime`。参数：--target、--authoring、--schema-path、--probe-db、--output。

description: Queries, manages, and troubleshoots Apache Airflow using the `af` CLI. Use when working with anything related to Airflow - a DAG, a DAG run, a task log, an import or parse error, a broken DAG, or any Airflow operation. Covers listing and triggering DAGs, retrying runs, reading task logs, diagnosing failures, debugging import and parse errors, checking connections, variables and pools, exploring the REST API, and monitoring health (for example "trigger a pipeline", "retry a run", "list connections", "check Airflow health", "why did my DAG fail"). This is the entrypoint that routes to sibling skills for authoring, testing, deploying, and migrating Airflow 2 to 3. Not for warehouse/SQL analytics on Airflow metadata tables (use analyzing-data); for deep root-cause reports use debugging-dags or airflow-investigation.
description_zh: 使用 `af` CLI 查询、管理和排查 Apache Airflow。当处理任何与 Airflow 相关的内容时使用——包括 DAG、DAG 运行、任务日志、导入或解析错误、损坏的 DAG，以及任何 Airflow 操作。覆盖列出和触发 DAG、重试运行、读取任务日志、诊断故障、调试导入和解析错误、检查连接、变量和池、探索 REST API 以及监控健康状态（例如“触发流水线”、“重试运行”、“列出连接”、“检查 Airflow 健康状态”、“我的 DAG 为何失败”）。这是路由到相关技能以进行 Airflow 2 到 3 的编写、测试、部署和迁移的入口点。不用于对 Airflow 元数据表进行仓库/SQL 分析（请使用 analyzing-data）；如需深度根本原因报告，请使用 debugging-dags 或 airflow-investigation。
