TRIGGER when: user wants to create, generate, or edit video content, mentions video generation/animation/video clips/Wan models, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-video-generation). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to generate images (use qwencloud-image-generation), understand/analyze existing videos (use qwencloud-vision), text-only tasks.
description_zh: 使用 Wan 模型生成视频。支持文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧、基于参考的角色扮演，以及视频编辑（VACE）。触发条件：用户希望创建、生成或编辑视频内容，提及视频生成/动画/视频片段/Wan 模型，或明确调用本技能名称（例如使用 qwencloud-video-generation）。不要触发：用户想要生成图片（使用 qwencloud-image-generation）、理解/分析现有视频（使用 qwencloud-vision）、纯文本任务。

description: Search and retrieve Norwegian company data from Brønnøysundregistrene (the Norwegian Business Registry). Access all ~1.2 million registered companies in Norway.
description_zh: 通过 Brønnøysundregistrene（挪威商业登记处）搜索并检索挪威公司数据。访问挪威全部约120万的注册公司。

description: Personal AI assistant framework supporting multiple chat channels (DingTalk, Feishu, QQ, Discord, etc.) with extensible skills, local/cloud deployment, and cron scheduling.
description_zh: 支持多个聊天渠道（DingTalk、Feishu、QQ、Discord 等）的个人 AI 助手框架，具备可扩展技能、本地/云端部署和 cron 调度功能。

description: Independently research and write an AI-narrative / due-diligence card for a crypto token — the kind of "叙事分析" card that covers what story a token is telling and what's independently verifiable about its social spread. Use whenever the user asks for a token's "叙事"、"舆情"、"传播情况"、"社媒热度", wants to know "这个币在讲什么故事"/"这个币是不是在蹭热点", asks to analyze or fact-check a token's X/Twitter narrative, or gives a bare contract address together with a request to understand its story rather than just its price/security numbers. This is not a raw safety score (`gmgn-contract-dd` owns that), not a screened hot list (`gmgn-heat-rank` owns that), and not a buy decision (`gmgn-token-buy` / `gmgn-swap` own that) — route here only when the ask is specifically about story and spread.
description_zh: 独立研究并撰写加密代币的AI叙事/尽职调查卡片，该卡片即“叙事分析”卡片，用以阐述代币所讲述的故事，以及其社媒传播中能够独立验证的内容。当用户要求查询代币的“叙事”、“舆情”、“传播情况”、“社媒热度”，想了解“这个币在讲什么故事”/“这个币是不是在蹭热点”，要求分析或核实代币在X/Twitter上的叙事，或者仅提供一个合约地址并请求了解其故事（而非仅仅其价格/安全性数据）时，即可使用此卡片。它并非原始安全性评分（`gmgn-contract-dd`负责此事项），亦非筛选后的热门榜单（`gmgn-heat-rank`负责此事项），也非购买决策（`gmgn-token-buy` / `gmgn-swap`负责此事项）——仅当询问内容专门针对故事与传播时，才应将请求路由至此。

description: A concise feature matrix for deciding which PlanetScale safety, observability, and automation recommendations apply by engine.
description_zh: 用于依据引擎判断 PlanetScale 安全性、可观测性与自动化建议适用情况的简洁功能矩阵。

description: Guides embedding model migration in Qdrant without downtime. Use when someone asks 'how to switch embedding models', 'how to migrate vectors', 'how to update to a new model', 'zero-downtime model change', 'how to re-embed my data', or 'can I use two models at once'. Also use when upgrading model dimensions, switching providers, or A/B testing models.
description_zh: 指导在 Qdrant 中实现嵌入模型迁移且无停机。当有人询问“如何切换嵌入模型”、“如何迁移向量”、“如何更新到新模型”、“零停机模型变更”、“如何重新嵌入我的数据”或“我是否可以同时使用两个模型”时使用。也适用于升级模型维度、切换供应商或对模型进行 A/B 测试时。

description:
Analyzes events through cybersecurity lens using threat modeling, attack surface analysis, defense-in-depth,
zero-trust architecture, and risk-based frameworks (CIA triad, STRIDE, MITRE ATT&CK).
Provides insights on vulnerabilities, attack vectors, defense strategies, incident response, and security posture.
Use when: Security incidents, vulnerability assessments, threat analysis, security architecture, compliance.
Evaluates: Confidentiality, integrity, availability, threat actors, attack patterns, controls, residual risk.
description_zh:
运用威胁建模、攻击面分析、纵深防御、零信任架构和基于风险的框架（CIA 三元组、STRIDE、MITRE ATT&CK），从网络安全视角分析事件。  
提供有关漏洞、攻击向量、防御策略、事件响应和安全态势的见解。  
适用场景：安全事件、漏洞评估、威胁分析、安全架构、合规。  
评估：保密性、完整性、可用性、威胁行为者、攻击模式、控制措施、残余风险。

description: Simulate a structured peer-review process using multiple specialized agents to validate designs, surface hidden assumptions, and identify failure modes before implementation.
description_zh: 使用多个专业智能体模拟结构化同行评审流程，在实施前验证设计方案、揭示隐藏假设并识别失效模式。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-feat-impl 调用用；转交 cs-feat --stage impl。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用兼容入口：供旧 cs-feat-impl 调用使用；请改用 cs-feat --stage impl。新请求不要主动选择。

description: Generate or scaffold ASP.NET Core code — Razor Pages, Blazor components, MVC controllers, views, and Minimal API endpoints — without using ASP.NET Core CLI scaffolding/code-generation tools. Use when (1) adding CRUD pages, views, or API endpoints backed by Entity Framework (EF Core) and a database, (2) generating code to create, read, update, and delete data using a DbContext, (3) scaffolding UI components that match the project's existing CSS framework and coding patterns, or (4) creating data-driven forms, tables, and navigation for a model class. Do not use for non-ASP.NET projects or when CLI-based scaffolding is preferred.
description_zh:
无需使用 ASP.NET Core CLI 脚手架及代码生成工具，即可生成或搭建 ASP.NET Core 代码（涵盖 Razor Pages、Blazor 组件、MVC 控制器、视图以及 Minimal API 端点）。

适用场景包括：（1）添加由实体框架（EF Core）与数据库支撑的 CRUD 页面、视图或 API 端点；（2）使用 DbContext 编写代码，实现数据的创建、读取、更新与删除；（3）搭建符合项目现有 CSS 框架及编码规范的 UI 组件；（4）为模型类创建数据驱动的表单、表格及导航。

不适用于非 ASP.NET 项目，亦不适用于当首选基于 CLI 的脚手架时。

description: Use when configuring any n8n node: HTTP, webhooks, database, comms (Slack/Gmail/Discord), AI, triggers, Merge, anything. Triggers on any node-builder call (`node(...)`, `trigger(...)`, `tool(...)`, `memory(...)`, `languageModel(...)`, `ifElse(...)`, `merge(...)`, etc.), configuring a parameter, `useDataOfInput`, `numberOfInputs`, fan-in convergence, or any node-specific debugging.
description_zh: 配置任何 n8n 节点时使用：HTTP、webhooks、database、通讯（Slack/Gmail/Discord）、AI、触发器、合并、任何节点。在以下情况下触发：任何节点构建器调用（`node(...)`、`trigger(...)`、`tool(...)`、`memory(...)`、`languageModel(...)`、`ifElse(...)`、`merge(...)` 等），配置参数，`useDataOfInput`，`numberOfInputs`，扇入收敛，或任何特定节点调试。

description: Critique a rendered screen against mood.md, voice.md, and tokens.md. Use when those brand files exist and you are checking compliance. For defining the visual language itself, use `illustration-style` (ui-design).
description_zh: 对照 mood.md、voice.md 和 tokens.md 审查渲染后的屏幕。当这些品牌文件存在且您正在进行合规性检查时使用。用于定义视觉语言本身时，使用 `illustration-style` (ui-design)。

description: Queries the data warehouse with SQL and answers business questions about data. Use when answering anything that needs warehouse data - counts, metrics, trends, aggregations, joins across tables, data lookups, or ad-hoc SQL analysis (for example "who uses X", "how many Y", "show me Z", "find customers", "what is the count").
description_zh: 使用 SQL 查询数据仓库，并回答关于数据的业务问题。在回答任何需要仓库数据的内容时使用——包括计数、指标、趋势、跨表聚合、数据查询，或即席 SQL 分析（例如“谁使用 X”、“有多少 Y”、“显示我 Z”、“查找客户”、“数量是多少”）。

description: Synthesizes trust boundaries, attack surfaces, and attacker profiles into a living threat model. Use as Stage B of the Knowledge Base generation process, reading architecture and entity definitions from the KB. Don't use for analyzing source code or extracting raw learnings from JSONL files.
description_zh: 将信任边界、攻击面和攻击者画像整合为动态威胁模型。作为知识库生成过程Stage B阶段使用，从知识库（KB）中读取架构和实体定义。不得用于分析源代码或从JSONL文件中提取原始学习结果。

description: Iris is Redis's umbrella for AI-focused products. Use this skill when integrating with the Iris Redis Agent Memory (RAM) data plane on Redis Cloud — recording session events for an AI agent, creating or searching long-term memories, configuring a memory store, or tuning background memory promotion. Code examples use the official `redis-agent-memory` (Python) and `@redis-iris/agent-memory` (TypeScript) SDKs.
description_zh: Iris 是 Redis 在 AI 相关产品领域的统一平台。当与 Redis Cloud 上的 Iris Redis Agent Memory (RAM) 数据平面集成时，请使用此技能——记录 AI 代理的会话事件、创建或检索长期记忆、配置记忆存储，或调整后台记忆提升功能。代码示例使用官方的 `redis-agent-memory` (Python) 和 `@redis-iris/agent-memory` (TypeScript) SDK。

description: Performs comprehensive Rust security review for safe/unsafe boundary issues, memory safety in unsafe blocks, concurrency hazards, panic-induced DoS, FFI safety, and async runtime mistakes. Use when auditing Rust crates, services, or libraries — particularly those with `unsafe`, FFI, or concurrent code.
description_zh: 针对安全/不安全边界问题、不安全代码块中的内存安全、并发风险、panic 导致的拒绝服务攻击、FFI（外部函数接口）安全性以及 async 运行时错误，进行全面的 Rust 安全审查。适用于审计 Rust crate、服务或库时使用——特别是包含 `unsafe`、FFI 或并发代码的用例。

description: Use when setting up metrics, alarms, or troubleshooting missing data in OCI Monitoring. Covers metric namespace confusion, alarm threshold gotchas, log collection setup, and common monitoring gaps.
description_zh: 用于在 OCI 监控中配置指标、设置告警或排查缺失数据时使用，涵盖指标命名空间混淆、告警阈值易错点、日志采集配置以及常见的监控盲区。

description: Assesses whether and how an existing mobile product should migrate to React Native. Use when auditing one or more product repositories for migration readiness, including products whose iOS, Android, and other clients live in separate directories or repositories; choosing brownfield, greenfield, or a checkpoint-based path; defining a representative trial; or preparing a baseline and ROI decision before implementation. When product scope or material evidence is unavailable, grills the stakeholder with exactly one question per turn instead of sending a questionnaire.
description_zh: 评估现有移动产品是否应迁移至 React Native 以及如何进行迁移。在审计一个或多个产品仓库的迁移准备度时使用，包括其 iOS、Android 及其他客户端分别位于不同目录或仓库中的产品；选择灰色开发、绿色开发或基于检查点的路径；定义代表性试点；或在实施前准备基线和投资回报率（ROI）决策。当产品范围或实质证据不可用时，不发送问卷，而是逐轮向利益相关者严格提问，每轮仅问一个问题。

description: Build complete, functional apps with InstantDB as the backend. Use when creating React/vanilla JS or expo applications. Triggers on requests for building apps.
description_zh: 以InstantDB作为后端，构建完整且功能完善的应用。在创建React/原生JS或expo应用时使用。当有构建应用的请求时触发。

description: Comprehensive GitHub project management with swarm-coordinated issue tracking, project board automation, and sprint planning
description_zh: 基于 GitHub 的全面项目管理工作，支持群组协同的问题追踪、项目看板自动化及迭代规划。

description: 全功能智能股票监控预警系统。支持成本百分比、均线金叉死叉、RSI超买超卖、成交量异动、跳空缺口、动态止盈等7大预警规则。符合中国投资者习惯（红涨绿跌）。
description_zh: 全功能智能股票监控预警系统。支持成本百分比、均线金叉死叉、RSI超买超卖、成交量异动、跳空缺口、动态止盈等7大预警规则。符合中国投资者习惯（红涨绿跌）。

description: Use xiaohongshu-cli for ALL Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book, 小红书) operations — searching notes, reading content, browsing users, liking, collecting, commenting, following, and posting. Invoke whenever the user requests any Xiaohongshu interaction.
description_zh: 使用小红书-cli 进行所有小红书（Little Red Book，小红书）操作，包括搜索笔记、阅读内容、浏览用户、点赞、收藏、评论、关注和发布。当用户提出任何小红书互动需求时，请调用此工具。

description: Apply Traceknot's ISTQB-aligned, evidence-bound QA process to repository changes across OMP, Codex, GajaeCode, Claude Code, and OpenCode, including session-scoped QA Board publication. Use for implementation verification, bug fixes, release checks, repository audits, defect confirmation, and residual-risk decisions without treating an agent's own completion claim as proof.
description_zh: 将Traceknot的ISTQB对齐、基于证据的QA流程应用于OMP、Codex、GajaeCode、Claude Code和OpenCode中的仓库变更，包括会话范围的QA委员会发布。用于实现验证、缺陷修复、发布检查、仓库审计、缺陷确认和残余风险决策，且不将代理自身的完成声明视为证据。

description: Review PlanetScale Postgres for Traffic Control, query tags, roles, pg_strict, backups/PITR, private connectivity, webhooks, branches, and safe agent operation.
description_zh: 审查 PlanetScale Postgres 的流量控制、查询标签、角色、pg_strict、备份/按点恢复（PITR）、私有连接、Webhook、分支以及安全代理操作。

description: Lab environment for Claude superpowers
description_zh: Claude 超级能力实验环境

description: Designs runtime and platform architecture inside a chosen solution. Use when deciding modular monolith vs services, consistency, resilience, or estate topology.
description_zh: 在所选解决方案中设计运行时与平台架构。在决定模块化单体架构与微服务、一致性、韧性或整体架构拓扑时使用。

description: Soft, extruded UI elements with inner and outer shadows on monochromatic surfaces for a tactile, embedded look.
description_zh: 采用柔和凸起的 UI 元素，在单色表面呈现内阴影与外阴影，营造触感与嵌入式视觉效果。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-issue-fix 调用用；转交 cs-issue --stage fix。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用的兼容入口：供旧 cs-issue-fix 调用使用；转交 cs-issue --stage fix。新请求不要主动选择。

description: Interactive onboarding that learns your communication style, audiences, and data sources to configure personalized status briefings. Paste in examples of updates you already write, answer a few questions, and roundup calibrates itself to your workflow.
description_zh: 交互式入职引导能够学习您的沟通风格、受众与数据源，以配置个性化的状态简报。粘贴您已撰写的内容更新示例，回答几个问题，Roundup 便会根据您的工作流程进行自我校准。

description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or structure Privacy Policy page. Also use when the user mentions "privacy policy," "privacy page," "data protection," "GDPR compliance," "privacy notice," "data privacy," "CCPA," "cookie policy," or "personal data." For legal overview page, use legal-page-generator.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建、优化或结构化隐私政策页面时。当用户提及“隐私政策”、“隐私页面”、“数据保护”、“GDPR合规”、“隐私声明”、“数据隐私”、“CCPA”、“Cookie政策”或“个人数据”时，也使用。对于法律概览页面，使用 legal-page-generator。

description: Find images you can confidently use for free — for websites, documents, presentations, UIs, blog posts, marketing assets, or anything else — without ever worrying about licensing. This skill pulls from a curated repository of pre-vetted images, pinned to a specific human-reviewed revision, and confirms each image's license — read from the image's own embedded metadata — before handing it over, so the licensing question is already answered by the time you get the URL. Triggers on any request involving an image, photo, illustration, banner, hero, or visual asset, including phrases like 'find me an image of...', 'I need a photo of...', 'get a picture for...'. Also use this when building UIs, articles, or content where a stress-free, freely-licensed image is needed.
description_zh: 找到您可以自信免费使用的图片——适用于网站、文档、演示文稿、用户界面、博客文章、营销素材，或其他任何用途——且无需担心版权授权问题。本技能会从精选的素材库中筛选预先审核过的图片，并将它们固定在特定的人工审核版本上，并在交付之前从图片自带的嵌入元数据中确认每张图片的授权许可，因此在您获得URL之时，授权问题已经得到解答。在涉及图片、照片、插画、横幅、主视觉图或视觉素材的任何请求时，本技能均会触发，包括"为我找一张……的图片"、"我需要一张……的照片"、"为……提供一张图片"等表述。当构建用户界面、文章或内容且需要无压力、可自由授权的图片时，也请使用本技能。

description: Configure authentication (API keys, endpoints). TRIGGER when: setting up QWEN_API_KEY, troubleshooting 401/auth errors, when another skill reports missing credentials, or user explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-ops-auth). DO NOT TRIGGER when: non-auth Qwen tasks, general API usage questions.
description_zh: 配置认证（API 密钥、端点）。触发条件：设置 QWEN_API_KEY、排查 401/认证错误、其他技能报告缺少凭据，或用户按名称明确调用本技能（例如使用 qwencloud-ops-auth）时。当执行非认证 Qwen 任务、一般 API 使用问题时，不要触发。

description: Salesforce architecture diagrams using Mermaid with ASCII fallback. TRIGGER when: user says "diagram", "visualize", "ERD", or asks for sequence diagrams, flowcharts, class diagrams, or architecture visualizations in Mermaid. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants PNG/SVG image output (use sf-diagram-nanobananapro), or asks about non-Salesforce systems.
description_zh: 使用 Mermaid 并带有 ASCII 备选方案的 Salesforce 架构图。触发条件：当用户提到“diagram”、“visualize”、“ERD”，或要求生成 Mermaid 中的时序图、流程图、类图或架构可视化图时。不触发条件：当用户需要 PNG/SVG 图片输出（使用 sf-diagram-nanobananapro），或询问非 Salesforce 系统时。

description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to work with the Loops CLI from the terminal. This includes installing or updating the CLI, authenticating, storing and selecting API keys, validating credentials, and running commands for contacts, contact properties, lists, events, transactional email, campaigns, email messages, themes, components, and uploads. Trigger on phrases like "Loops CLI", "loops auth login", "loops campaigns create", "loops uploads create", "loops email-messages update", "loops themes list", "loops components get", "loops contacts create", "loops events send", "loops transactional send", "loops api-key", "loops agent-context", "brew install loops-so/tap/loops", or any time the user wants to use Loops from the shell instead of application code.
description_zh: 当用户希望从终端使用 Loops CLI 时，请使用此技能。这包括安装或更新 CLI、认证、存储和选择 API keys、验证凭据，以及运行针对联系人、联系人属性、列表、事件、事务邮件、活动、邮件消息、主题、组件和上传的命令。触发条件包括类似"Loops CLI", "loops auth login", "loops campaigns create", "loops uploads create", "loops email-messages update", "loops themes list", "loops components get", "loops contacts create", "loops events send", "loops transactional send", "loops api-key", "loops agent-context", "brew install loops-so/tap/loops"等短语，或用户希望从终端使用 Loops 而不是应用代码的任何时候。

description: Use when building anything multi-step, anything that looks repeatable, anything the user mentions reusing, or any workflow with more than ~10 nodes. Triggers on "reuse", "I do this in another workflow", "extract", "modular", "shared logic", "subworkflow", multi-step builds, or any task that mentions logic the user has built before.
description_zh: “当构建任何多步骤内容、任何看起来可重复的内容、用户提及需要复用的内容，或任何节点超过约10个的工作流时使用。触发条件包括：“复用”、“我在另一个工作流中做过这个”、“提取”、“模块化”、“共享逻辑”、“子工作流”，多步骤构建，或任何提及用户此前构建过的逻辑的任务。”

description: Aggregates PayPal disputes, HubSpot feedback and tickets, and email sentiment (plus pasted or exported Google/Yelp reviews) into a themes report with verbatim evidence and a "do these three things this week" list. Use when the user asks how customers are feeling, for review analysis, what people are saying, or about disputes.
description_zh: 将PayPal争议、HubSpot反馈与工单、邮件情感（以及粘贴或导出的Google/Yelp评论）汇总为一份主题报告，内含逐字证据与“本周需做这三件事”清单。当用户询问客户感受如何、进行评论分析、了解人们说了什么，或涉及争议时使用。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-issue-analyze 调用用；转交 cs-issue --stage analyze。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用的兼容入口：供旧版 cs-issue-analyze 调用使用；转交至 cs-issue --stage analyze。新请求请勿主动选择。

description: 能力愿景维护。触发：起草/回填/更新 requirements，或 design/acceptance 需要 req delta。不要用于单个功能实现方案(cs-feat design)、大需求拆解排期(cs-epic)、开放式发散讨论(cs-brainstorm)、领域术语/ADR建模(cs-domain)。
description_zh: 能力愿景维护。触发：起草/回填/更新 requirements，或 design/acceptance 需要 req delta。不得用于单个功能实现方案（cs-feat design）、大需求拆解排期（cs-epic）、开放式发散讨论（cs-brainstorm）、领域术语/ADR 建模（cs-domain）。

description: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) vertical skill for the Customware SPA. Defines the section layout, entity views, and mapping rules for transforming a DOMAIN.md into a CRM tool. Use this skill when the Builder Agent classifies a customer's domain as contact management, sales pipeline, deal tracking, or customer relationship workflows. Trigger signals: contacts, leads, deals, pipeline, follow-ups, opportunities, accounts, customer data everywhere, can't track who talked to whom, sales process, referrals.
description_zh: 针对 Customware SPA 的客户关系管理（CRM）垂直技能。该技能定义了板块布局、实体视图与映射规则，用于将 DOMAIN.md 转换为 CRM 工具。当 Builder Agent 将客户领域归类为联系管理、销售管道、交易跟踪或客户关系工作流程时，使用本技能。触发信号：联系人、潜在客户、交易、销售管道、跟进、机会、账户、各处客户数据、无法追踪谁与谁沟通过、销售流程、推荐。

description: Start or reuse the CAD Explorer viewer, return review links, and create saved snapshots for explicit CAD and robot-description files. Use when rendering or visually reviewing `.step`, `.stp`, `.glb`, `.stl`, `.3mf`, `.dxf`, `.urdf`, `.srdf`, or `.sdf` files, especially when handed off from CAD, URDF, SRDF, or SDF generation skills.
description_zh: 启动或复用 CAD Explorer 查看器，返回审阅链接，并为显式 CAD 与机器人描述文件创建已保存的快照。当需要渲染或可视化审阅 `.step`、`.stp`、`.glb`、`.stl`、`.3mf`、`.dxf`、`.urdf`、`.srdf` 或 `.sdf` 文件时使用，尤其适用于由 CAD、URDF、SRDF 或 SDF 生成技能生成并移交的文件。

description: Audit an LLM eval pipeline and surface problems: missing error analysis, unvalidated judges, vanity metrics, etc. Use when inheriting an eval system, when unsure whether evals are trustworthy, or as a starting point when no eval infrastructure exists. Do NOT use when the goal is to build a new evaluator from scratch (use error-analysis, write-judge-prompt, or validate-evaluator instead).
description_zh: 审计LLM评估流水线并发现问题：缺少错误分析、未经验证的评审者、虚荣指标等。当继承评估系统、不确定评估是否可信，或没有评估基础设施时，可作为起点使用。当目标是“从零开始”构建新的评估器时，不要使用（请改用 error-analysis、write-judge-prompt 或 validate-evaluator 替代）。

description: Prepare a reusable, technology-agnostic environment for local tests and QA. Compiles discovery into cross-platform launch scripts, provisions the configured browser provider autonomously, and writes the shared test-env descriptor consumed by UI and integration-test skills.
description_zh: 为本地测试和QA准备一个可复用、技术无关的环境。将测试发现编译为跨平台启动脚本，自主配置相应的浏览器提供者，并编写供UI和集成测试技能使用的共享测试环境描述符。

description: Hand a Prisma Next question or report off to the team — file a GitHub issue (bug or feature request), or route Q&A / design discussion / direct-team-contact to the Prisma Discord at pris.ly/discord. Use for bug, bug report, file an issue, report a bug, feature request, missing feature, this should be a feature, file this, this is a bug, this is broken, surprising behaviour, this doesn't work, file feedback, send feedback, capability gap, file via prisma-next-feedback, ask the team, talk to the team, talk to the Prisma team, talk to Prisma, Discord, Prisma Discord, Q&A, design feedback, is this the intended way, how should I do X, extension author question, extension author needs help.
description_zh: 将 Prisma Next 的问题或报告移交给团队处理——提交一个 GitHub issue（bug 或功能请求），或将 Q&A、设计讨论或直接联系团队的请求路由至 Prisma Discord（地址为 pris.ly/discord）。适用于：bug、bug 报告、提交一个 issue、报告 bug、功能请求、缺失功能、这应该是一个功能、提交此内容、这是一个 bug、这已损坏、异常行为、这无法使用、提交反馈、发送反馈、能力差距、通过 prisma-next-feedback 提交、向团队提问、与团队沟通、与 Prisma 团队沟通、与 Prisma 沟通、Discord、Prisma Discord、Q&A、设计反馈、这是预期的使用方式吗、我应该如何做 X、扩展作者问题、扩展作者需要帮助。

description: Pydantic is a Python data validation and serialization library, based on type hints. Use this skill whenever you need to do relatively complex data modeling using Pydantic, e.g. when adding constraints, defining a model hierarchy with subclasses, etc.
description_zh: Pydantic 是基于类型提示的 Python 数据验证与序列化库。当需要使用 Pydantic 进行相对复杂的数据建模时，例如添加约束、通过子类定义模型层级结构等，请使用此技能。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-feat-ff 调用用；转交 cs-feat --mode fastforward。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用的兼容入口：用于旧 cs-feat-ff 调用；请改用 cs-feat --mode fastforward。新请求不要主动选择。

description: 从 Bilibili 视频提取字幕、转录无字幕视频、生成结构化摘要。触发条件：Bilibili URL (bilibili.com)、BV ID (BV1xxx)、或"提取B站字幕"等请求。
description_zh: 从B站视频提取字幕、转录无字幕视频、生成结构化摘要。触发条件：B站链接（bilibili.com）、BV ID（BV1xxx）、或“提取B站字幕”等请求。

description: One-time pipeline configurator. Inspects the repo (default branch, validation scripts, labels), asks a few questions, writes .ai/agentic.config.json — the file every other skill reads — installs the tracker descriptor, and generates missing project docs (SDLC.md, CODE_REVIEW.md, BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.md, AGENTS.md starter). Re-run when the toolchain or label taxonomy changes. Verifies cross-skill coverage and prints the install command for missing skills.
description_zh: 一次性流水线配置器。检查仓库（默认分支、验证脚本、标签），提出几个问题，写入 .ai/agentic.config.json——其他所有技能读取的文件——安装追踪描述符，并生成缺失的项目文档（SDLC.md、CODE_REVIEW.md、BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.md、AGENTS.md 起始文件）。当工具链或标签分类发生变化时重新运行。验证跨技能覆盖情况，并为缺失技能打印安装命令。

description: Watch and understand footage with Diffusion Studio: answer questions about a video or audio file, summarize it, find scenes and moments, pull quotes, and describe what happens and when. Use whenever the user asks what's in a piece of footage, wants a summary or recap, wants to locate a moment ("where does X happen", "find the scene where..."), or needs a claim about a video or audio file checked.
description_zh: 借助 Diffusion Studio 观看并理解影像：回答关于视频或音频文件的提问，总结内容，查找场景与时刻，提取引用，并描述发生的事件及时间。当用户询问影像中包含的内容、需要总结或回顾、需要定位某个时刻（如“X 发生在哪里”“查找……的场景”），或需要核实视频或音频文件的陈述时，即可使用。

description: Generates custom design system rules for the user's codebase. Use when user says "create design system rules", "generate rules for my project", "set up design rules", "customize design system guidelines", or wants to establish project-specific conventions for Figma-to-code workflows. Requires Figma MCP server connection.
description_zh: 为用户的代码库生成自定义的设计系统规则。当用户说“创建设计系统规则”、“为我的项目生成规则”、“设置设计规则”、“定制设计系统指南”，或需要为Figma到代码的工作流建立项目特定规范时使用。需要Figma MCP服务器连接。

description: Use when an n8n-mcp account targets more than one n8n instance — i.e. the `n8n_instances` tool is available, the user mentions multiple n8n instances or environments (prod vs staging, several teams or clients), a workflow / datatable / credential / execution call returns an unexpected NOT_FOUND or reads data you don't recognize, or a credential create/update/delete is refused with an `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` error. Covers choosing and switching which instance this MCP session targets, verifying the target before high-stakes work — credential writes above all — and recovering from misroutes and ambiguous-write fail-closes. Always consult this skill before operating on a specific instance, before any credential create/update/delete on a multi-instance account, or when a call hits the wrong/empty data or an `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` error.
description_zh: 在以下情况下使用：n8n-mcp 账号针对多个 n8n 实例时——即 `n8n_instances` 工具可用，用户提到多个 n8n 实例或环境（生产环境与预发布环境，多个团队或客户），工作流/数据表/凭据/执行调用返回意外的 NOT_FOUND，或读取到您不认识的数据，或凭据的创建/更新/删除被拒绝并出现 `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` 错误。涵盖为本次 MCP 会话选择并切换其目标实例，在高风险操作前（尤其是凭据写入操作）验证目标，以及从误路由和存在歧义的写入操作导致的失败关闭中恢复。在执行针对特定实例的操作之前、在多实例账号上执行任何凭据创建/更新/删除之前，或当调用访问到错误/空数据或 `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` 错误时，始终咨询本技能。

description: Comprehensive DevOps skill for CI/CD, infrastructure automation, containerization, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Includes pipeline setup, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and monitoring. Use when setting up pipelines, deploying applications, managing infrastructure, implementing monitoring, or optimizing deployment processes.
description_zh: 涵盖CI/CD、基础设施自动化、容器化及云平台（AWS、GCP、Azure）的全面DevOps技能。包含流水线设置、基础设施即代码、部署自动化与监控。适用于设置流水线、部署应用程序、管理基础设施、实施监控或优化部署流程的场景。

description: Build MCP servers in Python with FastMCP. Define tools / resources / prompts, build the server, test locally, deploy to FastMCP Cloud or Docker. Use whenever the user mentions building an MCP server, exposing tools to LLMs, FastMCP, building a Claude integration, or troubleshooting FastMCP module-level server, storage, lifespan, middleware, OAuth, or deployment errors.
description_zh: 使用 FastMCP 在 Python 中构建 MCP 服务器。定义工具、资源、提示词，构建服务器，在本地进行测试，部署到 FastMCP Cloud 或 Docker。当用户提及构建 MCP 服务器、向 LLM 暴露工具、FastMCP、构建 Claude 集成，或排查 FastMCP 模块级服务器、存储、生命周期、中间件、OAuth 或部署错误时使用。

description: Expert skill for building, running, and extending MinecraftConsoles (Minecraft Legacy Console Edition) — a C++ multi-platform reimplementation with dedicated server, LAN multiplayer, and modding support.
description_zh: Minecraft控制台（Minecraft经典控制台版）的构建、运行与扩展专业技能——一款基于C++的跨平台重构实现，支持专用服务器、局域网多人游戏及模组开发。

description: Runs on the 25th — shows the next 30-day cash-flow outlook and flags anything that needs attention before month-end. Accepts optional 30 or 60 day horizon.
description_zh: 于25日运行——显示未来30天的现金流展望，并在月底前标记任何需要关注的事项。支持可选的30天或60天时间段。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-roadmap 调用用；转交 cs-epic --stage planning。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用兼容入口：旧 cs-roadmap 调用使用；转交 cs-epic --stage planning。新请求请勿主动选择。

description: Verifies factual claims in documents using web search and official sources, then proposes corrections with user confirmation. Use when the user asks to fact-check, verify information, validate claims, check accuracy, or update outdated information in documents. Supports AI model specs, technical documentation, statistics, and general factual statements.
description_zh: 利用网页搜索和官方来源核实文档中的事实性主张，随后提出修正建议并征得用户确认。当用户要求对文档进行事实核查、核实信息、验证主张、检查准确性或更新过时信息时使用。支持 AI 模型规格、技术文档、统计数据及一般性事实陈述。

description: Validates a project's Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK integration for iOS, Android, or Unity projects. Use when conducting a full pre-launch audit of an app that integrates GMA SDK or when validating any individual GMA SDK integration checks, such as when validating ad unit IDs and ad formats, SKAdNetwork IDs, mediation adapter SDK version compatibility, or ad preloading.
description_zh: 验证iOS、Android或Unity项目中的Google移动广告（GMA）SDK集成情况。适用于对集成GMA SDK的应用进行完整上线前审计，或验证任何单项GMA SDK集成检查（如验证广告单元ID与广告格式、SKAdNetwork ID、媒介适配器SDK版本兼容性以及广告预加载等）。

description: Salesforce Connected Apps and OAuth configuration with 120-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user configures OAuth flows, JWT bearer auth, Connected Apps, or touches .connectedApp-meta.xml / .eca-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Named Credentials for callouts (use sf-integration), permission policies (use sf-permissions), or API endpoint code (use sf-apex).
description_zh: 120分评分机制的Salesforce连通应用与OAuth配置。触发条件：用户配置OAuth流程、JWT Bearer认证、连通应用，或操作/触及 .connectedApp-meta.xml / .eca-meta.xml 文件时触发。不触发条件：调用（调用输出）具名凭据（使用 sf-integration）、权限策略（使用 sf-permissions），或API端点代码（使用 sf-apex）时不触发。

description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.
description_zh:
通过 screenpipe 观察用户的屏幕，检测重复的科研工作流程，将其与现有的科学智能体技能进行匹配，并为尚未覆盖的模式草拟新的技能（或由现有技能串联而成的组合配方）。

**使用场景：**当用户要求分析其近期工作，并根据其实际操作提出技能建议时使用。

**要求：**需要本地运行于 3030 端口的 screenpipe 守护进程（https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe）——该技能没有其他数据源，若无法访问 screenpipe，技能将拒绝运行。所有检测均在本地执行；仅有经过脱敏的集群摘要数据会发送给大语言模型（LLM）。

description: Read-only root-cause analysis for a tracker issue. Identifies the bug's location and the minimal change surface so the next agent can implement the fix without re-exploring the repo. Outputs a short summary, the files that need to change, and the proposed approach.
description_zh: 针对追踪问题的只读根因分析。识别出缺陷所在位置以及最小变更范围，以便下一个智能体无需重新探索仓库即可实施修复。输出简短摘要、需变更的文件及建议方案。

description: Default guidance for building AI agents. Use for generic requests to build, create, scaffold, design, architect, or implement an AI agent, agent app, tool-calling agent, durable agent, multi-agent system, or scheduled agent.
description_zh: 构建AI智能体的默认指南。适用于构建、创建、搭建、设计、架构或实现AI智能体、智能体应用、工具调用智能体、持久化智能体、多智能体系统或定时智能体的通用请求。

description: Build a production behavior-tree runtime (Blackboard, action/condition leaves, sequence/selector/parallel composites, decorators) and a Utility AI system (response curves — linear, exponential, sigmoid, quadratic — considerations, and action evaluators), plus hybrid BT-drives-Utility agents. Use when implementing a reusable behavior-tree or utility-based decision system, or tuning enemy/NPC decisions beyond a simple FSM, or when the user mentions behavior tree, blackboard, decorator, selector, sequence, tick status, utility AI, response/scoring curve, or consideration. For choosing between FSM/BT/steering or for pathfinding, use game-ai; for Unreal's BehaviorTree/Blackboard assets, use unreal-behavior-trees.
description_zh: 构建生产级行为树运行时（黑板、动作/条件叶节点、序列/选择/并行复合节点、装饰器）与工具AI系统（响应曲线——线性、指数、S型、二次——的考量，以及动作评估器），以及混合BT驱动工具型智能体。适用于实现可复用的行为树或工具型决策系统、调整敌人/NPC决策以超越简单状态机（FSM）时，或当用户提及行为树、黑板、装饰器、选择器、序列、tick状态、工具AI、响应/评分曲线、考量等关键词时使用。如需在状态机（FSM）/行为树（BT）/转向（steering）之间进行选择或进行寻路，请使用 game-ai；针对 Unreal 的行为树/黑板资源，请使用 unreal-behavior-trees。

description: Carefully curated, modern minimal style with elegant serif typography and understated, sophisticated palettes.
description_zh: 精心策展的现代极简风格，配以优雅的衬线字体与内敛而精致的配色。

description: Compatibility alias — renamed to fitness. Use fitness to measure declared project fitness goals. Triggers: "goals" (deprecated).
description_zh: 兼容性别名 — 已重命名为健身。使用健身来衡量声明的项目健身目标。触发器："goals"（已弃用）。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-issue-report 调用用；转交 cs-issue --stage report。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用兼容入口：用于旧 cs-issue-report 调用；请转用 cs-issue --stage report。新请求请勿主动选择。

description: This skill provides reference guidance for citation verification in academic writing. Use when the user asks about "citation verification best practices", "how to verify references", "preventing fake citations", or needs guidance on citation accuracy. This skill supports ml-paper-writing by providing detailed verification principles and common error patterns.
description_zh: 本技能为学术写作中的引用核验提供参考指导。当用户询问“引用核验最佳实践”“如何核实参考文献”“防止虚假引用”，或需要引用准确性方面的指导时，使用本技能。本技能通过提供详细的核验原则和常见错误模式，支持 ml-paper-writing。

description: Use when handling files, images, attachments, or binary data in n8n, OR when an AI agent needs to take a user-uploaded file as tool input or return a generated file. For Data Tables (schemas, dedup, persistent state), see the separate n8n-data-tables-official skill. Triggers on "file", "image", "PDF", "attachment", "binary", "upload", "download", chat trigger with files, agent tool that needs a file, vision/multimodal, or any handling of non-JSON file data.
description_zh: 用于在 n8n 中处理文件、图像、附件或二进制数据时，或在 AI 智能体需要将用户上传的文件作为工具输入或返回生成的文件时使用。对于数据表（架构、去重、持久状态），请参阅独立的 n8n-data-tables-official 技能。触发场景包括：“文件”、“图像”、“PDF”、“附件”、“二进制”、“上传”、“下载”、带有文件的聊天触发、需要文件的智能体工具、视觉/多模态，或任何对非JSON文件数据的处理。

description: Mermaid diagram specialist for creating flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ERDs, and architecture visualizations
description_zh: Mermaid 图表专家，用于创建流程图、时序图、ERD（实体关系图）及架构可视化。

description: Analyse video content by extracting frames with ffmpeg and using AI vision to generate timestamped step-by-step summaries. Use when user provides a video file and wants to understand its visual content — screen recordings, tutorials, presentations, footage, or animations. Triggers on "analyse this video", "what happens in this video", "summarise this recording", or any request involving understanding video file contents.
description_zh: 使用 ffmpeg 提取帧，结合 AI 视觉生成带时间戳的逐步摘要，来分析视频内容。当用户提供视频文件并希望理解其视觉内容时使用，适用于屏幕录制、教程、演示、素材或动画。触发条件为“分析这段视频”、“这段视频发生了什么”、“总结这段录制内容”，或任何涉及理解视频文件内容的请求。

description: Use when building or debugging interactive 3D scenes on the web with Three.js (scene/camera/renderer, lights/materials, GLTF loading, controls, performance). Helpful for designers shipping 3D UI moments.
description_zh: 适用于在网页上使用 Three.js 构建或调试交互式 3D 场景（场景/相机/渲染器、灯光/材质、GLTF 加载、控件、性能）。这有助于设计师交付 3D UI 场景。

description: Deprecated 兼容入口：旧 cs-refactor-ff 调用用；转交 cs-refactor --mode fastforward。新请求不要主动选择。
description_zh: 已弃用的兼容入口：用于旧 cs-refactor-ff 调用；请转交使用 cs-refactor --mode fastforward。新请求无需主动选择。

description: Configures and runs LLM evaluation using Promptfoo framework. Use when setting up prompt testing, creating evaluation configs (promptfooconfig.yaml), writing Python custom assertions, implementing llm-rubric for LLM-as-judge, or managing few-shot examples in prompts. Triggers on keywords like "promptfoo", "eval", "LLM evaluation", "prompt testing", or "model comparison".
description_zh: 使用 Promptfoo 框架配置并运行 LLM 评估。适用于设置提示词测试、创建评估配置（promptfooconfig.yaml）、编写 Python 自定义断言、为 LLM-as-judge 实现 llm-rubric，或管理提示词中的 few-shot 示例。匹配 promptfoo、eval、"LLM评估"、"提示词测试"或"模型对比"等关键词时触发。

description: Load and reuse 3D assets in React Three Fiber with useGLTF, useLoader, Suspense, and preloading. Use for model loading, decoder setup, caching, cloning, or loading/error UI.
description_zh: 使用 useGLTF、useLoader、Suspense 和 preloading 在 React Three Fiber 中加载和复用 3D 资源。用于模型加载、解码器设置、缓存、克隆或加载/错误界面。

description: Generate videos with Pruna P-Video and WAN models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Video, WAN-T2V, WAN-I2V. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, audio support, 720p/1080p, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna video, p-video, pruna ai video, fast video generation, optimized video, wan t2v, wan i2v, economic video generation, cheap video generation, pruna text to video, pruna image to video
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 Pruna P-Video 和 WAN 模型生成视频。模型：P-Video、WAN-T2V、WAN-I2V。功能：文本转视频、图像转视频、音频支持、720p/1080p、快速推理。Pruna 对模型进行优化，以实现速度提升且不损失画质。触发词：pruna video、p-video、pruna ai video、fast video generation、optimized video、wan t2v、wan i2v、economic video generation、cheap video generation、pruna text to video、pruna image to video

description: NeoData Financial Search — 自然语言通用金融数据搜索服务。用自然语言查询股票、基金、指数、板块、 宏观经济、外汇、大宗商品等全品类金融数据，涵盖行情报价、财务报表（财报）、资金流向、研报评级、 事件公告等，支持结构化API数据和财经文章两种召回模式，即问即答。 Use when the user asks about financial data, stock quotes, financial statements, earnings reports, market data, fund info, macro economics, forex, commodities, or needs to query the NeoData API.
description_zh: NeoData Financial Search — 自然语言通用金融数据搜索服务。用自然语言查询股票、基金、指数、板块、宏观经济、外汇、大宗商品等全品类金融数据，涵盖行情报价、财务报表（财报）、资金流向、研报评级、事件公告等，支持结构化API数据和财经文章两种召回模式，即问即答。适用于用户查询金融数据、股票报价、财务报表、财报、市场数据、基金信息、宏观经济、外汇、大宗商品，或需要查询 NeoData API 时。

description: Transforms raw meeting transcripts into high-fidelity, structured meeting minutes (notes / summaries). Use when (1) a meeting transcript is provided and meeting minutes, notes, or a summary are requested; (2) multiple versions of minutes must be merged without losing content; (3) existing minutes need review against the original transcript for missing items; (4) the transcript has anonymous speakers like "Speaker 1/2/3" or "发言人1" that need identifying (optionally mapped via a context.md team directory). Triggers on 会议纪要 / 会议记录 / 整理纪要 / 妙记转纪要, "write meeting minutes", "summarize this meeting", "merge these minutes", "what's missing from these notes". For fixing ASR/STT recognition errors in the raw transcript first, use transcript-fixer; this skill structures clean transcripts into minutes.
description_zh:
将原始会议转录文本转化为高保真、结构化的会议纪要（笔记/摘要）。适用场景：

(1) 提供了会议转录文本，且需要会议纪要、笔记或摘要；
(2) 需要合并多版会议纪要且不丢失内容；
(3) 已有会议纪要需对照原始转录文本审查缺失内容；
(4) 转录文本包含匿名发言人（如"发言人1/2/3"）且需要指派身份（可通过 context.md 团队目录可选映射）。

触发关键词：会议纪要、会议记录、整理纪要、妙记转纪要、"write meeting minutes"、"summarize this meeting"、"merge these minutes"、"what's missing from these notes"。

首先使用 transcript-fixer 修复原始转录文本中的 ASR/STT 识别错误；本技能将清晰的转录文本整理为会议纪要。

description: End-to-end Dynatrace alerting lifecycle — anomaly detector setup and model selection (static threshold, adaptive baseline, seasonal baseline), alert event storage in Grail, problem grouping and denoising by root cause analysis, and workflow-based notification routing (email, Slack, ServiceNow, webhook). Use when configuring alerting, choosing between detector types, querying alert event history, understanding why alerts merged into a problem, or setting up problem-triggered notifications.
description_zh: 端到端 Dynatrace 告警生命周期——异常检测器设置与模型选择（静态阈值、自适应基线、季节性基线），Grail 中的告警事件存储，基于根因分析的故障分组与降噪，以及基于工作流的通知路由（邮件、Slack、ServiceNow、webhook）。适用于配置告警、选择检测器类型、查询告警事件历史、了解告警为何合并为故障，或设置故障触发的通知。

description: Ultra-lightweight AI assistant in Go that runs on $10 hardware with <10MB RAM, supporting multiple LLM providers, tools, and single-binary deployment across RISC-V, ARM, MIPS, and x86.
description_zh: 基于 Go 语言构建的超轻量级 AI 助手，可在 10 美元硬件上运行，仅使用 <10MB RAM，支持多种 LLM 提供商与工具，并在 RISC-V、ARM、MIPS 和 x86 上实现单二进制部署。

description: Best practices for using Radon IDE's MCP tools when developing, debugging, and inspecting React Native and Expo apps. Use when interacting with a running app through Radon IDE - viewing screenshots, reading logs, inspecting the component tree, debugging network requests, reloading the app, or querying React Native documentation and library info. Trigger on: 'debug React Native', 'fix UI', 'network issues', 'build issues', 'Radon IDE', 'view screenshot', 'app logs', 'component tree', 'network inspector', 'reload app', 'React Native docs', 'library description', 'emulator', 'development viewport', 'view_screenshot', 'view_application_logs', 'view_component_tree', 'reload_application', 'view_network_logs', 'view_network_request_details', 'query_documentation', 'get_library_description', and every request involving live app inspection, debugging or development in a Radon IDE session.
description_zh:
Radon IDE 开发、调试与检查 React Native 和 Expo 应用时使用 MCP 工具的最佳实践。

当通过 Radon IDE 与正在运行的 App 进行交互时使用——包括查看截图、读取日志、检查组件树、调试网络请求、重新加载应用，或查询 React Native 文档与库信息。

触发条件：'debug React Native', 'fix UI', 'network issues', 'build issues', 'Radon IDE', 'view screenshot', 'app logs', 'component tree', 'network inspector', 'reload app', 'React Native docs', 'library description', 'emulator', 'development viewport', 'view_screenshot', 'view_application_logs', 'view_component_tree', 'reload_application', 'view_network_logs', 'view_network_request_details', 'query_documentation', 'get_library_description'，以及涉及 Radon IDE 会话中实时应用检查、调试或开发的所有请求。

description: Synthesizes themes from PayPal disputes, HubSpot tickets, and review exports into a top-3 fixable issues list with drafted response templates. Accepts optional since-date argument.
description_zh: 整合来自PayPal争议、HubSpot工单及评价导出数据的主题，生成包含草拟回复模板的前三大可修复问题清单。接受可选的since-date参数。

description: Use when implementing or debugging ANY network connection, API call, or socket in an Apple app. Covers URLSession, Network.framework, NetworkConnection, connection diagnostics.
description_zh: 在Apple应用中实现或调试任何网络连接、API调用或套接字时使用。涵盖URLSession、Network.framework、NetworkConnection及连接诊断。

description: Map service delivery across frontstage actions, backstage processes, and supporting systems. Use when staff and operations are part of the experience. For the customer-visible layer only, use `experience-map`.
description_zh: 将服务交付映射至前台动作、后台流程和支持系统。当工作人员与运营属于体验的一部分时使用。仅用于客户可见层时，使用 `experience-map`。

description: Recall past Parallel Task, Monitor, and FindAll runs when they may help; evict runs or clear memory when asked.
description_zh: 在可能有帮助时，回顾以往 Parallel Task、Monitor 和 FindAll 的运行；当被要求时，回收运行或清除内存。

description: Fullstack development toolkit with project scaffolding for Next.js, FastAPI, MERN, and Django stacks, code quality analysis with security and complexity scoring, and stack selection guidance. Use when the user asks to "scaffold a new project", "create a Next.js app", "set up FastAPI with React", "analyze code quality", "audit my codebase", "what stack should I use", "generate project boilerplate", or mentions fullstack development, project setup, or tech stack comparison.
description_zh: 全栈开发工具包，为 Next.js、FastAPI、MERN 和 Django 技术栈提供项目脚手架搭建功能，包含代码质量分析（含安全与复杂度评分）及技术栈选择指导。当用户要求执行“搭建新项目”、“创建 Next.js 应用”、“使用 React 配置 FastAPI”、“分析代码质量”、“审计我的代码库”、“我应该使用什么技术栈”、“生成项目模板”，或提及全栈开发、项目配置或技术栈对比时使用。

description: Review a web app or page for visual design quality — layout, typography, spacing, colour, hierarchy, consistency, interaction patterns, and responsive behaviour. Not a UX audit (that checks usability) — this checks whether it looks professional and polished. Produces a design findings report with screenshots. Triggers: 'design review', 'does this look good', 'review the design', 'check the layout', 'is this polished', 'visual review', 'design audit', 'make it look better', 'it looks off'.
description_zh: 检查网页应用或页面的视觉设计质量——布局、排版、间距、颜色、层次、一致性、交互模式及响应式行为。并非用户体验审计（那是检查可用性的）——此检查判断其是否专业且精致。生成包含截图的版面发现报告。触发词：“设计审查”、“这看起来是否美观”、“审查设计”、“检查布局”、“这是否精致”、“视觉审查”、“设计审计”、“让它看起来更好”、“看起来不对”。

description: Create award-winning, cinematic frontend interfaces that feel ALIVE. Combines 10+ years of creative frontend experience with technical excellence. Specializes in WebGL, custom shaders, premium animations, and distinctive aesthetics that would win on Awwwards. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, platforms, or any interface where "generic AI slop" is unacceptable.
description_zh: 打造屡获大奖、电影级质感且充满鲜活生命力的前端界面。融合10年以上创意前端经验与卓越技术实力。精通WebGL、自定义着色器、高端动画以及独特的视觉美学，能够征服Awwwards。适用于构建落地页、数据看板、各类平台，或任何“千篇一律、毫无质感的AI生成内容”不可接受的场景。

description: Build or review Langfuse backend code. Use for tRPC routers, public REST APIs, BullMQ processors, services, middleware, Prisma or ClickHouse access, OpenTelemetry, Zod, environment configuration, or backend tests.
description_zh: 构建或审查 Langfuse 后端代码，用于 tRPC 路由、公开 REST API、BullMQ 处理器、服务、中间件、Prisma 或 ClickHouse 访问、OpenTelemetry、Zod、环境配置或后端测试。

description: Polished, business-ready design with modern typography, structured layouts, and a trustworthy visual identity.
description_zh: 设计精致，契合商务需求，以现代排版、结构化布局展现，并具备值得信赖的视觉形象。

description: AI-powered image generation for Salesforce visuals via Nano Banana Pro. TRIGGER when: user asks for PNG/SVG output, UI mockups, wireframes, visual ERDs, or says "generate image" / "create mockup". DO NOT TRIGGER when: text-based Mermaid diagrams (use sf-diagram-mermaid), or non-visual documentation tasks.
description_zh: 通过 Nano Banana Pro 为 Salesforce 视觉内容提供 AI 驱动的图像生成。触发条件：用户要求 PNG/SVG 输出、UI 模拟图、线框图、可视化 ERD，或说“生成图像”/“创建模拟图”。不要触发条件：基于文本的 Mermaid 图表（使用 sf-diagram-mermaid），或非视觉文档任务。

description: Turn any MCP server, OpenAPI spec, or GraphQL endpoint into a CLI. Use this skill when the user wants to interact with an MCP server, OpenAPI/REST API, or GraphQL API via command line, discover available tools/endpoints, call API operations, or generate a new skill from an API. Triggers include "mcp2cli", "call this MCP server", "use this API", "list tools from", "create a skill for this API", "graphql", or any task involving MCP tool invocation, OpenAPI endpoint calls, or GraphQL queries without writing code.
description_zh: 将任何 MCP 服务器、OpenAPI 规范或 GraphQL 端点转换为 CLI。当用户希望通过命令行与 MCP 服务器、OpenAPI/REST API 或 GraphQL API 进行交互、发现可用工具/端点、调用 API 操作或根据 API 生成新的技能时，使用本技能。触发条件包括 "mcp2cli"、"调用此 MCP 服务器"、"使用此 API"、"从...列出工具"、"为此 API 创建技能"、"graphql"，或任何涉及 MCP 工具调用、OpenAPI 端点调用或 GraphQL 查询且不编写代码的任务。

description: Fully local multi-agent swarm intelligence simulation engine using Neo4j + Ollama for public opinion, market sentiment, and social dynamics prediction.
description_zh: 基于Neo4j和Ollama的完全本地化多智能体群体智能仿真引擎，用于公众舆论、市场情绪及社会动态预测。

description: React Testing Library: user-centric component testing with queries, user-event simulation, async utilities, and accessibility-first API. Use when writing React component tests, selecting elements by role/label/text, simulating user events, or testing async UI behavior. Keywords: React Testing Library, @testing-library/react, user-event, queries, render.
description_zh: React Testing Library：以用户为中心，通过查询、用户事件模拟、异步工具及以无障碍优先的 API 进行的组件测试。在编写 React 组件测试、通过 role/label/textarea 选择元素、模拟用户事件或测试异步 UI 行为时使用。关键词：React Testing Library、@testing-library/react、user-event、queries、render。

description: Agent Script DSL for deterministic Agentforce agents. TRIGGER when: user writes or edits .agent files, builds FSM-based agents, uses Agent Script CLI (sf agent generate authoring-bundle, sf agent validate authoring-bundle, sf agent preview, sf agent publish authoring-bundle, sf agent activate), or asks about deterministic agent patterns, slot filling, or instruction resolution. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Builder metadata work (use sf-ai-agentforce), agent testing (use sf-ai-agentforce-testing), or persona design (use sf-ai-agentforce-persona).
description_zh:
**确定性 Agentforce 代理的 Agent Script DSL。**

**触发条件：** 当用户编写或编辑 .agent 文件、构建基于状态机（FSM）的代理、使用 Agent Script CLI（sf agent generate authoring-bundle、sf agent validate authoring-bundle、sf agent preview、sf agent publish authoring-bundle、sf agent activate），或询问确定性代理模式、槽位填充或指令解析时触发。

**不触发条件：** Builder 元数据工作（使用 sf-ai-agentforce）、代理测试（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-testing）、或人格设计（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-persona）时，不触发。

description: Use when working with multi-item data, batches, paginated APIs, rate-limited APIs, fan-out across multiple branches, anything that needs to "do this for each", or any time the user mentions looping, iterating, batching, paging, parallelism, or "loop over items". Triggers on "loop", "iterate", "for each", "batch", "page through", "paginate", "rate limit", "process all", "fan-out", "parallel branches", "concurrency", or any node that should run once vs once-per-item.
description_zh: 适用于处理多数据项、批量、分页API、限速API、跨多个分支的扇出，以及任何需要“逐个执行此操作”的情况，或用户提及循环、迭代、批量、分页、并行性或“遍历项目”时使用。触发条件包括“循环”、“迭代”、“逐个”、“批量”、“分页遍历”、“分页”、“限速”、“处理所有”、“扇出”、“并行分支”、“并发”，以及任何应一次性运行与每个项目运行一次的情况。

description: Produces structured judgment briefs for contested situations — news events, decisions, conflicts, strategy questions. Surfaces hidden bets, real disagreements, unspeakable truths, and who concretely pays. Use when the user wants sharper thinking about something messy, not a summary.
description_zh: 为争议情境产出结构化的判断简报——包括新闻事件、决策、冲突及战略问题。揭示隐藏的赌注、真实的分歧、难以言说的真相，以及究竟谁会具体买单。适用场景：用户希望对纷繁复杂的事务进行更精准思考时，而非提供摘要。

description: Use PlanetScale Insights and SQLCommenter-style query tags to attribute database load, identify risky queries, and prepare safe Traffic Control or schema recommendations.
description_zh: 使用 PlanetScale Insights 和 SQLCommenter 风格的查询标签，用于归因数据库负载、识别高风险查询，并制定安全的流量控制或架构建议。

description: Vite plugin that reimplements the Next.js API surface for deploying anywhere, including Cloudflare Workers
description_zh: 用于在包括 Cloudflare Workers 在内的任意环境部署，重实现 Next.js API 界面的 Vite 插件

description: Workflow creation, execution, and template management. Automates complex multi-step processes with agent coordination. Use when: automating processes, creating reusable workflows, orchestrating multi-step tasks. Skip when: simple single-step tasks, ad-hoc operations.
description_zh: 工作流创建、执行与模板管理。通过代理协调，自动化复杂的多步骤流程。适用场景：自动化流程、创建可复用工作流、编排多步骤任务。跳过场景：简单的单步任务、临时性操作。

description: Transform audio recordings into professional Markdown documentation with intelligent summaries using LLM integration
description_zh: 利用大语言模型集成，将音频录音转化为具备智能摘要的专业 Markdown 文档

description: Develops iOS/macOS apps with XcodeGen, SwiftUI, and SPM, including Apple Developer signing, notarization, and CI/CD pipelines. Use when building iOS/macOS apps, fixing Xcode build failures, deploying to real devices, or configuring CI/CD signing. Triggers on XcodeGen project.yml, SPM dependency issues, code signing errors (Error -25294, keychain mismatch, adhoc fallback, EMFILE, notarization credential conflict), "Library not loaded @rpath", Electron @electron/osx-sign / @electron/notarize, notarytool, or certificate/provisioning problems.
description_zh: 借助 XcodeGen、SwiftUI 与 SPM 技术开发 iOS/macOS 应用，涵盖 Apple 开发者签名、公证及 CI/CD 流水线配置。适用于构建 iOS/macOS 应用、修复 Xcode 构建失败、将应用部署至真实设备或配置 CI/CD 签名等场景。触发条件包括：XcodeGen 的 project.yml、SPM 依赖问题、代码签名错误（错误 -25294、钥匙串不匹配、adhoc 回退、EMFILE、公证凭证冲突）、"Library not loaded @rpath"、Electron 的 @electron/osx-sign / @electron/notarize、notarytool，或证书/描述文件问题。

description: Use when you want to expose an n8n workflow as a tool the coding agent can call. Two cases. (1) Wrap n8n API capabilities the MCP doesn't natively expose: folder deletion, project create/rename, tag rename/delete, instance metadata, credential creation. (2) Expose a general-purpose workflow as an agent tool: a workflow that calls a third-party API, runs business logic, or does any task you want the agent to invoke. Triggers on "expose as MCP tool", "build a tool for my agent", "I need to know X" where X isn't an MCP tool, "delete folder", "rename tag", or any capability gap.
description_zh: 当您想要将 n8n 工作流暴露为编码代理可调用的工具时使用。两种情况。（1）封装 MCP 原生未暴露的 n8n API 能力：文件夹删除、项目创建/重命名、标签重命名/删除、实例元数据、凭证创建。（2）将通用工作流暴露为代理工具：调用第三方 API、执行业务逻辑或执行任何您希望代理调用的任务的工作流。触发条件包括：“作为 MCP 工具暴露”、“为我的代理构建工具”、“我需要了解 X”（其中 X 不是 MCP 工具）、“删除文件夹”、“重命名标签”或任何能力缺口。

description: Guide for authoring Pulumi ComponentResource classes. Use when creating reusable infrastructure components, designing component interfaces, setting up multi-language support, or distributing component packages.
description_zh: 编写 Pulumi ComponentResource 类的指南。当创建可重用基础设施组件、设计组件接口、设置多语言支持或分发组件包时使用。

description: Dropbox integration. Manage Accounts. Use when the user wants to interact with Dropbox data.
description_zh:
Dropbox 集成。
管理账户。
用户需要与 Dropbox 数据交互时使用。

description: Apply the Law of Proximity — spatial closeness groups elements more strongly than any other cue. Use when spacing alone must carry grouping. For grouping via containers use `law-of-common-region`; via shared appearance use `law-of-similarity`.
description_zh: 应用邻近性原则——空间接近性比其他任何线索都能更强烈地分组元素。当仅凭间距就必须完成分组时使用。通过容器分组时使用 `law-of-common-region`；通过共同外观分组时使用 `law-of-simplarity`。

description: Safely triage PlanetScale schema recommendations and turn them into reviewed branches, migrations, issues, or pull requests without applying production changes.
description_zh: 安全地处理 PlanetScale 模式建议，并将其转化为已审核的分支、迁移、问题或拉取请求，且无需应用生产环境变更。

description: Expert security auditor specializing in DevSecOps, comprehensive cybersecurity, and compliance frameworks.
description_zh: 专注于 DevSecOps、全面网络安全与合规框架的资深安全审计专家。

description: Design the first-run experience — activation path, progressive disclosure, and time to first value. Use for a user's very first session. For the mechanics of the signup form itself, use `form-design`.
description_zh: 设计首次运行体验——激活路径、渐进式披露和首次价值实现时间。用于用户的第一次会话。对于注册表单本身的机制，使用 `form-design`。

description: Master skill that runs the full PlanetScale safe best-practices assessment — inventory, engine review, Insights, Traffic Control, webhooks, schema recommendations, codebase instrumentation, and agent operating model — then produces a unified recommendations report. Never applies changes without explicit approval. Use when the user asks to run the full assessment, all skills, or PlanetScale best-practices review.
description_zh: 用于运行完整的PlanetScale安全最佳实践评估的主技能——涵盖资源清单、引擎审查、洞察、流量控制、Webhooks、模式建议、代码库插桩和智能体运营模型——随后生成一份统一的建议报告。绝不未经明确批准而应用任何更改。适用于当用户要求运行完整评估、所有技能，或进行PlanetScale最佳实践审查时。

description: Use for building, debugging, integrating, migrating, or documenting OpenUI, OpenUI Lang, Agent Interface, OpenUI Cloud, @openuidev packages, streaming generative UI rendering, component libraries, existing-project Cloud integration, self-hosted-to-Cloud migration, migrations from JSON UI formats, Cloud tools (web/image search, artifacts), remote MCP servers, custom function tools and tool loops, and multi-user or multi-app identity (frontend tokens, app_id/user_id, conversation APIs, Responses metadata).
description_zh: 用于构建、调试、集成、迁移或文档化 OpenUI、OpenUI Lang、Agent Interface、OpenUI Cloud、@openuidev 包、流式生成式 UI 渲染、组件库、现有项目的云集成、从自托管迁移至云、从 JSON UI 格式迁移、云工具（网络/图像搜索、制品）、远程 MCP 服务器、自定义函数工具和工具循环，以及多用户或多应用身份（前端令牌、app_id/user_id、对话 API、Responses 元数据）。

description: Google's Material Design with layered surfaces, dynamic theming, built-in motion, and responsive cross-platform patterns.
description_zh: 谷歌的 Material Design 具备分层表面、动态主题、内置动效以及响应式的跨平台设计模式。

description: Create and manage Shopify products via the Admin GraphQL API or CSV import. Workflow: gather data, choose method, execute, verify. Use whenever the user wants to add products to Shopify, bulk-import a catalog from CSV/spreadsheet/URL, update variants or prices, manage inventory quantities, upload product images, or assign products to collections.
description_zh: 通过管理后台 GraphQL API 或 CSV 导入来创建并管理 Shopify 商品。工作流程：收集数据、选择方法、执行、验证。当用户需要向 Shopify 添加商品、从 CSV、电子表格或 URL 批量导入目录、更新变体或价格、管理库存数量、上传商品图片或为商品分配集合时，均可使用。

description: Guidance for working with Pulumi ESC (Environments, Secrets, and Configuration). Use when users ask about managing secrets, configuration, environments, short-term credentials, configuring OIDC for AWS, Azure, GCP, integrating with secret stores (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, 1Password), or using ESC with Pulumi stacks.
description_zh: 关于使用 Pulumi ESC（环境、密钥和配置）的指导。当用户询问有关管理密钥、配置、环境、短期凭证、为 AWS、Azure、GCP 配置 OIDC、与密钥存储（AWS Secrets Manager、Azure Key Vault、HashiCorp Vault、1Password）集成，或在 Pulumi 栈中与 ESC 配合使用的问题时，使用本指南。

description: A skill to build and manage Home Assistant configurations. Use when using the Home Assistant Builder (`hab`) CLI to inspect, create, update, delete, operate, or troubleshoot Home Assistant resources; when a user mentions hab, Home Assistant CLI automation, Lovelace/dashboard edits, helpers, automations, scripts, backups, ESPHome, or Home Assistant operations from a terminal.
description_zh: 用于构建和管理 Home Assistant 配置的技能。使用场景：使用 Home Assistant 构建器（`hab`）CLI 检查、创建、更新、删除、操作或排查 Home Assistant 资源；当用户从终端提及 hab、Home Assistant CLI 自动化、Lovelace/仪表盘编辑、辅助工具、自动化、脚本、备份、ESPHome 或 Home Assistant 操作时使用。

description: Contemporary editorial style with serif typography, minimal palettes, and clean layouts for polished digital products.
description_zh: 现代编辑风格，运用衬线字体、极简配色与简洁布局，为精致数字产品打造。

description: Convert AgentOps skill formats. Triggers: "converter", "convert agentops skill formats.", "converter skill".
description_zh: 转换 AgentOps 技能格式。触发词：“转换器”、“转换 AgentOps 技能格式。”、“转换器技能”。

description: Load only the standards relevant to a caller-supplied change, then report concrete findings. Triggers: "check standards", "which standards apply".
description_zh: 仅加载与调用方提供的变更相关的标准，然后报告具体发现。触发条件：“检查标准”、“哪些标准适用”。

description: Guides the usage of Gemini API on Google Cloud Vertex AI with the Gen AI SDK. Use when the user asks about using Gemini in an enterprise environment or explicitly mentions Vertex AI. Covers SDK usage (Python, JS/TS, Go, Java, C#), capabilities like Live API, tools, multimedia generation, caching, and batch prediction.
Claude Code subagents for offensive security research, penetration testing planning, recon analysis, exploit research, detection engineering, and security reporting
description_zh: Claude Code 子代理，用于攻击性安全研究、渗透测试规划、侦察分析、漏洞研究、检测工程和安全报告

description: Current-era minimalist design with bento grids, dark mode support, and high-performance accessible layouts.
description_zh: 当代极简设计，支持 bento 网格、深色模式及高性能无障碍布局。

description: Binance Convert request using the Binance API. Authentication requires API key and secret key.
description_zh: 使用 Binance API 发起 Convert 请求。认证需要 API 密钥和密钥。

description: Turn a reference Instagram Reel into a script for your own Reel, tuned to your voice and repurposed from your newsletter content. Takes a Reel URL or Notion reference link, uses Apify to scrape the video, sends it to Gemini 2.5 Flash for full transcript + hook + structure analysis, then writes a new script applying the same patterns to your newsletter topic. Use this skill whenever the user says "script a reel", "reels scripting", "turn this into a reel", pastes an Instagram Reel URL, or references their Notion outlier reels database. The URL-to-video-analysis route needs APIFY_API_TOKEN and GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY; supplied input can skip the corresponding stages.
description_zh: 将参考的 Instagram Reel 转化为适合您本人口吻、并基于您的通讯录内容重新改编的脚本。接受 Reel 网址或 Notion 参考链接，使用 Apify 抓取视频，将其发送至 Gemini 2.5 Flash 进行完整转录、钩子与结构分析，随后基于相同的模式，为您的通讯录主题撰写新脚本。当用户表示“编写 Reel 脚本”、“进行 Reel 脚本制作”、“将此内容转化为 Reel”、粘贴 Instagram Reel 网址，或引用其 Notion 异常 Reel 数据库时，使用此技能。URL 转视频分析流程需要 APIFY_API_TOKEN 和 GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY；若提供输入内容，可跳过相应阶段。

description: Execute approved PlanetScale changes end-to-end without per-step approval when the operator has explicitly acknowledged the risk. Defines the risk-acknowledgment contract, scoped autonomy levels, sensible execution ordering, continuous status reporting, halt conditions, and rollback discipline. Extremely safe, very enabling.
description_zh: 当操作者明确确认了风险后，执行已批准的 PlanetScale 变更端到端，无需逐步骤审批。定义了风险确认协议、受限自主级别、合理的执行顺序、持续状态报告、停止条件和回滚纪律。极其安全，极具赋能。

description: Covers upgrading Qdrant server and SDKs without interrupting availability or losing data integrity. Use when someone asks 'how do I upgrade Qdrant', 'can I jump from 1.15 to 1.18', 'rolling upgrade without downtime', 'do I upgrade the client or the server first', 'which SDK version matches my server', 'what should I check before upgrading', or 'something changed after we upgraded'.
description_zh: 覆盖在不中断服务可用性且不丢失数据完整性的前提下，对 Qdrant 服务器和 SDK 进行升级的相关内容。在有人询问“如何升级 Qdrant”、“我能否从 1.15 升级到 1.18”、“如何进行无停机的滚动升级”、“我应该先升级客户端还是服务器”、“哪个 SDK 版本与我的服务器匹配”、“升级前应该检查什么”，或“我们在升级后有什么变化”时使用。

description: Forward-looking design with tech-inspired typography, modern layouts, and a sleek, innovation-driven aesthetic.
description_zh: 以前瞻性设计、科技启发的字体、现代版式布局，营造简洁流畅、创新驱动的美学风格。

description: Use when designing small UI feedback moments like button states, toggles, form validation, loading indicators, or notification badges.
description_zh: 用于设计小型UI反馈瞬间，如按钮状态、开关、表单验证、加载指示器或通知徽标。

description: Web platform design and accessibility guidelines. Use when building web interfaces, auditing accessibility, implementing responsive layouts, or reviewing web UI code. Triggers on tasks involving HTML, CSS, web components, WCAG compliance, responsive design, or web performance.
description_zh: Web 平台设计与无障碍指南。用于构建 Web 界面、审计无障碍性、实施响应式布局或审查 Web UI 代码时使用。在涉及 HTML、CSS、Web 组件、WCAG 合规性、响应式设计或 Web 性能的任务时触发。

description: Use when handling external API rate limits (e.g., OpenAI 429s, HubSpot or Stripe rate limits), preventing duplicate work from rapid event bursts (debouncing user actions), spreading load over time, ensuring per-tenant fairness, processing events in batches, limiting concurrent runs of the same operation, or assigning priority to important runs. Covers Inngest flow control: concurrency limits with keys, throttling, rate limiting, debounce, priority, singleton, and event batching.
description_zh: 用于处理外部 API 速率限制（例如 OpenAI 429 错误、HubSpot 或 Stripe 速率限制）、防止快速事件突发（通过防抖用户操作）导致的重复工作、在时间上分散负载、确保租户间公平、批量处理事件、限制同一操作的并发运行，或为重要任务分配优先级。涵盖 Inngest 流控：基于键的并发限制、节流、速率限制、防抖、优先级、单例与事件批处理。

description: Guide for creating effective skills that extend agent capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations. Use this skill when the user asks to: (1) create a new skill, (2) make a skill, (3) build a skill, (4) set up a skill, (5) initialize a skill, (6) scaffold a skill, (7) update or modify an existing skill, (8) validate a skill, (9) learn about skill structure, (10) understand how skills work, or (11) get guidance on skill design patterns. Trigger on phrases like "create a skill", "new skill", "make a skill", "skill for X", "how do I create a skill", or "help me build a skill".
description_zh: 用于创建能够有效扩展智能体能力、融入专门知识、工作流程或工具集成的技能的指南。当用户询问时使用本技能：(1) 创建新技能，(2) 制作技能，(3) 构建技能，(4) 设置技能，(5) 初始化技能，(6) 搭建技能，(7) 更新或修改现有技能，(8) 验证技能，(9) 了解技能结构，(10) 理解技能如何运作，或 (11) 获取关于技能设计模式的指导。在类似“创建技能”、“新技能”、“制作技能”、“用于X的技能”、“我如何创建技能”或“帮助我构建技能”等短语时触发。

description: Apply the Law of Common Region — a shared container, background, or border groups elements regardless of spacing. Use when grouping must survive a tight layout. For grouping by spacing alone, use `law-of-proximity`.
description_zh: 应用“共同区域”法则——即根据共同的区域（如共享的容器、背景或边框），无论元素间距如何，都将这些元素归为一组。当必须将分组方式保留在紧凑布局中时使用。若仅依据间距进行分组，则使用 `law-of-proximity`。

description: Set line length and measure for comfortable reading across type sizes and breakpoints. Use when tuning body text. Covers measure only — for the full size and weight scale, use `typography-scale`.
description_zh: 设置行高与字宽，确保在不同字号和断点下都能舒适阅读。用于调节正文。仅覆盖字宽——若需完整的字号与字重范围，请使用 `typography-scale`。

description: Design search — query input, zero results, refinement, and result presentation. Use when users retrieve rather than browse. For browse structure, use `navigation-patterns`.
description_zh:
设计搜索 — 查询输入、零结果、筛选与结果展示。
用户检索而非浏览时使用。
针对浏览结构，使用 `navigation-patterns`。

description: Generate a personal Claude Code usage & impact report ("receipts") from this machine's local session transcripts — for justifying Claude Code usage/spend to a manager, self-review, or "what have I been using this for" check-ins. Mines ~/.claude/projects locally (no extra API calls beyond one final write-up), cross-references local git history, and writes a markdown report plus a self-contained HTML receipt to your home directory. Use when the user asks for "receipts", an "impact report", "usage report", wants to "show my Claude Code activity", "prove the value of Claude Code", or runs `/receipts`.
description_zh: 从本机的本地会话记录中生成一份个人 Claude Code 使用与影响报告（"receipts"）——用于向经理说明 Claude Code 的使用情况/支出、进行自我评审，或进行"我这段时间内都使用它来做什么"的例行检查。在本地挖掘 `~/.claude/projects` 下的数据（除最终撰写总结外，不进行额外的 API 调用），与本地 git 历史进行交叉参考，并将一份 Markdown 报告以及一份自包含的 HTML 收据写入你的家庭目录。当用户请求"receipts"、"impact report"、"usage report"、希望"展示我的 Claude Code 活动"、"证明 Claude Code 的价值"，或执行 `/receipts` 命令时使用本功能。

description: Shared payment and setup skill for fetcher.sh, a pay-per-call web-data API covering Twitter/X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Google Search, Google Maps, Google News, Google Play, the App Store, and Yelp. Use this skill whenever a task needs a fetcher.sh API key, a credit top-up, an x402 micropayment, MCP server configuration, or an explanation of the { status, message, data } response envelope and error codes — before or alongside any of the per-service skills (twitter-api, x-api, tiktok-api, instagram-api, youtube-api, reddit-api, google-search, google-maps, google-news, google-play, app-store, yelp). Also use it when the user asks how to pay with USDC, fund an agent wallet, set up credits, mint or rotate an API key, or connect an MCP client to fetcher.sh.
description_zh: fetcher.sh 的共享支付与设置技能，这是一个涵盖 Twitter/X、TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Reddit、Google Search、Google Maps、Google News、Google Play、App Store 和 Yelp 的按次付费网络数据 API。当任何任务需要 fetcher.sh API 密钥、额度充值、x402 微小支付、MCP 服务器配置，或解释 { status, message, data } 响应封装及错误码时，请使用此技能——在任何单一服务技能（twitter-api、x-api、tiktok-api、instagram-api、youtube-api、reddit-api、google-search、google-maps、google-news、google-play、app-store、yelp）之前或与之配合时使用。当用户询问如何使用 USDC 支付、为代理钱包充值、设置额度、铸造或轮换 API 密钥，或将 MCP 客户端连接到 fetcher.sh 时，也请使用此技能。

description: Operate InstaCloud infrastructure with the `insta` CLI: create projects, add postgres/storage/compute services, deploy apps, create disposable branch environments (isolated DB + storage + compute per branch), bind service credentials into compute env, wire user secrets into `.env`, run multiple agents each in their own branch, handle governance approvals, check metrics/logs/usage, and promote branches to main. Use this skill when working in an InstaCloud-managed project (a `.insta/` dir or the `insta` CLI), when the user mentions InstaCloud or insta, AND when they ask to deploy an app, need a database/backend/object storage, want preview or per-agent sandbox environments, want branchable infrastructure, want to migrate an existing app in from Heroku / Railway / Fly / Render, or mention agent setup or MCP — even if they don't say "InstaCloud" explicitly. Also covers the insta-cloud remote MCP server (insta_* tools) and the self-hosted insta-oss runtime (same CLI, local daemon).
description_zh:
使用 `insta` CLI 管理 InstaCloud 基础设施：创建项目、添加 PostgreSQL/存储/计算服务、部署应用、为每个分支创建独立的数据库、存储和计算环境（每个分支均拥有独立的 DB、存储和计算资源）、将服务凭证绑定到计算环境、将用户密钥配置到 `.env`、让多个 Agent 各自运行在自己的分支中、处理治理审批、检查指标/日志/使用情况，并将分支提升至 `main` 分支。

在 InstaCloud 管理的项目（`.insta/` 目录或 `insta` CLI）中工作时使用本技能，当用户提及 InstaCloud 或 insta，且询问部署应用、需要数据库/后端/对象存储、需要预览或按 Agent 划分的沙盒环境、需要可分支的基础设施、希望从 Heroku / Railway / Fly / Render 迁移现有应用，或提及 Agent 配置或 MCP 时，即使用户未明确提及“InstaCloud”，也应使用此技能。

此外，还涵盖 InstaCloud 远程 MCP 服务器（`insta_*` 工具）以及自托管的 insta-oss 运行时（使用相同的 CLI，本地守护进程）。

description: Salesforce integration. Manage crm and marketing automation data, records, and workflows. Use when the user wants to interact with Salesforce data.
description_zh:
Salesforce 集成。

管理 CRM 和营销自动化数据、记录和流程。

当用户需要与 Salesforce 数据交互时使用。

description: Execute the implementation planning workflow using the plan template to generate design artifacts.
description_zh: 使用计划模板执行实施规划工作流程，以生成设计成果。

description: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于33+位传奇设计师）。支持多平台多比例：公众号封面(21:9)、小红书配图(3:4)、文章配图(16:9)、书籍封面(9:16)、专辑封面(1:1)、电影海报(9:16)。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封面设计"、"专辑封面"、"海报设计"、"读书笔记配图"、"公众号封面"、"小红书配图"、"文章配图"。One-sentence generation of master-level posters, book covers, album covers and designs. 33+ legendary designer styles with multi-platform aspect ratio support (21:9, 16:9, 3:4, 1:1, 9:16).
description_zh: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于33+位传奇设计师）。支持多平台多比例：公众号封面(21:9)、小红书配图(3:4)、文章配图(16:9)、书籍封面(9:16)、专辑封面(1:1)、电影海报(9:16)。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封面设计"、"专辑封面"、"海报设计"、"读书笔记配图"、"公众号封面"、"小红书配图"、"文章配图"。一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。33+位传奇设计师风格，支持多平台多比例（21:9、16:9、3:4、1:1、9:16）。

description: Create cinematic scroll-driven landing pages with Lenis smooth scrolling, GSAP ScrollTrigger, scroll-linked progression, staggered text reveals, sticky card stacks, parallax backgrounds, scroll-scrubbed transitions, footer reveals, and immersive preloaders. Use when analyzing or building premium editorial scroll experiences, sticky project stacks, kinetic typography, or section-by-section storytelling.
description_zh: 使用 Lenis 平滑滚动、GSAP ScrollTrigger、滚动关联的推进、错落文字揭示、粘性卡片堆叠、视差背景、滚动驱动的转场、页脚显现以及沉浸式预加载器，创建电影感的滚动驱动落地页。适用于分析或构建高级编辑滚动体验、粘性项目堆叠、动态排版或分章节叙事等场景。

description: Generate personalized music playlists by analyzing the user's music taste and generation feedback history. Triggers on any request involving playlist generation, music taste profiling, or personalized music recommendations. Supports multilingual triggers — match equivalent phrases in any language.
description_zh: 通过分析用户音乐品味和生成反馈历史，生成个性化音乐播放列表。在涉及播放列表生成、音乐品味分析或个性化音乐推荐的任何请求时触发。支持多语言触发——匹配任意语言中的等效短语。

description: Use when working with n8n's built-in Data Tables, designing schemas, inserting/updating/upserting rows, deduping, or querying. Triggers on "Data Table", "data table", `n8n-nodes-base.dataTable`, "dedup", "idempotency", "lookup", "persistent state", "store across executions", or any schema design discussion inside n8n.
description_zh: 用于在操作n8n内置数据表、设计表结构、插入/更新/upsert数据行、进行去重或查询时使用。当触发条件涉及“Data Table”、“data table”、`n8n-nodes-base.dataTable`、“dedup”、“idempotency”、“lookup”、“persistent state”、“store across executions”或n8n内的任何表结构设计讨论时触发。

description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件自动化语义化版本管理及发布工作流。该工作流覆盖 package.json、marketplace.json、plugin.json 等清单文件中的版本号递增，以及构建验证、git 打标签、GitHub 发布和变更日志生成。由于维护者提出了 npm 安全相关事项，NPM 发布是最终需要人工交接的环节。

description: Use this skill when you writing commands, hooks, skills for Agent, or prompts for sub agents or any other LLM interaction, including optimizing prompts, improving LLM outputs, or designing production prompt templates.
description_zh: 当您需要编写指令、钩子、智能体技能，或为子代理编写提示，以及进行任何其他 LLM 交互时，使用本技能，包括优化提示、提升 LLM 输出或设计生产级提示模板。

description: Design unbiased survey instruments — question wording, scales, and sampling — to measure attitudes at scale. Use when you need quantitative breadth. For behavioural experiments, use `a-b-test-design` (prototyping-testing).

description:
Call third-party APIs through the Maton gateway, which injects the credential for an app the user has already connected.
Use this skill when the user names a connected app and a concrete action in it - read a mailbox, query a CRM, file an issue, update a spreadsheet, run a query through a connected search or scraping provider.
Every call goes to an app the user connected. It is not a general-purpose browser or network client, and it cannot reach a service with no Maton connection.
It also manages event triggers, webhook destinations that forward event payloads to an external URL until deleted, and local `--exec` handlers that run a script per event - separate, high-risk capabilities beyond a normal API call.
Default to read and list calls; every write, connection, trigger, destination, or handler needs explicit user confirmation.
description_zh:
通过 Maton 网关调用第三方 API，该网关为用户已连接的 app 注入凭据。

当用户指定已连接的 app 及其具体操作时，请使用此技能（例如读取邮箱、查询 CRM、提交工单、更新电子表格，或通过已连接的搜索或抓取提供商执行查询）。

每一次调用都指向用户已连接的 app。它并非通用的浏览器或网络客户端，且无法访问未经 Maton 连接的任何服务。

它还管理事件触发器、在删除前将事件负载转发至外部 URL 的 webhook 目标，以及针对每个事件执行脚本的本地 `--exec` 处理器——这些是超出普通 API 调用之外的独立、高风险功能。

默认为读取和列表类调用；每一项写入、连接、触发器、目标或处理器的操作均需用户明确的确认。
