description_zh: 应用赫克定律——决策时间随同时选择数量的增加而增长。当屏幕一次提供过多选项时使用。对于后续有多少项目能够留存于记忆，使用 `millers-law`。

description: Design for multiple languages, writing directions, and cultural contexts — text expansion, RTL mirroring, and locale formats. Use when shipping beyond one locale. For the words themselves, use `ux-writing` (designer-toolkit).
description_zh: 为多种语言、书写方向和文化语境而设计——文本扩展、RTL镜像和区域格式。当需向多个区域交付时使用。针对具体文字，使用 `ux-writing` (designer-toolkit)。

description: Apply the Von Restorff Effect — the element that differs from its neighbours is the one remembered. Use when a single action must dominate. For overall ordering rather than single-element emphasis, use `visual-hierarchy`.
description_zh: 应用冯·雷斯托夫效应——与周围元素不同的元素是更容易被记住的元素。当需要单一行动占据主导地位时使用。对于整体排序而非单一元素强调，使用 `visual-hierarchy`。

description: Manage account auth, query usage, billing, and subscriptions. Use for: login, logout, check usage, view billing summary/breakdown, spending limit, free tier quota, Token Plan status, coding plan status, pay-as-you-go costs, call logs (which requests failed, 4xx/5xx errors, request latency, recent models called, request-id lookup), subscription orders, team seats. Skip for: model browsing, payment methods (use qwencloud-payment).
description_zh:
管理账户身份认证、查询用量、账单和订阅。

用于：登录、登出、检查用量、查看账单摘要/明细、查看支出限额、查看免费层级额度、Token Plan 状态、编码计划状态、按需付费费用、调用日志（哪些请求失败、4xx/5xx 错误、请求延迟、近期调用的模型、请求 ID 查询）、订阅订单、团队席位。

跳过用于：模型浏览、支付方式（使用 qwencloud-payment）。

description: Clean AI-generated code slop with a regression-safe, deletion-first workflow and optional reviewer-only mode
description_zh: 通过防回归、优先删除的工作流程清理AI生成的代码冗余，并提供可选的仅审查者模式

description: Automates ingestion of documents into the Obsidian wiki (obsidian-wiki) using the wiki-ingest pipeline. Handles deduplication via manifest, frontmatter, and cross-links; triggers on user request within the obsidian-wiki project context.
description_zh: 使用 wiki-ingest 管道自动化文档导入 Obsidian wiki（obsidian-wiki）。通过 manifest、frontmatter 和交叉链接处理去重；根据 obsidian-wiki 项目上下文中的用户请求触发。

description: Configure textures in React Three Fiber, including color spaces, UV channels, sampling, video, and render targets. Use for texture appearance or memory issues; use loader guidance for model-loading workflows.
description_zh: 在 React Three Fiber 中配置纹理，包括色彩空间、UV通道、采样、视频和渲染目标。用于纹理外观或内存问题；使用加载器指南处理模型加载工作流。

description: Expert guidelines for Native WeChat Mini Program development focusing on performance, code size, and native compatibility. Use when developing WeChat Mini Programs in native JavaScript.
description_zh: 专注于性能、代码大小和原生兼容性的原生微信小程序开发专家指南。用于在原生JavaScript中开发微信小程序。

description: 러브버그.com 공개 지도 표면으로 수도권 시·구별 러브버그 출몰 지수·동네별 제보 현황을 조회하고, 사용자가 제공한 현재 좌표로 익명 러브버그 제보를 제출한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在러브버그.com的公开地图上，可查询首都圈按市、区分的러브버그出现指数及社区提交情况，并基于用户提供的当前坐标提交匿名러브버그报告。在“돌쇠”中，可执行通过官方界面进行的后续行动。

description: TypeScript performance, tsconfig, type errors, async patterns — triggered when the user asks to "optimize TypeScript performance", "speed up tsc compilation", "configure tsconfig.json", "fix type errors", "improve async patterns", or encounters TS errors (TS2322, TS2339, "is not assignable to"). Also triggers on .ts, .tsx, .d.ts file work involving type definitions, module organization, or memory management. Does NOT cover TypeScript basics, framework-specific patterns, or testing.
description_zh: TypeScript 性能、tsconfig、类型错误、异步模式——当用户要求“优化 TypeScript 性能”、“加快 tsc 编译速度”、“配置 tsconfig.json”、“修复类型错误”、“改进异步模式”，或遇到 TS 错误（TS2322、TS2339、“is not assignable to”）时触发。此外，在处理涉及类型定义、模块组织或内存管理的 .ts、.tsx、.d.ts 文件时也会触发。不涵盖 TypeScript 基础、框架特定模式或测试。

description: This skill should be used when user wants to access, capture, or reference Claude Code session history. Trigger when user says "capture session", "save session history", or references past/current conversation as a source - whether for saving, extracting, summarizing, or reviewing. This includes any mention of "what we discussed", "today's work", "session history", or when user treats the conversation itself as source material (e.g., "from our conversation").
description_zh: 当用户需要访问、捕获或引用 Claude Code 会话历史时，应使用本技能。当用户说出“捕获会话”、“保存会话历史”，或将过往或当前对话引用为来源时，应触发该技能——无论出于保存、提取、总结或审查的目的。这包括任何对“我们所讨论的内容”、“今日工作”、“会话历史”的提及，以及用户将对话本身视为来源材料的情况（例如“从我们的对话中”）。

description: Scaffold, build, and package SwiftPM-based macOS apps without an Xcode project. Use when you need a from-scratch macOS app layout, SwiftPM targets/resources, a custom .app bundle assembly script, or signing/notarization/appcast steps outside Xcode.
description_zh: 无需Xcode项目即可搭建、构建并打包基于SwiftPM的macOS应用。适用于您需要从零开始构建macOS应用布局、SwiftPM目标/资源、自定义.app捆绑组装脚本，或执行Xcode之外的签名、公证、应用列表（appcast）等步骤的场景。

description: Build responsive, mobile-first web applications. Use when implementing responsive layouts, touch interactions, mobile navigation, or optimizing for various screen sizes. Triggers on responsive design, mobile-first, breakpoints, touch events, viewport.
description_zh: 构建响应式、移动优先的 Web 应用。适用于实现响应式布局、触控交互、移动导航，或优化以适配各种屏幕尺寸。触发条件包括响应式设计、移动优先、断点、触控事件、视口。

description: Browser automation, visual testing, and screenshot validation using Playwright MCP server for accelerated web development. Master visual regression testing, automated UI testing, and cross-browser validation.
description_zh: 使用 Playwright MCP 服务器进行浏览器自动化、视觉测试与截图验证，加速网页开发。掌握视觉回归测试、自动化 UI 测试与跨浏览器验证。

description: Inventory and prioritise accumulated design inconsistencies across a product. Use when drift has built up over time. For token coverage specifically use `design-token-audit` (designer-toolkit); for WCAG gaps use `accessibility-audit` (design-systems).
description_zh: 盘点并优先处理产品范围内的累积设计不一致问题。当漂移随时间推移逐渐累积时使用。专门针对 token 覆盖情况，请使用 `design-token-audit`（designer-toolkit）；针对 WCAG 差距，请使用 `accessibility-audit`（design-systems）。

description: Apply Miller's Law — chunk information into groups of about four to fit working memory. Use when grouping fields, menu items, or steps. For reducing the number of choices offered, use `hicks-law`.
description_zh: 应用米尔定律——将信息分组成约四个一组，以适应工作记忆。在对字段、菜单项或步骤进行分组时使用。为减少所提供的选项数量，使用 `hicks-law`。

description: Adversarial code review using cross-model approach. Spawns reviewers on the opposing model (Claude uses Codex, Codex uses Claude) to challenge work from distinct critical lenses. Produces a synthesized verdict with findings and lead judgment. Triggers: "adversarial review".
description_zh: 基于跨模型的对抗性代码审查。由对抗模型生成审查者（Claude使用Codex，Codex使用Claude），以不同的批判视角挑战审查工作。产出包含发现与主要判断的综合裁决。触发：'adversarial review'。

description: Use when you need Apple's own documentation or a Swift compiler diagnostic explained rather than recalled.
description_zh: 当您需要 Apple 官方文档，或需要 Swift 编译器诊断信息已说明而非需回忆时使用。

description: Use when writing or reviewing Jetpack Compose motion: visibility enter/exit, animating one property toward a target, color or size transitions, multiple properties from one state, switching composable content, or choosing between AnimatedVisibility, animate*AsState, rememberTransition, AnimatedContent, and Crossfade.
description_zh: 适用于编写或审查 Jetpack Compose 动画时：处理可见性进入/退出、将单个属性动画化至目标值、颜色或尺寸过渡、从一个状态过渡多个属性、切换可组合内容，或在 AnimatedVisibility、animate*AsState、rememberTransition、AnimatedContent 与 Crossfade 之间进行选择。

description: A Google Maps API alternative and Google Places API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no Google Cloud billing account. Use when the user wants to search places by text query or anchor the search to a latitude/longitude coordinate, fetch a place's full details by its feature ID (fid), pull a place's reviews sorted by relevance/newest/rating, or look up a single review by ID. Also covers local business discovery, points-of-interest data, store-locator input, and review monitoring without Google Cloud Platform's API key setup, billing, and per-request pricing.
description_zh: 在 fetcher.sh 上，为您提供谷歌地图API替代方案与谷歌地点API替代方案——可通过 x402 使用 USDC 按次付费，或通过 Bearer 密钥使用预付费额度，无需注册谷歌云账单账户。适用于用户通过文本查询搜索地点、根据经纬度坐标定位搜索、通过功能ID（fid）获取地点完整详情、拉取按相关性/最新/评分排序的地点评论，或按ID查询单条评论的场景。此外，还涵盖本地商家发现、兴趣点数据、店铺定位输入与评论监控等功能，无需进行谷歌云平台API密钥设置、计费及单次请求计费操作。

description:
去除文字中的 AI 生成痕跡。適用於編輯或審閱文字，使其聽起來更自然、更像人類書寫。
基於維基百科的「AI 寫作特徵」綜合指南。偵測並修復以下模式：誇大的象徵意義、
宣傳性語言、以 -ing 結尾的膚淺分析、模糊的歸因、破折號過度使用、三段式法則、
AI 詞彙、否定式排比、過多的連接性短語。若使用者要求清理不可見 Unicode、
文字型 AI 浮水印或檔案 provenance，改用 $text-watermark-cleaner-zh-tw，
不要在本 skill 中把語氣改寫冒充成浮水印已移除。
description_zh:
去除文字中的 AI 生成痕迹。适用于编辑或审阅文字，使其听起来更自然、更像人类书写。

基于维基百科的「AI 写作特征」综合指南。检测并修复以下模式：夸大的象征意义、
宣传性语言、以 -ing 结尾的肤浅分析、模糊的归因、破折号过度使用、三段式法则、
AI 词汇、否定式排比、过多的连接性短语。若使用者要求清理不可见 Unicode、
文字型 AI 浮水印或文件的 provenance，改用 $文本浮水印-cleaner-zh-tw，
不要在本 skill 中将语气改写冒充为浮水印已移除。

description: Use when designing or implementing product-grade web motion like Stripe, Linear, Apple, and Vercel. Covers motion principles, easing/duration defaults, choreography patterns, scroll/hover interactions, performance, accessibility (reduced motion), and implementation guidance.
description_zh: 适用于设计或实现类似 Stripe、Linear、Apple 和 Vercel 的产品级网页动效。涵盖动效原则、缓动/时长默认值、编排模式、滚动/悬停交互、性能、无障碍性（减弱动态效果）以及实现指导。

description: Guidelines for building robust APIs with Express.js and TypeScript, covering middleware patterns, routing, and security best practices
description_zh: 基于 Express.js 和 TypeScript 构建健壮 API 的指南，涵盖中间件模式、路由及安全最佳实践

description: Generative UI framework that renders AI-generated JSON specs into type-safe UI components across React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, React Native, video, PDF, and email.
description_zh: 支持React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、React Native、视频、PDF和邮件的生成式UI框架，能够将AI生成的JSON规范渲染为类型安全UI组件。

description: Research tool for visually exploring BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook data with an interactive treemap, LLM-powered scoring pipeline, and data scraping/parsing utilities.
description_zh: 一款用于可视化探索BLS职业展望手册数据的研究工具，具备交互式树状图、LLM驱动的评分流程以及数据抓取/解析工具。

description: Comprehensive guidance for mastering TypeScript's advanced type system including generics, conditional types, mapped types, template literal types, and utility types for building robust, type-safe applications.
description_zh: 全面掌握TypeScript高级类型系统的指南：涵盖泛型、条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量类型及工具类型，助力构建稳健、类型安全的应用。

description: Define how the system evolves — contribution model, versioning, deprecation, and change management. Use when multiple teams contribute. For driving uptake use `design-system-adoption` (designer-toolkit); for design file history use `version-control-strategy` (design-ops).
description_zh: 定义系统的演进方式——包括贡献模型、版本管理、弃用和变更管理。当多个团队参与贡献时使用。推动采用时使用 `design-system-adoption`（designer-toolkit）；设计文件历史管理使用 `version-control-strategy`（design-ops）。

description: Reference for Zustand 5.x state management including slices, middleware, Immer, useShallow, persistence, selectors, and devtools integration. Documents 7 core patterns with TypeScript examples and anti-patterns. Use when building React state management with Zustand instead of Redux.
description_zh: Zustand 5.x 状态管理参考指南，涵盖 slices、中间件、Immer、useShallow、持久化、selectors 和开发工具集成。文档介绍 7 种核心模式，并提供 TypeScript 示例与反模式。适用于使用 Zustand 构建 React 状态管理并替代 Redux 的场景。

description: An Apple App Store API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no Apple Developer Program membership. Use when the user wants to search iOS apps by keyword in any country's storefront, fetch an app's or app bundle's full details, reviews sorted by recent/helpful, apps similar to a given app, search or fetch app bundles, or fetch a developer's app catalog. Also covers iOS app store optimization (ASO) research, competitor app monitoring, localized storefront comparison, and app discovery without Apple Developer Program access.
description_zh: fetcher.sh 上的 Apple App Store API 替代方案——通过 x402 以 USDC 按调用付费，或使用 Bearer 密钥预付费积分，无需 Apple 开发者计划会员资格。适用于用户在任何国家的商店中按关键词搜索 iOS 应用、获取应用或应用包完整详情、按最近/有用排序的评论、与给定应用相似的应用、搜索或获取应用包、获取开发者应用目录的场景。同时涵盖 iOS 应用商店优化（ASO）研究、竞品应用监控、本地化商店对比，以及无需 Apple 开发者计划访问即可进行应用发现的需求。

description: Structured prompts, vault templates, and autonomous research workflows for AI-assisted genealogy using Claude Code.
description_zh: 使用Claude Code进行AI辅助家谱研究的结构化提示词、保险库模板与自主研究工作流

description: Platform-neutral guidance for using Open Computer Use, the open-source Computer Use MCP server and CLI for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Use when an agent needs to install, verify, troubleshoot, configure, or operate Open Computer Use through its native CLI, stdio MCP server, or direct Computer Use tool calls.
description_zh: 使用 Open Computer Use 的平台中立指南，该指南是适用于 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的开源 Computer Use MCP 服务器与命令行工具。适用于 Agent 需要通过其原生 CLI、stdio MCP 服务器或直接调用 Computer Use 工具来安装、验证、排除故障、配置或运行 Open Computer Use 时使用。

description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.
description_zh: 基于 Exa 的 Web 工具包，专为科学和技术内容优化。当用户需要搜索网络或获取/提取 URL 内容时，使用此技能。涵盖内容：网络搜索（语义检索、研究、当前信息——可选研究论文类别及学术领域筛选）以及 URL 提取（批量获取页面、文章、学术 PDF 文件）。当用户希望对网络相关任务进行高质量搜索，或通过 category=research paper 进行学术筛选时，使用此技能。当用户提出搜索、查询、获取页面或提取文章等请求时触发。

description: Train or fine-tune sentence-transformers models across `SentenceTransformer` (bi-encoder, dense or static embedding model for retrieval, similarity, clustering, classification, paraphrase mining, dedup, multimodal), `CrossEncoder` (reranker, pair scoring for two-stage retrieval / pair classification), `SparseEncoder` (SPLADE, sparse embedding model for learned-sparse retrieval), and `MultiVectorEncoder` (ColBERT / late-interaction, per-token embeddings scored with MaxSim). Covers loss selection, hard-negative mining, evaluators, distillation, LoRA, Matryoshka, and Hugging Face Hub publishing. Use for any sentence-transformers training task.
description_zh: 在 `SentenceTransformer`（双编码器、用于检索、相似度、聚类、分类、释义挖掘、去重及多模态的稠密或静态嵌入模型）、`CrossEncoder`（重排序器，用于两阶段检索/成对分类的成对评分）、`SparseEncoder`（SPLADE，用于学习式稀疏检索的稀疏嵌入模型）及 `MultiVectorEncoder`（ColBERT / 晚期交互，使用 MaxSim 进行逐 token 嵌入评分）上进行句子嵌入模型的训练或微调。涵盖损失选择、硬负样本挖掘、评估器、知识蒸馏、LoRA、Matryoshka 及 Hugging Face Hub 发布。适用于任何句子嵌入模型的训练任务。

description: Use when user wants their Claude Code pet (/buddy) to sing a song. Triggers on any request that combines the concept of their Claude Code buddy, pet, or companion with singing or music. Supports multilingual triggers — match equivalent phrases in any language.
description_zh: 当用户希望其 Claude Code 宠物（/buddy）唱歌时使用。触发条件为任何将用户 Claude Code 的伙伴、宠物或伴侣概念与唱歌或音乐结合在一起的请求。支持多语言触发 — 匹配任意语言的等效表达。

description: Desktop app that generates 3D models from images using local AI running entirely on your GPU
description_zh: 利用在您本地 GPU 上完全运行的本地 AI 的桌面应用，可从图片生成 3D 模型

description: Generate a high-quality deep-reading note for a single paper and write it into an Obsidian-style vault. Use when the user gives a paper title, DOI, URL, arXiv ID, Zotero item, or local PDF and wants a polished Markdown note with strong structure, evidence-based analysis, and figure placeholders.
description_zh: 为单篇论文生成高质量深度阅读笔记，并将其写入 Obsidian 风格的知识库（vault）。当用户提供论文标题、DOI、URL、arXiv ID、Zotero 条目或本地 PDF，并希望生成结构严谨、基于证据且包含图表占位符的润色 Markdown 笔记时使用。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "트윗 가져와", "트윗 번역", "X 게시글 읽어줘", "tweet fetch", "트윗 내용", "트윗 원문", or provides an X/Twitter URL (x.com, twitter.com) and wants to read, translate, or analyze the tweet content. Also useful when other skills need to fetch tweet text programmatically.
description_zh: 此技能应在用户要求“트윗 가져와”、“트윗 번역”、“X 게시글 읽어줘”、“tweet fetch”、“트윗 내용”、“트윗 원문”，或提供 X/Twitter 网址（x.com, twitter.com）并要求阅读、翻译或分析推文内容时使用。此外，当其他技能需要程序化获取推文文本时，也很有用。

description: Use for secrets or key setup in a repo with .sops.yaml, encrypted environment files, or a pnpm secrets script.
description_zh: 用于在包含 .sops.yaml、加密的环境文件或 pnpm secrets script 的仓库中进行密钥或密钥设置。

description: How to inject external code examples into Dartdoc using the {@example} directive, and how to filter those files using #hide, #region, and #endregion tags.
description_zh: 如何使用 {@example} 指令将外部代码示例注入 Dartdoc，以及如何使用 #hide、#region 和 #endregion 标签过滤这些文件。

description: Use when asked to ship a completed change, commit and open a PR, or push changes and watch CI. Use babysit for monitoring an existing PR.
description_zh: 当需要发布已完成的更改、提交并开启PR，或推送更改并监控CI时使用。监控现有PR时，使用babysit（负责监控）。

description: Expert skill for Token-Oriented Object Notation (TOON) — compact, schema-aware JSON encoding for LLM prompts that reduces tokens by ~40%.
description_zh: 面向令牌导向对象记法（TOON）的专家技能——一种用于LLM提示的紧凑、感知模式的JSON编码，可减少约40%的令牌。

description: Professional music creation with Suno AI V5 and Suno Studio. Use this skill when users want to create songs, playlists, corporate anthems, jingles, workout music, ambient soundscapes, or any AI-generated music. Triggers on requests mentioning Suno, music creation, playlist generation, song composition, or specific music projects like "create a track", "make a playlist", "compose music for", "corporate anthem", "workout mix", or any music production task.

description: Work with the @upstash/workflow TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for durable, long-running workflows in serverless functions, multi-step processes that survive timeouts, retries, and restarts (built on QStash). Use when defining a workflow endpoint with serve(), running steps with context.run, sleeping for minutes to days without holding a function open, calling external APIs with context.call, waiting for an external event or webhook, invoking other workflows, configuring retries, failure callbacks, and a DLQ, controlling concurrency, rate, and parallelism, triggering, cancelling, or inspecting runs with the Workflow client, building AI agents and orchestrators, human-in-the-loop approvals, realtime updates, local development with the QStash dev server, adding middleware, or migrating workflows safely. Also use when the user asks for durable execution, step functions, saga or orchestration patterns, background jobs with checkpoints, or long-running tasks on Vercel, Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, or other serverless platforms.
description_zh:
使用 @upstash/workflow TypeScript/JavaScript SDK，支持在无服务器函数中构建持久化、长时间运行的流程。这些流程是多步骤过程，能够在超时、重试和重启后依然存活（基于 QStash 构建）。

当需要进行以下操作时，请使用本 SDK：使用 `serve()` 定义工作流端点，使用 `context.run` 运行步骤；无需保持函数持续运行，即可休眠数分钟至数天；使用 `context.call` 调用外部 API、等待外部事件或 Webhook 并调用其他工作流；配置重试、失败回调及死信队列（DLQ）；控制并发数、速率和并行度；使用 Workflow 客户端触发、取消或检查运行；构建 AI 智能体与编排器；实现人工在环审批、实时更新；使用 QStash 开发服务器进行本地开发；添加中间件；或安全地迁移工作流。

此外，当用户需要持久化执行、步骤函数、saga 或编排模式、具备检查点的后台任务，或在 Vercel、Next.js、Cloudflare Workers 或其他无服务器平台执行长时间运行任务时，也应使用本 SDK。

description: Discovery skill for the Native SDK, the complete toolkit for building native desktop applications. Use when the user asks what the Native SDK is, how to build a Native SDK app, author native UI, scaffold an app, configure app.json or legacy app.zon, add bridge commands, embed web content, package an app, test a running app, or automate a Native SDK app.

description: Two-dimensional minimalist style with vibrant colors, clean typography, and no 3D effects for fast, user-friendly interfaces.
description_zh: 二维极简风格，融合鲜艳色彩、简洁字体与无三维效果，打造快速、用户友好的界面。

description: Generate an actionable, dependency-ordered tasks.md for the feature based on available design artifacts.
description_zh: 基于可用设计产物，生成针对该功能的可执行、按依赖顺序排序的 tasks.md。

description: Use when agents work concurrently in a codebase, shared files have recurring merge conflicts, or AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md needs maintenance.
description_zh: 适用于以下情况：多个代理在代码库中并发工作，共享文件频繁出现合并冲突，或需要对 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 进行维护。

description: Define what content a product needs, how it is structured, and who owns it. Use when content itself is the problem. For the words in the interface use `ux-writing` (designer-toolkit); for structural hierarchy use `information-architecture`.
description_zh: 定义产品需要哪些内容、内容的组织结构和内容归属。在内容本身成为问题时使用。界面用词使用 `ux-writing`（设计师工具包）；结构层级使用 `information-architecture`。

description: Comprehensive security auditing workflow covering web application testing, API security, penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and security hardening.
description_zh: 涵盖 Web 应用测试、API 安全、渗透测试、漏洞扫描和安全管理加固的综合安全审计流程。

description: Use when building, fixing, or improving ANY SwiftUI UI — views, navigation, layout, animations, gestures, debugging, iOS 26 features, iPhone Duo, view-level performance, feature architecture.
description_zh: 适用于构建、修复或改进任何 SwiftUI UI 的场景——视图、导航、布局、动画、手势、调试、iOS 26 功能、iPhone Duo、视图级性能与功能架构。

description: Create user-facing App Store release notes by collecting and summarizing all user-impacting changes since the last git tag (or a specified ref). Use when asked to generate a comprehensive release changelog, App Store "What's New" text, or release notes based on git history or tags.
description_zh: 创建面向用户的 App Store 发布说明，通过收集并汇总自上次 git 标签（或指定引用）以来所有影响用户的变化。当被要求根据 git 历史或标签生成全面的发布变更日志、App Store “What's New” 文本或发布说明时使用。

description: Optimizes GKE costs, rightsizes workloads, and configures Spot VMs and CUDs. Use when optimizing GKE costs, rightsizing GKE workloads, or configuring GKE Spot VMs. Don't use for general compute class provisioning or GPU Selection (use gke-compute-classes instead).
description_zh: 优化GKE成本、调整工作负载规模，并配置Spot VM和CUD。适用于优化GKE成本、调整GKE工作负载规模或配置GKE Spot VM时。不适用于通用计算类资源配置或GPU选择（请改用gke-compute-classes）。

description: Strong visual presence with heavyweight typography, high-contrast colors, and commanding layouts.
description_zh: 以粗厚字体、高对比度色彩和极具主导性的版面布局，呈现强烈的视觉存在感。

description: Creates interactive HTML playgrounds — self-contained single-file explorers that let users configure something visually through controls, see a live preview, and copy out a prompt. Use when the user asks to make a playground, explorer, or interactive tool for a topic.
description_zh: 创建交互式HTML游戏场——自包含的单文件探索器，用户可通过控件以可视化方式配置内容，查看实时预览，并复制提示词。当用户要求为主题创建游戏场、探索器或交互工具时使用。

description: Apply the Doherty Threshold — keep system response under 400ms to preserve user flow. Use when diagnosing perceived slowness or setting a performance budget. For what to show during unavoidable waits, use `loading-states`.
description_zh: 应用 Doherty Threshold — 保持系统响应时间低于 400ms 以保障用户流畅性。在诊断感知缓慢或设置性能预算时使用。对于不可避免等待期间要展示的内容，使用 `loading-states`。

description: Build a repository that makes findings findable, reusable, and cumulative across teams. Use when the same research keeps getting redone. For synthesising one study, use `affinity-diagram`.
description_zh: 构建一个仓库，让跨团队的研究发现可查找、可复用、可累积。当相同的研究不断被重复进行时使用。综合一项研究时，使用 `affinity-diagram`。

description: Build accessible design systems with Radix UI primitives. Headless component customization, theming strategies, and compound component patterns for production-grade UI libraries.
description_zh: 使用 Radix UI 基础组件构建无障碍设计系统。提供无头组件定制、主题策略与复合组件模式，助力打造生产级 UI 库。

description: Create, parse, and control Excel files on macOS. Professional formatting with openpyxl, complex xlsm parsing with stdlib zipfile+xml for investment bank financial models, and Excel window control via AppleScript. Use when creating formatted Excel reports, parsing financial models that openpyxl cannot handle, or automating Excel on macOS.
description_zh: 在 macOS 上创建、解析和控制 Excel 文件。使用 openpyxl 进行专业格式化，使用标准库 zipfile+xml 解析用于投资银行财务模型的复杂 xlsm，并通过 AppleScript 控制 Excel 窗口。当需要创建格式化的 Excel 报告、解析 openpyxl 无法处理的财务模型，或实现 macOS 上的 Excel 自动化时使用。

description: When the user wants to improve conversion rates, run A/B tests, optimize funnels, or reduce friction. Also use when the user mentions "CRO," "conversion rate optimization," "A/B test," "split test," "funnel optimization," "checkout optimization," "form optimization," or "conversion funnel." For pricing psychology, use pricing-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户想要提升转化率、运行 A/B 测试、优化漏斗或减少摩擦时使用。当用户提到“CRO”“转化率优化”“A/B 测试”“拆分测试”“漏斗优化”“结账优化”“表单优化”或“转化漏斗”时，也使用。针对定价心理学，使用 pricing-strategy。

description:
Use upbit CLI for Upbit REST API — spot orders, market data, withdrawals, deposits, travel rule, account management.
업비트 CLI로 시세 조회, 주문, 잔고 확인, 입출금을 처리합니다.

Trigger this skill whenever the user wants to query prices, place/cancel orders, check balances, withdraw or deposit assets, or interact with the Upbit exchange API — in any language.
사용자가 업비트 시세·주문·잔고·입출금을 언급하면 반드시 이 스킬을 사용하세요.
description_zh:
使用 upbit CLI 调用 Upbit REST API——支持现货订单、行情数据、提现、充值、交易规则和账户管理。

使用 Upbit CLI 处理行情查询、下单、查询余额及充值与提现。

无论用户使用何种语言，只要其需要查询价格、下单或取消订单、查询余额、充值或提现资产，或与该 Upbit 交易所 API 交互，都必须使用本技能。

当用户提及 Upbit 的行情、订单、余额及充值与提现时，必须使用本技能。

description: Conversational AI-first interface with minimal controls, clear outcomes, and delegated task flows for agentic workflows.

description: When the user wants to research keywords, find target keywords, or analyze search intent. Also use when the user mentions "keyword research," "keyword tool," "target keywords," "search volume," "search intent," "keyword difficulty," "topical map," "keyword clustering," "People Also Ask," "Google autocomplete," "autocomplete keywords," or "alphabet method." For clusters, use content-strategy.

description: Extracts Mermaid diagrams from markdown files and generates high-quality PNG images using bundled scripts. Activates when working with Mermaid diagrams, converting diagrams to PNG, extracting diagrams from markdown, or processing markdown files with embedded Mermaid code.
description_zh: 从 Markdown 文件中提取 Mermaid 图表，并使用捆绑脚本生成高质量 PNG 图片。在涉及 Mermaid 图表、将图表转换为 PNG、从 Markdown 中提取图表或处理包含嵌入 Mermaid 代码的 Markdown 文件时激活。

description: Setup and diagnostics for the AWS DevOps Agent MCP connection. Triggers when aws-devops-agent is missing from .mcp.json, when the connection is broken, or when the user says "set up devops agent" / "configure agent". Does NOT trigger if the MCP is already connected and working.
description_zh: AWS DevOps Agent MCP 连接的设置和诊断。当 aws-devops-agent 在 .mcp.json 中缺失、连接中断，或用户说 "设置 DevOps 代理" / "配置代理" 时触发。如果 MCP 已连接并正常工作，则不会触发。

description: Structured, enterprise-focused design system emphasizing clarity, consistency, and efficiency for data-dense web applications.
description_zh: 面向企业的结构化设计系统，以清晰、一致与高效为核心，为数据密集型 Web 应用而设计。

description: High-contrast, theatrical design with bold layouts, immersive visuals, and unconventional compositions that command attention.
description_zh: 高对比、戏剧性的设计，兼具大胆的布局、沉浸式的视觉效果和非传统的构图，引人注目。

description: FFmpeg automation for cutting, trimming, concatenating videos. Audio mixing, timeline editing, transitions, effects. Export optimization for YouTube, social media. Subtitle handling, color grading, batch processing. Use for videogen projects, content creation, automated video production. Activate on "video editing", "FFmpeg", "trim video", "concatenate", "transitions", "export optimization". NOT for real-time video editing UI, 3D compositing, or motion graphics.
description_zh: FFmpeg 自动化，用于视频剪切、修剪、拼接。音频混音、时间线编辑、转场、特效。针对 YouTube、社交媒体进行导出优化。字幕处理、调色、批量处理。适用于 videogen 项目、内容创作、自动化视频制作。在“视频编辑”、“FFmpeg”、“修剪视频”、“拼接”、“转场”、“导出优化”时激活。不适用于实时视频编辑界面、3D 合成或动态图形。

description: 소상공인시장진흥공단 상가(상권)정보 공개파일(무인증)로 업종·상호 키워드에 맞는 전국 점포 전수를 뽑고, 과거 스냅샷과 상호+좌표 매칭해 'N년 전에도 존재했고 지금도 영업 중'인 장수 점포 리스트를 추출한다. 사업자등록번호 없이 상호 기준이며 개업일이 아닌 최초 관측 시점 하한을 제공한다.
description_zh: 基于中小企业市场振兴公社的店面（商圈）信息公开文件（无需认证），依据行业与店名关键词筛选全国门店，并结合历史截图与店名及坐标匹配，提取出“N年前就已存在且至今仍在营业”的长期店面列表。该功能以店名为依据，不以经营者登记号为基础，并提供首个观测时间下限（而非开业日期）。

description: Comprehensive spreadsheet creation, editing, and analysis with support for formulas, formatting, data analysis, and visualization. When Claude needs to work with spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv, etc) for: (1) Creating new spreadsheets with formulas and formatting, (2) Reading or analyzing data, (3) Modify existing spreadsheets while preserving formulas, (4) Data analysis and visualization in spreadsheets, or (5) Recalculating formulas
description_zh:
全面支持电子表格的创建、编辑与分析，支持公式、格式设置、数据分析与可视化。当 Claude 需要处理电子表格（.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 等）时，可执行：
（1）创建带有公式和格式设置的新电子表格；
（2）读取或分析数据；
（3）修改现有电子表格并保留公式；
（4）在电子表格中进行数据分析和可视化；
（5）重新计算公式。

description: Build a personal brand strategy for founders, executives, creators, and consultants. Use when the user says "personal brand", "personal branding", "build my brand", "founder brand", "executive brand", "thought leadership", "I want to be known for", "grow my personal brand", "LinkedIn presence", "creator brand", "consultant brand", "personal brand strategy", "position myself", "what should I be known for", or wants to establish credibility, grow an audience, or become a recognized voice in their industry.

为创始人、高管、创作者和顾问制定个人品牌策略。

description: Agentforce Builder metadata path for Builder-managed topics/actions, Prompt Builder templates, GenAiFunction/GenAiPlugin, Models API, and custom Lightning types. TRIGGER when: user maintains or configures Builder metadata agents, creates topics/actions, works with Prompt Builder templates, or touches .genAiFunction, .genAiPlugin, or .genAiPromptTemplate metadata XML files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Agent Script DSL .agent files (use sf-ai-agentscript), agent testing (use sf-ai-agentforce-testing), or persona design (use sf-ai-agentforce-persona).
description_zh: Agentforce Builder 的元数据路径，用于 Builder 管理的主题/操作、Prompt Builder 模板、GenAiFunction/GenAiPlugin、Models API 以及自定义 Lightning 类型。触发条件：当用户维护或配置 Builder 元数据代理，创建主题/操作，使用 Prompt Builder 模板，或操作 .genAiFunction、.genAiPlugin 或 .genAiPromptTemplate 元数据 XML 文件时。不触发条件：当涉及 Agent Script DSL 的 .agent 文件（使用 sf-ai-agentscript）、代理测试（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-testing）或人设设计（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-persona）时。

description:
Build type-safe global state in React with Zustand. Supports TypeScript, persist middleware, devtools, slices pattern, and Next.js SSR with hydration handling. Prevents 6 documented errors.

Use when setting up React state, migrating from Redux/Context, or troubleshooting hydration errors, TypeScript inference, infinite render loops, or persist race conditions.
description_zh:
使用 Zustand 在 React 中构建类型安全的全局状态。支持 TypeScript、持久化中间件、DevTools、切片模式以及处理水合的 Next.js SSR。防止 6 种已记录的错误。

适用于设置 React 状态、从 Redux/Context 迁移，或排查水合错误、TypeScript 推断、无限渲染循环、持久化竞态条件等问题。

description: AI-powered analysis of Trump's social media posts to predict stock market movements using 31.5M brute-force tested rules
description_zh: 利用3150万条经暴力测试的规则，通过AI分析特朗普的社交媒体帖子，以预测股市走势。

description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh CLI 使用 Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 模型生成并编辑视频。模型：HappyHorse T2V、I2V、R2V、Video Edit。功能：文本生成视频、图像生成视频、参考生成视频、自然语言视频编辑、角色保留、720P/1080P、最长 15 秒。适用场景：物理真实感视频、视频编辑、角色一致的内容、产品演示、社交媒体。触发词：happyhorse、happy horse、alibaba video、happyhorse 1.0、dashscope video、alibaba happyhorse、video editing ai、ai video editor

description: See, Understand, Act on video and audio. See- ingest from local files, URLs, RTSP/live feeds, or live record desktop; return realtime context and playable stream links. Understand- run analyzers over speech, scenes, objects, OCR, brands and activity; build searchable indexes; then search moments, ask questions about a video, filter and aggregate results with timestamps and auto-clips. Act- transcode and normalize (codec, fps, resolution, aspect ratio), perform timeline edits (subtitles, text/image overlays, branding, audio overlays, dubbing, translation), generate media assets (image, audio, video), and create real time alerts for events from live streams or desktop capture.
description_zh:
视频与音频的"看见、理解、行动"

看见- 从本地文件、URL、RTSP/直播流或实时录屏中采集数据；实时返回上下文信息与可播放的流链接。

理解- 对语音、场景、物体、OCR、品牌及活动运行分析器；构建可搜索索引；随后检索片段、针对视频提问、结合时间戳筛选并汇总结果，并自动截取片段。

行动- 进行转码与标准化（编码、帧率、分辨率、宽高比），执行时间轴编辑（字幕、文字/图片叠加、品牌标识、音频叠加、配音、翻译），生成媒体素材（图片、音频、视频），并为直播流或桌面录屏的实时事件创建实时告警。

description: Approachable, intuitive design with rounded elements, ample whitespace, and soft pastel color palettes.
description_zh: 带有圆润元素、充足留白与柔和粉彩配色方案的易用、直观的设计。

description: 定时任务管理
description_zh: 定时任务管理

description: Expert skill for memory-lancedb-pro — a production-grade LanceDB-backed long-term memory plugin for OpenClaw agents with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, multi-scope isolation, and smart auto-capture.
description_zh: memory-lancedb-pro 专家技能 —— 一款面向 OpenClaw 智能体的生产级基于 LanceDB 的长期记忆插件，支持混合检索、交叉编码器重排序、多作用域隔离与智能自动捕获。

description: OpenClaw-RL framework for training personalized AI agents via reinforcement learning from natural conversation feedback
description_zh: 通过自然对话反馈进行强化学习训练个性化AI智能体的OpenClaw-RL框架

description_zh: 为 agent 编写文档。适用于创建或编辑 skills，或在修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 时。

description: WPS 文字智能助手，通过自然语言操控 Word 文档，解决排版、格式、内容编辑等痛点问题
description_zh: WPS 文字智能助手，通过自然语言操控 Word 文档，解决排版、格式、内容编辑等痛点问题。

description: Have a fast, conversational analysis with the AWS DevOps Agent. Use for cost optimization, architecture review, topology mapping, knowledge / runbook discovery, security audits, dependency questions, and quick diagnostics — anything that needs a 5-30 second answer rather than a 5-8 minute deep investigation. Trigger words include cost, optimize, review, architecture, topology, what runbooks, show me, compare, audit, what if.
description_zh: 与 AWS DevOps 助手进行快速、对话式的分析。适用于成本优化、架构评审、拓扑映射、知识/运行手册查找、安全审计、依赖问题与快速诊断——任何需要在 5 到 30 秒内给出答案，而非进行 5 到 8 分钟深度调查的需求。触发词包括：成本、优化、评审、架构、拓扑、有哪些运行手册、展示给我、对比、审计、假如。

description: Cozy cafe-inspired interface with warm tones, soft typography, and clean layouts for a relaxed browsing experience.
description_zh: 温馨咖啡馆风格的界面，以暖色调、柔和字体与简洁布局，营造轻松浏览体验。

description: Monospace-driven, matrix-inspired design with high-contrast elements, compact density, and a hacker-chic aesthetic.
description_zh: 以等宽字体为主导、灵感源自矩阵的设计，兼具高对比度元素、紧凑密度与黑客酷炫美学风格。

description: 1950s-1990s nostalgia with skeuomorphic touches, grainy textures, retro color palettes, and pixel-style typography.
description_zh: 1950年代至1990年代的怀旧风格，融入拟物化细节、颗粒感纹理、复古配色方案及像素风格字体。

description: An Instagram API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no login and no session cookies. Use when the user wants to resolve an Instagram profile by @handle, search users by keyword, pull a profile's posts, reels, stories, tagged posts, followers, or followings, look up a single post by its shortcode, read a post's comments, fetch posts under a hashtag or reel-only hashtag feed, pull posts from a location, or pull posts using a specific audio/music track. Also covers Instagram follower export, hashtag and location monitoring, influencer discovery, competitor content tracking, and Instagram data pipelines without an official Graph API business verification or a headless browser.
description_zh: 一个位于 fetcher.sh 的 Instagram API 替代方案——可通过 x402 以 USDC 按次付费，或凭 Bearer 密钥使用预付积分，无需登录，无需会话 Cookie。适用于用户需要解析 Instagram 个人资料（根据 @handle）、按关键词搜索用户、拉取个人资料的帖子、Reels、快拍、带标签帖子、粉丝或关注者，通过短码查询单条帖子，读取帖子评论，抓取话题或仅 Reels 话题的帖子信息流，按地点拉取帖子，或使用特定音频/音乐曲目拉取帖子的情况。此外，还支持 Instagram 粉丝导出、话题与地点监控、达人发现、竞品内容追踪，以及无需官方 Graph API 商业验证或无头浏览器即可实现的 Instagram 数据管线。

description: Expert in Windows UI Automation (UIA) and Win32 APIs for desktop automation. Specializes in accessible, secure automation of Windows applications including element discovery, input simulation, and process interaction. HIGH-RISK skill requiring strict security controls for system access.
description_zh: 精通 Windows UI 自动化（UIA）和 Win32 API 的桌面自动化。专攻 Windows 应用的无障碍、安全自动化，涵盖元素发现、输入模拟和进程交互。HIGH-RISK 技能，要求对系统访问实施严格的安全控制措施。

description: Direct-invocation specialist for low-fidelity, self-contained HTML wireframes that test information hierarchy, content, navigation, task flow, and responsive structure before visual design. Use when the user explicitly invokes html-wireframe or the broad html skill routes a wireframe request here. Do not activate independently from a general request. Do not use for polished mockups or production-like interaction; use html-prototype for those.
description_zh: 针对低保真、自包含 HTML 线框图的直接调用专家，用于在视觉设计前测试信息层级、内容、导航、任务流程和响应式结构。当用户明确调用 html-wireframe，或广泛 html 技能将线框图请求路由至此功能时使用。不得从一般请求中独立激活。不用于精致的界面展示图或生产级别的交互；此类情况请使用 html-prototype。

description: Create and checkout a new git branch with smart validation and GitHub issue integration
description_zh: 创建并切换新 git 分支，支持智能校验与 GitHub 问题集成

description: Game-inspired fantasy aesthetic with bold, premium visuals, rich color palettes, and immersive thematic elements.
description_zh: 以游戏风格为灵感的奇幻美学，搭配大胆、高级的视觉效果，丰富的色彩方案，以及沉浸式的主题元素。

description: A Google News API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no RSS scraping. Use when the user wants keyword search across Google News scoped to a language edition, section headlines (world, business, technology, entertainment, sport, science, health, or a specific topic ID), the latest headlines, a list of supported language-region codes, or to decode a Google News redirect URL into the real article URL. Also covers news monitoring, headline aggregation, media tracking, and press-mention alerts without scraping Google News' RSS feeds directly.
description_zh: 在 fetcher.sh 上提供 Google News API 的替代方案——可通过 x402 以 USDC 实现按次付费，或使用 Bearer 密钥预先充值积分，无需抓取 RSS。当用户需要关键词搜索 Google News 并按语言版本进行限定、获取板块标题（包括世界、商业、科技、娱乐、体育、科学、健康，或特定主题 ID）、最新标题、支持的语区域码列表，或将 Google News 重定向 URL 解码为实际文章 URL 时，均可使用。此外，还涵盖无需直接抓取 Google News RSS 订阅源即可实现的新闻监控、标题聚合、媒体追踪及媒体提及提醒功能。

description: Use when tackling complex reasoning tasks requiring step-by-step logic, multi-step arithmetic, commonsense reasoning, symbolic manipulation, or problems where simple prompting fails - provides comprehensive guide to Chain-of-Thought and related prompting techniques (Zero-shot CoT, Self-Consistency, Tree of Thoughts, Least-to-Most, ReAct, PAL, Reflexion) with templates, decision matrices, and research-backed patterns
description_zh: 适用于处理需要逐步逻辑、多步算术、常识推理、符号运算的复杂推理任务，以及简单提示无法解决的推理问题——提供针对思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）及相关提示技术的全面指南，涵盖模板、决策矩阵和经研究验证的模式（零样本思维链、自我一致性、思维树、Least-to-Most（最少到最多）、ReAct、PAL、Reflexion（反思））。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "analyze session", "세션 분석", "evaluate skill execution", "스킬 실행 검증", "check session logs", "로그 분석", provides a session ID with a skill path, or wants to verify that a skill executed correctly in a past session. Post-hoc analysis of Claude Code sessions to validate skill/agent/hook behavior against SKILL.md specifications.
description_zh: 当用户要求"分析会话"、"세션 분석"、"评估技能执行"、"스킬 실행 검증"、"检查会话日志"、"로그 분석"、提供带有技能路径的会话 ID，或希望验证某个技能在过去会话中执行是否正确时，应使用本技能。对 Claude Code 会话进行事后分析，以验证技能/代理/钩子行为符合 SKILL.md 规范。

description: Electric neon glow effects with high-contrast color pairings for bold, attention-grabbing interfaces.
description_zh: 电致霓虹发光效果搭配高对比度配色，适用于大胆、吸睛的界面。

description: Advocate for design quality, scope, and timeline with partners and leadership using evidence and shared goals. Use in the conversation itself. For the commercial vocabulary behind it, use `business-design` (ux-strategy).
description_zh: 以证据和共同目标为基础，与合作伙伴及领导层共同倡导设计质量、范围与时间安排。在对话本身中使用。针对其背后的商业词汇，使用 `business-design`（ux-strategy）。

description: Generate hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a codebase. Creates root + complexity-scored subdirectory documentation.
description_zh: 为代码库生成层级化的 AGENTS.md 知识库。创建根目录与按复杂度评分的子目录文档。

description: Use when the user asks to "optimize for AI citations"; improves citation readiness for ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude. Not for structural on-page SEO — use on-page-seo-checker; not for net-new drafting — use content-writer. AI引用优化/GEO优化/AI搜索
description_zh: 当用户要求"优化AI引用"时使用；可提升 ChatGPT、Perplexity、AI 概览、Gemini 和 Claude 的引用准备度。不适用于结构化页面 SEO——请使用 on-page-seo-checker；不适用于全新内容起草——请使用 content-writer。AI引用优化/GEO优化/AI搜索

description: Throwback design with vintage-inspired typography, high-contrast retro palettes, and nostalgic visual elements.
description_zh: 采用复古风格设计，融入灵感源自复古的字体、高对比度的复古配色及怀旧视觉元素。

description: Apply a refined Scandinavian visual system with a neutral black-and-white foundation, restrained sans-serif typography, purposeful product imagery, generous spacing, clear page chapters, and minimal decoration. Use when the user invokes /scandinavian-design or requests a Nordic, monochrome, calm, spacious, restrained, or minimalist interface.

description: Debug and fix a Sentry issue — find it (by link, ID, or search), pull full context (stack trace, breadcrumbs, trace, logs), optionally run Seer root-cause / autofix, apply the code fix, and resolve it via a `Fixes PROJECT-NAME-12A` commit/PR. Use when working a known error or hunting one down to fix.
description_zh: 调试并修复一个 Sentry 问题——定位它（通过链接、ID 或搜索），获取完整上下文（堆栈跟踪、面包屑、追踪信息、日志），可选地运行 Seer 根因分析/自动修复，应用代码修复，并通过 `Fixes PROJECT-NAME-12A` 的提交/PR 解决。适用于处理已知错误或排查并修复错误时使用。

description: Generates and formats changelog files for a new release based on provided version and raw changelog data.
description_zh: 根据所提供的版本和原始变更日志数据，为新版本发布生成并格式化变更日志文件。

description: Audit and improve the visual design, polish, and player experience of an existing game. Use when the user says "make my game look better", "improve the design", "add polish", "add juice", "add particles", "fix the UI", or "make it more visually appealing". Do NOT use for gameplay logic changes (use add-feature instead).
description_zh: 审查并优化现有游戏的视觉设计、细节打磨与玩家体验。当用户提出“让我的游戏看起来更好”、“优化设计”、“增加打磨”、“增加游戏细节与表现力”、“添加粒子效果”、“修复UI”或“让游戏更具视觉吸引力”等需求时使用。请勿用于游戏玩法逻辑修改（请改用“add-feature”功能）。

description: Prevent feature creep when building software, apps, and AI-powered products. Use this skill when planning features, reviewing scope, building MVPs, managing backlogs, or when a user says "just one more feature." Helps developers and AI agents stay focused, ship faster, and avoid bloated products.
description_zh: 在构建软件、应用程序和AI驱动产品时防止功能蔓延。当规划功能、审查范围、构建最小可行产品（MVP）或管理待办事项，或用户说“只需再添加一个功能”时，使用此技能。帮助开发人员和AI智能体保持专注，加快交付速度，并避免产品臃肿。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "팀 구성해줘", "team assemble", "전문가 팀으로 해줘", "팀으로 해줘", "swarm", "병렬로 전문가 팀", or wants to decompose a complex task into specialist roles executed via TeamCreate. Also triggers when user describes a task clearly benefiting from parallel expert execution.
description_zh: 该技能应在以下情况下使用：用户要求“팀 구성해줘”、“team assemble”、“전문가 팀으로 해줘”、“팀으로 해줘”、“swarm”、“병렬로 전문가 팀”，或希望将复杂任务分解为专家角色并由TeamCreate执行。此外，当用户描述的任务明确受益于并行专家执行时，也会触发此技能的启用。

description: Real-world mimicry with textured surfaces, 3D effects, and familiar physical metaphors for intuitive digital interfaces.
description_zh: 通过纹理表面、3D 效果与熟悉的物理隐喻，实现真实世界拟态，打造直观的数字界面。

description: Prepare and publish GitHub releases. Sanitizes code for public release (secrets scan, personal artifacts, LICENSE/README validation), creates version tags, and publishes via gh CLI. Trigger with 'release', 'publish', 'open source', 'prepare for release', 'create release', or 'github release'.
description_zh: 准备并发布 GitHub 版本。为公开发布清理代码（执行密钥扫描、检查个人制品、校验 LICENSE/README），创建版本标签，并通过 gh CLI 发布。可通过 '发布'、'发布'、'开源'、'准备发布'、'创建发布' 或 'GitHub 发布' 进行触发。

description: Open or return Logfire project pages, live views, trace links, and Explore pages in the Codex browser without querying telemetry first. Use this skill when the user asks to "open in Logfire", "show in the live view", "open Explore", "open the UI", "show in Codex", "use the browser", "give me a link", or asks for a Logfire GUI/browser/live-view presentation of a project, time range, service, span, trace, log, or filter. If "show" or "view" wording is ambiguous, ask whether the user wants a UI view or query analysis.
description_zh: 在 Codex 浏览器中打开或返回 Logfire 项目页面、实时视图、追踪链接和 Explore 页面，无需先查询遥测数据。当用户要求使用"在 Logfire 中打开"、"在实时视图中显示"、"打开 Explore"、"打开界面"、"在 Codex 中显示"、"使用浏览器"、"给我一个链接"，或要求以 Logfire 图形用户界面/浏览器/实时视图展示项目、时间范围、服务、跨度、追踪、日志或过滤器时，使用此技能。如果"显示"或"视图"的表述存在歧义，请询问用户是否需要 UI 视图还是查询分析。

description: Agent orchestration patterns for agentic loops, multi-agent coordination, alternative frameworks, and multi-scenario workflows. Use when building autonomous agent loops, coordinating multiple agents, evaluating CrewAI/AutoGen/Swarm, or orchestrating complex multi-step scenarios.
description_zh: 智能体编排模式，适用于智能体循环、多智能体协调、替代性框架及多场景工作流。用于构建自主智能体循环、协调多个智能体、评估 CrewAI/AutoGen/Swarm，或编排复杂多步骤场景。

description: Conversion-focused design that removes friction and guides users toward action through clarity, trust, and speed.
description_zh: 以转化为核心的设计，通过清晰、信任与速度消除摩擦，引导用户采取行动。

description: Reference HLSL shader implementations for the Slug font rendering algorithm, enabling high-quality GPU-accelerated vector font and glyph rendering.
description_zh: Slug字体渲染算法的HLSL着色器参考实现，实现高质量GPU加速的矢量字体与字形渲染。

description: Source-backed research orchestrator for the Fusion ecosystem. Routes to the correct research agent based on question type. Returns source-backed evidence only; will not invent Framework behavior, component APIs, skill catalog relationships, platform guidance, or backend implementation details. USE FOR: any research question needing source-backed evidence about Fusion Framework APIs, EDS components, the Fusion skill catalog, Fusion platform documentation, or backend service implementation. DO NOT USE FOR: implementing code changes, installing or editing skills, MCP setup or troubleshooting, or inventing Fusion behavior without evidence.
description_zh:
Fusion 生态系统基于来源的研究编排器。根据问题类型路由至正确的调研代理，仅返回有来源依据的证据；不会虚构框架行为、组件 API、技能目录关系、平台指导或后端实现细节。

**适用场景：** 任何需要关于 Fusion 框架 API、EDS 组件、Fusion 技能目录、Fusion 平台文档或后端服务实现的有来源依据证据的研究问题。

**禁止使用场景：** 实施代码修改、安装或编辑技能、MCP 设置或故障排除，或未经证据虚构 Fusion 行为。

description: Vibrant, personality-driven design with bold colors, playful graphics, and dynamic layouts that balance creativity with structure.
description_zh: 充满活力、以个性为驱动的设计，以大胆色彩、俏皮图形和富有动感的版式，在创意与结构之间取得平衡。

description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
description_zh: 帮助用户在提出诸如“如何做X”、“为X寻找技能”、“是否存在能……的技能”，或表达扩展能力意愿的问题时，发现并安装智能体技能。当用户正在寻找可能以可安装技能形式存在的功能时，应使用本技能。

description: Use when configuring CORS, rotating access keys, setting bucket policies, or securing Tigris storage — covers key lifecycle, roles, CORS rules, presigned URL security, audit checklist
description_zh: 用于配置CORS、轮换访问密钥、设置存储桶策略或保护Tigris存储时——涵盖密钥生命周期、角色、CORS规则、预签名URL安全及审计清单。

description: 작업 중 발견한 인사이트를 구조화된 문서로 축적하여 나만의 지식 베이스를 복리로 성장시킨다
description_zh: 将工作中发现的见解以结构化文档的形式积累，使个人知识库以复利的方式增长。

description: Download YouTube videos and HLS streams (m3u8) from platforms like Mux, Vimeo, etc. using yt-dlp and ffmpeg. Use this skill when users request downloading videos, extracting audio, handling protected streams with authentication headers, or troubleshooting download issues like nsig extraction failures, 403 errors, or cookie extraction problems.
description_zh: 使用 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，从 Mux、Vimeo 等平台下载 YouTube 视频与 HLS 流（m3u8）。当用户需要下载视频、提取音频、处理带有认证头的受保护流，或排查 nsig 提取失败、403 错误、Cookie 提取问题等下载故障时，请使用此技能。

description: Oracle APEX skills for Oracle APEX application development.
description_zh: Oracle APEX 技能：Oracle APEX 应用开发

description: Use when working with Tigris file storage - uploading, downloading, deleting, listing files, presigned URLs, client uploads, or setting up Tigris CLI and SDK. Covers Next.js, Remix, Express, Rails, and Laravel. For Python/Django, see the tigris-python-sdk skill.
description_zh: 当使用 Tigris 文件存储时使用——涉及上传、下载、删除、列出文件、预签名 URL、客户端上传或设置 Tigris CLI 和 SDK。涵盖 Next.js、Remix、Express、Rails 和 Laravel。对于 Python/Django，请参阅 tigris-python-sdk skill。

description: Installs, configures, customizes, or troubleshoots the Claude Code statusline (cwd, model, token counts). Use when the user wants to set up or change the statusline, switch minimal vs full layouts, show absolute token counts (e.g. ctx 108K / 1M) instead of a percentage, add cost via ccusage or git status, dump the stdin JSON Claude Code passes the script, or fix a statusline that is blank, silent, stuck, shows "permission denied", or stopped updating after a script edit (often a missing chmod +x). Trigger phrases: "configure statusline", "statusline blank", "status line not showing", "statusline broken", "show token count in statusline", 状态栏, 状态栏不显示, 状态栏空白, 显示工作目录, 显示 token 数.
description_zh:
安装、配置、自定义或排查 Claude Code 状态栏（cwd、模型、token 数量）。当用户需要设置或更改状态栏、切换最小化与完整布局、以绝对 token 数量（例如 ctx 108K / 1M）替代百分比显示、通过 ccusage 或 git status 添加成本、导出 Claude Code 传递给脚本的 stdin JSON、或修复空白、无输出、卡住、显示“permission denied”、或在脚本编辑后停止更新的状态栏（通常缺少 chmod +x）时使用。

触发短语：“配置状态栏”、“状态栏空白”、“状态栏不显示”、“状态栏损坏”、“状态栏显示 token 数量”、状态栏、状态栏不显示、状态栏空白、显示工作目录、显示 token 数。

description: Vehicle routing (VRP, TSP, PDP) — problem types and data requirements. Domain concepts; no API or interface.
description_zh: 车辆路径规划（VRP, TSP, PDP）——问题类型和数据要求。领域概念；无 API 或接口。

description: Sub-millisecond VM sandboxes for AI agents using copy-on-write KVM forking via Zeroboot
description_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的基于 Zeroboot 和拷贝-写回（copy-on-write）KVM 分叉的亚毫秒级虚拟机沙箱

description: Python development principles and decision-making. Framework selection, async patterns, type hints, project structure. Teaches thinking, not copying.
description_zh: Python 开发原则与决策。框架选择、异步模式、类型提示、项目结构。教授思考，而非照搬。

description: Orchestrates multi-agent task execution using a Royal Navy squadron metaphor — from mission planning through parallel work coordination to stand-down. Use when work needs parallel agent orchestration, tight task coordination with quality gates, structured delegation with progress checkpoints, or a documented decision log.
description_zh: 采用皇家海军舰队为喻，协调多智能体的任务执行，涵盖从任务规划，到并行工作协调，直至任务结束。适用于需要并行智能体协调、具备质量关卡的任务紧密协调、基于结构化的委派并设有进度检查点，或需要记录决策日志的工作场景。

description: Lively, colorful design with bold playful typography, warm accents, and dynamic visual energy.
description_zh: 充满活力与缤纷色彩的设计，搭配大胆俏皮的字型，温暖的点缀，以及动态视觉活力。

description: Operates GitHub through gh CLI and the REST/GraphQL APIs with explicit target, authorization, impact preview, and independent readback. Use for pull requests, issues, Actions, repositories, collaborators, teams, organization member privileges, base permissions, 2FA enforcement, repository settings, API automation, parallel or superseded PR convergence, and public or enterprise GitHub. Also use when a GitHub write returned success but the requested state did not change, or when deciding whether a setting is writable through CLI, REST, GraphQL, or only the GitHub UI.
description_zh: 通过 gh CLI 和 REST/GraphQL API 操作 GitHub，具备明确的目标、授权、影响预览和独立回读功能。适用于处理拉取请求、问题、动作、仓库、协作者、团队、组织成员权限、基础权限、2FA 强制执行、仓库设置、API 自动化、并行或已被替代的拉取请求合并，以及公共或企业级 GitHub。同时，在 GitHub 写入操作返回成功但请求状态未发生变化，或在判断某项设置是否可通过 CLI、REST、GraphQL 或仅 GitHub UI 进行写入时使用。

description: Writes and executes SQL queries from simple SELECTs to complex multi-table JOINs, aggregations, and subqueries. Use when the user asks to query a database, write SQL, run a SELECT statement, retrieve data, filter records, or generate reports from database tables.
description_zh: 编写并执行从简单的SELECT语句到复杂的多表JOIN、聚合和子查询的SQL查询。当用户要求查询数据库、编写SQL、运行SELECT语句、检索数据、筛选记录或根据数据库表生成报表时使用。

description: Advanced Compose Multiplatform UI patterns for shared composables. Use when working with visual UI components, state management patterns (remember, derivedStateOf, produceState), recomposition optimization (@Stable/@Immutable visual usage), Material3 theming, custom ImageVector icons, or determining whether to share UI in commonMain vs keep platform-specific. Delegates navigation to android-expert/desktop-expert. Complements kotlin-expert (handles Kotlin language aspects of state/annotations).
description_zh: 高级的 Compose 多平台共享组合组件 UI 模式。用于处理可视化 UI 组件、状态管理模式（remember、derivedStateOf、produceState）、重组优化（@Stable/@Immutable 视觉使用）、Material3 主题、自定义 ImageVector 图标，或判断在 commonMain 中共享 UI 还是保持平台特定的情况。将导航委托给 android-expert/desktop-expert。与 kotlin-expert 互补（负责处理状态/注解的 Kotlin 语言方面）。

description: Provides reverse engineering techniques. Use when the main job is to understand how a compiled, obfuscated, packed, or virtualized target works before exploiting or solving it, including binaries, APKs, WASM, firmware, custom VMs, bytecode, malware-like loaders, and anti-debug or anti-analysis logic. Do not use it when the vulnerability is already understood and the remaining task is exploitation; use pwn instead. Do not use it for pure web workflows, log or disk forensics, or standalone crypto problems unless reversing the implementation is the real blocker.
description_zh: 提供逆向工程技术。在主要任务是理解编译、混淆、打包或虚拟化目标的运行方式，并在利用或解决该目标之前时使用，包括二进制文件、APK、WASM、固件、自定义虚拟机、字节码、类似恶意软件的加载器以及反调试或反分析逻辑。当漏洞已了解且剩余任务是利用时，不要使用它；应使用 pwn 代替。不要将其用于纯网页工作流、日志或磁盘取证，或独立加密问题，除非逆向实现才是真正的障碍。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing HTML/CSS websites for SEO optimization, fixing SEO issues, generating SEO reports, or implementing SEO best practices. Use when the user requests SEO audits, optimization, meta tag improvements, schema markup implementation, sitemap generation, or general search engine optimization tasks.
description_zh: 当需要对HTML/CSS网站进行SEO优化分析、修复SEO问题、生成SEO报告或实施SEO最佳实践时，应使用本技能。当用户请求进行SEO审计、优化、元标签改进、schema标记实施、站点地图生成或一般的搜索引擎优化任务时，也应使用本技能。

description: Configure AWS Security Agent for the current workspace — provision or reuse an agent space, IAM service role, and S3 bucket. Use when the user asks to "set up security agent", "configure security scanner", "is security agent configured", or on first-time use before any scan or pentest.
description_zh:
为当前工作区配置 AWS 安全代理——配置或复用代理空间、IAM 服务角色和 S3 存储桶。

当用户询问"设置安全代理"、"配置安全扫描器"、"安全代理是否已配置"，或在首次使用、在任何扫描或渗透测试之前时使用。

description: Agentforce agent testing with dual-track workflow and 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user tests Agentforce agents, runs sf agent test commands, creates test specs, validates topic routing, or analyzes agent test coverage. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex unit tests (use sf-testing), building agents (use sf-ai-agentforce), or Agent Script DSL (use sf-ai-agentscript).
description_zh: 支持双轨工作流和100分评分的Agentforce智能体测试。触发条件：用户测试Agentforce智能体、执行 sf agent test commands、创建测试规格、验证主题路由，或分析智能体测试覆盖率。不触发条件：Apex单元测试（使用 sf-testing）、构建智能体（使用 sf-ai-agentforce）、或 Agent Script DSL（使用 sf-ai-agentscript）。

description: Lists tables, describes columns and data types, identifies foreign key relationships, and maps entity relationships in a database. Use when the user asks about database schema, table structure, column types, what tables exist, ERD, foreign keys, or how entities relate.
description_zh: 在数据库中，列出表、描述列和数据类型、识别外键关系，并映射实体关系。当用户询问数据库模式、表结构、列类型、存在哪些表、ERD、外键，或实体如何关联时使用。

description: Use the PlanetScale CLI (pscale) from automated agents with --format json, auth check, pscale sql, and per-command --force. Run before other PlanetScale skills when driving pscale directly. Use when the user asks to automate pscale, run CLI commands headless, or verify pscale auth from an agent.
description_zh: 在自动化代理中调用 PlanetScale CLI (pscale) 时，需指定 --format json、auth check、pscale sql，并每次命令均使用 --force。直接驱动 pscale 时，应于其他 PlanetScale 技能之前运行。当用户要求自动化 pscale、以无头模式运行 CLI 命令，或从代理中验证 pscale 认证时使用。

description: Autonomous bug bounty agent framework with 50 agents, hunt loops, exploit chains, MCP servers for platform integration and writeup search
description_zh: 具备50个智能体、狩猎循环、漏洞利用链，以及用于平台集成与漏洞报告检索的MCP 服务器的自主漏洞悬赏智能体框架

description: Master markdown formatting, GitHub Flavored Markdown, README files, and documentation formatting. Use when writing markdown docs, READMEs, or formatting documentation.
description_zh: 掌握 Markdown 格式、GitHub Flavored Markdown、README 文件及文档格式。在撰写 Markdown 文档、README 或格式化文档时使用。

description: 专注科技周刊的中文写作与审稿技能指南，指导大模型生成与审核清晰、克制、无 AI 味的高质量周刊内容。
description_zh: 专注科技周刊的中文写作与审稿技能指南，指导大模型生成与审核清晰、克制、无 AI 味的高质量周刊内容。

description: Spatial depth design with isometric views, vanishing points, and layered elements that guide attention through 3D-like realism.
description_zh: 空间深度设计运用等轴视图、消失点和分层元素，通过类3D真实感引导注意力。

description: Verify that the current branch is ready to publish by running every configured validation command in order, fix straightforward failures (including locale-file drift when the repo checks it), and once everything passes commit and push the current branch. Use when the user asks to check the branch, make CI-style verification pass, then commit and push.
description_zh: 验证当前分支是否已准备好发布，需按顺序执行所有配置的校验命令，修复简单的失败（包括仓库检查时的 locale 文件漂移），并在一切通过后提交并推送当前分支。当用户要求检查分支、使 CI 风格验证通过，再提交并推送时使用。

description: AI-native open knowledge base about Taiwan built with Astro v5, featuring bilingual content (zh-TW/en), D3.js knowledge graph, and structured Markdown SSOT architecture.
description_zh: 基于Astro v5构建的AI原生台湾开放知识库，具备双语内容（zh-TW/en）、D3.js知识图谱，以及结构化Markdown SSOT（单一事实来源）架构。

description: Model Kotlin persistence code correctly for Spring Data JPA and Hibernate. Covers entity design, identity and equality, uniqueness constraints, relationships, fetch plans, and common ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) traps  specific to Kotlin. Use when creating or reviewing JPA (Java Persistence API)  entities, diagnosing N+1 or LazyInitializationException, placing indexes and  uniqueness rules, or preventing Kotlin-specific bugs such as data class  entities and broken equals/hashCode.
description_zh: 为 Spring Data JPA 和 Hibernate 正确建模 Kotlin 持久化代码。涵盖实体设计、标识与相等性、唯一性约束、关系、获取计划，以及针对 Kotlin 的常见 ORM（对象关系映射）陷阱。在创建或审查 JPA（Java Persistence API）实体、诊断 N+1 或 LazyInitializationException 问题、设置索引和唯一性规则，或防止 Kotlin 特有的 bug（如 data class 实体和失效的 equals/hashCode）时使用。

description: Use this skill when the user wants to review, audit, improve, or plan email sending best practices. This includes deliverability, inbox placement, sender reputation, consent, list hygiene, subject lines, preview text, preference centers, onboarding emails, lifecycle emails, product updates, or deciding between marketing and transactional email. It works for any email stack, but when Loops is involved, use Loops behavior and docs as the source of truth. Trigger on phrases like "email deliverability", "inbox placement", "sender reputation", "double opt-in", "unsubscribe", "subject line review", "preview text", "lifecycle emails", "onboarding emails", "product update email", "transactional vs marketing", or "email sending best practices". Do not prefer this skill for pure API implementation; use the Loops API skill for integration details.
description_zh: 当用户希望审阅、审计、改进或规划电子邮件发送最佳实践时，使用此技能。这包括可送达性、收件箱放置、发件人信誉、同意机制、列表清洁度、主题行、预览文本、偏好中心、入门邮件、生命周期邮件、产品更新，或决定营销邮件与事务性邮件之间的区别。该技能适用于任何电子邮件栈，但当涉及 Loops 时，应以 Loops 的行为和文档作为事实依据。当出现类似“email deliverability”、“inbox placement”、“sender reputation”、“double opt-in”、“unsubscribe”、“subject line review”、“preview text”、“lifecycle emails”、“onboarding emails”、“product update email”、“transactional vs marketing”或“email sending best practices”等短语时，触发此技能。请勿将此技能用于纯 API 实现；如需集成详情，请使用 Loops API 技能。

description:
Open the context-mode Insight dashboard in your default browser.
Insight is the hosted analytics layer for AI-assisted engineering teams —
per-engineer productive rate, retry waste, blocker detection, role-narrowed views.
Trigger: /context-mode:ctx-insight
description_zh:
在你的默认浏览器中打开 context-mode Insight 仪表盘。
Insight 是面向 AI 辅助工程团队的托管分析层——
人均产出率、重试浪费、阻塞问题检测、角色细分视图。
触发：/context-mode:ctx-insight

description: Agent skill for spec-mobile-react-native - invoke with $agent-spec-mobile-react-native
description_zh: spec-mobile-react-native 代理技能 - 通过 $agent-spec-mobile-react-native 调用

description: Use when choosing between Tigris-native SDKs and AWS S3-compatible SDKs — covers which SDK to use per language, CLI preference, and when AWS SDKs are the only option
description_zh: 在 Tigris 原生 SDK 与 AWS S3 兼容 SDK 之间进行选择时使用——涵盖按语言选择使用哪个 SDK、CLI 偏好，以及 AWS SDK 是唯一选择的情况。

description: A Google Play Store API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no Google Play Console access. Use when the user wants to search Android apps by keyword with price (free/paid) and country storefront filters, fetch an app's full details, reviews sorted by newest/rating/helpfulness, permissions, or data safety disclosure, list apps similar to a given app, or fetch a developer's app catalog. Also covers Android app store optimization (ASO) research, competitor app monitoring, review sentiment input, and app discovery without Google Play Console developer access.
description_zh: 在 fetcher.sh 上的 Google Play Store API 替代方案——通过 x402 使用 USDC 按调用付费，或使用 Bearer key 获取预付费积分，无需访问 Google Play Console。当用户需要按关键词搜索 Android 应用，并结合价格（免费/付费）和国家商店界面进行筛选，获取应用完整详情，获取按最新、评分、有用性排序的评论，以及权限或数据安全披露，列出与指定应用相似的应用，或获取开发者的应用目录时使用。此外还涵盖 Android 应用商店优化（ASO）研究、竞品应用监控、评论情感输入，以及无需 Google Play Console 开发者访问权限的应用发现。

description: Full-stack Next.js 14 development with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Supabase for building production-ready web applications.
description_zh: 全栈 Next.js 14 开发，使用 TypeScript、TailwindCSS 和 Supabase，用于构建生产就绪的 Web 应用。

description: Reflect on previus response and output, based on Self-refinement framework for iterative improvement with complexity triage and verification
description_zh: 基于用于结合复杂性分诊与验证的迭代改进的自我优化框架，反思此前的回答与输出

description: Playful, minimal design with bright colors, rounded shapes, tactile 3D borders, and friendly illustrations for approachable interfaces.
description_zh: 活泼、极简的设计，搭配明亮色彩、圆润造型、触感立体边框与友好插图，打造亲和易用的界面。

description: Dynatrace server-side JS runtime — function contract, runtime limits, Web APIs, Node.js modules, fetch with credential vault, and the @dynatrace-sdk/* catalog.
description_zh: Dynatrace 服务端 JS 运行时——函数契约、运行时限制、Web API、Node.js 模块、使用凭据保险库的 fetch 以及 @dynatrace-sdk/* 目录。

description: Define a brand's verbal identity — tone, voice, writing style, vocabulary, and messaging rules. Use when the user says "brand voice", "tone of voice", "how should we write", "writing guidelines", "copy style guide", "brand language", "verbal identity", "how should the brand sound", "tone guide", "our copy doesn't sound right", "copywriter guidelines", "voice and tone", or when onboarding a copywriter or content team. Also use when the user has a brand strategy and wants to define how the brand communicates.
description_zh: 定义品牌的话语身份——语气、声音、写作风格、词汇及信息传达规则。当用户说“品牌声音”、“语气”、“我们应该如何写作”、“写作规范”、“文案风格指南”、“品牌语言”、“话语身份”、“品牌应该如何发声”、“语气指南”、“我们的文案听起来不对”、“文案撰写规范”、“声音与语气”，或在为文案写手或内容团队进行入职引导时，使用。此外，当用户拥有品牌策略并希望定义品牌如何进行沟通时，也使用。

description: Set up the AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent connections. Use when the user says "set up", "configure", "connect", or when MCP tools are missing.
description_zh: 设置 AWS DevOps Agent 和 AWS Security Agent 连接。当用户说“设置”、“配置”、“连接”，或 MCP 工具缺失时使用。

description: Use when researching React APIs or concepts for documentation. Use when you need authoritative usage examples, caveats, warnings, or errors for a React feature.
description_zh: 研究 React API 或概念以编写文档时使用。当您需要为 React 功能提供权威的用法示例、注意事项、警告或错误信息时使用。

description: Control the user's real Safari browser on macOS through AppleScript, page JavaScript, screenshots, and carefully verified System Events input. Use when an agent needs to inspect or operate the user's existing Safari tabs and login sessions, including reading pages, navigating, clicking, filling non-sensitive forms, taking screenshots, observing page-level fetch/XHR metadata, or troubleshooting Safari-specific UI behavior.

description: Modern Angular best practices for building performant, maintainable Angular 17+ applications. Covers Signals, RxJS, components, templates, styles, performance, SSR, testing, forms, routing, accessibility, and architecture — with code examples and impact ratings for every rule. Use this skill whenever the user is working on Angular code of any kind: components, services, templates, stylesheets, routes, tests, or configuration. This applies to editing .component.ts, .service.ts, .html templates, .scss/.css styles, .spec.ts tests, .routes.ts files, store files, and any general .ts file in an Angular project. Look for angular.json, nx.json, or @angular/core imports as project indicators. Do not use for AngularJS (1.x), React, Vue, or non-Angular TypeScript projects.
description_zh: 构建高性能、易于维护的 Angular 17+ 应用程序的现代 Angular 最佳实践。涵盖 Signals、RxJS、组件、模板、样式、性能、SSR、测试、表单、路由、无障碍访问以及架构等内容——为每一条规则提供代码示例和影响评级。当用户处理任何类型的 Angular 代码（如组件、服务、模板、样式表、路由、测试或配置）时，请使用此技能。此技能适用于编辑 Angular 项目中的 .component.ts、.service.ts、.html 模板、.scss/.css 样式、.spec.ts 测试、.routes.ts 文件、存储文件，以及任何通用的 .ts 文件。通过 angular.json、nx.json 或 @angular/core 的导入来判断项目是否为 Angular 项目。不得用于 AngularJS (1.x)、React、Vue 或非 Angular 的 TypeScript 项目。

description: Data Mask end-to-end operation on a sandbox: configure a masking policy over PII, run the masking job, poll it to completion, report masked-record results, and abort an in-progress run. Use when the user needs to run, monitor, or cancel a Salesforce Data Mask job, mask PII/sandbox data, or work with DataMaskPolicy / DataMaskPolicyJobRun. TRIGGER when: user runs a data mask job, masks sandbox PII, polls masking status, reports masked records, or aborts a running mask. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing anonymization Apex by hand (use platform-apex-generate), generating test data (use platform-data-manage), or deploying unrelated metadata (use platform-metadata-deploy).
description_zh:
沙盒中的数据脱敏端到端操作：配置针对个人身份信息（PII）的脱敏策略，运行脱敏任务，轮询直至完成，报告已脱敏记录结果，并中止正在进行的运行。

**使用场景**：当用户需要运行、监控或取消 Salesforce 数据脱敏任务、脱敏个人身份信息/沙盒数据，或使用 DataMaskPolicy / DataMaskPolicyJobRun 时使用。

**触发条件**：当用户运行数据脱敏任务、脱敏沙盒中的个人身份信息、轮询脱敏状态、报告已脱敏记录，或中止正在运行的脱敏任务时触发。

**切勿触发场景**：手动编写匿名化 Apex（应使用 platform-apex-generate）、生成测试数据（应使用 platform-data-manage），或部署不相关的元数据（应使用 platform-metadata-deploy）时。

Use when running cog push, deploying a model to Replicate, releasing a new version, validating a model with cog-safe-push before publishing, configuring a Replicate deployment, setting up GitHub Actions for model releases, or porting a community model to an official one. Trigger on phrases like "push a model to Replicate", "publish a model", "deploy a model", "release a new version", "cog push", "cog-safe-push", "model CI", "r8.im", or "schema compatibility", and when referencing github.com/replicate/cog-safe-push or github.com/replicate/model-ci-template. Covers cog push, the full cog-safe-push config (test cases, fuzz, deployment, official_model), GitHub Actions patterns, multi-model matrix pushes, and post-publish monitoring. Assumes you already have a working Cog project; see build-models if you need to package one first.
description_zh:
将自定义AI模型推送到Replicate并发布，并设置CI/CD流程以安全地发布新模型版本。适用于执行cog push、将模型部署到Replicate、发布新版本、在发布前使用cog-safe-push验证模型、配置Replicate部署、为模型发布设置GitHub Actions，或将社区模型迁移为官方模型时使用。

当触发关键词如"push a model to Replicate"、"publish a model"、"deploy a model"、"release a new version"、"cog push"、"cog-safe-push"、"model CI"、"r8.im"或"schema compatibility"时触发，以及在引用github.com/replicate/cog-safe-push或github.com/replicate/model-ci-template时触发。

涵盖cog push、完整的cog-safe-push配置（测试用例、fuzz、部署、official_model）、GitHub Actions模式、多模型矩阵推送以及发布后监控。假设您已拥有一个可正常运行的Cog项目；如果需要先打包一个，请参阅build-models。

description: Advanced GitHub Actions workflow automation with AI swarm coordination, intelligent CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive repository management

description: Expert guidance for writing high-quality academic and research papers. Use when the user wants to write, structure, revise, or improve academic papers, research articles, conference papers, or technical reports. Provides comprehensive support for all stages from planning to final polish.
description_zh: 撰写高质量学术与科研论文的专家指导。适用于用户需要撰写、构建、修改或优化学术论文、研究文章、会议论文或技术报告时，为从规划到最终润色的各个阶段提供全面支持。

description: Build React components, implement responsive layouts, and handle client-side state management. Masters React 19, Next.js 15, and modern frontend architecture.
description_zh: 构建 React 组件，实现响应式布局，并处理客户端状态管理。精通 React 19、Next.js 15 及现代前端架构。

description: Create a comprehensive brand standards document — covering logo usage, color, typography, voice, messaging, and application rules. Use when the user says "brand guidelines", "brand standards", "brand book", "style guide", "brand guide", "brand manual", "brand rules", "brand documentation", "brand toolkit", "onboarding designers or copywriters", "need a document for the team", "brand consistency across teams", or wants to codify all brand decisions into a reusable reference document.
description_zh: 创建一份全面的品牌标准文档——涵盖标志使用、色彩、排版、语气、信息传达与应用规则。当用户提及“品牌指南”、“品牌标准”、“品牌手册”、“风格指南”、“品牌指南”、“品牌手册”、“品牌规则”、“品牌文档”、“品牌工具包”、要求为新入职的设计师或文案撰写人员进行入职引导、表示团队需要一份文档、强调跨团队的品牌一致性，或希望将所有品牌决策固化为可复用的参考文档时使用。

description: React Email renderer for json-render that turns JSON specs into HTML or plain-text emails using @react-email/components and @react-email/render. Use when working with @json-render/react-email, building transactional or marketing emails from JSON, creating email catalogs, rendering AI-generated email specs, or when the user mentions react-email, HTML email, or transactional email.

description: Canonical workflow for a task. Read and follow strictly end to end while working on the task.

description: An X API alternative and Twitter API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no OAuth and no developer application. Use when the user wants to search X posts by keyword, hashtag, or advanced operators (from:, to:, since:, until:, min_faves:, filter:), scrape an X/Twitter profile by handle, pull a user's posts, replies, followers, or followings, fetch a single post with its replies or reposters, read an X List's members or posts, check trending topics by country, or search for X accounts by name. Also covers building an X data pipeline, social listening, competitor monitoring, hashtag tracking, or follower export without the official X API's pricing tiers or app-review process.
description_zh: fetcher.sh 上的 X API 替代方案及 Twitter API 替代方案——通过 x402 以 USDC 按调用计费，或使用 Bearer 密钥充值预付费额度，无需 OAuth 和开发者申请。适用于用户希望按关键词、话题标签或高级运算符（from:、to:、since:、until:、min_faves:、filter:）搜索 X 帖子时使用。支持通过用户名抓取 X/Twitter 主页，获取用户发布的帖子、回复、关注者或粉丝，获取包含回复或转发者的单条帖子，读取 X List 的成员或帖子，按国家查看热门话题，或按名称搜索 X 账号。此外，还支持构建 X 数据管道、开展社会监听、竞品监控、话题标签追踪或粉丝导出，无需经过官方 X API 的定价层级或应用审核流程。

description: Expert in LangGraph - the production-grade framework for building stateful, multi-actor AI applications. Covers graph construction, state management, cycles and branches, persistence with checkpointers, human-in-the-loop patterns, and the ReAct agent pattern.
description_zh: LangGraph 专家 —— 构建有状态、多智能体 AI 应用的生产级框架，涵盖图构建、状态管理、循环与分支、基于检查点的持久化、人在环模式以及 ReAct 智能体模式。

description: Run an AWS Security Agent scan on the workspace — uploads the source to AWS, scans it with the managed Security Agent service, and returns ranked, verified findings with code locations and remediations. Use when the user asks to scan code, find vulnerabilities, run a security scan or review, check security issues, check scan status, show findings, list recent scans, or stop a scan.
description_zh: 在工作区运行 AWS 安全代理扫描——将源代码上传到 AWS，使用托管的安全代理服务进行扫描，并返回带有代码位置和修复方案的有序、已验证的发现结果。适用于用户要求扫描代码、查找漏洞、运行安全扫描或审查、检查安全问题、查看扫描状态、显示发现结果、列出最近扫描或停止扫描等场景。

description_zh: 当用户想要设置、优化或管理 TikTok Ads 时。当用户提到“TikTok Ads”、“TikTok for Business”、“TikTok Pixel”、“Events API”、“TikTok Spark Ads”或“TikTok video ads”时，也使用。对于自然 TikTok，使用 tiktok-captions。

description: Trigger a pre-merge release readiness review on a GitHub PR, GitLab MR, or local branch. Use when the user wants to analyze code changes for risk, correctness, and potential rollback issues before merging. Trigger words include release readiness, analyze PR, analyze MR, review PR, risk analysis, pre-merge, safe to ship, ready to merge, ready to commit, any risks, before merging, validate changes, release management.

Preserve supplied evidence and format. Assessment without rewriting belongs to ccf-paper-reviewer; rebuttal belongs to ccf-rebuttal-writer.

description: Build responsive, mobile-first layouts using fluid containers, flexible units, media queries, and touch-friendly design that works across all screen sizes. Use this skill when creating or modifying UI layouts, responsive grids, breakpoint styles, mobile navigation, or any interface that needs to adapt to different screen sizes. Apply when working with responsive CSS, media queries, viewport settings, flexbox/grid layouts, mobile-first styling, breakpoint definitions (mobile, tablet, desktop), touch target sizing, relative units (rem, em, %), image optimization for different screens, or testing layouts across multiple devices. Use for any task involving multi-device support, responsive design patterns, or adaptive layouts.

description:
Polymarket sports prediction markets — read-only live odds, prices, order books, events, series, and market search. No auth required. Covers NFL, NBA, MLB, football (EPL, UCL, La Liga), tennis, cricket, MMA, esports. Supports moneyline, spreads, totals, and player props.

Use when: user asks about sports betting odds, prediction markets, win probabilities, market sentiment, or "who is favored to win" questions and only needs read-only market intelligence.
Don't use when: user asks about actual match results, scores, or statistics — use the sport-specific skill. Don't use for historical match data. Don't use for news — use sports-news instead. Don't use for placing, cancelling, or managing orders — use the separate polymarket-trading skill only after explicit user approval.
description_zh:
Polymarket 体育赛事预测市场 — 提供只读的实时赔率、价格、订单簿、赛事、系列赛及市场搜索功能。无需身份验证。涵盖 NFL、NBA、MLB、足球（英超、欧冠、西甲）、网球、板球、综合格斗（MMA）及电竞。支持独赢盘、盘口、总分及球员及参赛者数据（Props）。

适用场景：当用户询问体育赛事投注赔率、预测市场、胜率、市场情绪，或“谁更被看好获胜”等疑问，且仅需只读市场情报时使用。

不适用场景：当用户询问实际比赛结果、比分或统计数据时，请使用对应运动的专业技能。不得用于历史比赛数据。不得用于新闻查询，请使用体育新闻服务。不得用于下注、取消或管理订单，请仅在用户明确授权后，使用独立的 Polymarket 交易技能。

description: Up-to-date Microsoft Graph API knowledge for AI agents. Search 27,700+ Graph APIs, endpoint docs, resource schemas, and community samples — all locally, no network calls. Use when the agent needs to find, understand, or call Microsoft Graph endpoints.

Use when the user describes an incident, alarm, outage, or unexplained behavior — keywords like "5xx", "503", "OOM", "latency spike", "deployment failure", "rollback", "sev1", "investigate", "root cause", "debug", "alarm fired", "service down". description: Pull AWS Security Agent findings (penetration tests and code reviews) and drive remediation. Use this whenever the user mentions Security Agent, security findings, pentest or penetration test results, code review findings, vulnerabilities found in their AWS account, "what did the security scan find", remediating or triaging security risks, or wants to start fixing reported vulnerabilities — even if they don't name the service explicitly.
