Be sure to use this skill when the user asks for the latest docs, latest API behavior, or explicitly mentions chub or Context Hub. Ensure `chub` is available, run `chub --help`, then follow the instructions there.
description_zh: 使用此技能，在编写使用它们（第三方 API、SDK 或库）的代码之前获取相关文档，以确保您拥有最新、最准确的官方文档。与进行网络搜索相比，这是查找文档的更好方式。这包括当用户提出类似“使用 OpenAI API”、“调用 Stripe API”、“使用 Anthropic SDK”、“查询 Pinecone”等任务，或在任何其他情况下要求您针对外部服务编写代码且需要当前 API 参考时。在回答之前，使用 chub 获取文档，而不是依赖您的预训练知识，因为这些 API 近期有所变化，可能导致知识过时。请务必在用户要求获取最新文档、了解最新 API 行为，或明确提及 chub 或 Context Hub 时使用此技能。确保 `chub` 可用，运行 `chub --help`，然后按照其中的说明操作。

description: Coordinate the AWS DevOps Agent across multiple AgentSpaces from one Claude Code session — route questions to the right space (prod vs staging vs knowledge), query several spaces in parallel and synthesize, or compare findings across accounts. Use whenever the user has more than one AgentSpace configured, mentions multiple AWS accounts, or asks something like "check both prod and staging", "compare across accounts", or "ask the knowledge space".
description_zh: 在一个 Claude Code 会话中，协调 AWS DevOps Agent 在多个 AgentSpace 上工作——将问题路由到正确的空间（生产环境、预发布环境或知识库），并行查询多个空间并整合信息，或比较不同账户中的发现。当用户配置了不止一个 AgentSpace、提及多个 AWS 账户，或询问类似"检查生产环境和预发布环境"、"跨账户比较"或"咨询知识库"等内容时，随时使用此功能。

description: Create / provision / set up a NEW Digital Experience (Communities) / Experience Cloud site — employee service, IT support, help desk, HR, customer, and partner portals — via the headless-360 MCP site-creation APIs. Use whenever a user asks to create/provision/set up a portal, site, or community, e.g.: 'create an employee service portal', 'create an IT Support Portal', 'create an Agentforce Employee Center', including wiring MIAW (Messaging for In-App/Web) at create. This is the site-CREATION skill and OWNS provisioning a new Aura OR LWR Experience Builder site from scratch — trigger it even when the user says 'Experience Builder site' or 'LWR site', as long as a NEW site is wanted. It always writes a portal-creation report as its final step (never ad hoc via CLI) and never makes a legacy Tabs+Visualforce site. DO NOT TRIGGER only for modifying an EXISTING site's pages/routes/theme/branding/guest-access metadata (experience-lwr-site-generate), existing-site customization (experience-ui-bundle), CMS, Commerce.
description_zh:
通过 headless-360 MCP site-creation APIs 创建 / 配置 / 建立一个新的数字体验（Communities）/ Experience Cloud 站点——员工服务、IT 支持、帮助台、HR、客户和合作伙伴门户——每当用户要求创建 / 配置 / 建立门户、站点或社区时，应使用该方法，例如：“创建员工服务门户”、“创建 IT 支持门户”、“创建 Agentforce 员工中心”，包括在创建时接入 MIAW（Messaging for In-App/Web）。

这是 site-CREATION 技能，并且负责从零开始为新 Aura 或 LWR Experience Builder 站点进行配置部署——即使用户说“Experience Builder site”或“LWR site”，只要需要创建新站点，就触发该技能。它始终将生成门户创建报告作为最终步骤（绝不临时通过 CLI 完成），并且永远不会创建 legacy Tabs+Visualforce 站点。

切勿仅因以下场景触发：修改现有站点的页面/路由/主题/品牌/访客访问元数据（experience-lwr-site-generate）；现有站点自定义（experience-ui-bundle）；CMS；Commerce。

description: 使用得到大脑保存文字、链接、图片和长笔记，查看笔记详情、原文、录音转写、附件、时间线、快捷笔记和会议待办，并安全更新、删除或分享笔记。
description_zh: 使用得到大脑保存文字、链接、图片及长笔记，查看笔记详情、原文、录音转写、附件、时间线、快捷笔记和会议待办，并安全地更新、删除或分享笔记。

description: Amazon PPC campaign builder and optimizer for sellers. Two modes: (A) Build — design a complete campaign structure from scratch with keyword groupings, bid calculations, and negative keyword lists, (B) Optimize — audit existing campaigns using search term reports, identify keyword funnel opportunities, calculate bid adjustments, and generate a week-by-week action plan. Integrates with amazon-keyword-research for keyword input. No API key required. Use when: (1) setting up Amazon PPC campaigns for a new product, (2) auditing existing campaign performance and ACoS, (3) optimizing keyword bids and negative keywords, (4) building Auto/Manual/Exact campaign structures, (5) analyzing search term reports for opportunities, (6) calculating break-even ACoS and target ACoS, (7) scaling profitable campaigns to Sponsored Brands or Display.
description_zh:
Amazon PPC 广告计划构建器与优化器，面向卖家。

两种模式：
(A) 构建 — 从零开始设计完整的广告计划结构，包含关键词分组、出价计算和负关键词列表；
(B) 优化 — 使用搜索词报告审计现有广告计划，识别关键词漏斗机会，计算出价调整，并生成按周制定的操作计划。

与 amazon-keyword-research 集成，支持关键词输入。
无需 API 密钥。

适用场景：
(1) 为新产品设置 Amazon PPC 广告计划；
(2) 审计现有广告计划的性能与 ACoS（广告销售成本比）；
(3) 优化关键词出价与负关键词；
(4) 构建自动、手动、精确匹配广告计划结构；
(5) 分析搜索词报告以挖掘机会；
(6) 计算盈亏平衡 ACoS 与目标 ACoS；
(7) 将盈利广告计划扩展至 Sponsored Brands（品牌推广）或 Display（展示）广告。

description: Use when building AI agent storage workflows on Tigris — forks for isolated dataset copies, workspaces for per-agent buckets with TTL, checkpoints for snapshot/restore, and coordination for event-driven pipelines via bucket webhooks. Triggers on "@tigrisdata/agent-kit", "agent storage", "agent workspace", "agent fork", "isolated agent environment", "checkpoint and restore", "bucket webhook", "multi-agent pipeline"
description_zh:
使用场景：在 Tigris 上构建 AI 智能体存储工作流时——通过 forks 实现数据集副本的隔离，通过工作区为具有 TTL 的每个智能体提供桶，通过 checkpoint 进行快照与恢复，以及通过桶 webhook 协调事件驱动流水线。

触发关键词：@tigrisdata/agent-kit、"智能体存储"、"智能体工作区"、"智能体 forks"、"智能体隔离环境"、"checkpoint 与恢复"、"桶 webhook"、"多智能体流水线"

description: Compatibility pointer for the canonical postmortem skill.
description_zh: 标准复盘技能兼容性指向

description: Use when the task involves reading, creating, or editing `.docx` documents, especially when formatting or layout fidelity matters; prefer `python-docx` plus the bundled `scripts/render_docx.py` for visual checks.
description_zh: 当任务涉及读取、创建或编辑 `.docx` 文档，尤其是格式或版式保真度至关重要时，优先使用 `python-docx` 及内置的 `scripts/render_docx.py` 进行可视化检查。

description: Write production-grade Playwright tests in TypeScript: Page Object Model, fixtures, auto-waiting, user-facing locators, parallel execution, CI integration, sharding, and 2025-2026 feature awareness. Includes an explicit "do not" list for AI agents. Use when: "Playwright," "write E2E test," "page object," "new Playwright suite," "Playwright config." Not for: fixing one flaky test at runtime — use test-reliability. Not for: bulk regenerating selectors after a UI refactor — use selector-drift-recovery. Not for: visual baseline creation/management — use visual-testing. Not for: deep WCAG/axe audits — use accessibility-testing. Related: visual-testing, ci-cd-integration, api-testing, test-reliability, selector-drift-recovery, accessibility-testing.
description_zh:
在 TypeScript 中编写生产级 Playwright 测试：页面对象模型、固件（fixtures）、自动等待、用户定位器、并行执行、CI 集成、分片，以及 2025-2026 特性认知。包含针对 AI 智能体的明确“请勿”清单。

适用场景：当涉及“Playwright”、“编写 E2E 测试”、“页面对象”、“新建 Playwright 测试套件”、“Playwright 配置”时使用。

不适用于：
- 运行时修复单个不稳定测试 —— 请使用 test-reliability。
- UI 重构后批量重新生成选择器 —— 请使用 selector-drift-recovery。
- 可视化基准创建/管理 —— 请使用 visual-testing。
- 深度 WCAG/Axe 审计 —— 请使用 accessibility-testing。

相关：visual-testing, ci-cd-integration, api-testing, test-reliability, selector-drift-recovery, accessibility-testing。

description: Run configured lint and type checks, distinguish failures from checks that did not run, and report concrete validation results.
description_zh: 执行已配置的 lint 与类型检查，区分失败项与未运行的检查，并报告具体的验证结果。

description: Explanations of common asynchronous patterns used in tursodb. Involves IOResult, state machines, re-entrancy pitfalls, CompletionGroup. Always use these patterns in `core` when doing anything IO
description_zh: tursodb 常用异步模式的说明。涉及 IOResult、状态机、重入陷阱、CompletionGroup。在进行任何 IO 操作时，在 `core` 中始终使用这些模式。

description: Tauri development guidelines for building cross-platform desktop applications with TypeScript, Rust, and modern web technologies
description_zh: 基于 TypeScript、Rust 及现代 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的 Tauri 开发指南

description: Use when building 3D scenes with TresJS (Vue Three.js) - provides TresCanvas, composables (useTres, useLoop), Cientos helpers (OrbitControls, useGLTF, Environment), and post-processing effects
description_zh: 在 TresJS (Vue Three.js) 中构建 3D 场景时使用：提供 TresCanvas、composables（useTres，useLoop）、Cientos 辅助工具（OrbitControls，useGLTF，Environment）以及后处理效果

description: Collect read-only evidence about PlanetScale org, database, branches, webhooks, backups, roles, Insights, recommendations, and traffic configuration.
description_zh: 收集关于 PlanetScale 组织、数据库、分支、Webhooks、备份、角色、Insights、推荐及流量配置的只读证据。

description: Build a safe recommendation plan for PlanetScale Postgres Database Traffic Control budgets and rules without applying them.
description_zh: 在不应用的前提下，为 PlanetScale PostgreSQL 数据库流量控制的预算和规则构建一个安全建议方案。

description: Generate and iterate on UI with 21st AI from the terminal via the `21st` CLI (`@21st-dev/cli`): sketch a UI from a prompt, preview the variants in the browser, edit any variant in place with a natural-language change, and pull the final code into the project. Use whenever the user wants to BUILD / SKETCH new UI ("sketch a pricing page", "generate a hero with 21st", "make me a <X> section"), ITERATE on a generated draft ("edit the third variant", "add a toggle to that take"), or GRAB the code of a draft ("pull that variant's code", "сгенери UI на 21st", "поправь третий вариант", "забери код того наброска"). For finding/installing existing components use the `21st-cli-use` skill; to publish your own, `21st-registry`.
description_zh:
使用 `21st` CLI（`@21st-dev/cli`）从终端通过 21st AI 生成并迭代 UI：根据提示词勾勒 UI，在浏览器中预览各变体，使用自然语言更改原位编辑任一变体，并将最终代码拉取到项目中。

用户需要 **BUILD** / **SKETCH** 新 UI 时使用（例如"生成一个价格页面"、"用 21st 生成一个主视觉图"、"为我制作一个 <X>" 区块），对生成草稿进行 **ITERATE**（例如"编辑第三个变体"、"为那个区块添加一个开关"），或 **GRAB** 草稿的代码（例如"获取该变体的代码"、"用 21st 生成 UI"、"修改第三个版本"、"获取那个草稿的代码"）。查找/安装现有组件使用 `21st-cli-use` 技能；发布自己的组件使用 `21st-registry`。

description: Use this skill to create a Salesforce trial, developer, or Trialforce org against an already-authenticated host org, the same way a developer/Trialforce web signup form provisions one. INVOKE when the user asks to: create a trial org, sign up a new trial or developer org, provision a Trialforce org from a template, or check the status of a trial-org signup they started. Trigger phrases: 'create a trial org', 'sign up a trial org', 'spin up a dev org', 'Trialforce signup', 'provision trial from template', 'check my trial org signup status'. Do NOT use for scratch orgs (use dx-org-manage) or for checking trial expiration dates of existing orgs (use dx-org-trial-expiration-check).
description_zh: 使用此技能，通过一个已认证的主组织，以与开发者/Trialforce网页注册表单建立组织相同的方式，创建一个Salesforce试用、开发者或Trialforce组织。当用户要求执行以下操作时，调用此技能：创建试用组织、注册新的试用或开发者组织、根据模板配置Trialforce组织，或查看其启动的试用组织注册状态。触发短语：“创建试用组织”、“注册试用组织”、“启动开发者组织”、“Trialforce注册”、“根据模板配置试用”、“查看我的试用组织注册状态”。不得用于临时组织（使用dx-org-manage），也不得用于检查现有组织的试用有效期（使用dx-org-trial-expiration-check）。

description: Review manuscript claims, evidence, and writing without rewriting. Use for 文章审核, 审稿, 稿件有什么硬伤, 结论站得住吗, 投稿成熟度, writing review, and version comparison. Return a structured scientific or writing review; scores need not be explicitly requested. Concept-only judgment belongs to ccf-idea-reviewer even with a full PDF; requested prose edits belong to ccf-paper-writer.
description_zh: 在不重写稿件的前提下，审核稿件的论断、证据与写作。适用于文章审核、审稿、稿件存在哪些硬伤、结论是否站得住脚、投稿成熟度、写作审核以及版本对比等场景。输出结构化的科学或写作审核意见；分数无需明确要求。仅概念判断属于 ccf-idea-reviewer，即使提供完整PDF；要求的文字润色修改属于 ccf-paper-writer。

description: Use when the user asks for STRIDE threat modeling, DREAD risk scoring, data-flow-diagram threat analysis, or a quick secret scan — or when a security request needs routing to the right specialist skill (pen-testing, incident response, cloud posture, red team, AI security, threat hunting, secure code review). This skill owns threat modeling; everything else routes to a sibling.
description_zh: 当用户请求进行 STRIDE 威胁建模、DREAD 风险评分、数据流图威胁分析或快速秘密扫描时使用；或当安全请求需要路由至相应专业技能（渗透测试、事件响应、云安全态势、红队、AI 安全、威胁狩猎、安全代码审查）时使用。本技能负责威胁建模，其余内容均路由至同级技能。

description:
Fetch up-to-date library documentation via Context7 CLI. Use PROACTIVELY when:
(1) Working with ANY external library (React, Next.js, Supabase, etc.)
(2) User asks about library APIs, patterns, or best practices
(3) Implementing features that rely on third-party packages
(4) Debugging library-specific issues
(5) Need current documentation beyond training data cutoff
(6) AND MOST IMPORTANTLY, when you are installing dependencies, libraries, or frameworks you should ALWAYS check the docs to see what the latest versions are. Do not rely on outdated knowledge.
Always prefer this over guessing library APIs or using outdated knowledge.
description_zh:
通过 Context7 CLI 获取最新的库文档。当以下情况发生时，务必使用 PROACTIVELY：
(1) 处理任何外部库（React、Next.js、Supabase 等）
(2) 用户询问库的 API、模式或最佳实践
(3) 实现依赖第三方包的功能
(4) 调试库特有的问题
(5) 需要获取超出训练数据截止日期后的最新文档
(6) 且最重要的是，在安装依赖项、库或框架时，您始终应查阅文档，以了解最新版本。请勿依赖过时的知识。
始终优先采用此方法，而非猜测库的 API 或依赖过时的知识。

description: When the user wants to design, optimize, or audit carousel/slider layouts for content display. Also use when the user mentions "carousel," "slider," "carousel layout," "testimonial carousel," "gallery carousel," "quote carousel," "image slider," or "carousel accessibility." For hero-area patterns, use hero-generator.
description_zh: 当用户希望对内容展示的轮播/滑动布局进行设计、优化或审计时，使用此功能。当用户提到“轮播”、“滑动”、“轮播布局”、“证言轮播”、“图库轮播”、“引言轮播”、“图片滑动”或“轮播可访问性”时，也使用此功能。对于英雄区域模式，使用 hero-generator。

description: Create, update, and organize Google Calendar events and schedules. Check availability, book time, and manage calendars. Use when asked to schedule a meeting, set up an appointment, book a call, check gcal, or manage calendar events.
description_zh: 创建、更新和组织 Google 日历事件与日程。查询可用时间、预约时间并管理日历。当被要求安排会议、设置预约、预约通话、查看 gcal 或管理日历事件时使用。

description: An immersive, interactive, exhibit-style interface that blends storytelling, animation, and gamified elements to create a playful, experience-driven journey. The entire app sits on a single continuous brand-colored canvas (deep green)
description_zh: 一种沉浸式、互动式、展陈风格的界面，融合叙事、动画与游戏化元素，打造充满乐趣、体验驱动的旅程。整个应用呈现在单一连续的品牌色画布（深绿色）之上。

description: You are a code refactoring expert specializing in clean code principles, SOLID design patterns, and modern software engineering best practices. Analyze and refactor the provided code to improve its quality, maintainability, and performance.
description_zh: 您是一位代码重构专家，专注于 Clean Code 原则、SOLID 设计模式与现代软件工程最佳实践。分析并重构所提供代码，以提升其质量、可维护性与性能。

description_zh: 资深前端开发工程师，精通 ReactJS、NextJS、JavaScript、TypeScript、HTML、CSS 及现代 UI/UX 框架。
