description_zh: 使用 TypeScript 的 React 和 Next.js 应用全面的 Redux Toolkit 最佳实践

description: Build a persistent knowledge graph of your codebase so Claude reads only what matters — up to 49x fewer tokens on coding tasks.
description_zh: 构建代码库的持久知识图谱，让 Claude 只读取重要内容——在编码任务上，token 消耗最多可降低 49 倍。

description: How to write tests, when to use each type of test, and how to run them. Contains information about conversion of `.test` to `.sqltest`, and how to write `.sqltest` and rust tests
description_zh: 如何编写测试、何时使用每种类型的测试以及如何运行它们。内容包括将 `.test` 转换为 `.sqltest` 的转换方法，以及如何编写 `.sqltest` 和 Rust 测试。

description: Run automated release testing (UI or API) via the AWS DevOps Agent using a pre-configured test profile. Use when the user wants to validate multi-step workflows, verify features, check for regressions, or test API endpoints. Trigger words include run tests, UAT, test my app, test profile, UI test, API test, automated testing, regression test, QA, end-to-end test, run the QA agent.
description_zh: 通过 AWS DevOps Agent，使用预配置的测试配置文件运行自动化发布测试（UI 或 API）。当用户需要验证多步骤工作流、验证功能、检查回归问题或测试 API 端点时使用。触发词包括：运行测试、UAT、测试我的应用、测试配置、UI 测试、API 测试、自动化测试、回归测试、QA、端到端测试、运行 QA 代理。

description: Find and verify external literature, prior art, datasets, benchmarks, and citation candidates. Use for 文献检索, 相关工作, benchmark搜索, and research opportunity maps. Recurring recent-paper watch belongs to ccf-literature-monitor; existing-citation audits, manuscript assessment, and result schemas have separate owners.
description_zh: 查找并验证外部文献、现有技术、数据集、基准和引用候选。用于文献检索、相关工作、benchmark搜索和研究机会地图。定期近期论文监控属于 ccf-literature-monitor；现有引用审计、手稿评估和结果模式有各自的负责人。

description: Recommend webhook subscriptions and safe automation patterns for PlanetScale alerts, anomalies, schema recommendations, deploy requests, and agent workflows.
description_zh: 推荐 PlanetScale 警报、异常、模式推荐、部署请求及代理工作流的 Webhook 订阅与安全自动化模式。

description: Guide to deploying and managing OpenClaw-compatible AI agent systems across cloud, bare metal, and hybrid infrastructure.
description_zh: 兼容OpenClaw的AI智能体系统在云、裸机及混合基础设施中的部署与管理系统指南

description: Set up, write, or review Rstest tests and configuration, including environments, mocks, snapshots, coverage, and CI.
description_zh: 设置、编写或审查 Rstest 测试及配置，包括环境、模拟、快照、覆盖率与 CI。

description: Autonomous agents are AI systems that can independently decompose goals, plan actions, execute tools, and self-correct without constant human guidance. The challenge isn't making them capable - it's making them reliable. Every extra decision multiplies failure probability.
description_zh: 自主智能体是能够独立分解目标、规划行动、执行工具，并在无需持续人类指导的情况下自我纠正的AI系统。挑战不在于让它们具备能力——而在于让它们可靠。每一个额外的决策都会成倍增加失败概率。

description: Build production-ready Web3 applications, smart contracts, and decentralized systems. Implements DeFi protocols, NFT platforms, DAOs, and enterprise blockchain integrations.
description_zh: 构建生产就绪的 Web3 应用、智能合约和去中心化系统。实现 DeFi 协议、NFT 平台、DAO 以及企业区块链集成。

description: SQLite file format, B-trees, pages, cells, overflow, freelist that is used in tursodb
description_zh: 在 tursodb 中使用的 SQLite 文件格式、B 树、页、单元格、溢出和自由列表。

description: Turn ordinary text plans into rich interactive visual plans with diagrams, file maps, annotated code, open questions, and UI/prototype review when useful.
description_zh: 在需要时，将普通文本计划转化为内容丰富的交互式可视化计划，包含图示、文件地图、带注释的代码、开放问题以及 UI/原型评审。

description: Use this skill whenever LMX is used, produced, reviewed, migrated, or modified. This includes composing campaigns, loops, lifecycle emails, or email-message bodies for the Loops editor or Content API. LMX (Loops Markup Language) is the format used for Loops email content. Trigger on phrases like "create a campaign", "generate an email", "write a welcome email", "draft a lifecycle email", "build an email template", "create an onboarding email", "copy this into LMX", "migrate this email", "convert this email to LMX", "design a new Loops email", "use imagegen for a Loops email", "use gpt-image for an LMX reference", "visual reference for a Loops email", "LMX", "Loops email", or any request to produce, copy, migrate, convert, review, or modify email body content intended for Loops. For net-new emails or major visual redesigns, follow this skill's Net-New Email Design Flow before generating or sourcing new visual assets. Source copy, existing HTML, MJML, Markdown, screenshots, and migration instructions do not bypass this skill's rules unless the user explicitly overrides a specific rule. Do not trigger for questions about the Loops HTTP API, SDK integration, or CLI unless email body content is also involved.
description_zh: 在 LMX 被使用、生成、审查、迁移或修改时，请使用本技能。这包括为 Loops 编辑器或内容 API 创作活动、循环、生命周期邮件或邮件正文。LMX（Loops 标记语言）是用于 Loops 邮件内容的格式。当出现诸如“创建活动”、“生成邮件”、“撰写欢迎邮件”、“起草生命周期邮件”、“构建邮件模板”、“创建入职邮件”、“将此内容复制到 LMX”、“迁移此邮件”、“将此邮件转换为 LMX”、“设计新的 Loops 邮件”、“使用 imagegen 为 Loops 邮件生成图片”、“使用 gpt-image 作为 LMX 参考”、“为 Loops 邮件提供视觉参考”、“LMX”、“Loops 邮件”，或任何旨在为 Loops 生成、复制、迁移、转换、审查或修改邮件正文内容的请求时，请触发本技能。对于全新邮件或重大视觉重新设计，在生成或获取新视觉素材之前，请遵循本技能的全新邮件设计流程。源文案、现有 HTML、MJML、Markdown、截图和迁移说明，除非用户明确覆盖了某项具体规则，否则均不能绕过本技能的规则。对于涉及 Loops HTTP API、SDK 集成或 CLI 的问题，除非也涉及邮件正文内容，否则请勿触发本技能。

description: A research-journal aesthetic printed on warm stone — authoritative, editorial, almost achromatic. Pages live on warm ivory parchment (never pure white), with near-black slate as the dominant ink.
description_zh: 印于温润石材之上的研究期刊审美——权威、兼具编辑感，近乎无色彩。页面以温润的象牙纸承载（绝非纯白），以近黑的板岩墨为主导墨色。

description: Explain any topic, code, concept, or error tailored to a specific audience's level of understanding. Use this skill whenever the user says 'explain like I am', 'ELI5', 'explain this to my', 'break this down for', 'dumb it down', 'simplify this for', or asks you to explain something to a specific person or audience type (e.g., 'explain this to a manager', 'how would I explain this to my mom', 'make this understandable for a 5th grader'). Also trigger when the user mentions wanting to understand something at a particular level, or asks for an explanation targeting a non-technical audience. Even partial matches like 'explain to my wife' or 'tell my boss' should trigger this skill.
description_zh: 根据特定受众的理解水平，为任何主题、代码、概念或错误进行定制化解释。当用户说出“explain like I am”、“ELI5”、“explain this to my”、“break this down for”、“dumb it down”、“simplify this for”等表述，或要求向特定人物或受众类型进行解释时，使用本技能（例如：“向管理者解释这个”、“我该如何向妈妈解释这个”、“让这个内容对五年级学生易于理解”）。此外，当用户表示希望以特定水平理解某事物，或要求针对非技术受众进行解释时，也应触发本技能。即使“explain to my wife”或“tell my boss”这类部分匹配的情况，也应触发本技能。

description: Develop and optimize rough CCF research ideas into problems, insights, mechanisms, and evidence plans. Use for 优化idea, 具象化idea, 找方向, 方向探索, and rescue routes when development is the requested deliverable. Judging whether an idea is worthwhile, novel, or coherent belongs to ccf-idea-reviewer even without scores; manuscript edits belong to ccf-paper-writer.
description_zh: 将初步的CCF研究思路开发并优化，转化为问题、洞见、机制与证据方案。若开发为要求的交付成果，用于优化思路、具象化思路、寻找方向、方向探索和补救路线。判断思路是否值得、新颖且连贯，即使没有分数，也属于ccf-idea-reviewer；稿件修改属于ccf-paper-writer。

description: Produce the final PlanetScale best-practices report after running the inventory and relevant review skills.
description_zh: 在运行库存盘点及相关审查技能后，生成最终的 PlanetScale 最佳实践报告。

description: Build or update the code review knowledge graph. Run this first to initialize, or let hooks keep it updated automatically.
description_zh: 构建或更新代码评审知识图谱。先运行此操作以初始化，或让钩子自动保持其最新状态。

description: React Flow (@xyflow/react) for workflow visualization with custom nodes and edges. Use when building graph visualizations, creating custom workflow nodes, implementing edge labels, or controlling viewport. Triggers on ReactFlow, @xyflow/react, Handle, NodeProps, EdgeProps, useReactFlow, fitView.
description_zh: React Flow (@xyflow/react) 用于工作流可视化，支持自定义节点和边。适用于构建图可视化、创建自定义工作流节点、实现边标签或控制视口。触发关键词：ReactFlow, @xyflow/react, Handle, NodeProps, EdgeProps, useReactFlow, fitView。

description: Generate images with Pruna P-Image models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Image, P-Image-LoRA, P-Image-Edit, P-Image-Edit-LoRA. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, multi-image compositing, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna, p-image, pruna image, fast image generation, optimized flux, pruna ai, p image, fast ai image, economic image generation, cheap image generation
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh 命令行工具，使用 Pruna P-Image 模型生成图像。

模型：P-Image、P-Image-LoRA、P-Image-Edit、P-Image-Edit-LoRA。

能力：文生图、图像编辑、LoRA 风格、多图合成、快速推理。

Pruna 在不损失质量的前提下优化模型速度。

触发词：pruna、p-image、pruna image、fast image generation、optimized flux、pruna ai、p image、fast ai image、economic image generation、cheap image generation

description: Tailwind CSS utility-first framework for rapid UI development with responsive design and dark mode
description_zh: Tailwind CSS：一款以工具优先为理念的框架，可实现快速 UI 开发，支持响应式设计与暗黑模式。

description: Use this skill for Interactive Media Ads (IMA) SDK client-side ad insertion when you are requesting video ads client-side into websites, apps, TVs or other platforms with VAST or VMAP. Do not use for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), SSAI, or SGAI (use the `ima-sdk-dai-basics` skill instead).
description_zh: 使用本技能进行交互式媒体广告（IMA）SDK 客户端广告插入，适用于当需要将视频广告以客户端方式插入网站、应用、电视或其他支持 VAST 或 VMAP 的平台时。请勿用于动态广告插入（DAI）、SSAI 或 SGAI（请改用 `ima-sdk-dai-basics` 技能）。

description: Design CCF experiment protocols and evidence schemas: datasets, baselines, metrics, ablations, and result-table contents. Use for 设计实验, 消融, benchmark planning, and 结果表证据结构. Preserve real values. Table styling/rendering belongs to ccf-visual-composer; broad retrieval belongs to ccf-literature-searcher.
description_zh: 设计CCF实验方案与证据模式：数据集、基准、指标、消融实验以及结果表内容。用于 设计实验、消融、基准规划以及 结果表证据结构。保留真实数值。表格样式/渲染属于 ccf-visual-composer；广泛检索属于 ccf-literature-searcher。

description: Audit existing CCF claims, numbers, terminology, and citations against supplied or verified evidence. Use for 引用核验, claim审计, 数字一致性, and BibTeX/context checks. Full scientific review belongs to ccf-paper-reviewer; new literature discovery belongs to ccf-literature-searcher.
description_zh: 对现有的 CCF 声明、数字、术语和引用进行审计，并与已提供或经核实的证据进行核对。用于引用核验、声明审计、数字一致性和 BibTeX/context 检查。完整的科学评审由 ccf-paper-reviewer 负责；新的文献发现由 ccf-literature-searcher 负责。

description: Search A-Share/HK/US finance stock tickers and retrieve finance stock price history. Use when user asks about finance stock codes, recent price changes, or specific company finance stock info.
description_zh: 检索A股/HK/美股金融股票代码，并获取金融股票历史价格。当用户询问金融股票代码、近期价格变动或特定公司金融股票信息时使用。

description: Foundation skill that captures and stores core brand context — identity, audience, positioning, values, and voice. Use when the user says "set brand context", "save my brand info", "store brand details", "brand profile", "create brand context file", "update brand context", or when starting any brand project for the first time. Every other brand skill reads this file first. Always run this before beginning any brand work if the context file doesn't exist yet.
description_zh: 用于捕获并存储核心品牌上下文——身份、受众、定位、价值观和语调的基础技能。当用户说“设置品牌上下文”、“保存我的品牌信息”、“存储品牌详情”、“品牌简介”、“创建品牌上下文文件”、“更新品牌上下文”，或首次启动任何品牌项目时使用。其他所有品牌技能必须先读取此文件。如果上下文文件尚未存在，在开始任何品牌工作之前，始终运行此技能。

description: Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) vertical skill for the Customware SPA. Defines patterns, minimum standards, layout patterns, lifecycle indicators, product configurator patterns, business rule templates, and mapping rules for transforming a DOMAIN.md into a CPQ-shaped application. Targeted at SMB customers (5-50 employees) migrating from spreadsheets and email-based quoting workflows. The prototype must feel dramatically better than Excel without feeling enterprise-overcomplicated. Patterns are defaults, not mandates — adapt them when the actual workflow deviates. Trigger signals: quoting, pricing, product configuration, calculators, guided intake forms, assessment tools, estimate builders, proposal workflows, eligibility checkers, any "fill in fields → calculate → produce a deliverable" pattern.
description_zh: 为 Customware SPA 配置的 Configure-Price-Quote（CPQ）垂直技能。定义了模式、最低标准、布局模式、生命周期指标、产品配置器模式、业务规则模板以及映射规则，用于将 DOMAIN.md 转化为具备 CPQ 形态的应用。面向中小企业客户（5-50 名员工），这些客户正从电子表格及基于邮件的方式迁移至报价工作流程。该原型必须比 Excel 体验好得多，但不能显得企业级过度复杂。模式是默认值，而非强制要求——当实际工作流程偏离时，需对其进行适配调整。触发信号：报价、定价、产品配置、计算器、引导式信息收集表单、评估工具、估算构建器、提案工作流程、资格检查器，以及任何“填写字段 → 计算 → 生成交付物”的模式。

description: Comprehensive QA and testing skill for quality assurance, test automation, and testing strategies for ReactJS, NextJS, NodeJS applications. Includes test suite generation, coverage analysis, E2E testing setup, and quality metrics. Use when designing test strategies, writing test cases, implementing test automation, performing manual testing, or analyzing test coverage.
description_zh: 全面的QA与测试技能，涵盖质量保证、测试自动化及针对ReactJS、NextJS、NodeJS应用的测试策略。包括测试套件生成、覆盖率分析、端到端测试设置与质量指标。用于设计测试策略、编写测试用例、实施测试自动化、进行手动测试或分析测试覆盖率。

description: Official Salesforce documentation retrieval guidance. Use when you need authoritative Salesforce docs from developer.salesforce.com or help.salesforce.com, especially when pages are JS-heavy, shell-rendered, or hard to extract with naive fetching.
description_zh: 官方 Salesforce 文档获取指南。当您需从 developer.salesforce.com 或 help.salesforce.com 获取权威 Salesforce 文档时使用，特别是当页面 JS 代码密集、由 Shell 渲染，或使用常规抓取方式难以提取时。

description: Assess research ideas for value, novelty, insight, and mechanism. Use for 思路审核, 靠谱吗, 值得做吗, 创新够不够, idea review, scoring, and ranking; no numeric-score request is needed. Default to concept-only review without experiment assessment, including ideas extracted from manuscripts. Developing an idea belongs to ccf-idea-optimizer; evaluating manuscript evidence or writing belongs to ccf-paper-reviewer.
description_zh: 评估研究思路的价值、新颖性、洞察力与机制。用于思路审核、靠谱吗、值得做吗、创新够不够、idea review、评分和排名；无需进行数值评分。默认仅进行概念审查，不进行实验评估，包括从论文中提取的思路。构思思路属于 ccf-idea-optimizer；评估论文证据或写作属于 ccf-paper-reviewer。

description: Create a packaging design brief — structure, visual direction, hierarchy, materials, and unboxing experience. Use when the user says "packaging design", "packaging brief", "product packaging", "packaging direction", "label design", "packaging identity", "unboxing experience", "packaging look and feel", "brief my packaging designer", "packaging for my product", "packaging strategy", "retail packaging", "e-commerce packaging", "what should my packaging look like", or is briefing a designer, agency, or manufacturer on packaging requirements.
description_zh:
创建包装设计简报——结构、视觉方向、层级、材质与开箱体验。

当用户说“包装设计”“包装简报”“产品包装”“包装方向”“标签设计”“包装标识”“开箱体验”“包装外观与触感”“为我的包装设计师简报”“为我产品的包装”“包装策略”“零售包装”“电商包装”“我的包装应该是什么样子的”，或在向设计师、代理机构或制造商就包装要求简报时。

description: Plan, build, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram — campaign structure, audience targeting (core, custom, lookalike), creative formats, pixel setup, retargeting strategy, budget scaling, and ROAS optimization. Use when the user says "Meta ads", "Facebook ads", "Instagram ads", "Facebook advertising", "Meta advertising", "Meta campaigns", "Facebook campaign", "Instagram campaign", "Meta ad strategy", "ROAS", "Meta pixel", "Facebook pixel", "lookalike audiences", "Meta retargeting", "scaling Meta ads", "Facebook ad account", "Meta ads manager", "Facebook ads not working", or wants to run or improve paid social advertising on Facebook or Instagram.
description_zh: 规划、搭建并优化 Facebook 和 Instagram 的 Meta 广告系列——涵盖广告系列结构、受众定向（核心、自定义、相似受众）、创意格式、像素设置、再营销策略、预算扩量及 ROAS 优化。适用于用户提及“Meta ads”“Facebook ads”“Instagram ads”“Facebook advertising”“Meta advertising”“Meta campaigns”“Facebook campaign”“Instagram campaign”“Meta ad strategy”“ROAS”“Meta pixel”“Facebook pixel”“lookalike audiences”“Meta retargeting”“scaling Meta ads”“Facebook ad account”“Meta ads manager”“Facebook ads not working”等关键词，或希望在 Facebook 或 Instagram 上投放或优化付费社交广告时使用。

description: Build a brand's messaging hierarchy — taglines, value propositions, key messages, and proof points for each audience. Use when the user says "brand messaging", "messaging framework", "value proposition", "tagline", "brand tagline", "key messages", "messaging hierarchy", "what should we say about our brand", "brand copy foundation", "messaging architecture", "elevator pitch", "one-liner", "brand statement", or needs consistent language across all communications. Also use when messaging feels inconsistent across channels or teams.
description_zh:
建立品牌信息层级——针对每个受众制定标语、价值主张、核心信息与论据。

当用户提及"品牌信息""信息框架""价值主张""标语""品牌标语""核心信息""信息层级""我们应该如何表达品牌""品牌文案基础""信息架构""电梯演讲""一句话（或单行表述）""品牌声明"，或需要在所有沟通中保持语言一致性时使用。同时在信息在不同渠道或团队间显得不一致时使用。

description: Convert HTML to PDF with pixel-perfect rendering and excellent Hebrew/RTL support. Use when the user asks to 'convert HTML to PDF', 'generate PDF from HTML', 'create PDF from webpage', 'export to PDF', or needs PDF generation with Hebrew text support.
description_zh: 将 HTML 转换为 PDF，实现像素级精准渲染，并提供出色的希伯来语/从右向左（RTL）支持。当用户请求“将 HTML 转换为 PDF”、“从 HTML 生成 PDF”、“从网页创建 PDF”、“导出为 PDF”，或需要支持希伯来语文本的 PDF 生成功能时使用。

description: guidelines for discovering, adding, configuring, and using Botpress integrations in ADK projects - use when users ask about connecting services, managing dependencies, or using integration actions
description_zh: 用于在 ADK 项目中发现、添加、配置和使用 Botpress 集成的指南——当用户询问连接服务、管理依赖或执行集成操作时使用

description: Official integration patterns for Mapbox Maps SDK on Android. Covers installation, adding markers, user location, custom data, styles, camera control, and featureset interactions. Based on official Mapbox documentation.
description_zh: Mapbox Maps SDK for Android 官方集成模式。涵盖安装、添加标记、用户定位、自定义数据、样式、相机控制及功能集交互，基于官方 Mapbox 文档。

description: Design multi-agent architectures for complex tasks. Use when single-agent context limits are exceeded, when tasks decompose naturally into subtasks, or when specializing agents improves quality.
description_zh: 为复杂任务设计多智能体架构。在单智能体上下文限制超出、任务可自然分解为子任务，或专精智能体能提升任务质量时使用。

description: Use when you want to validate changes before committing, or when you need to check all React contribution requirements.
description_zh: 在提交前验证更改，或需要检查所有 React 贡献要求时使用。

description: Comprehensive code review for diffs. Analyzes changed code for security vulnerabilities, anti-patterns, and quality issues. Auto-detects domain (frontend/backend) from file paths.
description_zh: 对差异代码进行全面的代码审查。分析变更代码中的安全漏洞、反模式和质量问题。自动从文件路径识别所属领域（前端/后端）。

description: Implements OAuth 2.0/2.1 authorization flows in Fastify applications — configures authorization code with PKCE, client credentials, device flow, refresh token rotation, JWT validation, and token introspection/revocation endpoints. Use when setting up authentication, authorization, login flows, access tokens, API security, or securing Fastify routes with OAuth; also applies when troubleshooting token validation errors, mismatched redirect URIs, CSRF issues, scope problems, or RFC 6749/6750/7636/8252/8628 compliance questions.
description_zh: 在 Fastify 应用中实现 OAuth 2.0/2.1 授权流程——配置使用 PKCE 的授权码模式、客户端凭证模式、设备流程、刷新令牌轮换、JWT 验证，以及令牌内省/撤销端点。当设置身份验证、授权、登录流程、访问令牌、API 安全性，或使用 OAuth 保护 Fastify 路由时使用；同时在排查令牌验证错误、重定向 URI 不匹配、CSRF 问题、范围问题，或 RFC 6749/6750/7636/8252/8628 合规性疑问时同样适用。

description: Scan recent arXiv/OpenReview papers, venue feeds, labs, and competitors for overlap. Use for 竞品监控, 新论文追踪, 论文跟踪, and recurring novelty watch. Give dated evidence and changes since the prior scan. Broad related-work retrieval belongs to ccf-literature-searcher.
description_zh: 扫描近期 arXiv/OpenReview 论文、会议信息源、实验室及竞品，以排查重叠内容。用于竞品监控、新论文追踪、论文跟踪及持续性新颖性监测。提供带日期的证据，并呈现自上次扫描以来的变更情况。广泛的相关工作检索由 ccf-literature-searcher 负责。

description: Trace, complete, and interpret the Pareto frontier across competing objectives using repeated single-objective cuOpt solves (weighted-sum and ε-constraint).
description_zh: 追踪、完成并解释在不同竞争目标下的帕累托前沿，使用多次单目标 cuOpt 求解（加权求和与 ε-约束）。

description: Review a PlanetScale Vitess database for safe migrations, deploy requests, schema recommendations, Insights, webhooks, and operational safety.
description_zh: 审核 PlanetScale Vitess 数据库，涵盖安全的迁移、部署请求、架构建议、洞察、Webhooks 及运营安全。

description: Optimizes AI skills for activation, clarity, and cross-model reliability. Use when creating or editing skill packs, diagnosing weak skill uptake, reducing regressions, tuning instruction salience, improving examples, shrinking context cost, or setting benchmark/release gates for skills. Trigger terms: skill optimization, activation gap, benchmark skill, with/without skill delta, regression, context budget, prompt salience.
description_zh: 优化AI技能，以提升激活度、清晰度及跨模型可靠性。在创建或编辑技能包、诊断技能吸收不足、减少回归、调整指令显著性、改进示例、降低上下文成本，或设置技能基准/发布门禁时使用。触发术语：技能优化、激活差距、基准技能、有/无技能差异、回归、上下文预算、提示显著性。

description: Use when you need to add or debug professional web animations with GSAP (timelines, ScrollTrigger, stagger, transforms) in HTML/CSS/JS/React. Includes patterns for smooth motion, performance, and common pitfalls.
description_zh: 适用场景：当您需要为 HTML/CSS/JS/React 项目中的 GSAP 专业网页动画添加或调试（时间轴、ScrollTrigger、stagger、transform）时使用。涵盖平滑运动、性能以及常见陷阱的实用模式。

description: Comprehensive multi-perspective review using specialized judges with debate and consensus building
description_zh: 采用专业评委进行综合多视角评审，通过辩论与凝聚共识

description: Update and maintain project documentation for local code changes using multi-agent workflow with tech-writer agents. Covers docs/, READMEs, JSDoc, and API documentation.
description_zh: 使用基于技术写作代理的多智能体工作流，更新并维护本地代码修改对应的项目文档。涵盖 docs/、README、JSDoc 及 API 文档。

description: Fetch dependency source code to give AI agents deeper implementation context. Use when the agent needs to understand how a library works internally, read source code for a package, fetch implementation details for a dependency, or explore how an npm/PyPI/crates.io package is built. Triggers include "fetch source for", "read the source of", "how does X work internally", "get the implementation of", "opensrc path", or any task requiring access to dependency source code beyond types and docs.
description_zh: 获取依赖项源代码，为 AI 智能体提供更深入的实现上下文。当智能体需要理解库的内部工作原理、读取包源代码、获取依赖项的实现细节，或探索 npm/PyPI/crates.io 包构建方式时使用。触发条件包括 "fetch source for"、"read the source of"、"X 在内部如何运作"、"get the implementation of"、"opensrc 路径"，或任何需要访问依赖项源代码（超出类型与文档范畴）的任务。

description: A friendly, hand-drawn sketch interface inspired by pencil illustrations on warm cream paper. Soft teal brand accents, hand-written display headings, rounded pill controls.
description_zh: 一款友好且手绘的素描风格界面，灵感来源于温暖奶油色纸张上的铅笔插画。柔和的青蓝色品牌点缀、手写展示标题、圆角药丸式控件。

description: 在开始任何对话时使用——确立如何查找和使用技能，要求在任何响应（包括澄清性问题）之前调用 Skill 工具
description_zh: 在开始任何对话时使用——确立如何查找和使用技能，要求在任何响应（包括澄清性问题）之前调用 Skill 工具

description: Required first preflight before every CCFA skill, including research, review, retrieval, experiments, visuals, and maintenance. Keep reasoning and communication direct, remove empty defensive framing, and preserve evidence and uncertainty. Also use for 去防御性 and 论文人性化. Apply prose edits only within the authorized task; specialist skills retain ownership.
description_zh: 每次 CCFA 技能执行前均需进行首次预检，包括研究、审查、检索、实验、可视化及维护。保持推理与沟通直接，去除空泛的防御性框架，并保留证据与不确定性。同样适用于“去防御性”和“论文人性化”。仅在授权任务范围内进行文本润色修改；专项技能保留其归属。

description: Render and redesign CCF figures, visual tables, and method/architecture diagrams from supplied content. Use for 绘图美化, 排版, 配色, GPT Image 2 generation, pure SVG, and editable SVG/PDF/PPTX. Preserve values and topology. Experiment evidence design belongs to ccf-experiment-designer; manuscript rewriting and PDF-to-writing exemplars are separate.
description_zh: 基于提供内容渲染并重新设计 CCF 图表、可视化表格以及方法/架构示意图。可用于绘图美化、排版、配色、GPT Image 2 生成、纯 SVG，以及可编辑的 SVG/PDF/PPTX。保留数值与拓扑关系。实验证据设计属于 ccf-experiment-designer；文稿重写与 PDF 至文稿的范例相互独立。

description: Generate comprehensive product requirements documents. Use when starting a new feature or product initiative and need structured documentation.
description_zh: 生成全面的产品需求文档。在启动新功能或产品项目且需要结构化文档时使用。

description: A modern, graphic, editorial-poster aesthetic — warm and confident — built on alternating cream and burnt orange sections, an amber brand color.
description_zh: 一种现代、图形化、编辑海报风格的美学——温暖而自信——以奶油色与焦橙色交替的区块构建，搭配琥珀色作为品牌色。

description: Binance Derivatives-trading-coin-futures request using the Binance API. Authentication requires API key and secret key. Supports testnet and mainnet.
description_zh: Binance Derivatives-trading-coin-futures请求使用 Binance API。认证需要 API 密钥和秘密密钥。支持测试网和主网。

description:
Build React animations with Motion (formerly Framer Motion) - gestures (drag, hover, tap),
scroll effects, spring physics, layout animations, SVG, exit animations, and motion values.
Use when: building React animations, adding hover/tap/drag interactions, scroll-triggered effects,
layout transitions, shared element animations, exit animations with AnimatePresence, or working
with motion values and springs. Triggers: "animate", "motion component", "framer motion",
"gesture", "drag", "scroll animation", "layout animation", "exit animation", "spring",
"whileHover", "whileTap", "whileInView", "AnimatePresence", "layoutId", "useScroll",
"useSpring", "useAnimate", "motion value", "reorder", "parallax".
description_zh:
使用 Motion（原名 Framer Motion）构建 React 动画——手势（拖拽、悬停、点击）、滚动效果、弹簧物理、布局动画、SVG、退出动画和运动值。

适用场景：构建 React 动画、添加悬停/点击/拖拽交互、滚动触发的特效、布局过渡、共享元素动画、使用 AnimatePresence 的退出动画，以及使用运动值和弹簧效果。

触发关键词：“animate”, “motion component”, “framer motion”,
“gesture”, “drag”, “scroll animation”, “layout animation”, “exit animation”, “spring”,
“whileHover”, “whileTap”, “whileInView”, “AnimatePresence”, “layoutId”, “useScroll”,
“useSpring”, “useAnimate”, “motion value”, “reorder”, “parallax”。

description: Create publication-quality scientific diagrams using Nano Banana Pro AI with smart iterative refinement. Uses Gemini 3 Pro for quality review. Only regenerates if quality is below threshold for your document type. Specialized in neural network architectures, system diagrams, flowcharts, biological pathways, and complex scientific visualizations.
description_zh: 使用 Nano Banana Pro AI 配合智能迭代精修，创建出版级科学图表。使用 Gemini 3 Pro 进行质量审查。仅当质量低于您文档类型的阈值时，才会重新生成。专精于神经网络架构、系统图、流程图、生物通路及复杂科学可视化。

description: Provides before/after patterns for migrating test files to React 19 compatibility, including act() imports, Simulate removal, and StrictMode call count changes.
description_zh: 为将测试文件迁移至 React 19 兼容性提供迁移前/后模式，包括 act() 导入、Simulate 移除以及 StrictMode 调用次数变更。

description: 生成 Ian 风格的中文正文配图。用于用户要求为中文文章、帖子、博客、Notion 文档、工作流文档、方法论、流程、结构、状态、隐喻或观点生成“怪诞”“小黑”“手绘”“正文配图”“文章插图”“配图建议”“shot list”“去标题/改图”等任务；默认使用小黑 IP、纯白手绘、少量红橙蓝批注、简洁清爽但天马行空的视觉风格。
description_zh: 生成 Ian 风格的中文正文配图。用于用户要求为中文文章、帖子、博客、Notion 文档、工作流文档、方法论、流程、结构、状态、隐喻或观点生成“怪诞”“小黑”“手绘”“正文配图”“文章插图”“配图建议”“shot list”“去标题/改图”等任务；默认使用小黑 IP、纯白手绘、少量红橙蓝批注、简洁清爽但天马行空的视觉风格。

description: Build 3D web apps with Three.js (WebGL/WebGPU). Use for 3D scenes, animations, custom shaders, PBR materials, VR/XR experiences, games, data visualizations, product configurators.
description_zh: 使用 Three.js（WebGL/WebGPU）构建 3D Web 应用，适用于 3D 场景、动画、自定义着色器、PBR 材质、VR/XR 体验、游戏、数据可视化、产品配置器等场景。

description: Analyzes Android apps to identify key user workflows for AppFunctions such as creating a note, playing media, or sending an automated or AI agent triggered message, voice commands, or system shortcuts, without needing to open the app UI. Generates Kotlin code to expose these workflows to the Android system, allowing agents to discover and execute them on-device. Also refines KDoc documentation to ensure AI agents correctly understand and use the provided functionality.
description_zh: 分析 Android 应用，以识别 AppFunctions 的关键用户工作流，如创建笔记、播放媒体、发送由自动化或 AI 代理触发的消息、语音指令或系统快捷方式，且无需打开应用界面即可完成。生成 Kotlin 代码，将这些工作流暴露给 Android 系统，使代理能够发现并在设备上执行这些工作流。同时优化 KDoc 文档，确保 AI 代理能够正确理解并使用这些功能。

description: Generate FilamentPHP v4 resources with form, table, relation managers, and actions
description_zh: 使用表单、表格、关联管理器以及动作生成 FilamentPHP v4 资源

description: Use when creating or developing, before writing code or implementation plans - refines rough ideas into fully-formed designs through collaborative questioning, alternative exploration, and incremental validation. Don't use during clear 'mechanical' processes
description_zh: 在创建或开发时使用，在编写代码或制定实施计划之前——通过协作提问、探索替代方案和增量验证，将粗略想法细化成完整的设计。在明显的“机械性”流程中不使用。

description: Build and configure personal AI agents with memory, personality, and autonomy using OpenHanako on Electron.
description_zh: 使用OpenHanako在Electron上构建并配置具备记忆、个性与自主性的个人AI代理。

description: React Three Fiber (R3F) and Poimandres ecosystem best practices. Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing R3F code. Triggers on tasks involving @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, zustand, @react-three/postprocessing, @react-three/rapier, or leva.
description_zh: React Three Fiber (R3F) 与 Poemandres 生态系统的最佳实践。在编写、审查或优化 R3F 代码时使用。适用于涉及 @react-three/fiber、@react-three/drei、zustand、@react-three/postprocessing、@react-three/rapier 或 leva 的任务。

description: 中文文档排版参考——中英文空格、全半角标点、术语保留、链接格式、中文文案排版指北约定。仅在用户显式 /chinese-documentation 时调用，不要根据上下文自动触发。
description_zh: 中文文档排版参考——中英文空格、全半角标点、术语保留、链接格式、中文文案排版指北约定。仅在用户显式 /chinese-documentation 时调用，不要根据上下文自动触发。

description: Check CCF venue rules and submission packages: template, pages, anonymity, PDF build, metadata, and reproducibility. Use for 投稿检查, 会议格式, page limits, and artifact readiness. Verify current official rules for the exact venue/year/track. Manuscript polishing belongs to ccf-paper-writer.
description_zh: 检查 CCF 场地规则和投稿包：模板、页数、匿名性、PDF 构建、元数据和可复现性。用于投稿检查、会议格式、页数限制和产出就绪性。针对具体的场地/年份/赛道核实当前的官方规则。稿件润色由 ccf-paper-writer 负责。

description: Zod 4 schema validation patterns. Trigger: When creating or updating Zod v4 schemas for validation/parsing (forms, request payloads, adapters), including v3 -> v4 migration patterns.
description_zh:
Zod 4 模式验证模式。  
触发：当创建或更新用于验证/解析的 Zod v4 模式（表单、请求负载、适配器），包括 v3 -> v4 迁移模式时。

description: Generates Unity Search / Quick Search queries and opens the Unity Search window for read-only Unity Editor asset or scene-object lookup requests. Always use when the user asks to find, search, show, locate, filter, look up, query, or list concrete assets or scene objects in the current project or scene, even if Unity Search is not named. Covers materials, textures, prefabs, scenes, scripts, shaders, GameObjects, components, Lights, Cameras, UI objects, labels, paths, references, selected or named assets, and asset types. Also use when the user explicitly mentions Unity Search, Quick Search, Search window, open Search, or asks what Unity Search query to use. Do not use for general project overview, project structure, folder-purpose summaries, gameplay/system explanations, how-to programming questions, web search, repository text search, build logs, package installation, menu or settings search, modifying results, or non-Unity filesystem search unless the user explicitly asks to use Unity Search.
description_zh: 生成 Unity Search / 快速搜索查询，并打开 Unity Search 窗口，用于处理只读的 Unity 编辑器资产或场景对象查询请求。当用户要求查找、搜索、显示、定位、过滤、查询或列举当前项目或场景中的具体资产或场景对象时，无论 Unity Search 是否被提及，均应使用。涵盖材质、纹理、预制体、场景、脚本、着色器、游戏对象、组件、光源、相机、UI 对象、标签、路径、引用、已选择或命名的资产以及各类资产类型。当用户明确提及 Unity Search、快速搜索、搜索窗口、打开搜索，或询问应使用何种 Unity Search 查询时，也应使用。除非用户明确要求使用 Unity Search，否则不得用于项目概览、项目结构、文件夹用途总结、玩法/系统说明、编程操作指南问题、网络搜索、仓库文本搜索、构建日志、包安装、菜单或设置搜索、结果修改，或非 Unity 文件系统搜索。

description: Diagnoses and fixes skills in the dotnet/skills repository that lose to their own baseline, fail to activate, time out, or return "no credible improvement". Use when an evaluation verdict is a regression or underpowered, when a skill regressed after a change, when /evaluate reports no results, or when deciding whether a weak skill should be strengthened or retired. Do not use for scaffolding a brand-new skill (use create-skill) or a brand-new eval (use create-skill-test).
description_zh:
诊断并修复 dotnet/skills 仓库中表现低于自身基线、无法激活、超时，或返回“无可信改进”的技能。

适用于以下情况：评估结论为回归或性能不足；技能在变更后出现退化；/evaluate 报告无结果；或用于判断弱技能是否应当加强或退役。不得用于搭建全新技能（请使用 create-skill），也不得用于搭建全新评估（请使用 create-skill-test）。

description: Creates structured change proposals with specification deltas for new features, breaking changes, or architecture updates. Use when planning features, creating proposals, speccing changes, introducing new capabilities, or starting development workflows. Triggers include "openspec proposal", "create proposal", "plan change", "spec feature", "new capability", "add feature planning", "design spec".
description_zh: 为新的功能、破坏性变更或架构更新创建包含规范差异的结构化变更提案。在规划功能、创建提案、规范变更、引入新能力或启动开发工作流时使用。触发条件包括“openspec proposal”、“create proposal”、“plan change”、“spec feature”、“new capability”、“add feature planning”、“design spec”。

description: Send Google Chat messages via incoming webhooks — text, rich cards (cardsV2), threaded replies. TypeScript types, card builder utility, widget reference inline. Use whenever the user wants to post to Google Chat from a script, build a chatbot reply, send a notification card, build a Google Chat webhook integration, or troubleshoot card / threading issues.
description_zh: 通过传入 Webhook 发送 Google Chat 消息——文本、富媒体卡片（cardsV2）及线程回复。提供 TypeScript 类型、卡片构建工具及内联组件参考。当用户需要从脚本发布至 Google Chat、构建聊天机器人回复、发送通知卡片、搭建 Google Chat Webhook 集成，或排查卡片/线程问题时，即可使用。

description: Build cinematic sticky product storytelling with GSAP ScrollTrigger, progressive UI reveals, scroll-synced animation, smooth interpolation, and immersive section transitions.
description_zh: 运用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 构建电影级粘性产品叙事，通过渐进式 UI 展示、滚动同步动画、平滑插值以及沉浸式区块转场，打造沉浸式体验。

description: Distill supplied paper PDFs into writing exemplar cards and register a requested personal library. Use for PDF to writing exemplar, 写作范例, and reusable paper-writing patterns. Preserve source attribution and transfer writing logic only. Figure reconstruction, manuscript drafting, and review have separate owners.
description_zh: 将所提供的纸质 PDF 文件提炼为写作范例卡片，并登记用户所请求的个人资料库。用于 PDF 转写作范例、写作范例以及可复用的纸笔写作模式。仅保留源文件署名并转移写作逻辑，不作其他处理。图表重建、稿件起草和审核分别由不同的负责人负责。

description: Amazon product listing image strategy and optimization. Comprehensive shot planning, infographic design, lifestyle photography, mobile optimization, and conversion-focused visual content. Use when the user asks about Amazon images, product photography, visual optimization, or listing conversion.
description_zh: 亚马逊产品列表图片策略与优化。涵盖全面的拍摄策划、信息图表设计、生活摄影、移动端优化，以及以转化为导向的视觉内容。当用户询问亚马逊图片、产品摄影、视觉优化或列表转化相关问题时使用。

description: Critique a rendered screen's density — cognitive load, content prioritisation, scanning patterns, and progressive disclosure. Use when a screen feels overwhelming. For the underlying choice-count principle, use `hicks-law` (interaction-design).
description_zh: 评判渲染后界面的密度——认知负荷、内容优先级、扫描模式与渐进式披露。当界面显得令人难以应对时使用。对于其背后的选择数量原则，使用 `hicks-law`（交互设计）。

description: Use when the user's task involves Ant Design (antd) — writing antd components, debugging antd issues, querying antd APIs/props/tokens/demos, migrating between antd versions, or analyzing antd usage in a project. Triggers on antd-related code, imports from 'antd', or explicit antd questions.
description_zh: 在用户任务涉及 Ant Design（antd）时使用——包括编写 antd 组件、调试 antd 问题、查询 antd 的 API / props / tokens / demos、在不同 antd 版本间迁移，或分析项目中的 antd 使用情况。触发条件包括与 antd 相关的代码、从 'antd' 导入的代码，或明确提出 antd 相关的问题。

description: Audit all filename and naming conventions in the codebase against AGENTS.md standards and common patterns. Use when user asks to check naming conventions, audit filenames, find naming inconsistencies, or validate file naming patterns.
description_zh: 对照 AGENTS.md 的标准与常见模式，审计代码库中的所有文件名及命名规范。当用户要求检查命名规范、审计文件名、查找命名不一致或验证文件命名模式时使用。

description: Use when the user mentions Jira issues (e.g., "PROJ-123"), asks about tickets, wants to create/view/update issues, check sprint status, or manage their Jira workflow. Triggers on keywords like "jira", "issue", "ticket", "sprint", "backlog", or issue key patterns.
description_zh: 当用户提及 Jira 问题（例如“PROJ-123”）、询问工单、需要创建/查看/更新问题、检查冲刺状态或管理其 Jira 工作流时使用。当出现诸如“jira”、“issue”、“ticket”、“sprint”、“backlog”或问题键模式等关键词时触发。

description: Use when Code implementation and refactoring, architecturing or designing systems, process and workflow improvements, error handling and validation. Provide tehniquest to avoid over-engineering and apply iterative improvements.
description_zh: 适用于代码实现与重构、系统架构或设计、流程与工作流改进、错误处理与校验等场景。提供技术方法，以规避过度设计，并实施迭代改进。

description: E-commerce growth strategy advisor. Diagnoses current business health using unit economics (CAC, LTV, AOV, contribution margin), identifies the highest-impact growth opportunities across 5 levers (traffic, conversion, AOV, retention, expansion), and builds a prioritized 90-day growth roadmap. Uses the Ansoff Matrix adapted for e-commerce to evaluate market penetration, channel expansion, product expansion, and new market entry. Includes multichannel readiness assessment (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Etsy, DTC/Shopify/Shopify) and product line expansion analysis. No API key required. Use when: (1) planning next phase of e-commerce growth, (2) deciding whether to expand to new channels or products, (3) diagnosing why growth has stalled, (4) prioritizing what to fix or build next.
description_zh: 电商增长策略顾问。运用单位经济学（获客成本CAC、用户生命周期价值LTV、客单价AOV、贡献利润）诊断当前业务健康状况，识别流量、转化率、客单价、用户留存、拓展五大驱动杠杆下的最高影响力增长机会，并制定优先排序的90天增长路线图。采用适配电商的安索夫矩阵，评估市场渗透、渠道拓展、产品拓展及新市场进入。包含多渠道就绪度评估（亚马逊、沃尔玛、TikTok Shop、Etsy、DTC/Shopify/Shopify）及产品线拓展分析。无需 API 密钥。适用场景：(1) 规划电商增长的下个阶段；(2) 决定是拓展新渠道还是新产品；(3) 诊断增长停滞的原因；(4) 优先确定下一步需优化或建设的重点。

description: General guidelines for Commits, formatting, CI, dependencies, security
description_zh: 提交、格式、CI、依赖项、安全性的通用指南

description: Structural feedback on a legal writing draft (memo, brief, paper, exam essay) — organization, analysis depth, clarity, citation form. NEVER rewrites the draft. Use when the user says "feedback on my memo", "read my draft", or "critique my brief".
description_zh: 法律写作草稿的结构性反馈（备忘录、简章、论文、考试作文）——结构、分析深度、清晰度、引用格式。绝不重写草稿。当用户说“给我的备忘录反馈”、“阅读我的草稿”或“评论我的简章”时使用。

description: Plan or coordinate CCF research stages, goals, gates, artifacts, and ccfa.yaml state. Use for 任务拆解, 流程规划, project status, and explicitly requested end-to-end coordination. Specialist skills own research outputs; ccf-project-scaffolder owns folder/template creation.
description_zh: 规划或协调 CCF 研究阶段、目标、关卡、产出物以及 ccfa.yaml 状态。用于任务拆解、流程规划、项目状态，以及明确要求的端到端协调。专业技能负责研究产出；ccf-project-scaffolder 负责文件夹/模板创建。

description: Write CCF rebuttals, author responses, revision ledgers, response letters, and conservative resubmission plans. Use for 审稿意见回复, rebuttal, revision ledger, and 重投迁移. Ground promises in feasible changes and actual evidence. Ordinary manuscript writing has a separate owner.
description_zh: 撰写 CCF 反驳意见、作者回复、修订台账、回复函以及保守性重投方案。适用于审稿意见回复、反驳、修订台账和重投迁移。将承诺建立在可行的修改与实际证据之上。普通稿件撰写由专人负责。

description: Evaluate solutions through multi-round debate between independent judges until consensus
description_zh: 通过独立评委之间的多轮辩论评估解决方案，直至达成共识。

description: Modern React patterns and principles. Hooks, composition, performance, TypeScript best practices.
description_zh: 现代 React 模式与原则。Hooks、组合、性能、TypeScript 最佳实践。

description: Define a brand's target audience with deep personas, psychographics, and ICP (Ideal Customer Profile). Use when the user says "target audience", "ideal customer", "customer persona", "audience persona", "ICP", "who is our customer", "define our audience", "audience research", "buyer persona", "who should we be targeting", "audience profile", "customer profile", "who buys this", or needs to understand their audience more deeply before investing in brand or marketing work.
description_zh: 使用深度的人物画像、心理特征和 ICP（理想客户画像）来定义品牌的目标受众。当用户提及“目标受众”、“理想客户”、“客户画像”、“受众画像”、“ICP”、“我们的客户是谁”、“定义我们的受众”、“受众调研”、“买家画像”、“我们应该定位的受众群体”、“受众画像”、“客户画像”、“谁会购买此产品”，或者在为品牌或营销工作投入之前需要更深入地了解受众时，使用此方法。

description: Use when writing, reviewing, or improving Go test code — including table-driven tests, subtests, parallel tests, test helpers, test doubles, and assertions with cmp.Diff. Also use when a user asks to write a test for a Go function, even if they don't mention specific patterns like table-driven tests or subtests. Does not cover benchmark performance testing (see go-performance).
description_zh: 在编写、审查或改进 Go 测试代码时使用——包括表格驱动测试、子测试、并行测试、测试辅助函数、测试替身，以及使用 cmp.Diff 的断言。当用户要求为某个 Go 函数编写测试时，即使未提及表格驱动测试或子测试等具体模式，也应使用。不包含基准性能测试（参见 go-performance）。

description: Use when errors occur deep in execution and you need to trace back to find the original trigger - systematically traces bugs backward through call stack, adding instrumentation when needed, to identify source of invalid data or incorrect behavior
description_zh: 当执行过程中深层出现错误，需要回溯定位原始触发原因时使用——可系统性地通过调用栈回溯追踪缺陷，在需要时添加插桩，以定位无效数据或错误行为产生的源头。

description: How WAL mechanics, checkpointing, concurrency rules, recovery work in tursodb
description_zh: 在 TursoDB 中，WAL 机制、检查点、并发规则和恢复是如何工作的。

description: Start working on a Marshroom cart issue — creates branch, injects context, updates status to running
description_zh: 开始处理 Marshroom cart 问题——创建分支、注入上下文、将状态更新为运行中。

description: When the user wants to plan content for SEO, create content calendar, or build topic clusters. Also use when the user mentions "content strategy," "content plan," "topic clusters," "pillar content," "pillar page," "cluster articles," "editorial calendar," "content hub," "content planning," "content clusters," "topic cluster strategy," "content strategy for SEO," or "content calendar." For editorial mix, use content-marketing.
description_zh: 当用户需要规划 SEO 内容、创建内容日历或构建主题集群时，可使用。当用户提及“内容策略”、“内容计划”、“主题集群”、“支柱内容”、“支柱页面”、“集群文章”、“编辑日历”、“内容中心”、“内容规划”、“内容集群”、“主题集群策略”、“SEO 内容策略”或“内容日历”时，也应使用。对于编辑组合，使用内容营销。

description: When the user wants to optimize for AI search visibility (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, AI Overviews). Also use when the user mentions "GEO," "AEO," "generative engine optimization," "AI search visibility," "LLM optimization," "GitHub GEO," "Grokipedia," "optimize for ChatGPT," "AI Overviews," "Bing Copilot," "Yandex AI," "Perplexity optimization," "GEO strategy," or "AI search optimization." For third-party publishing strategy (which platforms to use), use parasite-seo. For GitHub repos, README, and Awesome lists, use github. For Medium.com only, use medium-posts. For Grokipedia edits, use grokipedia-recommendations. For traditional Google SERP strategy, use seo-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户想要优化 AI 搜索可见性（ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、AI Overviews）时。当用户提及 “GEO、”、“AEO、”、“生成式引擎优化”、“AI 搜索可见性”、“LLM 优化”、“GitHub GEO”、“Grokipedia”、“为 ChatGPT 优化”、“AI Overviews”、“Bing Copilot”、“Yandex AI”、“Perplexity 优化”、“GEO 策略” 或 “AI 搜索优化” 时。针对第三方发布策略（选择使用哪些平台），使用 parasite-seo。针对 GitHub 仓库、README 和 Awesome 列表，使用 github。仅针对 Medium.com，使用 medium-posts。针对 Grokipedia 编辑，使用 grokipedia-recommends。针对传统的 Google SERP 策略，使用 seo-strategy。

description: Initialize CCF project folders, LaTeX templates, artifact directories, and ccfa.yaml. Use for 项目初始化, 目录搭建, template setup, and reproducible workspace scaffolding. Preserve existing files. Workflow planning belongs to ccf-pipeline-orchestrator; research content belongs to its specialist owner.
description_zh: 初始化 CCF 项目文件夹、LaTeX 模板、产物目录以及 ccfa.yaml。可用于项目初始化、目录搭建、模板配置及可复现工作区搭建。保留现有文件。工作流规划由 ccf-pipeline-orchestrator 负责；研究内容由其专属负责人负责。

description: Maintain and audit Codex/CCFA skills, triggers, references, scripts, docs/SVG diagrams, installation dependencies, and release validation. Use for skill维护, GPT model adaptation, and family routing cleanup. Do not perform research writing or review.
description_zh: 维护并审计 Codex/CCFA 的技能、触发器、参考资料、脚本、文档/SVG 图、安装依赖项与发布验证。用于技能维护、GPT 模型适配和家庭路由清理。不得进行研究报告撰写或审查。

description: Electron development guidelines for building cross-platform desktop applications with JavaScript/TypeScript
description_zh: 使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 构建跨平台桌面应用的 Electron 开发指南

description: Analyze how competitors present their brand — identity, messaging, positioning, voice, and visual style — to find gaps and opportunities. Use when the user says "competitor brand analysis", "analyze competitor brands", "how do competitors position themselves", "competitor messaging", "competitor identity", "what are competitors saying", "benchmark competitors", "competitive brand landscape", "how do we compare to competitors", "competitive audit", or wants to understand the brand landscape before defining their own position.
description_zh:
分析竞争对手如何呈现其品牌——品牌身份、信息传递、定位、声音与视觉风格——以发现市场空白与机会。

适用于用户提及“竞争对手品牌分析”、“分析竞争对手品牌”、“竞争对手如何定位自身”、“竞争对手信息传递”、“竞争对手品牌身份”、“竞争对手在传递什么信息”、“对标竞争对手”、“竞争品牌格局”、“如何与竞争对手进行比较”、“竞争审计”，或在确定自身定位之前需要了解品牌格局的场景。

description: Run release validation. Triggers: "run release validation", "cut a release", "check release readiness".
description_zh: 执行发布验证。触发条件："run release validation"，"cut a release"，"check release readiness"。

description: Use when building CSS animations, JavaScript transitions, React/Vue motion, or any browser-based animation work.
description_zh: 用于构建CSS动画、JavaScript过渡、React/Vue动效，或任何基于浏览器的动画工作。

description: Assess the health and consistency of an existing brand — identity, messaging, voice, positioning, and market perception. Use when the user says "brand audit", "brand review", "assess our brand", "is our brand consistent", "brand health check", "brand analysis", "something's off with our brand", "our brand feels outdated", "brand diagnosis", "review our brand", "brand gap analysis", or wants to understand where their brand is strong and where it needs work before investing in brand development.
description_zh: 评估现有品牌的健康状况与一致性——标识、信息传达、语调、定位及市场认知。适用于当用户提及“品牌审计”、“品牌审查”、“评估我们的品牌”、“我们的品牌是否一致”、“品牌健康检查”、“品牌分析”、“我们的品牌存在问题”、“我们的品牌显得过时”、“品牌诊断”、“审查我们的品牌”、“品牌差距分析”，或希望在品牌发展投资前了解其品牌优势及待改进之处时使用。

description: Guides human users' AI agents to the NemoClaw docs MCP server and canonical Fern documentation in Markdown form. Use when users ask how to install, configure, operate, troubleshoot, secure, or learn NemoClaw with an AI coding assistant. Trigger keywords - nemoclaw docs, use nemoclaw with ai agent, nemoclaw mcp docs, nemoclaw install help, nemoclaw quickstart, nemoclaw markdown docs, llms.txt, agent skills.
description_zh: 将人类用户的AI智能体引导至NemoClaw文档MCP服务器及标准Fern文档（Markdown格式）。当用户在使用AI编码助手时，询问如何安装、配置、操作、排错、安全或学习NemoClaw时使用。触发关键词 - nemoclaw docs, use nemoclaw with ai agent, nemoclaw mcp docs, nemoclaw install help, nemoclaw quickstart, nemoclaw markdown docs, llms.txt, agent skills.

description: Use when the user is explicitly working with Quarto, .qmd files, _quarto.yml, Quarto projects, or Quarto features such as callouts, cross-references, citations, Mermaid diagrams, extensions, websites, books, presentations, and reports. Also use for explicit migration from or comparison with R Markdown, bookdown, blogdown, xaringan, distill, or Jupyter notebooks to Quarto. Do not use for general R Markdown or related-format questions unless Quarto or migration to Quarto is explicitly mentioned.
description_zh: 当用户明确使用 Quarto、.qmd 文件、_quarto.yml、Quarto 项目，或 Quarto 功能（如提示框、交叉引用、引用、Mermaid 图表、扩展、网站、书籍、演示文稿和报告）时使用。也用于将 R Markdown、bookdown、blogdown、xaringan、distill 或 Jupyter 笔记本明确迁移至 Quarto，或对比这些格式与 Quarto。不用于一般的 R Markdown 或相关格式问题，除非明确提及 Quarto 或向 Quarto 的迁移。

description: Agent skill for workflow-automation - invoke with $agent-workflow-automation
description_zh: 用于工作流自动化的智能体技能 - 通过 $agent-workflow-automation 调用

description: Create comprehensive, phased implementation plans with sprints and atomic tasks. Use when user says: "make a plan", "create a plan", "plan this out", "plan the implementation", "help me plan", "design a plan", "draft a plan", "write a plan", "outline the steps", "break this down into tasks", "what's the plan for", or any similar planning request. Also triggers on explicit "/planner" or "/plan" commands.
description_zh: 创建全面、分阶段的实施计划，包含冲刺和原子任务。当用户说“make a plan”、“create a plan”、“plan this out”、“plan the implementation”、“help me plan”、“design a plan”、“draft a plan”、“write a plan”、“outline the steps”、“break this down into tasks”、“what's the plan for”，或任何类似的规划请求时使用。此外，在明确输入 /planner 或 /plan 命令时也会触发。

description: A radically minimal, blank-canvas interface built as a pure edge-to-edge surface, with almost no color and typography carrying the visual weight. Black serves as the only filled color, the only divider, and the sole surface tone cards.
description_zh: 一款极致极简的、如白纸般空白界面的界面，作为一个纯粹的上下边缘全屏表面构建而成，几乎不依靠色彩，文字则承担视觉权重。黑色是唯一使用的填充色、唯一的分隔线，以及唯一的卡片色调。

description: Inngest expert for serverless-first background jobs, event-driven workflows, and durable execution without managing queues or workers.
description_zh: Inngest 专家，用于以无服务器优先为原则的后台任务、事件驱动工作流，以及无需管理队列或工作者的持久化执行。

description: Explain a topic like I'm a 5 year old. Use when the user types /eli5 <topic> or asks for a dead-simple picture explainer of how something works.
description_zh: 以五岁孩子的视角解释一个话题。当用户输入 /eli5 <topic 或要求一个极其简单的图片说明以解释某事物如何运作时使用。

description: Fetches raw IAM recommendations and associated security insights from Google Cloud for a specified target scope (Organization, Folder, or Project). Use when you need to retrieve security recommendations before analyzing or applying them. Don't use for applying/acting on recommendations (use the recommendation applier skill) or for general allow policy querying (use the allow policy viewer skill).
description_zh: 从 Google Cloud 为指定的目标范围（组织、文件夹或项目）获取原始 IAM 建议及关联的安全洞察。在需要获取安全建议以进行分析或应用之前使用。请勿用于应用/执行建议（使用建议执行者技能）或用于一般允许策略查询（使用允许策略查看者技能）。

description: Transcribe speech in local or remote videos with timestamps. Convert existing timed transcripts locally into SRT or ASS; use media-analysis for visual understanding.
description_zh: 对本地或远程视频中的语音进行带时间戳的转写。将现有的带时间戳的转写文件在本地转换为 SRT 或 ASS 格式；使用媒体分析进行视觉理解。

description: Scans the scene and audio assets to appropriately route Audio Sources into existing Audio Mixer Groups, classifying each source by what it plays. Use when the user asks about cleaning up mixer assignments, routing audio through a mixer, or which group a sound belongs in. Creating mixers and groups, and setting volumes, are not automated — the skill inventories what exists and asks the user to add anything missing.
description_zh: 扫描场景和音频素材，以便将音频源适当路由到现有的音频混音组中，并根据每个源播放的内容进行分类。当用户询问整理混音配置、通过混音器路由音频，或某个声音属于哪个混音组时使用。创建混音器、混音组以及设置音量并非自动化——该技能会盘点现有内容，并询问用户添加缺失的部分。

description: Product requirements and planning specialist. Creates PRDs and tech specs with functional/non-functional requirements, prioritizes features using MoSCoW/RICE frameworks, breaks down epics into user stories, and ensures requirements are testable and traceable. Use for PRD creation, requirements definition, feature prioritization, tech specs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
description_zh: 产品需求与规划专员。创建包含功能需求与非功能需求的 PRD 和技术规范，使用 MoSCoW/RICE 框架对功能进行优先级排序，将史诗拆解为用户故事，并确保需求可测试、可追溯。适用于 PRD 创建、需求定义、功能优先级排序、技术规范、史诗、用户故事及验收标准。

description: Craft a brand's origin story, founder narrative, and "why we exist" statement. Use when the user says "brand story", "origin story", "founder story", "why we exist", "about us", "our story", "company narrative", "brand narrative", "write our about page", "tell our story", "founding story", "brand history", or wants to articulate the deeper purpose and human story behind the brand. Also use when the About Us page feels generic or corporate and needs a rewrite.
description_zh:
撰写品牌的起源故事、创始人叙事及“我们为何存在”的陈述。

当用户提及“品牌故事”、“起源故事”、“创始人故事”、“我们为何存在”、“关于我们”、“我们的故事”、“公司叙事”、“品牌叙事”、“撰写我们的关于页面”、“讲述我们的故事”、“创立故事”、“品牌历史”，或希望阐述品牌背后的深层目的与人文故事时使用。

此外，当“关于我们”页面显得笼统或过于企业化，需要重写时，也使用。

description: Self-directed iterative research skill for Codex that continuously cycles through modify, verify, retain or discard, and repeat until a measurable goal is reached.
description_zh: 面向Codex的自主迭代研究技能：持续循环执行修改、验证、保留或丢弃操作，并重复进行，直至达成可衡量的目标。

description: Comprehensive software architecture skill for designing scalable, maintainable systems using ReactJS, NextJS, NodeJS, Express, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, Postgres, GraphQL, Go, Python. Includes architecture diagram generation, system design patterns, tech stack decision frameworks, and dependency analysis. Use when designing system architecture, making technical decisions, creating architecture diagrams, evaluating trade-offs, or defining integration patterns.
description_zh: 全面的软件架构技能，用于设计可扩展、可维护的系统，并基于 ReactJS、NextJS、NodeJS、Express、React Native、Swift、Kotlin、Flutter、Postgres、GraphQL、Go、Python。包括架构图生成、系统设计模式、技术栈决策框架以及依赖分析。适用于系统设计架构、进行技术决策、创建架构图、评估权衡取舍或定义集成模式。

description: Curates insights from reflections and critiques into CLAUDE.md using Agentic Context Engineering
description_zh: 利用 Agentic Context Engineering，将反思与批评中提炼的洞见整合至 CLAUDE.md。

description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session or facing 3+ independent issues that can be investigated without shared state or dependencies - dispatches fresh subagent for each task with code review between tasks, enabling fast iteration with quality gates
description_zh: 适用于执行当前会话中包含独立任务的实施计划，或面临3个及以上可独立调查、无需共享状态或依赖的问题时——为每个任务派发全新子代理，并在任务之间进行代码审查，以质量门禁实现快速迭代。

description: Patterns for durable one-shot, calendar, and fixed-interval work on Rivet Actors.
description_zh: 针对 Rivet Actors 的持久性一次性、日历及固定间隔工作模式

description: Manage SpriteAtlas using prebuild pipeline with IPreprocessBuildWithReport (DEFAULT approach). Use it to configure master atlases, variant atlases, texture settings, packing settings, and platform-specific configurations. Use when the user asks about creating sprite atlases, optimizing sprites, configuring atlas settings, adding sprites to atlases, creating variant atlases, implementing automated atlas generation, or runtime sprite atlas access. Always use prebuild approach unless user explicitly requests manual authoring.
description_zh: 使用带有 IPreprocessBuildWithReport 的预构建管线（默认方案）管理精灵图集。用于配置主图集、变体图集、纹理设置、打包设置以及平台特定配置。当用户询问创建精灵图集、优化精灵、配置图集设置、将精灵添加到图集、创建变体图集、实现自动化图集生成或运行时精灵图集访问时使用。除非用户明确要求手动制作，否则始终使用预构建方案。

description: 面向中文自然语言的 Tushare 数据研究技能。用于把“看看这只股票最近怎么样”“帮我查财报趋势”“最近哪个板块最强”“北向资金在买什么”“给我导出一份行情数据”这类请求，转成可执行的数据获取、清洗、对比、筛选、导出与简要分析流程。适用于 A 股、指数、ETF/基金、财务、估值、资金流、公告新闻、板块概念与宏观数据等研究场景。
description_zh: 面向中文自然语言的 Tushare 数据研究技能。用于将“看看这只股票最近怎么样”“帮我查财报趋势”“最近哪个板块最强”“北向资金在买什么”“给我导出一份行情数据”这类请求，转化为可执行的数据获取、清洗、对比、筛选、导出与简要分析流程。适用于 A 股、指数、ETF/基金、财务、估值、资金流、公告新闻、板块概念与宏观数据等研究场景。

description: Full-spectrum Amazon competitor analysis. Compare listings, pricing, reviews, advertising strategy, and market positioning against direct competitors. Identify weaknesses to exploit and strengths to counter. Use when the user asks about competitor analysis, competitive research, ASIN comparison, pricing analysis, or how to beat competitors on Amazon.
description_zh: 全方位亚马逊竞争对手分析。对比直接竞争对手的商品列表、定价、评价、广告策略和市场定位。识别可利用的弱点，以及需加以应对的优势。适用于用户询问竞争对手分析、竞争研究、ASIN 对比、定价分析，或如何在亚马逊上击败竞争对手时。

description: Quick remote sync shortcut. Use when user says "/sync", "동기화", "pull", "git pull", or wants to pull latest changes from remote. Defaults to pulling from origin main.
description_zh: 快速远程同步快捷方式。用户输入“/sync”、“동기화”、“pull”、“git pull”，或要求从远程拉取最新更改时使用。默认为从 origin main 拉取。

description: Information about the differential fuzzer tool, how to run it and use it catch bugs in Turso. Always load this skill when running this tool
description_zh: 关于差分模糊测试工具的信息，以及如何运行它并使用它来在 Turso 中捕获缺陷。在运行此工具时，始终加载此技能。

description: Australian business English for professional writing — warm, direct, EN-AU spelling (colour, organise, centre), no filler words. Use whenever the user is writing for an Australian audience: emails, chat messages, proposals, client communications, blog posts, web copy, or any business writing. Apply to drafting, editing, and tone-checking professional text.
description_zh: 面向专业写作的澳大利亚商务英语——温暖、直接，使用EN-AU拼写（colour、organise、centre），无冗余词。当用户为面向澳大利亚受众写作时使用：邮件、聊天消息、提案、客户沟通、博客文章、网站文案，或任何商务写作。适用于专业文本的起草、编辑和语气检查。

description: Operate and supervise Mastra Factory through `mastra api factory`. Use for Factory status or queue summaries, project and work-item inspection, metrics, health, decisions, attention, supervisor sessions, and user-authorized autonomous or interactive Factory operations on hosted, local, remote, or self-hosted servers.
description_zh: 通过 `mastra api factory` 操作和管理 Mastra Factory。用于工厂状态或队列摘要、项目和工作项检查、指标、健康、决策、关注、监管会话，以及在托管、本地、远程或自托管服务器上进行用户授权的自主或交互式工厂操作。

description: Generate or prepare models for physical 3D printing, including white or multicolor prints, Creative Lab products, sizing, and slicer handoff.
description_zh: 生成或准备用于物理3D打印的模型，包括白色或多色打印、Creative Lab 产品、尺寸设置以及切片器交接。

description: Overview of Experimental MVCC feature - snapshot isolation, versioning, limitations
description_zh: 实验性 MVCC 功能概览——快照隔离、版本控制、限制

description:
Read and search GitHub repository documentation via gitmcp.io MCP service.

**WHEN TO USE:**
- User provides a GitHub URL
- User mentions a specific repo in owner/repo format
- User asks "what does this repo do?", "read the docs for X repo", or similar
- User wants to search code or docs within a repo
description_zh:
通过 gitmcp.io MCP 服务读取并搜索 GitHub 仓库文档。

**何时使用：**
- 用户提供 GitHub URL
- 用户以 owner/repo 格式提及特定仓库
- 用户询问“这个仓库是做什么的？”“阅读 X 仓库的文档”等类似问题
- 用户希望在仓库内搜索代码或文档

description: Generate speech audio from text using HeyGen's Starfish TTS model. Use when: (1) Generating standalone speech audio files from text, (2) Converting text to speech with voice selection and speed control, (3) Creating audio for voiceovers, narration, or podcasts, (4) Working with HeyGen's /v3/voices endpoints, (5) Listing available TTS voices by language or gender.
description_zh: 使用 HeyGen 的 Starfish TTS 模型，根据文本生成语音音频。适用场景：(1) 从文本生成独立的语音音频文件；(2) 结合语音选择与语速控制，将文本转换为语音；(3) 为旁白、解说或播客制作音频；(4) 使用 HeyGen 的 /v3/voices 接口；(5) 按语言或性别列出可用的 TTS 语音。

description: Use when adding a lightweight interactive globe with cobe (canvas setup, markers, interaction, performance, integration with React/Next.js).
description_zh: 用于添加轻量级交互式地球时配合 cobe 使用（画布设置、标记、交互、性能、与 React/Next.js 的集成）。

description: Use when upgrading react-native to a newer version. Handles version bumps, native project changes (Android/iOS), dependency updates, and breaking change migration. Invoke with `/upgrade-react-native <version>`.
description_zh: 用于将 react-native 升级到新版本时使用。处理版本升级、原生项目变更（Android/iOS）、依赖更新及破坏性变更迁移。使用 `/upgrade-react-native <version>` 调用。

description: Agent skill for ops-cicd-github - invoke with $agent-ops-cicd-github
description_zh: 用于 ops-cicd-github 的 Agent 技能 - 使用 $agent-ops-cicd-github 调用

description: Refine a draft task specification into a fully planned, implementation-ready task with acceptance criteria, architecture, per-step sub-task files and verifiable phases
description_zh: 将草案任务规格完善为一项完全规划、可直接实施的完整任务，包含验收标准、架构、各步骤子任务文件以及可验证的阶段

description: Measure Jetson DRAM/NvMap usage and verify before/after memory reclamation with live audit data.
description_zh: 测量 Jetson DRAM/NvMap 使用情况，并基于实时审计数据验证内存回收前后的状态。

description: AgentDB memory system with HNSW vector search. Provides 150x-12,500x faster pattern retrieval, persistent storage, and semantic search capabilities for learning and knowledge management. Use when: need to store successful patterns, searching for similar solutions, semantic lookup of past work, learning from previous tasks, sharing knowledge between agents, building knowledge base. Skip when: no learning needed, ephemeral one-off tasks, external data sources available, read-only exploration.
description_zh:
基于 HNSW 向量搜索的 AgentDB 记忆系统。提供 150x-12,500x 更快的模式检索、持久存储和语义搜索能力，用于学习与知识管理。

适用场景：
- 需要存储成功模式
- 查找相似解决方案
- 对过往工作进行语义检索
- 从先前任务中学习
- 在不同 Agent 之间共享知识
- 构建知识库

不适用场景：
- 无需学习
- 临时一次性任务
- 已有外部数据源可用
- 只读探索

description: Build a WhatsApp marketing strategy — WhatsApp Business setup, broadcast campaigns, automated flows, customer service, drip sequences, and conversational marketing. Use when the user says "WhatsApp marketing", "WhatsApp Business", "WhatsApp campaigns", "WhatsApp broadcasts", "WhatsApp automation", "WhatsApp drip", "market on WhatsApp", "WhatsApp for business", "WhatsApp chatbot", "WhatsApp customer service", "WhatsApp API", "messaging marketing India", or wants to use WhatsApp as a marketing and customer communication channel. Especially relevant for brands in India, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Brazil, and Africa.
description_zh: 构建 WhatsApp 营销策略——WhatsApp 商业平台搭建、广播营销活动、自动化流程、客户服务、滴灌序列以及对话式营销。当用户提及 "WhatsApp 营销"、"WhatsApp 商业平台"、"WhatsApp 营销活动"、"WhatsApp 广播"、"WhatsApp 自动化"、"WhatsApp 滴灌"、"WhatsApp 营销"、"WhatsApp 商业应用"、"WhatsApp 聊天机器人"、"WhatsApp 客户服务"、"WhatsApp API"、"印度通讯营销"，或希望将 WhatsApp 作为营销与客户沟通渠道使用时，适用本策略。尤其适用于印度、中东、东南亚、巴西和非洲的品牌。

description: Set up Shopify CLI auth and Admin API access for a store. Install CLI, authenticate, create custom app, store access token, verify. Use whenever the user wants to connect to a Shopify store, set up Shopify API access, install Shopify CLI, or troubleshoot Shopify auth / Admin API token issues.
description_zh:
为店铺设置Shopify CLI认证与Admin API访问权限。

安装CLI、完成认证、创建自定义应用、生成店铺访问令牌并进行验证。

在用户需要连接Shopify店铺、设置Shopify API访问权限、安装Shopify CLI或排查Shopify认证/Admin API令牌问题的时候随时使用。

description: Structured research summarization agent skill for non-dev users. Handles academic papers, web articles, reports, and documentation. Extracts key findings, generates comparative analyses, and produces properly formatted citations. Use when: user wants to summarize a research paper, compare multiple sources, extract citations from documents, or create structured research briefs. Plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw.
description_zh: 面向非开发用户的结构化研究摘要代理技能。处理学术论文、网络文章、报告和文档。提取关键发现，生成对比分析，并生成格式规范的引用。适用场景：用户需要总结研究论文、对比多个来源、从文档中提取引用或创建结构化研究简报时。适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 OpenClaw。

description: Optimizes, improves, and debugs LLM prompts using production trace data, evaluations, and annotations. Extracts prompts from spans, gathers performance signal, and runs a data-driven optimization loop using the ax CLI. Use when the user mentions optimize prompt, improve prompt, make AI respond better, improve output quality, prompt engineering, prompt tuning, or system prompt improvement.
description_zh: 使用生产环境追踪数据、评估和标注，优化、改进和调试 LLM 提示。从 spans 中提取提示，收集性能信号，并使用 ax CLI 运行数据驱动的优化循环。当用户提及优化提示、改进提示、使 AI 响应更好、提升输出质量、提示工程、提示调优，或系统提示改进时使用。

description: Apply exact Tailwind arbitrary shadow utilities for polished, layered neutral elevation. Use when compact cards, controls, panels, popovers, hero media, feature callouts, or modal-like containers need refined shadows without default Tailwind shadow scales or colored tinting.
description_zh: 使用精确的 Tailwind 任意阴影工具类，实现精致、层次分明的中性层次效果。适用于紧凑卡片、控件、面板、弹出层、首屏媒体、功能提示或模态式容器需要精致阴影，且无需依赖默认 Tailwind 阴影层级或添加彩色色调的场景。

description: Redis Search guidance covering FT.CREATE schema design, field type selection (TEXT, TAG, NUMERIC, GEO, GEOSHAPE, VECTOR, JSON path), DIALECT 2 query syntax, FT.SEARCH / FT.AGGREGATE / FT.HYBRID command selection, vector similarity with HNSW or FLAT, hybrid retrieval combining lexical and vector ranking, RAG pipelines, zero-downtime index updates via aliases, and debugging with FT.PROFILE and FT.EXPLAIN. Use when defining a search index on Hash or JSON documents, writing FT.SEARCH queries with filters, sorting, aggregation, or vector KNN, tuning HNSW parameters, building a RAG retrieval pipeline, or troubleshooting slow or empty search results.
description_zh: Redis搜索指南，涵盖FT.CREATE模式设计、字段类型选择（TEXT、TAG、NUMERIC、GEO、GEOSHAPE、VECTOR、JSON路径）、DIALECT 2查询语法、FT.SEARCH / FT.AGGREGATE / FT.HYBRID命令选择、基于HNSW或FLAT的向量相似度、结合词法与向量排序的混合检索、RAG流水线、通过别名实现零停机索引更新以及使用FT.PROFILE和FT.EXPLAIN进行调试。当需要在Hash或JSON文档上定义搜索索引、编写包含过滤条件、排序、聚合或向量KNN的FT.SEARCH查询、调优HNSW参数、构建RAG检索流水线，或排查搜索结果缓慢或为空的问题时使用。

description: Generate a Product Requirements Document (PRD) for ralph-tui task orchestration. Creates PRDs with user stories that can be converted to beads issues or prd.json for automated execution. Triggers on: create a prd, write prd for, plan this feature, requirements for, spec out.
description_zh: 为 ralph-tui 任务编排生成产品需求文档（PRD）。创建包含用户故事、可转换为 beads issues 或 prd.json 以支持自动化执行的 PRD。触发条件：创建 PRD、为...编写 PRD、规划此功能、需求、规范制定。

description: Apply when building React components under react/ or configuring store blocks in store/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers interfaces.json, contentSchemas.json for Site Editor, VTEX Styleguide for admin apps, and css-handles for storefront styling. Use for creating custom storefront components, admin panels, pixel apps, or any frontend development within the VTEX IO react builder ecosystem.
description_zh: 适用于在 VTEX IO 应用中，于 react/ 目录下构建 React 组件或于 store/ 目录下配置 store 区块时使用。涵盖 Site Editor 的 interfaces.json 与 contentSchemas.json、管理应用的 VTEX Styleguide 以及店面样式所需的 css-handles。适用于在 VTEX IO react 构建器生态系统中创建自定义店面组件、管理面板、像素应用，或进行任何前端开发。

description: Agent skill for performance-optimizer - invoke with $agent-performance-optimizer
description_zh: 性能优化器智能体技能 - 通过 $agent-performance-optimizer 调用

description: Search, install and pull code from the 21st.dev catalog with the `21st` CLI (`@21st-dev/cli`): find React/shadcn components, themes and templates, print a component's code or a theme's CSS, install an item into the project, or generate a new component with 21st AI. Use whenever the user says "search/find a component/theme on 21st", "install our team's Button", "add @user/slug", "pull that component's code", "найди компонент на 21st", "поставь наш компонент", or wants to script catalog access from the shell/CI. Auto-activate when a project has a `components.json` — search 21st before hand-writing UI.
description_zh: 通过 `21st` CLI（`@21st-dev/cli`）从 21st.dev 目录中搜索、安装和拉取代码：查找 React/shadcn 组件、主题和模板，打印组件的代码或主题的 CSS，将某项安装到项目中，或使用 21st AI 生成新组件。当用户说“在 21st 上搜索/查找组件/主题”、“安装我们团队的 Button”、“添加 @user/slug”、“拉取该组件的代码”、“在 21st 上查找组件”、“安装我们的组件”，或希望从 shell/CI 中脚本化目录访问时，即可使用。当项目包含 `components.json` 时自动激活——在手动编写 UI 之前先搜索 21st。

description: A playful, energetic, cartoonesque interface inspired by friendly children's-book illustrations — warm cream backgrounds, big bold custom display typography, saturated brand color blocks, thick black outlines, generously rounded shapes
description_zh: 一款活泼、充满活力、富有卡通感的界面，灵感来源于亲切的儿童绘本插画——温暖米色背景、大而粗的自定义展示字体、饱和的品牌色块、粗黑描边，以及充足圆润的形状。

description: A sun-baked, clay-toned editorial interface built on warm cream surfaces, ink-brown headlines set in a display serif, and a single terracotta accent.
description_zh: 一款以暖奶油色表面为基底、带有日晒质感且呈陶土色调的编辑界面，墨褐色标题采用展示衬线字体，以及单一陶土色点缀。

description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "fix janky CSS animation", "make animation 60fps", "stop layout thrashing", "animate width/height/top/left smoothly", "convert animation to transform", "animate box-shadow performantly", "animate height auto", "FLIP animation", or "why is my scroll/hover animation choppy".
description_zh: 该技能应在用户要求做以下操作时使用：“修复卡顿的CSS动画”、“让动画达到60fps”、“停止布局抖动”、“让 width、height、top、left 平滑动画化”、“将动画转换为 transform”、“高效动画化 box-shadow”、“动画化 height auto”、“FLIP 动画”，或“为什么我的滚动/悬停动画会卡顿”。

description: Remove em-dashes and the dashes standing in for them from a user-owned scope, reading each occurrence in context and choosing the punctuation or wording that fits.
description_zh: 从用户所有范围内，移除破折号以及替代破折号的连字符，结合上下文逐一阅读，并选择合适的标点或措辞。

description: Create a layered CSS progressive blur (top or bottom) using multiple backdrop-filter masks for depth and softness. Use when asked for “progressive blur”, “gradient blur overlay”, or stepped blur masks that fade from an edge of the viewport.
description_zh: 创建分层的CSS渐进模糊（顶部或底部），使用多个backdrop-filter遮罩来营造深度与柔和感。当被要求使用“渐进模糊”、“渐变模糊覆盖层”或从视口边缘淡化的分步模糊遮罩时使用。

description: Expert guidance for browser automation and web testing using Selenium WebDriver with best practices for element location, waits, and test organization.
description_zh: 使用 Selenium WebDriver 进行浏览器自动化与 Web 测试的专家指导，涵盖元素定位、等待与测试组织的最佳实践。

description: Use when medium-to-large changes need explicit requirements, technical design, and task planning before implementation, especially for multi-module work, unclear acceptance criteria, or architecture-heavy requests.
description_zh: 适用于需要进行中等至大型变更，并在实施前明确需求、技术设计和任务规划的场景；尤其适用于多模块工作、验收标准不明确或架构要求较多的情况。

description: 通过openspec规范驱动的方法创建结构化的变更提案与规范差异。用于规划功能、创建提案、编写规范、引入新能力或启动开发流程。触发词包括 "openspec提案", "规划", "创建提案", "规划变更", "规范功能", "新功能", "新特性", "新需求", "添加功能规划", "设计规范"。
description_zh: 通过openspec规范驱动的方法创建结构化的变更提案与规范差异。用于规划功能、创建提案、编写规范、引入新能力或启动开发流程。触发词包括“openspec提案”、“规划”、“创建提案”、“规划变更”、“规范功能”、“新功能”、“新特性”、“新需求”、“添加功能规划”、“设计规范”。

description: Independently reviews findings and filters out false positives. Use when consolidated findings need validation against the actual source code. Don't use for reproducing crashes or patching code.
description_zh: 独立审查发现结果，并过滤掉假阳性。当汇总后的发现结果需与实际源代码进行验证时使用。不可用于复现崩溃或修补代码。

description: Use when drafting or editing durable prose, including docs, UI copy, comments, commit messages, and PR or issue text. Skip ordinary chat replies.
description_zh: 适用于撰写或编辑持久性文本的场景，包括文档、UI 文案、注释、提交信息、PR 或 issue 文本。跳过普通聊天回复。

description: Comprehensive React component testing with Jest and React Testing Library covering configuration, mocking strategies, async testing patterns, hooks testing, and integration testing best practices
description_zh: 使用 Jest 和 React Testing Library 的全面 React 组件测试，涵盖配置、模拟策略、异步测试模式、Hooks 测试及集成测试最佳实践

description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code - write the test first, watch it fail, write minimal code to pass; ensures tests actually verify behavior by requiring failure first
description_zh: 在任何功能或缺陷修复的实施过程中，编写实现代码之前需使用该方法：先编写测试，观察测试失败，再编写最小代码使其通过；通过先要求失败，确保测试真正验证功能行为。

description: Duck a music bed under a voice track using Sonilo — automatically lowers the music wherever the voice speaks and lifts it back in the gaps. Use when mixing a separately-generated or existing music track under narration, dialogue, or a video's own voice track, without manual volume automation.
description_zh: 使用 Sonilo 将音乐垫压在人声轨道之下——在人声说话处自动压低音乐音量，并在间隙处恢复。适用于混音时将单独生成或现有音乐轨道置于旁白、对白或视频自带人声轨道下方，且无需手动进行音量自动化。

description: Expert in building 3D experiences for the web - Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, WebGL, and interactive 3D scenes. Covers product configurators, 3D portfolios, immersive websites, and bringing depth to web experiences. Use when: 3D website, three.js, WebGL, react three fiber, 3D experience.
description_zh:
擅长为网页构建3D体验的专家——精通 Three.js、React Three Fiber、Spline、WebGL 及交互式3D场景。涵盖产品配置器、3D作品集、沉浸式网站，以及为网页体验增添深度。

适用场景：3D网站、three.js、WebGL、React Three Fiber、3D体验。

description: Expert skill for writing FreeCAD Python scripts, macros, and automation. Use when asked to create FreeCAD models, parametric objects, Part/Mesh/Sketcher scripts, workbench tools, GUI dialogs with PySide, Coin3D scenegraph manipulation, or any FreeCAD Python API task. Covers FreeCAD scripting basics, geometry creation, FeaturePython objects, interface tools, and macro development.
description_zh: 编写 FreeCAD Python 脚本、宏与自动化方面的专家技能。当被要求创建 FreeCAD 模型、参数化对象、Part/Mesh/Sketcher 脚本、工作台工具、使用 PySide 的 GUI 对话框、Coin3D 场景图操作，或任何 FreeCAD Python API 任务时使用。涵盖 FreeCAD 脚本基础、几何创建、FeaturePython 对象、界面工具以及宏开发。

description: A cyber-slick, dark-only Matrix-inspired interface defined by minimalist fashion, high-tech digital elements
description_zh: 一种仅以深色呈现、受《黑客帝国》启发、以极简时尚和高科技数字元素为特色的赛博风格界面。

description: Pre-processes the repository by generating security-focused summaries (mantis-summary.md) for each directory to make planning and research more efficient. Use when starting a review campaign to map the codebase before threat modeling and planning. Don't use for executing code reviews, writing test scripts, or patching code.
description_zh: 对仓库进行预处理，通过为每个目录生成专注于安全的摘要（mantis-summary.md），以提高规划和研究的效率。在威胁建模与规划之前，启动审查活动时，用于映射代码库。不可用于执行代码审查、编写测试脚本或修复代码。

description: Guided git workflows: prepare PRs, clean up branches, resolve merge conflicts, handle monorepo tags, squash-and-merge patterns. Use when asked to prepare a PR, clean branches, resolve conflicts, or tag a release.
description_zh: 引导式 Git 工作流：准备 PR、清理分支、解决合并冲突、处理 monorepo 标签、Squash 合并模式。当被要求准备 PR、清理分支、解决冲突或标记发布版本时使用。

description: When the user wants to plan website structure, decide which pages to build, or prioritize pages for a new or existing site. Also use when the user mentions "website structure," "site structure," "which pages do I need," "page planning," "sitemap planning," "Must Have pages," "website architecture," or "site hierarchy." For a specific page template (e.g. homepage), use homepage-generator or landing-page-generator as appropriate. Not for organic SEO roadmap alone; use seo-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户想要规划网站结构、决定要构建哪些页面，或为新建或现有网站优先安排页面时使用。当用户提及“网站结构”、“站点结构”、“我需要哪些页面”、“页面规划”、“网站地图规划”、“必备页面”、“网站架构”或“站点层级”时，也使用。对于特定页面模板（例如首页），酌情使用首页生成器或落地页生成器。仅用于有机SEO路线图时，请使用SEO策略。

description: Migration guide for developers moving from Google Maps Platform to Mapbox GL JS, covering API equivalents, pattern translations, and key differences
description_zh: 从 Google Maps Platform 迁移至 Mapbox GL JS 的开发者迁移指南，涵盖 API 对应关系、模式转换及关键差异

description: Design principles for building polished, native-feeling SwiftUI apps and widgets. Use this skill when creating or modifying SwiftUI views, iOS widgets (WidgetKit), or any native Apple UI. Ensures proper spacing, typography, colors, and widget implementations that look and feel like quality apps rather than AI-generated slop.
