description: Instrument an application with Sentry — detect the platform, install and initialize the SDK if needed, and wire up any signal — error monitoring, tracing/performance, logging, metrics, profiling, session replay, user feedback, cron check-ins, and AI/LLM monitoring (agent runs, token cost, and conversations for OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI, LangChain, Google GenAI, Pydantic AI, Laravel AI, Eve, Flue, the Cloudflare Agents SDK, and Workers AI). Use to add Sentry to a project or to capture more than errors.
description_zh: 用 Sentry 配置应用程序 — 检测平台，如需则安装并初始化 SDK，并配置相关信号：错误监控、追踪/性能、日志记录、指标、性能分析、会话回放、用户反馈、计划任务检查，以及 AI/大语言模型监控（涵盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、Vercel AI、LangChain、Google GenAI、Pydantic AI、Laravel AI、Eve、Flue、Cloudflare Agents SDK 和 Workers AI 的 Agent 运行、Token 消耗与对话）。用于在项目中集成 Sentry，或捕获比错误监控范围更广的问题。

description: Audits production source code files based on the strategy in workspace/plan.json. Use when a review plan exists and you need to perform static analysis and deep-dive reviews of targeted files. Don't use for planning, deduplicating, or writing patches.
description_zh: 根据 workspace/plan.json 中的策略审核生产源代码文件。当存在审查计划，且需要针对目标文件进行静态分析并深度审查时使用。请勿用于规划、去重或编写补丁。

description: Create and manage Shopify pages, blog posts, navigation menus, redirects, and SEO metadata via the Admin API or browser automation. Use whenever the user wants to add a page to a Shopify store, write a Shopify blog post, update the storefront navigation, manage redirects, or tune SEO metadata on a Shopify site.
description_zh: 通过管理后台 API 或浏览器自动化，创建并管理 Shopify 页面、博客文章、导航菜单、重定向以及 SEO 元数据。当用户需要在 Shopify 店铺中添加页面、撰写 Shopify 博客文章、更新店铺前台导航、管理重定向或调整 Shopify 站点的 SEO 元数据时，可随时使用。

description: Comprehensive Amazon advertising strategy and campaign optimization. Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display campaign management, budget allocation, ACoS optimization, and performance tracking. Use when the user asks about Amazon PPC, advertising strategy, campaign optimization, or Amazon ads management.
description_zh: 全面的Amazon广告策略和活动优化。管理Sponsored Products、Sponsored Brands、Sponsored Display活动，预算分配、ACoS优化和绩效跟踪。当用户询问Amazon PPC、广告策略、活动优化或Amazon广告管理时使用。

description: Agent spawning, lifecycle management, and coordination patterns. Manages 60+ agent types with specialized capabilities. Use when: spawning agents, coordinating multi-agent tasks, managing agent pools. Skip when: single-agent work, no coordination needed.
description_zh: 智能体生成、生命周期管理及协调模式。管理60多种具备专业能力的智能体类型。适用场景：生成智能体、协调多智能体任务、管理智能体池。跳过场景：单一智能体工作，无需协调。

description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

Build a User Generated Content (UGC) strategy — getting customers to create content, review generation, UGC briefs for creators, social campaigns, contest mechanics, legal rights management, and repurposing UGC in paid ads. Use when the user says "UGC", "user generated content", "get customers to create content", "customer content", "UGC ads", "UGC creators", "organic UGC", "UGC strategy", "how do we get customers to post about us", "brand hashtag", "UGC brief", "influencer UGC", "UGC for ads", "customer photos and videos", or wants to use real customer content to build trust and reduce content production costs.
description_zh: 构建用户生成内容（UGC）策略——引导客户创作内容、审核与生成用户内容、向创作者提供 UGC 简报、开展社交媒体活动、设计竞赛机制、进行法律权益管理，并将 UGC 重新用于付费广告。适用于当用户提及"UGC"、"用户生成内容"、"引导客户创作内容"、"客户内容"、"UGC 广告"、"UGC 创作者"、"有机 UGC"、"UGC 策略"、"如何引导客户为我们发布内容"、"品牌标签"、"UGC 简报"、"达人 UGC"、"用于广告的客户内容"或希望借助真实客户内容建立信任、降低内容制作成本等场景时使用。

description: World-class computer vision skill for image/video processing, object detection, segmentation, and visual AI systems. Expertise in PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLO, SAM, diffusion models, and vision transformers. Includes 3D vision, video analysis, real-time processing, and production deployment. Use when building vision AI systems, implementing object detection, training custom vision models, or optimizing inference pipelines.
description_zh: 世界级的计算机视觉技能，覆盖图像/视频处理、目标检测、图像分割及视觉AI系统领域。精通PyTorch、OpenCV、YOLO、SAM、扩散模型和视觉Transformer。涵盖3D视觉、视频分析、实时处理及生产部署。适用于构建视觉AI系统、实施目标检测、训练定制视觉模型或优化推理流水线。

description: Wires an existing, active Agentforce agent to a channel by resolving a fallback queue, setting up inbound routing (either PATCH SessionHandlerId on the MessagingChannel, or an inbound RoutingFlow for Voice/Email), and optionally configuring outbound escalation. Use when the user wants to add a channel to an existing agent, connect an agent to a messaging or voice channel, route Voice or Email-to-Case to an Agentforce agent, or set up a fallback queue for an agent channel. Also applies to an existing Help Agent. The channel infrastructure must already exist — this skill adds routing. DO NOT TRIGGER when the agent does not yet exist or still needs Help Agent setup (use agentforce-generate or service-helpagent-coordinate), when setting up Email-to-Case with an agent end-to-end (use service-email-to-case-configure), when creating the MessagingChannel itself (use service-digital-engagement-channel-configure), or when creating an Embedded Service Deployment (use service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure).
description_zh:
通过解析备用队列、设置入站路由（在 MessagingChannel 上使用 PATCH SessionHandlerId，或为 Voice/Email 设置入站 RoutingFlow），并可选地配置出站升级，将现有的活跃 Agentforce 代理连接到渠道。

适用于用户想要将渠道添加到现有代理中、将代理连接到消息或语音渠道、将语音或邮件转案件路由到 Agentforce 代理，或为代理渠道设置备用队列的情况。同样适用于现有的 Help Agent。

渠道基础设施必须已经存在——本技能添加路由功能。当代理尚不存在或仍需进行 Help Agent 设置（请使用 agentforce-generate 或 service-helpagent-coordinate）时，不要触发；当需要端到端设置 Email-to-Case 时（请使用 service-email-to-case-configure），不要触发；当需要创建 MessagingChannel 本身时（请使用 service-digital-engagement-channel-configure），不要触发；或者当需要创建 Embedded Service Deployment 时（请使用 service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure），不要触发。

description: Teaches JavaScript compression techniques including Gzip and Brotli. Use when optimizing network transfer times or configuring server-side compression for production builds.
description_zh: 教授 JavaScript 压缩技术，包括 Gzip 和 Brotli。适用于优化网络传输时间，或为生产构建配置服务端压缩。

description: Define how multiple brands, sub-brands, and product lines relate to each other under one organization. Use when the user says "brand architecture", "sub-brand", "brand portfolio", "master brand", "house of brands", "branded house", "product naming system", "how do our brands relate", "parent brand", "brand hierarchy", "brand family", "we have multiple products and need a naming system", "brand extension", "new product launch under existing brand", or when a company has grown beyond a single brand and needs a system to manage brand relationships.
description_zh: 定义多个品牌、子品牌和产品线在同一个组织下如何相互关联。当用户说出“品牌架构”、“子品牌”、“品牌组合”、“主导品牌”、“品牌屋”、“品牌商”、“产品命名系统”、“我们的品牌如何关联”、“母品牌”、“品牌层级”、“品牌家族”、“我们拥有多种产品并需要命名系统”、“品牌延伸”、“在现有品牌下推出新产品”，或者当公司规模已超越单一品牌、需要一套体系来管理品牌关系时，使用本定义。

description: Publish the current Convex app to a live *.convex.app URL (deploy backend + upload web build).
description_zh: 将当前 Convex 应用发布到线上 *.convex.app URL（部署后端 + 上传 Web 构建）。

description: Query Funda AI financial data via two surfaces: the MCP server at https://funda.ai/api/mcp for analyst-grade research synthesis (DCF, comps, earnings previews/recaps, sector deep-dives, SEC filings, transcripts, supply-chain mapping, ownership flow, macro framing) via the agent_chat tool — OR the REST API at https://api.funda.ai/v1 with FUNDA_API_KEY for raw data (real-time quotes, intraday candles, EOD prices, financial statements, options chains/greeks/GEX, supply-chain KG, social sentiment, news, calendars, FRED, ESG, congressional trades, AI hiring signals). Triggers: "funda", "funda.ai", real-time quote, stock price, intraday, balance sheet, income statement, options chain, DCF, comps, earnings preview/recap, analyst estimates, 10-K/10-Q/8-K, transcript, ownership flow, gamma exposure, supply chain, sector deep-dive, congressional trades, FRED. Prefer MCP for synthesis/analysis questions; use REST for raw structured data the MCP declines.
description_zh: 通过两个接口查询 Funda AI 财务数据：位于 https://funda.ai/api/mcp 的 MCP 服务端，用于分析师级研究综合（DCF、comps、盈利预告/回顾、行业深度剖析、SEC 文件、会议记录/转录、供应链映射、所有权流向、宏观框架），通过 agent_chat 工具实现——或位于 https://api.funda.ai/v1 的 REST API，使用 FUNDA_API_KEY 获取原始数据（实时报价、盘中蜡烛图、收盘价格、财务报表、期权链/greeks/GEX、供应链知识图谱、社交情绪、新闻、日历、FRED、ESG、国会交易、AI 招聘信号）。触发词："funda"、"funda.ai"、实时报价、股票价格、盘中、资产负债表、损益表、期权链、DCF、comps、盈利预告/回顾、分析师预估、10-K/10-Q/8-K、转录、所有权流向、伽玛敞口、供应链、行业深度剖析、国会交易、FRED。优先使用 MCP 处理综合/分析类问题；若 MCP 拒绝处理，则使用 REST 获取原始结构化数据。

description:
Generate AI images from text prompts. Triggers on: "生成图片", "画一张",
"AI图", "generate image", "配图", "create picture", "draw", "visualize",
"generate an image".
description_zh: 根据文本提示生成AI图像。触发词："生成图片", "画一张", "AI图", "生成图像", "配图", "创建图片", "绘制", "可视化", "生成一张图片"。

description: AI-powered OSINT agent with interactive REPL, MCP server, and CLI for email/username/domain/IP/phone investigation using 11 integrated tools
description_zh: AI驱动的OSINT智能体，配备交互式REPL、MCP服务器及命令行工具，用于邮箱、用户名、域名、IP及电话的调查，集成了11个集成工具。

description:
Use this skill for any PostgreSQL database work — table design, indexing, data types, constraints, extensions (pgvector, PostGIS, TimescaleDB), search, and migrations.

**Trigger when user asks to:**
- Design or modify PostgreSQL tables, schemas, or data models
- Choose data types, constraints, indexes, or partitioning strategies
- Work with pgvector embeddings, semantic search, or RAG
- Set up full-text search, hybrid search, or BM25 ranking
- Use PostGIS for spatial/geographic data
- Set up TimescaleDB hypertables for time-series data
- Migrate tables to hypertables or evaluate migration candidates
- Plan or execute safe schema migrations with zero downtime

**Keywords:** PostgreSQL, Postgres, SQL, schema, table design, indexes, constraints, pgvector, PostGIS, TimescaleDB, hypertable, semantic search, hybrid search, BM25, time-series, migration
description_zh:
针对任何 PostgreSQL 数据库工作，使用此技能——表设计、索引、数据类型、约束、扩展（pgvector、PostGIS、TimescaleDB）、搜索和迁移。

**当用户要求时触发：**
- 设计或修改 PostgreSQL 表、模式或数据模型
- 选择数据类型、约束、索引或分区策略
- 处理 pgvector 嵌入、语义搜索或 RAG
- 设置全文搜索、混合搜索或 BM25 排序
- 使用 PostGIS 处理空间/地理数据
- 为时序数据设置 TimescaleDB 超表
- 将表迁移到超表或评估迁移候选
- 计划或执行零停机时的安全模式迁移

**关键词：**
PostgreSQL, Postgres, SQL, schema, table design, indexes, constraints, pgvector, PostGIS, TimescaleDB, hypertable, semantic search, hybrid search, BM25, time-series, migration

description: Generates a human-readable security review packet compiled from confirmed findings and exploit chains. Use at the end of a review cycle to produce stakeholder-facing documentation. Don't use for auditing code or verifying patches directly.
description_zh: 生成一份由已确认的发现和利用链编译而成的、供人阅读的安全审查数据包。在审查周期结束时使用，以生成面向利益相关者的文档。请勿直接用于代码审计或验证补丁。

description: Integration patterns for Mapbox MCP Server in AI applications and agent frameworks. Covers runtime integration with pydantic-ai, mastra, LangChain, and custom agents. Use when building AI-powered applications that need geospatial capabilities.
description_zh: 面向 AI 应用与智能体框架的 Mapbox MCP 服务器集成模式。涵盖与 pydantic-ai、mastra、LangChain 及自定义智能体的运行时集成。在构建需要地理空间能力的 AI 驱动应用程序时使用。

description: Author a new OM skill from a brief, or split an oversized SKILL.md into layered references/ files — conservatively, behind the lint + completeness gate. Knows the layering philosophy, lint invariants, tracker abstraction, and the cross-skill contract, so output matches house conventions. Use for "create a skill for…", "new om-skill", "split this skill into references".
description_zh: 根据简报编写新的 OM 技能，或将过大的 SKILL.md 拆分为分层参考/文件——谨慎地，在 lint 完整性检查门禁通过后。了解分层理念、lint 不变量、追踪器抽象和跨技能契约，因此输出符合组织惯例。用于“create a skill for……”, “new om-skill”, “split this skill into references”。

description: Build an AI agent backend with persistent memory: one Rivet Actor per conversation, queued message handling, and streaming LLM responses as realtime events.
description_zh: 构建具备持久化记忆的AI代理后端：每会话一个Rivet Actor，消息处理采用排队方式，并将LLM响应以实时事件的形式进行流式传输。

description: Vector embeddings with HNSW indexing, sql.js persistence, and hyperbolic support. 75x faster with agentic-flow integration. Use when: semantic search, pattern matching, similarity queries, knowledge retrieval. Skip when: exact text matching, simple lookups, no semantic understanding needed.
description_zh:
向量嵌入，支持 HNSW 索引、sql.js 持久化及双曲空间支持。结合 agentic-flow 集成后，速度提升 75 倍。

使用场景：语义搜索、模式匹配、相似性查询、知识检索。

不使用场景：精确文本匹配、简单查找、无需语义理解的情况。

description: React performance optimization guidelines. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React components to ensure optimal rendering and bundle patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, hooks, memoization, or bundle optimization.
description_zh: React性能优化指南。用于编写、评审或重构React组件，以确保最优渲染和打包模式。适用于涉及React组件、自定义Hook、记忆化或打包优化的任务。

description: This skill should be used when generating comprehensive test cases from PRD documents or user requirements. Triggers when users request test case generation, QA planning, test scenario creation, or need structured test documentation. Produces detailed test cases covering functional, edge case, error handling, and state transition scenarios.
description_zh: 本技能应在从需求文档或用户需求中生成全面测试用例时使用。当用户请求测试用例生成、QA规划、测试场景创建或需要结构化测试文档时，触发。生成涵盖功能场景、边界场景、错误处理及状态转换场景的详细测试用例。

description: Integrate EVM blockchains using viem. Use when user says "read blockchain data", "send transaction", "interact with smart contract", "connect to Ethereum", "use viem", "use wagmi", "wallet integration", "viem setup", or mentions blockchain/EVM development with TypeScript.
description_zh: 使用 viem 集成 EVM 区块链。当用户提到“读取区块链数据”、“发送交易”、“与智能合约交互”、“连接到以太坊”、“使用 viem”、“使用 wagmi”、“钱包集成”、“viem 配置”，或提及 TypeScript 中的区块链/EVM 开发时使用。

description: Analyze Google Analytics data, review website performance metrics, identify traffic patterns, and suggest data-driven improvements. Use when the user asks about analytics, website metrics, traffic analysis, conversion rates, user behavior, or performance optimization.
description_zh: 分析 Google Analytics 数据，审查网站性能指标，识别流量模式，并提出数据驱动的优化建议。当用户询问有关分析、网站指标、流量分析、转化率、用户行为或性能优化时使用。

description: Orchestrator for setting up Agentforce in Salesforce Service Cloud ITSM — Agentforce Studio enablement, the IT Service Fulfiller agent, the IT Service Employee agent, specialized employee agents, and human escalation. Use when the user asks to set up Agentforce for ITSM, enable Studio and the Fulfiller/Employee agents together, configure employee-agent escalation, wants a guided Agentforce ITSM walkthrough, or asks what Agentforce features are available for IT Service. Presents available Agentforce capabilities and delegates each selection to a specialized child skill while tracking progress. Triggers on: set up agentforce for itsm, configure agentforce studio and fulfiller, agentforce itsm walkthrough, what agentforce features for it service. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the user asks to enable Agentforce Studio alone, asks to create or activate the Fulfiller or Employee agent alone, asks to configure escalation alone, or asks about CMDB, Incident Management, Teams, or general ITSM setup without Agentforce intent.
description_zh:
**设置 Salesforce Service Cloud ITSM 平台中 Agentforce 的编排器**
——负责 Agentforce Studio 启用、IT Service Fulfiller 代理、IT Service 员工代理、专业员工代理及人工升级。

**使用时机：**
当用户要求设置 ITSM 平台的 Agentforce、同时启用 Studio 与 Fulfiller/员工代理、配置员工代理升级流程、需要 Agentforce ITSM 引导流程，或询问 IT 服务场景下可用的 Agentforce 功能时使用。

**功能说明：**
展示可用的 Agentforce 功能能力，并将各项功能选择委托给对应的专业子技能处理，同时跟踪执行进度。

**触发条件：**
- 设置 ITSM 的 Agentforce
- 配置 Agentforce Studio 与 Fulfiller
- Agentforce ITSM 引导流程
- 询问 IT 服务的 Agentforce 功能

**不触发场景：**
- 用户单独要求启用 Agentforce Studio
- 用户单独要求创建或激活 Fulfiller 或员工代理
- 用户单独要求配置升级流程
- 用户询问关于 CMDB、事件管理、Teams 或通用 ITSM 配置，且不包含 Agentforce 相关意图时

description: Check the current app's pinned Convex components against recommended versions and upgrade them behind a build gate.
description_zh: 检查当前应用中被锁定的 Convex 组件与推荐版本是否一致，并在构建门禁管控下对其进行升级。

description: Use when the user asks for language swap or a task matching the examples below. Translate and dub a video into another language. One worker call preserves each speaker's voice, translates the speech, and returns a fully A/V-synced video. Lipsync ON by default. Use when the user says "translate this video", "dub this in <language>", "make this Spanish/French/Japanese", "translate the audio", or asks for bilingual subtitles on a dubbed/language-swap output. NOT for: subtitles/captions only (use add_captions or video-captions), transcription only (use transcribe_audio directly), or translating on-screen text overlays.
description_zh: 当用户要求语言互换或与以下示例匹配的任务时使用。将视频翻译成另一种语言并进行配音。一次 worker 调用即可保留每位说话者的声音，翻译语音内容，并返回完全 A/V 同步的视频。默认开启同步（Lipsync）。当用户说“translate this video”, “dub this in <language＞”, “make this Spanish/French/Japanese”, “translate the audio”，或在配音/语言转换输出上要求双语字幕时使用。不适用于：仅字幕/片名（subtitles/captions）（使用 add_captions 或 video-captions）、仅转录（直接使用 transcribe_audio）、或翻译屏幕文字叠加层。

description: This skill should be used when analyzing CSV datasets, handling missing values through intelligent imputation, and creating interactive dashboards to visualize data trends. Use this skill for tasks involving data quality assessment, automated missing value detection and filling, statistical analysis, and generating Plotly Dash dashboards for exploratory data analysis.
description_zh: 当分析 CSV 数据集、通过智能填充处理缺失值以及创建用于可视化数据趋势的交互式仪表盘时，应使用此技能。请在处理涉及数据质量评估、缺失值的自动检测与填充、统计分析以及为探索性数据分析生成 Plotly Dash 仪表盘的任务时使用此技能。

description: Downloads videos from YouTube and other platforms for offline viewing, editing, or archival. Handles various formats and quality options.
description_zh: 从 YouTube 及其他平台下载视频，支持离线观看、编辑或归档。支持多种格式和画质选项。

description: Use this skill when designing terminal user interfaces, creating TUI layouts, choosing TUI color schemes, implementing keyboard navigation, building terminal dashboards, or working with any TUI framework. Activates on mentions of TUI design, terminal UI, Ratatui layout, Ink components, Textual widgets, Bubbletea views, terminal color palette, keybinding design, panel layout, split panes, terminal dashboard, box-drawing characters, sparklines, progress bars, modal dialogs, focus management, or terminal accessibility.
description_zh:
当设计终端用户界面（TUI）、创建 TUI 布局、选择 TUI 配色方案、实现键盘导航、构建终端仪表盘，或处理任何 TUI 框架时，请使用本技能。

在提及 TUI 设计、终端用户界面、Ratatui 布局、Ink 组件、Textual 控件、Bubbletea 视图、终端配色方案、按键绑定设计、面板布局、分割面板、终端仪表盘、图形字符、sparklines（迷你趋势图）、进度条、模态对话框、焦点管理或终端可访问性时，本技能激活。

description: Audit and consolidate a fact that's scattered across places into one canonical source, after approval, and replace the rest with references. Use when asked to find duplication, check consistency, locate the source of truth, deduplicate, consolidate, unify, or establish SSOT across artifacts or platforms. Starts read-only, reports the map and plan, then mutates only after explicit approval.

跳过场景：简单的 Bug 修复、文档更新、配置变更、定义清晰的小任务、日常维护。

description: Generates unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests for React/Next.js applications. Scans components to create Jest + React Testing Library test stubs, analyzes Istanbul/LCOV coverage reports to surface gaps, scaffolds Playwright test files from Next.js routes, mocks API calls with MSW, creates test fixtures, and configures test runners. Use when the user asks to "generate tests", "write unit tests", "analyze test coverage", "scaffold E2E tests", "set up Playwright", "configure Jest", "implement testing patterns", or "improve test quality".
description_zh: 为 React/Next.js 应用程序生成单元测试、集成测试与 E2E 测试。扫描组件以创建 Jest 与 React Testing Library 的测试桩，分析 Istanbul/LCOV 覆盖率报告以识别覆盖漏洞，基于 Next.js 路由搭建 Playwright 测试文件，使用 MSW 模拟 API 调用，创建测试夹具，并配置测试运行器。适用于用户提出"生成测试"、"编写单元测试"、"分析测试覆盖率"、"搭建 E2E 测试"、"配置 Playwright"、"配置 Jest"、"实现测试模式"或"提升测试质量"等需求时使用。

description: A fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback that enables AI agents to navigate, click, type, and snapshot pages via structured commands.
description_zh: 基于 Rust 的快速无头浏览器自动化 CLI 工具，内置 Node.js 兜底方案，支持通过结构化命令，让 AI 智能体完成页面导航、点击、输入及页面快照操作。

description: Check or repair structural hygiene in AgentOps skill packages. Triggers: "heal skill", "repair skill hygiene", "audit skill structure", "check skill package".
description_zh: 检查或修复 AgentOps 技能包的结构卫生。触发条件：“heal skill”、“repair skill hygiene”、“audit skill structure”、“check skill package”。

description: Generate 6 clickbait-style LinkedIn hook variations for any topic. Two-line hooks built on the formula: a 40-char opening line, a 40-char bold contrast line. Uses supplied numbers and genuine first-person experience when available. Use this skill whenever the user says "write me hooks", "hook ideas", "generate hooks", "I need a hook for a post about...", or pastes a topic and asks for openers. Fast output, no preamble.
description_zh: 为任何主题生成6个具有点击诱饵风格的领英钩子变体。钩子采用两行公式构建：40个字符的开场白，以及40个字符的加粗对比句。在可用时，使用所提供的数字和真实的亲身经历。当用户说“为我写钩子”、“需要钩子创意”、“生成钩子”，或针对某篇文章说“我需要关于……的钩子”，亦或是粘贴主题并要求提供开场句式时，请使用此技能。快速输出，不附带任何前言。

description: Deploys an Agentforce Concierge portal on an LWR Experience Cloud site: provisions the site, configures Concierge components, sets up branding, wires the agent, enables guest access, and publishes. Use when the user wants to stand up a Help Portal / Agentforce Concierge portal — standalone or as the channel step in a Help Agent setup. Requires an existing, active Agentforce Service Agent on the org. DO NOT TRIGGER when the user only wants to embed a chat widget on an existing site (use service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure instead).
description_zh: 部署 LWR 体验云站点上的 Agentforce 礼宾门户：设置站点、配置礼宾组件、设置品牌标识、关联客户代理、启用访客访问并发布。当用户需要搭建帮助门户/Agentforce 礼宾门户（可独立部署，或作为帮助代理设置中的渠道步骤）时使用。需要组织内已存在且活跃的 Agentforce 服务代理。当用户仅需要在现有站点上嵌入聊天组件时，切勿触发（请改用 service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure）。

description: Create and activate the IT Service Fulfiller agent as a Next-Gen Authoring (NGA) native agent from the shipped ITSM Fulfiller template's Agent Script, using the Salesforce CLI (sf): read the template, check idempotency, create the NGA bundle then publish and activate it, then verify it is live. Idempotent per developer name. The Fulfiller agent is the IT-technician-facing assistant for incident triage, case summarization, field updates, and related-record automations. Use when asked to create the Fulfiller agent, set up the IT Service Fulfiller agent, provision the fulfiller assistant, or activate the Fulfiller agent. Triggers: create fulfiller agent, set up fulfiller agent, provision fulfiller agent, activate fulfiller agent. DO NOT TRIGGER: checking org prerequisites (service-itsm-agentic-setup-agentforce-studio-validate), or CMDB CRUD.
description_zh:
从随附的 ITS M Fulfiller 模板的 Agent Script 中，使用 Salesforce CLI（sf）创建并激活 IT Service Fulfiller 代理，作为下一代作者（NGA）原生代理：读取模板、检查幂等性、创建 NGA bundle，然后发布并激活它，最后验证其已上线。按开发者名称幂等。

Fulfiller 代理是面向 IT 技术人员的助手，用于事件分诊、案件总结、字段更新以及关联记录的自动化。当被要求创建 Fulfiller 代理、设置 IT Service Fulfiller 代理、配置 Fulfiller 助手或激活 Fulfiller 代理时使用。

触发条件：创建 Fulfiller 代理、设置 Fulfiller 代理、配置 Fulfiller 代理、激活 Fulfiller 代理。

不得触发：检查组织前提条件（service-itsm-agentic-setup-agentforce-studio-validate），或 CMDB CRUD。

description: Generates and runs crash reproducers to verify security flaws. Use when viable findings exist and you need to write and execute a script or payload to verify the crash. Don't use for code auditing or patching.

description: Generate project documentation from codebase analysis — ARCHITECTURE.md, API_ENDPOINTS.md, DATABASE_SCHEMA.md. Reads source code, schema files, routes, and config to produce accurate, structured docs. Use when starting a project, onboarding contributors, or when docs are missing or stale. Triggers: 'generate docs', 'document architecture', 'create api docs', 'document schema', 'project documentation', 'write architecture doc'.

description: End-to-end Incident SLA setup for Service Cloud ITSM — creating a MilestoneType, an Incident-scoped SLA Policy (SlaProcess), attaching a Milestone with criteria, and wiring an Entitlement so Incidents derive an EntityMilestone with a computed TargetDate. Use when the user asks to configure SLA milestones on Incidents, create an SLA policy for Incident records, set up entitlement processes for ITSM, wire milestones so they appear on the Incident page, or enable SLA tracking for incident management. description_zh: 端到端Service Cloud ITSM事件SLA配置——创建里程碑类型、针对事件的SLA策略（SlaProcess）、添加带条件的里程碑，并配置权限，使事件派生具有计算目标日期的实体里程碑。当用户要求为事件配置SLA里程碑、为事件记录创建SLA策略、为ITSM设置权限流程、配置里程碑以在事件页面显示，或为事件管理启用SLA追踪时使用。请勿触发以下情况：用户询问案例权限或案例SLA（而非事件）、查询现有SLA策略但无配置意图、与事件无关的一般权限SObject CRUD，或仅用于报告目的的事件里程碑查询。

description: Generate talking head avatar videos with Pruna P-Video-Avatar via inference.sh CLI. Turn a portrait image into a realistic speaking video with built-in TTS. 18x faster and 6x cheaper than competitors. Models: P-Video-Avatar, P-Image (for portrait generation). Capabilities: text-to-avatar, audio-driven avatars, 30 voices, 10 languages, 720p/1080p, built-in TTS, dynamic backgrounds, full-body control. Use for: AI presenters, product demos, explainer videos, virtual influencers, marketing, education, multilingual content, UGC, gaming avatars. Triggers: avatar video, talking head, ai avatar, p-video-avatar, pruna avatar, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, virtual presenter, lipsync, talking avatar, ai spokesperson, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, veed alternative, fabric alternative, omnihuman alternative
description_zh:
通过 `inference.sh` CLI 使用 Pruna P-Video-Avatar 生成口播头像视频。利用内置 TTS，将人像图片转化为逼真的说话视频。相比竞品，速度提升 18 倍，成本降低 6 倍。

模型：P-Video-Avatar、P-Image（用于人像生成）。

功能特性：文生头像、音频驱动头像、30 种声音、10 种语言、720p/1080p 分辨率、内置 TTS、动态背景、全身控制。

适用场景：AI 主播、产品演示、讲解视频、虚拟网红、营销、教育、多语言内容、UGC、游戏形象。

触发词：头像视频、口播、AI 头像、p-video-avatar、pruna avatar、视频头像、AI 主播、数字人、虚拟主播、唇形同步、说话头像、AI 发言人、heygen 替代方案、synthesia 替代方案、veed 替代方案、fabric 替代方案、omnihuman 替代方案。

description: When the user wants to optimize content for SEO—word count, H2 keywords, keyword density, multimedia, tables, lists. Also use when the user mentions "content length," "word count," "keyword stuffing," "H2 keywords," "keyword density," "tables," "bullet points," or "content structure." For keywords, use keyword-research.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化内容以符合SEO要求时——包括字数、H2关键词、关键词密度、多媒体、表格和列表。用户提及“内容长度”“字数”“关键词堆砌”“H2关键词”“关键词密度”“表格”“项目符号”“内容结构”时，也使用此功能。关键词方面，使用关键词调研。

description: Attack a plan, design, or argument like you want it to fail before you commit real effort — return the single load-bearing objection and the cheapest experiment that would prove it matters, not a checklist. User-invoked on purpose: a hate-it reflex always in the agent's reach would bias it toward demolition. Weighs many failure axes but owns the synthesis to one root.
description_zh:
在付诸实际努力之前，就仿佛希望它失败一般，去攻击计划、设计或论据；只返回那起决定性作用的关键反对意见，以及证明其重要性所需的最廉价实验，而非清单。

这是有意识地被用户触发的：一种“反感”的本能若始终处于智能体的可及范围内，会使其偏向于摧毁。

权衡诸多失败维度，但将其综合归结于一个根源。

description: Teaches resource prefetching strategies for faster navigation. Use when you can predict which resources the user will need next and want to load them during idle time.

description: Generate, inpaint, and outpaint music with ACE Step on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. ACE Step is StepFun-AI's open-weights music foundation model — tag-driven composition (genre, mood, instruments), multilingual lyrics with section markers, 5 s to 4 min stereo output, $0.0002–0.0003 per second (≈ 27× cheaper than ElevenLabs Music). Four endpoints: ACE Step text-to-audio (the default), ACE Step 1.5 text-to-audio (50+ language lyrics, refined structured-lyric handling), ACE Step audio-inpaint (regenerate a time range inside an existing track), ACE Step audio-outpaint (extend an existing track before or after). Triggers on "ace step", "ace-step", "acestep", "ACE music", "open music model", "cheap AI music", "inpaint audio", "audio inpaint", "extend music", "audio outpaint", "lengthen track", "music with tags", or any explicit ask to generate or edit music with ACE Step.
description_zh:
通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上使用 ACE Step 生成、修复（inpaint）和延绘（outpaint）音乐。

ACE Step 是 StepFun-AI 的开放权重音乐基础模型——基于标签的编曲（曲风、情绪、乐器），带段落标记的多语言歌词，5 秒至 4 分钟立体声输出，每秒 $0.0002–0.0003（≈ 比 ElevenLabs Music 便宜 27 倍）。

四个端点：
- ACE Step 文本转音频（默认）
- ACE Step 1.5 文本转音频（50+ 种语言歌词，优化结构化歌词处理）

description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上编辑图片——该技能是一个智能路由，可依据用户意图，将用户匹配至 RunComfy 目录中合适的编辑模型。技能会选取 Nano Banana Edit（支持最多20张批量处理，默认保持身份一致性）、OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit（支持多语言图像内文本重写、多参考图构图与精准布局）、Flux Kon text Pro（单参考高保真本地编辑），或 Z-Image Turbo Inpaint（基于蒙版精准区域编辑）。该技能集成了各模型文档中记录的提示词模式，以确保编辑效果更精准，避免在错误模型上消耗迭代次数。通过本地 RunComfy 命令行工具（CLI）调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/ <model>/edit`。当触发“图像编辑”、“编辑图像”、“图像到图像”、“i2i”、“替换背景”、“移除物体”、“重写标题”，或任何明确的单张或批量图片编辑请求时，该技能被触发。

description: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't available and the region must be described instead. Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area. Triggers on "inpaint", "inpainting", "image inpaint", "remove from image", "fill region", "mask-driven edit", "remove watermark", "remove object", "patch the photo", "fill the hole", or any explicit ask to edit a specific masked region of a still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上实现的基于掩码的图像修复。路由至通义万相 MAI Z-Image Turbo 图像修复（专用图像修复端点，具备掩码、强度及控制缩放功能）以及具有身份保持功能的编辑模型（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Konpt Pro），当未提供掩码且需以区域描述代替时。用于对象去除、水印去除、区域替换、瑕疵清理以及任何受控的局部编辑，其中二进制掩码定义目标区域。触发条件包括“inpaint”、“inpainting”、“image inpaint”、“remove from image”、“fill region”、“mask-driven edit”、“remove watermark”、“remove object”、“patch the photo”、“fill the hole”，或任何要求编辑特定掩码区域的静态图像的明确指令。

description: Image outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend a still beyond its original canvas, fill in what the camera didn't capture, change aspect ratio (square → 16:9, portrait → landscape) while preserving the original content. Routes across Nano Banana 2 Edit (default, spatial-language driven), GPT Image 2 Edit (multi-ref with reference-style matching), FLUX Kontext Pro (single-shot maximum-preservation), and the brand edit endpoints (Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2). Picks the right route based on whether the outpaint is prose-driven, reference-driven, or brand-locked. Triggers on "outpaint", "outpainting", "extend image canvas", "expand the image", "fill in around the photo", "uncrop", "change aspect ratio", "extend frame", "wide-screen from square", or any explicit ask to add canvas around an existing still.
description_zh:
通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行图像外扩——将静态图像扩展至原始画布之外，填补摄像机未捕捉到的部分，在保留原始内容的同时改变画面比例（从正方形变更为 16:9、从竖屏变更为横屏）。

提供多条路线：Nano Banana 2 Edit（默认，以空间与语言驱动）、GPT Image 2 Edit（多参考，采用参考风格匹配）、FLUX Konft Pro（单次生成，最大程度保留），以及品牌编辑接口（Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2）。根据外扩任务以文本驱动、参考驱动还是品牌锁定来选择合适路线。

触发关键词包括："outpaint"、"outpainting"、"extend image canvas"、"expand the image"、"fill in around the photo"、"uncrop"、"change aspect ratio"、"extend frame"、"wide-screen from square"，或任何明确要求为现有静态图像添加画布区域请求。

description: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio. Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the caller gets sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video` (or endpoint variant) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image to video", "image-to-video", "i2v", "animate image", "make this move", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video.
description_zh:
在 RunComfy 中为任意静态图像添加动画 —— 本技能是一个智能路由器，能够将用户意图与 RunComfy 目录中的正确 i2v 模型进行匹配。针对通用动画，选择 HappyHorse 1.0 I2V（竞技场 #1，原生音频，身份保持）；针对自定义配音口型同步，使用带 `audio_url` 的 Wan 2.7；针对图像、参考视频与参考音频的多模态动画，选择 Seedance 2.0 Pro。它将每个模型的标注提示词模式进行整合，使调用方能够获得更出色的输出，而无需在多错误的模型上浪费计算次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>//<model>/image-to-video`（或接口变体）。

触发条件为"image to video"、"image-to-video"、"i2v"、"animate image"、"make this move"，或任何将静态图像转化为视频的明确指令。

description: Kling 3.0 video generation on RunComfy. Kling 3.0 (also called Kling V3.0) is Kuaishou Technology's third-generation multi-shot video model with native synchronized audio and consistent character identity across shots. This skill covers all six Kling 3.0 endpoints, spanning three rendering tiers (Standard, Pro, 4K) and two modes (text-to-video, image-to-video). Calls runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/<mode> through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "kling", "kling 3.0", "kling v3", "kling pro", "kling 4k", "kling text to video", "kling image to video", or any explicit ask to generate or animate with Kling 3.0.
description_zh:
RunComfy 平台上的 Kling 3.0 视频生成

Kling 3.0（又称 Kling V3.0）是快手科技推出的第三代多镜头视频模型，具备原生同步音频以及跨镜头一致的角色身份特性。本技能覆盖全部六个 Kling 3.0 接口，涵盖三种渲染层级（标准版、专业版、4K）与两种模式（文字生成视频、图像生成视频）。调用方式通过本地 RunComfy CLI 执行 `runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/</mode}`。触发条件包括 "kling"、"kling 3.0"、"kling v3"、"kling pro"、"kling 4k"、"kling text to video"、"kling image to video"，以及任何明确要求使用 Kling 3.0 进行生成或动画制作的需求。

description: Lip-sync a face to a specific audio track on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar from a portrait + audio), Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro (state-of-the-art mouth sync onto a video), Kling lipsync (audio-to- video and text-to-video with synced speech), and Creatify lipsync. The skill picks the right endpoint for the user's actual intent — portrait still + audio (avatar-style), source video + audio (mouth- swap on existing footage), or generate-and-sync from a script. Triggers on "lip sync", "lipsync", "make this video speak", "match audio to mouth", "dub video", "sync lips to voice", "Sync Labs", "voiceover sync", or any explicit ask to drive a face's mouth from an audio track.
description_zh: 使用 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上将面部与特定音频轨道进行唇形同步。覆盖 ByteDance OmniHuman（基于肖像和音频的音控驱动全身虚拟人）、Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro（在视频上实现最先进的口型同步）、Kling lipsync（音频转视频与文本转视频，且语音口型同步），以及 Creatify lipsync。该技能会根据用户实际需求选择正确的端点——即静态肖像与音频（虚拟人风格）、源视频与音频（现有素材的口型替换），或基于脚本生成并同步。触发词包括 "lip sync"、"lipsync"、"make this video speak"、"match audio to mouth"、"dub video"、"sync lips to voice"、"Sync Labs"、"voiceover sync"，以及任何要求以音频轨道驱动面部口型的明确指令。

description: Generate images with Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini-family flash-tier text-to-image) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents Nano Banana 2's strengths (rapid iteration, in-image typography rendering, predictable framing, optional web-grounded context), the resolution-tier pricing, the safety-tolerance dial, and when to route to Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana", "nano-banana-2", "nano banana 2", "google image gen", "gemini image", or any explicit ask to generate with this model.
description_zh: 通过 RunComfy 使用 Google Nano Banana 2（Gemini 家族闪存级文生图）生成图像——内置该模型文档记录的提示词模式，使该技能产生的输出比针对同一模型采用朴素提示词的方式更为精准锐利。说明 Nano Banana 2 的优势（快速迭代、图像内字体排版渲染、可预期的构图、可选的网页溯源上下文），按分辨率档位的定价，安全容差调节，以及何时应改用 Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream 替代。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/ text-to-image`。当触发词为“nano banana”、“nano-banana-2”、“nano banana 2”、“google image gen”、“gemini image”，或任何明确要求使用本模型生成时触发。

description: Edit images with Google Nano Banana 2 (image-to-image edit endpoint) on RunComfy. Documents Nano Banana Edit's strengths (preserve subject identity, swap background, localize edits with spatial language, multi-image batch edits up to 20 inputs), the schema, and when to route to GPT Image 2 edit / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana edit", "edit with nano banana", "image edit nano banana", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 Google Nano Banana 2（图像到图像编辑端点）编辑图像。说明 Nano Banana Edit 的优势（保持主体身份、替换背景、使用空间语言进行局部化编辑、支持最多 20 个输入的批量多图编辑），该 schema，以及何时应改用 GPT Image 2 edit / Flux Konxt / Nano Banana 2 t2i 进行处理。通过本地的 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit`。在触发词“nano banana edit”、“edit with nano banana”、“image edit nano banana”或任何明确要求使用该模型进行编辑的请求时触发。

description: Relight a still image — change the lighting setup, color temperature, direction, or mood — on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Qwen Edit 2509's dedicated `relight` LoRA endpoint for purpose-built relighting, with fallback to identity-preserving edit endpoints (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when prose lighting language is enough. Use for product relighting (studio softbox → window light), portrait mood shift (overcast → golden hour), or color-grade change. Triggers on "relight", "relighting", "change the lighting", "make it golden hour", "studio lighting", "rim light", "blue hour", "soft window light", "change light direction", "color temperature", or any explicit ask to alter how a still is lit.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上对静态图像重新打光——调整照明设置、色温、方向或氛围。该功能将请求路由至 Qwen Edit 2509 的专用 `relight` LoRA 端点，进行专为重新打光设计的处理；当自然语言中的打光描述已足够时，回退至保持身份的编辑端点（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Kontxt Pro）。可用于产品重新打光（影棚柔光箱 → 窗光）、人像氛围转换（阴天 → 黄金时刻）或调色调整。触发条件为包含“重新打光”“正在重新打光”“调整照明”“使其呈现黄金时刻”“影棚照明”“轮廓光”“蓝调时刻”“柔和窗光”“改变光线方向”“色温”，或任何明确要求改变静态图像打光方式的表述。

description: Run any model on RunComfy from the command line. The `runcomfy` CLI is one binary, one auth, hundreds of model endpoints — image generation, image edit, video generation, image-to-video, lip-sync, face swap, video edit, inpainting, outpainting, extend, ControlNet, relight, upscale, LoRA training and more. Submit a request, poll for status, download the output. This skill teaches the agent how to install, authenticate, discover model schemas, invoke models, stream / poll / no-wait, script in JSON output mode, and handle errors. Triggers on "runcomfy cli", "install runcomfy", "runcomfy login", "runcomfy run", "runcomfy whoami", "runcomfy api", or any explicit ask to call a RunComfy model from a script or terminal. Sibling skills (ai-image-generation, ai-video-generation, image-edit, video-edit, face-swap, lipsync, image-to-video, image-inpainting, image-outpainting, video-extend, controlnet-pose, relight) all dispatch through this CLI.
description_zh: 从命令行在 RunComfy 上运行任何模型。`runcomfy` CLI 是单一二进制文件、单一身份验证，拥有数百个模型接口——涵盖图像生成、图像编辑、视频生成、图像转视频、口型同步、换脸、视频编辑、图像修复、图像延伸、扩展、ControlNet、重打光、放大、LoRA 训练等功能。提交请求，轮询状态，下载输出结果。本技能教授智能体如何安装、身份验证、发现模型模式（schema）、调用模型、流式传输/轮询/不等待，在 JSON 输出模式下进行脚本编写，并处理错误。触发条件包括 "runcomfy cli"、"install runcomfy"、"runcomfy login"、"runcomfy run"、"runcomfy whoami"、"runcomfy api"，或任何通过脚本或终端显式要求调用 RunComfy 模型的请求。相关技能（ai-image-generation、ai-video-generation、image-edit、video-edit、face-swap、lipsync、image-to-video、image-inpainting、image-outpainting、video-extend、controlnet-pose、relight）均通过此 CLI 进行分发。

description: Generate cinematic short-form video with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro on RunComfy. Documents Seedance 2.0 Pro's strengths (multi-modal references — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio — synchronized in-pass audio with natural lip-sync, cinematic motion refinement), the 4–15s duration schema, and when to route to HappyHorse 1.0 / Wan 2.7 / Kling instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-v2/pro` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "seedance", "seedance 2", "seedance v2", "seedance pro", "bytedance video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.
description_zh: 使用 RunComfy 上的 ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro 生成电影感短格式视频。阐述 Seedance 2.0 Pro 的优势（多模态参考——最多支持 9 张图像、3 个视频、3 段音频；实时同步内录音频，实现自然口型同步；电影感动态优化），4–15 秒时长方案，以及何时应将其路由至 HappyHorse 1.0 / Wan 2.7 / Kling。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-v2/pro`。在触发词为“seedance”、“seedance 2”、“seedance v2”、“seedance pro”、“bytedance video”或任何要求使用该模型生成视频的明确请求时触发。

description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上编辑现有视频 —— 该技能是一个智能路由，用于将用户意图与 RunComfy 目录中的合适编辑模型进行匹配。选择 Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（通用重绘 / 背景替换 / 包装替换，保留身份与动作）、Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control（将参考视频中的精确动作迁移至目标角色）、或 Lucy Edit Restyle（轻量级、保持身份稳定的重绘 / 服装替换）。该技能整合了各模型的文档化提示词模式，从而在执行编辑时更为精准，避免因错误模型而浪费迭代次数。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run <vendor>/`/<model>/`/<endpoint>`。在遇到“video edit”（视频编辑）、“edit video”（编辑视频）、“restyle video”（视频重绘）、“swap video background”（替换视频背景）、“motion control”（动作控制）、“outfit swap video”（服装替换视频），或任何明确要求转换视频的指令时触发。

description: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. Use when the user has a short Veo clip and wants it longer, or wants a chained narrative built shot-by-shot from a single seed clip. Triggers on "extend video", "continue video", "longer video", "video extend", "make this clip longer", "Veo extend", "chain video shots", "video continuation", or any explicit ask to take an existing video and add more frames after it.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上延长或继续现有的视频片段。该功能路由至 Google Veo 3-1 的 `extend-video` 和 `fast/extend-video` 接口——用户需选择源视频及描述后续内容的提示词，模型将生成一段以一致的运动、灯光和主体身份延续原始视频的片段。适用于用户拥有较短的 Veo 视频片段但希望延长其时长，或希望基于单个种子视频片段逐镜头构建连贯叙事的情形。触发条件包括 "extend video"、"continue video"、"longer video"、"video extend"、"make this clip longer"、"Veo extend"、"chain video shots"、"video continuation"，或任何明确要求将现有视频作为基础并添加后续画面的请求。

description: Region edits across video frames on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — remove an object that appears across many frames, clean up wires or watermarks, replace a region with matching motion. Routes across Wan 2-7 edit-video (default, prompt-driven region edits with spatial language), Lucy Edit Restyle (identity-stable region-aware restyle), and Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential (when treating the clip as a frame stack). Picks the right route based on whether the change is prose-driven, identity-locked, or needs frame-by-frame still inpaint chained into a video. Triggers on "video inpaint", "video inpainting", "remove from video", "mask region in video", "clean up video", "remove object from clip", "video patch", "frame-by-frame edit", "remove watermark from video", "remove passing person", or any explicit ask to edit a region across video frames.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上执行跨视频帧的区域编辑——移除在多帧中出现的对象、清理电线或水印、用匹配的运动替换区域。提供 Wan 2-7 视频编辑（默认设置、具备空间语言的提示词驱动区域编辑）、Lucy Edit Restyle（身份保持的区域感知重塑）和 Seedream 4-0 顺序编辑（当将片段视为帧堆栈时）的路由路径。根据需求是文本驱动、身份锁定，还是需要将逐帧静态修复串联到视频中，选择合适的路由。触发条件包括 "video inpaint"、"video inpainting"、"remove from video"、"mask region in video"、"clean up video"、"remove object from clip"、"video patch"、"frame-by-frame edit"、"remove watermark from video"、"remove passing person"，或任何明确要求跨视频帧编辑区域的请求。

description: Video outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend the spatial canvas of a video, change aspect ratio (9:16 vertical to 16:9 horizontal or vice versa), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action. Routes prompt-shaped spatial extension through Wan 2-7 edit-video and points the agent at dedicated ComfyUI outpaint workflows when seam quality matters for hero delivery. Triggers on "video outpaint", "video outpainting", "extend video canvas", "expand video frame", "uncrop video", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal video", "16:9 from 9:16", "TikTok to YouTube", or any explicit ask to extend a video spatially beyond its original frame.
description_zh:
通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行视频外扩——扩展视频空间画布，更改宽高比（将 9:16 竖向转换为 16:9 横向，或反之），在原始画面之外添加环境并保留中心动作。系统将提示词驱动的空间扩展路由至 Wan 2-7 编辑视频，并在英雄级交付对接缝质量有要求时，将代理指向专用的 ComfyUI 外扩工作流。

触发条件包括："video outpaint"、"video outpainting"、"extend video canvas"、"expand video frame"、"uncrop video"、"aspect ratio change"、"vertical to horizontal video"、"16:9 from 9:16"、"TikTok to YouTube"，或任何明确要求将视频在原始画面之外进行空间扩展的请求。

description: Generate text-to-video with Wan 2.7 (Wan-AI's flagship motion model) on RunComfy. Documents Wan 2.7's strengths (multi-reference conditioning, audio-driven lip-sync via `audio_url`, smoother transitions, prompt expansion), the duration / resolution / aspect-ratio schema, and when to route to HappyHorse 1.0 / Seedance 2.0 / Kling / LTX 2 instead. Calls `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-2-7/text-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "wan", "wan 2.7", "wan-2-7", "wan video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.

This skill teaches the agent how to install, authenticate, discover model schemas, invoke models, stream / poll / no-wait, script in JSON output mode, and handle errors. Also covers the catalog (`models list` / `get`), account balance, Serverless ComfyUI deployments (`deployments`), and LoRA training (`datasets`, `train`). Triggers on "runcomfy cli", "install runcomfy", "runcomfy login", "runcomfy run", "runcomfy whoami", "runcomfy api", "runcomfy deployments", "runcomfy train", "deploy a comfyui workflow", "train a lora on runcomfy", or any explicit ask to call a RunComfy model from a script or terminal. Sibling skills (ai-image-generation, ai-video-generation, image-edit, video-edit, face-swap, lipsync, image-to-video, image-inpainting, image-outpainting, video-extend, controlnet-pose, relight) all dispatch through this CLI.

description: Plan, write, and diagnose Instagram Reels that earn cold-audience reach. Built around what Mosseri has publicly named as the signal hierarchy (watch time, sends per reach, likes per reach), the Trial Reels test-then-publish loop, the Original Content Guidelines and 30-day recovery window, the Edits app, and Reels Insights metrics (skip rate, share rate, followers from this post). Covers a Reels-specific reels strategy: send-driving CTAs, originality without watermarks, audio licensing by account type, captions as the primary SEO signal, and the anti-patterns that quietly cap distribution. Pattern-based guidance, not a virality promise.

本内容围绕 Mosseri 公开界定的信号层级（观看时长、每触达发送次数、每触达点赞数）、Trial Reels 的测试后发布循环、原始内容准则与 30 天恢复期、Edits 应用以及 Reels 洞察指标（跳过率、分享率、本帖带来的粉丝）展开构建。

内容涵盖 Reels 专属的 Reels 策略：以发送为导向的行动号召（CTAs）、去水印的原创性、按账号类型进行音频授权、以文案作为主要 SEO 信号，以及悄然限制传播的反模式。

这属于基于模式的指导，而非病毒式传播的承诺。
